name: TDA.placeholder_add_zero
statement: theorem placeholder_add_zero (x : ℝ) : x + 0 = x
proof: := add_zero x

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.CommonAmbient.isometry_left
statement:
theorem CommonAmbient.isometry_left (a : CommonAmbient X Y) :
    letI := a.metric
    Isometry a.left
proof:
:= by
  let : MetricSpace a.carrier := a.metric
  exact Isometry.of_dist_eq a.left_dist

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.CommonAmbient.isometry_right
statement:
theorem CommonAmbient.isometry_right (a : CommonAmbient X Y) :
    letI := a.metric
    Isometry a.right
proof:
:= by
  let : MetricSpace a.carrier := a.metric
  exact Isometry.of_dist_eq a.right_dist

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.landmarkCoordinates_dist
statement:
theorem landmarkCoordinates_dist (p : I → Z) (i : I) (z : Z) :
    dist (landmarkCoordinates p (p i)) (landmarkCoordinates p z) = dist (p i) z
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (dist_pi_le_iff dist_nonneg).2
    intro j
    simpa only [landmarkCoordinates, Real.dist_eq, dist_comm (p j)] using abs_dist_sub_le (p i) z (p j)
  · have h := dist_le_pi_dist (landmarkCoordinates p (p i)) (landmarkCoordinates p z) i
    simpa [landmarkCoordinates, Real.dist_eq] using h

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.gromovProkhorovEDist_le_cost
statement:
theorem gromovProkhorovEDist_le_cost (a : CommonAmbient X Y) :
    gromovProkhorovEDist X Y ≤ a.cost
proof: := iInf_le _ a

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.gromovProkhorovEDist_lt_iff
statement:
theorem gromovProkhorovEDist_lt_iff {δ : ℝ≥0∞} :
    gromovProkhorovEDist X Y < δ ↔ ∃ a : CommonAmbient X Y, a.cost < δ
proof:
:=
  iInf_lt_iff

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.CommonAmbient.cost_symm
statement: theorem CommonAmbient.cost_symm (a : CommonAmbient X Y) : a.symm.cost = a.cost
proof:
:= by
  let : MetricSpace a.carrier := a.metric
  let : MeasurableSpace a.carrier := borel _
  change levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure a.right) (uniformMeasure a.left) =
    levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure a.left) (uniformMeasure a.right)
  exact levyProkhorovEDist_comm _ _

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.gromovProkhorovEDist_comm
statement:
theorem gromovProkhorovEDist_comm :
    gromovProkhorovEDist X Y = gromovProkhorovEDist Y X
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_iInf
    intro a
    exact (gromovProkhorovEDist_le_cost a.symm).trans_eq a.cost_symm
  · apply le_iInf
    intro a
    exact (gromovProkhorovEDist_le_cost a.symm).trans_eq a.cost_symm

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.coordinatesAmbient_cost
statement:
theorem coordinatesAmbient_cost [MeasurableSpace Z] [OpensMeasurableSpace Z]
    (p : X → Z) (q : Y → Z) (hp : Isometry p) (hq : Isometry q) :
    (coordinatesAmbient p q hp hq).cost =
      levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure p) (uniformMeasure q)
proof:
:= by
  let : MeasurableSpace ((X ⊕ Y) → ℝ) := borel _
  let : BorelSpace ((X ⊕ Y) → ℝ) := ⟨rfl⟩
  exact levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_eq_of_cross_dist_eq
    (landmarkCoordinates (Sum.elim p q) ∘ p) (landmarkCoordinates (Sum.elim p q) ∘ q) p q
    (fun x y => landmarkCoordinates_dist (Sum.elim p q) (Sum.inl x) (q y))

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.gromovProkhorovEDist_le_ambient
statement:
theorem gromovProkhorovEDist_le_ambient [MeasurableSpace Z] [OpensMeasurableSpace Z]
    (p : X → Z) (q : Y → Z) (hp : Isometry p) (hq : Isometry q) :
    gromovProkhorovEDist X Y ≤ levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure p) (uniformMeasure q)
proof:
:=
  (gromovProkhorovEDist_le_cost (coordinatesAmbient p q hp hq)).trans_eq
    (coordinatesAmbient_cost p q hp hq)

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.CommonAmbient.cost_le_one
statement: theorem CommonAmbient.cost_le_one (a : CommonAmbient X Y) : a.cost ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  let : MetricSpace a.carrier := a.metric
  let : MeasurableSpace a.carrier := borel _
  change levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure a.left) (uniformMeasure a.right) ≤ 1
  simpa only [measure_univ, max_self] using
    levyProkhorovEDist_le_max_measure_univ (uniformMeasure a.left) (uniformMeasure a.right)

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.gromovProkhorovEDist_le_one
statement: theorem gromovProkhorovEDist_le_one : gromovProkhorovEDist X Y ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (gromovProkhorovEDist_le_cost (disjointAmbient (X := X) (Y := Y))).trans
    (CommonAmbient.cost_le_one _)

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.gromovProkhorovEDist_embedding_le
statement:
theorem gromovProkhorovEDist_embedding_le (i : X ↪ Y) (hi : Isometry i) :
    gromovProkhorovEDist X Y ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (((Fintype.card Y : ℝ) - Fintype.card X) / Fintype.card Y)
proof:
:= by
  let : MeasurableSpace (ULift.{u} Y) := borel _
  let : BorelSpace (ULift.{u} Y) := ⟨rfl⟩
  apply (gromovProkhorovEDist_le_cost (inclusionAmbient i hi)).trans
  exact levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_embedding_le i (fun y : Y => (⟨y⟩ : ULift.{u} Y))

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.gromovProkhorovEDist_self
statement: @[simp] theorem gromovProkhorovEDist_self : gromovProkhorovEDist X X = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  simpa using gromovProkhorovEDist_embedding_le (Function.Embedding.refl X) isometry_id

name: TDA.Topology.mem_interMember_iff
statement:
theorem mem_interMember_iff {σ : Finset I} {x : X} :
    x ∈ interMember V σ ↔ ∀ i ∈ σ, x ∈ V i
proof:
:=
  Set.mem_iInter₂

name: TDA.Topology.interMember_anti
statement:
theorem interMember_anti {σ τ : Finset I} (h : τ ⊆ σ) :
    interMember V σ ⊆ interMember V τ
proof:
:= fun _ hx =>
  (mem_interMember_iff V).2 fun i hi => (mem_interMember_iff V).1 hx i (h hi)

name: TDA.Topology.interMember_subset
statement:
theorem interMember_subset {σ : Finset I} {i : I} (hi : i ∈ σ) :
    interMember V σ ⊆ V i
proof:
:= fun _ hx =>
  (mem_interMember_iff V).1 hx i hi

name: TDA.Topology.interMember_singleton
statement: theorem interMember_singleton (i : I) : interMember V {i} = V i
proof:
:=
  Finset.set_biInter_singleton i V

name: TDA.Topology.interMember_insert
statement:
theorem interMember_insert [DecidableEq I] (i : I) (σ : Finset I) :
    interMember V (insert i σ) = V i ∩ interMember V σ
proof:
:=
  Finset.set_biInter_insert i σ V

name: TDA.Topology.faceMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem faceMap_mk {σ τ : Finset I} (h : τ ⊆ σ) (x : interMember V σ) :
    faceMap V h (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x.1, interMember_anti V h x.2⟩ : interMember V τ)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.faceMap_refl
statement: theorem faceMap_refl (σ : Finset I) : faceMap V (Finset.Subset.refl σ) = id
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => rfl

name: TDA.Topology.faceMap_self
statement:
theorem faceMap_self {σ : Finset I} (h : σ ⊆ σ) (c : ZerothHomotopy (interMember V σ)) :
    faceMap V h c = c
proof:
:=
  congrFun (faceMap_refl V σ) c

name: TDA.Topology.faceMap_trans
statement:
theorem faceMap_trans {ρ τ σ : Finset I} (hρτ : ρ ⊆ τ) (hτσ : τ ⊆ σ) :
    faceMap V hρτ ∘ faceMap V hτσ = faceMap V (hρτ.trans hτσ)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => rfl

name: TDA.Topology.faceMap_faceMap
statement:
theorem faceMap_faceMap {ρ τ σ : Finset I} (hρτ : ρ ⊆ τ) (hτσ : τ ⊆ σ)
    (c : ZerothHomotopy (interMember V σ)) :
    faceMap V hρτ (faceMap V hτσ c) = faceMap V (hρτ.trans hτσ) c
proof:
:=
  congrFun (faceMap_trans V hρτ hτσ) c

name: TDA.Topology.isEmpty_cellsOver_iff
statement:
theorem isEmpty_cellsOver_iff (V : CoverFamily X I) (σ : Finset I) :
    IsEmpty (ZerothHomotopy (interMember V σ)) ↔ interMember V σ = ∅
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    exact fun hx => h.false (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x, hx⟩)
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun c => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨x, -⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective c
    exact (Set.ext_iff.1 h x.1).1 x.2

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.support_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem support_mk (σ : Finset I) (hσ : σ.Nonempty)
    (c : ZerothHomotopy (interMember V σ)) : (mk σ hσ c).support = σ
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.component_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem component_mk (σ : Finset I) (hσ : σ.Nonempty)
    (c : ZerothHomotopy (interMember V σ)) : (mk σ hσ c).component = c
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.support_nonempty
statement: theorem support_nonempty (a : MultiNerveCell V) : a.support.Nonempty

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.eta
statement: theorem eta (a : MultiNerveCell V) : mk a.support a.support_nonempty a.component = a
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.ext_of_support_eq
statement:
theorem ext_of_support_eq {a b : MultiNerveCell V} (h : b.support = a.support)
    (hc : faceMap V h.le a.component = b.component) : b = a
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨⟨σ, hσ⟩, c⟩
  rcases b with ⟨⟨τ, hτ⟩, d⟩
  change τ = σ at h
  subst h
  obtain rfl : c = d := (faceMap_self V _ c).symm.trans hc
  rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.carrier_subset
statement: theorem carrier_subset (a : MultiNerveCell V) : a.carrier ⊆ interMember V a.support
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => hx.1

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.carrier_nonempty
statement: theorem carrier_nonempty (a : MultiNerveCell V) : a.carrier.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective a.component
  exact ⟨x.1, x.2, hx⟩

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.le_def
statement:
theorem le_def {a b : MultiNerveCell V} :
    b ≤ a ↔ ∃ h : b.support ⊆ a.support, faceMap V h a.component = b.component
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.support_mono
statement: theorem support_mono {a b : MultiNerveCell V} (h : b ≤ a) : b.support ⊆ a.support

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.support_face
statement:
@[simp] theorem support_face (a : MultiNerveCell V) (τ : Finset I) (hτ : τ.Nonempty)
    (hτa : τ ⊆ a.support) : (a.face τ hτ hτa).support = τ
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.face_le
statement:
theorem face_le (a : MultiNerveCell V) (τ : Finset I) (hτ : τ.Nonempty)
    (hτa : τ ⊆ a.support) : a.face τ hτ hτa ≤ a
proof:
:=
  ⟨hτa, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.eq_face_of_le
statement:
theorem eq_face_of_le {a b : MultiNerveCell V} (h : b ≤ a) :
    b = a.face b.support b.support_nonempty (support_mono h)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h, e⟩ := h
  exact ext_of_support_eq (a := a.face b.support b.support_nonempty h) (b := b) rfl
    ((faceMap_faceMap V (Finset.Subset.refl _) h a.component).trans e)

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.face_le_face_iff
statement:
theorem face_le_face_iff (a : MultiNerveCell V) {τ τ' : Finset I} (hτ : τ.Nonempty)
    (hτ' : τ'.Nonempty) (hτa : τ ⊆ a.support) (hτ'a : τ' ⊆ a.support) :
    a.face τ hτ hτa ≤ a.face τ' hτ' hτ'a ↔ τ ⊆ τ'
proof:
:=
  ⟨support_mono, fun h => ⟨h, faceMap_faceMap V h hτ'a a.component⟩⟩

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.lowerSetOrderIso_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem lowerSetOrderIso_apply (a : MultiNerveCell V) (b : {b // b ≤ a}) :
    (lowerSetOrderIso a b).1 = b.1.support
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.support_mem_nerve
statement: theorem support_mem_nerve (a : MultiNerveCell V) : a.support ∈ nerve V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, -⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective a.component
  exact (mem_nerve_iff V _).2 ⟨a.support_nonempty, x.1, (mem_interMember_iff V).1 x.2⟩

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveCell.exists_cell_of_mem_nerve
statement:
theorem exists_cell_of_mem_nerve {σ : Finset I} (hσ : σ ∈ nerve V) :
    ∃ a : MultiNerveCell V, a.support = σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, x, hx⟩ := (mem_nerve_iff V σ).1 hσ
  exact ⟨mk σ hne (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x, (mem_interMember_iff V).2 hx⟩), rfl⟩

name: TDA.Topology.projection_coe
statement: @[simp] theorem projection_coe (a : MultiNerveCell V) : (projection V a).1 = a.support
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.projection_monotone
statement: theorem projection_monotone : Monotone (projection V)
proof: := fun _ _ h => support_mono h

name: TDA.Topology.projection_surjective
statement: theorem projection_surjective : Function.Surjective (projection V)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨σ, hσ⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_cell_of_mem_nerve hσ
  exact ⟨a, Subtype.ext ha⟩

name: TDA.Topology.cellsOverEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cellsOverEquiv_symm_apply (σ : Finset I) (hσ : σ.Nonempty)
    (c : ZerothHomotopy (interMember V σ)) :
    ((cellsOverEquiv V σ hσ).symm c).1 = mk σ hσ c
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.projection_injective_iff
statement:
theorem projection_injective_iff :
    Function.Injective (projection V) ↔ IntersectionsPathSubsingleton V
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hinj σ hσ
    refine ⟨fun c d => ?_⟩
    have h := hinj (a₁ := mk σ hσ c) (a₂ := mk σ hσ d) rfl
    exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.1 h).2
  · intro hsub a b hab
    have hs : b.support = a.support := (congrArg Subtype.val hab).symm
    exact (ext_of_support_eq hs
      (@Subsingleton.elim _ (hsub _ b.support_nonempty) _ _)).symm

name: TDA.Topology.coe_multiNerveOrderIso
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_multiNerveOrderIso (h : IntersectionsPathSubsingleton V) :
    ⇑(multiNerveOrderIso V h) = projection V
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.subsingleton_zerothHomotopy_of_isPathConnected
statement:
theorem subsingleton_zerothHomotopy_of_isPathConnected {S : Set X} (hS : IsPathConnected S) :
    Subsingleton (ZerothHomotopy S)
proof:
:= by
  have := isPathConnected_iff_pathConnectedSpace.1 hS
  exact (pathConnectedSpace_iff_zerothHomotopy.1 inferInstance).2

name: TDA.Topology.intersectionsPathSubsingleton_of_isPathConnected
statement:
theorem intersectionsPathSubsingleton_of_isPathConnected
    (h : ∀ σ : Finset I, σ.Nonempty → (interMember V σ).Nonempty →
      IsPathConnected (interMember V σ)) :
    IntersectionsPathSubsingleton V
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  refine ⟨fun c d => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective c
  exact @Subsingleton.elim _
    (subsingleton_zerothHomotopy_of_isPathConnected (h σ hσ ⟨x.1, x.2⟩)) _ _

name: TDA.Topology.mem_nerve_iff
statement:
theorem mem_nerve_iff (U : CoverFamily X I) (s : Finset I) :
    s ∈ nerve U ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ ∃ x, ∀ i ∈ s, x ∈ U i
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Topology.mem_nerve_singleton_iff
statement:
theorem mem_nerve_singleton_iff (U : CoverFamily X I) (i : I) :
    ({i} : Finset I) ∈ nerve U ↔ (U i).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_nerve_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx i (Finset.mem_singleton_self i)⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨Finset.singleton_nonempty i, x, fun j hj =>
      (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hj) ▸ hx⟩

name: TDA.Topology.mem_nerve_of_nonempty_subset
statement:
theorem mem_nerve_of_nonempty_subset (U : CoverFamily X I) {s t : Finset I}
    (hs : s ∈ nerve U) (hts : t ⊆ s) (ht : t.Nonempty) : t ∈ nerve U
proof:
:= by
  exact (nerve U).isRelLowerSet_faces hs |>.2 hts ht

name: TDA.Topology.nerve_mono
statement:
theorem nerve_mono {U V : CoverFamily X I} (hUV : ∀ i, U i ⊆ V i) :
    nerve U ≤ nerve V
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsn, x, hx⟩ := (mem_nerve_iff U s).1 hs
  exact (mem_nerve_iff V s).2 ⟨hsn, x, fun i hi => hUV i (hx i hi)⟩

name: TDA.Topology.nerve_eq_bot_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem nerve_eq_bot_of_isEmpty (U : CoverFamily X I) [IsEmpty X] :
    nerve U = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ext
  ext s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    exact isEmptyElim hs.2.choose
  · intro hs
    exact hs.elim

name: TDA.Topology.mem_nerve_relabel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_nerve_relabel_iff (e : I ≃ J) (U : CoverFamily X J) (s : Finset I) :
    s ∈ nerve (fun i => U (e i)) ↔ s.image e ∈ nerve U
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs'
    obtain ⟨hs, x, hx⟩ := (mem_nerve_iff _ s).1 hs'
    refine (mem_nerve_iff _ _).2 ⟨hs.image e, x, ?_⟩
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hj
    exact hx i hi
  · intro hs'
    obtain ⟨hs, x, hx⟩ := (mem_nerve_iff _ _).1 hs'
    refine (mem_nerve_iff _ s).2 ⟨Finset.image_nonempty.mp hs, x, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    exact hx (e i) (mem_image.mpr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Topology.mem_nerve_pullback_iff
statement:
theorem mem_nerve_pullback_iff {Y : Type w} (f : X → Y) (U : CoverFamily Y I)
    (s : Finset I) :
    s ∈ nerve (pullback f U) ↔
      s.Nonempty ∧ ∃ y ∈ Set.range f, ∀ i ∈ s, y ∈ U i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs'
    obtain ⟨hs, x, hx⟩ := (mem_nerve_iff _ s).1 hs'
    refine ⟨hs, f x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    exact hx i hi
  · rintro ⟨hs, y, ⟨x, rfl⟩, hy⟩
    exact (mem_nerve_iff _ s).2 ⟨hs, x, hy⟩

name: TDA.Topology.nerve_pullback_le
statement:
theorem nerve_pullback_le {Y : Type w} (f : X → Y) (U : CoverFamily Y I) :
    nerve (pullback f U) ≤ nerve U
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsn, y, hy, hface⟩ := (mem_nerve_pullback_iff f U s).1 hs
  exact (mem_nerve_iff U s).2 ⟨hsn, y, fun i hi => hface i hi⟩

name: TDA.Topology.nerve_pullback_eq_of_surjective
statement:
theorem nerve_pullback_eq_of_surjective {Y : Type w} (f : X → Y)
    (U : CoverFamily Y I) (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
    nerve (pullback f U) = nerve U
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact nerve_pullback_le f U
  · intro s hs
    obtain ⟨hsn, y, hy⟩ := (mem_nerve_iff U s).1 hs
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hf y
    exact (mem_nerve_pullback_iff f U s).2 ⟨hsn, f x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, hy⟩

name: TDA.Topology.interMember_image_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_interMember_iff]
  intro j hj
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hj
  exact R.subset i ((mem_interMember_iff U).1 hx i hi)

name: TDA.Topology.refinementFaceMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem refinementFaceMap_mk (R : Refinement U V) (σ : Finset I) (x : interMember U σ) :
    refinementFaceMap R σ (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk
        (⟨x.1, interMember_image_subset R σ x.2⟩ : interMember V (σ.image R.selector))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Topology.refinementFaceMap_faceMap
statement:
theorem refinementFaceMap_faceMap (R : Refinement U V) {σ τ : Finset I} (h : τ ⊆ σ)
    (c : ZerothHomotopy (interMember U σ)) :
    faceMap V (Finset.image_subset_image h) (refinementFaceMap R σ c) =
      refinementFaceMap R τ (faceMap U h c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => rfl

name: TDA.Topology.support_multiNerveMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem support_multiNerveMap (R : Refinement U V) (a : MultiNerveCell U) :
    (multiNerveMap R a).support = a.support.image R.selector
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.multiNerveMap_mk
statement:
theorem multiNerveMap_mk (R : Refinement U V) (σ : Finset I) (hσ : σ.Nonempty)
    (c : ZerothHomotopy (interMember U σ)) :
    multiNerveMap R (MultiNerveCell.mk σ hσ c) =
      MultiNerveCell.mk (σ.image R.selector) (hσ.image R.selector) (refinementFaceMap R σ c)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Topology.multiNerveMap_monotone
statement: theorem multiNerveMap_monotone (R : Refinement U V) : Monotone (multiNerveMap R)
proof:
:= by
  intro b a hba
  obtain ⟨hs, hc⟩ := le_def.1 hba
  refine le_def.2 ⟨Finset.image_subset_image hs, ?_⟩
  change faceMap V (Finset.image_subset_image hs) (refinementFaceMap R a.support a.component) =
    refinementFaceMap R b.support b.component
  rw [refinementFaceMap_faceMap R hs, hc]

name: TDA.Topology.multiNerveMap_face
statement:
theorem multiNerveMap_face (R : Refinement U V) (a : MultiNerveCell U) (τ : Finset I)
    (hτ : τ.Nonempty) (hτa : τ ⊆ a.support) :
    multiNerveMap R (a.face τ hτ hτa) =
      (multiNerveMap R a).face (τ.image R.selector) (hτ.image _)
        (Finset.image_subset_image hτa)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (MultiNerveCell.mk (τ.image R.selector) (hτ.image _))
    (refinementFaceMap_faceMap R hτa a.component).symm

name: TDA.Topology.multiNerveMap_id
statement: theorem multiNerveMap_id : multiNerveMap (Refinement.id U) = id
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  refine ext_of_support_eq (a := a) (b := multiNerveMap (Refinement.id U) a)
    Finset.image_id' ?_
  rcases a with ⟨⟨σ, hσ⟩, c⟩
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => rfl

name: TDA.Topology.multiNerveMap_comp
statement:
theorem multiNerveMap_comp (R : Refinement U V) (S : Refinement V W) :
    multiNerveMap (Refinement.comp R S) = multiNerveMap S ∘ multiNerveMap R
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  refine (ext_of_support_eq (a := multiNerveMap S (multiNerveMap R a))
    (b := multiNerveMap (Refinement.comp R S) a)
    (Finset.image_image (s := a.support) (f := R.selector) (g := S.selector)).symm ?_)
  rcases a with ⟨⟨σ, hσ⟩, c⟩
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => rfl

name: TDA.Topology.projection_multiNerveMap
statement:
theorem projection_multiNerveMap (R : Refinement U V) (a : MultiNerveCell U) :
    (projection V (multiNerveMap R a)).1 = (projection U a).1.image (nerveMap R)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Topology.NerveMapExamples.duplicate_edge_maps_to_singleton
statement:
theorem duplicate_edge_maps_to_singleton :
    ({false, true} : Finset Bool).image
          (nerveMap ProbeFixtures.mergeDuplicated : Bool → Unit) =
        ({()} : Finset Unit) ∧
      ({false, true} : Finset Bool) ∈ nerve ProbeFixtures.duplicatedFamily ∧
      ({()} : Finset Unit) ∈ nerve ProbeFixtures.singletonFamily
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext i
    constructor
    · intro hi
      obtain ⟨b, _, hb⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
      simpa using hb
    · intro hi
      have : i = () := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hi
      subst i
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨false, by simp, rfl⟩
  · simp [mem_nerve_iff, ProbeFixtures.duplicatedFamily]
  · simp [mem_nerve_iff, ProbeFixtures.singletonFamily]

name: TDA.Topology.NerveMapExamples.permutation_reindex_inverse_fixture
statement:
theorem permutation_reindex_inverse_fixture :
    swapEquiv 0 = 1 ∧
      VertexMap.comp
          (nerveMap (reindexRefinement swapEquiv NerveExamples.disjointFamily))
          (nerveMap (reindexRefinement_symm swapEquiv NerveExamples.disjointFamily)) =
        VertexMap.id
          (nerve (fun i => NerveExamples.disjointFamily (swapEquiv i))) ∧
      VertexMap.comp
          (nerveMap (reindexRefinement_symm swapEquiv NerveExamples.disjointFamily))
          (nerveMap (reindexRefinement swapEquiv NerveExamples.disjointFamily)) =
        VertexMap.id (nerve NerveExamples.disjointFamily)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by decide, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact nerveMap_reindex_comp swapEquiv NerveExamples.disjointFamily
  · exact nerveMap_reindex_symm_comp swapEquiv NerveExamples.disjointFamily

name: TDA.Topology.NerveMapExamples.composable_refinements_have_direct_composite
statement:
theorem composable_refinements_have_direct_composite :
    firstRefinement.selector 0 = 1 ∧
      secondRefinement.selector 0 = 0 ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 2, (Refinement.comp firstRefinement secondRefinement).selector i = 0) ∧
      nerveMap (Refinement.comp firstRefinement secondRefinement) =
        VertexMap.comp (nerveMap firstRefinement) (nerveMap secondRefinement)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_, nerveMap_comp firstRefinement secondRefinement⟩
  intro i
  rfl

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.SupNormWitness.interleaving_left
statement:
theorem SupNormWitness.interleaving_left {δ : ℝ≥0} (s : SupNormWitness X Y δ) :
    letI : MeasurableSpace ((X ⊕ Y) → ℝ) := borel _
    letI : BorelSpace ((X ⊕ Y) → ℝ) := ⟨rfl⟩
    (copy δ false).toFunctor ⋙ s.interleaving = topologicalDiagram (uniformMeasure s.left)

statement:

proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveExamples.singletonFamily_interMember_pair
statement:
theorem singletonFamily_interMember_pair :
    interMember singletonFamily {false, true} = ∅
proof:

  rw [interMember_insert, interMember_singleton]
  ext x
  cases x <;> simp [singletonFamily]

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveExamples.singletonFamily_no_cell_over_pair
statement:
theorem singletonFamily_no_cell_over_pair :
    IsEmpty (ZerothHomotopy (interMember singletonFamily {false, true})) ∧
      (¬ ∃ a : MultiNerveCell singletonFamily, a.support = {false, true}) ∧
      ({false, true} : Finset Bool) ∉ nerve singletonFamily
proof:
:= by
  have hempty := (isEmpty_cellsOver_iff singletonFamily _).2 singletonFamily_interMember_pair
  refine ⟨hempty, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    exact hempty.false (cellsOverEquiv singletonFamily _ (by simp) ⟨a, ha⟩)
  · intro hσ
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_cell_of_mem_nerve hσ
    exact hempty.false (cellsOverEquiv singletonFamily _ (by simp) ⟨a, ha⟩)

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveExamples.unit_mem_duplicate
statement: private theorem unit_mem_duplicate (σ : Finset Bool) : () ∈ interMember duplicateFamily σ
proof:
:=
  (mem_interMember_iff duplicateFamily).2 fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ ()

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveExamples.duplicate_labels_distinct_vertex_cells
statement:
theorem duplicate_labels_distinct_vertex_cells :
    duplicateCell {false} (by simp) ≠ duplicateCell {true} (by simp) ∧
      duplicateCell {false} (by simp) ≤ duplicateCell {false, true} (by simp) ∧
      duplicateCell {true} (by simp) ≤ duplicateCell {false, true} (by simp) ∧
      ({false} : Finset Bool) ∈ nerve duplicateFamily ∧
      ({true} : Finset Bool) ∈ nerve duplicateFamily
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ⟨by simp [duplicateCell], rfl⟩, ⟨by simp [duplicateCell], rfl⟩,
    support_mem_nerve (duplicateCell {false} (by simp)),
    support_mem_nerve (duplicateCell {true} (by simp))⟩
  have hs := congrArg MultiNerveCell.support h
  simp [duplicateCell] at hs

name: TDA.Topology.covers_pullback
statement:
theorem covers_pullback {Y : Type z} (f : X → Y) {U : CoverFamily Y I} {A : Set Y}

proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  change f x ∈ A at hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hU (f x) hx
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  exact hi

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.interleavingIndex_le_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem interleavingIndex_le_iff (δ : ℝ≥0) (p q : InterleavingIndex δ) :
    p ≤ q ↔ mass q.point + penalty δ p.side q.side ≤ mass p.point ∧
      radius p.point + penalty δ p.side q.side ≤ radius q.point
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.cross_le_iff
statement:
theorem cross_le_iff (δ : ℝ≥0) (p q : Index) :
    (⟨p, false⟩ : InterleavingIndex δ) ≤ ⟨q, true⟩ ↔
      mass q ≤ mass p - δ ∧ radius p + δ ≤ radius q
proof:
:= by
  change mass q + penalty δ false true ≤ mass p ∧ _ ↔ _
  simp only [penalty, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨h, h'⟩ <;> exact ⟨by linarith, h'⟩

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.stage_mono
statement:
theorem stage_mono (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {p q : Index} (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    stage μ p ⊆ stage μ q
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact hpq.1.trans (hx.trans (measureReal_mono (μ := μ) (ball_subset_ball (x := x) hpq.2)))

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.ball_mass_le
statement:
theorem ball_mass_le (μ ν : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (h : levyProkhorovEDist μ ν < (δ : ℝ≥0∞)) (x : X) (r : ℝ) :
    μ.real (ball x r) ≤ ν.real (ball x (r + δ)) + δ
proof:
:= by
  have hP := left_measure_le_of_levyProkhorovEDist_lt h (B := ball x r) measurableSet_ball
  simp only [ENNReal.coe_toReal] at hP
  have hsub : thickening (δ : ℝ) (ball x r) ⊆ ball x (r + δ) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hyz⟩ := mem_thickening_iff.mp hy
    rw [mem_ball] at hz ⊢
    calc dist y x ≤ dist y z + dist z x := dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < (δ : ℝ) + r := add_lt_add hyz hz
      _ = r + δ := add_comm _ _
  have hle : μ (ball x r) ≤ ν (ball x (r + δ)) + (δ : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    exact hP.trans (add_le_add (measure_mono (μ := ν) hsub) le_rfl)
  have ht := ENNReal.toReal_mono (by finiteness) hle
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_add (measure_ne_top _ _) ENNReal.coe_ne_top,
    ENNReal.coe_toReal, Measure.real] using ht

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.stage_cross
statement:
theorem stage_cross (μ ν : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (h : levyProkhorovEDist μ ν < (δ : ℝ≥0∞))
    {p q : Index} (hpq : mass q ≤ mass p - δ ∧ radius p + δ ≤ radius q) :
    stage μ p ⊆ stage ν q
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hm := ball_mass_le μ ν δ h x (radius p)
  have hn : ν.real (ball x (radius p + δ)) ≤ ν.real (ball x (radius q)) :=
    measureReal_mono (μ := ν) (ball_subset_ball (x := x) hpq.2)
  change mass q ≤ ν.real (ball x (radius q))
  change mass p ≤ μ.real (ball x (radius p)) at hx
  linarith [hpq.1]

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.interleavingDiagram_left
statement:
theorem interleavingDiagram_left (μ ν : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (h : levyProkhorovEDist μ ν < (δ : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    (copy δ false).toFunctor ⋙ interleavingDiagram μ ν δ h = diagram μ
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.interleavingDiagram_right

    (δ : ℝ≥0) (h : levyProkhorovEDist μ ν < (δ : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    (copy δ true).toFunctor ⋙ interleavingDiagram μ ν δ h = diagram ν
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.topologicalInterleaving_left
statement:
theorem topologicalInterleaving_left (μ ν : Measure X)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (h : levyProkhorovEDist μ ν < (δ : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    (copy δ false).toFunctor ⋙ topologicalInterleaving μ ν δ h = topologicalDiagram μ
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.topologicalInterleaving_right
statement:

    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (h : levyProkhorovEDist μ ν < (δ : ℝ≥0∞)) :
    (copy δ true).toFunctor ⋙ topologicalInterleaving μ ν δ h = topologicalDiagram ν
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.uniformMeasure_apply
statement:
theorem uniformMeasure_apply (p : V → X) {A : Set X} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    uniformMeasure p A =
      (labelCount p A : ℝ≥0∞) / Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : MeasurableSpace V := ⊤
  rw [uniformMeasure, PMF.toMeasure_map_apply p (PMF.uniformOfFintype V) A
    (measurable_of_finite p) hA]
  let : Fintype (p ⁻¹' A) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [PMF.toMeasure_uniformOfFintype_apply (p ⁻¹' A)
    ((measurable_of_finite p) hA)]
  simp only [Fintype.card_subtype, Set.mem_preimage, labelCount]

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.uniformMeasure_real
statement:
theorem uniformMeasure_real (p : V → X) {A : Set X} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    (uniformMeasure p).real A =
      (labelCount p A : ℝ) / Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Measure.real, uniformMeasure_apply p hA, ENNReal.toReal_div]
  simp

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.uniformMeasure_apply_le_of_label_mem
statement:
theorem uniformMeasure_apply_le_of_label_mem (p : V → X) (q : V → Y)
    {A : Set X} {B : Set Y} (hA : MeasurableSet A) (hB : MeasurableSet B)
    (h : ∀ v, p v ∈ A → q v ∈ B) : uniformMeasure p A ≤ uniformMeasure q B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc : labelCount p A ≤ labelCount q B := by
    unfold labelCount
    apply Finset.card_le_card
    intro v hv
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, h v (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2⟩
  rw [uniformMeasure_apply p hA, uniformMeasure_apply q hB]
  gcongr

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.levyProkhorovDist_uniform_le_of_cross_dist_le
statement:
theorem levyProkhorovDist_uniform_le_of_cross_dist_le
    (p : V → X) (q : W → X) (p' : V → Y) (q' : W → Y)
    (hcross : ∀ v w, dist (p v) (q w) ≤ dist (p' v) (q' w)) :
    levyProkhorovDist (uniformMeasure p) (uniformMeasure q) ≤
      levyProkhorovDist (uniformMeasure p') (uniformMeasure q')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply levyProkhorovDist_le_of_forall_le _ _ ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  intro ε A hε hA
  have hεpos : 0 < ε := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg.trans_lt hε
  let B := p' '' (p ⁻¹' A)
  have hB : MeasurableSet B := ((Set.toFinite (p ⁻¹' A)).image p').measurableSet
  have hleft : uniformMeasure p A ≤ uniformMeasure p' B :=
    uniformMeasure_apply_le_of_label_mem p p' hA hB (fun v hv => ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩)
  have hright : uniformMeasure q' (thickening ε B) ≤ uniformMeasure q (thickening ε A) := by
    apply uniformMeasure_apply_le_of_label_mem q' q isOpen_thickening.measurableSet
      isOpen_thickening.measurableSet
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hd⟩ := mem_thickening_iff.mp hw
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hz
    apply mem_thickening_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨p v, hv, ?_⟩
    have hc : dist (q w) (p v) ≤ dist (q' w) (p' v) := by
      simpa only [dist_comm] using hcross v w
    exact hc.trans_lt hd
  have hLP : levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure p') (uniformMeasure q') < ENNReal.ofReal ε :=
    (ENNReal.lt_ofReal_iff_toReal_lt (levyProkhorovEDist_ne_top _ _)).2 hε
  have hm := left_measure_le_of_levyProkhorovEDist_lt hLP hB
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hεpos.le] at hm
  exact hleft.trans (hm.trans (add_le_add hright le_rfl))

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_le_of_cross_dist_le
statement:
theorem levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_le_of_cross_dist_le
    (p : V → X) (q : W → X) (p' : V → Y) (q' : W → Y)
    (hcross : ∀ v w, dist (p v) (q w) ≤ dist (p' v) (q' w)) :
    levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure p) (uniformMeasure q) ≤
      levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure p') (uniformMeasure q')
proof:
:= by
  have h := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    (levyProkhorovDist_uniform_le_of_cross_dist_le p q p' q' hcross)
  simpa only [levyProkhorovDist,
    ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (levyProkhorovEDist_ne_top (uniformMeasure p) (uniformMeasure q)),
    ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (levyProkhorovEDist_ne_top (uniformMeasure p') (uniformMeasure q'))] using h

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_eq_of_cross_dist_eq
statement:
theorem levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_eq_of_cross_dist_eq
    (p : V → X) (q : W → X) (p' : V → Y) (q' : W → Y)
    (hcross : ∀ v w, dist (p v) (q w) = dist (p' v) (q' w)) :
    levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure p) (uniformMeasure q) =
      levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure p') (uniformMeasure q')
proof:
:= by
  exact le_antisymm
    (levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_le_of_cross_dist_le p q p' q' (fun v w => (hcross v w).le))
    (levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_le_of_cross_dist_le p' q' p q (fun v w => (hcross v w).ge))

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.levyProkhorovDist_uniform_le_of_isClosed
statement:
theorem levyProkhorovDist_uniform_le_of_isClosed (p : V → X) (q : W → X)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (h : ∀ ε A, δ < ε → IsClosed A →
      uniformMeasure p A ≤ uniformMeasure q (thickening ε A) + ENNReal.ofReal ε) :
    levyProkhorovDist (uniformMeasure p) (uniformMeasure q) ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply levyProkhorovDist_le_of_forall_le _ _ hδ
  intro ε A hε hA
  let B := p '' (p ⁻¹' A)
  have hB : IsClosed B := ((Set.toFinite (p ⁻¹' A)).image p).isClosed
  have hBA : B ⊆ A := by
    rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact hv
  have hm : uniformMeasure p A ≤ uniformMeasure p B :=
    uniformMeasure_apply_le_of_label_mem p p hA hB.measurableSet
      (fun v hv => ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩)
  exact hm.trans ((h ε B hε hB).trans
    (add_le_add (measure_mono (thickening_subset_of_subset ε hBA)) le_rfl))

name: TDA.Topology.exists_subdivision
statement:
theorem exists_subdivision (γ : Path x y) {U : ι → Set X} (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcov : range γ ⊆ ⋃ i, U i) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → I) (i : Fin n → ι), t 0 = 0 ∧ t (last n) = 1 ∧
      Monotone t ∧ ∀ k : Fin n, γ '' Icc (t k.castSucc) (t k.succ) ⊆ U (i k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, t0, tmono, ⟨n, hn⟩, hsub⟩ :=
    exists_monotone_Icc_subset_open_cover_unitInterval (c := fun i => γ ⁻¹' U i)
      (fun i => (hU i).preimage γ.continuous)
      (fun s _ => by simpa using hcov (mem_range_self s))
  choose i hi using hsub
  refine ⟨n, fun k => t k, fun k => i k, t0, hn n le_rfl, fun a b hab => tmono hab, fun k => ?_⟩
  rw [image_subset_iff]
  simpa using hi k

name: TDA.Topology.exists_subpath_chain
statement:
theorem exists_subpath_chain (γ : Path x y) {U : ι → Set X} (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcov : range γ ⊆ ⋃ i, U i) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → I) (i : Fin n → ι), t 0 = 0 ∧ t (last n) = 1 ∧
      Monotone t ∧ ∀ k : Fin n, range (γ.subpath (t k.castSucc) (t k.succ)) ⊆ U (i k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, t, i, t0, tn, tmono, hsub⟩ := exists_subdivision γ hU hcov
  refine ⟨n, t, i, t0, tn, tmono, fun k => ?_⟩
  rw [Path.range_subpath_of_le _ _ _ (tmono (castSucc_le_succ k))]
  exact hsub k

name: TDA.Topology.exists_overlap_chain
statement:
theorem exists_overlap_chain (γ : Path x y) {U : ι → Set X} (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcov : range γ ⊆ ⋃ i, U i) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p : Fin (n + 1) → X) (i : Fin n → ι), p 0 = x ∧ p (last n) = y ∧
      (∀ k : Fin n, JoinedIn (U (i k)) (p k.castSucc) (p k.succ)) ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k + 1 < n),
        p ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ ∈ U (i ⟨k, by omega⟩) ∩ U (i ⟨k + 1, hk⟩)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, t, i, t0, tn, tmono, hsub⟩ := exists_subpath_chain γ hU hcov
  have hJ : ∀ k : Fin n, JoinedIn (U (i k)) (γ (t k.castSucc)) (γ (t k.succ)) := fun k =>
    ⟨γ.subpath _ _, fun s => hsub k (mem_range_self s)⟩
  refine ⟨n, γ ∘ t, i, by simp [t0], by simp [tn], hJ, fun k hk => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · exact (hJ ⟨k, by omega⟩).target_mem
  · exact (hJ ⟨k + 1, hk⟩).source_mem

name: TDA.Topology.reflTransGen_of_path
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_of_path (γ : Path x y) {U : ι → Set X} (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcov : range γ ⊆ ⋃ i, U i) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => ∃ i, JoinedIn (U i) a b) x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, p, i, p0, pn, hJ, -⟩ := exists_overlap_chain γ hU hcov
  have key : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m < n + 1),
      Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => ∃ i, JoinedIn (U i) a b) (p 0) (p ⟨m, hm⟩) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro _; exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
    | succ m ih =>
      intro hm
      exact (ih (by omega)).tail ⟨i ⟨m, by omega⟩, hJ ⟨m, by omega⟩⟩
  have := key n (by omega)
  rwa [p0, show (⟨n, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) = last n from rfl, pn] at this

name: TDA.Topology.reflTransGen_of_joined
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_of_joined (h : Joined x y) {U : ι → Set X} (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcov : pathComponent x ⊆ ⋃ i, U i) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => ∃ i, JoinedIn (U i) a b) x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ⟩ := h
  refine reflTransGen_of_path γ hU ?_
  rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
  exact hcov ⟨(γ.subpath 0 s).cast (by simp) rfl⟩

name: TDA.Topology.exists_subdivision_opens
statement:
theorem exists_subdivision_opens (γ : Path x y) {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens X}
    (V : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens X) (hγ : ∀ s, γ s ∈ W) (hWV : W ≤ ⨆ i, V i) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → I) (i : Fin n → ι), t 0 = 0 ∧ t (last n) = 1 ∧
      Monotone t ∧ ∀ k : Fin n, γ '' Icc (t k.castSucc) (t k.succ) ⊆ V (i k)
proof:
:=
  exists_subdivision γ (fun i => (V i).isOpen) (by
    rintro _ ⟨s, rfl⟩
    simpa [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] using hWV (hγ s))

name: TDA.Topology.reflTransGen_preimage
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_preimage {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] (f : C(X, Y))
    {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y} (V : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (hWV : W ≤ ⨆ i, V i)
    {a b : {x : X // f x ∈ W}} (h : Joined a b) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun a b : {x : X // f x ∈ W} => ∃ i, ∃ (ha : f a.1 ∈ V i) (hb : f b.1 ∈ V i),
        Joined (⟨a.1, ha⟩ : {x : X // f x ∈ V i}) ⟨b.1, hb⟩) a b
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen {s : {x : X // f x ∈ W} | f s.1 ∈ V i} := fun i =>
    (V i).isOpen.preimage (f.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val)
  refine Relation.ReflTransGen.mono ?_ a b (reflTransGen_of_joined h hopen (fun z _ => ?_))
  · rintro c d ⟨i, γ, hγ⟩
    refine ⟨i, by simpa using hγ 0, by simpa using hγ 1, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    exact
      { toFun := fun s => ⟨(γ s).1, hγ s⟩
        continuous_toFun := (continuous_subtype_val.comp γ.continuous).subtype_mk _
        source' := by ext; simp
        target' := by ext; simp }
  · simpa [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup] using hWV z.2

name: TDA.Topology.Examples.segment_chain_exists
statement:
theorem segment_chain_exists :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (p : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin n → Bool), p 0 = 0 ∧ p (last n) = 1 ∧
      (∀ k : Fin n, JoinedIn (twoOpens (i k)) (p k.castSucc) (p k.succ)) ∧
      ∀ (k : ℕ) (hk : k + 1 < n),
        p ⟨k + 1, by omega⟩ ∈ twoOpens (i ⟨k, by omega⟩) ∩ twoOpens (i ⟨k + 1, hk⟩)
proof:
:=
  exists_overlap_chain segment twoOpens_isOpen (fun z _ => twoOpens_cover z)

name: TDA.Topology.Examples.segment_chain_uses_both
statement:
theorem segment_chain_uses_both (n : ℕ) (p : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (i : Fin n → Bool)
    (p0 : p 0 = 0) (pn : p (last n) = 1)
    (hJ : ∀ k : Fin n, JoinedIn (twoOpens (i k)) (p k.castSucc) (p k.succ)) :
    ∃ hn : 0 < n, i ⟨0, hn⟩ = false ∧ i ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩ = true
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · have : p (last 0) = p 0 := rfl
      rw [p0, pn] at this; norm_num at this
    · exact hn
  refine ⟨hn, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h0 := (hJ ⟨0, hn⟩).source_mem
    have : p (castSucc ⟨0, hn⟩) = 0 := p0
    rw [this] at h0
    cases hi : i ⟨0, hn⟩
    · rfl
    · rw [hi] at h0; simp [twoOpens] at h0; norm_num at h0
  · have h1 := (hJ ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩).target_mem
    have : p (succ ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩) = 1 := by
      rw [← pn]; congr 1; ext; simp; omega
    rw [this] at h1
    cases hi : i ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
    · rw [hi] at h1; simp [twoOpens] at h1; norm_num at h1
    · rfl

name: TDA.Topology.Examples.refl_subdivision_mem
statement:
theorem refl_subdivision_mem {U : ι → Set X} (n : ℕ) (t : Fin (n + 1) → I) (i : Fin n → ι)
    (t0 : t 0 = 0) (tn : t (last n) = 1) (tmono : Monotone t)
    (hsub : ∀ k : Fin n, Path.refl x '' Icc (t k.castSucc) (t k.succ) ⊆ U (i k)) :
    0 < n ∧ ∀ k, x ∈ U (i k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, fun k => hsub k ⟨t k.castSucc, ⟨le_rfl, tmono (castSucc_le_succ k)⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
  · have : t (last 0) = t 0 := rfl
    rw [t0, tn] at this; exact absurd this one_ne_zero
  · exact hn

name: TDA.Topology.Examples.singletons_no_subdivision
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨n, t, i, t0, tn, tmono, hsub⟩
  
  have hconst : ∀ (m : ℕ) (hm : m < n + 1), t ⟨m, hm⟩ = t 0 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => intro _; rfl
    | succ m ih =>
      intro hm
      have hle := tmono (castSucc_le_succ (⟨m, by omega⟩ : Fin n))
      have ha := hsub ⟨m, by omega⟩ ⟨_, ⟨le_rfl, hle⟩, rfl⟩
      have hb := hsub ⟨m, by omega⟩ ⟨_, ⟨hle, le_rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [mem_singleton_iff] at ha hb
      rw [← ih (by omega)]
      exact hb.trans ha.symm
  have := hconst n (by omega)
  rw [show (⟨n, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) = last n from rfl, tn, t0] at this
  exact zero_ne_one this.symm

name: TDA.Topology.eqvGen_overlapRel_apply_eq
statement:
theorem eqvGen_overlapRel_apply_eq (F : α ⥤ Type w₀) (U : ι → α) {A : Sort*}
    (a : ∀ i, F.obj (U i) → A)
    (ha : ∀ i j (c : F.obj (U i ⊓ U j)),
      a i (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) = a j (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c))
    {p q : Σ i, F.obj (U i)} (h : Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel F U) p q) :
    a p.1 p.2 = a q.1 q.2
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel p q hpq =>
    obtain ⟨c, hcp, hcq⟩ := hpq
    rw [← hcp, ← hcq]
    exact ha _ _ c
  | refl => rfl
  | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂

name: TDA.Topology.nonempty_isColimit_mapCocone_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_isColimit_mapCocone_iff (F : α ⥤ Type w₀) (U : ι → α)
    (c : Cocone (Pairwise.diagram U)) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (F.mapCocone c)) ↔
      (∀ x : F.obj c.pt, ∃ i, ∃ e : F.obj (U i), F.map (c.ι.app (.single i)) e = x) ∧
      ∀ (i j : ι) (e : F.obj (U i)) (e' : F.obj (U j)),
        F.map (c.ι.app (.single i)) e = F.map (c.ι.app (.single j)) e' →
          Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel F U) ⟨i, e⟩ ⟨j, e'⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [Types.isColimit_iff_coconeTypesIsColimit]
  set G := Pairwise.diagram U ⋙ F
  
  have hsingle : ∀ t : G.ColimitType, ∃ i, ∃ e : F.obj (U i),
      G.ιColimitType (.single i) e = t := by
    intro t
    obtain ⟨o, x, rfl⟩ := G.ιColimitType_jointly_surjective t
    cases o with
    | single i => exact ⟨i, x, rfl⟩
    | pair i j => exact ⟨i, G.map (Pairwise.Hom.left i j) x, G.ιColimitType_map _ _⟩
  
  have hstep : ∀ p q : Σ i, F.obj (U i), Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel F U) p q →
      G.ιColimitType (.single p.1) p.2 = G.ιColimitType (.single q.1) q.2 := by
    intro p q h
    induction h with
    | rel p q hpq =>
      obtain ⟨x, hxp, hxq⟩ := hpq
      rw [← hxp, ← hxq]
      exact (G.ιColimitType_map (Pairwise.Hom.left p.1 q.1) x).trans
        (G.ιColimitType_map (Pairwise.Hom.right p.1 q.1) x).symm
    | refl => rfl
    | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
    | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂
  
  let φ : (Σ o, G.obj o) → Σ i, F.obj (U i) := fun p =>
    match p with
    | ⟨.single i, x⟩ => ⟨i, x⟩
    | ⟨.pair i _, x⟩ => ⟨i, F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) x⟩
  have hφ : ∀ p q, Relation.EqvGen G.ColimitTypeRel p q →
      Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel F U) (φ p) (φ q) := by
    intro p q h
    induction h with
    | rel p q hpq =>
      obtain ⟨o, x⟩ := p
      obtain ⟨o', x'⟩ := q
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hpq
      cases g with
      | id_single i =>
        have : x' = x := hg.trans (by erw [F.map_id]; rfl)
        rw [this]; exact .refl _
      | id_pair i j =>
        have : x' = x := hg.trans (by erw [F.map_id]; rfl)
        rw [this]; exact .refl _
      | left i j =>
        have hg' : x' = G.map (Pairwise.Hom.left i j) x := hg
        rw [hg']; exact .refl _
      | right i j =>
        have hg' : x' = G.map (Pairwise.Hom.right i j) x := hg
        rw [hg']; exact .rel _ _ ⟨x, rfl, rfl⟩
    | refl => exact .refl _
    | symm _ _ _ ih => exact .symm _ _ ih
    | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact .trans _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hbij⟩
    refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun i j e e' h => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hbij.2 x
      obtain ⟨i, e, rfl⟩ := hsingle t
      exact ⟨i, e, rfl⟩
    · have := hbij.1 (a₁ := G.ιColimitType (.single i) e) (a₂ := G.ιColimitType (.single j) e') h
      exact hφ _ _ ((G.ιColimitType_eq_iff _ _).1 this)
  · rintro ⟨hsurj, hker⟩
    refine ⟨⟨fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, e, rfl⟩ := hsingle t₁
      obtain ⟨j, e', rfl⟩ := hsingle t₂
      exact hstep ⟨i, e⟩ ⟨j, e'⟩ (hker i j e e' h)
    · obtain ⟨i, e, rfl⟩ := hsurj x
      exact ⟨G.ιColimitType (.single i) e, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Topology.existsUnique_glue_of_surjective_of_eqvGen
statement:
theorem existsUnique_glue_of_surjective_of_eqvGen (F : α ⥤ Type w₀) (U : ι → α)
    (c : Cocone (Pairwise.diagram U))
    (hsurj : ∀ x : F.obj c.pt, ∃ i, ∃ e : F.obj (U i), F.map (c.ι.app (.single i)) e = x)
    (hker : ∀ (i j : ι) (e : F.obj (U i)) (e' : F.obj (U j)),
      F.map (c.ι.app (.single i)) e = F.map (c.ι.app (.single j)) e' →
        Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel F U) ⟨i, e⟩ ⟨j, e'⟩)
    {A : Sort*} (a : ∀ i, F.obj (U i) → A)
    (ha : ∀ i j (c : F.obj (U i ⊓ U j)),
      a i (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) = a j (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c)) :
    ∃! g : F.obj c.pt → A, ∀ i (e : F.obj (U i)), g (F.map (c.ι.app (.single i)) e) = a i e
proof:
:= by
  choose i₀ e₀ he₀ using hsurj
  have key : ∀ i (e : F.obj (U i)), a (i₀ (F.map (c.ι.app (.single i)) e))
      (e₀ (F.map (c.ι.app (.single i)) e)) = a i e := fun i e =>
    eqvGen_overlapRel_apply_eq F U a ha (hker _ _ _ _ (he₀ _))
  refine ⟨fun x => a (i₀ x) (e₀ x), key, fun g hg => funext fun x => ?_⟩
  rw [← he₀ x, hg, key]

name: TDA.Topology.map_apply_eq_of_thin
statement: theorem map_apply_eq_of_thin {a b : α} (f g : a ⟶ b) (x : F.obj a) : F.map f x = F.map g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subsingleton.elim f g]

name: TDA.Topology.map_map_apply_of_thin
statement:
theorem map_map_apply_of_thin {a b c : α} (f : a ⟶ b) (g : b ⟶ c) (h : a ⟶ c) (x : F.obj a) :
    F.map g (F.map f x) = F.map h x
proof:
:= by
  change (F.map f ≫ F.map g) x = _
  rw [← F.map_comp, Subsingleton.elim (f ≫ g) h]

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.mem_stage_uniform_iff_large_face
statement:
theorem mem_stage_uniform_iff_large_face (p : V → X) (a : Index) (x : X) :
    x ∈ stage (uniformMeasure p) a ↔ ∃ s : Finset V,
      s ∈ openCech p (radius a) ∧ mass a ≤ (s.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V ∧
        x ∈ faceRegion p (radius a) s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hx
    let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => p v ∈ ball x (radius a))
    have hsize : mass a ≤ (s.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V := by
      change mass a ≤ (uniformMeasure p).real (ball x (radius a)) at hx
      simpa only [uniformMeasure_real _ measurableSet_ball, labelCount, s] using hx
    have hnonempty : s.Nonempty := by
      apply Finset.card_pos.mp
      by_contra h
      have hzero : s.card = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos h
      have : mass a ≤ 0 := by simpa only [hzero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div] using hsize
      exact (mass_pos a).not_ge this
    have hregion : x ∈ faceRegion p (radius a) s := by
      intro v hv
      simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
    exact ⟨s, ⟨hnonempty, x, hregion⟩, hsize, hregion⟩
  · rintro ⟨s, _, hsize, hregion⟩
    have hsub : s ⊆ Finset.univ.filter (fun v => p v ∈ ball x (radius a)) := by
      intro v hv
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, by
        simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_comm] using hregion v hv⟩
    change mass a ≤ (uniformMeasure p).real (ball x (radius a))
    rw [uniformMeasure_real _ measurableSet_ball]
    apply hsize.trans
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card hsub)
      (by positivity)

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.stage_uniform_eq_iUnion_large_face
statement:
theorem stage_uniform_eq_iUnion_large_face (p : V → X) (a : Index) :
    stage (uniformMeasure p) a =
      ⋃ (s : Finset V) (_ : s ∈ openCech p (radius a))
        (_ : mass a ≤ (s.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V), faceRegion p (radius a) s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simpa only [Set.mem_iUnion, exists_prop] using mem_stage_uniform_iff_large_face p a x

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.isOpen_faceRegion
statement:
theorem isOpen_faceRegion (p : V → X) (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    IsOpen (faceRegion p r s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : faceRegion p r s = ⋂ v ∈ s, ball (p v) r := by ext x; simp [faceRegion]
  rw [this]
  exact isOpen_biInter_finset (fun _ _ => isOpen_ball)

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.largeFaceCover_mono
statement:
theorem largeFaceCover_mono (p : V → X) {a b : Index} (hab : a ≤ b) (s : Finset V) :
    largeFaceCover p a s ⊆ largeFaceCover p b s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  unfold largeFaceCover at hx ⊢
  split_ifs at hx with ha
  · have hregion : x ∈ faceRegion p (radius b) s :=
      fun v hv => (hx v hv).trans_le hab.2
    have hcech : s ∈ openCech p (radius b) := ⟨ha.1.1, x, hregion⟩
    rw [if_pos ⟨hcech, hab.1.trans ha.2⟩]
    exact hregion
  · exact hx.elim

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.subdivision_openCech_le_largeFaceNerve
statement:
theorem subdivision_openCech_le_largeFaceNerve (p : V → X) (a : Index) :
    subdivision (openCech p (radius a)) (mass a) ≤ TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover p a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro S hS
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image S Finset.card hS.1
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hS.2.1 s hs).1.2
  refine ⟨hS.1, x, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have hts : t ⊆ s := by
    rcases hS.2.2 t ht s hs with hts | hst
    · exact hts
    · have heq := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hst (hmax t ht)
      exact heq ▸ Finset.Subset.refl s
  unfold largeFaceCover
  rw [if_pos (hS.2.1 t ht)]
  exact fun v hv => hx v (hts hv)

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.stage_uniform_eq_iUnion_largeFaceCover
statement:
theorem stage_uniform_eq_iUnion_largeFaceCover (p : V → X) (a : Index) :
    stage (uniformMeasure p) a = ⋃ s : Finset V, largeFaceCover p a s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsize, hregion⟩ := (mem_stage_uniform_iff_large_face p a x).mp hx
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨s, ?_⟩
    unfold largeFaceCover
    rw [if_pos ⟨hs, hsize⟩]
    exact hregion
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    unfold largeFaceCover at hs
    split_ifs at hs with h
    · exact (mem_stage_uniform_iff_large_face p a x).mpr ⟨s, h.1, h.2, hs⟩
    · exact hs.elim

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.mem_largeFaceNerve_iff
statement:
theorem mem_largeFaceNerve_iff (p : V → X) (a : Index) (S : Finset (Finset V)) :
    S ∈ TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover p a) ↔
      S.Nonempty ∧ (∀ s ∈ S, s ∈ openCech p (radius a) ∧
        mass a ≤ (s.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V) ∧
      S.biUnion id ∈ openCech p (radius a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hS, x, hx⟩
    have hvalid : ∀ s ∈ S, s ∈ openCech p (radius a) ∧
        mass a ≤ (s.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V := by
      intro s hs
      by_contra h
      have := hx s hs
      simp only [largeFaceCover, if_neg h, Set.mem_empty_iff_false] at this
    have hregion : ∀ s ∈ S, x ∈ faceRegion p (radius a) s := by
      intro s hs
      simpa only [largeFaceCover, if_pos (hvalid s hs)] using hx s hs
    refine ⟨hS, hvalid, ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hS
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (hvalid s hs).1.1
    refine ⟨⟨v, Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨s, hs, hv⟩⟩, x, ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hvt⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hv
    exact hregion t ht v hvt
  · rintro ⟨hS, hvalid, _, x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨hS, x, ?_⟩
    intro s hs
    unfold largeFaceCover
    rw [if_pos (hvalid s hs)]
    exact fun v hv => hx v (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨s, hs, hv⟩)

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.isOpen_largeFaceCover
statement:
theorem isOpen_largeFaceCover (p : V → X) (a : Index) (s : Finset V) :
    IsOpen (largeFaceCover p a s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold largeFaceCover
  split_ifs
  · exact isOpen_faceRegion p (radius a) s
  · exact isOpen_empty

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.convex_faceRegion
statement:
theorem convex_faceRegion (p : V → E) (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    Convex ℝ (faceRegion p r s)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : faceRegion p r s = ⋂ v ∈ s, ball (p v) r := by ext x; simp [faceRegion]
  rw [heq]
  exact convex_iInter₂ (fun _ _ => convex_ball _ _)

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.convex_largeFaceCover
statement:
theorem convex_largeFaceCover (p : V → E) (a : Index) (s : Finset V) :
    Convex ℝ (largeFaceCover p a s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold largeFaceCover
  split_ifs
  · exact convex_faceRegion p (radius a) s
  · exact convex_empty

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.contractibleSpace_largeFaceCover_intersection
statement:
theorem contractibleSpace_largeFaceCover_intersection (p : V → E) (a : Index)
    (S : Finset (Finset V))
    (h : (⋂ s ∈ S, largeFaceCover p a s).Nonempty) :
    ContractibleSpace (⋂ s ∈ S, largeFaceCover p a s)
proof:
:=
  (convex_iInter₂ (fun s _ => convex_largeFaceCover p a s)).contractibleSpace h

name: CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.toReal_zero
statement:
@[simp]
private lemma toReal_zero : (0 : C_c(X, ℝ≥0)).toReal = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp

name: CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.toReal_le_toReal_iff
statement:
@[simp]
private lemma toReal_le_toReal_iff {f g : C_c(X, ℝ≥0)} : f.toReal ≤ g.toReal ↔ f ≤ g
proof:
:= by
  simp [le_def]

name: CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.toReal_nnrealPart_of_nonneg
statement:
private lemma toReal_nnrealPart_of_nonneg {f : C_c(X, ℝ)} (hf : 0 ≤ f) :
    f.nnrealPart.toReal = f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simpa using le_def.1 hf x

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.bddAbove_range_posPartAux
statement:
private lemma bddAbove_range_posPartAux (f : C_c(X, ℝ≥0)) :
    BddAbove (range fun g : Iic f => Λ (g : C_c(X, ℝ≥0)).toReal)
proof:
:=
  (hΛ f.toReal).mono <| by
    rintro _ ⟨⟨g, hg⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g.toReal, ⟨toReal_nonneg, toReal_le_toReal_iff.2 hg⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.apply_le_posPartAux
statement:
private lemma apply_le_posPartAux {f g : C_c(X, ℝ≥0)} (hg : g ≤ f) :
    Λ g.toReal ≤ posPartAux Λ f
proof:
:=
  le_ciSup (f := fun g : Iic f => Λ (g : C_c(X, ℝ≥0)).toReal) (bddAbove_range_posPartAux hΛ f)
    ⟨g, hg⟩

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.posPartAux_le
statement:
private lemma posPartAux_le {f : C_c(X, ℝ≥0)} {c : ℝ} (h : ∀ g ≤ f, Λ g.toReal ≤ c) :
    posPartAux Λ f ≤ c
proof:
:=
  have : Nonempty (Iic f) := ⟨⟨f, mem_Iic.2 le_rfl⟩⟩
  ciSup_le fun g => h g g.2

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.posPartAux_nonneg
statement: private lemma posPartAux_nonneg (f : C_c(X, ℝ≥0)) : 0 ≤ posPartAux Λ f
proof:
:= by
  simpa using apply_le_posPartAux hΛ (le_def.2 fun x => by simp : 0 ≤ f)

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.posPartAux_add
statement:
private lemma posPartAux_add (f₁ f₂ : C_c(X, ℝ≥0)) :
    posPartAux Λ (f₁ + f₂) = posPartAux Λ f₁ + posPartAux Λ f₂
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (posPartAux_le fun g hg => ?_) ?_
  · 
    obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂⟩ := CompactlySupportedContinuousMap.exists_add_of_le (inf_le_left : g ⊓ f₁ ≤ g)
    have hg₂f₂ : g₂ ≤ f₂ := le_def.2 fun x => by
      have hx : min (g x) (f₁ x) + g₂ x = g x := by simpa using congr($hg₂ x)
      have hgx : g x ≤ f₁ x + f₂ x := by simpa using le_def.1 hg x
      rcases le_total (g x) (f₁ x) with h | h
      · rw [min_eq_left h, add_eq_left] at hx
        simp [hx]
      · rw [min_eq_right h] at hx
        exact le_of_add_le_add_left (hx ▸ hgx)
    rw [← hg₂, toReal_add, map_add]
    exact add_le_add (apply_le_posPartAux hΛ inf_le_right) (apply_le_posPartAux hΛ hg₂f₂)
  · rw [← le_sub_iff_add_le]
    refine posPartAux_le fun g₁ hg₁ => ?_
    rw [le_sub_comm]
    refine posPartAux_le fun g₂ hg₂ => ?_
    rw [le_sub_iff_add_le', ← map_add, ← toReal_add]
    exact apply_le_posPartAux hΛ (add_le_add hg₁ hg₂)

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.apply_toReal_smul
statement:
private lemma apply_toReal_smul (c : ℝ≥0) (g : C_c(X, ℝ≥0)) :
    Λ (c • g).toReal = c * Λ g.toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [toReal_smul, NNReal.smul_def, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.posPartAux_smul
statement:
private lemma posPartAux_smul (c : ℝ≥0) (f : C_c(X, ℝ≥0)) :
    posPartAux Λ (c • f) = c * posPartAux Λ f
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with rfl | hc
  · refine le_antisymm (posPartAux_le fun g hg => ?_) (by simpa using posPartAux_nonneg hΛ 0)
    have hg0 : g = 0 := le_antisymm (by simpa using hg) (le_def.2 fun x => by simp)
    simp [hg0]
  have hc₀ : (0 : ℝ) < c := by positivity
  refine le_antisymm (posPartAux_le fun g hg => ?_) ?_
  · 
    have hle : c⁻¹ • g ≤ f := le_def.2 fun x => by
      have hx : g x ≤ c * f x := by simpa using le_def.1 hg x
      simpa [inv_mul_le_iff₀ (pos_iff_ne_zero.2 hc)] using hx
    have hg' : g = c • c⁻¹ • g := by rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]
    rw [hg', apply_toReal_smul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (apply_le_posPartAux hΛ hle) hc₀.le
  · rw [← le_div_iff₀' hc₀]
    refine posPartAux_le fun g hg => ?_
    rw [le_div_iff₀' hc₀, ← apply_toReal_smul]
    refine apply_le_posPartAux hΛ (le_def.2 fun x => ?_)
    simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_def.1 hg x) c.2

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.coe_posPartNNReal_apply
statement:
private lemma coe_posPartNNReal_apply (f : C_c(X, ℝ≥0)) :
    (posPartNNReal hΛ f : ℝ) = posPartAux Λ f
proof:
:=
  (rfl)

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.posPart_apply_eq_posPartAux
statement:
private lemma posPart_apply_eq_posPartAux {f : C_c(X, ℝ)} (hf : 0 ≤ f) :
    posPart Λ hΛ f = posPartAux Λ f.nnrealPart
proof:
:= by
  simp [posPart, toRealPositiveLinear_apply, nnrealPart_neg_eq_zero_of_nonneg hf,
    coe_posPartNNReal_apply]

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.apply_le_posPart_apply
statement:
private theorem apply_le_posPart_apply {f g : C_c(X, ℝ)} (hg : 0 ≤ g) (hgf : g ≤ f) :
    Λ g ≤ posPart Λ hΛ f
proof:
:= by
  rw [posPart_apply_eq_posPartAux hΛ (hg.trans hgf)]
  have h := apply_le_posPartAux hΛ (f := f.nnrealPart) (g := g.nnrealPart) <|
    toReal_le_toReal_iff.1 <| by
      rwa [toReal_nnrealPart_of_nonneg hg, toReal_nnrealPart_of_nonneg (hg.trans hgf)]
  rwa [toReal_nnrealPart_of_nonneg hg] at h

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.posPart_apply_le
statement:
private theorem posPart_apply_le {f : C_c(X, ℝ)} (hf : 0 ≤ f) {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ g : C_c(X, ℝ), 0 ≤ g → g ≤ f → Λ g ≤ c) : posPart Λ hΛ f ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [posPart_apply_eq_posPartAux hΛ hf]
  exact posPartAux_le fun g hg => h _ toReal_nonneg
    ((toReal_le_toReal_iff.2 hg).trans_eq (toReal_nnrealPart_of_nonneg hf))

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.negPart_apply
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem negPart_apply (f : C_c(X, ℝ)) : negPart Λ hΛ f = posPart Λ hΛ f - Λ f
proof:
:=
  (rfl)

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.posPart_sub_negPart_apply
statement:
private theorem posPart_sub_negPart_apply (f : C_c(X, ℝ)) :
    posPart Λ hΛ f - negPart Λ hΛ f = Λ f
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.negPart_apply_le
statement:
private theorem negPart_apply_le {f : C_c(X, ℝ)} (hf : 0 ≤ f) {c : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ g : C_c(X, ℝ), 0 ≤ g → g ≤ f → -Λ g ≤ c) : negPart Λ hΛ f ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [negPart_apply, sub_le_iff_le_add]
  refine posPart_apply_le hΛ hf fun g hg hgf => ?_
  have := h (f - g) (sub_nonneg.2 hgf) (sub_le_self f hg)
  rw [map_sub] at this
  linarith

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.Internal.integral_rieszMeasure_posPart_sub_integral_rieszMeasure_negPart
proof:
:= by
  rw [_root_.RealRMK.integral_rieszMeasure, _root_.RealRMK.integral_rieszMeasure,
    posPart_sub_negPart_apply]

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.cc_norm_le
statement:
private theorem cc_norm_le {f : C_c(X, ℝ)} {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hf : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C) : ‖(f : C₀(X, ℝ))‖ ≤ C
proof:
:=
  (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le hC).2 hf

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.restrictFunctional_orderBounded
statement:
private theorem restrictFunctional_orderBounded (L : C₀(X, ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (f : C_c(X, ℝ)) : BddAbove (restrictFunctional L '' Icc 0 f)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨‖L‖ * ‖(f : C₀(X, ℝ))‖, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨g, ⟨hg, hgf⟩, rfl⟩
  have hgn : ‖(g : C₀(X, ℝ))‖ ≤ ‖(f : C₀(X, ℝ))‖ := by
    apply cc_norm_le (norm_nonneg _)
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hg x)]
    exact (hgf x).trans ((f : C₀(X, ℝ)).toBCF.apply_le_norm x)
  exact (le_abs_self (L (g : C₀(X, ℝ)))).trans <|
    (L.le_opNorm (g : C₀(X, ℝ))).trans <|
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgn (norm_nonneg _)

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.finite_rieszMeasure_of_cutoff_bound
statement:
private theorem finite_rieszMeasure_of_cutoff_bound (P : C_c(X, ℝ) →ₚ[ℝ] ℝ)
    {C : ℝ} (_hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hP : ∀ f : C_c(X, ℝ), (∀ x, f x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) → P f ≤ C) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (_root_.RealRMK.rieszMeasure P)
proof:
:= by
  have hcompact (K : Set X) (hK : IsCompact K) :
      _root_.RealRMK.rieszMeasure P K ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C := by
    obtain ⟨f, hfK, hfc, _, hf01⟩ :=
      exists_continuousMap_one_of_isCompact_subset_isOpen hK isOpen_univ (subset_univ K)
    let g : C_c(X, ℝ) := ⟨f, hfc⟩
    exact (_root_.RealRMK.rieszMeasure_le_of_eq_one P (f := g)
      (fun x => (hf01 x).1) hK hfK).trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (hP g hf01))
  have hmass : _root_.RealRMK.rieszMeasure P univ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C := by
    rw [isOpen_univ.measure_eq_iSup_isCompact]
    exact iSup_le fun K => iSup_le fun _ => iSup_le fun hK => hcompact K hK
  exact ⟨hmass.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top⟩

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.finite_posPart_measure
proof:
:= by
  apply finite_rieszMeasure_of_cutoff_bound _ (norm_nonneg L)
  intro f hf
  apply Internal.posPart_apply_le (restrictFunctional_orderBounded L)
    (fun x => (hf x).1)
  intro g hg hgf
  have hgn : ‖(g : C₀(X, ℝ))‖ ≤ 1 := by
    apply cc_norm_le zero_le_one
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hg x)]
    exact (hgf x).trans (hf x).2
  exact (le_abs_self (L (g : C₀(X, ℝ)))).trans <|
    (L.le_opNorm (g : C₀(X, ℝ))).trans <| by nlinarith [norm_nonneg L]

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.finite_negPart_measure
proof:
:= by
  apply finite_rieszMeasure_of_cutoff_bound _ (norm_nonneg L)
  intro f hf
  apply Internal.negPart_apply_le (restrictFunctional_orderBounded L)
    (fun x => (hf x).1)
  intro g hg hgf
  have hgn : ‖(g : C₀(X, ℝ))‖ ≤ 1 := by
    apply cc_norm_le zero_le_one
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hg x)]
    exact (hgf x).trans (hf x).2
  exact (neg_le_abs (L (g : C₀(X, ℝ)))).trans <|
    (L.le_opNorm (g : C₀(X, ℝ))).trans <| by nlinarith [norm_nonneg L]

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.denseRange_compactlySupported
statement:
theorem denseRange_compactlySupported :
    DenseRange (fun f : C_c(X, ℝ) => (f : C₀(X, ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  apply Metric.mem_closure_iff.2
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨K, hK, htail⟩ := Filter.mem_cocompact.1 <|
    (zero_at_infty f) (Metric.ball_mem_nhds (0 : ℝ) (half_pos hε))
  obtain ⟨χ, hχK, hχc, _, hχ01⟩ :=
    exists_continuousMap_one_of_isCompact_subset_isOpen hK isOpen_univ (subset_univ K)
  have hχsupport : HasCompactSupport (χ : X → ℝ) := hχc
  let g : C_c(X, ℝ) := ⟨χ * f.toContinuousMap, hχsupport.mul_right⟩
  refine ⟨ccInclusion g, ⟨g, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (half_lt_self hε)
  rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm]
  apply (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (le_of_lt (half_pos hε))).2
  intro x
  change ‖χ x * f x - f x‖ ≤ ε / 2
  by_cases hx : x ∈ K
  · simpa [hχK hx] using (le_of_lt (half_pos hε))
  · have ht := htail hx
    have hfx : |f x| < ε / 2 := by simpa [Real.dist_eq] using ht
    have hχ : |χ x - 1| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor <;> linarith [(hχ01 x).1, (hχ01 x).2]
    calc
      _ = |χ x - 1| * |f x| := by rw [← sub_one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      _ ≤ 1 * |f x| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hχ (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ ε / 2 := by linarith

name: TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.exists_finite_regular_measure_sub
statement:
theorem exists_finite_regular_measure_sub (L : C₀(X, ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ∃ μ ν : Measure X, IsFiniteMeasure μ ∧ IsFiniteMeasure ν ∧ μ.Regular ∧ ν.Regular ∧
      ∀ f : C₀(X, ℝ), L f = (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∫ x, f x ∂ν
proof:
:= by
  let Λ := restrictFunctional L
  let P := Internal.posPart Λ (restrictFunctional_orderBounded L)
  let N := Internal.negPart Λ (restrictFunctional_orderBounded L)
  let μ := _root_.RealRMK.rieszMeasure P
  let ν := _root_.RealRMK.rieszMeasure N
  have hμ : IsFiniteMeasure μ := finite_posPart_measure L
  have hν : IsFiniteMeasure ν := finite_negPart_measure L
  let := hμ
  let := hν
  refine ⟨μ, ν, hμ, hν, inferInstance, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  have hcont (ρ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure ρ] :
      Continuous (fun f : C₀(X, ℝ) => ∫ x, f x ∂ρ) := by
    apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.2
    intro f
    apply Metric.continuousAt_iff.2
    intro ε hε
    refine ⟨ε / (ρ.real univ + 1), by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro g hg
    rw [dist_eq_norm]
    have hgint : Integrable (fun x => g x) ρ := g.toBCF.integrable ρ
    have hfint : Integrable (fun x => f x) ρ := f.toBCF.integrable ρ
    rw [← integral_sub hgint hfint]
    have hbound := (g - f).toBCF.norm_integral_le_mul_norm ρ
    rw [ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.norm_toBCF_eq_norm] at hbound
    change ‖∫ x, g x - f x ∂ρ‖ ≤ ρ.real univ * ‖g - f‖ at hbound
    have hdist : ‖g - f‖ < ε / (ρ.real univ + 1) := by simpa [dist_eq_norm] using hg
    have := (lt_div_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < ρ.real univ + 1)).1 hdist
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (g - f), measureReal_nonneg (μ := ρ) (s := univ)]
  have heq : (fun f : C₀(X, ℝ) => L f) = fun f => (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∫ x, f x ∂ν := by
    apply denseRange_compactlySupported.equalizer L.continuous ((hcont μ).sub (hcont ν))
    funext f
    change Λ f = (∫ x, f x ∂μ) - ∫ x, f x ∂ν
    exact (Internal.integral_rieszMeasure_posPart_sub_integral_rieszMeasure_negPart
      (restrictFunctional_orderBounded L) f).symm
  exact congrFun heq

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveMapExamples.carrier_subsingleton_of_discrete
statement:
theorem carrier_subsingleton_of_discrete {X I : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [DiscreteTopology X]
    {V : CoverFamily X I} (a : MultiNerveCell V) : a.carrier.Subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨hx, hcx⟩ y ⟨hy, hcy⟩
  obtain ⟨γ⟩ := Quotient.exact (hcx.trans hcy.symm)
  have h := PreconnectedSpace.constant (inferInstance : PreconnectedSpace unitInterval)
    γ.continuous (x := 0) (y := 1)
  rw [γ.source, γ.target] at h
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: TDA.Topology.MultiNerveMapExamples.collapse_multiNerveMap_separates
statement:
theorem collapse_multiNerveMap_separates :
    pointCell false ≠ pointCell true ∧
      (∀ b, (multiNerveMap collapseRefinement (pointCell b)).support = {()}) ∧
      (∀ b, b ∈ (multiNerveMap collapseRefinement (pointCell b)).carrier) ∧
      multiNerveMap collapseRefinement (pointCell false) ≠
        multiNerveMap collapseRefinement (pointCell true)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ b, b ∈ (multiNerveMap collapseRefinement (pointCell b)).carrier :=
    fun b => ⟨_, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun b => Finset.eq_singleton_iff_nonempty_unique_mem.2
    ⟨support_nonempty _, fun _ _ => rfl⟩, hmem, fun h => ?_⟩
  · have hs := congrArg MultiNerveCell.support h
    exact Bool.false_ne_true (Finset.singleton_inj.1 hs)
  · have hf := hmem false
    rw [h] at hf
    exact Bool.false_ne_true (carrier_subsingleton_of_discrete _ hf (hmem true))

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.labelCount_le_card
statement:
theorem labelCount_le_card [Fintype V] (p : V → X) (A : Set X) :
    labelCount p A ≤ Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa [labelCount] using Finset.card_filter_le (Finset.univ : Finset V) (fun v => p v ∈ A)

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.labelCount_comp_embedding_le
statement:
theorem labelCount_comp_embedding_le [Fintype V] [Fintype W]
    (i : V ↪ W) (p : W → X) (A : Set X) :
    labelCount (p ∘ i) A ≤ labelCount p A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsub : ((Finset.univ.filter (fun v => p (i v) ∈ A)).map i) ⊆
      Finset.univ.filter (fun w => p w ∈ A) := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hw
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2⟩
  simpa [labelCount, Function.comp_def] using Finset.card_le_card hsub

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.uniformMeasure_real_comp_embedding_le
statement:
theorem uniformMeasure_real_comp_embedding_le (i : V ↪ W) (p : W → X)
    {A : Set X} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    (uniformMeasure (p ∘ i)).real A ≤ (uniformMeasure p).real A +
      ((Fintype.card W : ℝ) - Fintype.card V) / Fintype.card W
proof:
:= by
  have hn : 0 < (Fintype.card V : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hN : 0 < (Fintype.card W : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hnN : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card W := by
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_le_of_injective i i.injective
  have hab : (labelCount (p ∘ i) A : ℝ) ≤ labelCount p A := by
    exact_mod_cast labelCount_comp_embedding_le i p A
  have han : (labelCount (p ∘ i) A : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card V := by
    exact_mod_cast labelCount_le_card (p ∘ i) A
  rw [uniformMeasure_real _ hA, uniformMeasure_real _ hA, ← add_div]
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hn hN).2
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hab hn.le
  have hprod := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hnN) (sub_nonneg.mpr han)
  nlinarith

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.levyProkhorovDist_uniform_embedding_le
statement:
theorem levyProkhorovDist_uniform_embedding_le (i : V ↪ W) (p : W → X) :
    levyProkhorovDist (uniformMeasure (p ∘ i)) (uniformMeasure p) ≤
      ((Fintype.card W : ℝ) - Fintype.card V) / Fintype.card W
proof:
:= by
  have hnN : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ Fintype.card W := by
    exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_le_of_injective i i.injective
  have hδ : 0 ≤ ((Fintype.card W : ℝ) - Fintype.card V) / Fintype.card W :=
    div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hnN) (by positivity)
  apply levyProkhorovDist_le_of_forall_le _ _ hδ
  intro ε A hε hA
  have hεpos : 0 < ε := hδ.trans_lt hε
  have hm := uniformMeasure_real_comp_embedding_le i p hA
  calc
    uniformMeasure (p ∘ i) A = ENNReal.ofReal ((uniformMeasure (p ∘ i)).real A) :=
      (ofReal_measureReal).symm
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((uniformMeasure p).real A + ε) :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith)
    _ = uniformMeasure p A + ENNReal.ofReal ε := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add (measureReal_nonneg) hεpos.le, ofReal_measureReal]
    _ ≤ uniformMeasure p (thickening ε A) + ENNReal.ofReal ε :=
      add_le_add (measure_mono (self_subset_thickening hεpos A)) le_rfl

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_embedding_le
statement:
theorem levyProkhorovEDist_uniform_embedding_le (i : V ↪ W) (p : W → X) :
    levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure (p ∘ i)) (uniformMeasure p) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (((Fintype.card W : ℝ) - Fintype.card V) / Fintype.card W)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (levyProkhorovDist_uniform_embedding_le i p)
  simpa only [levyProkhorovDist, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (levyProkhorovEDist_ne_top _ _)] using h

name: TDA.Topology.MeasureBifiltration.uniformOutlierInterleaving_right

name: TDA.Topology.nerveMap_contiguous
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsn, x, hx⟩ := (TDA.Topology.mem_nerve_iff U s).1 hs
  refine (TDA.Topology.mem_nerve_iff V _).2 ⟨?_, x, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hsn
    exact ⟨R.selector i, Finset.mem_union_left _
      (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)⟩
  · intro j hj
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hj with hj | hj
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hj
      exact R.subset i (hx i hi)
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hj
      exact S.subset i (hx i hi)

name: TDA.Probability.distortion_self
statement: @[simp] theorem distortion_self (a : X × Y) : distortion a a = 0
proof:

proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Probability.Coupling.distortionMoment_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem Coupling.distortionMoment_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton Y]
    {μ : PMF X} {ν : PMF Y} (π : Coupling μ ν) (p : ℝ) :
    π.distortionMoment p = expectation μ (fun x => expectation μ
      (fun x' => ENNReal.ofReal (dist x x') ^ p))
proof:
:= by
  have hd (a b : X × Y) : distortion a b = ENNReal.ofReal (dist a.1 b.1) := by
    simp [distortion, Subsingleton.elim a.2 b.2, abs_of_nonneg dist_nonneg]
  simp only [Coupling.distortionMoment, hd]
  have hm (f : X → ℝ≥0∞) : expectation π.joint (fun a => f a.1) = expectation μ f := by
    rw [← expectation_map, π.fst_map]
  calc
    _ = expectation π.joint (fun a => expectation μ
        (fun x' => ENNReal.ofReal (dist a.1 x') ^ p)) := by
      congr 1
      funext a
      exact hm (fun x' => ENNReal.ofReal (dist a.1 x') ^ p)
    _ = _ := hm (fun x => expectation μ (fun x' => ENNReal.ofReal (dist x x') ^ p))

name: TDA.Probability.gromovWasserstein_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem gromovWasserstein_of_subsingleton [Subsingleton Y]
    (μ : PMF X) (ν : PMF Y) (p : ℝ) :
    gromovWasserstein p μ ν = (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ *
      expectation μ (fun x => expectation μ (fun x' => ENNReal.ofReal (dist x x') ^ p)) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  simp [gromovWasserstein, Coupling.distortionMoment_of_subsingleton]

name: TDA.Probability.MeasureCoupling.cost_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem cost_map (π : MeasureCoupling μ ν) (f : X → Z) (g : Y → W)
    [MeasurableSpace Z] [MeasurableSpace W] (hf : Measurable f) (hg : Measurable g)
    (c : Z → W → ℝ≥0∞) (hc : Measurable (fun xy : Z × W => c xy.1 xy.2)) :
    (π.map f g hf hg).cost c = π.cost (fun x y => c (f x) (g y))
proof:
:= by
  change ∫⁻ xy : Z × W, c xy.1 xy.2 ∂Measure.map (Prod.map f g)
      (π.joint : Measure (X × Y)) = _
  rw [lintegral_map hc (hf.prodMap hg)]
  rfl

name: TDA.Probability.measureTransportCost_le_coupling
statement:
theorem measureTransportCost_le_coupling (c : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞)

    measureTransportCost c μ ν ≤ π.cost c
proof: := iInf_le _ π

name: TDA.Probability.measureWasserstein_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem measureWasserstein_eq_iInf {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (c : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞)
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure X) (ν : ProbabilityMeasure Y) :
    measureWasserstein p c μ ν =
      ⨅ π : MeasureCoupling μ ν, π.cost (fun x y => c x y ^ p) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  exact (ENNReal.orderIsoRpow p⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hp)).map_iInf _
