name: TDA.Probability.expectation_add
statement:
theorem expectation_add (μ : PMF X) (f g : X → ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectation μ (fun x => f x + g x) = expectation μ f + expectation μ g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [expectation, mul_add, ENNReal.tsum_add]

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_sum
statement:
theorem expectation_sum (μ : PMF X) {I : Type*} (s : Finset I) (f : I → X → ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectation μ (fun x => ∑ i ∈ s, f i x) = ∑ i ∈ s, expectation μ (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [expectation]
  | @insert i s hi ih => simp [hi, expectation_add, ih]

name: TDA.Probability.iid_eval
statement:
theorem iid_eval (μ : PMF X) {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    (iid μ n).map (fun t => t i) = μ
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ n ih =>
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp only [iid_succ, PMF.map_bind, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def, Fin.cons_zero]
      change (μ.bind fun x => (iid μ n).map (Function.const _ x)) = μ
      simp [PMF.map_const, PMF.bind_pure]
    · simp only [iid_succ, PMF.map_bind, PMF.map_comp, Function.comp_def, Fin.cons_succ]
      simp only [ih, PMF.bind_const]

name: TDA.Probability.pairEnergy_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairEnergy_zero (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) (t : Fin 0 → X) :
    pairEnergy c t = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Probability.pairEnergy_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairEnergy_succ (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) {n : ℕ} (t : Fin (n+1) → X) :
    pairEnergy c t = pairEnergy c (fun i => t i.succ) + ∑ j : Fin n, c (t 0) (t j.succ)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Probability.cost_le_pairEnergy
statement:
theorem cost_le_pairEnergy (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hc : ∀ x, c x x = 0) (hs : ∀ x y, c x y = c y x)
    {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → X) (i j : Fin n) : c (t i) (t j) ≤ pairEnergy c t
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ n ih =>
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i' => ?_) i
    · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j' => ?_) j
      · simp [hc]
      · exact (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j : Fin n => c (t 0) (t j.succ))
          (fun _ _ => bot_le) (Finset.mem_univ j')).trans
          (le_add_left le_rfl)
    · refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j' => ?_) j
      · rw [hs]
        exact (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j : Fin n => c (t 0) (t j.succ))
          (fun _ _ => bot_le) (Finset.mem_univ i')).trans
          (le_add_left le_rfl)
      · exact (ih (fun a => t a.succ) i' j').trans (le_add_right le_rfl)

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_pairEnergy
statement:
theorem expectation_pairEnergy (μ : PMF X) (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) (n : ℕ) :
    expectation (iid μ n) (pairEnergy c) =
      (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) * expectation μ (fun x => expectation μ (c x))
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [expectation]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [iid_succ, expectation_bind]
    simp only [expectation_map, pairEnergy_succ, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ,
      expectation_add, expectation_sum]
    have heval (x : X) (j : Fin n) :
        expectation (iid μ n) (fun t => c x (t j)) = expectation μ (c x) := by
      rw [← expectation_map, iid_eval]
    simp only [heval, ih, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
      nsmul_eq_mul]
    rw [expectation_const]
    rw [← add_mul]
    congr 1
    norm_cast
    simp [Nat.choose_succ_succ, Nat.choose_one_right, Nat.add_comm]

name: TDA.Probability.cost_le_pairMaximum
statement:
theorem cost_le_pairMaximum (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → X)
    (i j : Fin n) : c (t i) (t j) ≤ pairMaximum c t
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun ij : Fin n × Fin n => c (t ij.1) (t ij.2))
    (Finset.mem_univ (i, j))

name: TDA.Probability.pairMaximum_rpow_le_pairEnergy
statement:
theorem pairMaximum_rpow_le_pairEnergy (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hc : ∀ x, c x x = 0) (hs : ∀ x y, c x y = c y x)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → X) :
    pairMaximum c t ^ p ≤ pairEnergy (fun x y => c x y ^ p) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.le_rpow_inv_iff hp]
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro ij _
  rw [ENNReal.le_rpow_inv_iff hp]
  exact cost_le_pairEnergy _ (fun x => by simp [hc, hp])
    (fun x y => by rw [hs]) t ij.1 ij.2

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_pairMaximum_rpow_le
statement:
theorem expectation_pairMaximum_rpow_le (μ : PMF X) (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hc : ∀ x, c x x = 0) (hs : ∀ x y, c x y = c y x)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (n : ℕ) :
    expectation (iid μ n) (fun t => pairMaximum c t ^ p) ≤
      (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) * expectation μ (fun x => expectation μ (fun y => c x y ^ p))
proof:
:= by
  exact (expectation_mono _ (fun t => pairMaximum_rpow_le_pairEnergy c hc hs hp t)).trans_eq
    (expectation_pairEnergy μ _ n)

name: TDA.Probability.mem_support_of_mem_support_iid
statement:
theorem mem_support_of_mem_support_iid (μ : PMF X) {n : ℕ} {t : Fin n → X}
    (ht : t ∈ (iid μ n).support) (i : Fin n) : t i ∈ μ.support
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iid_eval μ i]
  exact (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mpr ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Probability.essentialSup_pairMaximum_le
statement:
theorem essentialSup_pairMaximum_le (μ : PMF X) (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) (n : ℕ) :
    essentialSup (iid μ n) (pairMaximum c) ≤
      essentialSup μ (fun x => essentialSup μ (c x))
proof:
:= by
  apply iSup_le
  intro t
  apply iSup_le
  intro ht
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro ij _
  apply le_iSup_of_le (t ij.1)
  apply le_iSup_of_le (mem_support_of_mem_support_iid μ ht ij.1)
  apply le_iSup_of_le (t ij.2)
  exact le_iSup_of_le (mem_support_of_mem_support_iid μ ht ij.2) le_rfl

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_const
statement:
@[simp] theorem expectation_const (μ : PMF X) (c : ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectation μ (fun _ => c) = c
proof:
:= by
  simp [expectation, ENNReal.tsum_mul_right, μ.tsum_coe]

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_pure
statement:
@[simp] theorem expectation_pure (x : X) (f : X → ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectation (PMF.pure x) f = f x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [expectation, PMF.pure_apply]

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_map
statement:
theorem expectation_map (μ : PMF X) (g : X → Y) (f : Y → ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectation (μ.map g) f = expectation μ (fun x => f (g x))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [expectation, PMF.map_apply, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_comm]
  congr 1
  funext x
  simp

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_bind
statement:
theorem expectation_bind (μ : PMF X) (ν : X → PMF Y) (f : Y → ℝ≥0∞) :
    expectation (μ.bind ν) f = expectation μ (fun x => expectation (ν x) f)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [expectation, PMF.bind_apply, ← ENNReal.tsum_mul_right]
  rw [ENNReal.tsum_comm]
  simp only [mul_assoc, ENNReal.tsum_mul_left]

name: TDA.Probability.expectation_mono
statement:
theorem expectation_mono (μ : PMF X) {f g : X → ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) :
    expectation μ f ≤ expectation μ g
proof:
:=
  ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum fun x => mul_le_mul_right (h x) _

name: TDA.Probability.Coupling.row_sum
statement:
theorem row_sum [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (π : Coupling μ ν) (x : X) :
    ∑ y, π.joint (x, y) = μ x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := congrArg (fun p : PMF X => p x) π.fst_map
  simpa [PMF.map_apply, tsum_fintype, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm] using h

name: TDA.Probability.Coupling.col_sum
statement:
theorem col_sum [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (π : Coupling μ ν) (y : Y) :
    ∑ x, π.joint (x, y) = ν y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := congrArg (fun p : PMF Y => p y) π.snd_map
  simpa [PMF.map_apply, tsum_fintype, Fintype.sum_prod_type] using h

name: TDA.Probability.Coupling.cost_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem cost_map (π : Coupling μ ν) (f : X → Z) (g : Y → W)
    (c : Z → W → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (π.map f g).cost c = π.cost (fun x y => c (f x) (g y))
proof:
:=
  expectation_map _ _ _

name: TDA.Probability.iid_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem iid_zero (μ : PMF X) : iid μ 0 = PMF.pure Fin.elim0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Probability.iid_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem iid_succ (μ : PMF X) (n : ℕ) :
    iid μ (n + 1) = μ.bind (fun x => (iid μ n).map (Fin.cons x))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Probability.iid_map
statement:
theorem iid_map (μ : PMF X) (f : X → Y) (n : ℕ) :
    (iid μ n).map (fun t i => f (t i)) = iid (μ.map f) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [iid_zero, PMF.pure_map, iid_zero]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [iid_succ, PMF.map_bind, PMF.map_comp, PMF.bind_map]
    congr 1
    funext x
    rw [← ih]
    change (iid μ n).map _ = ((iid μ n).map _).map _
    rw [PMF.map_comp]
    congr 1
    funext t
    funext i
    exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i

name: TDA.Probability.transportCost_le_coupling
statement:
theorem transportCost_le_coupling (c : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞) (μ : PMF X) (ν : PMF Y)
    (π : Coupling μ ν) : transportCost c μ ν ≤ π.cost c
proof: := iInf_le _ π

name: TDA.Probability.wasserstein_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem wasserstein_eq_iInf {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) (c : X → Y → ℝ≥0∞)
    (μ : PMF X) (ν : PMF Y) :
    wasserstein p c μ ν = ⨅ π : Coupling μ ν, π.cost (fun x y => c x y ^ p) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  exact (ENNReal.orderIsoRpow p⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hp)).map_iInf _

name: TDA.Probability.essentialSup_map
statement:
theorem essentialSup_map (μ : PMF X) (g : X → Y) (f : Y → ℝ≥0∞) :
    essentialSup (μ.map g) f = essentialSup μ (fun x => f (g x))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply iSup_le
    intro y
    apply iSup_le
    intro hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := (PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mp hy
    exact le_iSup_of_le x (le_iSup_of_le hx le_rfl)
  · apply iSup_le
    intro x
    apply iSup_le
    intro hx
    apply le_iSup_of_le (g x)
    apply le_iSup_of_le ((PMF.mem_support_map_iff _ _ _).mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
    exact le_rfl

name: TDA.Probability.measurable_tuplePairMap
statement: private theorem measurable_tuplePairMap : Measurable (tuplePairMap (X := X) (Y := Y) (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  apply Measurable.prodMk
  · apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro i
    exact measurable_fst.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  · apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro i
    exact measurable_snd.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)

name: TDA.Probability.MeasureCoupling.cost_tuples
statement:
theorem cost_tuples (π : MeasureCoupling μ ν) (n : ℕ)
    (c : (Fin n → X) → (Fin n → Y) → ℝ≥0∞)
    (hc : Measurable (fun ts : (Fin n → X) × (Fin n → Y) => c ts.1 ts.2)) :
    (π.tuples n).cost c =
      ∫⁻ t, c (fun i => (t i).1) (fun i => (t i).2)
        ∂(ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => π.joint) : Measure (Fin n → X × Y))
proof:
:= by
  change ∫⁻ ts, c ts.1 ts.2 ∂Measure.map
      (tuplePairMap (X := X) (Y := Y) (n := n))
      (ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => π.joint) : Measure (Fin n → X × Y)) = _
  rw [lintegral_map hc (measurable_tuplePairMap (X := X) (Y := Y) (n := n))]
  rfl

name: TDA.Probability.pairEnergy_eq_pairEnergyNested
statement:
private theorem pairEnergy_eq_pairEnergyNested (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) {n : ℕ}
    (t : Fin n → X) : pairEnergy c t = pairEnergyNested c t
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [pairEnergy, pairEnergyNested]
  | succ n ih =>
    simp [pairEnergy_succ, pairEnergyNested, Fin.sum_univ_succ, ih, add_comm]

name: TDA.Probability.pairEnergyNested_eq_pairEnergySum
statement:
private theorem pairEnergyNested_eq_pairEnergySum (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) {n : ℕ}
    (t : Fin n → X) : pairEnergyNested c t = pairEnergySum c t
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ i : Fin n, ∑ j : Fin n, if i < j then c (t i) (t j) else 0) = _
  exact (Fintype.sum_prod_type' (fun i j => if i < j then c (t i) (t j) else 0)).symm

name: TDA.Probability.pairEnergySum_eq_pairIndicesSum
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairEnergySum, pairIndices, Finset.sum_filter]

name: TDA.Probability.pairEnergy_eq_pairEnergySum
statement:
private theorem pairEnergy_eq_pairEnergySum (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) {n : ℕ}
    (t : Fin n → X) : pairEnergy c t = pairEnergySum c t
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairEnergy_eq_pairEnergyNested, pairEnergyNested_eq_pairEnergySum]

name: TDA.Probability.pairIndices_card
statement: private theorem pairIndices_card (n : ℕ) : (pairIndices n).card = n.choose 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pairIndices, Fintype.card_fin] using
    (Finset.card_product_filter_lt (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n))))

name: TDA.Probability.iid_pair_map
statement:
private theorem iid_pair_map (μ : ProbabilityMeasure X) (n : ℕ)
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Measure.map (fun t : Fin n → X => (t i, t j))
      (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => (μ : Measure X))) =
        (μ : Measure X).prod μ
proof:
:= by
  let ν : Fin n → Measure X := fun _ => (μ : Measure X)
  have hind : iIndepFun (fun (i : Fin n) (t : Fin n → X) => t i) (Measure.pi ν) :=
    iIndepFun_pi (X := fun _ : Fin n => id) (fun _ => aemeasurable_id)
  have hmap := (hind.indepFun hij).map_prod_eq_prod_map_map
    (measurable_pi_apply i).aemeasurable (measurable_pi_apply j).aemeasurable
  have hi : Measure.map (fun t : Fin n → X => t i) (Measure.pi ν) = μ := by
    exact (measurePreserving_eval ν i).map_eq
  have hj : Measure.map (fun t : Fin n → X => t j) (Measure.pi ν) = μ := by
    exact (measurePreserving_eval ν j).map_eq
  simpa [ν, hi, hj] using hmap

name: TDA.Probability.lintegral_iid_pair
statement:
private theorem lintegral_iid_pair (μ : ProbabilityMeasure X) (n : ℕ)
    (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) (hc : Measurable (fun xy : X × X => c xy.1 xy.2))
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    ∫⁻ t, c (t i) (t j) ∂(iidMeasure μ n : Measure (Fin n → X)) =
      ∫⁻ xy, c xy.1 xy.2 ∂(μ : Measure X).prod μ
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ xy, c xy.1 xy.2 ∂Measure.map (fun t : Fin n → X => (t i, t j))
        (iidMeasure μ n : Measure (Fin n → X)) := by
      symm
      rw [iidMeasure, ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_pi]
      exact lintegral_map hc (by fun_prop)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [iidMeasure, ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_pi]
      rw [iid_pair_map μ n i j hij]

name: TDA.Probability.lintegral_iid_pairEnergy
statement:
theorem lintegral_iid_pairEnergy (μ : ProbabilityMeasure X) (n : ℕ)
    (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) (hc : Measurable (fun xy : X × X => c xy.1 xy.2)) :
    ∫⁻ t, pairEnergy c t ∂(iidMeasure μ n : Measure (Fin n → X)) =
      (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) * ∫⁻ xy, c xy.1 xy.2 ∂(μ : Measure X).prod μ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp_rw [pairEnergy_eq_pairEnergySum, pairEnergySum_eq_pairIndicesSum]
  rw [lintegral_finsetSum (s := pairIndices n)]
  · calc
      _ = ∑ ij ∈ pairIndices n,
          ∫⁻ t, c (t ij.1) (t ij.2) ∂(iidMeasure μ n : Measure (Fin n → X)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro ij hij
        rfl
      _ = ∑ ij ∈ pairIndices n,
          ∫⁻ xy, c xy.1 xy.2 ∂(μ : Measure X).prod μ := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro ij hij
        exact lintegral_iid_pair μ n c hc ij.1 ij.2
          (ne_of_lt (Finset.mem_filter.mp hij).2)
      _ = (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) *
          ∫⁻ xy, c xy.1 xy.2 ∂(μ : Measure X).prod μ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, pairIndices_card]
  · intro ij hij
    fun_prop

name: TDA.Probability.lintegral_iid_pairMaximum_rpow_le
statement:
theorem lintegral_iid_pairMaximum_rpow_le (μ : ProbabilityMeasure X) (n : ℕ)
    (c : X → X → ℝ≥0∞) (hc : ∀ x, c x x = 0)
    (hs : ∀ x y, c x y = c y x) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hcm : Measurable (fun xy : X × X => c xy.1 xy.2)) :
    ∫⁻ t, pairMaximum c t ^ p ∂(iidMeasure μ n : Measure (Fin n → X)) ≤
      (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) * ∫⁻ xy, c xy.1 xy.2 ^ p ∂(μ : Measure X).prod μ
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ t, pairEnergy (fun x y => c x y ^ p) t
        ∂(iidMeasure μ n : Measure (Fin n → X)) := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro t
      exact pairMaximum_rpow_le_pairEnergy c hc hs hp t
    _ = (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) *
        ∫⁻ xy, c xy.1 xy.2 ^ p ∂(μ : Measure X).prod μ :=
      lintegral_iid_pairEnergy μ n (fun x y => c x y ^ p) (by fun_prop)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.cover_bot_member
statement:
theorem cover_bot_member (J : OpenInterval) :
    ⋃ b : Bool, ((cond b ⊥ J : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ) = J
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_iUnion, Bool.exists_bool, cond_false, cond_true, SetLike.mem_coe]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.elim id fun h => (show x ∈ (∅ : Set ℝ) from h).elim, Or.inl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.cover_top
statement:
theorem cover_top :
    ⋃ b : Bool, ((cond b (iio 1) (ioi 0) : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ) = (⊤ : OpenInterval)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_iUnion, Bool.exists_bool, cond_false, cond_true, coe_ioi, coe_iio, mem_Ioi,
    mem_Iio, coe_top, mem_univ, iff_true]
  rcases lt_or_ge x 1 with h | h
  · exact Or.inr h
  · exact Or.inl (by linarith)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.disjoint_thicken_overlap
statement:
theorem disjoint_thicken_overlap :
    ((ioo 0 1 ⊓ ioo 2 3 : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ) = ∅ ∧
      (3 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ thicken 1 (ioo 0 1) ⊓ thicken 1 (ioo 2 3) ∧
      thicken 1 (ioo 0 1 ⊓ ioo 2 3) ≠ thicken 1 (ioo 0 1) ⊓ thicken 1 (ioo 2 3)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ((ioo 0 1 ⊓ ioo 2 3 : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ) = ∅ := by
    ext x; simp only [coe_inf, coe_ioo, mem_inter_iff, mem_Ioo, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
    rintro ⟨⟨-, h1⟩, h2, -⟩; linarith
  have hbot : ioo 0 1 ⊓ ioo 2 3 = ⊥ := SetLike.coe_injective (by rw [h0, coe_bot])
  have hmem : (3 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ thicken 1 (ioo 0 1) ⊓ thicken 1 (ioo 2 3) := by
    show (3 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ (thicken 1 (ioo 0 1) : Set ℝ) ∩ thicken 1 (ioo 2 3)
    rw [thicken_ioo (by norm_num), thicken_ioo (by norm_num)]
    simp only [coe_ioo, mem_inter_iff, mem_Ioo, NNReal.coe_one]
    norm_num
  refine ⟨h0, hmem, fun h => ?_⟩
  rw [hbot, thicken_bot] at h
  have : (3 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ (⊥ : OpenInterval) := h ▸ hmem
  exact this

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.overlap_without_containment
statement:
theorem overlap_without_containment :
    ((ioo 0 1 ⊓ ioo (-5) (1 / 10) : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ).Nonempty ∧
      ¬ thicken 1 (ioo 0 1) ⊓ thicken 1 (ioo 2 3) ≤ thicken 1 (ioo 0 1 ⊓ ioo (-5) (1 / 10))
proof:
:= by
  have hinf : ioo 0 1 ⊓ ioo (-5) (1 / 10) = ioo 0 (1 / 10) := by
    ext x
    show x ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ Ioo (-5) (1 / 10) ↔ x ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 10)
    simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_Ioo]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨h1, -⟩, -, h2⟩; exact ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩; exact ⟨⟨h1, by linarith⟩, by linarith, h2⟩
  refine ⟨⟨1 / 20, by rw [hinf, coe_ioo]; norm_num⟩, fun h => ?_⟩
  have hmem := (disjoint_thicken_overlap).2.1
  have := OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 h hmem
  rw [hinf, thicken_ioo (by norm_num)] at this
  simp only [coe_ioo, mem_Ioo, NNReal.coe_one] at this
  norm_num at this

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.threeCover_union
statement: theorem threeCover_union : ⋃ k, (threeCover k : Set ℝ) = ioo 0 3
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_iUnion, Fin.exists_fin_succ, Fin.exists_fin_zero, threeCover,
    Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_succ, coe_ioo, mem_Ioo, or_false]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩) <;> constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    by_cases ha : x < 1
    · exact Or.inl ⟨h1, ha⟩
    by_cases hb : x < 5 / 2
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨by linarith, hb⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨by linarith, h2⟩)

:= by

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricSmoothingEqIso_hom_eq
statement:

:= by

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafFunctor_map_geometricEnlargement_app
statement:
theorem cosheafFunctor_map_geometricEnlargement_app (h : ε ≤ δ) (B : RGraphCat) :
    (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricEnlargement h).app B)).hom ≫
        ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso δ).hom.app B).hom =
      ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app B).hom ≫
        (smoothingMap h).app (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj
proof:
:= by
  ext I c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk Q' =>
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Q'
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ :=
      ReebQuotient.mk_surjective (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap B.obj) ε) Q
    have hQ' : GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap B.obj) δ
        (GeometricThickening.bandInclusion B.obj.left h z) ∈ I := by
      rw [GeometricThickening.height_bandInclusion]
      exact hQ
    change
      ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso δ).hom.app B).hom.app I
          (ZerothHomotopy.mk
            ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ (GeometricThickening.bandInclusion B.obj.left h z), hQ'⟩) =
        ((smoothingMap h).app (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj).app I
          (((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app B).hom.app I
            (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ z, hQ⟩))
    have l := geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk δ B I
      ⟨GeometricThickening.bandInclusion B.obj.left h z, hQ'⟩
    have r := geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk ε B I ⟨z, hQ⟩
    refine l.trans (Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (fun w =>
      ((smoothingMap h).app (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj).app I w) r).symm)
    rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafShiftMap_comp_geometricEnlargement
statement:
theorem cosheafShiftMap_comp_geometricEnlargement (h : ε ≤ δ)
    (f : A ⟶ (geometricSmoothing ε).obj B) :
    cosheafShiftMap (f ≫ (geometricEnlargement h).app B) =
      cosheafShiftMap f ≫ (smoothingMap h).app (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : (cosheafFunctor.map (f ≫ (geometricEnlargement h).app B)).hom =
      (cosheafFunctor.map f).hom ≫ (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricEnlargement h).app B)).hom := by
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  refine (congrArg (· ≫ ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso δ).hom.app B).hom) e1).trans ?_
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg ((cosheafFunctor.map f).hom ≫ ·)
    (cosheafFunctor_map_geometricEnlargement_app h B)).trans ?_
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.mono_toCosheaf
statement:
theorem mono_toCosheaf (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) (h : ε ≤ δ) :
    (i.mono h).toCosheaf = i.toCosheaf.mono h
proof:
:=
  toCosheaf_ofCosheaf _

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.mono_φ
statement:
theorem mono_φ (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) (h : ε ≤ δ) :
    (i.mono h).φ = i.φ ≫ (geometricEnlargement h).app B
proof:
:= by
  apply cosheafShiftMap_injective δ A B
  rw [← toCosheaf_φ (i.mono h)]
  calc
    (i.mono h).toCosheaf.φ = (i.toCosheaf.mono h).φ := by rw [mono_toCosheaf]
    _ = i.toCosheaf.φ ≫ (smoothingMap h).app (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj := rfl
    _ = cosheafShiftMap i.φ ≫ (smoothingMap h).app (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj := by
      rw [toCosheaf_φ]
    _ = cosheafShiftMap (i.φ ≫ (geometricEnlargement h).app B) :=
      (cosheafShiftMap_comp_geometricEnlargement h i.φ).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.mono_ψ
statement:
theorem mono_ψ (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) (h : ε ≤ δ) :
    (i.mono h).ψ = i.ψ ≫ (geometricEnlargement h).app A
proof:
:= by
  apply cosheafShiftMap_injective δ B A
  rw [← toCosheaf_ψ (i.mono h)]
  calc
    (i.mono h).toCosheaf.ψ = (i.toCosheaf.mono h).ψ := by rw [mono_toCosheaf]
    _ = i.toCosheaf.ψ ≫ (smoothingMap h).app (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj := rfl
    _ = cosheafShiftMap i.ψ ≫ (smoothingMap h).app (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj := by
      rw [toCosheaf_ψ]
    _ = cosheafShiftMap (i.ψ ≫ (geometricEnlargement h).app A) :=
      (cosheafShiftMap_comp_geometricEnlargement h i.ψ).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.nonempty_mono
statement:
theorem nonempty_mono (h : ε ≤ δ) :
    Nonempty (GeometricInterleaving ε A B) → Nonempty (GeometricInterleaving δ A B)
proof: | ⟨i⟩ => ⟨GeometricInterleaving.mono i h⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.nonempty_of_geometricInterleavingDistance_lt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hi⟩ := geometricInterleavingDistance_lt_iff.1 h
  exact nonempty_mono (ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.1 hε₀).le hi

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_le_iff
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_le_iff {r : ℝ≥0∞} :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A B ≤ r ↔
      ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, r < ε → Nonempty (GeometricInterleaving ε A B)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h ε hε
    exact nonempty_of_geometricInterleavingDistance_lt (h.trans_lt hε)
  · intro h
    apply le_of_forall_gt_imp_ge_of_dense
    intro a ha
    by_cases ha_top : a = ⊤
    · rw [ha_top]
      exact le_top
    · obtain ⟨ε, hrε, hεa⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_nnreal_btwn.1 ha
      exact (geometricInterleavingDistance_le_of_nonempty (h ε hrε)).trans hεa.le

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.trans_ψ
statement:
theorem trans_ψ (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B)
    (j : GeometricInterleaving δ B D) :
    (i.trans j).ψ =
      j.ψ ≫ (geometricSmoothing δ).map i.ψ ≫ (geometricSmoothingCompIso δ ε).hom.app A ≫
        (geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_comm δ ε)).hom.app A
proof:
:= by
  apply cosheafShiftMap_injective (ε + δ) D A
  rw [← toCosheaf_ψ (i.trans j), trans_toCosheaf]
  rw [geometricSmoothingEqIso_hom_eq]
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [cosheafShiftMap_comp_geometricEnlargement]
  rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [cosheafShiftMap_comp']
  rw [← toCosheaf_ψ j, ← toCosheaf_ψ i]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.trans_ψ'
statement:
theorem trans_ψ' (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B)
    (j : GeometricInterleaving δ B D) :
    (i.trans j).ψ =
      j.ψ ≫ (geometricSmoothing δ).map i.ψ ≫ (geometricSmoothingCompIso δ ε).hom.app A ≫
        (geometricEnlargement (add_comm δ ε).le).app A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← geometricSmoothingEqIso_hom_eq (add_comm δ ε)]
  exact trans_ψ i j

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.selfSmoothing_φ
statement:
theorem GeometricInterleaving.selfSmoothing_φ (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : RGraphCat) :
    (GeometricInterleaving.selfSmoothing ε A).φ =
      (geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app A ≫
        (geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A)
proof:
:= by
  apply cosheafShiftMap_injective ε A ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A)
  rw [← GeometricInterleaving.toCosheaf_φ (GeometricInterleaving.selfSmoothing ε A)]
  let e : (smoothing ε).obj (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj ≅
      (cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A)).obj :=
    ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso ε).app A).symm
  have hto :
      (GeometricInterleaving.selfSmoothing ε A).toCosheaf =
        (Interleaving.selfSmoothing ε (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj).isoRight e := by
    change
      (GeometricInterleaving.ofCosheaf
        ((Interleaving.selfSmoothing ε (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj).isoRight e)).toCosheaf =
          (Interleaving.selfSmoothing ε (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj).isoRight e
    exact GeometricInterleaving.toCosheaf_ofCosheaf _
  rw [hto]
  rw [Interleaving.isoRight_φ]
  change
    ((smoothingUnit ε).app (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj ≫
      (smoothingUnit ε).app ((smoothing ε).obj (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj)) ≫
        (smoothing ε).map e.hom =
      cosheafShiftMap ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app A ≫
        (geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A))
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← (smoothingUnit ε).naturality e.hom]
  have hunit :
      (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app A)).hom =
        (smoothingUnit ε).app (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj ≫
          ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso ε).app A).symm.hom := by
    have h := congrArg
      (fun k => k ≫ ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso ε).app A).symm.hom)
      (cosheafShiftMap_unit ε A)
    dsimp [cosheafShiftMap] at h
    rw [← geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso_hom_app ε A] at h
    erw [Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app, Category.comp_id] at h
    exact h
  have hcomp :
      cosheafShiftMap ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app A ≫
        (geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A)) =
        (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app A)).hom ≫
          cosheafShiftMap ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A)) := by
    unfold cosheafShiftMap
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  calc
    (smoothingUnit ε).app (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj ≫
        ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso ε).app A).symm.hom ≫
          (smoothingUnit ε).app ((cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A)).obj) =
      (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app A)).hom ≫
        (smoothingUnit ε).app ((cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A)).obj) := by
          rw [hunit]
          exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app A)).hom ≫
        cosheafShiftMap ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A)) := by
          rw [cosheafShiftMap_unit]
    _ = cosheafShiftMap ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app A ≫
        (geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A)) := hcomp.symm

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.selfSmoothing_ψ
statement:
theorem GeometricInterleaving.selfSmoothing_ψ (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : RGraphCat) :
    (GeometricInterleaving.selfSmoothing ε A).ψ = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply cosheafShiftMap_injective ε ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A) A
  rw [← GeometricInterleaving.toCosheaf_ψ (GeometricInterleaving.selfSmoothing ε A)]
  let e : (smoothing ε).obj (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj ≅
      (cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A)).obj :=
    ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso ε).app A).symm
  have hto :
      (GeometricInterleaving.selfSmoothing ε A).toCosheaf =
        (Interleaving.selfSmoothing ε (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj).isoRight e := by
    change
      (GeometricInterleaving.ofCosheaf
        ((Interleaving.selfSmoothing ε (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj).isoRight e)).toCosheaf =
          (Interleaving.selfSmoothing ε (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj).isoRight e
    exact GeometricInterleaving.toCosheaf_ofCosheaf _
  rw [hto]
  rw [Interleaving.isoRight_ψ]
  change
    e.inv ≫ 𝟙 _ = cosheafShiftMap (𝟙 _)
  rw [Category.comp_id]
  have e1 : (cosheafFunctor.map (𝟙 ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A))).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    rfl
  exact (geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso_hom_app ε A).trans
    ((Category.id_comp _).symm.trans
      (congrArg (· ≫ ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app A).hom) e1.symm))

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_self_le

        ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B) ≤ geometricInterleavingDistance A B
proof:
:= by

    geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_interleavingDistance]
  exact interleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_le ε A B

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.neg_mem_band
statement: theorem neg_mem_band {ε : ℝ≥0} {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Band ε) : -t ∈ Band ε
proof:
:=
  ⟨neg_le_neg ht.2, by linarith [ht.1]⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.add_mem_band
statement: theorem add_mem_band {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (s : Band δ) (t : Band ε) : (s : ℝ) + t ∈ Band (ε + δ)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := s.2.1
  have h₂ := s.2.2
  have h₃ := t.2.1
  have h₄ := t.2.2
  rw [Band, NNReal.coe_add]
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem addMap_apply (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (x : X) (s : Band δ) (t : Band ε) :
    addMap X ε δ ((x, s), t) = (x, ⟨s + t, add_mem_band s t⟩)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.height_addMap
statement:
theorem height_addMap (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (z : (X × Band δ) × Band ε) :
    height f (ε + δ) (addMap X ε δ z) = height (height f δ) ε z
proof:
:=
  (add_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addMap_natural
statement:
theorem addMap_natural (g : C(X, Y)) (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    (map g (ε + δ)).comp (addMap X ε δ) = (addMap Y ε δ).comp (map (map g δ) ε)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addMap_comp_bandInclusion
statement:
theorem addMap_comp_bandInclusion {ε ε' δ δ' : ℝ≥0} (hε : ε ≤ ε') (hδ : δ ≤ δ') :
    (addMap X ε' δ').comp ((bandInclusion (X × Band δ') hε).comp (map (bandInclusion X hδ) ε)) =
      (bandInclusion X (add_le_add hε hδ)).comp (addMap X ε δ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addMap_assoc
statement:
theorem addMap_assoc (ε δ γ : ℝ≥0) :
    (bandInclusion X (add_assoc ε δ γ).le).comp
        ((addMap X (ε + δ) γ).comp (addMap (X × Band γ) ε δ)) =
      (addMap X ε (δ + γ)).comp (map (addMap X δ γ) ε)
proof:
:=
  ContinuousMap.ext fun z => Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext
    (show (z.1.1.2 : ℝ) + (z.1.2 + z.2) = z.1.1.2 + z.1.2 + z.2 from (add_assoc _ _ _).symm))

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addMap_zero_left
statement:
theorem addMap_zero_left (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    (bandInclusion X (zero_add δ).le).comp (addMap X 0 δ) =
      (zeroHomeomorph (X × Band δ) : C((X × Band δ) × Band 0, X × Band δ))
proof:
:=
  ContinuousMap.ext fun z => Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext
    (show (z.1.2 : ℝ) + z.2 = z.1.2 by rw [eq_zero_of_mem_band_zero z.2.2, add_zero]))

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addMap_zero_right
statement:
theorem addMap_zero_right (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    (bandInclusion X (add_zero δ).le).comp (addMap X δ 0) =
      map (zeroHomeomorph X : C(X × Band 0, X)) δ
proof:
:=
  ContinuousMap.ext fun z => Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext
    (show (z.1.2 : ℝ) + z.2 = z.2 by rw [eq_zero_of_mem_band_zero z.1.2.2, zero_add]))

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addMap_comp_zeroSection
statement:
theorem addMap_comp_zeroSection (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    (addMap X ε δ).comp (zeroSection (X × Band δ) ε) = bandInclusion X (le_add_self : δ ≤ ε + δ)
proof:
:=
  ContinuousMap.ext fun z => Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext (add_zero (z.2 : ℝ)))

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addMap_comp_map_zeroSection
statement:
theorem addMap_comp_map_zeroSection (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    (addMap X ε δ).comp (map (zeroSection X δ) ε) = bandInclusion X (le_self_add : ε ≤ ε + δ)
proof:
:=
  ContinuousMap.ext fun z => Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext (zero_add (z.2 : ℝ)))

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addMap_surjective
statement:
theorem addMap_surjective (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    Function.Surjective (addMap X ε δ)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, u⟩
  set s : Band δ := projIcc (-(δ : ℝ)) δ (neg_le_band δ) u with hs_def
  have hs : (s : ℝ) = max (-(δ : ℝ)) (min (δ : ℝ) u) := coe_projIcc _ _ _ _
  have h₁ : -((ε : ℝ) + δ) ≤ u := by have := u.2.1; rwa [NNReal.coe_add] at this
  have h₂ : (u : ℝ) ≤ ε + δ := by have := u.2.2; rwa [NNReal.coe_add] at this
  have hε := ε.coe_nonneg
  have hδ := δ.coe_nonneg
  have hmem : (u : ℝ) - s ∈ Band ε := by
    rw [hs]
    have hm1 : min (δ : ℝ) u ≤ δ := min_le_left _ _
    have hm2 : min (δ : ℝ) u ≤ u := min_le_right _ _
    have hv1 : -(δ : ℝ) ≤ max (-(δ : ℝ)) (min (δ : ℝ) u) := le_max_left _ _
    have hv2 : min (δ : ℝ) u ≤ max (-(δ : ℝ)) (min (δ : ℝ) u) := le_max_right _ _
    rcases min_choice (δ : ℝ) u with hm | hm <;>
      rcases max_choice (-(δ : ℝ)) (min (δ : ℝ) u) with hv | hv <;>
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  exact ⟨((x, s), ⟨u - s, hmem⟩), Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext (add_sub_cancel _ _))⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addMap_not_injective
statement:
theorem addMap_not_injective [Nonempty X] {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (hε : 0 < ε) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ¬ Function.Injective (addMap X ε δ)
proof:
:= by
  intro hinj
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
  have hε' : (0 : ℝ) < ε := hε
  have hδ' : (0 : ℝ) < δ := hδ
  have hm : 0 < min (ε : ℝ) δ := lt_min hε' hδ'
  have hmε : min (ε : ℝ) δ ≤ ε := min_le_left _ _
  have hmδ : min (ε : ℝ) δ ≤ δ := min_le_right _ _
  have h := hinj (a₁ := ((x, ⟨0, zero_mem_band δ⟩), ⟨0, zero_mem_band ε⟩))
    (a₂ := ((x, ⟨min (ε : ℝ) δ, ⟨by linarith, hmδ⟩⟩), ⟨-min (ε : ℝ) δ, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩))
    (Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext (show (0 : ℝ) + 0 = min (ε : ℝ) δ + -min (ε : ℝ) δ by ring)))
  have h' := congrArg (fun z : (X × Band δ) × Band ε => (z.1.2 : ℝ)) h
  exact hm.ne h'

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addMap_comp_componentComparison
statement:
theorem addMap_comp_componentComparison (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    intervalComponentNatTrans (addMap X ε δ) (height_addMap f ε δ) ≫
        componentComparison f (ε + δ) =
      componentComparison (height f δ) ε ≫ (smoothing ε).map (componentComparison f δ) ≫
        (smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app (intervalComponents f)
proof:
:= by
  ext I c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk z => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.intervalComponentNatTrans_addMap_app_bijective
statement:
theorem intervalComponentNatTrans_addMap_app_bijective (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε δ : ℝ≥0)
    (I : OpenInterval) :
    Function.Bijective ((intervalComponentNatTrans (addMap X ε δ) (height_addMap f ε δ)).app I)
proof:
:=
  (isIso_iff_bijective _).1 inferInstance

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.bandInclusionNatTrans_app_left_hom
statement:
theorem bandInclusionNatTrans_app_left_hom {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε ≤ δ) (A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)) :
    ((bandInclusionNatTrans h).app A).left.hom = bandInclusion A.left h
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addNatTrans_app_left_hom
statement:
theorem addNatTrans_app_left_hom (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)) :
    ((addNatTrans ε δ).app A).left.hom = addMap A.left ε δ
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addNatTrans_comp_bandInclusionNatTrans
statement:
theorem addNatTrans_comp_bandInclusionNatTrans {ε ε' δ δ' : ℝ≥0} (hε : ε ≤ ε') (hδ : δ ≤ δ') :
    Functor.whiskerRight (bandInclusionNatTrans hδ) (functor ε) ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (functor δ') (bandInclusionNatTrans hε) ≫ addNatTrans ε' δ' =
      addNatTrans ε δ ≫ bandInclusionNatTrans (add_le_add hε hδ)
proof:
:= by
  ext A z
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addNatTrans_assoc
statement:
theorem addNatTrans_assoc (ε δ γ : ℝ≥0) :
    Functor.whiskerLeft (functor γ) (addNatTrans ε δ) ≫ addNatTrans (ε + δ) γ ≫
        bandInclusionNatTrans (add_assoc ε δ γ).le =
      Functor.whiskerRight (addNatTrans δ γ) (functor ε) ≫ addNatTrans ε (δ + γ)
proof:
:= by
  ext A z
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (addMap_assoc (X := A.left) ε δ γ) z

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addNatTrans_zero_left
statement:
theorem addNatTrans_zero_left (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    addNatTrans 0 δ ≫ bandInclusionNatTrans (zero_add δ).le =
      Functor.whiskerLeft (functor δ) zeroIso.hom
proof:
:= by
  ext A z
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (addMap_zero_left (X := A.left) δ) z

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addNatTrans_zero_right
statement:
theorem addNatTrans_zero_right (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    addNatTrans δ 0 ≫ bandInclusionNatTrans (add_zero δ).le =
      Functor.whiskerRight zeroIso.hom (functor δ)
proof:
:= by
  ext A z
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (addMap_zero_right (X := A.left) δ) z

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.whiskerLeft_zeroSectionNatTrans_comp_addNatTrans
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_zeroSectionNatTrans_comp_addNatTrans (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    Functor.whiskerLeft (functor δ) (zeroSectionNatTrans ε) ≫ addNatTrans ε δ =
      bandInclusionNatTrans (le_add_self : δ ≤ ε + δ)
proof:
:= by
  ext A z
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (addMap_comp_zeroSection (X := A.left) ε δ) z

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.whiskerRight_zeroSectionNatTrans_comp_addNatTrans
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_zeroSectionNatTrans_comp_addNatTrans (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (zeroSectionNatTrans δ) (functor ε) ≫ addNatTrans ε δ =
      bandInclusionNatTrans (le_self_add : ε ≤ ε + δ)
proof:
:= by
  ext A z
  exact DFunLike.congr_fun (addMap_comp_map_zeroSection (X := A.left) ε δ) z

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.map_addNatTrans_comp_componentComparisonNatIso
statement:
theorem map_addNatTrans_comp_componentComparisonNatIso (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)) :
    intervalComponentsOver.map ((addNatTrans ε δ).app A) ≫
        (componentComparisonNatIso (ε + δ)).hom.app A =
      (componentComparisonNatIso ε).hom.app ((functor δ).obj A) ≫
        (smoothing ε).map ((componentComparisonNatIso δ).hom.app A) ≫
          (smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app (intervalComponentsOver.obj A)
proof:
:=
  addMap_comp_componentComparison (overBaseMap A) ε δ

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.whiskerRight_addNatTrans_comp_componentComparisonNatIso
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_addNatTrans_comp_componentComparisonNatIso (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (addNatTrans ε δ) intervalComponentsOver ≫
        (componentComparisonNatIso (ε + δ)).hom =
      Functor.whiskerLeft (functor δ) (componentComparisonNatIso ε).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (componentComparisonNatIso δ).hom (smoothing ε) ≫
          Functor.whiskerLeft intervalComponentsOver (smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext A I c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk z => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.fiber_zero_injective
statement:
theorem fiber_zero_injective :
    Function.Injective fiberSegment ∧
      ∀ s, overBaseMap ((functor 1).obj ((functor 1).obj onePoint)) (fiberSegment s) = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun s s' h => congrArg (fun z : ((functor 1).obj ((functor 1).obj onePoint)).left => z.1.2) h,
    fun s => show (0 : ℝ) + s + -s = 0 by ring⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.fiber_zero_subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rintro ⟨⟨a, s⟩, hs⟩ ⟨⟨b, t⟩, ht⟩
  have hs' : (0 : ℝ) + s = 0 := hs
  have ht' : (0 : ℝ) + t = 0 := ht
  exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (Subsingleton.elim (α := PUnit.{1}) _ _) (Subtype.ext (by linarith)))

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.not_iso_one_one
statement:
theorem not_iso_one_one :
    IsEmpty ((functor 1).obj ((functor 1).obj onePoint) ≅ (functor (1 + 1)).obj onePoint)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro e
  have hinj : Function.Injective e.hom.left.hom :=
    (TopCat.homeoOfIso ((Over.forget _).mapIso e)).injective
  have hz : ∀ s, overBaseMap ((functor (1 + 1)).obj onePoint) (e.hom.left.hom (fiberSegment s)) =
      0 := fun s => (overBaseMap_comm e.hom _).trans (fiber_zero_injective.2 s)
  have h01 := hinj (congrArg Subtype.val ((fiber_zero_subsingleton (1 + 1)).elim
    ⟨_, hz ⟨0, zero_mem_band 1⟩⟩ ⟨_, hz ⟨((1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ), right_mem_Icc.2 (neg_le_band 1)⟩⟩))
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val (fiber_zero_injective.1 h01)
  norm_num at h

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.not_isIso_addNatTrans_app_one_one
statement: theorem not_isIso_addNatTrans_app_one_one : ¬ IsIso ((addNatTrans 1 1).app onePoint)
proof:
:=
  fun _ => not_iso_one_one.false (asIso ((addNatTrans 1 1).app onePoint))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.IntervalTranslation.zero_translation
statement:
theorem zero_translation {C : Type*} [Category C] (F : OpenInterval ⥤ C) {X : Type*}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [Nonempty X] (f : C(X, ℝ)) (hf : BddBelow (range f)) :
    interleavingDistance F (translatePre 0 F) = 0 ∧
      interleavingDistance (intervalComponents f)
        (intervalComponents (f + ContinuousMap.const X 0)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨interleavingDistance_eq_zero_of_iso (translatePreZeroIso F).symm, ?_⟩
  rw [interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_add_const f hf 0, nnnorm_zero, ENNReal.coe_zero]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.IntervalTranslation.id_translation_distance
statement:
theorem id_translation_distance :
    ¬ BddBelow (range (ContinuousMap.id ℝ)) ∧ ‖(1 : ℝ)‖₊ = 1 ∧
      interleavingDistance (intervalComponents (ContinuousMap.id ℝ))
        (intervalComponents (ContinuousMap.id ℝ + ContinuousMap.const ℝ 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, NNReal.eq (by simp [Real.norm_eq_abs]), interleavingDistance_eq_zero_of_iso
    (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft toOpensFunctor idAddOneIso).symm⟩
  rw [ContinuousMap.coe_id, range_id]
  exact not_bddBelow_univ

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_le
proof:
:=
  (perturbationInterleaving hfg).interleavingDistance_le

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_smoothing_intervalComponents_le
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_smoothing_intervalComponents_le {f g : C(X, ℝ)} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (hfg : ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ ε) (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    interleavingDistance ((smoothing δ).obj (intervalComponents f))
      ((smoothing δ).obj (intervalComponents g)) ≤ ε
proof:
:=
  (interleavingDistance_smoothing_le δ _ _).trans (interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_le hfg)

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.neg_le_band
statement: theorem neg_le_band (ε : ℝ≥0) : -(ε : ℝ) ≤ ε
proof: := neg_le_self ε.coe_nonneg

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band
statement: theorem zero_mem_band (ε : ℝ≥0) : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Band ε
proof:
:=
  ⟨neg_nonpos.2 ε.coe_nonneg, ε.coe_nonneg⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.eq_zero_of_mem_band_zero
statement: theorem eq_zero_of_mem_band_zero {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Band 0) : t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ t := by simpa using ht.1
  have h₂ : t ≤ (0 : ℝ) := by simpa using ht.2
  exact le_antisymm h₂ h₁

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.interp_mem_band
statement:
theorem interp_mem_band {ε : ℝ≥0} (a b : Band ε) (r : unitInterval) :
    (1 - (r : ℝ)) * a + r * b ∈ Band ε
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using
    convex_Icc (-(ε : ℝ)) ε a.2 b.2 (sub_nonneg.2 r.2.2) r.2.1 (sub_add_cancel 1 (r : ℝ))

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.interp_mem
statement:
theorem interp_mem {I : OpenInterval} {a b : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ I) (hb : b ∈ I) (r : unitInterval) :
    (1 - (r : ℝ)) * a + r * b ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  have h := (convex_iff_ordConnected.2 I.ordConnected) ha hb (sub_nonneg.2 r.2.2) r.2.1
    (sub_add_cancel 1 (r : ℝ))
  rw [smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.coe_clamp
statement:
theorem coe_clamp (ε : ℝ≥0) (c s : ℝ) :
    (clamp ε c s : ℝ) = max (-(ε : ℝ)) (min (ε : ℝ) (c - s))
proof:
:=
  coe_projIcc _ _ _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.continuous_clamp
statement: theorem continuous_clamp (ε : ℝ≥0) (c : ℝ) : Continuous (clamp ε c)
proof:
:=
  continuous_projIcc.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.nonempty_of_mem_thicken
statement:
theorem nonempty_of_mem_thicken {ε : ℝ≥0} {I : OpenInterval} {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ thicken ε I) :
    (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  let ⟨y, hy, _⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hs
  ⟨y, hy⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.add_clamp_mem
statement:
theorem add_clamp_mem {ε : ℝ≥0} {I : OpenInterval} {c s : ℝ} (hc : c ∈ I)
    (hs : s ∈ thicken ε I) : s + (clamp ε c s : ℝ) ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hsy⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hs
  rw [abs_le] at hsy
  have hε := ε.coe_nonneg
  refine I.ordConnected.uIcc_subset hc hy ?_
  rw [coe_clamp, mem_uIcc]
  have hm1 : min (ε : ℝ) (c - s) ≤ ε := min_le_left _ _
  have hm2 : min (ε : ℝ) (c - s) ≤ c - s := min_le_right _ _
  have hm3 := min_choice (ε : ℝ) (c - s)
  have hv1 : -(ε : ℝ) ≤ max (-(ε : ℝ)) (min (ε : ℝ) (c - s)) := le_max_left _ _
  have hv2 : min (ε : ℝ) (c - s) ≤ max (-(ε : ℝ)) (min (ε : ℝ) (c - s)) := le_max_right _ _
  have hv3 := max_choice (-(ε : ℝ)) (min (ε : ℝ) (c - s))
  rcases hm3 with hm3 | hm3 <;> rcases hv3 with hv3 | hv3 <;> rcases le_total c y with hcy | hcy <;>
    first
    | (left; constructor <;> linarith)
    | (right; constructor <;> linarith)

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.height_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem height_apply (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (z : X × Band ε) :
    height f ε z = f z.1 + z.2
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.map_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_apply (g : C(X, Y)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (z : X × Band ε) :
    map g ε z = (g z.1, z.2)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.height_map
statement:
theorem height_map {f : C(X, ℝ)} {h : C(Y, ℝ)} (g : C(X, Y)) (comm : ∀ x, h (g x) = f x)
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (z : X × Band ε) : height h ε (map g ε z) = height f ε z
proof:
:= by
  simp [comm]

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.map_id
statement: theorem map_id (ε : ℝ≥0) : map (ContinuousMap.id X) ε = ContinuousMap.id (X × Band ε)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp (k : C(Y, Z)) (g : C(X, Y)) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    map (k.comp g) ε = (map k ε).comp (map g ε)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.zeroSection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroSection_apply (ε : ℝ≥0) (x : X) :
    zeroSection X ε x = (x, ⟨0, zero_mem_band ε⟩)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.height_zeroSection
statement:
theorem height_zeroSection (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (x : X) :
    height f ε (zeroSection X ε x) = f x
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.map_comp_zeroSection
statement:
theorem map_comp_zeroSection (g : C(X, Y)) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    (map g ε).comp (zeroSection X ε) = (zeroSection Y ε).comp g
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.height_bandInclusion
statement:
theorem height_bandInclusion (f : C(X, ℝ)) {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (hεδ : ε ≤ δ) (z : X × Band ε) :
    height f δ (bandInclusion X hεδ z) = height f ε z
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.band_bounds
statement:
theorem band_bounds (f : C(X, ℝ)) {ε : ℝ≥0} (x : X) (t : Band ε) :
    (f x + t) - ε ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ (f x + t) + ε
proof:
:=
  ⟨by linarith [t.2.2], by linarith [t.2.1]⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.sub_mem_band
statement:
theorem sub_mem_band (f : C(X, ℝ)) {ε : ℝ≥0} {x : X} {s : ℝ}
    (h : s - ε ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ s + ε) : s - f x ∈ Band ε
proof:
:=
  ⟨by linarith [h.2], by linarith [h.1]⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.coe_bandHomeomorph_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_bandHomeomorph_apply (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (z : X × Band ε) :
    (bandHomeomorph f ε z : X × ℝ) = (z.1, f z.1 + z.2)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.bandHomeomorph_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem bandHomeomorph_symm_apply (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (p : {p : X × ℝ // p.2 - ε ≤ f p.1 ∧ f p.1 ≤ p.2 + ε}) :
    (bandHomeomorph f ε).symm p =
      (p.1.1, ⟨p.1.2 - f p.1.1, sub_mem_band f p.2⟩)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.snd_bandHomeomorph
statement:
theorem snd_bandHomeomorph (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (z : X × Band ε) :
    (bandHomeomorph f ε z : X × ℝ).2 = height f ε z
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.fst_mem_thicken
statement:
theorem fst_mem_thicken {f : C(X, ℝ)} {ε : ℝ≥0} {I : OpenInterval} {z : X × Band ε}
    (hz : height f ε z ∈ I) : f z.1 ∈ thicken ε I
proof:
:=
  mem_thicken.2 ⟨height f ε z, hz, abs_le.2 ⟨by rw [height_apply]; linarith [z.2.2.2],
    by rw [height_apply]; linarith [z.2.2.1]⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.coe_preimageProjection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_preimageProjection_apply (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval)
    (z : {z : X × Band ε // height f ε z ∈ I}) :
    (preimageProjection f ε I z : X) = z.1.1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.preimageProjection_comp_preimageSectionAt
statement:
theorem preimageProjection_comp_preimageSectionAt (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty → c ∈ I) :
    (preimageProjection f ε I).comp (preimageSectionAt f ε I hc) = ContinuousMap.id _
proof:
:=
  ContinuousMap.ext fun _ => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.intervalCenter_mem
statement: theorem intervalCenter_mem {I : OpenInterval} (hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty) : intervalCenter I ∈ I
proof:
:=
  Classical.epsilon_spec hI

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.preimageHomotopyEquiv_toFun
statement:
theorem preimageHomotopyEquiv_toFun (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval) :
    (preimageHomotopyEquiv f ε I).toFun = preimageProjection f ε I
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.coe_preimageHomotopyEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem coe_preimageHomotopyEquiv_apply (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval)
    (z : {z : X × Band ε // height f ε z ∈ I}) :
    (preimageHomotopyEquiv f ε I z : X) = z.1.1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.preimageProjection_comp_inclusion
statement:
theorem preimageProjection_comp_inclusion (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) {I J : OpenInterval}
    (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    (preimageInclusion f (toOpens_monotone (thicken_mono (ε := ε) hIJ))).comp
        (preimageProjection f ε I) =
      (preimageProjection f ε J).comp (preimageInclusion (height f ε) (toOpens_monotone hIJ))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.preimageProjection_comp_restrict
statement:
theorem preimageProjection_comp_restrict {f : C(X, ℝ)} {h : C(Y, ℝ)} (g : C(X, Y))
    (comm : ∀ x, h (g x) = f x) (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval) :
    (preimageRestrict g comm (toOpens (thicken ε I))).comp (preimageProjection f ε I) =
      (preimageProjection h ε I).comp
        (preimageRestrict (map g ε) (height_map g comm ε) (toOpens I))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.componentComparison_app
statement:
theorem componentComparison_app (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval) :
    (componentComparison f ε).app I = TypeCat.ofHom (componentMap (preimageProjection f ε I))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.componentComparison_app_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentComparison_app_mk (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval)
    (z : {z : X × Band ε // height f ε z ∈ I}) :
    (componentComparison f ε).app I (ZerothHomotopy.mk z) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨z.1.1, fst_mem_thicken z.2⟩ : {x : X // f x ∈ thicken ε I})
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.componentComparison_app_eq_componentEquiv
statement:
theorem componentComparison_app_eq_componentEquiv (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval) :
    ⇑((componentComparison f ε).app I) =
      ⇑(componentEquivOfHomotopyEquiv (preimageHomotopyEquiv f ε I))
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk z => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.componentComparison_app_bijective
statement:
theorem componentComparison_app_bijective (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval) :
    Function.Bijective ((componentComparison f ε).app I)
proof:
:= by
  rw [componentComparison_app_eq_componentEquiv]
  exact Equiv.bijective _

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.componentComparisonIso_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentComparisonIso_hom (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    (componentComparisonIso f ε).hom = componentComparison f ε
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.componentComparison_naturality
statement:
theorem componentComparison_naturality (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) {I J : OpenInterval}
    (i : I ⟶ J) :
    (intervalComponents (height f ε)).map i ≫ (componentComparison f ε).app J =
      (componentComparison f ε).app I ≫ ((smoothing ε).obj (intervalComponents f)).map i
proof:
:=
  (componentComparison f ε).naturality i

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.componentComparison_natural
statement:
theorem componentComparison_natural {f : C(X, ℝ)} {h : C(Y, ℝ)} (g : C(X, Y))
    (comm : ∀ x, h (g x) = f x) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    intervalComponentNatTrans (map g ε) (height_map g comm ε) ≫ componentComparison h ε =
      componentComparison f ε ≫ (smoothing ε).map (intervalComponentNatTrans g comm)
proof:
:= by
  ext I c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk z => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.zeroSection_comp_componentComparison
statement:
theorem zeroSection_comp_componentComparison (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    intervalComponentNatTrans (zeroSection X ε) (height_zeroSection f ε) ≫
        componentComparison f ε =
      (smoothingUnit ε).app (intervalComponents f)
proof:
:= by
  ext I c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.componentComparison_app_zeroSection_mk
statement:
theorem componentComparison_app_zeroSection_mk (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval)
    (x : {x : X // f x ∈ I}) :
    (componentComparison f ε).app I
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨zeroSection X ε x.1, by rw [height_zeroSection]; exact x.2⟩ :
          {z : X × Band ε // height f ε z ∈ I})) =
      ((smoothingUnit ε).app (intervalComponents f)).app I (ZerothHomotopy.mk x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.bandInclusion_comp_componentComparison
statement:
theorem bandInclusion_comp_componentComparison (f : C(X, ℝ)) {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (hεδ : ε ≤ δ) :
    intervalComponentNatTrans (bandInclusion X hεδ) (height_bandInclusion f hεδ) ≫
        componentComparison f δ =
      componentComparison f ε ≫ (smoothingMap hεδ).app (intervalComponents f)
proof:
:= by
  ext I c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk z => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.overBaseMap_functor_obj
statement:
theorem overBaseMap_functor_obj (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)) :
    overBaseMap ((functor ε).obj A) = height (overBaseMap A) ε
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.functor_map_left_hom
statement:
theorem functor_map_left_hom (ε : ℝ≥0) {A B : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)} (φ : A ⟶ B) :
    ((functor ε).map φ).left.hom = map φ.left.hom ε
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.zeroSectionNatTrans_app_left_hom
statement:
theorem zeroSectionNatTrans_app_left_hom (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)) :
    ((zeroSectionNatTrans ε).app A).left.hom = zeroSection A.left ε
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.zeroHomeomorph_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroHomeomorph_apply {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (z : X × Band 0) :
    zeroHomeomorph X z = z.1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.zeroHomeomorph_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroHomeomorph_symm_apply {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (x : X) :
    (zeroHomeomorph X).symm x = zeroSection X 0 x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.apply_zeroHomeomorph
statement:
theorem apply_zeroHomeomorph {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : C(X, ℝ)) (z : X × Band 0) :
    f (zeroHomeomorph X z) = height f 0 z
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroHomeomorph_apply, height_apply, eq_zero_of_mem_band_zero z.2.2, add_zero]

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.zeroIso_inv
statement: theorem zeroIso_inv : zeroIso.inv = zeroSectionNatTrans 0
proof:
:= by
  ext A x
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.zeroIso_hom_app_left_hom
statement:
theorem zeroIso_hom_app_left_hom (A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)) :
    (zeroIso.hom.app A).left.hom = (zeroHomeomorph A.left : C(A.left × Band 0, A.left))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.zeroIso_inv_app_left_hom
statement:
theorem zeroIso_inv_app_left_hom (A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)) :
    (zeroIso.inv.app A).left.hom = zeroSection A.left 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.componentComparisonNatIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentComparisonNatIso_hom_app (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)) :
    (componentComparisonNatIso ε).hom.app A = componentComparison (overBaseMap A) ε
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.map_zeroIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem map_zeroIso_hom_app (A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)) :
    intervalComponentsOver.map (zeroIso.hom.app A) =
      (componentComparisonNatIso 0).hom.app A ≫
        smoothingZeroIso.hom.app (intervalComponentsOver.obj A)
proof:
:= by
  ext I c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk z => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.map_zeroSectionNatTrans_comp_componentComparisonNatIso
statement:
theorem map_zeroSectionNatTrans_comp_componentComparisonNatIso (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)) :
    intervalComponentsOver.map ((zeroSectionNatTrans ε).app A) ≫
        (componentComparisonNatIso ε).hom.app A =
      (smoothingUnit ε).app (intervalComponentsOver.obj A)
proof:
:= by
  ext I c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.whiskerRight_zeroSectionNatTrans_comp_componentComparisonNatIso
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_zeroSectionNatTrans_comp_componentComparisonNatIso (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (zeroSectionNatTrans ε) intervalComponentsOver ≫
        (componentComparisonNatIso ε).hom =
      Functor.whiskerLeft intervalComponentsOver (smoothingUnit ε)
proof:
:= by
  ext A I c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafShiftEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cosheafShiftEquiv_apply (φ : A ⟶ (geometricSmoothing ε).obj B) :
    cosheafShiftEquiv ε A B φ = cosheafShiftMap φ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafShiftMap_injective
statement:
theorem cosheafShiftMap_injective (ε : ℝ≥0) (A B : RGraphCat) :
    Function.Injective (cosheafShiftMap : (A ⟶ (geometricSmoothing ε).obj B) → _)
proof:
:=
  (cosheafShiftEquiv ε A B).injective

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafShiftMap_cosheafShiftEquiv_symm
statement:
theorem cosheafShiftMap_cosheafShiftEquiv_symm
    (f : (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj ⟶ (smoothing ε).obj (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj) :
    cosheafShiftMap ((cosheafShiftEquiv ε A B).symm f) = f
proof:
:=
  (cosheafShiftEquiv ε A B).apply_symm_apply f

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafShiftMap_comp'
statement:
theorem cosheafShiftMap_comp' (φ : A ⟶ (geometricSmoothing ε).obj B)
    (ψ : B ⟶ (geometricSmoothing δ).obj D) :
    cosheafShiftMap (φ ≫ (geometricSmoothing ε).map ψ ≫
        (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app D) =
      cosheafShiftMap φ ≫ (smoothing ε).map (cosheafShiftMap ψ) ≫
        (smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj D).obj
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothing ε).map ψ)).hom ≫
      ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app ((geometricSmoothing δ).obj D)).hom =
        ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app B).hom ≫
          (smoothing ε).map (cosheafFunctor.map ψ).hom :=
    congrArg (fun f => f.hom) ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.naturality ψ)
  have hsq := cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app ε δ D
  have e1 : (cosheafFunctor.map (φ ≫ (geometricSmoothing ε).map ψ ≫
      (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app D)).hom =
        (cosheafFunctor.map φ).hom ≫ (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothing ε).map ψ)).hom ≫
          (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app D)).hom := by
    rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  
  refine ((congrArg (· ≫ ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso (ε + δ)).hom.app D).hom) e1).trans
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg ((cosheafFunctor.map φ).hom ≫ ·)
      ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg
        ((cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothing ε).map ψ)).hom ≫ ·) hsq))))).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg ((cosheafFunctor.map φ).hom ≫ ·)
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (· ≫ _) hnat))).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg ((cosheafFunctor.map φ).hom ≫ ·) (Category.assoc _ _ _)).trans ?_
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ?_
  refine congrArg (((cosheafFunctor.map φ).hom ≫
    ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app B).hom) ≫ ·) ?_
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ?_
  exact congrArg (· ≫ (smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj D).obj)
    ((smoothing ε).map_comp _ _).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.ofCosheaf_toCosheaf
statement: theorem ofCosheaf_toCosheaf (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) : ofCosheaf i.toCosheaf = i
proof:
:=
  GeometricInterleaving.ext ((cosheafShiftEquiv ε A B).symm_apply_apply i.φ)
    ((cosheafShiftEquiv ε B A).symm_apply_apply i.ψ)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.toCosheaf_ofCosheaf
statement:
theorem toCosheaf_ofCosheaf
    (j : Interleaving ε (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj) :
    (ofCosheaf j).toCosheaf = j
proof:
:=
  Interleaving.ext (cosheafShiftMap_cosheafShiftEquiv_symm j.φ)
    (cosheafShiftMap_cosheafShiftEquiv_symm j.ψ)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.cosheafEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem cosheafEquiv_apply (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) :
    cosheafEquiv ε A B i = i.toCosheaf
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.cosheafEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem cosheafEquiv_symm_apply
    (j : Interleaving ε (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj) :
    (cosheafEquiv ε A B).symm j = ofCosheaf j
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.nonempty_iff_cosheaf
statement:
theorem nonempty_iff_cosheaf :
    Nonempty (GeometricInterleaving ε A B) ↔
      Nonempty (Interleaving ε (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj)
proof:
:=
  (cosheafEquiv ε A B).nonempty_congr

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_interleavingDistance
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_interleavingDistance (A B : RGraphCat) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A B =
      interleavingDistance (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm
    (le_iInf₂ fun _ ⟨j⟩ => (GeometricInterleaving.ofCosheaf j).geometricInterleavingDistance_le)
    (interleavingDistance_cosheafFunctor_le_geometricInterleavingDistance A B)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_lt_iff
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_lt_iff {r : ℝ≥0∞} :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A B < r ↔
      ∃ ε : ℝ≥0, (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < r ∧ Nonempty (GeometricInterleaving ε A B)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [geometricInterleavingDistance, iInf_lt_iff, exists_prop]
  exact exists_congr fun _ => and_comm

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_iff :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A B = 0 ↔
      ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, 0 < ε → Nonempty (GeometricInterleaving ε A B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_interleavingDistance, interleavingDistance_eq_zero_iff]
  exact forall₂_congr fun _ _ => GeometricInterleaving.nonempty_iff_cosheaf.symm

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.trans_toCosheaf
statement:
theorem trans_toCosheaf (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) (j : GeometricInterleaving δ B D) :
    (i.trans j).toCosheaf = i.toCosheaf.trans j.toCosheaf
proof:
:=
  toCosheaf_ofCosheaf _

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.trans_φ
statement:
theorem trans_φ (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) (j : GeometricInterleaving δ B D) :
    (i.trans j).φ =
      i.φ ≫ (geometricSmoothing ε).map j.φ ≫ (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app D
proof:
:=
  cosheafShiftMap_injective (ε + δ) A D
    ((cosheafShiftMap_cosheafShiftEquiv_symm _).trans (cosheafShiftMap_comp' i.φ j.φ).symm)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_triangle
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_triangle (A B D : RGraphCat) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A D ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance A B + geometricInterleavingDistance B D
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_interleavingDistance,
    geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_interleavingDistance,
    geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_interleavingDistance]
  exact interleavingDistance_triangle _ _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_congr
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_congr {A A' B B' : RGraphCat} (e : A ≅ A') (e' : B ≅ B') :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A B = geometricInterleavingDistance A' B'
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_interleavingDistance,
    geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_interleavingDistance]
  exact interleavingDistance_congr ((ObjectProperty.ι _).mapIso (cosheafFunctor.mapIso e))
    ((ObjectProperty.ι _).mapIso (cosheafFunctor.mapIso e'))

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_congr_left
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_congr_left {A A' : RGraphCat} (e : A ≅ A')
    (B : RGraphCat) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A B = geometricInterleavingDistance A' B
proof:
:=
  geometricInterleavingDistance_congr e (Iso.refl B)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_congr_right
proof:
:=
  geometricInterleavingDistance_congr (Iso.refl A) e

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.eq_of_joined_of_discrete
statement:
theorem eq_of_joined_of_discrete {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T] [DiscreteTopology T]
    {a b : T} (hab : Joined a b) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := hab
  have hs := (isPreconnected_range p.continuous).subsingleton
  simpa using hs ⟨0, rfl⟩ ⟨1, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.boolComponentsEquiv_boolClass
statement: theorem boolComponentsEquiv_boolClass (b : Bool) : boolComponentsEquiv (boolClass b) = b
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.boolClass_false_ne_true
statement: theorem boolClass_false_ne_true : boolClass false ≠ boolClass true
proof:
:= fun hc => by
  have hb := congrArg boolComponentsEquiv hc
  rw [boolComponentsEquiv_boolClass, boolComponentsEquiv_boolClass] at hb
  exact Bool.false_ne_true hb

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.boolClass_exhaustive
statement:
theorem boolClass_exhaustive (c : (componentFunctor boolToUnit).obj ⊤) :
    c = boolClass false ∨ c = boolClass true
proof:
:= by
  rcases hb : boolComponentsEquiv c with _ | _
  · left; rw [← boolComponentsEquiv.symm_apply_apply c, hb]; rfl
  · right; rw [← boolComponentsEquiv.symm_apply_apply c, hb]; rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.collapseNatTrans_identifies
statement:
theorem collapseNatTrans_identifies :
    collapseNatTrans.app ⊤ (boolClass false) = collapseNatTrans.app ⊤ (boolClass true)

name: TDA.Reeb.componentFunctor_exists_map_eq
statement:
theorem componentFunctor_exists_map_eq (f : C(X, Y)) {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y}
    (U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (hU : ∀ i, U i ≤ W) (hcov : W ≤ ⨆ i, U i)
    (x : (componentFunctor f).obj W) :
    ∃ i, ∃ e : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i), (componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE (hU i)) e = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk a =>
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.1 (hcov a.2)
    exact ⟨i, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨a.1, hi⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.componentFunctor_map_eq_iff_eqvGen
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction e using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk a =>
    induction e' using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk b =>
    have hR := componentFunctor_reflTransGen_of_mk_eq f U hcov h
    have key : ∀ z : {x : X // f x ∈ W},
        Relation.ReflTransGen
          (fun a b : {x : X // f x ∈ W} => ∃ i, ∃ (ha : f a.1 ∈ U i) (hb : f b.1 ∈ U i),
            (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨a.1, ha⟩ : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i)) =
              ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨b.1, hb⟩) ⟨a.1, hU i a.2⟩ z →
        ∀ (k : ι) (hz : f z.1 ∈ U k),
          Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel (componentFunctor f) U) ⟨i, ZerothHomotopy.mk a⟩
            ⟨k, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨z.1, hz⟩⟩ := by
      intro z hz
      induction hz with
      | refl => intro k hk; exact .rel _ _ (overlapRel_mk f U a.1 a.2 hk)
      | tail _ hst ih =>
        obtain ⟨i', hs, ht, hst⟩ := hst
        intro k hk
        refine .trans _ _ _ (ih i' hs) ?_
        rw [hst]
        exact .rel _ _ (overlapRel_mk f U _ ht hk)
    exact key _ hR j b.2
  · intro h
    have key : ∀ p q : Σ i, (componentFunctor f).obj (U i),
        Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel (componentFunctor f) U) p q →
        (componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE (hU p.1)) p.2 =
          (componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE (hU q.1)) q.2 := by
      intro p q hpq
      induction hpq with
      | rel p q hpq =>
        obtain ⟨c, hcp, hcq⟩ := hpq
        rw [← hcp, ← hcq]
        induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
        | mk z => rfl
      | refl => rfl
      | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
      | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂
    exact key _ _ h

name: TDA.Reeb.componentFunctor_existsUnique_glue
statement:
theorem componentFunctor_existsUnique_glue (f : C(X, Y)) {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y}
    (U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (hU : ∀ i, U i ≤ W) (hcov : W ≤ ⨆ i, U i) {A : Sort*}
    (a : ∀ i, (componentFunctor f).obj (U i) → A)
    (ha : ∀ i j (c : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i ⊓ U j)),
      a i ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) =
        a j ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c)) :
    ∃! g : (componentFunctor f).obj W → A,
      ∀ i (e : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i)),
        g ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE (hU i)) e) = a i e
proof:
:=
  existsUnique_glue_of_surjective_of_eqvGen (componentFunctor f) U (coverCocone U hU)
    (componentFunctor_exists_map_eq f U hU hcov)
    (fun _ _ e e' h => (componentFunctor_map_eq_iff_eqvGen f U hU hcov e e').1 h) a ha

name: TDA.Reeb.componentFunctor_isColimit
statement:
theorem componentFunctor_isColimit (f : C(X, Y)) (U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens Y)
    (c : Cocone (Pairwise.diagram U)) (hcov : c.pt ≤ ⨆ i, U i) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit ((componentFunctor f).mapCocone c))
proof:
:= by
  have hU : ∀ i, U i ≤ c.pt := fun i => (c.ι.app (.single i)).le
  refine (nonempty_isColimit_mapCocone_iff _ U c).2
    ⟨componentFunctor_exists_map_eq f U hU hcov, fun _ _ e e' h => ?_⟩
  exact (componentFunctor_map_eq_iff_eqvGen f U hU hcov e e').1 h

:=

name: TDA.Reeb.componentFunctor_glue_natTrans
statement:
theorem componentFunctor_glue_natTrans {Z : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Z] {f : C(X, Y)}
    {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y}
    (U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (hU : ∀ i, U i ≤ W) (hcov : W ≤ ⨆ i, U i) {A : Sort*}
    (a : ∀ i, (componentFunctor g).obj (U i) → A) (G : (componentFunctor g).obj W → A)
    (hG : ∀ i (e : (componentFunctor g).obj (U i)),
      G ((componentFunctor g).map (homOfLE (hU i)) e) = a i e)
    (G' : (componentFunctor f).obj W → A)
    (hG' : ∀ i (e : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i)),
      G' ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE (hU i)) e) =
        a i ((componentNatTrans h comm).app (U i) e)) :
    G' = G ∘ (componentNatTrans h comm).app W
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  obtain ⟨i, e, rfl⟩ := componentFunctor_exists_map_eq f U hU hcov x
  rw [hG', Function.comp_apply, ← hG]
  induction e using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk z => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricSmoothingUnit_comp_geometricSmoothingUnit
statement:
theorem geometricSmoothingUnit_comp_geometricSmoothingUnit (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (A : RGraphCat) :

        (geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app ((geometricSmoothing δ).obj A) ≫
          (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app A =
      (geometricSmoothingUnit (ε + δ)).app A
proof:
:= by

  exact (geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk ε δ A
      (GeometricThickening.zeroSection A.obj.left δ x)
      ⟨0, GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band ε⟩).trans

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.hom_ext_of_fiber_subsingleton
statement:
theorem hom_ext_of_fiber_subsingleton {X Y : RGraphCat} {f g : X ⟶ Y}

proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have h₁ : f.hom.left.hom x ∈ overBaseMap Y.obj ⁻¹' {overBaseMap X.obj x} :=

  have h₂ : g.hom.left.hom x ∈ overBaseMap Y.obj ⁻¹' {overBaseMap X.obj x} :=
    overBaseMap_comm g.hom x
  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((hY _).elim ⟨_, h₁⟩ ⟨_, h₂⟩)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.ofIso_triangle
statement:
private theorem ofIso_triangle {A B : RGraphCat} (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ A) (hfg : f ≫ g = 𝟙 A) :
    (f ≫ (geometricSmoothingUnit 0).app B) ≫
        (geometricSmoothing 0).map (g ≫ (geometricSmoothingUnit 0).app A) ≫
          (geometricSmoothingCompIso 0 0).hom.app A =
      (geometricSmoothingUnit (0 + 0)).app A
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (geometricSmoothingUnit 0).app B ≫ (geometricSmoothing 0).map g =
      g ≫ (geometricSmoothingUnit 0).app A :=
    ((geometricSmoothingUnit 0).naturality g).symm
  calc (f ≫ (geometricSmoothingUnit 0).app B) ≫
          (geometricSmoothing 0).map (g ≫ (geometricSmoothingUnit 0).app A) ≫
            (geometricSmoothingCompIso 0 0).hom.app A
      = f ≫ ((geometricSmoothingUnit 0).app B ≫ (geometricSmoothing 0).map g) ≫
          (geometricSmoothing 0).map ((geometricSmoothingUnit 0).app A) ≫
            (geometricSmoothingCompIso 0 0).hom.app A := by
        rw [Functor.map_comp]; simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (f ≫ g) ≫ (geometricSmoothingUnit 0).app A ≫
          (geometricSmoothing 0).map ((geometricSmoothingUnit 0).app A) ≫
            (geometricSmoothingCompIso 0 0).hom.app A := by
        rw [hn]; simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (geometricSmoothingUnit (0 + 0)).app A := by
        rw [hfg, Category.id_comp]
        exact geometricSmoothingUnit_comp_map_geometricSmoothingUnit 0 0 A

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.toIso_comp
statement:
private theorem toIso_comp {A B : RGraphCat} (φ : A ⟶ (geometricSmoothing 0).obj B)
    (ψ : B ⟶ (geometricSmoothing 0).obj A)
    (h : φ ≫ (geometricSmoothing 0).map ψ ≫ (geometricSmoothingCompIso 0 0).hom.app A =
      (geometricSmoothingUnit (0 + 0)).app A) :
    (φ ≫ geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app B) ≫ ψ ≫ geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app A =
      𝟙 A
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app ((geometricSmoothing 0).obj A) =
      (geometricSmoothingCompIso 0 0).hom.app A ≫
        (geometricSmoothingEqIso (zero_add (0 : ℝ≥0))).hom.app A :=
    ((congrArg (fun e => e.hom.app A) (geometricSmoothingCompIso_zero_left 0)).trans
      (Category.comp_id _)).symm
  have hU : (geometricSmoothingUnit (0 + 0)).app A ≫
      (geometricSmoothingEqIso (zero_add (0 : ℝ≥0))).hom.app A =
        (geometricSmoothingUnit 0).app A :=
    congrArg (fun t => t.app A)
      (geometricSmoothingUnit_comp_geometricSmoothingEqIso (zero_add (0 : ℝ≥0)))
  have hn : geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app B ≫ ψ =
      (geometricSmoothing 0).map ψ ≫ geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app _ :=
    (geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.naturality ψ).symm
  calc (φ ≫ geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app B) ≫ ψ ≫ geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app A
      = φ ≫ (geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app B ≫ ψ) ≫ geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app A := by
        simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (φ ≫ (geometricSmoothing 0).map ψ ≫ (geometricSmoothingCompIso 0 0).hom.app A) ≫
          (geometricSmoothingEqIso (zero_add (0 : ℝ≥0))).hom.app A ≫
            geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app A := by
        rw [hn, hZ]; simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (geometricSmoothingUnit 0).app A ≫ geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app A := by
        rw [h, ← Category.assoc, hU]
    _ = 𝟙 A := by
        rw [geometricSmoothingUnit_zero, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
        rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafShiftMap_comp
statement:
theorem cosheafShiftMap_comp {ε δ : ℝ≥0} {A B : RGraphCat}
    (φ : A ⟶ (geometricSmoothing ε).obj B) (ψ : B ⟶ (geometricSmoothing δ).obj A) :
    cosheafShiftMap (φ ≫ (geometricSmoothing ε).map ψ ≫
        (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app A) =
      cosheafShiftMap φ ≫ (smoothing ε).map (cosheafShiftMap ψ) ≫
        (smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothing ε).map ψ)).hom ≫
      ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app ((geometricSmoothing δ).obj A)).hom =
        ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app B).hom ≫
          (smoothing ε).map (cosheafFunctor.map ψ).hom :=
    congrArg (fun f => f.hom) ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.naturality ψ)
  have hsq := cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app ε δ A
  have e1 : (cosheafFunctor.map (φ ≫ (geometricSmoothing ε).map ψ ≫
      (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app A)).hom =
        (cosheafFunctor.map φ).hom ≫ (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothing ε).map ψ)).hom ≫
          (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app A)).hom := by
    rw [Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  
  
  refine ((congrArg (· ≫ ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso (ε + δ)).hom.app A).hom) e1).trans
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg ((cosheafFunctor.map φ).hom ≫ ·)
      ((Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg
        ((cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothing ε).map ψ)).hom ≫ ·) hsq))))).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg ((cosheafFunctor.map φ).hom ≫ ·)
    ((Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (· ≫ _) hnat))).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg ((cosheafFunctor.map φ).hom ≫ ·) (Category.assoc _ _ _)).trans ?_
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ?_
  refine congrArg (((cosheafFunctor.map φ).hom ≫
    ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app B).hom) ≫ ·) ?_
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans ?_
  exact congrArg (· ≫ (smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj)
    ((smoothing ε).map_comp _ _).symm
