name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.sub_projIcc_mem_band
statement:
theorem sub_projIcc_mem_band {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (u : Band (ε + δ)) :
    (u : ℝ) - projIcc (-(δ : ℝ)) δ (neg_le_band δ) u ∈ Band ε
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (projIcc (-(δ : ℝ)) δ (neg_le_band δ) u : ℝ) =
      max (-(δ : ℝ)) (min (δ : ℝ) u) := coe_projIcc _ _ _ _
  have h₁ : -((ε : ℝ) + δ) ≤ u := by have := u.2.1; rwa [NNReal.coe_add] at this
  have h₂ : (u : ℝ) ≤ ε + δ := by have := u.2.2; rwa [NNReal.coe_add] at this
  have hε := ε.coe_nonneg
  have hδ := δ.coe_nonneg
  rw [hs]
  have hm1 : min (δ : ℝ) u ≤ δ := min_le_left _ _
  have hm2 : min (δ : ℝ) u ≤ u := min_le_right _ _
  have hv1 : -(δ : ℝ) ≤ max (-(δ : ℝ)) (min (δ : ℝ) u) := le_max_left _ _
  have hv2 : min (δ : ℝ) u ≤ max (-(δ : ℝ)) (min (δ : ℝ) u) := le_max_right _ _
  rcases min_choice (δ : ℝ) u with hm | hm <;>
    rcases max_choice (-(δ : ℝ)) (min (δ : ℝ) u) with hv | hv <;>
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addSection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem addSection_apply (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (x : X) (u : Band (ε + δ)) :
    addSection X ε δ (x, u) = ((x, projIcc (-(δ : ℝ)) δ (neg_le_band δ) u),
      ⟨u - projIcc (-(δ : ℝ)) δ (neg_le_band δ) u, sub_projIcc_mem_band u⟩)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.height_addSection
statement:
theorem height_addSection (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (w : X × Band (ε + δ)) :
    height (height f δ) ε (addSection X ε δ w) = height f (ε + δ) w
proof:
:= by
  show f w.1 + (projIcc (-(δ : ℝ)) δ (neg_le_band δ) w.2 : ℝ) +
      ((w.2 : ℝ) - projIcc (-(δ : ℝ)) δ (neg_le_band δ) w.2) = f w.1 + w.2
  ring

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addMap_comp_addSection
statement:
theorem addMap_comp_addSection (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    (addMap X ε δ).comp (addSection X ε δ) = ContinuousMap.id _
proof:
:=
  ContinuousMap.ext fun _ => Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext (add_sub_cancel _ _))

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.addSection_natural
statement:
theorem addSection_natural (g : C(X, Y)) (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    (addSection Y ε δ).comp (map g (ε + δ)) = (map (map g δ) ε).comp (addSection X ε δ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.height_addFiberPath
statement:
theorem height_addFiberPath (f : C(X, ℝ)) (z : (X × Band δ) × Band ε) (r : unitInterval) :
    height (height f δ) ε (addFiberPath z r) = height (height f δ) ε z
proof:
:= by
  show f z.1.1 + ((1 - (r : ℝ)) * z.1.2 + r * (addSection X ε δ (addMap X ε δ z)).1.2) +
      ((1 - (r : ℝ)) * z.2 + r * (addSection X ε δ (addMap X ε δ z)).2) = f z.1.1 + z.1.2 + z.2
  have h : ((addSection X ε δ (addMap X ε δ z)).2 : ℝ) =
      z.1.2 + z.2 - (addSection X ε δ (addMap X ε δ z)).1.2 := rfl
  rw [h]
  ring

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.reebRel_addSection_addMap
statement:
theorem reebRel_addSection_addMap (f : C(X, ℝ)) (z : (X × Band δ) × Band ε) :
    ReebRel (height (height f δ) ε) z (addSection X ε δ (addMap X ε δ z))
proof:
:=
  ⟨addFiberPath z, height_addFiberPath f z⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.coe_quotientAddHomeomorph
statement:
theorem coe_quotientAddHomeomorph (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    ⇑(quotientAddHomeomorph f ε δ) = ReebQuotient.map (addMap X ε δ) (height_addMap f ε δ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.coe_quotientAddHomeomorph_symm
statement:
theorem coe_quotientAddHomeomorph_symm (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    ⇑(quotientAddHomeomorph f ε δ).symm =
      ReebQuotient.map (addSection X ε δ) (height_addSection f ε δ)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.quotientAddHomeomorph_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientAddHomeomorph_mk (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (z : (X × Band δ) × Band ε) :
    quotientAddHomeomorph f ε δ (ReebQuotient.mk _ z) = ReebQuotient.mk _ (addMap X ε δ z)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.quotientAddHomeomorph_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientAddHomeomorph_symm_mk (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (w : X × Band (ε + δ)) :
    (quotientAddHomeomorph f ε δ).symm (ReebQuotient.mk _ w) =
      ReebQuotient.mk _ (addSection X ε δ w)
proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.height_quotientAddHomeomorph
statement:
theorem height_quotientAddHomeomorph (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε δ : ℝ≥0)
    (q : ReebQuotient (height (height f δ) ε)) :
    ReebQuotient.height _ (quotientAddHomeomorph f ε δ q) = ReebQuotient.height _ q
proof:
:=
  ReebQuotient.height_map_apply (addMap X ε δ) (height_addMap f ε δ) q

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.bijective_quotientMap_addMap
statement:
theorem bijective_quotientMap_addMap (f : C(X, ℝ)) (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    Function.Bijective (ReebQuotient.map (addMap X ε δ) (height_addMap f ε δ))
proof:
:=
  (quotientAddHomeomorph f ε δ).bijective

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.mk_addMap_eq_mk_addMap_iff
statement:
theorem mk_addMap_eq_mk_addMap_iff (f : C(X, ℝ)) {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (z z' : (X × Band δ) × Band ε) :
    ReebQuotient.mk (height f (ε + δ)) (addMap X ε δ z) =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height f (ε + δ)) (addMap X ε δ z') ↔
      ReebRel (height (height f δ) ε) z z'
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => (ReebQuotient.mk_eq_mk_iff _).1 ((quotientAddHomeomorph f ε δ).injective
      (a₁ := ReebQuotient.mk _ z) (a₂ := ReebQuotient.mk _ z') h),
    fun h => (ReebQuotient.mk_eq_mk_iff _).2 (h.map (addMap X ε δ) (height_addMap f ε δ))⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.reebAddIso_hom
statement:
theorem reebAddIso_hom (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :

proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.reebAddIso_inv_app_left_hom
statement:
theorem reebAddIso_inv_app_left_hom (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)) :
    ((reebAddIso ε δ).inv.app A).left.hom =
      ReebQuotient.map (addSection A.left ε δ) (height_addSection (overBaseMap A) ε δ)
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  have h : quotientAddHomeomorph (overBaseMap A) ε δ (((reebAddIso ε δ).inv.app A).left.hom q) =
      q :=
    congrArg (fun φ => φ.left.hom q) ((reebAddIso ε δ).inv_hom_id_app A)
  exact ((quotientAddHomeomorph (overBaseMap A) ε δ).symm_apply_apply _).symm.trans
    (congrArg (quotientAddHomeomorph (overBaseMap A) ε δ).symm h)

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.reebAddIso_assoc
statement:
theorem reebAddIso_assoc (ε δ γ : ℝ≥0) :
    Functor.whiskerLeft (functor γ) (reebAddIso ε δ).hom ≫ (reebAddIso (ε + δ) γ).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (bandEqIso (add_assoc ε δ γ)).hom ℛ =
      Functor.whiskerRight (Functor.whiskerRight (addNatTrans δ γ) (functor ε)) ℛ ≫
        (reebAddIso ε (δ + γ)).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext A q
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h z =>
    exact congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) (DFunLike.congr_fun (addMap_assoc (X := A.left) ε δ γ) z)

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.reebAddInnerIso_hom
statement:
theorem reebAddInnerIso_hom (ε δ γ : ℝ≥0) :
    (reebAddInnerIso ε δ γ).hom =
      Functor.whiskerRight (Functor.whiskerRight (addNatTrans δ γ) (functor ε)) ℛ
proof:
:=

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.reebAddIso_assoc_iso
statement:
theorem reebAddIso_assoc_iso (ε δ γ : ℝ≥0) :
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (functor γ) (reebAddIso ε δ) ≪≫ reebAddIso (ε + δ) γ ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerRight (bandEqIso (add_assoc ε δ γ)) ℛ =
      reebAddInnerIso ε δ γ ≪≫ reebAddIso ε (δ + γ)
proof:
:=
  Iso.ext (reebAddIso_assoc ε δ γ)

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.reebAddIso_zero_left
statement:
theorem reebAddIso_zero_left (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    reebAddIso 0 δ ≪≫ Functor.isoWhiskerRight (bandEqIso (zero_add δ)) ℛ =

proof:
:= by
  ext A q
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h z =>
    exact congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) (DFunLike.congr_fun (addMap_zero_left (X := A.left) δ) z)

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.reebAddIso_zero_right
statement:
theorem reebAddIso_zero_right (δ : ℝ≥0) :

proof:
:= by
  ext A q
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h z =>
    exact congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) (DFunLike.congr_fun (addMap_zero_right (X := A.left) δ) z)

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.whiskerLeft_zeroSectionNatTrans_comp_reebAddIso
statement:
theorem whiskerLeft_zeroSectionNatTrans_comp_reebAddIso (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (Functor.whiskerLeft (functor δ) (zeroSectionNatTrans ε)) ℛ ≫
        (reebAddIso ε δ).hom =
      Functor.whiskerRight (bandInclusionNatTrans (le_add_self : δ ≤ ε + δ)) ℛ
proof:
:= by
  ext A q
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h z =>
    exact congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _)
      (DFunLike.congr_fun (addMap_comp_zeroSection (X := A.left) ε δ) z)

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.whiskerRight_zeroSectionNatTrans_comp_reebAddIso
statement:
theorem whiskerRight_zeroSectionNatTrans_comp_reebAddIso (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (Functor.whiskerRight (zeroSectionNatTrans δ) (functor ε)) ℛ ≫
        (reebAddIso ε δ).hom =
      Functor.whiskerRight (bandInclusionNatTrans (le_self_add : ε ≤ ε + δ)) ℛ
proof:
:= by
  ext A q
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h z =>
    exact congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _)
      (DFunLike.congr_fun (addMap_comp_map_zeroSection (X := A.left) ε δ) z)

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.reebAddIso_comp_bandInclusionNatTrans
statement:
theorem reebAddIso_comp_bandInclusionNatTrans {ε ε' δ δ' : ℝ≥0} (hε : ε ≤ ε') (hδ : δ ≤ δ') :
    Functor.whiskerRight (Functor.whiskerRight (bandInclusionNatTrans hδ) (functor ε)) ℛ ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (Functor.whiskerLeft (functor δ') (bandInclusionNatTrans hε)) ℛ ≫
          (reebAddIso ε' δ').hom =
      (reebAddIso ε δ).hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight (bandInclusionNatTrans (add_le_add hε hδ)) ℛ
proof:
:= by
  ext A q
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h z => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.RGraph.isRGraph_quotient_thickening_thickening

theorem isRGraph_quotient_thickening_thickening {A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)} (hA : IsRGraph A)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricEnlargement.enlargement_parallel_not_injective
statement:
theorem enlargement_parallel_not_injective :
    ¬ Function.Injective
        ((geometricEnlargement quarter_le_halfNN).app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
proof:
:= by
  intro hinj
  have : Nontrivial
      (overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj parallelGraph).obj ⁻¹' {1 / 2}) :=
    not_subsingleton_iff_nontrivial.mp parallel_quarter_fiber_not_subsingleton
  obtain ⟨p, q, hpq⟩ := exists_pair_ne
    (overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj parallelGraph).obj ⁻¹' {1 / 2})
  have hp' :
      overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing halfNN).obj parallelGraph).obj
          (((geometricEnlargement quarter_le_halfNN).app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom p.1) =
        1 / 2 :=
    (overBaseMap_comm
      ((geometricEnlargement quarter_le_halfNN).app parallelGraph).hom p.1).trans p.2
  have hq' :
      overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing halfNN).obj parallelGraph).obj
          (((geometricEnlargement quarter_le_halfNN).app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom q.1) =
        1 / 2 :=
    (overBaseMap_comm
      ((geometricEnlargement quarter_le_halfNN).app parallelGraph).hom q.1).trans q.2
  have hmap :
      ((geometricEnlargement quarter_le_halfNN).app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom p.1 =
        ((geometricEnlargement quarter_le_halfNN).app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom q.1 := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      ((parallel_half_fiber_subsingleton (1 / 2)).elim
        (⟨_, hp'⟩ : overBaseMap
            ((geometricSmoothing halfNN).obj parallelGraph).obj ⁻¹' {1 / 2})
        (⟨_, hq'⟩ : overBaseMap
            ((geometricSmoothing halfNN).obj parallelGraph).obj ⁻¹' {1 / 2}))
  exact hpq (Subtype.ext (hinj hmap))

proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hε
    exact h.elim (edgeMid_isEmpty (not_le.mp hε)).false
  · intro hε
    exact nonempty_mono (A := singleGraph) (B := midGraph)

        rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, coe_halfNN]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphCosheafEquivalence.swap_cosheaf_edge

theorem collapseToPoint_bijective (I : OpenInterval) :
    Function.Bijective ((intervalComponentsOver.map collapseToPoint).app I)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun c c' _ => ?_, fun d => ?_⟩
  · induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      induction c' using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
      | mk y =>
        obtain ⟨γ⟩ := PathConnectedSpace.joined (X := unitInterval) x.1 y.1
        have hf : Continuous (fun z : unitInterval => (⟨z, x.2⟩ :
            {w : constInterval.left // overBaseMap constInterval w ∈ toOpens I})) :=
          continuous_id.subtype_mk _
        exact ZerothHomotopy.sound (γ.map hf)
  · induction d using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk q =>
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ :=
        ofVertex_surjective_zero S0 (ofFiniteData Examples.ConstructibleRepresentation.pt0) q.1
      have h0 : overBaseMap constInterval (0 : unitInterval) ∈ toOpens I := by
        have := q.2
        rw [← hv] at this
        exact this
      exact ⟨ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨(0 : unitInterval), h0⟩,
        congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (Subtype.ext hv)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphCosheafEquivalence.constInterval_not_isRGraph
statement: theorem constInterval_not_isRGraph : ¬ IsRGraph constInterval
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨m, T, D, ⟨i⟩⟩
  have hinv : ∀ x : unitInterval, i.inv.left.hom (i.hom.left.hom x) = x := fun x =>
    congrArg (fun φ : constInterval ⟶ constInterval => φ.left.hom x) i.hom_inv_id
  have hfib : ∀ x : unitInterval, (ofFiniteData D).height T (i.hom.left.hom x) = 0 :=
    fun x => overBaseMap_comm i.hom x
  have := discreteTopology_fiber T D 0
  have hc : Continuous (fun x : unitInterval =>
      (⟨i.hom.left.hom x, hfib x⟩ : (ofFiniteData D).height T ⁻¹' {0})) :=
    i.hom.left.hom.continuous.subtype_mk _
  have h01 := PreconnectedSpace.constant inferInstance hc (x := 0) (y := 1)
  have h01' : (0 : unitInterval) = 1 :=
    (hinv 0).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (fun y => i.inv.left.hom y) (congrArg Subtype.val h01)).trans (hinv 1))
  exact absurd (congrArg Subtype.val h01') (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.exists_clampData_Icc
statement:
theorem exists_clampData_Icc {n : ℕ} (S : CriticalValues n) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∃ c : S.ClampData (ioo (a - δ) (b + δ)), c.lo = a ∧ c.hi = b
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ k : Fin (n + 1),
      ∀ᶠ δ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), S.value k ∈ Ioo (a - δ) (b + δ) →
        S.value k ∈ Icc a b := by
    intro k
    by_cases hka : S.value k < a
    · have hg : 0 < a - S.value k := sub_pos.mpr hka
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hg] with δ hδ
      intro hmem
      exfalso
      linarith [hmem.1, hδ.2]
    · by_cases hkb : b < S.value k
      · have hg : 0 < S.value k - b := sub_pos.mpr hkb
        filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT hg] with δ hδ
        intro hmem
        exfalso
        linarith [hmem.2, hδ.2]
      · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ _ =>
          ⟨le_of_not_gt hka, le_of_not_gt hkb⟩)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hpos⟩ := ((Filter.eventually_all.2 h).and self_mem_nhdsWithin).exists
  refine ⟨δ, hpos, ⟨a, b, hab, ?_, ?_⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
  · intro t ht
    constructor <;> linarith [hpos, ht.1, ht.2]
  · intro k hk
    exact hδ k hk

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.joinedIn_Icc_of_joinedIn
statement:
theorem joinedIn_Icc_of_joinedIn {n : ℕ} (S : CriticalValues n)
    (P : CylinderPresentation.{u} n) {a b δ : ℝ} (c : S.ClampData (ioo (a - δ) (b + δ)))
    (hlo : c.lo = a) (hhi : c.hi = b) {x x' : P.Realization S}
    (hx : P.height S x ∈ Icc a b) (hx' : P.height S x' ∈ Icc a b)
    (h : JoinedIn (P.height S ⁻¹' (ioo (a - δ) (b + δ) : Set ℝ)) x x') :
    JoinedIn (P.height S ⁻¹' Icc a b) x x'
proof:
:= by
  let γ : Path x x' :=
    { toFun := fun t => P.clampFamily c ⟨h.somePath t, h.somePath_mem t⟩ 1
      continuous_toFun := (P.continuous_clampFamily_one c).comp
        (h.somePath.continuous.subtype_mk _)
      source' := by
        simp only [Path.source]
        exact P.clampFamily_of_mem c _ (by rw [hlo, hhi]; exact hx) 1
      target' := by
        simp only [Path.target]
        exact P.clampFamily_of_mem c _ (by rw [hlo, hhi]; exact hx') 1 }
  refine ⟨γ, fun t => ?_⟩
  have hm := P.clampFamily_one_mem_Icc c ⟨h.somePath t, h.somePath_mem t⟩
  rw [hlo, hhi] at hm
  exact hm

name: TDA.Reeb.GeometricThickening.reebRel_height_iff
statement:
theorem reebRel_height_iff {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : C(X, ℝ))
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (z z' : X × Band ε) :
    ReebRel (height f ε) z z' ↔ height f ε z' = height f ε z ∧
      JoinedIn (f ⁻¹' Icc (height f ε z - ε) (height f ε z + ε)) z.1 z'.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨γ, hγ⟩
    refine ⟨by simpa using hγ 1, ⟨γ.map continuous_fst, ?_⟩⟩
    intro t
    have hb : height f ε (γ t) - ε ≤ f (γ t).1 ∧
        f (γ t).1 ≤ height f ε (γ t) + ε := band_bounds f (γ t).1 (γ t).2
    rw [hγ t] at hb
    exact hb
  · rintro ⟨hz', hjoin⟩
    let t : ℝ := height f ε z
    let γ : Path z.1 z'.1 := hjoin.somePath
    have hmem : ∀ s : unitInterval, f (γ s) ∈ Icc (t - ε) (t + ε) := by
      intro s
      exact hjoin.somePath_mem s
    let γ' : Path z z' := {
      toFun := fun s =>
        (γ s, ⟨t - f (γ s), sub_mem_band f (hmem s)⟩)
      continuous_toFun := γ.continuous.prodMk
        ((continuous_const.sub (f.continuous.comp γ.continuous)).subtype_mk _)
      source' := by
        apply Prod.ext
        · exact γ.source
        · apply Subtype.ext
          dsimp only [Prod.snd, Subtype.coe_mk]
          rw [γ.source]
          dsimp [t]
          ring
      target' := by
        apply Prod.ext
        · exact γ.target
        · apply Subtype.ext
          dsimp only [Prod.snd, Subtype.coe_mk]
          rw [γ.target]
          dsimp [t]
          have e : f z'.1 + (z'.2 : ℝ) = f z.1 + z.2 := hz'
          linarith }
    refine ⟨γ', ?_⟩
    intro s
    change f (γ s) + (t - f (γ s)) = height f ε z
    dsimp [t]
    ring

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.joinedIn_Icc_of_isConstructibleSpace
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, S, P, h1, h2, h3, h4, ⟨i⟩⟩ := hX
  have := h1
  have := h2
  have := h3
  have := h4
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, c, hlo, hhi⟩ := S.exists_clampData_Icc hab
  let J : OpenInterval := ioo (a - δ) (b + δ)
  have hxP : P.height S (i.hom.left.hom x) ∈ Icc a b := by
    have e : P.height S (i.hom.left.hom x) = overBaseMap X x :=
      overBaseMap_comm i.hom x
    exact e.symm ▸ hx
  have hxP' : P.height S (i.hom.left.hom x') ∈ Icc a b := by
    have e : P.height S (i.hom.left.hom x') = overBaseMap X x' :=
      overBaseMap_comm i.hom x'
    exact e.symm ▸ hx'
  have hmap := h.map (((ℛ).map i.hom).left.hom.continuous)
  have hP : JoinedIn
      (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj (Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S)))) ⁻¹' Icc a b)
      (ReebQuotient.mk (P.height S) (i.hom.left.hom x))
      (ReebQuotient.mk (P.height S) (i.hom.left.hom x')) := by
    apply (hmap.mono ?_)
    rintro q ⟨q₀, hq₀, rfl⟩
    change overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj (Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S))))
      (((ℛ).map i.hom).left.hom q₀) ∈ Icc a b
    rw [overBaseMap_comm ((ℛ).map i.hom) q₀]
    exact hq₀
  have hJ : JoinedIn
      (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj (Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S)))) ⁻¹' (J : Set ℝ))
      (ReebQuotient.mk (P.height S) (i.hom.left.hom x))
      (ReebQuotient.mk (P.height S) (i.hom.left.hom x')) := by
    have hsub : Icc a b ⊆ (J : Set ℝ) := by
      intro t ht
      constructor <;> linarith [hδ, ht.1, ht.2]
    exact hP.mono (fun q hq => hsub hq)
  have hxJ : P.height S (i.hom.left.hom x) ∈ (J : Set ℝ) := by
    have hsub : Icc a b ⊆ (J : Set ℝ) := by
      intro t ht
      constructor <;> linarith [hδ, ht.1, ht.2]
    exact hsub hxP
  have hxJ' : P.height S (i.hom.left.hom x') ∈ (J : Set ℝ) := by
    have hsub : Icc a b ⊆ (J : Set ℝ) := by
      intro t ht
      constructor <;> linarith [hδ, ht.1, ht.2]
    exact hsub hxP'
  have hQcomp :
      ZerothHomotopy.mk
          (⟨ReebQuotient.mk (P.height S) (i.hom.left.hom x), hJ.source_mem⟩ :
            {q : ReebQuotient (P.height S) //
              ReebQuotient.height (P.height S) q ∈ OpenInterval.toOpens J}) =
        ZerothHomotopy.mk
          (⟨ReebQuotient.mk (P.height S) (i.hom.left.hom x'), hJ.target_mem⟩ :
            {q : ReebQuotient (P.height S) //
              ReebQuotient.height (P.height S) q ∈ OpenInterval.toOpens J}) :=
    ZerothHomotopy.sound hJ.joined_subtype.somePath
  have hPconstructible : IsConstructibleSpace (Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S))) :=
    ⟨n, S, P, h1, h2, h3, h4, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩
  have hκinj :=
    (bijective_intervalComponentComparison_app_of_constructible hPconstructible J).1
  have hPcomp :
      ZerothHomotopy.mk
          (⟨i.hom.left.hom x, hxJ⟩ :
            {y : P.Realization S //
              overBaseMap (Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S))) y ∈
                OpenInterval.toOpens J}) =
        ZerothHomotopy.mk
          (⟨i.hom.left.hom x', hxJ'⟩ :
            {y : P.Realization S //
              overBaseMap (Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S))) y ∈
                OpenInterval.toOpens J}) := by
    apply hκinj
    exact
      (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison_app_mk
        (overBaseMap (Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S)))) J
        ⟨i.hom.left.hom x, hxJ⟩).trans
        (hQcomp.trans
          (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison_app_mk
            (overBaseMap (Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S)))) J
            ⟨i.hom.left.hom x', hxJ'⟩).symm)
  have hJ' : JoinedIn (P.height S ⁻¹' (J : Set ℝ))
      (i.hom.left.hom x) (i.hom.left.hom x') :=
    (joinedIn_iff_joined (F := P.height S ⁻¹' (J : Set ℝ)) hxJ hxJ').2
      (Quotient.exact hPcomp)
  have hPclosed := CylinderPresentation.joinedIn_Icc_of_joinedIn S P c hlo hhi
    hxP hxP' hJ'
  have hback := hPclosed.map i.inv.left.hom.continuous
  have hback' : JoinedIn (overBaseMap X ⁻¹' Icc a b)
      (i.inv.left.hom (i.hom.left.hom x))
      (i.inv.left.hom (i.hom.left.hom x')) := by
    apply hback.mono
    rintro y ⟨y₀, hy₀, rfl⟩
    change overBaseMap X (i.inv.left.hom y₀) ∈ Icc a b
    have e : overBaseMap X (i.inv.left.hom y₀) = P.height S y₀ :=
      overBaseMap_comm i.inv y₀
    exact e.symm ▸ hy₀
  have hinv (y : X.left) : i.inv.left.hom (i.hom.left.hom y) = y :=
    congrArg (fun φ => φ.left.hom y) i.hom_inv_id
  rw [hinv x, hinv x'] at hback'
  exact hback'

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.bijective_quotientFunctor_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app
statement:
theorem bijective_quotientFunctor_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app {X : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)}
    (hX : IsConstructibleSpace X) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    Function.Bijective (((ℛ).map ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).map
      ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X))).left.hom)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro q q' h
    induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
    | h z =>
      induction q' using ReebQuotient.ind with
      | h z' =>
        rcases z with ⟨x, t⟩
        rcases z' with ⟨x', t'⟩
        change ReebQuotient.mk _ (ReebQuotient.mk _ x, t) =
          ReebQuotient.mk _ (ReebQuotient.mk _ x', t') at h
        have hrelQ :
            ReebRel (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj X)) ε)
              (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap X) x, t)
              (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap X) x', t') :=
          (ReebQuotient.mk_eq_mk_iff _).1 h
        have hheight := (GeometricThickening.reebRel_height_iff
          (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj X)) ε
          (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap X) x, t)
          (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap X) x', t')).1 hrelQ
        have hx : overBaseMap X x ∈ Icc
            (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj X)) ε
              (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap X) x, t) - ε)
            (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj X)) ε
              (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap X) x, t) + ε) := by
          change (overBaseMap X x + t) - ε ≤ overBaseMap X x ∧
            overBaseMap X x ≤ (overBaseMap X x + t) + ε
          exact GeometricThickening.band_bounds (overBaseMap X) x t
        have hx' : overBaseMap X x' ∈ Icc
            (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj X)) ε
              (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap X) x, t) - ε)
            (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj X)) ε
              (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap X) x, t) + ε) := by
          have heq : overBaseMap X x' + t' = overBaseMap X x + t := by
            exact hheight.1
          change (overBaseMap X x + t) - ε ≤ overBaseMap X x' ∧
            overBaseMap X x' ≤ (overBaseMap X x + t) + ε
          rw [← heq]
          exact GeometricThickening.band_bounds (overBaseMap X) x' t'
        have hab :
            GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj X)) ε
                (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap X) x, t) - ε ≤
              GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj X)) ε
                (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap X) x, t) + ε := by
          linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]
        have hjoinX := joinedIn_Icc_of_isConstructibleSpace hX hab hx hx' hheight.2
        have hrelX : ReebRel (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap X) ε) (x, t) (x', t') := by
          apply (GeometricThickening.reebRel_height_iff (overBaseMap X) ε (x, t) (x', t')).2
          exact ⟨by
            exact hheight.1,
            by
              exact hjoinX⟩
        change ReebQuotient.mk (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap X) ε) (x, t) =
          ReebQuotient.mk (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap X) ε) (x', t')
        exact (ReebQuotient.mk_eq_mk_iff _).2 hrelX
  · intro q
    obtain ⟨⟨p, s⟩, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _ q
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective (overBaseMap X) p
    exact ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ (x, s), rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.compactSpace_quotient_thickening
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, S, P, h1, h2, h3, h4, ⟨i⟩⟩ := hX
  have := h1
  have := h3
  have : CompactSpace (P.Realization S) := P.compactSpace S
  let e : X.left ≃ₜ P.Realization S := TopCat.homeoOfIso ((Over.forget _).mapIso i)
  have : CompactSpace X.left := e.symm.compactSpace
  have : CompactSpace (X.left × GeometricThickening.Band ε) := inferInstance
  exact (ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _).compactSpace (ReebQuotient.continuous_mk _)

theorem t2Space_quotient_thickening_quotient {X : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)}
    (hX : IsConstructibleSpace X) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    T2Space (ReebQuotient
      (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj X)) ε))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, T, D, ⟨i⟩⟩ :=
    isRGraph_quotient_of_isConstructibleSpace
      (isConstructibleSpace_thickening (isRGraph_quotient_of_isConstructibleSpace hX) ε)
  have : T2Space ((CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData D).Realization T) :=
    CylinderPresentation.finiteData_t2Space T D
  let e : ReebQuotient
      (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj X)) ε) ≃ₜ
      (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData D).Realization T :=
    TopCat.homeoOfIso ((Over.forget _).mapIso i)
  exact e.isEmbedding.t2Space

theorem continuous_lift [TopologicalSpace Y] (hfe : ∀ d, Continuous (fe d)) :

:= by
  let _ : TopologicalSpace V := ⊥

    ∃! g : C(Realization G, Y), (∀ v, g (vertex G v) = fv v) ∧
      ∀ d t, g (edgePoint G d t) = fe d t
proof:
:=
  ⟨continuousLift G fv fe hsymm hstart, ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩,
    fun g hg => continuousLift_unique G fv fe hsymm hstart g hg.1 hg.2⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphRealization.vertex_injective
statement: theorem vertex_injective : Function.Injective (vertex G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hne : ∀ t : unitInterval, t ≠ 0 → σ t ≠ 1 := fun t ht h =>
    ht (by rw [← symm_symm t, h, symm_one])
  have hne' : ∀ t : unitInterval, t ≠ 1 → σ t ≠ 0 := fun t ht h =>
    ht (by rw [← symm_symm t, h, symm_zero])
  let r : Realization G → Option V :=
    lift G some (fun d t => if t = 0 then some d.fst else if t = 1 then some d.snd else none)
      (fun d t => by
        by_cases h0 : t = 0
        · subst h0
          simp [symm_zero]
        · by_cases h1 : t = 1
          · subst h1
            simp [symm_one]
          · simp [h0, h1, hne t h0, hne' t h1])
      (fun d => by simp)
  exact fun v w h => Option.some_injective _ (congrArg r h)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.homEquiv_symm_constructibleSmoothingUnit
statement:
theorem homEquiv_symm_constructibleSmoothingUnit (ε : ℝ≥0) (X : ConstructibleSpaceCat) :
    (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv _ _).symm ((constructibleSmoothingUnit ε).app X) ≫
        (thickeningQuotientAbsorptionIso ε).hom.app X =
      (geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  let u : X ⟶ rgraphToConstructible.obj ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X) :=
    (constructibleSmoothingUnit ε).app X
  have h : u ≫ rgraphToConstructible.map ((thickeningQuotientAbsorptionIso ε).hom.app X) =
      quotientRGraphAdjunction.unit.app X ≫
        rgraphToConstructible.map ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X)) := by
    ext1
    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext (by
      ext x
      rfl)
  calc
    (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv _ _).symm u ≫
        (thickeningQuotientAbsorptionIso ε).hom.app X =
      (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv _ _).symm
        (u ≫ rgraphToConstructible.map ((thickeningQuotientAbsorptionIso ε).hom.app X)) :=
      (Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm quotientRGraphAdjunction u
        ((thickeningQuotientAbsorptionIso ε).hom.app X)).symm
    _ = (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv _ _).symm
          (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv _ _
            ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X))) := by
        rw [h, Adjunction.homEquiv_unit]
        rfl
    _ = _ := Equiv.symm_apply_apply _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.ConstructibleInterleaving.coherence_iff
statement:
theorem coherence_iff (φ : X ⟶ (constructibleSmoothing ε).obj Y)
    (ψ : Y ⟶ (constructibleSmoothing ε).obj X) :
    (φ ≫ (constructibleSmoothing ε).map ψ ≫
        (constructibleSmoothingCompIso ε ε).hom.app X =
      (constructibleSmoothingUnit (ε + ε)).app X) ↔
      ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj Y)).symm φ ≫
        (thickeningQuotientAbsorptionIso ε).hom.app Y) ≫
        (geometricSmoothing ε).map
          ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv Y ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X)).symm ψ ≫
            (thickeningQuotientAbsorptionIso ε).hom.app X) ≫
        (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε ε).hom.app (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X) =
      (geometricSmoothingUnit (ε + ε)).app (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X)
proof:
:= by
  let φ₀ : X ⟶ rgraphToConstructible.obj ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj Y) := φ
  let ψ₀ : Y ⟶ rgraphToConstructible.obj ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X) := ψ
  change
    (φ₀ ≫ rgraphToConstructible.map ((thickeningQuotient ε).map ψ₀) ≫
        rgraphToConstructible.map ((thickeningQuotientCompIso ε ε).hom.app X) =
      (constructibleSmoothingUnit (ε + ε)).app X) ↔
      ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj Y)).symm φ₀ ≫
        (thickeningQuotientAbsorptionIso ε).hom.app Y) ≫
        (geometricSmoothing ε).map
          ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv Y ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X)).symm ψ₀ ≫
            (thickeningQuotientAbsorptionIso ε).hom.app X) ≫
        (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε ε).hom.app (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X) =
      (geometricSmoothingUnit (ε + ε)).app (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X)
  let aε := thickeningQuotientAbsorptionIso ε
  let a2ε := thickeningQuotientAbsorptionIso (ε + ε)
  let μ := geometricSmoothingCompIso ε ε
  let c := thickeningQuotientCompIso ε ε
  have hmap {A B : RGraphCat} (g : A ⟶ B) :
      (thickeningQuotient ε).map (rgraphToConstructible.map g) =
        (geometricSmoothing ε).map g := by
    change (rgraphToConstructible ⋙ thickeningQuotient ε).map g =
      (geometricSmoothing ε).map g
    rfl
  have hc : c.hom.app X =
      (geometricSmoothing ε).map (aε.hom.app X) ≫
        μ.hom.app (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X) ≫ a2ε.inv.app X := by
    simp [c, aε, a2ε, μ, thickeningQuotientCompIso, Functor.associator]
  have hψ : ψ₀ = quotientRGraphAdjunction.unit.app Y ≫
      rgraphToConstructible.map
        ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv Y ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X)).symm ψ₀) := by
    change ψ₀ =
      (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv Y ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X))
        ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv Y ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X)).symm ψ₀)
    exact ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv Y ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X)).apply_symm_apply ψ₀).symm.trans
      (Adjunction.homEquiv_unit quotientRGraphAdjunction _ _ _)
  have hcomp :
      (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient (ε + ε)).obj X)).symm
          (φ₀ ≫ rgraphToConstructible.map ((thickeningQuotient ε).map ψ₀) ≫
            rgraphToConstructible.map (c.hom.app X)) =
        (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj Y)).symm φ₀ ≫
          (thickeningQuotient ε).map ψ₀ ≫ c.hom.app X := by
    calc
      _ = (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient (ε + ε)).obj X)).symm
          (φ₀ ≫ rgraphToConstructible.map
            ((thickeningQuotient ε).map ψ₀ ≫ c.hom.app X)) := by
        exact congrArg
          (fun k => (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv
            X ((thickeningQuotient (ε + ε)).obj X)).symm (φ₀ ≫ k))
          (rgraphToConstructible.map_comp ((thickeningQuotient ε).map ψ₀)
            (c.hom.app X)).symm
      _ = (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj Y)).symm φ₀ ≫
          (thickeningQuotient ε).map ψ₀ ≫ c.hom.app X :=
        Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_right_symm quotientRGraphAdjunction φ₀
          ((thickeningQuotient ε).map ψ₀ ≫ c.hom.app X)
  have hcomp' :
      (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient (ε + ε)).obj X)).symm
          (φ₀ ≫ rgraphToConstructible.map ((thickeningQuotient ε).map ψ₀) ≫
            rgraphToConstructible.map (c.hom.app X)) =
        ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj Y)).symm φ₀ ≫
          aε.hom.app Y) ≫
          (geometricSmoothing ε).map
            ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv Y ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X)).symm ψ₀ ≫
              aε.hom.app X) ≫
          μ.hom.app (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X) ≫ a2ε.inv.app X := by
    calc
      _ = (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj Y)).symm φ₀ ≫
          (thickeningQuotient ε).map ψ₀ ≫ c.hom.app X := hcomp
      _ = (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj Y)).symm φ₀ ≫
          aε.hom.app Y ≫
          (geometricSmoothing ε).map
            ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv Y ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X)).symm ψ₀) ≫
          c.hom.app X := by
        have hT : (thickeningQuotient ε).map ψ₀ = aε.hom.app Y ≫
            (geometricSmoothing ε).map
              ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv Y ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X)).symm ψ₀) := by
          calc
            (thickeningQuotient ε).map ψ₀ = (thickeningQuotient ε).map
                (quotientRGraphAdjunction.unit.app Y ≫ rgraphToConstructible.map
                  ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv Y ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X)).symm ψ₀)) :=
              congrArg _ hψ
            _ = (thickeningQuotient ε).map (quotientRGraphAdjunction.unit.app Y) ≫
                (thickeningQuotient ε).map (rgraphToConstructible.map
                  ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv Y ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X)).symm ψ₀)) :=
              Functor.map_comp _ _ _
            _ = _ := by
              rw [← thickeningQuotientAbsorptionIso_hom_app_eq]
              rfl
        rw [hT]
        exact congrArg (fun k => _ ≫ k) (Category.assoc _ _ _)
      _ = ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj Y)).symm φ₀ ≫
            aε.hom.app Y) ≫
          (geometricSmoothing ε).map
            ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv Y ((thickeningQuotient ε).obj X)).symm ψ₀ ≫
              aε.hom.app X) ≫
          μ.hom.app (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X) ≫ a2ε.inv.app X := by
        rw [hc]
        simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  have hunit :
      (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient (ε + ε)).obj X)).symm
          ((constructibleSmoothingUnit (ε + ε)).app X) =
        (geometricSmoothingUnit (ε + ε)).app (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X) ≫
          a2ε.inv.app X := by
    calc
      _ = ((quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient (ε + ε)).obj X)).symm
            ((constructibleSmoothingUnit (ε + ε)).app X) ≫ a2ε.hom.app X) ≫
          a2ε.inv.app X := by simp [a2ε]
      _ = (geometricSmoothingUnit (ε + ε)).app (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X) ≫
          a2ε.inv.app X := by
        exact congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a2ε.inv.app X)
          (homEquiv_symm_constructibleSmoothingUnit (ε + ε) X)
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (cancel_mono (a2ε.inv.app X)).1
      (hcomp'.symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun k =>
          (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv
            X ((thickeningQuotient (ε + ε)).obj X)).symm k) h).trans hunit))
  · intro h
    apply (quotientRGraphAdjunction.homEquiv X ((thickeningQuotient (ε + ε)).obj X)).symm.injective
    exact hcomp'.trans
      ((congrArg (fun k => k ≫ a2ε.inv.app X) h).trans hunit.symm)

        (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj Y)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.constructibleInterleavingDistance_eq_interleavingDistance
statement:

    (X Y : ConstructibleSpaceCat) :

      interleavingDistance (intervalComponents (overBaseMap X.obj))
        (intervalComponents (overBaseMap Y.obj))
proof:
:= by
  rw [constructibleInterleavingDistance_eq_geometricInterleavingDistance,
    geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_interleavingDistance]
  exact interleavingDistance_congr
    (show (cosheafFunctor.obj (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X)).obj ≅
        intervalComponents (overBaseMap X.obj) from
      (constructibleComponentComparisonIso.app X).symm)
    (show (cosheafFunctor.obj (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj Y)).obj ≅
        intervalComponents (overBaseMap Y.obj) from

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.constructibleInterleavingDistance_constructibleSmoothing_self_le
statement:
theorem constructibleInterleavingDistance_constructibleSmoothing_self_le
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (X : ConstructibleSpaceCat) :
    constructibleInterleavingDistance X ((constructibleSmoothing ε).obj X) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [constructibleInterleavingDistance_eq_geometricInterleavingDistance]
  calc
    geometricInterleavingDistance (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X)
        (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj ((constructibleSmoothing ε).obj X)) =
      geometricInterleavingDistance (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X)
        ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X)) :=
      geometricInterleavingDistance_congr (Iso.refl _)
        (constructibleSmoothingQuotientIso ε X)
    _ ≤ ε := geometricInterleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_self_le ε _

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.constructibleInterleavingDistance_constructibleSmoothing_le
statement:
theorem constructibleInterleavingDistance_constructibleSmoothing_le

    constructibleInterleavingDistance ((constructibleSmoothing ε).obj X)
        ((constructibleSmoothing ε).obj Y) ≤ constructibleInterleavingDistance X Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [constructibleInterleavingDistance_eq_geometricInterleavingDistance,
    constructibleInterleavingDistance_eq_geometricInterleavingDistance]
  calc
    geometricInterleavingDistance (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj ((constructibleSmoothing ε).obj X))
        (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj ((constructibleSmoothing ε).obj Y)) =
      geometricInterleavingDistance ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X))
        ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj Y)) :=
      geometricInterleavingDistance_congr (constructibleSmoothingQuotientIso ε X)
        (constructibleSmoothingQuotientIso ε Y)
    _ ≤ geometricInterleavingDistance (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X)
        (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj Y) := geometricInterleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_le ε _ _

      edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑f) (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑g)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.twoOpens_classes_related
statement:
theorem twoOpens_classes_related :
    Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id ℝ)) twoOpens)
      ⟨false, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨0, show (0 : ℝ) < 2 / 3 by norm_num⟩⟩
      ⟨true, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨1, show (1 / 3 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  refine (componentFunctor_map_eq_iff_eqvGen (ContinuousMap.id ℝ) twoOpens
    (fun _ => le_top) twoOpens_cover _ _).1 ?_
  simp only [componentFunctor_map_mk]
  exact ZerothHomotopy.sound
    { toFun := fun s => ⟨(s : ℝ), TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top _⟩
      continuous_toFun := continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _
      source' := rfl
      target' := rfl }

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.negPos_overlapRel_fst
statement:
theorem negPos_overlapRel_fst {p q : Σ b, (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id ℝ)).obj (negPos b)}
    (h : overlapRel (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id ℝ)) negPos p q) : p.1 = q.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, -, -⟩ := h
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk z =>
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := z
    rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_inf] at hz
    obtain ⟨hp, hq⟩ := hz
    rcases p with ⟨_ | _, _⟩ <;> rcases q with ⟨_ | _, _⟩
    · rfl
    · exact absurd (lt_trans (show (0 : ℝ) < z from hq) (show z < 0 from hp)) (lt_irrefl _)
    · exact absurd (lt_trans (show (0 : ℝ) < z from hp) (show z < 0 from hq)) (lt_irrefl _)
    · rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.negPos_classes_ne
statement:
theorem negPos_classes_ne :
    (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id ℝ)).map (homOfLE (le_iSup negPos false))
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨-1, show (-1 : ℝ) < 0 by norm_num⟩) ≠
      (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id ℝ)).map (homOfLE (le_iSup negPos true))
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨1, show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num⟩)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hR := (componentFunctor_map_eq_iff_eqvGen (ContinuousMap.id ℝ) negPos
    (le_iSup negPos) le_rfl _ _).1 h
  have key : ∀ p q, Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id ℝ)) negPos)
      p q → p.1 = q.1 := by
    intro p q hpq
    induction hpq with
    | rel _ _ h => exact negPos_overlapRel_fst h
    | refl => rfl
    | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
    | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂
  exact Bool.false_ne_true (key _ _ hR)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.existsUnique_glue_sort
statement:
theorem existsUnique_glue_sort {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {κ : Sort*} (f : C(X, Y)) {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y} (U : κ → TopologicalSpace.Opens Y)
    (hU : ∀ i, U i ≤ W) (hcov : W ≤ ⨆ i, U i) {A : Sort*}
    (a : ∀ i, (componentFunctor f).obj (U i) → A)
    (ha : ∀ i j (c : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i ⊓ U j)),
      a i ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) =
        a j ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c)) :
    ∃! g : (componentFunctor f).obj W → A,
      ∀ i (e : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i)),
        g ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE (hU i)) e) = a i e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, huniq⟩ := componentFunctor_existsUnique_glue f (fun i : PLift κ => U i.down)
    (fun i => hU i.down) (by rwa [iSup_plift_down]) (fun i => a i.down)
    (fun i j c => ha i.down j.down c)
  exact ⟨g, fun i e => hg ⟨i⟩ e, fun g' hg' => huniq g' fun i e => hg' i.down e⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.collapse_glue_identifies
statement:
theorem collapse_glue_identifies {A : Sort*}
    (a : ∀ _ : Bool, (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id Unit)).obj ⊤ → A)
    (G : (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id Unit)).obj ⊤ → A)
    (hG : ∀ i (e : (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id Unit)).obj ⊤),
      G ((componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id Unit)).map (homOfLE le_top) e) = a i e)
    (G' : (componentFunctor boolToUnit).obj ⊤ → A)
    (hG' : ∀ i (e : (componentFunctor boolToUnit).obj ⊤),
      G' ((componentFunctor boolToUnit).map (homOfLE le_top) e) = a i (collapseNatTrans.app ⊤ e)) :
    G' = G ∘ collapseNatTrans.app ⊤ ∧ G' (boolClass false) = G' (boolClass true)
proof:
:= by
  have h := componentFunctor_glue_natTrans (f := boolToUnit) (g := ContinuousMap.id Unit)
    (ContinuousMap.const Bool ()) (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ : Bool => ⊤) (fun _ => le_top)
    unitCover_cover a G hG G' hG'
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  rw [h]
  exact congrArg G collapseNatTrans_identifies

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructiblePerturbation.singleEdge_geometric_distance_eq_one
statement:
theorem singleEdge_geometric_distance_eq_one :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance
      ((RGraph.toRGraph S01).obj singleEdge) ((RGraph.toRGraph S02).obj singleEdge) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm singleEdge_geometric_stability_le_one
  rw [← RGraph.constructibleInterleavingDistance_rgraphToConstructible]
  change 1 ≤ RGraph.constructibleInterleavingDistance
    (singleEdgePresentation.realizationSpace S01) (singleEdgePresentation.realizationSpace S02)
  let : Nonempty (singleEdgePresentation.realizationSpace S01).obj.left :=
    ⟨singleEdgePresentation.ofVertex S01 1 ()⟩
  let : Nonempty (singleEdgePresentation.realizationSpace S02).obj.left :=
    ⟨singleEdgePresentation.ofVertex S02 1 ()⟩
  have h := RGraph.ofReal_abs_sSup_range_sub_le_constructibleInterleavingDistance
    (singleEdgePresentation.realizationSpace S01) (singleEdgePresentation.realizationSpace S02)
  change ENNReal.ofReal |sSup (Set.range (singleEdgePresentation.height S01)) -
    sSup (Set.range (singleEdgePresentation.height S02))| ≤ _ at h
  rw [singleEdge_sSup_height S01, singleEdge_sSup_height S02] at h
  norm_num [S01, S02] at h
  exact h

      ((ofFiniteData (emptyData 1)).realizationSpace S01)
      ((ofFiniteData (emptyData 1)).realizationSpace (S01.translate 1))
    d = 0 ∧ d ≠ ENNReal.ofReal |(1 : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  let P := ofFiniteData (emptyData 1)
  have e : P.realizationSpace S01 ≅ P.realizationSpace (S01.translate 1) :=
    CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isoMk _ (CategoryTheory.Over.isoMk
      (TopCat.isoOfHomeo (P.levelHomeomorph S01 (S01.translate 1))) (by
        ext q
        exact ((emptyData_isEmpty 1 S01).false q).elim))
  have hz : RGraph.constructibleInterleavingDistance
      (P.realizationSpace S01) (P.realizationSpace (S01.translate 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [RGraph.constructibleInterleavingDistance_congr (CategoryTheory.Iso.refl _) e.symm]
    exact RGraph.constructibleInterleavingDistance_self _
  exact ⟨hz, by rw [hz]; norm_num⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.componentNatTrans_naturality
statement:
theorem componentNatTrans_naturality {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z))
    (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) {U V : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y} (i : U ⟶ V) :
    (componentFunctor f).map i ≫ (componentNatTrans h comm).app V =
      (componentNatTrans h comm).app U ≫ (componentFunctor g).map i
proof:
:=
  (componentNatTrans h comm).naturality i

name: TDA.Reeb.componentNatTrans_id
statement:
theorem componentNatTrans_id (f : C(X, Y)) (comm : ∀ x, f (ContinuousMap.id X x) = f x) :
    componentNatTrans (ContinuousMap.id X) comm = 𝟙 (componentFunctor f)
proof:
:= by
  ext U c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.componentNatTrans_comp
statement:
theorem componentNatTrans_comp {W : Type u} [TopologicalSpace W] {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)}
    {e : C(W, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (hh : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) (k : C(Z, W))
    (hk : ∀ z, e (k z) = g z) (hkh : ∀ x, e ((k.comp h) x) = f x) :
    componentNatTrans (k.comp h) hkh = componentNatTrans h hh ≫ componentNatTrans k hk
proof:
:= by
  ext U c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.componentNatTrans_comp_app_mk
statement:
theorem componentNatTrans_comp_app_mk {W : Type u} [TopologicalSpace W] {f : C(X, Y)}
    {g : C(Z, Y)} {e : C(W, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (hh : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) (k : C(Z, W))
    (hk : ∀ z, e (k z) = g z) (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (x : {x : X // f x ∈ U}) :
    (componentNatTrans k hk).app U ((componentNatTrans h hh).app U (ZerothHomotopy.mk x)) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨k (h x.1), by rw [hk, hh]; exact x.2⟩ : {w : W // e w ∈ U})
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.componentNatTrans_proof_irrel
statement:

proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleSmoothingLift.constructibleSmoothingMap_pinch_not_isIso
statement:
theorem constructibleSmoothingMap_pinch_not_isIso :
    ¬ IsIso ((constructibleSmoothingMap one_le_two_nn).app
      (cosheafFunctor.obj pinchGraph))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hhom : IsIso (((constructibleSmoothingMap one_le_two_nn).app
      (cosheafFunctor.obj pinchGraph)).hom) :=
    (ObjectProperty.isIso_hom_iff _).2 h
  have hsource : IsEmpty (((smoothing 1).obj FP).obj (iio (-1))) :=
    smoothedPinch_lower_isEmpty
  have htarget : Nonempty (FP.obj (thicken 2 (iio (-1)))) := by
    have h : thicken 2 (iio (-1)) = S01.J 0 := by
      ext x
      rw [thicken_iio, pinch_J0_mem_iff, mem_iio]
      norm_num
    change Nonempty (FP.obj (thicken 2 (iio (-1))))
    rw [h]
    exact ⟨DP.vertexLabel S01 0 (0 : Fin 2)⟩
  have hbij : Function.Bijective
      (((constructibleSmoothingMap one_le_two_nn).app
        (cosheafFunctor.obj pinchGraph)).hom.app (iio (-1))) :=
    (CategoryTheory.isIso_iff_bijective _).1
      (NatIso.isIso_app_of_isIso
        ((constructibleSmoothingMap one_le_two_nn).app
          (cosheafFunctor.obj pinchGraph)).hom (iio (-1)))
  obtain ⟨y⟩ := htarget
  obtain ⟨x, _⟩ := hbij.2 y
  exact (hsource.false x).elim

name: TDA.Reeb.componentMap_eq_of_homotopic
statement:
theorem componentMap_eq_of_homotopic {f g : C(A, B)} (h : f.Homotopic g) :

proof:
:= by
  funext c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    obtain ⟨H⟩ := h
    exact ZerothHomotopy.sound
      { toFun := fun s => H (s, x)
        continuous_toFun := H.continuous.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        source' := H.apply_zero x
        target' := H.apply_one x }

name: TDA.Reeb.le_interleavingDistance_iff

proof:

  le_iInf₂_iff

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_lt_iff
statement:

    interleavingDistance F G < r ↔
      ∃ ε : ℝ≥0, (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < r ∧ Nonempty (Interleaving ε F G)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [interleavingDistance, iInf_lt_iff, exists_prop]
  exact exists_congr fun _ => and_comm

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_eq_top_iff :
    interleavingDistance F G = ⊤ ↔ ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, IsEmpty (Interleaving ε F G)
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_comm
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_comm (F G : OpenInterval ⥤ C) :
    interleavingDistance F G = interleavingDistance G F
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_iInf₂ fun _ ⟨i⟩ => i.symm.interleavingDistance_le)
    (le_iInf₂ fun _ ⟨i⟩ => i.symm.interleavingDistance_le)

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_triangle
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_triangle (F G H : OpenInterval ⥤ C) :
    interleavingDistance F H ≤ interleavingDistance F G + interleavingDistance G H
proof:
:= by
  calc interleavingDistance F H
      ≤ ⨅ (ε : ℝ≥0) (_ : Nonempty (Interleaving ε F G)) (δ : ℝ≥0)
          (_ : Nonempty (Interleaving δ G H)), ((ε : ℝ≥0∞) + δ) :=
        le_iInf₂ fun ε ⟨i⟩ => le_iInf₂ fun δ ⟨j⟩ => by
          simpa only [ENNReal.coe_add] using (i.trans j).interleavingDistance_le
    _ = interleavingDistance F G + interleavingDistance G H := by
        rw [interleavingDistance, interleavingDistance, ENNReal.iInf_add]
        refine iInf_congr fun ε => ?_
        rw [ENNReal.iInf_add]
        refine iInf_congr fun _ => ?_
        rw [ENNReal.add_iInf]
        refine iInf_congr fun δ => ?_
        rw [ENNReal.add_iInf]

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_congr
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_congr (e : F ≅ F') (e' : G ≅ G') :
    interleavingDistance F G = interleavingDistance F' G'
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ {A B A' B' : OpenInterval ⥤ C}, (A ≅ A') → (B ≅ B') →
      interleavingDistance A' B' ≤ interleavingDistance A B := fun e e' =>
    le_iInf₂ fun _ ⟨i⟩ =>
      (((Interleaving.ofIso e.symm).trans (i.trans (Interleaving.ofIso e'))).mono
        (by simp)).interleavingDistance_le
  exact le_antisymm (key e.symm e'.symm) (key e e')

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_eq_zero_iff :
    interleavingDistance F G = 0 ↔ ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, 0 < ε → Nonempty (Interleaving ε F G)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, ⟨i⟩⟩ :=
      interleavingDistance_lt_iff.1 (h.trans_lt (ENNReal.coe_pos.2 hε))
    exact ⟨i.mono (ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.1 hδ).le⟩
  · intro h
    refine nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 (ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε _ => ?_)
    simpa using interleavingDistance_le_of_nonempty (h ε hε)

proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.exists_clampData_of_le
statement:
theorem exists_clampData_of_le {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty)
    (hhit : ∀ i, S.value i ∈ I ↔ S.value i ∈ J) :
    ∃ c : S.ClampData J, Icc c.lo c.hi ⊆ (I : Set ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hI
  set T : Finset ℝ := insert s ((Finset.univ.filter fun k => S.value k ∈ I).image S.value)
  have hT : T.Nonempty := Finset.insert_nonempty _ _
  have hTI : ∀ x ∈ T, x ∈ (I : Set ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hx with rfl | hx
    · exact hs
    · obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hx
      exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 hk).2
  have hsub : Icc (T.min' hT) (T.max' hT) ⊆ (I : Set ℝ) :=
    I.ordConnected.out (hTI _ (T.min'_mem hT)) (hTI _ (T.max'_mem hT))
  refine ⟨⟨T.min' hT, T.max' hT, T.min'_le_max' hT, hsub.trans hIJ, fun k hk => ?_⟩, hsub⟩
  have hkT : S.value k ∈ T := Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
    (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (hhit k).2 hk⟩))
  exact ⟨T.min'_le _ hkT, T.le_max' _ hkT⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.joinedIn_cylinder
statement:
theorem joinedIn_cylinder (e : Fin n) (y : P.E e) (t t' : Seg S e) :
    JoinedIn (P.height S ⁻¹' uIcc (t : ℝ) t') (P.ofCylinder S e (y, t))
      (P.ofCylinder S e (y, t'))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := ((convex_uIcc (t : ℝ) (t' : ℝ) : Convex ℝ _).isPathConnected
    nonempty_uIcc).joinedIn _ left_mem_uIcc _ right_mem_uIcc
  have hsub : uIcc (t : ℝ) t' ⊆ Seg S e := ordConnected_Icc.uIcc_subset t.2 t'.2
  exact ⟨{ toFun := fun s => P.ofCylinder S e (y, ⟨γ s, hsub (hγ s)⟩)
           continuous_toFun := (P.continuous_ofCylinder S e).comp
             (continuous_const.prodMk (γ.continuous.subtype_mk _))
           source' := congrArg (fun z => P.ofCylinder S e (y, z)) (Subtype.ext γ.source)
           target' := congrArg (fun z => P.ofCylinder S e (y, z)) (Subtype.ext γ.target) },
    fun s => hγ s⟩

  exact ⟨{ toFun := fun s => ⟨γ s, hγ s⟩
           continuous_toFun := γ.continuous.subtype_mk _
           source' := Subtype.ext γ.source
           target' := Subtype.ext γ.target }⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.descend_quotMk
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : P.quotMk S (Quotient.out (s := P.setoid S) (P.quotMk S x)) = P.quotMk S x :=
    Quotient.out_eq _
  have h₂ := (P.quotMk_eq_iff S).1 h₁
  have hx' : P.rawHeight S (Quotient.out (s := P.setoid S) (P.quotMk S x)) ∈ J := by
    rw [← P.rawHeight_nf S, h₂, P.rawHeight_nf S]
    exact hx
  show g (Quotient.out (s := P.setoid S) (P.quotMk S x)) = g x
  rw [← hresp _ hx', h₂, hresp x hx]

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.continuous_clampRaw
statement: theorem continuous_clampRaw : Continuous (P.clampRaw c)
proof:
:=
  Continuous.sumElim (continuous_sigma fun i => (P.clampVertex (S := S) i).curry.continuous)
    (continuous_sigma fun e => (P.clampCyl c e).curry.continuous)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.clampRaw_inl
statement:
theorem clampRaw_inl (p : P.VertexPiece) (s : unitInterval) :
    P.clampRaw c (.inl p) s = P.quotMk S (.inl p)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.clampRaw_inr
statement:
theorem clampRaw_inr (e : Fin n) (y : P.E e) (t : Seg S e) (s : unitInterval) :
    P.clampRaw c (.inr ⟨e, y, t⟩) s = P.ofCylinder S e
      (y, projIcc _ _ (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e).le (c.interp s t))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.clampRaw_nf
statement:
theorem clampRaw_nf (x : P.Raw S) (hx : P.rawHeight S x ∈ J) :
    P.clampRaw c (P.nf S x) = P.clampRaw c x
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with p | ⟨e, y, t⟩
  · rfl
  · have hxJ : (t : ℝ) ∈ (J : Set ℝ) := hx
    simp only [nf, Sum.elim_inr, nfCyl]
    split_ifs with h₁ h₂
    · have hm : (t : ℝ) ∈ Icc c.lo c.hi := by rw [h₁]; exact c.value_mem _ (h₁ ▸ hxJ)
      ext s
      rw [clampRaw_inl, clampRaw_inr, c.interp_of_mem hm, projIcc_val,
        show t = segBot S e from Subtype.ext h₁, ofCylinder_segBot]
      rfl
    · have hm : (t : ℝ) ∈ Icc c.lo c.hi := by rw [h₂]; exact c.value_mem _ (h₂ ▸ hxJ)
      ext s
      rw [clampRaw_inl, clampRaw_inr, c.interp_of_mem hm, projIcc_val,
        show t = segTop S e from Subtype.ext h₂, ofCylinder_segTop]
      rfl
    · rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.clampFamily_quotMk
statement:
theorem clampFamily_quotMk (x : P.Raw S) (hx : P.rawHeight S x ∈ J) :
    P.clampFamily c ⟨P.quotMk S x, hx⟩ = P.clampRaw c x
proof:
:=
  descend_quotMk x hx

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_clampRaw
statement:
theorem height_clampRaw (x : P.Raw S) (hx : P.rawHeight S x ∈ J) (s : unitInterval) :
    P.height S (P.clampRaw c x s) = c.interp s (P.rawHeight S x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨k, v⟩ | ⟨e, y, t⟩
  · exact (c.interp_of_mem (c.value_mem k hx) s).symm
  · rw [clampRaw_inr, height_ofCylinder,
      projIcc_of_mem _ (c.interp_mem_seg s.2 t.2 hx)]
    rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.clampRaw_zero
statement: theorem clampRaw_zero (x : P.Raw S) : P.clampRaw c x 0 = P.quotMk S x
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with p | ⟨e, y, t⟩
  · rfl
  · rw [clampRaw_inr]
    simp only [Set.Icc.coe_zero, c.interp_zero, projIcc_val]
    rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.clampRaw_of_mem
statement:
theorem clampRaw_of_mem (x : P.Raw S) (hx : P.rawHeight S x ∈ Icc c.lo c.hi) (s : unitInterval) :
    P.clampRaw c x s = P.quotMk S x
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with p | ⟨e, y, t⟩
  · rfl
  · rw [clampRaw_inr, c.interp_of_mem (show (t : ℝ) ∈ Icc c.lo c.hi from hx), projIcc_val]
    rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_clampFamily
statement:
theorem height_clampFamily (u : P.heightPreimage S J) (s : unitInterval) :
    P.height S (P.clampFamily c u s) = c.interp s (P.height S u.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := P.exists_quotMk S u
  rw [clampFamily_quotMk, height_clampRaw _ _ _ hx]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.clampFamily_zero
statement: theorem clampFamily_zero (u : P.heightPreimage S J) : P.clampFamily c u 0 = u.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := P.exists_quotMk S u
  rw [clampFamily_quotMk, clampRaw_zero]

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.clampFamily_of_mem
statement:
theorem clampFamily_of_mem (u : P.heightPreimage S J) (hu : P.height S u.1 ∈ Icc c.lo c.hi)
    (s : unitInterval) : P.clampFamily c u s = u.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := P.exists_quotMk S u
  rw [clampFamily_quotMk, clampRaw_of_mem _ _ _ hu]

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_clampFamily_one
statement:
theorem height_clampFamily_one (u : P.heightPreimage S J) :
    P.height S (P.clampFamily c u 1) = c.clampHeight (P.height S u.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [height_clampFamily]
  exact c.interp_one _

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.continuous_clampFamily_one
statement:
theorem continuous_clampFamily_one :
    Continuous fun u : P.heightPreimage S J => P.clampFamily c u 1
proof:
:=
  (continuous_eval_const (1 : unitInterval)).comp (P.clampFamily c).continuous

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_clampFamily_mem
statement:
theorem height_clampFamily_mem {W : OpenInterval} (hW : Icc c.lo c.hi ⊆ (W : Set ℝ))
    (u : P.heightPreimage S J) (hu : P.height S u.1 ∈ W) (s : unitInterval) :
    P.height S (P.clampFamily c u s) ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  rw [height_clampFamily]
  exact W.ordConnected.uIcc_subset hu (hW (c.clampHeight_mem_Icc _)) (c.interp_mem_uIcc s.2 _)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.clampFamily_one_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem clampFamily_one_mem_Icc (u : P.heightPreimage S J) :
    P.height S (P.clampFamily c u 1) ∈ Icc c.lo c.hi
proof:
:= by
  rw [height_clampFamily_one]
  exact c.clampHeight_mem_Icc _

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.vertexFiberInclusion_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexFiberInclusion_apply (i : Fin (n + 1)) (v : P.V i) :
    (P.vertexFiberInclusion S i v : P.Realization S) = P.ofVertex S i v
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.regularFiberInclusion_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem regularFiberInclusion_apply (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (y : P.E e) :
    (P.regularFiberInclusion S e t y : P.Realization S) = P.ofStrip S e (y, t)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.vertexClamp_one_mem
statement:
theorem vertexClamp_one_mem (i : Fin (n + 1)) (u : P.heightPreimage S (S.J i)) :
    P.clampFamily (vertexClamp S i) u 1 ∈ P.height S ⁻¹' {S.value i}
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (P.clampFamily_one_mem_Icc (vertexClamp S i) u).2
    (P.clampFamily_one_mem_Icc (vertexClamp S i) u).1

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.regularClamp_one_mem
statement:
theorem regularClamp_one_mem (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (u : P.heightPreimage S (S.K e)) :
    P.clampFamily (regularClamp S e t) u 1 ∈ P.height S ⁻¹' {(t : ℝ)}
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (P.clampFamily_one_mem_Icc (regularClamp S e t) u).2
    (P.clampFamily_one_mem_Icc (regularClamp S e t) u).1

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.vertexRetraction_comp_inclusion
statement:
theorem vertexRetraction_comp_inclusion (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (P.vertexRetraction S i).comp (P.vertexFiberInclusion S i) = ContinuousMap.id _
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  change (P.criticalFiberHomeomorph S i).symm
    ⟨P.clampFamily (vertexClamp S i) (P.vertexFiberInclusion S i v) 1, _⟩ = v
  rw [Homeomorph.symm_apply_eq]
  exact Subtype.ext (P.clampFamily_of_mem (vertexClamp S i) _ ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩ 1)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.vertexInclusion_comp_retraction
statement:
theorem vertexInclusion_comp_retraction (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (P.vertexFiberInclusion S i).comp (P.vertexRetraction S i) =
      P.clampEnd (vertexClamp S i) (S.J i) (vertexClamp S i).Icc_subset le_rfl
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousMap.ext fun u => Subtype.ext ?_
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val ((P.criticalFiberHomeomorph S i).apply_symm_apply
    ⟨P.clampFamily (vertexClamp S i) u 1, P.vertexClamp_one_mem S i u⟩)
  exact h

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.regularRetraction_comp_inclusion
statement:
theorem regularRetraction_comp_inclusion (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    (P.regularRetraction S e t).comp (P.regularFiberInclusion S e t) = ContinuousMap.id _
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  change (P.regularFiberHomeomorph S e t).symm
    ⟨P.clampFamily (regularClamp S e t) (P.regularFiberInclusion S e t y) 1, _⟩ = y
  rw [Homeomorph.symm_apply_eq]
  exact Subtype.ext (P.clampFamily_of_mem (regularClamp S e t) _ ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩ 1)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.regularInclusion_comp_retraction
statement:
theorem regularInclusion_comp_retraction (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    (P.regularFiberInclusion S e t).comp (P.regularRetraction S e t) =
      P.clampEnd (regularClamp S e t) (S.K e) (regularClamp S e t).Icc_subset le_rfl
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousMap.ext fun u => Subtype.ext ?_
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val ((P.regularFiberHomeomorph S e t).apply_symm_apply
    ⟨P.clampFamily (regularClamp S e t) u 1, P.regularClamp_one_mem S e t u⟩)
  exact h

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.vertexComponentsEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem vertexComponentsEquiv_mk (i : Fin (n + 1)) (v : P.V i) :
    P.vertexComponentsEquiv S i (.mk v) = .mk (P.vertexFiberInclusion S i v)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.edgeComponentsEquiv_mk
statement:
theorem edgeComponentsEquiv_mk (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (y : P.E e) :
    P.edgeComponentsEquiv S e t (.mk y) = .mk (P.regularFiberInclusion S e t y)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.intervalComponents_map_bijective
statement:
theorem intervalComponents_map_bijective {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty) (hhit : ∀ i, S.value i ∈ I ↔ S.value i ∈ J) :
    Function.Bijective ((intervalComponents (P.height S)).map (homOfLE hIJ))
proof:
:= by
  have h : ⇑((intervalComponents (P.height S)).map (homOfLE hIJ)) =
      componentEquivOfHomotopyEquiv (P.nestedHomotopyEquiv S hIJ hI hhit) := by
    funext c
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x => rfl
  rw [h]
  exact Equiv.bijective _

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isEmpty_intervalComponents_lowerTail
statement:
theorem isEmpty_intervalComponents_lowerTail :
    IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (P.height S)).obj S.lowerTail)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun c => by
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      have hx : x.1 ∈ P.height S ⁻¹' (S.lowerTail : Set ℝ) := x.2
      rw [P.height_preimage_lowerTail S] at hx
      exact hx⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isEmpty_intervalComponents_upperTail
statement:
theorem isEmpty_intervalComponents_upperTail :
    IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (P.height S)).obj S.upperTail)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun c => by
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      have hx : x.1 ∈ P.height S ⁻¹' (S.upperTail : Set ℝ) := x.2
      rw [P.height_preimage_upperTail S] at hx
      exact hx⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.finite_intervalComponents
statement:
theorem finite_intervalComponents [∀ i, Finite (ZerothHomotopy (P.V i))]
    [∀ e, Finite (ZerothHomotopy (P.E e))] (I : OpenInterval) :
    Finite ((intervalComponents (P.height S)).obj I)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hne : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty
  swap
  · have : IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (P.height S)).obj I) :=
      ⟨fun c => by
        induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
        | mk x => exact hne ⟨_, x.2⟩⟩
    infer_instance
  let vI : ∀ k : {k : Fin (n + 1) // S.value k ∈ I}, C(P.V k.1, P.heightPreimage S I) :=
    fun k =>
      ⟨fun v => ⟨P.ofVertex S k.1 v, k.2⟩, (P.continuous_ofVertex S k.1).subtype_mk _⟩
  let eI : ∀ e : {e : Fin n // I ≤ S.K e}, C(P.E e.1, P.heightPreimage S I) := fun e =>
    ⟨fun y => ⟨P.ofStrip S e.1 (y, ⟨hne.some, e.2 hne.some_mem⟩), hne.some_mem⟩,
      ((P.continuous_ofStrip S e.1).comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).subtype_mk _⟩
  let Φ : (Σ k : {k : Fin (n + 1) // S.value k ∈ I}, ZerothHomotopy (P.V k.1)) ⊕
      (Σ e : {e : Fin n // I ≤ S.K e}, ZerothHomotopy (P.E e.1)) →
        (intervalComponents (P.height S)).obj I :=
    Sum.elim (fun p => componentMap (vI p.1) p.2) fun p => componentMap (eI p.1) p.2
  refine Finite.of_surjective Φ fun c => ?_
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk u =>
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := u
    rcases P.exists_rep S q with ⟨k, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, ⟨y, t⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨.inl ⟨⟨k, hq⟩, .mk v⟩, rfl⟩
    · have htI : (t : ℝ) ∈ (I : Set ℝ) := hq
      by_cases ha : S.value e.castSucc ∈ I
      · refine ⟨.inl ⟨⟨e.castSucc, ha⟩, .mk (P.left e y)⟩, mk_eq_of_joinedIn ?_⟩
        have h := P.joinedIn_cylinder S e y (segBot S e) (gapIncl S e t)
        rw [ofCylinder_segBot] at h
        exact h.mono (preimage_mono (I.ordConnected.uIcc_subset ha htI))
      by_cases hb : S.value e.succ ∈ I
      · refine ⟨.inl ⟨⟨e.succ, hb⟩, .mk (P.right e y)⟩, mk_eq_of_joinedIn ?_⟩
        have h := P.joinedIn_cylinder S e y (segTop S e) (gapIncl S e t)
        rw [ofCylinder_segTop] at h
        exact h.mono (preimage_mono (I.ordConnected.uIcc_subset hb htI))
      have hIK : I ≤ S.K e := fun z hz => by
        refine ⟨lt_of_not_ge fun h => ha ?_, lt_of_not_ge fun h => hb ?_⟩
        · exact I.ordConnected.out hz htI ⟨h, t.2.1.le⟩
        · exact I.ordConnected.out htI hz ⟨t.2.2.le, h⟩
      refine ⟨.inr ⟨⟨e, hIK⟩, .mk y⟩, mk_eq_of_joinedIn ?_⟩
      exact (P.joinedIn_cylinder S e y (gapIncl S e ⟨hne.some, hIK hne.some_mem⟩)
        (gapIncl S e t)).mono (preimage_mono (I.ordConnected.uIcc_subset hne.some_mem htI))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.intervalComponents_isConstructibleAt
statement:
theorem intervalComponents_isConstructibleAt [∀ i, Finite (ZerothHomotopy (P.V i))]
    [∀ e, Finite (ZerothHomotopy (P.E e))] :
    S.IsConstructibleAt (intervalComponents (P.height S)) where
  finite
proof:
:= P.finite_intervalComponents S
  bijective _ _ h hI hhit := P.intervalComponents_map_bijective S h hI hhit
  isEmpty_lowerTail := P.isEmpty_intervalComponents_lowerTail S
  isEmpty_upperTail := P.isEmpty_intervalComponents_upperTail S

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isConstructibleAt_of_compact_lpc
statement:
theorem isConstructibleAt_of_compact_lpc [∀ i, CompactSpace (P.V i)]
    [∀ i, LocallyPathConnectedSpace (P.V i)] [∀ e, CompactSpace (P.E e)]
    [∀ e, LocallyPathConnectedSpace (P.E e)] :
    S.IsConstructibleAt (intervalComponents (P.height S))
proof:
:=
  P.intervalComponents_isConstructibleAt S

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.finiteData_isConstructibleAt
statement:
theorem finiteData_isConstructibleAt (D : FiniteReebData.{u} n) :
    S.IsConstructibleAt (intervalComponents ((ofFiniteData D).height S))
proof:
:=
  (ofFiniteData D).intervalComponents_isConstructibleAt S

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.map_K_le_J_castSucc_edgeComponentsEquiv
statement:
theorem map_K_le_J_castSucc_edgeComponentsEquiv (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (c : ZerothHomotopy (P.E e)) :
    (intervalComponents (P.height S)).map (homOfLE (S.K_le_J_castSucc e))
        (P.edgeComponentsEquiv S e t c) =
      P.vertexComponentsEquiv S e.castSucc (componentMap (P.left e) c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk y =>
    refine mk_eq_of_joinedIn (W := S.J e.castSucc) ?_
    have h := P.joinedIn_cylinder S e y (gapIncl S e t) (segBot S e)
    rw [ofCylinder_segBot] at h
    exact h.mono (preimage_mono ((S.J e.castSucc).ordConnected.uIcc_subset
      (S.K_le_J_castSucc e t.2) (S.value_mem_J _)))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.map_K_le_J_succ_edgeComponentsEquiv
statement:
theorem map_K_le_J_succ_edgeComponentsEquiv (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (c : ZerothHomotopy (P.E e)) :
    (intervalComponents (P.height S)).map (homOfLE (S.K_le_J_succ e))
        (P.edgeComponentsEquiv S e t c) =
      P.vertexComponentsEquiv S e.succ (componentMap (P.right e) c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk y =>
    refine mk_eq_of_joinedIn (W := S.J e.succ) ?_
    have h := P.joinedIn_cylinder S e y (gapIncl S e t) (segTop S e)
    rw [ofCylinder_segTop] at h
    exact h.mono (preimage_mono ((S.J e.succ).ordConnected.uIcc_subset
      (S.K_le_J_succ e t.2) (S.value_mem_J _)))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.vertexComponentsEquiv_symm_map_castSucc
statement:
theorem vertexComponentsEquiv_symm_map_castSucc (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (c : ZerothHomotopy (P.E e)) :
    (P.vertexComponentsEquiv S e.castSucc).symm
        ((intervalComponents (P.height S)).map (homOfLE (S.K_le_J_castSucc e))
          (P.edgeComponentsEquiv S e t c)) = componentMap (P.left e) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
  exact P.map_K_le_J_castSucc_edgeComponentsEquiv S e t c

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.vertexComponentsEquiv_symm_map_succ
statement:
theorem vertexComponentsEquiv_symm_map_succ (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (c : ZerothHomotopy (P.E e)) :
    (P.vertexComponentsEquiv S e.succ).symm
        ((intervalComponents (P.height S)).map (homOfLE (S.K_le_J_succ e))
          (P.edgeComponentsEquiv S e t c)) = componentMap (P.right e) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
  exact P.map_K_le_J_succ_edgeComponentsEquiv S e t c

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.map_ofVertex_eq
statement:
theorem map_ofVertex_eq (i : Fin (n + 1)) (v : P.V i) :
    φ (P.ofVertex S i v) = P'.ofVertex S i (vertexFiberMap S φ hφ i v)
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((P'.criticalFiberHomeomorph S i).apply_symm_apply ⟨φ (P.ofVertex S i v), hφ _⟩)
  rw [criticalFiberHomeomorph_apply] at this
  exact this.symm

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.map_ofStrip_eq
statement:
theorem map_ofStrip_eq (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (y : P.E e) :
    φ (P.ofStrip S e (y, t)) = P'.ofStrip S e (regularFiberMap S φ hφ e t y, t)
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg Subtype.val
    ((P'.regularFiberHomeomorph S e t).apply_symm_apply ⟨φ (P.ofStrip S e (y, t)), hφ _⟩)
  rw [regularFiberHomeomorph_apply] at this
  exact this.symm

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.vertexFiberInclusion_naturality
statement:
theorem vertexFiberInclusion_naturality (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (preimageRestrict φ hφ (OpenInterval.toOpens (S.J i))).comp (P.vertexFiberInclusion S i) =
      (P'.vertexFiberInclusion S i).comp (vertexFiberMap S φ hφ i)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  exact map_ofVertex_eq S φ hφ i v

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.regularFiberInclusion_naturality
statement:
theorem regularFiberInclusion_naturality (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    (preimageRestrict φ hφ (OpenInterval.toOpens (S.K e))).comp (P.regularFiberInclusion S e t) =
      (P'.regularFiberInclusion S e t).comp (regularFiberMap S φ hφ e t)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  exact map_ofStrip_eq S φ hφ e t y

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.componentNatTrans_vertexComponentsEquiv
statement:
theorem componentNatTrans_vertexComponentsEquiv (i : Fin (n + 1)) (c : ZerothHomotopy (P.V i)) :

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.edgeComponentsEquiv_indep
statement:
theorem edgeComponentsEquiv_indep (P : CylinderPresentation.{u} n) (e : Fin n)
    (t t' : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) : P.edgeComponentsEquiv S e t = P.edgeComponentsEquiv S e t'
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk y =>
    refine mk_eq_of_joinedIn (W := S.K e) ?_
    exact (P.joinedIn_cylinder S e y (gapIncl S e t) (gapIncl S e t')).mono
      (preimage_mono ((S.K e).ordConnected.uIcc_subset t.2 t'.2))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.componentMap_regularFiberMap_indep
statement:
theorem componentMap_regularFiberMap_indep {P P' : CylinderPresentation.{u} n}
    (φ : C(P.Realization S, P'.Realization S)) (hφ : ∀ x, P'.height S (φ x) = P.height S x)
    (e : Fin n) (t t' : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    componentMap (regularFiberMap S φ hφ e t) = componentMap (regularFiberMap S φ hφ e t')
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  apply (P'.edgeComponentsEquiv S e t).injective
  rw [← componentNatTrans_edgeComponentsEquiv, P'.edgeComponentsEquiv_indep S e t t',
    ← componentNatTrans_edgeComponentsEquiv, P.edgeComponentsEquiv_indep S e t t']

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.regularFiberMap_indep_of_discrete
statement:
theorem regularFiberMap_indep_of_discrete {P P' : CylinderPresentation.{u} n}
    (φ : C(P.Realization S, P'.Realization S)) (hφ : ∀ x, P'.height S (φ x) = P.height S x)
    (e : Fin n) [DiscreteTopology (P'.E e)] (t t' : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    regularFiberMap S φ hφ e t = regularFiberMap S φ hφ e t'
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  have h := congrFun (componentMap_regularFiberMap_indep S φ hφ e t t') (.mk y)
  simp only [componentMap_mk] at h
  exact joined_eq_of_discrete (Quotient.exact h)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.regularFiberMap_realizeHom
statement:
theorem regularFiberMap_realizeHom {D D' : FiniteReebData.{u} n} (ψ : D.Hom D') (e : Fin n)
    (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (y : (ofFiniteData D).E e) :
    regularFiberMap S (realizeHom S ψ) (height_realizeHom S ψ) e t y = ψ.e e y
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_ofStrip_eq S (realizeHom S ψ) (height_realizeHom S ψ) e t y
  have h' : ((ofFiniteData D').ofStrip S e
      (regularFiberMap S (realizeHom S ψ) (height_realizeHom S ψ) e t y, t)) =
      (ofFiniteData D').ofStrip S e (ψ.e e y, t) := h.symm.trans rfl
  exact congrArg Prod.fst ((ofFiniteData D').ofStrip_injective S e h')

theorem natCard_quotient (I : OpenInterval) :
    Nat.card ((intervalComponents (ReebQuotient.height (P.height S))).obj I) =
      Nat.card ((intervalComponents (P.height S)).obj I)
proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleComparison.quotient_map_injective_iff
statement:
theorem quotient_map_injective_iff {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    Function.Injective
        ((intervalComponents (ReebQuotient.height (P.height S))).map (homOfLE hIJ)) ↔
      Function.Injective ((intervalComponents (P.height S)).map (homOfLE hIJ))
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ x, (intervalComponents (ReebQuotient.height (P.height S))).map (homOfLE hIJ)
      ((ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison (P.height S)).app I x) =
      (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison (P.height S)).app J
        ((intervalComponents (P.height S)).map (homOfLE hIJ) x) := fun x =>
    (NatTrans.naturality_apply (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison (P.height S))
      (homOfLE hIJ) x).symm
  have hI := P.bijective_intervalComponentComparison_app S I
  have hJ := P.bijective_intervalComponentComparison_app S J
  constructor
  · intro h x y hxy
    exact hI.1 (h (by rw [key, key, hxy]))
  · intro h x y hxy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hI.2 x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hI.2 y
    rw [key, key] at hxy
    exact congrArg _ (h (hJ.1 hxy))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleComparison.S012_J0_mem_iff
statement: theorem S012_J0_mem_iff (x : ℝ) : x ∈ S012.J 0 ↔ x < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [S012.mem_J_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa [S012] using h.2 1 rfl
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun k hk => by simp at hk, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    obtain rfl : k = 1 := Fin.ext (by simpa using hk.symm)
    simpa [S012] using h

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleComparison.S012_J2_mem_iff

proof:

  rw [S012.mem_J_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa [S012] using h.1 1 rfl
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun k hk => ?_, fun k hk => by have := k.isLt; simp at hk; omega⟩
    obtain rfl : k = 1 := Fin.ext (by simpa using hk)
    simpa [S012] using h
