        (parallelI.edgeComponentsEquiv S01 0 half (ZerothHomotopy.mk (b, s))) =
      parallelI.edgeComponentsEquiv S01 0 half (ZerothHomotopy.mk (!b, s))
proof:
:= by
  rw [componentNatTrans_edgeComponentsEquiv]
  congr 1
  show ZerothHomotopy.mk (regularFiberMap S01 twist height_twist 0 half (b, s)) = _
  rw [twist_regularFiberMap]
  exact (thicken_edgeClass_eq_iff parallelData 0 _ _ _ _).2 rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleComparison.twist_quotient_gap
statement:
theorem twist_quotient_gap (b : Bool) (s : unitInterval) :
    (componentNatTrans (ReebQuotient.map twist height_twist)
        (ReebQuotient.height_map_apply twist height_twist)).app (OpenInterval.toOpens (S01.K 0))
        ((ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison (parallelI.height S01)).app (S01.K 0)
          (parallelI.edgeComponentsEquiv S01 0 half (ZerothHomotopy.mk (b, s)))) =
      (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison (parallelI.height S01)).app (S01.K 0)
        (parallelI.edgeComponentsEquiv S01 0 half (ZerothHomotopy.mk (!b, s)))
proof:
:=
  congrArg ((ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison (parallelI.height S01)).app (S01.K 0))
    (twist_source_gap b s)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleComparison.twist_constructible_natural
statement:
theorem twist_constructible_natural :
    intervalComponentsOver.map twistHom.hom ≫
        constructibleComponentComparisonIso.hom.app parallelIObj =
      constructibleComponentComparisonIso.hom.app parallelIObj ≫
        intervalComponentsOver.map
          ((ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ).map twistHom.hom)
proof:
:=
  constructibleComponentComparison_naturality twistHom

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.continuous_dartHeight
statement: theorem continuous_dartHeight (d : G.Dart) : Continuous (dartHeight h d)
proof:
:= by
  unfold dartHeight
  fun_prop

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartHeight_symm
statement:
theorem dartHeight_symm (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    dartHeight h d.symm (σ t) = dartHeight h d t
proof:
:= by
  show (1 - (σ t : ℝ)) * h d.snd + (σ t : ℝ) * h d.fst =
    (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd
  rw [unitInterval.coe_symm_eq]
  ring

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartHeight_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem dartHeight_zero (d : G.Dart) : dartHeight h d 0 = h d.fst
proof:
:= by
  simp [dartHeight]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartHeight_one
statement: @[simp] theorem dartHeight_one (d : G.Dart) : dartHeight h d 1 = h d.snd
proof:
:= by
  simp [dartHeight]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartHeight_of_eq
statement:
theorem dartHeight_of_eq {d : G.Dart} (hd : h d.fst = h d.snd) (t : unitInterval) :
    dartHeight h d t = h d.fst
proof:
:= by
  rw [dartHeight, ← hd]
  ring

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartHeight_injective
statement:
theorem dartHeight_injective {d : G.Dart} (hne : h d.fst ≠ h d.snd) :
    Function.Injective (dartHeight h d)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t hst
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne.symm)
  unfold dartHeight at hst
  linear_combination hst

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.ordConnected_preimage_lineHeight
statement:
theorem ordConnected_preimage_lineHeight (d : G.Dart) {s : Set ℝ} (hs : s.OrdConnected) :
    ((fun r : ℝ => (1 - r) * h d.fst + r * h d.snd) ⁻¹' s).OrdConnected
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hab | hab
  · refine hs.preimage_mono fun r r' hrr' => ?_
    show (1 - r) * h d.fst + r * h d.snd ≤ (1 - r') * h d.fst + r' * h d.snd
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hrr') (sub_nonneg.2 hab)]
  · refine hs.preimage_anti fun r r' hrr' => ?_
    show (1 - r') * h d.fst + r' * h d.snd ≤ (1 - r) * h d.fst + r * h d.snd
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hrr') (sub_nonneg.2 hab)]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight_vertex
statement: @[simp] theorem plHeight_vertex (v : V) : plHeight G h (vertex G v) = h v
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight_edgePoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem plHeight_edgePoint (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    plHeight G h (edgePoint G d t) = dartHeight h d t
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight_edgeSegment_bounds
statement:
theorem plHeight_edgeSegment_bounds (d : G.Dart) (s t r : unitInterval) :
    min (plHeight G h (edgePoint G d s)) (plHeight G h (edgePoint G d t)) ≤
        plHeight G h (edgeSegment G d s t r) ∧
      plHeight G h (edgeSegment G d s t r) ≤
        max (plHeight G h (edgePoint G d s)) (plHeight G h (edgePoint G d t))
proof:
:= by
  have hformula :
      plHeight G h (edgeSegment G d s t r) =
        (1 - (r : ℝ)) * plHeight G h (edgePoint G d s) +
          (r : ℝ) * plHeight G h (edgePoint G d t) := by
    simp only [edgeSegment_apply, plHeight_edgePoint, dartHeight, Set.Icc.coe_convexComb]
    ring
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ (r : ℝ) := r.2.1
  have hr1 : (r : ℝ) ≤ 1 := r.2.2
  have h1r0 : 0 ≤ 1 - (r : ℝ) := by linarith
  let a := plHeight G h (edgePoint G d s)
  let b := plHeight G h (edgePoint G d t)
  change min a b ≤ plHeight G h (edgeSegment G d s t r) ∧
    plHeight G h (edgeSegment G d s t r) ≤ max a b
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
  · rw [min_eq_left hab, max_eq_right hab]
    constructor
    · rw [hformula]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)]
    · rw [hformula]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1r0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hab)]
  · rw [min_eq_right hba, max_eq_left hba]
    constructor
    · rw [hformula]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1r0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hba)]
    · rw [hformula]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hba)]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight_unique
statement:
theorem plHeight_unique (g : C(Realization G, ℝ)) (hv : ∀ v, g (vertex G v) = h v)
    (he : ∀ d t, g (edgePoint G d t) = dartHeight h d t) : g = plHeight G h
proof:
:=
  continuousLift_unique G _ _ _ _ g hv he

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight_add_const
statement:
theorem plHeight_add_const (c : ℝ) :
    plHeight G (fun v => h v + c) = plHeight G h + ContinuousMap.const (Realization G) c
proof:
:=
  (plHeight_unique G _ _ (fun v => by simp) fun d t => by
    simp only [ContinuousMap.add_apply, plHeight_edgePoint, ContinuousMap.const_apply,
      dartHeight]
    ring).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight_add_const_apply
statement:
theorem plHeight_add_const_apply (c : ℝ) (x : Realization G) :
    plHeight G (fun v => h v + c) x = plHeight G h x + c
proof:
:= by
  rw [plHeight_add_const]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.coe_dartEdge
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_dartEdge (d : G.Dart) : (dartEdge d : Sym2 V) = d.edge
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartEdge_symm
statement: @[simp] theorem dartEdge_symm (d : G.Dart) : dartEdge d.symm = dartEdge d
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext d.edge_symm

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.dartEdge_eq_iff
statement:
theorem dartEdge_eq_iff {d₁ d₂ : G.Dart} :
    dartEdge d₁ = dartEdge d₂ ↔ d₁ = d₂ ∨ d₁ = d₂.symm
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext_iff.trans (dart_edge_eq_iff d₁ d₂)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.mem_dartEdge
statement:
theorem mem_dartEdge {d : G.Dart} {v : V} :
    v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V) ↔ v = d.fst ∨ v = d.snd
proof:
:=
  Sym2.mem_iff

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.fst_mem_dartEdge
statement: theorem fst_mem_dartEdge (d : G.Dart) : d.fst ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V)
proof: := Sym2.mem_mk_left _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.snd_mem_dartEdge
statement: theorem snd_mem_dartEdge (d : G.Dart) : d.snd ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V)
proof: := Sym2.mem_mk_right _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.exists_dartEdge_eq
statement: theorem exists_dartEdge_eq (e : G.edgeSet) : ∃ d : G.Dart, dartEdge d = e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := e
  induction e using Sym2.ind with
  | h a b => exact ⟨⟨(a, b), he⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.exists_dartEdge_eq_fst
statement:
theorem exists_dartEdge_eq_fst {e : G.edgeSet} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ (e : Sym2 V)) :
    ∃ d : G.Dart, dartEdge d = e ∧ d.fst = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := e
  induction e using Sym2.ind with
  | h a b =>
    rcases Sym2.mem_iff.1 hv with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨⟨(v, b), he⟩, rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨(v, a), (G.mem_edgeSet.1 he).symm⟩, Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.exists_interior_of_mem
statement:
theorem exists_interior_of_mem {d : G.Dart} {t : unitInterval} (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ I) :
    ∃ s : unitInterval, 0 < (s : ℝ) ∧ (s : ℝ) < 1 ∧ dartHeight h d s ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Continuous fun r : ℝ => (1 - r) * h d.fst + r * h d.snd := by fun_prop
  have hmem : (t : ℝ) ∈ closure (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    rw [closure_Ioo zero_ne_one]
    exact t.2
  obtain ⟨r, hrI, hr⟩ := mem_closure_iff_nhds.1 hmem _
    (hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (I.isOpen.mem_nhds ht))
  exact ⟨⟨r, Ioo_subset_Icc_self hr⟩, hr.1, hr.2, hrI⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.EdgeActive.mono
statement:
theorem EdgeActive.mono (hIJ : I ≤ J) {e : G.edgeSet} (he : EdgeActive G h I e) :
    EdgeActive G h J e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, t, ht₀, ht₁, ht⟩ := he
  exact ⟨d, hd, t, ht₀, ht₁, OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 hIJ ht⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edgeActive_dartEdge_iff
statement:
theorem edgeActive_dartEdge_iff (d : G.Dart) :
    EdgeActive G h I (dartEdge d) ↔
      ∃ t : unitInterval, 0 < (t : ℝ) ∧ (t : ℝ) < 1 ∧ dartHeight h d t ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d', hd', t, ht₀, ht₁, ht⟩
    rcases dartEdge_eq_iff.1 hd' with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨t, ht₀, ht₁, ht⟩
    · refine ⟨σ t, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [unitInterval.coe_symm_eq]; linarith
      · rw [unitInterval.coe_symm_eq]; linarith
      · have hrev := dartHeight_symm h d.symm t
        rw [Dart.symm_symm] at hrev
        rwa [hrev]
  · rintro ⟨t, ht₀, ht₁, ht⟩
    exact ⟨d, rfl, t, ht₀, ht₁, ht⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edgeActive_dartEdge_iff_nonempty
statement:
theorem edgeActive_dartEdge_iff_nonempty (d : G.Dart) :
    EdgeActive G h I (dartEdge d) ↔ Nonempty {t : unitInterval // dartHeight h d t ∈ I}
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeActive_dartEdge_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, -, -, ht⟩
    exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    exact exists_interior_of_mem ht

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem
statement:
theorem edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem {d : G.Dart} {t : unitInterval} (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ I) :
    EdgeActive G h I (dartEdge d)
proof:
:=
  (edgeActive_dartEdge_iff_nonempty d).2 ⟨⟨t, ht⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.EdgeActive.exists_mem
proof:
:= by
  subst hd
  exact (edgeActive_dartEdge_iff d).1 he

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edgeActive_of_mem
statement:
theorem edgeActive_of_mem {e : G.edgeSet} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ (e : Sym2 V)) (hI : h v ∈ I) :
    EdgeActive G h I e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq_fst hv
  exact edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem (t := 0) (by rwa [dartHeight_zero])

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edgeActive_dartEdge_iff_of_eq
statement:
theorem edgeActive_dartEdge_iff_of_eq {d : G.Dart} (hd : h d.fst = h d.snd) :
    EdgeActive G h I (dartEdge d) ↔ h d.fst ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeActive_dartEdge_iff_nonempty]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    rwa [dartHeight_of_eq h hd] at ht
  · intro hI
    exact ⟨⟨0, by rwa [dartHeight_zero]⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.joinedIn_edgePoint
statement:
theorem joinedIn_edgePoint (d : G.Dart) {s t : unitInterval} (hs : dartHeight h d s ∈ I)
    (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ I) :
    JoinedIn (plHeight G h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ)) (edgePoint G d s) (edgePoint G d t)
proof:
:= by
  have hF : Convex ℝ
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ (fun r : ℝ => (1 - r) * h d.fst + r * h d.snd) ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ)) :=
    (convex_Icc 0 1).inter
      (convex_iff_ordConnected.2 (ordConnected_preimage_lineHeight h d I.ordConnected))
  have hJ := (hF.isPathConnected ⟨s, s.2, hs⟩).joinedIn (s : ℝ) ⟨s.2, hs⟩ (t : ℝ) ⟨t.2, ht⟩
  have hc : Continuous fun r : ℝ => edgePoint G d (projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one r) :=
    (continuous_edgePoint G d).comp continuous_projIcc
  have hsub : (fun r : ℝ => edgePoint G d (projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one r)) ''
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ (fun r : ℝ => (1 - r) * h d.fst + r * h d.snd) ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ)) ⊆
        plHeight G h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ) := by
    rintro _ ⟨r, ⟨hr, hrI⟩, rfl⟩
    show dartHeight h d (projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one r) ∈ I
    rw [projIcc_of_mem _ hr]
    exact hrI
  simpa only [projIcc_val] using (hJ.map hc).mono hsub

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.heightRange_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem heightRange_subset_Icc (A : RGraphCat) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, heightRange A ⊆ Icc a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, T, D, ⟨e⟩⟩ := A.property
  refine ⟨T.value 0, T.value (Fin.last m), ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [← overBaseMap_comm e.hom x]
  exact (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData D).height_mem_Icc T (e.hom.left.hom x)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.bddAbove_heightRange
statement: theorem bddAbove_heightRange (A : RGraphCat) : BddAbove (heightRange A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, h⟩ := heightRange_subset_Icc A
  exact ⟨b, fun _ hx => (h hx).2⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.bddBelow_heightRange
statement: theorem bddBelow_heightRange (A : RGraphCat) : BddBelow (heightRange A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, h⟩ := heightRange_subset_Icc A
  exact ⟨a, fun _ hx => (h hx).1⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.heightRange_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem heightRange_eq_of_iso {A B : RGraphCat} (e : A ≅ B) :
    heightRange A = heightRange B
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e.hom.hom.left.hom x, overBaseMap_comm e.hom.hom x⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e.inv.hom.left.hom x, overBaseMap_comm e.inv.hom x⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.heightRange_nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem heightRange_nonempty_iff {A : RGraphCat} :
    (heightRange A).Nonempty ↔ Nonempty A.obj.left
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩
    exact ⟨x⟩
  · rintro ⟨x⟩
    exact ⟨overBaseMap A.obj x, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.heightRange_geometricSmoothing
statement:
theorem heightRange_geometricSmoothing (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : RGraphCat) :
    heightRange ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A) =
      heightRange A + Icc (-(ε : ℝ)) ε
proof:
:= by
  unfold heightRange
  rw [geometricSmoothing_obj_obj]
  ext q
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨⟨x, t⟩, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _ q
    show overBaseMap A.obj x + (t : ℝ) ∈ _
    exact Set.add_mem_add ⟨x, rfl⟩ t.2
  · intro hq
    obtain ⟨x, hx, t, ht, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_add.1 hq
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ (x, ⟨t, ht⟩), ?_⟩
    rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.exists_heightRange_near_of_hom
proof:
:= by
  have hx : overBaseMap A.obj x ∈ heightRange ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B) :=
    ⟨φ.hom.left.hom x, overBaseMap_comm φ.hom x⟩
  rw [heightRange_geometricSmoothing] at hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, t, ht, hyt⟩ := Set.mem_add.1 hx
  refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
  rw [← hyt, add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact abs_le.2 ht

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le
statement:
theorem hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) :
    Metric.hausdorffEDist (heightRange A) (heightRange B) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.hausdorffEDist_le_of_mem_edist
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := exists_heightRange_near_of_hom i.φ x
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
    simpa only [edist_dist, Real.dist_eq, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal] using
      ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hxy
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hz
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := exists_heightRange_near_of_hom i.ψ x
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
    simpa only [edist_dist, Real.dist_eq, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal] using
      ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hxy

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le_geometricInterleavingDistance
statement:
theorem hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le_geometricInterleavingDistance (A B : RGraphCat) :
    Metric.hausdorffEDist (heightRange A) (heightRange B) ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance A B
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_geometricInterleavingDistance_iff]
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := hε
  exact i.hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_top_of_isEmpty_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_top_of_isEmpty_of_nonempty
    {A B : RGraphCat} (hA : IsEmpty A.obj.left) (hB : Nonempty B.obj.left) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A B = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hRA : heightRange A = ∅ := by
    apply Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp
    intro h
    exact (not_nonempty_iff.mpr hA) (heightRange_nonempty_iff.mp h)
  have hRB : (heightRange B).Nonempty := heightRange_nonempty_iff.mpr hB
  have hzero : Metric.hausdorffEDist (heightRange A) (heightRange B) = ⊤ := by
    rw [hRA, Metric.hausdorffEDist_comm, Metric.hausdorffEDist_empty hRB]
  have hle := hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le_geometricInterleavingDistance A B
  rw [hzero] at hle
  exact top_unique hle

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_of_isEmpty
proof:
:=
  geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_of_iso <| ObjectProperty.isoMk _ <|
    Over.isoMk (TopCat.isoOfHomeo Homeomorph.empty) (by ext x; exact hA.elim x)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.ofReal_abs_sSup_sub_le_hausdorffEDist
statement:
theorem ofReal_abs_sSup_sub_le_hausdorffEDist {s t : Set ℝ} (hs : s.Nonempty) (ht : t.Nonempty)
    (hs' : BddAbove s) (ht' : BddAbove t) :
    ENNReal.ofReal |sSup s - sSup t| ≤ Metric.hausdorffEDist s t
proof:
:= by
  have directional : ∀ (u v : Set ℝ), u.Nonempty → v.Nonempty → BddAbove u → BddAbove v →
      ENNReal.ofReal (sSup u - sSup v) ≤ Metric.hausdorffEDist u v := by
    intro u v hu hv hu' hv'
    refine ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add ?_
    intro δ hδ hH
    have hδ' : (0 : ℝ) < δ := by exact_mod_cast hδ
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxs⟩ := exists_lt_of_lt_csSup hu (sub_lt_self _ hδ')
    have hpoint : ENNReal.ofReal (x - sSup v) ≤ Metric.infEDist x v := by
      apply (Metric.le_infEDist).2
      intro y hy
      rw [edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
      exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        ((sub_le_sub_left (le_csSup hv' hy) x).trans (le_abs_self _))
    have hpoint' : ENNReal.ofReal (x - sSup v) ≤ Metric.hausdorffEDist u v :=
      hpoint.trans (Metric.infEDist_le_hausdorffEDist_of_mem hx)
    have hsup : sSup u - sSup v ≤ (x - sSup v) + (δ : ℝ) := by
      linarith
    calc
      ENNReal.ofReal (sSup u - sSup v) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((x - sSup v) + (δ : ℝ)) :=
        ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hsup
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (x - sSup v) + ENNReal.ofReal (δ : ℝ) :=
        ENNReal.ofReal_add_le
      _ ≤ Metric.hausdorffEDist u v + δ := by
        simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, add_comm] using
          add_le_add_right hpoint' (δ : ℝ≥0∞)
  have hst := directional s t hs ht hs' ht'
  have hts := directional t s ht hs ht' hs'
  have hts' : ENNReal.ofReal (sSup t - sSup s) ≤ Metric.hausdorffEDist s t := by
    simpa only [Metric.hausdorffEDist_comm] using hts
  rcases le_total 0 (sSup s - sSup t) with h | h
  · simpa only [abs_of_nonneg h] using hst
  · simpa only [abs_of_nonpos h, neg_sub] using hts'

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.ofReal_abs_sInf_sub_le_hausdorffEDist
statement:
theorem ofReal_abs_sInf_sub_le_hausdorffEDist {s t : Set ℝ} (hs : s.Nonempty) (ht : t.Nonempty)
    (hs' : BddBelow s) (ht' : BddBelow t) :
    ENNReal.ofReal |sInf s - sInf t| ≤ Metric.hausdorffEDist s t
proof:
:= by
  have h := ofReal_abs_sSup_sub_le_hausdorffEDist (s := -s) (t := -t) hs.neg ht.neg
    (bddAbove_neg.2 hs') (bddAbove_neg.2 ht')
  have hH : Metric.hausdorffEDist (-s) (-t) = Metric.hausdorffEDist s t := by
    rw [← Set.image_neg_eq_neg, ← Set.image_neg_eq_neg]
    exact Metric.hausdorffEDist_image
      (Isometry.of_dist_eq fun x y => by
        rw [Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, neg_sub_neg, abs_sub_comm])
  have habs : |sInf s - sInf t| = |sSup (-s) - sSup (-t)| := by
    rw [Real.sInf_def, Real.sInf_def, ← abs_neg]
    congr 1
    ring
  rwa [habs, ← hH]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_self
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_self (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : RGraphCat)
    [Nonempty A.obj.left] :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A) = ε
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact geometricInterleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_self_le ε A
  · have hs : (heightRange A).Nonempty := heightRange_nonempty_iff.mpr inferInstance
    have ht : (heightRange A + Icc (-(ε : ℝ)) ε).Nonempty :=
      hs.add (nonempty_Icc.mpr (GeometricThickening.neg_le_band ε))
    have hs' := bddAbove_heightRange A
    have ht' : BddAbove (heightRange A + Icc (-(ε : ℝ)) ε) :=
      hs'.add ⟨ε, fun _ hx => hx.2⟩
    have hsup : sSup (heightRange A + Icc (-(ε : ℝ)) ε) =
        sSup (heightRange A) + (ε : ℝ) := by
      rw [csSup_add hs hs' (nonempty_Icc.mpr (GeometricThickening.neg_le_band ε))
        ⟨ε, fun _ hx => hx.2⟩, csSup_Icc (GeometricThickening.neg_le_band ε)]
    have hbound := ofReal_abs_sSup_sub_le_hausdorffEDist hs ht hs' ht'
    rw [hsup] at hbound
    rw [abs_sub_comm, add_sub_cancel_left, abs_of_nonneg ε.coe_nonneg] at hbound
    have hd := hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le_geometricInterleavingDistance A
      ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A)
    rw [heightRange_geometricSmoothing] at hd
    simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal] using
      hbound.trans hd

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_top_of_isEmpty_equiv
proof:
:= by

  intro ε

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.ofEReal_lower_upper
statement: theorem ofEReal_lower_upper (I : OpenInterval) : ofEReal I.lower I.upper = I
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_ofEReal, lower, upper]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hl, hu⟩
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hyx⟩ := sInf_lt_iff.1 hl
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩, hxz⟩ := lt_sSup_iff.1 hu
    exact I.ordConnected.out hy hz
      ⟨(EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.1 hyx).le, (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.1 hxz).le⟩
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 I.isOpen x hx
    have h₁ : x - δ / 2 ∈ (I : Set ℝ) := hball (by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith)
    have h₂ : x + δ / 2 ∈ (I : Set ℝ) := hball (by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, abs_lt]; constructor <;> linarith)
    refine ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt (sInf_le ⟨_, h₁, rfl⟩) ?_, lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (le_sSup ⟨_, h₂, rfl⟩)⟩
    · exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.2 (by linarith)
    · exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.2 (by linarith)

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.mem_thickenSet
statement:
theorem mem_thickenSet {ε : ℝ≥0} {s : Set ℝ} {x : ℝ} :
    x ∈ thickenSet ε s ↔ ∃ y ∈ s, |x - y| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  simp only [thickenSet, mem_add, mem_Icc, abs_le]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, t, ⟨ht₁, ht₂⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, hy, by linarith, by linarith⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, h₁, h₂⟩
    exact ⟨y, hy, x - y, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩, by ring⟩

proof:

  convex_iff_ordConnected.1 ((convex_iff_ordConnected.2 hs).add (convex_Icc _ _))

statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_thicken (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval) :

proof: := rfl

proof: := mem_thickenSet

proof:

  ext x
  rw [mem_thicken]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, -⟩; exact (notMem_empty y hy).elim
  · intro h; exact (notMem_empty x h).elim

proof:
:=
  fun x hx => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hx
    exact mem_thicken.2 ⟨y, h hy, hxy⟩

statement: theorem thicken_monotone (ε : ℝ≥0) : Monotone (thicken ε)

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.thicken_le_thicken_of_le
statement:
theorem thicken_le_thicken_of_le {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε ≤ δ) (I : OpenInterval) :
    thicken ε I ≤ thicken δ I
proof:
:= fun x hx => by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hx
  exact mem_thicken.2 ⟨y, hy, hxy.trans (by exact_mod_cast h)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.thicken_thicken
statement:
theorem thicken_thicken (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval) :
    thicken ε (thicken δ I) = thicken (ε + δ) I
proof:
:= by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  simp only [coe_thicken, add_assoc,
    Set.Icc_add_Icc (by simp : -(δ : ℝ) ≤ δ) (by simp : -(ε : ℝ) ≤ ε)]
  congr 2 <;> push_cast <;> ring

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.thicken_thicken'
statement:
theorem thicken_thicken' (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval) :
    thicken δ (thicken ε I) = thicken (ε + δ) I
proof:
:= by
  rw [thicken_thicken, add_comm]

proof:
:= by
  rw [thicken_thicken, thicken_thicken, add_comm]

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.thicken_ioo
statement:
theorem thicken_ioo {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    thicken ε (ioo a b) = ioo (a - ε) (b + ε)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_thicken, abs_le]
  change (∃ y ∈ Ioo a b, _) ↔ x ∈ Ioo (a - ε) (b + ε)
  simp only [mem_Ioo]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hay, hyb⟩, h₁, h₂⟩; constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    by_cases hxa : x ≤ a
    · refine ⟨min (x + ε) ((a + b) / 2), ⟨lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith),
        (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt (by linarith)⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · linarith [min_le_left (x + (ε : ℝ)) ((a + b) / 2)]
      · rcases min_cases (x + (ε : ℝ)) ((a + b) / 2) with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩ <;> rw [h] <;>
          linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]
    by_cases hxb : b ≤ x
    · refine ⟨max (x - ε) ((a + b) / 2), ⟨(by linarith : a < (a + b) / 2).trans_le
        (le_max_right _ _), max_lt (by linarith) (by linarith)⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rcases max_cases (x - (ε : ℝ)) ((a + b) / 2) with ⟨h, _⟩ | ⟨h, _⟩ <;> rw [h] <;>
          linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]
      · linarith [le_max_left (x - (ε : ℝ)) ((a + b) / 2)]
    · rw [not_le] at hxa hxb
      exact ⟨x, ⟨hxa, hxb⟩, by linarith [ε.coe_nonneg], by linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.thicken_ioi
statement: theorem thicken_ioi (a : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0) : thicken ε (ioi a) = ioi (a - ε)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_thicken]
  change (∃ y ∈ Ioi a, |x - y| ≤ ε) ↔ x ∈ Ioi (a - ε)
  simp only [mem_Ioi, abs_le]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, h₁, h₂⟩; linarith
  · intro hx
    by_cases hxa : a < x
    · exact ⟨x, hxa, by linarith [ε.coe_nonneg], by linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]⟩
    · exact ⟨x + ε, by linarith, by linarith, by linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.thicken_iio
statement: theorem thicken_iio (b : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0) : thicken ε (iio b) = iio (b + ε)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_thicken]
  change (∃ y ∈ Iio b, |x - y| ≤ ε) ↔ x ∈ Iio (b + ε)
  simp only [mem_Iio, abs_le]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, h₁, h₂⟩; linarith
  · intro hx
    by_cases hxb : x < b
    · exact ⟨x, hxb, by linarith [ε.coe_nonneg], by linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]⟩
    · exact ⟨x - ε, by linarith, by linarith [ε.coe_nonneg], by linarith⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.thickenSet_eq_thickening
statement:
theorem thickenSet_eq_thickening {s : Set ℝ} (hs : IsOpen s) {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    thickenSet ε s = Metric.thickening ε s
proof:
:= by
  have hε' : (0 : ℝ) < ε := hε
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := mem_thickenSet.1 hx
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hs y hy
    
    set k : ℝ := min (η / 2) ε / (2 * ε) with hk
    have hk0 : 0 < k := div_pos (lt_min (by linarith) hε') (by linarith)
    have hk1 : k ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [hk, div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]; linarith [min_le_right (η / 2) (ε : ℝ)]
    have hkη : k * ε < η := by
      rw [hk, div_mul_eq_mul_div, div_lt_iff₀ (by linarith)]
      nlinarith [min_le_left (η / 2) (ε : ℝ)]
    refine Metric.mem_thickening_iff.2 ⟨y + k * (x - y), hball ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, show y + k * (x - y) - y = k * (x - y) by ring,
        abs_mul, abs_of_pos hk0]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxy hk0.le) hkη
    · rw [Real.dist_eq, show x - (y + k * (x - y)) = (1 - k) * (x - y) by ring, abs_mul,
        abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
      calc (1 - k) * |x - y| ≤ (1 - k) * ε := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxy (by linarith)
        _ < ε := by nlinarith
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := Metric.mem_thickening_iff.1 hx
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hxy
    exact mem_thickenSet.2 ⟨y, hy, hxy.le⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.coe_thicken_eq_thickening
statement:
theorem coe_thicken_eq_thickening (I : OpenInterval) {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    (thicken ε I : Set ℝ) = Metric.thickening ε I
proof:
:=
  thickenSet_eq_thickening I.isOpen hε

theorem thickenUnit_comp (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval) :

  Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.intervalComponentNatTrans_app_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intervalComponentNatTrans_app_mk {f : C(X, ℝ)} {g : C(Z, ℝ)} (h : C(X, Z))
    (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) (I : OpenInterval) (x : {x : X // f x ∈ OpenInterval.toOpens I}) :
    (intervalComponentNatTrans h comm).app I (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨h x.1, by rw [comm]; exact x.2⟩ :
        {z : Z // g z ∈ OpenInterval.toOpens I})
proof: := rfl

theorem intervalComponentComparison_app_mk (f : C(X, ℝ)) (I : OpenInterval)

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison_natural
statement:
theorem intervalComponentComparison_natural {Z : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Z] {f : C(X, ℝ)}
    {g : C(Z, ℝ)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) :
    intervalComponentNatTrans h comm ≫ intervalComponentComparison g =
      intervalComponentComparison f ≫
        intervalComponentNatTrans (map h comm) (height_map_apply h comm)
proof:
:= by
  have key := congrArg (Functor.whiskerLeft OpenInterval.toOpensFunctor)
    (componentComparison_natural h comm)
  rw [Functor.whiskerLeft_comp, Functor.whiskerLeft_comp] at key
  exact key

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.inv_intervalComponentComparison_natural
statement:
theorem inv_intervalComponentComparison_natural {Z : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Z]
    {f : C(X, ℝ)} {g : C(Z, ℝ)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x)
    [IsIso (intervalComponentComparison f)] [IsIso (intervalComponentComparison g)] :
    intervalComponentNatTrans (map h comm) (height_map_apply h comm) ≫
        inv (intervalComponentComparison g) =
      inv (intervalComponentComparison f) ≫ intervalComponentNatTrans h comm
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isIso_intervalComponentNatTrans_componentGraphMap
statement:
theorem isIso_intervalComponentNatTrans_componentGraphMap :
    IsIso (intervalComponentNatTrans (P.componentGraphMap S) (P.height_componentGraphMap S))
proof:
:= by
  refine (S.isIso_iff_shortIntervals (P.intervalComponents_isConstructibleAt S)
    (intervalComponents_isIntervalCosheaf _) (finiteData_isConstructibleAt S P.componentData)
    (intervalComponents_isIntervalCosheaf _) _).2 ⟨fun i => ?_, fun e => ?_⟩
  · constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (P.vertexComponentsEquiv S i).surjective x
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := (P.vertexComponentsEquiv S i).surjective y
      rw [P.componentGraphMap_star S i c, P.componentGraphMap_star S i d] at hxy
      have hcd := ((ofFiniteData P.componentData).vertexComponentsEquiv S i).injective hxy
      exact congrArg _
        (joined_eq_of_discrete (A := (ofFiniteData P.componentData).V i) (Quotient.exact hcd))
    · intro z
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := ((ofFiniteData P.componentData).vertexComponentsEquiv S i).surjective z
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective w
      exact ⟨P.vertexComponentsEquiv S i c, P.componentGraphMap_star S i c⟩
  · constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := (P.edgeComponentsEquiv S e (RGraph.basePt S e)).surjective x
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := (P.edgeComponentsEquiv S e (RGraph.basePt S e)).surjective y
      rw [P.componentGraphMap_gap S e _ c, P.componentGraphMap_gap S e _ d] at hxy
      have hcd :=
        ((ofFiniteData P.componentData).edgeComponentsEquiv S e (RGraph.basePt S e)).injective hxy
      exact congrArg _
        (joined_eq_of_discrete (A := (ofFiniteData P.componentData).E e) (Quotient.exact hcd))
    · intro z
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ :=
        ((ofFiniteData P.componentData).edgeComponentsEquiv S e (RGraph.basePt S e)).surjective z
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective w
      exact ⟨P.edgeComponentsEquiv S e (RGraph.basePt S e) c, P.componentGraphMap_gap S e _ c⟩

    Function.Bijective ((ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison (P.height S)).app I)

    ← P.intervalComponentComparison_comp_apply S I y, hxy]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.TopologistsSineCurve.exists_unitInterval_gt
statement:
private lemma exists_unitInterval_gt {t₀ : unitInterval} (ht₀ : t₀ < 1) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ t₁, t₀ < t₁ ∧ dist t₀ t₁ < δ
proof:
:= by
  let s₀ := (t₀ : ℝ)
  let s₁ := min (s₀ + δ / 2) 1
  have h_s₀_delta_pos : 0 ≤ s₀ + δ / 2 := add_nonneg t₀.2.1 (by positivity)
  have hs₁ : 0 ≤ s₁ := le_min h_s₀_delta_pos zero_le_one
  have hs₁' : s₁ ≤ 1 := min_le_right ..
  refine ⟨⟨s₁, hs₁, hs₁'⟩, lt_min ((lt_add_iff_pos_right _).mpr (half_pos hδ)) ht₀, ?_⟩
  have h_le : s₁ ≤ s₀ + δ / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have h_ge : s₀ ≤ s₁ := le_min (by linarith) t₀.2.2
  rw [Subtype.dist_eq, dist_comm, dist_eq, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
  linarith

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ : p ∈ S := by
    cases hT with
    | inl hT => trivial
    | inr hZ => obtain ⟨y, ⟨-, rfl⟩⟩ := hZ; exact (lt_irrefl _ hx).elim
  simp [← hx]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.TopologistsSineCurve.exists_mem_Ioc_of_y
statement:
private lemma exists_mem_Ioc_of_y {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Icc (-1) 1) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    ∃ x ∈ Ioc 0 a, sin x⁻¹ = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, h_dist⟩ := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (xSeq_tendsto y) (a / 2) (by positivity)).exists
  refine ⟨xSeq y N, ⟨xSeq_pos y N, ?_⟩, sin_inv_xSeq hy _⟩
  rw [dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos (xSeq_pos _ N)] at h_dist
  linarith

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.TopologistsSineCurve.not_joinedIn_T
statement: theorem not_joinedIn_T : ¬ JoinedIn T (0, 0) w
proof:
:= by
  intro h_pathConn
  let p := h_pathConn.somePath
  have xcoord_pathContinuous : Continuous fun t ↦ (p t).1 := continuous_fst.comp p.continuous
  let t₀ : unitInterval := sSup {t | (p t).1 = 0}
  have h_pt₀_x : (p t₀).1 = 0 :=
    (isClosed_singleton.preimage xcoord_pathContinuous).sSup_mem ⟨0, by aesop⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, ht⟩ : ∃ δ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ t, dist t t₀ < δ → dist (p t) (p t₀) < 1 :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp <| Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp (p.continuousAt t₀) _ one_pos
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ : ∃ t₁, t₀ < t₁ ∧ dist t₀ t₁ < δ := by
    refine exists_unitInterval_gt (lt_of_le_of_ne (unitInterval.le_one t₀) fun ht₀' ↦ ?_) hδ
    have w_x_path : (p 1).1 = 1 := by rw [Path.target p, w]
    have x_eq_zero : (p 1).1 = 0 := by rwa [ht₀'] at h_pt₀_x
    linarith
  let a := (p t₁).1
  have ha : 0 < a := by
    obtain ⟨x, hxI, hx_eq⟩ : p t₁ ∈ S := by
      refine (h_pathConn.somePath_mem t₁).elim id fun ⟨y, hy⟩ ↦ ?_
      have : (p t₁).1 = 0 := by simp only [p, ← hy.2]
      exact ((show t₁ ≤ t₀ from le_sSup this).not_gt ht₁.1).elim
    simpa only [a, ← hx_eq] using! hxI.1
  have intervalAZeroSubOfT₀T₁Xcoord : Icc 0 a ⊆ (fun t ↦ (p t).1) '' Icc t₀ t₁ :=
    (isPreconnected_Icc.image _ <| xcoord_pathContinuous.continuousOn).Icc_subset
      (show 0 ∈ (fun t ↦ (p t).1) '' Icc t₀ t₁ from ⟨t₀, ⟨le_rfl, ht₁.1.le⟩, ‹_›⟩)
      (show a ∈ (fun t ↦ (p t).1) '' Icc t₀ t₁ from ⟨t₁, ⟨ht₁.1.le, le_rfl⟩, rfl⟩)
  have exists_close {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Icc (-1) 1) : ∃ t, dist t t₀ < δ ∧ (p t).2 = y := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := exists_mem_Ioc_of_y hy ha
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t ∈ Icc t₀ t₁, (p t).1 = x := intervalAZeroSubOfT₀T₁Xcoord ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2⟩
    have hp : (p t).2 = sin (p t).1⁻¹ := mem_S_of_x_pos (ht.2 ▸ hx.1) (h_pathConn.somePath_mem t)
    refine ⟨t, ?_, by rw [← hx', hp, ht.2]⟩
    calc
    dist t t₀ ≤ dist t₁ t₀ := dist_right_le_of_mem_uIcc (Icc_subset_uIcc' ht.1)
    _ = dist t₀ t₁ := by rw [dist_comm]
    _ < δ := ht₁.2
  obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, h_pathx₁⟩ : ∃ x₁, dist x₁ t₀ < δ ∧ (p x₁).2 = 1 := exists_close (by simp)
  obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂, h_pathx₂⟩ : ∃ x₂, dist x₂ t₀ < δ ∧ (p x₂).2 = -1 := exists_close (by simp)
  have : dist (p x₁) (p x₂) < 2 := by
    refine (dist_triangle_right _ _ (p t₀)).trans_lt ?_
    exact (add_lt_add (ht _ hx₁) (ht _ hx₂)).trans_eq (by norm_num)
  have := norm_ge_abs_snd.trans_lt this
  rw [h_pathx₁, h_pathx₂, abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num)] at this
  linarith

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.TopologistsSineCurve.mk_segment
statement:
private lemma mk_segment {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ Icc (-1) 1) :
    mk fstHeight ⟨(0, 0), zero_mem_T⟩ = mk fstHeight ⟨(0, y), .inr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩
proof:
:= by
  have mem (s : unitInterval) : ((0 : ℝ), (s : ℝ) * y) ∈ T :=
    .inr ⟨(s : ℝ) * y, ⟨by nlinarith [s.2.1, s.2.2, hy.1, hy.2],
      by nlinarith [s.2.1, s.2.2, hy.1, hy.2]⟩, rfl⟩
  let γ : Path (⟨(0, 0), zero_mem_T⟩ : T) ⟨(0, y), .inr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩ :=
    { toFun := fun s => ⟨(0, (s : ℝ) * y), mem s⟩
      continuous_toFun := by fun_prop
      source' := by ext <;> simp
      target' := by ext <;> simp }
  exact mk_eq_mk_of_path fstHeight γ fun _ => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.TopologistsSineCurve.continuous_mk_curve
statement: private lemma continuous_mk_curve : Continuous fun s => mk fstHeight (curve s)
proof:
:= by
  refine continuous_iff_continuousAt.2 fun t => ?_
  rcases t.2.1.eq_or_lt with h | h
  · rw [ContinuousAt, (nhds_basis_opens _).tendsto_right_iff]
    rintro V ⟨hVt, hV⟩
    obtain ⟨N, hN, hNV⟩ := isOpen_induced_iff.1 (hV.preimage (continuous_mk fstHeight))
    have hcurve : curve t = ⟨(0, 0), zero_mem_T⟩ := Subtype.ext (by simp [curve, ← h])
    have hseg : {(0 : ℝ)} ×ˢ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ N := by
      rintro ⟨x, y⟩ ⟨rfl, hy⟩
      have : (⟨(0, y), .inr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩⟩ : T) ∈ Subtype.val ⁻¹' N := by
        rw [hNV]
        show mk fstHeight _ ∈ V
        rw [← mk_segment hy, ← hcurve]
        exact hVt
      exact this
    obtain ⟨u, v, hu, -, hu0, hv, huv⟩ :=
      generalized_tube_lemma isCompact_singleton isCompact_Icc hN hseg
    have hut : Subtype.val ⁻¹' u ∈ 𝓝 t :=
      continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
        (hu.mem_nhds (by rw [← h]; exact hu0 rfl))
    filter_upwards [hut] with s hs
    have : curve s ∈ Subtype.val ⁻¹' N :=
      huv ⟨hs, hv ⟨neg_one_le_sin _, sin_le_one _⟩⟩
    rw [hNV] at this
    exact this
  · refine (continuous_mk fstHeight).continuousAt.comp ?_
    refine (continuousAt_codRestrict_iff _).2 ?_
    exact continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt.prodMk
      (continuous_sin.continuousAt.comp
        ((continuousAt_inv₀ h.ne').comp continuous_subtype_val.continuousAt))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.TopologistsSineCurve.joined_mk_zero_mk_w
statement:
theorem joined_mk_zero_mk_w :
    Joined (mk fstHeight ⟨(0, 0), zero_mem_T⟩) (mk fstHeight ⟨w, w_mem_T⟩)
proof:
:=
  ⟨{ toFun := fun s => mk fstHeight (curve s)
     continuous_toFun := continuous_mk_curve
     source' := congrArg (mk fstHeight) (Subtype.ext (by simp [curve]))
     target' := congrArg (mk fstHeight) (Subtype.ext (by simp [curve, w])) }⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.TopologistsSineCurve.componentComparison_not_injective_of_forall_mem
statement:
private lemma componentComparison_not_injective_of_forall_mem {U : TopologicalSpace.Opens ℝ}
    (hU : ∀ t : ℝ, t ∈ U) : ¬ Function.Injective ((componentComparison fstHeight).app U)
proof:
:= by
  intro hinj
  have hne : ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨⟨(0, 0), zero_mem_T⟩, hU _⟩ : {x : T // fstHeight x ∈ U}) ≠
      ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨⟨w, w_mem_T⟩, hU _⟩ := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨γ⟩ : Joined _ _ := Quotient.exact h
    exact not_joinedIn_T
      ⟨γ.map (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_subtype_val), fun t => (γ t).1.2⟩
  refine hne (hinj ?_)
  rw [componentComparison_app_mk, componentComparison_app_mk]
  have hV (q : ReebQuotient fstHeight) :
      q ∈ {q : ReebQuotient fstHeight | height fstHeight q ∈ U} := hU _
  exact Quotient.sound <| (joinedIn_iff_joined (hV _) (hV _)).1 <|
    (joinedIn_univ.2 joined_mk_zero_mk_w).mono fun q _ => hV q

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricDistanceBounds.heightRange_singleton

private theorem heightRange_singleton (a : ℝ) :

  ext t
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using height_singleton a x
  · intro ht
    have ht' : t = a := by simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using ht

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricDistanceBounds.geometricInterleavingDistance_singleton
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_singleton {a b : ℝ} :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (singletonGraph a) (singletonGraph b) =
      ENNReal.ofReal |a - b|
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply geometricInterleavingDistance_le_iff.2
    intro ε hε
    have hε' : |a - b| < (ε : ℝ) :=
      (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_coe_iff (abs_nonneg _)).mp hε
    exact ⟨pointInterleaving (le_of_lt hε')⟩
  · have hdist := hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le_geometricInterleavingDistance
      (singletonGraph a) (singletonGraph b)
    have hleft : ENNReal.ofReal |a - b| ≤
        Metric.infEDist a (heightRange (singletonGraph b)) := by
      rw [heightRange_singleton, Metric.infEDist_singleton, edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
    have hmem : a ∈ heightRange (singletonGraph a) := by
      rw [heightRange_singleton]
      exact Set.mem_singleton a
    exact hleft.trans ((Metric.infEDist_le_hausdorffEDist_of_mem hmem).trans hdist)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricDistanceBounds.geometricInterleavingDistance_single_mid
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_single_mid :
    geometricInterleavingDistance singleGraph midGraph = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [← coe_halfNN_ennreal]
    exact edgeMidInterleaving.geometricInterleavingDistance_le
  · have hdist := hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le_geometricInterleavingDistance
      singleGraph midGraph
    have htop : (1 : ℝ) ∈ heightRange singleGraph := ⟨edgeTop, height_edgeTop⟩
    have hleft : ENNReal.ofReal |(1 : ℝ) - 1 / 2| ≤
        Metric.infEDist (1 : ℝ) (heightRange midGraph) := by
      rw [heightRange_singleton, Metric.infEDist_singleton, edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
    have hfull := hleft.trans ((Metric.infEDist_le_hausdorffEDist_of_mem htop).trans hdist)
    norm_num at hfull
    have hhalf : ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / 2 : ℝ)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos zero_lt_two, ENNReal.ofReal_one,
        ENNReal.ofReal_ofNat]
    rw [hhalf] at hfull
    exact hfull

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricDistanceBounds.heightRange_single_smoothing_half_subset
statement:
theorem heightRange_single_smoothing_half_subset :
    heightRange ((geometricSmoothing halfNN).obj singleGraph) ⊆ Icc (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (3 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [heightRange_geometricSmoothing]
  rintro _ hz
  obtain ⟨x, hx, t, ht, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_add.1 hz
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
  have hx' := height_single_mem y
  rw [coe_halfNN] at ht
  obtain ⟨ht1, ht2⟩ := ht
  obtain ⟨hx1, hx2⟩ := hx'
  constructor <;> linarith

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricDistanceBounds.neg_half_mem_heightRange_single_smoothing_half
statement:
theorem neg_half_mem_heightRange_single_smoothing_half :
    (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ heightRange ((geometricSmoothing halfNN).obj singleGraph)
proof:
:= by
  rw [heightRange_geometricSmoothing]
  refine Set.mem_add.2 ⟨0, ?_, -(1 / 2 : ℝ), ?_, by norm_num⟩
  · let x₀ : singleGraph.obj.left := (ofFiniteData singleEdge).ofVertex S01 0 ()
    refine ⟨x₀, ?_⟩
    change (ofFiniteData singleEdge).height S01
      ((ofFiniteData singleEdge).ofVertex S01 0 ()) = 0
    exact S01_value_zero
  · rw [coe_halfNN]
    norm_num

  refine Set.mem_add.2 ⟨1, ⟨edgeTop, height_edgeTop⟩, (1 / 2 : ℝ), ?_, by norm_num⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricDistanceBounds.geometricInterleavingDistance_twoPoint_singleton
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_twoPoint_singleton :
    geometricInterleavingDistance twoPointGraph (singletonGraph 0) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton (singletonGraph (0 : ℝ)).obj.left := singleton_subsingleton 0
  apply geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_top_of_isEmpty_equiv
  refine ⟨fun e => ?_⟩
  have hsub : Subsingleton ((cosheafFunctor.obj (singletonGraph 0)).obj.obj ⊤) := by
    change Subsingleton
      ((intervalComponents (overBaseMap (singletonGraph (0 : ℝ)).obj)).obj ⊤)
    exact ⟨fun c d => by
      induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
      | mk x =>
        induction d using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
        | mk y =>
          exact congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (Subtype.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _))⟩
  have htwo : Subsingleton ((cosheafFunctor.obj twoPointGraph).obj.obj ⊤) :=
    e.subsingleton_congr.mpr hsub
  have hcard_ne_zero : Nat.card ((cosheafFunctor.obj twoPointGraph).obj.obj ⊤) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphCosheafEquivalence.twoPoint_card_top]
    norm_num
  have hnonempty : Nonempty ((cosheafFunctor.obj twoPointGraph).obj.obj ⊤) :=
    (Nat.card_ne_zero.mp hcard_ne_zero).1
  have hone : Nat.card ((cosheafFunctor.obj twoPointGraph).obj.obj ⊤) = 1 :=
    Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mpr ⟨htwo, hnonempty⟩
  rw [TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphCosheafEquivalence.twoPoint_card_top] at hone
  norm_num at hone

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.toCosheafLift_app_J
statement:
theorem toCosheafLift_app_J (j : D.Hom (S.extract G hG.finite)) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : D.V i) :
    (D.toCosheafLift hG hGc j).app (S.J i) (D.vertexLabel S i x) = j.v i x
proof:
:= by
  rw [toCosheafLift, ShortMaps.extend_app_J]
  show j.v i ((D.fromExtractHom S).v i (D.vertexLabel S i x)) = j.v i x
  rw [fromExtractHom_v_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

proof:

  show j.e e ((D.fromExtractHom S).e e (D.edgeLabel S e x)) = j.e e x

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.toCosheafLift_unique
statement:
theorem toCosheafLift_unique (j : D.Hom (S.extract G hG.finite)) (α : D.toCosheaf S ⟶ G)
    (hJ : ∀ i x, α.app (S.J i) (D.vertexLabel S i x) = j.v i x)
    (hK : ∀ e x, α.app (S.K e) (D.edgeLabel S e x) = j.e e x) :
    α = D.toCosheafLift hG hGc j
proof:
:=
  S.natTrans_ext (D.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt S) (D.toCosheaf_isIntervalCosheaf S) hG hGc
    (fun i y => by
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (D.vertexLabel S i).surjective y
      rw [hJ, toCosheafLift_app_J])
    (fun e y => by
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (D.edgeLabel S e).surjective y
      rw [hK, toCosheafLift_app_K])

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.existsUnique_natTrans_labelled
statement:
theorem existsUnique_natTrans_labelled (j : D.Hom (S.extract G hG.finite)) :
    ∃! α : D.toCosheaf S ⟶ G, (∀ i x, α.app (S.J i) (D.vertexLabel S i x) = j.v i x) ∧
      ∀ e x, α.app (S.K e) (D.edgeLabel S e x) = j.e e x
proof:
:=
  ⟨D.toCosheafLift hG hGc j, ⟨D.toCosheafLift_app_J hG hGc j, D.toCosheafLift_app_K hG hGc j⟩,
    fun α hα => D.toCosheafLift_unique hG hGc j α hα.1 hα.2⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.isIso_toCosheafLift
statement:
theorem isIso_toCosheafLift (j : D.Hom (S.extract G hG.finite))
    (hv : ∀ i, Function.Bijective (j.v i)) (he : ∀ e, Function.Bijective (j.e e)) :
    IsIso (D.toCosheafLift hG hGc j)
proof:
:=
  ShortMaps.isIso_extend S (D.labelledShortMaps hG j) (D.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt S)
    (D.toCosheaf_isIntervalCosheaf S) hG hGc
    (fun i => (hv i).comp (Equiv.ofBijective _ (D.toExtractHom_v_bijective S i)).symm.bijective)
    (fun e => (he e).comp (Equiv.ofBijective _ (D.toExtractHom_e_bijective S e)).symm.bijective)

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.natTransEquivDiagramHom_toCosheafLift

theorem natTransEquivDiagramHom_toCosheafLift (j : D.Hom (S.extract G hG.finite)) :
    S.natTransEquivDiagramHom (D.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt S) (D.toCosheaf_isIntervalCosheaf S)
      hG hGc (D.toCosheafLift hG hGc j) = (D.fromExtractHom S).comp j
proof:
:= by
  show (S.restrict (D.toCosheafLift hG hGc j)).toHom _ _ = _
  rw [toCosheafLift, ShortMaps.restrict_extend]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.isIso_toCosheafLift_id
statement:
theorem isIso_toCosheafLift_id :
    IsIso ((S.extract F hF.finite).toCosheafLift hF hFc
      (FiniteReebData.Hom.id (S.extract F hF.finite)))
proof:
:=
  (S.extract F hF.finite).isIso_toCosheafLift hF hFc _ (fun _ => Function.bijective_id)
    (fun _ => Function.bijective_id)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.realizeExtractIso_hom
statement:

    (realizeExtractIso hF hFc).hom = (S.extract F hF.finite).toCosheafLift hF hFc

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.realizeExtractIso_hom_app_J

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.realizeExtractIso_inv_app_J
statement:
theorem realizeExtractIso_inv_app_J (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : F.obj (S.J i)) :

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.realizeExtractIso_hom_unique
statement:
theorem realizeExtractIso_hom_unique (α : (S.extract F hF.finite).toCosheaf S ⟶ F)
    (hJ : ∀ i x, α.app (S.J i) ((S.extract F hF.finite).vertexLabel S i x) = x)
    (hK : ∀ e x, α.app (S.K e) ((S.extract F hF.finite).edgeLabel S e x) = x) :
    α = (realizeExtractIso hF hFc).hom
proof:
:=
  (S.extract F hF.finite).toCosheafLift_unique hF hFc _ α hJ hK

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.natTransEquivDiagramHom_realizeExtractIso
statement:
theorem natTransEquivDiagramHom_realizeExtractIso :
    S.natTransEquivDiagramHom ((S.extract F hF.finite).toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt S)
      ((S.extract F hF.finite).toCosheaf_isIntervalCosheaf S) hF hFc

proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.map_realizeExtractIso_hom_app_strip
statement:
theorem map_realizeExtractIso_hom_app_strip {e : Fin n} {I : OpenInterval} (hI : I ≤ S.K e)
    (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (ht : (t : ℝ) ∈ I) (z : F.obj (S.K e)) :
    F.map (homOfLE hI) ((realizeExtractIso hF hFc).hom.app I
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData (S.extract F hF.finite)).ofStrip S e (z, t), ht⟩ :
        (ofFiniteData (S.extract F hF.finite)).heightPreimage S I))) = z
proof:
:= by
  refine (NatTrans.naturality_apply (realizeExtractIso hF hFc).hom (homOfLE hI) _).symm.trans ?_
  refine (congrArg ((realizeExtractIso hF hFc).hom.app (S.K e)) ?_).trans
    (realizeExtractIso_hom_app_K hF hFc e z)
  exact ((S.extract F hF.finite).edgeLabel_apply S e t z).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.map_realizeExtractIso_hom_app_vertex
statement:
theorem map_realizeExtractIso_hom_app_vertex {i : Fin (n + 1)} {I : OpenInterval}
    (hI : I ≤ S.J i) (hi : S.value i ∈ I) (x : F.obj (S.J i)) :
    F.map (homOfLE hI) ((realizeExtractIso hF hFc).hom.app I
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData (S.extract F hF.finite)).ofVertex S i x, hi⟩ :
        (ofFiniteData (S.extract F hF.finite)).heightPreimage S I))) = x
proof:
:= by
  refine (NatTrans.naturality_apply (realizeExtractIso hF hFc).hom (homOfLE hI) _).symm.trans ?_
  refine (congrArg ((realizeExtractIso hF hFc).hom.app (S.J i)) ?_).trans
    (realizeExtractIso_hom_app_J hF hFc i x)
  exact ((S.extract F hF.finite).vertexLabel_apply S i x).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.not_pointInterleaving_zero
statement:
theorem not_pointInterleaving_zero :
    IsEmpty (Interleaving 0 (pointPrecosheaf 0) (pointPrecosheaf 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_⟩
  have x : (pointPrecosheaf 0).obj (ioo (-1/2) (1/2)) :=
    PLift.up (by change (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-1/2) (1/2); constructor <;> norm_num)
  have h : (1 : ℝ) ∈ ioo (-1/2) (1/2) := PLift.down ((i.toIso).hom.app _ x)
  change (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-1/2) (1/2) at h
  norm_num at h

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.point_closure_interleaving
statement:
theorem point_closure_interleaving :
    (∀ ε : ℝ≥0, 0 < ε → Nonempty (Interleaving ε (pointPrecosheaf 0) (closurePrecosheaf 0))) ∧
      IsEmpty (Interleaving 0 (pointPrecosheaf 0) (closurePrecosheaf 0))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ε hε => ⟨interleavingOfSubsingleton
    { app := fun I => TypeCat.ofHom fun (x : PLift ((0 : ℝ) ∈ I)) =>
        (PLift.up (subset_closure (le_thicken ε I x.down)) :
          PLift ((0 : ℝ) ∈ closure (thicken ε I : Set ℝ)))
      naturality := fun _ _ _ => rfl }
    { app := fun I => TypeCat.ofHom fun (x : PLift ((0 : ℝ) ∈ closure (I : Set ℝ))) =>
        (PLift.up (by
          obtain ⟨b, hb, hd⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.1 x.down ε hε
          exact mem_thicken.2 ⟨b, hb, by rw [← Real.dist_eq]; exact hd.le⟩) :
          PLift ((0 : ℝ) ∈ thicken ε I))
      naturality := fun _ _ _ => rfl }⟩, ⟨fun i => ?_⟩⟩
  have x : (closurePrecosheaf 0).obj (ioo 0 1) := PLift.up (by
    change (0 : ℝ) ∈ closure (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
    rw [closure_Ioo (by norm_num)]; constructor <;> norm_num)
  have h : (0 : ℝ) ∈ ioo 0 1 := PLift.down ((i.toIso).inv.app _ x)
  change (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 at h
  exact lt_irrefl _ h.1

name: TDA.Reeb.IsIntervalCosheaf.glue_map
statement:
theorem glue_map (k : κ) (h : I k ≤ J) (e : F.obj (I k)) :
    glue hF I hJ a ha (F.map (homOfLE h) e) = a k e
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_apply_eq_of_thin F (homOfLE h) (homOfLE (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ k))]
  exact (hF.existsUnique_glue I hJ a ha).exists.choose_spec k e

name: TDA.Reeb.IsIntervalCosheaf.eq_glue
statement:
theorem eq_glue (g : F.obj J → A)
    (hg : ∀ k e, g (F.map (homOfLE (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ k)) e) = a k e) :
    g = glue hF I hJ a ha
proof:
:=
  (hF.existsUnique_glue I hJ a ha).unique hg
    (hF.existsUnique_glue I hJ a ha).exists.choose_spec

name: TDA.Reeb.IsIntervalCosheaf.glue_comp_map
proof:
:= by
  have hu := hF.existsUnique_glue I hJ (fun k e => t (a k e)) (fun k l c => congrArg t (ha k l c))
  have key : (fun x => t (glue hF I hJ a ha x)) =
      (fun x => glue hF L hH b hb (F.map (homOfLE hJH) x)) := by
    refine hu.unique (fun k e => ?_) (fun k e => ?_)
    · exact congrArg t (glue_map hF k _ e)
    · show glue hF L hH b hb (F.map (homOfLE hJH) (F.map (homOfLE (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ k)) e)) =
        t (a k e)
      have hkH : I k ≤ H := (hr k).trans (le_of_iUnion_eq hH (r k))
      rw [map_map_apply_of_thin F _ _ (homOfLE hkH),
        ← map_map_apply_of_thin F (homOfLE (hr k)) (homOfLE (le_of_iUnion_eq hH (r k))),
        glue_map hF (r k), ht]
  exact congrFun key x

name: TDA.Reeb.IsIntervalCosheaf.exists_map_eq
statement:
theorem exists_map_eq (I : κ → OpenInterval) (hJ : ⋃ k, (I k : Set ℝ) = J) (x : F.obj J) :
    ∃ k, ∃ e : F.obj (I k), F.map (homOfLE (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ k)) e = x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hF.existsUnique_glue I hJ (A := Prop) (fun _ _ => True) (fun _ _ _ => rfl)).unique
    (y₁ := fun _ => True) (y₂ := fun x => ∃ k, ∃ e : F.obj (I k),
      F.map (homOfLE (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ k)) e = x)
    (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun k e => eq_true ⟨k, e, rfl⟩)
  exact (congrFun h x).mp trivial

name: TDA.Reeb.map_self_apply
statement: theorem map_self_apply {I : OpenInterval} (h : I ≤ I) (x : F.obj I) : F.map (homOfLE h) x = x
proof:
:=
  (map_apply_eq_of_thin F _ (𝟙 I) x).trans (F.map_id_apply I x)

name: TDA.Reeb.compat_of_inf_le
statement:
theorem compat_of_inf_le {T Jk Jl K : OpenInterval} (hk : Jk ≤ T) (hl : Jl ≤ T)
    (hKk : K ≤ Jk) (hKl : K ≤ Jl) (hinf : Jk ⊓ Jl ≤ K)
    (sk : F.obj Jk → G.obj Jk) (sl : F.obj Jl → G.obj Jl) (g : F.obj K → G.obj K)
    (hgk : ∀ y, G.map (homOfLE hKk) (g y) = sk (F.map (homOfLE hKk) y))
    (hgl : ∀ y, G.map (homOfLE hKl) (g y) = sl (F.map (homOfLE hKl) y))
    (c : F.obj (Jk ⊓ Jl)) :
    G.map (homOfLE hk) (sk (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c)) =
      G.map (homOfLE hl) (sl (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_map_apply_of_thin F (homOfLE hinf) (homOfLE hKk) (homOfLE inf_le_left) c,
    ← map_map_apply_of_thin F (homOfLE hinf) (homOfLE hKl) (homOfLE inf_le_right) c,
    ← hgk, ← hgl, map_map_apply_of_thin G _ _ (homOfLE (hKk.trans hk)),
    map_map_apply_of_thin G _ _ (homOfLE (hKl.trans hl))]

name: TDA.Reeb.isEmpty_of_le_bot
statement:
theorem isEmpty_of_le_bot {I : OpenInterval} (hbot : IsEmpty (F.obj ⊥)) (h : I ≤ ⊥) :
    IsEmpty (F.obj I)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun c => hbot.false (F.map (homOfLE h) c)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.compat_comp
statement:
theorem compat_comp {κ μ : Type*} {I : κ → OpenInterval} {L : μ → OpenInterval} (r : κ → μ)
    (hr : ∀ k, I k ≤ L (r k)) {A : Sort*} (b : ∀ l, F.obj (L l) → A)
    (hb : ∀ l l' (c : F.obj (L l ⊓ L l')),
      b l (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) = b l' (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c))
    (k l : κ) (c : F.obj (I k ⊓ I l)) :
    b (r k) (F.map (homOfLE (hr k)) (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c)) =
      b (r l) (F.map (homOfLE (hr l)) (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c))
proof:
:= by
  have h := hb (r k) (r l) (F.map (homOfLE (inf_le_inf (hr k) (hr l))) c)
  rw [map_map_apply_of_thin F _ _ (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans (hr k))),
    map_map_apply_of_thin F _ _ (homOfLE (inf_le_right.trans (hr l)))] at h
  rw [map_map_apply_of_thin F _ _ (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans (hr k))),
    map_map_apply_of_thin F _ _ (homOfLE (inf_le_right.trans (hr l)))]
  exact h

name: TDA.Reeb.unitTo_app
statement:
theorem unitTo_app (F : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u) (I : OpenInterval) :
    (unitTo N η F).app I = F.map (η.app I)
proof:
:= by
  simp [unitTo]

name: TDA.Reeb.isIso_unitTo
statement:
theorem isIso_unitTo (hG : ∀ I, Function.Bijective (G.map (η.app I))) :
    IsIso (unitTo N η G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro I
  rw [unitTo_app, isIso_iff_bijective]
  exact hG I

name: TDA.Reeb.transport_comp_unitTo
statement: theorem transport_comp_unitTo : transport hG β ≫ unitTo N η G = unitTo N η F ≫ β
proof:
:= by
  have := isIso_unitTo hG
  simp [transport]

name: TDA.Reeb.map_transport_app
statement:
theorem map_transport_app (I : OpenInterval) (x : F.obj I) :
    G.map (η.app I) ((transport hG β).app I x) = β.app I (F.map (η.app I) x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun γ => γ.app I x) (transport_comp_unitTo hG β)
  simpa [unitTo_app] using h

name: TDA.Reeb.transport_app
statement:
theorem transport_app (I : OpenInterval) (x : F.obj I) :
    (transport hG β).app I x = (Equiv.ofBijective _ (hG I)).symm (β.app I (F.map (η.app I) x))
proof:
:=
  (hG I).injective (by
    rw [Equiv.ofBijective_apply_symm_apply _ (hG I)]; exact map_transport_app hG β I x)

name: TDA.Reeb.eq_transport
statement:
theorem eq_transport (α : F ⟶ G) (h : α ≫ unitTo N η G = unitTo N η F ≫ β) :
    α = transport hG β
proof:
:= by
  have := isIso_unitTo hG
  rw [← cancel_mono (unitTo N η G), h, transport_comp_unitTo]

name: TDA.Reeb.eq_transport_of_apply
statement:
theorem eq_transport_of_apply (α : F ⟶ G)
    (h : ∀ I x, G.map (η.app I) (α.app I x) = β.app I (F.map (η.app I) x)) :
    α = transport hG β
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_transport hG β α (NatTrans.ext (funext fun I => ?_))
  ext x
  simpa [unitTo_app] using h I x

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.IsConstructibleAt.isEmpty_of_le_lowerTail
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleAt.isEmpty_of_le_lowerTail {F : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : S.IsConstructibleAt F) {I : OpenInterval} (h : I ≤ S.lowerTail) : IsEmpty (F.obj I)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x => hF.isEmpty_lowerTail.false (F.map (homOfLE h) x)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.IsConstructibleAt.isEmpty_of_le_upperTail
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleAt.isEmpty_of_le_upperTail {F : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u}
    (hF : S.IsConstructibleAt F) {I : OpenInterval} (h : I ≤ S.upperTail) : IsEmpty (F.obj I)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x => hF.isEmpty_upperTail.false (F.map (homOfLE h) x)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.isEmpty_lowerTail_iff
statement:
theorem isEmpty_lowerTail_iff (F : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u) :
    IsEmpty (F.obj S.lowerTail) ↔ ∀ I ≤ S.lowerTail, IsEmpty (F.obj I)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ hI => ⟨fun x => h.false (F.map (homOfLE hI) x)⟩, fun h => h _ le_rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.isEmpty_upperTail_iff
statement:
theorem isEmpty_upperTail_iff (F : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u) :
    IsEmpty (F.obj S.upperTail) ↔ ∀ I ≤ S.upperTail, IsEmpty (F.obj I)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h _ hI => ⟨fun x => h.false (F.map (homOfLE hI) x)⟩, fun h => h _ le_rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.IsConstructibleAt.of_refines
proof:
:= hF.finite
  bijective _ _ h hI hhit := hF.bijective h hI fun i => by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hST ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [← hj]
    exact hhit j
  isEmpty_lowerTail := hF.isEmpty_of_le_lowerTail (S.lowerTail_le_of_refines hST)
  isEmpty_upperTail := hF.isEmpty_of_le_upperTail (S.upperTail_le_of_refines hST)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.IsConstructibleAt.of_iso
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleAt.of_iso {F G : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u} (e : F ≅ G)
    (hF : S.IsConstructibleAt F) : S.IsConstructibleAt G where
  finite I
proof:
:= by
    have := hF.finite I
    exact Finite.of_surjective _ ((isIso_iff_bijective (e.hom.app I)).1 inferInstance).2
  bijective I J h hI hhit := by
    have key : ⇑(G.map (homOfLE h)) = e.hom.app J ∘ F.map (homOfLE h) ∘ e.inv.app I := by
      funext y
      simp only [Function.comp_apply]
      rw [NatTrans.naturality_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
    rw [key]
    exact ((isIso_iff_bijective (e.hom.app J)).1 inferInstance).comp
      ((hF.bijective h hI hhit).comp ((isIso_iff_bijective (e.inv.app I)).1 inferInstance))
  isEmpty_lowerTail := ⟨fun y => hF.isEmpty_lowerTail.false (e.inv.app _ y)⟩
  isEmpty_upperTail := ⟨fun y => hF.isEmpty_upperTail.false (e.inv.app _ y)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.extract_left
statement:
theorem extract_left (F : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u) (hF : ∀ I, Finite (F.obj I)) (e : Fin n)
    (x : F.obj (S.K e)) : (S.extract F hF).left e x = F.map (homOfLE (S.K_le_J_castSucc e)) x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.extract_right
statement:
theorem extract_right (F : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u) (hF : ∀ I, Finite (F.obj I)) (e : Fin n)
    (x : F.obj (S.K e)) : (S.extract F hF).right e x = F.map (homOfLE (S.K_le_J_succ e)) x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.comp_inv
statement:
theorem comp_inv (φ : S.ShortMaps F G) (hv : ∀ i, Function.Bijective (φ.star i))
    (he : ∀ e, Function.Bijective (φ.gap e)) : φ.comp (φ.inv hv he) = ShortMaps.id F
proof:
:=
  ShortMaps.ext (funext fun i => funext fun x => Equiv.ofBijective_symm_apply_apply _ (hv i) x)
    (funext fun e => funext fun x => Equiv.ofBijective_symm_apply_apply _ (he e) x)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.inv_comp
statement:
theorem inv_comp (φ : S.ShortMaps F G) (hv : ∀ i, Function.Bijective (φ.star i))
    (he : ∀ e, Function.Bijective (φ.gap e)) : (φ.inv hv he).comp φ = ShortMaps.id G
proof:
:=
  ShortMaps.ext (funext fun i => funext fun x => Equiv.ofBijective_apply_symm_apply _ (hv i) x)
    (funext fun e => funext fun x => Equiv.ofBijective_apply_symm_apply _ (he e) x)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.restrict_comp_star
statement:
theorem restrict_comp_star {F G H : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u} (α : F ⟶ G) (β : G ⟶ H) (i)
    (x : F.obj (S.J i)) :
    (S.restrict (α ≫ β)).star i x = (S.restrict β).star i ((S.restrict α).star i x)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.restrict_comp_gap
statement:
theorem restrict_comp_gap {F G H : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u} (α : F ⟶ G) (β : G ⟶ H) (e)
    (x : F.obj (S.K e)) :
    (S.restrict (α ≫ β)).gap e x = (S.restrict β).gap e ((S.restrict α).gap e x)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.restrict_comp
statement:
theorem restrict_comp {F G H : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u} (α : F ⟶ G) (β : G ⟶ H) :
    S.restrict (α ≫ β) = (S.restrict α).comp (S.restrict β)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.restrict_id
statement: theorem restrict_id (F : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u) : S.restrict (𝟙 F) = ShortMaps.id F
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.onPiece_map
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | star i =>
    obtain rfl := S.value_mem_piece_iff.1 (h (S.value_mem_J i))
    rw [map_self_apply, map_self_apply]
  | gap e =>
    cases p with
    | star j =>
      rcases S.K_le_J_iff.1 h with rfl | rfl
      · exact φ.left_comm e x
      · exact φ.right_comm e x
    | gap e' =>
      obtain rfl := S.eq_of_K_le_K h
      rw [map_self_apply, map_self_apply]
    | lowerTail => exact absurd h (S.not_K_le_lowerTail e)
    | upperTail => exact absurd h (S.not_K_le_upperTail e)
  | lowerTail => exact (hF.isEmpty_lowerTail.false x).elim
  | upperTail => exact (hF.isEmpty_upperTail.false x).elim

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.pieceFamily_compat
statement:
theorem pieceFamily_compat (φ : S.ShortMaps F G) (hF : S.IsConstructibleAt F)
    (hFc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} F) (U : OpenInterval) (p q : {p : Piece n // S.piece p ≤ U})
    (c : F.obj (S.piece p.1 ⊓ S.piece q.1)) :
    φ.pieceFamily hF U p (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) =
      φ.pieceFamily hF U q (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c)
proof:
:= by
  have hW := S.envelope_inf_of_eq (S.envelope_piece p.1) (S.envelope_piece q.1)
  obtain ⟨s, e, rfl⟩ := hFc.exists_map_eq
    (fun s : {s : Piece n // S.piece s ≤ S.piece p.1 ⊓ S.piece q.1} => S.piece s.1)
    (S.iUnion_piece_eq hW) c
  have hsp : S.piece s.1 ≤ S.piece p.1 := s.2.trans inf_le_left
  have hsq : S.piece s.1 ≤ S.piece q.1 := s.2.trans inf_le_right
  simp only [pieceFamily]
  rw [map_map_apply_of_thin F _ _ (homOfLE hsp), map_map_apply_of_thin F _ _ (homOfLE hsq),
    ← φ.onPiece_map hF hsp, ← φ.onPiece_map hF hsq,
    map_map_apply_of_thin G _ _ (homOfLE (hsp.trans p.2)),
    map_map_apply_of_thin G _ _ (homOfLE (hsq.trans q.2))]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.extendNormal_map
proof:
:= by
  unfold extendNormal
  exact IsIntervalCosheaf.glue_map hFc
    (I := fun q : {q : Piece n // S.piece q ≤ U} => S.piece q.1) ⟨p, h⟩ h x

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.eq_extendNormal
statement:
theorem eq_extendNormal {U : OpenInterval} (hU : S.envelope U = U) (g : F.obj U → G.obj U)
    (hg : ∀ (p : Piece n) (h : S.piece p ≤ U) (x : F.obj (S.piece p)),
      g (F.map (homOfLE h) x) = G.map (homOfLE h) (φ.onPiece hF p x)) :
    g = φ.extendNormal hF hFc hU
proof:
:= by
  unfold extendNormal
  exact IsIntervalCosheaf.eq_glue hFc g fun p x => hg p.1 p.2 x

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.extendNormal_comp_map
statement:
theorem extendNormal_comp_map {U V : OpenInterval} (hU : S.envelope U = U)
    (hV : S.envelope V = V) (hUV : U ≤ V) (x : F.obj U) :
    G.map (homOfLE hUV) (φ.extendNormal hF hFc hU x) =
      φ.extendNormal hF hFc hV (F.map (homOfLE hUV) x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold extendNormal
  exact IsIntervalCosheaf.glue_comp_map hFc
    (I := fun q : {q : Piece n // S.piece q ≤ U} => S.piece q.1)
    (L := fun q : {q : Piece n // S.piece q ≤ V} => S.piece q.1) hUV
    (fun p : {p : Piece n // S.piece p ≤ U} =>
      (⟨p.1, p.2.trans hUV⟩ : {p : Piece n // S.piece p ≤ V}))
    (fun _ => le_rfl) (G.map (homOfLE hUV)) (fun p e => by
      dsimp only [pieceFamily]
      rw [map_self_apply, map_map_apply_of_thin G _ _ (homOfLE (p.2.trans hUV))]) x

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.envelopeExtension_app
statement:
theorem envelopeExtension_app (I : OpenInterval) (x : F.obj (S.envelope I)) :
    (φ.envelopeExtension hF hFc).app I x = φ.extendNormal hF hFc (S.envelope_envelope I) x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.bijective_map_unit
statement:
theorem _root_.TDA.Reeb.bijective_map_unit {N : OpenInterval ⥤ OpenInterval}
    {η : 𝟭 OpenInterval ⟶ N} (hG : S.IsConstructibleAt G) (hGc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{w} G)
    (hhit : ∀ I : OpenInterval, (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty → ∀ i, S.value i ∈ I ↔ S.value i ∈ N.obj I)
    (hbot : ∀ I : OpenInterval, ¬ (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty → N.obj I = ⊥) (I : OpenInterval) :
    Function.Bijective (G.map (η.app I))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty
  · rw [← homOfLE_leOfHom (η.app I)]
    exact hG.bijective _ hI (hhit I hI)
  · have hle : I ≤ ⊥ := OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => (hI ⟨x, hx⟩).elim
    have h₁ := isEmpty_of_le_bot hGc.isEmpty_obj_bot hle
    have h₂ := isEmpty_of_le_bot hGc.isEmpty_obj_bot (hbot I hI).le
    exact ⟨fun a => (h₁.false a).elim, fun b => (h₂.false b).elim⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.bijective_map_envelopeUnit
statement:
theorem bijective_map_envelopeUnit (hG : S.IsConstructibleAt G) (hGc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{w} G)
    (I : OpenInterval) : Function.Bijective (G.map (S.envelopeUnit.app I))
proof:
:=
  bijective_map_unit hG hGc (fun _ hI i => (S.value_mem_envelope_iff hI i).symm)
    (fun _ hI => S.envelope_eq_bot hI) I

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.map_extend_app
statement:
theorem map_extend_app (I : OpenInterval) (x : F.obj I) :
    G.map (homOfLE (S.le_envelope I)) ((φ.extend hF hFc hG hGc).app I x) =
      φ.extendNormal hF hFc (S.envelope_envelope I) (F.map (homOfLE (S.le_envelope I)) x)
proof:
:=
  map_transport_app (bijective_map_envelopeUnit hG hGc) (φ.envelopeExtension hF hFc) I x

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.extend_app_piece
statement:
theorem extend_app_piece (p : Piece n) (x : F.obj (S.piece p)) :
    (φ.extend hF hFc hG hGc).app (S.piece p) x = φ.onPiece hF p x
proof:
:= by
  apply (bijective_map_envelopeUnit hG hGc (S.piece p)).injective
  refine (φ.map_extend_app hF hFc hG hGc _ x).trans ?_
  exact φ.extendNormal_map hF hFc (S.envelope_envelope _) (S.le_envelope _) x

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.restrict_extend
statement: theorem restrict_extend : S.restrict (φ.extend hF hFc hG hGc) = φ
proof:
:=
  ShortMaps.ext (funext fun i => funext fun x => φ.extend_app_piece hF hFc hG hGc (.star i) x)
    (funext fun e => funext fun x => φ.extend_app_piece hF hFc hG hGc (.gap e) x)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.extend_app_J
statement:
theorem extend_app_J (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : F.obj (S.J i)) :
    (φ.extend hF hFc hG hGc).app (S.J i) x = φ.star i x
proof:
:=
  φ.extend_app_piece hF hFc hG hGc (.star i) x

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.extend_app_K
statement:
theorem extend_app_K (e : Fin n) (x : F.obj (S.K e)) :
    (φ.extend hF hFc hG hGc).app (S.K e) x = φ.gap e x
proof:
:=
  φ.extend_app_piece hF hFc hG hGc (.gap e) x

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.restrict_onPiece
statement:
theorem restrict_onPiece (α : F ⟶ G) (hF : S.IsConstructibleAt F) (p : Piece n)
    (x : F.obj (S.piece p)) : (S.restrict α).onPiece hF p x = α.app (S.piece p) x
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | star i => rfl
  | gap e => rfl
  | lowerTail => exact (hF.isEmpty_lowerTail.false x).elim
  | upperTail => exact (hF.isEmpty_upperTail.false x).elim

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.extend_restrict
statement:
theorem ShortMaps.extend_restrict (α : F ⟶ G) (hF : S.IsConstructibleAt F)
    (hFc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} F) (hG : S.IsConstructibleAt G)
    (hGc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} G) : (S.restrict α).extend hF hFc hG hGc = α
proof:
:= by
  refine (eq_transport_of_apply _ _ α fun I x => ?_).symm
  refine (NatTrans.naturality_apply α (S.envelopeUnit.app I) x).symm.trans ?_
  show α.app (S.envelope I) _ = (S.restrict α).extendNormal hF hFc (S.envelope_envelope I) _
  refine congrFun ((S.restrict α).eq_extendNormal hF hFc (S.envelope_envelope I)
    (fun y => α.app (S.envelope I) y) fun p h y => ?_) _
  dsimp only
  rw [NatTrans.naturality_apply, restrict_onPiece]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.natTransEquivDiagramHom_apply
statement:
theorem natTransEquivDiagramHom_apply (hF : S.IsConstructibleAt F)
    (hFc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} F) (hG : S.IsConstructibleAt G) (hGc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} G)
    (α : F ⟶ G) : S.natTransEquivDiagramHom hF hFc hG hGc α = S.restrictHom hF hG α
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.restrict_injective
statement:
theorem restrict_injective (hF : S.IsConstructibleAt F) (hFc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} F)
    (hG : S.IsConstructibleAt G) (hGc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} G) :
    Function.Injective (S.restrict : (F ⟶ G) → S.ShortMaps F G)
proof:
:=
  (S.natTransEquivShortMaps hF hFc hG hGc).injective

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.natTrans_ext
statement:
theorem natTrans_ext (hF : S.IsConstructibleAt F) (hFc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} F)
    (hG : S.IsConstructibleAt G) (hGc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} G) {α β : F ⟶ G}
    (hJ : ∀ i x, α.app (S.J i) x = β.app (S.J i) x)
    (hK : ∀ e x, α.app (S.K e) x = β.app (S.K e) x) : α = β
proof:
:=
  S.restrict_injective hF hFc hG hGc (ShortMaps.ext (funext fun i => funext fun x => hJ i x)
    (funext fun e => funext fun x => hK e x))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.isIso_iff_shortIntervals
statement:
theorem isIso_iff_shortIntervals (hF : S.IsConstructibleAt F) (hFc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} F)
    (hG : S.IsConstructibleAt G) (hGc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} G) (α : F ⟶ G) :
    IsIso α ↔ (∀ i, Function.Bijective (α.app (S.J i))) ∧
      ∀ e, Function.Bijective (α.app (S.K e))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact ⟨fun i => (isIso_iff_bijective _).1 inferInstance,
      fun e => (isIso_iff_bijective _).1 inferInstance⟩
  · rintro ⟨hv, he⟩
    let ψ : S.ShortMaps G F := (S.restrict α).inv hv he
    refine ⟨⟨ψ.extend hG hGc hF hFc, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · apply S.restrict_injective hF hFc hF hFc
      rw [restrict_comp, restrict_id, ψ.restrict_extend]
      exact ShortMaps.comp_inv _ hv he
    · apply S.restrict_injective hG hGc hG hGc
      rw [restrict_comp, restrict_id, ψ.restrict_extend]
      exact ShortMaps.inv_comp _ hv he

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.isIso_extend
statement:
theorem ShortMaps.isIso_extend (φ : S.ShortMaps F G) (hF : S.IsConstructibleAt F)
    (hFc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} F) (hG : S.IsConstructibleAt G) (hGc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} G)
    (hv : ∀ i, Function.Bijective (φ.star i)) (he : ∀ e, Function.Bijective (φ.gap e)) :
    IsIso (φ.extend hF hFc hG hGc)
proof:
:= by
  refine (S.isIso_iff_shortIntervals hF hFc hG hGc _).2 ⟨fun i => ?_, fun e => ?_⟩
  · convert hv i using 1
    exact funext fun x => φ.extend_app_J hF hFc hG hGc i x
  · convert he e using 1
    exact funext fun x => φ.extend_app_K hF hFc hG hGc e x

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.starFamily_compat
statement:
theorem starFamily_compat (φ : S.ShortMaps F G) (hFc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{w} F)
    {U : OpenInterval} (hU : S.envelope U = U) (i j : {i : Fin (n + 1) // S.value i ∈ U})
    (c : F.obj (S.J i.1 ⊓ S.J j.1)) :
    φ.starFamily hU i (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) =
      φ.starFamily hU j (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := i
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := j
  simp only [starFamily]
  rcases lt_trichotomy (i.val + 1) j.val with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exact ((isEmpty_of_le_bot hFc.isEmpty_obj_bot (S.J_inf_J_eq_bot hlt).le).false c).elim
  · have he : ∃ e : Fin n, i = e.castSucc ∧ j = e.succ :=
      ⟨⟨i.val, by omega⟩, Fin.ext rfl, Fin.ext (by simp; omega)⟩
    obtain ⟨e, rfl, rfl⟩ := he
    exact compat_of_inf_le _ _ (S.K_le_J_castSucc e) (S.K_le_J_succ e)
      (S.J_castSucc_inf_J_succ e).le _ _ (φ.gap e) (φ.left_comm e) (φ.right_comm e) c
  · rcases lt_trichotomy (j.val + 1) i.val with hlt' | heq' | hgt'
    · exact ((isEmpty_of_le_bot hFc.isEmpty_obj_bot
        (by rw [inf_comm]; exact (S.J_inf_J_eq_bot hlt').le)).false c).elim
    · have he : ∃ e : Fin n, j = e.castSucc ∧ i = e.succ :=
        ⟨⟨j.val, by omega⟩, Fin.ext rfl, Fin.ext (by simp; omega)⟩
      obtain ⟨e, rfl, rfl⟩ := he
      exact compat_of_inf_le _ _ (S.K_le_J_succ e) (S.K_le_J_castSucc e)
        (by rw [inf_comm]; exact (S.J_castSucc_inf_J_succ e).le) _ _ (φ.gap e)
        (φ.right_comm e) (φ.left_comm e) c
    · obtain rfl : i = j := Fin.ext (by omega)
      rw [map_apply_eq_of_thin F (homOfLE inf_le_left) (homOfLE inf_le_right) c]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.ShortMaps.extend_app_eq_starGlue
statement:
theorem extend_app_eq_starGlue (φ : S.ShortMaps F G) (hF : S.IsConstructibleAt F)
    (hFc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} F) (hG : S.IsConstructibleAt G) (hGc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} G)
    {U : OpenInterval} (hU : S.envelope U = U) (hhit : ∃ i, S.value i ∈ U) :
    ⇑((φ.extend hF hFc hG hGc).app U) = φ.starGlue hFc hU hhit
proof:
:=
  IsIntervalCosheaf.eq_glue hFc _ fun i x => by
    rw [NatTrans.naturality_apply, φ.extend_app_J hF hFc hG hGc]
    rfl
