name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.zero_mem_frag
statement: theorem zero_mem_frag : (0 : ℝ) ∈ frag S01 0 (-1 / 2) (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [frag]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.quarter_mem_frag
statement: theorem quarter_mem_frag : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ∈ frag S01 0 (-1 / 2) (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [frag]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.pw_glued
statement:
theorem pw_glued (b : Bool) :
    windowCover S01 parallelData _ _ (pwEdge b ⟨0, zero_mem_frag⟩) =
      windowCover S01 parallelData _ _ pwVertex
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  have hs : (⟨0, frag_subset_seg zero_mem_frag⟩ : Seg S01 0) = segBot S01 0 :=
    Subtype.ext (by simp [segBot])
  change (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofCylinder S01 0 (b, ⟨0, frag_subset_seg zero_mem_frag⟩) =
    (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofVertex S01 0 ()
  rw [hs]
  exact (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofCylinder_segBot S01 0 b

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.pw_separate
statement:
theorem pw_separate :
    windowCover S01 parallelData _ _ (pwEdge false ⟨1 / 4, quarter_mem_frag⟩) ≠
      windowCover S01 parallelData _ _ (pwEdge true ⟨1 / 4, quarter_mem_frag⟩)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have ht : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ∈ (S01.K 0 : Set ℝ) :=
    ⟨by rw [Fin.castSucc_zero, S01_value_zero]; norm_num,
      by rw [Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_one]; norm_num⟩
  have h' : (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofStrip S01 0 (false, ⟨_, ht⟩) =
      (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofStrip S01 0 (true, ⟨_, ht⟩) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val h
  exact Bool.false_ne_true
    (congrArg Prod.fst ((ofFiniteData parallelData).ofStrip_injective S01 0 h'))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.S01_shifted_zero
statement: theorem S01_shifted_zero : (S01.shifted 1).value 0 = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [S01.shifted_value_zero, S01_value_zero, NNReal.coe_one]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.S01_shiftedCount_pos
statement: theorem S01_shiftedCount_pos : 0 < S01.shiftedCount 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (-1 : ℝ) ∈ S01.shiftedSet 1 := by
    have := S01.sub_mem_shiftedSet 1 0
    rwa [S01_value_zero, NNReal.coe_one, zero_sub] at this
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ∈ S01.shiftedSet 1 := by
    have := S01.add_mem_shiftedSet 1 1
    rw [S01_value_one, NNReal.coe_one] at this
    norm_num at this
    exact this
  have hc : 1 < (S01.shiftedSet 1).card := Finset.one_lt_card.2 ⟨_, h1, _, h2, by norm_num⟩
  have := S01.card_shiftedSet 1
  omega

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.k0_castSucc
statement: theorem k0_castSucc : (k0.castSucc : Fin (S01.shiftedCount 1 + 1)) = 0
proof:
:=
  Fin.ext (by simp [k0])

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.coe_segBot_k0
statement: theorem coe_segBot_k0 : ((segBot (S01.shifted 1) k0 : Seg (S01.shifted 1) k0) : ℝ) = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ((segBot (S01.shifted 1) k0 : Seg (S01.shifted 1) k0) : ℝ) =
    (S01.shifted 1).value k0.castSucc from rfl, k0_castSucc, S01_shifted_zero]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.S01_shifted_one_le
statement: theorem S01_shifted_one_le : (S01.shifted 1).value k0.succ ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := S01.exists_shifted_value_eq_sub 1 1
  rw [S01_value_one, NNReal.coe_one, sub_self] at hj
  have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [S01_shifted_zero] at hj
    norm_num at hj
  have hjv : j.val ≠ 0 := fun h => hj0 (Fin.ext (by simpa using h))
  have hle : k0.succ ≤ j := by
    rw [Fin.le_def, Fin.val_succ]
    show 0 + 1 ≤ j.val
    omega
  exact ((S01.shifted 1).strictMono.monotone hle).trans_eq hj

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.mid_k0_bounds
statement: theorem mid_k0_bounds : -1 < mid S01 1 k0 ∧ mid S01 1 k0 < 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := mid_mem_K S01 1 k0
  have h1 : (S01.shifted 1).value k0.castSucc < mid S01 1 k0 := h.1
  have h2 : mid S01 1 k0 < (S01.shifted 1).value k0.succ := h.2
  rw [k0_castSucc, S01_shifted_zero] at h1
  exact ⟨h1, h2.trans_le S01_shifted_one_le⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.s0_mem
statement:
theorem s0_mem : (mid S01 1 k0 + 1) / 2 ∈
    frag S01 0 (mid S01 1 k0 - ((1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) (mid S01 1 k0 + ((1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hb := mid_k0_bounds
  rw [NNReal.coe_one]
  simp only [frag, Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_zero, S01_value_one]
  exact ⟨max_le (by linarith [hb.1]) (by linarith [hb.2]),
    le_min (by linarith [hb.2]) (by linarith [hb.1])⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.collapsePt_ne
statement: theorem collapsePt_ne : collapsePt false ≠ collapsePt true
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hb := mid_k0_bounds
  have ht : (mid S01 1 k0 + 1) / 2 ∈ (S01.K 0 : Set ℝ) :=
    ⟨by rw [Fin.castSucc_zero, S01_value_zero]; linarith [hb.1],
      by rw [Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_one]; linarith [hb.2]⟩
  have h' : (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofStrip S01 0 (false, ⟨_, ht⟩) =
      (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofStrip S01 0 (true, ⟨_, ht⟩) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val h
  exact Bool.false_ne_true
    (congrArg Prod.fst ((ofFiniteData parallelData).ofStrip_injective S01 0 h'))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.left_collapse_apply
statement:
theorem left_collapse_apply (b : Bool) :
    ((thickPresentation S01 parallelData 1).left k0 (collapsePt b)).1 =
      (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofVertex S01 0 ()
proof:
:= by
  have hok := transferOK_of_mem S01 1 (mid_mem_K S01 1 k0) (segBot (S01.shifted 1) k0).2
  change (windowTransfer S01 parallelData 1 hok (collapsePt b) :
    (ofFiniteData parallelData).Realization S01) = _
  rw [coe_windowTransfer_ofCylinder S01 parallelData 1 hok s0_mem (collapsePt b) (y := b) rfl]
  have hz : fragAff (S01.value (Fin.castSucc 0)) (S01.value (Fin.succ 0)) ((1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)
      (mid S01 1 k0) ((segBot (S01.shifted 1) k0 : Seg (S01.shifted 1) k0) : ℝ)
      ((mid S01 1 k0 + 1) / 2) = S01.value (Fin.castSucc 0) := by
    rw [fragAff_collapse]
    · rw [coe_segBot_k0, Fin.castSucc_zero, S01_value_zero, NNReal.coe_one]
      norm_num
    · rw [coe_segBot_k0, Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_zero, S01_value_one,
        NNReal.coe_one]
      norm_num
  have hseg : (⟨_, frag_subset_seg (hok.fragAff_mem s0_mem)⟩ : Seg S01 0) = segBot S01 0 :=
    Subtype.ext hz
  rw [hseg]
  exact (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofCylinder_segBot S01 0 b

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.left_collapse
statement:

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.pwFull_glued_bot
statement:
theorem pwFull_glued_bot (b : Bool) :
    windowCover S01 parallelData _ _ (pwFullEdge b ⟨0, zero_mem_fragFull⟩) =
      windowCover S01 parallelData _ _ pwFullBot
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  have hs : (⟨0, frag_subset_seg zero_mem_fragFull⟩ : Seg S01 0) = segBot S01 0 :=
    Subtype.ext (by simp [segBot])
  change (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofCylinder S01 0
      (b, ⟨0, frag_subset_seg zero_mem_fragFull⟩) = (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofVertex S01 0 ()
  rw [hs]
  exact (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofCylinder_segBot S01 0 b

  change (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofCylinder S01 0

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.touch_eq_vertex
statement:
theorem touch_eq_vertex (r : WindowRaw S01 parallelData 1 (3 / 2)) :
    windowCover S01 parallelData 1 (3 / 2) r =
      windowCover S01 parallelData 1 (3 / 2) touchVertex
proof:
:= by
  rcases r with ⟨⟨i, v⟩, hi⟩ | ⟨⟨e, b⟩, s, hs⟩
  · obtain rfl : i = 1 := by
      have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) := hi.1
      have h2 := i.isLt
      have h3 := Nat.one_le_cast.1 h1
      exact Fin.ext (by simp only [Fin.val_one]; omega)
    rfl
  · obtain rfl : e = 0 := Fin.fin_one_eq_zero e
    have hs1 : s = 1 := le_antisymm
      (hs.2.trans ((min_le_left _ _).trans_eq (by simp)))
      ((le_max_right _ _).trans hs.1)
    subst hs1
    exact touch_glued b

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.pwTouch_subsingleton

    obtain ⟨r', rfl⟩ := windowCover_surjective S01 parallelData 1 (3 / 2) y
    rw [touch_eq_vertex r, touch_eq_vertex r']⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.pwMid_isEmpty_V
statement: theorem pwMid_isEmpty_V : IsEmpty (WindowV S01 parallelData (1 / 4) (3 / 4))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨⟨i, _⟩, hi⟩ => by
    have h1 : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) := hi.1
    have h2 : ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4 := hi.2
    have hi2 := i.isLt
    have h : (i : ℕ) = 0 ∨ (i : ℕ) = 1 := by omega
    rcases h with h | h
    · rw [h] at h1
      norm_num at h1
    · rw [h] at h2
      norm_num at h2⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.pwMidRawLabel_factors
statement:
theorem pwMidRawLabel_factors :
    Function.FactorsThrough pwMidRawLabel (windowCover S01 parallelData (1 / 4) (3 / 4))
proof:
:= by
  rintro (v | ⟨⟨e, b⟩, s, hs⟩) (v' | ⟨⟨e', b'⟩, s', hs'⟩) h
  · exact (pwMid_isEmpty_V.false v).elim
  · exact (pwMid_isEmpty_V.false v).elim
  · exact (pwMid_isEmpty_V.false v').elim
  · obtain rfl : e = 0 := Fin.fin_one_eq_zero e
    obtain rfl : e' = 0 := Fin.fin_one_eq_zero e'
    have hK : ∀ {r : ℝ}, r ∈ frag S01 0 (1 / 4) (3 / 4) → r ∈ (S01.K 0 : Set ℝ) := fun hr =>
      ⟨by rw [Fin.castSucc_zero, S01_value_zero]; linarith [(le_max_right _ _).trans hr.1],
        by rw [Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_one]; linarith [hr.2.trans (min_le_right _ _)]⟩
    have h' : (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofStrip S01 0 (b, ⟨s, hK hs⟩) =
        (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofStrip S01 0 (b', ⟨s', hK hs'⟩) :=
      congrArg Subtype.val h
    have hb := congrArg Prod.fst ((ofFiniteData parallelData).ofStrip_injective S01 0 h')
    exact hb

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.pwMidLabel_windowCover
statement:
theorem pwMidLabel_windowCover (r : WindowRaw S01 parallelData (1 / 4) (3 / 4)) :
    pwMidLabel (windowCover S01 parallelData _ _ r) = pwMidRawLabel r
proof:
:= by
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun (IsQuotientMap.lift_comp
    (isQuotientMap_windowCover S01 parallelData (1 / 4) (3 / 4)) pwMidRawLabel
    pwMidRawLabel_factors) r
  rw [ContinuousMap.comp_apply] at this
  exact this

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.singleton_snd_ofStrip
statement:
theorem singleton_snd_ofStrip (a : ℝ) {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 0 < ε)
    (k : Fin ((single a).shiftedCount ε)) (x : (thickPresentation (single a) pt0 ε).E k)
    (t : (((single a).shifted ε).K k : Set ℝ)) :
    ((thickProdHomeomorph (single a) pt0 ε hε
      ((thickPresentation (single a) pt0 ε).ofStrip _ k (x, t))).2 : ℝ) = t - a
proof:
:= by
  rw [snd_thickProdHomeomorph_ofStrip]
  have h := (ofFiniteData pt0).height_mem_Icc (single a)
    (windowTransfer (single a) pt0 ε
      (transferOK_of_mem (single a) ε (mid_mem_K (single a) ε k) (Ioo_subset_Icc_self t.2)) x :
        (ofFiniteData pt0).Realization (single a))
  rw [le_antisymm h.2 h.1]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.singleEdge_strip_height
statement:
theorem singleEdge_strip_height {s : ℝ}
    (hs : s ∈ frag S01 0 (mid S01 1 k0 - ((1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) (mid S01 1 k0 + ((1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))
    (x : (thickPresentation S01 singleEdge 1).E k0) {y : singleEdge.E 0}
    (hx : x.1 = (ofFiniteData singleEdge).ofCylinder S01 0 (y, ⟨s, frag_subset_seg hs⟩))
    (t : ((S01.shifted 1).K k0 : Set ℝ)) :
    (ofFiniteData singleEdge).height S01 (thickProdHomeomorph S01 singleEdge 1 one_pos
      ((thickPresentation S01 singleEdge 1).ofStrip _ k0 (x, t))).1 =
        s * ((t + 1) / (mid S01 1 k0 + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [fst_thickProdHomeomorph_ofStrip, coe_windowTransfer_ofCylinder S01 singleEdge 1 _ hs x hx]
  have hb := mid_k0_bounds
  have ht1 : -1 < (t : ℝ) := by
    have := t.2.1
    rwa [k0_castSucc, S01_shifted_zero] at this
  have ht2 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 0 := t.2.2.le.trans S01_shifted_one_le
  show fragAff (S01.value (Fin.castSucc 0)) (S01.value (Fin.succ 0)) ((1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)
    (mid S01 1 k0) t s = _
  have e1 : max (0 : ℝ) ((t : ℝ) - 1) = 0 := max_eq_left (by linarith)
  have e2 : max (0 : ℝ) (mid S01 1 k0 - 1) = 0 := max_eq_left (by linarith [hb.2])
  have e3 : min (1 : ℝ) ((t : ℝ) + 1) = t + 1 := min_eq_right (by linarith)
  have e4 : min (1 : ℝ) (mid S01 1 k0 + 1) = mid S01 1 k0 + 1 := min_eq_right (by linarith [hb.2])
  simp only [fragAff, Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_zero, S01_value_one,
    NNReal.coe_one]
  rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
  ring

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.fragAff_segBot_k0
statement:
theorem fragAff_segBot_k0 (s : ℝ) :
    fragAff (S01.value (Fin.castSucc 0)) (S01.value (Fin.succ 0)) ((1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)
      (mid S01 1 k0) ((segBot (S01.shifted 1) k0 : Seg (S01.shifted 1) k0) : ℝ) s =
        S01.value (Fin.castSucc 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fragAff_collapse]
  · rw [coe_segBot_k0, Fin.castSucc_zero, S01_value_zero, NNReal.coe_one]
    norm_num
  · rw [coe_segBot_k0, Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_zero, S01_value_one,
      NNReal.coe_one]
    norm_num

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.twoSeg_left_apply
statement:
theorem twoSeg_left_apply (b : Bool) :
    ((thickPresentation S01 twoSegData 1).left k0 (twoSegPt b)).1 =
      (ofFiniteData twoSegData).ofVertex S01 0 b
proof:
:= by
  have hok := transferOK_of_mem S01 1 (mid_mem_K S01 1 k0) (segBot (S01.shifted 1) k0).2
  change (windowTransfer S01 twoSegData 1 hok (twoSegPt b) :
    (ofFiniteData twoSegData).Realization S01) = _
  rw [coe_windowTransfer_ofCylinder S01 twoSegData 1 hok s0_mem (twoSegPt b) (y := b) rfl]
  have hseg : (⟨_, frag_subset_seg (hok.fragAff_mem s0_mem)⟩ : Seg S01 0) = segBot S01 0 :=
    Subtype.ext (fragAff_segBot_k0 _)
  rw [hseg]
  exact (ofFiniteData twoSegData).ofCylinder_segBot S01 0 b

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.coe_halfNN
statement: @[simp] theorem coe_halfNN : (halfNN : ℝ) = 1 / 2
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.S01_shiftedSet_half
statement: theorem S01_shiftedSet_half : S01.shiftedSet halfNN = {-1 / 2, 1 / 2, 3 / 2}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [CriticalValues.mem_shiftedSet]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, h | h⟩ <;> fin_cases i <;> norm_num [S01] at h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num
  · intro h
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h
    rcases h with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨0, Or.inl (by norm_num [S01])⟩
    · exact ⟨0, Or.inr (by norm_num [S01])⟩
    · exact ⟨1, Or.inr (by norm_num [S01])⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.S01_shiftedCount_half
statement: theorem S01_shiftedCount_half : S01.shiftedCount halfNN = 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold CriticalValues.shiftedCount
  rw [S01_shiftedSet_half, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by norm_num),
    Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by norm_num), Finset.card_singleton]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.S01_shifted_half_first
statement: theorem S01_shifted_half_first : (S01.shifted halfNN).value 0 = -1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [CriticalValues.shifted_value_zero, S01_value_zero, coe_halfNN]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.S01_shifted_half_last
statement: theorem S01_shifted_half_last : (S01.shifted halfNN).value (Fin.last _) = 3 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [CriticalValues.shifted_value_last, show Fin.last 1 = 1 from rfl, S01_value_one, coe_halfNN]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.S01_shifted_half_middle
statement: theorem S01_shifted_half_middle : (S01.shifted halfNN).value kc = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : (S01.shifted halfNN).value kc ∈ Set.range (S01.shifted halfNN).value := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [CriticalValues.range_shifted, S01_shiftedSet_half] at hmem
  have h0 : (S01.shifted halfNN).value 0 < (S01.shifted halfNN).value kc :=
    (S01.shifted halfNN).strictMono (by simp [Fin.lt_def, kc])
  have h2 : (S01.shifted halfNN).value kc < (S01.shifted halfNN).value (Fin.last _) :=
    (S01.shifted halfNN).strictMono (by simp [Fin.lt_def, kc, S01_shiftedCount_half])
  rw [S01_shifted_half_first] at h0
  rw [S01_shifted_half_last] at h2
  simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_insert_iff,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hmem
  rcases hmem with h | h | h
  · linarith
  · exact h
  · linarith

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.kh_castSucc
statement: theorem kh_castSucc : (kh.castSucc : Fin (S01.shiftedCount halfNN + 1)) = 0
proof:
:=
  Fin.ext (by simp [kh])

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.kh_succ
statement: theorem kh_succ : kh.succ = kc
proof:
:=
  Fin.ext (by simp [kh, kc])

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.mid_kh
statement: theorem mid_kh : mid S01 halfNN kh = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold mid
  rw [kh_castSucc, kh_succ, S01_shifted_half_first, S01_shifted_half_middle]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.collision_window_eq_univ
statement:
theorem collision_window_eq_univ :
    win S01 singleEdge halfNN ((S01.shifted halfNN).value kc) = univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [S01_shifted_half_middle]
  refine eq_univ_of_forall fun x => ?_
  have h := (ofFiniteData singleEdge).height_mem_Icc S01 x
  rw [S01_value_zero, show Fin.last 1 = 1 from rfl, S01_value_one] at h
  show (ofFiniteData singleEdge).height S01 x ∈ Icc (1 / 2 - (halfNN : ℝ)) (1 / 2 + (halfNN : ℝ))
  rw [coe_halfNN]
  exact ⟨by linarith [h.1], by linarith [h.2]⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.half_mem_fragCollision
statement:
theorem half_mem_fragCollision :
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈
      frag S01 0 (mid S01 halfNN kh - (halfNN : ℝ)) (mid S01 halfNN kh + (halfNN : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mid_kh, coe_halfNN]
  norm_num [frag]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphThickening.collision_right_apply
statement:
theorem collision_right_apply :
    ((thickPresentation S01 singleEdge halfNN).right kh collisionTop).1 =
      (ofFiniteData singleEdge).ofVertex S01 1 ()
proof:
:= by
  have hok := transferOK_of_mem S01 halfNN (mid_mem_K S01 halfNN kh)
    (segTop (S01.shifted halfNN) kh).2
  change (windowTransfer S01 singleEdge halfNN hok collisionTop :
    (ofFiniteData singleEdge).Realization S01) = _
  rw [coe_windowTransfer_ofCylinder S01 singleEdge halfNN hok half_mem_fragCollision collisionTop
    (y := ()) rfl]
  have htop : ((segTop (S01.shifted halfNN) kh : Seg (S01.shifted halfNN) kh) : ℝ) = 1 / 2 := by
    show (S01.shifted halfNN).value kh.succ = 1 / 2
    rw [kh_succ, S01_shifted_half_middle]
  have hz : fragAff (S01.value (Fin.castSucc 0)) (S01.value (Fin.succ 0)) (halfNN : ℝ)
      (mid S01 halfNN kh) ((segTop (S01.shifted halfNN) kh : Seg (S01.shifted halfNN) kh) : ℝ)
      (1 / 2) = S01.value (Fin.succ 0) := by
    rw [htop, mid_kh, coe_halfNN]
    simp only [fragAff, Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_zero, S01_value_one]
    norm_num
  have hseg : (⟨_, frag_subset_seg (hok.fragAff_mem half_mem_fragCollision)⟩ : Seg S01 0) =
      segTop S01 0 :=
    Subtype.ext hz
  rw [hseg]
  exact (ofFiniteData singleEdge).ofCylinder_segTop S01 0 ()

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleQuotient.locallyPathConnectedSpace_unitInterval
statement: theorem locallyPathConnectedSpace_unitInterval : LocallyPathConnectedSpace unitInterval
proof:
:= by
  refine LocallyPathConnectedSpace.of_bases (p := fun _ (ε : ℝ) => 0 < ε)
    (s := fun x ε => ((↑) : unitInterval → ℝ) ⁻¹' Ioo ((x : ℝ) - ε) (x + ε)) (fun x => ?_)
    fun x ε hε => ?_
  · rw [nhds_subtype]
    exact (nhds_basis_Ioo_pos (x : ℝ)).comap _
  · have hW : IsPathConnected (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ Ioo ((x : ℝ) - ε) (x + ε)) :=
      ((convex_Icc (𝕜 := ℝ) _ _).inter (convex_Ioo _ _)).isPathConnected
        ⟨(x : ℝ), x.2, by constructor <;> linarith⟩
    have := hW.preimage_coe (U := Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) inter_subset_left
    rwa [Subtype.preimage_coe_self_inter] at this

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleQuotient.mk_prod_zero_bijective

theorem mk_prod_zero_bijective (A : Type) [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A] :
    Function.Bijective fun a : A =>
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk (a, (0 : unitInterval)) : ZerothHomotopy (A × unitInterval))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a a' h => ?_, fun c => ?_⟩
  · exact joined_eq_of_discrete ((Quotient.exact h : Joined _ _).map continuous_fst)
  · induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk p =>
      exact ⟨p.1, ZerothHomotopy.sound
        ((Path.refl p.1).prod (PathConnectedSpace.somePath (0 : unitInterval) p.2))⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleQuotient.thicken_vertexClass_eq_iff
statement:
theorem thicken_vertexClass_eq_iff (D : FiniteReebData.{0} n) (i : Fin (n + 1))

    (thicken D).vertexClass i (a, s) = (thicken D).vertexClass i (a', s') ↔ a = a'
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexClass_eq_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact joined_eq_of_discrete (h.map continuous_fst)
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨(Path.refl a).prod (PathConnectedSpace.somePath s s')⟩

proof:

  constructor

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleQuotient.twoPieces_ne
statement:
theorem twoPieces_ne :
    ReebQuotient.mk (twoPieces.height S0) (twoPt 0 0) ≠
      ReebQuotient.mk (twoPieces.height S0) (twoPt 1 0)
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have h1 : (ofFiniteData twoPieces.componentData).ofVertex S0 0
        (twoPieces.vertexClass 0 ((0 : Fin 2), (0 : unitInterval))) =
      (ofFiniteData twoPieces.componentData).ofVertex S0 0
        (twoPieces.vertexClass 0 ((1 : Fin 2), (0 : unitInterval))) :=
    congrArg (twoPieces.quotientComponentGraphMap S0) h
  have h2 : (0 : Fin 2) = 1 :=
    (thicken_vertexClass_eq_iff D0 0 _ _ 0 0).1
      ((ofFiniteData twoPieces.componentData).ofVertex_injective S0 0 h1)
  exact absurd h2 (by decide)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleQuotient.twoPieces_collapse
statement:
theorem twoPieces_collapse (b : Fin 2) (s : unitInterval) :
    ReebQuotient.mk (twoPieces.height S0) (twoPt b s) =
      ReebQuotient.mk (twoPieces.height S0) (twoPt b 0)
proof:
:=
  twoPieces.quotientComponentGraphMap_injective S0
    (congrArg ((ofFiniteData twoPieces.componentData).ofVertex S0 0)
      ((thicken_vertexClass_eq_iff D0 0 b b s 0).2 rfl))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleQuotient.twoPieces_cases
statement:
theorem twoPieces_cases (q : ReebQuotient (twoPieces.height S0)) :
    q = ReebQuotient.mk _ (twoPt 0 0) ∨ q = ReebQuotient.mk _ (twoPt 1 0)
proof:
:= by
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h x =>
    obtain ⟨⟨a, s⟩, rfl⟩ := ofVertex_surjective_zero S0 twoPieces x
    have key : ∀ b : Fin 2, ∀ s : unitInterval,
        ReebQuotient.mk (twoPieces.height S0) (twoPt b s) = ReebQuotient.mk _ (twoPt 0 0) ∨
          ReebQuotient.mk (twoPieces.height S0) (twoPt b s) = ReebQuotient.mk _ (twoPt 1 0) := by
      intro b s
      rw [twoPieces_collapse b s]
      exact (Fin.forall_fin_two (p := fun b : Fin 2 =>
        ReebQuotient.mk (twoPieces.height S0) (twoPt b 0) = ReebQuotient.mk _ (twoPt 0 0) ∨
          ReebQuotient.mk (twoPieces.height S0) (twoPt b 0) =
            ReebQuotient.mk _ (twoPt 1 0))).2 ⟨Or.inl rfl, Or.inr rfl⟩ b
    exact key a s

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleQuotient.bumpVal_mem
statement:
theorem bumpVal_mem {s t : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    bumpVal s t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hs0, hs1⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨ht0, ht1⟩ := ht
  unfold bumpVal
  constructor
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg ht0 (sub_nonneg.2 ht1)) (sub_nonneg.2 hs1)]
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hs1) (sq_nonneg (t - 1 / 2))]

  have h : (t : ℝ) ∈ Icc (S01.value (Fin.castSucc 0)) (S01.value (Fin.succ 0)) := t.2
  simpa only [Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_zero, S01_value_one] using h

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleQuotient.twist_regularFiberMap
statement:
theorem twist_regularFiberMap (t : (S01.K 0 : Set ℝ)) (b : Bool) (s : unitInterval) :
    regularFiberMap S01 twist height_twist 0 t (b, s) = (flipE 0 b, bumpI s t (K01_mem t))
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : parallelI.ofStrip S01 0 (regularFiberMap S01 twist height_twist 0 t (b, s), t) =
      parallelI.ofStrip S01 0 ((flipE 0 b, bumpI s t (K01_mem t)), t) :=
    (map_ofStrip_eq S01 twist height_twist 0 t (b, s)).symm.trans rfl
  exact congrArg Prod.fst (parallelI.ofStrip_injective S01 0 h2)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleQuotient.twist_regularFiberMap_depends
statement:
theorem twist_regularFiberMap_depends :
    regularFiberMap S01 twist height_twist 0 half ≠
      regularFiberMap S01 twist height_twist 0 threeQuarters
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have h1 := congrArg (fun g : C(parallelI.E 0, parallelI.E 0) =>
    ((g ((false : Bool), (0 : unitInterval))).2 : ℝ)) h
  have e1 : ((regularFiberMap S01 twist height_twist 0 half
      ((false : Bool), (0 : unitInterval))).2 : ℝ) = bumpVal 0 (1 / 2) := by
    rw [twist_regularFiberMap]
    rfl
  have e2 : ((regularFiberMap S01 twist height_twist 0 threeQuarters
      ((false : Bool), (0 : unitInterval))).2 : ℝ) = bumpVal 0 (3 / 4) := by
    rw [twist_regularFiberMap]
    rfl
  have h2 : bumpVal 0 (1 / 2) = bumpVal 0 (3 / 4) := e1.symm.trans (h1.trans e2)
  norm_num [bumpVal] at h2

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleQuotient.twist_componentDataHom_e

      parallelI.edgeClass 0 (regularFiberMap S01 twist height_twist 0 half (b, s)) :=
    congrFun (componentDataHom_e S01 twist height_twist 0 half) _

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleQuotient.pinchI_formula_strip
statement:

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleQuotient.pinchI_formula_vertex

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleQuotient.pinchI_formula_cylinder
statement:

          (ReebQuotient.mk _ (pinchI.ofCylinder S01 0 ((b, s), t)))) = t

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.continuous_fragAff
statement: theorem continuous_fragAff (a d ε c : ℝ) : Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => fragAff a d ε c p.2 p.1
proof:
:= by
  unfold fragAff
  fun_prop

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.fragAff_left
statement: theorem fragAff_left (a d ε c u : ℝ) : fragAff a d ε c u (max a (c - ε)) = max a (u - ε)
proof:
:= by
  simp [fragAff]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.fragAff_right
statement:
theorem fragAff_right (h : max a (c - ε) < min d (c + ε)) :
    fragAff a d ε c u (min d (c + ε)) = min d (u + ε)
proof:
:= by
  have h' : min d (c + ε) - max a (c - ε) ≠ 0 := (sub_pos.2 h).ne'
  have hm : (min d (c + ε) - max a (c - ε)) *
      ((min d (u + ε) - max a (u - ε)) / (min d (c + ε) - max a (c - ε))) =
        min d (u + ε) - max a (u - ε) := by
    rw [mul_div_assoc', mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ h']
  unfold fragAff
  rw [hm]
  ring

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.fragAff_mem
statement:
theorem fragAff_mem (hu : max a (u - ε) ≤ min d (u + ε))
    (hs : s ∈ Icc (max a (c - ε)) (min d (c + ε))) :
    fragAff a d ε c u s ∈ Icc (max a (u - ε)) (min d (u + ε))
proof:
:= by
  have hw : 0 ≤ min d (c + ε) - max a (c - ε) := sub_nonneg.2 (hs.1.trans hs.2)
  have hW : 0 ≤ min d (u + ε) - max a (u - ε) := sub_nonneg.2 hu
  have h1 : 0 ≤ s - max a (c - ε) := sub_nonneg.2 hs.1
  have h2 : s - max a (c - ε) ≤ min d (c + ε) - max a (c - ε) := sub_le_sub_right hs.2 _
  have hq : 0 ≤ (min d (u + ε) - max a (u - ε)) / (min d (c + ε) - max a (c - ε)) :=
    div_nonneg hW hw
  have h3 : (s - max a (c - ε)) *
      ((min d (u + ε) - max a (u - ε)) / (min d (c + ε) - max a (c - ε))) ≤
        min d (u + ε) - max a (u - ε) := by
    rcases hw.eq_or_lt with h0 | h0
    · rw [← h0, div_zero, mul_zero]
      exact hW
    · calc _ ≤ (min d (c + ε) - max a (c - ε)) *
            ((min d (u + ε) - max a (u - ε)) / (min d (c + ε) - max a (c - ε))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 hq
        _ = _ := by rw [mul_div_assoc', mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ h0.ne']
  have h4 := mul_nonneg h1 hq
  unfold fragAff
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.fragAff_collapse
statement:
theorem fragAff_collapse (hu : max a (u - ε) = min d (u + ε)) (c s : ℝ) :
    fragAff a d ε c u s = max a (u - ε)
proof:
:= by
  simp [fragAff, hu]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.fragAff_fragAff
statement:
theorem fragAff_fragAff (hc : max a (c - ε) < min d (c + ε))
    (hu : max a (u - ε) < min d (u + ε)) (s : ℝ) :
    fragAff a d ε u c (fragAff a d ε c u s) = s
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (sub_pos.2 hc).ne'
  have h2 := (sub_pos.2 hu).ne'
  have hAB : (min d (u + ε) - max a (u - ε)) / (min d (c + ε) - max a (c - ε)) *
      ((min d (c + ε) - max a (c - ε)) / (min d (u + ε) - max a (u - ε))) = 1 := by
    rw [div_mul_div_comm, mul_comm (min d (u + ε) - max a (u - ε)),
      div_self (mul_ne_zero h1 h2)]
  unfold fragAff
  linear_combination (s - max a (c - ε)) * hAB

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.fragLo_lt_fragHi
statement:
theorem fragLo_lt_fragHi (had : a < d) (hε : 0 < ε) (h1 : a ≤ c + ε) (h1' : c ≠ a - ε)
    (h2 : c - ε ≤ d) (h2' : c ≠ d + ε) : max a (c - ε) < min d (c + ε)
proof:
:= by
  refine max_lt (lt_min had (lt_of_le_of_ne h1 ?_)) (lt_min (lt_of_le_of_ne h2 ?_) (by linarith))
  · intro h
    exact h1' (by linarith)
  · intro h
    exact h2' (by linarith)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.locallyPathConnectedSpace_Icc

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.mem_window

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.continuous_windowIncl
statement: theorem continuous_windowIncl (lo hi : ℝ) : Continuous (windowIncl S D lo hi)
proof:
:=
  continuous_subtype_val.sumMap (continuous_sigma fun c => by
    dsimp only
    exact continuous_sigmaMk.comp (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _)))

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.windowIncl_mem
statement:
theorem windowIncl_mem {lo hi : ℝ} (r : WindowRaw S D lo hi) :
    (ofFiniteData D).quotMk S (windowIncl S D lo hi r) ∈ window S D lo hi
proof:
:= by
  rcases r with p | c
  · exact p.2
  · exact frag_subset_Icc c.2.2

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.coe_windowCover
statement:
theorem coe_windowCover {lo hi : ℝ} (r : WindowRaw S D lo hi) :
    (windowCover S D lo hi r : (ofFiniteData D).Realization S) =
      (ofFiniteData D).quotMk S (windowIncl S D lo hi r)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.windowCover_eq_iff
statement:
theorem windowCover_eq_iff {lo hi : ℝ} {r r' : WindowRaw S D lo hi} :
    windowCover S D lo hi r = windowCover S D lo hi r' ↔
      (ofFiniteData D).nf S (windowIncl S D lo hi r) =
        (ofFiniteData D).nf S (windowIncl S D lo hi r')
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext_iff.trans ((ofFiniteData D).quotMk_eq_iff S)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.windowCover_surjective
statement: theorem windowCover_surjective (lo hi : ℝ) : Function.Surjective (windowCover S D lo hi)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  rcases (ofFiniteData D).exists_rep S x with ⟨i, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, ⟨y, t⟩, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨.inl ⟨⟨i, v⟩, hx⟩, rfl⟩
  · have ht : (t : ℝ) ∈ Icc lo hi := hx
    exact ⟨.inr ⟨⟨e, y⟩, ⟨t, max_le t.2.1.le ht.1, le_min t.2.2.le ht.2⟩⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isQuotientMap_windowCover
statement: theorem isQuotientMap_windowCover (lo hi : ℝ) : IsQuotientMap (windowCover S D lo hi)
proof:
:=
  IsQuotientMap.of_surjective_continuous (windowCover_surjective S D lo hi)
    (windowCover S D lo hi).continuous

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWindingCell_self
statement:
theorem edgeWindingCell_self (d₀ : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    edgeWindingCell G d₀ d₀ t = ((t : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  unfold edgeWindingCell
  rw [if_pos rfl]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWindingCell_symm_self
statement:
theorem edgeWindingCell_symm_self (d₀ : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    edgeWindingCell G d₀ d₀.symm t = ((1 - (t : ℝ) : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  unfold edgeWindingCell
  rw [if_neg d₀.symm_ne, if_pos rfl]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWindingCell_of_ne
statement:
theorem edgeWindingCell_of_ne (d₀ d : G.Dart) (hd : d ≠ d₀) (hd' : d ≠ d₀.symm)
    (t : unitInterval) : edgeWindingCell G d₀ d t = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold edgeWindingCell
  rw [if_neg hd, if_neg hd']
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWindingCell_symm
statement:
theorem edgeWindingCell_symm (d₀ d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    edgeWindingCell G d₀ d.symm (σ t) = edgeWindingCell G d₀ d t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₁ : d = d₀
  · subst h₁
    rw [edgeWindingCell_symm_self, edgeWindingCell_self, coe_symm_eq, sub_sub_cancel]
  · by_cases h₂ : d = d₀.symm
    · subst h₂
      rw [Dart.symm_symm, edgeWindingCell_self, edgeWindingCell_symm_self, coe_symm_eq]
    · have h₁' : d.symm ≠ d₀ := fun h => h₂ (by rw [← h, Dart.symm_symm])
      have h₂' : d.symm ≠ d₀.symm := fun h => h₁ (by rw [← Dart.symm_symm d, h, Dart.symm_symm])
      rw [edgeWindingCell_of_ne G d₀ _ h₁' h₂', edgeWindingCell_of_ne G d₀ _ h₁ h₂]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWindingCell_zero
statement: theorem edgeWindingCell_zero (d₀ d : G.Dart) : edgeWindingCell G d₀ d 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h₁ : d = d₀
  · subst h₁
    rw [edgeWindingCell_self, Set.Icc.coe_zero, AddCircle.coe_zero]
  · by_cases h₂ : d = d₀.symm
    · subst h₂
      rw [edgeWindingCell_symm_self, Set.Icc.coe_zero, sub_zero]
      exact AddCircle.coe_period (1 : ℝ)
    · exact edgeWindingCell_of_ne G d₀ d h₁ h₂ 0

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWinding_vertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem edgeWinding_vertex (d₀ : G.Dart) (v : V) :
    edgeWinding G d₀ (vertex G v) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWinding_edgePoint
statement:
theorem edgeWinding_edgePoint (d₀ d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    edgeWinding G d₀ (edgePoint G d t) = edgeWindingCell G d₀ d t
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWinding_edgePoint_self
statement:
theorem edgeWinding_edgePoint_self (d₀ : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    edgeWinding G d₀ (edgePoint G d₀ t) = ((t : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  edgeWindingCell_self G d₀ t

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWinding_edgePoint_symm_self
statement:
theorem edgeWinding_edgePoint_symm_self (d₀ : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    edgeWinding G d₀ (edgePoint G d₀.symm t) = ((1 - (t : ℝ) : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  edgeWindingCell_symm_self G d₀ t

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWinding_edgePoint_of_ne
statement:
theorem edgeWinding_edgePoint_of_ne (d₀ d : G.Dart) (hd : d ≠ d₀) (hd' : d ≠ d₀.symm)
    (t : unitInterval) : edgeWinding G d₀ (edgePoint G d t) = 0
proof:
:=
  edgeWindingCell_of_ne G d₀ d hd hd' t

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWinding_edgePoint_of_edge_ne
statement:
theorem edgeWinding_edgePoint_of_edge_ne (d₀ d : G.Dart) (hd : d.edge ≠ d₀.edge)
    (t : unitInterval) : edgeWinding G d₀ (edgePoint G d t) = 0
proof:
:=
  edgeWinding_edgePoint_of_ne G d₀ d (fun h => hd (by rw [h]))
    (fun h => hd (by rw [h, Dart.edge_symm])) t

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWinding_edgePoint_self_zero
statement:
theorem edgeWinding_edgePoint_self_zero (d₀ : G.Dart) :
    edgeWinding G d₀ (edgePoint G d₀ 0) = 0
proof:
:=
  edgeWindingCell_zero G d₀ d₀

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWinding_edgePoint_self_one
statement:
theorem edgeWinding_edgePoint_self_one (d₀ : G.Dart) :
    edgeWinding G d₀ (edgePoint G d₀ 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeWinding_edgePoint_self, Set.Icc.coe_one]
  exact AddCircle.coe_period (1 : ℝ)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWinding_edgePoint_symm_self_zero
statement:
theorem edgeWinding_edgePoint_symm_self_zero (d₀ : G.Dart) :
    edgeWinding G d₀ (edgePoint G d₀.symm 0) = 0
proof:
:=
  edgeWindingCell_zero G d₀ d₀.symm

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWinding_edgePoint_symm_self_one
statement:
theorem edgeWinding_edgePoint_symm_self_one (d₀ : G.Dart) :
    edgeWinding G d₀ (edgePoint G d₀.symm 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeWinding_edgePoint_symm_self, Set.Icc.coe_one, sub_self, AddCircle.coe_zero]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWinding_walkPath_deleteEdges
proof:
:= by
  induction q generalizing t with
  | nil => exact edgeWinding_vertex G d₀ _
  | @cons a c b hac p ih =>
    change edgeWinding G d₀
      ((edgePath G ⟨(a, c), G.deleteEdges_le _ hac⟩).trans
        (walkPath G (p.mapLe (G.deleteEdges_le _))) t) = 0
    rw [Path.trans_apply]
    split_ifs
    · have hne : s(a, c) ≠ d₀.edge := by
        simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using (deleteEdges_adj.mp hac).2
      exact edgeWinding_edgePoint_of_edge_ne G d₀ ⟨(a, c), G.deleteEdges_le _ hac⟩ hne _
    · exact ih _

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.returnLoop_eq
statement:
theorem returnLoop_eq (d₀ : G.Dart) (q : (G.deleteEdges {d₀.edge}).Walk d₀.snd d₀.fst) :
    returnLoop G d₀ q =
      (edgePath G d₀).trans (walkPath G (q.mapLe (G.deleteEdges_le {d₀.edge})))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.returnLift_apply
statement: theorem returnLift_apply (s : unitInterval) : returnLift s = min (2 * (s : ℝ)) 1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.returnLift_of_le
statement:
theorem returnLift_of_le {s : unitInterval} (hs : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) :
    returnLift s = 2 * (s : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  min_eq_left (by linarith)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.returnLift_of_ge
statement: theorem returnLift_of_ge {s : unitInterval} (hs : 1 / 2 ≤ (s : ℝ)) : returnLift s = 1
proof:
:=
  min_eq_right (by linarith)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.returnLift_zero
statement: theorem returnLift_zero : returnLift 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [returnLift_of_le (by norm_num)]
  simp

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.returnLift_one
statement: theorem returnLift_one : returnLift 1 = 1
proof:
:=
  returnLift_of_ge (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWinding_returnLoop
statement:
theorem edgeWinding_returnLoop (d₀ : G.Dart) (q : (G.deleteEdges {d₀.edge}).Walk d₀.snd d₀.fst)
    (s : unitInterval) :
    edgeWinding G d₀ (returnLoop G d₀ q s) = ((returnLift s : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [returnLoop, Path.trans_apply]
  split_ifs with hs
  · rw [returnLift_of_le hs]
    exact edgeWinding_edgePoint_self G d₀ _
  · rw [returnLift_of_ge (not_le.mp hs).le, edgeWinding_walkPath_deleteEdges]
    exact (AddCircle.coe_period (1 : ℝ)).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.edgeWinding_returnLoop_zero
statement:
theorem edgeWinding_returnLoop_zero (d₀ : G.Dart)
    (q : (G.deleteEdges {d₀.edge}).Walk d₀.snd d₀.fst) :
    ((returnLoop G d₀ q).map (edgeWinding G d₀).continuous) 0 = ((0 : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  ((returnLoop G d₀ q).map (edgeWinding G d₀).continuous).source.trans (edgeWinding_vertex G d₀ _)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.returnLift_eq_liftPath
statement:
theorem returnLift_eq_liftPath (d₀ : G.Dart)
    (q : (G.deleteEdges {d₀.edge}).Walk d₀.snd d₀.fst) :
    returnLift = (AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe (1 : ℝ)).liftPath
      ((returnLoop G d₀ q).map (edgeWinding G d₀).continuous).toContinuousMap 0
      (edgeWinding_returnLoop_zero G d₀ q)
proof:
:=
  ((AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe (1 : ℝ)).eq_liftPath_iff' _).2
    ⟨_root_.funext fun s => (edgeWinding_returnLoop G d₀ q s).symm, returnLift_zero⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.not_homotopic_returnLoop
statement:
theorem not_homotopic_returnLoop (d₀ : G.Dart)
    (q : (G.deleteEdges {d₀.edge}).Walk d₀.snd d₀.fst) :
    ¬ (returnLoop G d₀ q).Homotopic (Path.refl (vertex G d₀.fst))
proof:
:= by
  intro hh
  let cov := AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe (1 : ℝ)
  let pγ := (returnLoop G d₀ q).map (edgeWinding G d₀).continuous
  let pγ₀ := (Path.refl (vertex G d₀.fst)).map (edgeWinding G d₀).continuous
  have h0 : pγ 0 = ((0 : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) := edgeWinding_returnLoop_zero G d₀ q
  have h0' : pγ₀ 0 = ((0 : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) := edgeWinding_vertex G d₀ d₀.fst
  have hhom : pγ.toContinuousMap.HomotopicRel pγ₀.toContinuousMap {0, 1} :=
    hh.map (edgeWinding G d₀)
  have hend : cov.liftPath pγ.toContinuousMap 0 h0 1 = cov.liftPath pγ₀.toContinuousMap 0 h0' 1 :=
    cov.liftPath_apply_one_eq_of_homotopicRel hhom 0 h0 h0'
  have hleft : cov.liftPath pγ.toContinuousMap 0 h0 1 = 1 := by
    rw [← returnLift_eq_liftPath G d₀ q]
    exact returnLift_one
  have hright : cov.liftPath pγ₀.toContinuousMap 0 h0' 1 = 0 := by
    have hc : ContinuousMap.const unitInterval (0 : ℝ) = cov.liftPath pγ₀.toContinuousMap 0 h0' :=
      (cov.eq_liftPath_iff' _).2
        ⟨_root_.funext fun _ => (edgeWinding_vertex G d₀ d₀.fst).symm, rfl⟩
    rw [← hc]
    rfl
  exact one_ne_zero (hleft.symm.trans (hend.trans hright))

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.not_simplyConnectedSpace_of_returnWalk
statement:
theorem not_simplyConnectedSpace_of_returnWalk (d₀ : G.Dart)
    (q : (G.deleteEdges {d₀.edge}).Walk d₀.snd d₀.fst) :
    ¬ SimplyConnectedSpace (Realization G)
proof:
:= fun _ =>
  not_homotopic_returnLoop G d₀ q (SimplyConnectedSpace.paths_homotopic _ _)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.isAcyclic_of_simplyConnectedSpace
statement:
theorem isAcyclic_of_simplyConnectedSpace (h : SimplyConnectedSpace (Realization G)) :
    G.IsAcyclic
proof:
:= by
  rw [isAcyclic_iff_forall_adj_isBridge]
  intro u v huv
  rw [isBridge_iff]
  intro hreach
  let d₀ : G.Dart := ⟨(u, v), huv⟩
  obtain ⟨q⟩ : (G.deleteEdges {d₀.edge}).Reachable d₀.snd d₀.fst := hreach.symm
  exact not_simplyConnectedSpace_of_returnWalk G d₀ q h

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.isTree_of_simplyConnectedSpace
statement:
theorem isTree_of_simplyConnectedSpace (h : SimplyConnectedSpace (Realization G)) :
    G.IsTree
proof:
:=
  ⟨(connected_iff_pathConnectedSpace G).2 inferInstance, isAcyclic_of_simplyConnectedSpace G h⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphCycleObstruction.not_simplyConnectedSpace_of_not_isTree

theorem not_simplyConnectedSpace_of_not_isTree (hG : ¬ G.IsTree) :

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.stability_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem stability_of_isEmpty {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [IsEmpty X] (f g : C(X, ℝ)) :
    interleavingDistance (intervalComponents f) (intervalComponents g) = 0 ∧
      edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑f) (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑f) (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑g) = 0 := by
    rw [edist_uniformFun_ofFun_eq_iSup, iSup_of_empty, bot_eq_zero]
  exact ⟨le_antisymm ((interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_le_edist f g).trans_eq he)
    zero_le, he⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.edist_id_twiceId_eq_top
statement:
theorem edist_id_twiceId_eq_top :
    edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(ContinuousMap.id ℝ)) (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑twiceId) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [edist_uniformFun_ofFun_eq_iSup]
  refine ENNReal.eq_top_of_forall_nnreal_le fun r => le_iSup_of_le (r : ℝ) ?_
  have h : |(ContinuousMap.id ℝ) (r : ℝ) - twiceId (r : ℝ)| = r := by
    change |(r : ℝ) - 2 * r| = r
    rw [show (r : ℝ) - 2 * r = -r by ring, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg r.coe_nonneg]
  rw [h, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.interleavingDistance_heightShift_le
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_heightShift_le {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : C(X, ℝ))
    (c : ℝ) :
    interleavingDistance (intervalComponents f) (intervalComponents (heightShift f c)) ≤
      Real.nnabs c
proof:
:=
  (interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_le_edist f (heightShift f c)).trans
    (edist_uniformFun_ofFun_le_coe_iff.2 (abs_sub_heightShift_le f c))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.edist_heightShift
statement:
theorem edist_heightShift {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [Nonempty X] (f : C(X, ℝ))
    (c : ℝ) :
    edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑f) (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(heightShift f c)) = Real.nnabs c
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ x, ENNReal.ofReal |f x - heightShift f c x| = Real.nnabs c := fun x => by
    change ENNReal.ofReal |f x - (f x + c)| = Real.nnabs c
    rw [sub_add_cancel_left, abs_neg, ← Real.coe_nnabs, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
  rw [edist_uniformFun_ofFun_eq_iSup]
  simp only [h, ciSup_const]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.stability_const_eq
statement:
theorem stability_const_eq (c : ℝ) :
    interleavingDistance (intervalComponents (ContinuousMap.const Unit (0 : ℝ)))
        (intervalComponents (ContinuousMap.const Unit c)) =
      edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(ContinuousMap.const Unit (0 : ℝ)))
        (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(ContinuousMap.const Unit c)) ∧
      edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(ContinuousMap.const Unit (0 : ℝ)))
        (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(ContinuousMap.const Unit c)) = Real.nnabs c
proof:
:= by
  have he : edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(ContinuousMap.const Unit (0 : ℝ)))
      (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(ContinuousMap.const Unit c)) = Real.nnabs c := by
    rw [edist_uniformFun_ofFun_eq_iSup, ciSup_unique]
    change ENNReal.ofReal |0 - c| = Real.nnabs c
    rw [zero_sub, abs_neg, ← Real.coe_nnabs, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
  refine ⟨le_antisymm (interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_le_edist _ _) ?_, he⟩
  rw [he]
  refine le_interleavingDistance_iff.2 fun ε ⟨i⟩ => ?_
  by_contra hlt
  have hε : (ε : ℝ) < |c| := by
    rw [← Real.coe_nnabs]
    exact_mod_cast not_le.1 hlt
  exact (isEmpty_interleaving_const hε).false i

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.stability_self
statement:
theorem stability_self {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : C(X, ℝ)) :
    interleavingDistance (intervalComponents f) (intervalComponents f) = 0 ∧
      edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑f) (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑f) = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨le_antisymm ((interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_le_edist f f).trans_eq (edist_self _))
    zero_le, edist_self _⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.mem_scale
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_scale {s x : ℝ} {I : OpenInterval} :
    x ∈ scale s I ↔ s * x ∈ I
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.coe_scale
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_scale (s : ℝ) (I : OpenInterval) :
    (scale s I : Set ℝ) = (s * ·) ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.scale_ioo_of_pos
statement:
theorem scale_ioo_of_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (p q : ℝ) :
    scale s (ioo p q) = ioo (p / s) (q / s)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change p < s * x ∧ s * x < q ↔ p / s < x ∧ x < q / s
  simp only [div_lt_iff₀ hs, lt_div_iff₀ hs, mul_comm s]

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.scale_ioo_of_neg
statement:
theorem scale_ioo_of_neg {s : ℝ} (hs : s < 0) (p q : ℝ) :
    scale s (ioo p q) = ioo (q / s) (p / s)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change p < s * x ∧ s * x < q ↔ q / s < x ∧ x < p / s
  simp only [div_lt_iff_of_neg hs, lt_div_iff_of_neg hs, mul_comm s, and_comm]

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.scale_one
statement: @[simp] theorem scale_one (I : OpenInterval) : scale 1 I = I
proof: := by ext; simp

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.scale_top
statement: @[simp] theorem scale_top (s : ℝ) : scale s ⊤ = ⊤
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.scale_bot
statement: @[simp] theorem scale_bot (s : ℝ) : scale s ⊥ = ⊥
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.scale_zero
statement: theorem scale_zero (I : OpenInterval) : scale 0 I = if 0 ∈ I then ⊤ else ⊥
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · ext x
    change (0 * x ∈ I ↔ True)
    simp [h]
  · ext x
    change (0 * x ∈ I ↔ False)
    simp [h]

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.scale_scale
statement:
theorem scale_scale (s μ : ℝ) (I : OpenInterval) :
    scale s (scale μ I) = scale (μ * s) I
proof: := by ext; simp [mul_assoc]

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.scale_monotone
statement: theorem scale_monotone (s : ℝ) : Monotone (scale s)
proof: := fun _ _ h _ hx => h hx

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.thicken_scale
statement:
theorem thicken_scale (s : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval) :
    thicken ε (scale s I) = scale s (thicken (‖s‖₊ * ε) I)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : s = 0
  · subst s
    simp only [nnnorm_zero, zero_mul, thicken_zero, scale_zero]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  ext x
  simp only [mem_thicken, mem_scale, NNReal.coe_mul, coe_nnnorm, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    refine ⟨s * y, hy, ?_⟩
    rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxy (abs_nonneg s)
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    refine ⟨y / s, by simpa only [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hs] using hy, ?_⟩
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (abs_pos.2 hs)).1
    rw [← abs_mul, mul_sub, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hs]
    exact hxy

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.scaleFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleFunctor_obj (s : ℝ) (I : OpenInterval) :
    (scaleFunctor s).obj I = scale s I
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.scalePre_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem scalePre_obj (s : ℝ) (F : OpenInterval ⥤ C) (I : OpenInterval) :
    (scalePre s F).obj I = F.obj (scale s I)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.scalePre_map
statement:
@[simp] theorem scalePre_map (s : ℝ) (F : OpenInterval ⥤ C) {I J : OpenInterval}
    (f : I ⟶ J) : (scalePre s F).map f = F.map ((scaleFunctor s).map f)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.distance_scalePre_le
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (‖s‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 := by simpa using hs
  conv_rhs => unfold interleavingDistance
  simp only [ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne hn ENNReal.coe_ne_top]
  exact le_iInf₂ fun ε ⟨i⟩ => by
    simpa only [ENNReal.coe_mul] using (i.scalePre s).interleavingDistance_le

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_scalePre
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_scalePre {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (F G : OpenInterval ⥤ C) :
    interleavingDistance (scalePre s F) (scalePre s G) =
      (‖s‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) * interleavingDistance F G
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (distance_scalePre_le hs F G) ?_
  have e (H : OpenInterval ⥤ C) : scalePre s⁻¹ (scalePre s H) ≅ H :=
    scalePreScalePreIso s⁻¹ s H ≪≫ eqToIso (by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hs]) ≪≫ scalePreOneIso H
  have h := distance_scalePre_le (inv_ne_zero hs) (scalePre s F) (scalePre s G)
  rw [interleavingDistance_congr (e F) (e G)] at h
  have hn : ‖s‖₊ ≠ 0 := nnnorm_ne_zero_iff.2 hs
  have hprod : (‖s‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) * (‖s⁻¹‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) = 1 := by
    rw [nnnorm_inv, ← ENNReal.coe_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hn, ENNReal.coe_one]
  simpa only [← mul_assoc, hprod, one_mul] using mul_le_mul_right h (‖s‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞)

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_scalePre_neg_one
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_scalePre_neg_one (F G : OpenInterval ⥤ C) :
    interleavingDistance (scalePre (-1) F) (scalePre (-1) G) = interleavingDistance F G
proof:
:= by
  simpa using interleavingDistance_scalePre (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≠ 0) F G

name: TDA.Reeb.intervalComponents_smul
statement:
theorem intervalComponents_smul {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (s : ℝ) (f : C(X, ℝ)) :
    intervalComponents (s • f) = scalePre s (intervalComponents f)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_smul
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_smul {X X' : Type u}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace X'] {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0)
    (f : C(X, ℝ)) (g : C(X', ℝ)) :
    interleavingDistance (intervalComponents (s • f)) (intervalComponents (s • g)) =
      (‖s‖₊ : ℝ≥0∞) * interleavingDistance (intervalComponents f) (intervalComponents g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [intervalComponents_smul, intervalComponents_smul, interleavingDistance_scalePre hs]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPLVertexPerturbation.empty_edist_ofFun_plHeight

proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPLVertexPerturbation.edist_flat_tilted
statement: theorem edist_flat_tilted : edist flat tilted = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine edist_pi_le_iff.2 fun b => ?_
    cases b <;> norm_num [flat, tilted, edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
  · calc (1 : ℝ≥0∞) = edist (flat true) (tilted true) := by
          norm_num [flat, tilted, edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
      _ ≤ edist flat tilted := edist_le_pi_edist flat tilted true

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPLVertexPerturbation.flat_tilted_edist_ofFun_plHeight
statement:
theorem flat_tilted_edist_ofFun_plHeight :
    flat d₀.fst = flat d₀.snd ∧ tilted d₀.fst ≠ tilted d₀.snd ∧
      edist (UniformFun.ofFun (plHeight edgeGraph flat))
        (UniformFun.ofFun (plHeight edgeGraph tilted)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rfl, by norm_num [tilted, d₀], ?_⟩
  rw [edist_ofFun_plHeight_eq_edist, edist_flat_tilted]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPLVertexPerturbation.bump_not_controlled
statement:
theorem bump_not_controlled :
    edist (UniformFun.ofFun fun v => bump (vertex edgeGraph v)) (UniformFun.ofFun flat) = 0 ∧
      |bump (edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ half) - plHeight edgeGraph flat (edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ half)| =
        1 ∧
      1 ≤ edist (UniformFun.ofFun bump) (UniformFun.ofFun (plHeight edgeGraph flat))
proof:
:= by
  have hmid : |bump (edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ half) -
      plHeight edgeGraph flat (edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ half)| = 1 := by
    change |4 * (half : ℝ) * (1 - (half : ℝ)) - dartHeight flat d₀ half| = 1
    norm_num [half, dartHeight, flat]
  refine ⟨edist_self _, hmid, ?_⟩
  refine le_trans ?_ (UniformFun.edist_eval_le (x := edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ half))
  rw [edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
  change 1 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal |bump (edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ half) -
    plHeight edgeGraph flat (edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ half)|
  rw [hmid, ENNReal.ofReal_one]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.twoOpens_cover
statement: theorem twoOpens_cover : (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens ℝ) ≤ ⨆ b, twoOpens b
proof:
:= fun z _ => by
  refine TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.2 ?_
  rcases lt_or_ge z (2 / 3) with h | h
  · exact ⟨false, h⟩
  · exact ⟨true, show (1 / 3 : ℝ) < z by linarith⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.twoOpens_zero_one_chain
statement:
theorem twoOpens_zero_one_chain :
    Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun a b : {x : ℝ // ContinuousMap.id ℝ x ∈ (⊤ : TopologicalSpace.Opens ℝ)} =>
        ∃ i, ∃ (ha : ContinuousMap.id ℝ a.1 ∈ twoOpens i)
          (hb : ContinuousMap.id ℝ b.1 ∈ twoOpens i),
          (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨a.1, ha⟩ : (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id ℝ)).obj (twoOpens i)) =
            ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨b.1, hb⟩)
      ⟨0, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top _⟩ ⟨1, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top _⟩
proof:
:=
  componentFunctor_reflTransGen_of_mk_eq (ContinuousMap.id ℝ) twoOpens twoOpens_cover
    ((componentFunctor_mk_eq_iff_joined _ _ _ _).2
      ⟨{ toFun := fun s => ⟨(s : ℝ), TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_top _⟩
         continuous_toFun := continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _
         source' := rfl
         target' := rfl }⟩)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.twoOpens_zero_one_not_single_link
statement:
theorem twoOpens_zero_one_not_single_link :
    ¬ ∃ i, ∃ (ha : ContinuousMap.id ℝ 0 ∈ twoOpens i) (hb : ContinuousMap.id ℝ 1 ∈ twoOpens i),
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨0, ha⟩ : (componentFunctor (ContinuousMap.id ℝ)).obj (twoOpens i)) =
        ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨1, hb⟩
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨i, ha, hb, -⟩
  cases i
  · change (1 : ℝ) < 2 / 3 at hb
    norm_num at hb
  · change (1 / 3 : ℝ) < 0 at ha
    norm_num at ha

name: TDA.Reeb.smoothingMap_refl
statement:
theorem smoothingMap_refl (ε : ℝ≥0) :

proof:
:= by
  ext F I
  dsimp

name: TDA.Reeb.smoothingMap_comp
statement:
theorem smoothingMap_comp {ε δ γ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε ≤ δ) (h' : δ ≤ γ) :
    smoothingMap h ≫ smoothingMap h' =
      (smoothingMap (h.trans h') : (smoothing ε : (OpenInterval ⥤ C) ⥤ _) ⟶ _)
proof:
:= by
  ext F I
  dsimp
  interval_coherence

name: TDA.Reeb.smoothingUnit_comp_smoothingMap
statement:
theorem smoothingUnit_comp_smoothingMap {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε ≤ δ) :
    smoothingUnit ε ≫ smoothingMap h = (smoothingUnit δ : 𝟭 (OpenInterval ⥤ C) ⟶ _)
proof:
:= by
  ext F I

  interval_coherence

name: TDA.Reeb.smoothingUnit_zero
statement:
theorem smoothingUnit_zero :
    smoothingUnit 0 = (smoothingZeroIso.inv : 𝟭 (OpenInterval ⥤ C) ⟶ _)
proof:
:= by
  ext F I
  dsimp
  interval_coherence

name: TDA.Reeb.smoothingUnit_comp_smoothingUnit
statement:
theorem smoothingUnit_comp_smoothingUnit (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (F : OpenInterval ⥤ C) :
    (smoothingUnit δ).app F ≫ (smoothingUnit ε).app ((smoothing δ).obj F) ≫
      (smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app F = (smoothingUnit (ε + δ)).app F
proof:
:= by
  ext I
  dsimp
  interval_coherence

name: TDA.Reeb.smoothingUnit_comp_map_smoothingUnit
statement:
theorem smoothingUnit_comp_map_smoothingUnit (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (F : OpenInterval ⥤ C) :
    (smoothingUnit ε).app F ≫ (smoothing ε).map ((smoothingUnit δ).app F) ≫
      (smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app F = (smoothingUnit (ε + δ)).app F
proof:
:= by
  ext I
  dsimp
  interval_coherence

name: TDA.Reeb.smoothingCompIso_assoc
statement:
theorem smoothingCompIso_assoc (ε δ γ : ℝ≥0) (F : OpenInterval ⥤ C) :
    (smoothing ε).map ((smoothingCompIso δ γ).hom.app F) ≫
        (smoothingCompIso ε (δ + γ)).hom.app F ≫
        (smoothingMap (add_assoc ε δ γ).ge).app F =
      (smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app ((smoothing γ).obj F) ≫
        (smoothingCompIso (ε + δ) γ).hom.app F
proof:
:= by
  ext I
  dsimp
  erw [smoothing_obj_map]
  interval_coherence

name: TDA.Reeb.smoothingCompIso_zero_left
statement:
theorem smoothingCompIso_zero_left (δ : ℝ≥0) (F : OpenInterval ⥤ C) :
    (smoothingCompIso 0 δ).hom.app F ≫ (smoothingMap (zero_add δ).le).app F =
      smoothingZeroIso.hom.app ((smoothing δ).obj F)
proof:
:= by
  ext I
  dsimp
  interval_coherence

name: TDA.Reeb.smoothingCompIso_zero_right
statement:
theorem smoothingCompIso_zero_right (δ : ℝ≥0) (F : OpenInterval ⥤ C) :
    (smoothingCompIso δ 0).hom.app F ≫ (smoothingMap (add_zero δ).le).app F =
      (smoothing δ).map (smoothingZeroIso.hom.app F)
proof:
:= by
  ext I
  dsimp
  interval_coherence

name: TDA.Reeb.smoothingCommIso_hom_app_app
statement:
theorem smoothingCommIso_hom_app_app (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (F : OpenInterval ⥤ C)
    (I : OpenInterval) :
    ((smoothingCommIso ε δ).hom.app F).app I =
      F.map (homOfLE (thicken_comm ε δ I).le)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [smoothingCommIso]
  interval_coherence

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {i j : Interleaving ε F G} (hφ : i.φ = j.φ) (hψ : i.ψ = j.ψ) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  cases i; cases j; cases hφ; cases hψ; rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.φ_ψ_app
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem φ_ψ_app (i : Interleaving ε F G) (I : OpenInterval) :
    i.φ.app I ≫ i.ψ.app (thicken ε I) =
      F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε _)))
proof:
:= by
  have h : i.φ.app I ≫ i.ψ.app (thicken ε I) ≫ F.map (homOfLE (thicken_thicken' ε ε I).le) =
      F.map (homOfLE (le_thicken (ε + ε) I)) := congrArg (fun t => NatTrans.app t I) i.φ_ψ
  have e : F.map (homOfLE (thicken_thicken' ε ε I).le) ≫
      F.map (homOfLE (thicken_thicken' ε ε I).ge) = 𝟙 _ :=
    (map_comp_map_of_interval F _ _ (𝟙 _)).trans (F.map_id _)
  rw [← Category.comp_id (i.φ.app I ≫ i.ψ.app (thicken ε I)), ← e]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% h]
  exact map_comp_map_of_interval F _ _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.ψ_φ_app
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ψ_φ_app (i : Interleaving ε F G) (I : OpenInterval) :
    i.ψ.app I ≫ i.φ.app (thicken ε I) =
      G.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε _)))
proof:
:= by
  have h : i.ψ.app I ≫ i.φ.app (thicken ε I) ≫ G.map (homOfLE (thicken_thicken' ε ε I).le) =
      G.map (homOfLE (le_thicken (ε + ε) I)) := congrArg (fun t => NatTrans.app t I) i.ψ_φ
  have e : G.map (homOfLE (thicken_thicken' ε ε I).le) ≫
      G.map (homOfLE (thicken_thicken' ε ε I).ge) = 𝟙 _ :=
    (map_comp_map_of_interval G _ _ (𝟙 _)).trans (G.map_id _)
  rw [← Category.comp_id (i.ψ.app I ≫ i.φ.app (thicken ε I)), ← e]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [reassoc_of% h]
  exact map_comp_map_of_interval G _ _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.φ_map_ψ
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem φ_map_ψ (i : Interleaving ε F G) {I K : OpenInterval} (g : thicken ε I ⟶ K) :
    i.φ.app I ≫ G.map g ≫ i.ψ.app K =
      F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (g.le.trans (le_thicken ε K))))
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : i.φ.app I ≫ G.map g ≫ i.ψ.app K =
      i.φ.app I ≫ i.ψ.app (thicken ε I) ≫ F.map ((thickenFunctor ε).map g) :=
    congrArg (fun t => i.φ.app I ≫ t) (i.ψ.naturality g)
  rw [e1]
  erw [i.φ_ψ_app_assoc]
  exact map_comp_map_of_interval F _ _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.ψ_map_φ
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ψ_map_φ (i : Interleaving ε F G) {I K : OpenInterval} (g : thicken ε I ⟶ K) :
    i.ψ.app I ≫ F.map g ≫ i.φ.app K =
      G.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (g.le.trans (le_thicken ε K))))
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : i.ψ.app I ≫ F.map g ≫ i.φ.app K =
      i.ψ.app I ≫ i.φ.app (thicken ε I) ≫ G.map ((thickenFunctor ε).map g) :=
    congrArg (fun t => i.ψ.app I ≫ t) (i.φ.naturality g)
  rw [e1]
  erw [i.ψ_φ_app_assoc]
  exact map_comp_map_of_interval G _ _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.φ_map_map_ψ
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem φ_map_map_ψ (i : Interleaving ε F G) {I J K : OpenInterval} (g₁ : thicken ε I ⟶ J)
    (g₂ : J ⟶ K) :
    i.φ.app I ≫ G.map g₁ ≫ G.map g₂ ≫ i.ψ.app K =
      F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans ((g₁ ≫ g₂).le.trans (le_thicken ε K))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← G.map_comp_assoc]; exact i.φ_map_ψ (g₁ ≫ g₂)

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.ψ_map_map_φ
statement:
@[reassoc]
theorem ψ_map_map_φ (i : Interleaving ε F G) {I J K : OpenInterval} (g₁ : thicken ε I ⟶ J)
    (g₂ : J ⟶ K) :
    i.ψ.app I ≫ F.map g₁ ≫ F.map g₂ ≫ i.φ.app K =
      G.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans ((g₁ ≫ g₂).le.trans (le_thicken ε K))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← F.map_comp_assoc]; exact i.ψ_map_φ (g₁ ≫ g₂)

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.realizeNatTrans_edgeLabel
statement:

    (realizeNatTrans S φ).app (S.K e) (D.edgeLabel S e y) = D'.edgeLabel S e (φ.e e y)
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.natTransEquivDiagramHom_realizeNatTrans
statement:
theorem natTransEquivDiagramHom_realizeNatTrans (φ : D.Hom D') :
    S.natTransEquivDiagramHom (D.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt S) (D.toCosheaf_isIntervalCosheaf S)
        (D'.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt S) (D'.toCosheaf_isIntervalCosheaf S)
        (realizeNatTrans S φ) =
      (D.fromExtractHom S).comp (φ.comp (D'.toExtractHom S))
proof:
:= by
  apply Hom.ext
  · funext i x
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := (D.vertexLabel S i).surjective x
    show (realizeNatTrans S φ).app (S.J i) (D.vertexLabel S i v) =
      D'.vertexLabel S i (φ.v i ((D.fromExtractHom S).v i (D.vertexLabel S i v)))
    rw [realizeNatTrans_vertexLabel, fromExtractHom_v_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  · funext e x
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (D.edgeLabel S e).surjective x
    show (realizeNatTrans S φ).app (S.K e) (D.edgeLabel S e y) =
      D'.edgeLabel S e (φ.e e ((D.fromExtractHom S).e e (D.edgeLabel S e y)))
    rw [realizeNatTrans_edgeLabel, fromExtractHom_e_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.intervalComponentsOver_map_eq
statement:
theorem intervalComponentsOver_map_eq {X Y : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)} (iX : X ≅ toOver T DA)
    (iY : Y ≅ toOver T DB) (g : X ⟶ Y) :
    intervalComponentsOver.map g =
      Iso.homCongr (intervalComponentsOver.mapIso iX).symm (intervalComponentsOver.mapIso iY).symm
        (realizeNatTrans T (homEquivOfIso iX iY g))
proof:
:= by
  change _ = intervalComponentsOver.map iX.hom ≫
    intervalComponentsOver.map ((realizationFunctor T).map (homEquivOfIso iX iY g)) ≫
      intervalComponentsOver.map iY.inv
  rw [homEquivOfIso_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← Functor.map_comp]
  simp

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafFunctor_map_conj
statement:
theorem cosheafFunctor_map_conj (iA : A.obj ≅ toOver T DA) (iB : B.obj ≅ toOver T DB)
    (f : A ⟶ B) :
    intervalComponentsOver.map iA.inv ≫ (cosheafFunctor.map f).hom ≫
        intervalComponentsOver.map iB.hom =
      realizeNatTrans T (homEquivOfIso iA iB f.hom)
proof:
:= by
  change intervalComponentsOver.map iA.inv ≫ intervalComponentsOver.map f.hom ≫
      intervalComponentsOver.map iB.hom =
    intervalComponentsOver.map ((realizationFunctor T).map (homEquivOfIso iA iB f.hom))
  rw [homEquivOfIso_apply, Functor.map_comp, Functor.map_comp]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.natTransEquivDiagramHom_cosheafFunctor_map
statement:
theorem natTransEquivDiagramHom_cosheafFunctor_map (iA : A.obj ≅ toOver T DA)
    (iB : B.obj ≅ toOver T DB) (f : A ⟶ B) :
    T.natTransEquivDiagramHom (DA.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt T)
        (DA.toCosheaf_isIntervalCosheaf T) (DB.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt T)
        (DB.toCosheaf_isIntervalCosheaf T)
        (intervalComponentsOver.map iA.inv ≫ (cosheafFunctor.map f).hom ≫
          intervalComponentsOver.map iB.hom) =
      (DA.fromExtractHom T).comp
        (FiniteReebData.Hom.comp (homEquivOfIso iA iB f.hom) (DB.toExtractHom T))
proof:
:= by
  exact (congrArg (T.natTransEquivDiagramHom (DA.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt T)
      (DA.toCosheaf_isIntervalCosheaf T) (DB.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt T)
      (DB.toCosheaf_isIntervalCosheaf T)) (cosheafFunctor_map_conj iA iB f)).trans
    (natTransEquivDiagramHom_realizeNatTrans T _)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafFunctor_map_conj_vertexLabel
statement:
theorem cosheafFunctor_map_conj_vertexLabel (iA : A.obj ≅ toOver T DA)
    (iB : B.obj ≅ toOver T DB) (f : A ⟶ B) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (v : DA.V i) :
    (intervalComponentsOver.map iA.inv ≫ (cosheafFunctor.map f).hom ≫
        intervalComponentsOver.map iB.hom).app (T.J i) (DA.vertexLabel T i v) =
      DB.vertexLabel T i ((homEquivOfIso iA iB f.hom).v i v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cosheafFunctor_map_conj]
  exact realizeNatTrans_vertexLabel T _ i v

    (intervalComponentsOver.map iA.inv ≫ (cosheafFunctor.map f).hom ≫
        intervalComponentsOver.map iB.hom).app (T.K e) (DA.edgeLabel T e y) =
      DB.edgeLabel T e ((homEquivOfIso iA iB f.hom).e e y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cosheafFunctor_map_conj]
  exact realizeNatTrans_edgeLabel T _ e y

theorem cosheafHomEquiv_apply (iA : A.obj ≅ toOver T DA) (iB : B.obj ≅ toOver T DB)

proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafFunctor_map_bijective
statement:
theorem cosheafFunctor_map_bijective (A B : RGraphCat) :
    Function.Bijective
      (cosheafFunctor.map : (A ⟶ B) → (cosheafFunctor.obj A ⟶ cosheafFunctor.obj B))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, T, DA, DB, ⟨iA⟩, ⟨iB⟩⟩ := exists_common_presentation A B
  have key : (cosheafFunctor.map : (A ⟶ B) → _) = cosheafHomEquiv iA iB :=
    funext fun f => (cosheafHomEquiv_apply iA iB f).symm
  rw [key]
  exact (cosheafHomEquiv iA iB).bijective

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.FiniteDataGraph.single_adj
statement:
theorem single_adj :
    singleEdge.incidenceGraph.Adj
      (⟨0, ()⟩ : singleEdge.IncidenceVertex) ⟨1, ()⟩
proof:
:= by
  change singleEdge.incidenceGraph.Adj
    (⟨(0 : Fin 1).castSucc, ()⟩ : singleEdge.IncidenceVertex)
    ⟨(0 : Fin 1).succ, ()⟩
  exact (singleEdge.incidenceGraph_adj_castSucc_succ_iff 0 () ()).2 ⟨(), rfl, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.FiniteDataGraph.single_edgeCard
statement: theorem single_edgeCard : Nat.card singleEdge.incidenceGraph.edgeSet = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Nat.card singleEdge.incidenceGraph.edgeSet =
        ∑ e, Nat.card (singleEdge.E e) :=
      singleEdge.card_incidenceGraph_edgeSet_eq (by
        rw [singleEdge.incidenceEdgeSet_injective_iff]
        intro e x y _ _
        change Unit at x y
        exact Subsingleton.elim x y)
    _ = 1 := by simp [singleEdge]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.FiniteDataGraph.single_homCard

theorem single_homCard :
    Nat.card (Quiver.Hom (V := singleEdge.IncidenceVertex)

proof:
:= by
  have h := Nat.card_congr (singleEdge.homCastSuccSuccEquiv (0 : Fin 1) () ())
  simpa [singleEdge, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using h

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.FiniteDataGraph.parallel_homCard
statement:
theorem parallel_homCard :
    Nat.card (Quiver.Hom (V := parallelData.IncidenceVertex)

proof:
:= by
  have h := Nat.card_congr (parallelData.homCastSuccSuccEquiv (0 : Fin 1) () ())

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.FiniteDataGraph.parallel_edgeCard
statement: theorem parallel_edgeCard : Nat.card parallelData.incidenceGraph.edgeSet = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_eq_one_iff_exists]
  refine ⟨parallelData.incidenceEdgeSet ⟨0, false⟩, ?_⟩
  intro q
  obtain ⟨⟨e, x⟩, rfl⟩ := parallelData.incidenceEdgeSet_surjective q
  have he : e = 0 := Fin.eq_zero e
  subst e
  cases x <;> rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.FiniteDataGraph.parallel_not_injective
statement:
theorem parallel_not_injective :
    ¬Function.Injective parallelData.incidenceEdgeSet
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have heq : parallelData.incidenceEdgeSet
      ⟨(0 : Fin 1), false⟩ = parallelData.incidenceEdgeSet
      ⟨(0 : Fin 1), true⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  have hp : (⟨(0 : Fin 1), false⟩ : parallelData.IncidenceEdge) =
      ⟨(0 : Fin 1), true⟩ := h heq
  exact Bool.false_ne_true (eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp hp).2)

statement:
theorem parallel_card_lt :
    Nat.card parallelData.incidenceGraph.edgeSet <
      ∑ e, Nat.card (parallelData.E e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [parallel_edgeCard]
  simp [parallelData]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.FiniteDataGraph.parallel_graphIso
statement:
theorem parallel_graphIso :
    Nonempty (parallelData.incidenceGraph ≃g singleEdge.incidenceGraph)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨{ toEquiv := Equiv.refl _, map_rel_iff' := ?_ }⟩
  intro x y
  change singleEdge.incidenceGraph.Adj x y ↔ parallelData.incidenceGraph.Adj x y
  rcases x with ⟨x, ⟨⟩⟩
  rcases y with ⟨y, ⟨⟩⟩
  have hsingle : singleEdge.incidenceGraph.Adj
      (⟨(0 : Fin 2), ()⟩ : singleEdge.IncidenceVertex) ⟨(1 : Fin 2), ()⟩ := by
    exact single_adj
  have hparallel : parallelData.incidenceGraph.Adj
      (⟨(0 : Fin 2), ()⟩ : parallelData.IncidenceVertex) ⟨(1 : Fin 2), ()⟩ := by
    change parallelData.incidenceGraph.Adj
      (⟨(0 : Fin 1).castSucc, ()⟩ : parallelData.IncidenceVertex)
      ⟨(0 : Fin 1).succ, ()⟩
    exact (parallelData.incidenceGraph_adj_castSucc_succ_iff 0 () ()).2
      ⟨false, rfl, rfl⟩
  fin_cases x <;> fin_cases y
  · constructor <;> intro h
    · exact (singleEdge.incidenceGraph.irrefl h).elim
    · exact (parallelData.incidenceGraph.irrefl h).elim
  · exact ⟨fun _ => hparallel, fun _ => hsingle⟩
  · exact ⟨fun h => (parallelData.incidenceGraph.adj_comm _ _).mp hparallel,
      fun h => (singleEdge.incidenceGraph.adj_comm _ _).mp hsingle⟩
  · constructor <;> intro h
    · exact (singleEdge.incidenceGraph.irrefl h).elim
    · exact (parallelData.incidenceGraph.irrefl h).elim

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.FiniteDataGraph.cycle_not_adj_02
statement:
theorem cycle_not_adj_02 :
    ¬cycleData.incidenceGraph.Adj
      (⟨0, (0 : Fin 1)⟩ : cycleData.IncidenceVertex)
      (⟨2, (0 : Fin 1)⟩ : cycleData.IncidenceVertex)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rcases cycleData.incidenceGraph_adj_level h with h | h
  · change ((0 : Fin 3) : ℕ) + 1 = ((2 : Fin 3) : ℕ) at h
    omega
  · change ((2 : Fin 3) : ℕ) + 1 = ((0 : Fin 3) : ℕ) at h
    omega

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.FiniteDataGraph.iso_isolated
statement:
theorem iso_isolated :
    ∀ y, ¬isoData.incidenceGraph.Adj
      (⟨0, true⟩ : isoData.IncidenceVertex) y
proof:
:= by
  intro y h
  rcases (isoData.incidenceGraph_adj_iff).mp h with hxy | hyx
  · obtain ⟨p⟩ := hxy
    have hs := congrArg (fun z : isoData.IncidenceVertex => z.2) p.2.1
    change false = true at hs
    exact Bool.false_ne_true hs
  · obtain ⟨p⟩ := hyx
    have ht := congrArg (fun z : isoData.IncidenceVertex => z.2) p.2.2
    change false = true at ht
    exact Bool.false_ne_true ht

    IsEmpty (ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph h02 p ∈ ioo 0 2} ≃
      (edgeGraph.induce (h02 ⁻¹' ((ioo 0 2 : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ))).ConnectedComponent)
proof:
:=
  single_no_vertexOnly_equiv ioo_zero_two_zero ioo_zero_two_two ioo_zero_two_one

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.half_no_vertex

proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.half_activeEdge_eq

theorem half_activeEdge_eq
    (e : {e : edgeGraph.edgeSet // EdgeActive edgeGraph h02 (ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2)) e}) :
    e = ⟨dartEdge d₀, single_active ioo_half_one⟩
proof:
:=
  single_activeEdge_eq ioo_half_one e

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.half_card_preimage
statement:
theorem half_card_preimage :
    Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy
      {p : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph h02 p ∈ ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2)}) = 1
proof:
:=
  single_card_preimage ioo_half_zero ioo_half_two ioo_half_one

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.half_not_endpointCoverage
statement: theorem half_not_endpointCoverage : ¬ EndpointCoverage edgeGraph h02 (ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.half_no_vertexOnly_equiv
statement:
theorem half_no_vertexOnly_equiv :

        {p : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph h02 p ∈ ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2)} ≃
      (edgeGraph.induce
        (h02 ⁻¹' ((ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2) : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ))).ConnectedComponent)
