name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.third_mem
statement: theorem third_mem : dartHeight h02 d₀ third ∈ ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dartHeight_d₀, mem_ioo]; show (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 2 * (1 / 3) ∧ 2 * (1 / 3) < (3 / 2 : ℝ)
  norm_num

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.third_symm_mem
statement: theorem third_symm_mem : dartHeight h02 d₀.symm third ∈ ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dartHeight_d₀_symm, mem_ioo]; show (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 2 - 2 * (1 / 3) ∧ 2 - 2 * (1 / 3) < (3 / 2 : ℝ)
  norm_num

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.opposite_points_ne
statement: theorem opposite_points_ne : edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ third ≠ edgePoint edgeGraph d₀.symm third
proof:
:= by
  intro hpt
  have hp : edgePoint edgeGraph d₀.symm third = edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ (σ third) := by
    rw [← edgePoint_symm edgeGraph d₀ (σ third), unitInterval.symm_symm]
  rw [hp] at hpt
  have := congrArg Subtype.val (edge_param_injective hpt)
  rw [unitInterval.coe_symm_eq] at this
  change (1 / 3 : ℝ) = 1 - 1 / 3 at this
  norm_num at this

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.opposite_points_same_class
statement:
theorem opposite_points_same_class :
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ third, third_mem⟩ : ZerothHomotopy
        {p : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph h02 p ∈ ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2)}) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint edgeGraph d₀.symm third, third_symm_mem⟩
proof:
:=
  single_opposite_darts ioo_half_zero ioo_half_two ioo_half_one third_mem third_symm_mem

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.plHeight_hconst
statement: theorem plHeight_hconst (p : Realization edgeGraph) : plHeight edgeGraph hconst p = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction p using ind edgeGraph with
  | vertex v => rfl
  | edgePoint d t => exact dartHeight_of_eq hconst rfl t

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.horizontal_inside_mem
statement: theorem horizontal_inside_mem (p : Realization edgeGraph) : plHeight edgeGraph hconst p ∈ ioo 0 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [plHeight_hconst, mem_ioo]; norm_num

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.horizontal_cell_class
statement:
theorem horizontal_cell_class (x : Cell edgeGraph hconst (ioo 0 2)) :
    (cellGraph edgeGraph hconst (ioo 0 2)).connectedComponentMk x =
      (cellGraph edgeGraph hconst (ioo 0 2)).connectedComponentMk
        (Sum.inr ⟨dartEdge d₀, horizontal_inside_active⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨v, hv⟩ | e
  · apply connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr
    cases v
    · exact fst_mem_dartEdge d₀
    · exact snd_mem_dartEdge d₀
  · exact congrArg _ (congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext (edgeGraph_edge_eq e.1)))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.horizontal_inside_card_cell
statement:
theorem horizontal_inside_card_cell :
    Nat.card (cellGraph edgeGraph hconst (ioo 0 2)).ConnectedComponent = 1
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.2 ⟨⟨ConnectedComponent.ind₂ fun x y => by
      rw [horizontal_cell_class x, horizontal_cell_class y]⟩,
    ⟨(cellGraph edgeGraph hconst (ioo 0 2)).connectedComponentMk
      (Sum.inr ⟨dartEdge d₀, horizontal_inside_active⟩)⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.horizontal_inside_card
statement:
theorem horizontal_inside_card :
    Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy
      {p : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph hconst p ∈ ioo 0 2}) = 1
proof:
:=
  (Nat.card_congr (preimageComponentsEquiv edgeGraph hconst (ioo 0 2))).trans
    horizontal_inside_card_cell

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.horizontal_outside_preimage_isEmpty
statement:
theorem horizontal_outside_preimage_isEmpty :
    IsEmpty {p : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph hconst p ∈ ioo 2 3}
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨p, hp⟩ => by
    rw [plHeight_hconst, mem_ioo] at hp
    norm_num at hp⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.horizontal_outside_cell_isEmpty
statement: theorem horizontal_outside_cell_isEmpty : IsEmpty (Cell edgeGraph hconst (ioo 2 3))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x => by
    rcases x with ⟨v, hv⟩ | ⟨e, he⟩
    · rw [mem_ioo] at hv
      norm_num [hconst] at hv
    · rw [edgeGraph_edge_eq e] at he
      exact horizontal_outside_inactive he⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.ray_true
statement: theorem ray_true : h02 true ∈ ioi 1
proof: := by rw [mem_ioi]; norm_num [h02]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.ray_false
statement: theorem ray_false : h02 false ∉ ioi 1
proof: := by rw [mem_ioi]; norm_num [h02]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.ray_truncated
statement:
theorem ray_truncated (t : unitInterval) :
    plHeight edgeGraph h02 (edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ t) ∈ ioi 1 ↔ 1 / 2 < (t : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [plHeight_edgePoint, dartHeight_d₀, mem_ioi]
  constructor <;> intro ht <;> linarith

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.ray_endpointCoverage
statement: theorem ray_endpointCoverage : EndpointCoverage edgeGraph h02 (ioi 1)
proof:
:= fun e _ => by
  rw [edgeGraph_edge_eq e]
  exact ⟨true, snd_mem_dartEdge d₀, ray_true⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.ray_vertex_eq
statement: theorem ray_vertex_eq (v : ↥(h02 ⁻¹' ((ioi 1 : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ))) : v = rayVertex
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := v
  cases v
  · exact absurd hv ray_false
  · rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.ray_card_induced
statement:
theorem ray_card_induced :
    Nat.card (edgeGraph.induce (h02 ⁻¹' ((ioi 1 : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ))).ConnectedComponent
      = 1
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.2 ⟨⟨ConnectedComponent.ind₂ fun x y => by
      rw [ray_vertex_eq x, ray_vertex_eq y]⟩,
    ⟨(edgeGraph.induce _).connectedComponentMk rayVertex⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.ray_card
statement:
theorem ray_card :
    Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph h02 p ∈ ioi 1})
      = 1
proof:
:=
  (Nat.card_congr (preimageInducedEquiv edgeGraph h02 (ioi 1) ray_endpointCoverage)).trans
    ray_card_induced

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.ray_edgePoint
statement:
theorem ray_edgePoint (t : unitInterval) (ht : dartHeight h02 d₀ t ∈ ioi 1) :
    preimageInducedEquiv edgeGraph h02 (ioi 1) ray_endpointCoverage
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ t, ht⟩) =
      (edgeGraph.induce _).connectedComponentMk rayVertex
proof:
:=
  preimageInducedEquiv_mk_edgePoint edgeGraph h02 (ioi 1) _ d₀ t ht (snd_mem_dartEdge d₀) ray_true

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.ray_edge_class
statement:
theorem ray_edge_class (t : unitInterval) (ht : dartHeight h02 d₀ t ∈ ioi 1) :
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ t, ht⟩ :
        ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph h02 p ∈ ioi 1}) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨vertex edgeGraph true, ray_true⟩
proof:
:=
  (preimageInducedEquiv edgeGraph h02 (ioi 1) ray_endpointCoverage).injective
    ((ray_edgePoint t ht).trans
      (preimageInducedEquiv_mk_vertex edgeGraph h02 (ioi 1) _ true ray_true).symm)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.h4_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem h4_zero : h4 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.h4_one
statement: @[simp] theorem h4_one : h4 1 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.h4_two
statement: @[simp] theorem h4_two : h4 2 = 2
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.h4_three
statement: @[simp] theorem h4_three : h4 3 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.h4_mem_I4
statement: theorem h4_mem_I4 {v : Fin 4} : h4 v ∈ I4 ↔ v = 1 ∨ v = 3
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases v <;> norm_num [h4, mem_ioo] <;> decide

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.h4_mem_J4
statement: theorem h4_mem_J4 (v : Fin 4) : h4 v ∈ J4
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases v <;> norm_num [h4, mem_ioo]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.I4_le_J4
statement: theorem I4_le_J4 : I4 ≤ J4
proof:
:= OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := hx
  show (-1 / 2 : ℝ) < x ∧ x < 5 / 2
  constructor <;> linarith

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.I4_lt_J4
statement: theorem I4_lt_J4 : I4 < J4
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne I4_le_J4 fun hIJ => by
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ J4 := by rw [mem_ioo]; norm_num
    rw [← hIJ, mem_ioo] at h0
    norm_num at h0

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.one_mem_I4
statement: theorem one_mem_I4 : h4 1 ∈ I4
proof: := h4_mem_I4.2 (.inl rfl)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.three_mem_I4
statement: theorem three_mem_I4 : h4 3 ∈ I4
proof: := h4_mem_I4.2 (.inr rfl)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.C4_not_adj_one_three
statement: theorem C4_not_adj_one_three : ¬ C4.Adj 1 3
proof: := by decide

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.C4_adj_endpoint
statement: theorem C4_adj_endpoint : ∀ a b : Fin 4, C4.Adj a b → (a = 1 ∨ a = 3) ∨ (b = 1 ∨ b = 3)
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.C4_edge_endpoint
statement:
theorem C4_edge_endpoint (d : C4.Dart) :
    ∃ w : Fin 4, w ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 (Fin 4)) ∧ (w = 1 ∨ w = 3)
proof:
:= by
  rcases C4_adj_endpoint d.fst d.snd d.adj with hw | hw
  · exact ⟨d.fst, fst_mem_dartEdge d, hw⟩
  · exact ⟨d.snd, snd_mem_dartEdge d, hw⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4Side_inl_iff_inr
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv1
    rwa [← hv1]
  · intro h1
    rcases h4_mem_I4.1 v.2 with hv1 | hv3
    · exact hv1
    · exfalso
      have he : (e.1 : Sym2 (Fin 4)) = s(1, 3) :=
        (Sym2.mem_and_mem_iff (by decide)).1 ⟨h1, hv3 ▸ hv⟩
      have hadj : C4.Adj 1 3 := by
        have := e.1.2
        rw [he] at this
        exact this
      exact C4_not_adj_one_three hadj

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4Side_adj
statement:
theorem c4Side_adj {x y : Cell C4 h4 I4} (hxy : (cellGraph C4 h4 I4).Adj x y) :
    c4Side x = c4Side y
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with v | e <;> rcases y with w | e'
  · exact (hxy : False).elim
  · exact propext (c4Side_inl_iff_inr hxy)
  · exact (propext (c4Side_inl_iff_inr hxy)).symm
  · exact (hxy : False).elim

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_cell_ne
statement:
theorem c4_cell_ne :
    (cellGraph C4 h4 I4).connectedComponentMk n1 ≠ (cellGraph C4 h4 I4).connectedComponentMk n3
proof:
:=
  fun hc => by
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := ConnectedComponent.exact hc
    have hs : c4Side n1 = c4Side n3 := eq_of_walk (fun _ _ => c4Side_adj) p
    have h31 : (3 : Fin 4) = 1 := Eq.mp hs rfl
    exact absurd h31 (by decide)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_cell_classification
statement:
theorem c4_cell_classification (c : (cellGraph C4 h4 I4).ConnectedComponent) :
    c = (cellGraph C4 h4 I4).connectedComponentMk n1 ∨
      c = (cellGraph C4 h4 I4).connectedComponentMk n3
proof:
:= by
  induction c using ConnectedComponent.ind with
  | h x =>
    rcases x with ⟨v, hv⟩ | ⟨e, he⟩
    · rcases h4_mem_I4.1 hv with rfl | rfl
      · exact .inl rfl
      · exact .inr rfl
    · obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
      obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl | rfl⟩ := C4_edge_endpoint d
      · exact .inl (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr C4 h4 I4 (v := ⟨1, one_mem_I4⟩) hw).symm
      · exact .inr (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr C4 h4 I4 (v := ⟨3, three_mem_I4⟩) hw).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_card_cell
statement: theorem c4_card_cell : Nat.card (cellGraph C4 h4 I4).ConnectedComponent = 2
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_eq_two_iff.2 ⟨_, _, c4_cell_ne, Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun c => by
    rcases c4_cell_classification c with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_equiv_x1
statement:
theorem c4_equiv_x1 :
    preimageComponentsEquiv C4 h4 I4 x1 = (cellGraph C4 h4 I4).connectedComponentMk n1
proof:
:=
  preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex C4 h4 I4 1 one_mem_I4

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_equiv_x3
statement:
theorem c4_equiv_x3 :
    preimageComponentsEquiv C4 h4 I4 x3 = (cellGraph C4 h4 I4).connectedComponentMk n3
proof:
:=
  preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex C4 h4 I4 3 three_mem_I4

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_x1_ne_x3
statement: theorem c4_x1_ne_x3 : x1 ≠ x3
proof:
:= fun hx =>
  c4_cell_ne (by rw [← c4_equiv_x1, ← c4_equiv_x3, hx])

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_preimage_classification
statement:
theorem c4_preimage_classification
    (c : ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 p ∈ I4}) : c = x1 ∨ c = x3
proof:
:= by
  rcases c4_cell_classification (preimageComponentsEquiv C4 h4 I4 c) with hc | hc
  · left
    rw [← (preimageComponentsEquiv C4 h4 I4).symm_apply_apply c, hc]
    rfl
  · right
    rw [← (preimageComponentsEquiv C4 h4 I4).symm_apply_apply c, hc]
    rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_card_preimage
statement:
theorem c4_card_preimage :
    Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 p ∈ I4}) = 2
proof:
:=
  (Nat.card_congr (preimageComponentsEquiv C4 h4 I4)).trans c4_card_cell

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.d01_mem
statement: theorem d01_mem : dartHeight h4 d01 threeQuarter ∈ I4

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.d23_mem
statement: theorem d23_mem : dartHeight h4 d23 threeQuarter ∈ I4

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_d01_class
statement:
theorem c4_d01_class :
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint C4 d01 threeQuarter, d01_mem⟩ :
      ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 p ∈ I4}) = x1
proof:
:=
  (preimageComponentsEquiv C4 h4 I4).injective
    ((preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint_of_snd_mem C4 h4 I4 d01_mem one_mem_I4).trans
      c4_equiv_x1.symm)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_d23_class
statement:
theorem c4_d23_class :
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint C4 d23 threeQuarter, d23_mem⟩ :
      ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 p ∈ I4}) = x3
proof:
:=
  (preimageComponentsEquiv C4 h4 I4).injective
    ((preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint_of_snd_mem C4 h4 I4 d23_mem three_mem_I4).trans
      c4_equiv_x3.symm)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_J_cell_merge
statement:
theorem c4_J_cell_merge :
    ((cellGraph C4 h4 I4).connectedComponentMk n1).map (cellInclusion C4 h4 I4_le_J4) =
      ((cellGraph C4 h4 I4).connectedComponentMk n3).map (cellInclusion C4 h4 I4_le_J4)
proof:
:= by
  have a12 : C4.Adj 1 2 := by decide
  have a23 : C4.Adj 2 3 := by decide
  show (cellGraph C4 h4 J4).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨1, h4_mem_J4 1⟩) =
    (cellGraph C4 h4 J4).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨3, h4_mem_J4 3⟩)
  calc (cellGraph C4 h4 J4).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨1, h4_mem_J4 1⟩)
      = (cellGraph C4 h4 J4).connectedComponentMk
          (Sum.inl ⟨2, h4_mem_J4 2⟩) :=
        connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_of_adj C4 h4 J4 (u := ⟨1, h4_mem_J4 1⟩)
          (w := ⟨2, h4_mem_J4 2⟩) a12
    _ = (cellGraph C4 h4 J4).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨3, h4_mem_J4 3⟩) :=
        connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_of_adj C4 h4 J4 (u := ⟨2, h4_mem_J4 2⟩)
          (w := ⟨3, h4_mem_J4 3⟩) a23

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_J_preimage_merge
statement:
theorem c4_J_preimage_merge :
    TDA.Reeb.componentMap (preimageInclusion (plHeight C4 h4) (toOpens_le_iff.2 I4_le_J4)) x1 =
      TDA.Reeb.componentMap (preimageInclusion (plHeight C4 h4) (toOpens_le_iff.2 I4_le_J4)) x3
proof:
:=
  (preimageComponentsEquiv C4 h4 J4).injective (by
    have e1 := preimageComponentsEquiv_componentMap C4 h4 I4_le_J4 x1
    have e3 := preimageComponentsEquiv_componentMap C4 h4 I4_le_J4 x3
    rw [c4_equiv_x1] at e1
    rw [c4_equiv_x3] at e3
    exact e1.trans (c4_J_cell_merge.trans e3.symm))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_square_x1
statement:
theorem c4_square_x1 :
    preimageComponentsEquiv C4 h4 J4
        (TDA.Reeb.componentMap (preimageInclusion (plHeight C4 h4) (toOpens_le_iff.2 I4_le_J4)) x1) =
      ((cellGraph C4 h4 I4).connectedComponentMk n1).map (cellInclusion C4 h4 I4_le_J4)
proof:
:= by
  rw [preimageComponentsEquiv_componentMap, c4_equiv_x1]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_square_x3
statement:
theorem c4_square_x3 :
    preimageComponentsEquiv C4 h4 J4
        (TDA.Reeb.componentMap (preimageInclusion (plHeight C4 h4) (toOpens_le_iff.2 I4_le_J4)) x3) =
      ((cellGraph C4 h4 I4).connectedComponentMk n3).map (cellInclusion C4 h4 I4_le_J4)
proof:
:= by
  rw [preimageComponentsEquiv_componentMap, c4_equiv_x3]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_functor_merge
statement:
theorem c4_functor_merge :
    (intervalComponents (plHeight C4 h4)).map (homOfLE I4_le_J4) x1 =
        (intervalComponents (plHeight C4 h4)).map (homOfLE I4_le_J4) x3 ∧
      (cellComponentFunctor C4 h4).map (homOfLE I4_le_J4)
          ((intervalComponentsIso C4 h4).hom.app I4 x1) =
        (cellComponentFunctor C4 h4).map (homOfLE I4_le_J4)
          ((intervalComponentsIso C4 h4).hom.app I4 x3)
proof:
:=
  ⟨c4_J_preimage_merge, by
    have hm := c4_J_cell_merge
    rw [← c4_equiv_x1, ← c4_equiv_x3] at hm
    exact hm⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_endpointCoverage
statement: theorem c4_endpointCoverage : EndpointCoverage C4 h4 I4
proof:
:= fun e _ => by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hw'⟩ := C4_edge_endpoint d
  exact ⟨w, hw, h4_mem_I4.2 hw'⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphPL.c4_vertexOnly_x1
statement:
theorem c4_vertexOnly_x1 :
    preimageInducedEquiv C4 h4 I4 c4_endpointCoverage x1 =
      (C4.induce (h4 ⁻¹' (I4 : Set ℝ))).connectedComponentMk ⟨1, one_mem_I4⟩
proof:
:=

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.point_distance_eq_one
statement:
theorem point_distance_eq_one :
    interleavingDistance (pointPrecosheaf 0) (pointPrecosheaf 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (by simpa using pointInterleaving.interleavingDistance_le)
    (le_interleavingDistance_iff.2 fun ε ⟨i⟩ => ?_)
  by_contra hlt
  have hε : (ε : ℝ) < 1 := by
    have : ε < 1 := by simpa using not_le.1 hlt
    exact_mod_cast this
  set r : ℝ := (1 - ε) / 2 with hr
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by rw [hr]; linarith
  have x : (pointPrecosheaf 0).obj (ioo (-r) r) :=
    PLift.up (by change (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (-r) r; constructor <;> linarith)
  have h := (i.φ.app (ioo (-r) r) x).down
  rw [thicken_ioo (by linarith)] at h
  change (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo _ _ at h
  linarith [h.2]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isIso_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app
statement:
theorem isIso_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app {X : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)}
    (hX : IsConstructibleSpace X) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    IsIso (intervalComponentsOver.map
      ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).map ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X)))
proof:
:= by
  have : IsIso (intervalComponentsOver.map ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X)) := by
    rw [intervalComponentsOver_map_projNatTrans_app]
    exact isIso_intervalComponentComparison_of_constructible hX
  have : IsIso ((smoothing ε).map
      (intervalComponentsOver.map ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X))) :=
    Functor.map_isIso (smoothing ε) _
  have h : IsIso ((GeometricThickening.componentComparisonNatIso ε).hom.app X ≫
      (smoothing ε).map (intervalComponentsOver.map ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X)) ≫
        (GeometricThickening.componentComparisonNatIso ε).inv.app ((ℛ).obj X)) :=
    inferInstance
  change IsIso ((GeometricThickening.functor ε ⋙ intervalComponentsOver).map
    ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X))
  rw [← NatIso.naturality_2 (GeometricThickening.componentComparisonNatIso ε)]
  exact h

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isIso_intervalComponentComparison_thickening
statement:
theorem isIso_intervalComponentComparison_thickening {X : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)}
    (hX : IsConstructibleSpace X) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    IsIso (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison
      (overBaseMap ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj X)))
proof:
:= by
  let g := (GeometricThickening.functor ε).map ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X)
  have := isIso_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app hX ε
  have : IsIso (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparisonOver.app
      ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj ((ℛ).obj X))) :=
    isIso_intervalComponentComparison_of_constructible
      (isConstructibleSpace_thickening (isRGraph_quotient_of_isConstructibleSpace hX) ε)
  have hsq : intervalComponentsOver.map g ≫ ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparisonOver.app
        ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj ((ℛ).obj X)) =
      ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparisonOver.app ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj X) ≫
        (ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ ⋙ intervalComponentsOver).map g :=
    ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparisonOver.naturality g
  have hc : IsIso (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparisonOver.app
      ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj X) ≫ intervalComponentsOver.map ((ℛ).map g)) := by
    change IsIso (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparisonOver.app
      ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj X) ≫
        (ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ ⋙ intervalComponentsOver).map g)
    rw [← hsq]
    infer_instance
  refine @NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app _ _ _ _ _ _ _ fun I => ?_
  refine (isIso_iff_bijective _).2 ⟨?_, ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison_app_surjective _ I⟩
  have hI : IsIso ((ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparisonOver.app
      ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj X) ≫ intervalComponentsOver.map ((ℛ).map g)).app I) :=
    inferInstance
  exact Function.Injective.of_comp ((isIso_iff_bijective _).1 hI).1

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isIso_map_quotientFunctor_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app
statement:

    (hX : IsConstructibleSpace X) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    IsIso (intervalComponentsOver.map ((ℛ).map
      ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).map ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X))))
proof:
:= by
  let g := (GeometricThickening.functor ε).map ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X)
  have := isIso_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app hX ε
  have : IsIso (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparisonOver.app
      ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj ((ℛ).obj X))) :=
    isIso_intervalComponentComparison_of_constructible
      (isConstructibleSpace_thickening (isRGraph_quotient_of_isConstructibleSpace hX) ε)
  have : IsIso (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparisonOver.app
      ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj X)) :=
    isIso_intervalComponentComparison_thickening hX ε
  have hc : IsIso (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparisonOver.app
      ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj X) ≫ intervalComponentsOver.map ((ℛ).map g)) := by
    change IsIso (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparisonOver.app
      ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj X) ≫
        (ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ ⋙ intervalComponentsOver).map g)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isIso_quotientFunctor_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app
statement:
theorem isIso_quotientFunctor_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app {X : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)}
    (hX : IsConstructibleSpace X) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (hT : IsRGraph ((ℛ).obj ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj X))) :
    IsIso ((ℛ).map
      ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).map ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X)))
proof:
:= by
  let s : RGraphCat := ⟨(ℛ).obj ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj X), hT⟩
  let t : RGraphCat := ⟨(ℛ).obj ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj ((ℛ).obj X)),
    isRGraph_quotient_of_isConstructibleSpace
      (isConstructibleSpace_thickening (isRGraph_quotient_of_isConstructibleSpace hX) ε)⟩
  let G : s ⟶ t := ObjectProperty.homMk
    ((ℛ).map ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).map ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X)))
  have : IsIso ((ObjectProperty.ι IsConstructibleCosheaf.{0}).map (cosheafFunctor.map G)) :=
    isIso_map_quotientFunctor_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app hX ε
  have : IsIso (cosheafFunctor.map G) :=
    (ObjectProperty.fullyFaithfulι IsConstructibleCosheaf.{0}).isIso_of_isIso_map _
  have : IsIso G := cosheafFullyFaithful.isIso_of_isIso_map G
  exact (inferInstance : IsIso (IsRGraph.ι.map G))

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.absorption_inv_mk
statement:
theorem absorption_inv_mk {X : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)} (hX : IsConstructibleSpace X) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (hT : IsRGraph ((ℛ).obj ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj X))) (x : X.left)
    (t : GeometricThickening.Band ε) :
    haveI := isIso_quotientFunctor_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app hX ε hT
    (inv ((ℛ).map ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).map
        ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X)))).left.hom
        (ReebQuotient.mk (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj X)) ε)
          (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap X) x, t)) =
      ReebQuotient.mk (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap X) ε) (x, t)
proof:
:= by
  have := isIso_quotientFunctor_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app hX ε hT
  exact congrArg (fun φ => φ.left.hom
    (ReebQuotient.mk (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap X) ε) (x, t)))
    (IsIso.hom_inv_id ((ℛ).map ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).map
      ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X))))

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricSmoothingCompIso_assoc
statement:
theorem geometricSmoothingCompIso_assoc (ε δ γ : ℝ≥0) :
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (geometricSmoothing γ) (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ) ≪≫
        geometricSmoothingCompIso (ε + δ) γ ≪≫ geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_assoc ε δ γ) =
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight (geometricSmoothingCompIso δ γ) (geometricSmoothing ε) ≪≫
        geometricSmoothingCompIso ε (δ + γ)
proof:
:= by
  ext A q
  obtain ⟨⟨p, u⟩, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _ q
  obtain ⟨⟨r, t⟩, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _ p
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _ r
  have e1 := geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk ε δ ((geometricSmoothing γ).obj A)
    (ReebQuotient.mk (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap A.obj) γ) z, t) u
  have e2 := geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk (ε + δ) γ A z
    (GeometricThickening.addMap ((geometricSmoothing γ).obj A).obj.left ε δ
      ((ReebQuotient.mk (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap A.obj) γ) z, t), u)).2
  have e3 := geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk δ γ A z t
  have e4 := geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk ε (δ + γ) A
    (GeometricThickening.addMap A.obj.left δ γ (z, t)) u
  refine ((congrArg (fun w => ((geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_assoc ε δ γ)).hom.app A).hom.left.hom
    (((geometricSmoothingCompIso (ε + δ) γ).hom.app A).hom.left.hom w)) e1).trans
    ((congrArg (fun w => ((geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_assoc ε δ γ)).hom.app A).hom.left.hom w)
      e2).trans ?_)).trans
    ((congrArg (fun w => ((geometricSmoothingCompIso ε (δ + γ)).hom.app A).hom.left.hom
      (ReebQuotient.mk _ (w, u))) e3).trans e4).symm
  exact congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) (Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext (add_assoc _ _ _).symm))

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricSmoothingCompIso_zero_left
statement:
theorem geometricSmoothingCompIso_zero_left (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    geometricSmoothingCompIso 0 δ ≪≫ geometricSmoothingEqIso (zero_add δ) =
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (geometricSmoothing δ) geometricSmoothingZeroIso ≪≫
        Functor.rightUnitor _
proof:
:= by
  ext A q
  obtain ⟨⟨p, t⟩, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _ q
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _ p
  refine (congrArg (fun w => ((geometricSmoothingEqIso (zero_add δ)).hom.app A).hom.left.hom w)
    (geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk 0 δ A z t)).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (geometricSmoothingZeroIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk
    ((geometricSmoothing δ).obj A) _ t).symm
  refine congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) (Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext ?_))
  show (z.2 : ℝ) + t = z.2
  rw [GeometricThickening.eq_zero_of_mem_band_zero t.2, add_zero]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricSmoothingCompIso_zero_right
statement:
theorem geometricSmoothingCompIso_zero_right (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    geometricSmoothingCompIso δ 0 ≪≫ geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_zero δ) =
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight geometricSmoothingZeroIso (geometricSmoothing δ) ≪≫
        Functor.leftUnitor _
proof:
:= by
  ext A q
  obtain ⟨⟨p, t⟩, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _ q
  obtain ⟨⟨x, s⟩, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _ p
  refine (congrArg (fun w => ((geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_zero δ)).hom.app A).hom.left.hom w)
    (geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk δ 0 A (x, s) t)).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (fun b => ReebQuotient.mk
    (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap A.obj) δ) (b, t))
    (geometricSmoothingZeroIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk A x s)).symm
  refine congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) (Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext ?_))
  show (s : ℝ) + t = t
  rw [GeometricThickening.eq_zero_of_mem_band_zero s.2, zero_add]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (A : RGraphCat) :
    (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app A)).hom ≫
        ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso (ε + δ)).hom.app A).hom =
      ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app ((geometricSmoothing δ).obj A)).hom ≫
        (smoothing ε).map ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso δ).hom.app A).hom ≫
          (smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app (intervalComponentsOver.obj A.obj)
proof:
:= by
  ext I c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk Q' =>
    obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Q'
    obtain ⟨⟨b, t⟩, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _ Q
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _ b
    have e := geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk ε δ A z t
    have hw : GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap A.obj) (ε + δ)
        (GeometricThickening.addMap A.obj.left ε δ (z, t)) ∈ I := by
      rw [GeometricThickening.height_addMap]
      exact hQ
    have key : ∀ (y : ReebQuotient (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap A.obj) (ε + δ)))
        (hy : ReebQuotient.height (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap A.obj) (ε + δ)) y ∈ I),
        y = ReebQuotient.mk _ (GeometricThickening.addMap A.obj.left ε δ (z, t)) →
        ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso (ε + δ)).hom.app A).hom.app I
            (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨y, hy⟩) =
          ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso (ε + δ)).hom.app A).hom.app I
            (ZerothHomotopy.mk
              ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ (GeometricThickening.addMap A.obj.left ε δ (z, t)), hw⟩) := by
      rintro y hy rfl
      rfl
    have l2 := geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk (ε + δ) A I
      ⟨GeometricThickening.addMap A.obj.left ε δ (z, t), hw⟩
    have r1 := geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk ε ((geometricSmoothing δ).obj A) I
      ⟨(ReebQuotient.mk _ z, t), hQ⟩
    have r2 := geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk δ A (thicken ε I)
      ⟨z, GeometricThickening.fst_mem_thicken hQ⟩
    refine ((key _ _ e).trans l2).trans ?_
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (fun w =>
      ((smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app (intervalComponentsOver.obj A.obj)).app I
        (((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso δ).hom.app A).hom.app (thicken ε I) w)) r1).symm
    exact (congrArg (fun w =>
      ((smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app (intervalComponentsOver.obj A.obj)).app I w) r2).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.reebRel_iff_joinedIn
statement:
theorem reebRel_iff_joinedIn (f : C(X, Y)) (x x' : X) :
    ReebRel f x x' ↔ JoinedIn (f ⁻¹' {f x}) x x'
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebRel.apply_eq
statement: theorem ReebRel.apply_eq {f : C(X, Y)} {x x' : X} (h : ReebRel f x x') : f x' = f x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := h
  simpa using hγ 1

name: TDA.Reeb.reebRel_iff_joined_fiber
statement:
theorem reebRel_iff_joined_fiber (f : C(X, Y)) (x x' : X) :
    ReebRel f x x' ↔
      ∃ h : f x' = f x,
        Joined (⟨x, rfl⟩ : f ⁻¹' {f x}) (⟨x', h⟩ : f ⁻¹' {f x})
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hr
    exact ⟨hr.apply_eq, (joinedIn_iff_joined (F := f ⁻¹' {f x}) rfl hr.apply_eq).1 hr⟩
  · rintro ⟨h, hj⟩
    exact (joinedIn_iff_joined (F := f ⁻¹' {f x}) rfl h).2 hj

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebRel.refl
statement: theorem ReebRel.refl (f : C(X, Y)) (x : X) : ReebRel f x x
proof:
:=
  ⟨Path.refl x, fun _ => rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebRel.symm
statement: theorem ReebRel.symm {f : C(X, Y)} {x x' : X} (h : ReebRel f x x') : ReebRel f x' x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := h
  refine ⟨γ.symm, fun t => ?_⟩
  show f (γ (unitInterval.symm t)) = f x'
  rw [hγ]
  simpa using (hγ 1).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebRel.trans
statement:
theorem ReebRel.trans {f : C(X, Y)} {x x' x'' : X} (h₁ : ReebRel f x x')
    (h₂ : ReebRel f x' x'') : ReebRel f x x''
proof:
:= by
  have e := h₁.apply_eq
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := h₂
  refine ⟨γ.trans δ, fun t => ?_⟩
  rw [Path.trans_apply]
  split_ifs
  · exact hγ _
  · rw [hδ, e]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Cylinder.gapData_not_preconnected
statement:
theorem gapData_not_preconnected :
    ¬ PreconnectedSpace ((ofFiniteData gapData).Realization S01)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hpc := isPreconnected_range ((ofFiniteData gapData).height S01).continuous
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ range ((ofFiniteData gapData).height S01) :=
    ⟨(ofFiniteData gapData).ofVertex S01 0 (show (ofFiniteData gapData).V 0 from ()),
      ((ofFiniteData gapData).height_ofVertex S01 0 _).trans S01_value_zero⟩
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ∈ range ((ofFiniteData gapData).height S01) :=
    ⟨(ofFiniteData gapData).ofVertex S01 1 (show (ofFiniteData gapData).V 1 from ()),
      ((ofFiniteData gapData).height_ofVertex S01 1 _).trans S01_value_one⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hpc.Icc_subset h0 h1 (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 by norm_num)
  rcases (ofFiniteData gapData).exists_rep S01 q with ⟨i, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, p, -⟩
  · rw [height_ofVertex] at hq
    fin_cases i <;> simp at hq
  · exact isEmptyElim (α := Empty) p.1

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Cylinder.height_preimage_Ico_eq_empty
statement:
theorem height_preimage_Ico_eq_empty {n : ℕ} (S : CriticalValues n)
    (P : CylinderPresentation.{u} n) (e : Fin n) (h : IsEmpty (P.V e.castSucc)) :
    P.height S ⁻¹' Ico (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2 fun q hq => ?_
  rcases P.exists_rep S q with ⟨i, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e', p, rfl⟩
  · have hq : S.value i ∈ Ico (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) := hq
    have h₁ : e.castSucc ≤ i := S.strictMono.le_iff_le.1 hq.1
    have h₂ : i < e.succ := S.strictMono.lt_iff_lt.1 hq.2
    obtain rfl : i = e.castSucc := le_antisymm (Fin.le_castSucc_iff.2 h₂) h₁
    exact h.false v
  · have hq : (p.2 : ℝ) ∈ Ico (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) := hq
    obtain rfl : e' = e := S.eq_of_mem_K_of_mem_Icc p.2.2 ⟨hq.1, hq.2.le⟩
    exact (P.isEmpty_E_of_left h).false p.1

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricComponentObstruction.parallel_restrict_bijective
statement:
theorem parallel_restrict_bijective {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (hJ : J ≤ S01.K 0) (hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty) :
    Function.Bijective ((cosheafFunctor.obj parallelGraph).obj.map (homOfLE hIJ))
proof:
:= by
  change Function.Bijective ((parallelData.toCosheaf S01).map (homOfLE hIJ))
  apply (parallelData.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt S01).bijective hIJ hI
  intro i
  exact iff_of_false
    (fun hi => S01.value_notMem_K 0 i
      (OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 (hIJ.trans hJ) hi))
    (fun hi => S01.value_notMem_K 0 i (OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 hJ hi))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricComponentObstruction.parallel_nontrivial_of_le_K

theorem parallel_nontrivial_of_le_K {I : OpenInterval} (hI : I ≤ S01.K 0)
    (hI_nonempty : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty) :
    Nontrivial ((cosheafFunctor.obj parallelGraph).obj.obj I)
proof:
:= by
  change Nontrivial ((parallelData.toCosheaf S01).obj I)
  have hK : Nontrivial ((parallelData.toCosheaf S01).obj (S01.K 0)) :=
    @Function.Injective.nontrivial _ _ (inferInstanceAs (Nontrivial Bool)) _
      (parallelData.edgeLabel S01 0).injective
  exact @Function.Surjective.nontrivial _ _ hK _
    (parallel_restrict_bijective hI le_rfl hI_nonempty).surjective

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricComponentObstruction.thicken_thicken_obstructionInterval
statement:
theorem thicken_thicken_obstructionInterval {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : (ε : ℝ) < 1 / 4) :
    thicken ε (thicken ε (obstructionInterval ε)) = S01.K 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [obstructionInterval, thicken_ioo (by linarith) ε,
    thicken_ioo (by linarith) ε, S01.mem_K, mem_ioo]
  simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_zero, S01_value_one]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩
    constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨hx, hy⟩
    constructor <;> linarith

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricComponentObstruction.obstructionInterval_nonempty
statement:
theorem obstructionInterval_nonempty {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : (ε : ℝ) < 1 / 4) :
    ((obstructionInterval ε : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨1 / 2, ?_⟩
  show (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ ioo (2 * (ε : ℝ)) (1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
  exact mem_ioo.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricComponentObstruction.parallelSingle_isEmpty
statement:
theorem parallelSingle_isEmpty {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : (ε : ℝ) < 1 / 4) :
    IsEmpty (GeometricInterleaving ε parallelGraph singleGraph)
proof:
:= by
  let I : OpenInterval := obstructionInterval ε
  have hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty := obstructionInterval_nonempty hε
  have hdouble : thicken ε (thicken ε I) ≤ S01.K 0 := by
    exact (thicken_thicken_obstructionInterval hε).le
  have hIJ : I ≤ thicken ε (thicken ε I) :=
    (le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I))
  have hmap : Function.Injective ((cosheafFunctor.obj parallelGraph).obj.map
      (homOfLE hIJ)) :=
    (parallel_restrict_bijective hIJ hdouble hI).injective
  have hnontrivial : Nontrivial ((cosheafFunctor.obj parallelGraph).obj.obj I) :=
    parallel_nontrivial_of_le_K
      ((le_thicken ε I).trans ((le_thicken ε (thicken ε I)).trans hdouble)) hI
  have hsubsingleton : Subsingleton
      ((cosheafFunctor.obj singleGraph).obj.obj (thicken ε I)) :=
    single_subsingleton _
  exact @isEmpty_geometricInterleaving_of_injective_of_subsingleton ε parallelGraph
    singleGraph I hmap hnontrivial hsubsingleton

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricComponentObstruction.geometricInterleavingDistance_parallel_single
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_parallel_single :
    geometricInterleavingDistance parallelGraph singleGraph = 1 / 4
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricInterleaving.geometricInterleavingDistance_parallel_single_le
  · rw [← coe_quarter_ennreal]
    apply le_geometricInterleavingDistance_of_isEmpty

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricComponentObstruction.thicken_half_not_le_K
statement:
theorem thicken_half_not_le_K :
    ∀ I : OpenInterval, (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty →
      ¬ thicken (quarter + quarter) I ≤ S01.K 0
proof:
:= by
  intro I hI hle
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hI
  have hhalf : ((quarter + quarter : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = 1 / 2 := by
    rw [NNReal.coe_add, coe_quarter]
    norm_num
  have hleft : x - (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ S01.K 0 := by
    apply hle
    rw [mem_thicken]
    refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
    have hx' : (x - (1 / 2 : ℝ)) - x = -(1 / 2 : ℝ) := by ring
    rw [hx', abs_of_nonpos (by norm_num), hhalf]
    norm_num
  have hright : x + (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ S01.K 0 := by
    apply hle
    rw [mem_thicken]
    refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
    have hx' : (x + (1 / 2 : ℝ)) - x = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by ring
    rw [hx', abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num), hhalf]
  rw [S01.mem_K] at hleft hright
  simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_zero, S01_value_one]
    at hleft hright
  linarith [hleft.1, hright.2]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricComponentObstruction.geometricInterleavingDistance_twoSeg_single
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_twoSeg_single :
    geometricInterleavingDistance twoSegGraph singleGraph = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_top_iff]
  intro ε
  have hmap : Function.Injective ((cosheafFunctor.obj twoSegGraph).obj.map
      (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε (⊤ : OpenInterval)).trans
        (le_thicken ε (thicken ε (⊤ : OpenInterval)))))) := by
    have hmap_of_eq {J : OpenInterval} (hJ : J = ⊤)
        (h : (⊤ : OpenInterval) ≤ J) :
        Function.Injective
          ((cosheafFunctor.obj twoSegGraph).obj.map (homOfLE h)) := by
      subst J
      rw [map_eq_map_of_interval (cosheafFunctor.obj twoSegGraph).obj _ (𝟙 _),
        CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
      exact Function.injective_id
    exact hmap_of_eq (J := thicken ε (thicken ε (⊤ : OpenInterval)))
      (by simp only [thicken_top])
      ((le_thicken ε (⊤ : OpenInterval)).trans
        (le_thicken ε (thicken ε (⊤ : OpenInterval))))
  have hnontrivial : Nontrivial
      ((cosheafFunctor.obj twoSegGraph).obj.obj (⊤ : OpenInterval)) := by
    change Nontrivial ((intervalComponents (overBaseMap twoSegGraph.obj)).obj ⊤)
    let c (b : Bool) :
        (intervalComponents (overBaseMap twoSegGraph.obj)).obj ⊤ :=
      ZerothHomotopy.mk
        ⟨(ofFiniteData twoSegData).ofVertex S01 0 b, Set.mem_univ _⟩
    refine ⟨⟨c false, c true, ?_⟩⟩
    intro h
    dsimp [c] at h
    have hc : Continuous fun x :
        {x : (ofFiniteData twoSegData).Realization S01 //
          (ofFiniteData twoSegData).height S01 x ∈ (⊤ : OpenInterval)} =>
        twoSegLabel x.1 :=
      twoSegLabel.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val
    have hj := (Quotient.exact h).map hc
    exact Bool.false_ne_true (joined_eq_of_discrete hj)
  have hsubsingleton : Subsingleton
      ((cosheafFunctor.obj singleGraph).obj.obj
        (thicken ε (⊤ : OpenInterval))) := by
    exact single_subsingleton _
  exact @isEmpty_geometricInterleaving_of_injective_of_subsingleton ε twoSegGraph
    singleGraph (⊤ : OpenInterval) hmap hnontrivial hsubsingleton

proof:
:= by
  intro q
  rcases (ofFiniteData P.componentData).exists_rep S q with ⟨i, c, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, ⟨c, t⟩, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := P.vertexClass_surjective i c
    exact ⟨P.ofVertex S i v, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := P.edgeClass_surjective e c
    exact ⟨P.ofStrip S e (y, t), rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.reebRel_of_componentGraphMap_eq
statement:
theorem reebRel_of_componentGraphMap_eq {x x' : P.Realization S}
    (h : P.componentGraphMap S x = P.componentGraphMap S x') : ReebRel (P.height S) x x'
proof:
:= by
  rcases P.exists_rep S x with ⟨i, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, ⟨y, t⟩, rfl⟩ <;>
    rcases P.exists_rep S x' with ⟨i', v', rfl⟩ | ⟨e', ⟨y', t'⟩, rfl⟩
  · rw [componentGraphMap_ofVertex, componentGraphMap_ofVertex, ofVertex_eq_ofVertex_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, hv⟩ := Sigma.mk.inj_iff.1 h
    obtain ⟨γ⟩ := (P.vertexClass_eq_iff).1 (eq_of_heq hv)
    exact ⟨γ.map (P.continuous_ofVertex S i), fun _ => rfl⟩
  · rw [componentGraphMap_ofVertex, componentGraphMap_ofStrip] at h
    exact absurd h ((ofFiniteData P.componentData).ofVertex_ne_ofStrip S i _ e' _)
  · rw [componentGraphMap_ofVertex, componentGraphMap_ofStrip] at h
    exact absurd h.symm ((ofFiniteData P.componentData).ofVertex_ne_ofStrip S i' _ e _)
  · have ht : (t : ℝ) = t' := by
      have := congrArg ((ofFiniteData P.componentData).height S) h
      rwa [componentGraphMap_ofStrip, componentGraphMap_ofStrip, height_ofStrip,
        height_ofStrip] at this
    obtain rfl : e = e' := S.eq_of_mem_K_of_mem_Icc t.2 (ht ▸ Ioo_subset_Icc_self t'.2)
    obtain rfl : t = t' := Subtype.ext ht
    rw [componentGraphMap_ofStrip, componentGraphMap_ofStrip] at h
    obtain ⟨γ⟩ := (P.edgeClass_eq_iff).1
      (congrArg Prod.fst ((ofFiniteData P.componentData).ofStrip_injective S e h))
    exact ⟨γ.map (f := fun z => P.ofStrip S e (z, t))
      ((P.continuous_ofStrip S e).comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)), fun _ => rfl⟩

theorem quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph_symm_ofCylinder (e : Fin n) (p : P.Cylinder S e) :
    (P.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph S).symm
        ((ofFiniteData P.componentData).ofCylinder S e (P.edgeClass e p.1, p.2)) =
      ReebQuotient.mk _ (P.ofCylinder S e p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Homeomorph.symm_apply_eq]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph_symm_ofStrip
statement:
theorem quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph_symm_ofStrip (e : Fin n)
    (p : P.E e × (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    (P.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph S).symm
        ((ofFiniteData P.componentData).ofStrip S e (P.edgeClass e p.1, p.2)) =
      ReebQuotient.mk _ (P.ofStrip S e p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Homeomorph.symm_apply_eq]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph_symm
statement:
theorem height_quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph_symm
    (g : (ofFiniteData P.componentData).Realization S) :
    ReebQuotient.height (P.height S) ((P.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph S).symm g) =
      (ofFiniteData P.componentData).height S g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.height_quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph S, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph_mk_of_height_eq_value
statement:
theorem quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph_mk_of_height_eq_value {x : P.Realization S}
    {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hx : P.height S x = S.value i) :
    P.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph S (ReebQuotient.mk _ x) =
      (ofFiniteData P.componentData).ofVertex S i
        (P.vertexClass i ((P.criticalFiberHomeomorph S i).symm ⟨x, hx⟩))
proof:
:= by
  have hv : P.ofVertex S i ((P.criticalFiberHomeomorph S i).symm ⟨x, hx⟩) = x :=
    congrArg Subtype.val ((P.criticalFiberHomeomorph S i).apply_symm_apply ⟨x, hx⟩)
  calc P.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph S (ReebQuotient.mk _ x)
      = P.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph S (ReebQuotient.mk _
          (P.ofVertex S i ((P.criticalFiberHomeomorph S i).symm ⟨x, hx⟩))) := by
        rw [hv]
    _ = _ := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph_mk_of_height_eq_regular
statement:
theorem quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph_mk_of_height_eq_regular {x : P.Realization S}
    {e : Fin n} (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (hx : P.height S x = t) :
    P.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph S (ReebQuotient.mk _ x) =
      (ofFiniteData P.componentData).ofStrip S e
        (P.edgeClass e ((P.regularFiberHomeomorph S e t).symm ⟨x, hx⟩), t)
proof:
:= by
  have hy : P.ofStrip S e ((P.regularFiberHomeomorph S e t).symm ⟨x, hx⟩, t) = x :=
    congrArg Subtype.val ((P.regularFiberHomeomorph S e t).apply_symm_apply ⟨x, hx⟩)
  calc P.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph S (ReebQuotient.mk _ x)
      = P.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph S (ReebQuotient.mk _
          (P.ofStrip S e ((P.regularFiberHomeomorph S e t).symm ⟨x, hx⟩, t))) := by
        rw [hy]
    _ = _ := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.t2Space_reebQuotient
statement: theorem t2Space_reebQuotient : T2Space (ReebQuotient (P.height S))
proof:
:=
  (P.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph S).isEmbedding.t2Space

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.componentDataHom_v_mk
statement:
theorem componentDataHom_v_mk (i : Fin (n + 1)) (v : P.V i) :
    (componentDataHom S φ hφ).v i (ZerothHomotopy.mk v) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (vertexFiberMap S φ hφ i v)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.componentDataHom_e
statement:
theorem componentDataHom_e (k : Fin n) (t : (S.K k : Set ℝ)) :
    (componentDataHom S φ hφ).e k = componentMap (regularFiberMap S φ hφ k t)
proof:
:=
  componentMap_regularFiberMap_indep S φ hφ k (RGraph.basePt S k) t

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.componentDataHom_id
statement:
theorem componentDataHom_id :
    componentDataHom S (ContinuousMap.id (P.Realization S)) (fun _ => rfl) =
      FiniteReebData.Hom.id P.componentData
proof:
:= by
  refine FiniteReebData.Hom.ext (funext fun i => funext fun c => ?_)
    (funext fun k => funext fun c => ?_)
  · induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk v =>
      exact congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (P.ofVertex_injective S i
        (map_ofVertex_eq S (ContinuousMap.id _) (fun _ => rfl) i v).symm)
  · induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk y =>
      exact congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (congrArg Prod.fst (P.ofStrip_injective S k
        (a₁ := (_, RGraph.basePt S k)) (a₂ := (y, RGraph.basePt S k))
        (map_ofStrip_eq S (ContinuousMap.id _) (fun _ => rfl) k (RGraph.basePt S k) y).symm))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.componentDataHom_comp
statement:
theorem componentDataHom_comp (φ : C(P.Realization S, P'.Realization S))
    (hφ : ∀ x, P'.height S (φ x) = P.height S x) (ψ : C(P'.Realization S, P''.Realization S))
    (hψ : ∀ x, P''.height S (ψ x) = P'.height S x) :
    componentDataHom S (ψ.comp φ) (fun x => (hψ (φ x)).trans (hφ x)) =
      (componentDataHom S φ hφ).comp (componentDataHom S ψ hψ)
proof:
:= by
  refine FiniteReebData.Hom.ext (funext fun i => funext fun c => ?_)
    (funext fun k => funext fun c => ?_)
  · induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk v =>
      refine congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (P''.ofVertex_injective S i ?_)
      rw [← map_ofVertex_eq, ← map_ofVertex_eq, ← map_ofVertex_eq]
      rfl
  · induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk y =>
      refine congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (congrArg Prod.fst (P''.ofStrip_injective S k
        (a₁ := (_, RGraph.basePt S k)) (a₂ := (_, RGraph.basePt S k)) ?_))
      rw [← map_ofStrip_eq, ← map_ofStrip_eq, ← map_ofStrip_eq]
      rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.componentGraphMap_natural
statement:
theorem componentGraphMap_natural (x : P.Realization S) :
    P'.componentGraphMap S (φ x) =
      realizeHom S (componentDataHom S φ hφ) (P.componentGraphMap S x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases P.exists_rep S x with ⟨i, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, ⟨y, t⟩, rfl⟩
  · rw [map_ofVertex_eq S φ hφ i v]
    rfl
  · rw [map_ofStrip_eq S φ hφ e t y]
    exact congrArg (fun c => (ofFiniteData P'.componentData).ofStrip S e (c, t))
      (congrFun (componentDataHom_e S φ hφ e t).symm (ZerothHomotopy.mk y))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.quotientComponentGraphMap_natural
statement:
theorem quotientComponentGraphMap_natural (q : ReebQuotient (P.height S)) :
    P'.quotientComponentGraphMap S (ReebQuotient.map φ hφ q) =
      realizeHom S (componentDataHom S φ hφ) (P.quotientComponentGraphMap S q)
proof:
:= by
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h x => exact componentGraphMap_natural S φ hφ x

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_overHomMap
proof:
:=
  overBaseMap_comm g x

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.quotientOverIso_natural
statement:
theorem quotientOverIso_natural
    (g : Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S)) ⟶ Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P'.height S))) :
    (ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ).map g ≫ (P'.quotientOverIso S).hom =
      (P.quotientOverIso S).hom ≫
        (RGraph.realizationFunctor S).map
          (componentDataHom S (overHomMap S g) (height_overHomMap S g))
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  exact quotientComponentGraphMap_natural S (overHomMap S g) (height_overHomMap S g) q

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.componentDataHom_eq_preimage
statement:
theorem componentDataHom_eq_preimage
    (g : Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S)) ⟶ Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P'.height S))) :
    componentDataHom S (overHomMap S g) (height_overHomMap S g) =
      (RGraph.realizationFullyFaithful S).preimage
        ((P.quotientOverIso S).inv ≫ (ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ).map g ≫
          (P'.quotientOverIso S).hom)
proof:
:= by
  apply (RGraph.realizationFullyFaithful S).map_injective
  rw [Functor.FullyFaithful.map_preimage, quotientOverIso_natural, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.quotientIsoOfIso_natural
statement:
theorem quotientIsoOfIso_natural {A B : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)}
    (iA : A ≅ Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S)))
    (iB : B ≅ Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P'.height S))) (g : A ⟶ B) :
    (ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ).map g ≫ (P'.quotientIsoOfIso S iB).hom =
      (P.quotientIsoOfIso S iA).hom ≫
        (RGraph.realizationFunctor S).map
          (componentDataHom S (overHomMap S (iA.inv ≫ g ≫ iB.hom))
            (height_overHomMap S (iA.inv ≫ g ≫ iB.hom)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [quotientIsoOfIso, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  rw [← quotientOverIso_natural, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc, ← Functor.map_comp_assoc,
    Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Functor.map_comp_assoc]

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.inducedGraphMap_square
statement:
theorem inducedGraphMap_square (iA : A ≅ Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S)))
    (iB : B ≅ Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P'.height S'))) (g : A ⟶ B) :
    (ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ).map g ≫ (P'.quotientIsoOfIso S' iB).hom =
      (P.quotientIsoOfIso S iA).hom ≫ inducedGraphMap S S' iA iB g
proof:
:= by
  rw [inducedGraphMap, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.inducedGraphMap_eq_componentDataHom
statement:
theorem inducedGraphMap_eq_componentDataHom (iA : A ≅ Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S)))
    (iB : B ≅ Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P'.height S))) (g : A ⟶ B) :
    inducedGraphMap S S iA iB g =
      (RGraph.realizationFunctor S).map
        (componentDataHom S (overHomMap S (iA.inv ≫ g ≫ iB.hom))
          (height_overHomMap S (iA.inv ≫ g ≫ iB.hom)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [inducedGraphMap, quotientIsoOfIso_natural S iA iB g, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isRGraph_quotient
statement:
theorem isRGraph_quotient {A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)} {n : ℕ} (S : CriticalValues n)
    (P : CylinderPresentation.{0} n) [∀ i, CompactSpace (P.V i)]
    [∀ i, LocallyPathConnectedSpace (P.V i)] [∀ e, CompactSpace (P.E e)]
    [∀ e, LocallyPathConnectedSpace (P.E e)] (i : A ≅ Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S))) :
    IsRGraph ((ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ).obj A)
proof:
:=
  ⟨n, S, P.componentData, ⟨P.quotientIsoOfIso S i⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.isRGraph_quotient_of_isConstructibleSpace
statement:
theorem isRGraph_quotient_of_isConstructibleSpace {A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)}
    (hA : IsConstructibleSpace A) : RGraph.IsRGraph ((ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ).obj A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, S, P, h1, h2, h3, h4, ⟨i⟩⟩ := hA
  exact RGraph.isRGraph_quotient S P i

name: TDA.Reeb.isConstructibleSpace_of_isRGraph
statement:
theorem isConstructibleSpace_of_isRGraph {A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)} (hA : RGraph.IsRGraph A) :
    IsConstructibleSpace A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, T, D, ⟨i⟩⟩ := hA
  exact ⟨m, T, CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData D, fun _ => inferInstance,
    fun _ => inferInstance, fun _ => inferInstance, fun _ => inferInstance, ⟨i⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.toComponentData_v_bijective
statement:
theorem toComponentData_v_bijective (D : FiniteReebData.{u} n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Bijective (D.toComponentData.v i)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ h => joined_eq_of_discrete (A := (ofFiniteData D).V i)
      ((ofFiniteData D).vertexClass_eq_iff.1 h),
    (ofFiniteData D).vertexClass_surjective i⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.toComponentData_e_bijective
statement:
theorem toComponentData_e_bijective (D : FiniteReebData.{u} n) (k : Fin n) :
    Function.Bijective (D.toComponentData.e k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ _ h => joined_eq_of_discrete (A := (ofFiniteData D).E k)
      ((ofFiniteData D).edgeClass_eq_iff.1 h),
    (ofFiniteData D).edgeClass_surjective k⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.quotientComponentGraphMap_projHomeomorph
statement:
theorem quotientComponentGraphMap_projHomeomorph (D : FiniteReebData.{u} n)
    (x : (ofFiniteData D).Realization S) :
    (ofFiniteData D).quotientComponentGraphMap S (RGraph.projHomeomorph S D x) =
      realizeHom S D.toComponentData x
proof:
:= by
  rcases (ofFiniteData D).exists_rep S x with ⟨i, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, p, rfl⟩ <;> rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.projNatTrans_comp_quotientOverIso
statement:
theorem projNatTrans_comp_quotientOverIso (D : FiniteReebData.{0} n) :
    (ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app (Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom ((ofFiniteData D).height S))) ≫
        ((ofFiniteData D).quotientOverIso S).hom =
      (RGraph.realizationFunctor S).map D.toComponentData
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact quotientComponentGraphMap_projHomeomorph S D x

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebRel.map
statement:
theorem ReebRel.map {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x)
    {x x' : X} (hr : ReebRel f x x') : ReebRel g (h x) (h x')
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := hr
  exact ⟨γ.map h.continuous, fun t => by simp [comm, hγ]⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.map_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_mk {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) (x : X) :
    map h comm (mk f x) = mk g (h x)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.map_comp_proj
statement:
theorem map_comp_proj {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) :
    (map h comm).comp (proj f) = (proj g).comp h
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.map_unique
statement:
theorem map_unique {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x)
    (k : C(ReebQuotient f, ReebQuotient g)) (hk : ∀ x, k (mk f x) = mk g (h x)) :
    k = map h comm
proof:
:=
  hom_ext hk

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.height_map_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem height_map_apply {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x)
    (q : ReebQuotient f) : height g (map h comm q) = height f q
proof:
:= by
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h x => exact comm x

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.height_comp_map
statement:
theorem height_comp_map {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) :
    (height g).comp (map h comm) = height f
proof:
:=
  ContinuousMap.ext (height_map_apply h comm)

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.map_id
statement:
theorem map_id (f : C(X, Y)) (comm : ∀ x, f (ContinuousMap.id X x) = f x) :
    map (ContinuousMap.id X) comm = ContinuousMap.id (ReebQuotient f)
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun _ => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp {W : Type*} [TopologicalSpace W] {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} {e : C(W, Y)}
    (h : C(X, Z)) (hh : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) (k : C(Z, W)) (hk : ∀ z, e (k z) = g z)
    (hkh : ∀ x, e ((k.comp h) x) = f x) :
    map (k.comp h) hkh = (map k hk).comp (map h hh)
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun _ => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.map_surjective
statement:
theorem map_surjective {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z)) (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x)
    (hs : Function.Surjective h) : Function.Surjective (map h comm)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h z =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hs z
    exact ⟨mk f x, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.componentComparison_app_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem componentComparison_app_mk (f : C(X, Y)) (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y)
    (x : {x : X // f x ∈ U}) :
    (componentComparison f).app U (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨mk f x.1, x.2⟩ : {q : ReebQuotient f // height f q ∈ U})
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.componentComparison_naturality
statement:
theorem componentComparison_naturality (f : C(X, Y)) {U V : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y}
    (i : U ⟶ V) :
    (componentFunctor f).map i ≫ (componentComparison f).app V =
      (componentComparison f).app U ≫ (componentFunctor (height f)).map i
proof:
:=
  (componentComparison f).naturality i

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.componentComparison_natural
statement:
theorem componentComparison_natural {f : C(X, Y)} {g : C(Z, Y)} (h : C(X, Z))
    (comm : ∀ x, g (h x) = f x) :
    componentNatTrans h comm ≫ componentComparison g =
      componentComparison f ≫ componentNatTrans (map h comm) (height_map_apply h comm)
proof:
:= by
  ext U c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.ReebQuotient.componentComparison_app_surjective
statement:
theorem componentComparison_app_surjective (f : C(X, Y)) (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) :
    Function.Surjective ((componentComparison f).app U)
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk q =>
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := q
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective f q
    exact ⟨ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x, hq⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.overBaseMap_comm
statement:
theorem overBaseMap_comm {Y : Type u} [TopologicalSpace Y] {A B : Over (TopCat.of Y)}
    (φ : A ⟶ B) (x : A.left) : overBaseMap B (φ.left.hom x) = overBaseMap A x
proof:
:= by
  rw [overBaseMap, overBaseMap, ← Over.w φ]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.intervalComponents_obj
statement:
theorem intervalComponents_obj (f : C(X, ℝ)) (I : OpenInterval) :
    (intervalComponents f).obj I = ZerothHomotopy {x : X // f x ∈ I}
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.intervalComponents_map_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intervalComponents_map_mk (f : C(X, ℝ)) {I J : OpenInterval} (i : I ⟶ J)
    (x : {x : X // f x ∈ toOpens I}) :
    (intervalComponents f).map i (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk
        (⟨x.1, OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 (leOfHom i) x.2⟩ : {x : X // f x ∈ toOpens J})
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.mem_translate
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_translate {c x : ℝ} {I : OpenInterval} :
    x ∈ translate c I ↔ x + c ∈ I
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.coe_translate
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_translate (c : ℝ) (I : OpenInterval) :
    (translate c I : Set ℝ) = (· + c) ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.translate_ioo
statement: theorem translate_ioo (c p q : ℝ) : translate c (ioo p q) = ioo (p - c) (q - c)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change p < x + c ∧ x + c < q ↔ p - c < x ∧ x < q - c
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ <;> constructor <;> linarith

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.translate_top
statement: @[simp] theorem translate_top (c : ℝ) : translate c ⊤ = ⊤
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.translate_bot
statement: @[simp] theorem translate_bot (c : ℝ) : translate c ⊥ = ⊥
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.translate_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem translate_zero (I : OpenInterval) : translate 0 I = I
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.translate_translate
statement:
theorem translate_translate (c d : ℝ) (I : OpenInterval) :
    translate c (translate d I) = translate (c + d) I
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [add_assoc]

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.translate_monotone
statement: theorem translate_monotone (c : ℝ) : Monotone (translate c)
proof: := fun _ _ h _ hx => h hx

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.translate_thicken
statement:
theorem translate_thicken (c : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval) :
    translate c (thicken ε I) = thicken ε (translate c I)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_translate, mem_thicken]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    exact ⟨y - c, by simpa using hy, by rwa [show x - (y - c) = x + c - y by ring]⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    exact ⟨y + c, hy, by rwa [show x + c - (y + c) = x - y by ring]⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.coe_le_interleavingDistance_add_const
statement:
private theorem coe_le_interleavingDistance_add_const [Nonempty X] (f : C(X, ℝ))
    (hf : BddBelow (range f)) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ((‖c‖₊ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ interleavingDistance (intervalComponents f)
      (intervalComponents (f + ContinuousMap.const X c))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_interleavingDistance_of_forall_exists_isEmpty fun ε hε => ?_
  have hεc : (ε : ℝ) < c := by
    have := ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.1 hε
    rwa [← NNReal.coe_lt_coe, coe_nnnorm, Real.norm_of_nonneg hc.le] at this
  set α := sInf (range f)
  set η := (c - ε) / 2
  have hη : 0 < η := by simp only [η]; linarith
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨x₀, rfl⟩, hx₀⟩ := Real.lt_sInf_add_pos (range_nonempty f) hη
  have hlow : ∀ x, α ≤ f x := fun x => csInf_le hf ⟨x, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨ioo (α - η) (α + η), ⟨ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x₀, ?_⟩⟩, isEmpty_zerothHomotopy ⟨?_⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨by linarith [hlow x₀], hx₀⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hx
    have hy' : y < α + η := hy.2
    have hfx := hlow x
    have hle := (abs_le.1 hxy).2
    change f x + c - y ≤ ε at hle
    simp only [η] at hy'
    linarith

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_add_const
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_add_const [Nonempty X] (f : C(X, ℝ))
    (hf : BddBelow (range f)) (c : ℝ) :
    interleavingDistance (intervalComponents f)
      (intervalComponents (f + ContinuousMap.const X c)) = ‖c‖₊
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [intervalComponents_add_const]
    exact interleavingDistance_translatePre_le c _
  rcases lt_trichotomy c 0 with hc | rfl | hc
  · have hf' : BddBelow (range (f + ContinuousMap.const X c)) := by
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hf
      exact ⟨m + c, by rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩; simpa using hm ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩
    have hback : f + ContinuousMap.const X c + ContinuousMap.const X (-c) = f := by ext; simp
    have := coe_le_interleavingDistance_add_const (f + ContinuousMap.const X c) hf' (neg_pos.2 hc)
    rwa [hback, interleavingDistance_comm, nnnorm_neg] at this
  · simp
  · exact coe_le_interleavingDistance_add_const f hf hc

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.smoothing_map_smoothingMap_comp_commIso
statement:
private theorem smoothing_map_smoothingMap_comp_commIso {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε ≤ δ) (η : ℝ≥0)
    (F : OpenInterval ⥤ C) :
    (smoothing η).map ((smoothingMap h).app F) ≫ (smoothingCommIso δ η).hom.app F =
      (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app F ≫ (smoothingMap h).app ((smoothing η).obj F)
proof:
:= by
  ext I
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, smoothingMap_app_app, smoothingCommIso_hom_app_app]
  interval_coherence

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.enlargement_comm_coherence
statement:
private theorem enlargement_comm_coherence {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε ≤ δ) (η : ℝ≥0)
    {X Y F Z : OpenInterval ⥤ C} (p : X ⟶ (smoothing η).obj Y) (q : Y ⟶ (smoothing ε).obj F)
    (r : (smoothing η).obj F ⟶ Z) :
    p ≫ (smoothing η).map (q ≫ (smoothingMap h).app F) ≫ (smoothingCommIso δ η).hom.app F ≫
        (smoothing δ).map r =
      (p ≫ (smoothing η).map q ≫ (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app F ≫ (smoothing ε).map r) ≫
        (smoothingMap h).app Z
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ∀ {W : OpenInterval ⥤ C} (k : (smoothing δ).obj ((smoothing η).obj F) ⟶ W),
      (smoothing η).map ((smoothingMap h).app F) ≫ (smoothingCommIso δ η).hom.app F ≫ k =
        (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app F ≫ (smoothingMap h).app ((smoothing η).obj F) ≫ k := by
    intro W k
    rw [← Category.assoc, smoothing_map_smoothingMap_comp_commIso h η F, Category.assoc]
  rw [(smoothing η).map_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hL,
    ← (smoothingMap h).naturality r]
  repeat rw [Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.smoothingCommIso_add_coherence
statement:
private theorem smoothingCommIso_add_coherence (ε η η' : ℝ≥0) (F : OpenInterval ⥤ C) :
    (smoothingCompIso η η').inv.app ((smoothing ε).obj F) ≫
        (smoothing η).map ((smoothingCommIso ε η').hom.app F) ≫
          (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app ((smoothing η').obj F) ≫
            (smoothing ε).map ((smoothingCompIso η η').hom.app F) =
      (smoothingCommIso ε (η + η')).hom.app F
proof:
:= by
  ext I
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, smoothingCompIso_inv_app_app, smoothingCompIso_hom_app_app,
    smoothingCommIso_hom_app_app]
  interval_coherence

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.smooth_add_coherence
statement:
private theorem smooth_add_coherence {ε η η' : ℝ≥0}
    {Y Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ F F₁ F₂ F₃ : OpenInterval ⥤ C} (q : Y ⟶ (smoothing ε).obj F)
    (a₁ : Y₁ ≅ (smoothing η').obj Y) (a₂ : Y₂ ≅ (smoothing η).obj Y₁)
    (a₃ : Y₃ ≅ (smoothing (η + η')).obj Y)
    (b₁ : F₁ ≅ (smoothing η').obj F) (b₂ : F₂ ≅ (smoothing η).obj F₁)
    (b₃ : F₃ ≅ (smoothing (η + η')).obj F) (g : Y₃ ⟶ Y₂) (m : F₂ ⟶ F₃)
    (hg : g ≫ a₂.hom ≫ (smoothing η).map a₁.hom =
      a₃.hom ≫ (smoothingCompIso η η').inv.app Y)
    (hm : b₂.inv ≫ m =
      (smoothing η).map b₁.hom ≫ (smoothingCompIso η η').hom.app F ≫ b₃.inv) :
    g ≫ (a₂.hom ≫ (smoothing η).map (a₁.hom ≫ (smoothing η').map q ≫
          (smoothingCommIso ε η').hom.app F ≫ (smoothing ε).map b₁.inv) ≫
        (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app F₁ ≫ (smoothing ε).map b₂.inv) ≫ (smoothing ε).map m =
      a₃.hom ≫ (smoothing (η + η')).map q ≫ (smoothingCommIso ε (η + η')).hom.app F ≫
        (smoothing ε).map b₃.inv
proof:
:= by
  have hn₁ : ∀ {W : OpenInterval ⥤ C}
      (k : (smoothing ε).obj ((smoothing η).obj ((smoothing η').obj F)) ⟶ W),
      (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app F₁ ≫ (smoothing ε).map ((smoothing η).map b₁.hom) ≫ k =
        (smoothing η).map ((smoothing ε).map b₁.hom) ≫
          (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app ((smoothing η').obj F) ≫ k := by
    intro W k
    have nat : (smoothing η).map ((smoothing ε).map b₁.hom) ≫
        (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app ((smoothing η').obj F) =
          (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app F₁ ≫ (smoothing ε).map ((smoothing η).map b₁.hom) :=
      (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.naturality b₁.hom
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← nat, Category.assoc]
  have hn₂ : ∀ {W : OpenInterval ⥤ C}
      (k : (smoothing η).obj ((smoothing η').obj ((smoothing ε).obj F)) ⟶ W),
      (smoothingCompIso η η').inv.app Y ≫ (smoothing η).map ((smoothing η').map q) ≫ k =
        (smoothing (η + η')).map q ≫ (smoothingCompIso η η').inv.app ((smoothing ε).obj F) ≫
          k := by
    intro W k
    have nat : (smoothingCompIso η η').inv.app Y ≫ (smoothing η).map ((smoothing η').map q) =
        (smoothing (η + η')).map q ≫ (smoothingCompIso η η').inv.app ((smoothing ε).obj F) :=
      ((smoothingCompIso η η').inv.naturality q).symm
    rw [← Category.assoc, nat, Category.assoc]
  have hb : ∀ {W : OpenInterval ⥤ C}
      (k : (smoothing η).obj ((smoothing ε).obj ((smoothing η').obj F)) ⟶ W),
      (smoothing η).map (a₁.hom ≫ (smoothing η').map q ≫
          (smoothingCommIso ε η').hom.app F ≫ (smoothing ε).map b₁.inv) ≫
          (smoothing η).map ((smoothing ε).map b₁.hom) ≫ k =
        (smoothing η).map a₁.hom ≫ (smoothing η).map ((smoothing η').map q) ≫
          (smoothing η).map ((smoothingCommIso ε η').hom.app F) ≫ k := by
    intro W k
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← (smoothing η).map_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc,
      Category.assoc, ← (smoothing ε).map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, (smoothing ε).map_id]
    erw [Category.comp_id]
    rw [(smoothing η).map_comp, (smoothing η).map_comp, Category.assoc, Category.assoc]
  have hg' : ∀ {W : OpenInterval ⥤ C} (k : (smoothing η).obj ((smoothing η').obj Y) ⟶ W),
      g ≫ a₂.hom ≫ (smoothing η).map a₁.hom ≫ k =
        a₃.hom ≫ (smoothingCompIso η η').inv.app Y ≫ k := by
    intro W k
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, Category.assoc g, hg,
      Category.assoc]
  have hc : ∀ {W : OpenInterval ⥤ C}
      (k : (smoothing ε).obj ((smoothing (η + η')).obj F) ⟶ W),
      (smoothingCompIso η η').inv.app ((smoothing ε).obj F) ≫
        (smoothing η).map ((smoothingCommIso ε η').hom.app F) ≫
          (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app ((smoothing η').obj F) ≫
            (smoothing ε).map ((smoothingCompIso η η').hom.app F) ≫ k =
        (smoothingCommIso ε (η + η')).hom.app F ≫ k := by
    intro W k
    rw [← smoothingCommIso_add_coherence ε η η' F]
    repeat rw [Category.assoc]
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ← (smoothing ε).map_comp b₂.inv m, hm,
    (smoothing ε).map_comp, (smoothing ε).map_comp, hn₁, hb, hg', hn₂, hc]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricSmoothingCommIso_zero_hom_app
statement:
theorem geometricSmoothingCommIso_zero_hom_app (ε : ℝ≥0) (B : RGraphCat) :
    (geometricSmoothingCommIso ε 0).hom.app B =
      geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B) ≫
        (geometricSmoothing ε).map (geometricSmoothingZeroIso.inv.app B)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit :
      (geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_comm 0 ε)).hom =
        (geometricSmoothingEqIso (zero_add ε)).hom ≫
          (geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_zero ε)).inv := by
    have hsymm :
        (geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_zero ε).symm).hom =
          (geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_zero ε)).inv := by
      ext A
      rfl
    rw [← hsymm]
    exact (geometricSmoothingEqIso_hom_comp_hom (zero_add ε) (add_zero ε).symm).symm
  have hleft :
      geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B) =
        (geometricSmoothingCompIso 0 ε).hom.app B ≫
          (geometricSmoothingEqIso (zero_add ε)).hom.app B :=
    ((congrArg (fun e => e.hom.app B) (geometricSmoothingCompIso_zero_left ε)).trans
      (Category.comp_id _)).symm
  have hright_inv :
      (geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_zero ε)).inv.app B ≫
          (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε 0).inv.app B =
        (geometricSmoothing ε).map (geometricSmoothingZeroIso.inv.app B) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun e => e.inv.app B) (geometricSmoothingCompIso_zero_right ε)
    simpa only [Iso.trans_inv, NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.leftUnitor_inv_app,
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight_inv, Functor.whiskerRight_app, Category.id_comp] using h
  rw [geometricSmoothingCommIso_hom_app, hsplit]
  calc
    (geometricSmoothingCompIso 0 ε).hom.app B ≫
          (geometricSmoothingEqIso (zero_add ε)).hom.app B ≫
          ((geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_zero ε)).inv.app B ≫
            (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε 0).inv.app B) =
        geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B) ≫
          ((geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_zero ε)).inv.app B ≫
            (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε 0).inv.app B) := by
      rw [hleft]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B) ≫
          (geometricSmoothing ε).map (geometricSmoothingZeroIso.inv.app B) := by
      rw [hright_inv]
