name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafShiftMap_geometricSmoothing_map_comp_commIso
statement:
theorem cosheafShiftMap_geometricSmoothing_map_comp_commIso {ε : ℝ≥0} (η : ℝ≥0)
    {X Y : RGraphCat} (f : X ⟶ (geometricSmoothing ε).obj Y) :
    cosheafShiftMap ((geometricSmoothing η).map f ≫
        (geometricSmoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app Y) =
      ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso η).app X).hom ≫
        (smoothing η).map (cosheafShiftMap f) ≫
          (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj Y).obj ≫
            (smoothing ε).map ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso η).app Y).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hid : ∀ Z : RGraphCat, cosheafShiftMap (ε := η) (B := Z)
      (𝟙 ((geometricSmoothing η).obj Z)) = ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso η).app Z).hom := by
    intro Z
    unfold cosheafShiftMap
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.id_hom]
    exact Category.id_comp _
  have h1 := cosheafShiftMap_comp' (ε := η) (δ := ε) (𝟙 ((geometricSmoothing η).obj X)) f
  rw [Category.id_comp, hid] at h1
  have h2 := cosheafShiftMap_comp_geometricEnlargement (add_comm η ε).le
    ((geometricSmoothing η).map f ≫ (geometricSmoothingCompIso η ε).hom.app Y)
  rw [h1] at h2
  let eP : (cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing η).obj Y)).obj ≅
      (smoothing η).obj (cosheafFunctor.obj Y).obj := (geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso η).app Y
  have hidY : cosheafShiftMap (ε := η) (B := Y) (𝟙 ((geometricSmoothing η).obj Y)) = eP.hom :=
    hid Y
  have h3 := cosheafShiftMap_comp' (ε := ε) (δ := η)
    ((geometricSmoothing η).map f ≫ (geometricSmoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app Y)
    (𝟙 ((geometricSmoothing η).obj Y))
  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id, Category.id_comp, hidY] at h3
  have hg : ((geometricSmoothing η).map f ≫ (geometricSmoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app Y) ≫
      (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε η).hom.app Y =
        ((geometricSmoothing η).map f ≫ (geometricSmoothingCompIso η ε).hom.app Y) ≫
          (geometricEnlargement (add_comm η ε).le).app Y := by
    rw [geometricSmoothingCommIso_hom_app, geometricSmoothingEqIso_hom_eq]
    simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app, Category.comp_id]
  rw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc _ _ ((geometricSmoothingCompIso ε η).hom.app Y)] at h3
  rw [hg, h2] at h3
  have key : ∀ k : (cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing η).obj X)).obj ⟶
      (smoothing ε).obj (cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing η).obj Y)).obj,
      k = (k ≫ (smoothing ε).map eP.hom ≫
        (smoothingCompIso ε η).hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj Y).obj) ≫
          (smoothingCompIso ε η).inv.app (cosheafFunctor.obj Y).obj ≫
            (smoothing ε).map eP.inv := fun k => by
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc,
      ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id,
      Category.comp_id]
  rw [key (cosheafShiftMap _), ← h3]
  ext I
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricSmoothing_map_geometricEnlargement_comp_commIso
statement:
theorem geometricSmoothing_map_geometricEnlargement_comp_commIso {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε ≤ δ)
    (η : ℝ≥0) (B : RGraphCat) :
    (geometricSmoothing η).map ((geometricEnlargement h).app B) ≫
        (geometricSmoothingCommIso δ η).hom.app B =
      (geometricSmoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app B ≫
        (geometricEnlargement h).app ((geometricSmoothing η).obj B)
proof:
:= by
  apply cosheafShiftMap_injective δ ((geometricSmoothing η).obj ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B))
    ((geometricSmoothing η).obj B)
  rw [cosheafShiftMap_geometricSmoothing_map_comp_commIso η
    ((geometricEnlargement h).app B)]
  rw [cosheafShiftMap_comp_geometricEnlargement h]
  have hcomm :
      cosheafShiftMap ((geometricSmoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app B) =
        ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso η).app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B)).hom ≫
          (smoothing η).map (cosheafShiftMap (𝟙 ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B))) ≫
            (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj ≫
              (smoothing ε).map ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso η).app B).inv := by
    have h' := cosheafShiftMap_geometricSmoothing_map_comp_commIso (ε := ε) η
      (𝟙 ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B))
    have hmap : (geometricSmoothing η).map
        (𝟙 ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B)) = 𝟙 _ :=
      (geometricSmoothing η).map_id _
    rw [hmap, Category.id_comp] at h'
    exact h'
  rw [hcomm]
  have hid :
      cosheafShiftMap ((geometricEnlargement h).app B) =
        ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso ε).app B).hom ≫
          (smoothingMap h).app (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj := by
    unfold cosheafShiftMap
    rw [geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso_component_hom]
    exact cosheafFunctor_map_geometricEnlargement_app h B
  rw [hid, cosheafShiftMap_id]
  exact Interleaving.enlargement_comm_coherence h η _ _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafShiftMap_precomp
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : (cosheafFunctor.map (g ≫ φ)).hom =
      (cosheafFunctor.map g).hom ≫ (cosheafFunctor.map φ).hom := by
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  exact (congrArg (· ≫ ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app D).hom) e1).trans
    (Category.assoc _ _ _)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafShiftMap_comp_map
statement:
private theorem cosheafShiftMap_comp_map {ε : ℝ≥0} {A B D : RGraphCat}
    (φ : A ⟶ (geometricSmoothing ε).obj B) (g : B ⟶ D) :
    cosheafShiftMap (φ ≫ (geometricSmoothing ε).map g) =
      cosheafShiftMap φ ≫ (smoothing ε).map (cosheafFunctor.map g).hom
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : (cosheafFunctor.map (φ ≫ (geometricSmoothing ε).map g)).hom =
      (cosheafFunctor.map φ).hom ≫ (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothing ε).map g)).hom := by
    rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
    rfl
  have hnat :
      (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothing ε).map g)).hom ≫
          ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app D).hom =
        ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app B).hom ≫
          (smoothing ε).map (cosheafFunctor.map g).hom :=
    congrArg (fun k => k.hom) ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.naturality g)
  refine (congrArg (· ≫ ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app D).hom) e1).trans ?_
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg ((cosheafFunctor.map φ).hom ≫ ·) hnat).trans ?_
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafShiftMap_geometricSmoothingCommIso
statement:
private theorem cosheafShiftMap_geometricSmoothingCommIso (ε θ : ℝ≥0) (B : RGraphCat) :
    cosheafShiftMap ((geometricSmoothingCommIso ε θ).hom.app B) =
      ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso θ).app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B)).hom ≫
        (smoothing θ).map ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso ε).app B).hom ≫
          (smoothingCommIso ε θ).hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj ≫
            (smoothing ε).map ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso θ).app B).inv
proof:
:= by
  have h' := cosheafShiftMap_geometricSmoothing_map_comp_commIso (ε := ε) θ
    (𝟙 ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B))
  have hmap : (geometricSmoothing θ).map (𝟙 ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B)) = 𝟙 _ :=
    (geometricSmoothing θ).map_id _
  rw [hmap, Category.id_comp, cosheafShiftMap_id] at h'
  exact h'

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricSmoothingCommIso_add
statement:
private theorem geometricSmoothingCommIso_add (ε η η' : ℝ≥0) (B : RGraphCat) :
    (geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').inv.app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B) ≫
        (geometricSmoothing η).map ((geometricSmoothingCommIso ε η').hom.app B) ≫
          (geometricSmoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app ((geometricSmoothing η').obj B) ≫
            (geometricSmoothing ε).map ((geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').hom.app B) =
      (geometricSmoothingCommIso ε (η + η')).hom.app B
proof:
:= by
  have hm := Interleaving.inv_comp_eq_of_comp_hom
    ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso η).app ((geometricSmoothing η').obj B))
    ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso (η + η')).app B)
    (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').hom.app B)).hom _
    (cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app η η' B)
  have huv : (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').inv.app
        ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B))).hom ≫
      (cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').hom.app
        ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B))).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.comp_hom, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp,
      Iso.inv_hom_id_app, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
    rfl
  have hg := Interleaving.comp_comp_eq_of_section _ _ huv
    ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso (η + η')).app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B)).hom _ _
    ((smoothingCompIso η η').app (cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B)).obj)
    (cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app η η' ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B))
  apply cosheafShiftMap_injective ε _ _
  rw [cosheafShiftMap_precomp,
    ← Category.assoc ((geometricSmoothing η).map ((geometricSmoothingCommIso ε η').hom.app B)),
    cosheafShiftMap_comp_map, cosheafShiftMap_geometricSmoothing_map_comp_commIso,
    cosheafShiftMap_geometricSmoothingCommIso, cosheafShiftMap_geometricSmoothingCommIso]
  exact Interleaving.smooth_add_coherence _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hg hm

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.smooth_toCosheaf
statement:
theorem smooth_toCosheaf (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) (η : ℝ≥0) :
    (i.smooth η).toCosheaf =
    ((i.toCosheaf.smooth η).isoLeft ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso η).app A).symm).isoRight
      ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso η).app B).symm
proof:
:=
  toCosheaf_ofCosheaf _

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.smooth_φ
statement:
theorem smooth_φ (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) (η : ℝ≥0) :
    (i.smooth η).φ =
      (geometricSmoothing η).map i.φ ≫ (geometricSmoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app B
proof:
:= by
  apply cosheafShiftMap_injective ε ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A)
    ((geometricSmoothing η).obj B)
  rw [← toCosheaf_φ (i.smooth η), smooth_toCosheaf]
  change
    ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso η).app A).hom ≫
        (smoothing η).map i.toCosheaf.φ ≫
          (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj ≫
            (smoothing ε).map ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso η).app B).inv =
      cosheafShiftMap ((geometricSmoothing η).map i.φ ≫
        (geometricSmoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app B)
  rw [toCosheaf_φ]
  exact (cosheafShiftMap_geometricSmoothing_map_comp_commIso η i.φ).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.smooth_ψ
statement:
theorem smooth_ψ (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) (η : ℝ≥0) :
    (i.smooth η).ψ =
      (geometricSmoothing η).map i.ψ ≫ (geometricSmoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app A
proof:
:= by
  apply cosheafShiftMap_injective ε ((geometricSmoothing η).obj B)
    ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A)
  rw [← toCosheaf_ψ (i.smooth η), smooth_toCosheaf]
  change
    ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso η).app B).hom ≫
        (smoothing η).map i.toCosheaf.ψ ≫
          (smoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj ≫
            (smoothing ε).map ((geometricSmoothingPrecosheafIso η).app A).inv =
      cosheafShiftMap ((geometricSmoothing η).map i.ψ ≫
        (geometricSmoothingCommIso ε η).hom.app A)
  rw [toCosheaf_ψ]
  exact (cosheafShiftMap_geometricSmoothing_map_comp_commIso η i.ψ).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.smooth_zero_φ
statement:
theorem smooth_zero_φ (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) :
    geometricSmoothingZeroIso.inv.app A ≫ (i.smooth 0).φ ≫
        (geometricSmoothing ε).map (geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app B) = i.φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [smooth_φ, geometricSmoothingCommIso_zero_hom_app]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  erw [geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.naturality_assoc i.φ]
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  exact Category.comp_id _

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.smooth_zero_ψ
statement:
theorem smooth_zero_ψ (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) :
    geometricSmoothingZeroIso.inv.app B ≫ (i.smooth 0).ψ ≫
        (geometricSmoothing ε).map (geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app A) = i.ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [smooth_ψ, geometricSmoothingCommIso_zero_hom_app]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  erw [geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.naturality_assoc i.ψ]
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc, ← CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id_app]
  erw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  exact Category.comp_id _

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.smooth_add_φ
statement:
theorem smooth_add_φ (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) (η η' : ℝ≥0) :
    (geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').inv.app A ≫ ((i.smooth η').smooth η).φ ≫
        (geometricSmoothing ε).map ((geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').hom.app B) =
      (i.smooth (η + η')).φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [smooth_φ, smooth_φ, smooth_φ, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
  have hn : (geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').inv.app A ≫
      (geometricSmoothing η).map ((geometricSmoothing η').map i.φ) =
        (geometricSmoothing (η + η')).map i.φ ≫
          (geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').inv.app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj B) :=
    ((geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').inv.naturality i.φ).symm
  rw [← geometricSmoothingCommIso_add ε η η' B]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc ((geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').inv.app A), hn, Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.smooth_add_ψ
statement:
theorem smooth_add_ψ (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) (η η' : ℝ≥0) :
    (geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').inv.app B ≫ ((i.smooth η').smooth η).ψ ≫
        (geometricSmoothing ε).map ((geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').hom.app A) =
      (i.smooth (η + η')).ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [smooth_ψ, smooth_ψ, smooth_ψ, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp]
  have hn : (geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').inv.app B ≫
      (geometricSmoothing η).map ((geometricSmoothing η').map i.ψ) =
        (geometricSmoothing (η + η')).map i.ψ ≫
          (geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').inv.app ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj A) :=
    ((geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').inv.naturality i.ψ).symm
  rw [← geometricSmoothingCommIso_add ε η η' A]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [← Category.assoc ((geometricSmoothingCompIso η η').inv.app B), hn, Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.smooth_mono
statement:
theorem smooth_mono (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) {δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε ≤ δ) (η : ℝ≥0) :
    (i.mono h).smooth η = (i.smooth η).mono h
proof:
:= by
  apply GeometricInterleaving.ext
  · rw [smooth_φ, mono_φ, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp,
      mono_φ, smooth_φ]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [geometricSmoothing_map_geometricEnlargement_comp_commIso h]
  · rw [smooth_ψ, mono_ψ, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp,
      mono_ψ, smooth_ψ]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [geometricSmoothing_map_geometricEnlargement_comp_commIso h]

statement:
theorem nonempty_smooth (η : ℝ≥0) :

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.GeometricInterleaving.geometricInterleavingDistance_smooth_le
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_smooth_le (i : GeometricInterleaving ε A B) (η : ℝ≥0) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A)
      ((geometricSmoothing η).obj B) ≤ ε
proof:
:=
  (i.smooth η).geometricInterleavingDistance_le

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_left_le
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_left_le (η : ℝ≥0) (A C : RGraphCat) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A) C ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance A C + η
proof:
:= by
  calc
    geometricInterleavingDistance ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A) C ≤
        geometricInterleavingDistance ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A) A +
          geometricInterleavingDistance A C :=
      geometricInterleavingDistance_triangle _ _ _
    _ = geometricInterleavingDistance A ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A) +
          geometricInterleavingDistance A C := by
      rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_comm]
    _ ≤ η + geometricInterleavingDistance A C :=
      add_le_add_left (geometricInterleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_self_le η A) _
    _ = geometricInterleavingDistance A C + η := add_comm _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_le_geometricSmoothing_left
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_le_geometricSmoothing_left (η : ℝ≥0) (A C : RGraphCat) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A C ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A) C + η
proof:
:= by
  calc
    geometricInterleavingDistance A C ≤
        geometricInterleavingDistance A ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A) +
          geometricInterleavingDistance ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A) C :=
      geometricInterleavingDistance_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ η + geometricInterleavingDistance ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A) C :=
      add_le_add_left (geometricInterleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_self_le η A) _
    _ = geometricInterleavingDistance ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A) C + η := add_comm _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_right_le
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_right_le (η : ℝ≥0) (A C : RGraphCat) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance C ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A) ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance C A + η
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_comm C ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A),
    geometricInterleavingDistance_comm C A]
  exact geometricInterleavingDistance_geometricSmoothing_left_le η A C

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_le_geometricSmoothing_right
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_le_geometricSmoothing_right (η : ℝ≥0) (A C : RGraphCat) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance C A ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance C ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A) + η
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_comm C A,
    geometricInterleavingDistance_comm C ((geometricSmoothing η).obj A)]
  exact geometricInterleavingDistance_le_geometricSmoothing_left η A C

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.abs_dartHeight_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_dartHeight_sub_le {ε : ℝ} (hhg : ∀ v, |h v - g v| ≤ ε) (d : G.Dart)
    (t : unitInterval) : |dartHeight h d t - dartHeight g d t| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  have h₀ : 0 ≤ (t : ℝ) := t.2.1
  have h₁ : 0 ≤ 1 - (t : ℝ) := sub_nonneg.2 t.2.2
  have hsub : dartHeight h d t - dartHeight g d t =
      (1 - (t : ℝ)) * (h d.fst - g d.fst) + (t : ℝ) * (h d.snd - g d.snd) := by
    unfold dartHeight
    ring
  rw [hsub]
  calc
    |(1 - (t : ℝ)) * (h d.fst - g d.fst) + (t : ℝ) * (h d.snd - g d.snd)|
        ≤ (1 - (t : ℝ)) * |h d.fst - g d.fst| + (t : ℝ) * |h d.snd - g d.snd| := by
      refine (abs_add_le _ _).trans ?_
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg h₀, abs_of_nonneg h₁]
    _ ≤ (1 - (t : ℝ)) * ε + (t : ℝ) * ε := by
      gcongr
      · exact hhg _
      · exact hhg _
    _ = ε := by ring

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.abs_plHeight_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_plHeight_sub_le {ε : ℝ} (hhg : ∀ v, |h v - g v| ≤ ε) (x : Realization G) :
    |plHeight G h x - plHeight G g x| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  induction x using GraphRealization.ind with
  | vertex v => exact hhg v
  | edgePoint d t => exact abs_dartHeight_sub_le hhg d t

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edist_ofFun_plHeight
statement:
theorem edist_ofFun_plHeight :
    edist (UniformFun.ofFun (plHeight G h)) (UniformFun.ofFun (plHeight G g)) =
      edist (UniformFun.ofFun h) (UniformFun.ofFun g)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · by_cases htop : edist (UniformFun.ofFun h) (UniformFun.ofFun g) = ⊤
    · rw [htop]
      exact le_top
    · rw [← ENNReal.coe_toNNReal htop]
      exact edist_uniformFun_ofFun_le_coe_iff.2 (abs_plHeight_sub_le G
        (edist_uniformFun_ofFun_le_coe_iff.1 (ENNReal.coe_toNNReal htop).ge))
  · rw [UniformFun.edist_le]
    intro v
    exact UniformFun.edist_eval_le (f := UniformFun.ofFun (plHeight G h))
      (g := UniformFun.ofFun (plHeight G g)) (x := vertex G v)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edist_ofFun_plHeight_eq_edist
statement:
theorem edist_ofFun_plHeight_eq_edist [Fintype V] :
    edist (UniformFun.ofFun (plHeight G h)) (UniformFun.ofFun (plHeight G g)) = edist h g
proof:
:= by
  rw [edist_ofFun_plHeight, UniformFun.edist_def, edist_pi_def, Finset.sup_univ_eq_iSup]
  rfl

theorem vertexHeightInterleaving_eq {ε : ℝ≥0} (hhg : ∀ v, |h v - g v| ≤ ε) :

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.vertexHeightInterleaving_φ_app_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vertexHeightInterleaving_φ_app_mk {ε : ℝ≥0} (hhg : ∀ v, |h v - g v| ≤ ε)
    (I : OpenInterval) (x : {x : Realization G // plHeight G h x ∈ OpenInterval.toOpens I}) :
    (vertexHeightInterleaving G hhg).φ.app I (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x.1, preimage_subset_preimage_thicken (abs_plHeight_sub_le G hhg) I x.2⟩ :
        {y : Realization G // plHeight G g y ∈ OpenInterval.toOpens (OpenInterval.thicken ε I)})
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.vertexHeightInterleaving_ψ_app_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem vertexHeightInterleaving_ψ_app_mk {ε : ℝ≥0} (hhg : ∀ v, |h v - g v| ≤ ε)
    (I : OpenInterval) (x : {x : Realization G // plHeight G g x ∈ OpenInterval.toOpens I}) :
    (vertexHeightInterleaving G hhg).ψ.app I (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x.1, preimage_subset_preimage_thicken
          (perturbationBound_symm (abs_plHeight_sub_le G hhg)) I x.2⟩ :
        {y : Realization G // plHeight G h y ∈ OpenInterval.toOpens (OpenInterval.thicken ε I)})
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.isEmpty_hom_of_ne
statement:
theorem isEmpty_hom_of_ne {x y : D.IncidenceVertex} (h : (x.1 : ℕ) + 1 ≠ y.1) :
    IsEmpty (x ⟶ y)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro p
  apply h
  have hs := congrArg (fun z : D.IncidenceVertex => (z.1 : ℕ)) p.2.1
  have ht := congrArg (fun z : D.IncidenceVertex => (z.1 : ℕ)) p.2.2
  change (p.1.1.castSucc : ℕ) = (x.1 : ℕ) at hs
  change (p.1.1.succ : ℕ) = (y.1 : ℕ) at ht
  calc
    (x.1 : ℕ) + 1 = (p.1.1.castSucc : ℕ) + 1 := by rw [hs]
    _ = (p.1.1.succ : ℕ) := by simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
    _ = (y.1 : ℕ) := ht

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.incidenceGraph_adj_iff
statement:
theorem incidenceGraph_adj_iff {x y : D.IncidenceVertex} :
    D.incidenceGraph.Adj x y ↔ Nonempty (x ⟶ y) ∨ Nonempty (y ⟶ x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [incidenceGraph, SimpleGraph.fromRel_adj]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, hxy⟩
    exact hxy
  · intro hxy
    refine ⟨?_, hxy⟩
    intro h
    subst y
    rcases hxy with hx | hx
    · obtain ⟨p⟩ := hx
      exact (isEmpty_hom_of_ne D (by omega) : IsEmpty (x ⟶ x)).false p
    · obtain ⟨p⟩ := hx
      exact (isEmpty_hom_of_ne D (by omega) : IsEmpty (x ⟶ x)).false p

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.incidenceGraph_adj_castSucc_succ_iff
statement:
theorem incidenceGraph_adj_castSucc_succ_iff (e : Fin n) (v : D.V e.castSucc)
    (w : D.V e.succ) :
    D.incidenceGraph.Adj ⟨e.castSucc, v⟩ ⟨e.succ, w⟩ ↔
      ∃ x : D.E e, D.left e x = v ∧ D.right e x = w
proof:
:= by
  refine (D.incidenceGraph_adj_iff
    (x := (⟨e.castSucc, v⟩ : D.IncidenceVertex))
    (y := (⟨e.succ, w⟩ : D.IncidenceVertex))).trans ?_
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases h with hxy | hyx
    · obtain ⟨p⟩ := hxy
      exact ⟨(D.homCastSuccSuccEquiv e v w p).1,
        (D.homCastSuccSuccEquiv e v w p).2⟩
    · obtain ⟨p⟩ := hyx
      exact ((isEmpty_hom_of_ne D (by
          change (e.succ : ℕ) + 1 ≠ (e.castSucc : ℕ)
          rw [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc]
          omega) :
        IsEmpty (Quiver.Hom (V := D.IncidenceVertex) ⟨e.succ, w⟩ ⟨e.castSucc, v⟩)).false p).elim
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hy⟩
    exact Or.inl ⟨(D.homCastSuccSuccEquiv e v w).symm ⟨x, hx, hy⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.incidenceGraph_adj_level
statement:
theorem incidenceGraph_adj_level {x y : D.IncidenceVertex} (h : D.incidenceGraph.Adj x y) :
    (x.1 : ℕ) + 1 = y.1 ∨ (y.1 : ℕ) + 1 = x.1
proof:
:= by
  rcases (D.incidenceGraph_adj_iff).mp h with hxy | hyx
  · left
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := hxy
    have hs := congrArg (fun z : D.IncidenceVertex => (z.1 : ℕ)) p.2.1
    have ht := congrArg (fun z : D.IncidenceVertex => (z.1 : ℕ)) p.2.2
    change (p.1.1.castSucc : ℕ) = (x.1 : ℕ) at hs
    change (p.1.1.succ : ℕ) = (y.1 : ℕ) at ht
    calc
      (x.1 : ℕ) + 1 = (p.1.1.castSucc : ℕ) + 1 := by rw [hs]
      _ = (p.1.1.succ : ℕ) := by simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
      _ = (y.1 : ℕ) := ht
  · right
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := hyx
    have hs := congrArg (fun z : D.IncidenceVertex => (z.1 : ℕ)) p.2.1
    have ht := congrArg (fun z : D.IncidenceVertex => (z.1 : ℕ)) p.2.2
    change (p.1.1.castSucc : ℕ) = (y.1 : ℕ) at hs
    change (p.1.1.succ : ℕ) = (x.1 : ℕ) at ht
    calc
      (y.1 : ℕ) + 1 = (p.1.1.castSucc : ℕ) + 1 := by rw [hs]
      _ = (p.1.1.succ : ℕ) := by simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
      _ = (x.1 : ℕ) := ht

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.incidenceEdgeSet_surjective
statement: theorem incidenceEdgeSet_surjective : Function.Surjective D.incidenceEdgeSet
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e, he⟩
  induction e using Sym2.ind with
  | h x y =>
    rw [SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] at he
    rcases (D.incidenceGraph_adj_iff).mp he with hxy | hyx
    · obtain ⟨p⟩ := hxy
      refine ⟨p.1, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg₂ (fun a b => s(a, b)) p.2.1 p.2.2
    · obtain ⟨p⟩ := hyx
      refine ⟨p.1, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (congrArg₂ (fun a b => s(a, b)) p.2.1 p.2.2).trans Sym2.eq_swap

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.incidenceEdgeSet_injective_iff
statement:
theorem incidenceEdgeSet_injective_iff :
    Function.Injective D.incidenceEdgeSet ↔
      ∀ e (x y : D.E e), D.left e x = D.left e y → D.right e x = D.right e y → x = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hinj e x y hleft hright
    have hs : D.incidenceSource ⟨e, x⟩ = D.incidenceSource ⟨e, y⟩ := by
      change (⟨e.castSucc, D.left e x⟩ : D.IncidenceVertex) =
        ⟨e.castSucc, D.left e y⟩
      exact congrArg (fun z => (⟨e.castSucc, z⟩ : D.IncidenceVertex)) hleft
    have ht : D.incidenceTarget ⟨e, x⟩ = D.incidenceTarget ⟨e, y⟩ := by
      change (⟨e.succ, D.right e x⟩ : D.IncidenceVertex) =
        ⟨e.succ, D.right e y⟩
      exact congrArg (fun z => (⟨e.succ, z⟩ : D.IncidenceVertex)) hright
    have hp : D.incidenceEdgeSet ⟨e, x⟩ = D.incidenceEdgeSet ⟨e, y⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg₂ (fun a b => s(a, b)) hs ht
    exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp (hinj hp)).2
  · intro hcond p q hpq
    rcases p with ⟨e, x⟩
    rcases q with ⟨e', y⟩
    have hpq' : s(D.incidenceSource ⟨e, x⟩, D.incidenceTarget ⟨e, x⟩) =
        s(D.incidenceSource ⟨e', y⟩, D.incidenceTarget ⟨e', y⟩) :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hpq
    rw [Sym2.eq_iff] at hpq'
    rcases hpq' with ⟨hs, ht⟩ | ⟨hs, ht⟩
    · change (⟨e.castSucc, D.left e x⟩ : D.IncidenceVertex) =
        ⟨e'.castSucc, D.left e' y⟩ at hs
      change (⟨e.succ, D.right e x⟩ : D.IncidenceVertex) =
        ⟨e'.succ, D.right e' y⟩ at ht
      have he : e = e' := Fin.castSucc_injective _
        (congrArg (fun z : D.IncidenceVertex => z.1) hs)
      subst e'
      have hleft : D.left e x = D.left e y := eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp hs).2
      have hright : D.right e x = D.right e y := eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp ht).2
      exact congrArg (fun z => (⟨e, z⟩ : D.IncidenceEdge)) (hcond e x y hleft hright)
    · change (⟨e.castSucc, D.left e x⟩ : D.IncidenceVertex) =
        ⟨e'.succ, D.right e' y⟩ at hs
      change (⟨e.succ, D.right e x⟩ : D.IncidenceVertex) =
        ⟨e'.castSucc, D.left e' y⟩ at ht
      have hlevel := congrArg (fun z : D.IncidenceVertex => (z.1 : ℕ)) hs
      have hlevel' := congrArg (fun z : D.IncidenceVertex => (z.1 : ℕ)) ht
      simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at hlevel hlevel'
      omega

proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleThickeningQuotient.point_thickeningQuotient_one_fiber_subsingleton
statement:
theorem point_thickeningQuotient_one_fiber_subsingleton (t : ℝ) :
    Subsingleton (overBaseMap ((thickeningQuotient 1).obj pointSpace).obj ⁻¹' {t})
proof:
:= by
  apply fiber_subsingleton_of_iso ((thickeningQuotientAbsorptionIso 1).app pointSpace) t
  have hpoint : Subsingleton pointGraph.obj.left := by
    have : Subsingleton ((ofFiniteData pt0).V 0) := inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton Unit)
    exact (homeomorphZero S0 (ofFiniteData pt0)).symm.injective.subsingleton
  have : Subsingleton pointGraph.obj.left := hpoint
  let pointQuotientIso : pointGraph ≅ quotientRGraphFunctor.obj pointSpace :=
    ObjectProperty.isoMk _ (RGraph.projNatIso.app pointGraph)
  apply fiber_subsingleton_of_iso
    (((geometricSmoothing 1).mapIso pointQuotientIso).symm) t
  apply fiber_subsingleton_of_cosheaf
  intro I
  have h : Subsingleton
      ((intervalComponents (overBaseMap pointGraph.obj)).obj (thicken 1 I)) := by
    constructor
    intro c d
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      induction d using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
      | mk y =>
        exact congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (Subtype.ext (Subsingleton.elim x.1 y.1))
  exact (geometricSmoothingValueEquiv 1 pointGraph I).subsingleton_congr.2 h

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleThickeningQuotient.id_thickening_quotient_not_isRGraph
statement:
theorem id_thickening_quotient_not_isRGraph :
    ¬ IsRGraph ((ℛ).obj ((GeometricThickening.functor 1).obj
      (Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (ContinuousMap.id ℝ)))))
proof:
:= by
  let X : Over (TopCat.of ℝ) := Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (ContinuousMap.id ℝ))
  change ¬ IsRGraph ((ℛ).obj ((GeometricThickening.functor 1).obj X))
  intro hA
  obtain ⟨m, T, D, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hA
  have hsurj : ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ q : ((ℛ).obj ((GeometricThickening.functor 1).obj X)).left,
      overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj ((GeometricThickening.functor 1).obj X)) q = t := by
    intro t
    refine ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ (t, ⟨0, GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band 1⟩), ?_⟩
    change (ContinuousMap.id ℝ) t + 0 = t
    simp
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hsurj (T.value (Fin.last m) + 1)
  have hq' : (ofFiniteData D).height T (e.hom.left.hom q) =
      T.value (Fin.last m) + 1 := by
    calc
      (ofFiniteData D).height T (e.hom.left.hom q) =
          overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj ((GeometricThickening.functor 1).obj X)) q :=
        overBaseMap_comm e.hom q
      _ = T.value (Fin.last m) + 1 := hq
  have hbound := (ofFiniteData D).height_mem_Icc T (e.hom.left.hom q)
  linarith [hbound.2, hq']

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.rep_unit_ioo

    (z : {z : A.obj.left × GeometricThickening.Band ε //
      GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap A.obj) ε z ∈ ioo a b})
    (x : {x : A.obj.left // overBaseMap A.obj x ∈ ioo a b}) :
    ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app A).hom.app (ioo a b)
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ z.1, z.2⟩ :
          {q : ReebQuotient (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap A.obj) ε) //
            ReebQuotient.height _ q ∈ ioo a b})) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨z.1.1, GeometricThickening.fst_mem_thicken z.2⟩ :
        {w : A.obj.left // overBaseMap A.obj w ∈ thicken ε (ioo a b)}) ∧
    ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app A).hom.app (ioo a b)
        ((cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app A)).hom.app (ioo a b)
          (ZerothHomotopy.mk x)) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x.1, OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 (le_thicken ε _) x.2⟩ :
        {y : A.obj.left // overBaseMap A.obj y ∈ thicken ε (ioo a b)})
proof:
:=
  ⟨geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk ε A _ z,
    geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_unit_mk ε A _ x⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.singleton_smoothed_subsingleton
statement:
theorem singleton_smoothed_subsingleton (a : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : OpenInterval) :

      ((cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj (singletonGraph a))).obj.obj I)
proof:
:= by

  have h : Subsingleton
      ((intervalComponents (overBaseMap (singletonGraph a).obj)).obj (thicken ε I)) :=
    ⟨fun c d => by
      induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
      | mk x =>
        induction d using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
        | mk y => exact congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (Subtype.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _))⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.singleton_smoothed_isEmpty_iio
statement:
theorem singleton_smoothed_isEmpty_iio (a : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    IsEmpty ((cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj (singletonGraph a))).obj.obj
      (iio (a - ε)))
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (overBaseMap (singletonGraph a).obj)).obj
      (thicken ε (iio (a - ε)))) :=
    ⟨fun c => by
      induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
      | mk x =>
        have hx : overBaseMap (singletonGraph a).obj x.1 ∈ thicken ε (iio (a - ε)) := x.2
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hx
        have ha : overBaseMap (singletonGraph a).obj x.1 = a :=
          height_zero (single a) (ofFiniteData pt0) x.1
        have hy' : y < a - ε := hy
        rw [ha, abs_le] at hxy
        linarith [hxy.2]⟩
  exact (geometricSmoothingValueEquiv ε (singletonGraph a) _).isEmpty_congr.2 h

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.singleton_smoothed_nonempty_iio
statement:
theorem singleton_smoothed_nonempty_iio (a : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :

      (iio (a - ε + δ)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ ((ofFiniteData pt0).ofVertex (single a) 0 (),
      ⟨-(ε : ℝ), le_refl _, GeometricThickening.neg_le_band ε⟩), by
        show a + -(ε : ℝ) < a - ε + δ
        linarith⟩ :
    {q : ReebQuotient (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap (singletonGraph a).obj) ε) //
      ReebQuotient.height _ q ∈ iio (a - ε + δ)})⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.S01_J1_mem_iff
statement: theorem S01_J1_mem_iff (x : ℝ) : x ∈ S01.J 1 ↔ 0 < x
proof:
:= by
  rw [S01.mem_J_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa using h.1 0 rfl
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun k hk => ?_, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    · obtain rfl : k = 0 := Fin.ext (by simpa using hk)
      simpa using h
    · have := k.isLt
      simp at hk
      omega

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.top_glue
statement:
theorem top_glue (y : D.E 0) :
    (D.toCosheaf S01).map (homOfLE (le_top : S01.J (Fin.castSucc 0) ≤ ⊤))
        (D.vertexLabel S01 (Fin.castSucc 0) (D.left 0 y)) =
      (D.toCosheaf S01).map (homOfLE (le_top : S01.J (Fin.succ 0) ≤ ⊤))
        (D.vertexLabel S01 (Fin.succ 0) (D.right 0 y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← D.map_K_le_J_castSucc_edgeLabel S01 0 y, ← D.map_K_le_J_succ_edgeLabel S01 0 y,
    ← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  exact congrArg (fun f => (D.toCosheaf S01).map f (D.edgeLabel S01 0 y)) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.subsingleton_top
statement:
theorem subsingleton_top (h0 : Subsingleton (D.V 0)) (h1 : Subsingleton (D.V 1)) (y : D.E 0) :
    Subsingleton ((D.toCosheaf S01).obj ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  have := h0
  have := h1
  have hJ0 : Subsingleton ((D.toCosheaf S01).obj (S01.J 0)) :=
    (D.vertexLabel S01 0).symm.subsingleton
  have hJ1 : Subsingleton ((D.toCosheaf S01).obj (S01.J 1)) :=
    (D.vertexLabel S01 1).symm.subsingleton
  have key : ∀ c : (D.toCosheaf S01).obj ⊤, c =
      (D.toCosheaf S01).map (homOfLE (le_top : S01.J (Fin.castSucc 0) ≤ ⊤))
        (D.vertexLabel S01 (Fin.castSucc 0) (D.left 0 y)) := by
    intro c
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      rcases lt_or_ge ((ofFiniteData D).height S01 x.1) 1 with hx | hx
      · have hm : (ofFiniteData D).height S01 x.1 ∈ S01.J 0 := (pinch_J0_mem_iff _).2 hx
        exact congrArg ((D.toCosheaf S01).map (homOfLE (le_top : S01.J (Fin.castSucc 0) ≤ ⊤)))
          (hJ0.elim (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x.1, hm⟩ :
            {z : (ofFiniteData D).Realization S01 // (ofFiniteData D).height S01 z ∈ S01.J 0}) :
              (D.toCosheaf S01).obj (S01.J 0))
            (D.vertexLabel S01 (Fin.castSucc 0) (D.left 0 y)))
      · have hm : (ofFiniteData D).height S01 x.1 ∈ S01.J 1 :=
          (S01_J1_mem_iff _).2 (by linarith)
        exact (congrArg ((D.toCosheaf S01).map (homOfLE (le_top : S01.J (Fin.succ 0) ≤ ⊤)))
          (hJ1.elim (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x.1, hm⟩ :
            {z : (ofFiniteData D).Realization S01 // (ofFiniteData D).height S01 z ∈ S01.J 1}) :
              (D.toCosheaf S01).obj (S01.J 1))
            (D.vertexLabel S01 (Fin.succ 0) (D.right 0 y)))).trans (top_glue D y).symm
  exact ⟨fun a b => (key a).trans (key b).symm⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.subsingleton_of_mem
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_mem (h0 : Subsingleton (D.V 0)) (h1 : Subsingleton (D.V 1)) (y : D.E 0)
    {L : OpenInterval} (hL : (0 : ℝ) ∈ L ∨ (1 : ℝ) ∈ L) :
    Subsingleton ((D.toCosheaf S01).obj L)
proof:
:= by
  have := h0
  have := h1
  have hF := D.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt S01
  by_cases hz : (0 : ℝ) ∈ L <;> by_cases ho : (1 : ℝ) ∈ L
  · have := subsingleton_top D h0 h1 y
    exact (hF.bijective (le_top : L ≤ ⊤) ⟨0, hz⟩
      (fun i => ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => by fin_cases i <;> simp [hz, ho]⟩)).injective
        |>.subsingleton
  · have hle : L ≤ S01.J 0 := OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => (pinch_J0_mem_iff x).2
      (not_le.1 fun hx1 => ho (L.ordConnected.out hz hx ⟨zero_le_one, hx1⟩))
    have : Subsingleton ((D.toCosheaf S01).obj (S01.J 0)) :=
      (D.vertexLabel S01 0).symm.subsingleton
    exact (hF.bijective hle ⟨0, hz⟩ (fun i => by
      rw [S01.value_mem_J_iff]
      fin_cases i <;> simp [hz, ho])).injective.subsingleton
  · have hle : L ≤ S01.J 1 := OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => (S01_J1_mem_iff x).2
      (not_le.1 fun hx0 => hz (L.ordConnected.out hx ho ⟨hx0, zero_le_one⟩))
    have : Subsingleton ((D.toCosheaf S01).obj (S01.J 1)) :=
      (D.vertexLabel S01 1).symm.subsingleton
    exact (hF.bijective hle ⟨1, ho⟩ (fun i => by
      rw [S01.value_mem_J_iff]
      fin_cases i <;> simp [hz, ho])).injective.subsingleton
  · exact absurd hL (by tauto)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.isEmpty_of_lt
statement:
theorem isEmpty_of_lt {L : OpenInterval} (h : ∀ x ∈ L, x < 0) :
    IsEmpty ((D.toCosheaf S01).obj L)
proof:
:=
  (D.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt S01).isEmpty_of_le_lowerTail
    (OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => S01.mem_lowerTail.2 (by
      rw [S01_value_zero]
      exact h x hx))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.isEmpty_of_gt
statement:
theorem isEmpty_of_gt {L : OpenInterval} (h : ∀ x ∈ L, 1 < x) :
    IsEmpty ((D.toCosheaf S01).obj L)
proof:
:=
  (D.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt S01).isEmpty_of_le_upperTail
    (OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => S01.mem_upperTail.2 (by
      rw [show Fin.last 1 = 1 from rfl, S01_value_one]
      exact h x hx))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.subsingleton_of_long
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_long (h0 : Subsingleton (D.V 0)) (h1 : Subsingleton (D.V 1))
    (y : D.E 0) {L : OpenInterval} {c : ℝ} (ha : c - 1 / 2 ∈ L) (hb : c + 1 / 2 ∈ L) :
    Subsingleton ((D.toCosheaf S01).obj L)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : (0 : ℝ) ∈ L
  · exact subsingleton_of_mem D h0 h1 y (.inl hz)
  by_cases ho : (1 : ℝ) ∈ L
  · exact subsingleton_of_mem D h0 h1 y (.inr ho)
  have hIcc := L.ordConnected.out ha hb
  rcases lt_or_ge c (1 / 2) with hc | hc
  · have hb0 : c + 1 / 2 < 0 := not_le.1 fun hn => hz (hIcc ⟨by linarith, hn⟩)
    have := isEmpty_of_lt D (L := L) fun x hx =>
      not_le.1 fun hn => hz (L.ordConnected.out hb hx ⟨hb0.le, hn⟩)
    infer_instance
  · have ha1 : 1 < c - 1 / 2 := not_le.1 fun hn => ho (hIcc ⟨hn, by linarith⟩)
    have := isEmpty_of_gt D (L := L) fun x hx =>
      not_le.1 fun hn => ho (L.ordConnected.out hx ha ⟨hn, ha1.le⟩)
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.thicken_subsingleton_of_half_le
statement:
theorem thicken_subsingleton_of_half_le (h0 : Subsingleton (D.V 0)) (h1 : Subsingleton (D.V 1))
    (y : D.E 0) {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 1 / 2 ≤ (ε : ℝ)) (I : OpenInterval) :
    Subsingleton ((D.toCosheaf S01).obj (thicken ε I))
proof:
:= by
  rcases (I : Set ℝ).eq_empty_or_nonempty with hI | ⟨c, hc⟩
  · refine ⟨fun a _ => ?_⟩
    induction a using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      exfalso
      have hx : (ofFiniteData D).height S01 x.1 ∈ thicken ε I := x.2
      obtain ⟨t, ht, -⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hx
      have ht' : t ∈ (I : Set ℝ) := ht
      rw [hI] at ht'
      exact ht'
  · refine subsingleton_of_long D h0 h1 y (c := c) ?_ ?_
    · exact mem_thicken.2 ⟨c, hc, by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith⟩
    · exact mem_thicken.2 ⟨c, hc, by rw [abs_le]; constructor <;> linarith⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.smoothed_isEmpty_rays
statement:
theorem smoothed_isEmpty_rays (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    IsEmpty ((cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj ((toRGraph S01).obj D))).obj.obj
        (iio (-(ε : ℝ)))) ∧
      IsEmpty ((cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj ((toRGraph S01).obj D))).obj.obj
        (ioi (1 + ε)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine (geometricSmoothingValueEquiv ε ((toRGraph S01).obj D) _).isEmpty_congr.2
      (isEmpty_of_lt D fun x hx => ?_)
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hx
    have ht' : t < -(ε : ℝ) := ht
    rw [abs_le] at hxt
    linarith [hxt.2]
  · refine (geometricSmoothingValueEquiv ε ((toRGraph S01).obj D) _).isEmpty_congr.2
      (isEmpty_of_gt D fun x hx => ?_)
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hxt⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hx
    have ht' : 1 + (ε : ℝ) < t := ht
    rw [abs_le] at hxt
    linarith [hxt.1]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.smoothed_nonempty
statement:
theorem smoothed_nonempty (v₀ : D.V 0) (v₁ : D.V 1) {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 1 / 2 ≤ (ε : ℝ))
    {I : OpenInterval} {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ I) (ht₁ : -(ε : ℝ) ≤ t) (ht₂ : t ≤ 1 + ε) :
    Nonempty ((cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj ((toRGraph S01).obj D))).obj.obj
      I)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt t ε with h | h
  · refine ⟨ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ ((ofFiniteData D).ofVertex S01 0 v₀,
      ⟨t, ht₁, h⟩), ?_⟩ :
        {q : ReebQuotient
            (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap ((toRGraph S01).obj D).obj) ε) //
          ReebQuotient.height _ q ∈ I})⟩
    change S01.value 0 + t ∈ I
    rw [S01_value_zero, zero_add]
    exact ht
  · refine ⟨ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ ((ofFiniteData D).ofVertex S01 1 v₁,
      ⟨t - 1, by linarith, by linarith⟩), ?_⟩ :
        {q : ReebQuotient
            (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap ((toRGraph S01).obj D).obj) ε) //
          ReebQuotient.height _ q ∈ I})⟩
    change S01.value 1 + (t - 1) ∈ I
    rw [S01_value_one, add_sub_cancel]
    exact ht

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.subsingleton_of_one_edge
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_one_edge (h0 : Subsingleton (D.V 0)) (h1 : Subsingleton (D.V 1))
    (hE : Subsingleton (D.E 0)) (y : D.E 0) (L : OpenInterval) :
    Subsingleton ((D.toCosheaf S01).obj L)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : (0 : ℝ) ∈ L
  · exact subsingleton_of_mem D h0 h1 y (.inl hz)
  by_cases ho : (1 : ℝ) ∈ L
  · exact subsingleton_of_mem D h0 h1 y (.inr ho)
  rcases (L : Set ℝ).eq_empty_or_nonempty with hL | ⟨c, hc⟩
  · refine ⟨fun a _ => ?_⟩
    induction a using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      exfalso
      have hx : (ofFiniteData D).height S01 x.1 ∈ (L : Set ℝ) := x.2
      rw [hL] at hx
      exact hx
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (show c ≠ 0 from fun h => hz (h ▸ hc)) with hc0 | hc0
  · have := isEmpty_of_lt D (L := L) fun x hx =>
      not_le.1 fun hn => hz (L.ordConnected.out hc hx ⟨hc0.le, hn⟩)
    infer_instance
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (show c ≠ 1 from fun h => ho (h ▸ hc)) with hc1 | hc1
  · have hle : L ≤ S01.K 0 := OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => by
      refine S01.mem_K.2 ?_
      simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_zero, S01_value_one]
      exact ⟨not_le.1 fun hn => hz (L.ordConnected.out hx hc ⟨hn, hc0.le⟩),
        not_le.1 fun hn => ho (L.ordConnected.out hc hx ⟨hc1.le, hn⟩)⟩
    have : Subsingleton ((D.toCosheaf S01).obj (S01.K 0)) :=
      (D.edgeLabel S01 0).symm.subsingleton
    refine ((D.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt S01).bijective hle ⟨c, hc⟩ fun i =>
      iff_of_false ?_ (S01.value_notMem_K 0 i)).injective.subsingleton
    fin_cases i
    · simpa using hz
    · simpa using ho
  · have := isEmpty_of_gt D (L := L) fun x hx =>
      not_le.1 fun hn => ho (L.ordConnected.out hx hc ⟨hn, hc1.le⟩)
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.smoothed_fiber_nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem smoothed_fiber_nonempty_iff (y : D.E 0) (ε : ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ) :
    (overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj ((toRGraph S01).obj D)).obj ⁻¹' {t}).Nonempty ↔
      t ∈ Icc (-(ε : ℝ)) (1 + ε)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _ q
    have hz : (ofFiniteData D).height S01 z.1 + (z.2 : ℝ) = t := hq
    have hx := (ofFiniteData D).height_mem_Icc S01 z.1
    rw [S01_value_zero, show Fin.last 1 = 1 from rfl, S01_value_one] at hx
    exact ⟨by linarith [hx.1, z.2.2.1], by linarith [hx.2, z.2.2.2]⟩
  · rintro ⟨ht₁, ht₂⟩
    rcases le_or_gt t ε with h | h
    · refine ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ ((ofFiniteData D).ofVertex S01 0 (D.left 0 y), ⟨t, ht₁, h⟩), ?_⟩
      show S01.value 0 + t = t
      rw [S01_value_zero, zero_add]
    rcases le_or_gt (1 - (ε : ℝ)) t with h' | h'
    · refine ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ ((ofFiniteData D).ofVertex S01 1 (D.right 0 y),
        ⟨t - 1, by linarith, by linarith⟩), ?_⟩
      show S01.value 1 + (t - 1) = t
      rw [S01_value_one, add_sub_cancel]
    · have hK : t ∈ S01.K 0 := by
        rw [S01.mem_K]
        simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_zero, S01_value_one]
        exact ⟨by linarith [ε.coe_nonneg], by linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]⟩
      refine ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ ((ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S01 0 (y, ⟨t, hK⟩),
        ⟨0, GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band ε⟩), ?_⟩
      show t + 0 = t
      rw [add_zero]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.smoothed_nonempty_of_edge
statement:
theorem smoothed_nonempty_of_edge (y : D.E 0) (ε : ℝ≥0) {I : OpenInterval} {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ I)
    (ht₁ : -(ε : ℝ) ≤ t) (ht₂ : t ≤ 1 + ε) :
    Nonempty ((cosheafFunctor.obj ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj ((toRGraph S01).obj D))).obj.obj
      I)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := (smoothed_fiber_nonempty_iff D y ε t).2 ⟨ht₁, ht₂⟩
  have hq' : overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj ((toRGraph S01).obj D)).obj q = t := hq
  exact ⟨ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨q, by rw [hq']; exact ht⟩ :
    {q : ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj ((toRGraph S01).obj D)).obj.left //
      overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj ((toRGraph S01).obj D)).obj q ∈ I})⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.parallel_mid_not_subsingleton
statement:
theorem parallel_mid_not_subsingleton :
    ¬ Subsingleton ((parallelData.toCosheaf S01).obj (ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4)))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hle : ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4) ≤ S01.K 0 := OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => by
    refine S01.mem_K.2 ?_
    simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, S01_value_zero, S01_value_one]
    obtain ⟨hx₁, hx₂⟩ := mem_ioo.1 hx
    exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
  have hbij := (parallelData.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt S01).bijective hle
    ⟨1 / 2, mem_ioo.2 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩⟩ fun i =>
      iff_of_false (by fin_cases i <;> norm_num [mem_ioo]) (S01.value_notMem_K 0 i)
  have : Subsingleton ((parallelData.toCosheaf S01).obj (S01.K 0)) := hbij.surjective.subsingleton
  exact Bool.false_ne_true ((parallelData.edgeLabel S01 0).injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.realization_fiber_subsingleton
statement:
theorem realization_fiber_subsingleton {m : ℕ} (T : CriticalValues m)
    (D : FiniteReebData.{0} m) (h : ∀ L, Subsingleton ((D.toCosheaf T).obj L)) (t : ℝ) :
    Subsingleton ((ofFiniteData D).height T ⁻¹' {t})
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hlev : ∃ i, T.value i = t
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hlev
    have := h (T.J i)
    have hV : Subsingleton (D.V i) := (D.vertexLabel T i).subsingleton
    have key : ∀ q : (ofFiniteData D).height T ⁻¹' {T.value i},
        ∃ v : D.V i, q.1 = (ofFiniteData D).ofVertex T i v := by
      rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
      rcases (ofFiniteData D).exists_rep T q with ⟨j, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, p, rfl⟩
      · have hj : T.value j = T.value i := hq
        obtain rfl := T.strictMono.injective hj
        exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
      · have hp : (p.2 : ℝ) = T.value i := hq
        have hK := p.2.2
        rw [hp] at hK
        exact absurd hK (T.value_notMem_K e i)
    refine ⟨fun q q' => Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := key q
    obtain ⟨v', hv'⟩ := key q'
    rw [hv, hv', Subsingleton.elim v v']
  · simp only [not_exists] at hlev
    refine ⟨fun q q' => Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨e, he, z, hz⟩ := exists_strip_rep (ofFiniteData D) q.1 q.2 hlev
    obtain ⟨e', he', z', hz'⟩ := exists_strip_rep (ofFiniteData D) q'.1 q'.2 hlev
    obtain rfl : e = e' := T.eq_of_K_inf_K_nonempty ⟨t, he, he'⟩
    have := h (T.K e)
    have hE : Subsingleton ((ofFiniteData D).E e) := (D.edgeLabel T e).subsingleton
    rw [hz, hz', Subsingleton.elim z z']

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.fiber_subsingleton_of_cosheaf
statement:
theorem fiber_subsingleton_of_cosheaf (B : RGraphCat)
    (h : ∀ L, Subsingleton ((cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj.obj L)) (t : ℝ) :
    Subsingleton (overBaseMap B.obj ⁻¹' {t})
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, T, D, ⟨i⟩⟩ := B.property
  have hD : ∀ L, Subsingleton ((D.toCosheaf T).obj L) := fun L =>
    @Equiv.subsingleton _ _ ((intervalComponentsOver.mapIso i).app L).toEquiv.symm (h L)
  have hF := realization_fiber_subsingleton T D hD t
  have hinj : Function.Injective i.hom.left.hom := fun x y hxy => by
    have hx : i.inv.left.hom (i.hom.left.hom x) = x :=
      congrArg (fun φ : B.obj ⟶ B.obj => φ.left.hom x) i.hom_inv_id
    have hy : i.inv.left.hom (i.hom.left.hom y) = y :=
      congrArg (fun φ : B.obj ⟶ B.obj => φ.left.hom y) i.hom_inv_id
    rw [← hx, ← hy, hxy]
  refine ⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext (hinj ?_)⟩
  have hx : (ofFiniteData D).height T (i.hom.left.hom x.1) = t :=
    (overBaseMap_comm i.hom x.1).trans x.2
  have hy : (ofFiniteData D).height T (i.hom.left.hom y.1) = t :=
    (overBaseMap_comm i.hom y.1).trans y.2
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (hF.elim ⟨_, hx⟩ ⟨_, hy⟩)

theorem parallel_smoothed_fiber_existsUnique {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 1 / 2 ≤ (ε : ℝ)) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ Icc (-(ε : ℝ)) (1 + ε)) :
    ∃! q : ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj parallelGraph).obj.left,
      overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj parallelGraph).obj q = t
proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.parallel_half_fiber_ends
statement:
theorem parallel_half_fiber_ends {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    (∃! q : ((geometricSmoothing halfNN).obj parallelGraph).obj.left,
        overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing halfNN).obj parallelGraph).obj q = -(1 / 2)) ∧
      (∃! q : ((geometricSmoothing halfNN).obj parallelGraph).obj.left,
        overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing halfNN).obj parallelGraph).obj q = 3 / 2) ∧
      IsEmpty (overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing halfNN).obj parallelGraph).obj ⁻¹'
        {-(1 / 2) - δ}) ∧
      IsEmpty (overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing halfNN).obj parallelGraph).obj ⁻¹'
        {3 / 2 + δ})
proof:
:= by
  have hε : 1 / 2 ≤ ((halfNN : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by rw [coe_halfNN]
  refine ⟨parallel_smoothed_fiber_existsUnique hε ?_, parallel_smoothed_fiber_existsUnique hε ?_,
    parallel_smoothed_fiber_isEmpty halfNN ?_, parallel_smoothed_fiber_isEmpty halfNN ?_⟩
  · rw [coe_halfNN]
    constructor <;> norm_num
  · rw [coe_halfNN]
    constructor <;> norm_num
  · rw [coe_halfNN]
    exact fun h => absurd h.1 (by linarith)
  · rw [coe_halfNN]
    exact fun h => absurd h.2 (by linarith)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.parallel_quarter_fiber_not_subsingleton
statement:
theorem parallel_quarter_fiber_not_subsingleton :
    ¬ Subsingleton
      (overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj parallelGraph).obj ⁻¹' {1 / 2})
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  let x : Bool → (ofFiniteData parallelData).Realization S01 := fun b =>
    (ofFiniteData parallelData).ofStrip S01 0 (b, Examples.Cylinder.half)
  let z : Bool → {z : parallelGraph.obj.left × GeometricThickening.Band quarter //
      GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap parallelGraph.obj) quarter z ∈
        ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4)} := fun b =>
    ⟨(x b, ⟨0, GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band quarter⟩), by
      show (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 0 ∈ ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4)
      rw [mem_ioo]
      constructor <;> norm_num⟩
  have hq : ReebQuotient.mk _ (z false).1 = ReebQuotient.mk _ (z true).1 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (h.elim ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ (z false).1, by
      show (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 0 = 1 / 2
      rw [add_zero]⟩ ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ (z true).1, by
      show (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 0 = 1 / 2
      rw [add_zero]⟩)
  have hc := congrArg (((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso quarter).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.app
    (ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4))) (congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (Subtype.ext hq :
      (⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ (z false).1, (z false).2⟩ :
        {q : ReebQuotient (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap parallelGraph.obj) quarter) //
          ReebQuotient.height _ q ∈ ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4)}) =
        ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ (z true).1, (z true).2⟩))
  rw [geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk,
    geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk] at hc
  have key : ∀ (L : OpenInterval), L = S01.K 0 →
      ∀ (h0 : (ofFiniteData parallelData).height S01 (x false) ∈ L)
        (h1 : (ofFiniteData parallelData).height S01 (x true) ∈ L),
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x false, h0⟩ : (parallelData.toCosheaf S01).obj L) ≠
        ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x true, h1⟩ := by
    rintro L rfl h0 h1 hne
    exact Bool.false_ne_true ((parallelData.edgeLabel S01 0).injective
      (((parallelData.edgeLabel_apply S01 0 Examples.Cylinder.half false).trans hne).trans
        (parallelData.edgeLabel_apply S01 0 Examples.Cylinder.half true).symm))
  exact key _ quarter_thicken _ _ hc

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.twoSeg_smoothed_distinct
statement: theorem twoSeg_smoothed_distinct (ε : ℝ≥0) : twoSegClass ε false ≠ twoSegClass ε true
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have e : ∀ b : Bool, ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app twoSegGraph).hom.app ⊤
      (twoSegClass ε b) =
        ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData twoSegData).ofVertex S01 0 b,
            OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 (le_thicken ε ⊤) trivial⟩ :
          {x : (ofFiniteData twoSegData).Realization S01 //
            (ofFiniteData twoSegData).height S01 x ∈ thicken ε ⊤}) := fun b =>
    geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk ε twoSegGraph ⊤
      ⟨((ofFiniteData twoSegData).ofVertex S01 0 b, ⟨0, GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band ε⟩),
        trivial⟩
  have h2 := (e false).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app twoSegGraph).hom.app ⊤) h).trans
      (e true))
  have hc : Continuous fun x : {x : (ofFiniteData twoSegData).Realization S01 //
      (ofFiniteData twoSegData).height S01 x ∈ thicken ε ⊤} => twoSegLabel x.1 :=
    twoSegLabel.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val
  have hj := (Quotient.exact h2).map hc
  exact Bool.false_ne_true (joined_eq_of_discrete hj)

    cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothing ε).map swapGraph) ≫
        (geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app parallelGraph =
      (geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app parallelGraph ≫
        (constructibleSmoothing ε).map (cosheafFunctor.map swapGraph)
proof:

  (geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.naturality swapGraph

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.RGraphSmoothing.swap_smoothed_quarter_ne_id
statement:
theorem swap_smoothed_quarter_ne_id :
    cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothing quarter).map swapGraph) ≠ 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply smoothedSwap_quarter_ne_id
  have hn := swap_naturality quarter
  rw [h, Category.id_comp] at hn
  rw [← cancel_epi ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso quarter).hom.app parallelGraph)]
  exact hn.symm.trans (Category.comp_id _).symm

      FP.map (homOfLE (S01.K_le_J_castSucc 0)) (DP.edgeLabel S01 0 (0 : Fin 2)) =
        FP.map (homOfLE (S01.K_le_J_castSucc 0)) (DP.edgeLabel S01 0 (1 : Fin 2)) ∧
      FP.map (homOfLE (S01.K_le_J_succ 0)) (DP.edgeLabel S01 0 (0 : Fin 2)) ≠
        FP.map (homOfLE (S01.K_le_J_succ 0)) (DP.edgeLabel S01 0 (1 : Fin 2))

    (pinch_left_label 0).trans (pinch_left_label 1).symm, fun h => ?_⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleRepresentation.pinch_recon_vertex
statement:
theorem pinch_recon_vertex {I : OpenInterval} (i : Fin 2) (hi : S01.value i ∈ I) (v : Fin 2) :
    pinchRecon.hom.app I
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData DPx).ofVertex S01 i (DP.vertexLabel S01 i v), hi⟩ :
          (ofFiniteData DPx).heightPreimage S01 I)) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData DP).ofVertex S01 i v, hi⟩ :
        (ofFiniteData DP).heightPreimage S01 I)
proof:
:= by
  have hiA : S01.value i ∈ I ⊓ S01.J i := Set.mem_inter hi (S01.value_mem_J i)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (FP.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : I ⊓ S01.J i ≤ S01.J i))) :=
    (FP_isConstructibleAt.bijective (inf_le_right : I ⊓ S01.J i ≤ S01.J i) ⟨_, hiA⟩ fun k =>
      ⟨fun h => Set.mem_of_mem_inter_right h,
        fun h => Set.mem_inter ((S01.value_mem_J_iff.1 h) ▸ hi) h⟩).1
  have hA : pinchRecon.hom.app (I ⊓ S01.J i)
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData DPx).ofVertex S01 i (DP.vertexLabel S01 i v), hiA⟩ :
        (ofFiniteData DPx).heightPreimage S01 (I ⊓ S01.J i))) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData DP).ofVertex S01 i v, hiA⟩ :
        (ofFiniteData DP).heightPreimage S01 (I ⊓ S01.J i)) := by
    apply hinj
    exact (map_realizeExtractIso_hom_app_vertex FP_isConstructibleAt FP_isIntervalCosheaf
      inf_le_right hiA (DP.vertexLabel S01 i v)).trans (DP.vertexLabel_apply S01 i v)
  have key := NatTrans.naturality_apply pinchRecon.hom
    (homOfLE (inf_le_left : I ⊓ S01.J i ≤ I))
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData DPx).ofVertex S01 i (DP.vertexLabel S01 i v), hiA⟩ :
      (ofFiniteData DPx).heightPreimage S01 (I ⊓ S01.J i)))
  exact key.trans (congrArg (fun z => FP.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : I ⊓ S01.J i ≤ I)) z) hA)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleRepresentation.pinch_recon_strip
statement:
theorem pinch_recon_strip {I : OpenInterval} (t : (S01.K 0 : Set ℝ)) (ht : (t : ℝ) ∈ I)
    (y : Fin 2) :
    pinchRecon.hom.app I
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData DPx).ofStrip S01 0 (DP.edgeLabel S01 0 y, t), ht⟩ :
          (ofFiniteData DPx).heightPreimage S01 I)) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData DP).ofStrip S01 0 (y, t), ht⟩ :
        (ofFiniteData DP).heightPreimage S01 I)
proof:
:= by
  have htA : (t : ℝ) ∈ I ⊓ S01.K 0 := Set.mem_inter ht t.2
  have hinj : Function.Injective (FP.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right : I ⊓ S01.K 0 ≤ S01.K 0))) :=
    (FP_isConstructibleAt.bijective (inf_le_right : I ⊓ S01.K 0 ≤ S01.K 0) ⟨_, htA⟩ fun k =>
      iff_of_false (fun h => S01.value_notMem_K 0 k (Set.mem_of_mem_inter_right h))
        (S01.value_notMem_K 0 k)).1
  have hA : pinchRecon.hom.app (I ⊓ S01.K 0)
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData DPx).ofStrip S01 0 (DP.edgeLabel S01 0 y, t), htA⟩ :
        (ofFiniteData DPx).heightPreimage S01 (I ⊓ S01.K 0))) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData DP).ofStrip S01 0 (y, t), htA⟩ :
        (ofFiniteData DP).heightPreimage S01 (I ⊓ S01.K 0)) := by
    apply hinj
    exact (map_realizeExtractIso_hom_app_strip FP_isConstructibleAt FP_isIntervalCosheaf
      inf_le_right t htA (DP.edgeLabel S01 0 y)).trans (DP.edgeLabel_apply S01 0 t y)
  have key := NatTrans.naturality_apply pinchRecon.hom
    (homOfLE (inf_le_left : I ⊓ S01.K 0 ≤ I))
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData DPx).ofStrip S01 0 (DP.edgeLabel S01 0 y, t), htA⟩ :
      (ofFiniteData DPx).heightPreimage S01 (I ⊓ S01.K 0)))
  exact key.trans (congrArg (fun z => FP.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : I ⊓ S01.K 0 ≤ I)) z) hA)

          K0_le_ioi t.2⟩ : (ofFiniteData DPx).heightPreimage S01 (ioi (-1)))) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(ofFiniteData DP).ofStrip S01 0 (y, t), K0_le_ioi t.2⟩ :
        (ofFiniteData DP).heightPreimage S01 (ioi (-1)))
proof:
:=
  pinch_recon_strip t (K0_le_ioi t.2) y

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleRepresentation.pinch_top_glue
statement:
theorem pinch_top_glue (y : Fin 2) :
    FP.map (homOfLE (le_top : S01.J 0 ≤ ⊤)) (DP.vertexLabel S01 0 (0 : Fin 2)) =
      FP.map (homOfLE (le_top : S01.J 1 ≤ ⊤)) (DP.vertexLabel S01 1 y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pinch_left_label y, ← pinch_right_label y, ← Functor.map_comp_apply,
    ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  exact congrArg (fun f => FP.map f (DP.edgeLabel S01 0 y)) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleRepresentation.pinch_reconstructed_top_glue
statement:
theorem pinch_reconstructed_top_glue (y : Fin 2) :
    (DPx.toCosheaf S01).map (homOfLE (le_top : S01.J 0 ≤ ⊤))
        (DPx.vertexLabel S01 0 (DP.vertexLabel S01 0 (0 : Fin 2))) =
      (DPx.toCosheaf S01).map (homOfLE (le_top : S01.J 1 ≤ ⊤))
        (DPx.vertexLabel S01 1 (DP.vertexLabel S01 1 y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pinch_reconstructed_left y]
  have hr : (DPx.toCosheaf S01).map (homOfLE (S01.K_le_J_succ 0))
      (DPx.edgeLabel S01 0 (DP.edgeLabel S01 0 y)) =
        DPx.vertexLabel S01 1 (DP.vertexLabel S01 1 y) :=
    (DPx.map_K_le_J_succ_edgeLabel S01 0 _).trans
      (congrArg (DPx.vertexLabel S01 1) (pinch_right_label y))
  rw [← hr, ← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp_apply]
  exact congrArg (fun f => (DPx.toCosheaf S01).map f (DPx.edgeLabel S01 0 (DP.edgeLabel S01 0 y)))
    (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleRepresentation.pinch_recon_top_glue
statement:
theorem pinch_recon_top_glue (y : Fin 2) :
    pinchRecon.hom.app ⊤ ((DPx.toCosheaf S01).map (homOfLE (le_top : S01.J 0 ≤ ⊤))
        (DPx.vertexLabel S01 0 (DP.vertexLabel S01 0 (0 : Fin 2)))) =
      FP.map (homOfLE (le_top : S01.J 1 ≤ ⊤)) (DP.vertexLabel S01 1 y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [NatTrans.naturality_apply, pinch_recon_J0]
  exact pinch_top_glue y

name: TDA.Reeb.edist_uniformFun_ofFun_eq_iSup
statement:
theorem edist_uniformFun_ofFun_eq_iSup (f g : X → ℝ) :
    edist (UniformFun.ofFun f) (UniformFun.ofFun g) = ⨆ x, ENNReal.ofReal |f x - g x|
proof:
:= by
  simp only [UniformFun.edist_def, UniformFun.toFun_ofFun, edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]

name: TDA.Reeb.edist_uniformFun_ofFun_le_coe_iff
statement:
theorem edist_uniformFun_ofFun_le_coe_iff {f g : X → ℝ} {ε : ℝ≥0} :
    edist (UniformFun.ofFun f) (UniformFun.ofFun g) ≤ ε ↔ ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  simp only [UniformFun.edist_le, UniformFun.toFun_ofFun, edist_le_coe, Real.nndist_eq,
    ← NNReal.coe_le_coe, Real.coe_nnabs]

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_le_edist
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_le_edist (f g : C(X, ℝ)) :
    interleavingDistance (intervalComponents f) (intervalComponents g) ≤
      edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑f) (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑g)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases htop : edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑f) (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑g) = ⊤
  · rw [htop]
    exact le_top
  · rw [← ENNReal.coe_toNNReal htop]
    exact interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_le
      (edist_uniformFun_ofFun_le_coe_iff.1 (ENNReal.coe_toNNReal htop).ge)

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_smoothing_intervalComponents_le_edist

theorem interleavingDistance_smoothing_intervalComponents_le_edist (f g : C(X, ℝ)) (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    interleavingDistance ((smoothing δ).obj (intervalComponents f))
      ((smoothing δ).obj (intervalComponents g)) ≤
      edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑f) (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑g)
proof:
:=
  (interleavingDistance_smoothing_le δ _ _).trans
    (interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_le_edist f g)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.constructibleShiftMap_unit
statement:
theorem constructibleShiftMap_unit (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : RGraphCat) :
    constructibleShiftMap ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app A) =
      (constructibleSmoothingUnit ε).app (cosheafFunctor.obj A)
proof:
