name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_comp
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_comp
    (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (A : RGraphCat) :
    cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app A) ≫
        (geometricSmoothingComparisonIso (ε + δ)).hom.app A =
      (geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app ((geometricSmoothing δ).obj A) ≫
        (constructibleSmoothing ε).map ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso δ).hom.app A) ≫
        (constructibleSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj A)
proof:
:= by
  apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
  simp only [ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory.comp_hom, constructibleSmoothing_map_hom,
    constructibleSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom]
  exact cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app ε δ A

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_compIso
statement:
theorem geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_compIso (ε δ : ℝ≥0) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom cosheafFunctor ≫
        (geometricSmoothingComparisonIso (ε + δ)).hom =
      Functor.whiskerLeft (geometricSmoothing δ) (geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerRight (geometricSmoothingComparisonIso δ).hom (constructibleSmoothing ε) ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft cosheafFunctor (constructibleSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext A : 2
  exact cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_comp ε δ A

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.constructibleShiftMap_comp
statement:
theorem constructibleShiftMap_comp (φ : A ⟶ (geometricSmoothing ε).obj B)
    (ψ : B ⟶ (geometricSmoothing δ).obj D) :
    constructibleShiftMap (φ ≫ (geometricSmoothing ε).map ψ ≫
        (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app D) =
      constructibleShiftMap φ ≫ (constructibleSmoothing ε).map (constructibleShiftMap ψ) ≫
        (constructibleSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj D)
proof:
:= by
  unfold constructibleShiftMap
  have hnat :
      cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothing ε).map ψ) ≫
          (geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app ((geometricSmoothing δ).obj D) =
        (geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app B ≫
          (constructibleSmoothing ε).map (cosheafFunctor.map ψ) :=
    (geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.naturality ψ
  simp only [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_comp, reassoc_of% hnat]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafShiftMap_comp_of_constructible
statement:
theorem cosheafShiftMap_comp_of_constructible (φ : A ⟶ (geometricSmoothing ε).obj B)
    (ψ : B ⟶ (geometricSmoothing δ).obj D) :
    cosheafShiftMap (φ ≫ (geometricSmoothing ε).map ψ ≫
        (geometricSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app D) =
      cosheafShiftMap φ ≫ (smoothing ε).map (cosheafShiftMap ψ) ≫
        (smoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj D).obj
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom) (constructibleShiftMap_comp φ ψ)

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.range_map_subset_range_ψ
statement:
theorem range_map_subset_range_ψ (i : Interleaving ε F G) (I : OpenInterval) :
    range (F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I))))) ⊆
      range (i.ψ.app (thicken ε I))
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨i.φ.app I x, ?_⟩
  simpa only [types_comp_apply] using congrArg (fun f => f x) (i.φ_ψ_app I)

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.card_range_map_le
statement:
theorem card_range_map_le (i : Interleaving ε F G) (I : OpenInterval)
    [Finite (G.obj (thicken ε I))] :
    Nat.card (range (F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I)))))) ≤
      Nat.card (G.obj (thicken ε I))
proof:
:=
  (Nat.card_mono (finite_range _) (i.range_map_subset_range_ψ I)).trans
    (Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective _ rangeFactorization_surjective)

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.card_range_map_add_le
statement:
theorem card_range_map_add_le (i : Interleaving ε F G) (I : OpenInterval)
    [Finite (G.obj (thicken ε I))] :
    Nat.card (range (F.map (homOfLE (le_thicken (ε + ε) I)))) ≤ Nat.card (G.obj (thicken ε I))
proof:
:= by
  let k : thicken ε (thicken ε I) ⟶ thicken (ε + ε) I := homOfLE (thicken_thicken' ε ε I).le
  have hsub : range (F.map (homOfLE (le_thicken (ε + ε) I))) ⊆
      range (fun y => F.map k (i.ψ.app (thicken ε I) y)) := by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨i.φ.app I x, ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun f => f x)
      ((i.φ_ψ_app_assoc I (F.map k)).trans
        (map_comp_map_of_interval F _ k (homOfLE (le_thicken (ε + ε) I))))
    simpa only [types_comp_apply] using h
  exact (Nat.card_mono (finite_range _) hsub).trans
    (Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective _ rangeFactorization_surjective)

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.finite_of_injective
statement:
theorem finite_of_injective (i : Interleaving ε F G) {I : OpenInterval}
    (h : Function.Injective
      (F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I))))))
    [Finite (G.obj (thicken ε I))] : Finite (F.obj I)
proof:
:=
  Finite.of_injective _ (i.φ_app_injective h)

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.card_le_of_injective
statement:
theorem card_le_of_injective (i : Interleaving ε F G) {I : OpenInterval}
    (h : Function.Injective
      (F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I))))))
    [Finite (G.obj (thicken ε I))] : Nat.card (F.obj I) ≤ Nat.card (G.obj (thicken ε I))
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ (i.φ_app_injective h)

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.isEmpty_of_card_lt_card_range
statement:
theorem isEmpty_of_card_lt_card_range {I : OpenInterval} [Finite (G.obj (thicken ε I))]
    (hc : Nat.card (G.obj (thicken ε I)) <
      Nat.card (range (F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I))))))) :
    IsEmpty (Interleaving ε F G)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun i => (i.card_range_map_le I).not_gt hc⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.le_interleavingDistance_of_forall_exists_card_lt
statement:
theorem le_interleavingDistance_of_forall_exists_card_lt {r : ℝ≥0∞}
    (h : ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < r → ∃ I : OpenInterval,
      Function.Injective
        (F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I))))) ∧
      Finite (G.obj (thicken ε I)) ∧ Nat.card (G.obj (thicken ε I)) < Nat.card (F.obj I)) :
    r ≤ interleavingDistance F G
proof:
:= by
  refine le_interleavingDistance_iff.2 fun ε ⟨i⟩ => le_of_not_gt fun hε => ?_
  obtain ⟨I, hinj, hfin, hc⟩ := h ε hε
  exact (Interleaving.isEmpty_of_injective_of_card_lt hinj hc).false i

name: TDA.Reeb.le_interleavingDistance_of_forall_exists_card_lt_symm
statement:
theorem le_interleavingDistance_of_forall_exists_card_lt_symm {r : ℝ≥0∞}
    (h : ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < r → ∃ I : OpenInterval,
      Function.Injective
        (G.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I))))) ∧
      Finite (F.obj (thicken ε I)) ∧ Nat.card (F.obj (thicken ε I)) < Nat.card (G.obj I)) :
    r ≤ interleavingDistance F G
proof:
:= by
  rw [interleavingDistance_comm]
  exact le_interleavingDistance_of_forall_exists_card_lt h

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_eq_top_of_card_ne
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_eq_top_of_card_ne (h : Nat.card (F.obj ⊤) ≠ Nat.card (G.obj ⊤)) :
    interleavingDistance F G = ⊤
proof:
:=
  interleavingDistance_eq_top_iff.2 fun _ => ⟨fun i => h (Nat.card_congr i.topEquiv)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_top_of_card_ne
statement:
theorem RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_top_of_card_ne {A B : RGraph.RGraphCat}
    (h : Nat.card ((RGraph.cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj.obj ⊤) ≠
      Nat.card ((RGraph.cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj.obj ⊤)) :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance A B = ⊤
proof:
:=
  RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_top_of_isEmpty_equiv ⟨fun e => h (Nat.card_congr e)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.deleteVertexInclusion_vertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem deleteVertexInclusion_vertex (ℓ : V) (v : ({ℓ}ᶜ : Set V)) :
    deleteVertexInclusion G ℓ (vertex _ v) = vertex G v
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.deleteVertexInclusion_edgePoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem deleteVertexInclusion_edgePoint (ℓ : V) (d : (G.induce ({ℓ}ᶜ : Set V)).Dart)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    deleteVertexInclusion G ℓ (edgePoint _ d t) =
      edgePoint G ⟨(d.fst.1, d.snd.1), d.adj⟩ t
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.collapseEdge_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  simp [collapseEdge, h₁, h₂]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.collapseEdge_of_not
statement:
private theorem collapseEdge_of_not (d : G.Dart) (h : ¬ (d.fst ≠ ℓ ∧ d.snd ≠ ℓ))
    (t : unitInterval) : collapseEdge hadj d t = vertex _ ⟨m, hadj.ne'⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp only [collapseEdge, dif_neg h, ContinuousMap.const_apply]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.collapseEdge_symm
statement:
private theorem collapseEdge_symm (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    collapseEdge hadj d.symm (σ t) = collapseEdge hadj d t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : d.fst ≠ ℓ ∧ d.snd ≠ ℓ
  · rw [collapseEdge_of_ne hadj d.symm h.2 h.1, collapseEdge_of_ne hadj d h.1 h.2]
    exact edgePoint_symm _ (restrictDart G d h.1 h.2) t
  · rw [collapseEdge_of_not hadj d.symm (fun h' => h ⟨h'.2, h'.1⟩), collapseEdge_of_not hadj d h]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.collapseEdge_zero
statement:
private theorem collapseEdge_zero (d : G.Dart) :
    collapseEdge hadj d 0 = collapseVertex hadj d.fst
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : d.fst ≠ ℓ ∧ d.snd ≠ ℓ
  · rw [collapseEdge_of_ne hadj d h.1 h.2, edgePoint_zero]
    simp [collapseVertex, h.1, restrictDart]
  · rw [collapseEdge_of_not hadj d h]
    by_cases hf : d.fst = ℓ
    · simp [collapseVertex, hf]
    · have hs : d.snd = ℓ := by
        by_contra hs
        exact h ⟨hf, hs⟩
      have hfm : d.fst = m := huniq d.fst (hs ▸ d.adj.symm)
      simp only [collapseVertex, dif_neg hf]
      exact congrArg (vertex _) (Subtype.ext hfm.symm)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.leafCollapse_vertex_self
statement:
theorem leafCollapse_vertex_self :
    leafCollapse hadj huniq (vertex G ℓ) = vertex _ ⟨m, hadj.ne'⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [leafCollapse, collapseVertex]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.leafCollapse_vertex_of_ne
statement:
theorem leafCollapse_vertex_of_ne {v : V} (h : v ≠ ℓ) :
    leafCollapse hadj huniq (vertex G v) = vertex _ ⟨v, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [leafCollapse, collapseVertex, h]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.leafCollapse_edgePoint_of_ne
statement:
theorem leafCollapse_edgePoint_of_ne (d : G.Dart) (h₁ : d.fst ≠ ℓ) (h₂ : d.snd ≠ ℓ)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    leafCollapse hadj huniq (edgePoint G d t) =
      edgePoint _ ⟨(⟨d.fst, h₁⟩, ⟨d.snd, h₂⟩), d.adj⟩ t
proof:
:=
  collapseEdge_of_ne hadj d h₁ h₂ t

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.leafCollapse_edgePoint_of_eq
statement:
theorem leafCollapse_edgePoint_of_eq (d : G.Dart) (h : d.fst = ℓ ∨ d.snd = ℓ)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    leafCollapse hadj huniq (edgePoint G d t) = vertex _ ⟨m, hadj.ne'⟩
proof:
:=
  collapseEdge_of_not hadj d (fun h' => h.elim h'.1 h'.2) t

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.leafCollapse_comp_deleteVertexInclusion
statement:
theorem leafCollapse_comp_deleteVertexInclusion :
    (leafCollapse hadj huniq).comp (deleteVertexInclusion G ℓ) = ContinuousMap.id _
proof:
:= by
  refine hom_ext _ (fun v => ?_) fun d t => ?_
  · exact leafCollapse_vertex_of_ne hadj huniq v.2
  · exact leafCollapse_edgePoint_of_ne hadj huniq ⟨(d.fst.1, d.snd.1), d.adj⟩ d.fst.2 d.snd.2 t

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.dart_eq_of_fst_eq
statement: private theorem dart_eq_of_fst_eq {d : G.Dart} (hd : d.fst = ℓ) : d = ⟨(ℓ, m), hadj⟩
proof:
:=
  Dart.ext _ _ (Prod.ext hd (huniq _ (hd ▸ d.adj)))

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.fst_eq_of_snd_eq
statement: private theorem fst_eq_of_snd_eq {d : G.Dart} (hd : d.snd = ℓ) : d.fst = m
proof:
:=
  huniq _ (hd ▸ d.adj.symm)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.slideParam_of_fst_eq
statement:
private theorem slideParam_of_fst_eq {d : G.Dart} (hd : d.fst = ℓ) (t s : unitInterval) :
    slideParam ℓ d (t, s) = σ (σ t * σ s)
proof:
:= by
  simp [slideParam, hd]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.slideParam_of_snd_eq
statement:
private theorem slideParam_of_snd_eq {d : G.Dart} (hd : d.snd = ℓ) (t s : unitInterval) :
    slideParam ℓ d (t, s) = t * σ s
proof:
:= by
  have hf : d.fst ≠ ℓ := fun hf => d.adj.ne (hf.trans hd.symm)
  simp [slideParam, hd, hf]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.slideParam_of_ne
statement:
private theorem slideParam_of_ne {d : G.Dart} (h₁ : d.fst ≠ ℓ) (h₂ : d.snd ≠ ℓ)
    (t s : unitInterval) : slideParam ℓ d (t, s) = t
proof:
:= by
  simp [slideParam, h₁, h₂]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.slideVertex_self
statement:
private theorem slideVertex_self (s : unitInterval) :
    slideVertex hadj ℓ s = edgePoint G ⟨(ℓ, m), hadj⟩ s
proof:
:= by
  simp [slideVertex]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.slideVertex_of_ne
statement:
private theorem slideVertex_of_ne {v : V} (h : v ≠ ℓ) (s : unitInterval) :
    slideVertex hadj v s = vertex G v
proof:
:= by
  simp [slideVertex, h]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.slideEdge_apply
statement:
private theorem slideEdge_apply (d : G.Dart) (t s : unitInterval) :
    slideEdge ℓ d t s = edgePoint G d (slideParam ℓ d (t, s))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.slideEdge_symm
statement:
private theorem slideEdge_symm (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    slideEdge ℓ d.symm (σ t) = slideEdge ℓ d t
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  rw [slideEdge_apply, slideEdge_apply]
  by_cases h₁ : d.fst = ℓ
  · rw [slideParam_of_snd_eq (d := d.symm) h₁, slideParam_of_fst_eq h₁,
      ← edgePoint_symm G d, symm_symm]
  · by_cases h₂ : d.snd = ℓ
    · rw [slideParam_of_fst_eq (d := d.symm) h₂, slideParam_of_snd_eq h₂, symm_symm,
        edgePoint_symm]
    · rw [slideParam_of_ne (d := d.symm) h₂ h₁, slideParam_of_ne h₁ h₂, edgePoint_symm]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.slideEdge_zero
statement: private theorem slideEdge_zero (d : G.Dart) : slideEdge ℓ d 0 = slideVertex hadj d.fst
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  rw [slideEdge_apply]
  by_cases h₁ : d.fst = ℓ
  · rw [slideParam_of_fst_eq h₁, symm_zero, one_mul, symm_symm, h₁, slideVertex_self,
      dart_eq_of_fst_eq hadj huniq h₁]
  · rw [slideVertex_of_ne hadj h₁]
    by_cases h₂ : d.snd = ℓ
    · rw [slideParam_of_snd_eq h₂, zero_mul, edgePoint_zero]
    · rw [slideParam_of_ne h₁ h₂, edgePoint_zero]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.slide_zero
statement: private theorem slide_zero (x : Realization G) : slide hadj huniq x 0 = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using ind G with
  | vertex v =>
    change slideVertex hadj v 0 = _
    by_cases h : v = ℓ
    · subst h
      rw [slideVertex_self, edgePoint_zero]
    · rw [slideVertex_of_ne hadj h]
  | edgePoint d t =>
    change slideEdge ℓ d t 0 = _
    rw [slideEdge_apply]
    by_cases h₁ : d.fst = ℓ
    · rw [slideParam_of_fst_eq h₁, symm_zero, mul_one, symm_symm]
    · by_cases h₂ : d.snd = ℓ
      · rw [slideParam_of_snd_eq h₂, symm_zero, mul_one]
      · rw [slideParam_of_ne h₁ h₂]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.slide_one
statement:
private theorem slide_one (x : Realization G) :
    slide hadj huniq x 1 = deleteVertexInclusion G ℓ (leafCollapse hadj huniq x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using ind G with
  | vertex v =>
    change slideVertex hadj v 1 = _
    by_cases h : v = ℓ
    · subst h
      rw [slideVertex_self, edgePoint_one, leafCollapse_vertex_self, deleteVertexInclusion_vertex]
    · rw [slideVertex_of_ne hadj h, leafCollapse_vertex_of_ne hadj huniq h,
        deleteVertexInclusion_vertex]
  | edgePoint d t =>
    change slideEdge ℓ d t 1 = _
    rw [slideEdge_apply]
    by_cases h₁ : d.fst = ℓ
    · rw [slideParam_of_fst_eq h₁, symm_one, mul_zero, symm_zero, edgePoint_one,
        leafCollapse_edgePoint_of_eq hadj huniq d (.inl h₁), deleteVertexInclusion_vertex,
        dart_eq_of_fst_eq hadj huniq h₁]
    · by_cases h₂ : d.snd = ℓ
      · rw [slideParam_of_snd_eq h₂, symm_one, mul_zero, edgePoint_zero,
          leafCollapse_edgePoint_of_eq hadj huniq d (.inr h₂), deleteVertexInclusion_vertex,
          fst_eq_of_snd_eq huniq h₂]
      · rw [slideParam_of_ne h₁ h₂, leafCollapse_edgePoint_of_ne hadj huniq d h₁ h₂,
          deleteVertexInclusion_edgePoint]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.leafHomotopy_vertex_self
statement:
theorem leafHomotopy_vertex_self (s : unitInterval) :
    leafHomotopy hadj huniq (s, vertex G ℓ) = edgePoint G ⟨(ℓ, m), hadj⟩ s
proof:
:=
  slideVertex_self hadj s

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.leafHomotopy_vertex_of_ne
statement:
theorem leafHomotopy_vertex_of_ne {v : V} (h : v ≠ ℓ) (s : unitInterval) :
    leafHomotopy hadj huniq (s, vertex G v) = vertex G v
proof:
:=
  slideVertex_of_ne hadj h s

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.leafHomotopy_edgePoint_of_fst_eq
statement:
theorem leafHomotopy_edgePoint_of_fst_eq {d : G.Dart} (hd : d.fst = ℓ) (s t : unitInterval) :
    leafHomotopy hadj huniq (s, edgePoint G d t) = edgePoint G d (σ (σ t * σ s))
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (edgePoint G d) (slideParam_of_fst_eq hd t s) :)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.leafHomotopy_edgePoint_of_snd_eq
statement:
theorem leafHomotopy_edgePoint_of_snd_eq {d : G.Dart} (hd : d.snd = ℓ) (s t : unitInterval) :
    leafHomotopy hadj huniq (s, edgePoint G d t) = edgePoint G d (t * σ s)
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (edgePoint G d) (slideParam_of_snd_eq hd t s) :)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.leafHomotopy_edgePoint_of_ne
statement:
theorem leafHomotopy_edgePoint_of_ne {d : G.Dart} (h₁ : d.fst ≠ ℓ) (h₂ : d.snd ≠ ℓ)
    (s t : unitInterval) : leafHomotopy hadj huniq (s, edgePoint G d t) = edgePoint G d t
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (edgePoint G d) (slideParam_of_ne h₁ h₂ t s) :)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.contractibleSpace_realization_of_isTree
statement:
theorem contractibleSpace_realization_of_isTree [Finite V] (h : G.IsTree) :
    ContractibleSpace (Realization G)
proof:
:= by
  suffices key : ∀ (n : ℕ) {V : Type u} [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V), Nat.card V = n + 1 →
      G.IsTree → ContractibleSpace (Realization G) by
    have hpos : 0 < Nat.card V := Finite.card_pos_iff.2 h.connected.nonempty
    exact key (Nat.card V - 1) G (by omega) h
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro V _ G hcard h
    have : Subsingleton V := Finite.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.1 hcard.le
    have : Nonempty V := h.connected.nonempty
    have : Subsingleton (Realization G) := by
      refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
      have key : ∀ z : Realization G, z = vertex G (Classical.arbitrary V) := fun z => by
        induction z using ind G with
        | vertex v => exact congrArg _ (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
        | edgePoint d t => exact (d.adj.ne (Subsingleton.elim _ _)).elim
      rw [key x, key y]
    infer_instance
  | succ n ih =>
    intro V _ G hcard h
    classical
    have : Nontrivial V := Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial.1 (by omega)
    have : G.LocallyFinite := fun _ => Fintype.ofFinite _
    obtain ⟨ℓ, -, -, hdeg, -⟩ := h.exists_ne_and_degree_eq_one
    obtain ⟨m, hadj, huniq⟩ := degree_eq_one_iff_existsUnique_adj.1 hdeg
    have htree : (G.induce ({ℓ}ᶜ : Set V)).IsTree :=
      ⟨h.connected.induce_compl_singleton_of_degree_eq_one hdeg, h.isAcyclic.induce _⟩
    have hcard' : Nat.card ({ℓ}ᶜ : Set V) = n + 1 := by
      rw [Nat.card_coe_set_eq]
      exact Set.ncard_compl_of_ncard_eq_add _ (by rw [Set.ncard_singleton]; omega)
    have := ih (G.induce ({ℓ}ᶜ : Set V)) hcard' htree
    exact (leafHomotopyEquiv hadj huniq).contractibleSpace

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.simplyConnectedSpace_realization_of_isTree
statement:
theorem simplyConnectedSpace_realization_of_isTree [Finite V] (h : G.IsTree) :
    SimplyConnectedSpace (Realization G)
proof:
:=
  have := contractibleSpace_realization_of_isTree G h
  inferInstance

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.isTree_iff_simplyConnectedSpace_realization
statement:
theorem isTree_iff_simplyConnectedSpace_realization [Finite V] :
    G.IsTree ↔ SimplyConnectedSpace (Realization G)
proof:
:=
  ⟨simplyConnectedSpace_realization_of_isTree G, isTree_of_simplyConnectedSpace G⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphTreeContraction.isTree_iff_contractibleSpace_realization
statement:
theorem isTree_iff_contractibleSpace_realization [Finite V] :
    G.IsTree ↔ ContractibleSpace (Realization G)
proof:
:=
  ⟨contractibleSpace_realization_of_isTree G, fun _ =>
    isTree_of_simplyConnectedSpace G inferInstance⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.IsConstructibleAt.smoothing
statement:
theorem IsConstructibleAt.smoothing {F : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u} (hF : S.IsConstructibleAt F)
    (ε : ℝ≥0) : (S.shifted ε).IsConstructibleAt ((TDA.Reeb.smoothing ε).obj F) where
  finite I
proof:
:= hF.finite (thicken ε I)
  bijective I J h hI hhit :=
    hF.bijective (thicken_mono h) (hI.mono (OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 (le_thicken ε I)))
      (S.value_mem_thicken_iff_of_shifted ε h hI hhit)
  isEmpty_lowerTail := by
    change IsEmpty (F.obj (thicken ε (iio ((S.shifted ε).value 0))))
    rw [S.shifted_value_zero ε, thicken_iio, sub_add_cancel]
    exact hF.isEmpty_lowerTail
  isEmpty_upperTail := by
    change IsEmpty (F.obj (thicken ε (ioi ((S.shifted ε).value (Fin.last _)))))
    rw [S.shifted_value_last ε, thicken_ioi, add_sub_cancel_right]
    exact hF.isEmpty_upperTail

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.isConstructibleAt_shifted_zero_iff
statement:
theorem isConstructibleAt_shifted_zero_iff {F : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u} :
    (S.shifted 0).IsConstructibleAt F ↔ S.IsConstructibleAt F
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h.of_refines (S.range_shifted_zero).le,
    fun h => h.of_refines (S.range_shifted_zero).ge⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.IsConstructibleCosheaf.smoothing
statement:
theorem smoothing {F : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u} (hF : IsConstructibleCosheaf F) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    IsConstructibleCosheaf ((TDA.Reeb.smoothing ε).obj F)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hc, n, S, hS⟩ := hF
  exact of_isConstructibleAt (hS.smoothing ε) (isIntervalCosheaf_smoothing hc ε)

name: TDA.Reeb.constructibleSmoothing_comp_ι

name: TDA.Reeb.constructibleSmoothing_map_hom_app

name: TDA.Reeb.constructibleSmoothingUnit_app_hom

@[simp] theorem constructibleSmoothingUnit_app_hom (ε : ℝ≥0) (G : ConstructibleCosheafCat.{u}) :

@[simp] theorem constructibleSmoothingZeroIso_hom_app_hom (G : ConstructibleCosheafCat.{u}) :

@[simp] theorem constructibleSmoothingZeroIso_inv_app_hom (G : ConstructibleCosheafCat.{u}) :

name: TDA.Reeb.constructibleSmoothingUnit_zero

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricSmoothing_comp_ι
statement:
theorem geometricSmoothing_comp_ι (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    geometricSmoothing ε ⋙ IsRGraph.ι =
      IsRGraph.ι ⋙ GeometricThickening.functor ε ⋙ ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricSmoothing_comp_cosheafFunctor_comp_ι
statement:
theorem geometricSmoothing_comp_cosheafFunctor_comp_ι (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    geometricSmoothing ε ⋙ cosheafFunctor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι IsConstructibleCosheaf.{0} =
      IsRGraph.ι ⋙ GeometricThickening.functor ε ⋙ ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ ⋙

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.thickeningCosheafComparisonIso_hom_app_hom
statement:
theorem thickeningCosheafComparisonIso_hom_app_hom (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : RGraphCat) :
    ((thickeningCosheafComparisonIso ε).hom.app A).hom =
      (GeometricThickening.componentComparisonNatIso ε).hom.app A.obj
proof:

theorem geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : RGraphCat)
    (I : OpenInterval)
    (z : {z : A.obj.left × GeometricThickening.Band ε //
      GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap A.obj) ε z ∈ I}) :
    ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app A).hom.app I
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ z.1, z.2⟩ :
          {q : ReebQuotient (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap A.obj) ε) //
            ReebQuotient.height _ q ∈ I})) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨z.1.1, GeometricThickening.fst_mem_thicken z.2⟩ :
        {x : A.obj.left // overBaseMap A.obj x ∈ thicken ε I})
proof:
:=
  ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (NatTrans.congr_app
    (intervalComponentComparison_comp_geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom ε A) I)
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk z)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingUnit_comp_geometricSmoothingComparisonIso
statement:
theorem cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingUnit_comp_geometricSmoothingComparisonIso
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : RGraphCat) :
    cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingUnit ε).app A) ≫
        (geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app A =
      (constructibleSmoothingUnit ε).app (cosheafFunctor.obj A)
proof:
:= by
  ext1
  refine Eq.trans (congrArg (· ≫ ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso ε).hom.app A).hom)
    (intervalComponentsOver.map_comp ((GeometricThickening.zeroSectionNatTrans ε).app A.obj)
      ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj A.obj)))) ?_
  refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
  exact (congrArg
    (intervalComponentsOver.map ((GeometricThickening.zeroSectionNatTrans ε).app A.obj) ≫ ·)
    (Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc constructibleComponentComparisonIso
      ((thickeningToConstructible ε).obj A)
      ((GeometricThickening.componentComparisonNatIso ε).hom.app A.obj))).trans
    (GeometricThickening.map_zeroSectionNatTrans_comp_componentComparisonNatIso ε A.obj)

        {y : A.obj.left // overBaseMap A.obj y ∈ thicken ε I})

  ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (NatTrans.congr_app
    (intervalComponentsOver_map_geometricSmoothingUnit_comp ε A) I) (ZerothHomotopy.mk x)

statement:

    (ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app ((GeometricThickening.functor 0).obj A.obj) ≫
        (geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app A).hom =
      GeometricThickening.zeroIso.hom.app A.obj
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app ((𝟭 (Over (TopCat.of ℝ))).obj A.obj) ≫
      projNatIso.inv.app A = 𝟙 _ :=
    projNatIso.hom_inv_id_app A
  rw [geometricSmoothingZeroIso_hom_app_hom, ← Category.assoc,
    ← (ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).naturality, Category.assoc, hp, Category.comp_id]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingZeroIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingZeroIso_hom_app (A : RGraphCat) :
    cosheafFunctor.map (geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app A) =
      (geometricSmoothingComparisonIso 0).hom.app A ≫
        constructibleSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app (cosheafFunctor.obj A)
proof:
:= by
  ext1
  apply (cancel_epi
    (constructibleComponentComparisonIso.hom.app ((thickeningToConstructible 0).obj A))).1
  refine ((intervalComponentsOver.map_comp
    ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app ((GeometricThickening.functor 0).obj A.obj))
    (geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom.app A).hom).symm.trans
      ((congrArg intervalComponentsOver.map
        (projNatTrans_app_comp_geometricSmoothingZeroIso_hom_app_hom A)).trans
        (GeometricThickening.map_zeroIso_hom_app A.obj))).trans ?_
  refine (Iso.hom_inv_id_app_assoc constructibleComponentComparisonIso
    ((thickeningToConstructible 0).obj A) _).symm.trans ?_
  exact congrArg
    (constructibleComponentComparisonIso.hom.app ((thickeningToConstructible 0).obj A) ≫ ·)
    (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricSmoothingUnit_zero
statement: theorem geometricSmoothingUnit_zero : geometricSmoothingUnit 0 = geometricSmoothingZeroIso.inv
proof:
:= by
  have h : geometricSmoothingUnit 0 ≫ geometricSmoothingZeroIso.hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    ext A : 2
    apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
    refine (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg ((GeometricThickening.zeroSectionNatTrans 0).app A.obj ≫ ·)
      (projNatTrans_app_comp_geometricSmoothingZeroIso_hom_app_hom A)).trans ?_
    rw [← GeometricThickening.zeroIso_inv]
    exact GeometricThickening.zeroIso.inv_hom_id_app A.obj
  rw [← Category.id_comp geometricSmoothingZeroIso.inv, ← h, Category.assoc, Iso.hom_inv_id,
    Category.comp_id]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricSmoothInterleaving.smoothed_edgeMid_isEmpty
statement:
theorem smoothed_edgeMid_isEmpty (ε : ℝ≥0) (hε : (ε : ℝ) < 1 / 2) :
    IsEmpty
      (GeometricInterleaving ε ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj singleGraph)
        ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj midGraph))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_⟩
  have hupper : ∀ q : ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj
      ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj midGraph)).obj.left,
      overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing ε).obj
        ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj midGraph)).obj q ≤ 3 / 4 + (ε : ℝ) := by
    intro q
    obtain ⟨⟨y, t⟩, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective _ q
    show overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj midGraph).obj y + (t : ℝ) ≤
      3 / 4 + (ε : ℝ)
    have hy := height_smoothed_mid_mem quarter y
    rcases hy with ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩
    norm_num [coe_quarter] at hy₂
    linarith [hy₂, t.2.2]
  let q : ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj singleGraph).obj.left :=
    ReebQuotient.mk _
      (edgeTop, ⟨(quarter : ℝ), right_mem_Icc.2 (GeometricThickening.neg_le_band quarter)⟩)
  have h := hupper (i.φ.hom.left.hom q)
  rw [overBaseMap_comm i.φ.hom q] at h
  change overBaseMap singleGraph.obj edgeTop + (quarter : ℝ) ≤
      3 / 4 + (ε : ℝ) at h
  rw [height_edgeTop] at h
  norm_num [coe_quarter] at h
  linarith

proof:

  · rw [← coe_halfNN_ennreal]

  · rw [← coe_halfNN_ennreal, ENNReal.coe_le_coe, ← NNReal.coe_le_coe, coe_halfNN]
    by_contra h
    exact (smoothed_edgeMid_isEmpty ε (not_le.1 h)).false i

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleGeometricInterleaving.not_nonempty_interval_iso_point
statement: theorem not_nonempty_interval_iso_point : ¬ Nonempty (intervalSpace ≅ pointSpace)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e⟩
  have hinv : ∀ x : intervalSpace.obj.left,
      e.inv.hom.left.hom (e.hom.hom.left.hom x) = x := fun x =>
    congrArg (fun φ : intervalSpace ⟶ intervalSpace => φ.hom.left.hom x) e.hom_inv_id
  have hinj : Function.Injective e.hom.hom.left.hom := by
    intro x y hxy
    calc
      x = e.inv.hom.left.hom (e.hom.hom.left.hom x) := (hinv x).symm
      _ = e.inv.hom.left.hom (e.hom.hom.left.hom y) := congrArg _ hxy
      _ = y := hinv y
  have hpoint : Subsingleton pointGraph.obj.left := by
    have : Subsingleton ((ofFiniteData pt0).V 0) := inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton Unit)
    exact (homeomorphZero S0 (ofFiniteData pt0)).symm.injective.subsingleton
  apply interval_ofVertex_zero_ne_one
  apply hinj
  exact @Subsingleton.elim pointGraph.obj.left hpoint _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleGeometricInterleaving.constructibleInterleavingDistance_const_zero_one_le
statement:
theorem constructibleInterleavingDistance_const_zero_one_le :
    constructibleInterleavingDistance
        ⟨_, constZero_isConstructibleSpace⟩
        ⟨_, constOne_isConstructibleSpace⟩ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine (constructibleInterleavingDistance_le_edist
    constZero_isConstructibleSpace constOne_isConstructibleSpace).trans ?_
  rw [← ENNReal.coe_one]
  exact edist_uniformFun_ofFun_le_coe_iff.2 (by
    intro x
    norm_num)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.eq_of_walk
statement:
theorem eq_of_walk {W : Type*} {H : SimpleGraph W} {β : Sort*} {f : W → β}
    (hf : ∀ x y, H.Adj x y → f x = f y) {x y : W} (p : H.Walk x y) : f x = f y
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hadj _ ih => exact (hf _ _ hadj).trans ih

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellGraph_adj_inl_inr
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellGraph_adj_inr_inl
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.not_cellGraph_adj_inl_inl
statement:
theorem not_cellGraph_adj_inl_inl {v w : {v : V // h v ∈ I}} :

proof: := id

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.not_cellGraph_adj_inr_inr
statement:
theorem not_cellGraph_adj_inr_inr {e e' : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h I e}} :
    ¬ (cellGraph G h I).Adj (Sum.inr e) (Sum.inr e')
proof: := id

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellGraph_isBipartiteWith
statement:
theorem cellGraph_isBipartiteWith :
    (cellGraph G h I).IsBipartiteWith (range Sum.inl) (range Sum.inr)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Set.disjoint_left.2 ?_, fun ⦃x y⦄ hxy => ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩ ⟨e, he⟩
    exact Sum.inr_ne_inl he
  · rcases x with v | e <;> rcases y with w | e'
    · exact (hxy : False).elim
    · exact .inl ⟨⟨v, rfl⟩, ⟨e', rfl⟩⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨⟨e, rfl⟩, ⟨w, rfl⟩⟩
    · exact (hxy : False).elim

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr
statement:
theorem connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr {v : {v : V // h v ∈ I}}
    {e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h I e}} (hv : (v : V) ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V)) :
    (cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl v) =
      (cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr e)
proof:
:=
  ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj hv

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellInclusion_inl

@[simp] theorem cellInclusion_inl {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (v : {v : V // h v ∈ I}) :
    cellInclusion G h hIJ (Sum.inl v) = Sum.inl ⟨v.1, OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 hIJ v.2⟩
proof:
:=

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellInclusion_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem cellInclusion_inr {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h I e}) :
    cellInclusion G h hIJ (Sum.inr e) = Sum.inr ⟨e.1, e.2.mono hIJ⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellInclusion_refl
statement: theorem cellInclusion_refl (I : OpenInterval) : cellInclusion G h (le_refl I) = Hom.id

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellInclusion_comp

theorem cellInclusion_comp {I J K : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hJK : J ≤ K) :
    (cellInclusion G h hJK).comp (cellInclusion G h hIJ) = cellInclusion G h (hIJ.trans hJK)
proof:
:=
  RelHom.ext fun x => by cases x <;> rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellComponentFunctor_obj
statement:
theorem cellComponentFunctor_obj (I : OpenInterval) :
    (cellComponentFunctor G h).obj I = (cellGraph G h I).ConnectedComponent
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellComponentFunctor_map_apply

theorem cellComponentFunctor_map_apply {I J : OpenInterval} (i : I ⟶ J)
    (c : (cellGraph G h I).ConnectedComponent) :
    (cellComponentFunctor G h).map i c = c.map (cellInclusion G h (leOfHom i))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.vertexLabel_of_mem
statement:
private theorem vertexLabel_of_mem {v : V} (hv : h v ∈ I) :
    vertexLabel G h I v = some ((cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨v, hv⟩))
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexLabel, dif_pos hv]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edgeLabel_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeLabel, dif_pos ht]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edgeLabel_symm
statement:
private theorem edgeLabel_symm (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    edgeLabel G h I d.symm (σ t) = edgeLabel G h I d t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ I
  · have ht' : dartHeight h d.symm (σ t) ∈ I := by rwa [dartHeight_symm]
    rw [edgeLabel_of_mem G h I ht, edgeLabel_of_mem G h I ht']
    have he : (⟨dartEdge d.symm, edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem ht'⟩ :
        {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h I e}) = ⟨dartEdge d, edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem ht⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext (dartEdge_symm d)
    rw [he]
  · have ht' : dartHeight h d.symm (σ t) ∉ I := by rwa [dartHeight_symm]
    rw [edgeLabel, edgeLabel, dif_neg ht, dif_neg ht']

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.edgeLabel_zero
statement: private theorem edgeLabel_zero (d : G.Dart) : edgeLabel G h I d 0 = vertexLabel G h I d.fst
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv : h d.fst ∈ I
  · have ht : dartHeight h d 0 ∈ I := by rwa [dartHeight_zero]
    rw [edgeLabel_of_mem G h I ht, vertexLabel_of_mem G h I hv]
    exact congrArg some
      (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr G h I (v := ⟨d.fst, hv⟩) (fst_mem_dartEdge d)).symm
  · have ht : dartHeight h d 0 ∉ I := by rwa [dartHeight_zero]
    rw [edgeLabel, vertexLabel, dif_neg ht, dif_neg hv]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.isSome_optionLabel
statement:
theorem isSome_optionLabel {p : Realization G} (hp : plHeight G h p ∈ I) :
    (optionLabel G h I p).isSome
proof:
:= by
  induction p using ind G with
  | vertex v =>
    show (vertexLabel G h I v).isSome
    rw [vertexLabel_of_mem G h I hp]
    rfl
  | edgePoint d t =>
    show (edgeLabel G h I d t).isSome
    rw [edgeLabel_of_mem G h I hp]
    rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.some_preimageLabel
statement:
theorem some_preimageLabel (p : {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ I}) :
    some (preimageLabel G h I p) = optionLabel G h I p.1
proof:
:=
  Option.some_get _

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.preimageLabel_vertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem preimageLabel_vertex (v : V) (hv : h v ∈ I) :
    preimageLabel G h I ⟨vertex G v, hv⟩ =
      (cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨v, hv⟩)
proof:
:=
  Option.some_injective _ ((some_preimageLabel G h I _).trans (vertexLabel_of_mem G h I hv))

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.preimageLabel_edgePoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem preimageLabel_edgePoint (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval)
    (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ I) :
    preimageLabel G h I ⟨edgePoint G d t, ht⟩ =
      (cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk
        (Sum.inr ⟨dartEdge d, edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem ht⟩)
proof:
:=
  Option.some_injective _ ((some_preimageLabel G h I _).trans (edgeLabel_of_mem G h I ht))

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.isLocallyConstant_preimageLabel
statement: theorem isLocallyConstant_preimageLabel : IsLocallyConstant (preimageLabel G h I)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : TopologicalSpace (cellGraph G h I).ConnectedComponent := ⊥
  have _ : DiscreteTopology (cellGraph G h I).ConnectedComponent := ⟨rfl⟩
  have hU : IsOpen (plHeight G h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ)) := I.isOpen.preimage (plHeight G h).continuous
  have hq := (isQuotientMap_quotMk G).restrictPreimage_isOpen hU
  refine (IsLocallyConstant.iff_continuous _).2 (hq.continuous_iff.2 ?_)
  refine IsLocallyConstant.continuous ((IsLocallyConstant.iff_exists_open _).2 ?_)
  let _ : TopologicalSpace V := ⊥
  rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
  rcases c with v | ⟨d, t⟩
  · refine ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' {Sum.inl v},
      (isOpen_vertexCell G v).preimage continuous_subtype_val, rfl, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨c', hc'⟩ (hmem : c' = Sum.inl v)
    subst hmem
    rfl
  · have hd := @isOpen_range_sigmaMk G.Dart (fun _ => unitInterval) _ d
    refine ⟨Subtype.val ⁻¹' (Sum.inr '' range (Sigma.mk d)),
      (isOpenMap_inr (X := V) _ hd).preimage continuous_subtype_val, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact ⟨⟨d, t⟩, ⟨t, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨c', hc'⟩ ⟨_, ⟨s, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact (preimageLabel_edgePoint G h I d s hc').trans
        (preimageLabel_edgePoint G h I d t hc).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.preimageLabel_eq_of_joined
statement:
theorem preimageLabel_eq_of_joined {x y : {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ I}}
    (hxy : Joined x y) : preimageLabel G h I x = preimageLabel G h I y
proof:
:= by
  let _ : TopologicalSpace (cellGraph G h I).ConnectedComponent := ⊥
  have _ : DiscreteTopology (cellGraph G h I).ConnectedComponent := ⟨rfl⟩
  exact TDA.Reeb.joined_eq_of_discrete (hxy.map (isLocallyConstant_preimageLabel G h I).continuous)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.mk_eq_of_joinedIn
statement:
theorem mk_eq_of_joinedIn {x y : Realization G} (hxy : JoinedIn (plHeight G h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ)) x y)
    (hx : plHeight G h x ∈ I) (hy : plHeight G h y ∈ I) :
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x, hx⟩ : ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ I}) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨y, hy⟩
proof:
:=
  TDA.Topology.mk_eq_of_joinedIn (plHeight G h) (I : Set ℝ) hxy hx hy

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.mk_edgePoint_eq_of_dartEdge_eq
statement:
theorem mk_edgePoint_eq_of_dartEdge_eq {d₁ d₂ : G.Dart} (hd : dartEdge d₁ = dartEdge d₂)
    {t₁ t₂ : unitInterval} (h₁ : dartHeight h d₁ t₁ ∈ I) (h₂ : dartHeight h d₂ t₂ ∈ I) :
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint G d₁ t₁, h₁⟩ :
        ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ I}) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint G d₂ t₂, h₂⟩
proof:
:= by
  rcases dartEdge_eq_iff.1 hd with rfl | rfl
  · exact mk_eq_of_joinedIn G h I (joinedIn_edgePoint d₁ h₁ h₂) _ _
  · have hrev := dartHeight_symm h d₂ (σ t₁)
    rw [unitInterval.symm_symm] at hrev
    have h₁' : dartHeight h d₂ (σ t₁) ∈ I := by rwa [← hrev]
    have hp : edgePoint G d₂.symm t₁ = edgePoint G d₂ (σ t₁) := by
      rw [← edgePoint_symm G d₂ (σ t₁), unitInterval.symm_symm]
    calc (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint G d₂.symm t₁, h₁⟩ :
            ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ I})
        = ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint G d₂ (σ t₁), h₁'⟩ :=
          congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (Subtype.ext hp)
      _ = ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint G d₂ t₂, h₂⟩ :=
          mk_eq_of_joinedIn G h I (joinedIn_edgePoint d₂ h₁' h₂) _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellPoint_inl
statement:
theorem cellPoint_inl (v : {v : V // h v ∈ I}) :
    cellPoint G h I (Sum.inl v) = ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨vertex G v.1, v.2⟩
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellPoint_inr
proof:
:=
  mk_edgePoint_eq_of_dartEdge_eq G h I ((Classical.choose_spec e.2).1.trans hd.symm) _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellPoint_inl_eq_inr
statement:
theorem cellPoint_inl_eq_inr {v : {v : V // h v ∈ I}} {e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h I e}}
    (hv : (v : V) ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V)) : cellPoint G h I (Sum.inl v) = cellPoint G h I (Sum.inr e)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdv⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq_fst hv
  have h0 : dartHeight h d 0 ∈ I := by rw [dartHeight_zero, hdv]; exact v.2
  rw [cellPoint_inr G h I e hd h0]
  exact congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk
    (Subtype.ext (show vertex G v.1 = edgePoint G d 0 by rw [edgePoint_zero, hdv]))

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellPoint_eq_of_adj
statement:
theorem cellPoint_eq_of_adj {x y : Cell G h I} (hxy : (cellGraph G h I).Adj x y) :
    cellPoint G h I x = cellPoint G h I y
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with v | e <;> rcases y with w | e'
  · exact (hxy : False).elim
  · exact cellPoint_inl_eq_inr G h I hxy
  · exact (cellPoint_inl_eq_inr G h I hxy).symm
  · exact (hxy : False).elim

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex (v : V) (hv : h v ∈ I) :
    preimageComponentsEquiv G h I (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨vertex G v, hv⟩) =
      (cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨v, hv⟩)
proof:
:=
  preimageLabel_vertex G h I v hv

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval)
    (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ I) :
    preimageComponentsEquiv G h I (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint G d t, ht⟩) =
      (cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk
        (Sum.inr ⟨dartEdge d, edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem ht⟩)
proof:
:=
  preimageLabel_edgePoint G h I d t ht

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint_of_fst_mem
statement:
theorem preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint_of_fst_mem {d : G.Dart} {t : unitInterval}
    (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ I) (hv : h d.fst ∈ I) :
    preimageComponentsEquiv G h I (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint G d t, ht⟩) =
      (cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨d.fst, hv⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint]
  exact (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr G h I (fst_mem_dartEdge d)).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint_of_snd_mem
statement:
theorem preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint_of_snd_mem {d : G.Dart} {t : unitInterval}
    (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ I) (hv : h d.snd ∈ I) :
    preimageComponentsEquiv G h I (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint G d t, ht⟩) =
      (cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨d.snd, hv⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint]
  exact (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr G h I (snd_mem_dartEdge d)).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.preimageComponentsEquiv_symm_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem preimageComponentsEquiv_symm_inl (v : {v : V // h v ∈ I}) :
    (preimageComponentsEquiv G h I).symm ((cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl v)) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨vertex G v.1, v.2⟩
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.preimageComponentsEquiv_symm_inr
statement:
theorem preimageComponentsEquiv_symm_inr (e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h I e})
    {d : G.Dart} (hd : dartEdge d = e.1) {t : unitInterval} (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ I) :
    (preimageComponentsEquiv G h I).symm ((cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr e)) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint G d t, ht⟩
proof:
:=
  cellPoint_inr G h I e hd ht

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.finite_zerothHomotopy
statement:
theorem finite_zerothHomotopy [Finite V] :
    Finite (ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ I})
proof:
:=
  Finite.of_equiv _ (preimageComponentsEquiv G h I).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.preimageComponentsEquiv_componentMap
statement:
theorem preimageComponentsEquiv_componentMap {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (c : ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ I}) :
    preimageComponentsEquiv G h J
        (TDA.Reeb.componentMap (preimageInclusion (plHeight G h) (toOpens_le_iff.2 hIJ)) c) =
      (preimageComponentsEquiv G h I c).map (cellInclusion G h hIJ)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := x
    induction p using ind G with
    | vertex v =>
      rw [preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex G h I v hp]
      exact preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex G h J v _
    | edgePoint d t =>
      rw [preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint G h I d t hp]
      exact preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint G h J d t _

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.preimageComponentsEquiv_comp_componentMap
statement:
theorem preimageComponentsEquiv_comp_componentMap {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    preimageComponentsEquiv G h J ∘
        TDA.Reeb.componentMap (preimageInclusion (plHeight G h) (toOpens_le_iff.2 hIJ)) =
      ConnectedComponent.map (cellInclusion G h hIJ) ∘ preimageComponentsEquiv G h I
proof:
:=
  _root_.funext (preimageComponentsEquiv_componentMap G h hIJ)

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.intervalComponentsIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem intervalComponentsIso_hom_app (I : OpenInterval)
    (c : (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)).obj I) :
    (intervalComponentsIso G h).hom.app I c = preimageComponentsEquiv G h I c
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.intervalComponentsIso_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem intervalComponentsIso_inv_app (I : OpenInterval)
    (c : (cellComponentFunctor G h).obj I) :
    (intervalComponentsIso G h).inv.app I c = (preimageComponentsEquiv G h I).symm c
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_of_adj
statement:
theorem connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_of_adj {u w : ↥(h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ))} (huw : G.Adj u w) :
    (cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl u) =
      (cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl w)
proof:
:=
  (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr G h I (e := ⟨⟨s(u.1, w.1), huw⟩,
      edgeActive_of_mem (Sym2.mem_mk_left _ _) u.2⟩) (Sym2.mem_mk_left _ _)).trans
    (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr G h I (Sym2.mem_mk_right _ _)).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.induce_mk_eq_of_mem
statement:
theorem induce_mk_eq_of_mem {e : G.edgeSet} {u w : ↥(h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ))}
    (hu : (u : V) ∈ (e : Sym2 V)) (hw : (w : V) ∈ (e : Sym2 V)) :
    (G.induce (h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ))).connectedComponentMk u =
      (G.induce (h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ))).connectedComponentMk w
proof:
:= by
  by_cases huw : (u : V) = w
  · rw [Subtype.ext huw]
  · have he : (e : Sym2 V) = s(u.1, w.1) := (Sym2.mem_and_mem_iff huw).1 ⟨hu, hw⟩
    have hadj : G.Adj u w := by
      have := e.2
      rw [he] at this
      exact this
    exact ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj hadj

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.coverEndpoint_mem
statement:
theorem coverEndpoint_mem (hcov : EndpointCoverage G h I)
    (e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h I e}) :
    (coverEndpoint G h I hcov e : V) ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (hcov e.1 e.2)).1

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.coverNode_eq_of_adj
statement:
theorem coverNode_eq_of_adj (hcov : EndpointCoverage G h I) {x y : Cell G h I}
    (hxy : (cellGraph G h I).Adj x y) : coverNode G h I hcov x = coverNode G h I hcov y
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with v | e <;> rcases y with w | e'
  · exact (hxy : False).elim
  · exact induce_mk_eq_of_mem G h I hxy (coverEndpoint_mem G h I hcov e')
  · exact induce_mk_eq_of_mem G h I (coverEndpoint_mem G h I hcov e) hxy
  · exact (hxy : False).elim

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellInducedEquiv_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem cellInducedEquiv_inl (hcov : EndpointCoverage G h I) (v : {v : V // h v ∈ I}) :
    cellInducedEquiv G h I hcov ((cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl v)) =
      (G.induce (h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ))).connectedComponentMk v
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellInducedEquiv_inr
statement:
theorem cellInducedEquiv_inr (hcov : EndpointCoverage G h I)
    (e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h I e}) {w : ↥(h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ))}
    (hw : (w : V) ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V)) :
    cellInducedEquiv G h I hcov ((cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr e)) =
      (G.induce (h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ))).connectedComponentMk w
proof:
:=
  induce_mk_eq_of_mem G h I (coverEndpoint_mem G h I hcov e) hw

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.cellInducedEquiv_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem cellInducedEquiv_symm_mk (hcov : EndpointCoverage G h I)
    (v : ↥(h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ))) :
    (cellInducedEquiv G h I hcov).symm ((G.induce (h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ))).connectedComponentMk v) =
      (cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl v)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.preimageInducedEquiv_mk_vertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem preimageInducedEquiv_mk_vertex (hcov : EndpointCoverage G h I) (v : V)
    (hv : h v ∈ I) :
    preimageInducedEquiv G h I hcov (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨vertex G v, hv⟩) =
      (G.induce (h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ))).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hv⟩
proof:
:= by
  show cellInducedEquiv G h I hcov (preimageComponentsEquiv G h I _) = _
  rw [preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.preimageInducedEquiv_mk_edgePoint
statement:
theorem preimageInducedEquiv_mk_edgePoint (hcov : EndpointCoverage G h I) (d : G.Dart)
    (t : unitInterval) (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ I) {w : V} (hw : w ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V))
    (hwI : h w ∈ I) :
    preimageInducedEquiv G h I hcov (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint G d t, ht⟩) =
      (G.induce (h ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ))).connectedComponentMk ⟨w, hwI⟩
proof:
:= by
  show cellInducedEquiv G h I hcov (preimageComponentsEquiv G h I _) = _
  rw [preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint]
  exact cellInducedEquiv_inr G h I hcov _ (w := ⟨w, hwI⟩) hw

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.endpointCoverage_top
statement: theorem endpointCoverage_top : EndpointCoverage G h ⊤
proof:
:= fun e _ => by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
  exact ⟨d.fst, fst_mem_dartEdge d, trivial⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.full_componentsEquiv
statement:
theorem full_componentsEquiv
    (c : ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ (⊤ : OpenInterval)}) :
    componentsEquiv G (TDA.Reeb.componentMap ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩ c) =
      (preimageInducedEquiv G h ⊤ (endpointCoverage_top G h) c).map
        (Embedding.induce (G := G) _).toHom
proof:
:= by
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := x
    induction p using ind G with
    | vertex v =>
      rw [preimageInducedEquiv_mk_vertex G h ⊤ _ v hp]
      rfl
    | edgePoint d t =>
      rw [preimageInducedEquiv_mk_edgePoint G h ⊤ _ d t hp (fst_mem_dartEdge d) trivial]
      rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAddition.point_segment_image

theorem point_segment_image (s : Band 1) :

      ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap onePoint) (1 + 1))
        (PUnit.unit, ⟨0, zero_mem_band (1 + 1)⟩)
proof:
:= by
  exact (quotientAddHomeomorph_mk _ 1 1 (fiberSegment s)).trans

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAddition.point_quotient_fiber_zero_subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (height (overBaseMap onePoint) (1 + 1)) := by
    rintro ⟨a, s⟩ ⟨b, t⟩ h
    have h' : (0 : ℝ) + s = 0 + t := h
    exact Prod.ext (Subsingleton.elim (α := PUnit.{1}) _ _) (Subtype.ext (by linarith))
  let e := (quotientAddHomeomorph (overBaseMap onePoint) 1 1).trans
    (ReebQuotient.homeomorphOfInjective hinj)
  have hh : ∀ p : ReebQuotient (height (overBaseMap onePoint) (1 + 1)),
      overBaseMap ((functor (1 + 1)).obj onePoint) (ReebQuotient.homeomorphOfInjective hinj p) =
        ReebQuotient.height _ p := by
    intro p
    induction p using ReebQuotient.ind with
    | h w => rfl
  have he : ∀ q, overBaseMap ((functor (1 + 1)).obj onePoint) (e q) = ReebQuotient.height _ q :=
    fun q => (hh _).trans (height_quotientAddHomeomorph _ 1 1 q)
  constructor
  rintro ⟨q₁, h₁⟩ ⟨q₂, h₂⟩
  have h := (fiber_zero_subsingleton (1 + 1)).elim ⟨e q₁, (he q₁).trans h₁⟩
    ⟨e q₂, (he q₂).trans h₂⟩
  exact Subtype.ext (e.injective (congrArg Subtype.val h))

        (ReebQuotient.mk (height (height (overBaseMap onePoint) 1) 0)
          ((PUnit.unit, s), ⟨0, zero_mem_band 0⟩)) =

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAddition.point_addSection_zero

theorem point_addSection_zero (w : PUnit.{1} × Band (0 + 1)) :
    ((addSection PUnit.{1} 0 1 w).1.2 : ℝ) = w.2 ∧ ((addSection PUnit.{1} 0 1 w).2 : ℝ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h01 : (((0 + 1 : ℝ≥0)) : ℝ) = ((1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by rw [zero_add]
  have hw : (w.2 : ℝ) ∈ Band 1 := ⟨by linarith [w.2.2.1], by linarith [w.2.2.2]⟩
  exact ⟨congrArg Subtype.val (projIcc_of_mem (neg_le_band 1) hw),
    eq_zero_of_mem_band_zero (addSection PUnit.{1} 0 1 w).2.2⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAddition.edge_quotientAddHomeomorph
statement:
theorem edge_quotientAddHomeomorph :
    quotientAddHomeomorph (overBaseMap edgeObj) quarter quarter (ReebQuotient.mk _ edgeZ) =
      ReebQuotient.mk _ (edgePt, halfPt)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientAddHomeomorph_mk]
  exact congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) (Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext
    (show (quarter : ℝ) + quarter = 1 / 2 by rw [coe_quarter]; norm_num)))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAddition.edge_quotientAddHomeomorph_symm
statement:
theorem edge_quotientAddHomeomorph_symm :
    (quotientAddHomeomorph (overBaseMap edgeObj) quarter quarter).symm
        (ReebQuotient.mk _ (edgePt, halfPt)) =
      ReebQuotient.mk _ ((edgePt, quarterPt), quarterPt)
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientAddHomeomorph_symm_mk]
  have hc : (projIcc (-(quarter : ℝ)) quarter (neg_le_band quarter) (1 / 2) : ℝ) = 1 / 4 := by
    rw [coe_projIcc, coe_quarter, min_eq_left (by norm_num), max_eq_right (by norm_num)]
  refine congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) (Prod.ext (Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext ?_)) (Subtype.ext ?_))
  · show (projIcc (-(quarter : ℝ)) quarter (neg_le_band quarter) (1 / 2) : ℝ) = quarter
    rw [hc, coe_quarter]
  · show (1 / 2 : ℝ) - (projIcc (-(quarter : ℝ)) quarter (neg_le_band quarter) (1 / 2) : ℝ) =
      quarter
    rw [hc, coe_quarter]
    norm_num

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAddition.edge_reebRel_identification
statement:
theorem edge_reebRel_identification :
    ReebQuotient.mk (height (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) quarter) quarter)
        ((edgePt, quarterPt), negQuarterPt) =
      ReebQuotient.mk (height (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) quarter) quarter)
        ((edgePt, zeroQ), zeroQ)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (projIcc (-(quarter : ℝ)) quarter (neg_le_band quarter)
      ((quarter : ℝ) + -(quarter : ℝ)) : ℝ) = 0 := by
    rw [add_neg_cancel, coe_projIcc, min_eq_right quarter.coe_nonneg,
      max_eq_right (neg_nonpos.2 quarter.coe_nonneg)]
  have hσ : addSection edgeObj.left quarter quarter
      (addMap edgeObj.left quarter quarter ((edgePt, quarterPt), negQuarterPt)) =
        ((edgePt, zeroQ), zeroQ) := by
    refine Prod.ext (Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext ?_)) (Subtype.ext ?_)
    · exact hc
    · show (quarter : ℝ) + -(quarter : ℝ) -
          (projIcc (-(quarter : ℝ)) quarter (neg_le_band quarter)
            ((quarter : ℝ) + -(quarter : ℝ)) : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hc, add_neg_cancel, sub_zero]
  rw [← hσ]
  exact (ReebQuotient.mk_eq_mk_iff _).2 (reebRel_addSection_addMap _ _)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAddition.edge_reebAddIso_assoc
statement:
theorem edge_reebAddIso_assoc :
    ((Functor.whiskerLeft (functor quarter) (reebAddIso quarter quarter).hom ≫
        (reebAddIso (quarter + quarter) quarter).hom ≫
          Functor.whiskerRight (bandEqIso (add_assoc quarter quarter quarter)).hom ℛ).app
          edgeObj).left.hom
        (ReebQuotient.mk (height (height (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) quarter) quarter) quarter)
          (((edgePt, quarterPt), quarterPt), quarterPt)) =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) (quarter + (quarter + quarter)))
          (edgePt, threeQuarterPt) ∧
      ((Functor.whiskerRight (Functor.whiskerRight (addNatTrans quarter quarter) (functor quarter))
          ℛ ≫ (reebAddIso quarter (quarter + quarter)).hom).app edgeObj).left.hom
        (ReebQuotient.mk (height (height (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) quarter) quarter) quarter)
          (((edgePt, quarterPt), quarterPt), quarterPt)) =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) (quarter + (quarter + quarter)))
          (edgePt, threeQuarterPt)
proof:
:= by
  have hR : ((Functor.whiskerRight (Functor.whiskerRight (addNatTrans quarter quarter)
      (functor quarter)) ℛ ≫ (reebAddIso quarter (quarter + quarter)).hom).app edgeObj).left.hom
        (ReebQuotient.mk (height (height (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) quarter) quarter) quarter)
          (((edgePt, quarterPt), quarterPt), quarterPt)) =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) (quarter + (quarter + quarter)))
          (edgePt, threeQuarterPt) :=
    congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) (Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext
      (show (quarter : ℝ) + quarter + quarter = 3 / 4 by rw [coe_quarter]; norm_num)))
  exact ⟨(congrArg (fun φ => φ.left.hom
    (ReebQuotient.mk (height (height (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) quarter) quarter) quarter)
      (((edgePt, quarterPt), quarterPt), quarterPt)))
    (NatTrans.congr_app (reebAddIso_assoc quarter quarter quarter) edgeObj)).trans hR, hR⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAddition.par_quarter_classes_eq
statement:
theorem par_quarter_classes_eq :
    parZ false ≠ parZ true ∧
      ReebQuotient.mk (height (height (overBaseMap parObj) quarter) quarter) (parZ false) =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (height (overBaseMap parObj) quarter) quarter) (parZ true)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => parPt_false_ne_true (congrArg (fun z => z.1.1) h), ?_⟩
  have hε : 1 / 2 ≤ ((quarter + quarter : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
    rw [NNReal.coe_add, coe_quarter]
    norm_num
  have hsub := parallel_smoothed_fiber_subsingleton hε (1 / 2)
  have hb : ∀ b, overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing (quarter + quarter)).obj parallelGraph).obj
      (ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) (quarter + quarter)) (parPt b, parW)) =
        1 / 2 :=
    fun b => (height_addMap _ quarter quarter (parZ b)).trans (height_parZ b)
  have himg := congrArg Subtype.val (hsub.elim ⟨_, hb false⟩ ⟨_, hb true⟩)
  exact (quotientAddHomeomorph (overBaseMap parObj) quarter quarter).injective
    (a₁ := ReebQuotient.mk _ (parZ false)) (a₂ := ReebQuotient.mk _ (parZ true)) himg

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAddition.par_eighth_fiber_not_subsingleton
statement:
theorem par_eighth_fiber_not_subsingleton :
    ¬ Subsingleton (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj ((functor eighth).obj ((functor eighth).obj parObj))) ⁻¹'
      {1 / 2})
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply parallel_quarter_fiber_not_subsingleton
  rw [← eighth_add_eighth]
  let e := quotientAddHomeomorph (overBaseMap parObj) eighth eighth
  have k : ∀ p : ReebQuotient (height (overBaseMap parObj) (eighth + eighth)),
      ReebQuotient.height _ p = 1 / 2 → ReebQuotient.height _ (e.symm p) = 1 / 2 := by
    intro p hp
    have := height_quotientAddHomeomorph (overBaseMap parObj) eighth eighth (e.symm p)
    rw [Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply] at this
    exact this.symm.trans hp
  constructor
  rintro ⟨p₁, h₁⟩ ⟨p₂, h₂⟩
  exact Subtype.ext (e.symm.injective (congrArg Subtype.val
    (h.elim ⟨e.symm p₁, k p₁ h₁⟩ ⟨e.symm p₂, k p₂ h₂⟩)))

        (geometricSmoothingAddIso quarter quarter).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
        (ReebQuotient.mk (height (height (overBaseMap parObj) quarter) quarter) (parZ true)) =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) (quarter + quarter)) (parPt false, parW) ∧
      ((geometricSmoothingAddIso quarter quarter).hom.app parallelGraph ≫
        (geometricSmoothing (quarter + quarter)).map swapGraph).hom.left.hom
        (ReebQuotient.mk (height (height (overBaseMap parObj) quarter) quarter) (parZ true)) =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) (quarter + quarter)) (parPt false, parW)
proof:

  have h₁ : ((doubleThickeningQuotient quarter quarter).map swapGraph ≫
      (geometricSmoothingAddIso quarter quarter).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
        (ReebQuotient.mk (height (height (overBaseMap parObj) quarter) quarter) (parZ true)) =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) (quarter + quarter)) (parPt false, parW) :=
    congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) swap_addNatTrans_square_apply.1
  exact ⟨h₁, (congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom.left.hom
    (ReebQuotient.mk (height (height (overBaseMap parObj) quarter) quarter) (parZ true)))
    ((geometricSmoothingAddIso quarter quarter).hom.naturality swapGraph)).symm.trans h₁⟩

statement: theorem S02_shifted_one_middle : (S02.shifted 1).value S02mid = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : (S02.shifted 1).value S02mid ∈ Set.range (S02.shifted 1).value := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [range_shifted, S02_shiftedSet_one] at hmem
  have h0 : (S02.shifted 1).value 0 < (S02.shifted 1).value S02mid :=
    (S02.shifted 1).strictMono (by simp [Fin.lt_def, S02mid])
  have h2 : (S02.shifted 1).value S02mid < (S02.shifted 1).value (Fin.last _) :=
    (S02.shifted 1).strictMono (by simp [Fin.lt_def, S02mid, S02_shiftedCount_one])
  rw [S02_shifted_one_first] at h0
  rw [S02_shifted_one_last] at h2
  simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_insert_iff,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hmem
  rcases hmem with h | h | h
  · linarith
  · exact h
  · linarith

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleSmoothing.shiftedSet_eq_pair
statement:
theorem shiftedSet_eq_pair (S : CriticalValues 0) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    S.shiftedSet ε = {S.value 0 - ε, S.value 0 + ε}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_shiftedSet, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, h⟩
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := Fin.fin_one_eq_zero i
    exact h
  · exact fun h => ⟨0, h⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleSmoothing.shiftedCount_eq_one
statement:
theorem shiftedCount_eq_one (S : CriticalValues 0) {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    S.shiftedCount ε = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hε' : (0 : ℝ) < ε := NNReal.coe_pos.2 hε
  have hne : S.value 0 - ε ≠ S.value 0 + ε := fun h => by linarith
  unfold shiftedCount
  rw [shiftedSet_eq_pair, Finset.card_pair_eq_two_iff.2 hne]

proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleSmoothing.between_key
statement:
theorem between_key :
    ((S1.value 0 ∈ thicken 1 (ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4))) ↔ S1.value 0 ∈ thicken 1 (ioo (-1) 1)) ∧
      Function.Bijective (((smoothing 1).obj pointCosheaf).map (homOfLE between_le))
proof:
:=
  ⟨S1.value_mem_thicken_iff_of_shifted 1 between_le
      ⟨1 / 2, show (1 / 4 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 3 / 4 by norm_num⟩ between_hits 0,
    smoothedPoint_isConstructibleAt.bijective between_le
      ⟨1 / 2, show (1 / 4 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 ∧ (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 3 / 4 by norm_num⟩ between_hits⟩

proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleSmoothing.emptySource_not_bijective
statement:
theorem emptySource_not_bijective :
    ¬ Function.Bijective (((smoothing 1).obj pointCosheaf).map
      (homOfLE (bot_le : (⊥ : OpenInterval) ≤ ioo (-1) 1)))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hJ : Nonempty (((smoothing 1).obj pointCosheaf).obj (ioo (-1) 1)) := by
    change Nonempty (pointCosheaf.obj (thicken 1 (ioo (-1) 1)))
    rw [pointCosheaf_nonempty_iff, thicken_ioo (by norm_num), mem_ioo]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨y⟩ := hJ
  obtain ⟨x, -⟩ := h.2 y
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ thicken 1 (⊥ : OpenInterval) := (pointCosheaf_nonempty_iff _).1 ⟨x⟩
  rw [thicken_bot] at h0
  exact notMem_empty _ h0

    (hfh : ∀ x, |f x - h x| ≤ (ε + δ : ℝ≥0)) :
    (perturbationInterleaving hfg).trans (perturbationInterleaving hgh) =

  · induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.value_le_or_le
statement:
theorem value_le_or_le {m : ℕ} (T : CriticalValues m) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (k : Fin m) :
    T.value j ≤ T.value k.castSucc ∨ T.value k.succ ≤ T.value j
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt j k.castSucc with h | h
  · exact .inl (T.strictMono.monotone h)
  · refine .inr (T.strictMono.monotone ?_)
    rw [Fin.le_def]
    rw [Fin.lt_def] at h
    simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at h ⊢
    omega

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.transferOK_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i h => ?_, fun i h => ?_, fun i h => ?_, fun i h => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := S.exists_shifted_value_eq_sub ε i
    exact (S.shifted ε).value_notMem_K k j (by rw [hj, ← h]; exact hc)
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := S.exists_shifted_value_eq_add ε i
    exact (S.shifted ε).value_notMem_K k j (by rw [hj, ← h]; exact hc)
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := S.exists_shifted_value_eq_add ε i
    have hc1 := hc.1
    rcases value_le_or_le _ j k with h' | h'
    · exact absurd h' (not_le.2 (hc1.trans_le (by linarith)))
    · linarith [hu.2]
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := S.exists_shifted_value_eq_sub ε i
    have hc2 := hc.2
    rcases value_le_or_le _ j k with h' | h'
    · linarith [hu.1]
    · exact absurd h' (not_le.2 (lt_of_le_of_lt (by linarith) hc2))

    transferRaw S D ε c (.inr ⟨⟨e, y⟩, s⟩, u) =
      (ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder S e (y, projIcc _ _ (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e).le

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.TransferOK.vertex_mem
