theorem vertex_mem {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hi : S.value i ∈ Icc (c - ε) (c + ε)) :
    S.value i ∈ Icc (u - ε) (u + ε)
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.lo_le i hi.1, h.le_hi i hi.2⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.TransferOK.frag_le
statement:
theorem frag_le {e : Fin n} {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ frag S e (c - ε) (c + ε)) :
    max (S.value e.castSucc) (u - ε) ≤ min (S.value e.succ) (u + ε)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : S.value e.castSucc ≤ c + ε :=
    (le_max_left _ _).trans (hs.1.trans (hs.2.trans (min_le_right _ _)))
  have h2 : c - ε ≤ S.value e.succ :=
    (le_max_right _ _).trans (hs.1.trans (hs.2.trans (min_le_left _ _)))
  have had := S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e
  have hε := ε.coe_nonneg
  exact max_le (le_min had.le (h.le_hi _ h1)) (le_min (h.lo_le _ h2) (by linarith))

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.TransferOK.fragAff_mem
statement:
theorem fragAff_mem {e : Fin n} {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ frag S e (c - ε) (c + ε)) :
    fragAff (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) ε c u s ∈ frag S e (u - ε) (u + ε)
proof:
:=
  RGraph.fragAff_mem (h.frag_le hs) hs

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.TransferOK.frag_lt
statement:
theorem frag_lt (hε : 0 < ε) {e : Fin n} {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ frag S e (c - ε) (c + ε)) :
    max (S.value e.castSucc) (c - ε) < min (S.value e.succ) (c + ε)
proof:
:=
  fragLo_lt_fragHi (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) (NNReal.coe_pos.2 hε)
    ((le_max_left _ _).trans (hs.1.trans (hs.2.trans (min_le_right _ _)))) (h.ne_sub _)
    ((le_max_right _ _).trans (hs.1.trans (hs.2.trans (min_le_left _ _)))) (h.ne_add _)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.TransferOK.fragAff_eq_left
statement:
theorem fragAff_eq_left {e : Fin n} {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ frag S e (c - ε) (c + ε))
    (hsa : s = S.value e.castSucc) :
    fragAff (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) ε c u s = S.value e.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  have hca : c - ε ≤ S.value e.castSucc := by
    rw [← hsa]
    exact (le_max_right _ _).trans hs.1
  have hL : max (S.value e.castSucc) (c - ε) = S.value e.castSucc := max_eq_left hca
  calc fragAff (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) ε c u s =
        fragAff (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) ε c u (max (S.value e.castSucc) (c - ε)) := by
        rw [hL, hsa]
    _ = max (S.value e.castSucc) (u - ε) := fragAff_left _ _ _ _ _
    _ = S.value e.castSucc := max_eq_left (h.lo_le _ hca)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.TransferOK.fragAff_eq_right
statement:
theorem fragAff_eq_right {e : Fin n} {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ frag S e (c - ε) (c + ε))
    (hsd : s = S.value e.succ) :
    fragAff (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) ε c u s = S.value e.succ
proof:
:= by
  have hdc : S.value e.succ ≤ c + ε := by
    rw [← hsd]
    exact hs.2.trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hR : min (S.value e.succ) (c + ε) = S.value e.succ := min_eq_left hdc
  have hlt : max (S.value e.castSucc) (c - ε) < min (S.value e.succ) (c + ε) := by
    rw [hR]
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (by rw [← hsd]; exact hs.1) fun heq => ?_
    rcases max_choice (S.value e.castSucc) (c - ε) with hm | hm <;> rw [hm] at heq
    · exact (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e).ne heq
    · exact h.ne_add e.succ (by linarith)
  calc fragAff (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) ε c u s =
        fragAff (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) ε c u (min (S.value e.succ) (c + ε)) := by
        rw [hR, hsd]
    _ = min (S.value e.succ) (u + ε) := fragAff_right hlt
    _ = S.value e.succ := min_eq_left (h.le_hi _ hdc)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.transferRaw_eq
statement:
private theorem transferRaw_eq {c u : ℝ} (h : TransferOK S ε c u)
    (r : WindowRaw S D (c - ε) (c + ε)) :
    transferRaw S D ε c (r, u) =
      (windowCover S D (u - ε) (u + ε) (rawTransfer S D ε h r) :
        (ofFiniteData D).Realization S)
proof:
:= by
  rcases r with v | ⟨⟨e, y⟩, s⟩
  · rfl
  · rw [transferRaw_inr, projIcc_of_mem _ (frag_subset_seg (h.fragAff_mem s.2))]
    rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.nf_windowIncl_rawTransfer
statement:
private theorem nf_windowIncl_rawTransfer {c u : ℝ} (h : TransferOK S ε c u)
    (r : WindowRaw S D (c - ε) (c + ε)) :
    (ofFiniteData D).nf S (windowIncl S D _ _ (rawTransfer S D ε h r)) =
      (ofFiniteData D).nf S (transferNf S D ε c u
        ((ofFiniteData D).nf S (windowIncl S D _ _ r)))
proof:
:= by
  rcases r with v | ⟨⟨e, y⟩, s⟩
  · rfl
  · have hmem : fragAff (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) ε c u s ∈ frag S e (u - ε) (u + ε) :=
      h.fragAff_mem s.2
    by_cases hsa : (s : ℝ) = S.value e.castSucc
    · have h1 : (⟨s, frag_subset_seg s.2⟩ : Seg S e) = segBot S e := Subtype.ext hsa
      have h2 : (⟨_, frag_subset_seg hmem⟩ : Seg S e) = segBot S e :=
        Subtype.ext (h.fragAff_eq_left s.2 hsa)
      have hL : (ofFiniteData D).nf S (.inr ⟨e, y, ⟨_, frag_subset_seg hmem⟩⟩) =
          .inl ⟨e.castSucc, (ofFiniteData D).left e y⟩ := by
        rw [h2]
        exact (ofFiniteData D).nf_segBot S e y
      have hR : (ofFiniteData D).nf S (.inr ⟨e, y, ⟨s, frag_subset_seg s.2⟩⟩) =
          .inl ⟨e.castSucc, (ofFiniteData D).left e y⟩ := by
        rw [h1]
        exact (ofFiniteData D).nf_segBot S e y
      change (ofFiniteData D).nf S (.inr ⟨e, y, ⟨_, frag_subset_seg hmem⟩⟩) =
        (ofFiniteData D).nf S (transferNf S D ε c u
          ((ofFiniteData D).nf S (.inr ⟨e, y, ⟨s, frag_subset_seg s.2⟩⟩)))
      rw [hL, hR]
      rfl
    by_cases hsd : (s : ℝ) = S.value e.succ
    · have h1 : (⟨s, frag_subset_seg s.2⟩ : Seg S e) = segTop S e := Subtype.ext hsd
      have h2 : (⟨_, frag_subset_seg hmem⟩ : Seg S e) = segTop S e :=
        Subtype.ext (h.fragAff_eq_right s.2 hsd)
      have hL : (ofFiniteData D).nf S (.inr ⟨e, y, ⟨_, frag_subset_seg hmem⟩⟩) =
          .inl ⟨e.succ, (ofFiniteData D).right e y⟩ := by
        rw [h2]
        exact (ofFiniteData D).nf_segTop S e y
      have hR : (ofFiniteData D).nf S (.inr ⟨e, y, ⟨s, frag_subset_seg s.2⟩⟩) =
          .inl ⟨e.succ, (ofFiniteData D).right e y⟩ := by
        rw [h1]
        exact (ofFiniteData D).nf_segTop S e y
      change (ofFiniteData D).nf S (.inr ⟨e, y, ⟨_, frag_subset_seg hmem⟩⟩) =
        (ofFiniteData D).nf S (transferNf S D ε c u
          ((ofFiniteData D).nf S (.inr ⟨e, y, ⟨s, frag_subset_seg s.2⟩⟩)))
      rw [hL, hR]
      rfl
    · have hnf : (ofFiniteData D).nf S (.inr ⟨e, y, ⟨s, frag_subset_seg s.2⟩⟩) =
          .inr ⟨e, y, ⟨s, frag_subset_seg s.2⟩⟩ := by
        simp only [nf, nfCyl, Sum.elim_inr, hsa, hsd, ↓reduceIte]
      change (ofFiniteData D).nf S (.inr ⟨e, y, ⟨_, frag_subset_seg hmem⟩⟩) =
        (ofFiniteData D).nf S (transferNf S D ε c u
          ((ofFiniteData D).nf S (.inr ⟨e, y, ⟨s, frag_subset_seg s.2⟩⟩)))
      rw [hnf]
      simp only [transferNf, Sum.elim_inr]
      rw [projIcc_of_mem _ (frag_subset_seg hmem)]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.windowCover_rawTransfer_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [windowCover_eq_iff] at hrr ⊢
  rw [nf_windowIncl_rawTransfer, nf_windowIncl_rawTransfer, hrr]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.transferRaw_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [transferRaw_eq S D ε h]
  exact (windowCover S D _ _ (rawTransfer S D ε h r)).2

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.transferCover_eq
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (transferRaw_eq S D ε h r)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.transferCover_factors
statement:
private theorem transferCover_factors {c u : ℝ} (h : TransferOK S ε c u) :
    Function.FactorsThrough (transferCover S D ε h) (windowCover S D (c - ε) (c + ε))
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ hrr => by
    rw [transferCover_eq, transferCover_eq, windowCover_rawTransfer_eq S D ε h hrr]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.windowTransfer_windowCover
statement:
private theorem windowTransfer_windowCover {c u : ℝ} (h : TransferOK S ε c u)
    (r : WindowRaw S D (c - ε) (c + ε)) :
    windowTransfer S D ε h (windowCover S D _ _ r) =
      windowCover S D _ _ (rawTransfer S D ε h r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← transferCover_eq]
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun (IsQuotientMap.lift_comp
    (isQuotientMap_windowCover S D (c - ε) (c + ε)) (transferCover S D ε h)
    (transferCover_factors S D ε h)) r
  rw [ContinuousMap.comp_apply] at this
  exact this

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.coe_windowTransfer_ofCylinder
statement:
theorem coe_windowTransfer_ofCylinder {c u : ℝ} (h : TransferOK S ε c u) {e : Fin n} {s : ℝ}
    (hs : s ∈ frag S e (c - ε) (c + ε)) (x : win S D ε c) {y : D.E e}
    (hx : (x : (ofFiniteData D).Realization S) =
      (ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder S e (y, ⟨s, frag_subset_seg hs⟩)) :
    (windowTransfer S D ε h x : (ofFiniteData D).Realization S) =
      (ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder S e (y, ⟨fragAff (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) ε c u s,
        frag_subset_seg (h.fragAff_mem hs)⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x = windowCover S D _ _ (.inr ⟨⟨e, y⟩, ⟨s, hs⟩⟩) := Subtype.ext hx
  rw [hx', windowTransfer_windowCover]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.coe_windowTransfer_ofVertex
statement:
theorem coe_windowTransfer_ofVertex {c u : ℝ} (h : TransferOK S ε c u) (x : win S D ε c)
    {i : Fin (n + 1)} {v : D.V i}
    (hx : (x : (ofFiniteData D).Realization S) = (ofFiniteData D).ofVertex S i v) :
    (windowTransfer S D ε h x : (ofFiniteData D).Realization S) =
      (ofFiniteData D).ofVertex S i v
proof:
:= by
  have hi : S.value i ∈ Icc (c - ε) (c + ε) := by
    have hm := x.2
    rw [hx] at hm
    exact hm
  have hx' : x = windowCover S D _ _ (.inl ⟨⟨i, v⟩, hi⟩) := Subtype.ext hx
  rw [hx', windowTransfer_windowCover]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.rawTransfer_rawTransfer
proof:
:= by
  rcases r with v | ⟨⟨e, y⟩, s⟩
  · rfl
  · exact congrArg Sum.inr (Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq (Subtype.ext
      (fragAff_fragAff (h.frag_lt hε s.2) (h'.frag_lt hε (h.fragAff_mem s.2)) s))))

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.windowTransfer_windowTransfer
statement:
theorem windowTransfer_windowTransfer (hε : 0 < ε) {c u : ℝ} (h : TransferOK S ε c u)
    (h' : TransferOK S ε u c) (x : win S D ε c) :
    windowTransfer S D ε h' (windowTransfer S D ε h x) = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := windowCover_surjective S D _ _ x
  rw [windowTransfer_windowCover, windowTransfer_windowCover, rawTransfer_rawTransfer S D ε hε h h']

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isQuotientMap_slabCover
statement:
private theorem isQuotientMap_slabCover (k : Fin (S.shiftedCount ε)) :
    IsQuotientMap (slabCover S D ε k)
proof:
:=
  IsQuotientMap.of_surjective_continuous
    ((windowCover_surjective S D _ _).prodMap Function.surjective_id) (slabCover S D ε k).continuous

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.slabRaw_factors
statement:
private theorem slabRaw_factors (k : Fin (S.shiftedCount ε)) :
    Function.FactorsThrough (slabRaw S D ε k) (slabCover S D ε k)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨r, t⟩ ⟨r', t'⟩ hpp'
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hpp'
  change t = t' at h2
  subst h2
  have hok := transferOK_of_mem S ε (mid_mem_K S ε k) t.2
  refine Subtype.ext (Prod.ext ?_ rfl)
  change transferRaw S D ε (mid S ε k) (r, (t : ℝ)) = transferRaw S D ε (mid S ε k) (r', (t : ℝ))
  rw [transferRaw_eq S D ε hok, transferRaw_eq S D ε hok, windowCover_rawTransfer_eq S D ε hok h1]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.slabCylinder_slabCover
proof:
:= by
  have := DFunLike.congr_fun (IsQuotientMap.lift_comp (isQuotientMap_slabCover S D ε k)
    (slabRaw S D ε k) (slabRaw_factors S D ε k)) p
  rw [ContinuousMap.comp_apply] at this
  exact this

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.coe_slabCylinder
statement:
theorem coe_slabCylinder (k : Fin (S.shiftedCount ε)) (x : win S D ε (mid S ε k))
    (t : Seg (S.shifted ε) k) :
    (slabCylinder S D ε k (x, t) : (ofFiniteData D).Realization S × ℝ) =
      ((windowTransfer S D ε (transferOK_of_mem S ε (mid_mem_K S ε k) t.2) x :
        (ofFiniteData D).Realization S), (t : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := windowCover_surjective S D _ _ x
  have h := congrArg Subtype.val (slabCylinder_slabCover S D ε k (r, t))
  refine h.trans (Prod.ext ?_ rfl)
  change transferRaw S D ε (mid S ε k) (r, (t : ℝ)) = _
  rw [transferRaw_eq S D ε (transferOK_of_mem S ε (mid_mem_K S ε k) t.2),
    windowTransfer_windowCover]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.snd_slabCylinder
statement:
theorem snd_slabCylinder (k : Fin (S.shiftedCount ε)) (x : win S D ε (mid S ε k))
    (t : Seg (S.shifted ε) k) : (slabCylinder S D ε k (x, t)).1.2 = t
proof:
:=
  congrArg Prod.snd (coe_slabCylinder S D ε k x t)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.thickMap_ofVertex
statement:
theorem thickMap_ofVertex (j : Fin (S.shiftedCount ε + 1)) (x : (thickPresentation S D ε).V j) :
    thickMap S D ε ((thickPresentation S D ε).ofVertex (S.shifted ε) j x) =
      ⟨(x.1, (S.shifted ε).value j), x.2.1, x.2.2⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.coe_thickMap_ofStrip
statement:
theorem coe_thickMap_ofStrip (k : Fin (S.shiftedCount ε)) (x : (thickPresentation S D ε).E k)
    (t : ((S.shifted ε).K k : Set ℝ)) :
    (thickMap S D ε ((thickPresentation S D ε).ofStrip (S.shifted ε) k (x, t))).1 =
      ((windowTransfer S D ε (transferOK_of_mem S ε (mid_mem_K S ε k) (Ioo_subset_Icc_self t.2))
        x : (ofFiniteData D).Realization S), (t : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  coe_slabCylinder S D ε k x (gapIncl _ k t)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.thickMap_snd
statement:
theorem thickMap_snd (q : (thickPresentation S D ε).Realization (S.shifted ε)) :
    (thickMap S D ε q).1.2 = (thickPresentation S D ε).height (S.shifted ε) q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (thickPresentation S D ε).quotMk_surjective _ q
  rcases x with ⟨j, v⟩ | ⟨k, v, t⟩
  · rfl
  · exact snd_slabCylinder S D ε k v t

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.thickMap_injective
statement: theorem thickMap_injective (hε : 0 < ε) : Function.Injective (thickMap S D ε)
proof:
:= by
  intro q q' hqq'
  have hh := (thickMap_snd S D ε q).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun p : BandSpace S D ε => p.1.2) hqq').trans (thickMap_snd S D ε q'))
  rcases (thickPresentation S D ε).exists_rep _ q with ⟨j, x, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, ⟨x, t⟩, rfl⟩ <;>
    rcases (thickPresentation S D ε).exists_rep _ q' with ⟨j', x', rfl⟩ | ⟨k', ⟨x', t'⟩, rfl⟩
  · rw [height_ofVertex, height_ofVertex] at hh
    obtain rfl : j = j' := (S.shifted ε).strictMono.injective hh
    have h1 := congrArg (fun p : BandSpace S D ε => p.1.1) hqq'
    exact congrArg _ (Subtype.ext h1)
  · rw [height_ofVertex, height_ofStrip] at hh
    exact ((S.shifted ε).value_notMem_K k' j (by rw [hh]; exact t'.2)).elim
  · rw [height_ofStrip, height_ofVertex] at hh
    exact ((S.shifted ε).value_notMem_K k j' (by rw [← hh]; exact t.2)).elim
  · rw [height_ofStrip, height_ofStrip] at hh
    obtain rfl : k = k' :=
      (S.shifted ε).eq_of_mem_K_of_mem_Icc t.2 (by rw [hh]; exact Ioo_subset_Icc_self t'.2)
    obtain rfl : t = t' := Subtype.ext hh
    have h1 := congrArg (fun p : BandSpace S D ε => p.1.1) hqq'
    simp only [coe_thickMap_ofStrip] at h1
    have hok := transferOK_of_mem S ε (mid_mem_K S ε k) (Ioo_subset_Icc_self t.2)
    have hok' := transferOK_of_mem S ε t.2 (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (mid_mem_K S ε k))
    have hx := congrArg (windowTransfer S D ε hok') (Subtype.ext h1 :
      windowTransfer S D ε hok x = windowTransfer S D ε hok x')
    have hxx : x = x' := (windowTransfer_windowTransfer S D ε hε hok hok' x).symm.trans
      (hx.trans (windowTransfer_windowTransfer S D ε hε hok hok' x'))
    rw [hxx]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.thickMap_surjective
statement: theorem thickMap_surjective (hε : 0 < ε) : Function.Surjective (thickMap S D ε)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨⟨y, u⟩, hy⟩
  by_cases hlev : ∃ j, (S.shifted ε).value j = u
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hlev
    exact ⟨(thickPresentation S D ε).ofVertex _ j ⟨y, hy.1, hy.2⟩, rfl⟩
  · simp only [not_exists] at hlev
    have hu : u ∈ Icc ((S.shifted ε).value 0) ((S.shifted ε).value (Fin.last _)) := by
      rw [S.shifted_value_zero, S.shifted_value_last]
      have := (ofFiniteData D).height_mem_Icc S y
      exact ⟨by linarith [hy.1, hy.2, this.1, this.2], by linarith [hy.1, hy.2, this.1, this.2]⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := CriticalValues.exists_mem_K_of_mem_Icc hu hlev
    have hok' : TransferOK S ε u (mid S ε k) :=
      transferOK_of_mem S ε hk (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (mid_mem_K S ε k))
    have hok := transferOK_of_mem S ε (mid_mem_K S ε k) (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hk)
    refine ⟨(thickPresentation S D ε).ofStrip _ k
      (windowTransfer S D ε hok' ⟨y, hy.1, hy.2⟩, ⟨u, hk⟩), Subtype.ext
        ((coe_thickMap_ofStrip S D ε k (windowTransfer S D ε hok' ⟨y, hy.1, hy.2⟩) ⟨u, hk⟩).trans
          (Prod.ext ?_ rfl))⟩
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (windowTransfer_windowTransfer S D ε hε hok' hok ⟨y, hy.1, hy.2⟩)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.height_thickProdHomeomorph
statement:
theorem height_thickProdHomeomorph (hε : 0 < ε)
    (q : (thickPresentation S D ε).Realization (S.shifted ε)) :
    GeometricThickening.height ((ofFiniteData D).height S) ε (thickProdHomeomorph S D ε hε q) =
      (thickPresentation S D ε).height (S.shifted ε) q
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GeometricThickening.snd_bandHomeomorph]
  simp only [thickProdHomeomorph, Homeomorph.trans_apply, Homeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
  exact thickMap_snd S D ε q

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.fst_thickProdHomeomorph_ofVertex
statement:
theorem fst_thickProdHomeomorph_ofVertex (hε : 0 < ε) (j : Fin (S.shiftedCount ε + 1))
    (x : (thickPresentation S D ε).V j) :
    (thickProdHomeomorph S D ε hε ((thickPresentation S D ε).ofVertex _ j x)).1 = x.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.fst_thickProdHomeomorph_ofStrip
statement:
theorem fst_thickProdHomeomorph_ofStrip (hε : 0 < ε) (k : Fin (S.shiftedCount ε))
    (x : (thickPresentation S D ε).E k) (t : ((S.shifted ε).K k : Set ℝ)) :
    (thickProdHomeomorph S D ε hε ((thickPresentation S D ε).ofStrip _ k (x, t))).1 =
      (windowTransfer S D ε (transferOK_of_mem S ε (mid_mem_K S ε k) (Ioo_subset_Icc_self t.2)) x :
        (ofFiniteData D).Realization S)
proof:
:=
  congrArg Prod.fst (coe_thickMap_ofStrip S D ε k x t)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.snd_thickProdHomeomorph_ofVertex
statement:
theorem snd_thickProdHomeomorph_ofVertex (hε : 0 < ε) (j : Fin (S.shiftedCount ε + 1))
    (x : (thickPresentation S D ε).V j) :
    ((thickProdHomeomorph S D ε hε ((thickPresentation S D ε).ofVertex _ j x)).2 : ℝ) =
      (S.shifted ε).value j - (ofFiniteData D).height S x.1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.snd_thickProdHomeomorph_ofStrip
statement:
theorem snd_thickProdHomeomorph_ofStrip (hε : 0 < ε) (k : Fin (S.shiftedCount ε))
    (x : (thickPresentation S D ε).E k) (t : ((S.shifted ε).K k : Set ℝ)) :
    ((thickProdHomeomorph S D ε hε ((thickPresentation S D ε).ofStrip _ k (x, t))).2 : ℝ) =
      t - (ofFiniteData D).height S (windowTransfer S D ε
        (transferOK_of_mem S ε (mid_mem_K S ε k) (Ioo_subset_Icc_self t.2)) x :
          (ofFiniteData D).Realization S)
proof:
:= by
  have h := height_thickProdHomeomorph S D ε hε ((thickPresentation S D ε).ofStrip _ k (x, t))
  rw [GeometricThickening.height_apply, fst_thickProdHomeomorph_ofStrip, height_ofStrip] at h
  linarith

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isConstructibleSpace_thickening_toOver
statement:
theorem isConstructibleSpace_thickening_toOver :
    IsConstructibleSpace ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj (toOver S D))
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_zero_or_pos ε with rfl | hε
  · obtain ⟨m, T, P, h1, h2, h3, h4, ⟨i⟩⟩ :=
      isConstructibleSpace_of_isRGraph (A := toOver S D) ⟨n, S, D, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩
    exact ⟨m, T, P, h1, h2, h3, h4, ⟨GeometricThickening.zeroIso.app (toOver S D) ≪≫ i⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨_, S.shifted ε, thickPresentation S D ε, fun _ => inferInstance,
      fun _ => inferInstance, fun _ => inferInstance, fun _ => inferInstance,
      ⟨thickOverIso S D ε hε⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isConstructibleSpace_thickening
statement:
theorem isConstructibleSpace_thickening {A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)} (hA : IsRGraph A) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    IsConstructibleSpace ((GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, S, D, ⟨i⟩⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨m, T, P, h1, h2, h3, h4, ⟨j⟩⟩ := isConstructibleSpace_thickening_toOver S D ε
  exact ⟨m, T, P, h1, h2, h3, h4, ⟨(GeometricThickening.functor ε).mapIso i ≪≫ j⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.thickeningToConstructible_comp_ι
statement:
theorem thickeningToConstructible_comp_ι (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    thickeningToConstructible ε ⋙ IsConstructibleSpace.ι =
      IsRGraph.ι ⋙ GeometricThickening.functor ε
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.thickeningToConstructible_obj_obj
statement:
theorem thickeningToConstructible_obj_obj (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : RGraphCat) :
    ((thickeningToConstructible ε).obj A).obj = (GeometricThickening.functor ε).obj A.obj
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.thickeningToConstructible_map_hom
statement:
theorem thickeningToConstructible_map_hom (ε : ℝ≥0) {A B : RGraphCat} (φ : A ⟶ B) :
    ((thickeningToConstructible ε).map φ).hom = (GeometricThickening.functor ε).map φ.hom

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.thickeningToConstructible_comp_quotientRGraphFunctor

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.φ_app_injective
statement:
theorem φ_app_injective (j : Interleaving ε F G) {I : OpenInterval}
    (h : Function.Injective
      (F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I)))))) :
    Function.Injective (j.φ.app I)
proof:
:= by
  have h' := h
  rw [← j.φ_ψ_app I] at h'
  exact Function.Injective.of_comp (by simpa only [types_comp] using h')

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.isEmpty_of_injective_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem isEmpty_of_injective_of_subsingleton {I : OpenInterval}
    (h : Function.Injective
      (F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I))))))
    [Nontrivial (F.obj I)] [Subsingleton (G.obj (thicken ε I))] :
    IsEmpty (Interleaving ε F G)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun j => ?_⟩
  have hφ : Function.Injective (j.φ.app I) := j.φ_app_injective h
  exact (@false_of_nontrivial_of_subsingleton _ hφ.nontrivial
    (inferInstance : Subsingleton _)).elim

name: TDA.Reeb.Interleaving.isEmpty_of_injective_of_card_lt
statement:
theorem isEmpty_of_injective_of_card_lt {I : OpenInterval}
    (h : Function.Injective
      (F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I))))))
    [Finite (G.obj (thicken ε I))]
    (hc : Nat.card (G.obj (thicken ε I)) < Nat.card (F.obj I)) :
    IsEmpty (Interleaving ε F G)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun j => ?_⟩
  have hφ : Function.Injective (j.φ.app I) := j.φ_app_injective h
  have hcard := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective (j.φ.app I) hφ
  exact (not_le_of_gt hc hcard).elim

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isEmpty_geometricInterleaving_of_injective_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem isEmpty_geometricInterleaving_of_injective_of_subsingleton {A B : RGraphCat}
    {I : OpenInterval}
    (h : Function.Injective ((cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj.map
      (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I))))))
    [Nontrivial ((cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj.obj I)]
    [Subsingleton ((cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj.obj (thicken ε I))] :
    IsEmpty (GeometricInterleaving ε A B)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_⟩
  exact (Interleaving.isEmpty_of_injective_of_subsingleton h).false i.toCosheaf

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isEmpty_geometricInterleaving_of_injective_of_card_lt
statement:
theorem isEmpty_geometricInterleaving_of_injective_of_card_lt {A B : RGraphCat}
    {I : OpenInterval}
    (h : Function.Injective ((cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj.map
      (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I))))))
    [Finite ((cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj.obj (thicken ε I))]
    (hc : Nat.card ((cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj.obj (thicken ε I)) <
      Nat.card ((cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj.obj I)) :
    IsEmpty (GeometricInterleaving ε A B)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_⟩
  exact (Interleaving.isEmpty_of_injective_of_card_lt h hc).false i.toCosheaf

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.le_geometricInterleavingDistance_of_isEmpty
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_geometricInterleavingDistance_iff]
  intro ε hε
  by_contra hnot
  have hεr : (ε : ℝ≥0) < r :=
    ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.mp (lt_of_not_ge hnot)
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := hε
  exact (h ε hεr).false i

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.InterleavingCardinality.point_distance_eq_one_of_card
statement:
theorem point_distance_eq_one_of_card :
    interleavingDistance (pointPrecosheaf 0) (pointPrecosheaf 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (by simpa using pointInterleaving.interleavingDistance_le)
    (le_interleavingDistance_of_forall_exists_card_lt fun ε hε => ?_)
  have hε' : (ε : ℝ) < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hε
  set r : ℝ := (1 - ε) / 2 with hr
  have hr0 : 0 < r := by rw [hr]; linarith
  have hx : (0 : ℝ) ∈ ioo (-r) r := ⟨by linarith, hr0⟩
  have hy : (1 : ℝ) ∉ thicken ε (ioo (-r) r) := by
    rw [thicken_ioo (by linarith)]
    rintro ⟨-, h⟩
    rw [hr] at h
    linarith
  have : IsEmpty ((pointPrecosheaf 1).obj (thicken ε (ioo (-r) r))) := ⟨fun x => hy x.down⟩
  have : Unique ((pointPrecosheaf 0).obj (ioo (-r) r)) :=
    ⟨⟨PLift.up hx⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩
  refine ⟨ioo (-r) r, Function.injective_of_subsingleton _, inferInstance, ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.card_of_isEmpty, Nat.card_unique]
  exact Nat.one_pos

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.InterleavingCardinality.isEmpty_of_nonempty_of_isEmpty_of_finite
proof:
:= by
  refine Interleaving.isEmpty_of_card_lt_card_range (I := I) ?_
  rw [Nat.card_of_isEmpty]
  have : Finite (range (F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans
      (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I)))))) := finite_range _
  have : Nonempty (range (F.map (homOfLE ((le_thicken ε I).trans
      (le_thicken ε (thicken ε I)))))) := (range_nonempty _).to_subtype
  exact Nat.card_pos

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.InterleavingCardinality.geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_top_of_isEmpty_of_nonempty_of_card
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_top_of_isEmpty_of_nonempty_of_card
    {A B : RGraph.RGraphCat} (hA : IsEmpty A.obj.left) (hB : Nonempty B.obj.left)
    [Finite ((RGraph.cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj.obj ⊤)] :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance A B = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_top_of_card_ne
  have : IsEmpty ((RGraph.cosheafFunctor.obj A).obj.obj ⊤) := ⟨fun c => by
    change ZerothHomotopy _ at c
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x => exact hA.false x.1⟩
  have : Nonempty ((RGraph.cosheafFunctor.obj B).obj.obj ⊤) :=
    ⟨(ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨hB.some, trivial⟩ :
      (intervalComponents (overBaseMap B.obj)).obj ⊤)⟩
  rw [Nat.card_of_isEmpty]
  exact (Nat.card_pos).ne

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.value_ne
statement:
theorem value_ne {j : Fin m} {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ (T.K j : Set ℝ)) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    S.value i ≠ s
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hST ⟨i, rfl⟩
  exact T.value_notMem_K j k (by rw [hk, h]; exact hs)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.mem_K_of_ne
statement:
theorem mem_K_of_ne {e : Fin n} {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Icc (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ))
    (hne : ∀ i, S.value i ≠ s) : s ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)
proof:
:=
  S.mem_K.2 ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hs.1 (hne _), lt_of_le_of_ne hs.2 (hne _).symm⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hST ⟨e.castSucc, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨k', hk'⟩ := hST ⟨e.succ, rfl⟩
  have hxe' := S.mem_K.1 hxe
  have h1 : k < j.succ := T.strictMono.lt_iff_lt.1 (by rw [hk]; exact hxe'.1.trans_le hx.2)
  have h2 : j.castSucc < k' := T.strictMono.lt_iff_lt.1 (by rw [hk']; exact hx.1.trans_lt hxe'.2)
  have h1' : k ≤ j.castSucc := Fin.le_castSucc_iff.2 h1
  have h2' : j.succ ≤ k' := by
    rw [Fin.le_iff_val_le_val]
    have := Fin.lt_def.1 h2
    simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at this ⊢
    omega
  intro s hs
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hk]; exact (T.strictMono.monotone h1').trans hs.1
  · rw [← hk']; exact hs.2.trans (T.strictMono.monotone h2')

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.cylAt_congr
statement:
theorem cylAt_congr (j : Fin m) {e e' : Fin n} (z : D.E e) (z' : D.E e')
    (h : (basePt T j : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (h' : (basePt T j : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e' : Set ℝ))
    (hzz : (ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z, ⟨_, h⟩) =
      (ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e' (z', ⟨_, h'⟩))
    (t : Seg T j) : cylAt hST D j e z h t = cylAt hST D j e' z' h' t
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : e = e' := S.eq_of_mem_K_of_mem_Icc h (Ioo_subset_Icc_self h')
  obtain rfl : z = z' := congrArg Prod.fst ((ofFiniteData D).ofStrip_injective S e hzz)
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.exists_edge_rep
statement:
theorem exists_edge_rep (j : Fin m) (y : (ofFiniteData D).height S ⁻¹' {(basePt T j : ℝ)}) :
    ∃ (e : Fin n) (h : (basePt T j : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (z : D.E e),
      y.1 = (ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z, ⟨_, h⟩)
proof:
:=
  exists_strip_rep (ofFiniteData D) y.1 y.2 (value_ne hST (basePt T j).2)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.edgePoint_eq
statement:
theorem edgePoint_eq (j : Fin m) (y : (ofFiniteData D).height S ⁻¹' {(basePt T j : ℝ)})
    {e : Fin n} (z : D.E e) (h : (basePt T j : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (hy : y.1 = (ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z, ⟨_, h⟩)) (t : Seg T j) :
    edgePoint hST D j y t = cylAt hST D j e z h t
proof:
:=
  cylAt_congr hST D j _ _ _ _
    ((exists_edge_rep hST D j y).choose_spec.choose_spec.choose_spec.symm.trans hy) t

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.continuous_edgePoint
statement:
theorem continuous_edgePoint (j : Fin m)
    (y : (ofFiniteData D).height S ⁻¹' {(basePt T j : ℝ)}) :
    Continuous (edgePoint hST D j y)
proof:
:=
  ((ofFiniteData D).continuous_ofCylinder S _).comp
    (continuous_const.prodMk (continuous_subtype_val.subtype_mk _))

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.edgePoint_inj
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, hs, z, hy⟩ := exists_edge_rep hST D j y
  obtain ⟨e', hs', z', hy'⟩ := exists_edge_rep hST D j y'
  rw [edgePoint_eq hST D j y z hs hy, edgePoint_eq hST D j y' z' hs' hy'] at hyy
  have hte : (t : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) :=
    mem_K_of_ne (Icc_subset_of_mem hST (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (basePt T j).2) hs t.2) hns
  have hte' : (t : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e' : Set ℝ) :=
    mem_K_of_ne (Icc_subset_of_mem hST (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (basePt T j).2) hs' t.2) hns
  obtain rfl : e = e' := S.eq_of_mem_K_of_mem_Icc hte (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hte')
  have h2 : (ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z, ⟨t, hte⟩) =
      (ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z', ⟨t, hte'⟩) := hyy
  obtain rfl : z = z' := congrArg Prod.fst ((ofFiniteData D).ofStrip_injective S e h2)
  exact Subtype.ext (hy.trans hy'.symm)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.height_refineMap
statement:
theorem height_refineMap (q : (ofFiniteData (refineData hST D)).Realization T) :
    (ofFiniteData D).height S (refineMap hST D q) =
      (ofFiniteData (refineData hST D)).height T q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (ofFiniteData (refineData hST D)).quotMk_surjective T q
  rcases x with ⟨j, v⟩ | ⟨j, y, t⟩
  · exact v.2
  · rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.refineMap_injective
statement: theorem refineMap_injective : Function.Injective (refineMap hST D)
proof:
:= by
  intro p p' hpp
  have hh : (ofFiniteData (refineData hST D)).height T p =
      (ofFiniteData (refineData hST D)).height T p' := by
    rw [← height_refineMap, ← height_refineMap, hpp]
  rcases (ofFiniteData (refineData hST D)).exists_rep T p with ⟨j, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, a, rfl⟩ <;>
    rcases (ofFiniteData (refineData hST D)).exists_rep T p' with ⟨j', v', rfl⟩ | ⟨j', a', rfl⟩
  · have hj : T.value j = T.value j' := hh
    obtain rfl : j = j' := T.strictMono.injective hj
    obtain rfl : v = v' := Subtype.ext hpp
    rfl
  · have hj : T.value j = a'.2 := hh
    exact absurd (hj ▸ a'.2.2) (T.value_notMem_K j' j)
  · have hj : (a.2 : ℝ) = T.value j' := hh
    exact absurd (hj ▸ a.2.2) (T.value_notMem_K j j')
  · have hh' : (a.2 : ℝ) = a'.2 := hh
    obtain rfl : j = j' := T.eq_of_mem_K_of_mem_Icc a.2.2 (hh' ▸ Ioo_subset_Icc_self a'.2.2)
    obtain ⟨y, t⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨y', t'⟩ := a'
    obtain rfl : t = t' := Subtype.ext hh'
    obtain rfl : y = y' :=
      edgePoint_inj hST D j (y := y) (y' := y') (gapIncl T j t) (value_ne hST t.2) hpp
    rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.refineMap_surjective
statement: theorem refineMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (refineMap hST D)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  by_cases hT : ∃ j, T.value j = (ofFiniteData D).height S q
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hT
    exact ⟨(ofFiniteData (refineData hST D)).ofVertex T j ⟨q, hj.symm⟩, rfl⟩
  · push Not at hT
    have hS : ∀ i, S.value i ≠ (ofFiniteData D).height S q := fun i h => by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hST ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact hT k (hk.trans h)
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, (ofFiniteData D).height S q ∈ (T.K j : Set ℝ) := by
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpl⟩ := T.exists_piece ((ofFiniteData D).height S q)
      cases p with
      | star i => exact absurd (hpl i (T.value_mem_J i)) (hT i)
      | gap j => exact ⟨j, hp⟩
      | lowerTail =>
        exfalso
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hST ⟨0, rfl⟩
        have h1 := ((ofFiniteData D).height_mem_Icc S q).1
        have h2 : T.value 0 ≤ T.value k := T.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le k)
        exact absurd (T.mem_lowerTail.1 hp) (not_lt.2 (h2.trans (hk.le.trans h1)))
      | upperTail =>
        exfalso
        obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hST ⟨Fin.last n, rfl⟩
        have h1 := ((ofFiniteData D).height_mem_Icc S q).2
        have h2 : T.value k ≤ T.value (Fin.last m) := T.strictMono.monotone (Fin.le_last k)
        exact absurd (T.mem_upperTail.1 hp) (not_lt.2 (h1.trans (hk.ge.trans h2)))
    obtain ⟨e, he, z, hq⟩ := exists_strip_rep (ofFiniteData D) q rfl hS
    have hsub := Icc_subset_of_mem hST (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hj) he
    have hs : (basePt T j : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) :=
      mem_K_of_ne (hsub (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (basePt T j).2)) (value_ne hST (basePt T j).2)
    let y : (ofFiniteData D).height S ⁻¹' {(basePt T j : ℝ)} :=
      ⟨(ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z, ⟨_, hs⟩), rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(ofFiniteData (refineData hST D)).ofStrip T j (y, ⟨_, hj⟩), ?_⟩
    show edgePoint hST D j y (gapIncl T j ⟨_, hj⟩) = q
    rw [edgePoint_eq hST D j y z hs rfl]
    exact hq.symm

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.height_refineHomeomorph
statement:
theorem height_refineHomeomorph (q : (ofFiniteData (refineData hST D)).Realization T) :
    (ofFiniteData D).height S (refineHomeomorph hST D q) =
      (ofFiniteData (refineData hST D)).height T q
proof:
:=
  height_refineMap hST D q

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.right_bijective
statement:
theorem right_bijective (j : Fin m) (hj : ∀ i, S.value i ≠ T.value j.succ) :
    Function.Bijective ((refineData hST D).right j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun y y' h => edgePoint_inj hST D j (segTop T j) hj (congrArg Subtype.val h), ?_⟩
  intro w
  obtain ⟨e, he, z, hw⟩ := exists_strip_rep (ofFiniteData D) w.1 w.2 hj
  have hsub := Icc_subset_of_mem hST (right_mem_Icc.2 (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ j).le) he
  have hs : (basePt T j : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) :=
    mem_K_of_ne (hsub (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (basePt T j).2)) (value_ne hST (basePt T j).2)
  let y : (ofFiniteData D).height S ⁻¹' {(basePt T j : ℝ)} :=
    ⟨(ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z, ⟨_, hs⟩), rfl⟩
  refine ⟨y, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  show edgePoint hST D j y (segTop T j) = w.1
  rw [edgePoint_eq hST D j y z hs rfl, hw]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.left_bijective
statement:
theorem left_bijective (j : Fin m) (hj : ∀ i, S.value i ≠ T.value j.castSucc) :
    Function.Bijective ((refineData hST D).left j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun y y' h => edgePoint_inj hST D j (segBot T j) hj (congrArg Subtype.val h), ?_⟩
  intro w
  obtain ⟨e, he, z, hw⟩ := exists_strip_rep (ofFiniteData D) w.1 w.2 hj
  have hsub := Icc_subset_of_mem hST (left_mem_Icc.2 (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ j).le) he
  have hs : (basePt T j : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) :=
    mem_K_of_ne (hsub (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (basePt T j).2)) (value_ne hST (basePt T j).2)
  let y : (ofFiniteData D).height S ⁻¹' {(basePt T j : ℝ)} :=
    ⟨(ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z, ⟨_, hs⟩), rfl⟩
  refine ⟨y, Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  show edgePoint hST D j y (segBot T j) = w.1
  rw [edgePoint_eq hST D j y z hs rfl, hw]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isEmpty_refine_V
statement:
theorem isEmpty_refine_V (j : Fin (m + 1))
    (hj : T.value j ∉ Icc (S.value 0) (S.value (Fin.last n))) :
    IsEmpty ((refineData hST D).V j)
proof:
:=
  isEmpty_fiber S (ofFiniteData D) hj

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isEmpty_refine_E
statement:
theorem isEmpty_refine_E (j : Fin m)
    (hj : (basePt T j : ℝ) ∉ Icc (S.value 0) (S.value (Fin.last n))) :
    IsEmpty ((refineData hST D).E j)
proof:
:=
  isEmpty_fiber S (ofFiniteData D) hj

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.basePt_mem_K_of_succ
statement:
theorem basePt_mem_K_of_succ (j : Fin m) (e : Fin n) (h : T.value j.succ ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    (basePt T j : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)
proof:
:=
  mem_K_of_ne (Icc_subset_of_mem hST (right_mem_Icc.2 (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ j).le) h
    (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (basePt T j).2)) (value_ne hST (basePt T j).2)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.basePt_mem_K_of_castSucc
statement:
theorem basePt_mem_K_of_castSucc (j : Fin m) (e : Fin n)
    (h : T.value j.castSucc ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)) : (basePt T j : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)
proof:
:=
  mem_K_of_ne (Icc_subset_of_mem hST (left_mem_Icc.2 (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ j).le) h
    (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (basePt T j).2)) (value_ne hST (basePt T j).2)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.refine_right_eq
statement:
theorem refine_right_eq (j : Fin m) (e : Fin n) (h : T.value j.succ ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (y : (refineData hST D).E j) :
    refineVEquiv hST D j.succ e h ((refineData hST D).right j y) =
      refineEEquiv hST D j e (basePt_mem_K_of_succ hST j e h) y
proof:
:= by
  have h' := basePt_mem_K_of_succ hST j e h
  set z := refineEEquiv hST D j e h' y
  have hy : y.1 = (ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z, ⟨_, h'⟩) :=
    (congrArg Subtype.val
      (((ofFiniteData D).regularFiberHomeomorph S e ⟨_, h'⟩).apply_symm_apply y)).symm
  refine (Equiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 (Subtype.ext ?_)
  show edgePoint hST D j y (segTop T j) = (ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z, ⟨_, h⟩)
  rw [edgePoint_eq hST D j y z h' hy]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.refine_left_eq
statement:
theorem refine_left_eq (j : Fin m) (e : Fin n) (h : T.value j.castSucc ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (y : (refineData hST D).E j) :
    refineVEquiv hST D j.castSucc e h ((refineData hST D).left j y) =
      refineEEquiv hST D j e (basePt_mem_K_of_castSucc hST j e h) y
proof:
:= by
  have h' := basePt_mem_K_of_castSucc hST j e h
  set z := refineEEquiv hST D j e h' y
  have hy : y.1 = (ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z, ⟨_, h'⟩) :=
    (congrArg Subtype.val
      (((ofFiniteData D).regularFiberHomeomorph S e ⟨_, h'⟩).apply_symm_apply y)).symm
  refine (Equiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 (Subtype.ext ?_)
  show edgePoint hST D j y (segBot T j) = (ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z, ⟨_, h⟩)
  rw [edgePoint_eq hST D j y z h' hy]
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.old_level_succ
statement:
theorem old_level_succ (j : Fin m) (e : Fin n) (h' : (basePt T j : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hi : T.value j.succ = S.value i) : i = e.succ
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := Icc_subset_of_mem hST (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (basePt T j).2) h'
    (right_mem_Icc.2 (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ j).le)
  rw [hi] at hmem
  have h1 : i ≤ e.succ := S.strictMono.le_iff_le.1 hmem.2
  have h2 : e.castSucc < i := S.strictMono.lt_iff_lt.1
    ((S.mem_K.1 h').1.trans (hi ▸ (basePt T j).2.2))
  rw [Fin.le_iff_val_le_val] at h1
  rw [Fin.lt_def] at h2
  simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at h1 h2
  exact Fin.ext (by simp only [Fin.val_succ]; omega)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.old_level_castSucc
statement:
theorem old_level_castSucc (j : Fin m) (e : Fin n) (h' : (basePt T j : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (hi : T.value j.castSucc = S.value i) : i = e.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := Icc_subset_of_mem hST (Ioo_subset_Icc_self (basePt T j).2) h'
    (left_mem_Icc.2 (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ j).le)
  rw [hi] at hmem
  have h1 : e.castSucc ≤ i := S.strictMono.le_iff_le.1 hmem.1
  have h2 : i < e.succ := S.strictMono.lt_iff_lt.1
    ((hi ▸ (basePt T j).2.1).trans (S.mem_K.1 h').2)
  rw [Fin.le_iff_val_le_val] at h1
  rw [Fin.lt_def] at h2
  simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at h1 h2
  exact Fin.ext (by simp only [Fin.val_castSucc]; omega)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.refine_right_old
statement:
theorem refine_right_old (j : Fin m) (e : Fin n) (h' : (basePt T j : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (hi : T.value j.succ = S.value e.succ) (y : (refineData hST D).E j) :
    refineVEquivOld hST D j.succ e.succ hi ((refineData hST D).right j y) =
      D.right e (refineEEquiv hST D j e h' y)
proof:
:= by
  set z := refineEEquiv hST D j e h' y
  have hy : y.1 = (ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z, ⟨_, h'⟩) :=
    (congrArg Subtype.val
      (((ofFiniteData D).regularFiberHomeomorph S e ⟨_, h'⟩).apply_symm_apply y)).symm
  have hpt : ((refineData hST D).right j y).1 =
      (ofFiniteData D).ofVertex S e.succ (D.right e z) :=
    calc edgePoint hST D j y (segTop T j) = cylAt hST D j e z h' (segTop T j) :=
          edgePoint_eq hST D j y z h' hy (segTop T j)
      _ = (ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder S e (z, segTop S e) :=
          congrArg (fun p => (ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder S e (z, p)) (Subtype.ext hi)
      _ = _ := (ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder_segTop S e z
  apply (ofFiniteData D).ofVertex_injective S e.succ
  refine Eq.trans ?_ hpt
  exact congrArg Subtype.val
    (((ofFiniteData D).criticalFiberHomeomorph S e.succ).apply_symm_apply _)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.refine_left_old
statement:
theorem refine_left_old (j : Fin m) (e : Fin n) (h' : (basePt T j : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (hi : T.value j.castSucc = S.value e.castSucc) (y : (refineData hST D).E j) :
    refineVEquivOld hST D j.castSucc e.castSucc hi ((refineData hST D).left j y) =
      D.left e (refineEEquiv hST D j e h' y)
proof:
:= by
  set z := refineEEquiv hST D j e h' y
  have hy : y.1 = (ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e (z, ⟨_, h'⟩) :=
    (congrArg Subtype.val
      (((ofFiniteData D).regularFiberHomeomorph S e ⟨_, h'⟩).apply_symm_apply y)).symm
  have hpt : ((refineData hST D).left j y).1 =
      (ofFiniteData D).ofVertex S e.castSucc (D.left e z) :=
    calc edgePoint hST D j y (segBot T j) = cylAt hST D j e z h' (segBot T j) :=
          edgePoint_eq hST D j y z h' hy (segBot T j)
      _ = (ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder S e (z, segBot S e) :=
          congrArg (fun p => (ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder S e (z, p)) (Subtype.ext hi)
      _ = _ := (ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder_segBot S e z
  apply (ofFiniteData D).ofVertex_injective S e.castSucc
  refine Eq.trans ?_ hpt
  exact congrArg Subtype.val
    (((ofFiniteData D).criticalFiberHomeomorph S e.castSucc).apply_symm_apply _)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.exists_common_refinement
statement:
theorem exists_common_refinement {n₁ n₂ : ℕ} (S₁ : CriticalValues n₁) (S₂ : CriticalValues n₂) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (T : CriticalValues m),
      Set.range S₁.value ⊆ Set.range T.value ∧ Set.range S₂.value ⊆ Set.range T.value
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : Finset ℝ := Finset.univ.image S₁.value ∪ Finset.univ.image S₂.value
  have hne : s.card ≠ 0 := Finset.card_ne_zero.2
    ⟨S₁.value 0, Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _))⟩
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, s.card = m + 1 := ⟨s.card - 1, by omega⟩
  refine ⟨m, ⟨s.orderEmbOfFin hm, (s.orderEmbOfFin hm).strictMono⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    show S₁.value i ∈ Set.range (s.orderEmbOfFin hm)
    rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
    exact Finset.mem_coe.2
      (Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)))
  · rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    show S₂.value i ∈ Set.range (s.orderEmbOfFin hm)
    rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
    exact Finset.mem_coe.2
      (Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)))

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.exists_common_presentation
statement:
theorem exists_common_presentation (A B : RGraphCat) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (T : CriticalValues m) (DA DB : FiniteReebData.{0} m),
      Nonempty (A.obj ≅ toOver T DA) ∧ Nonempty (B.obj ≅ toOver T DB)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n₁, S₁, D₁, ⟨i₁⟩⟩ := A.property
  obtain ⟨n₂, S₂, D₂, ⟨i₂⟩⟩ := B.property
  obtain ⟨m, T, h₁, h₂⟩ := exists_common_refinement S₁ S₂
  exact ⟨m, T, refineData h₁ D₁, refineData h₂ D₂, ⟨i₁ ≪≫ (refineIso h₁ D₁).symm⟩,
    ⟨i₂ ≪≫ (refineIso h₂ D₂).symm⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.homEquivOfIso_apply
statement:
theorem homEquivOfIso_apply (iA : A ≅ toOver T DA) (iB : B ≅ toOver T DB) (f : A ⟶ B) :
    (realizationFunctor T).map (homEquivOfIso iA iB f) = iA.inv ≫ f ≫ iB.hom
proof:
:=
  (realizationFullyFaithful T).map_preimage _

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.homEquivOfIso_id
statement: theorem homEquivOfIso_id (iA : A ≅ toOver T DA) : homEquivOfIso iA iA (𝟙 A) = 𝟙 DA
proof:
:= by
  apply (realizationFullyFaithful T).map_injective
  rw [homEquivOfIso_apply, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_id]
  simp

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.homEquivOfIso_comp
statement:
theorem homEquivOfIso_comp (iA : A ≅ toOver T DA) (iB : B ≅ toOver T DB)
    (iC : C ≅ toOver T DC) (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) :
    homEquivOfIso iA iC (f ≫ g) = homEquivOfIso iA iB f ≫ homEquivOfIso iB iC g
proof:
:= by
  apply (realizationFullyFaithful T).map_injective
  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, homEquivOfIso_apply, homEquivOfIso_apply,
    homEquivOfIso_apply]
  simp

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.homEquivOfIso_conj
statement:
theorem homEquivOfIso_conj (iA : A ≅ toOver T DA) (iA' : A ≅ toOver T DA')
    (iB : B ≅ toOver T DB) (iB' : B ≅ toOver T DB') (f : A ⟶ B) :
    homEquivOfIso iA iB f ≫ (presIso iB iB').hom =
      (presIso iA iA').hom ≫ homEquivOfIso iA' iB' f
proof:
:= by
  apply (realizationFullyFaithful T).map_injective
  rw [CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, CategoryTheory.Functor.map_comp, homEquivOfIso_apply,
    homEquivOfIso_apply, presIso, presIso, Functor.FullyFaithful.preimageIso_hom,
    Functor.FullyFaithful.preimageIso_hom, Functor.FullyFaithful.map_preimage,
    Functor.FullyFaithful.map_preimage]
  simp

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.homEquivOfIso_refine
proof:
:= by
  apply (realizationFullyFaithful U).map_injective
  rw [homEquivOfIso_apply, refineHom, Functor.FullyFaithful.map_preimage, homEquivOfIso_apply]
  simp

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.homEquivOfIso_independent
proof:
:= by
  rw [← homEquivOfIso_refine, ← homEquivOfIso_refine]
  exact homEquivOfIso_conj _ _ _ _ f

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.refine_coherent
statement:
theorem refine_coherent {n m l : ℕ} {S : CriticalValues n} {T : CriticalValues m}
    {U : CriticalValues l} (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value)
    (hTU : Set.range T.value ⊆ Set.range U.value) (hSU : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range U.value)
    (D : FiniteReebData.{0} n) :
    ∃! φ : refineData hTU (refineData hST D) ⟶ refineData hSU D,
      (realizationFunctor U).map φ ≫ (refineIso hSU D).hom =
        (refineIso hTU (refineData hST D)).hom ≫ (refineIso hST D).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(realizationFullyFaithful U).preimage
    ((refineIso hTU _).hom ≫ (refineIso hST D).hom ≫ (refineIso hSU D).inv), ?_, ?_⟩
  · beta_reduce
    rw [Functor.FullyFaithful.map_preimage]
    simp
  · intro ψ hψ
    apply (realizationFullyFaithful U).map_injective
    apply (cancel_mono (refineIso hSU D).hom).1
    rw [hψ, Functor.FullyFaithful.map_preimage]
    simp

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.refineCoherentIso_comm
statement:
theorem refineCoherentIso_comm {n m l : ℕ} {S : CriticalValues n} {T : CriticalValues m}
    {U : CriticalValues l} (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value)
    (hTU : Set.range T.value ⊆ Set.range U.value) (hSU : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range U.value)
    (D : FiniteReebData.{0} n) :
    (realizationFunctor U).map (refineCoherentIso hST hTU hSU D).hom ≫ (refineIso hSU D).hom =
      (refineIso hTU (refineData hST D)).hom ≫ (refineIso hST D).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [refineCoherentIso, Functor.FullyFaithful.preimageIso_hom,
    Functor.FullyFaithful.map_preimage]
  simp

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAbsorption.fiber_subsingleton_of_iso
statement:
theorem fiber_subsingleton_of_iso {B B' : RGraphCat} (e : B ≅ B') (t : ℝ)
    (h : Subsingleton (overBaseMap B'.obj ⁻¹' {t})) :
    Subsingleton (overBaseMap B.obj ⁻¹' {t})
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rintro ⟨x₁, h₁⟩ ⟨x₂, h₂⟩
  have hh : ∀ x, overBaseMap B'.obj (e.hom.hom.left.hom x) = overBaseMap B.obj x :=
    overBaseMap_comm e.hom.hom
  have hinv : ∀ x, e.inv.hom.left.hom (e.hom.hom.left.hom x) = x := fun x =>
    congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom.left.hom x) e.hom_inv_id
  have hx := congrArg Subtype.val
    (h.elim ⟨_, (hh x₁).trans (Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 h₁)⟩
      ⟨_, (hh x₂).trans (Set.mem_singleton_iff.1 h₂)⟩)
  exact Subtype.ext ((hinv x₁).symm.trans ((congrArg e.inv.hom.left.hom hx).trans (hinv x₂)))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAbsorption.edge_projNatTrans_not_isIso
statement:
theorem edge_projNatTrans_not_isIso :
    ¬ IsIso ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app ((functor quarter).obj edgeObj)) ∧
      IsIso ((ℛ).map ((functor quarter).map
        ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app ((functor quarter).obj edgeObj))))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hiso => ?_, isIso_quotientFunctor_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app_thickening
    singleGraph quarter quarter⟩
  have hne : ((edgePt, zeroQ) : edgeObj.left × Band quarter) ≠ (edgeQuarterPt, quarterPt) :=
    fun h => by
      have h' := congrArg (fun z : edgeObj.left × Band quarter => (z.2 : ℝ)) h
      change (0 : ℝ) = quarter at h'
      rw [coe_quarter] at h'
      norm_num at h'
  have hmk : ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) quarter) (edgePt, zeroQ) =
      ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) quarter) (edgeQuarterPt, quarterPt) :=
    ReebQuotient.mk_eq_mk_of_path _ edgeFiberPath fun r => by
      show (1 / 2 - (r : ℝ) / 4) + (r : ℝ) / 4 = 1 / 2 + 0
      ring
  have hinv : ∀ z, (inv ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app
      ((functor quarter).obj edgeObj))).left.hom
        (ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) quarter) z) = z := fun z =>
    congrArg (fun φ => φ.left.hom z)
      (IsIso.hom_inv_id ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app ((functor quarter).obj edgeObj)))
  exact hne ((hinv _).symm.trans ((congrArg _ hmk).trans (hinv _)))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAbsorption.par_absorption_inv
statement:
theorem par_absorption_inv :
    inv ((ℛ).map ((functor quarter).map
        ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app parallelGraph.obj))) =
        (ℛ).map ((functor quarter).map (projNatIso.inv.app parallelGraph)) ∧
      ((ℛ).map ((functor quarter).map (projNatIso.inv.app parallelGraph))).left.hom
          (ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj parObj)) quarter)
            (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap parObj) (parPt true), quarterPt)) =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) quarter) (parPt true, quarterPt) ∧
      (inv ((ℛ).map ((functor quarter).map
          ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app parallelGraph.obj)))).left.hom
          (ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj parObj)) quarter)
            (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap parObj) (parPt true), quarterPt)) =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) quarter) (parPt true, quarterPt)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (projNatIso.inv.app parallelGraph).left.hom
      (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap parObj) (parPt true)) = parPt true :=
    congrArg (fun φ => φ.left.hom (parPt true)) (projNatIso.hom_inv_id_app parallelGraph)
  have h₂ : ((ℛ).map ((functor quarter).map (projNatIso.inv.app parallelGraph))).left.hom
      (ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap ((ℛ).obj parObj)) quarter)
        (ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap parObj) (parPt true), quarterPt)) =
      ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) quarter) (parPt true, quarterPt) :=
    congrArg (fun x => ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) quarter) (x, quarterPt)) hp
  exact ⟨inv_quotientFunctor_map_functor_map_projNatTrans_app_of_isRGraph parallelGraph quarter,
    h₂, absorption_inv_mk (isConstructibleSpace_of_isRGraph parallelGraph.property) quarter
      (isRGraph_quotient_of_isConstructibleSpace
        (isConstructibleSpace_thickening parallelGraph.property quarter)) (parPt true) quarterPt⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAbsorption.quotientFunctor_map_projNatTrans_app
statement:
theorem quotientFunctor_map_projNatTrans_app (X : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)) :
    (ℛ).map ((ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app X) =
      (ReebQuotient.projNatTrans ℝ).app ((ℛ).obj X)
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h x => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAbsorption.point_compIso_zero_left_apply
statement:
theorem point_compIso_zero_left_apply (x : pointGraph.obj.left) (s : Band 1) :
    ((geometricSmoothingCompIso 0 1 ≪≫ geometricSmoothingEqIso (zero_add 1)).hom.app
        pointGraph).hom.left.hom
        (ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing 1).obj pointGraph).obj) 0)
          (ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap pointGraph.obj) 1) (x, s),
            ⟨0, zero_mem_band 0⟩)) =
      ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap pointGraph.obj) 1) (x, s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricSmoothingCompIso_zero_left]
  exact geometricSmoothingZeroIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk _ _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAbsorption.edge_compIso_apply
statement:
theorem edge_compIso_apply :
    ((geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter quarter).hom.app singleGraph).hom.left.hom edgeCls =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) (quarter + quarter)) (edgePt, halfPt) ∧
      ((geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter quarter).inv.app singleGraph).hom.left.hom
          (ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) (quarter + quarter)) (edgePt, halfPt)) =
        edgeCls
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk quarter quarter singleGraph
    (edgePt, quarterPt) quarterPt).trans (congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) (Prod.ext rfl
      (Subtype.ext (show (quarter : ℝ) + quarter = 1 / 2 by rw [coe_quarter]; norm_num)))), ?_⟩
  have hc : (projIcc (-(quarter : ℝ)) quarter (neg_le_band quarter) (1 / 2) : ℝ) = 1 / 4 := by
    rw [coe_projIcc, coe_quarter, min_eq_left (by norm_num), max_eq_right (by norm_num)]
  have hσ : addSection edgeObj.left quarter quarter (edgePt, halfPt) =
      ((edgePt, quarterPt), quarterPt) := by
    refine Prod.ext (Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext ?_)) (Subtype.ext ?_)
    · show (projIcc (-(quarter : ℝ)) quarter (neg_le_band quarter) (1 / 2) : ℝ) = quarter
      rw [hc, coe_quarter]
    · show (1 / 2 : ℝ) - (projIcc (-(quarter : ℝ)) quarter (neg_le_band quarter) (1 / 2) : ℝ) =
        quarter
      rw [hc, coe_quarter]
      norm_num
  refine (geometricSmoothingCompIso_inv_app_hom_left_mk quarter quarter singleGraph
    (edgePt, halfPt)).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun w : (edgeObj.left × Band quarter) × Band quarter =>
    ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj singleGraph).obj)
      quarter) (ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) quarter) w.1, w.2)) hσ

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAbsorption.edge_compIso_assoc
statement:
theorem edge_compIso_assoc :
    ((Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (geometricSmoothing quarter)
          (geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter quarter) ≪≫
        geometricSmoothingCompIso (quarter + quarter) quarter ≪≫
          geometricSmoothingEqIso (add_assoc quarter quarter quarter)).hom.app
          singleGraph).hom.left.hom edgeCls₃ =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) (quarter + (quarter + quarter)))
          (edgePt, threeQuarterPt) ∧
      ((Functor.isoWhiskerRight (geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter quarter)
          (geometricSmoothing quarter) ≪≫
          geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter (quarter + quarter)).hom.app
          singleGraph).hom.left.hom edgeCls₃ =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) (quarter + (quarter + quarter)))
          (edgePt, threeQuarterPt)
proof:
:= by
  have e3 := geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk quarter quarter singleGraph
    (edgePt, quarterPt) quarterPt
  have e4 := geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk quarter (quarter + quarter) singleGraph
    (addMap edgeObj.left quarter quarter ((edgePt, quarterPt), quarterPt)) quarterPt
  have hR : ((Functor.isoWhiskerRight (geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter quarter)
      (geometricSmoothing quarter) ≪≫
        geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter (quarter + quarter)).hom.app
        singleGraph).hom.left.hom edgeCls₃ =
      ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) (quarter + (quarter + quarter)))
        (edgePt, threeQuarterPt) :=
    ((congrArg (fun w => ((geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter (quarter + quarter)).hom.app
      singleGraph).hom.left.hom (ReebQuotient.mk _ (w, quarterPt))) e3).trans e4).trans
      (congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) (Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext
        (show (quarter : ℝ) + quarter + quarter = 3 / 4 by rw [coe_quarter]; norm_num))))
  exact ⟨(congrArg (fun φ => (φ.hom.app singleGraph).hom.left.hom edgeCls₃)
    (geometricSmoothingCompIso_assoc quarter quarter quarter)).trans hR, hR⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAbsorption.edge_cosheaf_square_top
statement:
theorem edge_cosheaf_square_top :
    ((cosheafFunctor.map ((geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter quarter).hom.app singleGraph)).hom ≫
        ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso (quarter + quarter)).hom.app singleGraph).hom).app ⊤
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgeCls, Set.mem_univ _⟩) =
        ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨edgePt, (by rw [thicken_top]; exact Set.mem_univ _)⟩ :
          {x : edgeObj.left // overBaseMap edgeObj x ∈ thicken (quarter + quarter) ⊤}) ∧
      (((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso quarter).hom.app
          ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj singleGraph)).hom ≫
        (smoothing quarter).map ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso quarter).hom.app
          singleGraph).hom ≫
          (smoothingCompIso quarter quarter).hom.app
            (intervalComponentsOver.obj singleGraph.obj)).app ⊤
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgeCls, Set.mem_univ _⟩) =
        ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨edgePt, (by rw [thicken_top]; exact Set.mem_univ _)⟩ :
          {x : edgeObj.left // overBaseMap edgeObj x ∈ thicken (quarter + quarter) ⊤})
proof:
:= by
  have r1 := geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk quarter
    ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj singleGraph) ⊤
    ⟨(ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap edgeObj) quarter) (edgePt, quarterPt), quarterPt),
      Set.mem_univ _⟩
  have r2 := geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk quarter singleGraph
    (thicken quarter ⊤) ⟨(edgePt, quarterPt), (by rw [thicken_top]; exact Set.mem_univ _)⟩
  have hR : (((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso quarter).hom.app
          ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj singleGraph)).hom ≫
        (smoothing quarter).map ((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso quarter).hom.app
          singleGraph).hom ≫
          (smoothingCompIso quarter quarter).hom.app
            (intervalComponentsOver.obj singleGraph.obj)).app ⊤
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgeCls, Set.mem_univ _⟩) =
        ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨edgePt, (by rw [thicken_top]; exact Set.mem_univ _)⟩ :
          {x : edgeObj.left // overBaseMap edgeObj x ∈ thicken (quarter + quarter) ⊤}) :=
    (congrArg (fun w =>
      ((smoothingCompIso quarter quarter).hom.app (intervalComponentsOver.obj singleGraph.obj)).app
        ⊤ (((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso quarter).hom.app singleGraph).hom.app
          (thicken quarter ⊤) w)) r1).trans
      (congrArg (fun w =>
        ((smoothingCompIso quarter quarter).hom.app
          (intervalComponentsOver.obj singleGraph.obj)).app ⊤ w) r2)
  exact ⟨(ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (NatTrans.congr_app
    (cosheafFunctor_map_geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app quarter quarter singleGraph) ⊤)
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgeCls, Set.mem_univ _⟩)).trans hR, hR⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAbsorption.swap_geometricSmoothingCompIso_square_apply
statement:
theorem swap_geometricSmoothingCompIso_square_apply :
    (((geometricSmoothing quarter ⋙ geometricSmoothing quarter).map swapGraph ≫
        (geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter quarter).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
        (parCls true) =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) (quarter + quarter)) (parPt false, parW)) ∧
      (((geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter quarter).hom.app parallelGraph ≫
        (geometricSmoothing (quarter + quarter)).map swapGraph).hom.left.hom (parCls true) =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) (quarter + quarter)) (parPt false, parW)) ∧
      ((geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter quarter).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
          (parCls true) =
        ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) (quarter + quarter))
          (addMap parObj.left quarter quarter (parZ true)) ∧
      ((parPt false, parW) : parObj.left × Band (quarter + quarter)) ≠
        addMap parObj.left quarter quarter (parZ true)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : ((geometricSmoothing quarter ⋙ geometricSmoothing quarter).map swapGraph ≫
      (geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter quarter).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
        (parCls true) =
      ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) (quarter + quarter)) (parPt false, parW) :=
    (geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk quarter quarter parallelGraph
      (parPt false, quarterPt) negQuarterPt).trans swap_geometricSmoothingAddIso_square_apply.1
  exact ⟨h₁, (congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom.left.hom (parCls true))
    ((geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter quarter).hom.naturality swapGraph)).symm.trans h₁,
    geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk quarter quarter parallelGraph
      (parPt true, quarterPt) negQuarterPt, swap_image_ne⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAbsorption.par_quarter_classes_ne
statement:
theorem par_quarter_classes_ne :
    ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) Examples.ConstructibleSmoothing.quarter)
        (parPt false, ⟨0, zero_mem_band _⟩) ≠
      ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) Examples.ConstructibleSmoothing.quarter)
        (parPt true, ⟨0, zero_mem_band _⟩)
proof:
:= by
  intro hq
  let z : Bool → {z : parallelGraph.obj.left × Band Examples.ConstructibleSmoothing.quarter //
      height (overBaseMap parallelGraph.obj) Examples.ConstructibleSmoothing.quarter z ∈
        ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4)} := fun b =>
    ⟨(parPt b, ⟨0, zero_mem_band _⟩), by
      show (1 / 2 : ℝ) + 0 ∈ ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4)
      rw [mem_ioo]
      constructor <;> norm_num⟩
  have hc := congrArg (((geometricSmoothingComparisonIso
    Examples.ConstructibleSmoothing.quarter).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.app (ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4)))
    (congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (Subtype.ext hq :
      (⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ (z false).1, (z false).2⟩ :
        {q : ReebQuotient (height (overBaseMap parallelGraph.obj)
          Examples.ConstructibleSmoothing.quarter) //
            ReebQuotient.height _ q ∈ ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4)}) =
        ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ (z true).1, (z true).2⟩))
  rw [geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk,
    geometricSmoothingComparisonIso_hom_app_hom_app_mk] at hc
  have key : ∀ (L : OpenInterval), L = S01.K 0 →
      ∀ (h0 : (ofFiniteData parallelData).height S01 (parPt false) ∈ L)
        (h1 : (ofFiniteData parallelData).height S01 (parPt true) ∈ L),
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨parPt false, h0⟩ : (parallelData.toCosheaf S01).obj L) ≠
        ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨parPt true, h1⟩ := by
    rintro L rfl h0 h1 hne
    exact Bool.false_ne_true ((parallelData.edgeLabel S01 0).injective
      (((parallelData.edgeLabel_apply S01 0 Examples.Cylinder.half false).trans hne).trans
        (parallelData.edgeLabel_apply S01 0 Examples.Cylinder.half true).symm))
  exact key _ quarter_thicken _ _ hc

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.QuotientThickeningAbsorption.swap_geometricSmoothingCompIso_eighth_square_apply
statement:
theorem swap_geometricSmoothingCompIso_eighth_square_apply :
    ((geometricSmoothing eighth ⋙ geometricSmoothing eighth).map swapGraph ≫
        (geometricSmoothingCompIso eighth eighth).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
        (parCls₈ true) =
        ((geometricSmoothingCompIso eighth eighth).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
          (parCls₈ false) ∧
      ((geometricSmoothingCompIso eighth eighth).hom.app parallelGraph ≫
        (geometricSmoothing (eighth + eighth)).map swapGraph).hom.left.hom (parCls₈ true) =
        ((geometricSmoothingCompIso eighth eighth).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
          (parCls₈ false) ∧
      ((geometricSmoothingCompIso eighth eighth).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
          (parCls₈ false) ≠
        ((geometricSmoothingCompIso eighth eighth).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
          (parCls₈ true)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : ((geometricSmoothing eighth ⋙ geometricSmoothing eighth).map swapGraph ≫
      (geometricSmoothingCompIso eighth eighth).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
        (parCls₈ true) =
      ((geometricSmoothingCompIso eighth eighth).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
        (parCls₈ false) :=
    rfl
  refine ⟨h₁, (congrArg (fun φ => φ.hom.left.hom (parCls₈ true))
    ((geometricSmoothingCompIso eighth eighth).hom.naturality swapGraph)).symm.trans h₁,
    fun h => par_quarter_classes_ne ?_⟩
  have e : ∀ b, ((geometricSmoothingEqIso eighth_add_eighth).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
      (((geometricSmoothingCompIso eighth eighth).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
        (parCls₈ b)) =
      ReebQuotient.mk (height (overBaseMap parObj) Examples.ConstructibleSmoothing.quarter)
        (parPt b, ⟨0, zero_mem_band _⟩) := fun b =>
    (congrArg ((geometricSmoothingEqIso eighth_add_eighth).hom.app parallelGraph).hom.left.hom
      (geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk eighth eighth parallelGraph
        (parPt b, zeroE) zeroE)).trans
      (congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) (Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext (add_zero (0 : ℝ)))))
  exact (e false).symm.trans ((congrArg _ h).trans (e true))

  ext x
  rw [S3.mem_J, h₁, h₂, mem_ioi, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, EReal.coe_lt_top x⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_K0
statement: theorem S3_K0 : S3.K 0 = ioo 0 1
proof: := by simp [CriticalValues.K, S3]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_K1
statement: theorem S3_K1 : S3.K 1 = ioo 1 2
proof: := by simp [CriticalValues.K, S3]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_lowerTail
statement: theorem S3_lowerTail : S3.lowerTail = iio 0
proof: := by simp [CriticalValues.lowerTail, S3]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_cover
statement: theorem S3_cover : ⋃ i, (S3.J i : Set ℝ) = (⊤ : OpenInterval)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_iUnion, coe_top, mem_univ, iff_true, SetLike.mem_coe]
  rcases lt_or_ge x 1 with h | h
  · exact ⟨0, by rw [S3_J0]; exact h⟩
  rcases lt_or_ge x 2 with h' | h'
  · exact ⟨1, by rw [S3_J1]; exact ⟨by linarith, h'⟩⟩
  · exact ⟨2, by rw [S3_J2]; exact (show (1 : ℝ) < x by linarith)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_inf01
statement: theorem S3_inf01 : S3.J 0 ⊓ S3.J 1 = S3.K 0
proof: := S3.J_castSucc_inf_J_succ 0

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_inf12
statement: theorem S3_inf12 : S3.J 1 ⊓ S3.J 2 = S3.K 1
proof: := S3.J_castSucc_inf_J_succ 1

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_inf02
statement: theorem S3_inf02 : S3.J 0 ⊓ S3.J 2 = ⊥
proof: := S3.J_inf_J_eq_bot (by simp)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_envelope_iio
statement: theorem S3_envelope_iio : S3.envelope (iio (1 / 2)) = iio 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← S3_J0]
  refine S3.envelope_eq_J (by rw [S3_J0]; exact fun x (hx : x < 1 / 2) => mem_iio.2 (by linarith))
    (mem_iio.2 (by simp [S3]))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_envelope_ioi
statement: theorem S3_envelope_ioi : S3.envelope (ioi (3 / 2)) = ioi 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← S3_J2]
  refine S3.envelope_eq_J (by rw [S3_J2]; exact fun x (hx : 3 / 2 < x) => mem_ioi.2 (by linarith))
    (mem_ioi.2 (by simp [S3]; norm_num))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_envelope_top
statement: theorem S3_envelope_top : S3.envelope ⊤ = ⊤
proof: := le_antisymm le_top (S3.le_envelope ⊤)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_envelope_lowerRay
statement: theorem S3_envelope_lowerRay : S3.envelope (iio (-1)) = iio 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← S3_lowerTail]
  exact S3.envelope_eq_lowerTail (by
    rw [S3_lowerTail]; exact fun x (hx : x < -1) => mem_iio.2 (by linarith))
    ⟨-2, mem_iio.2 (by norm_num)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_envelope_not_inf
statement:
theorem S3_envelope_not_inf :
    S3.envelope (ioo (1 / 4) (1 / 3)) = S3.K 0 ∧ S3.envelope (ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 4)) = S3.K 0 ∧
      S3.envelope (ioo (1 / 4) (1 / 3) ⊓ ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 4)) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨S3.envelope_eq_K ?_ ⟨0.3, ?_⟩, S3.envelope_eq_K ?_ ⟨0.6, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [S3_K0]; exact fun x hx => mem_ioo.2 ⟨by linarith [(mem_ioo.1 hx).1],
      by linarith [(mem_ioo.1 hx).2]⟩
  · exact mem_ioo.2 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  · rw [S3_K0]; exact fun x hx => mem_ioo.2 ⟨by linarith [(mem_ioo.1 hx).1],
      by linarith [(mem_ioo.1 hx).2]⟩
  · exact mem_ioo.2 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  · refine S3.envelope_eq_bot fun ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ => ?_
    linarith [(mem_ioo.1 hx₁).2, (mem_ioo.1 hx₂).1]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_envelope_middle
statement: theorem S3_envelope_middle : S3.envelope (ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2)) = ioo 0 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← S3_J1]
  exact S3.envelope_eq_J (by
    rw [S3_J1]; exact fun x hx => mem_ioo.2 ⟨by linarith [(mem_ioo.1 hx).1],
      by linarith [(mem_ioo.1 hx).2]⟩) (mem_ioo.2 ⟨by simp [S3]; norm_num, by simp [S3]; norm_num⟩)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.starFamily_compat
statement:
theorem starFamily_compat (hbot : IsEmpty (F.obj ⊥)) (φ : S3.ShortMaps F G) (k l : Fin 3)
    (c : F.obj (S3.J k ⊓ S3.J l)) :
    starFamily φ k (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) =
      starFamily φ l (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold starFamily
  fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l
  · exact congrArg _ (congrArg _ (map_apply_eq_of_thin F _ _ c))
  · exact compat_of_inf_le le_top le_top (S3.K_le_J_castSucc 0) (S3.K_le_J_succ 0)
      S3_inf01.le _ _ (φ.gap 0) (φ.left_comm 0) (φ.right_comm 0) c
  · exact ((isEmpty_of_le_bot hbot S3_inf02.le).false c).elim
  · exact compat_of_inf_le le_top le_top (S3.K_le_J_succ 0) (S3.K_le_J_castSucc 0)
      (by rw [inf_comm]; exact S3_inf01.le) _ _ (φ.gap 0) (φ.right_comm 0) (φ.left_comm 0) c
  · exact congrArg _ (congrArg _ (map_apply_eq_of_thin F _ _ c))
  · exact compat_of_inf_le le_top le_top (S3.K_le_J_castSucc 1) (S3.K_le_J_succ 1)
      S3_inf12.le _ _ (φ.gap 1) (φ.left_comm 1) (φ.right_comm 1) c
  · exact ((isEmpty_of_le_bot hbot (by rw [inf_comm]; exact S3_inf02.le)).false c).elim
  · exact compat_of_inf_le le_top le_top (S3.K_le_J_succ 1) (S3.K_le_J_castSucc 1)
      (by rw [inf_comm]; exact S3_inf12.le) _ _ (φ.gap 1) (φ.right_comm 1) (φ.left_comm 1) c
  · exact congrArg _ (congrArg _ (map_apply_eq_of_thin F _ _ c))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.glueTop_map
statement:
theorem glueTop_map (φ : S3.ShortMaps F G) (i : Fin 3) (x : F.obj (S3.J i)) :
    glueTop hF φ (F.map (homOfLE le_top) x) = G.map (homOfLE le_top) (φ.star i x)
proof:
:=
  hF.glue_map i _ x

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.eq_glueTop
statement:
theorem eq_glueTop (φ : S3.ShortMaps F G) (g : F.obj ⊤ → G.obj ⊤)
    (hg : ∀ i x, g (F.map (homOfLE le_top) x) = G.map (homOfLE le_top) (φ.star i x)) :
    g = glueTop hF φ
proof:
:=
  hF.eq_glue g fun i x => (congrArg g (map_apply_eq_of_thin F _ _ x)).trans (hg i x)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.J1_cover
statement: theorem J1_cover : ⋃ _ : Unit, (S3.J 1 : Set ℝ) = S3.J 1
proof: := iUnion_const _

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.glueJ1_eq
statement: theorem glueJ1_eq (φ : S3.ShortMaps F G) : glueJ1 hF φ = φ.star 1
proof:
:=
  (hF.eq_glue (φ.star 1) fun _ x => congrArg _ (map_self_apply _ x)).symm

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.fringe_square
statement:
theorem fringe_square (φ : S3.ShortMaps F G) (x : F.obj (S3.K 0)) :
    G.map (homOfLE (S3.K_le_J_succ 0)) (φ.gap 0 x) =
      glueJ1 hF φ (F.map (homOfLE (S3.K_le_J_succ 0)) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [glueJ1_eq]; exact φ.right_comm 0 x

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.glueJ1_comp_map
statement:
theorem glueJ1_comp_map (φ : S3.ShortMaps F G) (x : F.obj (S3.J 1)) :
    G.map (homOfLE le_top) (glueJ1 hF φ x) = glueTop hF φ (F.map (homOfLE le_top) x)
proof:
:=
  hF.glue_comp_map (le_top : S3.J 1 ≤ ⊤) (fun _ => (1 : Fin 3)) (fun _ => le_rfl)
    (G.map (homOfLE le_top)) (fun _ e => by
      show G.map (homOfLE le_top) (φ.star 1 e) = G.map (homOfLE le_top) (φ.star 1 _)
      rw [map_self_apply]) x

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.U2_cover
statement: theorem U2_cover : ⋃ k, (U2 k : Set ℝ) = iio 2
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_iUnion, Fin.exists_fin_two]
  show x ∈ S3.J 0 ∨ x ∈ S3.J 1 ↔ x ∈ iio 2
  rw [S3_J0, S3_J1, mem_iio, mem_ioo, mem_iio]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨-, h⟩) <;> linarith
  · intro h
    by_cases h₁ : x < 1
    · exact Or.inl h₁
    · exact Or.inr ⟨by linarith, h⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.U2_le
statement: theorem U2_le (k : Fin 2) : U2 k ≤ iio 2
proof: := le_of_iUnion_eq U2_cover k

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_envelope_U
statement: theorem S3_envelope_U : S3.envelope (iio 2) = iio 2
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx => ?_) (S3.le_envelope _)
  obtain ⟨-, h₂⟩ := S3.mem_envelope.1 hx
  exact mem_iio.2 (by simpa [S3] using h₂ 2 fun y (hy : y < 2) => by simpa [S3] using hy)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.U2Family_compat
statement:
theorem U2Family_compat (φ : S3.ShortMaps F G) (k l : Fin 2) (c : F.obj (U2 k ⊓ U2 l)) :
    U2Family φ k (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) =
      U2Family φ l (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold U2Family
  fin_cases k <;> fin_cases l
  · exact congrArg _ (congrArg _ (map_apply_eq_of_thin F _ _ c))
  · exact compat_of_inf_le (U2_le 0) (U2_le 1) (S3.K_le_J_castSucc 0) (S3.K_le_J_succ 0)
      S3_inf01.le _ _ (φ.gap 0) (φ.left_comm 0) (φ.right_comm 0) c
  · exact compat_of_inf_le (U2_le 1) (U2_le 0) (S3.K_le_J_succ 0) (S3.K_le_J_castSucc 0)
      (by rw [inf_comm]; exact S3_inf01.le) _ _ (φ.gap 0) (φ.right_comm 0) (φ.left_comm 0) c
  · exact congrArg _ (congrArg _ (map_apply_eq_of_thin F _ _ c))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.K1_le_U
statement: theorem K1_le_U : S3.K 1 ≤ iio 2
proof: := (S3.K_le_J_castSucc 1).trans (U2_le 1)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.fringe_square_U
statement:
theorem fringe_square_U (φ : S3.ShortMaps F G) (x : F.obj (S3.K 1)) :
    G.map (homOfLE K1_le_U) (φ.gap 1 x) = glueU hF φ (F.map (homOfLE K1_le_U) x)
proof:
:= by
  have hK : S3.K 1 ≤ U2 1 := S3.K_le_J_castSucc 1
  unfold glueU
  rw [← map_map_apply_of_thin F (homOfLE hK) (homOfLE (U2_le 1)) (homOfLE K1_le_U) x,
    hF.glue_map (1 : Fin 2)]
  exact (map_map_apply_of_thin G (homOfLE hK) (homOfLE (U2_le 1)) (homOfLE K1_le_U)
    (φ.gap 1 x)).symm.trans (congrArg (G.map (homOfLE (U2_le 1))) (φ.left_comm 1 x))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.Isrc_cover
statement: theorem Isrc_cover : ⋃ k, (Isrc k : Set ℝ) = iio 2
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_iUnion, Fin.exists_fin_two]
  show x ∈ iio (1 / 2) ∨ x ∈ S3.J 1 ↔ x ∈ iio 2
  rw [S3_J1, mem_iio, mem_ioo, mem_iio]
  constructor
  · rintro (h | ⟨-, h⟩) <;> linarith
  · intro h
    by_cases h₁ : x < 1 / 2
    · exact Or.inl h₁
    · exact Or.inr ⟨by linarith, h⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.Isrc_le
statement: theorem Isrc_le (k : Fin 2) : Isrc k ≤ U2 k
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases k
  · show iio (1 / 2) ≤ S3.J 0
    rw [S3_J0]
    exact OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx =>
      show x < 1 from lt_trans (mem_iio.1 hx) (by norm_num)
  · exact le_rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.Isrc_lt
statement: theorem Isrc_lt : Isrc 0 < U2 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (Isrc_le 0).lt_of_ne fun h => ?_
  have h₁ : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ∈ U2 0 := by
    show (3 / 4 : ℝ) ∈ S3.J 0
    rw [S3_J0, mem_iio]; norm_num
  rw [← h] at h₁
  exact absurd (mem_iio.1 (show (3 / 4 : ℝ) ∈ iio (1 / 2) from h₁)) (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.IsrcFamily_compat
statement:
theorem IsrcFamily_compat (φ : S3.ShortMaps F G) (k l : Fin 2) (c : F.obj (Isrc k ⊓ Isrc l)) :
    IsrcFamily φ k (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) c) =
      IsrcFamily φ l (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_right) c)
proof:
:=
  compat_comp id Isrc_le (U2Family φ) (U2Family_compat φ) k l c

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.glueIsrc_eq
statement:
theorem glueIsrc_eq (φ : S3.ShortMaps F G) (x : F.obj (iio 2)) :
    hF.glue Isrc Isrc_cover (IsrcFamily φ) (IsrcFamily_compat φ) x = glueU hF φ x
proof:
:=
  (hF.glue_comp_map (hJ := Isrc_cover) (a := IsrcFamily φ) (ha := IsrcFamily_compat φ)
    (hH := U2_cover) (b := U2Family φ) (hb := U2Family_compat φ) (le_rfl : iio 2 ≤ iio 2)
    (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2) Isrc_le id (fun _ _ => rfl) x).trans (congrArg _ (map_self_apply _ x))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.glueIsrc_comp_map
statement:
theorem glueIsrc_comp_map (φ : S3.ShortMaps F G) (x : F.obj (iio 2)) :
    G.map (homOfLE le_top) (hF.glue Isrc Isrc_cover (IsrcFamily φ) (IsrcFamily_compat φ) x) =
      glueTop hF φ (F.map (homOfLE le_top) x)
proof:
:=
  hF.glue_comp_map (hJ := Isrc_cover) (a := IsrcFamily φ) (ha := IsrcFamily_compat φ)
    (hH := S3_cover) (b := starFamily φ) (hb := starFamily_compat hF.isEmpty_obj_bot φ)
    (le_top : iio 2 ≤ ⊤) Fin.castSucc Isrc_le (G.map (homOfLE le_top))
    (fun k e => map_map_apply_of_thin G (homOfLE (U2_le k)) (homOfLE le_top) (homOfLE le_top)
      (φ.star k.castSucc (F.map (homOfLE (Isrc_le k)) e))) x

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S3_cover_ulift
statement: theorem S3_cover_ulift : ⋃ k : ULift.{w} (Fin 3), (S3.J k.down : Set ℝ) = (⊤ : OpenInterval)
proof:
:=
  (Equiv.ulift.surjective.iUnion_comp (fun i => (S3.J i : Set ℝ))).trans S3_cover

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.pinchData_right_not_injective
statement: theorem pinchData_right_not_injective : ¬ Function.Injective (pinchData.right 0)
proof:
:=
  fun h => Bool.false_ne_true (h rfl)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.collapseHom_e_not_injective
statement: theorem collapseHom_e_not_injective : ¬ Function.Injective (collapseHom.e 0)
proof:
:=
  fun h => Bool.false_ne_true (h rfl)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.swapHom_bijective_v
statement: theorem swapHom_bijective_v (i : Fin 2) : Function.Bijective (swapHom.v i)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · exact Function.Involutive.bijective (f := (! ·)) Bool.not_not
  · exact Function.bijective_id

statement: theorem swapHom_bijective_e (e : Fin 1) : Function.Bijective (swapHom.e e)
proof:
:=
