name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.strip_regular_nonempty
statement:
theorem strip_regular_nonempty [Nonempty A] :
    Nonempty ((intervalComponents (strip A)).obj (ioo 0 2))
proof:
:=
  ⟨ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨(Classical.arbitrary A, ⟨1, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩),
    show (1 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo 0 2 by norm_num⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.strip_lower_empty
statement: theorem strip_lower_empty : IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (strip A)).obj (iio 0))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun c => by
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x => exact absurd (show ((x.1.2 : ℝ)) < 0 from x.2) (not_lt.2 x.1.2.2.1)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.strip_upper_empty
statement: theorem strip_upper_empty : IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (strip A)).obj (ioi 2))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun c => by
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x => exact absurd (show (2 : ℝ) < x.1.2 from x.2) (not_lt.2 x.1.2.2.2)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S2_value_zero
statement: theorem S2_value_zero : S2.value 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S2_value_one
statement: theorem S2_value_one : S2.value 1 = 2
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S2_K0
statement: theorem S2_K0 : S2.K 0 = ioo 0 2
proof: := by simp [CriticalValues.K, S2]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S2_lowerTail
statement: theorem S2_lowerTail : S2.lowerTail = iio 0
proof: := by simp [CriticalValues.lowerTail, S2]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S2_upperTail
statement: theorem S2_upperTail : S2.upperTail = ioi 2
proof: := by simp [CriticalValues.upperTail, S2]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S2_J0
statement: theorem S2_J0 : S2.J 0 = iio 2
proof:
:= by
  have h₂ : S2.upperCut 0 = ((2 : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [show (0 : Fin 2) = Fin.castSucc (0 : Fin 1) from rfl, S2.upperCut_castSucc]; simp [S2]
  ext x
  rw [S2.mem_J, CriticalValues.lowerCut_zero, h₂, mem_iio, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨EReal.bot_lt_coe x, h⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S2_J1
statement: theorem S2_J1 : S2.J 1 = ioi 0
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : S2.lowerCut 1 = ((0 : ℝ) : EReal) := by
    rw [show (1 : Fin 2) = Fin.succ (0 : Fin 1) from rfl, S2.lowerCut_succ]; simp [S2]
  have h₂ : S2.upperCut 1 = ⊤ := S2.upperCut_last
  ext x
  rw [S2.mem_J, h₁, h₂, mem_ioi, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.1, fun h => ⟨h, EReal.coe_lt_top x⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.strip_isEmpty_S2_lowerTail
statement:
theorem strip_isEmpty_S2_lowerTail :
    IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (strip A)).obj S2.lowerTail)
proof:
:= by
  rw [S2_lowerTail]; exact strip_lower_empty A

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.strip_isEmpty_S2_upperTail
statement:
theorem strip_isEmpty_S2_upperTail :
    IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (strip A)).obj S2.upperTail)
proof:
:= by
  rw [S2_upperTail]; exact strip_upper_empty A

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.uncorrected_rule_fails
statement:
theorem uncorrected_rule_fails :
    ¬ ∀ ⦃I J : OpenInterval⦄ (h : I ≤ J), (∀ i, S2.value i ∈ I ↔ S2.value i ∈ J) →
      Function.Bijective ((intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1})).map (homOfLE h))
proof:
:= by
  intro hrule
  have hhit : ∀ i, S2.value i ∈ (⊥ : OpenInterval) ↔ S2.value i ∈ S2.K 0 :=
    fun i => iff_of_false (fun h => h) (S2.value_notMem_K 0 i)
  obtain ⟨y⟩ := strip_regular_nonempty PUnit.{1}
  rw [← S2_K0] at y
  obtain ⟨x, -⟩ := (hrule (bot_le : ⊥ ≤ S2.K 0) hhit).2 y
  exact (intervalComponents_obj_bot_isEmpty _).false x

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.firstCoord_mk
statement:
theorem firstCoord_mk (I : OpenInterval) (x : {x : A × Icc (0 : ℝ) 2 // strip A x ∈ toOpens I}) :
    firstCoord A I (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) = x.1.1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.strip_mk_eq_mk
statement:
theorem strip_mk_eq_mk {I : OpenInterval} (x y : {x : A × Icc (0 : ℝ) 2 // strip A x ∈ toOpens I})
    (h : x.1.1 = y.1.1) :
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk x : (intervalComponents (strip A)).obj I) = ZerothHomotopy.mk y
proof:
:= by
  have hconv : Convex ℝ ((I : Set ℝ) ∩ Icc 0 2) :=
    (convex_iff_ordConnected.2 I.ordConnected).inter (convex_Icc 0 2)
  have hpc := (hconv.isPathConnected ⟨_, x.2, x.1.2.2⟩).image
    (show Continuous fun t : ℝ => (x.1.1, projIcc (0 : ℝ) 2 (by norm_num) t) by
      exact continuous_const.prodMk continuous_projIcc)
  have hx : (x.1.1, projIcc (0 : ℝ) 2 (by norm_num) (x.1.2 : ℝ)) = x.1 := by
    rw [projIcc_val]
  have hy : (x.1.1, projIcc (0 : ℝ) 2 (by norm_num) (y.1.2 : ℝ)) = y.1 := by
    rw [projIcc_val, h]
  have hJ := hpc.joinedIn _ ⟨_, ⟨x.2, x.1.2.2⟩, hx⟩ _ ⟨_, ⟨y.2, y.1.2.2⟩, hy⟩
  have hJ' : JoinedIn {p : A × Icc (0 : ℝ) 2 | strip A p ∈ toOpens I} x.1 y.1 :=
    hJ.mono (by
      rintro _ ⟨t, ⟨htI, htc⟩, rfl⟩
      show ((projIcc (0 : ℝ) 2 (by norm_num) t : Icc (0 : ℝ) 2) : ℝ) ∈ I
      rwa [projIcc_of_mem (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) htc])
  exact Quotient.sound hJ'.joined_subtype

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.firstCoord_injective
statement: theorem firstCoord_injective (I : OpenInterval) : Function.Injective (firstCoord A I)
proof:
:= by
  intro c d h
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    induction d using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk y => exact strip_mk_eq_mk A x y h

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.firstCoord_map
statement:
theorem firstCoord_map {I J : OpenInterval} (h : I ≤ J)
    (c : (intervalComponents (strip A)).obj I) :
    firstCoord A J ((intervalComponents (strip A)).map (homOfLE h) c) = firstCoord A I c
proof:
:= by
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.exists_mem_Icc_of_hits
statement:
theorem exists_mem_Icc_of_hits {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty)
    (hhit : ∀ i, S2.value i ∈ I ↔ S2.value i ∈ J) {t : ℝ} (htJ : t ∈ J)
    (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 2) : ∃ s ∈ I, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 2
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := hhit 0
  have h2 := hhit 1
  rw [S2_value_zero] at h0
  rw [S2_value_one] at h2
  by_cases hI0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ I
  · exact ⟨0, hI0, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  by_cases hI2 : (2 : ℝ) ∈ I
  · exact ⟨2, hI2, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hI
  refine ⟨y, hy, ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_contra hlt
    exact hI0 (h0.2 (mem_of_le_of_le (hIJ hy) htJ (not_le.1 hlt).le ht.1))
  · by_contra hlt
    exact hI2 (h2.2 (mem_of_le_of_le htJ (hIJ hy) ht.2 (not_le.1 hlt).le))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.strip_isConstructibleAt
statement:
theorem strip_isConstructibleAt [Finite A] :
    S2.IsConstructibleAt (intervalComponents (strip A)) where
  finite I
proof:
:= Finite.of_injective _ (firstCoord_injective A I)
  bijective I J h hI hhit := by
    refine ⟨fun c d hcd => firstCoord_injective A I ?_, fun d => ?_⟩
    · rw [← firstCoord_map A h c, ← firstCoord_map A h d, hcd]
    · induction d using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
      | mk y =>
        obtain ⟨s, hsI, hs⟩ := exists_mem_Icc_of_hits h hI hhit (t := (y.1.2 : ℝ)) y.2 y.1.2.2
        exact ⟨ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨(y.1.1, ⟨s, hs⟩), hsI⟩, strip_mk_eq_mk A _ y rfl⟩
  isEmpty_lowerTail := strip_isEmpty_S2_lowerTail A
  isEmpty_upperTail := strip_isEmpty_S2_upperTail A

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.strip_corrected_not_uncorrected
statement:
theorem strip_corrected_not_uncorrected :
    S2.IsConstructibleAt (intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1})) ∧
      ¬ ∀ ⦃I J : OpenInterval⦄ (h : I ≤ J), (∀ i, S2.value i ∈ I ↔ S2.value i ∈ J) →
        Function.Bijective ((intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1})).map (homOfLE h))
proof:
:=
  ⟨strip_isConstructibleAt PUnit.{1}, uncorrected_rule_fails⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.strip_extract_left_mk
statement:
theorem strip_extract_left_mk
    (x : {x : PUnit.{1} × Icc (0 : ℝ) 2 // strip PUnit.{1} x ∈ toOpens (S2.K 0)}) :
    (S2.extract (intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1}))
      (strip_isConstructibleAt PUnit.{1}).finite).left 0 (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x.1, OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 (S2.K_le_J_castSucc 0) x.2⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.strip_extract_bijective
statement:
theorem strip_extract_bijective :
    Function.Bijective ((S2.extract (intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1}))
      (strip_isConstructibleAt PUnit.{1}).finite).left 0) ∧
    Function.Bijective ((S2.extract (intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1}))
      (strip_isConstructibleAt PUnit.{1}).finite).right 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : ∀ I, Subsingleton ((intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1})).obj I) := fun I =>
    ⟨fun a b => firstCoord_injective PUnit.{1} I (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
  have hK : Nonempty ((intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1})).obj (S2.K 0)) := by
    rw [S2_K0]; exact strip_regular_nonempty PUnit.{1}
  exact ⟨@bijective_of_subsingleton _ _ (hsub _) (hsub _) _ fun _ => hK,
    @bijective_of_subsingleton _ _ (hsub _) (hsub _) _ fun _ => hK⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.boolClass_ne
statement: theorem boolClass_ne : boolClass false ≠ boolClass true
proof:
:= fun h =>

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.collapse_not_injective

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.collapse_not_isIso
statement: theorem collapse_not_isIso : ¬ IsIso collapse
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have := ((S2.isIso_iff_shortIntervals (strip_isConstructibleAt Bool)
    (intervalComponents_isIntervalCosheaf _) (strip_isConstructibleAt PUnit.{1})
    (intervalComponents_isIntervalCosheaf _) collapse).1 h).2 0
  rw [S2_K0] at this
  exact collapse_not_injective this.1

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.line_not_constructible
statement:
theorem line_not_constructible {n : ℕ} (S : CriticalValues n) :
    ¬ S.IsConstructibleAt
      (intervalComponents (⟨Prod.snd, continuous_snd⟩ : C(PUnit.{1} × ℝ, ℝ)))
proof:
:=
  fun h => h.isEmpty_lowerTail.false
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨(PUnit.unit, S.value 0 - 1), show S.value 0 - 1 < S.value 0 by linarith⟩)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S2_refines_S3
statement: theorem S2_refines_S3 : Set.range S2.value ⊆ Set.range S3.value
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  fin_cases i
  · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨2, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.strip_isConstructibleAt_S3
statement:
theorem strip_isConstructibleAt_S3 (A : Type u) [TopologicalSpace A] [DiscreteTopology A]
    [Finite A] : S3.IsConstructibleAt (intervalComponents (strip A))
proof:
:=
  (strip_isConstructibleAt A).of_refines S2_refines_S3

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.envelope_refinement
statement:
theorem envelope_refinement :
    S3.envelope (ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4)) = ioo 0 1 ∧ S2.envelope (ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4)) = ioo 0 2 ∧
      ioo 0 1 < ioo 0 2
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ((ioo (1 / 4) (3 / 4) : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ).Nonempty :=
    ⟨1 / 2, mem_ioo.2 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← S3_K0]
    exact S3.envelope_eq_K (by
      rw [S3_K0]; exact fun x hx => mem_ioo.2 ⟨by linarith [(mem_ioo.1 hx).1],
        by linarith [(mem_ioo.1 hx).2]⟩) hne
  · rw [← S2_K0]
    exact S2.envelope_eq_K (by
      rw [S2_K0]; exact fun x hx => mem_ioo.2 ⟨by linarith [(mem_ioo.1 hx).1],
        by linarith [(mem_ioo.1 hx).2]⟩) hne
  · refine lt_of_le_of_ne (fun x hx => mem_ioo.2 ⟨(mem_ioo.1 hx).1,
      by linarith [(mem_ioo.1 hx).2]⟩) fun h => ?_
    have : (3 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ ioo 0 2 := mem_ioo.2 ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩
    rw [← h] at this
    exact absurd (mem_ioo.1 this).2 (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S2_refines_S023
statement: theorem S2_refines_S023 : Set.range S2.value ⊆ Set.range S023.value
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
  fin_cases i
  · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨1, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S023_K0
statement: theorem S023_K0 : S023.K 0 = ioo 0 2
proof: := by simp [CriticalValues.K, S023]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.S023_K1
statement: theorem S023_K1 : S023.K 1 = ioo 2 3
proof: := by simp [CriticalValues.K, S023]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.Constructible.distinct_gap_values
statement:
theorem distinct_gap_values :
    S023.IsConstructibleAt (intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1})) ∧
      (∀ i, S023.value i ∉ S023.K 0 ∧ S023.value i ∉ S023.K 1) ∧
      Nonempty ((intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1})).obj (S023.K 0)) ∧
      IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1})).obj (S023.K 1)) ∧
      ¬ Nonempty ((intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1})).obj (S023.K 0) ≃
        (intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1})).obj (S023.K 1))
proof:
:= by
  have h₀ : Nonempty ((intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1})).obj (S023.K 0)) := by
    rw [S023_K0]; exact strip_regular_nonempty PUnit.{1}
  have hle : S023.K 1 ≤ ioi 2 := by
    rw [S023_K1]; exact fun x hx => mem_ioi.2 (mem_ioo.1 hx).1
  have h₁ : IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1})).obj (S023.K 1)) :=
    ⟨fun c => (strip_upper_empty PUnit.{1}).false
      ((intervalComponents (strip PUnit.{1})).map (homOfLE hle) c)⟩
  exact ⟨(strip_isConstructibleAt PUnit.{1}).of_refines S2_refines_S023,
    fun i => ⟨S023.value_notMem_K 0 i, S023.value_notMem_K 1 i⟩, h₀, h₁,
    fun ⟨e⟩ => h₁.false (e h₀.some)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.value_castSucc_lt_succ
statement: theorem value_castSucc_lt_succ (e : Fin n) : S.value e.castSucc < S.value e.succ
proof:
:=
  S.strictMono Fin.castSucc_lt_succ

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.eq_of_mem_K_of_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_K_of_mem_Icc {e e' : Fin n} {t : ℝ} (h : t ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (h' : t ∈ Icc (S.value e'.castSucc) (S.value e'.succ)) : e = e'
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy e e' with hl | rfl | hl
  · have := S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.succ_le_castSucc_iff.2 hl)
    exact absurd (h.2.trans_le (this.trans h'.1)) (lt_irrefl _)
  · rfl
  · have := S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.succ_le_castSucc_iff.2 hl)
    exact absurd ((h'.2.trans this).trans_lt h.1) (lt_irrefl _)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.exists_collarWidth
statement: theorem exists_collarWidth : ∃ δ, S.IsCollarWidth δ
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ e : Fin n, ∀ᶠ δ in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), 2 * δ ≤ S.value e.succ - S.value e.castSucc :=
    fun e => by
      have hg := sub_pos.2 (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e)
      filter_upwards [Ioo_mem_nhdsGT (half_pos hg)] with δ hδ
      linarith [hδ.2]
  obtain ⟨δ, h₁, h₂⟩ := ((Filter.eventually_all.2 h).and self_mem_nhdsWithin).exists
  exact ⟨δ, h₂, h₁⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.quotMk_surjective
statement: theorem quotMk_surjective : Function.Surjective (P.quotMk S)
proof: := Quotient.mk_surjective

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isQuotientMap_quotMk

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.continuous_quotMk

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.nf_inl
statement: @[simp] theorem nf_inl (p : P.VertexPiece) : P.nf S (.inl p) = .inl p
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.nf_segBot
statement:
theorem nf_segBot (e : Fin n) (y : P.E e) :
    P.nf S (.inr ⟨e, y, segBot S e⟩) = .inl ⟨e.castSucc, P.left e y⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [nf, nfCyl, segBot]

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.nf_segTop
statement:
theorem nf_segTop (e : Fin n) (y : P.E e) :
    P.nf S (.inr ⟨e, y, segTop S e⟩) = .inl ⟨e.succ, P.right e y⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [nf, nfCyl, segTop, (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e).ne']

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.eqvGen_nf
statement: theorem eqvGen_nf (x : P.Raw S) : Relation.EqvGen (P.EndpointRel S) x (P.nf S x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with p | ⟨e, y, t⟩
  · exact .refl _
  · simp only [nf, Sum.elim_inr, nfCyl]
    split_ifs with h₁ h₂
    · obtain rfl : t = segBot S e := Subtype.ext h₁
      exact .rel _ _ (.left e y)
    · obtain rfl : t = segTop S e := Subtype.ext h₂
      exact .rel _ _ (.right e y)
    · exact .refl _

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.nf_eq_of_eqvGen
statement:
theorem nf_eq_of_eqvGen {x y : P.Raw S} (h : Relation.EqvGen (P.EndpointRel S) x y) :
    P.nf S x = P.nf S y
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | rel x y h =>
    cases h with
    | left e y => rw [nf_segBot]; rfl
    | right e y => rw [nf_segTop]; rfl
  | refl => rfl
  | symm _ _ _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact ih₁.trans ih₂

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.eqvGen_iff
statement:
theorem eqvGen_iff {x y : P.Raw S} :
    Relation.EqvGen (P.EndpointRel S) x y ↔ P.nf S x = P.nf S y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨P.nf_eq_of_eqvGen S, fun h => ?_⟩
  have h₂ := Relation.EqvGen.symm _ _ (P.eqvGen_nf S y)
  rw [← h] at h₂
  exact .trans _ _ _ (P.eqvGen_nf S x) h₂

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.quotMk_eq_iff
statement: theorem quotMk_eq_iff {x y : P.Raw S} : P.quotMk S x = P.quotMk S y ↔ P.nf S x = P.nf S y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => (P.eqvGen_iff S).1 (Quotient.exact h), fun h => Quotient.sound ((P.eqvGen_iff S).2 h)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.eq_of_nf_eq_inr
statement:
theorem eq_of_nf_eq_inr {x : P.Raw S} {c : P.CylinderPiece S} (h : P.nf S x = .inr c) :
    x = .inr c
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with p | c'
  · cases h
  · simp only [nf, Sum.elim_inr, nfCyl] at h
    split_ifs at h
    exact h

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofCylinder_segBot
statement:
theorem ofCylinder_segBot (e : Fin n) (y : P.E e) :
    P.ofCylinder S e (y, segBot S e) = P.ofVertex S e.castSucc (P.left e y)
proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofCylinder_segTop
statement:
theorem ofCylinder_segTop (e : Fin n) (y : P.E e) :
    P.ofCylinder S e (y, segTop S e) = P.ofVertex S e.succ (P.right e y)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.sound (Relation.EqvGen.rel _ _ (EndpointRel.right e y))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.continuous_ofCylinder

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofVertex_injective
statement: theorem ofVertex_injective (i : Fin (n + 1)) : Function.Injective (P.ofVertex S i)
proof:

  simp only [nf_inl, Sum.inl.injEq] at this

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofVertex_eq_ofVertex_iff

theorem ofVertex_eq_ofVertex_iff {i j : Fin (n + 1)} {v : P.V i} {w : P.V j} :
    P.ofVertex S i v = P.ofVertex S j w ↔ (⟨i, v⟩ : P.VertexPiece) = ⟨j, w⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.continuous_rawHeight
statement: theorem continuous_rawHeight : Continuous (P.rawHeight S)
proof:
:=
  Continuous.sumElim
    (continuous_sigma fun i => (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : P.V i => S.value i))
    (continuous_sigma fun _ => continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.rawHeight_nf
statement: theorem rawHeight_nf (x : P.Raw S) : P.rawHeight S (P.nf S x) = P.rawHeight S x
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with p | ⟨e, y, t⟩
  · rfl
  · simp only [nf, Sum.elim_inr, nfCyl]
    split_ifs with h₁ h₂
    · exact h₁.symm
    · exact h₂.symm
    · rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_ofVertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem height_ofVertex (i : Fin (n + 1)) (v : P.V i) :

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_ofCylinder

@[simp] theorem height_ofCylinder (e : Fin n) (p : P.Cylinder S e) :

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.CompatibleMaps.continuous_raw
statement: theorem continuous_raw (k : P.CompatibleMaps S Z) : Continuous k.raw
proof:
:=
  Continuous.sumElim (continuous_sigma fun i => (k.vertex i).continuous)
    (continuous_sigma fun e => (k.cylinder e).continuous)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.CompatibleMaps.raw_nf
statement: theorem raw_nf (k : P.CompatibleMaps S Z) (x : P.Raw S) : k.raw (P.nf S x) = k.raw x
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with p | ⟨e, y, t⟩
  · rfl
  · simp only [nf, Sum.elim_inr, nfCyl]
    split_ifs with h₁ h₂
    · obtain rfl : t = segBot S e := Subtype.ext h₁
      exact (k.segBot_eq e y).symm
    · obtain rfl : t = segTop S e := Subtype.ext h₂
      exact (k.segTop_eq e y).symm
    · rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.lift_ofVertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_ofVertex (k : P.CompatibleMaps S Z) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (v : P.V i) :
    lift k (P.ofVertex S i v) = k.vertex i v
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.lift_ofCylinder

proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := P.quotMk_surjective S q
  rcases x with ⟨i, v⟩ | ⟨e, p⟩
  · exact hv i v
  · exact hc e p

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.lift_unique
statement:
theorem lift_unique (k : P.CompatibleMaps S Z) (g : C(P.Realization S, Z))
    (hv : ∀ i v, g (P.ofVertex S i v) = k.vertex i v)
    (hc : ∀ e p, g (P.ofCylinder S e p) = k.cylinder e p) : g = lift k
proof:
:=
  hom_ext hv hc

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.existsUnique_lift
statement:
theorem existsUnique_lift (k : P.CompatibleMaps S Z) :
    ∃! g : C(P.Realization S, Z), (∀ i v, g (P.ofVertex S i v) = k.vertex i v) ∧
      ∀ e p, g (P.ofCylinder S e p) = k.cylinder e p
proof:
:=
  ⟨lift k, ⟨fun _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl⟩, fun g hg => lift_unique k g hg.1 hg.2⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofStrip_eq_ofCylinder
statement:
theorem ofStrip_eq_ofCylinder (e : Fin n) (p : P.E e × (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    P.ofStrip S e p = P.ofCylinder S e (p.1, gapIncl S e p.2)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_ofStrip
statement:
@[simp] theorem height_ofStrip (e : Fin n) (p : P.E e × (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    P.height S (P.ofStrip S e p) = p.2
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.nf_rawStrip
statement:
theorem nf_rawStrip (e : Fin n) (p : P.E e × (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    P.nf S (P.rawStrip S e p) = P.rawStrip S e p
proof:
:= by
  simp [nf, nfCyl, rawStrip, gapIncl, p.2.2.1.ne', p.2.2.2.ne]

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.rawStrip_injective
statement: theorem rawStrip_injective (e : Fin n) : Function.Injective (P.rawStrip S e)
proof:
:= by
  intro p p' h
  simp only [rawStrip, gapIncl, Sum.inr.injEq, Sigma.mk.inj_iff, heq_eq_eq, true_and,
    Prod.mk.injEq, Subtype.mk.injEq] at h
  exact Prod.ext h.1 (Subtype.ext h.2)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofStrip_injective
statement: theorem ofStrip_injective (e : Fin n) : Function.Injective (P.ofStrip S e)
proof:
:= by
  intro p p' h
  have := (P.quotMk_eq_iff S).1 h
  rw [nf_rawStrip, nf_rawStrip] at this
  exact P.rawStrip_injective S e this

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.continuous_ofStrip
statement: theorem continuous_ofStrip (e : Fin n) : Continuous (P.ofStrip S e)
proof:
:=
  (P.continuous_ofCylinder S e).comp
    (continuous_fst.prodMk ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).subtype_mk _))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isOpenMap_gapIncl
statement: theorem isOpenMap_gapIncl (e : Fin n) : IsOpenMap (gapIncl S e)
proof:
:= by
  intro O hO
  have hO' : IsOpen (Subtype.val '' O : Set ℝ) :=
    (S.K e).isOpen.isOpenEmbedding_subtypeVal.isOpenMap O hO
  have : gapIncl S e '' O = Subtype.val ⁻¹' (Subtype.val '' O) := by
    ext s
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨t, ht, hts⟩
      exact ⟨t, ht, Subtype.ext hts⟩
  rw [this]
  exact hO'.preimage continuous_subtype_val

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isOpenMap_rawStrip
statement: theorem isOpenMap_rawStrip (e : Fin n) : IsOpenMap (P.rawStrip S e)
proof:
:=
  isOpenMap_inr.comp (isOpenMap_sigmaMk.comp (IsOpenMap.id.prodMap (isOpenMap_gapIncl S e)))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isOpenEmbedding_ofStrip
statement: theorem isOpenEmbedding_ofStrip (e : Fin n) : IsOpenEmbedding (P.ofStrip S e)
proof:
:= by
  refine .of_continuous_injective_isOpenMap (P.continuous_ofStrip S e) (P.ofStrip_injective S e)
    fun O hO => ?_
  have : P.quotMk S ⁻¹' (P.ofStrip S e '' O) = P.rawStrip S e '' O := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩
      have := (P.quotMk_eq_iff S).1 hpx
      rw [nf_rawStrip] at this
      exact ⟨p, hp, (P.eq_of_nf_eq_inr S this.symm).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  rw [← (P.isQuotientMap_quotMk S).isOpen_preimage, this]
  exact P.isOpenMap_rawStrip S e O hO

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.exists_rep
statement:
theorem exists_rep (q : P.Realization S) :
    (∃ i v, q = P.ofVertex S i v) ∨ ∃ e p, q = P.ofStrip S e p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := P.quotMk_surjective S q
  rcases x with ⟨i, v⟩ | ⟨e, y, t⟩
  · exact .inl ⟨i, v, rfl⟩
  · by_cases h₁ : (t : ℝ) = S.value e.castSucc
    · obtain rfl : t = segBot S e := Subtype.ext h₁
      exact .inl ⟨_, _, P.ofCylinder_segBot S e y⟩
    by_cases h₂ : (t : ℝ) = S.value e.succ
    · obtain rfl : t = segTop S e := Subtype.ext h₂
      exact .inl ⟨_, _, P.ofCylinder_segTop S e y⟩
    exact .inr ⟨e, (y, ⟨t, lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.1 (Ne.symm h₁), lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.2 h₂⟩), rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofVertex_ne_ofStrip
statement:
theorem ofVertex_ne_ofStrip (i : Fin (n + 1)) (v : P.V i) (e : Fin n)
    (p : P.E e × (S.K e : Set ℝ)) : P.ofVertex S i v ≠ P.ofStrip S e p
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have h' := congrArg (P.height S) h
  rw [height_ofVertex, height_ofStrip] at h'
  exact S.value_notMem_K e i (by rw [h']; exact p.2.2)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.range_ofVertex
statement:
theorem range_ofVertex (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    range (P.ofVertex S i) = P.height S ⁻¹' {S.value i}
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, rfl⟩
    rfl
  · intro hq
    rcases P.exists_rep S q with ⟨j, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, p, rfl⟩
    · obtain rfl : j = i := S.strictMono.injective hq
      exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
    · have hq' : P.height S (P.ofStrip S e p) = S.value i := hq
      rw [height_ofStrip] at hq'
      exact absurd (hq' ▸ p.2.2) (S.value_notMem_K e i)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.range_ofStrip
statement:
theorem range_ofStrip (e : Fin n) :
    range (P.ofStrip S e) = P.height S ⁻¹' (S.K e : Set ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
    show P.height S (P.ofStrip S e p) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)
    rw [height_ofStrip]
    exact p.2.2
  · intro hq
    rcases P.exists_rep S q with ⟨i, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e', p, rfl⟩
    · exact absurd hq (S.value_notMem_K e i)
    · have hq' : P.height S (P.ofStrip S e' p) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) := hq
      rw [height_ofStrip] at hq'
      obtain rfl : e = e' := S.eq_of_mem_K_of_mem_Icc hq' (Ioo_subset_Icc_self p.2.2)
      exact ⟨p, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isOpen_strip
statement: theorem isOpen_strip (e : Fin n) : IsOpen (P.height S ⁻¹' (S.K e : Set ℝ))
proof:
:=
  (S.K e).isOpen.preimage (P.height S).continuous

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.stripHomeomorph_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem stripHomeomorph_apply (e : Fin n) (p : P.E e × (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    (P.stripHomeomorph S e p : P.Realization S) = P.ofStrip S e p
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_stripHomeomorph
statement:
theorem height_stripHomeomorph (e : Fin n) (p : P.E e × (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    P.height S (P.stripHomeomorph S e p) = p.2
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isEmbedding_ofStrip_at
statement:
theorem isEmbedding_ofStrip_at (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    IsEmbedding fun y : P.E e => P.ofStrip S e (y, t)
proof:
:=
  (P.isOpenEmbedding_ofStrip S e).isEmbedding.comp (isEmbedding_prodMkLeft t)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.range_ofStrip_at
statement:
theorem range_ofStrip_at (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    range (fun y : P.E e => P.ofStrip S e (y, t)) = P.height S ⁻¹' {(t : ℝ)}
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact P.height_ofStrip S e (y, t)
  · intro hq
    have hq' : q ∈ range (P.ofStrip S e) := by
      rw [range_ofStrip]
      show P.height S q ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)
      rw [show P.height S q = t from hq]
      exact t.2
    obtain ⟨⟨y, s⟩, rfl⟩ := hq'
    have hs : P.height S (P.ofStrip S e (y, s)) = t := hq
    rw [height_ofStrip] at hs
    obtain rfl : s = t := Subtype.ext hs
    exact ⟨y, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.regularFiberHomeomorph_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem regularFiberHomeomorph_apply (e : Fin n) (t : (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (y : P.E e) :
    (P.regularFiberHomeomorph S e t y : P.Realization S) = P.ofStrip S e (y, t)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem height_mem_Icc (q : P.Realization S) :
    P.height S q ∈ Icc (S.value 0) (S.value (Fin.last n))
proof:
:= by
  rcases P.exists_rep S q with ⟨i, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, p, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le i), S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.le_last i)⟩
  · rw [height_ofStrip]
    exact ⟨(S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le _)).trans p.2.2.1.le,
      p.2.2.2.le.trans (S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.le_last _))⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_preimage_eq_empty
statement:
theorem height_preimage_eq_empty {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∉ Icc (S.value 0) (S.value (Fin.last n))) :
    P.height S ⁻¹' {t} = ∅
proof:
:=
  eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2 fun q (hq : P.height S q = t) => ht (hq ▸ P.height_mem_Icc S q)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_preimage_lowerTail
statement: theorem height_preimage_lowerTail : P.height S ⁻¹' (S.lowerTail : Set ℝ) = ∅
proof:
:=
  eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2 fun q hq =>
    absurd (S.mem_lowerTail.1 hq) (not_lt.2 (P.height_mem_Icc S q).1)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_preimage_upperTail
statement: theorem height_preimage_upperTail : P.height S ⁻¹' (S.upperTail : Set ℝ) = ∅
proof:
:=
  eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2 fun q hq =>
    absurd (S.mem_upperTail.1 hq) (not_lt.2 (P.height_mem_Icc S q).2)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_preimage_eq_empty_of_mem_lowerTail
statement:
theorem height_preimage_eq_empty_of_mem_lowerTail {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ S.lowerTail) :
    P.height S ⁻¹' {t} = ∅
proof:
:=
  P.height_preimage_eq_empty S fun h => absurd h.1 (not_le.2 (S.mem_lowerTail.1 ht))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_preimage_eq_empty_of_mem_upperTail
statement:
theorem height_preimage_eq_empty_of_mem_upperTail {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ S.upperTail) :
    P.height S ⁻¹' {t} = ∅
proof:
:=
  P.height_preimage_eq_empty S fun h => absurd h.2 (not_le.2 (S.mem_upperTail.1 ht))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.inCollar_nf
statement:
theorem inCollar_nf {δ : ℝ} (hδ : S.IsCollarWidth δ) (W : Set P.VertexPiece) (x : P.Raw S) :
    P.InCollar S W δ (P.nf S x) ↔ P.InCollar S W δ x
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with p | ⟨e, y, t⟩
  · rfl
  · have h0 := hδ.1
    have hg := hδ.2 e
    simp only [nf, Sum.elim_inr, nfCyl]
    split_ifs with h₁ h₂
    · change _ ↔ ((t : ℝ) < _ ∧ _) ∨ (_ < (t : ℝ) ∧ _)
      rw [h₁]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact .inl ⟨by linarith, h⟩
      · rintro (⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩)
        · exact h
        · linarith
    · change _ ↔ ((t : ℝ) < _ ∧ _) ∨ (_ < (t : ℝ) ∧ _)
      rw [h₂]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact .inr ⟨by linarith, h⟩
      · rintro (⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩)
        · linarith
        · exact h
    · rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isOpen_inCollar
statement:
theorem isOpen_inCollar {W : Set P.VertexPiece} (hW : IsOpen W) (δ : ℝ) :
    IsOpen {x | P.InCollar S W δ x}
proof:
:= by
  refine isOpen_sum_iff.2 ⟨hW, ?_⟩
  have hh : Continuous fun c : P.CylinderPiece S => (c.2.2 : ℝ) :=
    continuous_sigma fun _ => continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd
  have hl : Continuous fun c : P.CylinderPiece S => S.value c.1.castSucc + δ :=
    continuous_sigma fun e =>
      (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : P.Cylinder S e => S.value e.castSucc + δ)
  have hr : Continuous fun c : P.CylinderPiece S => S.value c.1.succ - δ :=
    continuous_sigma fun e =>
      (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : P.Cylinder S e => S.value e.succ - δ)
  have hL : Continuous (P.leftEnd S) :=
    continuous_sigma fun e => continuous_sigmaMk.comp ((P.left e).continuous.comp continuous_fst)
  have hR : Continuous (P.rightEnd S) :=
    continuous_sigma fun e => continuous_sigmaMk.comp ((P.right e).continuous.comp continuous_fst)
  exact ((isOpen_lt hh hl).inter (hW.preimage hL)).union ((isOpen_lt hr hh).inter (hW.preimage hR))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isOpen_collar
statement:
theorem isOpen_collar {W : Set P.VertexPiece} (hW : IsOpen W) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : S.IsCollarWidth δ) :
    IsOpen (P.collar W hδ)
proof:
:=
  (P.isQuotientMap_quotMk S).isOpen_preimage.1 (P.isOpen_inCollar S hW δ)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofVertex_mem_collar
statement:
theorem ofVertex_mem_collar (W : Set P.VertexPiece) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : S.IsCollarWidth δ)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (v : P.V i) : P.ofVertex S i v ∈ P.collar W hδ ↔ ⟨i, v⟩ ∈ W
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.disjoint_collar
statement:
theorem disjoint_collar {W W' : Set P.VertexPiece} (hWW' : Disjoint W W') {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : S.IsCollarWidth δ) : Disjoint (P.collar W hδ) (P.collar W' hδ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro q hq hq'
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := P.quotMk_surjective S q
  rcases x with p | ⟨e, y, t⟩
  · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hWW' hq hq'
  · have hg := hδ.2 e
    change ((t : ℝ) < _ ∧ _) ∨ (_ < (t : ℝ) ∧ _) at hq
    change ((t : ℝ) < _ ∧ _) ∨ (_ < (t : ℝ) ∧ _) at hq'
    rcases hq with ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ | ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ <;> rcases hq' with ⟨h₁', h₂'⟩ | ⟨h₁', h₂'⟩
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hWW' h₂ h₂'
    · linarith
    · linarith
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hWW' h₂ h₂'

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isInducing_ofVertex
statement: theorem isInducing_ofVertex (i : Fin (n + 1)) : IsInducing (P.ofVertex S i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := S.exists_collarWidth
  refine ⟨le_antisymm (P.continuous_ofVertex S i).le_induced ?_⟩
  rw [TopologicalSpace.le_def]
  intro U hU
  refine isOpen_induced_iff.2
    ⟨P.collar (Sigma.mk i '' U) hδ, P.isOpen_collar (isOpenMap_sigmaMk U hU) hδ, ?_⟩
  ext v
  exact sigma_mk_injective.mem_set_image

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isEmbedding_ofVertex
statement: theorem isEmbedding_ofVertex (i : Fin (n + 1)) : IsEmbedding (P.ofVertex S i)
proof:
:=
  ⟨P.isInducing_ofVertex S i, P.ofVertex_injective S i⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.criticalFiberHomeomorph_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem criticalFiberHomeomorph_apply (i : Fin (n + 1)) (v : P.V i) :
    (P.criticalFiberHomeomorph S i v : P.Realization S) = P.ofVertex S i v
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.t2Space
statement: theorem t2Space [∀ i, T2Space (P.V i)] [∀ e, T2Space (P.E e)] : T2Space (P.Realization S)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun q q' hne => ?_⟩
  by_cases hh : P.height S q = P.height S q'
  · rcases P.exists_rep S q with ⟨i, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, p, rfl⟩ <;>
      rcases P.exists_rep S q' with ⟨i', v', rfl⟩ | ⟨e', p', rfl⟩
    · obtain rfl : i = i' := S.strictMono.injective hh
      have hv : v ≠ v' := fun h => hne (h ▸ rfl)
      obtain ⟨U, U', hU, hU', hvU, hvU', hUU'⟩ := t2_separation hv
      obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := S.exists_collarWidth
      exact ⟨_, _, P.isOpen_collar (isOpenMap_sigmaMk U hU) hδ,
        P.isOpen_collar (isOpenMap_sigmaMk U' hU') hδ, ⟨v, hvU, rfl⟩, ⟨v', hvU', rfl⟩,
        P.disjoint_collar ((disjoint_image_iff sigma_mk_injective).2 hUU') hδ⟩
    · rw [height_ofVertex, height_ofStrip] at hh
      exact absurd (hh ▸ p'.2.2) (S.value_notMem_K e' i)
    · rw [height_ofVertex, height_ofStrip] at hh
      exact absurd (hh.symm ▸ p.2.2) (S.value_notMem_K e i')
    · rw [height_ofStrip, height_ofStrip] at hh
      obtain rfl : e = e' :=
        S.eq_of_mem_K_of_mem_Icc p.2.2 (by rw [hh]; exact Ioo_subset_Icc_self p'.2.2)
      have hp : p ≠ p' := fun h => hne (h ▸ rfl)
      obtain ⟨U, U', hU, hU', hpU, hpU', hUU'⟩ := t2_separation hp
      have hO := P.isOpenEmbedding_ofStrip S e
      exact ⟨_, _, hO.isOpenMap U hU, hO.isOpenMap U' hU', ⟨p, hpU, rfl⟩, ⟨p', hpU', rfl⟩,
        (disjoint_image_iff hO.injective).2 hUU'⟩
  · obtain ⟨U, U', hU, hU', h₁, h₂, hUU'⟩ := t2_separation hh
    exact ⟨_, _, hU.preimage (P.height S).continuous, hU'.preimage (P.height S).continuous,
      h₁, h₂, hUU'.preimage _⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.compactSpace
statement:
theorem compactSpace [∀ i, CompactSpace (P.V i)] [∀ e, CompactSpace (P.E e)] :
    CompactSpace (P.Realization S)
proof:
:=
  Quotient.compactSpace

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.locallyPathConnectedSpace_seg
statement: theorem locallyPathConnectedSpace_seg (e : Fin n) : LocallyPathConnectedSpace (Seg S e)
proof:
:= by
  refine LocallyPathConnectedSpace.of_bases (p := fun _ (ε : ℝ) => 0 < ε)
    (s := fun x ε => ((↑) : Seg S e → ℝ) ⁻¹' Ioo ((x : ℝ) - ε) (x + ε)) (fun x => ?_)
    fun x ε hε => ?_
  · rw [nhds_subtype]
    exact (nhds_basis_Ioo_pos (x : ℝ)).comap _
  · have hW : IsPathConnected (Seg S e ∩ Ioo ((x : ℝ) - ε) (x + ε)) :=
      ((convex_Icc (𝕜 := ℝ) _ _).inter (convex_Ioo _ _)).isPathConnected
        ⟨(x : ℝ), x.2, by constructor <;> linarith⟩
    have := hW.preimage_coe (U := Seg S e) inter_subset_left
    rwa [Subtype.preimage_coe_self_inter] at this

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.locallyPathConnectedSpace
statement:
theorem locallyPathConnectedSpace [∀ i, LocallyPathConnectedSpace (P.V i)]
    [∀ e, LocallyPathConnectedSpace (P.E e)] : LocallyPathConnectedSpace (P.Realization S)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ e, LocallyPathConnectedSpace (Seg S e) := locallyPathConnectedSpace_seg S
  exact Quotient.locallyPathConnectedSpace

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isEmpty_E_of_left
statement: theorem isEmpty_E_of_left {e : Fin n} (h : IsEmpty (P.V e.castSucc)) : IsEmpty (P.E e)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun y => h.false (P.left e y)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isEmpty_E_of_right
statement: theorem isEmpty_E_of_right {e : Fin n} (h : IsEmpty (P.V e.succ)) : IsEmpty (P.E e)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun y => h.false (P.right e y)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.isEmpty_realization
statement: theorem isEmpty_realization [∀ i, IsEmpty (P.V i)] : IsEmpty (P.Realization S)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun q => by
    rcases P.exists_rep S q with ⟨i, v, -⟩ | ⟨e, p, -⟩
    · exact isEmptyElim v
    · exact (P.isEmpty_E_of_left (e := e) inferInstance).false p.1⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData_V
statement: @[simp] theorem ofFiniteData_V (D : FiniteReebData.{u} n) : (ofFiniteData D).V = D.V

    ((geometricSmoothingUnit quarter).app singleGraph ≫
        (geometricSmoothingUnit quarter).app ((geometricSmoothing quarter).obj singleGraph) ≫
          (geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter quarter).hom.app singleGraph).hom.left.hom edgePt =
        ReebQuotient.mk _ (edgePt, ⟨0, GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band _⟩) ∧
      ((geometricSmoothingUnit quarter).app singleGraph ≫
        (geometricSmoothing quarter).map ((geometricSmoothingUnit quarter).app singleGraph) ≫
          (geometricSmoothingCompIso quarter quarter).hom.app singleGraph).hom.left.hom edgePt =
        ReebQuotient.mk _ (edgePt, ⟨0, GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band _⟩)
proof:
:=
  ⟨congrArg (fun f => f.hom.left.hom edgePt)
      (geometricSmoothingUnit_comp_geometricSmoothingUnit quarter quarter singleGraph),
    congrArg (fun f => f.hom.left.hom edgePt)
      (geometricSmoothingUnit_comp_map_geometricSmoothingUnit quarter quarter singleGraph)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.GeometricInterleaving.parallelSingle_eighth_ne
statement:
theorem parallelSingle_eighth_ne :
    (collapseGraph ≫ (geometricSmoothingUnit eighth).app singleGraph) ≫
        (geometricSmoothing eighth).map
          (includeGraph ≫ (geometricSmoothingUnit eighth).app parallelGraph) ≫
        (geometricSmoothingCompIso eighth eighth).hom.app parallelGraph ≠
      (geometricSmoothingUnit (eighth + eighth)).app parallelGraph
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h₁ := congrArg (fun f => ((geometricSmoothingEqIso eighth_add_eighth).hom.app
    parallelGraph).hom.left.hom (f.hom.left.hom (parPt true))) h
  have e := geometricSmoothingCompIso_hom_app_hom_left_mk eighth eighth parallelGraph
    (parPt false, ⟨0, GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band _⟩)
    ⟨0, GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band _⟩
  have h₂ := (congrArg (((geometricSmoothingEqIso eighth_add_eighth).hom.app
    parallelGraph).hom.left.hom) e).symm.trans h₁
  have h₃ : ReebQuotient.mk (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap parallelGraph.obj) quarter)
        (parPt false, ⟨0 + 0, by rw [add_zero]; exact GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band _⟩) =
      ReebQuotient.mk (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap parallelGraph.obj) quarter)
        (parPt true, ⟨0, GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band _⟩) := h₂
  have h₄ : ReebQuotient.mk (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap parallelGraph.obj) quarter)
        (parPt false, ⟨0, GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band _⟩) =
      ReebQuotient.mk (GeometricThickening.height (overBaseMap parallelGraph.obj) quarter)
        (parPt false, ⟨0 + 0, by rw [add_zero]; exact GeometricThickening.zero_mem_band _⟩) :=
    congrArg (ReebQuotient.mk _) (Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext (add_zero (0 : ℝ)).symm))
  exact par_quarter_classes_ne (h₄.trans h₃)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.lowerCut_lt_iff
statement:
theorem lowerCut_lt_iff {i : Fin (n + 1)} {x : ℝ} :
    S.lowerCut i < (x : EReal) ↔ ∀ k : Fin (n + 1), k.val + 1 = i.val → S.value k < x
proof:
:= by
  cases i using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m =>
    rw [lowerCut_succ, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]
    refine ⟨fun h k hk => ?_, fun h => h _ (by simp)⟩
    rwa [show k = m.castSucc from Fin.ext (by simp at hk; simp; omega)]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.lt_upperCut_iff
statement:
theorem lt_upperCut_iff {i : Fin (n + 1)} {x : ℝ} :
    (x : EReal) < S.upperCut i ↔ ∀ k : Fin (n + 1), i.val + 1 = k.val → x < S.value k
proof:
:= by
  cases i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last => simp only [upperCut_last, EReal.coe_lt_top, Fin.val_last, true_iff]; omega
  | cast m =>
    rw [upperCut_castSucc, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]
    refine ⟨fun h k hk => ?_, fun h => h _ (by simp)⟩
    rwa [show k = m.succ from Fin.ext (by simp at hk; simp; omega)]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.mem_J_iff
statement:
theorem mem_J_iff {i : Fin (n + 1)} {x : ℝ} :
    x ∈ S.J i ↔ (∀ k : Fin (n + 1), k.val + 1 = i.val → S.value k < x) ∧
      (∀ k : Fin (n + 1), i.val + 1 = k.val → x < S.value k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_J, lowerCut_lt_iff, lt_upperCut_iff]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.lowerCut_lt_value
statement: theorem lowerCut_lt_value (i : Fin (n + 1)) : S.lowerCut i < (S.value i : EReal)
proof:
:=
  S.lowerCut_lt_iff.2 fun _ hk => S.strictMono (show _ < _ from by rw [Fin.lt_def]; omega)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.value_lt_upperCut
statement: theorem value_lt_upperCut (i : Fin (n + 1)) : (S.value i : EReal) < S.upperCut i
proof:
:=
  S.lt_upperCut_iff.2 fun _ hk => S.strictMono (show _ < _ from by rw [Fin.lt_def]; omega)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.value_mem_J
statement: theorem value_mem_J (i : Fin (n + 1)) : S.value i ∈ S.J i
proof:
:=
  ⟨S.lowerCut_lt_value i, S.value_lt_upperCut i⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.value_mem_J_iff
statement: theorem value_mem_J_iff {i k : Fin (n + 1)} : S.value k ∈ S.J i ↔ k = i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h ▸ S.value_mem_J i⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := S.mem_J_iff.1 h
  refine Fin.ext (le_antisymm ?_ ?_)
  · by_contra hlt
    have := h₂ ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩ rfl
    exact absurd this (not_lt.2 (S.strictMono.monotone (show _ ≤ _ from by
      rw [Fin.le_def]; simp; omega)))
  · by_contra hlt
    have := h₁ ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩ (by simp; omega)
    exact absurd this (not_lt.2 (S.strictMono.monotone (show _ ≤ _ from by
      rw [Fin.le_def]; simp; omega)))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.K_le_J_castSucc
statement: theorem K_le_J_castSucc (e : Fin n) : S.K e ≤ S.J e.castSucc
proof:
:=
  OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => by
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := mem_ioo.1 hx
    refine ⟨(S.lowerCut_lt_value _).trans (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.2 h₁), ?_⟩
    rw [upperCut_castSucc]
    exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.2 h₂

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.K_le_J_succ
statement: theorem K_le_J_succ (e : Fin n) : S.K e ≤ S.J e.succ
proof:
:=
  OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => by
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := mem_ioo.1 hx
    refine ⟨?_, (EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.2 h₂).trans (S.value_lt_upperCut _)⟩
    rw [lowerCut_succ]
    exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.2 h₁

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.K_nonempty
statement: theorem K_nonempty (e : Fin n) : ((S.K e : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  nonempty_Ioo.2 (S.strictMono Fin.castSucc_lt_succ)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.value_notMem_K
statement: theorem value_notMem_K (e : Fin n) (i : Fin (n + 1)) : S.value i ∉ S.K e
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  rcases lt_or_ge i e.succ with h | h
  · have : i ≤ e.castSucc := Fin.le_castSucc_iff.2 h
    exact absurd h₁ (not_lt.2 (S.strictMono.monotone this))
  · exact absurd h₂ (not_lt.2 (S.strictMono.monotone h))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.value_notMem_lowerTail
statement: theorem value_notMem_lowerTail (i : Fin (n + 1)) : S.value i ∉ S.lowerTail
proof:
:= fun h =>
  absurd (S.mem_lowerTail.1 h) (not_lt.2 (S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le i)))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.value_notMem_upperTail
statement: theorem value_notMem_upperTail (i : Fin (n + 1)) : S.value i ∉ S.upperTail
proof:
:= fun h =>
  absurd (S.mem_upperTail.1 h) (not_lt.2 (S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.le_last i)))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.J_eq_top_of_zero
statement: theorem J_eq_top_of_zero (S : CriticalValues 0) : S.J 0 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h₂ : S.upperCut 0 = ⊤ := S.upperCut_last
  ext x
  rw [S.mem_J, lowerCut_zero, h₂]
  exact ⟨fun _ => trivial, fun _ => ⟨EReal.bot_lt_coe x, EReal.coe_lt_top x⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.lowerTail_le_J_zero
statement: theorem lowerTail_le_J_zero : S.lowerTail ≤ S.J 0
proof:
:=
  OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => S.mem_J_iff.2
    ⟨fun _ hk => by simp at hk, fun k hk => (S.mem_lowerTail.1 hx).trans_le
      (S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le k))⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.upperTail_le_J_last
statement: theorem upperTail_le_J_last : S.upperTail ≤ S.J (Fin.last n)
proof:
:=
  OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => S.mem_J_iff.2
    ⟨fun k _ => (S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.le_last k)).trans_lt (S.mem_upperTail.1 hx),
      fun k hk => by have := k.isLt; simp at hk; omega⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.cut_vertex
statement: theorem cut_vertex (i : Fin (n + 1)) : S.cut i.succ.castSucc = S.value i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cut, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.cons_succ]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.lowerCut_eq_cut
statement: theorem lowerCut_eq_cut (i : Fin (n + 1)) : S.lowerCut i = S.cut i.castSucc.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  cases i using Fin.cases with
  | zero => simp [cut]
  | succ k =>
    have hk : k.succ.castSucc = k.castSucc.succ := Fin.ext rfl
    simp only [lowerCut_succ, cut, Fin.snoc_castSucc, hk, Fin.cons_succ]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.upperCut_eq_cut
statement: theorem upperCut_eq_cut (i : Fin (n + 1)) : S.upperCut i = S.cut i.succ.succ
proof:
:= by
  cases i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last => simp [cut]
  | cast k =>
    have hk : k.castSucc.succ.succ = k.succ.succ.castSucc := Fin.ext rfl
    simp only [upperCut_castSucc, cut, hk, Fin.snoc_castSucc, Fin.cons_succ]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.J_castSucc_inf_J_succ
statement: theorem J_castSucc_inf_J_succ (e : Fin n) : S.J e.castSucc ⊓ S.J e.succ = S.K e
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => ?_)
    (le_inf (S.K_le_J_castSucc e) (S.K_le_J_succ e))
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := (show x ∈ S.J e.castSucc ∧ x ∈ S.J e.succ from hx)
  exact ⟨(S.mem_J_iff.1 h₂).1 _ (by simp), (S.mem_J_iff.1 h₁).2 _ (by simp)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.J_inf_J_eq_bot
statement: theorem J_inf_J_eq_bot {i j : Fin (n + 1)} (h : i.val + 1 < j.val) : S.J i ⊓ S.J j = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => ?_) bot_le
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := (show x ∈ S.J i ∧ x ∈ S.J j from hx)
  have hu := (S.mem_J_iff.1 h₁).2 ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩ rfl
  have hl := (S.mem_J_iff.1 h₂).1 ⟨j.val - 1, by omega⟩ (by simp; omega)
  exact absurd (hl.trans hu) (not_lt.2 (S.strictMono.monotone (show _ ≤ _ from by
    rw [Fin.le_def]; simp; omega)))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.value_mem_of_K_le
statement:
theorem value_mem_of_K_le {e : Fin n} {U : OpenInterval} (hK : S.K e ≤ U)
    (hU : ∃ k, S.value k ∈ U) : S.value e.castSucc ∈ U ∨ S.value e.succ ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hU
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := S.K_nonempty e
  have hyU : y ∈ U := hK hy
  obtain ⟨hy₁, hy₂⟩ := S.mem_K.1 hy
  rcases le_or_gt k e.castSucc with hke | hke
  · exact Or.inl (mem_of_le_of_le hk hyU (S.strictMono.monotone hke) hy₁.le)
  · exact Or.inr (mem_of_le_of_le hyU hk hy₂.le
      (S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.castSucc_lt_iff_succ_le.1 hke)))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.K_le_J_iff
statement:
theorem K_le_J_iff {e : Fin n} {j : Fin (n + 1)} :
    S.K e ≤ S.J j ↔ j = e.castSucc ∨ j = e.succ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · rcases S.value_mem_of_K_le h ⟨j, S.value_mem_J j⟩ with h' | h'
    · exact Or.inl (S.value_mem_J_iff.1 h').symm
    · exact Or.inr (S.value_mem_J_iff.1 h').symm
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    exacts [S.K_le_J_castSucc e, S.K_le_J_succ e]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.eq_of_K_inf_K_nonempty
statement:
theorem eq_of_K_inf_K_nonempty {e e' : Fin n}
    (h : ((S.K e ⊓ S.K e' : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ).Nonempty) : e = e'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := S.mem_K.1 hy
  obtain ⟨h₁', h₂'⟩ := S.mem_K.1 hy'
  rcases lt_trichotomy e e' with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exact absurd (h₁'.trans h₂) (not_lt.2 (S.strictMono.monotone
      (Fin.succ_le_castSucc_iff.2 hlt)))
  · exact heq
  · exact absurd (h₁.trans h₂') (not_lt.2 (S.strictMono.monotone
      (Fin.succ_le_castSucc_iff.2 hgt)))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.eq_of_K_le_K
statement: theorem eq_of_K_le_K {e e' : Fin n} (h : S.K e ≤ S.K e') : e = e'
proof:
:=
  S.eq_of_K_inf_K_nonempty (by rw [inf_eq_left.2 h]; exact S.K_nonempty e)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.not_K_le_lowerTail
statement: theorem not_K_le_lowerTail (e : Fin n) : ¬ S.K e ≤ S.lowerTail
proof:
:= fun h => by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := S.K_nonempty e
  exact absurd ((S.mem_K.1 hy).1.trans (S.mem_lowerTail.1 (h hy)))
    (not_lt.2 (S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le _)))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.not_K_le_upperTail
statement: theorem not_K_le_upperTail (e : Fin n) : ¬ S.K e ≤ S.upperTail
proof:
:= fun h => by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := S.K_nonempty e
  exact absurd ((S.mem_upperTail.1 (h hy)).trans (S.mem_K.1 hy).2)
    (not_lt.2 (S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.le_last _)))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.mem_envelope
statement:
theorem mem_envelope {I : OpenInterval} {x : ℝ} :
    x ∈ S.envelope I ↔ (∀ i, (∀ y ∈ I, S.value i < y) → S.value i < x) ∧
      (∀ i, (∀ y ∈ I, y < S.value i) → x < S.value i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [envelope, mem_ofEReal, envLower, envUpper, Finset.sup_lt_iff (EReal.bot_lt_coe x),
    Finset.lt_inf_iff (EReal.coe_lt_top x)]
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.le_envelope
statement: theorem le_envelope (I : OpenInterval) : I ≤ S.envelope I
proof:
:= fun x hx =>
  S.mem_envelope.2 ⟨fun _ hi => hi x hx, fun _ hi => hi x hx⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_mono
statement: theorem envelope_mono {I I' : OpenInterval} (h : I ≤ I') : S.envelope I ≤ S.envelope I'
proof:
:=
  fun x hx => by
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := S.mem_envelope.1 hx
    exact S.mem_envelope.2 ⟨fun i hi => h₁ i fun y hy => hi y (h hy),
      fun i hi => h₂ i fun y hy => hi y (h hy)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_monotone
statement: theorem envelope_monotone : Monotone S.envelope
proof: := fun _ _ h => S.envelope_mono h

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_eq_bot
statement: theorem envelope_eq_bot {I : OpenInterval} (hI : ¬ (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty) : S.envelope I = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun x hx => ?_) bot_le
  have hI' : ∀ y, y ∉ I := fun y hy => hI ⟨y, hy⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := S.mem_envelope.1 hx
  exact absurd ((h₁ 0 fun y hy => (hI' y hy).elim).trans (h₂ 0 fun y hy => (hI' y hy).elim))
    (lt_irrefl _)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_bot
statement: @[simp] theorem envelope_bot : S.envelope ⊥ = ⊥
proof:
:=
  S.envelope_eq_bot fun ⟨_, h⟩ => h

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.le_envelope_of_hits
statement:
theorem le_envelope_of_hits {P I : OpenInterval} (hP : ∀ i, S.value i ∈ P → S.value i ∈ I)
    (hPI : ∃ x ∈ P, x ∈ I) : P ≤ S.envelope I
proof:
:= fun y hy => by
  obtain ⟨x, hxP, hxI⟩ := hPI
  refine S.mem_envelope.2 ⟨fun i hi => ?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  · have hiP : S.value i ∉ P := fun h => lt_irrefl _ (hi _ (hP i h))
    by_contra hle
    exact hiP (mem_of_le_of_le hy hxP (not_lt.1 hle) (hi x hxI).le)
  · have hiP : S.value i ∉ P := fun h => lt_irrefl _ (hi _ (hP i h))
    by_contra hle
    exact hiP (mem_of_le_of_le hxP hy (hi x hxI).le (not_lt.1 hle))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.le_envelope_of_le
statement:
theorem le_envelope_of_le {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty)
    (hhit : ∀ i, S.value i ∈ I ↔ S.value i ∈ J) : J ≤ S.envelope I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hI
  exact S.le_envelope_of_hits (fun i h => (hhit i).2 h) ⟨x, hIJ hx, hx⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.value_mem_envelope_iff
statement:
theorem value_mem_envelope_iff {I : OpenInterval} (hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    S.value i ∈ S.envelope I ↔ S.value i ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => S.le_envelope I h⟩
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := S.mem_envelope.1 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hI
  by_contra hiI
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (show S.value i ≠ y from fun he => hiI (he ▸ hy)) with hlt | hgt
  · refine lt_irrefl _ (h₁ i fun z hz => ?_)
    by_contra hle
    exact hiI (mem_of_le_of_le hz hy (not_lt.1 hle) hlt.le)
  · refine lt_irrefl _ (h₂ i fun z hz => ?_)
    by_contra hle
    exact hiI (mem_of_le_of_le hy hz hgt.le (not_lt.1 hle))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem envelope_nonempty_iff {I : OpenInterval} :
    ((S.envelope I : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ).Nonempty ↔ (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => ⟨x, S.le_envelope I hx⟩⟩
  by_contra hI
  rw [S.envelope_eq_bot hI] at h
  exact h.ne_empty rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_envelope
statement: theorem envelope_envelope (I : OpenInterval) : S.envelope (S.envelope I) = S.envelope I
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty
  · refine le_antisymm ?_ (S.le_envelope _)
    refine S.le_envelope_of_le ((S.le_envelope I).trans (S.le_envelope _)) hI fun i => ?_
    rw [S.value_mem_envelope_iff (S.envelope_nonempty_iff.2 hI),
      S.value_mem_envelope_iff hI]
  · rw [S.envelope_eq_bot hI, envelope_bot]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_inf_le
statement:
theorem envelope_inf_le (I I' : OpenInterval) :
    S.envelope (I ⊓ I') ≤ S.envelope I ⊓ S.envelope I'
proof:
:=
  le_inf (S.envelope_mono inf_le_left) (S.envelope_mono inf_le_right)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_inf_of_eq
statement:
theorem envelope_inf_of_eq {I I' : OpenInterval} (hI : S.envelope I = I)
    (hI' : S.envelope I' = I') : S.envelope (I ⊓ I') = I ⊓ I'
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (S.le_envelope _)
  have := S.envelope_inf_le I I'
  rwa [hI, hI'] at this

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.exists_envelope_inf_ne
statement:
theorem exists_envelope_inf_ne :
    ∃ I I' : OpenInterval, S.envelope (I ⊓ I') ≠ S.envelope I ⊓ S.envelope I'
proof:
:= by
  set a := S.value 0
  have htail : ∀ {I : OpenInterval} (x : ℝ), x ∈ I → I ≤ S.lowerTail →
      S.lowerTail ≤ S.envelope I := fun x hx hI =>
    S.le_envelope_of_hits (fun i h => (S.value_notMem_lowerTail i h).elim) ⟨x, hI hx, hx⟩
  have hsub₁ : iio (a - 2) ≤ S.lowerTail := fun x (hx : x < a - 2) =>
    (S.mem_lowerTail).2 (by linarith)
  have hsub₂ : ioo (a - 1) a ≤ S.lowerTail := fun x hx => (S.mem_lowerTail).2 (mem_ioo.1 hx).2
  refine ⟨iio (a - 2), ioo (a - 1) a, fun h => ?_⟩
  have hdisj : iio (a - 2) ⊓ ioo (a - 1) a = ⊥ := by
    refine le_antisymm (fun x hx => ?_) bot_le
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := (show x < a - 2 ∧ (a - 1 < x ∧ x < a) from hx)
    linarith
  rw [hdisj, envelope_bot] at h
  have hmem : a - 1 / 2 ∈ S.envelope (iio (a - 2)) ⊓ S.envelope (ioo (a - 1) a) :=
    ⟨htail (a - 3) (show a - 3 < a - 2 by linarith) hsub₁ ((S.mem_lowerTail).2 (by linarith)),
      htail (a - 1 / 2) (mem_ioo.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩) hsub₂
        ((S.mem_lowerTail).2 (by linarith))⟩
  rw [← h] at hmem
  exact hmem

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_le_of_refines
proof:
:= fun x hx => by
  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := T.mem_envelope.1 hx
  refine S.mem_envelope.2 ⟨fun i hi => ?_, fun i hi => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hST ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [← hj] at hi ⊢
    exact h₁ j hi
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hST ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [← hj] at hi ⊢
    exact h₂ j hi

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.lowerTail_le_of_refines
statement:
theorem lowerTail_le_of_refines {m : ℕ} {T : CriticalValues m}
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) : T.lowerTail ≤ S.lowerTail
proof:
:= fun x hx => by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hST ⟨0, rfl⟩
  exact S.mem_lowerTail.2 (hj ▸ (T.mem_lowerTail.1 hx).trans_le
    (T.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le j)))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.upperTail_le_of_refines
statement:
theorem upperTail_le_of_refines {m : ℕ} {T : CriticalValues m}
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) : T.upperTail ≤ S.upperTail
proof:
:= fun x hx => by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hST ⟨Fin.last n, rfl⟩
  exact S.mem_upperTail.2 (hj ▸ (T.strictMono.monotone (Fin.le_last j)).trans_lt
    (T.mem_upperTail.1 hx))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelopeFunctor_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem envelopeFunctor_obj (I : OpenInterval) :
    S.envelopeFunctor.obj I = S.envelope I
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_ofEReal_le
statement:
theorem envelope_ofEReal_le {lo hi : EReal} (hlo : lo = ⊥ ∨ ∃ k, lo = S.value k)
    (hhi : hi = ⊤ ∨ ∃ k, hi = S.value k) : S.envelope (ofEReal lo hi) ≤ ofEReal lo hi
proof:
:=
  fun x hx => by
    obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := S.mem_envelope.1 hx
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases hlo with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
      · exact EReal.bot_lt_coe x
      · exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.2 (h₁ k fun y hy => EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.1 hy.1)
    · rcases hhi with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
      · exact EReal.coe_lt_top x
      · exact EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.2 (h₂ k fun y hy => EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff.1 hy.2)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.K_eq_ofEReal
statement:
theorem K_eq_ofEReal (e : Fin n) :
    S.K e = ofEReal (S.value e.castSucc : EReal) (S.value e.succ : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [mem_K]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.lowerTail_eq_ofEReal
statement: theorem lowerTail_eq_ofEReal : S.lowerTail = ofEReal ⊥ (S.value 0 : EReal)
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [mem_lowerTail]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.upperTail_eq_ofEReal
statement: theorem upperTail_eq_ofEReal : S.upperTail = ofEReal (S.value (Fin.last n) : EReal) ⊤
proof:
:= by
  ext x; simp [mem_upperTail]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_J
statement: theorem envelope_J (i : Fin (n + 1)) : S.envelope (S.J i) = S.J i
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (S.envelope_ofEReal_le ?_ ?_) (S.le_envelope _)
  · cases i using Fin.cases with
    | zero => exact Or.inl (S.lowerCut_zero)
    | succ k => exact Or.inr ⟨_, S.lowerCut_succ k⟩
  · cases i using Fin.lastCases with
    | last => exact Or.inl S.upperCut_last
    | cast k => exact Or.inr ⟨_, S.upperCut_castSucc k⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_K
statement: theorem envelope_K (e : Fin n) : S.envelope (S.K e) = S.K e
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (S.le_envelope _)
  rw [S.K_eq_ofEReal]
  exact S.envelope_ofEReal_le (Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩) (Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_lowerTail
statement: theorem envelope_lowerTail : S.envelope S.lowerTail = S.lowerTail
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (S.le_envelope _)
  rw [S.lowerTail_eq_ofEReal]
  exact S.envelope_ofEReal_le (Or.inl rfl) (Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_upperTail
statement: theorem envelope_upperTail : S.envelope S.upperTail = S.upperTail
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (S.le_envelope _)
  rw [S.upperTail_eq_ofEReal]
  exact S.envelope_ofEReal_le (Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩) (Or.inl rfl)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.J_le_envelope
statement:
theorem J_le_envelope {I : OpenInterval} {i : Fin (n + 1)} (h : S.value i ∈ I) :
    S.J i ≤ S.envelope I
proof:
:=
  S.le_envelope_of_hits (fun _ hk => (S.value_mem_J_iff.1 hk) ▸ h) ⟨_, S.value_mem_J i, h⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_eq_J
statement:
theorem envelope_eq_J {I : OpenInterval} {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hI : I ≤ S.J i)
    (h : S.value i ∈ I) : S.envelope I = S.J i
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((S.envelope_mono hI).trans_eq (S.envelope_J i)) (S.J_le_envelope h)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_eq_K
statement:
theorem envelope_eq_K {I : OpenInterval} {e : Fin n} (hI : I ≤ S.K e)
    (hne : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty) : S.envelope I = S.K e
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((S.envelope_mono hI).trans_eq (S.envelope_K e))
    (S.le_envelope_of_le hI hne fun i =>
      iff_of_false (fun h => S.value_notMem_K e i (hI h)) (S.value_notMem_K e i))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_eq_lowerTail
statement:
theorem envelope_eq_lowerTail {I : OpenInterval} (hI : I ≤ S.lowerTail)
    (hne : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty) : S.envelope I = S.lowerTail
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((S.envelope_mono hI).trans_eq S.envelope_lowerTail)
    (S.le_envelope_of_le hI hne fun i =>
      iff_of_false (fun h => S.value_notMem_lowerTail i (hI h)) (S.value_notMem_lowerTail i))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_eq_upperTail
statement:
theorem envelope_eq_upperTail {I : OpenInterval} (hI : I ≤ S.upperTail)
    (hne : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty) : S.envelope I = S.upperTail
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((S.envelope_mono hI).trans_eq S.envelope_upperTail)
    (S.le_envelope_of_le hI hne fun i =>
      iff_of_false (fun h => S.value_notMem_upperTail i (hI h)) (S.value_notMem_upperTail i))

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.envelope_piece
statement: theorem envelope_piece (p : Piece n) : S.envelope (S.piece p) = S.piece p
proof:
:= by
  cases p
  exacts [S.envelope_J _, S.envelope_K _, S.envelope_lowerTail, S.envelope_upperTail]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.value_mem_piece_iff
statement:
theorem value_mem_piece_iff {p : Piece n} {k : Fin (n + 1)} :
    S.value k ∈ S.piece p ↔ p = .star k
proof:
:= by
  cases p with
  | star i => exact S.value_mem_J_iff.trans ⟨fun h => h ▸ rfl, fun h => (Piece.star.inj h).symm⟩
  | gap e => exact iff_of_false (S.value_notMem_K e k) fun h => by cases h
  | lowerTail => exact iff_of_false (S.value_notMem_lowerTail k) fun h => by cases h
  | upperTail => exact iff_of_false (S.value_notMem_upperTail k) fun h => by cases h

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.exists_piece
statement:
theorem exists_piece (x : ℝ) :
    ∃ p : Piece n, x ∈ S.piece p ∧ ∀ i, S.value i ∈ S.piece p → S.value i = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv : ∃ i, S.value i = x
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hv
    exact ⟨.star i, S.value_mem_J i, fun k hk => by rw [S.value_mem_J_iff.1 hk]⟩
  push Not at hv
  by_cases h0 : x < S.value 0
  · exact ⟨.lowerTail, h0, fun i hi => (S.value_notMem_lowerTail i hi).elim⟩
  have h0' : S.value 0 < x := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.1 h0) (hv 0)
  by_cases hn : S.value (Fin.last n) < x
  · exact ⟨.upperTail, hn, fun i hi => (S.value_notMem_upperTail i hi).elim⟩
  classical
  set s := Finset.univ.filter fun i => S.value i < x
  have hs : s.Nonempty := ⟨0, by simp [s, h0']⟩
  set i := s.max' hs
  have hi : S.value i < x := by simpa [s] using s.max'_mem hs
  have hil : i ≠ Fin.last n := fun h => hn (h ▸ hi)
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.2 hil
  have hsucc : x < S.value e.succ := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.1 fun h => ?_) (fun h => hv _ h.symm)
    have : e.succ ≤ i := s.le_max' e.succ (by simp [s, h])
    rw [← he] at this
    exact absurd this (not_le.2 Fin.castSucc_lt_succ)
  exact ⟨.gap e, ⟨he ▸ hi, hsucc⟩, fun k hk => (S.value_notMem_K e k hk).elim⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.exists_mem_K_of_mem_Icc
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hxp, hp⟩ := S.exists_piece x
  cases p with
  | star i => exact (hne i (hp i (S.value_mem_J i))).elim
  | gap e => exact ⟨e, hxp⟩
  | lowerTail => exact (not_lt_of_ge hx.1 (S.mem_lowerTail.1 hxp)).elim
  | upperTail => exact (not_lt_of_ge hx.2 (S.mem_upperTail.1 hxp)).elim

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.exists_piece_le_envelope
statement:
theorem exists_piece_le_envelope {I : OpenInterval} {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ S.envelope I) :
    ∃ p : Piece n, x ∈ S.piece p ∧ S.piece p ≤ S.envelope I
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hxp, hp⟩ := S.exists_piece x
  refine ⟨p, hxp, ?_⟩
  have := S.le_envelope_of_hits (I := S.envelope I) (fun i hi => (hp i hi) ▸ hx) ⟨x, hxp, hx⟩
  rwa [S.envelope_envelope] at this

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.iUnion_piece_eq
statement:
theorem iUnion_piece_eq {U : OpenInterval} (hU : S.envelope U = U) :
    ⋃ p : {p : Piece n // S.piece p ≤ U}, (S.piece p.1 : Set ℝ) = U
proof:
:= by
  refine Subset.antisymm (iUnion_subset fun p => OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 p.2) fun x hx => ?_
  rw [← hU] at hx
  obtain ⟨p, hxp, hp⟩ := S.exists_piece_le_envelope hx
  exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨p, hU ▸ hp⟩, hxp⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.K_le_envelope_cases
statement:
theorem K_le_envelope_cases {e : Fin n} {V : OpenInterval} (hV : S.envelope V = V)
    (hK : S.K e ≤ V) : V = S.K e ∨ S.J e.castSucc ≤ V ∨ S.J e.succ ≤ V
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hhit : ∃ k, S.value k ∈ V
  · rcases S.value_mem_of_K_le hK hhit with h | h
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (hV ▸ S.J_le_envelope h))
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (hV ▸ S.J_le_envelope h))
  · push Not at hhit
    refine Or.inl (le_antisymm ?_ hK)
    rw [← S.envelope_K e]
    exact S.le_envelope_of_le hK (S.K_nonempty e) fun i =>
      iff_of_false (S.value_notMem_K e i) (hhit i)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.iUnion_J_eq_envelope
statement:
theorem iUnion_J_eq_envelope {I : OpenInterval} (h : ∃ i, S.value i ∈ I) :
    ⋃ i : {i : Fin (n + 1) // S.value i ∈ I}, (S.J i.1 : Set ℝ) = S.envelope I
proof:
:= by
  have hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty := let ⟨i, hi⟩ := h; ⟨_, hi⟩
  have hN := S.envelope_envelope I
  have hhitN : ∃ k, S.value k ∈ S.envelope I := let ⟨i, hi⟩ := h; ⟨i, S.le_envelope I hi⟩
  have hmem : ∀ {x : ℝ} (k : Fin (n + 1)), S.value k ∈ S.envelope I → x ∈ S.J k →
      x ∈ ⋃ i : {i : Fin (n + 1) // S.value i ∈ I}, (S.J i.1 : Set ℝ) := fun k hk hx =>
    mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨k, (S.value_mem_envelope_iff hI k).1 hk⟩, hx⟩
  refine Subset.antisymm (iUnion_subset fun i => OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1
    (S.J_le_envelope i.2)) fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨p, hxp, hp⟩ := S.exists_piece_le_envelope hx
  cases p with
  | star i => exact hmem i (hp (S.value_mem_J i)) hxp
  | gap e =>
    rcases S.value_mem_of_K_le hp hhitN with h' | h'
    · exact hmem _ h' (S.K_le_J_castSucc e hxp)
    · exact hmem _ h' (S.K_le_J_succ e hxp)
  | lowerTail =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hhitN
    refine hmem 0 (mem_of_le_of_le (hp hxp) hk (S.mem_lowerTail.1 hxp).le
      (S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le k))) (S.lowerTail_le_J_zero hxp)
  | upperTail =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hhitN
    refine hmem (Fin.last n) (mem_of_le_of_le hk (hp hxp)
      (S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.le_last k)) (S.mem_upperTail.1 hxp).le)
      (S.upperTail_le_J_last hxp)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.apply_ofStrip
statement:
theorem apply_ofStrip (k : Fin n) (y : (ofFiniteData D).E k) (t : (S.K k : Set ℝ)) :
    g ((ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S k (y, t)) =
      (ofFiniteData D').ofStrip S k (edgeMap g hg k y, t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_ofStrip_eq S g hg k t y, edgeMap,
    regularFiberMap_indep_of_discrete S g hg k t (basePt S k)]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.apply_ofCylinder
statement:
theorem apply_ofCylinder (k : Fin n) (y : (ofFiniteData D).E k) (p : Seg S k) :
    g ((ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder S k (y, p)) =
      (ofFiniteData D').ofCylinder S k (edgeMap g hg k y, p)
proof:
:= by
  have hab := (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ k).le
  have hF : Continuous fun t : ℝ =>
      g ((ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder S k (y, projIcc _ _ hab t)) :=
    g.continuous.comp (((ofFiniteData D).continuous_ofCylinder S k).comp
      (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_projIcc))
  have hG : Continuous fun t : ℝ =>
      (ofFiniteData D').ofCylinder S k (edgeMap g hg k y, projIcc _ _ hab t) :=
    ((ofFiniteData D').continuous_ofCylinder S k).comp
      (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_projIcc)
  have hEq : EqOn (fun t : ℝ => g ((ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder S k (y, projIcc _ _ hab t)))
      (fun t : ℝ => (ofFiniteData D').ofCylinder S k (edgeMap g hg k y, projIcc _ _ hab t))
      (Ioo (S.value k.castSucc) (S.value k.succ)) := by
    intro t ht
    have hp : projIcc _ _ hab t = gapIncl S k ⟨t, ht⟩ :=
      projIcc_of_mem hab (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)
    show g ((ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder S k (y, projIcc _ _ hab t)) =
      (ofFiniteData D').ofCylinder S k (edgeMap g hg k y, projIcc _ _ hab t)
    rw [hp]
    exact apply_ofStrip g hg k y ⟨t, ht⟩
  have h := (hEq.closure hF hG)
    (show (p : ℝ) ∈ closure (Ioo (S.value k.castSucc) (S.value k.succ)) by
      rw [closure_Ioo (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ k).ne]; exact p.2)
  simpa only [projIcc_val] using h

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.apply_ofVertex
statement:
theorem apply_ofVertex (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : (ofFiniteData D).V i) :
    g ((ofFiniteData D).ofVertex S i x) =
      (ofFiniteData D').ofVertex S i (vertexFiberMap S g hg i x)
proof:
:=
  map_ofVertex_eq S g hg i x

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.homEquiv_apply
statement: theorem homEquiv_apply (φ : D.Hom D') : ((homEquiv S φ).1 : C(_, _)) = realizeHom S φ
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.comp_def
statement:
theorem _root_.TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.comp_def {D D' D'' : FiniteReebData.{u} n}
    (φ : D ⟶ D') (ψ : D' ⟶ D'') : φ ≫ ψ = FiniteReebData.Hom.comp φ ψ
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.id_def
statement:
theorem _root_.TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.id_def (D : FiniteReebData.{u} n) :
    𝟙 D = FiniteReebData.Hom.id D
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.discreteTopology_fiber
statement:
theorem discreteTopology_fiber (D : FiniteReebData.{u} n) (t : ℝ) :
    DiscreteTopology ((ofFiniteData D).height S ⁻¹' {t})
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hne : ((ofFiniteData D).height S ⁻¹' {t}).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hne
    rcases (ofFiniteData D).exists_rep S q with ⟨i, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, p, rfl⟩
    · have ht : S.value i = t := hq
      subst ht
      exact ((ofFiniteData D).criticalFiberHomeomorph S i).discreteTopology_iff.1 inferInstance
    · have ht : (p.2 : ℝ) = t := hq
      subst ht
      exact ((ofFiniteData D).regularFiberHomeomorph S e p.2).discreteTopology_iff.1
        inferInstance
  · rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hne
    rw [hne]
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.reebRel_iff_eq
statement:
theorem reebRel_iff_eq (D : FiniteReebData.{u} n) (q q' : (ofFiniteData D).Realization S) :
    ReebRel ((ofFiniteData D).height S) q q' ↔ q = q'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨γ, hγ⟩
    have := discreteTopology_fiber S D ((ofFiniteData D).height S q)
    let c : Path (⟨q, rfl⟩ : (ofFiniteData D).height S ⁻¹' {(ofFiniteData D).height S q})
        ⟨q', by simpa using hγ 1⟩ :=
      ⟨⟨fun s => ⟨γ s, hγ s⟩, γ.continuous.subtype_mk _⟩, Subtype.ext γ.source,
        Subtype.ext γ.target⟩
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (joined_eq_of_discrete ⟨c⟩)
  · rintro rfl
    exact ReebRel.refl _ q

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.projHomeomorph_apply
statement:
theorem projHomeomorph_apply (D : FiniteReebData.{u} n) (q) :
    projHomeomorph S D q = ReebQuotient.proj ((ofFiniteData D).height S) q
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.height_projHomeomorph
statement:
theorem height_projHomeomorph (D : FiniteReebData.{u} n) (q) :
    ReebQuotient.height _ (projHomeomorph S D q) = (ofFiniteData D).height S q
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.projInv_natural
statement:
theorem projInv_natural {D D' : FiniteReebData.{u} n}
    (g : C((ofFiniteData D).Realization S, (ofFiniteData D').Realization S))
    (hg : ∀ q, (ofFiniteData D').height S (g q) = (ofFiniteData D).height S q) :
    (projInv S D').comp (ReebQuotient.map g hg) = g.comp (projInv S D)
proof:
:=
  ReebQuotient.hom_ext fun _ => rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.e_injective_of_iso
statement:
theorem e_injective_of_iso {D D' : FiniteReebData.{u} n} (i : D ≅ D') (k : Fin n) :
    Function.Injective (i.hom.e k)
proof:
:= fun x y h => by
  have hc := congrArg (fun φ : D ⟶ D => φ.e k) i.hom_inv_id
  have hx : i.inv.e k (i.hom.e k x) = x := congrFun hc x
  have hy : i.inv.e k (i.hom.e k y) = y := congrFun hc y
  rw [← hx, ← hy, h]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.v_injective_of_iso
statement:
theorem v_injective_of_iso {D D' : FiniteReebData.{u} n} (i : D ≅ D') (k : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (i.hom.v k)
proof:
:= fun x y h => by
  have hc := congrArg (fun φ : D ⟶ D => φ.v k) i.hom_inv_id
  have hx : i.inv.v k (i.hom.v k x) = x := congrFun hc x
  have hy : i.inv.v k (i.hom.v k y) = y := congrFun hc y
  rw [← hx, ← hy, h]

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.finite_fiber
statement:
theorem finite_fiber (S : CriticalValues n) (D : FiniteReebData.{u} n) (t : ℝ) :
    Finite ((ofFiniteData D).height S ⁻¹' {t})
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.Finite.to_subtype (Set.Finite.subset
    ((Set.finite_range fun v : (Σ i, D.V i) => (ofFiniteData D).ofVertex S v.1 v.2).union
      (Set.finite_range fun z : (Σ e, D.E e) => (ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder S z.1
        (z.2, projIcc _ _ (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ z.1).le t))) ?_)
  intro q hq
  rcases (ofFiniteData D).exists_rep S q with ⟨i, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, p, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨i, v⟩, rfl⟩
  · have ht : (p.2 : ℝ) = t := hq
    subst ht
    refine Or.inr ⟨⟨e, p.1⟩, ?_⟩
    show (ofFiniteData D).ofCylinder S e (p.1, projIcc _ _ _ (p.2 : ℝ)) =
      (ofFiniteData D).ofStrip S e p
    rw [projIcc_of_mem _ (Ioo_subset_Icc_self p.2.2)]
    rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isEmpty_fiber
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun q => ht ((show P.height S q.1 = t from q.2) ▸ P.height_mem_Icc S q.1)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.exists_strip_rep
statement:
theorem exists_strip_rep (P : CylinderPresentation.{u} n) (q : P.Realization S) {t : ℝ}
    (hq : P.height S q = t) (ht : ∀ i, S.value i ≠ t) :
    ∃ (e : Fin n) (h : t ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (z : P.E e),
      q = P.ofStrip S e (z, ⟨t, h⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rcases P.exists_rep S q with ⟨i, v, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, p, rfl⟩
  · exact absurd hq (ht i)
  · have hp : (p.2 : ℝ) = t := hq
    subst hp
    exact ⟨e, p.2.2, p.1, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.segMap_segBot
statement: @[simp] theorem segMap_segBot (e : Fin n) : segMap S T e (segBot S e) = segBot T e
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [segMap, segBot]

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.segMap_segTop
statement: @[simp] theorem segMap_segTop (e : Fin n) : segMap S T e (segTop S e) = segTop T e
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hs : S.value e.succ - S.value e.castSucc ≠ 0 :=
    (sub_pos.mpr (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e)).ne'
  simp [segMap, segTop, hs]

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.segMap_segMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem segMap_segMap (e : Fin n) (t : Seg S e) :
    segMap T S e (segMap S T e t) = t
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hs : S.value e.succ - S.value e.castSucc ≠ 0 :=
    (sub_pos.mpr (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e)).ne'
  have ht : T.value e.succ - T.value e.castSucc ≠ 0 :=
    (sub_pos.mpr (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ e)).ne'
  change S.value e.castSucc +
    (T.value e.castSucc + ((t : ℝ) - S.value e.castSucc) /
      (S.value e.succ - S.value e.castSucc) * (T.value e.succ - T.value e.castSucc) -
      T.value e.castSucc) / (T.value e.succ - T.value e.castSucc) *
      (S.value e.succ - S.value e.castSucc) = t
  field_simp
  ring

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.segMap_self
statement: @[simp] theorem segMap_self (e : Fin n) (t : Seg S e) : segMap S S e t = t
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hs : S.value e.succ - S.value e.castSucc ≠ 0 :=
    (sub_pos.mpr (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e)).ne'
  change S.value e.castSucc + ((t : ℝ) - S.value e.castSucc) /
    (S.value e.succ - S.value e.castSucc) * (S.value e.succ - S.value e.castSucc) = t
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hs]
  ring

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.abs_sub_segMap_le
statement:
theorem abs_sub_segMap_le (e : Fin n) (t : Seg S e) :
    |(t : ℝ) - segMap S T e t| ≤
      max |S.value e.castSucc - T.value e.castSucc| |S.value e.succ - T.value e.succ|
proof:
:= by
  let weight := ((t : ℝ) - S.value e.castSucc) / (S.value e.succ - S.value e.castSucc)
  have hs := sub_pos.mpr (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e)
  have hweight0 : 0 ≤ weight := div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr t.2.1) hs.le
  have hweight1 : weight ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hs).mpr (by linarith [t.2.2])
  have ha := abs_le.mp (le_max_left |S.value e.castSucc - T.value e.castSucc|
    |S.value e.succ - T.value e.succ|)
  have hb := abs_le.mp (le_max_right |S.value e.castSucc - T.value e.castSucc|
    |S.value e.succ - T.value e.succ|)
  have hformula : (t : ℝ) - segMap S T e t =
      (1 - weight) * (S.value e.castSucc - T.value e.castSucc) +
        weight * (S.value e.succ - T.value e.succ) := by
    change (t : ℝ) - (T.value e.castSucc + weight * (T.value e.succ - T.value e.castSucc)) = _
    dsimp [weight]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hformula]
  have hweight : 0 ≤ 1 - weight := sub_nonneg.mpr hweight1
  have ha₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha.1 hweight
  have ha₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha.2 hweight
  have hb₁ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb.1 hweight0
  have hb₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb.2 hweight0
  exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by nlinarith, by nlinarith⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.levelMap_ofVertex

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.abs_height_sub_height_levelMap_le
statement:
theorem abs_height_sub_height_levelMap_le (q : P.Realization S) :
    |P.height S q - P.height T (P.levelMap S T q)| ≤ dist S.value T.value
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := P.quotMk_surjective S q
  rcases x with ⟨i, v⟩ | ⟨e, y, t⟩
  · change |P.height S (P.ofVertex S i v) -
      P.height T (P.levelMap S T (P.ofVertex S i v))| ≤ _
    simpa only [levelMap_ofVertex, height_ofVertex, Real.dist_eq] using
      dist_le_pi_dist S.value T.value i
  · change |P.height S (P.ofCylinder S e (y, t)) -
      P.height T (P.levelMap S T (P.ofCylinder S e (y, t)))| ≤ _
    simp only [levelMap_ofCylinder, height_ofCylinder]
    exact (abs_sub_segMap_le S T e t).trans (max_le
      (by simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using dist_le_pi_dist S.value T.value e.castSucc)
      (by simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using dist_le_pi_dist S.value T.value e.succ))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.edist_height_levelMap_le
statement:
theorem edist_height_levelMap_le :
    edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(P.height S))
        (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑((P.height T).comp (P.levelMap S T))) ≤ edist S.value T.value
proof:
:= by
  apply UniformFun.edist_le.mpr
  intro q
  simpa only [UniformFun.toFun_ofFun, ContinuousMap.comp_apply, edist_dist, Real.dist_eq] using
    ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (P.abs_height_sub_height_levelMap_le S T q)

:=
