name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.TDA.Reeb.RGraph.isConstructibleSpace_levelPerturbation
proof:
:= by
  apply isConstructibleSpace_of_iso_realization P (S := T)
  exact Over.isoMk ((Over.forget (TopCat.of ℝ)).mapIso i ≪≫
    TopCat.isoOfHomeo (P.levelHomeomorph S T)) (by ext x; rfl)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.TDA.Reeb.RGraph.edist_levelPerturbation_le
statement:
theorem edist_levelPerturbation_le {A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)} {S : CriticalValues n}
    (i : A ≅ Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S))) (T : CriticalValues n) :
    edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(overBaseMap A))
        (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(overBaseMap (P.levelPerturbation i T))) ≤ edist S.value T.value
proof:
:= by
  apply UniformFun.edist_le.mpr
  intro x
  have hi : P.height S (i.hom.left.hom x) = overBaseMap A x := overBaseMap_comm i.hom x
  change edist (overBaseMap A x)
    (P.height T (P.levelMap S T (i.hom.left.hom x))) ≤ edist S.value T.value
  rw [← hi, edist_dist, edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (P.abs_height_sub_height_levelMap_le S T _)

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.TDA.Reeb.RGraph.constructibleInterleavingDistance_realizationSpace_le
statement:
theorem constructibleInterleavingDistance_realizationSpace_le (S T : CriticalValues n) :
    constructibleInterleavingDistance (P.realizationSpace S) (P.realizationSpace T) ≤
      edist S.value T.value
proof:
:= by
  let hg := P.isConstructibleSpace_height_comp_levelMap S T
  have e : P.realizationSpace T ≅ (⟨_, hg⟩ : ConstructibleSpaceCat) :=
    ObjectProperty.isoMk _ (P.levelOverIso S T).symm
  calc
    _ = constructibleInterleavingDistance (P.realizationSpace S) ⟨_, hg⟩ :=
      constructibleInterleavingDistance_congr (Iso.refl _) e
    _ ≤ edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(P.height S))
        (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑((P.height T).comp (P.levelMap S T))) :=
      constructibleInterleavingDistance_le_edist (P.isConstructibleSpace_realization S) hg
    _ ≤ _ := P.edist_height_levelMap_le S T

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.TDA.Reeb.RGraph.constructibleInterleavingDistance_levelPerturbation_le
statement:
theorem constructibleInterleavingDistance_levelPerturbation_le {A : Over (TopCat.of ℝ)}
    {S : CriticalValues n} (i : A ≅ Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom (P.height S)))
    (T : CriticalValues n) :
    constructibleInterleavingDistance ⟨A, isConstructibleSpace_of_iso_realization P i⟩
        ⟨_, isConstructibleSpace_levelPerturbation P i T⟩ ≤
      edist (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(overBaseMap A))
        (UniformFun.ofFun ⇑(overBaseMap (P.levelPerturbation i T)))
proof:
:= by
  let f := overBaseMap A
  let g := overBaseMap (P.levelPerturbation i T)
  let e : A ≅ Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom f) :=
    Over.isoMk (Iso.refl _) (by simp [f, overBaseMap])
  have hf : IsConstructibleSpace (Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom f)) :=
    isConstructibleSpace_of_iso_realization P (e.symm ≪≫ i)
  have hg : IsConstructibleSpace (Over.mk (TopCat.ofHom g)) :=
    isConstructibleSpace_levelPerturbation P i T
  calc
    _ = constructibleInterleavingDistance ⟨_, hf⟩ ⟨_, hg⟩ :=
      constructibleInterleavingDistance_congr (ObjectProperty.isoMk _ e) (Iso.refl _)
    _ ≤ _ := constructibleInterleavingDistance_le_edist hf hg

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_toRGraph_le
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_toRGraph_le (D : FiniteReebData.{0} n)
    (S T : CriticalValues n) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance ((toRGraph S).obj D) ((toRGraph T).obj D) ≤
      edist S.value T.value
proof:
:= by
  rw [← constructibleInterleavingDistance_rgraphToConstructible]
  change constructibleInterleavingDistance
    ((CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData D).realizationSpace S)
    ((CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData D).realizationSpace T) ≤ _
  exact constructibleInterleavingDistance_realizationSpace_le _ S T

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.TDA.Reeb.RGraph.heightRange_quotientRGraphFunctor_obj
statement:
theorem heightRange_quotientRGraphFunctor_obj (X : ConstructibleSpaceCat) :
    heightRange (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X) = Set.range (overBaseMap X.obj)
proof:
:= by
  change Set.range (ReebQuotient.height (overBaseMap X.obj)) = Set.range (overBaseMap X.obj)
  ext t
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ReebQuotient.mk_surjective (overBaseMap X.obj) q
    exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨ReebQuotient.mk (overBaseMap X.obj) x, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.TDA.Reeb.RGraph.ofReal_abs_sSup_range_sub_le_constructibleInterleavingDistance
statement:
theorem ofReal_abs_sSup_range_sub_le_constructibleInterleavingDistance
    (X Y : ConstructibleSpaceCat) [Nonempty X.obj.left] [Nonempty Y.obj.left] :
    ENNReal.ofReal |sSup (Set.range (overBaseMap X.obj)) - sSup (Set.range (overBaseMap Y.obj))| ≤
      constructibleInterleavingDistance X Y
proof:
:= by
  have hbX := bddAbove_heightRange (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X)
  have hbY := bddAbove_heightRange (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj Y)
  rw [heightRange_quotientRGraphFunctor_obj] at hbX hbY
  have h := ofReal_abs_sSup_sub_le_hausdorffEDist (Set.range_nonempty _) (Set.range_nonempty _)
    hbX hbY
  rw [constructibleInterleavingDistance_eq_geometricInterleavingDistance]
  exact h.trans (by
    simpa only [heightRange_quotientRGraphFunctor_obj] using
      hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le_geometricInterleavingDistance
        (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj X) (quotientRGraphFunctor.obj Y))

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.edist_translate
statement:
theorem edist_translate (S : CriticalValues n) (c : ℝ) :
    edist S.value (S.translate c).value = ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:= by
  have h (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
      edist (S.value i) ((S.translate c).value i) = ENNReal.ofReal |c| := by
    rw [edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
    change ENNReal.ofReal |S.value i - (S.value i + c)| = _
    rw [show S.value i - (S.value i + c) = -c by ring, abs_neg]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact edist_pi_le_iff.mpr fun i => (h i).le
  · exact (h 0).symm.le.trans (edist_le_pi_edist S.value (S.translate c).value 0)

proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.height_levelMap_translate
statement:
theorem height_levelMap_translate (S : CriticalValues n) (c : ℝ) (q : P.Realization S) :
    P.height (S.translate c) (P.levelMap S (S.translate c) q) = P.height S q + c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := P.quotMk_surjective S q
  rcases x with ⟨i, v⟩ | ⟨e, y, t⟩
  · change P.height (S.translate c) (P.levelMap S (S.translate c) (P.ofVertex S i v)) =
      P.height S (P.ofVertex S i v) + c
    rw [levelMap_ofVertex, height_ofVertex, height_ofVertex]
    rfl
  · change P.height (S.translate c) (P.levelMap S (S.translate c)
      (P.ofCylinder S e (y, t))) = _
    simp only [levelMap_ofCylinder, height_ofCylinder]
    have hs : S.value e.succ - S.value e.castSucc ≠ 0 :=
      (sub_pos.mpr (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e)).ne'
    change S.value e.castSucc + c + ((t : ℝ) - S.value e.castSucc) /
      (S.value e.succ - S.value e.castSucc) *
      ((S.value e.succ + c) - (S.value e.castSucc + c)) = (t : ℝ) + c
    field_simp
    ring

name: TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.TDA.Reeb.RGraph.constructibleInterleavingDistance_realizationSpace_translate
statement:
theorem constructibleInterleavingDistance_realizationSpace_translate (S : CriticalValues n)
    (c : ℝ) [Nonempty (P.Realization S)] :
    constructibleInterleavingDistance (P.realizationSpace S)
        (P.realizationSpace (S.translate c)) = ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa only [S.edist_translate c] using
      constructibleInterleavingDistance_realizationSpace_le P S (S.translate c)
  · obtain ⟨q⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty (P.Realization S))
    let : Nonempty (P.realizationSpace S).obj.left := ⟨q⟩
    let : Nonempty (P.realizationSpace (S.translate c)).obj.left :=
      ⟨P.levelMap S (S.translate c) q⟩
    have h := ofReal_abs_sSup_range_sub_le_constructibleInterleavingDistance
      (P.realizationSpace S) (P.realizationSpace (S.translate c))
    have hrange : Set.range (P.height (S.translate c)) =
        (fun t : ℝ => t + c) '' Set.range (P.height S) := by
      ext t
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
        obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (P.levelHomeomorph S (S.translate c)).surjective y
        exact ⟨P.height S x, ⟨x, rfl⟩, (P.height_levelMap_translate S c x).symm⟩
      · rintro ⟨t, ⟨x, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨P.levelMap S (S.translate c) x, P.height_levelMap_translate S c x⟩
    have hb : BddAbove (Set.range (P.height S)) :=
      ⟨S.value (Fin.last n), fun _ ⟨x, hx⟩ => hx ▸ (P.height_mem_Icc S x).2⟩
    have hsup : sSup (Set.range (P.height (S.translate c))) =
        sSup (Set.range (P.height S)) + c := by
      rw [hrange]
      exact ((OrderIso.addRight c).map_csSup' (Set.range_nonempty _) hb).symm
    change ENNReal.ofReal |sSup (Set.range (P.height S)) -
      sSup (Set.range (P.height (S.translate c)))| ≤ _ at h
    rw [hsup, show sSup (Set.range (P.height S)) -
      (sSup (Set.range (P.height S)) + c) = -c by ring, abs_neg] at h
    exact h

name: TDA.Reeb.interleavingDistance_translatePre
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_translatePre (c : ℝ) (F G : OpenInterval ⥤ C) :
    interleavingDistance (translatePre c F) (translatePre c G) = interleavingDistance F G
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (d : ℝ) (F G : OpenInterval ⥤ C),
      interleavingDistance (translatePre d F) (translatePre d G) ≤ interleavingDistance F G :=
    fun d _ _ => le_iInf₂ fun _ ⟨i⟩ => (i.translatePre d).interleavingDistance_le
  refine le_antisymm (key c F G) ?_
  have e : ∀ H : OpenInterval ⥤ C, translatePre (-c) (translatePre c H) ≅ H := fun H =>
    translatePreTranslatePreIso (-c) c H ≪≫ eqToIso (by rw [add_neg_cancel]) ≪≫
      translatePreZeroIso H
  rw [← interleavingDistance_congr (e F) (e G)]
  exact key (-c) _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_translateRGraph_self
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_translateRGraph_self (A : RGraphCat)
    (hA : Nonempty A.obj.left) (c : ℝ) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A ((translateRGraph c).obj A) = ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_interleavingDistance, cosheafFunctor_obj_obj,
    cosheafFunctor_obj_obj, translateRGraph_obj_obj, overBaseMap_translateOver]
  have := hA
  exact (interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_add_const (overBaseMap A.obj)
    (bddBelow_heightRange A) c).trans (coe_nnnorm_eq_ofReal_abs c)

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_translateRGraph_self_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_translateRGraph_self_of_isEmpty (A : RGraphCat)
    (hA : IsEmpty A.obj.left) (c : ℝ) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A ((translateRGraph c).obj A) = 0
proof:
:=
  geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_of_isEmpty hA hA

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_translateRGraph_le
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_translateRGraph_le (A B : RGraphCat) (c : ℝ) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A ((translateRGraph c).obj B) ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance A B + ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:=
  (geometricInterleavingDistance_triangle A B _).trans
    (add_le_add le_rfl (geometricInterleavingDistance_translateRGraph_self_le B c))

name: TDA.Reeb.RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_le_translateRGraph_add
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_le_translateRGraph_add (A B : RGraphCat) (c : ℝ) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance A B ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance A ((translateRGraph c).obj B) + ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:= by
  refine (geometricInterleavingDistance_triangle A ((translateRGraph c).obj B) B).trans ?_
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_comm ((translateRGraph c).obj B) B]
  exact add_le_add le_rfl (geometricInterleavingDistance_translateRGraph_self_le B c)

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.mem_thicken_iff_of_sub_add
statement:
theorem mem_thicken_iff_of_sub_add {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty) {ε : ℝ≥0} {a : ℝ} (hsub : a - ε ∈ I ↔ a - ε ∈ J)
    (hadd : a + ε ∈ I ↔ a + ε ∈ J) : a ∈ thicken ε I ↔ a ∈ thicken ε J
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => thicken_mono hIJ h, fun hJ => ?_⟩
  by_contra hnot
  have hfar : ∀ y ∈ I, ¬ (-(ε : ℝ) ≤ a - y ∧ a - y ≤ ε) := fun y hy h =>
    hnot (mem_thicken.2 ⟨y, hy, abs_le.2 h⟩)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hI
  obtain ⟨y, hyJ, hy⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hJ
  rw [abs_le] at hy
  rcases lt_or_ge x (a - ε) with hxa | hxa
  · 
    have hJ' : a - ε ∈ J := mem_of_le_of_le (hIJ hx) hyJ hxa.le (by linarith [hy.2])
    exact hfar _ (hsub.2 hJ') ⟨by linarith [ε.coe_nonneg], by linarith⟩
  rcases lt_or_ge (a + ε) x with hxb | hxb
  · 
    have hJ' : a + ε ∈ J := mem_of_le_of_le hyJ (hIJ hx) (by linarith [hy.1]) hxb.le
    exact hfar _ (hadd.2 hJ') ⟨by linarith, by linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]⟩
  · exact hfar x hx ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.mem_shiftedSet
statement:
theorem mem_shiftedSet {x : ℝ} :
    x ∈ S.shiftedSet ε ↔ ∃ i, x = S.value i - ε ∨ x = S.value i + ε
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shiftedSet, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨i, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, rfl⟩)
    exacts [⟨i, Or.inl rfl⟩, ⟨i, Or.inr rfl⟩]
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl | rfl⟩
    exacts [Or.inl ⟨i, rfl⟩, Or.inr ⟨i, rfl⟩]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.sub_mem_shiftedSet
statement: theorem sub_mem_shiftedSet (i : Fin (n + 1)) : S.value i - ε ∈ S.shiftedSet ε
proof:
:=
  (S.mem_shiftedSet ε).2 ⟨i, Or.inl rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.add_mem_shiftedSet
statement: theorem add_mem_shiftedSet (i : Fin (n + 1)) : S.value i + ε ∈ S.shiftedSet ε
proof:
:=
  (S.mem_shiftedSet ε).2 ⟨i, Or.inr rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.shiftedSet_nonempty
statement: theorem shiftedSet_nonempty : (S.shiftedSet ε).Nonempty
proof: := ⟨_, S.sub_mem_shiftedSet ε 0⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.card_shiftedSet
statement: theorem card_shiftedSet : (S.shiftedSet ε).card = S.shiftedCount ε + 1
proof:
:= by
  have := (S.shiftedSet_nonempty ε).card_pos
  unfold shiftedCount
  omega

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.shifted_value
statement:
theorem shifted_value :
    (S.shifted ε).value = (S.shiftedSet ε).orderEmbOfFin (S.card_shiftedSet ε)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.range_shifted
statement: theorem range_shifted : Set.range (S.shifted ε).value = ↑(S.shiftedSet ε)
proof:
:=
  Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin _ _

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.mem_range_shifted_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_shifted_iff {x : ℝ} :
    x ∈ Set.range (S.shifted ε).value ↔ ∃ i, x = S.value i - ε ∨ x = S.value i + ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_shifted, Finset.mem_coe, mem_shiftedSet]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.exists_shifted_value_eq_sub
statement:
theorem exists_shifted_value_eq_sub (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ∃ j, (S.shifted ε).value j = S.value i - ε
proof:
:=
  (S.mem_range_shifted_iff ε).2 ⟨i, Or.inl rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.exists_shifted_value_eq_add
statement:
theorem exists_shifted_value_eq_add (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ∃ j, (S.shifted ε).value j = S.value i + ε
proof:
:=
  (S.mem_range_shifted_iff ε).2 ⟨i, Or.inr rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.min'_shiftedSet
statement: theorem min'_shiftedSet : (S.shiftedSet ε).min' (S.shiftedSet_nonempty ε) = S.value 0 - ε
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Finset.min'_le _ _ (S.sub_mem_shiftedSet ε 0))
    (Finset.le_min' _ _ _ fun y hy => ?_)
  obtain ⟨i, rfl | rfl⟩ := (S.mem_shiftedSet ε).1 hy
  · linarith [S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le i)]
  · linarith [S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le i), ε.coe_nonneg]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.max'_shiftedSet
statement:
theorem max'_shiftedSet :
    (S.shiftedSet ε).max' (S.shiftedSet_nonempty ε) = S.value (Fin.last n) + ε
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Finset.max'_le _ _ _ fun y hy => ?_)
    (Finset.le_max' _ _ (S.add_mem_shiftedSet ε _))
  obtain ⟨i, rfl | rfl⟩ := (S.mem_shiftedSet ε).1 hy
  · linarith [S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.le_last i), ε.coe_nonneg]
  · linarith [S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.le_last i)]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.shifted_value_zero
statement: theorem shifted_value_zero : (S.shifted ε).value 0 = S.value 0 - ε
proof:
:=
  (Finset.orderEmbOfFin_zero (S.card_shiftedSet ε) (Nat.succ_pos _)).trans (S.min'_shiftedSet ε)

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.shifted_value_last
statement: theorem shifted_value_last : (S.shifted ε).value (Fin.last _) = S.value (Fin.last n) + ε
proof:
:= by
  have h := Finset.orderEmbOfFin_last (S.card_shiftedSet ε) (Nat.succ_pos _)
  rw [S.max'_shiftedSet ε] at h
  rw [← h, shifted_value]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.shiftedCount_le
statement: theorem shiftedCount_le : S.shiftedCount ε ≤ 2 * n + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := Finset.card_union_le (Finset.univ.image fun i => S.value i - ε)
    (Finset.univ.image fun i => S.value i + ε)
  have h₂ := Finset.card_image_le (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))))
    (f := fun i => S.value i - ε)
  have h₃ := Finset.card_image_le (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 1))))
    (f := fun i => S.value i + ε)
  have h₄ := S.card_shiftedSet ε
  simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h₂ h₃
  unfold shiftedSet at h₄
  omega

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.shiftedSet_zero
statement: theorem shiftedSet_zero : S.shiftedSet 0 = Finset.univ.image S.value
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_shiftedSet]
  simp only [NNReal.coe_zero, sub_zero, add_zero, or_self, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ,
    true_and]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨i, h⟩ => ⟨i, h.symm⟩, fun ⟨i, h⟩ => ⟨i, h.symm⟩⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.shiftedCount_zero
statement: theorem shiftedCount_zero : S.shiftedCount 0 = n
proof:
:= by
  unfold shiftedCount
  rw [shiftedSet_zero, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ S.strictMono.injective, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin]
  simp

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.range_shifted_zero
statement: theorem range_shifted_zero : Set.range (S.shifted 0).value = Set.range S.value
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_shifted, shiftedSet_zero, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ, Set.image_univ]

name: TDA.Reeb.CriticalValues.value_mem_thicken_iff_of_shifted
statement:
theorem value_mem_thicken_iff_of_shifted {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty)
    (hhit : ∀ j, (S.shifted ε).value j ∈ I ↔ (S.shifted ε).value j ∈ J) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    S.value i ∈ thicken ε I ↔ S.value i ∈ thicken ε J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := S.exists_shifted_value_eq_sub ε i
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := S.exists_shifted_value_eq_add ε i
  refine mem_thicken_iff_of_sub_add hIJ hI ?_ ?_
  · rw [← hj]; exact hhit j
  · rw [← hk]; exact hhit k

name: TDA.Reeb.componentFunctor_mk_eq_iff_joined
statement:
theorem componentFunctor_mk_eq_iff_joined (f : C(X, Y)) (W : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y)
    (a b : {x : X // f x ∈ W}) :
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk a : (componentFunctor f).obj W) = ZerothHomotopy.mk b ↔ Joined a b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => Quotient.exact h, fun h => ZerothHomotopy.sound h.somePath⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.componentFunctor_reflTransGen_of_mk_eq
statement:
theorem componentFunctor_reflTransGen_of_mk_eq (f : C(X, Y)) {W : TopologicalSpace.Opens Y}
    (U : ι → TopologicalSpace.Opens Y) (hcov : W ≤ ⨆ i, U i) {a b : {x : X // f x ∈ W}}
    (h : (ZerothHomotopy.mk a : (componentFunctor f).obj W) = ZerothHomotopy.mk b) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun a b : {x : X // f x ∈ W} => ∃ i, ∃ (ha : f a.1 ∈ U i) (hb : f b.1 ∈ U i),
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨a.1, ha⟩ : (componentFunctor f).obj (U i)) =
          ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨b.1, hb⟩) a b
proof:
:= by
  refine Relation.ReflTransGen.mono ?_ a b
    (TDA.Topology.reflTransGen_preimage f U hcov
      ((componentFunctor_mk_eq_iff_joined f W a b).1 h))
  rintro c d ⟨i, hc, hd, hJ⟩
  exact ⟨i, hc, hd, (componentFunctor_mk_eq_iff_joined f (U i) _ _).2 hJ⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.le_of_iUnion_eq
statement:
theorem le_of_iUnion_eq {κ : Sort*} {I : κ → OpenInterval} {J : OpenInterval}
    (hJ : ⋃ k, (I k : Set ℝ) = J) (k : κ) : I k ≤ J
proof:
:=
  le_iff_subset.2 (hJ ▸ subset_iUnion (fun k => (I k : Set ℝ)) k)

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.iUnion_thicken_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_iUnion, SetLike.mem_coe, mem_thicken]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, y, hy, hxy⟩
    exact ⟨y, le_iff_subset.1 (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ k) hy, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
    have hy' : y ∈ ⋃ k, (I k : Set ℝ) := by rw [hJ]; exact hy
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 hy'
    exact ⟨k, y, hk, hxy⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.thicken_inf
statement:
theorem thicken_inf {I I' : OpenInterval} (h : ((I ⊓ I' : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ).Nonempty)
    (ε : ℝ≥0) : thicken ε (I ⊓ I') = thicken ε I ⊓ thicken ε I'
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_inf (thicken_mono inf_le_left) (thicken_mono inf_le_right)) ?_
  refine le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => ?_
  have hx' : x ∈ (thicken ε I : Set ℝ) ∩ thicken ε I' := hx
  obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁, h₁⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hx'.1
  obtain ⟨y₂, hy₂, h₂⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hx'.2
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h
  rw [coe_inf] at hz
  obtain ⟨hzI, hzI'⟩ := hz
  have hy₁' : y₁ ∈ (I : Set ℝ) := hy₁
  have hy₂' : y₂ ∈ (I' : Set ℝ) := hy₂
  rw [abs_le] at h₁ h₂
  have key : ∃ y, y ∈ (I : Set ℝ) ∧ y ∈ (I' : Set ℝ) ∧ |x - y| ≤ ε := by
    rcases le_total y₁ y₂ with h12 | h21
    · rcases le_total z y₁ with hz1 | h1z
      · exact ⟨y₁, hy₁', I'.ordConnected.out hzI' hy₂' ⟨hz1, h12⟩, abs_le.2 h₁⟩
      · rcases le_total z y₂ with hz2 | h2z
        · exact ⟨z, hzI, hzI', abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
        · exact ⟨y₂, I.ordConnected.out hy₁' hzI ⟨h12, h2z⟩, hy₂', abs_le.2 h₂⟩
    · rcases le_total z y₂ with hz2 | h2z
      · exact ⟨y₂, I.ordConnected.out hzI hy₁' ⟨hz2, h21⟩, hy₂', abs_le.2 h₂⟩
      · rcases le_total z y₁ with hz1 | h1z
        · exact ⟨z, hzI, hzI', abs_le.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
        · exact ⟨y₁, hy₁', I'.ordConnected.out hy₂' hzI' ⟨h21, h1z⟩, abs_le.2 h₁⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hy', hxy⟩ := key
  exact mem_thicken.2 ⟨y, (show y ∈ (I : Set ℝ) ∩ I' from ⟨hy, hy'⟩), hxy⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.exists_cover_member_thicken_of_mem_hull
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huy, hyv⟩ := hy
  by_cases hyi : y ∈ (I i : Set ℝ)
  · exact ⟨i, hyi, inf_le_left⟩
  by_cases hyj : y ∈ (I j : Set ℝ)
  · exact ⟨j, hyj, inf_le_right⟩
  have hsub : (I i : Set ℝ) ∪ I j ⊆ J :=
    union_subset (le_iff_subset.1 (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ i)) (le_iff_subset.1 (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ j))
  have hyJ : y ∈ (J : Set ℝ) := J.ordConnected.out (hsub hu) (hsub hv) ⟨huy, hyv⟩
  rw [← hJ] at hyJ
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 hyJ
  refine ⟨k, hk, le_iff_subset.2 fun x hx => mem_thicken.2 ⟨y, hk, ?_⟩⟩
  have hx' : x ∈ (thicken ε (I i) : Set ℝ) ∩ thicken ε (I j) := hx
  obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁, h₁⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hx'.1
  obtain ⟨y₂, hy₂, h₂⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hx'.2
  have hy₁' : y₁ ∈ (I i : Set ℝ) := hy₁
  have hy₂' : y₂ ∈ (I j : Set ℝ) := hy₂
  rw [abs_le] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
  rcases le_total y y₁ with hy1 | h1y <;> rcases le_total y y₂ with hy2 | h2y
  · exfalso
    rcases hu with hu | hu
    · exact hyi ((I i).ordConnected.out hu hy₁' ⟨huy, hy1⟩)
    · exact hyj ((I j).ordConnected.out hu hy₂' ⟨huy, hy2⟩)
  · constructor <;> linarith
  · constructor <;> linarith
  · exfalso
    rcases hv with hv | hv
    · exact hyi ((I i).ordConnected.out hy₁' hv ⟨h1y, hyv⟩)
    · exact hyj ((I j).ordConnected.out hy₂' hv ⟨h2y, hyv⟩)

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.reflTransGen_thicken_inf_of_mem_hull
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_thicken_inf_of_mem_hull {κ : Type*} {I : κ → OpenInterval}
    {J : OpenInterval} (hJ : ⋃ k, (I k : Set ℝ) = J) (ε : ℝ≥0) (i j : κ)
    (hW : ((thicken ε (I i) ⊓ thicken ε (I j) : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ).Nonempty) :
    ∀ k, thicken ε (I i) ⊓ thicken ε (I j) ≤ thicken ε (I k) →
      ((I k : Set ℝ) ∩
        {y | ∃ u ∈ (I i : Set ℝ) ∪ I j, ∃ v ∈ (I i : Set ℝ) ∪ I j, u ≤ y ∧ y ≤ v}).Nonempty →
      Relation.ReflTransGen
        (fun k l => thicken ε (I i) ⊓ thicken ε (I j) ≤ thicken ε (I k ⊓ I l)) i k
proof:
:= by
  let W := thicken ε (I i) ⊓ thicken ε (I j)
  let S : Set ℝ :=
    {y | ∃ u ∈ (I i : Set ℝ) ∪ I j, ∃ v ∈ (I i : Set ℝ) ∪ I j, u ≤ y ∧ y ≤ v}
  change ∀ k, W ≤ thicken ε (I k) → ((I k : Set ℝ) ∩ S).Nonempty →
    Relation.ReflTransGen (fun k l => W ≤ thicken ε (I k ⊓ I l)) i k
  have hne : (W : Set ℝ).Nonempty := by simpa [W] using hW
  have hstep : ∀ k l, W ≤ thicken ε (I k) → W ≤ thicken ε (I l) →
      ((I k : Set ℝ) ∩ I l).Nonempty → W ≤ thicken ε (I k ⊓ I l) := fun k l hk hl hkl => by
    rw [thicken_inf (by rw [coe_inf]; exact hkl) ε]
    exact le_inf hk hl
  have hS : S.OrdConnected := ⟨fun a ha b hb y hy => by
    obtain ⟨u, hu, -, -, hua, -⟩ := ha
    obtain ⟨-, -, v, hv, -, hbv⟩ := hb
    exact ⟨u, hu, v, hv, hua.trans hy.1, hy.2.trans hbv⟩⟩
  have hcov : ∀ y ∈ S, ∃ k, y ∈ (I k : Set ℝ) ∧ W ≤ thicken ε (I k) := by
    intro y hy
    simpa [W, S] using exists_cover_member_thicken_of_mem_hull hJ ε i j hW hy
  let P : κ → κ → Prop := fun k l => W ≤ thicken ε (I k ⊓ I l)
  let O₁ : Set ℝ := ⋃ (k) (_ : W ≤ thicken ε (I k) ∧ Relation.ReflTransGen P i k), (I k : Set ℝ)
  let O₂ : Set ℝ := ⋃ (k) (_ : W ≤ thicken ε (I k) ∧ ¬ Relation.ReflTransGen P i k),
    (I k : Set ℝ)
  have hO₁ : IsOpen O₁ := isOpen_iUnion fun k => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => (I k).isOpen
  have hO₂ : IsOpen O₂ := isOpen_iUnion fun k => isOpen_iUnion fun _ => (I k).isOpen
  have hdisj : Disjoint O₁ O₂ := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro y hy₁ hy₂
    obtain ⟨k, ⟨hkW, hk⟩, hyk⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 hy₁
    obtain ⟨l, ⟨hlW, hl⟩, hyl⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 hy₂
    exact hl (hk.tail (hstep k l hkW hlW ⟨y, hyk, hyl⟩))
  have hSO : S ⊆ O₁ ∪ O₂ := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨k, hyk, hkW⟩ := hcov y hy
    by_cases hk : Relation.ReflTransGen P i k
    · exact Or.inl (mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨k, ⟨hkW, hk⟩, hyk⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨k, ⟨hkW, hk⟩, hyk⟩)
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hne
  have hx₀' : x₀ ∈ (thicken ε (I i) : Set ℝ) ∩ thicken ε (I j) := hx₀
  obtain ⟨p, hp, -⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hx₀'.1
  have hp' : p ∈ (I i : Set ℝ) := hp
  have hpS : p ∈ S := ⟨p, Or.inl hp', p, Or.inl hp', le_rfl, le_rfl⟩
  have hSO₁ : S ⊆ O₁ := hS.isPreconnected.subset_left_of_subset_union hO₁ hO₂ hdisj hSO
    ⟨p, hpS, mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨i, ⟨inf_le_left, .refl⟩, hp'⟩⟩
  intro k hkW
  rintro ⟨q, hqk, hqS⟩
  obtain ⟨l, ⟨hlW, hl⟩, hql⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 (hSO₁ hqS)
  exact hl.tail (hstep l k hlW hkW ⟨q, hql, hqk⟩)

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.reflTransGen_thicken_inf
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_thicken_inf {κ : Type*} {I : κ → OpenInterval} {J : OpenInterval}
    (hJ : ⋃ k, (I k : Set ℝ) = J) (ε : ℝ≥0) (i j : κ) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen
      (fun k l => thicken ε (I i) ⊓ thicken ε (I j) ≤ thicken ε (I k ⊓ I l)) i j
proof:
:= by
  set W := thicken ε (I i) ⊓ thicken ε (I j) with hW
  by_cases hne : (W : Set ℝ).Nonempty
  swap
  · refine Relation.ReflTransGen.single (le_iff_subset.2 ?_)
    rw [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hne]
    exact empty_subset _
  have hne' : ((thicken ε (I i) ⊓ thicken ε (I j) : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ).Nonempty := by
    simpa [W] using hne
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hne
  have hx₀' : x₀ ∈ (thicken ε (I i) : Set ℝ) ∩ thicken ε (I j) := hx₀
  obtain ⟨q, hq, -⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hx₀'.2
  have hq' : q ∈ (I j : Set ℝ) := hq
  apply reflTransGen_thicken_inf_of_mem_hull hJ ε i j hne' j inf_le_right
  exact ⟨q, hq', q, Or.inr hq', q, Or.inr hq', le_rfl, le_rfl⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.OpenInterval.reflTransGen_thicken_inf_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem reflTransGen_thicken_inf_of_nonempty {κ : Type*} {I : κ → OpenInterval} {J : OpenInterval}
    (hJ : ⋃ k, (I k : Set ℝ) = J) (ε : ℝ≥0) (i j : κ)
    (hW : ((thicken ε (I i) ⊓ thicken ε (I j) : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ).Nonempty) :
    Relation.ReflTransGen (fun k l => ((I k ⊓ I l : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ).Nonempty ∧
      thicken ε (I i) ⊓ thicken ε (I j) ≤ thicken ε (I k ⊓ I l)) i j
proof:
:= by
  refine Relation.ReflTransGen.mono ?_ i j (reflTransGen_thicken_inf hJ ε i j)
  intro k l hkl
  refine ⟨?_, hkl⟩
  by_contra hne
  have hbot : I k ⊓ I l = ⊥ :=
    SetLike.coe_injective (by rw [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.1 hne, coe_bot])
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hW
  have hx' := le_iff_subset.1 hkl hx
  rw [hbot, thicken_bot, coe_bot] at hx'
  exact hx'

name: TDA.Reeb.IsIntervalCosheaf.isEmpty_obj_bot
statement: theorem IsIntervalCosheaf.isEmpty_obj_bot (hF : IsIntervalCosheaf.{w} F) : IsEmpty (F.obj ⊥)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hsurj, -⟩ := (nonempty_isColimit_mapCocone_iff _ _ _).1
    (hF (PEmpty.elim : PEmpty.{w + 1} → OpenInterval) ⊥ (by simp))
  exact ⟨fun x => (hsurj x).elim fun i _ => i.elim⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.IsIntervalCosheaf.existsUnique_glue
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hsurj, hker⟩ := (nonempty_isColimit_mapCocone_iff _ _ _).1 (hF I J hJ)
  exact existsUnique_glue_of_surjective_of_eqvGen F I _ hsurj hker a ha

name: TDA.Reeb.IsIntervalCosheaf.of_iso
statement:
theorem IsIntervalCosheaf.of_iso {G : OpenInterval ⥤ Type u} (e : F ≅ G)
    (hF : IsIntervalCosheaf.{w} F) : IsIntervalCosheaf.{w} G
proof:
:=
  fun _ I J hJ => (hF I J hJ).map fun h => IsColimit.mapCoconeEquiv e h

name: TDA.Reeb.isIntervalCosheaf_of_isPairwiseCosheaf
statement:
theorem isIntervalCosheaf_of_isPairwiseCosheaf {G : TopologicalSpace.Opens ℝ ⥤ Type u}
    (hG : IsPairwiseCosheaf.{w} G) : IsIntervalCosheaf.{w} (toOpensFunctor ⋙ G)
proof:
:= by
  intro κ I J hJ
  have hV := hG (fun k => toOpens (I k))
  rw [nonempty_isColimit_mapCocone_iff] at hV ⊢
  obtain ⟨hsurj, hker⟩ := hV
  have hsup : ⨆ k, toOpens (I k) = toOpens J := iSup_toOpens_eq I J hJ
  let a : (⨆ k, toOpens (I k)) ⟶ toOpens J := homOfLE hsup.le
  let b : toOpens J ⟶ ⨆ k, toOpens (I k) := homOfLE hsup.ge
  refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun i j e e' h => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, e, he⟩ := hsurj (G.map b x)
    refine ⟨i, e, ?_⟩
    refine (map_map_apply_of_thin G ((Pairwise.cocone fun k => toOpens (I k)).ι.app (.single i))
      a _ e).symm.trans ?_
    rw [he]
    exact (map_map_apply_of_thin G b a (𝟙 _) x).trans (G.map_id_apply _ x)
  · refine hker i j e e' ?_
    have h' := congrArg (fun y => G.map b y) h
    exact (map_map_apply_of_thin G _ b _ e).symm.trans (h'.trans (map_map_apply_of_thin G _ b _ e'))

name: TDA.Reeb.intervalComponents_isIntervalCosheaf
statement:
theorem intervalComponents_isIntervalCosheaf {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : C(X, ℝ)) :
    IsIntervalCosheaf.{w} (intervalComponents f)
proof:
:=
  isIntervalCosheaf_of_isPairwiseCosheaf (componentFunctor_isPairwiseCosheaf f)

name: TDA.Reeb.eqvGen_overlapRel_smoothing
proof:
:= by
  have step : ∀ p q, overlapRel F (fun k => thicken ε (I k)) p q →
      Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel ((smoothing ε).obj F) I) p q := by
    rintro ⟨i, e⟩ ⟨j, e'⟩ ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩
    have key : ∀ k, Relation.ReflTransGen
        (fun k l => thicken ε (I i) ⊓ thicken ε (I j) ≤ thicken ε (I k ⊓ I l)) i k →
        ∃ hk : thicken ε (I i) ⊓ thicken ε (I j) ≤ thicken ε (I k),
          Relation.EqvGen (overlapRel ((smoothing ε).obj F) I) ⟨i, e⟩ ⟨k, F.map (homOfLE hk) c⟩ := by
      intro k hk
      induction hk with
      | refl => exact ⟨inf_le_left, by rw [hc]; exact .refl _⟩
      | tail _ hkl ih =>
        obtain ⟨hk, ih⟩ := ih
        refine ⟨hkl.trans (thicken_mono inf_le_right), ih.trans _ _ _ (.rel _ _ ?_)⟩
        refine ⟨F.map (homOfLE hkl) c, ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact map_map_apply_of_thin F _ _ _ c
        · exact map_map_apply_of_thin F _ _ _ c
    obtain ⟨hj, hrel⟩ := key j (reflTransGen_thicken_inf hJ ε i j)
    have : F.map (homOfLE hj) c = e' := (map_apply_eq_of_thin F _ _ c).trans hc'
    rw [← this]
    exact hrel
  induction h with
  | rel p q hpq => exact step p q hpq
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | symm _ _ _ ih => exact .symm _ _ ih
  | trans _ _ _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => exact .trans _ _ _ ih₁ ih₂

name: TDA.Reeb.smoothing_isColimit_coverCocone
statement:
theorem smoothing_isColimit_coverCocone (ε : ℝ≥0) {κ : Type w} (I : κ → OpenInterval)
    {J : OpenInterval} (hJ : ⋃ k, (I k : Set ℝ) = J)
    (hF : Nonempty (IsColimit (F.mapCocone
      (coverCocone (fun k => thicken ε (I k)) (le_of_iUnion_eq (iUnion_thicken_eq hJ ε)))))) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (((smoothing ε).obj F).mapCocone (coverCocone I (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonempty_isColimit_mapCocone_iff] at hF ⊢
  obtain ⟨hsurj, hker⟩ := hF
  refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun i j e e' h => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, e, he⟩ := hsurj x
    exact ⟨i, e, (map_apply_eq_of_thin F _ _ e).trans he⟩
  · refine eqvGen_overlapRel_smoothing F ε hJ (hker i j e e' ?_)
    exact (map_apply_eq_of_thin F _ _ e).trans (h.trans (map_apply_eq_of_thin F _ _ e'))

name: TDA.Reeb.isIntervalCosheaf_smoothing
statement:
theorem isIntervalCosheaf_smoothing (hF : IsIntervalCosheaf.{w} F) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    IsIntervalCosheaf.{w} ((smoothing ε).obj F)
proof:

  fun _ I _ hJ => smoothing_isColimit_coverCocone ε I hJ (hF _ _ (iUnion_thicken_eq hJ ε))

proof:

  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa using h.2 1 rfl
  · intro h
    refine ⟨fun k hk => by simp at hk, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    obtain rfl : k = 1 := Fin.ext (by simpa using hk.symm)
    simpa using h

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleCylinder.pinch_map_not_injective
statement:
theorem pinch_map_not_injective :
    ¬ Function.Injective ((intervalComponents hP).map (homOfLE (S01.K_le_J_castSucc 0)))
proof:
:= by
  intro hinj
  have h0 := (ofFiniteData DP).map_K_le_J_castSucc_edgeComponentsEquiv S01 0 half (.mk (show (ofFiniteData DP).E 0 from (0 : Fin 2)))
  have h1 := (ofFiniteData DP).map_K_le_J_castSucc_edgeComponentsEquiv S01 0 half (.mk (show (ofFiniteData DP).E 0 from (1 : Fin 2)))
  have heq := hinj (h0.trans h1.symm)
  have hmk := Equiv.injective _ heq
  have h01 := joined_eq_of_discrete (A := (ofFiniteData DP).E 0) (Quotient.exact hmk)
  exact absurd h01 (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1)

    fun i => iff_of_false (fun h => S01.value_notMem_K 0 i (quarter_le_K h))

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.ConstructibleCylinder.pinch_swap_regularFiberMap_indep

        regularFiberMap S01 (realizeHom S01 swapDP) (height_realizeHom S01 swapDP) 0

      regularFiberMap S01 (realizeHom S01 swapDP) (height_realizeHom S01 swapDP) 0 half ≠

  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    refine ⟨fun k hk => ?_, fun k hk => ?_⟩
    · obtain rfl : k = 0 := Fin.ext (by simpa using hk)
      simpa [S012] using h₁
    · obtain rfl : k = 2 := Fin.ext (by simpa using hk.symm)
      simpa [S012] using h₂

name: TDA.Reeb.joined_eq_of_discrete
statement: theorem joined_eq_of_discrete [DiscreteTopology A] {x y : A} (h : Joined x y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ⟩ := h

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.abs_sub_heightShift_le
statement:
theorem abs_sub_heightShift_le {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : C(X, ℝ)) (c : ℝ) :
    ∀ x, |f x - heightShift f c x| ≤ Real.nnabs c
proof:
:= fun x => by
  change |f x - (f x + c)| ≤ (Real.nnabs c : ℝ)
  rw [sub_add_cancel_left, abs_neg, Real.coe_nnabs]

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.isEmpty_interleaving_const
statement:
theorem isEmpty_interleaving_const {c : ℝ} {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : (ε : ℝ) < |c|) :
    IsEmpty (Interleaving ε (intervalComponents (ContinuousMap.const Unit (0 : ℝ)))
      (intervalComponents (ContinuousMap.const Unit c)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_⟩
  set η : ℝ := (|c| - ε) / 2 with hη
  have hη0 : 0 < η := by rw [hη]; linarith
  have pt : (intervalComponents (ContinuousMap.const Unit (0 : ℝ))).obj (ioo (-η) η) :=
    ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨(), show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo (-η) η from ⟨by linarith, hη0⟩⟩
  have q := i.φ.app (ioo (-η) η) pt
  induction q using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk y =>
    have hy : c ∈ thicken ε (ioo (-η) η) := y.2
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hcz⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hy
    have hz' : |z| < η := abs_lt.2 hz
    have htri : |c| ≤ |c - z| + |z| := by
      simpa using abs_add_le (c - z) z
    linarith

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.sheets_bound
statement: theorem sheets_bound : ∀ b, |sheetsF b - sheetsG b| ≤ (1 : ℝ≥0)
proof:

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.sheetLift_injective
statement:
theorem sheetLift_injective (h : C(Bool, ℝ)) (U : TopologicalSpace.Opens ℝ) :
    Function.Injective (sheetLift h U)
proof:
:= by
  intro c d hcd
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    induction d using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk y => exact congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (Subtype.ext hcd)

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.sheets_φ_injective
statement:
theorem sheets_φ_injective (I : OpenInterval) :
    Function.Injective ((perturbationInterleaving sheets_bound).φ.app I)
proof:
:= by
  intro c d hcd
  apply sheetLift_injective sheetsF (toOpens I)
  have := congrArg (sheetLift sheetsG (toOpens (thicken 1 I))) hcd
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    induction d using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk y => exact this

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.sheets_two_components
statement:
theorem sheets_two_components :
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨false, show sheetsF false ∈ Ioo (-1/2 : ℝ) (3/2) by norm_num [sheetsF]⟩ :
        (intervalComponents sheetsF).obj (ioo (-1/2) (3/2))) ≠
      ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨true, show sheetsF true ∈ Ioo (-1/2 : ℝ) (3/2) by norm_num [sheetsF]⟩
proof:
:=
      fun h => by
  have := congrArg (sheetLift sheetsF _) h
  exact Bool.false_ne_true this

name: TDA.Reeb.Examples.sheets_not_zero_interleaved
statement:
theorem sheets_not_zero_interleaved :
    IsEmpty (Interleaving 0 (intervalComponents sheetsF) (intervalComponents sheetsG))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => ?_⟩
  have q := i.toIso.hom.app (ioo (1/2) (3/2))
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨true, show sheetsF true ∈ Ioo (1/2 : ℝ) (3/2) by norm_num [sheetsF]⟩)
  induction q using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk y =>
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := y
    have hb' : sheetsG b ∈ Ioo (1/2 : ℝ) (3/2) := hb
    cases b <;> norm_num [sheetsG] at hb'

name: TDA.Reeb.constructibleSmoothingMap_app_hom

name: TDA.Reeb.constructibleSmoothingMap_comp
statement:

      constructibleSmoothingMap (h.trans h')

name: TDA.Reeb.constructibleSmoothingUnit_comp_constructibleSmoothingUnit
statement:
theorem constructibleSmoothingUnit_comp_constructibleSmoothingUnit (ε δ : ℝ≥0)
    (G : ConstructibleCosheafCat.{u}) :
    (constructibleSmoothingUnit δ).app G ≫
        (constructibleSmoothingUnit ε).app ((constructibleSmoothing δ).obj G) ≫
      (constructibleSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app G =
      (constructibleSmoothingUnit (ε + δ)).app G
proof:
:= by
  apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
  exact smoothingUnit_comp_smoothingUnit ε δ G.obj

name: TDA.Reeb.constructibleSmoothingUnit_comp_map_constructibleSmoothingUnit

    (constructibleSmoothingUnit ε).app G ≫
        (constructibleSmoothing ε).map ((constructibleSmoothingUnit δ).app G) ≫
      (constructibleSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app G =
      (constructibleSmoothingUnit (ε + δ)).app G
proof:
:= by
  apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
  exact smoothingUnit_comp_map_smoothingUnit ε δ G.obj

name: TDA.Reeb.constructibleSmoothingCompIso_assoc
statement:
theorem constructibleSmoothingCompIso_assoc (ε δ γ : ℝ≥0)

    (constructibleSmoothing ε).map ((constructibleSmoothingCompIso δ γ).hom.app G) ≫
        (constructibleSmoothingCompIso ε (δ + γ)).hom.app G ≫
        (constructibleSmoothingMap (add_assoc ε δ γ).ge).app G =
      (constructibleSmoothingCompIso ε δ).hom.app ((constructibleSmoothing γ).obj G) ≫
        (constructibleSmoothingCompIso (ε + δ) γ).hom.app G
proof:
:= by
  apply ObjectProperty.hom_ext
  exact smoothingCompIso_assoc ε δ γ G.obj

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_mem_cycles
statement:
private theorem boundary_mem_cycles
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (R : Type v) [CommRing R]
    (n : ℕ) (c : Chain K R (n + 1)) :
    boundary K R n c ∈ simplicialCycles K R n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => rw [simplicialCycles_zero]; trivial
  | succ m =>
    rw [simplicialCycles_succ]
    change boundary K R m (boundary K R (m + 1) c) = 0
    have h := congrArg (fun f : Chain K R (m + 2) →ₗ[R] Chain K R m => f c)
      (boundary_comp_boundary K R m)
    simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, Nat.add_assoc] using h

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_apply_symm
statement:
private theorem boundaryMatrix_apply_symm
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (R : Type v) [CommRing R]
    (n : ℕ) [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))]
    [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))] [Finite (Face K n)]
    (x : Face K (n + 1) → R) :
    Matrix.toLin' (boundaryMatrix K R n) x =
      chainCoordinates K R n (boundary K R n ((chainCoordinates K R (n + 1)).symm x))
proof:
:= by
  have h := boundaryMatrix_mulVec K R n ((chainCoordinates K R (n + 1)).symm x)
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Matrix.toLin'_apply] using h

name: TDA.Simplicial.coordinateCycles_zero
statement:
theorem coordinateCycles_zero [Finite (Face K 0)] :
    coordinateCycles K R 0 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateCycles, simplicialCycles_zero]

name: TDA.Simplicial.coordinateCycles_succ
statement:
theorem coordinateCycles_succ (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] :
    coordinateCycles K R (n + 1) =
      LinearMap.ker (Matrix.toLin' (boundaryMatrix K R n))
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.ext
  intro x
  change (chainCoordinates K R (n + 1)).symm x ∈ simplicialCycles K R (n + 1) ↔
    x ∈ LinearMap.ker (Matrix.toLin' (boundaryMatrix K R n))
  rw [simplicialCycles_succ]
  change boundary K R n ((chainCoordinates K R (n + 1)).symm x) = 0 ↔
    Matrix.toLin' (boundaryMatrix K R n) x = 0
  rw [boundaryMatrix_apply_symm]
  constructor
  · intro h; rw [h, map_zero]
  · intro h; exact (chainCoordinates K R n).injective (by simpa using h)

name: TDA.Simplicial.cycleCoordinates_coe
statement:
theorem cycleCoordinates_coe (n : ℕ) [Finite (Face K n)]
    (z : simplicialCycles K R n) :
    (cycleCoordinates K R n z : Face K n → R) =
      chainCoordinates K R n (z : Chain K R n)
proof:
:= by
  exact (LinearEquiv.ofSubmodule'_symm_apply
    (chainCoordinates K R n).symm (simplicialCycles K R n) z)

name: TDA.Simplicial.coordinateBoundaryToCycles_coe
statement:
theorem coordinateBoundaryToCycles_coe (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] (x : Face K (n + 1) → R) :
    (coordinateBoundaryToCycles K R n x : Face K n → R) =
      boundaryMatrix K R n *ᵥ x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.mem_coordinateBoundaries_iff
statement:
theorem mem_coordinateBoundaries_iff (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] (z : coordinateCycles K R n) :
    z ∈ coordinateBoundaries K R n ↔
      ∃ x : Face K (n + 1) → R,
        boundaryMatrix K R n *ᵥ x = (z : Face K n → R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateBoundaries, LinearMap.mem_range]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨x, (coordinateBoundaryToCycles_coe K R n x).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (coordinateBoundaryToCycles_coe K R n x).trans hx

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialBoundaries_map_cycleCoordinates
statement:
theorem simplicialBoundaries_map_cycleCoordinates (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] :
    (simplicialBoundaries K R n).map (cycleCoordinates K R n).toLinearMap =
      coordinateBoundaries K R n
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.ext
  intro z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.mp hz
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff R K n w).mp hw
    apply (mem_coordinateBoundaries_iff K R n z).mpr
    refine ⟨chainCoordinates K R (n + 1) c, ?_⟩
    rw [boundaryMatrix_mulVec, hc]
    rw [← cycleCoordinates_coe K R n w]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hwz
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (mem_coordinateBoundaries_iff K R n z).mp hz
    let c : Chain K R (n + 1) := (chainCoordinates K R (n + 1)).symm x
    let w : simplicialCycles K R n := (cycleCoordinates K R n).symm z
    have hc : boundary K R n c = (w : Chain K R n) := by
      apply (chainCoordinates K R n).injective
      have hm := boundaryMatrix_mulVec K R n c
      change boundaryMatrix K R n *ᵥ x =
        chainCoordinates K R n (boundary K R n c) at hm
      calc
        chainCoordinates K R n (boundary K R n c) =
            boundaryMatrix K R n *ᵥ x := hm.symm
        _ = (z : Face K n → R) := hx
        _ = chainCoordinates K R n (w : Chain K R n) := by
          rw [← cycleCoordinates_coe K R n w]
          simp [w]
    apply Submodule.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨w, (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff R K n w).mpr ⟨c, hc⟩, ?_⟩
    exact (cycleCoordinates K R n).apply_symm_apply z

name: TDA.Simplicial.coordinateCycleIncl_coe
statement:
theorem coordinateCycleIncl_coe (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)] [Finite (Face L n)]
    (z : coordinateCycles K R n) :
    (coordinateCycleIncl R h n z : Face L n → R) =
      chainInclusionMatrix R h n *ᵥ (z : Face K n → R)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.cycleCoordinates_naturality
statement:
theorem cycleCoordinates_naturality (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)] [Finite (Face L n)] :
    (coordinateCycleIncl R h n).comp (cycleCoordinates K R n).toLinearMap =
      (cycleCoordinates L R n).toLinearMap.comp (simplicialCycleIncl R h n)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  rw [coordinateCycleIncl_coe, cycleCoordinates_coe, cycleCoordinates_coe,
    simplicialCycleIncl_coe]
  exact chainInclusionMatrix_mulVec R h n (z : Chain K R n)

name: TDA.Simplicial.coordinateCycleIncl_boundaryToCycles
statement:
theorem coordinateCycleIncl_boundaryToCycles (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)]
    [Fintype (Face L (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face L (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face L n)] :
    (coordinateCycleIncl R h n).comp (coordinateBoundaryToCycles K R n) =
      (coordinateBoundaryToCycles L R n).comp
        (Matrix.toLin' (chainInclusionMatrix R h (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [coordinateCycleIncl_coe, coordinateBoundaryToCycles_coe,
    coordinateBoundaryToCycles_coe, Matrix.toLin'_apply]
  have hm := boundaryMatrix_chainInclusionMatrix R h n
  calc
    chainInclusionMatrix R h n *ᵥ (boundaryMatrix K R n *ᵥ x) =
        (chainInclusionMatrix R h n * boundaryMatrix K R n) *ᵥ x :=
          Matrix.mulVec_mulVec x (chainInclusionMatrix R h n)
            (boundaryMatrix K R n)
    _ = (boundaryMatrix L R n * chainInclusionMatrix R h (n + 1)) *ᵥ x := by
          rw [hm]
    _ = boundaryMatrix L R n *ᵥ (chainInclusionMatrix R h (n + 1) *ᵥ x) :=
          (Matrix.mulVec_mulVec x (boundaryMatrix L R n)
            (chainInclusionMatrix R h (n + 1))).symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.coordinateBoundaries_le_comap
statement:
theorem coordinateBoundaries_le_comap (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)]
    [Fintype (Face L (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face L (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face L n)] :
    coordinateBoundaries K R n ≤
      (coordinateBoundaries L R n).comap (coordinateCycleIncl R h n)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp hz
  change coordinateCycleIncl R h n (coordinateBoundaryToCycles K R n x) ∈
    coordinateBoundaries L R n
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, coordinateCycleIncl_boundaryToCycles,
    LinearMap.comp_apply]
  exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _

name: TDA.Simplicial.map_le_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h s hs
    exact h (by
      change s.image r ∈ PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.map K r
      exact ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩)
  · intro h s hs
    change s ∈ K.faces.image (fun t => t.image r) at hs
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hs

name: TDA.Simplicial.FiniteComplex.mem_toPre
statement:
theorem mem_toPre (C : FiniteComplex n) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    s ∈ C.toPre ↔ s ∈ C.faces
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.FiniteComplex.empty_not_mem_faces
statement:
theorem empty_not_mem_faces (C : FiniteComplex n) :
    (∅ : Finset (Fin n)) ∉ C.faces

:= by

name: TDA.Simplicial.FiniteComplex.image_univ_totalFace_val
statement:
theorem image_univ_totalFace_val (C : FiniteComplex n) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace C.toPre)).image
      (fun s => s.val) = C.faces
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
    exact t.property
  · intro hs
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Simplicial.FiniteComplex.card_totalFace
statement:

    Fintype.card (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace C.toPre) = C.faces.card

name: TDA.Simplicial.FiniteComplex.toPre_injective
statement:
theorem toPre_injective :
    Function.Injective (toPre : FiniteComplex n →
      PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  intro C D h
  have hf : C.faces = D.faces := by
    ext s
    have hm := congrArg (fun K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin n) => s ∈ K) h
    change (s ∈ C.faces) = (s ∈ D.faces) at hm
    exact Iff.of_eq hm
  cases C with
  | mk fc nc dc =>
    cases D with
    | mk fd nd dd =>
      cases hf
      rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.swapDeletion_involutive
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨i, j⟩
  simp [swapDeletion, Fin.succAbove_succAbove_predAbove,
    Fin.predAbove_predAbove_succAbove]

name: TDA.Simplicial.swapDeletion_ne
statement:
private theorem swapDeletion_ne (n : ℕ)
    (x : Fin (n + 2) × Fin (n + 1)) : swapDeletion n x ≠ x
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨i, j⟩
  intro h
  have hi : i.succAbove j = i := congrArg Prod.fst h
  exact (Fin.succAbove_ne i j) hi

name: TDA.Simplicial.deletedFace_twice
statement:
private theorem deletedFace_twice (n : ℕ) (s : Face K (n + 2))
    (i : Fin (n + 3)) (j : Fin (n + 2)) :
    deletedFace K n (deletedFace K (n + 1) s i) j =
      deletedFace K n (deletedFace K (n + 1) s (i.succAbove j))
        (j.predAbove i)
proof:
:= by
  have hleft :
      (deletedFace K (n + 1) s i).1.orderEmbOfFin
          (deletedFace K (n + 1) s i).2.2 j =
        s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 (i.succAbove j) := by
    exact enumerationAfterDeletion K (n + 1) s i
      (deletedFace K (n + 1) s i).2.2 j
  have hright :
      (deletedFace K (n + 1) s (i.succAbove j)).1.orderEmbOfFin
          (deletedFace K (n + 1) s (i.succAbove j)).2.2 (j.predAbove i) =
        s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 i := by
    calc
      _ = s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2
          ((i.succAbove j).succAbove (j.predAbove i)) :=
        enumerationAfterDeletion K (n + 1) s (i.succAbove j)
          (deletedFace K (n + 1) s (i.succAbove j)).2.2 (j.predAbove i)
      _ = _ := by rw [Fin.succAbove_succAbove_predAbove]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ((deletedFace K (n + 1) s i).1.erase
      ((deletedFace K (n + 1) s i).1.orderEmbOfFin
        (deletedFace K (n + 1) s i).2.2 j)) =
    ((deletedFace K (n + 1) s (i.succAbove j)).1.erase
      ((deletedFace K (n + 1) s (i.succAbove j)).1.orderEmbOfFin
        (deletedFace K (n + 1) s (i.succAbove j)).2.2 (j.predAbove i)))
  rw [hleft, hright]
  change (s.1.erase (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 i)).erase
      (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 (i.succAbove j)) =
    (s.1.erase (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 (i.succAbove j))).erase
      (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 i)
  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_erase]
  tauto

name: TDA.Simplicial.doubleTerm_pair
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨i, j⟩
  have hface := deletedFace_twice K n s i j
  dsimp only [doubleTerm, swapDeletion, Prod.fst, Prod.snd]
  rw [← hface]
  rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add, Fin.neg_one_pow_succAbove_add_predAbove]
  simp

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_on_signed_sum
statement:
private theorem boundary_on_signed_sum (n : ℕ) (s : Face K (n + 2)) :
    boundary K R n
      (∑ i : Fin (n + 3),
        Finsupp.single (deletedFace K (n + 1) s i) ((-1 : R) ^ (i : ℕ))) =
      ∑ x : Fin (n + 3) × Fin (n + 2), doubleTerm K R n s x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp only [map_sum, boundary_single, Finset.smul_sum, Finsupp.smul_single]

name: TDA.Simplicial.double_sum_zero
statement:
private theorem double_sum_zero (n : ℕ) (s : Face K (n + 2)) :
    ∑ x : Fin (n + 3) × Fin (n + 2), doubleTerm K R n s x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa using (Finset.sum_involution
    (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (n + 3) × Fin (n + 2))))
    (f := doubleTerm K R n s) (g := fun x _ => swapDeletion (n + 1) x)
    (fun x _ => doubleTerm_pair K R n s x)
    (fun x _ _ => swapDeletion_ne (n + 1) x)
    (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
    (fun x _ => swapDeletion_involutive (n + 1) x))

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_comp_boundary
statement:
theorem boundary_comp_boundary (n : ℕ) :
    (boundary K R n).comp (boundary K R (n + 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro s a
  change boundary K R n (boundary K R (n + 1) (Finsupp.single s a)) = 0
  rw [boundary_single K R (n + 1) s a, map_smul,
    boundary_on_signed_sum K R n s, double_sum_zero K R n s]
  simp

name: TDA.Simplicial.triangleFace_orderEmb

name: TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum_boundary
statement:
theorem zeroChainSum_boundary :
    (zeroChainSum K k).comp (boundary K k 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro σ a
  change zeroChainSum K k (boundary K k 0 (Finsupp.single σ a)) = 0
  rw [boundary_single]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, zeroChainSum_single]
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: TDA.Simplicial.selectedZeroChainSum_boundary
statement:
theorem selectedZeroChainSum_boundary (P : Face K 0 → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (hP : ∀ σ : Face K 1,
      P (deletedFace K 0 σ 0) ↔ P (deletedFace K 0 σ 1)) :
    (selectedZeroChainSum K k P).comp (boundary K k 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro σ a
  change selectedZeroChainSum K k P (boundary K k 0 (Finsupp.single σ a)) = 0
  rw [boundary_single]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, selectedZeroChainSum_single]
  by_cases hp : P (deletedFace K 0 σ 0)
  · have hp' := (hP σ).mp hp
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, hp, hp']
  · have hp' := mt (hP σ).mpr hp
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, hp, hp']

name: TDA.Simplicial.zeroVertexCycle_not_boundary
statement:
theorem zeroVertexCycle_not_boundary (σ : Face K 0) :
    zeroVertexCycle K k σ ∉ simplicialBoundaries K k 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff k K 0 _).mp hz
  have hb : zeroChainSum K k (boundary K k 0 d) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : Chain K k 1 →ₗ[k] k => f d)
      (zeroChainSum_boundary K k)
    simpa using h
  have hv : zeroChainSum K k (zeroVertexCycle K k σ : Chain K k 0) = 1 := by
    exact zeroChainSum_single K k σ 1
  rw [hd] at hb
  exact one_ne_zero (hv.symm.trans hb)

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyClass_zeroVertexCycle_ne_zero
statement:
theorem simplicialHomologyClass_zeroVertexCycle_ne_zero (σ : Face K 0) :
    simplicialHomologyClass k K 0 (zeroVertexCycle K k σ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hq := congrArg
    (homologyKernelQuotient.{v, u, v} k (simplicialChainComplex K k) 0).hom.hom hz
  rw [simplicialHomologyClass_quotient, map_zero] at hq
  exact zeroVertexCycle_not_boundary K k σ ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hq)

name: TDA.Simplicial.vertexCombination_not_boundary_of_selected
statement:
theorem vertexCombination_not_boundary_of_selected
    (P : Face K 0 → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (hP : ∀ σ : Face K 1,
      P (deletedFace K 0 σ 0) ↔ P (deletedFace K 0 σ 1))
    (u v : Face K 0) (hu : P u) (hv : ¬ P v) (a b : k)
    (hmem : a • zeroVertexCycle K k u + b • zeroVertexCycle K k v ∈
      simplicialBoundaries K k 0) : a = 0 ∧ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff k K 0 _).mp hmem
  have hsel : selectedZeroChainSum K k P (boundary K k 0 d) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : Chain K k 1 →ₗ[k] k => f d)
      (selectedZeroChainSum_boundary K k P hP)
    simpa using h
  have hsum : zeroChainSum K k (boundary K k 0 d) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : Chain K k 1 →ₗ[k] k => f d)
      (zeroChainSum_boundary K k)
    simpa using h
  have hsel' : a = 0 := by
    rw [hd] at hsel
    simpa [map_add, map_smul, zeroVertexCycle,
      selectedZeroChainSum_single, hu, hv] using hsel
  have hsum' : a + b = 0 := by
    rw [hd] at hsum
    simpa [map_add, map_smul, zeroVertexCycle,
      zeroChainSum_single] using hsum
  exact ⟨hsel', by simpa [hsel'] using hsum'⟩

name: TDA.Simplicial.zeroShortF_of_no_edges
statement:
theorem zeroShortF_of_no_edges [IsEmpty (Face K 1)] :
    ((simplicialChainComplex K k).sc 0).f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (simplicialChainComplex K k).d 1 0 = 0 := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    ext c
    change (boundary K k 0) c = 0
    have hc : c = 0 := by
      apply Finsupp.ext
      intro σ
      exact isEmptyElim σ
    rw [hc]
    exact map_zero _
  change (simplicialChainComplex K k).d
    ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev 0) 0 = 0
  rw [ChainComplex.prev]
  exact hf

name: TDA.Simplicial.zeroShortG
statement: theorem zeroShortG : ((simplicialChainComplex K k).sc 0).g = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (simplicialChainComplex K k).d
    0 ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).next 0) = 0
  rw [ChainComplex.next_nat_zero]
  exact simplicialChainComplex_d_zero K k 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.finrank_zeroHomology_of_no_edges
statement:
theorem finrank_zeroHomology_of_no_edges [IsEmpty (Face K 1)]
    [Fintype (Face K 0)] :
    Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology K k 0) = Fintype.card (Face K 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(zeroHomologyEquivOfNoEdges K k).finrank_eq]
  exact Module.finrank_finsupp_self k

name: TDA.Simplicial.finrank_homologyIncl_range_eq_quotientIncl_range
statement:
theorem finrank_homologyIncl_range_eq_quotientIncl_range
    {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} (h : K ≤ L) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom) =
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialQuotientIncl k h 0))
proof:
:= by
  let eK := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k
    (simplicialChainComplex K k) 0).toLinearEquiv
  let eL := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k
    (simplicialChainComplex L k) 0).toLinearEquiv
  let f := (simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom
  let q := simplicialQuotientIncl k h 0
  have hn (x : simplicialHomology K k 0) : eL (f x) = q (eK x) := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun z => z.hom x)
      (simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality k h 0)
    exact hh
  let g : LinearMap.range f →ₗ[k] LinearMap.range q := {
    toFun x := ⟨eL x.1, by
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := x.2
      refine ⟨eK a, ?_⟩
      rw [← ha]
      exact (hn a).symm⟩
    map_add' := by
      intro x y
      apply Subtype.ext
      change eL (x.1 + y.1) = eL x.1 + eL y.1
      exact eL.map_add x.1 y.1
    map_smul' := by
      intro c x
      apply Subtype.ext
      change eL (c • x.1) = c • eL x.1
      exact eL.map_smul c x.1
  }
  have hg : Function.Bijective g := by
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply eL.injective
      have hh := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
      change eL x.1 = eL y.1 at hh
      exact hh
    · intro y
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := y.2
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := eK.surjective b
      refine ⟨⟨f a, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      have he : eL (f a) = y.1 :=
        (hn a).trans ((congrArg q ha).trans hb)
      exact he
  exact (LinearEquiv.ofBijective g hg).finrank_eq

name: TDA.Simplicial.zeroVertexCycle_incl
statement:
theorem zeroVertexCycle_incl {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    (h : K ≤ L) (σ : Face K 0) :
    simplicialCycleIncl k h 0 (zeroVertexCycle K k σ) =
      zeroVertexCycle L k (faceIncl h 0 σ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change chainIncl k h 0 (Finsupp.single σ 1) =
    Finsupp.single (faceIncl h 0 σ) 1
  exact chainIncl_single k h 0 σ 1

name: TDA.Simplicial.zeroVertexCycle_incl_not_boundary
statement:
theorem zeroVertexCycle_incl_not_boundary
    {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} (h : K ≤ L) (σ : Face K 0) :
    simplicialCycleIncl k h 0 (zeroVertexCycle K k σ) ∉
      simplicialBoundaries L k 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [zeroVertexCycle_incl]
  exact zeroVertexCycle_not_boundary L k (faceIncl h 0 σ)

name: TDA.Simplicial.finrank_homologyIncl_range_pos_of_vertex
statement:
theorem finrank_homologyIncl_range_pos_of_vertex
    {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} [Finite (TotalFace L)]
    (h : K ≤ L) (σ : Face K 0) :
    0 < Module.finrank k
      (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom)
proof:
:= by
  let z := zeroVertexCycle K k σ
  let qz := Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles K k 0)
    (simplicialBoundaries K k 0) z
  have hq : simplicialQuotientIncl k h 0 qz ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show simplicialQuotientIncl k h 0 qz =
      Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles L k 0)
        (simplicialBoundaries L k 0) (simplicialCycleIncl k h 0 z) from
      simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ k h 0 z]
    intro hz
    apply zeroVertexCycle_incl_not_boundary K k h σ
    simpa only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] using hz
  let eK := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k
    (simplicialChainComplex K k) 0).toLinearEquiv
  let eL := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k
    (simplicialChainComplex L k) 0).toLinearEquiv
  let x := eK.symm qz
  have hn : eL ((simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom x) =
      simplicialQuotientIncl k h 0 (eK x) := by
    exact congrArg (fun z => z.hom x)
      (simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality k h 0)
  have hne : (simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz, map_zero, show eK x = qz from eK.apply_symm_apply qz] at hn
    exact hq hn.symm
  apply Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
  refine ⟨⟨(simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom x, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  intro hz
  exact hne (congrArg Subtype.val hz)

name: TDA.Simplicial.quotientIncl_injective_of_two_vertices_separated
statement:
theorem quotientIncl_injective_of_two_vertices_separated
    {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} (h : K ≤ L)
    (u v : Face K 0)
    (hdecomp : ∀ c : Chain K k 0,
      c = Finsupp.single u (c u) + Finsupp.single v (c v))
    (P : Face L 0 → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (hP : ∀ σ : Face L 1,
      P (deletedFace L 0 σ 0) ↔ P (deletedFace L 0 σ 1))
    (hu : P (faceIncl h 0 u)) (hv : ¬ P (faceIncl h 0 v)) :
    Function.Injective (simplicialQuotientIncl k h 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  rw [Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ z =>
    let a : k := (z : Chain K k 0) u
    let b : k := (z : Chain K k 0) v
    have hz : z = a • zeroVertexCycle K k u + b • zeroVertexCycle K k v := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (z : Chain K k 0) =
        a • Finsupp.single u 1 + b • Finsupp.single v 1
      rw [hdecomp (z : Chain K k 0)]
      simp [a, b, Finsupp.smul_single]
    have htarget : simplicialCycleIncl k h 0 z ∈ simplicialBoundaries L k 0 := by
      have hx' := (LinearMap.mem_ker).mp hx
      change simplicialQuotientIncl k h 0
        (Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles K k 0)
          (simplicialBoundaries K k 0) z) = 0 at hx'
      rw [simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ, Submodule.mkQ_apply] at hx'
      simpa only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] using hx'
    rw [hz, map_add, map_smul, map_smul,
      zeroVertexCycle_incl, zeroVertexCycle_incl] at htarget
    obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := vertexCombination_not_boundary_of_selected L k P hP
      (faceIncl h 0 u) (faceIncl h 0 v) hu hv a b htarget
    change (simplicialBoundaries K k 0).mkQ z = 0
    rw [hz, ha, hb, zero_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]
    exact map_zero _

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.attachingHomologyClass_ne_zero_of_separated_vertices
statement:
theorem SimplexAttachment.attachingHomologyClass_ne_zero_of_separated_vertices
    {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    (A : SimplexAttachment K L 1)
    (P : Face K 0 → Prop) [DecidablePred P]
    (hP : ∀ σ : Face K 1,
      P (deletedFace K 0 σ 0) ↔ P (deletedFace K 0 σ 1))
    (h0 : P (A.oldDeletedFace 0)) (h1 : ¬ P (A.oldDeletedFace 1)) :
    A.attachingHomologyClass k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hq : A.attachingQuotientClass k = 0 := by
    rw [← A.attachingHomologyClass_equiv k, hz, map_zero]
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff k K 0 _).mp
    ((A.attachingClass_zero_iff_boundary k).mp hq)
  have hsum : selectedZeroChainSum K k P (boundary K k 0 d) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : Chain K k 1 →ₗ[k] k => f d)
      (selectedZeroChainSum_boundary K k P hP)
    simpa using h
  rw [hd] at hsum
  have hv : selectedZeroChainSum K k P (A.attachingBoundary k) = 1 := by
    simp [SimplexAttachment.attachingBoundary, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
      selectedZeroChainSum_single, h0, h1]
  exact one_ne_zero (hv.symm.trans hsum)

name: TDA.Simplicial.chainCoordinates_apply
statement:
theorem chainCoordinates_apply (n : ℕ) [Finite (Face K n)]
    (c : Chain K R n) (s : Face K n) :
    chainCoordinates K R n c s = c s
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_apply (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] (τ : Face K n) (σ : Face K (n + 1)) :
    boundaryMatrix K R n τ σ =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 2),
        if deletedFace K n σ i = τ then (-1 : R) ^ (i : ℕ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryMatrix, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  simp only [faceBasis, Finsupp.coe_basisSingleOne, boundary_single, one_smul]
  simp [Finsupp.basisSingleOne_repr, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: TDA.Simplicial.deletedFace_injective
statement:
private theorem deletedFace_injective (n : ℕ) (σ : Face K (n + 1)) :
    Function.Injective (deletedFace K n σ)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  by_contra hne
  let vi := σ.1.orderEmbOfFin σ.2.2 i
  let vj := σ.1.orderEmbOfFin σ.2.2 j
  have hvne : vi ≠ vj := fun h => hne ((σ.1.orderEmbOfFin σ.2.2).injective h)
  have hmem : vi ∈ (deletedFace K n σ j).1 := by
    change vi ∈ σ.1.erase vj
    exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hvne, Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem σ.1 σ.2.2 i⟩
  rw [← hij] at hmem
  have : vi ∈ σ.1.erase vi := hmem
  simpa using this

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_deletedFace
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_deletedFace (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] (σ : Face K (n + 1)) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
    boundaryMatrix K R n (deletedFace K n σ i) σ =
      (-1 : R) ^ (i : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryMatrix_apply]
  classical
  simp only [(deletedFace_injective K n σ).eq_iff]
  simp

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_eq_zero_of_not_deletedFace
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_eq_zero_of_not_deletedFace (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] (τ : Face K n) (σ : Face K (n + 1))
    (hτ : ∀ i : Fin (n + 2), deletedFace K n σ i ≠ τ) :
    boundaryMatrix K R n τ σ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryMatrix_apply]
  simp [hτ]

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_mulVec (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] (c : Chain K R (n + 1)) :
    boundaryMatrix K R n *ᵥ chainCoordinates K R (n + 1) c =
      chainCoordinates K R n (boundary K R n c)
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_toLin
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_toLin (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] :
    Matrix.toLin (faceBasis K R (n + 1)) (faceBasis K R n)
        (boundaryMatrix K R n) = boundary K R n
proof:

    (faceBasis K R n) (boundary K R n)

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_mul_boundaryMatrix
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_mul_boundaryMatrix (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 2))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 2))]
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] :
    boundaryMatrix K R n * boundaryMatrix K R (n + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc := LinearMap.toMatrix_comp (faceBasis K R (n + 2))
    (faceBasis K R (n + 1)) (faceBasis K R n)
    (boundary K R n) (boundary K R (n + 1))
  rw [boundary_comp_boundary K R n, map_zero] at hc
  simpa only [boundaryMatrix, Nat.add_assoc] using hc.symm

      ((simplicialChainComplex K R).d 0 j).hom = 0
proof:

name: TDA.Simplicial.chainInclusionMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem chainInclusionMatrix_apply (R : Type v) [CommRing R] (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)] [Finite (Face L n)]
    (τ : Face L n) (σ : Face K n) :
    chainInclusionMatrix R h n τ σ =
      if faceIncl h n σ = τ then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chainInclusionMatrix, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
  simp only [faceBasis, Finsupp.coe_basisSingleOne, chainIncl_single]
  simp [Finsupp.basisSingleOne_repr, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: TDA.Simplicial.chainInclusionMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem chainInclusionMatrix_mulVec (R : Type v) [CommRing R] (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)] [Finite (Face L n)]
    (c : Chain K R n) :
    chainInclusionMatrix R h n *ᵥ chainCoordinates K R n c =
      chainCoordinates L R n (chainIncl R h n c)
proof:
:= by
  exact LinearMap.toMatrix_mulVec_repr (faceBasis K R n)
    (faceBasis L R n) (chainIncl R h n) c

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundaryMatrix_chainInclusionMatrix
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_chainInclusionMatrix (R : Type v) [CommRing R]
    (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)]
    [Fintype (Face L (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face L (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face L n)] :
    boundaryMatrix L R n * chainInclusionMatrix R h (n + 1) =
      chainInclusionMatrix R h n * boundaryMatrix K R n
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := LinearMap.toMatrix_comp (faceBasis K R (n + 1))
    (faceBasis L R (n + 1)) (faceBasis L R n)
    (boundary L R n) (chainIncl R h (n + 1))
  have hright := LinearMap.toMatrix_comp (faceBasis K R (n + 1))
    (faceBasis K R n) (faceBasis L R n)
    (chainIncl R h n) (boundary K R n)
  rw [boundary_chainIncl R h n] at hleft
  exact (show boundaryMatrix L R n * chainInclusionMatrix R h (n + 1) =
    LinearMap.toMatrix (faceBasis K R (n + 1)) (faceBasis L R n)
      ((chainIncl R h n).comp (boundary K R n)) from hleft.symm).trans
    (by simpa only [boundaryMatrix, chainInclusionMatrix] using hright)

  simpa only [Finset.image_union, Finset.image_image, Function.comp_apply] using himage

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.edgeVertex_bijective
statement: theorem edgeVertex_bijective : Function.Bijective edgeVertex
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j h
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      first | rfl |
        simp [edgeVertex] at hv
  · intro s
    have hc : s.1 = {(0 : Fin 3)} ∨ s.1 = {(1 : Fin 3)} := by
      have h : ∀ t : Finset (Fin 3), t.card = 1 →
          t ⊆ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 3)) →
          t = {0} ∨ t = {1} := by decide
      exact h s.1 s.2.2 s.2.1.2
    rcases hc with hc | hc
    · exact ⟨0, Subtype.ext (by simpa [edgeVertex] using hc.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨1, Subtype.ext (by simpa [edgeVertex] using hc.symm)⟩

    exact ⟨0, Subtype.ext (by simpa [edgeColumn, edge01] using
      (h s.1 s.2.2 s.2.1.2).symm)⟩

        t = {0} ∨ t = {1} ∨ t = {2} := by decide
    rcases h s.1 s.2.2 with hs | hs | hs
    · exact ⟨0, Subtype.ext (by simpa [triangleVertex] using hs.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨1, Subtype.ext (by simpa [triangleVertex] using hs.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨2, Subtype.ext (by simpa [triangleVertex] using hs.symm)⟩

         exact False.elim (absurd hv (by decide)))
  · intro s
    have h : ∀ t : Finset (Fin 3), t.card = 2 →
        t = {0, 1} ∨ t = {0, 2} ∨ t = {1, 2} := by decide
    rcases h s.1 s.2.2 with hs | hs | hs
    · exact ⟨0, Subtype.ext (by simpa [triangleEdge, triangleEdge01] using hs.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨1, Subtype.ext (by simpa [triangleEdge, triangleEdge02] using hs.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨2, Subtype.ext (by simpa [triangleEdge, triangleEdge12] using hs.symm)⟩
