    congrFun (congrFun edgeB0_array i) j

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.edgeJ0_reindexed
statement:
private theorem edgeJ0_reindexed :
    Matrix.reindex triangleVertexEquiv.symm edgeVertexEquiv.symm
      (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 0) =
        !![1, 0; 0, 1; 0, 0]
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simpa [Matrix.reindex_apply, triangleVertexEquiv, edgeVertexEquiv] using
    congrFun (congrFun edgeJ0_array i) j

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.edgeJ1_reindexed
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simpa [Matrix.reindex_apply, triangleEdgeEquiv, edgeColumnEquiv] using
    congrFun (congrFun edgeJ1_array i) j

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.singletonJ0_reindexed
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simpa [Matrix.reindex_apply, edgeVertexEquiv, singletonColumnEquiv] using
    congrFun (congrFun singletonJ0_array i) j

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.triangle_cancel_reindexed
proof:
:= by
  change (Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv ℤ ℤ
    triangleVertexEquiv.symm triangleColumnEquiv.symm)
    (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0 * boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 1) = 0
  rw [← Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_mul (R := ℤ) (A := ℤ)
    triangleVertexEquiv.symm triangleEdgeEquiv.symm triangleColumnEquiv.symm
    (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0) (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 1)]
  change Matrix.reindex triangleVertexEquiv.symm triangleEdgeEquiv.symm
      (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0) *
    Matrix.reindex triangleEdgeEquiv.symm triangleColumnEquiv.symm
      (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 1) = 0
  rw [triangleB0_reindexed, triangleB1_reindexed, triangle_arrays_cancel]

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.edge_triangle_common_reindexed
statement:
private theorem edge_triangle_common_reindexed :
    Matrix.reindex triangleVertexEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm
      (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0 * chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 1) =
        !![-1; 1; 0]
proof:
:= by
  change (Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv ℤ ℤ
    triangleVertexEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm)
    (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0 * chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 1) =
      !![-1; 1; 0]
  rw [← Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_mul (R := ℤ) (A := ℤ)
    triangleVertexEquiv.symm triangleEdgeEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm
    (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0) (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 1)]
  change Matrix.reindex triangleVertexEquiv.symm triangleEdgeEquiv.symm
      (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0) *
    Matrix.reindex triangleEdgeEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm
      (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 1) = !![-1; 1; 0]
  rw [triangleB0_reindexed, edgeJ1_reindexed, edge_triangle_common_column]

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.edge_triangle_right_reindexed
statement:
private theorem edge_triangle_right_reindexed :
    Matrix.reindex triangleVertexEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm
      (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 0 * boundaryMatrix edgeK ℤ 0) =
        !![-1; 1; 0]
proof:
:= by
  change (Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv ℤ ℤ
    triangleVertexEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm)
    (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 0 * boundaryMatrix edgeK ℤ 0) =
      !![-1; 1; 0]
  rw [← Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_mul (R := ℤ) (A := ℤ)
    triangleVertexEquiv.symm edgeVertexEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm
    (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 0) (boundaryMatrix edgeK ℤ 0)]
  change Matrix.reindex triangleVertexEquiv.symm edgeVertexEquiv.symm
      (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 0) *
    Matrix.reindex edgeVertexEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm
      (boundaryMatrix edgeK ℤ 0) = !![-1; 1; 0]
  rw [edgeJ0_reindexed, edgeB0_reindexed]
  decide

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.unfilled_le_triangle
statement: theorem unfilled_le_triangle : unfilledK ≤ triangleK
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  exact hs.1

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.unfilledEdge_bijective
statement: private theorem unfilledEdge_bijective : Function.Bijective unfilledEdge
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j h
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      first | rfl |
        (simp [unfilledEdge, unfilledEdge01, unfilledEdge02, unfilledEdge12] at hv
         exact False.elim (absurd hv (by decide)))
  · intro s
    have h : ∀ t : Finset (Fin 3), t.card = 2 →
        t = {0, 1} ∨ t = {0, 2} ∨ t = {1, 2} := by decide
    rcases h s.1 s.2.2 with hs | hs | hs
    · exact ⟨0, Subtype.ext (by simpa [unfilledEdge, unfilledEdge01] using hs.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨1, Subtype.ext (by simpa [unfilledEdge, unfilledEdge02] using hs.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨2, Subtype.ext (by simpa [unfilledEdge, unfilledEdge12] using hs.symm)⟩

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.unfilledFace2_empty
statement: private theorem unfilledFace2_empty : IsEmpty (Face unfilledK 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun s => ?_⟩
  have hc : s.1.card = 3 := s.2.2
  have hle : s.1.card ≤ 2 := s.2.1.2
  omega

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.unfilled_to_triangle_edges
statement:
private theorem unfilled_to_triangle_edges (i : Fin 3) :
    faceIncl unfilled_le_triangle 1 (unfilledEdge i) = triangleEdge i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> apply Subtype.ext <;>
    simp [unfilledEdge, triangleEdge, unfilledEdge01, unfilledEdge02,
      unfilledEdge12, triangleEdge01, triangleEdge02, triangleEdge12, faceIncl]

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.signedUnfilled_coeff
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;>
    (simp [signedUnfilled, unfilledEdge, unfilledEdge01, unfilledEdge02,
      unfilledEdge12, Finsupp.single_apply]
     all_goals decide)

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.triangleFace_boundary_signed
statement:
private theorem triangleFace_boundary_signed :
    boundary triangleK ℤ 1 (Finsupp.single triangleFace 1) =
      Finsupp.single triangleEdge01 1 - Finsupp.single triangleEdge02 1 +
        Finsupp.single triangleEdge12 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundary_single]
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, triangleFace_del0, triangleFace_del1,
    triangleFace_del2, Finsupp.smul_single]
  abel

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.signedUnfilled_includes_boundary
proof:
:= by
  rw [triangleFace_boundary_signed]
  simp only [signedUnfilled, map_add, map_sub, chainIncl_single]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.chainIncl_injective_fixture
statement:
private theorem chainIncl_injective_fixture
    {A B : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)} (h : A ≤ B) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (chainIncl ℤ h n)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have hf : Function.Injective (faceIncl h n) := by
    intro x y hxy
    have hv : x.1 = y.1 := congrArg (fun z : Face B n => z.1) hxy
    exact Subtype.ext hv
  apply Finsupp.mapDomain_injective hf
  simpa only [chainIncl, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply] using hab

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.signedUnfilled_cycle
statement:
private theorem signedUnfilled_cycle :
    signedUnfilled ∈ simplicialCycles unfilledK ℤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplicialCycles_succ]
  change boundary unfilledK ℤ 0 signedUnfilled = 0
  have hs := congrArg (fun f : Chain unfilledK ℤ 1 →ₗ[ℤ] Chain triangleK ℤ 0 =>
    f signedUnfilled) (boundary_chainIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 0)
  change boundary triangleK ℤ 0 (chainIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1 signedUnfilled) =
    chainIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 0 (boundary unfilledK ℤ 0 signedUnfilled) at hs
  rw [signedUnfilled_includes_boundary] at hs
  have hzero := congrArg
    (fun f : Chain triangleK ℤ 2 →ₗ[ℤ] Chain triangleK ℤ 0 =>
      f (Finsupp.single triangleFace 1)) (boundary_comp_boundary triangleK ℤ 0)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hzero
  rw [hzero] at hs
  exact chainIncl_injective_fixture unfilled_le_triangle 0
    (hs.symm.trans (map_zero _).symm)

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.signedUnfilledCoord_coeff
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedUnfilledCoord, cycleCoordinates_coe, chainCoordinates_apply]
  exact signedUnfilled_coeff i

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.signedUnfilledCoord_ne_zero
statement: private theorem signedUnfilledCoord_ne_zero : signedUnfilledCoord ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have h := signedUnfilledCoord_coeff 0
  rw [hz] at h
  norm_num at h

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.unfilledBoundaries_bot
statement: private theorem unfilledBoundaries_bot : coordinateBoundaries unfilledK ℤ 1 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (mem_coordinateBoundaries_iff unfilledK ℤ 1 z).mp hz
  have hx0 : x = 0 := by
    funext σ
    exact isEmptyElim (unfilledFace2_empty.false σ)
  subst x
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_zero] at hx
  change z = 0
  exact Subtype.ext hx.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.signedUnfilledCoord_not_boundary
statement:
theorem signedUnfilledCoord_not_boundary :
    signedUnfilledCoord ∉ coordinateBoundaries unfilledK ℤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [unfilledBoundaries_bot]
  simpa using signedUnfilledCoord_ne_zero

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.signedUnfilled_included_boundary
statement:
theorem signedUnfilled_included_boundary :
    coordinateCycleIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1 signedUnfilledCoord ∈
      coordinateBoundaries triangleK ℤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (mem_coordinateBoundaries_iff triangleK ℤ 1 _).mpr
  refine ⟨chainCoordinates triangleK ℤ 2 (Finsupp.single triangleFace 1), ?_⟩
  rw [boundaryMatrix_mulVec, coordinateCycleIncl_coe]
  rw [signedUnfilledCoord, cycleCoordinates_coe]
  rw [chainInclusionMatrix_mulVec]
  change chainCoordinates triangleK ℤ 1
      (boundary triangleK ℤ 1 (Finsupp.single triangleFace 1)) =
    chainCoordinates triangleK ℤ 1 (chainIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1 signedUnfilled)
  rw [signedUnfilled_includes_boundary]

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.signedUnfilled_naturality
statement:
private theorem signedUnfilled_naturality :
    coordinateCycleIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1 signedUnfilledCoord =
      cycleCoordinates triangleK ℤ 1
        (simplicialCycleIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1 signedUnfilledCycle)
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun f : simplicialCycles unfilledK ℤ 1 →ₗ[ℤ]
      coordinateCycles triangleK ℤ 1 => f signedUnfilledCycle)
    (cycleCoordinates_naturality ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1)

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.signedUnfilled_included_simplicial_boundary
proof:
:= by
  apply (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff ℤ triangleK 1 _).mpr
  refine ⟨Finsupp.single triangleFace 1, ?_⟩
  rw [simplicialCycleIncl_coe]
  exact signedUnfilled_includes_boundary.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.signedUnfilled_included_eq_boundary
statement:
private theorem signedUnfilled_included_eq_boundary :
    coordinateCycleIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1 signedUnfilledCoord =
      coordinateBoundaryToCycles triangleK ℤ 1
        (chainCoordinates triangleK ℤ 2 (Finsupp.single triangleFace 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [coordinateCycleIncl_coe, coordinateBoundaryToCycles_coe,
    boundaryMatrix_mulVec, signedUnfilledCoord, cycleCoordinates_coe,
    chainInclusionMatrix_mulVec]
  exact congrArg (chainCoordinates triangleK ℤ 1)
    signedUnfilled_includes_boundary

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.signedUnfilledCoord_kernel
proof:
:= by
  let x : Face triangleK 2 → ℤ :=
    chainCoordinates triangleK ℤ 2 (Finsupp.single triangleFace 1)
  have harray : boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0 * boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 1 = 0 := by
    apply (Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv ℤ ℤ
      triangleVertexEquiv.symm triangleColumnEquiv.symm).injective
    change Matrix.reindex triangleVertexEquiv.symm triangleColumnEquiv.symm
      (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0 * boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 1) = 0
    exact triangle_cancel_reindexed
  have hinc := congrArg Subtype.val signedUnfilled_included_eq_boundary
  change chainInclusionMatrix ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1 *ᵥ
      (signedUnfilledCoord : Face unfilledK 1 → ℤ) =
    boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 1 *ᵥ x at hinc
  have hj : chainInclusionMatrix ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 0 *ᵥ
      (boundaryMatrix unfilledK ℤ 0 *ᵥ
        (signedUnfilledCoord : Face unfilledK 1 → ℤ)) = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 0 *
          boundaryMatrix unfilledK ℤ 0) *ᵥ
            (signedUnfilledCoord : Face unfilledK 1 → ℤ) :=
        Matrix.mulVec_mulVec _ _ _
      _ = (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0 *
          chainInclusionMatrix ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1) *ᵥ
            (signedUnfilledCoord : Face unfilledK 1 → ℤ) := by
        rw [boundaryMatrix_chainInclusionMatrix]
      _ = boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0 *ᵥ
          (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1 *ᵥ
            (signedUnfilledCoord : Face unfilledK 1 → ℤ)) :=
        (Matrix.mulVec_mulVec _ _ _).symm
      _ = boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0 *ᵥ (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 1 *ᵥ x) := by
        rw [hinc]
      _ = (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0 * boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 1) *ᵥ x :=
        Matrix.mulVec_mulVec _ _ _
      _ = 0 := by rw [harray]; exact Matrix.zero_mulVec x
  have hm : boundaryMatrix unfilledK ℤ 0 *ᵥ
      (signedUnfilledCoord : Face unfilledK 1 → ℤ) = 0 := by
    let c : Chain unfilledK ℤ 0 := (chainCoordinates unfilledK ℤ 0).symm
      (boundaryMatrix unfilledK ℤ 0 *ᵥ
        (signedUnfilledCoord : Face unfilledK 1 → ℤ))
    have hc := chainInclusionMatrix_mulVec ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 0 c
    change chainInclusionMatrix ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 0 *ᵥ
        (boundaryMatrix unfilledK ℤ 0 *ᵥ
          (signedUnfilledCoord : Face unfilledK 1 → ℤ)) =
        chainCoordinates triangleK ℤ 0 (chainIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 0 c) at hc
    have hc0 : chainIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 0 c = 0 :=
      (chainCoordinates triangleK ℤ 0).injective (by simpa only [map_zero] using hc.symm.trans hj)
    have c0 : c = 0 := (chainIncl_injective_fixture unfilled_le_triangle 0)
      (by simpa only [map_zero] using hc0)
    have hcoord := (chainCoordinates unfilledK ℤ 0).apply_symm_apply
      (boundaryMatrix unfilledK ℤ 0 *ᵥ
        (signedUnfilledCoord : Face unfilledK 1 → ℤ))
    calc
      boundaryMatrix unfilledK ℤ 0 *ᵥ
          (signedUnfilledCoord : Face unfilledK 1 → ℤ) =
        chainCoordinates unfilledK ℤ 0 c := hcoord.symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [c0, map_zero]
  let vec : Face unfilledK 1 → ℤ := signedUnfilledCoord
  have hker : vec ∈ LinearMap.ker (Matrix.toLin' (boundaryMatrix unfilledK ℤ 0)) := by
    simpa only [LinearMap.mem_ker, Matrix.toLin'_apply] using hm
  have hid := coordinateCycles_succ unfilledK ℤ 0
  have hcycle : vec ∈ coordinateCycles unfilledK ℤ 1 := by
    simpa only [hid] using hker
  simpa only [hid] using hcycle

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.signedUnfilled_included_inverse
statement:
private theorem signedUnfilled_included_inverse :
    ((cycleCoordinates triangleK ℤ 1).symm
      (coordinateCycleIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1 signedUnfilledCoord) :
        Chain triangleK ℤ 1) =
      boundary triangleK ℤ 1 (Finsupp.single triangleFace 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply (chainCoordinates triangleK ℤ 1).injective
  have hcc := cycleCoordinates_coe triangleK ℤ 1
    ((cycleCoordinates triangleK ℤ 1).symm
      (coordinateCycleIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1 signedUnfilledCoord))
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hcc
  rw [← hcc, signedUnfilled_included_eq_boundary,
    coordinateBoundaryToCycles_coe, boundaryMatrix_mulVec]

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.signedUnfilled_included_ne_zero
statement:
theorem signedUnfilled_included_ne_zero :
    coordinateCycleIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1 signedUnfilledCoord ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have h := congrArg (fun z : coordinateCycles triangleK ℤ 1 =>
    (z : Face triangleK 1 → ℤ) triangleEdge01) hz
  rw [coordinateCycleIncl_coe, signedUnfilledCoord, cycleCoordinates_coe,
    chainInclusionMatrix_mulVec] at h
  change chainCoordinates triangleK ℤ 1
    (chainIncl ℤ unfilled_le_triangle 1 signedUnfilled) triangleEdge01 = 0 at h
  rw [signedUnfilled_includes_boundary, triangleFace_boundary_signed,
    chainCoordinates_apply] at h
  
  simp [triangleFace_boundary_signed, Finsupp.single_apply,
    triangleEdge01, triangleEdge02, triangleEdge12] at h
  have hneq1 : ({0, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)) ≠ {0, 1} := by decide
  have hneq2 : ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)) ≠ {0, 1} := by decide
  simp [hneq1, hneq2] at h

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.bottom_cycles_zero
statement:
theorem bottom_cycles_zero (n : ℕ) (z :
    coordinateCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ℤ n) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext σ
  exact isEmptyElim σ

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.bottom_boundaries_bot
statement:
private theorem bottom_boundaries_bot (n : ℕ) :
    coordinateBoundaries (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ℤ n = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro z _
  change z = 0
  exact bottom_cycles_zero n z

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.singleton_cycles_top
statement:
private theorem singleton_cycles_top :
    coordinateCycles (Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 3)) ℤ 0 = ⊤
proof:
:=
  coordinateCycles_zero _ _

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.singleton_edges_empty
statement:
private theorem singleton_edges_empty :
    IsEmpty (Face (Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 3)) 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun σ => ?_⟩
  have h := (Filtration.mem_singletonFace_iff (0 : Fin 3) σ.1).mp σ.2.1
  have hc : σ.1.card = 2 := σ.2.2
  rw [h] at hc
  simp at hc

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.singleton_boundaries_bot
statement:
private theorem singleton_boundaries_bot :
    coordinateBoundaries (Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 3)) ℤ 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (mem_coordinateBoundaries_iff _ ℤ 0 z).mp hz
  have hx0 : x = 0 := by
    funext σ
    exact isEmptyElim (singleton_edges_empty.false σ)
  subst x
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_zero] at hx
  change z = 0
  exact Subtype.ext hx.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.singleton_cycle_coefficient
proof:
:= by
  rw [cycleCoordinates_coe]
  change chainCoordinates (Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 3)) ℤ 0
    (Finsupp.single (singletonVertex 0) a) (singletonVertex 0) = a
  exact singleton_coordinate a

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.singleton_one_not_boundary
statement:
theorem singleton_one_not_boundary :
    (cycleCoordinates (Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 3)) ℤ 0
      (singletonCycle 1)) ∉
      coordinateBoundaries (Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 3)) ℤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [singleton_boundaries_bot]
  intro hz
  have h := singleton_cycle_coefficient 1
  rw [hz] at h
  norm_num at h

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.edge_coordinate_input
proof:
:= by
  funext σ
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := edgeColumn_bijective.2 σ
  rw [chainCoordinates_apply]
  simp [edgeColumn]

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.edge_boundary_scalar
statement:
theorem edge_boundary_scalar (a : ℤ) (i : Fin 2) :
    ((coordinateBoundaryToCycles edgeK ℤ 0 (fun _ => a) :
      coordinateCycles edgeK ℤ 0) : Face edgeK 0 → ℤ) (edgeVertex i) =
        if i = 0 then -a else a
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateBoundaryToCycles_coe, edge_coordinate_input,
    boundaryMatrix_mulVec]
  exact edge_scalar a i

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.edge_boundary_scalar_mem
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.edge_boundary_scalar_finsupp
statement:
private theorem edge_boundary_scalar_finsupp (a : ℤ) :
    ((cycleCoordinates edgeK ℤ 0).symm
      (coordinateBoundaryToCycles edgeK ℤ 0 (fun _ => a)) : Chain edgeK ℤ 0) =
      boundary edgeK ℤ 0 (Finsupp.single edge01 a)
proof:
:= by
  apply (chainCoordinates edgeK ℤ 0).injective
  have hcc := cycleCoordinates_coe edgeK ℤ 0
    ((cycleCoordinates edgeK ℤ 0).symm
      (coordinateBoundaryToCycles edgeK ℤ 0 (fun _ => a)))
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hcc
  calc
    chainCoordinates edgeK ℤ 0
        ((cycleCoordinates edgeK ℤ 0).symm
          (coordinateBoundaryToCycles edgeK ℤ 0 (fun _ => a)) : Chain edgeK ℤ 0) =
      (coordinateBoundaryToCycles edgeK ℤ 0 (fun _ => a) : Face edgeK 0 → ℤ) := hcc.symm
    _ = boundaryMatrix edgeK ℤ 0 *ᵥ (fun _ => a) :=
      coordinateBoundaryToCycles_coe edgeK ℤ 0 _
    _ = chainCoordinates edgeK ℤ 0
        (boundary edgeK ℤ 0 (Finsupp.single edge01 a)) := by
      rw [edge_coordinate_input]
      exact boundaryMatrix_mulVec edgeK ℤ 0 _

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.edge_degree1_cycles_zero
statement: private theorem edge_degree1_cycles_zero (z : coordinateCycles edgeK ℤ 1) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (z : Face edgeK 1 → ℤ) ∈
      LinearMap.ker (Matrix.toLin' (boundaryMatrix edgeK ℤ 0)) := by
    rw [← coordinateCycles_succ edgeK ℤ 0]
    exact z.property
  have hzero := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hz
  have hcoeff : (z : Face edgeK 1 → ℤ) edge01 = 0 := by
    have h := congrFun hzero (edgeVertex 1)
    rw [Matrix.toLin'_apply] at h
    have hvec : (z : Face edgeK 1 → ℤ) =
        (fun _ : Face edgeK 1 => (z : Face edgeK 1 → ℤ) edge01) := by
      funext σ
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := edgeColumn_bijective.2 σ
      fin_cases i
      rfl
    rw [hvec, edge_coordinate_input, boundaryMatrix_mulVec] at h
    simpa [edge_scalar] using h
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext σ
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := edgeColumn_bijective.2 σ
  fin_cases i
  simpa [edgeColumn] using hcoeff

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.edge_degree1_boundaries_bot
statement: private theorem edge_degree1_boundaries_bot : coordinateBoundaries edgeK ℤ 1 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro z _
  change z = 0
  exact edge_degree1_cycles_zero z

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.edge_triangle_scalar_square
statement:
private theorem edge_triangle_scalar_square (a : ℤ) :
    coordinateCycleIncl ℤ edge_le_triangle 0
        (coordinateBoundaryToCycles edgeK ℤ 0 (fun _ => a)) =
      coordinateBoundaryToCycles triangleK ℤ 0
        (Matrix.toLin' (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 1) (fun _ => a))
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun f : (Face edgeK 1 → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ]
      coordinateCycles triangleK ℤ 0 => f (fun _ => a))
    (coordinateCycleIncl_boundaryToCycles ℤ edge_le_triangle 0)

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.singleton_edge_scalar
statement:
private theorem singleton_edge_scalar (a : ℤ) (i : Fin 2) :
    ((coordinateCycleIncl ℤ singleton_le_edge 0
      (cycleCoordinates (Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 3)) ℤ 0
        (singletonCycle a)) : coordinateCycles edgeK ℤ 0) :
        Face edgeK 0 → ℤ) (edgeVertex i) = if i = 0 then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinateCycleIncl_coe, cycleCoordinates_coe,
    chainInclusionMatrix_mulVec]
  change chainCoordinates edgeK ℤ 0
    (chainIncl ℤ singleton_le_edge 0 (Finsupp.single (singletonVertex 0) a))
      (edgeVertex i) = if i = 0 then a else 0
  rw [chainIncl_single, chainCoordinates_apply]
  fin_cases i <;>
    (simp [faceIncl, edgeVertex, singletonVertex, Finsupp.single_apply]
     all_goals decide)

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.singleton_edge_naturality
statement:
theorem singleton_edge_naturality (a : ℤ) :
    coordinateCycleIncl ℤ singleton_le_edge 0
      (cycleCoordinates (Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 3)) ℤ 0
        (singletonCycle a)) =
    cycleCoordinates edgeK ℤ 0
      (simplicialCycleIncl ℤ singleton_le_edge 0 (singletonCycle a))
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun f : simplicialCycles
      (Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 3)) ℤ 0 →ₗ[ℤ]
        coordinateCycles edgeK ℤ 0 => f (singletonCycle a))
    (cycleCoordinates_naturality ℤ singleton_le_edge 0)

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.triangleEdge01_scalar
statement:
private theorem triangleEdge01_scalar (a : ℤ) (i : Fin 3) :
    chainCoordinates triangleK ℤ 0
      (boundary triangleK ℤ 0 (Finsupp.single triangleEdge01 a))
      (triangleVertex i) = if i = 0 then -a else if i = 1 then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [chainCoordinates_apply, boundary_single]
  fin_cases i <;>
    (simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ, triangleEdge01_del0, triangleEdge01_del1,
      triangleVertex, Finsupp.single_apply]
     all_goals decide)

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.edge_triangle_scalar_coords
statement:
private theorem edge_triangle_scalar_coords (a : ℤ) (i : Fin 3) :
    ((coordinateCycleIncl ℤ edge_le_triangle 0
      (coordinateBoundaryToCycles edgeK ℤ 0 (fun _ => a)) :
        coordinateCycles triangleK ℤ 0) : Face triangleK 0 → ℤ)
      (triangleVertex i) = if i = 0 then -a else if i = 1 then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [edge_triangle_scalar_square, coordinateBoundaryToCycles_coe]
  have hinc : Matrix.toLin' (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 1)
      (fun _ : Face edgeK 1 => a) =
        chainCoordinates triangleK ℤ 1 (Finsupp.single triangleEdge01 a) := by
    rw [Matrix.toLin'_apply, edge_coordinate_input,
      chainInclusionMatrix_mulVec, chainIncl_single]
    congr 1
  rw [hinc, boundaryMatrix_mulVec]
  exact triangleEdge01_scalar a i

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.bottom_edge_incoming_square
statement:
private theorem bottom_edge_incoming_square :
    (coordinateCycleIncl ℤ (bot_le : (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ≤ edgeK) 0).comp
      (coordinateBoundaryToCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ℤ 0) =
    (coordinateBoundaryToCycles edgeK ℤ 0).comp
      (Matrix.toLin' (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ
        (bot_le : (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ≤ edgeK) 1))
proof:
:= by
  exact coordinateCycleIncl_boundaryToCycles ℤ bot_le 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.bottom_edge_cycle_square
statement:
private theorem bottom_edge_cycle_square :
    (coordinateCycleIncl ℤ (bot_le : (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ≤ edgeK) 0).comp
      (cycleCoordinates (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ℤ 0).toLinearMap =
    (cycleCoordinates edgeK ℤ 0).toLinearMap.comp
      (simplicialCycleIncl ℤ
        (bot_le : (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ≤ edgeK) 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact cycleCoordinates_naturality ℤ bot_le 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.finiteTotal_boundary_transport

      coordinateBoundaries A S n

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.finiteTotal_cycle_naturality
statement:
private theorem finiteTotal_cycle_naturality
    {A B : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    [Finite (TotalFace A)] [Finite (TotalFace B)]
    (S : Type v) [CommRing S] (h : A ≤ B) (n : ℕ) :
    (coordinateCycleIncl S h n).comp (cycleCoordinates A S n).toLinearMap =
      (cycleCoordinates B S n).toLinearMap.comp (simplicialCycleIncl S h n)

name: TDA.Simplicial.InternalFiniteCycleFixtures.finiteTotal_incoming_square

    (coordinateCycleIncl S h n).comp (coordinateBoundaryToCycles A S n) =
      (coordinateBoundaryToCycles B S n).comp
        (Matrix.toLin' (chainInclusionMatrix S h (n + 1)))

  coordinateCycleIncl_boundaryToCycles S h n

name: TDA.Simplicial.HomologyExamples.K_le_L
statement: private theorem K_le_L : K ≤ L
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Simplicial.HomologyExamples.K_lt_L
statement: private theorem K_lt_L : K < L
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne K_le_L
  intro h
  have hmem : ({(2 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)) ∈ K := by
    rw [h]
    change ({(2 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)).Nonempty ∧
      ({(2 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)) ⊆ ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 4))
    simp
  change ({(2 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)).Nonempty ∧
    ({(2 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)) ⊆ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 4)) at hmem
  exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 4) ∉ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 4)))
    (hmem.2 (by simp))

name: TDA.Simplicial.HomologyExamples.L_lt_M
statement: private theorem L_lt_M : L < M
proof:
:= by

  intro h
  have hmem : ({(3 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)) ∈ L := by
    rw [h]
    change ({(3 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)).Nonempty
    simp
  change ({(3 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)).Nonempty ∧
    ({(3 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)) ⊆ ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 4)) at hmem
  exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 4) ∉ ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 4)))
    (hmem.2 (by simp))

name: TDA.Simplicial.quotientCoordinates_mkQ
statement:
theorem quotientCoordinates_mkQ (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] (z : simplicialCycles K R n) :
    quotientCoordinates K R n
        (Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := simplicialCycles K R n)
          (simplicialBoundaries K R n) z) =
      Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := coordinateCycles K R n)
        (coordinateBoundaries K R n) (cycleCoordinates K R n z)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyCoordinates_mkQ
statement:
theorem simplicialHomologyCoordinates_mkQ (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face K n)] (z : simplicialCycles K R n) :
    simplicialHomologyCoordinates K R n
        ((homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} R (simplicialChainComplex K R) n).inv.hom
          (Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := simplicialCycles K R n)
            (simplicialBoundaries K R n) z)) =
      Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := coordinateCycles K R n)
        (coordinateBoundaries K R n) (cycleCoordinates K R n z)
proof:
:= by
  change quotientCoordinates K R n
    ((homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} R (simplicialChainComplex K R) n).toLinearEquiv
      ((homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} R (simplicialChainComplex K R) n).toLinearEquiv.symm
        (Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := simplicialCycles K R n)
          (simplicialBoundaries K R n) z))) = _
  have hcancel := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} R
    (simplicialChainComplex K R) n).toLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply
      (Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := simplicialCycles K R n)
        (simplicialBoundaries K R n) z)
  exact (congrArg (quotientCoordinates K R n) hcancel).trans
    (quotientCoordinates_mkQ K R n z)

name: TDA.Simplicial.coordinateHomologyIncl_mkQ
statement:
theorem coordinateHomologyIncl_mkQ (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)]
    [Fintype (Face L (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face L (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face L n)] (z : coordinateCycles K R n) :
    coordinateHomologyIncl R h n
        (Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := coordinateCycles K R n)
          (coordinateBoundaries K R n) z) =
      Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := coordinateCycles L R n)
        (coordinateBoundaries L R n) (coordinateCycleIncl R h n z)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.quotientCoordinates_naturality
statement:
theorem quotientCoordinates_naturality (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)]
    [Fintype (Face L (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face L (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face L n)] :
    (coordinateHomologyIncl R h n).comp (quotientCoordinates K R n).toLinearMap =
      (quotientCoordinates L R n).toLinearMap.comp (simplicialQuotientIncl R h n)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ z =>
    change (coordinateHomologyIncl R h n)
      (quotientCoordinates K R n
        (Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := simplicialCycles K R n)
          (simplicialBoundaries K R n) z)) =
      quotientCoordinates L R n
        (simplicialQuotientIncl R h n
          (Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := simplicialCycles K R n)
            (simplicialBoundaries K R n) z))
    rw [quotientCoordinates_mkQ, coordinateHomologyIncl_mkQ,
      simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ, quotientCoordinates_mkQ]
    have hc := congrArg (fun f => f z) (cycleCoordinates_naturality R h n)
    simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] using
      congrArg (Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := coordinateCycles L R n)
        (coordinateBoundaries L R n)) hc

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyCoordinates_naturality
statement:
theorem simplicialHomologyCoordinates_naturality (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)]
    [Fintype (Face L (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face L (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face L n)] :
    (coordinateHomologyIncl R h n).comp
        (simplicialHomologyCoordinates K R n).toLinearMap =
      (simplicialHomologyCoordinates L R n).toLinearMap.comp
        (simplicialHomologyIncl R h n).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  let qK := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} R (simplicialChainComplex K R) n)
  let qL := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} R (simplicialChainComplex L R) n)
  have hq := congrArg (fun f => f.hom x)
    (simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality R h n)
  have he := congrArg
    (fun f => f (qK.toLinearEquiv x)) (quotientCoordinates_naturality R h n)
  change (coordinateHomologyIncl R h n)
      (quotientCoordinates K R n (qK.toLinearEquiv x)) =
    quotientCoordinates L R n (qL.toLinearEquiv ((simplicialHomologyIncl R h n).hom x))
  calc
    _ = quotientCoordinates L R n (simplicialQuotientIncl R h n (qK.toLinearEquiv x)) := by
      exact he
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      exact hq.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.coordinateHomologyIncl_id
statement:
theorem coordinateHomologyIncl_id
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)] :
    coordinateHomologyIncl R (le_refl K) n = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (quotientCoordinates K R n).surjective x
  have hq := congrArg (fun f => f y)
    (quotientCoordinates_naturality R (le_refl K) n)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, simplicialQuotientIncl_id,
    LinearMap.id_apply] at hq
  simpa only [LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.id_apply] using hq

name: TDA.Simplicial.coordinateHomologyIncl_comp
statement:
theorem coordinateHomologyIncl_comp
    {K L M : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} (h : K ≤ L) (g : L ≤ M) (n : ℕ)
    [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))]
    [Fintype (Face K n)] [DecidableEq (Face K n)]
    [Fintype (Face L (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face L (n + 1))]
    [Fintype (Face L n)] [DecidableEq (Face L n)]
    [Fintype (Face M (n + 1))] [DecidableEq (Face M (n + 1))]
    [Finite (Face M n)] :
    coordinateHomologyIncl R (h.trans g) n =
      (coordinateHomologyIncl R g n).comp (coordinateHomologyIncl R h n)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (quotientCoordinates K R n).surjective x
  have hkh := congrArg (fun f => f y) (quotientCoordinates_naturality R h n)
  have hlm := congrArg (fun f => f ((simplicialQuotientIncl R h n) y))
    (quotientCoordinates_naturality R g n)
  have hkm := congrArg (fun f => f y) (quotientCoordinates_naturality R (h.trans g) n)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hkh hlm hkm
  change (coordinateHomologyIncl R (h.trans g) n)
      ((quotientCoordinates K R n).toLinearMap y) =
    (coordinateHomologyIncl R g n)
      ((coordinateHomologyIncl R h n) ((quotientCoordinates K R n).toLinearMap y))
  calc
    _ = (quotientCoordinates M R n).toLinearMap (simplicialQuotientIncl R (h.trans g) n y) := by
      simpa only [LinearEquiv.coe_coe] using hkm
    _ = (quotientCoordinates M R n).toLinearMap
        (simplicialQuotientIncl R g n (simplicialQuotientIncl R h n y)) := by
          congr 1
          exact congrArg (fun f => f y) (simplicialQuotientIncl_comp R h g n)
    _ = _ := by rw [← hlm, ← hkh]

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexMapExamples.edge_collapse_fixture
statement:
theorem edge_collapse_fixture :
    ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2)).image (fun _ : Fin 2 => (0 : Fin 2)) =
        ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∧
      ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ TDA.Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)

  · decide

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexMapExamples.permutation_inverse_fixture
statement:
theorem permutation_inverse_fixture :
    swapMap 0 = 1 ∧ swapMap 1 = 0 ∧
      VertexMap.comp swapMap swapMap = VertexMap.id (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · apply VertexMap.ext
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [swapMap, swapVertex]

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexMapExamples.ghost_vertices_are_not_forced
statement:
theorem ghost_vertices_are_not_forced :
    ¬ ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ TDA.Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) ∧
      @PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.map (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (Classical.decEq (Fin 2))
          (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2))
          (fun _ : Fin 2 => (0 : Fin 2)) ≤
        TDA.Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp [TDA.Filtration.mem_singletonFace_iff]
  · intro s hs
    have hs' : s ∈
        (fun t : Finset (Fin 2) =>
          @Finset.image (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (Classical.decEq (Fin 2))
            (fun _ : Fin 2 => (0 : Fin 2)) t) ''
          (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)).faces := by
      simpa only [PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.map] using hs
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hs'
    change t.Nonempty at ht
    apply (TDA.Filtration.mem_singletonFace_iff 0 _).2
    ext i
    constructor
    · intro hi
      have hi' := hi
      simp only [Finset.mem_image] at hi'
      obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := hi'
      simpa using hj.symm
    · intro hi
      have hi0 : i = (0 : Fin 2) := by simpa using hi
      subst i
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := ht
      change (0 : Fin 2) ∈
        @Finset.image (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (Classical.decEq (Fin 2))
          (fun _ : Fin 2 => (0 : Fin 2)) t
      exact (@Finset.mem_image (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (Classical.decEq (Fin 2))
        (fun _ : Fin 2 => (0 : Fin 2)) t 0).2 ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Simplicial.enumerationAfterDeletion
statement:
theorem enumerationAfterDeletion (n : ℕ) (s : Face K (n + 1)) (i : Fin (n + 2))
    (hc : (s.1.erase (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 i)).card = n + 1)
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (s.1.erase (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 i)).orderEmbOfFin hc j =
      s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 (i.succAbove j)
proof:
:= by
  let t := s.1.erase (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 i)
  have hmem : ∀ j : Fin (n + 1),
      s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 (i.succAbove j) ∈ t := by
    intro j
    refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem s.1 s.2.2 (i.succAbove j)⟩
    intro heq
    apply Fin.succAbove_ne i j
    exact (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2).injective heq
  have hmono : StrictMono (fun j : Fin (n + 1) =>
      s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 (i.succAbove j)) :=
    (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2).strictMono.comp (Fin.strictMono_succAbove i)
  have hunique : (fun j : Fin (n + 1) =>
      s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 (i.succAbove j)) = t.orderEmbOfFin hc :=
    Finset.orderEmbOfFin_unique hc hmem hmono
  simpa only [t] using (congrFun hunique j).symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.enumerationAfterDeletion_deletedFace
statement:
private theorem enumerationAfterDeletion_deletedFace (n : ℕ) (s : Face K (n + 1))
    (i : Fin (n + 2)) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (deletedFace K n s i).1.orderEmbOfFin (deletedFace K n s i).2.2 j =
      s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 (i.succAbove j)
proof:
:= by
  exact enumerationAfterDeletion K n s i (deletedFace K n s i).2.2 j

name: TDA.Simplicial.vertexChainMap_single
statement:
theorem vertexChainMap_single (f : VertexMap K L) (n : ℕ) (s : Face K n) (a : R) :
    vertexChainMap R f n (Finsupp.single s a) =
      a • orientedTuple L R (f ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertexChainMap]

name: TDA.Simplicial.vertexTuple_mem
proof:
:= by
  have h := f.map_face (Finset.univ.image x) hk
  have he : @Finset.image V W (Classical.decEq W) f (Finset.univ.image x) =
      Finset.univ.image (f ∘ x) := by
    ext w
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Function.comp_apply]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, ⟨i, rfl⟩, hv⟩
      exact ⟨i, hv⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      exact ⟨x i, ⟨i, rfl⟩, hi⟩
  rw [he] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Simplicial.vertexChainMap_orientedTuple
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : Function.Injective x
  · rw [orientedTuple_of_injective K R x hx hk, map_zsmul, vertexChainMap_single,
      one_smul, tupleFace_sorted_enumeration K x hx hk]
    have he : f ∘ (x ∘ Tuple.sort x) = (f ∘ x) ∘ Tuple.sort x := rfl
    rw [he, orientedTuple_comp_perm, smul_smul]
    have hs : (Equiv.Perm.sign (Tuple.sort x) : ℤ) *
        (Equiv.Perm.sign (Tuple.sort x) : ℤ) = 1 := by
      simp
    rw [hs, one_smul]
  · have hfx : ¬Function.Injective (f ∘ x) := by
      intro h
      exact hx (fun _ _ hxy => h (congrArg f hxy))
    rw [orientedTuple_of_not_injective K R x hx, map_zero,
      orientedTuple_of_not_injective L R _ hfx]

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_vertexChainMap
statement:
theorem boundary_vertexChainMap (f : VertexMap K L) (n : ℕ) :
    (boundary L R n).comp (vertexChainMap R f (n + 1)) =
      (vertexChainMap R f n).comp (boundary K R n)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
  intro s
  apply LinearMap.ext_ring
  have hk : Finset.univ.image (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2) ∈ K := by
    simpa only [Finset.image_orderEmbOfFin_univ] using s.2.1
  change boundary L R n (vertexChainMap R f (n + 1) (Finsupp.single s 1)) =
    vertexChainMap R f n (boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s 1))
  rw [← orientedTuple_face K R s, vertexChainMap_orientedTuple R f _ hk,
    boundary_orientedTuple L R _ (vertexTuple_mem f _ hk), boundary_orientedTuple K R _ hk]
  unfold tupleBoundarySum
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [map_zsmul, vertexChainMap_orientedTuple R f _ (tupleImage_delete_mem K _ hk i)]
  rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialChainMap_f
statement:
@[simp] theorem simplicialChainMap_f (f : VertexMap K L) (n : ℕ) :
    (simplicialChainMap R f).f n = ModuleCat.ofHom (vertexChainMap R f n)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.vertexChainMap_id
statement:
theorem vertexChainMap_id (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (n : ℕ) :
    vertexChainMap R (VertexMap.id K) n = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro s a
  rw [vertexChainMap_single]
  change a • orientedTuple K R (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2) = Finsupp.single s a
  rw [orientedTuple_face]
  simp

name: TDA.Simplicial.vertexChainMap_comp
statement:
theorem vertexChainMap_comp (f : VertexMap K L) (g : VertexMap L M) (n : ℕ) :
    vertexChainMap R (VertexMap.comp f g) n =
      (vertexChainMap R g n).comp (vertexChainMap R f n)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro s a
  have hk : Finset.univ.image (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2) ∈ K := by
    simpa only [Finset.image_orderEmbOfFin_univ] using s.2.1
  change vertexChainMap R (VertexMap.comp f g) n (Finsupp.single s a) =
    vertexChainMap R g n (vertexChainMap R f n (Finsupp.single s a))
  rw [vertexChainMap_single, vertexChainMap_single, map_smul,
    vertexChainMap_orientedTuple R g _ (vertexTuple_mem f _ hk)]
  rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialChainMap_id
statement:
theorem simplicialChainMap_id (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) :
    simplicialChainMap R (VertexMap.id K) = 𝟙 (simplicialChainComplex K R)
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
  intro n
  simp [vertexChainMap_id]

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialChainMap_comp
statement:
theorem simplicialChainMap_comp (f : VertexMap K L) (g : VertexMap L M) :
    simplicialChainMap R (VertexMap.comp f g) =
      simplicialChainMap R f ≫ simplicialChainMap R g
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
  intro n
  simp only [simplicialChainMap_f, HomologicalComplex.comp_f]
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  exact vertexChainMap_comp R f g n

name: TDA.Simplicial.vertexChainMap_inclusion
statement:
theorem vertexChainMap_inclusion {K L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ) : vertexChainMap R (inclusionVertexMap h) n = chainIncl R h n
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro s a
  rw [vertexChainMap_single, chainIncl_single]
  have ht : inclusionVertexMap h ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 =
      (faceIncl h n s).1.orderEmbOfFin (faceIncl h n s).2.2 := rfl
  rw [ht, orientedTuple_face]
  simp

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialChainMap_inclusion
statement:
theorem simplicialChainMap_inclusion {K L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    (h : K ≤ L) : simplicialChainMap R (inclusionVertexMap h) = simplicialChainIncl R h
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
  intro n
  simp [vertexChainMap_inclusion]

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyMap_id
statement:
theorem simplicialHomologyMap_id (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialHomologyMap R (VertexMap.id K) n = 𝟙 (simplicialHomology K R n)
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyMap_comp
statement:
theorem simplicialHomologyMap_comp (f : VertexMap K L) (g : VertexMap L M) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialHomologyMap R (VertexMap.comp f g) n =
      simplicialHomologyMap R f n ≫ simplicialHomologyMap R g n
proof:
:= by
  unfold simplicialHomologyMap
  rw [simplicialChainMap_comp]
  exact HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp _ _ n

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion
proof:
:= by
  unfold simplicialHomologyMap simplicialHomologyIncl

name: TDA.Simplicial.vertexChainMap_single_of_not_injective
statement:
theorem vertexChainMap_single_of_not_injective (f : VertexMap K L) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Face K n) (a : R) (hx : ¬Function.Injective (f ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2)) :
    vertexChainMap R f n (Finsupp.single s a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexChainMap_single, orientedTuple_of_not_injective L R _ hx, smul_zero]

name: TDA.Simplicial.vertexChainMap_single_of_injective
statement:
theorem vertexChainMap_single_of_injective (f : VertexMap K L) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Face K n) (a : R) (hx : Function.Injective (f ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2)) :
    vertexChainMap R f n (Finsupp.single s a) =
      a • ((Equiv.Perm.sign (Tuple.sort (f ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2)) : ℤ) •
        Finsupp.single (vertexImageFace f s hx) (1 : R))
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexChainMap_single, orientedTuple_of_injective L R _ hx
    (vertexTuple_mem f _ (by simpa only [Finset.image_orderEmbOfFin_univ] using s.2.1))]
  rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.vertexChainMap_vertex
statement:
theorem vertexChainMap_vertex (f : VertexMap K L) (s : Face K 0) (a : R) :
    vertexChainMap R f 0 (Finsupp.single s a) =
      Finsupp.single (vertexImageFace f s (fun i j _ => Fin.ext (by omega))) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexChainMap_single]
  have hm : Monotone (f ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2) :=
    fun i j _ => le_of_eq (congrArg (f ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2) (show i = j from Fin.ext (by omega)))
  rw [orientedTuple_of_monotone L R _ (fun i j _ => Fin.ext (by omega))
    (vertexTuple_mem f _ (by simpa only [Finset.image_orderEmbOfFin_univ] using s.2.1)) hm]
  simp [vertexImageFace]

name: TDA.Simplicial.shortHomologyClass_map
statement:
private theorem shortHomologyClass_map
    (S T : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)) (φ : S ⟶ T)
    (z : LinearMap.ker S.g.hom) (w : LinearMap.ker T.g.hom)
    (h : φ.τ₂.hom (z : S.X₂) = (w : T.X₂)) :
    (ShortComplex.homologyMap φ).hom (shortHomologyClass R S z) =
      shortHomologyClass R T w
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (S.moduleCatCyclesIso.inv ≫ ShortComplex.cyclesMap φ).hom z =
      T.moduleCatCyclesIso.inv.hom w := by
    apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective T.iCycles).mp inferInstance
    change (S.moduleCatCyclesIso.inv ≫ ShortComplex.cyclesMap φ ≫ T.iCycles).hom z =
      (T.moduleCatCyclesIso.inv ≫ T.iCycles).hom w
    rw [ShortComplex.cyclesMap_i, ← Category.assoc,
      ShortComplex.moduleCatCyclesIso_inv_iCycles,
      ShortComplex.moduleCatCyclesIso_inv_iCycles]
    exact h
  have hn := congrArg
    (fun q => q.hom (S.moduleCatCyclesIso.inv.hom z))
    (ShortComplex.homologyπ_naturality φ)
  change (ShortComplex.homologyMap φ).hom (shortHomologyClass R S z) =
    T.homologyπ.hom ((S.moduleCatCyclesIso.inv ≫ ShortComplex.cyclesMap φ).hom z) at hn
  rw [hc] at hn
  exact hn

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyClass_quotient
statement:
theorem simplicialHomologyClass_quotient (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (n : ℕ)
    (z : simplicialCycles K R n) :
    (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} R (simplicialChainComplex K R) n).hom.hom
      (simplicialHomologyClass R K n z) = (simplicialBoundaries K R n).mkQ z
proof:
:= by
  let S := (simplicialChainComplex K R).sc n
  change (S.moduleCatCyclesIso.inv ≫ S.homologyπ ≫ S.moduleCatHomologyIso.hom).hom z = _
  rw [← Category.assoc, ShortComplex.moduleCatCyclesIso_inv_π]
  simp only [Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyMap_class
statement:
theorem simplicialHomologyMap_class (f : VertexMap K L) (n : ℕ)
    (z : simplicialCycles K R n) (w : simplicialCycles L R n)
    (h : vertexChainMap R f n (z : Chain K R n) = (w : Chain L R n)) :
    (simplicialHomologyMap R f n).hom (simplicialHomologyClass R K n z) =
      simplicialHomologyClass R L n w
proof:
:= by
  exact shortHomologyClass_map R _ _
    ((HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor _ _ n).map (simplicialChainMap R f)) z w h

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialSingletonH0Equiv_class
statement:
theorem simplicialSingletonH0Equiv_class (v : V) (a : R) :
    simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R v
      (simplicialHomologyClass R (Filtration.singletonFace v) 0
        ⟨Finsupp.single (singletonVertex v) a, by rw [simplicialCycles_zero]; trivial⟩) = a
proof:
:= by
  let S := (simplicialChainComplex (Filtration.singletonFace v) R).sc 0
  have hf : S.f = 0 := by
    change (simplicialChainComplex (Filtration.singletonFace v) R).d
      ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev 0) 0 = 0
    rw [ChainComplex.prev]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    ext c
    change boundary (Filtration.singletonFace v) R 0 c = 0
    rw [singletonHigherChain_eq_zero v R 0 c]
    simp
  have hg : S.g = 0 := by
    change (simplicialChainComplex (Filtration.singletonFace v) R).d
      0 ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).next 0) = 0
    rw [ChainComplex.next_nat_zero]
    exact simplicialChainComplex_d_zero _ R 0
  have hi : (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S hf hg).cyclesIso.hom =
      S.iCycles := by
    simpa [ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros] using
      (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S hf hg).cyclesIso_hom_comp_i
  have hn : S.moduleCatCyclesIso.inv ≫ S.homologyπ ≫
      (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S hf hg).homologyIso.hom =
      S.moduleCatLeftHomologyData.i := by
    rw [(ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S hf hg).homologyπ_comp_homologyIso_hom]
    simp only [ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros_π]
    rw [hi]
    exact S.moduleCatCyclesIso_inv_iCycles
  change (Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv R R (singletonVertex v))
    ((S.moduleCatCyclesIso.inv ≫ S.homologyπ ≫
      (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S hf hg).homologyIso.hom).hom
      ⟨Finsupp.single (singletonVertex v) a, _⟩) = a
  rw [hn]
  change (Finsupp.single (singletonVertex v) a) (singletonVertex v) = a
  simp

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.endpoint_prism
proof:
:= by
  rw [prism_vertex]
  have ht : (fun k : Fin 2 => if k = 0 then endpoint 0
      ((fullFace 0).1.orderEmbOfFin (fullFace 0).2.2 0) else
      endpoint 1 ((fullFace 0).1.orderEmbOfFin (fullFace 0).2.2 0)) = (fun i => i) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.edge_boundary
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (Contiguous.boundary_prismMap_zero R endpoints_contiguous)
    (Finsupp.single (fullFace 0) a)

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.point_endpoint_chains_differ
statement:
private theorem point_endpoint_chains_differ :
    vertexChainMap ℤ (endpoint 0) 0 ≠ vertexChainMap ℤ (endpoint 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun h (Finsupp.single (fullFace 0) 1)
  rw [endpoint_vertex, endpoint_vertex] at hc
  have he := congrArg (fun c : Chain edgeK ℤ 0 => c (edgeVertex 0)) hc
  norm_num [edgeVertex] at he

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.endpoint_prism_nonzero_boundary
statement:
private theorem endpoint_prism_nonzero_boundary :
    boundary edgeK ℤ 0
      (Contiguous.prismMap ℤ endpoints_contiguous 0 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 0) 1)) =
      Finsupp.single (edgeVertex 1) 1 - Finsupp.single (edgeVertex 0) 1 ∧
    boundary edgeK ℤ 0
      (Contiguous.prismMap ℤ endpoints_contiguous 0 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 0) 1)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [endpoint_prism, edge_boundary]
  constructor
  · rfl
  · intro hz
    have hc := congrArg (fun c : Chain edgeK ℤ 0 => c (edgeVertex 1)) hz
    norm_num [edgeVertex] at hc

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.endpoint_simplicialH0
statement:
private theorem endpoint_simplicialH0 :
    simplicialHomologyMap ℚ (endpoint 0) 0 = simplicialHomologyMap ℚ (endpoint 1) 0 ∧
    (simplicialHomologyMap ℚ (endpoint 0) 0).hom
      (simplicialHomologyClass ℚ pointK 0 (zeroVertexCycle pointK ℚ (fullFace 0))) ≠ 0 ∧
    simplicialHomologyClass ℚ pointK 0 (zeroVertexCycle pointK ℚ (fullFace 0)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Contiguous.simplicialHomologyMap_eq ℚ endpoints_contiguous 0, ?_,
    simplicialHomologyClass_zeroVertexCycle_ne_zero _ ℚ _⟩
  have hm := simplicialHomologyMap_class ℚ (endpoint 0) 0
    (zeroVertexCycle pointK ℚ (fullFace 0)) (zeroVertexCycle edgeK ℚ (edgeVertex 0))
    (endpoint_vertex ℚ 0 1)
  rw [hm]
  exact simplicialHomologyClass_zeroVertexCycle_ne_zero _ ℚ _

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.prism_edge
statement:
private theorem prism_edge {W : Type} [LinearOrder W] {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W}
    (R : Type) [Ring R] {f g : VertexMap edgeK L} (h : Contiguous f g) :
    Contiguous.prismMap R h 1 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1) =
      orientedTuple L R ![f 0, g 0, g 1] - orientedTuple L R ![f 0, f 1, g 1]
proof:
:= by
  rw [Contiguous.prismMap_single, fullFace_enumeration, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, pow_zero, pow_one, one_smul, neg_smul,
    sub_eq_add_neg]
  apply congrArg₂ (fun x y : Chain L R 2 => x + -y)
  all_goals
    congr 1
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;> rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.id_chain
statement:
private theorem id_chain (R : Type) [Ring R] (n : ℕ) :
    vertexChainMap R edgeId n = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  have h : edgeId = VertexMap.id edgeK := by ext i; rfl
  rw [h, vertexChainMap_id]

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.reversal_edge
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexChainMap_single, fullFace_enumeration, one_smul]
  have h := orientedTuple_comp_perm edgeK R (fun i => i) (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)
  simpa [edgeRev, fullMap, Function.comp_def, orientedTuple_id,
    Equiv.Perm.sign_swap (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1)] using h

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.reversal_prism
proof:
:= by
  rw [prism_edge]
  have hr : orientedTuple edgeK R ![0, 1, 0] = 0 := by
    apply orientedTuple_of_not_injective
    intro hi
    have h := hi (show (![0, 1, 0] : Fin 3 → Fin 2) 0 = ![0, 1, 0] 2 by rfl)
    exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2) h
  change orientedTuple edgeK R ![0, 1, 0] - orientedTuple edgeK R ![0, 1, 0] = 0
  rw [hr]
  simp

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.reversal_boundary_prism
statement:
private theorem reversal_boundary_prism (R : Type) [Ring R] :
    Contiguous.prismMap R (full_contiguous id (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) 0
      (boundary edgeK R 0 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) =
      -Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1 - Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun
    (Contiguous.boundary_prismMap_succ R (full_contiguous id (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) 0)
    (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply] at h
  change boundary edgeK R 1 (Contiguous.prismMap R
      (full_contiguous id (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) 1 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) +
    Contiguous.prismMap R (full_contiguous id (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) 0
      (boundary edgeK R 0 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) =
    vertexChainMap R edgeRev 1 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1) -
      vertexChainMap R edgeId 1 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1) at h
  simpa only [reversal_prism, map_zero, zero_add, reversal_edge, id_chain,
    LinearMap.id_apply] using h

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.reversal_integer_nonzero
statement:
private theorem reversal_integer_nonzero :
    Contiguous.prismMap ℤ (full_contiguous id (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) 0
      (boundary edgeK ℤ 0 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) =
      Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) (-2) ∧
    Contiguous.prismMap ℤ (full_contiguous id (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) 0
      (boundary edgeK ℤ 0 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [reversal_boundary_prism]
  constructor
  · apply Finsupp.ext
    intro σ
    by_cases hs : fullFace 1 = σ <;> simp [hs]
  · intro hz
    have hc := congrArg (fun c : Chain edgeK ℤ 1 => c (fullFace 1)) hz
    norm_num at hc

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.reversal_characteristic_two
statement:
private theorem reversal_characteristic_two :
    Contiguous.prismMap (ZMod 2) (full_contiguous id (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) 0
      (boundary edgeK (ZMod 2) 0 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) = 0 ∧
    simplicialHomologyMap (ZMod 2) edgeId 1 = simplicialHomologyMap (ZMod 2) edgeRev 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [reversal_boundary_prism]
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro σ
    by_cases hs : fullFace 1 = σ <;> norm_num [Finsupp.single_apply, hs]
  · exact Contiguous.simplicialHomologyMap_eq (ZMod 2) (full_contiguous _ _) 1

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.prism_edge_vertex
statement:
private theorem prism_edge_vertex {W : Type} [LinearOrder W] {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W}
    (R : Type) [Ring R] {f g : VertexMap edgeK L} (h : Contiguous f g) (i : Fin 2) (a : R) :
    Contiguous.prismMap R h 0 (Finsupp.single (edgeVertex i) a) =
      a • orientedTuple L R ![f i, g i]
proof:
:= by
  rw [prism_vertex]
  have hi : (edgeVertex i).1.orderEmbOfFin (edgeVertex i).2.2 0 = i :=
    Finset.mem_singleton.mp (Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ _ 0)
  rw [hi]
  congr 2
  funext k
  fin_cases k <;> rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.map_edge_tuple
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexChainMap_single, fullFace_enumeration, one_smul]
  congr 1
  funext k
  fin_cases k <;> rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.constant_edge_tuple
statement:
private theorem constant_edge_tuple (R : Type) [Ring R] (i : Fin 2) :
    orientedTuple edgeK R ![i, i] = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply orientedTuple_of_not_injective
  intro hi
  exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1) (hi (show (![i, i] : Fin 2 → Fin 2) 0 = ![i, i] 1 by rfl))

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.triangle_contiguous
statement: private theorem triangle_contiguous : Contiguous edgeTo01 edgeTo02
proof: := full_contiguous _ _

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.mixed_triangle_prism
proof:
:= by
  rw [prism_edge]
  change orientedTuple triangleK ℤ ![0, 0, 2] - orientedTuple triangleK ℤ ![0, 1, 2] = _
  have hz : orientedTuple triangleK ℤ ![0, 0, 2] = 0 := by
    apply orientedTuple_of_not_injective
    intro hi
    exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1)
      (hi (show (![0, 0, 2] : Fin 3 → Fin 3) 0 = ![0, 0, 2] 1 by rfl))
  have ht : (![0, 1, 2] : Fin 3 → Fin 3) = fun i => i := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hz, ht, orientedTuple_id, zero_sub]

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.mixed_triangle_prism_nonzero
statement:
private theorem mixed_triangle_prism_nonzero :
    Contiguous.prismMap ℤ triangle_contiguous 1 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mixed_triangle_prism]
  intro hz
  have he := congrArg (fun c : Chain triangleK ℤ 2 => c (fullFace 2)) hz
  norm_num at he

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.mixed_triangle_boundary_prism
statement:
private theorem mixed_triangle_boundary_prism :
    Contiguous.prismMap ℤ triangle_contiguous 0
      (boundary edgeK ℤ 0 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) =
      orientedTuple triangleK ℤ ![1, 2]
proof:
:= by
  rw [edge_boundary, map_sub, prism_edge_vertex, prism_edge_vertex]
  simp only [one_smul]
  change orientedTuple triangleK ℤ ![1, 2] - orientedTuple triangleK ℤ ![0, 0] = _
  have hz : orientedTuple triangleK ℤ ![0, 0] = 0 := by
    apply orientedTuple_of_not_injective
    intro hi
    exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1)
      (hi (show (![0, 0] : Fin 2 → Fin 3) 0 = ![0, 0] 1 by rfl))
  rw [hz, sub_zero]

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.mixed_triangle_identity
statement:
private theorem mixed_triangle_identity :
    boundary triangleK ℤ 1 (-Finsupp.single (fullFace 2) 1) +
      orientedTuple triangleK ℤ ![1, 2] =
      orientedTuple triangleK ℤ ![0, 2] - orientedTuple triangleK ℤ ![0, 1]
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (Contiguous.boundary_prismMap_succ ℤ triangle_contiguous 0)
    (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply] at h
  change boundary triangleK ℤ 1
      (Contiguous.prismMap ℤ triangle_contiguous 1 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) +
    Contiguous.prismMap ℤ triangle_contiguous 0
      (boundary edgeK ℤ 0 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) =
    vertexChainMap ℤ edgeTo02 1 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1) -
      vertexChainMap ℤ edgeTo01 1 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1) at h
  rw [mixed_triangle_prism, mixed_triangle_boundary_prism, map_edge_tuple, map_edge_tuple] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.collapse_prism
proof:
:= by
  rw [prism_edge]
  change orientedTuple edgeK ℤ ![0, 0, 1] - orientedTuple edgeK ℤ ![0, 0, 1] = 0
  have hz : orientedTuple edgeK ℤ ![0, 0, 1] = 0 := by
    apply orientedTuple_of_not_injective
    intro hi
    exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1)
      (hi (show (![0, 0, 1] : Fin 3 → Fin 2) 0 = ![0, 0, 1] 1 by rfl))
  rw [hz]
  simp

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.collapse_edge
statement:
private theorem collapse_edge :
    vertexChainMap ℤ edgeCollapse 1 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_edge_tuple]
  exact constant_edge_tuple ℤ 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.collapse_boundary_prism
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun
    (Contiguous.boundary_prismMap_succ ℤ (full_contiguous (fun _ : Fin 2 => (0 : Fin 2)) id) 0)
    (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply] at h
  change boundary edgeK ℤ 1 (Contiguous.prismMap ℤ
      (full_contiguous (fun _ : Fin 2 => (0 : Fin 2)) id) 1 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) +
    Contiguous.prismMap ℤ (full_contiguous (fun _ : Fin 2 => (0 : Fin 2)) id) 0
      (boundary edgeK ℤ 0 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) =
    vertexChainMap ℤ edgeId 1 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1) -
      vertexChainMap ℤ edgeCollapse 1 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1) at h
  simpa only [collapse_prism, map_zero, zero_add, id_chain, LinearMap.id_apply,
    collapse_edge, sub_zero] using h

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.isolated_endpoint_vertex
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexChainMap_vertex]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.isolated_endpoints_not_contiguous
statement:
private theorem isolated_endpoints_not_contiguous :
    ¬Contiguous (isolatedEndpoint 0) (isolatedEndpoint 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have ht := h {(0 : Fin 1)} (by change ({(0 : Fin 1)} : Finset (Fin 1)).Nonempty; simp)
  have hc := ht.2
  norm_num [isolatedEndpoint] at hc

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.isolated_simplicialH0_maps_differ
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  let z := zeroVertexCycle pointK ℚ (fullFace 0)
  let z₀ := zeroVertexCycle isolatedK ℚ (isolatedVertex 0)
  let z₁ := zeroVertexCycle isolatedK ℚ (isolatedVertex 1)
  have hm₀ := simplicialHomologyMap_class ℚ (isolatedEndpoint 0) 0 z z₀
    (isolated_endpoint_vertex 0)
  have hm₁ := simplicialHomologyMap_class ℚ (isolatedEndpoint 1) 0 z z₁
    (isolated_endpoint_vertex 1)
  have hc := congrArg (fun m => m.hom (simplicialHomologyClass ℚ pointK 0 z)) he
  rw [hm₀, hm₁] at hc
  have hq := congrArg (homologyKernelQuotient ℚ (simplicialChainComplex isolatedK ℚ) 0).hom.hom hc
  rw [simplicialHomologyClass_quotient, simplicialHomologyClass_quotient] at hq
  have hb : z₀ - z₁ ∈ simplicialBoundaries isolatedK ℚ 0 := (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).mp hq
  obtain ⟨c, hcb⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff ℚ isolatedK 0 (z₀ - z₁)).mp hb
  have hz : c = 0 := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro σ
    exact isEmptyElim σ
  rw [hz, map_zero] at hcb
  have hv := congrArg (fun c : Chain isolatedK ℚ 0 => c (isolatedVertex 0)) hcb
  norm_num [z₀, z₁, zeroVertexCycle, isolatedVertex] at hv

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.ghost_contiguous
statement: private theorem ghost_contiguous : Contiguous (ghostEndpoint 0) (ghostEndpoint 1)
proof:
:= by
  let : DecidableEq (Fin 3) := Classical.decEq _
  intro s hs
  have h₀ := (ghostEndpoint 0).map_face s hs
  have h₁ := (ghostEndpoint 1).map_face s hs
  exact ⟨h₀.1.mono Finset.subset_union_left, Finset.union_subset h₀.2 h₁.2⟩

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.ghost_singleton_absent
statement: private theorem ghost_singleton_absent : ¬({(2 : Fin 3)} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈ ghostEdge
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hi := h.2 (by simp : (2 : Fin 3) ∈ ({2} : Finset (Fin 3)))
  exact (by decide : ¬((2 : Fin 3) ∈ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 3)))) hi

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.ghost_prism
proof:
:= by
  rw [prism_vertex, one_smul]
  have ht : (fun k : Fin 2 => if k = 0 then ghostEndpoint 0
      ((fullFace 0).1.orderEmbOfFin (fullFace 0).2.2 0) else
      ghostEndpoint 1 ((fullFace 0).1.orderEmbOfFin (fullFace 0).2.2 0)) =
      (![0, 1] : Fin 2 → Fin 3) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [ht]
  have hi : Function.Injective (![0, 1] : Fin 2 → Fin 3) := by decide
  have hm : Monotone (![0, 1] : Fin 2 → Fin 3) := by decide
  have hk : Finset.univ.image (![0, 1] : Fin 2 → Fin 3) ∈ ghostEdge := by
    constructor <;> decide
  rw [orientedTuple_of_monotone ghostEdge ℤ _ hi hk hm]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.ghost_homotopy_component
proof:
:=
  Contiguous.chainHomotopy_hom_succ ℤ ghost_contiguous 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.bottom_contiguous
statement: private theorem bottom_contiguous : Contiguous bottomF bottomG
proof:
:= by
  intro _ hs
  exact False.elim hs

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.bottom_prism_zero
statement: private theorem bottom_prism_zero (n : ℕ) : Contiguous.prismMap ℤ bottom_contiguous n = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro s _
  exact False.elim s.2.1

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.bottom_homotopy_component_zero
statement:
private theorem bottom_homotopy_component_zero (n : ℕ) :
    (Contiguous.chainHomotopy ℤ bottom_contiguous).hom n (n + 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Contiguous.chainHomotopy_hom_succ, bottom_prism_zero, neg_zero]
  rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.empty_ambient_prism_zero
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro s _
  obtain ⟨i, _⟩ := s.2.1
  exact isEmptyElim i

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.matrix_left_coefficient_prism
statement:
private theorem matrix_left_coefficient_prism :
    let A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ := !![0, 1; 0, 0]
    Contiguous.prismMap (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) endpoints_contiguous 0
      (Finsupp.single (fullFace 0) A) = Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) A ∧
    boundary edgeK (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) 0
      (Contiguous.prismMap (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) endpoints_contiguous 0
        (Finsupp.single (fullFace 0) A)) =
      Finsupp.single (edgeVertex 1) A - Finsupp.single (edgeVertex 0) A ∧
    A * !![1, 0; 0, 0] ≠ !![1, 0; 0, 0] * A
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨endpoint_prism _ _, ?_, VertexChainMapExamples.matrix_coefficient_noncentral⟩
  rw [endpoint_prism, edge_boundary]

name: TDA.Simplicial.ContiguityHomotopyExamples.matrix_prism_nonzero
proof:
:= by
  rw [endpoint_prism]
  intro hz
  have he := congrArg
    (fun c : Chain edgeK (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) 1 => c (fullFace 1) 0 1) hz
  norm_num at he

name: TDA.Simplicial.isApexCone_top
statement:
theorem isApexCone_top (v : V) (hv : ∀ w, v ≤ w) :
    IsApexCone (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) v
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change ({v} : Finset V).Nonempty
    simp
  · intro s hs
    change (insert v s).Nonempty
    simp
  · intro s hs w hw
    exact hv w

name: TDA.Simplicial.exists_isApexCone_top
statement:
theorem exists_isApexCone_top [Finite V] [Nonempty V] :
    ∃ v, IsApexCone (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Finite.exists_min (fun w : V => w)
  exact ⟨v, isApexCone_top v hv⟩

name: TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone.coneFace_orderEmb
statement:
private theorem coneFace_orderEmb (hK : IsApexCone K v) {n : ℕ}
    (s : Face K n) (hs : v ∉ s.1) :
    ∀ i, (hK.coneFace s hs).1.orderEmbOfFin (hK.coneFace s hs).2.2 i =
      ((Fin.cons (n := n + 1) v (fun j => s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j) :
        Fin (n + 1 + 1) → V) i)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have horder :
      (Fin.cons (n := n + 1) v (fun j => s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j) :
          Fin (n + 1 + 1) → V) =
        (hK.coneFace s hs).1.orderEmbOfFin (hK.coneFace s hs).2.2 := by
    apply Finset.orderEmbOfFin_unique (hK.coneFace s hs).2.2
    · intro i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · exact Finset.mem_insert_self v s.1
      · exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem s.1 s.2.2 j)
    · apply Fin.strictMono_cons.mpr
      refine ⟨?_, (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2).strictMono⟩
      intro j
      have hle := hK.apex_le (insert v s.1) (hK.insert_mem s.1 s.2.1)
        (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j)
        (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem s.1 s.2.2 j))
      have hne : v ≠ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j := by
        intro h
        exact hs (h.symm ▸ Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem s.1 s.2.2 j)
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne
  exact congrFun horder.symm i

name: TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone.deletedFace_coneFace_zero
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (hK.coneFace s hs).1.erase
      ((hK.coneFace s hs).1.orderEmbOfFin (hK.coneFace s hs).2.2 0) = s.1
  rw [coneFace_orderEmb hK s hs 0]
  change (insert v s.1).erase v = s.1
  simp [hs]

name: TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone.deletedFace_coneFace_succ
statement:
private theorem deletedFace_coneFace_succ (hK : IsApexCone K v) {n : ℕ}
    (s : Face K (n + 1)) (hs : v ∉ s.1) (j : Fin (n + 2)) :
    deletedFace K (n + 1) (hK.coneFace s hs) j.succ =
      hK.coneFace (deletedFace K n s j) (by
        intro hvj
        exact hs (Finset.erase_subset _ _ hvj))
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (hK.coneFace s hs).1.erase
      ((hK.coneFace s hs).1.orderEmbOfFin (hK.coneFace s hs).2.2 j.succ) =
    insert v (s.1.erase (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j))
  rw [coneFace_orderEmb hK s hs j.succ]
  have hne : v ≠ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j := by
    intro h
    exact hs (h.symm ▸ Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem s.1 s.2.2 j)
  change (insert v s.1).erase
      ((Fin.cons v (fun j => s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j) : Fin (n + 3) → V) j.succ) =
    insert v (s.1.erase (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j))
  simp only [Fin.cons_succ]
  exact Finset.erase_insert_of_ne hne

name: TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone.orderEmbOfFin_zero_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  change s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 2)) = v
  rw [Finset.orderEmbOfFin_zero s.2.2 (by omega)]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact Finset.min'_le _ _ hs
  · exact Finset.le_min' _ _ _ (fun w hw => hK.apex_le s s.2.1 w hw)

name: TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone.deletedFace_zero_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  change s.1.erase (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 0) = s.1.erase v
  rw [orderEmbOfFin_zero_of_mem hK s hs]

name: TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone.coneFace_deletedFace_zero_of_mem
statement:
private theorem coneFace_deletedFace_zero_of_mem (hK : IsApexCone K v) {n : ℕ}
    (s : Face K (n + 1)) (hs : v ∈ s.1) :
    hK.coneFace (deletedFace K n s 0) (by
      rw [deletedFace_zero_of_mem hK s hs]
      exact Finset.notMem_erase _ _) = s
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change insert v (deletedFace K n s 0).1 = s.1
  rw [deletedFace_zero_of_mem hK s hs]
  exact Finset.insert_erase hs

name: TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone.deletedFace_succ_mem_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  change v ∈ s.1.erase (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j.succ)
  refine Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨?_, hs⟩
  intro h
  have he : s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 0 =
      s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j.succ := by
    exact (orderEmbOfFin_zero_of_mem hK s hs).trans h
  have hi := (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2).injective he
  have hi' := congrArg (fun i : Fin (n + 2) => i.1) hi
  have hjpos : 0 < (j.succ : ℕ) := by simp
  exact (Nat.ne_of_gt hjpos) hi'.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone.deletedFace_coneFace_succ_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp s.2.2
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (hK.coneFace s hs).1.erase
      ((hK.coneFace s hs).1.orderEmbOfFin (hK.coneFace s hs).2.2 (Fin.succ 0)) =
    (hK.apexFace).1
  rw [coneFace_orderEmb hK s hs (Fin.succ 0)]
  change (insert v s.1).erase
      ((Fin.cons v (fun j => s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j) : Fin 2 → V) (Fin.succ 0)) = {v}
  have hvw : v ≠ w := by
    intro hvw
    apply hs
    rw [hw, hvw]
    exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _
  simpa [hw] using
    (Finset.erase_insert_of_ne hvw :
      (insert v ({w} : Finset V)).erase w =
        insert v (({w} : Finset V).erase w))

name: TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone.coneOperator_single_of_notMem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coneOperator_single_of_notMem (hK : IsApexCone K v) (R : Type v) [Ring R]
    {n : ℕ} (s : Face K n) (a : R) (hs : v ∉ s.1) :
    hK.coneOperator R n (Finsupp.single s a) = Finsupp.single (hK.coneFace s hs) a
proof:
:= by
  simp [coneOperator, hs]

name: TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone.coneOperator_single_of_mem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coneOperator_single_of_mem (hK : IsApexCone K v) (R : Type v) [Ring R]
    {n : ℕ} (s : Face K n) (a : R) (hs : v ∈ s.1) :
    hK.coneOperator R n (Finsupp.single s a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [coneOperator, hs]

name: TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone.boundary_coneOperator_add
statement:
theorem boundary_coneOperator_add (hK : IsApexCone K v) (R : Type v) [Ring R] (n : ℕ)
    (c : Chain K R (n + 1)) :
    boundary K R (n + 1) (hK.coneOperator R (n + 1) c) +
        hK.coneOperator R n (boundary K R n c) = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Chain K R (n + 1) →ₗ[R] Chain K R (n + 1) :=
    (boundary K R (n + 1)).comp (hK.coneOperator R (n + 1)) +
      (hK.coneOperator R n).comp (boundary K R n)
  have hf : f = LinearMap.id := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro s a
    change boundary K R (n + 1) (hK.coneOperator R (n + 1) (Finsupp.single s a)) +
      hK.coneOperator R n (boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s a)) = Finsupp.single s a
    by_cases hs : v ∈ s.1
    · rw [show hK.coneOperator R (n + 1) (Finsupp.single s a) = 0 from
          hK.coneOperator_single_of_mem R s a hs]
      simp only [map_zero, zero_add]
      rw [boundary_single, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      simp only [map_smul, map_add, map_sum]
      have hzero : v ∉ (deletedFace K n s 0).1 := by
        rw [deletedFace_zero_of_mem hK s hs]
        exact Finset.notMem_erase _ _
      rw [hK.coneOperator_single_of_notMem R _ _ hzero]
      rw [coneFace_deletedFace_zero_of_mem hK s hs]
      have htail (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
          hK.coneOperator R n
              (Finsupp.single (deletedFace K n s j.succ)
                ((-1 : R) ^ (j.succ : ℕ))) = 0 := by
        exact hK.coneOperator_single_of_mem R _ _
          (deletedFace_succ_mem_of_mem hK s hs j)
      simp_rw [htail]
      simp
    · let hdel : ∀ j : Fin (n + 2), v ∉ (deletedFace K n s j).1 := fun j => by
        intro hvj
        exact hs (Finset.erase_subset _ _ hvj)
      have hface (j : Fin (n + 2)) :
          deletedFace K (n + 1) (hK.coneFace s hs) j.succ =
            hK.coneFace (deletedFace K n s j) (hdel j) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change (hK.coneFace s hs).1.erase
            ((hK.coneFace s hs).1.orderEmbOfFin (hK.coneFace s hs).2.2 j.succ) =
          insert v (s.1.erase (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j))
        rw [coneFace_orderEmb hK s hs j.succ]
        have hne : v ≠ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j := by
          intro h
          exact hs (h.symm ▸ Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem s.1 s.2.2 j)
        change (insert v s.1).erase
            ((Fin.cons v (fun j => s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j) : Fin (n + 3) → V) j.succ) =
          insert v (s.1.erase (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 j))
        simp only [Fin.cons_succ]
        exact Finset.erase_insert_of_ne hne
      have hzero : deletedFace K (n + 1) (hK.coneFace s hs) 0 = s :=
        deletedFace_coneFace_zero hK s hs
      have hsign (j : Fin (n + 2)) :
          (-1 : R) ^ (j.succ : ℕ) = -((-1 : R) ^ (j : ℕ)) := by
        simp [pow_succ]
      have hboundary :
          boundary K R (n + 1)
              (hK.coneOperator R (n + 1) (Finsupp.single s a)) =
            a • (Finsupp.single s 1 +
              ∑ j : Fin (n + 2),
                Finsupp.single (hK.coneFace (deletedFace K n s j) (hdel j))
                  ((-1 : R) ^ (j.succ : ℕ))) := by
        rw [hK.coneOperator_single_of_notMem R s a hs, boundary_single,
          Fin.sum_univ_succ, hzero]
        simp_rw [hface]
        simp
      have hcone :
          hK.coneOperator R n (boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s a)) =
            a • ∑ j : Fin (n + 2),
              Finsupp.single (hK.coneFace (deletedFace K n s j) (hdel j))
                ((-1 : R) ^ (j : ℕ)) := by
        rw [boundary_single]
        simp only [map_smul, map_sum]
        congr 1
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        rw [hK.coneOperator_single_of_notMem R _ _ (hdel j)]
      have hcancel :
          (∑ j : Fin (n + 2),
              Finsupp.single (hK.coneFace (deletedFace K n s j) (hdel j))
                ((-1 : R) ^ (j.succ : ℕ))) +
            ∑ j : Fin (n + 2),
              Finsupp.single (hK.coneFace (deletedFace K n s j) (hdel j))
                ((-1 : R) ^ (j : ℕ)) = 0 := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro j hj
        rw [hsign j]
        apply Finsupp.ext
        intro x
        by_cases hx : x = hK.coneFace (deletedFace K n s j) (hdel j)
        · subst x
          simp
        · simp
      rw [hboundary, hcone, ← smul_add, add_assoc, hcancel]
      simp
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hf c

name: TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone.boundary_coneOperator_zero
statement:
theorem boundary_coneOperator_zero (hK : IsApexCone K v) (k : Type v) [Field k]
    (c : Chain K k 0) :
    boundary K k 0 (hK.coneOperator k 0 c) =
      c - Finsupp.single hK.apexFace (zeroChainSum K k c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Chain K k 0 →ₗ[k] Chain K k 0 :=
    (boundary K k 0).comp (hK.coneOperator k 0)
  have hf : f = LinearMap.id -
      (zeroChainSum K k).smulRight (Finsupp.single hK.apexFace 1) := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro s a
    change boundary K k 0 (hK.coneOperator k 0 (Finsupp.single s a)) =
      Finsupp.single s a -
        (zeroChainSum K k (Finsupp.single s a)) • Finsupp.single hK.apexFace 1
    by_cases hs : v ∈ s.1
    · have hseq : s = hK.apexFace := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp s.2.2
        have hwv : w = v := by
          have : v ∈ ({w} : Finset V) := by simpa [← hw] using hs
          have hvw : v = w := by simpa using this
          exact hvw.symm
        change s.1 = ({v} : Finset V)
        rw [hw, hwv]
      rw [hK.coneOperator_single_of_mem k s a hs, hseq]
      simp [zeroChainSum_single]
    · have hzero : deletedFace K 0 (hK.coneFace s hs) 0 = s :=
        deletedFace_coneFace_zero hK s hs
      have hsucc : deletedFace K 0 (hK.coneFace s hs) (Fin.succ 0) = hK.apexFace :=
        deletedFace_coneFace_succ_zero hK s hs
      rw [hK.coneOperator_single_of_notMem k s a hs, boundary_single,
        Fin.sum_univ_succ, hzero, Fin.sum_univ_succ, hsucc]
      simp [f, zeroChainSum_single, sub_eq_add_neg]
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hf c
  simpa [f, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smulRight_apply] using h

name: TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone.isZero_simplicialHomology_succ
statement:
theorem isZero_simplicialHomology_succ (hK : IsApexCone K v) (R : Type v) [Ring R]
    (n : ℕ) : IsZero (simplicialHomology K R (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
