name: TDA.Simplicial.ConeExamples.boundary_coneOperator_triangle_face
statement:
theorem boundary_coneOperator_triangle_face :
    (isApexCone_top (0 : Fin 3) (fun w => Fin.zero_le w)).coneOperator ℤ 1
        (boundary (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ℤ 1
          (Finsupp.single
            (⟨{0, 1, 2}, by change ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)).Nonempty; decide,
              by decide⟩ : Face (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) 2) 1)) =
      Finsupp.single
        (⟨{0, 1, 2}, by change ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)).Nonempty; decide,
          by decide⟩ : Face (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) 2) 1
proof:
:= by
  let hK : IsApexCone (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) 0 :=
    isApexCone_top 0 (fun w => Fin.zero_le w)
  let σ : Face (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) 2 :=
    ⟨{0, 1, 2}, by change ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)).Nonempty; decide, by decide⟩
  let edge01 : Face (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) 1 :=
    ⟨{0, 1}, by change ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 3)).Nonempty; decide, by decide⟩
  let edge02 : Face (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) 1 :=
    ⟨{0, 2}, by change ({0, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)).Nonempty; decide, by decide⟩
  let edge12 : Face (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) 1 :=
    ⟨{1, 2}, by change ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)).Nonempty; decide, by decide⟩
  change hK.coneOperator ℤ 1
      (boundary (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ℤ 1
        (Finsupp.single σ 1)) = Finsupp.single σ 1
  have horder : σ.1.orderEmbOfFin σ.2.2 =
      (OrderIso.refl (Fin 3)).toOrderEmbedding := by
    symm
    apply Finset.orderEmbOfFin_unique'
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [σ]
  have hboundary :
      boundary (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ℤ 1
          (Finsupp.single σ 1) =
        Finsupp.single edge12 1 - Finsupp.single edge02 1 +
          Finsupp.single edge01 1 := by
    rw [boundary_single]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, deletedFace, horder]
    simp [σ, edge01, edge02, edge12, sub_eq_add_neg]
    abel
  have h01 : (0 : Fin 3) ∈ edge01.1 := by simp [edge01]
  have h02 : (0 : Fin 3) ∈ edge02.1 := by simp [edge02]
  have h12 : (0 : Fin 3) ∉ edge12.1 := by simp [edge12]
  have hcone12 : hK.coneFace edge12 h12 = σ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [IsApexCone.coneFace, edge12, σ]
  rw [hboundary, map_add, map_sub,
    hK.coneOperator_single_of_notMem ℤ edge12 1 h12,
    hK.coneOperator_single_of_mem ℤ edge02 1 h02,
    hK.coneOperator_single_of_mem ℤ edge01 1 h01, hcone12]
  simp

name: TDA.Simplicial.ConeExamples.not_isApexCone_top_one
statement:
theorem not_isApexCone_top_one :
    ¬ IsApexCone (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) 1
proof:

  have hle := hK.apex_le ({0} : Finset (Fin 3))
    (by change ({0} : Finset (Fin 3)).Nonempty; decide) 0 (by simp)
  norm_num at hle

name: TDA.Simplicial.ConeExamples.not_isApexCone_bot_zero

name: TDA.Simplicial.chainIncl_id
statement:
theorem chainIncl_id (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (R : Type*) [Ring R]
    (n : ℕ) : chainIncl R (le_refl K) n = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  have he : faceIncl (le_refl K) n = (id : Face K n → Face K n) := by
    funext s
    rfl
  simp [chainIncl, he]

name: TDA.Simplicial.chainIncl_comp
statement:
theorem chainIncl_comp {K L M : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} (R : Type*) [Ring R]
    (h : K ≤ L) (g : L ≤ M) (n : ℕ) :
    chainIncl R (h.trans g) n = (chainIncl R g n).comp (chainIncl R h n)
proof:
:= by
  have he : faceIncl (h.trans g) n = faceIncl g n ∘ faceIncl h n := by
    funext s
    rfl
  simpa [chainIncl, he] using
    (Finsupp.lmapDomain_comp (M := R) (R := R) (faceIncl h n) (faceIncl g n))

name: TDA.Simplicial.emptyChain_eq_zero
statement:
theorem emptyChain_eq_zero (R : Type*) [Ring R] (n : ℕ)
    (c : Chain (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) R n) : c = 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.emptyH0_eq_zero

theorem emptyH0_eq_zero (R : Type*) [Ring R]

name: TDA.Simplicial.singletonHigherChain_eq_zero
statement:
theorem singletonHigherChain_eq_zero (x : V) (R : Type*) [Ring R] (n : ℕ)

proof:
:=
  Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: TDA.Simplicial.edge_cover
statement:
private theorem edge_cover :
    ∀ e : Face triangleK 1, e = edge01 ∨ e = edge02 ∨ e = edge12
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ s : Finset (Fin 3), s.card = 2 →
      s = {0, 1} ∨ s = {0, 2} ∨ s = {1, 2} := by decide
  intro e
  rcases h e.1 e.2.2 with h | h | h
  · left; exact Subtype.ext h
  · right; left; exact Subtype.ext h
  · right; right; exact Subtype.ext h

name: TDA.Simplicial.signed_triangle_cancels
statement: private theorem signed_triangle_cancels : signedD1 triangleBoundary = 0
proof:
:= by

  have h₂ : edge12 ≠ edge02 := by decide
  have h₃ : edge02 ≠ edge01 := by decide
  simp [signedD1, triangleBoundary, edgeBoundary, h₁, h₂, h₃,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_single]

name: TDA.Simplicial.triangle_boundary_formula

name: TDA.Simplicial.matrix_coordinate
statement:
private theorem matrix_coordinate {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} (R : Type*)
    [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) [Fintype (Face K (n + 1))]
    [DecidableEq (Face K (n + 1))] [Finite (Face K n)]
    (d : Chain K R (n + 1) →ₗ[R] Chain K R n)
    (i : Face K n) (j : Face K (n + 1)) :
    LinearMap.toMatrix (faceBasis K R (n + 1)) (faceBasis K R n) d i j =
      (faceBasis K R n).repr (d ((faceBasis K R (n + 1)) j)) i
proof:
:= by
  exact LinearMap.toMatrix_apply _ _ _ _ _

name: TDA.Simplicial.signed_matrix_entry
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype (Face triangleK 1) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let M := LinearMap.toMatrix (faceBasis triangleK ℤ 1) (faceBasis triangleK ℤ 0) signedD1
  refine ⟨M, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (LinearMap.toMatrix (faceBasis triangleK ℤ 1)
      (faceBasis triangleK ℤ 0) signedD1) (vertex 1) edge01 = 1
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    simp [faceBasis, signedD1, edgeBoundary, edge01, vertex,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_single]
  · change (LinearMap.toMatrix (faceBasis triangleK ℤ 1)
      (faceBasis triangleK ℤ 0) signedD1) (vertex 0) edge01 = -1
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    simp [faceBasis, signedD1, edgeBoundary, edge01, vertex,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_single]

name: TDA.Simplicial.edgeFace_unique
statement: private theorem edgeFace_unique (e : Face edgeK 1) : e = edgeFace
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ s : Finset (Fin 3), s.card = 2 → s ⊆ {0, 1} → s = {0, 1} := by decide
  exact Subtype.ext (h e.1 e.2.2 e.2.1.2)

name: TDA.Simplicial.edge_triangle_square
proof:
:= by

  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro e a
  rw [edgeFace_unique e]
  simp [edgeD1, signedD1, chainIncl, faceIncl, edgeBoundary, edgeFace,
    edgeVertex, edge01, vertex, Finsupp.linearCombination_single,
    Finsupp.mapDomain_sub, Finsupp.mapDomain_single]

name: TDA.Simplicial.AttachmentExamples.pathEdge01_order
proof:
:= by
  have hs : pathEdge01.1 = ({(2 : Fin 3)}ᶜ : Finset (Fin 3)) := by decide

name: TDA.Simplicial.AttachmentExamples.pathEdge02_order
proof:

      ({(0 : Fin 3)}ᶜ : Finset (Fin 3)) := by decide

name: TDA.Simplicial.AttachmentExamples.closingEdge_old_filler
statement:
private theorem closingEdge_old_filler (k : Type*) [Field k] :
    boundary path k 0
      (Finsupp.single pathEdge02 1 - Finsupp.single pathEdge01 1) =
        closingEdge.attachingBoundary k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h02 : deletedFace path 0 pathEdge02 0 = closingEdge.oldDeletedFace 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change pathEdge02.1.erase
      (pathEdge02.1.orderEmbOfFin pathEdge02.2.2 0) =
      closingEdge.newFace.1.erase
        (closingEdge.newFace.1.orderEmbOfFin closingEdge.newFace.2.2 0)
    rw [pathEdge02_order, closingEdge_order]
    decide
  have hcommon : deletedFace path 0 pathEdge02 1 =
      deletedFace path 0 pathEdge01 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change pathEdge02.1.erase
      (pathEdge02.1.orderEmbOfFin pathEdge02.2.2 1) =
      pathEdge01.1.erase
        (pathEdge01.1.orderEmbOfFin pathEdge01.2.2 1)
    rw [pathEdge02_order, pathEdge01_order]
    decide
  have h01 : deletedFace path 0 pathEdge01 0 =
      closingEdge.oldDeletedFace 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change pathEdge01.1.erase
      (pathEdge01.1.orderEmbOfFin pathEdge01.2.2 0) =
      closingEdge.newFace.1.erase
        (closingEdge.newFace.1.orderEmbOfFin closingEdge.newFace.2.2 1)
    rw [pathEdge01_order, closingEdge_order]
    decide
  rw [map_sub, boundary_single, boundary_single]
  simp only [one_smul, SimplexAttachment.attachingBoundary,
    Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_zero]
  have hcommon' : deletedFace path 0 pathEdge02 (Fin.succ 0) =
      deletedFace path 0 pathEdge01 (Fin.succ 0) := by simpa using hcommon
  have h01' : deletedFace path 0 pathEdge01 0 =
      closingEdge.oldDeletedFace (Fin.succ 0) := by simpa using h01
  rw [h02, hcommon', h01']
  norm_num
  module

name: TDA.Simplicial.AttachmentExamples.closingEdge_attachingClass_zero
statement:
private theorem closingEdge_attachingClass_zero (k : Type v) [Field k] :
    closingEdge.attachingHomologyClass k = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hb : closingEdge.attachingCycle k ∈ simplicialBoundaries path k 0 :=
    (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff k path 0 _).2
      ⟨Finsupp.single pathEdge02 1 - Finsupp.single pathEdge01 1,
        closingEdge_old_filler k⟩
  have hq : closingEdge.attachingQuotientClass k = 0 :=
    (closingEdge.attachingClass_zero_iff_boundary k).2 hb
  let e := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,0,v} k
    (simplicialChainComplex path k) 0).toLinearEquiv
  apply e.injective
  exact (closingEdge.attachingHomologyClass_equiv k).trans
    (hq.trans e.map_zero.symm)

name: TDA.Simplicial.AttachmentExamples.filled_triangle_H1_birth_and_death
statement:
theorem filled_triangle_H1_birth_and_death (k : Type*) [Field k] :
    ∃ (P C T : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3))
      (A : SimplexAttachment P C 1) (B : SimplexAttachment C T 2),
      A.simplex = {1, 2} ∧ B.simplex = {0, 1, 2} ∧
      Function.Injective (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion 1).hom ∧
      Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology C k 1 ⧸
        LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion 1).hom) = 1 ∧
      LinearMap.ker (simplicialHomologyIncl k B.inclusion 1).hom =
        k ∙ B.attachingHomologyClass k ∧
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
        (simplicialHomologyIncl k B.inclusion 1).hom) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hb := closingEdge.positive_birth k (closingEdge_attachingClass_zero k)
  have hd := fillingTriangle.positive_death k
    (fillingTriangle.attachingClass_ne_zero_of_no_old_coface k)
  exact ⟨path, cycle, triangle, closingEdge, fillingTriangle,
    rfl, rfl, hb.1, hb.2.1, hd.2.1, hd.2.2.1⟩

name: TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainCoefficientSum_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem zeroChainCoefficientSum_single (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] (s : Face K 0) (a : R) :
    zeroChainCoefficientSum K R (Finsupp.single s a) = a
proof:
:= by
  simp [zeroChainCoefficientSum]

name: TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainCoefficientSum_vertexChainMap
statement:
theorem zeroChainCoefficientSum_vertexChainMap
    {W : Type u} [LinearOrder W] {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W}
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] (f : VertexMap K L) :
    (zeroChainCoefficientSum L R).comp (vertexChainMap R f 0) =
      zeroChainCoefficientSum K R
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro s a
  change zeroChainCoefficientSum L R
      (vertexChainMap R f 0 (Finsupp.single s a)) =
    zeroChainCoefficientSum K R (Finsupp.single s a)
  rw [vertexChainMap_vertex]
  simp

name: TDA.Simplicial.fin_cons_image_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext w
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_insert]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr ⟨j, rfl⟩
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨Fin.succ j, by simp⟩

name: TDA.Simplicial.succ_cons_succAbove
statement:
private theorem succ_cons_succAbove {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin n) :
    (Fin.succ i).succAbove (Fin.succ j) = Fin.succ (i.succAbove j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hji : j.succ ≤ i
  · rw [Fin.succAbove_succ_of_le i (j.succ) hji,
      Fin.succAbove_of_succ_le i j hji]
    apply Fin.ext
    rfl
  · have hij : i ≤ j.castSucc := by
      rcases Fin.succ_le_or_le_castSucc i j with h | h
      · exact False.elim (hji h)
      · exact h
    have hlt : i < j.succ := lt_of_le_of_lt hij Fin.castSucc_lt_succ
    rw [Fin.succAbove_succ_of_lt i (j.succ) hlt,
      Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc i j hij]

name: TDA.Simplicial.fin_cons_comp_succ_succAbove
statement:
private theorem fin_cons_comp_succ_succAbove {n : ℕ} (apex : V)
    (x : Fin (n + 1) → V) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Fin.cons apex x ∘ (Fin.succ i).succAbove =
      Fin.cons apex (x ∘ i.succAbove)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j
  · simp
  · simp only [Fin.cons_succ, Function.comp_apply, succ_cons_succAbove]

name: TDA.Simplicial.tupleBoundarySum_cons
statement:
private theorem tupleBoundarySum_cons {n : ℕ} (R : Type v) [Ring R]
    (apex : V) (x : Fin (n + 1) → V) :
    tupleBoundarySum K R (Fin.cons apex x) =
      orientedTuple K R x -
        ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
          orientedTuple K R (Fin.cons apex (x ∘ i.succAbove))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold tupleBoundarySum
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp_rw [Fin.succAbove_zero]
  have hhead : Fin.cons apex x ∘ Fin.succ = x := by
    funext i
    rfl
  rw [hhead]
  simp_rw [fin_cons_comp_succ_succAbove]
  have hsign (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i.succ : ℕ) = -((-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ)) := by
    simp [pow_succ]
  simp_rw [hsign]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_smul, neg_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  abel

name: TDA.Simplicial.apexConsTuple_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [apexConsTuple, fin_cons_image_eq]
  simpa only [Finset.image_orderEmbOfFin_univ] using hinsert s.1 s.2.1

name: TDA.Simplicial.arbitraryApexConeOperator_single
statement:
@[simp]
theorem arbitraryApexConeOperator_single (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] (apex : V) (hapex : ({apex} : Finset V) ∈ K)
    (hinsert : ∀ s ∈ K, insert apex s ∈ K) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Face K n) (a : R) :
    arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert n (Finsupp.single s a) =
      a • orientedTuple K R (apexConsTuple apex s)
proof:
:= by
  simp [arbitraryApexConeOperator]

name: TDA.Simplicial.arbitraryApexConeFill_eq_operator
statement:
theorem arbitraryApexConeFill_eq_operator (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] (apex : V)
    (hapex : ({apex} : Finset V) ∈ K)
    (hinsert : ∀ s ∈ K, insert apex s ∈ K) (n : ℕ) (c : Chain K R n) :
    arbitraryApexConeFill K R apex n c =
      arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert n c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [arbitraryApexConeFill, arbitraryApexConeOperator, apexConsTuple,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]

name: TDA.Simplicial.arbitraryApexConeFill_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem arbitraryApexConeFill_zero (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] (apex : V) (n : ℕ) :
    arbitraryApexConeFill K R apex n (0 : Chain K R n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [arbitraryApexConeFill]

name: TDA.Simplicial.intSign_smul
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul R ((-1 : ℤ) ^ i) c]
  simp

name: TDA.Simplicial.arbitraryApexCone_basis_add
statement:
private theorem arbitraryApexCone_basis_add
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (R : Type v) [Ring R]
    (apex : V) (hapex : ({apex} : Finset V) ∈ K)
    (hinsert : ∀ s ∈ K, insert apex s ∈ K) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Face K (n + 1)) :
    boundary K R (n + 1)
        (arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert (n + 1)
          (Finsupp.single s (1 : R))) +
      arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert n
        (boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s (1 : R))) =
      Finsupp.single s (1 : R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x := s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2
  have himage : Finset.univ.image (apexConsTuple apex s) ∈ K :=
    apexConsTuple_mem apex hinsert s
  have hfirst : orientedTuple K R x = Finsupp.single s (1 : R) :=
    orientedTuple_face K R s
  have hdelEnum (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
      (deletedFace K n s i).1.orderEmbOfFin (deletedFace K n s i).2.2 =
        x ∘ i.succAbove := by
    funext j
    exact enumerationAfterDeletion K n s i (deletedFace K n s i).2.2 j
  have hdelTuple (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
      apexConsTuple apex (deletedFace K n s i) =
        (Fin.cons (n := n + 1) (α := fun _ : Fin (n + 2) => V)
          apex (x ∘ i.succAbove) : Fin (n + 2) → V) := by
    unfold apexConsTuple
    change Fin.cons (n := n + 1) apex
        (fun j : Fin (n + 1) =>
          (deletedFace K n s i).1.orderEmbOfFin (deletedFace K n s i).2.2 j) =
      (Fin.cons (n := n + 1) (α := fun _ : Fin (n + 2) => V)
        apex (x ∘ i.succAbove) : Fin (n + 2) → V)
    exact congrArg
      (fun y : Fin (n + 1) → V =>
        (Fin.cons (n := n + 1) (α := fun _ : Fin (n + 2) => V)
          apex y : Fin (n + 2) → V)) (hdelEnum i)
  have hmap :
      arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert n
        (boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s (1 : R))) =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : R) ^ (i : ℕ) •
        orientedTuple K R (Fin.cons apex (x ∘ i.succAbove)) := by
    rw [boundary_single, one_smul, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [arbitraryApexConeOperator_single, hdelTuple]
  have hsigns :
      (∑ i : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
        orientedTuple K R (Fin.cons apex (x ∘ i.succAbove))) =
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : R) ^ (i : ℕ) •
        orientedTuple K R (Fin.cons apex (x ∘ i.succAbove)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    exact intSign_smul R _ i
  have hboundary :
      boundary K R (n + 1)
        (orientedTuple K R (apexConsTuple apex s)) =
      Finsupp.single s (1 : R) -
        ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
          orientedTuple K R (Fin.cons apex (x ∘ i.succAbove)) := by
    change boundary K R (n + 1)
      (orientedTuple K R (Fin.cons apex x)) = _
    rw [boundary_orientedTuple K R (Fin.cons apex x) himage,
      tupleBoundarySum_cons, hfirst]
  simp only [arbitraryApexConeOperator_single, one_smul]
  rw [hboundary, hmap, hsigns]
  abel

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_arbitraryApexConeOperator_add
statement:
theorem boundary_arbitraryApexConeOperator_add
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (R : Type v) [Ring R] (apex : V)
    (hapex : ({apex} : Finset V) ∈ K)
    (hinsert : ∀ s ∈ K, insert apex s ∈ K) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Chain K R (n + 1)) :
    boundary K R (n + 1)
        (arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert (n + 1) c) +
      arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert n
        (boundary K R n c) = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Chain K R (n + 1) →ₗ[R] Chain K R (n + 1) :=
    (boundary K R (n + 1)).comp
        (arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert (n + 1)) +
      (arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert n).comp
        (boundary K R n)
  have hf : f = LinearMap.id := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro s a
    change boundary K R (n + 1)
        (arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert (n + 1)
          (Finsupp.single s a)) +
      arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert n
        (boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s a)) = Finsupp.single s a
    have hboundary_single : boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s a) =
        a • boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s (1 : R)) := by
      rw [boundary_single, boundary_single]
      simp
    rw [arbitraryApexConeOperator_single, map_smul, hboundary_single,
      map_smul, ← smul_add]
    have hunit :
        boundary K R (n + 1)
            (arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert (n + 1)
              (Finsupp.single s (1 : R))) +
          arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert n
            (boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s (1 : R))) =
          Finsupp.single s (1 : R) :=
      arbitraryApexCone_basis_add K R apex hapex hinsert n s
    have hunit' :
        boundary K R (n + 1)
            (orientedTuple K R (apexConsTuple apex s)) +
          arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert n
            (boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s (1 : R))) =
          Finsupp.single s (1 : R) := by
      simpa only [arbitraryApexConeOperator_single, one_smul] using hunit
    rw [hunit']
    simp
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun hf c

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_arbitraryApexConeFill_add
statement:
theorem boundary_arbitraryApexConeFill_add
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (R : Type v) [Ring R] (apex : V)
    (hapex : ({apex} : Finset V) ∈ K)
    (hinsert : ∀ s ∈ K, insert apex s ∈ K) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Chain K R (n + 1)) :
    boundary K R (n + 1) (arbitraryApexConeFill K R apex (n + 1) c) +
      arbitraryApexConeFill K R apex n (boundary K R n c) = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [arbitraryApexConeFill_eq_operator K R apex hapex hinsert (n + 1) c,
    arbitraryApexConeFill_eq_operator K R apex hapex hinsert n
      (boundary K R n c)]
  exact boundary_arbitraryApexConeOperator_add K R apex hapex hinsert n c

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_arbitraryApexConeFill_add_of_closed
statement:
theorem boundary_arbitraryApexConeFill_add_of_closed
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (R : Type v) [Ring R] (apex : V)
    (hclosed : ApexInsertionClosed K apex) (n : ℕ)
    (c : Chain K R (n + 1)) :
    boundary K R (n + 1) (arbitraryApexConeFill K R apex (n + 1) c) +
      arbitraryApexConeFill K R apex n (boundary K R n c) = c
proof:
:= by
  exact boundary_arbitraryApexConeFill_add K R apex hclosed.apex_mem
    hclosed.insert_mem n c

name: TDA.Simplicial.orientedTuple_apexFace
statement:
private theorem orientedTuple_apexFace (R : Type v) [Ring R] (apex : V)
    (hapex : ({apex} : Finset V) ∈ K) :
    orientedTuple K R (fun _ : Fin 1 => apex) =
      Finsupp.single (apexFace apex hapex) (1 : R)
proof:
:= by
  have hEnum : (apexFace apex hapex).1.orderEmbOfFin
      (apexFace apex hapex).2.2 = (fun _ : Fin 1 => apex) := by
    funext i
    have hi := Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem (apexFace apex hapex).1
      (apexFace apex hapex).2.2 i
    exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp hi
  rw [← hEnum]
  exact orientedTuple_face K R (apexFace apex hapex)

name: TDA.Simplicial.tupleBoundarySum_cons_zero
statement:
private theorem tupleBoundarySum_cons_zero (R : Type v) [Ring R] (apex : V)
    (hapex : ({apex} : Finset V) ∈ K) (x : Fin 1 → V) :
    tupleBoundarySum K R (Fin.cons apex x) =
      orientedTuple K R x -
        Finsupp.single (apexFace apex hapex) (1 : R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tupleBoundarySum_cons]
  have hsum :
      (∑ i : Fin 1, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
        orientedTuple K R (Fin.cons apex (x ∘ i.succAbove))) =
      Finsupp.single (apexFace apex hapex) (1 : R) := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    have htuple : Fin.cons apex (x ∘ (0 : Fin 1).succAbove) =
        (fun _ : Fin 1 => apex) := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      simp
    rw [htuple]
    simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_smul, Fin.sum_univ_zero, add_zero]
    exact orientedTuple_apexFace R apex hapex
  rw [hsum]

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_apexCone_basis_zero
statement:
private theorem boundary_apexCone_basis_zero
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (R : Type v) [Ring R]
    (apex : V) (hapex : ({apex} : Finset V) ∈ K)
    (hinsert : ∀ s ∈ K, insert apex s ∈ K)
    (s : Face K 0) (a : R) :
    boundary K R 0
        (arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert 0
          (Finsupp.single s a)) =
      Finsupp.single s a - Finsupp.single (apexFace apex hapex) a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x := s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2
  have himage : Finset.univ.image (apexConsTuple apex s) ∈ K :=
    apexConsTuple_mem apex hinsert s
  have hformula :
      boundary K R 0 (orientedTuple K R (apexConsTuple apex s)) =
        Finsupp.single s (1 : R) -
          Finsupp.single (apexFace apex hapex) (1 : R) := by
    change boundary K R 0 (orientedTuple K R (Fin.cons apex x)) = _
    rw [boundary_orientedTuple K R (Fin.cons apex x) himage,
      tupleBoundarySum_cons_zero R, orientedTuple_face K R s]
  rw [arbitraryApexConeOperator_single, map_smul, hformula]
  simp [smul_sub]

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_arbitraryApexConeOperator_zero
statement:
theorem boundary_arbitraryApexConeOperator_zero
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (R : Type v) [Ring R] (apex : V)
    (hapex : ({apex} : Finset V) ∈ K)
    (hinsert : ∀ s ∈ K, insert apex s ∈ K) (c : Chain K R 0) :
    boundary K R 0 (arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert 0 c) =
      c - Finsupp.single
        (⟨{apex}, hapex, by simp⟩ : Face K 0)
        (zeroChainCoefficientSum K R c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Chain K R 0 →ₗ[R] Chain K R 0 :=
    (boundary K R 0).comp
      (arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert 0)
  have hf : f = LinearMap.id -
      (zeroChainCoefficientSum K R).smulRight
        (Finsupp.single (apexFace apex hapex) (1 : R)) := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro s a
    change boundary K R 0
        (arbitraryApexConeOperator K R apex hapex hinsert 0
          (Finsupp.single s a)) =
      Finsupp.single s a -
        zeroChainCoefficientSum K R (Finsupp.single s a) •
          Finsupp.single (apexFace apex hapex) 1
    rw [boundary_apexCone_basis_zero, zeroChainCoefficientSum_single]
    simp [Finsupp.smul_single]
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun hf c
  simpa [f, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smulRight_apply, apexFace] using h

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_arbitraryApexConeFill_zero
statement:
theorem boundary_arbitraryApexConeFill_zero
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (R : Type v) [Ring R] (apex : V)
    (hapex : ({apex} : Finset V) ∈ K)
    (hinsert : ∀ s ∈ K, insert apex s ∈ K) (c : Chain K R 0) :
    boundary K R 0 (arbitraryApexConeFill K R apex 0 c) =
      c - Finsupp.single
        (⟨{apex}, hapex, by simp⟩ : Face K 0)
        (zeroChainCoefficientSum K R c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [arbitraryApexConeFill_eq_operator K R apex hapex hinsert 0 c]
  exact boundary_arbitraryApexConeOperator_zero K R apex hapex hinsert c

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_arbitraryApexConeFill_zero_of_closed
statement:
theorem boundary_arbitraryApexConeFill_zero_of_closed
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (R : Type v) [Ring R] (apex : V)
    (hclosed : ApexInsertionClosed K apex) (c : Chain K R 0) :
    boundary K R 0 (arbitraryApexConeFill K R apex 0 c) =
      c - Finsupp.single
        (⟨{apex}, hclosed.apex_mem, by simp⟩ : Face K 0)
        (zeroChainCoefficientSum K R c)
proof:
:= by
  exact boundary_arbitraryApexConeFill_zero K R apex hclosed.apex_mem
    hclosed.insert_mem c

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.K_le_L
statement: private theorem K_le_L : K ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  change s.Nonempty ∧ s ⊆ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 4)) at hs
  change s.Nonempty ∧ s ⊆ ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 4))

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.K_lt_L
statement: private theorem K_lt_L : K < L
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne K_le_L
  intro h
  have hmem : ({(2 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)) ∈ K := by
    rw [h]
    change ({(2 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)).Nonempty ∧
      ({(2 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)) ⊆ ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 4))
    simp
  change ({(2 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)).Nonempty ∧
    ({(2 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)) ⊆ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 4)) at hmem
  exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 4) ∉ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 4)))
    (hmem.2 (by simp))

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.L_lt_M
statement: private theorem L_lt_M : L < M
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne L_le_M
  intro h
  have hmem : ({(3 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)) ∈ L := by
    rw [h]
    change ({(3 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)).Nonempty
    simp
  change ({(3 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)).Nonempty ∧
    ({(3 : Fin 4)} : Finset (Fin 4)) ⊆ ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 4)) at hmem
  exact (by decide : (3 : Fin 4) ∉ ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 4)))
    (hmem.2 (by simp))

        (boundary K ℤ 0 (Finsupp.single edgeK01 1))

  simpa using congrArg

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.triangleL012_boundary
statement:
private theorem triangleL012_boundary :
    boundary L ℤ 1 (Finsupp.single triangleL012 1) =
      Finsupp.single edgeL12 1 - Finsupp.single edgeL02 1 +
        Finsupp.single edgeL01 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundary_single]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, deleted_triangleL012_zero]
  have h1 : deletedFace L 1 triangleL012 (Fin.succ 0) = edgeL02 :=
    deleted_triangleL012_one
  have h2 : deletedFace L 1 triangleL012 (Fin.succ (Fin.succ 0)) = edgeL01 :=
    deleted_triangleL012_two
  rw [h1, h2]
  norm_num
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc]

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.triangleM012_orderEmb

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.deleted_triangleM012_zero

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.deleted_triangleM012_one

private theorem deleted_triangleM012_one :

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.triangle_inclusion_chain_square
proof:

    (fun f => f (Finsupp.single triangleL012 1)) (boundary_chainIncl (R := ℤ) L_le_M 1)

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.included_triangleL012_boundary
statement:
private theorem included_triangleL012_boundary :
    boundary M ℤ 1 (chainIncl ℤ L_le_M 2 (Finsupp.single triangleL012 1)) =
      Finsupp.single edgeM12 1 - Finsupp.single edgeM02 1 +
        Finsupp.single edgeM01 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := triangle_inclusion_chain_square
  rw [triangleL012_boundary] at h
  simpa only [map_sub, map_add, chainIncl_single, faceIncl_edgeL12,
    faceIncl_edgeL02, faceIncl_edgeL01] using h

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.triangleM012_boundary
statement:
private theorem triangleM012_boundary :
    boundary M ℤ 1 (Finsupp.single triangleM012 1) =
      Finsupp.single edgeM12 1 - Finsupp.single edgeM02 1 +
        Finsupp.single edgeM01 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundary_single]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, deleted_triangleM012_zero]
  have h1 : deletedFace M 1 triangleM012 (Fin.succ 0) = edgeM02 :=
    deleted_triangleM012_one
  have h2 : deletedFace M 1 triangleM012 (Fin.succ (Fin.succ 0)) = edgeM01 :=
    deleted_triangleM012_two
  rw [h1, h2]
  norm_num
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_assoc]

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.included_triangleL012_agrees_with_target_boundary
proof:
:= by
  rw [included_triangleL012_boundary, triangleM012_boundary]

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.two_step_chainmap_edge
statement:
private theorem two_step_chainmap_edge :
    ((simplicialChainIncl ℤ (K_le_L.trans L_le_M)).f 1)
        (Finsupp.single edgeK01 1) =
      ((simplicialChainIncl ℤ K_le_L ≫ simplicialChainIncl ℤ L_le_M).f 1)
        (Finsupp.single edgeK01 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f.f 1)
    (simplicialChainIncl_comp (R := ℤ) K_le_L L_le_M)
  simpa [HomologicalComplex.comp_f, simplicialChainIncl_f, chainIncl_single] using
    congrArg (fun f => f (Finsupp.single edgeK01 1)) h

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.bottom_chains_vanish

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.bottom_map_on_zero

:= by

  exact map_zero _

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.singleton_le_K
statement:
private theorem singleton_le_K :
    Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 4) ≤ K
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  change s = ({0} : Finset (Fin 4)) at hs
  subst s
  change ({0} : Finset (Fin 4)).Nonempty ∧
    ({0} : Finset (Fin 4)) ⊆ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 4))
  simp

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.singleton_vertex_inclusion

private theorem singleton_vertex_inclusion :

      (Finsupp.single (singletonVertex (0 : Fin 4)) 1) =

  singletonHigherChain_eq_zero (0 : Fin 4) ℤ n c

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.singleton_inclusion_component_zero
proof:
:=

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.singleton_inclusion_outgoing_zero

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.matrix_boundary_naturality
statement:
private theorem matrix_boundary_naturality :
    (boundary L (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) 0).comp
        (chainIncl (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) K_le_L 1) =
      (chainIncl (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) K_le_L 0).comp
        (boundary K (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) 0)
proof:

  boundary_chainIncl (R := Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) K_le_L 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.InclusionExamples.matrix_chainIncl_single

:=
  chainIncl_single (R := Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) K_le_L 1 edgeK01 a

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.inclusion
statement: theorem inclusion : K ≤ L
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  exact (A.face_iff s).2 (Or.inl hs)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.simplex_mem
statement: theorem simplex_mem : A.simplex ∈ L
proof:
:=
  (A.face_iff A.simplex).2 (Or.inr rfl)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.faceIncl_injective
statement:
theorem faceIncl_injective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (faceIncl A.inclusion n)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun x : Face L n => x.1) h)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.newFace_not_range
statement: theorem newFace_not_range : A.newFace ∉ Set.range (faceIncl A.inclusion q)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
  have : s.1 = A.simplex := congrArg Subtype.val hs
  exact A.not_mem (this ▸ s.2.1)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.old_of_ne
statement: theorem old_of_ne {n : ℕ} (s : Face L n) (hs : s.1 ≠ A.simplex) : s.1 ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  rcases (A.face_iff s.1).1 s.2.1 with hk | he
  · exact hk
  · exact (hs he).elim

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.old_of_degree_ne
statement: theorem old_of_degree_ne {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ q) (s : Face L n) : s.1 ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  apply A.old_of_ne s
  intro he
  have hc : n + 1 = q + 1 := by rw [← s.2.2, he, A.card_simplex]
  exact hn (Nat.add_right_cancel hc)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.old_face_of_degree_ne
statement:
theorem old_face_of_degree_ne {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ q) (s : Face L n) :
    ∃ t : Face K n, faceIncl A.inclusion n t = s
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨⟨s.1, A.old_of_degree_ne hn s, s.2.2⟩, Subtype.ext rfl⟩

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.chainIncl_injective
statement:
theorem chainIncl_injective (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (chainIncl k A.inclusion n)
proof:
:= by
  change Function.Injective (Finsupp.mapDomain (faceIncl A.inclusion n))
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_injective (A.faceIncl_injective n)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.chainIncl_surjective_of_ne
statement:
theorem chainIncl_surjective_of_ne {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ q) :
    Function.Surjective (chainIncl k A.inclusion n)
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  change ∃ a, Finsupp.mapDomain (faceIncl A.inclusion n) a = c
  exact (Finsupp.mem_range_mapDomain_iff (faceIncl A.inclusion n)
    (A.faceIncl_injective n) c).2
    (fun s hs => (hs (A.old_face_of_degree_ne hn s)).elim)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.chainIncl_new_coeff
statement:
theorem chainIncl_new_coeff (a : Chain K k q) :
    (chainIncl k A.inclusion q a) A.newFace = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (Finsupp.mapDomain (faceIncl A.inclusion q) a) A.newFace = 0
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_of_notMem_range a A.newFace (by
    intro h
    rcases h with ⟨s, hs⟩
    have he : s.1 = A.simplex := congrArg (fun x : Face L q => x.1) hs
    exact A.not_mem (he ▸ s.2.1))

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.chain_decomposition
statement:
theorem chain_decomposition (c : Chain L k q) :
    ∃ a : Chain K k q, c = chainIncl k A.inclusion q a + Finsupp.single A.newFace (c A.newFace)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrange : c - Finsupp.single A.newFace (c A.newFace) ∈
      Set.range (Finsupp.mapDomain (faceIncl A.inclusion q)) := by
    apply (Finsupp.mem_range_mapDomain_iff (faceIncl A.inclusion q)
      (A.faceIncl_injective q) _).2
    intro s hs
    by_cases he : s = A.newFace
    · subst s
      simp
    · have hold : s.1 ∈ K := A.old_of_ne s (by
        intro hval
        exact he (Subtype.ext hval))
      exact (hs ⟨⟨s.1, hold, s.2.2⟩, Subtype.ext rfl⟩).elim
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hrange
  change chainIncl k A.inclusion q a = _ at ha
  exact ⟨a, by rw [ha]; abel⟩

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.chain_decomposition_unique
statement:
theorem chain_decomposition_unique (c : Chain L k q) :
    ∃! a : Chain K k q,
      c = chainIncl k A.inclusion q a + Finsupp.single A.newFace (c A.newFace)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.chain_decomposition k c
  refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
  intro b hb
  apply A.chainIncl_injective k q
  exact (add_right_cancel (ha.symm.trans hb)).symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.chainIncl_range_iff_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem chainIncl_range_iff_coeff_zero (c : Chain L k q) :
    c ∈ LinearMap.range (chainIncl k A.inclusion q) ↔ c A.newFace = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact A.chainIncl_new_coeff k a
  · intro hc
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.chain_decomposition k c
    refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
    simpa [hc] using ha.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.cycleIncl_surjective_of_ne
statement:
theorem cycleIncl_surjective_of_ne {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ q) :
    Function.Surjective (simplicialCycleIncl k A.inclusion n)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.chainIncl_surjective_of_ne k hn (z : Chain L k n)
  have hcycle : a ∈ simplicialCycles K k n := by
    cases n with
    | zero => rw [simplicialCycles_zero]; trivial
    | succ m =>
      rw [simplicialCycles_succ]
      apply A.chainIncl_injective k m
      have hnat := congrArg (fun f : Chain K k (m + 1) →ₗ[k] Chain L k m => f a)
        (boundary_chainIncl k A.inclusion m)
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hnat
      rw [ha] at hnat
      have hz : boundary L k m (z : Chain L k (m + 1)) = 0 := by
        have hm : (z : Chain L k (m + 1)) ∈ LinearMap.ker (boundary L k m) := by
          simpa only [simplicialCycles_succ] using z.2
        exact hm
      simpa [hz] using hnat.symm
  refine ⟨⟨a, hcycle⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa only [simplicialCycleIncl_coe] using ha

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.old_cycle_of_included_chain
statement:
theorem old_cycle_of_included_chain (n : ℕ) (a : Chain K k n)
    (z : simplicialCycles L k n)
    (ha : chainIncl k A.inclusion n a = (z : Chain L k n)) :
    a ∈ simplicialCycles K k n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => rw [simplicialCycles_zero]; trivial
  | succ m =>
    rw [simplicialCycles_succ]
    apply A.chainIncl_injective k m
    have hnat := congrArg (fun f : Chain K k (m + 1) →ₗ[k] Chain L k m => f a)
      (boundary_chainIncl k A.inclusion m)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hnat
    rw [ha] at hnat
    have hz : boundary L k m (z : Chain L k (m + 1)) = 0 := by
      have hm : (z : Chain L k (m + 1)) ∈ LinearMap.ker (boundary L k m) := by
        simpa only [simplicialCycles_succ] using z.2
      exact hm
    simpa [hz] using hnat.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.boundary_new_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem boundary_new_coeff_zero (d : Chain L k (q + 1)) :
    (boundary L k q d) A.newFace = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.chainIncl_surjective_of_ne k (by omega : q + 1 ≠ q) d
  have hn := congrArg (fun f : Chain K k (q + 1) →ₗ[k] Chain L k q => f a)
    (boundary_chainIncl k A.inclusion q)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hn
  calc
    (boundary L k q d) A.newFace =
        (chainIncl k A.inclusion q (boundary K k q a)) A.newFace := by
      rw [← ha, hn]
    _ = 0 := A.chainIncl_new_coeff k _

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.boundaries_new_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem boundaries_new_coeff_zero :
    simplicialBoundaries L k q ≤ LinearMap.ker (A.newCoeffCycles k)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff k L q z).mp hz
  change (show Chain L k q from z.1) A.newFace = 0
  rw [← hd]
  exact A.boundary_new_coeff_zero k d

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.cycleIncl_surjective_of_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem cycleIncl_surjective_of_coeff_zero
    (hz : ∀ z : simplicialCycles L k q, (z : Chain L k q) A.newFace = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (simplicialCycleIncl k A.inclusion q)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (A.chainIncl_range_iff_coeff_zero k _).2 (hz z)
  have hca := A.old_cycle_of_included_chain k q a z ha
  refine ⟨⟨a, hca⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  simpa only [simplicialCycleIncl_coe] using ha

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.quotientIncl_surjective_of_coeff_zero
statement:
theorem quotientIncl_surjective_of_coeff_zero
    (hz : ∀ z : simplicialCycles L k q, (z : Chain L k q) A.newFace = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion q)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ z =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.cycleIncl_surjective_of_coeff_zero k hz z
    refine ⟨Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles K k q)
      (simplicialBoundaries K k q) a, ?_⟩
    change simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion q
      (Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles K k q)
        (simplicialBoundaries K k q) a) =
      Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles L k q)
        (simplicialBoundaries L k q) z
    rw [simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ, ha]

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.new_cycle_class_not_range
statement:
theorem new_cycle_class_not_range (w : simplicialCycles L k q)
    (hw : (w : Chain L k q) A.newFace = 1) :
    (simplicialBoundaries L k q).mkQ w ∉
      LinearMap.range (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion q)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ a =>
    change simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion q
      (Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles K k q)
        (simplicialBoundaries K k q) a) =
        Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles L k q)
          (simplicialBoundaries L k q) w at hx
    rw [simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ] at hx
    have hb : simplicialCycleIncl k A.inclusion q a - w ∈
        simplicialBoundaries L k q := by
      simpa only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.eq] using hx
    have hc := (LinearMap.mem_ker).mp (A.boundaries_new_coeff_zero k hb)
    change (chainIncl k A.inclusion q (a : Chain K k q) -
      (w : Chain L k q)) A.newFace = 0 at hc
    simp only [Finsupp.sub_apply] at hc
    simp only [A.chainIncl_new_coeff, hw, zero_sub] at hc
    exact (neg_ne_zero.mpr (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0)) hc

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.quotient_range_sup_birth_span_eq_top
statement:
theorem quotient_range_sup_birth_span_eq_top (w : simplicialCycles L k q)
    (hw : (w : Chain L k q) A.newFace = 1) :
    LinearMap.range (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion q) ⊔
      k ∙ (simplicialBoundaries L k q).mkQ w = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply (Submodule.eq_top_iff').2
  intro x
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ z =>
    let c := (z : Chain L k q) A.newFace
    have hc : ((z - c • w : simplicialCycles L k q) : Chain L k q)
        A.newFace = 0 := by
      change ((z : Chain L k q) - c • (w : Chain L k q)) A.newFace = 0
      simp [Finsupp.sub_apply, c, hw]
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (A.chainIncl_range_iff_coeff_zero k _).2 hc
    let old : simplicialCycles K k q :=
      ⟨a, A.old_cycle_of_included_chain k q a (z - c • w) ha⟩
    have he : simplicialCycleIncl k A.inclusion q old + c • w = z := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      change chainIncl k A.inclusion q a + c • (w : Chain L k q) =
        (z : Chain L k q)
      rw [ha]
      change ((z : Chain L k q) - c • (w : Chain L k q)) +
        c • (w : Chain L k q) = (z : Chain L k q)
      abel
    have hq : simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion q
        (Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles K k q)
          (simplicialBoundaries K k q) old) +
        c • Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles L k q)
          (simplicialBoundaries L k q) w =
          Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles L k q)
            (simplicialBoundaries L k q) z := by
      rw [simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ]
      change (simplicialBoundaries L k q).mkQ
          (simplicialCycleIncl k A.inclusion q old) +
          c • (simplicialBoundaries L k q).mkQ w =
          (simplicialBoundaries L k q).mkQ z
      rw [← map_smul, ← map_add, he]
    apply Submodule.mem_sup.mpr
    refine ⟨simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion q
      (Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles K k q)
        (simplicialBoundaries K k q) old), ⟨_, rfl⟩,
      c • Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles L k q)
        (simplicialBoundaries L k q) w, ?_, hq⟩
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.quotientIncl_birth_cokernel_finrank
statement:
theorem quotientIncl_birth_cokernel_finrank [Finite (TotalFace L)]
    (w : simplicialCycles L k q)
    (hw : (w : Chain L k q) A.newFace = 1) :
    Module.finrank k
      ((simplicialCycles L k q ⧸ simplicialBoundaries L k q) ⧸
        LinearMap.range (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion q)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite (Face L q) := faceFiniteOfTotalFinite L q
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (Chain L k q) := finiteDimensional_finsupp
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (simplicialCycles L k q) := inferInstance
  letI : FiniteDimensional k
      (simplicialCycles L k q ⧸ simplicialBoundaries L k q) := inferInstance
  have htop := A.quotient_range_sup_birth_span_eq_top k w hw
  have hnot := A.new_cycle_class_not_range k w hw
  have hd := LinearEquiv.finrank_quotient_sup_span_singleton hnot
  rw [htop] at hd
  have hzero : Module.finrank k
      ((simplicialCycles L k q ⧸ simplicialBoundaries L k q) ⧸
        (⊤ : Submodule k (simplicialCycles L k q ⧸ simplicialBoundaries L k q))) =
        0 := (Module.finrank_zero_iff).2 inferInstance
  rw [hzero, zero_add] at hd
  exact hd.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.boundary_reflect_of_ne
statement:
theorem boundary_reflect_of_ne {n : ℕ} (hn : n + 1 ≠ q)
    (z : simplicialCycles K k n)
    (hz : simplicialCycleIncl k A.inclusion n z ∈ simplicialBoundaries L k n) :
    z ∈ simplicialBoundaries K k n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff k L n _).mp hz
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.chainIncl_surjective_of_ne k hn d
  apply (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff k K n z).2
  refine ⟨a, A.chainIncl_injective k n ?_⟩
  have hnat := congrArg (fun f : Chain K k (n + 1) →ₗ[k] Chain L k n => f a)
    (boundary_chainIncl k A.inclusion n)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hnat
  rw [ha] at hnat
  rw [hd] at hnat
  simpa only [simplicialCycleIncl_coe] using hnat.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.quotientIncl_injective_of_ne
statement:
theorem quotientIncl_injective_of_ne {n : ℕ} (hn : n + 1 ≠ q) :
    Function.Injective (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion n)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  rw [Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro x hx
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ z =>
    change (simplicialBoundaries K k n).mkQ z = 0
    have hx' := (LinearMap.mem_ker).mp hx
    change simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion n
      (Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles K k n)
        (simplicialBoundaries K k n) z) = 0 at hx'
    rw [simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ] at hx'
    rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply] at hx'
    simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hx'
    simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact A.boundary_reflect_of_ne k hn z hx'

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.quotientIncl_surjective_of_ne
statement:
theorem quotientIncl_surjective_of_ne {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ q) :
    Function.Surjective (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ z =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.cycleIncl_surjective_of_ne k hn z
    refine ⟨Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles K k n)
      (simplicialBoundaries K k n) a, ?_⟩
    change simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion n
      (Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles K k n)
        (simplicialBoundaries K k n) a) =
      Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles L k n)
        (simplicialBoundaries L k n) z
    rw [simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ, ha]

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.homologyIncl_bijective_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  let eK := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k (simplicialChainComplex K k) n).toLinearEquiv
  let eL := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k (simplicialChainComplex L k) n).toLinearEquiv
  have hnat := simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality k A.inclusion n
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    apply eK.injective
    apply A.quotientIncl_injective_of_ne k hn'
    have hx := congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) hnat
    have hy := congrArg (fun f => f.hom y) hnat
    change eL ((simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion n).hom x) =
      (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion n) (eK x) at hx
    change eL ((simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion n).hom y) =
      (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion n) (eK y) at hy
    rw [hxy] at hx
    exact hx.symm.trans hy
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := A.quotientIncl_surjective_of_ne k hn (eL y)
    refine ⟨eK.symm z, ?_⟩
    have hx := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (eK.symm z)) hnat
    change eL ((simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion n).hom (eK.symm z)) =
      (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion n) (eK (eK.symm z)) at hx
    apply eL.injective
    exact hx.trans ((congrArg (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion n)
      (eK.apply_symm_apply z)).trans hz)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.homologyIncl_injective_of_succ_ne
statement:
theorem homologyIncl_injective_of_succ_ne {n : ℕ} (hn : n + 1 ≠ q) :
    Function.Injective (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion n).hom
proof:
:= by
  let eK := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k (simplicialChainComplex K k) n).toLinearEquiv
  let eL := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k (simplicialChainComplex L k) n).toLinearEquiv
  have hnat := simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality k A.inclusion n
  intro x y hxy
  apply eK.injective
  apply A.quotientIncl_injective_of_ne k hn
  have hx := congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) hnat
  have hy := congrArg (fun f => f.hom y) hnat
  change eL ((simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion n).hom x) =
    (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion n) (eK x) at hx
  change eL ((simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion n).hom y) =
    (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion n) (eK y) at hy
  rw [hxy] at hx
  exact hx.symm.trans hy

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.homologyIncl_surjective_of_quotient
proof:
:= by
  let eK := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k (simplicialChainComplex K k) n).toLinearEquiv
  let eL := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k (simplicialChainComplex L k) n).toLinearEquiv
  have hnat := simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality k A.inclusion n
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hq (eL y)
  refine ⟨eK.symm z, ?_⟩
  have hx := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (eK.symm z)) hnat
  change eL ((simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion n).hom (eK.symm z)) =
    (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion n) (eK (eK.symm z)) at hx
  apply eL.injective
  exact hx.trans ((congrArg (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion n)
    (eK.apply_symm_apply z)).trans hz)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.homologyIncl_birth_cokernel_finrank
statement:
theorem homologyIncl_birth_cokernel_finrank [Finite (TotalFace L)]
    (w : simplicialCycles L k q)
    (hw : (w : Chain L k q) A.newFace = 1) :
    Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology L k q ⧸
      LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion q).hom) = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = Module.finrank k
        ((simplicialCycles L k q ⧸ simplicialBoundaries L k q) ⧸
          LinearMap.range (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion q)) :=
      (A.homologyCokernelEquiv k q).finrank_eq
    _ = 1 := A.quotientIncl_birth_cokernel_finrank k w hw

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.homologyIncl_birth_generator
statement:
theorem homologyIncl_birth_generator [Finite (TotalFace L)]
    (w : simplicialCycles L k q)
    (hw : (w : Chain L k q) A.newFace = 1) :
    k ∙ A.birthCokernelClass k w = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let eK := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k (simplicialChainComplex K k) q).toLinearEquiv
  let eL := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k (simplicialChainComplex L k) q).toLinearEquiv
  let u := birthHomologyClass (L := L) k w
  have hnot := A.new_cycle_class_not_range k w hw
  have hne : (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion q).hom).mkQ u ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hu : u ∈ LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion q).hom := by
      simpa only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] using hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hu
    apply hnot
    refine ⟨eK x, ?_⟩
    have hnat := simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality k A.inclusion q
    have hc := congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) hnat
    change eL ((simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion q).hom x) =
      simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion q (eK x) at hc
    have hu' : eL u = (simplicialBoundaries L k q).mkQ w := by
      change eL (eL.symm (birthQuotientClass (L := L) k w)) = _
      exact eL.apply_symm_apply _
    exact hc.symm.trans ((congrArg eL hx).trans hu')
  exact (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero _ hne).mp
    (A.homologyIncl_birth_cokernel_finrank k w hw)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.oldDeletedFace_incl
statement:
theorem oldDeletedFace_incl (i : Fin (p + 2)) :
    faceIncl A.inclusion p (A.oldDeletedFace i) = deletedFace L p A.newFace i
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.attachingBoundary_incl
statement:
theorem attachingBoundary_incl :
    chainIncl k A.inclusion p (A.attachingBoundary k) =
      boundary L k p (Finsupp.single A.newFace 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [attachingBoundary, map_sum, chainIncl_single, boundary_single, one_smul]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by rw [A.oldDeletedFace_incl])

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.attachingBoundary_ne_zero
statement: theorem attachingBoundary_ne_zero : A.attachingBoundary k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (deletedFace L p A.newFace) := by
    intro i j hij
    by_contra hne
    let vi := A.newFace.1.orderEmbOfFin A.newFace.2.2 i
    let vj := A.newFace.1.orderEmbOfFin A.newFace.2.2 j
    have hvne : vi ≠ vj := fun h => hne
      ((A.newFace.1.orderEmbOfFin A.newFace.2.2).injective h)
    have hmem : vi ∈ (deletedFace L p A.newFace j).1 := by
      change vi ∈ A.newFace.1.erase vj
      exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr
        ⟨hvne, Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem A.newFace.1 A.newFace.2.2 i⟩
    rw [← hij] at hmem
    have : vi ∈ A.newFace.1.erase vi := hmem
    simpa using this
  have hcoeff :
      (boundary L k p (Finsupp.single A.newFace 1))
        (deletedFace L p A.newFace 0) = 1 := by
    rw [boundary_single]
    change (Finsupp.lapply (deletedFace L p A.newFace 0) : Chain L k p →ₗ[k] k)
      ((1 : k) • ∑ i : Fin (p + 2),
        Finsupp.single (deletedFace L p A.newFace i) ((-1 : k) ^ (i : ℕ))) = 1
    rw [one_smul, map_sum]
    simp only [Finsupp.lapply_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, hinj.eq_iff]
    simp
  intro hz
  rw [← A.attachingBoundary_incl, hz, map_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply] at hcoeff
  exact one_ne_zero hcoeff.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.boundary_of_decomposition
statement:
theorem boundary_of_decomposition (c : Chain L k (p + 1))
    (a : Chain K k (p + 1))
    (hc : c = chainIncl k A.inclusion (p + 1) a +
      Finsupp.single A.newFace (c A.newFace)) :
    boundary L k p c = chainIncl k A.inclusion p
      (boundary K k p a + (c A.newFace) • A.attachingBoundary k)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Finsupp.single A.newFace (c A.newFace) =
      (c A.newFace) • (Finsupp.single A.newFace (1 : k)) := by simp
  have hn := congrArg (fun f : Chain K k (p + 1) →ₗ[k] Chain L k p => f a)
    (boundary_chainIncl k A.inclusion p)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hn
  conv_lhs => rw [hc]
  rw [map_add, hs, map_smul, ← A.attachingBoundary_incl, hn]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul]

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.boundary_of_chain
statement:
theorem boundary_of_chain (c : Chain L k (p + 1)) :
    ∃ a : Chain K k (p + 1), boundary L k p c =
      chainIncl k A.inclusion p (boundary K k p a +
        (c A.newFace) • A.attachingBoundary k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.chain_decomposition k c
  exact ⟨a, A.boundary_of_decomposition k c a ha⟩

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.attachingQuotientClass_maps_zero
statement:
theorem attachingQuotientClass_maps_zero :
    simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion p (A.attachingQuotientClass k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion p
    (Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles K k p)
      (simplicialBoundaries K k p) (A.attachingCycle k)) = 0
  rw [simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ]
  simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  apply (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff k L p _).2
  refine ⟨Finsupp.single A.newFace 1, ?_⟩
  simpa only [simplicialCycleIncl_coe, attachingCycle] using
    (A.attachingBoundary_incl k).symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.quotientIncl_ker_eq_span_attachingClass
statement:
theorem quotientIncl_ker_eq_span_attachingClass :
    LinearMap.ker (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion p) =
      k ∙ A.attachingQuotientClass k
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with
    | _ z =>
      have hx' := (LinearMap.mem_ker).mp hx
      change simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion p
        (Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles K k p)
          (simplicialBoundaries K k p) z) = 0 at hx'
      rw [simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ, Submodule.mkQ_apply] at hx'
      simp only [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at hx'
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff k L p _).mp hx'
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.boundary_of_chain k d
      have he : (z : Chain K k p) = boundary K k p a +
          (d A.newFace) • A.attachingBoundary k := by
        apply A.chainIncl_injective k p
        calc
          chainIncl k A.inclusion p (z : Chain K k p) =
              boundary L k p d := by simpa only [simplicialCycleIncl_coe] using hd.symm
          _ = _ := ha
      have hb : z - (d A.newFace) • A.attachingCycle k ∈
          simplicialBoundaries K k p := by
        apply (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff k K p _).2
        refine ⟨a, ?_⟩
        change boundary K k p a = (z : Chain K k p) -
          (d A.newFace) • A.attachingBoundary k
        rw [he]
        abel
      have hq' : (Quotient.mk'' z : simplicialCycles K k p ⧸
          simplicialBoundaries K k p) =
          (d A.newFace) • A.attachingQuotientClass k := by
        calc
          _ = Quotient.mk'' ((d A.newFace) • A.attachingCycle k) :=
            (Submodule.Quotient.eq (simplicialBoundaries K k p)).2 hb
          _ = _ := by
            change (simplicialBoundaries K k p).mkQ
              ((d A.newFace) • A.attachingCycle k) =
                (d A.newFace) • (simplicialBoundaries K k p).mkQ
                  (A.attachingCycle k)
            rfl
      rw [hq']
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _)
  · exact Submodule.span_le.mpr (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr
      (A.attachingQuotientClass_maps_zero k))

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.attachingHomologyClass_equiv
statement:
theorem attachingHomologyClass_equiv :
    (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k
      (simplicialChainComplex K k) p).toLinearEquiv (A.attachingHomologyClass k) =
      A.attachingQuotientClass k
proof:
:= by
  exact LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.homologyIncl_ker_eq_span_attachingClass
statement:
theorem homologyIncl_ker_eq_span_attachingClass :
    LinearMap.ker (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion p).hom =
      k ∙ A.attachingHomologyClass k
proof:
:= by
  let eK := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k (simplicialChainComplex K k) p).toLinearEquiv
  let eL := (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k (simplicialChainComplex L k) p).toLinearEquiv
  have hnat := simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality k A.inclusion p
  have hcomm (x : simplicialHomology K k p) :
      eL ((simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion p).hom x) =
        simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion p (eK x) := by
    exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) hnat
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hq : eK x ∈ LinearMap.ker (simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion p) := by
      change simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion p (eK x) = 0
      calc
        _ = eL ((simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion p).hom x) := (hcomm x).symm
        _ = eL 0 := congrArg eL ((LinearMap.mem_ker).mp hx)
        _ = 0 := eL.map_zero
    rw [A.quotientIncl_ker_eq_span_attachingClass k] at hq
    change (eK x : simplicialCycles K k p ⧸ simplicialBoundaries K k p) ∈
      k ∙ A.attachingQuotientClass k at hq
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_singleton).mp hq
    apply (Submodule.mem_span_singleton).2
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    apply eK.injective
    calc
      eK (c • A.attachingHomologyClass k) =
          c • eK (A.attachingHomologyClass k) := eK.map_smul c _
      _ = c • A.attachingQuotientClass k :=
        congrArg (c • ·) (A.attachingHomologyClass_equiv k)
      _ = eK x := hc
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (Submodule.mem_span_singleton).mp hx
    have hq : eK x ∈ k ∙ A.attachingQuotientClass k := by
      apply (Submodule.mem_span_singleton).2
      refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
      calc
        c • A.attachingQuotientClass k =
            c • eK (A.attachingHomologyClass k) :=
          congrArg (c • ·) (A.attachingHomologyClass_equiv k).symm
        _ = eK (c • A.attachingHomologyClass k) := (eK.map_smul c _).symm
        _ = eK x := congrArg eK hc
    rw [← A.quotientIncl_ker_eq_span_attachingClass k] at hq
    change (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion p).hom x = 0
    apply eL.injective
    calc
      eL ((simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion p).hom x) =
          simplicialQuotientIncl k A.inclusion p (eK x) := hcomm x
      _ = 0 := (LinearMap.mem_ker).mp hq
      _ = eL 0 := eL.map_zero.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.homologyIncl_death_kernel_finrank
statement:
theorem homologyIncl_death_kernel_finrank
    (hne : A.attachingQuotientClass k ≠ 0) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
      (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion p).hom) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [A.homologyIncl_ker_eq_span_attachingClass k]
  apply finrank_span_singleton
  intro hz
  apply hne
  have heq := A.attachingHomologyClass_equiv k
  rw [hz] at heq
  exact heq.symm.trans
    ((homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k
      (simplicialChainComplex K k) p).toLinearEquiv.map_zero)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.new_coeff_zero_of_attachingClass_ne_zero
statement:
theorem new_coeff_zero_of_attachingClass_ne_zero
    (hne : A.attachingQuotientClass k ≠ 0)
    (z : simplicialCycles L k (p + 1)) :
    (z : Chain L k (p + 1)) A.newFace = 0
proof:
:= by
  let c := (z : Chain L k (p + 1)) A.newFace
  by_contra hc
  have hc' : c ≠ 0 := hc
  have hnot : A.attachingCycle k ∉ simplicialBoundaries K k p := by
    intro hb
    apply hne
    change (simplicialBoundaries K k p).mkQ (A.attachingCycle k) = 0
    simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact hb
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := A.chain_decomposition k (z : Chain L k (p + 1))
  have hz : boundary L k p (z : Chain L k (p + 1)) = 0 := by
    have hm : (z : Chain L k (p + 1)) ∈ LinearMap.ker (boundary L k p) := by
      simpa only [simplicialCycles_succ] using z.2
    exact hm
  have he : boundary K k p a + c • A.attachingBoundary k = 0 := by
    apply A.chainIncl_injective k p
    have hd := A.boundary_of_decomposition k (z : Chain L k (p + 1)) a ha
    simpa only [map_zero] using hd.symm.trans hz
  have he' : boundary K k p a = (-c) • A.attachingBoundary k := by
    rw [neg_smul]
    exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left he
  apply hnot
  apply (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff k K p (A.attachingCycle k)).2
  refine ⟨(-c)⁻¹ • a, ?_⟩
  change boundary K k p ((-c)⁻¹ • a) = A.attachingBoundary k
  rw [map_smul, he', smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (neg_ne_zero.mpr hc'), one_smul]

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.homologyIncl_bijective_of_attachingClass_ne_zero
statement:
theorem homologyIncl_bijective_of_attachingClass_ne_zero
    (hne : A.attachingQuotientClass k ≠ 0) :
    Function.Bijective (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion (p + 1)).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨A.homologyIncl_injective_of_succ_ne k (by omega), ?_⟩
  apply A.homologyIncl_surjective_of_quotient k
  exact A.quotientIncl_surjective_of_coeff_zero k
    (A.new_coeff_zero_of_attachingClass_ne_zero k hne)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.attachingClass_zero_iff_boundary
statement:
theorem attachingClass_zero_iff_boundary :
    A.attachingQuotientClass k = 0 ↔
      A.attachingCycle k ∈ simplicialBoundaries K k p
proof:
:= by
  change (simplicialBoundaries K k p).mkQ (A.attachingCycle k) = 0 ↔ _
  simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.attachingClass_ne_zero_of_no_old_coface
statement:
theorem attachingClass_ne_zero_of_no_old_coface
    [IsEmpty (Face K (p + 1))] : A.attachingHomologyClass k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have heq := A.attachingHomologyClass_equiv k
  rw [hz] at heq
  have hqzero : A.attachingQuotientClass k = 0 := by
    exact heq.symm.trans
      ((homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k
        (simplicialChainComplex K k) p).toLinearEquiv.map_zero)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff k K p _).mp
    ((A.attachingClass_zero_iff_boundary k).mp hqzero)
  have ha0 : a = 0 := by
    ext s
    exact isEmptyElim s
  rw [ha0, map_zero] at ha
  exact A.attachingBoundary_ne_zero k ha.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.birth_cycle_of_attachingClass_zero
statement:
theorem birth_cycle_of_attachingClass_zero
    (hzero : A.attachingQuotientClass k = 0) :
    ∃ a : Chain K k (p + 1), boundary K k p a = A.attachingBoundary k ∧
      ∃ z : simplicialCycles L k (p + 1),
        (z : Chain L k (p + 1)) =
          Finsupp.single A.newFace 1 - chainIncl k A.inclusion (p + 1) a ∧
        (z : Chain L k (p + 1)) A.newFace = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff k K p _).mp
    ((A.attachingClass_zero_iff_boundary k).mp hzero)
  let c : Chain L k (p + 1) :=
    Finsupp.single A.newFace 1 - chainIncl k A.inclusion (p + 1) a
  have hc : c ∈ simplicialCycles L k (p + 1) := by
    rw [simplicialCycles_succ]
    have hnat := congrArg (fun f : Chain K k (p + 1) →ₗ[k] Chain L k p => f a)
      (boundary_chainIncl k A.inclusion p)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hnat
    change boundary L k p c = 0
    dsimp [c]
    rw [map_sub, ← A.attachingBoundary_incl, hnat, ha]
    change chainIncl k A.inclusion p (A.attachingBoundary k) -
      chainIncl k A.inclusion p (A.attachingBoundary k) = 0
    exact sub_self _
  refine ⟨a, ha, ⟨c, hc⟩, rfl, ?_⟩
  change c A.newFace = 1
  simp only [c, Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, A.chainIncl_new_coeff,
    sub_zero]

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.isolatedVertex_birth

theorem isolatedVertex_birth [Finite (TotalFace L)] :
    Function.Injective (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion 0).hom ∧
    Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology L k 0 ⧸
      LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion 0).hom) = 1 ∧
    ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r →
      Function.Bijective (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion r).hom
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨A.homologyIncl_injective_of_succ_ne k (by omega),
    A.homologyIncl_birth_cokernel_finrank k (A.isolatedVertexCycle k)
      (A.isolatedVertexCycle_coeff k), ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  exact A.homologyIncl_bijective_of_ne k (by omega) (by omega)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.positive_birth
statement:
theorem positive_birth [Finite (TotalFace L)]
    (hzero : A.attachingHomologyClass k = 0) :
    Function.Injective (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion (p + 1)).hom ∧
    Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology L k (p + 1) ⧸
      LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion (p + 1)).hom) = 1 ∧
    (∀ r : ℕ, r ≠ p + 1 →
      Function.Bijective (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion r).hom) ∧
    (∃ a : Chain K k (p + 1), boundary K k p a = A.attachingBoundary k ∧
      ∃ z : simplicialCycles L k (p + 1),
        (z : Chain L k (p + 1)) =
          Finsupp.single A.newFace 1 - chainIncl k A.inclusion (p + 1) a ∧
        (z : Chain L k (p + 1)) A.newFace = 1)
proof:
:= by
  have heq := A.attachingHomologyClass_equiv k
  rw [hzero] at heq
  have hqzero : A.attachingQuotientClass k = 0 := by
    exact heq.symm.trans
      ((homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k
        (simplicialChainComplex K k) p).toLinearEquiv.map_zero)
  obtain ⟨a, ha, z, hz, hc⟩ := A.birth_cycle_of_attachingClass_zero k hqzero
  refine ⟨A.homologyIncl_injective_of_succ_ne k (by omega),
    A.homologyIncl_birth_cokernel_finrank k z hc, ?_, ⟨a, ha, z, hz, hc⟩⟩
  intro r hr
  by_cases hp : r = p
  · subst r
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion p).hom :=
      A.homologyIncl_surjective_of_quotient k
        (A.quotientIncl_surjective_of_ne k (by omega))
    have hinj : Function.Injective (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion p).hom := by
      apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
      rw [A.homologyIncl_ker_eq_span_attachingClass k, hzero]
      simp
    exact ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩
  · exact A.homologyIncl_bijective_of_ne k hr (by omega)

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.positive_birth_generator
statement:
theorem positive_birth_generator [Finite (TotalFace L)]
    (hzero : A.attachingHomologyClass k = 0) :
    ∃ a : Chain K k (p + 1), boundary K k p a = A.attachingBoundary k ∧
      ∃ z : simplicialCycles L k (p + 1),
        (z : Chain L k (p + 1)) =
          Finsupp.single A.newFace 1 - chainIncl k A.inclusion (p + 1) a ∧
        k ∙ A.birthCokernelClass k z = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, h⟩ := A.positive_birth k hzero
  obtain ⟨a, ha, z, hz, hc⟩ := h
  exact ⟨a, ha, z, hz, A.homologyIncl_birth_generator k z hc⟩

name: TDA.Simplicial.SimplexAttachment.positive_death
statement:
theorem positive_death
    (hne : A.attachingHomologyClass k ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion p).hom ∧
    LinearMap.ker (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion p).hom =
      k ∙ A.attachingHomologyClass k ∧
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
      (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion p).hom) = 1 ∧
    ∀ r : ℕ, r ≠ p →
      Function.Bijective (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion r).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hqne : A.attachingQuotientClass k ≠ 0 := by
    intro hq
    apply hne
    apply (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k
      (simplicialChainComplex K k) p).toLinearEquiv.injective
    rw [A.attachingHomologyClass_equiv k, hq]
    exact ((homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} k
      (simplicialChainComplex K k) p).toLinearEquiv.map_zero).symm
  refine ⟨A.homologyIncl_surjective_of_quotient k
      (A.quotientIncl_surjective_of_ne k (by omega)),
    A.homologyIncl_ker_eq_span_attachingClass k,
    A.homologyIncl_death_kernel_finrank k hqne, ?_⟩
  intro r hr
  by_cases hq : r = p + 1
  · subst r
    exact A.homologyIncl_bijective_of_attachingClass_ne_zero k hqne
  · exact A.homologyIncl_bijective_of_ne k hq (by omega)

name: TDA.Simplicial.edgeVertex_bijective
statement: private theorem edgeVertex_bijective : Function.Bijective edgeVertex
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j h
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      first | rfl |
        simp [edgeVertex] at hv
  · intro s
    have hc : s.1 = {(0 : Fin 3)} ∨ s.1 = {(1 : Fin 3)} := by
      have h : ∀ t : Finset (Fin 3), t.card = 1 →
          t ⊆ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 3)) →
          t = {0} ∨ t = {1} := by decide
      exact h s.1 s.2.2 s.2.1.2
    rcases hc with hc | hc
    · exact ⟨0, Subtype.ext (by simpa [edgeVertex] using hc.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨1, Subtype.ext (by simpa [edgeVertex] using hc.symm)⟩
