    congrFun (congrFun edgeJ0_array i) j

name: TDA.Simplicial.edgeJ1_reindexed
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simpa [Matrix.reindex_apply, triangleEdgeEquiv, edgeColumnEquiv] using
    congrFun (congrFun edgeJ1_array i) j

name: TDA.Simplicial.singletonJ0_reindexed
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simpa [Matrix.reindex_apply, edgeVertexEquiv, singletonColumnEquiv] using
    congrFun (congrFun singletonJ0_array i) j

name: TDA.Simplicial.triangle_cancel_reindexed
proof:
:= by
  change (Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv ℤ ℤ
    triangleVertexEquiv.symm triangleColumnEquiv.symm)
    (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0 * boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 1) = 0
  rw [← Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_mul (R := ℤ) (A := ℤ)
    triangleVertexEquiv.symm triangleEdgeEquiv.symm triangleColumnEquiv.symm
    (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0) (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 1)]
  change Matrix.reindex triangleVertexEquiv.symm triangleEdgeEquiv.symm
      (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0) *
    Matrix.reindex triangleEdgeEquiv.symm triangleColumnEquiv.symm
      (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 1) = 0
  rw [triangleB0_reindexed, triangleB1_reindexed, triangle_arrays_cancel]

name: TDA.Simplicial.edge_triangle_common_reindexed
statement:
private theorem edge_triangle_common_reindexed :
    Matrix.reindex triangleVertexEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm
      (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0 * chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 1) =
        !![-1; 1; 0]
proof:
:= by
  change (Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv ℤ ℤ
    triangleVertexEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm)
    (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0 * chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 1) =
      !![-1; 1; 0]
  rw [← Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_mul (R := ℤ) (A := ℤ)
    triangleVertexEquiv.symm triangleEdgeEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm
    (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0) (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 1)]
  change Matrix.reindex triangleVertexEquiv.symm triangleEdgeEquiv.symm
      (boundaryMatrix triangleK ℤ 0) *
    Matrix.reindex triangleEdgeEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm
      (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 1) = !![-1; 1; 0]
  rw [triangleB0_reindexed, edgeJ1_reindexed, edge_triangle_common_column]

name: TDA.Simplicial.edge_triangle_right_reindexed
statement:
private theorem edge_triangle_right_reindexed :
    Matrix.reindex triangleVertexEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm
      (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 0 * boundaryMatrix edgeK ℤ 0) =
        !![-1; 1; 0]
proof:
:= by
  change (Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv ℤ ℤ
    triangleVertexEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm)
    (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 0 * boundaryMatrix edgeK ℤ 0) =
      !![-1; 1; 0]
  rw [← Matrix.reindexLinearEquiv_mul (R := ℤ) (A := ℤ)
    triangleVertexEquiv.symm edgeVertexEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm
    (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 0) (boundaryMatrix edgeK ℤ 0)]
  change Matrix.reindex triangleVertexEquiv.symm edgeVertexEquiv.symm
      (chainInclusionMatrix ℤ edge_le_triangle 0) *
    Matrix.reindex edgeVertexEquiv.symm edgeColumnEquiv.symm
      (boundaryMatrix edgeK ℤ 0) = !![-1; 1; 0]
  rw [edgeJ0_reindexed, edgeB0_reindexed]
  decide

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialCycles_zero
statement:
theorem simplicialCycles_zero (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) :
    simplicialCycles K R 0 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  change LinearMap.ker ((simplicialChainComplex K R).sc 0).g.hom = ⊤
  have hg : ((simplicialChainComplex K R).sc 0).g = 0 := by
    change (simplicialChainComplex K R).d 0 ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).next 0) = 0
    rw [ChainComplex.next_nat_zero]
    exact simplicialChainComplex_d_zero K R 0
  rw [hg]
  exact LinearMap.ker_zero

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialCycles_succ
statement:
theorem simplicialCycles_succ (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialCycles K R (n + 1) = LinearMap.ker (boundary K R n)
proof:
:= by
  change LinearMap.ker ((simplicialChainComplex K R).d
    (n + 1) ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).next (n + 1))).hom = _
  rw [ChainComplex.next_nat_succ, simplicialChainComplex_d]
  rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff
statement:
theorem mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (n : ℕ)
    (z : simplicialCycles K R n) :
    z ∈ simplicialBoundaries K R n ↔
      ∃ c : Chain K R (n + 1), boundary K R n c = (z : Chain K R n)
proof:
:= by
  simp [simplicialBoundaries, simplicialCycles, HomologicalComplex.sc,
    HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor,
    HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor', simplicialChainComplex,
    ShortComplex.moduleCatToCycles, LinearMap.mem_range,
    Subtype.ext_iff]
  have hmem (m : ℕ) (hm : m = n + 1) :
      (∃ y : (simplicialChainComplex K R).X m,
        ((simplicialChainComplex K R).d m n).hom y = (z : Chain K R n)) ↔
      ∃ c : Chain K R (n + 1), boundary K R n c = (z : Chain K R n) := by
    subst m
    simp [simplicialChainComplex_d]
  exact hmem _ (ChainComplex.prev ℕ n)

name: TDA.Simplicial.shortCycleMap_toCycles
statement:
private theorem shortCycleMap_toCycles
    (S₁ S₂ : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)) (φ : S₁ ⟶ S₂) :
    (shortCycleMap R S₁ S₂ φ).comp S₁.moduleCatToCycles =
      S₂.moduleCatToCycles.comp φ.τ₁.hom
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  have hc := congrArg (fun f : S₁.X₁ ⟶ S₂.X₂ => f.hom c) φ.comm₁₂
  exact hc.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.shortRange_le
statement:
private theorem shortRange_le
    (S₁ S₂ : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)) (φ : S₁ ⟶ S₂) :
    LinearMap.range S₁.moduleCatToCycles ≤
      (LinearMap.range S₂.moduleCatToCycles).comap (shortCycleMap R S₁ S₂ φ)
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := hz
  change shortCycleMap R S₁ S₂ φ (S₁.moduleCatToCycles c) ∈
    LinearMap.range S₂.moduleCatToCycles
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, shortCycleMap_toCycles, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _

name: TDA.Simplicial.shortQuotientMap_mkQ
statement:
private theorem shortQuotientMap_mkQ
    (S₁ S₂ : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)) (φ : S₁ ⟶ S₂)
    (z : LinearMap.ker S₁.g.hom) :
    shortQuotientMap R S₁ S₂ φ ((LinearMap.range S₁.moduleCatToCycles).mkQ z) =
      (LinearMap.range S₂.moduleCatToCycles).mkQ (shortCycleMap R S₁ S₂ φ z)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialCycleIncl_coe
statement:
theorem simplicialCycleIncl_coe (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    (z : simplicialCycles K R n) :
    (simplicialCycleIncl R h n z : Chain L R n) =
      chainIncl R h n (z : Chain K R n)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialCycleIncl_id
statement:
theorem simplicialCycleIncl_id (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialCycleIncl R (le_refl K) n = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [simplicialCycleIncl_coe, chainIncl_id]

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialCycleIncl_comp
statement:
theorem simplicialCycleIncl_comp (h : K ≤ L) (g : L ≤ M) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialCycleIncl R (h.trans g) n =
      (simplicialCycleIncl R g n).comp (simplicialCycleIncl R h n)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [simplicialCycleIncl_coe, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  exact congrArg (fun f => f (z : Chain K R n)) (chainIncl_comp R h g n)

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialCycleIncl_toCycles
statement:
theorem simplicialCycleIncl_toCycles (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ) :
    (simplicialCycleIncl R h n).comp
        ((simplicialChainComplex K R).sc n).moduleCatToCycles =
      (((simplicialChainComplex L R).sc n).moduleCatToCycles).comp
        (chainIncl R h ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev n))
proof:
:= by
  have hs := shortCycleMap_toCycles R _ _ (homologyShortMap R h n)
  have hc : (homologyShortMap R h n).τ₁.hom =
      chainIncl R h ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev n) := rfl
  rw [hc] at hs
  exact hs

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialBoundaries_le_comap
statement:
theorem simplicialBoundaries_le_comap (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialBoundaries K R n ≤
      (simplicialBoundaries L R n).comap (simplicialCycleIncl R h n)
proof:
:= by
  exact shortRange_le R _ _ (homologyShortMap R h n)

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ
statement:
theorem simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ)
    (z : simplicialCycles K R n) :
    simplicialQuotientIncl R h n
        (Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := simplicialCycles K R n)
          (simplicialBoundaries K R n) z) =
      Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := simplicialCycles L R n)
        (simplicialBoundaries L R n) (simplicialCycleIncl R h n z)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialQuotientIncl_id
statement:
theorem simplicialQuotientIncl_id (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialQuotientIncl R (le_refl K) n = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  induction z using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ z =>
    change simplicialQuotientIncl R (le_refl K) n
      (Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := simplicialCycles K R n)
        (simplicialBoundaries K R n) z) = _
    rw [simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ, simplicialCycleIncl_id]
    rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialQuotientIncl_comp
statement:
theorem simplicialQuotientIncl_comp (h : K ≤ L) (g : L ≤ M) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialQuotientIncl R (h.trans g) n =
      (simplicialQuotientIncl R g n).comp (simplicialQuotientIncl R h n)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  induction z using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ z =>
    change simplicialQuotientIncl R (h.trans g) n
      (Submodule.mkQ (R := R) (M := simplicialCycles K R n)
        (simplicialBoundaries K R n) z) = _
    simp only [simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [simplicialCycleIncl_comp]
    rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyIncl_id
statement:
theorem simplicialHomologyIncl_id (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl R (le_refl K) n = 𝟙 (simplicialHomology K R n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold simplicialHomologyIncl
  rw [simplicialChainIncl_id]
  exact HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_id _ n

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyIncl_comp
statement:
theorem simplicialHomologyIncl_comp (h : K ≤ L) (g : L ≤ M) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl R (h.trans g) n =
      simplicialHomologyIncl R h n ≫ simplicialHomologyIncl R g n
proof:
:= by
  unfold simplicialHomologyIncl
  rw [simplicialChainIncl_comp]
  exact HomologicalComplex.homologyMap_comp _ _ n

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality
statement:
theorem simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl R h n ≫
        (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} R (simplicialChainComplex L R) n).hom =
      (homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} R (simplicialChainComplex K R) n).hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom (simplicialQuotientIncl R h n)
proof:
:= by
  exact (homologyMapData R _ _ (homologyShortMap R h n)).homologyMap_comm

name: TDA.Simplicial.zeroBoundaryNormalization
statement:
private theorem zeroBoundaryNormalization
    (S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)) (hf : S.f = 0) (hg : S.g = 0) :
    S.moduleCatLeftHomologyData.π ≫ S.moduleCatHomologyIso.inv ≫
        (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S hf hg).homologyIso.hom =
      S.moduleCatLeftHomologyData.i
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← S.moduleCatCyclesIso_inv_π]
  rw [Category.assoc,
    (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S hf hg).homologyπ_comp_homologyIso_hom]
  simp only [ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros_π]
  have hci : (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S hf hg).cyclesIso.hom =
      S.iCycles := by
    simpa [ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros] using
      (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S hf hg).cyclesIso_hom_comp_i
  rw [hci]
  exact S.moduleCatCyclesIso_inv_iCycles

name: TDA.Simplicial.singletonShort_f_zero
statement: private theorem singletonShort_f_zero (x : V) : (singletonShort R x).f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (simplicialChainComplex (Filtration.singletonFace x) R).d 1 0 = 0 := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    ext c
    change (boundary (Filtration.singletonFace x) R 0) c = 0
    have hc := singletonHigherChain_eq_zero x R 0 c
    rw [hc]
    simp
  change (simplicialChainComplex (Filtration.singletonFace x) R).d
    ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev 0) 0 = 0
  rw [ChainComplex.prev]
  exact hf

name: TDA.Simplicial.singletonShort_g_zero
statement: private theorem singletonShort_g_zero (x : V) : (singletonShort R x).g = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (simplicialChainComplex (Filtration.singletonFace x) R).d
    0 ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).next 0) = 0
  rw [ChainComplex.next_nat_zero]
  exact simplicialChainComplex_d_zero _ R 0

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomology_bot_zero
statement:
theorem simplicialHomology_bot_zero
    (z : simplicialHomology (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) R 0) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  let S := (simplicialChainComplex (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) R).sc 0
  have hf : S.f = 0 := by
    have hf' : (simplicialChainComplex (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) R).d 1 0 = 0 := by
      apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
      ext c
      change boundary (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) R 0 c = 0
      have hc := emptyChain_eq_zero R 1 c
      rw [hc]
      simp
    change (simplicialChainComplex (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) R).d
      ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev 0) 0 = 0
    rw [ChainComplex.prev]
    exact hf'
  have hg : S.g = 0 := by
    change (simplicialChainComplex (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) R).d
      0 ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).next 0) = 0
    rw [ChainComplex.next_nat_zero]
    exact simplicialChainComplex_d_zero _ R 0
  apply (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S hf hg).homologyIso.toLinearEquiv.injective
  let e := (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S hf hg).homologyIso.toLinearEquiv
  change e z = e 0
  exact (emptyChain_eq_zero R 0 (e z)).trans e.map_zero.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.singletonVertex_normalization
statement:
private theorem singletonVertex_normalization (x : V) (a : R) :
    simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R x
      ((homologyKernelQuotient.{v,u,v} R
        (simplicialChainComplex (Filtration.singletonFace x) R) 0).inv.hom
          ((LinearMap.range (singletonShort R x).moduleCatToCycles).mkQ
            (singletonVertexCycle R x a))) = a
proof:
:= by
  let S := singletonShort R x
  let h0 := ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S
    (singletonShort_f_zero R x) (singletonShort_g_zero R x)
  change (Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv R R (singletonVertex x))
    ((S.moduleCatLeftHomologyData.π ≫ S.moduleCatHomologyIso.inv ≫ h0.homologyIso.hom).hom
      (singletonVertexCycle R x a)) = a
  rw [zeroBoundaryNormalization R S (singletonShort_f_zero R x)
    (singletonShort_g_zero R x)]
  change (Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv R R (singletonVertex x))
    ((singletonVertexCycle R x a).1) = a
  simp [singletonVertexCycle, Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv_apply]

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialSingletonH0Equiv_symm_one_ne_zero
statement:
theorem simplicialSingletonH0Equiv_symm_one_ne_zero [Nontrivial R] (x : V) :
    (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R x).symm (1 : R) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have h := congrArg (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R x) hz
  simp at h

name: TDA.Simplicial.succAbove_val
statement:
private theorem succAbove_val {n : ℕ} (j : Fin (n + 1)) (k : Fin n) :
    (j.succAbove k).val = if k.val < j.val then k.val else k.val + 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : k.castSucc < j
  · rw [Fin.succAbove_of_castSucc_lt _ _ h]
    have hv : k.val < j.val := h
    simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, if_pos hv]
  · rw [Fin.succAbove_of_le_castSucc _ _ (le_of_not_gt h)]
    have hv : ¬k.val < j.val := h
    simp only [Fin.val_succ, if_neg hv]

name: TDA.Simplicial.prism_delete_before
statement:
private theorem prism_delete_before {W : Type*} {n : ℕ}
    (a b : Fin (n + 2) → W) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 2))
    (h : i.castSucc < j) :
    prismTuple (a ∘ j.succAbove) (b ∘ j.succAbove) i =
      prismTuple a b i.castSucc ∘ j.succ.succAbove
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  have hv := succAbove_val j.succ k
  simp only [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ] at h hv
  simp only [prismTuple, Function.comp_apply, Fin.val_castSucc]
  split_ifs <;> split_ifs at hv <;> try omega
  all_goals
    congr 1
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [succAbove_val, Fin.val_succ]; split_ifs <;> omega

name: TDA.Simplicial.prism_delete_after
statement:
private theorem prism_delete_after {W : Type*} {n : ℕ}
    (a b : Fin (n + 2) → W) (i : Fin (n + 1)) (j : Fin (n + 2))
    (h : ¬i.castSucc < j) :
    prismTuple (a ∘ j.succAbove) (b ∘ j.succAbove) i =
      prismTuple a b i.succ ∘ j.castSucc.succAbove
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  have hv := succAbove_val j.castSucc k
  simp only [Fin.lt_def, Fin.val_castSucc] at h hv
  simp only [prismTuple, Function.comp_apply, Fin.val_succ]
  split_ifs <;> split_ifs at hv <;> try omega
  all_goals
    congr 1
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [succAbove_val, Fin.val_castSucc] <;> split_ifs <;> omega

name: TDA.Simplicial.prism_delete_interface
statement:
private theorem prism_delete_interface {W : Type*} {n : ℕ}
    (a b : Fin (n + 2) → W) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    prismTuple a b i.succ ∘ i.castSucc.succ.succAbove =
      prismTuple a b i.castSucc ∘ i.castSucc.succ.succAbove
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  have hv := succAbove_val i.castSucc.succ k
  simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ] at hv
  simp only [prismTuple, Function.comp_apply, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]
  split_ifs <;> split_ifs at hv <;> first | omega | rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.prism_delete_first
statement:
private theorem prism_delete_first {W : Type*} {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin (n + 1) → W) :
    prismTuple a b 0 ∘ (0 : Fin (n + 2)).succAbove = b
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  simp [prismTuple, Fin.succAbove_zero]

name: TDA.Simplicial.prism_delete_last
statement:
private theorem prism_delete_last {W : Type*} {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin (n + 1) → W) :
    prismTuple a b (Fin.last n) ∘ (Fin.last (n + 1)).succAbove = a
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  simp [prismTuple, Fin.succAbove_last, Nat.le_of_lt_succ k.isLt]

name: TDA.Simplicial.prism_sum_cancel
statement:
private theorem prism_sum_cancel {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] (n : ℕ)
    (α : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 2) → A)
    (β : Fin (n + 3) × Fin (n + 2) → A)
    (hb : ∀ x, x.1.castSucc < x.2 → α x = -β (x.2.succ, x.1.castSucc))
    (ha : ∀ x, ¬x.1.castSucc < x.2 → α x = -β (x.2.castSucc, x.1.succ))
    (hi : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), β (i.castSucc.succ, i.castSucc) =
      -β (i.castSucc.succ, i.succ)) :
    (∑ x, α x) + (∑ y, β y) = β (0, 0) + β (Fin.last _, Fin.last _)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Finset (Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 2)) := { x | x.1.castSucc < x.2 }
  let γ₁ (x : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 2)) := (x.2.castSucc, x.1.succ)
  let γ₂ (x : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 2)) := (x.2.succ, x.1.castSucc)
  let γ₃ (i : Fin (n + 1)) := (i.castSucc.succ, i.succ)
  let γ₄ (i : Fin (n + 1)) := (i.castSucc.succ, i.castSucc)
  have hγ₁ : Function.Injective γ₁ := fun _ _ ↦ by aesop
  have hγ₂ : Function.Injective γ₂ := fun _ _ ↦ by aesop
  have hγ₃ : Function.Injective γ₃ := fun _ _ ↦ by aesop
  have hγ₄ : Function.Injective γ₄ := fun _ _ ↦ by aesop
  have eq₃ : ∑ x ∈ Sᶜ, α x = - ∑ y ∈ Finset.image γ₁ Sᶜ, β y := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Finset.sum_image hγ₁.injOn]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    exact ha x (by simpa [S] using hx)
  have eq₄ : ∑ x ∈ S, α x = - ∑ y ∈ Finset.image γ₂ S, β y := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib, Finset.sum_image hγ₂.injOn]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    exact hb x (by simpa [S] using hx)
  have eq₅ : ∑ x, β (γ₄ x) = - ∑ x, β (γ₃ x) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hi i)
  have h₁ : Disjoint (Finset.image γ₁ Sᶜ) (Finset.image γ₂ S) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]
    grind [Finset.mem_compl]
  have h₂ : Disjoint (Finset.image γ₃ .univ) (Finset.image γ₄ .univ) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]
    grind
  have h₃ : Disjoint (Finset.disjUnion _ _ h₂) {(0, 0), (Fin.last _, Fin.last _)} := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, forall_eq_or_imp, Prod.forall]
    rintro ⟨a, _⟩ ⟨b, _⟩
    simp
    grind
  have h₄ : Disjoint (Finset.disjUnion _ _ h₁) (Finset.disjUnion _ _ h₃) := by
    rw [Finset.disjoint_iff_ne]
    simp only [Finset.compl_filter, not_lt, Finset.disjUnion_eq_union, Finset.mem_union,
      Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Prod.exists, ne_eq,
      Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, Prod.forall, Prod.mk.injEq, not_and,
      S, γ₁, γ₂, γ₃, γ₄]
    rintro ⟨a, _⟩ ⟨b, _⟩ (⟨⟨j, _⟩, ⟨k, _⟩, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩ | ⟨⟨j, _⟩, ⟨k, _⟩, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩) _ _
      ((⟨⟨i, _⟩, h₄, h₅⟩ | ⟨⟨i, _⟩, h₄, h₅⟩) | (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)) <;>
        simp [Fin.ext_iff] at h₁ h₂ h₃ ⊢ <;> grind
  have H : (Finset.disjUnion _ _ h₁)ᶜ = Finset.disjUnion _ _ h₃ :=
    Finset.compl_eq_of_disjoint_of_card_add_eq h₄ (by
      rw [Finset.card_disjUnion, Finset.card_disjUnion, Finset.card_disjUnion,
        Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hγ₁, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hγ₂,
        Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hγ₃, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hγ₄]
      simp
      lia)
  rw [← S.sum_add_sum_compl, eq₃, eq₄]
  rw [← neg_add_rev, ← Finset.sum_disjUnion h₁, ← (Finset.disjUnion _ _ h₁).sum_add_sum_compl,
    H]
  simp only [Finset.sum_disjUnion]
  rw [Finset.sum_image hγ₃.injOn, Finset.sum_image hγ₄.injOn,
    Finset.sum_insert (by simp), Finset.sum_singleton, eq₅]
  abel

name: TDA.Simplicial.prismTuple_mem
statement:
private theorem prismTuple_mem (L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W) {n : ℕ}
    (a b : Fin (n + 1) → W)
    (hk : Finset.univ.image a ∪ Finset.univ.image b ∈ L) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Finset.univ.image (prismTuple a b i) ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (L.isRelLowerSet_faces hk).2
  · intro w hw
    obtain ⟨k, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hw
    unfold prismTuple
    split_ifs
    · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
    · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨_, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
  · exact Finset.image_nonempty.mpr Finset.univ_nonempty

name: TDA.Simplicial.tuplePrism_boundary
statement:
private theorem tuplePrism_boundary (L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] {n : ℕ} (a b : Fin (n + 2) → W)
    (hprism : ∀ i : Fin (n + 2),
      Finset.univ.image (prismTuple a b i) ∈ L) :
    boundary L R (n + 1) (tuplePrism L R a b) +
        (∑ j : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) •
          tuplePrism L R (a ∘ j.succAbove) (b ∘ j.succAbove)) =
      orientedTuple L R b - orientedTuple L R a
proof:
:= by
  let α (x : Fin (n + 1) × Fin (n + 2)) : Chain L R (n + 1) :=
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ ((x.1 : ℕ) + (x.2 : ℕ)) •
      orientedTuple L R (prismTuple (a ∘ x.2.succAbove) (b ∘ x.2.succAbove) x.1)
  let β (x : Fin (n + 3) × Fin (n + 2)) : Chain L R (n + 1) :=
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ ((x.1 : ℕ) + (x.2 : ℕ)) •
      orientedTuple L R (prismTuple a b x.2 ∘ x.1.succAbove)
  have hb : ∀ x, x.1.castSucc < x.2 → α x = -β (x.2.succ, x.1.castSucc) := by
    rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij
    dsimp only [α, β, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc]
    rw [prism_delete_before a b i j hij,
      show (j.val + 1 + i.val) = (i.val + j.val) + 1 by omega]
    simp [pow_succ]
  have ha : ∀ x, ¬x.1.castSucc < x.2 → α x = -β (x.2.castSucc, x.1.succ) := by
    rintro ⟨i, j⟩ hij
    dsimp only [α, β, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc]
    rw [prism_delete_after a b i j hij,
      show j.val + (i.val + 1) = (i.val + j.val) + 1 by omega]
    simp [pow_succ]
  have hi : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), β (i.castSucc.succ, i.castSucc) =
      -β (i.castSucc.succ, i.succ) := by
    intro i
    dsimp only [β, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc]
    rw [prism_delete_interface,
      show (i.val + 1) + (i.val + 1) = ((i.val + 1) + i.val) + 1 by omega]
    simp [pow_succ]
  have hα : (∑ j : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) •
      tuplePrism L R (a ∘ j.succAbove) (b ∘ j.succAbove)) = ∑ x, α x := by
    unfold tuplePrism
    simp only [Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, ← pow_add]
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp only [α, Nat.add_comm]
  have hβ : boundary L R (n + 1) (tuplePrism L R a b) = ∑ x, β x := by
    unfold tuplePrism
    rw [map_sum]
    simp only [map_zsmul]
    simp_rw [boundary_orientedTuple L R _ (hprism _)]
    simp only [tupleBoundarySum, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul, ← pow_add]
    rw [Fintype.sum_prod_type, Finset.sum_comm]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    simp only [β, Nat.add_comm]
  have he : β (0, 0) = orientedTuple L R b := by
    dsimp only [β, Fin.val_zero]
    rw [prism_delete_first]
    simp
  have hl : β (Fin.last _, Fin.last _) = -orientedTuple L R a := by
    dsimp only [β, Fin.val_last]
    rw [prism_delete_last,
      show n + 2 + (n + 1) = 2 * (n + 1) + 1 by omega, pow_add, pow_mul]
    norm_num
  rw [hα, hβ, add_comm (∑ x, β x) (∑ x, α x)]
  exact (prism_sum_cancel n α β hb ha hi).trans (by rw [he, hl, sub_eq_add_neg])

name: TDA.Simplicial.tuplePrism_boundary_zero
statement:
private theorem tuplePrism_boundary_zero (L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W)
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] (a b : Fin 1 → W)
    (hprism : ∀ i : Fin 1, Finset.univ.image (prismTuple a b i) ∈ L) :
    boundary L R 0 (tuplePrism L R a b) = orientedTuple L R b - orientedTuple L R a
proof:
:= by
  change boundary L R 0 (∑ i : Fin 1, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) •
    orientedTuple L R (prismTuple a b i)) = _
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_one]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_smul]
  rw [boundary_orientedTuple L R _ (hprism 0)]
  unfold tupleBoundarySum
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  have hf := prism_delete_first a b
  have hl := prism_delete_last a b
  change prismTuple a b 0 ∘ (1 : Fin 2).succAbove = a at hl
  rw [hf, hl]
  simp [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: TDA.Simplicial.PrismAdmissible.prismMap_single_tuple
statement:
private theorem prismMap_single_tuple (h : PrismAdmissible f g) (n : ℕ)
    (s : Face K n) (a : R) :
    prismMap R h n (Finsupp.single s a) =
      a • tuplePrism L R (f ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2)
        (g ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [prismMap]

name: TDA.Simplicial.PrismAdmissible.boundary_prismMap_zero
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
  intro s
  apply LinearMap.ext_ring
  change boundary L R 0 (prismMap R h 0 (Finsupp.single s 1)) =
    vertexChainMap R g 0 (Finsupp.single s 1) -
      vertexChainMap R f 0 (Finsupp.single s 1)
  simp only [prismMap_single_tuple, vertexChainMap_single, one_smul]
  exact tuplePrism_boundary_zero L R _ _ (fun i => h s i)

name: TDA.Simplicial.PrismAdmissible.boundary_prismMap_succ
statement:
private theorem boundary_prismMap_succ (h : PrismAdmissible f g) (n : ℕ) :
    (boundary L R (n + 1)).comp (prismMap R h (n + 1)) +
      (prismMap R h n).comp (boundary K R n) =
        vertexChainMap R g (n + 1) - vertexChainMap R f (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
  intro s
  apply LinearMap.ext_ring
  change boundary L R (n + 1) (prismMap R h (n + 1) (Finsupp.single s 1)) +
      prismMap R h n (boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s 1)) =
    vertexChainMap R g (n + 1) (Finsupp.single s 1) -
      vertexChainMap R f (n + 1) (Finsupp.single s 1)
  simp only [prismMap_single_tuple, vertexChainMap_single, one_smul]
  have hd : prismMap R h n (boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s 1)) =
      ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) • tuplePrism L R
        ((f ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2) ∘ j.succAbove)
        ((g ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2) ∘ j.succAbove) := by
    rw [boundary_single, one_smul, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [prismMap_single_tuple]
    have he : ⇑((deletedFace K n s j).1.orderEmbOfFin (deletedFace K n s j).2.2) =
        s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 ∘ j.succAbove := by
      funext k
      exact enumerationAfterDeletion K n s j _ k
    rw [he]
    have hs : (-1 : R) ^ (j : ℕ) = (((-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) : ℤ) : R) := by norm_cast
    rw [hs, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
    rfl
  rw [hd]
  exact tuplePrism_boundary L R _ _ (fun i => h s i)

name: TDA.Simplicial.PrismAdmissible.homotopyComponent_succ
statement:
private theorem homotopyComponent_succ (h : PrismAdmissible f g) (i : ℕ) :
    homotopyComponent R h i (i + 1) = ModuleCat.ofHom (-prismMap R h i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [homotopyComponent]

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyMap_eq_of_prismAdmissible
statement:
theorem simplicialHomologyMap_eq_of_prismAdmissible (h : PrismAdmissible f g) (n : ℕ) :
    TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyMap R f n =
      TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyMap R g n
proof:
:=
  (PrismAdmissible.chainHomotopy R h).homologyMap_eq n

name: TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous.prismMap_single_tuple
proof:
:= by
  simp [prismMap]

name: TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous.prismMap_single
statement:
theorem prismMap_single (h : Contiguous f g) (n : ℕ) (s : Face K n) (a : R) :
    prismMap R h n (Finsupp.single s a) = a •
      ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i : ℕ) • orientedTuple L R
        (fun k : Fin (n + 2) => if hi : k.val ≤ i.val then
          f (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 ⟨k.val, by omega⟩) else
          g (s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 ⟨k.val - 1, by omega⟩))
proof:
:= by
  rw [prismMap_single_tuple]
  rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous.face_union_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he (q : V → W) : Finset.univ.image (q ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2) =
      @Finset.image V W (Classical.decEq W) q s.1 := by
    rw [← Finset.image_image, Finset.image_orderEmbOfFin_univ]
    ext w
    simp only [Finset.mem_image]
  rw [he f, he g]
  convert h s.1 s.2.1 using 1
  ext w
  simp only [Finset.mem_union]

name: TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous.prismAdmissible
statement:
theorem prismAdmissible (h : Contiguous f g) :
    PrismAdmissible f g
proof:
:= by
  intro n s i
  exact prismTuple_mem L _ _ (face_union_mem h s) i

name: TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous.boundary_prismMap_zero
statement:
theorem boundary_prismMap_zero (h : Contiguous f g) :
    (boundary L R 0).comp (prismMap R h 0) = vertexChainMap R g 0 - vertexChainMap R f 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
  intro s
  apply LinearMap.ext_ring
  change boundary L R 0 (prismMap R h 0 (Finsupp.single s 1)) =
    vertexChainMap R g 0 (Finsupp.single s 1) - vertexChainMap R f 0 (Finsupp.single s 1)
  simp only [prismMap_single_tuple, vertexChainMap_single, one_smul]
  exact tuplePrism_boundary_zero L R _ _ (fun i => h.prismAdmissible s i)

name: TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous.boundary_prismMap_succ
statement:
theorem boundary_prismMap_succ (h : Contiguous f g) (n : ℕ) :
    (boundary L R (n + 1)).comp (prismMap R h (n + 1)) +
      (prismMap R h n).comp (boundary K R n) =
        vertexChainMap R g (n + 1) - vertexChainMap R f (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
  intro s
  apply LinearMap.ext_ring
  change boundary L R (n + 1) (prismMap R h (n + 1) (Finsupp.single s 1)) +
      prismMap R h n (boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s 1)) =
    vertexChainMap R g (n + 1) (Finsupp.single s 1) -
      vertexChainMap R f (n + 1) (Finsupp.single s 1)
  simp only [prismMap_single_tuple, vertexChainMap_single, one_smul]
  have hd : prismMap R h n (boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s 1)) =
      ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) • tuplePrism L R
        ((f ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2) ∘ j.succAbove)
        ((g ∘ s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2) ∘ j.succAbove) := by
    rw [boundary_single, one_smul, map_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    rw [prismMap_single_tuple]
    have he : ⇑((deletedFace K n s j).1.orderEmbOfFin (deletedFace K n s j).2.2) =
        s.1.orderEmbOfFin s.2.2 ∘ j.succAbove := by
      funext k
      exact enumerationAfterDeletion K n s j _ k
    rw [he]
    have hs : (-1 : R) ^ (j : ℕ) = (((-1 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ) : ℤ) : R) := by norm_cast
    rw [hs, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
    rfl
  rw [hd]
  exact tuplePrism_boundary L R _ _ (fun i => h.prismAdmissible s i)

name: TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous.homotopyComponent_succ
statement:
private theorem homotopyComponent_succ (h : Contiguous f g) (i : ℕ) :
    homotopyComponent R h i (i + 1) = ModuleCat.ofHom (-prismMap R h i)
proof:
:= by
  simp [homotopyComponent]

name: TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous.chainHomotopy_hom_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem chainHomotopy_hom_succ (h : Contiguous f g) (n : ℕ) :
    (chainHomotopy R h).hom n (n + 1) = ModuleCat.ofHom (-prismMap R h n)
proof:
:=
  homotopyComponent_succ R h n

name: TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous.chainHomotopy_hom_eq_zero
statement:
theorem chainHomotopy_hom_eq_zero (h : Contiguous f g) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i + 1 ≠ j) :
    (chainHomotopy R h).hom i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact dif_neg hij

name: TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous.simplicialHomologyMap_eq
statement:
theorem simplicialHomologyMap_eq (h : Contiguous f g) (n : ℕ) :
    TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyMap R f n = TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyMap R g n
proof:
:=
  simplicialHomologyMap_eq_of_prismAdmissible R (h.prismAdmissible) n

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.fullFace_enumeration
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Finset.orderEmbOfFin_unique'
  intro i
  exact Finset.mem_univ i

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.fullMap_single
statement:
private theorem fullMap_single {V : Type} [LinearOrder V] (R : Type) [Ring R]
    {n : ℕ} (f : Fin (n + 1) → V) (a : R) :
    vertexChainMap R (fullMap f) n (Finsupp.single (fullFace n) a) =
      a • orientedTuple (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) R f
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexChainMap_single, fullFace_enumeration]
  rfl

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.orientedTuple_id
proof:
:= by
  have h := orientedTuple_face (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin (n + 1))) R (fullFace n)
  rw [fullFace_enumeration] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.edge_delete_zero
statement:
private theorem edge_delete_zero :
    deletedFace (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) 0 (fullFace 1) 0 = edgeVertex 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [deletedFace, fullFace_enumeration]
  decide

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.edge_delete_one
statement:
private theorem edge_delete_one :
    deletedFace (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) 0 (fullFace 1) 1 = edgeVertex 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [deletedFace, fullFace_enumeration]
  decide

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.edge_boundary_nonzero
statement:
theorem edge_boundary_nonzero :
    boundary (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) ℤ 0
      (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have h := congrArg (fun c => c (edgeVertex 1)) hz
  simp [boundary_single, Fin.sum_univ_succ, edge_delete_zero, edge_delete_one,
    edgeVertex] at h

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.edge_reversal
statement:
theorem edge_reversal :
    vertexChainMap ℤ (fullMap (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) 1
      (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1) = -Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullMap_single, one_smul]
  have h := orientedTuple_comp_perm (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) ℤ
    (fun i => i) (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)
  simpa [Function.comp_def, orientedTuple_id, Equiv.Perm.sign_swap (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1)] using h

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.edge_reversal_boundary
statement:
theorem edge_reversal_boundary :
    boundary (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) ℤ 0
      (vertexChainMap ℤ (fullMap (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) 1
        (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) =
      -boundary (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) ℤ 0
        (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1) ∧
    boundary (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) ℤ 0
      (vertexChainMap ℤ (fullMap (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) 1
        (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [edge_reversal, map_neg]
  exact ⟨rfl, neg_ne_zero.mpr edge_boundary_nonzero⟩

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.edge_collapse
statement:
theorem edge_collapse :
    vertexChainMap ℤ collapseMap 1 (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply vertexChainMap_single_of_not_injective
  rw [fullFace_enumeration]
  intro h
  have he : (0 : Fin 2) = 1 := h (by rfl)
  exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1) he

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.collapse_vertex
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexChainMap_vertex]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.edge_collapse_boundary
statement:
theorem edge_collapse_boundary :
    vertexChainMap ℤ collapseMap 0
      (boundary (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) ℤ 0
        (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (boundary_vertexChainMap ℤ collapseMap 0)
    (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1)
  simpa [edge_collapse] using h.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.triangle_one_pair_collapse
statement:
theorem triangle_one_pair_collapse :
    vertexChainMap ℤ (fullMap triangleCollapse) 2
      (Finsupp.single (fullFace 2) 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply vertexChainMap_single_of_not_injective
  rw [fullFace_enumeration]
  intro h
  have he : (0 : Fin 3) = 1 := h (by decide)
  exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1) he

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.triangle_one_pair_boundary
statement:
theorem triangle_one_pair_boundary :
    tupleBoundarySum (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) ℤ triangleCollapse = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← boundary_orientedTuple _ ℤ _ (by
    change (Finset.univ.image triangleCollapse).Nonempty
    exact Finset.image_nonempty.mpr Finset.univ_nonempty)]
  have hx : ¬Function.Injective triangleCollapse := by
    intro h
    exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1) (h (by decide))
  rw [orientedTuple_of_not_injective _ ℤ _ hx, map_zero]

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.triangle_one_pair_boundary_image
statement:
theorem triangle_one_pair_boundary_image :
    vertexChainMap ℤ (fullMap triangleCollapse) 1
      (boundary (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ℤ 1
        (Finsupp.single (fullFace 2) 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (boundary_vertexChainMap ℤ (fullMap triangleCollapse) 1)
    (Finsupp.single (fullFace 2) 1)
  simpa [triangle_one_pair_collapse] using h.symm

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.triangle_transpositions_compose
statement:
theorem triangle_transpositions_compose :
    vertexChainMap ℤ
      (VertexMap.comp (fullMap (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1))
        (fullMap (Equiv.swap (1 : Fin 3) 2))) 2 =
      (vertexChainMap ℤ (fullMap (Equiv.swap (1 : Fin 3) 2)) 2).comp
        (vertexChainMap ℤ (fullMap (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1)) 2)
proof:
:=
  vertexChainMap_comp _ _ _ _

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.triangle_second_map_collapses
statement:
theorem triangle_second_map_collapses :
    vertexChainMap ℤ
      (VertexMap.comp (fullMap (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1)) (fullMap triangleCollapse)) 2
      (Finsupp.single (fullFace 2) 1) = 0
proof:
:= by

  rw [fullFace_enumeration]
  intro h
  have he : (0 : Fin 3) = 1 := h (by decide)
  exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1) he

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.matrix_edge_reversal
statement:
theorem matrix_edge_reversal :
    vertexChainMap (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ)
      (fullMap (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)) 1
      (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) !![0, 1; 0, 0]) =
      Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) (- !![0, 1; 0, 0])
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullMap_single]
  have h := orientedTuple_comp_perm (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2))
    (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) (fun i => i) (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)
  have he : orientedTuple (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2))
      (Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℤ) (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) =
      -Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1 := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, orientedTuple_id, Equiv.Perm.sign_swap (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1)] using h
  rw [he]
  simp only [smul_neg, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, Finsupp.single_neg]

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.vertex_class_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem vertex_class_ne_zero {V : Type} [LinearOrder V]
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (s : Face K 0) :
    simplicialHomologyClass ℚ K 0 (zeroVertexCycle K ℚ s) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hq := congrArg (homologyKernelQuotient ℚ (simplicialChainComplex K ℚ) 0).hom.hom hz
  rw [simplicialHomologyClass_quotient, map_zero] at hq
  exact zeroVertexCycle_not_boundary K ℚ s ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hq)

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.edge_collapse_simplicialH0

theorem edge_collapse_simplicialH0 :
    (simplicialHomologyMap ℚ collapseMap 0).hom
      (simplicialHomologyClass ℚ (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) 0
        (zeroVertexCycle _ ℚ (edgeVertex 0))) =
      simplicialHomologyClass ℚ (Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 1)) 0
        (zeroVertexCycle _ ℚ (singletonVertex (0 : Fin 1))) ∧
    simplicialHomologyClass ℚ (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) 0
      (zeroVertexCycle _ ℚ (edgeVertex 0)) ≠ 0 ∧
    simplicialSingletonH0Equiv ℚ (0 : Fin 1)
      (simplicialHomologyClass ℚ (Filtration.singletonFace (0 : Fin 1)) 0
        (zeroVertexCycle _ ℚ (singletonVertex (0 : Fin 1)))) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨simplicialHomologyMap_class ℚ collapseMap 0 _ _ (collapse_vertex ℚ 0),
    vertex_class_ne_zero _ _, ?_⟩
  exact simplicialSingletonH0Equiv_class ℚ 0 1

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.triangle_one_pair_terms
statement:
theorem triangle_one_pair_terms :
    orientedTuple (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) ℤ
      (triangleCollapse ∘ (0 : Fin 3).succAbove) = Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1 ∧
    orientedTuple (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) ℤ
      (triangleCollapse ∘ (1 : Fin 3).succAbove) = Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) 1 ∧
    orientedTuple (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) ℤ
      (triangleCollapse ∘ (2 : Fin 3).succAbove) = 0 ∧
    (Finsupp.single (fullFace 1) (1 : ℤ) : Chain (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) ℤ 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : triangleCollapse ∘ (0 : Fin 3).succAbove = (fun i : Fin 2 => i) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> decide
  have h1 : triangleCollapse ∘ (1 : Fin 3).succAbove = (fun i : Fin 2 => i) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> decide
  refine ⟨by rw [h0, orientedTuple_id], by rw [h1, orientedTuple_id], ?_,
    Finsupp.single_ne_zero.mpr (by decide)⟩
  apply orientedTuple_of_not_injective
  intro h
  have he : (0 : Fin 2) = 1 := h (by decide)
  exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1) he

name: TDA.Simplicial.VertexChainMapExamples.triangle_transpositions_image
statement:
theorem triangle_transpositions_image :
    vertexChainMap ℤ
      (VertexMap.comp (fullMap (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1))
        (fullMap (Equiv.swap (1 : Fin 3) 2))) 2
      (Finsupp.single (fullFace 2) 1) = Finsupp.single (fullFace 2) 1 ∧
    (Finsupp.single (fullFace 2) (1 : ℤ) : Chain (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ℤ 2) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let p := (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1).trans (Equiv.swap (1 : Fin 3) 2)
  have hm : VertexMap.comp (fullMap (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1))
      (fullMap (Equiv.swap (1 : Fin 3) 2)) = fullMap p := by
    apply VertexMap.ext
    intro i
    rfl
  refine ⟨?_, Finsupp.single_ne_zero.mpr (by decide)⟩
  rw [hm, fullMap_single, one_smul]
  have h := orientedTuple_comp_perm (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 3)) ℤ
    (fun i => i) p
  have hs : Equiv.Perm.sign p = 1 := by
    simp [p, Equiv.Perm.sign_trans, Equiv.Perm.sign_swap (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 1),
      Equiv.Perm.sign_swap (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2)]
  simpa [hs, Function.comp_def, orientedTuple_id] using h

name: TDA.Simplicial.boundary_chainIncl
statement:
theorem boundary_chainIncl (h : K ≤ L) (n : ℕ) :
    (boundary L R n).comp (chainIncl R h (n + 1)) =
      (chainIncl R h n).comp (boundary K R n)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro s a
  change boundary L R n
      (chainIncl R h (n + 1) (Finsupp.single s a)) =
    chainIncl R h n (boundary K R n (Finsupp.single s a))
  rw [chainIncl_single, boundary_single, boundary_single, map_smul, map_sum]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [chainIncl_single, faceIncl_deletedFace]

name: TDA.Simplicial.simplicialChainIncl_comp
statement:
theorem simplicialChainIncl_comp (h : K ≤ L) (g : L ≤ M) :
    simplicialChainIncl R (h.trans g) =
      simplicialChainIncl R h ≫ simplicialChainIncl R g
proof:
:= by
  apply HomologicalComplex.hom_ext
  intro n
  simp only [simplicialChainIncl_f, HomologicalComplex.comp_f]
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  change chainIncl R (h.trans g) n =
    (chainIncl R g n).comp (chainIncl R h n)
  exact chainIncl_comp R h g n

name: TDA.Mapper.componentCover_interMember_subset_preimage
statement:
theorem componentCover_interMember_subset_preimage :
    interMember (componentCover f U) s ⊆ f ⁻¹' ⋂ i ∈ s.image Sigma.fst, U i
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_iInter₂]
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hi
  exact ((mem_interMember_iff _).1 hx a ha).1

name: TDA.Mapper.interMemberPreimageMap_injective
statement:
theorem interMemberPreimageMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (interMemberPreimageMap f U s)
proof:
:= by
  intro c d hcd
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective c
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective d
  set P : Set X := f ⁻¹' ⋂ i ∈ s.image Sigma.fst, U i with hPdef
  have hxP : x.1 ∈ P := componentCover_interMember_subset_preimage f U s x.2
  have hyP : y.1 ∈ P := componentCover_interMember_subset_preimage f U s y.2
  have hcd' : (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x.1, hxP⟩ : ZerothHomotopy P) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨y.1, hyP⟩ := hcd
  have hxy : JoinedIn P x.1 y.1 := (joinedIn_iff_joined hxP hyP).2 (Quotient.exact hcd')
  let C := pathComponentIn P x.1
  have hC : IsPathConnected C := isPathConnected_pathComponentIn hxP
  have hCP : C ⊆ P := pathComponentIn_subset
  have hxC : x.1 ∈ C := mem_pathComponentIn_self hxP
  have hCsub : C ⊆ interMember (componentCover f U) s := by
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_interMember_iff]
    intro a ha
    have hτa : a.1 ∈ s.image Sigma.fst := Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ha
    have hPU : P ⊆ f ⁻¹' U a.1 := fun w hw => mem_iInter₂.1 hw a.1 hτa
    have hzU : f z ∈ U a.1 := hPU (hCP hz)
    obtain ⟨hxU, hxc⟩ := (mem_interMember_iff _).1 x.2 a ha
    have hxz : JoinedIn (f ⁻¹' U a.1) x.1 z :=
      (hC.joinedIn _ hxC _ hz).mono (hCP.trans hPU)
    exact ⟨hzU, (mk_eq_of_joinedIn f (U a.1) hxz hxU hzU).symm.trans hxc⟩
  exact ZerothHomotopy.sound ((hC.joinedIn _ hxC _ hxy).mono hCsub).joined_subtype.somePath

theorem multiNerveMapper_projection_multiNerveMapperMap {U : I → Set Y} {V : J → Set Y}
    (R : Refinement U V) (c : multiNerveMapper f U) :
    (multiNerveMapper_projection f V (multiNerveMapperMap f R c)).1 =
      (multiNerveMapper_projection f U c).1.image (mapperMap f R)
proof:
:=
  projection_multiNerveMap (componentRefinement f R) c

name: TDA.Mapper.multiNerveMapperMap_vertexCell
statement:
theorem multiNerveMapperMap_vertexCell {U : I → Set Y} {V : J → Set Y} (R : Refinement U V)
    (a : ComponentIndex f U) :
    multiNerveMapperMap f R (vertexCell f U a) = vertexCell f V (mapperMap f R a)
proof:
:= by
  apply eq_vertexCell_of_support_eq
  rw [support_multiNerveMapperMap, support_vertexCell, Finset.image_singleton]
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.CoherentCoverTower.multiNerveMapperMap_refl
statement:
theorem multiNerveMapperMap_refl (f : C(X, Y)) (q : P) :
    T.multiNerveMapperMap f (le_refl q) = id
proof:
:= by
  have hrefinement : T.refinement (q := q) (r := q) (le_refl q) =
      Refinement.id (T.cover q) := by
    apply Refinement.ext
    intro i
    exact congrFun (T.selector_refl q) i
  unfold multiNerveMapperMap
  rw [hrefinement]
  exact TDA.Mapper.multiNerveMapperMap_id f (T.cover q)

name: TDA.Mapper.CoherentCoverTower.multiNerveMapperMap_trans
statement:
theorem multiNerveMapperMap_trans (f : C(X, Y)) {q r t : P} (h : q ≤ r) (k : r ≤ t) :
    T.multiNerveMapperMap f k ∘ T.multiNerveMapperMap f h =
      T.multiNerveMapperMap f (h.trans k)
proof:
:= by
  have hrefinement : Refinement.comp (T.refinement h) (T.refinement k) =
      T.refinement (h.trans k) := by
    apply Refinement.ext
    intro i
    exact congrFun (T.selector_trans h k) i
  unfold multiNerveMapperMap
  rw [← TDA.Mapper.multiNerveMapperMap_comp, hrefinement]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.continuous_mergeSectionPoint
statement:
private theorem continuous_mergeSectionPoint (c M : ℝ) (h0c : 0 < c) (hcM : c ≤ M) :
    Continuous (mergeSectionPoint c M h0c hcM)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let z : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => (Set.projIcc 0 M (le_trans h0c.le hcM) y : ℝ)
  let topDen : ℝ := if c = M then 1 else M - c
  let lower : ℝ → Realization mergeY := fun y =>
    edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 (Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one (z y / c))
  let upper : ℝ → Realization mergeY := fun y =>
    edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23
      (Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one ((z y - c) / topDen))
  have hz : Continuous z := by
    exact continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_projIcc
  have hden : topDen ≠ 0 := by
    dsimp [topDen]
    split_ifs with h
    · norm_num
    · have hlt : c < M := by
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hcM with hlt | heq
        · exact hlt
        · exact (h heq).elim
      exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (by linarith)
  have hlower : Continuous lower := by
    dsimp [lower]
    exact (continuous_edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02).comp
      (continuous_projIcc.comp (hz.div_const c))
  have hupper : Continuous upper := by
    dsimp [upper]
    exact (continuous_edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23).comp
      (continuous_projIcc.comp ((hz.sub continuous_const).div_const topDen))
  have hzg : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => c := continuous_const
  change Continuous fun y => if z y ≤ c then lower y else upper y
  exact hlower.if_le hupper hz hzg fun y hy => by
    have hzero : z y - c = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr hy
    have hratio₁ : z y / c = 1 := by rw [hy]; exact div_self h0c.ne'
    have hratio₂ : (z y - c) / topDen = 0 := by rw [hzero, zero_div]
    have h₁ : Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one (z y / c) = (1 : unitInterval) := by
      rw [hratio₁]
      exact Set.projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one (by norm_num)
    have h₂ : Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one ((z y - c) / topDen) = (0 : unitInterval) := by
      rw [hratio₂]
      exact Set.projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one (by norm_num)
    change edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 _ = edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 _
    rw [h₁, h₂, edgePoint_one, edgePoint_zero]
    rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeSection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem mergeSection_apply (c M : ℝ) (h0c : 0 < c) (hcM : c ≤ M) (y : ℝ) :
    mergeSection c M h0c hcM y = mergeSectionPoint c M h0c hcM y
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeSection_lower
statement:
theorem mergeSection_lower (c M : ℝ) (h0c : 0 < c) (hcM : c ≤ M) (t : unitInterval) :
    mergeSection c M h0c hcM (c * (t : ℝ)) = edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 t
proof:
:= by
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ (t : ℝ) := t.2.1
  have ht1 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 := t.2.2
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ c * (t : ℝ) := mul_nonneg h0c.le ht0
  have hyM : c * (t : ℝ) ≤ M := by
    calc
      c * (t : ℝ) ≤ c := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht1 h0c.le]
      _ ≤ M := hcM
  have hclamp : (Set.projIcc 0 M (le_trans h0c.le hcM) (c * (t : ℝ)) : ℝ) = c * (t : ℝ) := by
    rw [Set.projIcc_of_mem (le_trans h0c.le hcM) ⟨hy0, hyM⟩]
  have hratio : c * (t : ℝ) / c = (t : ℝ) := by
    field_simp [h0c.ne']
  have hproj : Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one (c * (t : ℝ) / c) = t := by
    rw [hratio]
    exact Set.projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one t.2
  have hbranch : c * (t : ℝ) ≤ c := by
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht1 h0c.le]
  simp only [mergeSection_apply, mergeSectionPoint, hclamp, if_pos hbranch, hproj]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeSection_upper
statement:
theorem mergeSection_upper (c M : ℝ) (h0c : 0 < c) (hcM : c ≤ M) (hcM' : c < M)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    mergeSection c M h0c hcM (c + (M - c) * (t : ℝ)) = edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 t
proof:
:= by
  have hMc : 0 < M - c := sub_pos.mpr hcM'
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ (t : ℝ) := t.2.1
  have ht1 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 := t.2.2
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ c + (M - c) * (t : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hyM : c + (M - c) * (t : ℝ) ≤ M := by nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht1 hMc.le]
  have hclamp :
      (Set.projIcc 0 M (le_trans h0c.le hcM) (c + (M - c) * (t : ℝ)) : ℝ) =
        c + (M - c) * (t : ℝ) := by
    rw [Set.projIcc_of_mem (le_trans h0c.le hcM) ⟨hy0, hyM⟩]
  by_cases htzero : (t : ℝ) = 0
  · have hden : (if c = M then (1 : ℝ) else M - c) = M - c := by
      simp [ne_of_lt hcM']
    have htzero' : t = 0 := Subtype.ext htzero
    subst t
    have hratio : c / c = 1 := div_self h0c.ne'
    have hproj : Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one (c / c) = (1 : unitInterval) := by
      rw [hratio]
      exact Set.projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one (by norm_num)
    have hclamp0 : (Set.projIcc 0 M (le_trans h0c.le hcM) c : ℝ) = c := by
      exact congrArg Subtype.val
        (Set.projIcc_of_mem (le_trans h0c.le hcM) ⟨h0c.le, hcM⟩)
    simp [mergeSection, mergeSectionPoint, hclamp0, hratio,
      edgePoint_one, edgePoint_zero]
  have htpos : 0 < (t : ℝ) := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le t.2.1 with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact (htzero h.symm).elim
  have hgt : c < c + (M - c) * (t : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hcM') htpos]
  have hratio :
      (c + (M - c) * (t : ℝ) - c) / (M - c) = (t : ℝ) := by
    rw [show c + (M - c) * (t : ℝ) - c = (M - c) * (t : ℝ) by ring,
      mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ hMc.ne']
  have hproj :
      Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one
          ((c + (M - c) * (t : ℝ) - c) / (M - c)) = t := by
    rw [hratio]
    exact Set.projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one t.2
  have hden : (if c = M then (1 : ℝ) else M - c) = M - c := by
    simp [ne_of_lt hcM']
  rw [mergeSection_apply]
  unfold mergeSectionPoint
  simp only [hclamp]
  rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hgt), hden, hproj]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeSection_at_top_apex
statement:
theorem mergeSection_at_top_apex (M : ℝ) (hM : 0 < M) (y : ℝ) :
    mergeSection M M hM le_rfl y = edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02
      (Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one
        (((Set.projIcc 0 M hM.le y : ℝ) : ℝ) / M))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mergeSection_apply]
  unfold mergeSectionPoint
  have hclamp_le : (Set.projIcc 0 M hM.le y : ℝ) ≤ M :=
    (Set.projIcc 0 M hM.le y).2.2
  simp only [if_pos hclamp_le]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.plHeight_mergeSection
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hyc : y ≤ c
  · have ht : (y / c : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 := by
      constructor
      · exact div_nonneg hy.1 h0c.le
      · exact (div_le_one h0c).2 hyc
    have hclamp : (Set.projIcc 0 M (le_trans h0c.le hcM) y : ℝ) = y := by
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (Set.projIcc_of_mem (le_trans h0c.le hcM) hy)
    have hparam : Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one (y / c) = ⟨y / c, ht⟩ :=
      Set.projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one ht
    rw [mergeSection_apply]
    unfold mergeSectionPoint
    simp only [hclamp]
    rw [if_pos hyc, hparam]
    simp [GraphPL.plHeight_edgePoint, GraphPL.dartHeight, mergeHeights, mergeFoldD02]
    field_simp [h0c.ne']
  · have hcy : c < y := lt_of_not_ge hyc
    have hcM' : c < M := by linarith [hcy, hy.2]
    have hden : (if c = M then (1 : ℝ) else M - c) = M - c := by
      simp [ne_of_lt hcM']
    have ht : ((y - c) / (M - c) : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 := by
      constructor
      · exact div_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hcy.le) (sub_nonneg.mpr hcM)
      · exact (div_le_one (sub_pos.mpr hcM')).2 (by linarith [hy.2])
    have hclamp : (Set.projIcc 0 M (le_trans h0c.le hcM) y : ℝ) = y := by
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (Set.projIcc_of_mem (le_trans h0c.le hcM) hy)
    have hparam : Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one ((y - c) / (M - c)) =
        ⟨(y - c) / (M - c), ht⟩ := Set.projIcc_of_mem zero_le_one ht
    have hden0 : M - c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hcM')
    have hden1 : -c + M ≠ 0 := by linarith
    rw [mergeSection_apply]
    unfold mergeSectionPoint
    simp only [hclamp]
    rw [if_neg (not_le.mpr hcy), hden, hparam]
    simp [GraphPL.plHeight_edgePoint, GraphPL.dartHeight, mergeHeights, mergeFoldD23]
    change (1 - ((y - c) / (M - c))) * c + ((y - c) / (M - c)) * M = y
    field_simp [hden0]; ring_nf

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.castPath_apply
proof:
:= by
  exact congrFun (Path.cast_coe γ hx hy) t

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeFoldHeight_d02
statement:
private theorem mergeFoldHeight_d02 (c M : ℝ) (t : unitInterval) :
    plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 t) = c * (t : ℝ)
proof:
:= by

:= by
  simp [GraphPL.plHeight_edgePoint, GraphPL.dartHeight, mergeHeights, mergeFoldD23]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeSection_top_eq_d23zero
proof:
:= by
  subst M
  calc
    mergeSection c c h0c le_rfl c = mergeSection c c h0c le_rfl (c * (1 : ℝ)) := by rw [mul_one]
    _ = edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 1 := mergeSection_lower c c h0c le_rfl 1
    _ = edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 0 := by
      rw [edgePoint_one, edgePoint_zero]
      simp [mergeFoldD02, mergeFoldD23]

    vertex mergeY mergeFoldD12.snd = edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 1

  simp [mergeFoldD02, mergeFoldD12]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeFoldPathD02_target
statement:
private theorem mergeFoldPathD02_target (c M : ℝ) (h0c : 0 < c) (hcM : c ≤ M)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    mergeSection c M h0c hcM
        (plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 t)) =
      edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 t

:= by

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeFoldPathD12_target
statement:
private theorem mergeFoldPathD12_target (c M : ℝ) (h0c : 0 < c) (hcM : c ≤ M)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    mergeSection c M h0c hcM
        (plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD12 t)) =
      edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 t
proof:
:= by
  rw [mergeFoldHeight_d12, mergeSection_lower]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeFoldPathD23_target_top
statement:
private theorem mergeFoldPathD23_target_top (c M : ℝ) (h0c : 0 < c) (hcM : c ≤ M)
    (t : unitInterval) (hcm : c = M) :
    mergeSection c M h0c hcM
        (plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 t)) =
      edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 0
proof:
:= by
  have hheight :
      plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 t) = M := by
    rw [mergeFoldHeight_d23, hcm]
    ring
  calc
    _ = mergeSection c M h0c hcM M := congrArg (mergeSection c M h0c hcM) hheight
    _ = edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 0 := mergeSection_top_eq_d23zero c M h0c hcM hcm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeFoldPathD23_target_self
statement:
private theorem mergeFoldPathD23_target_self (c M : ℝ) (h0c : 0 < c) (hcM : c ≤ M)
    (t : unitInterval) (hcM' : c < M) :
    mergeSection c M h0c hcM
        (plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 t)) =
      edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 t
proof:
:= by
  rw [mergeFoldHeight_d23, mergeSection_upper c M h0c hcM hcM']

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeFoldDart_cases
statement:
private theorem mergeFoldDart_cases (d : mergeY.Dart) :
    d = mergeFoldD02 ∨ d = mergeFoldD02.symm ∨
      d = mergeFoldD12 ∨ d = mergeFoldD12.symm ∨
      d = mergeFoldD23 ∨ d = mergeFoldD23.symm
proof:
:= by
  rcases d with ⟨⟨u, v⟩, huv⟩
  rcases (mergeY_adj u v).1 huv with h | h | h | h | h | h
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    left
    apply SimpleGraph.Dart.ext
    rfl
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    right
    left
    apply SimpleGraph.Dart.ext
    rfl
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    right
    right
    left
    apply SimpleGraph.Dart.ext
    rfl
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    right
    right
    right
    left
    apply SimpleGraph.Dart.ext
    rfl
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    right
    right
    right
    right
    left
    apply SimpleGraph.Dart.ext
    rfl
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    right
    right
    right
    right
    right
    apply SimpleGraph.Dart.ext
    rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edgePoint_reverse
statement:
private theorem edgePoint_reverse (d : mergeY.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    edgePoint mergeY d.symm t = edgePoint mergeY d (unitInterval.symm t)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    edgePoint mergeY d.symm t = edgePoint mergeY d.symm (unitInterval.symm (unitInterval.symm t)) := by simp
    _ = edgePoint mergeY d (unitInterval.symm t) := edgePoint_symm mergeY d _

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeFoldD12Route_height
statement:
private theorem mergeFoldD12Route_height (c M : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (t r : unitInterval) :
    c * (t : ℝ) ≤
        plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (mergeFoldD12Route t r) ∧
      plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (mergeFoldD12Route t r) ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  have hct : c * (t : ℝ) ≤ c := by
    calc
      c * (t : ℝ) ≤ c * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left t.2.2 hc
      _ = c := by ring
  have hD12 (u : unitInterval) :
      c * (t : ℝ) ≤ mergeFoldHeight c M (edgeSegment mergeY mergeFoldD12 t 1 u) ∧
        mergeFoldHeight c M (edgeSegment mergeY mergeFoldD12 t 1 u) ≤ c := by
    have h := GraphPL.plHeight_edgeSegment_bounds mergeY (mergeHeights c M)
      mergeFoldD12 t 1 u
    change min (mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD12 t))
        (mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD12 1)) ≤ _ ∧
      _ ≤ max (mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD12 t))
        (mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD12 1)) at h
    have hone : ((1 : unitInterval) : ℝ) = 1 := rfl
    rw [mergeFoldHeight_d12 c M t, mergeFoldHeight_d12 c M 1, hone, mul_one,
      min_eq_left hct, max_eq_right hct] at h
    exact h
  have hD02 (u : unitInterval) :
      c * (t : ℝ) ≤ mergeFoldHeight c M (edgeSegment mergeY mergeFoldD02 1 t u) ∧
        mergeFoldHeight c M (edgeSegment mergeY mergeFoldD02 1 t u) ≤ c := by
    have h := GraphPL.plHeight_edgeSegment_bounds mergeY (mergeHeights c M)
      mergeFoldD02 1 t u
    change min (mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 1))
        (mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 t)) ≤ _ ∧
      _ ≤ max (mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 1))
        (mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 t)) at h
    have hone : ((1 : unitInterval) : ℝ) = 1 := rfl
    rw [mergeFoldHeight_d02 c M 1, mergeFoldHeight_d02 c M t, hone, mul_one,
      min_eq_right hct, max_eq_left hct] at h
    exact h
  unfold mergeFoldD12Route
  rw [Path.trans_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · let u : unitInterval := ⟨2 * (r : ℝ),
      (unitInterval.mul_pos_mem_iff (by norm_num)).2 ⟨r.2.1, h⟩⟩
    simpa only [castPath_apply, mergeFoldHeight] using hD12 u
  · have hr0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ r := r.2.1
    have hr1 : (r : ℝ) ≤ 1 := r.2.2
    have hq0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (r : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
    have hq1 : 2 * (r : ℝ) - 1 ≤ 1 := by linarith
    let u : unitInterval := ⟨2 * (r : ℝ) - 1, ⟨hq0, hq1⟩⟩
    simpa only [castPath_apply, mergeFoldHeight] using hD02 u

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeFoldPath_d02_good
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mergeFoldPathD02 c M h0c hcM t, fun s => ?_⟩
  have hpath : mergeFoldPathD02 c M h0c hcM t s = edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD02 t := by
    exact (castPath_apply _ _ _ _).trans (Path.refl_apply _ _)
  have hpathHeight := congrArg (mergeFoldHeight c M) hpath
  constructor
  · intro hs
    exact ⟨hpathHeight.symm.le, hpathHeight.le.trans hs⟩
  · intro _
    exact hpathHeight

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeFoldPath_d12_good
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mergeFoldPathD12 c M h0c hcM t, fun s => ?_⟩
  have hpath : mergeFoldPathD12 c M h0c hcM t s = mergeFoldD12Route t s := by
    exact castPath_apply _ _ _ _
  have hroute := mergeFoldD12Route_height c M h0c.le t s
  have hroute' :
      mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD12 t) ≤
          mergeFoldHeight c M (mergeFoldD12Route t s) ∧
        mergeFoldHeight c M (mergeFoldD12Route t s) ≤ c := by
    rw [mergeFoldHeight_d12]
    exact hroute
  have hpathHeight := congrArg (mergeFoldHeight c M) hpath
  constructor
  · intro _
    exact ⟨hroute'.1.trans hpathHeight.symm.le, hpathHeight.le.trans hroute'.2⟩
  · intro hgt
    have hstart : c * (t : ℝ) ≤ c := by
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left t.2.2 h0c.le]
    have hgt' : c < c * (t : ℝ) := by
      simpa [GraphPL.dartHeight, mergeHeights, mergeFoldD12, mul_comm] using hgt
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hstart hgt').elim

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeFoldPath_d23_top_height
proof:
:= by
  have hbounds := GraphPL.plHeight_edgeSegment_bounds mergeY (mergeHeights c M)
    mergeFoldD23 t 0 s
  change min (mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 t))
      (mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 0)) ≤ _ ∧
    _ ≤ max (mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 t))
      (mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 0)) at hbounds
  rw [mergeFoldHeight_d23 c M t, mergeFoldHeight_d23 c M 0, hcm] at hbounds
  simp only [sub_self, zero_mul, add_zero, min_self, max_self] at hbounds
  change M ≤ mergeFoldHeight M M (edgeSegment mergeY mergeFoldD23 t 0 s) ∧
    mergeFoldHeight M M (edgeSegment mergeY mergeFoldD23 t 0 s) ≤ M at hbounds
  have hEq : mergeFoldHeight M M (edgeSegment mergeY mergeFoldD23 t 0 s) = M :=
    le_antisymm hbounds.2 hbounds.1
  simpa [hcm] using hEq

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeFoldPath_d23_good
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hcm : c = M
  · refine ⟨mergeFoldPathD23 c M h0c hcM t, fun s => ?_⟩
    have hstart : mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 t) = c := by
      rw [mergeFoldHeight_d23, hcm]
      ring
    have hpath :
        mergeFoldHeight c M (mergeFoldPathD23 c M h0c hcM t s) = c := by
      have hpath' :
          mergeFoldPathD23 c M h0c hcM t s = edgeSegment mergeY mergeFoldD23 t 0 s := by
        simp only [mergeFoldPathD23, hcm]
        exact castPath_apply (edgeSegment mergeY mergeFoldD23 t 0) rfl
          (mergeFoldPathD23_target_top c M h0c hcM t hcm) s
      calc
        mergeFoldHeight c M (mergeFoldPathD23 c M h0c hcM t s) =
            mergeFoldHeight c M (edgeSegment mergeY mergeFoldD23 t 0 s) :=
          congrArg (mergeFoldHeight c M) hpath'
        _ = c := mergeFoldPath_d23_top_height c M hcm t s
    constructor
    · intro _
      exact ⟨hstart.le.trans hpath.symm.le, hpath.le⟩
    · intro _
      exact hpath.trans hstart.symm
  · have hcM' : c < M := by
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hcM with h | heq
      · exact h
      · exact (hcm heq).elim
    refine ⟨mergeFoldPathD23 c M h0c hcM t, fun s => ?_⟩
    have hpath :
        mergeFoldPathD23 c M h0c hcM t s = edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 t := by
      simp only [mergeFoldPathD23, hcm]
      exact castPath_apply (Path.refl (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 t)) rfl
        (mergeFoldPathD23_target_self c M h0c hcM t hcM') s
    have hpathHeight :
        mergeFoldHeight c M (mergeFoldPathD23 c M h0c hcM t s) =
          mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 t) :=
      congrArg (mergeFoldHeight c M) hpath
    have hstart_le : c ≤ mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 t) := by
      rw [mergeFoldHeight_d23]
      have ht0 : 0 ≤ (t : ℝ) := t.2.1
      have hMc : 0 ≤ M - c := by linarith
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hMc ht0]
    constructor
    · intro hle
      have heq : mergeFoldHeight c M (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 t) = c := le_antisymm hle hstart_le
      exact ⟨hpathHeight.symm.le, hpathHeight.le.trans heq.le⟩
    · intro _
      exact hpathHeight.trans rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.exists_mergeSection_path
statement:
theorem exists_mergeSection_path (c M : ℝ) (h0c : 0 < c) (hcM : c ≤ M)
    (x : Realization mergeY) :
    ∃ γ : Path x (mergeSection c M h0c hcM (plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x)),
      ∀ t,
        (plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x ≤ c →
          plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x ≤ plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (γ t) ∧
            plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (γ t) ≤ c) ∧
        (c < plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x →
          plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (γ t) =
            plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x)
proof:
:= by
  apply ind mergeY (p := mergeFoldPathProperty c M h0c hcM)
  · intro v
    fin_cases v
    · simpa [mergeFoldD02, edgePoint_zero] using mergeFoldPath_d02_good c M h0c hcM 0
    · simpa [mergeFoldD12, edgePoint_zero] using mergeFoldPath_d12_good c M h0c hcM 0
    · simpa [mergeFoldD02, edgePoint_one] using mergeFoldPath_d02_good c M h0c hcM 1
    · simpa [mergeFoldD23, edgePoint_one] using mergeFoldPath_d23_good c M h0c hcM 1
  · intro d t
    rcases mergeFoldDart_cases d with h | h | h | h | h | h
    · rw [h]
      exact mergeFoldPath_d02_good c M h0c hcM t
    · rw [h, edgePoint_reverse]
      exact mergeFoldPath_d02_good c M h0c hcM (unitInterval.symm t)
    · rw [h]
      exact mergeFoldPath_d12_good c M h0c hcM t
    · rw [h, edgePoint_reverse]
      exact mergeFoldPath_d12_good c M h0c hcM (unitInterval.symm t)
    · rw [h]
      exact mergeFoldPath_d23_good c M h0c hcM t
    · rw [h, edgePoint_reverse]
      exact mergeFoldPath_d23_good c M h0c hcM (unitInterval.symm t)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeFoldHeight_mem_Icc
proof:
:= by
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := hc0.trans hcM
  apply plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall
  intro v
  fin_cases v <;> simp [mergeHeights, hc0, hcM, hM0]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeFoldPath_deviation_le
statement:
private theorem mergeFoldPath_deviation_le (c B M : ℝ) (h0c : 0 < c) (hcM : c ≤ M)
    (hcb : c ≤ B) (x : Realization mergeY) (γ : Path x
      (mergeSection c M h0c hcM (plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x)))
    (hγ : ∀ t,
      (plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x ≤ c →
        plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x ≤ plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (γ t) ∧
          plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (γ t) ≤ c) ∧
      (c < plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x →
        plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (γ t) =
          plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x)) :
    ∀ t, |plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) (γ t) -
      plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x| ≤ B
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : 0 ≤ plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x :=
    (mergeFoldHeight_mem_Icc c M h0c.le hcM x).1
  have hB0 : 0 ≤ B := h0c.le.trans hcb
  intro t
  by_cases hle : plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x ≤ c
  · obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := (hγ t).1 hle
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlo)]
    have hdiff := sub_le_sub_right hhi (plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x)
    linarith
  · have hgt : c < plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights c M) x := lt_of_not_ge hle
    rw [(hγ t).2 hgt, sub_self, abs_zero]
    exact hB0

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY_eq_min
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY_eq_min {a b M : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hbM : b ≤ M) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M))
      (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights b M)) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (min (b - a) (b / 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hbudget :
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M))
        (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights b M)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b - a) := by
    rw [← edist_mergeHeights hab.le]
    exact geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le_edist mergeY _ _
  have hfold := geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le_of_heightMapPair
    (mergeFoldHeightMapPair ha hab hbM)
  have hfold' :
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M))
        (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights b M)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b / 2) := by
    have hconvert : ENNReal.ofReal (b / 2) =
        ENNReal.ofNNReal (⟨b / 2, by linarith [ha, hab]⟩ : ℝ≥0) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_coe_nnreal (by linarith [ha, hab])]
      rfl
    rw [hconvert]
    exact hfold
  have hupper :
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M))
        (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights b M)) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (min (b - a) (b / 2)) := by
    rw [ENNReal.ofReal_min]
    exact le_min hbudget hfold'
  exact le_antisymm hupper
    (ofReal_min_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY ha hab hbM)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY_eq_half
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY_eq_half {a b M : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (h2a : 2 * a ≤ b) (hbM : b ≤ M) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M))
      (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights b M)) = ENNReal.ofReal (b / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY_eq_min ha hab hbM,
    min_eq_right (by linarith : b / 2 ≤ b - a)]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY_lt_vertex_budget
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY_lt_vertex_budget {a b M : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (h2a : 2 * a < b) (hbM : b ≤ M) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M))
      (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights b M)) < ENNReal.ofReal (b - a)
proof:
:= by
  have hab : a < b := by linarith
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY_eq_min ha hab hbM,
    ENNReal.ofReal_min]
  rw [min_eq_right ((ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (by linarith : 0 ≤ b - a)).2
    (by linarith : b / 2 ≤ b - a))]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by linarith : 0 < b - a) |>.2 (by linarith)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_splitY_eq_min
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_splitY_eq_min {a b M : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hbM : b ≤ M) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (splitHeights a M))
      (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (splitHeights b M)) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (min (b - a) (b / 2))
proof:
:= by
  unfold splitHeights
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_neg]
  exact geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY_eq_min ha hab hbM

name: TDA.Mapper.stepMapperDiagram_eq_ofIndexBars_succ
statement:
theorem stepMapperDiagram_eq_ofIndexBars_succ :
    stepMapperDiagram k f c cover r n =
      ofIndexBars c c.strictMono (mapperBarcode k f (fun j : Fin m => cover j.succ)
        (fun h => r (Fin.succ_le_succ_iff.mpr h)) n)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ j, FiniteDimensional k ((reindex c.toOrderHom
      (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower c cover) (stepRefinement c cover r) n)).obj j) :=
    finiteDimensional_stepTower k f c cover r n
  change ofIndexBars c c.strictMono (rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom
    (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower c cover) (stepRefinement c cover r) n))) = _
  congr 1
  exact rankBarcode_eq_of_iso (eqToIso (congrArg
    (fun s : Fin m →o Fin (m + 1) => reindex s (mapperHomologyPModule k f cover r n))
    (cellIndex_comp_grid c)))

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_le

    (ζ : ∀ t, Refinement (stepTower c cover t) (stepTower d cover' (t + η)))

    bottleneck (stepMapperDiagram k f c cover r n) (stepMapperDiagram k f d cover' r' n) ≤ η
proof:

    (isConstructible_stepTower d cover' k f r' n) _ _
    (mapperHomologyInterleaving k f (stepRefinement c cover r) (stepRefinement d cover' r') ζ ξ n)

        (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower c cover) (stepRefinement c cover r) n)
        (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower d cover') (stepRefinement d cover' r') n)) ↔
      ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching (stepMapperDiagram k f c cover r n).finiteOccurrences
          (stepMapperDiagram k f d cover' r' n).finiteOccurrences
          (stepMapperDiagram k f c cover r n).essentialOccurrences
          (stepMapperDiagram k f d cover' r' n).essentialOccurrences,
        A.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:=
  interleaving_iff_matching (isConstructible_stepTower c cover k f r n)
    (isConstructible_stepTower d cover' k f r' n) _ _ ε

      (essentialPart (stepMapperDiagram k f c cover r n).points).card ≠
        (essentialPart (stepMapperDiagram k f d cover' r' n).points).card

    (isConstructible_stepTower d cover' k f r' n) _ _

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_le_add

theorem bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_le_add {IndexV : ℝ → Type u}

    (rV : ∀ {s t : ℝ}, s ≤ t → Refinement (V s) (V t)) {η₁ η₂ : ℝ≥0}
    (ζ₁ : ∀ t, Refinement (stepTower c cover t) (V (t + η₁)))
    (ξ₁ : ∀ t, Refinement (V t) (stepTower c cover (t + η₁)))
    (ζ₂ : ∀ t, Refinement (V t) (stepTower e cover'' (t + η₂)))
    (ξ₂ : ∀ t, Refinement (stepTower e cover'' t) (V (t + η₂))) :
    bottleneck (stepMapperDiagram k f c cover r n) (stepMapperDiagram k f e cover'' r'' n) ≤
      η₁ + η₂

:=

    (isConstructible_stepTower e cover'' k f r'' n) _ _).trans
    (realInterleavingDistance_mapperHomologyPModule_le_add k f (stepRefinement c cover r) n rV
      (stepRefinement e cover'' r'') ζ₁ ξ₁ ζ₂ ξ₂)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.finrank_range_homologyMap_zero_pos

private theorem finrank_range_homologyMap_zero_pos {W : Type} [LinearOrder W]
    {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W} [Finite (Face L 0)] (g : VertexMap K L) (σ : Face K 0) :
    0 < Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyMap k g 0).hom)
proof:
:= by
  let τ := vertexImageFace g σ (fun i j _ => Fin.ext (by omega))
  have hclass := simplicialHomologyMap_class k g 0 (zeroVertexCycle K k σ)
    (zeroVertexCycle L k τ) (vertexChainMap_vertex k g σ 1)
  have hne := simplicialHomologyClass_zeroVertexCycle_ne_zero L k τ
  apply Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
  refine ⟨⟨_, ⟨_, hclass⟩⟩, ?_⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.natCard_componentIndex
