private theorem natCard_componentIndex
    (hsub : ∀ i, Subsingleton (ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace f U i)))
    (hne : ∀ i, Nonempty (PullbackSpace f U i)) :
    Nat.card (ComponentIndex f U) = Nat.card I
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective (fun a : ComponentIndex f U => a.1)
    ⟨fun a b h => Sigma.ext h (Subsingleton.helim
      (congrArg (fun i => ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace f U i)) h) a.2 b.2),
      fun i => ⟨⟨i, ZerothHomotopy.mk (hne i).some⟩, rfl⟩⟩)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.isEmpty_face_one_of_disjoint
statement:
private theorem isEmpty_face_one_of_disjoint (hU : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (U i) (U j)) :
    IsEmpty (Face (mapper f U) 1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun σ => by
    classical
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hσ⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.1 σ.2.2
    obtain ⟨_, x, hx⟩ := (mem_mapper_iff f U σ.1).1 σ.2.1
    have ha : a ∈ σ.1 := by simp [hσ]
    have hb : b ∈ σ.1 := by simp [hσ]
    by_cases hi : a.1 = b.1
    · exact hab (eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq f U σ.2.1 ha hb hi)
    · obtain ⟨hxa, _⟩ := hx a ha
      obtain ⟨hxb, _⟩ := hx b hb
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (hU _ _ hi) hxa hxb⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.preimage_subsingleton
statement:
private theorem preimage_subsingleton {V : Type} {G : SimpleGraph V} {h : V → ℝ}
    {K : OpenInterval} (v₀ : V) (hv₀ : h v₀ ∈ K)
    (hv : ∀ (v : V) (hv : h v ∈ K),
      (cellGraph G h K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨v, hv⟩) =
        (cellGraph G h K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩))
    (hcov : EndpointCoverage G h K) :
    Subsingleton (ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ K})
proof:
:= by
  have hcell : ∀ x : Cell G h K, (cellGraph G h K).connectedComponentMk x =
      (cellGraph G h K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩) := by
    rintro (⟨v, hvK⟩ | ⟨e, hact⟩)
    · exact hv v hvK
    · obtain ⟨w, hw, hwK⟩ := hcov e hact
      exact (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr G h K (v := ⟨w, hwK⟩) (e := ⟨e, hact⟩)
        hw).symm.trans (hv w hwK)
  have : Subsingleton (cellGraph G h K).ConnectedComponent :=
    ⟨ConnectedComponent.ind₂ fun x y => by rw [hcell x, hcell y]⟩
  exact ⟨fun c d => (preimageComponentsEquiv G h K).injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.edgeGraph_mem_edge
statement: private theorem edgeGraph_mem_edge (b : Bool) (e : edgeGraph.edgeSet) : b ∈ (e : Sym2 Bool)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
  rcases TDA.Reeb.Examples.GraphRealization.edgeGraph_dart d with rfl | rfl <;> cases b
  · exact fst_mem_dartEdge d₀
  · exact snd_mem_dartEdge d₀
  · exact snd_mem_dartEdge d₀.symm
  · exact fst_mem_dartEdge d₀.symm

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.edge_preimage_subsingleton
proof:
:=
  preimage_subsingleton b hb
    (fun v hv => by
      by_cases hvb : v = b
      · subst hvb
        rfl
      · exact connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_of_adj edgeGraph h K (u := ⟨v, hv⟩) (w := ⟨b, hb⟩) hvb)
    (fun e _ => ⟨b, edgeGraph_mem_edge b e, hb⟩)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.finrank_homology_one
proof:
:= by
  let : HasQuotient (simplicialCycles K ℚ 1) (Submodule ℚ (simplicialCycles K ℚ 1)) :=
    Submodule.hasQuotient (R := ℚ) (M := simplicialCycles K ℚ 1)
  have hhom := (homologyKernelQuotient.{0, 0, 0} ℚ (simplicialChainComplex K ℚ) 1).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq
  change Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology K ℚ 1) =
    Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialCycles K ℚ 1 ⧸ simplicialBoundaries K ℚ 1) at hhom
  have hB : simplicialBoundaries K ℚ 1 = ⊥ := by
    rw [eq_bot_iff]
    intro z hz
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff ℚ K 1 z).1 hz
    have hc0 : c = 0 := Finsupp.ext fun σ => isEmptyElim σ
    rw [hc0, map_zero] at hc
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot ℚ).2 (Subtype.ext hc.symm)
  rw [hhom, (Submodule.quotEquivOfEqBot _ hB).finrank_eq]
  exact congrArg (fun S : Submodule ℚ (Chain K ℚ 1) => Module.finrank ℚ S)
    (simplicialCycles_succ (R := ℚ) K 0)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.boundary_apply_vertex
statement:
private theorem boundary_apply_vertex (z : Chain K ℚ 1) (τ : Face K 0) :
    boundary K ℚ 0 z τ = ∑ σ, boundaryMatrix K ℚ 0 τ σ * z σ
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrFun (boundaryMatrix_mulVec K ℚ 0 z) τ
  rw [chainCoordinates_apply] at h
  rw [← h]
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, chainCoordinates_apply]

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.boundaryMatrix_vertex_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem boundaryMatrix_vertex_eq_zero (τ : Face K 0) (σ : Face K 1) {w : V}
    (hτ : τ.1 = {w}) (hw : w ∉ σ.1) : boundaryMatrix K ℚ 0 τ σ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply boundaryMatrix_eq_zero_of_not_deletedFace
  intro i hi
  apply hw
  have hsub : (deletedFace K 0 σ i).1 ⊆ σ.1 := Finset.erase_subset _ _
  rw [hi, hτ] at hsub
  exact hsub (Finset.mem_singleton_self w)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.boundaryMatrix_vertex_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem boundaryMatrix_vertex_ne_zero (τ : Face K 0) (σ : Face K 1) {w : V}
    (hτ : τ.1 = {w}) (hw : w ∈ σ.1) : boundaryMatrix K ℚ 0 τ σ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huw⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_ne (by rw [σ.2.2]; omega) w
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : u ∈ Set.range (σ.1.orderEmbOfFin σ.2.2) := by
    rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
    exact hu
  have hdel : deletedFace K 0 σ i = τ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change σ.1.erase (σ.1.orderEmbOfFin σ.2.2 i) = τ.1
    rw [hi, hτ]
    symm
    apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le
    · exact Finset.singleton_subset_iff.2 (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨huw.symm, hw⟩)
    · rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hu, σ.2.2, Finset.card_singleton]
  rw [← hdel, boundaryMatrix_deletedFace]
  exact pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.mapperBarcode_fin_zero
statement:
theorem mapperBarcode_fin_zero {X : Type} {Y : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (k : Type) [Field k] (f : C(X, Y)) {Index : Fin 0 → Type} (cover : (q : Fin 0) → Index q → Set Y)
    [∀ q, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f (cover q))]
    (r : ∀ {q t : Fin 0}, q ≤ t → Refinement (cover q) (cover t)) (n : ℕ)
    [∀ q, Finite (Face (mapper f (cover q)) n)] :
    mapperBarcode k f cover r n = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [mapperBarcode, rankBarcode]

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.emptyDomain_mapperBarcode
statement:
theorem emptyDomain_mapperBarcode {N : ℕ} {Index : Fin N → Type}
    (cover : (q : Fin N) → Index q → Set Unit)
    [∀ q, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex emptyMap (cover q))]
    (r : ∀ {q t : Fin N}, q ≤ t → Refinement (cover q) (cover t)) (k : Type) [Field k]
    (n : ℕ) :
    mapperBarcode k emptyMap cover r n = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapperBarcode_eq_iff]
  intro q t h
  rw [Multiset.countP_zero]
  apply Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
  calc _ ≤ Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (mapper emptyMap (cover q)) k n) :=
        LinearMap.finrank_range_le _
    _ = 0 := finrank_homology_eq_zero _ k n

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.merge_disjoint
statement:
private theorem merge_disjoint (q : Fin 2) (i j : mergeIndex q) (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (mergeCover q i) (mergeCover q j)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases q
  · change Fin 2 at i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
    all_goals first
      | exact absurd rfl hij
      | (rw [Set.disjoint_left]
         intro x hx hy
         simp only [mergeCover, mergeIntervals, mergeFine, coe_ioo, Set.mem_Ioo] at hx hy
         linarith [hx.1, hx.2, hy.1, hy.2])
  · exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim (α := Unit) i j) hij

proof:

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.merge_finrank_H0_values
statement:
theorem merge_finrank_H0_values :
    Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology (mapper (plHeight edgeGraph h01) (mergeCover 0)) ℚ 0) =
        2 ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ
        (simplicialHomology (mapper (plHeight edgeGraph h01) (mergeCover 1)) ℚ 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [merge_finrank_H0, merge_finrank_H0]
  exact ⟨by change Nat.card (Fin 2) = 2; simp, by change Nat.card Unit = 1; simp⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.merge_mapperBarcode
statement:
theorem merge_mapperBarcode :
    mapperBarcode ℚ (plHeight edgeGraph h01) mergeCover mergeRefinement 0 =
        {mergeBar02, mergeBar01} ∧
      mapperBarcode ℚ (plHeight edgeGraph h01) mergeCover mergeRefinement 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := merge_finrank_H0_values
  constructor
  · rw [mapperBarcode_eq_iff]
    intro q t h
    fin_cases q <;> fin_cases t
    · rw [mapperHomologyMap_eq_id, finrank_range_id]
      exact h0.trans (by decide)
    · apply le_antisymm
      · calc _ ≤ Module.finrank ℚ
              (simplicialHomology (mapper (plHeight edgeGraph h01) (mergeCover 1)) ℚ 0) :=
              Submodule.finrank_le _
          _ = _ := h1.trans (by decide)
      · let i : mergeIndex 0 := (0 : Fin 2)
        have hb := (merge_member_vertex 0 i).choose_spec
        let a : ComponentIndex (plHeight edgeGraph h01) (mergeCover 0) :=
          ⟨i, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨vertex edgeGraph _, hb⟩⟩
        calc _ = 1 := by decide
          _ ≤ _ := finrank_range_homologyMap_zero_pos _ ℚ _
            ⟨{a}, componentIndex_supported _ _ a, Finset.card_singleton a⟩
    · exact absurd h (by decide)
    · rw [mapperHomologyMap_eq_id, finrank_range_id]
      exact h1.trans (by decide)
  · rw [mapperBarcode_eq_iff]
    intro q t h
    rw [Multiset.countP_zero]
    apply Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
    calc _ ≤ Module.finrank ℚ
          (simplicialHomology (mapper (plHeight edgeGraph h01) (mergeCover q)) ℚ 1) :=
          LinearMap.finrank_range_le _
      _ = 0 := finrank_homology_eq_zero _ ℚ 1

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.threeStage_mapper_eq_top

private theorem threeStage_mapper_eq_top (p : ThreeStage) :

proof:
:= by
  ext s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    exact ((mem_mapper_iff _ _ s).1 hs).1
  · intro hs
    refine (mem_mapper_iff _ _ s).2 ⟨hs, (), ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨i, c⟩ _
    have := subsingleton_zerothHomotopy (Z := PullbackSpace threeStageMap (threeStageCover p) i)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.skew_finrank_H0
statement:
private theorem skew_finrank_H0 (q : Fin 3) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology (mapper threeStageMap (skewCover q)) ℚ 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (ComponentIndex threeStageMap (skewCover q)) := by
    fin_cases q
    · exact ⟨threeStageComponentIndex .first false⟩
    · exact ⟨threeStageComponentIndex .middle ()⟩
    · exact ⟨threeStageComponentIndex .last (0 : Fin 2)⟩
  rw [threeStage_mapper_eq_top]
  exact finrank_simplicialHomology_top_zero ℚ

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.skew_mapperBarcode
statement:
theorem skew_mapperBarcode :
    (skewFin (q := 0) (t := 2) (by decide)).selector ≠
        (skewFin (q := 1) (t := 2) (by decide)).selector ∘
          (skewFin (q := 0) (t := 1) (by decide)).selector ∧
      mapperBarcode ℚ threeStageMap skewCover skewFin 0 = {skewBar} ∧
      mapperBarcode ℚ threeStageMap skewCover skewFin 0 =
        mapperBarcode ℚ threeStageMap skewCover coherentFin 0
proof:
:= by
  have hbar : mapperBarcode ℚ threeStageMap skewCover skewFin 0 = {skewBar} := by
    rw [mapperBarcode_eq_iff]
    intro q t h
    have hcount : ({skewBar} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3)).countP
        (fun I => I.birth ≤ q.val ∧ t.val < I.death) = 1 := by
      rw [Multiset.countP_eq_card.mpr]
      · rfl
      · intro I hI
        rw [Multiset.mem_singleton] at hI
        subst hI
        exact ⟨Nat.zero_le _, t.isLt⟩
    rw [hcount]
    apply le_antisymm
    · calc _ ≤ Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology (mapper threeStageMap (skewCover t)) ℚ 0) :=
            Submodule.finrank_le _
        _ = 1 := skew_finrank_H0 t
    · obtain ⟨a⟩ : Nonempty (ComponentIndex threeStageMap (skewCover q)) := by
        fin_cases q
        · exact ⟨threeStageComponentIndex .first false⟩
        · exact ⟨threeStageComponentIndex .middle ()⟩
        · exact ⟨threeStageComponentIndex .last (0 : Fin 2)⟩
      exact finrank_range_homologyMap_zero_pos _ ℚ _
        ⟨{a}, componentIndex_supported _ _ a, Finset.card_singleton a⟩
  exact ⟨skew_not_coherent.1, hbar, mapperBarcode_eq ℚ threeStageMap skewCover skewFin 0 _⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.coherentTowerFin_finrank_range
statement:
theorem coherentTowerFin_finrank_range {q t : Fin 3} (h : q ≤ t) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyMap ℚ (coherentTowerFin.mapperMap threeStageMap h) 0).hom) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [CoherentCoverTower.finrank_range_simplicialHomologyMap]
  change (mapperBarcode ℚ threeStageMap skewCover coherentFin 0).countP _ = 1
  rw [← skew_mapperBarcode.2.2, skew_mapperBarcode.2.1, Multiset.countP_eq_card.mpr]
  · rfl
  · intro I hI
    rw [Multiset.mem_singleton] at hI
    subst hI
    exact ⟨Nat.zero_le _, t.isLt⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.pair_finrank_H1
statement:
theorem pair_finrank_H1 :
    Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology (mapper (plHeight C4 h4) pairCover) ℚ 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let K := mapper (plHeight C4 h4) pairCover
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite (Face K 1)
  obtain ⟨-, hcard2, hmem, hcard⟩ := cycle_categorical_pair_distinguishes_ordinary_edge
  let e : Face K 1 := ⟨_, hmem, hcard2⟩
  have he : ∀ σ : Face K 1, σ = e := fun σ => Subtype.ext (hcard σ.1 σ.2.1 σ.2.2)
  let a := TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveExamples.cycleIndex false
  have ha : a ∈ e.1 := @Finset.mem_insert_self _ (Classical.decEq _) _ _
  let τ : Face K 0 := ⟨{a}, componentIndex_supported _ _ a, Finset.card_singleton a⟩
  rw [finrank_homology_one, Submodule.finrank_eq_zero, eq_bot_iff]
  intro z hz
  have hz' : boundary K ℚ 0 z = 0 := hz
  have hsum := boundary_apply_vertex K z τ
  rw [hz', Finsupp.zero_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single e (fun σ _ hσ => absurd (he σ) hσ)
    (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ e) h)] at hsum
  have hze : z e = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.1 hsum.symm).resolve_left (boundaryMatrix_vertex_ne_zero K τ e rfl ha)
  refine (Submodule.mem_bot ℚ).2 (Finsupp.ext fun σ => ?_)
  rw [he σ, hze, Finsupp.zero_apply]

  · exact h1 ▸ fst_mem_dartEdge d

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.loop_sub0
statement:
private theorem loop_sub0 :
    Subsingleton (ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 p ∈ loopFine 0})
proof:
:=
  preimage_subsingleton 0 (by norm_num [loopFine, mem_ioo])
    (fun v hv => by
      have : v = 0 := by
        by_contra hv0
        have := h4_ge_one hv0
        rw [loopFine, mem_ioo] at hv
        linarith [hv.2]
      subst this
      rfl)
    (C4_coverage 0 (by norm_num [loopFine, mem_ioo]) fun d h1 h2 t ht => by
      have := (dartHeight_mem_Icc d t (m := 1) (M := 2) ⟨h4_ge_one h1, h4_ge_one h2⟩
        ⟨(h4_mem_Icc _).2, (h4_mem_Icc _).2⟩).1
      rw [loopFine, mem_ioo] at ht
      linarith [ht.2])

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.loop_sub2
statement:
private theorem loop_sub2 :
    Subsingleton (ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 p ∈ loopFine 2})
proof:
:=
  preimage_subsingleton 2 (by norm_num [loopFine, mem_ioo])
    (fun v hv => by
      have : v = 2 := by
        by_contra hv2
        have := h4_le_one hv2
        rw [loopFine, mem_ioo] at hv
        linarith [hv.1]
      subst this
      rfl)
    (C4_coverage 2 (by norm_num [loopFine, mem_ioo]) fun d h1 h2 t ht => by
      have := (dartHeight_mem_Icc d t (m := 0) (M := 1)
        ⟨(h4_mem_Icc _).1, (h4_mem_Icc _).1⟩ ⟨h4_le_one h1, h4_le_one h2⟩).2
      rw [loopFine, mem_ioo] at ht
      linarith [ht.1])

private theorem loop_vertex_cases (a : ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4) (loopCover 0)) :
    a = loopA ∨ a = loopB1 ∨ a = loopB3 ∨ a = loopC
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨i, c⟩
  change Fin 3 at i
  fin_cases i
  · exact .inl (Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq (@Subsingleton.elim _ loop_sub0 _ _)))
  · rcases c4_preimage_classification c with rfl | rfl
    · exact .inr (.inl rfl)
    · exact .inr (.inr (.inl rfl))
  · exact .inr (.inr (.inr (Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq (@Subsingleton.elim _ loop_sub2 _ _)))))

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.edgePoint_fiveEighths_mem
proof:

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.loop_mem_A

private theorem loop_mem_A (x : Realization C4) (hx : plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ loopFine 0) :

:=
  (mem_componentCover_iff _ _ (i := (0 : Fin 3)) loopA.2 hx).2 (@Subsingleton.elim _ loop_sub0 _ _)

private theorem loop_mem_C (x : Realization C4) (hx : plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ loopFine 2) :

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.loop_mem_B1
proof:
:= by

  apply (preimageComponentsEquiv C4 h4 I4).injective
  rw [preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint_of_snd_mem C4 h4 I4 hx (hd ▸ one_mem_I4), c4_equiv_x1]

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.loop_pair_mem
proof:
:=
  (mem_mapper_iff _ _ _).2 ⟨Finset.insert_nonempty _ _, x, fun c hc => by
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hc with rfl | hc
    · exact ha
    · rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 hc]

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.loop_not_AC
statement:
private theorem loop_not_AC (s : Finset (ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4) (loopCover 0)))
    (hs : s ∈ loopK) : ¬ (loopA ∈ s ∧ loopC ∈ s)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨hA, hC⟩
  obtain ⟨_, x, hx⟩ := (mem_mapper_iff _ _ s).1 hs
  obtain ⟨h0, _⟩ := hx loopA hA
  obtain ⟨h2, _⟩ := hx loopC hC
  change plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ loopFine 0 at h0
  change plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ loopFine 2 at h2
  rw [loopFine, mem_ioo] at h0
  rw [loopFine, mem_ioo] at h2
  linarith [h0.2, h2.1]

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.loop_not_B1B3
statement:
private theorem loop_not_B1B3 (s : Finset (ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4) (loopCover 0)))
    (hs : s ∈ loopK) : ¬ (loopB1 ∈ s ∧ loopB3 ∈ s)
proof:
:= fun h =>
  loopB1_ne_B3 (eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq _ _ hs h.1 h.2 rfl)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.loop_face_one_cases
statement:
private theorem loop_face_one_cases (σ : Face loopK 1) :
    σ = loopE1 ∨ σ = loopE2 ∨ σ = loopE3 ∨ σ = loopE4
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hσ⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.1 σ.2.2
  have hface : ({a, b} : Finset _) ∈ loopK := hσ ▸ σ.2.1
  rcases loop_vertex_cases a with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    rcases loop_vertex_cases b with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  all_goals first
    | exact absurd rfl hab
    | (refine (loop_not_AC _ hface ⟨?_, ?_⟩).elim <;> simp <;> done)
    | (refine (loop_not_B1B3 _ hface ⟨?_, ?_⟩).elim <;> simp <;> done)
    | (left; apply Subtype.ext; rw [hσ]; rfl)
    | (left; apply Subtype.ext; rw [hσ, Finset.pair_comm]; rfl)
    | (right; left; apply Subtype.ext; rw [hσ]; rfl)
    | (right; left; apply Subtype.ext; rw [hσ, Finset.pair_comm]; rfl)
    | (right; right; left; apply Subtype.ext; rw [hσ]; rfl)
    | (right; right; left; apply Subtype.ext; rw [hσ, Finset.pair_comm]; rfl)
    | (right; right; right; apply Subtype.ext; rw [hσ]; rfl)
    | (right; right; right; apply Subtype.ext; rw [hσ, Finset.pair_comm]; rfl)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.loop_card_componentIndex
statement:
private theorem loop_card_componentIndex :
    Nat.card (ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4) (loopCover 0)) = 4
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := GraphPL.finite_componentIndex C4 h4 (loopIntervals 0)
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite (ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4) (loopCover 0))
  have huniv : (Finset.univ : Finset (ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4) (loopCover 0))) =
      {loopA, loopB1, loopB3, loopC} := by
    ext a
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, true_iff]
    exact loop_vertex_cases a
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, ← Finset.card_univ, huniv,
    Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [loopA_ne_B1, loopA_ne_B3, loopA_ne_C]),
    Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [loopB1_ne_B3, loopB1_ne_C]),
    Finset.card_pair loopB3_ne_C]

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.loopE_mem
proof:
:= by
  simp [loopE1, loopE2, loopE3, loopE4]

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.loopE_ne
proof:
:= by
  have hm := loopE_mem
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · have := (hm loopB1).2.1.1 (h ▸ (hm loopB1).1.2 (.inr rfl))
    rcases this with h' | h'
    exacts [loopA_ne_B1 h'.symm, loopB1_ne_B3 h']
  · have := (hm loopA).2.2.1.1 (h ▸ (hm loopA).1.2 (.inl rfl))
    rcases this with h' | h'
    exacts [loopA_ne_B1 h', loopA_ne_C h']
  · have := (hm loopA).2.2.2.1 (h ▸ (hm loopA).1.2 (.inl rfl))
    rcases this with h' | h'
    exacts [loopA_ne_B3 h', loopA_ne_C h']
  · have := (hm loopA).2.2.1.1 (h ▸ (hm loopA).2.1.2 (.inl rfl))
    rcases this with h' | h'
    exacts [loopA_ne_B1 h', loopA_ne_C h']
  · have := (hm loopA).2.2.2.1 (h ▸ (hm loopA).2.1.2 (.inl rfl))
    rcases this with h' | h'
    exacts [loopA_ne_B3 h', loopA_ne_C h']
  · have := (hm loopB1).2.2.2.1 (h ▸ (hm loopB1).2.2.1.2 (.inl rfl))
    rcases this with h' | h'
    exacts [loopB1_ne_B3 h', loopB1_ne_C h']

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.loop_finrank_H1
statement: theorem loop_finrank_H1 : Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology loopK ℚ 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite (Face loopK 1)
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite (Face loopK 0)
  obtain ⟨h12, h13, h14, h23, h24, h34⟩ := loopE_ne
  have hm := loopE_mem
  have huniv : (Finset.univ : Finset (Face loopK 1)) = {loopE1, loopE2, loopE3, loopE4} := by
    ext σ
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, true_iff]
    exact loop_face_one_cases σ
  have hsum : ∀ (z : Chain loopK ℚ 1) (τ : Face loopK 0), boundary loopK ℚ 0 z τ =
      boundaryMatrix loopK ℚ 0 τ loopE1 * z loopE1 + boundaryMatrix loopK ℚ 0 τ loopE2 * z loopE2 +
        boundaryMatrix loopK ℚ 0 τ loopE3 * z loopE3 +
          boundaryMatrix loopK ℚ 0 τ loopE4 * z loopE4 := by
    intro z τ
    rw [boundary_apply_vertex, huniv, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [h12, h13, h14]),
      Finset.sum_insert (by simp [h23, h24]), Finset.sum_pair h34]
    ring
  have hz0 : ∀ (a : ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4) (loopCover 0)) (σ : Face loopK 1),
      a ∉ σ.1 → boundaryMatrix loopK ℚ 0 (loopVertex a) σ = 0 := fun a σ ha =>
    boundaryMatrix_vertex_eq_zero loopK _ σ rfl ha
  have hnz : ∀ (a : ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4) (loopCover 0)) (σ : Face loopK 1),
      a ∈ σ.1 → boundaryMatrix loopK ℚ 0 (loopVertex a) σ ≠ 0 := fun a σ ha =>
    boundaryMatrix_vertex_ne_zero loopK _ σ rfl ha
  have hcard1 : Fintype.card (Face loopK 1) = 4 := by
    rw [← Finset.card_univ, huniv, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [h12, h13, h14]),
      Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (by simp [h23, h24]), Finset.card_pair h34]
  have hcard0 : Fintype.card (Face loopK 0) = 4 := by
    rw [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card, Nat.card_congr (faceZeroEquiv _ _), loop_card_componentIndex]
  rw [finrank_homology_one]
  apply le_antisymm
  · 
    let φ : LinearMap.ker (boundary loopK ℚ 0) →ₗ[ℚ] ℚ :=
      (Finsupp.lapply loopE1).comp (LinearMap.ker (boundary loopK ℚ 0)).subtype
    have hφ : Function.Injective φ := by
      rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, eq_bot_iff]
      rintro ⟨z, hz⟩ hφz
      have hz' : boundary loopK ℚ 0 z = 0 := hz
      have h1 : z loopE1 = 0 := hφz
      have hB1 := hsum z (loopVertex loopB1)
      rw [hz', Finsupp.zero_apply, h1, hz0 _ loopE2 (by simp [hm, loopA_ne_B1.symm, loopB1_ne_B3]),
        hz0 _ loopE4 (by simp [hm, loopB1_ne_B3, loopB1_ne_C])] at hB1
      have h3 : z loopE3 = 0 := by
        have := hnz loopB1 loopE3 (by simp [hm])
        have h : boundaryMatrix loopK ℚ 0 (loopVertex loopB1) loopE3 * z loopE3 = 0 := by
          linarith
        exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_left this
      have hC := hsum z (loopVertex loopC)
      rw [hz', Finsupp.zero_apply, h3, hz0 _ loopE1 (by simp [hm, loopA_ne_C.symm, loopB1_ne_C.symm]),
        hz0 _ loopE2 (by simp [hm, loopA_ne_C.symm, loopB3_ne_C.symm])] at hC
      have h4 : z loopE4 = 0 := by
        have := hnz loopC loopE4 (by simp [hm])
        have h : boundaryMatrix loopK ℚ 0 (loopVertex loopC) loopE4 * z loopE4 = 0 := by
          linarith
        exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_left this
      have hB3 := hsum z (loopVertex loopB3)
      rw [hz', Finsupp.zero_apply, h4, hz0 _ loopE1 (by simp [hm, loopA_ne_B3.symm, loopB1_ne_B3.symm]),
        hz0 _ loopE3 (by simp [hm, loopB1_ne_B3.symm, loopB3_ne_C])] at hB3
      have h2 : z loopE2 = 0 := by
        have := hnz loopB3 loopE2 (by simp [hm])
        have h : boundaryMatrix loopK ℚ 0 (loopVertex loopB3) loopE2 * z loopE2 = 0 := by
          linarith
        exact (mul_eq_zero.1 h).resolve_left this
      have hzero : z = 0 := by
        ext σ
        rcases loop_face_one_cases σ with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
        exacts [h1, h2, h3, h4]
      exact (Submodule.mem_bot ℚ).2 (Subtype.ext hzero)
    calc _ ≤ Module.finrank ℚ ℚ := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hφ
      _ = 1 := Module.finrank_self ℚ
  · 
    have hrn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (boundary loopK ℚ 0)
    have hsn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (zeroChainSum loopK ℚ)
    have hC1 : Module.finrank ℚ (Chain loopK ℚ (0 + 1)) = 4 := by
      rw [Module.finrank_finsupp_self, hcard1]
    have hC0 : Module.finrank ℚ (Chain loopK ℚ 0) = 4 := by
      rw [Module.finrank_finsupp_self, hcard0]
    have hsurj : LinearMap.range (zeroChainSum loopK ℚ) = ⊤ := by
      rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top]
      intro c
      exact ⟨Finsupp.single (loopVertex loopA) c, zeroChainSum_single _ ℚ _ c⟩
    have hle : LinearMap.range (boundary loopK ℚ 0) ≤ LinearMap.ker (zeroChainSum loopK ℚ) :=
      LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff.2 (zeroChainSum_boundary loopK ℚ)
    have hmono := Submodule.finrank_mono hle
    rw [hsurj, finrank_top, Module.finrank_self] at hsn
    omega

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.loop_mapperBarcode
statement:
theorem loop_mapperBarcode :
    mapperBarcode ℚ (plHeight C4 h4) loopCover loopRefinement 1 = {loopBar}
proof:
:= by
  have hcoarse := finrank_homology_eq_zero (mapper (plHeight C4 h4) (loopCover 1)) ℚ 1
  rw [mapperBarcode_eq_iff]
  intro q t h
  fin_cases q <;> fin_cases t
  · rw [mapperHomologyMap_eq_id, finrank_range_id]
    exact loop_finrank_H1.trans (by decide)
  · refine (Nat.le_zero.1 ?_).trans (by decide)
    calc _ ≤ Module.finrank ℚ
          (simplicialHomology (mapper (plHeight C4 h4) (loopCover 1)) ℚ 1) :=
          Submodule.finrank_le _
      _ = 0 := hcoarse
  · exact absurd h (by decide)
  · rw [mapperHomologyMap_eq_id, finrank_range_id]
    exact hcoarse.trans (by decide)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.natToUnit_not_finite_face
statement: theorem natToUnit_not_finite_face : ¬ Finite (Face (mapper natToUnit unitCover) 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro hfin
  let g : ℕ → Face (mapper natToUnit unitCover) 0 := fun m =>
    ⟨{(natMapperVertexEquiv.symm m).1}, (natMapperVertexEquiv.symm m).2,
      Finset.card_singleton _⟩
  have hg : Function.Injective g := by
    intro m m' hm
    have h1 : (natMapperVertexEquiv.symm m).1 = (natMapperVertexEquiv.symm m').1 :=
      Finset.singleton_injective (congrArg Subtype.val hm)
    exact natMapperVertexEquiv.symm.injective (Subtype.ext h1)
  have := Finite.of_injective g hg
  exact not_finite ℕ

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyBarcodeExamples.natToUnit_not_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem natToUnit_not_finiteDimensional [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex natToUnit unitCover)]
    (k : Type) [Field k] :
    ¬ FiniteDimensional k (simplicialHomology (mapper natToUnit unitCover) k 0)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsEmpty (Face (mapper natToUnit unitCover) 1) := ⟨fun σ => by
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hσ⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.1 σ.2.2
    apply hab
    exact eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq natToUnit unitCover σ.2.1 (by simp [hσ])
      (by simp [hσ]) rfl⟩
  intro hfd
  have hchain : Module.Finite k (Chain (mapper natToUnit unitCover) k 0) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (zeroHomologyEquivOfNoEdges _ k)
  rcases Module.finite_finsupp_self_iff.1 hchain with hk | hface
  · exact not_subsingleton k hk
  · exact natToUnit_not_finite_face hface

name: TDA.Mapper.componentClass_proof_irrel
statement:
theorem componentClass_proof_irrel (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) {i : I} {x : X}
    (hx hx' : f x ∈ U i) :
    ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x, hx⟩ : PullbackSpace f U i) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x, hx'⟩ : PullbackSpace f U i)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.mem_componentCover_iff
statement:
theorem mem_componentCover_iff (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) {i : I}
    (c : ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace f U i)) {x : X} (hx : f x ∈ U i) :
    x ∈ componentCover f U ⟨i, c⟩ ↔
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x, hx⟩ : PullbackSpace f U i) = c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx', hclass⟩
    exact (componentClass_proof_irrel f U hx hx').trans hclass
  · intro hclass
    exact ⟨hx, hclass⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.componentCover_nonempty
statement:
theorem componentCover_nonempty (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y)
    (a : ComponentIndex f U) : (componentCover f U a).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨i, c⟩
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => exact ⟨x.1, x.2, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.componentCover_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxc hxd
  rcases hxc with ⟨hxi, hc⟩
  rcases hxd with ⟨hxi', hd⟩
  apply hcd
  exact hc.symm.trans ((componentClass_proof_irrel f U hxi hxi').trans hd)

name: TDA.Mapper.iUnion_componentCover_fiber
statement:
theorem iUnion_componentCover_fiber (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) (i : I) :
    (⋃ c : ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace f U i), componentCover f U ⟨i, c⟩) =
      f ⁻¹' U i
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_preimage]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hx⟩
    exact hx.1
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x, hx⟩ : PullbackSpace f U i), hx, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.iUnion_componentCover
statement:
theorem iUnion_componentCover (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) :
    (⋃ a : ComponentIndex f U, componentCover f U a) = f ⁻¹' (⋃ i, U i)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_preimage]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨i, c⟩, hx⟩
    exact ⟨i, hx.1⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hxi⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x, hxi⟩ : PullbackSpace f U i)⟩, hxi, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.componentCover_covers
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hU (f x) hx
  exact ⟨⟨i, ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x, hxi⟩ : PullbackSpace f U i)⟩, hxi, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.componentCover_covers_range
statement:
theorem componentCover_covers_range (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y)
    (hU : TDA.Topology.Covers U (Set.range f)) :
    TDA.Topology.Covers (componentCover f U) Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  intro x _
  obtain ⟨i, hxi⟩ := hU (f x) ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨⟨i, ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x, hxi⟩ : PullbackSpace f U i)⟩, hxi, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.componentType_isEmpty
statement:
theorem componentType_isEmpty (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) (i : I)
    (h : IsEmpty (PullbackSpace f U i)) :
    IsEmpty (ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace f U i))
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun c => by
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x => exact h.false x⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.no_componentIndex_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem no_componentIndex_of_isEmpty (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) (i : I)
    (h : IsEmpty (PullbackSpace f U i)) :
    ¬ ∃ a : ComponentIndex f U, a.1 = i
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨⟨j, c⟩, hj⟩
  change j = i at hj
  subst j
  exact (componentType_isEmpty f U i h).false c

name: TDA.Mapper.componentIndex_ne_of_index_ne
statement:
theorem componentIndex_ne_of_index_ne (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) {i j : I}
    (hij : i ≠ j) (c : ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace f U i))
    (d : ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace f U j)) :
    (⟨i, c⟩ : ComponentIndex f U) ≠ ⟨j, d⟩
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact hij (congrArg Sigma.fst h)

name: TDA.Mapper.componentRefinement_selector_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem componentRefinement_selector_mk (f : C(X, Y)) {U : I → Set Y} {V : J → Set Y}
    (R : TDA.Topology.Refinement U V) (i : I) (x : PullbackSpace f U i) :
    (componentRefinement f R).selector ⟨i, ZerothHomotopy.mk x⟩ =
      ⟨R.selector i, ZerothHomotopy.mk (refinementInclusion f R i x)⟩
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.componentRefinement_id
statement:
theorem componentRefinement_id (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) :
    componentRefinement f (TDA.Topology.Refinement.id U) =
      TDA.Topology.Refinement.id (componentCover f U)
proof:
:= by
  apply TDA.Topology.Refinement.ext
  rintro ⟨i, c⟩
  refine Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq ?_)
  change TDA.Topology.componentMap (refinementInclusion f (TDA.Topology.Refinement.id U) i) c = c
  rw [show refinementInclusion f (TDA.Topology.Refinement.id U) i =
      ContinuousMap.id (PullbackSpace f U i) by
    ext x
    rfl]
  exact congrFun TDA.Topology.componentMap_id c

name: TDA.Mapper.componentRefinement_comp
statement:
theorem componentRefinement_comp {K : Type*} (f : C(X, Y))
    {U : I → Set Y} {V : J → Set Y} {W : K → Set Y}
    (R : TDA.Topology.Refinement U V) (S : TDA.Topology.Refinement V W) :
    componentRefinement f (TDA.Topology.Refinement.comp R S) =
      TDA.Topology.Refinement.comp (componentRefinement f R) (componentRefinement f S)
proof:
:= by
  apply TDA.Topology.Refinement.ext
  rintro ⟨i, c⟩
  refine Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq ?_)
  change TDA.Topology.componentMap
      (refinementInclusion f (TDA.Topology.Refinement.comp R S) i) c =
    componentRefinementMap f S (R.selector i) (componentRefinementMap f R i c)
  rw [show refinementInclusion f (TDA.Topology.Refinement.comp R S) i =
      (refinementInclusion f S (R.selector i)).comp (refinementInclusion f R i) by
    ext x
    rfl]
  exact congrFun (TDA.Topology.componentMap_comp
    (refinementInclusion f S (R.selector i)) (refinementInclusion f R i)) c

name: TDA.Mapper.componentCover_mk_eq_pathComponentIn
statement:
theorem componentCover_mk_eq_pathComponentIn (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) (i : I)
    (x : PullbackSpace f U i) :
    componentCover f U ⟨i, ZerothHomotopy.mk x⟩ = pathComponentIn (f ⁻¹' U i) x.1
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hy, hclass⟩
    change JoinedIn (f ⁻¹' U i) x.1 y
    rw [joinedIn_iff_joined
      (show x.1 ∈ f ⁻¹' U i from x.2) (show y ∈ f ⁻¹' U i from hy)]
    exact (Quotient.exact hclass).symm
  · intro hjoined
    change JoinedIn (f ⁻¹' U i) x.1 y at hjoined
    have hjoined' : Joined x (⟨y, hjoined.target_mem⟩ : PullbackSpace f U i) :=
      (joinedIn_iff_joined
        (show x.1 ∈ f ⁻¹' U i from x.2)
        (show y ∈ f ⁻¹' U i from hjoined.target_mem)).1 hjoined
    exact ⟨hjoined.target_mem, (ZerothHomotopy.sound hjoined'.somePath).symm⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.componentCover_isOpen
statement:
theorem componentCover_isOpen [LocallyPathConnectedSpace X] (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y)
    (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i)) (a : ComponentIndex f U) : IsOpen (componentCover f U a)
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨i, c⟩
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
      rw [componentCover_mk_eq_pathComponentIn]
      exact ((hU i).preimage f.continuous).pathComponentIn x.1

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebTranslationExamples.translation_exact
statement:
theorem translation_exact :
    ∃ n : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ a b : ∀ t, Fin (n t) → ℝ,
      (∀ t x, ∃ i, plHeight edgeGraph h02 x ∈ ioo (a t i) (b t i)) ∧
      (∀ t x, ∃ i, plHeight edgeGraph (fun v => h02 v + 1) x ∈
        ioo (a t i + 1) (b t i + 1)) ∧
      ∀ t, RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance
        (graphPLMapperReconstruction edgeGraph h02 (a t) (b t))
        (graphPLMapperReconstruction edgeGraph (fun v => h02 v + 1)
          (fun i => a t i + 1) (fun i => b t i + 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, a, b, hcov, -⟩ := nonconstant_edge_convergent_reconstructions
  refine ⟨n, a, b, hcov, fun t x => ?_, fun t => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov t x
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    rw [plHeight_add_const_apply]
    exact ⟨by linarith [hi.1], by linarith [hi.2]⟩
  · rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLMapperReconstruction_add_const_of_covers
      edgeGraph h02 (a t) (b t) 1 (hcov t), abs_one, ENNReal.ofReal_one]

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebTranslationExamples.zero_translation
statement:
theorem zero_translation {ι : Type} [Finite ι] (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (hcov : ∀ x, ∃ i, plHeight edgeGraph h02 x ∈ ioo (a i) (b i)) :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction edgeGraph h02 a b)
        (graphPLMapperReconstruction edgeGraph (fun v => h02 v + 0) (fun i => a i + 0)
          (fun i => b i + 0)) = 0 ∧
      interleavingDistance (intervalComponents (scaleMap 4))
        (intervalComponents (scaleMap 4 + ContinuousMap.const I 0)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLMapperReconstruction_add_const_of_covers
      edgeGraph h02 a b 0 hcov, abs_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_zero]
  · rw [interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_add_const _ bddBelow_range_scaleMap,
      nnnorm_zero, ENNReal.coe_zero]

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebTranslationExamples.graphPLReebGraph_add_const_via_intervalComponents
statement:
theorem graphPLReebGraph_add_const_via_intervalComponents {V : Type} [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h)
      (graphPLReebGraph G fun v => h v + c) = ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (Realization G) := ⟨vertex G (Classical.arbitrary V)⟩
  have hbdd : BddBelow (range (plHeight G h)) := by
    refine ⟨Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty h, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact (plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall (M := Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty h)
      (fun w => ⟨Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ w), Finset.le_sup' _ (Finset.mem_univ w)⟩)
      x).1
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph, plHeight_add_const,
    interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_add_const _ hbdd, ← Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs]
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebTranslationExamples.empty_cover_translation
statement:
theorem empty_cover_translation {V : Type} [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V)
    (h : V → ℝ) (a b : Empty → ℝ) :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
        (graphPLMapperReconstruction G (fun v => h v + 1) (fun i => a i + 1)
          (fun i => b i + 1)) = 0 ∧
      coverResolution a b = 0 ∧
      RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h)
        (graphPLReebGraph G fun v => h v + 1) = 1 ∧
      ¬ RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h)
          (graphPLReebGraph G fun v => h v + 1) ≤
        RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
          (graphPLMapperReconstruction G (fun v => h v + 1) (fun i => a i + 1)
            (fun i => b i + 1)) +
          (coverResolution a b : ℝ≥0∞) +
          coverResolution (fun i => a i + 1) (fun i => b i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLMapperReconstruction_of_isEmpty G h
    (fun v => h v + 1) a b (fun i => a i + 1) (fun i => b i + 1)
  have hres : ∀ a b : Empty → ℝ, coverResolution a b = 0 := fun a b => by
    unfold coverResolution
    simp
  have hReeb : RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h)
      (graphPLReebGraph G fun v => h v + 1) = 1 := by
    rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_add_const, abs_one, ENNReal.ofReal_one]
  refine ⟨h0, hres a b, hReeb, ?_⟩
  rw [hReeb, h0, hres, hres]
  simp

      (cappedCentredDiagram k (plHeight edgeGraph h01) 0 1 zeroLabel quarterGrid 0) = ⊤

name: TDA.Mapper.coverResolution_add_const
statement:
theorem coverResolution_add_const (a b : ι → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    coverResolution (fun i => a i + c) (fun i => b i + c) = coverResolution a b
proof:
:= by
  unfold coverResolution
  simp

name: TDA.Mapper.width_le_coverResolution
statement:
theorem width_le_coverResolution (a b : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    b i - a i ≤ (coverResolution a b : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  exact (Real.le_coe_toNNReal _).trans
    (NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr (Finset.le_sup (f := fun i => Real.toNNReal (b i - a i))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)))

name: TDA.Mapper.diameter_le_coverResolution
statement:
theorem diameter_le_coverResolution (a b : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) (x : ℝ)
    (hx : x ∈ ioo (a i) (b i)) (y : ℝ) (hy : y ∈ ioo (a i) (b i)) :
    |x - y| ≤ (coverResolution a b : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply abs_le.mpr
  have hw := width_le_coverResolution a b i
  constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2, hy.1, hy.2]

name: TDA.Mapper.finite_graphPL_categoricalMapperData
statement:
theorem finite_graphPL_categoricalMapperData (U : ι → OpenInterval) (s : CoverSimplex U) :
    Finite ((categoricalMapperData (plHeight G h) U).obj s)
proof:
:= by
  change Finite ((componentFunctor (plHeight G h)).obj (coverIntersection U s))
  rw [← toOpens_coverIntersectionInterval U s]
  exact finite_zerothHomotopy G h (coverIntersectionInterval U s)

name: TDA.Mapper.geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_eq
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_eq (a b : ι → ℝ) :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
      (GraphPL.graphPLReebGraph G h) =
    interleavingDistance (coverComponents (plHeight G h) (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i)))
      (intervalComponents (plHeight G h))
proof:
:= by
  rw [RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_interleavingDistance]
  change interleavingDistance
    (RGraph.cosheafFunctor.obj (categoricalMapperReconstruction (plHeight G h) a b
      (fun i => finite_zerothHomotopy G h (ioo (a i) (b i))))).obj
    (intervalComponents (ReebQuotient.height (plHeight G h))) = _
  exact interleavingDistance_congr
    (categoricalMapperReconstructionIso (plHeight G h) a b
      (fun i => finite_zerothHomotopy G h (ioo (a i) (b i))))
    (asIso (ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison (plHeight G h))).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (hcov : ∀ x, ∃ i, plHeight G h x ∈ ioo (a i) (b i)) :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
      (GraphPL.graphPLReebGraph G h) ≤ (coverResolution a b : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_eq]
  exact interleavingDistance_coverComponents_le (plHeight G h)
    (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i)) (coverResolution a b) hcov
    (diameter_le_coverResolution a b)

name: TDA.Mapper.geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_retained
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_retained (a b : ι → ℝ)
    (hcov : ∀ x, ∃ i, plHeight G h x ∈ ioo (a i) (b i)) :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
      (GraphPL.graphPLReebGraph G h) ≤
        (retainedCoverResolution (plHeight G h) a b : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_eq,
    interleavingDistance_congr
      (coverComponentsRetainedIso (plHeight G h) (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i)))
      (Iso.refl _)]
  exact interleavingDistance_coverComponents_le (plHeight G h)
    (retainedCover (plHeight G h) (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i)))
    (retainedCoverResolution (plHeight G h) a b)
    (retainedCover_covers (plHeight G h) (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i)) hcov)
    (diameter_le_coverResolution
      (fun i : RetainedCoverMember (plHeight G h) (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i)) => a i.val)
      (fun i => b i.val))

name: TDA.Mapper.exists_graphPLMapperCover_resolution_le_of_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_graphPLMapperCover_resolution_le_of_bounds {m M r : ℝ}
    (hh : ∀ v, h v ∈ Icc m M) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : Fin n → ℝ,
      (∀ x, ∃ i, plHeight G h x ∈ ioo (a i) (b i)) ∧
      coverResolution a b ≤ Real.toNNReal r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hM⟩ := exists_uniformCover_window (by linarith : 0 < r / 2)
    (by linarith : r / 2 < r) (m - r) M
  let a : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => m - r + i.val * (r - r / 2)
  let b : Fin n → ℝ := fun i => a i + r
  have hcov : ∀ x, ∃ i, plHeight G h x ∈ ioo (a i) (b i) := by
    intro x
    exact uniformCover_covers_range hh (by linarith : m - r < m) hM
      (by linarith : 0 < r / 2) hn _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨n, a, b, hcov, ?_⟩
  unfold coverResolution
  exact Finset.sup_le (fun _ _ => by simp [b])

name: TDA.Mapper.exists_graphPLMapperCover_resolution_le
statement:
theorem exists_graphPLMapperCover_resolution_le {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : Fin n → ℝ,
      (∀ x, ∃ i, plHeight G h x ∈ ioo (a i) (b i)) ∧
      coverResolution a b ≤ Real.toNNReal r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, S, hS⟩ := GraphPL.exists_coversVertexHeights h
  apply exists_graphPLMapperCover_resolution_le_of_bounds G h (m := S.value 0)
    (M := S.value (Fin.last n)) _ hr
  intro v
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hS v
  rw [← hi]
  exact ⟨S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le i), S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.le_last i)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.exists_graphPLMapperReconstruction_error_le_of_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_graphPLMapperReconstruction_error_le_of_bounds {m M r : ℝ}
    (hh : ∀ v, h v ∈ Icc m M) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : Fin n → ℝ,
      (∀ x, ∃ i, plHeight G h x ∈ ioo (a i) (b i)) ∧
      RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
        (GraphPL.graphPLReebGraph G h) ≤ (Real.toNNReal r : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, a, b, hcov, hres⟩ :=
    exists_graphPLMapperCover_resolution_le_of_bounds G h hh hr
  exact ⟨n, a, b, hcov, (geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le G h a b hcov).trans
    (ENNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr hres)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.exists_graphPLMapperReconstruction_error_le
statement:
theorem exists_graphPLMapperReconstruction_error_le {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ a b : Fin n → ℝ,
      (∀ x, ∃ i, plHeight G h x ∈ ioo (a i) (b i)) ∧
      RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
        (GraphPL.graphPLReebGraph G h) ≤ (Real.toNNReal r : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, a, b, hcov, hres⟩ := exists_graphPLMapperCover_resolution_le G h hr
  exact ⟨n, a, b, hcov, (geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le G h a b hcov).trans
    (ENNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr hres)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.tendsto_geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb
statement:
theorem tendsto_geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb
    {α : Type*} {l : Filter α} (κ : α → Type) [∀ t, Finite (κ t)]
    (a b : ∀ t, κ t → ℝ)
    (hcov : ∀ t x, ∃ i, plHeight G h x ∈ ioo (a t i) (b t i))
    (hres : Tendsto (fun t => (coverResolution (a t) (b t) : ℝ≥0∞)) l (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun t => RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance
      (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h (a t) (b t)) (GraphPL.graphPLReebGraph G h))
      l (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hres
    (fun _ => bot_le) (fun t => geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le G h
      (a t) (b t) (hcov t))

name: TDA.Mapper.tendsto_geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_retained
statement:
theorem tendsto_geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_retained
    {α : Type*} {l : Filter α} (κ : α → Type) [∀ t, Finite (κ t)]
    (a b : ∀ t, κ t → ℝ)
    (hcov : ∀ t x, ∃ i, plHeight G h x ∈ ioo (a t i) (b t i))
    (hres : Tendsto (fun t => (retainedCoverResolution (plHeight G h) (a t) (b t) : ℝ≥0∞))
      l (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun t => RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance
      (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h (a t) (b t)) (GraphPL.graphPLReebGraph G h))
      l (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hres
    (fun _ => bot_le) (fun t => geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_retained G h
      (a t) (b t) (hcov t))

name: TDA.Mapper.coe_uniformInterval
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_uniformInterval (a r g : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    (uniformInterval a r g k : Set ℝ) = Ioo (a + k * (r - g)) (a + k * (r - g) + r)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.mem_uniformInterval
statement:
theorem mem_uniformInterval {a r g y : ℝ} {k : ℕ} :
    y ∈ uniformInterval a r g k ↔ a + k * (r - g) < y ∧ y < a + k * (r - g) + r
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformCover_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem uniformCover_apply (a r g : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (k : Fin n) :
    uniformCover a r g n k = uniformInterval a r g k
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformInterval_inf_succ
statement:
theorem uniformInterval_inf_succ {a r g : ℝ} (hgr : g ≤ r) (k : ℕ) :
    uniformInterval a r g k ⊓ uniformInterval a r g (k + 1) =
      ioo (a + (k + 1) * (r - g)) (a + (k + 1) * (r - g) + g)
proof:
:= by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  ext y
  simp only [coe_inf, coe_uniformInterval, coe_ioo, mem_inter_iff, mem_Ioo, Nat.cast_add,
    Nat.cast_one]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨-, h₂⟩, h₃, -⟩
    constructor <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformInterval_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  refine Set.disjoint_left.2 fun y h₁ h₂ => ?_
  rw [coe_uniformInterval, mem_Ioo] at h₁ h₂
  have hkl' : (k : ℝ) + 2 ≤ l := by exact_mod_cast hkl
  have hd : 0 ≤ r - g := by linarith [h₁.1, h₁.2]
  have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkl' hd
  linarith [h₁.2, h₂.1]

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformInterval_inf_eq_bot
statement:
theorem uniformInterval_inf_eq_bot {a r g : ℝ} (hg : 2 * g ≤ r) {k l : ℕ}
    (hkl : k + 2 ≤ l) : uniformInterval a r g k ⊓ uniformInterval a r g l = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply SetLike.coe_injective
  rw [coe_inf, coe_bot]
  exact (uniformInterval_disjoint hg hkl).inter_eq

name: TDA.Mapper.exists_uniformInterval_of_mem
proof:
| 0, y, h₁, h₂ => ⟨0, le_rfl, by
      rw [mem_uniformInterval]
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, zero_mul, add_zero, one_mul] at h₂ ⊢
      constructor <;> linarith⟩
  | n + 1, y, h₁, h₂ => by
      by_cases hy : y < a + ((n : ℝ) + 1) * (r - g) + g
      · obtain ⟨k, hk, hmem⟩ := exists_uniformInterval_of_mem hg n y h₁ hy
        exact ⟨k, Nat.le_succ_of_le hk, hmem⟩
      · refine ⟨n + 1, le_rfl, ?_⟩
        rw [mem_uniformInterval]
        push_cast at h₂ ⊢
        have hy' := not_lt.1 hy
        constructor <;> linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.Ioo_subset_iUnion_uniformCover
statement:
theorem Ioo_subset_iUnion_uniformCover {a r g : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hg : 0 < g) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Set.Ioo a (a + n * (r - g) + g) ⊆ ⋃ k : Fin n, (uniformCover a r g n k : Set ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn.ne'
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hmem⟩ := exists_uniformInterval_of_mem hg m y hy.1 (by
    have := hy.2
    push_cast at this
    exact this)
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨⟨k, Nat.lt_succ_of_le hk⟩, hmem⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.iUnion_uniformCover
statement:
theorem iUnion_uniformCover {a r g : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : g ≤ r) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ⋃ k : Fin n, (uniformCover a r g n k : Set ℝ) = Set.Ioo a (a + n * (r - g) + g)
proof:
:= by
  refine Subset.antisymm ?_ (Ioo_subset_iUnion_uniformCover hg hn)
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hy
  rw [uniformCover_apply, coe_uniformInterval, mem_Ioo] at hk
  have hk0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℕ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hkn : ((k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_le_of_lt k.2
  have hd : 0 ≤ r - g := sub_nonneg.2 hgr
  have h₁ := mul_nonneg hk0 hd
  have h₂ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hkn hd
  constructor <;> linarith [hk.1, hk.2]

name: TDA.Mapper.plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall
statement:
theorem plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {h : V → ℝ} {m M : ℝ}
    (hh : ∀ v, h v ∈ Set.Icc m M) (p : Realization G) : plHeight G h p ∈ Set.Icc m M
proof:
:= by
  induction p using ind G with
  | vertex v => exact hh v
  | edgePoint d t =>
      have hf := hh d.fst
      have hs := hh d.snd
      have ht0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ t := t.2.1
      have ht1 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 := t.2.2
      change m ≤ (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd ∧
        (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd ≤ M
      constructor
      · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 ht1) (sub_nonneg.2 hf.1),
          mul_nonneg ht0 (sub_nonneg.2 hs.1)]
      · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 ht1) (sub_nonneg.2 hf.2),
          mul_nonneg ht0 (sub_nonneg.2 hs.2)]

name: TDA.Mapper.range_plHeight_subset_Icc
statement:
theorem range_plHeight_subset_Icc {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {h : V → ℝ} {m M : ℝ}
    (hh : ∀ v, h v ∈ Set.Icc m M) : Set.range (plHeight G h) ⊆ Set.Icc m M
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
  exact plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall hh p

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformCover_covers_range
statement:
theorem uniformCover_covers_range {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {h : V → ℝ}
    {a r g m M : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hh : ∀ v, h v ∈ Set.Icc m M) (ha : a < m)
    (hM : M < a + n * (r - g) + g) (hg : 0 < g) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Covers (fun k => (uniformCover a r g n k : Set ℝ)) (Set.range (plHeight G h))
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hIcc := range_plHeight_subset_Icc hh hy
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.1 (Ioo_subset_iUnion_uniformCover hg hn
    ⟨by linarith [hIcc.1], by linarith [hIcc.2]⟩)

name: TDA.Mapper.exists_uniformCover_window
statement:
theorem exists_uniformCover_window {r g : ℝ} (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : g < r) (a M : ℝ) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ M < a + n * (r - g) + g
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < r - g := sub_pos.2 hgr
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((M - a) / (r - g))
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ hd] at hn
  refine ⟨n + 1, Nat.succ_pos n, ?_⟩
  push_cast
  linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformCover_card_le_two
statement:
theorem uniformCover_card_le_two {a r g : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hg : 2 * g ≤ r) :
    ∀ y (t : Finset (Fin n)), (∀ k ∈ t, y ∈ uniformCover a r g n k) → t.card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  intro y t ht
  by_contra hcard
  obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, k, hk, hij, hik, hjk⟩ := Finset.two_lt_card.1 (not_le.1 hcard)
  have far : ∀ p q : Fin n, p ∈ t → q ∈ t → (p : ℕ) + 2 ≤ q → False := fun p q hp hq hpq =>
    Set.disjoint_left.1 (uniformInterval_disjoint (a := a) hg hpq) (ht p hp) (ht q hq)
  have hij' : (i : ℕ) ≠ j := fun h => hij (Fin.ext h)
  have hik' : (i : ℕ) ≠ k := fun h => hik (Fin.ext h)
  have hjk' : (j : ℕ) ≠ k := fun h => hjk (Fin.ext h)
  have : (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ j ∨ (j : ℕ) + 2 ≤ i ∨ (i : ℕ) + 2 ≤ k ∨ (k : ℕ) + 2 ≤ i ∨
      (j : ℕ) + 2 ≤ k ∨ (k : ℕ) + 2 ≤ j := by omega
  rcases this with h | h | h | h | h | h
  · exact far i j hi hj h
  · exact far j i hj hi h
  · exact far i k hi hk h
  · exact far k i hk hi h
  · exact far j k hj hk h
  · exact far k j hk hj h

name: TDA.Mapper.coverMultiplicityAtMost_uniformCover
proof:
:=
  fun y _ t ht => uniformCover_card_le_two hg y t ht

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformCover_card_le_two_iff
statement:
theorem uniformCover_card_le_two_iff {a r g : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hgr : g < r) :
    (∀ y (t : Finset (Fin n)), (∀ k ∈ t, y ∈ uniformCover a r g n k) → t.card ≤ 2) ↔
      2 * g ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => uniformCover_card_le_two h⟩
  by_contra hlt'
  have hlt := not_le.1 hlt'
  let k₀ : Fin n := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let k₁ : Fin n := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  let k₂ : Fin n := ⟨2, by omega⟩
  have hmem : ∀ k ∈ ({k₀, k₁, k₂} : Finset (Fin n)),
      (a + 2 * (r - g) + (a + r)) / 2 ∈ uniformCover a r g n k := by
    intro k hk
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hk
    rcases hk with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      simp only [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval, k₀, k₁, k₂, Nat.cast_zero,
        Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_ofNat] <;>
      constructor <;> linarith
  have hcard : ({k₀, k₁, k₂} : Finset (Fin n)).card = 3 :=
    Finset.card_eq_three.2 ⟨k₀, k₁, k₂, Fin.ne_of_val_ne (by norm_num),
      Fin.ne_of_val_ne (by norm_num), Fin.ne_of_val_ne (by norm_num), rfl⟩
  have := h _ _ hmem
  omega

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.sSup_range_plHeight
statement:
theorem sSup_range_plHeight :
    sSup (range (plHeight G h)) = Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty h
proof:
:= by
  apply IsGreatest.csSup_eq
  obtain ⟨v, -, hv⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' Finset.univ_nonempty h
  refine ⟨⟨GraphRealization.vertex G v, by simpa using hv.symm⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact (plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall (m := Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty h)
    (M := Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty h)
    (fun w => ⟨Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ w), Finset.le_sup' _ (Finset.mem_univ w)⟩) x).2

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.sInf_range_plHeight
statement:
theorem sInf_range_plHeight :
    sInf (range (plHeight G h)) = Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty h
proof:
:= by
  apply IsLeast.csInf_eq
  obtain ⟨v, -, hv⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_inf' Finset.univ_nonempty h
  refine ⟨⟨GraphRealization.vertex G v, by simpa using hv.symm⟩, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact (plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall (m := Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty h)
    (M := Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty h)
    (fun w => ⟨Finset.inf'_le _ (Finset.mem_univ w), Finset.le_sup' _ (Finset.mem_univ w)⟩) x).1

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.nonempty_heightRange
statement:
private theorem nonempty_heightRange :
    (heightRange (graphPLReebGraph G h)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [heightRange_graphPLReebGraph]
  exact range_nonempty_iff_nonempty.2 ⟨GraphRealization.vertex G (Classical.arbitrary V)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.ofReal_abs_sup'_sub_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph
statement:
theorem ofReal_abs_sup'_sub_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph :
    ENNReal.ofReal |Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty h -
        Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty g| ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G g)
proof:
:= by
  have key := ofReal_abs_sSup_sub_le_hausdorffEDist (nonempty_heightRange G h)
    (nonempty_heightRange G g) (bddAbove_heightRange _) (bddAbove_heightRange _)
  rw [heightRange_graphPLReebGraph, heightRange_graphPLReebGraph, sSup_range_plHeight,
    sSup_range_plHeight] at key
  refine key.trans ?_
  have := hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le_geometricInterleavingDistance
    (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G g)
  rwa [heightRange_graphPLReebGraph, heightRange_graphPLReebGraph] at this

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.ofReal_abs_inf'_sub_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph
statement:
theorem ofReal_abs_inf'_sub_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph :
    ENNReal.ofReal |Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty h -
        Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty g| ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G g)
proof:
:= by
  have key := ofReal_abs_sInf_sub_le_hausdorffEDist (nonempty_heightRange G h)
    (nonempty_heightRange G g) (bddBelow_heightRange _) (bddBelow_heightRange _)
  rw [heightRange_graphPLReebGraph, heightRange_graphPLReebGraph, sInf_range_plHeight,
    sInf_range_plHeight] at key
  refine key.trans ?_
  have := hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le_geometricInterleavingDistance
    (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G g)
  rwa [heightRange_graphPLReebGraph, heightRange_graphPLReebGraph] at this

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.max_ofReal_abs_sub_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph
statement:
theorem max_ofReal_abs_sub_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph :
    max (ENNReal.ofReal |Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty h -
        Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty g|)
      (ENNReal.ofReal |Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty h -
        Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty g|) ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G g)
proof:
:=
  max_le (ofReal_abs_sup'_sub_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph G h g)
    (ofReal_abs_inf'_sub_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph G h g)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_eq_edist_of_sup'
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_eq_edist_of_sup'
    (hsup : edist h g = ENNReal.ofReal |Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty h -
      Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty g|) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G g) = edist h g
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le_edist G h g)
    (hsup ▸ ofReal_abs_sup'_sub_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph G h g)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_eq_edist_of_inf'
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_eq_edist_of_inf'
    (hinf : edist h g = ENNReal.ofReal |Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty h -
      Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty g|) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G g) = edist h g
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le_edist G h g)
    (hinf ▸ ofReal_abs_inf'_sub_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph G h g)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edist_add_const
statement: private theorem edist_add_const (c : ℝ) : edist h (fun v => h v + c) = ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:= by
  have hv (v : V) : edist (h v) (h v + c) = ENNReal.ofReal |c| := by
    rw [edist_dist, Real.dist_eq, show h v - (h v + c) = -c by ring, abs_neg]
  exact le_antisymm (edist_pi_le_iff.2 fun v => (hv v).le)
    ((hv (Classical.arbitrary V)).ge.trans (edist_le_pi_edist _ _ _))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_add_const
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_add_const (c : ℝ) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G fun v => h v + c) =
      ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:= by
  rw [← edist_add_const (h := h) c]
  apply geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_eq_edist_of_sup'
  have hsup : Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun v => h v + c) =
      Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty h + c :=
    (Finset.sup'_add _ _ _ _).symm
  rw [edist_add_const, hsup, show Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty h -
    (Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty h + c) = -c by ring, abs_neg]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty V] (h g : V → ℝ) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Fintype V := Fintype.ofIsEmpty
  have hz : edist h g = 0 := by
    rw [edist_pi_def, Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sup_empty]
    rfl
  exact le_antisymm ((geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le_edist G h g).trans
    hz.le) bot_le

name: TDA.Mapper.le_bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_of_finrank_lt
statement:
theorem le_bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_of_finrank_lt {ρ : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hρ : ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < ρ → ∃ (t : ℝ) (h : t ≤ t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)),
      FiniteDimensional k
          (simplicialHomology (mapper f (cover' (cellIndex d (t + ε)))) k n) ∧
        Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (mapper f (cover' (cellIndex d (t + ε)))) k n) <
          Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
            (mapperHomologyMap k f (r ((cellIndex c).monotone h)) n).hom)) :
    ρ ≤ bottleneck (stepMapperDiagram k f c cover r n) (stepMapperDiagram k f d cover' r' n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_eq]
  exact le_realInterleavingDistance_mapperHomologyPModule_of_finrank_lt k
    (stepRefinement c cover r) (stepRefinement d cover' r') n hρ

name: TDA.Mapper.le_bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_of_isEmpty_face
statement:
theorem le_bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_of_isEmpty_face {ρ : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hρ : ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < ρ → ∃ (t : ℝ) (h : t ≤ t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)),
      IsEmpty (Face (mapper f (cover' (cellIndex d (t + ε)))) n) ∧
        mapperHomologyMap k f (r ((cellIndex c).monotone h)) n ≠ 0) :
    ρ ≤ bottleneck (stepMapperDiagram k f c cover r n) (stepMapperDiagram k f d cover' r' n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_eq]
  exact le_realInterleavingDistance_mapperHomologyPModule_of_isEmpty_face k
    (stepRefinement c cover r) (stepRefinement d cover' r') n hρ

name: TDA.Mapper.le_bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_of_structureMap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem le_bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_of_structureMap_ne_zero {ρ : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hρ : ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < ρ → ∃ (t : ℝ) (h : t ≤ t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)),
      Subsingleton ((mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower d cover')
        (stepRefinement d cover' r') n).obj (t + ε)) ∧
        structureMap (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower c cover)
          (stepRefinement c cover r) n) h ≠ 0) :
    ρ ≤ bottleneck (stepMapperDiagram k f c cover r n) (stepMapperDiagram k f d cover' r' n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_eq]
  exact le_realInterleavingDistance_of_structureMap_ne_zero hρ

name: TDA.Mapper.isEmpty_realInterleaving_stepTower_of_isEmpty_face
statement:
theorem isEmpty_realInterleaving_stepTower_of_isEmpty_face {ε : ℝ≥0} (t : ℝ)
    (h : t ≤ t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))
    [IsEmpty (Face (mapper f (cover' (cellIndex d (t + ε)))) n)]
    (hne : mapperHomologyMap k f (r ((cellIndex c).monotone h)) n ≠ 0) :
    IsEmpty (RealInterleaving ε
      (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower c cover) (stepRefinement c cover r) n)
      (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower d cover') (stepRefinement d cover' r') n))
proof:
:=
  isEmpty_realInterleaving_mapperHomologyPModule_of_isEmpty_face k
    (stepRefinement c cover r) (stepRefinement d cover' r') n t h hne

name: TDA.Mapper.heq_stepTower_shiftGrid
statement:
theorem heq_stepTower_shiftGrid (t : ℝ) :
    HEq (stepTower (shiftGrid ε c) cover t) (stepTower c cover (t + ε))
proof:
:= by
  unfold stepTower
  rw [cellIndex_shiftGrid]

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_shiftGrid_le

    (stepTowerOfShiftGrid c cover r ε)

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperHomologyMap_ne_zero_of_le
proof:
:= fun h0 =>
  hne ((mapperHomologyMap_comp_eq k f (r hij) (r hjl) (r hil) n).symm.trans
    (by rw [h0, zero_comp]))

name: TDA.Mapper.le_realInterleavingDistance_stepTower_shiftGrid
statement:
theorem le_realInterleavingDistance_stepTower_shiftGrid (ε : ℝ≥0) (hsurv : SurvivesToLast k f n r) :
    (ε : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ realInterleavingDistance
      (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower c cover) (stepRefinement c cover r) n)
      (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower (shiftGrid ε c) cover)
        (stepRefinement (shiftGrid ε c) cover r) n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [realInterleavingDistance_comm]
  refine le_realInterleavingDistance_of_structureMap_ne_zero fun δ hδ => ?_
  have hδε : (δ : ℝ) < ε := by exact_mod_cast ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.1 hδ
  have hδ0 := δ.coe_nonneg
  refine ⟨c 0 - ε, by linarith, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hz := (isConstructible_stepTower c cover k f r n).zero_left (c 0 - ε + δ)
      (fun i => by linarith [c.monotone (Fin.zero_le i)])
    exact ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hz
  · have hi : (0 : Fin (m₀ + 1)).succ = cellIndex (shiftGrid ε c) (c 0 - ε) := by
      rw [cellIndex_shiftGrid, sub_add_cancel, cellIndex_critical]
    intro h0
    have key : ∀ i (_ : (0 : Fin (m₀ + 1)).succ = i) (hil : i ≤ Fin.last (m₀ + 1)),
        mapperHomologyMap k f (r hil) n ≠ 0 := by
      rintro i rfl hil
      exact hsurv
    exact mapperHomologyMap_ne_zero_of_le
      ((cellIndex (shiftGrid ε c)).monotone (show c 0 - ε ≤ c 0 - ε + ((δ + δ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) by
        have := (δ + δ).coe_nonneg
        linarith))
      (Fin.le_last _) (Fin.le_last _) (key _ hi _) h0

name: TDA.Mapper.realInterleavingDistance_stepTower_shiftGrid_eq
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_stepTower_shiftGrid_eq (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (hsurv : SurvivesToLast k f n r) :
    realInterleavingDistance
        (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower c cover) (stepRefinement c cover r) n)
        (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower (shiftGrid ε c) cover)
          (stepRefinement (shiftGrid ε c) cover r) n) = ε
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (le_realInterleavingDistance_stepTower_shiftGrid c ε hsurv)
  rw [← bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_eq]
  exact bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_shiftGrid_le c cover r ε k f n

name: TDA.Mapper.existsUnique_cell_support_singleton
statement:
theorem existsUnique_cell_support_singleton (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y)
    (a : ComponentIndex f U) : ∃! c : multiNerveMapper f U, c.support = {a}
proof:
:= by
  have hpc : IsPathConnected (interMember (componentCover f U) {a}) := by
    rw [interMember_singleton]
    exact componentCover_isPathConnected f U a
  have hsub := subsingleton_zerothHomotopy_of_isPathConnected hpc
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_cell_of_mem_nerve (componentIndex_supported f U a)
  refine ⟨c, hc, fun d hd => ?_⟩
  have e := cellsOverEquiv (componentCover f U) {a} (Finset.singleton_nonempty a)
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.injective (a₁ := ⟨d, hd⟩) (a₂ := ⟨c, hc⟩)
    (@Subsingleton.elim _ hsub _ _))

name: TDA.Mapper.intersectionsPathSubsingleton_of_preimage
statement:
theorem intersectionsPathSubsingleton_of_preimage (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y)
    (h : PreimageIntersectionsPathConnected f U) :
    IntersectionsPathSubsingleton (componentCover f U)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  refine ⟨fun c d => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective c
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective d
  have hx := (mem_interMember_iff _).1 x.2
  let τ : Finset I := s.image Sigma.fst
  have hmem : ∀ z ∈ interMember (componentCover f U) s, z ∈ f ⁻¹' ⋂ i ∈ τ, U i := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Set.mem_preimage, mem_iInter₂]
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hi
    exact ((mem_interMember_iff _).1 hz a ha).1
  have hP := h τ (hs.image _) ⟨x.1, hmem _ x.2⟩
  have hsub : f ⁻¹' (⋂ i ∈ τ, U i) ⊆ interMember (componentCover f U) s := by
    intro z hz
    rw [mem_interMember_iff]
    intro a ha
    have hτa : a.1 ∈ τ := Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ha
    have hzU : f z ∈ U a.1 := mem_iInter₂.1 hz a.1 hτa
    obtain ⟨hxU, hxc⟩ := hx a ha
    have hxz : JoinedIn (f ⁻¹' U a.1) x.1 z :=
      (hP.joinedIn _ (hmem _ x.2) _ hz).mono fun w hw => mem_iInter₂.1 hw a.1 hτa
    exact ⟨hzU, (mk_eq_of_joinedIn f (U a.1) hxz hxU hzU).symm.trans hxc⟩
  have hxy : JoinedIn (f ⁻¹' ⋂ i ∈ τ, U i) x.1 y.1 :=
    hP.joinedIn _ (hmem _ x.2) _ (hmem _ y.2)
  exact ZerothHomotopy.sound (hxy.mono hsub).joined_subtype.somePath

name: TDA.Mapper.ioo_inter_nonempty_of_left_mem
statement:
theorem ioo_inter_nonempty_of_left_mem (I : OpenInterval) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : a ∈ I) (hab : a < b) : ((ioo a b : Set ℝ) ∩ I).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, r, ⟨hla, har⟩, hsub⟩ :=
    mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.mp (I.isOpen.mem_nhds ha)
  obtain ⟨x, hax, hxr⟩ := exists_between (lt_min har hab)
  exact ⟨x, ⟨hax, hxr.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)⟩,
    hsub ⟨hla.trans hax, hxr.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)⟩⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.ioo_inter_nonempty_of_right_mem
statement:
theorem ioo_inter_nonempty_of_right_mem (I : OpenInterval) {a b : ℝ}
    (hb : b ∈ I) (hab : a < b) : ((ioo a b : Set ℝ) ∩ I).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, r, ⟨hlb, hbr⟩, hsub⟩ :=
    mem_nhds_iff_exists_Ioo_subset.mp (I.isOpen.mem_nhds hb)
  obtain ⟨x, hlx, hxb⟩ := exists_between (max_lt hlb hab)
  exact ⟨x, ⟨(le_max_right _ _).trans_lt hlx, hxb⟩,
    hsub ⟨(le_max_left _ _).trans_lt hlx, hxb.trans hbr⟩⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.ioo_inter_nonempty_of_same_endpoints
statement:
theorem ioo_inter_nonempty_of_same_endpoints {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : a ∈ I ↔ a ∈ J) (hb : b ∈ I ↔ b ∈ J) :
    ((ioo a b : Set ℝ) ∩ I).Nonempty ↔ ((ioo a b : Set ℝ) ∩ J).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hxI⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, hIJ hxI⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hay, hyb⟩, hyJ⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hxI⟩ := hI
    by_cases hx : a < x ∧ x < b
    · exact ⟨x, hx, hxI⟩
    · by_cases hxa : x ≤ a
      · have haJ : a ∈ J := J.ordConnected.out (hIJ hxI) hyJ ⟨hxa, hay.le⟩
        exact ioo_inter_nonempty_of_left_mem I (ha.mpr haJ) (hay.trans hyb)
      · have hbx : b ≤ x := le_of_not_gt (fun hxb => hx ⟨lt_of_not_ge hxa, hxb⟩)
        have hbJ : b ∈ J := J.ordConnected.out hyJ (hIJ hxI) ⟨hyb.le, hbx⟩
        exact ioo_inter_nonempty_of_right_mem I (hb.mpr hbJ) (hay.trans hyb)

name: TDA.Mapper.exists_coversIntervalEndpoints
statement:
theorem exists_coversIntervalEndpoints [Finite ι] :
    ∃ n, ∃ S : CriticalValues n, CoversIntervalEndpoints a b S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hι | hι
  · let : Subsingleton (Fin (0 + 1)) := ⟨fun i j =>
      (Fin.eq_zero i).trans (Fin.eq_zero j).symm⟩
    exact ⟨0, ⟨fun _ => 0, Subsingleton.strictMono _⟩,
      (fun i => isEmptyElim i), fun i => isEmptyElim i⟩
  · let : Nonempty ι := hι
    let : Fintype (ι × Bool) := Fintype.ofFinite _
    refine ⟨_, GraphPL.vertexHeightLevels (coverEndpointHeight a b), ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i
      simpa [coverEndpointHeight] using
        GraphPL.coversVertexHeights_vertexHeightLevels (coverEndpointHeight a b) (i, false)
    · intro i
      simpa [coverEndpointHeight] using
        GraphPL.coversVertexHeights_vertexHeightLevels (coverEndpointHeight a b) (i, true)

name: TDA.Mapper.coverSaturation_eq_of_same_endpoints
statement:
theorem coverSaturation_eq_of_same_endpoints {n : ℕ} (S : CriticalValues n)
    (hS : CoversIntervalEndpoints a b S) {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty) (hlev : ∀ j, S.value j ∈ I ↔ S.value j ∈ J) :
    coverSaturation (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i)) I =
      coverSaturation (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i)) J
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (coverSaturation_mono _ hIJ)
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hxi, y, hyU, hyJ⟩ := mem_coverSaturation.mp hx
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hS.1 i
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hS.2 i
  have ha : a i ∈ I ↔ a i ∈ J := by simpa [hj] using hlev j
  have hb : b i ∈ I ↔ b i ∈ J := by simpa [hk] using hlev k
  obtain ⟨z, hzU, hzI⟩ := (ioo_inter_nonempty_of_same_endpoints hIJ hI ha hb).mpr
    ⟨y, hyU, hyJ⟩
  exact mem_coverSaturation.mpr ⟨i, hxi, z, hzU, hzI⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.isConstructibleAt_coverComponents
statement:
theorem isConstructibleAt_coverComponents [Finite ι] (f : C(X, ℝ))
    (hfinite : ∀ i, Finite ((intervalComponents f).obj (ioo (a i) (b i))))
    {n : ℕ} (S : CriticalValues n) (hS : CoversIntervalEndpoints a b S) :
    S.IsConstructibleAt (coverComponents f (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i))) where
  finite
proof:
:= finite_coverComponents f _ hfinite
  bijective := by
    intro I J hIJ hI hlev
    have hsat := coverSaturation_eq_of_same_endpoints a b S hS hIJ hI hlev
    let m := homOfLE (coverSaturation_mono (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i)) hIJ)
    let : IsIso m := ⟨⟨homOfLE hsat.ge, Subsingleton.elim _ _, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩⟩
    exact (isIso_iff_bijective ((componentFunctor f).map m)).mp inferInstance
  isEmpty_lowerTail := ⟨fun c => by
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      obtain ⟨i, _, y, hyU, hyI⟩ := mem_coverSaturation.mp x.property
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hS.1 i
      have hj0 := S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le j)
      rw [hj] at hj0
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hj0) (hyU.1.trans (S.mem_lowerTail.mp hyI))⟩
  isEmpty_upperTail := ⟨fun c => by
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      obtain ⟨i, _, y, hyU, hyI⟩ := mem_coverSaturation.mp x.property
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hS.2 i
      have hjn := S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.le_last j)
      rw [hj] at hjn
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hjn) ((S.mem_upperTail.mp hyI).trans hyU.2)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.isConstructibleCosheaf_coverComponents
statement:
theorem isConstructibleCosheaf_coverComponents [Finite ι] (f : C(X, ℝ))
    (hfinite : ∀ i, Finite ((intervalComponents f).obj (ioo (a i) (b i)))) :
    IsConstructibleCosheaf (coverComponents f (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, S, hS⟩ := exists_coversIntervalEndpoints a b
  exact IsConstructibleCosheaf.of_isConstructibleAt
    (isConstructibleAt_coverComponents a b f hfinite S hS)
    (coverComponents_isIntervalCosheaf f (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i)))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.incidenceComponentCover_covers
statement:
theorem incidenceComponentCover_covers (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ)
    (U : I → OpenInterval)
    (hU : Covers (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ)) (Set.range (plHeight G h))) :
    Covers (incidenceComponentCover G h U) Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := componentCover_covers_range (plHeight G h)
    (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ)) hU x hx
  refine ⟨componentIndexEquiv G h U a, ?_⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mem_mapper_iff_incidenceMapper_image
statement:
theorem mem_mapper_iff_incidenceMapper_image (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ)
    (U : I → OpenInterval)
    (s : Finset (ComponentIndex (plHeight G h) (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ)))) :
    s ∈ mapper (plHeight G h) (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ)) ↔
      s.image (componentIndexEquiv G h U) ∈ incidenceMapper G h U
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨hsn, x, hx⟩ := (mem_mapper_iff _ _ s).1 hs
    apply (mem_nerve_iff _ _).2
    refine ⟨Finset.image_nonempty.mpr hsn, x, ?_⟩
    intro b hb
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hb
    simpa [incidenceComponentCover] using hx a ha
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨hsn, x, hx⟩ := (mem_nerve_iff _ _).1 hs
    apply (mem_mapper_iff _ _ s).2
    refine ⟨Finset.image_nonempty.mp hsn, x, ?_⟩
    intro a ha
    have hmem := hx (componentIndexEquiv G h U a)
      (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩)
    simpa [incidenceComponentCover] using hmem

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mem_incidenceMapper_iff_mapper_image_symm
statement:
theorem mem_incidenceMapper_iff_mapper_image_symm (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ)
    (U : I → OpenInterval) (s : Finset (IncidenceComponentIndex G h U)) :
    s ∈ incidenceMapper G h U ↔
      s.image (componentIndexEquiv G h U).symm ∈
        mapper (plHeight G h) (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨hsn, x, hx⟩ := (mem_nerve_iff _ _).1 hs
    apply (mem_mapper_iff _ _ _).2
    refine ⟨Finset.image_nonempty.mpr hsn, x, ?_⟩
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
    simpa [incidenceComponentCover] using hx b hb
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨hsn, x, hx⟩ := (mem_mapper_iff _ _ _).1 hs
    apply (mem_nerve_iff _ _).2
    refine ⟨Finset.image_nonempty.mp hsn, x, ?_⟩
    intro b hb
    have hmem := hx ((componentIndexEquiv G h U).symm b)
      (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩)
    simpa [incidenceComponentCover] using hmem

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.componentIndexEquiv_mapperMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentIndexEquiv_mapperMap (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ)
    {U : I → OpenInterval} {W : J → OpenInterval}
    (R : Refinement (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ)) (fun j => (W j : Set ℝ)))
    (a : ComponentIndex (plHeight G h) (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ))) :
    componentIndexEquiv G h W (mapperMap (plHeight G h) R a) =
      incidenceRefinementMap G h R (componentIndexEquiv G h U a)
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨i, c⟩
  let hUW : U i ≤ W (R.selector i) := OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.2 (R.subset i)
  change (⟨R.selector i, preimageComponentsEquiv G h (W (R.selector i))
      (componentRefinementMap (plHeight G h) R i c)⟩ :
        IncidenceComponentIndex G h W) =
    ⟨R.selector i,
      (preimageComponentsEquiv G h (U i) c).map (cellInclusion G h hUW)⟩
  refine Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq ?_)
  change preimageComponentsEquiv G h (W (R.selector i))
      (TDA.Topology.componentMap (refinementInclusion (plHeight G h) R i) c) =
    (preimageComponentsEquiv G h (U i) c).map (cellInclusion G h hUW)
  rw [show refinementInclusion (plHeight G h) R i =
      TDA.Reeb.preimageInclusion (plHeight G h) (toOpens_le_iff.2 hUW) by
    ext x
    rfl]
  exact preimageComponentsEquiv_componentMap G h hUW c

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.incidenceMapperMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem incidenceMapperMap_apply (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ)

    (R : Refinement (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ)) (fun j => (W j : Set ℝ)))
    (a : IncidenceComponentIndex G h U) :
    incidenceMapperMap G h R a = incidenceRefinementMap G h R a

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.finite_componentIndex
statement:
theorem finite_componentIndex [Finite V] [Finite I] (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ)
    (U : I → OpenInterval) :
    Finite (ComponentIndex (plHeight G h) (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  change Finite (Σ i, ZerothHomotopy
    {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ U i})
  let _ (i : I) : Finite
      (ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ U i}) :=
    finite_zerothHomotopy G h (U i)
