name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.finite_mapperVertex
statement:
theorem finite_mapperVertex [Finite V] [Finite I] (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ)
    (U : I → OpenInterval) :
    Finite (MapperVertex (plHeight G h) (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  let _ := finite_componentIndex G h U
  exact Finite.of_injective Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.finite_mapperFaces
statement:
theorem finite_mapperFaces [Finite V] [Finite I] (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ)
    (U : I → OpenInterval) :
    Finite {s : Finset (ComponentIndex (plHeight G h) (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ))) //
      s ∈ mapper (plHeight G h) (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ))}
proof:
:= by
  let _ := finite_componentIndex G h U
  let _ : Fintype (ComponentIndex (plHeight G h) (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ))) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite _
  exact Finite.of_injective Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective

name: TDA.Mapper.range_plHeight_eq_Icc
proof:
:= by
  refine Subset.antisymm (range_plHeight_subset_Icc fun v => ⟨hlo v, hhi v⟩) ?_
  have := (connected_iff_pathConnectedSpace G).1 hG
  exact (isPreconnected_range (plHeight G h).continuous).Icc_subset
    ⟨vertex G lo, plHeight_vertex G h lo⟩ ⟨vertex G hi, plHeight_vertex G h hi⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.exists_range_plHeight_eq_Icc
statement:
theorem exists_range_plHeight_eq_Icc [Finite V] {G : SimpleGraph V} (h : V → ℝ)
    (hG : G.Connected) :
    ∃ lo hi : V, (∀ v, h lo ≤ h v) ∧ (∀ v, h v ≤ h hi) ∧
      Set.range (plHeight G h) = Set.Icc (h lo) (h hi)
proof:
:= by
  have := hG.nonempty
  obtain ⟨lo, hlo⟩ := Finite.exists_min h
  obtain ⟨hi, hhi⟩ := Finite.exists_max h
  exact ⟨lo, hi, hlo, hhi, range_plHeight_eq_Icc hG hlo hhi⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.exists_pos_le_abs
statement:
private theorem exists_pos_le_abs {ι : Type*} [Finite ι] (F : ι → ℝ) (hF : ∀ i, F i ≠ 0) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ i, ε ≤ |F i|
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty ι with hι | hι
  · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun i => isEmptyElim i⟩
  · obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := Finite.exists_min fun i => |F i|
    exact ⟨|F i₀|, abs_pos.2 (hF i₀), hi₀⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.exists_heightSeparating_uniformCover
statement:
theorem exists_heightSeparating_uniformCover [Finite V] (h : V → ℝ) {m M ρ : ℝ}
    (_hh : ∀ v, h v ∈ Set.Icc m M) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ∃ (a r g : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 < g ∧ 2 * g ≤ r ∧ r < ρ ∧ 0 < n ∧
      m - (r - g) < a ∧ a < m ∧ M < a + n * (r - g) + g ∧
      HeightSeparating h (uniformCover a r g n)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hδle⟩ := exists_pos_le_abs (ι := {p : V × V // h p.1 ≠ h p.2})
    (fun p => h p.1.1 - h p.1.2) fun p => sub_ne_zero.2 p.2
  
  set s : ℝ := min ρ δ / 2 with hs_def
  have hs : 0 < s := half_pos (lt_min hρ hδ)
  have hsρ : s ≤ ρ / 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left _ _) zero_le_two
  have hsδ : s ≤ δ / 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) zero_le_two
  
  obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀⟩ := exists_nat_gt ((M - m) / s)
  set n : ℕ := n₀ + 1 with hn_def
  have hn : 0 < n := Nat.succ_pos n₀
  have hns : M - m + s < n * s := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hs] at hn₀
    rw [hn_def]
    push_cast
    linarith
  
  have hB : (Set.range fun p : V × Fin n => h p.1 - ((p.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * s).Finite :=
    Set.finite_range _
  obtain ⟨a, ha, haB⟩ :=
    (Set.Ioo_infinite (by linarith : m - s < m)).exists_notMem_finite hB
  
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεle⟩ := exists_pos_le_abs (ι := V × Fin n)
    (fun p => h p.1 - (a + ((p.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * s)) fun p hp =>
      haB ⟨p, by
        have hp' : h p.1 - (a + ((p.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * s) = 0 := hp
        show h p.1 - ((p.2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * s = a
        linarith⟩
  set g : ℝ := min ε s / 2 with hg_def
  have hg : 0 < g := half_pos (lt_min hε hs)
  have hgε : g < ε := lt_of_le_of_lt (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_left _ _) zero_le_two)
    (half_lt_self hε)
  have hgs : g ≤ s / 2 := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) zero_le_two
  set r : ℝ := s + g with hr_def
  have hrg : r - g = s := by rw [hr_def]; ring
  have hgr : g ≤ r := by linarith
  refine ⟨a, r, g, n, hg, by linarith, by linarith, hn, by rw [hrg]; exact ha.1, ha.2,
    by rw [hrg]; linarith [ha.1], ?_, ?_⟩
  · 
    intro k v w hv hw
    rw [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval, hrg] at hv hw
    obtain ⟨hv₁, hv₂⟩ := hv
    obtain ⟨hw₁, hw₂⟩ := hw
    by_contra hne
    have hgap : δ ≤ |h v - h w| := hδle ⟨(v, w), hne⟩
    have : |h v - h w| < r := abs_sub_lt_iff.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    linarith
  · 
    intro k l hkl v hv
    rw [GraphPL.uniformCover_inf_of_succ hgr hkl, mem_ioo, hrg] at hv
    have hdist : ε ≤ |h v - (a + ((l : ℕ) : ℝ) * s)| := hεle (v, l)
    have : |h v - (a + ((l : ℕ) : ℝ) * s)| < g :=
      abs_sub_lt_iff.2 ⟨by linarith [hv.2], by linarith [hv.1]⟩
    linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.heightSeparating_covers_range
statement:
theorem heightSeparating_covers_range [Finite V] (h : V → ℝ) {m M ρ : ℝ}
    (hh : ∀ v, h v ∈ Set.Icc m M) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ∃ (a r g : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 < g ∧ 2 * g ≤ r ∧ r < ρ ∧ 0 < n ∧
      m - (r - g) < a ∧ a < m ∧ M < a + n * (r - g) + g ∧
      HeightSeparating h (uniformCover a r g n) ∧
      ∀ G : SimpleGraph V,
        Covers (fun k => (uniformCover a r g n k : Set ℝ)) (Set.range (plHeight G h))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, r, g, n, hg, hgr, hrρ, hn, ha₁, ha₂, hM, hsep⟩ :=
    exists_heightSeparating_uniformCover h hh hρ
  exact ⟨a, r, g, n, hg, hgr, hrρ, hn, ha₁, ha₂, hM, hsep, fun _ =>
    uniformCover_covers_range hh ha₂ hM hg hn⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edgeSplit_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hv : ∃ v ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V), h v ∈ K := ⟨w, hw, w.2⟩
  unfold edgeSplit
  rw [dif_pos hv]
  exact congrArg Sum.inl (induce_mk_eq_of_mem G h K (Classical.choose_spec hv).1 hw)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edgeSplit_of_not
proof:

  rw [dif_neg hv]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.splitNode_eq_of_adj
statement:
private theorem splitNode_eq_of_adj {x y : Cell G h K} (hxy : (cellGraph G h K).Adj x y) :
    splitNode G h K x = splitNode G h K y
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with v | e <;> rcases y with w | e'
  · exact (hxy : False).elim
  · exact (edgeSplit_of_mem e' hxy).symm
  · exact edgeSplit_of_mem e hxy
  · exact (hxy : False).elim

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.cellComponentsEquivSum_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem cellComponentsEquivSum_inl (v : {v : V // h v ∈ K}) :
    cellComponentsEquivSum G h K ((cellGraph G h K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl v)) =
      Sum.inl ((G.induce (h ⁻¹' (K : Set ℝ))).connectedComponentMk v)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.cellComponentsEquivSum_inr_of_mem
statement:
theorem cellComponentsEquivSum_inr_of_mem (e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h K e})
    {w : ↥(h ⁻¹' (K : Set ℝ))} (hw : (w : V) ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V)) :
    cellComponentsEquivSum G h K ((cellGraph G h K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr e)) =
      Sum.inl ((G.induce (h ⁻¹' (K : Set ℝ))).connectedComponentMk w)
proof:

  edgeSplit_of_mem e hw

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.cellComponentsEquivSum_inr_uncovered
statement:
@[simp] theorem cellComponentsEquivSum_inr_uncovered (e : UncoveredEdge G h K) :
    cellComponentsEquivSum G h K ((cellGraph G h K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr ⟨e.1, e.2.1⟩)) =
      Sum.inr e
proof:
:=
  (cellComponentsEquivSum G h K).apply_symm_apply (Sum.inr e)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.cellComponentsEquivSum_symm_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem cellComponentsEquivSum_symm_inl
    (c : (G.induce (h ⁻¹' (K : Set ℝ))).ConnectedComponent) :
    (cellComponentsEquivSum G h K).symm (Sum.inl c) = inducedToCell G h K c
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.cellComponentsEquivSum_symm_inr
statement:

    (cellComponentsEquivSum G h K).symm (Sum.inr e) =

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.isEmpty_uncoveredEdge_of_coverage
statement:
theorem isEmpty_uncoveredEdge_of_coverage (hcov : EndpointCoverage G h K) :
    IsEmpty (UncoveredEdge G h K)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun e => by
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvK⟩ := hcov e.1 e.2.1

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.cellComponentsEquivSum_eq_inl_of_coverage
statement:
theorem cellComponentsEquivSum_eq_inl_of_coverage (hcov : EndpointCoverage G h K)
    (c : (cellGraph G h K).ConnectedComponent) :
    cellComponentsEquivSum G h K c = Sum.inl (cellInducedEquiv G h K hcov c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using ConnectedComponent.ind with
  | h x =>
    rcases x with v | e
    · rfl
    · exact cellComponentsEquivSum_inr_of_mem G h K e (coverEndpoint_mem G h K hcov e)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.cellComponentsEquivSum_eq_inr_of_forall_not_mem
statement:
theorem cellComponentsEquivSum_eq_inr_of_forall_not_mem (hK : ∀ v, h v ∉ K)
    (c : (cellGraph G h K).ConnectedComponent) :
    cellComponentsEquivSum G h K c =
      Sum.inr ⟨(cellGraphComponentsEquivActiveEdges hK c).1,
        (cellGraphComponentsEquivActiveEdges hK c).2, fun v _ => hK v⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction c using ConnectedComponent.ind with
  | h x =>
    rcases x with v | e
    · exact (hK v.1 v.2).elim
    · show edgeSplit G h K e = _
      rw [edgeSplit_of_not e fun ⟨v, _, hvK⟩ => hK v hvK]
      rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edgeCrosses_dartEdge_iff
statement:
theorem edgeCrosses_dartEdge_iff {c : ℝ} (d : G.Dart) :
    EdgeCrosses G h c (dartEdge d) ↔
      min (h d.fst) (h d.snd) < c ∧ c < max (h d.fst) (h d.snd)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨d', hd', h₁, h₂⟩ => ?_, fun hd => ⟨d, rfl, hd⟩⟩
  rcases dartEdge_eq_iff.1 hd' with rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  · exact ⟨by rw [min_comm]; exact h₁, by rw [max_comm]; exact h₂⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff
statement:
theorem edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff {p q : ℝ} (d : G.Dart) :
    EdgeSpans G h p q (dartEdge d) ↔
      min (h d.fst) (h d.snd) ≤ p ∧ q ≤ max (h d.fst) (h d.snd)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨d', hd', h₁, h₂⟩ => ?_, fun hd => ⟨d, rfl, hd⟩⟩
  rcases dartEdge_eq_iff.1 hd' with rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  · exact ⟨by rw [min_comm]; exact h₁, by rw [max_comm]; exact h₂⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedTowerExamples.nonempty_zeroComponent

private theorem nonempty_zeroComponent {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin (m + 1))
    (hi : 0 < stageRadius c i) :
    Nonempty (ComponentIndex (constMap 0) fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover 0 1 zeroLabel c i w : Set ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩ := i.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
  · exact absurd hi (by simp)
  exact ⟨⟨(), ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨(), (mem_cappedCentredCover_succ_iff 0 1 zeroLabel c j () 0).mpr
    (by simpa using hi)⟩⟩⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedTowerExamples.isEmpty_halfComponent
statement:
private theorem isEmpty_halfComponent {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin (m + 1))
    (hi : stageRadius c i ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : EReal)) :
    IsEmpty (ComponentIndex (constMap (1 / 2)) fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover 0 1 zeroLabel c i w : Set ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨w, z⟩ => ?_⟩
  obtain rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩ := i.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
  · exact isEmptyElim w
  induction z using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    have hx := (mem_cappedCentredCover_succ_iff 0 1 zeroLabel c j w (1 / 2)).mp x.2
    have : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) < (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (hx.trans_le hi)
      norm_num
    exact lt_irrefl _ this

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedTowerExamples.stageRadius_cellIndex_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | ⟨j, h⟩ := (cellIndex c u).eq_zero_or_eq_succ
  · rw [h, stageRadius_zero]
    exact bot_le
  have hju := ((cellIndex_eq_succ_iff c j u).mp h).1
  have hjq : j.val < q.val + 1 := by
    by_contra hge
    exact (hu.trans_le (hju.trans' (c.monotone (Fin.le_def.mpr (by simp; omega))))).false
  rw [h, stageRadius_succ_of_lt c j (by omega)]
  exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (c.monotone (Fin.le_def.mpr (by omega)))

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedTowerExamples.le_realInterleavingDistance_const
proof:
:= by

      (EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hcq))
    exact isEmpty_face_mapper _ _ 0
  · obtain ⟨a⟩ := nonempty_zeroComponent c (cellIndex c (c j)) (by
      rw [cellIndex_critical, stageRadius_succ_of_lt c j hj]
      exact EReal.coe_pos.mpr hcj)
    exact mapperHomologyMap_ne_zero k _ _ a

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedTowerExamples.const_bottleneck_eq
statement:
theorem const_bottleneck_eq (k : Type) [Field k] :
    bottleneck (constDiagram k 0 quarterGrid) (constDiagram k (1 / 2) quarterGrid) =
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_uniformGrid_le k 0 1 zeroLabel 0 0 (1 / 4) _ 5
      abs_const_sub 2 (by norm_num)
  · rw [bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_eq]
    refine le_realInterleavingDistance_const k quarterGrid 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) 2
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) fun ε hε => ?_
    have : (ε : ℝ) < 1 / 2 := by exact_mod_cast hε
    simp only [quarterGrid, uniformGrid_apply]
    norm_num
    linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedTowerExamples.const_bottleneck_self

    (f := constMap 0) (g := constMap 0) (δ := 0) (fun _ => by simp) 0 (by simp)).trans_eq

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedTowerExamples.const_bottleneck_grid_le
statement:

    (fun _ _ hij => by rw [uniformGrid_of_val_eq_succ _ _ _ hij]; norm_num)
    (fun _ _ hij => by rw [uniformGrid_of_val_eq_succ _ _ _ hij]; norm_num)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedTowerExamples.edge_bottleneck_le
statement:
theorem edge_bottleneck_le (k : Type) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (cappedCentredDiagram k (plHeight edgeGraph h01) 0 1 (fun w : Fin 3 => (w : ℤ))
        edgeGrid n)

proof:

  bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_plHeight_uniformGrid_le k edgeGraph 0 1 _ n
    (fun v => by cases v <;> norm_num [h01, h032, abs_of_neg]) 0 (1 / 4) _ 9 2 (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedTowerExamples.open_bottleneck_eq_top
statement:
theorem open_bottleneck_eq_top (k : Type) [Field k] :
    (∀ x, |constMap 0 x - constMap (1 / 2) x| ≤ 1 / 2) ∧
      bottleneck (stepMapperDiagram k (constMap 0) shortGrid openCover openRefinement 0)
        (stepMapperDiagram k (constMap (1 / 2)) shortGrid openCover openRefinement 0) = ⊤ ∧
      (essentialPart (stepMapperDiagram k (constMap 0) shortGrid openCover openRefinement
        0).points).card ≠
      (essentialPart (stepMapperDiagram k (constMap (1 / 2)) shortGrid openCover openRefinement
        0).points).card
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : ∀ i, IsEmpty (ComponentIndex (constMap (1 / 2)) (openCover i)) := fun i =>
    ⟨fun ⟨w, z⟩ => by
      induction z using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
      | mk x =>
        have hx : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < (((i : ℕ) - 1 : ℕ) / 4 : ℝ) := x.2.2
        have : (((i : ℕ) - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
          exact_mod_cast (by omega : (i : ℕ) - 1 ≤ 1)
        linarith⟩
  have htop : realInterleavingDistance (openModule k 0) (openModule k (1 / 2)) = ⊤ := by
    refine top_le_iff.mp (le_realInterleavingDistance_mapperHomologyPModule_of_isEmpty_face k _ _
      0 fun ε _ => ⟨1 / 4, by simp, isEmpty_face_mapper _ _ 0, ?_⟩)
    have hcell : ∀ t : ℝ, 1 / 4 ≤ t → cellIndex shortGrid t = 2 := fun t ht =>
      cellIndex_of_last_le shortGrid t (by simpa using ht)
    obtain ⟨a⟩ :
        Nonempty (ComponentIndex (constMap 0) (openCover (cellIndex shortGrid (1 / 4)))) := by
      rw [hcell _ le_rfl]
      exact ⟨⟨⟨(), by decide⟩, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨(), by norm_num [openCover]⟩⟩⟩
    exact mapperHomologyMap_ne_zero k _ _ a
  have hM := isConstructible_stepTower shortGrid openCover k (constMap 0) openRefinement 0
  have hN := isConstructible_stepTower shortGrid openCover k (constMap (1 / 2)) openRefinement 0
  refine ⟨fun _ => by norm_num [abs_of_neg], ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (bottleneck_eq_distance hM hN _ _).trans htop
  · exact (distance_eq_top_iff_essential_card_ne hM hN _ _).mp htop

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedTowerExamples.coarse_bottleneck_bounds
statement:
theorem coarse_bottleneck_bounds (k : Type) [Field k] :
    ((3 / 4 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ bottleneck (constDiagram k 0 coarseGrid)
        (constDiagram k (1 / 2) coarseGrid) ∧
      bottleneck (constDiagram k 0 coarseGrid) (constDiagram k (1 / 2) coarseGrid) ≤
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) + ((3 / 4 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ∧
      ¬ bottleneck (constDiagram k 0 coarseGrid) (constDiagram k (1 / 2) coarseGrid) ≤
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hlow : ((3 / 4 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤
      bottleneck (constDiagram k 0 coarseGrid) (constDiagram k (1 / 2) coarseGrid) := by
    rw [bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_eq]
    refine le_realInterleavingDistance_const k coarseGrid 1 (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num [coarseGrid]) 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num [coarseGrid]) fun ε hε => ?_
    have : (ε : ℝ) < 3 / 4 := by exact_mod_cast hε
    simp only [coarseGrid]
    norm_num
    linarith
  refine ⟨hlow, ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · refine bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le k 0 1 zeroLabel 0 abs_const_sub fun i j hij => ?_
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [coarseGrid] <;> norm_num
  · have := hlow.trans h
    rw [ENNReal.coe_le_coe] at this
    have : ((3 / 4 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast this
    norm_num at this

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyDiagramExamples.oneSource_not_isConstructible
statement:
theorem oneSource_not_isConstructible (k : Type) [Field k]
    [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex threeStageMap oneSource)] {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ) :
    ¬ IsConstructible c (mapperHomologyPModule k threeStageMap
      (stepTower c (fun _ : Fin (m + 1) => oneSource))
      (stepRefinement c _ fun _ => Refinement.id oneSource) 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have ht : ∀ i, -1 - ∑ j, |c j| < c i := by
    intro i
    have h1 := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => |c j|) (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (c j))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
    have h2 := neg_abs_le (c i)
    linarith
  exact not_isZero_H0 k threeStageMap oneSource ⟨(), ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨(), Set.mem_univ _⟩⟩
    (h.zero_left _ ht)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyDiagramExamples.exists_pos_cellIndex_eq
statement:
private theorem exists_pos_cellIndex_eq {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ cellIndex c δ = cellIndex c 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Finset ℝ := (Finset.univ.filter fun i => 0 < c i).image c
  have hS : ∀ x ∈ S, 0 < x := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hlt⟩ : ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, δ < x := by
    by_cases hne : S.Nonempty
    · exact ⟨S.min' hne / 2, by linarith [hS _ (S.min'_mem hne)],
        fun x hx => by linarith [S.min'_le x hx, hS _ (S.min'_mem hne)]⟩
    · exact ⟨1, one_pos, fun x hx => absurd ⟨x, hx⟩ hne⟩
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, Fin.ext ?_⟩
  change (Finset.univ.filter fun i => c i ≤ δ).card = (Finset.univ.filter fun i => c i ≤ 0).card
  congr 1
  apply Finset.filter_congr
  intro i _
  constructor
  · intro hi
    by_contra h0
    have hmem : c i ∈ S := Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, lt_of_not_ge h0⟩, rfl⟩
    linarith [hlt _ hmem]
  · intro hi
    linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyDiagramExamples.centred_not_isConstructible
statement:
theorem centred_not_isConstructible (k : Type) [Field k]
    [∀ t, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex flatMap (centredCover 1 t))] :
    IsZero ((centredModule k).obj 0) ∧ (∀ t, 0 < t → ¬ IsZero ((centredModule k).obj t)) ∧
      ∀ (m : ℕ) (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ), ¬ IsConstructible c (centredModule k)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : IsZero ((centredModule k).obj 0) := by
    have : IsEmpty (ComponentIndex flatMap (centredCover 1 0)) := ⟨fun ⟨i, a⟩ => by
      induction a using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
      | mk x =>
        exact Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mp
          (centredCover_eq_empty (s := 1) (t := 0) le_rfl i) _ x.2⟩
    change IsZero (simplicialHomology (mapper flatMap (centredCover 1 0)) k 0)
    rw [mapper_eq_bot_of_isEmpty_componentIndex]
    exact TDA.Persistence.isZero_simplicialHomology_bot k 0
  have hpos : ∀ t, 0 < t → ¬ IsZero ((centredModule k).obj t) := by
    intro t ht
    have hmem : flatMap 0 ∈ centredCover 1 t 0 := by
      rw [mem_centredCover_iff]
      simpa [scaleMap] using ht
    exact not_isZero_H0 k flatMap (centredCover 1 t) ⟨0, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨0, hmem⟩⟩
  refine ⟨hzero, hpos, fun m c h => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hcell⟩ := exists_pos_cellIndex_eq c
  have := h.isIso_map 0 δ hδ.le hcell.symm
  exact hpos δ hδ (hzero.of_iso (asIso (structureMap (centredModule k) hδ.le)).symm)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebMergeHeightExamples.mergeY_injective_needed
statement:
theorem mergeY_injective_needed {a M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (haM : a ≤ M) :
    Nat.card ((cellComponentFunctor mergeY (mergeHeights a M)).obj (ioo 0 (a / 2))) = 2 ∧
      Nat.card ((cellComponentFunctor mergeY (mergeHeights 0 M)).obj
        (thicken ⟨a, ha.le⟩ (ioo 0 (a / 2)))) = 1 ∧
      ¬ Function.Injective ((cellComponentFunctor mergeY (mergeHeights a M)).map
        (homOfLE ((le_thicken ⟨a, ha.le⟩ (ioo 0 (a / 2))).trans
          (le_thicken ⟨a, ha.le⟩ (thicken ⟨a, ha.le⟩ (ioo 0 (a / 2))))))) ∧
      Nonempty (Interleaving ⟨a, ha.le⟩ (cellComponentFunctor mergeY (mergeHeights a M))
        (cellComponentFunctor mergeY (mergeHeights 0 M)))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) < a / 2 := by linarith
  have hthick : thicken ⟨a, ha.le⟩ (ioo 0 (a / 2)) = ioo (0 - a) (a / 2 + a) := thicken_ioo hc _
  have hthick₂ : thicken ⟨a, ha.le⟩ (thicken ⟨a, ha.le⟩ (ioo 0 (a / 2))) =
      ioo (0 - a - a) (a / 2 + a + a) := by
    rw [hthick]
    exact thicken_ioo (by linarith) _
  have htwo := card_cellComponents_mergeHeights_ioo (M := M) hc (by linarith) haM
  refine ⟨htwo, card_cellComponents_mergeHeights_eq_one (by rw [hthick]; constructor <;> linarith),
    fun hinj => ?_, ⟨((vertexHeightInterleaving mergeY (ε := ⟨a, ha.le⟩) fun v => ?_).isoLeft
      (intervalComponentsIso _ _)).isoRight (intervalComponentsIso _ _)⟩⟩
  · have hone : Nat.card ((cellComponentFunctor mergeY (mergeHeights a M)).obj
        (thicken ⟨a, ha.le⟩ (thicken ⟨a, ha.le⟩ (ioo 0 (a / 2))))) = 1 :=
      card_cellComponents_mergeHeights_eq_one (by rw [hthick₂]; constructor <;> linarith)
    have : Finite ((cellComponentFunctor mergeY (mergeHeights a M)).obj
        (thicken ⟨a, ha.le⟩ (thicken ⟨a, ha.le⟩ (ioo 0 (a / 2))))) := by
      change Finite (cellGraph _ _ _).ConnectedComponent
      infer_instance
    have hle := Nat.card_le_card_of_injective _ hinj
    change Nat.card (cellGraph _ _ _).ConnectedComponent ≤ _ at hle
    rw [htwo, hone] at hle
    exact absurd hle (by decide)
  · change |mergeHeights a M v - mergeHeights 0 M v| ≤ a
    fin_cases v <;> simp [mergeHeights, abs_of_pos ha, ha.le]

name: TDA.Mapper.interleavingDistance_coverComponents_le_add_of_le
statement:
private theorem interleavingDistance_coverComponents_le_add_of_le
    {f g : C(X, ℝ)} {U : ι → OpenInterval} {U' : ι' → OpenInterval} {r r' : ℝ≥0} {D : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hcovf : ∀ x, ∃ i, f x ∈ U i) (hdiam : ∀ i x, x ∈ U i → ∀ y, y ∈ U i → |x - y| ≤ r)
    (hcovg : ∀ x, ∃ i, g x ∈ U' i) (hdiam' : ∀ i x, x ∈ U' i → ∀ y, y ∈ U' i → |x - y| ≤ r')
    (hD : interleavingDistance (intervalComponents f) (intervalComponents g) ≤ D) :
    interleavingDistance (coverComponents f U) (coverComponents g U') ≤ r + D + r'
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := interleavingDistance_coverComponents_le f U r hcovf hdiam
  have h3 := interleavingDistance_coverComponents_le g U' r' hcovg hdiam'
  rw [interleavingDistance_comm] at h3
  calc _ ≤ interleavingDistance (coverComponents f U) (intervalComponents f) +
        interleavingDistance (intervalComponents f) (coverComponents g U') :=
        interleavingDistance_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ interleavingDistance (coverComponents f U) (intervalComponents f) +
        (interleavingDistance (intervalComponents f) (intervalComponents g) +
          interleavingDistance (intervalComponents g) (coverComponents g U')) :=
        add_le_add_right (interleavingDistance_triangle _ _ _) _
    _ ≤ r + (D + r') := add_le_add h1 (add_le_add hD h3)
    _ = r + D + r' := (add_assoc _ _ _).symm

    interleavingDistance (coverComponents (plHeight G h) (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i)))
      (coverComponents (plHeight G g) (fun i => ioo (a' i) (b' i)))

name: TDA.Mapper.geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_add_of_le
statement:
private theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_add_of_le {D : ℝ≥0∞} {ρ ρ' : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hρ : RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
      (graphPLReebGraph G h) ≤ ρ)
    (hρ' : RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G g a' b')
      (graphPLReebGraph G g) ≤ ρ')
    (hD : RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G g) ≤ D) :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
      (graphPLMapperReconstruction G g a' b') ≤ ρ + D + ρ'
proof:
:= by
  rw [RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_comm _ (graphPLReebGraph G g)] at hρ'
  calc _ ≤ _ := RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_triangle _ (graphPLReebGraph G h) _
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add_right (RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_triangle _
      (graphPLReebGraph G g) _) _
    _ ≤ ρ + (D + ρ') := add_le_add hρ (add_le_add hD hρ')
    _ = ρ + D + ρ' := (add_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le_add_of_le
statement:
private theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le_add_of_le {ρ ρ' : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hρ : RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
      (graphPLReebGraph G h) ≤ ρ)
    (hρ' : RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G g a' b')
      (graphPLReebGraph G g) ≤ ρ') :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G g) ≤
      RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
        (graphPLMapperReconstruction G g a' b') + ρ + ρ'
proof:
:= by
  rw [RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_comm _ (graphPLReebGraph G h)] at hρ
  calc _ ≤ _ := RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_triangle _
        (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b) _
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add_right (RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance_triangle _
        (graphPLMapperReconstruction G g a' b') _) _
    _ ≤ ρ + (RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
          (graphPLMapperReconstruction G g a' b') + ρ') :=
        add_le_add hρ (add_le_add le_rfl hρ')
    _ = _ := by ring

name: TDA.Mapper.geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_add_edist
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_add_edist [Fintype V] :

name: TDA.Mapper.geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_two_mul_add_edist
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_two_mul_add_edist [Fintype V]
    (hcov : ∀ x, ∃ i, plHeight G h x ∈ ioo (a i) (b i))
    (hcov' : ∀ x, ∃ i, plHeight G g x ∈ ioo (a i) (b i)) :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
      (graphPLMapperReconstruction G g a b) ≤ 2 * (coverResolution a b : ℝ≥0∞) + edist h g
proof:
:=
  (geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_add_edist G h g hcov hcov').trans_eq (by ring)

name: TDA.Mapper.exists_graphPLMapperReconstruction_pair_le
statement:
theorem exists_graphPLMapperReconstruction_pair_le [Fintype V] {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ n n' : ℕ, ∃ (a b : Fin n → ℝ) (a' b' : Fin n' → ℝ),
      (∀ x, ∃ i, plHeight G h x ∈ ioo (a i) (b i)) ∧
      (∀ x, ∃ i, plHeight G g x ∈ ioo (a' i) (b' i)) ∧
      RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
        (graphPLMapperReconstruction G g a' b') ≤
        edist h g + 2 * (Real.toNNReal r : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, a, b, hcov, hres⟩ := exists_graphPLMapperCover_resolution_le G h hr
  obtain ⟨n', a', b', hcov', hres'⟩ := exists_graphPLMapperCover_resolution_le G g hr
  refine ⟨n, n', a, b, a', b', hcov, hcov', ?_⟩
  calc _ ≤ _ := geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_add_edist G h g hcov hcov'
    _ ≤ (Real.toNNReal r : ℝ≥0∞) + edist h g + (Real.toNNReal r : ℝ≥0∞) :=
      add_le_add (add_le_add (ENNReal.coe_le_coe.2 hres) le_rfl) (ENNReal.coe_le_coe.2 hres')
    _ = _ := by ring

name: TDA.Mapper.tendsto_of_add_sandwich
proof:
:= by
  have hl : Tendsto (fun t => d - ρ t) l (𝓝 d) := by
    simpa using ENNReal.Tendsto.sub tendsto_const_nhds hρ (Or.inr ENNReal.zero_ne_top)
  have hu : Tendsto (fun t => d + ρ t) l (𝓝 d) := by
    simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := d)).add hρ
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le hl hu
    (fun t => tsub_le_iff_right.2 (hlow t)) hup

name: TDA.Mapper.tendsto_geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_pair
statement:
theorem tendsto_geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_pair
    (hcov : ∀ t x, ∃ i, plHeight G h x ∈ ioo (a t i) (b t i))
    (hcov' : ∀ t x, ∃ i, plHeight G g x ∈ ioo (a' t i) (b' t i))
    (hres : Tendsto (fun t => (coverResolution (a t) (b t) : ℝ≥0∞)) l (𝓝 0))
    (hres' : Tendsto (fun t => (coverResolution (a' t) (b' t) : ℝ≥0∞)) l (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun t => RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance
      (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h (a t) (b t))
      (graphPLMapperReconstruction G g (a' t) (b' t))) l
      (𝓝 (RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h)
        (graphPLReebGraph G g)))
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_of_add_sandwich (ρ := fun t => (coverResolution (a t) (b t) : ℝ≥0∞) +
    coverResolution (a' t) (b' t)) (by simpa using hres.add hres') (fun t => ?_) (fun t => ?_)
  · rw [← add_assoc]
    exact geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le_mapperReeb_add G h g (hcov t) (hcov' t)
  · rw [← add_assoc]
    exact geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_graphPLReebGraph_add G h g (hcov t) (hcov' t)

name: TDA.Mapper.tendsto_geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_pair_retained
statement:
theorem tendsto_geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_pair_retained
    (hcov : ∀ t x, ∃ i, plHeight G h x ∈ ioo (a t i) (b t i))
    (hcov' : ∀ t x, ∃ i, plHeight G g x ∈ ioo (a' t i) (b' t i))
    (hres : Tendsto (fun t => (retainedCoverResolution (plHeight G h) (a t) (b t) : ℝ≥0∞))
      l (𝓝 0))
    (hres' : Tendsto (fun t => (retainedCoverResolution (plHeight G g) (a' t) (b' t) : ℝ≥0∞))
      l (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun t => RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance
      (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h (a t) (b t))
      (graphPLMapperReconstruction G g (a' t) (b' t))) l
      (𝓝 (RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h)
        (graphPLReebGraph G g)))
proof:
:= by
  refine tendsto_of_add_sandwich (ρ := fun t =>
    (retainedCoverResolution (plHeight G h) (a t) (b t) : ℝ≥0∞) +
      retainedCoverResolution (plHeight G g) (a' t) (b' t)) (by simpa using hres.add hres')
    (fun t => ?_) (fun t => ?_)
  · rw [← add_assoc]
    exact geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le_add_of_le G h g
      (geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_retained G h (a t) (b t) (hcov t))
      (geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_retained G g (a' t) (b' t) (hcov' t))
  · rw [← add_assoc]
    exact (geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_add_of_le G h g
      (geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_retained G h (a t) (b t) (hcov t))
      (geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le_retained G g (a' t) (b' t) (hcov' t))
      le_rfl).trans_eq (by ring)

name: TDA.Mapper.finrank_homology_range_id
statement:
private theorem finrank_homology_range_id {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V]
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (ModuleCat.Hom.hom (𝟙 (simplicialHomology K k n)))) =
      Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology K k n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ModuleCat.hom_id, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]

name: TDA.Mapper.card_essentialPart_stepMapperDiagram
statement:
theorem card_essentialPart_stepMapperDiagram :
    (essentialPart (stepMapperDiagram k f c cover r n).points).card =
      Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (mapper f (cover (Fin.last m))) k n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases m with
  | zero =>
    have hz := isZero_simplicialHomology_mapper_of_isEmpty k f (cover 0) n
    have := ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hz
    rw [show Fin.last 0 = (0 : Fin 1) from rfl, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]
    have hp := moduleDiagram_empty_grid c
      (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower c cover) (stepRefinement c cover r) n)
    change (essentialPart (moduleDiagram c _ _).points).card = 0
    rw [hp]
    simp [essentialPart]
  | succ m =>
    rw [stepMapperDiagram_eq_ofIndexBars_succ, card_essentialPart_eq_countP,
      RealBarcode.ofIndexBars_points, Multiset.countP_map, ← Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter]
    have hr := finrank_range_mapperHomologyMap k f
      (fun j : Fin (m + 1) => cover j.succ)
      (fun h => r (Fin.succ_le_succ_iff.mpr h)) n (le_refl (Fin.last m))
    rw [mapperHomologyMap_eq_id, finrank_homology_range_id] at hr
    refine (Multiset.countP_congr rfl fun I _ => propext ?_).trans hr.symm
    have hb := I.birth_lt_death
    have hd := I.death_le_size
    simp only [RealBarcode.endpoints, Fin.val_last]
    split_ifs with h
    · simp only [WithTop.coe_ne_top, false_iff, not_and]
      omega
    · simp only [true_iff]
      omega

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_lt_top_iff
statement:
theorem bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_lt_top_iff :
    bottleneck (stepMapperDiagram k f c cover r n) (stepMapperDiagram k f' d cover' r' n) < ⊤ ↔
      Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (mapper f (cover (Fin.last m))) k n) =
        Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (mapper f' (cover' (Fin.last m'))) k n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_lt_top_iff, card_essentialPart_stepMapperDiagram,
    card_essentialPart_stepMapperDiagram]

name: TDA.Mapper.mapper_full_eq_top
statement:
theorem mapper_full_eq_top [PathConnectedSpace X] :
    mapper f (fun _ : I => Set.univ) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ext
  ext t
  change t.Nonempty ∧ (∃ x : X, ∀ a ∈ t, x ∈ componentCover f _ a) ↔ t.Nonempty
  refine ⟨And.left, fun ht => ⟨ht, Classical.arbitrary X, fun a _ => ?_⟩⟩
  refine ⟨Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  apply (fullPullbackComponentsEquiv f a.1).injective
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: TDA.Mapper.finrank_simplicialHomology_mapper_full_zero
statement:
theorem finrank_simplicialHomology_mapper_full_zero [PathConnectedSpace X]
    [Finite I] [Nonempty I] (k : Type z) [Field k] :
    Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (mapper f (fun _ : I => Set.univ)) k 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let e := componentIndexFullEquiv (I := I) f
  let : LinearOrder I := LinearOrder.lift' e.symm e.symm.injective
  exact (fullMapperHomologyIso f k 0).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq.trans
    (finrank_simplicialHomology_top_zero k)

name: TDA.Mapper.isZero_simplicialHomology_mapper_full_succ
statement:
theorem isZero_simplicialHomology_mapper_full_succ [PathConnectedSpace X]
    [Finite I] (R : Type z) [Ring R] (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (simplicialHomology (mapper f (fun _ : I => Set.univ)) R (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let e := componentIndexFullEquiv (I := I) f
  let : LinearOrder I := LinearOrder.lift' e.symm e.symm.injective
  exact (isZero_simplicialHomology_top_succ (V := I) R n).of_iso
    (fullMapperHomologyIso f R (n + 1))

name: TDA.Mapper.isEmpty_mapper_face_one_of_unique
statement:
theorem isEmpty_mapper_face_one_of_unique [Unique I] (U : I → Set Y)
    [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f U)] : IsEmpty (Face (mapper f U) 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun F => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, he⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp F.2.2
  have hs := F.2.1
  rw [he] at hs
  exact hab (eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq f U hs (by simp) (by simp)
    (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

name: TDA.Mapper.finrank_simplicialHomology_mapper_full_zero_of_unique
statement:
theorem finrank_simplicialHomology_mapper_full_zero_of_unique [Unique I]
    [Finite (ZerothHomotopy X)] (k : Type z) [Field k] :
    Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (mapper f (fun _ : I => Set.univ)) k 0) =
      Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy X)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := (fullComponentIndexEquiv (I := I) f).trans (Equiv.uniqueProd _ _)
  have : Finite (ComponentIndex f (fun _ : I => Set.univ)) := Finite.of_equiv _ e.symm
  let vertex (a : ComponentIndex f (fun _ : I => Set.univ)) :
      Face (mapper f (fun _ : I => Set.univ)) 0 :=
    ⟨{a}, componentIndex_supported f _ a, by simp⟩
  have hv : Function.Bijective vertex := by
    refine ⟨fun a b h => Finset.singleton_injective (congrArg Subtype.val h), fun F => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp F.2.2
    exact ⟨a, Subtype.ext ha.symm⟩
  let eF := (Equiv.ofBijective vertex hv).symm.trans e
  let : Fintype (Face (mapper f (fun _ : I => Set.univ)) 0) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have := isEmpty_mapper_face_one_of_unique f (fun _ : I => Set.univ)
  rw [finrank_zeroHomology_of_no_edges, ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact Nat.card_congr eF

name: TDA.Mapper.finrank_mapper_eq_full_zero
statement:
private theorem finrank_mapper_eq_full_zero [PathConnectedSpace X] [Finite I] [Nonempty I]

proof:

statement:

name: TDA.Mapper.finrank_mapper_eq_full_zero_of_unique
statement:

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_lt_top

      (cappedCentredDiagram k g a' s' ℓ' d n) < ⊤

  cases n with
  | zero => rw [card_essentialPart_cappedCentredDiagram_zero,

      a s ℓ c n).points).card = if n = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:

  have : PathConnectedSpace (TDA.Reeb.GraphRealization.Realization G) :=
    (TDA.Reeb.GraphRealization.connected_iff_pathConnectedSpace G).mp hG
  cases n with

statement:
theorem card_essentialPart_cappedCentredDiagram_plHeight_zero_of_unique [Unique W] :
    (essentialPart (cappedCentredDiagram k (TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight G h)
      a s ℓ c 0).points).card = Nat.card G.ConnectedComponent

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.CoversVertexHeights.edgeActive_iff
proof:
:= by
  have hlevel : ∀ v, h v ∈ J → h v ∈ I := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hS v
    rw [← hi] at hv ⊢
    exact (hlev i).2 hv
  constructor
  · exact EdgeActive.mono hIJ
  · intro he
    obtain ⟨x, hxI⟩ := hI
    have hxJ : x ∈ J := OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 hIJ hxI
    obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
    have handle : ∀ (d : G.Dart), dartEdge d = e →
        h d.fst ≤ h d.snd →
        (∃ t : unitInterval, 0 < (t : ℝ) ∧ (t : ℝ) < 1 ∧ dartHeight h d t ∈ J) →
        EdgeActive G h I e := by
      intro d hd hpq ht
      obtain ⟨t, ht₀, ht₁, hyt⟩ := ht
      have hyseg : h d.fst ≤ dartHeight h d t ∧ dartHeight h d t ≤ h d.snd := by
        change h d.fst ≤ (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd ∧
          (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd ≤ h d.snd
        have ht_nonneg : 0 ≤ (t : ℝ) := ht₀.le
        have hone_minus_t_nonneg : 0 ≤ 1 - (t : ℝ) := sub_nonneg.mpr ht₁.le
        have hgap : 0 ≤ h d.snd - h d.fst := sub_nonneg.mpr hpq
        have hmul_t := mul_nonneg ht_nonneg hgap
        have hmul_one_minus_t := mul_nonneg hone_minus_t_nonneg hgap
        constructor <;> linarith
      by_cases hpI : h d.fst ∈ I
      · rw [← hd]
        exact edgeActive_of_mem (fst_mem_dartEdge d) hpI
      by_cases hqI : h d.snd ∈ I
      · rw [← hd]
        exact edgeActive_of_mem (snd_mem_dartEdge d) hqI
      by_cases hxp : x ≤ h d.fst
      · have hpJ : h d.fst ∈ J :=
          mem_of_le_of_le hxJ hyt hxp hyseg.1
        exact False.elim (hpI (hlevel d.fst hpJ))
      by_cases hqx : h d.snd ≤ x
      · have hqJ : h d.snd ∈ J :=
          mem_of_le_of_le hyt hxJ hyseg.2 hqx
        exact False.elim (hqI (hlevel d.snd hqJ))
      · have hpx : h d.fst < x := lt_of_not_ge hxp
        have hxq : x < h d.snd := lt_of_not_ge hqx
        have hcross : dartHeight h d (crossingParam G h hpx hxq) ∈ I := by
          rw [dartHeight_crossingParam]
          exact hxI
        rw [← hd]
        exact edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem hcross
    rcases le_total (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hpq | hqp
    · exact handle d hd hpq (he.exists_mem hd)
    · have hd' : dartEdge d.symm = e := by simpa [dartEdge_symm] using hd
      exact handle d.symm hd' (by simpa using hqp) (he.exists_mem hd')

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.cellGraphIsoOfSameLevels_apply
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.intervalComponents_plHeight_map_bijective
statement:
theorem intervalComponents_plHeight_map_bijective (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty)
    (hlev : ∀ i, S.value i ∈ I ↔ S.value i ∈ J) :
    Function.Bijective ((intervalComponents (plHeight G h)).map (homOfLE hIJ))
proof:
:= by
  let e := cellGraphIsoOfSameLevels G h hS hIJ hI hlev
  have hcell : Function.Bijective ((cellComponentFunctor G h).map (homOfLE hIJ)) := by
    have hcell_eq :
        ((cellComponentFunctor G h).map (homOfLE hIJ) :
          (cellGraph G h I).ConnectedComponent → (cellGraph G h J).ConnectedComponent) =
          e.connectedComponentEquiv := by
      funext c
      exact (cellComponentFunctor_map_apply G h (homOfLE hIJ) c).trans rfl
    rw [hcell_eq]
    exact e.connectedComponentEquiv.bijective
  let e' := (intervalComponentsIso G h).symm
  have hmap' :
      ⇑((intervalComponents (plHeight G h)).map (homOfLE hIJ)) =
        e'.hom.app J ∘
          (cellComponentFunctor G h).map (homOfLE hIJ) ∘ e'.inv.app I := by
    funext x
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [NatTrans.naturality_apply, Iso.inv_hom_id_app_apply]
  have hmap :
      ⇑((intervalComponents (plHeight G h)).map (homOfLE hIJ)) =
        (intervalComponentsIso G h).inv.app J ∘
          (cellComponentFunctor G h).map (homOfLE hIJ) ∘
            (intervalComponentsIso G h).hom.app I := by
    simpa [e'] using hmap'
  rw [hmap]
  exact ((isIso_iff_bijective ((intervalComponentsIso G h).inv.app J)).1 inferInstance).comp
    (hcell.comp
      ((isIso_iff_bijective ((intervalComponentsIso G h).hom.app I)).1 inferInstance))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPL_vertex_mem_Icc

private theorem graphPL_vertex_mem_Icc (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (v : V) :

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.isConstructibleAt_intervalComponents_plHeight
statement:
theorem isConstructibleAt_intervalComponents_plHeight (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) :
    S.IsConstructibleAt (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)) where
  finite
proof:
:= fun I => finite_zerothHomotopy G h I
  bijective := fun _ _ hIJ hI hlev =>
    intervalComponents_plHeight_map_bijective G h hS hIJ hI hlev
  isEmpty_lowerTail := ⟨fun c => by
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      have hx := x.2
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall
        (fun v => graphPL_vertex_mem_Icc h hS v) x.1).1) (mem_iio.1 hx)⟩
  isEmpty_upperTail := ⟨fun c => by
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      have hx := x.2
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall
        (fun v => graphPL_vertex_mem_Icc h hS v) x.1).2) (mem_ioi.1 hx)⟩

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.Hom.bijective_v_of_iso
statement:
theorem _root_.TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.Hom.bijective_v_of_iso
    {D D' : FiniteReebData.{0} n} (e : D ≅ D') (i) :
    Function.Bijective (e.hom.v i)
proof:
:= by
  refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.2 ⟨e.inv.v i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    change (e.hom ≫ e.inv).v i x = (𝟙 D : D ⟶ D).v i x
    rw [e.hom_inv_id]
  · intro x
    change (e.inv ≫ e.hom).v i x = (𝟙 D' : D' ⟶ D').v i x
    rw [e.inv_hom_id]

name: TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.Hom.bijective_e_of_iso

theorem _root_.TDA.Reeb.FiniteReebData.Hom.bijective_e_of_iso

  · intro x
    change (e.hom ≫ e.inv).e k x = (𝟙 D : D ⟶ D).e k x
    rw [e.hom_inv_id]
  · intro x
    change (e.inv ≫ e.hom).e k x = (𝟙 D' : D' ⟶ D').e k x
    rw [e.inv_hom_id]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.isIso_graphPLLift
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLCosheafIsoOfIso_hom
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLCosheafIso_hom_app_J
statement:
theorem graphPLCosheafIso_hom_app_J (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : LevelVertex G h (S.value i)) :
    (graphPLCosheafIso G h hS).hom.app (S.J i)
        ((graphPLReebData G h S).vertexLabel S i x) =
      (graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i).symm x
proof:
:= by
  let hF := isConstructibleAt_intervalComponents_plHeight G h hS
  let hFc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)) :=
    intervalComponents_isIntervalCosheaf _
  let j : (graphPLReebData G h S).Hom
      (S.extract (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)) hF.finite) :=
    (CategoryTheory.Iso.refl _).hom ≫ (graphPLExtractIso G h S hS).inv
  change (graphPLCosheafIsoOfIso G h hS (CategoryTheory.Iso.refl _)).hom.app (S.J i)
      ((graphPLReebData G h S).vertexLabel S i x) = _
  rw [graphPLCosheafIsoOfIso_hom]
  change ((graphPLReebData G h S).toCosheafLift hF hFc j).app (S.J i)
    ((graphPLReebData G h S).vertexLabel S i x) = _
  exact ((graphPLReebData G h S).toCosheafLift_app_J hF hFc j i x).trans
    (graphPLExtractIso_inv_v G h hS i x)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLCosheafIso_hom_app_K
statement:
theorem graphPLCosheafIso_hom_app_K (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (k : Fin n)
    (y : (graphPLReebData G h S).E k) :
    (graphPLCosheafIso G h hS).hom.app (S.K k)
        ((graphPLReebData G h S).edgeLabel S k y) =
      (graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS k).symm y
proof:
:= by
  let hF := isConstructibleAt_intervalComponents_plHeight G h hS
  let hFc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)) :=
    intervalComponents_isIntervalCosheaf _
  let j : (graphPLReebData G h S).Hom
      (S.extract (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)) hF.finite) :=
    (CategoryTheory.Iso.refl _).hom ≫ (graphPLExtractIso G h S hS).inv
  change (graphPLCosheafIsoOfIso G h hS (CategoryTheory.Iso.refl _)).hom.app (S.K k)
      ((graphPLReebData G h S).edgeLabel S k y) = _
  rw [graphPLCosheafIsoOfIso_hom]
  change ((graphPLReebData G h S).toCosheafLift hF hFc j).app (S.K k)
    ((graphPLReebData G h S).edgeLabel S k y) = _
  exact ((graphPLReebData G h S).toCosheafLift_app_K hF hFc j k y).trans
    (graphPLExtractIso_inv_e G h hS k y)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLCosheafIso_hom_unique
statement:
theorem graphPLCosheafIso_hom_unique (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (α : (graphPLReebData G h S).toCosheaf S ⟶ intervalComponents (plHeight G h))
    (hJ : ∀ i x, α.app (S.J i) ((graphPLReebData G h S).vertexLabel S i x) =
      (graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i).symm x)
    (hK : ∀ k y, α.app (S.K k) ((graphPLReebData G h S).edgeLabel S k y) =
      (graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS k).symm y) :
    α = (graphPLCosheafIso G h hS).hom
proof:
:= by
  let hF := isConstructibleAt_intervalComponents_plHeight G h hS
  let hFc : IsIntervalCosheaf.{0} (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)) :=
    intervalComponents_isIntervalCosheaf _
  let j : (graphPLReebData G h S).Hom
      (S.extract (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)) hF.finite) :=
    (CategoryTheory.Iso.refl _).hom ≫ (graphPLExtractIso G h S hS).inv
  change α = (graphPLCosheafIsoOfIso G h hS (CategoryTheory.Iso.refl _)).hom
  rw [graphPLCosheafIsoOfIso_hom]
  change α = (graphPLReebData G h S).toCosheafLift hF hFc j
  apply (graphPLReebData G h S).toCosheafLift_unique hF hFc j α
  · intro i x
    exact (hJ i x).trans (graphPLExtractIso_inv_v G h hS i x).symm
  · intro k y
    exact (hK k y).trans (graphPLExtractIso_inv_e G h hS k y).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyDiagramTightnessExamples.isZero_loopModule
statement:
private theorem isZero_loopModule {c : Fin 2 ↪o ℝ} {t : ℝ} (ht : cellIndex c t ≠ 1) :
    IsZero ((loopModule c).obj t)
proof:
:= by
  change IsZero (simplicialHomology
    (mapper (plHeight C4 h4) (padCover loopCover (cellIndex c t))) ℚ 1)
  generalize cellIndex c t = i at ht ⊢
  match i, ht with
  | 0, _ => exact isZero_simplicialHomology_mapper_of_isEmpty ℚ _ _ 1
  | 1, ht => exact absurd rfl ht
  | 2, _ =>
    exact isZero_simplicialHomology_of_isEmpty_face (K := mapper (plHeight C4 h4) (loopCover 1)) ℚ 1

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyDiagramTightnessExamples.loopModule_structureMap_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem loopModule_structureMap_eq_zero {c : Fin 2 ↪o ℝ} (hc : c 1 ≤ c 0 + 1) {t : ℝ}
    (h : t ≤ t + (((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) + 1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) : structureMap (loopModule c) h = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : cellIndex c t = 1
  · refine (isZero_loopModule (t := t + (((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) + 1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) ?_).eq_of_tgt _ _
    have h0 := ((cellIndex_eq_succ_iff c 0 t).1 ht).1
    have : cellIndex c (t + (((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) + 1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) = Fin.last 2 :=
      cellIndex_of_last_le c _ (by push_cast; linarith [c.monotone (Fin.zero_le (Fin.last 1))])
    rw [this]
    decide
  · exact (isZero_loopModule ht).eq_of_src _ _

      (loopDiagram (shiftGrid 1 grid01)).points = {((-1 : ℝ), ((0 : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ))} ∧

      bottleneck (loopDiagram grid01) (loopDiagram (shiftGrid 1 grid01)) < ((1 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ∧
      ¬ SurvivesToLast ℚ (plHeight C4 h4) 1 (padRefinement loopCover loopRefinement)
proof:
:= by
  have hle : bottleneck (loopDiagram grid01) (loopDiagram (shiftGrid 1 grid01)) ≤
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    obtain ⟨i⟩ := loop_shift_interleaving
    rw [bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_eq]
    exact i.distance_le
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hle, hle.trans_lt ?_, loop_not_survivesToLast⟩
  · rw [loopDiagram_points]
    simp [grid01]
  · rw [loopDiagram_points]
    simp [grid01]
  · rw [ENNReal.coe_lt_coe]
    norm_num

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyDiagramTightnessExamples.emptyGrid_merge_bottleneck_eq_top
statement:
