        emptyStageRefinement 0).points).card = 0 ∧
      (essentialPart (mergeDiagram grid01).points).card = 1 ∧
      bottleneck (stepMapperDiagram ℚ (plHeight edgeGraph h01) emptyGrid emptyStage
        emptyStageRefinement 0) (mergeDiagram grid01) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (stepMapperDiagram ℚ (plHeight edgeGraph h01) emptyGrid emptyStage
      emptyStageRefinement 0).points = 0 := (emptyGrid_stepMapperDiagram ℚ _ 0).2.1
  have h1 : essentialPart (mergeDiagram grid01).points = {(0 : ℝ)} := merge_stepMapperDiagram.2.2
  have c0 : (essentialPart (stepMapperDiagram ℚ (plHeight edgeGraph h01) emptyGrid emptyStage
      emptyStageRefinement 0).points).card = 0 := by
    rw [h0]
    rfl
  have c1 : (essentialPart (mergeDiagram grid01).points).card = 1 := by
    rw [h1]
    rfl
  exact ⟨c0, c1, (bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_eq_top_iff ℚ _ 0 _ _).2 (by rw [c0, c1]; simp)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.CoversVertexHeights.eq_of_mem_J
statement:
theorem CoversVertexHeights.eq_of_mem_J (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) {v : V}
    {i : Fin (n + 1)} (hv : h v ∈ S.J i) : h v = S.value i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hS v
  rw [← hj] at hv ⊢
  rw [S.value_mem_J_iff.1 hv]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.CoversVertexHeights.preimage_J
statement:
theorem CoversVertexHeights.preimage_J (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    h ⁻¹' (S.J i : Set ℝ) = {v | h v = S.value i}
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  refine ⟨fun hv => hS.eq_of_mem_J hv, fun hv => ?_⟩
  show h v ∈ S.J i
  rw [show h v = S.value i from hv]
  exact S.value_mem_J i

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.CoversVertexHeights.notMem_K
statement:
theorem CoversVertexHeights.notMem_K (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (e : Fin n) (v : V) :
    h v ∉ S.K e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hS v
  rw [← hj]
  exact S.value_notMem_K e j

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.card_vertexHeightSet
statement:
theorem card_vertexHeightSet [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] (h : V → ℝ) :
    (vertexHeightSet h).card = vertexGapCount h + 1
proof:
:=
  (Nat.sub_add_cancel (Finset.card_pos.2 (Finset.univ_nonempty.image h))).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.range_vertexHeightLevels
statement:
theorem range_vertexHeightLevels [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] (h : V → ℝ) :
    Set.range (vertexHeightLevels h).value = Set.range h
proof:
:= by
  show Set.range ((vertexHeightSet h).orderEmbOfFin (card_vertexHeightSet h)) = _
  rw [Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin, vertexHeightSet, Finset.coe_image, Finset.coe_univ,
    Set.image_univ]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.coversVertexHeights_vertexHeightLevels
statement:
theorem coversVertexHeights_vertexHeightLevels [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] (h : V → ℝ) :
    CoversVertexHeights (vertexHeightLevels h) h
proof:
:= fun v => by
  have hv : h v ∈ Set.range (vertexHeightLevels h).value := by
    rw [range_vertexHeightLevels]
    exact ⟨v, rfl⟩
  exact hv

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.induce_mk_eq_of_mem_edge
proof:
:= by
  by_cases huw : (u : V) = w
  · rw [Subtype.ext huw]
  · have he : (e : Sym2 V) = s(u.1, w.1) := (Sym2.mem_and_mem_iff huw).1 ⟨hu, hw⟩
    have hadj : G.Adj u w := by
      have := e.2
      rw [he] at this
      exact this
    exact ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj hadj

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelEnd_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hv' : ∃ v ∈ (e : Sym2 V), h v = c := ⟨v, hv, hvc⟩
  unfold levelEnd
  rw [dif_pos hv']
  exact congrArg Sum.inl (induce_mk_eq_of_mem_edge G (Classical.choose_spec hv').1 hv)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelEnd_of_forall_ne
proof:
:= by
  unfold levelEnd
  rw [dif_neg fun ⟨w, hw, hwc⟩ => hne w hw hwc]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.EdgeSpans.crosses_left
statement:
theorem EdgeSpans.crosses_left {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p < q) {e : G.edgeSet}
    (he : EdgeSpans G h p q e) (hne : ∀ v ∈ (e : Sym2 V), h v ≠ p) : EdgeCrosses G h p e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl, hmin, hmax⟩ := he
  refine ⟨d, rfl, lt_of_le_of_ne hmin ?_, hpq.trans_le hmax⟩
  rcases min_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm <;> rw [hm]
  · exact hne _ (fst_mem_dartEdge d)
  · exact hne _ (snd_mem_dartEdge d)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.EdgeSpans.crosses_right
statement:
theorem EdgeSpans.crosses_right {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p < q) {e : G.edgeSet}
    (he : EdgeSpans G h p q e) (hne : ∀ v ∈ (e : Sym2 V), h v ≠ q) : EdgeCrosses G h q e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl, hmin, hmax⟩ := he
  refine ⟨d, rfl, hmin.trans_lt hpq, lt_of_le_of_ne hmax ?_⟩
  rcases max_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm <;> rw [hm]
  · exact (hne _ (fst_mem_dartEdge d)).symm
  · exact (hne _ (snd_mem_dartEdge d)).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebData_V
statement:
@[simp] theorem graphPLReebData_V [Finite V] (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (graphPLReebData G h S).V i = LevelVertex G h (S.value i)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebData_E
statement:
@[simp] theorem graphPLReebData_E [Finite V] (e : Fin n) :
    (graphPLReebData G h S).E e = SpanEdge G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebData_left_of_mem
statement:
theorem graphPLReebData_left_of_mem [Finite V] (e : Fin n)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ)) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 V))
    (hvc : h v = S.value e.castSucc) :
    ((graphPLReebData G h S).left e y : LevelVertex G h (S.value e.castSucc)) =
      Sum.inl ((G.induce {v | h v = S.value e.castSucc}).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hvc⟩)
proof:
:=
  levelEnd_of_mem G h (y.2.crosses_left (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e)) hv hvc

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebData_left_of_forall_ne
statement:
theorem graphPLReebData_left_of_forall_ne [Finite V] (e : Fin n)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ))
    (hne : ∀ v ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 V), h v ≠ S.value e.castSucc) :
    ((graphPLReebData G h S).left e y : LevelVertex G h (S.value e.castSucc)) =
      Sum.inr ⟨y.1, y.2.crosses_left (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) hne⟩
proof:
:=
  levelEnd_of_forall_ne G h (y.2.crosses_left (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e)) hne

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebData_right_of_mem
statement:
theorem graphPLReebData_right_of_mem [Finite V] (e : Fin n)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ)) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 V))
    (hvc : h v = S.value e.succ) :
    ((graphPLReebData G h S).right e y : LevelVertex G h (S.value e.succ)) =
      Sum.inl ((G.induce {v | h v = S.value e.succ}).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hvc⟩)
proof:
:=
  levelEnd_of_mem G h (y.2.crosses_right (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e)) hv hvc

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebData_right_of_forall_ne
statement:
theorem graphPLReebData_right_of_forall_ne [Finite V] (e : Fin n)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ))
    (hne : ∀ v ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 V), h v ≠ S.value e.succ) :
    ((graphPLReebData G h S).right e y : LevelVertex G h (S.value e.succ)) =
      Sum.inr ⟨y.1, y.2.crosses_right (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) hne⟩
proof:
:=
  levelEnd_of_forall_ne G h (y.2.crosses_right (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e)) hne

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.ne_of_min_lt_of_lt_max
statement:
private theorem ne_of_min_lt_of_lt_max {a b c : ℝ} (h₁ : min a b < c) (h₂ : c < max a b) :
    a ≠ c ∧ b ≠ c
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hab
  · rw [min_eq_left hab] at h₁
    rw [max_eq_right hab] at h₂
    exact ⟨h₁.ne, h₂.ne'⟩
  · rw [min_eq_right hab] at h₁
    rw [max_eq_left hab] at h₂
    exact ⟨h₂.ne', h₁.ne⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edgeActive_of_fst_lt_of_lt_snd
statement:
private theorem edgeActive_of_fst_lt_of_lt_snd {I : OpenInterval} {c : ℝ} (hc : c ∈ I)
    {d : G.Dart} (h₁ : h d.fst < c) (h₂ : c < h d.snd) : EdgeActive G h I (dartEdge d)
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < h d.snd - h d.fst := by linarith
  set s : ℝ := (c - h d.fst) / (h d.snd - h d.fst) with hs
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := div_nonneg (by linarith) hden.le
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hden).2 (by linarith)
  have hmul : s * (h d.snd - h d.fst) = c - h d.fst := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden.ne'
  refine edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem (t := ⟨s, hs0, hs1⟩) ?_
  have hval : dartHeight h d ⟨s, hs0, hs1⟩ = c := by
    show (1 - s) * h d.fst + s * h d.snd = c
    linear_combination hmul
  rw [hval]
  exact hc

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uncoveredEdgeEquivCrossesOfLevel_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem uncoveredEdgeEquivCrossesOfLevel_apply_coe {I : OpenInterval} {c : ℝ}
    (hc : c ∈ I) (hlev : ∀ v, h v ∈ I → h v = c) (e : UncoveredEdge G h I) :
    ((uncoveredEdgeEquivCrossesOfLevel G h hc hlev e : {e // EdgeCrosses G h c e}) :
      G.edgeSet) = e.1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.induceComponentsEquivOfEq_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem induceComponentsEquivOfEq_mk {A B : Set V} (hAB : A = B) (v : A) :
    induceComponentsEquivOfEq G hAB ((G.induce A).connectedComponentMk v) =
      (G.induce B).connectedComponentMk ⟨v.1, hAB ▸ v.2⟩
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLStarEquiv_apply
statement:
private theorem graphPLStarEquiv_apply (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)).obj (S.J i)) :
    graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i x =
      Equiv.sumCongr (induceComponentsEquivOfEq G (hS.preimage_J i))
        (uncoveredEdgeEquivCrossesOfLevel G h (S.value_mem_J i) fun _ hv => hS.eq_of_mem_J hv)
        (cellComponentsEquivSum G h (S.J i) (preimageComponentsEquiv G h (S.J i) x))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLGapEquiv_apply
statement:
private theorem graphPLGapEquiv_apply (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (e : Fin n)
    (x : (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)).obj (S.K e)) :
    graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS e x =
      activeEdgeEquivSpans (G := G) (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) (fun v => hS.notMem_K e v)
        (cellGraphComponentsEquivActiveEdges (G := G) (hS.notMem_K e)
          (preimageComponentsEquiv G h (S.K e) x))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLStarEquiv_mk_vertex
statement:
theorem graphPLStarEquiv_mk_vertex (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) {i : Fin (n + 1)} (v : V)
    (hv : h v = S.value i) :
    graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨vertex G v, by rw [plHeight_vertex, hv]; exact S.value_mem_J i⟩ :
          {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ S.J i})) =
      Sum.inl ((G.induce {v | h v = S.value i}).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hv⟩)
proof:
:= by
  refine (graphPLStarEquiv_apply G h S hS i _).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun c => Equiv.sumCongr (induceComponentsEquivOfEq G (hS.preimage_J i))
    (uncoveredEdgeEquivCrossesOfLevel G h (S.value_mem_J i) fun _ hv => hS.eq_of_mem_J hv)
    (cellComponentsEquivSum G h (S.J i) c))
    (preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex G h (S.J i) v (by rw [hv]; exact S.value_mem_J i))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLStarEquiv_cell_inr
statement:
theorem graphPLStarEquiv_cell_inr (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) {i : Fin (n + 1)}
    (e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h (S.J i) e})
    (hx : (∀ v ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V), h v ≠ S.value i) → EdgeCrosses G h (S.value i) e.1) :
    graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i ((preimageComponentsEquiv G h (S.J i)).symm
        ((cellGraph G h (S.J i)).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr e))) =
      levelEnd G h (S.value i) e.1 hx
proof:
:= by
  refine (graphPLStarEquiv_apply G h S hS i _).trans ?_
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  by_cases hw : ∃ w ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V), h w = S.value i
  · obtain ⟨w, hw, hwc⟩ := hw
    have hwJ : h w ∈ S.J i := by
      rw [hwc]
      exact S.value_mem_J i
    rw [cellComponentsEquivSum_inr_of_mem G h (S.J i) e (w := ⟨w, hwJ⟩) hw,
      levelEnd_of_mem G h hx hw hwc]
    rfl
  · replace hw : ∀ w ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V), h w ≠ S.value i := fun w hw' hwc => hw ⟨w, hw', hwc⟩
    have hunc : ∀ v ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V), h v ∉ S.J i := fun v hv hvJ =>
      hw v hv (hS.eq_of_mem_J hvJ)
    rw [cellComponentsEquivSum_inr_uncovered G h (S.J i) ⟨e.1, e.2, hunc⟩,
      levelEnd_of_forall_ne G h hx hw]
    rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLStarEquiv_mk_edgePoint
statement:
theorem graphPLStarEquiv_mk_edgePoint (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) {i : Fin (n + 1)}
    (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ S.J i)
    (hx : (∀ v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V), h v ≠ S.value i) →
      EdgeCrosses G h (S.value i) (dartEdge d)) :
    graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨edgePoint G d t, ht⟩ :
          {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ S.J i})) =
      levelEnd G h (S.value i) (dartEdge d) hx
proof:
:= by
  have key := graphPLStarEquiv_cell_inr G h S hS ⟨dartEdge d, edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem ht⟩ hx
  rw [← preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint G h (S.J i) d t ht, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at key
  exact key

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLGapEquiv_mk_edgePoint
statement:
theorem graphPLGapEquiv_mk_edgePoint (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) {e : Fin n} (d : G.Dart)
    (t : unitInterval) (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ S.K e)
    (hsp : EdgeSpans G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) (dartEdge d)) :
    graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS e
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨edgePoint G d t, ht⟩ :
          {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ S.K e})) = ⟨dartEdge d, hsp⟩
proof:
:= by
  refine (graphPLGapEquiv_apply G h S hS e _).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun c => activeEdgeEquivSpans (G := G) (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e)
    (fun v => hS.notMem_K e v) (cellGraphComponentsEquivActiveEdges (G := G) (hS.notMem_K e) c))
    (preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint G h (S.K e) d t ht)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLGapEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem graphPLGapEquiv_symm_apply (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) {e : Fin n}
    (y : SpanEdge G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ))
    (hy : EdgeActive G h (S.K e) y.1) :
    (graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS e).symm y =
      (preimageComponentsEquiv G h (S.K e)).symm
        ((cellGraph G h (S.K e)).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr ⟨y.1, hy⟩))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.map_symm_cell_inr
statement:
private theorem map_symm_cell_inr {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    (y : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h I e}) :
    (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)).map (homOfLE hIJ)
        ((preimageComponentsEquiv G h I).symm
          ((cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr y))) =
      (preimageComponentsEquiv G h J).symm
        ((cellGraph G h J).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr ⟨y.1, y.2.mono hIJ⟩))
proof:
:= by
  apply (preimageComponentsEquiv G h J).injective
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have := preimageComponentsEquiv_componentMap G h hIJ
    ((preimageComponentsEquiv G h I).symm ((cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr y)))
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
  exact this

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLStarEquiv_map_left
statement:
theorem graphPLStarEquiv_map_left [Finite V] (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (e : Fin n)
    (x : (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)).obj (S.K e)) :
    graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS e.castSucc
        ((intervalComponents (plHeight G h)).map (homOfLE (S.K_le_J_castSucc e)) x) =
      (graphPLReebData G h S).left e (graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS e x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS e).symm.surjective x
  have hy : EdgeActive G h (S.K e) y.1 :=
    ((activeEdgeEquivSpans (G := G) (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) fun v => hS.notMem_K e v).symm
      y).2
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, graphPLGapEquiv_symm_apply G h S hS y hy, map_symm_cell_inr,
    graphPLStarEquiv_cell_inr G h S hS _ (y.2.crosses_left (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e))]
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLStarEquiv_map_right
statement:
theorem graphPLStarEquiv_map_right [Finite V] (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (e : Fin n)
    (x : (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)).obj (S.K e)) :
    graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS e.succ
        ((intervalComponents (plHeight G h)).map (homOfLE (S.K_le_J_succ e)) x) =
      (graphPLReebData G h S).right e (graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS e x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS e).symm.surjective x
  have hy : EdgeActive G h (S.K e) y.1 :=
    ((activeEdgeEquivSpans (G := G) (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) fun v => hS.notMem_K e v).symm
      y).2
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, graphPLGapEquiv_symm_apply G h S hS y hy, map_symm_cell_inr,
    graphPLStarEquiv_cell_inr G h S hS _ (y.2.crosses_right (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e))]
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLExtractHom_v
statement:
@[simp] theorem graphPLExtractHom_v [Finite V] (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) : (graphPLExtractHom G h S hS).v i = graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLExtractHom_e
statement:
@[simp] theorem graphPLExtractHom_e [Finite V] (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (k : Fin n) :
    (graphPLExtractHom G h S hS).e k = graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS k
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.zerothHomotopySetCongr_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem zerothHomotopySetCongr_mk {A B : Set X} (hAB : A = B) (x : A) :
    zerothHomotopySetCongr hAB (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x.1, hAB ▸ x.2⟩
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.interMember_subset_preimage_of_labels
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_iInter₂]
  intro i hi
  rw [← hs] at hi
  obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hi
  exact ((mem_interMember_iff _).1 hx a ha).1

name: TDA.Mapper.componentIndex_eq_of_joinedIn
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨i, c⟩
  rcases b with ⟨j, d⟩
  change i = j at hab
  subst hab
  obtain ⟨hxi, hc⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨hyi, hd⟩ := hy
  exact Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq (hc.symm.trans
    ((mk_eq_of_joinedIn f (U i) hxy hxi hyi).trans hd)))

name: TDA.Mapper.mem_preimage_biInter_image
proof:
:=
  show f z ∈ ⋂ i ∈ @Finset.image _ _ inst Sigma.fst s, U i from
    Set.mem_iInter₂.2 fun i hi => by
      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hi
      exact Set.mem_iInter₂.1 hz a.1 (hs a ha)

name: TDA.Mapper.cellLabelsMap_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hx', hcls⟩ := hx
  exact (congrArg (componentMap (preimageSetInclusion (ContinuousMap.id X)
    (interMember_subset_preimage_of_labels f U c.2))) hcls).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.cellLabelsMap_injective
statement:
private theorem cellLabelsMap_injective (τ : Finset I) :
    Function.Injective (cellLabelsMap (f := f) (U := U) τ)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨c, hc⟩ ⟨d, hd⟩ hcd
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := c.carrier_nonempty
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := d.carrier_nonempty
  rw [cellLabelsMap_of_mem τ ⟨c, hc⟩ hx, cellLabelsMap_of_mem τ ⟨d, hd⟩ hy] at hcd
  set P : Set X := f ⁻¹' ⋂ i ∈ τ, U i
  have hxP : x ∈ P := interMember_subset_preimage_of_labels f U hc (c.carrier_subset hx)
  have hyP : y ∈ P := interMember_subset_preimage_of_labels f U hd (d.carrier_subset hy)
  have hxy : JoinedIn P x y := (joinedIn_iff_joined hxP hyP).2 (Quotient.exact hcd)
  have hxc : ∀ a ∈ c.support, x ∈ componentCover f U a :=
    (mem_interMember_iff _).1 (c.carrier_subset hx)
  have hyd : ∀ b ∈ d.support, y ∈ componentCover f U b :=
    (mem_interMember_iff _).1 (d.carrier_subset hy)
  have hPU : ∀ i ∈ τ, P ⊆ f ⁻¹' U i := fun i hi z hz => Set.mem_iInter₂.1 hz i hi
  
  have hsub : ∀ {c' d' : multiNerveMapper f U} {x' y' : X},
      c'.support.image Sigma.fst = τ → d'.support.image Sigma.fst = τ →
      (∀ a ∈ c'.support, x' ∈ componentCover f U a) →
      (∀ b ∈ d'.support, y' ∈ componentCover f U b) → JoinedIn P x' y' →
      c'.support ⊆ d'.support := by
    intro c' d' x' y' hc' hd' hx' hy' hxy' a ha
    have haτ : a.1 ∈ τ := hc' ▸ Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 (hd'.symm ▸ haτ : a.1 ∈ d'.support.image Sigma.fst)
    have hab : a = b := componentIndex_eq_of_joinedIn f U (hx' a ha) (hy' b hb) hba.symm
      (hxy'.mono (hPU a.1 haτ))
    exact hab ▸ hb
  have hsupp : d.support = c.support :=
    Finset.Subset.antisymm (hsub hd hc hyd hxc hxy.symm) (hsub hc hd hxc hyd hxy)
  refine Subtype.ext (ext_of_support_eq hsupp ?_).symm
  apply interMemberPreimageMap_injective f U d.support
  obtain ⟨hx', hxcls⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨hy', hycls⟩ := hy
  rw [← hxcls, ← hycls]
  have hdτ : ∀ a ∈ d.support, a.1 ∈ τ := fun a ha => hd ▸ Finset.mem_image_of_mem Sigma.fst ha
  change ZerothHomotopy.mk _ = ZerothHomotopy.mk _
  exact mk_eq_of_joinedIn f _ (hxy.mono fun z hz => mem_preimage_biInter_image f U hdτ hz) _ _

name: TDA.Mapper.cellLabelsMap_surjective
statement:
private theorem cellLabelsMap_surjective (τ : Finset I) (hτ : τ.Nonempty) :
    Function.Surjective (cellLabelsMap (f := f) (U := U) τ)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : DecidableEq (ComponentIndex f U) := Classical.decEq _
  let _ : DecidableEq ((i : I) × ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace f U i)) := Classical.decEq _
  intro z
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective z
  have hxU : ∀ i ∈ τ, f x.1 ∈ U i := fun i hi => Set.mem_iInter₂.1 x.2 i hi
  let s : Finset (ComponentIndex f U) :=
    τ.attach.image fun i => ⟨i.1, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x.1, hxU i.1 i.2⟩⟩
  have hs : s.image Sigma.fst = τ := by
    ext i
    constructor
    · intro hi
      obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hi
      obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 ha
      exact j.2
    · intro hi
      exact Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨⟨i, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x.1, hxU i hi⟩⟩,
        Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hsne : s.Nonempty := hτ.attach.image _
  have hxs : x.1 ∈ interMember (componentCover f U) s := by
    rw [mem_interMember_iff]
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 ha
    exact ⟨hxU i.1 i.2, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨⟨MultiNerveCell.mk s hsne (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x.1, hxs⟩), hs⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.cellsOverLabelsEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem cellsOverLabelsEquiv_apply (τ : Finset I) (hτ : τ.Nonempty)
    (c : {c : multiNerveMapper f U // c.support.image Sigma.fst = τ}) :
    cellsOverLabelsEquiv f U τ hτ c =
      componentMap (preimageSetInclusion (ContinuousMap.id X)
        (interMember_subset_preimage_of_labels f U c.2)) c.1.component
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.cellsOverLabelsEquiv_apply_of_mem
statement:
theorem cellsOverLabelsEquiv_apply_of_mem (τ : Finset I) (hτ : τ.Nonempty)
    (c : {c : multiNerveMapper f U // c.support.image Sigma.fst = τ}) {x : X}
    (hx : x ∈ c.1.carrier) :
    cellsOverLabelsEquiv f U τ hτ c = ZerothHomotopy.mk
      ⟨x, interMember_subset_preimage_of_labels f U c.2 (c.1.carrier_subset hx)⟩
proof:
:=
  cellLabelsMap_of_mem τ c hx

name: TDA.Mapper.preimage_biInter_pair
statement:
theorem preimage_biInter_pair (i j : I) :
    f ⁻¹' (⋂ x ∈ ({i, j} : Finset I), U x) = f ⁻¹' (U i ∩ U j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.set_biInter_insert, Finset.set_biInter_singleton]

name: TDA.Mapper.card_support_of_labels_pair
statement:
theorem card_support_of_labels_pair {i j : I} (hij : i ≠ j) {c : multiNerveMapper f U}
    (hc : c.support.image Sigma.fst = {i, j}) : c.support.card = 2
proof:
:= by
  have himage := Finset.card_image_of_injOn (componentLabel_injOn_face f U c.support_mem_nerve)
  calc c.support.card = (c.support.image Sigma.fst).card := himage.symm
    _ = ({i, j} : Finset I).card := by rw [hc]
    _ = 2 := Finset.card_pair hij

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperFacesOverLabels_surjective
statement:
theorem mapperFacesOverLabels_surjective (τ : Finset I) :
    Function.Surjective
      (fun c : {c : multiNerveMapper f U // c.support.image Sigma.fst = τ} =>
        (⟨c.1.support, c.1.support_mem_nerve, c.2⟩ :
          {s // s ∈ mapper f U ∧ s.image Sigma.fst = τ}))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨s, hs, hsτ⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_cell_of_mem_nerve hs
  subst hc
  exact ⟨⟨c, hsτ⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.nat_card_mapperFacesOverLabels_le
statement:
theorem nat_card_mapperFacesOverLabels_le (i j : I)
    [Finite (ZerothHomotopy (f ⁻¹' (U i ∩ U j)))] :
    Nat.card {s // s ∈ mapper f U ∧ s.image Sigma.fst = {i, j}} ≤
      Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy (f ⁻¹' (U i ∩ U j)))
proof:
:= by
  have := Finite.of_equiv _ (edgeCellsEquiv f U i j).symm
  exact (Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective _ (mapperFacesOverLabels_surjective f U {i, j})).trans
    (Nat.card_congr (edgeCellsEquiv f U i j)).le

name: TDA.Mapper.labelFace_le
statement:
theorem labelFace_le (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) [DecidableEq I]
    {τ : Finset I}
    (c : {c : multiNerveMapper f U // c.support.image Sigma.fst = τ})
    (i : I) (hi : i ∈ τ) : (labelFace f U c i hi).1 ≤ c.1
proof:
:= by
  unfold labelFace
  exact MultiNerveCell.face_le c.1 _ _ _

name: TDA.Mapper.eq_labelFace_of_le
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : b.1.support = c.1.support.filter (fun x => x.1 = i) := by
    apply Finset.Subset.antisymm
    · intro x hx
      have hxc : x ∈ c.1.support := support_mono hb hx
      have hxi : x.1 = i := by
        have : x.1 ∈ b.1.support.image Sigma.fst :=
          Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        rw [b.2] at this
        exact Finset.mem_singleton.1 this
      exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hxc, hxi⟩
    · intro x hx
      have hxc : x ∈ c.1.support := Finset.filter_subset _ _ hx
      have hxi : x.1 = i := Finset.mem_filter.1 hx |>.2
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := b.1.support_nonempty
      have hyc : y ∈ c.1.support := support_mono hb hy
      have hyi : y.1 = i := by
        have : y.1 ∈ b.1.support.image Sigma.fst :=
          Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
        rw [b.2] at this
        exact Finset.mem_singleton.1 this
      have hxy : x = y :=
        componentLabel_injOn_face f U c.1.support_mem_nerve
          (show x ∈ (c.1.support : Set _) from hxc)
          (show y ∈ (c.1.support : Set _) from hyc) (hxi.trans hyi.symm)
      exact hxy ▸ hy
  refine Subtype.ext ((eq_face_of_le hb).trans ?_)
  have key : ∀ {σ σ' : Finset (ComponentIndex f U)} (hσσ' : σ = σ')
      (h₁ : σ.Nonempty) (h₂ : σ'.Nonempty) (s₁ : σ ⊆ c.1.support)
      (s₂ : σ' ⊆ c.1.support), c.1.face σ h₁ s₁ = c.1.face σ' h₂ s₂ := by
    intro σ σ' hσσ' _ _ _ _
    subst hσσ'
    rfl
  show c.1.face b.1.support _ _ =
    c.1.face (c.1.support.filter (fun x => x.1 = i)) _ _
  exact key hsub _ _ _ _

name: TDA.Mapper.mem_carrier_labelFace
statement:
private theorem mem_carrier_labelFace
    (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) [DecidableEq I]
    {τ : Finset I}
    (c : {c : multiNerveMapper f U // c.support.image Sigma.fst = τ})
    (i : I) (hi : i ∈ τ) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ c.1.carrier) :
    x ∈ (labelFace f U c i hi).1.carrier
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨interMember_anti _ (Finset.filter_subset _ _) hx.1, ?_⟩
  show ZerothHomotopy.mk
      (⟨x, interMember_anti _ (Finset.filter_subset _ _) hx.1⟩ :
        interMember (componentCover f U)
          (c.1.support.filter (fun y => y.1 = i))) =
    faceMap (componentCover f U)
      (Finset.filter_subset (fun y => y.1 = i) _) c.1.component
  rw [← hx.2, faceMap_mk]

name: TDA.Mapper.vertexCellsEquiv_labelFace
statement:
theorem vertexCellsEquiv_labelFace
    (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) [DecidableEq I]
    {τ : Finset I}
    (c : {c : multiNerveMapper f U // c.support.image Sigma.fst = τ})
    (i : I) (hi : i ∈ τ) (hτ : τ.Nonempty)
    (hτi : ⋂ j ∈ τ, U j ⊆ U i) :
    vertexCellsEquiv f U i (labelFace f U c i hi) =
      componentMap (preimageSetInclusion (ContinuousMap.id X) (Set.preimage_mono hτi))
        (cellsOverLabelsEquiv f U τ hτ c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := c.1.carrier_nonempty
  rw [vertexCellsEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply]
  rw [cellsOverLabelsEquiv_apply_of_mem f U _ _ _
    (mem_carrier_labelFace f U c i hi hx)]
  rw [cellsOverLabelsEquiv_apply_of_mem f U _ _ _ hx]
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.vertexCellsEquiv_labelFace_pair_left
statement:
theorem vertexCellsEquiv_labelFace_pair_left
    (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) [DecidableEq I] {i j : I}
    (c : {c : multiNerveMapper f U // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {i, j}}) :
    vertexCellsEquiv f U i (labelFace f U c i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)) =
      componentMap (preimageSetInclusion (ContinuousMap.id X) (Set.preimage_mono
        (Set.inter_subset_left : U i ∩ U j ⊆ U i))) (edgeCellsEquiv f U i j c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := c.1.carrier_nonempty
  simp only [vertexCellsEquiv, edgeCellsEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply]
  rw [cellsOverLabelsEquiv_apply_of_mem f U _ _ _
    (mem_carrier_labelFace f U c i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) hx)]
  rw [cellsOverLabelsEquiv_apply_of_mem f U _ _ _ hx]
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.vertexCellsEquiv_labelFace_pair_right
statement:
theorem vertexCellsEquiv_labelFace_pair_right
    (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) [DecidableEq I] {i j : I}
    (c : {c : multiNerveMapper f U // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {i, j}}) :
    vertexCellsEquiv f U j (labelFace f U c j
      (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))) =
      componentMap (preimageSetInclusion (ContinuousMap.id X) (Set.preimage_mono
        (Set.inter_subset_right : U i ∩ U j ⊆ U j))) (edgeCellsEquiv f U i j c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := c.1.carrier_nonempty
  simp only [vertexCellsEquiv, edgeCellsEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply]
  rw [cellsOverLabelsEquiv_apply_of_mem f U _ _ _
    (mem_carrier_labelFace f U c j
      (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)) hx)]
  rw [cellsOverLabelsEquiv_apply_of_mem f U _ _ _ hx]
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.plHeight_preimage_inter
statement:
theorem plHeight_preimage_inter (K L : OpenInterval) :
    plHeight G h ⁻¹' ((K : Set ℝ) ∩ (L : Set ℝ)) = {p | plHeight G h p ∈ K ⊓ L}
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.finite_edgeCells
proof:
:=
  Finite.of_equiv _ (edgeCellsCellGraphEquiv G h U i j).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.nat_card_mapperEdges_le
statement:
theorem nat_card_mapperEdges_le [DecidableEq I] [Finite V] (U : I → OpenInterval) (i j : I) :
    Nat.card {s // s ∈ mapper (plHeight G h) (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ)) ∧
        s.image Sigma.fst = {i, j}} ≤
      Nat.card (cellGraph G h (U i ⊓ U j)).ConnectedComponent
proof:
:= by
  have := finite_edgeCells G h U i j
  exact (Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective _
    (mapperFacesOverLabels_surjective (plHeight G h) (fun i => (U i : Set ℝ)) {i, j})).trans
      (Nat.card_congr (edgeCellsCellGraphEquiv G h U i j)).le

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.cellGraphComponentsEquivActiveEdges_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem cellGraphComponentsEquivActiveEdges_symm_apply {K : OpenInterval}
    (hK : ∀ v, h v ∉ K) (e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h K e}) :
    (cellGraphComponentsEquivActiveEdges hK).symm e =
      (cellGraph G h K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr e)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edgeActive_ioo_of_le
statement:
private theorem edgeActive_ioo_of_le {p q : ℝ} {d : G.Dart} (hp : h d.fst ≤ p) (hpq : p < q)
    (hq : q ≤ h d.snd) : EdgeActive G h (ioo p q) (dartEdge d)
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < h d.snd - h d.fst := by linarith
  set s : ℝ := ((p + q) / 2 - h d.fst) / (h d.snd - h d.fst) with hs
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := div_nonneg (by linarith) hden.le
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := (div_le_one hden).2 (by linarith)
  have hmul : s * (h d.snd - h d.fst) = (p + q) / 2 - h d.fst := div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden.ne'
  refine edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem (t := ⟨s, hs0, hs1⟩) ?_
  rw [mem_ioo]
  change p < (1 - s) * h d.fst + s * h d.snd ∧ (1 - s) * h d.fst + s * h d.snd < q
  constructor <;> nlinarith

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edgeActive_ioo_iff_of_endpoints
statement:
theorem edgeActive_ioo_iff_of_endpoints {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p < q) (d : G.Dart)
    (h₁ : h d.fst ∉ Set.Ioo p q) (h₂ : h d.snd ∉ Set.Ioo p q) :
    EdgeActive G h (ioo p q) (dartEdge d) ↔
      min (h d.fst) (h d.snd) ≤ p ∧ q ≤ max (h d.fst) (h d.snd)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hact
    obtain ⟨t, ht0, ht1, hy⟩ := (edgeActive_dartEdge_iff d).1 hact
    rw [mem_ioo] at hy
    change p < (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd ∧
      (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd < q at hy
    have hmin : min (h d.fst) (h d.snd) ≤ (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 ht1.le) (sub_nonneg.2 (min_le_left (h d.fst) (h d.snd))),
        mul_nonneg ht0.le (sub_nonneg.2 (min_le_right (h d.fst) (h d.snd)))]
    have hmax : (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd ≤ max (h d.fst) (h d.snd) := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 ht1.le) (sub_nonneg.2 (le_max_left (h d.fst) (h d.snd))),
        mul_nonneg ht0.le (sub_nonneg.2 (le_max_right (h d.fst) (h d.snd)))]
    constructor
    · by_contra hlt
      have hlt' := not_le.1 hlt
      have hmq : min (h d.fst) (h d.snd) < q := lt_of_le_of_lt hmin hy.2
      rcases min_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm
      · rw [hm] at hlt' hmq
        exact h₁ ⟨hlt', hmq⟩
      · rw [hm] at hlt' hmq
        exact h₂ ⟨hlt', hmq⟩
    · by_contra hlt
      have hlt' := not_le.1 hlt
      have hpm : p < max (h d.fst) (h d.snd) := lt_of_lt_of_le hy.1 hmax
      rcases max_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm
      · rw [hm] at hlt' hpm
        exact h₁ ⟨hpm, hlt'⟩
      · rw [hm] at hlt' hpm
        exact h₂ ⟨hpm, hlt'⟩
  · rintro ⟨hmin, hmax⟩
    rcases le_total (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hle | hle
    · rw [min_eq_left hle] at hmin
      rw [max_eq_right hle] at hmax
      exact edgeActive_ioo_of_le hmin hpq hmax
    · rw [min_eq_right hle] at hmin
      rw [max_eq_left hle] at hmax
      rw [← dartEdge_symm d]
      exact edgeActive_ioo_of_le (d := d.symm) hmin hpq hmax

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformCover_inf_of_succ
statement:
theorem uniformCover_inf_of_succ {a r g : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hgr : g ≤ r) {k l : Fin n}
    (hkl : (k : ℕ) + 1 = l) :
    uniformCover a r g n k ⊓ uniformCover a r g n l =
      ioo (a + (l : ℕ) * (r - g)) (a + (l : ℕ) * (r - g) + g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [uniformCover_apply, uniformCover_apply, ← hkl, uniformInterval_inf_succ hgr]
  push_cast
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.isEmpty_uniformEdgeCells_of_far
proof:
:= by
  have hempty : (uniformCover a r g n k : Set ℝ) ∩ (uniformCover a r g n l : Set ℝ) = ∅ :=
    (uniformInterval_disjoint hg hkl).inter_eq
  have hZ : IsEmpty (ZerothHomotopy (plHeight G h ⁻¹'
      ((uniformCover a r g n k : Set ℝ) ∩ (uniformCover a r g n l : Set ℝ)))) := by
    rw [hempty, Set.preimage_empty]
    exact ⟨fun c => by
      obtain ⟨x, -⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective c
      exact absurd x.2 (Set.notMem_empty _)⟩
  exact (edgeCellsEquiv (plHeight G h) (fun i => (uniformCover a r g n i : Set ℝ)) k l).isEmpty

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveExamples.cycle_cell_class
statement:
private theorem cycle_cell_class {K : OpenInterval} (v₀ : Fin 4) (hv₀ : h4 v₀ ∈ K)
    (hv : ∀ (v : Fin 4) (hv : h4 v ∈ K),
      (cellGraph C4 h4 K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨v, hv⟩) =
        (cellGraph C4 h4 K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩))
    (he : ∀ d : C4.Dart, ∃ w ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 (Fin 4)), h4 w ∈ K)
    (x : Cell C4 h4 K) :
    (cellGraph C4 h4 K).connectedComponentMk x =
      (cellGraph C4 h4 K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨v, hvK⟩ | ⟨e, hact⟩
  · exact hv v hvK
  · obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwK⟩ := he d
    exact (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr C4 h4 K (v := ⟨w, hwK⟩)
      (e := ⟨dartEdge d, hact⟩) hw).symm.trans (hv w hwK)

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveExamples.cycle_preimage_subsingleton_of
statement:
private theorem cycle_preimage_subsingleton_of {K : OpenInterval} (v₀ : Fin 4)
    (hv₀ : h4 v₀ ∈ K)
    (hv : ∀ (v : Fin 4) (hv : h4 v ∈ K),
      (cellGraph C4 h4 K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨v, hv⟩) =
        (cellGraph C4 h4 K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩))
    (he : ∀ d : C4.Dart, ∃ w ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 (Fin 4)), h4 w ∈ K) :
    Subsingleton (ZerothHomotopy {p : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 p ∈ K})
proof:
:= by
  have hcell : Subsingleton (cellGraph C4 h4 K).ConnectedComponent :=
    ⟨ConnectedComponent.ind₂ fun x y => by
      rw [cycle_cell_class v₀ hv₀ hv he x, cycle_cell_class v₀ hv₀ hv he y]⟩
  exact ⟨fun c d => (preimageComponentsEquiv C4 h4 K).injective
    (@Subsingleton.elim _ hcell _ _)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveExamples.cycle_preimage_subsingleton
statement:
theorem cycle_preimage_subsingleton (i : Bool) :
    Subsingleton (ZerothHomotopy
      {p : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 p ∈ overlappingIntervals i})
proof:
:= by
  cases i
  · refine cycle_preimage_subsingleton_of 0 (h4_mem_overlap_false.2 (by decide)) ?_ ?_
    · intro v hv
      have hv2 : v ≠ 2 := h4_mem_overlap_false.1 hv
      fin_cases v
      · rfl
      · exact connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_of_adj C4 h4 _ (show C4.Adj 1 0 by decide)
      · exact absurd rfl hv2
      · exact connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_of_adj C4 h4 _ (show C4.Adj 3 0 by decide)
    · intro d
      rcases C4_adj_ne_two d.fst d.snd d.adj with h | h
      · exact ⟨d.fst, fst_mem_dartEdge d, h4_mem_overlap_false.2 h⟩
      · exact ⟨d.snd, snd_mem_dartEdge d, h4_mem_overlap_false.2 h⟩
  · refine cycle_preimage_subsingleton_of 2 (h4_mem_overlap_true.2 (by decide)) ?_ ?_
    · intro v hv
      have hv0 : v ≠ 0 := h4_mem_overlap_true.1 hv
      fin_cases v
      · exact absurd rfl hv0
      · exact connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_of_adj C4 h4 _ (show C4.Adj 1 2 by decide)
      · rfl
      · exact connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_of_adj C4 h4 _ (show C4.Adj 3 2 by decide)
    · intro d
      rcases C4_adj_ne_zero d.fst d.snd d.adj with h | h
      · exact ⟨d.fst, fst_mem_dartEdge d, h4_mem_overlap_true.2 h⟩
      · exact ⟨d.snd, snd_mem_dartEdge d, h4_mem_overlap_true.2 h⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveExamples.cycle_multiNerveMapper_ne_mapper
statement:
theorem cycle_multiNerveMapper_ne_mapper :
    (∀ i, Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy
      {p : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 p ∈ overlappingIntervals i}) = 1) ∧
    Nat.card (ComponentIndex cycleMap overlapCover) = 2 ∧
    cycleEdge ∈ mapper cycleMap overlapCover ∧
    (∀ s ∈ mapper cycleMap overlapCover, s.card = 2 → s = cycleEdge) ∧
    interMember (componentCover cycleMap overlapCover) cycleEdge =
      plHeight C4 h4 ⁻¹' (I4 : Set ℝ) ∧
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper cycleMap overlapCover // c.support.card = 1} = 2 ∧
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper cycleMap overlapCover // c.support = cycleEdge} = 2 ∧
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper cycleMap overlapCover // c.support.card = 2} = 2 ∧
    cycleEdgeCellOne ≠ cycleEdgeCellThree ∧
    cycleEdgeCellOne.support = cycleEdge ∧ cycleEdgeCellThree.support = cycleEdge ∧
    cycleInterComponentsEquiv cycleEdgeCellOne.component = x1 ∧
    cycleInterComponentsEquiv cycleEdgeCellThree.component = x3 ∧
    Function.Surjective (multiNerveMapper_projection cycleMap overlapCover) ∧
    ¬ Function.Injective (multiNerveMapper_projection cycleMap overlapCover) ∧
    ¬ IntersectionsPathSubsingleton (componentCover cycleMap overlapCover) ∧
    ∀ c : multiNerveMapper cycleMap overlapCover, c.support.card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hnotinj : ¬ Function.Injective (multiNerveMapper_projection cycleMap overlapCover) :=
    fun h => cycleEdgeCellOne_ne_three (h rfl)
  refine ⟨cycle_preimage_card, cycle_componentIndex_card, cycleEdge_mem_mapper,
    cycle_mapper_edge_unique, cycle_interMember_eq,
    (Nat.card_congr (vertexCellEquiv _ _)).trans cycle_componentIndex_card,
    (Nat.card_congr ((cellsOverEquiv _ cycleEdge cycleEdge_nonempty).trans
      cycleInterComponentsEquiv)).trans c4_card_preimage, ?_, cycleEdgeCellOne_ne_three,
    rfl, rfl, cycleInterComponentsEquiv_one, cycleInterComponentsEquiv_three,
    multiNerveMapper_projection_surjective _ _, hnotinj,
    fun h => hnotinj ((projection_injective_iff _).2 h),
    multiNerveMapper_card_le_of_multiplicity _ _ (overlappingIntervals_multiplicity_two C4 h4)⟩
  refine Nat.card_eq_two_iff.2 ⟨⟨cycleEdgeCellOne, cycleEdge_card⟩,
    ⟨cycleEdgeCellThree, cycleEdge_card⟩, fun h => cycleEdgeCellOne_ne_three
      (congrArg Subtype.val h), Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun c => ?_⟩
  rcases cycle_cells_over_edge c.1
      (cycle_mapper_edge_unique _ c.1.support_mem_nerve c.2) with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext h)
  · exact Or.inr (Subtype.ext h)

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveExamples.bool_finset_cases
statement:
private theorem bool_finset_cases (τ : Finset Bool) (hτ : τ.Nonempty) :
    τ = {false} ∨ τ = {true} ∨ τ = {false, true}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hτ
  by_cases hf : false ∈ τ <;> by_cases ht : true ∈ τ
  · right; right
    ext x
    cases x <;> simp [hf, ht]
  · left
    ext x
    cases x <;> simp [hf, ht]
  · right; left
    ext x
    cases x <;> simp [hf, ht]
  · exfalso
    cases b <;> contradiction

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveExamples.singleEdge_preimageIntersectionsPathConnected

  · simp only [Finset.set_biInter_singleton] at hne ⊢
    exact preimage_isPathConnected_of_subsingleton (overlap_components_subsingleton false) hne
  · simp only [Finset.set_biInter_singleton] at hne ⊢
    exact preimage_isPathConnected_of_subsingleton (overlap_components_subsingleton true) hne
  · simp only [Finset.set_biInter_insert, Finset.set_biInter_singleton] at hne ⊢
    rw [overlap_inter_eq] at hne ⊢
    exact preimage_isPathConnected_of_subsingleton
      ⟨fun _ _ => (preimageComponentsEquiv edgeGraph h02 _).injective
        (@Subsingleton.elim _
          (single_cellComponents_subsingleton ioo_half_zero ioo_half_two ioo_half_one) _ _)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveExamples.singleEdge_multiNerveMapper_agrees

theorem singleEdge_multiNerveMapper_agrees :

    ⇑singleEdgeMultiNerveOrderIso = multiNerveMapper_projection edgeMap overlapCover ∧
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper edgeMap overlapCover // c.support.card = 1} = 2 ∧
    ∃! c : multiNerveMapper edgeMap overlapCover,
      c.support = {edgeOverlapIndex false, edgeOverlapIndex true}
proof:
:= by
  have hsub := intersectionsPathSubsingleton_of_preimage _ _
    singleEdge_preimageIntersectionsPathConnected
  have hinj : Function.Injective (multiNerveMapper_projection edgeMap overlapCover) :=
    (projection_injective_iff _).2 hsub
  refine ⟨hsub, ⟨hinj, multiNerveMapper_projection_surjective _ _⟩, rfl,
    (Nat.card_congr (vertexCellEquiv _ _)).trans singleEdge_overlap_exact.1, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := multiNerveMapper_projection_surjective edgeMap overlapCover
    ⟨_, singleEdge_overlap_exact.2.1⟩
  refine ⟨c, congrArg Subtype.val hc, fun d hd => hinj ?_⟩
  rw [hc]
  exact Subtype.ext hd

theorem triangle_multiNerveMapper_cell :

    triple_duplicate_cover_has_triangle.1

    exact triple_duplicate_cover_has_triangle.2
  refine ⟨triangle_intersectionsPathSubsingleton, ⟨c, hcard, hc⟩, fun hmult => ?_⟩
  have h := multiNerveMapper_card_le_of_multiplicity _ _ hmult c

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_dartHeight_mem_Icc
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_dartHeight_mem_Icc (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    dartHeight h d t ∈ Icc (min (h d.fst) (h d.snd)) (max (h d.fst) (h d.snd))
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hab | hba
  · rw [min_eq_left hab, max_eq_right hab]
    change h d.fst ≤ (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd ∧
      (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd ≤ h d.snd
    constructor
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg t.2.1 (sub_nonneg.2 hab)]
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 t.2.2) (sub_nonneg.2 hab)]
  · rw [min_eq_right hba, max_eq_left hba]
    change h d.snd ≤ (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd ∧
      (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd ≤ h d.fst
    constructor
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 t.2.2) (sub_nonneg.2 hba)]
    · nlinarith [mul_nonneg t.2.1 (sub_nonneg.2 hba)]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_edgeCrosses_of_level
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_edgeCrosses_of_level {i : Fin (n + 1)} (d : G.Dart)
    {t : unitInterval} (ht : dartHeight h d t = S.value i)
    (hne : ∀ v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V), h v ≠ S.value i) :
    EdgeCrosses G h (S.value i) (dartEdge d)
proof:
:= by
  apply (edgeCrosses_dartEdge_iff d).2
  have hrange := reebQuot_dartHeight_mem_Icc G h d t
  rw [ht] at hrange
  constructor
  · rcases min_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm
    · rw [hm] at hrange ⊢
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hrange.1 (hne d.fst (fst_mem_dartEdge d))
    · rw [hm] at hrange ⊢
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hrange.1 (hne d.snd (snd_mem_dartEdge d))
  · rcases max_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm
    · rw [hm] at hrange ⊢
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hrange.2 (Ne.symm (hne d.fst (fst_mem_dartEdge d)))
    · rw [hm] at hrange ⊢
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hrange.2 (Ne.symm (hne d.snd (snd_mem_dartEdge d)))
