name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_dartValue_of_level
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_dartValue_of_level (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    {i : Fin (n + 1)} (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval)
    (ht : dartHeight h d t = S.value i) :
    reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d t =
      (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofVertex S i
      (levelEnd G h (S.value i) (dartEdge d)
          (fun hne => reebQuot_edgeCrosses_of_level G h (i := i) d (t := t) ht hne))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold reebQuot_dartValue
  rw [dif_pos ⟨i, ht⟩]
  have hidx : Classical.choose (show ∃ j, dartHeight h d t = S.value j from ⟨i, ht⟩) = i := by
    apply S.strictMono.injective
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (show ∃ j, dartHeight h d t = S.value j from ⟨i, ht⟩)).symm.trans ht
  dsimp only
  exact reebQuot_ofVertex_levelEnd_congr G h d hidx _ _

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_dartValue_of_mem_K
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_dartValue_of_mem_K (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    {e : Fin n} (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval)
    (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ S.K e) :
    reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d t =
      (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e
        (⟨dartEdge d, reebQuot_edgeSpans_of_mem_K G h hS d ht⟩, ⟨dartHeight h d t, ht⟩)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnot : ¬ ∃ i, dartHeight h d t = S.value i := by
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact S.value_notMem_K e i (hi ▸ ht)
  unfold reebQuot_dartValue
  rw [dif_neg hnot]
  have heq : Classical.choose (reebQuot_dart_mem_gap G h hS d t hnot) = e := by
    apply S.eq_of_K_inf_K_nonempty
    exact ⟨dartHeight h d t,
      Classical.choose_spec (reebQuot_dart_mem_gap G h hS d t hnot), ht⟩
  cases heq
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_dartValue_symm
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_dartValue_symm (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (d : G.Dart)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d.symm (unitInterval.symm t) =
      reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hi : ∃ i, dartHeight h d t = S.value i
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hi
    rw [reebQuot_dartValue_of_level G h hS (i := i) d.symm (unitInterval.symm t) (by
      rw [dartHeight_symm]; exact hi),
      reebQuot_dartValue_of_level G h hS (i := i) d t hi]
    exact reebQuot_ofVertex_levelEnd_edge_congr G h (j := i) (k := i)
      (ε := dartEdge d.symm) (ε' := dartEdge d) rfl (dartEdge_symm d) _ _
  · have hi' : ¬ ∃ i, dartHeight h d.symm (unitInterval.symm t) = S.value i := by
      simpa [dartHeight_symm] using hi
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : Fin n, dartHeight h d t ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) :=
      reebQuot_dart_mem_gap G h hS d t hi
    have he' : dartHeight h d.symm (unitInterval.symm t) ∈ S.K e := by
      simpa [dartHeight_symm] using he
    rw [reebQuot_dartValue_of_mem_K G h hS d.symm (unitInterval.symm t) he',
      reebQuot_dartValue_of_mem_K G h hS d t he]
    apply congrArg (fun p =>
      (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e p)
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact dartEdge_symm d
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact dartHeight_symm h d t

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_dartValue_zero
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_dartValue_zero (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (d : G.Dart) :
    reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d 0 = reebQuot_vertexValue G h hS d.fst
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let i := Classical.choose (hS d.fst)
  have hi : dartHeight h d 0 = S.value i := by
    rw [dartHeight_zero]
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hS d.fst)).symm
  rw [reebQuot_dartValue_of_level G h hS (i := i) d 0 hi]
  rw [levelEnd_of_mem G h (fun hne =>
      reebQuot_edgeCrosses_of_level G h (i := i) d (t := 0) hi hne)
    (fst_mem_dartEdge d)
    (Classical.choose_spec (hS d.fst)).symm]
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_segments_cover
proof:
:= by
  have hc : dartHeight h d t ∈ Icc (S.value 0) (S.value (Fin.last n)) := by
    simpa [plHeight_edgePoint] using
      reebQuot_plHeight_mem_Icc G h hS (edgePoint G d t)
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩ := S.exists_piece (dartHeight h d t)
  cases p with
  | star i =>
      have hi : S.value i = dartHeight h d t := hp' i (S.value_mem_J i)
      cases i using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
          refine ⟨⟨0, hn⟩, ?_⟩
          rw [← hi]
          exact ⟨le_rfl, S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le _)
            ⟩
      | succ k =>
          refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
          rw [← hi]
          exact ⟨S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.castSucc_le_succ k), le_rfl⟩
  | gap e => exact ⟨e, ⟨hp.1.le, hp.2.le⟩⟩
  | lowerTail => exact (not_lt_of_ge hc.1 hp).elim
  | upperTail => exact (not_lt_of_ge hc.2 hp).elim

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_segment_subsingleton
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_segment_subsingleton (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    {d : G.Dart} (hne : h d.fst ≠ h d.snd) (e : Fin n)
    (hspan : ¬ EdgeSpans G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) (dartEdge d)) :
    Set.Subsingleton ((dartHeight h d) ⁻¹'
      (CylinderPresentation.Seg S e : Set ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs t ht
  have hendpoint : ∀ r : unitInterval,
      r ∈ (dartHeight h d) ⁻¹' (CylinderPresentation.Seg S e : Set ℝ) →
        dartHeight h d r = S.value e.castSucc ∨
          dartHeight h d r = S.value e.succ := by
    intro r hr
    change dartHeight h d r ∈ Icc (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) at hr
    by_cases hlevel : ∃ i, dartHeight h d r = S.value i
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hlevel
      have hlow : e.castSucc ≤ i := by
        have hlow' : S.value e.castSucc ≤ S.value i := by simpa [hi] using hr.1
        by_contra hnot
        exact (not_lt_of_ge hlow') (S.strictMono (lt_of_not_ge hnot))
      have hupp : i ≤ e.succ := by
        have hupp' : S.value i ≤ S.value e.succ := by simpa [hi] using hr.2
        by_contra hnot
        exact (not_lt_of_ge hupp') (S.strictMono (lt_of_not_ge hnot))
      rcases eq_or_ne i e.castSucc with rfl | hne'
      · exact Or.inl hi
      · right
        have hlt : e.castSucc < i := lt_of_le_of_ne hlow (Ne.symm hne')
        exact hi.trans (congrArg S.value
          (le_antisymm hupp (Fin.castSucc_lt_iff_succ_le.1 hlt)))
    · have hca : dartHeight h d r ≠ S.value e.castSucc := by
        intro hca
        exact hlevel ⟨e.castSucc, hca⟩
      have hcb : dartHeight h d r ≠ S.value e.succ := by
        intro hcb
        exact hlevel ⟨e.succ, hcb⟩
      have hrK : dartHeight h d r ∈ S.K e := by
        exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hr.1 (Ne.symm hca), lt_of_le_of_ne hr.2 hcb⟩
      obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ : ∃ e' : Fin n, dartHeight h d r ∈ (S.K e' : Set ℝ) :=
        reebQuot_dart_mem_gap G h hS d r hlevel
      have heq : e' = e := by
        apply S.eq_of_K_inf_K_nonempty
        exact ⟨dartHeight h d r, he', hrK⟩
      exact (hspan (by simpa [heq] using
        reebQuot_edgeSpans_of_mem_K G h hS d he')).elim
  have hs' := hendpoint s hs
  have ht' := hendpoint t ht
  by_cases hst : dartHeight h d s = dartHeight h d t
  · exact dartHeight_injective h hne hst
  apply Subtype.ext
  rcases hs' with hs' | hs' <;> rcases ht' with ht' | ht'
  · exact (hst (hs'.trans ht'.symm)).elim
  · have hrs : min (h d.fst) (h d.snd) ≤ S.value e.castSucc := by
      simpa [hs'] using (reebQuot_dartHeight_mem_Icc G h d s).1
    have hrt : S.value e.succ ≤ max (h d.fst) (h d.snd) := by
      simpa [ht'] using (reebQuot_dartHeight_mem_Icc G h d t).2
    exact (hspan ((edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff d).2 ⟨hrs, hrt⟩)).elim
  · have hrs : min (h d.fst) (h d.snd) ≤ S.value e.castSucc := by
      simpa [ht'] using (reebQuot_dartHeight_mem_Icc G h d t).1
    have hrt : S.value e.succ ≤ max (h d.fst) (h d.snd) := by
      simpa [hs'] using (reebQuot_dartHeight_mem_Icc G h d s).2
    exact (hspan ((edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff d).2 ⟨hrs, hrt⟩)).elim
  · exact (hst (hs'.trans ht'.symm)).elim

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_dartValue_continuousOn
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_dartValue_continuousOn (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    {d : G.Dart} (hne : h d.fst ≠ h d.snd) (e : Fin n) :
    ContinuousOn (reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d)
      ((dartHeight h d) ⁻¹' (CylinderPresentation.Seg S e : Set ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hspan : EdgeSpans G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) (dartEdge d)
  · let y : (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).E e :=
      ⟨dartEdge d, hspan⟩
    let f : unitInterval →
        (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).Realization S :=
      fun r => (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofCylinder S e
        (y, Set.projIcc (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ)
          (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e).le (dartHeight h d r))
    have hf : Continuous f :=
      (CylinderPresentation.continuous_ofCylinder
        S (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)) e).comp
        (continuous_const.prodMk
          (continuous_projIcc.comp (continuous_dartHeight h d)))
    refine hf.continuousOn.congr ?_
    intro r hr
    change dartHeight h d r ∈ Icc (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) at hr
    by_cases hlow : dartHeight h d r = S.value e.castSucc
    · rw [reebQuot_dartValue_of_level G h hS d r hlow]
      dsimp only [f]
      have hp : Set.projIcc (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ)
          (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e).le (dartHeight h d r) =
          CylinderPresentation.segBot S e := by
        rw [Set.projIcc_of_mem _ hr]
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact hlow
      rw [hp, CylinderPresentation.ofCylinder_segBot]
      rfl
    · by_cases hupp : dartHeight h d r = S.value e.succ
      · rw [reebQuot_dartValue_of_level G h hS d r hupp]
        dsimp only [f]
        have hp : Set.projIcc (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ)
            (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e).le (dartHeight h d r) =
            CylinderPresentation.segTop S e := by
          rw [Set.projIcc_of_mem _ hr]
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact hupp
        rw [hp, CylinderPresentation.ofCylinder_segTop]
        rfl
      · have hK : dartHeight h d r ∈ S.K e :=
          ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hr.1 (Ne.symm hlow), lt_of_le_of_ne hr.2 hupp⟩
        rw [reebQuot_dartValue_of_mem_K G h hS d r hK,
          CylinderPresentation.ofStrip_eq_ofCylinder]
        dsimp only [f]
        rw [Set.projIcc_of_mem _ hr]
        rfl
  · exact (reebQuot_segment_subsingleton G h hS hne e hspan).continuousOn _

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_dartValue_continuous
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn : 0 < n := by
    by_contra hn'
    have hn0 : n = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hn'
    subst n
    rcases hS d.fst with ⟨i, hi⟩
    rcases hS d.snd with ⟨j, hj⟩
    have hi0 : i = 0 := Fin.eq_zero i
    have hj0 : j = 0 := Fin.eq_zero j
    have hfst : h d.fst = S.value 0 := hi.symm.trans (by rw [hi0])
    have hsnd : h d.snd = S.value 0 := hj.symm.trans (by rw [hj0])
    exact hne (hfst.trans hsnd.symm)
  let F : Fin n → Set unitInterval := fun e =>
    (dartHeight h d) ⁻¹' (CylinderPresentation.Seg S e : Set ℝ)
  have hcover : ⋃ e, F e = Set.univ := by
    apply Set.eq_univ_of_forall
    intro t
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := reebQuot_segments_cover G h hS hn d t
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨e, he⟩
  apply (locallyFinite_of_finite F).continuous hcover
  · intro e
    exact isClosed_Icc.preimage (continuous_dartHeight h d)
  · intro e
    exact reebQuot_dartValue_continuousOn G h hS hne e

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_dartValue_continuous_horizontal
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : ∀ t : unitInterval,
      reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d t = reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d 0 := by
    intro t
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hS d.fst
    have ht : dartHeight h d t = S.value i := by
      rw [dartHeight_of_eq h hd, hi.symm]
    have h0 : dartHeight h d 0 = S.value i := by
      rw [dartHeight_zero, hi.symm]
    rw [reebQuot_dartValue_of_level G h hS d t ht,
      reebQuot_dartValue_of_level G h hS d 0 h0]
  rw [show (reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d) =
      (fun _ : unitInterval => reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d 0) from funext hconst]
  exact continuous_const

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_dartValue_height
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_dartValue_height (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (d : G.Dart)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).height S
        (reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d t) = dartHeight h d t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hi : ∃ i, dartHeight h d t = S.value i
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hi
    rw [reebQuot_dartValue_of_level G h hS d t hi]
    change S.value i = dartHeight h d t
    exact hi.symm
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : Fin n, dartHeight h d t ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) :=
      reebQuot_dart_mem_gap G h hS d t hi
    rw [reebQuot_dartValue_of_mem_K G h hS d t he,
      CylinderPresentation.height_ofStrip]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_edgeMap_symm
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_edgeMap_symm (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (d : G.Dart)
    (t : unitInterval) :
    (reebQuot_edgeMap G h hS d.symm) (unitInterval.symm t) =
      (reebQuot_edgeMap G h hS d) t
proof:
:= by
  change reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d.symm (unitInterval.symm t) =
    reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d t
  exact reebQuot_dartValue_symm G h hS d t

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_edgeMap_zero
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_edgeMap_zero (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (d : G.Dart) :
    (reebQuot_edgeMap G h hS d) 0 = graphPLReebVertexMap G h hS d.fst
proof:
:= by
  change reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d 0 = reebQuot_vertexValue G h hS d.fst
  exact reebQuot_dartValue_zero G h hS d

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.height_graphPLReebMap
statement:
theorem height_graphPLReebMap (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (x : Realization G) :
    (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).height S
      (graphPLReebMap G h hS x) = plHeight G h x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using ind G with
  | vertex v =>
      change (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).height S
        (graphPLReebVertexMap G h hS v) = h v
      change (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).height S
        (reebQuot_vertexValue G h hS v) = h v
      dsimp [reebQuot_vertexValue]
      change S.value (Classical.choose (hS v)) = h v
      exact Classical.choose_spec (hS v)
  | edgePoint d t =>
      change (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).height S
          (reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d t) = dartHeight h d t
      exact reebQuot_dartValue_height G h hS d t

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebMap_vertex
statement:
theorem graphPLReebMap_vertex (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) {i : Fin (n + 1)} (v : V)
    (hv : h v = S.value i) :
    graphPLReebMap G h hS (vertex G v) =
      (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofVertex S i
        (Sum.inl ((G.induce {w | h w = S.value i}).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hv⟩))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change graphPLReebVertexMap G h hS v = _
  change reebQuot_vertexValue G h hS v = _
  dsimp [reebQuot_vertexValue]
  have hi : Classical.choose (hS v) = i := by
    apply S.strictMono.injective
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hS v)).trans hv
  exact reebQuot_ofVertex_levelComponent_congr G h v hi
    (Classical.choose_spec (hS v)).symm hv

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebMap_edgePoint_of_mem_K
statement:
theorem graphPLReebMap_edgePoint_of_mem_K (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) {e : Fin n}
    (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ S.K e)
    (hsp : EdgeSpans G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) (dartEdge d)) :
    graphPLReebMap G h hS (edgePoint G d t) =
      (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e
        (⟨dartEdge d, hsp⟩, ⟨dartHeight h d t, ht⟩)
proof:
:= by
  change reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d t = _
  exact reebQuot_dartValue_of_mem_K G h hS d t ht

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_closedLevelComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_closedLevelComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint
    {c : ℝ} (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval)
    (hp : plHeight G h (edgePoint G d t) ∈ ({c} : Set ℝ))
    (hx : (∀ v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V), h v ≠ c) →
      EdgeCrosses G h c (dartEdge d)) :
    closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h c
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint G d t, hp⟩) = levelEnd G h c (dartEdge d) hx
proof:
:= by
  have ht : dartHeight h d t = c := by
    simpa [plHeight_edgePoint] using hp
  obtain ⟨η, _hη, hI⟩ := exists_isLevelWindow h c
  have htI : dartHeight h d t ∈ (ioo (c - η) (c + η) : Set ℝ) := by
    rw [ht]
    exact hI.1
  rw [closedLevelComponentsEquiv_eq G h hI]
  exact levelWindowEquiv_mk_edgePoint G h hI d t htI hx

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebMap_of_level
statement:
theorem graphPLReebMap_of_level (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (p : ClosedLevel G h (S.value i)) :
    graphPLReebMap G h hS p.1 =
      (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofVertex S i
        (closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h (S.value i) (ZerothHomotopy.mk p))
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨p, hp⟩
  induction p using ind G with
  | vertex v =>
      have hv : h v = S.value i := by
        simpa [plHeight_vertex] using hp
      change graphPLReebMap G h hS (vertex G v) = _
      rw [graphPLReebMap_vertex G h hS v hv,
        closedLevelComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex G h v hv]
  | edgePoint d t =>
      have ht : dartHeight h d t = S.value i := by
        simpa [plHeight_edgePoint] using hp
      change reebQuot_dartValue G h hS d t = _
      let hx : (∀ v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V), h v ≠ S.value i) →
          EdgeCrosses G h (S.value i) (dartEdge d) := fun hne =>
        reebQuot_edgeCrosses_of_level G h (i := i) d ht hne
      rw [reebQuot_dartValue_of_level G h hS (i := i) d t ht,
        reebQuot_closedLevelComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint G h d t hp hx]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_reebRel_of_level_map_eq
proof:
:= by
  let px : ClosedLevel G h (S.value i) := ⟨x, by simp [hx]⟩
  let px' : ClosedLevel G h (S.value i) := ⟨x', by simp [hx']⟩
  have hlabels :
      closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h (S.value i) (ZerothHomotopy.mk px) =
        closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h (S.value i) (ZerothHomotopy.mk px') := by
    apply (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofVertex_injective S i
    rw [← graphPLReebMap_of_level G h hS i px,
      ← graphPLReebMap_of_level G h hS i px']
    exact hmap
  have hcomp : ZerothHomotopy.mk px = ZerothHomotopy.mk px' :=
    (closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h (S.value i)).injective hlabels
  obtain ⟨γ⟩ := Quotient.exact hcomp
  refine ⟨γ.map continuous_subtype_val, ?_⟩
  intro t
  have hγ : plHeight G h (γ t).1 = S.value i := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp (γ t).2
  exact hγ.trans hx.symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_edgePoint_eq_of_map_eq
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_edgePoint_eq_of_map_eq (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    {d d' : G.Dart} {e e' : Fin n} (t t' : unitInterval)
    (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ S.K e) (ht' : dartHeight h d' t' ∈ S.K e')
    (hmap : graphPLReebMap G h hS (edgePoint G d t) =
      graphPLReebMap G h hS (edgePoint G d' t')) :
    edgePoint G d t = edgePoint G d' t'
proof:
:= by
  have hheight : dartHeight h d t = dartHeight h d' t' := by
    calc
      dartHeight h d t = plHeight G h (edgePoint G d t) := by
        rw [plHeight_edgePoint]
      _ = (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).height S
          (graphPLReebMap G h hS (edgePoint G d t)) :=
        (height_graphPLReebMap G h hS (edgePoint G d t)).symm
      _ = (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).height S
          (graphPLReebMap G h hS (edgePoint G d' t')) := congrArg _ hmap
      _ = plHeight G h (edgePoint G d' t') :=
        height_graphPLReebMap G h hS (edgePoint G d' t')
      _ = dartHeight h d' t' := by
        rw [plHeight_edgePoint]
  have hte' : dartHeight h d t ∈ (S.K e' : Set ℝ) := by
    rw [hheight]
    exact ht'
  have heq : e = e' := S.eq_of_K_inf_K_nonempty ⟨dartHeight h d t, ht, hte'⟩
  subst e'
  have hsp : EdgeSpans G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) (dartEdge d) :=
    reebQuot_edgeSpans_of_mem_K G h hS d ht
  have hsp' : EdgeSpans G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) (dartEdge d') :=
    reebQuot_edgeSpans_of_mem_K G h hS d' ht'
  have hne : h d.fst ≠ h d.snd := by
    intro heq
    have hconst : dartHeight h d t = h d.fst := dartHeight_of_eq h heq t
    exact (hS.notMem_K e d.fst) (hconst ▸ ht)
  have hne' : h d'.fst ≠ h d'.snd := by
    intro heq
    have hconst : dartHeight h d' t' = h d'.fst := dartHeight_of_eq h heq t'
    exact (hS.notMem_K e d'.fst) (hconst ▸ ht')
  rw [graphPLReebMap_edgePoint_of_mem_K G h hS d t ht hsp,
    graphPLReebMap_edgePoint_of_mem_K G h hS d' t' ht' hsp'] at hmap
  have hp := (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip_injective S e hmap
  have hde : dartEdge d = dartEdge d' :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (congrArg Prod.fst hp)
  have hdt : dartHeight h d t = dartHeight h d' t' :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (congrArg Prod.snd hp)
  rcases (dartEdge_eq_iff).1 hde with hdd | hdd
  · subst d'
    have htt : t = t' := dartHeight_injective h hne hdt
    subst t'
    rfl
  · have hdt' : dartHeight h d' (unitInterval.symm t) = dartHeight h d' t' := by
      have hsymm := dartHeight_symm h d' (unitInterval.symm t)
      rw [unitInterval.symm_symm] at hsymm
      exact hsymm.symm.trans (by simpa [hdd] using hdt)
    have htt : unitInterval.symm t = t' :=
      dartHeight_injective h hne' hdt'
    calc
      edgePoint G d t = edgePoint G d'.symm t := by rw [hdd]
      _ = edgePoint G d' (unitInterval.symm t) := by
        have hsymm := edgePoint_symm G d' (unitInterval.symm t)
        rw [unitInterval.symm_symm] at hsymm
        exact hsymm
      _ = edgePoint G d' t' := congrArg (edgePoint G d') htt

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_graphPLReebMap_eq_iff
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_graphPLReebMap_eq_iff (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    {x x' : Realization G} :
    graphPLReebMap G h hS x = graphPLReebMap G h hS x' ↔
      ReebRel (plHeight G h) x x'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hmap
    have hheight : plHeight G h x = plHeight G h x' := by
      calc
        plHeight G h x =
            (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).height S
              (graphPLReebMap G h hS x) :=
          (height_graphPLReebMap G h hS x).symm
        _ = (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).height S
              (graphPLReebMap G h hS x') := congrArg _ hmap
        _ = plHeight G h x' := height_graphPLReebMap G h hS x'
    by_cases hlevel : ∃ i, plHeight G h x = S.value i
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hlevel
      exact reebQuot_reebRel_of_level_map_eq G h hS i hi (hheight.symm.trans hi) hmap
    · have hlevel' : ¬ ∃ i, plHeight G h x' = S.value i := by
        intro hi'
        apply hlevel
        obtain ⟨i, hi'⟩ := hi'
        exact ⟨i, hheight.trans hi'⟩
      have hx : ∃ d t, x = edgePoint G d t := by
        induction x using ind G with
        | vertex v =>
            obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hS v
            exact (hlevel ⟨i, by simpa [plHeight_vertex] using hi.symm⟩).elim
        | edgePoint d t => exact ⟨d, t, rfl⟩
      have hx' : ∃ d t, x' = edgePoint G d t := by
        induction x' using ind G with
        | vertex v =>
            obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hS v
            exact (hlevel' ⟨i, by simpa [plHeight_vertex] using hi.symm⟩).elim
        | edgePoint d t => exact ⟨d, t, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨d, t, rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨d', t', rfl⟩ := hx'
      have hgap : ∃ e, dartHeight h d t ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) := by
        refine reebQuot_dart_mem_gap G h hS d t ?_
        rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        apply hlevel
        exact ⟨i, by simpa [plHeight_edgePoint] using hi⟩
      have hgap' : ∃ e, dartHeight h d' t' ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) := by
        refine reebQuot_dart_mem_gap G h hS d' t' ?_
        rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        apply hlevel'
        exact ⟨i, by simpa [plHeight_edgePoint] using hi⟩
      obtain ⟨e, ht⟩ := hgap
      obtain ⟨e', ht'⟩ := hgap'
      have hpoint := reebQuot_edgePoint_eq_of_map_eq G h hS t t' ht ht' hmap
      rw [hpoint]
      exact ReebRel.refl _ _
  · intro hreeb
    exact RGraph.apply_eq_of_reebRel S (graphPLReebMap G h hS)
      (height_graphPLReebMap G h hS) hreeb

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.reebQuot_strip_crossing
statement:
private theorem reebQuot_strip_crossing (e : Fin n)
    (p : (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).E e ×
      (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    ∃ d : G.Dart, ∃ t : unitInterval,
      dartEdge d = p.1.1 ∧ dartHeight h d t = (p.2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases p.1.2 with ⟨d, hd, hmin, hmax⟩
  have hcross : min (h d.fst) (h d.snd) < (p.2 : ℝ) ∧
      (p.2 : ℝ) < max (h d.fst) (h d.snd) := by
    exact ⟨hmin.trans_lt p.2.property.1, p.2.property.2.trans_le hmax⟩
  rcases le_total (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hab | hba
  · have h₁ : h d.fst < (p.2 : ℝ) := by
      simpa [min_eq_left hab] using hcross.1
    have h₂ : (p.2 : ℝ) < h d.snd := by
      simpa [max_eq_right hab] using hcross.2
    exact ⟨d, crossingParam G h h₁ h₂, hd,
      dartHeight_crossingParam G h h₁ h₂⟩
  · have h₁ : h d.snd < (p.2 : ℝ) := by
      simpa [min_eq_right hba] using hcross.1
    have h₂ : (p.2 : ℝ) < h d.fst := by
      simpa [max_eq_left hba] using hcross.2
    refine ⟨d.symm, crossingParam G h (d := d.symm) (by simpa using h₁)
      (by simpa using h₂), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [dartEdge_symm]
      exact hd
    · exact dartHeight_crossingParam G h (d := d.symm) (by simpa using h₁)
        (by simpa using h₂)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebQuotientMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem graphPLReebQuotientMap_mk (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (x : Realization G) :
    graphPLReebQuotientMap G h hS (ReebQuotient.mk _ x) = graphPLReebMap G h hS x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebQuotientMap_bijective
statement:
theorem graphPLReebQuotientMap_bijective (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) :
    Function.Bijective (graphPLReebQuotientMap G h hS)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro q q' hq
    induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
    | h x =>
        induction q' using ReebQuotient.ind with
        | h x' =>
            exact (ReebQuotient.mk_eq_mk_iff _).2
              ((reebQuot_graphPLReebMap_eq_iff G h hS).1 hq)
  · intro y
    rcases (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).exists_rep S y with
      ⟨i, z, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, p, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h (S.value i)).surjective z
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective x
      exact ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ p.1, by
        rw [graphPLReebQuotientMap_mk, graphPLReebMap_of_level G h hS i p]
        simp [hp, hx]⟩
    · obtain ⟨d, t, hd, htval⟩ := reebQuot_strip_crossing G h e p
      have ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) := by
        rw [htval]
        exact p.2.2
      have hsp := reebQuot_edgeSpans_of_mem_K G h hS d ht
      exact ⟨ReebQuotient.mk _ (edgePoint G d t), by
        rw [graphPLReebQuotientMap_mk,
          graphPLReebMap_edgePoint_of_mem_K G h hS d t ht hsp]
        have hp : (⟨dartEdge d, hsp⟩, ⟨dartHeight h d t, ht⟩) = p := by
          apply Prod.ext
          · exact Subtype.ext hd
          · exact Subtype.ext htval
        exact congrArg (fun z =>
          (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e z) hp⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebQuotientHomeomorph_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem graphPLReebQuotientHomeomorph_mk (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (x : Realization G) :
    graphPLReebQuotientHomeomorph G h hS (ReebQuotient.mk _ x) =
      graphPLReebMap G h hS x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.height_graphPLReebQuotientHomeomorph
statement:
theorem height_graphPLReebQuotientHomeomorph (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (q : ReebQuotient (plHeight G h)) :
    (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).height S
        (graphPLReebQuotientHomeomorph G h hS q) = ReebQuotient.height _ q
proof:
:= by
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h x =>
      exact height_graphPLReebMap G h hS x

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.intervalComponentNatTrans_graphPLReebMap_on_vertexLabel
statement:
private theorem intervalComponentNatTrans_graphPLReebMap_on_vertexLabel
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) {i : Fin (n + 1)}
    (x : (graphPLReebData G h S).V i) :
    (intervalComponentNatTrans (graphPLReebMap G h hS)
        (height_graphPLReebMap G h hS)).app (S.J i)
        ((graphPLCosheafIso G h hS).hom.app (S.J i)
          ((graphPLReebData G h S).vertexLabel S i x)) =
      (graphPLReebData G h S).vertexLabel S i x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [graphPLCosheafIso_hom_app_J G h hS i x]
  let z : ZerothHomotopy (ClosedLevel G h (S.value i)) :=
    (closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h (S.value i)).symm x
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective z
  have hstar :
      graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i
          (TDA.Topology.componentMap (levelInclusion G h (S.value_mem_J i))
            (ZerothHomotopy.mk p)) = x := by
    have hstar' := congrFun
      (graphPLStarEquiv_comp_componentMap_levelInclusion G h S hS i)
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk p)
    have hstar'' :
        graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i
            (TDA.Topology.componentMap (levelInclusion G h (S.value_mem_J i))
              (ZerothHomotopy.mk p)) =
          closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h (S.value i) (ZerothHomotopy.mk p) := by
      exact hstar'
    exact hstar''.trans (by
      rw [hp]
      exact (closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h (S.value i)).apply_symm_apply x)
  have hcomponent :
      TDA.Topology.componentMap (levelInclusion G h (S.value_mem_J i))
          (ZerothHomotopy.mk p) =
        (graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i).symm x := by
    apply (graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i).injective
    exact hstar.trans ((graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i).apply_symm_apply x).symm
  rw [← hcomponent]
  change (intervalComponentNatTrans (graphPLReebMap G h hS)
      (height_graphPLReebMap G h hS)).app (S.J i)
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk (levelInclusion G h (S.value_mem_J i) p)) = _
  rw [intervalComponentNatTrans_app_mk
        (h := graphPLReebMap G h hS)
        (comm := height_graphPLReebMap G h hS)
        (I := S.J i)
        (x := levelInclusion G h (S.value_mem_J i) p)]
  have hx : closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h (S.value i) (ZerothHomotopy.mk p) = x := by
    rw [hp]
    exact (closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h (S.value i)).apply_symm_apply x
  rw [(graphPLReebData G h S).vertexLabel_apply S i x]
  refine congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (Subtype.ext ?_)
  exact (graphPLReebMap_of_level G h hS i p).trans
    (congrArg ((CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofVertex S i) hx)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.intervalComponentNatTrans_graphPLReebMap_on_edgeLabel
statement:
private theorem intervalComponentNatTrans_graphPLReebMap_on_edgeLabel
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) {e : Fin n}
    (y : (graphPLReebData G h S).E e) :
    (intervalComponentNatTrans (graphPLReebMap G h hS)
        (height_graphPLReebMap G h hS)).app (S.K e)
        ((graphPLCosheafIso G h hS).hom.app (S.K e)
          ((graphPLReebData G h S).edgeLabel S e y)) =
      (graphPLReebData G h S).edgeLabel S e y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [graphPLCosheafIso_hom_app_K G h hS e y]
  obtain ⟨d, t, hd, htval⟩ :=
    reebQuot_strip_crossing G h e (y, S.gapMidpoint e)
  have ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) := by
    rw [htval]
    exact (S.gapMidpoint e).2
  have hsp : EdgeSpans G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) (dartEdge d) :=
    reebQuot_edgeSpans_of_mem_K G h hS d ht
  have hge :
      graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS e
          (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨edgePoint G d t, ht⟩ :
            {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ S.K e})) = y := by
    rw [graphPLGapEquiv_mk_edgePoint G h S hS d t ht hsp]
    exact Subtype.ext hd
  have hpoint :
      (graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS e).symm y =
        ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨edgePoint G d t, ht⟩ :
          {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ S.K e}) := by
    have hpoint' := congrArg (graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS e).symm hge
    exact hpoint'.symm.trans
      ((graphPLGapEquiv G h S hS e).symm_apply_apply _)
  rw [hpoint]
  refine (intervalComponentNatTrans_app_mk (graphPLReebMap G h hS)
    (height_graphPLReebMap G h hS) (S.K e)
    (⟨edgePoint G d t, ht⟩ : {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ S.K e})).trans ?_
  have hp :
      (⟨dartEdge d, hsp⟩, ⟨dartHeight h d t, ht⟩) =
        (y, S.gapMidpoint e) := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact Subtype.ext hd
    · exact Subtype.ext htval
  rw [(graphPLReebData G h S).edgeLabel_apply S e (S.gapMidpoint e) y]
  refine congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (Subtype.ext ?_)
  exact (graphPLReebMap_edgePoint_of_mem_K G h hS d t ht hsp).trans
    (congrArg ((CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e) hp)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.intervalComponentNatTrans_graphPLReebMap
statement:
theorem intervalComponentNatTrans_graphPLReebMap (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) :
    intervalComponentNatTrans (graphPLReebMap G h hS) (height_graphPLReebMap G h hS) =
      (graphPLCosheafIso G h hS).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp :
      (graphPLCosheafIso G h hS).hom ≫
          intervalComponentNatTrans (graphPLReebMap G h hS)
            (height_graphPLReebMap G h hS) =
        𝟙 _ := by
    refine S.natTrans_ext
      (FiniteReebData.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt (graphPLReebData G h S) S)
      (FiniteReebData.toCosheaf_isIntervalCosheaf (graphPLReebData G h S) S)
      (FiniteReebData.toCosheaf_isConstructibleAt (graphPLReebData G h S) S)
      (FiniteReebData.toCosheaf_isIntervalCosheaf (graphPLReebData G h S) S)
      ?_ ?_
    · intro i x
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := (graphPLReebData G h S).vertexLabel S i |>.surjective x
      change (intervalComponentNatTrans (graphPLReebMap G h hS)
          (height_graphPLReebMap G h hS)).app (S.J i)
          ((graphPLCosheafIso G h hS).hom.app (S.J i)
            ((graphPLReebData G h S).vertexLabel S i v)) =
        (graphPLReebData G h S).vertexLabel S i v
      exact intervalComponentNatTrans_graphPLReebMap_on_vertexLabel G h hS v
    · intro e x
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (graphPLReebData G h S).edgeLabel S e |>.surjective x
      change (intervalComponentNatTrans (graphPLReebMap G h hS)
          (height_graphPLReebMap G h hS)).app (S.K e)
          ((graphPLCosheafIso G h hS).hom.app (S.K e)
            ((graphPLReebData G h S).edgeLabel S e y)) =
        (graphPLReebData G h S).edgeLabel S e y
      exact intervalComponentNatTrans_graphPLReebMap_on_edgeLabel G h hS y
  exact (Iso.hom_comp_eq_id (graphPLCosheafIso G h hS)).mp hcomp

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.height_graphPLReebQuotientMap
statement:
theorem height_graphPLReebQuotientMap (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (q : ReebQuotient (plHeight G h)) :
    (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).height S
        (graphPLReebQuotientMap G h hS q) = ReebQuotient.height _ q
proof:
:= by
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h x =>
      change (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).height S
          (graphPLReebMap G h hS x) = plHeight G h x
      exact height_graphPLReebMap G h hS x

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.intervalComponentComparison_comp_graphPLReebQuotientMap
statement:
theorem intervalComponentComparison_comp_graphPLReebQuotientMap
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) :
    ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison (plHeight G h) ≫
        intervalComponentNatTrans (graphPLReebQuotientMap G h hS)
          (height_graphPLReebQuotientMap G h hS) =
      (graphPLCosheafIso G h hS).inv
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp :
      ReebQuotient.intervalComponentComparison (plHeight G h) ≫
          intervalComponentNatTrans (graphPLReebQuotientMap G h hS)
            (height_graphPLReebQuotientMap G h hS) =
        intervalComponentNatTrans (graphPLReebMap G h hS)
          (height_graphPLReebMap G h hS) := by
    ext I c
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x => rfl
  rw [hcomp, intervalComponentNatTrans_graphPLReebMap]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.isRGraph_graphPLReebQuotient
statement:
theorem isRGraph_graphPLReebQuotient :
    RGraph.IsRGraph ((ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ).obj (graphPLOver G h))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, S, hS⟩ := exists_coversVertexHeights h
  exact ⟨n, S, graphPLReebData G h S, ⟨graphPLReebQuotientIso G h hS⟩⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph {V' : Type} [Finite V']
    (G' : SimpleGraph V') (h' : V' → ℝ) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G' h') =
      interleavingDistance (intervalComponents (plHeight G h))
        (intervalComponents (plHeight G' h'))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, S, hS⟩ := exists_coversVertexHeights h
  obtain ⟨m, T, hT⟩ := exists_coversVertexHeights h'
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_congr
    (graphPLReebGraphIso G h hS) (graphPLReebGraphIso G' h' hT)]
  exact geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPL G h G' h' hS hT

name: TDA.Mapper.CoherentCoverTower.mapperMap_refl
statement:
theorem mapperMap_refl (f : C(X, Y)) (q : P) :
    T.mapperMap f (le_refl q) = VertexMap.id (T.mapperComplex f q)
proof:
:= by
  have hrefinement : T.refinement (q := q) (r := q) (le_refl q) =
      Refinement.id (T.cover q) := by
    apply Refinement.ext
    intro i
    exact congrFun (T.selector_refl q) i
  unfold mapperMap
  rw [hrefinement]
  exact TDA.Mapper.mapperMap_id f (T.cover q)

name: TDA.Mapper.CoherentCoverTower.mapperMap_trans
statement:
theorem mapperMap_trans (f : C(X, Y)) {q r t : P}
    (h : q ≤ r) (k : r ≤ t) :
    VertexMap.comp (T.mapperMap f h) (T.mapperMap f k) =
      T.mapperMap f (h.trans k)
proof:
:= by
  have hrefinement : Refinement.comp (T.refinement h) (T.refinement k) =
      T.refinement (h.trans k) := by
    apply Refinement.ext
    intro i
    exact congrFun (T.selector_trans h k) i
  change VertexMap.comp
      (TDA.Mapper.mapperMap f (T.refinement h))
      (TDA.Mapper.mapperMap f (T.refinement k)) =
    TDA.Mapper.mapperMap f (T.refinement (h.trans k))
  rw [← TDA.Mapper.mapperMap_comp, hrefinement]

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperMap_contiguous
statement:

proof:

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebStabilityExamples.point_geometricInterleavingDistance
statement:
theorem point_geometricInterleavingDistance (a b : ℝ) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph pointGraph fun _ => a)
      (graphPLReebGraph pointGraph fun _ => b) = ENNReal.ofReal |a - b|
proof:
:= by
  have hab : ENNReal.ofReal |a - b| = edist a b := by rw [edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [hab, ← edist_pi_const (β := Unit) a b]
    exact geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le_edist pointGraph _ _
  · have hdist := hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le_geometricInterleavingDistance
      (graphPLReebGraph pointGraph fun _ => a) (graphPLReebGraph pointGraph fun _ => b)
    rw [heightRange_point, heightRange_point, Metric.hausdorffEDist_singleton] at hdist
    rwa [hab]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebStabilityExamples.flat_tilted_geometricInterleavingDistance
statement:
theorem flat_tilted_geometricInterleavingDistance :
    range flat = {0} ∧ range tilted = {0, 1} ∧
      flat d₀.fst = flat d₀.snd ∧ tilted d₀.fst ≠ tilted d₀.snd ∧
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph flat)
        (graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph tilted) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, rfl, by norm_num [tilted, d₀], ?_⟩
  · exact range_const
  · ext t
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
      cases b <;> simp [tilted]
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨false, by simp [tilted]⟩
      · exact ⟨true, by simp [tilted]⟩
  · apply le_antisymm
    · rw [← edist_flat_tilted]
      exact geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le_edist edgeGraph flat tilted
    · have hne : ∀ h : Bool → ℝ, (heightRange (graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph h)).Nonempty :=
        fun h => by
          rw [heightRange_graphPLReebGraph]
          exact range_nonempty_iff_nonempty.2 ⟨vertex edgeGraph false⟩
      have hsup := ofReal_abs_sSup_sub_le_hausdorffEDist (hne flat) (hne tilted)
        (bddAbove_heightRange _) (bddAbove_heightRange _)
      rw [sSup_heightRange_flat, sSup_heightRange_tilted] at hsup
      norm_num at hsup
      exact hsup.trans (hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le_geometricInterleavingDistance _ _)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebStabilityExamples.plHeight_reversed_swap
statement:
private theorem plHeight_reversed_swap (x : Realization edgeGraph) :
    plHeight edgeGraph reversed (swapHomeomorph x) = plHeight edgeGraph tilted x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using GraphRealization.ind with
  | vertex v => exact reversed_swap v
  | edgePoint d t =>
    change (1 - (t : ℝ)) * reversed (swapEdge d.fst) + (t : ℝ) * reversed (swapEdge d.snd) =
      (1 - (t : ℝ)) * tilted d.fst + (t : ℝ) * tilted d.snd
    rw [reversed_swap, reversed_swap]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebStabilityExamples.reversal_geometricInterleavingDistance
statement:
theorem reversal_geometricInterleavingDistance :
    tilted false < tilted true ∧ reversed true < reversed false ∧ edist tilted reversed = 1 ∧
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph tilted)
        (graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph reversed) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by norm_num [tilted], by norm_num [reversed], ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply le_antisymm
    · refine edist_pi_le_iff.2 fun b => ?_
      cases b <;> norm_num [tilted, reversed, edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
    · calc (1 : ℝ≥0∞) = edist (tilted true) (reversed true) := by
            norm_num [tilted, reversed, edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
        _ ≤ edist tilted reversed := edist_le_pi_edist tilted reversed true
  · let e : graphPLOver edgeGraph tilted ≅ graphPLOver edgeGraph reversed :=
      CategoryTheory.Over.isoMk (TopCat.isoOfHomeo swapHomeomorph) (by
        ext x
        exact plHeight_reversed_swap x)
    exact geometricInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_of_iso
      (CategoryTheory.ObjectProperty.isoMk _ ((ReebQuotient.quotientFunctor ℝ).mapIso e))

name: TDA.Mapper.TowerExamples.distinct_selector_maps_are_contiguous
statement:
theorem distinct_selector_maps_are_contiguous :
    nerveMap selectFalse ≠ nerveMap selectTrue ∧
      Contiguous (nerveMap selectFalse) (nerveMap selectTrue)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have happ := congrArg
      (fun m : VertexMap (nerve selectorSource) (nerve selectorTarget) => m ()) h
    exact Bool.false_ne_true happ
  · exact nerveMap_contiguous selectFalse selectTrue

name: TDA.Mapper.TowerExamples.isolated_vertex_maps_are_not_contiguous
statement:
theorem isolated_vertex_maps_are_not_contiguous :
    ¬ Contiguous (mapToIsolated false) (mapToIsolated true)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hsource : ({()} : Finset Unit) ∈ nerve oneSource := by
    simp [mem_nerve_iff, oneSource]
  have htarget := h {()} hsource
  have hpair : ({false, true} : Finset Bool) ∈ nerve isolatedTarget := by
    simpa [mapToIsolated] using htarget
  obtain ⟨_, x, hx⟩ := (mem_nerve_iff isolatedTarget _).1 hpair
  have hfalse := hx false (by simp)
  have htrue := hx true (by simp)
  simp [isolatedTarget] at hfalse htrue
  exact Bool.false_ne_true (hfalse.symm.trans htrue)

name: TDA.Mapper.TowerExamples.three_stage_tower_composite_and_collapsing_edge
statement:
theorem three_stage_tower_composite_and_collapsing_edge :
    threeStageTower.mapperMap threeStageMap first_le_last =
        VertexMap.comp
          (threeStageTower.mapperMap threeStageMap first_le_middle)
          (threeStageTower.mapperMap threeStageMap middle_le_last) ∧
      threeStageComponentIndex .first false ≠
        threeStageComponentIndex .first true ∧
      ({threeStageComponentIndex .first false,
          threeStageComponentIndex .first true} :
          Finset (ComponentIndex threeStageMap (threeStageCover .first))) ∈
        threeStageTower.mapperComplex threeStageMap .first ∧
      (({threeStageComponentIndex .first false,
          threeStageComponentIndex .first true} :
          Finset (ComponentIndex threeStageMap (threeStageCover .first))).image
          (TDA.Mapper.mapperMap threeStageMap
            (threeStageRefinement first_le_middle))) =
        {threeStageComponentIndex .middle ()}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(threeStageTower.mapperMap_trans threeStageMap
      first_le_middle middle_le_last).symm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    exact Bool.false_ne_true (congrArg Sigma.fst h)
  · apply (mem_mapper_iff threeStageMap (threeStageCover .first) _).2
    refine ⟨by simp, (), ?_⟩
    intro a ha
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> exact ⟨Set.mem_univ (), rfl⟩
  · ext a
    constructor
    · intro ha
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hmap⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ha
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hi
      rcases hi with rfl | rfl
      · rw [firstMiddleMapperMap_apply] at hmap
        exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr hmap.symm
      · rw [firstMiddleMapperMap_apply] at hmap
        exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr hmap.symm
    · intro ha
      have ha' := Finset.mem_singleton.mp ha
      subst a
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr
        ⟨threeStageComponentIndex .first false, by simp, by
          exact firstMiddleMapperMap_apply false⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.plHeight_mem_Icc_of_vertex_bounds
proof:
:= by
  induction p using ind G with
  | vertex v => exact hh v
  | edgePoint d t =>
      have hf := hh d.fst
      have hs := hh d.snd
      have ht0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ t := t.2.1
      have ht1 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 := t.2.2
      change a ≤ (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd ∧
        (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd ≤ b
      constructor
      · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 ht1) (sub_nonneg.2 hf.1),
          mul_nonneg ht0 (sub_nonneg.2 hs.1)]
      · nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 ht1) (sub_nonneg.2 hf.2),
          mul_nonneg ht0 (sub_nonneg.2 hs.2)]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.overlappingIntervals_cover_of_bounds

  obtain ⟨hp0, hp2⟩ := plHeight_mem_Icc_of_vertex_bounds G h hh p
  by_cases hy : plHeight G h p < 3 / 2
  · refine ⟨false, ?_⟩
    change (-1 : ℝ) < plHeight G h p ∧ plHeight G h p < 3 / 2
    exact ⟨by linarith, hy⟩
  · refine ⟨true, ?_⟩
    change (1 / 2 : ℝ) < plHeight G h p ∧ plHeight G h p < 3
    constructor <;> linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.edgeCell_class_of_vertex_mem
statement:
private theorem edgeCell_class_of_vertex_mem {K : OpenInterval} (b : Bool) (hb : h02 b ∈ K)
    (x : Cell edgeGraph h02 K) :
    (cellGraph edgeGraph h02 K).connectedComponentMk x =
      (cellGraph edgeGraph h02 K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨b, hb⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let e : {e : edgeGraph.edgeSet // EdgeActive edgeGraph h02 K e} :=
    ⟨dartEdge d₀, edgeActive_of_mem (bool_mem_singleEdge b) hb⟩
  rcases x with v | e'
  · calc
      (cellGraph edgeGraph h02 K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl v) =
          (cellGraph edgeGraph h02 K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr e) :=
        connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr edgeGraph h02 K (bool_mem_singleEdge v.1)
      _ = (cellGraph edgeGraph h02 K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨b, hb⟩) :=
        (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr edgeGraph h02 K
          (bool_mem_singleEdge b)).symm
  · have he : e' = e := Subtype.ext (edgeGraph_edge_eq e'.1)
    subst e'
    exact (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr edgeGraph h02 K
      (bool_mem_singleEdge b)).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdgeCellSide_adj
proof:
:= by
  have hinc : ∀ (v : {v : Bool ⊕ Bool // twoEdgeHeight v ∈ K})
      (e : {e : twoEdgeGraph.edgeSet // EdgeActive twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight K e}),
      (v : Bool ⊕ Bool) ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 (Bool ⊕ Bool)) →
        twoEdgeCellSide K (Sum.inl v) = twoEdgeCellSide K (Sum.inr e) := by
    intro v e hve
    rcases twoEdge_edge_eq e.1 with he | he
    · rw [he] at hve
      rcases mem_dartEdge.mp hve with hv | hv
      · rcases v with ⟨v, hvK⟩
        change v = _ at hv
        subst v
        simp [twoEdgeCellSide, he, twoEdgeDart]
      · rcases v with ⟨v, hvK⟩
        change v = _ at hv
        subst v
        simp [twoEdgeCellSide, he, twoEdgeDart]
    · rw [he] at hve
      rcases mem_dartEdge.mp hve with hv | hv
      · rcases v with ⟨v, hvK⟩
        change v = _ at hv
        subst v
        change true = if e.1 = dartEdge (twoEdgeDart false) then false else true
        rw [if_neg]
        intro hEq
        exact (Ne.symm twoEdge_edges_ne) (he.symm.trans hEq)
      · rcases v with ⟨v, hvK⟩
        change v = _ at hv
        subst v
        change true = if e.1 = dartEdge (twoEdgeDart false) then false else true
        rw [if_neg]
        intro hEq
        exact (Ne.symm twoEdge_edges_ne) (he.symm.trans hEq)
  rcases x with v | e <;> rcases y with w | e'
  · exact (hxy : False).elim
  · exact hinc v e' hxy
  · exact (hinc w e hxy).symm
  · exact (hxy : False).elim

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdgeVertex_mem_dart

  · exact snd_mem_dartEdge (twoEdgeDart true)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdge_cell_classification
statement:
private theorem twoEdge_cell_classification (i : Bool)
    (c : (cellGraph twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (overlappingIntervals i)).ConnectedComponent) :
    c = (cellGraph twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (overlappingIntervals i)).connectedComponentMk
        (Sum.inl (twoEdgeVertex false i)) ∨
      c = (cellGraph twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (overlappingIntervals i)).connectedComponentMk
        (Sum.inl (twoEdgeVertex true i))
proof:
:= by
  induction c using ConnectedComponent.ind with
  | h x =>
      rcases x with ⟨v, hv⟩ | e
      · rcases v with b | b
        · left
          apply congrArg
          apply congrArg Sum.inl
          apply Subtype.ext
          cases i <;> cases b
          · rfl
          · norm_num [twoEdgeHeight, h02, overlappingIntervals, mem_ioo] at hv
          · norm_num [twoEdgeHeight, h02, overlappingIntervals, mem_ioo] at hv
          · rfl
        · right
          apply congrArg
          apply congrArg Sum.inl
          apply Subtype.ext
          cases i <;> cases b
          · rfl
          · norm_num [twoEdgeHeight, h02, overlappingIntervals, mem_ioo] at hv
          · norm_num [twoEdgeHeight, h02, overlappingIntervals, mem_ioo] at hv
          · rfl
      · rcases twoEdge_edge_eq e.1 with he | he
        · left
          exact (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight
            (overlappingIntervals i) (e := e) (by
              rw [he]
              exact twoEdgeVertex_mem_dart false i)).symm
        · right
          exact (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight
            (overlappingIntervals i) (e := e) (by
              rw [he]
              exact twoEdgeVertex_mem_dart true i)).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdge_midpoint_mem

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdge_overlap_equiv
statement:
private theorem twoEdge_overlap_equiv (side i : Bool) :
    preimageComponentsEquiv twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (overlappingIntervals i)
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk (twoEdgeOverlapPoint side i)) =
      (cellGraph twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (overlappingIntervals i)).connectedComponentMk
        (Sum.inl (twoEdgeVertex side i) :
          Cell twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (overlappingIntervals i))
proof:
:= by
  change preimageComponentsEquiv twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (overlappingIntervals i)
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint twoEdgeGraph (twoEdgeDart side) half,
        twoEdge_midpoint_mem side i⟩) = _
  calc
    _ = (cellGraph twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight
        (overlappingIntervals i)).connectedComponentMk
        (Sum.inr ⟨dartEdge (twoEdgeDart side),
          edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem (twoEdge_midpoint_mem side i)⟩) :=
      preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight
        (overlappingIntervals i) (twoEdgeDart side) half (twoEdge_midpoint_mem side i)
    _ = _ := (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight
      (overlappingIntervals i) (twoEdgeVertex_mem_dart side i)).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdge_componentIndexEquiv

private theorem twoEdge_componentIndexEquiv (side i : Bool) :
    componentIndexEquiv twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight overlappingIntervals
        (twoEdgeOverlapIndex side i) =
      ⟨i, (cellGraph twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (overlappingIntervals i)).connectedComponentMk
        (Sum.inl (twoEdgeVertex side i) :
          Cell twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (overlappingIntervals i))⟩
proof:
:= by
  refine Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq ?_)
  exact twoEdge_overlap_equiv side i

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdge_preimage_classification
statement:
private theorem twoEdge_preimage_classification (i : Bool)
    (c : ZerothHomotopy
      {p : Realization twoEdgeGraph //
        plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight p ∈ overlappingIntervals i}) :
    c = ZerothHomotopy.mk (twoEdgeOverlapPoint false i) ∨
      c = ZerothHomotopy.mk (twoEdgeOverlapPoint true i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases twoEdge_cell_classification i
      (preimageComponentsEquiv twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (overlappingIntervals i) c) with hc | hc
  · left
    apply (preimageComponentsEquiv twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight
      (overlappingIntervals i)).injective
    exact hc.trans (twoEdge_overlap_equiv false i).symm
  · right
    apply (preimageComponentsEquiv twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight
      (overlappingIntervals i)).injective
    exact hc.trans (twoEdge_overlap_equiv true i).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdgeOverlapIndex_pair_injective
statement:
private theorem twoEdgeOverlapIndex_pair_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun p : Bool × Bool => twoEdgeOverlapIndex p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨s, i⟩ ⟨t, j⟩ hst
  have hij : i = j := congrArg Sigma.fst hst
  subst j
  have hc : ZerothHomotopy.mk (twoEdgeOverlapPoint s i) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (twoEdgeOverlapPoint t i) :=
    eq_of_heq (Sigma.ext_iff.mp hst).2
  have hcell := congrArg
    (preimageComponentsEquiv twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (overlappingIntervals i)) hc
  rw [twoEdge_overlap_equiv, twoEdge_overlap_equiv] at hcell
  have hside : s = t := by
    cases s <;> cases t
    · rfl
    · exact (twoEdge_cell_anchors_ne i hcell).elim
    · exact (twoEdge_cell_anchors_ne i hcell.symm).elim
    · rfl
  exact Prod.ext hside rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdgeOverlapIndex_pair_surjective
statement:
private theorem twoEdgeOverlapIndex_pair_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (fun p : Bool × Bool => twoEdgeOverlapIndex p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨i, c⟩
  rcases twoEdge_preimage_classification i c with hc | hc
  · exact ⟨(false, i), Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq hc.symm)⟩
  · exact ⟨(true, i), Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq hc.symm)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdge_pair_face
statement:
private theorem twoEdge_pair_face (side : Bool) :
    ({twoEdgeOverlapIndex side false, twoEdgeOverlapIndex side true} :

        (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ)))) ∈

        (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ))

  refine ⟨by simp, edgePoint twoEdgeGraph (twoEdgeDart side) half, ?_⟩
  intro a ha
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha

  · exact ⟨(twoEdgeOverlapPoint side false).2, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨(twoEdgeOverlapPoint side true).2, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdge_wide_refinement_incidence
statement:
theorem twoEdge_wide_refinement_incidence (side i : Bool) :
    componentIndexEquiv twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight wideIntervals
        (mapperMap (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide
          (twoEdgeOverlapIndex side i)) =
      ⟨(), (cellGraph twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (wideIntervals ())).connectedComponentMk

          Cell twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (wideIntervals ()))⟩
proof:

      (Sum.inl ⟨(twoEdgeVertex side i).1, overlapToWide.subset i

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdge_wide_edge_components_ne

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdge_wide_same_side
statement:
private theorem twoEdge_wide_same_side (side : Bool) :
    mapperMap (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide
        (twoEdgeOverlapIndex side false) =
      mapperMap (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide
        (twoEdgeOverlapIndex side true)
proof:
:= by

      ⟨false, ZerothHomotopy.mk (twoEdgeOverlapPoint side false)⟩ by rfl,

      ⟨true, ZerothHomotopy.mk (twoEdgeOverlapPoint side true)⟩ by rfl,

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdge_wide_cross_ne
statement:
private theorem twoEdge_wide_cross_ne (i j : Bool) :
    mapperMap (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide
        (twoEdgeOverlapIndex false i) ≠
      mapperMap (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide
        (twoEdgeOverlapIndex true j)
proof:
:= by

  have hc := congrArg (componentIndexEquiv twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight wideIntervals) h
  rw [twoEdge_wide_refinement_incidence, twoEdge_wide_refinement_incidence] at hc
  exact twoEdge_wide_edge_components_ne (eq_of_heq (Sigma.ext_iff.mp hc).2)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdge_cross_componentCover_disjoint
statement:
theorem twoEdge_cross_componentCover_disjoint (i j : Bool) :
    Disjoint
      (componentCover (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight)
        (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ)) (twoEdgeOverlapIndex false i))
      (componentCover (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight)
        (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ)) (twoEdgeOverlapIndex true j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro p hp hq
  have hp' := (componentRefinement (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide).subset
    (twoEdgeOverlapIndex false i) hp
  have hq' := (componentRefinement (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide).subset
    (twoEdgeOverlapIndex true j) hq
  let a := mapperMap (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide
    (twoEdgeOverlapIndex false i)
  let b := mapperMap (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide
    (twoEdgeOverlapIndex true j)
  have hab : a.2 ≠ b.2 := by
    intro hab'
    apply twoEdge_wide_cross_ne i j
    exact Sigma.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) (heq_of_eq hab')
  exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (componentCover_disjoint
    (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) (fun _ : Unit => (wideIntervals () : Set ℝ)) hab))
      hp' hq'

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdge_mapper_two_disjoint_edges
statement:
theorem twoEdge_mapper_two_disjoint_edges :
    Nat.card (ComponentIndex (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight)
      (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ))) = 4 ∧
    (∀ side, ({twoEdgeOverlapIndex side false, twoEdgeOverlapIndex side true} :
      Finset (ComponentIndex (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight)
        (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ)))) ∈
      mapper (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight)
        (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ))) ∧
    (∀ i j, ({twoEdgeOverlapIndex false i, twoEdgeOverlapIndex true j} :
      Finset (ComponentIndex (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight)
        (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ)))) ∉
      mapper (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight)
        (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ))) ∧
    ∀ s, s ∈ mapper (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight)
      (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ)) → s.card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, twoEdge_pair_face, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      Nat.card (ComponentIndex (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight)
          (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ))) = Nat.card (Bool × Bool) :=
        Nat.card_congr twoEdgeIndexEquiv.symm
      _ = 4 := by simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_bool]
  · intro i j hs
    obtain ⟨_, p, hp⟩ := (mem_mapper_iff _ _ _).1 hs
    exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (twoEdge_cross_componentCover_disjoint i j))
      (hp _ (by simp)) (hp _ (by simp))
  · intro s hs
    exact mapper_face_card_le_of_multiplicity _ _
      (overlappingIntervals_multiplicity_two twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) hs

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdge_wide_refinement_behavior
statement:
theorem twoEdge_wide_refinement_behavior :
    ¬ Function.Injective
      (mapperMap (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide) ∧
    (∀ side,
      mapperMap (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide
          (twoEdgeOverlapIndex side false) =
        mapperMap (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide
          (twoEdgeOverlapIndex side true)) ∧
    (∀ i j,
      mapperMap (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide
          (twoEdgeOverlapIndex false i) ≠
        mapperMap (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide
          (twoEdgeOverlapIndex true j)) ∧
    ∀ side i,
      componentIndexEquiv twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight wideIntervals
          (mapperMap (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight) overlapToWide
            (twoEdgeOverlapIndex side i)) =
        ⟨(), (cellGraph twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (wideIntervals ())).connectedComponentMk
          (Sum.inr (twoEdgeWideEdge side) :
            Cell twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (wideIntervals ()))⟩
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, twoEdge_wide_same_side, twoEdge_wide_cross_ne,
    twoEdge_wide_refinement_incidence⟩
  intro hinj
  have hsource : twoEdgeOverlapIndex false false ≠ twoEdgeOverlapIndex false true :=
    componentIndex_ne_of_index_ne (plHeight twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight)
      (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ)) Bool.false_ne_true _ _
  exact hsource (hinj (twoEdge_wide_same_side false))

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapperMap_apply (f : C(X, Y)) {U : I → Set Y} {V : J → Set Y}
    (R : Refinement U V) (a : ComponentIndex f U) :
    mapperMap f R a = (componentRefinement f R).selector a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperMap_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mapperMap_mk (f : C(X, Y)) {U : I → Set Y} {V : J → Set Y}
    (R : Refinement U V) (i : I) (x : PullbackSpace f U i) :
    mapperMap f R ⟨i, ZerothHomotopy.mk x⟩ =
      ⟨R.selector i, ZerothHomotopy.mk (refinementInclusion f R i x)⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperMap_id
statement:
theorem mapperMap_id (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y) :
    mapperMap f (Refinement.id U) = VertexMap.id (mapper f U)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mapperMap
  rw [componentRefinement_id, nerveMap_id]
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperMap_comp
statement:
theorem mapperMap_comp {K : Type*} (f : C(X, Y))
    {U : I → Set Y} {V : J → Set Y} {W : K → Set Y}
    (R : Refinement U V) (S : Refinement V W) :
    mapperMap f (Refinement.comp R S) =
      VertexMap.comp (mapperMap f R) (mapperMap f S)
proof:
:= by
  unfold mapperMap
  rw [componentRefinement_comp, nerveMap_comp]
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperMap_reindex_comp
statement:
theorem mapperMap_reindex_comp (f : C(X, Y)) (e : I ≃ J) (U : J → Set Y) :
    VertexMap.comp
        (mapperMap f (reindexRefinement e U))
        (mapperMap f (reindexRefinement_symm e U)) =
      VertexMap.id (mapper f (fun i => U (e i)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapperMap_comp]
  have h : Refinement.comp (reindexRefinement e U)
      (reindexRefinement_symm e U) = Refinement.id (fun i => U (e i)) := by
    apply Refinement.ext
    intro i
    simp [reindexRefinement, reindexRefinement_symm]
  rw [h, mapperMap_id]

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperMap_reindex_symm_comp
statement:
theorem mapperMap_reindex_symm_comp (f : C(X, Y)) (e : I ≃ J) (U : J → Set Y) :
    VertexMap.comp
        (mapperMap f (reindexRefinement_symm e U))
        (mapperMap f (reindexRefinement e U)) =
      VertexMap.id (mapper f U)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapperMap_comp]
  have h : Refinement.comp (reindexRefinement_symm e U)
      (reindexRefinement e U) = Refinement.id U := by
    apply Refinement.ext
    intro j
    simp [reindexRefinement, reindexRefinement_symm]
  rw [h, mapperMap_id]

name: TDA.Reeb.GraphPL.plHeight_smul
statement:
theorem plHeight_smul {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    plHeight G (fun v => s * h v) = s • plHeight G h
proof:
:=
  (plHeight_unique G _ _ (fun v => by simp) fun d t => by
    simp only [ContinuousMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, plHeight_edgePoint, dartHeight]
    ring).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_smul
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_smul {V V' : Type}
    [Finite V] [Finite V'] (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ) (G' : SimpleGraph V') (h' : V' → ℝ)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G (fun v => s * h v))
      (graphPLReebGraph G' (fun v => s * h' v)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal |s| * geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h)
        (graphPLReebGraph G' h')
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph,
    geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph, plHeight_smul, plHeight_smul,
    interleavingDistance_intervalComponents_smul hs]
  exact congrArg (fun r : ℝ≥0∞ => r * _) (Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs s)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_neg
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_neg {V V' : Type}
    [Finite V] [Finite V'] (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ) (G' : SimpleGraph V') (h' : V' → ℝ) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G (fun v => -h v))
      (graphPLReebGraph G' (fun v => -h' v)) =
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G' h')
proof:
:= by
  simpa using geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_smul G h G' h'
    (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≠ 0)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_affine
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_affine {V V' : Type}
    [Finite V] [Finite V'] (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ) (G' : SimpleGraph V') (h' : V' → ℝ)
    {s : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (c : ℝ) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G (fun v => s * h v + c))
      (graphPLReebGraph G' (fun v => s * h' v + c)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal |s| * geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h)
        (graphPLReebGraph G' h')
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph, plHeight_add_const, plHeight_add_const,
    intervalComponents_add_const, intervalComponents_add_const, interleavingDistance_translatePre,
    ← geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph]
  exact geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_smul G h G' h' hs

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_splitY
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_splitY {a b M : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hb : b ≤ 2 * a) (hbM : b ≤ M) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (splitHeights a M))
      (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (splitHeights b M)) = ENNReal.ofReal (b - a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold splitHeights
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_neg]
  exact geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY ha hab hb hbM

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.ofReal_min_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY
statement:
theorem ofReal_min_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY {a b M : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hbM : b ≤ M) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (min (b - a) (b / 2)) ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M))
        (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights b M))
proof:
:= by
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph,
    interleavingDistance_congr (intervalComponentsIso _ _) (intervalComponentsIso _ _)]
  refine le_interleavingDistance_of_forall_exists_card_lt_symm fun ε hε => ?_
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal,
    ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by apply lt_min <;> linarith)] at hε
  obtain ⟨hεa, hεb⟩ := lt_min_iff.1 hε
  have hc : 0 < b - 2 * ε := by linarith
  have hthick (x : ℝ) : x ∈ thicken ε (ioo 0 (b - 2 * ε)) ↔ -ε < x ∧ x < b - ε := by
    rw [thicken_ioo hc, mem_ioo]
    constructor <;> rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ <;> constructor <;> linarith
  have hthick₂ (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ thicken ε (thicken ε (ioo 0 (b - 2 * ε)))) : x < b := by
    rw [thicken_ioo hc, thicken_ioo (by linarith), mem_ioo] at hx
    linarith [hx.2]
  refine ⟨ioo 0 (b - 2 * ε),
    injective_cellComponentFunctor_mergeHeights_map hc hbM _ hthick₂,
    by change Finite (cellGraph _ _ _).ConnectedComponent; infer_instance, ?_⟩
  change Nat.card (cellGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M) _).ConnectedComponent <
    Nat.card (cellGraph mergeY (mergeHeights b M) _).ConnectedComponent
  have hε₀ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ε := ε.coe_nonneg
  rw [card_cellComponents_mergeHeights_eq_one ((hthick a).2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩),
    card_cellComponents_mergeHeights_ioo hc (by linarith) hbM]
  decide

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY_bounds
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY_bounds {a b M : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 2 * a < b) (hbM : b ≤ M) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (b / 2) ≤
        geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M))
          (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights b M)) ∧
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M))
          (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights b M)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b - a)
proof:
:= by
  have hab : a < b := by linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [min_eq_right (by linarith : b / 2 ≤ b - a)] using
      ofReal_min_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY ha hab hbM
  · rw [← edist_mergeHeights hab.le]
    exact geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le_edist mergeY _ _

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.ofReal_min_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_splitY
statement:
theorem ofReal_min_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_splitY {a b M : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b) (hbM : b ≤ M) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (min (b - a) (b / 2)) ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (splitHeights a M))
        (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (splitHeights b M))
proof:
:= by
  unfold splitHeights
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_neg]
  exact ofReal_min_le_geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY ha hab hbM

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_splitY_bounds
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_splitY_bounds {a b M : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 2 * a < b) (hbM : b ≤ M) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (b / 2) ≤
        geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (splitHeights a M))
          (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (splitHeights b M)) ∧
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (splitHeights a M))
          (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (splitHeights b M)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (b - a)
