  exact geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY_bounds ha hb hbM

name: TDA.Mapper.mem_coverIntersection
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_coverIntersection (U : ι → OpenInterval) (s : CoverSimplex U) (x : ℝ) :
    x ∈ coverIntersection U s ↔ ∀ i ∈ s.val, x ∈ U i
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ ((⨅ i : s.val, toOpens (U i.val) : TopologicalSpace.Opens ℝ) : Set ℝ) ↔ _
  rw [TopologicalSpace.Opens.coe_iInf]
  simp only [Set.mem_iInter]
  exact ⟨fun h i hi => h ⟨i, hi⟩, fun h i => h i.val i.property⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.toOpens_coverIntersectionInterval
statement:
@[simp] theorem toOpens_coverIntersectionInterval (U : ι → OpenInterval) (s : CoverSimplex U) :
    toOpens (coverIntersectionInterval U s) = coverIntersection U s
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.coverIntersection_antitone
statement:
theorem coverIntersection_antitone (U : ι → OpenInterval) {s t : CoverSimplex U}
    (h : s ≤ t) : coverIntersection U t ≤ coverIntersection U s
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact (mem_coverIntersection U s x).mpr fun i hi =>
    (mem_coverIntersection U t x).mp hx i (h hi)

name: TDA.Mapper.coverIntersection_le_saturation
statement:
theorem coverIntersection_le_saturation (U : ι → OpenInterval) (I : OpenInterval)
    (s : ActiveCoverSimplex U I) : coverIntersection U s.val ≤ coverSaturation U I
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := s.val.property.1
  obtain ⟨y, hyU, hyI⟩ := s.property
  exact mem_coverSaturation.mpr ⟨i, (mem_coverIntersection U s.val x).mp hx i hi,
    y, (mem_coverIntersection U s.val y).mp hyU i hi, hyI⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.categoricalMapperCocone_map
statement:
theorem categoricalMapperCocone_map (f : C(X, ℝ)) (U : ι → OpenInterval)
    {I J : OpenInterval} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (s : ActiveCoverSimplex U I) :
    (categoricalMapperCocone f U I).ι.app s ≫ (coverComponents f U).map (homOfLE hIJ) =
      (categoricalMapperCocone f U J).ι.app ((activeCoverSimplexMap U hIJ).obj s)
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.intervalTripleIntersection_nonempty
statement:
theorem intervalTripleIntersection_nonempty (I J K : OpenInterval)
    (hIJ : ((I : Set ℝ) ∩ J).Nonempty) (hIK : ((I : Set ℝ) ∩ K).Nonempty)
    (hJK : ((J : Set ℝ) ∩ K).Nonempty) :
    ∃ x, x ∈ I ∧ x ∈ J ∧ x ∈ K
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hzI, hzJ⟩ := hIJ
  obtain ⟨x, hxI, hxK⟩ := hIK
  obtain ⟨y, hyJ, hyK⟩ := hJK
  rcases le_total x y with hxy | hyx
  · rcases le_total z x with hzx | hxz
    · exact ⟨x, hxI, J.ordConnected.out hzJ hyJ ⟨hzx, hxy⟩, hxK⟩
    · rcases le_total z y with hzy | hyz
      · exact ⟨z, hzI, hzJ, K.ordConnected.out hxK hyK ⟨hxz, hzy⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨y, I.ordConnected.out hxI hzI ⟨hxy, hyz⟩, hyJ, hyK⟩
  · rcases le_total z y with hzy | hyz
    · exact ⟨y, I.ordConnected.out hzI hxI ⟨hzy, hyx⟩, hyJ, hyK⟩
    · rcases le_total z x with hzx | hxz
      · exact ⟨z, hzI, hzJ, K.ordConnected.out hyK hxK ⟨hyz, hzx⟩⟩
      · exact ⟨x, hxI, J.ordConnected.out hyJ hzJ ⟨hyx, hxz⟩, hxK⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.coverIntersection_activeCoverSingleton
statement:
theorem coverIntersection_activeCoverSingleton (U : ι → OpenInterval) (I : OpenInterval)
    (i : ActiveCoverMember U I) :
    coverIntersection U (activeCoverSingleton U I i).val = toOpens (U i.val)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact (mem_coverIntersection U (activeCoverSingleton U I i).val x).mp hx i.val
      (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
  · intro hx
    exact (mem_coverIntersection U (activeCoverSingleton U I i).val x).mpr
      (fun j hj => (Finset.mem_singleton.mp hj) ▸ hx)

name: TDA.Mapper.categoricalMapperMemberMap_face
statement:
theorem categoricalMapperMemberMap_face (f : C(X, ℝ)) (U : ι → OpenInterval)
    (I : OpenInterval) (c : Cocone (categoricalMapperDiagram f U I))
    (s : ActiveCoverSimplex U I) (i : ActiveCoverMember U I) (hi : i.val ∈ s.val.val)
    (e : (componentFunctor f).obj (coverIntersection U s.val)) :
    categoricalMapperMemberMap f U I c i
      ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE (fun x hx =>
        (mem_coverIntersection U s.val x).mp hx i.val hi)) e) = c.ι.app s e
proof:
:= by
  let h : OrderDual.toDual s ⟶ OrderDual.toDual (activeCoverSingleton U I i) :=
    homOfLE (Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mpr hi)
  have hw := c.w_apply h e
  induction e using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x => exact hw

name: TDA.Mapper.mem_mapper_iff
statement:
theorem mem_mapper_iff (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y)
    (s : Finset (ComponentIndex f U)) :
    s ∈ mapper f U ↔
      s.Nonempty ∧ ∃ x : X, ∀ a ∈ s, x ∈ componentCover f U a
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.componentIndex_supported
statement:
theorem componentIndex_supported (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y)
    (a : ComponentIndex f U) :
    ({a} : Finset (ComponentIndex f U)) ∈ mapper f U
proof:
:=
  (mem_nerve_singleton_iff (componentCover f U) a).2
    (componentCover_nonempty f U a)

name: TDA.Mapper.eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y)
    {s : Finset (ComponentIndex f U)} (hs : s ∈ mapper f U)
    {a b : ComponentIndex f U} (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s)
    (hab : a.1 = b.1) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, x, hx⟩ := (mem_mapper_iff f U s).1 hs
  rcases a with ⟨i, c⟩
  rcases b with ⟨j, d⟩
  change i = j at hab
  subst j
  rcases hx ⟨i, c⟩ ha with ⟨hxi, hc⟩
  rcases hx ⟨i, d⟩ hb with ⟨hxi', hd⟩
  refine Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq ?_)
  exact hc.symm.trans ((componentClass_proof_irrel f U hxi hxi').trans hd)

name: TDA.Mapper.componentLabel_injOn_face
statement:
theorem componentLabel_injOn_face (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y)
    {s : Finset (ComponentIndex f U)} (hs : s ∈ mapper f U) :
    Set.InjOn Sigma.fst (s : Set (ComponentIndex f U))
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  exact eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq f U hs ha hb hab

name: TDA.Mapper.mapper_face_card_le_of_multiplicity
statement:
theorem mapper_face_card_le_of_multiplicity (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y)
    {m : ℕ} (hmult : CoverMultiplicityAtMost f U m)
    {s : Finset (ComponentIndex f U)} (hs : s ∈ mapper f U) :
    s.card ≤ m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, x, hx⟩ := (mem_mapper_iff f U s).1 hs
  let labels : Finset I := s.image Sigma.fst
  have hlabels : labels.card ≤ m := hmult (f x) ⟨x, rfl⟩ labels (by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
    exact (hx a ha).1)
  have hcard : labels.card = s.card :=
    Finset.card_image_of_injOn (componentLabel_injOn_face f U hs)
  rw [← hcard]
  exact hlabels

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperOneSkeleton_adj_iff
statement:
theorem mapperOneSkeleton_adj_iff (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y)
    (a b : MapperVertex f U) :
    (mapperOneSkeleton f U).Adj a b ↔
      a ≠ b ∧ ({a.1, b.1} : Finset (ComponentIndex f U)) ∈ mapper f U
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.mem_mapper_iff_supported_singleton_or_adjacent_pair
statement:
theorem mem_mapper_iff_supported_singleton_or_adjacent_pair
    (f : C(X, Y)) (U : I → Set Y)
    (hmult : CoverMultiplicityAtMost f U 2)
    (s : Finset (ComponentIndex f U)) :
    s ∈ mapper f U ↔
      (∃ a : MapperVertex f U, s = {a.1}) ∨
        ∃ a b : MapperVertex f U,
          (mapperOneSkeleton f U).Adj a b ∧ s = {a.1, b.1}
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    have hcard := mapper_face_card_le_of_multiplicity f U hmult hs
    have hpos : 0 < s.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ((mem_mapper_iff f U s).1 hs).1
    have hcases : s.card = 1 ∨ s.card = 2 := by omega
    rcases hcases with hcard_one | hcard_two
    · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.mp hcard_one
      exact Or.inl ⟨toMapperVertex f U a, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.mp hcard_two
      let va := toMapperVertex f U a
      let vb := toMapperVertex f U b
      refine Or.inr ⟨va, vb, ?_, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨fun hv => hab (congrArg Subtype.val hv), hs⟩
  · rintro (⟨a, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩)
    · exact a.2
    · exact hab.2

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyInterleavingExamples.mapperHomologyInterleaving_zero_toIso
statement:
theorem mapperHomologyInterleaving_zero_toIso {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] (R : Type c) [Ring R] (f : C(X, Y)) {Index : ℝ → Type w}
    {U : (t : ℝ) → Index t → Set Y} [∀ t, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f (U t))]
    (rU : ∀ {s t : ℝ}, s ≤ t → Refinement (U s) (U t)) (n : ℕ) :
    (mapperHomologyInterleaving R f rU rU (η := 0)
        (fun t => rU (by simp)) (fun t => rU (by simp)) n).toIso = Iso.refl _
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  exact (mapperHomologyMap_comp_eq R f _ _ (Refinement.id (U t)) n).trans
    (mapperHomologyMap_id R f n)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyInterleavingExamples.duplicatedTower_interleaving
statement:
theorem duplicatedTower_interleaving (η : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (Refinement.comp (selectFirst t (t + η))
        (duplicatedRefinement (s := t + η) (t := t + η + η)
          (le_add_of_nonneg_right (NNReal.coe_nonneg η)))).selector ≠
      (duplicatedRefinement (s := t) (t := t + η + η) (by linarith [NNReal.coe_nonneg η])).selector ∧
    Nonempty (RealInterleaving η
      (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ threeStageMap duplicatedTower duplicatedRefinement n)
      (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ threeStageMap duplicatedTower duplicatedRefinement n))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => Bool.false_ne_true (congrFun h true), ⟨?_⟩⟩
  exact mapperHomologyInterleaving ℚ threeStageMap duplicatedRefinement duplicatedRefinement
    (fun t => selectFirst t (t + η)) (fun _ => duplicatedRefinement (le_add_of_nonneg_right
      (NNReal.coe_nonneg η))) n

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyInterleavingExamples.centredCover_shift_interleaving
statement:
theorem centredCover_shift_interleaving {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (R : Type c) [Ring R]
    (f : C(X, ℝ)) (s : ℝ) [∀ t, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f (centredCover s t))]
    (η : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (RealInterleaving η
      (mapperHomologyPModule R f (centredCover s) (centredCoverRefinement s) n)
      (mapperHomologyPModule R f (fun t => centredCover s (t + η))
        (fun h => centredCoverRefinement s (add_le_add h le_rfl)) n)) ∧
    ∀ t ≤ 0, ∀ m, IsEmpty (Face (mapper f (centredCover s t)) m)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨mapperHomologyInterleaving R f (centredCoverRefinement s)
    (fun h => centredCoverRefinement s (add_le_add h le_rfl))
    (fun t => centredCoverRefinement s (by linarith [NNReal.coe_nonneg η]))
    (fun t => centredCoverRefinement s le_rfl) n⟩, ?_⟩
  intro t ht m
  refine ⟨fun F => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨a, _⟩, x, hx⟩ := (mem_mapper_iff f (centredCover s t) F.1).1 F.2.1
  obtain ⟨hxa, _⟩ := hx a ‹_›
  rw [centredCover_eq_empty ht] at hxa
  exact hxa

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyInterleavingExamples.scaleMap_zerothHomotopy_subsingleton
statement:
theorem scaleMap_zerothHomotopy_subsingleton (c s t : ℝ) (k : ℤ) :
    Subsingleton (ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace (scaleMap c) (centredCover s t) k))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro p q
  induction p using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk p =>
  induction q using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk q =>
  let T : Set ℝ := Set.Icc 0 1 ∩ (LinearMap.mulLeft ℝ c) ⁻¹' centredCover s t k
  have hT : Convex ℝ T := (convex_Icc 0 1).inter ((convex_Ioo _ _).linear_preimage _)
  have hp : (p.1 : ℝ) ∈ T := ⟨p.1.2, p.2⟩
  have hq : (q.1 : ℝ) ∈ T := ⟨q.1.2, q.2⟩
  have hj := ((hT.isPathConnected ⟨_, hp⟩).joinedIn _ hp _ hq).map
    (continuous_projIcc (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) (h := zero_le_one))
  rw [Set.projIcc_val, Set.projIcc_val] at hj
  refine mk_eq_of_joinedIn (scaleMap c) (centredCover s t k) (hj.mono ?_) p.2 q.2
  rintro _ ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
  change c * (Set.projIcc 0 1 zero_le_one r : ℝ) ∈ centredCover s t k
  rw [Set.projIcc_of_mem _ hr.1]
  exact hr.2

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyInterleavingExamples.centredCover_half_no_edges
statement:
theorem centredCover_half_no_edges {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : C(X, ℝ))
    [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f (centredCover 1 (1 / 2)))] :
    IsEmpty (Face (mapper f (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun F => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hF⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.1 F.2.2
  have hface := F.2.1
  rw [hF] at hface
  obtain ⟨_, x, hx⟩ := (mem_mapper_iff f _ _).1 hface
  obtain ⟨ha, _⟩ := hx a (by simp)
  obtain ⟨hb, _⟩ := hx b (by simp)
  rw [mem_centredCover_iff] at ha hb
  have hlt : |((a.1 : ℝ) - b.1)| < 1 := by
    have := abs_sub_le (a.1 : ℝ) (f x) (b.1)
    rw [abs_sub_comm (a.1 : ℝ) (f x)] at this
    simp only [mul_one] at ha hb
    linarith
  have hkey : a.1 = b.1 := by
    rw [abs_lt] at hlt
    have h₁ : a.1 - b.1 < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hlt.2
    have h₂ : -1 < a.1 - b.1 := by exact_mod_cast hlt.1
    omega
  exact hab (eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq f _ hface (by simp) (by simp) hkey)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyInterleavingExamples.vertexFace_bijective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro a b h
    exact Finset.singleton_injective (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  · intro F
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.1 F.2.2
    exact ⟨a, Subtype.ext ha.symm⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyInterleavingExamples.finrank_scaleMap_centredCover_half
statement:
theorem finrank_scaleMap_centredCover_half (c : ℝ) (S : Finset ℤ)
    (hS : ∀ k, k ∈ S ↔ ∃ x : I, c * (x : ℝ) ∈ centredCover 1 (1 / 2) k) :
    Module.finrank ℚ
        (simplicialHomology (mapper (scaleMap c) (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) ℚ 0) = S.card
proof:
:= by
  have hbij : Function.Bijective (fun a : ComponentIndex (scaleMap c) (centredCover 1 (1 / 2)) =>
      (⟨a.1, (hS a.1).2 (by
        induction a.2 using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
        | mk x => exact ⟨x.1, x.2⟩)⟩ : S)) := by
    constructor
    · intro a b h
      have := scaleMap_zerothHomotopy_subsingleton c 1 (1 / 2)
      have h' : a.1 = b.1 := congrArg Subtype.val h
      exact Sigma.ext h' (Subsingleton.helim (congrArg (fun k =>
        ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace (scaleMap c) (centredCover 1 (1 / 2)) k)) h') a.2 b.2)
    · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hS k).1 hk
      exact ⟨⟨k, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x, hx⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  let e : Face (mapper (scaleMap c) (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) 0 ≃ S :=
    (Equiv.ofBijective _ (vertexFace_bijective _ _)).symm.trans (Equiv.ofBijective _ hbij)
  have := centredCover_half_no_edges (scaleMap c)
  let _ : Fintype (Face (mapper (scaleMap c) (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) 0) := Fintype.ofEquiv S e.symm
  rw [finrank_zeroHomology_of_no_edges, Fintype.card_congr e, Fintype.card_coe]

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyInterleavingExamples.mem_centredCover_half_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_centredCover_half_iff (y : ℝ) (k : ℤ) :
    y ∈ centredCover 1 (1 / 2) k ↔ (k : ℝ) - 1 / 2 < y ∧ y < k + 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [centredCover]

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyInterleavingExamples.flat_steep_dist
statement: theorem flat_steep_dist (x : I) : |flatMap x - steepMap x| ≤ ((4 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  change |0 * (x : ℝ) - 4 * x| ≤ 4
  rw [zero_mul, zero_sub, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith [x.2.1])]
  linarith [x.2.2]

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyInterleavingExamples.flat_steep_perturbation
statement:
theorem flat_steep_perturbation :
    Module.finrank ℚ ((mapperHomologyPModule ℚ flatMap (centredCover 1)
        (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0).obj (1 / 2)) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank ℚ ((mapperHomologyPModule ℚ steepMap (centredCover 1)
        (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0).obj (1 / 2)) = 5 ∧
    IsEmpty (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ flatMap (centredCover 1) (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0 ≅
      mapperHomologyPModule ℚ steepMap (centredCover 1) (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0) ∧
    realInterleavingDistance
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ flatMap (centredCover 1) (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0)
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ steepMap (centredCover 1) (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0) ≤
      (4 : ℝ≥0)
proof:
:= by
  have hflat : Module.finrank ℚ ((mapperHomologyPModule ℚ flatMap (centredCover 1)
      (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0).obj (1 / 2)) = 1 := by
    refine (finrank_scaleMap_centredCover_half 0 {0} fun k => ?_).trans (by simp)
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton, zero_mul, mem_centredCover_half_iff, exists_const]
    constructor
    · rintro rfl
      norm_num
    · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
      have h₁' : (k : ℝ) < 1 := by linarith
      have h₂' : (-1 : ℝ) < k := by linarith
      have : k < 1 := by exact_mod_cast h₁'
      have : -1 < k := by exact_mod_cast h₂'
      omega
  have hsteep : Module.finrank ℚ ((mapperHomologyPModule ℚ steepMap (centredCover 1)
      (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0).obj (1 / 2)) = 5 := by
    refine (finrank_scaleMap_centredCover_half 4 (Finset.Icc 0 4) fun k => ?_).trans (by rfl)
    simp only [Finset.mem_Icc, mem_centredCover_half_iff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h₀, h₄⟩
      have h₀' : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast h₀
      have h₄' : (k : ℝ) ≤ 4 := by exact_mod_cast h₄
      refine ⟨⟨(k : ℝ) / 4, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩, ?_⟩
      constructor <;> simp only [] <;> linarith
    · rintro ⟨x, h₁, h₂⟩
      have hx₀ := x.2.1
      have hx₁ := x.2.2
      have h₁' : (k : ℝ) < 5 := by linarith
      have h₂' : (-1 : ℝ) < k := by linarith
      have : k < 5 := by exact_mod_cast h₁'
      have : -1 < k := by exact_mod_cast h₂'
      omega
  refine ⟨hflat, hsteep, ⟨fun e => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · have h := (e.app (1 / 2)).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq
    rw [hflat, hsteep] at h
    exact absurd h (by norm_num)
  · exact realInterleavingDistance_centredMapperHomology_le ℚ 1 flat_steep_dist 0

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyInterleavingExamples.pullback_id_mapperHomologyPModule
statement:
theorem pullback_id_mapperHomologyPModule {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] (R : Type c)
    [Ring R] {Index : ℝ → Type w} (U : (t : ℝ) → Index t → Set X)
    [hU : ∀ t, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex (ContinuousMap.id X) (U t))]
    (rU : ∀ {s t : ℝ}, s ≤ t → Refinement (U s) (U t)) (n : ℕ) :
    (fun t => pullback (ContinuousMap.id X) (U t)) = U ∧
    mapperHomologyPModule R (ContinuousMap.id X) U rU n =
      @mapperHomologyPModule X X ℝ _ _ _ R _ (ContinuousMap.id X) Index
        (fun t => pullback (ContinuousMap.id X) (U t)) hU
        (fun h => pullbackRefinement (ContinuousMap.id X) (rU h)) n
proof:
:=
  ⟨rfl, mapperHomologyPModule_pullback R (ContinuousMap.id X) U rU n⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyInterleavingExamples.refinement_homology_control
statement:
theorem refinement_homology_control :
    (∀ r r' : Refinement selectorSource selectorTarget,
      Contiguous (TDA.Mapper.mapperMap threeStageMap r) (TDA.Mapper.mapperMap threeStageMap r') ∧
        mapperHomologyMap ℚ threeStageMap r 0 = mapperHomologyMap ℚ threeStageMap r' 0) ∧
    ¬ Contiguous (mapToIsolated false) (mapToIsolated true) ∧
    simplicialHomologyMap (ZMod 2) (mapToIsolated false) 0 ≠
      simplicialHomologyMap (ZMod 2) (mapToIsolated true) 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun r r' => ⟨mapperMap_contiguous threeStageMap r r',
    mapperHomologyMap_eq ℚ threeStageMap r r' 0⟩, isolated_vertex_maps_homology_ne⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.barycentric_vertex
statement: theorem barycentric_vertex (v : V) : barycentric G (vertex G v) = Pi.single v 1
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.barycentric_edgePoint
statement:
theorem barycentric_edgePoint (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval) :
    barycentric G (edgePoint G d t) =
      (1 - (t : ℝ)) • Pi.single d.fst 1 + (t : ℝ) • Pi.single d.snd 1
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.barycentric_edge_coord_pos
statement:
private theorem barycentric_edge_coord_pos {d : G.Dart} {t : unitInterval} {i : V}
    (_ht₀ : 0 < (t : ℝ)) (_ht₁ : (t : ℝ) < 1)
    (hi : 0 < barycentric G (edgePoint G d t) i) :
    i = d.fst ∨ i = d.snd
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hfst : i ≠ d.fst := fun h => hn (Or.inl h)
  have hsnd : i ≠ d.snd := fun h => hn (Or.inr h)
  simp [barycentric_edgePoint, hfst, hsnd] at hi

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.barycentric_edge_eq_vertex
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hfv : d.fst = v
  · left
    refine ⟨?_, hfv⟩
    have hs := congr_fun h d.snd
    have hne : v ≠ d.snd := by
      intro hv
      exact d.fst_ne_snd (hfv.trans hv)
    have : (t : ℝ) = 0 := by
      simpa [barycentric_edgePoint, barycentric_vertex, Pi.single_apply, hne, eq_comm] using hs
    exact Subtype.ext (by rw [Set.Icc.coe_zero]; exact this)
  · by_cases hsv : d.snd = v
    · right
      refine ⟨?_, hsv⟩
      have hs := congr_fun h d.fst
      have hne : v ≠ d.fst := Ne.symm hfv
      have : 1 - (t : ℝ) = 0 := by
        simpa [barycentric_edgePoint, barycentric_vertex, Pi.single_apply, hfv, hne, eq_comm,
          d.fst_ne_snd] using hs
      exact Subtype.ext (by rw [Set.Icc.coe_one]; linarith only [this])
    · have hs₀ := congr_fun h d.fst
      have hs₁ := congr_fun h d.snd
      have ht₀ : (t : ℝ) = 0 := by
        simpa [barycentric_edgePoint, barycentric_vertex, Pi.single_apply, hfv, hsv, eq_comm,
          d.fst_ne_snd] using hs₁
      have ht₁ : (t : ℝ) = 1 := by
        have hs₀' : (0 : ℝ) = 1 - (t : ℝ) := by
          simpa [barycentric_edgePoint, barycentric_vertex, Pi.single_apply, hfv, hsv, eq_comm,
            d.snd_ne_fst] using hs₀
        linarith only [hs₀']
      linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mem_dart_edge
statement: private theorem mem_dart_edge {d : G.Dart} {v : V} : v ∈ d.edge ↔ v = d.fst ∨ v = d.snd
proof:
:=
  Sym2.mem_iff

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.barycentric_edge_eq_edgePoint
statement:
private theorem barycentric_edge_eq_edgePoint {d d' : G.Dart} {t t' : unitInterval}
    (ht₀ : t ≠ 0) (ht₁ : t ≠ 1) (ht₀' : t' ≠ 0) (ht₁' : t' ≠ 1)
    (h : barycentric G (edgePoint G d t) = barycentric G (edgePoint G d' t')) :
    (d' = d ∧ t' = t) ∨ (d' = d.symm ∧ t' = unitInterval.symm t)
proof:
:= by
  have htpos : 0 < (t : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.1 (Ne.symm (unitInterval.coe_ne_zero.mpr ht₀))
  have htlt : (t : ℝ) < 1 :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne t.2.2 (unitInterval.coe_ne_one.mpr ht₁)
  have htpos' : 0 < (t' : ℝ) :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne t'.2.1 (Ne.symm (unitInterval.coe_ne_zero.mpr ht₀'))
  have htlt' : (t' : ℝ) < 1 :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne t'.2.2 (unitInterval.coe_ne_one.mpr ht₁')
  have hedge : d.edge = d'.edge := by
    apply Sym2.ext
    intro i
    constructor
    · intro hi
      have hpos : 0 < barycentric G (edgePoint G d t) i := by
        rcases (mem_dart_edge G).mp hi with rfl | rfl
        · have hc : barycentric G (edgePoint G d t) d.fst = 1 - (t : ℝ) := by
            simp [barycentric_edgePoint, d.fst_ne_snd]
          rw [hc]
          linarith
        · have hc : barycentric G (edgePoint G d t) d.snd = (t : ℝ) := by
            simp [barycentric_edgePoint, eq_comm]
          rw [hc]
          exact htpos
      have hpos' : 0 < barycentric G (edgePoint G d' t') i := by
        rw [← congr_fun h i]
        exact hpos
      exact (mem_dart_edge G).mpr (barycentric_edge_coord_pos G htpos' htlt' hpos')
    · intro hi
      have hpos : 0 < barycentric G (edgePoint G d' t') i := by
        rcases (mem_dart_edge G).mp hi with rfl | rfl
        · have hc : barycentric G (edgePoint G d' t') d'.fst = 1 - (t' : ℝ) := by
            simp [barycentric_edgePoint, d'.fst_ne_snd]
          rw [hc]
          linarith
        · have hc : barycentric G (edgePoint G d' t') d'.snd = (t' : ℝ) := by
            simp [barycentric_edgePoint, eq_comm]
          rw [hc]
          exact htpos'
      have hpos' : 0 < barycentric G (edgePoint G d t) i := by
        rw [congr_fun h i]
        exact hpos
      exact (mem_dart_edge G).mpr (barycentric_edge_coord_pos G htpos htlt hpos')
  rcases (dart_edge_eq_iff d d').mp hedge with hd | hd
  · left
    refine ⟨hd.symm, ?_⟩
    have hs := congr_fun h d.snd
    have heq : (t : ℝ) = (t' : ℝ) := by
      subst d'
      simpa [barycentric_edgePoint, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm, d.snd_ne_fst] using hs
    exact Subtype.ext heq.symm
  · right
    have hd' : d' = d.symm := by
      apply Dart.ext
      exact congrArg Prod.swap (congrArg Dart.toProd hd.symm)
    refine ⟨hd', ?_⟩
    have hs := congr_fun h d.snd
    have hs' : (t : ℝ) = 1 - (t' : ℝ) := by
      simpa [barycentric_edgePoint, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm, d.snd_ne_fst,
        d'.fst_ne_snd, hd] using hs
    have heq : (t' : ℝ) = 1 - (t : ℝ) := by linarith
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [unitInterval.coe_symm_eq]
    exact heq

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.barycentric_injective
statement: theorem barycentric_injective : Function.Injective (barycentric G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x
  refine ind G (p := fun x => ∀ y, barycentric G x = barycentric G y → x = y) ?_ ?_ x
  · intro v y
    refine ind G (p := fun y => barycentric G (vertex G v) = barycentric G y →
      vertex G v = y) ?_ ?_ y
    · intro w h
      by_contra hvw
      have hv := congr_fun h v
      simp [barycentric_vertex, Pi.single_apply, eq_comm] at hv
      exact hvw (congrArg (vertex G) hv)
    · intro d t h
      have h' := barycentric_edge_eq_vertex G h.symm
      rcases h' with ⟨ht, hd⟩ | ⟨ht, hd⟩
      · rw [ht, edgePoint_zero]
        exact congrArg (vertex G) hd.symm
      · rw [ht, edgePoint_one]
        exact congrArg (vertex G) hd.symm
  · intro d t y
    refine ind G (p := fun y => barycentric G (edgePoint G d t) = barycentric G y →
      edgePoint G d t = y) ?_ ?_ y
    · intro v h
      rcases barycentric_edge_eq_vertex G h with ⟨ht, hd⟩ | ⟨ht, hd⟩
      · rw [ht, edgePoint_zero]
        exact congrArg (vertex G) hd
      · rw [ht, edgePoint_one]
        exact congrArg (vertex G) hd
    · intro d' t' h
      by_cases ht₀ : t = 0
      · rw [ht₀, edgePoint_zero]
        have h' := barycentric_edge_eq_vertex G (by
          simpa [ht₀, edgePoint_zero] using h.symm)
        rcases h' with ⟨ht', hd'⟩ | ⟨ht', hd'⟩
        · rw [ht', edgePoint_zero]
          exact congrArg (vertex G) hd'.symm
        · rw [ht', edgePoint_one]
          exact congrArg (vertex G) hd'.symm
      · by_cases ht₁ : t = 1
        · rw [ht₁, edgePoint_one]
          have h' := barycentric_edge_eq_vertex G (by
            simpa [ht₁, edgePoint_one] using h.symm)
          rcases h' with ⟨ht', hd'⟩ | ⟨ht', hd'⟩
          · rw [ht', edgePoint_zero]
            exact congrArg (vertex G) hd'.symm
          · rw [ht', edgePoint_one]
            exact congrArg (vertex G) hd'.symm
        · by_cases ht₀' : t' = 0
          · rw [ht₀', edgePoint_zero]
            have h' := barycentric_edge_eq_vertex G (by
              simpa [ht₀', edgePoint_zero] using h)
            rcases h' with ⟨ht', hd'⟩ | ⟨ht', hd'⟩
            · rw [ht', edgePoint_zero]
              exact congrArg (vertex G) hd'
            · rw [ht', edgePoint_one]
              exact congrArg (vertex G) hd'
          · by_cases ht₁' : t' = 1
            · rw [ht₁', edgePoint_one]
              have h' := barycentric_edge_eq_vertex G (by
                simpa [ht₁', edgePoint_one] using h)
              rcases h' with ⟨ht', hd'⟩ | ⟨ht', hd'⟩
              · rw [ht', edgePoint_zero]
                exact congrArg (vertex G) hd'
              · rw [ht', edgePoint_one]
                exact congrArg (vertex G) hd'
            · rcases barycentric_edge_eq_edgePoint G ht₀ ht₁ ht₀' ht₁' h with
                ⟨hd, ht⟩ | ⟨hd, ht⟩
              · rw [hd, ht]
              · rw [hd, ht, edgePoint_symm]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.t2Space_realization
statement: theorem t2Space_realization : T2Space (Realization G)
proof:
:=
  T2Space.of_injective_continuous (barycentric_injective G) (barycentric G).continuous

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edgePoint_eq_vertex_iff
statement:
theorem edgePoint_eq_vertex_iff {d : G.Dart} {t : unitInterval} {v : V} :
    edgePoint G d t = vertex G v ↔ (t = 0 ∧ d.fst = v) ∨ (t = 1 ∧ d.snd = v)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact barycentric_edge_eq_vertex G (congrArg (barycentric G) h)
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact edgePoint_zero G d
    · exact edgePoint_one G d

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edgePoint_eq_edgePoint_iff
statement:
theorem edgePoint_eq_edgePoint_iff {d d' : G.Dart} {t t' : unitInterval}
    (ht₀ : t ≠ 0) (ht₁ : t ≠ 1) :
    edgePoint G d t = edgePoint G d' t' ↔
      (d' = d ∧ t' = t) ∨ (d' = d.symm ∧ t' = unitInterval.symm t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have ht₀' : t' ≠ 0 := by
      intro ht'
      subst t'
      have hv := (edgePoint_eq_vertex_iff G).mp (h.trans (edgePoint_zero G d'))
      rcases hv with ⟨ht, _⟩ | ⟨ht, _⟩
      · exact ht₀ ht
      · exact ht₁ ht
    have ht₁' : t' ≠ 1 := by
      intro ht'
      subst t'
      have hv := (edgePoint_eq_vertex_iff G).mp (h.trans (edgePoint_one G d'))
      rcases hv with ⟨ht, _⟩ | ⟨ht, _⟩
      · exact ht₀ ht
      · exact ht₁ ht
    have h' := barycentric_edge_eq_edgePoint G ht₀ ht₁
      ht₀' ht₁'
      (congrArg (barycentric G) h)
    exact h'
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    · rfl
    · exact (edgePoint_symm G d t).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.locallyPathConnectedSpace_unitInterval
statement:
private theorem locallyPathConnectedSpace_unitInterval :
    LocallyPathConnectedSpace unitInterval
proof:
:= by
  refine LocallyPathConnectedSpace.of_bases (p := fun _ (ε : ℝ) => 0 < ε)
    (s := fun x ε => ((↑) : unitInterval → ℝ) ⁻¹' Ioo ((x : ℝ) - ε) (x + ε)) (fun x => ?_)
    fun x ε hε => ?_
  · rw [nhds_subtype]
    exact (nhds_basis_Ioo_pos (x : ℝ)).comap _
  · have hW : IsPathConnected (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ Ioo ((x : ℝ) - ε) (x + ε)) :=
      ((convex_Icc (𝕜 := ℝ) _ _).inter (convex_Ioo _ _)).isPathConnected
        ⟨(x : ℝ), x.2, by constructor <;> linarith⟩
    have := hW.preimage_coe (U := Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) inter_subset_left
    rwa [Subtype.preimage_coe_self_inter] at this

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.locallyPathConnectedSpace_realization
statement:
theorem locallyPathConnectedSpace_realization :
    LocallyPathConnectedSpace (Realization G)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : TopologicalSpace V := ⊥
  let _ : DiscreteTopology V := ⟨rfl⟩
  let _ : LocallyPathConnectedSpace unitInterval := locallyPathConnectedSpace_unitInterval
  let _ : LocallyPathConnectedSpace (Cells G) := by
    change LocallyPathConnectedSpace (V ⊕ Σ _ : G.Dart, unitInterval)
    infer_instance
  change LocallyPathConnectedSpace (Quot (CellRel G))
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.realizationMap_injective
statement:
theorem realizationMap_injective {W : Type v} {H : SimpleGraph W} (φ : G ↪g H) :
    Function.Injective (realizationMap φ.toHom)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmapDart : Function.Injective (φ.toHom.mapDart) := by
    intro d d' h
    apply Dart.ext
    have hp : (φ d.fst, φ d.snd) = (φ d'.fst, φ d'.snd) := by
      have hp := congrArg Dart.toProd h
      change (φ d.fst, φ d.snd) = (φ d'.fst, φ d'.snd) at hp
      exact hp
    exact Prod.ext (φ.injective (congrArg Prod.fst hp))
      (φ.injective (congrArg Prod.snd hp))
  have hsymm (d : G.Dart) :
      (φ.toHom.mapDart d).symm = φ.toHom.mapDart d.symm := by
    apply Dart.ext
    rfl
  have hVE {v : V} {d : G.Dart} {t : unitInterval}
      (h : realizationMap φ.toHom (vertex G v) =
        realizationMap φ.toHom (edgePoint G d t)) :
      vertex G v = edgePoint G d t := by
    have h' := (edgePoint_eq_vertex_iff H).mp h.symm
    rcases h' with ⟨ht, hd⟩ | ⟨ht, hd⟩
    · have ht' : t = 0 := ht
      rw [ht', edgePoint_zero]
      have hd' : φ d.fst = φ v := by
        simpa [SimpleGraph.Hom.mapDart_apply] using hd
      exact congrArg (vertex G) (φ.injective hd').symm
    · have ht' : t = 1 := ht
      rw [ht', edgePoint_one]
      have hd' : φ d.snd = φ v := by
        simpa [SimpleGraph.Hom.mapDart_apply] using hd
      exact congrArg (vertex G) (φ.injective hd').symm
  have hEV {v : V} {d : G.Dart} {t : unitInterval}
      (h : realizationMap φ.toHom (edgePoint G d t) =
        realizationMap φ.toHom (vertex G v)) :
      edgePoint G d t = vertex G v := by
    have h' := (edgePoint_eq_vertex_iff H).mp h
    rcases h' with ⟨ht, hd⟩ | ⟨ht, hd⟩
    · have ht' : t = 0 := ht
      rw [ht', edgePoint_zero]
      have hd' : φ d.fst = φ v := by
        simpa [SimpleGraph.Hom.mapDart_apply] using hd
      exact congrArg (vertex G) (φ.injective hd')
    · have ht' : t = 1 := ht
      rw [ht', edgePoint_one]
      have hd' : φ d.snd = φ v := by
        simpa [SimpleGraph.Hom.mapDart_apply] using hd
      exact congrArg (vertex G) (φ.injective hd')
  intro x
  refine ind G (p := fun x => ∀ y, realizationMap φ.toHom x = realizationMap φ.toHom y →
    x = y) ?_ ?_ x
  · intro v y
    refine ind G (p := fun y => realizationMap φ.toHom (vertex G v) =
      realizationMap φ.toHom y → vertex G v = y) ?_ ?_ y
    · intro w h
      exact congrArg (vertex G) (φ.injective (vertex_injective H (by simpa using h)))
    · intro d t h
      exact hVE h
  · intro d t y
    refine ind G (p := fun y => realizationMap φ.toHom (edgePoint G d t) =
      realizationMap φ.toHom y → edgePoint G d t = y) ?_ ?_ y
    · intro v h
      exact hEV h
    · intro d' t' h
      by_cases ht₀ : t = 0
      · rw [ht₀, edgePoint_zero]
        apply hVE
        simpa [ht₀, realizationMap_edgePoint, realizationMap_vertex, edgePoint_zero] using h
      · by_cases ht₁ : t = 1
        · rw [ht₁, edgePoint_one]
          apply hVE
          simpa [ht₁, realizationMap_edgePoint, realizationMap_vertex, edgePoint_one] using h
        · by_cases ht₀' : t' = 0
          · rw [ht₀', edgePoint_zero]
            apply hEV
            simpa [ht₀', realizationMap_edgePoint, realizationMap_vertex, edgePoint_zero] using h
          · by_cases ht₁' : t' = 1
            · rw [ht₁', edgePoint_one]
              apply hEV
              simpa [ht₁', realizationMap_edgePoint, realizationMap_vertex, edgePoint_one] using h
            · have h' := (edgePoint_eq_edgePoint_iff H ht₀ ht₁).mp h
              rcases h' with ⟨hd, ht⟩ | ⟨hd, ht⟩
              · have hd' : d' = d := hmapDart hd
                have ht' : t' = t := ht
                rw [hd', ht']
              · have hdmap : φ.toHom.mapDart d' = φ.toHom.mapDart d.symm :=
                  hd.trans (hsymm d)
                have hd' : d' = d.symm := hmapDart hdmap
                have ht' : t' = unitInterval.symm t := ht
                rw [hd', ht']
                exact (edgePoint_symm G d t).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.compactSpace_realization
statement: theorem compactSpace_realization : CompactSpace (Realization G)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ : TopologicalSpace V := ⊥
  let _ : Fintype V := Fintype.ofFinite V
  let _ : DecidableRel G.Adj := Classical.decRel G.Adj
  let _ : Fintype G.Dart := SimpleGraph.Dart.fintype
  let _ : CompactSpace V := @Finite.compactSpace V ⊥ inferInstance
  let _ : CompactSpace (Σ _ : G.Dart, unitInterval) := by
    constructor
    rw [Sigma.univ]
    exact isCompact_iUnion fun d => isCompact_range continuous_sigmaMk
  let _ : CompactSpace (Cells G) := by
    constructor
    change IsCompact (Set.univ : Set (V ⊕ Σ _ : G.Dart, unitInterval))
    rw [← range_inl_union_range_inr]
    exact (isCompact_range continuous_inl).union (isCompact_range continuous_inr)
  exact Quot.compactSpace

    Subsingleton (ReebQuotient (plHeight edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  have hsub :
      Subsingleton
        ((CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData
          (graphPLReebData edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) S0)).V 0) :=
    (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.1 flatEdge_count).1
  have hrealization : Subsingleton
      ((CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData
        (graphPLReebData edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) S0)).Realization S0) := by
    constructor
    intro x y
    rcases (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData
      (graphPLReebData edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) S0)).exists_rep S0 x with
      ⟨i, v, hx⟩ | ⟨e, p, hx⟩
    · rcases (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData
        (graphPLReebData edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) S0)).exists_rep S0 y with
        ⟨j, w, hy⟩ | ⟨e, p, hy⟩
      · have hi : i = 0 := Fin.eq_zero i
        have hj : j = 0 := Fin.eq_zero j
        subst i
        subst j
        rw [hx, hy, @Subsingleton.elim _ hsub v w]
      · exact e.elim0
    · exact e.elim0
  haveI : Subsingleton
      ((CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData
        (graphPLReebData edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) S0)).Realization S0) := hrealization

private theorem mapperHomologyMap_comp₃_eq {I J K L : Type w} {A : I → Set Y} {B : J → Set Y}
    {C : K → Set Y} {D : L → Set Y} [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f A)]
    [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f B)] [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f C)]
    [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f D)] (a : Refinement A B) (b : Refinement B C)
    (c : Refinement C D) (d : Refinement A D) (n : ℕ) :
    mapperHomologyMap R f a n ≫ mapperHomologyMap R f b n ≫ mapperHomologyMap R f c n =
      mapperHomologyMap R f d n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapperHomologyMap_comp_eq R f b c (b.comp c), mapperHomologyMap_comp_eq R f a _ d]

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperHomologyShiftMap_comp
statement:
private theorem mapperHomologyShiftMap_comp
    (rU : ∀ {s t : ℝ}, s ≤ t → Refinement (U s) (U t))
    (rV : ∀ {s t : ℝ}, s ≤ t → Refinement (V s) (V t)) {η : ℝ≥0}
    (ζ : ∀ t, Refinement (U t) (V (t + η))) (ξ : ∀ t, Refinement (V t) (U (t + η)))
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (mapperHomologyShiftMap R f rU rV ζ n).app t ≫
        (mapperHomologyShiftMap R f rV rU ξ n).app (t + (η : ℝ)) ≫
          (compIso η η (mapperHomologyPModule R f U rU n)).hom.app t =
      (transition (η + η) (mapperHomologyPModule R f U rU n)).app t
proof:
:= by
  rw [compIso_hom_app, transition_app, mapperHomologyPModule_map,
    structureMap_mapperHomologyPModule, mapperHomologyShiftMap_app,
    mapperHomologyShiftMap_app]
  exact mapperHomologyMap_comp₃_eq R f _ _ _ _ n

    (rV : ∀ {s t : ℝ}, s ≤ t → Refinement (V s) (V t))
    (rW : ∀ {s t : ℝ}, s ≤ t → Refinement (W s) (W t)) {η₁ η₂ : ℝ≥0}

statement:
theorem mem_centredCover_iff {s t y : ℝ} {k : ℤ} :
    y ∈ centredCover s t k ↔ |y - k * s| < t
proof:
:= by
  rw [centredCover, Set.mem_Ioo, abs_sub_lt_iff]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ <;> constructor <;> linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.covers_centredCover
statement:
theorem covers_centredCover {s t : ℝ} (hs : s ≠ 0) (ht : |s| / 2 < t) :
    Covers (centredCover s t) Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  intro y _
  refine ⟨round (y / s), mem_centredCover_iff.2 ?_⟩
  have hr := abs_sub_round (y / s)
  have hy : y - (round (y / s) : ℝ) * s = (y / s - round (y / s)) * s := by
    field_simp
  rw [hy, abs_mul]
  calc |y / s - round (y / s)| * |s| ≤ 1 / 2 * |s| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr (abs_nonneg s)
    _ < t := by linarith

proof:

  (centredMapperHomologyInterleaving R s hfg n).distance_le

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.exists_dart_crossing'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e.1
  have hcross : EdgeCrosses G h c (dartEdge d) := by
    rw [hd]
    exact e.2
  obtain ⟨hmin, hmax⟩ := (edgeCrosses_dartEdge_iff d).1 hcross
  rcases le_total (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hab | hab
  · refine ⟨d, hd, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [min_eq_left hab] at hmin
      exact hmin
    · rw [max_eq_right hab] at hmax
      exact hmax
  · refine ⟨d.symm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [dartEdge_symm]
      exact hd
    · rw [min_eq_right hab] at hmin
      exact hmin
    · rw [max_eq_left hab] at hmax
      exact hmax

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.crossingPoint_spec'
statement:
private theorem crossingPoint_spec' {c : ℝ}
    (e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h c e}) :
    ∃ d : G.Dart, ∃ h₁ : h d.fst < c, ∃ h₂ : c < h d.snd,
      dartEdge d = e.1 ∧
        (crossingPoint G h e).1 = edgePoint G d (crossingParam G h h₁ h₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, h₁, h₂⟩ := exists_dart_crossing' G h e
  refine ⟨d, h₁, h₂, hd, ?_⟩
  exact (eq_crossingPoint G h e d hd (crossingParam G h h₁ h₂)
    (dartHeight_crossingParam G h h₁ h₂)).symm

proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · dsimp [crossingParam]
    exact div_pos (by linarith) (by linarith)
  · dsimp [crossingParam]
    apply (div_lt_one (by linarith)).2
    linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.level_crossing_not_level_graph
statement:
private theorem level_crossing_not_level_graph {c : ℝ}
    (z : Realization (G.induce {v | h v = c}))
    (e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h c e}) :
    realizationMap (Embedding.induce _).toHom z ≠ (crossingPoint G h e).1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨d', h₁, h₂, hd', hpoint⟩ := crossingPoint_spec' G h e
  have hi := crossingParam_interior G h h₁ h₂
  intro hz
  have hcross_eq : edgePoint G d' (crossingParam G h h₁ h₂) =
      realizationMap (Embedding.induce (G := G) {v | h v = c}).toHom z :=
    hpoint.symm.trans hz.symm
  induction z using ind (G.induce {v | h v = c}) with
  | vertex v =>
      have hv := (edgePoint_eq_vertex_iff G).mp (by
        simpa [realizationMap_vertex] using hcross_eq)
      rcases hv with ⟨ht, _⟩ | ⟨ht, _⟩
      · exact (ne_of_gt hi.1)
          (congrArg (fun s : unitInterval => (s : ℝ)) ht)
      · exact (ne_of_lt hi.2)
          (congrArg (fun s : unitInterval => (s : ℝ)) ht)
  | edgePoint d t =>
      by_cases ht₀ : t = 0
      · have hv := (edgePoint_eq_vertex_iff G).mp (by
          simpa [realizationMap_edgePoint, realizationMap_vertex, ht₀, edgePoint_zero]
            using hcross_eq)
        rcases hv with ⟨ht, _⟩ | ⟨ht, _⟩
        · exact (ne_of_gt hi.1)
            (congrArg (fun s : unitInterval => (s : ℝ)) ht)
        · exact (ne_of_lt hi.2)
            (congrArg (fun s : unitInterval => (s : ℝ)) ht)
      · by_cases ht₁ : t = 1
        · have hv := (edgePoint_eq_vertex_iff G).mp (by
            simpa [realizationMap_edgePoint, realizationMap_vertex, ht₁, edgePoint_one]
              using hcross_eq)
          rcases hv with ⟨ht, _⟩ | ⟨ht, _⟩
          · exact (ne_of_gt hi.1)
              (congrArg (fun s : unitInterval => (s : ℝ)) ht)
          · exact (ne_of_lt hi.2)
              (congrArg (fun s : unitInterval => (s : ℝ)) ht)
        · have heq : edgePoint G
              ((Embedding.induce (G := G) {v | h v = c}).toHom.mapDart d) t =
              edgePoint G d' (crossingParam G h h₁ h₂) := by
            calc
              edgePoint G
                  ((Embedding.induce (G := G) {v | h v = c}).toHom.mapDart d) t =
                  (realizationMap (Embedding.induce (G := G) {v | h v = c}).toHom
                    (edgePoint (G.induce {v | h v = c}) d t)) :=
                (realizationMap_edgePoint _ _ _).symm
              _ = (crossingPoint G h e).1 := hz
              _ = edgePoint G d' (crossingParam G h h₁ h₂) := hpoint
          have hcases := (edgePoint_eq_edgePoint_iff G ht₀ ht₁).mp heq
          rcases hcases with ⟨hdart, _⟩ | ⟨hdart, _⟩
          · have hsrc : h
                ((Embedding.induce (G := G) {v | h v = c}).toHom.mapDart d).fst = c :=
              by
                change h (d.fst : V) = c
                exact d.fst.property
            exact (ne_of_lt h₁) (by simpa [hdart] using hsrc)
          · have hsrc : h
                ((Embedding.induce (G := G) {v | h v = c}).toHom.mapDart d).snd = c :=
              by
                change h (d.snd : V) = c
                exact d.snd.property
            exact (ne_of_lt h₁) (by simpa [hdart] using hsrc)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelPieceMap_bijective
statement: theorem levelPieceMap_bijective (c : ℝ) : Function.Bijective (levelPieceMap G h c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    rcases x with x | e <;> rcases y with y | e'
    · have hmap : realizationMap (Embedding.induce _).toHom x =
          realizationMap (Embedding.induce _).toHom y := by
        change (⟨realizationMap (Embedding.induce _).toHom x, _⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c) =
          ⟨realizationMap (Embedding.induce _).toHom y, _⟩ at hxy
        exact congrArg Subtype.val hxy
      exact congrArg Sum.inl
        (realizationMap_injective (G.induce {v | h v = c})
          (Embedding.induce (G := G) {v | h v = c}) hmap)
    · change (⟨realizationMap (Embedding.induce _).toHom x, _⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c) =
        crossingPoint G h e' at hxy
      exact (level_crossing_not_level_graph G h x e').elim (congrArg Subtype.val hxy)
    · change crossingPoint G h e =
        (⟨realizationMap (Embedding.induce _).toHom y, _⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c) at hxy
      exact (level_crossing_not_level_graph G h y e).elim (congrArg Subtype.val hxy.symm)
    · obtain ⟨d, h₁, h₂, hd, hpoint⟩ := crossingPoint_spec' G h e
      obtain ⟨d', h₁', h₂', hd', hpoint'⟩ := crossingPoint_spec' G h e'
      change crossingPoint G h e = crossingPoint G h e' at hxy
      have heq : edgePoint G d (crossingParam G h h₁ h₂) =
          edgePoint G d' (crossingParam G h h₁' h₂') := by
        rw [← hpoint, ← hpoint']
        exact congrArg Subtype.val hxy
      have hi := crossingParam_interior G h h₁ h₂
      have ht₀ : crossingParam G h h₁ h₂ ≠ 0 :=
        unitInterval.coe_ne_zero.mp hi.1.ne'
      have ht₁ : crossingParam G h h₁ h₂ ≠ 1 :=
        unitInterval.coe_ne_one.mp hi.2.ne
      have hc := (edgePoint_eq_edgePoint_iff G ht₀ ht₁).mp heq
      rcases hc with ⟨hc, _⟩ | ⟨hc, _⟩
      · apply congrArg Sum.inr
        apply Subtype.ext
        have heq : dartEdge d = dartEdge d' := by rw [hc]
        exact hd.symm.trans (heq.trans hd')
      · apply congrArg Sum.inr
        apply Subtype.ext
        have heq : dartEdge d = dartEdge d' := by
          rw [hc, dartEdge_symm]
        exact hd.symm.trans (heq.trans hd')
  · intro z
    rcases z with ⟨z, hz⟩
    induction z using ind G with
    | vertex v =>
        have hv : h v = c := by simpa [plHeight_vertex] using hz
        refine ⟨Sum.inl (vertex (G.induce {v | h v = c}) ⟨v, hv⟩), ?_⟩
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
    | edgePoint d t =>
        have ht : dartHeight h d t = c := by simpa [plHeight_edgePoint] using hz
        by_cases hh : h d.fst = h d.snd
        · have hfst : h d.fst = c := (dartHeight_of_eq h hh t).symm.trans ht
          have hsnd : h d.snd = c := hh.symm.trans hfst
          let d' : (G.induce {v | h v = c}).Dart :=
            ⟨(⟨d.fst, hfst⟩, ⟨d.snd, hsnd⟩), d.adj⟩
          have hd' : (Embedding.induce (G := G) {v | h v = c}).toHom.mapDart d' = d := by
            apply Dart.ext
            rfl
          refine ⟨Sum.inl (edgePoint (G.induce {v | h v = c}) d' t), ?_⟩
          apply Subtype.ext
          rw [levelPieceMap_inl, realizationMap_edgePoint, hd']
        · by_cases ht₀ : t = 0
          · have hv : h d.fst = c := by
              exact (dartHeight_zero h d).symm.trans (by simpa [ht₀] using ht)
            refine ⟨Sum.inl (vertex (G.induce {v | h v = c}) ⟨d.fst, hv⟩), ?_⟩
            apply Subtype.ext
            rw [levelPieceMap_inl, realizationMap_vertex]
            show _ = edgePoint G d t
            rw [ht₀, edgePoint_zero]
            rfl
          · by_cases ht₁ : t = 1
            · have hv : h d.snd = c := by
                exact (dartHeight_one h d).symm.trans (by simpa [ht₁] using ht)
              refine ⟨Sum.inl (vertex (G.induce {v | h v = c}) ⟨d.snd, hv⟩), ?_⟩
              apply Subtype.ext
              rw [levelPieceMap_inl, realizationMap_vertex]
              show _ = edgePoint G d t
              rw [ht₁, edgePoint_one]
              rfl
            · have hne : h d.fst ≠ h d.snd := hh
              have hfst : h d.fst ≠ c := by
                intro hfc
                have hzero : dartHeight h d 0 = dartHeight h d t := by
                  rw [dartHeight_zero, hfc, ht]
                exact ht₀ (dartHeight_injective h hne hzero).symm
              have hsnd : h d.snd ≠ c := by
                intro hsc
                have hone : dartHeight h d 1 = dartHeight h d t := by
                  rw [dartHeight_one, hsc, ht]
                exact ht₁ (dartHeight_injective h hne hone).symm
              have hcross : EdgeCrosses G h c (dartEdge d) := by
                rw [edgeCrosses_dartEdge_iff]
                rcases le_total (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hab | hab
                · rw [min_eq_left hab, max_eq_right hab]
                  constructor
                  · have hle : h d.fst ≤ c := by
                      rw [← ht]
                      unfold dartHeight
                      nlinarith [mul_nonneg t.2.1 (sub_nonneg.2 hab),
                        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 t.2.2) (sub_nonneg.2 hab)]
                    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle hfst
                  · have hle : c ≤ h d.snd := by
                      rw [← ht]
                      unfold dartHeight
                      nlinarith [mul_nonneg t.2.1 (sub_nonneg.2 hab),
                        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 t.2.2) (sub_nonneg.2 hab)]
                    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle (Ne.symm hsnd)
                · rw [min_eq_right hab, max_eq_left hab]
                  constructor
                  · have hle : h d.snd ≤ c := by
                      rw [← ht]
                      unfold dartHeight
                      nlinarith [mul_nonneg t.2.1 (sub_nonneg.2 hab),
                        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 t.2.2) (sub_nonneg.2 hab)]
                    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle hsnd
                  · have hle : c ≤ h d.fst := by
                      rw [← ht]
                      unfold dartHeight
                      nlinarith [mul_nonneg t.2.1 (sub_nonneg.2 hab),
                        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 t.2.2) (sub_nonneg.2 hab)]
                    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle (Ne.symm hfst)
              let e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h c e} := ⟨dartEdge d, hcross⟩
              refine ⟨Sum.inr e, ?_⟩
              apply Subtype.ext
              exact (eq_crossingPoint G h e d rfl t ht).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.compactSpace_levelPiece
statement: theorem compactSpace_levelPiece (c : ℝ) : CompactSpace (LevelPiece G h c)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelPieceHomeomorph_apply
statement:
theorem levelPieceHomeomorph_apply (c : ℝ) (z : LevelPiece G h c) :
    levelPieceHomeomorph G h c z = levelPieceMap G h c z
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.compactSpace_closedLevel
statement: theorem compactSpace_closedLevel (c : ℝ) : CompactSpace (ClosedLevel G h c)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : CompactSpace (LevelPiece G h c) := compactSpace_levelPiece G h c
  let _ : T2Space (Realization G) := t2Space_realization G
  exact (levelPieceHomeomorph G h c).compactSpace

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.locallyPathConnectedSpace_closedLevel
statement:
theorem locallyPathConnectedSpace_closedLevel (c : ℝ) :
    LocallyPathConnectedSpace (ClosedLevel G h c)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : TopologicalSpace {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h c e} := ⊥
  let _ : DiscreteTopology {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h c e} := ⟨rfl⟩
  let _ : LocallyPathConnectedSpace (Realization (G.induce {v | h v = c})) :=
    locallyPathConnectedSpace_realization _
  let _ : LocallyPathConnectedSpace {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h c e} := by
    infer_instance
  let _ : LocallyPathConnectedSpace (LevelPiece G h c) := by
    unfold LevelPiece
    infer_instance
  let _ : T2Space (Realization G) := t2Space_realization G
  exact (levelPieceHomeomorph G h c).symm.isOpenEmbedding.locallyPathConnectedSpace

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.exists_spanDart
statement:
private theorem exists_spanDart {p q : ℝ} (_hpq : p < q) (y : SpanEdge G h p q) :
    ∃ d : G.Dart, dartEdge d = y.1 ∧ h d.fst ≤ p ∧ q ≤ h d.snd
proof:
:= by
  rcases y.2 with ⟨d, hd, hmin, hmax⟩
  rcases le_total (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hab | hab
  · refine ⟨d, hd, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [min_eq_left hab] at hmin
      exact hmin
    · rw [max_eq_right hab] at hmax
      exact hmax
  · refine ⟨d.symm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [dartEdge_symm]
      exact hd
    · rw [min_eq_right hab] at hmin
      exact hmin
    · rw [max_eq_left hab] at hmax
      exact hmax

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.spanDart_spec
statement:
theorem spanDart_spec {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p < q) (y : SpanEdge G h p q) :
    dartEdge (spanDart G h hpq y) = y.1 ∧
      h (spanDart G h hpq y).fst ≤ p ∧ q ≤ h (spanDart G h hpq y).snd
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (exists_spanDart G h hpq y)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.spanDart_height_lt
statement:
private theorem spanDart_height_lt {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p < q) (y : SpanEdge G h p q) :
    h (spanDart G h hpq y).fst < h (spanDart G h hpq y).snd
proof:
:= by
  have hd := spanDart_spec G h hpq y
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le (hd.2.1.trans_lt hpq) hd.2.2

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.spanDart_den_pos
statement:
private theorem spanDart_den_pos {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p < q) (y : SpanEdge G h p q) :
    0 < h (spanDart G h hpq y).snd - h (spanDart G h hpq y).fst
proof:
:=
  sub_pos.2 (spanDart_height_lt G h hpq y)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.spanParam_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hden := spanDart_den_pos G h hpq y
  have h₁ := (spanDart_spec G h hpq y).2.1
  have h₂ := (spanDart_spec G h hpq y).2.2
  have ht₁ : p ≤ (t : ℝ) := t.2.1
  have ht₂ : (t : ℝ) ≤ q := t.2.2
  refine ⟨div_nonneg ?_ hden.le, (div_le_one hden).2 ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.spanPoint_apply
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.coe_spanParam
statement:
private theorem coe_spanParam {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p < q) (y : SpanEdge G h p q) (t : Icc p q) :
    (spanParam G h hpq y t : ℝ) =
      ((t : ℝ) - h (spanDart G h hpq y).fst) /
        (h (spanDart G h hpq y).snd - h (spanDart G h hpq y).fst)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.plHeight_spanPoint
statement:
theorem plHeight_spanPoint {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p < q) (y : SpanEdge G h p q) (t : Icc p q) :
    plHeight G h (spanPoint G h hpq y t) = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [spanPoint_apply, plHeight_edgePoint]
  unfold dartHeight
  rw [coe_spanParam]
  have hden := spanDart_den_pos G h hpq y
  have hmul := div_mul_cancel₀
    ((t : ℝ) - h (spanDart G h hpq y).fst)
    hden.ne'
  linear_combination hmul

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLPresentationMap_ofCylinder
statement:
private theorem graphPLPresentationMap_ofCylinder (e : Fin n)
    (y : (graphPLPresentation G h S).E e) (t : CylinderPresentation.Seg S e) :
    graphPLPresentationMap G h S
        ((graphPLPresentation G h S).ofCylinder S e (y, t)) =
      spanPoint G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y t
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLPresentationMap_ofStrip
statement:
private theorem graphPLPresentationMap_ofStrip (e : Fin n)
    (p : (graphPLPresentation G h S).E e × (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    graphPLPresentationMap G h S ((graphPLPresentation G h S).ofStrip S e p) =
      spanPoint G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) p.1
        (CylinderPresentation.gapIncl S e p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [CylinderPresentation.ofStrip_eq_ofCylinder, graphPLPresentationMap_ofCylinder]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLPresentationMap_ofVertex
statement:
theorem graphPLPresentationMap_ofVertex (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (p : ClosedLevel G h (S.value i)) :
    graphPLPresentationMap G h S ((graphPLPresentation G h S).ofVertex S i p) = p.1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.plHeight_graphPLPresentationMap
statement:
theorem plHeight_graphPLPresentationMap (x : (graphPLPresentation G h S).Realization S) :
    plHeight G h (graphPLPresentationMap G h S x) =
      (graphPLPresentation G h S).height S x
proof:
:= by
  have hmap :
      (plHeight G h).comp (graphPLPresentationMap G h S) =
        (graphPLPresentation G h S).height S := by
    refine (graphPLPresentation G h S).hom_ext ?_ ?_
    · intro i p
      exact (p.2 : plHeight G h p.1 = S.value i)
    · intro e p
      exact plHeight_spanPoint G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) p.1 p.2
  exact congrArg (fun f => f x) hmap

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLPresentationMap_injective
statement:
theorem graphPLPresentationMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (graphPLPresentationMap G h S)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  rcases (graphPLPresentation G h S).exists_rep S x with ⟨i, p, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, p, rfl⟩
  · rcases (graphPLPresentation G h S).exists_rep S y with ⟨j, q, rfl⟩ | ⟨e', q, rfl⟩
    · have hpq : p.1 = q.1 := by
        rw [← graphPLPresentationMap_ofVertex G h S i p,
          ← graphPLPresentationMap_ofVertex G h S j q]
        exact hxy
      have hij : i = j := S.strictMono.injective (by
        calc
          S.value i = plHeight G h p.1 := p.2.symm
          _ = plHeight G h q.1 := congrArg (plHeight G h) hpq
          _ = S.value j := q.2)
      subst j
      apply congrArg ((graphPLPresentation G h S).ofVertex S i)
      exact Subtype.ext hpq
    · exfalso
      have hh : S.value i = (q.2 : ℝ) := by
        have := congrArg (plHeight G h) hxy
        rw [plHeight_graphPLPresentationMap, plHeight_graphPLPresentationMap] at this
        simpa [CylinderPresentation.height_ofVertex, CylinderPresentation.height_ofStrip] using this
      exact S.value_notMem_K e' i (hh.symm ▸ q.2.2)
  · rcases (graphPLPresentation G h S).exists_rep S y with ⟨j, q, rfl⟩ | ⟨e', q, rfl⟩
    · exfalso
      have hh : (p.2 : ℝ) = S.value j := by
        have := congrArg (plHeight G h) hxy
        rw [plHeight_graphPLPresentationMap, plHeight_graphPLPresentationMap] at this
        simpa [CylinderPresentation.height_ofStrip, CylinderPresentation.height_ofVertex] using this
      exact S.value_notMem_K e j (hh ▸ p.2.2)
    · have hh : (p.2 : ℝ) = (q.2 : ℝ) := by
        have := congrArg (plHeight G h) hxy
        rw [plHeight_graphPLPresentationMap, plHeight_graphPLPresentationMap] at this
        simpa [CylinderPresentation.height_ofStrip] using this
      have he : e = e' := S.eq_of_mem_K_of_mem_Icc
        (by rw [← hh]; exact p.2.2) (Ioo_subset_Icc_self q.2.2)
      subst e'
      have hpoint :
          spanPoint G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) p.1
              (CylinderPresentation.gapIncl S e p.2) =
            spanPoint G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) q.1
              (CylinderPresentation.gapIncl S e q.2) := by
        rw [graphPLPresentationMap_ofStrip G h S e p,
          graphPLPresentationMap_ofStrip G h S e q] at hxy
        exact hxy
      let d := spanDart G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) p.1
      let d' := spanDart G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) q.1
      have hd := spanDart_spec G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) p.1
      have hd' := spanDart_spec G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) q.1
      have htp : h d.fst < (p.2 : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [d]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hd.2.1 p.2.2.1
      have hsp : (p.2 : ℝ) < h d.snd := by
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le p.2.2.2 hd.2.2
      have htq : h d'.fst < (q.2 : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [d']
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hd'.2.1 q.2.2.1
      have hsq : (q.2 : ℝ) < h d'.snd := by
        exact lt_of_lt_of_le q.2.2.2 hd'.2.2
      have hden : 0 < h d.snd - h d.fst := by linarith
      have hden' : 0 < h d'.snd - h d'.fst := by linarith
      have ht₀ :
          (⟨((p.2 : ℝ) - h d.fst) / (h d.snd - h d.fst), by
            refine ⟨div_nonneg (by linarith) hden.le, (div_le_one hden).2 (by linarith)⟩⟩ :
            unitInterval) ≠ 0 := by
        apply unitInterval.coe_ne_zero.mp
        exact div_ne_zero (sub_ne_zero.mpr htp.ne') hden.ne'
      have ht₁ :
          (⟨((p.2 : ℝ) - h d.fst) / (h d.snd - h d.fst), by
            refine ⟨div_nonneg (by linarith) hden.le, (div_le_one hden).2 (by linarith)⟩⟩ :
            unitInterval) ≠ 1 := by
        apply unitInterval.coe_ne_one.mp
        intro hone
        have := (div_eq_one_iff_eq hden.ne').1 hone
        linarith
      have hpp : edgePoint G d
            ⟨((p.2 : ℝ) - h d.fst) / (h d.snd - h d.fst), by
              refine ⟨div_nonneg (by linarith) hden.le, (div_le_one hden).2 (by linarith)⟩⟩ =
          edgePoint G d'
            ⟨((q.2 : ℝ) - h d'.fst) / (h d'.snd - h d'.fst), by
              refine ⟨div_nonneg (by linarith) hden'.le, (div_le_one hden').2 (by linarith)⟩⟩ := by
        simpa [spanPoint, spanParam, d, d', CylinderPresentation.gapIncl] using hpoint
      rcases (edgePoint_eq_edgePoint_iff G ht₀ ht₁).1 hpp with hdart | hdart
      · have hy : p.1 = q.1 := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact hd.1.symm.trans ((congrArg dartEdge hdart.1.symm).trans hd'.1)
        apply congrArg ((graphPLPresentation G h S).ofStrip S e)
        apply Prod.ext hy
        exact Subtype.ext hh
      · have hy : p.1 = q.1 := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact hd.1.symm.trans ((dartEdge_symm d).symm.trans
            ((congrArg dartEdge hdart.1.symm).trans hd'.1))
        apply congrArg ((graphPLPresentation G h S).ofStrip S e)
        apply Prod.ext hy
        exact Subtype.ext hh

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLPresentationMap_surjective
statement:
theorem graphPLPresentationMap_surjective {S : CriticalValues n} (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) :
    Function.Surjective (graphPLPresentationMap G h S)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  induction z using ind G with
  | vertex v =>
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hS v
      refine ⟨(graphPLPresentation G h S).ofVertex S i
        ⟨vertex G v, by simpa [plHeight_vertex] using hi.symm⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [graphPLPresentationMap_ofVertex]
  | edgePoint d t =>
      let c : ℝ := dartHeight h d t
      by_cases hlevel : ∃ i, S.value i = c
      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hlevel
        refine ⟨(graphPLPresentation G h S).ofVertex S i
          ⟨edgePoint G d t, by
            change plHeight G h (edgePoint G d t) = S.value i
            rw [plHeight_edgePoint, hi]⟩, ?_⟩
        rw [graphPLPresentationMap_ofVertex]
      · have hnot_level : ∀ i, S.value i ≠ c := by
          intro i hi
          exact hlevel ⟨i, hi⟩
        have hvbounds : ∀ v, h v ∈ Icc (S.value 0) (S.value (Fin.last n)) := by
          intro v
          obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hS v
          rw [← hi]
          exact ⟨S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.zero_le i),
            S.strictMono.monotone (Fin.le_last i)⟩
        have hrange := plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall hvbounds (edgePoint G d t)
        have hcrange : c ∈ Icc (S.value 0) (S.value (Fin.last n)) := by
          simpa [c, plHeight_edgePoint] using hrange
        obtain ⟨piece, hpiece, huniq⟩ := S.exists_piece c
        have hcK : ∃ e : Fin n, c ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) := by
          cases piece with
          | star i => exact False.elim (hnot_level i (huniq i (S.value_mem_J i)))
          | gap e => exact ⟨e, hpiece⟩
          | lowerTail => exact (not_lt_of_ge hcrange.1 hpiece).elim
          | upperTail => exact (not_lt_of_ge hcrange.2 hpiece).elim
        obtain ⟨e, hce⟩ := hcK
        have hact : EdgeActive G h (S.K e) (dartEdge d) := by
          exact edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem (I := S.K e) (by simpa [c] using hce)
        have hspan : EdgeSpans G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) (dartEdge d) := by
          let a : {a : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h (S.K e) a} :=
            ⟨dartEdge d, hact⟩
          exact (activeEdgeEquivSpans (G := G) (h := h) (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e)
            (fun v => hS.notMem_K e v) a).2
        let y : SpanEdge G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) := ⟨dartEdge d, hspan⟩
        refine ⟨(graphPLPresentation G h S).ofStrip S e (y, ⟨c, hce⟩), ?_⟩
        rw [CylinderPresentation.ofStrip_eq_ofCylinder,
          graphPLPresentationMap_ofCylinder]
        have hne : h d.fst ≠ h d.snd := by
          intro heq
          obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hS d.fst
          apply hnot_level i
          calc
            S.value i = h d.fst := hi
            _ = dartHeight h d t := (dartHeight_of_eq h heq t).symm
        have hsheight := plHeight_spanPoint G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
          (CylinderPresentation.gapIncl S e ⟨c, hce⟩)
        rw [spanPoint_apply, plHeight_edgePoint] at hsheight
        rw [spanPoint_apply]
        have hd' := spanDart_spec G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
        generalize spanParam G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
          (CylinderPresentation.gapIncl S e ⟨c, hce⟩) = s at hsheight ⊢
        generalize spanDart G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y = d' at hsheight hd' ⊢
        have hsc : dartHeight h d' s = dartHeight h d t := hsheight
        have hde : dartEdge d' = dartEdge d := hd'.1
        rcases dartEdge_eq_iff.1 hde with rfl | rfl
        · exact congrArg (edgePoint G d') (dartHeight_injective h hne hsc)
        · have hst : s = unitInterval.symm t :=
            dartHeight_injective h (d := d.symm) hne.symm
              (hsc.trans (dartHeight_symm h d t).symm)
          rw [hst, edgePoint_symm]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.zerothHomotopyEquivOfDiscrete_mk
statement:
private theorem zerothHomotopyEquivOfDiscrete_mk {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A]
    [DiscreteTopology A] (x : A) :
    zerothHomotopyEquivOfDiscrete A (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hb : Function.Bijective (ZerothHomotopy.mk : A → ZerothHomotopy A) :=
    ⟨fun _ _ hx => joined_eq_of_discrete (Quotient.exact hx), ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective⟩

      (ZerothHomotopy.mk x) = x

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebData_left_eq
statement:
private theorem graphPLReebData_left_eq (e : Fin n)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ)) :
    (graphPLReebData G h S).left e y =
      closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h (S.value e.castSucc)
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk ((graphPLPresentation G h S).left e y))
proof:
:= by
  have hd := spanDart_spec G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
  have hval : ((graphPLPresentation G h S).left e y).1 =
      edgePoint G (spanDart G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y)
        (spanParam G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y (CylinderPresentation.segBot S e)) := rfl
  have hheight := plHeight_spanPoint G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
    (CylinderPresentation.segBot S e)
  rw [spanPoint_apply, plHeight_edgePoint] at hheight
  have hcoe := coe_spanParam G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
    (CylinderPresentation.segBot S e)
  generalize spanParam G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
    (CylinderPresentation.segBot S e) = s at hval hheight hcoe
  generalize spanDart G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y = d at hd hval hheight hcoe
  have hheight' : dartHeight h d s = S.value e.castSucc := hheight
  by_cases hfst : h d.fst = S.value e.castSucc
  · have hs : s = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hcoe, Set.Icc.coe_zero]
      change (S.value e.castSucc - h d.fst) / (h d.snd - h d.fst) = 0
      rw [hfst, sub_self, zero_div]
    have hl : (graphPLPresentation G h S).left e y =
        (⟨vertex G d.fst, by
          rw [plHeight_vertex, hfst]
          exact Set.mem_singleton _⟩ : ClosedLevel G h (S.value e.castSucc)) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hval, hs, edgePoint_zero]
    have hmem : d.fst ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 V) := by
      rw [← hd.1]
      exact fst_mem_dartEdge d
    rw [hl, closedLevelComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex G h d.fst hfst]
    exact graphPLReebData_left_of_mem G h S e y hmem hfst
  · have hne : ∀ v ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 V), h v ≠ S.value e.castSucc := by
      intro v hv hvp
      have hv' : v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V) := by
        rw [hd.1]
        exact hv
      rcases mem_dartEdge.mp hv' with rfl | rfl
      · exact hfst hvp
      · linarith [S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e, hd.2.2]
    let a : {a : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h (S.value e.castSucc) a} :=
      ⟨y.1, y.2.crosses_left (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) hne⟩
    have hl : (graphPLPresentation G h S).left e y = crossingPoint G h a := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hval]
      exact eq_crossingPoint G h a d hd.1 s hheight'
    rw [hl, closedLevelComponentsEquiv_crossingPoint]
    exact graphPLReebData_left_of_forall_ne G h S e y hne

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebData_right_eq
statement:
private theorem graphPLReebData_right_eq (e : Fin n)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ)) :
    (graphPLReebData G h S).right e y =
      closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h (S.value e.succ)
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk ((graphPLPresentation G h S).right e y))
proof:
:= by
  have hd := spanDart_spec G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
  have hden := spanDart_den_pos G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
  have hval : ((graphPLPresentation G h S).right e y).1 =
      edgePoint G (spanDart G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y)
        (spanParam G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y (CylinderPresentation.segTop S e)) := rfl
  have hheight := plHeight_spanPoint G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
    (CylinderPresentation.segTop S e)
  rw [spanPoint_apply, plHeight_edgePoint] at hheight
  have hcoe := coe_spanParam G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
    (CylinderPresentation.segTop S e)
  generalize spanParam G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
    (CylinderPresentation.segTop S e) = s at hval hheight hcoe
  generalize spanDart G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y = d at hd hden hval hheight hcoe
  have hheight' : dartHeight h d s = S.value e.succ := hheight
  by_cases hsnd : h d.snd = S.value e.succ
  · have hs : s = 1 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hcoe, Set.Icc.coe_one]
      change (S.value e.succ - h d.fst) / (h d.snd - h d.fst) = 1
      rw [← hsnd]
      exact div_self hden.ne'
    have hr : (graphPLPresentation G h S).right e y =
        (⟨vertex G d.snd, by
          rw [plHeight_vertex, hsnd]
          exact Set.mem_singleton _⟩ : ClosedLevel G h (S.value e.succ)) := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hval, hs, edgePoint_one]
    have hmem : d.snd ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 V) := by
      rw [← hd.1]
      exact snd_mem_dartEdge d
    rw [hr, closedLevelComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex G h d.snd hsnd]
    exact graphPLReebData_right_of_mem G h S e y hmem hsnd
  · have hne : ∀ v ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 V), h v ≠ S.value e.succ := by
      intro v hv hvq
      have hv' : v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V) := by
        rw [hd.1]
        exact hv
      rcases mem_dartEdge.mp hv' with rfl | rfl
      · linarith [hd.2.1, S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e]
      · exact hsnd hvq
    let a : {a : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h (S.value e.succ) a} :=
      ⟨y.1, y.2.crosses_right (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) hne⟩
    have hr : (graphPLPresentation G h S).right e y = crossingPoint G h a := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [hval]
      exact eq_crossingPoint G h a d hd.1 s hheight'
    rw [hr, closedLevelComponentsEquiv_crossingPoint]
    exact graphPLReebData_right_of_forall_ne G h S e y hne

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebMap_graphPLPresentationMap
statement:
theorem graphPLReebMap_graphPLPresentationMap {S : CriticalValues n}
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (x : (graphPLPresentation G h S).Realization S) :
    graphPLReebMap G h hS (graphPLPresentationMap G h S x) =
      CylinderPresentation.realizeHom S (graphPLComponentDataIso G h S).hom
        ((graphPLPresentation G h S).componentGraphMap S x)
proof:
:= by
  rcases (graphPLPresentation G h S).exists_rep S x with ⟨i, p, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, ⟨y, t⟩, rfl⟩
  · exact graphPLReebMap_of_level G h hS i p
  · let d := spanDart G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
    have hd := spanDart_spec G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
    have hsp : EdgeSpans G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) (dartEdge d) := by
      rw [hd.1]
      exact y.2
    have hheight :
        dartHeight h d (spanParam G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
          (CylinderPresentation.gapIncl S e t)) = (t : ℝ) := by
      have ht := plHeight_spanPoint G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
        (CylinderPresentation.gapIncl S e t)
      erw [spanPoint_apply, plHeight_edgePoint] at ht
      exact ht
    have hmap :
        graphPLReebMap G h hS
            (spanPoint G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
              (CylinderPresentation.gapIncl S e t)) =
          (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e
            (⟨dartEdge d, hsp⟩, ⟨dartHeight h d (spanParam G h
              (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y (CylinderPresentation.gapIncl S e t)), by
                rw [hheight]
                exact t.2⟩) := by
      erw [spanPoint_apply]
      exact graphPLReebMap_edgePoint_of_mem_K G h hS d
        (spanParam G h (S.value_castSucc_lt_succ e) y
          (CylinderPresentation.gapIncl S e t))
        (by rw [hheight]; exact t.2) hsp
    rw [graphPLPresentationMap_ofStrip, hmap]
    rw [CylinderPresentation.componentGraphMap_ofStrip]
    change _ = (CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e
      ((graphPLComponentDataIso G h S).hom.e e (ZerothHomotopy.mk y), t)
    apply congrArg ((CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e)
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change dartEdge d =
        (zerothHomotopyEquivOfDiscrete ((graphPLPresentation G h S).E e)
          (ZerothHomotopy.mk y)).1
      rw [zerothHomotopyEquivOfDiscrete_mk]
      exact hd.1
    · exact Subtype.ext hheight

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLReebQuotientIsoOfIso_graphPLComponentDataIso
statement:
theorem graphPLReebQuotientIsoOfIso_graphPLComponentDataIso
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) :
    graphPLReebQuotientIsoOfIso G h hS (graphPLComponentDataIso G h S) =
      (graphPLPresentation G h S).quotientIsoOfIso S
        (graphPLPresentationIso G h hS)
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
  ext q
  induction q using ReebQuotient.ind with
  | h a =>
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := graphPLPresentationMap_surjective G h hS a
      change CylinderPresentation.realizeHom S (graphPLComponentDataIso G h S).inv
          (graphPLReebQuotientHomeomorph G h hS
            (ReebQuotient.mk _ (graphPLPresentationMap G h S x))) =
        (graphPLPresentation G h S).quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph S
          (ReebQuotient.mk _
            ((graphPLPresentationHomeomorph G h hS).symm
              (graphPLPresentationMap G h S x)))
      rw [graphPLReebQuotientHomeomorph_mk,
        graphPLReebMap_graphPLPresentationMap G h hS,
        CylinderPresentation.quotientComponentGraphHomeomorph_mk]
      rw [← graphPLPresentationHomeomorph_apply G h hS x,
        Homeomorph.symm_apply_apply]
      have hc : (graphPLComponentDataIso G h S).hom.comp (graphPLComponentDataIso G h S).inv =
          FiniteReebData.Hom.id _ := (graphPLComponentDataIso G h S).hom_inv_id
      rw [← ContinuousMap.comp_apply, ← CylinderPresentation.realizeHom_comp S
        (graphPLComponentDataIso G h S).hom (graphPLComponentDataIso G h S).inv,
        hc, CylinderPresentation.realizeHom_id]
      rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebMergeFoldExamples.mergeY_top_boundary_fold
statement:
theorem mergeY_top_boundary_fold :
    mergeSection 3 3 (by norm_num) le_rfl 3 = vertex mergeY 2 ∧
      mergeHeights 3 3 2 = mergeHeights 3 3 3 ∧
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights 1 3))
        (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights 3 3)) = ENNReal.ofReal (3 / 2) ∧
      ∃ γ : Path (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 (⟨(1 / 2 : ℝ), by norm_num⟩ : unitInterval))
          (mergeSection 3 3 (by norm_num) le_rfl
            (plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights 3 3)
              (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 (⟨(1 / 2 : ℝ), by norm_num⟩ : unitInterval)))),
        ∀ t, plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights 3 3) (γ t) = 3
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      mergeSection 3 3 (by norm_num) le_rfl 3 =
      mergeSection 3 3 (by norm_num) le_rfl
            (3 * ((1 : unitInterval) : ℝ)) := by
        congr 1
        norm_num
      _ = edgePoint mergeY _ 1 := mergeSection_lower 3 3 (by norm_num) le_rfl 1
      _ = vertex mergeY 2 := by rw [edgePoint_one]; rfl
  · rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY_eq_min (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  · have hstart :
        plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights 3 3)
          (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 (⟨(1 / 2 : ℝ), by norm_num⟩ : unitInterval)) = 3 := by
      simp [GraphPL.plHeight_edgePoint, GraphPL.dartHeight, mergeHeights, mergeFoldD23]
      norm_num
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := exists_mergeSection_path 3 3 (by norm_num) le_rfl
      (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23 (⟨(1 / 2 : ℝ), by norm_num⟩ : unitInterval))
    refine ⟨γ, ?_⟩
    intro t
    obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := (hγ t).1 (by rw [hstart])
    have hlo' : 3 ≤ plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights 3 3) (γ t) := by
      calc
        3 = plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights 3 3)
            (edgePoint mergeY mergeFoldD23
              (⟨(1 / 2 : ℝ), by norm_num⟩ : unitInterval)) := hstart.symm
        _ ≤ plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights 3 3) (γ t) := hlo
    exact le_antisymm hhi hlo'

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebMergeFoldExamples.mergeY_fold_improves_vertex_budget
statement:
theorem mergeY_fold_improves_vertex_budget :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights 1 4))
        (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights 3 4)) = ENNReal.ofReal (3 / 2) ∧
      edist (mergeHeights 1 4) (mergeHeights 3 4) = ENNReal.ofReal 2 ∧
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights 1 4))
        (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights 3 4)) <
          edist (mergeHeights 1 4) (mergeHeights 3 4)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨mergeY_beyond_twice_exact, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [edist_mergeHeights (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  · rw [mergeY_beyond_twice_exact, edist_mergeHeights (by norm_num)]
    norm_num

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebMergeFoldExamples.mergeSection_clamps_above_top
statement:
theorem mergeSection_clamps_above_top :
    plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights 2 2)
        (mergeSection 2 2 (by norm_num) le_rfl 3) = 2 ∧
      plHeight mergeY (mergeHeights 2 2)
        (mergeSection 2 2 (by norm_num) le_rfl 3) ≠ 3
proof:
:= by
  have hclamp3 : Set.projIcc 0 (2 : ℝ) (by norm_num) 3 = Set.projIcc 0 2 (by norm_num) 2 := by
    rw [Set.projIcc_of_right_le (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 3),
      Set.projIcc_of_mem (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) ⟨by norm_num, by norm_num⟩]
  have hsection :
      mergeSection 2 2 (by norm_num) le_rfl 3 =
        mergeSection 2 2 (by norm_num) le_rfl 2 := by
    rw [mergeSection_at_top_apex 2 (by norm_num) 3,
      mergeSection_at_top_apex 2 (by norm_num) 2, hclamp3]
  have hheight := plHeight_mergeSection 2 2 (by norm_num) le_rfl
    (y := 2) (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 2)
  rw [hsection, hheight]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Mapper.mem_centredInterval_iff
statement:
theorem mem_centredInterval_iff {r y : ℝ} {w : W} :
    y ∈ centredInterval a s ℓ r w ↔ |y - (a + ℓ w * s)| < r
proof:
:= by
  change y ∈ Set.Ioo _ _ ↔ _
  rw [Set.mem_Ioo, abs_sub_lt_iff]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ <;> constructor <;> linarith
