name: TDA.Mapper.cappedCentredCover_last
statement:
theorem cappedCentredCover_last (j : Fin m) (hj : j.val + 1 = m) (w : W) :
    cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c j.succ w = ⊤
proof:
:=
  if_pos hj

name: TDA.Mapper.stageRadius_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem stageRadius_zero : stageRadius c 0 = ⊥
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.stageRadius_succ_of_lt
statement:
theorem stageRadius_succ_of_lt (j : Fin m) (hj : j.val + 1 < m) :
    stageRadius c j.succ = c j
proof:
:=
  if_neg hj.ne

name: TDA.Mapper.stageRadius_last
statement: theorem stageRadius_last (j : Fin m) (hj : j.val + 1 = m) : stageRadius c j.succ = ⊤
proof:
:=
  if_pos hj

name: TDA.Mapper.stageRadius_eq_bot_iff
statement: theorem stageRadius_eq_bot_iff {i : Fin (m + 1)} : stageRadius c i = ⊥ ↔ i = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩
  obtain rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩ := i.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
  · rfl
  · by_cases hj : j.val + 1 = m
    · rw [stageRadius_last c j hj] at h
      exact absurd h (by simp)
    · rw [stageRadius_succ_of_lt c j (lt_of_le_of_ne j.isLt hj)] at h
      exact absurd h (EReal.coe_ne_bot _)

name: TDA.Mapper.stageRadius_mono
statement: theorem stageRadius_mono : Monotone (stageRadius c)
proof:
:= by
  intro i i' h
  obtain rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩ := i.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
  · exact bot_le
  obtain rfl | ⟨j', rfl⟩ := i'.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
  · exact absurd h (by simp)
  have hjj' : j ≤ j' := Fin.succ_le_succ_iff.mp h
  by_cases hj' : j'.val + 1 = m
  · rw [stageRadius_last c j' hj']
    exact le_top
  have hlt' : j'.val + 1 < m := lt_of_le_of_ne j'.isLt hj'
  have hlt : j.val + 1 < m := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.succ_le_succ hjj') hlt'
  rw [stageRadius_succ_of_lt c j hlt, stageRadius_succ_of_lt c j' hlt']
  exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (c.monotone hjj')

name: TDA.Mapper.mem_cappedCentredCover_succ_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cappedCentredCover_succ_iff (j : Fin m) (w : W) (y : ℝ) :
    y ∈ cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c j.succ w ↔
      ((|y - (a + ℓ w * s)| : ℝ) : EReal) < stageRadius c j.succ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j.val + 1 = m
  · rw [cappedCentredCover_last a s ℓ c j hj, stageRadius_last c j hj]
    exact ⟨fun _ => EReal.coe_lt_top _, fun _ => Set.mem_univ y⟩
  · have hlt : j.val + 1 < m := lt_of_le_of_ne j.isLt hj
    rw [cappedCentredCover_succ_of_lt a s ℓ c j hlt, stageRadius_succ_of_lt c j hlt,
      EReal.coe_lt_coe_iff]
    exact mem_centredInterval_iff a s ℓ

name: TDA.Mapper.eq_zero_of_stageRadius_le
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  rw [stageRadius_zero, le_bot_iff] at h
  rcases EReal.add_eq_bot_iff.mp h with h | h
  · exact (stageRadius_eq_bot_iff c).mp h
  · exact absurd h (EReal.coe_ne_bot δ)

name: TDA.Mapper.mem_cappedCentredCover_of_stageRadius_le
statement:
theorem mem_cappedCentredCover_of_stageRadius_le {m' : ℕ} {d : Fin m' ↪o ℝ} {δ : ℝ}
    {i : Fin (m + 1)} {j : Fin (m' + 1)} (h : stageRadius c i + δ ≤ stageRadius d j)
    (w : cappedIndex W i) {y z : ℝ} (hyz : |z - y| ≤ δ)
    (hy : y ∈ cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w) :
    z ∈ cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d j (stageSelector i j (eq_zero_of_stageRadius_le h) w)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩ := i.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
  · exact isEmptyElim w
  obtain rfl | ⟨j', rfl⟩ := j.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
  · exact absurd (eq_zero_of_stageRadius_le h rfl) (Fin.succ_ne_zero i')
  have hy' := (mem_cappedCentredCover_succ_iff a s ℓ c i' w y).mp hy
  refine (mem_cappedCentredCover_succ_iff a s ℓ d j' w z).mpr ?_
  have hz : |z - (a + ℓ w * s)| ≤ |y - (a + ℓ w * s)| + δ := by
    calc |z - (a + ℓ w * s)| ≤ |z - y| + |y - (a + ℓ w * s)| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
      _ ≤ |y - (a + ℓ w * s)| + δ := by linarith
  calc ((|z - (a + ℓ w * s)| : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ ((|y - (a + ℓ w * s)| + δ : ℝ) : EReal) :=
        EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr hz
    _ = ((|y - (a + ℓ w * s)| : ℝ) : EReal) + δ := EReal.coe_add _ _
    _ < stageRadius c i'.succ + δ := EReal.add_lt_add_right_coe hy' δ
    _ ≤ stageRadius d j'.succ := h

name: TDA.Mapper.cappedCentredDiagram_eq_pullback
statement:
theorem cappedCentredDiagram_eq_pullback :
    cappedCentredDiagram k f a s ℓ c n =
      @stepMapperDiagram X X _ _ k _ (ContinuousMap.id X) m c (cappedIndex W)
        (fun i => pullback f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ)) hf
        (fun h => pullbackRefinement f (cappedCentredRefinement a s ℓ c h)) n hF
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le_of_stageRadius_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le_of_stageRadius_le {f g : C(X, ℝ)} {m m' : ℕ}
    {c : Fin m ↪o ℝ} {d : Fin m' ↪o ℝ}
    [hf : ∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))]
    [hF : ∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    [hg : ∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ))]
    [hG : ∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    {δ η : ℝ≥0} (hfg : ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ δ)
    (hcd : ∀ t, stageRadius c (cellIndex c t) + (δ : ℝ) ≤ stageRadius d (cellIndex d (t + η)))
    (hdc : ∀ t, stageRadius d (cellIndex d t) + (δ : ℝ) ≤ stageRadius c (cellIndex c (t + η))) :
    bottleneck (cappedCentredDiagram k f a s ℓ c n) (cappedCentredDiagram k g a s ℓ d n) ≤ η
proof:
:= by
  have hgf : ∀ x, |g x - f x| ≤ δ := fun x => by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact hfg x
  rw [cappedCentredDiagram_eq_pullback, cappedCentredDiagram_eq_pullback]
  let : ∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex (ContinuousMap.id X)
      (pullback f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))) := hf
  let : ∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper (ContinuousMap.id X)
      (pullback f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))) n) := hF
  let : ∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex (ContinuousMap.id X)
      (pullback g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ))) := hg
  let : ∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper (ContinuousMap.id X)
      (pullback g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ))) n) := hG
  exact bottleneck_stepMapperDiagram_le k (ContinuousMap.id X) n _ _
    (fun t => cappedCentredPullbackRefinement a s ℓ c d hfg (hcd t))
    (fun t => cappedCentredPullbackRefinement a s ℓ d c hgf (hdc t))

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_eq
statement:
theorem bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_eq {f g : C(X, ℝ)} {m m' : ℕ}
    {c : Fin m ↪o ℝ} {d : Fin m' ↪o ℝ}
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ)) n)] :
    bottleneck (cappedCentredDiagram k f a s ℓ c n) (cappedCentredDiagram k g a s ℓ d n) =
      realInterleavingDistance
        (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower c fun i w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))
          (stepRefinement c _ fun h => cappedCentredRefinement a s ℓ c h) n)
        (mapperHomologyPModule k g (stepTower d fun i w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ))
          (stepRefinement d _ fun h => cappedCentredRefinement a s ℓ d h) n)
proof:
:=
  bottleneck_eq_distance (isConstructible_stepTower c _ k f _ n)
    (isConstructible_stepTower d _ k g _ n) _ _

name: TDA.Mapper.cellIndex_cases
statement:
private theorem cellIndex_cases {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    cellIndex c t = 0 ∨ (∃ j : Fin m, j.val + 1 = m ∧ cellIndex c t = j.succ ∧ c j ≤ t) ∨
      ∃ (j : Fin m) (hj : j.val + 1 < m),
        cellIndex c t = j.succ ∧ c j ≤ t ∧ t < c ⟨j.val + 1, hj⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain h | ⟨j, hj⟩ := (cellIndex c t).eq_zero_or_eq_succ
  · exact Or.inl h
  have hc := (cellIndex_eq_succ_iff c j t).mp hj
  by_cases hl : j.val + 1 = m
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨j, hl, hj, hc.1⟩)
  · have hlt : j.val + 1 < m := lt_of_le_of_ne j.isLt hl
    exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨j, hlt, hj, hc.1, hc.2 _ (Fin.lt_def.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_self _))⟩)

name: TDA.Mapper.stageRadius_cellIndex_of_last_le
statement:
private theorem stageRadius_cellIndex_of_last_le {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ) (j : Fin m)
    (hj : j.val + 1 = m) {u : ℝ} (hu : c j ≤ u) : stageRadius c (cellIndex c u) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have : cellIndex c u = j.succ := (cellIndex_eq_succ_iff c j u).mpr
    ⟨hu, fun k hk => absurd (Fin.lt_def.mp hk) (by have := k.isLt; omega)⟩
  rw [this, stageRadius_last c j hj]

name: TDA.Mapper.le_stageRadius_cellIndex
statement:
private theorem le_stageRadius_cellIndex {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ) (q : Fin m) {u : ℝ}
    (hu : c q ≤ u) : (c q : EReal) ≤ stageRadius c (cellIndex c u)
proof:
:= by
  have hq := (lt_cellIndex_iff c q u).mpr hu
  rcases cellIndex_cases c u with h | ⟨j, hj, h, _⟩ | ⟨j, hj, h, _, _⟩
  · rw [h] at hq
    exact absurd hq (by simp)
  · rw [h, stageRadius_last c j hj]
    exact le_top
  · rw [h, stageRadius_succ_of_lt c j hj]
    rw [h, Fin.val_succ] at hq
    exact EReal.coe_le_coe_iff.mpr (c.monotone (Fin.le_def.mpr (by omega)))

name: TDA.Mapper.stageRadius_add_le_of_mesh
proof:
:= by
  rcases cellIndex_cases c t with h | ⟨i, hi, h, hit⟩ | ⟨i, hi, h, hit, _⟩
  · rw [h, stageRadius_zero, EReal.bot_add]
    exact bot_le
  · have hi' : i = Fin.last m := Fin.ext (by simp; omega)
    subst hi'
    rw [stageRadius_cellIndex_of_last_le d (Fin.last m') (by simp) (by linarith)]
    exact le_top
  · rw [h, stageRadius_succ_of_lt c i hi]
    have hc0 : c 0 ≤ t := (c.monotone (Fin.zero_le i)).trans hit
    rcases cellIndex_cases d (t + η) with h' | ⟨j, hj, h', _⟩ | ⟨j, hj, h', _, hlt⟩
    · have := ((cellIndex_eq_zero_iff d _).mp h') 0
      linarith
    · rw [h', stageRadius_last d j hj]
      exact le_top
    · rw [h', stageRadius_succ_of_lt d j hj, ← EReal.coe_add, EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
      have := hgap j ⟨j.val + 1, hj⟩ rfl
      linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.stageRadius_add_le_of_gap
statement:
theorem stageRadius_add_le_of_gap {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ) {δ μ : ℝ} (hδμ : 0 ≤ δ + μ)
    (hgap : ∀ i j : Fin m, j.val = i.val + 1 → c j ≤ c i + μ) (t : ℝ) :
    stageRadius c (cellIndex c t) + δ ≤ stageRadius c (cellIndex c (t + (δ + μ)))
proof:
:= by
  cases m with
  | zero =>
    rw [cellIndex_empty, stageRadius_zero, EReal.bot_add]
    exact bot_le
  | succ m => exact stageRadius_add_le_of_mesh c c hgap le_rfl (by linarith) (by linarith) t

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le {f g : C(X, ℝ)} {m : ℕ} {c : Fin m ↪o ℝ}
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    {δ μ : ℝ≥0} (hfg : ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ δ)
    (hgap : ∀ i j : Fin m, j.val = i.val + 1 → c j ≤ c i + μ) :
    bottleneck (cappedCentredDiagram k f a s ℓ c n) (cappedCentredDiagram k g a s ℓ c n) ≤
      (δ : ℝ≥0∞) + μ
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ t, stageRadius c (cellIndex c t) + ((δ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) ≤
      stageRadius c (cellIndex c (t + ((δ + μ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) := fun t => by
    rw [NNReal.coe_add]
    exact stageRadius_add_le_of_gap c (by positivity) hgap t
  rw [← ENNReal.coe_add]
  exact bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le_of_stageRadius_le k a s ℓ n hfg h h

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_grid_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_grid_le {f : C(X, ℝ)} {m m' : ℕ}
    {c : Fin (m + 1) ↪o ℝ} {d : Fin (m' + 1) ↪o ℝ}
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    {η : ℝ≥0} (hc : ∀ i j : Fin (m + 1), j.val = i.val + 1 → c j ≤ c i + η)
    (hd : ∀ i j : Fin (m' + 1), j.val = i.val + 1 → d j ≤ d i + η)
    (hfirst : |c 0 - d 0| ≤ η) (hlast : |c (Fin.last m) - d (Fin.last m')| ≤ η) :
    bottleneck (cappedCentredDiagram k f a s ℓ c n) (cappedCentredDiagram k f a s ℓ d n) ≤ η
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_le] at hfirst hlast
  refine bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le_of_stageRadius_le k a s ℓ n (δ := 0)
    (fun x => by simp) (fun t => ?_) (fun t => ?_)
  · simpa using stageRadius_add_le_of_mesh c d hd (δ := 0) (by simp) (by linarith)
      (by linarith) t
  · simpa using stageRadius_add_le_of_mesh d c hc (δ := 0) (by simp) (by linarith)
      (by linarith) t

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le_add
statement:
theorem bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le_add {f g : C(X, ℝ)} {m m' : ℕ}
    {c : Fin (m + 1) ↪o ℝ} {d : Fin (m' + 1) ↪o ℝ}
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    {δ μ η : ℝ≥0} (hfg : ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ δ)
    (hgap : ∀ i j : Fin (m + 1), j.val = i.val + 1 → c j ≤ c i + μ)
    (hc : ∀ i j : Fin (m + 1), j.val = i.val + 1 → c j ≤ c i + η)
    (hd : ∀ i j : Fin (m' + 1), j.val = i.val + 1 → d j ≤ d i + η)
    (hfirst : |c 0 - d 0| ≤ η) (hlast : |c (Fin.last m) - d (Fin.last m')| ≤ η) :
    bottleneck (cappedCentredDiagram k f a s ℓ c n) (cappedCentredDiagram k g a s ℓ d n) ≤
      ((δ : ℝ≥0∞) + μ) + η
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_triangle _ (cappedCentredDiagram k g a s ℓ c n) _).trans
    (add_le_add (bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le k a s ℓ n hfg hgap)
      (bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_grid_le k a s ℓ n hc hd hfirst hlast))

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformGrid_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem uniformGrid_apply (x₀ h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) {m : ℕ} (i : Fin m) :
    uniformGrid x₀ h hh m i = x₀ + (i : ℕ) * h
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.uniformGrid_of_val_eq_succ
statement:
theorem uniformGrid_of_val_eq_succ (x₀ h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) {m : ℕ} {i j : Fin m}
    (hij : j.val = i.val + 1) : uniformGrid x₀ h hh m j = uniformGrid x₀ h hh m i + h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [uniformGrid_apply, hij]
  push_cast
  ring

name: TDA.Mapper.stageRadius_add_le_uniformGrid
statement:
theorem stageRadius_add_le_uniformGrid (x₀ h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (m p : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    stageRadius (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) (cellIndex (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) t) + (p * h : ℝ) ≤
      stageRadius (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) (cellIndex (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) (t + p * h))
proof:
:= by
  set c := uniformGrid x₀ h hh m
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p * h := by positivity
  rcases cellIndex_cases c t with h₀ | ⟨j, hj, h₀, hjt⟩ | ⟨j, hj, h₀, hjt, _⟩
  · rw [h₀, stageRadius_zero, EReal.bot_add]
    exact bot_le
  · rw [stageRadius_cellIndex_of_last_le c j hj (u := t + p * h) (by linarith)]
    exact le_top
  · rw [h₀, stageRadius_succ_of_lt c j hj]
    have hjt' : x₀ + (j : ℕ) * h ≤ t := hjt
    by_cases hq : j.val + p < m
    · have hcq : c ⟨j.val + p, hq⟩ = c j + p * h := by
        simp only [c, uniformGrid_apply]
        push_cast
        ring
      have := le_stageRadius_cellIndex c ⟨j.val + p, hq⟩ (u := t + p * h) (by rw [hcq]; linarith)
      rwa [hcq, EReal.coe_add] at this
    · have hm : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
      have hL : c ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩ ≤ t + p * h := by
        simp only [c, uniformGrid_apply]
        have : ((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℕ) + p := by
          rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
          push_cast
          have : (m : ℝ) ≤ (j : ℕ) + p + 1 := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : m ≤ j.val + p + 1)
          linarith
        nlinarith
      rw [stageRadius_cellIndex_of_last_le c ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩ hm hL]
      exact le_top

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_uniformGrid_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_uniformGrid_le {f g : C(X, ℝ)} (x₀ h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (m : ℕ)
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper f fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex g fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper g fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    {δ : ℝ≥0} (hfg : ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ δ) (p : ℕ) (hδ : (δ : ℝ) = p * h) :
    bottleneck (cappedCentredDiagram k f a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) n)
      (cappedCentredDiagram k g a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) n) ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  have H : ∀ t, stageRadius (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) (cellIndex (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) t) +
      ((δ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) ≤ stageRadius (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m)
        (cellIndex (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) (t + ((δ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) := fun t => by
    rw [hδ]
    exact stageRadius_add_le_uniformGrid x₀ h hh m p t
  exact bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le_of_stageRadius_le k a s ℓ n hfg H H

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_plHeight_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_plHeight_le (hh : ∀ v, |h₁ v - h₂ v| ≤ ε) {m : ℕ}
    {c : Fin m ↪o ℝ}
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex (GraphPL.plHeight G h₁) fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex (GraphPL.plHeight G h₂) fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))]
    {μ : ℝ≥0} (hgap : ∀ i j : Fin m, j.val = i.val + 1 → c j ≤ c i + μ) :
    bottleneck (cappedCentredDiagram k (GraphPL.plHeight G h₁) a s ℓ c n)
      (cappedCentredDiagram k (GraphPL.plHeight G h₂) a s ℓ c n) ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞) + μ
proof:
:=
  bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le k a s ℓ n (GraphPL.abs_plHeight_sub_le G hh) hgap

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_plHeight_uniformGrid_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_plHeight_uniformGrid_le (hh : ∀ v, |h₁ v - h₂ v| ≤ ε)
    (x₀ h : ℝ) (hpos : 0 < h) (m : ℕ)
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex (GraphPL.plHeight G h₁) fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hpos m) i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex (GraphPL.plHeight G h₂) fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hpos m) i w : Set ℝ))]
    (p : ℕ) (hε : (ε : ℝ) = p * h) :
    bottleneck (cappedCentredDiagram k (GraphPL.plHeight G h₁) a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hpos m) n)
      (cappedCentredDiagram k (GraphPL.plHeight G h₂) a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hpos m) n) ≤ ε
proof:
:=
  bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_uniformGrid_le k a s ℓ n x₀ h hpos m
    (GraphPL.abs_plHeight_sub_le G hh) p hε

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.card_zero_of
statement: private theorem card_zero_of {P : α → Prop} (hP : ∀ x, ¬ P x) : Nat.card {x // P x} = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : IsEmpty {x // P x} := ⟨fun x => hP x.1 x.2⟩
  exact Nat.card_of_isEmpty

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.card_one_of
statement:
private theorem card_one_of {P : α → Prop} {a : α} (ha : P a) (hP : ∀ x, P x → x = a) :
    Nat.card {x // P x} = 1
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.2
    ⟨⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext ((hP x.1 x.2).trans (hP y.1 y.2).symm)⟩, ⟨⟨a, ha⟩⟩⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.card_two_of
statement:
private theorem card_two_of {P : α → Prop} {a b : α} (hab : a ≠ b) (ha : P a) (hb : P b)
    (hP : ∀ x, P x → x = a ∨ x = b) : Nat.card {x // P x} = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_eq_two_iff]
  refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩, fun h => hab (congrArg Subtype.val h), ?_⟩
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  rcases hP x.1 x.2 with h | h
  · exact .inl (Subtype.ext h)
  · exact .inr (Subtype.ext h)

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.card_eq_add_of_equiv
statement:
private theorem card_eq_add_of_equiv {β γ : Type*} [Finite β] [Finite γ] (e : α ≃ β ⊕ γ)
    {m k : ℕ} (hm : Nat.card β = m) (hk : Nat.card γ = k) : Nat.card α = m + k
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr e, Nat.card_sum, hm, hk]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.card_induce_of_not_adj
statement:
private theorem card_induce_of_not_adj {S : Set V} (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ¬ G.Adj x y) :
    Nat.card (G.induce S).ConnectedComponent = Nat.card S
proof:
:= by
  refine (Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective (G.induce S).connectedComponentMk
    ⟨fun x y hxy => ?_, fun c => ?_⟩)).symm
  · obtain ⟨p⟩ := ConnectedComponent.exact hxy
    cases p with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons hadj _ => exact (hS _ (Subtype.prop _) _ (Subtype.prop _) hadj).elim
  · induction c using ConnectedComponent.ind with
    | h v => exact ⟨v, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.card_induce_singleton
statement:
private theorem card_induce_singleton {S : Set V} {v₀ : V} (hv₀ : v₀ ∈ S)
    (hS : ∀ v ∈ S, v = v₀) : Nat.card (G.induce S).ConnectedComponent = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_induce_of_not_adj fun x hx y hy hxy => G.loopless.irrefl x
    (by rw [hS x hx, ← hS y hy] at hxy ⊢; exact hxy)]
  exact card_one_of (P := (· ∈ S)) hv₀ hS

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.card_induce_complete
proof:
:= by
  refine Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.2 ⟨⟨ConnectedComponent.ind₂ fun x y => ?_⟩,
    ⟨(G.induce S).connectedComponentMk ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩⟩⟩
  by_cases hxy : (x : V) = y
  · rw [Subtype.ext hxy]
  · exact ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj (hS x x.2 y y.2 hxy)

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.not_edgeCrosses_of_le
statement:
private theorem not_edgeCrosses_of_le {c : ℝ} (hc : ∀ v, c ≤ h v) (e : G.edgeSet) :
    ¬ EdgeCrosses G h c e
proof:
:= fun ⟨d, _, hmin, _⟩ => by
  rcases min_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm <;> rw [hm] at hmin <;>
    linarith [hc d.fst, hc d.snd]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.not_edgeCrosses_of_ge
statement:
private theorem not_edgeCrosses_of_ge {c : ℝ} (hc : ∀ v, h v ≤ c) (e : G.edgeSet) :
    ¬ EdgeCrosses G h c e
proof:
:= fun ⟨d, _, _, hmax⟩ => by
  rcases max_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm <;> rw [hm] at hmax <;>
    linarith [hc d.fst, hc d.snd]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq
statement:
private theorem not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq {c : ℝ} {d : G.Dart}
    (hd : h d.fst = c ∨ h d.snd = c) : ¬ EdgeCrosses G h c (dartEdge d)
proof:
:= fun hcr => by
  obtain ⟨hmin, hmax⟩ := (edgeCrosses_dartEdge_iff d).1 hcr
  rcases hd with hd | hd <;> rw [hd] at hmin hmax
  · rcases min_lt_iff.1 hmin with h' | h'
    · exact lt_irrefl _ h'
    · rcases lt_max_iff.1 hmax with h'' | h''
      · exact lt_irrefl _ h''
      · linarith
  · rcases min_lt_iff.1 hmin with h' | h'
    · rcases lt_max_iff.1 hmax with h'' | h''
      · linarith
      · exact lt_irrefl _ h''
    · exact lt_irrefl _ h'

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.dartEdge_ne
statement:
private theorem dartEdge_ne {d d' : G.Dart} (h₁ : d.toProd ≠ d'.toProd)
    (h₂ : d.toProd ≠ d'.toProd.swap) : dartEdge d ≠ dartEdge d'
proof:
:= fun hdd => by
  rcases dartEdge_eq_iff.1 hdd with h | h
  · exact h₁ (congrArg Dart.toProd h)
  · exact h₂ (congrArg Dart.toProd h)

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.sep₁_of
proof:
:=
  fun k v w hv hw => (hc k k.2 v hv).trans (hc k k.2 w hw).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.sep₂_of
statement:
private theorem sep₂_of {a r g : ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hgr : g ≤ r)
    (hl : ∀ l : ℕ, 1 ≤ l → l < n → ∀ v,
      h v ∉ ioo (a + (l : ℝ) * (r - g)) (a + (l : ℝ) * (r - g) + g)) :
    ∀ k l : Fin n, (k : ℕ) + 1 = l → ∀ v, h v ∉ uniformCover a r g n k ⊓ uniformCover a r g n l
proof:
:=
  fun k l hkl v hv => hl l (by omega) l.2 v (by rwa [uniformCover_inf_of_succ hgr hkl] at hv)

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.h4_cases
statement: private theorem h4_cases (v : Fin 4) : h4 v = 0 ∨ h4 v = 1 ∨ h4 v = 2
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases v <;> norm_num [h4]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.h4_nonneg
statement: private theorem h4_nonneg (v : Fin 4) : 0 ≤ h4 v
proof:
:= by
  rcases h4_cases v with h | h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.h4_le_two
statement: private theorem h4_le_two (v : Fin 4) : h4 v ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases h4_cases v with h | h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.c4_range
statement: theorem c4_range : Set.range (plHeight C4 h4) = Set.Icc 0 2
proof:
:= by
  have := range_plHeight_eq_Icc (G := C4) (h := h4) cycleGraph_connected (lo := 0) (hi := 2)
    h4_nonneg h4_le_two
  rwa [h4_zero, h4_two] at this

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.c4_heightSeparating
statement: theorem c4_heightSeparating : HeightSeparating h4 U₃
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨sep₁_of (fun k => k) fun k hk v hv => ?_, sep₂_of (by norm_num) fun l h1 h2 v hv => ?_⟩
  · rw [mem_uniformInterval] at hv
    obtain rfl | rfl | rfl : k = 0 ∨ k = 1 ∨ k = 2 := by omega
    all_goals rcases h4_cases v with h | h | h <;> rw [h] at hv ⊢ <;>
      first | (norm_num at hv; done) | norm_num
  · rw [mem_ioo] at hv
    obtain rfl | rfl : l = 1 ∨ l = 2 := by omega
    all_goals rcases h4_cases v with h | h | h <;> rw [h] at hv <;> norm_num at hv

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.h4_mem_U₃_zero
statement: private theorem h4_mem_U₃_zero : h4 0 ∈ U₃ 0
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.h4_mem_U₃_one
statement: private theorem h4_mem_U₃_one : h4 1 ∈ U₃ 1
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.h4_mem_U₃_two
statement: private theorem h4_mem_U₃_two : h4 2 ∈ U₃ 2
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.c4_level_one_card
statement:
private theorem c4_level_one_card :
    Nat.card (C4.induce {v | h4 v = h4 1}).ConnectedComponent = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlev : ∀ v : Fin 4, h4 v = h4 1 ↔ v = 1 ∨ v = 3 := by
    intro v
    fin_cases v <;> norm_num [h4] <;> decide
  rw [card_induce_of_not_adj fun x hx y hy hxy => ?_]
  · exact card_two_of (P := fun v => h4 v = h4 1) (a := 1) (b := 3) (by decide) rfl
      (h4_three.trans h4_one.symm) fun x hx => (hlev x).1 hx
  · rcases (hlev x).1 hx with rfl | rfl <;> rcases (hlev y).1 hy with rfl | rfl <;>
      revert hxy <;> decide

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.c4_vertexCells_zero
statement:
theorem c4_vertexCells_zero :
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0}} = 1
proof:
:=
  card_eq_add_of_equiv
    (uniformVertexCellsEquivLevel C4 h4 c4_heightSeparating 0 0 h4_mem_U₃_zero)
    (card_induce_singleton (v₀ := 0) rfl fun v hv => by
      have hv' : h4 v = 0 := hv
      fin_cases v <;> first | rfl | (norm_num [h4] at hv'))
    (card_zero_of (not_edgeCrosses_of_le h4_nonneg))

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.c4_vertexCells_one
statement:
theorem c4_vertexCells_one :
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1}} = 2
proof:
:=
  card_eq_add_of_equiv
    (uniformVertexCellsEquivLevel C4 h4 c4_heightSeparating 1 1 h4_mem_U₃_one)
    c4_level_one_card
    (card_zero_of fun e => by
      obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hw13⟩ := C4_edge_endpoint d
      refine not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq ?_
      rcases mem_dartEdge.1 hw with rfl | rfl
      · exact .inl (by rcases hw13 with h | h <;> simp [h])
      · exact .inr (by rcases hw13 with h | h <;> simp [h]))

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.c4_vertexCells_two
statement:
theorem c4_vertexCells_two :
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {2}} = 1
proof:
:=
  card_eq_add_of_equiv
    (uniformVertexCellsEquivLevel C4 h4 c4_heightSeparating 2 2 h4_mem_U₃_two)
    (card_induce_singleton (v₀ := 2) rfl fun v hv => by
      have hv' : h4 v = 2 := hv
      fin_cases v <;> first | rfl | (norm_num [h4] at hv'))
    (card_zero_of (not_edgeCrosses_of_ge h4_le_two))

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.c4_vertexCells_eq_preimage
statement:
theorem c4_vertexCells_eq_preimage :
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0}} =
        Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy {x : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ U₃ 0}) ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1}} =
        Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy {x : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ U₃ 1}) ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {2}} =
        Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy {x : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ U₃ 2})
proof:
:= by
  rw [c4_vertexCells_zero, c4_vertexCells_one, c4_vertexCells_two,
    UniformCoverExamples.threeMember_card_zero, UniformCoverExamples.threeMember_card_one,
    UniformCoverExamples.threeMember_card_two]
  exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.c4_edges_ne_low
statement: private theorem c4_edges_ne_low : dartEdge d01 ≠ dartEdge d03
proof:
:=
  dartEdge_ne (by decide) (by decide)

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.c4_edges_ne_high
statement: private theorem c4_edges_ne_high : dartEdge d12 ≠ dartEdge d23
proof:
:=
  dartEdge_ne (by decide) (by decide)

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.c4_edgeCells01
statement:
theorem c4_edgeCells01 :
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} =
      2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (uniformEdgeCellsEquivSpans C4 h4 c4_heightSeparating (by norm_num)
    (by norm_num) (k := 0) (l := 1) rfl)]
  refine card_two_of c4_edges_ne_low ?_ ?_ fun e he => ?_
  · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
    norm_num [d01]
  · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
    norm_num [d03]
  · rcases c4_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact .inl rfl
    · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at he
      norm_num [d12] at he
    · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at he
      norm_num [d23] at he
    · exact .inr rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.c4_edgeCells12
statement:
theorem c4_edgeCells12 :
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1, 2}} =
      2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (uniformEdgeCellsEquivSpans C4 h4 c4_heightSeparating (by norm_num)
    (by norm_num) (k := 1) (l := 2) rfl)]
  refine card_two_of c4_edges_ne_high ?_ ?_ fun e he => ?_
  · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
    norm_num [d12]
  · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
    norm_num [d23]
  · rcases c4_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at he
      norm_num [d01] at he
    · exact .inl rfl
    · exact .inr rfl
    · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at he
      norm_num [d03] at he

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.c4_threeMember
statement:
theorem c4_threeMember :
    Set.range (plHeight C4 h4) = Set.Icc 0 2 ∧ HeightSeparating h4 U₃ ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0}} = 1 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1}} = 2 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {2}} = 1 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} = 2 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1, 2}} = 2
proof:
:=
  ⟨c4_range, c4_heightSeparating, c4_vertexCells_zero, c4_vertexCells_one, c4_vertexCells_two,
    c4_edgeCells01, c4_edgeCells12⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.edgeGraph_edge
statement: private theorem edgeGraph_edge (e : edgeGraph.edgeSet) : e = dartEdge d₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
  rcases edgeGraph_dart d with rfl | rfl
  · rfl
  · exact dartEdge_symm d₀

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.h02_cases
statement: private theorem h02_cases (v : Bool) : h02 v = 0 ∨ h02 v = 2
proof:
:= by
  cases v
  · exact .inl rfl
  · exact .inr rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.h02_nonneg
statement: private theorem h02_nonneg (v : Bool) : 0 ≤ h02 v
proof:
:= by
  rcases h02_cases v with h | h <;> norm_num [h]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.h02_le_two
statement: private theorem h02_le_two (v : Bool) : h02 v ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases h02_cases v with h | h <;> norm_num [h]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.edge_heightSeparating
statement: theorem edge_heightSeparating : HeightSeparating h02 U₃
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨sep₁_of (fun k => k) fun k hk v hv => ?_, sep₂_of (by norm_num) fun l h1 h2 v hv => ?_⟩
  · rw [mem_uniformInterval] at hv
    obtain rfl | rfl | rfl : k = 0 ∨ k = 1 ∨ k = 2 := by omega
    all_goals rcases h02_cases v with h | h <;> rw [h] at hv ⊢ <;>
      first | (norm_num at hv; done) | norm_num
  · rw [mem_ioo] at hv
    obtain rfl | rfl : l = 1 ∨ l = 2 := by omega
    all_goals rcases h02_cases v with h | h <;> rw [h] at hv <;> norm_num at hv

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.edge_not_mem_one
statement: theorem edge_not_mem_one (v : Bool) : h02 v ∉ U₃ 1
proof:
:= fun hv => by
  rw [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval] at hv
  rcases h02_cases v with h | h <;> rw [h] at hv <;> norm_num at hv

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.edge_vertexCells_one
statement:
theorem edge_vertexCells_one :
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1}} = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (uniformVertexCellsEquivSpans edgeGraph h02 1 edge_not_mem_one
    (by norm_num))]
  refine card_one_of (a := dartEdge d₀) ?_ fun e _ => edgeGraph_edge e
  rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
  norm_num [d₀, h02]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.edge_vertexCells_zero
statement:
theorem edge_vertexCells_zero :
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0}} = 1
proof:
:=
  card_eq_add_of_equiv
    (uniformVertexCellsEquivLevel edgeGraph h02 edge_heightSeparating 0 false
      (by norm_num [h02, uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval]))
    (card_induce_singleton (v₀ := false) rfl fun v hv => by
      cases v
      · rfl
      · norm_num [h02] at hv)
    (card_zero_of (not_edgeCrosses_of_le h02_nonneg))

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.edge_vertexCells_two
statement:
theorem edge_vertexCells_two :
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {2}} = 1
proof:
:=
  card_eq_add_of_equiv
    (uniformVertexCellsEquivLevel edgeGraph h02 edge_heightSeparating 2 true
      (by norm_num [h02, uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval]))
    (card_induce_singleton (v₀ := true) rfl fun v hv => by
      cases v
      · norm_num [h02] at hv
      · rfl)
    (card_zero_of (not_edgeCrosses_of_ge h02_le_two))

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.edge_threeMember
statement:
theorem edge_threeMember :
    HeightSeparating h02 U₃ ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0}} = 1 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1}} = 1 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {2}} = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨edge_heightSeparating, edge_vertexCells_zero, edge_vertexCells_one, edge_vertexCells_two⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.Y_adj
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [Y, fromEdgeSet_adj]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.Y_edge_cases
statement: theorem Y_edge_cases (e : Y.edgeSet) : e = dartEdge y02 ∨ e = dartEdge y12 ∨ e = dartEdge y23
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab⟩, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
  rcases (Y_adj a b).1 hab with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ |
      ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact .inl rfl
  · exact .inl (Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap)
  · exact .inr (.inl rfl)
  · exact .inr (.inl (Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap))
  · exact .inr (.inr rfl)
  · exact .inr (.inr (Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap))

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.Y_connected
statement: theorem Y_connected : Y.Connected
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ∀ u : Fin 4, Y.Reachable u 2 := by
    intro u
    fin_cases u
    · exact ((Y_adj 0 2).2 (by decide)).reachable
    · exact ((Y_adj 1 2).2 (by decide)).reachable
    · exact Reachable.refl _
    · exact ((Y_adj 3 2).2 (by decide)).reachable
  exact ⟨fun u v => (hr u).trans (hr v).symm⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.hY_zero

proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.hY_one
statement: @[simp] private theorem hY_one : hY 1 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.hY_two
statement: @[simp] private theorem hY_two : hY 2 = 2
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.hY_three
statement: @[simp] private theorem hY_three : hY 3 = 3
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.hY_cases
statement: private theorem hY_cases (v : Fin 4) : hY v = 0 ∨ hY v = 1 ∨ hY v = 2 ∨ hY v = 3
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.hY_nonneg
statement: private theorem hY_nonneg (v : Fin 4) : 0 ≤ hY v
proof:

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.hY_le_three

statement: private theorem hY_injective {v w : Fin 4} (h : hY v = hY w) : v = w
proof:

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.Y_range
statement: theorem Y_range : Set.range (plHeight Y hY) = Set.Icc 0 3
proof:
:= by
  have := range_plHeight_eq_Icc (G := Y) (h := hY) Y_connected (lo := 0) (hi := 3)
    hY_nonneg hY_le_three
  rwa [hY_zero, hY_three] at this

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.Y_heightSeparating
statement: theorem Y_heightSeparating : HeightSeparating hY U₄
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨sep₁_of (fun k => k) fun k hk v hv => ?_, sep₂_of (by norm_num) fun l h1 h2 v hv => ?_⟩
  · rw [mem_uniformInterval] at hv
    obtain rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl : k = 0 ∨ k = 1 ∨ k = 2 ∨ k = 3 := by omega
    all_goals rcases hY_cases v with h | h | h | h <;> rw [h] at hv ⊢ <;>
      first | (norm_num at hv; done) | norm_num
  · rw [mem_ioo] at hv
    obtain rfl | rfl | rfl : l = 1 ∨ l = 2 ∨ l = 3 := by omega
    all_goals rcases hY_cases v with h | h | h | h <;> rw [h] at hv <;> norm_num at hv

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.Y_vertexCells_one
statement:
theorem Y_vertexCells_one :
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1}} = 2
proof:
:=
  card_eq_add_of_equiv (uniformVertexCellsEquivLevel Y hY Y_heightSeparating 1 1 (Y_mem 1))
    (Y_level_card 1)
    (card_one_of (a := dartEdge y02)
      (by rw [edgeCrosses_dartEdge_iff]; norm_num [y02])
      fun e he => by
        rcases Y_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl
        · rfl
        · exact absurd he (not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq (.inl rfl))
        · rw [edgeCrosses_dartEdge_iff] at he
          norm_num [y23] at he)

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.Y_vertexCells_other
statement:
theorem Y_vertexCells_other :
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0}} = 1 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {2}} = 1 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {3}} = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨card_eq_add_of_equiv (uniformVertexCellsEquivLevel Y hY Y_heightSeparating 0 0 (Y_mem 0))
      (Y_level_card 0) (card_zero_of (not_edgeCrosses_of_le hY_nonneg)),
    card_eq_add_of_equiv (uniformVertexCellsEquivLevel Y hY Y_heightSeparating 2 2 (Y_mem 2))
      (Y_level_card 2) (card_zero_of fun e => ?_),
    card_eq_add_of_equiv (uniformVertexCellsEquivLevel Y hY Y_heightSeparating 3 3 (Y_mem 3))
      (Y_level_card 3) (card_zero_of (not_edgeCrosses_of_ge fun v => by
        rw [hY_three]; exact hY_le_three v))⟩
  rcases Y_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq (.inr rfl)
  · exact not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq (.inr rfl)
  · exact not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq (.inl rfl)

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.Y_edges_ne
statement: private theorem Y_edges_ne : dartEdge y02 ≠ dartEdge y12
proof:
:=

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.Y_edgeCells
statement:
theorem Y_edgeCells :
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} = 1 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1, 2}} = 2 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {2, 3}} = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Nat.card_congr (uniformEdgeCellsEquivSpans Y hY Y_heightSeparating (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num) (k := 0) (l := 1) rfl)]
    refine card_one_of (a := dartEdge y02) ?_ fun e he => ?_
    · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
      norm_num [y02]
    · rcases Y_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rfl
      · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at he
        norm_num [y12] at he
      · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at he
        norm_num [y23] at he
  · rw [Nat.card_congr (uniformEdgeCellsEquivSpans Y hY Y_heightSeparating (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num) (k := 1) (l := 2) rfl)]
    refine card_two_of Y_edges_ne ?_ ?_ fun e he => ?_
    · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
      norm_num [y02]
    · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
      norm_num [y12]
    · rcases Y_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · exact .inl rfl
      · exact .inr rfl
      · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at he
        norm_num [y23] at he
  · rw [Nat.card_congr (uniformEdgeCellsEquivSpans Y hY Y_heightSeparating (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num) (k := 2) (l := 3) rfl)]
    refine card_one_of (a := dartEdge y23) ?_ fun e he => ?_
    · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
      norm_num [y23]
    · rcases Y_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at he
        norm_num [y02] at he
      · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at he
        norm_num [y12] at he
      · rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.Y_fourMember
statement:
theorem Y_fourMember :
    Set.range (plHeight Y hY) = Set.Icc 0 3 ∧ HeightSeparating hY U₄ ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1}} = 2 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0}} = 1 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {2}} = 1 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {3}} = 1 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} = 1 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1, 2}} = 2 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY) F₄ //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {2, 3}} = 1
proof:

  ⟨Y_range, Y_heightSeparating, Y_vertexCells_one, Y_vertexCells_other.1, Y_vertexCells_other.2.1,

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.edge_mem_J4

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.oneMember_edge
statement:
theorem oneMember_edge (g : ℝ) :
    ¬ HeightSeparating h02 (uniformCover (-1 / 2) 3 g 1) ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02)
          (fun k => (uniformCover (-1 / 2) 3 g 1 k : Set ℝ)) //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0}} = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ v, h02 v ∈ uniformCover (-1 / 2) 3 g 1 0 := fun v => by
    rw [oneMember_eq_J4]
    exact edge_mem_J4 v
  refine ⟨fun hs => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have := hs.1 0 false true (hmem false) (hmem true)
    norm_num [h02] at this
  · have hunc : IsEmpty (UncoveredEdge edgeGraph h02 (uniformCover (-1 / 2) 3 g 1 0)) :=
      ⟨fun e => by
        have he := edgeGraph_edge e.1
        exact e.2.2 false (he ▸ fst_mem_dartEdge d₀) (hmem false)⟩
    exact card_eq_add_of_equiv
      ((vertexCellsCellGraphEquiv edgeGraph h02 (uniformCover (-1 / 2) 3 g 1) 0).trans
        (cellComponentsEquivSum edgeGraph h02 _))
      (card_induce_complete (v₀ := false) (hmem false) fun x _ y _ hxy => hxy)
      Nat.card_of_isEmpty

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.overlap_inf
statement: theorem overlap_inf : W₃ 0 ⊓ W₃ 1 = ioo (3 / 4) (5 / 4)
proof:
:= by
  rw [uniformCover_inf_of_succ (by norm_num) (k := 0) (l := 1) rfl]
  congr 1 <;> norm_num

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.overlap_control
statement:
theorem overlap_control :
    h4 1 ∈ W₃ 0 ⊓ W₃ 1 ∧
      ¬ (∀ k l : Fin 3, (k : ℕ) + 1 = l → ∀ v, h4 v ∉ W₃ k ⊓ W₃ l) ∧
      ¬ HeightSeparating h4 W₃ ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) (fun k => (W₃ k : Set ℝ)) //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} = 2 ∧
      Nat.card {e // EdgeSpans C4 h4 (3 / 4) (5 / 4) e} = 0 ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) (fun k => (W₃ k : Set ℝ)) //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} ≠
        Nat.card {e // EdgeSpans C4 h4 (3 / 4) (5 / 4) e}
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : h4 1 ∈ W₃ 0 ⊓ W₃ 1 := by
    rw [overlap_inf, mem_ioo]
    norm_num
  have hclause : ¬ (∀ k l : Fin 3, (k : ℕ) + 1 = l → ∀ v, h4 v ∉ W₃ k ⊓ W₃ l) :=
    fun h => h 0 1 rfl 1 hmem
  
  have hlev : ∀ v : Fin 4, h4 v ∈ ioo (3 / 4) (5 / 4) ↔ v = 1 ∨ v = 3 := by
    intro v
    rw [mem_ioo]
    fin_cases v <;> norm_num [h4] <;> decide
  have hcells : Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) (fun k => (W₃ k : Set ℝ)) //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} = 2 := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr ((edgeCellsCellGraphEquiv C4 h4 W₃ 0 1).trans
      (cellComponentsEquivSum C4 h4 _)), overlap_inf]
    have hunc : IsEmpty (UncoveredEdge C4 h4 (ioo (3 / 4) (5 / 4))) :=
      ⟨fun e => by
        obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e.1
        obtain ⟨w, hw, hw13⟩ := C4_edge_endpoint d
        exact e.2.2 w (hd ▸ hw) ((hlev w).2 hw13)⟩
    rw [Nat.card_sum, Nat.card_of_isEmpty (α := UncoveredEdge C4 h4 _), add_zero,
      card_induce_of_not_adj fun x hx y hy hxy => ?_]
    · exact card_two_of (P := fun v => h4 v ∈ ioo (3 / 4) (5 / 4)) (by decide)
        ((hlev 1).2 (.inl rfl)) ((hlev 3).2 (.inr rfl)) fun x hx => (hlev x).1 hx
    · rcases (hlev x).1 hx with rfl | rfl <;> rcases (hlev y).1 hy with rfl | rfl <;>
        revert hxy <;> decide
  have hspans : Nat.card {e // EdgeSpans C4 h4 (3 / 4) (5 / 4) e} = 0 :=
    card_zero_of fun e he => by
      rcases c4_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at he
      · norm_num [d01] at he
      · norm_num [d12] at he
      · norm_num [d23] at he
      · norm_num [d03] at he
  exact ⟨hmem, hclause, fun hs => hclause hs.2, hcells, hspans, by rw [hcells, hspans]; decide⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.disconnected_range
statement:
theorem disconnected_range :
    (∀ v, hb 0 ≤ hb v) ∧ (∀ v, hb v ≤ hb 1) ∧
      (1 : ℝ) ∉ Set.range (plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)) hb) ∧
      Set.range (plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)) hb) ≠ Set.Icc (hb 0) (hb 1) ∧
      ¬ (⊥ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)).Connected
proof:
:= by
  have hlo : ∀ v, hb 0 ≤ hb v := fun v => by fin_cases v <;> norm_num [hb]
  have hhi : ∀ v, hb v ≤ hb 1 := fun v => by fin_cases v <;> norm_num [hb]
  have hnot : (1 : ℝ) ∉ Set.range (plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)) hb) := by
    rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    induction p using ind (⊥ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)) with
    | vertex v =>
      rw [plHeight_vertex] at hp
      fin_cases v <;> norm_num [hb] at hp
    | edgePoint d t => exact d.adj.elim
  have hne : Set.range (plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)) hb) ≠ Set.Icc (hb 0) (hb 1) :=
    fun heq => hnot (heq ▸ ⟨by norm_num [hb], by norm_num [hb]⟩)
  exact ⟨hlo, hhi, hnot, hne, fun hc => hne (range_plHeight_eq_Icc hc hlo hhi)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.edge_boundary
statement:
theorem edge_boundary :
    EdgeSpans edgeGraph h02 0 2 (dartEdge d₀) ∧
      Nat.card {e // EdgeActive edgeGraph h02 (ioo 0 2) e} = 1 ∧
      ¬ EdgeCrosses edgeGraph h02 0 (dartEdge d₀) ∧ ¬ EdgeCrosses edgeGraph h02 2 (dartEdge d₀) ∧
      EdgeCrosses edgeGraph h02 1 (dartEdge d₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hspans : EdgeSpans edgeGraph h02 0 2 (dartEdge d₀) := by
    rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
    norm_num [d₀, h02]
  refine ⟨hspans, ?_, not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq (.inl rfl),
    not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq (.inr rfl), ?_⟩
  · rw [Nat.card_congr (activeEdgeEquivSpans (G := edgeGraph) (h := h02) (by norm_num)
      fun v hv => by rw [mem_ioo] at hv; rcases h02_cases v with h | h <;> rw [h] at hv <;>
        norm_num at hv)]
    exact card_one_of hspans fun e _ => edgeGraph_edge e
  · rw [edgeCrosses_dartEdge_iff]
    norm_num [d₀, h02]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.edge_farLabels
statement:
theorem edge_farLabels :
    HeightSeparating h02 (uniformCover (-1 / 4) (3 / 2) 1 3) ∧
      uniformCover (-1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 2) 1 3 0 ⊓ uniformCover (-1 / 4) (3 / 2) 1 3 2 =
        ioo (3 / 4) (5 / 4) ∧
      Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02)
          (fun k => (uniformCover (-1 / 4) (3 / 2) 1 3 k : Set ℝ)) //
        c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 2}} = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsep : HeightSeparating h02 (uniformCover (-1 / 4) (3 / 2) 1 3) := by
    refine ⟨sep₁_of (fun k => k) fun k hk v hv => ?_,
      sep₂_of (by norm_num) fun l h1 h2 v hv => ?_⟩
    · rw [mem_uniformInterval] at hv
      obtain rfl | rfl | rfl : k = 0 ∨ k = 1 ∨ k = 2 := by omega
      all_goals rcases h02_cases v with h | h <;> rw [h] at hv ⊢ <;>
        first | (norm_num at hv; done) | norm_num
    · rw [mem_ioo] at hv
      obtain rfl | rfl : l = 1 ∨ l = 2 := by omega
      all_goals rcases h02_cases v with h | h <;> rw [h] at hv <;> norm_num at hv
  have hK : uniformCover (-1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 2) 1 3 0 ⊓ uniformCover (-1 / 4) (3 / 2) 1 3 2 =
      ioo (3 / 4) (5 / 4) := by
    apply SetLike.coe_injective
    ext y
    simp only [coe_inf, uniformCover_apply, coe_uniformInterval, coe_ioo, Set.mem_inter_iff,
      Set.mem_Ioo]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨h₁, h₂⟩, h₃, h₄⟩
      norm_num at h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
      norm_num
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> linarith
  have hnot : ∀ v, h02 v ∉ ioo (3 / 4) (5 / 4) := fun v hv => by
    rw [mem_ioo] at hv
    rcases h02_cases v with h | h <;> rw [h] at hv <;> norm_num at hv
  refine ⟨hsep, hK, ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.card_congr
      (edgeCellsCellGraphEquiv edgeGraph h02 (uniformCover (-1 / 4) (3 / 2) 1 3) 0 2),
    hK, Nat.card_congr ((cellGraphComponentsEquivActiveEdges hnot).trans
      (activeEdgeEquivSpans (by norm_num) hnot))]
  refine card_one_of (a := dartEdge d₀) ?_ fun e _ => edgeGraph_edge e
  rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
  norm_num [d₀, h02]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverCellsExamples.c4_exists_heightSeparating
statement:
theorem c4_exists_heightSeparating :
    ∃ (a r g : ℝ) (n : ℕ), 0 < g ∧ 2 * g ≤ r ∧ r < 1 / 2 ∧ 0 < n ∧
      HeightSeparating h4 (uniformCover a r g n) ∧
      Covers (fun k => (uniformCover a r g n k : Set ℝ)) (Set.range (plHeight C4 h4))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, r, g, n, hg, hgr, hrρ, hn, -, -, -, hsep, hcov⟩ :=
    heightSeparating_covers_range h4 (m := 0) (M := 2) (ρ := 1 / 2) h4_mem_Icc (by norm_num)
  exact ⟨a, r, g, n, hg, hgr, hrρ, hn, hsep, hcov C4⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.HeightMapPair.edge_to_point_distance_eq_half
statement:
theorem edge_to_point_distance_eq_half :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph tilted)
      (graphPLReebGraph pointGraph fun _ => (1 / 2 : ℝ)) = (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  have hup := geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le_of_heightMapPair edgePointPair
  have hRE : (heightRange (graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph tilted)).Nonempty := by
    rw [heightRange_graphPLReebGraph]
    exact range_nonempty_iff_nonempty.mpr ⟨vertex edgeGraph false⟩
  have hRP : (heightRange (graphPLReebGraph pointGraph fun _ => (1 / 2 : ℝ))).Nonempty := by
    rw [heightRange_graphPLReebGraph]
    exact range_nonempty_iff_nonempty.mpr ⟨vertex pointGraph ()⟩
  have hlow := ofReal_abs_sSup_sub_le_hausdorffEDist hRE hRP
    (bddAbove_heightRange _) (bddAbove_heightRange _)
  have hs₁ : Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty tilted = 1 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact Finset.sup'_le _ _ (fun b _ => by cases b <;> norm_num [tilted])
    · simp [tilted]
  have hs₂ : Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun _ : Unit => (1 / 2 : ℝ)) = 1 / 2 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact Finset.sup'_le _ _ (fun _ _ => le_rfl)
    · simp
  rw [heightRange_graphPLReebGraph, heightRange_graphPLReebGraph,
    sSup_range_plHeight, sSup_range_plHeight] at hlow
  rw [hs₁, hs₂] at hlow
  have hdist := hausdorffEDist_heightRange_le_geometricInterleavingDistance
    (graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph tilted)
    (graphPLReebGraph pointGraph fun _ => (1 / 2 : ℝ))
  rw [heightRange_graphPLReebGraph, heightRange_graphPLReebGraph] at hdist
  have hlow' := hlow.trans hdist
  have habs : |(1 : ℝ) - (1 / 2 : ℝ)| = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
  rw [habs] at hlow'
  have hval : ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2 : ℝ) = (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    rw [show (1 / 2 : ℝ) = ((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) by norm_num]
    simp
  rw [hval] at hlow'
  have hlow'' : (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph tilted)
        (graphPLReebGraph pointGraph fun _ => (1 / 2 : ℝ)) := hlow'
  have hup' : geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph tilted)
      (graphPLReebGraph pointGraph fun _ => (1 / 2 : ℝ)) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    simpa using hup
  exact le_antisymm hup' hlow''

name: TDA.Mapper.domainIndexMap_id
statement:
theorem domainIndexMap_id (U : I → Set Y) :
    domainIndexMap (ContinuousMap.id X) (fun _ => rfl) U = (id : ComponentIndex f U → _)
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  rcases a with ⟨i, c⟩
  refine Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq ?_)
  change componentMap _ c = c
  rw [show pullbackRestrict (ContinuousMap.id X) (fun _ => rfl) U i =
      ContinuousMap.id (PullbackSpace f U i) from rfl]
  exact congrFun componentMap_id c

name: TDA.Mapper.domainIndexMap_comp
statement:
theorem domainIndexMap_comp {X'' : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X''] {f'' : C(X'', Y)}
    (φ : C(X, X')) (hφ : ∀ x, f' (φ x) = f x) (ψ : C(X', X'')) (hψ : ∀ x, f'' (ψ x) = f' x)
    (U : I → Set Y) :
    domainIndexMap (ψ.comp φ) (fun x => (hψ _).trans (hφ x)) U =
      domainIndexMap ψ hψ U ∘ domainIndexMap φ hφ U
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  rcases a with ⟨i, c⟩
  refine Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq ?_)
  change componentMap _ c = componentMap (pullbackRestrict ψ hψ U i)
    (componentMap (pullbackRestrict φ hφ U i) c)
  rw [show pullbackRestrict (ψ.comp φ) (fun x => (hψ _).trans (hφ x)) U i =
      (pullbackRestrict ψ hψ U i).comp (pullbackRestrict φ hφ U i) from rfl]
  exact congrFun (componentMap_comp _ _) c

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperDomainMap_comp
statement:
theorem mapperDomainMap_comp {X'' : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X''] {f'' : C(X'', Y)}
    (φ : C(X, X')) (hφ : ∀ x, f' (φ x) = f x) (ψ : C(X', X'')) (hψ : ∀ x, f'' (ψ x) = f' x)
    (U : I → Set Y) :

    (hψ : ∀ x, f (ψ x) = f' x) (hψφ : ψ.comp φ = ContinuousMap.id X) (U : I → Set Y) :
    VertexMap.comp (mapperDomainMap φ hφ U) (mapperDomainMap ψ hψ U) =

statement:
theorem missing_not_isConstructibleAt :
    ¬ S0.IsConstructibleAt
      (intervalComponents (plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) h02))
proof:
:= by
  intro hF
  let I : OpenInterval := ioo (-1) 1
  have hIJ : I ≤ S0.J 0 := by
    rw [S0.J_eq_top_of_zero]
    exact le_top
  have hI : (I : Set ℝ).Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    change (0 : ℝ) ∈ ioo (-1) 1
    norm_num [mem_ioo]
  have hlev : ∀ i, S0.value i ∈ I ↔ S0.value i ∈ S0.J 0 := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    rw [S0.J_eq_top_of_zero]
    exact ⟨
      fun _ => by
        change (S0.value 0 : ℝ) ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)
        exact Set.mem_univ _,
      fun _ => by
        change (S0.value 0) ∈ ioo (-1) 1
        simp [S0, mem_ioo]⟩
  have : Finite (((intervalComponents (plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) h02)).obj I)) :=
    hF.finite I
  have hcard := Nat.card_le_card_of_surjective
    ((intervalComponents (plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) h02)).map (homOfLE hIJ))
    (hF.bijective hIJ hI hlev).2
  have hIcard :
      Nat.card ((intervalComponents (plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) h02)).obj I) = 1 := by
    simpa [I] using missing_ioo_card
  rw [missing_star_card, hIcard] at hcard
  omega

theorem finrank_range_structureMapLinear_le_of_realInterleaving (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)

name: TDA.Mapper.structureMap_eq_zero_of_realInterleaving

theorem structureMap_eq_zero_of_realInterleaving (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (t : ℝ)
    (h : t ≤ t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) [Subsingleton (N.obj (t + ε))] :
    structureMap M h = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  rw [← structureMapLinear, structureMapLinear_eq_comp i t h]
  ext x
  change backMap i t ((i.φ.app t).hom x) = 0
  rw [Subsingleton.elim (α := N.obj (t + ε)) ((i.φ.app t).hom x) 0]
  exact (backMap i t).map_zero

name: TDA.Mapper.le_realInterleavingDistance_of_finrank_lt
statement:
theorem le_realInterleavingDistance_of_finrank_lt {r : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hr : ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < r → ∃ (t : ℝ) (h : t ≤ t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)),
      FiniteDimensional k (N.obj (t + ε)) ∧
        Module.finrank k (N.obj (t + ε)) <
          Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M h))) :
    r ≤ realInterleavingDistance M N
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_realInterleavingDistance_iff]
  intro ε ⟨i⟩
  by_contra hεr
  obtain ⟨t, h, _, hlt⟩ := hr ε (not_le.1 hεr)
  exact (isEmpty_realInterleaving_of_finrank_lt t h hlt).false i

name: TDA.Mapper.le_realInterleavingDistance_of_structureMap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem le_realInterleavingDistance_of_structureMap_ne_zero {r : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hr : ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < r → ∃ (t : ℝ) (h : t ≤ t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)),
      Subsingleton (N.obj (t + ε)) ∧ structureMap M h ≠ 0) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [le_realInterleavingDistance_iff]
  intro ε ⟨i⟩
  by_contra hεr
  obtain ⟨t, h, _, hne⟩ := hr ε (not_le.1 hεr)
  exact (isEmpty_realInterleaving_of_structureMap_ne_zero t h hne).false i

name: TDA.Mapper.isZero_simplicialHomology
statement:
private theorem isZero_simplicialHomology {V : Type*} [LinearOrder V]

    Limits.IsZero (simplicialHomology K R n)

name: TDA.Mapper.isEmpty_realInterleaving_mapperHomologyPModule_of_finrank_lt
statement:
theorem isEmpty_realInterleaving_mapperHomologyPModule_of_finrank_lt (t : ℝ)

      (mapperHomologyPModule k g V rV n))
proof:
:=
  have : FiniteDimensional k ((mapperHomologyPModule k g V rV n).obj (t + ε)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (FiniteDimensional k (simplicialHomology (mapper g (V (t + ε))) k n))

name: TDA.Mapper.le_realInterleavingDistance_mapperHomologyPModule_of_finrank_lt
statement:
theorem le_realInterleavingDistance_mapperHomologyPModule_of_finrank_lt {r : ℝ≥0∞}

      FiniteDimensional k (simplicialHomology (mapper g (V (t + ε))) k n) ∧
        Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (mapper g (V (t + ε))) k n) <
          Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (mapperHomologyMap k f (rU h) n).hom)) :

name: TDA.Mapper.isEmpty_realInterleaving_mapperHomologyPModule_of_isEmpty_face
statement:
theorem isEmpty_realInterleaving_mapperHomologyPModule_of_isEmpty_face (t : ℝ)

    (hne : mapperHomologyMap k f (rU h) n ≠ 0) :
    IsEmpty (RealInterleaving ε (mapperHomologyPModule k f U rU n)
      (mapperHomologyPModule k g V rV n))
proof:
:=
  have : Subsingleton ((mapperHomologyPModule k g V rV n).obj (t + ε)) :=
    ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (isZero_simplicialHomology (mapper g (V (t + ε))) k n)

name: TDA.Mapper.le_realInterleavingDistance_mapperHomologyPModule_of_isEmpty_face
statement:
theorem le_realInterleavingDistance_mapperHomologyPModule_of_isEmpty_face {r : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hr : ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < r → ∃ (t : ℝ) (h : t ≤ t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)),
      IsEmpty (Face (mapper g (V (t + ε))) n) ∧ mapperHomologyMap k f (rU h) n ≠ 0) :
    r ≤ realInterleavingDistance (mapperHomologyPModule k f U rU n)
      (mapperHomologyPModule k g V rV n)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_realInterleavingDistance_of_structureMap_ne_zero fun ε hε => ?_
  obtain ⟨t, h, _, hne⟩ := hr ε hε
  exact ⟨t, h, ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
    (isZero_simplicialHomology (mapper g (V (t + ε))) k n), hne⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperHomologyMap_zero_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mapperHomologyMap_zero_ne_zero {ι κ : Type w} {U : ι → Set Y} {V : κ → Set Y}
    [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f U)] [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f V)]
    (ρ : Refinement U V) (a : ComponentIndex f U) :
    mapperHomologyMap k f ρ 0 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  let σ : Face (mapper f U) 0 := ⟨{a}, componentIndex_supported f U a, Finset.card_singleton a⟩
  have hclass := simplicialHomologyMap_class k (mapperMap f ρ) 0 (zeroVertexCycle _ k σ)
    (zeroVertexCycle _ k (vertexImageFace (mapperMap f ρ) σ (fun i j _ => Fin.ext (by omega))))
    (vertexChainMap_vertex k _ _ 1)
  rw [← mapperHomologyMap_def, h0] at hclass
  exact simplicialHomologyClass_zeroVertexCycle_ne_zero _ k _ hclass.symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.card_cellComponents_eq_one
statement:
theorem card_cellComponents_eq_one {w : V} (hw : h w ∈ I) (hcov : EndpointCoverage G h I)
    (hadj : ∀ v, h v ∈ I → v = w ∨ G.Adj v w) :
    Nat.card (cellGraph G h I).ConnectedComponent = 1
proof:
:= by
  let c₀ := (cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl ⟨w, hw⟩)
  have hvert (v : {v : V // h v ∈ I}) :
      (cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inl v) = c₀ := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := v
    rcases hadj v hv with rfl | hvw
    · rfl
    · exact connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_of_adj G h I (u := ⟨v, hv⟩) (w := ⟨w, hw⟩) hvw
  have hall (c : (cellGraph G h I).ConnectedComponent) : c = c₀ := by
    induction c using ConnectedComponent.ind with
    | h x =>
      rcases x with v | e
      · exact hvert v
      · obtain ⟨u, hu, huI⟩ := hcov e.1 e.2
        exact (connectedComponentMk_inl_eq_inr G h I (v := ⟨u, huI⟩) hu).symm.trans
          (hvert ⟨u, huI⟩)
  exact Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.2
    ⟨⟨fun c d => (hall c).trans (hall d).symm⟩, ⟨c₀⟩⟩

    [Finite V] [Finite V'] (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ) (G' : SimpleGraph V') (h' : V' → ℝ)
    (hc : Nat.card G.ConnectedComponent ≠ Nat.card G'.ConnectedComponent) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph G h) (graphPLReebGraph G' h') = ⊤
proof:

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeY_adj
statement:
theorem mergeY_adj (u v : Fin 4) :
    mergeY.Adj u v ↔ (u = 0 ∧ v = 2) ∨ (u = 2 ∧ v = 0) ∨ (u = 1 ∧ v = 2) ∨ (u = 2 ∧ v = 1) ∨
      (u = 2 ∧ v = 3) ∨ (u = 3 ∧ v = 2)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases u <;> fin_cases v <;> simp [mergeY, fromEdgeSet_adj]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.mergeY_edge_cases
statement:
private theorem mergeY_edge_cases (e : mergeY.edgeSet) :
    e = dartEdge d02 ∨ e = dartEdge d12 ∨ e = dartEdge d23
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨u, v⟩, huv⟩, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
  rcases (mergeY_adj u v).1 huv with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ |
      ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · exact .inl rfl
  · exact .inl (Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap)
  · exact .inr (.inl rfl)
  · exact .inr (.inl (Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap))
  · exact .inr (.inr rfl)
  · exact .inr (.inr (Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.two_mem_edge
statement: private theorem two_mem_edge (e : mergeY.edgeSet) : (2 : Fin 4) ∈ (e : Sym2 (Fin 4))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edgeActive_leaf
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 < a := hc.trans_le hca
  have ht : c / (2 * a) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨by positivity, (div_le_one (by positivity)).2 (by linarith)⟩
  refine edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem (t := ⟨c / (2 * a), ht⟩) ?_
  rw [dartHeight, hd₀, hd₁, mem_ioo]
  have hval : (1 - c / (2 * a)) * 0 + c / (2 * a) * a = c / 2 := by field_simp; ring
  simp only [hval]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.not_edgeActive_top
statement:
private theorem not_edgeActive_top {K : OpenInterval} (haM : a ≤ M) (hK : ∀ x ∈ K, x < a) :
    ¬ EdgeActive mergeY (mergeHeights a M) K (dartEdge d23)
proof:
:= fun hact => by
  obtain ⟨t, -, -, ht⟩ := hact.exists_mem rfl
  have hlt := hK _ ht
  have h₀ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ t := t.2.1
  have hmul : (t : ℝ) * a ≤ t * M := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left haM h₀
  change (1 - (t : ℝ)) * a + t * M < a at hlt
  linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.leaf_of_edgeActive
proof:
:= by
  rcases mergeY_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact .inl rfl
  · exact .inr rfl
  · exact (not_edgeActive_top haM hK he).elim

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.card_cellComponents_mergeHeights_ioo
statement:
theorem card_cellComponents_mergeHeights_ioo {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hca : c ≤ a) (haM : a ≤ M) :
    Nat.card (cellGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M) (ioo 0 c)).ConnectedComponent = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hI : ∀ v, mergeHeights a M v ∉ ioo 0 c := fun v hv => by
    rw [mem_ioo] at hv
    fin_cases v <;> simp at hv <;> linarith [hv.1, hv.2]
  rw [card_cellComponents_eq_card_activeEdges hI]
  refine Nat.card_eq_two_iff.2 ⟨⟨dartEdge d02, edgeActive_leaf rfl rfl hc hca⟩,
    ⟨dartEdge d12, edgeActive_leaf rfl rfl hc hca⟩, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h' : (s(0, 2) : Sym2 (Fin 4)) = s(1, 2) :=
      congrArg (fun e => ((e.1 : mergeY.edgeSet) : Sym2 (Fin 4))) h
    exact absurd h' (by decide)
  · refine eq_univ_of_forall fun e => ?_
    rcases leaf_of_edgeActive (K := ioo 0 c) haM (fun x hx => (mem_ioo.1 hx).2.trans_le hca)
      e.2 with he | he
    · exact .inl (Subtype.ext he)
    · exact .inr (Subtype.ext he)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.card_cellComponents_mergeHeights_eq_one
statement:
theorem card_cellComponents_mergeHeights_eq_one {K : OpenInterval} (hK : a ∈ K) :
    Nat.card (cellGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M) K).ConnectedComponent = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine card_cellComponents_eq_one (w := 2) hK (fun e _ => ⟨2, two_mem_edge e, hK⟩) fun v _ => ?_
  fin_cases v
  · exact .inr ((mergeY_adj 0 2).2 (by decide))
  · exact .inr ((mergeY_adj 1 2).2 (by decide))
  · exact .inl rfl
  · exact .inr ((mergeY_adj 3 2).2 (by decide))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.leafSide_adj
proof:
:= by
  have key (v : Fin 4) (hvK : mergeHeights a M v ∈ K) (e : mergeY.edgeSet)
      (he : EdgeActive mergeY (mergeHeights a M) K e) (hv : v ∈ (e : Sym2 (Fin 4))) :
      (v = 0) = ((0 : Fin 4) ∈ (e : Sym2 (Fin 4))) := by
    have hv01 : v = 0 ∨ v = 1 := by
      have hlt := hK _ hvK
      fin_cases v
      · exact .inl rfl
      · exact .inr rfl
      · exact (lt_irrefl _ hlt).elim
      · exact absurd hlt (not_lt.2 haM)
    clear hvK
    rcases leaf_of_edgeActive haM hK he with rfl | rfl <;> clear he <;>
      rcases hv01 with rfl | rfl <;> revert hv <;> decide
  rcases x with v | e <;> rcases y with w | e'
  · exact (hxy : False).elim
  · exact key v.1 v.2 e'.1 e'.2 hxy
  · exact (key w.1 w.2 e.1 e.2 hxy).symm
  · exact (hxy : False).elim

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.injective_cellComponentFunctor_mergeHeights_map
statement:
theorem injective_cellComponentFunctor_mergeHeights_map {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (haM : a ≤ M)
    {K : OpenInterval} (f : ioo 0 c ⟶ K) (hK : ∀ x ∈ K, x < a) :
    Function.Injective ((cellComponentFunctor mergeY (mergeHeights a M)).map f)
proof:
:= by
  have hca : c ≤ a := by
    by_contra hlt
    push Not at hlt
    have hx : max (c / 2) a ∈ ioo 0 c :=
      mem_ioo.2 ⟨lt_max_of_lt_left (by linarith), max_lt (by linarith) hlt⟩
    exact absurd (hK _ (OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 f.le hx)) (not_lt.2 (le_max_right _ _))
  have hI : ∀ v, mergeHeights a M v ∉ ioo 0 c := fun v hv => by
    rw [mem_ioo] at hv
    fin_cases v <;> simp at hv <;> linarith [hv.1, hv.2]
  intro c₁ c₂ heq
  induction c₁ using ConnectedComponent.ind with
  | h x =>
  induction c₂ using ConnectedComponent.ind with
  | h y =>
  rcases x with v | e
  · exact (hI v v.2).elim
  rcases y with w | e'
  · exact (hI w w.2).elim
  have heq' : (cellGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M) K).connectedComponentMk
      (Sum.inr ⟨e.1, e.2.mono f.le⟩) =
      (cellGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M) K).connectedComponentMk
        (Sum.inr ⟨e'.1, e'.2.mono f.le⟩) := heq
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := ConnectedComponent.exact heq'
  have hs := eq_of_walk (fun _ _ => leafSide_adj haM hK) p
  have hI' : ∀ x ∈ ioo 0 c, x < a := fun x hx => hx.2.trans_le hca
  have hee : e.1 = e'.1 := by
    change ((0 : Fin 4) ∈ ((e.1 : mergeY.edgeSet) : Sym2 (Fin 4))) =
      ((0 : Fin 4) ∈ ((e'.1 : mergeY.edgeSet) : Sym2 (Fin 4))) at hs
    rcases leaf_of_edgeActive haM hI' e.2 with he | he <;>
      rcases leaf_of_edgeActive haM hI' e'.2 with he' | he' <;> rw [he, he'] at hs ⊢ <;>
      exact absurd hs (by decide)
  rw [Subtype.ext hee]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edist_mergeHeights
statement:
theorem edist_mergeHeights {b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    edist (mergeHeights a M) (mergeHeights b M) = ENNReal.ofReal (b - a)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : edist (mergeHeights a M 2) (mergeHeights b M 2) = ENNReal.ofReal (b - a) := by
    rw [edist_dist, Real.dist_eq, mergeHeights_two, mergeHeights_two, abs_sub_comm,
      abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 hab)]
  refine le_antisymm (edist_pi_le_iff.2 fun v => ?_) (h2.ge.trans (edist_le_pi_edist _ _ 2))
  fin_cases v
  · simp
  · simp
  · exact h2.le
  · simp

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.sup'_mergeHeights
statement:
private theorem sup'_mergeHeights (ha : 0 ≤ a) (haM : a ≤ M) :
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (mergeHeights a M) = M
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (Finset.sup'_le _ _ fun v _ => by fin_cases v <;> simp <;> linarith)
    (Finset.le_sup' (mergeHeights a M) (Finset.mem_univ 3))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.inf'_mergeHeights
statement:
private theorem inf'_mergeHeights (ha : 0 ≤ a) (haM : a ≤ M) :
    Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty (mergeHeights a M) = 0
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (Finset.inf'_le (mergeHeights a M) (Finset.mem_univ 0))
    (Finset.le_inf' _ _ fun v _ => by fin_cases v <;> simp <;> linarith)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.max_ofReal_abs_sub_mergeHeights_eq_zero
statement:
theorem max_ofReal_abs_sub_mergeHeights_eq_zero {b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hbM : b ≤ M) :
    max (ENNReal.ofReal |Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (mergeHeights a M) -
        Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (mergeHeights b M)|)
      (ENNReal.ofReal |Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty (mergeHeights a M) -
        Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty (mergeHeights b M)|) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sup'_mergeHeights ha (hab.trans hbM), sup'_mergeHeights (ha.trans hab) hbM,
    inf'_mergeHeights ha (hab.trans hbM), inf'_mergeHeights (ha.trans hab) hbM]
  simp

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY
statement:
theorem geometricInterleavingDistance_mergeY {b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a < b)
    (hb : b ≤ 2 * a) (hbM : b ≤ M) :
    geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M))
      (graphPLReebGraph mergeY (mergeHeights b M)) = ENNReal.ofReal (b - a)
proof:
:= by
  have hba : 0 ≤ b - a := sub_nonneg.2 hab.le
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [ENNReal.ofReal_eq_coe_nnreal hba]
    refine geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_le mergeY fun v => ?_
    change |mergeHeights a M v - mergeHeights b M v| ≤ b - a
    fin_cases v
    · simpa using hba
    · simpa using hba
    · change |a - b| ≤ b - a
      rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg hba]
    · simpa using hba
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph,
    interleavingDistance_congr (intervalComponentsIso _ _) (intervalComponentsIso _ _)]
  refine le_interleavingDistance_of_forall_exists_card_lt_symm fun ε hε => ?_
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (by linarith)] at hε
  have hc : 0 < b - 2 * ε := by linarith
  have hthick (x : ℝ) : x ∈ thicken ε (ioo 0 (b - 2 * ε)) ↔ -ε < x ∧ x < b - ε := by
    rw [thicken_ioo hc, mem_ioo]
    constructor <;> rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ <;> constructor <;> linarith
  have hthick₂ (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ thicken ε (thicken ε (ioo 0 (b - 2 * ε)))) : x < b := by
    rw [thicken_ioo hc, thicken_ioo (by linarith), mem_ioo] at hx
    linarith [hx.2]
  refine ⟨ioo 0 (b - 2 * ε),
    injective_cellComponentFunctor_mergeHeights_map hc hbM _ hthick₂,
    by change Finite (cellGraph _ _ _).ConnectedComponent; infer_instance, ?_⟩
  change Nat.card (cellGraph mergeY (mergeHeights a M) _).ConnectedComponent <
    Nat.card (cellGraph mergeY (mergeHeights b M) _).ConnectedComponent
  have hε₀ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ε := ε.coe_nonneg
  rw [card_cellComponents_mergeHeights_eq_one ((hthick a).2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩),
    card_cellComponents_mergeHeights_ioo hc (by linarith) hbM]
  decide

proof:
:= by
  have hg : (0 : ℝ) < 3 / 8 := by norm_num
  have hgr : (3 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by norm_num
  intro hinj
  apply c4_left_zero_not_injective
  intro y y' hyy
  let E := uniformMapperEdgeEquiv C4 h4 S012 c4_adapted c4_covers hg hgr 0
  let x := E.symm y
  let x' := E.symm y'
  have hxe : E x = y := by
    dsimp [x]
    exact E.apply_symm_apply y
  have hxe' : E x' = y' := by
    dsimp [x']
    exact E.apply_symm_apply y'
  have hxx :
      (uniformMapperData C4 h4 (-1 / 8) 1 (3 / 8) 2).left 0 x =
        (uniformMapperData C4 h4 (-1 / 8) 1 (3 / 8) 2).left 0 x' := by
    apply (uniformMapperVertexEquiv C4 h4 S012 c4_adapted c4_covers (Fin.castSucc 0)).injective
    have h1 := uniformMapperVertexEquiv_left C4 h4 S012 c4_adapted c4_covers hg hgr 0 x
    have h2 := uniformMapperVertexEquiv_left C4 h4 S012 c4_adapted c4_covers hg hgr 0 x'
    rw [h1, h2, hxe, hxe', hyy]
  exact hxe.symm.trans ((congrArg E (hinj hxx)).trans hxe')

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformMapperReebDataExamples.triple_cell
statement:
theorem triple_cell :
    ∃ c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)))
        (fun i => (uniformCover (-3 / 2) 2 (3 / 2) 3 i : Set ℝ)),
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1, 2}
proof:
:= by
  let τ : Finset (Fin 3) := {0, 1, 2}
  have hτ : τ.Nonempty := by simp [τ]
  have hv : vertex pointGraph () ∈
      (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) ⁻¹'
        (⋂ i ∈ τ, (uniformCover (-3 / 2) 2 (3 / 2) 3 i : Set ℝ)) := by
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_iInter, plHeight_vertex]
    intro i hi
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [τ, uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval]
  let z := ZerothHomotopy.mk
    (⟨vertex pointGraph (), hv⟩ :
      (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) ⁻¹'
        (⋂ i ∈ τ, (uniformCover (-3 / 2) 2 (3 / 2) 3 i : Set ℝ)))
  let c := (cellsOverLabelsEquiv
      (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)))
      (fun i => (uniformCover (-3 / 2) 2 (3 / 2) 3 i : Set ℝ)) τ hτ).symm z
  exact ⟨c.1, c.2⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformMapperReebDataExamples.triple_cell_not_mem_summands
statement:
theorem triple_cell_not_mem_summands
    {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)))
        (fun i => (uniformCover (-3 / 2) 2 (3 / 2) 3 i : Set ℝ))}
    (hc : c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1, 2}) :
    (∀ k : Fin 3, c.support.image Sigma.fst ≠ {k}) ∧
      (∀ e : Fin 2, c.support.image Sigma.fst ≠ {e.castSucc, e.succ})
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro k hk
    have hcard := congrArg Finset.card (hc.symm.trans hk)
    rw [show ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)).card = 3 by decide,
      Finset.card_singleton] at hcard
    omega
  · intro e he
    have hcard := congrArg Finset.card (hc.symm.trans he)
    rw [show ({0, 1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)).card = 3 by decide,
      Finset.card_pair (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ (i := e)).ne] at hcard
    omega

  obtain ⟨γ⟩ := Quotient.exact h
  let q : Path (-3 / 2 : ℝ) (3 / 2 : ℝ) := γ.map continuous_subtype_val
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.range q := by
    apply intermediate_value_univ (0 : unitInterval) (1 : unitInterval) q.continuous
    change q 0 ≤ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ q 1
    rw [q.source, q.target]
    norm_num
  rcases hzero with ⟨t, ht⟩
  have hval : (γ t).1 = (0 : ℝ) := by
    change q t = 0
    exact ht
  have : (0 : ℝ) ∈ twoIntervalCover () := hval ▸ (γ t).2
  norm_num [twoIntervalCover] at this

  let _ : PathConnectedSpace (PullbackSpace realMap middleIntervalCover ()) :=
