name: TDA.Mapper.mem_coverSaturation
statement:
theorem mem_coverSaturation {U : ι → OpenInterval} {I : OpenInterval} {x : ℝ} :
    x ∈ coverSaturation U I ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ U i ∧ ∃ y, y ∈ U i ∧ y ∈ I
proof:
:= by
  simp only [coverSaturation, TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, ⟨y, hyU, hyI⟩, hx⟩
    exact ⟨i, hx, y, hyU, hyI⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hx, y, hyU, hyI⟩
    exact ⟨i, ⟨y, hyU, hyI⟩, hx⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.coverSaturation_mono
statement:
theorem coverSaturation_mono (U : ι → OpenInterval) {I J : OpenInterval} (h : I ≤ J) :
    coverSaturation U I ≤ coverSaturation U J
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hx, y, hy, hyI⟩ := mem_coverSaturation.mp hx
  exact mem_coverSaturation.mpr ⟨i, hx, y, hy, h hyI⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.coverSaturation_le_thicken
statement:
theorem coverSaturation_le_thicken (U : ι → OpenInterval) (r : ℝ≥0)
    (hdiam : ∀ i x, x ∈ U i → ∀ y, y ∈ U i → |x - y| ≤ r) (I : OpenInterval) :
    coverSaturation U I ≤ toOpens (thicken r I)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hx, y, hy, hyI⟩ := mem_coverSaturation.mp hx
  exact mem_thicken.mpr ⟨y, hyI, hdiam i x hx y hy⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.coverMember_le_saturation
statement:
theorem coverMember_le_saturation (U : ι → OpenInterval) (I : OpenInterval)
    (i : ActiveCoverMember U I) : toOpens (U i.val) ≤ coverSaturation U I
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y, hyU, hyI⟩ := i.property
  exact mem_coverSaturation.mpr ⟨i.val, hx, y, hyU, hyI⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.coverComponentGenerator_surjective
statement:
theorem coverComponentGenerator_surjective (f : C(X, ℝ)) (U : ι → OpenInterval)
    (I : OpenInterval) : Function.Surjective (coverComponentGenerator f U I)
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    obtain ⟨i, hxi, y, hyU, hyI⟩ := mem_coverSaturation.mp x.2
    exact ⟨⟨⟨i, y, hyU, hyI⟩, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x.1, hxi⟩⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.finite_coverComponents
statement:
theorem finite_coverComponents [Finite ι] (f : C(X, ℝ)) (U : ι → OpenInterval)
    (hfinite : ∀ i, Finite ((intervalComponents f).obj (U i))) (I : OpenInterval) :
    Finite ((coverComponents f U).obj I)
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ i : ActiveCoverMember U I, Finite ((intervalComponents f).obj (U i.val)) :=
    fun i => hfinite i.val
  exact Finite.of_surjective _ (coverComponentGenerator_surjective f U I)

name: TDA.Mapper.preimage_subset_coverSaturation
statement:
theorem preimage_subset_coverSaturation (f : C(X, ℝ)) (U : ι → OpenInterval)
    (hcov : ∀ x, ∃ i, f x ∈ U i) (I : OpenInterval) :
    f ⁻¹' (I : Set ℝ) ⊆ f ⁻¹' (coverSaturation U I : Set ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov x
  exact mem_coverSaturation.mpr ⟨i, hi, f x, hi, hx⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.interleavingDistance_coverComponents_le
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_coverComponents_le (f : C(X, ℝ)) (U : ι → OpenInterval)
    (r : ℝ≥0) (hcov : ∀ x, ∃ i, f x ∈ U i)
    (hdiam : ∀ i x, x ∈ U i → ∀ y, y ∈ U i → |x - y| ≤ r) :
    interleavingDistance (coverComponents f U) (intervalComponents f) ≤ (r : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:=
  (coverComponentsInterleaving f U r hcov hdiam).interleavingDistance_le

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLLevelSetsExamples.card_zero_of
statement:
private theorem card_zero_of {α : Type*} {P : α → Prop} (hP : ∀ x, ¬ P x) :
    Nat.card {x // P x} = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : IsEmpty {x // P x} := ⟨fun x => hP x.1 x.2⟩
  exact Nat.card_of_isEmpty

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLLevelSetsExamples.card_two_of
statement:
private theorem card_two_of {α : Type*} {P : α → Prop} {a b : α} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (ha : P a) (hb : P b) (hP : ∀ x, P x → x = a ∨ x = b) : Nat.card {x // P x} = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_eq_two_iff]
  refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩, fun h => hab (congrArg Subtype.val h), ?_⟩
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  rcases hP x.1 x.2 with h | h
  · exact .inl (Subtype.ext h)
  · exact .inr (Subtype.ext h)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLLevelSetsExamples.induce_mk_injective_of_not_adj
proof:
:= fun x y hxy => by
  obtain ⟨p⟩ := ConnectedComponent.exact hxy
  cases p with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons hadj _ => exact (hS _ (Subtype.prop _) _ (Subtype.prop _) hadj).elim

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLLevelSetsExamples.card_induce_empty
statement:
private theorem card_induce_empty {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {S : Set V}
    (hS : ∀ v, v ∉ S) : Nat.card (G.induce S).ConnectedComponent = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : IsEmpty (G.induce S).ConnectedComponent :=
    ⟨fun c => by
      induction c using ConnectedComponent.ind with
      | h v => exact hS v.1 v.2⟩
  exact Nat.card_of_isEmpty

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLLevelSetsExamples.not_edgeCrosses_of_ge
statement:
private theorem not_edgeCrosses_of_ge {V : Type*} {G : SimpleGraph V} {h : V → ℝ}
    {c : ℝ} (hc : ∀ v, h v ≤ c) (e : G.edgeSet) : ¬ EdgeCrosses G h c e
proof:
:=
  fun ⟨d, _, _, hmax⟩ => by
    rcases max_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm <;> rw [hm] at hmax <;>
      linarith [hc d.fst, hc d.snd]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLLevelSetsExamples.card_levelVertex
statement:
private theorem card_levelVertex {V : Type*} [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    {m k : ℕ} (hm : Nat.card (G.induce {v | h v = c}).ConnectedComponent = m)
    (hk : Nat.card {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h c e} = k) :
    Nat.card (LevelVertex G h c) = m + k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let _ := Fintype.ofFinite V
  rw [Nat.card_sum, hm, hk]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLLevelSetsExamples.c4_level_not_adj

proof:

theorem c4_level_one_card :

proof:

    Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy (ClosedLevel C4 h4 1)) = Nat.card (LevelVertex C4 h4 1) :=
      Nat.card_congr (closedLevelComponentsEquiv C4 h4 1)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLLevelSetsExamples.c4_level_one_ne
statement:
theorem c4_level_one_ne :
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk
        (⟨vertex C4 1, by rw [plHeight_vertex, h4_one]; simp⟩ : ClosedLevel C4 h4 1)) ≠
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk
        (⟨vertex C4 3, by rw [plHeight_vertex, h4_three]; simp⟩ : ClosedLevel C4 h4 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro hneq
  have hcomp := congrArg (closedLevelComponentsEquiv C4 h4 1) hneq
  rw [closedLevelComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex C4 h4 1 h4_one,
    closedLevelComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex C4 h4 3 h4_three] at hcomp
  have hvert := induce_mk_injective_of_not_adj (G := C4)
    (S := {v | h4 v = 1}) (c4_level_not_adj 1) (Sum.inl.inj hcomp)
  exact absurd (congrArg Subtype.val hvert) (by decide : ((1 : Fin 4) ≠ 3))

      Nat.card_congr (closedLevelComponentsEquiv edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) 0)
    _ = Nat.card ((graphPLReebData edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) S0).V 0) := by
      rfl
    _ = 1 := flatEdge_count

          flat_midpoint_mem⟩ : ClosedLevel edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) 0)) =

          ClosedLevel edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) 0)
proof:

    ({0} : Set ℝ)
    (joinedIn_level_of_eq edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) rfl rfl
      ⟨1 / 2, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩)
    (by rw [plHeight_vertex]; simp) flat_midpoint_mem

        Nat.card (LevelVertex edgeGraph h02 1) :=

    _ = Nat.card ((graphPLReebData edgeGraph h02 S012).V 1) := by

    ⟨1 / 2, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩ (by rw [dartHeight_d₀]; norm_num)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLLevelSetsExamples.crossing_midpoint

    closedLevelComponentsEquiv edgeGraph h02 1
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk
          (⟨edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ ⟨1 / 2, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩,
            h02_midpoint_mem⟩ : ClosedLevel edgeGraph h02 1)) =
      Sum.inr ⟨dartEdge d₀, h02_crosses_one⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hp :
      (⟨edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ ⟨1 / 2, by norm_num, by norm_num⟩,
          h02_midpoint_mem⟩ : ClosedLevel edgeGraph h02 1) =
        crossingPoint edgeGraph h02 ⟨dartEdge d₀, h02_crosses_one⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact crossing_midpoint_eq
  exact (congrArg (fun p : ClosedLevel edgeGraph h02 1 =>
      closedLevelComponentsEquiv edgeGraph h02 1 (ZerothHomotopy.mk p)) hp).trans
    (closedLevelComponentsEquiv_crossingPoint edgeGraph h02
      ⟨dartEdge d₀, h02_crosses_one⟩)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLLevelSetsExamples.J4_not_injective
statement:
theorem J4_not_injective :
    ¬ Function.Injective
      (componentMap (levelInclusion C4 h4 (c := 1) (I := J4) J4_one_mem))
proof:
:= by
  intro hinj
  let z1 : ZerothHomotopy (ClosedLevel C4 h4 1) :=
    ZerothHomotopy.mk
      (⟨vertex C4 1, by rw [plHeight_vertex, h4_one]; simp⟩ : ClosedLevel C4 h4 1)
  let z3 : ZerothHomotopy (ClosedLevel C4 h4 1) :=
    ZerothHomotopy.mk
      (⟨vertex C4 3, by rw [plHeight_vertex, h4_three]; simp⟩ : ClosedLevel C4 h4 1)
  have hz1 : componentMap (levelInclusion C4 h4 I4_isLevelWindow.1) z1 = x1 := by
    dsimp [z1, x1]
    apply congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk
    exact Subtype.ext rfl
  have hz3 : componentMap (levelInclusion C4 h4 I4_isLevelWindow.1) z3 = x3 := by
    dsimp [z3, x3]
    apply congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk
    exact Subtype.ext rfl
  have hI4J : (I4 : Set ℝ) ⊆ (J4 : Set ℝ) :=
    OpenInterval.le_iff_subset.1 I4_le_J4
  have hinc :
      levelInclusion C4 h4 J4_one_mem =
        (TDA.Topology.preimageSetInclusion (plHeight C4 h4) hI4J).comp
          (levelInclusion C4 h4 I4_isLevelWindow.1) := by
    exact ContinuousMap.ext (fun _ => rfl)
  have hcomp :
      componentMap (levelInclusion C4 h4 J4_one_mem) =
        componentMap (TDA.Topology.preimageSetInclusion (plHeight C4 h4) hI4J) ∘
          componentMap (levelInclusion C4 h4 I4_isLevelWindow.1) := by
    rw [hinc, componentMap_comp]
  have hmerge :
      componentMap (TDA.Topology.preimageSetInclusion (plHeight C4 h4) hI4J) x1 =
        componentMap (TDA.Topology.preimageSetInclusion (plHeight C4 h4) hI4J) x3 := by
    change
      componentMap (TDA.Reeb.preimageInclusion (plHeight C4 h4)
          (toOpens_le_iff.2 I4_le_J4)) x1 =
        componentMap (TDA.Reeb.preimageInclusion (plHeight C4 h4)
          (toOpens_le_iff.2 I4_le_J4)) x3
    exact c4_J_preimage_merge
  have hmap : componentMap (levelInclusion C4 h4 J4_one_mem) z1 =
      componentMap (levelInclusion C4 h4 J4_one_mem) z3 := by
    have h1 := congrFun hcomp z1
    have h3 := congrFun hcomp z3
    change componentMap (levelInclusion C4 h4 J4_one_mem) z1 =
      componentMap (TDA.Topology.preimageSetInclusion (plHeight C4 h4) hI4J)
        (componentMap (levelInclusion C4 h4 I4_isLevelWindow.1) z1) at h1
    change componentMap (levelInclusion C4 h4 J4_one_mem) z3 =
      componentMap (TDA.Topology.preimageSetInclusion (plHeight C4 h4) hI4J)
        (componentMap (levelInclusion C4 h4 I4_isLevelWindow.1) z3) at h3
    rw [hz1] at h1
    rw [hz3] at h3
    exact h1.trans (hmerge.trans h3.symm)
  exact c4_level_one_ne (by simpa [z1, z3] using hinj hmap)

    ∃ n : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ a b : ∀ t, Fin (n t) → ℝ,
      (∀ t x, ∃ i, plHeight edgeGraph h02 x ∈ ioo (a t i) (b t i)) ∧
      (∀ t x, ∃ i, plHeight edgeGraph (fun v => h02 v + 1) x ∈
        ioo (a t i + 1) (b t i + 1)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun t => RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance
        (graphPLMapperReconstruction edgeGraph h02 (a t) (b t))
        (graphPLMapperReconstruction edgeGraph (fun v => h02 v + 1)
          (fun i => a t i + 1) (fun i => b t i + 1))) atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, a, b, hcov, -, hres, -, -⟩ := nonconstant_edge_convergent_reconstructions
  have hcov' : ∀ t x, ∃ i, plHeight edgeGraph (fun v => h02 v + 1) x ∈
      ioo (a t i + 1) (b t i + 1) := by
    intro t x
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcov t x
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    rw [plHeight_add_const_apply]
    exact ⟨by linarith [hi.1], by linarith [hi.2]⟩
  refine ⟨n, a, b, hcov, hcov', ?_⟩

      (fun i => b t i + 1) : ℝ≥0∞)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [coverResolution_add_const] using hres
  have := tendsto_geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_pair edgeGraph h02
    (fun v => h02 v + 1) hcov hcov' hres hres'
  rwa [geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_add_const (G := edgeGraph) (h := h02) 1,

        (graphPLMapperReconstruction G g a' b') = 0 ∧

proof:

  refine ⟨?_, geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_of_isEmpty (G := G) h g⟩
  have hE : IsEmpty (Realization G) :=
    ⟨fun x => by
      induction x using TDA.Reeb.GraphRealization.ind with
      | vertex v => exact isEmptyElim v
      | edgePoint d t => exact isEmptyElim d.fst⟩
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLMapperReconstruction_eq]
  have e1 : ∀ I, IsEmpty ((coverComponents (plHeight G h) (fun i => ioo (a i) (b i))).obj I) :=
    fun I => componentFunctor_obj_isEmpty_of_isEmpty _ _
  have e2 : ∀ I, IsEmpty ((coverComponents (plHeight G g) (fun i => ioo (a' i) (b' i))).obj I) :=
    fun I => componentFunctor_obj_isEmpty_of_isEmpty _ _
  refine interleavingDistance_eq_zero_of_iso (NatIso.ofComponents
    (fun I => haveI := e1 I; haveI := e2 I; (Equiv.equivOfIsEmpty _ _).toIso) fun _ => ?_)
  ext c
  exact (e1 _).elim c

    cycle_doubleWide_edgeCells_merge,
    fun hinj => cycleEdgeCellOne_ne_three (hinj cycle_doubleWide_edgeCells_merge), hsupp, ?_⟩
  rw [hsupp, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ cycle_doubleWide_mapperMap_injective, cycleEdge_card]

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveRefinementExamples.twoEdge_index_cases
statement:
private theorem twoEdge_index_cases (a : ComponentIndex twoEdgeMap overlapCover) :
    ∃ σ i, a = twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ i
proof:
:=
  ⟨(twoEdgeIndexEquiv.symm a).1, (twoEdgeIndexEquiv.symm a).2,
    (twoEdgeIndexEquiv.apply_symm_apply a).symm⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveRefinementExamples.twoEdge_side_eq
proof:
:= by
  cases σ <;> cases τ
  · rfl
  · exact ((Set.disjoint_left.1 (twoEdge_cross_componentCover_disjoint i j)) hσ hτ).elim
  · exact ((Set.disjoint_left.1 (twoEdge_cross_componentCover_disjoint j i)) hτ hσ).elim
  · rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveRefinementExamples.twoEdge_not_preimageIntersectionsPathConnected
statement:
theorem twoEdge_not_preimageIntersectionsPathConnected :
    ¬ PreimageIntersectionsPathConnected twoEdgeMap overlapCover
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hne : (twoEdgeMap ⁻¹' ⋂ i ∈ ({false} : Finset Bool), overlapCover i).Nonempty := by
    rw [Finset.set_biInter_singleton]
    exact ⟨_, (twoEdgeOverlapPoint false false).2⟩
  have hpc := h {false} (Finset.singleton_nonempty _) hne
  rw [Finset.set_biInter_singleton] at hpc
  have hsub := subsingleton_zerothHomotopy_of_isPathConnected hpc
  have hne' : twoEdgeOverlapIndex false false ≠ twoEdgeOverlapIndex true false := fun h =>
    Bool.false_ne_true (congrArg Prod.fst
      (twoEdgeIndexEquiv.injective (a₁ := (false, false)) (a₂ := (true, false)) h))
  exact hne' (Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq (@Subsingleton.elim _ hsub _ _)))

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveRefinementExamples.twoEdge_midpoint_mem_half
statement:
private theorem twoEdge_midpoint_mem_half (σ : Bool) :
    dartHeight twoEdgeHeight (twoEdgeDart σ) half ∈ ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twoEdge_midpoint_height, mem_ioo]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveRefinementExamples.twoEdge_half_classification
statement:
private theorem twoEdge_half_classification
    (z : {p : Realization twoEdgeGraph // twoEdgeMap p ∈ ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2)}) :
    ∃ σ, ZerothHomotopy.mk z = ZerothHomotopy.mk
      (⟨edgePoint twoEdgeGraph (twoEdgeDart σ) half, twoEdge_midpoint_mem_half σ⟩ :
        {p : Realization twoEdgeGraph // twoEdgeMap p ∈ ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2)})
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ c : (cellGraph twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2))).ConnectedComponent,
      ∃ σ, c = preimageComponentsEquiv twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight (ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2))
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨edgePoint twoEdgeGraph (twoEdgeDart σ) half,
          twoEdge_midpoint_mem_half σ⟩) := by
    intro c
    induction c using ConnectedComponent.ind with
    | h x =>
      rcases x with ⟨v, hv⟩ | ⟨e, hact⟩
      · exfalso
        rcases v with b | b <;> cases b <;> norm_num [twoEdgeHeight, h02, mem_ioo] at hv
      · rcases twoEdge_edge_eq e with he | he
        · refine ⟨false, ?_⟩
          rw [preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint]
          exact congrArg _ (congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext he))
        · refine ⟨true, ?_⟩
          rw [preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint]
          exact congrArg _ (congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext he))
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := key (preimageComponentsEquiv twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight _
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk z))
  exact ⟨σ, (preimageComponentsEquiv twoEdgeGraph twoEdgeHeight _).injective hσ⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveRefinementExamples.half_subset_overlap
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  have hp' : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < twoEdgeMap p ∧ twoEdgeMap p < 3 / 2 := hp
  refine Set.mem_iInter₂.2 fun i _ => ?_
  cases i
  · show (-1 : ℝ) < twoEdgeMap p ∧ twoEdgeMap p < 3 / 2
    constructor <;> linarith [hp'.1, hp'.2]
  · show (1 / 2 : ℝ) < twoEdgeMap p ∧ twoEdgeMap p < 3
    constructor <;> linarith [hp'.1, hp'.2]

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveRefinementExamples.twoEdge_pair_joined
statement:
private theorem twoEdge_pair_joined {σ : Bool} {p : Realization twoEdgeGraph}
    (hp : p ∈ interMember (componentCover twoEdgeMap overlapCover)
      {twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ false, twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ true}) :
    JoinedIn (twoEdgeMap ⁻¹' ((ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2) : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ)) p
      (edgePoint twoEdgeGraph (twoEdgeDart σ) half)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : p ∈ componentCover twoEdgeMap overlapCover (twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ false) :=
    (mem_interMember_iff _).1 hp _ (by simp)
  have ht : p ∈ componentCover twoEdgeMap overlapCover (twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ true) :=
    (mem_interMember_iff _).1 hp _ (by simp)
  have h₁ : (-1 : ℝ) < twoEdgeMap p ∧ twoEdgeMap p < 3 / 2 := hf.1
  have h₂ : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < twoEdgeMap p ∧ twoEdgeMap p < 3 := ht.1
  have hpK : twoEdgeMap p ∈ ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2) := ⟨h₂.1, h₁.2⟩
  obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := twoEdge_half_classification ⟨p, hpK⟩
  have hJ : JoinedIn (twoEdgeMap ⁻¹' ((ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2) : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ)) p
      (edgePoint twoEdgeGraph (twoEdgeDart τ) half) :=
    (joinedIn_iff_joined (F := twoEdgeMap ⁻¹' ((ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2) : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ))
      hpK (twoEdge_midpoint_mem_half τ)).2 (Quotient.exact hτ)
  have hsub : twoEdgeMap ⁻¹' ((ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 2) : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ) ⊆
      twoEdgeMap ⁻¹' overlapCover false := by
    intro w hw
    have hw' : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < twoEdgeMap w ∧ twoEdgeMap w < 3 / 2 := hw
    show (-1 : ℝ) < twoEdgeMap w ∧ twoEdgeMap w < 3 / 2
    constructor <;> linarith [hw'.1, hw'.2]
  have hτmem : p ∈ componentCover twoEdgeMap overlapCover (twoEdgeOverlapIndex τ false) :=
    ⟨hf.1, mk_eq_of_joinedIn twoEdgeMap (overlapCover false) (hJ.mono hsub) hf.1
      (twoEdgeOverlapPoint τ false).2⟩
  obtain rfl := twoEdge_side_eq hf hτmem
  exact hJ

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveRefinementExamples.twoEdge_pair_subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun c d => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective c
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective d
  apply interMemberPreimageMap_injective
  refine ZerothHomotopy.sound (JoinedIn.joined_subtype ?_).somePath
  exact ((twoEdge_pair_joined x.2).trans (twoEdge_pair_joined y.2).symm).mono
    (half_subset_overlap _)

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveRefinementExamples.singleton_subsingleton
statement:
private theorem singleton_subsingleton (a : ComponentIndex twoEdgeMap overlapCover) :
    Subsingleton (ZerothHomotopy (interMember (componentCover twoEdgeMap overlapCover) {a}))
proof:
:= by
  have hpc : IsPathConnected (interMember (componentCover twoEdgeMap overlapCover) {a}) := by
    rw [interMember_singleton]
    exact componentCover_isPathConnected _ _ a
  exact subsingleton_zerothHomotopy_of_isPathConnected hpc

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveRefinementExamples.twoEdge_intersectionsPathSubsingleton
statement:
theorem twoEdge_intersectionsPathSubsingleton :
    IntersectionsPathSubsingleton (componentCover twoEdgeMap overlapCover)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  by_cases hempty : interMember (componentCover twoEdgeMap overlapCover) s = ∅
  · have := (isEmpty_cellsOver_iff _ s).2 hempty
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 hempty
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨σ, i₀, rfl⟩ := twoEdge_index_cases a₀
  have hside : ∀ a ∈ s, ∃ i, a = twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ i := by
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨τ, j, rfl⟩ := twoEdge_index_cases a
    obtain rfl := twoEdge_side_eq ((mem_interMember_iff _).1 hx _ ha₀)
      ((mem_interMember_iff _).1 hx _ ha)
    exact ⟨j, rfl⟩
  by_cases hf : twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ false ∈ s <;> by_cases ht : twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ true ∈ s
  · have hs_eq : s = {twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ false, twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ true} := by
      ext a
      constructor
      · intro ha
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hside a ha
        cases i <;> simp
      · intro ha
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha
        rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> assumption
    rw [hs_eq]
    exact twoEdge_pair_subsingleton σ
  · have hs_eq : s = {twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ false} := by
      ext a
      constructor
      · intro ha
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hside a ha
        cases i
        · simp
        · exact absurd ha ht
      · intro ha
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 ha]
        exact hf
    rw [hs_eq]
    exact singleton_subsingleton _
  · have hs_eq : s = {twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ true} := by
      ext a
      constructor
      · intro ha
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hside a ha
        cases i
        · exact absurd ha hf
        · simp
      · intro ha
        rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 ha]
        exact ht
    rw [hs_eq]
    exact singleton_subsingleton _
  · exfalso
    cases i₀
    · exact hf ha₀
    · exact ht ha₀

name: TDA.Mapper.MultiNerveRefinementExamples.twoEdge_multiNerveMapper_separation
statement:
theorem twoEdge_multiNerveMapper_separation :
    ¬ PreimageIntersectionsPathConnected twoEdgeMap overlapCover ∧
    IntersectionsPathSubsingleton (componentCover twoEdgeMap overlapCover) ∧
    Function.Bijective (multiNerveMapper_projection twoEdgeMap overlapCover) ∧
    ⇑twoEdgeMultiNerveOrderIso = multiNerveMapper_projection twoEdgeMap overlapCover ∧
    (∀ σ, ∃! c : multiNerveMapper twoEdgeMap overlapCover,
      c.support = {twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ false, twoEdgeOverlapIndex σ true}) ∧
    ∀ (i j : Bool) (c : multiNerveMapper twoEdgeMap overlapCover),
      c.support ≠ {twoEdgeOverlapIndex false i, twoEdgeOverlapIndex true j}
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (multiNerveMapper_projection twoEdgeMap overlapCover) :=
    (projection_injective_iff _).2 twoEdge_intersectionsPathSubsingleton
  refine ⟨twoEdge_not_preimageIntersectionsPathConnected, twoEdge_intersectionsPathSubsingleton,
    ⟨hinj, multiNerveMapper_projection_surjective _ _⟩, rfl, fun σ => ?_, fun i j c hc => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := multiNerveMapper_projection_surjective twoEdgeMap overlapCover
      ⟨_, twoEdge_mapper_two_disjoint_edges.2.1 σ⟩
    refine ⟨c, congrArg Subtype.val hc, fun d hd => hinj ?_⟩
    rw [hc]
    exact Subtype.ext hd
  · apply twoEdge_mapper_two_disjoint_edges.2.2.1 i j
    rw [← hc]
    exact c.support_mem_nerve

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.adapted_overlap_bounds
statement:
private theorem adapted_overlap_bounds {t : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ}
    (ht : ∀ k j : Fin (n + 1), t k ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) j ↔ j = k)
    (hgr : g ≤ r) (e : Fin n) :
    t e.castSucc ≤ a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g) ∧
      a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g) + g ≤ t e.succ
proof:
:= by
  have hleft : t e.castSucc ≤ a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g) := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hlt : a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g) < t e.castSucc := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hown := (ht e.castSucc e.castSucc).2 rfl
    rw [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval] at hown
    have hmem : t e.castSucc ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ := by
      rw [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval]
      constructor
      · exact hlt
      · simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at hown ⊢
        push_cast at hown ⊢
        nlinarith [hown.2, sub_nonneg.2 hgr]
    have heq := (ht e.castSucc e.succ).1 hmem
    exact (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ (i := e)).ne' heq
  have hright : a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g) + g ≤ t e.succ := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hlt : t e.succ < a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g) + g := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hown := (ht e.succ e.succ).2 rfl
    rw [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval] at hown
    have hmem : t e.succ ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc := by
      rw [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval]
      constructor
      · simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at hown ⊢
        push_cast at hown ⊢
        nlinarith [hown.1, sub_nonneg.2 hgr]
      · simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at hlt ⊢
        push_cast at hlt ⊢
        nlinarith [hlt, hgr]
    have heq := (ht e.succ e.castSucc).1 hmem
    exact (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ (i := e)).ne heq
  exact ⟨hleft, hright⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.LevelsAdapted.overlap_left_ge
statement:
theorem LevelsAdapted.overlap_left_ge
    {T : CriticalValues n} (hT : LevelsAdapted T a r g) (hgr : g ≤ r) (e : Fin n) :
    T.value e.castSucc ≤ a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g)
proof:
:=
  (adapted_overlap_bounds (t := T.value) hT hgr e).1

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.LevelsAdapted.overlap_right_le
statement:
theorem LevelsAdapted.overlap_right_le
    {T : CriticalValues n} (hT : LevelsAdapted T a r g) (hgr : g ≤ r) (e : Fin n) :
    a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g) + g ≤ T.value e.succ
proof:
:=
  (adapted_overlap_bounds (t := T.value) hT hgr e).2

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.LevelsAdapted.heightSeparating
statement:
theorem LevelsAdapted.heightSeparating
    {V : Type u} {h : V → ℝ} {a r g : ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    {T : CriticalValues n} (hT : LevelsAdapted T a r g)
    (hcov : CoversVertexHeights T h) :
    HeightSeparating h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro k v w hv hw
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov v
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hcov w
    have hkj : k = j := (hT j k).1 (by rw [hj]; exact hv)
    have hkl : k = l := (hT l k).1 (by rw [hl]; exact hw)
    calc
      h v = T.value j := hj.symm
      _ = T.value l := congrArg T.value (hkj.symm.trans hkl)
      _ = h w := hl
  · intro k l hkl v hv
    have hv' : h v ∈ (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k : Set ℝ) ∩
        (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) l : Set ℝ) := by
      exact hv
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov v
    have hkj : k = j := (hT j k).1 (by rw [hj]; exact hv'.1)
    have hlj : l = j := (hT j l).1 (by rw [hj]; exact hv'.2)
    have : k = l := hkj.trans hlj.symm
    subst l
    omega

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.LevelsAdapted.preimage_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov v
    have hkj : k = j := (hT j k).1 (by rw [hj]; exact hv)
    exact hj.symm.trans (congrArg T.value hkj.symm)
  · intro hv
    change h v = T.value k at hv
    change h v ∈ (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k : Set ℝ)
    rw [hv]
    exact (hT k k).2 rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.midpoint_mem_uniformCover
statement:
private theorem midpoint_mem_uniformCover {k : Fin (n + 1)}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : 2 * g ≤ r) :
    a + (k : ℕ) * (r - g) + r / 2 ∈
      uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval]
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith : 0 < 2 * g) hgr
  have hstep : 0 ≤ r - g := by linarith
  constructor <;> linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.adapted_midpoint_not_mem_of_ne
statement:
private theorem adapted_midpoint_not_mem_of_ne {k j : Fin (n + 1)}
    (_hk : ¬ ∃ v, h v ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k)
    (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : 2 * g ≤ r) (hkj : j ≠ k) :
    a + (k : ℕ) * (r - g) + r / 2 ∉
      uniformCover a r g (n + 1) j
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hmem' := hmem
  rw [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval] at hmem'
  have hmemk := midpoint_mem_uniformCover (a := a) (n := n) (k := k) hg hgr
  have hval_ne : (j : ℕ) ≠ (k : ℕ) := fun h => hkj (Fin.ext h)
  by_cases hfar : (k : ℕ) + 2 ≤ j
  · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (uniformInterval_disjoint hgr hfar) hmemk hmem
  by_cases hfar' : (j : ℕ) + 2 ≤ k
  · exact Set.disjoint_left.1 (uniformInterval_disjoint hgr hfar') hmem hmemk
  by_cases hnext : (k : ℕ) + 1 = j
  ·
    have hnext' : ((k : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = ((j : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast hnext
    have hbound : a + ((k : ℕ) : ℝ) * (r - g) + r / 2 ≤
        a + ((j : ℕ) : ℝ) * (r - g) := by
      rw [← hnext']
      nlinarith [hgr]
    linarith
  have hprev : (j : ℕ) + 1 = k := by omega
  have hprev' : ((j : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = ((k : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hprev
  have hbound : a + ((j : ℕ) : ℝ) * (r - g) + r ≤
      a + ((k : ℕ) : ℝ) * (r - g) + r / 2 := by
    rw [← hprev']
    nlinarith [hgr]
  linarith

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.adapted_of_member_chosen_level
statement:
private theorem adapted_of_member_chosen_level
    (hsep : HeightSeparating h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)))
    (hgr : 2 * g ≤ r) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (hk : ∃ v, h v ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k)
    (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    (h hk.choose ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) j) ↔ j = k
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hj
    by_cases hkj : j = k
    · exact hkj
    · have hval_ne : (j : ℕ) ≠ (k : ℕ) := fun h => hkj (Fin.ext h)
      by_cases hfar : (k : ℕ) + 2 ≤ j
      · exact (Set.disjoint_left.1 (uniformInterval_disjoint hgr hfar)
          (Classical.choose_spec hk) hj).elim
      by_cases hfar' : (j : ℕ) + 2 ≤ k
      · exact (Set.disjoint_left.1 (uniformInterval_disjoint hgr hfar') hj
          (Classical.choose_spec hk)).elim
      by_cases hnext : (k : ℕ) + 1 = j
      · exact ((hsep.2 k j hnext hk.choose) (by
          show h hk.choose ∈
            ((uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k ⊓ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) j :
              OpenInterval) : Set ℝ)
          exact ⟨Classical.choose_spec hk, hj⟩)).elim
      have hprev : (j : ℕ) + 1 = k := by omega
      exact ((hsep.2 j k hprev hk.choose) (by
        show h hk.choose ∈
          ((uniformCover a r g (n + 1) j ⊓ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k :
            OpenInterval) : Set ℝ)
        exact ⟨hj, Classical.choose_spec hk⟩)).elim
  · intro hkj
    subst j
    exact Classical.choose_spec hk

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.exists_levelsAdapted
statement:
theorem exists_levelsAdapted
    (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : 2 * g ≤ r)
    (hsep : HeightSeparating h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)))
    (hcov : ∀ v, ∃ k, h v ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k) :
    ∃ T : CriticalValues n, LevelsAdapted T a r g ∧ CoversVertexHeights T h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let t : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun k =>
    if hk : ∃ v, h v ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k then h hk.choose
    else a + (k : ℕ) * (r - g) + r / 2
  have ht_mem : ∀ k, t k ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : ∃ v, h v ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k
    · have htk : t k = h hk.choose := by
        unfold t
        rw [dif_pos hk]
      rw [htk]
      exact Classical.choose_spec hk
    · have htk : t k = a + (k : ℕ) * (r - g) + r / 2 := by
        unfold t
        rw [dif_neg hk]
      rw [htk]
      exact midpoint_mem_uniformCover (a := a) (n := n) (k := k) hg hgr
  have ht_adapted : ∀ k j, t k ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) j ↔ j = k := by
    intro k j
    by_cases hk : ∃ v, h v ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k
    · have htk : t k = h hk.choose := by
        unfold t
        rw [dif_pos hk]
      rw [htk]
      exact adapted_of_member_chosen_level (a := a) (r := r) (g := g)
        h hsep hgr k hk j
    · have htk : t k = a + (k : ℕ) * (r - g) + r / 2 := by
        unfold t
        rw [dif_neg hk]
      constructor
      · intro hj
        by_contra hne
        rw [htk] at hj
        exact (adapted_midpoint_not_mem_of_ne (a := a) (r := r) (g := g)
          (n := n) (k := k) (j := j) h hk hg hgr hne) hj
      · intro hkj
        subst j
        exact ht_mem k
  have ht_strict : StrictMono t := by
    apply (Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ (f := t)).2
    intro e
    have hb := adapted_overlap_bounds (a := a) (r := r) (g := g) (t := t) ht_adapted
      (by linarith [hg, hgr]) e
    linarith [hb.1, hb.2, hg]
  let T : CriticalValues n := ⟨t, ht_strict⟩
  refine ⟨T, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact ht_adapted
  · intro v
    obtain ⟨k, hvk⟩ := hcov v
    have hk : ∃ w, h w ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k := ⟨v, hvk⟩
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    have heq := hsep.1 k hk.choose v (Classical.choose_spec hk) hvk
    have htk : t k = h hk.choose := by
      unfold t
      rw [dif_pos hk]
    change t k = h v
    rw [htk]
    exact heq

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.pair_castSucc_succ_injective
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : e.castSucc ∈ ({e'.castSucc, e'.succ} : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) := by
    rw [← he]
    simp
  have h₂ : e'.castSucc ∈ ({e.castSucc, e.succ} : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) := by
    rw [he]
    simp
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h₁ h₂
  have hlt : e.castSucc < e.succ := Fin.castSucc_lt_succ
  have hlt' : e'.castSucc < e'.succ := Fin.castSucc_lt_succ
  rcases h₁ with h₁ | h₁ <;> rcases h₂ with h₂ | h₂
  · exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun z => z.val) h₁)
  · omega
  · omega
  · omega

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperCellsForget_injective
statement:
private theorem uniformMapperCellsForget_injective [Finite V] :
    Function.Injective (uniformMapperCellsForget G h a r g n)
proof:
:= by
  rintro (⟨k, c⟩ | ⟨e, c⟩) (⟨k', c'⟩ | ⟨e', c'⟩) hc
  · change c.1 = c'.1 at hc
    have hcc : c.1 = c'.1 := hc
    have hlabels : ({k} : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) = {k'} :=
      c.2.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun z => z.support.image Sigma.fst) hcc).trans c'.2)
    have hkk : k = k' := Finset.singleton_inj.1 hlabels
    subst k'
    have hc' : c = c' := Subtype.ext hcc
    subst hc'
    rfl
  · change c.1 = c'.1 at hc
    have hcc : c.1 = c'.1 := hc
    have hlabels : ({k} : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) = {e'.castSucc, e'.succ} :=
      c.2.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun z => z.support.image Sigma.fst) hcc).trans c'.2)
    have hcard := congrArg Finset.card hlabels
    rw [Finset.card_singleton,
      Finset.card_pair (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ (i := e')).ne] at hcard
    omega
  · change c.1 = c'.1 at hc
    have hcc : c.1 = c'.1 := hc
    have hlabels : ({e.castSucc, e.succ} : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) = {k'} :=
      c.2.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun z => z.support.image Sigma.fst) hcc).trans c'.2)
    have hcard := congrArg Finset.card hlabels
    rw [Finset.card_pair (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ (i := e)).ne, Finset.card_singleton] at hcard
    omega
  · change c.1 = c'.1 at hc
    have hcc : c.1 = c'.1 := hc
    have hlabels : ({e.castSucc, e.succ} : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) =
        {e'.castSucc, e'.succ} :=
      c.2.symm.trans ((congrArg (fun z => z.support.image Sigma.fst) hcc).trans c'.2)
    have hee : e = e' := pair_castSucc_succ_injective hlabels
    subst e'
    have hc' : c = c' := Subtype.ext hcc
    subst hc'
    rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperCells_pair_preimage
statement:
private theorem uniformMapperCells_pair_preimage [Finite V]
    (hgr : 2 * g ≤ r) (c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight G h)
      (fun i => (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) i : Set ℝ)))
    {k l : Fin (n + 1)} (hkl : k < l)
    (hc : c.support.image Sigma.fst = {k, l}) :
    ∃ p : (Σ e, (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).E e),
      uniformMapperCellsForget G h a r g n (Sum.inr p) = c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hfar : (k : ℕ) + 2 ≤ l
  · exact ((isEmpty_uniformEdgeCells_of_far G h hgr hfar).false ⟨c, hc⟩).elim
  have hnext : (k : ℕ) + 1 = l := by omega
  let e : Fin n := ⟨k, by omega⟩
  have hecast : e.castSucc = k := Fin.ext rfl
  have hesucc : e.succ = l := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simpa [e] using hnext
  refine ⟨⟨e, ⟨c, hc.trans ?_⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hecast, hesucc]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperCellsForget_surjective
statement:
private theorem uniformMapperCellsForget_surjective [Finite V]
    (hgr : 2 * g ≤ r) :
    Function.Surjective (uniformMapperCellsForget G h a r g n)
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  let L := c.support.image Sigma.fst
  have hLne : L.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := c.support_nonempty
    exact ⟨x.1, Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
  have hLcard : L.card ≤ 2 := by
    have hcard := multiNerveMapper_card_le_of_multiplicity
      (plHeight G h) (fun i => (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) i : Set ℝ))
      (coverMultiplicityAtMost_uniformCover hgr (plHeight G h)) c
    have himage : (c.support.image Sigma.fst).card ≤ c.support.card :=
      Finset.card_image_le
    exact himage.trans hcard
  have hpos : 0 < L.card := Finset.card_pos.2 hLne
  have hcases : L.card = 1 ∨ L.card = 2 := by omega
  rcases hcases with hcard_one | hcard_two
  · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.1 hcard_one
    refine ⟨Sum.inl ⟨k, ⟨c, show c.support.image Sigma.fst = {k} from hk⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨k, l, hkl, hL⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.1 hcard_two
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hkl with hkl' | hlk
    · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := uniformMapperCells_pair_preimage G h hgr c hkl'
        (show c.support.image Sigma.fst = {k, l} from hL)
      exact ⟨Sum.inr p, hp⟩
    · have hL' : L = {l, k} := hL.trans (Finset.pair_comm k l)
      obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := uniformMapperCells_pair_preimage G h hgr c hlk
        (show c.support.image Sigma.fst = {l, k} from hL')
      exact ⟨Sum.inr p, hp⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperVertexEquiv_apply
statement:
private theorem uniformMapperVertexEquiv_apply [Finite V] (T : CriticalValues n)
    (hT : LevelsAdapted T a r g) (hcov : CoversVertexHeights T h) (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (c : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).V k) :
    uniformMapperVertexEquiv G h T hT hcov k c =
      (Equiv.sumCongr
        (induceComponentsEquivOfEq G (hT.preimage_eq hcov k))
        (uncoveredEdgeEquivCrossesOfLevel G h
          ((hT k k).2 rfl)
          (fun v hv => (show v ∈ {v | h v = T.value k} from
            (hT.preimage_eq hcov k) ▸ hv))))
        (cellComponentsEquivSum G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k)
          ((vertexCellsCellGraphEquiv G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)) k) c))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.spanEdge_overlap_iff
statement:
theorem spanEdge_overlap_iff (T : CriticalValues n)
    (hT : LevelsAdapted T a r g) (hcov : CoversVertexHeights T h)
    (hgr : g ≤ r) (e : Fin n) (x : G.edgeSet) :
    EdgeSpans G h (a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g))
        (a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g) + g) x ↔
      EdgeSpans G h (T.value e.castSucc) (T.value e.succ) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq x
  rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff, edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
  have hleft : a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g) < T.value e.succ := by
    have hm := (hT e.succ e.succ).2 rfl
    rw [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval] at hm
    exact hm.1
  have hright : T.value e.castSucc <
      a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g) + g := by
    have hm := (hT e.castSucc e.castSucc).2 rfl
    rw [uniformCover_apply, mem_uniformInterval] at hm
    simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_castSucc] at hm ⊢
    push_cast at hm ⊢
    nlinarith [hm.2]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hmin, hmax⟩
    constructor
    · rcases min_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov d.fst
        have hjlt : j < e.succ := T.strictMono.lt_iff_lt.1 (by
          rw [hj, ← hm]
          exact hmin.trans_lt hleft)
        have hjle : j ≤ e.castSucc := Fin.le_castSucc_iff.2 hjlt
        rw [hm, ← hj]
        exact T.strictMono.monotone hjle
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov d.snd
        have hjlt : j < e.succ := T.strictMono.lt_iff_lt.1 (by
          rw [hj, ← hm]
          exact hmin.trans_lt hleft)
        have hjle : j ≤ e.castSucc := Fin.le_castSucc_iff.2 hjlt
        rw [hm, ← hj]
        exact T.strictMono.monotone hjle
    · rcases max_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov d.fst
        have hjlt : e.castSucc < j := T.strictMono.lt_iff_lt.1 (by
          rw [hj, ← hm]
          exact hright.trans_le hmax)
        have hle : e.succ ≤ j := Fin.castSucc_lt_iff_succ_le.1 hjlt
        rw [hm, ← hj]
        exact T.strictMono.monotone hle
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hcov d.snd
        have hjlt : e.castSucc < j := T.strictMono.lt_iff_lt.1 (by
          rw [hj, ← hm]
          exact hright.trans_le hmax)
        have hle : e.succ ≤ j := Fin.castSucc_lt_iff_succ_le.1 hjlt
        rw [hm, ← hj]
        exact T.strictMono.monotone hle
  · rintro ⟨hmin, hmax⟩
    constructor
    · exact hmin.trans (hT.overlap_left_ge hgr e)
    · exact (hT.overlap_right_le hgr e).trans hmax

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapper_cast_symm_apply
statement:
private theorem uniformMapper_cast_symm_apply {K L : OpenInterval}
    (hKL : K = L) (y : G.edgeSet) (hyK : EdgeActive G h K y)
    (hyL : EdgeActive G h L y) :
    (Equiv.cast (congrArg (fun K => (cellGraph G h K).ConnectedComponent) hKL)).symm
        ((cellGraph G h L).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr ⟨y, hyL⟩)) =
      (cellGraph G h K).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr ⟨y, hyK⟩)
proof:
:= by
  subst L
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperEdgeEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
theorem uniformMapperEdgeEquiv_symm_apply [Finite V] (T : CriticalValues n)
    (hT : LevelsAdapted T a r g) (hcov : CoversVertexHeights T h)
    (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : g ≤ r) (e : Fin n)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (T.value e.castSucc) (T.value e.succ))
    (hy : EdgeActive G h
      (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
        uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ) y.1) :
    edgeCellsCellGraphEquiv G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)) e.castSucc e.succ
        ((uniformMapperEdgeEquiv G h T hT hcov hg hgr e).symm y) =
      (cellGraph G h
        (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
          uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)).connectedComponentMk
        (Sum.inr ⟨y.1, hy⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hkl : (e.castSucc : ℕ) + 1 = e.succ := by simp
  let p : ℝ := a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g)
  let q : ℝ := p + g
  have hK : ∀ v, h v ∉ ioo p q := by
    intro v hv
    apply (hT.heightSeparating hcov).2 e.castSucc e.succ hkl v
    rw [uniformCover_inf_of_succ hgr hkl]
    exact hv
  have hpq : p < q := by linarith
  have hyL : EdgeActive G h (ioo p q) y.1 := by
    rw [← uniformCover_inf_of_succ hgr hkl]
    exact hy
  have hyspan : EdgeSpans G h p q y.1 := by
    exact ((spanEdge_overlap_iff G h T hT hcov hgr e y.1).2 y.2)
  have hyactive : EdgeActive G h (ioo p q) y.1 :=
    ((activeEdgeEquivSpans (G := G) (h := h) hpq hK).symm
      ⟨y.1, hyspan⟩).2
  have hcancel :
      edgeCellsCellGraphEquiv G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)) e.castSucc e.succ
          ((uniformMapperEdgeEquiv G h T hT hcov hg hgr e).symm y) =
        (Equiv.cast (congrArg (fun K => (cellGraph G h K).ConnectedComponent)
          (uniformCover_inf_of_succ hgr hkl))).symm
          ((cellGraph G h (ioo p q)).connectedComponentMk
            (Sum.inr ⟨y.1, hyactive⟩)) := by
    unfold uniformMapperEdgeEquiv uniformEdgeCellsEquivSpans uniformEdgeCellsEquiv
    erw [Equiv.symm_trans_apply, Equiv.symm_trans_apply, Equiv.symm_trans_apply,
      Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  rw [hcancel]
  exact uniformMapper_cast_symm_apply G h
    (uniformCover_inf_of_succ hgr hkl) y.1 hy hyL

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperEdgeEquiv_active
statement:
private theorem uniformMapperEdgeEquiv_active [Finite V] (T : CriticalValues n)
    (hT : LevelsAdapted T a r g) (hcov : CoversVertexHeights T h)
    (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : g ≤ r) (e : Fin n)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (T.value e.castSucc) (T.value e.succ)) :
    EdgeActive G h
      (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
        uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ) y.1
proof:
:= by
  have hkl : (e.castSucc : ℕ) + 1 = e.succ := by simp
  let p : ℝ := a + (e.succ : ℕ) * (r - g)
  let q : ℝ := p + g
  have hK : ∀ v, h v ∉ ioo p q := by
    intro v hv
    apply (hT.heightSeparating hcov).2 e.castSucc e.succ hkl v
    rw [uniformCover_inf_of_succ hgr hkl]
    exact hv
  have hpq : p < q := by linarith
  have hyspan : EdgeSpans G h p q y.1 :=
    ((spanEdge_overlap_iff G h T hT hcov hgr e y.1).2 y.2)
  have hyactive : EdgeActive G h (ioo p q) y.1 :=
    ((activeEdgeEquivSpans (G := G) (h := h) hpq hK).symm
      ⟨y.1, hyspan⟩).2
  rw [uniformCover_inf_of_succ hgr hkl]
  exact hyactive

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperVertexEquiv_cell_inr
statement:
theorem uniformMapperVertexEquiv_cell_inr [Finite V] (T : CriticalValues n)
    (hT : LevelsAdapted T a r g) (hcov : CoversVertexHeights T h)
    (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (x : {e : G.edgeSet //
      EdgeActive G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k) e})
    (hx : (∀ v ∈ (x.1 : Sym2 V), h v ≠ T.value k) →
      EdgeCrosses G h (T.value k) x.1) :
    uniformMapperVertexEquiv G h T hT hcov k
        ((vertexCellsCellGraphEquiv G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)) k).symm
          ((cellGraph G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k)).connectedComponentMk
            (Sum.inr x))) =
      levelEnd G h (T.value k) x.1 hx
proof:
:= by
  refine (uniformMapperVertexEquiv_apply G h T hT hcov k _).trans ?_
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  by_cases hw : ∃ w ∈ (x.1 : Sym2 V), h w = T.value k
  · obtain ⟨w, hw, hwc⟩ := hw
    have hwK : h w ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k := by
      rw [hwc]
      exact (hT k k).2 rfl
    rw [cellComponentsEquivSum_inr_of_mem G h
      (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k) x (w := ⟨w, hwK⟩) hw,
      levelEnd_of_mem G h hx hw hwc]
    rfl
  · replace hw : ∀ w ∈ (x.1 : Sym2 V), h w ≠ T.value k :=
      fun w hw' hwc => hw ⟨w, hw', hwc⟩
    have hunc : ∀ v ∈ (x.1 : Sym2 V),
        h v ∉ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k := fun v hv hvK =>
      hw v hv (show v ∈ {v | h v = T.value k} from (hT.preimage_eq hcov k) ▸ hvK)
    rw [cellComponentsEquivSum_inr_uncovered G h
      (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k) ⟨x.1, x.2, hunc⟩,
      levelEnd_of_forall_ne G h hx hw]
    rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperVertexEquiv_face_component_left
statement:
private theorem uniformMapperVertexEquiv_face_component_left [Finite V]
    (T : CriticalValues n) (hT : LevelsAdapted T a r g)
    (hcov : CoversVertexHeights T h) (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : g ≤ r) (e : Fin n)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (T.value e.castSucc) (T.value e.succ))
    (hy : EdgeActive G h
      (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
        uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ) y.1) :
    vertexCellsCellGraphEquiv G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)) e.castSucc
        (labelFace (plHeight G h)
          (fun i => (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) i : Set ℝ))
          ((uniformMapperEdgeEquiv G h T hT hcov hg hgr e).symm y)
          e.castSucc (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)) =
      (cellGraph G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc)).connectedComponentMk
        (Sum.inr ⟨y.1, hy.mono inf_le_left⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let c : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).E e :=
    (uniformMapperEdgeEquiv G h T hT hcov hg hgr e).symm y
  have hraw (z : ZerothHomotopy
      (plHeight G h ⁻¹'
        ((uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc : Set ℝ) ∩
          (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ : Set ℝ)))) :
      TDA.Topology.componentMap
          (TDA.Topology.preimageSetInclusion (ContinuousMap.id (Realization G))
            (Set.preimage_mono (f := plHeight G h) (Set.inter_subset_left :
              (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc : Set ℝ) ∩
                (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ : Set ℝ) ⊆
              (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc : Set ℝ)))) z =
        TDA.Reeb.componentMap
          (preimageInclusion (plHeight G h)
            (toOpens_le_iff.2 (inf_le_left :
              uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
                uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ ≤
              uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc)))
          (zerothHomotopySetCongr
            (plHeight_preimage_inter G h
              (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc)
              (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)) z) := by
    induction z using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x => rfl
  have hcomponent (z : ZerothHomotopy
      (plHeight G h ⁻¹'
        ((uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc : Set ℝ) ∩
          (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ : Set ℝ)))) :
      preimageComponentsEquiv G h
          (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc)
          (TDA.Topology.componentMap
            (TDA.Topology.preimageSetInclusion (ContinuousMap.id (Realization G))
              (Set.preimage_mono (f := plHeight G h) (Set.inter_subset_left :
                (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc : Set ℝ) ∩
                  (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ : Set ℝ) ⊆
                (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc : Set ℝ)))) z) =
        (preimageComponentsEquiv G h
          (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
            uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)
          (zerothHomotopySetCongr
            (plHeight_preimage_inter G h
              (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc)
              (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)) z)).map
          (cellInclusion G h (inf_le_left :
            uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
              uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ ≤
            uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc)) := by
    erw [hraw z]
    exact preimageComponentsEquiv_componentMap G h
      (inf_le_left :
        uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
          uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ ≤
        uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc) _
  have hedge :
      (preimageComponentsEquiv G h
        (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
          uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)
        (zerothHomotopySetCongr
          (plHeight_preimage_inter G h
            (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc)
            (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ))
          (edgeCellsEquiv (plHeight G h)
            (fun i => (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) i : Set ℝ))
            e.castSucc e.succ c))) =
      edgeCellsCellGraphEquiv G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1))
        e.castSucc e.succ c := rfl
  have hvertex :
      vertexCellsCellGraphEquiv G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)) e.castSucc
          (labelFace (plHeight G h)
            (fun i => (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) i : Set ℝ)) c
            e.castSucc (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)) =
        (cellGraph G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc)).connectedComponentMk
          (Sum.inr ⟨y.1, hy.mono inf_le_left⟩) := by
    rw [vertexCellsCellGraphEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply,
      vertexCellsEquiv_labelFace_pair_left (plHeight G h)
        (fun i => (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) i : Set ℝ)) c]
    refine (hcomponent _).trans ?_
    rw [hedge, uniformMapperEdgeEquiv_symm_apply G h T hT hcov hg hgr e y hy]
    rfl
  exact hvertex

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperVertexEquiv_face_component_right
statement:
private theorem uniformMapperVertexEquiv_face_component_right [Finite V]
    (T : CriticalValues n) (hT : LevelsAdapted T a r g)
    (hcov : CoversVertexHeights T h) (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : g ≤ r) (e : Fin n)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (T.value e.castSucc) (T.value e.succ))
    (hy : EdgeActive G h
      (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
        uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ) y.1) :
    vertexCellsCellGraphEquiv G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)) e.succ
        (labelFace (plHeight G h)
          (fun i => (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) i : Set ℝ))
          ((uniformMapperEdgeEquiv G h T hT hcov hg hgr e).symm y)
          e.succ (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))) =
      (cellGraph G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)).connectedComponentMk
        (Sum.inr ⟨y.1, hy.mono inf_le_right⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let c : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).E e :=
    (uniformMapperEdgeEquiv G h T hT hcov hg hgr e).symm y
  have hraw (z : ZerothHomotopy
      (plHeight G h ⁻¹'
        ((uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc : Set ℝ) ∩
          (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ : Set ℝ)))) :
      TDA.Topology.componentMap
          (TDA.Topology.preimageSetInclusion (ContinuousMap.id (Realization G))
            (Set.preimage_mono (f := plHeight G h) (Set.inter_subset_right :
              (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc : Set ℝ) ∩
                (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ : Set ℝ) ⊆
              (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ : Set ℝ)))) z =
        TDA.Reeb.componentMap
          (preimageInclusion (plHeight G h)
            (toOpens_le_iff.2 (inf_le_right :
              uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
                uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ ≤
              uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)))
          (zerothHomotopySetCongr
            (plHeight_preimage_inter G h
              (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc)
              (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)) z) := by
    induction z using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x => rfl
  have hcomponent (z : ZerothHomotopy
      (plHeight G h ⁻¹'
        ((uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc : Set ℝ) ∩
          (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ : Set ℝ)))) :
      preimageComponentsEquiv G h
          (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)
          (TDA.Topology.componentMap
            (TDA.Topology.preimageSetInclusion (ContinuousMap.id (Realization G))
              (Set.preimage_mono (f := plHeight G h) (Set.inter_subset_right :
                (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc : Set ℝ) ∩
                  (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ : Set ℝ) ⊆
                (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ : Set ℝ)))) z) =
        (preimageComponentsEquiv G h
          (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
            uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)
          (zerothHomotopySetCongr
            (plHeight_preimage_inter G h
              (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc)
              (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)) z)).map
          (cellInclusion G h (inf_le_right :
            uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
              uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ ≤
            uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)) := by
    erw [hraw z]
    exact preimageComponentsEquiv_componentMap G h
      (inf_le_right :
        uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
          uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ ≤
        uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ) _
  have hedge :
      (preimageComponentsEquiv G h
        (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc ⊓
          uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)
        (zerothHomotopySetCongr
          (plHeight_preimage_inter G h
            (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc)
            (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ))
          (edgeCellsEquiv (plHeight G h)
            (fun i => (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) i : Set ℝ))
            e.castSucc e.succ c))) =
      edgeCellsCellGraphEquiv G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1))
        e.castSucc e.succ c := rfl
  have hvertex :
      vertexCellsCellGraphEquiv G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)) e.succ
          (labelFace (plHeight G h)
            (fun i => (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) i : Set ℝ)) c e.succ
            (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))) =
        (cellGraph G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)).connectedComponentMk
          (Sum.inr ⟨y.1, hy.mono inf_le_right⟩) := by
    rw [vertexCellsCellGraphEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply,
      vertexCellsEquiv_labelFace_pair_right (plHeight G h)
        (fun i => (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) i : Set ℝ)) c]
    refine (hcomponent _).trans ?_
    rw [hedge, uniformMapperEdgeEquiv_symm_apply G h T hT hcov hg hgr e y hy]
    rfl
  exact hvertex

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperVertexEquiv_left
statement:
theorem uniformMapperVertexEquiv_left [Finite V] (T : CriticalValues n)
    (hT : LevelsAdapted T a r g) (hcov : CoversVertexHeights T h)
    (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : g ≤ r) (e : Fin n)
    (c : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).E e) :
    uniformMapperVertexEquiv G h T hT hcov e.castSucc
        ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).left e c) =
      (graphPLReebData G h T).left e
        (uniformMapperEdgeEquiv G h T hT hcov hg hgr e c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ :=
    (uniformMapperEdgeEquiv G h T hT hcov hg hgr e).symm.surjective c
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hy := uniformMapperEdgeEquiv_active G h T hT hcov hg hgr e y
  have hface :
      labelFace (plHeight G h)
          (fun i => (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) i : Set ℝ))
          ((uniformMapperEdgeEquiv G h T hT hcov hg hgr e).symm y)
          e.castSucc (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _) =
        (vertexCellsCellGraphEquiv G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)) e.castSucc).symm
          ((cellGraph G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.castSucc)).connectedComponentMk
            (Sum.inr ⟨y.1, hy.mono inf_le_left⟩)) := by
    apply (vertexCellsCellGraphEquiv G h
      (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)) e.castSucc).injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact uniformMapperVertexEquiv_face_component_left G h T hT hcov hg hgr e y hy
  rw [uniformMapperData_left, hface,
    uniformMapperVertexEquiv_cell_inr G h T hT hcov e.castSucc
      ⟨y.1, hy.mono inf_le_left⟩
      (y.2.crosses_left (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ e))]
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperVertexEquiv_right
statement:
theorem uniformMapperVertexEquiv_right [Finite V] (T : CriticalValues n)
    (hT : LevelsAdapted T a r g) (hcov : CoversVertexHeights T h)
    (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : g ≤ r) (e : Fin n)
    (c : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).E e) :
    uniformMapperVertexEquiv G h T hT hcov e.succ
        ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).right e c) =
      (graphPLReebData G h T).right e
        (uniformMapperEdgeEquiv G h T hT hcov hg hgr e c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ :=
    (uniformMapperEdgeEquiv G h T hT hcov hg hgr e).symm.surjective c
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hy := uniformMapperEdgeEquiv_active G h T hT hcov hg hgr e y
  have hface :
      labelFace (plHeight G h)
          (fun i => (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) i : Set ℝ))
          ((uniformMapperEdgeEquiv G h T hT hcov hg hgr e).symm y)
          e.succ (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)) =
        (vertexCellsCellGraphEquiv G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)) e.succ).symm
          ((cellGraph G h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) e.succ)).connectedComponentMk
            (Sum.inr ⟨y.1, hy.mono inf_le_right⟩)) := by
    apply (vertexCellsCellGraphEquiv G h
      (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)) e.succ).injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact uniformMapperVertexEquiv_face_component_right G h T hT hcov hg hgr e y hy
  rw [uniformMapperData_right, hface,
    uniformMapperVertexEquiv_cell_inr G h T hT hcov e.succ
      ⟨y.1, hy.mono inf_le_right⟩
      (y.2.crosses_right (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ e))]
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperHom_v
statement:

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperHom_e
statement:
@[simp] theorem uniformMapperHom_e [Finite V] (T : CriticalValues n)

    (hg : 0 < g) (hgr : g ≤ r) (e : Fin n) :

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.exists_uniformMapperIso
statement:
theorem exists_uniformMapperIso [Finite V] {m M ρ : ℝ}
    (hh : ∀ v, h v ∈ Set.Icc m M) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ∃ (a r g : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (T : CriticalValues n),
      0 < g ∧ 2 * g ≤ r ∧ r < ρ ∧ LevelsAdapted T a r g ∧
        CoversVertexHeights T h ∧
          Nonempty (uniformMapperData G h a r g n ≅ graphPLReebData G h T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, r, g, n', hg, hgr, hrρ, hn', ha₁, ha₂, hM, hsep, hcovers⟩ :=
    heightSeparating_covers_range h hh hρ
  obtain ⟨n, hn_eq⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn'.ne'
  subst hn_eq
  have hsep' : HeightSeparating h (uniformCover a r g (n + 1)) := by
    simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using hsep
  have hcov : ∀ v, ∃ k : Fin (n + 1),
      h v ∈ uniformCover a r g (n + 1) k := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hcovers G (plHeight G h (vertex G v))
      ⟨vertex G v, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
    exact hk
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hcovT⟩ := exists_levelsAdapted (a := a) (r := r) (g := g)
    h hg hgr hsep' hcov
  have hgr' : g ≤ r := by linarith
  refine ⟨a, r, g, n, T, hg, hgr, hrρ, hT, hcovT, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨uniformMapperIso G h T hT hcovT hg hgr'⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperHomologyMap_comp_eq

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperBarcode_eq

    mapperBarcode k f cover r n = mapperBarcode k f cover r' n

:=
  rankBarcode_eq_of_iso (eqToIso (mapperHomologyPModule_eq k f cover r n r'))

name: TDA.Mapper.nonempty_mapperBarcodeIso

    Nonempty (mapperHomologyPModule k f cover r n ≅

proof:

name: TDA.Mapper.finrank_range_mapperHomologyMap
statement:
theorem finrank_range_mapperHomologyMap {q t : Fin N} (h : q ≤ t) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (mapperHomologyMap k f (r h) n).hom) =
      (mapperBarcode k f cover r n).countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ q.val ∧ t.val < I.death)
proof:
:=
  (structureMapRank_rankBarcode (mapperHomologyPModule k f cover r n) q t h).symm.trans
    (rank_barcodeMap _ q t h)

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperBarcode_eq_iff
statement:
theorem mapperBarcode_eq_iff (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) :
    mapperBarcode k f cover r n = B ↔
      ∀ (q t : Fin N) (h : q ≤ t),
        Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (mapperHomologyMap k f (r h) n).hom) =
          B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ q.val ∧ t.val < I.death)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl q t h
    exact finrank_range_mapperHomologyMap k f cover r n h
  · intro hB
    calc mapperBarcode k f cover r n = rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := k) B) :=
          (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).2 fun q t h =>
            (hB q t h).trans (rank_barcodeMap B q t h).symm
      _ = B := rankBarcode_barcodeModule B

name: TDA.Mapper.nonempty_iso_iff_mapperBarcode_eq
statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_iff_mapperBarcode_eq :
    Nonempty (mapperHomologyPModule k f cover r n ≅ mapperHomologyPModule k f' cover' r' m) ↔
      mapperBarcode k f cover r n = mapperBarcode k f' cover' r' m
proof:
:=
  nonempty_iso_iff_rankBarcode_eq _ _

name: TDA.Mapper.CoherentCoverTower.finrank_range_simplicialHomologyMap
statement:
theorem finrank_range_simplicialHomologyMap {q t : Fin N} (h : q ≤ t) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyMap k (T.mapperMap f h) n).hom) =
      (mapperBarcode k f T.cover T.refinement n).countP
        (fun I => I.birth ≤ q.val ∧ t.val < I.death)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← T.structureMap_mapperHomologyPModule k f n h]
  exact finrank_range_mapperHomologyMap k f T.cover T.refinement n h

name: TDA.Mapper.add_const_mem_coverSaturation_translate_iff
statement:
theorem add_const_mem_coverSaturation_translate_iff (U : ι → OpenInterval) (c : ℝ)
    (I : OpenInterval) {y : ℝ} :
    y + c ∈ coverSaturation (fun i => translate (-c) (U i)) I ↔
      y ∈ coverSaturation U (translate c I)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_coverSaturation, mem_translate]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hy, z, hz, hzI⟩
    exact ⟨i, by simpa using hy, z - c, hz, by simpa using hzI⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hy, z, hz, hzI⟩
    exact ⟨i, by simpa using hy, z + c, by simpa using hz, hzI⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.preimage_coverSaturation_add_const
statement:
theorem preimage_coverSaturation_add_const (f : C(X, ℝ)) (U : ι → OpenInterval) (c : ℝ)
    (I : OpenInterval) :
    (f + ContinuousMap.const X c) ⁻¹' (coverSaturation (fun i => translate (-c) (U i)) I) =
      f ⁻¹' (coverSaturation U (translate c I))
proof:
:=
  Set.ext fun x => add_const_mem_coverSaturation_translate_iff U c I (y := f x)

name: TDA.Mapper.interleavingDistance_coverComponents_translate_le
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_coverComponents_translate_le (f : C(X, ℝ)) (U : ι → OpenInterval)
    (c : ℝ) :
    interleavingDistance (coverComponents f U)
      (coverComponents (f + ContinuousMap.const X c) (fun i => translate (-c) (U i))) ≤ ‖c‖₊
proof:
:= by
  rw [interleavingDistance_congr (Iso.refl _) (coverComponentsTranslateIso f U c)]
  exact interleavingDistance_translatePre_le c _

name: TDA.Mapper.coe_le_interleavingDistance_coverComponents_add_const
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite ι
  let S := Finset.univ.filter fun i => (f ⁻¹' (ioo (a i) (b i) : Set ℝ)).Nonempty
  have hS : S.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hact
    exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀, hmin⟩ := S.exists_min_image a hS
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hi₀).2
  have hx₀' : a i₀ < f x₀ ∧ f x₀ < b i₀ := hx₀
  refine le_interleavingDistance_of_forall_exists_isEmpty fun ε hε => ?_
  have hεc : (ε : ℝ) < c := by
    have := ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.1 hε
    rwa [← NNReal.coe_lt_coe, coe_nnnorm, Real.norm_of_nonneg hc.le] at this
  set η := (c - ε) / 2 with hη_def
  have hη : 0 < η := by linarith
  set m := min (b i₀ - a i₀) η with hm_def
  have hm : 0 < m := lt_min (by linarith) hη
  have hm₁ : m ≤ b i₀ - a i₀ := min_le_left _ _
  have hm₂ : m ≤ η := min_le_right _ _
  have hy₀ : a i₀ < a i₀ + m / 2 := by linarith
  have hy₁ : a i₀ + m / 2 < b i₀ := by linarith
  have hy₂ : a i₀ + m / 2 < a i₀ + η := by linarith
  refine ⟨ioo (a i₀) (a i₀ + η), ⟨ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x₀, mem_coverSaturation.2
    ⟨i₀, hx₀, a i₀ + m / 2, ⟨hy₀, hy₁⟩, ⟨hy₀, hy₂⟩⟩⟩⟩, ⟨fun p => ?_⟩⟩
  induction p using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    obtain ⟨i, hxi, z, hz, hzI⟩ := mem_coverSaturation.1 x.2
    have hxi' : a i + c < f x + c ∧ f x + c < b i + c := hxi
    have hz' : a i + c < z := hz.1
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hzw⟩ := mem_thicken.1 hzI
    have hw' : w < a i₀ + η := hw.2
    have hi : i ∈ S := Finset.mem_filter.2
      ⟨Finset.mem_univ i, x.1, show a i < f x.1 ∧ f x.1 < b i by constructor <;> linarith⟩
    have := hmin i hi
    linarith [(abs_le.1 hzw).2]

name: TDA.Mapper.interleavingDistance_coverComponents_add_const
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_coverComponents_add_const (f : C(X, ℝ)) (a b : ι → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hact : ∃ i, (f ⁻¹' (ioo (a i) (b i) : Set ℝ)).Nonempty) :
    interleavingDistance (coverComponents f fun i => ioo (a i) (b i))
      (coverComponents (f + ContinuousMap.const X c) fun i => ioo (a i + c) (b i + c)) =
      ‖c‖₊
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · have hU : (fun i => ioo (a i + c) (b i + c)) = fun i => translate (-c) (ioo (a i) (b i)) := by
      funext i
      rw [translate_ioo, sub_neg_eq_add, sub_neg_eq_add]
    rw [hU]
    exact interleavingDistance_coverComponents_translate_le f _ c
  rcases lt_trichotomy c 0 with hc | rfl | hc
  · have hact' : ∃ i, ((f + ContinuousMap.const X c) ⁻¹'
        (ioo (a i + c) (b i + c) : Set ℝ)).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨i, x, hx⟩ := hact
      have hx' : a i < f x ∧ f x < b i := hx
      exact ⟨i, x, show a i + c < f x + c ∧ f x + c < b i + c by constructor <;> linarith⟩
    have := coe_le_interleavingDistance_coverComponents_add_const (f + ContinuousMap.const X c)
      (fun i => a i + c) (fun i => b i + c) hact' (neg_pos.2 hc)
    have hback : f + ContinuousMap.const X c + ContinuousMap.const X (-c) = f := by ext; simp
    simp only [add_neg_cancel_right, hback, nnnorm_neg] at this
    rwa [interleavingDistance_comm]
  · simp
  · exact coe_le_interleavingDistance_coverComponents_add_const f a b hact hc

name: TDA.Mapper.geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLMapperReconstruction_add_const

    (c : ℝ) (hact : ∃ i, (plHeight G h ⁻¹' (ioo (a i) (b i) : Set ℝ)).Nonempty) :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)
      (graphPLMapperReconstruction G (fun v => h v + c) (fun i => a i + c)
        (fun i => b i + c)) = ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:

    interleavingDistance_coverComponents_add_const _ a b c hact, ← Real.enorm_eq_ofReal_abs]

statement:
theorem isEmpty_graphPLMapperReconstruction_of_isEmpty_cover [IsEmpty ι] (a b : ι → ℝ) :

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x => ?_⟩
  let t := overBaseMap (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b).obj x
  let I : OpenInterval := ioo (t - 1) (t + 1)
  have hx : t ∈ I := ⟨by simp, by simp⟩
  have p : ((RGraph.cosheafFunctor.obj (graphPLMapperReconstruction G h a b)).obj).obj I :=
    ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x, hx⟩
  have q := (categoricalMapperReconstructionIso (plHeight G h) a b
    (fun i => finite_zerothHomotopy G h (ioo (a i) (b i)))).hom.app I p
  induction q using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk y =>
    obtain ⟨i, -⟩ := mem_coverSaturation.mp y.2
    exact isEmptyElim i

name: TDA.Mapper.cappedCentredPairVertexMap_natural
statement:
theorem cappedCentredPairVertexMap_natural (P : HeightMapPair f g δ)
    (a s : ℝ) (ℓ : W → ℤ) {m m' : ℕ} (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ) (d : Fin m' ↪o ℝ)
    {i i' : Fin (m + 1)} {j j' : Fin (m' + 1)}
    (hii : i ≤ i') (hjj : j ≤ j')
    (h : stageRadius c i + (δ : ℝ) ≤ stageRadius d j)
    (h' : stageRadius c i' + (δ : ℝ) ≤ stageRadius d j') :
    VertexMap.comp (mapperMap f (cappedCentredRefinement a s ℓ c hii))
        (cappedCentredPairVertexMap P a s ℓ c d h') =
      VertexMap.comp (cappedCentredPairVertexMap P a s ℓ c d h)
        (mapperMap g (cappedCentredRefinement a s ℓ d hjj))
proof:
:= by
  apply VertexMap.ext
  rintro ⟨w, z⟩
  induction z using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    obtain rfl | ⟨i₀, rfl⟩ := i.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
    · exact isEmptyElim w
    obtain rfl | ⟨i'₀, rfl⟩ := i'.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
    · exact False.elim (by simpa using hii)
    obtain rfl | ⟨j₀, rfl⟩ := j.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
    · exact False.elim (Fin.succ_ne_zero i₀ (eq_zero_of_stageRadius_le h rfl))
    obtain rfl | ⟨j'₀, rfl⟩ := j'.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
    · exact False.elim (Fin.succ_ne_zero i'₀ (eq_zero_of_stageRadius_le h' rfl))
    change cappedCentredPairVertexMap P a s ℓ c d h'
        (mapperMap f (cappedCentredRefinement a s ℓ c hii) ⟨w, ZerothHomotopy.mk x⟩) =
      mapperMap g (cappedCentredRefinement a s ℓ d hjj)
        (cappedCentredPairVertexMap P a s ℓ c d h ⟨w, ZerothHomotopy.mk x⟩)
    rw [mapperMap_mk]
    rw [cappedCentredPairVertexMap_mk]
    rw [cappedCentredPairVertexMap_mk]
    rw [mapperMap_mk]
    change (⟨w, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨P.φ x.1, _⟩⟩ :
        ComponentIndex g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d j'₀.succ w : Set ℝ)) =
      ⟨w, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨P.φ x.1, _⟩⟩
    rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.joinedIn_cappedDoubleShift_f
statement:
private theorem joinedIn_cappedDoubleShift_f (a s : ℝ) (ℓ : W → ℤ)
    (P : HeightMapPair f g δ)
    {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ) {i k : Fin (m + 1)}
    (h : stageRadius c i + ((δ : ℝ) + (δ : ℝ)) ≤ stageRadius c k)
    (w : cappedIndex W i)
    (x : PullbackSpace f (fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ)) w) :
    JoinedIn (f ⁻¹' (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c k
      (stageSelector i k (eq_zero_of_stageRadius_le h) w) : Set ℝ))
      x.1 (P.ψ (P.φ x.1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := P.hψφ x.1
  refine ⟨γ, fun q => ?_⟩
  change f (γ q) ∈ cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c k
    (stageSelector i k (eq_zero_of_stageRadius_le h) w)
  have hpath : |f (γ q) - f x.1| ≤ (δ : ℝ) + (δ : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_add] using hγ q
  exact mem_cappedCentredCover_of_stageRadius_le h w hpath x.2

name: TDA.Mapper.joinedIn_cappedDoubleShift_g
statement:
private theorem joinedIn_cappedDoubleShift_g (a s : ℝ) (ℓ : W → ℤ)
    (P : HeightMapPair f g δ)
    {m : ℕ} (d : Fin m ↪o ℝ) {j k : Fin (m + 1)}
    (h : stageRadius d j + ((δ : ℝ) + (δ : ℝ)) ≤ stageRadius d k)
    (w : cappedIndex W j)
    (y : PullbackSpace g (fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d j w : Set ℝ)) w) :
    JoinedIn (g ⁻¹' (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d k
      (stageSelector j k (eq_zero_of_stageRadius_le h) w) : Set ℝ))
      y.1 (P.φ (P.ψ y.1))
proof:
:=
  joinedIn_cappedDoubleShift_f a s ℓ P.symm d h w y

name: TDA.Mapper.cappedCentredPairVertexMap_comp
statement:
theorem cappedCentredPairVertexMap_comp (P : HeightMapPair f g δ)
    (a s : ℝ) (ℓ : W → ℤ) {m m' : ℕ} (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ) (d : Fin m' ↪o ℝ)
    {i : Fin (m + 1)} {j : Fin (m' + 1)} {k : Fin (m + 1)} (hik : i ≤ k)
    (hcd : stageRadius c i + (δ : ℝ) ≤ stageRadius d j)
    (hdc : stageRadius d j + (δ : ℝ) ≤ stageRadius c k) :
    VertexMap.comp (cappedCentredPairVertexMap P a s ℓ c d hcd)
        (cappedCentredPairVertexMapSymm P a s ℓ c d hdc) =
      mapperMap f (cappedCentredRefinement a s ℓ c hik)
proof:
:= by
  apply VertexMap.ext
  rintro ⟨w, z⟩
  induction z using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    obtain rfl | ⟨i₀, rfl⟩ := i.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
    · exact isEmptyElim w
    obtain rfl | ⟨j₀, rfl⟩ := j.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
    · exact False.elim (Fin.succ_ne_zero i₀ (eq_zero_of_stageRadius_le hcd rfl))
    obtain rfl | ⟨k₀, rfl⟩ := k.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
    · exact False.elim (Fin.succ_ne_zero j₀ (eq_zero_of_stageRadius_le hdc rfl))
    have hdouble : stageRadius c i₀.succ + ((δ : ℝ) + (δ : ℝ)) ≤
        stageRadius c k₀.succ := by
      calc
        stageRadius c i₀.succ + ((δ : ℝ) + (δ : ℝ)) =
            (stageRadius c i₀.succ + (δ : ℝ)) + (δ : ℝ) := by rw [add_assoc]
        _ ≤ stageRadius d j₀.succ + (δ : ℝ) := add_le_add_left hcd (δ : EReal)
        _ ≤ stageRadius c k₀.succ := hdc
    change cappedCentredPairVertexMapSymm P a s ℓ c d hdc
        (cappedCentredPairVertexMap P a s ℓ c d hcd ⟨w, ZerothHomotopy.mk x⟩) =
      mapperMap f (cappedCentredRefinement a s ℓ c hik) ⟨w, ZerothHomotopy.mk x⟩
    rw [cappedCentredPairVertexMap_mk, cappedCentredPairVertexMapSymm_mk,
      mapperMap_mk]
    simp only [cappedCentredRefinement, stageSelector]
    change (⟨w, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨P.ψ (P.φ x.1), _⟩⟩ :
        ComponentIndex f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c k₀.succ w : Set ℝ)) =
      ⟨w, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x.1, _⟩⟩
    apply congrArg (fun z : ZerothHomotopy
        (PullbackSpace f (fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c k₀.succ w : Set ℝ)) w) =>
      (⟨w, z⟩ : ComponentIndex f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c k₀.succ w : Set ℝ)))
    have hxlarge := mem_cappedCentredCover_of_stageRadius_le hdouble w (z := f x.1)
      (y := f x.1) (by simp) x.2
    exact (mk_eq_of_joinedIn f _ (joinedIn_cappedDoubleShift_f a s ℓ P c hdouble w x)
      hxlarge (joinedIn_cappedDoubleShift_f a s ℓ P c hdouble w x).target_mem).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.cappedCentredPairVertexMapSymm_comp
statement:
theorem cappedCentredPairVertexMapSymm_comp (P : HeightMapPair f g δ)
    (a s : ℝ) (ℓ : W → ℤ) {m m' : ℕ} (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ) (d : Fin m' ↪o ℝ)
    {i : Fin (m' + 1)} {j : Fin (m + 1)} {k : Fin (m' + 1)} (hik : i ≤ k)

        (cappedCentredPairVertexMap P a s ℓ c d hcd) =

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le_of_heightMapPair
statement:
theorem bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le_of_heightMapPair
    {X X' : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace X']
    {f : C(X, ℝ)} {g : C(X', ℝ)} {δ η : ℝ≥0} (P : HeightMapPair f g δ)
    {m m' : ℕ} {c : Fin m ↪o ℝ} {d : Fin m' ↪o ℝ}
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    (hcd : ∀ t, stageRadius c (cellIndex c t) + (δ : ℝ) ≤
      stageRadius d (cellIndex d (t + η)))
    (hdc : ∀ t, stageRadius d (cellIndex d t) + (δ : ℝ) ≤
      stageRadius c (cellIndex c (t + η))) :
    bottleneck (cappedCentredDiagram k f a s ℓ c n)
      (cappedCentredDiagram k g a s ℓ d n) ≤ η
proof:
:= by
  calc
    bottleneck (cappedCentredDiagram k f a s ℓ c n)
        (cappedCentredDiagram k g a s ℓ d n) =
      realInterleavingDistance
        (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower c fun i w =>
          (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))
            (stepRefinement c _ fun h => cappedCentredRefinement a s ℓ c h) n)
        (mapperHomologyPModule k g (stepTower d fun i w =>
          (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ))
            (stepRefinement d _ fun h => cappedCentredRefinement a s ℓ d h) n) := by
          change bottleneck
            (moduleDiagram c
              (mapperHomologyPModule k f (stepTower c fun i w =>
                (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))
                  (stepRefinement c _ fun h => cappedCentredRefinement a s ℓ c h) n) _)
            (moduleDiagram d
              (mapperHomologyPModule k g (stepTower d fun i w =>
                (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ))
                  (stepRefinement d _ fun h => cappedCentredRefinement a s ℓ d h) n) _) = _
          exact bottleneck_eq_distance
            (isConstructible_stepTower c _ k f _ n)
            (isConstructible_stepTower d _ k g _ n) _ _
    _ ≤ η := (cappedCentredPairInterleaving k a s ℓ n P hcd hdc).distance_le

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_pair_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_pair_le
    {X X' : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace X']
    {f : C(X, ℝ)} {g : C(X', ℝ)} {m : ℕ} {c : Fin m ↪o ℝ}
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    {δ μ : ℝ≥0} (P : HeightMapPair f g δ)
    (hgap : ∀ i j : Fin m, j.val = i.val + 1 → c j ≤ c i + μ) :
    bottleneck (cappedCentredDiagram k f a s ℓ c n)
      (cappedCentredDiagram k g a s ℓ c n) ≤ (δ : ℝ≥0∞) + μ
proof:
:= by
  apply bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le_of_heightMapPair k a s ℓ n P
  · intro t
    rw [NNReal.coe_add]
    exact stageRadius_add_le_of_gap c (by positivity) hgap t
  · intro t
    rw [NNReal.coe_add]
    exact stageRadius_add_le_of_gap c (by positivity) hgap t

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_pair_uniformGrid_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_pair_uniformGrid_le
    {X X' : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace X']
    {f : C(X, ℝ)} {g : C(X', ℝ)} {δ : ℝ≥0}
    (P : HeightMapPair f g δ) (x₀ h : ℝ) (hh : 0 < h) (m : ℕ)
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper f fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex g fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper g fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    (p : ℕ) (hδ : (δ : ℝ) = p * h) :
    bottleneck
      (cappedCentredDiagram k f a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) n)
      (cappedCentredDiagram k g a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) n) ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  apply bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le_of_heightMapPair k a s ℓ n P
  · intro t
    rw [hδ]
    exact stageRadius_add_le_uniformGrid x₀ h hh m p t
  · intro t
    rw [hδ]
    exact stageRadius_add_le_uniformGrid x₀ h hh m p t

name: TDA.Mapper.bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_pair_le_ofUniformBound
statement:
theorem bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_pair_le_ofUniformBound
    {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X] {f g : C(X, ℝ)} {m m' : ℕ}
    {c : Fin m ↪o ℝ} {d : Fin m' ↪o ℝ}
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper f fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ c i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ))]
    [∀ i, Finite (Face (mapper g fun w => (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ d i w : Set ℝ)) n)]
    {δ η : ℝ≥0} (hfg : ∀ x, |f x - g x| ≤ δ)
    (hcd : ∀ t, stageRadius c (cellIndex c t) + (δ : ℝ) ≤
      stageRadius d (cellIndex d (t + η)))
    (hdc : ∀ t, stageRadius d (cellIndex d t) + (δ : ℝ) ≤
      stageRadius c (cellIndex c (t + η))) :
    bottleneck (cappedCentredDiagram k f a s ℓ c n)
      (cappedCentredDiagram k g a s ℓ d n) ≤ η
proof:
:=
  bottleneck_cappedCentredDiagram_le_of_heightMapPair k a s ℓ n
    (HeightMapPair.ofUniformBound hfg) hcd hdc

    {h₁ : V → ℝ} {h₂ : V' → ℝ} {δ : ℝ≥0}

    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex (plHeight G h₁) fun w =>

    [∀ i, LinearOrder (ComponentIndex (plHeight G' h₂) fun w =>
      (cappedCentredCover a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) i w : Set ℝ))]

    bottleneck
      (cappedCentredDiagram k (plHeight G h₁) a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) n)
      (cappedCentredDiagram k (plHeight G' h₂) a s ℓ (uniformGrid x₀ h hh m) n) ≤ δ

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperHomologyDomainMap_id
statement:
theorem mapperHomologyDomainMap_id (U : I → Set Y) [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f U)] (n : ℕ) :
    mapperHomologyDomainMap R (ContinuousMap.id X) (fun _ => rfl) U n =
      𝟙 (simplicialHomology (mapper f U) R n)
