name: TDA.Mapper.mapperHomologyDomainMap_comp
statement:
theorem mapperHomologyDomainMap_comp {X'' : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X''] {f'' : C(X'', Y)}
    (ψ : C(X', X'')) (hψ : ∀ x, f'' (ψ x) = f' x) (U : I → Set Y)
    [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f U)] [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f' U)]
    [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f'' U)] (n : ℕ) :
    mapperHomologyDomainMap R (ψ.comp φ) (fun x => (hψ _).trans (hφ x)) U n =
      mapperHomologyDomainMap R φ hφ U n ≫ mapperHomologyDomainMap R ψ hψ U n
proof:
:= by
  change simplicialHomologyMap R (mapperDomainMap (ψ.comp φ) _ U) n = _
  rw [mapperDomainMap_comp φ hφ ψ hψ U]
  exact simplicialHomologyMap_comp R (mapperDomainMap φ hφ U) (mapperDomainMap ψ hψ U) n

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperHomologyDomainMap_congr
statement:
theorem mapperHomologyDomainMap_congr {φ φ' : C(X, X')} (h : φ = φ')
    (hφ : ∀ x, f' (φ x) = f x) (hφ' : ∀ x, f' (φ' x) = f x) (U : I → Set Y)
    [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f U)] [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f' U)] (n : ℕ) :
    mapperHomologyDomainMap R φ hφ U n = mapperHomologyDomainMap R φ' hφ' U n
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.mapperHomologyMap_comp_mapperHomologyDomainMap
statement:
theorem mapperHomologyMap_comp_mapperHomologyDomainMap {U : I → Set Y} {V : J → Set Y}
    [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f U)] [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f' U)]
    [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f V)] [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f' V)] (r : Refinement U V) (n : ℕ) :
    mapperHomologyMap R f r n ≫ mapperHomologyDomainMap R φ hφ V n =
      mapperHomologyDomainMap R φ hφ U n ≫ mapperHomologyMap R f' r n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapperHomologyMap_def, mapperHomologyMap_def, mapperHomologyDomainMap,
    mapperHomologyDomainMap, ← simplicialHomologyMap_comp, ← simplicialHomologyMap_comp,
    mapperMap_comp_mapperDomainMap]

name: TDA.Mapper.plHeight_realizationHomeomorph
proof:
:= by
  have key : (plHeight G' g).comp (realizationMap e.toHom) = plHeight G h :=
    plHeight_unique G h _ (fun v => hg v) fun d t => by
      change (1 - (t : ℝ)) * g (e d.fst) + (t : ℝ) * g (e d.snd) =
        (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h d.fst + (t : ℝ) * h d.snd

name: TDA.Mapper.centredMapperPairVertexMap_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem centredMapperPairVertexMap_mk (P : HeightMapPair f g δ) (s t : ℝ)
    (k : ℤ) (x : PullbackSpace f (centredCover s t) k) :
    centredMapperPairVertexMap P s t ⟨k, ZerothHomotopy.mk x⟩ =
      ⟨k, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨P.φ x.1, by
        rw [mem_centredCover_iff]
        have hx : |f x.1 - k * s| < t := mem_centredCover_iff.mp x.2
        calc
          |g (P.φ x.1) - k * s| ≤ |g (P.φ x.1) - f x.1| + |f x.1 - k * s|
proof:
:=
            abs_sub_le _ _ _
          _ < (δ : ℝ) + t := add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (P.hφ x.1) hx
          _ = t + δ := add_comm _ _⟩⟩ := by
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm_mk (P : HeightMapPair f g δ) (s t : ℝ)
    (k : ℤ) (y : PullbackSpace g (centredCover s t) k) :
    centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm P s t ⟨k, ZerothHomotopy.mk y⟩ =
      ⟨k, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨P.ψ y.1, by
        rw [mem_centredCover_iff]
        have hy : |g y.1 - k * s| < t := mem_centredCover_iff.mp y.2
        calc
          |f (P.ψ y.1) - k * s| ≤ |f (P.ψ y.1) - g y.1| + |g y.1 - k * s|
proof:
:=
            abs_sub_le _ _ _
          _ < (δ : ℝ) + t := add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt (P.hψ y.1) hy
          _ = t + δ := add_comm _ _⟩⟩ := by
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.centredMapperPairVertexMap_natural
statement:
theorem centredMapperPairVertexMap_natural (P : HeightMapPair f g δ) (s : ℝ)
    {t t' : ℝ} (h : t ≤ t') :
    VertexMap.comp (mapperMap f (centredCoverRefinement s h))
        (centredMapperPairVertexMap P s t') =
      VertexMap.comp (centredMapperPairVertexMap P s t)
        (mapperMap g (centredCoverRefinement s (add_le_add h le_rfl)))
proof:
:= by
  apply VertexMap.ext
  rintro ⟨k, c⟩
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    change centredMapperPairVertexMap P s t'
        (mapperMap f (centredCoverRefinement s h) ⟨k, ZerothHomotopy.mk x⟩) =
      mapperMap g (centredCoverRefinement s (add_le_add h le_rfl))
        (centredMapperPairVertexMap P s t ⟨k, ZerothHomotopy.mk x⟩)
    rw [mapperMap_mk, centredMapperPairVertexMap_mk,
      centredMapperPairVertexMap_mk, mapperMap_mk]
    rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm_natural
statement:
theorem centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm_natural (P : HeightMapPair f g δ) (s : ℝ)
    {t t' : ℝ} (h : t ≤ t') :
    VertexMap.comp (mapperMap g (centredCoverRefinement s h))
        (centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm P s t') =
      VertexMap.comp (centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm P s t)
        (mapperMap f (centredCoverRefinement s (add_le_add h le_rfl)))
proof:
:=
  centredMapperPairVertexMap_natural P.symm s h

name: TDA.Mapper.joinedIn_doubleShift_f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := P.hψφ x.1
  refine ⟨γ, fun q => ?_⟩
  change f (γ q) ∈ centredCover s (t + δ + δ) k
  rw [mem_centredCover_iff]
  have hx : |f x.1 - k * s| < t := mem_centredCover_iff.mp x.2
  calc
    |f (γ q) - k * s| ≤ |f (γ q) - f x.1| + |f x.1 - k * s| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
    _ < δ + δ + t := by
      have hpath : |f (γ q) - f x.1| ≤ (δ : ℝ) + δ := by
        simpa only [NNReal.coe_add] using hγ q
      exact add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt hpath hx
    _ = t + δ + δ := by ring

name: TDA.Mapper.joinedIn_doubleShift_g
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := P.hφψ y.1
  refine ⟨γ, fun q => ?_⟩
  change g (γ q) ∈ centredCover s (t + δ + δ) k
  rw [mem_centredCover_iff]
  have hy : |g y.1 - k * s| < t := mem_centredCover_iff.mp y.2
  calc
    |g (γ q) - k * s| ≤ |g (γ q) - g y.1| + |g y.1 - k * s| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
    _ < δ + δ + t := by
      have hpath : |g (γ q) - g y.1| ≤ (δ : ℝ) + δ := by
        simpa only [NNReal.coe_add] using hγ q
      exact add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt hpath hy
    _ = t + δ + δ := by ring

name: TDA.Mapper.centredMapperPairVertexMap_comp
statement:
theorem centredMapperPairVertexMap_comp (P : HeightMapPair f g δ) (s t : ℝ) :
    VertexMap.comp (centredMapperPairVertexMap P s t)
        (centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm P s (t + δ)) =
      mapperMap f (centredCoverRefinement s (by
        have _hδ : 0 ≤ (δ : ℝ) := δ.coe_nonneg
        linarith))
proof:
:= by
  apply VertexMap.ext
  rintro ⟨k, c⟩
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    change centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm P s (t + δ)
        (centredMapperPairVertexMap P s t ⟨k, ZerothHomotopy.mk x⟩) =
      mapperMap f (centredCoverRefinement s (by
        have _hδ : 0 ≤ (δ : ℝ) := δ.coe_nonneg
        linarith)) ⟨k, ZerothHomotopy.mk x⟩
    rw [centredMapperPairVertexMap_mk, centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm_mk,
      mapperMap_mk]
    simp only [centredCoverRefinement]
    change (⟨k, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨P.ψ (P.φ x.1), _⟩⟩ :
        ComponentIndex f (centredCover s (t + δ + δ))) =
      ⟨k, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x.1, _⟩⟩
    apply congrArg (fun c : ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace f (centredCover s (t + δ + δ)) k) =>
      (⟨k, c⟩ : ComponentIndex f (centredCover s (t + δ + δ))))
    have hxlarge : f x.1 ∈ centredCover s (t + δ + δ) k := by
      rw [mem_centredCover_iff]
      have hx : |f x.1 - k * s| < t := mem_centredCover_iff.mp x.2
      have _hδ : 0 ≤ (δ : ℝ) := δ.coe_nonneg
      linarith
    exact (TDA.Topology.mk_eq_of_joinedIn f (centredCover s (t + δ + δ) k)
      (joinedIn_doubleShift_f P s t k x) hxlarge
      (joinedIn_doubleShift_f P s t k x).target_mem).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm_comp
statement:
theorem centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm_comp (P : HeightMapPair f g δ) (s t : ℝ) :
    VertexMap.comp (centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm P s t)
        (centredMapperPairVertexMap P s (t + δ)) =
      mapperMap g (centredCoverRefinement s (by
        have _hδ : 0 ≤ (δ : ℝ) := δ.coe_nonneg
        linarith))
proof:
:=
  centredMapperPairVertexMap_comp P.symm s t

statement:
private theorem centredMapperPairHomologyMap_comp_f (P : HeightMapPair f g δ)
    (t : ℝ) :

        simplicialHomologyMap R (centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm P s (t + δ)) n =
      mapperHomologyMap R f
        (centredCoverRefinement s (by

name: TDA.Mapper.centredMapperPairHomologyMap_comp_g
statement:
private theorem centredMapperPairHomologyMap_comp_g (P : HeightMapPair f g δ)
    (t : ℝ) :
    simplicialHomologyMap R (centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm P s t) n ≫
        simplicialHomologyMap R (centredMapperPairVertexMap P s (t + δ)) n =
      mapperHomologyMap R g
        (centredCoverRefinement s (by
          have _hδ : 0 ≤ (δ : ℝ) := δ.coe_nonneg
          linarith)) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← simplicialHomologyMap_comp R (centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm P s t)
    (centredMapperPairVertexMap P s (t + δ)) n,
    centredMapperPairVertexMapSymm_comp P s t, ← mapperHomologyMap_def]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.IsLevelWindow.preimage_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · exact hI.2 v
  · intro hv
    show h v ∈ I
    rw [show h v = c from hv]
    exact hI.1

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.exists_isLevelWindow
statement:
theorem exists_isLevelWindow [Finite V] (c : ℝ) :
    ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ IsLevelWindow h c (ioo (c - η) (c + η))
proof:
:= by
  let A : Set ℝ := {x | ∃ v, h v = x ∧ h v ≠ c}
  have hA : A.Finite := (Set.finite_range h).subset (by
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with ⟨v, hv, _⟩
    exact ⟨v, hv⟩)
  have hcA : c ∉ A := by
    intro hc
    rcases hc with ⟨v, hv, hne⟩
    exact hne hv
  have hopen : IsOpen Aᶜ := hA.isClosed.isOpen_compl
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.1 hopen c hcA
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  unfold IsLevelWindow
  constructor
  · rw [mem_ioo]
    constructor <;> linarith
  · intro v hv
    by_contra hne
    have hb : h v ∈ Metric.ball c η := by
      rw [Real.ball_eq_Ioo]
      exact hv
    exact (hball hb) ⟨v, rfl, hne⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelWindowEquiv_apply
statement:
private theorem levelWindowEquiv_apply {c : ℝ} {I : OpenInterval}
    (hI : IsLevelWindow h c I)
    (x : (intervalComponents (plHeight G h)).obj I) :
    levelWindowEquiv G h hI x =
      Equiv.sumCongr (induceComponentsEquivOfEq G (IsLevelWindow.preimage_eq h hI))
        (uncoveredEdgeEquivCrossesOfLevel G h hI.1 fun _ hv => hI.2 _ hv)
        (cellComponentsEquivSum G h I (preimageComponentsEquiv G h I x))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelWindowEquiv_componentMap_mk
statement:
private theorem levelWindowEquiv_componentMap_mk {c : ℝ} {I : OpenInterval}
    (hI : IsLevelWindow h c I) (x : ClosedLevel G h c) :
    levelWindowEquiv G h hI
        (TDA.Topology.componentMap (levelInclusion G h hI.1) (ZerothHomotopy.mk x)) =
      levelWindowEquiv G h hI
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨x.1, (levelInclusion G h hI.1 x).2⟩ :
          {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ I}))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLStarEquiv_eq_levelWindowEquiv
statement:
theorem graphPLStarEquiv_eq_levelWindowEquiv {n : ℕ} (S : CriticalValues n)
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i =
      levelWindowEquiv G h
        (c := S.value i) (I := S.J i)
        ⟨S.value_mem_J i, fun _ hv => hS.eq_of_mem_J hv⟩
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelWindowEquiv_mk_vertex
statement:
theorem levelWindowEquiv_mk_vertex {c : ℝ} {I : OpenInterval}
    (hI : IsLevelWindow h c I) (v : V) (hv : h v = c) :
    levelWindowEquiv G h hI
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨vertex G v, by rw [plHeight_vertex, hv]; exact hI.1⟩ :
          {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ I})) =
      Sum.inl ((G.induce {v | h v = c}).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hv⟩)
proof:
:= by
  refine (levelWindowEquiv_apply G h hI _).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun c => Equiv.sumCongr
    (induceComponentsEquivOfEq G (IsLevelWindow.preimage_eq h hI))
    (uncoveredEdgeEquivCrossesOfLevel G h hI.1 fun _ hv => hI.2 _ hv)
    (cellComponentsEquivSum G h I c))
    (preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex G h I v (by rw [hv]; exact hI.1))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelWindowEquiv_cell_inr
statement:
private theorem levelWindowEquiv_cell_inr {c : ℝ} {I : OpenInterval}
    (hI : IsLevelWindow h c I)
    (e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeActive G h I e})
    (hx : (∀ v ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V), h v ≠ c) → EdgeCrosses G h c e.1) :
    levelWindowEquiv G h hI ((preimageComponentsEquiv G h I).symm
        ((cellGraph G h I).connectedComponentMk (Sum.inr e))) =
      levelEnd G h c e.1 hx
proof:
:= by
  refine (levelWindowEquiv_apply G h hI _).trans ?_
  rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  by_cases hw : ∃ w ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V), h w = c
  · obtain ⟨w, hw, hwc⟩ := hw
    have hwI : h w ∈ I := by
      rw [hwc]
      exact hI.1
    rw [cellComponentsEquivSum_inr_of_mem G h I e (w := ⟨w, hwI⟩) hw,
      levelEnd_of_mem G h hx hw hwc]
    rfl
  · replace hw : ∀ w ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V), h w ≠ c := fun w hw' hwc => hw ⟨w, hw', hwc⟩
    have hunc : ∀ v ∈ (e.1 : Sym2 V), h v ∉ I := fun v hv hvI =>
      hw v hv (hI.2 v hvI)
    rw [cellComponentsEquivSum_inr_uncovered G h I ⟨e.1, e.2, hunc⟩,
      levelEnd_of_forall_ne G h hx hw]
    rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelWindowEquiv_mk_edgePoint
statement:
theorem levelWindowEquiv_mk_edgePoint {c : ℝ} {I : OpenInterval}
    (hI : IsLevelWindow h c I) (d : G.Dart) (t : unitInterval)
    (ht : dartHeight h d t ∈ I)
    (hx : (∀ v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V), h v ≠ c) →
      EdgeCrosses G h c (dartEdge d)) :
    levelWindowEquiv G h hI
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨edgePoint G d t, ht⟩ :
          {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ I})) =
      levelEnd G h c (dartEdge d) hx
proof:
:= by
  have key := levelWindowEquiv_cell_inr G h hI
    ⟨dartEdge d, edgeActive_dartEdge_of_mem ht⟩ hx
  rw [← preimageComponentsEquiv_mk_edgePoint G h I d t ht, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at key
  exact key

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.dartHeight_crossingParam
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < h d.snd - h d.fst := by linarith
  have hmul : (c - h d.fst) / (h d.snd - h d.fst) *
      (h d.snd - h d.fst) = c - h d.fst :=
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden.ne'
  show (1 - ((c - h d.fst) / (h d.snd - h d.fst))) * h d.fst +
      ((c - h d.fst) / (h d.snd - h d.fst)) * h d.snd = c
  linear_combination hmul

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.exists_dart_crossing
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e.1
  have hcross : EdgeCrosses G h c (dartEdge d) := by
    rw [hd]
    exact e.2
  obtain ⟨hmin, hmax⟩ := (edgeCrosses_dartEdge_iff d).1 hcross
  rcases le_total (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hab | hab
  · refine ⟨d, hd, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [min_eq_left hab] at hmin
      exact hmin
    · rw [max_eq_right hab] at hmax
      exact hmax
  · refine ⟨d.symm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [dartEdge_symm]
      exact hd
    · rw [min_eq_right hab] at hmin
      exact hmin
    · rw [max_eq_left hab] at hmax
      exact hmax

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.crossingPoint_spec
statement:
private theorem crossingPoint_spec {c : ℝ} (e : {e // EdgeCrosses G h c e}) :
    ∃ d : G.Dart, ∃ h₁ : h d.fst < c, ∃ h₂ : c < h d.snd,
      dartEdge d = e.1 ∧
        (crossingPoint G h e).1 = edgePoint G d (crossingParam G h h₁ h₂)
proof:
:= by
  let hex := exists_dart_crossing G h e
  let d := Classical.choose hex
  have hd := Classical.choose_spec hex
  refine ⟨d, hd.2.1, hd.2.2, hd.1, ?_⟩
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.eq_of_dartHeight_eq
statement:
private theorem eq_of_dartHeight_eq {d : G.Dart} {s t : unitInterval}
    (hne : h d.fst ≠ h d.snd) (hst : dartHeight h d s = dartHeight h d t) : s = t
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply mul_right_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne.symm)
  unfold dartHeight at hst
  linear_combination hst

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.eq_crossingPoint
statement:
theorem eq_crossingPoint {c : ℝ} (e : {e // EdgeCrosses G h c e}) (d : G.Dart)
    (hd : dartEdge d = e.1) (t : unitInterval) (ht : dartHeight h d t = c) :
    edgePoint G d t = (crossingPoint G h e).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d', h₁, h₂, hd', hcp⟩ := crossingPoint_spec G h e
  have hne : h d'.fst ≠ h d'.snd := by linarith
  have hdd : dartEdge d = dartEdge d' := hd.trans hd'.symm
  rcases dartEdge_eq_iff.1 hdd with hdd' | hdd'
  · have ht' : dartHeight h d' t = c := by
      simpa [hdd'] using ht
    have hts := eq_of_dartHeight_eq G h hne
      (ht'.trans (dartHeight_crossingParam G h h₁ h₂).symm)
    calc
      edgePoint G d t = edgePoint G d' t := by rw [hdd']
      _ = edgePoint G d' (crossingParam G h h₁ h₂) :=
        congrArg (edgePoint G d') hts
      _ = (crossingPoint G h e).1 := hcp.symm
  · have ht'' : dartHeight h d'.symm t = c := by
      simpa [hdd'] using ht
    have ht' : dartHeight h d' (unitInterval.symm t) = c := by
      have hsymm := dartHeight_symm h d' (unitInterval.symm t)
      rw [unitInterval.symm_symm] at hsymm
      exact hsymm.symm.trans ht''
    have hts := eq_of_dartHeight_eq G h hne
      (ht'.trans (dartHeight_crossingParam G h h₁ h₂).symm)
    calc
      edgePoint G d t = edgePoint G d'.symm t := by rw [hdd']
      _ = edgePoint G d' (unitInterval.symm t) := by
        have hsymm := edgePoint_symm G d' (unitInterval.symm t)
        simpa using hsymm
      _ = edgePoint G d' (crossingParam G h h₁ h₂) := congrArg (edgePoint G d') hts
      _ = (crossingPoint G h e).1 := hcp.symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.joinedIn_level_of_eq
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨{
      toFun := fun s => edgePoint G d (s * t)
      continuous_toFun := (continuous_edgePoint G d).comp
        (Continuous.subtype_mk (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)
          (fun s => unitInterval.mul_mem s.2 t.2))
      source' := by simp [edgePoint_zero]
      target' := by simp
    }, ?_⟩
  intro s
  change plHeight G h (edgePoint G d (s * t)) = c
  rw [plHeight_edgePoint, dartHeight_of_eq h (hd₁.trans hd₂.symm), hd₁]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.closedLevelPoint_inr
statement:
private theorem closedLevelPoint_inr {c : ℝ}
    (e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h c e}) :
    closedLevelPoint G h c (Sum.inr e) =
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk (crossingPoint G h e) : ZerothHomotopy (ClosedLevel G h c))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.closedLevelPoint_inl_mk
statement:
private theorem closedLevelPoint_inl_mk {c : ℝ} (v : {v : V | h v = c}) :
    closedLevelPoint G h c (Sum.inl ((G.induce {v | h v = c}).connectedComponentMk v)) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨vertex G v.1, by
        change h v.1 = c
        exact v.2⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelWindow_closedLevelPoint
statement:
private theorem levelWindow_closedLevelPoint {c : ℝ} {I : OpenInterval}
    (hI : IsLevelWindow h c I) (y : LevelVertex G h c) :
    levelWindowEquiv G h hI
        (TDA.Topology.componentMap (levelInclusion G h hI.1)
          (closedLevelPoint G h c y)) = y
proof:
:= by
  rcases y with y | y
  · induction y using ConnectedComponent.ind with
    | h v =>
      rw [closedLevelPoint_inl_mk G h v, levelWindowEquiv_componentMap_mk G h hI,
        levelWindowEquiv_mk_vertex G h hI v.1 v.2]
  · obtain ⟨d, h₁, h₂, hd, hpoint⟩ := crossingPoint_spec G h y
    have hne : ∀ v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V), h v ≠ c := by
      intro v hv
      rcases mem_dartEdge.1 hv with rfl | rfl
      · exact h₁.ne
      · exact h₂.ne'
    let hx : (∀ v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V), h v ≠ c) →
        EdgeCrosses G h c (dartEdge d) := fun _ => by
      rw [hd]
      exact y.2
    have ht : dartHeight h d (crossingParam G h h₁ h₂) ∈ I := by
      rw [dartHeight_crossingParam G h h₁ h₂]
      exact hI.1
    rw [closedLevelPoint_inr G h y, levelWindowEquiv_componentMap_mk G h hI]
    have hmk : (⟨(crossingPoint G h y).1,
          (levelInclusion G h hI.1 (crossingPoint G h y)).2⟩ :
          {p : Realization G // plHeight G h p ∈ I}) =
        ⟨edgePoint G d (crossingParam G h h₁ h₂), ht⟩ := Subtype.ext hpoint
    rw [hmk, levelWindowEquiv_mk_edgePoint G h hI d (crossingParam G h h₁ h₂) ht hx,
      levelEnd_of_forall_ne G h hx hne]
    exact congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext hd)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.closedLevelPoint_levelWindow
statement:
private theorem closedLevelPoint_levelWindow {c : ℝ} {I : OpenInterval}
    (hI : IsLevelWindow h c I) (x : ZerothHomotopy (ClosedLevel G h c)) :
    closedLevelPoint G h c
        (levelWindowEquiv G h hI
          (TDA.Topology.componentMap (levelInclusion G h hI.1) x)) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := x
    change plHeight G h p = c at hp
    induction p using ind G with
    | vertex v =>
      have hv : h v = c := by simpa [plHeight_vertex] using hp
      rw [levelWindowEquiv_componentMap_mk G h hI,
        levelWindowEquiv_mk_vertex G h hI v hv]
      change ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨vertex G v, _⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c) =
        ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨vertex G v, hp⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c)
      congr 1
    | edgePoint d t =>
      have ht : dartHeight h d t = c := by
        simpa [plHeight_edgePoint] using hp
      by_cases hfst : h d.fst = c
      · by_cases hsnd : h d.snd = c
        · have hx : (∀ v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V), h v ≠ c) →
              EdgeCrosses G h c (dartEdge d) := by
            intro hne
            exact (hne d.fst (fst_mem_dartEdge d) hfst).elim
          have htI : dartHeight h d t ∈ I := by
            rw [ht]
            exact hI.1
          rw [levelWindowEquiv_componentMap_mk G h hI,
            levelWindowEquiv_mk_edgePoint G h hI d t htI hx,
            levelEnd_of_mem G h hx (fst_mem_dartEdge d) hfst]
          change ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨vertex G d.fst, _⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c) =
            ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨edgePoint G d t, hp⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c)
          exact TDA.Topology.mk_eq_of_joinedIn (plHeight G h) ({c} : Set ℝ)
            (joinedIn_level_of_eq G h hfst hsnd t)
            (by rw [plHeight_vertex]; exact hfst) hp
        · have hne : h d.fst ≠ h d.snd := by
            intro heq
            exact hsnd (heq.symm.trans hfst)
          have ht0 : t = 0 := eq_of_dartHeight_eq G h hne (by
            rw [dartHeight_zero]
            exact ht.trans hfst.symm)
          have hxval : (⟨edgePoint G d t, hp⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c) =
              (⟨vertex G d.fst, by rw [plHeight_vertex]; exact hfst⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c) := by
            apply Subtype.ext
            calc
              edgePoint G d t = edgePoint G d 0 := congrArg (edgePoint G d) ht0
              _ = vertex G d.fst := edgePoint_zero G d
          rw [hxval, levelWindowEquiv_componentMap_mk G h hI,
            levelWindowEquiv_mk_vertex G h hI d.fst hfst]
          rfl
      · by_cases hsnd : h d.snd = c
        · have hne : h d.fst ≠ h d.snd := by
            intro heq
            exact hfst (heq.trans hsnd)
          have ht1 : t = 1 := eq_of_dartHeight_eq G h hne (by
            rw [dartHeight_one]
            exact ht.trans hsnd.symm)
          have hxval : (⟨edgePoint G d t, hp⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c) =
              (⟨vertex G d.snd, by rw [plHeight_vertex]; exact hsnd⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c) := by
            apply Subtype.ext
            calc
              edgePoint G d t = edgePoint G d 1 := congrArg (edgePoint G d) ht1
              _ = vertex G d.snd := edgePoint_one G d
          rw [hxval, levelWindowEquiv_componentMap_mk G h hI,
            levelWindowEquiv_mk_vertex G h hI d.snd hsnd]
          rfl
        · have hne : ∀ v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V), h v ≠ c := by
            intro v hv
            rcases mem_dartEdge.1 hv with rfl | rfl
            · exact hfst
            · exact hsnd
          have hcross : EdgeCrosses G h c (dartEdge d) := by
            rw [edgeCrosses_dartEdge_iff]
            rcases le_total (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hab | hab
            · rw [min_eq_left hab, max_eq_right hab]
              have hleft : h d.fst ≤ c := by
                rw [← ht]
                unfold dartHeight
                nlinarith [t.2.1, t.2.2,
                  mul_nonneg t.2.1 (sub_nonneg.2 hab),
                  mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 t.2.2) (sub_nonneg.2 hab)]
              have hright : c ≤ h d.snd := by
                rw [← ht]
                unfold dartHeight
                nlinarith [t.2.1, t.2.2,
                  mul_nonneg t.2.1 (sub_nonneg.2 hab),
                  mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 t.2.2) (sub_nonneg.2 hab)]
              exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hleft hfst, lt_of_le_of_ne hright (Ne.symm hsnd)⟩
            · rw [min_eq_right hab, max_eq_left hab]
              have hleft : h d.snd ≤ c := by
                rw [← ht]
                unfold dartHeight
                nlinarith [t.2.1, t.2.2,
                  mul_nonneg t.2.1 (sub_nonneg.2 hab),
                  mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 t.2.2) (sub_nonneg.2 hab)]
              have hright : c ≤ h d.fst := by
                rw [← ht]
                unfold dartHeight
                nlinarith [t.2.1, t.2.2,
                  mul_nonneg t.2.1 (sub_nonneg.2 hab),
                  mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.2 t.2.2) (sub_nonneg.2 hab)]
              exact ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne hleft hsnd, lt_of_le_of_ne hright (Ne.symm hfst)⟩
          let hx : (∀ v ∈ (dartEdge d : Sym2 V), h v ≠ c) →
              EdgeCrosses G h c (dartEdge d) := fun _ => hcross
          have htI : dartHeight h d t ∈ I := by
            rw [ht]
            exact hI.1
          rw [levelWindowEquiv_componentMap_mk G h hI,
            levelWindowEquiv_mk_edgePoint G h hI d t htI hx,
            levelEnd_of_forall_ne G h hx hne]
          change ZerothHomotopy.mk
              (crossingPoint G h ⟨dartEdge d, hcross⟩) =
                ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨edgePoint G d t, hp⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c)
          exact congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk (Subtype.ext
            ((eq_crossingPoint G h ⟨dartEdge d, hcross⟩ d rfl t ht).symm))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.closedLevelComponentsEquiv_symm_apply
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.closedLevelComponentsEquiv_eq
statement:
theorem closedLevelComponentsEquiv_eq [Finite V] {c : ℝ} {I : OpenInterval}
    (hI : IsLevelWindow h c I) (x : ZerothHomotopy (ClosedLevel G h c)) :
    closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h c x =
      levelWindowEquiv G h hI
        (TDA.Topology.componentMap (levelInclusion G h hI.1) x)
proof:
:= by
  let hI₀ : IsLevelWindow h c
      (ioo (c - (exists_isLevelWindow h c).choose)
        (c + (exists_isLevelWindow h c).choose)) :=
    (exists_isLevelWindow h c).choose_spec.2
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (closedLevelPoint G h c) := by
    intro z
    refine ⟨closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h c z, ?_⟩
    change closedLevelPoint G h c
      (levelWindowEquiv G h hI₀
        (TDA.Topology.componentMap (levelInclusion G h hI₀.1) z)) = z
    exact closedLevelPoint_levelWindow G h hI₀ z
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hsurj x
  calc
    closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h c (closedLevelPoint G h c y) = y :=
      by
        rw [← closedLevelComponentsEquiv_symm_apply G h c y]
        exact (closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h c).apply_symm_apply y
    _ = levelWindowEquiv G h hI
        (TDA.Topology.componentMap (levelInclusion G h hI.1)
          (closedLevelPoint G h c y)) :=
      (levelWindow_closedLevelPoint G h hI y).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.closedLevelComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex
statement:
theorem closedLevelComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex [Finite V] {c : ℝ} (v : V) (hv : h v = c) :
    closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h c
      (ZerothHomotopy.mk
          (⟨vertex G v, by
            rw [plHeight_vertex, hv]
            exact Set.mem_singleton c⟩ : ClosedLevel G h c)) =
      Sum.inl ((G.induce {v | h v = c}).connectedComponentMk ⟨v, hv⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let hI := (exists_isLevelWindow h c).choose_spec.2
  rw [closedLevelComponentsEquiv_eq G h hI,
    levelWindowEquiv_componentMap_mk G h hI,
    levelWindowEquiv_mk_vertex G h hI v hv]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.closedLevelComponentsEquiv_crossingPoint
statement:
theorem closedLevelComponentsEquiv_crossingPoint [Finite V] {c : ℝ}
    (e : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h c e}) :
    closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h c
        (ZerothHomotopy.mk (crossingPoint G h e)) = Sum.inr e
proof:
:= by
  rw [← closedLevelPoint_inr G h e]
  exact (closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h c).apply_symm_apply (Sum.inr e)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelWindowEquiv_comp_componentMap_levelInclusion
statement:
theorem levelWindowEquiv_comp_componentMap_levelInclusion [Finite V] {c : ℝ}
    {I : OpenInterval} (hI : IsLevelWindow h c I) :
    levelWindowEquiv G h hI ∘
        TDA.Topology.componentMap (levelInclusion G h hI.1) =
      closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h c
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  exact (closedLevelComponentsEquiv_eq G h hI x).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.componentMap_levelInclusion_bijective
statement:
theorem componentMap_levelInclusion_bijective [Finite V] {c : ℝ} {I : OpenInterval}
    (hI : IsLevelWindow h c I) :
    Function.Bijective
      (TDA.Topology.componentMap (levelInclusion G h hI.1))
proof:
:= by
  have heq :
      TDA.Topology.componentMap (levelInclusion G h hI.1) =
        (levelWindowEquiv G h hI).symm ∘ closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h c := by
    funext x
    apply (levelWindowEquiv G h hI).injective
    rw [Function.comp_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact congrFun (levelWindowEquiv_comp_componentMap_levelInclusion G h hI) x
  rw [heq]
  exact (levelWindowEquiv G h hI).symm.bijective.comp
    (closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h c).bijective

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLStarEquiv_comp_componentMap_levelInclusion
statement:
theorem graphPLStarEquiv_comp_componentMap_levelInclusion [Finite V] {n : ℕ}
    (S : CriticalValues n) (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    graphPLStarEquiv G h S hS i ∘
        TDA.Topology.componentMap
          (levelInclusion G h (S.value_mem_J i)) =
      closedLevelComponentsEquiv G h (S.value i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [graphPLStarEquiv_eq_levelWindowEquiv G h S hS i]
  exact levelWindowEquiv_comp_componentMap_levelInclusion G h
    ⟨S.value_mem_J i, fun _ hv => hS.eq_of_mem_J hv⟩

  · have h' := h

    have hb : (φ.symm b).1 = (0 : Fin 1) := Fin.eq_zero _

name: TDA.Mapper.OneSkeletonReebDataExamples.point_oneSkeleton_vertexCard
statement:
theorem point_oneSkeleton_vertexCard :
    Nat.card (MapperVertex (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point) = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hsub (k : Fin 3) :
      Subsingleton (ZerothHomotopy
        (PullbackSpace (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point k)) := by
    constructor
    intro c d
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective c
    obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective d
    have hxy : x = y := Subtype.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    subst y
    rfl
  have hnonempty (k : Fin 3) :
      Nonempty (ZerothHomotopy
        (PullbackSpace (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point k)) :=
    ⟨ZerothHomotopy.mk
      (⟨vertex pointGraph (), point_cover_mem k⟩ :
        PullbackSpace (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point k)⟩
  have hcard (k : Fin 3) :
      Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy
        (PullbackSpace (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point k)) = 1 :=
    Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.2 ⟨hsub k, hnonempty k⟩
  let e : ComponentIndex (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point ≃
      MapperVertex (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point :=
    { toFun := toMapperVertex (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point
      invFun := fun z => z.1
      left_inv := fun z => rfl
      right_inv := fun z => Subtype.ext rfl }
  calc
    Nat.card (MapperVertex (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point) =
        Nat.card (ComponentIndex (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point) :=
      (Nat.card_congr e).symm
    _ = ∑ k : Fin 3, Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy
        (PullbackSpace (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point k)) := by
      change Nat.card (Σ k : Fin 3, ZerothHomotopy
        (PullbackSpace (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point k)) = _
      let : ∀ k : Fin 3, Finite (ZerothHomotopy
          (PullbackSpace (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point k)) :=
        fun k => @Finite.of_subsingleton _ (hsub k)
      exact Nat.card_sigma
    _ = 3 := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_three, hcard 0, hcard 1, hcard 2]

name: TDA.Mapper.OneSkeletonReebDataExamples.point_oneSkeleton_complete

theorem point_oneSkeleton_complete
    {a b : MapperVertex (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point}
    (hab : a ≠ b) :
    (mapperOneSkeleton (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point).Adj a b
proof:
:= by
  apply (mapperOneSkeleton_adj_iff (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point a b).2
  refine ⟨hab, ?_⟩
  apply (mem_mapper_iff (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point
    {a.1, b.1}).2
  refine ⟨Finset.insert_nonempty _ _, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := componentCover_nonempty
    (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point a.1
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hz with rfl | hz
  · exact hx
  · obtain rfl := Finset.mem_singleton.1 hz
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := componentCover_nonempty
      (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point b.1
    exact (Subsingleton.elim x y).symm ▸ hy

name: TDA.Mapper.OneSkeletonReebDataExamples.point_no_oneSkeletonIso

theorem point_no_oneSkeletonIso :
    IsEmpty ((D_point).incidenceGraph ≃g
      mapperOneSkeleton (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro φ
  let x : (D_point).IncidenceVertex := ⟨0, point_vertex 0⟩
  let y : (D_point).IncidenceVertex := ⟨2, point_vertex 2⟩
  have hxy : x ≠ y := by
    intro h
    have h' := congrArg (fun z : (D_point).IncidenceVertex => z.1) h
    change (0 : Fin 3) = 2 at h'
    exact absurd h' (by decide)
  have hφxy : φ x ≠ φ y := by
    intro h
    exact hxy (φ.injective h)
  have hm :
      (mapperOneSkeleton (plHeight pointGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) U_point).Adj
        (φ x) (φ y) :=
    point_oneSkeleton_complete hφxy
  have hd : (D_point).incidenceGraph.Adj x y := (φ.map_adj_iff).mp hm
  exact point_incidence_not_adj hd

private theorem card_preimage_eq_one {K : OpenInterval} (hcov : EndpointCoverage G h K)

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.c4_edge_cases
statement:
theorem c4_edge_cases (e : C4.edgeSet) :
    e = dartEdge d01 ∨ e = dartEdge d12 ∨ e = dartEdge d23 ∨ e = dartEdge d03
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab⟩, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
  have hab' : C4.Adj a b := hab
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> first
    | exact absurd hab' (by decide)
    | exact Or.inl rfl
    | exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap)
    | exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    | exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap))
    | exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
    | exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap)))
    | exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))
    | exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap)))

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.c4_dartEdge_ne
statement:
private theorem c4_dartEdge_ne {d d' : C4.Dart} (v : Fin 4) (hv : v = d.fst ∨ v = d.snd)
    (hv' : v ≠ d'.fst ∧ v ≠ d'.snd) : dartEdge d ≠ dartEdge d'
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have hmem : v ∈ (dartEdge d' : Sym2 (Fin 4)) := h ▸ mem_dartEdge.2 hv
  rcases mem_dartEdge.1 hmem with h' | h'
  · exact hv'.1 h'
  · exact hv'.2 h'

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.c4_active_low
statement:
theorem c4_active_low {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hpq : p < q) (hq : q ≤ 1) (e : C4.edgeSet) :
    EdgeActive C4 h4 (ioo p q) e ↔ e = dartEdge d01 ∨ e = dartEdge d03
proof:
:= by
  have key := fun d : C4.Dart => edgeActive_ioo_iff_of_endpoints hpq d
    (h4_not_mem_low hp hq d.fst) (h4_not_mem_low hp hq d.snd)
  rcases c4_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · refine iff_of_true ((key d01).2 ?_) (Or.inl rfl)
    change min (h4 0) (h4 1) ≤ p ∧ q ≤ max (h4 0) (h4 1)
    rw [h4_zero, h4_one, min_eq_left zero_le_one, max_eq_right zero_le_one]
    exact ⟨hp, hq⟩
  · refine iff_of_false (fun hact => ?_) ?_
    · have h1 := (key d12).1 hact
      change min (h4 1) (h4 2) ≤ p ∧ q ≤ max (h4 1) (h4 2) at h1
      rw [h4_one, h4_two, min_eq_left one_le_two] at h1
      linarith [h1.1]
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact c4_dartEdge_ne (d := d12) (d' := d01) 2 (by decide) (by decide) h
      · exact c4_dartEdge_ne (d := d12) (d' := d03) 1 (by decide) (by decide) h
  · refine iff_of_false (fun hact => ?_) ?_
    · have h1 := (key d23).1 hact
      change min (h4 2) (h4 3) ≤ p ∧ q ≤ max (h4 2) (h4 3) at h1
      rw [h4_two, h4_three, min_eq_right one_le_two] at h1
      linarith [h1.1]
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact c4_dartEdge_ne (d := d23) (d' := d01) 2 (by decide) (by decide) h
      · exact c4_dartEdge_ne (d := d23) (d' := d03) 2 (by decide) (by decide) h
  · refine iff_of_true ((key d03).2 ?_) (Or.inr rfl)
    change min (h4 0) (h4 3) ≤ p ∧ q ≤ max (h4 0) (h4 3)
    rw [h4_zero, h4_three, min_eq_left zero_le_one, max_eq_right zero_le_one]
    exact ⟨hp, hq⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.c4_active_high
statement:
theorem c4_active_high {p q : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hpq : p < q) (hq : q ≤ 2) (e : C4.edgeSet) :
    EdgeActive C4 h4 (ioo p q) e ↔ e = dartEdge d12 ∨ e = dartEdge d23
proof:
:= by
  have key := fun d : C4.Dart => edgeActive_ioo_iff_of_endpoints hpq d
    (h4_not_mem_high hp hq d.fst) (h4_not_mem_high hp hq d.snd)
  rcases c4_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · refine iff_of_false (fun hact => ?_) ?_
    · have h1 := (key d01).1 hact
      change min (h4 0) (h4 1) ≤ p ∧ q ≤ max (h4 0) (h4 1) at h1
      rw [h4_zero, h4_one, max_eq_right zero_le_one] at h1
      linarith [h1.2]
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact c4_dartEdge_ne (d := d01) (d' := d12) 0 (by decide) (by decide) h
      · exact c4_dartEdge_ne (d := d01) (d' := d23) 0 (by decide) (by decide) h
  · refine iff_of_true ((key d12).2 ?_) (Or.inl rfl)
    change min (h4 1) (h4 2) ≤ p ∧ q ≤ max (h4 1) (h4 2)
    rw [h4_one, h4_two, min_eq_left one_le_two, max_eq_right one_le_two]
    exact ⟨hp, hq⟩
  · refine iff_of_true ((key d23).2 ?_) (Or.inr rfl)
    change min (h4 2) (h4 3) ≤ p ∧ q ≤ max (h4 2) (h4 3)
    rw [h4_two, h4_three, min_eq_right one_le_two, max_eq_left one_le_two]
    exact ⟨hp, hq⟩
  · refine iff_of_false (fun hact => ?_) ?_
    · have h1 := (key d03).1 hact
      change min (h4 0) (h4 3) ≤ p ∧ q ≤ max (h4 0) (h4 3) at h1
      rw [h4_zero, h4_three, max_eq_right zero_le_one] at h1
      linarith [h1.2]
    · rintro (h | h)
      · exact c4_dartEdge_ne (d := d03) (d' := d12) 0 (by decide) (by decide) h
      · exact c4_dartEdge_ne (d := d03) (d' := d23) 0 (by decide) (by decide) h

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.card_active_two
proof:
:=
  Nat.card_eq_two_iff.2 ⟨⟨e₁, (h e₁).2 (Or.inl rfl)⟩, ⟨e₂, (h e₂).2 (Or.inr rfl)⟩,
    fun h' => hne (congrArg Subtype.val h'), Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun e => by
      rcases (h e.1).1 e.2 with he | he
      · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext he)
      · exact Or.inr (Subtype.ext he)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.c4_card_low
statement:
private theorem c4_card_low {p q : ℝ} (hp : p < 0) (hq0 : 0 < q) (hq : q ≤ 1) :
    Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy {x : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ ioo p q}) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : h4 0 ∈ ioo p q := by
    rw [h4_zero]
    exact ⟨hp, hq0⟩
  have honly : ∀ v, h4 v ∈ ioo p q → v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    rw [mem_ioo] at hv
    rcases h4_cases v with h | h | h
    · fin_cases v
      · rfl
      all_goals norm_num [h4] at h
    all_goals (rw [h] at hv; linarith [hv.2])
  refine card_preimage_eq_one ?_ 0 h0 fun v hv => by
    obtain rfl := honly v hv
    rfl
  intro e he
  rcases c4_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact ⟨0, fst_mem_dartEdge d01, h0⟩
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨t, -, -, ht⟩ := (edgeActive_dartEdge_iff d12).1 he
    change p < (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h4 1 + (t : ℝ) * h4 2 ∧ (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h4 1 + (t : ℝ) * h4 2 < q
      at ht
    rw [h4_one, h4_two] at ht
    have ht0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ t := t.2.1
    linarith [ht.2]
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨t, -, -, ht⟩ := (edgeActive_dartEdge_iff d23).1 he
    change p < (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h4 2 + (t : ℝ) * h4 3 ∧ (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h4 2 + (t : ℝ) * h4 3 < q
      at ht
    rw [h4_two, h4_three] at ht
    have ht1 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 := t.2.2
    linarith [ht.2]
  · exact ⟨0, fst_mem_dartEdge d03, h0⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.c4_card_high
statement:
private theorem c4_card_high {p q : ℝ} (hp1 : 1 ≤ p) (hp : p < 2) (hq : 2 < q) :
    Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy {x : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ ioo p q}) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : h4 2 ∈ ioo p q := by
    rw [h4_two]
    exact ⟨hp, hq⟩
  have honly : ∀ v, h4 v ∈ ioo p q → v = 2 := by
    intro v hv
    rw [mem_ioo] at hv
    rcases h4_cases v with h | h | h
    · rw [h] at hv; linarith [hv.1]
    · rw [h] at hv; linarith [hv.1]
    · fin_cases v
      all_goals first | rfl | (norm_num [h4] at h)
  refine card_preimage_eq_one ?_ 2 h2 fun v hv => by
    obtain rfl := honly v hv
    rfl
  intro e he
  rcases c4_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨t, -, -, ht⟩ := (edgeActive_dartEdge_iff d01).1 he
    change p < (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h4 0 + (t : ℝ) * h4 1 ∧ (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h4 0 + (t : ℝ) * h4 1 < q
      at ht
    rw [h4_zero, h4_one] at ht
    have ht1 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 := t.2.2
    linarith [ht.1]
  · exact ⟨2, snd_mem_dartEdge d12, h2⟩
  · exact ⟨2, fst_mem_dartEdge d23, h2⟩
  · exfalso
    obtain ⟨t, -, -, ht⟩ := (edgeActive_dartEdge_iff d03).1 he
    change p < (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h4 0 + (t : ℝ) * h4 3 ∧ (1 - (t : ℝ)) * h4 0 + (t : ℝ) * h4 3 < q
      at ht
    rw [h4_zero, h4_three] at ht
    have ht1 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 := t.2.2
    linarith [ht.1]

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.c4_card_upper
statement:
private theorem c4_card_upper {p q : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp : p < 1) (hq : 2 < q) :
    Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy {x : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ ioo p q}) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : h4 2 ∈ ioo p q := by
    rw [h4_two]
    exact ⟨by linarith, hq⟩
  have h13 : ∀ w : Fin 4, w = 1 ∨ w = 3 → h4 w ∈ ioo p q := by
    rintro w (rfl | rfl)
    · rw [h4_one]; exact ⟨hp, by linarith⟩
    · rw [h4_three]; exact ⟨hp, by linarith⟩
  refine card_preimage_eq_one ?_ 2 h2 fun v hv => ?_
  · intro e _
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hw13⟩ := C4_edge_endpoint d
    exact ⟨w, hw, h13 w hw13⟩
  · fin_cases v
    · exfalso
      norm_num [h4, mem_ioo] at hv
      linarith [hv.1]
    · exact ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj (show C4.Adj 1 2 by decide)
    · rfl
    · exact ConnectedComponent.connectedComponentMk_eq_of_adj (show C4.Adj 3 2 by decide)

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.twoMember_support_subset
statement:
private theorem twoMember_support_subset {s s' : Finset (ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4) F₂)}
    (h : s.image Sigma.fst = s'.image Sigma.fst) : s ⊆ s'
proof:
:= fun a ha => by
  have : a.1 ∈ s'.image Sigma.fst := h ▸ Finset.mem_image_of_mem Sigma.fst ha
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hba⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 this
  rw [componentIndex_eq_of_fst_eq hba.symm (twoMember_sub a.1)]
  exact hb

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.twoMember_labels_of_card
statement:
private theorem twoMember_labels_of_card {s : Finset (ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4) F₂)}
    (hs : s ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₂) (hcard : s.card = 2) : s.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (s.image Sigma.fst).card = 2 :=
    (Finset.card_image_of_injOn (componentLabel_injOn_face _ _ hs)).trans hcard
  have h2 : s.image Sigma.fst = Finset.univ :=
    Finset.eq_univ_of_card _ (by rw [h1, Fintype.card_fin])
  rw [h2]
  decide

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.twoMember_mapper_edge_card
statement:
theorem twoMember_mapper_edge_card :
    Nat.card {s // s ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₂ ∧ s.card = 2} = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c⟩ := (Nat.card_pos_iff.1 (by rw [twoMember_edgeCells_card]; norm_num :
    0 < Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₂ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}})).1
  refine Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.2 ⟨⟨fun s s' => Subtype.ext ?_⟩,
    ⟨⟨c.1.support, c.1.support_mem_nerve,
      card_support_of_labels_pair _ _ (by decide) c.2⟩⟩⟩
  have hs := twoMember_labels_of_card s.2.1 s.2.2
  have hs' := twoMember_labels_of_card s'.2.1 s'.2.2
  exact Finset.Subset.antisymm (twoMember_support_subset (hs.trans hs'.symm))
    (twoMember_support_subset (hs'.trans hs.symm))

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.twoMember_cycle
statement:
theorem twoMember_cycle :
    (∀ k, Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy {x : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ U₂ k}) = 1) ∧
    Nat.card (ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4) F₂) = 2 ∧
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₂ // c.support.card = 1} = 2 ∧
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₂ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} =
      2 ∧
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₂ // c.support.card = 2} = 2 ∧
    Nat.card {s // s ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₂ ∧ s.card = 2} = 1 ∧
    Function.Surjective (multiNerveMapper_projection (plHeight C4 h4) F₂) ∧
    ¬ Function.Injective (multiNerveMapper_projection (plHeight C4 h4) F₂) ∧
    ¬ IntersectionsPathSubsingleton (componentCover (plHeight C4 h4) F₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hnotinj : ¬ Function.Injective (multiNerveMapper_projection (plHeight C4 h4) F₂) := by
    intro hinj
    obtain ⟨c, c', hne, -⟩ := Nat.card_eq_two_iff.1 twoMember_edgeCells_card
    apply hne
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply hinj
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Finset.Subset.antisymm (twoMember_support_subset (c.2.trans c'.2.symm))
      (twoMember_support_subset (c'.2.trans c.2.symm))
  refine ⟨twoMember_cycle_preimage_card, twoMember_componentIndex_card,
    (Nat.card_congr (vertexCellEquiv _ _)).trans twoMember_componentIndex_card,
    twoMember_edgeCells_card, ?_, twoMember_mapper_edge_card,
    multiNerveMapper_projection_surjective _ _, hnotinj,
    fun h => hnotinj ((projection_injective_iff _).2 h)⟩
  exact (Nat.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun c =>
    ⟨fun hc => twoMember_labels_of_card c.support_mem_nerve hc,
      fun hc => card_support_of_labels_pair _ _ (by decide) hc⟩)).trans twoMember_edgeCells_card

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.threeMember_card_two

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.cells_faces_bijective
statement:
private theorem cells_faces_bijective {τ : Finset (Fin 3)}
    [Finite {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = τ}]
    (hcells : Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = τ} = 2)
    (s₁ s₂ : Finset (ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4) F₃)) (hne : s₁ ≠ s₂)
    (h₁ : s₁ ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ ∧ s₁.image Sigma.fst = τ)
    (h₂ : s₂ ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ ∧ s₂.image Sigma.fst = τ)
    (hcases : ∀ s, s ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ → s.image Sigma.fst = τ → s = s₁ ∨ s = s₂) :
    Function.Bijective
      (fun c : {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = τ} =>
        (⟨c.1.support, c.1.support_mem_nerve, c.2⟩ :
          {s // s ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ ∧ s.image Sigma.fst = τ}))
proof:
:= by
  refine (mapperFacesOverLabels_surjective _ _ τ).bijective_of_nat_card_le ?_
  rw [hcells]
  refine le_of_eq (Nat.card_eq_two_iff.2 ⟨⟨s₁, h₁⟩, ⟨s₂, h₂⟩,
    fun h => hne (congrArg Subtype.val h), Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun s => ?_⟩).symm
  rcases hcases s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2 with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext h)
  · exact Or.inr (Subtype.ext h)

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.cells01_bijective

          {s // s ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ ∧ s.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}}))
proof:
:= by
  have := finite_edgeCells C4 h4 U₃ 0 1
  refine cells_faces_bijective threeMember_edgeCells01_card _ _ ?_
    ⟨threeFace_low_one, image_pair _ _⟩ ⟨threeFace_low_three, image_pair _ _⟩
    fun s hs hl => threeMember_faces01 hs hl
  intro h
  have hmem : threeMidOne ∈ ({threeLow, threeMidOne} : Finset _) :=
    Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
  rw [h] at hmem
  exact threeMidOne_not_mem_low_three hmem

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.threeMember_cycle
statement:
theorem threeMember_cycle :
    Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy {x : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ U₃ 0}) = 1 ∧
    Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy {x : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ U₃ 1}) = 2 ∧
    Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy {x : Realization C4 // plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ U₃ 2}) = 1 ∧
    Nat.card (ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4) F₃) = 4 ∧
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} =
      2 ∧
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1, 2}} =
      2 ∧
    IsEmpty {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 2}} ∧
    (∀ c : {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}},
      c.1.support = {threeLow, threeMidOne} ∨ c.1.support = {threeLow, threeMidThree}) ∧
    (∀ c : {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1, 2}},
      c.1.support = {threeMidOne, threeHigh} ∨ c.1.support = {threeMidThree, threeHigh}) ∧
    threeMidOne ≠ threeMidThree ∧
    (∀ c c' : {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}},
      c.1.support = c'.1.support → c = c') ∧
    (∀ c c' : {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1, 2}},
      c.1.support = c'.1.support → c = c') ∧
    Nat.card {s // s ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ ∧ s.card = 2} = 4 ∧
    Function.Bijective
      (fun c : {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.card = 2} =>
        (⟨c.1.support, c.1.support_mem_nerve, c.2⟩ :
          {s // s ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ ∧ s.card = 2}))
proof:
:= by
  have inj01 : ∀ c c' : {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}}, c.1.support = c'.1.support → c = c' :=
    fun c c' h => cells01_bijective.1 (Subtype.ext h)
  have inj12 : ∀ c c' : {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1, 2}}, c.1.support = c'.1.support → c = c' :=
    fun c c' h => cells12_bijective.1 (Subtype.ext h)
  have hbij : Function.Bijective
      (fun c : {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.card = 2} =>
        (⟨c.1.support, c.1.support_mem_nerve, c.2⟩ :
          {s // s ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ ∧ s.card = 2})) := by
    refine ⟨fun c c' h => ?_, fun s => ?_⟩
    · have hs : c.1.support = c'.1.support := by
        have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
        exact h'
      apply Subtype.ext
      rcases three_labels c.2 with hc | hc
      · have h2 := congrArg Subtype.val (inj01 ⟨c.1, hc⟩ ⟨c'.1, hs ▸ hc⟩ hs)
        exact h2
      · have h2 := congrArg Subtype.val (inj12 ⟨c.1, hc⟩ ⟨c'.1, hs ▸ hc⟩ hs)
        exact h2
    · obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_cell_of_mem_nerve s.2.1
      exact ⟨⟨c, hc ▸ s.2.2⟩, Subtype.ext hc⟩
  have hcells2 : Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.card = 2} = 4 := by
    have := finite_edgeCells C4 h4 U₃ 0 1
    have := finite_edgeCells C4 h4 U₃ 1 2
    let e : {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} ⊕
        {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1, 2}} →
        {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ // c.support.card = 2} :=
      Sum.elim (fun c => ⟨c.1, card_support_of_labels_pair _ _ (by decide) c.2⟩)
        (fun c => ⟨c.1, card_support_of_labels_pair _ _ (by decide) c.2⟩)
    have he : Function.Bijective e := by
      refine ⟨?_, fun c => ?_⟩
      · rintro (c | c) (c' | c') h <;> have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
        · exact congrArg Sum.inl (Subtype.ext h')
        · have : ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 3)) = {1, 2} := by
            rw [← c.2, ← c'.2]
            exact congrArg (fun d : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ =>
              d.support.image Sigma.fst) h'
          exact absurd this (by decide)
        · have : ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)) = {0, 1} := by
            rw [← c.2, ← c'.2]
            exact congrArg (fun d : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4) F₃ =>
              d.support.image Sigma.fst) h'
          exact absurd this (by decide)
        · exact congrArg Sum.inr (Subtype.ext h')
      · rcases three_labels c.2 with hc | hc
        · exact ⟨Sum.inl ⟨c.1, hc⟩, rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨Sum.inr ⟨c.1, hc⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [← Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective e he), Nat.card_sum, threeMember_edgeCells01_card,
      threeMember_edgeCells12_card]
  refine ⟨threeMember_card_zero, threeMember_card_one, threeMember_card_two,
    threeMember_componentIndex_card, threeMember_edgeCells01_card, threeMember_edgeCells12_card,
    threeMember_edgeCells02_isEmpty, fun c => threeMember_faces01 c.1.support_mem_nerve c.2,
    fun c => threeMember_faces12 c.1.support_mem_nerve c.2, threeMidOne_ne_threeMidThree,
    inj01, inj12, ?_, hbij⟩

      (edge_not_mem hp hq true)).2 ?_

    rw [min_eq_left (by norm_num), max_eq_right (by norm_num)]

    ((edgeGraph_edge_eq x.1).trans (edgeGraph_edge_eq y.1).symm)⟩, ⟨⟨dartEdge d₀, hact⟩⟩⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.singleEdge_twoMember
statement:
theorem singleEdge_twoMember :
    (∀ k, Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy
      {x : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph h02 x ∈ U₂ k}) = 1) ∧
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₂ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} = 1 ∧
    Nat.card {s // s ∈ mapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₂ ∧ s.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcells : Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₂ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} = 1 :=
    Eq.trans (card_edgeCells_eq (k := 0) (l := 1) (by norm_num) (by rfl) (p := 1 / 4)
      (q := 3 / 4) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (edge_not_mem (by norm_num) (by norm_num)))
      (edge_card_active (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
  have := finite_edgeCells edgeGraph h02 U₂ 0 1
  refine ⟨fun k => ?_, hcells, faces_card_one hcells⟩
  fin_cases k
  · show Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy
      {x : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph h02 x ∈ U₂ 0}) = 1
    rw [twoMember_zero]
    exact edge_card_of_mem false (by norm_num [h02, mem_ioo])
  · show Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy
      {x : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph h02 x ∈ U₂ 1}) = 1
    rw [twoMember_one]
    exact edge_card_of_mem true (by norm_num [h02, mem_ioo])

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.singleEdge_threeMember
statement:
theorem singleEdge_threeMember :
    (∀ k, Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy
      {x : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph h02 x ∈ U₃ k}) = 1) ∧
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} = 1 ∧
    Nat.card {s // s ∈ mapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ ∧ s.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} = 1 ∧
    Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1, 2}} = 1 ∧
    Nat.card {s // s ∈ mapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ ∧ s.image Sigma.fst = {1, 2}} = 1 ∧
    IsEmpty {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 2}} ∧
    IsEmpty {s // s ∈ mapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ ∧ s.image Sigma.fst = {0, 2}}
proof:
:= by
  have h01 : Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} = 1 :=
    Eq.trans (card_edgeCells_eq (k := 0) (l := 1) (by norm_num) (by rfl) (p := 1 / 2)
      (q := 7 / 8) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (edge_not_mem (by norm_num) (by norm_num)))
      (edge_card_active (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
  have h12 : Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1, 2}} = 1 :=
    Eq.trans (card_edgeCells_eq (k := 1) (l := 2) (by norm_num) (by rfl) (p := 9 / 8)
      (q := 3 / 2) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (edge_not_mem (by norm_num) (by norm_num)))
      (edge_card_active (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
  have h02e : IsEmpty {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₃ //
      c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 2}} :=
    isEmpty_uniformEdgeCells_of_far edgeGraph h02 (k := 0) (l := 2) (by norm_num) (by decide)
  have := finite_edgeCells edgeGraph h02 U₃ 0 1
  have := finite_edgeCells edgeGraph h02 U₃ 1 2
  refine ⟨fin3_forall ?_ ?_ ?_, h01, faces_card_one h01, h12, faces_card_one h12, h02e,
    faces_isEmpty h02e⟩
  · show Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy
      {x : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph h02 x ∈ U₃ 0}) = 1
    rw [threeMember_zero]
    exact edge_card_of_mem false (by norm_num [h02, mem_ioo])
  · show Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy
      {x : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph h02 x ∈ U₃ 1}) = 1
    rw [threeMember_one, card_preimage_eq_card_active (edge_not_mem (by norm_num) (by norm_num))]
    exact edge_card_active (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  · show Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy
      {x : Realization edgeGraph // plHeight edgeGraph h02 x ∈ U₃ 2}) = 1
    rw [threeMember_two]
    exact edge_card_of_mem true (by norm_num [h02, mem_ioo])

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.oneMember_cycle
statement:
theorem oneMember_cycle (g : ℝ) :
    (∀ k, uniformCover (-1 / 2) 3 g 1 k = J4) ∧
    Covers (fun k => (uniformCover (-1 / 2) 3 g 1 k : Set ℝ)) (Set.range (plHeight C4 h4)) ∧
    Nat.card (ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4)
      (fun k => (uniformCover (-1 / 2) 3 g 1 k : Set ℝ))) = Nat.card C4.ConnectedComponent ∧
    Nat.card (ComponentIndex (plHeight C4 h4)
      (fun k => (uniformCover (-1 / 2) 3 g 1 k : Set ℝ))) = 1 ∧
    (∀ s ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4) (fun k => (uniformCover (-1 / 2) 3 g 1 k : Set ℝ)),
      s.card ≤ 1) ∧
    IsEmpty {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight C4 h4)
      (fun k => (uniformCover (-1 / 2) 3 g 1 k : Set ℝ)) // c.support.card = 2}
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ x, plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ uniformCover (-1 / 2) 3 g 1 0 := fun x => by
    rw [oneMember_eq_J4]
    have := plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall h4_mem_Icc x
    exact ⟨by linarith [this.1], by linarith [this.2]⟩
  have hcard := card_componentIndex_one (uniformCover (-1 / 2) 3 g 1) hall
  refine ⟨oneMember_eq_J4 g, ?_, hcard, hcard.trans c4_card_connectedComponent, fun s hs =>
    mapper_face_card_le_of_multiplicity _ _ (oneMember_multiplicity _ _) hs,
    oneMember_no_edge_cell _ _⟩
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨0, hall x⟩

        TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdgeHeight)
      (fun k => (uniformCover (-1) 4 g 1 k : Set ℝ))) =
      Nat.card (TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdgeGraph).ConnectedComponent ∧
    Nat.card (ComponentIndex (plHeight TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdgeGraph
        TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdgeHeight)
      (fun k => (uniformCover (-1) 4 g 1 k : Set ℝ))) = 2 ∧
    IsEmpty {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdgeGraph
        TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdgeHeight)
      (fun k => (uniformCover (-1) 4 g 1 k : Set ℝ)) // c.support.card = 2}
proof:
:= by
  have hh : ∀ v, TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdgeHeight v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 2 := by
    rintro (b | b) <;> exact h02_mem_Icc b
  have hall : ∀ x, plHeight TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdgeGraph
      TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.Examples.twoEdgeHeight x ∈ uniformCover (-1) 4 g 1 0 := fun x => by
    rw [oneMember_wide]
    have := plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall hh x
    exact ⟨by linarith [this.1], by linarith [this.2]⟩
  have hcard := card_componentIndex_one (uniformCover (-1) 4 g 1) hall
  exact ⟨oneMember_wide g, hcard, hcard.trans twoEdge_card_connectedComponent,
    oneMember_no_edge_cell _ _⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.negative_control
statement:
theorem negative_control :
    plHeight edgeGraph h02 (edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ eighth) = 1 / 4 ∧
    (∀ k, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ∈ U₅ k) ∧
    ¬ CoverMultiplicityAtMost (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₅ 2 ∧
    (Finset.univ.image negativeIndex) ∈ mapper (plHeight edgeGraph h02) F₅ ∧
    (Finset.univ.image negativeIndex).card = 3 ∧
    ¬ ∀ y (t : Finset (Fin 3)), (∀ k ∈ t, y ∈ U₅ k) → t.card ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨negative_height, negative_mem, fun h => ?_, ?_, ?_, fun h =>
    absurd ((uniformCover_card_le_two_iff (le_refl 3) (by norm_num)).1 h) (by norm_num)⟩
  · have := h (1 / 4) ⟨edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ eighth, negative_height⟩ Finset.univ
      fun k _ => negative_mem k
    rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at this
    omega
  · refine (mem_mapper_iff _ _ _).2 ⟨Finset.univ_nonempty.image _, edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ eighth,
      fun a ha => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨k, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 ha
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · have hinj : Function.Injective negativeIndex := fun k l hkl => by
      have := congrArg Sigma.fst hkl
      exact this
    exact (Finset.card_image_of_injective Finset.univ hinj).trans
      (by rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin])

name: TDA.Mapper.UniformCoverExamples.boundary_uniformCover
statement:
theorem boundary_uniformCover :
    (U₆ 0 : Set ℝ) ∩ (U₆ 2 : Set ℝ) = ∅ ∧
    (∀ y (t : Finset (Fin 3)), (∀ k ∈ t, y ∈ U₆ k) → t.card ≤ 2) ∧
    (U₆ 1 : Set ℝ) \ ((U₆ 0 : Set ℝ) ∪ (U₆ 2 : Set ℝ)) = {2}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(uniformInterval_disjoint (by norm_num) (by decide)).inter_eq,
    uniformCover_card_le_two (by norm_num), ?_⟩
  rw [boundary_zero, boundary_one, boundary_two]
  ext y
  simp only [coe_ioo, Set.mem_sdiff, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_Ioo, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨h₁, h₃⟩, hn⟩
    have h₂ : 2 ≤ y := by
      by_contra hy
      exact hn (Or.inl ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
    by_contra hy
    exact hn (Or.inr ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne h₂ (Ne.symm hy), by linarith⟩)
  · rintro rfl
    norm_num

proof:
:=
  Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.2
    ⟨⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext ((hP x.1 x.2).trans (hP y.1 y.2).symm)⟩, ⟨⟨a, ha⟩⟩⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.card_two_of

private theorem card_two_of {P : α → Prop} {a b : α} (hab : a ≠ b) (ha : P a) (hb : P b)
    (hP : ∀ x, P x → x = a ∨ x = b) : Nat.card {x // P x} = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_eq_two_iff]
  refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩, fun h => hab (congrArg Subtype.val h), ?_⟩
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_univ, iff_true]
  rcases hP x.1 x.2 with h | h
  · exact .inl (Subtype.ext h)
  · exact .inr (Subtype.ext h)

proof:
:= by

    ⟨induce_mk_injective_of_not_adj hS, fun c => ?_⟩)).symm

proof:
:= by
  rw [card_induce_of_not_adj fun x hx y hy hxy => G.loopless.irrefl x
    (by rw [hS x hx, ← hS y hy] at hxy ⊢; exact hxy)]
  exact card_one_of (P := (· ∈ S)) hv₀ hS

    ⟨(G.induce S).connectedComponentMk ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩⟩⟩
  by_cases hxy : (x : V) = y
  · rw [Subtype.ext hxy]

      | h v => exact hS v.1 v.2⟩
  exact Nat.card_of_isEmpty

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.bot_edge_false
statement: private theorem bot_edge_false (e : (⊥ : SimpleGraph V).edgeSet) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, -⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
  exact d.adj

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.not_edgeCrosses_of_le
statement:
private theorem not_edgeCrosses_of_le {c : ℝ} (hc : ∀ v, c ≤ h v) (e : G.edgeSet) :
    ¬ EdgeCrosses G h c e
proof:
:= fun ⟨d, _, hmin, _⟩ => by
  rcases min_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm <;> rw [hm] at hmin <;>
    linarith [hc d.fst, hc d.snd]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.not_edgeCrosses_of_ge
statement:
private theorem not_edgeCrosses_of_ge {c : ℝ} (hc : ∀ v, h v ≤ c) (e : G.edgeSet) :
    ¬ EdgeCrosses G h c e
proof:
:= fun ⟨d, _, _, hmax⟩ => by
  rcases max_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm <;> rw [hm] at hmax <;>
    linarith [hc d.fst, hc d.snd]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq
statement:
private theorem not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq {c : ℝ} {d : G.Dart}
    (hd : h d.fst = c ∨ h d.snd = c) : ¬ EdgeCrosses G h c (dartEdge d)
proof:
:= fun hcr => by
  obtain ⟨hmin, hmax⟩ := (edgeCrosses_dartEdge_iff d).1 hcr
  rcases hd with hd | hd <;> rw [hd] at hmin hmax
  · rcases min_lt_iff.1 hmin with h' | h'
    · exact lt_irrefl _ h'
    · rcases lt_max_iff.1 hmax with h'' | h''
      · exact lt_irrefl _ h''
      · linarith
  · rcases min_lt_iff.1 hmin with h' | h'
    · rcases lt_max_iff.1 hmax with h'' | h''
      · linarith
      · exact lt_irrefl _ h''
    · exact lt_irrefl _ h'

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.dartEdge_ne
statement:
private theorem dartEdge_ne {d d' : G.Dart} (h₁ : d.toProd ≠ d'.toProd)
    (h₂ : d.toProd ≠ d'.toProd.swap) : dartEdge d ≠ dartEdge d'
proof:
:= fun hdd => by
  rcases dartEdge_eq_iff.1 hdd with h | h
  · exact h₁ (congrArg Dart.toProd h)
  · exact h₂ (congrArg Dart.toProd h)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.card_levelVertex
statement:
private theorem card_levelVertex [Finite V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (h : V → ℝ) (c : ℝ) {m k : ℕ}
    (hm : Nat.card (G.induce {v | h v = c}).ConnectedComponent = m)
    (hk : Nat.card {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h c e} = k) :
    Nat.card (LevelVertex G h c) = m + k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have := Fintype.ofFinite V
  rw [Nat.card_sum, hm, hk]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.S012_zero
statement: @[simp] private theorem S012_zero : S012.value 0 = 0
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_covers

proof:

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_level_not_adj
statement:
private theorem c4_level_not_adj (c : ℝ) :
    ∀ x ∈ {v | h4 v = c}, ∀ y ∈ {v | h4 v = c}, ¬ C4.Adj x y
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy hadj
  have hxy : h4 x = h4 y := hx.trans hy.symm
  fin_cases x <;> fin_cases y <;> first | exact absurd hadj (by decide) | norm_num [h4] at hxy

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_card_V0
statement: private theorem c4_card_V0 : Nat.card ((graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).V 0) = 1
proof:
:=
  card_levelVertex C4 h4 _
    (card_induce_singleton (v₀ := 0) (by simp) fun v hv => by
      fin_cases v <;> simp_all [h4])
    (card_zero_of (not_edgeCrosses_of_le fun v => by
      rw [S012_zero]; fin_cases v <;> norm_num [h4]))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_level_one_card
statement: private theorem c4_level_one_card : Nat.card ↥{v | h4 v = S012.value 1} = 2
proof:
:=
  card_two_of (P := fun v => v ∈ {v | h4 v = S012.value 1}) (a := 1) (b := 3) (by decide)
    (by simp) (by simp) fun v hv => by fin_cases v <;> simp_all [h4]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_not_crosses_one
statement: private theorem c4_not_crosses_one (e : C4.edgeSet) : ¬ EdgeCrosses C4 h4 (S012.value 1) e
proof:
:= by
  rcases c4_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq (.inr (by simp [d01]))
  · exact not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq (.inl (by simp [d12]))
  · exact not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq (.inr (by simp [d23]))
  · exact not_edgeCrosses_dartEdge_of_eq (.inr (by simp [d03]))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_level_one
statement:
theorem c4_level_one :
    Nat.card (C4.induce {v | h4 v = S012.value 1}).ConnectedComponent = 2 ∧
      ∀ e : C4.edgeSet, ¬ EdgeCrosses C4 h4 (S012.value 1) e
proof:
:=
  ⟨(card_induce_of_not_adj (c4_level_not_adj _)).trans c4_level_one_card, c4_not_crosses_one⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_card_V1
statement: private theorem c4_card_V1 : Nat.card ((graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).V 1) = 2
proof:
:=
  card_levelVertex C4 h4 _ c4_level_one.1 (card_zero_of c4_level_one.2)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_card_V2
statement: private theorem c4_card_V2 : Nat.card ((graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).V 2) = 1
proof:
:=
  card_levelVertex C4 h4 _
    (card_induce_singleton (v₀ := 2) (by simp) fun v hv => by
      fin_cases v <;> simp_all [h4])
    (card_zero_of (not_edgeCrosses_of_ge fun v => by
      rw [S012_two]; fin_cases v <;> norm_num [h4]))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_vertexCounts
statement:
theorem c4_vertexCounts :
    Nat.card ((graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).V 0) = 1 ∧
      Nat.card ((graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).V 1) = 2 ∧
      Nat.card ((graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).V 2) = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨c4_card_V0, c4_card_V1, c4_card_V2⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_spans_zero_cases
proof:
:= by
  rcases c4_edge_cases e with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact .inl rfl
  · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at he
    norm_num [d12] at he
  · rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at he
    norm_num [d23] at he

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_spans_one_cases
proof:
:= by

  · exact .inr rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_spans_d01

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_spans_d03

proof:
:=
  ⟨card_two_of (dartEdge_ne (by decide) (by decide)) c4_spans_d01 c4_spans_d03
      c4_spans_zero_cases,
    card_two_of (dartEdge_ne (by decide) (by decide)) c4_spans_d12 c4_spans_d23

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4e01_ne_c4e03

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_left_zero
statement:
theorem c4_left_zero (y : (graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).E 0) :
    ((graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).left 0 y : LevelVertex C4 h4 (S012.value (Fin.castSucc 0))) =
      Sum.inl ((C4.induce {v | h4 v = S012.value (Fin.castSucc 0)}).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨0, by simp⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : (0 : Fin 4) ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 (Fin 4)) := by
    rcases c4_spans_zero_cases y.1 y.2 with h | h <;> rw [h]
    · exact fst_mem_dartEdge d01
    · exact fst_mem_dartEdge d03
  exact graphPLReebData_left_of_mem C4 h4 S012 0 y hv (by simp)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_right_zero_01

theorem c4_right_zero_01 :

      Sum.inl ((C4.induce {v | h4 v = S012.value (Fin.succ 0)}).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨1, by simp⟩)
proof:
:=
  graphPLReebData_right_of_mem C4 h4 S012 0 c4e01 (snd_mem_dartEdge d01) (by simp [d01])

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_right_zero_03

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_left_one_12

theorem c4_left_one_12 :
    ((graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).left 1 c4e12 :
        LevelVertex C4 h4 (S012.value (Fin.castSucc 1))) =
      Sum.inl ((C4.induce {v | h4 v = S012.value (Fin.castSucc 1)}).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨1, by simp⟩)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_left_one_23
statement:
theorem c4_left_one_23 :
    ((graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).left 1 c4e23 :

      Sum.inl ((C4.induce {v | h4 v = S012.value (Fin.castSucc 1)}).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨3, by simp⟩)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_right_one
statement:
theorem c4_right_one (y : (graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).E 1) :
    ((graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).right 1 y : LevelVertex C4 h4 (S012.value (Fin.succ 1))) =
      Sum.inl ((C4.induce {v | h4 v = S012.value (Fin.succ 1)}).connectedComponentMk
        ⟨2, by simp⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : (2 : Fin 4) ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 (Fin 4)) := by
    rcases c4_spans_one_cases y.1 y.2 with h | h <;> rw [h]
    · exact snd_mem_dartEdge d12
    · exact fst_mem_dartEdge d23
  exact graphPLReebData_right_of_mem C4 h4 S012 1 y hv (by simp)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_left_zero_not_injective
statement:
theorem c4_left_zero_not_injective :
    ¬ Function.Injective ((graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).left 0)
proof:
:= fun hinj =>
  c4e01_ne_c4e03 (hinj ((c4_left_zero c4e01).trans (c4_left_zero c4e03).symm))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.c4_right_zero_injective
statement: theorem c4_right_zero_injective : Function.Injective ((graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).right 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ((C4.induce {v | h4 v = S012.value (Fin.succ 0)}).connectedComponentMk
      ⟨1, by simp⟩) ≠ (C4.induce {v | h4 v = S012.value (Fin.succ 0)}).connectedComponentMk
      ⟨3, by simp⟩ := fun h => by
    have := congrArg Subtype.val (induce_mk_injective_of_not_adj (c4_level_not_adj _) h)
    exact absurd this (by decide)
  have hcases : ∀ y : (graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012).E 0, y = c4e01 ∨ y = c4e03 := fun y => by
    rcases c4_spans_zero_cases y.1 y.2 with h | h
    · exact .inl (Subtype.ext h)
    · exact .inr (Subtype.ext h)
  intro y y' hyy
  rcases hcases y with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hcases y' with rfl | rfl
  · rfl
  · exact (hne (c4_right_zero_01.symm.trans (hyy.trans c4_right_zero_03) |> Sum.inl_injective)).elim
  · exact (hne (c4_right_zero_01.symm.trans (hyy.symm.trans c4_right_zero_03)
      |> Sum.inl_injective)).elim
  · rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.cyc_spans

    EdgeSpans C4 h4 (S012.value i.castSucc) (S012.value i.succ) (dartEdge (cycDart i y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
  exact ⟨(min_le_left _ _).trans_eq (h4_cycA i y.val),
    (h4_cycB i y.val).symm.trans_le (le_max_right _ _)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.cycVert_injective
statement:
private theorem cycVert_injective (i : Fin 3) (a b : cycleData.V i)
    (hab : cycVert i a.val = cycVert i b.val) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := b
  apply Fin.ext
  fin_cases i
  · simp at ha hb
    simp only
    omega
  · simp at ha hb
    simp only
    by_cases ha0 : a = 0 <;> by_cases hb0 : b = 0 <;>
      simp [cycVert, ha0, hb0] at hab <;> omega
  · simp at ha hb
    simp only
    omega

    (induce_mk_injective_of_not_adj (c4_level_not_adj _) (Sum.inl_injective hab)))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.cycDart_edge_injective

private theorem cycDart_edge_injective (i a b : Fin 2)
    (h : dartEdge (cycDart i a) = dartEdge (cycDart i b)) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> first
    | rfl
    | exact absurd h (dartEdge_ne (by decide) (by decide))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.edge_mem
statement: private theorem edge_mem (y : edgeGraph.edgeSet) (b : Bool) : b ∈ (y : Sym2 Bool)
proof:
:= by
  rw [edge_cases y]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.Y_counts_eq_cells
statement:
theorem Y_counts_eq_cells :
    Nat.card ((graphPLReebData Y hY S0123).V 1) =
        Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY)
          (fun k : Fin 4 => ((uniformCover (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (5 / 4) (1 / 4) 4 k : OpenInterval) :
            Set ℝ)) // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1}} ∧
      Nat.card ((graphPLReebData Y hY S0123).V 0) =
        Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY)
          (fun k : Fin 4 => ((uniformCover (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (5 / 4) (1 / 4) 4 k : OpenInterval) :
            Set ℝ)) // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0}} ∧
      Nat.card ((graphPLReebData Y hY S0123).V 2) =
        Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY)
          (fun k : Fin 4 => ((uniformCover (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (5 / 4) (1 / 4) 4 k : OpenInterval) :
            Set ℝ)) // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {2}} ∧
      Nat.card ((graphPLReebData Y hY S0123).V 3) =
        Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY)
          (fun k : Fin 4 => ((uniformCover (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (5 / 4) (1 / 4) 4 k : OpenInterval) :
            Set ℝ)) // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {3}} ∧
      Nat.card ((graphPLReebData Y hY S0123).E 0) =
        Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY)
          (fun k : Fin 4 => ((uniformCover (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (5 / 4) (1 / 4) 4 k : OpenInterval) :
            Set ℝ)) // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {0, 1}} ∧
      Nat.card ((graphPLReebData Y hY S0123).E 1) =
        Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY)
          (fun k : Fin 4 => ((uniformCover (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (5 / 4) (1 / 4) 4 k : OpenInterval) :
            Set ℝ)) // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {1, 2}} ∧
      Nat.card ((graphPLReebData Y hY S0123).E 2) =
        Nat.card {c : multiNerveMapper (plHeight Y hY)
          (fun k : Fin 4 => ((uniformCover (-1 / 2 : ℝ) (5 / 4) (1 / 4) 4 k : OpenInterval) :
            Set ℝ)) // c.support.image Sigma.fst = {2, 3}}
proof:
:=
  ⟨Y_vertexCounts.2.1.trans Y_vertexCells_one.symm,
    Y_vertexCounts.1.trans Y_vertexCells_other.1.symm,
    Y_vertexCounts.2.2.1.trans Y_vertexCells_other.2.1.symm,
    Y_vertexCounts.2.2.2.trans Y_vertexCells_other.2.2.symm,
    Y_edgeCounts.1.trans Y_edgeCells.1.symm,
    Y_edgeCounts.2.1.trans Y_edgeCells.2.1.symm,
    Y_edgeCounts.2.2.trans Y_edgeCells.2.2.symm⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.isolated_count
statement:
theorem isolated_count :
    Nat.card ((graphPLReebData (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) S0).V 0) = 2
proof:
:=
  card_levelVertex (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) _ _
    ((card_induce_of_not_adj fun _ _ _ _ h => h).trans
      (card_two_of (P := fun v => v ∈ {v : Bool | (0 : ℝ) = S0.value 0}) Bool.false_ne_true rfl
        rfl fun v _ => by cases v <;> simp))
    (card_zero_of fun e _ => bot_edge_false e)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.isolated_components
statement:
theorem isolated_components :
    Nat.card ((intervalComponents (plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) fun _ => (0 : ℝ))).obj ⊤) =
      2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← S0.J_eq_top_of_zero]
  exact (Nat.card_congr (graphPLStarEquiv (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) _ S0 const_covers 0)).trans
    isolated_count

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.missing_not_covers
statement: theorem missing_not_covers : ¬ CoversVertexHeights S0 h02
proof:
:= fun hS => by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hS true
  have : (0 : ℝ) = 2 := hi
  norm_num at this

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.missing_star_card
statement:
theorem missing_star_card :
    Nat.card ((intervalComponents (plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) h02)).obj (S0.J 0)) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [S0.J_eq_top_of_zero]
  have := isEmpty_uncoveredEdge_of_coverage (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) h02 ⊤
    (endpointCoverage_top _ _)
  refine (Nat.card_congr ((preimageComponentsEquiv (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) h02 ⊤).trans
    (cellComponentsEquivSum (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) h02 ⊤))).trans ?_
  rw [Nat.card_sum,
    card_induce_of_not_adj fun _ _ _ _ h => h, Nat.card_of_isEmpty (α := UncoveredEdge _ _ _)]
  exact card_two_of (P := fun v => v ∈ h02 ⁻¹' ((⊤ : OpenInterval) : Set ℝ)) Bool.false_ne_true
    trivial trivial fun v _ => by cases v <;> simp

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.missing_count
statement: theorem missing_count : Nat.card ((graphPLReebData (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) h02 S0).V 0) = 1
proof:
:=
  card_levelVertex (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) h02 _
    (card_induce_singleton (v₀ := false) rfl fun v hv => by
      cases v
      · rfl
      · have : (2 : ℝ) = 0 := hv
        norm_num at this)
    (card_zero_of fun e _ => bot_edge_false e)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.missing_no_equiv
statement:
theorem missing_no_equiv :
    IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) h02)).obj (S0.J 0) ≃
      (graphPLReebData (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) h02 S0).V 0)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun e => by
    have := Nat.card_congr e
    rw [missing_star_card, missing_count] at this
    norm_num at this⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebDataExamples.empty_data
statement:
theorem empty_data :
    IsEmpty ((graphPLReebData (⊥ : SimpleGraph Empty) Empty.elim S0).V 0) ∧
      IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph Empty) Empty.elim)).obj (S0.J 0)) ∧
      Nonempty ((intervalComponents (plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph Empty) Empty.elim)).obj (S0.J 0) ≃
        (graphPLReebData (⊥ : SimpleGraph Empty) Empty.elim S0).V 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hV : IsEmpty ((graphPLReebData (⊥ : SimpleGraph Empty) Empty.elim S0).V 0) :=
    ⟨fun x => by
      rcases x with c | e
      · induction c using ConnectedComponent.ind with
        | h v => exact v.1.elim
      · exact bot_edge_false e.1⟩
  have e := graphPLStarEquiv (⊥ : SimpleGraph Empty) Empty.elim S0 (fun v => v.elim) 0
  exact ⟨hV, e.isEmpty, ⟨e⟩⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLRefinementExamples.edge_refine_middle
statement:
theorem edge_refine_middle :
    edge_refineIso.hom.v 1 (Sum.inr ⟨dartEdge d₀, edge_crosses_one⟩) =
      (RGraph.refineVEquiv S02_sub_S012 _ 1 0 S012_one_mem_S02_K0).symm
        (⟨dartEdge d₀, edge_spans_S02⟩ :
          SpanEdge edgeGraph h02 (S02.value (Fin.castSucc 0))
            (S02.value (Fin.succ 0)))
proof:
:= by
  change (graphPLRefineHom edgeGraph h02 edge_covers_S02 S02_sub_S012).v 1 _ = _
  refine (graphPLRefineHom_v_inserted edgeGraph h02 edge_covers_S02 S02_sub_S012
    1 0 S012_one_mem_S02_K0 _).trans ?_
  rw [levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK_inr]

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLRefinementExamples.edge_refine_counts
statement:
theorem edge_refine_counts :
    Nat.card ((RGraph.refineData S02_sub_S012
        (graphPLReebData edgeGraph h02 S02)).V 0) = 1 ∧
      Nat.card ((RGraph.refineData S02_sub_S012
        (graphPLReebData edgeGraph h02 S02)).V 1) = 1 ∧
      Nat.card ((RGraph.refineData S02_sub_S012
        (graphPLReebData edgeGraph h02 S02)).V 2) = 1 ∧
      Nat.card ((RGraph.refineData S02_sub_S012
        (graphPLReebData edgeGraph h02 S02)).E 0) = 1 ∧
      Nat.card ((RGraph.refineData S02_sub_S012
        (graphPLReebData edgeGraph h02 S02)).E 1) = 1
proof:
:= by

  · exact (refine_old_v_card edgeGraph h02 S02_sub_S012 2 1
