name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLRefinementExamples.c4_refine_counts
statement:
theorem c4_refine_counts :
    Nat.card ((RGraph.refineData S012_sub_S0h12
        (graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012)).V 1) = 2 ∧
      Nat.card ((RGraph.refineData S012_sub_S0h12
        (graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012)).E 0) = 2 ∧
      Nat.card ((RGraph.refineData S012_sub_S0h12
        (graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012)).E 1) = 2 ∧
      Nat.card ((RGraph.refineData S012_sub_S0h12
        (graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012)).V 0) = 1 ∧
      Nat.card ((RGraph.refineData S012_sub_S0h12
        (graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012)).V 2) = 2 ∧
      Nat.card ((RGraph.refineData S012_sub_S0h12
        (graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012)).V 3) = 1 ∧
      IsEmpty (C4.induce {v | h4 v = S0h12.value 1}).ConnectedComponent ∧
      Nat.card ((graphPLReebData C4 h4 S0h12).V 1) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hV : Nat.card ((RGraph.refineData S012_sub_S0h12
      (graphPLReebData C4 h4 S012)).V 1) = 2 :=
    (refine_gap_v_card C4 h4 S012_sub_S0h12 1 0 S0h12_one_mem_S012_K0).trans
      c4_edgeCounts.1
  refine ⟨hV, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (refine_gap_e_card C4 h4 S012_sub_S0h12 0 0 basePt_S0h12_zero_mem_S012).trans
      c4_edgeCounts.1
  · exact (refine_gap_e_card C4 h4 S012_sub_S0h12 1 0 basePt_S0h12_one_mem_S012).trans
      c4_edgeCounts.1
  · exact (refine_old_v_card C4 h4 S012_sub_S0h12 0 0
      (by simp only [S0h12_zero, S012_zero_local])).trans c4_vertexCounts.1
  · exact (refine_old_v_card C4 h4 S012_sub_S0h12 2 1
      (by simp only [S0h12_two, S012_one_local])).trans c4_vertexCounts.2.1
  · exact (refine_old_v_card C4 h4 S012_sub_S0h12 3 2
      (by simp only [S0h12_three, S012_two_local])).trans c4_vertexCounts.2.2
  · have hv : IsEmpty {v : Fin 4 // h4 v = S0h12.value 1} :=
      ⟨fun ⟨v, hv⟩ => by
        fin_cases v <;> norm_num [h4, S0h12_one] at hv⟩
    exact ⟨fun c => c.ind fun v => hv.false ⟨v.1, v.2⟩⟩
  · exact (Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective _
      (graphPLRefineHom_bijective_v C4 h4 c4_covers S012_sub_S0h12 1))).trans hV

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLRefinementExamples.path_edge_cases
statement:
private theorem path_edge_cases (e : path3.edgeSet) :
    e = dartEdge path_d01 ∨ e = dartEdge path_d12
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab⟩, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq e
  have hab' := pathGraph_adj.1 hab
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> first
    | exact absurd hab' (by decide)
    | exact Or.inl rfl
    | exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap)
    | exact Or.inr rfl
    | exact Or.inr (Subtype.ext Sym2.eq_swap)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLRefinementExamples.path_S02_E0_empty
statement: theorem path_S02_E0_empty : IsEmpty ((graphPLReebData path3 h012 S02).E 0)

:= by
  rw [graphPLReebData_E]
  refine ⟨fun z => ?_⟩
  rcases path_edge_cases z.1 with hz | hz
  · have hz' := z.2
    rw [hz, edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at hz'
    rcases hz' with ⟨_, hz'⟩
    norm_num [path_d01, h012, S02_succ_zero_local] at hz'
  · have hz' := z.2
    rw [hz, edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff] at hz'
    rcases hz' with ⟨hz', _⟩
    norm_num [path_d12, h012, S02_castSucc_zero_local] at hz'
    have htwo : (![0, 1, 2] : Fin 3 → ℝ) 2 = 2 := rfl
    rw [htwo] at hz'
    norm_num at hz'

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.flat_height
statement:
private theorem flat_height {V : Type*} (G : SimpleGraph V) (x : Realization G) :
    plHeight G (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx := plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall (G := G) (h := fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
    (m := 0) (M := 0) (fun _ => ⟨le_rfl, le_rfl⟩) x
  exact le_antisymm hx.2 hx.1

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.constant_wide_cover_exceeds_clipped_range
statement:
theorem constant_wide_cover_exceeds_clipped_range :
    (∀ x, plHeight edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) x = 0) ∧
    IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (plHeight edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)))).obj
      (ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 4))) ∧
    Nonempty ((coverComponents (plHeight edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))) wideCover).obj
      (ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 4)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨flat_height edgeGraph, ⟨fun c => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      have hx := x.property
      rw [flat_height edgeGraph x.val] at hx
      change (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 0 ∧ 0 < 3 / 4 at hx
      norm_num at hx
  · exact ⟨ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨vertex edgeGraph false,
      mem_coverSaturation.mpr ⟨(), by norm_num [wideCover, mem_ioo],
        2 / 3, by norm_num [wideCover, mem_ioo], by norm_num [mem_ioo]⟩⟩⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.constant_wide_cover_clipped_resolution_zero
statement:
theorem constant_wide_cover_clipped_resolution_zero :
    clippedCoverResolution (plHeight edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)))
      (fun _ : Unit => -1) (fun _ => 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ((ioo (-1) 1 : Set ℝ) ∩
      Set.range (plHeight edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)))).Subsingleton := by
    intro x hx y hy
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hx.2
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hy.2
    rw [flat_height edgeGraph u, flat_height edgeGraph v]
  unfold clippedCoverResolution
  simp only [Metric.diam_subsingleton hs, Real.toNNReal_zero]
  exact Finset.sup_bot _

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.constant_wide_cover_geometric_error_pos
statement:
theorem constant_wide_cover_geometric_error_pos :
    0 < RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance
      (graphPLMapperReconstruction edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
        (fun _ : Unit => -1) (fun _ => 1))
      (GraphPL.graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr
  intro hzero
  rw [geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_eq] at hzero
  obtain ⟨j⟩ := (interleavingDistance_eq_zero_iff.mp hzero) (1 / 8) (by norm_num)
  have he : IsEmpty ((intervalComponents (plHeight edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)))).obj
      (thicken (1 / 8) (ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 4)))) := by
    constructor
    intro c
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := mem_thicken.mp x.property
      rw [flat_height edgeGraph x.val] at hxy
      have hl := (abs_le.mp hxy).1
      norm_num at hl
      linarith [hy.1]
  let c := constant_wide_cover_exceeds_clipped_range.2.2.some
  exact he.false (j.φ.app (ioo (1 / 2) (3 / 4)) c)

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.wide_cover_endpoint_contact_empty

  | mk x =>
    obtain ⟨i, _, y, hyU, hyI⟩ := mem_coverSaturation.mp x.property
    change (-1 : ℝ) < y ∧ y < 1 at hyU
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hyI.1.le) hyU.2

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.empty_graph_zero_resolution
statement:
theorem empty_graph_zero_resolution :
    RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance
      (graphPLMapperReconstruction (⊥ : SimpleGraph Empty) Empty.elim
        (fun i : Empty => i.elim) (fun i => i.elim))
      (GraphPL.graphPLReebGraph (⊥ : SimpleGraph Empty) Empty.elim) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  have h := geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le (⊥ : SimpleGraph Empty) Empty.elim
    (fun i : Empty => i.elim) (fun i => i.elim) (fun x => isEmptyElim x)
  norm_num [coverResolution] at h
  exact h.le

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.interior_hit_retained

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.cyclePair_intersection
statement:
private theorem cyclePair_intersection :
    coverIntersection overlappingIntervals cyclePair = toOpens I4
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hf := (mem_coverIntersection overlappingIntervals cyclePair x).mp hx false
      (Finset.mem_univ false)
    have ht := (mem_coverIntersection overlappingIntervals cyclePair x).mp hx true
      (Finset.mem_univ true)
    exact ⟨ht.1, hf.2⟩
  · intro hx
    apply (mem_coverIntersection overlappingIntervals cyclePair x).mpr
    intro i _
    cases i <;> change _ < x ∧ x < _ <;> constructor <;> linarith [hx.1, hx.2]

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.disconnected_pair_pullback_empty

    (coverIntersection overlappingIntervals cyclePair))
  rw [cyclePair_intersection]
  have hm : ∀ p : Realization (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool),
      plHeight (⊥ : SimpleGraph Bool) h02 p ∉ I4 :=
    TDA.Reeb.GraphRealization.ind _
      (fun v => by cases v <;> norm_num [plHeight_vertex, h02, I4, mem_ioo])

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.cycle_categorical_pair_distinguishes_ordinary_edge
statement:
theorem cycle_categorical_pair_distinguishes_ordinary_edge :
    Nat.card ((categoricalMapperData (plHeight C4 h4) overlappingIntervals).obj cyclePair) = 2 ∧
    MultiNerveExamples.cycleEdge.card = 2 ∧
    MultiNerveExamples.cycleEdge ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4)
      (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ s ∈ mapper (plHeight C4 h4) (fun i => (overlappingIntervals i : Set ℝ)),
      s.card = 2 → s = MultiNerveExamples.cycleEdge)
proof:
:=
  by
    classical
    refine ⟨cycle_categorical_pair_card, ?_,
      MultiNerveExamples.cycle_multiNerveMapper_ne_mapper.2.2.1,
      MultiNerveExamples.cycle_multiNerveMapper_ne_mapper.2.2.2.1⟩
    unfold MultiNerveExamples.cycleEdge

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.cycleFine_covers
statement:
theorem cycleFine_covers (x : Realization C4) :
    ∃ i, plHeight C4 h4 x ∈ ioo (cycleFineLeft i) (cycleFineRight i)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := plHeight_mem_Icc_of_forall (G := C4) (h := h4) (m := 0) (M := 2)
    (fun v => by fin_cases v <;> norm_num [h4]) x
  by_cases hlow : plHeight C4 h4 x < 3 / 4
  · exact ⟨0, by change (-1 : ℝ) < _ ∧ _ < 3 / 4; constructor <;> linarith [hx.1]⟩
  · by_cases hmid : plHeight C4 h4 x < 3 / 2
    · exact ⟨1, by change (1 / 2 : ℝ) < _ ∧ _ < 3 / 2; constructor <;> linarith⟩
    · exact ⟨2, by change (5 / 4 : ℝ) < _ ∧ _ < 3; constructor <;> linarith [hx.2]⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.cycleFine_central_saturation
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨i, hxi, y, hyU, hyI⟩ := mem_coverSaturation.mp hx
    fin_cases i
    · change (-1 : ℝ) < y ∧ y < 3 / 4 at hyU
      change (7 / 8 : ℝ) < y ∧ y < 9 / 8 at hyI
      linarith [hyU.2, hyI.1]
    · exact hxi
    · change (5 / 4 : ℝ) < y ∧ y < 3 at hyU
      change (7 / 8 : ℝ) < y ∧ y < 9 / 8 at hyI
      linarith [hyU.1, hyI.2]
  · intro hx
    exact mem_coverSaturation.mpr ⟨1, hx, 1,
      by norm_num [cycleFineLeft, cycleFineRight, mem_ioo], by norm_num [mem_ioo]⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.cycleFine_reconstruction_central_card

theorem cycleFine_reconstruction_central_card :

      (graphPLMapperReconstruction C4 h4 cycleFineLeft cycleFineRight)).obj).obj
        (ioo (7 / 8) (9 / 8))) = 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = Nat.card ((coverComponents (plHeight C4 h4)
        (fun i => ioo (cycleFineLeft i) (cycleFineRight i))).obj
          (ioo (7 / 8) (9 / 8))) :=
      Nat.card_congr ((categoricalMapperReconstructionIso (plHeight C4 h4)
        cycleFineLeft cycleFineRight (fun i => finite_zerothHomotopy C4 h4
          (ioo (cycleFineLeft i) (cycleFineRight i)))).app _).toEquiv
    _ = 2 := by
      change Nat.card ((componentFunctor (plHeight C4 h4)).obj
        (coverSaturation (fun i => ioo (cycleFineLeft i) (cycleFineRight i))
          (ioo (7 / 8) (9 / 8)))) = 2
      rw [cycleFine_central_saturation]
      exact c4_card_preimage

name: TDA.Mapper.MapperReebApproximationExamples.nonconstant_edge_convergent_reconstructions
statement:
theorem nonconstant_edge_convergent_reconstructions :
    ∃ n : ℕ → ℕ, ∃ a b : ∀ t, Fin (n t) → ℝ,
      (∀ t x, ∃ i, plHeight edgeGraph h02 x ∈ ioo (a t i) (b t i)) ∧
      (∀ t, coverResolution (a t) (b t) ≤ Real.toNNReal (1 / ((t : ℝ) + 1))) ∧
      Tendsto (fun t => (coverResolution (a t) (b t) : ℝ≥0∞)) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
      (∀ t, RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance
        (graphPLMapperReconstruction edgeGraph h02 (a t) (b t))
        (GraphPL.graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph h02) ≤
          (Real.toNNReal (1 / ((t : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ≥0∞)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun t => RGraph.geometricInterleavingDistance
        (graphPLMapperReconstruction edgeGraph h02 (a t) (b t))
        (GraphPL.graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph h02)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hex (t : ℕ) := exists_graphPLMapperCover_resolution_le edgeGraph h02
    (r := 1 / ((t : ℝ) + 1)) (by positivity)
  choose n a b hcov hres using hex
  have hinner : Tendsto (fun t : ℕ =>
      Real.toNNReal (1 / ((t : ℝ) + 1))) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.toNNReal_zero] using
      (continuous_real_toNNReal.tendsto 0).comp
        (tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat (𝕜 := ℝ))
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun t : ℕ =>
      (Real.toNNReal (1 / ((t : ℝ) + 1)) : ℝ≥0∞)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, ENNReal.coe_zero] using
      (ENNReal.continuous_coe.tendsto 0).comp hinner
  have hreslim : Tendsto (fun t => (coverResolution (a t) (b t) : ℝ≥0∞)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hlim
      (fun _ => bot_le) (fun t => ENNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr (hres t))
  refine ⟨n, a, b, hcov, hres, hreslim, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t
    exact (geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb_le edgeGraph h02
      (a t) (b t) (hcov t)).trans (ENNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr (hres t))
  · exact tendsto_geometricInterleavingDistance_mapperReeb edgeGraph h02
      (fun t => Fin (n t)) a b hcov hreslim

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyLowerBoundExamples.eq_singleton_of_no_edges
statement:
private theorem eq_singleton_of_no_edges [IsEmpty (Face (mapper f V) 1)]
    {s : Finset (ComponentIndex f V)} (hs : s ∈ mapper f V) : ∃ b, s = {b}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hne, x, hx⟩ := (mem_mapper_iff f V s).1 hs
  refine Finset.card_eq_one.1 (le_antisymm ?_ hne.card_pos)
  by_contra hlt
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.1 (not_le.1 hlt)
  have hface : ({a, b} : Finset (ComponentIndex f V)) ∈ mapper f V :=
    (mem_mapper_iff f V _).2 ⟨Finset.insert_nonempty _ _, x, fun d hd => by
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hd with rfl | hd
      · exact hx _ ha
      · rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 hd]
        exact hx _ hb⟩
  exact isEmptyElim (⟨_, hface, Finset.card_pair hab⟩ : Face (mapper f V) 1)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyLowerBoundExamples.mapperHomologyMap_bijective_of_bijective
statement:
theorem mapperHomologyMap_bijective_of_bijective [IsEmpty (Face (mapper f V) 1)]
    (r : Refinement U V) (hr : Function.Bijective (mapperMap f r)) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Bijective (mapperHomologyMap R f r n).hom
proof:
:= by
  let g := inverseVertexMap f r hr
  have h₁ : mapperHomologyMap R f r n ≫ simplicialHomologyMap R g n = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [mapperHomologyMap_def, ← simplicialHomologyMap_comp]
    convert simplicialHomologyMap_id R (mapper f U) n
    exact VertexMap.ext fun a => (Equiv.ofBijective _ hr).symm_apply_apply a
  have h₂ : simplicialHomologyMap R g n ≫ mapperHomologyMap R f r n = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [mapperHomologyMap_def, ← simplicialHomologyMap_comp]
    convert simplicialHomologyMap_id R (mapper f V) n
    exact VertexMap.ext fun b => (Equiv.ofBijective _ hr).apply_symm_apply b
  refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.2 ⟨(simplicialHomologyMap R g n).hom, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom h₁) x
  · intro y
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom h₂) y

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyLowerBoundExamples.realInterleavingDistance_late_early
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_late_early (k : Type c) [Field k] :
    realInterleavingDistance
        (mapperHomologyPModule k threeStageMap lateTower lateRefinement 0)
        (mapperHomologyPModule k threeStageMap earlyTower earlyRefinement 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa using realInterleavingDistance_mapperHomologyPModule_le k threeStageMap
      lateRefinement earlyRefinement 0 (lateToEarly 1) earlyToLate
  · rw [realInterleavingDistance_comm]
    refine le_realInterleavingDistance_mapperHomologyPModule_of_isEmpty_face k
      earlyRefinement lateRefinement 0 fun ε hε => ?_
    have hε' : (ε : ℝ) < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hε
    have hpos : 0 < 1 - (ε : ℝ) := by linarith
    refine ⟨1 - ε, by linarith [ε.coe_nonneg], ?_,
      mapperHomologyMap_earlyRefinement_ne_zero k hpos _⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyLowerBoundExamples.centredCover_no_edges_of_le_half
statement:
theorem centredCover_no_edges_of_le_half {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (f : C(X, ℝ))
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1 / 2) [LinearOrder (ComponentIndex f (centredCover 1 t))] :
    IsEmpty (Face (mapper f (centredCover 1 t)) 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun F => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hF⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.1 F.2.2
  have hface := F.2.1
  rw [hF] at hface
  obtain ⟨_, x, hx⟩ := (mem_mapper_iff f _ _).1 hface
  obtain ⟨ha, _⟩ := hx a (by simp)
  obtain ⟨hb, _⟩ := hx b (by simp)
  rw [mem_centredCover_iff] at ha hb
  have hlt : |((a.1 : ℝ) - b.1)| < 1 := by
    have := abs_sub_le (a.1 : ℝ) (f x) (b.1)
    rw [abs_sub_comm (a.1 : ℝ) (f x)] at this
    simp only [mul_one] at ha hb
    linarith
  have hkey : a.1 = b.1 := by
    rw [abs_lt] at hlt
    have h₁ : a.1 - b.1 < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hlt.2
    have h₂ : -1 < a.1 - b.1 := by exact_mod_cast hlt.1
    omega
  exact hab (eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq f _ hface (by simp) (by simp) hkey)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyLowerBoundExamples.mapperMap_scaleMap_bijective
statement:
private theorem mapperMap_scaleMap_bijective (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ (x : I) (k : ℤ), |c * (x : ℝ) - k| < 1 / 2 → ∃ y : I, c * (y : ℝ) = k)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Function.Bijective (mapperMap (scaleMap c) (centredCoverRefinement 1 hab))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, p⟩ ⟨l, q⟩ h
    have hkl : k = l := congrArg Sigma.fst h
    subst hkl
    have := scaleMap_zerothHomotopy_subsingleton c 1 a k
    exact Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq (Subsingleton.elim p q))
  · rintro ⟨k, p⟩
    induction p using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
    have hx : |c * (x.1 : ℝ) - k| < 1 / 2 := by
      have := mem_centredCover_iff.1 x.2
      simp only [mul_one] at this
      change |c * (x.1 : ℝ) - k| < b at this
      linarith
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hc x.1 k hx
    have hya : scaleMap c y ∈ centredCover 1 a k := by
      rw [mem_centredCover_iff]
      change |c * (y : ℝ) - k * 1| < a
      rw [hy, mul_one, sub_self, abs_zero]
      exact ha
    refine ⟨⟨k, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨y, hya⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [mapperMap_mk]
    have := scaleMap_zerothHomotopy_subsingleton c 1 b k
    exact Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq
      (Subsingleton.elim (α := ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace (scaleMap c) (centredCover 1 b) k))
        _ _))

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyLowerBoundExamples.flat_attains
statement:
private theorem flat_attains (x : I) (k : ℤ) (h : |0 * (x : ℝ) - k| < 1 / 2) :
    ∃ y : I, 0 * (y : ℝ) = k
proof:
:= by
  rw [zero_mul, zero_sub, abs_neg] at h
  have h' : |k| < 1 := by
    have : |(k : ℝ)| < 1 := by linarith
    exact_mod_cast this
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  rw [zero_mul, eq_comm, Int.cast_eq_zero]
  exact Int.abs_lt_one_iff.1 h'

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyLowerBoundExamples.steep_attains
statement:
private theorem steep_attains (x : I) (k : ℤ) (h : |4 * (x : ℝ) - k| < 1 / 2) :
    ∃ y : I, 4 * (y : ℝ) = k
proof:
:= by
  rw [abs_lt] at h
  have hx₀ := x.2.1
  have hx₁ := x.2.2
  have hk₀ : (-1 : ℝ) < k := by linarith
  have hk₄ : (k : ℝ) < 5 := by linarith
  have hk₀' : 0 ≤ k := by
    have : (-1 : ℤ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk₀
    omega
  have hk₄' : k ≤ 4 := by
    have : k < (5 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hk₄
    omega
  have h₀ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hk₀'
  have h₄ : (k : ℝ) ≤ 4 := by exact_mod_cast hk₄'
  exact ⟨⟨(k : ℝ) / 4, by linarith, by linarith⟩,
    by change 4 * ((k : ℝ) / 4) = k; ring⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyLowerBoundExamples.scaleMap_structureMap_bijective
statement:
private theorem scaleMap_structureMap_bijective (c : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ (x : I) (k : ℤ), |c * (x : ℝ) - k| < 1 / 2 → ∃ y : I, c * (y : ℝ) = k)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1 / 2) :

proof:

  mapperHomologyMap_bijective_of_bijective ℚ (scaleMap c) _
    (mapperMap_scaleMap_bijective c hc ha hab hb) 0

    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hr' : r ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology (mapper (scaleMap c) (centredCover 1 r)) ℚ 0) =
      Module.finrank ℚ
        (simplicialHomology (mapper (scaleMap c) (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) ℚ 0)
proof:

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyLowerBoundExamples.finrank_steep_centredCover

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyLowerBoundExamples.finrank_range_steep_refinement
statement:
theorem finrank_range_steep_refinement {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range
      (mapperHomologyMap ℚ steepMap (centredCoverRefinement 1 hab) 0).hom) = 5
proof:
:= by

    finrank_top]
  exact finrank_steep_centredCover (ha.trans_le hab) hb

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyLowerBoundExamples.flat_steep_distance_bounds
statement:
theorem flat_steep_distance_bounds :
    (1 / 8 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ realInterleavingDistance
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ flatMap (centredCover 1) (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0)
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ steepMap (centredCover 1) (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0) ∧
    realInterleavingDistance
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ flatMap (centredCover 1) (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0)
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ steepMap (centredCover 1) (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0) ≤ 4
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, by simpa using flat_steep_perturbation.2.2.2⟩
  rw [realInterleavingDistance_comm]
  refine le_realInterleavingDistance_centredMapperHomology_of_finrank_lt ℚ 1 0
    fun ε hε => ?_
  have hε' : (ε : ℝ) < 1 / 8 := by
    have : (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < ((1 / 8 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) := by simpa using hε
    exact_mod_cast ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.1 this
  have hε₀ := ε.coe_nonneg
  have h : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4 + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by push_cast; linarith
  have hflat := finrank_flat_centredCover (r := 1 / 4 + ε) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨1 / 4, h, Module.finite_of_finrank_eq_succ hflat, ?_⟩
  rw [hflat, finrank_range_steep_refinement (by norm_num) h (by push_cast; linarith)]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyLowerBoundExamples.rank_obstruction_self
statement:
theorem rank_obstruction_self (k : Type u) [Field k] (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) :
    (∀ (t : ℝ) (h : t ≤ t + ((0 + 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))
        [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (t + ((0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))],
        Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M h)) ≤
          Module.finrank k (M.obj (t + ((0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))) ∧
    (∀ (t : ℝ) (h : t ≤ t + ((0 + 0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)),
      ¬ (FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (t + ((0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) ∧
        Module.finrank k (M.obj (t + ((0 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) <
          Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M h)))) ∧
    realInterleavingDistance M M = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun t h _ => finrank_range_structureMapLinear_le_of_realInterleaving
    (RealInterleaving.refl 0 M) t h, fun t h ⟨_, hlt⟩ => ?_, realInterleavingDistance_self M⟩
  exact (isEmpty_realInterleaving_of_finrank_lt t h hlt).false (RealInterleaving.refl 0 M)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyMapPairExamples.pointMapper_has_no_vertices
statement:
private theorem pointMapper_has_no_vertices :
    IsEmpty (ComponentIndex pointHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun a => ?_⟩
  rcases a with ⟨k, c⟩
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    have hm : |(1 / 2 : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)| < 1 / 2 := by
      simpa [pointHeight, pointRealization_eq, centredCover,
        GraphPL.plHeight_vertex] using (mem_centredCover_iff.mp x.2)
    rw [abs_lt] at hm
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by linarith [hm.2]
    have hlt : (k : ℝ) < 1 := by linarith [hm.1]
    have hkpos : 0 < k := by exact_mod_cast hpos
    have hklt : k < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hlt
    omega

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyMapPairExamples.pointMapper_finrank_zero
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsEmpty (ComponentIndex pointHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) :=
    pointMapper_has_no_vertices
  rw [mapper_eq_bot_of_isEmpty_componentIndex pointHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))]
  haveI : Subsingleton (simplicialHomology
      (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex
        (ComponentIndex pointHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2)))) ℚ 0) :=
    ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (TDA.Persistence.isZero_simplicialHomology_bot ℚ 0)
  exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton (R := ℚ)

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyMapPairExamples.scaleMap_one_centred_half_finrank
proof:
:= by
  have hlabels : ∀ k : ℤ, k ∈ ({0, 1} : Finset ℤ) ↔
      ∃ x : unitInterval, scaleMap 1 x ∈ centredCover 1 (1 / 2) k := by
    intro k
    rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro (rfl | rfl)
      · exact ⟨0, by norm_num [scaleMap, centredCover, Set.mem_Ioo]⟩
      · exact ⟨1, by norm_num [scaleMap, centredCover, Set.mem_Ioo]⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
      rw [mem_centredCover_iff] at hx
      have hx' : |(x : ℝ) - (k : ℝ)| < 1 / 2 := by simpa [scaleMap] using hx
      rw [abs_lt] at hx'
      have hlo : (-1 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by
        have hx0 := x.2.1
        linarith [hx'.2]
      have hhi : (k : ℝ) < 2 := by
        have hx1 := x.2.2
        linarith [hx'.1]
      have hlo' : -1 < k := by exact_mod_cast hlo
      have hhi' : k < 2 := by exact_mod_cast hhi
      omega
  calc
    Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology (mapper (scaleMap 1)
        (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) ℚ 0) = ({0, 1} : Finset ℤ).card :=
      finrank_scaleMap_centredCover_half 1 {0, 1} hlabels
    _ = 2 := by norm_num

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyMapPairExamples.edgeToPoint_mapper_dimensions
statement:
theorem edgeToPoint_mapper_dimensions :
    Module.finrank ℚ ((mapperHomologyPModule ℚ edgeHeight (centredCover 1)
      (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0).obj (1 / 2)) = 2 ∧
    Module.finrank ℚ ((mapperHomologyPModule ℚ pointHeight (centredCover 1)
      (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0).obj (1 / 2)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology
      (mapper (scaleMap 1) (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) ℚ 0) = 2 :=
    scaleMap_one_centred_half_finrank
  have hmap : ∀ x, scaleMap 1 (edgeHomeomorph x) = edgeHeight x := by
    intro x
    rw [edgeHeight_eq_edgeCoordReal]
    simp [scaleMap, edgeCoordReal]
  let iso := mapperHomologyPModuleIso (R := ℚ) (e := edgeHomeomorph) (he := hmap)
    (centredCover 1) (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0
  have hrank := (iso.app (1 / 2)).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq
  have hrank' : Module.finrank ℚ ((mapperHomologyPModule ℚ edgeHeight
      (centredCover 1) (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0).obj (1 / 2)) =
      Module.finrank ℚ ((mapperHomologyPModule ℚ (scaleMap 1) (centredCover 1)
        (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0).obj (1 / 2)) := by
    simpa only [mapperHomologyPModule_obj] using hrank
  have hscale' : Module.finrank ℚ ((mapperHomologyPModule ℚ (scaleMap 1)
      (centredCover 1) (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0).obj (1 / 2)) = 2 := by
    change Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology
      (mapper (scaleMap 1) (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) ℚ 0) = 2
    exact hscale
  constructor
  · exact hrank'.trans hscale'
  · change Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology
      (mapper pointHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) ℚ 0) = 0
    exact pointMapper_finrank_zero

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyMapPairExamples.edgeToPoint_mapper_noniso

        (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0)
proof:

  have htgt := edgeToPoint_mapper_dimensions.2

        (centredCover 1) (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0).obj (1 / 2)) := by

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyMapPairExamples.boolZeroMapper_finrank
statement:
private theorem boolZeroMapper_finrank :
    Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology (mapper boolZeroHeight wholeLine) ℚ 0) = 2
proof:
:= by
  let q : Bool → ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace boolZeroHeight wholeLine ()) :=
    fun b => ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨b, trivial⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective q := by
    intro a b hab
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := Quotient.exact hab
    have hc : Continuous fun t => (p t).1 := continuous_subtype_val.comp p.continuous
    have hconst := PreconnectedSpace.constant inferInstance hc (x := 0) (y := 1)
    simp at hconst
    exact hne hconst
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective q := by
    intro c
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x => exact ⟨x.1, rfl⟩
  have hcard : Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy
      (PullbackSpace boolZeroHeight wholeLine ())) = 2 := by
    rw [← Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective q ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩)]
    simp
  have hfinite : Finite (ZerothHomotopy
      (PullbackSpace boolZeroHeight wholeLine ())) :=
    Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [hcard]; omega)
  have hnoEdges : IsEmpty (Face (mapper boolZeroHeight wholeLine) 1) := by
    refine ⟨fun s => ?_⟩
    have hmult : CoverMultiplicityAtMost boolZeroHeight wholeLine 1 :=
      fun _ _ t _ => by simpa using Finset.card_le_univ t
    have := mapper_face_card_le_of_multiplicity boolZeroHeight wholeLine hmult s.2.1
    omega
  have hfaceEquiv : Face (mapper boolZeroHeight wholeLine) 0 ≃
      ComponentIndex boolZeroHeight wholeLine := by
    refine {
      toFun s := (Finset.card_eq_one.1 s.2.2).choose
      invFun a := ⟨{a}, componentIndex_supported boolZeroHeight wholeLine a,
        Finset.card_singleton a⟩
      left_inv s := Subtype.ext (Finset.card_eq_one.1 s.2.2).choose_spec.symm
      right_inv a := ?_ }
    have h := (Finset.card_eq_one.1 (Finset.card_singleton a)).choose_spec
    exact (Finset.singleton_inj.1 h).symm
  have hcomponents : Nat.card (ComponentIndex boolZeroHeight wholeLine) = 2 := by
    change Nat.card (Σ i : Unit,
      ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace boolZeroHeight wholeLine i)) = 2
    calc
      Nat.card (Σ i : Unit, ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace boolZeroHeight wholeLine i)) =
          Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace boolZeroHeight wholeLine ())) :=
        Nat.card_congr (Equiv.uniqueSigma _)
      _ = 2 := hcard
  have hfiniteComponents : Finite (ComponentIndex boolZeroHeight wholeLine) :=
    Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [hcomponents]; omega)
  letI : Finite (ComponentIndex boolZeroHeight wholeLine) := hfiniteComponents
  have hfiniteFaces : Finite (Face (mapper boolZeroHeight wholeLine) 0) :=
    Finite.of_equiv _ hfaceEquiv.symm
  letI := Fintype.ofFinite (Face (mapper boolZeroHeight wholeLine) 0)
  calc
    Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology (mapper boolZeroHeight wholeLine) ℚ 0) =
        Fintype.card (Face (mapper boolZeroHeight wholeLine) 0) :=
      finrank_zeroHomology_of_no_edges (mapper boolZeroHeight wholeLine) ℚ
    _ = Nat.card (Face (mapper boolZeroHeight wholeLine) 0) := Fintype.card_eq_nat_card
    _ = Nat.card (ComponentIndex boolZeroHeight wholeLine) := Nat.card_congr hfaceEquiv
    _ = 2 := hcomponents

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyMapPairExamples.zeroHeight_componentIndex_label_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem zeroHeight_componentIndex_label_eq_zero {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (f : C(X, ℝ)) (hf : ∀ x, f x = 0) {r : ℝ} (hr : r < 1)
    (a : ComponentIndex f (centredCover 1 r)) : a.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, _⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective a.2
  have hmem : |(a.1 : ℝ)| < r := by
    have h := mem_centredCover_iff.mp x.2
    simpa [hf x.1] using h
  have hkReal : |(a.1 : ℝ)| < 1 := hmem.trans hr
  have hkInt : |a.1| < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hkReal
  exact Int.abs_lt_one_iff.1 hkInt

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyMapPairExamples.zeroHeight_mapper_no_edges
statement:
private theorem zeroHeight_mapper_no_edges {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X]
    (f : C(X, ℝ)) (hf : ∀ x, f x = 0) {r : ℝ} (hr : r < 1) :
    IsEmpty (Face (mapper f (centredCover 1 r)) 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun F => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, hF⟩ := Finset.card_eq_two.1 F.2.2
  have hface := F.2.1
  rw [hF] at hface
  have ha := zeroHeight_componentIndex_label_eq_zero f hf hr a
  have hb := zeroHeight_componentIndex_label_eq_zero f hf hr b
  exact hab (eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq f _ hface (by simp) (by simp)
    (ha.trans hb.symm))

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyMapPairExamples.boolZeroMapper_centredMap_bijective
proof:
:= by
  let ea := boolZeroComponentIndexEquiv ha (lt_of_le_of_lt hab hb)
  let eb := boolZeroComponentIndexEquiv (lt_of_lt_of_le ha hab) hb
  have hmap (x : Bool) :
      mapperMap boolZeroHeight (centredCoverRefinement 1 hab) (ea x) = eb x := by
    change mapperMap boolZeroHeight (centredCoverRefinement 1 hab)
        (boolZeroComponentIndexVertex ha x) =
          boolZeroComponentIndexVertex (lt_of_lt_of_le ha hab) x
    unfold boolZeroComponentIndexVertex
    rw [mapperMap_mk]
    apply Sigma.ext rfl
    apply heq_of_eq
    apply congrArg ZerothHomotopy.mk
    exact Subtype.ext rfl
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := ea.surjective x
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := ea.surjective y
    have huv : u = v := eb.injective ((hmap u).symm.trans (hxy.trans (hmap v)))
    subst v
    rfl
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := eb.surjective y
    exact ⟨ea v, hmap v⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyMapPairExamples.boolZeroMapper_centred_finrank
proof:
:= by
  let e := boolZeroComponentIndexEquiv hr hr'
  letI : Fintype (ComponentIndex boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1 r)) :=
    Fintype.ofEquiv Bool e
  let hfaceEquiv := mapper_vertexFace_equiv boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1 r)
  letI : Fintype (Face (mapper boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1 r)) 0) :=
    Fintype.ofEquiv (ComponentIndex boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1 r)) hfaceEquiv.symm
  letI : IsEmpty (Face (mapper boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1 r)) 1) :=
    zeroHeight_mapper_no_edges boolZeroHeight (by intro _; rfl) hr'
  calc
    Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology
        (mapper boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1 r)) ℚ 0) =
        Fintype.card (Face (mapper boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1 r)) 0) :=
      finrank_zeroHomology_of_no_edges (mapper boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1 r)) ℚ
    _ = Fintype.card (ComponentIndex boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1 r)) :=
      Fintype.card_congr hfaceEquiv
    _ = 2 := by
      rw [← Fintype.card_congr e]
      simp

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyMapPairExamples.unitZeroMapper_centred_half_finrank
proof:
:= by
  letI : Unique (ComponentIndex unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) := by
    refine ⟨⟨0, ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨(), by
      rw [mem_centredCover_iff]
      norm_num [unitZeroHeight]⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    intro a
    rcases a with ⟨k, c⟩
    have hk := zeroHeight_componentIndex_label_eq_zero unitZeroHeight
      (by intro _; rfl) (by norm_num) ⟨k, c⟩
    change k = 0 at hk
    subst k
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := ZerothHomotopy.mk_surjective c
    change (⟨0, c⟩ : ComponentIndex unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) =
      ⟨0, ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(), by
        rw [mem_centredCover_iff]
        norm_num [unitZeroHeight]⟩ :
          PullbackSpace unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2)) 0)⟩
    exact Sigma.ext rfl (heq_of_eq (calc
      c = ZerothHomotopy.mk x := hx.symm
      _ = ZerothHomotopy.mk (⟨(), by
        rw [mem_centredCover_iff]
        norm_num [unitZeroHeight]⟩ :
          PullbackSpace unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2)) 0) := by
            congr 1))
  letI : Fintype (ComponentIndex unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite _
  let hfaceEquiv := mapper_vertexFace_equiv unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))
  letI : Fintype (Face (mapper unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) 0) :=
    Fintype.ofEquiv (ComponentIndex unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) hfaceEquiv.symm
  letI : IsEmpty (Face (mapper unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) 1) :=
    zeroHeight_mapper_no_edges unitZeroHeight (by intro _; rfl) (by norm_num)
  calc
    Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology
        (mapper unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) ℚ 0) =
        Fintype.card (Face (mapper unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) 0) :=
      finrank_zeroHomology_of_no_edges (mapper unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) ℚ
    _ = Fintype.card (ComponentIndex unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (1 / 2))) :=
      Fintype.card_congr hfaceEquiv
    _ = 1 := by
      simp

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyMapPairExamples.boolToUnit_centred_distance_ge_half
statement:
private theorem boolToUnit_centred_distance_ge_half :
    ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2) ≤ realInterleavingDistance
      (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1)
        (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0)
      (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1)
        (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hbound : ((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ realInterleavingDistance
      (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1)
        (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0)
      (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1)
        (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0) := by
    apply le_realInterleavingDistance_of_finrank_lt (k := ℚ)
      (M := mapperHomologyPModule ℚ boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1)
        (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0)
      (N := mapperHomologyPModule ℚ unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1)
        (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0)
      (r := (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0))
    intro ε hε
    have hε' : (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < ((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) := by simpa using hε
    have hεReal : (ε : ℝ) < 1 / 2 := by
      exact_mod_cast ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.1 hε'
    let t : ℝ := (1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) / 2
    have htpos : 0 < t := by dsimp [t]; linarith
    have hmid : t + (ε : ℝ) = 1 / 2 := by dsimp [t]; ring
    have hdouble : t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = 1 / 2 + (ε : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [t]
      ring
    have hdouble_pos : 0 < t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by rw [hdouble]; positivity
    have hdouble_lt : t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) < 1 := by
      rw [hdouble]
      linarith
    have h : t ≤ t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
      rw [hdouble]
      linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]
    have hmapBij : Function.Bijective (mapperMap boolZeroHeight
        (centredCoverRefinement 1 h)) :=
      boolZeroMapper_centredMap_bijective htpos h hdouble_lt
    letI : IsEmpty (Face (mapper boolZeroHeight
        (centredCover 1 (t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))) 1) :=
      zeroHeight_mapper_no_edges boolZeroHeight (by intro _; rfl) hdouble_lt
    have hhomBij : Function.Bijective
        (mapperHomologyMap ℚ boolZeroHeight (centredCoverRefinement 1 h) 0).hom :=
      RefinementHomologyLowerBoundExamples.mapperHomologyMap_bijective_of_bijective
        ℚ boolZeroHeight _ hmapBij 0
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective (structureMapLinear
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1)
          (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0) h) := by
      change Function.Surjective
        (mapperHomologyMap ℚ boolZeroHeight (centredCoverRefinement 1 h) 0).hom
      exact hhomBij.2
    have hrank : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1)
          (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0) h)) = 2 := by
      rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.2 hsurj, finrank_top]
      change Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology
        (mapper boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)))) ℚ 0) = 2
      exact boolZeroMapper_centred_finrank hdouble_pos hdouble_lt
    have htarget : Module.finrank ℚ ((mapperHomologyPModule ℚ unitZeroHeight
        (centredCover 1) (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0).obj (t + (ε : ℝ))) = 1 := by
      change Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology
        (mapper unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1 (t + (ε : ℝ)))) ℚ 0) = 1
      rw [hmid]
      exact unitZeroMapper_centred_half_finrank
    refine ⟨t, h, Module.finite_of_finrank_eq_succ htarget, ?_⟩
    rw [htarget, hrank]
    norm_num
  have hconvert : ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2 : ℝ) = (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    have hreal : (1 / 2 : ℝ) = ((1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by norm_num
    rw [hreal, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
    norm_num
  simpa [hconvert] using hbound

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyMapPairExamples.boolToUnit_pathCondition_needed
statement:
theorem boolToUnit_pathCondition_needed :
    (∀ b, unitZeroHeight (boolToUnit b) = boolZeroHeight b) ∧
      (∀ u, boolZeroHeight (unitToBool u) = unitZeroHeight u) ∧
      (∀ δ : ℝ≥0, ¬ Nonempty (HeightMapPair boolZeroHeight unitZeroHeight δ)) ∧
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2) ≤ realInterleavingDistance
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ boolZeroHeight (centredCover 1)
          (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0)
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ unitZeroHeight (centredCover 1)
          (centredCoverRefinement 1) 0) ∧
      realInterleavingDistance
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ boolZeroHeight fullCoverTower fullCoverRefinement 0)
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ unitZeroHeight fullCoverTower fullCoverRefinement 0) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, ?_, boolToUnit_centred_distance_ge_half, ?_⟩
  · intro δ
    rintro ⟨P⟩
    have htrue : P.ψ (P.φ true) = true := by
      obtain ⟨γ, _⟩ := P.hψφ true
      have hconst := PreconnectedSpace.constant inferInstance γ.continuous (x := 0) (y := 1)
      simpa using hconst
    have hfalse : P.ψ (P.φ false) = false := by
      obtain ⟨γ, _⟩ := P.hψφ false
      have hconst := PreconnectedSpace.constant inferInstance γ.continuous (x := 0) (y := 1)
      simpa using hconst
    have hcomp : P.ψ (P.φ true) = P.ψ (P.φ false) :=
      congrArg P.ψ (Subsingleton.elim (P.φ true) (P.φ false))
    exact Bool.false_ne_true (htrue.symm.trans (hcomp.trans hfalse)).symm
  · apply le_antisymm le_top
    apply le_realInterleavingDistance_of_finrank_lt
      (k := ℚ)
      (M := mapperHomologyPModule ℚ boolZeroHeight fullCoverTower fullCoverRefinement 0)
      (N := mapperHomologyPModule ℚ unitZeroHeight fullCoverTower fullCoverRefinement 0)
      (r := ⊤)
    intro ε hε
    have h : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
      linarith [NNReal.coe_nonneg (ε + ε)]
    have hmapBij : Function.Bijective
        (mapperHomologyMap ℚ boolZeroHeight (fullCoverRefinement h) 0).hom := by
      change Function.Bijective
        (mapperHomologyMap ℚ boolZeroHeight (Refinement.id wholeLine) 0).hom
      rw [mapperHomologyMap_id]
      constructor
      · intro x y hxy
        exact hxy
      · intro y
        exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective (structureMapLinear
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ boolZeroHeight fullCoverTower fullCoverRefinement 0) h) := by
      change Function.Surjective
        ((mapperHomologyMap ℚ boolZeroHeight (fullCoverRefinement h) 0).hom)
      exact hmapBij.2
    have hrank : Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ boolZeroHeight fullCoverTower fullCoverRefinement 0) h)) = 2 := by
      rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.2 hsurj, finrank_top]
      change Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology (mapper boolZeroHeight wholeLine) ℚ 0) = 2
      exact boolZeroMapper_finrank
    have htarget : Module.finrank ℚ ((mapperHomologyPModule ℚ unitZeroHeight
        fullCoverTower fullCoverRefinement 0).obj (1 + ε)) = 1 := by
      change Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology (mapper unitZeroHeight wholeLine) ℚ 0) = 1
      exact unitZeroMapper_finrank
    refine ⟨1, h, Module.finite_of_finrank_eq_succ htarget, ?_⟩
    rw [htarget, hrank]
    norm_num

statement:
private theorem pointIndexEmpty (i : Fin 10)
    (hi : stageRadius edgeGrid i ≤ ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : EReal)) :
    IsEmpty (ComponentIndex pointHeight fun (w : cappedIndex (Fin 3) i) =>
      (cappedCentredCover 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid i w : Set ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨w, z⟩ => ?_⟩
  obtain rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩ := i.eq_zero_or_eq_succ
  · exact isEmptyElim w
  induction z using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    have hxmem : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈
        (cappedCentredCover 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid j.succ w : Set ℝ) := by
      simpa [pointHeight_apply] using x.2
    have hx := (mem_cappedCentredCover_succ_iff 0 1 edgeLabels
      edgeGrid j w (1 / 2)).mp hxmem
    have hdist : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) ≤
        ((|1 / 2 - (0 + edgeLabels w * 1)| : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      rw [EReal.coe_le_coe_iff]
      simpa [edgeLabels] using edgeLabels_dist_from_half (show Fin 3 from w)
    have hx' : ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) < stageRadius edgeGrid j.succ := by
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hdist hx
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hi) hx'

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedMapPairExamples.edgePoint_bottleneck_eq_distance
statement:
private theorem edgePoint_bottleneck_eq_distance :
    bottleneck
      (cappedCentredDiagram ℚ edgeHeight 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid 0)
      (cappedCentredDiagram ℚ pointHeight 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid 0) =
      realInterleavingDistance
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ edgeHeight
          (stepTower edgeGrid fun i w =>
            (cappedCentredCover 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid i w : Set ℝ))
          (stepRefinement edgeGrid _ fun h =>
            cappedCentredRefinement 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid h) 0)
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ pointHeight
          (stepTower edgeGrid fun i w =>
            (cappedCentredCover 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid i w : Set ℝ))
          (stepRefinement edgeGrid _ fun h =>
            cappedCentredRefinement 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid h) 0)
proof:
:= by
  change bottleneck
      (moduleDiagram edgeGrid
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ edgeHeight
          (stepTower edgeGrid fun i w =>
            (cappedCentredCover 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid i w : Set ℝ))
          (stepRefinement edgeGrid _ fun h =>
            cappedCentredRefinement 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid h) 0) _)
      (moduleDiagram edgeGrid
        (mapperHomologyPModule ℚ pointHeight
          (stepTower edgeGrid fun i w =>
            (cappedCentredCover 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid i w : Set ℝ))
          (stepRefinement edgeGrid _ fun h =>
            cappedCentredRefinement 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid h) 0) _) = _
  exact bottleneck_eq_distance
    (isConstructible_stepTower edgeGrid _ ℚ edgeHeight _ 0)
    (isConstructible_stepTower edgeGrid _ ℚ pointHeight _ 0) _ _

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedMapPairExamples.edge_point_pair_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem edge_point_pair_lower_bound :
    (1 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ bottleneck
      (cappedCentredDiagram ℚ edgeHeight 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid 0)
      (cappedCentredDiagram ℚ pointHeight 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgePoint_bottleneck_eq_distance]
  refine le_realInterleavingDistance_of_structureMap_ne_zero (r := (1 / 4 : ℝ≥0∞)) ?_
  intro ε hε
  have hεnn : ε < (1 / 4 : ℝ≥0) := by
    have hεcoe : (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < ((1 / 4 : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) := by simpa using hε
    exact ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.1 hεcoe
  have hε' : (ε : ℝ) < 1 / 4 := NNReal.coe_lt_coe.mpr hεnn
  let t : ℝ := 1 / 4
  have h : t ≤ t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [t]
    linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]
  refine ⟨t, h, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change Subsingleton (simplicialHomology
      (mapper pointHeight (fun w : cappedIndex (Fin 3) (cellIndex edgeGrid (t + ε)) =>
        (cappedCentredCover 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid
          (cellIndex edgeGrid (t + ε)) w : Set ℝ))) ℚ 0)
    have hparam : t + (ε : ℝ) < 1 / 2 := by dsimp [t]; linarith
    have hindex := (cellIndex edgeGrid).monotone (le_of_lt hparam)
    have hquarter : edgeGrid (2 : Fin 9) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
      norm_num [edgeGrid, uniformGrid_apply]
    have hhalf : cellIndex edgeGrid (1 / 2) = (2 : Fin 9).succ := by
      rw [← hquarter, cellIndex_critical]
    have hradius : stageRadius edgeGrid (cellIndex edgeGrid (t + ε)) ≤
        ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) := by
      calc
        stageRadius edgeGrid (cellIndex edgeGrid (t + ε)) ≤
            stageRadius edgeGrid (cellIndex edgeGrid (1 / 2)) := stageRadius_mono edgeGrid hindex
        _ = ((1 / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) := by
          rw [hhalf, stageRadius_succ_of_lt edgeGrid 2 (by norm_num)]
          norm_num [edgeGrid, uniformGrid_apply]
    letI : IsEmpty (ComponentIndex pointHeight
        fun (w : cappedIndex (Fin 3) (cellIndex edgeGrid (t + ε))) =>
        (cappedCentredCover 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid
          (cellIndex edgeGrid (t + ε)) w : Set ℝ)) := pointIndexEmpty _ hradius
    letI : IsEmpty (Face (mapper pointHeight fun w : cappedIndex (Fin 3)
        (cellIndex edgeGrid (t + ε)) =>
        (cappedCentredCover 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid
          (cellIndex edgeGrid (t + ε)) w : Set ℝ)) 0) :=
      isEmpty_face_mapper pointHeight _ 0
    exact ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero
      (isZero_simplicialHomology_of_isEmpty_face ℚ 0)
  · rw [structureMap_mapperHomologyPModule]
    change mapperHomologyMap ℚ edgeHeight
      (cappedCentredRefinement 0 1 edgeLabels edgeGrid
        ((cellIndex edgeGrid).monotone h)) 0 ≠ 0
    obtain ⟨a⟩ := by simpa [t] using edgeQuarterComponent
    exact mapperHomologyMap_zero_ne_zero ℚ _ a

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedMapPairExamples.boolToUnit_noHeightMapPair
statement:
private theorem boolToUnit_noHeightMapPair :
    ∀ δ : ℝ≥0, ¬ Nonempty (HeightMapPair boolZeroHeight unitZeroHeight δ)
proof:
:= by
  intro δ ⟨P⟩
  have htrue : P.ψ (P.φ true) = true := by
    obtain ⟨γ, _⟩ := P.hψφ true
    have hc := PreconnectedSpace.constant inferInstance γ.continuous (x := 0) (y := 1)
    simpa using hc
  have hfalse : P.ψ (P.φ false) = false := by
    obtain ⟨γ, _⟩ := P.hψφ false
    have hc := PreconnectedSpace.constant inferInstance γ.continuous (x := 0) (y := 1)
    simpa using hc
  have hcomp : P.ψ (P.φ true) = P.ψ (P.φ false) :=
    congrArg P.ψ (Subsingleton.elim (P.φ true) (P.φ false))
  exact Bool.false_ne_true (htrue.symm.trans (hcomp.trans hfalse)).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyCappedMapPairExamples.bool_to_unit_path_condition_needed
statement:
theorem bool_to_unit_path_condition_needed :
    (∀ b, unitZeroHeight (boolToUnit b) = boolZeroHeight b) ∧
      (∀ u, boolZeroHeight (unitToBool u) = unitZeroHeight u) ∧
      (∀ δ : ℝ≥0, ¬ Nonempty (HeightMapPair boolZeroHeight unitZeroHeight δ)) ∧
      bottleneck
        (cappedCentredDiagram ℚ boolZeroHeight 0 1 (fun _ : Unit => 0) quarterGrid 0)
        (cappedCentredDiagram ℚ unitZeroHeight 0 1 (fun _ : Unit => 0) quarterGrid 0) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, boolToUnit_noHeightMapPair, ?_⟩
  apply le_antisymm le_top
  by_contra htop
  have hne : bottleneck
      (cappedCentredDiagram ℚ boolZeroHeight 0 1 (fun _ : Unit => 0) quarterGrid 0)
      (cappedCentredDiagram ℚ unitZeroHeight 0 1 (fun _ : Unit => 0) quarterGrid 0) ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro heq
    exact htop (heq ▸ le_rfl)
  have hfinite := lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hne
  have hcount := (bottleneck_lt_top_iff _ _).mp hfinite
  rw [boolEssentialCount, unitEssentialCount] at hcount
  norm_num at hcount

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.exterior_segment
statement:
theorem exterior_segment (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (k : Fin m)
    (hk : (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∉ Icc (S.value 0) (S.value (Fin.last n))) :
    T.value k.succ ≤ S.value 0 ∨ S.value (Fin.last n) ≤ T.value k.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀⟩ := hST ⟨0, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨iₙ, hiₙ⟩ := hST ⟨Fin.last n, rfl⟩
  have hleft : T.value k.castSucc < (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) := (RGraph.basePt T k).2.1
  have hright : (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) < T.value k.succ := (RGraph.basePt T k).2.2
  by_cases hbelow : (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) < S.value 0
  · left
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hlt
    apply T.value_notMem_K k i₀
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hleft.trans (hbelow.trans_eq hi₀.symm)
    · exact hi₀.trans_lt hlt
  · right
    have habove : S.value (Fin.last n) < (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) := by
      apply lt_of_not_ge
      intro hle
      exact hk ⟨le_of_not_gt hbelow, hle⟩
    apply le_of_not_gt
    intro hlt
    apply T.value_notMem_K k iₙ
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hlt.trans_eq hiₙ.symm
    · exact hiₙ.trans_lt (habove.trans hright)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.edgeCrosses_iff_span_of_mem_K
statement:
private theorem edgeCrosses_iff_span_of_mem_K (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (e : Fin n)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : c ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (x : G.edgeSet) :
    EdgeCrosses G h c x ↔
      EdgeSpans G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := exists_dartEdge_eq x
  rw [edgeCrosses_dartEdge_iff, edgeSpans_dartEdge_iff]
  have hK := S.mem_K.1 hc
  constructor
  · intro hcross
    have hmin : min (h d.fst) (h d.snd) ≤ S.value e.castSucc := by
      by_contra ha
      have ha' : S.value e.castSucc < min (h d.fst) (h d.snd) := lt_of_not_ge ha
      rcases min_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm
      · exact hS.notMem_K e d.fst
          ⟨ha'.trans_eq hm, hm.symm.trans_lt (hcross.1.trans hK.2)⟩
      · exact hS.notMem_K e d.snd
          ⟨ha'.trans_eq hm, hm.symm.trans_lt (hcross.1.trans hK.2)⟩
    have hmax : S.value e.succ ≤ max (h d.fst) (h d.snd) := by
      by_contra hb
      have hb' : max (h d.fst) (h d.snd) < S.value e.succ := lt_of_not_ge hb
      rcases max_choice (h d.fst) (h d.snd) with hm | hm
      · exact hS.notMem_K e d.fst
          ⟨hK.1.trans (hcross.2.trans_eq hm), hm.symm.trans_lt hb'⟩
      · exact hS.notMem_K e d.snd
          ⟨hK.1.trans (hcross.2.trans_eq hm), hm.symm.trans_lt hb'⟩
    exact ⟨hmin, hmax⟩
  · rintro ⟨hmin, hmax⟩
    exact ⟨hmin.trans_lt hK.1, hK.2.trans_le hmax⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK_inr

@[simp]
theorem levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK_inr (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (e : Fin n)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : c ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (y : {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h c e}) :
    levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e hc (Sum.inr y) =
      ⟨y.1, (edgeCrosses_iff_span_of_mem_K G h hS e hc y.1).mp y.2⟩
proof: := rfl

theorem spanEdgeEquivOfSubset_apply_coe (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (e : Fin n)
    {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p < q)
    (hsub : Icc p q ⊆ Icc (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ))
    (y : SpanEdge G h p q) :
    ((spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e hpq hsub y :
      SpanEdge G h (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ)) : G.edgeSet) = y.1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.isEmpty_levelVertex_of_notMem_Icc
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : IsEmpty (G.induce {v | h v = c}).ConnectedComponent :=
    ⟨fun z => by
      induction z using ConnectedComponent.ind with
      | h v =>
        have hvc : h v.1 = c := v.2
        have hv := mem_hull_of_covers (S := S) (h := h) hS v.1
        rw [hvc] at hv
        exact hc hv⟩
  have hcross : IsEmpty {e : G.edgeSet // EdgeCrosses G h c e} :=
    ⟨fun z => by
      rcases z.2 with ⟨d, _, hmin, hmax⟩
      have hfst := mem_hull_of_covers (S := S) (h := h) hS d.fst
      have hsnd := mem_hull_of_covers (S := S) (h := h) hS d.snd
      apply hc
      exact ⟨((le_min hfst.1 hsnd.1).trans_lt hmin).le,
        (hmax.trans_le (max_le hfst.2 hsnd.2)).le⟩⟩
  exact ⟨fun z => by
    cases z with
    | inl z => exact hcomp.false z
    | inr z => exact hcross.false z⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.isEmpty_spanEdge_of_exterior
statement:
theorem isEmpty_spanEdge_of_exterior (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p < q)
    (hout : q ≤ S.value 0 ∨ S.value (Fin.last n) ≤ p) :
    IsEmpty (SpanEdge G h p q)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨fun z => by
    rcases z.2 with ⟨d, _, hmin, hmax⟩
    have hfst := mem_hull_of_covers (S := S) (h := h) hS d.fst
    have hsnd := mem_hull_of_covers (S := S) (h := h) hS d.snd
    have hlow : S.value 0 ≤ min (h d.fst) (h d.snd) := le_min hfst.1 hsnd.1
    have hupp : max (h d.fst) (h d.snd) ≤ S.value (Fin.last n) :=
      max_le hfst.2 hsnd.2
    rcases hout with hout | hout
    · exact (not_lt_of_ge (hlow.trans hmin)) (hpq.trans_le hout)
    · exact (not_lt_of_ge hout) (hpq.trans_le (hmax.trans hupp))⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.value_exterior_of_not_old_not_gap
statement:
private theorem value_exterior_of_not_old_not_gap
    (j : Fin (m + 1))
    (hi : ¬ ∃ i, T.value j = S.value i)
    (he : ¬ ∃ e, T.value j ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)) :
    T.value j ∉ Icc (S.value 0) (S.value (Fin.last n))
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  obtain ⟨e, he'⟩ := CriticalValues.exists_mem_K_of_mem_Icc hx (fun i h => hi ⟨i, h.symm⟩)
  exact he ⟨e, he'⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.basePt_exterior_of_not_gap
statement:
private theorem basePt_exterior_of_not_gap

    (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∉ Icc (S.value 0) (S.value (Fin.last n))

  intro hx
  obtain ⟨e, he'⟩ := CriticalValues.exists_mem_K_of_mem_Icc hx
    (fun i h => RGraph.value_ne hST (RGraph.basePt T k).2 i h)
  exact he ⟨e, he'⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.endpoint_mem_K_left
statement:
private theorem endpoint_mem_K_left
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (k : Fin m) (e : Fin n)

:= by

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineV_old
statement:
private theorem graphPLRefineV_old [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : T.value j = S.value i) (x : LevelVertex G h (T.value j)) :
    graphPLRefineV G h hS hST j x =
      (RGraph.refineVEquivOld hST (graphPLReebData G h S) j i hi).symm
        (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hi x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold graphPLRefineV
  rw [dif_pos ⟨i, hi⟩]
  have hchoose : Classical.choose (⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, T.value j = S.value i) = i := by
    apply S.strictMono.injective
    calc
      S.value (Classical.choose (⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, T.value j = S.value i)) = T.value j :=
        (Classical.choose_spec (⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, T.value j = S.value i)).symm
      _ = S.value i := hi
  have key : ∀ (i' : Fin (n + 1)) (hi' : T.value j = S.value i'), i' = i →
      (RGraph.refineVEquivOld hST (graphPLReebData G h S) j i' hi').symm
          (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hi' x) =
        (RGraph.refineVEquivOld hST (graphPLReebData G h S) j i hi).symm
          (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hi x) := by
    rintro _ _ rfl
    rfl
  exact key _ _ hchoose

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineV_inserted
statement:
private theorem graphPLRefineV_inserted [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (e : Fin n)
    (he : T.value j ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (x : LevelVertex G h (T.value j)) :
    graphPLRefineV G h hS hST j x =
      (RGraph.refineVEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) j e he).symm
        (levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e he x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnot : ¬ ∃ i, T.value j = S.value i := by
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact S.value_notMem_K e i (hi ▸ he)
  unfold graphPLRefineV
  rw [dif_neg hnot, dif_pos ⟨e, he⟩]
  have hchoose : Classical.choose (⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, T.value j ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)) = e := by
    exact S.eq_of_mem_K_of_mem_Icc
      (Classical.choose_spec (⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, T.value j ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)))
      (Ioo_subset_Icc_self he)
  have key : ∀ (e' : Fin n) (he' : T.value j ∈ (S.K e' : Set ℝ)), e' = e →
      (RGraph.refineVEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) j e' he').symm
          (levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e' he' x) =
        (RGraph.refineVEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) j e he).symm
          (levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e he x) := by
    rintro _ _ rfl
    rfl
  exact key _ _ hchoose

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineE_mem
statement:
private theorem graphPLRefineE_mem [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (k : Fin m) (e : Fin n)
    (he : (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (y : SpanEdge G h (T.value k.castSucc) (T.value k.succ)) :
    graphPLRefineE G h hS hST k y =
      (RGraph.refineEEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k e he).symm
        (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
          (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold graphPLRefineE
  rw [dif_pos ⟨e, he⟩]
  have hchoose : Classical.choose
      (⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)) = e := by
    exact S.eq_of_mem_K_of_mem_Icc
      (Classical.choose_spec
        (⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e, (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)))
      (Ioo_subset_Icc_self he)
  have key : ∀ (e' : Fin n) (he' : (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e' : Set ℝ)), e' = e →
      (RGraph.refineEEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k e' he').symm
          (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e' (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
            (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he') y) =
        (RGraph.refineEEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k e he).symm
          (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
            (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y) := by
    rintro _ _ rfl
    rfl
  exact key _ _ hchoose

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPL_left_old
statement:
private theorem graphPL_left_old [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (k : Fin m) (e : Fin n)
    (he : (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (hi : T.value k.castSucc = S.value e.castSucc)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (T.value k.castSucc) (T.value k.succ)) :
    (graphPLReebData G h S).left e
        (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
          (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y) =
      levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hi ((graphPLReebData G h T).left k y)
proof:
:= by
  let z := spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
    (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y
  have hzcoe : (z.1 : G.edgeSet) = y.1 := by
    exact spanEdgeEquivOfSubset_apply_coe G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
      (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y
  by_cases hv : ∃ v ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 V), h v = T.value k.castSucc
  · obtain ⟨v, hvy, hv⟩ := hv
    have hvz : v ∈ (z.1 : Sym2 V) := by rw [hzcoe]; exact hvy
    have hv' : h v = S.value e.castSucc := hv.trans hi
    rw [graphPLReebData_left_of_mem G h T k y hvy hv,
      graphPLReebData_left_of_mem G h S e z hvz hv']
    rw [levelVertexEquivOfEq_inl]
  · have hvz : ∀ v ∈ (z.1 : Sym2 V), h v ≠ S.value e.castSucc := by
      intro v hvz hv'
      apply hv
      refine ⟨v, ?_, hv'.trans hi.symm⟩
      rw [← hzcoe]
      exact hvz
    rw [graphPLReebData_left_of_forall_ne G h T k y
        (fun v hvy hv' => hv ⟨v, hvy, hv'⟩),
      graphPLReebData_left_of_forall_ne G h S e z hvz]
    rw [levelVertexEquivOfEq_inr]
    rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPL_right_old
statement:
private theorem graphPL_right_old [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (k : Fin m) (e : Fin n)
    (he : (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (hi : T.value k.succ = S.value e.succ)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (T.value k.castSucc) (T.value k.succ)) :
    (graphPLReebData G h S).right e
        (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
          (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y) =
      levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hi ((graphPLReebData G h T).right k y)
proof:
:= by
  let z := spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
    (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y
  have hzcoe : (z.1 : G.edgeSet) = y.1 := by
    exact spanEdgeEquivOfSubset_apply_coe G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
      (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y
  by_cases hv : ∃ v ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 V), h v = T.value k.succ
  · obtain ⟨v, hvy, hv⟩ := hv
    have hvz : v ∈ (z.1 : Sym2 V) := by rw [hzcoe]; exact hvy
    have hv' : h v = S.value e.succ := hv.trans hi
    rw [graphPLReebData_right_of_mem G h T k y hvy hv,
      graphPLReebData_right_of_mem G h S e z hvz hv']
    rw [levelVertexEquivOfEq_inl]
  · have hvz : ∀ v ∈ (z.1 : Sym2 V), h v ≠ S.value e.succ := by
      intro v hvz hv'
      apply hv
      refine ⟨v, ?_, hv'.trans hi.symm⟩
      rw [← hzcoe]
      exact hvz
    rw [graphPLReebData_right_of_forall_ne G h T k y
        (fun v hvy hv' => hv ⟨v, hvy, hv'⟩),
      graphPLReebData_right_of_forall_ne G h S e z hvz]
    rw [levelVertexEquivOfEq_inr]
    rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.refineEEquiv_graphPLRefineE
statement:
private theorem refineEEquiv_graphPLRefineE [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (k : Fin m) (e : Fin n)
    (he : (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (y : SpanEdge G h (T.value k.castSucc) (T.value k.succ)) :
    RGraph.refineEEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k e he
        (graphPLRefineE G h hS hST k y) =
      (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
        (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y :
        (graphPLReebData G h S).E e)
proof:
:= by
  exact
    (congrArg (RGraph.refineEEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k e he)
      (graphPLRefineE_mem G h hS hST k e he y)).trans
      (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefine_left_comm
statement:
private theorem graphPLRefine_left_comm [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (k : Fin m)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (T.value k.castSucc) (T.value k.succ)) :
    (RGraph.refineData hST (graphPLReebData G h S)).left k
        (graphPLRefineE G h hS hST k y) =
      graphPLRefineV G h hS hST k.castSucc ((graphPLReebData G h T).left k y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbase : ∃ e, (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hbase
    by_cases hold : ∃ i, T.value k.castSucc = S.value i
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hold
      have hindex := RGraph.old_level_castSucc hST k e he i hi
      subst i
      apply (RGraph.refineVEquivOld hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k.castSucc e.castSucc hi).injective
      refine (RGraph.refine_left_old hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k e he hi _).trans ?_
      refine (congrArg ((graphPLReebData G h S).left e)
        (refineEEquiv_graphPLRefineE G h hS hST k e he y)).trans ?_
      refine (graphPL_left_old G h hS hST k e he hi y).trans ?_
      exact ((congrArg
          (RGraph.refineVEquivOld hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k.castSucc e.castSucc hi)
          (graphPLRefineV_old G h hS hST k.castSucc e.castSucc hi
            ((graphPLReebData G h T).left k y))).trans (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)).symm
    · have he' := endpoint_mem_K_left hST k e he hold
      apply (RGraph.refineVEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k.castSucc e he').injective
      have hne : ∀ v ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 V), h v ≠ T.value k.castSucc := by
        intro v hv hv'
        exact hS.notMem_K e v (by rw [hv']; exact he')
      refine (RGraph.refine_left_eq hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k e he' _).trans ?_
      refine (refineEEquiv_graphPLRefineE G h hS hST k e he y).trans ?_
      refine Eq.trans ?_ ((congrArg
          (RGraph.refineVEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k.castSucc e he')
          (graphPLRefineV_inserted G h hS hST k.castSucc e he'
            ((graphPLReebData G h T).left k y))).trans (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)).symm
      refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e he')
        (graphPLReebData_left_of_forall_ne G h T k y hne)).symm
      refine Eq.trans ?_ (levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK_inr G h hS e he'
        ⟨y.1, y.2.crosses_left (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k) hne⟩).symm
      exact Subtype.ext (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset_apply_coe G h hS e
        (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
        (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y)
  · have hout := basePt_exterior_of_not_gap hST k hbase
    exact ((isEmpty_spanEdge_of_exterior G h hS (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
      (exterior_segment hST k hout)).false y).elim

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefine_right_comm
statement:
private theorem graphPLRefine_right_comm [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (k : Fin m)
    (y : SpanEdge G h (T.value k.castSucc) (T.value k.succ)) :
    (RGraph.refineData hST (graphPLReebData G h S)).right k
        (graphPLRefineE G h hS hST k y) =
      graphPLRefineV G h hS hST k.succ ((graphPLReebData G h T).right k y)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hbase : ∃ e, (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hbase
    by_cases hold : ∃ i, T.value k.succ = S.value i
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hold
      have hindex := RGraph.old_level_succ hST k e he i hi
      subst i
      apply (RGraph.refineVEquivOld hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k.succ e.succ hi).injective
      refine (RGraph.refine_right_old hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k e he hi _).trans ?_
      refine (congrArg ((graphPLReebData G h S).right e)
        (refineEEquiv_graphPLRefineE G h hS hST k e he y)).trans ?_
      refine (graphPL_right_old G h hS hST k e he hi y).trans ?_
      exact ((congrArg
          (RGraph.refineVEquivOld hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k.succ e.succ hi)
          (graphPLRefineV_old G h hS hST k.succ e.succ hi
            ((graphPLReebData G h T).right k y))).trans (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)).symm
    · have he' := endpoint_mem_K_right hST k e he hold
      apply (RGraph.refineVEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k.succ e he').injective
      have hne : ∀ v ∈ (y.1 : Sym2 V), h v ≠ T.value k.succ := by
        intro v hv hv'
        exact hS.notMem_K e v (by rw [hv']; exact he')
      refine (RGraph.refine_right_eq hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k e he' _).trans ?_
      refine (refineEEquiv_graphPLRefineE G h hS hST k e he y).trans ?_
      refine Eq.trans ?_ ((congrArg
          (RGraph.refineVEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k.succ e he')
          (graphPLRefineV_inserted G h hS hST k.succ e he'
            ((graphPLReebData G h T).right k y))).trans (Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)).symm
      refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e he')
        (graphPLReebData_right_of_forall_ne G h T k y hne)).symm
      refine Eq.trans ?_ (levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK_inr G h hS e he'
        ⟨y.1, y.2.crosses_right (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k) hne⟩).symm
      exact Subtype.ext (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset_apply_coe G h hS e
        (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
        (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y)
  · have hout := basePt_exterior_of_not_gap hST k hbase
    exact ((isEmpty_spanEdge_of_exterior G h hS (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
      (exterior_segment hST k hout)).false y).elim

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineHom_v_old
statement:
theorem graphPLRefineHom_v_old [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : T.value j = S.value i) (x : LevelVertex G h (T.value j)) :
    (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST).v j x =
      (RGraph.refineVEquivOld hST (graphPLReebData G h S) j i hi).symm
        (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hi x)
proof:
:= by
  change graphPLRefineV G h hS hST j x = _
  exact graphPLRefineV_old G h hS hST j i hi x

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineHom_v_inserted
statement:
theorem graphPLRefineHom_v_inserted [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (e : Fin n)
    (he : T.value j ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (x : LevelVertex G h (T.value j)) :
    (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST).v j x =
      (RGraph.refineVEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) j e he).symm
        (levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e he x)

:= by
