name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineHom_e
statement:
theorem graphPLRefineHom_e [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (k : Fin m) (e : Fin n)
    (he : (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (y : SpanEdge G h (T.value k.castSucc) (T.value k.succ)) :
    (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST).e k y =
      (RGraph.refineEEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k e he).symm
        (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
          (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y)
proof:
:= by
  change graphPLRefineE G h hS hST k y = _
  exact graphPLRefineE_mem G h hS hST k e he y

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineHom_bijective_v
statement:
theorem graphPLRefineHom_bijective_v [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    Function.Bijective ((graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST).v j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hi : ∃ i, T.value j = S.value i
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hi
    have hgap : ¬ ∃ e, T.value j ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) := by
      rintro ⟨e, he⟩
      exact S.value_notMem_K e i (hi ▸ he)
    have hfun : (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST).v j =
        (RGraph.refineVEquivOld hST (graphPLReebData G h S) j i hi).symm ∘
          levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hi := by
      funext x
      exact graphPLRefineHom_v_old G h hS hST j i hi x
    rw [hfun]
    exact (RGraph.refineVEquivOld hST (graphPLReebData G h S) j i hi).symm.bijective.comp
      (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hi).bijective
  · by_cases he : ∃ e, T.value j ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)
    · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := he
      have hfun : (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST).v j =
          (RGraph.refineVEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) j e he).symm ∘
            levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e he := by
        funext x
        exact graphPLRefineHom_v_inserted G h hS hST j e he x
      rw [hfun]
      exact (RGraph.refineVEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) j e he).symm.bijective.comp
        (levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e he).bijective
    · have hout := value_exterior_of_not_old_not_gap (S := S) (T := T) j hi he
      have hEmpty1 : IsEmpty ((graphPLReebData G h T).V j) := by
        change IsEmpty (LevelVertex G h (T.value j))
        exact isEmpty_levelVertex_of_notMem_Icc G h hS hout
      have hEmpty2 :
          IsEmpty ((RGraph.refineData hST (graphPLReebData G h S)).V j) :=
        RGraph.isEmpty_refine_V hST (graphPLReebData G h S) j hout
      exact ⟨fun x => (hEmpty1.false x).elim, fun y => (hEmpty2.false y).elim⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineHom_bijective_e
statement:
theorem graphPLRefineHom_bijective_e [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (k : Fin m) :
    Function.Bijective ((graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST).e k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases he : ∃ e, (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := he
    have hfun : (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST).e k =
        (RGraph.refineEEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k e he).symm ∘
          spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
            (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) := by
      funext y
      exact graphPLRefineHom_e G h hS hST k e he y
    rw [hfun]
    exact (RGraph.refineEEquiv hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k e he).symm.bijective.comp
      (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
        (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he)).bijective
  · have hout := basePt_exterior_of_not_gap hST k he
    have hEmpty1 : IsEmpty ((graphPLReebData G h T).E k) := by
      change IsEmpty (SpanEdge G h (T.value k.castSucc) (T.value k.succ))
      exact isEmpty_spanEdge_of_exterior G h hS (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
        (exterior_segment hST k hout)
    have hEmpty2 :
        IsEmpty ((RGraph.refineData hST (graphPLReebData G h S)).E k) :=
      RGraph.isEmpty_refine_E hST (graphPLReebData G h S) k hout
    exact ⟨fun x => (hEmpty1.false x).elim, fun y => (hEmpty2.false y).elim⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineIso_hom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem graphPLRefineIso_hom [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) :
    (graphPLRefineIso G h hS hST).hom = graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineHom_v_val_old
statement:
private theorem graphPLRefineHom_v_val_old [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : T.value j = S.value i) (x : LevelVertex G h (T.value j)) :
    ((graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST).v j x).1 =
      (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofVertex S i
        (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hi x)
proof:
:= by
  exact
    (congrArg Subtype.val (graphPLRefineHom_v_old G h hS hST j i hi x)).trans
      (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.criticalFiberHomeomorph_apply S
        (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)) i
        (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hi x))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineHom_v_val_inserted
statement:
private theorem graphPLRefineHom_v_val_inserted [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (j : Fin (m + 1)) (e : Fin n)
    (he : T.value j ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (x : LevelVertex G h (T.value j)) :
    ((graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST).v j x).1 =
      (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e
        (levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e he x, ⟨_, he⟩)
proof:
:= by
  exact
    (congrArg Subtype.val (graphPLRefineHom_v_inserted G h hS hST j e he x)).trans
      (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.regularFiberHomeomorph_apply S
        (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)) e ⟨_, he⟩
        (levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e he x))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineHom_e_val
statement:
private theorem graphPLRefineHom_e_val [Finite V]
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value) (k : Fin m) (e : Fin n)
    (he : (RGraph.basePt T k : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (y : SpanEdge G h (T.value k.castSucc) (T.value k.succ)) :
    ((graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST).e k y).1 =
      (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e
        (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
          (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y,
          ⟨_, he⟩)
proof:
:= by
  exact
    (congrArg Subtype.val (graphPLRefineHom_e G h hS hST k e he y)).trans
      (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.regularFiberHomeomorph_apply S
        (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)) e ⟨_, he⟩
        (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
          (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) k) he) y))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelVertexEquivOfEq_trans
statement:
private theorem levelVertexEquivOfEq_trans {c c' c'' : ℝ}
    (h₁ : c = c') (h₂ : c' = c'') (h₃ : c = c'') (x : LevelVertex G h c) :
    levelVertexEquivOfEq G h h₃ x =
      levelVertexEquivOfEq G h h₂ (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h h₁ x)
proof:
:= by
  subst c'
  subst c''
  rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.levelVertexEquivSpan_transport
statement:
private theorem levelVertexEquivSpan_transport (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h) (e : Fin n)
    {c c' : ℝ} (hcc : c = c') (hc : c ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ))
    (hc' : c' ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)) (x : LevelVertex G h c) :
    levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e hc'
        (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hcc x) =
      levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e hc x
proof:
:= by
  subst c'
  apply Subtype.ext
  cases x with
  | inl z =>
      induction z using SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.ind with
      | h v => exact (hS.notMem_K e v.1 (by rw [v.2]; exact hc)).elim
  | inr y => simp

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.refineMap_realizeHom_ofVertex
statement:
private theorem refineMap_realizeHom_ofVertex [Finite V] {D : FiniteReebData.{u} n}
    {S : CriticalValues n} {T : CriticalValues m}
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value)
    (φ : graphPLReebData G h T ⟶ RGraph.refineData hST D)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) (z : (graphPLReebData G h T).V i) :
    RGraph.refineMap hST D
        (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.realizeHom T φ
          ((TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h T)).ofVertex T i z)) =
      ((φ.v i z).1)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.refineMap_realizeHom_ofStrip
statement:
private theorem refineMap_realizeHom_ofStrip [Finite V] {D : FiniteReebData.{u} n}
    {S : CriticalValues n} {T : CriticalValues m}
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value)
    (φ : graphPLReebData G h T ⟶ RGraph.refineData hST D)
    (k : Fin m) (z : (graphPLReebData G h T).E k) (t : (T.K k : Set ℝ)) :
    RGraph.refineMap hST D
        (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.realizeHom T φ
          ((TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h T)).ofStrip T k
            (z, t))) =
      RGraph.edgePoint hST D k (φ.e k z) (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.gapIncl T k t)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineHom_trans_v
statement:
theorem graphPLRefineHom_trans_v
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value)
    (hTU : Set.range T.value ⊆ Set.range U.value)
    (hSU : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range U.value)
    (j : Fin (l + 1)) (x : LevelVertex G h (U.value j)) :
    ((graphPLRefineHom G h hS hSU).v j x).1 =
      RGraph.refineMap hST (graphPLReebData G h S)
        (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.realizeHom T
          (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST)
          ((graphPLRefineHom G h (hS.mono hST) hTU).v j x).1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hUT : ∃ i, U.value j = T.value i
  · obtain ⟨iT, hiT⟩ := hUT
    by_cases hUS : ∃ i, U.value j = S.value i
    · obtain ⟨iS, hiS⟩ := hUS
      have hiST : T.value iT = S.value iS := hiT.symm.trans hiS
      refine (graphPLRefineHom_v_val_old G h hS hSU j iS hiS x).trans ?_
      refine (congrArg
        ((TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofVertex S iS)
        (levelVertexEquivOfEq_trans G h hiT hiST hiS x)).trans ?_
      refine (graphPLRefineHom_v_val_old G h hS hST iT iS hiST
        (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hiT x)).symm.trans ?_
      refine (refineMap_realizeHom_ofVertex G h hST (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST) iT
        (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hiT x)).symm.trans ?_
      exact congrArg
        (fun q : (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData
            (graphPLReebData G h T)).Realization T =>
          RGraph.refineMap hST (graphPLReebData G h S)
            (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.realizeHom T
              (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST) q))
        (graphPLRefineHom_v_val_old G h (hS.mono hST) hTU j iT hiT x).symm
    · by_cases hUSgap : ∃ e, U.value j ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)
      · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hUSgap
        have heT : T.value iT ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) := hiT ▸ he
        have hstrip :
            (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e
                (levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e he x, ⟨_, he⟩) =
              (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e
                (levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e heT
                    (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hiT x), ⟨_, heT⟩) := by
          congr 1
          exact Prod.ext (levelVertexEquivSpan_transport G h hS e hiT he heT x).symm
            (Subtype.ext hiT)
        refine (graphPLRefineHom_v_val_inserted G h hS hSU j e he x).trans ?_
        refine hstrip.trans ?_
        refine (graphPLRefineHom_v_val_inserted G h hS hST iT e heT
          (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hiT x)).symm.trans ?_
        refine (refineMap_realizeHom_ofVertex G h hST (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST) iT
          (levelVertexEquivOfEq G h hiT x)).symm.trans ?_
        exact congrArg
          (fun q : (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData
              (graphPLReebData G h T)).Realization T =>
            RGraph.refineMap hST (graphPLReebData G h S)
              (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.realizeHom T
                (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST) q))
          (graphPLRefineHom_v_val_old G h (hS.mono hST) hTU j iT hiT x).symm
      · have hout := value_exterior_of_not_old_not_gap (S := S) (T := U) j
          hUS hUSgap
        exact ((isEmpty_levelVertex_of_notMem_Icc G h hS hout).false x).elim
  · obtain ⟨kT, hkT⟩ : ∃ k, U.value j ∈ (T.K k : Set ℝ) := by
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpne⟩ := T.exists_piece (U.value j)
      cases p with
      | star i => exact (hUT ⟨i, (hpne i (T.value_mem_J i)).symm⟩).elim
      | gap k => exact ⟨k, hp⟩
      | lowerTail =>
          have houtT : U.value j ∉ Icc (T.value 0) (T.value (Fin.last m)) := by
            intro hx
            exact (not_lt_of_ge hx.1) (T.mem_lowerTail.1 hp)
          exact ((isEmpty_levelVertex_of_notMem_Icc G h (hS.mono hST) houtT).false x).elim
      | upperTail =>
          have houtT : U.value j ∉ Icc (T.value 0) (T.value (Fin.last m)) := by
            intro hx
            exact (not_le_of_gt (T.mem_upperTail.1 hp)) hx.2
          exact ((isEmpty_levelVertex_of_notMem_Icc G h (hS.mono hST) houtT).false x).elim
    by_cases hUS : ∃ i, U.value j = S.value i
    · obtain ⟨iS, hiS⟩ := hUS
      obtain ⟨iT, hiT⟩ := hST ⟨iS, rfl⟩
      exact (T.value_notMem_K kT iT (by rw [hiT, ← hiS]; exact hkT)).elim
    · by_cases hUSgap : ∃ e, U.value j ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)
      · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hUSgap
        have hsub : Icc (T.value kT.castSucc) (T.value kT.succ) ⊆
            Icc (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) :=
          RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hkT) he
        have hebase : (RGraph.basePt T kT : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) :=
          RGraph.mem_K_of_ne (hsub (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) kT))
            (RGraph.value_ne hST (RGraph.basePt T kT).2)
        let zT := levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h (hS.mono hST) kT hkT x
        have hz : levelVertexEquivSpanOfMemK G h hS e he x =
            spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ kT)
              hsub zT := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          cases x with
          | inl w =>
              induction w using SimpleGraph.ConnectedComponent.ind with
              | h v => exact (hS.notMem_K e v.1 (by rw [v.2]; exact he)).elim
          | inr w => rfl
        refine (graphPLRefineHom_v_val_inserted G h hS hSU j e he x).trans ?_
        refine Eq.trans ?_
          (congrArg
            (fun q : (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData
                (graphPLReebData G h T)).Realization T =>
              RGraph.refineMap hST (graphPLReebData G h S)
                (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.realizeHom T
                  (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST) q))
            (graphPLRefineHom_v_val_inserted G h (hS.mono hST) hTU j kT hkT x).symm)
        refine Eq.trans ?_
          (refineMap_realizeHom_ofStrip G h hST (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST) kT zT
            (⟨_, hkT⟩ : (T.K kT : Set ℝ))).symm
        have hy := graphPLRefineHom_e_val G h hS hST kT e hebase zT
        refine Eq.trans ?_
          (RGraph.edgePoint_eq hST (graphPLReebData G h S) kT
            ((graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST).e kT zT)
            (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ kT) hsub zT)
            hebase hy
            (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.gapIncl T kT (⟨_, hkT⟩ : (T.K kT : Set ℝ)))).symm
        refine (congrArg
          (fun z : (graphPLReebData G h S).E e =>
            (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e
              (z, ⟨_, he⟩)) hz).trans ?_
        rfl
      · have hout := value_exterior_of_not_old_not_gap (S := S) (T := U) j hUS hUSgap
        exact ((isEmpty_levelVertex_of_notMem_Icc G h hS hout).false x).elim

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.graphPLRefineHom_trans_e
statement:
theorem graphPLRefineHom_trans_e
    (hS : CoversVertexHeights S h)
    (hST : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range T.value)
    (hTU : Set.range T.value ⊆ Set.range U.value)
    (hSU : Set.range S.value ⊆ Set.range U.value)
    (k : Fin l) (y : SpanEdge G h (U.value k.castSucc) (U.value k.succ)) :
    ((graphPLRefineHom G h hS hSU).e k y).1 =
      RGraph.refineMap hST (graphPLReebData G h S)
        (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.realizeHom T
          (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST)
          ((graphPLRefineHom G h (hS.mono hST) hTU).e k y).1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hUT : ∃ k', (RGraph.basePt U k : ℝ) ∈ (T.K k' : Set ℝ)
  · obtain ⟨kT, hkT⟩ := hUT
    by_cases hUS : ∃ e, (RGraph.basePt U k : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ)
    · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hUS
      have hsub : Icc (T.value kT.castSucc) (T.value kT.succ) ⊆
          Icc (S.value e.castSucc) (S.value e.succ) :=
        RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hST (Ioo_subset_Icc_self hkT) he
      have hebase : (RGraph.basePt T kT : ℝ) ∈ (S.K e : Set ℝ) :=
        RGraph.mem_K_of_ne (hsub (basePt_mem_Icc (T := T) kT))
          (RGraph.value_ne hST (RGraph.basePt T kT).2)
      let zT := spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h (hS.mono hST) kT
        (U.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
        (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hTU (basePt_mem_Icc (T := U) k) hkT) y
      let zS := spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (U.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
        (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hSU (basePt_mem_Icc (T := U) k) he) y
      have hzcoe : (zT : G.edgeSet) = (y : G.edgeSet) := by
        exact spanEdgeEquivOfSubset_apply_coe G h (hS.mono hST) kT
          (U.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
          (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hTU (basePt_mem_Icc (T := U) k) hkT) y
      have hz : zS = spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ kT) hsub zT := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset_apply_coe G h hS e (U.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
          (RGraph.Icc_subset_of_mem hSU (basePt_mem_Icc (T := U) k) he) y).trans
          ((spanEdgeEquivOfSubset_apply_coe G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ kT)
            hsub zT).symm.trans hzcoe)
      refine (graphPLRefineHom_e_val G h hS hSU k e he y).trans ?_
      refine Eq.trans ?_
        (congrArg
          (fun q : (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData
              (graphPLReebData G h T)).Realization T =>
            RGraph.refineMap hST (graphPLReebData G h S)
              (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.realizeHom T
                (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST) q))
          (graphPLRefineHom_e_val G h (hS.mono hST) hTU k kT hkT y).symm)
      refine Eq.trans ?_
        (refineMap_realizeHom_ofStrip G h hST (graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST) kT zT
          (⟨_, hkT⟩ : (T.K kT : Set ℝ))).symm
      have hy := graphPLRefineHom_e_val G h hS hST kT e hebase zT
      refine Eq.trans ?_
        (RGraph.edgePoint_eq hST (graphPLReebData G h S) kT
          ((graphPLRefineHom G h hS hST).e kT zT)
          (spanEdgeEquivOfSubset G h hS e (T.value_castSucc_lt_succ kT) hsub zT)
          hebase hy
          (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.gapIncl T kT (⟨_, hkT⟩ : (T.K kT : Set ℝ)))).symm
      refine (congrArg
        (fun z : (graphPLReebData G h S).E e =>
          (TDA.Reeb.CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData (graphPLReebData G h S)).ofStrip S e
            (z, ⟨_, he⟩)) hz).trans ?_
      rfl
    · have hout := basePt_exterior_of_not_gap hSU k hUS
      exact ((isEmpty_spanEdge_of_exterior G h hS (U.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
        (exterior_segment hSU k hout)).false y).elim
  · have hout := basePt_exterior_of_not_gap hTU k hUT
    exact ((isEmpty_spanEdge_of_exterior G h (hS.mono hST) (U.value_castSucc_lt_succ k)
      (exterior_segment hTU k hout)).false y).elim

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.range_vertexHeightLevels_subset
statement:
theorem range_vertexHeightLevels_subset [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (hcov : CoversVertexHeights T h) :
    Set.range (vertexHeightLevels h).value ⊆ Set.range T.value
proof:
:= by
  rw [range_vertexHeightLevels h]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hx
  exact hcov v

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebExtremalExamples.sup'_bool
statement:
private theorem sup'_bool (f : Bool → ℝ) :
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty f = max (f false) (f true)
proof:
:= by
  simp
  exact max_comm _ _

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebExtremalExamples.inf'_bool
statement:
private theorem inf'_bool (f : Bool → ℝ) :

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebExtremalExamples.tilted_widened_geometricInterleavingDistance
statement:
theorem tilted_widened_geometricInterleavingDistance :
    Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty tilted = Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty widened ∧
      geometricInterleavingDistance (graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph tilted)
        (graphPLReebGraph edgeGraph widened) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hedist : edist tilted widened = 1 := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine edist_pi_le_iff.2 fun b => ?_
      cases b <;> norm_num [tilted, widened, edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
    · calc (1 : ℝ≥0∞) = edist (tilted false) (widened false) := by
            norm_num [tilted, widened, edist_dist, Real.dist_eq]
        _ ≤ edist tilted widened := edist_le_pi_edist tilted widened false
  refine ⟨by simp [tilted, widened], ?_⟩
  rw [← hedist]
  apply geometricInterleavingDistance_graphPLReebGraph_eq_edist_of_inf'
  rw [hedist, inf'_bool, inf'_bool]
  norm_num [tilted, widened]

  · intro h

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyDomainMapExamples.mk_levelPoint₁_ne_mk_levelPoint₃
statement:
theorem mk_levelPoint₁_ne_mk_levelPoint₃ :
    (ZerothHomotopy.mk levelPoint₁ : ZerothHomotopy (ClosedLevel cycle4 cycleHeight 1)) ≠
      ZerothHomotopy.mk levelPoint₃
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h₁ := closedLevelComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex cycle4 cycleHeight 1 cycleHeight_one
  have h₃ := closedLevelComponentsEquiv_mk_vertex cycle4 cycleHeight 3 cycleHeight_three
  have h' := h₁.symm.trans ((congrArg (closedLevelComponentsEquiv cycle4 cycleHeight 1) h).trans
    h₃)
  have hreach := (ConnectedComponent.eq.1 (Sum.inl.inj h'))
  have hbot : cycle4.induce {v | cycleHeight v = 1} = ⊥ := by
    ext a b
    simp only [comap_adj, Function.Embedding.coe_subtype, bot_adj, iff_false]
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := b
    change cycleHeight a = 1 at ha
    change cycleHeight b = 1 at hb
    have hlevel : ∀ v : Fin 4, cycleHeight v = 1 → v = 1 ∨ v = 3 := by
      intro v hv
      fin_cases v <;> simp_all [cycleHeight]
    have hna : ∀ a b : Fin 4, (a = 1 ∨ a = 3) → (b = 1 ∨ b = 3) → ¬ cycle4.Adj a b := by
      decide
    exact hna a b (hlevel a ha) (hlevel b hb)
  rw [hbot, reachable_bot] at hreach
  have := congrArg Subtype.val hreach
  exact absurd this (by decide)

      domainIndexMap (f := plHeight cycle4 cycleHeight) (f' := plHeight cycle4 cycleHeight)
        (realizationMap reflection.toHom)
        (plHeight_realizationHomeomorph reflection cycleHeight_reflection) levelOne
        ⟨(), ZerothHomotopy.mk levelPoint₁⟩ ≠ ⟨(), ZerothHomotopy.mk levelPoint₁⟩
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rfl, fun h => ?_⟩
  have h' : (ZerothHomotopy.mk levelPoint₃ : ZerothHomotopy (ClosedLevel cycle4 cycleHeight 1)) =
      ZerothHomotopy.mk levelPoint₁ := eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj h).2

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyDomainMapExamples.card_endpoint_components
statement:

    Nat.card (ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace endpointHeight wholeLine ())) = 2
proof:
:= by
  let q : Bool → ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace endpointHeight wholeLine ()) :=
    fun b => ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨b, trivial⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective q := by
    intro a b hab
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨p⟩ := Quotient.exact hab
    have hc : Continuous fun t => (p t).1 := continuous_subtype_val.comp p.continuous
    have := PreconnectedSpace.constant inferInstance hc (x := 0) (y := 1)
    simp at this
    exact hne this
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective q := by
    intro c
    induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x => exact ⟨x.1, rfl⟩
  rw [← Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective q ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩)]
  simp

statement:
theorem endpoints_homologyDomainMap_not_injective :
    Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology (mapper endpointHeight wholeLine) ℚ 0) = 2 ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ (simplicialHomology (mapper intervalHeight wholeLine) ℚ 0) = 1 ∧
      ¬ Function.Injective
        (mapperHomologyDomainMap (f := endpointHeight) (f' := intervalHeight) ℚ endpoints
          (fun _ => rfl) wholeLine 0).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : Finite (ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace endpointHeight wholeLine ())) :=
    Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [card_endpoint_components]; omega)
  have h1 : Finite (ZerothHomotopy (PullbackSpace intervalHeight wholeLine ())) :=
    Nat.finite_of_card_ne_zero (by rw [card_interval_components]; omega)
  have hsrc := finrank_zeroHomology endpointHeight
  have htgt := finrank_zeroHomology intervalHeight
  rw [card_endpoint_components] at hsrc
  rw [card_interval_components] at htgt
  refine ⟨hsrc, htgt, fun hinj => ?_⟩
  have : Module.Finite ℚ (simplicialHomology (mapper intervalHeight wholeLine) ℚ 0) :=
    Module.finite_of_finrank_pos (by omega)
  have := LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hinj
  omega

name: TDA.Mapper.coverComponents_memberAgreementAt
statement:
theorem coverComponents_memberAgreementAt (i : ι) (k l : κ) (y : ℝ)
    (hyU : y ∈ U i) (hyk : y ∈ K k) (hyl : y ∈ K l)
    (c : (intervalComponents f).obj (U i)) :
    a k (memberToCoverComponents f U K i k ⟨y, hyU, hyk⟩ c) =
      a l (memberToCoverComponents f U K i l ⟨y, hyU, hyl⟩ c)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
  | mk x =>
    exact ha k l (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x.val,
      mem_coverSaturation.mpr ⟨i, x.property, y, hyU, hyk, hyl⟩⟩)

name: TDA.Mapper.coverComponents_memberAgreement
statement:
theorem coverComponents_memberAgreement {J : OpenInterval}
    (hJ : ⋃ k, (K k : Set ℝ) = J) (i : ι) (k l : κ)
    (hk : ((U i : Set ℝ) ∩ K k).Nonempty)
    (hl : ((U i : Set ℝ) ∩ K l).Nonempty)
    (c : (intervalComponents f).obj (U i)) :
    a k (memberToCoverComponents f U K i k hk c) =
      a l (memberToCoverComponents f U K i l hl c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let W := U i ⊓ J
  have hcover (p : W) : ∃ m, p.val ∈ K m := by
    have hp : p.val ∈ (J : Set ℝ) := p.property.2
    rw [← hJ] at hp
    exact mem_iUnion.mp hp
  let label (p : W) : κ := (hcover p).choose
  have hlabel (p : W) : p.val ∈ K (label p) := (hcover p).choose_spec
  let value (p : W) : A :=
    a (label p) (memberToCoverComponents f U K i (label p)
      ⟨p.val, p.property.1, hlabel p⟩ c)
  have hvalue (p : W) (m : κ) (hm : p.val ∈ K m) :
      value p = a m (memberToCoverComponents f U K i m
        ⟨p.val, p.property.1, hm⟩ c) :=
    coverComponents_memberAgreementAt f U K a ha i (label p) m p.val
      p.property.1 (hlabel p) hm c
  have hlocal : IsLocallyConstant value := by
    rw [IsLocallyConstant.iff_exists_open]
    intro p
    refine ⟨{q : W | q.val ∈ K (label p)},
      (K (label p)).isOpen.preimage continuous_subtype_val, hlabel p, ?_⟩
    intro q hq
    exact (hvalue q (label p) hq).trans (by rfl)
  let : PreconnectedSpace W :=
    isPreconnected_iff_preconnectedSpace.mp (U i ⊓ J).ordConnected.isPreconnected
  obtain ⟨y, hyU, hyk⟩ := hk
  obtain ⟨t, htU, htl⟩ := hl
  let p : W := ⟨y, hyU, le_of_iUnion_eq hJ k hyk⟩
  let q : W := ⟨t, htU, le_of_iUnion_eq hJ l htl⟩
  have hconst : value p = value q :=
    (⟨value, hlocal⟩ : LocallyConstant W A).apply_eq_of_preconnectedSpace p q
  exact (hvalue p k hyk).symm.trans (hconst.trans (hvalue q l htl))

name: TDA.Mapper.coverComponents_existsUnique_glue
statement:
theorem coverComponents_existsUnique_glue {J : OpenInterval}
    (hJ : ⋃ k, (K k : Set ℝ) = J) :
    ∃! g : (coverComponents f U).obj J → A,
      ∀ k (e : (coverComponents f U).obj (K k)),
        g ((coverComponents f U).map (homOfLE (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ k)) e) = a k e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex (i : ActiveCoverMember U J) : ∃ k, ((U i.val : Set ℝ) ∩ K k).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨y, hyU, hyJ⟩ := i.property
    rw [← hJ] at hyJ
    obtain ⟨k, hyk⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hyJ
    exact ⟨k, y, hyU, hyk⟩
  choose test htest using hex
  let b (i : ActiveCoverMember U J) (e : (intervalComponents f).obj (U i.val)) : A :=
    a (test i) (memberToCoverComponents f U K i.val (test i) (htest i) e)
  have hb (i j : ActiveCoverMember U J)
      (e : (componentFunctor f).obj (toOpens (U i.val) ⊓ toOpens (U j.val))) :
      b i ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE inf_le_left) e) =
        b j ((componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE inf_le_right) e) := by
    induction e using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
    | mk x =>
      obtain ⟨y, hyi, hyj, hyJ⟩ := intervalTripleIntersection_nonempty
        (U i.val) (U j.val) J ⟨f x.val, x.property.1, x.property.2⟩ i.property j.property
      change y ∈ (J : Set ℝ) at hyJ
      rw [← hJ] at hyJ
      obtain ⟨k, hyk⟩ := mem_iUnion.mp hyJ
      exact (coverComponents_memberAgreement f U K a ha hJ i.val (test i) k
        (htest i) ⟨y, hyi, hyk⟩ (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x.val, x.property.1⟩)).trans
        (coverComponents_memberAgreement f U K a ha hJ j.val (test j) k
          (htest j) ⟨y, hyj, hyk⟩ (ZerothHomotopy.mk ⟨x.val, x.property.2⟩)).symm
  have hcov : coverSaturation U J ≤ ⨆ i : ActiveCoverMember U J, toOpens (U i.val) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, hxi, y, hyU, hyJ⟩ := mem_coverSaturation.mp hx
    exact TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨⟨i, y, hyU, hyJ⟩, hxi⟩
  obtain ⟨g, hg, huniq⟩ := componentFunctor_existsUnique_glue f
    (fun i : ActiveCoverMember U J => toOpens (U i.val))
    (coverMember_le_saturation U J) hcov b hb
  refine ⟨g, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro k e
    obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := coverComponentGenerator_surjective f U (K k) e
    rcases p with ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, c⟩
    have hiJ : ((U i : Set ℝ) ∩ J).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨y, hyU, hyk⟩ := hi
      exact ⟨y, hyU, le_of_iUnion_eq hJ k hyk⟩
    let j : ActiveCoverMember U J := ⟨i, hiJ⟩
    have hmap : (coverComponents f U).map (homOfLE (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ k))
          (coverComponentGenerator f U (K k) ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, c⟩) =
        (componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE (coverMember_le_saturation U J j)) c := by
      induction c using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
      | mk x => rfl
    rw [hmap, hg j c]
    exact coverComponents_memberAgreement f U K a ha hJ i (test j) k (htest j) hi c
  · intro g' hg'
    apply huniq g'
    intro i e
    have hmap : (componentFunctor f).map (homOfLE (coverMember_le_saturation U J i)) e =
        (coverComponents f U).map (homOfLE (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ (test i)))
          (memberToCoverComponents f U K i.val (test i) (htest i) e) := by
      induction e using ZerothHomotopy.rec with
      | mk x => rfl
    rw [hmap, hg']

name: TDA.Mapper.coverComponents_isIntervalCosheaf
statement: theorem coverComponents_isIntervalCosheaf : IsIntervalCosheaf.{w} (coverComponents f U)
proof:
:= by
  intro κ K J hJ
  let F := coverComponents f U
  let lift (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone
      (CategoryTheory.Pairwise.diagram K ⋙ F)) : F.obj J → c.pt :=
    (coverComponents_existsUnique_glue f U K
      (fun k => c.ι.app (.single k)) (fun k l e => by
        exact (c.w_apply (CategoryTheory.Pairwise.Hom.left k l) e).trans
          (c.w_apply (CategoryTheory.Pairwise.Hom.right k l) e).symm) hJ).choose
  have hfac (c : CategoryTheory.Limits.Cocone (CategoryTheory.Pairwise.diagram K ⋙ F))
      (k : κ) (e : F.obj (K k)) :
      lift c (F.map (homOfLE (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ k)) e) = c.ι.app (.single k) e :=
    (coverComponents_existsUnique_glue f U K
      (fun k => c.ι.app (.single k)) (fun k l e => by
        exact (c.w_apply (CategoryTheory.Pairwise.Hom.left k l) e).trans
          (c.w_apply (CategoryTheory.Pairwise.Hom.right k l) e).symm) hJ).choose_spec.1 k e
  refine ⟨{ desc := fun c => TypeCat.ofHom (lift c), fac := ?_, uniq := ?_ }⟩
  · intro c o
    cases o with
    | single k =>
      ext e
      exact hfac c k e
    | pair k l =>
      ext e
      have he := hfac c k (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) e)
      have hw := c.w_apply (CategoryTheory.Pairwise.Hom.left k l) e
      have hmap : F.map (homOfLE (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ k))
          (F.map (homOfLE inf_le_left) e) =
          F.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans (le_of_iUnion_eq hJ k))) e := by
        exact TDA.Topology.map_map_apply_of_thin F _ _ _ e
      rw [hmap] at he
      exact he.trans hw
  · intro c m hm
    have heq : (fun x => m x) = lift c := by
      apply (coverComponents_existsUnique_glue f U K
        (fun k => c.ι.app (.single k)) (fun k l e => by
          exact (c.w_apply (CategoryTheory.Pairwise.Hom.left k l) e).trans
            (c.w_apply (CategoryTheory.Pairwise.Hom.right k l) e).symm) hJ).choose_spec.2
      intro k e
      exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (hm (.single k)) e
    ext e
    exact congrFun heq e

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.exists_uniformMapperCanonicalIso
statement:
theorem exists_uniformMapperCanonicalIso [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] {m₀ M ρ : ℝ}
    (hh : ∀ v, h v ∈ Set.Icc m₀ M) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ∃ (a r g : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (T : CriticalValues n)
      (hST : Set.range (vertexHeightLevels h).value ⊆ Set.range T.value),
      0 < g ∧ 2 * g ≤ r ∧ r < ρ ∧ LevelsAdapted T a r g ∧
        Nonempty (uniformMapperData G h a r g n ≅
          RGraph.refineData hST (graphPLReebData G h (vertexHeightLevels h)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, r, g, n, T, hg, hgr, hrρ, hT, hcov, _hiso⟩ :=
    exists_uniformMapperIso G h hh hρ
  refine ⟨a, r, g, n, T, range_vertexHeightLevels_subset h hcov,
    hg, hgr, hrρ, hT, ?_⟩
  have hgr' : g ≤ r := by linarith
  exact ⟨uniformMapperCanonicalIso G h T hT hcov hg hgr'⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyExamples.skew_first_middle_collapse
statement:
theorem skew_first_middle_collapse (R : Type) [Ring R] :
    vertexChainMap R (TDA.Mapper.mapperMap threeStageMap
        (skewRefinement ThreeStageLE.first_middle)) 1 (Finsupp.single firstEdge 1) = 0 ∧
    (∀ b : Bool, (mapperHomologyMap ℚ threeStageMap
        (skewRefinement ThreeStageLE.first_middle) 0).hom
          (simplicialHomologyClass ℚ _ 0 (zeroVertexCycle _ ℚ (firstVertexFace b))) =
        simplicialHomologyClass ℚ _ 0 (zeroVertexCycle _ ℚ middleVertexFace)) ∧
    simplicialHomologyClass ℚ _ 0 (zeroVertexCycle _ ℚ middleVertexFace) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, simplicialHomologyClass_zeroVertexCycle_ne_zero _ ℚ _⟩
  · apply vertexChainMap_single_of_not_injective
    intro hinj
    have h01 := hinj (Subsingleton.elim
      (TDA.Mapper.mapperMap threeStageMap (skewRefinement ThreeStageLE.first_middle)
        (firstEdge.1.orderEmbOfFin firstEdge.2.2 0))
      (TDA.Mapper.mapperMap threeStageMap (skewRefinement ThreeStageLE.first_middle)
        (firstEdge.1.orderEmbOfFin firstEdge.2.2 1)))
    exact absurd h01 (by decide)
  · intro b
    rw [mapperHomologyMap_def]
    exact simplicialHomologyMap_class ℚ _ 0 _ _
      (vertexChainMap_singleton_face _ ℚ (firstVertexFace b) middleVertexFace
        (threeStageComponentIndex .first b) rfl
        (congrArg (fun a : ComponentIndex threeStageMap (threeStageCover .middle) =>
          ({a} : Finset _)) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)))

    mapperHomologyMap R emptyMap (emptySelect j) n =
      mapperHomologyMap R emptyMap (emptySelect j') n
proof:
:= by

    obtain ⟨a, _⟩ := ((mem_mapper_iff emptyMap emptySource σ.1).1 σ.2.1).1
    exact isEmptyElim a⟩
  refine ⟨fun _ => ⟨fun x => x.1.elim⟩, hface, ?_, mapperHomologyMap_eq R emptyMap _ _ n⟩
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyExamples.isolatedTarget_no_edges
statement: private theorem isolatedTarget_no_edges : IsEmpty (Face (nerve isolatedTarget) 1)
proof:
:= ⟨by
  intro σ
  have hcard : σ.1.card = Fintype.card Bool := by rw [σ.2.2]; rfl
  have huniv : σ.1 = Finset.univ := Finset.eq_univ_of_card σ.1 hcard
  obtain ⟨_, x, hx⟩ := (mem_nerve_iff isolatedTarget σ.1).1 σ.2.1
  have hfalse := hx false (by rw [huniv]; exact Finset.mem_univ _)
  have htrue := hx true (by rw [huniv]; exact Finset.mem_univ _)
  simp [isolatedTarget] at hfalse htrue
  exact Bool.false_ne_true (hfalse.symm.trans htrue)⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.RefinementHomologyExamples.isolated_vertex_maps_homology_ne
statement:
theorem isolated_vertex_maps_homology_ne :
    ¬ Contiguous (mapToIsolated false) (mapToIsolated true) ∧
    simplicialHomologyMap (ZMod 2) (mapToIsolated false) 0 ≠
      simplicialHomologyMap (ZMod 2) (mapToIsolated true) 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isolated_vertex_maps_are_not_contiguous, ?_⟩
  intro he
  have hm₀ := simplicialHomologyMap_class (ZMod 2) (mapToIsolated false) 0
    (vertexCycle _ (ZMod 2) pointFace) (vertexCycle _ (ZMod 2) (isolatedFace false))
    (vertexChainMap_singleton_face _ (ZMod 2) pointFace (isolatedFace false) () rfl rfl)
  have hm₁ := simplicialHomologyMap_class (ZMod 2) (mapToIsolated true) 0
    (vertexCycle _ (ZMod 2) pointFace) (vertexCycle _ (ZMod 2) (isolatedFace true))
    (vertexChainMap_singleton_face _ (ZMod 2) pointFace (isolatedFace true) () rfl rfl)
  have hc := congrArg (fun m => m.hom (simplicialHomologyClass (ZMod 2) (nerve oneSource) 0
    (vertexCycle _ (ZMod 2) pointFace))) he
  rw [hm₀, hm₁] at hc
  have hq := congrArg
    (homologyKernelQuotient (ZMod 2) (simplicialChainComplex (nerve isolatedTarget) (ZMod 2)) 0).hom.hom
    hc
  rw [simplicialHomologyClass_quotient, simplicialHomologyClass_quotient] at hq
  have hb := (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).mp hq
  obtain ⟨c, hcb⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff (ZMod 2) (nerve isolatedTarget) 0 _).mp hb
  have := isolatedTarget_no_edges
  have hz : c = 0 := Finsupp.ext fun σ => isEmptyElim σ
  rw [hz, map_zero] at hcb
  have hv := congrArg (fun c : Chain (nerve isolatedTarget) (ZMod 2) 0 => c (isolatedFace false))
    hcb
  have hne : isolatedFace false ≠ isolatedFace true := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg (fun σ : Face (nerve isolatedTarget) 0 => (false ∈ σ.1)) h
    simp [isolatedFace] at this
  simp [vertexCycle, hne] at hv

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPLConstructibleExamples.flatEdge_vertexPiece_not_discrete
statement:
theorem flatEdge_vertexPiece_not_discrete :
    ¬ DiscreteTopology
      ((graphPLPresentation edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) S0).V 0)
proof:
:= by
  change ¬ DiscreteTopology (ClosedLevel edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) 0)
  intro hdiscrete
  let : DiscreteTopology (ClosedLevel edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) 0) := hdiscrete
  have hfalse :
      plHeight edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (vertex edgeGraph false) ∈ ({0} : Set ℝ) := by
    simp
  have hone :
      plHeight edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ (1 : unitInterval)) ∈
        ({0} : Set ℝ) := by
    simp [plHeight_edgePoint, dartHeight_one]
  have hjoined :=
    joinedIn_level_of_eq edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (c := 0) (d := d₀)
      rfl rfl (1 : unitInterval)
  have hjoined' :
      JoinedIn (plHeight edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) ⁻¹' ({0} : Set ℝ))
        (vertex edgeGraph false) (edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ (1 : unitInterval)) := by
    simpa [d₀] using hjoined
  have hxy :
      (⟨vertex edgeGraph false, hfalse⟩ :
          ClosedLevel edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) 0) =
        (⟨edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ (1 : unitInterval), hone⟩ :
          ClosedLevel edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) 0) :=
    joined_eq_of_discrete
      ((joinedIn_iff_joined (F := plHeight edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) ⁻¹' ({0} : Set ℝ))
        (x := vertex edgeGraph false) (y := edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ (1 : unitInterval))
        hfalse hone).mp hjoined')
  apply TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebQuotientExamples.flatEdge_vertex_ne
  calc
    vertex edgeGraph false = edgePoint edgeGraph d₀ (1 : unitInterval) :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hxy
    _ = vertex edgeGraph true := edgePoint_one edgeGraph d₀

      RGraph.toOver S0 (graphPLReebData edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) S0))
proof:
:= by

  have hq : Subsingleton (ReebQuotient (plHeight edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)))) :=
    TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebQuotientExamples.flatEdge_reebQuotient_subsingleton
  let : Subsingleton (ReebQuotient (plHeight edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)))) := hq
  have hsub :
      Subsingleton (↑((RGraph.toOver S0
        (graphPLReebData edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) S0)).left)) := by
    change Subsingleton
      ((CylinderPresentation.ofFiniteData
        (graphPLReebData edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) S0)).Realization S0)
    exact (graphPLReebQuotientHomeomorph edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) const_covers).symm.toEquiv.subsingleton
  let : Subsingleton (↑((RGraph.toOver S0
      (graphPLReebData edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) S0)).left)) := hsub
  have hinj : Function.Injective i.hom.left.hom := fun x y hxy => by
    have hx : i.inv.left.hom (i.hom.left.hom x) = x :=
      congrArg (fun φ : graphPLOver edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) ⟶
          graphPLOver edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) => φ.left.hom x) i.hom_inv_id
    have hy : i.inv.left.hom (i.hom.left.hom y) = y :=
      congrArg (fun φ : graphPLOver edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) ⟶
          graphPLOver edgeGraph (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) => φ.left.hom y) i.hom_inv_id
    rw [← hx, ← hy, hxy]
  exact TDA.Mapper.GraphPLReebQuotientExamples.flatEdge_vertex_ne
    (hinj (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.support_eq_singleton_of_vertexCell
statement:
theorem support_eq_singleton_of_vertexCell (k : Fin (n + 1))
    (c : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).V k) :
    c.1.support =
      {⟨k, vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h)
        (fun i => (uniformCover a r g (n + 1) i : Set ℝ)) k c⟩}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := c.1.support_nonempty
  rcases b with ⟨j, b⟩
  have hj : j = k := by
    have hmem : j ∈ c.1.support.image Sigma.fst :=
      Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨⟨j, b⟩, hb, rfl⟩
    rw [c.2] at hmem
    exact Finset.mem_singleton.1 hmem
  subst j
  have hsupport : c.1.support = {⟨k, b⟩} := by
    apply Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2
    refine ⟨hb, ?_⟩
    intro d hd
    have hdk : d.1 = k := by
      have hmem : d.1 ∈ c.1.support.image Sigma.fst :=
        Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩
      rw [c.2] at hmem
      exact Finset.mem_singleton.1 hmem
    exact eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq
      (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)
      c.1.support_mem_nerve hd hb hdk
  have hclass : b = vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h)
      (uniformMapperCover a r g n) k c := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := c.1.carrier_nonempty
    have hxb : x ∈ componentCover (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)
        ⟨k, b⟩ := by
      exact (mem_interMember_iff _).1 (c.1.carrier_subset hx) ⟨k, b⟩ hb
    rcases hxb with ⟨hxU, hxb⟩
    refine hxb.symm.trans ?_
    exact (congrArg (zerothHomotopySetCongr (by rw [Finset.set_biInter_singleton]; rfl))
      (cellsOverLabelsEquiv_apply_of_mem (plHeight G h)
        (uniformMapperCover a r g n) {k} (Finset.singleton_nonempty k) c hx)).symm
  rw [hsupport, hclass]

proof:

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperLeft_eq_of_mem
statement:
private theorem uniformMapperLeft_eq_of_mem (e : Fin n)
    (c : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).E e)
    (v : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).V e.castSucc)
    (hv : (⟨e.castSucc, vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h)
      (uniformMapperCover a r g n) e.castSucc v⟩ :
        ComponentIndex (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)) ∈ c.1.support) :
    (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).left e c = v
proof:
:= by
  let A : ComponentIndex (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) :=
    ⟨e.castSucc, vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h)
      (uniformMapperCover a r g n) e.castSucc v⟩
  let A' : ComponentIndex (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) :=
    ⟨e.castSucc, vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h)
      (uniformMapperCover a r g n) e.castSucc
        ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).left e c)⟩
  have hA' : A' ∈ c.1.support := by
    have hmem : A' ∈ ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).left e c).1.support := by
      rw [support_eq_singleton_of_vertexCell G h e.castSucc
        ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).left e c)]
      exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _
    exact (support_mono (show
      (labelFace (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) c
        e.castSucc (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)).1 ≤ c.1 from
      labelFace_le (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) c
        e.castSucc (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))) hmem
  have hAA' : A' = A := by
    apply eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq
      (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)
      c.1.support_mem_nerve hA' hv
    rfl
  apply Subtype.ext
  calc
    ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).left e c).1 = vertexCell
        (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) A' := by
          exact uniformMapperVertexCell_eq G h e.castSucc
            ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).left e c)
    _ = vertexCell (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) A :=
      congrArg (vertexCell (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)) hAA'
    _ = v.1 := (uniformMapperVertexCell_eq G h e.castSucc v).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperRight_eq_of_mem
statement:
private theorem uniformMapperRight_eq_of_mem (e : Fin n)
    (c : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).E e)
    (v : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).V e.succ)
    (hv : (⟨e.succ, vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h)
      (uniformMapperCover a r g n) e.succ v⟩ :
        ComponentIndex (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)) ∈ c.1.support) :
    (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).right e c = v
proof:
:= by
  let A : ComponentIndex (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) :=
    ⟨e.succ, vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h)
      (uniformMapperCover a r g n) e.succ v⟩
  let A' : ComponentIndex (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) :=
    ⟨e.succ, vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h)
      (uniformMapperCover a r g n) e.succ
        ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).right e c)⟩
  have hA' : A' ∈ c.1.support := by
    have hmem : A' ∈ ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).right e c).1.support := by
      rw [support_eq_singleton_of_vertexCell G h e.succ
        ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).right e c)]
      exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _
    exact (support_mono (show
      (labelFace (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) c
        e.succ (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _))).1 ≤ c.1 from
      labelFace_le (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) c
        e.succ (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)))) hmem
  have hAA' : A' = A := by
    apply eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq
      (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)
      c.1.support_mem_nerve hA' hv
    rfl
  apply Subtype.ext
  calc
    ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).right e c).1 = vertexCell
        (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) A' := by
          exact uniformMapperVertexCell_eq G h e.succ
            ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).right e c)
    _ = vertexCell (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) A :=
      congrArg (vertexCell (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)) hAA'
    _ = v.1 := (uniformMapperVertexCell_eq G h e.succ v).symm

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperLeft_mem_support
statement:
private theorem uniformMapperLeft_mem_support (e : Fin n)
    (c : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).E e) :

        ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).left e c)⟩ :

      ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).left e c)⟩ :

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperRight_mem_support

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperArrow_adj
statement:
private theorem uniformMapperArrow_adj (e : Fin n) (c : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).E e) :
    (mapperOneSkeleton (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)).Adj
        (uniformMapperIncidenceVertexEquiv G h
            ⟨e.castSucc, (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).left e c⟩)
        (uniformMapperIncidenceVertexEquiv G h
            ⟨e.succ, (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).right e c⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [uniformMapperIncidenceVertexEquiv_apply, uniformMapperIncidenceVertexEquiv_apply]
  apply (mapperOneSkeleton_adj_iff (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) _ _).2
  constructor
  · intro hab
    exact (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ (i := e)).ne
      (congrArg (fun z : MapperVertex (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) => z.1.1) hab)
  · apply mem_nerve_of_nonempty_subset
      (componentCover (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n))
      c.1.support_mem_nerve
    · intro z hz
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hz with rfl | hz
      · exact uniformMapperLeft_mem_support G h e c
      · obtain rfl := Finset.mem_singleton.1 hz
        exact uniformMapperRight_mem_support G h e c
    · exact Finset.insert_nonempty _ _

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperAdj_of_cell
statement:
private theorem uniformMapperAdj_of_cell (hgr : 2 * g ≤ r) {k l : Fin (n + 1)}
    (c : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).V k) (d : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).V l)
    (z : MultiNerveCell (componentCover (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)))
    (hz : z.support = {(⟨k, vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)
        k c⟩ : uniformMapperIndex G h a r g n),
      ⟨l, vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) l d⟩})
    (hkl : k < l) :
    (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).incidenceGraph.Adj ⟨k, c⟩ ⟨l, d⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hlabels : z.support.image Sigma.fst = {k, l} := by
    rw [hz]
    ext i
    constructor
    · intro hi
      obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hi
      rcases (Finset.mem_insert (α := uniformMapperIndex G h a r g n)).1 hy with rfl | hy
      · exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
      · obtain rfl := Finset.mem_singleton.1 hy
        exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
    · intro hi
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hi with rfl | hi
      · exact Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨_, Finset.mem_insert_self
          (α := uniformMapperIndex G h a r g n) _ _, rfl⟩
      · obtain rfl := Finset.mem_singleton.1 hi
        exact Finset.mem_image.2
          ⟨_, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (α := uniformMapperIndex G h a r g n)
              (Finset.mem_singleton_self _), rfl⟩
  have hfar : ¬ (k : ℕ) + 2 ≤ l := fun hfar =>
    (isEmpty_uniformEdgeCells_of_far G h hgr hfar).false ⟨z, hlabels⟩
  have hkl' : (k : ℕ) < l := hkl
  have hl : (l : ℕ) < n + 1 := l.isLt
  obtain ⟨e, rfl, rfl⟩ : ∃ e : Fin n, e.castSucc = k ∧ e.succ = l :=
    ⟨⟨k, by omega⟩, Fin.ext rfl, Fin.ext (show (k : ℕ) + 1 = l by omega)⟩
  have hA : (⟨e.castSucc, vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)
      e.castSucc c⟩ : uniformMapperIndex G h a r g n) ∈ z.support := by
    rw [hz]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_self (α := uniformMapperIndex G h a r g n) _ _
  have hB : (⟨e.succ, vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)
      e.succ d⟩ : uniformMapperIndex G h a r g n) ∈ z.support := by
    rw [hz]
    exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (α := uniformMapperIndex G h a r g n)
        (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
  exact ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).incidenceGraph_adj_castSucc_succ_iff e c d).2
    ⟨⟨z, hlabels⟩, uniformMapperLeft_eq_of_mem G h e ⟨z, hlabels⟩ c hA,
      uniformMapperRight_eq_of_mem G h e ⟨z, hlabels⟩ d hB⟩

name: TDA.Mapper.GraphPL.uniformMapperAdj_iff
statement:
private theorem uniformMapperAdj_iff (hgr : 2 * g ≤ r)
    {x y : (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).IncidenceVertex} :
    (mapperOneSkeleton (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)).Adj
        (uniformMapperIncidenceVertexEquiv G h x)
        (uniformMapperIncidenceVertexEquiv G h y) ↔
      (uniformMapperData G h a r g n).incidenceGraph.Adj x y
proof:
:= by
  rcases x with ⟨k, c⟩
  rcases y with ⟨l, d⟩
  rw [uniformMapperIncidenceVertexEquiv_apply, uniformMapperIncidenceVertexEquiv_apply]
  constructor
  · intro hab
    have hab' := (mapperOneSkeleton_adj_iff (plHeight G h)
      (uniformMapperCover a r g n) _ _).1 hab
    have hface : {(⟨k, vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)
        k c⟩ : uniformMapperIndex G h a r g n),
        ⟨l, vertexCellsEquiv (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) l d⟩} ∈
        mapper (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) := hab'.2
    have hkl : k ≠ l := by
      intro hkl
      apply hab'.1
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact eq_of_mem_mapper_face_of_fst_eq
        (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n) hface
        (Finset.mem_insert_self (α := uniformMapperIndex G h a r g n) _ _)
        (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (α := uniformMapperIndex G h a r g n)
            (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)) hkl
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_cell_of_mem_nerve
      (V := componentCover (plHeight G h) (uniformMapperCover a r g n)) hface
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hkl with hlt | hgt
    · exact uniformMapperAdj_of_cell G h hgr c d z hz hlt
    · exact (uniformMapperAdj_of_cell G h hgr d c z
        (hz.trans (Finset.pair_comm (α := uniformMapperIndex G h a r g n) _ _)) hgt).symm
  · intro hab
    rcases ((uniformMapperData G h a r g n).incidenceGraph_adj_iff).mp hab with hxy | hyx
    · obtain ⟨p⟩ := hxy
      rcases p with ⟨⟨e, q⟩, hs, ht⟩
      cases hs
      cases ht
      exact uniformMapperArrow_adj G h e q
    · obtain ⟨p⟩ := hyx
      rcases p with ⟨⟨e, q⟩, hs, ht⟩
      cases hs
      cases ht
      exact (uniformMapperArrow_adj G h e q).symm
