name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.target_balance
statement:
theorem target_balance (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v) (j : J) :
    (∑ i, a.mass i j) + a.insertionMass j = v j
proof: := by simp [insertionMass]

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedBoundaryMatrices_nonempty
statement:
theorem weightedBoundaryMatrices_nonempty (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0) :
    (weightedBoundaryMatrices w v).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, (FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.zero w v).mass_mem⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.isClosed_weightedBoundaryMatrices
statement:
private theorem isClosed_weightedBoundaryMatrices (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0) :
    IsClosed (weightedBoundaryMatrices w v)
proof:
:= by
  have hnonneg : IsClosed {a : I → J → ℝ | ∀ i j, 0 ≤ a i j} := by
    simp only [Set.ofPred_forall]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun i => isClosed_iInter fun j =>
      isClosed_le continuous_const (by fun_prop)
  have hrow : IsClosed {a : I → J → ℝ | ∀ i, ∑ j, a i j ≤ (w i : ℝ)} := by
    simp only [Set.ofPred_forall]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun i => isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  have hcol : IsClosed {a : I → J → ℝ | ∀ j, ∑ i, a i j ≤ (v j : ℝ)} := by
    simp only [Set.ofPred_forall]
    exact isClosed_iInter fun j => isClosed_le (by fun_prop) continuous_const
  exact hnonneg.inter (hrow.inter hcol)

name: TDA.Persistence.isCompact_weightedBoundaryMatrices
statement:
theorem isCompact_weightedBoundaryMatrices (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0) :
    IsCompact (weightedBoundaryMatrices w v)
proof:
:= by
  apply (isCompact_Icc : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0 : I → J → ℝ)
    (fun i _ => (w i : ℝ)))).of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_weightedBoundaryMatrices w v)
  intro a ha
  refine ⟨fun i j => ha.1 i j, fun i j => ?_⟩
  exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun k _ => ha.1 i k) (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans (ha.2.1 i)

name: TDA.Persistence.continuous_weightedBoundaryLinearObjective
statement:
theorem continuous_weightedBoundaryLinearObjective (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (c : I → J → ℝ) (d : I → ℝ) (e : J → ℝ) :
    Continuous (weightedBoundaryLinearObjective w v c d e)
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightedBoundaryLinearObjective
  fun_prop

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.linearCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem linearCost_nonneg (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (c : I → J → ℝ) (d : I → ℝ) (e : J → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ c i j) (hd : ∀ i, 0 ≤ d i) (he : ∀ j, 0 ≤ e j) :
    0 ≤ a.linearCost c d e
proof:
:= by
  exact add_nonneg
    (add_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (a.nonneg i j) (hc i j))
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (a.deletionMass_nonneg i) (hd i)))
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (a.insertionMass_nonneg j) (he j))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem powerCost_nonneg (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v) (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : 0 ≤ a.powerCost p x y
proof:
:=
  a.linearCost_nonneg _ _ _ (fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _)
    (fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _)
    (fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _)

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    0 ≤ weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y
proof:
:=
  le_ciInf fun a => a.powerCost_nonneg p x y

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan
statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v) :
    weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y ≤ a.powerCost p x y
proof:
:=
  ciInf_le ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩; exact b.powerCost_nonneg p x y⟩ a

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_minimizing_weightedPowerBoundaryPlan
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_weightedPowerBoundaryPlan (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v,
      a.powerCost p x y = weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y
proof:
:= by
  let c := fun i j => (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal ^ p
  let d := fun i => (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p
  let e := fun j => (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ p
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmin⟩ := (isCompact_weightedBoundaryMatrices w v).exists_isMinOn
    (weightedBoundaryMatrices_nonempty w v)
    (continuous_weightedBoundaryLinearObjective w v c d e).continuousOn
  let a := FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.ofMass m hm
  refine ⟨a, le_antisymm ?_ (weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan p w v x y a)⟩
  exact le_ciInf fun b => hmin b.mass_mem

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan
statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v) :
    weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y ≤ a.powerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:=
  Real.rpow_le_rpow (weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg p w v x y)
    (weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan p w v x y a)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_trans zero_le_one hp))

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_minimizing_weightedPBoundaryPlan
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_weightedPBoundaryPlan {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v,
      a.powerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹ = weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_minimizing_weightedPowerBoundaryPlan p w v x y
  refine ⟨a, le_antisymm ?_ (weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan hp w v x y a)⟩
  rw [ha]
  exact le_rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_eq_iInf {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y =
      ⨅ a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v, a.powerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hbd : BddBelow (Set.range fun a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v =>
      a.powerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹) := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (a.powerCost_nonneg p x y) _
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_ciInf fun a => weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan hp w v x y a
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_minimizing_weightedPBoundaryPlan hp w v x y
    exact (ciInf_le hbd a).trans_eq ha

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_transpose
statement:
theorem powerCost_transpose (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v) (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    a.transpose.powerCost p y x = a.powerCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [powerCost, linearCost, weightedBoundaryLinearObjective, transpose,
    finitePairCost_comm]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_reindex
statement:
theorem powerCost_reindex {I' : Type*} {J' : Type*} [Fintype I'] [Fintype J']
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v) (e : I' ≃ I) (f : J' ≃ J) (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    (a.reindex e f).powerCost p (x ∘ e) (y ∘ f) = a.powerCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  let c := fun i j => (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal ^ p
  let d := fun i => (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p
  let b := fun j => (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ p
  have hr (i : I') : (∑ j, a.mass (e i) (f j)) = ∑ j, a.mass (e i) j :=
    f.sum_comp (a.mass (e i))
  have hc (j : J') : (∑ i, a.mass (e i) (f j)) = ∑ i, a.mass i (f j) :=
    e.sum_comp (fun i => a.mass i (f j))
  change (∑ i, ∑ j, a.mass (e i) (f j) * c (e i) (f j)) +
      (∑ i, ((w (e i) : ℝ) - ∑ j, a.mass (e i) (f j)) * d (e i)) +
      (∑ j, ((v (f j) : ℝ) - ∑ i, a.mass (e i) (f j)) * b (f j)) = _
  simp_rw [hr, hc]
  apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
  · apply congrArg₂ (· + ·)
    · calc
        _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, a.mass (e i) j * c (e i) j := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          exact f.sum_comp (fun j => a.mass (e i) j * c (e i) j)
        _ = _ := e.sum_comp (fun i => ∑ j, a.mass i j * c i j)
    · exact e.sum_comp (fun i => ((w i : ℝ) - ∑ j, a.mass i j) * d i)
  · exact f.sum_comp (fun j => ((v j : ℝ) - ∑ i, a.mass i j) * b j)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_ofUnitPlan
statement:
theorem powerCost_ofUnitPlan (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    (ofUnitPlan a).powerCost p x y = a.powerCost p x y
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_toUnitPlan
statement:
theorem powerCost_toUnitPlan
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan (fun _ : I => 1) (fun _ : J => 1)) (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    a.toUnitPlan.powerCost p x y = a.powerCost p x y
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_of_isEmpty_right
statement:
theorem powerCost_of_isEmpty_right [IsEmpty J] (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    a.powerCost p x y = ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p
proof:
:= by
  simp [powerCost, linearCost, weightedBoundaryLinearObjective]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_of_isEmpty_left
statement:
theorem powerCost_of_isEmpty_left [IsEmpty I] (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    a.powerCost p x y = ∑ j, (v j : ℝ) * (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ p
proof:
:= by
  simp [powerCost, linearCost, weightedBoundaryLinearObjective]

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_symm
statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_symm (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y =
      weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p v w y x
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_ciInf
    intro a
    exact (weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan p w v x y a.transpose).trans_eq
      (a.powerCost_transpose p y x)
  · apply le_ciInf
    intro a
    exact (weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan p v w y x a.transpose).trans_eq
      (a.powerCost_transpose p x y)

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_symm
statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_symm (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y = weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p v w y x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weightedPBoundaryTransportCost, weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_symm p w v x y]

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_unit
statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_unit (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) x y =
      finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_ciInf
    intro a
    exact (weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan p _ _ x y
      (FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.ofUnitPlan a)).trans_eq
      (FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_ofUnitPlan a p x y)
  · apply le_ciInf
    intro a
    exact (finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan p x y a.toUnitPlan).trans_eq
      (a.powerCost_toUnitPlan p x y)

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_unit
statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_unit (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p (fun _ => 1) (fun _ => 1) x y =
      finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weightedPBoundaryTransportCost, weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_unit,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_reindex
statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_reindex
    {I' : Type*} {J' : Type*} [Fintype I'] [Fintype J']
    (e : I' ≃ I) (f : J' ≃ J) (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p (w ∘ e) (v ∘ f) (x ∘ e) (y ∘ f) =
      weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_ciInf
    intro a
    exact (weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan p _ _ _ _ (a.reindex e f)).trans_eq
      (a.powerCost_reindex e f p x y)
  · apply le_ciInf
    intro a
    have h := (weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan p _ _ _ _
      (a.reindex e.symm f.symm)).trans_eq
      (a.powerCost_reindex e.symm f.symm p (x ∘ e) (y ∘ f))
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_reindex
statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_reindex
    {I' : Type*} {J' : Type*} [Fintype I'] [Fintype J']
    (e : I' ≃ I) (f : J' ≃ J) (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p (w ∘ e) (v ∘ f) (x ∘ e) (y ∘ f) =
      weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedPBoundaryTransportCost, weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_reindex]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    0 ≤ weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y
proof:
:=
  Real.rpow_nonneg (weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg p w v x y) _

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_zero
statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_zero (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost, FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.linearCost,
      weightedBoundaryLinearObjective, FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.zero] using
      weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan p (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) x y
        (FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.zero _ _)
  · exact weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg p _ _ x y

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_zero
statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_zero {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedPBoundaryTransportCost, weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_zero]
  exact Real.zero_rpow (inv_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)))

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right
statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right [IsEmpty J]
    (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost, FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_of_isEmpty_right,
    ciInf_const]

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left
statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left [IsEmpty I]
    (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y =
      ∑ j, (v j : ℝ) * (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost, FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_of_isEmpty_left,
    ciInf_const]

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right
statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right [IsEmpty J]
    (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y =
      (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedPBoundaryTransportCost, weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right]

name: TDA.Persistence.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left
statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left [IsEmpty I]
    (p : ℝ) (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v x y =
      (∑ j, (v j : ℝ) * (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ p) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedPBoundaryTransportCost, weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.exists_minimizing_powerPlan
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_powerPlan (p : ℝ) (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    ∃ a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan D.weights E.weights,
      a.powerCost p D.coordinates E.coordinates = powerBoundaryTransportCost p D E
proof:
:=
  exists_minimizing_weightedPowerBoundaryPlan p D.weights E.weights D.coordinates E.coordinates

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.exists_minimizing_pPlan
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_pPlan {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    ∃ a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan D.weights E.weights,
      a.powerCost p D.coordinates E.coordinates ^ p⁻¹ = pBoundaryTransportCost p D E
proof:
:=
  exists_minimizing_weightedPBoundaryPlan hp D.weights E.weights D.coordinates E.coordinates

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.pBoundaryTransportCost_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem pBoundaryTransportCost_eq_iInf {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    pBoundaryTransportCost p D E =
      ⨅ a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan D.weights E.weights,
        a.powerCost p D.coordinates E.coordinates ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:=
  weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_eq_iInf hp D.weights E.weights D.coordinates E.coordinates

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost_symm
statement:
theorem powerBoundaryTransportCost_symm (p : ℝ) (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    powerBoundaryTransportCost p D E = powerBoundaryTransportCost p E D
proof:
:=
  weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_symm p D.weights E.weights D.coordinates E.coordinates

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.pBoundaryTransportCost_symm
statement:
theorem pBoundaryTransportCost_symm (p : ℝ) (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    pBoundaryTransportCost p D E = pBoundaryTransportCost p E D
proof:
:=
  weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_symm p D.weights E.weights D.coordinates E.coordinates

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.isEmpty_zero_supportLabels
statement: private theorem isEmpty_zero_supportLabels : IsEmpty ((0 : FiniteWeightedDiagram).supportLabels)
proof:
:= by
  change IsEmpty ↥(0 : FiniteWeightedDiagram).support
  rw [Finsupp.support_zero]
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost_zero_right
statement:
theorem powerBoundaryTransportCost_zero_right (p : ℝ) (D : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    powerBoundaryTransportCost p D 0 =
      ∑ i, (D.weights i : ℝ) * (diagonalCost (D.coordinates i)).toReal ^ p
proof:
:= by
  letI := isEmpty_zero_supportLabels
  exact weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right p _ _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost_zero_left
statement:
theorem powerBoundaryTransportCost_zero_left (p : ℝ) (D : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    powerBoundaryTransportCost p 0 D =
      ∑ i, (D.weights i : ℝ) * (diagonalCost (D.coordinates i)).toReal ^ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerBoundaryTransportCost_symm, powerBoundaryTransportCost_zero_right]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.pBoundaryTransportCost_zero_right
statement:
theorem pBoundaryTransportCost_zero_right (p : ℝ) (D : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    pBoundaryTransportCost p D 0 =
      (∑ i, (D.weights i : ℝ) * (diagonalCost (D.coordinates i)).toReal ^ p) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  change powerBoundaryTransportCost p D 0 ^ p⁻¹ = _
  rw [powerBoundaryTransportCost_zero_right]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.pBoundaryTransportCost_zero_left
statement:
theorem pBoundaryTransportCost_zero_left (p : ℝ) (D : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    pBoundaryTransportCost p 0 D =
      (∑ i, (D.weights i : ℝ) * (diagonalCost (D.coordinates i)).toReal ^ p) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [pBoundaryTransportCost_symm, pBoundaryTransportCost_zero_right]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem powerBoundaryTransportCost_zero (p : ℝ) :
    powerBoundaryTransportCost p (0 : FiniteWeightedDiagram) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := isEmpty_zero_supportLabels
  simp [powerBoundaryTransportCost_zero_right]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.pBoundaryTransportCost_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem pBoundaryTransportCost_zero {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    pBoundaryTransportCost p (0 : FiniteWeightedDiagram) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  change powerBoundaryTransportCost p 0 0 ^ p⁻¹ = 0
  rw [powerBoundaryTransportCost_zero]
  exact Real.zero_rpow (inv_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)))

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleRankInteger_fin
statement:
theorem moduleRankInteger_fin (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    moduleRankInteger M (i.val : ℤ) (j.val : ℤ) =
      (structureMapRank M i j hij : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hvalid : 0 ≤ (i.val : ℤ) ∧ (i.val : ℤ) ≤ (j.val : ℤ) ∧
      (j.val : ℤ) < (N : ℤ) := by
    exact ⟨by positivity, by exact_mod_cast Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp hij,
      by exact_mod_cast j.isLt⟩
  unfold moduleRankInteger
  rw [dif_pos hvalid]
  dsimp

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleRankInteger_neg_one
statement:
theorem moduleRankInteger_neg_one (j : ℤ) :
    moduleRankInteger M (-1) j = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [moduleRankInteger]

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleRankInteger_at_size
statement:
theorem moduleRankInteger_at_size (i : ℤ) :
    moduleRankInteger M i (N : ℤ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [moduleRankInteger]

name: TDA.Persistence.image_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [structureMapLinear_comp M hab hbc]
  exact LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapRank_mono_source
statement:
theorem structureMapRank_mono_source (a b c : Fin N)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    structureMapRank M a c (hab.trans hbc) ≤ structureMapRank M b c hbc
proof:
:= by
  unfold structureMapRank
  exact Submodule.finrank_mono (image_le M hab hbc)

name: TDA.Persistence.range_restricted
statement:
private theorem range_restricted {a c d : Fin N} (hac : a ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    LinearMap.range ((structureMapLinear M hcd).comp
      (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hac)).subtype) =
    LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M (hac.trans hcd))
proof:
:= by
  rw [structureMapLinear_comp M hac hcd]
  rw [LinearMap.range_comp, Submodule.range_subtype]
  exact (LinearMap.range_comp (structureMapLinear M hac) (structureMapLinear M hcd)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapRank_drop
statement:
theorem structureMapRank_drop (a c d : Fin N)
    (hac : a ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    structureMapRank M a c hac =
      structureMapRank M a d (hac.trans hcd) +
        Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
          ((structureMapLinear M hcd).comp
            (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hac)).subtype))
proof:
:= by
  let U := LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hac)
  let g := structureMapLinear M hcd
  let f := g.comp U.subtype
  have hr := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker f
  have he : LinearMap.range f = LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M (hac.trans hcd)) :=
    range_restricted M hac hcd
  unfold structureMapRank
  rw [← he]
  exact hr.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.ker_restricted_finrank
statement:
private theorem ker_restricted_finrank {c d : Fin N} (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (U : Submodule k (M.obj c)) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker ((structureMapLinear M hcd).comp U.subtype)) =
      Module.finrank k (U ⊓ LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M hcd) :
        Submodule k (M.obj c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq U
    (LinearMap.ker ((structureMapLinear M hcd).comp U.subtype))]
  change Module.finrank k (Submodule.map U.subtype
    (LinearMap.ker ((structureMapLinear M hcd).domRestrict U))) = _
  rw [LinearMap.ker_domRestrict, Submodule.map_comap_subtype]

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapRank_four_le
statement:
theorem structureMapRank_four_le (a b c d : Fin N)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    structureMapRank M a c (hab.trans hbc) + structureMapRank M b d (hbc.trans hcd) ≤
      structureMapRank M b c hbc + structureMapRank M a d ((hab.trans hbc).trans hcd)
proof:
:= by
  let U := LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M (hab.trans hbc))
  let W := LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hbc)
  let g := structureMapLinear M hcd
  have hUW : U ≤ W := image_le M hab hbc
  have hker : Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (g.comp U.subtype)) ≤
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (g.comp W.subtype)) := by
    rw [ker_restricted_finrank M hcd U, ker_restricted_finrank M hcd W]
    exact Submodule.finrank_mono (inf_le_inf_right _ hUW)
  have hU := structureMapRank_drop M a c d (hab.trans hbc) hcd
  have hW := structureMapRank_drop M b c d hbc hcd
  change structureMapRank M a c (hab.trans hbc) =
    structureMapRank M a d ((hab.trans hbc).trans hcd) +
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (g.comp U.subtype)) at hU
  change structureMapRank M b c hbc = structureMapRank M b d (hbc.trans hcd) +
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (g.comp W.subtype)) at hW
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.rank_nat
statement:
private theorem rank_nat (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (hj : j < N) :
    moduleRankInteger M (i : ℤ) (j : ℤ) =
      structureMapRank M ⟨i, by omega⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩
        (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr hij)
proof:
:= by
  exact moduleRankInteger_fin M ⟨i, by omega⟩ ⟨j, hj⟩
    (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr hij)

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleMultiplicityInteger_nonneg
statement:
theorem moduleMultiplicityInteger_nonneg (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    0 ≤ moduleMultiplicityInteger M b d
proof:
:= by
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by omega
  have hcN : d - 1 < N := by omega
  have hc : ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (d : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · subst b
    have hzero₁ := moduleRankInteger_neg_one M ((d : ℤ) - 1)
    have hzero₂ := moduleRankInteger_neg_one M (d : ℤ)
    by_cases hterminal : d = N
    · subst d
      have hr := rank_nat M 0 (N - 1) (by omega) hcN
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero] at hr
      have ht₁ := moduleRankInteger_at_size M (0 : ℤ)
      simp only [moduleMultiplicityInteger, Nat.cast_zero, zero_sub]
      rw [hzero₁, hzero₂, ht₁, ← hc, hr]
      omega
    · have hdn : d < N := by omega
      have hrc := rank_nat M 0 (d - 1) (by omega) hcN
      have hrd := rank_nat M 0 d (by omega) hdn
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero] at hrc hrd
      let a : Fin N := ⟨0, by omega⟩
      let c : Fin N := ⟨d - 1, hcN⟩
      let e : Fin N := ⟨d, hdn⟩
      have hac : a ≤ c := by
        apply Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr
        change 0 ≤ d - 1
        omega
      have hce : c ≤ e := by
        apply Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr
        change d - 1 ≤ d
        omega
      have hdrop := structureMapRank_drop M a c e hac hce
      simp only [moduleMultiplicityInteger, Nat.cast_zero, zero_sub]
      rw [hzero₁, hzero₂, ← hc, hrc, hrd]
      change 0 ≤ (structureMapRank M a c _ : ℤ) - 0 -
        (structureMapRank M a e _ : ℤ) + 0
      omega
  · have hbpos : 0 < b := by omega
    have ha : ((b - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (b : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hab : b - 1 ≤ b := by omega
    have hbc : b ≤ d - 1 := by omega
    by_cases hterminal : d = N
    · subst d
      have hrb := rank_nat M b (N - 1) hbc hcN
      have hra := rank_nat M (b - 1) (N - 1) (by omega) hcN
      have ht₁ := moduleRankInteger_at_size M (b : ℤ)
      have ht₂ := moduleRankInteger_at_size M ((b : ℤ) - 1)
      let a : Fin N := ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩
      let bb : Fin N := ⟨b, by omega⟩
      let c : Fin N := ⟨N - 1, hcN⟩
      have hmono := structureMapRank_mono_source M a bb c
        (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr hab) (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr hbc)
      unfold moduleMultiplicityInteger
      rw [ht₁, ht₂, ← hc, ← ha, hrb, hra]
      change 0 ≤ (structureMapRank M bb c _ : ℤ) -
        (structureMapRank M a c _ : ℤ) - 0 + 0
      omega
    · have hdn : d < N := by omega
      let a : Fin N := ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩
      let bb : Fin N := ⟨b, by omega⟩
      let c : Fin N := ⟨d - 1, hcN⟩
      let e : Fin N := ⟨d, hdn⟩
      have h₁ := rank_nat M b (d - 1) hbc hcN
      have h₂ := rank_nat M (b - 1) (d - 1) (by omega) hcN
      have h₃ := rank_nat M b d (by omega) hdn
      have h₄ := rank_nat M (b - 1) d (by omega) hdn
      have hce : c ≤ e := by
        apply Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr
        change d - 1 ≤ d
        omega
      have hfour := structureMapRank_four_le M a bb c e
        (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr hab)
        (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr hbc) hce
      unfold moduleMultiplicityInteger
      rw [← hc, ← ha, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄]
      change 0 ≤ (structureMapRank M bb c _ : ℤ) -
        (structureMapRank M a c _ : ℤ) -
        (structureMapRank M bb e _ : ℤ) +
        (structureMapRank M a e _ : ℤ)
      omega

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChangeExamples.zeroModule_extension_subsingleton
statement:
theorem zeroModule_extension_subsingleton {k : Type} [Field k] :
    ∀ x y : quotientModule (k := k) (S := Bool)
      (ModuleCat.of (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := Bool)) PUnit), x = y
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ :=
    (relation (k := k) (S := Bool)
      (ModuleCat.of (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := Bool)) PUnit)).mkQ_surjective x
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ :=
    (relation (k := k) (S := Bool)
      (ModuleCat.of (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := Bool)) PUnit)).mkQ_surjective y
  exact congrArg (fun a =>
    (relation (k := k) (S := Bool)
      (ModuleCat.of (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := Bool)) PUnit)).mkQ a)
      (Subsingleton.elim m n)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChangeExamples.bool_regularIncidence_projective

proof:

    (bool_regularIncidence_projective (k := k))

theorem rational_unit_counit_class
    (t : RightVertexModule (k := ℚ) (S := Unit) unitStrictVertex) :
    (extensionRightVertexIso (k := ℚ) (S := Unit) unitStrictVertex).hom
      ((relation (k := ℚ) (S := Unit)
        (RightVertexRestrictedModule (k := ℚ) (S := Unit) unitStrictVertex)).mkQ t) = t

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChangeExamples.rationalUnitDoubleMap_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem rationalUnitDoubleMap_apply_one :
    rationalUnitDoubleMap.hom (1 : ℚ) = (2 : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  change (1 : ℚ) + (1 : ℚ) = (2 : ℚ)
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChangeExamples.rationalUnitDoubleMap_ne_identity
statement:
theorem rationalUnitDoubleMap_ne_identity :
    rationalUnitDoubleMap ≠ 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 := congrArg (fun f :
      RightVertexModule (k := ℚ) (S := Unit) unitStrictVertex ⟶
        RightVertexModule (k := ℚ) (S := Unit) unitStrictVertex => f.hom (1 : ℚ)) h
  rw [rationalUnitDoubleMap_apply_one] at h1
  change (2 : ℚ) = (1 : ℚ) at h1
  norm_num at h1

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChangeExamples.rationalUnitDoubleMap_extension_naturality
statement:
theorem rationalUnitDoubleMap_extension_naturality :
    (extensionFunctor (k := ℚ) (S := Unit)).map
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := ℚ) (S := Unit))).map
          rationalUnitDoubleMap) ≫
      (extensionRightVertexIso (k := ℚ) (S := Unit) unitStrictVertex).hom =
    (extensionRightVertexIso (k := ℚ) (S := Unit) unitStrictVertex).hom ≫
      rationalUnitDoubleMap
proof:
:= by
  simpa [extensionRightVertexIso, Functor.comp_map] using
    (extensionRestrictionIso (k := ℚ) (S := Unit)).hom.naturality
      rationalUnitDoubleMap

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.coarse_apply

proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.fine_apply

proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.coarse_fine

:= by
  rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩

  · exact ⟨1, by norm_num [coarse_apply, fine_apply]⟩
  · exact ⟨3, by norm_num [coarse_apply, fine_apply]; rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.refinement_and_missing_control

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.bars_birth_pos
statement: private theorem bars_birth_pos (I : FiniteInterval 3) (hI : I ∈ bars) : 0 < I.birth
proof:

  rcases hI with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.initial_zero
statement: private theorem initial_zero : IsZero ((barcodeModule (k := ℚ) bars).obj 0)
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton ((barcodeModule (k := ℚ) bars).obj 0) := by
    change Subsingleton (∀ i : Fin bars.toList.length,
      FiniteInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) (bars.toList.get i) 0)
    refine ⟨fun x y => funext (fun i => ?_)⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hb := bars_birth_pos _ (Multiset.mem_toList.mp (List.get_mem bars.toList i))
    have hn : ¬ (bars.toList.get i).alive 0 := by
      simp only [FiniteInterval.alive, Fin.val_zero]; omega
    have hx : (x i : ℚ) = 0 := by
      simpa only [FiniteInterval.fiber, if_neg hn, Submodule.mem_bot] using (x i).property
    have hy : (y i : ℚ) = 0 := by
      simpa only [FiniteInterval.fiber, if_neg hn, Submodule.mem_bot] using (y i).property
    exact hx.trans hy.symm
  exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.input_constructible

proof:
:=
  isConstructible_reindex coarse _ initial_zero

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.critical_finite

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.fine_finite

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.coarse_diagram
statement:
private theorem coarse_diagram : moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite =
    ofIndexBars coarse coarse.strictMono (reindexBarcode (Fin.succOrderEmb 2).toOrderHom bars)
proof:
:= by
  let s : Fin 2 →o Fin 3 := (cellIndex coarse).comp coarse.toOrderHom
  have hs : s = (Fin.succOrderEmb 2).toOrderHom := by
    apply DFunLike.ext
    intro i
    exact cellIndex_critical coarse i
  unfold moduleDiagram
  change ofIndexBars coarse coarse.strictMono
    (rankBarcode (reindex s (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) bars))) = _
  rw [rankBarcode_reindex, rankBarcode_barcodeModule, hs]

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.refined_diagram_points
statement:
theorem refined_diagram_points : (moduleDiagram fine input fine_finite).points =
    ((1 : ℝ), (3 : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ (1, (3 : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ (3, ⊤) ::ₘ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [moduleDiagram_refinement input coarse_fine input_constructible critical_finite,
    coarse_diagram, RealBarcode.ofIndexBars_points]
  have hf := RealBarcode.restrictAlong_succ finiteBar (show 0 < finiteBar.birth by decide)
  have he := RealBarcode.restrictAlong_succ essentialBar (show 0 < essentialBar.birth by decide)
  simp only [reindexBarcode, bars, Multiset.filterMap_cons_some _ _ _ hf,
    Multiset.filterMap_cons_some _ _ _ he, Multiset.filterMap_zero,
    Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.map_zero]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.refined_multiplicities

theorem refined_multiplicities :
    (moduleDiagram fine input fine_finite).points.count (1, (3 : WithTop ℝ)) = 2 ∧
      (moduleDiagram fine input fine_finite).points.count (3, ⊤) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [refined_diagram_points]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.shifted_sign_boundaries_and_tail
statement:
theorem shifted_sign_boundaries_and_tail :
    shiftGrid 2 coarse 0 = -1 ∧ shiftGrid 2 coarse 1 = 1 ∧
    cellIndex (shiftGrid 2 coarse) (-1) = 1 ∧
    cellIndex (shiftGrid 2 coarse) 100 = 2 ∧
    IsConstructible (shiftGrid 2 coarse) ((shift 2).obj input)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by norm_num [shiftGrid_apply, coarse_apply], by norm_num [shiftGrid_apply, coarse_apply],
    ?_, ?_, input_constructible.shift 2⟩
  · apply (cellIndex_eq_succ_iff (shiftGrid 2 coarse) (0 : Fin 2) (-1)).mpr
    refine ⟨by norm_num [shiftGrid_apply, coarse_apply], ?_⟩
    intro j hj
    fin_cases j <;> norm_num [shiftGrid_apply, coarse_apply] at *
  · exact cellIndex_of_last_le (shiftGrid 2 coarse) 100 (by
      change coarse (1 : Fin 2) - (2 : ℝ) ≤ 100
      rw [coarse_apply]
      norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.empty_refinement
statement:
theorem empty_refinement (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    shiftGrid ε empty = empty ∧ (criticalValues empty ∪ criticalValues empty).card = 0 ∧
      (moduleDiagram fine zeroInput zero_fine_finite).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, by simp [criticalValues], ?_⟩
  · apply DFunLike.ext
    intro i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  · have h : Refines empty fine := by rintro x ⟨i, _⟩; exact Fin.elim0 i
    rw [moduleDiagram_refinement zeroInput h zero_constructible (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)]
    exact moduleDiagram_empty_grid empty zeroInput

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.unequal_grid_isometry_control
statement:
theorem unequal_grid_isometry_control (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    let A := interleavingMatching input_constructible (input_constructible.refine coarse_fine)
      critical_finite fine_finite (RealInterleaving.refl ε input)
    A.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞) ∧
      Function.Bijective A.essential ∧
      bottleneck (moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite) (moduleDiagram fine input fine_finite) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨interleavingMatching_cost_le input_constructible (input_constructible.refine coarse_fine)
    critical_finite fine_finite (RealInterleaving.refl ε input), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Equiv.bijective _
  · rw [bottleneck_eq_distance input_constructible (input_constructible.refine coarse_fine)
      critical_finite fine_finite, realInterleavingDistance_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleRefinementExamples.empty_isometry_control
statement:
theorem empty_isometry_control :
    let A := interleavingMatching zero_constructible zero_constructible
      (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) (RealInterleaving.refl 0 zeroInput)
    A.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) = 0 ∧
      bottleneck (moduleDiagram empty zeroInput (fun i => Fin.elim0 i))
      (moduleDiagram empty zeroInput (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)) = 0 ∧
      Nonempty (RealInterleaving 0 zeroInput zeroInput)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp (interleavingMatching_cost_le zero_constructible zero_constructible
    (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) (RealInterleaving.refl 0 zeroInput)),
    ?_, ⟨RealInterleaving.refl 0 _⟩⟩
  rw [bottleneck_eq_distance zero_constructible zero_constructible
    (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) (fun i => Fin.elim0 i), realInterleavingDistance_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_points_map_of_monotoneOn
statement:
theorem dgm_points_map_of_monotoneOn (f : FilterFunction K α) (g : FilterFunction K β)
    (φ : α → β) (hφ : MonotoneOn φ (Set.range f.value))
    (hvalue : ∀ s, g.value s = φ (f.value s)) (n : ℕ) :
    (dgm k g n).points =
      ((dgm k f n).points.map (fun p => (φ p.1, WithTop.map φ p.2))).filter
        (fun p => (p.1 : WithTop β) ≠ p.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases exists_compatibleOrder f with ⟨e⟩
  have hg : Monotone (g.value ∘ e.enum) := by
    intro a b hab
    calc
      g.value (e.enum a) = φ (f.value (e.enum a)) := hvalue _
      _ ≤ φ (f.value (e.enum b)) :=
        hφ ⟨e.enum a, rfl⟩ ⟨e.enum b, rfl⟩ (e.monotone hab)
      _ = g.value (e.enum b) := (hvalue _).symm
  rw [← evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm k e f e.monotone n,
    ← evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm k e g hg n]
  have hpair :
      (faceTemplatePairs k e n).map (pairValues g e) =
        ((faceTemplatePairs k e n).map (pairValues f e)).map (Prod.map φ φ) := by
    rw [Multiset.map_map]
    apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
    intro p hp
    simp [pairValues, hvalue]
  have hbirth :
      (faceTemplateEssential k e n).map (birthValue g e) =
        ((faceTemplateEssential k e n).map (birthValue f e)).map φ := by
    rw [Multiset.map_map]
    apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    simp [birthValue, hvalue]
  have hfinite (P : Multiset (α × α)) :
      ((P.map (Prod.map φ φ)).filter (fun p : β × β => p.1 ≠ p.2)).map
          (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop β))) =
        (((P.filter (fun p : α × α => p.1 ≠ p.2)).map
          (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop α)))).map
            (fun p => (φ p.1, WithTop.map φ p.2))).filter
          (fun p => (p.1 : WithTop β) ≠ p.2) := by
    induction P using Multiset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | cons a s ih =>
      obtain ⟨a₁, a₂⟩ := a
      by_cases h1 : a₁ = a₂
      · subst h1
        simpa [Multiset.filter_cons] using ih
      · by_cases h2 : φ a₁ = φ a₂
        · simpa [Multiset.filter_cons, h1, h2] using ih
        · simpa [Multiset.filter_cons, h1, h2] using ih
  have hessential (P : Multiset α) :
      (P.map φ).map (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop β))) =
        ((P.map (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop α)))).map
          (fun p => (φ p.1, WithTop.map φ p.2))).filter
            (fun p => (p.1 : WithTop β) ≠ p.2) := by
    induction P using Multiset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | cons a s ih => simpa [Multiset.filter_cons] using ih
  change
    (((faceTemplatePairs k e n).map (pairValues g e)).filter
        (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)).map
        (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop β))) +
      ((faceTemplateEssential k e n).map (birthValue g e)).map
        (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop β))) =
      (((((faceTemplatePairs k e n).map (pairValues f e)).filter
        (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)).map
        (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop α))) +
      ((faceTemplateEssential k e n).map (birthValue f e)).map
        (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop α)))).map
        (fun p => (φ p.1, WithTop.map φ p.2))).filter
        (fun p => (p.1 : WithTop β) ≠ p.2)
  rw [hpair, hbirth, Multiset.map_add, Multiset.filter_add, hfinite,
    hessential]

name: TDA.Persistence.finrank_sublevelHomology_eq_countP
statement:
theorem finrank_sublevelHomology_eq_countP (f : FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ) (t : α) :
    Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (f.sublevel t) k n) =
      (dgm k f n).points.countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ t ∧ (t : WithTop α) < p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rank_sublevelHomologyMap k f n t t le_rfl]
  have h : simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.sublevel_mono (le_refl t)) n = 𝟙 _ :=
    simplicialHomologyIncl_id k (f.sublevel t) n
  rw [h, ModuleCat.hom_id, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]

name: TDA.Persistence.not_isZero_sublevelHomology_of_mem_dgm
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hcount : 0 <
      (dgm k f n).points.countP
        (fun q => q.1 ≤ p.1 ∧ (p.1 : WithTop α) < q.2) :=
    Multiset.countP_pos.2 ⟨p, hp, ⟨le_rfl, (dgm_isPositive k f n p hp)⟩⟩
  have hfin : 0 < Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (f.sublevel p.1) k n) := by
    rw [finrank_sublevelHomology_eq_countP k f n p.1]
    exact hcount
  haveI : Subsingleton (simplicialHomology (f.sublevel p.1) k n) :=
    ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hz
  have hzero : Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (f.sublevel p.1) k n) = 0 :=
    Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton (R := k)
  exact (Nat.not_lt_zero _ (hzero ▸ hfin))

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_points_eq_zero_of_isZero
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiset.eq_zero_of_forall_notMem
  intro p hp
  exact not_isZero_sublevelHomology_of_mem_dgm k f hp (h p.1)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexRightAction_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexRightAction_one (x : k) :
    vertexRightAction χ x 1 = x
proof: := by simp [vertexRightAction]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexRightAction_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexRightAction_mul (x : k) (a b : R) :
    vertexRightAction χ (vertexRightAction χ x a) b =
      vertexRightAction χ x (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertexRightAction, map_mul, mul_assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexRelation_mkQ
statement:
theorem vertexRelation_mkQ (a : R) (n : N) :
    (vertexRelation (k := k) (R := R) (N := N) χ).mkQ (a • n) =
      χ a • (vertexRelation (k := k) (R := R) (N := N) χ).mkQ n
proof:
:= by
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq (vertexRelation (k := k) (R := R) (N := N) χ)).2
  have hmem : a • n - (χ a) • n ∈ vertexRelation (k := k) (R := R) (N := N) χ :=
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨(a, n), rfl⟩
  exact hmem

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexPureBilinear_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexPureBilinear_apply (x : k) (n : N) :
    vertexPureBilinear χ x n = vertexPure χ x n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexPure_balanced
statement:
theorem vertexPure_balanced (x : k) (a : R) (n : N) :
    vertexPure χ (x * χ a) n = vertexPure χ x (a • n)
proof:
:= by
  change (x * χ a) • (vertexRelation (k := k) (R := R) (N := N) χ).mkQ n =
    x • (vertexRelation (k := k) (R := R) (N := N) χ).mkQ (a • n)
  rw [vertexRelation_mkQ]
  simp [smul_smul, mul_assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexBalancedFactor_pure
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexBalancedFactor_pure {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (f : k →ₗ[k] N →ₗ[k] V) (hbal : IsVertexBalanced χ f)
    (x : k) (n : N) :
    vertexBalancedFactor χ f hbal (vertexPure χ x n) = f x n
proof:
:= by
  let f₁ : N →ₗ[k] V := f 1
  change vertexBalancedFactor χ f hbal
      (x • (vertexRelation (k := k) (R := R) (N := N) χ).mkQ n) = f x n
  rw [map_smul]
  simp only [vertexBalancedFactor, Submodule.liftQ_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
  have houter : f x n = x • f 1 n := by
    have h := congrArg (fun g : N →ₗ[k] V => g n) (f.map_smul x (1 : k))
    simpa using h
  exact houter.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexBalanced_universal
statement:
theorem vertexBalanced_universal {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    (f : k →ₗ[k] N →ₗ[k] V) (hbal : IsVertexBalanced χ f) :
    ∃! F : VertexCoinvariants (k := k) (R := R) (N := N) χ →ₗ[k] V,
      ∀ x n, F (vertexPure χ x n) = f x n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨vertexBalancedFactor χ f hbal, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x n
    exact vertexBalancedFactor_pure χ f hbal x n
  · intro F hF
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro q
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := (vertexRelation (k := k) (R := R) (N := N) χ).mkQ_surjective q
    calc
      F ((vertexRelation (k := k) (R := R) (N := N) χ).mkQ n) = f 1 n := by
        simpa [vertexPure] using hF 1 n
      _ = vertexBalancedFactor χ f hbal
          ((vertexRelation (k := k) (R := R) (N := N) χ).mkQ n) := by
        symm
        simpa [vertexPure] using vertexBalancedFactor_pure χ f hbal 1 n

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexCharacter_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexCharacter_apply (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v f = f v.1 v.1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexCharacter_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexCharacter_one (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S) :
    vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v (1 : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) = 1
proof:
:=
  map_one (vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexCharacter_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexCharacter_mul (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (f g : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v (f * g) =
      vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v f * vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v g
proof:
:=
  map_mul (vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v) f g

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexCharacter_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexCharacter_algebraMap (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (c : k) :
    vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v (algebraMap k (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) c) = c
proof:
:=
  AlgHom.commutes (vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v) c

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexCharacter_delta
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexCharacter_delta (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v (delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq) =
      if v.1 = p ∧ v.1 = q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [vertexCharacter, delta_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexCharacter_vanishes_on_diagonalIdeal
statement:
theorem vertexCharacter_vanishes_on_diagonalIdeal
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (hf : f ∈ DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) :
    vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v f = 0
proof:
:= by
  change f v.1 v.1 = 0
  exact diagonalIdeal_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses (k := k) (S := S)
    ⟨f, hf⟩ v.1 v.1 (by
      intro hcross
      exact (not_le_of_gt v.property) hcross)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexCharacter_zero_on_diagonalIdeal
statement:
theorem vertexCharacter_zero_on_diagonalIdeal
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (f : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) :
    vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v f.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact vertexCharacter_vanishes_on_diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) v f.1 f.2

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexQuotientCharacter_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexQuotientCharacter_mk
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    vertexQuotientCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) f) =
        vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v f
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp := Ideal.Quotient.liftₐ_comp
    (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
    (vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)
    (vertexCharacter_vanishes_on_diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) v)
  have h := congrArg (fun F : Incidence (k := k) (S := S) →ₐ[k] k => F f) hcomp
  simpa [vertexQuotientCharacter, AlgHom.comp_apply, Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ_eq_mk] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.crossingDelta_killed_in_diagonalIdealVertexCoinvariants
statement:
theorem crossingDelta_killed_in_diagonalIdealVertexCoinvariants
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hcross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    (diagonalIdealVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v).mkQ
      (⟨delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq,
        diagonalIdeal_mem_delta_of_cross (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq hcross⟩ :
          DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let r := diagonalFloor (S := S) q
  have hpr : p ≤ r :=
    (le_diagonalFloor_iff_crossesDiagonal (S := S) p q).2 hcross
  have hrq : r ≤ q := diagonalFloor_le (S := S) q
  have hrqCross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) r q := by
    change r.val.2 ≤ q.val.1
    simp [r, diagonalFloor]
  let n : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) :=
    ⟨delta (k := k) (S := S) r q hrq,
      diagonalIdeal_mem_delta_of_cross (k := k) (S := S) r q hrq hrqCross⟩
  have hfactor :
      (delta (k := k) (S := S) p r hpr) • n =
        ⟨delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq,
          diagonalIdeal_mem_delta_of_cross (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq hcross⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change delta (k := k) (S := S) p r hpr * delta (k := k) (S := S) r q hrq =
      delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq
    rw [delta_mul]
    simp
  have hchar : vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (delta (k := k) (S := S) p r hpr) = 0 := by
    rw [vertexCharacter_delta]
    have hne : v.1 ≠ r := by
      intro h
      have hdiag : IsDiagonal (S := S) v.1 := by
        rw [h]
        exact diagonalFloor_isDiagonal (S := S) q
      exact (ne_of_lt v.property) hdiag
    simp [hne]
  rw [← hfactor, vertexRelation_mkQ, hchar]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.diagonalIdealVertexCoinvariants_mkQ_eq_zero
statement:
theorem diagonalIdealVertexCoinvariants_mkQ_eq_zero
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (f : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) :
    (diagonalIdealVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v).mkQ f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfspan : f.1 ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S) :=
    (mem_diagonalIdeal_iff_mem_crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S) f.1).1 f.2
  have hkill : ∀ hspan : f.1 ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S),
      ∀ hf : f.1 ∈ DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S),
        (diagonalIdealVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v).mkQ
          (⟨f.1, hf⟩ : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) = 0 := by
    intro hspan
    refine Submodule.span_induction (s := Set.range fun c :
        {r : ComparablePair S // CrossesDiagonal (S := S) r.val.1 r.val.2} =>
          delta (k := k) (S := S) c.val.val.1 c.val.val.2 c.val.property)
      (p := fun g _ => ∀ hg : g ∈ DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S),
        (diagonalIdealVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v).mkQ
          (⟨g, hg⟩ : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) = 0)
      ?mem ?zero ?add ?smul hfspan
    · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩ _
      exact crossingDelta_killed_in_diagonalIdealVertexCoinvariants
        (k := k) (S := S) v c.val.val.1 c.val.val.2 c.val.property c.property
    · intro hg
      have hz : (⟨0, hg⟩ : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) = 0 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      rw [hz]
      simp
    · intro g h hgspan hhspan ihg ihh hsum
      have hgI := crossingDeltaSpan_le_diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) g hgspan
      have hhI := crossingDeltaSpan_le_diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) h hhspan
      have hsubtype : (⟨g + h, hsum⟩ : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) =
          (⟨g, hgI⟩ : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) + ⟨h, hhI⟩ := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      rw [hsubtype, map_add, ihg hgI, ihh hhI]
      simp
    · intro c g hgspan ih hgI
      have hgI' := crossingDeltaSpan_le_diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) g hgspan
      have hsubtype : (⟨c • g, hgI⟩ : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) =
          c • (⟨g, hgI'⟩ : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      rw [hsubtype, map_smul, ih hgI']
      simp
  exact hkill hfspan f.2

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.diagonalIdealVertexCoinvariants_eq_zero
statement:
theorem diagonalIdealVertexCoinvariants_eq_zero
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (x : DiagonalIdealVertexCoinvariants (k := k) (S := S) v) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Quotient.inductionOn' x ?_
  intro f
  exact diagonalIdealVertexCoinvariants_mkQ_eq_zero (k := k) (S := S) v f

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexQuotientCharacter_smul
statement:
theorem vertexQuotientCharacter_smul
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (a : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (b : DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) :
    vertexQuotientCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v (a • b) =
      vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v a * vertexQuotientCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v b
proof:
:= by
  change vertexQuotientCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) a * b) = _
  rw [map_mul, vertexQuotientCharacter_mk]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.diagonalQuotientVertexCharacter_balances
statement:
theorem diagonalQuotientVertexCharacter_balances
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S) :
    diagonalQuotientVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v ≤
      LinearMap.ker (vertexQuotientCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.2
  rintro _ ⟨⟨a, b⟩, rfl⟩
  change vertexQuotientCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (a • b - (vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v a) • b) = 0
  rw [map_sub, vertexQuotientCharacter_smul, map_smul]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation_mk
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (b : DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) :
    diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation (k := k) (S := S) v
      ((diagonalQuotientVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v).mkQ b) =
        vertexQuotientCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v b
proof:
:= by
  change (diagonalQuotientVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v).liftQ
      (vertexQuotientCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v).toLinearMap
      (diagonalQuotientVertexCharacter_balances (k := k) (S := S) v)
      ((diagonalQuotientVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v).mkQ b) = _
  exact Submodule.liftQ_apply
    (diagonalQuotientVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v)
    (vertexQuotientCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v).toLinearMap b

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation_unit
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation_unit
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S) :
    diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation (k := k) (S := S) v
      (diagonalQuotientVertexTensorUnit (k := k) (S := S) v) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalQuotientVertexTensorUnit, diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation_mk]
  exact map_one (vertexQuotientCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.diagonalQuotientVertexTensor_reconstruct
statement:
theorem diagonalQuotientVertexTensor_reconstruct
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (x : DiagonalQuotientVertexCoinvariants (k := k) (S := S) v) :
    x = diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation (k := k) (S := S) v x •
      diagonalQuotientVertexTensorUnit (k := k) (S := S) v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ :=
    (diagonalQuotientVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v).mkQ_surjective x
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective b
  have hsmul : (a • (1 : DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S))) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) a := by
    change Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) a * 1 = _
    simp
  calc
    (diagonalQuotientVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v).mkQ
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) a) =
      vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v a •
        diagonalQuotientVertexTensorUnit (k := k) (S := S) v := by
          rw [← hsmul]
          exact vertexRelation_mkQ
            (χ := vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v) a 1
    _ = diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation (k := k) (S := S) v
          ((diagonalQuotientVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v).mkQ
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) a) ) •
          diagonalQuotientVertexTensorUnit (k := k) (S := S) v := by
            rw [diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation_mk, vertexQuotientCharacter_mk]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEquiv_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEquiv_mk
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (b : DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) :
    diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEquiv (k := k) (S := S) v
      ((diagonalQuotientVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v).mkQ b) =

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEquiv_symm_apply

@[simp] theorem diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEquiv_symm_apply (v :

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.diagonalQuotientVertexTensorUnit_ne_zero
statement:
theorem diagonalQuotientVertexTensorUnit_ne_zero
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S) :
    diagonalQuotientVertexTensorUnit (k := k) (S := S) v ≠ 0
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation_mul
statement:
theorem diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation_mul
    (v : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.StrictVertex S)
    (b c : DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) :
    diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation (k := k) (S := S) v
        ((diagonalQuotientVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v).mkQ (b * c)) =
      diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation (k := k) (S := S) v
        ((diagonalQuotientVertexRelation (k := k) (S := S) v).mkQ b) *
          vertexQuotientCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v c
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation_mk,
    diagonalQuotientVertexTensorEvaluation_mk, map_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechRipsLogScaleConsumersExamples.twoPoints_logScale_consumers_zero
statement:
theorem twoPoints_logScale_consumers_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (σ τ : ℝ)
    {A B : ℝ} (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D : Diagram ℝ)
    {Kp : Type*} [Fintype Kp] (P : Kp → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts) n) = 0 ∧
      WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric) n) -
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts) n) = 0 ∧
      PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric) n) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts) n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hD := twoPoints_logScale_diagrams_eq hn
  simp [hD]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechRipsLogScaleConsumersExamples.twoPoints_logScale_bound_zero
statement:
theorem twoPoints_logScale_bound_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (σ : ℝ)
    {A B : ℝ} :
    WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (bottleneck (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric) n)
        (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts) n)).toReal = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Fintype.card
      (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric) n).finiteOccurrences = 0 := by
    rw [Multiset.card_coe]
    rw [twoPoints_rips_logDgm_pos hn]
    simp [finitePart]
  have hc : Fintype.card
      (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts) n).finiteOccurrences = 0 := by
    rw [Multiset.card_coe]
    rw [twoPoints_cech_logDgm_pos hn]
    simp [finitePart]
  rw [hr, hc, twoPoints_logBottleneck_pos hn]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.CechRipsLogScaleConsumersExamples.triangle_logScale_embedding_arctan
statement:
theorem triangle_logScale_embedding_arctan {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (σ : ℝ)
    {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter Triangle.metric) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter Triangle.pts) n)‖ ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter Triangle.metric) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter Triangle.pts) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa using
    Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le_arctan (ZMod 2)
      Triangle.metric Triangle.pts Triangle.metric_dist hn σ hC

name: TDA.Persistence.CechRipsLogScaleConsumersExamples.filledReal_scale_embedding_le
statement:
theorem filledReal_scale_embedding_le (σ : ℝ) {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) (filledReal.scale 2 two_pos) 1) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) filledReal 1)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (logDgm (ZMod 2) (filledReal.scale 2 two_pos) 1).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (logDgm (ZMod 2) filledReal 1).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  refine norm_diagramEmbedding_logDgm_sub_le_log (ZMod 2)
    (f := filledReal.scale 2 two_pos) (g := filledReal) (c := 2) le_rfl one_le_two ?_ ?_
      filledReal_positive σ hA hB w
  · intro s
    rw [FilterFunction.scale_value]
    have h : (0 : ℝ) ≤ filledReal.value s := by
      change (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((s.val.card - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
      exact Nat.cast_nonneg _
    linarith
  · intro s
    rw [FilterFunction.scale_value]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechRipsLogScaleConsumersExamples.zero_weight_logScale_consumers
statement:
theorem zero_weight_logScale_consumers {V X : Type} [LinearOrder V] [Fintype V]
    [PseudoMetricSpace X] (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (_hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) {n : ℕ} (_hn : 1 ≤ n) (σ : ℝ)
    {Kp : Type*} [Fintype Kp] (P : Kp → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 0 le_rfl)
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter d) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 0 le_rfl)
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter p) n) = 0 ∧
      PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 0 le_rfl) P
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter d) n) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 0 le_rfl) P
          (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter p) n) = 0 ∧
      0 < 2 * 0 + √2 * π / (2 * |(1 : ℝ)|) ∧
      0 < 2 * 0 + 3 * √(π / 2) / 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by simp [TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.zero_weight_embedding],
    by simp [TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.zero_weight_image], ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hsqrt_two : 0 < √(2 : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hpi : 0 < (π : ℝ) := Real.pi_pos
    positivity
  · have hsqrt : 0 < √(π / 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr Real.pi_div_two_pos
    positivity
