name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.crossFreeLR_collapse
statement:
private theorem crossFreeLR_collapse
    (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N)
    (W V : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    (a : module (R := R) W ⟶ M) (b : module (R := R) V ⟶ N) :
    crossFreeLR ε W V ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseRight i W V a b) =
      collapseLeft i W V a b ≫ i.φ
proof:
:= by
  apply sumHom_ext W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))
  · have ht : sumInl (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V ≫ collapseRight i W V a b = delaySource ε W N (a ≫ i.φ) := sumInl_sumDesc _ _ _ _
    have hs : sumInl W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫ collapseLeft i W V a b =
        a := sumInl_sumDesc _ _ _ _
    calc
      _ = (sumInl W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫ crossFreeLR ε W V) ≫
          (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseRight i W V a b) :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = ((delayedShiftIso ε W).hom ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (sumInl (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V)) ≫
          (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseRight i W V a b) :=
        congrArg (· ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseRight i W V a b))
          (sumInl_crossFreeLR (R := R) ε W V)
      _ = (delayedShiftIso ε W).hom ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
          (sumInl (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V ≫ collapseRight i W V a b) :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
          (congrArg ((delayedShiftIso ε W).hom ≫ ·) ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).map_comp _ _).symm)
      _ = (delayedShiftIso ε W).hom ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (delaySource ε W N (a ≫ i.φ)) :=
        congrArg (fun f => (delayedShiftIso ε W).hom ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map f) ht
      _ = a ≫ i.φ := delayedShiftIso_delaySource ε W N (a ≫ i.φ)
      _ = _ := (congrArg (· ≫ i.φ) hs).symm.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _)
  · have ht : sumInr (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V ≫ collapseRight i W V a b = b := sumInr_sumDesc _ _ _ _
    have hs : sumInr W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫ collapseLeft i W V a b =
        delaySource ε V M (b ≫ i.ψ) := sumInr_sumDesc _ _ _ _
    calc
      _ = (sumInr W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫ crossFreeLR ε W V) ≫
          (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseRight i W V a b) :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (delayedAdvance ε V ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (sumInr (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V)) ≫
          (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseRight i W V a b) :=
        congrArg (· ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseRight i W V a b))
          (sumInr_crossFreeLR (R := R) ε W V)
      _ = delayedAdvance ε V ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
          (sumInr (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V ≫ collapseRight i W V a b) :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
          (congrArg (delayedAdvance ε V ≫ ·) ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).map_comp _ _).symm)
      _ = delayedAdvance ε V ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (b) :=
        congrArg (fun f => delayedAdvance ε V ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map f) ht
      _ = delaySource ε V M (b ≫ i.ψ) ≫ i.φ := (delaySource_comp_interleaving i V b).symm
      _ = _ := (congrArg (· ≫ i.φ) hs).symm.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.crossFreeRL_collapse
statement:
private theorem crossFreeRL_collapse
    (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N)
    (W V : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    (a : module (R := R) W ⟶ M) (b : module (R := R) V ⟶ N) :
    crossFreeRL ε W V ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseLeft i W V a b) =
      collapseRight i W V a b ≫ i.ψ
proof:
:= by
  apply sumHom_ext (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V
  · have ht : sumInl W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫ collapseLeft i W V a b = a := sumInl_sumDesc _ _ _ _
    have hs : sumInl (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V ≫ collapseRight i W V a b =
        delaySource ε W N (a ≫ i.φ) := sumInl_sumDesc _ _ _ _
    calc
      _ = (sumInl (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V ≫ crossFreeRL ε W V) ≫
          (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseLeft i W V a b) :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (delayedAdvance ε W ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (sumInl W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))))) ≫
          (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseLeft i W V a b) :=
        congrArg (· ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseLeft i W V a b))
          (sumInl_crossFreeRL (R := R) ε W V)
      _ = delayedAdvance ε W ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
          (sumInl W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫ collapseLeft i W V a b) :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
          (congrArg (delayedAdvance ε W ≫ ·) ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).map_comp _ _).symm)
      _ = delayedAdvance ε W ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (a) :=
        congrArg (fun f => delayedAdvance ε W ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map f) ht
      _ = delaySource ε W N (a ≫ i.φ) ≫ i.ψ := (delaySource_comp_interleaving i.symm W a).symm
      _ = _ := (congrArg (· ≫ i.ψ) hs).symm.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _)
  · have ht : sumInr W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫ collapseLeft i W V a b = delaySource ε V M (b ≫ i.ψ) := sumInr_sumDesc _ _ _ _
    have hs : sumInr (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V ≫ collapseRight i W V a b =
        b := sumInr_sumDesc _ _ _ _
    calc
      _ = (sumInr (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V ≫ crossFreeRL ε W V) ≫
          (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseLeft i W V a b) :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = ((delayedShiftIso ε V).hom ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (sumInr W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))))) ≫
          (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseLeft i W V a b) :=
        congrArg (· ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (collapseLeft i W V a b))
          (sumInr_crossFreeRL (R := R) ε W V)
      _ = (delayedShiftIso ε V).hom ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
          (sumInr W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫ collapseLeft i W V a b) :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
          (congrArg ((delayedShiftIso ε V).hom ≫ ·) ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).map_comp _ _).symm)
      _ = (delayedShiftIso ε V).hom ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (delaySource ε V M (b ≫ i.ψ)) :=
        congrArg (fun f => (delayedShiftIso ε V).hom ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map f) ht
      _ = b ≫ i.ψ := delayedShiftIso_delaySource ε V M (b ≫ i.ψ)
      _ = _ := (congrArg (· ≫ i.ψ) hs).symm.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumDesc_comp_zero
statement:
private theorem sumDesc_comp_zero
    (W V : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    {A B : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (f : module (R := R) W ⟶ A) (g : module (R := R) V ⟶ A) (ρ : A ⟶ B)
    (hf : f ≫ ρ = 0) (hg : g ≫ ρ = 0) : sumDesc W V f g ≫ ρ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply sumHom_ext W V
  · exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (· ≫ ρ) (sumInl_sumDesc W V f g)).trans
        (hf.trans (by simp)))
  · exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      ((congrArg (· ≫ ρ) (sumInr_sumDesc W V f g)).trans
        (hg.trans (by simp)))

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.chosenMap_eq
statement:
private theorem chosenMap_eq
    (P : Presentation.{u,0,w} (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ))
    (V : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) (f : module (R := R) V ⟶ P.presented) :
    P.chosenMap V (fun v => f.app (V.grade v) (birth V v)) = f
proof:
:=
  (lift_unique V P.presented _ f (fun _ => rfl)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.leftCollapse_eq
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg
    (sumDesc D.generators (E.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) D.cover)
    (chosenMap_eq D (E.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) (leftValues D E i))

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.rightCollapse_eq
statement:
private theorem rightCollapse_eq :
    (sumCommIso (R := R) E.generators (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))).inv ≫
      E.adjoinCollapse (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) (rightChosen D E i) =
        collapseRight i D.generators E.generators D.cover E.cover
proof:
:= by
  apply sumHom_ext (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) E.generators
  · calc
      _ = sumInr E.generators (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫
          E.adjoinCollapse (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) (rightChosen D E i) := by
        simp only [← Category.assoc, sumCommIso, sumInl_sumDesc]
      _ = rightValues D E i :=
        (E.sumInr_adjoinCollapse _ _).trans (chosenMap_eq E _ _)
      _ = _ := (sumInl_sumDesc _ _ _ _).symm
  · calc
      _ = sumInl E.generators (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫
          E.adjoinCollapse (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) (rightChosen D E i) := by
        simp only [← Category.assoc, sumCommIso, sumInr_sumDesc]
      _ = E.cover := E.sumInl_adjoinCollapse _ _
      _ = _ := (sumInr_sumDesc _ _ _ _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.primitiveLeft_vanish
proof:
:= by
  change (leftAugmented D E i).relationMap ≫
    collapseLeft i D.generators E.generators D.cover E.cover = 0
  rw [← leftCollapse_eq]
  exact D.adjoinRelation_collapse _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.primitiveRight_vanish
proof:
:= by
  change ((rightAugmented D E i).relationMap ≫
      (sumCommIso (R := R) E.generators (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))).hom) ≫
    collapseRight i D.generators E.generators D.cover E.cover = 0
  have hR :
      (sumCommIso (R := R) E.generators (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))).hom ≫
        collapseRight i D.generators E.generators D.cover E.cover =
      E.adjoinCollapse (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) (rightChosen D E i) := by
    calc
      _ = (sumCommIso (R := R) E.generators (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))).hom ≫
          ((sumCommIso (R := R) E.generators (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))).inv ≫
            E.adjoinCollapse (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) (rightChosen D E i)) :=
        congrArg ((sumCommIso (R := R) E.generators
          (D.generators.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))).hom ≫ ·) (rightCollapse_eq D E i).symm
      _ = _ := by simp only [Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
    ((congrArg ((rightAugmented D E i).relationMap ≫ ·) hR).trans
      (E.adjoinRelation_collapse _ _))

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.allLeft_vanish
proof:
:= by
  apply sumDesc_comp_zero
  · exact primitiveLeft_vanish D E i
  · apply (delaySource_comp_zero_iff ε (D.crossData E i).Y₂
      ((D.crossData E i).r₂ ≫ crossFreeRL ε D.generators E.generators)
      (collapseLeft i D.generators E.generators D.cover E.cover)).mpr
    calc
      _ = (D.crossData E i).r₂ ≫
          (collapseRight i D.generators E.generators D.cover E.cover ≫ i.ψ) :=
        congrArg ((D.crossData E i).r₂ ≫ ·)
          (crossFreeRL_collapse i D.generators E.generators D.cover E.cover)
      _ = ((D.crossData E i).r₂ ≫
          collapseRight i D.generators E.generators D.cover E.cover) ≫ i.ψ :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [primitiveRight_vanish]; simp

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.allRight_vanish
proof:
:= by
  apply sumDesc_comp_zero
  · apply (delaySource_comp_zero_iff ε (D.crossData E i).Y₁
      ((D.crossData E i).r₁ ≫ crossFreeLR ε D.generators E.generators)
      (collapseRight i D.generators E.generators D.cover E.cover)).mpr
    calc
      _ = (D.crossData E i).r₁ ≫
          (collapseLeft i D.generators E.generators D.cover E.cover ≫ i.φ) :=
        congrArg ((D.crossData E i).r₁ ≫ ·)
          (crossFreeLR_collapse i D.generators E.generators D.cover E.cover)
      _ = ((D.crossData E i).r₁ ≫
          collapseLeft i D.generators E.generators D.cover E.cover) ≫ i.φ :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [primitiveLeft_vanish]; simp
  · exact primitiveRight_vanish D E i

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.crossData_isFinite
statement:
theorem crossData_isFinite (hD : D.IsFinite) (hE : E.IsFinite) :
    (D.crossData E i).IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Finite D.generators.Carrier := hD.1
  let : Finite E.generators.Carrier := hE.1
  let : Finite D.relations.Carrier := hD.2
  let : Finite E.relations.Carrier := hE.2
  let : Fintype D.generators.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let : Fintype E.generators.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let : Fintype D.relations.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let : Fintype E.relations.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite _
  change Finite D.generators.Carrier ∧ Finite E.generators.Carrier ∧
    Finite (D.relations.Carrier ⊕ E.generators.Carrier) ∧
    Finite (E.relations.Carrier ⊕ D.generators.Carrier)
  exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_crossPresentation
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_crossPresentation
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (hN : FinitelyPresented (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ) N)
    (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N) :
    ∃ C : CrossData.{u,w} (R := R) (n := n) ε, C.IsFinite ∧
      Nonempty (C.leftPresentation.presented ≅ M) ∧
      Nonempty (C.rightPresentation.presented ≅ N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨eD⟩⟩ := hM
  obtain ⟨E, hE, ⟨eE⟩⟩ := hN
  let j := i.congr eD.symm eE.symm
  exact ⟨D.crossData E j, D.crossData_isFinite E j hD hE,
    ⟨D.crossDataLeftIso E j ≪≫ eD⟩, ⟨D.crossDataRightIso E j ≪≫ eE⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_interleaving_iff_crossPresentation
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_interleaving_iff_crossPresentation
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (hN : FinitelyPresented (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ) N) :
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ε M N) ↔
      ∃ C : CrossData.{u,w} (R := R) (n := n) ε, C.IsFinite ∧
        Nonempty (C.leftPresentation.presented ≅ M) ∧
        Nonempty (C.rightPresentation.presented ≅ N)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i⟩
    exact finitelyPresented_exists_crossPresentation hM hN i
  · rintro ⟨C, _, ⟨eM⟩, ⟨eN⟩⟩
    exact ⟨C.interleavingOfIso eM eN⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.compact_plans
statement: private theorem compact_plans (μ ν : ProbabilityMeasure Space) : IsCompact (plans μ ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed : IsClosed (plans μ ν) :=
    (isClosed_eq (ProbabilityMeasure.continuous_map continuous_fst) continuous_const).inter
      (isClosed_eq (ProbabilityMeasure.continuous_map continuous_snd) continuous_const)
  have htight : IsTightMeasureSet {(γ : ProbabilityMeasure (Space × Space)).toMeasure |
      γ ∈ plans μ ν} := by
    apply IsTightMeasureSet.prodMk
    · apply (isTightMeasureSet_singleton (μ := μ.toMeasure)).subset
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact congrArg ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure hγ.1
    · apply (isTightMeasureSet_singleton (μ := ν.toMeasure)).subset
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨γ, hγ, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact congrArg ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure hγ.2
  simpa only [hclosed.closure_eq] using isCompact_closure_of_isTightMeasureSet htight

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.truncation_coe
statement:
private theorem truncation_coe (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (n : ℕ) (z : Space × Space) :
    (truncation p hp n z : ℝ≥0∞) = min (collapsedPowerCost p z) (n : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  change ENNReal.ofReal (min (dist z.1 z.2 ^ p) (n : ℝ)) = _
  simp [collapsedPowerCost, ENNReal.ofReal_min]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.cost_lsc
proof:
:= by
  have heq (γ : ProbabilityMeasure (Space × Space)) :
      (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂γ.toMeasure) =
        ⨆ n : ℕ, ∫⁻ z, (truncation p hp n z : ℝ≥0∞) ∂γ.toMeasure := by
    rw [← lintegral_iSup (fun n => (truncation p hp n).continuous.measurable.coe_nnreal_ennreal)
      (by intro i j hij z; simpa only [truncation_coe] using
        min_le_min_left (collapsedPowerCost p z) (show (i : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ j from Nat.cast_le.mpr hij))]
    apply lintegral_congr
    intro z
    simp_rw [truncation_coe]
    rw [← inf_iSup_eq, ENNReal.iSup_natCast, inf_top_eq]
  simp_rw [heq]
  apply lowerSemicontinuous_iSup
  intro n
  exact ((FiniteMeasure.continuous_lintegral_boundedContinuousFunction (truncation p hp n)).comp
    ProbabilityMeasure.toFiniteMeasure_continuous).lowerSemicontinuous

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.probability_minimizer
statement:
private theorem probability_minimizer (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (μ ν : ProbabilityMeasure Space) :
    ∃ γ : ProbabilityMeasure (Space × Space), γ ∈ plans μ ν ∧
      IsMinOn (fun τ : ProbabilityMeasure (Space × Space) =>
        ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂τ.toMeasure) (plans μ ν) γ
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (plans μ ν).Nonempty := ⟨μ.prod ν, by simp [plans]⟩
  exact ((cost_lsc p hp).lowerSemicontinuousOn _).exists_isMinOn hne (compact_plans μ ν)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoir_minimizer
statement:
private theorem reservoir_minimizer (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R)
    (hμR : μ univ ≤ R) (hνR : ν univ ≤ R) :
    ∃ γ : Measure (Space × Space),
      γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R ∧
      γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R ∧
      (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂γ) = reservoirPowerValue p μ ν R
proof:
:= by
  let A := normalizedReservoirProbability μ R hRtop hRpos hμR
  let B := normalizedReservoirProbability ν R hRtop hRpos hνR
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hmin⟩ := probability_minimizer p hp A B
  have scale_back (ξ : Measure Interior) :
      R • normalizedReservoirMeasure ξ R = reservoirMeasure ξ R := by
    rw [normalizedReservoirMeasure, smul_smul,
      ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hRpos.ne' hRtop.ne, one_smul]
  let γ := R • η.toMeasure
  have hη₁ : η.toMeasure.map Prod.fst = normalizedReservoirMeasure μ R :=
    congrArg ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure hη.1
  have hη₂ : η.toMeasure.map Prod.snd = normalizedReservoirMeasure ν R :=
    congrArg ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure hη.2
  have hγ₁ : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R := by
    rw [Measure.map_smul, hη₁]
    exact scale_back μ
  have hγ₂ : γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R := by
    rw [Measure.map_smul, hη₂]
    exact scale_back ν
  refine ⟨γ, hγ₁, hγ₂, le_antisymm ?_
    (reservoirPowerValue_le_plan p μ ν R γ hγ₁ hγ₂)⟩
  unfold reservoirPowerValue
  refine le_iInf fun σ => le_iInf fun hσ => ?_
  have hσmass : σ univ = R := by
    have h := congrArg (fun m : Measure Space => m univ) hσ.1
    simpa [Measure.map_apply measurable_fst MeasurableSet.univ,
      reservoirMeasure_mass μ R hμR] using h
  have hprob : IsProbabilityMeasure (R⁻¹ • σ) := ⟨by
    simp only [Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hσmass,
      ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hRpos.ne' hRtop.ne]⟩
  let τ : ProbabilityMeasure (Space × Space) := ⟨R⁻¹ • σ, hprob⟩
  have hτ : τ ∈ plans A B := by
    constructor
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change (R⁻¹ • σ).map Prod.fst = normalizedReservoirMeasure μ R
      rw [Measure.map_smul, hσ.1]
      rfl
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change (R⁻¹ • σ).map Prod.snd = normalizedReservoirMeasure ν R
      rw [Measure.map_smul, hσ.2]
      rfl
  have hcost : R * (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂η.toMeasure) ≤
      R * (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂τ.toMeasure) := by
    exact mul_le_mul' le_rfl (hmin hτ)
  change R * (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂η.toMeasure) ≤
    R * (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂(R⁻¹ • σ)) at hcost
  simpa only [γ, lintegral_smul_measure, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
    ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hRpos.ne' hRtop.ne, one_mul] using hcost

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.exists_minimizing_reservoirPlan
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_reservoirPlan (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R)
    (htotal : μ univ + ν univ ≤ R) :
    ∃ γ : Measure (Space × Space),
      γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R ∧
      γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R ∧
      (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂γ) = reservoirPowerValue p μ ν R
proof:
:=
  reservoir_minimizer p hp μ ν R hRtop hRpos
    (le_self_add.trans htotal) (le_add_self.trans htotal)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    ∃ π : Measure PlanSpace, IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) = boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν
proof:
:= by
  let R := μ univ + ν univ + 1
  have hRtop : R < ∞ := ENNReal.add_lt_top.mpr
    ⟨ENNReal.add_lt_top.mpr ⟨measure_lt_top μ _, measure_lt_top ν _⟩, by simp⟩
  have hRpos : 0 < R := (zero_lt_one : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < 1).trans_le le_add_self
  have htotal : μ univ + ν univ ≤ R := le_self_add
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ₁, hγ₂, hγcost⟩ := exists_minimizing_reservoirPlan p (by linarith) μ ν R hRtop hRpos htotal
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hcost⟩ := Reverse.exists_boundaryPlan_cost_le p hp γ μ ν R hγ₁ hγ₂
  refine ⟨π, hπ, le_antisymm ?_ (boundaryTransportPowerValue_le_plan p hπ)⟩
  exact hcost.trans_eq (hγcost.trans
    (boundaryTransportPowerValue_eq_reservoirPowerValue p hp μ ν R hRtop htotal).symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.exists_finite_cost_minimizing_boundaryPlan
statement:
theorem exists_finite_cost_minimizing_boundaryPlan (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hμ : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞)
    (hν : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂ν) < ∞) :
    ∃ π : Measure PlanSpace, IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) = boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) < ∞
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hcost⟩ := exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan p hp μ ν
  exact ⟨π, hπ, hcost, hcost ▸ boundaryTransportPowerValue_lt_top p μ ν hμ hν⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan_rooted
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan_rooted (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    ∃ π : Measure PlanSpace, IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) = boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) ^ (1 / p) = boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hcost⟩ := exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan p hp μ ν
  exact ⟨π, hπ, hcost, congrArg (fun a : ℝ≥0∞ => a ^ (1 / p)) hcost⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteDimensional_range_of_factorization
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_range_of_factorization
    {U : Type v} {V : Type w} {W : Type z}
    [AddCommGroup U] [Module k U] [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module k W] [FiniteDimensional k V]
    (f : U →ₗ[k] W) (g : U →ₗ[k] V) (h : V →ₗ[k] W)
    (hf : f = h.comp g) : FiniteDimensional k (LinearMap.range f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hf]
  exact Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (LinearMap.range_comp_le_range g h)

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.qTame_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem qTame_of_finiteDimensional (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ t, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)) : M.QTame
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  let := hM a
  exact LinearMap.finiteDimensional_range _

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.finiteDimensional_range_structureMap
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_range_structureMap (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (a : ℝ)
    [FiniteDimensional k (N.obj (a + (ε : ℝ)))] :
    FiniteDimensional k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M
      (show a ≤ (a + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) from
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg).trans
          (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg))))
proof:
:= by
  let f : M.obj a →ₗ[k] N.obj (a + (ε : ℝ)) := (i.φ.app a).hom
  let g : N.obj (a + (ε : ℝ)) →ₗ[k] M.obj ((a + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)) :=
    (i.ψ.app (a + (ε : ℝ))).hom
  apply finiteDimensional_range_of_factorization _ f g
  exact congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom (i.φ_ψ_structureMap a).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.filterInterpolate_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem filterInterpolate_zero (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    filterInterpolate f g 0 (le_refl 0) (by norm_num) = f
proof:
:= by
  cases f
  simp [filterInterpolate]

name: TDA.Persistence.filterInterpolate_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem filterInterpolate_one (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    filterInterpolate f g 1 (by norm_num) (le_refl 1) = g
proof:
:= by
  cases g
  simp [filterInterpolate]

name: TDA.Persistence.intervalFilter_value
statement:
@[simp] theorem intervalFilter_value (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (σ : TotalFace K) :
    (intervalFilter f g t).value σ = (1 - t) * f.value σ + t * g.value σ
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.faceSupDifference_nonneg
statement:
theorem faceSupDifference_nonneg (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    0 ≤ faceSupDifference f g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold faceSupDifference
  exact (Finset.le_fold_max 0).mpr (Or.inl le_rfl)

name: TDA.Persistence.abs_face_difference_le
statement:
theorem abs_face_difference_le (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (σ : TotalFace K) :
    |f.value σ - g.value σ| ≤ faceSupDifference f g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold faceSupDifference
  exact (Finset.le_fold_max _).mpr
    (Or.inr ⟨σ, Finset.mem_univ _, le_rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.faceSupDifference_self
statement:
theorem faceSupDifference_self (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    faceSupDifference f f = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · unfold faceSupDifference
    apply (Finset.fold_max_le 0).mpr
    simp
  · exact faceSupDifference_nonneg f f

name: TDA.Persistence.faceSupDifference_of_isEmpty
statement:
theorem faceSupDifference_of_isEmpty (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    [IsEmpty (TotalFace K)] : faceSupDifference f g = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [faceSupDifference]

name: TDA.Persistence.faceDifference_affine
statement:
private theorem faceDifference_affine (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (σ τ : TotalFace K) (t : ℝ) :
    faceDifference f g σ τ t =
      (f.value σ - f.value τ) + t * faceDifferenceSlope f g σ τ
proof:
:= by
  unfold faceDifference faceLine faceDifferenceSlope
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.faceDifference_continuous
statement:
private theorem faceDifference_continuous (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (σ τ : TotalFace K) : Continuous (faceDifference f g σ τ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold faceDifference faceLine
  fun_prop

name: TDA.Persistence.faceDifference_eq_zero_iff_crossing
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceDifference_affine]
  unfold faceCrossingTime
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply (eq_div_iff hsl).mpr
    nlinarith
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    field_simp
    ring

name: TDA.Persistence.faceDifference_eq_zero_of_slope_zero
statement:
private theorem faceDifference_eq_zero_of_slope_zero (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (σ τ : TotalFace K) (hsl : faceDifferenceSlope f g σ τ = 0)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : faceDifference f g σ τ t = 0) (s : ℝ) :
    faceDifference f g σ τ s = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceDifference_affine, hsl, mul_zero, add_zero] at ht ⊢
  exact ht

name: TDA.Persistence.zero_mem_faceCrossingTimes
statement:
private theorem zero_mem_faceCrossingTimes (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    0 ∈ faceCrossingTimes f g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [faceCrossingTimes]

name: TDA.Persistence.one_mem_faceCrossingTimes
statement:
private theorem one_mem_faceCrossingTimes (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    1 ∈ faceCrossingTimes f g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [faceCrossingTimes]

name: TDA.Persistence.faceCrossingTimes_subset_Icc
statement:
private theorem faceCrossingTimes_subset_Icc (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    ∀ t ∈ faceCrossingTimes f g, t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro t ht
  simp only [faceCrossingTimes, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at ht
  rcases ht with rfl | rfl | ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  · norm_num
  · norm_num
  · exact hp.2

name: TDA.Persistence.crossing_mem_faceCrossingTimes
statement:
private theorem crossing_mem_faceCrossingTimes (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (σ τ : TotalFace K) (hsl : faceDifferenceSlope f g σ τ ≠ 0)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (hz : faceDifference f g σ τ t = 0) :
    t ∈ faceCrossingTimes f g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heq := (faceDifference_eq_zero_iff_crossing f g σ τ hsl t).mp hz
  subst t
  unfold faceCrossingTimes
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image,
    Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨(σ, τ), ⟨hsl, ht⟩, rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.nonpos_on_closed_segment
statement:
private theorem nonpos_on_closed_segment (d : ℝ → ℝ) (hd : Continuous d)
    {a m b : ℝ} (ham : a < m) (hmb : m < b)
    (hmid : d m ≤ 0)
    (hzero : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo a b, d r = 0 → ∀ x, d x = 0)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Icc a b) : d t ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hdm0 : d m = 0
  · simp [hzero m ⟨ham, hmb⟩ hdm0 t]
  by_contra hnot
  have hdt : 0 < d t := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hdm : d m < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne hmid hdm0
  rcases le_total t m with htm | hmt
  · have htm' : t < m := lt_of_le_of_ne htm (by
      intro he
      subst t
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hmid) hdt)
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hz⟩ :=
      (intermediate_value_Ioo' htm'.le hd.continuousOn
        (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (d m) (d t) from ⟨hdm, hdt⟩))
    have hr' : r ∈ Set.Ioo a b := ⟨lt_of_le_of_lt ht.1 hr.1, hr.2.trans hmb⟩
    exact hdm0 (hzero r hr' hz m)
  · have hmt' : m < t := lt_of_le_of_ne hmt (by
      intro he
      subst t
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hmid) hdt)
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hz⟩ :=
      (intermediate_value_Ioo hmt'.le hd.continuousOn
        (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioo (d m) (d t) from ⟨hdm, hdt⟩))
    have hr' : r ∈ Set.Ioo a b := ⟨ham.trans hr.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hr.2 ht.2⟩
    exact hdm0 (hzero r hr' hz m)

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_segment_compatibleOrder
statement:
private theorem exists_segment_compatibleOrder (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 1)
    (hgap : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo a b, r ∉ faceCrossingTimes f g) :
    ∃ (m : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (e : CompatibleOrder (intervalFilter f g m)),
      ∀ (t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1), a ≤ t → t ≤ b →
        Monotone ((intervalFilter f g t).value ∘ e.enum)
proof:
:= by
  let m : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨(a + b) / 2, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩
  have ham : a < (m : ℝ) := by dsimp [m]; linarith
  have hmb : (m : ℝ) < b := by dsimp [m]; linarith
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_compatibleOrder (intervalFilter f g m)
  refine ⟨m, e, ?_⟩
  intro t hat htb i j hij
  apply sub_nonpos.mp
  change faceDifference f g (e.enum i) (e.enum j) t ≤ 0
  apply nonpos_on_closed_segment
    (faceDifference f g (e.enum i) (e.enum j))
    (faceDifference_continuous f g _ _) ham hmb
  · apply sub_nonpos.mpr
    exact e.monotone hij
  · intro r hr hz x
    by_cases hsl : faceDifferenceSlope f g (e.enum i) (e.enum j) = 0
    · exact faceDifference_eq_zero_of_slope_zero f g _ _ hsl hz x
    · have hrunit : r ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
        ⟨ha.trans hr.1.le, hr.2.le.trans hb⟩
      exact (hgap r hr (crossing_mem_faceCrossingTimes f g _ _ hsl hrunit hz)).elim
  · exact ⟨hat, htb⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.faceLine_sub_abs_le
statement:
private theorem faceLine_sub_abs_le (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (σ : TotalFace K) {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t) :
    |faceLine f g σ t - faceLine f g σ s| ≤
      (t - s) * faceSupDifference f g
proof:
:= by
  have h : faceLine f g σ t - faceLine f g σ s =
      (t - s) * (g.value σ - f.value σ) := by
    unfold faceLine
    ring
  rw [h, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hst)]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (by simpa only [abs_sub_comm] using abs_face_difference_le f g σ)
    (sub_nonneg.mpr hst)

name: TDA.Persistence.templateCoordinates_eq_orderedQ
statement:
private theorem templateCoordinates_eq_orderedQ (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {f : FilterFunction K ℝ} (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (h : FilterFunction K ℝ) (hh : Monotone (h.value ∘ e.enum)) :
    dgm k h n = orderedQ _ _ (templateCoordinates k e n h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm k e h hh n]
  apply evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_orderedQ_of_enumerations k e h hh n
  · classical
    simp only [templateCoordinates, List.ofFn_comp', List.ofFn_get]
    change Multiset.map (pairValues h e) (↑(faceTemplatePairs k e n).toList) = _
    rw [Multiset.coe_toList]
  · classical
    simp only [templateCoordinates, List.ofFn_comp', List.ofFn_get]
    change Multiset.map (birthValue h e) (↑(faceTemplateEssential k e n).toList) = _
    rw [Multiset.coe_toList]

name: TDA.Persistence.templateCoordinates_norm_le
statement:
private theorem templateCoordinates_norm_le (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) {h : FilterFunction K ℝ}
    (e : CompatibleOrder h) (n : ℕ)
    (s t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hst : (s : ℝ) ≤ t) :
    ‖templateCoordinates k e n (intervalFilter f g t) -
      templateCoordinates k e n (intervalFilter f g s)‖ ≤
        ((t : ℝ) - s) * faceSupDifference f g
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 ≤ ((t : ℝ) - s) * faceSupDifference f g :=
    mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hst) (faceSupDifference_nonneg f g)
  rw [norm_prod_le_iff]
  constructor
  · apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hr).mpr
    intro i
    rw [norm_prod_le_iff]
    constructor
    · change |faceLine f g (e.enum ((faceTemplatePairs k e n).toList.get i).1) t -
          faceLine f g (e.enum ((faceTemplatePairs k e n).toList.get i).1) s| ≤ _
      exact faceLine_sub_abs_le f g _ hst
    · change |faceLine f g (e.enum ((faceTemplatePairs k e n).toList.get i).2) t -
          faceLine f g (e.enum ((faceTemplatePairs k e n).toList.get i).2) s| ≤ _
      exact faceLine_sub_abs_le f g _ hst
  · apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg hr).mpr
    intro i
    change |faceLine f g (e.enum ((faceTemplateEssential k e n).toList.get i)) t -
        faceLine f g (e.enum ((faceTemplateEssential k e n).toList.get i)) s| ≤ _
    exact faceLine_sub_abs_le f g _ hst

name: TDA.Persistence.segment_bottleneck_le
statement:
private theorem segment_bottleneck_le (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    {h : FilterFunction K ℝ} (e : CompatibleOrder h)
    (s t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hst : (s : ℝ) ≤ t)
    (hs : Monotone ((intervalFilter f g s).value ∘ e.enum))
    (ht : Monotone ((intervalFilter f g t).value ∘ e.enum)) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (intervalFilter f g s) n)
      (dgm k (intervalFilter f g t) n) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (((t : ℝ) - s) * faceSupDifference f g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [templateCoordinates_eq_orderedQ k e n _ hs,
    templateCoordinates_eq_orderedQ k e n _ ht]
  have hnorm := templateCoordinates_norm_le k f g e n s t hst
  rw [norm_sub_rev] at hnorm
  exact (bottleneck_orderedQ_le_norm _ _ _ _).trans
    (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hnorm)

name: TDA.Persistence.gap_bottleneck_le
statement:
private theorem gap_bottleneck_le (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a < b) (hb : b ≤ 1)
    (hgap : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo a b, r ∉ faceCrossingTimes f g) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (intervalFilter f g ⟨a, ⟨ha, hab.le.trans hb⟩⟩) n)
      (dgm k (intervalFilter f g ⟨b, ⟨ha.trans hab.le, hb⟩⟩) n) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((b - a) * faceSupDifference f g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, e, he⟩ := exists_segment_compatibleOrder f g ha hab hb hgap
  exact segment_bottleneck_le k f g n e
    ⟨a, ⟨ha, hab.le.trans hb⟩⟩ ⟨b, ⟨ha.trans hab.le, hb⟩⟩ hab.le
    (he _ le_rfl hab.le) (he _ hab.le le_rfl)

name: TDA.Persistence.crossing_telescope
statement:
private theorem crossing_telescope (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hab : a ≤ b) (hb : b ≤ 1) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (intervalFilter f g ⟨a, ⟨ha, hab.trans hb⟩⟩) n)
      (dgm k (intervalFilter f g ⟨b, ⟨ha.trans hab, hb⟩⟩) n) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((b - a) * faceSupDifference f g)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let C (x y : ℝ) :=
    (faceCrossingTimes f g).filter (fun r => r ∈ Set.Ioo x y)
  suffices h : ∀ q : ℕ, ∀ (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hxy : x ≤ y) (hy : y ≤ 1),
      (C x y).card = q →
      bottleneck (dgm k (intervalFilter f g ⟨x, ⟨hx, hxy.trans hy⟩⟩) n)
        (dgm k (intervalFilter f g ⟨y, ⟨hx.trans hxy, hy⟩⟩) n) ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal ((y - x) * faceSupDifference f g) by
    exact h (C a b).card a b ha hab hb rfl
  intro q
  induction q using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h q ih =>
    intro x y hx hxy hy hcard
    by_cases heq : x = y
    · subst y
      simp [bottleneck_self]
    have hxy' : x < y := lt_of_le_of_ne hxy heq
    by_cases hnone : C x y = ∅
    · apply gap_bottleneck_le k f g n hx hxy' hy
      intro r hr hmem
      have : r ∈ C x y := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hmem, hr⟩
      simp [hnone] at this
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hnone
      have hrS : r ∈ faceCrossingTimes f g := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).1
      have hrxy : r ∈ Set.Ioo x y := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2
      have hleft : (C x r).card < q := by
        rw [← hcard]
        apply Finset.card_lt_card
        apply (Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset ?_).mpr
          ⟨r, hr, by simp [C]⟩
        intro z hz
        rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hz with ⟨hzS, hzr⟩
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hzS, ⟨hzr.1, hzr.2.trans hrxy.2⟩⟩
      have hright : (C r y).card < q := by
        rw [← hcard]
        apply Finset.card_lt_card
        apply (Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset ?_).mpr
          ⟨r, hr, by simp [C]⟩
        intro z hz
        rcases Finset.mem_filter.mp hz with ⟨hzS, hzr⟩
        exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hzS, ⟨hrxy.1.trans hzr.1, hzr.2⟩⟩
      have h₁ := ih (C x r).card hleft x r hx hrxy.1.le (hrxy.2.le.trans hy) rfl
      have h₂ := ih (C r y).card hright r y (hx.trans hrxy.1.le) hrxy.2.le hy rfl
      calc
        bottleneck (dgm k (intervalFilter f g ⟨x, _⟩) n)
            (dgm k (intervalFilter f g ⟨y, _⟩) n) ≤
          bottleneck (dgm k (intervalFilter f g ⟨x, _⟩) n)
            (dgm k (intervalFilter f g ⟨r, _⟩) n) +
          bottleneck (dgm k (intervalFilter f g ⟨r, _⟩) n)
            (dgm k (intervalFilter f g ⟨y, _⟩) n) := bottleneck_triangle _ _ _
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((r - x) * faceSupDifference f g) +
            ENNReal.ofReal ((y - r) * faceSupDifference f g) := add_le_add h₁ h₂
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal ((y - x) * faceSupDifference f g) := by
          rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add
            (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hrxy.1.le) (faceSupDifference_nonneg f g))
            (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hrxy.2.le) (faceSupDifference_nonneg f g))]
          congr 1
          ring

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_strict
statement:
theorem finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_strict (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    (finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g).SortedLT
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sortedLT_sort _

name: TDA.Persistence.mem_finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_iff
statement:
theorem mem_finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_iff (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) :
    t ∈ finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g ↔ t ∈ faceCrossingTimes f g
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.mem_sort (· ≤ ·)

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_endpoints
statement:
theorem finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_endpoints (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    0 ∈ finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g ∧
      1 ∈ finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g ∧
      ∀ t ∈ finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g, 0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (mem_finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_iff f g 0).mpr
      (zero_mem_faceCrossingTimes f g)
  · exact (mem_finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_iff f g 1).mpr
      (one_mem_faceCrossingTimes f g)
  · intro t ht
    exact faceCrossingTimes_subset_Icc f g t
      ((mem_finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_iff f g t).mp ht)

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_consecutive_gap
statement:
theorem finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_consecutive_gap (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g).length)
    (hij : j.val = i.val + 1) (r : ℝ)
    (hr : r ∈ finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g) :
    ¬ ((finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g).get i < r ∧
       r < (finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g).get j)
proof:
:= by
  let L := finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g
  have horder : L.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) := by
    exact Finset.pairwise_sort _ _
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp hr
  intro hbetween
  by_cases hqi : q ≤ i
  · have hle := horder.rel_get_of_le hqi
    rw [hq] at hle
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) hbetween.1
  · have hjq : j ≤ q := by
      apply Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr
      have hiq : i < q := lt_of_not_ge hqi
      omega
    have hle := horder.rel_get_of_le hjq
    rw [hq] at hle
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) hbetween.2

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_segment
statement:
theorem finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_segment (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g)
    (hb : b ∈ finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g) (hab : a < b)
    (hadj : ∀ r ∈ finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g, ¬ (a < r ∧ r < b)) :
    ∃ (m : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (e : CompatibleOrder (intervalFilter f g m)),
      ∀ (t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1), a ≤ t → t ≤ b →
        Monotone ((intervalFilter f g t).value ∘ e.enum)
proof:
:= by
  have hends := finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_endpoints f g
  exact exists_segment_compatibleOrder f g (hends.2.2 a ha).1 hab
    (hends.2.2 b hb).2 (by
      intro r hr hmem
      exact hadj r ((mem_finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_iff f g r).mpr hmem) hr)

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_consecutive_order
statement:
theorem finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_consecutive_order
    (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g).length)
    (hij : j.val = i.val + 1) :
    ∃ (m : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
      (e : CompatibleOrder (intervalFilter f g m)),
      ∀ (t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1),
        (finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g).get i ≤ t →
        t ≤ (finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g).get j →
          Monotone ((intervalFilter f g t).value ∘ e.enum)
proof:
:= by
  have hij' : i < j := Fin.lt_iff_val_lt_val.mpr (by omega)
  have hlt := (finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_strict f g).pairwise.rel_get_of_lt hij'
  exact finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_segment f g
    ((finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g).get_mem i)
    ((finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision f g).get_mem j) hlt
    (finiteFilterCrossingSubdivision_consecutive_gap f g i j hij)

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_dgm_le_faceSupDifference
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_le_faceSupDifference (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k f n) (dgm k g n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (faceSupDifference f g)
proof:
:= by
  have h := crossing_telescope k f g n (a := 0) (b := 1)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  simpa [intervalFilter, filterInterpolate_zero, filterInterpolate_one] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_empty_faces
statement:
theorem dgm_empty_faces (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (n : ℕ) [IsEmpty (TotalFace K)] :
    (dgm k f n).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hm : faceCount K = 0 := Fintype.card_eq_zero
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_compatibleOrder f
  rw [← evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm k e f e.monotone n]
  simp [evaluateFaceTemplate, faceTemplatePairs_empty k e n hm,
    faceTemplateEssential_empty k e n hm]

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_dgm_self
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_self (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k f n) (dgm k f n) = 0
proof:
:=
  bottleneck_self _

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleBarcodeExamples.initial_zero
statement: private theorem initial_zero : IsZero ((barcodeModule (k := ℚ) bars).obj 0)
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton ((barcodeModule (k := ℚ) bars).obj 0) := by
    change Subsingleton (∀ i : Fin bars.toList.length, FiniteInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) (bars.toList.get i) 0)
    refine ⟨fun x y => funext (fun i => ?_)⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hb := bars_birth_pos _ (Multiset.mem_toList.mp (List.get_mem bars.toList i))
    have hn : ¬ (bars.toList.get i).alive 0 := by
      simp only [FiniteInterval.alive, Fin.val_zero]
      omega
    have hx : (x i : ℚ) = 0 := by
      simpa only [FiniteInterval.fiber, if_neg hn, Submodule.mem_bot] using (x i).property
    have hy : (y i : ℚ) = 0 := by
      simpa only [FiniteInterval.fiber, if_neg hn, Submodule.mem_bot] using (y i).property
    exact hx.trans hy.symm
  exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostSimilarityExamples.negative_diagonal_shift
proof:

    (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) (-5)
