  norm_num [scaleFinitePair, repeated, Function.comp_def, repeated_root] at h ⊢
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostSimilarityExamples.zero_scale
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_scale hp x y (le_refl 0), zero_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostSimilarityExamples.empty_inputs
statement:
private theorem empty_inputs {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (t : ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p
        (Prod.map (· + t) (· + t) ∘ (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ))
        (Prod.map (· + t) (· + t) ∘ (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)) = 0 ∧
      finitePBoundaryTransportCost p
        (scaleFinitePair a ∘ (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ))
        (scaleFinitePair a ∘ (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_translate]
    exact finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty hp _ _
  · rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_scale hp _ _ ha,
      finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty hp, mul_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostSimilarityExamples.first_order_scaling
proof:
:= by
  have h := finitePBoundaryTransportCost_scale (p := 1) (by norm_num) repeated
    (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) (a := 3) (by norm_num)
  norm_num [scaleFinitePair, repeated, Function.comp_def, repeated_root] at h ⊢

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostSimilarityExamples.vertical_shift_changes_cost
statement:
private theorem vertical_shift_changes_cost :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost 1 (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ))
        (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) = 1 ∧
      finitePBoundaryTransportCost 1 (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0, 4) : ℝ × ℝ))
        (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) = 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;>
    rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost,
      finitePMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right] <;>
    norm_num [diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.singleton_count
statement:
private theorem singleton_count {n : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval n) (p : FiniteInterval n → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] : ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval n)).countP p = if p I then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.cons_zero, Multiset.countP_cons]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.single_barcode
statement:
private theorem single_barcode (I : FiniteInterval 3) :
    rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I) = {I}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {I}) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).mpr
      intro i j hij
      rw [rank_barcodeMap]
      change Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (intervalMap (k := ℚ) I hij)) = _
      rw [intervalMap_finrank_range]
      simp only [interval_alive_endpoints_iff I hij, singleton_count]
    _ = {I} := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.fiber_le
statement:
private theorem fiber_le (I J : FiniteInterval 3) (hb : J.birth ≤ I.birth)
    (hd : I.death = J.death) (i : Fin 3) : I.fiber (k := ℚ) i ≤ J.fiber (k := ℚ) i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (if I.alive i then (⊤ : Submodule ℚ ℚ) else ⊥) ≤
    (if J.alive i then (⊤ : Submodule ℚ ℚ) else ⊥)
  by_cases hi : I.alive i
  · have hj : J.alive i := ⟨hb.trans hi.1, hi.2.trans_eq hd⟩
    rw [if_pos hi, if_pos hj]
  · rw [if_neg hi]
    exact bot_le

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.inclusion_injective
statement:
private theorem inclusion_injective (I J : FiniteInterval 3) (hb : J.birth ≤ I.birth)
    (hd : I.death = J.death) (i : Fin 3) : Function.Injective ((inclusion I J hb hd).app i).hom
proof:
:=
  Submodule.inclusion_injective (fiber_le I J hb hd i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.first_injective
statement: private theorem first_injective (i : Fin 3) : Function.Injective (first.app i).hom
proof:
:=
  inclusion_injective late middle (by decide) rfl i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.second_injective
statement: private theorem second_injective (i : Fin 3) : Function.Injective (second.app i).hom
proof:
:=
  inclusion_injective middle early (by decide) rfl i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.unequal_birth_embedding
statement:
theorem unequal_birth_embedding :
    ∃ i : BarcodeOccurrence 3 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) late)),
      (occurrence _ i).birth = 2 ∧
      (occurrence _ (monoEmbedding first first_injective i)).birth = 1 ∧
      (occurrence _ (monoEmbedding first first_injective i)).death = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hsource : (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) late)).toList.length = 1 := by
    rw [single_barcode]; simp
  let i : BarcodeOccurrence 3 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) late)) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  have hget (I : FiniteInterval 3) (a : BarcodeOccurrence 3 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I))) :
      occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a = I := by
    have hmem := List.get_mem (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)).toList a
    have hmem' : occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈
        rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I) := Multiset.mem_toList.mp hmem
    have : occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈ ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3)) := by
      exact Eq.mp (congrArg (fun B : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3) =>
        occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈ B) (single_barcode I)) hmem'
    simpa using this
  exact ⟨i, congrArg FiniteInterval.birth (hget late i),
    congrArg FiniteInterval.birth (hget middle _), congrArg FiniteInterval.death (hget middle _)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.three_birth_composition
statement:
theorem three_birth_composition :
    monoEmbedding (first ≫ second) (fun i => (second_injective i).comp (first_injective i)) =
      (monoEmbedding first first_injective).trans (monoEmbedding second second_injective)
proof:
:=
  monoEmbedding_comp first second first_injective second_injective

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.finite_death_count
statement:
theorem finite_death_count :
    deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) short)) 1 2 = 1 ∧
      deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) short)) 1 2 =
        Module.finrank ℚ (deathSubspace (intervalModule (k := ℚ) short) 1 2 (by decide) (by decide))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, deathPrefixCount_eq_finrank _ _ _ (by decide) (by decide)⟩
  simp [single_barcode, deathPrefixCount, singleton_count, short]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.duplicate_occurrences_distinct
statement:
theorem duplicate_occurrences_distinct :
    ∃ i j : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode duplicates),
      i ≠ j ∧ monoEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) i ≠
        monoEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) j
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (rankBarcode duplicates).toList.length = 2 := by
    change (rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) (Multiset.replicate 2 oneBar))).toList.length = 2
    rw [rankBarcode_barcodeModule]
    simp
  let i : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode duplicates) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let j : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode duplicates) := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  have hne : i ≠ j := by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; simp [i, j] at this
  exact ⟨i, j, hne, fun h => hne ((monoEmbedding _ _).injective h)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.duplicate_terminal_count
statement: theorem duplicate_terminal_count : deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode duplicates) 0 1 = 2
proof:
:= by
  change deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) (Multiset.replicate 2 oneBar))) 0 1 = 2
  rw [rankBarcode_barcodeModule]
  unfold deathPrefixCount
  rw [Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.replicate_one, Multiset.countP_cons, singleton_count]
  norm_num [oneBar]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.empty_chain
statement:
theorem empty_chain : IsEmpty (BarcodeOccurrence 0 (rankBarcode empty)) ∧
    monoEmbedding (𝟙 empty) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) = Function.Embedding.refl _
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, monoEmbedding_id empty⟩
  change IsEmpty (Fin (rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 0)))).toList.length)
  rw [rankBarcode_barcodeModule]
  simp only [Multiset.toList_zero, List.length_nil]
  exact inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoMatchingExamples.rank_domination_insufficient
statement:
theorem rank_domination_insufficient :
    (∀ (i j : Fin 3) (h : i ≤ j),
      structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {short}) i j h ≤
        structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {early}) i j h) ∧
    ¬ ∃ e : BarcodeOccurrence 3 ({short} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3)) ↪
        BarcodeOccurrence 3 ({early} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3)),
      ∀ i, (occurrence {early} (e i)).death = (occurrence {short} i).death
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j h
    rw [rank_barcodeMap, rank_barcodeMap]
    rw [singleton_count, singleton_count]
    have hi := i.isLt
    have hj := j.isLt
    simp [early, short]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    have h := he ⟨0, by simp⟩
    simp [occurrence, early, short] at h

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.kernel_id_short
proof:
:= by
  apply (kernel_translationTrivial_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro i x hx
  change x = 0 at hx
  simp [hx]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.cokernel_id_short
proof:
:= by
  apply (cokernel_translationTrivial_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro i
  change _ ≤ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : input.obj _ →ₗ[ℚ] input.obj _)
  rw [LinearMap.range_id]
  exact le_top

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.sum_id
statement:
private theorem sum_id (i : RealBarcode.Occurrences D) :
    RealInduced.sumMap grid (𝟙 input) i = some i
proof:
:= by
  unfold RealInduced.sumMap
  rw [inducedMap_id]
  simp only [Option.map_some, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.identity_labels
statement:
theorem identity_labels (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    (∀ p : D.finiteOccurrences, (identityMatching δ).finite p = some p) ∧
      (∀ b : D.essentialOccurrences, (identityMatching δ).essential b = b)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p
    exact (RealInduced.matching_finite_eq_some_iff grid (𝟙 input) δ δ
      (kernel_id_short δ) (cokernel_id_short δ) p p).mpr (sum_id (.inl p))
  · intro b
    exact (RealInduced.matching_essential_eq_iff grid (𝟙 input) δ δ
      (kernel_id_short δ) (cokernel_id_short δ) b b).mpr (sum_id (.inr b))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.diagram_points
statement:
private theorem diagram_points : D.points =
    ((0 : ℝ), (3 : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ (0, (3 : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ (1, ⊤) ::ₘ (1, ⊤) ::ₘ 0
proof:
:= by
  change (ofIndexBars grid grid.strictMono (rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) bars))).points = _
  rw [rankBarcode_barcodeModule, RealBarcode.ofIndexBars_points]
  simp only [bars, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.map_zero]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.multiplicities
statement:
theorem multiplicities : D.points.count (0, (3 : WithTop ℝ)) = 2 ∧
    D.points.count (1, ⊤) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagram_points]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.finite_value
statement: private theorem finite_value (p : D.finiteOccurrences) : p.1 = (0, 3)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p.1 ∈ finitePart D.points := Multiset.coe_mem
  have hm := Eq.mp (congrArg (fun s : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ) =>
    p.1 ∈ finitePart s) diagram_points) hp
  change p.1 ∈ ((0, 3) ::ₘ (0, 3) ::ₘ (0 : Multiset (ℝ × ℝ))) at hm
  simpa using hm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.distinct_duplicate_labels
statement:
theorem distinct_duplicate_labels (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    (∃ p q : D.finiteOccurrences, p ≠ q ∧ p.1 = q.1 ∧
      (identityMatching δ).finite p = some p ∧ (identityMatching δ).finite q = some q) ∧
    (∃ b c : D.essentialOccurrences, b ≠ c ∧ b.1 = c.1 ∧
      (identityMatching δ).essential b = b ∧ (identityMatching δ).essential c = c)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (finitePart D.points).count (0, 3) = 2 := by
    rw [diagram_points]
    change ((0, 3) ::ₘ (0, 3) ::ₘ (0 : Multiset (ℝ × ℝ))).count (0, 3) = 2
    norm_num
  have he : (essentialPart D.points).count 1 = 2 := by
    rw [diagram_points]
    change ((1 : ℝ) ::ₘ 1 ::ₘ (0 : Multiset ℝ)).count 1 = 2
    norm_num
  constructor
  · let p : D.finiteOccurrences := ⟨(0, 3), ⟨0, by omega⟩⟩
    let q : D.finiteOccurrences := ⟨(0, 3), ⟨1, by omega⟩⟩
    refine ⟨p, q, ?_, rfl, (identity_labels δ).1 p, (identity_labels δ).1 q⟩
    intro h
    have hn := congrArg (fun x : D.finiteOccurrences => x.2.val) h
    norm_num [p, q] at hn
  · let b : D.essentialOccurrences := ⟨1, ⟨0, by omega⟩⟩
    let c : D.essentialOccurrences := ⟨1, ⟨1, by omega⟩⟩
    refine ⟨b, c, ?_, rfl, (identity_labels δ).2 b, (identity_labels δ).2 c⟩
    intro h
    have hn := congrArg (fun x : D.essentialOccurrences => x.2.val) h
    norm_num [b, c] at hn

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.strict_long_unique
statement:
theorem strict_long_unique (p : D.finiteOccurrences) :
    (∃! q, (identityMatching 2).finite p = some q) ∧
      (∃! q, (identityMatching 2).finite q = some p)
proof:
:= by
  have h := RealInduced.matching_bounds grid (𝟙 input) 2 2 (kernel_id_short 2) (cokernel_id_short 2)
  have hl : (2 : ℝ) < p.1.2 - p.1.1 := by rw [finite_value p]; norm_num
  exact ⟨h.covers_long_source p hl, h.covers_long_target p hl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.threshold_matched
statement:
theorem threshold_matched (p : D.finiteOccurrences) :
    p.1.2 - p.1.1 = 3 ∧ (identityMatching 3).finite p = some p
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, (identity_labels 3).1 p⟩
  rw [finite_value p]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.essential_every_threshold
statement:
theorem essential_every_threshold (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    (∀ b : D.essentialOccurrences, (identityMatching δ).essential b = b) ∧
      Function.Bijective (identityMatching δ).essential
proof:
:=
  ⟨(identity_labels δ).2, (identityMatching δ).essential.bijective⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.zero_parameter
statement:
theorem zero_parameter : RealMatchingBounds 0 0 (identityMatching 0) ∧
    (∀ p : D.finiteOccurrences, (identityMatching 0).finite p = some p) ∧
      (∀ b : D.essentialOccurrences, (identityMatching 0).essential b = b)
proof:
:=
  ⟨RealInduced.matching_bounds grid (𝟙 input) 0 0 (kernel_id_short 0) (cokernel_id_short 0),
    identity_labels 0⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.empty_matching
statement:
theorem empty_matching (δK δC : ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching (RealInduced.diagram emptyGrid emptyModule).finiteOccurrences
        (RealInduced.diagram emptyGrid emptyModule).finiteOccurrences
        (RealInduced.diagram emptyGrid emptyModule).essentialOccurrences
        (RealInduced.diagram emptyGrid emptyModule).essentialOccurrences,
      RealMatchingBounds δK δC A
proof:
:= by
  let hk : TranslationTrivial (FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation emptyGrid δK)
      (FiniteConstructible.le_sampleTranslation emptyGrid δK) (finiteKernel (𝟙 emptyModule)) :=
    fun i => Fin.elim0 i
  let hc : TranslationTrivial (FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation emptyGrid δC)
      (FiniteConstructible.le_sampleTranslation emptyGrid δC) (finiteCokernel (𝟙 emptyModule)) :=
    fun i => Fin.elim0 i
  exact ⟨RealInduced.matching emptyGrid (𝟙 emptyModule) δK δC hk hc,
    RealInduced.matching_bounds emptyGrid (𝟙 emptyModule) δK δC hk hc⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInducedMatchingExamples.duplicate_zero_cost
statement:
theorem duplicate_zero_cost :
    ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences D.finiteOccurrences
        D.essentialOccurrences D.essentialOccurrences,
      A.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) = 0 ∧
        Function.Bijective A.essential ∧
        D.points.count (0, (3 : WithTop ℝ)) = 2 ∧ D.points.count (1, ⊤) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hD : D.IsPositive := ofIndexBars_isPositive _ _ _
  have H : ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences
        (translateDiagram D (-(0 : ℝ))).finiteOccurrences D.essentialOccurrences
        (translateDiagram D (-(0 : ℝ))).essentialOccurrences,
      RealMatchingBounds (0 + 0) (0 + 0) A := by
    rw [neg_zero, translateDiagram_zero]
    exact ⟨identityMatching 0, by simpa only [zero_add] using zero_parameter.1⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := H
  exact ⟨A.untranslateTarget (-(0 : ℝ)),
    nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp (RealMatchingBounds.untranslateTarget_cost_le hD hD 0 A hA),
    (A.untranslateTarget (-(0 : ℝ))).essential.bijective, multiplicities⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightMatrixUnitAction_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightMatrixUnitAction_apply
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (m : M) :
    rightMatrixUnitAction (k := k) (S := S) M p q hpq m =
      IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq • m
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightIncidenceMatrixUnit_mul
    (p q r s : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq *
        IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r s hrs =
      if h : s = p then
        IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r q
          (by subst p; exact hrs.trans hpq)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
  simp only [MulOpposite.unop_mul,
    IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit, MulOpposite.unop_op]
  rw [FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.delta_mul]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightIncidence_diagonal_sum
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightIncidence_diagonal_sum :
    (∑ p : PairPoset S,
      IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl) =
      (1 : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit]
  rw [← Finset.op_sum, IncidenceQuotientSimple.incidence_sum_diagonal_delta]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.diagonalProjector_idempotent
statement:
theorem diagonalProjector_idempotent
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) (p : PairPoset S)
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p
        (diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p m) =
      diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p m
proof:
:= by
  change IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
      p p le_rfl •
        (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
          p p le_rfl • m) =
      IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
        p p le_rfl • m
  rw [smul_smul, rightIncidenceMatrixUnit_mul]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.mem_vertexFiber_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_vertexFiber_iff
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) (p : PairPoset S)
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    m ∈ vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p ↔
      diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p m = m
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.mem_eqLocus

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.projectToVertexFiber_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem projectToVertexFiber_val
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) (p : PairPoset S)
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m : M) =
      diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p m
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.diagonalProjector_apply_vertex
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalProjector_apply_vertex
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) (p q : PairPoset S)
    (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M q) :
    diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p x = if p = q then x else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpq : p = q
  · subst q
    simpa using (mem_vertexFiber_iff (k := k) (S := S) M p x).1 x.property
  · have hmul :
        IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl *
            IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) q q le_rfl = 0 := by
      rw [rightIncidenceMatrixUnit_mul]
      have hqp : q ≠ p := fun h => hpq h.symm
      simp [hqp]
    rw [if_neg hpq]
    change IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
        p p le_rfl • (x : M) = 0
    have hx : IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
        q q le_rfl • (x : M) = (x : M) := x.property
    rw [← hx, smul_smul, hmul]
    exact zero_smul (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) (x : M)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.diagonalProjector_sum
statement:
theorem diagonalProjector_sum
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    (∑ p : PairPoset S, diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M p m) = m
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ p : PairPoset S,
    IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m) = m
  rw [← Finset.sum_smul, rightIncidence_diagonal_sum, one_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.vertexStructureMap_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexStructureMap_val
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    {p q : PairPoset S} (hpq : p ≤ q) (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p) :
    (vertexStructureMap (k := k) (S := S) M hpq x : M) =
      IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq • (x : M)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.vertexRepresentation_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexRepresentation_obj
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) (p : PairPoset S) :
    (vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M).obj p =
      VertexSpace (k := k) (S := S) M p
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.mapOnVertexFiber_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapOnVertexFiber_val
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (p : PairPoset S) (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p) :
    (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p x : N) = f.hom x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightMatrixUnit_smul_vertex
statement:
theorem rightMatrixUnit_smul_vertex
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    {p q : PairPoset S} (hpq : p ≤ q) {r : PairPoset S}
    (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M r) :
    IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq •
        (x : M) =
      if r = p then
        IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq •
          (x : M)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : r = p
  · subst r
    simp
  · have hmul :
        IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq *
            IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r r le_rfl = 0 := by
      rw [rightIncidenceMatrixUnit_mul]
      simp [hr]
    have hx : IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
        r r le_rfl • (x : M) = (x : M) :=
      (mem_vertexFiber_iff (k := k) (S := S) M r x).1 x.property
    rw [if_neg hr, ← hx, smul_smul, hmul]
    exact zero_smul (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) (x : M)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightMatrixUnit_smul_projector
statement:
theorem rightMatrixUnit_smul_projector
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    {p q : PairPoset S} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq • m =
      IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq •
        (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m : M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdecomp :
      (∑ r : PairPoset S, (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M r m : M)) = m := by
    calc
      (∑ r : PairPoset S, (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M r m : M)) =
          ∑ r : PairPoset S, diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M r m := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro r hr
        exact projectToVertexFiber_val (k := k) (S := S) M r m
      _ = m := diagonalProjector_sum (k := k) (S := S) M m
  calc
    IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq • m =
        IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq •
          ∑ r : PairPoset S, (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M r m : M) := by
            rw [hdecomp]
    _ = ∑ r : PairPoset S,
          IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq •
            (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M r m : M) := by
          change rightMatrixUnitAction (k := k) (S := S) M p q hpq
            (∑ r : PairPoset S, (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M r m : M)) = _
          rw [map_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro r hr
          exact rightMatrixUnitAction_apply (k := k) (S := S) M p q hpq
            (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M r m)
    _ = IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq •
          (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m : M) := by
          calc
            (∑ r : PairPoset S,
                IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq •
                  (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M r m : M)) =
                ∑ r : PairPoset S, if r = p then
                  IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq •
                    (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M r m : M) else 0 := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro r hr
              exact rightMatrixUnit_smul_vertex (k := k) (S := S) M hpq
                (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M r m)
            _ = IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq •
                (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m : M) := by simp

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_apply
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (α : vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M ⟶
      vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) N)
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α m =
      ∑ p : PairPoset S,
        ((naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α p
          (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m)) : N)
proof:
:= by
  simp [reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_apply_vertex
statement:
theorem reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_apply_vertex
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (α : vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M ⟶
      vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) N)
    (p : PairPoset S) (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p) :
    reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α x =
      ((naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α p x) : N)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_apply]
  calc
    (∑ q : PairPoset S,
      ((naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α q
        (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M q x)) : N)) =
        ∑ q : PairPoset S, if q = p then
          ((naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α p x) : N) else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro q hq
      by_cases hqp : q = p
      · subst q
        have hproj : projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p x = x := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          simp only [projectToVertexFiber_val]
          exact (mem_vertexFiber_iff (k := k) (S := S) M p x).1 x.property
        simp [hproj]
      · have hzero : projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M q x = 0 := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          change diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) M q x = 0
          have hx := diagonalProjector_apply_vertex (k := k) (S := S) M q p x
          simpa [hqp] using hx
        rw [hzero]
        simp only [if_neg hqp]
        exact congrArg (fun y : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) N q => (y : N))
          ((naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α q).map_zero)
    _ = ((naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α p x) : N) := by simp

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.projectToVertexFiber_reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation
statement:
theorem projectToVertexFiber_reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (α : vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M ⟶
      vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) N)
    (p : PairPoset S) (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) N p
      (reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α m) =
        naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α p
          (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_apply]
  change diagonalProjector (k := k) (S := S) N p
      (∑ r : PairPoset S,
        (naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α r
          (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M r m) : N)) = _
  rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single p]
  · simpa using diagonalProjector_apply_vertex (k := k) (S := S) N p p
      (naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α p
        (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m))
  · intro r hr hrne
    have hpr : p ≠ r := fun h => hrne h.symm
    have h := diagonalProjector_apply_vertex (k := k) (S := S) N p r
      (naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α r
        (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M r m))
    rw [if_neg hpr] at h
    simpa using h
  · simp

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.naturalTransformationComponent_naturality
statement:
theorem naturalTransformationComponent_naturality
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (α : vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M ⟶
      vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) N)
    {p q : PairPoset S} (hpq : p ≤ q) (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p) :
    naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α q
        (vertexStructureMap (k := k) (S := S) M hpq x) =
      vertexStructureMap (k := k) (S := S) N hpq
        (naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α p x)
proof:
:= by
  change (α.app q).hom (vertexStructureMap (k := k) (S := S) M hpq x) =
    vertexStructureMap (k := k) (S := S) N hpq ((α.app p).hom x)
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) (α.naturality (homOfLE hpq))

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_map_rightMatrixUnit
statement:
theorem reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_map_rightMatrixUnit
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (α : vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M ⟶
      vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) N)
    {p q : PairPoset S} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α
        (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
          p q hpq • m) =
      IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
        p q hpq • reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α m
proof:
:= by
  calc
    reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α
        (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
          p q hpq • m) =
        reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α
          (vertexStructureMap (k := k) (S := S) M hpq
            (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m)) := by
          congr 1
          rw [rightMatrixUnit_smul_projector]
          rw [← vertexStructureMap_val]
    _ = (naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α q
          (vertexStructureMap (k := k) (S := S) M hpq
            (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m)) : N) := by
          rw [reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_apply_vertex]
    _ = (vertexStructureMap (k := k) (S := S) N hpq
          (naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α p
            (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m)) : N) := by
          exact congrArg (fun x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) N q => (x : N))
            (naturalTransformationComponent_naturality (k := k) (S := S) α hpq _)
    _ = IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
          p q hpq • reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α m := by
          rw [rightMatrixUnit_smul_projector (k := k) (S := S) N hpq
            (reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α m)]
          rw [projectToVertexFiber_reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation]
          rw [vertexStructureMap_val]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit_scalar_mul
statement:
private theorem rightIncidenceMatrixUnit_scalar_mul
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (a : k) :
    MulOpposite.op
        (a • FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq) =
      IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq *
        algebraMap k (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]
  change MulOpposite.op
      (algebraMap k (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) a *
        FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq) = _
  rw [MulOpposite.op_mul]
  simp [IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightIncidence_eq_matrixUnit_sum
statement:
private theorem rightIncidence_eq_matrixUnit_sum
    (r : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    r = ∑ cp : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.ComparablePair (S := S),
      IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
          cp.val.1 cp.val.2 cp.property *
        algebraMap k (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))
          (MulOpposite.unop r cp.val.1 cp.val.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    r = MulOpposite.op (MulOpposite.unop r) := (MulOpposite.op_unop r).symm
    _ = MulOpposite.op
          (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S)
            (MulOpposite.unop r)) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidence_eq_deltaExpansion
              (k := k) (S := S) (MulOpposite.unop r)]
    _ = ∑ cp : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.ComparablePair (S := S),
          IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
              cp.val.1 cp.val.2 cp.property *
            algebraMap k (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))
              (MulOpposite.unop r cp.val.1 cp.val.2) := by
          rw [FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.deltaExpansion, Finset.op_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro cp hcp
          exact rightIncidenceMatrixUnit_scalar_mul (k := k) (S := S)
            cp.val.1 cp.val.2 cp.property
            (MulOpposite.unop r cp.val.1 cp.val.2)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.reconstructVertexNaturalTransformationRLinear_vertexFunctor_map
statement:
theorem reconstructVertexNaturalTransformationRLinear_vertexFunctor_map
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    reconstructVertexNaturalTransformationRLinear (k := k) (S := S)
      ((vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map f) = f.hom
proof:
:= by
  let α : vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M ⟶
      vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) N := by
    change vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M ⟶
      vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) N
    exact (vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map f
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  change reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α m = f.hom m
  rw [reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_apply]
  calc
    (∑ p : PairPoset S,
      (naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S)
        α p
        (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m) : N)) =
      ∑ p : PairPoset S, f.hom (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m : M) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        change (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p
          (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m) : N) = _
        exact mapOnVertexFiber_val (k := k) (S := S) f p
          (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m)
    _ = f.hom m := by
        rw [← map_sum]
        congr 1
        exact diagonalProjector_sum (k := k) (S := S) M m

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.vertexFunctor_map_naturalTransformationToRightIncidenceHom
statement:
theorem vertexFunctor_map_naturalTransformationToRightIncidenceHom
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (α : vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) M ⟶
      vertexRepresentation (k := k) (S := S) N) :
    (vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map
        (naturalTransformationToRightIncidenceHom (k := k) (S := S) α) = α
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext p
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change VertexSpace (k := k) (S := S) M p at x
  let x' : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p := x
  apply Subtype.ext
  change reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) α (x' : M) =
    (naturalTransformationComponent (k := k) (S := S) α p x' : N)
  exact reconstructVertexNaturalTransformation_apply_vertex (k := k) (S := S) α p x'

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.vertexFunctor_map_app_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexFunctor_map_app_hom
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (p : PairPoset S) :
    (((vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map f).app p).hom =
      mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.projectToVertexFiber_map
statement:
theorem projectToVertexFiber_map
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (p : PairPoset S) (m : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) N p (f.hom m) =
      mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p
        (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p m)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
      p p le_rfl • f.hom m = f.hom
        (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
          p p le_rfl • m)
  rw [← f.hom.map_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightIncidenceMap_injective_iff_vertexFibers
statement:
theorem rightIncidenceMap_injective_iff_vertexFibers
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    Function.Injective f.hom ↔
      ∀ p : PairPoset S, Function.Injective (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf p x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply hf
    exact congrArg (fun z : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) N p => (z : N)) hxy
  · intro hf x y hxy
    have hproj : ∀ p : PairPoset S,
        projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p x =
          projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p y := by
      intro p
      apply hf p
      rw [← projectToVertexFiber_map, ← projectToVertexFiber_map, hxy]
    calc
      x = ∑ p : PairPoset S,
          (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p x : M) :=
            (diagonalProjector_sum (k := k) (S := S) M x).symm
      _ = ∑ p : PairPoset S,
          (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p y : M) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro p hp
            exact congrArg Subtype.val (hproj p)
      _ = y := diagonalProjector_sum (k := k) (S := S) M y

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightIncidenceMap_surjective_iff_vertexFibers
statement:
theorem rightIncidenceMap_surjective_iff_vertexFibers
    {M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    Function.Surjective f.hom ↔
      ∀ p : PairPoset S, Function.Surjective (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hf p y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hf (y : N)
    refine ⟨projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p x, ?_⟩
    calc
      mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p
          (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p x) =
        projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) N p (f.hom x) :=
          (projectToVertexFiber_map (k := k) (S := S) f p x).symm
      _ = projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) N p y :=
        congrArg (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) N p) hx
      _ = y := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact (mem_vertexFiber_iff (k := k) (S := S) N p y).1 y.property
  · intro hf y
    choose x hx using fun p : PairPoset S => hf p
      (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) N p y)
    refine ⟨∑ p : PairPoset S, (x p : M), ?_⟩
    calc
      f.hom (∑ p : PairPoset S, (x p : M)) =
          ∑ p : PairPoset S, f.hom (x p : M) := map_sum f.hom _ _
      _ = ∑ p : PairPoset S,
          (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) N p y : N) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro p hp
            exact congrArg Subtype.val (hx p)
      _ = y := diagonalProjector_sum (k := k) (S := S) N y

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightIncidenceRange_eq_ker_iff_vertexFibers
statement:
theorem rightIncidenceRange_eq_ker_iff_vertexFibers
    {L M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (f : L ⟶ M) (g : M ⟶ N) (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) :
    LinearMap.range f.hom = LinearMap.ker g.hom ↔
      ∀ p : PairPoset S,
        LinearMap.range (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p) =
          LinearMap.ker (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) g p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcomp (x : L) : g.hom (f.hom x) = 0 := by
    have hx := congrArg (fun h : L ⟶ N => h.hom x) hfg
    simpa using hx
  constructor
  · intro h p
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro z hz
      rcases LinearMap.mem_range.mp hz with ⟨x, hx⟩
      have hker : (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) g p)
          (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p x) = 0 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change g.hom (f.hom (x : L)) = 0
        exact hcomp (x : L)
      rw [← hx]
      exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hker
    · intro z hz
      have hmem := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hz
      have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hmem
      have hzker : g.hom (z : M) = 0 := by
        rw [mapOnVertexFiber_val] at hval
        exact hval
      have hzrange : (z : M) ∈ LinearMap.range f.hom := by
        rw [h]
        exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hzker
      rcases LinearMap.mem_range.mp hzrange with ⟨x, hx⟩
      refine LinearMap.mem_range.mpr ⟨projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) L p x, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      calc
        (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p
            (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) L p x) : M) =
            (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p (f.hom x) : M) :=
          congrArg Subtype.val (projectToVertexFiber_map (k := k) (S := S) f p x).symm
        _ = (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p z : M) := by rw [hx]
        _ = (z : M) := by
          rw [projectToVertexFiber_val]
          exact (mem_vertexFiber_iff (k := k) (S := S) M p z).1 z.property
  · intro h
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro y hy
      rcases LinearMap.mem_range.mp hy with ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (hcomp x)
    · intro y hy
      have hyker : g.hom y = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hy
      have hprojker (p : PairPoset S) :
          projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p y ∈
            LinearMap.ker (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) g p) := by
        apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
        apply Subtype.ext
        calc
          (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) g p
              (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p y) : N) =
              (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) N p (g.hom y) : N) :=
            congrArg Subtype.val (projectToVertexFiber_map (k := k) (S := S) g p y).symm
          _ = 0 := by rw [hyker]; simp
      have hprojrange (p : PairPoset S) :
          projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p y ∈
            LinearMap.range (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p) := by
        rw [h p]
        exact hprojker p
      let x : (p : PairPoset S) → vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) L p :=
        fun p => Classical.choose (LinearMap.mem_range.mp (hprojrange p))
      have hx (p : PairPoset S) :
          mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p (x p) =
            projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p y :=
        Classical.choose_spec (LinearMap.mem_range.mp (hprojrange p))
      refine LinearMap.mem_range.mpr ⟨∑ p : PairPoset S, (x p : L), ?_⟩
      calc
        f.hom (∑ p : PairPoset S, (x p : L)) =
            ∑ p : PairPoset S, f.hom (x p : L) := map_sum f.hom _ _
        _ = ∑ p : PairPoset S,
            (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p y : M) := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro p hp
              exact congrArg Subtype.val (hx p)
        _ = y := diagonalProjector_sum (k := k) (S := S) M y

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.rightIncidenceShortExact_iff_vertexPointwise
statement:
theorem rightIncidenceShortExact_iff_vertexPointwise
    {L M N : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (f : L ⟶ M) (g : M ⟶ N) (hfg : f ≫ g = 0) :
    (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).ShortExact ↔
      IsPointwiseShortExact
        ((vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map f)
        ((vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).map g)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro p
      change Function.Injective (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p)
      exact (rightIncidenceMap_injective_iff_vertexFibers (k := k) (S := S) f).mp
          h.moduleCat_injective_f p
    · intro p
      change Function.Surjective (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) g p)
      exact (rightIncidenceMap_surjective_iff_vertexFibers (k := k) (S := S) g).mp
          h.moduleCat_surjective_g p
    · intro p
      change LinearMap.range (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p) =
        LinearMap.ker (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) g p)
      exact (rightIncidenceRange_eq_ker_iff_vertexFibers (k := k) (S := S) f g hfg).mp
          h.exact.moduleCat_range_eq_ker p
  · intro h
    have hinj : Function.Injective f.hom :=
      (rightIncidenceMap_injective_iff_vertexFibers (k := k) (S := S) f).mpr
        (fun p => by
          have hp := h.injective p
          change Function.Injective (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p) at hp
          exact hp)
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective g.hom :=
      (rightIncidenceMap_surjective_iff_vertexFibers (k := k) (S := S) g).mpr
        (fun p => by
          have hp := h.surjective p
          change Function.Surjective (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) g p) at hp
          exact hp)
    have hrange : LinearMap.range f.hom = LinearMap.ker g.hom :=
      (rightIncidenceRange_eq_ker_iff_vertexFibers (k := k) (S := S) f g hfg).2
        (fun p => by
          have hp := h.range_eq_ker p
          change LinearMap.range (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) f p) =
            LinearMap.ker (mapOnVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) g p) at hp
          exact hp)
    let C : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) :=
      ShortComplex.mk f g hfg
    have hexact : C.Exact := (ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker C).2 hrange
    letI : Mono C.f := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective f).2 hinj
    letI : Epi C.g := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective g).2 hsurj
    exact ⟨hexact⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentation.finiteDimensional_iff_vertexFibers
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_iff_vertexFibers
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) :
    FiniteDimensional k (restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M) ↔
      ∀ p : PairPoset S, FiniteDimensional k (vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h p
    letI := h
    infer_instance
  · intro h
    letI : ∀ p : PairPoset S,
        FiniteDimensional k (vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p) := h
    haveI : FiniteDimensional k
        ((p : PairPoset S) → vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) M p) := by
      infer_instance
    exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective
      (vertexDecomposition (k := k) (S := S) M).toLinearMap
      (vertexDecomposition (k := k) (S := S) M).injective

statement:
private theorem hookInfinity_finiteDimensional {P : Type} [Preorder P]

proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p ≤ q
  · exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
      (HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := ℚ) hp).symm
  · haveI : Subsingleton ((HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) p).obj q) := ⟨fun x y =>
      (HookInfinity.fiber_eq_zero_of_not_le (R := ℚ) hp x).trans
        (HookInfinity.fiber_eq_zero_of_not_le (R := ℚ) hp y).symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelExamples.biprod_projective
statement:
private theorem biprod_projective {A B : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)}
    (hA : IsRankProjective A) (hB : IsRankProjective B) : IsRankProjective (A ⊞ B)
proof:
:= by
  intro L M N ι π hs α
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hA L M N ι π hs (biprod.inl ≫ α)
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hB L M N ι π hs (biprod.inr ≫ α)
  refine ⟨biprod.desc f g, ?_⟩
  apply biprod.hom_ext'
  · simpa only [← Category.assoc, biprod.inl_desc] using hf
  · simpa only [← Category.assoc, biprod.inr_desc] using hg

proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelExamples.cover_fiber_ext
statement:
private theorem cover_fiber_ext (a : Fin 2 → ℝ) {x y : (cover k).obj a}
    (h₁ : ((biprod.fst : cover k ⟶ hook k).app a).hom x =
      ((biprod.fst : cover k ⟶ hook k).app a).hom y)
    (h₂ : ((biprod.snd : cover k ⟶ hook k).app a).hom x =
      ((biprod.snd : cover k ⟶ hook k).app a).hom y) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hf : HookInfinity.fromBirth a (cover k) x ≫ biprod.fst =
      HookInfinity.fromBirth a (cover k) y ≫ biprod.fst := by
    apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
    simpa only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth] using h₁
  have hg : HookInfinity.fromBirth a (cover k) x ≫ biprod.snd =
      HookInfinity.fromBirth a (cover k) y ≫ biprod.snd := by
    apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
    simpa only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth] using h₂
  have he := biprod.hom_ext _ _ hf hg
  simpa only [HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth] using congrArg
    (fun f : HookInfinity.module (R := k) a ⟶ cover k => (f.app a).hom (HookInfinity.birth a)) he

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelExamples.pointwise2
statement:
private theorem pointwise2 : IsPointwiseShortExact (diagonal k) (quotient2 k) where
  injective a
proof:
:= by
    intro x y h
    have he := congrArg ((biprod.fst : cover k ⟶ hook k).app a).hom h
    exact (fst_diagonal k a x).symm.trans (he.trans (fst_diagonal k a y))
  surjective a := by
    intro x
    refine ⟨((biprod.inl : hook k ⟶ cover k).app a).hom x, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg (fun f : hook k ⟶ hook k => (f.app a).hom x) (quotient2_section k)
  range_eq_ker a := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      change ((quotient2 k).app a).hom (((diagonal k).app a).hom x) = 0
      rw [quotient2_app, fst_diagonal, snd_diagonal, add_neg_cancel]
    · intro hy
      refine ⟨((biprod.fst : cover k ⟶ hook k).app a).hom y, ?_⟩
      apply cover_fiber_ext k a
      · exact fst_diagonal k a _
      · rw [snd_diagonal]
        have hsum : ((biprod.fst : cover k ⟶ hook k).app a).hom y +
            ((biprod.snd : cover k ⟶ hook k).app a).hom y = 0 :=
          (quotient2_app k a y).symm.trans hy
        have he := congrArg Neg.neg (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hsum)
        simpa only [neg_neg] using he

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelExamples.unitAtBirth_ne_zero
statement: private theorem unitAtBirth_ne_zero : unitAtBirth k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (fun x : (hook k).obj birthGrade => (x : k)) h
  exact one_ne_zero he

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelExamples.kernels_nonzero
statement:
theorem kernels_nonzero :
    (∃ x : (kernel (quotient2 k)).obj birthGrade, x ≠ 0) ∧
      (∃ x : (kernel (quotient3 k)).obj birthGrade, x ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · let e := ((rankExact2 k).toIsPointwiseShortExact.kernelIso.app birthGrade).toLinearEquiv
    refine ⟨e (unitAtBirth k), ?_⟩
    exact fun h => unitAtBirth_ne_zero k (e.injective (h.trans (map_zero e).symm))
  · let f : hook k ⟶ cover3 k := diagonal k ≫ biprod.inl
    have hf : f ≫ quotient3 k = 0 := by
      dsimp [f, quotient3]
      rw [Category.assoc, biprod.inl_desc]
      exact (rankExact2 k).toIsPointwiseShortExact.comp_eq_zero
    let z := kernel.lift (quotient3 k) f hf
    refine ⟨(z.app birthGrade).hom (unitAtBirth k), ?_⟩
    intro hz
    have he := congrArg (fun t : hook k ⟶ cover3 k =>
      ((biprod.fst : cover k ⟶ hook k).app birthGrade).hom
        (((biprod.fst : cover3 k ⟶ cover k).app birthGrade).hom
          ((t.app birthGrade).hom (unitAtBirth k)))) (kernel.lift_ι (quotient3 k) f hf)
    have hfst : ((biprod.fst : cover3 k ⟶ cover k).app birthGrade).hom
        ((f.app birthGrade).hom (unitAtBirth k)) =
          ((diagonal k).app birthGrade).hom (unitAtBirth k) :=
      congrArg (fun t : hook k ⟶ cover k => (t.app birthGrade).hom (unitAtBirth k))
        (show f ≫ (biprod.fst : cover3 k ⟶ cover k) = diagonal k from by
          dsimp only [f]
          rw [Category.assoc, biprod.inl_fst, Category.comp_id])
    change _ = ((biprod.fst : cover k ⟶ hook k).app birthGrade).hom
      (((biprod.fst : cover3 k ⟶ cover k).app birthGrade).hom
        ((f.app birthGrade).hom (unitAtBirth k))) at he
    rw [hfst, fst_diagonal] at he
    change ((biprod.fst : cover k ⟶ hook k).app birthGrade).hom
      (((biprod.fst : cover3 k ⟶ cover k).app birthGrade).hom
        (((kernel.ι (quotient3 k)).app birthGrade).hom
          ((z.app birthGrade).hom (unitAtBirth k)))) = unitAtBirth k at he
    rw [hz, map_zero, map_zero, map_zero] at he
    exact unitAtBirth_ne_zero k he.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelExamples.characteristic_two
statement:
theorem characteristic_two :
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving 1
      (cover (ZMod 2) ⊞ (shift 1).obj (kernel (quotient3 (ZMod 2))))
      ((shift 1).obj (hook (ZMod 2)) ⊞ cover3 (ZMod 2))) ∧
    (∃ x : (kernel (quotient2 (ZMod 2))).obj birthGrade, x ≠ 0) ∧
      (∃ x : (kernel (quotient3 (ZMod 2))).obj birthGrade, x ≠ 0)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨positiveInterleaving (ZMod 2)⟩, kernels_nonzero (ZMod 2)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelExamples.no_coordinates
statement:
theorem no_coordinates :
    let a : Fin 0 → ℝ := fun _ => 0
    let M := HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) a
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving 1 (M ⊞ (shift 1).obj (kernel (𝟙 M)))
      ((shift 1).obj (kernel (𝟙 M)) ⊞ M)) ∧ HookInfinity.birth (R := ℚ) a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let a : Fin 0 → ℝ := fun _ => 0
  let M := HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) a
  exact ⟨⟨RankSchanuel.interleaving (𝟙 M) (𝟙 M) (CoordinateInterleaving.refl 1 M)
    (IsRankDeflation.id M) (IsRankDeflation.id M)
    (HookInfinity.isRankProjective a) (HookInfinity.isRankProjective a)⟩,
    HookInfinity.birth_ne_zero a⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelExamples.positive_pullback_forward_nonzero
statement:
theorem positive_pullback_forward_nonzero :
    let M := HookInfinity.module (R := k) birthGrade
    RankSchanuel.forward (𝟙 M) (𝟙 M) (CoordinateInterleaving.refl 1 M) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let M := HookInfinity.module (R := k) birthGrade
  let i := CoordinateInterleaving.refl 1 M
  let x := HookInfinity.birth (R := k) birthGrade
  let y := (i.φ.app birthGrade).hom x
  have hy : y ≠ 0 := by
    have hab : birthGrade ≤ translation 1 birthGrade := by
      intro j; norm_num [translation, birthGrade]
    have he := HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe_structureMap (R := k)
      (le_refl birthGrade) hab x
    intro h
    change structureMapLinear M hab x = 0 at h
    rw [h, map_zero] at he
    have hx : x = 0 := (HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k)
      (le_refl birthGrade)).injective (he.symm.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    exact HookInfinity.birth_ne_zero birthGrade hx
  let z := PullbackFiber.mk ((shift 1).map (𝟙 M)) ((𝟙 M) ≫ i.φ) birthGrade y x rfl
  have hz := RankSchanuel.forward_snd_app (𝟙 M) (𝟙 M) i birthGrade z
  have hz' := PullbackFiber.fst_mk ((shift 1).map (𝟙 M)) ((𝟙 M) ≫ i.φ)
    birthGrade y x rfl
  have he := hz.trans hz'
  intro h
  change RankSchanuel.forward (𝟙 M) (𝟙 M) i = 0 at h
  have hz0 : ((RankSchanuel.forward (𝟙 M) (𝟙 M) i).app birthGrade).hom z = 0 := by
    rw [h]
    rfl
  rw [hz0] at he
  exact hy (he.symm.trans (map_zero _))

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelExamples.zero_projective
statement: private theorem zero_projective : IsRankProjective (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 2 → ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro L M N ι π hs α
  exact ⟨0, (isZero_zero _).eq_of_src _ _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelExamples.zero_module
statement:
theorem zero_module :
    let M : PModule ℚ (Fin 2 → ℝ) := 0
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving 1 (M ⊞ (shift 1).obj (kernel (𝟙 M)))
      ((shift 1).obj (kernel (𝟙 M)) ⊞ M))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  exact ⟨RankSchanuel.interleaving (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (CoordinateInterleaving.refl 1 _)
    (IsRankDeflation.id _) (IsRankDeflation.id _) zero_projective zero_projective⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison.transport_equation
statement:
private theorem transport_equation
    (cM : CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison δ M M')
    (cN : CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison δ N N')
    (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M' N') :
    (cM.forward ≫ i.φ ≫ (shift ε).map cN.reverse ≫ (compIso ε δ N).hom) ≫
      (shift (ε + δ)).map
        (cN.forward ≫ i.ψ ≫ (shift ε).map cM.reverse ≫ (compIso ε δ M).hom) ≫
      (compIso (ε + δ) (ε + δ) M).hom = transition ((ε + δ) + (ε + δ)) M
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  have hIso := (compIso_naturality ε δ cN.forward).symm
  rw [← Category.assoc (compIso ε δ N).hom
    ((shift (ε + δ)).map cN.forward)
    ((shift (ε + δ)).map i.ψ ≫
      (shift (ε + δ)).map ((shift ε).map cM.reverse) ≫
        (shift (ε + δ)).map (compIso ε δ M).hom ≫
          (compIso (ε + δ) (ε + δ) M).hom)]
  rw [hIso]
  have hN : (shift ε).map cN.reverse ≫
      (shift ε).map ((shift δ).map cN.forward) =
      (shift ε).map (transition δ N') := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp, cN.reverse_shift_forward]
  have hNt := congrArg (fun q => q ≫
    (compIso ε δ N').hom ≫
      (shift (ε + δ)).map i.ψ ≫
        (shift (ε + δ)).map ((shift ε).map cM.reverse) ≫
          (shift (ε + δ)).map (compIso ε δ M).hom ≫
            (compIso (ε + δ) (ε + δ) M).hom) hN
  simp only [Category.assoc] at hNt
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [hNt]
  have hIsoψ := compIso_naturality ε δ i.ψ
  have hIsoψt := congrArg (fun q => q ≫
    (shift (ε + δ)).map ((shift ε).map cM.reverse) ≫
      (shift (ε + δ)).map (compIso ε δ M).hom ≫
        (compIso (ε + δ) (ε + δ) M).hom) hIsoψ
  simp only [Category.assoc] at hIsoψt
  rw [← hIsoψt]
  let tail := (shift (ε + δ)).map ((shift ε).map cM.reverse) ≫
    (shift (ε + δ)).map (compIso ε δ M).hom ≫
      (compIso (ε + δ) (ε + δ) M).hom
  have hMid := congrArg (fun q => q ≫
      (compIso ε δ ((shift ε).obj M')).hom ≫ tail)
    (congrArg (fun q => (shift ε).map q)
      ((transition_naturality (ε := δ) i.ψ).symm))
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc] at hMid
  rw [hMid]
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  dsimp only [tail, NatTrans.comp_app, shift_map_app, compIso_hom_app]
  erw [← Category.assoc (i.φ.app a) (i.ψ.app (translation ε a)),
    i.φ_ψ_structureMap]
  let q := translation ε (translation (ε + δ) a)
  have hComp : cM.forward.app q ≫ cM.reverse.app q =
      (transition δ M).app q := by
    simpa only [NatTrans.comp_app] using
      congrArg (fun f => f.app q) cM.forward_reverse
  change cM.forward.app a ≫ M'.map _ ≫ M'.map _ ≫ M'.map _ ≫
    cM.reverse.app q ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  erw [← M'.map_comp_assoc, ← M'.map_comp_assoc]
  erw [← cM.forward.naturality_assoc]
  erw [← Category.assoc (cM.forward.app q) (cM.reverse.app q), hComp]
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  erw [← M.map_comp, ← M.map_comp, ← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison.transport_φ
statement:
@[simp] theorem transport_φ
    (cM : CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison δ M M')
    (cN : CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison δ N N')
    (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M' N') :
    (transport cM cN i).φ =
      cM.forward ≫ i.φ ≫ (shift ε).map cN.reverse ≫ (compIso ε δ N).hom
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison.transport_ψ
statement:
@[simp] theorem transport_ψ
    (cM : CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison δ M M')
    (cN : CoordinateInterleavingDelayComparison δ N N')
    (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M' N') :
    (transport cM cN i).ψ =
      cN.forward ≫ i.ψ ≫ (shift ε).map cM.reverse ≫ (compIso ε δ M).hom
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent_of_le
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent_of_le
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (X : ι → PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (t : ι → ℝ≥0) (i : ι) (h : t i ≤ δ)
    (hcase : t i ≤ δ ∨ IsZero (X i)) :
    finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent δ X t i hcase = shiftLE h (X i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent_eq_zero
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (X : ι → PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (t : ι → ℝ≥0) (i : ι) (hcase : t i ≤ δ ∨ IsZero (X i))
    (hnot : ¬ t i ≤ δ) :
    finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent δ X t i hcase = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent, hnot]

name: TDA.Persistence.transition_comp_shiftLE
statement:
private theorem transition_comp_shiftLE
    {t δ : ℝ≥0} (h : t ≤ δ) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    transition t M ≫ shiftLE h M = transition δ M
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  erw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.shiftLE_comp_shift_transition
statement:
private theorem shiftLE_comp_shift_transition
    {t δ : ℝ≥0} (h : t ≤ δ) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    shiftLE h M ≫ (shift δ).map (transition t M) =
      transition δ ((shift t).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  erw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFamilyDelayComparison_ι_forward
statement:
@[reassoc, simp] theorem finiteFamilyDelayComparison_ι_forward
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (X : ι → PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (t : ι → ℝ≥0) (hdelay : ∀ i, t i ≤ δ ∨ IsZero (X i)) (i : ι) :
    biproduct.ι X i ≫ (finiteFamilyDelayComparison δ X t hdelay).forward =
      transition (t i) (X i) ≫ biproduct.ι (fun j => (shift (t j)).obj (X j)) i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [finiteFamilyDelayComparison]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFamilyDelayComparison_ι_reverse
statement:
@[reassoc, simp] theorem finiteFamilyDelayComparison_ι_reverse
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (X : ι → PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (t : ι → ℝ≥0) (hdelay : ∀ i, t i ≤ δ ∨ IsZero (X i)) (i : ι) :
    biproduct.ι (fun j => (shift (t j)).obj (X j)) i ≫
        (finiteFamilyDelayComparison δ X t hdelay).reverse =
      finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent δ X t i (hdelay i) ≫
        (shift δ).map (biproduct.ι X i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [finiteFamilyDelayComparison]

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.support_ordConnected
statement:
theorem support_ordConnected (i j : P) : (support i j).OrdConnected where
  out'
proof:
:= by
    intro a ha c hc b hb
    exact ⟨ha.1.trans hb.1, fun hj => hc.2 (hj.trans hb.2)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.birth_mem
statement: theorem birth_mem {i j : P} (hij : i < j) : i ∈ support i j
proof:
:=
  ⟨le_rfl, not_le_of_gt hij⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.death_not_mem
statement: theorem death_not_mem (i j : P) : j ∉ support i j
proof: := fun h => h.2 le_rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext p
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  by_cases hp : p ∈ support i j
  · have hg : structureMapLinear (module (k := k) i j) hp.1
        (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij)) =
          SupportInterval.one (support i j) hp := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (SupportInterval.structureMap_val (support i j) (support_ordConnected i j)
        hp.1 (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij))).trans (by
          simp [hp, SupportInterval.one])
    have hx : x = (x : k) • structureMapLinear (module i j) hp.1
        (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij)) := by
      rw [hg]
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [SupportInterval.one]
    have hα := congrArg (fun f => f.hom
      (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij)))
        (α.naturality (homOfLE hp.1))
    have hβ := congrArg (fun f => f.hom
      (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij)))
        (β.naturality (homOfLE hp.1))
    change (α.app p).hom (structureMapLinear (module i j) hp.1 _) =
      structureMapLinear M hp.1 ((α.app i).hom _) at hα
    change (β.app p).hom (structureMapLinear (module i j) hp.1 _) =
      structureMapLinear M hp.1 ((β.app i).hom _) at hβ
    rw [hx, map_smul, map_smul, hα, hβ, h]
  · have hx : x = 0 := Subtype.ext (SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (support i j) hp x)
    simp [hx]

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.generator_dies
statement:
theorem generator_dies {i j : P} (hij : i < j) {M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P}
    (α : module (k := k) i j ⟶ M) :
    structureMapLinear M hij.le
      ((α.app i).hom (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn := congrArg (fun f => f.hom
    (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij)))
      (α.naturality (homOfLE hij.le))
  have hz : structureMapLinear (module (k := k) i j) hij.le = 0 :=
    (SupportInterval.structureMap_eq_zero_iff (support i j)
      (support_ordConnected i j) hij.le).mpr
      (fun h => death_not_mem i j h.2)
  change (α.app j).hom (structureMapLinear (module i j) hij.le _) = _ at hn
  rw [hz, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero] at hn
  exact hn.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.fromGenerator_app
statement:
theorem fromGenerator_app {i j p : P} (hij : i < j) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P)
    (m : M.obj i) (hm : structureMapLinear M hij.le m = 0) (hip : i ≤ p)
    (x : SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) (support i j) p) :
    ((fromGenerator hij M m hm).app p).hom x = (x : k) • structureMapLinear M hip m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change generatorLinear M m p x = _
  simp [generatorLinear, hip, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.fromGenerator_birth
statement:
theorem fromGenerator_birth {i j : P} (hij : i < j) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P)
    (m : M.obj i) (hm : structureMapLinear M hij.le m = 0) :
    ((fromGenerator hij M m hm).app i).hom
      (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij)) = m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change generatorLinear M m i (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij)) = m
  simp only [generatorLinear, dif_pos (le_refl i), LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
  change (1 : k) • structureMapLinear M (le_refl i) m = m
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.exists_lift
statement:
theorem exists_lift {i j : P} (hij : i < j)
    {L M N : PModule.{u,v,u} k P} {ι : L ⟶ M} {π : M ⟶ N}
    (hs : IsRankExact ι π)
    (α : module (k := k) i j ⟶ N) :
    ∃ β : module (k := k) i j ⟶ M, β ≫ π = α
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hdie⟩ := hs.lift_kernel hij.le
    ((α.app i).hom (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij)))
    (generator_dies hij α)
  refine ⟨fromGenerator hij M m hdie, ?_⟩
  apply hom_ext hij
  change (π.app i).hom (((fromGenerator hij M m hdie).app i).hom _) = _
  rw [fromGenerator_birth]
  exact hm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleavingShortnessExamples.threshold_two_zero
statement: private theorem threshold_two_zero : transition (1 + 1) threshold = 0
proof:
:=
  (transition_eq_zero_iff 1 0 2).mpr (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleavingShortnessExamples.transition_zero_of_iso
statement:
private theorem transition_zero_of_iso {A B : PModule.{0,0,0} ℚ ℝ}
    (e : A ≅ B) (δ : ℝ≥0) (h : transition δ A = 0) : transition δ B = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi e.hom).mp
  rw [comp_zero, transition_naturality, h, zero_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleavingShortnessExamples.threshold_map_nonzero
proof:
:= by
  let x : fiber (k := ℚ) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) a :=
    ⟨1, by simp [fiber, ha]⟩
  intro h
  have hx := congrArg (fun f : threshold.obj a ⟶ threshold.obj b =>
    (show fiber (k := ℚ) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) b from f.hom x).val) h
  change (show fiber (k := ℚ) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) b from
    ((RealBarcode.intervalModule (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ))).map
      (homOfLE hab)).hom x).val = 0 at hx
  rw [map_val] at hx
  simp only [if_pos hb, x, one_ne_zero] at hx

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleavingShortnessExamples.threshold_one_nonzero
statement: private theorem threshold_one_nonzero : transition 1 threshold ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have ht := congrArg (fun f => f.app (0 : ℝ)) h
  change structureMap threshold (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0 + (1 : ℝ) by norm_num) = 0 at ht
  exact threshold_map_nonzero _ (by norm_num [alive]) (by norm_num [alive]) ht

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleavingShortnessExamples.shifted_threshold_one_nonzero
statement:
private theorem shifted_threshold_one_nonzero :
    transition 1 ((shift 1).obj threshold) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have ht := congrArg (fun f => f.app (-1 : ℝ)) h
  change structureMap threshold
    (show (-1 : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (-1 + 1) + 1 by norm_num) = 0 at ht
  exact threshold_map_nonzero _ (by norm_num [alive]) (by norm_num [alive]) ht

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleavingShortnessExamples.defects_threshold
statement:
theorem defects_threshold :
    transition (1 + 1) (kernel zeroMaps.φ) = 0 ∧
    transition (1 + 1) (cokernel zeroMaps.φ) = 0 ∧
    transition 1 (kernel zeroMaps.φ) ≠ 0 ∧
    transition 1 (cokernel zeroMaps.φ) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨zeroMaps.kernel_transition_eq_zero, zeroMaps.cokernel_transition_eq_zero, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    exact threshold_one_nonzero
      (transition_zero_of_iso kernelZeroIsoSource 1 h)
  · intro h
    exact shifted_threshold_one_nonzero
      (transition_zero_of_iso cokernelZeroIsoTarget 1 h)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleavingShortnessExamples.isZero_of_zero_double_transition
statement:
private theorem isZero_of_zero_double_transition {A : PModule.{0,0,0} ℤ ℝ}
    (h : transition (0 + 0) A = 0) : IsZero A
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero A).mpr
  have hz : transition 0 A = 0 := by
    rw [← transition_congr (show (0 : ℝ≥0) + 0 = 0 from zero_add 0) A, h, zero_comp]
  have ht := transition_zero A
  rw [hz, zero_comp] at ht
  exact ht.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleavingShortnessExamples.integer_zero_parameter
statement:
theorem integer_zero_parameter :
    ¬ IsZero integerConstant ∧ IsZero (kernel integerWitness.φ) ∧
      IsZero (cokernel integerWitness.φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, isZero_of_zero_double_transition integerWitness.kernel_transition_eq_zero,
    isZero_of_zero_double_transition integerWitness.cokernel_transition_eq_zero⟩
  intro h
  have hs : Subsingleton ℤ := ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp (h.obj 0)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePairCost_translate
statement:
private theorem finitePairCost_translate (p : ℝ × ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    finitePairCost p (p.1 + c, p.2 + c) = ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : p.1 - (p.1 + c) = -c := by ring
  have h₂ : p.2 - (p.2 + c) = -c := by ring
  simp [finitePairCost, h₁, h₂]
