name: TDA.Persistence.finiteTranslation_multiset
statement:
private theorem finiteTranslation_multiset (D : Diagram ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset D.finiteOccurrences).val.map
        (fun p => (p.1.1 + c, p.1.2 + c)) =
      (Finset.univ : Finset (translateDiagram D c).finiteOccurrences).val.map
        (fun p => p.1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (finitePart D.points).map (fun p => (p.1 + c, p.2 + c)) :=
      Multiset.map_univ _ _
    _ = finitePart (translateDiagram D c).points := by
      exact (finitePart_translateDiagram D c).symm
    _ = _ := (Multiset.map_univ_coe _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialTranslation_multiset
statement:
private theorem essentialTranslation_multiset (D : Diagram ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset D.essentialOccurrences).val.map (fun b => b.1 + c) =
      (Finset.univ : Finset (translateDiagram D c).essentialOccurrences).val.map
        (fun b => b.1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (essentialPart D.points).map (fun b => b + c) :=
      Multiset.map_univ _ _
    _ = essentialPart (translateDiagram D c).points := by
      exact (essentialPart_translateDiagram D c).symm
    _ = _ := (Multiset.map_univ_coe _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteTranslationEquiv_value
statement:
theorem finiteTranslationEquiv_value (D : Diagram ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (p : D.finiteOccurrences) :
    (finiteTranslationEquiv D c p).1 = (p.1.1 + c, p.1.2 + c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (presentationEquiv
    (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => (q.1.1 + c, q.1.2 + c))
    (fun q : (translateDiagram D c).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
    (finiteTranslation_multiset D c)).2 p

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialTranslationEquiv_value
statement:
theorem essentialTranslationEquiv_value (D : Diagram ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (b : D.essentialOccurrences) :
    (essentialTranslationEquiv D c b).1 = b.1 + c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (presentationEquiv
    (fun a : D.essentialOccurrences => a.1 + c)
    (fun a : (translateDiagram D c).essentialOccurrences => a.1)
    (essentialTranslation_multiset D c)).2 b

name: TDA.Persistence.translatedMatching_cost_le
statement:
theorem translatedMatching_cost_le (D : Diagram ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    (translatedMatching D c).cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1)
      (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M := translatedMatching D c
  apply M.cost_le_of
  · intro p
    change finitePairCost p.1 ((finiteTranslationEquiv D c p).1) ≤ _
    rw [finiteTranslationEquiv_value]
    exact le_of_eq (finitePairCost_translate p.1 c)
  · intro q
    have hmatched : ∃ p, M.finite p = some q := by
      refine ⟨(finiteTranslationEquiv D c).symm q, ?_⟩
      simp [M, translatedMatching]
    simp [hmatched]
  · intro b
    change essentialPairCost b.1 ((essentialTranslationEquiv D c b).1) ≤ _
    rw [essentialTranslationEquiv_value]
    exact le_of_eq (essentialPairCost_translate b.1 c)

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_translate_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_translate_le (D : Diagram ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    bottleneck D (translateDiagram D c) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_le_matching D (translateDiagram D c) (translatedMatching D c)).trans
    (translatedMatching_cost_le D c)

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_translate_lower_of_min
statement:
private theorem bottleneck_translate_lower_of_min (D : Diagram ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences (translateDiagram D c).finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences (translateDiagram D c).essentialOccurrences)
    (b : D.essentialOccurrences)
    (hmin : ∀ a : D.essentialOccurrences, b.1 ≤ a.1) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    ENNReal.ofReal |c| ≤
      M.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun a => a.1) (fun a => a.1)
proof:
:= by
  let e := essentialTranslationEquiv D c
  let b' := M.essential b
  let a := e.symm b'
  have htranslate : b'.1 = a.1 + c := by
    have hback : e a = b' := e.apply_symm_apply b'
    rw [← hback]
    exact essentialTranslationEquiv_value D c a
  have horder : b.1 ≤ a.1 := hmin a
  have habs : c ≤ |b.1 - b'.1| := by
    rw [htranslate, abs_sub_comm]
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ a.1 + c - b.1 := by linarith
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
    linarith
  have hpair : ENNReal.ofReal |c| ≤ essentialPairCost b.1 b'.1 := by
    unfold essentialPairCost
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hc]
    exact habs
  exact hpair.trans (M.essential_le_cost
    (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun a => a.1) (fun a => a.1) b)

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_translate_lower_of_max
statement:
private theorem bottleneck_translate_lower_of_max (D : Diagram ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences (translateDiagram D c).finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences (translateDiagram D c).essentialOccurrences)
    (b : D.essentialOccurrences)
    (hmax : ∀ a : D.essentialOccurrences, a.1 ≤ b.1) (hc : c ≤ 0) :
    ENNReal.ofReal |c| ≤
      M.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun a => a.1) (fun a => a.1)
proof:
:= by
  let e := essentialTranslationEquiv D c
  let b' := M.essential b
  let a := e.symm b'
  have htranslate : b'.1 = a.1 + c := by
    have hback : e a = b' := e.apply_symm_apply b'
    rw [← hback]
    exact essentialTranslationEquiv_value D c a
  have horder : a.1 ≤ b.1 := hmax a
  have habs : -c ≤ |b.1 - b'.1| := by
    rw [htranslate]
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ b.1 - (a.1 + c) := by linarith
    rw [abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]
    linarith
  have hpair : ENNReal.ofReal |c| ≤ essentialPairCost b.1 b'.1 := by
    unfold essentialPairCost
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    rw [abs_of_nonpos hc]
    exact habs
  exact hpair.trans (M.essential_le_cost
    (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun a => a.1) (fun a => a.1) b)

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_translate_ge_of_essential
statement:
theorem bottleneck_translate_ge_of_essential (D : Diagram ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hne : essentialPart D.points ≠ 0) :
    ENNReal.ofReal |c| ≤ bottleneck D (translateDiagram D c)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcard : 0 < Fintype.card D.essentialOccurrences := by
    simpa only [Multiset.card_coe] using (Multiset.card_pos.mpr hne)
  have hocc : Nonempty D.essentialOccurrences := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp hcard
  obtain ⟨bmin, _, hmin⟩ := Finset.univ.exists_min_image
    (fun b : D.essentialOccurrences => b.1) (Finset.univ_nonempty_iff.mpr hocc)
  obtain ⟨bmax, _, hmax⟩ := Finset.univ.exists_max_image
    (fun b : D.essentialOccurrences => b.1) (Finset.univ_nonempty_iff.mpr hocc)
  unfold bottleneck
  apply le_iInf
  intro M
  by_cases hc : 0 ≤ c
  · exact bottleneck_translate_lower_of_min D c M bmin
      (fun b => hmin b (Finset.mem_univ b)) hc
  · exact bottleneck_translate_lower_of_max D c M bmax
      (fun b => hmax b (Finset.mem_univ b)) (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hc))

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_translate_eq_of_essential
statement:
theorem bottleneck_translate_eq_of_essential (D : Diagram ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (hne : essentialPart D.points ≠ 0) :
    bottleneck D (translateDiagram D c) = ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (bottleneck_translate_le D c)
    (bottleneck_translate_ge_of_essential D c hne)

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_translateFilterFunction
statement:
theorem dgm_translateFilterFunction (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    [Fintype (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)]
    (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K ℝ) (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    dgm k (translateFilterFunction f c) n = translateDiagram (dgm k f n) c
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun a => a + c
  have hφ : StrictMonoOn φ (Set.range f.value) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    dsimp [φ]
    linarith
  have hvalue : ∀ σ : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K,
      (translateFilterFunction f c).value σ = φ (f.value σ) := by
    intro σ
    rfl
  change (dgm k (translateFilterFunction f c) n).points =
    (dgm k f n).points.map
      (fun p => (p.1 + c, WithTop.map (fun a : ℝ => a + c) p.2))
  exact dgm_points_map_of_strictMonoOn k f (translateFilterFunction f c)
    φ hφ hvalue n

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_dgm_translateFilterFunction_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_translateFilterFunction_le (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    [Fintype (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)]
    (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K ℝ) (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k f n) (dgm k (translateFilterFunction f c) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:= by

  exact bottleneck_translate_le (dgm k f n) c

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_dgm_translateFilterFunction_eq_of_essential
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_translateFilterFunction_eq_of_essential (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    [Fintype (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)]
    (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K ℝ) (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ)
    (hne : essentialPart (dgm k f n).points ≠ 0) :
    bottleneck (dgm k f n) (dgm k (translateFilterFunction f c) n) =

name: TDA.Persistence.translateDiagram_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem translateDiagram_zero (D : Diagram ℝ) : translateDiagram D 0 = D
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  change D.points.map (translateDiagramPoint 0) = D.points
  have h : translateDiagramPoint 0 = id := by
    funext p
    rcases p with ⟨b, d⟩
    cases d <;> simp [translateDiagramPoint]
  rw [h, Multiset.map_id]

name: TDA.Persistence.translateDiagram_add
statement:
theorem translateDiagram_add (D : Diagram ℝ) (a b : ℝ) :
    translateDiagram (translateDiagram D a) b = translateDiagram D (a + b)
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  change (D.points.map (translateDiagramPoint a)).map (translateDiagramPoint b) = _
  rw [Multiset.map_map]
  congr 1
  funext p
  rcases p with ⟨x, d⟩
  cases d with
  | top => exact Prod.ext (add_assoc x a b) rfl
  | coe d =>
    change ((x + a) + b, (((d + a) + b : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)) =
      (x + (a + b), ((d + (a + b) : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ))
    simp only [add_assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteTranslationEquiv_symm_value
statement:
theorem finiteTranslationEquiv_symm_value (D : Diagram ℝ) (a : ℝ)
    (p : (translateDiagram D a).finiteOccurrences) :
    ((finiteTranslationEquiv D a).symm p).1 = (p.1.1 - a, p.1.2 - a)
proof:
:= by
  have h := finiteTranslationEquiv_value D a ((finiteTranslationEquiv D a).symm p)
  simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  apply Prod.ext
  · have := congrArg Prod.fst h
    dsimp at this ⊢
    linarith
  · have := congrArg Prod.snd h
    dsimp at this ⊢
    linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialTranslationEquiv_symm_value
statement:
theorem essentialTranslationEquiv_symm_value (D : Diagram ℝ) (a : ℝ)
    (p : (translateDiagram D a).essentialOccurrences) :
    ((essentialTranslationEquiv D a).symm p).1 = p.1 - a
proof:
:= by
  have h := essentialTranslationEquiv_value D a ((essentialTranslationEquiv D a).symm p)
  simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.untranslateTarget_finite_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem untranslateTarget_finite_eq_some_iff (a : ℝ)
    (A : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences (translateDiagram E a).finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences (translateDiagram E a).essentialOccurrences)
    (i : D.finiteOccurrences) (j : E.finiteOccurrences) :
    (A.untranslateTarget a).finite i = some j ↔
      A.finite i = some (finiteTranslationEquiv E a j)
proof:
:= by
  change (A.finite i).map (finiteTranslationEquiv E a).symm = some j ↔ _
  cases h : A.finite i with
  | none => simp
  | some q => simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]; exact Equiv.symm_apply_eq _

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.untranslateTarget_finite_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem untranslateTarget_finite_eq_none_iff (a : ℝ)
    (A : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences (translateDiagram E a).finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences (translateDiagram E a).essentialOccurrences)
    (i : D.finiteOccurrences) :
    (A.untranslateTarget a).finite i = none ↔ A.finite i = none
proof:
:= by
  change (A.finite i).map _ = none ↔ _
  exact Option.map_eq_none_iff

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.untranslateTarget_mem_range_iff
statement:
theorem untranslateTarget_mem_range_iff (a : ℝ)
    (A : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences (translateDiagram E a).finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences (translateDiagram E a).essentialOccurrences)
    (j : E.finiteOccurrences) :
    (∃ i, (A.untranslateTarget a).finite i = some j) ↔
      ∃ i, A.finite i = some (finiteTranslationEquiv E a j)
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_congr fun i => untranslateTarget_finite_eq_some_iff a A i j

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.untranslateTarget_essential_value
statement:
theorem untranslateTarget_essential_value (a : ℝ)
    (A : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences (translateDiagram E a).finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences (translateDiagram E a).essentialOccurrences)
    (i : D.essentialOccurrences) :
    ((A.untranslateTarget a).essential i).1 = (A.essential i).1 - a
proof:
:=
  essentialTranslationEquiv_symm_value E a (A.essential i)

name: TDA.Persistence.indecomposable_of_scalar_end
statement:
private theorem indecomposable_of_scalar_end
    {C : Type*} [Category C] [Preadditive C] [HasBinaryBiproducts C]
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {X : C} (e : End X ≃+* k) : Indecomposable X
proof:
:= by
  have hX : ¬ IsZero X := by
    intro h
    have hz := congrArg e ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero X).mp h)
    change e (1 : End X) = e 0 at hz
    rw [map_one, map_zero] at hz
    exact one_ne_zero hz
  have hid : ∀ q : X ⟶ X, q ≫ q = q → q = 0 ∨ q = 𝟙 X := by
    intro q hq
    have h : IsIdempotentElem (e q) := by
      change e q * e q = e q
      simpa only [← map_mul, End.mul_def] using congrArg e hq
    rcases IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp h with h0 | h1
    · exact Or.inl (e.injective (h0.trans (map_zero e).symm))
    · exact Or.inr (e.injective (h1.trans (map_one e).symm))
  refine ⟨hX, fun Y Z i => ?_⟩
  rcases hid (i.hom ≫ biprod.fst ≫ biprod.inl ≫ i.inv) (by simp) with h0 | h1
  · refine Or.inl ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero Y).mpr ?_)
    simpa using congrArg (fun f : X ⟶ X =>
      biprod.inl ≫ i.inv ≫ f ≫ i.hom ≫ biprod.fst) h0
  · refine Or.inr ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero Z).mpr ?_)
    simpa using (congrArg (fun f : X ⟶ X =>
      biprod.inr ≫ i.inv ≫ f ≫ i.hom ≫ biprod.snd) h1).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.isZero_of_le
statement: theorem isZero_of_le {i j : P} (hji : j ≤ i) : IsZero (module (k := k) i j)
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
  ext p x
  exact SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (support i j)
    (fun hp => hp.2 (hji.trans hp.1)) x

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.end_eq_smul_id
statement:
theorem end_eq_smul_id {i j : P} (hij : i < j)
    (α : End (module (k := k) i j)) :
    α = (((α.app i).hom (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij)) : k)) •
      𝟙 (module (k := k) i j)
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext hij
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp [SupportInterval.one]

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.algebraMap_bijective
statement:
private theorem algebraMap_bijective {i j : P} (hij : i < j) :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap k (End (module (k := k) i j)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    have h := congrArg (fun f : End (module (k := k) i j) =>
      (((f.app i).hom (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij))) : k)) hab
    simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] at h
    change a * (1 : k) = b * 1 at h
    simpa only [mul_one] using h
  · intro α
    refine ⟨(((α.app i).hom (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij))) : k), ?_⟩
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, End.one_def] using (end_eq_smul_id hij α).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.endRingEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem endRingEquiv_symm_apply {i j : P} (hij : i < j) (c : k) :
    (endRingEquiv (k := k) hij).symm c = c • 𝟙 (module (k := k) i j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [endRingEquiv, RingEquiv.symm_symm, RingEquiv.ofBijective_apply,
    Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, End.one_def]

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.endRingEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem endRingEquiv_apply {i j : P} (hij : i < j) (α : End (module (k := k) i j)) :
    endRingEquiv hij α =
      (((α.app i).hom (SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij))) : k)
proof:
:= by
  apply (endRingEquiv hij).symm.injective
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, endRingEquiv_symm_apply]
  exact end_eq_smul_id hij α

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.indecomposable
statement:
theorem indecomposable {i j : P} (hij : i < j) :
    Indecomposable (module (k := k) i j)
proof:
:=
  indecomposable_of_scalar_end (endRingEquiv hij)

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.fiberEquiv_birth
statement:
@[simp] theorem fiberEquiv_birth (i : P) :
    fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) (le_refl i) (birth i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change (Finsupp.single () (1 : k)) () = 1
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.birth_ne_zero
statement: theorem birth_ne_zero (i : P) : birth (R := k) i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) (le_refl i)) h
  rw [fiberEquiv_birth, map_zero] at he
  exact one_ne_zero he

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.end_eq_smul_id
statement:
theorem end_eq_smul_id (i : P) (α : End (module (R := k) i)) :
    α = fiberEquivOfLe (le_refl i) ((α.app i).hom (birth i)) •
      𝟙 (module (R := k) i)
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext
  apply (fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) (le_refl i)).injective
  change _ = _ * ((birth (R := k) i).val ())
  rw [show (birth (R := k) i).val () = 1 from fiberEquiv_birth i, mul_one]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.algebraMap_bijective
statement:
private theorem algebraMap_bijective (i : P) :
    Function.Bijective (algebraMap k (End (module (R := k) i)))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    have h := congrArg (fun f : End (module (R := k) i) =>
      fiberEquivOfLe (le_refl i) ((f.app i).hom (birth i))) hab
    simp only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one] at h
    change a * ((birth i).val ()) = b * ((birth i).val ()) at h
    rw [show (birth (R := k) i).val () = 1 from fiberEquiv_birth i, mul_one, mul_one] at h
    exact h
  · intro α
    refine ⟨fiberEquivOfLe (le_refl i) ((α.app i).hom (birth i)), ?_⟩
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, End.one_def] using (end_eq_smul_id i α).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.endRingEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem endRingEquiv_symm_apply (i : P) (c : k) :
    (endRingEquiv (k := k) i).symm c = c • 𝟙 (module (R := k) i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [endRingEquiv, RingEquiv.symm_symm, RingEquiv.ofBijective_apply,
    Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, End.one_def]

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.endRingEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem endRingEquiv_apply (i : P) (α : End (module (R := k) i)) :
    endRingEquiv i α = fiberEquivOfLe (le_refl i) ((α.app i).hom (birth i))
proof:
:= by
  apply (endRingEquiv i).symm.injective
  rw [RingEquiv.symm_apply_apply, endRingEquiv_symm_apply]
  exact end_eq_smul_id i α

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.indecomposable
statement: theorem indecomposable (i : P) : Indecomposable (module (R := k) i)
proof:
:=
  indecomposable_of_scalar_end (endRingEquiv i)

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.support_subset_of_iso
statement:
private theorem support_subset_of_iso (S T : Set P) (hS : S.OrdConnected)
    (hT : T.OrdConnected) (e : module (k := k) S hS ≅ module T hT) : S ⊆ T
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  by_contra ht
  have hz : (e.hom.app p).hom (one S hp) = 0 :=
    Subtype.ext (val_eq_zero T ht _)
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (one S hp)) (e.hom_inv_id_app p)
  change (e.inv.app p).hom ((e.hom.app p).hom (one S hp)) = one S hp at h
  rw [hz, map_zero] at h
  exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : k) ≠ 1) (congrArg Subtype.val h)

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.support_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem support_eq_of_iso (S T : Set P) (hS : S.OrdConnected)
    (hT : T.OrdConnected) (e : module (k := k) S hS ≅ module T hT) : S = T
proof:
:=
  Set.Subset.antisymm (support_subset_of_iso S T hS hT e)
    (support_subset_of_iso T S hT hS e.symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.birth_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem birth_eq_of_iso {i j i' j' : P} (hij : i < j) (hij' : i' < j')
    (e : module (k := k) i j ≅ module i' j') : i = i'
proof:
:= by
  have h := SupportInterval.support_eq_of_iso (support i j) (support i' j')
    (support_ordConnected i j) (support_ordConnected i' j') e
  have hi : i ∈ support i' j' := h ▸ birth_mem hij
  have hi' : i' ∈ support i j := h.symm ▸ birth_mem hij'
  exact le_antisymm hi'.1 hi.1

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.endpoints_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem endpoints_eq_of_iso {i j i' j' : P} (hij : i < j) (hij' : i' < j')
    (e : module (k := k) i j ≅ module i' j') : i = i' ∧ j = j'
proof:
:= by
  have hi := birth_eq_of_iso hij hij' e
  subst i'
  have h := SupportInterval.support_eq_of_iso (support i j) (support i j')
    (support_ordConnected i j) (support_ordConnected i j') e
  constructor
  · rfl
  · apply le_antisymm
    · by_contra hj
      have hm : j' ∈ support i j := ⟨hij'.le, hj⟩
      exact death_not_mem i j' (h ▸ hm)
    · by_contra hj
      have hm : j ∈ support i j' := ⟨hij.le, hj⟩
      exact death_not_mem i j (h.symm ▸ hm)

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.nonempty_iso_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_iff {i j i' j' : P} (hij : i < j) (hij' : i' < j') :
    Nonempty (module (k := k) i j ≅ module i' j') ↔ i = i' ∧ j = j'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    exact endpoints_eq_of_iso hij hij' e
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Iso.refl _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.not_nonempty_iso_infinity
statement:
theorem not_nonempty_iso_infinity {i j i' : P} (hij : i < j) :
    ¬ Nonempty (module (k := k) i j ≅ HookInfinity.module (R := k) i')
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e⟩
  let x := SupportInterval.one (support i j) (birth_mem hij) (k := k)
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := fun h => (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0) (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hbirth : i' ≤ i := by
    by_contra h
    have hz := HookInfinity.fiber_eq_zero_of_not_le h ((e.hom.app i).hom x)
    exact hx ((e.app i).toLinearEquiv.injective (hz.trans (map_zero _).symm))
  let E := HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) (hbirth.trans hij.le)
  let y := E.symm 1
  have hz : (e.inv.app j).hom y = 0 :=
    Subtype.ext (SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (support i j) (death_not_mem i j) _)
  have hy : y = 0 :=
    (e.app j).symm.toLinearEquiv.injective (hz.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  have h := congrArg E hy
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, map_zero] at h
  exact one_ne_zero h

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.birth_le_of_iso
statement:
private theorem birth_le_of_iso {i i' : P}
    (e : module (R := k) i ≅ module i') : i' ≤ i
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hz := fiber_eq_zero_of_not_le h ((e.hom.app i).hom (birth (R := k) i))
  exact birth_ne_zero i ((e.app i).toLinearEquiv.injective (hz.trans (map_zero _).symm))

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.birth_eq_of_iso
statement: theorem birth_eq_of_iso {i i' : P} (e : module (R := k) i ≅ module i') : i = i'
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (birth_le_of_iso e.symm) (birth_le_of_iso e)

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.nonempty_iso_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_iff {i i' : P} :
    Nonempty (module (R := k) i ≅ module i') ↔ i = i'
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    exact birth_eq_of_iso e
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨Iso.refl _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.injective_postcomp_shiftLE_congr
statement:
private theorem injective_postcomp_shiftLE_congr
    (M : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    {ε δ σ : ℝ≥0} (hεδ : ε ≤ δ) (hεσ : ε ≤ σ) (hδσ : δ = σ)
    (h : Function.Injective (fun f : M ⟶ (shift ε).obj M => f ≫ shiftLE hεδ M)) :
    Function.Injective (fun f : M ⟶ (shift ε).obj M => f ≫ shiftLE hεσ M)
proof:
:= by
  subst σ
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_pos_interleaving_lowering
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_pos_interleaving_lowering
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) M) (hN : FinitelyPresented (R := R) N)
    (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ η : ℝ≥0, 0 < η ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ≥0, δ ≤ η →
      Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving (ε + δ) M N) →
        Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ε M N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨η₁, hη₁, hMN⟩ :=
    finitelyPresented_exists_pos_postcomp_shiftLE_bijective M N hM hN ε
  obtain ⟨η₂, hη₂, hNM⟩ :=
    finitelyPresented_exists_pos_postcomp_shiftLE_bijective N M hN hM ε
  obtain ⟨η₃, hη₃, hMM⟩ :=
    finitelyPresented_exists_pos_postcomp_shiftLE_bijective M M hM hM (ε + ε)
  obtain ⟨η₄, hη₄, hNN⟩ :=
    finitelyPresented_exists_pos_postcomp_shiftLE_bijective N N hN hN (ε + ε)
  let η := min η₁ (min η₂ (min (η₃ / 2) (η₄ / 2)))
  have hη : 0 < η :=
    lt_min hη₁ (lt_min hη₂ (lt_min (half_pos hη₃) (half_pos hη₄)))
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ ⟨i⟩
  have hδ₁ : δ ≤ η₁ := hδ.trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ₂ : δ ≤ η₂ := hδ.trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have hδ₃ : δ ≤ η₃ / 2 :=
    hδ.trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)))
  have hδ₄ : δ ≤ η₄ / 2 :=
    hδ.trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)))
  have htwice₃ : δ + δ ≤ η₃ := by
    calc
      δ + δ ≤ η₃ / 2 + η₃ / 2 := add_le_add hδ₃ hδ₃
      _ = η₃ := add_halves η₃
  have htwice₄ : δ + δ ≤ η₄ := by
    calc
      δ + δ ≤ η₄ / 2 + η₄ / 2 := add_le_add hδ₄ hδ₄
      _ = η₄ := add_halves η₄
  have hMM' : Function.Injective
      (fun f : M ⟶ (shift (ε + ε)).obj M =>
        f ≫ shiftLE (add_le_add (le_self_add : ε ≤ ε + δ) (le_self_add : ε ≤ ε + δ)) M) := by
    have heq : (ε + δ) + (ε + δ) = (ε + ε) + (δ + δ) := by ac_rfl
    exact injective_postcomp_shiftLE_congr M le_self_add _ heq.symm
      (hMM (δ + δ) htwice₃).1
  have hNN' : Function.Injective
      (fun f : N ⟶ (shift (ε + ε)).obj N =>
        f ≫ shiftLE (add_le_add (le_self_add : ε ≤ ε + δ) (le_self_add : ε ≤ ε + δ)) N) := by
    have heq : (ε + δ) + (ε + δ) = (ε + ε) + (δ + δ) := by ac_rfl
    exact injective_postcomp_shiftLE_congr N le_self_add _ heq.symm
      (hNN (δ + δ) htwice₄).1
  exact ⟨CoordinateInterleaving.of_postcomp_lifting le_self_add i
    (hMN δ hδ₁).2 (hNM δ hδ₂).2 hMM' hNN'⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_distance_le_iff_interleaving
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_distance_le_iff_interleaving
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) M) (hN : FinitelyPresented (R := R) N)
    (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance M N ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞) ↔
      Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ε M N)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hlower⟩ :=
      finitelyPresented_exists_pos_interleaving_lowering hM hN ε
    have hlt : coordinateInterleavingDistance M N < ((ε + η : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) :=
      h.trans_lt (ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.mpr (lt_add_of_pos_right ε hη))
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, ⟨i⟩⟩ := coordinateInterleavingDistance_lt_iff.mp hlt
    exact hlower η le_rfl ⟨i.mono (ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.mp hδ).le⟩
  · exact coordinateInterleavingDistance_le_of_nonempty

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_interleaving_at_distance
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_interleaving_at_distance
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) M) (hN : FinitelyPresented (R := R) N)
    (hf : coordinateInterleavingDistance M N ≠ ⊤) :
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving (coordinateInterleavingDistance M N).toNNReal M N)
proof:
:= by
  apply (finitelyPresented_distance_le_iff_interleaving hM hN _).mp
  exact (ENNReal.coe_toNNReal hf).symm.le

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_distance_eq_zero_iff_iso
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_distance_eq_zero_iff_iso
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) M) (hN : FinitelyPresented (R := R) N) :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance M N = 0 ↔ Nonempty (M ≅ N)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨i⟩ := (finitelyPresented_distance_le_iff_interleaving hM hN 0).mp
      (by simp [h])
    exact ⟨i.toIso⟩
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    exact coordinateInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_of_iso e

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_interleaving_parameters_eq_Ici
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_interleaving_parameters_eq_Ici
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) M) (hN : FinitelyPresented (R := R) N)
    (hf : coordinateInterleavingDistance M N ≠ ⊤) :
    {ε : ℝ≥0 | Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ε M N)} =
      Set.Ici (coordinateInterleavingDistance M N).toNNReal
proof:
:= by
  ext ε
  rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, ← finitelyPresented_distance_le_iff_interleaving hM hN,
    ← ENNReal.coe_toNNReal hf, ENNReal.coe_le_coe]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_isClosed_interleaving_parameters
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : coordinateInterleavingDistance M N = ⊤
  · have he : {ε : ℝ≥0 | Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ε M N)} = ∅ := by
      ext ε
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      intro h
      have hle := coordinateInterleavingDistance_le_of_nonempty h
      rw [hf] at hle
      exact ENNReal.coe_ne_top (top_le_iff.mp hle)
    rw [he]
    exact isClosed_empty
  · rw [finitelyPresented_interleaving_parameters_eq_Ici hM hN hf]
    exact isClosed_Ici

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.filledReal_scale_two_logDgm_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDgm_scale_points (ZMod 2) le_rfl filledReal filledReal_positive two_pos,
    filledReal_logDgm_one]
  simp [translateDiagramPoint, add_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.logDgm_scale_one
statement:
theorem logDgm_scale_one (k : Type) [Field k] {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {V : Type} [LinearOrder V] {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    [Fintype (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)] (f : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (hf : PositiveOnEdges f) :
    logDgm k (f.scale 1 one_pos) n = logDgm k f n
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDgm_scale k hn f hf one_pos, Real.log_one, translateDiagram_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.filledReal_logDgm_scale_one
statement:
theorem filledReal_logDgm_scale_one :
    logDgm (ZMod 2) (filledReal.scale 1 one_pos) 1 =
      logDgm (ZMod 2) filledReal 1
proof:
:= by
  exact logDgm_scale_one (ZMod 2) le_rfl filledReal filledReal_positive

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.hollowReal_logDgm_scale_one
statement:
theorem hollowReal_logDgm_scale_one :
    logDgm (ZMod 2) (hollowReal.scale 1 one_pos) 1 =
      logDgm (ZMod 2) hollowReal 1
proof:
:= by
  exact logDgm_scale_one (ZMod 2) le_rfl hollowReal hollowReal_positive

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.filledReal_scale_half_logDgm_one
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : Real.log (1 / 2 : ℝ) = -Real.log 2 := by
    rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]
  rw [logDgm_scale_points (ZMod 2) le_rfl filledReal filledReal_positive
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2), filledReal_logDgm_one]
  simp [translateDiagramPoint, hlog, add_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.hollowReal_scale_half_logDgm_one
proof:
:= by
  have hlog : Real.log (1 / 2 : ℝ) = -Real.log 2 := by
    rw [one_div, Real.log_inv]
  rw [logDgm_scale_points (ZMod 2) le_rfl hollowReal hollowReal_positive
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2), hollowReal_logDgm_one]
  simp [translateDiagramPoint, hlog]

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.filledReal_scale_half_birth_neg
statement: theorem filledReal_scale_half_birth_neg : -Real.log 2 < 0
proof:
:= by
  exact neg_lt_zero.mpr (Real.log_pos one_lt_two)

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.scaledPts_eq
statement: theorem scaledPts_eq : scaledPts = ![0, 4]
proof:
:= by
  funext v
  fin_cases v <;> norm_num [scaledPts, TwoPoints.pts, smul_eq_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.scaledPts_injective
statement: private theorem scaledPts_injective : Function.Injective scaledPts
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaledPts_eq]
  intro i j h
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> first | rfl | norm_num at h

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.scaledMetric_dist
statement:
theorem scaledMetric_dist (v w : Fin 2) :
    scaledMetric.dist v w = 2 * TwoPoints.metric.dist v w
proof:
:= by
  change dist (scaledPts v) (scaledPts w) = 2 * dist (TwoPoints.pts v) (TwoPoints.pts w)
  simp only [scaledPts, smul_eq_mul, Real.dist_eq]
  rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (two_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.scaled_rips_eq
statement:
theorem scaled_rips_eq :
    Rips.filter scaledMetric = (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).scale 2 two_pos
proof:
:= by
  exact Rips.filter_eq_scale_of_dist TwoPoints.metric scaledMetric two_pos scaledMetric_dist

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.scaled_cech_eq
statement:
theorem scaled_cech_eq :
    Cech.filter scaledPts = (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts).scale 2 two_pos
proof:
:= by
  exact Cech.filter_smul TwoPoints.pts two_pos

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.scaled_rips_logDgm_pos
statement:
theorem scaled_rips_logDgm_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter scaledMetric) n).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaled_rips_eq,
    logDgm_scale_points (ZMod 2) hn (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric)
      twoPoints_rips_positive two_pos,
    twoPoints_rips_logDgm_pos hn, Multiset.map_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.scaled_cech_logDgm_pos
statement:
theorem scaled_cech_logDgm_pos {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter scaledPts) n).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaled_cech_eq,
    logDgm_scale_points (ZMod 2) hn (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts)
      twoPoints_cech_positive two_pos,
    twoPoints_cech_logDgm_pos hn, Multiset.map_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleScalingExamples.scaled_bottleneck_eq
statement:
theorem scaled_bottleneck_eq {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    bottleneck (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter scaledMetric) n)
        (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter scaledPts) n) =

        (logDgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts) n)

    TwoPoints.pts two_pos TwoPoints.metric_dist scaledMetric_dist hn

name: TDA.Persistence.sum_fin_evenHookDegrees
statement:
private theorem sum_fin_evenHookDegrees (L : ℕ)
    (f : ℕ → Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n))) :
    (∑ j : Fin L, if Even j.val then f j.val else 0) =
      ∑ j ∈ evenHookDegrees L, f j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L)),
      if Even j.val then f j.val else 0) = _
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun j _ => j.val)
  · intro j hj
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, evenHookDegrees,
      Finset.mem_range] at hj ⊢
    exact ⟨j.isLt, hj⟩
  · intro j hj j' hj' heq
    exact Fin.ext heq
  · intro a ha
    simp only [evenHookDegrees, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at ha
    refine ⟨⟨a, ha.1⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    simp [evenHookDegrees, ha]
  · intro j hj
    rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.sum_fin_oddHookDegrees
statement:
private theorem sum_fin_oddHookDegrees (L : ℕ)
    (f : ℕ → Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n))) :
    (∑ j : Fin L, if Odd j.val then f j.val else 0) =
      ∑ j ∈ oddHookDegrees L, f j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (∑ j ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L)),
      if Odd j.val then f j.val else 0) = _
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
  apply Finset.sum_bij (fun j _ => j.val)
  · intro j hj
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, oddHookDegrees,
      Finset.mem_range] at hj ⊢
    exact ⟨j.isLt, hj⟩
  · intro j hj j' hj' heq
    exact Fin.ext heq
  · intro a ha
    simp only [oddHookDegrees, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at ha
    refine ⟨⟨a, ha.1⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    simp [oddHookDegrees, ha]
  · intro j hj
    rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.sum_fin_alternatingHookBetti
statement:
private theorem sum_fin_alternatingHookBetti (L : ℕ)
    (f g : ℕ → Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n))) :
    (∑ j : Fin L, if Even j.val then f j.val else g j.val) =
      (∑ j ∈ evenHookDegrees L, f j) +
        ∑ j ∈ oddHookDegrees L, g j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsplit (j : Fin L) :
      (if Even j.val then f j.val else g j.val) =
        (if Even j.val then f j.val else 0) +
          (if Odd j.val then g j.val else 0) := by
    by_cases he : Even j.val
    · have ho : ¬ Odd j.val := by
        intro ho
        exact (Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mpr ho) he
      simp [he, ho]
    · have ho : Odd j.val := Nat.not_even_iff_odd.mp he
      simp [he, ho]
  calc
    (∑ j : Fin L, if Even j.val then f j.val else g j.val) =
        ∑ j : Fin L,
          ((if Even j.val then f j.val else 0) +
            (if Odd j.val then g j.val else 0)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact hsplit j
    _ = (∑ j : Fin L, if Even j.val then f j.val else 0) +
          ∑ j : Fin L, if Odd j.val then g j.val else 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ = (∑ j ∈ evenHookDegrees L, f j) +
          ∑ j ∈ oddHookDegrees L, g j := by
      rw [sum_fin_evenHookDegrees, sum_fin_oddHookDegrees]

name: TDA.Persistence.evenHookBetti_extend_to
statement:
private theorem evenHookBetti_extend_to
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    {L : ℕ} (hL : R.resolution.length ≤ L) :
    (∑ j ∈ evenHookDegrees L,
      R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j) =
      R.evenHookBetti (k := k) (n := n) M hM
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.evenHookBetti
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro j hj
    simp only [evenHookDegrees, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hj ⊢
    exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hj.1 hL, hj.2⟩
  · intro j hj hjR
    simp only [evenHookDegrees, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hj hjR
    have hnot : ¬ j < R.resolution.length := fun hlt => hjR ⟨hlt, hj.2⟩
    exact R.hookBettiMultiset_eq_zero_of_length_le M hM (Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot)

name: TDA.Persistence.oddHookBetti_extend_to
statement:
private theorem oddHookBetti_extend_to
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    {L : ℕ} (hL : R.resolution.length ≤ L) :
    (∑ j ∈ oddHookDegrees L,
      R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j) =
      R.oddHookBetti (k := k) (n := n) M hM
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.oddHookBetti
  symm
  apply Finset.sum_subset
  · intro j hj
    simp only [oddHookDegrees, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hj ⊢
    exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hj.1 hL, hj.2⟩
  · intro j hj hjR
    simp only [oddHookDegrees, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hj hjR
    have hnot : ¬ j < R.resolution.length := fun hlt => hjR ⟨hlt, hj.2⟩
    exact R.hookBettiMultiset_eq_zero_of_length_le M hM (Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot)

name: TDA.Persistence.unshiftedSchanuelLeftHookPresentation_tagMultiset
statement:
theorem unshiftedSchanuelLeftHookPresentation_tagMultiset
    (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (hN : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) N)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    (S : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := N)) :
    hookTagMultiset
        (unshiftedSchanuelLeftHookPresentation M N hM hN R S).tag =
      (R.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) M hM).positive +
        (S.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) N hN).negative
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := max R.resolution.length S.resolution.length
  let X : Fin L → PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ) :=
    fun j => if Even j.val then R.termAt j.val else S.termAt j.val
  let P : ∀ j, FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := n) (X j) := fun j =>
    if he : Even j.val then
      by
        simpa only [X, if_pos he] using
          (Classical.choice (R.exists_hook_sum_presentation
            (k := k) (n := n) M hM j.val))
    else
      by
        simpa only [X, if_neg he] using
          (Classical.choice (S.exists_hook_sum_presentation
            (k := k) (n := n) N hN j.val))
  have hflat := FiniteHookSumPresentation.hookTagMultiset_biproduct
    (k := k) (n := n) X P
  have hterm (j : Fin L) :
      hookTagMultiset (P j).tag =
        if Even j.val then
          R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j.val
        else S.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) N hN j.val := by
    by_cases he : Even j.val
    · simp only [if_pos he]
      have hX : X j = R.termAt j.val := by simp [X, he]
      let Q : FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := n) (R.termAt j.val) :=
        ⟨(P j).count, (P j).tag, (eqToIso hX).symm.trans (P j).iso⟩
      exact (R.hookBettiMultiset_eq_tagMultiset M hM j.val Q).symm
    · simp only [if_neg he]
      have hX : X j = S.termAt j.val := by simp [X, he]
      let Q : FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := n) (S.termAt j.val) :=
        ⟨(P j).count, (P j).tag, (eqToIso hX).symm.trans (P j).iso⟩
      exact (S.hookBettiMultiset_eq_tagMultiset N hN j.val Q).symm
  have hsum :
      (∑ j : Fin L, hookTagMultiset (P j).tag) =
        ∑ j : Fin L, if Even j.val then
          R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j.val
        else S.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) N hN j.val := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    exact hterm j
  change hookTagMultiset
    (FiniteHookSumPresentation.biproduct (k := k) (n := n) X P).tag = _
  let hLr : R.resolution.length ≤ L := Nat.le_max_left _ _
  let hLs : S.resolution.length ≤ L := Nat.le_max_right _ _
  calc
    hookTagMultiset (FiniteHookSumPresentation.biproduct (k := k) (n := n) X P).tag =
        ∑ j : Fin L, hookTagMultiset (P j).tag := hflat
    _ = ∑ j : Fin L, if Even j.val then
          R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j.val
        else S.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) N hN j.val := hsum
    _ = R.evenHookBetti (k := k) (n := n) M hM +
          S.oddHookBetti (k := k) (n := n) N hN := by
      rw [sum_fin_alternatingHookBetti,
        evenHookBetti_extend_to M hM R hLr,
        oddHookBetti_extend_to N hN S hLs]

name: TDA.Persistence.unshiftedSchanuelRightHookPresentation_tagMultiset
statement:
theorem unshiftedSchanuelRightHookPresentation_tagMultiset
    (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (hN : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) N)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    (S : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := N)) :
    hookTagMultiset
        (unshiftedSchanuelRightHookPresentation M N hM hN R S).tag =
      (S.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) N hN).positive +
        (R.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) M hM).negative
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := max R.resolution.length S.resolution.length
  let X : Fin L → PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ) :=
    fun j => if Even j.val then S.termAt j.val else R.termAt j.val
  let P : ∀ j, FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := n) (X j) := fun j =>
    if he : Even j.val then
      by
        simpa only [X, if_pos he] using
          (Classical.choice (S.exists_hook_sum_presentation
            (k := k) (n := n) N hN j.val))
    else
      by
        simpa only [X, if_neg he] using
          (Classical.choice (R.exists_hook_sum_presentation
            (k := k) (n := n) M hM j.val))
  have hflat := FiniteHookSumPresentation.hookTagMultiset_biproduct
    (k := k) (n := n) X P
  have hterm (j : Fin L) :
      hookTagMultiset (P j).tag =
        if Even j.val then
          S.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) N hN j.val
        else R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j.val := by
    by_cases he : Even j.val
    · simp only [if_pos he]
      have hX : X j = S.termAt j.val := by simp [X, he]
      let Q : FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := n) (S.termAt j.val) :=
        ⟨(P j).count, (P j).tag, (eqToIso hX).symm.trans (P j).iso⟩
      exact (S.hookBettiMultiset_eq_tagMultiset N hN j.val Q).symm
    · simp only [if_neg he]
      have hX : X j = R.termAt j.val := by simp [X, he]
      let Q : FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := n) (R.termAt j.val) :=
        ⟨(P j).count, (P j).tag, (eqToIso hX).symm.trans (P j).iso⟩
      exact (R.hookBettiMultiset_eq_tagMultiset M hM j.val Q).symm
  have hsum :
      (∑ j : Fin L, hookTagMultiset (P j).tag) =
        ∑ j : Fin L, if Even j.val then
          S.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) N hN j.val
        else R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j.val := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    exact hterm j
  have hsum' :
      (∑ j : Fin L, if Even j.val then
      S.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) N hN j.val
      else R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j.val) =
        R.oddHookBetti (k := k) (n := n) M hM +
          S.evenHookBetti (k := k) (n := n) N hN := by
    rw [sum_fin_alternatingHookBetti]
    have hLr : R.resolution.length ≤ L := Nat.le_max_left _ _
    have hLs : S.resolution.length ≤ L := Nat.le_max_right _ _
    rw [oddHookBetti_extend_to M hM R hLr,
      evenHookBetti_extend_to N hN S hLs]
    ac_rfl
  change hookTagMultiset
    (FiniteHookSumPresentation.biproduct (k := k) (n := n) X P).tag = _
  calc
    hookTagMultiset (FiniteHookSumPresentation.biproduct (k := k) (n := n) X P).tag =
        ∑ j : Fin L, hookTagMultiset (P j).tag := hflat
    _ = ∑ j : Fin L, if Even j.val then
          S.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) N hN j.val
        else R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j.val := hsum
    _ = R.oddHookBetti (k := k) (n := n) M hM +
          S.evenHookBetti (k := k) (n := n) N hN := hsum'
    _ = (S.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) N hN).positive +
          (R.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) M hM).negative := by
      simp [MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.signedHookBarcode]
      ac_rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresented_exists_signedHookMultisetMatching
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_signedHookMultisetMatching
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (hN : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) N)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    (S : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := N))
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N) :
    HasMultisetMatching (k := k)
      ((((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) ^ 2) * ε)
      (((R.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) M hM).positive) +
        (S.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) N hN).negative)
      (((S.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) N hN).positive) +
        (R.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) M hM).negative)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P := unshiftedSchanuelLeftHookPresentation M N hM hN R S
  let Q := unshiftedSchanuelRightHookPresentation M N hM hN R S
  let hnn : 0 < n := by omega
  let iSum := finitelyPresented_unshiftedSchanuel_interleaving
    hn M N hM hN R S ε I
  let iHooks := iSum.congr P.iso Q.iso
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := HookMatching.exists_matching hnn P.tag Q.tag
    (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) iHooks
  have hwidth :
      RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n
          (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) =
        (((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) ^ 2) * ε := by
    simp [RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius]
    ring
  have hMatch : HookMatching.IsMatching (k := k)
      ((((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) ^ 2) * ε) P.tag Q.tag U := by
    rw [← hwidth]
    exact hU
  exact HasMultisetMatching.intro P.tag Q.tag
    (unshiftedSchanuelLeftHookPresentation_tagMultiset M N hM hN R S)
    (unshiftedSchanuelRightHookPresentation_tagMultiset M N hM hN R S)
    U hMatch

name: TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresented_signedHookBottleneckDistance_le
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_signedHookBottleneckDistance_le
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (hN : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) N)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    (S : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := N)) :
    signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity (k := k)
        (R.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) M hM)
        (S.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) N hN) ≤
      (((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2) * coordinateInterleavingDistance M N
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hc0 : (((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (pow_ne_zero 2 hc)
  have hct : (((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2) ≠ ⊤ := by
    exact ENNReal.pow_ne_top (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _)
  change hookMultisetBottleneckDistance (k := k)
      ((R.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) M hM).positive +
        (S.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) N hN).negative)
      ((S.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) N hN).positive +
        (R.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) M hM).negative) ≤
    (((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2) *
      (⨅ ε : ℝ≥0, ⨅ (_ : Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ε M N)),
        (ε : ℝ≥0∞))
  rw [ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne hc0 hct]
  apply le_iInf
  intro ε
  rw [ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne hc0 hct]
  apply le_iInf
  intro hI
  obtain ⟨I⟩ := hI
  have hmatch := finitelyPresented_exists_signedHookMultisetMatching
    hn M N hM hN R S ε I
  have hdist := hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_le_of_matching hmatch
  simpa [ENNReal.coe_mul, ENNReal.coe_pow, pow_two, mul_assoc] using hdist

name: TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode_eq
statement:
theorem finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode_eq
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) :
    finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode hn M hM =
      R.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) M hM
proof:
:= by
  change (Classical.choice
      (FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
        hn M hM)).signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) M hM =
    R.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := n) M hM
  exact (R.signedHookBarcode_eq M hM
    (Classical.choice
      (FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
        hn M hM))).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresented_moduleSignedHookBottleneckDistance_le
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_moduleSignedHookBottleneckDistance_le
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (hN : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) N) :
    signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity (k := k)
        (finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode hn M hM)
        (finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode hn N hN) ≤
      (((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) ^ 2) * coordinateInterleavingDistance M N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R⟩ :=
    FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
      hn M hM
  obtain ⟨S⟩ :=
    FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
      hn N hN
  have hfixed := finitelyPresented_signedHookBottleneckDistance_le hn M N hM hN R S
  simpa [finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode_eq hn M hM R,
    finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode_eq hn N hN S] using hfixed

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.incidenceToFunctions_injective
statement:

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.regularCoefficients_injective

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.regular_finiteDimensional

proof:

      ((FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S) →
        (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S) → k) := inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.columnFinsupp_apply
statement:
private theorem columnFinsupp_apply (q : (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S))
    (r : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) (regular (k := k) (S := S)))
    (a : (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S)) :
    columnFinsupp (k := k) (S := S) q r a =
      (MulOpposite.unop (r : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
        FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) a q
proof:
:= by
  change (regularCoefficients (k := k) (S := S) r) a q = _
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.columnFinsupp_supported
statement:
private theorem columnFinsupp_supported (q : (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S))
    (r : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) (regular (k := k) (S := S))) :
    columnFinsupp (k := k) (S := S) q r ∈
      GradedFree.fiber (R := k) (generators (S := S)) q
proof:
:= by
  change columnFinsupp (k := k) (S := S) q r ∈
    Finsupp.supported k k {a : (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S) | a ≤ q}
  rw [Finsupp.mem_supported']
  intro a ha
  change ((MulOpposite.unop (r : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) a q) = 0
  exact IncidenceAlgebra.apply_eq_zero_of_not_le ha _

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.columnMap_apply
statement:
private theorem columnMap_apply (q : (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S))
    (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) (regular (k := k) (S := S)) q)
    (a : (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S)) :
    ((columnMap (k := k) (S := S) q x :
      GradedFree.fiber (R := k) (generators (S := S)) q).val a) =
      (MulOpposite.unop (x.val : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
        FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) a q
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.regular_fixed_eq_column
statement:
private theorem regular_fixed_eq_column
    (q : (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S)) (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S)
      (regular (k := k) (S := S)) q) :
    ((MulOpposite.unop (x : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
      FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) *
        FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.delta (k := k) (S := S) q q le_rfl) =
      MulOpposite.unop (x : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  have hx := (mem_vertexFiber_iff (k := k) (S := S)
    (regular (k := k) (S := S)) q x).1 x.property
  change IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit
      (k := k) (S := S) q q le_rfl * x.val = x.val at hx
  have hu := congrArg MulOpposite.unop hx
  simpa [IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit,
    MulOpposite.unop_mul] using hu

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.regular_fixed_zero_off_column
statement:
private theorem regular_fixed_zero_off_column
    (q : (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S)) (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S)
      (regular (k := k) (S := S)) q) {a t : (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S)} (ht : t ≠ q) :
    (MulOpposite.unop (x : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
      FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) a t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence
    (k := k) (S := S) => f a t)
      (regular_fixed_eq_column (k := k) (S := S) q x)
  rw [FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.mul_delta_right_apply_column
    (hdq := le_rfl)] at h
  simpa [ht] using h.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.columnMap_birth
statement:
private theorem columnMap_birth (p : (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S)) :
    (columnNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S)).app p
      (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S)
        (regular (k := k) (S := S)) p 1) =
        GradedFree.birth (R := k) (generators (S := S)) p
proof:
:= by
  have hproj :
      (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S)
        (regular (k := k) (S := S)) p 1 : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) =
        IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
          p p le_rfl := by
    change IncidenceVertexRepresentation.diagonalProjector
      (k := k) (S := S) (regular (k := k) (S := S)) p 1 = _
    change IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit
      (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • (1 : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) = _
    simp
  change columnMap (k := k) (S := S) p
      (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) (regular (k := k) (S := S)) p 1) = _
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro a
  calc
    _ = (MulOpposite.unop
        ((projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S)
          (regular (k := k) (S := S)) p 1).val)) a p :=
      columnMap_apply (k := k) (S := S) p _ a
    _ = (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.delta (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl) a p := by
      exact congrArg (fun r : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S) =>
        (MulOpposite.unop r) a p) hproj
    _ = _ := by
      change (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.delta (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl) a p =
        (Finsupp.single p (1 : k)) a
      simp [FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.delta_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.alpha_column_id
proof:
:= by
  calc
    alpha (k := k) (S := S) ≫ columnNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S) =
        GradedFree.lift (R := k) (generators (S := S))
          (freeVertexModule (k := k) (S := S))
          (fun p => GradedFree.birth (R := k) (generators (S := S)) p) := by
      apply GradedFree.lift_unique (R := k) (generators (S := S))
      intro p
      change (columnNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S)).app p
        ((alpha (k := k) (S := S)).app p
          (GradedFree.birth (R := k) (generators (S := S)) p)) = _
      have h := GradedFree.lift_birth (R := k) (generators (S := S))
        ((vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).obj (regular (k := k) (S := S)))
        (fun p => projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S)
          (regular (k := k) (S := S)) p 1) p
      exact (congrArg (fun x => (columnNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S)).app p x)
        h).trans (columnMap_birth (k := k) (S := S) p)
    _ = 𝟙 (freeVertexModule (k := k) (S := S)) := by
      symm
      apply GradedFree.lift_unique (R := k) (generators (S := S))
      intro p
      simp [GradedFree.lift_birth]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.columnMap_injective
statement:
private theorem columnMap_injective (p : (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S)) :
    Function.Injective (columnMap (k := k) (S := S) p)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
  apply IncidenceAlgebra.ext
  intro a t hat
  by_cases ht : t = p
  · subst t
    have hcol := congrArg (fun z : (freeVertexModule (k := k) (S := S)).obj p =>
      z.val a) hxy
    exact (columnMap_apply (k := k) (S := S) p x a).symm.trans
      (hcol.trans (columnMap_apply (k := k) (S := S) p y a))
  · rw [regular_fixed_zero_off_column (k := k) (S := S) p x ht,
        regular_fixed_zero_off_column (k := k) (S := S) p y ht]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.columnMap_surjective
statement:
private theorem columnMap_surjective (p : (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S)) :
    Function.Surjective (columnMap (k := k) (S := S) p)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  refine ⟨(alpha (k := k) (S := S)).app p y, ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f.app p y) (alpha_column_id (k := k) (S := S))
  change (columnNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S)).app p
      ((alpha (k := k) (S := S)).app p y) = y at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.regularVertexIso_hom_coefficient
statement:
theorem regularVertexIso_hom_coefficient
    (q a : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S)
    (x : vertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) (regular (k := k) (S := S)) q) :
    (((regularVertexIso (k := k) (S := S)).hom.app q x :
      GradedFree.fiber (R := k) (generators (S := S)) q).val a) =
      (MulOpposite.unop (x.val : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
        FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) a q
proof:
:= by
  change ((columnMap (k := k) (S := S) q x :
    GradedFree.fiber (R := k) (generators (S := S)) q).val a) = _
  exact columnMap_apply (k := k) (S := S) q x a

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.regularVertexIso_hom_birth
statement:
theorem regularVertexIso_hom_birth (p : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S) :
    (regularVertexIso (k := k) (S := S)).hom.app p
      (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) (regular (k := k) (S := S)) p 1) =
      GradedFree.birth (R := k) (generators (S := S)) p
proof:
:= by
  change (columnNaturalTransformation (k := k) (S := S)).app p
    (projectToVertexFiber (k := k) (S := S) (regular (k := k) (S := S)) p 1) = _
  exact columnMap_birth (k := k) (S := S) p

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.regularVertex_projective
statement:
theorem regularVertex_projective :
    Projective ((IncidenceVertexRepresentation.vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).obj
      (regular (k := k) (S := S)))
proof:
:= by
  exact Projective.of_iso (regularVertexIso (k := k) (S := S)).symm
    (freeVertexModule_projective (k := k) (S := S))

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.finiteFreeVertex_projective
statement:
theorem finiteFreeVertex_projective (n : ℕ) :
    Projective ((IncidenceVertexRepresentation.vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).obj
      (finiteFreeModule (k := k) (S := S) n))
proof:
:= by
  let fU : ULift.{u} (Fin n) → PModule.{u,0,u} k (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S) :=
    fun i => (IncidenceVertexRepresentation.vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).obj
      (regularULiftFamily (k := k) (S := S) n i)
  let f : Fin n → PModule.{u,0,u} k (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset S) :=
    fun i => (IncidenceVertexRepresentation.vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).obj
      (regularFamily (k := k) (S := S) n i)
  letI : HasBiproduct fU := inferInstance
  letI : ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin n), Projective (fU i) := fun _ =>
    regularVertex_projective (k := k) (S := S)
  have hU : Projective (⨁ fU) :=
    CategoryTheory.Projective.instBiproduct fU
  have e : (⨁ fU) ≅ ⨁ f :=
    biproduct.whiskerEquiv (f := fU) (g := f) Equiv.ulift
      (fun i => Iso.refl (f i.down))
  have hF : Projective (⨁ f) := Projective.of_iso e hU
  exact Projective.of_iso (finiteFreeVertexBiproductIso (k := k) (S := S) n) hF

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.finiteFreeModule_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem finiteFreeModule_finiteDimensional (n : ℕ) :
    FiniteDimensional k
      (restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) (finiteFreeModule (k := k) (S := S) n))
proof:
:= by
  let e : restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S)
        (finiteFreeModule (k := k) (S := S) n) ≃ₗ[k]
      (Fin n → restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) (regular (k := k) (S := S))) := {
    toFun := fun x i => x i
    invFun := fun f i => f i
    left_inv := by intro x; rfl
    right_inv := by intro x; rfl
    map_add' := by intro x y; rfl
    map_smul' := by intro c x; ext i; rfl
  }
  letI : FiniteDimensional k
      (restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) (regular (k := k) (S := S))) :=
    regular_finiteDimensional (k := k) (S := S)
  haveI : FiniteDimensional k
      (Fin n → restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) (regular (k := k) (S := S))) := inferInstance
  exact e.finiteDimensional

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceRegularVertex.projective_of_vertex_projective

theorem projective_of_vertex_projective
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))

    Projective M

    (IncidenceVertexRepresentation.vertexFunctor (k := k) (S := S)) hM

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.shift_relationMap_square
statement:
theorem Presentation.shift_relationMap_square (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (D : Presentation.{u,0,w} (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (D.shift ε).relationMap ≫ (shiftIso (R := R) ε D.generators).hom =
      (shiftIso (R := R) ε D.relations).hom ≫
        (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map D.relationMap
proof:
:= by
  simp [Presentation.shift, Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.shift_finite
statement:
theorem Presentation.shift_finite (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (D : Presentation.{u,0,w} (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ))
    (hD : D.IsFinite) : (D.shift ε).IsFinite
proof: := hD

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.cover_presentedShiftIso
statement:
theorem Presentation.cover_presentedShiftIso (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (D : Presentation.{u,0,w} (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (D.shift ε).cover ≫ (D.presentedShiftIso ε).hom =
      (shiftIso (R := R) ε D.generators).hom ≫
        (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map D.cover
proof:
:= by
  let c := cokernel.mapIso (f := (D.shift ε).relationMap)
    ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).map D.relationMap)
    (shiftIso (R := R) ε D.relations)
    (shiftIso (R := R) ε D.generators)
    (D.shift_relationMap_square ε)
  let p := PreservesCokernel.iso (CoordinateShift.shift ε) D.relationMap
  have hc : (D.shift ε).cover ≫ c.hom =
      (shiftIso (R := R) ε D.generators).hom ≫
        cokernel.π ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).map D.relationMap) := by
    change cokernel.π (D.shift ε).relationMap ≫ c.hom = _
    dsimp [c, cokernel.mapIso, cokernel.map]
    rw [cokernel.π_desc]
    rfl
  have hp : (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (cokernel.π D.relationMap) ≫ p.hom =
      cokernel.π ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).map D.relationMap) :=
    PreservesCokernel.π_iso_hom (CoordinateShift.shift ε) D.relationMap
  change (D.shift ε).cover ≫ (c ≪≫ p.symm).hom =
    (shiftIso (R := R) ε D.generators).hom ≫
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map D.cover
  apply (cancel_mono p.hom).mp
  change (((D.shift ε).cover ≫ c.hom) ≫ p.inv) ≫ p.hom =
    ((shiftIso (R := R) ε D.generators).hom ≫
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (cokernel.π D.relationMap)) ≫ p.hom
  simp only [Category.assoc, p.inv_hom_id, Category.comp_id]
  rw [hc]
  change (shiftIso (R := R) ε D.generators).hom ≫
      cokernel.π ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).map D.relationMap) =
    ((shiftIso (R := R) ε D.generators).hom ≫
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (cokernel.π D.relationMap)) ≫ p.hom
  rw [Category.assoc, hp]

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_shift
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_shift (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {M : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    FinitelyPresented (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ)
      ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hM
  exact ⟨D.shift ε, D.shift_finite ε hD,
    ⟨(D.presentedShiftIso ε) ≪≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).mapIso e⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryTransportExamples.singleton_minimum
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_min
    · simpa [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, pairSingletons] using
        finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost
          (fun _ : Unit => p) (fun _ : Unit => q) pairSingletons
    · simpa using finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_diagonalSum
        (fun _ : Unit => p) (fun _ : Unit => q)
  · apply (le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro M
    cases h : M.finite () with
    | none => simp [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, h]
    | some j => cases j; simp [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryTransportExamples.repeated_minimum
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h := finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost
      (fun _ : Fin 2 => ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ)) (fun _ : Unit => (0, 2)) selectFirst
    norm_num [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, selectFirst, Fin.sum_univ_two,
      Fin.exists_fin_succ, finitePairCost, diagonalCost] at h ⊢
    exact h
  · apply (le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro M
    cases h0 : M.finite 0 with
    | none =>
      cases h1 : M.finite 1 with
      | none =>
        norm_num [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, Fin.sum_univ_two,
          Fin.exists_fin_succ, h0, h1, diagonalCost]
        simp
      | some j => cases j; norm_num [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, Fin.sum_univ_two,

    | some j =>
      cases j

      | none => norm_num [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, Fin.sum_univ_two,
          Fin.exists_fin_succ, h0, h1, finitePairCost, diagonalCost]
      | some j =>
        cases j
        have h := M.finite_injective 0 1 () h0 h1
        norm_num at h

theorem moving_tied_edge_full_strict_cr (r : ℕ∞ω) :
    ∃ e : CompatibleOrder (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter (0 : ℝ)),
      0 < (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1 ∧
      (strictFaceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1 = 0 ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ r
        (fixedFaceLift (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0) Set.univ ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ r
        (strictFaceLift (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0) Set.univ ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ,
        orderedQ (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1
          (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0).2
          (fixedFaceLift (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0 t) =
        orderedQ (strictFaceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1
          (strictFaceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0).2
          (strictFaceLift (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0 t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, hpos⟩ := Examples.moving_tied_edge_has_finite_slot
  refine ⟨e, hpos, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [strictFaceLiftCounts, strictFacePairList, Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter]
  · apply fixedFaceLift_contDiffOn_cr
    intro s
    change ContDiffOn ℝ r (fun x : ℝ => x) Set.univ
    exact contDiffOn_id
  · apply strictFaceLift_contDiffOn_cr
    intro s
    change ContDiffOn ℝ r (fun x : ℝ => x) Set.univ
    exact contDiffOn_id
  · intro t
    have horder : ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) →
        OrderingEquivalent (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter 0)
          (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter x) := by
      intro x _ _ _
      simp [Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter]
    rw [← fixedFaceLift_factorization (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter
      e 0 horder t (Set.mem_univ t)]
    exact strictFaceLift_factorization (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter
      e 0 horder t (Set.mem_univ t)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.shiftLE_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftLE_app {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε ≤ δ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (shiftLE h M).app t =
      structureMap M (add_le_add (le_refl t) (show (ε : ℝ) ≤ δ from h))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.φ_ψ_structureMap
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem φ_ψ_structureMap (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (t : ℝ) :
    i.φ.app t ≫ i.ψ.app (t + (ε : ℝ)) =
      structureMap M (show t ≤ (t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) from
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg))
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono ((compIso ε ε M).hom.app t)).mp
  erw [Category.assoc, i.φ_ψ_app]
  change M.map _ = M.map _ ≫ M.map _
  erw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.enlarge_equation
statement:
private theorem enlarge_equation (h : ε ≤ δ) (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (t : ℝ) :
    (i.φ ≫ shiftLE h N).app t ≫ (i.ψ ≫ shiftLE h M).app (t + (δ : ℝ)) =
      structureMap M (show t ≤ (t + (δ : ℝ)) + (δ : ℝ) from
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [NatTrans.comp_app, shiftLE, shift, reindex]
  repeat' erw [Category.assoc]
  erw [i.ψ.naturality_assoc]
  erw [← Category.assoc, i.φ_ψ_structureMap]
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  erw [← M.map_comp, ← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.compose_equation
statement:
private theorem compose_equation (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)
    (j : RealInterleaving δ N P) (h : ε + δ = σ) (h' : δ + ε = σ) (t : ℝ) :
    (composeMap i.φ j.φ h).app t ≫
        (composeMap j.ψ i.ψ h').app (t + (σ : ℝ)) =
      structureMap M (show t ≤ (t + (σ : ℝ)) + (σ : ℝ) from
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right σ.coe_nonneg).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right σ.coe_nonneg))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [composeMap, NatTrans.comp_app, shift_map_app]
  simp only [compIso_hom_app, congrIso_hom_app]
  repeat' erw [Category.assoc]
  
  erw [j.ψ.naturality_assoc]
  erw [j.ψ.naturality_assoc]
  erw [i.ψ.naturality_assoc]
  erw [i.ψ.naturality_assoc]
  
  erw [← Category.assoc (j.φ.app (t + (ε : ℝ))) (j.ψ.app ((t + (ε : ℝ)) + (δ : ℝ))),
    j.φ_ψ_structureMap]
  erw [i.ψ.naturality_assoc]
  erw [← Category.assoc (i.φ.app t) (i.ψ.app (t + (ε : ℝ))),
    i.φ_ψ_structureMap]
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  repeat' erw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_minimal_resolution_with_hook_sum_terms
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_minimal_resolution_with_hook_sum_terms
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    ∃ R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M),
      ∀ j, Nonempty (FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := n) (R.termAt j))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨G, A, hA, ⟨e⟩⟩ := GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_pfd_finiteGridKan M hM
  obtain ⟨RGrid, hGrid⟩ :=
    FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_with_hook_sum_terms_of_pfd_finitePoset
      A hA
  let RLan := G.lanMinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolutionObj RGrid
  let R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M) := {
    resolution := RLan.resolution.ofIso e
    quotient_is_cover := RLan.quotient_is_cover
  }
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j < R.resolution.length
  · let i : Fin R.resolution.length := ⟨j, hj⟩
    obtain ⟨m, tagGrid, ⟨eGrid⟩⟩ := hGrid i
    let tagReal : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n) :=
      fun r => embedGridHookTag G (tagGrid r)
    let eTerm : R.termAt j ≅ G.lan.obj (RGrid.resolution.term i) := by
      exact (eqToIso (R.termAt_eq hj)).trans
        (eqToIso (by rfl : R.resolution.term i = RLan.resolution.term i))
    let eHooks : G.lan.obj
          (⨁ fun r => FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule
            (k := k) (tagGrid r)) ≅
        ⨁ fun r => FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule
          (k := k) (tagReal r) :=
      (G.lanBiproductIso (fun r =>
        FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (tagGrid r))).trans
        (biproduct.mapIso (fun r => embedGridHookTagLanIso G (tagGrid r)))
    have eReal : R.termAt j ≅
        ⨁ fun r => FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule
          (k := k) (tagReal r) := by
      calc
        R.termAt j ≅ G.lan.obj (RGrid.resolution.term i) := eTerm
        _ ≅ G.lan.obj (⨁ fun r =>
            FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule
              (k := k) (tagGrid r)) := G.lan.mapIso eGrid
        _ ≅ ⨁ fun r => FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule
            (k := k) (tagReal r) := eHooks
    exact ⟨⟨m, tagReal, eReal⟩⟩
  · have hle : R.resolution.length ≤ j := Nat.le_of_not_gt hj
    let emptyTag : Fin 0 → RealHookTag (n := n) := Fin.elim0
    have hEmpty : IsZero
        (⨁ fun i : Fin 0 =>
          FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (emptyTag i)) := by
      apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
      apply biproduct.hom_ext'
      intro i
      exact Fin.elim0 i
    have eEmpty : R.termAt j ≅
        ⨁ fun i : Fin 0 =>
          FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (emptyTag i) := by
      rw [R.termAt_eq_zero hle]
      exact (isZero_zero _).isoZero.trans hEmpty.isoZero.symm
    exact ⟨⟨0, emptyTag, eEmpty⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.exists_hook_sum_presentation
statement:
theorem MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.exists_hook_sum_presentation
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)

    FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_minimal_resolution_with_hook_sum_terms
      (k := k) (n := n) M hM
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := R.termAt_nonempty_iso R₀ j
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := hR₀ j
  exact ⟨⟨P.count, P.tag, e.trans P.iso⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.hookBettiMultiset_eq_tagMultiset

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.hookBettiMultiset_eq

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.hookBettiMultiset_eq_zero_of_length_le
statement:
theorem MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.hookBettiMultiset_eq_zero_of_length_le
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)

    (hj : R.resolution.length ≤ j) :

proof:
:= by
  let P := Classical.choice
    (R.exists_hook_sum_presentation (k := k) (n := n) M hM j)
  let emptyTag : Fin 0 → RealHookTag (n := n) := Fin.elim0
  have hEmpty : IsZero
      (⨁ fun i : Fin 0 =>
        FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule
          (k := k) (emptyTag i)) := by
    apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
    apply biproduct.hom_ext'
    intro i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  let Q : FiniteHookSumPresentation
      (k := k) (n := n) (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) :=
    ⟨0, emptyTag, (isZero_zero _).isoZero.trans hEmpty.isoZero.symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.hookBettiMultiset_eq_zero_of_term_isZero

    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.evenHookBetti_eq
statement:
theorem MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.evenHookBetti_eq
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (R S : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) :
    R.evenHookBetti (k := k) (n := n) M hM =
      S.evenHookBetti (k := k) (n := n) M hM
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := max R.resolution.length S.resolution.length
  have hR : evenHookDegrees R.resolution.length ⊆ evenHookDegrees L := by
    intro j hj
    simp only [evenHookDegrees, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hj ⊢
    exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hj.1 (Nat.le_max_left _ _), hj.2⟩
  have hS : evenHookDegrees S.resolution.length ⊆ evenHookDegrees L := by
    intro j hj
    simp only [evenHookDegrees, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hj ⊢
    exact ⟨lt_of_lt_of_le hj.1 (Nat.le_max_right _ _), hj.2⟩
  have hExtendR :
      (∑ j ∈ evenHookDegrees R.resolution.length,
        R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j) =
      ∑ j ∈ evenHookDegrees L,
        R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset hR
    intro j hj hjR
    simp only [evenHookDegrees, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hj hjR
    have hnot : ¬ j < R.resolution.length := fun hlt => hjR ⟨hlt, hj.2⟩
    exact R.hookBettiMultiset_eq_zero_of_length_le M hM (Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot)
  have hExtendS :
      (∑ j ∈ evenHookDegrees S.resolution.length,
        S.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j) =
      ∑ j ∈ evenHookDegrees L,
        S.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset hS
    intro j hj hjS
    simp only [evenHookDegrees, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hj hjS
    have hnot : ¬ j < S.resolution.length := fun hlt => hjS ⟨hlt, hj.2⟩
    exact S.hookBettiMultiset_eq_zero_of_length_le M hM (Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot)
  unfold MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.evenHookBetti
  rw [hExtendR]
  rw [hExtendS]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  exact R.hookBettiMultiset_eq M hM S j

  have hExtendR :
