    simp only [oddHookDegrees, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hj hjR
    have hnot : ¬ j < R.resolution.length := fun hlt => hjR ⟨hlt, hj.2⟩
    exact R.hookBettiMultiset_eq_zero_of_length_le M hM (Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot)
  have hExtendS :
      (∑ j ∈ oddHookDegrees S.resolution.length,
        S.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j) =
      ∑ j ∈ oddHookDegrees L,
        S.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := n) M hM j := by
    apply Finset.sum_subset hS
    intro j hj hjS
    simp only [oddHookDegrees, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range] at hj hjS
    have hnot : ¬ j < S.resolution.length := fun hlt => hjS ⟨hlt, hj.2⟩
    exact S.hookBettiMultiset_eq_zero_of_length_le M hM (Nat.le_of_not_gt hnot)
  unfold MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.oddHookBetti
  rw [hExtendR]
  rw [hExtendS]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  exact R.hookBettiMultiset_eq M hM S j

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.signedHookBarcode_eq

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationColimitsExamples.repeated_nonzero_quotient_cokernel_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem repeated_nonzero_quotient_cokernel_finitelyPresented
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ} :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ)
        (Limits.cokernel
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) ⟶
            (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k n).presented)) ∧
      ∃ x : (Limits.cokernel
        (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) ⟶
          (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k n).presented)).obj
            ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2)),
        x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let D := FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k n
  let e : Limits.cokernel (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented) ≅
      D.presented := Limits.cokernelZeroIsoTarget
  refine ⟨GradedFree.finitelyPresented_cokernel
      (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)
      zero_finitelyPresented (repeatedPresentation_finitelyPresented), ?_⟩
  refine ⟨(e.inv.app ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2))).hom
      (FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k n), ?_⟩
  intro hx
  have hv : (e.hom.app ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2))).hom
      ((e.inv.app ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2))).hom
        (FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k n)) = 0 := by
    rw [hx, map_zero]
  have hzero : FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k n = 0 := by
    simpa using hv
  exact FinitePresentationKanExamples.surviving_generator n hzero

theorem repeated_redundant_presentation_finitelyPresented
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ} :
    let D := FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k n
    let E := D.adjoinRedundant (redundantGenerators n)
      (fun _ => (D.cover.app ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2))).hom
        (GradedFree.birth (FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators n) (0 : Fin 2)))
    E.IsFinite ∧ FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) E.presented
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let D := FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k n
  let V := redundantGenerators n
  let E := D.adjoinRedundant V
    (fun _ => (D.cover.app ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2))).hom
      (GradedFree.birth (FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators n) (0 : Fin 2)))
  have hD : D.IsFinite := FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation_finite k n
  have hE : E.IsFinite := D.adjoinRedundant_finite (V := V) (chosen := fun _ =>
    (D.cover.app ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2))).hom
      (GradedFree.birth (FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators n) (0 : Fin 2))) hD
  exact ⟨hE, E.finitelyPresented hE⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationColimitsExamples.identityQuotient_rankExact
statement:
private theorem identityQuotient_rankExact
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (hM : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) M) :
    IsRankExact (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) ⟶ M) (𝟙 M)
proof:
:= by
  letI : ∀ p : P, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) :=
    fun p => GradedFree.finitelyPresented_finiteDimensional M hM p
  have hs : IsPointwiseShortExact
      (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) ⟶ M) (𝟙 M) := by
    constructor
    · intro p x y _
      exact (ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)).elim _ _
    · intro p x
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    · intro p
      simp
  exact hs.rankExact_of_section (𝟙 M) (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationColimitsExamples.arbitrary_field_rank_exact_pushout_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem arbitrary_field_rank_exact_pushout_finitelyPresented
    {k : Type u} [Field k] :
    let D := FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2
    let hs := identityQuotient_rankExact (repeatedPresentation_finitelyPresented (k := k) (n := 2))
    FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (Limits.pushout
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)) ∧
      IsRankExact (Limits.pushout.inr
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented))
        (hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact.pushoutQuotient
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)) ∧
      ∃ x : (Limits.pushout
        (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)
        (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)).obj
          ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2).grade (1 : Fin 2)),
        x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let D := FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2
  let f : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented := 0
  have hD : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ) D.presented :=
    repeatedPresentation_finitelyPresented
  have hs : IsRankExact (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)
      (𝟙 D.presented) := identityQuotient_rankExact hD
  have hout := hs.pushout_finitelyPresented f zero_finitelyPresented hD hD
  let p := (FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2).grade (1 : Fin 2)
  refine ⟨hout.1, hout.2, ?_⟩
  have hsecond : FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2 ≠ 0 :=
    FinitePresentationKanExamples.surviving_generator 2
  refine ⟨((Limits.pushout.inr (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented) f).app p).hom
    (FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2), ?_⟩
  intro hx
  have hx' : ((Limits.pushout.inr
      (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented) f).app p).hom
      (FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2) =
    ((Limits.pushout.inr
      (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented) f).app p).hom 0 := by
    rw [map_zero]
    exact hx
  have hzero := hout.2.toIsPointwiseShortExact.injective p hx'
  exact hsecond hzero

name: TDA.Persistence.rankBarcode_count_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Multiset.ext'
  intro I
  have hpred (J : FiniteInterval N) :
      (J.birth = I.birth ∧ J.death = I.death) ↔ J = I := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hb, hd⟩
      cases J with
      | mk jb jd hjb hjd =>
        cases I with
        | mk ib id hib hid => simp_all
    · intro h
      subst J
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have he := h I.birth I.death I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size
  have hB : B.count I = barcodeMultiplicity B I.birth I.death := by
    simpa [barcodeMultiplicity, Multiset.count, eq_comm] using
      (Multiset.countP_congr (s := B) (s' := B) rfl
        (fun J _ => propext (hpred J)))
  have hC : C.count I = barcodeMultiplicity C I.birth I.death := by
    simpa [barcodeMultiplicity, Multiset.count, eq_comm] using
      (Multiset.countP_congr (s := C) (s' := C) rfl
        (fun J _ => propext (hpred J)))
  rw [hB, hC, he]

name: TDA.Persistence.oneStageMultiplicity
proof:
:= by
  have hself := moduleRankInteger_fin M (0 : Fin 1) (0 : Fin 1) (le_refl _)
  have hr : structureMapRank M (0 : Fin 1) 0 (le_refl _) =
      Module.finrank k (M.obj 0) := by
    unfold structureMapRank
    rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
  simp only [moduleMultiplicityInteger, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_one]
  norm_num only
  simp only [moduleRankInteger_neg_one]
  rw [show moduleRankInteger M 0 1 = 0 from moduleRankInteger_at_size M 0]
  change moduleRankInteger M 0 0 = _ at hself
  rw [hself, hr]
  ring

statement:
private theorem oneFieldRankBarcode :
    rankBarcode (oneField (k := k)) = ({bar01} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply rankBarcode_count_eq
  intro b d hbd hd
  have hb : b = 0 := by omega
  have hd' : d = 1 := by omega
  subst b
  subst d
  have h := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (oneField (k := k)) 0 1 (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [oneFieldMultiplicity] at h
  exact_mod_cast (show barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (oneField (k := k))) 0 1 = 1 by
    exact_mod_cast h).trans (by decide)

name: TDA.Persistence.twoStageValues
statement:
private theorem twoStageValues (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2))
    [∀ i : Fin 2, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger M 0 1 =
      (Module.finrank k (M.obj (0 : Fin 2)) : ℤ) -
        structureMapRank M 0 1 (by decide) ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger M 0 2 =
      (structureMapRank M 0 1 (by decide) : ℤ) ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger M 1 2 =
      (Module.finrank k (M.obj (1 : Fin 2)) : ℤ) -
        structureMapRank M 0 1 (by decide)
proof:
:= by
  have h00 := moduleRankInteger_fin M (0 : Fin 2) 0 (le_refl _)
  have h01 := moduleRankInteger_fin M (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide)
  have h11 := moduleRankInteger_fin M (1 : Fin 2) 1 (le_refl _)
  have h0 : structureMapRank M 0 0 (le_refl (0 : Fin 2)) =
      Module.finrank k (M.obj 0) := by
    unfold structureMapRank
    rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
  have h1 : structureMapRank M 1 1 (le_refl (1 : Fin 2)) =
      Module.finrank k (M.obj 1) := by
    unfold structureMapRank
    rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
  simp only [moduleMultiplicityInteger, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  norm_num only
  simp only [moduleRankInteger_neg_one]
  rw [show moduleRankInteger M 0 2 = 0 from moduleRankInteger_at_size M 0,
    show moduleRankInteger M 1 2 = 0 from moduleRankInteger_at_size M 1]
  change moduleRankInteger M 0 0 = _ at h00
  change moduleRankInteger M 0 1 = _ at h01
  change moduleRankInteger M 1 1 = _ at h11
  rw [h00, h01, h11, h0, h1]
  constructor
  · ring
  · constructor <;> ring

name: TDA.Persistence.identityModuleRank
statement:
private theorem identityModuleRank :
    structureMapRank (identityTransitionDiagram k) 0 1 (by decide) = 1
proof:
:=
  (equal_dimensions_different_structureMapRanks (k := k)).2.1

name: TDA.Persistence.zeroModuleRank
statement:
private theorem zeroModuleRank :
    structureMapRank (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 0 1 (by decide) = 0
proof:
:=
  (equal_dimensions_different_structureMapRanks (k := k)).2.2

name: TDA.Persistence.identityMu
statement:
private theorem identityMu :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (identityTransitionDiagram k) 0 1 = 0 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (identityTransitionDiagram k) 0 2 = 1 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (identityTransitionDiagram k) 1 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := twoStageValues (identityTransitionDiagram k)
  rw [identityModuleRank] at h
  simpa only [show Module.finrank k ((identityTransitionDiagram k).obj (0 : Fin 2)) = 1
      from Module.finrank_self k,
    show Module.finrank k ((identityTransitionDiagram k).obj (1 : Fin 2)) = 1
      from Module.finrank_self k, Nat.cast_one, sub_self] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.zeroMu
statement:
private theorem zeroMu :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 0 1 = 1 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 0 2 = 0 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 1 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := twoStageValues (zeroTransitionDiagram k)
  rw [zeroModuleRank] at h
  simpa only [show Module.finrank k ((zeroTransitionDiagram k).obj (0 : Fin 2)) = 1
      from Module.finrank_self k,
    show Module.finrank k ((zeroTransitionDiagram k).obj (1 : Fin 2)) = 1
      from Module.finrank_self k, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.twoStageClassify
statement:
private theorem twoStageClassify (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ 2) :
    (b = 0 ∧ d = 1) ∨ (b = 0 ∧ d = 2) ∨ (b = 1 ∧ d = 2)
proof: := by omega

name: TDA.Persistence.identityBarcode
proof:
:= by
  apply rankBarcode_count_eq
  intro b d hbd hd
  rcases twoStageClassify b d hbd hd with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · have h := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram k) 0 1 (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [identityMu.1] at h
    exact_mod_cast (show barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram k)) 0 1 = 0 by
      exact_mod_cast h).trans (by decide)
  · have h := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram k) 0 2 (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [identityMu.2.1] at h
    exact_mod_cast (show barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram k)) 0 2 = 1 by
      exact_mod_cast h).trans (by decide)
  · have h := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram k) 1 2 (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [identityMu.2.2] at h
    exact_mod_cast (show barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram k)) 1 2 = 0 by
      exact_mod_cast h).trans (by decide)

name: TDA.Persistence.zeroBarcode
proof:
:= by
  apply rankBarcode_count_eq
  intro b d hbd hd
  rcases twoStageClassify b d hbd hd with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · have h := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 0 1 (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [zeroMu.1] at h
    exact_mod_cast (show barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram k)) 0 1 = 1 by
      exact_mod_cast h).trans (by decide)
  · have h := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 0 2 (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [zeroMu.2.1] at h
    exact_mod_cast (show barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram k)) 0 2 = 0 by
      exact_mod_cast h).trans (by decide)
  · have h := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 1 2 (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [zeroMu.2.2] at h
    exact_mod_cast (show barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram k)) 1 2 = 1 by
      exact_mod_cast h).trans (by decide)

name: TDA.Persistence.sameDimensionsDifferentBarcodes
statement:
private theorem sameDimensionsDifferentBarcodes :
    (∀ i : Fin 2,
      Module.finrank k ((identityTransitionDiagram k).obj i) =
        Module.finrank k ((zeroTransitionDiagram k).obj i)) ∧
    rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram k) ≠ rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram k)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact (equal_dimensions_different_structureMapRanks (k := k)).1
  · intro he
    have hr := (rankBarcode_eq_iff (identityTransitionDiagram k)
      (zeroTransitionDiagram k)).mp he 0 1 (by decide)
    rw [identityModuleRank, zeroModuleRank] at hr
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.equalityCriterionForward
statement:
private theorem equalityCriterionForward :
    ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (hij : i ≤ j),
      structureMapRank (identityTransitionDiagram k) i j hij =
        structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) ({bar02} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2))) i j hij
proof:
:= by
  apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff (identityTransitionDiagram k)
    (barcodeModule (k := k) ({bar02} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2)))).mp
  rw [identityBarcode, rankBarcode_barcodeModule]

name: TDA.Persistence.identityRealizationRanks
statement:
private theorem identityRealizationRanks :
    ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (hij : i ≤ j),
      structureMapRank (identityTransitionDiagram k) i j hij =
        structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) ({bar02} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2))) i j hij
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hleft : structureMapRank (identityTransitionDiagram k) i j hij = 1 := by
    change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k)) = 1
    rw [LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
    exact Module.finrank_self k
  have hright :
      structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) ({bar02} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2)))
        i j hij = 1 := by
    rw [rank_barcodeMap]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> decide
  rw [hleft, hright]

name: TDA.Persistence.equalityCriterionReverse
proof:
:= by
  apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff (identityTransitionDiagram k)
    (barcodeModule (k := k) ({bar02} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2)))).mpr
  exact identityRealizationRanks

name: TDA.Persistence.twoCopiesDimension
statement: private theorem twoCopiesDimension : Module.finrank k (k × k) = 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Module.finrank_prod, Module.finrank_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.twoCopiesModuleRank
statement:
private theorem twoCopiesModuleRank :
    structureMapRank (twoCopies (k := k)) 0 1 (by decide) = 2
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : (k × k) →ₗ[k] (k × k))) = 2
  rw [LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
  exact twoCopiesDimension

name: TDA.Persistence.twoCopiesMu
statement:
private theorem twoCopiesMu :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (twoCopies (k := k)) 0 1 = 0 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (twoCopies (k := k)) 0 2 = 2 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (twoCopies (k := k)) 1 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := twoStageValues (twoCopies (k := k))
  rw [twoCopiesModuleRank] at h
  simpa only [show Module.finrank k ((twoCopies (k := k)).obj (0 : Fin 2)) = 2
      from twoCopiesDimension,
    show Module.finrank k ((twoCopies (k := k)).obj (1 : Fin 2)) = 2
      from twoCopiesDimension, Nat.cast_ofNat, sub_self] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.twoCopiesBarcode
proof:
:= by
  apply rankBarcode_count_eq
  intro b d hbd hd
  rcases twoStageClassify b d hbd hd with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  · have h := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (twoCopies (k := k)) 0 1 (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [twoCopiesMu.1] at h
    exact_mod_cast (show barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (twoCopies (k := k))) 0 1 = 0 by
      exact_mod_cast h).trans (by decide)
  · have h := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (twoCopies (k := k)) 0 2 (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [twoCopiesMu.2.1] at h
    exact_mod_cast (show barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (twoCopies (k := k))) 0 2 = 2 by
      exact_mod_cast h).trans (by decide)
  · have h := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (twoCopies (k := k)) 1 2 (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [twoCopiesMu.2.2] at h
    exact_mod_cast (show barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (twoCopies (k := k))) 1 2 = 0 by
      exact_mod_cast h).trans (by decide)

name: TDA.Persistence.twoCopiesMultiplicity
statement:
private theorem twoCopiesMultiplicity :
    barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (twoCopies (k := k))) 0 2 = 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (twoCopies (k := k)) 0 2 (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [twoCopiesMu.2.1] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: TDA.Persistence.rationalInstances
statement:
private theorem rationalInstances :
    rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram ℚ) = ({bar02} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2)) ∧
    rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram ℚ) =
      ({bar01two, bar12two} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2)) ∧
    barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (twoCopies (k := ℚ))) 0 2 = 2 ∧
    structureMapRank (twoCopies (k := ℚ)) 0 1 (by decide) = 2 ∧
    rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram ℚ) ≠
      rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨identityBarcode, zeroBarcode, twoCopiesMultiplicity,
    twoCopiesModuleRank, (sameDimensionsDifferentBarcodes (k := ℚ)).2⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.zmodTwoInstances
statement:
private theorem zmodTwoInstances :
    rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram (ZMod 2)) =
      ({bar02} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2)) ∧
    rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram (ZMod 2)) =
      ({bar01two, bar12two} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2)) ∧
    barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (twoCopies (k := ZMod 2))) 0 2 = 2 ∧
    structureMapRank (twoCopies (k := ZMod 2)) 0 1 (by decide) = 2 ∧
    rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram (ZMod 2)) ≠
      rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram (ZMod 2))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨identityBarcode, zeroBarcode, twoCopiesMultiplicity,
    twoCopiesModuleRank, (sameDimensionsDifferentBarcodes (k := ZMod 2)).2⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.rectangleCellBox_boxRectangleCell
statement:

  simp only [rectangleCellBox, h, dif_pos]
  exact (boxRectangleCell_injective h.choose_spec).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.boxRectangleCell_rectangleCellBox
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, _, rfl⟩ := exists_boxRectangleCell hU hne

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleRectangleValue_empty

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleRectangleValue_boxRectangleCell

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleRectangleContent_apply

theorem moduleRectangleContent_apply (hM : M.QTame) (a b c d : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.sourceCharge_nonneg
statement:
private theorem sourceCharge_nonneg
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (i : I) : 0 ≤ sourceCharge M x y i
proof:
:= by
  unfold sourceCharge
  cases M.finite i <;> exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.targetCharge_nonneg
statement:
private theorem targetCharge_nonneg
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (j : J) : 0 ≤ targetCharge M y j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold targetCharge
  split_ifs <;> positivity

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_eq_symmetricSums
statement:
private theorem totalFiniteCost_eq_symmetricSums
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.totalFiniteCost x y =
      (∑ i, ∑ j, if M.finite i = some j then (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal else 0) +
      (∑ i, if ∃ j, M.finite i = some j then 0 else (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal) +
      ∑ j, targetCharge M y j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs (i : I) : sourceCharge M x y i =
      (∑ j, if M.finite i = some j then (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal else 0) +
      (if ∃ j, M.finite i = some j then 0 else (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal) := by
    cases h : M.finite i <;> simp [sourceCharge, h]
  change (∑ i, sourceCharge M x y i) + ∑ j, targetCharge M y j = _
  simp_rw [hs]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_reverse
statement:
theorem totalFiniteCost_reverse
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.reverse.totalFiniteCost y x = M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [totalFiniteCost_eq_symmetricSums, totalFiniteCost_eq_symmetricSums]
  unfold targetCharge
  simp_rw [reverse_finite_some_iff, finitePairCost_comm (y _) (x _)]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  abel

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.diagonal_toReal_le_pair_add
statement:
private theorem diagonal_toReal_le_pair_add (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (diagonalCost p).toReal ≤ (finitePairCost p q).toReal + (diagonalCost q).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono
    (by simp [finitePairCost, diagonalCost]) (diagonalCost_le_pair_add p q)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add (show finitePairCost p q ≠ ⊤ by simp [finitePairCost])
    (show diagonalCost q ≠ ⊤ by simp [diagonalCost])] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.pair_toReal_triangle
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [finitePairCost_toReal, dist_eq_norm] using dist_triangle p q r

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_compose_le
statement:
theorem totalFiniteCost_compose_le
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (N : OccurrenceMatching J K PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (z : K → ℝ × ℝ) :
    (M.compose N).totalFiniteCost x z ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y + N.totalFiniteCost y z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hs (i : I) : sourceCharge (M.compose N) x z i ≤ sourceCharge M x y i +
      (match M.finite i with | some j => sourceCharge N y z j | none => 0) := by
    cases hm : M.finite i with
    | none => simp [sourceCharge, compose, hm]
    | some j =>
      cases hn : N.finite j with
      | none =>
        simpa [sourceCharge, compose, hm, hn] using diagonal_toReal_le_pair_add (x i) (y j)
      | some k =>
        simpa [sourceCharge, compose, hm, hn] using pair_toReal_triangle (x i) (y j) (z k)
  have hsource : (∑ i, sourceCharge (M.compose N) x z i) ≤
      (∑ i, sourceCharge M x y i) +
        ∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then sourceCharge N y z j else 0 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i, (sourceCharge M x y i +
          (match M.finite i with | some j => sourceCharge N y z j | none => 0)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hs i)
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        exact congrArg (fun r => (∑ i, sourceCharge M x y i) + r)
          (M.sum_matched (sourceCharge N y z))
  
  have hncomp (k : K) (hn : ¬ ∃ j, N.finite j = some k) :
      ¬ ∃ i, (M.compose N).finite i = some k := by
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    cases hm : M.finite i with
    | none => simp [compose, hm] at hi
    | some j => exact hn ⟨j, by simpa [compose, hm] using hi⟩
  
  have hsplit : (∑ k, targetCharge (M.compose N) z k) =
      (∑ j, match N.finite j with
        | some k => targetCharge (M.compose N) z k | none => 0) +
      ∑ k, targetCharge N z k := by
    calc
      _ = (∑ k, if ∃ j, N.finite j = some k then targetCharge (M.compose N) z k else 0) +
          ∑ k, targetCharge N z k := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro k _
        by_cases hn : ∃ j, N.finite j = some k
        · simp [targetCharge, hn]
        · simp [targetCharge, hn, hncomp k hn]
      _ = _ := congrArg (fun r => r + ∑ k, targetCharge N z k)
        (N.sum_matched (targetCharge (M.compose N) z)).symm
  
  have ht (j : J) :
      (match N.finite j with
        | some k => targetCharge (M.compose N) z k | none => 0) ≤
      targetCharge M y j +
        (if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else sourceCharge N y z j) := by
    cases hn : N.finite j with
    | none =>
      exact add_nonneg (targetCharge_nonneg M y j)
        (by split_ifs <;> first | exact le_rfl | exact sourceCharge_nonneg N y z j)
    | some k =>
      by_cases hm : ∃ i, M.finite i = some j
      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hm
        have hc : ∃ i, (M.compose N).finite i = some k :=
          ⟨i, by simp [compose, hi, hn]⟩
        simp [targetCharge, hc, show ∃ i, M.finite i = some j from ⟨i, hi⟩]
      · have hdiag : (diagonalCost (z k)).toReal ≤
            (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal + (finitePairCost (y j) (z k)).toReal := by
          simpa only [finitePairCost_comm, add_comm] using
            diagonal_toReal_le_pair_add (z k) (y j)
        calc
          _ ≤ (diagonalCost (z k)).toReal := by
            change targetCharge (M.compose N) z k ≤ _
            unfold targetCharge
            split_ifs <;> first | exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg | exact le_rfl
          _ ≤ _ := by simpa [targetCharge, sourceCharge, hm, hn] using hdiag
  have htarget : (∑ k, targetCharge (M.compose N) z k) ≤
      (∑ j, targetCharge M y j) +
        (∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else sourceCharge N y z j) +
        ∑ k, targetCharge N z k := by
    rw [hsplit]
    refine add_le_add ?_ le_rfl
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ j, (targetCharge M y j +
          (if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else sourceCharge N y z j)) :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ht j)
      _ = _ := Finset.sum_add_distrib
  have hpartition :
      (∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then sourceCharge N y z j else 0) +
        (∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else sourceCharge N y z j) =
      ∑ j, sourceCharge N y z j := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    split_ifs <;> simp
  change (∑ i, sourceCharge (M.compose N) x z i) +
      (∑ k, targetCharge (M.compose N) z k) ≤
    ((∑ i, sourceCharge M x y i) + ∑ j, targetCharge M y j) +
      ((∑ j, sourceCharge N y z j) + ∑ k, targetCharge N z k)
  have h := add_le_add hsource htarget
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.sourceCharge_le_total
statement:
private theorem sourceCharge_le_total
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (i : I) :
    sourceCharge M x y i ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, sourceCharge M x y i :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => sourceCharge_nonneg M x y i) (Finset.mem_univ i)
    _ ≤ (∑ i, sourceCharge M x y i) + ∑ j, targetCharge M y j :=
      le_add_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ => targetCharge_nonneg M y j))

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.targetCharge_le_total
statement:
private theorem targetCharge_le_total
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (j : J) :
    targetCharge M y j ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ j, targetCharge M y j :=
      Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => targetCharge_nonneg M y j) (Finset.mem_univ j)
    _ ≤ (∑ i, sourceCharge M x y i) + ∑ j, targetCharge M y j :=
      le_add_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sourceCharge_nonneg M x y i))

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.diagonal_toReal_pos
statement:
private theorem diagonal_toReal_pos {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p.1 < p.2) :
    0 < (diagonalCost p).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalCost_toReal, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hp)]
  exact div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hp) (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.exists_valueEquiv_of_totalFiniteCost_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem exists_valueEquiv_of_totalFiniteCost_eq_zero
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2)
    (hzero : M.totalFiniteCost x y = 0) :
    ∃ e : I ≃ J, ∀ i, x i = y (e i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs (i : I) : ∃ j, M.finite i = some j := by
    cases hi : M.finite i with
    | some j => exact ⟨j, rfl⟩
    | none =>
      have hd : (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ≤ 0 := by
        simpa only [sourceCharge, hi, hzero] using sourceCharge_le_total M x y i
      exact (not_le_of_gt (diagonal_toReal_pos (hx i)) hd).elim
  have ht (j : J) : ∃ i, M.finite i = some j := by
    by_contra hn
    have hd : (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ≤ 0 := by
      simpa only [targetCharge, if_neg hn, hzero] using targetCharge_le_total M x y j
    exact not_le_of_gt (diagonal_toReal_pos (hy j)) hd
  let f : I → J := fun i => (hs i).choose
  have hf (i : I) : M.finite i = some (f i) := (hs i).choose_spec
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro i i' he
    exact M.finite_injective i i' (f i) (hf i) (he ▸ hf i')
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro j
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ht j
    exact ⟨i, Option.some.inj ((hf i).symm.trans hi)⟩
  let e : I ≃ J := Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩
  refine ⟨e, fun i => ?_⟩
  have hc : ‖x i - y (f i)‖ ≤ 0 := by
    simpa only [sourceCharge, hf i, finitePairCost_toReal, hzero] using
      sourceCharge_le_total M x y i
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hc (norm_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_self (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : OccurrenceMatching I I PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1} :=
    ⟨some, by intro i i' j hi hi'; exact Option.some.inj (hi.trans hi'.symm), Equiv.refl _⟩
  have hcost : M.totalFiniteCost x x = 0 := by
    simp [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, M]
  exact le_antisymm ((finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost x x M).trans_eq hcost)
    (finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_nonneg x x)

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_comm
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_comm (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y = finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost y x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching y x
  apply le_antisymm
  · calc
      _ ≤ N.reverse.totalFiniteCost x y := finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost _ _ _
      _ = N.totalFiniteCost y x := N.totalFiniteCost_reverse y x
      _ = _ := hN
  · calc
      _ ≤ M.reverse.totalFiniteCost y x := finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost _ _ _
      _ = M.totalFiniteCost x y := M.totalFiniteCost_reverse x y
      _ = _ := hM

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_triangle
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_triangle
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (z : K → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x z ≤
      finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y + finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost y z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching y z
  calc
    _ ≤ (M.compose N).totalFiniteCost x z := finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost _ _ _
    _ ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y + N.totalFiniteCost y z := M.totalFiniteCost_compose_le N x y z
    _ = _ := by rw [hM, hN]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_eq_zero_of_equiv
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_eq_zero_of_equiv
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (e : I ≃ J) (he : ∀ i, x i = y (e i)) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx : y ∘ e = x := funext (fun i => (he i).symm)
  have hy : y ∘ Equiv.refl J = y := rfl
  have h := finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_reindex e (Equiv.refl J) y y
  rw [hx, hy] at h
  exact h.trans (finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_self y)

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_eq_zero_iff
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y = 0 ↔ ∃ e : I ≃ J, ∀ i, x i = y (e i)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
    exact M.exists_valueEquiv_of_totalFiniteCost_eq_zero x y hx hy (hM.trans hz)
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    exact finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_eq_zero_of_equiv x y e he

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.Moved.pts_injective
statement: theorem pts_injective : Function.Injective pts
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  have h0 : pts i 0 = pts j 0 := congrFun h 0
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> first | rfl | norm_num [pts] at h0

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.Moved.metric_dist
statement: theorem metric_dist (v w : Fin 2) : metric.dist v w = dist (pts v) (pts w)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.Moved.dist_pts
statement: theorem dist_pts : dist (pts 0) (pts 1) = 3
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.dist_le_of_coord (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num [pts]) (by norm_num [pts])

    norm_num [pts] at h

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.Moved.pairwiseDiscrepancy_eq
statement:
theorem pairwiseDiscrepancy_eq :
    Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric metric = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · unfold Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy
    refine (Finset.fold_max_le _).2 ⟨zero_le_one, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨v, w⟩ -
    change |TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric.dist v w -
      metric.dist v w| ≤ 1
    rw [TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric_dist, metric_dist]
    fin_cases v <;> fin_cases w
    · simp
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue]
      rw [TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.dist_pts, dist_pts]
      norm_num
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue]
      rw [dist_comm (TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts 1)
        (TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts 0),
        dist_comm (pts 1) (pts 0),
        TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.dist_pts, dist_pts]
      norm_num
    · simp
  · have h := Rips.abs_dist_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy
      TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric metric 0 1
    rw [TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric_dist, metric_dist,
      TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.dist_pts, dist_pts] at h
    norm_num at h
    exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.Moved.displacement_eq
statement:
theorem displacement_eq :
    Cech.displacement TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts pts = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (Cech.displacement_le_iff _ _ 1).2 ⟨zero_le_one, ?_⟩
    intro v
    fin_cases v
    · simp [TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts, pts]
    · exact TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.dist_le_of_coord (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num [TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts, pts])
        (by norm_num [TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts, pts])
  · have h := Cech.dist_le_displacement
      TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts pts 1
    have hcoord := TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.coord_le_dist
      (TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts 1) (pts 1) 0
    norm_num [TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts, pts] at hcoord
    exact hcoord.trans h

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.Moved.toReal_bottleneck_le_half
statement:
theorem toReal_bottleneck_le_half (n : ℕ) :
    (bottleneck (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter
        TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts) n)
      (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n)).toReal ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa [pairwiseDiscrepancy_eq] using
    Cech.toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy ℚ
      TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric metric
      TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts pts
      TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric_dist metric_dist n

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.Moved.embedding_arctan
statement:
theorem embedding_arctan (n : ℕ) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding 1 (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one)
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter
            TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding 1 (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one)
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n)‖ ≤
      (2 + √2 * π / 2) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter
            TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan ℚ
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric metric
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts pts
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric_dist metric_dist n 1 zero_le_one
  simpa [pairwiseDiscrepancy_eq] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.Moved.kernel_arctan
statement:
theorem kernel_arctan (n : ℕ) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    |WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel 1 1
          (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) D
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter
            TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts) n) -
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel 1 1
          (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) D
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n)| ≤
      (2 + √2 * π / 2) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter
            TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Cech.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan ℚ
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric metric
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts pts
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric_dist metric_dist n 1 1
      zero_le_one D
  simpa [pairwiseDiscrepancy_eq] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.Moved.image_arctan
statement:
theorem image_arctan (n : ℕ) {K : Type*} [Fintype K] (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage 1
          (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) P
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter
            TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts) n) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage 1
          (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) P
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n)‖ ≤
      (2 + 3 * √(π / 2)) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter
            TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan ℚ
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric metric
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts pts
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric_dist metric_dist n one_pos
      zero_le_one P hm hdisj
  simpa [pairwiseDiscrepancy_eq] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_le_displacement
statement:
theorem half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_le_displacement {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (d e : MetricSpace V) (p q : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) :
    Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e / 2 ≤ Cech.displacement p q
proof:
:= by
  have h := Cech.pairwiseDiscrepancy_le_two_mul_displacement d e p q hd he
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_lt_displacement
statement:
theorem half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_lt_displacement :
    Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy
        TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric Moved.metric / 2 <
      Cech.displacement TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts Moved.pts
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.zero_weight_consumers
statement:
theorem zero_weight_consumers {V : Type} [LinearOrder V] [Fintype V]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (σ : ℝ) (d e : MetricSpace V) (p q : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (n : ℕ)
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 0 le_rfl) P
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 0 le_rfl) P
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n) = 0 ∧
      WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 0 le_rfl)
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 0 le_rfl)
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n) = 0 ∧
      0 < 3 * √(π / 2) ∧ 0 < √2 * π / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : 0 < √(π / 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr Real.pi_div_two_pos
  refine ⟨by simp [TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.zero_weight_image],
    by simp [TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.zero_weight_embedding], ?_, ?_⟩
  · positivity
  · have hsqrt_two : 0 < √(2 : ℝ) := by positivity
    have hpi : 0 < (π : ℝ) := Real.pi_pos
    positivity

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.self_coincide
statement:
theorem self_coincide (n : ℕ) (q : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ v w, TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric.dist v w =
      dist (q v) (q w)) (σ τ : ℝ) {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D : Diagram ℝ)
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ' : ℝ} (hσ' : 0 < σ') (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter
            TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts) n) =
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n) ∧
      WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter
            TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts) n) =
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n) ∧
      PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ' w P
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter
            TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts) n) =
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ' w P
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy ℚ
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts
    q
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric_dist
    hq n σ hA hB w
  have h₂ := Cech.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy ℚ
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts
    q
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric_dist
    hq n σ τ hA hB w D
  have h₃ := Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy ℚ
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts
    q
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric_dist
    hq n hσ' hA hB w P hm hdisj
  rw [Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy_self, zero_div, mul_zero] at h₁ h₂ h₃
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h₁ (norm_nonneg _)))
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h₂ (abs_nonneg _)))
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h₃ (norm_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.line_bottleneck_le_half
statement:
theorem line_bottleneck_le_half (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.pts) n)
        (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter TDA.Persistence.Cech.Examples.MovedPoint.q) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Cech.bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_real ℚ
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.metric
    TDA.Persistence.Cech.Examples.MovedPoint.metricQ
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.pts
    TDA.Persistence.Cech.Examples.MovedPoint.q
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.metric_dist
    TDA.Persistence.Cech.Examples.MovedPoint.metricQ_dist n
  have hδ := TDA.Persistence.Cech.SupNormDiagramExamples.MovedPoint.pairwiseDiscrepancy_le
  exact h.trans (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hδ (by norm_num)))

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.bar_scale_points
proof:
:= by
  rw [Diagram.scale, Diagram.map_points]
  norm_num [bar, scaleFinitePair]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.bar_bottleneck_le
statement:
theorem bar_bottleneck_le :
    bottleneck bar (bar.scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := bottleneck_self_scale_le bar (c := (2 : ℝ)⁻¹)
    (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two) (M := 2)
    (by
      intro p hp
      have hp0 : ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)) = p := by
        simpa [bar, finitePart] using hp
      have hp' : p = ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)) := hp0.symm
      subst p
      norm_num)
    (by
      intro b hb
      simp [bar, essentialPart] at hb)
  convert h using 1 <;> norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.bar_bottleneck_eq
statement:
theorem bar_bottleneck_eq :
    bottleneck bar (bar.scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpresentation :
      bottleneck bar (bar.scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)) =
        presentationBottleneck
          (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)))
          (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)))
          (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) := by
    refine bottleneck_eq_presentation _ _ _ _ _ _ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    all_goals (try rw [bar_scale_points])
    all_goals simp [bar, finitePart, essentialPart]
    all_goals rfl
  rw [hpresentation]
  let M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 1) (Fin 1) (Fin 0) (Fin 0) :=
    { finite := fun _ => some 0
      finite_injective := fun i i' _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim i i'
      essential := Equiv.refl _ }
  have hupper :
      presentationBottleneck
          (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)))
          (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)))
          (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ M.cost (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)))
          (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)))
          (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) :=
        presentationBottleneck_le_cost _ _ _ _ M
      _ = 1 := by
        simp [M, OccurrenceMatching.cost, finitePairCost]
        norm_num
  have hlower :
      1 ≤ presentationBottleneck
          (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)))
          (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)))
          (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) := by
    apply le_iInf
    intro M
    unfold OccurrenceMatching.cost
    apply le_trans ?_ (le_max_left _ _)
    have hle := (Finset.le_sup (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)))
      (f := fun i => match M.finite i with
        | some j => finitePairCost ((fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ))) i)
            ((fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))) j)
        | none => diagonalCost ((fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ))) i))
      (Finset.mem_univ 0))
    cases h : M.finite 0 with
    | none =>
        exact le_trans
          (show (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ diagonalCost ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)) by
            norm_num [diagonalCost])
          (by simpa [h] using hle)
    | some j =>
        have hj : j = 0 := by fin_cases j; rfl
        exact le_trans
          (show (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ finitePairCost ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ))
              ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) by
            norm_num [finitePairCost, hj])
          (by simpa [h, hj] using hle)
  exact le_antisymm hupper hlower

name: TDA.Persistence.CechSupNormConsumersExamples.Diagonal.rips_cech_image_arctan
statement:
theorem rips_cech_image_arctan (n : ℕ) {K : Type*} [Fintype K]
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage 1
          (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) P
          (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metric) n) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage 1
          (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) P
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n)‖ ≤
      (2 + 3 * √(π / 2)) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metric) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_rips_sub_cech_le ℚ metric pts metric_dist n
    one_pos zero_le_one Real.pi_div_two_pos.le
    (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) P hm hdisj
  rw [PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_arctan, diameter_eq] at h
  convert h using 2 <;> norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.coinvariantsEquiv_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem coinvariantsEquiv_mkQ {N : Type u} [AddCommGroup N] [Module k N]
    [Module (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) N]
    (e : M ≃+ N)
    (hk : ∀ (c : k) (x : M), e ((algebraMap k (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) c) • x) =
      c • e x)
    (hA : ∀ (a : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (x : M), e (a • x) = a • e x)
    (x : M) :
    coinvariantsEquiv (k := k) (S := S) v e hk hA
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) v M).mkQ x) =
        (vertexRelation (k := k) (R := Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
          (N := N) (vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)).mkQ (e x)
proof:
:= by
  have he : (restrictedKLinearEquiv (k := k) (S := S) e hk) x = e x := by
    change (e.toLinearEquiv hk) x = e x
    exact congrFun (AddEquiv.coe_toLinearEquiv e hk) x
  simp only [coinvariantsEquiv, Submodule.Quotient.equiv_apply, Submodule.mapQ_mkQ]
  exact congrArg (fun y : N =>
    (vertexRelation (k := k) (R := Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
      (N := N) (vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)).mkQ y) he

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.relation_map_le
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.2
  rintro _ ⟨⟨a, m⟩, rfl⟩
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨(a, f.hom m), ?_⟩
  change a • f.hom m - vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v a • f.hom m =
    (restrictMap (k := k) (S := S) f)
      (a • m - vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v a • m)
  rw [map_sub]
  change a • f.hom m - vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v a • f.hom m =
    f.hom (a • m) - (restrictMap (k := k) (S := S) f)
      (vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v a • m)
  rw [← f.hom.map_smul]
  change f.hom (a • m) - vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v a •
      (restrictMap (k := k) (S := S) f m) = _
  rw [← (restrictMap (k := k) (S := S) f).map_smul]

    (hk : ∀ (c : k) (x : M), e ((algebraMap k (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) c) • x) =
      c • e x)
    (hA : ∀ (a : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (x : M), e (a • x) = a • e x)
    (x : M) :
    coinvariantsEquiv (k := k) (S := S) v e hk hA
      (mk (k := k) (S := S) v M x) =
        (vertexRelation (k := k) (R := Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
          (N := N) (vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)).mkQ (e x)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.vertexTensor_map_apply_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertexTensor_map_apply_mkQ {M N : ModuleCat (Incidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (f : M ⟶ N) (m : M) :
    (vertexTensor (k := k) (S := S) v).map f ((relation (k := k) (S := S) v M).mkQ m) =

:=
  vertexRelation_mkQ (k := k) (R := Incidence (k := k) (S := S))

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.kLinearOfRestrictedMap_apply
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.balancedBilinear_balanced
statement:
private theorem balancedBilinear_balanced {V : ModuleCat k}
    (g : M ⟶ (characterRestriction (k := k) (S := S) v).obj V)
    (x : k) (a : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (m : M) :
    balancedBilinear (k := k) (S := S) v g (x *
      vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v a) m =
      balancedBilinear (k := k) (S := S) v g x (a • m)
proof:
:= by
  have h : kLinearOfRestrictedMap (k := k) (S := S) v g (a • m) =
      vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v a •
        kLinearOfRestrictedMap (k := k) (S := S) v g m := by
    rw [kLinearOfRestrictedMap_apply, kLinearOfRestrictedMap_apply]
    exact g.hom.map_smul a m
  change (x * vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v a) •
      kLinearOfRestrictedMap (k := k) (S := S) v g m =
    x • kLinearOfRestrictedMap (k := k) (S := S) v g (a • m)
  rw [h, mul_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.toCharacterRestriction_apply
statement:
@[simp] private theorem toCharacterRestriction_apply {V : ModuleCat k}
    (f : coinvariants (k := k) (S := S) v M ⟶ V) (m : M) :
    (toCharacterRestriction (k := k) (S := S) v f).hom m =
      f.hom ((relation (k := k) (S := S) v M).mkQ m)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.fromCharacterRestriction_apply_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] private theorem fromCharacterRestriction_apply_mkQ {V : ModuleCat k}
    (g : M ⟶ (characterRestriction (k := k) (S := S) v).obj V) (m : M) :
    (fromCharacterRestriction (k := k) (S := S) v g).hom
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) v M).mkQ m) =
        kLinearOfRestrictedMap (k := k) (S := S) v g m
proof:
:= by
  change vertexBalancedFactor (χ := vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)
      (balancedBilinear (k := k) (S := S) v g)
      (balancedBilinear_balanced (k := k) (S := S) v g)
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) v M).mkQ m) = _
  rw [show (relation (k := k) (S := S) v M).mkQ m =
      vertexPure (χ := vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v) 1 m by simp [vertexPure]]
  simpa [balancedBilinear, kLinearOfRestrictedMap] using vertexBalancedFactor_pure
    (χ := vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)
    (balancedBilinear (k := k) (S := S) v g)
    (balancedBilinear_balanced (k := k) (S := S) v g) 1 m

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro q
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (relation (k := k) (S := S) v M').mkQ_surjective q
  rw [← hm]
  change (fromCharacterRestriction (k := k) (S := S) v (f ≫ g)).hom
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) v M').mkQ m) =
    ((map (k := k) (S := S) v f ≫
      fromCharacterRestriction (k := k) (S := S) v g).hom)
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) v M').mkQ m)
  rw [ModuleCat.hom_comp]
  change (fromCharacterRestriction (k := k) (S := S) v (f ≫ g)).hom
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) v M').mkQ m) =
    (fromCharacterRestriction (k := k) (S := S) v g).hom
      ((vertexTensor (k := k) (S := S) v).map f
        ((relation (k := k) (S := S) v M').mkQ m))
  rw [vertexTensor_map_apply_mkQ (k := k) (S := S) v f m]
  rw [fromCharacterRestriction_apply_mkQ, kLinearOfRestrictedMap_apply,
    fromCharacterRestriction_apply_mkQ, kLinearOfRestrictedMap_apply]
  rw [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.homEquiv_naturality_right
statement:
private theorem homEquiv_naturality_right {V V' : ModuleCat k}
    (f : coinvariants (k := k) (S := S) v M ⟶ V)
    (g : V ⟶ V') :
    homEquiv (k := k) (S := S) v (M := M) (V := V') (f ≫ g) =
      homEquiv (k := k) (S := S) v (M := M) (V := V) f ≫
        (characterRestriction (k := k) (S := S) v).map g
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro m
  change g.hom (f.hom ((relation (k := k) (S := S) v M).mkQ m)) =
    g.hom (f.hom ((relation (k := k) (S := S) v M).mkQ m))
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.kernel_structureMap_isIso
proof:
:= by
  let es := PreservesKernel.iso ((evaluation ℝ (ModuleCat R)).obj s) f
  let et := PreservesKernel.iso ((evaluation ℝ (ModuleCat R)).obj t) f
  let ep := kernel.mapIso (f.app s) (f.app t)
    (asIso (structureMap M h)) (asIso (structureMap N h))
    (f.naturality (homOfLE h)).symm
  let p := ep.hom
  have : IsIso p := ep.isIso_hom
  have hs : es.hom ≫ kernel.ι (f.app s) = (kernel.ι f).app s := by
    exact kernelComparison_comp_ι f ((evaluation ℝ (ModuleCat R)).obj s)
  have ht : et.inv ≫ (kernel.ι f).app t = kernel.ι (f.app t) :=
    PreservesKernel.iso_inv_ι ((evaluation ℝ (ModuleCat R)).obj t) f
  have he : structureMap (kernel f) h = es.hom ≫ p ≫ et.inv := by
    apply (cancel_mono ((kernel.ι f).app t)).mp
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, ht]
    change structureMap (kernel f) h ≫ (kernel.ι f).app t =
      es.hom ≫ kernel.lift _ _ _ ≫ kernel.ι _
    rw [kernel.lift_ι, ← Category.assoc, hs]
    exact (kernel.ι f).naturality (homOfLE h)
  rw [he]
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cokernel_structureMap_isIso
proof:
:= by
  let es := PreservesCokernel.iso ((evaluation ℝ (ModuleCat R)).obj s) f
  let et := PreservesCokernel.iso ((evaluation ℝ (ModuleCat R)).obj t) f
  let ep := cokernel.mapIso (f.app s) (f.app t)
    (asIso (structureMap M h)) (asIso (structureMap N h))
    (f.naturality (homOfLE h)).symm
  let p := ep.hom
  have : IsIso p := ep.isIso_hom
  have hs : (cokernel.π f).app s ≫ es.hom = cokernel.π (f.app s) :=
    PreservesCokernel.π_iso_hom ((evaluation ℝ (ModuleCat R)).obj s) f
  have ht : cokernel.π (f.app t) ≫ et.inv = (cokernel.π f).app t := by
    have he : (cokernel.π f).app t ≫ et.hom = cokernel.π (f.app t) :=
      PreservesCokernel.π_iso_hom ((evaluation ℝ (ModuleCat R)).obj t) f
    rw [← he]
    simp only [Category.assoc, et.hom_inv_id]
    exact Category.comp_id _
  have he : structureMap (cokernel f) h = es.hom ≫ p ≫ et.inv := by
    apply (cancel_epi ((cokernel.π f).app s)).mp
    rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc, hs]
    change (cokernel.π f).app s ≫ structureMap (cokernel f) h =
      (cokernel.π _ ≫ cokernel.desc _ _ _) ≫ et.inv
    rw [cokernel.π_desc, Category.assoc, ht]
    exact ((cokernel.π f).naturality (homOfLE h)).symm
  rw [he]
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.IsConstructible.kernel
statement:
theorem IsConstructible.kernel (hM : IsConstructible c M) (hN : IsConstructible c N)
    (f : M ⟶ N) : IsConstructible c (kernel f) where
  zero_left t ht
proof:
:= IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero ((kernel.ι f).app t)
    ((hM.zero_left t ht).eq_zero_of_tgt _)
  isIso_map s t h hc := by
    have := hM.isIso_map s t h hc
    have := hN.isIso_map s t h hc
    exact kernel_structureMap_isIso f h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.IsConstructible.cokernel
statement:
theorem IsConstructible.cokernel (hM : IsConstructible c M) (hN : IsConstructible c N)
    (f : M ⟶ N) : IsConstructible c (cokernel f) where
  zero_left t ht
proof:
:= IsZero.of_epi_eq_zero ((cokernel.π f).app t)
    ((hN.zero_left t ht).eq_zero_of_src _)
  isIso_map s t h hc := by
    have := hM.isIso_map s t h hc
    have := hN.isIso_map s t h hc
    exact cokernel_structureMap_isIso f h

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientProjectiveResolution.extensionProjectiveResolution_augmentation
statement:
@[simp] theorem extensionProjectiveResolution_augmentation
    (N : ModuleCat.{u} (C (k := k) (S := S)))
    (P : ProjectiveResolution ((Res (k := k) (S := S)).obj N)) :
    (extensionProjectiveResolution (k := k) (S := S) N P).π.f 0 =
      (E (k := k) (S := S)).map (P.π.f 0) ≫
        (extensionRestrictionIso (k := k) (S := S)).hom.app N
proof:
:= by
  exact ChainComplex.toSingle₀Equiv_symm_apply_f_zero _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientProjectiveResolution.extensionProjectiveResolution_augmentation_class
statement:
@[simp] theorem extensionProjectiveResolution_augmentation_class
    (N : ModuleCat.{u} (C (k := k) (S := S)))
    (P : ProjectiveResolution ((Res (k := k) (S := S)).obj N)) (x : P.complex.X 0) :
    ((extensionProjectiveResolution (k := k) (S := S) N P).π.f 0).hom
        ((relation (k := k) (S := S) (P.complex.X 0)).mkQ x) =
      (P.π.f 0).hom x
proof:
:= by
  let p₀ : P.complex.X 0 ⟶ (Res (k := k) (S := S)).obj N := P.π.f 0
  rw [extensionProjectiveResolution_augmentation]
  change (quotientCounitAt (k := k) (S := S) N).hom
      ((extensionMap (k := k) (S := S) p₀).hom
        ((relation (k := k) (S := S) (P.complex.X 0)).mkQ x)) = _
  rw [extensionMap_mkQ]
  exact extensionRestrictionIso_hom_mkQ (k := k) (S := S) N (p₀.hom x)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientProjectiveResolution.extensionProjectiveResolution_isZero_term

theorem extensionProjectiveResolution_isZero_term

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientProjectiveResolution.extensionProjectiveResolution_isZero_above
statement:
theorem extensionProjectiveResolution_isZero_above

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientProjectiveResolution.extension_map_shortExact_of_assemble_injective
statement:
theorem extension_map_shortExact_of_assemble_injective
    (T : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (R (k := k) (S := S)))) (hT : T.ShortExact)
    (hτ : Function.Injective (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) T.X₃)) :
    (T.map (E (k := k) (S := S))).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := E (k := k) (S := S)
  let QX := relation (k := k) (S := S) T.X₁
  let QY := relation (k := k) (S := S) T.X₂
  have hf_inj : Function.Injective T.f.hom := hT.moduleCat_injective_f
  have hmono : Mono ((T.map E).f) := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mpr (by
    intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨x₀, rfl⟩ := QX.mkQ_surjective x
    obtain ⟨y₀, rfl⟩ := QX.mkQ_surjective y
    have hquot : QY.mkQ (T.f.hom x₀) = QY.mkQ (T.f.hom y₀) := by
      change (extensionMap (k := k) (S := S) T.f).hom (QX.mkQ x₀) =
        (extensionMap (k := k) (S := S) T.f).hom (QX.mkQ y₀) at hxy
      rw [extensionMap_mkQ] at hxy
      exact hxy
    have hdiff : T.f.hom (x₀ - y₀) ∈ QY := by
      have h := (Submodule.Quotient.eq QY).1 hquot
      simpa only [map_sub] using h
    have hrange : T.f.hom (x₀ - y₀) ∈
        (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) T.X₂).range := by
      rw [assembleAction_range_eq_relation]
      exact hdiff
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hrange
    have hgf : T.g.hom (T.f.hom (x₀ - y₀)) = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun g : T.X₁ ⟶ T.X₃ => g.hom (x₀ - y₀)) T.zero
      simpa using h
    have hnatural := assembleAction_natural (k := k) (S := S) T.g w
    rw [hw, hgf] at hnatural
    let v : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) T.X₃ := fun q =>
      ⟨T.g.hom (w q), by
        change columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • T.g.hom (w q) = T.g.hom (w q)
        rw [← T.g.hom.map_smul]
        exact congrArg T.g.hom (w q).property⟩
    have hassemble : assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) T.X₃ v = 0 := by
      change assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) T.X₃ v = 0 at hnatural
      exact hnatural
    have hvzero : v = 0 := by
      apply hτ
      rw [map_zero]
      exact hassemble
    have hcolzero :
        (((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.g).hom w :
          ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) T.X₃) = 0 := by
      change (((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.g).hom w :
        ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) T.X₃) = 0
      funext q
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hq := congrArg (fun z : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) T.X₃ =>
        (z q : T.X₃)) hvzero
      exact hq
    have hGexact := columnAction_map_exact (k := k) (S := S) T hT.exact
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff _).mp hGexact w hcolzero
    let u' : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) T.X₁ := u
    have hu' : (columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.f u' = w := by
      change (columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.f u = w at hu
      exact hu
    have hnatural' := assembleAction_natural (k := k) (S := S) T.f u'
    change assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) T.X₂
      ((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.f u) = _ at hnatural'
    rw [hu'] at hnatural'
    have hfd : T.f.hom (x₀ - y₀) =
        T.f.hom (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) T.X₁ u) := hw.symm.trans hnatural'
    have hd : x₀ - y₀ = assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) T.X₁ u :=
      hf_inj hfd
    have hrel : x₀ - y₀ ∈ QX := by
      have hrange : x₀ - y₀ ∈
          (relation (k := k) (S := S) T.X₁).toAddSubgroup := by
        rw [← assembleAction_range_eq_relation]
        exact ⟨u, hd.symm⟩
      exact hrange
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.eq QX).2 hrel)
  have hright : (T.map E).Exact ∧ Epi ((T.map E).g) :=
    (T.map E).exact_and_epi_g_iff_g_is_cokernel |>.2
      ⟨CokernelCofork.mapIsColimit _ hT.gIsCokernel E⟩
  exact { exact := hright.1, mono_f := hmono, epi_g := hright.2 }

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientProjectiveResolution.assembleAction_injective_of_shortExact_projective_middle
statement:
theorem assembleAction_injective_of_shortExact_projective_middle
    (T : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (R (k := k) (S := S)))) (hT : T.ShortExact)
    [Projective T.X₂] :
    Function.Injective (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) T.X₁)
proof:
:= by
  have hG := columnAction_map_shortExact (k := k) (S := S) T hT
  have hGmono : Function.Injective ((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.f).hom :=
    (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp hG.mono_f
  have hτP := assembleAction_projective_injective (k := k) (S := S) T.X₂
  intro x y hxy
  have hτmap :
      assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) T.X₂
          (((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.f).hom x) =
        assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) T.X₂
          (((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.f).hom y) := by
    calc
      _ = T.f.hom (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) T.X₁ x) :=
        assembleAction_natural (k := k) (S := S) T.f x
      _ = T.f.hom (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) T.X₁ y) := by rw [hxy]
      _ = _ := (assembleAction_natural (k := k) (S := S) T.f y).symm
  exact hGmono (hτP hτmap)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientProjectiveResolution.extension_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_assemble_injective
statement:
theorem extension_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_assemble_injective
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (R (k := k) (S := S))) (d : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M) →
      HasProjectiveDimensionLE M d →
        HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((E (k := k) (S := S)).obj M) d
proof:
:= by
  induction d generalizing M with
  | zero =>
      intro hτ hM
      have hP : Projective M := (projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_zero M).2 hM
      exact (projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_zero ((E (k := k) (S := S)).obj M)).1
        (Functor.projective_obj_of_projective (E (k := k) (S := S)) hP)
  | succ d ih =>
      intro hτ hM
      let P := Projective.over M
      let π := Projective.π M
      let T := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι π) π (by simp)
      have hT : T.ShortExact := {
        exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel π
        mono_f := inferInstance
        epi_g := Projective.π_epi M
      }
      have hKτ := assembleAction_injective_of_shortExact_projective_middle
        (k := k) (S := S) T hT
      have hK : HasProjectiveDimensionLE T.X₁ d :=
        (hT.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃_iff d (by infer_instance)).mp hM
      have hEK := ih T.X₁ hKτ hK
      have hET := extension_map_shortExact_of_assemble_injective
        (k := k) (S := S) T hT hτ
      have hEP : Projective ((E (k := k) (S := S)).obj T.X₂) :=
        Functor.projective_obj_of_projective (E (k := k) (S := S)) (by infer_instance)
      exact (hET.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃_iff d hEP).mpr hEK

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientProjectiveResolution.assembleAction_restrict_injective
statement:
theorem assembleAction_restrict_injective
    (N : ModuleCat.{u} (C (k := k) (S := S))) :
    Function.Injective
      (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) ((Res (k := k) (S := S)).obj N))
proof:
:= by
  have hzero := columnAction_restrict_isZero (k := k) (S := S) N
  haveI : Subsingleton (ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S)
      ((Res (k := k) (S := S)).obj N)) := by
    change Subsingleton ((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).obj
      ((Res (k := k) (S := S)).obj N))
    exact AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hzero
  intro x y hxy
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientProjectiveResolution.extension_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_restricted
statement:
theorem extension_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_restricted
    (N : ModuleCat.{u} (C (k := k) (S := S))) (d : ℕ)
    (hN : HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((Res (k := k) (S := S)).obj N) d) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE N d
proof:
:= by
  have hE := extension_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_assemble_injective
    (k := k) (S := S) ((Res (k := k) (S := S)).obj N) d
    (assembleAction_restrict_injective (k := k) (S := S) N) hN
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT
      ((E (k := k) (S := S)).obj ((Res (k := k) (S := S)).obj N)) (d + 1) := hE
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso (quotientCounitAt (k := k) (S := S) N) (d + 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientProjectiveResolution.extension_hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_assemble_injective
statement:
theorem extension_hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_assemble_injective
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (R (k := k) (S := S))) (n : ℕ)
    (hτ : Function.Injective (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M))
    (hM : HasProjectiveDimensionLT M n) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLT ((E (k := k) (S := S)).obj M) n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      have hzero : IsZero M :=
        (hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero_iff_isZero (X := M)).mp hM
      exact (hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero_iff_isZero
          (X := (E (k := k) (S := S)).obj M)).mpr
        (Functor.map_isZero (E (k := k) (S := S)) hzero)
  | succ n =>
      exact extension_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_assemble_injective
        (k := k) (S := S) M n hτ hM

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientProjectiveResolution.extension_projectiveDimension_le_of_assemble_injective
statement:
theorem extension_projectiveDimension_le_of_assemble_injective
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (R (k := k) (S := S)))
    (hτ : Function.Injective (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M)) :
    CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension ((E (k := k) (S := S)).obj M) ≤
      CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension M
proof:
:= by
  unfold CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension
  apply sInf_le_sInf_of_subset_insert_top
  intro n hn
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, not_top_lt, IsEmpty.forall_iff, implies_true,
    Set.insert_eq_of_mem] at hn ⊢
  intro i hi
  exact extension_hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_assemble_injective
    (k := k) (S := S) M i hτ (hn i hi)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientProjectiveResolution.projectiveDimension_le_restriction
statement:
theorem projectiveDimension_le_restriction
    (N : ModuleCat.{u} (C (k := k) (S := S))) :
    CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension N ≤
      CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension ((Res (k := k) (S := S)).obj N)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension N =
        CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension
          ((E (k := k) (S := S)).obj ((Res (k := k) (S := S)).obj N)) :=
      (projectiveDimension_eq_of_iso (quotientCounitAt (k := k) (S := S) N)).symm
    _ ≤ CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension ((Res (k := k) (S := S)).obj N) :=
      extension_projectiveDimension_le_of_assemble_injective (k := k) (S := S)
        _ (assembleAction_restrict_injective (k := k) (S := S) N)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cutEndpoint_bounds
statement:
theorem cutEndpoint_bounds {c : Cut ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hc : c ∈ cutCell a b) :
    a ≤ cutEndpoint c ∧ cutEndpoint c ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  have hb := bddAbove_lower_of_mem_cutCell hc
  exact ⟨le_csSup hb hc.1, csSup_le ⟨a, hc.1⟩ (fun _ ht =>
    (c.lower_lt_upper ht hc.2).le)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cut_eq_minus_or_plus_of_mem_cutCell
proof:
:= by
  have hb := bddAbove_lower_of_mem_cutCell hc
  have hlo : Iio (cutEndpoint c) ⊆ c.lower := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨r, hr, htr⟩ := (lt_csSup_iff hb ⟨a, hc.1⟩).mp ht
    exact Cut.lower_of_le htr.le hr
  have hup : c.lower ⊆ Iic (cutEndpoint c) := fun _ ht => le_csSup hb ht
  rcases mem_Iic_Iio_of_subset_of_subset hlo hup with hplus | hminus
  · exact Or.inr (cut_eq_of_lower_eq hplus)
  · exact Or.inl (cut_eq_of_lower_eq hminus)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cutEndpoint_lt_of_mem_rectangleCell

proof:
:=
  (cutEndpoint_bounds hp.1).2.trans_lt (hbc.trans_le (cutEndpoint_bounds hp.2).1)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.Examples.chain_middle_minimalComplement

:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.Examples.chain_middle_complementCard
statement: theorem chain_middle_complementCard : complementCard (1 : Fin 3) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold complementCard
  simpa using Fintype.card_of_subtype
    (p := fun a => a ∈ minimalComplement (1 : Fin 3)) ({2} : Finset (Fin 3)) (by
      intro a
      rw [chain_middle_minimalComplement]
      simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.Examples.chain_maxComplementCard
statement: theorem chain_maxComplementCard : maxComplementCard (S := Fin 3) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold maxComplementCard
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · apply Finset.sup_le
    intro p hp
    fin_cases p
    · simpa [chain_complementCard]
    · simpa [chain_middle_complementCard]
    · have hc : complementCard (2 : Fin 3) = 0 :=
        (complementCard_eq_zero_iff (p := (2 : Fin 3))).2 rfl
      simp [hc]
  · have h : complementCard (0 : Fin 3) ≤
        Finset.univ.sup (fun p : Fin 3 => complementCard p) :=
      Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin 3))
    simpa [chain_complementCard] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.Examples.square_maxComplementCard

        Finset.univ.sup (fun p : Bool × Bool => complementCard p) :=

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.Examples.zero_module_coordinateCount
