name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_mapOfComponents
statement:
theorem component_mapOfComponents {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : ∀ i j, (R i).module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj (S j).module)
    (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    component R S ε (mapOfComponents R S ε f) i j = f i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [component, mapOfComponents, Preadditive.comp_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
    · simp only [← Category.assoc, inclusion_projection_self, Category.id_comp]
      simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, inclusion_projection_self]
      simp
    · intro b _ hbj
      simp only [← Category.assoc, inclusion_projection_self, Category.id_comp]
      simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, inclusion_projection_ne S hbj,
        Functor.map_zero, comp_zero]
    · simp
  · intro a _ hai
    simp only [← Category.assoc, inclusion_projection_ne R hai.symm,
      zero_comp, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  · simp

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.mapOfComponents_component
statement:
theorem mapOfComponents_component {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : module (k := k) R ⟶ (shift ε).obj (module S)) :
    mapOfComponents R S ε (component R S ε f) = f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, (projection R i ≫ inclusion R i ≫ f) ≫
        (shift ε).map (∑ j, projection S j ≫ inclusion S j) := by
      simp only [mapOfComponents, component, Functor.map_sum, Functor.map_comp,
        Preadditive.comp_sum, Category.assoc]
    _ = f := by
      simp only [sum_projection_inclusion, ← Category.assoc,
        ← Preadditive.sum_comp, Category.id_comp]
      simp

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_ext
statement:
theorem component_ext {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {f g : module (k := k) R ⟶ (shift ε).obj (module S)}
    (h : ∀ i j, component R S ε f i j = component R S ε g i j) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapOfComponents_component R S ε f, ← mapOfComponents_component R S ε g]
  congr 1
  funext i j
  exact h i j

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_composite_shift
statement:
theorem component_composite_shift {ι κ ν : Type}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype ν]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (T : ν → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : module (k := k) R ⟶ (shift ε).obj (module S))
    (g : module (k := k) S ⟶ (shift ε).obj (module T)) (i : ι) (l : ν) :
    (∑ j, component R S ε f i j ≫ (shift ε).map (component S T ε g j l)) ≫
        (compIso ε ε ((T l).module (k := k))).hom =
      component R T (ε + ε) (f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫ (compIso ε ε (module T)).hom) i l
proof:
:= by
  rw [component_composite]
  simp only [component, Category.assoc]
  rw [compIso_naturality ε ε (projection (k := k) T l)]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_transition_self
statement:
theorem component_transition_self {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0) (i : ι) :
    component R R ε (transition ε (module (k := k) R)) i i =
      transition ε ((R i).module (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [component, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [transition_naturality ε (inclusion (k := k) R i)]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, inclusion_projection_self]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_transition_ne
statement:
theorem component_transition_ne {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0) {i l : ι} (h : i ≠ l) :
    component R R ε (transition ε (module (k := k) R)) i l = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [component, ← Category.assoc]
  rw [transition_naturality ε (inclusion (k := k) R i)]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, inclusion_projection_ne R h,
    Functor.map_zero, comp_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.entry_some
statement:
private theorem entry_some {ι κ : Type} (R : ι → Rectangle n)
    (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0) (σ : ι → Option κ)
    (f : ∀ i j, σ i = some j → ((R i).module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj (S j).module))
    (i : ι) (j : κ) (h : σ i = some j) : entry R S ε σ f i j = f i j h
proof:
:= by
  simp [entry, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.selection_composite
statement:
private theorem selection_composite {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (σ : ι → Option κ) (τ : κ → Option ι)
    (hinv : ∀ i j, σ i = some j ↔ τ j = some i)
    (f : ∀ i j, σ i = some j → ((R i).module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj (S j).module))
    (g : ∀ j i, τ j = some i → ((S j).module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj (R i).module))
    (hpair : ∀ i j (h : σ i = some j), f i j h ≫ (shift ε).map (g j i ((hinv i j).mp h)) ≫
      (compIso ε ε ((R i).module (k := k))).hom = transition (ε + ε) ((R i).module (k := k)))
    (hzero : ∀ i, σ i = none → transition (ε + ε) ((R i).module (k := k)) = 0)
    (i l : ι) :
    (∑ j, entry R S ε σ f i j ≫ (shift ε).map (entry S R ε τ g j l)) ≫
        (compIso ε ε ((R l).module (k := k))).hom =
      component R R (ε + ε) (transition (ε + ε) (module (k := k) R)) i l
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases hi : σ i with
  | none =>
    have he (j : κ) : entry R S ε σ f i j = 0 := by simp [entry, hi]
    simp only [he, zero_comp, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    by_cases hil : i = l
    · subst l
      rw [component_transition_self, hzero i hi]
    · exact (component_transition_ne R (ε + ε) hil).symm
  | some j =>
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
    · rw [entry_some R S ε σ f i j hi]
      have hj : τ j = some i := (hinv i j).mp hi
      by_cases hil : i = l
      · subst l
        rw [entry_some S R ε τ g j i hj, component_transition_self]
        exact hpair i j hi
      · have hne : ¬ τ j = some l := by simp [hj, hil]
        rw [show entry S R ε τ g j l = 0 from dif_neg hne,
          Functor.map_zero, comp_zero, zero_comp, component_transition_ne R (ε + ε) hil]
    · intro b _ hbj
      have hne : ¬ σ i = some b := by simp [hi, hbj.symm]
      simp only [entry, dif_neg hne, zero_comp]
    · simp

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.IsMatching.interleaving_components
statement:
theorem IsMatching.interleaving_components {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    {R : ι → Rectangle n} {S : κ → Rectangle n} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    {M : OccurrenceMatching ι κ PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}}
    (hM : IsMatching (k := k) ε R S M) (i : ι) (j : κ) (h : M.finite i = some j) :
    ∃ I : CoordinateInterleaving ε ((R i).module (k := k)) (S j).module,
      component R S ε hM.interleaving.φ i j = I.φ ∧
      component S R ε hM.interleaving.ψ j i = I.ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(hM.paired i j h).some, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [IsMatching.interleaving, selectedInterleaving, component_mapOfComponents, entry, h]
  · have hr := (M.reverse_finite_some_iff j i).mpr h
    simp [IsMatching.interleaving, selectedInterleaving, component_mapOfComponents, entry, hr]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.IsMatching.interleaving_component_zero
proof:
:= by
  simp [IsMatching.interleaving, selectedInterleaving, component_mapOfComponents, entry, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.IsMatching.interleaving_reverse_component_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hr : M.reverse.finite j ≠ some i := by simpa [M.reverse_finite_some_iff] using h
  simp [IsMatching.interleaving, selectedInterleaving, component_mapOfComponents, entry, hr]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.IsMatching.reverse
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j i h
    exact (hM.paired i j ((M.reverse_finite_some_iff j i).mp h)).elim (fun I => ⟨I.symm⟩)
  · intro j hj
    apply hM.target_zero j
    intro i hi
    have h := (M.reverse_finite_some_iff j i).mpr hi
    simp [hj] at h
  · intro i hi
    apply hM.source_zero i
    cases h : M.finite i with
    | none => rfl
    | some j => exact False.elim (hi j ((M.reverse_finite_some_iff j i).mpr h))

name: TDA.Persistence.birthPersistence_snd_pos
statement:
theorem birthPersistence_snd_pos {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p.1 < p.2) :
    0 < (birthPersistence p).2
proof: := sub_pos.mpr hp

name: TDA.Persistence.norm_birthPersistence_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_birthPersistence_sub_le (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖birthPersistence p - birthPersistence q‖ ≤ 2 * ‖p - q‖
proof:
:= by
  simp only [birthPersistence, Prod.norm_def, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub,
    Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have h₁ := le_max_left |p.1 - q.1| |p.2 - q.2|
  have h₂ := le_max_right |p.1 - q.1| |p.2 - q.2|
  have hn := abs_nonneg (p.1 - q.1)
  have ht : |(p.2 - q.2) - (p.1 - q.1)| ≤ |p.2 - q.2| + |p.1 - q.1| := by
    simpa only [sub_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg] using
      abs_sub_le (p.2 - q.2) 0 (p.1 - q.1)
  apply max_le
  · linarith
  · rw [show p.2 - p.1 - (q.2 - q.1) = (p.2 - q.2) - (p.1 - q.1) by ring]
    linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePairCost_toReal
statement:
@[simp] theorem finitePairCost_toReal (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (finitePairCost p q).toReal = ‖p - q‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePairCost, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
    (le_trans (abs_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _))]
  simp only [Prod.norm_def, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: TDA.Persistence.diagonalCost_toReal
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalCost_toReal (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (diagonalCost p).toReal = |p.2 - p.1| / 2
proof:
:= by
  exact ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (div_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num))

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFeatureSum_reindex
statement:
theorem finiteFeatureSum_reindex {I J E : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    [AddCommMonoid E] (e : I ≃ J) (F : ℝ × ℝ → E) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFeatureSum F (y ∘ e) = finiteFeatureSum F y
proof:
:=
  e.sum_comp (fun j => F (y j))

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFeatureSum_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteFeatureSum_empty {I E : Type*} [Fintype I] [IsEmpty I]
    [AddCommMonoid E] (F : ℝ × ℝ → E) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFeatureSum F x = 0
proof: := Fintype.sum_empty _

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem totalFiniteCost_nonneg (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : 0 ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply add_nonneg
  · apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    cases M.finite i <;> exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  · apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro j _
    split_ifs <;> positivity

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.sum_matched
statement:
theorem sum_matched {E : Type*} [AddCommMonoid E]
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) (g : J → E) :
    (∑ i, match M.finite i with | some j => g j | none => 0) =
      ∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then g j else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, if M.finite i = some j then g j else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      cases M.finite i <;> simp
    _ = ∑ j, ∑ i, if M.finite i = some j then g j else 0 := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      by_cases hj : ∃ i, M.finite i = some j
      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hj
        rw [if_pos ⟨i, hi⟩]
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
        · simp [hi]
        · intro k _ hki
          have hk : M.finite k ≠ some j := fun hk =>
            hki (M.finite_injective k i j hk hi)
          simp [hk]
        · simp
      · simp [show ∀ i, M.finite i ≠ some j from fun i hi => hj ⟨i, hi⟩]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.sum_sub_eq_residual_sub_unmatched
statement:
theorem sum_sub_eq_residual_sub_unmatched {E : Type*} [AddCommGroup E]
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) (f : I → E) (g : J → E) :
    (∑ i, f i) - ∑ j, g j =
      (∑ i, (f i - (match M.finite i with | some j => g j | none => 0))) -
        ∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else g j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsplit : (∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then g j else 0) +
      (∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else g j) = ∑ j, g j := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, M.sum_matched g]
  rw [← hsplit]
  abel

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.norm_featureSum_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_featureSum_sub_le {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (F : ℝ × ℝ → E) (L : ℝ) (_hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hpair : ∀ p q : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 < p.2 → q.1 < q.2 →
      ‖F p - F q‖ ≤ L * ‖p - q‖)
    (hdiag : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, p.1 < p.2 → ‖F p‖ ≤ L * (diagonalCost p).toReal)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    ‖finiteFeatureSum F x - finiteFeatureSum F y‖ ≤ L * M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold finiteFeatureSum
  rw [M.sum_sub_eq_residual_sub_unmatched]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖∑ i, (F (x i) - (match M.finite i with | some j => F (y j) | none => 0))‖ +
        ‖∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else F (y j)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ (∑ i, ‖F (x i) -
          (match M.finite i with | some j => F (y j) | none => 0)‖) +
        ∑ j, ‖if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else F (y j)‖ :=
      add_le_add (norm_sum_le _ _) (norm_sum_le _ _)
    _ ≤ (∑ i, L * (match M.finite i with
          | some j => (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal
          | none => (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal)) +
        ∑ j, L * (if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal) := by
      apply add_le_add
      · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        cases h : M.finite i with
        | none => simpa [h] using hdiag (x i) (hx i)
        | some j => simpa [h] using hpair (x i) (y j) (hx i) (hy j)
      · apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        split_ifs
        · simp
        · exact hdiag (y j) (hy j)
    _ = L * M.totalFiniteCost x y := by
      simp only [totalFiniteCost, Finset.mul_sum, mul_add]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.armGrade_le_afterArmGrade
statement: private theorem armGrade_le_afterArmGrade : armGrade ≤ afterArmGrade
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [armGrade, afterArmGrade]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.armGrade_support
statement:
private theorem armGrade_support :
    armGrade ∈ Hook.support realBirth realDeath
proof:
:= by
  change realBirth ≤ armGrade ∧ ¬ realDeath ≤ armGrade
  constructor
  · intro i
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [realBirth, CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply,
      birth, CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarLower, armGrade]
  · intro h
    have h1 := h 1
    norm_num [realDeath, CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply,
      death, CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarUpper, armGrade] at h1

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.afterArmGrade_not_support
statement:
private theorem afterArmGrade_not_support :
    afterArmGrade ∉ Hook.support realBirth realDeath
proof:
:= by
  change ¬ (realBirth ≤ afterArmGrade ∧ ¬ realDeath ≤ afterArmGrade)
  intro h
  apply h.2
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [realDeath, CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply,
    death, CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarUpper, afterArmGrade]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.armVector_coefficient
statement:
theorem armVector_coefficient (k : Type) [Field k] :
    (((grid.hookLanIso birth death).hom.app armGrade).hom (armVector k) :
      SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) (Hook.support realBirth realDeath) armGrade) =
      (((grid.appIso (Hook.module (k := k) birth death) armGrade
        (show grid.HasLowerPoint armGrade from ⟨birth, by
          intro i
          fin_cases i <;> norm_num [armGrade, CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply, birth,
            CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarLower]⟩)).hom.hom (armVector k) :
        SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) (Hook.support birth death)
          (grid.floor armGrade (show grid.HasLowerPoint armGrade from ⟨birth, by
            intro i
            fin_cases i <;> norm_num [armGrade, CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply, birth,
              CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarLower]⟩))) : k)
proof:
:= by
  exact grid.hookLanIso_apply_coefficient birth death
    (show grid.HasLowerPoint armGrade from ⟨birth, by
      intro i
      fin_cases i <;> norm_num [armGrade, CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply, birth,
        CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarLower]⟩)
    armGrade_support (armVector k)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.armVector_ne_zero
statement: theorem armVector_ne_zero (k : Type) [Field k] : armVector k ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let e : grid.lan.obj (Hook.module (k := k) birth death) ≅
      Hook.module (k := k) realBirth realDeath := grid.hookLanIso birth death
  intro h
  have hcancel :
      (e.hom.app armGrade).hom (armVector k) =
        realArmUnit k := by
    dsimp [armVector]
    have hh := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (realArmUnit k)) (e.inv_hom_id_app armGrade)
    change ((e.inv.app armGrade ≫ e.hom.app armGrade).hom (realArmUnit k)) = _ at hh
    exact hh
  rw [h, map_zero] at hcancel
  have hzero : realArmUnit k = 0 := hcancel.symm
  have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hzero
  exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0) hval

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.realArmUnit_dies
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h := SupportInterval.structureMap_val (Hook.support realBirth realDeath)
    (Hook.support_ordConnected realBirth realDeath) armGrade_le_afterArmGrade
    (realArmUnit k)
  rw [if_neg afterArmGrade_not_support] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.armVector_dies_across_real_transition
statement:
theorem armVector_dies_across_real_transition (k : Type) [Field k] :
    structureMapLinear (grid.lan.obj (Hook.module (k := k) birth death))
      armGrade_le_afterArmGrade (armVector k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let e : grid.lan.obj (Hook.module (k := k) birth death) ≅
      Hook.module (k := k) realBirth realDeath := grid.hookLanIso birth death
  have hn := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (armVector k))
    (e.hom.naturality (homOfLE armGrade_le_afterArmGrade))
  change (e.hom.app afterArmGrade).hom
      (structureMapLinear (grid.lan.obj (Hook.module (k := k) birth death))
        armGrade_le_afterArmGrade (armVector k)) =
    structureMapLinear (Hook.module (k := k) realBirth realDeath)
      armGrade_le_afterArmGrade ((e.hom.app armGrade).hom (armVector k)) at hn
  have hcoeff : (e.hom.app armGrade).hom (armVector k) = realArmUnit k := by
    dsimp [armVector]
    have hh := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (realArmUnit k)) (e.inv_hom_id_app armGrade)
    change ((e.inv.app armGrade ≫ e.hom.app armGrade).hom (realArmUnit k)) = _ at hh
    exact hh
  rw [hcoeff, realArmUnit_dies] at hn
  have hinj : Function.Injective (e.hom.app afterArmGrade).hom :=
    (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (e.hom.app afterArmGrade)).mp inferInstance
  exact hinj (by simpa using hn)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.principal_upset_actual_tail

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.principal_upset_tail_coefficient
statement:
theorem principal_upset_tail_coefficient
    (x : (grid.lan.obj (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) birth)).obj (fun _ => 10)) :
    HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := ℚ)
        (show grid.embedding birth ≤ (fun _ => 10) from by
          intro i
          norm_num [CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply, birth,
            CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarLower])
        (((grid.infinityLanIso birth).hom.app (fun _ => 10)).hom x) =
      HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := ℚ)
        ((grid.le_floor_iff (fun _ => 10)
          (show grid.HasLowerPoint (fun _ => 10) from ⟨death, by
            intro i
            norm_num [CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply, death,
              CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarUpper]⟩) birth).mp
            (show grid.embedding birth ≤ (fun _ => 10) from by
              intro i
              norm_num [CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply, birth,
                CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarLower]))
        ((grid.appIso (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) birth) (fun _ => 10)
          (⟨death, by intro i; norm_num [CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply, death,
            CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarUpper]⟩)).hom.hom x)
proof:
:= by
  exact grid.infinityLanIso_apply_coefficient birth
    (⟨death, by intro i; norm_num [CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply, death,
      CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarUpper]⟩)
    (by intro i; norm_num [CoordinateGrid.embedding_apply, birth,
      CoordinateGridKan.Examples.planarLower]) x

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.degenerateHookFiber_subsingleton
statement:
private theorem degenerateHookFiber_subsingleton {P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    (k : Type) [Field k] (p : P) :
    Subsingleton ((Hook.module (k := k) p p).obj p)
proof:
:= by
  change Subsingleton
    (SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) (Hook.support p p) p)
  constructor
  intro x y
  have hp : p ∉ Hook.support p p := by simp [Hook.support]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (Hook.support p p) hp x,
    SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (Hook.support p p) hp y]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.lan_hook_deflation_lifts_identity

      s ≫ grid.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π gridHook) = 𝟙 (grid.lan.obj gridHook)
proof:
:= by
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional ℚ (gridHook.obj p) := by
    intro p
    change FiniteDimensional ℚ
      (SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) (Hook.support birth death) p)
    infer_instance
  have hprojective : IsRankProjective (grid.lan.obj gridHook) :=
    grid.lan_isRankProjective gridHook (Hook.isRankProjective gridBirth_lt_death)
  have hsequence :
      IsRankExact
        (grid.lan.map (kernel.ι (FiniteHookDeflation.π gridHook)))
        (grid.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π gridHook)) :=
    grid.lan_isRankExact (FiniteHookDeflation.rankExact gridHook)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.repeated_finite_first_projection_law
statement:
theorem repeated_finite_first_projection_law :
    repeatedFiniteHookLanIso.hom ≫ biproduct.π repeatedFiniteRealFamily 0 =
      grid.lan.map (biproduct.π repeatedFiniteGridFamily 0) ≫
        (grid.hookLanIso birth death).hom
proof:
:= by
  change (grid.lanBiproductIso repeatedFiniteGridFamily).hom ≫
      biproduct.map (fun _ => (grid.hookLanIso birth death).hom) ≫
        biproduct.π repeatedFiniteRealFamily 0 = _
  calc
    _ = (grid.lanBiproductIso repeatedFiniteGridFamily).hom ≫
        (biproduct.π (fun i => grid.lan.obj (repeatedFiniteGridFamily i)) 0 ≫
          (grid.hookLanIso birth death).hom) := by rw [biproduct.map_π]
    _ = ((grid.lanBiproductIso repeatedFiniteGridFamily).hom ≫
        biproduct.π (fun i => grid.lan.obj (repeatedFiniteGridFamily i)) 0) ≫
          (grid.hookLanIso birth death).hom := by rw [← Category.assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [grid.lanBiproductIso_hom_π]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridHook.Examples.repeated_finite_second_inclusion_law
statement:
theorem repeated_finite_second_inclusion_law :
    biproduct.ι repeatedFiniteRealFamily 1 ≫ repeatedFiniteHookLanIso.inv =
      (grid.hookLanIso birth death).inv ≫
        grid.lan.map (biproduct.ι repeatedFiniteGridFamily 1)
proof:
:= by
  change biproduct.ι repeatedFiniteRealFamily 1 ≫
      biproduct.map (fun _ => (grid.hookLanIso birth death).inv) ≫
        (grid.lanBiproductIso repeatedFiniteGridFamily).inv = _
  calc
    _ = (biproduct.ι repeatedFiniteRealFamily 1 ≫
        biproduct.map (fun _ => (grid.hookLanIso birth death).inv)) ≫
          (grid.lanBiproductIso repeatedFiniteGridFamily).inv := by
          rw [← Category.assoc]
    _ = ((grid.hookLanIso birth death).inv ≫
        biproduct.ι (fun i => grid.lan.obj (repeatedFiniteGridFamily i)) 1) ≫
          (grid.lanBiproductIso repeatedFiniteGridFamily).inv := by
          rw [biproduct.ι_map]
    _ = (grid.hookLanIso birth death).inv ≫
        biproduct.ι (fun i => grid.lan.obj (repeatedFiniteGridFamily i)) 1 ≫
          (grid.lanBiproductIso repeatedFiniteGridFamily).inv := by
          rw [← Category.assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [grid.lanBiproductIso_inv_ι]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteGridInjectiveRankDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_coordinateGrid
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_coordinateGrid
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] [Injective M]
    (hG : ∀ i : Fin n, (G i).Nonempty) :
    letI : BoundedOrder G.Point :=
      FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (gridHomFunctor (k := k) G |>.obj M) (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  letI : BoundedOrder G.Point :=
    FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
  have hgrid : maxComplementCard (S := G.Point) ≤ n :=
    FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.maxComplementCard_coordinateGrid_le G hG
  apply FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE
  intro p
  exact Nat.sub_le_sub_right
    ((FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.complementCard_le_maxComplementCard
      (S := G.Point) p).trans hgrid) 1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteGridInjectiveRankDimension.termAt_isZero_of_coordinateGrid
statement:
theorem termAt_isZero_of_coordinateGrid
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] [Injective M]
    (hG : ∀ i : Fin n, (G i).Nonempty)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    (j : ℕ) (hj : n - 1 < j) : IsZero (R.termAt j)
proof:
:= by
  letI : BoundedOrder G.Point :=
    FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
  have hdim := hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_coordinateGrid
    (k := k) G M hG
  exact (FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_iff
    (k := k) (S := G.Point) R (n - 1)).mp hdim j hj

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.card_index
statement:

    (∑ ab : StrictPair P, Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M ab.property.le))) +
      ∑ a : P, Module.finrank k (M.obj a)
proof:

  classical
  simp [Index, Fintype.card_sigma]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.family_isRankProjective
statement: theorem family_isRankProjective (t : Index M) : IsRankProjective (family M t)
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | inl t => exact Hook.isRankProjective t.1.property
  | inr t => exact HookInfinity.isRankProjective t.1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.family_finiteDimensional
statement:
@[instance] theorem family_finiteDimensional (t : Index M) (p : P) :
    FiniteDimensional k ((family M t).obj p)
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | inl t =>
    change FiniteDimensional k (SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) (Hook.support t.1.val.1 t.1.val.2) p)
    infer_instance
  | inr t =>
    change FiniteDimensional k (GradedFree.fiber (R := k) (HookInfinity.generators t.1) p)
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.finiteDimensional
statement: @[instance] theorem finiteDimensional (p : P) : FiniteDimensional k ((module M).obj p)
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.isRankProjective
statement: theorem isRankProjective : IsRankProjective (module M)
proof:
:=
  IsRankProjective.biproduct (family M) (family_isRankProjective M)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.ι_π
statement: theorem ι_π (t : Index M) : biproduct.ι (family M) t ≫ π M = summandMap M t
proof:
:=
  biproduct.ι_desc _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.π_ι_app
statement:
theorem π_ι_app (t : Index M) (p : P) (x : (family M t).obj p) :
    ((π M).app p).hom (((biproduct.ι (family M) t).app p).hom x) =
      ((summandMap M t).app p).hom x
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f : family M t ⟶ M => (f.app p).hom x) (ι_π M t)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.π_fiber_basis
statement:
private theorem π_fiber_basis (a : P) (i : Fin (Module.finrank k (M.obj a))) :
    ((π M).app a).hom
      (((biproduct.ι (family M) (.inr ⟨a, i⟩)).app a).hom (HookInfinity.birth a)) =
      fiberBasis M a i
proof:
:=
  (π_ι_app M (.inr ⟨a, i⟩) a (HookInfinity.birth a)).trans
    (HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth a M _)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.π_kernel_basis
statement:
private theorem π_kernel_basis (ab : StrictPair P)
    (i : Fin (Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M ab.property.le)))) :
    ((π M).app ab.val.1).hom
      (((biproduct.ι (family M) (.inl ⟨ab, i⟩)).app ab.val.1).hom
        (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support ab.val.1 ab.val.2) (Hook.birth_mem ab.property))) =
      (kernelBasis M ab i).val
proof:
:=
  (π_ι_app M (.inl ⟨ab, i⟩) ab.val.1 _).trans
    (Hook.fromGenerator_birth ab.property M (kernelBasis M ab i).val
      (kernelBasis M ab i).property)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.surjective
statement: theorem surjective (a : P) : Function.Surjective ((π M).app a).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  let B := fiberBasis M a
  let w : (module M).obj a := ∑ i, B.repr n i •
    ((biproduct.ι (family M) (.inr ⟨a, i⟩)).app a).hom (HookInfinity.birth a)
  refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ((π M).app a).hom (B.repr n i •
        ((biproduct.ι (family M) (.inr ⟨a, i⟩)).app a).hom (HookInfinity.birth a)) :=
      map_sum ((π M).app a).hom _ _
    _ = ∑ i, B.repr n i • B i := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact (map_smul ((π M).app a).hom (B.repr n i) _).trans
        (congrArg (fun x => B.repr n i • x) (π_fiber_basis M a i))
    _ = n := B.sum_repr n

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.lift_kernel
statement:
theorem lift_kernel {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b) (n : M.obj a)
    (hn : structureMapLinear M hab n = 0) :
    ∃ m : (module M).obj a, ((π M).app a).hom m = n ∧
      structureMapLinear (module M) hab m = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hab with hab' | he
  · let ab : StrictPair P := ⟨(a, b), hab'⟩
    let B := kernelBasis M ab
    let n' : LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M hab) := ⟨n, hn⟩
    let w : (module M).obj a := ∑ i, B.repr n' i •
      ((biproduct.ι (family M) (.inl ⟨ab, i⟩)).app a).hom
        (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support a b) (Hook.birth_mem hab'))
    refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc
        _ = ∑ i, ((π M).app a).hom (B.repr n' i •
            ((biproduct.ι (family M) (.inl ⟨ab, i⟩)).app a).hom
              (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support a b) (Hook.birth_mem hab'))) :=
          map_sum ((π M).app a).hom _ _
        _ = ∑ i, B.repr n' i • (B i).val := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          exact (map_smul ((π M).app a).hom (B.repr n' i) _).trans
            (congrArg (fun x => B.repr n' i • x) (π_kernel_basis M ab i))
        _ = n := by
          simpa only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul] using
            congrArg Subtype.val (B.sum_repr n')
    · calc
        _ = ∑ i, structureMapLinear (module M) hab (B.repr n' i •
            ((biproduct.ι (family M) (.inl ⟨ab, i⟩)).app a).hom
              (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support a b) (Hook.birth_mem hab'))) :=
          map_sum (structureMapLinear (module M) hab) _ _
        _ = 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro i _
          exact (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear (module M) hab)).smul_mem (B.repr n' i)
            (Hook.generator_dies hab' (biproduct.ι (family M) (.inl ⟨ab, i⟩)))
  · subst b
    have hn0 : n = 0 := by simpa using hn
    subst n
    exact ⟨0, by simp, by simp⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_diagram_card_le_one_empty
statement:
private theorem bottleneck_diagram_card_le_one_empty (k : Type w) [Field k]
    {Y : Type u} [Fintype Y] [MetricSpace Y] (hcard : Fintype.card Y ≤ 1)
    (degree : ℕ) (hdegree : 1 ≤ degree) :
    bottleneck (diagram k Y degree) Diagram.empty = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V := ULift.{w} (Fin (Fintype.card Y))
  have hcardV : Fintype.card V ≤ 1 := by simpa [V] using hcard
  let e : V ≃ Y := Equiv.ulift.trans (Fintype.equivFin Y).symm
  letI : LinearOrder V := inferInstance
  letI : MetricSpace V :=
    @MetricSpace.induced V Y e e.injective (inferInstance : MetricSpace Y)
  let D := diagram k Y degree
  have hess : essentialPart D.points = 0 := by
    change essentialPart
      (dgm k (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace V)) degree).points = 0
    exact TDA.Persistence.Rips.essentialPart_dgm_eq_zero k
      (inferInstance : MetricSpace V) hdegree
  have hcardD : Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences = 0 := by
    apply Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
    calc
      Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences ≤ Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (degree + 2) := by
        change Fintype.card
            (dgm k (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace V))
              degree).finiteOccurrences ≤ _
        exact card_finiteOccurrences_dgm_fullComplex_le k
          (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace V)) degree
      _ = 0 := Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)
  have hempty : IsEmpty D.finiteOccurrences := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hcardD
  change bottleneck D (orderedQ 0 0
    ((Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ), (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ))) = 0
  rw [bottleneck_finite_only_empty D hess]
  letI := hempty
  simp [Diagram.finiteOccurrences]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.distMatrixEntry_le_two_mul_piDist
statement:
theorem distMatrixEntry_le_two_mul_piDist (t s : Fin n → X) (i j : Fin n) :
    |dist (t i) (t j) - dist (s i) (s j)| ≤ 2 * dist t s
proof:
:= by
  have h := dist_dist_dist_le (t i) (t j) (s i) (s j)
  calc
    |dist (t i) (t j) - dist (s i) (s j)| =
        dist (dist (t i) (t j)) (dist (s i) (s j)) := by
      simp [Real.dist_eq]
    _ ≤ dist (t i) (s i) + dist (t j) (s j) := h
    _ ≤ dist t s + dist t s := add_le_add (dist_le_pi_dist t s i) (dist_le_pi_dist t s j)
    _ = 2 * dist t s := by ring

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.lipschitzWith_sampleDiagram
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_sampleDiagram (k : Type w) [Field k] (degree : ℕ) :
    LipschitzWith 2 (fun t : Fin n → X => sampleDiagram k t degree)
proof:
:= by
  intro t s
  let ε : ℝ≥0 := ⟨2 * dist t s, mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (dist_nonneg)⟩
  have h := bottleneck_sampleDiagram_le k t s (ε := ε)
    (fun i j => by
      change |dist (t i) (t j) - dist (s i) (s j)| ≤ 2 * dist t s
      exact distMatrixEntry_le_two_mul_piDist t s i j) degree
  have h' : bottleneck (sampleDiagram k t degree) (sampleDiagram k s degree) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * dist t s) := by
    have hε : (ε : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * dist t s) := by
      rw [ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq]
      congr 1
    simpa only [hε] using h
  change bottleneck (sampleDiagram k t degree) (sampleDiagram k s degree) ≤
    (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * edist t s
  rw [edist_dist]
  calc
    bottleneck (sampleDiagram k t degree) (sampleDiagram k s degree) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * dist t s) := h'
    _ = (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (dist t s) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
      simp

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.continuous_sampleDiagram
statement:
theorem continuous_sampleDiagram (k : Type w) [Field k] (degree : ℕ) :
    Continuous (fun t : Fin n → X => sampleDiagram k t degree)
proof:
:=
  (lipschitzWith_sampleDiagram k degree).continuous

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.isCompact_range_sampleDiagram
