name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.sampleLawMeasure_range
statement:
theorem sampleLawMeasure_range (k : Type w) [Field k] (μ : ProbabilityMeasure X)
    (n degree : ℕ) :
    (sampleLawMeasure k μ n degree : Measure (Diagram ℝ))
      (Set.range (fun t : Fin n → X => sampleDiagram k t degree)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sampleLawMeasure, ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_map]
  rw [Measure.map_apply (continuous_sampleDiagram k degree).measurable
    (isCompact_range_sampleDiagram k degree).measurableSet]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.sampleLawMeasure_map_isometry
statement:
theorem sampleLawMeasure_map_isometry (k : Type w) [Field k]
    {Y : Type v} [MetricSpace Y] [MeasurableSpace Y] [BorelSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y]
    (f : X → Y) (hf : Isometry f) (μ : ProbabilityMeasure X) (n degree : ℕ) :
    sampleLawMeasure k (μ.map hf.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable) n degree =
      sampleLawMeasure k μ n degree
proof:
:= by
  let g : (Fin n → X) → Fin n → Y := fun t i => f (t i)
  have hprod :
      (ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n =>
        μ.map hf.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable) : Measure (Fin n → Y)) =
        Measure.map g
          (ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ) : Measure (Fin n → X)) := by
    change Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n =>
        (μ.map hf.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable : Measure Y)) =
      Measure.map (fun t i => f (t i))
        (Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => (μ : Measure X)))
    exact (Measure.pi_map_pi
      (μ := fun _ : Fin n => (μ : Measure X))
      (f := fun _ : Fin n => f)
      (fun _ => hf.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable)).symm
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Measure.map (fun s : Fin n → Y => sampleDiagram k s degree)
      (ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n =>
        μ.map hf.continuous.measurable.aemeasurable) : Measure (Fin n → Y)) =
    Measure.map (fun t : Fin n → X => sampleDiagram k t degree)
      (ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ) : Measure (Fin n → X))
  rw [hprod]
  have hg : Measurable g := by
    apply measurable_pi_lambda
    intro i
    exact hf.continuous.measurable.comp (measurable_pi_apply i)
  calc
    Measure.map (fun s : Fin n → Y => sampleDiagram k s degree)
        (Measure.map g (ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ) : Measure (Fin n → X))) =
      Measure.map
        ((fun s : Fin n → Y => sampleDiagram k s degree) ∘ g)
        (ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ) : Measure (Fin n → X)) :=
      Measure.map_map (continuous_sampleDiagram (X := Y) k degree).measurable hg
    _ = Measure.map (fun t : Fin n → X => sampleDiagram k t degree)
        (ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ) : Measure (Fin n → X)) := by
      congr 1
      funext t
      exact sampleDiagram_eq_of_isometry k f hf t degree

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.iid_apply_product
statement:
private theorem iid_apply_product (μ : PMF X) (t : Fin n → X) :
    TDA.Probability.iid μ n t = ∏ i, μ (t i)
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    have ht : t = Fin.elim0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst t
    simp [TDA.Probability.iid]
  | succ n ih =>
    classical
    rw [TDA.Probability.iid_succ, PMF.bind_apply]
    let tail : Fin n → X := fun i => t i.succ
    let cons : X → (Fin n → X) → Fin (n + 1) → X := fun x xs => Fin.cons x xs
    have ht : t = cons (t 0) tail := by
      funext i
      exact Fin.cases rfl (fun j => rfl) i
    rw [ht]
    have hinner (a : X) :
        (TDA.Probability.iid μ n).map (cons a) (cons (t 0) tail) =
          if a = t 0 then TDA.Probability.iid μ n tail else 0 := by
      rw [PMF.map_apply]
      by_cases ha : a = t 0
      · subst a
        simp [cons, Fin.cons_inj]
      · simp [cons, Fin.cons_inj, ha, eq_comm]
    change (∑' a : X, μ a *
      (TDA.Probability.iid μ n).map (cons a) (cons (t 0) tail)) =
      ∏ i : Fin (n + 1), μ (cons (t 0) tail i)
    simp_rw [hinner]
    have hsum :
        (∑' a : X, μ a *
          (if a = t 0 then TDA.Probability.iid μ n tail else 0)) =
          μ (t 0) * TDA.Probability.iid μ n tail := by
      calc
        (∑' a : X, μ a *
            (if a = t 0 then TDA.Probability.iid μ n tail else 0)) =
            ∑' a : X, (if a = t 0 then μ a * TDA.Probability.iid μ n tail else 0) := by
          congr 1
          funext a
          by_cases ha : a = t 0 <;> simp [ha]
        _ = μ (t 0) * TDA.Probability.iid μ n tail := by
          rw [tsum_eq_single (t 0)]
          · simp
          · intro a ha
            simp [ha]
    calc
      _ = μ (t 0) * TDA.Probability.iid μ n tail := hsum
      _ = μ (t 0) * ∏ i : Fin n, μ (tail i) := by rw [ih]
      _ = ∏ i : Fin (n + 1), μ (cons (t 0) tail i) := by
        symm
        rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ]
        simp [cons]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.sampleLawMeasure_eq_toMeasure_sampleLaw
statement:
theorem sampleLawMeasure_eq_toMeasure_sampleLaw (k : Type w) [Field k]
    [Fintype X] [MeasurableSingletonClass X]
    (μ : PMF X) (n degree : ℕ) :
    sampleLawMeasure k
        (⟨μ.toMeasure, (inferInstance : IsProbabilityMeasure μ.toMeasure)⟩ :
          ProbabilityMeasure X)
        n degree =
      (sampleLaw k μ n degree).toMeasure
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let μprob : ProbabilityMeasure X :=
    ⟨μ.toMeasure, (inferInstance : IsProbabilityMeasure μ.toMeasure)⟩
  have hTuple :
      (ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μprob) : Measure (Fin n → X)) =
        (TDA.Probability.iid μ n).toMeasure := by
    apply Measure.ext_of_singleton
    intro t
    rw [ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_pi, Measure.pi_singleton]
    simp [μprob, iid_apply_product]
  change Measure.map (fun t : Fin n → X => sampleDiagram k t degree)
      (ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n =>
        (⟨μ.toMeasure, (inferInstance : IsProbabilityMeasure μ.toMeasure)⟩ :
          ProbabilityMeasure X)) : Measure (Fin n → X)) =
    ((TDA.Probability.iid μ n).map (fun t => sampleDiagram k t degree)).toMeasure
  rw [hTuple]
  exact PMF.toMeasure_map (p := TDA.Probability.iid μ n)
    (f := fun t => sampleDiagram k t degree)
    (continuous_sampleDiagram k degree).measurable

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_sampleDiagram_card_le_one_empty
statement:
private theorem bottleneck_sampleDiagram_card_le_one_empty (k : Type w) [Field k]
    (t : Fin n → X) (degree : ℕ) (hdegree : 1 ≤ degree)
    (hcard : Fintype.card (Sample t) ≤ 1) :
    bottleneck (sampleDiagram k t degree) Diagram.empty = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change bottleneck (diagram k (Sample t) degree) Diagram.empty = 0
  exact bottleneck_diagram_card_le_one_empty k hcard degree hdegree

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_sampleDiagram_const_empty
statement:
private theorem bottleneck_sampleDiagram_const_empty (k : Type w) [Field k]
    (x : X) (degree : ℕ) (hdegree : 1 ≤ degree) :
    bottleneck (sampleDiagram k (fun _ : Fin n => x) degree) Diagram.empty = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Subsingleton (Sample (fun _ : Fin n => x)) := ⟨by
    rintro ⟨a, i, rfl⟩ ⟨b, j, rfl⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl⟩
  apply bottleneck_sampleDiagram_card_le_one_empty k _ degree hdegree
  exact Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.mpr inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_sampleDiagram_empty_le_two_mul_diam
statement:
theorem bottleneck_sampleDiagram_empty_le_two_mul_diam (k : Type w) [Field k]
    (t : Fin n → X) (degree : ℕ) (hdegree : 1 ≤ degree) :
    bottleneck (sampleDiagram k t degree) Diagram.empty ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Metric.diam (Set.univ : Set X))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hn : n = 0
  · subst n
    letI : Subsingleton (Sample t) := ⟨by
      rintro ⟨x, i, hi⟩ _
      exact Fin.elim0 i⟩
    have hcard : Fintype.card (Sample t) ≤ 1 :=
      Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.mpr inferInstance
    rw [bottleneck_sampleDiagram_card_le_one_empty k t degree hdegree hcard]
    simp
  · have hnpos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
    let i₀ : Fin n := ⟨0, hnpos⟩
    let c : Fin n → X := fun _ => t i₀
    have hc_empty : bottleneck (sampleDiagram k c degree) Diagram.empty = 0 :=
      bottleneck_sampleDiagram_const_empty k (t i₀) degree hdegree
    have htuple : dist t c ≤ Metric.diam (Set.univ : Set X) := by
      apply (dist_pi_le_iff (Metric.diam_nonneg : 0 ≤ Metric.diam (Set.univ : Set X))).2
      intro i
      exact Metric.dist_le_diam_of_mem isCompact_univ.isBounded
        (Set.mem_univ (t i)) (Set.mem_univ (t i₀))
    have hLip : bottleneck (sampleDiagram k t degree) (sampleDiagram k c degree) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * dist t c) := by
      have h := (lipschitzWith_sampleDiagram (X := X) (n := n) k degree) t c
      change bottleneck (sampleDiagram k t degree) (sampleDiagram k c degree) ≤
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * edist t c at h
      rw [edist_dist] at h
      calc
        bottleneck (sampleDiagram k t degree) (sampleDiagram k c degree) ≤
            (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (dist t c) := h
        _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * dist t c) := by
          symm
          rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
          simp
    have hdiam : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * dist t c) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Metric.diam (Set.univ : Set X)) :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htuple (by norm_num))
    calc
      bottleneck (sampleDiagram k t degree) Diagram.empty ≤
          bottleneck (sampleDiagram k t degree) (sampleDiagram k c degree) +
            bottleneck (sampleDiagram k c degree) Diagram.empty :=
        bottleneck_triangle _ _ _
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Metric.diam (Set.univ : Set X)) + 0 :=
        add_le_add (hLip.trans hdiam) hc_empty.le
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Metric.diam (Set.univ : Set X)) := by simp

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.sampleLawMeasure_finite_rpow_moment
statement:
theorem sampleLawMeasure_finite_rpow_moment (k : Type w) [Field k]
    (μ : ProbabilityMeasure X) (n degree : ℕ) (hdegree : 1 ≤ degree)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∫⁻ D, (edist D Diagram.empty) ^ p ∂(sampleLawMeasure k μ n degree : Measure (Diagram ℝ))
      < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let bound : ℝ≥0∞ := ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Metric.diam (Set.univ : Set X))
  have hmap :
      ∫⁻ D, (edist D Diagram.empty) ^ p ∂
          (sampleLawMeasure k μ n degree : Measure (Diagram ℝ)) ≤
        ∫⁻ t, (edist (sampleDiagram k t degree) Diagram.empty) ^ p ∂
          (ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ) : Measure (Fin n → X)) := by
    rw [sampleLawMeasure, ProbabilityMeasure.toMeasure_map]
    exact MeasureTheory.lintegral_map_le _ _
  have hpoint (t : Fin n → X) :
      (edist (sampleDiagram k t degree) Diagram.empty) ^ p ≤ bound ^ p := by
    change (bottleneck (sampleDiagram k t degree) Diagram.empty) ^ p ≤ bound ^ p
    exact ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow
      (bottleneck_sampleDiagram_empty_le_two_mul_diam k t degree hdegree) hp.le
  have hfinite : bound ^ p < ⊤ := by
    apply ENNReal.rpow_lt_top_of_nonneg hp.le
    dsimp [bound]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  calc
    ∫⁻ D, (edist D Diagram.empty) ^ p ∂
        (sampleLawMeasure k μ n degree : Measure (Diagram ℝ)) ≤
      ∫⁻ t, (edist (sampleDiagram k t degree) Diagram.empty) ^ p ∂
        (ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ) : Measure (Fin n → X)) := hmap
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ _, bound ^ p ∂
        (ProbabilityMeasure.pi (fun _ : Fin n => μ) : Measure (Fin n → X)) :=
      MeasureTheory.lintegral_mono hpoint
    _ = bound ^ p := by simp [MeasureTheory.lintegral_const]
    _ < ⊤ := hfinite

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.face_nonempty
statement: theorem face_nonempty {m r : ℕ} (A : FaceIndex m r) : A.1.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.card_pos.mp
  rw [A.2]
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.faceJoin_mono
proof:
:= by
  exact Finset.sup'_mono f hBA (face_nonempty B)

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.faceJoin_le_iff
proof:
:= by
  change A.1.sup' (face_nonempty A) f ≤ p ↔ ∀ i ∈ A.1, f i ≤ p
  simpa only using (Finset.sup'_le_iff (s := A.1) (H := face_nonempty A)
    (f := f) (a := p))

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.inclusion_birth
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusion_birth {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) {r s : ℕ}
    (A : FaceIndex m r) (B : FaceIndex m s) (hBA : B.1 ⊆ A.1) :
    ((inclusion (k := k) f A B hBA).app (faceJoin f A)).hom
      (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)) =
        structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f B) (faceJoin_mono f A B hBA)
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f B))
proof:
:= by
  exact HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.freeToTerm_birth
statement:
@[simp] theorem freeToTerm_birth {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ)
    (A : FaceIndex m r) :
    (freeToTerm (k := k) f r).app (faceJoin f A)
      (GradedFree.birth (R := k) (faceGenerators f r) A) =
    (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B) A).app
      (faceJoin f A) (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))
proof:
:=
  GradedFree.lift_birth (faceGenerators f r) (term (k := k) f r)
    (fun B => (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B) B).app
      (faceJoin f B) (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f B))) A

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.termToFree_ι
statement:
@[simp] theorem termToFree_ι {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ)
    (A : FaceIndex m r) :
    biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B) A ≫
      termToFree (k := k) f r =
    HookInfinity.fromBirth (faceJoin f A) (freeTerm (k := k) f r)
      (GradedFree.birth (R := k) (faceGenerators f r) A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp only [termToFree]
  rw [biproduct.ι_desc]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.term_projective
statement: theorem term_projective {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ) : Projective (term (k := k) f r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : FaceIndex m r → PModule.{u,0,u} k P :=
    fun A => faceModule (k := k) f A
  have hF : ∀ A, Projective (F A) := fun A => by
    change Projective (HookInfinity.module (R := k) (faceJoin f A))
    infer_instance
  change Projective (⨁ F)
  letI : HasBiproduct F := inferInstance
  constructor
  intro E X α e he
  letI : Epi e := he
  choose β hβ using fun A => (hF A).factors (biproduct.ι F A ≫ α) e
  refine ⟨biproduct.desc β, ?_⟩
  apply biproduct.hom_ext'
  intro A
  rw [← Category.assoc, biproduct.ι_desc]
  exact hβ A

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.eraseFaceAt_subset
statement:
theorem eraseFaceAt_subset {m r : ℕ} (A : FaceIndex m (r + 1))
    (j : Fin (r + 2)) : (eraseFaceAt A j).1 ⊆ A.1
proof:
:= by
  change A.1.erase (faceOccurrence A j) ⊆ A.1
  exact Finset.erase_subset _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.signedDeletionAt_birth
statement:
@[simp] theorem signedDeletionAt_birth {m r : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P)
    (A : FaceIndex m (r + 1)) (j : Fin (r + 2)) :
    (signedDeletionAt (k := k) f A j).app (faceJoin f A)
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)) =
      (-1 : k) ^ (j : ℕ) • structureMapLinear
        (faceModule (k := k) f (eraseFaceAt A j))
            (faceJoin_mono f A (eraseFaceAt A j) (eraseFaceAt_subset A j))
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f (eraseFaceAt A j)))
proof:
:= by
  change (-1 : k) ^ (j : ℕ) •
    ((inclusion (k := k) f A (eraseFaceAt A j) (Finset.erase_subset _ _)).app
      (faceJoin f A)).hom (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)) = _
  simp [inclusion, HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.differential_ι
statement:
theorem differential_ι {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ)
    (A : FaceIndex m (r + 1)) :
    biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m (r + 1) => faceModule (k := k) f B) A ≫
        differential (k := k) f r =
      ∑ j : Fin (r + 2), signedDeletionAt (k := k) f A j ≫
        biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B)
          (eraseFaceAt A j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [differential, biproduct.ι_desc]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.generatedSupport_ordConnected
statement:
theorem generatedSupport_ordConnected {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) :
    (generatedSupport f).OrdConnected
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.ordConnected_def]
  intro p hp q hq x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hp
  exact ⟨i, hi.trans hx.1⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.faceJoin_mem_support
statement:
theorem faceJoin_mem_support {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) {r : ℕ}
    (A : FaceIndex m r) : faceJoin f A ∈ generatedSupport f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (face_nonempty A).exists_mem
  exact ⟨i, Finset.le_sup' (f := f) hi⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation_ι
statement:
theorem augmentation_ι {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (A : FaceIndex m 0) :
    biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m 0 => faceModule (k := k) f B) A ≫
        augmentation (k := k) f = augmentationComponent (k := k) f A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [augmentation, biproduct.ι_desc]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentationComponent_val
statement:
theorem augmentationComponent_val {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (A : FaceIndex m 0)
    {p : P} (h : faceJoin f A ≤ p) (hp : p ∈ generatedSupport f) :
    (((augmentationComponent (k := k) f A).app p).hom
      (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f A) h
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) : k) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hnat := (augmentationComponent (k := k) f A).naturality (homOfLE h)
  have hv := congrArg (fun α => α.hom (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) hnat
  have hmove : ((augmentationComponent (k := k) f A).app p).hom
      (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f A) h
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) =
      structureMapLinear
        (SupportInterval.module (generatedSupport f) (generatedSupport_ordConnected f)) h
        (((augmentationComponent (k := k) f A).app (faceJoin f A)).hom
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) := by
    simpa [structureMapLinear, structureMap] using hv.symm
  rw [hmove, SupportInterval.structureMap_val]
  simp only [hp, if_pos, one_mul]
  change (((HookInfinity.fromBirth (faceJoin f A)
      (SupportInterval.module (generatedSupport f) (generatedSupport_ordConnected f))
      (SupportInterval.one (generatedSupport f) (faceJoin_mem_support f A))).app
      (faceJoin f A)).hom (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)) : k) = 1
  rw [HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth]
  simp [SupportInterval.one]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.activeFaceEquiv_eraseFaceAt
statement:
theorem activeFaceEquiv_eraseFaceAt {m r : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P)
    (A : FaceIndex m (r + 1)) (j : Fin (r + 2)) (h : faceJoin f A ≤ p) :
    activeFaceEquiv f p ⟨eraseFaceAt A j,
      (faceJoin_mono f A (eraseFaceAt A j) (eraseFaceAt_subset A j)).trans h⟩ =
      TDA.Simplicial.deletedFace (activeComplex f p) r
        (activeFaceEquiv f p ⟨A, h⟩) j
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.termEvaluationEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem termEvaluationEquiv_apply {m r : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P)
    (x : (term (k := k) f r).obj p) :
    termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r) x =
      freeTermEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p
        (((termBiproductIso (k := k) f r).app p).toLinearEquiv x)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.termEvaluationEquiv_faceGenerator
statement:
@[simp] theorem termEvaluationEquiv_faceGenerator {m r : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P)
    (p : P) (A : FaceIndex m r) (h : faceJoin f A ≤ p) :
    termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r)
      (structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f r) h
        ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B) A).app
          (faceJoin f A) (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)))) =
        Finsupp.single (activeFaceEquiv f p ⟨A, h⟩) (1 : k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x := (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B) A).app
    (faceJoin f A) (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))
  have hbirth : (termToFree (k := k) f r).app (faceJoin f A) x =
      GradedFree.birth (R := k) (faceGenerators f r) A := by
    change ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B) A ≫
      termToFree (k := k) f r).app (faceJoin f A)).hom
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)) = _
    rw [termToFree_ι]
    simp [HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth]
  have hmove : (termToFree (k := k) f r).app p
      (structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f r) h x) =
        GradedFree.generator (R := k) (faceGenerators f r) A h := by
    have hn := termToFree (k := k) f r |>.naturality (homOfLE h)
    have hv := congrArg (fun α => α.hom x) hn
    have hs : structureMapLinear (freeTerm (k := k) f r) h
        ((termToFree (k := k) f r).app (faceJoin f A) x) =
          (termToFree (k := k) f r).app p (structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f r) h x) := by
      simpa [structureMapLinear, structureMap] using hv.symm
    rw [← hs, hbirth, GradedFree.generator_eq_structureMap]
  have hgen : GradedFree.fiberEquiv (R := k) (faceGenerators f r) p
      (GradedFree.generator (R := k) (faceGenerators f r) A h) =
        Finsupp.single ⟨A, h⟩ (1 : k) := by
    change Finsupp.subtypeDomain (fun g : FaceIndex m r => faceJoin f g ≤ p)
      (Finsupp.single A (1 : k)) = _
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro B
    simp [Finsupp.subtypeDomain_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, Subtype.ext_iff]
  calc
    _ = freeTermEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p
        (GradedFree.generator (R := k) (faceGenerators f r) A h) := by
          rw [termEvaluationEquiv_apply]
          change freeTermEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p
            ((termToFree (k := k) f r).app p
              (structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f r) h x)) = _
          rw [hmove]
    _ = Finsupp.single (activeFaceEquiv f p ⟨A, h⟩) (1 : k) := by
          rw [freeTermEvaluationEquiv]
          change Finsupp.domLCongr (M := k) (R := k) (activeFaceEquiv f p)
            (GradedFree.fiberEquiv (R := k) (faceGenerators f r) p
              (GradedFree.generator (R := k) (faceGenerators f r) A h)) = _
          rw [hgen, Finsupp.domLCongr_single]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.biproduct_ι_structureMap
statement:
theorem biproduct_ι_structureMap {m r : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P)
    (A : FaceIndex m r) {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (x : (faceModule (k := k) f A).obj a) :
    structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f r) hab
        ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B) A).app a x) =
      (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B) A).app b
        (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f A) hab x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn := (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B) A)
    |>.naturality (homOfLE hab)
  have hv := congrArg (fun α => α.hom x) hn
  simpa [structureMapLinear, structureMap] using hv

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation_faceGenerator_val
statement:
theorem augmentation_faceGenerator_val {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P)
    (A : FaceIndex m 0) (h : faceJoin f A ≤ p) (hp : p ∈ generatedSupport f) :
    (((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom
      (structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f 0) h
        ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m 0 => faceModule (k := k) f B) A).app
          (faceJoin f A) (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)))) : k) =
      TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum (activeComplex f p) k
        (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := 0)
          (structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f 0) h
            ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m 0 => faceModule (k := k) f B) A).app
              (faceJoin f A) (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [biproduct_ι_structureMap]
  have hιapp : ((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom
      ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m 0 => faceModule (k := k) f B) A).app p
        (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f A) h
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)))) =
        ((augmentationComponent (k := k) f A).app p).hom
          (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f A) h
            (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) := by
    have heq := congrArg (fun α => α.app p) (augmentation_ι (k := k) f A)
    have hv := congrArg (fun α => α.hom
      (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f A) h
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)))) heq
    simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply] using hv
  rw [hιapp]
  have hcv := augmentationComponent_val (k := k) f A h hp
  rw [hcv]
  rw [← biproduct_ι_structureMap (k := k) f A (hab := h)]
  rw [termEvaluationEquiv_faceGenerator]
  rw [TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum_single]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation_val
statement:
theorem augmentation_val {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P)
    (hp : p ∈ generatedSupport f) (x : (term (k := k) f 0).obj p) :
    (((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom x : k) =
      TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum (activeComplex f p) k
        (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := 0) x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := 0)
  let augVal : (term (k := k) f 0).obj p →ₗ[k] k :=
    (Submodule.subtype (SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) (generatedSupport f) p)).comp
      ((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom
  have hmap : augVal.comp E.symm.toLinearMap =
      TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum (activeComplex f p) k := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro σ a
    let A := (activeFaceEquiv f p).symm σ
    let xA := structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f 0) A.property
      ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m 0 => faceModule (k := k) f B) A.1).app
        (faceJoin f A.1) (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A.1)))
    have hface : activeFaceEquiv f p ⟨A.1, A.property⟩ = σ := by
      simpa [A] using (Equiv.apply_symm_apply (activeFaceEquiv f p) σ)
    have hgen : E xA = Finsupp.single σ (1 : k) := by
      simpa [E, xA, hface] using
        termEvaluationEquiv_faceGenerator (k := k) f p A.1 A.property
    have hinv : E.symm (Finsupp.single σ (1 : k)) = xA := by
      apply E.injective
      simpa [hgen]
    have hval : augVal xA = 1 := by
      have h := augmentation_faceGenerator_val (k := k) f p A.1 A.property hp
      rw [hgen, TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum_single] at h
      simpa [augVal, xA] using h
    have hcoeff : Finsupp.single σ a = a • Finsupp.single σ (1 : k) := by
      ext τ
      simp [Finsupp.smul_single]
    change augVal (E.symm (Finsupp.single σ a)) =
      TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum (activeComplex f p) k (Finsupp.single σ a)
    calc
      augVal (E.symm (Finsupp.single σ a)) = a := by
        rw [hcoeff, map_smul, hinv]
        simp [hval]
      _ = TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum (activeComplex f p) k (Finsupp.single σ a) := by
        rw [TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum_single]
  have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun hmap (E x)
  have hcancel : E.symm (E x) = x := E.symm_apply_apply x
  change augVal (E.symm (E x)) =
    TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum (activeComplex f p) k (E x) at hx
  rw [hcancel] at hx
  simpa [augVal, E] using hx

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.faceJoin_singleton
statement:
@[simp] theorem faceJoin_singleton {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (i : Fin m) :
    faceJoin f (singletonFaceIndex i) = f i
proof:
:= by
  simp [faceJoin, singletonFaceIndex]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation_surjective_at
statement:
theorem augmentation_surjective_at {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P) :
    Function.Surjective ((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hp : p ∈ generatedSupport f
  · intro y
    have hsupport := hp
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hp
    let A := singletonFaceIndex i
    have hA : faceJoin f A ≤ p := by simpa [A] using hi
    let x := structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f 0) hA
      ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m 0 => faceModule (k := k) f B) A).app
        (faceJoin f A) (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)))
    have hunit : (((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom x : k) = 1 := by
      have h := augmentation_faceGenerator_val (k := k) f p A hA hsupport
      rw [termEvaluationEquiv_faceGenerator, TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum_single] at h
      exact h
    refine ⟨(y : k) • x, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom ((y : k) • x) : k) = (y : k)
    simp [hunit]
  · intro y
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hy := SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k) (generatedSupport f) hp y
    simpa using hy.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.differential_faceBirth
statement:
theorem differential_faceBirth {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ)
    (A : FaceIndex m (r + 1)) :
    ((differential (k := k) f r).app (faceJoin f A)).hom
        ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m (r + 1) => faceModule (k := k) f B) A).app
          (faceJoin f A) (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) =
      ∑ j : Fin (r + 2), (-1 : k) ^ (j : ℕ) •
        (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B)
          (eraseFaceAt A j)).app (faceJoin f A)
          (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f (eraseFaceAt A j))
                (faceJoin_mono f A (eraseFaceAt A j) (eraseFaceAt_subset A j))
            (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f (eraseFaceAt A j))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcomp := congrArg (fun α => α.app (faceJoin f A))
    (differential_ι (k := k) f r A)
  have hv := congrArg (fun α => α.hom (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) hcomp
  simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply, signedDeletionAt_birth] using hv

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.termEvaluationEquiv_differential_face
statement:
theorem termEvaluationEquiv_differential_face {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P)
    (r : ℕ) (A : FaceIndex m (r + 1)) (h : faceJoin f A ≤ p) :
    termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r)
        (((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom
          (structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f (r + 1)) h
            ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m (r + 1) => faceModule (k := k) f B) A).app
              (faceJoin f A) (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))))) =
      TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k r
        (Finsupp.single (activeFaceEquiv f p ⟨A, h⟩) (1 : k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x := (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m (r + 1) => faceModule (k := k) f B) A).app
    (faceJoin f A) (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))
  have hnat := (differential (k := k) f r).naturality (homOfLE h)
  have hn : ((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom
      (structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f (r + 1)) h x) =
        structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f r) h
          (((differential (k := k) f r).app (faceJoin f A)).hom x) := by
    have hv := congrArg (fun α => α.hom x) hnat
    simpa [structureMapLinear, structureMap] using hv.symm
  have hterm (j : Fin (r + 2)) :
      termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r)
          (structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f r) h
            ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B)
              (eraseFaceAt A j)).app (faceJoin f A)
              (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f (eraseFaceAt A j))
                (faceJoin_mono f A (eraseFaceAt A j) (eraseFaceAt_subset A j))
                (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f (eraseFaceAt A j)))))) =
        Finsupp.single
          (TDA.Simplicial.deletedFace (activeComplex f p) r
            (activeFaceEquiv f p ⟨A, h⟩) j) (1 : k) := by
    rw [biproduct_ι_structureMap]
    have hjoin := faceJoin_mono f A (eraseFaceAt A j) (eraseFaceAt_subset A j)
    have htotal := hjoin.trans h
    have hcomp : structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f (eraseFaceAt A j))
        htotal (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f (eraseFaceAt A j))) =
      structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f (eraseFaceAt A j)) h
        (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f (eraseFaceAt A j)) hjoin
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f (eraseFaceAt A j)))) := by
      exact congrArg (fun g => g
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f (eraseFaceAt A j)))
      ) (structureMapLinear_comp (faceModule (k := k) f (eraseFaceAt A j)) hjoin h)
    rw [← hcomp]
    rw [← biproduct_ι_structureMap (k := k) f (eraseFaceAt A j)
      (hab := htotal)]
    rw [termEvaluationEquiv_faceGenerator]
    rw [activeFaceEquiv_eraseFaceAt]
  calc
    _ = termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r)
          (structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f r) h
            (((differential (k := k) f r).app (faceJoin f A)).hom x)) := by
          rw [hn]
    _ = TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k r
          (Finsupp.single (activeFaceEquiv f p ⟨A, h⟩) (1 : k)) := by
          rw [differential_faceBirth]
          calc
            _ = ∑ j : Fin (r + 2), (-1 : k) ^ (j : ℕ) •
                termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r)
                  (structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f r) h
                    ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B)
                      (eraseFaceAt A j)).app (faceJoin f A)
                      (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f (eraseFaceAt A j))
                        (faceJoin_mono f A (eraseFaceAt A j) (eraseFaceAt_subset A j))
                        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f (eraseFaceAt A j)))))) := by
                  simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
            _ = ∑ j : Fin (r + 2), (-1 : k) ^ (j : ℕ) •
                Finsupp.single
                  (TDA.Simplicial.deletedFace (activeComplex f p) r
                    (activeFaceEquiv f p ⟨A, h⟩) j) (1 : k) := by
                  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                  intro j hj
                  rw [hterm]
            _ = TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k r
                (Finsupp.single (activeFaceEquiv f p ⟨A, h⟩) (1 : k)) := by
                  rw [TDA.Simplicial.boundary_single]
                  simp [Finset.smul_sum, Finsupp.smul_single]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.termEvaluationEquiv_differential
statement:
theorem termEvaluationEquiv_differential {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P)
    (r : ℕ) (x : (term (k := k) f (r + 1)).obj p) :
    termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r)
        (((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom x) =
      TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k r
        (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r + 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E₁ := termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r + 1)
  let E₀ := termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r)
  let d : TDA.Simplicial.Chain (activeComplex f p) k (r + 1) →ₗ[k]
      TDA.Simplicial.Chain (activeComplex f p) k r :=
    E₀.toLinearMap.comp
      ((((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom).comp E₁.symm.toLinearMap)
  have hd : d = TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k r := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro σ a
    let A := (activeFaceEquiv f p).symm σ
    let xA := structureMapLinear (term (k := k) f (r + 1)) A.property
      ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m (r + 1) => faceModule (k := k) f B)
        A.1).app (faceJoin f A.1) (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A.1)))
    have hface : activeFaceEquiv f p ⟨A.1, A.property⟩ = σ := by
      simpa [A] using (Equiv.apply_symm_apply (activeFaceEquiv f p) σ)
    have hgen : E₁ xA = Finsupp.single σ (1 : k) := by
      simpa [E₁, xA, hface] using
        termEvaluationEquiv_faceGenerator (k := k) f p A.1 A.property
    have hinv : E₁.symm (Finsupp.single σ (1 : k)) = xA := by
      apply E₁.injective
      simpa [hgen]
    have hbase : E₀ (((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom xA) =
        TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k r
          (Finsupp.single σ (1 : k)) := by
      simpa [E₀, xA, hface] using
        termEvaluationEquiv_differential_face (k := k) f p r A.1 A.property
    have hcoeff : Finsupp.single σ a = a • Finsupp.single σ (1 : k) := by
      ext τ
      simp [Finsupp.smul_single]
    change d (Finsupp.single σ a) =
      TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k r (Finsupp.single σ a)
    calc
      d (Finsupp.single σ a) = a • d (Finsupp.single σ (1 : k)) := by
        rw [hcoeff]
        rw [map_smul]
      _ = a • TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k r
          (Finsupp.single σ (1 : k)) := by
        change a • E₀ (((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom
          (E₁.symm (Finsupp.single σ (1 : k)))) = _
        rw [hinv, hbase]
      _ = TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k r (Finsupp.single σ a) := by
        rw [hcoeff, map_smul]
  have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun hd (E₁ x)
  change E₀ (((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom
    (E₁.symm (E₁ x))) = _ at hx
  rw [LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at hx
  change E₀ (((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom x) = _
  exact hx

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.mem_generatedSupport_iff_active
statement:
theorem mem_generatedSupport_iff_active {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P) :
    p ∈ generatedSupport f ↔ Nonempty (ActiveIndex f p)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨i, hi⟩⟩
    exact ⟨i, hi⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.term_eq_zero_of_no_active
statement:
theorem term_eq_zero_of_no_active {m r : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P)
    (h : ¬ Nonempty (ActiveIndex f p)) (x : (term (k := k) f r).obj p) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r)).injective
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro σ
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := σ.2.1.1.exists_mem
  exact (h ⟨⟨i, σ.2.1.2 i hi⟩⟩).elim

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.term_isZero_of_degree_ge
statement:
theorem term_isZero_of_degree_ge {m r : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (hmr : m ≤ r) :
    IsZero (term (k := k) f r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Functor.isZero_iff]
  intro p
  rw [ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton]
  constructor
  intro x y
  have hzero (z : (term (k := k) f r).obj p) : z = 0 := by
    apply (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r)).injective
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro σ
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_univ σ.1
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
    have hdeg : σ.1.card = r + 1 := σ.2.2
    omega
  exact (hzero x).trans (hzero y).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.generatedSupport_fin_zero
statement: theorem generatedSupport_fin_zero (f : Fin 0 → P) : generatedSupport f = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  simp [generatedSupport]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.generatedSupport_fin_zero_module_isZero
statement:
theorem generatedSupport_fin_zero_module_isZero (f : Fin 0 → P) :
    IsZero (SupportInterval.module (k := k) (generatedSupport f)
      (generatedSupport_ordConnected f))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Functor.isZero_iff]
  intro p
  change IsZero (ModuleCat.of k
    (SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) (generatedSupport f) p))
  rw [ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton]
  change Subsingleton (SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) (generatedSupport f) p)
  constructor
  intro x y
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hx := SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k) (generatedSupport f)
    (by rw [generatedSupport_fin_zero]; simp) x
  have hy := SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k) (generatedSupport f)
    (by rw [generatedSupport_fin_zero]; simp) y
  exact hx.trans hy.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.activeComplex_isApexCone
statement:
theorem activeComplex_isApexCone {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P)
    [Nonempty (ActiveIndex f p)] :
    ∃ v, TDA.Simplicial.IsApexCone (activeComplex f p) v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : LinearOrder (ActiveIndex f p) := inferInstance
  letI : Finite (ActiveIndex f p) := Finite.of_fintype _
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := Finite.exists_min (fun w : ActiveIndex f p => w)
  refine ⟨v.1, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change ({v.1} : Finset (Fin m)).Nonempty ∧ _
    simp [v.2]
  · intro s hs
    change (insert v.1 s).Nonempty ∧ ∀ i ∈ insert v.1 s, f i ≤ p
    refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
    intro i hi
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | hi
    · exact v.2
    · exact hs.2 i hi
  · intro s hs w hw
    exact hv ⟨w, hs.2 w hw⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.activeComplex_positive_exact
statement:
theorem activeComplex_positive_exact {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P)
    [Nonempty (ActiveIndex f p)] (r : ℕ)
    (c : TDA.Simplicial.Chain (activeComplex f p) k (r + 1))
    (hc : TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k r c = 0) :
    ∃ d : TDA.Simplicial.Chain (activeComplex f p) k (r + 2),
      TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k (r + 1) d = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨v, hK⟩ := activeComplex_isApexCone f p
  refine ⟨hK.coneOperator k (r + 1) c, ?_⟩
  have hcontract := hK.boundary_coneOperator_add k r c
  rw [hc, map_zero, add_zero] at hcontract
  exact hcontract

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.activeComplex_zero_exact
statement:
theorem activeComplex_zero_exact {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P)
    [Nonempty (ActiveIndex f p)]
    (c : TDA.Simplicial.Chain (activeComplex f p) k 0)
    (hc : TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum (activeComplex f p) k c = 0) :
    ∃ d : TDA.Simplicial.Chain (activeComplex f p) k 1,
      TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k 0 d = c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨v, hK⟩ := activeComplex_isApexCone f p
  refine ⟨hK.coneOperator k 0 c, ?_⟩
  rw [hK.boundary_coneOperator_zero k c, hc]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.differential_exact_at_succ
statement:
theorem differential_exact_at_succ {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P) (r : ℕ)
    (x : (term (k := k) f (r + 1)).obj p)
    (hx : ((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ y : (term (k := k) f (r + 2)).obj p,
      ((differential (k := k) f (r + 1)).app p).hom y = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ha : Nonempty (ActiveIndex f p)
  · have hmap := termEvaluationEquiv_differential (k := k) f p r x
    have hcycle : TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k r
        (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r + 1) x) = 0 := by
      rw [← hmap, hx]
      simp
    letI : Nonempty (ActiveIndex f p) := ha
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := activeComplex_positive_exact (k := k) f p r
      (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r + 1) x) hcycle
    let y := (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r + 2)).symm z
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    apply (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r + 1)).injective
    calc
      termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r + 1)
          (((differential (k := k) f (r + 1)).app p).hom y) =
          TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k (r + 1)
            (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r + 2) y) :=
        termEvaluationEquiv_differential (k := k) f p (r + 1) y
      _ = TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k (r + 1) z := by simp [y]
      _ = termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r + 1) x := hz
  · have hx0 := term_eq_zero_of_no_active (k := k) f p ha x
    exact ⟨0, by simp [hx0]⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.differential_comp_differential
statement:
theorem differential_comp_differential {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ) :
    differential (k := k) f (r + 1) ≫ differential (k := k) f r = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext p
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r)).injective
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.comp_apply, NatTrans.app_zero,
    ModuleCat.hom_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
  change termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r)
      (((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom
        (((differential (k := k) f (r + 1)).app p).hom x)) = 0
  calc
    _ = TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k r
          (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r + 1)
            (((differential (k := k) f (r + 1)).app p).hom x)) :=
          termEvaluationEquiv_differential (k := k) f p r _
    _ = TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k r
          (TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k (r + 1)
            (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r + 2) x)) := by
          rw [termEvaluationEquiv_differential]
    _ = 0 := by
          have hz := LinearMap.congr_fun
            (TDA.Simplicial.boundary_comp_boundary (activeComplex f p) k r)
            (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := r + 2) x)
          simpa using hz

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.differential_comp_augmentation
statement:
theorem differential_comp_augmentation {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) :
    differential (k := k) f 0 ≫ augmentation (k := k) f = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext p
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom
    (((differential (k := k) f 0).app p).hom x) : k) = 0
  by_cases hp : p ∈ generatedSupport f
  · have hval := augmentation_val (k := k) f p hp
      (((differential (k := k) f 0).app p).hom x)
    rw [termEvaluationEquiv_differential] at hval
    have hzero : TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum (activeComplex f p) k
        (TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k 0
          (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := 1) x)) = 0 := by
      have hz := LinearMap.congr_fun
        (TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum_boundary (activeComplex f p) k)
        (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := 1) x)
      simpa [LinearMap.comp_apply] using hz
    rw [hval]
    exact hzero
  · exact SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k) (generatedSupport f) hp
      (((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom
        (((differential (k := k) f 0).app p).hom x))

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation_exact_at_zero
statement:
theorem augmentation_exact_at_zero {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P)
    (x : (term (k := k) f 0).obj p)
    (hx : ((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ y : (term (k := k) f 1).obj p,
      ((differential (k := k) f 0).app p).hom y = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hp : p ∈ generatedSupport f
  · have hsum : TDA.Simplicial.zeroChainSum (activeComplex f p) k
        (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := 0) x) = 0 := by
      have hval := augmentation_val (k := k) f p hp x
      have hv := congrArg (fun z : SupportInterval.fiber (k := k)
          (generatedSupport f) p => (z : k)) hx
      rw [← hval]
      simpa using hv
    letI : Nonempty (ActiveIndex f p) :=
      (mem_generatedSupport_iff_active f p).mp hp
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := activeComplex_zero_exact (k := k) f p
      (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := 0) x) hsum
    let y := (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := 1)).symm z
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    apply (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := 0)).injective
    calc
      termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := 0)
          (((differential (k := k) f 0).app p).hom y) =
          TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k 0
            (termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := 1) y) :=
        termEvaluationEquiv_differential (k := k) f p 0 y
      _ = TDA.Simplicial.boundary (activeComplex f p) k 0 z := by simp [y]
      _ = termEvaluationEquiv (k := k) f p (r := 0) x := hz
  · have hactive : ¬ Nonempty (ActiveIndex f p) := by
      intro ha
      exact hp ((mem_generatedSupport_iff_active f p).mpr ha)
    have hx0 := term_eq_zero_of_no_active (k := k) f p hactive x
    exact ⟨0, by simp [hx0]⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.resolution_pointwise_exact_at
statement:
theorem resolution_pointwise_exact_at {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P) :
    Function.Surjective ((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom ∧
      (∀ x : (term (k := k) f 0).obj p,
        ((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom x = 0 →
          ∃ y : (term (k := k) f 1).obj p,
            ((differential (k := k) f 0).app p).hom y = x) ∧
      (∀ r (x : (term (k := k) f (r + 1)).obj p),
        ((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom x = 0 →
          ∃ y : (term (k := k) f (r + 2)).obj p,
            ((differential (k := k) f (r + 1)).app p).hom y = x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨augmentation_surjective_at (k := k) f p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact augmentation_exact_at_zero (k := k) f p x hx
  · intro r x hx
    exact differential_exact_at_succ (k := k) f p r x hx

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolution.term_fin_zero_eq_zero
statement:
theorem term_fin_zero_eq_zero (f : Fin 0 → P) (r : ℕ) (p : P)
    (x : (term (k := k) f r).obj p) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact term_eq_zero_of_no_active (k := k) f p
    (by rintro ⟨⟨i, hi⟩⟩; exact Fin.elim0 i) x

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.diagramOccurrence_finite
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagramOccurrence_finite (b d : ℝ) :
    diagramOccurrence (b, (d : WithTop ℝ)) = (minusCut b, minusCut d)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.diagramOccurrence_essential
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagramOccurrence_essential (b : ℝ) :
    diagramOccurrence (b, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) = (minusCut b, infinityCut)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.diagramOccurrence_mem_rectangleCell
statement:
private theorem diagramOccurrence_mem_rectangleCell (p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ)
    (a b c d : ℝ) :
    diagramOccurrence p ∈ rectangleCell a b c d ↔
      a < p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ b ∧ c < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ (d : WithTop ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨birth, death⟩
  cases death with
  | top => simp [diagramOccurrence, rectangleCell, infinityCut_not_mem_cutCell]
  | coe death =>
      simp [diagramOccurrence, rectangleCell, cutCell, minusCut, and_assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.countP_fourRank_eq_rectangle
statement:
private theorem countP_fourRank_eq_rectangle (s : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ))
    (a b c d : ℝ) (_hab : a < b) (_hbc : b < c) (_hcd : c < d) :
    ((s.countP (fun p => p.1 ≤ b ∧ (c : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) : ℤ) -
      (s.countP (fun p => p.1 ≤ a ∧ (c : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) : ℤ) -
      (s.countP (fun p => p.1 ≤ b ∧ (d : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) : ℤ) +
      (s.countP (fun p => p.1 ≤ a ∧ (d : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) : ℤ)) =
    (s.countP (fun p => a < p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ b ∧
      (c : WithTop ℝ) < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ (d : WithTop ℝ)) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons p s ih =>
      simp only [Multiset.countP_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ite,
        Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero]
      have hp :
          ((if p.1 ≤ b ∧ (c : WithTop ℝ) < p.2 then (1 : ℤ) else 0) -
            (if p.1 ≤ a ∧ (c : WithTop ℝ) < p.2 then 1 else 0) -
            (if p.1 ≤ b ∧ (d : WithTop ℝ) < p.2 then 1 else 0) +
            (if p.1 ≤ a ∧ (d : WithTop ℝ) < p.2 then 1 else 0)) =
          (if a < p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ b ∧ (c : WithTop ℝ) < p.2 ∧
              p.2 ≤ (d : WithTop ℝ) then 1 else 0) := by
        rcases p with ⟨birth, death⟩
        cases death with
        | top => simp
        | coe death =>
            by_cases h₁ : birth ≤ a
            · have h₂ : birth ≤ b := h₁.trans _hab.le
              by_cases h₃ : c < death
              · by_cases h₄ : d < death
                · have hnot : ¬ death ≤ d := not_le_of_gt h₄
                  simp [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, hnot]
                · have h₅ : death ≤ d := le_of_not_gt h₄
                  simp [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅]
              · by_cases h₄ : d < death
                · exact (h₃ (_hcd.trans h₄)).elim
                · simp [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄]
            · have h₁' : a < birth := lt_of_not_ge h₁
              by_cases h₂ : birth ≤ b
              · by_cases h₃ : c < death
                · by_cases h₄ : d < death
                  · have hnot : ¬ death ≤ d := not_le_of_gt h₄
                    simp [h₁, h₁', h₂, h₃, h₄, hnot]
                  · have h₅ : death ≤ d := le_of_not_gt h₄
                    simp [h₁, h₁', h₂, h₃, h₄, h₅]
                · by_cases h₄ : d < death
                  · exact (h₃ (_hcd.trans h₄)).elim
                  · simp [h₁, h₁', h₂, h₃, h₄]
              · simp [h₁, h₂]
      linear_combination ih + hp

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.diagramOccurrence_count_rectangle
statement:
private theorem diagramOccurrence_count_rectangle (D : Diagram ℝ)
    (a b c d : ℝ) (_hab : a < b) (_hbc : b < c) (_hcd : c < d) :
    (D.points.map diagramOccurrence).countP (fun p => p ∈ rectangleCell a b c d) =
      D.points.countP (fun p => a < p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ b ∧
        (c : WithTop ℝ) < p.2 ∧ p.2 ≤ (d : WithTop ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.countP_map]
  rw [← Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter]
  apply Multiset.countP_congr rfl
  intro p _
  exact propext (diagramOccurrence_mem_rectangleCell p a b c d)

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.finiteRips_persistenceMeasure_eq_rectangleCount
statement:
private theorem finiteRips_persistenceMeasure_eq_rectangleCount
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fintype X] (n : ℕ)
    (a b c d : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) (hcd : c < d) :
    persistenceMeasureValue
      (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
      hab.le hbc.le hcd.le =
    ((diagram k X n).points.map diagramOccurrence).countP
      (fun p => p ∈ rectangleCell a b c d)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)
  let M := sublevelModule k f n
  have hTB : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X) := by
    apply Metric.totallyBounded_iff.2
    intro ε hε
    refine ⟨Set.univ, Set.finite_univ, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨Set.mem_univ x, by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hε⟩⟩
  let hQ := qTame_of_totallyBounded (X := X) k hTB n
  let _ : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc.le) := hQ b c hbc
  have hfour := persistenceMeasureValue_four_rank M hab.le hbc.le hcd.le
  have hrBC : Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M hbc.le) =
      (diagram k X n).points.countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ b ∧ (c : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) := by
    convert rank_sublevelHomologyMap k f n b c hbc.le using 1 <;>
      simp only [M, f, persistenceImage, structureMapLinear, sublevelModule,
        simplicialHomologyPModule_structureMap, diagram_eq_dgm k X n]; rfl
  have hrAC : Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M (hab.le.trans hbc.le)) =
      (diagram k X n).points.countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ a ∧ (c : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) := by
    convert rank_sublevelHomologyMap k f n a c (hab.trans hbc).le using 1 <;>
      simp only [M, f, persistenceImage, structureMapLinear, sublevelModule,
        simplicialHomologyPModule_structureMap, diagram_eq_dgm k X n]; rfl
  have hrBD : Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M (hbc.le.trans hcd.le)) =
      (diagram k X n).points.countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ b ∧ (d : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) := by
    convert rank_sublevelHomologyMap k f n b d (hbc.trans hcd).le using 1 <;>
      simp only [M, f, persistenceImage, structureMapLinear, sublevelModule,
        simplicialHomologyPModule_structureMap, diagram_eq_dgm k X n]; rfl
  have hrAD : Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M ((hab.le.trans hbc.le).trans hcd.le)) =
      (diagram k X n).points.countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ a ∧ (d : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) := by
    convert rank_sublevelHomologyMap k f n a d (hab.trans (hbc.trans hcd)).le using 1 <;>
      simp only [M, f, persistenceImage, structureMapLinear, sublevelModule,
        simplicialHomologyPModule_structureMap, diagram_eq_dgm k X n]; rfl
  rw [hrBC, hrAC, hrBD, hrAD] at hfour
  have hcounts := countP_fourRank_eq_rectangle (diagram k X n).points a b c d hab hbc hcd
  have hcounts' := diagramOccurrence_count_rectangle (diagram k X n) a b c d hab hbc hcd
  rw [hcounts] at hfour
  rw [← hcounts'] at hfour
  exact_mod_cast hfour

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.diagramFiniteDeath_lt_bound
proof:
:= by
  let deaths := insert 0 (D.points.toFinset.image fun q =>
    match q.2 with | (x : ℝ) => x | ⊤ => 0)
  have hmem : d ∈ deaths := by
    apply Finset.mem_insert_of_mem
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨p, Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr hp, ?_⟩
    rw [hpd]
  have hle' : d ≤ deaths.max' ⟨d, hmem⟩ := Finset.le_max' deaths d hmem
  have hle : d ≤ deaths.max' ⟨0, Finset.mem_insert_self 0 _⟩ := by
    convert hle'
  have hEq : deaths.max' ⟨0, Finset.mem_insert_self 0 _⟩ = diagramFiniteDeathBound D := by
    simp [diagramFiniteDeathBound, deaths]
  rw [hEq] at hle
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.countP_tail_split_aux
statement:
private theorem countP_tail_split_aux (points : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ))
    {a b C : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hfinite : ∀ p ∈ points, ∀ d : ℝ, p.2 = d → d < C) :
    points.countP (fun p => p.1 ≤ b ∧ (C : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) =
      points.countP (fun p => p.1 ≤ a ∧ (C : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) +
        points.countP (fun p => a < p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ b ∧ p.2 = ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction points using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons p points ih =>
      simp only [Multiset.countP_cons]
      have hp :
          (if p.1 ≤ b ∧ (C : WithTop ℝ) < p.2 then 1 else 0) =
            (if p.1 ≤ a ∧ (C : WithTop ℝ) < p.2 then 1 else 0) +
              (if a < p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ b ∧ p.2 = ⊤ then 1 else 0) := by
        rcases p with ⟨birth, death⟩
        cases death with
        | top =>
            simp only [WithTop.coe_lt_top, and_true]
            by_cases hA : birth ≤ a
            · have hB : birth ≤ b := hA.trans hab
              simp [hA, hB]
            · have hA' : a < birth := lt_of_not_ge hA
              by_cases hB : birth ≤ b
              · simp [hA, hA', hB]
              · simp [hA, hA', hB]
        | coe d =>
            have hdC : d < C := hfinite (birth, d) (by simp) d rfl
            have hCnot : ¬ C < (d : WithTop ℝ) := by exact not_lt_of_ge (show (d : WithTop ℝ) ≤ C from WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr hdC.le)
            simp [hCnot]
      have hfiniteTail : ∀ q ∈ points, ∀ d : ℝ, q.2 = d → d < C := by
        intro q hq d hqd
        exact hfinite q (by simp [hq]) d hqd
      rw [hp, ih hfiniteTail]
      omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.countP_tail_split
statement:
private theorem countP_tail_split (D : Diagram ℝ) {a b C : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hfinite : ∀ p ∈ D.points, ∀ d : ℝ, p.2 = d → d < C) :
    D.points.countP (fun p => p.1 ≤ b ∧ (C : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) =
      D.points.countP (fun p => p.1 ≤ a ∧ (C : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) +
        D.points.countP (fun p => a < p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ b ∧ p.2 = ⊤)
proof:
:=
  countP_tail_split_aux D.points hab hfinite

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.finiteRips_essentialMeasureValue_eq_essentialBirthCount
statement:
private theorem finiteRips_essentialMeasureValue_eq_essentialBirthCount
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fintype X] (n : ℕ) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    essentialMeasureValue
      (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n) hab =
    (diagram k X n).points.countP
      (fun p => a < p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ b ∧ p.2 = ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)
  let M := sublevelModule k f n
  let D := diagram k X n
  have hTB : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X) := by
    apply Metric.totallyBounded_iff.2
    intro ε hε
    refine ⟨Set.univ, Set.finite_univ, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨Set.mem_univ x, by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hε⟩⟩
  let hQ := qTame_of_totallyBounded (X := X) k hTB n
  obtain ⟨c₀, hbc₀, hstable⟩ := PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_eventually M hQ hab
  let C := max c₀ (max (b + 1) (diagramFiniteDeathBound D + 1))
  have h₀C : c₀ ≤ C := le_max_left _ _
  have hbC : b < C := by
    dsimp [C]
    exact (lt_add_one b).trans_le
      ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))
  have hbcC : b < C := hbC
  have htail :
      persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab hbcC.le = essentialMeasureValue M hab := by
    exact hstable C h₀C
  let _ : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbcC.le) := hQ b C hbcC
  have htailRank := persistenceTailMeasureValue_add_image M hab hbcC.le
  have hrankBC : Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M hbcC.le) =
      D.points.countP (fun p => p.1 ≤ b ∧ (C : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) := by
    convert rank_sublevelHomologyMap k f n b C hbcC.le using 1 <;>
      simp only [M, D, f, persistenceImage, structureMapLinear, sublevelModule,
        simplicialHomologyPModule_structureMap, diagram_eq_dgm k X n]; rfl
  have hrankAC : Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M (hab.trans hbcC.le)) =
      D.points.countP (fun p => p.1 ≤ a ∧ (C : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) := by
    convert rank_sublevelHomologyMap k f n a C (hab.trans hbcC.le) using 1 <;>
      simp only [M, D, f, persistenceImage, structureMapLinear, sublevelModule,
        simplicialHomologyPModule_structureMap, diagram_eq_dgm k X n]; rfl
  have hfinite : ∀ p ∈ D.points, ∀ d : ℝ, p.2 = d → d < C := by
    intro p hp d hpd
    have hbound := diagramFiniteDeath_lt_bound D hp hpd
    dsimp [C]
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hbound
      (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) (le_max_right _ _))
  have hsplit := countP_tail_split D hab hfinite
  have hEq := htailRank
  rw [hrankBC, hrankAC, hsplit] at hEq
  rw [htail] at hEq
  simpa [D] using (by omega : essentialMeasureValue M hab =
    D.points.countP (fun p => a < p.1 ∧ p.1 ≤ b ∧ p.2 = ⊤))

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.diagramEssentialBirths_count_cell
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [diagramEssentialBirths, Multiset.countP_map]
  rw [← Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter]
  rw [Multiset.countP_filter]
  apply Multiset.countP_congr rfl
  intro p _
  apply propext
  simp [cutCell, minusCut, and_assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.finiteRips_rectangleContent_eq_count
statement:
private theorem finiteRips_rectangleContent_eq_count
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fintype X] (n : ℕ)
    (hTB : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X)) (a b c d : ℝ)
    (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) (hcd : c < d) :
    moduleRectangleContent
      (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
      (qTame_of_totallyBounded k hTB n) (rectangleCell a b c d) =
    (((diagram k X n).points.map diagramOccurrence).filter
      (· ∈ rectangleCell a b c d)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [moduleRectangleContent_apply _ _ a b c d hab hbc hcd]
  rw [finiteRips_persistenceMeasure_eq_rectangleCount k n a b c d hab hbc hcd]
  rw [Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.count_decEq_irrel
proof:
:= by
  have hdec : Classical.decEq α = (inferInstance : DecidableEq α) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hdec]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.finiteRips_essentialCutContent_eq_count
statement:
private theorem finiteRips_essentialCutContent_eq_count
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fintype X] (n : ℕ)
    (hTB : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X)) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    essentialCutContent
      (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
        (qTame_of_totallyBounded k hTB n)
      (cutCell a b) = (diagramEssentialBirths (diagram k X n)).countP
        (fun birth => birth ∈ cutCell a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [essentialCutContent_apply _ _ hab]
  rw [finiteRips_essentialMeasureValue_eq_essentialBirthCount k n hab]
  exact (diagramEssentialBirths_count_cell (diagram k X n) a b).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.finiteRips_moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_occurrenceCount
statement:
private theorem finiteRips_moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_occurrenceCount
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fintype X] (n : ℕ)
    (hTB : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X)) (p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ)
    (hpInf : p.2 ≠ infinityCut) :
    moduleDiagramMultiplicity
        (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
        (qTame_of_totallyBounded k hTB n) p =
      ((diagram k X n).points.map diagramOccurrence).count p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)
  let M := sublevelModule k f n
  let hQ := qTame_of_totallyBounded (X := X) k hTB n
  let D := diagram k X n
  let points := D.points.map diagramOccurrence
  by_cases hVis : ∃ U ∈ separatedRectangleCells, p ∈ U
  · obtain ⟨K, hK, hpK⟩ := hVis
    rcases hK with rfl | ⟨a, b, c, d, hab, hbc, hcd, rfl⟩
    · exact hpK.elim
    · change contentMultiplicity (moduleRectangleContent M hQ) p = points.count p
      have hrepr : ∀ U ∈ separatedRectangleCells, U ⊆ rectangleCell a b c d →
          moduleRectangleContent M hQ U = (points.filter (· ∈ U)).card := by
        intro U hU hUK
        rcases hU with rfl | ⟨a', b', c', d', ha'b', hb'c', hc'd', rfl⟩
        · simp
        · exact finiteRips_rectangleContent_eq_count k n hTB a' b' c' d'
            ha'b' hb'c' hc'd'
      have hcount := contentMultiplicity_eq_count isSetSemiring_separatedRectangleCells
        (fun q hpq => exists_rectangleCell_separating hpq hbc hpK)
        (moduleRectangleContent M hQ) (rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells a b c d hbc)
        points hrepr hpK
      exact hcount.trans (count_decEq_irrel p points)
  · have hzero := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_zero_of_not_visible M hQ p hVis
    rw [hzero]
    apply Eq.symm
    apply Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr
    intro hp
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hp
    rcases q with ⟨birth, death⟩
    cases death with
    | top =>
        have htop : p.2 = infinityCut := by
          rw [← hqp]
          simp [diagramOccurrence]
        exact hpInf htop
    | coe d =>
        have hbirth : birth < d :=
          WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp ((diagram_isPositive k X n) (birth, (d : WithTop ℝ)) hq)
        let c := (birth + d) / 2
        have hmidlow : (birth + d) / 2 < d := by linarith
        have hmidhigh : d ≤ d + 1 := by linarith
        have hcell : diagramOccurrence (birth, (d : WithTop ℝ)) ∈
            rectangleCell (birth - 1) birth c (d + 1) := by
          apply (diagramOccurrence_mem_rectangleCell
            (birth, (d : WithTop ℝ)) (birth - 1) birth c (d + 1)).2
          exact ⟨by linarith, le_rfl, WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (by simpa [c] using hmidlow),
            WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr hmidhigh⟩
        have hpCell := hqp ▸ hcell
        have hsep := rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells
          (birth - 1) birth c (d + 1) (by dsimp [c]; linarith)
        exact hVis ⟨_, hsep, hpCell⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.finiteRips_moduleEssentialMultiplicity_eq_birthCount
statement:
private theorem finiteRips_moduleEssentialMultiplicity_eq_birthCount
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fintype X] (n : ℕ)
    (hTB : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X)) (birth : Cut ℝ) :
    moduleEssentialMultiplicity
        (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
        (qTame_of_totallyBounded k hTB n) birth =
      (diagramEssentialBirths (diagram k X n)).count birth
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)
  let M := sublevelModule k f n
  let hQ := qTame_of_totallyBounded (X := X) k hTB n
  let D := diagram k X n
  let points := diagramEssentialBirths D
  by_cases hVis : ∃ U ∈ cutCells, birth ∈ U
  · obtain ⟨K, hK, hbK⟩ := hVis
    obtain ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := hK
    change contentMultiplicity (essentialCutContent M hQ) birth = points.count birth
    refine contentMultiplicity_eq_count isSetSemiring_cutCells
      (fun y hby => by
        obtain ⟨a', b', _, _, hb', hy'⟩ := exists_subcell_separating_cuts hby hbK
        exact ⟨cutCell a' b', cutCell_mem_cutCells a' b', hb', hy'⟩)
      (essentialCutContent M hQ) (cutCell_mem_cutCells a b) points ?_ hbK
    intro U hU hUK
    obtain ⟨a', b', hab', rfl⟩ := hU
    rw [finiteRips_essentialCutContent_eq_count k n hTB a' b' hab']
    rw [Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter]
  ·
    have hzero' : moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hQ birth = 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      have hpos : 0 < moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hQ birth := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn
      obtain ⟨U, hU, hbU⟩ := moduleEssentialMultiplicity_visible_of_pos M hQ hpos
      exact hVis ⟨U, hU, hbU⟩
    rw [hzero']
    apply Eq.symm
    apply Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr
    intro hb
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqBirth⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hb
    rcases q with ⟨x, death⟩
    have hbirthEq : minusCut x = birth := hqBirth
    have hxCell : minusCut x ∈ cutCell (x - 1) x := by
      simp [cutCell, minusCut]
    exact hVis ⟨cutCell (x - 1) x, cutCell_mem_cutCells _ _, by
      rw [← hbirthEq]
      exact hxCell⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.diagramOccurrence_infinity_count
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Multiset.count_map, diagramEssentialBirths, Multiset.count_map]
  rw [Multiset.filter_filter]
  congr 1
  apply Multiset.filter_congr
  intro p _
  rcases p with ⟨x, death⟩
  cases death with
  | top =>
      simp [diagramOccurrence, and_comm]
  | coe d =>
      simp [diagramOccurrence]
      intro _ hEq
      have hdTop : d ∈ infinityCut.lower := by simp
      rw [hEq] at hdTop
      simp [minusCut] at hdTop

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTameDiagramMultiplicity_eq_diagramOccurrenceCount
statement:
theorem qTameDiagramMultiplicity_eq_diagramOccurrenceCount
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fintype X] (n : ℕ) (p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) :
    qTameDiagramMultiplicity k (Set.finite_univ.totallyBounded :
      TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X)) n p =
      ((diagram k X n).points.map diagramOccurrence).count p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hTB : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X) := Set.finite_univ.totallyBounded
  by_cases hInf : p.2 = infinityCut
  · have hess := finiteRips_moduleEssentialMultiplicity_eq_birthCount k n hTB p.1
    have hmap := diagramOccurrence_infinity_count (diagram k X n) p.1
    have hpEq : p = (p.1, infinityCut) := Prod.ext rfl hInf
    simp only [qTameDiagramMultiplicity, moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity, if_pos hInf]
    rw [hess]
    rw [hpEq.symm] at hmap
    simpa only [count_decEq_irrel] using hmap.symm
  · simp only [qTameDiagramMultiplicity, moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity, if_neg hInf]
    exact finiteRips_moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_occurrenceCount k n hTB p hInf

name: TDA.Persistence.LocalFiniteExamples.locallyFinite_family_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem locallyFinite_family_finiteDimensional {k : Type*} [Field k] {J : Type}
    (S : J → Set ℝ) (hS : ∀ j, (S j).OrdConnected)
    (hlocal : ∀ t : ℝ, {j : J | t ∈ S j}.Finite) (t : ℝ) :
    FiniteDimensional k ((AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
      (fun j => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S j) (hS j))).obj t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V : Set J := {j | t ∈ S j}
  letI : Fintype V := (hlocal t).fintype
  let Fv : V → PModule.{_,0,_} k ℝ :=
    fun j => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S j.val) (hS j.val)
  have hprod : FiniteDimensional k ((RealBarcode.familyModule Fv).obj t) := by
    change FiniteDimensional k (∀ j : V, SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) (S j.val) t)
    infer_instance
  have hfinite : FiniteDimensional k ((AlgebraicFamily.familyModule Fv).obj t) := by
    exact Module.Finite.equiv ((AlgebraicFamily.finiteProductIso Fv).app t).toLinearEquiv.symm
  let c := oneSample t
  have hcover (j : J) : (∃ i : Fin 1, c i ∈ S j) → j ∈ V := by
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    exact hi
  let e := FiniteObservation.visibleFamilyIso (k := k) c S hS V hcover
  change FiniteDimensional k
    ((reindex c.toOrderHom (AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
      (fun j => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S j) (hS j)))).obj 0)
  exact Module.Finite.equiv ((e.app 0).toLinearEquiv.symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.LocalFiniteExamples.accumulatingFamily_nonzero_at_endpoint
statement:
theorem accumulatingFamily_nonzero_at_endpoint (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ y : accumulatingFamily.obj (RealIntervalExamples.endpoint n), y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℕ → PModule ℚ ℝ := fun j => SupportInterval.module (k := ℚ)
    (RealIntervalExamples.accumulatingInterval j) (accumulatingOrdConnected j)
  let x : (F n).obj (RealIntervalExamples.endpoint n) :=
    SupportInterval.one (k := ℚ) (RealIntervalExamples.accumulatingInterval n)
      (RealIntervalExamples.occurrence_point_lies_in_interval n)
  let y : accumulatingFamily.obj (RealIntervalExamples.endpoint n) :=
    ((AlgebraicFamily.inclusion F n).app (RealIntervalExamples.endpoint n)).hom x
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  intro hy
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro he
    have hv := congrArg (fun z : SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ)
      (RealIntervalExamples.accumulatingInterval n)
      (RealIntervalExamples.endpoint n) => (z : ℚ)) he
    simp [x, SupportInterval.one] at hv
  have hc := congrArg (DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ
    (fun j => (F j).obj (RealIntervalExamples.endpoint n)) n) hy
  change DirectSum.component ℚ ℕ
    (fun j => (F j).obj (RealIntervalExamples.endpoint n)) n
      (((AlgebraicFamily.inclusion F n).app
        (RealIntervalExamples.endpoint n)).hom x) = 0 at hc
  rw [AlgebraicFamily.inclusion_apply_self] at hc
  exact hx hc

  · change (∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 0, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc 1 2,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger (identityTransitionDiagram k) x y) = 0
    rw [show Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) 0 = ∅ by decide]

      moduleMultiplicityInteger (zeroTransitionDiagram k) x y) = 0
    rw [show Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) 0 = ∅ by decide]

  · change (∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc 0 0, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 0,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger (identityTransitionDiagram k) x y) = 0
    simp
  · change (∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc 0 0, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 0,

name: TDA.Persistence.mixedIntegerFromNatural
statement:
private theorem mixedIntegerFromNatural {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (b d n : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ 4)
    (hn : barcodeMultiplicity
      (rankBarcode (reindex mixedSample (barcodeModule (k := k) mixedSource))) b d = n) :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger
      (reindex mixedSample (barcodeModule (k := k) mixedSource)) b d = (n : ℤ) ∧
    (let A := if b = 0 then 0 else (mixedSample ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val + 1
     let B := (mixedSample ⟨b, by omega⟩).val
     let C := (mixedSample ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩).val
     let D := if hdN : d < 4 then (mixedSample ⟨d, hdN⟩).val else 6
     ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc A B, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc C D,
       moduleMultiplicityInteger (barcodeModule (k := k) mixedSource) x y) = (n : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcast := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode
    (reindex mixedSample (barcodeModule (k := k) mixedSource)) b d hbd hd
  rw [hn] at hcast
  have hdiagram := hcast.symm
  have hrectangle := moduleMultiplicityInteger_reindex
    (barcodeModule (k := k) mixedSource) mixedSample b d hbd hd
  exact ⟨hdiagram, hrectangle.symm.trans hdiagram⟩

  have hself := moduleRankInteger_fin M (0 : Fin 1) (0 : Fin 1) (le_refl _)
  have hr : structureMapRank M (0 : Fin 1) 0 (le_refl _) =
      Module.finrank k (M.obj 0) := by

  norm_num only

statement:
theorem twoStageValues (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2))
    [∀ i : Fin 2, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger M 0 1 =
      (Module.finrank k (M.obj (0 : Fin 2)) : ℤ) -
        structureMapRank M 0 1 (by decide) ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger M 0 2 =
      (structureMapRank M 0 1 (by decide) : ℤ) ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger M 1 2 =
      (Module.finrank k (M.obj (1 : Fin 2)) : ℤ) -
        structureMapRank M 0 1 (by decide)
proof:
:= by
  have h00 := moduleRankInteger_fin M (0 : Fin 2) 0 (le_refl _)
  have h01 := moduleRankInteger_fin M (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by decide)
  have h11 := moduleRankInteger_fin M (1 : Fin 2) 1 (le_refl _)
  have h0 : structureMapRank M 0 0 (le_refl (0 : Fin 2)) =
      Module.finrank k (M.obj 0) := by
    unfold structureMapRank
    rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
  have h1 : structureMapRank M 1 1 (le_refl (1 : Fin 2)) =
      Module.finrank k (M.obj 1) := by
    unfold structureMapRank
    rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
  simp only [moduleMultiplicityInteger, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  norm_num only
  simp only [moduleRankInteger_neg_one]
  rw [show moduleRankInteger M 0 2 = 0 from moduleRankInteger_at_size M 0,
    show moduleRankInteger M 1 2 = 0 from moduleRankInteger_at_size M 1]
  change moduleRankInteger M 0 0 = _ at h00
  change moduleRankInteger M 0 1 = _ at h01
  change moduleRankInteger M 1 1 = _ at h11
  rw [h00, h01, h11, h0, h1]
  constructor
  · ring
  · constructor <;> ring

name: TDA.Persistence.RankExampleFixtures.identityTwoStageRanks
statement:
theorem identityTwoStageRanks :
    structureMapRank (identityTransitionDiagram k) 0 1 (by decide) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k)) = 1
  rw [LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
  exact Module.finrank_self k

name: TDA.Persistence.RankExampleFixtures.zeroTwoStageRanks
statement:
theorem zeroTwoStageRanks :
    structureMapRank (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 0 1 (by decide) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (0 : k →ₗ[k] k)) = 0
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.RankExampleFixtures.identityTwoStage
statement:
theorem identityTwoStage :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (identityTransitionDiagram k) 0 1 = 0 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (identityTransitionDiagram k) 0 2 = 1 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (identityTransitionDiagram k) 1 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := twoStageValues (identityTransitionDiagram k)
  rw [identityTwoStageRanks] at h
  simpa only [show Module.finrank k ((identityTransitionDiagram k).obj (0 : Fin 2)) = 1
      from Module.finrank_self k,
    show Module.finrank k ((identityTransitionDiagram k).obj (1 : Fin 2)) = 1
      from Module.finrank_self k, Nat.cast_one, sub_self] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.RankExampleFixtures.zeroTwoStage
statement:
theorem zeroTwoStage :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 0 1 = 1 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 0 2 = 0 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 1 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := twoStageValues (zeroTransitionDiagram k)
  rw [zeroTwoStageRanks] at h
  simpa only [show Module.finrank k ((zeroTransitionDiagram k).obj (0 : Fin 2)) = 1
      from Module.finrank_self k,
    show Module.finrank k ((zeroTransitionDiagram k).obj (1 : Fin 2)) = 1
      from Module.finrank_self k, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero, sub_zero] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.threeStageValues
statement:
private theorem threeStageValues (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 3))
    [∀ i : Fin 3, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger M 1 2 =
      (structureMapRank M 1 1 (by decide) : ℤ) -
      structureMapRank M 0 1 (by decide) -
      structureMapRank M 1 2 (by decide) +
      structureMapRank M 0 2 (by decide) ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger M 0 2 =
      (structureMapRank M 0 1 (by decide) : ℤ) -
      structureMapRank M 0 2 (by decide)
proof:
:= by
  have h01 := moduleRankInteger_fin M (0 : Fin 3) 1 (by decide)
  have h02 := moduleRankInteger_fin M (0 : Fin 3) 2 (by decide)
  have h11 := moduleRankInteger_fin M (1 : Fin 3) 1 (by decide)
  have h12 := moduleRankInteger_fin M (1 : Fin 3) 2 (by decide)
  simp only [moduleMultiplicityInteger, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_ofNat]
  norm_num only
  simp only [moduleRankInteger_neg_one]
  change moduleRankInteger M 0 1 = _ at h01
  change moduleRankInteger M 0 2 = _ at h02
  change moduleRankInteger M 1 1 = _ at h11
  change moduleRankInteger M 1 2 = _ at h12
  rw [h01, h02, h11, h12]
  constructor <;> ring

name: TDA.Persistence.threeRank02First

name: TDA.Persistence.threeRank02Second

name: TDA.Persistence.threeStageFirst
statement:
private theorem threeStageFirst :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger
      (threeStageDiagram (includeFirst (k := k)) (projectFirst (k := k))) 1 2 = 1 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger
      (threeStageDiagram (includeFirst (k := k)) (projectFirst (k := k))) 0 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := threeStageValues
    (threeStageDiagram (includeFirst (k := k)) (projectFirst (k := k)))
  rw [threeRank11, threeRank01, threeRank12First, threeRank02First] at h
  norm_num at h

name: TDA.Persistence.threeStageSecond
statement:
private theorem threeStageSecond :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger

proof:

    (threeStageDiagram (includeFirst (k := k)) (projectSecond (k := k)))
  rw [threeRank11, threeRank01, threeRank12Second, threeRank02Second] at h
