name: TDA.Persistence.firstRestrictedKernel
statement:
private theorem firstRestrictedKernel :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
      ((structureMapLinear
        (threeStageDiagram (includeFirst (k := k)) (projectFirst (k := k)))
        (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 2 by decide)).comp
        (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear
          (threeStageDiagram (includeFirst (k := k)) (projectFirst (k := k)))
          (show (0 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 by decide))).subtype)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let M := threeStageDiagram (includeFirst (k := k)) (projectFirst (k := k))
  have h := structureMapRank_drop M (0 : Fin 3) 1 2 (by decide) (by decide)
  rw [threeRank01, threeRank02First] at h
  change 1 = 1 + Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
    ((structureMapLinear M (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 2 by decide)).comp
      (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M (show (0 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 by decide))).subtype)) at h
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
    ((structureMapLinear M (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 2 by decide)).comp
      (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M (show (0 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 by decide))).subtype)) = 0
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.firstFullKernel
statement:
private theorem firstFullKernel :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
      ((structureMapLinear
        (threeStageDiagram (includeFirst (k := k)) (projectFirst (k := k)))
        (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 2 by decide)).comp
        (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear
          (threeStageDiagram (includeFirst (k := k)) (projectFirst (k := k)))
          (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 by decide))).subtype)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let M := threeStageDiagram (includeFirst (k := k)) (projectFirst (k := k))
  have h := structureMapRank_drop M (1 : Fin 3) 1 2 (by decide) (by decide)
  rw [threeRank11, threeRank12First] at h
  change 2 = 1 + Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
    ((structureMapLinear M (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 2 by decide)).comp
      (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 by decide))).subtype)) at h
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
    ((structureMapLinear M (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 2 by decide)).comp
      (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 by decide))).subtype)) = 1
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.secondRestrictedKernel
statement:
private theorem secondRestrictedKernel :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
      ((structureMapLinear
        (threeStageDiagram (includeFirst (k := k)) (projectSecond (k := k)))
        (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 2 by decide)).comp
        (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear
          (threeStageDiagram (includeFirst (k := k)) (projectSecond (k := k)))
          (show (0 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 by decide))).subtype)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let M := threeStageDiagram (includeFirst (k := k)) (projectSecond (k := k))
  have h := structureMapRank_drop M (0 : Fin 3) 1 2 (by decide) (by decide)
  rw [threeRank01, threeRank02Second] at h
  change 1 = 0 + Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
    ((structureMapLinear M (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 2 by decide)).comp
      (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M (show (0 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 by decide))).subtype)) at h
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker
    ((structureMapLinear M (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 2 by decide)).comp
      (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M (show (0 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 by decide))).subtype)) = 1
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.exists_subcell_separating_cuts
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ t, (t ∈ x.lower ∧ t ∉ y.lower) ∨ (t ∈ y.lower ∧ t ∉ x.lower) := by
    by_contra hn
    apply hxy
    apply cut_eq_of_lower_eq
    ext t
    constructor
    · intro ht
      by_contra ht'
      exact hn ⟨t, Or.inl ⟨ht, ht'⟩⟩
    · intro ht
      by_contra ht'
      exact hn ⟨t, Or.inr ⟨ht, ht'⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht | ht⟩ := hex
  · refine ⟨max a t, b, le_max_left _ _, le_rfl, ⟨?_, hx.2⟩, ?_⟩
    · rcases le_total a t with hat | hta
      · simpa only [max_eq_right hat] using ht.1
      · simpa only [max_eq_left hta] using hx.1
    · exact fun hy => ht.2 (Cut.lower_of_le (le_max_right _ _) hy.1)
  · have htx : t ∈ x.upper := (x.mem_lower_or_upper t).resolve_left ht.2
    refine ⟨a, min b t, le_rfl, min_le_left _ _, ⟨hx.1, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · rcases le_total b t with hbt | htb
      · simpa only [min_eq_left hbt] using hx.2
      · simpa only [min_eq_right htb] using htx
    · exact fun hy => Cut.not_mem_upper ht.1 (Cut.upper_of_le (min_le_right _ _) hy.2)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.exists_rectangleCell_separating
statement:
theorem exists_rectangleCell_separating {p q : Cut α × Cut α} (hpq : p ≠ q)
    {a b c d : α} (hbc : b < c) (hp : p ∈ rectangleCell a b c d) :
    ∃ U ∈ separatedRectangleCells, p ∈ U ∧ q ∉ U
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hfst : p.1 = q.1
  · have hsnd : p.2 ≠ q.2 := fun h => hpq (Prod.ext hfst h)
    obtain ⟨c', d', hcc', _, hp', hq'⟩ := exists_subcell_separating_cuts hsnd hp.2
    refine ⟨rectangleCell a b c' d', rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells _ _ _ _
      (hbc.trans_le hcc'), ⟨hp.1, hp'⟩, ?_⟩
    exact fun hq => hq' hq.2
  · obtain ⟨a', b', _, hb'b, hp', hq'⟩ := exists_subcell_separating_cuts hfst hp.1
    refine ⟨rectangleCell a' b' c d, rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells _ _ _ _
      (hb'b.trans_lt hbc), ⟨hp', hp.2⟩, ?_⟩
    exact fun hq => hq' hq.1

name: TDA.Persistence.MulticoverExamples.incomparable_pair_mem_cover_nerve
statement:
theorem incomparable_pair_mem_cover_nerve :
    incomparablePair ∈ TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover points halfIndex)
proof:
:= by
  apply (mem_largeFaceNerve_iff points halfIndex incomparablePair).2
  refine ⟨by simp [incomparablePair], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s hs
    simp only [incomparablePair, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hs
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl
    all_goals
      constructor
      · refine ⟨by simp, (0 : ℝ), ?_⟩
        intro v hv
        simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
        subst v
        norm_num [points, halfIndex, radius]
      · norm_num [halfIndex, mass]
  · refine ⟨?_, (0 : ℝ), ?_⟩
    · simp [incomparablePair]
    · intro v hv
      fin_cases v <;> norm_num [points, halfIndex, radius]

    ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) (by simp [incomparablePair])
  rcases hc with h | h
  · have := h (by simp : (0 : Fin 2) ∈ ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)))
    norm_num at this
  · have := h (by simp : (1 : Fin 2) ∈ ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)))
    norm_num at this

    rw [cut_upper_eq_compl, cut_upper_eq_compl, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cutOfLowerSet_cutLowerSet
statement:
@[simp] theorem cutOfLowerSet_cutLowerSet (c : Cut α) :
    cutOfLowerSet (cutLowerSet c) = c
proof:
:=
  cut_eq_of_lower_eq rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cutLowerSet_minusCut
statement:
@[simp] theorem cutLowerSet_minusCut (a : α) :
    cutLowerSet (minusCut a) = LowerSet.Iio a
proof:
:= by
  apply LowerSet.ext
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cutLowerSet_plusCut
statement:
@[simp] theorem cutLowerSet_plusCut (a : α) :
    cutLowerSet (plusCut a) = LowerSet.Iic a
proof:
:= by
  apply LowerSet.ext
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.lt_of_mem_cutCell
statement: theorem lt_of_mem_cutCell {a b : α} {c : Cut α} (hc : c ∈ cutCell a b) : a < b
proof:
:=
  c.lower_lt_upper hc.1 hc.2

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.image_cutCell_eq_Icc
statement:
theorem image_cutCell_eq_Icc (a b : α) :
    cutLowerSet '' cutCell a b = Icc (LowerSet.Iic a) (LowerSet.Iio b)
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · exact LowerSet.Iic_le.mpr hc.1
    · intro t ht
      exact c.lower_lt_upper ht hc.2
  · intro hs
    refine ⟨cutOfLowerSet s, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, cutLowerSet_cutOfLowerSet s⟩
    · exact LowerSet.Iic_le.mp hs.1
    · intro hb
      exact lt_irrefl b (hs.2 hb)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.iio_lt_iic
statement: private theorem iio_lt_iic (a : α) : LowerSet.Iio a < LowerSet.Iic a
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_not_ge
  · intro t ht
    exact ht.le
  · intro h
    have ha : a < a := h (show a ∈ LowerSet.Iic a from le_rfl)
    exact lt_irrefl a ha

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.image_cutCell_eq_Ioo
statement:
theorem image_cutCell_eq_Ioo (a b : α) :
    cutLowerSet '' cutCell a b = Ioo (LowerSet.Iio a) (LowerSet.Iic b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [image_cutCell_eq_Icc]
  ext s
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩
    constructor
    · exact (iio_lt_iic a).trans_le ha
    · exact hb.trans_lt (iio_lt_iic b)
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩
    constructor
    · apply LowerSet.Iic_le.mpr
      by_contra h
      have hs : s ≤ LowerSet.Iio a := by
        intro t ht
        exact lt_of_not_ge fun hat => h (s.lower hat ht)
      exact (not_le_of_gt ha) hs
    · intro t ht
      by_contra h
      have hbt : b ≤ t := le_of_not_gt h
      have hb' : b ∈ s := s.lower hbt ht
      exact (not_le_of_gt hb) (LowerSet.Iic_le.mpr hb')

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.isCompact_image_cutCell
statement:
theorem isCompact_image_cutCell [TopologicalSpace (LowerSet α)]
    [OrderTopology (LowerSet α)] (a b : α) :
    IsCompact (cutLowerSet '' cutCell a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [image_cutCell_eq_Icc]
  exact isCompact_Icc

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.isOpen_image_cutCell
statement:
theorem isOpen_image_cutCell [TopologicalSpace (LowerSet α)]
    [OrderTopology (LowerSet α)] (a b : α) :
    IsOpen (cutLowerSet '' cutCell a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [image_cutCell_eq_Ioo]
  exact isOpen_Ioo

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.empty_values
statement:
private theorem empty_values (V : Type u) (α : Type w) [LinearOrder α] :
    (emptyFilter V α).criticalValues.card = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [((emptyFilter V α).criticalValues_eq_empty_iff).2 rfl]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.empty_points
statement:
private theorem empty_points (V : Type u) [LinearOrder V]
    (α : Type w) [LinearOrder α] (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    (dgm k (emptyFilter V α) n).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hi : IsEmpty (Fin (emptyFilter V α).criticalValues.card) := by
    rw [empty_values]
    infer_instance
  letI := hi
  simp [dgm, gradeHomologyBarcode, rankBarcode, ofIndexBars]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.empty_rank
statement:
private theorem empty_rank (V : Type u) [LinearOrder V]
    (α : Type w) [LinearOrder α] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (n : ℕ) (r s : α) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl k ((emptyFilter V α).sublevel_mono hrs) n).hom) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rank_sublevelHomologyMap k (emptyFilter V α) n r s hrs,
    empty_points]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.empty_rank_count
statement:
private theorem empty_rank_count (V : Type u) [LinearOrder V]
    (α : Type w) [LinearOrder α] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (n : ℕ) (r s : α) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl k ((emptyFilter V α).sublevel_mono hrs) n).hom) =
      (dgm k (emptyFilter V α) n).points.countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ r ∧ (s : WithTop α) < p.2)
proof:
:=
  rank_sublevelHomologyMap k (emptyFilter V α) n r s hrs

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.empty_real_all_degrees
statement:
private theorem empty_real_all_degrees (n : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        ((emptyFilter (Fin 2) ℝ).sublevel_mono (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)) n).hom) = 0
proof:
:=
  empty_rank (Fin 2) ℝ (ZMod 2) n 0 1 (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.empty_value_type_points
statement:
private theorem empty_value_type_points (V : Type u) [LinearOrder V]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    (dgm k (emptyFilter V Empty) n).points = 0
proof:
:=
  empty_points V Empty k n

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.grade_consumer
statement:
private theorem grade_consumer {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {α : Type w} [LinearOrder α]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} [Fintype (TotalFace K)]
    (f : FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ)
    (i j : Fin f.criticalValues.card) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.gradeFiltration.monotone hij) n).hom) =
    (dgm k f n).points.countP
      (fun p => p.1 ≤ f.criticalValue i ∧
        (f.criticalValue j : WithTop α) < p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have transport {A B A' B' : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
      (hA : A = A') (hB : B = B') (h : A ≤ B) (h' : A' ≤ B') :
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k h n).hom) =
        Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k h' n).hom) := by
    subst A'
    subst B'
    rfl
  exact (transport (f.gradeFiltration_apply i) (f.gradeFiltration_apply j)
    (f.gradeFiltration.monotone hij)
    (f.sublevel_mono (f.criticalValue.monotone hij))).trans
      (rank_sublevelHomologyMap k f n (f.criticalValue i) (f.criticalValue j)
        (f.criticalValue.monotone hij))

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.iso_consumer
statement:
private theorem iso_consumer {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {α : Type w} [LinearOrder α]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} [Fintype (TotalFace K)]
    (f : FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval f.criticalValues.card))
    (e : simplicialHomologyPModule k f.gradeFiltration n ≅
      barcodeModule (k := k) B) :
    dgm k f n = ofIndexBars f.criticalValue f.criticalValue.strictMono B
proof:
:=
  dgm_eq_ofIndexBars_of_iso k f n B e

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.finite_multiplicity_consumer
statement:
private theorem finite_multiplicity_consumer {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {α : Type w} [LinearOrder α]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} [Fintype (TotalFace K)]
    (f : FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ)
    (b d : Fin f.criticalValues.card) (hbd : b < d) :
    ((dgm k f n).points.count
      (f.criticalValue b, (f.criticalValue d : WithTop α)) : ℤ) =
      moduleMultiplicityInteger
        (simplicialHomologyPModule k f.gradeFiltration n) b.val d.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [dgm, ofIndexBars_count_finite]
  exact barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode
    (simplicialHomologyPModule k f.gradeFiltration n)
    b.val d.val hbd (Nat.le_of_lt d.isLt)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.essential_multiplicity_consumer
statement:
private theorem essential_multiplicity_consumer {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {α : Type w} [LinearOrder α]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} [Fintype (TotalFace K)]
    (f : FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ)
    (b : Fin f.criticalValues.card) :
    ((dgm k f n).points.count
      (f.criticalValue b, (⊤ : WithTop α)) : ℤ) =
      moduleMultiplicityInteger
        (simplicialHomologyPModule k f.gradeFiltration n)
        b.val f.criticalValues.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [dgm, ofIndexBars_count_essential]
  exact barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode
    (simplicialHomologyPModule k f.gradeFiltration n)
    b.val f.criticalValues.card b.isLt le_rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.diagonal_zero_consumer
statement:
private theorem diagonal_zero_consumer {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {α : Type w} [LinearOrder α]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} [Fintype (TotalFace K)]
    (f : FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ)
    (b : Fin f.criticalValues.card) :
    (dgm k f n).points.count
      (f.criticalValue b, (f.criticalValue b : WithTop α)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dgm, ofIndexBars_count_finite]
  apply Multiset.countP_eq_zero.mpr
  intro I _ h
  exact (ne_of_lt I.birth_lt_death) (h.1.trans h.2.symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.empty_iso_consumer
statement:
private theorem empty_iso_consumer (V : Type u) [LinearOrder V]
    (α : Type w) [LinearOrder α] (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    dgm k (emptyFilter V α) n =
      ofIndexBars (emptyFilter V α).criticalValue
        (emptyFilter V α).criticalValue.strictMono
        (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval (emptyFilter V α).criticalValues.card))
proof:
:= by
  have hi : IsEmpty (Fin (emptyFilter V α).criticalValues.card) := by
    rw [empty_values]
    infer_instance
  letI := hi
  have he : simplicialHomologyPModule k (emptyFilter V α).gradeFiltration n =
      barcodeModule (k := k)
        (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval (emptyFilter V α).criticalValues.card)) := by
    apply CategoryTheory.Functor.ext
    · intro i
      exact isEmptyElim i
    · intro i
      exact isEmptyElim i
  exact iso_consumer k (emptyFilter V α) n 0 (eqToIso he)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.reversed_zero_consumer
statement:
private theorem reversed_zero_consumer {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {α : Type w} [LinearOrder α]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} [Fintype (TotalFace K)]
    (f : FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ)
    (b d : Fin f.criticalValues.card) (hdb : d < b) :
    (dgm k f n).points.count
      (f.criticalValue b, (f.criticalValue d : WithTop α)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dgm, ofIndexBars_count_finite]
  apply Multiset.countP_eq_zero.mpr
  intro I _ h
  have hbd := I.birth_lt_death
  rw [h.1, h.2] at hbd
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (Nat.le_of_lt hdb)) hbd

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_values
statement:
private theorem singleton_values (a : ℝ) :
    (singletonFilter a).criticalValues = {a}
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  constructor
  · intro hb
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := ((singletonFilter a).mem_criticalValues b).1 hb
    exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr (by simpa [singletonFilter] using hσ.symm)
  · intro hb
    have hface : ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) := by
      exact (mem_singletonFace_iff _ _).2 rfl
    have hb' : b = a := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hb
    subst b
    exact ((singletonFilter a).mem_criticalValues a).2 ⟨⟨{0}, hface⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_card
statement:
private theorem singleton_card (a : ℝ) :
    (singletonFilter a).criticalValues.card = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [singleton_values]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_critical
statement:
private theorem singleton_critical (a : ℝ) :
    (singletonFilter a).criticalValue (singleton_i a) = a
proof:
:= by
  have h := (singletonFilter a).criticalValue_mem (singleton_i a)
  simpa [singleton_values] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_stage
statement:
private theorem singleton_stage (a : ℝ) :
    (singletonFilter a).gradeFiltration (singleton_i a) = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(singletonFilter a).gradeFiltration_apply, singleton_critical]
  apply (singletonFilter a).sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
  intro s
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_h0
statement:
private theorem singleton_h0 (a : ℝ) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      ((simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2)
        (singletonFilter a).gradeFiltration 0).obj (singleton_i a)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplicialHomologyPModule_obj, singleton_stage]
  exact (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv (ZMod 2) (0 : Fin 2)).finrank_eq.trans
    (Module.finrank_self (ZMod 2))

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_barcode
statement:
private theorem singleton_barcode (a : ℝ) :
    gradeHomologyBarcode (ZMod 2) (singletonFilter a) 0 =
      ({singleton_bar a} :
        Multiset (FiniteInterval (singletonFilter a).criticalValues.card))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    gradeHomologyBarcode (ZMod 2) (singletonFilter a) 0 =
        rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ZMod 2)
          ({singleton_bar a} :
            Multiset (FiniteInterval (singletonFilter a).criticalValues.card))) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff
        (simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2) (singletonFilter a).gradeFiltration 0)
        (barcodeModule (k := ZMod 2)
          ({singleton_bar a} :
            Multiset (FiniteInterval (singletonFilter a).criticalValues.card)))).mpr
      intro i j hij
      have hi : i = singleton_i a := by
        apply Fin.ext
        have hh := i.isLt
        have hc := singleton_card a
        omega
      have hj : j = singleton_i a := by
        apply Fin.ext
        have hh := j.isLt
        have hc := singleton_card a
        omega
      subst i
      subst j
      rw [rank_barcodeMap]
      have hr : structureMapRank
          (simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2) (singletonFilter a).gradeFiltration 0)
          (singleton_i a) (singleton_i a) hij = 1 := by
        unfold structureMapRank
        rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
        exact singleton_h0 a
      rw [hr]
      rw [show ({singleton_bar a} :
        Multiset (FiniteInterval (singletonFilter a).criticalValues.card)) =
          singleton_bar a ::ₘ 0 by rfl, Multiset.countP_cons]
      simp [singleton_bar, singleton_i]
    _ = _ := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_points
statement:
theorem singleton_points (a : ℝ) :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) (singletonFilter a) 0).points =
      ({(a, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))} : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dgm, singleton_barcode]
  simp [ofIndexBars, singleton_bar]
  change ((singletonFilter a).criticalValue (singleton_i a),
      if hd : 1 < (singletonFilter a).criticalValues.card then
        ((singletonFilter a).criticalValue ⟨1, hd⟩ : WithTop ℝ)
      else (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) = (a, ⊤)
  simp [singleton_card, singleton_critical]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_below
statement:
private theorem singleton_below (a r : ℝ) (hr : r < a) :
    (singletonFilter a).sublevel r = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply (singletonFilter a).sublevel_eq_bot_of_forall_lt
  intro σ
  simpa [singletonFilter] using hr

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_tail
statement:
private theorem singleton_tail (a r : ℝ) (hr : a ≤ r) :
    (singletonFilter a).sublevel r = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply (singletonFilter a).sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
  intro σ
  simpa [singletonFilter] using hr

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.same_complex_identity
statement:
private theorem same_complex_identity
    {A B C : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)}
    (hA : A = C) (hB : B = C) (h : A ≤ B) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) h 0 ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun D => simplicialHomology D (ZMod 2) 0) hB) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun D => simplicialHomology D (ZMod 2) 0) hA)
proof:
:= by
  subst A
  subst B
  simp [simplicialHomologyIncl_id]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_tail_identity
statement:
private theorem singleton_tail_identity (a r s : ℝ) (har : a ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        ((singletonFilter a).sublevel_mono hrs) 0 ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg
        (fun C => simplicialHomology C (ZMod 2) 0)
        (singleton_tail a s (har.trans hrs))) =
      eqToHom (congrArg
        (fun C => simplicialHomology C (ZMod 2) 0)
        (singleton_tail a r har))
proof:
:= by
  exact same_complex_identity (singleton_tail a r har)
    (singleton_tail a s (har.trans hrs)) _

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_below_rank
statement:
private theorem singleton_below_rank (a r s : ℝ) (hr : r < a) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        ((singletonFilter a).sublevel_mono hrs) 0).hom) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rank_sublevelHomologyMap (ZMod 2) (singletonFilter a) 0 r s hrs,
    singleton_points]
  rw [show ({(a, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))} : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ)) =
    (a, ⊤) ::ₘ 0 by rfl, Multiset.countP_cons]
  simp [not_le.mpr hr]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_tail_rank
statement:
private theorem singleton_tail_rank (a r s : ℝ) (har : a ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        ((singletonFilter a).sublevel_mono hrs) 0).hom) = 1 ∧
    (dgm (ZMod 2) (singletonFilter a) 0).points.countP
      (fun p => p.1 ≤ r ∧ (s : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (dgm (ZMod 2) (singletonFilter a) 0).points.countP
      (fun p => p.1 ≤ r ∧ (s : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) = 1 := by
    rw [singleton_points]
    rw [show ({(a, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))} : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ)) =
      (a, ⊤) ::ₘ 0 by rfl, Multiset.countP_cons]
    simp [har]
  exact ⟨(rank_sublevelHomologyMap (ZMod 2) (singletonFilter a) 0
    r s hrs).trans hc, hc⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_self_rank
statement:
private theorem singleton_self_rank (a : ℝ) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        ((singletonFilter a).sublevel_mono (le_refl a)) 0).hom) = 1
proof:
:=
  (singleton_tail_rank a a a le_rfl le_rfl).1

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_gap_tail
statement:
private theorem singleton_gap_tail (a : ℝ) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        ((singletonFilter a).sublevel_mono (show a + 1 ≤ a + 2 by linarith)) 0).hom) =
      1
proof:
:=
  (singleton_tail_rank a (a + 1) (a + 2) (by linarith) (by linarith)).1

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_diagonal_absent
proof:
:= by
  rw [singleton_points]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_face_cases
statement:
theorem edge_face_cases (s : TotalFace edgeK) :
    s.val = ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∨
    s.val = ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∨
    s.val = ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2))
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ t : Finset (Fin 2), t.Nonempty →
      t = ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∨ t = ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∨
      t = ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2)) := by decide
  exact h s.val s.property

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_values
statement:
private theorem edge_values :
    edgeFilter.value edge_v0 = 2 ∧
    edgeFilter.value edge_v1 = 5 ∧
    edgeFilter.value edge_e01 = 9
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [edgeFilter, edge_v0, edge_v1, edge_e01, Finset.ext_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_critical_set
statement:
private theorem edge_critical_set :
    edgeFilter.criticalValues = ({2, 5, 9} : Finset ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  constructor
  · intro hb
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (edgeFilter.mem_criticalValues b).1 hb
    rcases edge_face_cases σ with h | h | h <;>
      simp [edgeFilter, h, Finset.ext_iff] at hσ ⊢
    all_goals subst b <;> simp_all
  · intro hb
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hb
    rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact (edgeFilter.mem_criticalValues 2).2 ⟨edge_v0, edge_values.1⟩
    · exact (edgeFilter.mem_criticalValues 5).2 ⟨edge_v1, edge_values.2.1⟩
    · exact (edgeFilter.mem_criticalValues 9).2 ⟨edge_e01, edge_values.2.2⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_card
statement: private theorem edge_card : edgeFilter.criticalValues.card = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [edge_critical_set]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_critical
statement:
private theorem edge_critical :
    edgeFilter.criticalValue edge_i0 = 2 ∧
    edgeFilter.criticalValue edge_i1 = 5 ∧
    edgeFilter.criticalValue edge_i2 = 9
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := edgeFilter.criticalValue_mem edge_i0
  have h1 := edgeFilter.criticalValue_mem edge_i1
  have h2 := edgeFilter.criticalValue_mem edge_i2
  have h01 : edgeFilter.criticalValue edge_i0 < edgeFilter.criticalValue edge_i1 :=
    edgeFilter.criticalValue.strictMono (by apply Fin.lt_def.mpr; decide)
  have h12 : edgeFilter.criticalValue edge_i1 < edgeFilter.criticalValue edge_i2 :=
    edgeFilter.criticalValue.strictMono (by apply Fin.lt_def.mpr; decide)
  simp only [edge_critical_set, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h0 h1 h2
  rcases h0 with h0 | h0 | h0 <;>
    rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1 <;>
    rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2 <;>
    simp_all <;> linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_mem_sublevel
statement:
private theorem edge_mem_sublevel (r : ℝ) (s : Finset (Fin 2)) :
    s ∈ edgeFilter.sublevel r ↔
      (s = {0} ∧ (2 : ℝ) ≤ r) ∨
      (s = {1} ∧ (5 : ℝ) ≤ r) ∨
      (s = {0, 1} ∧ (9 : ℝ) ≤ r)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨hsK, hv⟩ := (edgeFilter.mem_sublevel_iff r s).1 hs
    rcases edge_face_cases (⟨s, hsK⟩ : TotalFace edgeK) with h | h | h
    · left
      refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      have hs : (⟨s, hsK⟩ : TotalFace edgeK) = edge_v0 := Subtype.ext h
      rw [hs, edge_values.1] at hv
      exact hv
    · right; left
      refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      have hs : (⟨s, hsK⟩ : TotalFace edgeK) = edge_v1 := Subtype.ext h
      rw [hs, edge_values.2.1] at hv
      exact hv
    · right; right
      refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      have hs : (⟨s, hsK⟩ : TotalFace edgeK) = edge_e01 := Subtype.ext h
      rw [hs, edge_values.2.2] at hv
      exact hv
  · rintro (⟨rfl, hr⟩ | ⟨rfl, hr⟩ | ⟨rfl, hr⟩)
    · exact (edgeFilter.mem_sublevel_iff r _).2
        ⟨edge_v0.property, by simpa [edgeFilter, edge_v0] using hr⟩
    · exact (edgeFilter.mem_sublevel_iff r _).2
        ⟨edge_v1.property, by simpa [edgeFilter, edge_v1, Finset.ext_iff] using hr⟩
    · exact (edgeFilter.mem_sublevel_iff r _).2
        ⟨edge_e01.property, by simpa [edgeFilter, edge_e01, Finset.ext_iff] using hr⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_below
statement:
private theorem edge_below (r : ℝ) (hr : r < 2) :
    edgeFilter.sublevel r = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply edgeFilter.sublevel_eq_bot_of_lt_first (by rw [edge_card]; decide) r
  change r < edgeFilter.criticalValue edge_i0
  rw [edge_critical.1]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_region0
statement:
private theorem edge_region0 (r : ℝ) (hlo : (2 : ℝ) ≤ r) (hhi : r < 5) :
    edgeFilter.sublevel r = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  change s ∈ edgeFilter.sublevel r ↔ s ∈ singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)
  rw [edge_mem_sublevel]
  have h9 : ¬ (9 : ℝ) ≤ r := by linarith
  simp [mem_singletonFace_iff, hlo, not_le.mpr hhi, h9]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_region1
statement:

  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ r := by linarith
  have h9 : ¬ (9 : ℝ) ≤ r := by linarith
  simp only [h2, hlo, h9, and_true, and_false, or_false]
  change (s = {0} ∨ s = {1}) ↔ (s = {0} ∨ s = {1})
  rfl

:= by
  apply edgeFilter.sublevel_eq_self_of_last_le
    (by rw [edge_card]; decide) r
  have hlast : (⟨edgeFilter.criticalValues.card - 1,
      Nat.sub_lt (show 0 < edgeFilter.criticalValues.card by rw [edge_card]; decide)
        (by decide)⟩ : Fin edgeFilter.criticalValues.card) = edge_i2 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    change edgeFilter.criticalValues.card - 1 = 2
    have hc := edge_card
    omega
  rw [hlast, edge_critical.2.2]
  exact hlo

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edgeTwo_zeroBoundaryNormalization
statement:
private theorem edgeTwo_zeroBoundaryNormalization :
    edgeTwoShort.moduleCatLeftHomologyData.π ≫
        edgeTwoShort.moduleCatHomologyIso.inv ≫
        (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros edgeTwoShort
          edgeTwo_short_f_zero edgeTwo_short_g_zero).homologyIso.hom =
      edgeTwoShort.moduleCatLeftHomologyData.i
proof:
:= by
  let S := edgeTwoShort
  change S.moduleCatLeftHomologyData.π ≫ S.moduleCatHomologyIso.inv ≫
    (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S
      edgeTwo_short_f_zero edgeTwo_short_g_zero).homologyIso.hom =
      S.moduleCatLeftHomologyData.i
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← S.moduleCatCyclesIso_inv_π]
  rw [Category.assoc,
    (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S
      edgeTwo_short_f_zero edgeTwo_short_g_zero).homologyπ_comp_homologyIso_hom]
  simp only [ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros_π]
  have hci : (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S
      edgeTwo_short_f_zero edgeTwo_short_g_zero).cyclesIso.hom =
      S.iCycles := by
    simpa [ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros] using
      (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S
        edgeTwo_short_f_zero edgeTwo_short_g_zero).cyclesIso_hom_comp_i
  rw [hci]
  exact S.moduleCatCyclesIso_inv_iCycles

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_boundaries_finrank
statement:
private theorem edge_boundaries_finrank :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialBoundaries edgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let S := (simplicialChainComplex edgeK (ZMod 2)).sc 0
  letI : FiniteDimensional (ZMod 2) (↑S.X₁) := by
    change FiniteDimensional (ZMod 2)
      (Chain edgeK (ZMod 2) ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev 0))
    rw [ChainComplex.prev]
    exact finiteDimensional_finsupp
  letI : FiniteDimensional (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range S.moduleCatToCycles) :=
    inferInstance
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (LinearMap.range S.moduleCatToCycles) := by
    apply Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
    let z : simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0 :=
      ⟨boundary edgeK (ZMod 2) 0 (Finsupp.single edge_face 1), by
        rw [simplicialCycles_zero]; trivial⟩
    have hz : z ∈ simplicialBoundaries edgeK (ZMod 2) 0 :=
      (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff (ZMod 2) edgeK 0 z).2
        ⟨Finsupp.single edge_face 1, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hz
    have hc : z = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hz
    apply edge_boundary_nonzero
    exact congrArg (fun t : simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0 =>
      (t : Chain edgeK (ZMod 2) 0)) hc
  have hle := LinearMap.finrank_range_le S.moduleCatToCycles
  have hdim := edge_chain1_finrank
  have hsource : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (↑S.X₁) = 1 := by
    change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (Chain edgeK (ZMod 2) ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev 0)) = 1
    rw [ChainComplex.prev]
    exact hdim
  rw [hsource] at hle
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range S.moduleCatToCycles) = 1
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_H0_stage2
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplicialHomologyPModule_obj, edge_stage2]
  letI : Finite (Face edgeK 0) := inferInstance
  letI : FiniteDimensional (ZMod 2) (Chain edgeK (ZMod 2) 0) :=
    finiteDimensional_finsupp
  letI : FiniteDimensional (ZMod 2) (simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0) :=
    inferInstance
  letI : HasQuotient (simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0)
      (Submodule (ZMod 2) (simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0)) :=
    Submodule.hasQuotient (R := ZMod 2) (M := simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0)
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
    ((simplicialChainComplex edgeK (ZMod 2)).homology 0) = 1
  rw [(homologyKernelQuotient.{0,0,0} (ZMod 2)
    (simplicialChainComplex edgeK (ZMod 2)) 0).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq]
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
    (simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0 ⧸ simplicialBoundaries edgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = 1
  have hq : Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0 ⧸ simplicialBoundaries edgeK (ZMod 2) 0) +
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialBoundaries edgeK (ZMod 2) 0) =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0) := by
    exact Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank _
  have hc : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = 2 := by
    rw [simplicialCycles_zero, finrank_top]
    exact edge_chain0_finrank
  have hb := edge_boundaries_finrank
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edgeTwo_coeffSum_coords
statement:
private theorem edgeTwo_coeffSum_coords
    (c : Chain edge_twoVertices (ZMod 2) 0) :
    edgeTwo_coeffSum c = c (edge_twoVertex 0) + c (edge_twoVertex 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add c d hc hd => simp [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hc, hd, add_add_add_comm]
  | single v a =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := edge_twoVertex_bijective.2 v
      fin_cases i
      · simp [edgeTwo_coeffSum, edge_twoVertex_ne]
      · simp [edgeTwo_coeffSum, edge_twoVertex_ne.symm]

  intro σ a
  have hσ : σ = edge_face := edge_face_unique σ
  subst σ
  change edge_coeffSum (boundary edgeK (ZMod 2) 0
      (Finsupp.single edge_face a)) = 0

proof:
:= by

  | zero => simp
  | add c d hc hd => simp [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hc, hd, add_add_add_comm]
  | single v a =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := edge_vertex_bijective.2 v

      · simp [edge_coeffSum_single, edge_vertex_ne.symm]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_chain_decompose
statement:
private theorem edge_chain_decompose (c : Chain edgeK (ZMod 2) 0) :
    c - Finsupp.single (edge_vertex 0) (edge_coeffSum c) =
      boundary edgeK (ZMod 2) 0
        (Finsupp.single edge_face (c (edge_vertex 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [edge_boundary]
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro v
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := edge_vertex_bijective.2 v
  fin_cases i
  · simp [edge_coeffSum_coords, edge_vertex_ne, edge_vertex_ne.symm,
      sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc]
    have htwo : c (edge_vertex 0) + c (edge_vertex 0) = 0 := by
      simpa [ZMod.neg_eq_self_mod_two] using
        (add_neg_cancel (c (edge_vertex 0)))
    rw [← add_assoc, htwo, zero_add]
  · simp [edge_vertex_ne, edge_vertex_ne.symm]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_vertex0_not_boundary
statement:
private theorem edge_vertex0_not_boundary :
    edge_vertex0_cycle ∉ simplicialBoundaries edgeK (ZMod 2) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
    (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff (ZMod 2) edgeK 0 edge_vertex0_cycle).1 hz
  have hs := congrArg edge_coeffSum hc
  have hzero := congrArg (fun f : Chain edgeK (ZMod 2) 1 →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2 => f c)
    edge_coeffSum_boundary
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hzero
  rw [hzero] at hs
  change 0 = edge_coeffSum (Finsupp.single (edge_vertex 0) 1) at hs
  rw [edge_coeffSum_single] at hs

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_vertex0_class_nonzero

    (HomologicalComplex.shortComplexFunctor _ _ 0).map
      (simplicialChainIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_two)
  have h := (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyMapData.ofZeros φ
    edgeOne_short_f_zero edgeOne_short_g_zero
    edgeTwo_short_f_zero edgeTwo_short_g_zero).homologyMap_comm
  have hx := congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) h
  change edgeTwoH0Equiv
      ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_two 0).hom x) =
    chainIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_two 0 (edgeOneH0Equiv x) at hx

        (edgeOneScalarEquiv.symm a)) =
      (a, 0)
proof:
:= by
  let x := edgeOneScalarEquiv.symm a
  have hchain : edgeOneH0Equiv x =
      Finsupp.single (singletonVertex (0 : Fin 2)) a := by
    apply (Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv (ZMod 2) (ZMod 2)
      (singletonVertex (0 : Fin 2))).injective
    have hx : edgeOneScalarEquiv x = a :=
      LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
    simpa only [edgeOneScalarEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
      Finsupp.uniqueLinearEquiv_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same] using hx
  have hface : faceIncl edge_singleton_two 0
      (singletonVertex (0 : Fin 2)) = edge_twoVertex 0 := Subtype.ext rfl
  have hmap := edge_first_two_chain_square x
  rw [hchain, chainIncl_single, hface] at hmap
  rw [edgeTwoPairEquiv_apply, hmap]
  simp [edge_twoVertex_ne, edge_twoVertex_ne.symm]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_singleton_map_nonzero
statement:
private theorem edge_singleton_map_nonzero :
    (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_le 0).hom ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : HasQuotient (simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2) 0)
      (Submodule (ZMod 2)
        (simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2) 0)) :=
    Submodule.hasQuotient (R := ZMod 2)
      (M := simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2) 0)
  letI : HasQuotient (simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0)
      (Submodule (ZMod 2) (simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0)) :=
    Submodule.hasQuotient (R := ZMod 2)
      (M := simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0)
  let q := (simplicialBoundaries (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2) 0).mkQ
    edge_source_cycle
  let e0 := (homologyKernelQuotient.{0,0,0} (ZMod 2)
    (simplicialChainComplex (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2)) 0).toLinearEquiv
  let e1 := (homologyKernelQuotient.{0,0,0} (ZMod 2)
    (simplicialChainComplex edgeK (ZMod 2)) 0).toLinearEquiv
  let x := e0.symm q
  have hnat : e1 ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_le 0).hom x) =
      (simplicialBoundaries edgeK (ZMod 2) 0).mkQ edge_vertex0_cycle := by
    have hh := simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality
      (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_le 0
    have hx := congrArg (fun f : simplicialHomology
      (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2) 0 ⟶
      ModuleCat.of (ZMod 2) (simplicialCycles edgeK (ZMod 2) 0 ⧸
        simplicialBoundaries edgeK (ZMod 2) 0) => f.hom x) hh
    change e1 ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_le 0).hom x) =
      simplicialQuotientIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_le 0 (e0 x) at hx
    rw [show e0 x = q from e0.apply_symm_apply q,
      simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ, edge_cycle_inclusion] at hx
    exact hx
  intro hz
  rw [hz] at hnat
  change e1 (0 : simplicialHomology edgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = _ at hnat
  have he : e1 (0 : simplicialHomology edgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = 0 := e1.map_zero
  exact edge_vertex0_class_nonzero (hnat.symm.trans he)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.rank_one_of_nonzero
statement:
private theorem rank_one_of_nonzero
    {A B : Type} [AddCommGroup A] [Module (ZMod 2) A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module (ZMod 2) B]
    [FiniteDimensional (ZMod 2) A]
    (hA : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) A = 1)
    (f : A →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range f) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ∃ x : A, f x ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    apply hf
    ext x
    simpa using (not_not.mp (not_exists.mp h x))
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hx
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range f) := by
    apply Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨f x, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    exact fun he => hx (congrArg Subtype.val he)
  have hle := LinearMap.finrank_range_le f
  rw [hA] at hle
  omega

    (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_two_le 0).hom

      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_two_le 0).hom) := by
    apply Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
    have hx : ∃ x, (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_two_le 0).hom x ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      apply edge_two_full_nonzero
      ext x
      simpa using (not_not.mp (not_exists.mp h x))
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    exact fun he => hx (congrArg Subtype.val he)
  have htarget : Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (simplicialHomology edgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = 1 := by
    have hh := edge_H0_stage2
    change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (simplicialHomology (edgeFilter.gradeFiltration edge_i2) (ZMod 2) 0) = 1 at hh
    rw [edge_stage2] at hh
    exact hh
  have hle' := Submodule.finrank_le
    (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_two_le 0).hom)
  rw [htarget] at hle'
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_barcode
statement:
private theorem edge_barcode :
    gradeHomologyBarcode (ZMod 2) edgeFilter 0 =
      ({edge_bar03, edge_bar12} :
        Multiset (FiniteInterval edgeFilter.criticalValues.card))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    gradeHomologyBarcode (ZMod 2) edgeFilter 0 =
        rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ZMod 2)
          ({edge_bar03, edge_bar12} :
            Multiset (FiniteInterval edgeFilter.criticalValues.card))) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff
        (simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2) edgeFilter.gradeFiltration 0)
        (barcodeModule (k := ZMod 2)
          ({edge_bar03, edge_bar12} :
            Multiset (FiniteInterval edgeFilter.criticalValues.card)))).mpr
      intro i j hij
      have hi : i = edge_i0 ∨ i = edge_i1 ∨ i = edge_i2 := by
        have hv := i.isLt
        have hc := edge_card
        rcases (show i.val = 0 ∨ i.val = 1 ∨ i.val = 2 by omega) with h | h | h
        · exact Or.inl (Fin.ext h)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Fin.ext h))
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Fin.ext h))
      have hj : j = edge_i0 ∨ j = edge_i1 ∨ j = edge_i2 := by
        have hv := j.isLt
        have hc := edge_card
        rcases (show j.val = 0 ∨ j.val = 1 ∨ j.val = 2 by omega) with h | h | h
        · exact Or.inl (Fin.ext h)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Fin.ext h))
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Fin.ext h))
      rcases hi with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl | rfl
      all_goals simp only [edge_i0, edge_i1, edge_i2, Fin.mk_le_mk] at hij
      all_goals simp at hij
      all_goals rw [rank_barcodeMap]
      all_goals first
        | rw [edge_grade_rank_00]
        | rw [edge_grade_rank_01]
        | rw [edge_grade_rank_02]
        | rw [edge_grade_rank_11]
        | rw [edge_grade_rank_12]
        | rw [edge_grade_rank_22]
      all_goals
        rw [show ({edge_bar03, edge_bar12} :
          Multiset (FiniteInterval edgeFilter.criticalValues.card)) =
            edge_bar03 ::ₘ edge_bar12 ::ₘ 0 by rfl,
          Multiset.countP_cons, Multiset.countP_cons]
        simp [edge_bar03, edge_bar12, edge_i0, edge_i1, edge_i2]
      all_goals rfl
    _ = _ := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_points
statement:
theorem edge_points :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) edgeFilter 0).points =
      ({((2 : ℝ), (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)), ((5 : ℝ), (9 : WithTop ℝ))} :
        Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dgm, edge_barcode]
  change ({edge_bar03, edge_bar12} :
    Multiset (FiniteInterval edgeFilter.criticalValues.card)).map
      (fun I =>
        (edgeFilter.criticalValue
          ⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩,
          if hd : I.death < edgeFilter.criticalValues.card then
            (edgeFilter.criticalValue ⟨I.death, hd⟩ : WithTop ℝ)
          else (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))) = _
  simp [edge_bar03, edge_bar12, edge_card]
  have hc0 : ∀ h : 0 < edgeFilter.criticalValues.card,
      edgeFilter.criticalValue ⟨0, h⟩ = 2 := by
    intro h
    have he : (⟨0, h⟩ : Fin edgeFilter.criticalValues.card) = edge_i0 := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [he]
    exact edge_critical.1
  have hc1 : ∀ h : 1 < edgeFilter.criticalValues.card,
      edgeFilter.criticalValue ⟨1, h⟩ = 5 := by
    intro h
    have he : (⟨1, h⟩ : Fin edgeFilter.criticalValues.card) = edge_i1 := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [he]
    exact edge_critical.2.1
  have hc2 : ∀ h : 2 < edgeFilter.criticalValues.card,
      edgeFilter.criticalValue ⟨2, h⟩ = 9 := by
    intro h
    have he : (⟨2, h⟩ : Fin edgeFilter.criticalValues.card) = edge_i2 := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [he]
    exact edge_critical.2.2
  simp [hc0, hc1, hc2]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_rank_and_count
statement:
private theorem edge_rank_and_count (r s : ℝ) (hrs : r ≤ s) (m : ℕ)
    (hc : ({((2 : ℝ), (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)), ((5 : ℝ), (9 : WithTop ℝ))} :
      Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ)).countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ r ∧ (s : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) = m) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) (edgeFilter.sublevel_mono hrs) 0).hom) = m ∧
    (dgm (ZMod 2) edgeFilter 0).points.countP
      (fun p => p.1 ≤ r ∧ (s : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) = m
proof:
:= by
  have h := rank_sublevelHomologyMap (ZMod 2) edgeFilter 0 r s hrs
  rw [edge_points] at h
  exact ⟨h.trans hc, by rw [edge_points]; exact hc⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_count_formula
statement:
private theorem edge_count_formula (r s : ℝ) :
    ({((2 : ℝ), (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)), ((5 : ℝ), (9 : WithTop ℝ))} :
      Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ)).countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ r ∧ (s : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) =
      (if (2 : ℝ) ≤ r then 1 else 0) +
        (if (5 : ℝ) ≤ r ∧ s < 9 then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show ({((2 : ℝ), (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)), ((5 : ℝ), (9 : WithTop ℝ))} :
    Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ)) =
      ((2 : ℝ), (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ ((5 : ℝ), (9 : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ 0 by rfl,
    Multiset.countP_cons, Multiset.countP_cons]
  simp only [Multiset.countP_zero, zero_add, WithTop.coe_lt_coe, WithTop.coe_lt_top,
    and_true]
  have h9 : (s : WithTop ℝ) < (9 : WithTop ℝ) ↔ s < (9 : ℝ) := by
    exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe
  simp only [h9]
  exact Nat.add_comm (if (5 : ℝ) ≤ r ∧ s < 9 then 1 else 0)
    (if (2 : ℝ) ≤ r then 1 else 0)

      (simplicialChainComplex edgeK (ZMod 2)) 0).toLinearEquiv.symm

proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_scalar_generator_ne_zero

private theorem edge_scalar_generator_ne_zero
    {M N : Type} [AddCommGroup M] [Module (ZMod 2) M]
    [AddCommGroup N] [Module (ZMod 2) N]
    (e : M ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2) (f : M →ₗ[ZMod 2] N) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    f (e.symm 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  apply hf
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y

    apply e.injective

  rw [hy, map_smul, hz, smul_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_two_full_pair_coordinates
statement:
private theorem edge_two_full_pair_coordinates (a b : ZMod 2) :
    edge_H0Equiv
      ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_two_le 0).hom
        (edgeTwoPairEquiv.symm (a, b))) = a + b
proof:
:= by
  let g : ZMod 2 × ZMod 2 →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2 :=
    edge_H0Equiv.toLinearMap.comp
      ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_two_le 0).hom.comp
        edgeTwoPairEquiv.symm.toLinearMap)
  have h0 : g (1, 0) = 1 := by
    let x := edgeOneScalarEquiv.symm 1
    have hp := edge_first_two_pair_coordinates 1
    have hy : edgeTwoPairEquiv.symm (1, 0) =
        (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_two 0).hom x := by
      apply edgeTwoPairEquiv.injective
      simpa [x] using hp.symm
    have hc := congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) edge_map_comp
    change (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_le 0).hom x =
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_two_le 0).hom
        ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_two 0).hom x) at hc
    have hn : edge_H0Equiv
        ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_le 0).hom x) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      exact (edge_scalar_generator_ne_zero edgeOneScalarEquiv
        (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_le 0).hom
        edge_singleton_map_nonzero)
          (edge_H0Equiv.injective (hz.trans (map_zero _).symm))
    change edge_H0Equiv
      ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_two_le 0).hom
        (edgeTwoPairEquiv.symm (1, 0))) = 1
    rw [hy, ← hc]
    have h : ∀ z : ZMod 2, z = 0 ∨ z = 1 := by decide
    exact (h _).resolve_left hn
  have h1 : g (0, 1) = 1 := by
    let x := edgeOtherScalarEquiv.symm 1
    have hp := edge_other_two_pair_coordinates 1
    have hy : edgeTwoPairEquiv.symm (0, 1) =
        (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_other_two 0).hom x := by
      apply edgeTwoPairEquiv.injective
      simpa [x] using hp.symm
    have hc := simplicialHomologyIncl_comp (ZMod 2) edge_other_two edge_two_le 0
    have hp' : edge_other_two.trans edge_two_le = edge_other_le :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hp'] at hc
    have hh := congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) hc
    change (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_other_le 0).hom x =
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_two_le 0).hom
        ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_other_two 0).hom x) at hh
    have hn : edge_H0Equiv
        ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_other_le 0).hom x) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      exact (edge_scalar_generator_ne_zero edgeOtherScalarEquiv
        (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_other_le 0).hom
        edge_other_map_nonzero)
          (edge_H0Equiv.injective (hz.trans (map_zero _).symm))
    change edge_H0Equiv
      ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_two_le 0).hom
        (edgeTwoPairEquiv.symm (0, 1))) = 1
    rw [hy, ← hh]
    have h : ∀ z : ZMod 2, z = 0 ∨ z = 1 := by decide
    exact (h _).resolve_left hn
  have hp : (a, b) = a • (1, 0) + b • (0, 1) := by ext <;> simp
  change g (a, b) = a + b
  rw [hp, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, h0, h1]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_first_full_coordinates
statement:
private theorem edge_first_full_coordinates (a : ZMod 2) :
    edge_H0Equiv
      ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_le 0).hom
        (edgeOneScalarEquiv.symm a)) = a
proof:
:= by
  let x := edgeOneScalarEquiv.symm a
  let y := (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_two 0).hom x
  have hy : y = edgeTwoPairEquiv.symm (a, 0) := by
    apply edgeTwoPairEquiv.injective
    exact (edge_first_two_pair_coordinates a).trans
      (edgeTwoPairEquiv.apply_symm_apply (a, 0)).symm
  have hc := congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) edge_map_comp
  change (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_le 0).hom x =
    (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_two_le 0).hom y at hc
  change edge_H0Equiv
    ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) edge_singleton_le 0).hom x) = a
  rw [hc, hy, edge_two_full_pair_coordinates]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.empty_template_example
statement:
private theorem empty_template_example :
    ∃ e : CompatibleOrder (emptyFilter (Fin 2) ℝ),
      faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) e 0 = 0 ∧
      faceTemplateEssential (ZMod 2) e 0 = 0 ∧
      (evaluateFaceTemplate (ZMod 2) e (emptyFilter (Fin 2) ℝ)
        e.monotone 0).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_compatibleOrder (emptyFilter (Fin 2) ℝ)
  have hm : Fintype.card (TotalFace (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2))) = 0 := by
    letI : IsEmpty (TotalFace (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2))) :=
      ⟨fun s => ((mem_bot_iff s.val).mp s.property).elim⟩
    exact Fintype.card_eq_zero
  refine ⟨e, faceTemplatePairs_empty (ZMod 2) e 0 hm,
    faceTemplateEssential_empty (ZMod 2) e 0 hm, ?_⟩
  rw [evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm, empty_points]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_template_example
statement:
private theorem singleton_template_example (a : ℝ) :
    ∃ e : CompatibleOrder (singletonFilter a),
      faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) e 0 = 0 ∧
      (evaluateFaceTemplate (ZMod 2) e (singletonFilter a)
        e.monotone 0).points =
        ({(a, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))} : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_compatibleOrder (singletonFilter a)
  have hm : Fintype.card (TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) = 1 := by decide
  refine ⟨e, faceTemplatePairs_one_face (ZMod 2) e 0 hm, ?_⟩
  rw [evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm, singleton_points]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_template_essential_index
statement:
theorem singleton_template_essential_index (a : ℝ) :
    ∃ e : CompatibleOrder (singletonFilter a),
      faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) e 0 = 0 ∧
      faceTemplateEssential (ZMod 2) e 0 =
        ({⟨0, by
            have hm : Fintype.card (TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) = 1 := by decide
            omega⟩} : Multiset (Fin (Fintype.card
              (TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, hP, hpoints⟩ := singleton_template_example a
  have hm : Fintype.card (TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) = 1 := by decide
  have hcard : (faceTemplateEssential (ZMod 2) e 0).card = 1 := by
    have hc := congrArg Multiset.card hpoints
    simpa [evaluateFaceTemplate, hP] using hc
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Multiset.card_eq_one.mp hcard
  have hidx : i = (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (Fintype.card
      (TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))))) := by
    apply Fin.ext
    have hlt := i.isLt
    change i.val < Fintype.card (TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) at hlt
    rw [hm] at hlt
    change i.val = 0
    omega
  refine ⟨e, hP, ?_⟩
  rw [hi, hidx]

proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_smooth_lift
statement:
private theorem singleton_smooth_lift :
    ∃ (m l : ℕ) (L : ℝ → (Fin m → ℝ × ℝ) × (Fin l → ℝ)),
      m = 0 ∧ l = 1 ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, (dgm (ZMod 2) (singletonFilter x) 0).points =
        ({(x, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))} : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ)) ∧
        dgm (ZMod 2) (singletonFilter x) 0 = orderedQ m l (L x)) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 L Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → FilterFunction (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) ℝ := singletonFilter
  obtain ⟨e, hp, he⟩ := singleton_template_essential_index 0
  have hc : (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) F (x₀ := 0) e 0).1 = 0 ∧
      (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) F (x₀ := 0) e 0).2 = 1 := by
    simp [faceLiftCounts, hp, he]
  refine ⟨(faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) F (x₀ := 0) e 0).1,
    (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) F (x₀ := 0) e 0).2,
    fixedFaceLift (ZMod 2) F (x₀ := 0) e 0, hc.1, hc.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    refine ⟨singleton_points x, ?_⟩
    exact fixedFaceLift_factorization (ZMod 2) F (x₀ := 0) e 0
      (U := Set.univ) (fun _ _ s t => by simp [F, singletonFilter]) x (Set.mem_univ x)
  · exact fixedFaceLift_contDiffOn (ZMod 2) F (x₀ := 0) e 0 (U := Set.univ)
      (fun s => by
        change ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x : ℝ => x) Set.univ
        exact contDiffOn_id)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.moving_edge_smooth_lift
statement:
private theorem moving_edge_smooth_lift :
    ∃ (m l : ℕ) (L : ℝ → (Fin m → ℝ × ℝ) × (Fin l → ℝ)),
      (∀ x : ℝ, dgm (ZMod 2) (movingEdgeFilter x) 0 =
        orderedQ m l (L x)) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 L Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  have hF : ∀ s : TotalFace edgeK,
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x : ℝ => (movingEdgeFilter x).value s) Set.univ := by
    intro s
    change ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x : ℝ => edgeFilter.value s + x) Set.univ
    exact contDiffOn_const.add contDiffOn_id
  have horder : ∀ x ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ),
      OrderingEquivalent (movingEdgeFilter 0) (movingEdgeFilter x) := by
    intro x _ s t
    simp [movingEdgeFilter]
  obtain ⟨m, l, L, hfactor, hsmooth⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_face_lift (ZMod 2) movingEdgeFilter
      (x₀ := 0) isOpen_univ (Set.mem_univ 0) hF horder 0
  exact ⟨m, l, L, fun x => hfactor x (Set.mem_univ x), hsmooth⟩

proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.moving_tied_edge_has_finite_slot
statement:
theorem moving_tied_edge_has_finite_slot :
    ∃ e : CompatibleOrder (movingTiedEdgeFilter (0 : ℝ)),
      0 < (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₀, hpoints⟩ := edge_template_example
  have hmem : ((5 : ℝ), (9 : WithTop ℝ)) ∈
      (evaluateFaceTemplate (ZMod 2) e₀ edgeFilter e₀.monotone 0).points := by
    rw [hpoints]
    simp
  have hpair : faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) e₀ 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    simp [evaluateFaceTemplate, hz] at hmem
  let e : CompatibleOrder (movingTiedEdgeFilter (0 : ℝ)) :=
    e₀.transfer (g := movingTiedEdgeFilter 0) (by
      intro i j _
      exact le_rfl)
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩

  have heq : faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) e 0 =
      faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) e₀ 0 :=
    faceTemplatePairs_transfer (ZMod 2) e₀ (movingTiedEdgeFilter 0)
      (by intro i j _; exact le_rfl) 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.moving_tied_edge_lift
statement:

  · intro x

        (U := Set.univ) (fun _ _ s t => by simp [F, movingTiedEdgeFilter])

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapsedPowerCost_lintegral_eq_depthMoment
statement:
private theorem collapsedPowerCost_lintegral_eq_depthMoment
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (μ : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (γ : Measure (Space × Space))
    (hfirst : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R)
    (hsecond : γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure (0 : Measure Interior) R) :
    (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂γ) =
      ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hboundary_map : ∀ᵐ y ∂γ.map Prod.snd, y = Space.boundary := by
    rw [hsecond, reservoirMeasure_zero]
    exact Measure.ae_smul_measure (by simp) R
  have hboundary_set : MeasurableSet {y : Space | y = Space.boundary} := by
    have hset : {y : Space | y = Space.boundary} = {Space.boundary} := by
      ext y
      simp
    rw [hset]
    exact measurableSet_singleton _
  have hboundary : ∀ᵐ z ∂γ, z.2 = Space.boundary :=
    (ae_map_iff (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable Prod.snd γ)
      hboundary_set).1 hboundary_map
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := hp.le
  have hdist : Continuous (fun x : Space => dist x Space.boundary) := by
    exact continuous_dist.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
  have hmeasurable : Measurable (boundaryMomentIntegrand p) :=
    ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp
      ((Real.continuous_rpow_const hp0).comp hdist).measurable
  calc
    (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂γ) =
        ∫⁻ z, boundaryMomentIntegrand p z.1 ∂γ := by
      apply lintegral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [hboundary] with z hz
      simp [collapsedPowerCost, boundaryMomentIntegrand, hz]
    _ = ∫⁻ x, boundaryMomentIntegrand p x ∂γ.map Prod.fst := by
      symm
      exact lintegral_map hmeasurable (by fun_prop : Measurable Prod.fst)
    _ = ∫⁻ x, boundaryMomentIntegrand p x ∂reservoirMeasure μ R := by
      rw [hfirst]
    _ = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ :=
      reservoirMeasure_boundary_moment μ R p hp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_zero_target
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_zero_target
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ : Measure Interior) (hμtop : μ Set.univ < ∞) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ 0 =
      ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let R : ℝ≥0∞ := μ Set.univ
  have hRtop : R < ∞ := hμtop
  have htotal : μ Set.univ + (0 : Measure Interior) Set.univ ≤ R := by
    simp [R]
  have hreservoir : reservoirPowerValue p μ 0 R =
      ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · have hπ : IsBoundaryPlan (diagonalBoundaryPlan μ 0) μ 0 :=
        diagonalBoundaryPlan_admissible μ 0
      have hforward := collapsedAugmentation_forward hπ R hRtop htotal p hp
      calc
        reservoirPowerValue p μ 0 R ≤
            ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂collapsedAugmentation (diagonalBoundaryPlan μ 0) R :=
          reservoirPowerValue_le_plan p μ 0 R _ hforward.1 hforward.2.1
        _ ≤ ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂diagonalBoundaryPlan μ 0 := hforward.2.2
        _ = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ := by
          rw [diagonalBoundaryPlan_cost]
          simp
    · unfold reservoirPowerValue
      refine le_iInf fun γ => le_iInf fun hγ => ?_
      exact (collapsedPowerCost_lintegral_eq_depthMoment p
        (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp) μ R γ hγ.1 hγ.2).symm.le
  calc
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ 0 = reservoirPowerValue p μ 0 R :=
      boundaryTransportPowerValue_eq_reservoirPowerValue p hp μ 0 R hRtop htotal
    _ = ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ := hreservoir

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_zero_target
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_zero_target
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ : Measure Interior) (hμtop : μ Set.univ < ∞) :
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ 0 =
      (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) ^ (1 / p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryTransportDistance, boundaryTransportPowerValue_zero_target p hp μ hμtop]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_zero_target_rpow
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_zero_target_rpow
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ : Measure Interior) (hμtop : μ Set.univ < ∞) :
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ 0 ^ p =
      ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryTransportDistance_zero_target p hp μ hμtop, ← ENNReal.rpow_mul,
    one_div_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)), ENNReal.rpow_one]

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleDiagramExamples.triangle_rips_card_le_one
statement:
theorem triangle_rips_card_le_one :
    ∀ s ∈ (Rips.filter Triangle.metric).sublevel (6 / 5), s.card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  by_contra hcard
  obtain ⟨v, hv, w, hw, hvw⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.1 (show 1 < s.card by omega)
  have hpair : ({v, w} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈ (Rips.filter Triangle.metric).sublevel (6 / 5) := by
    rw [Rips.mem_sublevel_iff] at hs ⊢
    refine ⟨⟨v, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha hb
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl <;> apply hs.2 <;> assumption
  have key : ({v, w} : Finset (Fin 3)) = Triangle.edge01 ∨
      ({v, w} : Finset (Fin 3)) = Triangle.edge02 ∨
      ({v, w} : Finset (Fin 3)) = Triangle.edge12 ∨ v = w := by
    fin_cases v <;> fin_cases w <;> decide
  rcases key with h | h | h | h
  · exact Triangle.edge01_not_mem_rips (h ▸ hpair)
  · exact Triangle.edge02_not_mem_rips (h ▸ hpair)
  · exact Triangle.edge12_not_mem_rips (h ▸ hpair)
  · exact hvw h

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleDiagramExamples.triangle_rips_isZero_log
statement:
theorem triangle_rips_isZero_log :
    IsZero ((logModule (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter Triangle.metric) 1).obj (Real.log (6 / 5)))
proof:
:= by
  change IsZero (simplicialHomology
    ((Rips.filter Triangle.metric).sublevel (Real.exp (Real.log (6 / 5)))) (ZMod 2) 1)
  rw [Real.exp_log (by norm_num)]
