name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.exists_relation_dist_le_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem exists_relation_dist_le_hausdorffDist
    {Z : Type w} [MetricSpace Z] {V : Type u} {W : Type v}
    [Fintype V] [Fintype W] [Nonempty V] [Nonempty W]
    (p : V → Z) (q : W → Z) :
    ∃ C : SetRel V W,
      Relator.LeftTotal (fun v w => (v, w) ∈ C) ∧
      Relator.LeftTotal (fun w v => (w, v) ∈ C.inv) ∧
      ∀ v w, (v, w) ∈ C → dist (p v) (q w) ≤ hausdorffDist (range p) (range q)
proof:
:= by
  let r := hausdorffDist (range p) (range q)
  let C : SetRel V W := {vw | dist (p vw.1) (q vw.2) ≤ r}
  have hp := (Set.finite_range p).isCompact
  have hq := (Set.finite_range q).isCompact
  have hfin : hausdorffEDist (range p) (range q) ≠ ⊤ :=
    hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded (range_nonempty _) (range_nonempty _)
      hp.isBounded hq.isBounded
  refine ⟨C, ?_, ?_, fun _ _ h => h⟩
  · intro v
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨w, rfl⟩, hw⟩ := hq.exists_infDist_eq_dist (range_nonempty q) (p v)
    refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
    change dist (p v) (q w) ≤ r
    rw [← hw]
    exact infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem (mem_range_self v) hfin
  · intro w
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨v, rfl⟩, hv⟩ := hp.exists_infDist_eq_dist (range_nonempty p) (q w)
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    change dist (p v) (q w) ≤ r
    rw [dist_comm, ← hv]
    dsimp only [r]
    rw [hausdorffDist_comm]
    exact infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem (mem_range_self w)
      (by simpa only [hausdorffEDist_comm] using hfin)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_dgm_le_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_le_hausdorffDist [Nonempty V] [Nonempty W] (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (hausdorffDist (range p) (range q))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hCT, hIT, h⟩ := exists_relation_dist_le_hausdorffDist p q
  let ε : ℝ≥0 := ⟨hausdorffDist (range p) (range q), hausdorffDist_nonneg⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞) := bottleneck_dgm_le_of_relation (C := C) (ε := ε)
      p q hCT hIT h k n
    _ = _ := ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq ε

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_dgm_le_hausdorffEDist
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_le_hausdorffEDist [Nonempty V] [Nonempty W] (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n) ≤
      hausdorffEDist (range p) (range q)
proof:
:= by
  have hfin : hausdorffEDist (range p) (range q) ≠ ⊤ :=
    hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded (range_nonempty _) (range_nonempty _)
      (Set.finite_range p).isCompact.isBounded (Set.finite_range q).isCompact.isBounded
  simpa only [hausdorffDist, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfin] using
    bottleneck_dgm_le_hausdorffDist k p q n

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_dgm_le_of_hausdorffEDist_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_le_of_hausdorffEDist_le [Nonempty V] [Nonempty W]
    {ε : ℝ≥0∞} (h : hausdorffEDist (range p) (range q) ≤ ε) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n) ≤ ε
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_dgm_le_hausdorffEDist k p q n).trans h

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_dgm_le_sampling_errors
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_le_sampling_errors [Nonempty V] [Nonempty W]
    (target : Set Z) {α β : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hp : hausdorffEDist (range p) target ≤ α)
    (hq : hausdorffEDist (range q) target ≤ β) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n) ≤ α + β
proof:
:= by
  apply (bottleneck_dgm_le_hausdorffEDist k p q n).trans
  exact hausdorffEDist_triangle.trans (add_le_add hp (hausdorffEDist_comm.trans_le hq))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.dgm_eq_of_range_eq
statement:
theorem dgm_eq_of_range_eq (h : range p = range q) (n : ℕ) :
    dgm k (Cech.filter p) n = dgm k (Cech.filter q) n
proof:
:= by
  let C : SetRel V W := {vw | p vw.1 = q vw.2}
  have hCT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun v w => (v, w) ∈ C) := by
    intro v
    have hv : p v ∈ range q := h ▸ mem_range_self v
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hv
    exact ⟨w, hw.symm⟩
  have hIT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun w v => (w, v) ∈ C.inv) := by
    intro w
    have hw : q w ∈ range p := h.symm ▸ mem_range_self w
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hw
    exact ⟨v, hv⟩
  apply (bottleneck_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp
  apply le_antisymm _ zero_le
  have hb := bottleneck_dgm_le_of_relation (C := C) (ε := 0) p q hCT hIT
    (by intro v w hvw; change p v = q w at hvw; simp [hvw]) k n
  simpa only [ENNReal.coe_zero] using hb

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_relabel
statement:
theorem totalFiniteCost_relabel (u : I' ≃ I) (v : J' ≃ J)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    (M.relabel u v (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _)).totalFiniteCost (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) =
      M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:=
  totalBoundaryCost_relabel u v M
    (fun i j => (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal)
    (fun i => (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal) (fun j => (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal)

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      M.totalFiniteCost x y = finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :=
    occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff.mpr (by simp)
  exact exists_eq_ciInf_of_finite

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:= by
  apply ciInf_le
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩
  exact N.totalFiniteCost_nonneg x y

name: TDA.Persistence.le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_iff
statement:
theorem le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_iff (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    c ≤ finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y ↔
      ∀ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}, c ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h M
    exact h.trans (finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost x y M)
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
    exact hM ▸ h M

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_nonneg (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    0 ≤ finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y
proof:
:=
  (le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_iff x y 0).mpr (fun M => M.totalFiniteCost_nonneg x y)

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_diagonalSum
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_diagonalSum (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y ≤
      (∑ i, (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal) + ∑ j, (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1} :=
    ⟨fun _ => none, by simp, Equiv.refl _⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y := finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost x y M
    _ = _ := by simp [M, OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right [IsEmpty J]
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y = ∑ i, (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
  have hn (i : I) : M.finite i = none := by
    cases h : M.finite i with
    | none => rfl
    | some j => exact isEmptyElim j
  rw [← hM]
  simp [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, hn]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_left
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_left [IsEmpty I]
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y = ∑ j, (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
  rw [← hM]
  simp [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_empty [IsEmpty I] [IsEmpty J]
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right]
  exact Fintype.sum_empty _

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_reindex
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_reindex {I' J' : Type*} [Fintype I'] [Fintype J']
    (u : I' ≃ I) (v : J' ≃ J) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) = finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
    calc
      _ ≤ (M.relabel u v (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _)).totalFiniteCost (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) :=
        finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost _ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [M.totalFiniteCost_relabel, hM]
  · obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v)
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=
      (OccurrenceMatching.relabelEquiv u v (Equiv.refl PEmpty.{1})
        (Equiv.refl PEmpty.{1})).surjective N
    have hcost := M.totalFiniteCost_relabel u v x y
    change M.relabel u v (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _) = N at hM
    rw [hM] at hcost
    calc
      _ ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y := finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost x y M
      _ = _ := hcost.symm.trans hN

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.quotientHom_surjective
statement:
theorem quotientHom_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (MulOpposite.unop c)
  refine ⟨MulOpposite.op b, ?_⟩
  simpa [quotientHom] using congrArg MulOpposite.op hb

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.kernel_smul_class_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem kernel_smul_class_eq_zero
    (M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    (a : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (ha : a ∈ RingHom.ker (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))) (m : M) :
    (relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ (a • m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq (relation (k := k) (S := S) M)).2
  change a • m - 0 ∈ relation (k := k) (S := S) M
  simpa [relation] using (Submodule.subset_span
    (s := Set.range fun z :
      (RingHom.ker (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))) × M =>
        (z.1 : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) • z.2)
    ⟨(⟨a, ha⟩, m), rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.kernel_action_annihilates
statement:
theorem kernel_action_annihilates
    (M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    (a : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (ha : a ∈ RingHom.ker (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S)))
    (x : quotient (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    a • x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := (relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ_surjective x
  exact kernel_smul_class_eq_zero (k := k) (S := S) M a ha m

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.kernel_le_action_ker
statement:
private theorem kernel_le_action_ker
    (M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) :
    RingHom.ker (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S)) ≤
      RingHom.ker (Module.toAddMonoidEnd (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))
        (quotient (k := k) (S := S) M))
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  change Module.toAddMonoidEnd (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))
      (quotient (k := k) (S := S) M) a = 0
  apply AddMonoidHom.ext
  intro x
  change a • x = 0
  exact kernel_action_annihilates (k := k) (S := S) M a ha x

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.quotientAction_comp_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientAction_comp_apply
    (M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    (r : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) (x : quotient (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    quotientAction (k := k) (S := S) M (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) r) x = r • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [quotientAction, RingHom.liftOfSurjective_comp_apply]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.quotientModule_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientModule_smul
    (M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    (c : RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) (x : quotientModule (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    c • x = quotientAction (k := k) (S := S) M c x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.quotientModule_class_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientModule_class_smul
    (M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    (r : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) (m : M) :
    quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) r •
      (relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ m =
        (relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ (r • m)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) (quotient (k := k) (S := S) M) :=
    quotientModuleStructure (k := k) (S := S) M
  change quotientAction (k := k) (S := S) M
    (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) r)
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ m) = _
  rw [quotientAction_comp_apply]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.quotientProjection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientProjection_apply
    (M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))) (m : M) :
    (quotientProjection (k := k) (S := S) M).hom m =
      (relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ m
proof:
:= by
  change quotientProjectionHom (k := k) (S := S) M m = _
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.relation_map_le
statement:
private theorem relation_map_le
    {M N : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))} (g : M ⟶ N) :
    relation (k := k) (S := S) M ≤
      Submodule.comap g.hom (relation (k := k) (S := S) N)
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.2
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  refine ⟨(z.1, g.hom z.2), ?_⟩
  change z.1 • g.hom z.2 = g.hom (z.1 • z.2)
  exact (g.hom.map_smul z.1 z.2).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.mapQuotient_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem mapQuotient_mkQ {M N : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (g : M ⟶ N) (m : M) :
    mapQuotient (k := k) (S := S) g ((relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ m) =
      (relation (k := k) (S := S) N).mkQ (g.hom m)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.extensionMap_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem extensionMap_mkQ {M N : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    (g : M ⟶ N) (m : M) :
    (extensionMap (k := k) (S := S) g).hom
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ m) =
        (relation (k := k) (S := S) N).mkQ (g.hom m)
proof:
:=
  mapQuotient_mkQ (k := k) (S := S) g m

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.relation_le_ker_of_restrictedMap
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_le.2
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  change g.hom (z.1 • z.2) = 0
  calc
    g.hom (z.1 • z.2) =
        (z.1 : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) • g.hom z.2 := by
          exact g.hom.map_smul _ _
    _ = 0 := by
      have hz : quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) z.1 = 0 :=
        RingHom.mem_ker.mp z.1.property
      simp [ModuleCat.restrictScalars.smul_def, hz]
      exact zero_smul _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.liftQuotient_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftQuotient_mkQ
    {M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    {N : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))}
    (g : M ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)
    (m : M) :
    liftQuotient (k := k) (S := S) g ((relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ m) =
      g.hom m
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.liftCLinearMap_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftCLinearMap_mkQ
    {M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    {N : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))}
    (g : M ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)
    (m : M) :
    liftCLinearMap (k := k) (S := S) g
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ m) = g.hom m
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.liftMap_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem liftMap_mkQ
    {M : ModuleCat (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))}
    {N : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))}
    (g : M ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)
    (m : M) :
    (liftMap (k := k) (S := S) g).hom
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ m) = g.hom m
proof:
:=
  by
    change liftCLinearMap (k := k) (S := S) g
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S) M).mkQ m) = _
    exact liftCLinearMap_mkQ (k := k) (S := S) g m

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.extensionRestrictionIso_hom_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem extensionRestrictionIso_hom_mkQ
    (N : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))) (n : N) :
    (extensionRestrictionIso (k := k) (S := S)).hom.app N
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)).mkQ n) = n
proof:
:= by
  change (extensionRestrictionEquiv (k := k) (S := S) N)
    ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)).mkQ
        (show (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N from n)) = n
  change liftCLinearMap (k := k) (S := S) (𝟙 _)
    ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)).mkQ
        (show (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N from n)) = n
  rw [liftCLinearMap_mkQ]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.extensionRestrictionIso_inv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem extensionRestrictionIso_inv_apply
    (N : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))) (n : N) :
    (extensionRestrictionIso (k := k) (S := S)).inv.app N n =
      (relation (k := k) (S := S)
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)).mkQ n
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.extensionAdjunction_counit_eq_extensionRestrictionIso
statement:
theorem extensionAdjunction_counit_eq_extensionRestrictionIso
    (N : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))) :
    (extensionAdjunction (k := k) (S := S)).counit.app N =
      (extensionRestrictionIso (k := k) (S := S)).hom.app N
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ :=
    (relation (k := k) (S := S)
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)).mkQ_surjective x
  rw [← hn]
  change (liftMap (k := k) (S := S) (𝟙 _)).hom
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)).mkQ
          (show (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N from n)) =
    (liftCLinearMap (k := k) (S := S) (𝟙 _))
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)).mkQ
          (show (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N from n))
  rw [liftMap_mkQ, liftCLinearMap_mkQ]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.regularExtensionMap_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem regularExtensionMap_mkQ (a : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    (regularExtensionMap (k := k) (S := S)).hom
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
        (regularRightIncidenceModule (k := k) (S := S))).mkQ a) =
      quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) a
proof:
:=
  by
    change (liftMap (k := k) (S := S)
      (quotientHomOnRegular (k := k) (S := S))).hom
        ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
          (regularRightIncidenceModule (k := k) (S := S))).mkQ a) =
      quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) a
    rw [liftMap_mkQ]
    rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.kernel_le_regularRelation
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  change a ∈ Submodule.span (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (Set.range fun z :
      (RingHom.ker (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))) × RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S) =>
        (z.1 : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) • z.2)
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  exact ⟨(⟨a, ha⟩, 1), by simp⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.regularExtensionMap_injective
statement:
private theorem regularExtensionMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (regularExtensionMap (k := k) (S := S)).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  let K := relation (k := k) (S := S) (regularRightIncidenceModule (k := k) (S := S))
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := K.mkQ_surjective x
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := K.mkQ_surjective y
  have hxy' := hxy
  rw [← ha, ← hb] at hxy'
  rw [← ha, ← hb]
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq K).2
  have hq : quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) a = quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) b := by
    change (regularExtensionMap (k := k) (S := S)).hom
        ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
          (regularRightIncidenceModule (k := k) (S := S))).mkQ a) =
      (regularExtensionMap (k := k) (S := S)).hom
        ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
          (regularRightIncidenceModule (k := k) (S := S))).mkQ b) at hxy'
    rw [regularExtensionMap_mkQ, regularExtensionMap_mkQ] at hxy'
    exact hxy'
  apply kernel_le_regularRelation (k := k) (S := S)
  apply RingHom.mem_ker.mpr
  rw [map_sub, hq, sub_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.regularExtensionMap_surjective
statement:
private theorem regularExtensionMap_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (regularExtensionMap (k := k) (S := S)).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro c
  let K := relation (k := k) (S := S) (regularRightIncidenceModule (k := k) (S := S))
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := quotientHom_surjective (k := k) (S := S) c
  refine ⟨K.mkQ a, ?_⟩
  change (regularExtensionMap (k := k) (S := S)).hom
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
        (regularRightIncidenceModule (k := k) (S := S))).mkQ a) = c
  rw [regularExtensionMap_mkQ]
  exact ha

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.regularExtensionIso_hom_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem regularExtensionIso_hom_mkQ (a : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    (regularExtensionIso (k := k) (S := S)).hom
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
        (regularRightIncidenceModule (k := k) (S := S))).mkQ a) =
      quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) a
proof:
:= by
  exact regularExtensionMap_mkQ (k := k) (S := S) a

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.quotientHom_rightIncidenceMatrixUnit
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotientHom_rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    quotientHom (k := k) (S := S)
        (rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq) =
      rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightVertexRestrictedCharacter_surjective
statement:
theorem rightVertexRestrictedCharacter_surjective (v : StrictVertex S) :
    Function.Surjective (rightVertexRestrictedCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := rightVertexCharacter_surjective (k := k) (S := S) v a
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := quotientHom_surjective (k := k) (S := S) c
  exact ⟨r, by simp [rightVertexRestrictedCharacter, hr, hc]⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightVertexRestrictedModule_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightVertexRestrictedModule_smul (v : StrictVertex S)
    (r : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) (t : RightVertexRestrictedModule (k := k) (S := S) v) :
    r • t = rightVertexRestrictedCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v r • t
proof:
:= by
  change quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) r • t =
    rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) r) • t
  exact rightVertexModule_smul (k := k) (S := S) v
    (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) r) t

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightIncidenceMatrixUnit_smul (v : StrictVertex S)
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (t : RightVertexRestrictedModule (k := k) (S := S) v) :
    rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq • t =
      if v.1 = p ∧ v.1 = q then t else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightVertexRestrictedModule_smul]
  change rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S)
        (rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq)) • t = _
  rw [quotientHom_rightIncidenceMatrixUnit]
  change rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq) •
        (show RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v from t) = _
  calc
    _ = rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq •
        (show RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v from t) :=
          (rightVertexModule_smul (k := k) (S := S) v
            (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq) t).symm
    _ = _ := rightMatrixUnit_smul (k := k) (S := S) v p q hpq t

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightVertexRestrictedModule_isSimpleModule
statement:
theorem rightVertexRestrictedModule_isSimpleModule (v : StrictVertex S) :
    IsSimpleModule (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S))
      (RightVertexRestrictedModule (k := k) (S := S) v)
proof:
:= by
  let χ := rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
  let ψ := rightVertexRestrictedCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
  letI : RingHomSurjective ψ :=
    ⟨rightVertexRestrictedCharacter_surjective (k := k) (S := S) v⟩
  letI : Module (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) k := Module.compHom k ψ
  let f : k →ₛₗ[ψ] k :=
    { toFun := id
      map_add' := by intro a b; rfl
      map_smul' := by intro a b; rfl }
  have hf : Function.Bijective f := by
    constructor <;> intro a <;> simp [f]
  have hs : IsSimpleModule (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) k :=
    (LinearMap.isSimpleModule_iff_of_bijective f hf).2 inferInstance
  let i := ModuleCat.restrictScalarsComp'App
    (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S)) χ ψ rfl (ModuleCat.of k k)
  exact (LinearEquiv.isSimpleModule_iff i.toLinearEquiv).mp hs

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.extensionRightVertexIso_hom_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem extensionRightVertexIso_hom_mkQ (v : StrictVertex S)
    (t : RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) :
    (extensionRightVertexIso (k := k) (S := S) v).hom
      ((relation (k := k) (S := S)
        (RightVertexRestrictedModule (k := k) (S := S) v)).mkQ t) = t
proof:
:=
  extensionRestrictionIso_hom_mkQ (k := k) (S := S)
    (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) t

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_death_bounds_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_death_bounds_of_kernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel p))
    (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ≤
        (occurrence (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp j)).death ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp j)).death ≤
        (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).translatedDeath theta
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨epiEmbedding_death_le p hp j, ?_⟩
  let I := occurrence (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp j)
  let J := occurrence (rankBarcode N) j
  change I.death ≤ J.translatedDeath theta
  by_cases hd : J.death < s
  · rw [FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_of_lt J theta hd]
    by_contra h
    have hlo := birthOrdinal_lt_birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp j)
      (theta ⟨J.death, hd⟩).val (lt_of_not_ge h)
    have hhi := birthSuffixCount_le_birthOrdinal (rankBarcode N) j J.death (le_refl _)
    change birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode N) J.birth J.death ≤
      birthOrdinal (rankBarcode N) j at hhi
    have hcounts := birthSuffixCount_translated_le_of_kernelTrivial theta hTheta p hp hk
      J.birthStage ⟨J.death, hd⟩ (by change J.birth ≤ J.death; exact J.birth_lt_death.le)
    have hb := epiEmbedding_birth p hp j
    have ho := epiEmbedding_ordinal p hp j
    change (occurrence (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp j)).birth = J.birth at hb
    rw [hb] at hlo
    change birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode M) J.birth (theta ⟨J.death, hd⟩).val ≤
      birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode N) J.birth J.death at hcounts
    omega
  · have he : J.death = s := by have := J.death_le_size; omega
    rw [FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_terminal J theta he]
    exact I.death_le_size

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_covers_long_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_covers_long_of_kernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel p))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M))
    (hlong : (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birthStage).val <
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death) :
    ∃! j, epiEmbedding p hp j = i
proof:
:= by
  let I := occurrence (rankBarcode M) i
  have hlo := birthOrdinal_lt_birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode M) i
    (theta I.birthStage).val hlong
  have hcounts := birthSuffixCount_translated_le_of_kernelTrivial theta hTheta p hp hk
    I.birthStage I.birthStage (le_refl _)
  have hcard := birthSuffixCount_le_card (rankBarcode N) I.birth I.birth
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (epiEmbedding_mem_range_iff p hp i).mpr
    (hlo.trans_le (hcounts.trans hcard))
  exact ⟨j, hj, fun j' hj' => (epiEmbedding p hp).injective (hj'.trans hj.symm)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_unmatched_short_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_unmatched_short_of_kernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel p))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (hi : i ∉ Set.range (epiEmbedding p hp)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ≤
      (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birthStage).val
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨j, hj, _⟩ := epiEmbedding_covers_long_of_kernelTrivial
    theta hTheta p hp hk i (lt_of_not_ge h)
  exact hi ⟨j, hj⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars_coordinates
statement:
private theorem unitBars_coordinates (n : ℕ) (q : (unitBars n).finiteOccurrences) :
    q.1 = ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Multiset.coe_mem (x := q)
  exact Multiset.eq_of_mem_replicate (by simpa only [unitBars_finitePart] using h)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars_positive
statement: theorem unitBars_positive (n : ℕ) : (unitBars n).IsPositive

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.empty_occurrence_count

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars_to_empty
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right]
  have hd : (diagonalCost ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ)).toReal = 1 := by norm_num [diagonalCost]
  simp only [unitBars_coordinates, hd, Real.one_rpow, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars_bottleneck_empty
statement:
private theorem unitBars_bottleneck_empty (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    bottleneck (unitBars n) (unitBars 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty (unitBars n).finiteOccurrences :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by rw [unitBars_card]; exact hn)
  have hz : unitBars 0 = orderedQ 0 0
      ((Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ), (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ)) := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    simp [unitBars, orderedQ]
  rw [hz]
  rw [bottleneck_finite_only_empty _ (unitBars_essentialPart n)]
  simp only [unitBars_coordinates]
  norm_num [diagonalCost]
  exact Finset.sup_const Finset.univ_nonempty 1

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.empty_costs_eventually_zero
statement:
theorem empty_costs_eventually_zero :
    (∀ᶠ p : ℝ in atTop,
      finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : (unitBars 0).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : (unitBars 0).finiteOccurrences => q.1) = 0 ∧
      finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : (unitBars 0).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : (unitBars 0).finiteOccurrences => q.1) = 0)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with p hp
  exact ⟨finitePMatchingCost_empty hp _ _, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty hp _ _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.empty_bottleneck_zero
statement: theorem empty_bottleneck_zero : bottleneck (unitBars 0) (unitBars 0) = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.empty_costs_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem empty_costs_tendsto_zero :

      (fun q : (unitBars 0).finiteOccurrences => q.1)

      (fun q : (unitBars 0).finiteOccurrences => q.1)) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.singleton_empty_costs

theorem singleton_empty_costs {p : ℝ} (_hp : 1 ≤ p) :

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.singleton_empty_bottleneck
statement: theorem singleton_empty_bottleneck : bottleneck (unitBars 1) (unitBars 0) = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.duplicate_empty_costs
statement:
theorem duplicate_empty_costs (p : ℝ) :

      finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : (unitBars 2).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : (unitBars 0).finiteOccurrences => q.1) = (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.duplicate_empty_first_order
statement:
theorem duplicate_empty_first_order :

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.duplicate_empty_three_halves

theorem duplicate_empty_three_halves :

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.duplicate_empty_bottleneck
statement: theorem duplicate_empty_bottleneck : bottleneck (unitBars 2) (unitBars 0) = 1
proof:
:=
  unitBars_bottleneck_empty 2 (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.duplicate_empty_costs_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem duplicate_empty_costs_tendsto_one :
    Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => finitePMatchingCost p

      (fun q : (unitBars 0).finiteOccurrences => q.1)) atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:

      finitePMatchingCost_tendsto_bottleneck _ _ (unitBars_essentialPart 2)
        (unitBars_essentialPart 0)
  · simpa only [duplicate_empty_bottleneck, ENNReal.toReal_one] using
      finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendsto_bottleneck _ _ (unitBars_essentialPart 2)
        (unitBars_essentialPart 0)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.duplicate_singleton_bottleneck
statement: theorem duplicate_singleton_bottleneck : bottleneck (unitBars 2) (unitBars 1) = 1
proof:
:=
  bottleneck_repeated_pair_detected

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.duplicate_singleton_costs
statement:
theorem duplicate_singleton_costs {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : (unitBars 2).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : (unitBars 1).finiteOccurrences => q.1) = 1 ∧
      finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : (unitBars 2).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : (unitBars 1).finiteOccurrences => q.1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let u := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (unitBars_card 2)).symm
  let v := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (unitBars_card 1)).symm
  have hcost : pairAndDelete.totalFinitePowerCost p (fun _ => (0, 2)) (fun _ => (0, 2)) = 1 := by
    have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)
    norm_num [OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost,
      pairAndDelete, Fin.sum_univ_two, finitePairCost, diagonalCost, Real.zero_rpow hp0,
      Fin.exists_fin_two]
  have hu := finitePMatchingCost_le_matching hp (fun _ : Fin 2 => (0, 2))
    (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0, 2)) pairAndDelete
  rw [hcost, Real.one_rpow] at hu
  have hreindex := finitePMatchingCost_reindex u v p
    (fun q : (unitBars 2).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
    (fun q : (unitBars 1).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
  simp only [Function.comp_def, unitBars_coordinates] at hreindex
  rw [hreindex] at hu
  have hl := bottleneck_toReal_le_finitePMatchingCost hp _ _
    (unitBars_essentialPart 2) (unitBars_essentialPart 1)
  rw [duplicate_singleton_bottleneck, ENNReal.toReal_one] at hl
  simp only [unitBars_coordinates] at hl ⊢
  have heq := le_antisymm hu hl
  exact ⟨heq, by rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]; exact heq⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.duplicate_singleton_costs_tendsto_one
statement:
theorem duplicate_singleton_costs_tendsto_one :
    Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => finitePMatchingCost p
      (fun q : (unitBars 2).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
      (fun q : (unitBars 1).finiteOccurrences => q.1)) atTop (𝓝 1) ∧
    Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => finitePBoundaryTransportCost p
      (fun q : (unitBars 2).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
      (fun q : (unitBars 1).finiteOccurrences => q.1)) atTop (𝓝 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa only [duplicate_singleton_bottleneck, ENNReal.toReal_one] using
      finitePMatchingCost_tendsto_bottleneck _ _ (unitBars_essentialPart 2)
        (unitBars_essentialPart 1)
  · simpa only [duplicate_singleton_bottleneck, ENNReal.toReal_one] using
      finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendsto_bottleneck _ _ (unitBars_essentialPart 2)
        (unitBars_essentialPart 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth_positive
statement: theorem essentialBirth_positive (b : ℝ) : (essentialBirth b).IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  apply (orderedQ_isPositive_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro i
  exact Fin.elim0 i

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essential_births_zero_one
statement:
theorem essential_births_zero_one {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : (essentialBirth 0).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : (essentialBirth 1).finiteOccurrences => q.1) = 0 ∧
      bottleneck (essentialBirth 0) (essentialBirth 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hempty (b : ℝ) : IsEmpty (essentialBirth b).finiteOccurrences := by
    apply Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp
    change Fintype.card (finitePart (essentialBirth b).points) = 0
    rw [Multiset.card_coe]
    simp [essentialBirth, finitePart_orderedQ]
  let := hempty 0
  let := hempty 1
  constructor
  · exact finitePMatchingCost_empty hp _ _
  · have hf (b : ℝ) : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
        (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) = finitePart (essentialBirth b).points := by
      simp [essentialBirth, finitePart_orderedQ]
    rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation _ _ _ _ _ _ (hf 0) (hf 1)
      (orderedQ_essential_occurrences 0 1 (Fin.elim0, fun _ => (0 : ℝ)))
      (orderedQ_essential_occurrences 0 1 (Fin.elim0, fun _ => (1 : ℝ)))]
    rw [presentationBottleneck_essential_singletons]
    norm_num [essentialPairCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.continuous_featureAt
statement: theorem continuous_featureAt (σ : ℝ) : Continuous (featureAt σ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (LipschitzWith.of_dist_le' (K := Real.sqrt 2 / |σ|) ?_).continuous
  intro p q
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using norm_featureAt_sub_le σ p q

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.inner_featureAt_left
statement:
private theorem inner_featureAt_left (σ : ℝ) (f : Space σ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ⟪featureAt σ p, f⟫_ℝ = f p
proof:
:= by
  simp [featureAt, RKHS.kerFun_inner]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.continuous_rkhsFunction
statement: theorem continuous_rkhsFunction (σ : ℝ) (f : Space σ) : Continuous f
proof:
:= by
  have h : Continuous (fun p => ⟪featureAt σ p, f⟫_ℝ) :=
    (continuous_featureAt σ).inner continuous_const
  simpa only [inner_featureAt_left] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_rkhsFunction_apply_le
statement:
theorem norm_rkhsFunction_apply_le (σ : ℝ) (f : Space σ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖f p‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inner_featureAt_left σ f p]
  simpa only [norm_featureAt, one_mul] using norm_inner_le_norm (featureAt σ p) f

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.integrable_featureAt
statement:
theorem integrable_featureAt (σ : ℝ) (μ : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    Integrable (featureAt σ) μ
proof:
:= by
  exact (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)).mono'
    (continuous_featureAt σ).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => le_of_eq (norm_featureAt σ p))

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signed_integrable_featureAt
statement:
theorem signed_integrable_featureAt (σ : ℝ) (μ : SignedMeasure (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    μ.Integrable (featureAt σ)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsFiniteMeasure μ.variation := by
    rw [← SignedMeasure.totalVariation_eq_variation]
    infer_instance
  exact integrable_featureAt σ μ.variation

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.integrable_rkhsFunction
statement:
theorem integrable_rkhsFunction (σ : ℝ) (f : Space σ) (μ : Measure (ℝ × ℝ))
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] : Integrable f μ
proof:
:= by
  exact (integrable_const ‖f‖).mono'
    (continuous_rkhsFunction σ f).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => norm_rkhsFunction_apply_le σ f p)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_positiveEmbedding_le_mass
statement:
theorem norm_positiveEmbedding_le_mass (σ : ℝ) (μ : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    ‖positiveEmbedding σ μ‖ ≤ μ.real Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [positiveEmbedding, one_mul] using
    (MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (μ := μ) (f := featureAt σ) (C := 1)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => le_of_eq (norm_featureAt σ p)))

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.positiveEmbedding_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem positiveEmbedding_zero (σ : ℝ) : positiveEmbedding σ 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [positiveEmbedding]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.positiveEmbedding_dirac
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveEmbedding_dirac (σ : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    positiveEmbedding σ (Measure.dirac p) = featureAt σ p
proof:
:= by
  simp [positiveEmbedding]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.positiveEmbedding_add
statement:
theorem positiveEmbedding_add (σ : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure (ℝ × ℝ))
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    positiveEmbedding σ (μ + ν) = positiveEmbedding σ μ + positiveEmbedding σ ν
proof:
:=
  integral_add_measure (integrable_featureAt σ μ) (integrable_featureAt σ ν)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.positiveEmbedding_apply
statement:
theorem positiveEmbedding_apply (σ : ℝ) (μ : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (z : ℝ × ℝ) : positiveEmbedding σ μ z = ∫ p, kernel σ z p ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (integrable_featureAt σ μ) (featureAt σ z)
  simpa only [inner_featureAt, inner_featureAt_left, featureAt_apply, positiveEmbedding] using h.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.inner_positiveEmbedding
statement:
theorem inner_positiveEmbedding (σ : ℝ) (μ : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (f : Space σ) : ⟪f, positiveEmbedding σ μ⟫_ℝ = ∫ p, f p ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have h := integral_inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (integrable_featureAt σ μ) f
  simpa only [featureAt, RKHS.inner_kerFun, Real.inner_apply, mul_one,
    positiveEmbedding] using h.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signedEmbedding_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem signedEmbedding_zero (σ : ℝ) : signedEmbedding σ 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [signedEmbedding]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signedEmbedding_add
statement:
theorem signedEmbedding_add (σ : ℝ) (μ ν : SignedMeasure (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    signedEmbedding σ (μ + ν) = signedEmbedding σ μ + signedEmbedding σ ν
proof:
:= by
  exact VectorMeasure.integral_add_vectorMeasure
    (signed_integrable_featureAt σ μ) (signed_integrable_featureAt σ ν)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signedEmbedding_sub
statement:
theorem signedEmbedding_sub (σ : ℝ) (μ ν : SignedMeasure (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    signedEmbedding σ (μ - ν) = signedEmbedding σ μ - signedEmbedding σ ν
proof:
:= by
  exact VectorMeasure.integral_sub_vectorMeasure
    (signed_integrable_featureAt σ μ) (signed_integrable_featureAt σ ν)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signedEmbedding_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem signedEmbedding_smul (σ c : ℝ) (μ : SignedMeasure (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    signedEmbedding σ (c • μ) = c • signedEmbedding σ μ
proof:
:= by
  exact VectorMeasure.integral_smul_vectorMeasure _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signedEmbedding_toSignedMeasure
statement:
@[simp] theorem signedEmbedding_toSignedMeasure (σ : ℝ) (μ : Measure (ℝ × ℝ))
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] : signedEmbedding σ μ.toSignedMeasure = positiveEmbedding σ μ
proof:
:= by
  exact VectorMeasure.integral_toSignedMeasure

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signedEmbedding_eq_jordan
statement:
theorem signedEmbedding_eq_jordan (σ : ℝ) (μ : SignedMeasure (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    signedEmbedding σ μ = positiveEmbedding σ μ.toJordanDecomposition.posPart -
      positiveEmbedding σ μ.toJordanDecomposition.negPart
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← SignedMeasure.toSignedMeasure_toJordanDecomposition μ]
  rw [JordanDecomposition.toSignedMeasure, signedEmbedding_sub,
    signedEmbedding_toSignedMeasure, signedEmbedding_toSignedMeasure]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_signedEmbedding_le_totalVariation
statement:
theorem norm_signedEmbedding_le_totalVariation (σ : ℝ) (μ : SignedMeasure (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    ‖signedEmbedding σ μ‖ ≤ μ.totalVariation.real Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedEmbedding_eq_jordan]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖positiveEmbedding σ μ.toJordanDecomposition.posPart‖ +
        ‖positiveEmbedding σ μ.toJordanDecomposition.negPart‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ μ.toJordanDecomposition.posPart.real Set.univ +
        μ.toJordanDecomposition.negPart.real Set.univ :=
      add_le_add (norm_positiveEmbedding_le_mass σ _) (norm_positiveEmbedding_le_mass σ _)
    _ = μ.totalVariation.real Set.univ := by
      rw [SignedMeasure.totalVariation, measureReal_add_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.inner_signedEmbedding
statement:
theorem inner_signedEmbedding (σ : ℝ) (μ : SignedMeasure (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : Space σ) :
    ⟪f, signedEmbedding σ μ⟫_ℝ = ∫ᵛ p, f p ∂<•μ
proof:
:= by
  have hp : μ.toJordanDecomposition.posPart.toSignedMeasure.Integrable f := by
    simpa [VectorMeasure.Integrable] using
      integrable_rkhsFunction σ f μ.toJordanDecomposition.posPart
  have hn : μ.toJordanDecomposition.negPart.toSignedMeasure.Integrable f := by
    simpa [VectorMeasure.Integrable] using
      integrable_rkhsFunction σ f μ.toJordanDecomposition.negPart
  rw [signedEmbedding_eq_jordan, inner_sub_right, inner_positiveEmbedding,
    inner_positiveEmbedding]
  conv_rhs => rw [← SignedMeasure.toSignedMeasure_toJordanDecomposition μ]
  rw [JordanDecomposition.toSignedMeasure, VectorMeasure.integral_sub_vectorMeasure hp hn,
    VectorMeasure.integral_toSignedMeasure, VectorMeasure.integral_toSignedMeasure]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signedEmbedding_apply
statement:
theorem signedEmbedding_apply (σ : ℝ) (μ : SignedMeasure (ℝ × ℝ)) (z : ℝ × ℝ) :
    signedEmbedding σ μ z = ∫ᵛ p, kernel σ z p ∂<•μ
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [inner_featureAt_left, featureAt_apply, kernel_symm] using
    inner_signedEmbedding σ μ (featureAt σ z)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_signedEmbedding_sq
statement:
theorem norm_signedEmbedding_sq (σ : ℝ) (μ : SignedMeasure (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    ‖signedEmbedding σ μ‖ ^ 2 =
      ∫ᵛ p, (∫ᵛ q, kernel σ p q ∂<•μ) ∂<•μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, inner_signedEmbedding]
  simp_rw [signedEmbedding_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_signedEmbedding_sub_sq
statement:
theorem norm_signedEmbedding_sub_sq (σ : ℝ) (μ ν : SignedMeasure (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    ‖signedEmbedding σ μ - signedEmbedding σ ν‖ ^ 2 =
      ∫ᵛ p, (∫ᵛ q, kernel σ p q ∂<•(μ - ν)) ∂<•(μ - ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← signedEmbedding_sub, norm_signedEmbedding_sq]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signedEmbedding_dirac
statement:
@[simp] theorem signedEmbedding_dirac (σ : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    signedEmbedding σ (VectorMeasure.dirac p c) = c • featureAt σ p
proof:
:= by
  simp [signedEmbedding]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signedEmbedding_finset_atoms
statement:
theorem signedEmbedding_finset_atoms {I : Type*} (σ : ℝ) (s : Finset I)
    (p : I → ℝ × ℝ) (c : I → ℝ) :
    signedEmbedding σ (∑ i ∈ s, VectorMeasure.dirac (p i) (c i)) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, c i • featureAt σ (p i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s hi ih => simp [hi, signedEmbedding_add, ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signedEmbedding_atomicSignedMeasure
statement:
theorem signedEmbedding_atomicSignedMeasure (σ : ℝ) (m : ℝ × ℝ →₀ ℝ) :
    signedEmbedding σ (atomicSignedMeasure m) = measureEmbedding σ m
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [atomicSignedMeasure, Finsupp.sum, signedEmbedding_finset_atoms]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signedEmbedding_weightedDiagram
statement:
theorem signedEmbedding_weightedDiagram {A B : ℝ} (σ : ℝ)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    signedEmbedding σ (atomicSignedMeasure (weightedMeasure w D)) =
      diagramEmbedding σ w D
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedEmbedding_atomicSignedMeasure, diagramEmbedding_eq_measureEmbedding]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.positiveEmbedding_injective
statement:
theorem positiveEmbedding_injective {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (μ ν : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (h : positiveEmbedding σ μ = positiveEmbedding σ ν) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  let e := (WithLp.homeomorphProd 2 ℝ ℝ).symm
  apply e.measurableEmbedding.map_injective
  apply GaussianSpectral.eq_of_gaussian_integrals hσ
  intro p
  rw [integral_map e.measurable.aemeasurable (by fun_prop),
    integral_map e.measurable.aemeasurable (by fun_prop)]
  have hp := congrArg (fun f : Space σ => f (e.symm p)) h
  rw [positiveEmbedding_apply, positiveEmbedding_apply] at hp
  have hker (x : ℝ × ℝ) : kernel σ (e.symm p) x =
      Real.exp (-‖p - e x‖ ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2)) := by
    rw [kernel_eq_gaussian]
    rfl
  simpa only [hker] using hp

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signedEmbedding_injective
statement:
theorem signedEmbedding_injective {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (signedEmbedding σ)
proof:
:= by
  intro μ ν h
  have hz : signedEmbedding σ (μ - ν) = 0 := by rw [signedEmbedding_sub, h, sub_self]
  rw [signedEmbedding_eq_jordan, sub_eq_zero] at hz
  have hj := positiveEmbedding_injective hσ _ _ hz
  have hdiff : μ - ν = 0 := by
    rw [← SignedMeasure.toSignedMeasure_toJordanDecomposition (μ - ν),
      JordanDecomposition.toSignedMeasure]
    simp only [hj, sub_self]
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 hdiff

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.signedEmbedding_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem signedEmbedding_eq_zero_iff {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (μ : SignedMeasure (ℝ × ℝ)) : signedEmbedding σ μ = 0 ↔ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← signedEmbedding_zero σ, (signedEmbedding_injective hσ).eq_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_signedEmbedding_sub_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem norm_signedEmbedding_sub_eq_zero_iff {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (μ ν : SignedMeasure (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    ‖signedEmbedding σ μ - signedEmbedding σ ν‖ = 0 ↔ μ = ν
proof:
:=
  norm_sub_eq_zero_iff.trans (signedEmbedding_injective hσ).eq_iff

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.probabilityEmbedding_injective
statement:
theorem probabilityEmbedding_injective {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (μ ν : Measure (ℝ × ℝ)) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] [IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
    (h : positiveEmbedding σ μ = positiveEmbedding σ ν) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  have hsigned : μ.toSignedMeasure = ν.toSignedMeasure :=
    signedEmbedding_injective hσ (by simpa only [signedEmbedding_toSignedMeasure] using h)
  simpa only [Measure.variation_toSignedMeasure] using
    congrArg VectorMeasure.variation hsigned

name: TDA.Persistence.sum_filter_offDiagonal
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p l ih =>
    by_cases hp : p.1 = p.2
    · simpa [hp, hf p hp] using ih
    · simpa [hp] using congrArg (fun a : ℝ => f p + a) ih

name: TDA.Persistence.signedFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ
statement:
theorem signedFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ (m n : ℕ)
    (z : DiagramCoordinates m n) :
    signedFiniteEndpointDifference (orderedQ m n z) =
      ∑ i : Fin m, ((z.1 i).2 - (z.1 i).1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := sum_filter_offDiagonal (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => p.2 - p.1)
    (by intro p hp; simp [hp]) (List.ofFn z.1)
  simpa [signedFiniteEndpointDifference, orderedQ, List.sum_ofFn,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Function.comp_def] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ
statement:
theorem absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ (m n : ℕ)
    (z : DiagramCoordinates m n) :
    absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference (orderedQ m n z) =
      ∑ i : Fin m, |(z.1 i).2 - (z.1 i).1|
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := sum_filter_offDiagonal (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => |p.2 - p.1|)
    (by intro p hp; simp [hp]) (List.ofFn z.1)
  simpa [absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference, orderedQ, List.sum_ofFn,
    Function.comp_def] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.signedFiniteEndpointDifference_c1_all
statement:
theorem signedFiniteEndpointDifference_c1_all (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    C1ThroughAllRepresentatives signedFiniteEndpointDifference D
proof:
:= by
  intro m n z _
  refine ⟨Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.mem_univ z, ?_⟩
  apply contDiffOn_univ.mpr
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun w : DiagramCoordinates m n =>
      ∑ i : Fin m, ((w.1 i).2 - (w.1 i).1)) := by
    apply ContDiff.sum
    intro i _
    fun_prop
  simpa [Function.comp_def, signedFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ] using hs

name: TDA.Persistence.constantDiagram_hasLift
statement:
theorem constantDiagram_hasLift {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    ∃ m n, Nonempty (LocalDiagramLift (fun _ : E => D) m n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, n, z, hz⟩ := orderedQ_surjective D
  subst D
  exact ⟨m, n, ⟨constantDiagramLift m n z⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialOnly_coordinates_vary
statement:
theorem essentialOnly_coordinates_vary :
    orderedQ 0 1 (Fin.elim0, fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) ≠
      orderedQ 0 1 (Fin.elim0, fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := congrArg (fun D : Diagram ℝ => D.points.count (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))) h
  simp [orderedQ_count_essential] at hc

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteOnly_coordinates_vary
statement:
theorem finiteOnly_coordinates_vary :
    orderedQ 1 0 (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), 1), Fin.elim0) ≠
      orderedQ 1 0 (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), 2), Fin.elim0)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := congrArg (fun D : Diagram ℝ =>
    D.points.count ((0 : ℝ), ((1 : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ))) h
  rw [orderedQ_count_finite 1 0 _ 0 1,
    orderedQ_count_finite 1 0 _ 0 1] at hc
  simp at hc

name: TDA.Persistence.signedFiniteEndpointDifference_onePair_fderiv
statement:
theorem signedFiniteEndpointDifference_onePair_fderiv (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => signedFiniteEndpointDifference
        (orderedQ 1 0 (fun _ => q, Fin.elim0))) p =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ) -
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => signedFiniteEndpointDifference
        (orderedQ 1 0 (fun _ => q, Fin.elim0))) =
      (fun q => q.2 - q.1) := by
    funext q
    simp [signedFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ]
  rw [hfun]
  exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasFDerivAt.sub
    (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasFDerivAt).fderiv

name: TDA.Persistence.onePair_zero_is_empty
statement:
private theorem onePair_zero_is_empty :
    orderedQ 1 0 (onePair 0) = orderedQ 0 0 (Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0)
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  simp [orderedQ, onePair]

name: TDA.Persistence.absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference_not_c1_empty
statement:
theorem absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference_not_c1_empty :
    ¬ C1ThroughAllRepresentatives absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference
        (orderedQ 0 0 (Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨W, hWopen, hzW, hW⟩ := h 1 0 (onePair 0) onePair_zero_is_empty
  have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference ∘ orderedQ 1 0) (onePair 0) :=
    (hW.contDiffAt (hWopen.mem_nhds hzW)).differentiableAt_one
  have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ onePair 0 := by
    unfold onePair
    fun_prop
  have hcurve := hg.comp 0 hc
  apply not_differentiableAt_abs_zero
  simpa [Function.comp_def, absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ,
    onePair] using hcurve

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirPowerValue_le_plan
statement:
theorem reservoirPowerValue_le_plan (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (R : ℝ≥0∞) (γ : Measure (Space × Space))
    (hfirst : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R)
    (hsecond : γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R) :
    reservoirPowerValue p μ ν R ≤ ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂γ
proof:
:= by
  exact (iInf_le (fun τ : Measure (Space × Space) =>
    ⨅ (_ : τ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R ∧
      τ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R),
      ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂τ) γ).trans
        (iInf_le (fun _ : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R ∧
          γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R =>
          ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂γ) ⟨hfirst, hsecond⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_eq_reservoirPowerValue
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_eq_reservoirPowerValue
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hR : R < ∞) (htotal : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν = reservoirPowerValue p μ ν R
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · unfold reservoirPowerValue
    apply le_iInf
    intro γ
    apply le_iInf
    intro hγ
    obtain ⟨π, hπ, hcost⟩ :=
      Reverse.exists_boundaryPlan_cost_le p hp γ μ ν R hγ.1 hγ.2
    exact (boundaryTransportPowerValue_le_plan p hπ).trans hcost
  · unfold boundaryTransportPowerValue
    apply le_iInf
    intro π
    apply le_iInf
    intro hπ
    obtain ⟨hfirst, hsecond, hcost⟩ :=
      collapsedAugmentation_forward hπ R hR htotal p hp
    exact (reservoirPowerValue_le_plan p μ ν R (collapsedAugmentation π R)
      hfirst hsecond).trans hcost

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirPowerValue_independent
statement:
theorem reservoirPowerValue_independent
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (R S : ℝ≥0∞) (hR : R < ∞) (hS : S < ∞)
    (hμνR : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R)
    (hμνS : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ S) :
    reservoirPowerValue p μ ν R = reservoirPowerValue p μ ν S
proof:
:=
  (boundaryTransportPowerValue_eq_reservoirPowerValue p hp μ ν R hR hμνR).symm.trans
    (boundaryTransportPowerValue_eq_reservoirPowerValue p hp μ ν S hS hμνS)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_eq_reservoirDistance
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_eq_reservoirDistance
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hR : R < ∞) (htotal : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R) :
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν = reservoirDistance p μ ν R
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ≥0∞ => z ^ (1 / p))
    (boundaryTransportPowerValue_eq_reservoirPowerValue p hp μ ν R hR htotal)

name: TDA.Persistence.sum_rpow_le_rpow_sum
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [Real.zero_rpow (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp))]
  | @insert k s hk ih =>
    have hfs : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i := fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hk, Finset.sum_insert hk]
    calc
      _ ≤ f k ^ p + (∑ i ∈ s, f i) ^ p := add_le_add le_rfl (ih hfs)
      _ ≤ _ := Real.add_rpow_le_rpow_add (hf k (Finset.mem_insert_self k s))
        (Finset.sum_nonneg hfs) hp

name: TDA.Persistence.root_sum_rpow_le_sum
proof:
:= by
  have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hf k) p)
    (sum_rpow_le_rpow_sum Finset.univ f hp (fun k _ => hf k))
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_trans zero_le_one hp))
  simpa only [Real.rpow_rpow_inv (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => hf k)
    (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp))] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.sum_le_card_rpow_mul_root
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)
  have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow
    (Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => hf k) p)
    (Real.rpow_sum_le_const_mul_sum_rpow_of_nonneg Finset.univ hp (fun k _ => hf k))
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_trans zero_le_one hp))
  rw [Real.rpow_rpow_inv (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => hf k) hp0,
    Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hf k) p),
    ← Real.rpow_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _)] at h
  have hexp : (p - 1) * p⁻¹ = 1 - p⁻¹ := by field_simp
  simpa only [Finset.card_univ, hexp] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.root_sum_rpow_comparison
statement:
private theorem root_sum_rpow_comparison {K : Type*} [Fintype K] (f : K → ℝ)
    {r s : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) (hf : ∀ k, 0 ≤ f k) :
    (∑ k, f k ^ s) ^ s⁻¹ ≤ (∑ k, f k ^ r) ^ r⁻¹ ∧
      (∑ k, f k ^ r) ^ r⁻¹ ≤
        (Fintype.card K : ℝ) ^ (r⁻¹ - s⁻¹) * (∑ k, f k ^ s) ^ s⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hrpos : 0 < r := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hr
  have hspos : 0 < s := lt_of_lt_of_le hrpos hrs
  have hq : 1 ≤ s / r := (le_div_iff₀ hrpos).mpr (by simpa using hrs)
  have hmul : r * (s / r) = s := by field_simp
  have hinv : (s / r)⁻¹ * r⁻¹ = s⁻¹ := by
    field_simp
  have hexp : (1 - (s / r)⁻¹) * r⁻¹ = r⁻¹ - s⁻¹ := by
    rw [sub_mul, one_mul, hinv]
  have hpowers : ∑ k, (f k ^ r) ^ (s / r) = ∑ k, f k ^ s := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    rw [← Real.rpow_mul (hf k), hmul]
  have hsum : 0 ≤ ∑ k, f k ^ s :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hf k) s
  constructor
  · have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow
      (Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ =>
        Real.rpow_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (hf k) r) (s / r)) _)
      (root_sum_rpow_le_sum (fun k => f k ^ r) hq
        (fun k => Real.rpow_nonneg (hf k) r)) (inv_nonneg.mpr hrpos.le)
    rw [hpowers, ← Real.rpow_mul hsum, hinv] at h
    exact h
  · have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hf k) r)
      (sum_le_card_rpow_mul_root (fun k => f k ^ r) hq
        (fun k => Real.rpow_nonneg (hf k) r)) (inv_nonneg.mpr hrpos.le)
    rw [hpowers, Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
      (Real.rpow_nonneg hsum _), ← Real.rpow_mul (Nat.cast_nonneg _), hexp,
      ← Real.rpow_mul hsum, hinv] at h
    exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.comparisonCharge_nonneg
statement:
private theorem comparisonCharge_nonneg
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (k : I ⊕ J) :
    0 ≤ comparisonCharge M x y k
proof:
:= by
  cases k with
  | inl i =>
    change 0 ≤ match M.finite i with
      | some j => (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal
      | none => (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal
    cases M.finite i <;> exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  | inr j =>
    simp only [comparisonCharge]
    split_ifs
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_eq_comparisonCharges
statement:
private theorem totalFinitePowerCost_eq_comparisonCharges
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y = ∑ k, comparisonCharge M x y k ^ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  unfold totalFinitePowerCost totalBoundaryCost
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    cases h : M.finite i <;> simp only [comparisonCharge, h]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    simp only [comparisonCharge]
    split_ifs <;> simp only [Real.zero_rpow hp]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_eq_comparisonCharges
statement:
private theorem totalFiniteCost_eq_comparisonCharges
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.totalFiniteCost x y = ∑ k, comparisonCharge M x y k
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [totalFinitePowerCost_one, Real.rpow_one] using
    M.totalFinitePowerCost_eq_comparisonCharges one_ne_zero x y

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.root_totalFinitePowerCost_le_totalFiniteCost
statement:
private theorem root_totalFinitePowerCost_le_totalFiniteCost
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹ ≤ M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [M.totalFinitePowerCost_eq_comparisonCharges
    (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)), M.totalFiniteCost_eq_comparisonCharges]
  exact root_sum_rpow_le_sum _ hp (M.comparisonCharge_nonneg x y)

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_le_card_rpow_mul_root
statement:
private theorem totalFiniteCost_le_card_rpow_mul_root
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.totalFiniteCost x y ≤ ((Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 - p⁻¹) *
      M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [M.totalFinitePowerCost_eq_comparisonCharges
    (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)), M.totalFiniteCost_eq_comparisonCharges]
  simpa only [Fintype.card_sum] using
    sum_le_card_rpow_mul_root _ hp (M.comparisonCharge_nonneg x y)

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.root_totalFinitePowerCost_comparison
statement:
private theorem root_totalFinitePowerCost_comparison
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) {r s : ℝ}
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.totalFinitePowerCost s x y ^ s⁻¹ ≤ M.totalFinitePowerCost r x y ^ r⁻¹ ∧
      M.totalFinitePowerCost r x y ^ r⁻¹ ≤
        ((Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (r⁻¹ - s⁻¹) *
          M.totalFinitePowerCost s x y ^ s⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [M.totalFinitePowerCost_eq_comparisonCharges
    (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hr.trans hrs))),
    M.totalFinitePowerCost_eq_comparisonCharges (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hr))]
  simpa only [Fintype.card_sum] using
    root_sum_rpow_comparison _ hr hrs (M.comparisonCharge_nonneg x y)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_le_firstOrder
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_le_firstOrder {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost p x y ≤ finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
  exact (finitePMatchingCost_le_matching hp x y M).trans
    ((M.root_totalFinitePowerCost_le_totalFiniteCost hp x y).trans_eq hM)

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_p
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_p {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y ≤
      ((Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 - p⁻¹) * finitePMatchingCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_pMatching p x y
  exact (finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost x y M).trans
    (by simpa only [hM] using M.totalFiniteCost_le_card_rpow_mul_root hp x y)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_firstOrder
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_firstOrder {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y ≤ finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost,
    finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  exact finitePMatchingCost_le_firstOrder hp x y

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_p
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_p {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost x y ≤
      ((Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 - p⁻¹) *
        finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_le_of_exponent_le
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_le_of_exponent_le {r s : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost s x y ≤ finitePMatchingCost r x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_pMatching r x y
  exact (finitePMatchingCost_le_matching (hr.trans hrs) x y M).trans
    ((M.root_totalFinitePowerCost_comparison hr hrs x y).1.trans_eq hM)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_of_exponent_le
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_of_exponent_le {r s : ℝ}
    (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost r x y ≤
      ((Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (r⁻¹ - s⁻¹) *
        finitePMatchingCost s x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_pMatching s x y
  exact (finitePMatchingCost_le_matching hr x y M).trans
    (by simpa only [hM] using (M.root_totalFinitePowerCost_comparison hr hrs x y).2)

    (v : Fin 0 → α) (hv : StrictMono v)

    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    [Fintype (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)]
    (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ)
    (i j : Fin f.criticalValues.card) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyIncl k
        (f.gradeFiltration.monotone hij) n).hom) =
      (TDA.Persistence.ofIndexBars f.criticalValue f.criticalValue.strictMono
        (TDA.Persistence.gradeHomologyBarcode k f n)).points.countP
          (fun p => p.1 ≤ f.criticalValue i ∧
            (f.criticalValue j : WithTop α) < p.2)

  exact (rank_gradeHomologyMap k f n i j hij).trans
    (ofIndexBars_countP_grades f.criticalValue f.criticalValue.strictMono
      (gradeHomologyBarcode k f n) i j).symm

statement:
private theorem criticalValue_tail_sanity
    {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V]
    {α : Type w} [LinearOrder α]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    [Fintype (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)]
    (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α)
    (hN : 0 < f.criticalValues.card) (r : α)
    (hr : f.criticalValue
      ⟨f.criticalValues.card - 1, Nat.sub_lt hN (by decide)⟩ ≤ r) :
    f.sublevel r = K ∧
      f.gradeFiltration ⟨f.criticalValues.card - 1, Nat.sub_lt hN (by decide)⟩ = K ∧
      f.sublevel r = f.gradeFiltration
        ⟨f.criticalValues.card - 1, Nat.sub_lt hN (by decide)⟩
proof:
:= by
  have ht : f.sublevel r = K := f.sublevel_eq_self_of_last_le hN r hr
  have hg : f.gradeFiltration
      ⟨f.criticalValues.card - 1, Nat.sub_lt hN (by decide)⟩ = K := by
    rw [f.gradeFiltration_apply]
    exact f.sublevel_eq_self_of_last_le hN _ le_rfl
  exact ⟨ht, hg, ht.trans hg.symm⟩

proof:

  intro hz
  have hfree : IsZero (freeVertexModule (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)) :=
    IsZero.of_iso hz (regularVertexIso (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)).symm
  have hsub : Subsingleton ((freeVertexModule (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)).obj boolBirthGrade) :=
    ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (hfree.obj boolBirthGrade)
  have hzero := hsub.elim
    (GradedFree.birth (R := ℚ) (generators (S := Bool)) boolBirthGrade) 0
  have hval := congrArg
    (fun x : (freeVertexModule (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)).obj boolBirthGrade => x.val) hzero
  have hcoeff := congrArg
    (fun f : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset Bool →₀ ℚ => f boolBirthGrade) hval
  change (Finsupp.single boolBirthGrade (1 : ℚ)) boolBirthGrade =
    (0 : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset Bool →₀ ℚ) boolBirthGrade at hcoeff
  have hcontradiction : (1 : ℚ) = 0 := by simpa using hcoeff
  norm_num at hcontradiction

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.interleaved_zero_iff
statement:
theorem interleaved_zero_iff (R : Rectangle n) (ρ : ℝ≥0) :
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ρ (R.module (k := k)) 0) ↔
      ¬ Significant (ρ + ρ) R
proof:
:= by
  rw [significant_iff_transition_ne_zero (k := k)]
  simp only [not_not]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨I⟩
    have hφ : I.φ = 0 := by
      apply NatTrans.ext
      funext p
      exact (Functor.zero_obj (C := Fin n → ℝ) (D := ModuleCat.{u} k)
        (translation ρ p)).eq_of_tgt _ _
    simpa [hφ] using I.φ_ψ.symm
  · intro h
    exact ⟨interleavingZero R ρ h⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.IsMatching.source_covered
proof:
:= by
