  | some j => exact ⟨j, rfl⟩
  | none => exact False.elim ((interleaved_zero_iff (k := k) (R i) ρ).mp
      (hM.source_zero i h) hi)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.IsMatching.target_covered
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra h
  push Not at h
  exact (interleaved_zero_iff (k := k) (S j) ρ).mp (hM.target_zero j h) hj

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.exists_significant_injection
statement:
theorem exists_significant_injection (hn : 0 < n)
    {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (RectangleFamily.module (k := k) R)
      (RectangleFamily.module S)) :
    ∃ f : {i // Significant
        (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
          RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (R i)} → κ,
      Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ i, Neighbor (k := k)
        (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (R i.val) (S (f i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Fintype.all_card_le_filter_rel_iff_exists_injective
    (fun (i : {i // Significant
        (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
          RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (R i)}) (j : κ) =>
      Neighbor (k := k) (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε)
        (R i.val) (S j))).mp
  intro A
  let A' : Finset ι := A.image Subtype.val
  have hA : ∀ i ∈ A', Significant
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
        RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (R i) := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
    exact a.property
  have h := card_le_neighbors hn R S ε I A' hA
  have he : neighbors (k := k) R S A'
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun j => ∃ a ∈ A, Neighbor (k := k)
        (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (R a.val) (S j)) := by
    ext j
    simp [neighbors, A']
  rw [he, Finset.card_image_of_injective A Subtype.val_injective] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.exists_matching
statement:
theorem exists_matching (hn : 0 < n)
    {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (RectangleFamily.module (k := k) R)
      (RectangleFamily.module S)) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching ι κ PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      IsMatching (k := k) (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) R S M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ρ := RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε
  let P := fun i => Significant (ρ + ρ) (R i)
  let Q := fun j => Significant (ρ + ρ) (S j)
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfr⟩ := exists_significant_injection hn R S ε I
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgr⟩ := exists_significant_injection hn S R ε I.symm
  obtain ⟨M, hp, hs, ht⟩ := FiniteOccurrenceMatching.exists_two_sided P Q (fun i j =>
    Neighbor (k := k) ρ (R i) (S j)) f hf hfr g hg
    (fun j => (hgr j).elim (fun h => ⟨h.symm⟩))
  refine ⟨M, hp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    apply (interleaved_zero_iff (k := k) (R i) ρ).mpr
    intro h
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hs i h
    simp [hi] at hj
  · intro j hj
    apply (interleaved_zero_iff (k := k) (S j) ρ).mpr
    intro h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ht j h
    exact hj i hi

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem ext {i j : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N}
    (hφ : i.φ = j.φ) (hψ : i.ψ = j.ψ) : i = j
proof:
:= by
  cases i; cases j; cases hφ; cases hψ; rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.φ_ψ_app
statement:
theorem φ_ψ_app (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    i.φ.app a ≫ i.ψ.app (translation ε a) ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom.app a =
      (transition (ε + ε) M).app a
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f => f.app a) i.φ_ψ

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.ψ_φ_app
statement:
theorem ψ_φ_app (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    i.ψ.app a ≫ i.φ.app (translation ε a) ≫ (compIso ε ε N).hom.app a =
      (transition (ε + ε) N).app a
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f => f.app a) i.ψ_φ

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.equations_iff
statement:
theorem equations_iff (f : M ⟶ (shift ε).obj N) (g : N ⟶ (shift ε).obj M) :
    (f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom = transition (ε + ε) M ∧
      g ≫ (shift ε).map f ≫ (compIso ε ε N).hom = transition (ε + ε) N) ↔
    (∀ a, f.app a ≫ g.app (translation ε a) ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom.app a =
      (transition (ε + ε) M).app a) ∧
    (∀ a, g.app a ≫ f.app (translation ε a) ≫ (compIso ε ε N).hom.app a =
      (transition (ε + ε) N).app a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf, hg⟩
    exact ⟨fun a => congrArg (fun x => x.app a) hf,
      fun a => congrArg (fun x => x.app a) hg⟩
  · rintro ⟨hf, hg⟩
    constructor
    · apply NatTrans.ext; funext a; exact hf a
    · apply NatTrans.ext; funext a; exact hg a

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.twice_le
statement:
theorem twice_le (ε : ℝ≥0) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    a ≤ translation ε (translation ε a)
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  change a j ≤ (a j + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)
  exact (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg).trans
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.φ_ψ_structureMap
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem φ_ψ_structureMap (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N)
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    i.φ.app a ≫ i.ψ.app (translation ε a) = structureMap M (twice_le ε a)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono ((compIso ε ε M).hom.app a)).mp
  erw [Category.assoc, i.φ_ψ_app]
  change M.map _ = M.map _ ≫ M.map _
  erw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.enlarge_equation
statement:
private theorem enlarge_equation (h : ε ≤ δ)
    (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (i.φ ≫ shiftLE h N).app a ≫
        (i.ψ ≫ shiftLE h M).app (translation δ a) =
      structureMap M (twice_le δ a)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [NatTrans.comp_app, shiftLE, shift, reindex]
  repeat' erw [Category.assoc]
  erw [i.ψ.naturality_assoc]
  erw [← Category.assoc, i.φ_ψ_structureMap]
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  erw [← M.map_comp, ← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.compose_equation
statement:
private theorem compose_equation (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N)
    (j : CoordinateInterleaving δ N P) (h : ε + δ = σ)
    (h' : δ + ε = σ) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (composeMap i.φ j.φ h).app a ≫
        (composeMap j.ψ i.ψ h').app (translation σ a) =
      structureMap M (twice_le σ a)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [composeMap, NatTrans.comp_app, shift_map_app]
  simp only [compIso_hom_app, congrIso_hom_app]
  repeat' erw [Category.assoc]
  
  erw [j.ψ.naturality_assoc]
  erw [j.ψ.naturality_assoc]
  erw [i.ψ.naturality_assoc]
  erw [i.ψ.naturality_assoc]
  erw [← Category.assoc (j.φ.app (translation ε a))
    (j.ψ.app (translation δ (translation ε a))), j.φ_ψ_structureMap]
  erw [i.ψ.naturality_assoc]
  erw [← Category.assoc (i.φ.app a) (i.ψ.app (translation ε a)),
    i.φ_ψ_structureMap]
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  repeat' erw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.val_eq_zero
statement:
theorem val_eq_zero (S : Set P) {p : P} (hp : p ∉ S)
    (x : fiber (k := k) S p) : (x : k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [fiber, hp] using x.property

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.structureMap_val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change ((map S x) : k) = _
  by_cases hp : p ∈ S <;> by_cases hq : q ∈ S
  · simp [map, hp, hq]
  · simp [map, hp, hq]
  · simp [map, hp, hq, val_eq_zero S hp x]
  · simp [map, hp, hq]

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.structureMap_eq_zero_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem structureMap_eq_zero_of_not_mem (S : Set P) (hS : S.OrdConnected)
    {p q : P} (h : p ≤ q) (hz : ¬ (p ∈ S ∧ q ∈ S)) :
    structureMapLinear (module (k := k) S hS) h = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change map S = 0
  simp [map, hz]

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.structureMap_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem structureMap_eq_zero_iff (S : Set P) (hS : S.OrdConnected)
    {p q : P} (h : p ≤ q) :
    structureMapLinear (module (k := k) S hS) h = 0 ↔ ¬ (p ∈ S ∧ q ∈ S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hz ⟨hp, hq⟩
    have he := congrArg (fun f => (f (one (k := k) S hp) : k)) hz
    rw [structureMap_val] at he
    simp [hq, one] at he
  · exact structureMap_eq_zero_of_not_mem S hS h

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.comparisonLinear_val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : p ∈ T <;> simp [comparisonLinear, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.comparison_app_val
statement:
theorem comparison_app_val (S T : Set P) (hS : S.OrdConnected)
    (hT : T.OrdConnected) (c : k)
    (hcompat : ∀ p q, p ≤ q → p ∈ S → q ∈ T → (q ∈ S ↔ p ∈ T))
    (p : P) (x : fiber (k := k) S p) :
    (((comparison S T hS hT c hcompat).app p).hom x : k) =
      if p ∈ T then c * (x : k) else 0
proof:
:=
  comparisonLinear_val S T c p x

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.comparison_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem comparison_ne_zero_iff (S T : Set P) (hS : S.OrdConnected)
    (hT : T.OrdConnected) (c : k)
    (hcompat : ∀ p q, p ≤ q → p ∈ S → q ∈ T → (q ∈ S ↔ p ∈ T)) :
    comparison S T hS hT c hcompat ≠ 0 ↔ c ≠ 0 ∧ (S ∩ T).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · intro hc
      apply h
      ext p x
      change (((comparison S T hS hT c hcompat).app p).hom x : k) = 0
      rw [comparison_app_val, hc]
      simp
    · by_contra hn
      apply h
      ext p x
      change (((comparison S T hS hT c hcompat).app p).hom x : k) = 0
      by_cases hs : p ∈ S
      · have ht : p ∉ T := fun ht => hn ⟨p, hs, ht⟩
        rw [comparison_app_val, if_neg ht]
      · rw [comparison_app_val, val_eq_zero S hs x]
        simp
  · rintro ⟨hc, p, hp, ht⟩ hz
    have he := congrArg (fun f => (((f.app p).hom (one (k := k) S hp)) : k)) hz
    rw [comparison_app_val] at he
    exact hc (by simpa [ht, one] using he)

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.app_val_eq_mul
statement:
theorem app_val_eq_mul (S T : Set P) (hS : S.OrdConnected)
    (hT : T.OrdConnected) (α : module (k := k) S hS ⟶ module T hT)
    {p : P} (hp : p ∈ S) (x : fiber (k := k) S p) :
    (((α.app p).hom x) : k) =
      (x : k) * (((α.app p).hom (one (k := k) S hp)) : k)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x = (x : k) • one (k := k) S hp := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [one]
  conv_lhs => rw [hx, map_smul]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.ne_zero_iff_exists_coefficient
statement:
theorem ne_zero_iff_exists_coefficient (S T : Set P) (hS : S.OrdConnected)
    (hT : T.OrdConnected) (α : module (k := k) S hS ⟶ module T hT) :
    α ≠ 0 ↔ ∃ (p : P) (hp : p ∈ S),
      (((α.app p).hom (one (k := k) S hp)) : k) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hn
    push Not at hn
    apply h
    ext p x
    by_cases hp : p ∈ S
    · simp [app_val_eq_mul S T hS hT α hp x, hn]
    · have hx : x = 0 := Subtype.ext (val_eq_zero S hp x)
      simp [hx]
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, hne⟩ hz
    apply hne
    rw [hz]
    rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.coefficient_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem coefficient_eq_of_le (S T : Set P) (hS : S.OrdConnected)
    (hT : T.OrdConnected) (α : module (k := k) S hS ⟶ module T hT)
    {p q : P} (h : p ≤ q) (hp : p ∈ S) (hq : q ∈ S) (ht : q ∈ T) :
    (((α.app p).hom (one (k := k) S hp)) : k) =
      (((α.app q).hom (one (k := k) S hq)) : k)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := congrArg (fun f => (f.hom (one (k := k) S hp) : k))
    (α.naturality (homOfLE h))
  have hm : structureMapLinear (module (k := k) S hS) h (one S hp) = one S hq := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [structureMap_val]
    simp [hq, one]
  change (((α.app q).hom (structureMapLinear (module S hS) h (one S hp))) : k) =
    (structureMapLinear (module T hT) h ((α.app p).hom (one S hp)) : k) at hn
  rw [hm, structureMap_val, if_pos ht] at hn
  exact hn.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.mem_target_of_nonzero
statement:
theorem mem_target_of_nonzero (S T : Set P) (hS : S.OrdConnected)
    (hT : T.OrdConnected) (α : module (k := k) S hS ⟶ module T hT)
    {p q : P} (h : q ≤ p) (hp : p ∈ S) (hq : q ∈ S)
    (hne : (((α.app p).hom (one (k := k) S hp)) : k) ≠ 0) : q ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hqt
  have hpT : p ∈ T := by
    by_contra hpT
    exact hne (val_eq_zero T hpT _)
  have he := coefficient_eq_of_le S T hS hT α h hq hp hpT
  rw [val_eq_zero T hqt] at he
  exact hne he.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.SupportInterval.mem_source_of_nonzero
statement:
theorem mem_source_of_nonzero (S T : Set P) (hS : S.OrdConnected)
    (hT : T.OrdConnected) (α : module (k := k) S hS ⟶ module T hT)
    {p q : P} (h : p ≤ q) (hp : p ∈ S) (hq : q ∈ T)
    (hne : (((α.app p).hom (one (k := k) S hp)) : k) ≠ 0) : q ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hqs
  have hn := congrArg (fun f => (f.hom (one (k := k) S hp) : k))
    (α.naturality (homOfLE h))
  change (((α.app q).hom (structureMapLinear (module S hS) h (one S hp))) : k) =
    (structureMapLinear (module T hT) h ((α.app p).hom (one S hp)) : k) at hn
  have hm : structureMapLinear (module (k := k) S hS) h = 0 :=
    (structureMap_eq_zero_iff S hS h).mpr (fun hh => hqs hh.2)
  rw [hm, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero,
    structureMap_val, if_pos hq] at hn
  exact hne hn.symm

    (swapStage j).toLinearMap.comp (compositeZero.step i j h).toLin' =
      (basisSwapped.step i j h).toLin'.comp (swapStage i).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp at h
  · apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    funext a
    fin_cases a
    · change ((!![1; 0] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 1) ℚ) *ᵥ x) 1 =
        ((!![0; 1] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 1) ℚ) *ᵥ x) 0
      simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    · change ((!![1; 0] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 1) ℚ) *ᵥ x) 0 =
        ((!![0; 1] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 1) ℚ) *ᵥ x) 1
      simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
  · apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    funext a
    fin_cases a
    change ((!![0, 1] : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 2) ℚ) *ᵥ x) 0 =
      ((!![1, 0] : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 2) ℚ) *ᵥ ![x (1 : Fin 2), x (0 : Fin 2)]) 0
    simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.tagPoint_strict
statement:
@[simp] theorem tagPoint_strict
    (t : FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.RankProjectiveHookTag S) :
    (tagPoint t).val.1 < (tagPoint t).val.2
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | inl ab => exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr ab.property
  | inr a => exact WithTop.coe_lt_top a

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.tagPoint_injective
statement:
private theorem tagPoint_injective :
    Function.Injective (tagPoint (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  cases a with
  | inl ab =>
      cases b with
      | inl cd =>
          apply congrArg Sum.inl
          apply Subtype.ext
          have h := congrArg Subtype.val hab
          injection h with hfst hsnd
          exact Prod.ext (WithTop.coe_injective hfst) (WithTop.coe_injective hsnd)
      | inr c =>
          have h := congrArg Subtype.val hab
          simp [tagPoint] at h
  | inr a =>
      cases b with
      | inl cd =>
          have h := congrArg Subtype.val hab
          simp [tagPoint] at h
      | inr b =>
          apply congrArg Sum.inr
          have h := congrArg Subtype.val hab
          injection h with hfst _
          exact WithTop.coe_injective hfst

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.tagPoint_surjective
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  have ha₀ : p.val.val.1 ≠ ⊤ := by
    intro h
    have hp : (⊤ : WithTop S) < p.val.val.2 := by simpa [h] using p.property
    exact (not_lt_of_ge le_top) hp
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp ha₀
  by_cases hb₀ : p.val.val.2 = ⊤
  · refine ⟨Sum.inr a, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext <;> simp [tagPoint, ha, hb₀]
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := WithTop.ne_top_iff_exists.mp hb₀
    have hab : a < b := by
      apply WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp
      simpa [ha, hb] using p.property
    refine ⟨Sum.inl ⟨(a, b), hab⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    ext <;> simp [tagPoint, ha, hb]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.homCondition_iff_pairRel
statement:
theorem homCondition_iff_pairRel (s t : HookTag (S := S)) :
    HomCondition (P := S) s t ↔
      tagPoint (S := S) t ≤ tagPoint (S := S) s ∧
        ¬ (tagPoint (S := S) t).val.2 ≤ (tagPoint (S := S) s).val.1
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> cases t <;>
    simp [HomCondition, endpoints, birth, death, tagPoint, and_assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.tagPoint_eq_strictTag_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem tagPoint_eq_strictTag_iff (t : HookTag (S := S))
    (p : StrictVertex S) :
    tagPoint (S := S) t = p.val ↔ t = strictTag (S := S) p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply tagPoint_injective
    exact h.trans (tagPoint_strictTag (S := S) p).symm
  · rintro rfl
    exact tagPoint_strictTag (S := S) p

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_comp
statement:
theorem hookMatrixUnit_comp (s t u : HookTag (S := S))
    (hst : HomCondition (P := S) s t) (htu : HomCondition (P := S) t u)
    (hsu : HomCondition (P := S) s u) :
    hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t hst ≫
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) t u htu =
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s u hsu
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [hookMatrixUnit, HookSum, hookFamily]
  have hcomp := normalizedHom_comp_of_condition (k := k) s t u hst htu hsu
  calc
    _ = biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫
          normalizedHom (k := k) s t hst ≫
          (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t ≫
            biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t) ≫
          normalizedHom (k := k) t u htu ≫
          biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) u := by cat_disch
    _ = biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫
          normalizedHom (k := k) s t hst ≫
          normalizedHom (k := k) t u htu ≫
          biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) u := by
      simp [biproduct.ι_π]
    _ = biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫
          normalizedHom (k := k) s u hsu ≫
          biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) u := by
      rw [← Category.assoc (normalizedHom (k := k) s t hst)
        (normalizedHom (k := k) t u htu)
        (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) u)]
      rw [hcomp]
    _ = _ := by rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_ne
statement:
theorem hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_ne (s t r u : HookTag (S := S))
    (hst : HomCondition (P := S) s t) (hru : HomCondition (P := S) r u)
    (htr : t ≠ r) :
    hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t hst ≫
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r u hru = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [hookMatrixUnit, HookSum, hookFamily]
  calc
    _ = biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫
          normalizedHom (k := k) s t hst ≫
          (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t ≫
            biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) r) ≫
          normalizedHom (k := k) r u hru ≫
          biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) u := by cat_disch
    _ = 0 := by simp [biproduct.ι_π, htr]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_not_condition
statement:
theorem hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_not_condition (s t u : HookTag (S := S))
    (hst : HomCondition (P := S) s t) (htu : HomCondition (P := S) t u)
    (hsu : ¬ HomCondition (P := S) s u) :
    hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t hst ≫
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) t u htu = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [hookMatrixUnit, HookSum, hookFamily]
  calc
    _ = biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫
          normalizedHom (k := k) s t hst ≫
          (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t ≫
            biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t) ≫
          normalizedHom (k := k) t u htu ≫
          biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) u := by cat_disch
    _ = biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫
          (normalizedHom (k := k) s t hst ≫ normalizedHom (k := k) t u htu) ≫
          biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) u := by cat_disch
    _ = 0 := by
      rw [normalizedHom_comp_of_not_condition (k := k) s t u hst htu hsu]
      simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_middle_eq
statement:
theorem hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_middle_eq (s t r u : HookTag (S := S))
    (hst : HomCondition (P := S) s t) (hru : HomCondition (P := S) r u)
    (htr : t = r) (hsu : HomCondition (P := S) s u) :
    hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t hst ≫
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r u hru =
        hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s u hsu
proof:
:= by
  cases htr
  exact hookMatrixUnit_comp (k := k) (S := S) s t u hst hru hsu

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_middle_eq_not_condition
statement:
theorem hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_middle_eq_not_condition
    (s t r u : HookTag (S := S))
    (hst : HomCondition (P := S) s t) (hru : HomCondition (P := S) r u)
    (htr : t = r) (hsu : ¬ HomCondition (P := S) s u) :
    hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t hst ≫
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r u hru = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases htr
  exact hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_not_condition (k := k) (S := S) s t u hst hru hsu

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_diagonal_components
statement:
@[simp] theorem hookMatrixUnit_diagonal_components (s t : HookTag (S := S))
    (h : HomCondition (P := S) s t) :
    biproduct.components (hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t h) s t =
      normalizedHom (k := k) s t h
proof:
:= by
  change biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫
      biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫
      normalizedHom (k := k) s t h ≫
      biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t ≫
      biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t = _
  calc
    _ = (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫
          biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s) ≫
          normalizedHom (k := k) s t h ≫
          (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t ≫
            biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t) := by cat_disch
    _ = _ := by simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_components_zero_of_left_ne
statement:
@[simp] theorem hookMatrixUnit_components_zero_of_left_ne
    (s t : HookTag (S := S)) (h : HomCondition (P := S) s t)
    (a b : HookTag (S := S)) (ha : a ≠ s) :
    biproduct.components (hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t h) a b = 0
proof:
:= by
  change biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) a ≫
      biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫
      normalizedHom (k := k) s t h ≫
      biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t ≫
      biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) b = 0
  calc
    _ = (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) a ≫
          biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s) ≫
          normalizedHom (k := k) s t h ≫
          biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t ≫
          biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) b := by cat_disch
    _ = 0 := by simp [ha]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookMatrixUnit_components_zero_of_right_ne
statement:
@[simp] theorem hookMatrixUnit_components_zero_of_right_ne
    (s t : HookTag (S := S)) (h : HomCondition (P := S) s t)
    (a b : HookTag (S := S)) (hb : b ≠ t) :
    biproduct.components (hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s t h) a b = 0
proof:
:= by
  change biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) a ≫
      biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫
      normalizedHom (k := k) s t h ≫
      biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t ≫
      biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) b = 0
  calc
    _ = biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) a ≫
          biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫
          normalizedHom (k := k) s t h ≫
          (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t ≫
            biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) b) := by cat_disch
    _ = 0 := by simp [Ne.symm hb]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.components_add
statement:
private theorem components_add (f g : End (HookSum (k := k) (S := S)))
    (s t : HookTag (S := S)) :
    biproduct.components (f + g) s t =
      biproduct.components f s t + biproduct.components g s t
proof:
:= by
  change (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫ (f + g)) ≫
      biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t = _
  calc
    _ = (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫ f +
          biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫ g) ≫
          biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t := by
            rw [Preadditive.comp_add]
    _ = biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫ f ≫
          biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t +
        biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫ g ≫
          biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t := by
            rw [Preadditive.add_comp]
            rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.components_smul
proof:
:= by
  change (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫ (c • f)) ≫
      biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t = _
  calc
    _ = (c • (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫ f)) ≫
          biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t := by
            rw [Linear.comp_smul]
    _ = c • (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) s ≫ f ≫
          biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t) := by
            rw [Linear.smul_comp]
            rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.delta_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem delta_apply (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (x y : PairPoset S) :
    delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq x y = if x = p ∧ y = q then 1 else 0
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidence_sum_apply
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih => simp [hi, IncidenceAlgebra.add_apply, ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidence_eq_deltaExpansion
statement:
theorem incidence_eq_deltaExpansion (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    f = deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S) f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext a b hab
  rw [deltaExpansion, incidence_sum_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨(a, b), hab⟩]
  · simp [IncidenceAlgebra.constSMul_apply, delta_apply]
  · intro c hc hca
    have hval : c.val ≠ (a, b) := fun h => hca (Subtype.ext h)
    have hneq : ¬ (a = c.val.1 ∧ b = c.val.2) := by
      intro h
      apply hval
      exact Prod.ext h.1.symm h.2.symm
    simp [IncidenceAlgebra.constSMul_apply, delta_apply, hneq]
  · simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.delta_mul
statement:
theorem delta_mul (p q r s : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq * delta (k := k) (S := S) r s hrs =
      if h : q = r then delta (k := k) (S := S) p s (by
        subst r
        exact hpq.trans hrs)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hqr : q = r
  · subst r
    ext a b hab
    by_cases hap : a = p
    · subst a
      by_cases hbs : b = s
      · subst b
        have hqmem : q ∈ Finset.Icc p s := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hpq, hrs⟩
        simp [IncidenceAlgebra.mul_apply, delta_apply, hqmem, Finset.sum_ite_eq']
      · simp [IncidenceAlgebra.mul_apply, delta_apply, hbs]
    · simp [IncidenceAlgebra.mul_apply, delta_apply, hap]
  · ext a b hab
    rw [IncidenceAlgebra.mul_apply]
    simp only [delta_apply]
    rw [dif_neg hqr]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    by_cases hap : a = p
    · by_cases hbs : b = s
      · by_cases hxq : x = q
        · subst x
          simp [hqr]
        · simp [hxq]
      · simp [hbs]
    · simp [hap]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonal_between_iff_crosses
statement:
theorem diagonal_between_iff_crosses (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    (∃ d : PairPoset S, IsDiagonal (S := S) d ∧ p ≤ d ∧ d ≤ q) ↔
      CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d, hd, hpd, hdq⟩
    change d.val.1 = d.val.2 at hd
    change p.val.1 ≤ d.val.1 ∧ p.val.2 ≤ d.val.2 at hpd
    change d.val.1 ≤ q.val.1 ∧ d.val.2 ≤ q.val.2 at hdq
    change p.val.2 ≤ q.val.1
    calc
      p.val.2 ≤ d.val.2 := hpd.2
      _ = d.val.1 := hd.symm
      _ ≤ q.val.1 := hdq.1
  · intro h
    change p.val.2 ≤ q.val.1 at h
    refine ⟨⟨(q.val.1, q.val.1), le_rfl⟩, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change p.val.1 ≤ q.val.1 ∧ p.val.2 ≤ q.val.1
      exact ⟨hpq.1, h⟩
    · change q.val.1 ≤ q.val.1 ∧ q.val.1 ≤ q.val.2
      exact ⟨le_rfl, q.property⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.left_strict_of_not_crosses
statement:
theorem left_strict_of_not_crosses (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (h : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) : p.val.1 < p.val.2
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne p.property ?_
  intro heq
  apply h
  change p.val.2 ≤ q.val.1
  rw [← heq]
  exact hpq.1

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.right_strict_of_not_crosses
statement:
theorem right_strict_of_not_crosses (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (h : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) : q.val.1 < q.val.2
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne q.property ?_
  intro heq
  apply h
  change p.val.2 ≤ q.val.1
  rw [heq]
  exact hpq.2

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross
statement:
theorem incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross
    (p q : StrictVertex S) (hpq : p.val ≤ q.val)
    (hcross : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p.val q.val) :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
        (delta (k := k) p.val q.val hpq) =
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) (strictTag (S := S) q)
        (strictTag (S := S) p)
        ((homCondition_iff_pairRel (S := S)
          (strictTag (S := S) q) (strictTag (S := S) p)).2
          ⟨by simpa [tagPoint_strictTag] using hpq, by
            simpa [CrossesDiagonal, tagPoint_strictTag] using hcross⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let hqp : HomCondition (P := S) (strictTag (S := S) q) (strictTag (S := S) p) :=
    (homCondition_iff_pairRel (S := S) (strictTag (S := S) q)
      (strictTag (S := S) p)).2
      ⟨by simpa [tagPoint_strictTag] using hpq,
        by simpa [CrossesDiagonal, tagPoint_strictTag] using hcross⟩
  apply (biproduct.matrixEquiv
    (f := hookFamily (k := k) (S := S))
    (g := hookFamily (k := k) (S := S))).injective
  funext s t
  simp only [biproduct.matrixEquiv_apply]
  change biproduct.components
      (biproduct.matrix fun s t =>
        incidenceComponent (k := k) (S := S)
          (delta (k := k) p.val q.val hpq) s t) s t = _
  rw [biproduct.matrix_components]
  by_cases hs : s = strictTag (S := S) q
  · subst s
    by_cases ht : t = strictTag (S := S) p
    · subst t
      simp [incidenceComponent, delta_apply, hqp, tagPoint_strictTag]
    · have hnot : tagPoint (S := S) t ≠ p.val := by
        intro heq
        apply ht
        exact (tagPoint_eq_strictTag_iff (S := S) t p).1 heq
      have ht' : t ≠ strictTag (S := S) p := ht
      rw [hookMatrixUnit_components_zero_of_right_ne (S := S)
        (s := strictTag (S := S) q) (t := strictTag (S := S) p) hqp
        (a := strictTag (S := S) q) (b := t) ht']
      simp [incidenceComponent, delta_apply, hnot]
  · have hnot : tagPoint (S := S) s ≠ q.val := by
      intro heq
      apply hs
      exact (tagPoint_eq_strictTag_iff (S := S) s q).1 heq
    rw [hookMatrixUnit_components_zero_of_left_ne (S := S)
      (s := strictTag (S := S) q) (t := strictTag (S := S) p) hqp
      (a := s) (b := t) hs]
    simp [incidenceComponent, delta_apply, hnot]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross_pair
statement:
theorem incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross_pair
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hcross : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (delta (k := k) p q hpq) =
      hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
        (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq hcross))
        (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq hcross))
        (noCrossHomCondition (S := S) p q hpq hcross)
proof:
:= by
  let hp : StrictVertex S := noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq hcross
  let hq : StrictVertex S := noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq hcross
  simpa [hp, hq, noCrossTargetVertex, noCrossSourceVertex] using
    incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross (k := k) hp hq hpq hcross

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEnd_delta_of_cross
statement:
theorem incidenceToEnd_delta_of_cross
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hcross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (delta (k := k) p q hpq) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (biproduct.matrixEquiv
    (f := hookFamily (k := k) (S := S))
    (g := hookFamily (k := k) (S := S))).injective
  funext s t
  simp only [biproduct.matrixEquiv_apply]
  change biproduct.components
      (biproduct.matrix fun s t =>
        incidenceComponent (k := k) (S := S) (delta (k := k) p q hpq) s t)
      s t = biproduct.components 0 s t
  rw [biproduct.matrix_components]
  simp only [biproduct.components, comp_zero, zero_comp]
  by_cases hst : HomCondition (P := S) s t
  · by_cases htp : tagPoint (S := S) t = p
    · by_cases hsq : tagPoint (S := S) s = q
      · have hpair := (homCondition_iff_pairRel (S := S) s t).1 hst
        have hcross' : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S)
            (tagPoint (S := S) t) (tagPoint (S := S) s) := hpair.2
        have hcontra : False := by
          apply hcross'
          simpa [CrossesDiagonal, htp, hsq] using hcross
        exact False.elim hcontra
      · simp [incidenceComponent, delta_apply, hst, htp, hsq,
          tagPoint_eq_strictTag_iff]
    · simp [incidenceComponent, delta_apply, hst, htp,
        tagPoint_eq_strictTag_iff]
  · simp [incidenceComponent, hst]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEnd_delta_cases
statement:
theorem incidenceToEnd_delta_cases (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (delta (k := k) p q hpq) =
      if h : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q then 0 else
        hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
          (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq h))
          (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq h))
          (noCrossHomCondition (S := S) p q hpq h)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q
  · simp [h, incidenceToEnd_delta_of_cross (k := k) p q hpq h]
  · simp [h, incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross_pair (k := k) p q hpq h]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.normalizedHom_self
statement:
theorem normalizedHom_self (s : HookTag (S := S))
    (h : HomCondition (P := S) s s) :
    normalizedHom (k := k) s s h = 𝟙 (hookModule (k := k) s)
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | inl ab =>
      apply (Hook.homEquivKernel ab.property
        (hookModule (k := k) (.inl ab))).injective
      apply Subtype.ext
      change ((normalizedHom (k := k) (.inl ab) (.inl ab) h).app
          (birth (.inl ab))).hom
          (birthUnit (k := k) (.inl ab)) = birthUnit (k := k) (.inl ab)
      rw [normalizedHom_app_birth]
      change structureMapLinear (hookModule (k := k) (.inl ab))
          (h.1) (birthUnit (k := k) (.inl ab)) = _
      rw [structureMapLinear_self]
      rfl
  | inr a =>
      apply (HookInfinity.homEquivFiber a
        (hookModule (k := k) (.inr a))).injective
      change ((normalizedHom (k := k) (.inr a) (.inr a) h).app
          (birth (.inr a))).hom
          (birthUnit (k := k) (.inr a)) = birthUnit (k := k) (.inr a)
      rw [normalizedHom_app_birth]
      change structureMapLinear (hookModule (k := k) (.inr a))
          h.1 (birthUnit (k := k) (.inr a)) = _
      rw [structureMapLinear_self]
      rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndLinear_map_one
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndLinear_map_one :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (1 : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) =
      1
proof:
:= by
  apply (biproduct.matrixEquiv
    (f := hookFamily (k := k) (S := S))
    (g := hookFamily (k := k) (S := S))).injective
  funext s t
  simp only [biproduct.matrixEquiv_apply]
  change biproduct.components
      (biproduct.matrix fun s t =>
        incidenceComponent (k := k) (S := S) (1 : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) s t)
      s t = biproduct.components (1 : End (HookSum (k := k) (S := S))) s t
  rw [biproduct.matrix_components]
  by_cases hst : s = t
  · subst t
    have hss : HomCondition (P := S) s s := by
      apply (homCondition_iff_pairRel (S := S) s s).2
      exact ⟨le_rfl, not_le_of_gt (tagPoint_strict (S := S) s)⟩
    simp [incidenceComponent, hss, normalizedHom_self, biproduct.components]
  · have hpoints : tagPoint (S := S) t ≠ tagPoint (S := S) s := by
      intro h
      exact hst (tagPoint_injective h.symm)
    simp [incidenceComponent, hst, hpoints, biproduct.components]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndLinear_map_mul_delta
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndLinear_map_mul_delta
    (p q r s : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
        (delta (k := k) p q hpq * delta (k := k) r s hrs) =
      incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (delta (k := k) p q hpq) *
        incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (delta (k := k) r s hrs)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hqr : q = r
  · subst r
    have hmul : delta (k := k) p q hpq * delta (k := k) q s hrs =
        delta (k := k) p s (hpq.trans hrs) := by
      rw [delta_mul]
      simp
    rw [hmul]
    by_cases hpqCross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q
    · have hpsCross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p s := le_trans hpqCross hrs.1
      rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_cross (k := k) p s (hpq.trans hrs) hpsCross]
      rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_cross (k := k) p q hpq hpqCross]
      simp
    · by_cases hqsCross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) q s
      · have hpsCross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p s := le_trans hpq.2 hqsCross
        rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_cross (k := k) p s (hpq.trans hrs) hpsCross]
        rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_cross (k := k) q s hrs hqsCross]
        simp
      · by_cases hpsCross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p s
        · let vq₁ : StrictVertex S := noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq hpqCross
          let vq₂ : StrictVertex S := noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) q s hrs hqsCross
          let vp : StrictVertex S := noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq hpqCross
          let vs : StrictVertex S := noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) q s hrs hqsCross
          have hmid : vq₁ = vq₂ := by
            apply Subtype.ext
            rfl
          have hmidTag : strictTag (S := S) vq₁ = strictTag (S := S) vq₂ :=
            congrArg (strictTag (S := S)) hmid
          let h1 := noCrossHomCondition (S := S) p q hpq hpqCross
          let h2 := noCrossHomCondition (S := S) q s hrs hqsCross
          have hpsNot : ¬ HomCondition (P := S) (strictTag (S := S) vs)
              (strictTag (S := S) vp) := by
            intro h
            have hpair := (homCondition_iff_pairRel (S := S)
              (strictTag (S := S) vs) (strictTag (S := S) vp)).1 h
            have hnot : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p s := by
              simpa [CrossesDiagonal, tagPoint_strictTag, vs, vp,
                noCrossSourceVertex, noCrossTargetVertex] using hpair.2
            exact hnot hpsCross
          rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_cross (k := k) p s (hpq.trans hrs) hpsCross]
          rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross_pair (k := k) p q hpq hpqCross]
          rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross_pair (k := k) q s hrs hqsCross]
          rw [End.mul_def]
          exact (hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_middle_eq_not_condition (k := k) (S := S)
            (strictTag (S := S) vs) (strictTag (S := S) vq₂)
            (strictTag (S := S) vq₁) (strictTag (S := S) vp)
            h2 h1 hmidTag.symm hpsNot).symm
        · let vq₁ : StrictVertex S := noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq hpqCross
          let vq₂ : StrictVertex S := noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) q s hrs hqsCross
          let vp : StrictVertex S := noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq hpqCross
          let vs : StrictVertex S := noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) q s hrs hqsCross
          have hmid : vq₁ = vq₂ := by
            apply Subtype.ext
            rfl
          have hmidTag : strictTag (S := S) vq₁ = strictTag (S := S) vq₂ :=
            congrArg (strictTag (S := S)) hmid
          have hsource : noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p s (hpq.trans hrs) hpsCross = vs := by
            apply Subtype.ext
            rfl
          have htarget : noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p s (hpq.trans hrs) hpsCross = vp := by
            apply Subtype.ext
            rfl
          let h1 := noCrossHomCondition (S := S) p q hpq hpqCross
          let h2 := noCrossHomCondition (S := S) q s hrs hqsCross
          let h3 := noCrossHomCondition (S := S) p s (hpq.trans hrs) hpsCross
          rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross_pair (k := k) p q hpq hpqCross]
          rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross_pair (k := k) q s hrs hqsCross]
          rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross_pair (k := k) p s (hpq.trans hrs) hpsCross]
          rw [End.mul_def]
          simpa [hsource, htarget] using
            (hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_middle_eq (k := k) (S := S)
              (strictTag (S := S) vs) (strictTag (S := S) vq₂)
              (strictTag (S := S) vq₁) (strictTag (S := S) vp)
              h2 h1 hmidTag.symm h3).symm
  · have hmul : delta (k := k) p q hpq * delta (k := k) r s hrs = 0 := by
      rw [delta_mul]
      simp [hqr]
    rw [hmul]
    simp only [map_zero]
    by_cases hpqCross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q
    · rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_cross (k := k) p q hpq hpqCross]
      simp
    · by_cases hrsCross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) r s
      · rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_cross (k := k) r s hrs hrsCross]
        simp
      · let vq : StrictVertex S := noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq hpqCross
        let vr : StrictVertex S := noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) r s hrs hrsCross
        have hmidTag : strictTag (S := S) vr ≠ strictTag (S := S) vq := by
          intro heq
          have hval : vr.val = vq.val := by
            have h := congrArg (tagPoint (S := S)) heq
            calc
              vr.val = tagPoint (S := S) (strictTag (S := S) vr) :=
                (tagPoint_strictTag (S := S) vr).symm
              _ = tagPoint (S := S) (strictTag (S := S) vq) := h
              _ = vq.val := tagPoint_strictTag (S := S) vq
          exact hqr (by simpa [vr, vq, noCrossTargetVertex, noCrossSourceVertex] using hval.symm)
        rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross_pair (k := k) p q hpq hpqCross]
        rw [incidenceToEnd_delta_of_no_cross_pair (k := k) r s hrs hrsCross]
        rw [End.mul_def]
        exact (hookMatrixUnit_comp_of_ne (k := k) (S := S)
          (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) r s hrs hrsCross))
          (strictTag (S := S) vr)
          (strictTag (S := S) vq)
          (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq hpqCross))
          (noCrossHomCondition (S := S) r s hrs hrsCross)
          (noCrossHomCondition (S := S) p q hpq hpqCross)
          hmidTag).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.smul_mul_smul_eq
statement:
private theorem smul_mul_smul_eq (a b : k) {A : Type*} [Semiring A] [Algebra k A]
    (x y : A) : (a • x) * (b • y) = (a * b) • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, smul_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndLinear_eq_delta_sum
statement:
private theorem incidenceToEndLinear_eq_delta_sum (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) f =
      ∑ i : ComparablePair S, f i.val.1 i.val.2 •
        incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
          (delta (k := k) i.val.1 i.val.2 i.property)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) f =
        incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
          (deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S) f) := by
      exact congrArg (incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S))
        (incidence_eq_deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S) f)
    _ = _ := by simp only [deltaExpansion, map_sum, map_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidence_mul_delta_double_sum
statement:
private theorem incidence_mul_delta_double_sum
    (f g : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    f * g = ∑ i : ComparablePair S, ∑ j : ComparablePair S,
      (f i.val.1 i.val.2 * g j.val.1 j.val.2) •
        (delta (k := k) i.val.1 i.val.2 i.property *
          delta (k := k) j.val.1 j.val.2 j.property)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    f * g = deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S) f *
        deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S) g :=
      congrArg₂ (fun x y : Incidence (k := k) (S := S) => x * y)
        (incidence_eq_deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S) f)
        (incidence_eq_deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S) g)
    _ = ∑ i : ComparablePair S,
        (f i.val.1 i.val.2 • delta (k := k) i.val.1 i.val.2 i.property) *
          ∑ j : ComparablePair S,
            g j.val.1 j.val.2 • delta (k := k) j.val.1 j.val.2 j.property := by
      simp only [deltaExpansion, Finset.sum_mul]
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [smul_mul_smul_eq]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndLinear_map_mul
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndLinear_map_mul (f g : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) (f * g) =
      incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) f *
        incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ i : ComparablePair S, ∑ j : ComparablePair S,
        (f i.val.1 i.val.2 * g j.val.1 j.val.2) •
          incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
            (delta (k := k) i.val.1 i.val.2 i.property *
              delta (k := k) j.val.1 j.val.2 j.property) := by
      rw [incidence_mul_delta_double_sum (k := k) (S := S) f g]
      simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
    _ = ∑ i : ComparablePair S, ∑ j : ComparablePair S,
        (f i.val.1 i.val.2 * g j.val.1 j.val.2) •
          (incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
              (delta (k := k) i.val.1 i.val.2 i.property) *
            incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
              (delta (k := k) j.val.1 j.val.2 j.property)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [incidenceToEndLinear_map_mul_delta]
    _ = (∑ i : ComparablePair S,
          f i.val.1 i.val.2 • incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
            (delta (k := k) i.val.1 i.val.2 i.property)) *
        ∑ j : ComparablePair S,
          g j.val.1 j.val.2 • incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
            (delta (k := k) j.val.1 j.val.2 j.property) := by
      symm
      calc
        _ = ∑ i : ComparablePair S,
            (f i.val.1 i.val.2 • incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
              (delta (k := k) i.val.1 i.val.2 i.property)) *
              ∑ j : ComparablePair S,
                g j.val.1 j.val.2 • incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
                  (delta (k := k) j.val.1 j.val.2 j.property) := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
        _ = _ := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i hi
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j hj
          rw [smul_mul_smul_eq]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [incidenceToEndLinear_eq_delta_sum (k := k) (S := S) f,
        incidenceToEndLinear_eq_delta_sum (k := k) (S := S) g]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndLinear_components
statement:
@[simp] theorem incidenceToEndLinear_components
    (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (s t : HookTag (S := S)) :
    biproduct.components (incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) f) s t =
      incidenceComponent (k := k) (S := S) f s t
proof:
:= by
  simp [incidenceToEndLinear, biproduct.matrix_components]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookComponentScalar_spec
statement:
private theorem hookComponentScalar_spec (F : End (HookSum (k := k) (S := S)))
    (s t : HookTag (S := S)) (h : HomCondition (P := S) s t) :
    biproduct.components F s t =
      hookComponentScalar (k := k) (S := S) F s t h • normalizedHom (k := k) s t h
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (hom_eq_smul_normalized (k := k) s t h
    (biproduct.components F s t))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.strictTag_of_tagPoint
statement:
private theorem strictTag_of_tagPoint (s : HookTag (S := S)) :
    strictTag (S := S) ⟨tagPoint (S := S) s, tagPoint_strict (S := S) s⟩ = s
proof:
:= by
  symm
  exact (tagPoint_eq_strictTag_iff (S := S) s
    ⟨tagPoint (S := S) s, tagPoint_strict (S := S) s⟩).1 rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndAlgHom_surjective
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndAlgHom_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro F
  refine ⟨endToIncidence (k := k) (S := S) F, ?_⟩
  apply (biproduct.matrixEquiv
    (f := hookFamily (k := k) (S := S))
    (g := hookFamily (k := k) (S := S))).injective
  funext s t
  change biproduct.components
      (incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
        (endToIncidence (k := k) (S := S) F)) s t =
    biproduct.components F s t
  rw [incidenceToEndLinear_components]
  by_cases hst : HomCondition (P := S) s t
  · let p : PairPoset S := tagPoint (S := S) t
    let q : PairPoset S := tagPoint (S := S) s
    have hpq : p ≤ q := (homCondition_iff_pairRel (S := S) s t).1 hst |>.1
    have hcross : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q :=
      (homCondition_iff_pairRel (S := S) s t).1 hst |>.2
    have hsource : noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq hcross =
        ⟨tagPoint (S := S) s, tagPoint_strict (S := S) s⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl
    have htarget : noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq hcross =
        ⟨tagPoint (S := S) t, tagPoint_strict (S := S) t⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      rfl
    have hsourceTag : strictTag (S := S)
        (noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq hcross) = s := by
      rw [hsource]
      exact strictTag_of_tagPoint (S := S) s
    have htargetTag : strictTag (S := S)
        (noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq hcross) = t := by
      rw [htarget]
      exact strictTag_of_tagPoint (S := S) t
    have hcoef : endToIncidence (k := k) (S := S) F p q =
        hookComponentScalar (k := k) (S := S) F s t hst := by
      simp [endToIncidence, p, q, hpq, hcross, hsourceTag, htargetTag]
    have hcoef' : endToIncidence (k := k) (S := S) F
        (tagPoint (S := S) t) (tagPoint (S := S) s) =
        hookComponentScalar (k := k) (S := S) F s t hst := by
      simpa [p, q] using hcoef
    simp only [incidenceComponent, dif_pos hst]
    rw [hcoef']
    exact (hookComponentScalar_spec (k := k) (S := S) F s t hst).symm
  · simp only [incidenceComponent, hst, zero_smul]
    exact (hom_eq_zero_of_not_condition (k := k) s t hst
      (biproduct.components F s t)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdempotent_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalIdempotent_apply (x y : PairPoset S) :
    diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) x y =
      if x = y ∧ IsDiagonal x then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdempotent_eq_diagonalDeltaExpansion
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x y hxy
  rw [diagonalIdempotent_apply]
  rw [diagonalDeltaExpansion, incidence_sum_apply]
  by_cases h : x = y ∧ IsDiagonal (S := S) x
  · rcases h with ⟨rfl, hxdiag⟩
    rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, hxdiag⟩]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single x]
    · rw [dif_pos hxdiag]
      simp [delta_apply]
    · intro p hp hpx
      by_cases hpd : IsDiagonal (S := S) p
      · rw [dif_pos hpd]
        simp [delta_apply, Ne.symm hpx]
      · rw [dif_neg hpd]
        simp
    · simp
  · simp only [if_neg h]
    symm
    change ∑ p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (PairPoset S)),
      (if hp : IsDiagonal (S := S) p then delta (k := k) p p le_rfl else 0) x y = 0
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro p hp
    by_cases hpd : IsDiagonal (S := S) p
    · rw [dif_pos hpd]
      have hpair : ¬ (x = p ∧ y = p) := by
        intro hpair
        apply h
        constructor
        · exact hpair.1.trans hpair.2.symm
        · simpa [hpair.1] using hpd
      simp [delta_apply, hpair]
    · rw [dif_neg hpd]
      simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdempotent_mul_self
statement:
theorem diagonalIdempotent_mul_self :
    diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) *
        diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) =
      diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [diagonalIdempotent_eq_diagonalDeltaExpansion]
  simp only [diagonalDeltaExpansion, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  by_cases hpdiag : IsDiagonal (S := S) p
  · rw [dif_pos hpdiag]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single p]
    · rw [dif_pos hpdiag]
      rw [delta_mul (k := k) (S := S) p p p p le_rfl le_rfl]
      simp
    · intro q hq hqp
      by_cases hqdiag : IsDiagonal (S := S) q
      · rw [dif_pos hqdiag]
        rw [delta_mul (k := k) (S := S) q q p p le_rfl le_rfl]
        simp [hqp]
      · simp [hqdiag]
    · simp
  · simp [hpdiag]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.delta_mul_diagonalIdempotent_right
statement:
private theorem delta_mul_diagonalIdempotent_right (p q : PairPoset S)
    (hpq : p ≤ q) (hq : IsDiagonal (S := S) q) :
    delta (k := k) p q hpq * diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) =
      delta (k := k) p q hpq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [diagonalIdempotent_eq_diagonalDeltaExpansion]
  simp only [diagonalDeltaExpansion, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single q]
  · simp [delta_mul, hq]
  · intro x hx hxq
    by_cases hdiag : IsDiagonal (S := S) x
    · simp [delta_mul, hdiag]
      intro hqx
      exact (hxq hqx.symm).elim
    · simp [hdiag]
  · simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdeal_mem_delta_of_cross
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_mem_delta_of_cross (p q : PairPoset S)
    (hpq : p ≤ q) (hcross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    delta (k := k) p q hpq ∈ diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hpd, hdq⟩ :=
    (diagonal_between_iff_crosses (S := S) p q hpq).2 hcross
  have hdiag : IsDiagonal (S := S) d := hd
  have hpq' : p ≤ q := hpd.trans hdq
  have hmul : delta (k := k) p d hpd * delta (k := k) d q hdq =
      delta (k := k) p q hpq' := by
    rw [delta_mul]
    simp
  have hfactor : delta (k := k) p q hpq' =
      (delta (k := k) p d hpd * diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S)) *
        delta (k := k) d q hdq := by
    rw [delta_mul_diagonalIdempotent_right (k := k) (S := S) p d hpd hdiag]
    exact hmul.symm
  have hfactor' : delta (k := k) p q hpq =
      (delta (k := k) p d hpd * diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S)) *
        delta (k := k) d q hdq := by simpa using hfactor
  rw [hfactor']
  apply Ideal.subset_span
  exact ⟨(delta (k := k) p d hpd, delta (k := k) d q hdq), rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalGenerator_apply_eq_zero_of_not_crosses
statement:
theorem diagonalGenerator_apply_eq_zero_of_not_crosses
    (a b : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hnc : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    (a * diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) * b) p q = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [IncidenceAlgebra.mul_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  rcases Finset.mem_Icc.mp hx with ⟨hpx, hxq⟩
  have hxdiag : ¬ IsDiagonal (S := S) x := by
    intro hdiag
    exact hnc ((diagonal_between_iff_crosses (S := S) p q hpq).1
      ⟨x, hdiag, hpx, hxq⟩)
  have hleft : (a * diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S)) p x = 0 := by
    rw [IncidenceAlgebra.mul_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro d hd
    by_cases hdx : d = x
    · subst d
      simp [diagonalIdempotent_apply, hxdiag]
    · simp [diagonalIdempotent_apply, hdx]
  simp [hleft]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.crossingDeltaSpan_le_diagonalIdeal
statement:
theorem crossingDeltaSpan_le_diagonalIdeal (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (hf : f ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)) :
    f ∈ diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction (s := Set.range fun c :
      {r : ComparablePair S // CrossesDiagonal (S := S) r.val.1 r.val.2} =>
        delta (k := k) c.val.val.1 c.val.val.2 c.val.property)
    (p := fun f _ => f ∈ diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) ?mem ?zero ?add ?smul hf
  · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    exact diagonalIdeal_mem_delta_of_cross (k := k) (S := S)
      c.val.val.1 c.val.val.2 c.val.property c.property
  · exact (diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)).zero_mem
  · intro x y hx hy hxi hyi
    exact Ideal.add_mem _ hxi hyi
  · intro c f hspan hf
    simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_one_mul] using
      (Ideal.mul_mem_left (diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
        (algebraMap k (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) c) hf)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdeal_isTwoSided
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_isTwoSided :
    (diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)).IsTwoSided
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun {a} b ha => ?_⟩
  refine Submodule.span_induction (s := Set.range fun z : Incidence (k := k) (S := S) ×
      Incidence (k := k) (S := S) => z.1 * diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) * z.2)
    (p := fun x _ => x * b ∈
    diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) ?mem ?zero ?add ?smul ha
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
    apply Ideal.subset_span
    exact ⟨(z.1, z.2 * b), by simp [mul_assoc]⟩
  · simp
  · intro x y hx hy ihx ihy
    simpa [add_mul] using Ideal.add_mem _ ihx ihy
  · intro c x hx ih
    simpa [smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc] using
      (Ideal.mul_mem_left (diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) c ih)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndAlgHom_diagonalIdempotent_eq_zero
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndAlgHom_diagonalIdempotent_eq_zero :
    incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S)
        (diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (biproduct.matrixEquiv
    (f := hookFamily (k := k) (S := S))
    (g := hookFamily (k := k) (S := S))).injective
  funext s t
  change biproduct.components
      (incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S)
        (diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S))) s t =
    biproduct.components (0 : End (HookSum (k := k) (S := S))) s t
  rw [incidenceToEndLinear_components]
  by_cases hst : HomCondition (P := S) s t
  · have hnot : ¬ (tagPoint (S := S) t = tagPoint (S := S) s ∧
        IsDiagonal (S := S) (tagPoint (S := S) t)) := by
      rintro ⟨_, hdiag⟩
      exact (ne_of_gt (tagPoint_strict (S := S) t)) hdiag.symm
    simp [incidenceComponent, hst, diagonalIdempotent_apply, hnot,
      biproduct.components]
  · simp [incidenceComponent, hst, biproduct.components]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdeal_le_incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_le_incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker :
    diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) ≤
      RingHom.ker (incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  apply Ideal.span_le.2
  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
  change incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S)
      (z.1 * diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) * z.2) = 0
  simp only [map_mul, incidenceToEndAlgHom_diagonalIdempotent_eq_zero,
    mul_zero, zero_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndAlgHom_kernel_coefficient_zero
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndAlgHom_kernel_coefficient_zero
    (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (hker : incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S) f = 0)
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hcross : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    f p q = 0
proof:
:= by
  let source : HookTag (S := S) :=
    strictTag (S := S) (noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq hcross)
  let target : HookTag (S := S) :=
    strictTag (S := S) (noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq hcross)
  let hst : HomCondition (P := S) source target :=
    noCrossHomCondition (S := S) p q hpq hcross
  have hcomponent : biproduct.components
      (incidenceToEndLinear (k := k) (S := S) f) source target = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun F : End (HookSum (k := k) (S := S)) =>
      biproduct.components F source target) hker
    simpa [incidenceToEndAlgHom, biproduct.components] using h
  rw [incidenceToEndLinear_components] at hcomponent
  have hscalar : f p q • normalizedHom (k := k) source target hst = 0 := by
    simp only [incidenceComponent] at hcomponent
    rw [dif_pos hst] at hcomponent
    simpa only [source, target, tagPoint_strictTag,
      noCrossTargetVertex, noCrossSourceVertex] using hcomponent
  rcases smul_eq_zero.mp hscalar with hzero | hnorm
  · exact hzero
  · exact (normalizedHom_ne_zero (k := k) source target hst hnorm).elim

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.crossingDeltaSpan_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
statement:
theorem crossingDeltaSpan_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
    (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (hf : f ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S))
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hnc : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    f p q = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction (s := Set.range fun c :
      {r : ComparablePair S // CrossesDiagonal (S := S) r.val.1 r.val.2} =>
        delta (k := k) c.val.val.1 c.val.val.2 c.val.property)
    (p := fun f _ => f p q = 0) ?mem ?zero ?add ?smul hf
  · rintro _ ⟨c, rfl⟩
    have hneq : ¬ (p = c.val.val.1 ∧ q = c.val.val.2) := by
      intro h
      exact hnc (by simpa [h.1, h.2] using c.property)
    simp [delta_apply, hneq]
  · simp
  · intro f g hf hg hzeroF hzeroG
    simp [hzeroF, hzeroG]
  · intro a f hf hzero
    simp [hzero]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.not_crosses_right_subinterval
statement:
private theorem not_crosses_right_subinterval
    (p x q : PairPoset S) (hpx : p ≤ x) (hxq : x ≤ q)
    (hnc : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) x q
proof:
:= by
  intro hcross
  exact hnc (hpx.2.trans hcross)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.not_crosses_left_subinterval
statement:
private theorem not_crosses_left_subinterval
    (p x q : PairPoset S) (hpx : p ≤ x) (hxq : x ≤ q)
    (hnc : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) :
    ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p x
proof:
:= by
  intro hcross
  exact hnc (hcross.trans hxq.1)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.crossingDeltaSpan_mul_left
statement:
private theorem crossingDeltaSpan_mul_left
    (a f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (hf : f ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)) :
    a * f ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [incidence_eq_deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S) (a * f)]
  change (∑ c ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ComparablePair S)),
      (a * f) c.val.1 c.val.2 •
        delta (k := k) c.val.1 c.val.2 c.property) ∈
    crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro c hc
  by_cases hcross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) c.val.1 c.val.2
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨c, hcross⟩, rfl⟩)
  · have hcoef : (a * f) c.val.1 c.val.2 = 0 := by
      rw [IncidenceAlgebra.mul_apply]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro x hx
      rcases Finset.mem_Icc.mp hx with ⟨hpx, hxq⟩
      have hsub := not_crosses_right_subinterval
        (S := S) c.val.1 x c.val.2 hpx hxq hcross
      rw [crossingDeltaSpan_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
        (k := k) (S := S) f hf x c.val.2 hsub]
      simp
    rw [hcoef]
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.crossingDeltaSpan_mul_right
statement:
private theorem crossingDeltaSpan_mul_right
    (f a : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (hf : f ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)) :
    f * a ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [incidence_eq_deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S) (f * a)]
  change (∑ c ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ComparablePair S)),
      (f * a) c.val.1 c.val.2 •
        delta (k := k) c.val.1 c.val.2 c.property) ∈
    crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro c hc
  by_cases hcross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) c.val.1 c.val.2
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨c, hcross⟩, rfl⟩)
  · have hcoef : (f * a) c.val.1 c.val.2 = 0 := by
      rw [IncidenceAlgebra.mul_apply]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro x hx
      rcases Finset.mem_Icc.mp hx with ⟨hpx, hxq⟩
      have hsub := not_crosses_left_subinterval
        (S := S) c.val.1 x c.val.2 hpx hxq hcross
      rw [crossingDeltaSpan_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
        (k := k) (S := S) f hf c.val.1 x hsub]
      simp
    rw [hcoef]
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalGenerator_mem_crossingDeltaSpan
statement:
private theorem diagonalGenerator_mem_crossingDeltaSpan
    (a b : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    a * diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) * b ∈
      crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [incidence_eq_deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S)
    (a * diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) * b)]
  change (∑ c ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ComparablePair S)),
      (a * diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) * b)
          c.val.1 c.val.2 • delta (k := k) c.val.1 c.val.2 c.property) ∈
    crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro c hc
  by_cases hcross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) c.val.1 c.val.2
  · exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨c, hcross⟩, rfl⟩)
  · have hzero := diagonalGenerator_apply_eq_zero_of_not_crosses
      (k := k) (S := S) a b c.val.1 c.val.2 c.property hcross
    rw [hzero]
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdeal_le_crossingDeltaSpan
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_le_crossingDeltaSpan (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (hf : f ∈ diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) :
    f ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Submodule.span_induction (s := Set.range fun z :
      Incidence (k := k) (S := S) × Incidence (k := k) (S := S) =>
        z.1 * diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) * z.2)
    (p := fun x _ => x ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S))
    ?mem ?zero ?add ?smul hf
  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact diagonalGenerator_mem_crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S) z.1 z.2
  · exact (crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)).zero_mem
  · intro _ _ _ _ hleft hright
    exact (crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)).add_mem hleft hright
  · intro a f hfspan hf
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using
      crossingDeltaSpan_mul_left (k := k) (S := S) a f hf

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.mem_diagonalIdeal_iff_mem_crossingDeltaSpan
statement:
theorem mem_diagonalIdeal_iff_mem_crossingDeltaSpan
    (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    f ∈ diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) ↔
      f ∈ crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:=
  ⟨diagonalIdeal_le_crossingDeltaSpan (k := k) (S := S) f,
    crossingDeltaSpan_le_diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) f⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker_le_diagonalIdeal
statement:
theorem incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker_le_diagonalIdeal :
    RingHom.ker (incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S)) ≤
      diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro f hf
  rw [incidence_eq_deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S) f]
  change (∑ c ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ComparablePair S)),
      f c.val.1 c.val.2 •
        delta (k := k) c.val.1 c.val.2 c.property) ∈
      diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro c hc
  by_cases hcross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) c.val.1 c.val.2
  · simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_one_mul] using
      (Ideal.mul_mem_left (diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
        (algebraMap k (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (f c.val.1 c.val.2))
        (diagonalIdeal_mem_delta_of_cross (k := k) (S := S)
          c.val.1 c.val.2 c.property hcross))
  · have hcoef := incidenceToEndAlgHom_kernel_coefficient_zero
      (k := k) (S := S) f hf c.val.1 c.val.2 c.property hcross
    simp [hcoef]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.diagonalIdeal_eq_incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_eq_incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker :
    diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) =
      RingHom.ker (incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact diagonalIdeal_le_incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker (k := k) (S := S)
  · exact incidenceToEndAlgHom_ker_le_diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.incidenceToEndQuotientAlgEquiv_mk_delta
statement:
@[simp] private theorem incidenceToEndQuotientAlgEquiv_mk_delta
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    incidenceToEndQuotientAlgEquiv (k := k) (S := S)
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
          (delta (k := k) p q hpq)) =
      if h : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q then 0 else
        hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
          (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq h))
          (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq h))
          (noCrossHomCondition (S := S) p q hpq h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [incidenceToEndQuotientAlgEquiv, AlgEquiv.trans_apply,
    Ideal.quotientEquivAlgOfEq_mk,
    Ideal.quotientKerAlgEquivOfSurjective_mk]
  change incidenceToEndAlgHom (k := k) (S := S)
    (delta (k := k) p q hpq) = _
  exact incidenceToEnd_delta_cases (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.hookEndAlgEquivIncidenceQuotient_symm_mk_delta
statement:
@[simp] theorem hookEndAlgEquivIncidenceQuotient_symm_mk_delta
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    (hookEndAlgEquivIncidenceQuotient (k := k) (S := S)).symm
        (Ideal.Quotient.mk (diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
          (delta (k := k) p q hpq)) =
      if h : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q then 0 else
        hookMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S)
          (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossSourceVertex (S := S) p q hpq h))
          (strictTag (S := S) (noCrossTargetVertex (S := S) p q hpq h))
          (noCrossHomCondition (S := S) p q hpq h)
proof:
:= by
  change incidenceToEndQuotientAlgEquiv (k := k) (S := S)
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (diagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
      (delta (k := k) p q hpq)) = _
  exact incidenceToEndQuotientAlgEquiv_mk_delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.sigma_lmap_natural
statement:
private theorem sigma_lmap_natural
    {R : Type u} [Semiring R]
    {ι : Type v} [DecidableEq ι]
    {α : ι → Type w} [∀ i, DecidableEq (α i)]
    (D : ∀ i, α i → Type x)
    [∀ i a, AddCommMonoid (D i a)] [∀ i a, Module R (D i a)]
    (E : ∀ i, α i → Type y)
    [∀ i a, AddCommMonoid (E i a)] [∀ i a, Module R (E i a)]
    (f : ∀ i a, D i a →ₗ[R] E i a) :
    (DirectSum.sigmaLcurryEquiv (R := R) (δ := E)).toLinearMap.comp
      (DirectSum.lmap (fun j : Σ i, α i => f j.1 j.2)) =
    (DirectSum.lmap (fun i => DirectSum.lmap (f i))).comp
      (DirectSum.sigmaLcurryEquiv (R := R) (δ := D)).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro j
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro z
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, DirectSum.lmap_lof]
  change DirectSum.sigmaCurry
      (DirectSum.lof R _ (fun j : Σ i, α i => E j.1 j.2) j (f j.1 j.2 z)) =
    DirectSum.lmap (fun i => DirectSum.lmap (f i))
      (DirectSum.sigmaCurry
        (DirectSum.lof R _ (fun j : Σ i, α i => D j.1 j.2) j z))
  have hD : DirectSum.sigmaCurry
      (DirectSum.lof R _ (fun j : Σ i, α i => D j.1 j.2) j z) =
      DirectSum.lof R ι (fun i => ⨁ a, D i a) j.1
        (DirectSum.lof R (α j.1) (D j.1) j.2 z) := by
    simpa only [DirectSum.lof_eq_of] using
      (DirectSum.sigmaCurry_of (δ := D) j z)
  have hE : DirectSum.sigmaCurry
      (DirectSum.lof R _ (fun j : Σ i, α i => E j.1 j.2) j (f j.1 j.2 z)) =
      DirectSum.lof R ι (fun i => ⨁ a, E i a) j.1
        (DirectSum.lof R (α j.1) (E j.1) j.2 (f j.1 j.2 z)) := by
    simpa only [DirectSum.lof_eq_of] using
      (DirectSum.sigmaCurry_of (δ := E) j (f j.1 j.2 z))
  rw [hD, hE, DirectSum.lmap_lof, DirectSum.lmap_lof]

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.familyIso_hom_lof
statement:
@[simp] theorem familyIso_hom_lof (F G : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (e : ∀ i, F i ≅ G i) (t : ℝ) (i : ι) (z : (F i).obj t) :
    (((familyIso F G e).hom).app t).hom
      (DirectSum.lof k ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) i z) =
      DirectSum.lof k ι (fun j => (G j).obj t) i (((e i).hom.app t).hom z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change DirectSum.lmap (fun j => ((e j).hom.app t).hom)
    (DirectSum.lof k ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) i z) = _
  exact DirectSum.lmap_lof (fun j : ι => ((e j).hom.app t).hom) i z

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.sigmaIso_hom_lof
statement:
@[simp] theorem sigmaIso_hom_lof {κ : ι → Type}
    (F : (Σ i, κ i) → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (t : ℝ) (i : ι) (j : κ i) (z : (F ⟨i,j⟩).obj t) :
    (((sigmaIso F).hom).app t).hom
      (DirectSum.lof k (Σ i, κ i) (fun a => (F a).obj t) ⟨i,j⟩ z) =
    DirectSum.lof k ι (fun a => DirectSum (κ a) (fun b => (F ⟨a,b⟩).obj t)) i
      (DirectSum.lof k (κ i) (fun b => (F ⟨i,b⟩).obj t) j z)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change DirectSum.sigmaCurry
    (δ := fun a : ι => fun b : κ a => (F ⟨a,b⟩).obj t)
    (DirectSum.lof k _ (fun a : Σ i, κ i => (F a).obj t) ⟨i,j⟩ z) = _
  simpa only [DirectSum.lof_eq_of] using
    (DirectSum.sigmaCurry_of (δ := fun a : ι => fun b : κ a => (F ⟨a,b⟩).obj t) ⟨i,j⟩ z)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.exists_cutPair_topology
statement:
private theorem exists_cutPair_topology :
    ∃ t : TopologicalSpace (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ),
      (∀ U ∈ separatedRectangleCells, @IsOpen _ t U) ∧
      (∀ U ∈ separatedRectangleCells, @IsCompact _ t U)
proof:
:= by
  let : TopologicalSpace (LowerSet ℝ) := Preorder.topology _
  let : OrderTopology (LowerSet ℝ) := ⟨rfl⟩
  let : TopologicalSpace (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) :=
    TopologicalSpace.induced rectangleLowerSetEquiv inferInstance
  let e := (rectangleLowerSetEquiv (α := ℝ)).toHomeomorphOfIsInducing ⟨rfl⟩
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro U (rfl | ⟨a, b, c, d, _, _, _, rfl⟩)
    · exact isOpen_empty
    · exact e.isOpen_image.mp (isOpen_image_rectangleCell a b c d)
  · rintro U (rfl | ⟨a, b, c, d, _, _, _, rfl⟩)
    · exact isCompact_empty
    · exact e.isCompact_image.mp (isCompact_image_rectangleCell a b c d)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.separatedRectangleCells_separate
statement:
private theorem separatedRectangleCells_separate {K : Set (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ)}
    (hK : K ∈ separatedRectangleCells) (x : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) (hx : x ∈ K)
    (y : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    ∃ U ∈ separatedRectangleCells, x ∈ U ∧ y ∉ U
proof:
:= by
  rcases hK with rfl | ⟨a, b, c, d, _, hbc, _, rfl⟩
  · exact hx.elim
  · exact exists_rectangleCell_separating hxy hbc hx

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_zero_of_not_visible
statement:
theorem moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_zero_of_not_visible (hM : M.QTame)
    (p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) (hp : ¬ ∃ U ∈ separatedRectangleCells, p ∈ U) :
    moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hempty : {n | ∃ U ∈ separatedRectangleCells, p ∈ U ∧
      moduleRectangleContent M hM U = n} = ∅ := by
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    rintro n ⟨U, hU, hpU, _⟩
    exact hp ⟨U, hU, hpU⟩
  simp only [moduleDiagramMultiplicity, contentMultiplicity, hempty, Nat.sInf_empty]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleDiagramMultiplicity_visible_of_pos
statement:
theorem moduleDiagramMultiplicity_visible_of_pos (hM : M.QTame)
    {p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ} (hp : 0 < moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p) :
    ∃ U ∈ separatedRectangleCells, p ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hz := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_zero_of_not_visible M hM p hn
  omega

statement:

proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleDiagramMultiplicity_le_content
statement:
theorem moduleDiagramMultiplicity_le_content (hM : M.QTame)
    {K : Set (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ)} (hK : K ∈ separatedRectangleCells)
    {p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ} (hp : p ∈ K) :

proof:
:=
  contentMultiplicity_le _ hK hp

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.exists_moduleDiagram_atom_of_positive
statement:
theorem exists_moduleDiagram_atom_of_positive (hM : M.QTame)
    {K : Set (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ)} (hK : K ∈ separatedRectangleCells)
    (hpos : 0 < moduleRectangleContent M hM K) :
    ∃ p ∈ K, 0 < moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hOpen, hCompact⟩ := exists_cutPair_topology
  let := t
  exact exists_positive_content_atom isSetSemiring_separatedRectangleCells
    (moduleRectangleContent M hM) hOpen hK (hCompact K hK) hpos

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleDiagramMultiplicity_locally_finite
proof:
:= by

  exact finite_positive_content_support isSetSemiring_separatedRectangleCells
    (moduleRectangleContent M hM) hOpen (separatedRectangleCells_separate hK) hK (hCompact K hK)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleDiagramMultiplicity_content_counts
statement:
theorem moduleDiagramMultiplicity_content_counts (hM : M.QTame)
    {K : Set (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ)} (hK : K ∈ separatedRectangleCells) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ),
      (∀ p, p ∈ S ↔ p ∈ K ∧ 0 < moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p) ∧
      moduleRectangleContent M hM K = ∑ p ∈ S, moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hOpen, hCompact⟩ := exists_cutPair_topology
  let := t
  exact content_eq_sum_multiplicity isSetSemiring_separatedRectangleCells
    (moduleRectangleContent M hM) hOpen (separatedRectangleCells_separate hK) hK (hCompact K hK)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleDiagramMultiplicity_rectangle_counts
statement:
theorem moduleDiagramMultiplicity_rectangle_counts (hM : M.QTame) (a b c d : ℝ)
    (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) (hcd : c < d) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ),
      (∀ p, p ∈ S ↔ p ∈ rectangleCell a b c d ∧ 0 < moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p) ∧
      persistenceMeasureValue M hab.le hbc.le hcd.le =
        ∑ p ∈ S, moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hcount⟩ := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_content_counts M hM
    (rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells a b c d hbc)
  exact ⟨S, hS, (moduleRectangleContent_apply M hM a b c d hab hbc hcd).symm.trans hcount⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_zero_of_rectangle_zero
statement:
theorem moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_zero_of_rectangle_zero (hM : M.QTame)
    (hzero : ∀ (a b c d : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) (hcd : c < d),
      persistenceMeasureValue M hab.le hbc.le hcd.le = 0) (p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) :
    moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hpos := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hpU⟩ := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_visible_of_pos M hM hpos
  rcases hU with rfl | ⟨a, b, c, d, hab, hbc, hcd, rfl⟩
  · exact hpU.elim
  · have hle := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_le_content M hM
      (rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells a b c d hbc) hpU
    rw [moduleRectangleContent_apply M hM a b c d hab hbc hcd,
      hzero a b c d hab hbc hcd] at hle
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingExamples.reverse_comparison_zero
statement:
theorem reverse_comparison_zero :
    (interleavingOfBounds (k := k) 1 (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) (1, (3 : WithTop ℝ))
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num [← WithTop.coe_add, WithTop.coe_le_coe])
      (by exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (show (2 : ℝ) ≤ 3 + 1 by norm_num))).ψ = 0
proof:
