    weightedPBoundaryTransportCost 1 sourceMass targetMass sourcePoint targetPoint = 7 / 4 ∧
      weightedPBoundaryTransportCost 2 sourceMass targetMass sourcePoint targetPoint =
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [weightedPBoundaryTransportCost, fractional_power_optimum_one,
    fractional_power_optimum_two]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryTransportExamples.split_balances_and_cost
statement:
private theorem split_balances_and_cost :
    splitTargetPoint false ≠ splitTargetPoint true ∧
      splitPlan.mass () false = 1 / 2 ∧ splitPlan.mass () true = 1 / 2 ∧
      splitPlan.deletionMass () = 0 ∧
      (∀ b, splitPlan.insertionMass b = 0) ∧
      splitPlan.powerCost 1 splitSourcePoint splitTargetPoint = 1 / 2 ∧
      weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost 1 splitSource splitTarget
        splitSourcePoint splitTargetPoint ≤ 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hc : splitPlan.powerCost 1 splitSourcePoint splitTargetPoint = 1 / 2 := by
    norm_num [splitPlan, FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost,
      FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.linearCost, weightedBoundaryLinearObjective,
      splitSource, splitTarget, splitSourcePoint, splitTargetPoint,
      Fintype.sum_bool, finitePairCost, diagonalCost]
  refine ⟨by norm_num [splitTargetPoint], rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_, hc, ?_⟩
  · norm_num [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.deletionMass, splitPlan, splitSource, Fintype.sum_bool]
  · intro b
    norm_num [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.insertionMass, splitPlan, splitTarget]
  · exact (weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan 1 _ _ _ _ splitPlan).trans_eq hc

statement:

    FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost 1 fractionalDiagram 0 = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost_zero_right]
  change (∑ i : ↥fractionalDiagram.support,
    (fractionalDiagram i.1 : ℝ) * (diagonalCost i.1.1).toReal ^ (1 : ℝ)) = 1 / 2
  calc
    _ = ∑ z ∈ fractionalDiagram.support,
        (fractionalDiagram z : ℝ) * (diagonalCost z.1).toReal ^ (1 : ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_coe_sort fractionalDiagram.support _

    (N : ModuleCat.{u} (HomScalars (k := k) (S := S)))
    (hN : FiniteDimensional k (canonicalFieldRestriction (k := k) N)) :
    letI : Lattice (PairPoset S) := pairPosetLattice (S := S)
    letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset S) := pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := S)
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE N (maxComplementCard (S := PairPoset S))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Lattice (PairPoset S) := pairPosetLattice (S := S)
  letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset S) := pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := S)
  have hQ : FiniteDimensional k
      (IncidenceQuotientSimple.restrictRightQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S)
        (quotientModuleOfHomModule (k := k) (S := S) N)) :=
    (quotientRestrictionFieldIso (k := k) (S := S) N).toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  have hPD := IncidenceVertexProjectiveDimension.quotient_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    (k := k) (S := S) (quotientModuleOfHomModule (k := k) (S := S) N) hQ
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLE
      (quotientModuleOfHomModule (k := k) (S := S) N)
      (maxComplementCard (S := PairPoset S)) := hPD
  exact ModuleCat.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_semiLinearEquiv
    (hookHomAlgEquivRightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)).symm.toRingEquiv
    (quotientModuleSemilinearEquiv (k := k) (S := S) N)
    (maxComplementCard (S := PairPoset S))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomQuotientDimension.hookSum_finiteDimensional
statement:
private theorem hookSum_finiteDimensional (p : S) :
    FiniteDimensional k ((HookSum (k := k) (S := S)).obj p)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ∀ t : HookTag (S := S),
      FiniteDimensional k ((hookFamily (k := k) (S := S) t).obj p) := by
    intro t
    cases t with
    | inl ab =>
        change FiniteDimensional k ((Hook.module (k := k) ab.val.1 ab.val.2).obj p)
        infer_instance
    | inr a =>
        change FiniteDimensional k ((HookInfinity.module (R := k) a).obj p)
        infer_instance

proof:
:= by
  have hHom : FiniteDimensional k (HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ M) :=
    FiniteHomDimension.finiteDimensional_hom (k := k)
      (HookSum (k := k) (S := S)) M hookSum_finiteDimensional hM
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ M) := hHom
  exact (homScalarFieldLinearEquiv (k := k) (S := S) M).symm.finiteDimensional

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomQuotientDimension.homCokernel_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem homCokernel_finiteDimensional
    [OrderBot S] [OrderTop S]
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)) :
    FiniteDimensional k
      (canonicalFieldRestriction (k := k)
        (homCokernel (k := k) (S := S) M))
proof:
:= by
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hM
  have hQ : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k ((TwoInjectivePresentation.quotient M).obj p) :=
    TwoInjectivePresentation.quotient_finiteDimensional M
  have hSecond : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k ((secondInjective M).obj p) := by
    intro p
    letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k ((TwoInjectivePresentation.quotient M).obj p) := hQ
    exact FiniteInjectivePresentation.finiteDimensional
      (TwoInjectivePresentation.quotient M) p
  have hDomain := homFunctor_obj_finiteDimensional (k := k) (S := S)
    (secondInjective M) hSecond
  letI : FiniteDimensional k
      (canonicalFieldRestriction (k := k) ((homFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).obj
        (secondInjective M))) := hDomain
  have hEpi : Epi (homCokernelProjection M) := inferInstance
  have hSurj : Function.Surjective (homCokernelProjection M).hom :=
    (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp hEpi
  have hSurj' : Function.Surjective
      (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
        (algebraMap k (HomScalars (k := k) (S := S)))).map
        (homCokernelProjection M)).hom) := by
    change Function.Surjective (homCokernelProjection M).hom
    exact hSurj
  exact FiniteDimensional.of_surjective
    (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
      (algebraMap k (HomScalars (k := k) (S := S)))).map
      (homCokernelProjection M)).hom) hSurj'

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomQuotientDimension.homCokernel_hasProjectiveDimensionLE

      (maxComplementCard (S := PairPoset S))
proof:

  letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset S) := pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := S)

      (canonicalFieldRestriction (k := k) (homCokernel (k := k) (S := S) M)) :=

    (homCokernel (k := k) (S := S) M) hK

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomQuotientDimension.coordinateGrid_homCokernel_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem coordinateGrid_homCokernel_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    {n : ℕ} (G : CoordinateGrid n) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hG : ∀ i : Fin n, (G i).Nonempty)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point)
    (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)) :
    letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE
      (homCokernel (k := k) (S := G.Point) M) (2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
  letI : Lattice (PairPoset G.Point) := pairPosetLattice (S := G.Point)
  letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset G.Point) :=
    pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := G.Point)
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hM
  let K := homCokernel (k := k) (S := G.Point) M
  have hK : FiniteDimensional k (canonicalFieldRestriction (k := k) K) :=
    homCokernel_finiteDimensional (k := k) (S := G.Point) M hM
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (canonicalFieldRestriction (k := k) K) := hK
  have hQ : FiniteDimensional k
      (IncidenceQuotientSimple.restrictRightQuotientModule (k := k) (S := G.Point)
        (quotientModuleOfHomModule (k := k) (S := G.Point) K)) :=
    (quotientRestrictionFieldIso (k := k) (S := G.Point) K).toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  have hPDQ := IncidenceVertexProjectiveDimension.coordinateGrid_rightQuotient_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    (k := k) (G := G) hn hG (quotientModuleOfHomModule (k := k) (S := G.Point) K) hQ
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLE
      (quotientModuleOfHomModule (k := k) (S := G.Point) K) (2 * n) := hPDQ
  exact ModuleCat.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_semiLinearEquiv
    (hookHomAlgEquivRightQuotient (k := k) (S := G.Point)).symm.toRingEquiv
    (quotientModuleSemilinearEquiv (k := k) (S := G.Point) K) (2 * n)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomQuotientDimension.coordinateGrid_homFunctor_obj_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem coordinateGrid_homFunctor_obj_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    {n : ℕ} (G : CoordinateGrid n) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hG : ∀ i : Fin n, (G i).Nonempty)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point)
    (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)) :
    letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((homFunctor (k := k) (S := G.Point)).obj M)
      (2 * n - 2)
proof:
:= by
  letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hM
  have hcount := maxComplementCard_coordinateGrid_le G hG
  have hD : maxComplementCard (S := G.Point) - 1 ≤ 2 * n - 2 := by omega
  have hK : HasProjectiveDimensionLE
      (homCokernel (k := k) (S := G.Point) M) ((2 * n - 2) + 2) := by
    have hK' := coordinateGrid_homCokernel_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
      (k := k) G hn hG M hM
    convert hK' using 1 <;> omega
  exact TwoInjectiveHomDimension.hom_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_actualCokernel
    (k := k) (S := G.Point) M (2 * n - 2) hD hK

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_biproduct
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_biproduct
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] [HasFiniteBiproducts C]
    {I : Type w} [Fintype I]
    (F : I → C) (d : ℕ)
    (hF : ∀ i, HasProjectiveDimensionLE (F i) d) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (⨁ F) d
proof:
:= by
  letI := HasExt.standard C
  apply (hasProjectiveDimensionLT_iff (⨁ F) (d + 1)).2
  intro n hn Y e
  apply (Abelian.Ext.biproductAddEquiv (biproduct.isBilimit F) Y n).injective
  ext i
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (F i) (d + 1) := hF i
  have hzero := Abelian.Ext.eq_zero_of_hasProjectiveDimensionLT
    ((Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (biproduct.ι F i)).comp e (zero_add n)) (d + 1) (by omega)
  change (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (biproduct.ι F i)).comp e (zero_add n) =
    (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (biproduct.ι F i)).comp 0 (zero_add n)
  rw [hzero]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.homBiproductIso_hom_π_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem homBiproductIso_hom_π_apply {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (F : I → PModule.{u,0,u} k S) (f : HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ ⨁ F)
    (i : I) :
    (((((homBiproductIso (k := k) (S := S) F).hom) ≫
      biproduct.π (fun i => (H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (F i)) i).hom) f) =
        f ≫ biproduct.π F i
proof:
:= by
  simp [homBiproductIso, Category.assoc,
    FiniteRankProjectiveHomProjective.homBiproductEquivPi_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.presentation_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem presentation_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (d : ℕ)
    (hcard : ∀ p : S, complementCard (S := S) p - 1 ≤ d) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (module M)) d
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype (FiniteInjectivePresentation.Index (k := k) (P := S) M) :=
    FiniteInjectivePresentation.indexFintype (k := k) (P := S) M
  have hsum : HasProjectiveDimensionLE
      (⨁ fun i : FiniteInjectivePresentation.Index (k := k) (P := S) M =>
        (H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (FiniteInjectivePresentation.family M i)) d := by
    apply hasProjectiveDimensionLE_biproduct
      (C := ModuleCat (FiniteRankProjectiveHomProjective.HomScalars (k := k) (S := S)))
      (I := FiniteInjectivePresentation.Index (k := k) (P := S) M)
      (F := fun i : FiniteInjectivePresentation.Index (k := k) (P := S) M =>
        (H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (FiniteInjectivePresentation.family M i)) d
    intro i
    have hprincipal := PrincipalDownsetRankDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE
      (k := k) (S := S) i.1
    letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT
        ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module i.1))
        (complementCard i.1 - 1 + 1) := hprincipal
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge
      ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module i.1))
      (complementCard (S := S) i.1 - 1 + 1) (d + 1)
      (Nat.succ_le_succ (hcard i.1))
  let e := homBiproductIso (k := k) (S := S) (FiniteInjectivePresentation.family M)
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT
      (⨁ fun i : FiniteInjectivePresentation.Index (k := k) (P := S) M =>
        (H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (FiniteInjectivePresentation.family M i)) (d + 1) := hsum
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso e.symm (d + 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.hom_embedding_retraction
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem hom_embedding_retraction
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)]
    [Injective M] :
    (H (k := k) (S := S)).map (embedding M) ≫
      (H (k := k) (S := S)).map (retraction M) =
        𝟙 ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj M)
proof:
:=
  (mapped_embedding_retraction_retract (k := k) (S := S) M).retract

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)]
    [Injective M] (d : ℕ) (hcard : ∀ p : S, complementCard (S := S) p - 1 ≤ d) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj M) d
proof:
:= by
  have htarget := presentation_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    (k := k) (S := S) M d hcard
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT
      ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (module M)) (d + 1) := htarget
  exact CategoryTheory.Retract.hasProjectiveDimensionLT
    (mapped_embedding_retraction_retract (k := k) (S := S) M) (d + 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.complementCard_le_maxComplementCard
statement:
theorem complementCard_le_maxComplementCard (p : S) :
    complementCard p ≤ maxComplementCard (S := S)
proof:

  exact Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ p)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_max
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_max
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)]
    [Injective M] :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj M)
      (maxComplementCard (S := S) - 1)
proof:
:= by
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLE (k := k) (S := S) M
    (maxComplementCard (S := S) - 1) (by
      intro p
      exact Nat.sub_le_sub_right (complementCard_le_maxComplementCard (S := S) p) 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.termAt_isZero_of_max
statement:
theorem termAt_isZero_of_max
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)]
    [Injective M]
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    (j : ℕ) (hj : maxComplementCard (S := S) - 1 < j) :
    IsZero (R.termAt j)
proof:
:=
  (FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_iff R _).mp
    (hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_max (k := k) (S := S) M) j hj

name: TDA.Persistence.Diagram.map_points
statement:
theorem Diagram.map_points (D : Diagram α) (φ : α ↪o β) :
    (D.map φ).points = D.points.map (fun p => (φ p.1, WithTop.map φ p.2))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Diagram.IsPositive.map
statement:
theorem Diagram.IsPositive.map {D : Diagram α} (hD : D.IsPositive) (φ : α ↪o β) :
    (D.map φ).IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hp
  have h := hD q hq
  obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := q
  cases d with
  | top => exact WithTop.coe_lt_top _
  | coe d =>
    change ((φ b : β) : WithTop β) < ((φ d : β) : WithTop β)
    exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 (φ.lt_iff_lt.2 (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h))

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_map_points
statement:
theorem finitePart_map_points (D : Diagram α) (φ : α ↪o β) :
    finitePart (D.map φ).points = (finitePart D.points).map (fun p => (φ p.1, φ p.2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Diagram.map_points]
  simp only [finitePart, Multiset.filterMap_map, Multiset.map_filterMap]
  apply congrArg (fun g : (α × WithTop α) → Option (β × β) => D.points.filterMap g)
  funext p
  obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := p
  cases d <;> rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_map_points

    essentialPart (D.map φ).points = (essentialPart D.points).map φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Diagram.map_points]
  simp only [essentialPart, Multiset.filterMap_map, Multiset.map_filterMap]
  apply congrArg (fun g : (α × WithTop α) → Option β => D.points.filterMap g)
  funext p
  obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := p
  cases d <;> rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Diagram.map_refl
statement: theorem Diagram.map_refl (D : Diagram α) : D.map (RelEmbedding.refl (· ≤ ·)) = D
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  rw [Diagram.map_points]
  have h : (fun p : α × WithTop α =>
      ((RelEmbedding.refl (· ≤ ·) : α ↪o α) p.1,
        WithTop.map (RelEmbedding.refl (· ≤ ·) : α ↪o α) p.2)) = id := by
    funext p
    obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := p
    cases d <;> rfl
  rw [h, Multiset.map_id]

name: TDA.Persistence.Diagram.map_map
statement:
theorem Diagram.map_map (D : Diagram α) (φ : α ↪o β) (ψ : β ↪o γ) :
    (D.map φ).map ψ = D.map (φ.trans ψ)
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  rw [Diagram.map_points, Diagram.map_points, Diagram.map_points, Multiset.map_map]
  congr 1
  funext p
  obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := p
  cases d <;> rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_map

    (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α) (φ : α ↪o β) (n : ℕ) :

proof:

    (φ.strictMono.strictMonoOn _) (fun _ => rfl) n)

      (Rips.fullComplexFintype : Fintype (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace
        TDA.Persistence.Examples.edgeK)) := Subsingleton.elim _ _

    TDA.Persistence.Examples.edgeK I movedEdge n) hI

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.RelationExamples.moved_full_h0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← movedEdge_dgm 0]
  let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => if x ≤ 5 then 0 else 3 / 2
  have hφ : MonotoneOn φ (Set.range TDA.Persistence.Examples.edgeFilter.value) := by
    intro a _ b _ hab
    by_cases ha : a ≤ 5
    · by_cases hb : b ≤ 5 <;> norm_num [φ, ha, hb]
    · have hb : ¬ b ≤ 5 := fun hb => ha (hab.trans hb)
      simp [φ, ha, hb]
  have hvalue : ∀ s, movedEdge.value s =
      φ (TDA.Persistence.Examples.edgeFilter.value s) := by
    intro s
    change (Cech.filter moved).value s = _
    rcases TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_face_cases s with hs | hs | hs
    · have he : s = (⟨{0}, by simp⟩ : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 2))) :=
        Subtype.ext hs
      subst s
      rw [singleton_value]
      norm_num [TDA.Persistence.Examples.edgeFilter, φ]
    · have he : s = (⟨{1}, by simp⟩ : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 2))) :=
        Subtype.ext hs
      subst s
      rw [singleton_value]
      norm_num [TDA.Persistence.Examples.edgeFilter, φ]
    · have he : s = Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.edgeFace := Subtype.ext hs
      subst s
      rw [moved_edge_value]
      norm_num [TDA.Persistence.Examples.edgeFilter, Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.edgeFace,
        Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.edge, φ, Finset.ext_iff]
  rw [dgm_points_map_of_monotoneOn (ZMod 2)
    TDA.Persistence.Examples.edgeFilter movedEdge φ hφ hvalue 0]
  rw [TDA.Persistence.Examples.edge_points]
  norm_num [φ, Multiset.filter_singleton]

  · intro x hx
    refine ⟨0, ⟨⟨0, hm⟩, hzero⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [edist_dist]
    have hd : dist x 0 ≤ (3 : ℝ) := by

      intro v; fin_cases v <;> norm_num [TDA.Persistence.Cech.Examples.MovedPoint.q])

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))) (ε : ℝ≥0) (i : Fin n) :
    FiniteDimensional k (((shift ε).obj M).obj (shiftGrid ε c i))
proof:
:= by
  change FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i - (ε : ℝ) + (ε : ℝ)))
  rw [sub_add_cancel]
  exact hfd i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.endpoints_shift
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [RealBarcode.endpoints, translateDiagramPoint]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.ofIndexBars_shiftGrid
statement:
theorem ofIndexBars_shiftGrid (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval n)) :
    ofIndexBars (shiftGrid ε c) (shiftGrid ε c).strictMono B =
      translateDiagram (ofIndexBars c c.strictMono B) (-(ε : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  change B.map (RealBarcode.endpoints (shiftGrid ε c)) =
    (B.map (RealBarcode.endpoints c)).map (translateDiagramPoint (-(ε : ℝ)))
  rw [Multiset.map_map]
  congr 1
  funext I
  exact endpoints_shift c ε I

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram_shift
statement:
theorem moduleDiagram_shift (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    moduleDiagram (shiftGrid ε c) ((shift ε).obj M)
        (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical c M hfd ε) =
      translateDiagram (moduleDiagram c M hfd) (-(ε : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k ((reindex c.toOrderHom M).obj i) := hfd
  let : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k
      ((reindex (shiftGrid ε c).toOrderHom ((shift ε).obj M)).obj i) :=
    finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical c M hfd ε
  unfold moduleDiagram
  rw [rankBarcode_eq_of_iso (shiftedCriticalIso c M ε), ofIndexBars_shiftGrid]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram_shift_refinement
statement:
theorem moduleDiagram_shift_refinement (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (e : Fin m ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (he : Refines (shiftGrid ε c) e) :
    moduleDiagram e ((shift ε).obj M)
        (fun j => finiteDimensional_of_isConstructible ((shift ε).obj M) (hM.shift ε)
          (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical c M hfd ε) (e j)) =
      translateDiagram (moduleDiagram c M hfd) (-(ε : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [moduleDiagram_refinement ((shift ε).obj M) he (hM.shift ε)
    (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical c M hfd ε), moduleDiagram_shift]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram_unshift
statement:
theorem moduleDiagram_unshift (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    translateDiagram (moduleDiagram (shiftGrid ε c) ((shift ε).obj M)
      (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical c M hfd ε)) (ε : ℝ) =
        moduleDiagram c M hfd
proof:
:= by
  rw [moduleDiagram_shift, translateDiagram_add, neg_add_cancel, translateDiagram_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.exists_shift_matching
statement:
theorem exists_shift_matching (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    let D := moduleDiagram c M hfd
    let E := moduleDiagram (shiftGrid ε c) ((shift ε).obj M)
      (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical c M hfd ε)
    ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences
        D.essentialOccurrences E.essentialOccurrences,
      (∀ i, ∃ j, A.finite i = some j ∧
        j.1 = (i.1.1 - (ε : ℝ), i.1.2 - (ε : ℝ))) ∧
      (∀ j, ∃ i, A.finite i = some j) ∧
      (∀ i, (A.essential i).1 = i.1 - (ε : ℝ)) ∧
      A.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [moduleDiagram_shift]
  let D := moduleDiagram c M hfd
  refine ⟨translatedMatching D (-(ε : ℝ)), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    refine ⟨finiteTranslationEquiv D (-(ε : ℝ)) i, rfl, ?_⟩
    simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg] using finiteTranslationEquiv_value D (-(ε : ℝ)) i
  · intro j
    refine ⟨(finiteTranslationEquiv D (-(ε : ℝ))).symm j, ?_⟩
    simp only [translatedMatching, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  · intro i
    simpa only [translatedMatching, sub_eq_add_neg] using
      essentialTranslationEquiv_value D (-(ε : ℝ)) i
  · simpa only [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg ε.coe_nonneg, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal] using
      translatedMatching_cost_le D (-(ε : ℝ))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.exists_shift_refinement_matching
statement:
theorem exists_shift_refinement_matching (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (e : Fin m ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (he : Refines (shiftGrid ε c) e) :
    let D := moduleDiagram c M hfd
    let E := moduleDiagram e ((shift ε).obj M)
      (fun j => finiteDimensional_of_isConstructible ((shift ε).obj M) (hM.shift ε)
        (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical c M hfd ε) (e j))
    ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences
        D.essentialOccurrences E.essentialOccurrences,
      (∀ i, ∃ j, A.finite i = some j ∧
        j.1 = (i.1.1 - (ε : ℝ), i.1.2 - (ε : ℝ))) ∧
      (∀ j, ∃ i, A.finite i = some j) ∧
      (∀ i, (A.essential i).1 = i.1 - (ε : ℝ)) ∧
      A.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rw [moduleDiagram_shift_refinement c e M hM hfd ε he]
  have h := exists_shift_matching c M hfd ε
  dsimp only at h
  rw [moduleDiagram_shift] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteCokernel_π_fiberIso
statement:
theorem finiteCokernel_π_fiberIso (f : M ⟶ N) (i : Fin s) :
    (cokernel.π f).app i ≫ (finiteCokernelFiberIso f i).hom =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.range (f.app i).hom).mkQ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finiteCokernelFiberIso, Iso.trans_hom]
  have hp := PreservesCokernel.π_iso_hom ((evaluation (Fin s) (ModuleCat k)).obj i) f
  change (cokernel.π f).app i ≫
    (PreservesCokernel.iso ((evaluation (Fin s) (ModuleCat k)).obj i) f).hom =
      cokernel.π (f.app i) at hp
  rw [← Category.assoc, hp, ModuleCat.cokernel_π_cokernelIsoRangeQuotient_hom]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteCokernel_π_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finiteCokernel_π_eq_zero_iff (f : M ⟶ N) (i : Fin s) (y : N.obj i) :
    ((cokernel.π f).app i).hom y = 0 ↔ y ∈ LinearMap.range (f.app i).hom
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (fun g : N.obj i ⟶
    ModuleCat.of k (N.obj i ⧸ LinearMap.range (f.app i).hom) => g.hom y)
      (finiteCokernel_π_fiberIso f i)
  change (finiteCokernelFiberIso f i).hom.hom (((cokernel.π f).app i).hom y) =
    (LinearMap.range (f.app i).hom).mkQ y at he
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  change _ ↔ (LinearMap.range (f.app i).hom).mkQ y = 0
  rw [← he]
  exact ((finiteCokernelFiberIso f i).toLinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteCokernel_map_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finiteCokernel_map_eq_zero_iff (f : M ⟶ N) {a b : Fin s} (h : a ≤ b) :
    structureMap (finiteCokernel f) h = 0 ↔
      LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear N h) ≤ LinearMap.range (f.app b).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hn := (cokernel.π f).naturality (homOfLE h)
  change structureMap N h ≫ (cokernel.π f).app b =
    (cokernel.π f).app a ≫ structureMap (finiteCokernel f) h at hn
  constructor
  · intro hz y hy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
    apply (finiteCokernel_π_eq_zero_iff f b _).mp
    have he := congrArg (fun g : N.obj a ⟶ (finiteCokernel f).obj b => g.hom x) hn
    change ((cokernel.π f).app b).hom (structureMapLinear N h x) =
      (structureMap (finiteCokernel f) h).hom (((cokernel.π f).app a).hom x) at he
    rw [hz] at he
    exact he
  · intro hi
    apply (cancel_epi ((cokernel.π f).app a)).mp
    rw [comp_zero, ← hn]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    exact (finiteCokernel_π_eq_zero_iff f b _).mpr (hi ⟨x, rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.cokernel_translationTrivial_iff
statement:
theorem cokernel_translationTrivial_iff (theta : Fin s →o Fin s)
    (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N) :
    TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f) ↔
      ∀ i, LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear N (hTheta i)) ≤
        LinearMap.range (f.app (theta i)).hom
proof:
:= by
  exact forall_congr' (fun i => finiteCokernel_map_eq_zero_iff f (hTheta i))

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.FinitePresentationIsoClasses.distance_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem distance_classOf
    (M N : FinitelyPresentedModule (R := R) (n := n)) :
    distance (classOf M) (classOf N) =
      coordinateInterleavingDistance M.1 N.1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.FinitePresentationIsoClasses.distance_congr
statement:
theorem distance_congr
    {M M' N N' : FinitelyPresentedModule (R := R) (n := n)}
    (e : M.1 ≅ M'.1) (f : N.1 ≅ N'.1) :
    distance (classOf M) (classOf N) = distance (classOf M') (classOf N')
proof:
:= by
  rw [distance_classOf, distance_classOf]
  exact coordinateInterleavingDistance_congr e f

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.FinitePresentationIsoClasses.distance_self
statement:
theorem distance_self (x : FinitePresentationIsoClasses (R := R) (n := n)) :
    distance x x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h M =>
    change distance (classOf M) (classOf M) = 0
    rw [distance_classOf]
    exact coordinateInterleavingDistance_self M.1

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.FinitePresentationIsoClasses.distance_comm
statement:
theorem distance_comm (x y : FinitePresentationIsoClasses (R := R) (n := n)) :
    distance x y = distance y x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h M =>
    induction y using Quotient.inductionOn with
    | h N =>
      change distance (classOf M) (classOf N) = distance (classOf N) (classOf M)
      rw [distance_classOf, distance_classOf]
      exact coordinateInterleavingDistance_comm M.1 N.1

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.FinitePresentationIsoClasses.distance_triangle
statement:
theorem distance_triangle
    (x y z : FinitePresentationIsoClasses (R := R) (n := n)) :
    distance x z ≤ distance x y + distance y z
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn with
  | h M =>
    induction y using Quotient.inductionOn with
    | h N =>
      induction z using Quotient.inductionOn with
      | h P =>
        change distance (classOf M) (classOf P) ≤
          distance (classOf M) (classOf N) + distance (classOf N) (classOf P)
        rw [distance_classOf, distance_classOf, distance_classOf]
        exact coordinateInterleavingDistance_triangle M.1 N.1 P.1

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.FinitePresentationIsoClasses.distance_classOf_eq_zero_iff_iso
statement:
theorem distance_classOf_eq_zero_iff_iso
    (M N : FinitelyPresentedModule (R := R) (n := n)) :
    distance (classOf M) (classOf N) = 0 ↔ Nonempty (M.1 ≅ N.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [distance_classOf]
  exact finitelyPresented_distance_eq_zero_iff_iso M.2 N.2

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.FinitePresentationIsoClasses.distance_eq_zero_iff_eq
statement:
theorem distance_eq_zero_iff_eq
    (x y : FinitePresentationIsoClasses (R := R) (n := n)) :
    distance x y = 0 ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction x using Quotient.inductionOn with
    | h M =>
      induction y using Quotient.inductionOn with
      | h N =>
        change distance (classOf M) (classOf N) = 0 at h
        rw [distance_classOf] at h
        apply Quotient.sound
        apply (finitelyPresented_distance_eq_zero_iff_iso M.2 N.2).mp
        exact h
  · rintro rfl
    exact distance_self x

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.FinitePresentationIsoClasses.edist_classOf
statement:
@[simp]
theorem edist_classOf
    (M N : FinitelyPresentedModule (R := R) (n := n)) :
    edist (classOf M) (classOf N) = coordinateInterleavingDistance M.1 N.1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.source_zero_of_rightMinimal
statement:
private theorem source_zero_of_rightMinimal
    {C : Type*} [Category* C] [Abelian C] {A B : C} (g : A ⟶ B)
    (hmin : ∀ t : End A, t ≫ g = g → IsIso t) (hB : IsZero B) : IsZero A
proof:
:= by
  have h : IsIso (0 : End A) := hmin 0 (by simp [hB.eq_zero_of_tgt g])
  have := h
  exact IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero (0 : End A) rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.row_projective_iff_kernel_zero
statement:
private theorem row_projective_iff_kernel_zero
    {C : Type*} [Category* C] [Abelian C] {Q : ShortComplex C}
    (hQ : Q.ShortExact) (hP : Projective Q.X₂)
    (hmin : ∀ t : End Q.X₂, t ≫ Q.g = Q.g → IsIso t) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLT Q.X₃ 1 ↔ IsZero Q.X₁
proof:
:= by
  have := hQ.mono_f
  have := hQ.epi_g
  have := hP
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := h
    let s := Projective.factorThru (𝟙 Q.X₃) Q.g
    have hs : s ≫ Q.g = 𝟙 Q.X₃ := Projective.factorThru_comp _ _
    have ht : IsIso (Q.g ≫ s) := hmin _ (by simp [Category.assoc, hs])
    have := ht
    have : Mono Q.g := mono_of_mono Q.g s
    exact IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero Q.f ((cancel_mono Q.g).mp (by simp [Q.zero]))
  · intro h
    exact hQ.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃ 0 h.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.finite_rows_dimension_iff
statement:
private theorem finite_rows_dimension_iff
    {C : Type*} [Category* C] [Abelian C] (n : ℕ)
    (K : Fin (n + 1) → C) (P : Fin n → C)
    (f : ∀ i, K i.succ ⟶ P i) (g : ∀ i, P i ⟶ K i.castSucc)
    (w : ∀ i, f i ≫ g i = 0)
    (hex : ∀ i, (ShortComplex.mk (f i) (g i) (w i)).ShortExact)
    (hproj : ∀ i, Projective (P i))
    (hmin : ∀ i, ∀ t : End (P i), t ≫ g i = g i → IsIso t)
    (hlast : IsZero (K (Fin.last n))) (d : ℕ) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLT (K 0) d ↔ ∀ j, d ≤ j.val → IsZero (P j)
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing d with
  | zero =>
    have hzero : IsZero (K 0) := hlast
    constructor
    · intro _ j; exact Fin.elim0 j
    · intro _
      have := hzero.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero
      exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge (K 0) 0 d (Nat.zero_le _)
  | succ n ih =>
    have tail := ih (fun i => K i.succ) (fun i => P i.succ)
      (fun i => f i.succ) (fun i => g i.succ) (fun i => w i.succ)
      (fun i => hex i.succ) (fun i => hproj i.succ) (fun i => hmin i.succ) hlast
    have hrow := hex 0
    have : Mono (f 0) := hrow.mono_f
    have : Epi (g 0) := hrow.epi_g
    cases d with
    | zero =>
      rw [hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero_iff_isZero]
      constructor
      · intro h j _
        have hP : IsZero (P 0) := source_zero_of_rightMinimal (g 0) (hmin 0) h
        have hK : IsZero (K (Fin.succ 0)) := IsZero.of_mono (f 0) hP
        have htail := (tail 0).mp hK.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero
        refine Fin.cases hP (fun i => htail i (Nat.zero_le _)) j
      · intro h
        have hz := IsZero.of_epi (g 0) (h 0 (Nat.zero_le _))
        simpa only [Fin.castSucc_zero] using hz
    | succ d =>
      cases d with
      | zero =>
        have h := row_projective_iff_kernel_zero hrow (hproj 0) (hmin 0)
        dsimp only [ShortComplex.mk] at h
        simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero] at h
        rw [h, ← hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero_iff_isZero, tail 0]
        simp only [Fin.forall_fin_succ, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ]
        simp
      | succ d =>
        have h := hrow.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃_iff d (hproj 0)
        dsimp only [ShortComplex.mk] at h
        simp only [Fin.castSucc_zero] at h
        rw [h, tail (d + 1)]
        simp only [Fin.forall_fin_succ, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ]
        simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.finite_rows_dimension_lt
statement:
private theorem finite_rows_dimension_lt
    {C : Type*} [Category* C] [Abelian C] (n : ℕ)
    (K : Fin (n + 1) → C) (P : Fin n → C)
    (f : ∀ i, K i.succ ⟶ P i) (g : ∀ i, P i ⟶ K i.castSucc)
    (w : ∀ i, f i ≫ g i = 0)
    (hex : ∀ i, (ShortComplex.mk (f i) (g i) (w i)).ShortExact)
    (hproj : ∀ i, Projective (P i))
    (hlast : IsZero (K (Fin.last n))) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLT (K 0) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hlast.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero
  | succ n ih =>
    have htail := ih (fun i => K i.succ) (fun i => P i.succ)
      (fun i => f i.succ) (fun i => g i.succ) (fun i => w i.succ)
      (fun i => hex i.succ) (fun i => hproj i.succ) hlast
    have := hproj 0
    have hmiddle : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (P 0) (n + 1) :=
      hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge (P 0) 1 (n + 1) (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n))
    exact (hex 0).hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃ n htail hmiddle

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.isZero_hom_obj_iff
statement:
theorem isZero_hom_obj_iff (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) :
    IsZero ((homFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).obj M) ↔ IsZero M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero] at h ⊢
    apply (F (k := k) (S := S)).map_injective
    change (F (k := k) (S := S)).map (𝟙 M) = (F (k := k) (S := S)).map 0
    rw [(F (k := k) (S := S)).map_id, (F (k := k) (S := S)).map_zero]
    exact h
  · exact (F (k := k) (S := S)).map_isZero

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_length
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLT_length
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S} (R : FiniteRankProjectiveResolution M) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLT ((homFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).obj M) R.length
proof:
:= by
  have h := finite_rows_dimension_lt R.length
    (fun i => (F (k := k) (S := S)).obj (R.kernel i))
    (fun i => (F (k := k) (S := S)).obj (R.term i))
    (fun i => (F (k := k) (S := S)).map (R.inclusion i))
    (fun i => (F (k := k) (S := S)).map (R.quotient i))
    (fun i => (homShortComplex (R.row_rank_exact i).toIsPointwiseShortExact).zero)
    (fun i => homFunctor_map_shortExact (R.row_rank_exact i))
    (fun i => by
      have := (FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.rankProjective_iff_homProjective
        (R.term i) (R.row_rank_exact i).finiteDimensional).mp (R.term_rank_projective i)
      infer_instance)
    ((isZero_hom_obj_iff _).mpr (IsZero.of_iso (isZero_zero _) R.terminal_iso))
  have := h
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso
    ((F (k := k) (S := S)).mapIso R.initial_iso) R.length

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_iff_recorded_terms
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_iff_recorded_terms
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S}
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) (d : ℕ) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((homFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).obj M) d ↔
      ∀ j : Fin R.resolution.length, d < j.val → IsZero (R.resolution.term j)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := R.resolution
  have h := finite_rows_dimension_iff Q.length
    (fun i => (F (k := k) (S := S)).obj (Q.kernel i))
    (fun i => (F (k := k) (S := S)).obj (Q.term i))
    (fun i => (F (k := k) (S := S)).map (Q.inclusion i))
    (fun i => (F (k := k) (S := S)).map (Q.quotient i))
    (fun i => (homShortComplex (Q.row_rank_exact i).toIsPointwiseShortExact).zero)
    (fun i => homFunctor_map_shortExact (Q.row_rank_exact i))
    (fun i => by
      have := (minimalResolution_row_homCover R i).1
      infer_instance)
    (fun i => (minimalResolution_row_homCover R i).2.2)
    ((isZero_hom_obj_iff _).mpr
      (IsZero.of_iso (isZero_zero _) Q.terminal_iso)) (d + 1)
  have e := (F (k := k) (S := S)).mapIso Q.initial_iso
  have hdim : HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((F (k := k) (S := S)).obj M) d ↔
      HasProjectiveDimensionLT ((F (k := k) (S := S)).obj (Q.kernel 0)) (d + 1) :=
    ⟨fun h => by have := h; exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso e.symm _,
      fun h => by have := h; exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso e _⟩
  rw [hdim, h]
  simp only [Nat.succ_le_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hz j hj
    exact (isZero_hom_obj_iff _).mp (hz j hj)
  · intro hz j hj
    exact (isZero_hom_obj_iff _).mpr (hz j hj)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_iff
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_iff
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S}
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) (d : ℕ) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((homFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).obj M) d ↔
      ∀ j, d < j → IsZero (R.termAt j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [hasProjectiveDimensionLE_iff_recorded_terms R d]
  constructor
  · intro h j hj
    by_cases hlen : j < R.resolution.length
    · rw [R.termAt_eq hlen]
      exact h ⟨j, hlen⟩ hj
    · rw [R.termAt_eq_zero (Nat.le_of_not_gt hlen)]
      exact isZero_zero _
  · intro h j hj
    simpa only [R.termAt_eq j.isLt] using h j.val hj

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.projectiveDimension_le_iff
statement:
theorem projectiveDimension_le_iff
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S}
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) (d : ℕ) :
    projectiveDimension ((homFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).obj M) ≤ d ↔
      ∀ j, d < j → IsZero (R.termAt j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension_le_iff, hasProjectiveDimensionLE_iff R d]

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.structureMap_isIso_of_birth_iff
statement:
theorem Presentation.structureMap_isIso_of_birth_iff
    (D : Presentation.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P)) {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hG : ∀ g : D.generators.Carrier,
      D.generators.grade g ≤ a ↔ D.generators.grade g ≤ b)
    (hY : ∀ y : D.relations.Carrier,
      D.relations.grade y ≤ a ↔ D.relations.grade y ≤ b) :
    IsIso (structureMap D.presented hab)
proof:
:= by
  let evA := (evaluation P (ModuleCat.{max u w} R)).obj a
  let evB := (evaluation P (ModuleCat.{max u w} R)).obj b
  let eA := PreservesCokernel.iso evA D.relationMap
  let eB := PreservesCokernel.iso evB D.relationMap
  let gIso := structureIsoOfBirthIff (R := R) D.generators hab hG
  let yIso := structureIsoOfBirthIff (R := R) D.relations hab hY
  have hs : D.relationMap.app a ≫ gIso.hom =
      yIso.hom ≫ D.relationMap.app b :=
    (D.relationMap.naturality (homOfLE hab)).symm
  let cIso := cokernel.mapIso (f := D.relationMap.app a)
    (D.relationMap.app b) yIso gIso hs
  have hkey : structureMap D.presented hab ≫ eB.hom = eA.hom ≫ cIso.hom := by
    have hcover : Epi (D.cover.app a) :=
      (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr (D.cover_surjective a)
    apply (cancel_epi (D.cover.app a)).mp
    have ha : D.cover.app a ≫ eA.hom = cokernel.π (D.relationMap.app a) := by
      exact PreservesCokernel.π_iso_hom evA D.relationMap
    have hb : D.cover.app b ≫ eB.hom = cokernel.π (D.relationMap.app b) := by
      exact PreservesCokernel.π_iso_hom evB D.relationMap
    have hn : D.cover.app a ≫ structureMap D.presented hab =
        gIso.hom ≫ D.cover.app b :=
      (D.cover.naturality (homOfLE hab)).symm
    calc
      D.cover.app a ≫ (structureMap D.presented hab ≫ eB.hom) =
          (D.cover.app a ≫ structureMap D.presented hab) ≫ eB.hom := by
            exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (gIso.hom ≫ D.cover.app b) ≫ eB.hom := by rw [hn]
      _ = gIso.hom ≫ cokernel.π (D.relationMap.app b) := by
        exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans (congrArg (gIso.hom ≫ ·) hb)
      _ = cokernel.π (D.relationMap.app a) ≫ cIso.hom := by
        simp [cIso, cokernel.mapIso_hom, cokernel.map, cokernel.π_desc]
      _ = D.cover.app a ≫ (eA.hom ≫ cIso.hom) := by
        exact (congrArg (· ≫ cIso.hom) ha.symm).trans (Category.assoc _ _ _)
  have hcomp : IsIso (eA.hom ≫ cIso.hom) :=
    IsIso.comp_isIso' eA.isIso_hom cIso.isIso_hom
  have htotal : IsIso (structureMap D.presented hab ≫ eB.hom) := by
    rw [hkey]
    exact hcomp
  exact @IsIso.of_isIso_comp_right _ _ _ _ _
    (structureMap D.presented hab) eB.hom eB.isIso_hom htotal

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.criticalCoordinates_finite
statement:
theorem Presentation.criticalCoordinates_finite
    (D : Presentation.{u,0,w} (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ)) (hD : D.IsFinite)
    (i : Fin n) : (D.criticalCoordinates i).Finite
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite D.generators.Carrier := hD.1
  let : Finite D.relations.Carrier := hD.2
  exact (Set.finite_range _).union (Set.finite_range _)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.generators_birth_iff_of_no_critical
statement:
theorem Presentation.generators_birth_iff_of_no_critical
    (D : Presentation.{u,0,w} (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ))
    {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hgap : ∀ i, Disjoint (Set.Ioc (a i) (b i)) (D.criticalCoordinates i))
    (g : D.generators.Carrier) :
    D.generators.grade g ≤ a ↔ D.generators.grade g ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.trans hab
  · intro hb i
    by_contra h
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hgap i) ⟨lt_of_not_ge h, hb i⟩ (Or.inl ⟨g, rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.relations_birth_iff_of_no_critical
statement:
theorem Presentation.relations_birth_iff_of_no_critical
    (D : Presentation.{u,0,w} (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ))
    {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hgap : ∀ i, Disjoint (Set.Ioc (a i) (b i)) (D.criticalCoordinates i))
    (y : D.relations.Carrier) :
    D.relations.grade y ≤ a ↔ D.relations.grade y ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.trans hab
  · intro hb i
    by_contra h
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (hgap i) ⟨lt_of_not_ge h, hb i⟩ (Or.inr ⟨y, rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.structureMap_isIso_of_no_critical
statement:
theorem Presentation.structureMap_isIso_of_no_critical
    (D : Presentation.{u,0,w} (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ))
    {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hgap : ∀ i, Disjoint (Set.Ioc (a i) (b i)) (D.criticalCoordinates i)) :
    IsIso (structureMap D.presented hab)
proof:
:=
  D.structureMap_isIso_of_birth_iff hab
    (D.generators_birth_iff_of_no_critical hab hgap)
    (D.relations_birth_iff_of_no_critical hab hgap)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.exists_pos_structureMap_isIso
statement:
theorem Presentation.exists_pos_structureMap_isIso
    (D : Presentation.{u,0,w} (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ))
    (hD : D.IsFinite) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ), δ ≤ ε →
      IsIso (structureMap D.presented
        (show a ≤ (fun i => a i + δ) from fun _ => le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let : Finite D.generators.Carrier := hD.1
  let : Finite D.relations.Carrier := hD.2
  let : Fintype D.generators.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite D.generators.Carrier
  let : Fintype D.relations.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite D.relations.Carrier
  let gG : Finset ℝ :=
    (Finset.univ : Finset (D.generators.Carrier × Fin n)).image
      (fun p => D.generators.grade p.1 p.2 - a p.2)
  let gY : Finset ℝ :=
    (Finset.univ : Finset (D.relations.Carrier × Fin n)).image
      (fun p => D.relations.grade p.1 p.2 - a p.2)
  let gaps : Finset ℝ := insert 1 ((gG ∪ gY).filter (fun t => 0 < t))
  have hnonempty : gaps.Nonempty := ⟨1, Finset.mem_insert_self ..⟩
  have hpositive : ∀ t ∈ gaps, 0 < t := by
    intro t ht
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp ht with rfl | ht
    · norm_num
    · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).2
  have hmin : 0 < gaps.min' hnonempty :=
    hpositive _ (Finset.min'_mem gaps hnonempty)
  let ε : ℝ := gaps.min' hnonempty / 2
  have hε : 0 < ε := half_pos hmin
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ hδε
  have hgap : ∀ i, Disjoint (Set.Ioc (a i) (a i + δ))
      (D.criticalCoordinates i) := by
    intro i
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro c hc hcrit
    have hdiffpos : 0 < c - a i := sub_pos.mpr hc.1
    have hmem : c - a i ∈ gaps := by
      apply Finset.mem_insert.mpr
      right
      apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      refine ⟨?_, hdiffpos⟩
      rcases hcrit with ⟨g, rfl⟩ | ⟨y, rfl⟩
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _
          (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(g, i), Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
      · exact Finset.mem_union_right _
          (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(y, i), Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)
    have hsmall : ε < c - a i :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le (half_lt_self hmin) (Finset.min'_le gaps _ hmem)
    have hupper : c - a i ≤ δ :=
      sub_le_iff_le_add.mpr (by simpa [add_comm] using hc.2)
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (hupper.trans hδε)) hsmall
  exact D.structureMap_isIso_of_no_critical
    (fun _ => le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ) hgap

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.structureMap_isIso_of_iso
statement:
private theorem structureMap_isIso_of_iso
    {M N : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} (e : M ≅ N)
    {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (h : IsIso (structureMap M hab)) : IsIso (structureMap N hab)
proof:
:= by
  have hright : IsIso (structureMap M hab ≫ e.hom.app b) :=
    IsIso.comp_isIso' h (inferInstance : IsIso (e.hom.app b))
  have hnat : e.hom.app a ≫ structureMap N hab =
      structureMap M hab ≫ e.hom.app b :=
    (e.hom.naturality (homOfLE hab)).symm
  have hleft : IsIso (e.hom.app a ≫ structureMap N hab) := by
    rw [hnat]
    exact hright
  exact @IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left _ _ _ _ _
    (e.hom.app a) (structureMap N hab)
    (inferInstance : IsIso (e.hom.app a)) hleft

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_finite_criticalCoordinates
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_finite_criticalCoordinates
    (M : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    ∃ S : Fin n → Set ℝ, (∀ i, (S i).Finite) ∧
      ∀ {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b),
        (∀ i, Disjoint (Set.Ioc (a i) (b i)) (S i)) →
          IsIso (structureMap M hab)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hM
  refine ⟨D.criticalCoordinates, D.criticalCoordinates_finite hD, ?_⟩
  intro a b hab hgap
  exact structureMap_isIso_of_iso e hab
    (D.structureMap_isIso_of_no_critical hab hgap)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_pos_structureMap_isIso
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_pos_structureMap_isIso
    (M : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ), δ ≤ ε →
      IsIso (structureMap M
        (show a ≤ (fun i => a i + δ) from fun _ => le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hM
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hstable⟩ := D.exists_pos_structureMap_isIso hD a
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ hδε
  exact structureMap_isIso_of_iso e _ (hstable δ hδ hδε)

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.exists_antitone_coinitial
statement:
theorem exists_antitone_coinitial (I : Set ℝ) (t : I) :
    ∃ a : ℕ → I, a 0 = t ∧ Antitone a ∧ ∀ s : I, ∃ n, a n ≤ s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_surjective_nat ℚ
  by_cases hmin : ∃ m : I, ∀ s : I, m ≤ s
  · obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hmin
    refine ⟨fun n => if n = 0 then t else m, by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i j hij
      by_cases hj : j = 0
      · subst j
        have : i = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hij
        subst i
        exact le_rfl
      · simp only [hj, ↓reduceIte]
        split_ifs <;> exact hm _
    · intro s
      exact ⟨1, hm s⟩
  · have hleft (s : I) : ∃ r : I, r < s := by
      by_contra hn
      apply hmin
      refine ⟨s, fun r => ?_⟩
      exact le_of_not_gt (fun hrs => hn ⟨r, hrs⟩)
    let b : ℕ → I := fun n =>
      if h : ∃ s : I, (s : ℝ) < e n then h.choose else t
    let a : ℕ → I := Nat.rec t (fun n p => min p (b n))
    have ha0 : a 0 = t := rfl
    have hasucc (n : ℕ) : a (n + 1) = min (a n) (b n) := rfl
    refine ⟨a, ha0, antitone_nat_of_succ_le (fun n => ?_), ?_⟩
    · rw [hasucc]
      exact min_le_left _ _
    · intro s
      obtain ⟨r, hrs⟩ := hleft s
      obtain ⟨q, hrq, hqs⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (show (r : ℝ) < s from hrs)
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := he q
      have hb : (b n : ℝ) < q := by
        have h : ∃ r : I, (r : ℝ) < e n := ⟨r, by simpa [hn] using hrq⟩
        simp only [b, dif_pos h]
        simpa [hn] using h.choose_spec
      refine ⟨n + 1, ?_⟩
      exact (min_le_right (a n) (b n)).trans (le_of_lt (show b n < s from hb.trans hqs))

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.compatible
statement:
theorem compatible (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) (x : sections M)
    {s t : P} (h : s ≤ t) : structureMapLinear M h (x.val s) = x.val t
proof:
:=
  x.property s t h

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.evaluation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_apply (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) (t : P) (x : sections M) :
    evaluation M t x = x.val t
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.mem_vanishingAt
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_vanishingAt (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) (t : P) (x : sections M) :
    x ∈ vanishingAt M t ↔ x.val t = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.exists_sequenceSection
statement:
theorem exists_sequenceSection
    (hsurj : ∀ s t (h : s ≤ t), Function.Surjective (structureMapLinear M h))
    (y : M.obj (a 0)) :
    ∃ x : sequenceSections M a ha, x.val 0 = y
proof:
:= by
  let F := sequenceFunctor M a ha
  have hF : ∀ n, Function.Surjective (F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) :=
    fun n => hsurj _ _ _
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Types.surjective_π_app_zero_of_surjective_map
    (Types.limitConeIsLimit F) hF y
  refine ⟨⟨fun n => x.val (Opposite.op n), ?_⟩, hx⟩
  intro i j h
  exact x.property (homOfLE h).op

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.transported_value_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hi' := x.property i (max i j) (le_max_left i j)
  have hj' := x.property j (max i j) (le_max_right i j)
  rw [← hi', ← hj']
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← structureMapLinear_comp,
    ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← structureMapLinear_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.extensionValue_eq
proof:
:=
  transported_value_eq M a ha x (hcoin s).choose_spec hn

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.extend_apply
statement:
theorem extend_apply (x : sequenceSections M a ha) {s : P} {n : ℕ} (hn : a n ≤ s) :
    (extend M a ha hcoin x).val s = structureMapLinear M hn (x.val n)
proof:
:=
  extensionValue_eq M a ha hcoin x hn

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.extend_at_sequence
statement:
@[simp] theorem extend_at_sequence (x : sequenceSections M a ha) (n : ℕ) :
    (extend M a ha hcoin x).val (a n) = x.val n
proof:
:= by
  rw [extend_apply M a ha hcoin x (le_refl (a n))]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.evaluation_surjective_of_coinitial
statement:
theorem evaluation_surjective_of_coinitial
    (hsurj : ∀ s t (h : s ≤ t), Function.Surjective (structureMapLinear M h)) :
    Function.Surjective (evaluation M (a 0))
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_sequenceSection M a ha hsurj y
  refine ⟨extend M a ha hcoin x, ?_⟩
  change (extend M a ha hcoin x).val (a 0) = y
  rw [extend_at_sequence, hx]

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.evaluation_surjective_real
statement:
theorem evaluation_surjective_real {I : Set ℝ} (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R I)
    (hsurj : ∀ s t (h : s ≤ t), Function.Surjective (structureMapLinear M h)) (t : I) :
    Function.Surjective (evaluation M t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha0, ha, hcoin⟩ := exists_antitone_coinitial I t
  rw [← ha0]
  exact evaluation_surjective_of_coinitial M a ha hcoin hsurj

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.structureMapLinear_subspaceModule
statement:
@[simp] theorem structureMapLinear_subspaceModule {s t : I} (h : s ≤ t) :
    structureMapLinear (subspaceModule M I S hS) h = subspaceMap M I S hS h
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.exists_compatible_lift_real
statement:
theorem exists_compatible_lift_real (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (I : Set ℝ)
    (S : ∀ t : I, Submodule R (M.obj t.val))
    (hS : ∀ s t : I, ∀ (h : s ≤ t) (x : M.obj s.val),
      x ∈ S s → structureMapLinear M h x ∈ S t)
    (hsurj : ∀ s t : I, ∀ (h : s ≤ t) (y : M.obj t.val),
      y ∈ S t → ∃ x ∈ S s, structureMapLinear M h x = y)
    (t : I) (y : M.obj t.val) (hy : y ∈ S t) :
    ∃ x : ∀ s : I, M.obj s.val, x t = y ∧ (∀ s, x s ∈ S s) ∧
      ∀ s t : I, ∀ h : s ≤ t, structureMapLinear M h (x s) = x t
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj' : ∀ s t : I, ∀ h : s ≤ t,
      Function.Surjective (structureMapLinear (subspaceModule M I S hS) h) := by
    intro s t h y
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hsurj s t h y.val y.property
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Subtype.ext hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := evaluation_surjective_real (subspaceModule M I S hS) hsurj' t ⟨y, hy⟩
  refine ⟨fun s => (x.val s).val, congrArg Subtype.val hx, fun s => (x.val s).property, ?_⟩
  intro s t h
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (compatible (subspaceModule M I S hS) x h)

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.ker_quotientEvaluation
statement:
theorem ker_quotientEvaluation :
    (quotientEvaluation M t Q).ker = Q.comap (evaluation M t)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change (Submodule.Quotient.mk (x.val t) : M.obj t ⧸ Q) = 0 ↔ x.val t ∈ Q
  exact Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero Q

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSections.quotientEvaluation_surjective
statement:
theorem quotientEvaluation_surjective (he : Function.Surjective (evaluation M t)) :
    Function.Surjective (quotientEvaluation M t Q)
proof:
:=
  Q.mkQ_surjective.comp he

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_image_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost
statement:
theorem norm_image_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost
    {I J K : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K]
    {σ A B : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    ‖image σ w P x - image σ w P y‖ ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B * finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
  simpa only [hM] using norm_image_sub_le_matching hσ hA hB w P hm hd M x y hx hy

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.Examples.closedBar_significant
statement: private theorem closedBar_significant (a : ℝ) : Significant 2 (closedBar a)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ => a, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro j <;>
    norm_num [Rectangle.support, BoundedInterval.support, closedBar, translation_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.Examples.forward_bounds
statement:
private theorem forward_bounds (a : ℝ) : ∀ j,
    decoratedLE (endpoint (closedBar a) j)
      (endpoint (closedBar a) j + (1 : ℝ))
      (plus (closedBar a) j) (plus (closedBar a) j)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨j, b⟩
  cases b <;> norm_num [decoratedLE, endpoint, plus, closedBar, add_assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.Examples.forward_coefficient
statement:
private theorem forward_coefficient (a : ℝ) :
    shiftedCoefficient (closedBar a) (closedBar a) 1 (forward a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply shiftedCoefficient_comparison (p := fun _ => a)
  · intro j
    norm_num [Rectangle.support, BoundedInterval.support, closedBar]
  · intro j
    norm_num [Rectangle.support, BoundedInterval.support, closedBar, translation_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.Examples.closed_double_overlap
proof:
:= by
  ext p
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hp, hp'⟩
    apply Set.mem_singleton_iff.mpr
    funext j
    have h := hp j
    have h' := hp' j
    change (a < p j ∨ (a = p j ∧ true = true)) ∧ _ at h
    change _ ∧ (p j + 2 < a + 2 ∨ (p j + 2 = a + 2 ∧ true = true)) at h'
    rcases h.1 with h | ⟨h, _⟩ <;>
      (rcases h'.2 with h' | ⟨h', _⟩ <;> linarith)
  · intro hp
    have he := Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hp
    subst p
    constructor <;> intro j <;>
      norm_num [Rectangle.support, BoundedInterval.support, closedBar, translation_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.Examples.closed_boundary_composite
statement:
theorem closed_boundary_composite (a : ℝ) :
    shiftedCoefficient (closedBar a) (closedBar a) (1 + 1)
      (forward a ≫ (shift 1).map (forward a) ≫
        (compIso 1 1 ((closedBar a).module (k := ℚ))).hom) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hα : alphaLE (closedBar a) (closedBar a) := Or.inr ⟨rfl, le_rfl⟩
  have he := shiftedCoefficient_composite (k := ℚ) (by decide : 0 < 1)
    (closedBar a) (closedBar a) (closedBar a) 1 hα
    (by
      convert closedBar_significant a using 1
      norm_num [stabilityRadius, Significant])
    (by
      convert closedBar_significant a using 1
      norm_num [stabilityRadius, Significant])
    (forward a) (forward a)
  simpa only [forward_coefficient, one_mul] using he

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.Examples.halfOpen_dies_at_width
statement: theorem halfOpen_dies_at_width : ¬ Significant 2 halfOpenBar
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩
  have h := hp 0
  have h' := hp' 0
  change (0 < p 0 ∨ (0 = p 0 ∧ true = true)) ∧ _ at h
  change _ ∧ (p 0 + 2 < 2 ∨ (p 0 + 2 = 2 ∧ false = true)) at h'
  rcases h.1 with h | ⟨h, _⟩ <;>
    (rcases h'.2 with h' | ⟨_, h'⟩ <;> simp_all <;> linarith)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.Examples.repeated_occurrences
statement:
theorem repeated_occurrences :
    2 ≤ (neighbors (k := ℚ)
      (fun _ : Bool => closedBar 0) (fun _ : Bool => closedBar 0)
      Finset.univ (stabilityRadius 1 1)).card
proof:
:= by
  have h := card_le_neighbors (k := ℚ) (by decide : 0 < 1)
    (fun _ : Bool => closedBar 0) (fun _ : Bool => closedBar 0) 1
    (CoordinateInterleaving.refl 1 _) Finset.univ
    (fun i hi => by convert closedBar_significant 0 using 1; norm_num [stabilityRadius])
  simpa using h

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.Examples.two_parameter_occurrences
statement:
theorem two_parameter_occurrences :
    2 ≤ (neighbors (k := ℚ)
      (fun _ : Bool => closedSquare) (fun _ : Bool => closedSquare)
      Finset.univ 3).card
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Significant 6 closedSquare := by
    refine ⟨fun _ => 0, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro j <;>
      norm_num [Rectangle.support, BoundedInterval.support, closedSquare, translation_apply]
  have h := card_le_neighbors (k := ℚ) (by decide : 0 < 2)
    (fun _ : Bool => closedSquare) (fun _ : Bool => closedSquare) 1
    (CoordinateInterleaving.refl 1 _) Finset.univ
    (fun i hi => by convert hp using 1; norm_num [stabilityRadius])
  norm_num [stabilityRadius] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.Examples.zero_parameter_singleton
statement:
theorem zero_parameter_singleton :
    1 ≤ (neighbors (k := ℚ)
      (fun _ : Unit => closedPoint) (fun _ : Unit => closedPoint)
      Finset.univ (stabilityRadius 1 0)).card
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Significant 0 closedPoint := by
    refine ⟨fun _ => 0, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro j <;>
      norm_num [Rectangle.support, BoundedInterval.support, closedPoint, translation_apply]
  have h := card_le_neighbors (k := ℚ) (by decide : 0 < 1)
    (fun _ : Unit => closedPoint) (fun _ : Unit => closedPoint) 0
    (CoordinateInterleaving.refl 0 _) Finset.univ
    (fun i hi => by simpa [stabilityRadius] using hp)
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.Examples.empty_families
statement:
theorem empty_families (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).card ≤
      (neighbors (n := 1) (k := ℚ) (fun i : Fin 0 => i.elim0)
        (fun i : Fin 0 => i.elim0) Finset.univ (stabilityRadius 1 ε)).card
proof:
:= by
  exact card_le_neighbors (k := ℚ) (by decide : 0 < 1)
    (fun i : Fin 0 => i.elim0) (fun i : Fin 0 => i.elim0) ε
    (CoordinateInterleaving.refl ε _) Finset.univ (fun i _ => i.elim0)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.Examples.empty_selection
statement:
theorem empty_selection (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    0 ≤ (neighbors (k := ℚ) (fun _ : Bool => closedBar 0)
      (fun _ : Bool => closedBar 0) ∅ (stabilityRadius 1 ε)).card
proof:
:= by
  have h := card_le_neighbors (k := ℚ) (by decide : 0 < 1)
    (fun _ : Bool => closedBar 0) (fun _ : Bool => closedBar 0) ε
    (CoordinateInterleaving.refl ε _) ∅ (by simp)
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.RealRay.support_mono
statement:
private theorem support_mono (closed : Bool) {s t : ℝ} (h : s ≤ t)
    (hs : s ∈ support closed) : t ∈ support closed
proof:
:= by
  cases closed <;> simp only [support, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at *
  · exact hs.trans_le h
  · exact hs.trans h

name: TDA.Persistence.RealRay.support_ordConnected
statement: private theorem support_ordConnected (closed : Bool) : (support closed).OrdConnected
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro a ha b _ c hc
  exact support_mono closed hc.1 ha

name: TDA.Persistence.RealRay.structureMap_val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [SupportInterval.structureMap_val]
  split_ifs with ht
  · rfl
  · exact (SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (support closed)
      (fun hs => ht (support_mono closed h hs)) x).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealRay.shifted_support
statement:
private theorem shifted_support (c d : Bool) {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 0 < ε)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ support c) : t + (ε : ℝ) ∈ support d
proof:
:= by
  have ht' : 0 ≤ t := by
    cases c
    · exact le_of_lt (by simpa [support] using ht)
    · simpa [support] using ht
  have he : (0 : ℝ) < ε := hε
  cases d <;> simp [support] <;> linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.RealRay.fiber_le_shift
proof:
:= by
    classical
    intro x hx
    by_cases ht : t ∈ support c
    · simp [SupportInterval.fiber, shifted_support c d hε ht]
    · have hx0 : x = 0 := by simpa [SupportInterval.fiber, ht] using hx
      simp [hx0]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealRay.forward_val
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealRay.distance_eq_zero
statement:
theorem distance_eq_zero (c d : Bool) :
    realInterleavingDistance (module (k := k) c) (module d) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply realInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  exact ⟨interleaving c d ε hε⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RealRay.not_nonempty_iso
statement: theorem not_nonempty_iso : ¬ Nonempty (module (k := k) true ≅ module false)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e⟩
  let x : (module (k := k) true).obj 0 :=
    SupportInterval.one (support true) (by simp [support])
  have hz : ((e.hom.app 0).hom x : k) = 0 :=
    SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (support false) (by simp [support]) _
  have hy : (e.hom.app 0).hom x = 0 := Subtype.ext hz
  have hx0 : x = 0 := by
    have hh := congrArg (fun y => (e.inv.app 0).hom y) hy
    change ((e.hom.app 0 ≫ e.inv.app 0).hom x) = _ at hh
    rw [e.hom_inv_id_app] at hh
    simpa only [ModuleCat.hom_id, LinearMap.id_apply, map_zero] using hh
  have h := congrArg (fun y : (module (k := k) true).obj 0 => (y : k)) hx0
  exact one_ne_zero h

name: TDA.Persistence.RealRay.not_nonempty_zero_interleaving
statement:
theorem not_nonempty_zero_interleaving :
    ¬ Nonempty (RealInterleaving 0 (module (k := k) true) (module false))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨i⟩
  exact not_nonempty_iso ⟨i.toIso⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.isRankProjective
statement:
theorem Hook.isRankProjective {i j : P} (hij : i < j) :
    IsRankProjective (module (k := k) i j)
proof:
:= by
  intro L M N ι π hs α
  exact exists_lift hij hs α

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.isRankProjective
statement:
theorem HookInfinity.isRankProjective (i : P) :
    IsRankProjective (module (R := k) i)
proof:

  exact exists_lift_rankExact hs α

name: TDA.Persistence.Hook.finiteDimensional
statement:
@[instance] theorem Hook.finiteDimensional (i j p : P) :
    FiniteDimensional k ((module (k := k) i j).obj p)
proof:
:= by

  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.finiteDimensional

@[instance] theorem HookInfinity.finiteDimensional (i p : P) :

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankProjective.of_iso
statement:
theorem IsRankProjective.of_iso {Q Q' : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (h : IsRankProjective Q) (e : Q ≅ Q') : IsRankProjective Q'
proof:
:= by
  intro L M N ι π hs α
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := h L M N ι π hs (e.hom ≫ α)
  refine ⟨e.inv ≫ β, ?_⟩
  simp [Category.assoc, hβ]

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankProjective.biproduct
statement:
theorem IsRankProjective.biproduct {J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (F : J → PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hF : ∀ j, IsRankProjective (F j)) :
    IsRankProjective (⨁ F)
proof:
:= by
  intro L M N ι π hs α
  choose β hβ using fun j => hF j L M N ι π hs (biproduct.ι F j ≫ α)
  refine ⟨biproduct.desc β, ?_⟩
  apply biproduct.hom_ext'
  intro j
  simpa only [← Category.assoc, biproduct.ι_desc] using hβ j

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankProjective.of_retract
proof:
:= by
  intro L M N ι π hs α
  obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := h L M N ι π hs (r ≫ α)
  refine ⟨s ≫ β, ?_⟩
  calc
    (s ≫ β) ≫ π = s ≫ (β ≫ π) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = s ≫ (r ≫ α) := congrArg (fun f => s ≫ f) hβ
    _ = (s ≫ r) ≫ α := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = α := by rw [hsr, Category.id_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBiproduct.fiberIsoPi_hom_π
statement:
theorem fiberIsoPi_hom_π {J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (F : J → PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (p : P) (j : J) :
    (fiberIsoPi F p).hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.proj j) =
      (biproduct.π F j).app p
proof:
:= by
  have hπ : (ModuleCat.biproductIsoPi (fun j => (F j).obj p)).hom ≫
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.proj j) = biproduct.π (fun j => (F j).obj p) j := by
    rw [← ModuleCat.biproductIsoPi_inv_comp_π, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
  calc
    _ = (Functor.mapBiproduct ((evaluation P (ModuleCat.{u} k)).obj p) F).hom ≫
        ((ModuleCat.biproductIsoPi (fun j => (F j).obj p)).hom ≫
          ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.proj j)) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = (Functor.mapBiproduct ((evaluation P (ModuleCat.{u} k)).obj p) F).hom ≫
        biproduct.π (fun j => (F j).obj p) j :=
      congrArg (fun f =>
        (Functor.mapBiproduct ((evaluation P (ModuleCat.{u} k)).obj p) F).hom ≫ f) hπ
    _ = (biproduct.π F j).app p := biproduct.lift_π _ j

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBiproduct.element_ext
statement:
theorem element_ext {J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (F : J → PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (p : P) {x y : (⨁ F).obj p}
    (h : ∀ j, ((biproduct.π F j).app p).hom x = ((biproduct.π F j).app p).hom y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (fiberIsoPi F p).hom).mp inferInstance
  funext j
  have hx := congrArg (fun f : (⨁ F).obj p ⟶ (F j).obj p => f.hom x)
    (fiberIsoPi_hom_π F p j)
  have hy := congrArg (fun f : (⨁ F).obj p ⟶ (F j).obj p => f.hom y)
    (fiberIsoPi_hom_π F p j)
  exact hx.trans ((h j).trans hy.symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBiproduct.finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional {J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (F : J → PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (p : P)
    [∀ j, FiniteDimensional k ((F j).obj p)] :
    FiniteDimensional k ((⨁ F).obj p)
proof:
:=
  FiniteDimensional.of_injective (fiberIsoPi F p).hom.hom
    ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankKernel.fiberIso_inv_ι
statement:
theorem fiberIso_inv_ι (p : P) :
    (fiberIso π p).inv ≫ (kernel.ι π).app p =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.ker (π.app p).hom).subtype
proof:
:= by
  change (ModuleCat.kernelIsoKer (π.app p)).inv ≫
    (PreservesKernel.iso ((evaluation P (ModuleCat.{u} k)).obj p) π).inv ≫
      ((evaluation P (ModuleCat.{u} k)).obj p).map (kernel.ι π) = _
  rw [PreservesKernel.iso_inv_ι]
  exact ModuleCat.kernelIsoKer_inv_kernel_ι _

name: TDA.Persistence.RankKernel.injective
statement: theorem injective (p : P) : Function.Injective ((kernel.ι π).app p).hom
proof:
:= by
  exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.RankKernel.range_eq_ker
statement:
theorem range_eq_ker (p : P) :
    LinearMap.range ((kernel.ι π).app p).hom = LinearMap.ker (π.app p).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun f => (f.app p).hom y) (kernel.condition π)
    exact h
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨(fiberIso π p).inv.hom ⟨x, hx⟩, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg (fun f : ModuleCat.of k (LinearMap.ker (π.app p).hom) ⟶ M.obj p =>
      f.hom ⟨x, hx⟩) (fiberIso_inv_ι π p)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankKernel.shortExact
statement:
theorem shortExact (hπ : ∀ p, Function.Surjective (π.app p).hom) :
    IsPointwiseShortExact (kernel.ι π) π where
  injective
proof:
:= injective π
  surjective := hπ
  range_eq_ker := range_eq_ker π

name: TDA.Persistence.RankKernel.finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional (p : P) [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    FiniteDimensional k ((kernel π).obj p)
proof:
:=
  FiniteDimensional.of_injective ((kernel.ι π).app p).hom (injective π p)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankKernel.rankExact
statement:
theorem rankExact (hπ : ∀ p, Function.Surjective (π.app p).hom)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)]
    (hlift : ∀ {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b) (n : N.obj a),
      structureMapLinear N hab n = 0 →
        ∃ m : M.obj a, (π.app a).hom m = n ∧ structureMapLinear M hab m = 0) :
    IsRankExact (kernel.ι π) π where
  toIsPointwiseShortExact
proof:
:= shortExact π hπ
  finiteDimensional _ := inferInstance
  rank_add hab := ((shortExact π hπ).rank_add_iff_lift_kernel hab).mpr (hlift hab)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.GradedGenerators.shiftGrade_grade
statement:
@[simp] theorem GradedGenerators.shiftGrade_grade
    (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) (σ : ℝ)
    (g : W.Carrier) (i : Fin n) : (W.shiftGrade σ).grade g i = W.grade g i - σ
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.GradedGenerators.shiftGrade_neg_grade
statement:
@[simp] theorem GradedGenerators.shiftGrade_neg_grade
    (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (g : W.Carrier) (i : Fin n) :
    (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade g i = W.grade g i + (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [GradedGenerators.shiftGrade_grade]

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.fiber_shiftGrade_eq
statement:
theorem fiber_shiftGrade_eq (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    fiber (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (ε : ℝ)) a =
      fiber (R := R) W (CoordinateShift.translation ε a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fiber
  congr 1
  ext g
  change (∀ i, W.grade g i - (ε : ℝ) ≤ a i) ↔
    (∀ i, W.grade g i ≤ a i + (ε : ℝ))
  simp only [sub_le_iff_le_add]

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.shiftIso_hom_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftIso_hom_val (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (a : Fin n → ℝ)
    (x : (module (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (ε : ℝ))).obj a) :
    (((shiftIso (R := R) ε W).hom.app a).hom x :
      fiber (R := R) W (CoordinateShift.translation ε a)).val = x.val
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.shiftIso_generator
statement:
theorem shiftIso_generator (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (g : W.Carrier)
    (h : (W.shiftGrade (ε : ℝ)).grade g ≤ a) :
    ((shiftIso (R := R) ε W).hom.app a).hom
        (generator (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (ε : ℝ)) g h) =
      generator (R := R) W g (by
        intro i
        exact (sub_le_iff_le_add).mp (h i))
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.transition_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem transition_val (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : (module (R := R) W).obj a) :
    (((CoordinateShift.transition ε (module (R := R) W)).app a).hom x :
      fiber (R := R) W (CoordinateShift.translation ε a)).val = x.val
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delayed_fiber_le
statement:
theorem delayed_fiber_le (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    fiber (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) a ≤ fiber (R := R) W a
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx g hg i
  have h : W.grade g i + (ε : ℝ) ≤ a i := by
    simpa only [GradedGenerators.shiftGrade_neg_grade] using hx hg i
  exact (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg).trans h

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delayedInclusion_birth_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem delayedInclusion_birth_val
    (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (g : W.Carrier) :
    (((delayedInclusion (R := R) ε W).app
      ((W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade g)).hom
        (birth (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g) :
      fiber (R := R) W ((W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade g)).val =
        Finsupp.single g 1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delayedInclusion_generator
statement:
theorem delayedInclusion_generator
    (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) (g : W.Carrier)
    (h : (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade g ≤ a) :
    ((delayedInclusion (R := R) ε W).app a).hom
        (generator (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g h) =
      generator (R := R) W g (by
        intro i
        have hi : W.grade g i + (ε : ℝ) ≤ a i := by
          simpa only [GradedGenerators.shiftGrade_neg_grade] using h i
        exact (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg).trans hi)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

private theorem triangle_edge_values (t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_family_values_interpolate
statement:
private theorem triangle_family_values_interpolate
    (t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (σ : TotalFace triangleBoundary) :
    (triangleFilter t).value σ =
      (intervalFilter (triangleFilter ⟨0, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩)
        (triangleFilter ⟨1, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩) t).value σ
proof:
:= by
  have classify : ∀ s : Finset (Fin 3), s.Nonempty → s.card ≤ 2 →
      s = {0} ∨ s = {1} ∨ s = {2} ∨
      s = {0, 1} ∨ s = {1, 2} ∨ s = {0, 2} := by decide
  rcases σ with ⟨s, hs⟩
  rcases classify s hs.1 hs.2 with h | h | h | h | h | h <;>

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangleFilter_ext

private theorem triangleFilter_ext

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_half_order0_monotone
statement:
private theorem triangle_half_order0_monotone :
    Monotone ((triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf).value ∘ triangleCompatible0.enum)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hv : ∀ q : Fin (faceCount triangleBoundary),
      (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf).value (triangleOrder0 q) =
        if q.val = 3 ∨ q.val = 4 then (7 / 2 : ℝ) else q.val := by
    intro q
    fin_cases q <;>
      norm_num [triangleOrder0, triangleOrder0Fun, triangleFilter,
        triangleValue, triangleTimeHalf, triangleVertex0, triangleVertex1,
        triangleVertex2, triangleEdge01, triangleEdge12, triangleEdge02] <;>
      simp [show (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide,
        show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide,
        show ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)).card ≠ 1 by decide,
        show ({0, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)).card ≠ 1 by decide]
  change (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf).value (triangleOrder0 i) ≤
    (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf).value (triangleOrder0 j)
  rw [hv i, hv j]
  have hval : i.val ≤ j.val := Fin.le_def.mp hij
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num at *

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_half_order1_monotone

  have hv : ∀ q : Fin (faceCount triangleBoundary),

        triangleValue, triangleTimeHalf, triangleVertex0, triangleVertex1,
        triangleVertex2, triangleEdge01, triangleEdge12, triangleEdge02] <;>
      simp [show (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide,
        show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide,
        show ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)).card ≠ 1 by decide,
        show ({0, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)).card ≠ 1 by decide]
  change (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf).value (triangleOrder1 i) ≤
    (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf).value (triangleOrder1 j)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_compatible_orders_reverse
statement:
private theorem triangle_compatible_orders_reverse
    (e0 : CompatibleOrder (triangleFilter triangleTime0))
    (e1 : CompatibleOrder (triangleFilter triangleTime1)) :

    e1.enum.symm triangleEdge12 < e1.enum.symm triangleEdge01
proof:
:= by

  · apply e0.monotone.reflect_lt
    simpa only [e0.enum.apply_symm_apply, Function.comp_apply] using
      triangle_edge_order_crosses.1
  · apply e1.monotone.reflect_lt

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_explicit_endpoint_diagrams

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_prefix2_of_attachments
statement:
private theorem triangle_prefix2_of_attachments
    {f : FilterFunction triangleBoundary ℝ} (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (v0' : (faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 0)).simplex = {0})
    (v2' : (faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 1)).simplex = {2})
    (s : Finset (Fin 3)) :
    s ∈ e.prefixComplex 2 ↔ s = {0} ∨ s = {2}
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := (faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 0)).face_iff s
  have h1 := (faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 1)).face_iff s
  have hz : s ∉ e.prefixComplex 0 := by
    rw [e.prefixComplex_zero]
    simp
  have h0' : s ∈ e.prefixComplex 1 ↔
      s ∈ e.prefixComplex 0 ∨ s = {0} := by
    rw [v0'] at h0
    simpa [triangleIndex] using h0
  have h1' : s ∈ e.prefixComplex 2 ↔
      s ∈ e.prefixComplex 1 ∨ s = {2} := by
    rw [v2'] at h1
    simpa [triangleIndex] using h1
  simp only [h1', h0', hz, false_or]

  have h1 := (faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 1)).face_iff s
  have h2 := (faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 2)).face_iff s
  have hz : s ∉ e.prefixComplex 0 := by
    rw [e.prefixComplex_zero]
    simp
  have h0' : s ∈ e.prefixComplex 1 ↔
      s ∈ e.prefixComplex 0 ∨ s = {0} := by
    rw [v0'] at h0

  have h1' : s ∈ e.prefixComplex 2 ↔
      s ∈ e.prefixComplex 1 ∨ s = {2} := by

  have h2' : s ∈ e.prefixComplex 3 ↔
      s ∈ e.prefixComplex 2 ∨ s = {1} := by
