name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_order0_component_constant
statement:
private theorem triangle_order0_component_constant (σ :
    Face (triangleCompatible0.prefixComplex 4) 1) :
    (2 : Fin 3) ∉ (deletedFace _ 0 σ 0).1 ↔
      (2 : Fin 3) ∉ (deletedFace _ 0 σ 1).1
proof:
:= by
  have hedge := triangle_order0_prefix4_only_edge σ
  have hnot : (2 : Fin 3) ∉ σ.1 := by rw [hedge]; decide
  have h0 : (deletedFace _ 0 σ 0).1 ⊆ σ.1 :=
    Finset.erase_subset _ _
  have h1 : (deletedFace _ 0 σ 1).1 ⊆ σ.1 :=
    Finset.erase_subset _ _
  exact iff_of_true (fun hm => hnot (h0 hm))
    (fun hm => hnot (h1 hm))

proof:

  have hnot : (0 : Fin 3) ∉ σ.1 := by rw [hedge]; decide
  have h0 : (deletedFace _ 0 σ 0).1 ⊆ σ.1 :=
    Finset.erase_subset _ _
  have h1 : (deletedFace _ 0 σ 1).1 ⊆ σ.1 :=
    Finset.erase_subset _ _

    (fun hm => hnot (h1 hm))

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_rank33
statement:
private theorem triangle_rank33
    {f : FilterFunction triangleBoundary ℝ} (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (he : e.prefixComplex 3 = triangleCompatible0.prefixComplex 3) :
    structureMapRank (facePrefixModule (ZMod 2) e 0)
      (triangleStage 3) (triangleStage 3) (by decide) = 3
proof:
:= by
  unfold structureMapRank
  rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
    (simplicialHomology (e.prefixComplex 3) (ZMod 2) 0) = 3
  rw [he]
  exact triangle_prefix3_h0_dim

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_rank23
statement:
private theorem triangle_rank23
    {f : FilterFunction triangleBoundary ℝ} (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (he2 : e.prefixComplex 2 = triangleCompatible0.prefixComplex 2)
    (hface : (faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 2)).simplex = {1}) :
    structureMapRank (facePrefixModule (ZMod 2) e 0)
      (triangleStage 2) (triangleStage 3) (by decide) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (e.enum (triangleIndex 2)).val.card - 1 = 0 := by
    change (faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 2)).simplex.card - 1 = 0
    rw [hface]
    decide
  let A : SimplexAttachment (e.prefixComplex 2) (e.prefixComplex 3) 0 := by
    have hA := faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 2)
    rw [hq] at hA
    simpa [triangleIndex] using hA
  have hinj := A.homologyIncl_injective_of_succ_ne (ZMod 2) (by decide : 0 + 1 ≠ 0)
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
    (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) A.inclusion 0).hom) = 2
  rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hinj, he2]
  exact triangle_prefix2_h0_dim

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_rank34
statement:
private theorem triangle_rank34
    {f : FilterFunction triangleBoundary ℝ} (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (he3 : e.prefixComplex 3 = triangleCompatible0.prefixComplex 3)
    (hface : (faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 3)).simplex.card = 2) :
    structureMapRank (facePrefixModule (ZMod 2) e 0)
      (triangleStage 3) (triangleStage 4) (by decide) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (e.enum (triangleIndex 3)).val.card - 1 = 1 := by
    change (faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 3)).simplex.card - 1 = 1
    omega
  let A : SimplexAttachment (e.prefixComplex 3) (e.prefixComplex 4) 1 := by
    have hA := faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 3)
    rw [hq] at hA
    simpa [triangleIndex] using hA
  haveI : IsEmpty (Face (e.prefixComplex 3) 1) := by
    rw [he3]
    infer_instance
  have hdeath := A.positive_death (ZMod 2)
    (A.attachingClass_ne_zero_of_no_old_coface (ZMod 2))
  have hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (simplicialHomology (e.prefixComplex 3) (ZMod 2) 0) = 3 := by
    rw [he3]
    exact triangle_prefix3_h0_dim
  have hr := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
    (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) A.inclusion 0).hom
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) A.inclusion 0).hom) +
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
        (LinearMap.ker (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) A.inclusion 0).hom) =
        Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
          (simplicialHomology (e.prefixComplex 3) (ZMod 2) 0) at hr
  rw [hdeath.2.2.1, hdim] at hr
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) A.inclusion 0).hom) = 2
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_stage4_h0_dim
statement:
private theorem triangle_stage4_h0_dim
    {f : FilterFunction triangleBoundary ℝ} (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (he3 : e.prefixComplex 3 = triangleCompatible0.prefixComplex 3)
    (hface : (faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 3)).simplex.card = 2) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (simplicialHomology (e.prefixComplex 4) (ZMod 2) 0) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hq : (e.enum (triangleIndex 3)).val.card - 1 = 1 := by
    change (faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 3)).simplex.card - 1 = 1
    omega
  let A : SimplexAttachment (e.prefixComplex 3) (e.prefixComplex 4) 1 := by
    have hA := faceStepAttachment e (triangleIndex 3)
    rw [hq] at hA
    simpa [triangleIndex] using hA
  haveI : IsEmpty (Face (e.prefixComplex 3) 1) := by
    rw [he3]
    infer_instance
  have hsurj := (A.positive_death (ZMod 2)
    (A.attachingClass_ne_zero_of_no_old_coface (ZMod 2))).1
  have hr := triangle_rank34 e he3 hface
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
    (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) A.inclusion 0).hom) = 2 at hr
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj, finrank_top] at hr
  exact hr

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_order0_rank24
proof:
:= by
  let h := triangleCompatible0.prefixComplex_mono (by decide : 2 ≤ 4)

    quotientIncl_injective_of_two_vertices_separated
      (triangleCompatible0.prefixComplex 2) (ZMod 2) h
      (triangle_prefix2_vertex 0) (triangle_prefix2_vertex 1)
      triangle_prefix2_chain_decompose
      (fun σ => (2 : Fin 3) ∉ σ.1)
      triangle_order0_component_constant
      (by decide) (by decide)
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
    (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) h 0).hom) = 2
  rw [finrank_homologyIncl_range_eq_quotientIncl_range,
    LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hinj]
  exact ((homologyKernelQuotient (ZMod 2)
    (simplicialChainComplex (triangleCompatible0.prefixComplex 2) (ZMod 2)) 0
      ).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq).symm.trans triangle_prefix2_h0_dim

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_order0_second_edge_death
statement:
private theorem triangle_order0_second_edge_death :
    Function.Surjective (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
      (triangleCompatible0.prefixComplex_mono (by decide : 4 ≤ 5)) 0).hom ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (LinearMap.ker (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        (triangleCompatible0.prefixComplex_mono (by decide : 4 ≤ 5)) 0).hom) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hface : (faceStepAttachment triangleCompatible0 (triangleIndex 4)).simplex =
      {1, 2} := by
    simpa [triangleIndex] using triangle_order0_entering_faces (triangleIndex 4)
  have hq : (triangleCompatible0.enum (triangleIndex 4)).val.card - 1 = 1 := by
    change (faceStepAttachment triangleCompatible0 (triangleIndex 4)).simplex.card - 1 = 1
    rw [hface]
    decide
  let A : SimplexAttachment (triangleCompatible0.prefixComplex 4)
      (triangleCompatible0.prefixComplex 5) 1 := by
    have hA := faceStepAttachment triangleCompatible0 (triangleIndex 4)
    rw [hq] at hA
    simpa [triangleIndex] using hA
  have hnew : A.simplex = {1, 2} := hface
  have horder : A.simplex.orderEmbOfFin A.card_simplex =
      Fin.succAboveOrderEmb (0 : Fin 3) := by
    have hs : A.simplex = ({(0 : Fin 3)}ᶜ : Finset (Fin 3)) := by
      rw [hnew]
      decide
    simp [hs]
  have h0 : (2 : Fin 3) ∈ (A.oldDeletedFace 0).1 := by
    change (2 : Fin 3) ∈
      A.simplex.erase (A.simplex.orderEmbOfFin A.card_simplex 0)
    rw [horder, hnew]
    decide
  have h1 : (2 : Fin 3) ∉ (A.oldDeletedFace 1).1 := by
    change (2 : Fin 3) ∉
      A.simplex.erase (A.simplex.orderEmbOfFin A.card_simplex 1)
    rw [horder, hnew]
    decide
  have hdeath := A.positive_death (ZMod 2)
    (SimplexAttachment.attachingHomologyClass_ne_zero_of_separated_vertices
      (triangleCompatible0.prefixComplex 4) (ZMod 2) A
      (fun σ => (2 : Fin 3) ∈ σ.1)
      (by
        intro σ
        have hedge := triangle_order0_prefix4_only_edge σ
        have hnot : (2 : Fin 3) ∉ σ.1 := by rw [hedge]; decide
        have hdel0 : (deletedFace _ 0 σ 0).1 ⊆ σ.1 := Finset.erase_subset _ _
        have hdel1 : (deletedFace _ 0 σ 1).1 ⊆ σ.1 := Finset.erase_subset _ _
        exact iff_of_false (fun hm => hnot (hdel0 hm))
          (fun hm => hnot (hdel1 hm)))
      h0 h1)
  simpa only [SimplexAttachment.inclusion] using
    (show Function.Surjective (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) A.inclusion 0).hom ∧
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
        (LinearMap.ker (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) A.inclusion 0).hom) = 1
      from ⟨hdeath.1, hdeath.2.2.1⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_order1_second_edge_death
statement:
private theorem triangle_order1_second_edge_death :
    Function.Surjective (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
      (triangleCompatible1.prefixComplex_mono (by decide : 4 ≤ 5)) 0).hom ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (LinearMap.ker (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        (triangleCompatible1.prefixComplex_mono (by decide : 4 ≤ 5)) 0).hom) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hface : (faceStepAttachment triangleCompatible1 (triangleIndex 4)).simplex =
      {0, 1} := by
    simpa [triangleIndex] using triangle_order1_entering_faces (triangleIndex 4)
  have hq : (triangleCompatible1.enum (triangleIndex 4)).val.card - 1 = 1 := by
    change (faceStepAttachment triangleCompatible1 (triangleIndex 4)).simplex.card - 1 = 1
    rw [hface]
    decide
  let A : SimplexAttachment (triangleCompatible1.prefixComplex 4)
      (triangleCompatible1.prefixComplex 5) 1 := by
    have hA := faceStepAttachment triangleCompatible1 (triangleIndex 4)
    rw [hq] at hA
    simpa [triangleIndex] using hA
  have hnew : A.simplex = {0, 1} := hface
  have horder : A.simplex.orderEmbOfFin A.card_simplex =
      Fin.succAboveOrderEmb (2 : Fin 3) := by
    have hs : A.simplex = ({(2 : Fin 3)}ᶜ : Finset (Fin 3)) := by
      rw [hnew]
      decide
    simp [hs]
  have h0 : (0 : Fin 3) ∉ (A.oldDeletedFace 0).1 := by
    change (0 : Fin 3) ∉
      A.simplex.erase (A.simplex.orderEmbOfFin A.card_simplex 0)
    rw [horder, hnew]
    decide
  have h1 : ¬ (0 : Fin 3) ∉ (A.oldDeletedFace 1).1 := by
    change ¬ (0 : Fin 3) ∉
      A.simplex.erase (A.simplex.orderEmbOfFin A.card_simplex 1)
    rw [horder, hnew]
    decide
  have hdeath := A.positive_death (ZMod 2)
    (SimplexAttachment.attachingHomologyClass_ne_zero_of_separated_vertices
      (triangleCompatible1.prefixComplex 4) (ZMod 2) A
      (fun σ => (0 : Fin 3) ∉ σ.1)
      (by intro σ; exact not_congr (triangle_order1_component_constant σ))
      h0 h1)
  simpa only [SimplexAttachment.inclusion] using
    (show Function.Surjective (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) A.inclusion 0).hom ∧
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
        (LinearMap.ker (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) A.inclusion 0).hom) = 1
      from ⟨hdeath.1, hdeath.2.2.1⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_stage5_h0_dim

    {f : FilterFunction triangleBoundary ℝ} (e : CompatibleOrder f)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_rank_one_of_vertex
statement:
private theorem triangle_rank_one_of_vertex
    {f : FilterFunction triangleBoundary ℝ} (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (i j : Fin 7) (hij : i ≤ j) (σ : Face (e.prefixComplex i.val) 0)
    (hdim : Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
        (simplicialHomology (e.prefixComplex i.val) (ZMod 2) 0) = 1 ∨
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
        (simplicialHomology (e.prefixComplex j.val) (ZMod 2) 0) = 1) :
    structureMapRank (facePrefixModule (ZMod 2) e 0)
      (triangleStage i) (triangleStage j)
      (by simpa [triangleStage] using hij) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let h := e.prefixComplex_mono (Fin.le_def.mp hij)
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) h 0).hom) :=
    finrank_homologyIncl_range_pos_of_vertex
      (e.prefixComplex i.val) (ZMod 2) h σ
  have hle : Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) h 0).hom) ≤ 1 := by
    rcases hdim with hs | ht
    · exact (LinearMap.finrank_range_le _).trans_eq hs
    · exact (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) h 0).hom
        ).finrank_le.trans_eq ht
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
    (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) h 0).hom) = 1
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_multiplicities_from_ranks
statement:
private theorem triangle_multiplicities_from_ranks
    {f : FilterFunction triangleBoundary ℝ} (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (r33 : structureMapRank (facePrefixModule (ZMod 2) e 0)
      (triangleStage 3) (triangleStage 3) (by decide) = 3)
    (r23 : structureMapRank (facePrefixModule (ZMod 2) e 0)
      (triangleStage 2) (triangleStage 3) (by decide) = 2)
    (r34 : structureMapRank (facePrefixModule (ZMod 2) e 0)
      (triangleStage 3) (triangleStage 4) (by decide) = 2)
    (r24 : structureMapRank (facePrefixModule (ZMod 2) e 0)
      (triangleStage 2) (triangleStage 4) (by decide) = 2)
    (r14 : structureMapRank (facePrefixModule (ZMod 2) e 0)
      (triangleStage 1) (triangleStage 4) (by decide) = 1)
    (r25 : structureMapRank (facePrefixModule (ZMod 2) e 0)
      (triangleStage 2) (triangleStage 5) (by decide) = 1)
    (r15 : structureMapRank (facePrefixModule (ZMod 2) e 0)
      (triangleStage 1) (triangleStage 5) (by decide) = 1) :
    barcodeMultiplicity (facePrefixBarcode (ZMod 2) e 0) 3 4 = 1 ∧
    barcodeMultiplicity (facePrefixBarcode (ZMod 2) e 0) 2 5 = 1
proof:
:= by
  let M := facePrefixModule (ZMod 2) e 0
  have rankInt (i j : Fin 7) (hij : i ≤ j) :
      moduleRankInteger M i.val j.val =
        (structureMapRank M (triangleStage i) (triangleStage j)
          (by simpa [triangleStage] using hij) : ℤ) := by
    simpa only [triangleStage, Fin.val_cast] using
      (moduleRankInteger_fin M (triangleStage i) (triangleStage j)
        (by simpa [triangleStage] using hij))
  have a33 : moduleRankInteger M 3 3 = 3 := by
    simpa [M, r33] using rankInt 3 3 (by decide)
  have a23 : moduleRankInteger M 2 3 = 2 := by
    simpa [M, r23] using rankInt 2 3 (by decide)
  have a34 : moduleRankInteger M 3 4 = 2 := by
    simpa [M, r34] using rankInt 3 4 (by decide)
  have a24 : moduleRankInteger M 2 4 = 2 := by
    simpa [M, r24] using rankInt 2 4 (by decide)
  have a14 : moduleRankInteger M 1 4 = 1 := by
    simpa [M, r14] using rankInt 1 4 (by decide)
  have a25 : moduleRankInteger M 2 5 = 1 := by
    simpa [M, r25] using rankInt 2 5 (by decide)
  have a15 : moduleRankInteger M 1 5 = 1 := by
    simpa [M, r15] using rankInt 1 5 (by decide)
  have mu34 : moduleMultiplicityInteger M 3 4 = 1 := by
    change moduleRankInteger M 3 3 - moduleRankInteger M 2 3 -
      moduleRankInteger M 3 4 + moduleRankInteger M 2 4 = 1
    omega
  have mu25 : moduleMultiplicityInteger M 2 5 = 1 := by
    change moduleRankInteger M 2 4 - moduleRankInteger M 1 4 -
      moduleRankInteger M 2 5 + moduleRankInteger M 1 5 = 1
    omega
  constructor
  · have h := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode M 3 4 (by decide) (by
      rw [triangleBoundary_faceCount]; decide)
    change (barcodeMultiplicity (facePrefixBarcode (ZMod 2) e 0) 3 4 : ℤ) =
      moduleMultiplicityInteger M 3 4 at h
    exact_mod_cast h.trans mu34
  · have h := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode M 2 5 (by decide) (by
      rw [triangleBoundary_faceCount]; decide)
    change (barcodeMultiplicity (facePrefixBarcode (ZMod 2) e 0) 2 5 : ℤ) =
      moduleMultiplicityInteger M 2 5 at h
    exact_mod_cast h.trans mu25

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_pairing_change
statement:
theorem triangle_pairing_change :
    barcodeMultiplicity (facePrefixBarcode (ZMod 2) triangleCompatible0 0) 3 4 = 1 ∧
    barcodeMultiplicity (facePrefixBarcode (ZMod 2) triangleCompatible0 0) 2 5 = 1 ∧
    barcodeMultiplicity (facePrefixBarcode (ZMod 2) triangleCompatible1 0) 3 4 = 1 ∧
    barcodeMultiplicity (facePrefixBarcode (ZMod 2) triangleCompatible1 0) 2 5 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hvertex0 : (faceStepAttachment triangleCompatible0 (triangleIndex 2)).simplex =
      {1} := by
    simpa [triangleIndex] using triangle_order0_entering_faces (triangleIndex 2)
  have hvertex1 : (faceStepAttachment triangleCompatible1 (triangleIndex 2)).simplex =
      {1} := by
    simpa [triangleIndex] using triangle_order1_entering_faces (triangleIndex 2)
  have hfirst1 : Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (simplicialHomology (triangleCompatible1.prefixComplex 1) (ZMod 2) 0) = 1 := by
    rw [triangle_order1_prefix1, ← triangle_order0_prefix1]
    exact triangle_prefix1_h0_dim
  have h0 := triangle_multiplicities_from_ranks triangleCompatible0
    (triangle_rank33 triangleCompatible0 rfl)
    (triangle_rank23 triangleCompatible0 rfl hvertex0)
    (triangle_rank34 triangleCompatible0 rfl triangle_order0_first_edge_card)
    triangle_order0_rank24
    (triangle_rank_one_of_vertex triangleCompatible0 1 4 (by decide)
      triangle_order0_prefix1_vertex (Or.inl triangle_prefix1_h0_dim))
    (triangle_rank_one_of_vertex triangleCompatible0 2 5 (by decide)
      (triangle_prefix2_vertex 0) (Or.inr triangle_order0_stage5_h0_dim))
    (triangle_rank_one_of_vertex triangleCompatible0 1 5 (by decide)
      triangle_order0_prefix1_vertex (Or.inr triangle_order0_stage5_h0_dim))
  have h1 := triangle_multiplicities_from_ranks triangleCompatible1
    (triangle_rank33 triangleCompatible1 triangle_prefix3_eq.symm)
    (triangle_rank23 triangleCompatible1 triangle_prefix2_eq.symm hvertex1)
    (triangle_rank34 triangleCompatible1 triangle_prefix3_eq.symm
      triangle_order1_first_edge_card)
    triangle_order1_rank24
    (triangle_rank_one_of_vertex triangleCompatible1 1 4 (by decide)
      triangle_order1_prefix1_vertex (Or.inl hfirst1))
    (triangle_rank_one_of_vertex triangleCompatible1 2 5 (by decide)
      (triangle_order1_prefix2_vertex 0) (Or.inr triangle_order1_stage5_h0_dim))
    (triangle_rank_one_of_vertex triangleCompatible1 1 5 (by decide)
      triangle_order1_prefix1_vertex (Or.inr triangle_order1_stage5_h0_dim))
  exact ⟨h0.1, h0.2, h1.1, h1.2⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_pair34_mem
statement:
private theorem triangle_pair34_mem
    {f : FilterFunction triangleBoundary ℝ} (e : CompatibleOrder f)

    (triangleIndex 2, triangleIndex 3) ∈ faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) e 0
proof:
:= by

    faceTemplatePairs_mem_of_barcodeMultiplicity_pos (ZMod 2) e 0 3 4
      (by decide) (by rw [triangleBoundary_faceCount]; decide) hpos
  have h0 : p.1 = triangleIndex 2 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simpa [triangleIndex] using hb
  have h1 : p.2 = triangleIndex 3 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simpa [triangleIndex] using hd
  have hp' : p = (triangleIndex 2, triangleIndex 3) := Prod.ext h0 h1

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_pair25_mem
statement:

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_face_pairings
statement:
theorem triangle_face_pairings :
    (triangleVertex1, triangleEdge01) ∈
      (faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) triangleCompatible0 0).map
        (fun p => (triangleCompatible0.enum p.1, triangleCompatible0.enum p.2)) ∧
    (triangleVertex2, triangleEdge12) ∈
      (faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) triangleCompatible0 0).map
        (fun p => (triangleCompatible0.enum p.1, triangleCompatible0.enum p.2)) ∧
    (triangleVertex1, triangleEdge12) ∈
      (faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) triangleCompatible1 0).map
        (fun p => (triangleCompatible1.enum p.1, triangleCompatible1.enum p.2)) ∧
    (triangleVertex2, triangleEdge01) ∈
      (faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) triangleCompatible1 0).map
        (fun p => (triangleCompatible1.enum p.1, triangleCompatible1.enum p.2))
proof:
:= by
  have hm := triangle_pairing_change
  constructor
  · apply Multiset.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨(triangleIndex 2, triangleIndex 3),
      triangle_pair34_mem triangleCompatible0 (by omega), ?_⟩
    simp [triangleCompatible0, triangleOrder0, triangleOrder0Fun, triangleIndex]
  constructor
  · apply Multiset.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨(triangleIndex 1, triangleIndex 4),
      triangle_pair25_mem triangleCompatible0 (by omega), ?_⟩
    simp [triangleCompatible0, triangleOrder0, triangleOrder0Fun, triangleIndex]
  constructor
  · apply Multiset.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨(triangleIndex 2, triangleIndex 3),
      triangle_pair34_mem triangleCompatible1 (by omega), ?_⟩
    simp [triangleCompatible1, triangleOrder1, triangleOrder1Fun, triangleIndex]
  · apply Multiset.mem_map.mpr
    refine ⟨(triangleIndex 1, triangleIndex 4),
      triangle_pair25_mem triangleCompatible1 (by omega), ?_⟩
    simp [triangleCompatible1, triangleOrder1, triangleOrder1Fun, triangleIndex]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_pair_point_in_dgm
statement:
private theorem triangle_pair_point_in_dgm
    {f : FilterFunction triangleBoundary ℝ} (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (g : FilterFunction triangleBoundary ℝ)
    (hg : Monotone (g.value ∘ e.enum))
    (p : Fin (faceCount triangleBoundary) × Fin (faceCount triangleBoundary))
    (hp : p ∈ faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) e 0)
    (hne : g.value (e.enum p.1) ≠ g.value (e.enum p.2)) :
    (g.value (e.enum p.1), (g.value (e.enum p.2) : WithTop ℝ)) ∈
      (dgm (ZMod 2) g 0).points
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm (ZMod 2) e g hg 0]
  change _ ∈
    (((faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) e 0).map (pairValues g e)).filter
      (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2)).map (fun q => (q.1, (q.2 : WithTop ℝ))) + _
  apply Multiset.mem_add.mpr
  left
  apply Multiset.mem_map.mpr
  refine ⟨pairValues g e p, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Multiset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, by simpa [pairValues] using hne⟩
  · rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_midpoint_diagram_points
statement:
theorem triangle_midpoint_diagram_points :
    (2, ((7 / 2 : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)) ∈
      (dgm (ZMod 2) (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf) 0).points ∧
    (1, ((7 / 2 : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)) ∈
      (dgm (ZMod 2) (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf) 0).points
proof:
:= by
  have hm := triangle_pairing_change
  have hp34 := triangle_pair34_mem triangleCompatible0 (by omega)
  have hp25 := triangle_pair25_mem triangleCompatible0 (by omega)
  have hneq34 :
      (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf).value
        (triangleCompatible0.enum (triangleIndex 2)) ≠
      (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf).value
        (triangleCompatible0.enum (triangleIndex 3)) := by
    norm_num [triangleCompatible0, triangleOrder0, triangleOrder0Fun,
      triangleIndex, triangleFilter, triangleValue, triangleTimeHalf,
      triangleVertex1, triangleEdge01]
  have hneq25 :
      (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf).value
        (triangleCompatible0.enum (triangleIndex 1)) ≠
      (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf).value
        (triangleCompatible0.enum (triangleIndex 4)) := by
    norm_num [triangleCompatible0, triangleOrder0, triangleOrder0Fun,
      triangleIndex, triangleFilter, triangleValue, triangleTimeHalf,
      triangleVertex2, triangleEdge12]
    all_goals simp
    all_goals norm_num
  constructor
  · have hp := triangle_pair_point_in_dgm triangleCompatible0
      (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf) triangle_half_order0_monotone
      (triangleIndex 2, triangleIndex 3) hp34 hneq34
    convert hp using 1;
      norm_num [triangleCompatible0, triangleOrder0, triangleOrder0Fun,
        triangleIndex, triangleFilter, triangleValue, triangleTimeHalf,
        triangleVertex1, triangleEdge01]
  · have hp := triangle_pair_point_in_dgm triangleCompatible0
      (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf) triangle_half_order0_monotone
      (triangleIndex 1, triangleIndex 4) hp25 hneq25
    convert hp using 1;
      norm_num [triangleCompatible0, triangleOrder0, triangleOrder0Fun,
        triangleIndex, triangleFilter, triangleValue, triangleTimeHalf,
        triangleVertex2, triangleEdge12]; simp

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_time0_no_half_grade
statement:
private theorem triangle_time0_no_half_grade (σ : TotalFace triangleBoundary) :
    (triangleFilter triangleTime0).value σ ≠ (7 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := triangleCompatible0.enum.surjective σ
  fin_cases i <;>
    norm_num [triangleCompatible0, triangleOrder0, triangleOrder0Fun,
      triangleFilter, triangleValue, triangleTime0,
      triangleVertex0, triangleVertex1, triangleVertex2,
      triangleEdge01, triangleEdge12, triangleEdge02] <;>
    simp [show (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide,
      show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide,
      show ({1, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)).card ≠ 1 by decide,
      show ({0, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)).card ≠ 1 by decide] <;>
    norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.triangle_diagram_path_nonconstant
statement:
theorem triangle_diagram_path_nonconstant :
    dgm (ZMod 2) (triangleFilter triangleTime0) 0 ≠
      dgm (ZMod 2) (triangleFilter triangleTimeHalf) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hpoint := triangle_midpoint_diagram_points.1
  rw [← heq] at hpoint
  obtain ⟨p, _, hdeath⟩ := dgm_finite_death_from_faceTemplate
    (ZMod 2) triangleCompatible0 (triangleFilter triangleTime0)
    triangleCompatible0.monotone 0 2 (7 / 2 : ℝ) hpoint
  exact triangle_time0_no_half_grade (triangleCompatible0.enum p.2) hdeath

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructibleExamples.step_constructible
statement: private theorem step_constructible : IsConstructible oneGrid stepModule
proof:
:=
  isConstructible_reindex oneGrid _ (isZero_zero (ModuleCat ℚ))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructibleExamples.critical_and_left_cells
statement:
theorem critical_and_left_cells :
    cellIndex oneGrid 0 = 1 ∧ cellIndex oneGrid (-1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact cellIndex_critical oneGrid 0
  · apply (cellIndex_eq_zero_iff oneGrid (-1)).mpr
    intro i
    change (-1 : ℝ) < 0
    norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructibleExamples.unbounded_final_cell
statement: theorem unbounded_final_cell (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : cellIndex oneGrid t = 1
proof:
:=
  cellIndex_of_last_le oneGrid t ht

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructibleExamples.step_zero_left
statement: theorem step_zero_left (t : ℝ) (ht : t < 0) : IsZero (stepModule.obj t)
proof:
:=
  step_constructible.zero_left t (fun _ => ht)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructibleExamples.step_nonzero_tail
statement: theorem step_nonzero_tail (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : ¬ IsZero (stepModule.obj t)
proof:
:= by
  change ¬ IsZero ((sample oneGrid constantRationals).obj (cellIndex oneGrid t))
  rw [unbounded_final_cell t ht]
  change ¬ IsZero (ModuleCat.of ℚ ℚ)
  rw [ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton]
  exact not_subsingleton ℚ

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructibleExamples.twisted_constructible
statement:
private theorem twisted_constructible : IsConstructible oneGrid twistedStep where
  zero_left
proof:
:= step_constructible.zero_left
  isIso_map s t h heq := by
    have := step_constructible.isIso_map s t h heq
    change IsIso ((coordinateChange s).inv ≫ structureMap stepModule h ≫
      (coordinateChange t).hom)
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructibleExamples.twisted_transition_nonidentity
statement:
theorem twisted_transition_nonidentity :
    structureMap twistedStep (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num) ≠
      structureMap stepModule (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he : coordinateChange 0 = Iso.refl _ := by
    ext x
    simp [coordinateChange]
  have hcells : cellIndex oneGrid 0 = cellIndex oneGrid 1 := by
    rw [unbounded_final_cell 0 le_rfl, unbounded_final_cell 1 (by norm_num)]
  have := step_constructible.isIso_map 0 1 (by norm_num) hcells
  change (coordinateChange 0).inv ≫ structureMap stepModule _ ≫
    (coordinateChange 1).hom = structureMap stepModule _ at h
  rw [he, Iso.refl_inv, Category.id_comp] at h
  have hh : (coordinateChange 1).hom = 𝟙 _ := by
    apply (cancel_epi (structureMap stepModule (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num))).mp
    simpa using h
  apply step_nonzero_tail 1 (by norm_num)
  apply ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
  have hz (x : stepModule.obj 1) : x = 0 := by
    have hx := congrArg (fun f : stepModule.obj 1 ⟶ stepModule.obj 1 => f.hom x) hh
    change (if (1 : ℝ) < 1 then (1 : ℚ) else 2) • x = x at hx
    have hx' : x + x = x := by simpa [two_smul] using hx
    exact add_left_cancel (hx'.trans (add_zero x).symm)
  exact ⟨fun x y => (hz x).trans (hz y).symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructibleExamples.zero_transition_not_isIso
statement:
theorem zero_transition_not_isIso :
    ¬ IsIso (structureMap (zeroTransitionDiagram ℚ)
      (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := h
  have he := (asIso (structureMap (zeroTransitionDiagram ℚ)
    (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide))).hom_inv_id
  change (0 : (zeroTransitionDiagram ℚ).obj 0 ⟶
    (zeroTransitionDiagram ℚ).obj 1) ≫ _ = 𝟙 _ at he
  rw [zero_comp] at he
  have hv := congrArg (fun f : (zeroTransitionDiagram ℚ).obj 0 ⟶
    (zeroTransitionDiagram ℚ).obj 0 => f.hom (1 : ℚ)) he
  change (0 : ℚ) = 1 at hv
  norm_num at hv

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.cover_fiberIsoRangeQuotient
statement:
theorem Presentation.cover_fiberIsoRangeQuotient (a : P) :
    E.cover.app a ≫ (E.fiberIsoRangeQuotient a).hom =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.range (E.relationMap.app a).hom).mkQ
proof:
:= by
  change (cokernel.π E.relationMap).app a ≫
    ((PreservesCokernel.iso ((evaluation P (ModuleCat.{max u w} R)).obj a)
      E.relationMap).hom ≫
      (ModuleCat.cokernelIsoRangeQuotient (E.relationMap.app a)).hom) = _
  have hp := PreservesCokernel.π_iso_hom
    ((evaluation P (ModuleCat.{max u w} R)).obj a) E.relationMap
  change (cokernel.π E.relationMap).app a ≫
    (PreservesCokernel.iso ((evaluation P (ModuleCat.{max u w} R)).obj a)
      E.relationMap).hom = cokernel.π (E.relationMap.app a) at hp
  rw [← Category.assoc, hp, ModuleCat.cokernel_π_cokernelIsoRangeQuotient_hom]

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.cover_eq_zero_iff_mem_relation_range
statement:
theorem Presentation.cover_eq_zero_iff_mem_relation_range (a : P)
    (y : (module (R := R) E.generators).obj a) :
    (E.cover.app a).hom y = 0 ↔
      y ∈ LinearMap.range (E.relationMap.app a).hom
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (fun g : (module (R := R) E.generators).obj a ⟶
    ModuleCat.of R ((module (R := R) E.generators).obj a ⧸
      LinearMap.range (E.relationMap.app a).hom) => g.hom y)
    (E.cover_fiberIsoRangeQuotient a)
  change (E.fiberIsoRangeQuotient a).hom.hom ((E.cover.app a).hom y) =
    (LinearMap.range (E.relationMap.app a).hom).mkQ y at he
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  change _ ↔ (LinearMap.range (E.relationMap.app a).hom).mkQ y = 0
  rw [← he]
  exact ((E.fiberIsoRangeQuotient a).toLinearEquiv.map_eq_zero_iff).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.exists_chainMap_lift
statement:
theorem Presentation.exists_chainMap_lift
    (D : Presentation.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P))
    (f : D.presented ⟶ E.presented) :
    ∃ (α : module (R := R) D.generators ⟶ module E.generators)
      (β : module (R := R) D.relations ⟶ module E.relations),
      α ≫ E.cover = D.cover ≫ f ∧
        D.relationMap ≫ α = β ≫ E.relationMap
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := E.exists_lift D.generators (D.cover ≫ f)
  have hrelzero : D.relationMap ≫ (α ≫ E.cover) = 0 := by
    rw [hα, ← Category.assoc, D.relations_vanish, zero_comp]
  have hrange (y : D.relations.Carrier) :
      (D.relationMap ≫ α).app (D.relations.grade y)
        (birth (R := R) D.relations y) ∈
        LinearMap.range (E.relationMap.app (D.relations.grade y)).hom := by
    apply (E.cover_eq_zero_iff_mem_relation_range _ _).mp
    have hz := congrArg (fun q => q.app (D.relations.grade y)
      (birth (R := R) D.relations y)) hrelzero
    simpa [Category.assoc] using hz
  let s : ∀ y : D.relations.Carrier,
      (module (R := R) E.relations).obj (D.relations.grade y) :=
    fun y => Classical.choose (hrange y)
  have hs (y : D.relations.Carrier) :
      (E.relationMap.app (D.relations.grade y)).hom (s y) =
        (D.relationMap ≫ α).app (D.relations.grade y)
          (birth (R := R) D.relations y) :=
    Classical.choose_spec (hrange y)
  let β := lift (R := R) D.relations (module E.relations) s
  refine ⟨α, β, hα, ?_⟩
  symm
  apply TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.hom_ext_birth D.relations
  intro y
  change (E.relationMap.app (D.relations.grade y)).hom
      ((β.app (D.relations.grade y)).hom (birth D.relations y)) = _
  rw [lift_birth]
  exact hs y

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.max_mem_lower
statement:
private theorem max_mem_lower (q : Cut α) (a b : α) :
    max a b ∈ q.lower ↔ a ∈ q.lower ∧ b ∈ q.lower
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => ⟨Cut.lower_of_le (le_max_left _ _) h,
      Cut.lower_of_le (le_max_right _ _) h⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩
    rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
    · simpa only [max_eq_right hab] using hb
    · simpa only [max_eq_left hba] using ha

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.min_mem_upper
statement:
private theorem min_mem_upper (q : Cut α) (a b : α) :
    min a b ∈ q.upper ↔ a ∈ q.upper ∧ b ∈ q.upper
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fun h => ⟨Cut.upper_of_le (min_le_left _ _) h,
      Cut.upper_of_le (min_le_right _ _) h⟩
  · rintro ⟨ha, hb⟩
    rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
    · simpa only [min_eq_left hab] using ha
    · simpa only [min_eq_right hba] using hb

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cutCell_eq_empty
statement: theorem cutCell_eq_empty {a b : α} (h : b ≤ a) : cutCell a b = ∅
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  exact fun q hq => (not_lt_of_ge h) (lt_of_mem_cutCell hq)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cutCell_inter
statement:
theorem cutCell_inter (a b c d : α) :
    cutCell a b ∩ cutCell c d = cutCell (max a c) (min b d)
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  change ((a ∈ q.lower ∧ b ∈ q.upper) ∧ (c ∈ q.lower ∧ d ∈ q.upper)) ↔ _
  rw [show q ∈ cutCell (max a c) (min b d) ↔
    (a ∈ q.lower ∧ c ∈ q.lower) ∧ (b ∈ q.upper ∧ d ∈ q.upper) by
      exact and_congr (max_mem_lower q a c) (min_mem_upper q b d)]
  tauto

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cutCell_sdiff
statement:
theorem cutCell_sdiff (a b c d : α) :
    cutCell a b \ cutCell c d =
      cutCell a (min b c) ∪ cutCell (max a d) b
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  change ((a ∈ q.lower ∧ b ∈ q.upper) ∧ ¬ (c ∈ q.lower ∧ d ∈ q.upper)) ↔ _
  change _ ↔ (a ∈ q.lower ∧ min b c ∈ q.upper) ∨
    (max a d ∈ q.lower ∧ b ∈ q.upper)
  rw [min_mem_upper, max_mem_lower, cut_upper_eq_compl q]
  simp only [mem_compl_iff]
  tauto

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.disjoint_cutCell_sdiff_strips
statement:
theorem disjoint_cutCell_sdiff_strips (a b : α) {c d : α} (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    Disjoint (cutCell a (min b c)) (cutCell (max a d) b)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro q hq hq'
  have hc : c ∈ q.upper := Cut.upper_of_le (min_le_right _ _) hq.2
  have hd : d ∈ q.lower := Cut.lower_of_le (le_max_right _ _) hq'.1
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hcd) (q.lower_lt_upper hd hc)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cutCell_split
statement:
theorem cutCell_split {a e b : α} (hae : a ≤ e) (heb : e ≤ b) :
    cutCell a b = cutCell a e ∪ cutCell e b
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    rcases q.mem_lower_or_upper e with he | he
    · exact Or.inr ⟨he, hq.2⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hq.1, he⟩
  · rintro (hq | hq)
    · exact ⟨hq.1, Cut.upper_of_le heb hq.2⟩
    · exact ⟨Cut.lower_of_le hae hq.1, hq.2⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.disjoint_cutCell_split
statement: theorem disjoint_cutCell_split (a e b : α) : Disjoint (cutCell a e) (cutCell e b)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro q hl hr
  exact Cut.not_mem_upper hr.1 hl.2

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cutCell_mem_cutCells
statement: theorem cutCell_mem_cutCells (a b : α) : cutCell a b ∈ cutCells
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨a, max a b, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
  · rw [max_eq_right hab]
  · rw [cutCell_eq_empty hba, max_eq_left hba, cutCell_eq_empty le_rfl]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.isSetSemiring_cutCells
statement:
theorem isSetSemiring_cutCells [Nonempty α] : IsSetSemiring (cutCells (α := α)) where
  empty_mem
proof:
:= by
    inhabit α
    exact ⟨default, default, le_rfl, (cutCell_eq_empty le_rfl).symm⟩
  inter_mem := by
    rintro U ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩ V ⟨c, d, _, rfl⟩
    rw [cutCell_inter]
    exact cutCell_mem_cutCells _ _
  sdiff_eq_sUnion' := by
    classical
    rintro U ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩ V ⟨c, d, hcd, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨{cutCell a (min b c), cutCell (max a d) b}, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro W hW
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hW
      rcases hW with rfl | rfl <;> exact cutCell_mem_cutCells _ _
    · intro W hW Z hZ hWZ
      simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hW hZ
      rcases hW with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hZ with rfl | rfl
      · exact (hWZ rfl).elim
      · exact disjoint_cutCell_sdiff_strips a b hcd
      · exact (disjoint_cutCell_sdiff_strips a b hcd).symm
      · exact (hWZ rfl).elim
    · simpa only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, sUnion_insert, sUnion_singleton]
        using cutCell_sdiff a b c d

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells
statement:
theorem rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells (a b c d : α) (hbc : b < c) :
    rectangleCell a b c d ∈ separatedRectangleCells
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hab : a < b
  · by_cases hcd : c < d
    · exact Or.inr ⟨a, b, c, d, hab, hbc, hcd, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inl (by simp [rectangleCell, cutCell_eq_empty (le_of_not_gt hcd)])
  · exact Or.inl (by simp [rectangleCell, cutCell_eq_empty (le_of_not_gt hab)])

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.rectangleCell_inter
statement:
theorem rectangleCell_inter (a b c d e f g h : α) :
    rectangleCell a b c d ∩ rectangleCell e f g h =
      rectangleCell (max a e) (min b f) (max c g) (min d h)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [rectangleCell, prod_inter_prod, cutCell_inter]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.rectangleCell_sdiff
statement:
theorem rectangleCell_sdiff (a b c d e f g h : α) :
    rectangleCell a b c d \ rectangleCell e f g h =
      (rectangleCell a (min b e) c d ∪ rectangleCell (max a f) b c d) ∪
      (rectangleCell (max a e) (min b f) c (min d g) ∪
       rectangleCell (max a e) (min b f) (max c h) d)
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : (cutCell a b ×ˢ cutCell c d) \ (cutCell e f ×ˢ cutCell g h) =
      ((cutCell a b \ cutCell e f) ×ˢ cutCell c d) ∪
      ((cutCell a b ∩ cutCell e f) ×ˢ (cutCell c d \ cutCell g h)) := by
    ext p
    simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_prod, mem_union, mem_inter_iff]
    tauto
  simp only [rectangleCell, hprod, cutCell_sdiff, cutCell_inter, union_prod, prod_union]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.isSetSemiring_separatedRectangleCells
statement:
theorem isSetSemiring_separatedRectangleCells :
    IsSetSemiring (separatedRectangleCells (α := α)) where
  empty_mem
proof:
:= Or.inl rfl
  inter_mem := by
    rintro U (rfl | ⟨a, b, c, d, hab, hbc, hcd, rfl⟩)
      V (rfl | ⟨e, f, g, h, hef, hfg, hgh, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inl (by simp)
    · exact Or.inl (by simp)
    · exact Or.inl (by simp)
    · rw [rectangleCell_inter]
      exact rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells _ _ _ _
        ((min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (hbc.trans_le (le_max_left _ _)))
  sdiff_eq_sUnion' := by
    classical
    rintro U (rfl | ⟨a, b, c, d, hab, hbc, hcd, rfl⟩)
      V (rfl | ⟨e, f, g, h, hef, hfg, hgh, rfl⟩)
    · exact ⟨∅, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨∅, by simp, by simp, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨{rectangleCell a b c d}, by simpa using
        rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells a b c d hbc, by simp, by simp⟩
    · let R₁ := rectangleCell a (min b e) c d
      let R₂ := rectangleCell (max a f) b c d
      let R₃ := rectangleCell (max a e) (min b f) c (min d g)
      let R₄ := rectangleCell (max a e) (min b f) (max c h) d
      have hL : Disjoint (cutCell a (min b e)) (cutCell (max a e) (min b f)) := by
        apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
        intro q hq hq'
        exact Cut.not_mem_upper (Cut.lower_of_le (le_max_right _ _) hq'.1)
          (Cut.upper_of_le (min_le_right _ _) hq.2)
      have hR : Disjoint (cutCell (max a f) b) (cutCell (max a e) (min b f)) := by
        apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
        intro q hq hq'
        exact Cut.not_mem_upper (Cut.lower_of_le (le_max_right _ _) hq.1)
          (Cut.upper_of_le (min_le_right _ _) hq'.2)
      have h12 : Disjoint R₁ R₂ := disjoint_prod.mpr
        (Or.inl (disjoint_cutCell_sdiff_strips a b hef.le))
      have h13 : Disjoint R₁ R₃ := disjoint_prod.mpr (Or.inl hL)
      have h14 : Disjoint R₁ R₄ := disjoint_prod.mpr (Or.inl hL)
      have h23 : Disjoint R₂ R₃ := disjoint_prod.mpr (Or.inl hR)
      have h24 : Disjoint R₂ R₄ := disjoint_prod.mpr (Or.inl hR)
      have h34 : Disjoint R₃ R₄ := disjoint_prod.mpr
        (Or.inr (disjoint_cutCell_sdiff_strips c d hgh.le))
      refine ⟨{R₁, R₂, R₃, R₄}, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro W hW
        simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hW
        rcases hW with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
        · exact rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells _ _ _ _ ((min_le_left _ _).trans_lt hbc)
        · exact rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells _ _ _ _ hbc
        · exact rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells _ _ _ _ ((min_le_left _ _).trans_lt hbc)
        · exact rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells _ _ _ _
            ((min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (hbc.trans_le (le_max_left _ _)))
      · intro W hW Z hZ hWZ
        simp only [Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hW hZ
        rcases hW with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
          rcases hZ with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
        all_goals first
          | exact (hWZ rfl).elim
          | exact h12
          | exact h13
          | exact h14
          | exact h23
          | exact h24
          | exact h34
          | exact h12.symm
          | exact h13.symm
          | exact h14.symm
          | exact h23.symm
          | exact h24.symm
          | exact h34.symm
      · simpa only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, sUnion_insert, sUnion_singleton,
          union_assoc] using rectangleCell_sdiff a b c d e f g h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.deletionMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem deletionMass_nonneg (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) (i : I) :
    0 ≤ a.deletionMass i
proof: := sub_nonneg.mpr (a.row_le_one i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.insertionMass_nonneg
statement:
theorem insertionMass_nonneg (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) (j : J) :
    0 ≤ a.insertionMass j
proof: := sub_nonneg.mpr (a.col_le_one j)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.source_balance
statement:
theorem source_balance (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) (i : I) :
    (∑ j, a.mass i j) + a.deletionMass i = 1
proof: := by simp [deletionMass]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.target_balance
statement:
theorem target_balance (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) (j : J) :
    (∑ i, a.mass i j) + a.insertionMass j = 1
proof: := by simp [insertionMass]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.linearCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem linearCost_nonneg (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J)
    (c : I → J → ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (v : J → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ c i j) (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ j, 0 ≤ v j) :
    0 ≤ a.linearCost c u v
proof:
:= by
  apply add_nonneg
  · apply add_nonneg
    · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
        mul_nonneg (a.nonneg i j) (hc i j)
    · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (a.deletionMass_nonneg i) (hu i)
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (a.insertionMass_nonneg j) (hv j)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.cost_nonneg
statement:
theorem cost_nonneg (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : 0 ≤ a.cost x y
proof:
:= by
  apply add_nonneg
  · apply add_nonneg
    · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
        mul_nonneg (a.nonneg i j) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ =>
        mul_nonneg (a.deletionMass_nonneg i) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (a.insertionMass_nonneg j) ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.incidence_col_sum
statement:
private theorem incidence_col_sum
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) (j : J) :
    (∑ i, if M.finite i = some j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) =
      if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := h
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp [hi]
    · intro k _ hki
      have hk : M.finite k ≠ some j := fun hk => hki (M.finite_injective k i j hk hi)
      simp [hk]
    · simp
  · simp [show ∀ i, M.finite i ≠ some j from fun i hi => h ⟨i, hi⟩]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.linearCost_ofMatching
statement:
theorem linearCost_ofMatching (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (c : I → J → ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (v : J → ℝ) :
    (ofMatching M).linearCost c u v = M.totalBoundaryCost c u v
proof:
:= by
  unfold linearCost OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    cases h : M.finite i <;> simp [ofMatching, deletionMass, h]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    simp only [insertionMass, ofMatching, incidence_col_sum]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.cost_ofMatching
statement:
theorem cost_ofMatching (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    (ofMatching M).cost x y = M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:=
  linearCost_ofMatching M _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.paddedMatrix_doublyStochastic
statement:
theorem paddedMatrix_doublyStochastic (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) :
    a.paddedMatrix ∈ doublyStochastic ℝ (I ⊕ J)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_doublyStochastic_iff_sum]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z w
    cases z <;> cases w <;> simp only [paddedMatrix, Equiv.sumComm_apply, Sum.swap_inl, Sum.swap_inr, augmentedMass]
    · split_ifs
      · exact a.deletionMass_nonneg _
      · exact le_rfl
    · exact a.nonneg _ _
    · exact a.nonneg _ _
    · split_ifs
      · exact a.insertionMass_nonneg _
      · exact le_rfl
  · intro z
    cases z <;> simp [paddedMatrix, augmentedMass, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
      deletionMass, insertionMass]
  · intro w
    cases w <;> simp [paddedMatrix, augmentedMass, Fintype.sum_sum_type,
      deletionMass, insertionMass]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.assignmentLinearCost_padded
proof:
:= by
  simp [assignmentLinearCost, paddedMatrix, augmentedMass, boundaryAssignmentEntryWith,
    Fintype.sum_sum_type, Finset.sum_add_distrib, linearCost]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.assignmentLinearCost_perm
statement:
private theorem assignmentLinearCost_perm (c : I → J → ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (v : J → ℝ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (I ⊕ J)) :
    assignmentLinearCost c u v (σ.permMatrix ℝ) =
      boundaryAssignmentCostWith c u v (σ.trans (Equiv.sumComm I J))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [assignmentLinearCost, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk,
    PEquiv.toMatrix_apply, Equiv.toPEquiv_apply, Option.mem_def, Option.some.injEq,
    ite_mul, one_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true,
    boundaryAssignmentCostWith, Equiv.trans_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.exists_matching_linearCost_le
statement:
theorem exists_matching_linearCost_le (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J)
    (c : I → J → ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (v : J → ℝ) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      M.totalBoundaryCost c u v ≤ a.linearCost c u v
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :=
    occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff.mpr (by simp)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_eq_ciInf_of_finite
    (f := fun M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1} => M.totalBoundaryCost c u v)
  have hmin (N : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :
      M.totalBoundaryCost c u v ≤ N.totalBoundaryCost c u v :=
    hM.le.trans (ciInf_le (Set.finite_range _).bddBelow N)
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hsum, hdecomp⟩ :=
    exists_eq_sum_perm_of_mem_doublyStochastic a.paddedMatrix_doublyStochastic
  have hl (σ : Equiv.Perm (I ⊕ J)) :
      M.totalBoundaryCost c u v ≤ assignmentLinearCost c u v (σ.permMatrix ℝ) := by
    rw [assignmentLinearCost_perm, ← OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost_ofBoundaryAssignment]
    exact hmin _
  refine ⟨M, ?_⟩
  calc
    _ = ∑ σ, w σ * M.totalBoundaryCost c u v := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hsum, one_mul]
    _ ≤ ∑ σ, w σ * assignmentLinearCost c u v (σ.permMatrix ℝ) :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun σ _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hl σ) (hw σ)
    _ = assignmentLinearCost c u v a.paddedMatrix := by rw [← hdecomp]; simp
    _ = _ := assignmentLinearCost_padded a c u v

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.matchingCost_le_cost
statement:
theorem matchingCost_le_cost (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y ≤ a.cost x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := a.exists_matching_linearCost_le
    (fun i j => (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal)
    (fun i => (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal) (fun j => (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal)
  change M.totalFiniteCost x y ≤ a.cost x y at hM
  exact (finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost x y M).trans hM

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_le_cost
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_le_cost
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) :
    finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost x y ≤ a.cost x y
proof:
:=
  ciInf_le ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩; exact b.cost_nonneg x y⟩ a

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost x y = finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
    calc
      _ ≤ (FiniteBoundaryPlan.ofMatching M).cost x y :=
        finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_le_cost _ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [FiniteBoundaryPlan.cost_ofMatching, hM]
  · exact le_ciInf fun a => a.matchingCost_le_cost x y

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      (FiniteBoundaryPlan.ofMatching M).cost x y = finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
  exact ⟨M, by rw [FiniteBoundaryPlan.cost_ofMatching,
    finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost, hM]⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.exists_matching_cost_le
statement:
theorem FiniteBoundaryPlan.exists_matching_cost_le (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}, M.totalFiniteCost x y ≤ a.cost x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
  exact ⟨M, hM.le.trans (a.matchingCost_le_cost x y)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right [IsEmpty J]
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost x y = ∑ i, (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left [IsEmpty I]
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost x y = ∑ j, (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost,
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_left]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_empty [IsEmpty I] [IsEmpty J]
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost x y = 0
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_reindex
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_reindex {I' J' : Type*}
    [Fintype I'] [Fintype J'] (u : I' ≃ I) (v : J' ≃ J)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) =
      finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost,
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_reindex]

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.faceSupDifference_filter_le
statement:
theorem faceSupDifference_filter_le (p q : V → X) :
    faceSupDifference (Cech.filter p) (Cech.filter q) ≤ Cech.displacement p q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Finset.fold_max_le _).mpr
  exact ⟨Cech.displacement_nonneg p q,
    fun s _ => Cech.abs_filter_value_sub_le_displacement p q s⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement (k : Type u) [Field k] (p q : V → X) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Cech.displacement p q)
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_dgm_le_faceSupDifference k (Cech.filter p) (Cech.filter q) n).trans
    (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (faceSupDifference_filter_le p q))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_dgm_le_of_dist_le
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement k p q n).trans
    (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ((Cech.displacement_le_iff p q ε).2 ⟨hε, h⟩))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_rips_dgm_le_two_mul_displacement
statement:
theorem bottleneck_rips_dgm_le_two_mul_displacement (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (d e : MetricSpace V) (p q : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w))
    (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Cech.displacement p q)
proof:
:=
  (Rips.bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e n).trans
    (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (Cech.pairwiseDiscrepancy_le_two_mul_displacement d e p q hd he))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_with_bound
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_with_bound
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0}
      (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    ∃ R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M),
      ∀ j, 2 * n - 2 < j → IsZero (R.termAt j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨G, A, hA, hG, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_pfd_nonempty_finiteGridKan M hM
  obtain ⟨R⟩ :=
    FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_of_pfd_finitePoset
      A hA
  let R' := G.lanMinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolutionObj R
  let Rreal : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M) := {
    resolution := R'.resolution.ofIso e
    quotient_is_cover := fun i => R'.quotient_is_cover i
  }
  have hGrid :=
    FiniteRankProjectiveHomQuotientDimension.coordinateGrid_minimalResolution_termAt_isZero
      G hn hG A hA R
  refine ⟨Rreal, ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  change IsZero (R'.termAt j)
  exact IsZero.of_iso (Functor.map_isZero G.lan (hGrid j hj))
    (G.lanMinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolutionObj_termAtIso R j)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_termAt_isZero
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_termAt_isZero
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0}
      (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) :
    ∀ j, 2 * n - 2 < j → IsZero (R.termAt j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ :=
    FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_with_bound
      hn M hM
  intro j hj
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := R.termAt_nonempty_iso S j
  exact IsZero.of_iso (hS j hj) e

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSignedBarcodeOneDimensionalExamples.negativeInterval_nonzero

    change (1 : ℚ) ∈ RealBarcode.fiber (k := ℚ) (-2, (1 : WithTop ℝ)) (-2)
    have ha : RealBarcode.alive (-2, (1 : WithTop ℝ)) (-2) := by
      refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
      exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (by norm_num)
    simp only [RealBarcode.fiber, if_pos ha, Submodule.mem_top]
    ⟩
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  intro hx
  have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hx
  change (1 : ℚ) = 0 at hval
  norm_num at hval

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSignedBarcodeOneDimensionalExamples.distinct_essential_intervals_bottleneck_le_one
statement:
theorem distinct_essential_intervals_bottleneck_le_one :
    (∃ x : (essentialInterval 0).obj 0, x ≠ 0) ∧
    (∀ y : (essentialInterval 1).obj 0, y = 0) ∧
    bottleneck
        (finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram (essentialInterval 0)
          (essentialInterval_original_finitePresentation 0))
        (finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram (essentialInterval 1)
          (essentialInterval_original_finitePresentation 1)) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · let x : (essentialInterval 0).obj 0 := ⟨1, by
      have ha : RealBarcode.alive (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) 0 :=
        ⟨le_rfl, WithTop.coe_lt_top 0⟩
      simp only [RealBarcode.fiber, if_pos ha, Submodule.mem_top]⟩
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    intro hx
    have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hx
    change (1 : ℚ) = 0 at hval
    norm_num at hval
  · intro y
    have hna : ¬ RealBarcode.alive (1, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) 0 := fun h =>
      absurd h.1 (by norm_num)
    have hy : y.val ∈ RealBarcode.fiber (k := ℚ) (1, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) 0 := y.property
    simp only [RealBarcode.fiber, if_neg hna, Submodule.mem_bot] at hy
    exact Subtype.ext hy
  · rw [finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcode_bottleneck_eq_coordinateDistance (k := ℚ)]
    simpa using essentialIntervalInterleaving.distance_le

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.tupleProjection_surjective
statement:

proof:

  exact ⟨ULift.up i, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.dist_tupleProjection
statement:
@[simp] theorem dist_tupleProjection (t : Fin n → X) (i j : TupleVertex t) :
    dist (tupleProjection t i) (tupleProjection t j) = dist (t i.down) (t j.down)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.mem_tupleFilter_iff
statement:
theorem mem_tupleFilter_iff (t : Fin n → X) (r : ℝ)
    (σ : Finset (TupleVertex t)) :
    σ ∈ (tupleFilter t).sublevel r ↔
      σ.Nonempty ∧ σ.image (tupleProjection t) ∈
        (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace (Sample t))).sublevel r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff]
  change (∃ hs : σ.Nonempty, TDA.Filtration.Rips.diameter
      (inferInstance : MetricSpace (Sample t)) (σ.image (tupleProjection t)) ≤ r) ↔ _
  rw [FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff]
  change (∃ hs : σ.Nonempty, TDA.Filtration.Rips.diameter
      (inferInstance : MetricSpace (Sample t)) (σ.image (tupleProjection t)) ≤ r) ↔
    σ.Nonempty ∧ (∃ hs : (σ.image (tupleProjection t)).Nonempty,
      TDA.Filtration.Rips.diameter (inferInstance : MetricSpace (Sample t))
        (σ.image (tupleProjection t)) ≤ r)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hs, hr⟩
    exact ⟨hs, ⟨Finset.image_nonempty.mpr hs, hr⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨hs, ⟨_, hr⟩⟩
    exact ⟨hs, hr⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.quotientRelation_leftTotal
statement:
private theorem quotientRelation_leftTotal (t : Fin n → X) :
    Relator.LeftTotal (fun i x => (i, x) ∈ quotientRelation t)
proof:

  intro i

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.quotientRelation_rightTotal
statement:
private theorem quotientRelation_rightTotal (t : Fin n → X) :
    Relator.LeftTotal (fun x i => (x, i) ∈ (quotientRelation t).inv)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := tupleProjection_surjective t x
  exact ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.quotientRelation_forward
statement:
private theorem quotientRelation_forward (t : Fin n → X) :
    IsShiftedSimplicialRelation (tupleFilter t).sublevelFiltration
      (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace (Sample t))).sublevelFiltration
      (0 : ℝ) (quotientRelation t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro r σ hσ τ hτ hsub
  have himg : τ ⊆ σ.image (tupleProjection t) := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, hi, hiy⟩ := hsub hy
    change tupleProjection t i = y at hiy
    exact hiy ▸ Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
  have hface := ((mem_tupleFilter_iff t r σ).mp hσ).2
  change τ ∈ ((TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter
    (inferInstance : MetricSpace (Sample t))).sublevel (r + (0 : ℝ))).faces
  simpa only [add_zero] using
    (((TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace (Sample t))).sublevel r).isRelLowerSet_faces
      hface).2 himg hτ

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.quotientRelation_backward
statement:
private theorem quotientRelation_backward (t : Fin n → X) :
    IsShiftedSimplicialRelation
      (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace (Sample t))).sublevelFiltration
      (tupleFilter t).sublevelFiltration (0 : ℝ) (quotientRelation t).inv
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro r τ hτ σ hσ hsub
  have himg : σ.image (tupleProjection t) ⊆ τ := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxi⟩ := hsub hi
    change tupleProjection t i = x at hxi
    change x ∈ τ at hx
    simpa only [hxi] using hx
  have hface :=
    (((TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace (Sample t))).sublevel r).isRelLowerSet_faces
      hτ).2 himg (Finset.image_nonempty.mpr hσ)
  change σ ∈ (tupleFilter t).sublevel (r + (0 : ℝ))
  simpa only [add_zero] using (mem_tupleFilter_iff t r σ).mpr ⟨hσ, hface⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.embedding_π
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem embedding_π (t : Index M) :
    embedding M ≫ biproduct.π (family M) t = summandMap M t
proof: := biproduct.lift_π _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.embedding_π_app_val
statement:
theorem embedding_π_app_val (t : Index M) (q : P) (x : M.obj q) :
    (((biproduct.π (family M) t).app q).hom (((embedding M).app q).hom x) : k) =
      if h : q ≤ t.1 then coordinate M t.1 t.2 (structureMapLinear M h x) else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f : M ⟶ family M t => ((f.app q).hom x : k)) (embedding_π M t)
  exact h.trans (PrincipalDownsetInjective.extension_app_val t.1 M _ q x)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.embedding_coordinate
statement:
@[simp] theorem embedding_coordinate (q : P) (j : Fin (Module.finrank k (M.obj q)))
    (x : M.obj q) :
    (((biproduct.π (family M) ⟨q, j⟩).app q).hom (((embedding M).app q).hom x) : k) =
      coordinate M q j x
proof:
:= by
  rw [embedding_π_app_val]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.component_injective
statement: theorem component_injective (q : P) : Function.Injective ((embedding M).app q).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply (Module.finBasis k (M.obj q)).repr.injective
  ext j
  have hj := congrArg (fun z => (((biproduct.π (family M) ⟨q, j⟩).app q).hom z : k)) h
  rw [embedding_coordinate, embedding_coordinate] at hj
  exact hj

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.embedding_retraction
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem embedding_retraction [Injective M] :
    embedding M ≫ retraction M = 𝟙 M
proof: := Injective.comp_factorThru _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.injective_iff_splits
statement:
theorem injective_iff_splits : Injective M ↔
    ∃ r : module M ⟶ M, embedding M ≫ r = 𝟙 M
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := h
    exact ⟨retraction M, embedding_retraction M⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
    exact (show Retract M (module M) from ⟨embedding M, r, hr⟩).injective

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.presentation_finiteDimensional

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.kernelOp_apply
statement:
theorem kernelOp_apply (σ : ℝ) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    kernelOp σ p q t = kernel σ p q * t
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_kernelOp
statement: theorem posSemidef_kernelOp (σ : ℝ) : (kernelOp σ).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hH : (kernelOp σ).IsHermitian := by
    refine Matrix.IsHermitian.ext fun p q => ?_
    ext
    simp [kernelOp, ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_id,
      kernel_symm σ p q]
  have h3 : (kernelOp σ).IsHermitian ∧ ∀ vv : (ℝ × ℝ) →₀ ℝ,
      0 ≤ RCLike.re (vv.sum fun x t => vv.sum fun x' t' => ⟪kernelOp σ x' x t, t'⟫_ℝ) := by
    refine ⟨hH, fun vv => ?_⟩
    have h := (posSemidef_kernel σ).2 vv
    simp only [kernelOp_apply, RCLike.re_to_real, Real.inner_apply]
    refine h.trans_eq ?_
    simp only [Finsupp.sum, Matrix.of_apply, star_trivial]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => by
      rw [kernel_symm σ q p]
      ring
  exact (RKHS.posSemidef_tfae.out 2 0).mp h3

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.featureAt_apply
statement: theorem featureAt_apply (σ : ℝ) (p z : ℝ × ℝ) : featureAt σ p z = kernel σ z p
proof:
:= by
  rw [featureAt, RKHS.kerFun_apply, RKHS.OfKernel.kernel_ofKernel, kernelOp_apply, mul_one]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.inner_featureAt
statement:
theorem inner_featureAt (σ : ℝ) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ⟪featureAt σ p, featureAt σ q⟫_ℝ = kernel σ p q
proof:
:= by
  change ⟪RKHS.kerFun (Space σ) p 1, featureAt σ q⟫_ℝ = _
  rw [RKHS.kerFun_inner, featureAt_apply, Real.inner_apply, one_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_featureAt
statement: theorem norm_featureAt (σ : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : ‖featureAt σ p‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := inner_featureAt σ p p
  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, kernel_self] at h
  have h0 := norm_nonneg (featureAt σ p)
  nlinarith

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.embedding_apply
statement:
theorem embedding_apply (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ)
    (z : ℝ × ℝ) :
    embedding σ w x z = ∑ i, w (birthPersistence (x i)) * kernel σ z (x i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [embedding, finiteFeatureSum, ← RKHS.coeCLM_apply (𝕜 := ℝ), map_sum,
    Finset.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [RKHS.coeCLM_apply, RKHS.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, featureAt_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding_eq_sum
statement:
theorem diagramEmbedding_eq_sum (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    diagramEmbedding σ w D =
      ((finitePart D.points).map fun p => w (birthPersistence p) • featureAt σ p).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagramEmbedding, embedding, finiteFeatureSum, Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum]
  exact congrArg Multiset.sum
    (Multiset.map_univ (finitePart D.points) fun p => w (birthPersistence p) • featureAt σ p)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.inner_embedding
statement:
theorem inner_embedding (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ)
    (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ⟪embedding σ w x, embedding σ w y⟫_ℝ = linearKernel σ w x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [embedding, finiteFeatureSum, linearKernel, sum_inner, inner_sum,
    real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, inner_featureAt]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_embedding_sub_sq
statement:
theorem norm_embedding_sub_sq (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ)
    (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖embedding σ w x - embedding σ w y‖ ^ 2 =
      linearKernel σ w x x + linearKernel σ w y y - 2 * linearKernel σ w x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_sub_sq_real, ← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, ← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
    inner_embedding, inner_embedding, inner_embedding]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.linearKernel_self_nonneg
statement:
theorem linearKernel_self_nonneg (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) : 0 ≤ linearKernel σ w x x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inner_embedding]
  exact real_inner_self_nonneg

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.inner_diagramEmbedding
statement:
theorem inner_diagramEmbedding (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D E : Diagram ℝ) :
    ⟪diagramEmbedding σ w D, diagramEmbedding σ w E⟫_ℝ =
      linearKernel σ w (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
        (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_linearDiagramGram
statement:
theorem posSemidef_linearDiagramGram {κ : Type*} (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)

    (Matrix.of fun a b =>
      ⟪diagramEmbedding σ w (D a), diagramEmbedding σ w (D b)⟫_ℝ).PosSemidef
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_linearKernelDiagramGram
statement:
theorem posSemidef_linearKernelDiagramGram {κ : Type*} (σ : ℝ)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D : κ → Diagram ℝ) :
    (Matrix.of fun a b => linearKernel σ w (fun p : (D a).finiteOccurrences => p.1)
      (fun p : (D b).finiteOccurrences => p.1)).PosSemidef
proof:

  simpa only [inner_diagramEmbedding] using posSemidef_linearDiagramGram σ w D

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_gaussianDiagramGram

theorem posSemidef_gaussianDiagramGram {κ : Type*} (σ τ : ℝ)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D : κ → Diagram ℝ) :

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSignedStabilityExamples.oneCoordinate_signedMatching
statement:
theorem oneCoordinate_signedMatching (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    HasMultisetMatching (k := ℚ) (n := 1) ε
      ((oneCoordinateHookMinimalResolution.signedHookBarcode
        (k := ℚ) (n := 1)
        RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.oneCoordinateHook
        oneCoordinateHook_finitelyPresented).positive +
       (oneCoordinateHookMinimalResolution.signedHookBarcode
        (k := ℚ) (n := 1)
        RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.oneCoordinateHook
        oneCoordinateHook_finitelyPresented).negative)
      ((oneCoordinateHookMinimalResolution.signedHookBarcode
        (k := ℚ) (n := 1)
        RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.oneCoordinateHook
        oneCoordinateHook_finitelyPresented).positive +
       (oneCoordinateHookMinimalResolution.signedHookBarcode
        (k := ℚ) (n := 1)
        RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.oneCoordinateHook
        oneCoordinateHook_finitelyPresented).negative)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius] using
    finitelyPresented_exists_signedHookMultisetMatching
      (k := ℚ) (n := 1) (by norm_num)
      RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.oneCoordinateHook
      RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.oneCoordinateHook
      oneCoordinateHook_finitelyPresented oneCoordinateHook_finitelyPresented
      oneCoordinateHookMinimalResolution oneCoordinateHookMinimalResolution ε
      (CoordinateInterleaving.refl ε
        RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.oneCoordinateHook)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSignedStabilityExamples.oneCoordinate_self_signedDistance_zero
statement:
theorem oneCoordinate_self_signedDistance_zero :
    signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity (k := ℚ)
      (finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode (k := ℚ) (n := 1) (by norm_num)
        RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.oneCoordinateHook
        oneCoordinateHook_finitelyPresented)
      (finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode (k := ℚ) (n := 1) (by norm_num)
        RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.oneCoordinateHook
        oneCoordinateHook_finitelyPresented) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := finitelyPresented_moduleSignedHookBottleneckDistance_le

    HasMultisetMatching (k := ℚ) (n := 1) 1
      (finitePositive.positive + finiteNegative.negative)
      (finiteNegative.positive + finitePositive.negative)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hnot : ¬ HookMatching.finiteSignificant (1 + 1) finiteDeathPair := by
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    fin_cases i
    norm_num [finiteDeathPair] at hi
  let M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 2) (Fin 0) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1} :=
    ⟨fun _ => none, (by intro i i' j hi; cases hi), Equiv.refl _⟩
  have hM : HookMatching.IsMatching (k := ℚ) 1
      repeatedFiniteSource noFiniteTarget M := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i j hij
      simp [M] at hij
    · intro i hi
      exact (HookMatching.finiteInterleaved_zero_iff (k := ℚ)
        finiteDeathPair 1).2 hnot
    · intro j
      exact j.elim0
  apply HasMultisetMatching.intro repeatedFiniteSource noFiniteTarget ?_ ?_ M hM
  · simp [finitePositive, finiteNegative, hookTagMultiset,
      repeatedFiniteSource, finiteDeathTag]
  · simp [finitePositive, finiteNegative, hookTagMultiset]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerived.extensionMappedResolution_exactAt_add_two
statement:
theorem extensionMappedResolution_exactAt_add_two
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (R (k := k) (S := S))) (P : ProjectiveResolution M) (m : ℕ) :
    (TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerivedOne.extensionMappedResolution
      (k := k) (S := S) P).ExactAt (m + 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let E := TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.extensionFunctor
    (k := k) (S := S)
  let K := P.complex
  let d₁ := K.d (m + 3) (m + 2)
  let d₂ := K.d (m + 2) (m + 1)
  let d₃ := K.d (m + 1) m
  let U := ShortComplex.mk d₁ d₂ (K.d_comp_d (m + 3) (m + 2) (m + 1))
  have hU : U.Exact := P.exact_succ (m + 1)
  let T := ShortComplex.mk d₂ d₃ (K.d_comp_d (m + 2) (m + 1) m)
  have hT : T.Exact := P.exact_succ m
  let GT := T.map (columnAction (k := k) (S := S))
  have hGT : GT.Exact := columnAction_map_exact (k := k) (S := S) T hT
  change (TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerivedOne.extensionMappedResolution
    (k := k) (S := S) P).ExactAt (m + 2)
  rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ (m + 3) (m + 2) (m + 1) (by simp) (by simp)]
  change (U.map E).Exact
  apply (ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff _).2
  intro z hz
  change (E.map d₂).hom z = 0 at hz
  let Q₂ := relation (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 2))
  let Q₁ := relation (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 1))
  let Q₃ := relation (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 3))
  have hEMap : E.map d₂ = extensionMap (k := k) (S := S) d₂ := rfl
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Q₂.mkQ_surjective z
  have hExtensionCycle :
      (extensionMap (k := k) (S := S) d₂).hom (Q₂.mkQ y) = 0 := by
    rw [← hEMap, hy]
    exact hz
  have hqzero : Q₁.mkQ (d₂.hom y) = 0 := by
    have hh := hExtensionCycle
    rw [extensionMap_mkQ] at hh
    change Q₁.mkQ (d₂.hom y) = 0 at hh
    exact hh
  have hrel : d₂.hom y ∈ Q₁ := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero Q₁).mp hqzero
  have hrange : (d₂.hom y) ∈
      (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 1))).range := by
    rw [assembleAction_range_eq_relation (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 1))]
    exact hrel
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hrange
  have hxCycleG : ((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.g) x = 0 := by
    have hsum : assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X m)
        (((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.g) x) = 0 := by
      calc
        assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X m)
            (((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.g) x) =
            d₃.hom (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 1)) x) :=
          assembleAction_natural (k := k) (S := S) T.g x
        _ = d₃.hom (d₂.hom y) := by rw [hx]
        _ = 0 := by
          simpa [T, d₂, d₃] using T.zero_apply y
    letI : Projective (K.X m) := P.projective m
    apply (assembleAction_projective_injective (k := k) (S := S) (K.X m))
    calc
      assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X m)
          (((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.g) x) = 0 := hsum
      _ = assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X m) 0 := by
        exact (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X m)).map_zero.symm
  have hxCycle : GT.g x = 0 := by
    change ((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.g) x = 0
    exact hxCycleG
  have hGFunction := (ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff GT).mp hGT
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hGFunction x hxCycle
  have hτw : d₂.hom (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 2)) w) =
      assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 1)) x := by
    change (columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.f w = x at hw
    calc
      d₂.hom (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 2)) w) =
          assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 1))
            ((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map T.f w) :=
        (assembleAction_natural (k := k) (S := S) T.f w).symm
      _ = assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 1)) x := by rw [hw]
  have hyCycle : d₂.hom (y - assembleAction (k := k) (S := S)
      (K.X (m + 2)) w) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, ← hx, hτw]
    simp
  have hUFunction := (ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff U).mp hU
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hUFunction (y - assembleAction (k := k) (S := S)
    (K.X (m + 2)) w) hyCycle
  refine ⟨Q₃.mkQ v, ?_⟩
  change Q₂.mkQ (d₁.hom v) = z
  change (extensionMap (k := k) (S := S) d₁).hom (Q₃.mkQ v) = z
  rw [extensionMap_mkQ]
  change d₁.hom v = y - assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 2)) w at hv
  rw [hv]
  have hτwRel : assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 2)) w ∈ Q₂ := by
    have hr : assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 2)) w ∈
        (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 2))).range := ⟨w, rfl⟩
    rw [assembleAction_range_eq_relation] at hr
    exact hr
  have hmkW : Q₂.mkQ (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) (K.X (m + 2)) w) = 0 :=
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero Q₂).2 hτwRel
  rw [map_sub, hmkW, sub_zero, hy]

    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (R (k := k) (S := S))) (P : ProjectiveResolution M)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerived.extension_leftDerived_isZero_atLeastTwo
statement:
theorem extension_leftDerived_isZero_atLeastTwo
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (R (k := k) (S := S))) (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    IsZero (((TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.extensionFunctor
      (k := k) (S := S)).leftDerived n).obj M)
proof:
:= by
  let E := TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.extensionFunctor
    (k := k) (S := S)
  let P := ProjectiveResolution.of M
  let D := (E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj P.complex
  have hExact := extensionMappedResolution_exactAt (k := k) (S := S) M P n hn
  have hHomology : IsZero (D.homology n) := by
    rw [← HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology]
    exact hExact
  exact IsZero.of_iso hHomology (P.isoLeftDerivedObj E n)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerived.extensionMappedResolution_exactAt_positive_restricted
statement:
theorem extensionMappedResolution_exactAt_positive_restricted
    (N : ModuleCat.{u} (C (k := k) (S := S)))
    (P : ProjectiveResolution
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerivedOne.extensionMappedResolution
      (k := k) (S := S) P).ExactAt n
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      simpa using extensionMappedResolution_exactAt_one (k := k) (S := S) N P
    | succ m =>
      simpa using extensionMappedResolution_exactAt_add_two (k := k) (S := S)
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N) P m

  let P := ProjectiveResolution.of M
