name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_of_injective
statement:
theorem inducedMap_of_injective (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f.app i).hom) (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    inducedMap f i = some (monoEmbedding f hf i)
proof:
:= by
  let a := monoEmbedding (toFiniteImage f) (toFiniteImage_injective f hf) i
  have ha : imageSourceEmbedding f a = i :=
    epi_mono_cancel (toFiniteImage f) (toFiniteImage_injective f hf)
      (toFiniteImage_surjective f) i
  have hcomp := monoEmbedding_comp (toFiniteImage f) (fromFiniteImage f)
    (toFiniteImage_injective f hf) (fromFiniteImage_injective f)
  change monoEmbedding f hf =
    (monoEmbedding (toFiniteImage f) (toFiniteImage_injective f hf)).trans
      (monoEmbedding (fromFiniteImage f) (fromFiniteImage_injective f)) at hcomp
  have hj : imageTargetEmbedding f a = monoEmbedding f hf i :=
    (congrArg (fun e : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M) ↪
      BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N) => e i) hcomp).symm
  exact (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f _ _).mpr ⟨a, ha, hj⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_of_surjective_iff
statement:
theorem inducedMap_of_surjective_iff (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (f.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    inducedMap f i = some j ↔ epiEmbedding f hf j = i
proof:
:= by
  let hs := fromFiniteImage_surjective f hf
  have hcomp := epiEmbedding_comp (toFiniteImage f) (fromFiniteImage f)
    (toFiniteImage_surjective f) hs
  change epiEmbedding f hf =
    (epiEmbedding (fromFiniteImage f) hs).trans
      (epiEmbedding (toFiniteImage f) (toFiniteImage_surjective f)) at hcomp
  have hc (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
      epiEmbedding f hf a = imageSourceEmbedding f
        (epiEmbedding (fromFiniteImage f) hs a) :=
    congrArg (fun e : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N) ↪
      BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M) => e a) hcomp
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hj⟩ := (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f i j).mp h
    rw [hc, ← hj]
    change imageSourceEmbedding f (epiEmbedding (fromFiniteImage f) hs
      (monoEmbedding (fromFiniteImage f) (fromFiniteImage_injective f) a)) = i
    rw [epi_mono_cancel, ha]
  · intro h
    refine (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f i j).mpr
      ⟨epiEmbedding (fromFiniteImage f) hs j, (hc j).symm.trans h, ?_⟩
    exact mono_epi_cancel (fromFiniteImage f) (fromFiniteImage_injective f) hs j

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_id
statement:
theorem inducedMap_id (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    inducedMap (𝟙 M) i = some i
proof:
:= by
  rw [inducedMap_of_injective (𝟙 M) (fun _ => Function.injective_id), monoEmbedding_id]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureMatchingExamples.forward_boxes
statement:
private theorem forward_boxes (p : ℝ × ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    finiteBoxCount source p r ≤ finiteBoxCount target p (r + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn Fin.castSucc
  · intro i hi
    have hi' : dist (source i) p ≤ r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    have ht : dist (target i.castSucc) (source i) ≤ 1 := by
      fin_cases i <;> norm_num [target, source, Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    have := dist_triangle (target i.castSucc) (source i) p
    linarith
  · intro i _ i' _ h
    exact Fin.castSucc_injective _ h

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureMatchingExamples.reverse_boxes
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Fin 3 → Fin 2 := fun j => ⟨j.val % 2, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩
  have hlong : ∀ j, dist (target j) p ≤ r → j ≠ 2 := by
    intro j hj heq
    subst j
    simp [target, Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, abs_le] at hj
    linarith
  apply Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn f
  · intro j hj
    have hj' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
    have hne := hlong j hj'
    have ht : dist (source (f j)) (target j) ≤ 1 := by
      norm_num [source, target, hne, Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    have := dist_triangle (source (f j)) (target j) p
    linarith
  · intro j hj j' hj' heq
    have hne := hlong j (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
    have hne' := hlong j' (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj').2
    fin_cases j <;> fin_cases j' <;> norm_num [f, Fin.ext_iff] at *

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureMatchingExamples.duplicated_shift_with_short_target
statement:
theorem duplicated_shift_with_short_target :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 2) (Fin 3) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      (∀ i, ∃ j, M.finite i = some j) ∧
      M.cost (fun _ => (0, 10)) (fun j => if j = 2 then (0, 1) else (1, 11))
        PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := exists_matching_of_separated_box_bounds source target (ε := 1)
    (by norm_num) (by intro j; unfold target; split_ifs <;> norm_num)
    (by intro i; norm_num [source]) (by intro i i' hn; exact (hn rfl).elim)
    (fun p r _ _ => forward_boxes p r) (fun p r _ hgap => reverse_boxes p r hgap)
  change ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 2) (Fin 3) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
    (∀ i, ∃ j, M.finite i = some j) ∧ M.cost source target PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim ≤ 1
  simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_one] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.rank_gradeHomologyMap
statement:
theorem rank_gradeHomologyMap
    (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ)
    (i j : Fin f.criticalValues.card) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyIncl k
        (f.gradeFiltration.monotone hij) n).hom) =
      (gradeHomologyBarcode k f n).countP
        (fun I => I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death)
proof:
:= by
  change structureMapRank (simplicialHomologyPModule k f.gradeFiltration n) i j hij = _
  exact (structureMapRank_rankBarcode
    (simplicialHomologyPModule k f.gradeFiltration n) i j hij).symm.trans
      (rank_barcodeMap (gradeHomologyBarcode k f n) i j hij)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomCover.isIso_map_iff
statement:
theorem isIso_map_iff {A : PModule.{u,0,u} k S} (t : End A) :
    IsIso ((F (k := k) (S := S)).map t) ↔ IsIso t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    letI : IsIso ((F (k := k) (S := S)).map t) := h
    exact isIso_of_fully_faithful (F (k := k) (S := S)) t
  · intro h
    letI : IsIso t := h
    exact (F (k := k) (S := S)).map_isIso t

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomCover.map_comp_eq_map_iff
statement:
theorem map_comp_eq_map_iff {A B : PModule.{u,0,u} k S}
    (π : A ⟶ B) (t : End A) :
    ((F (k := k) (S := S)).map t) ≫ ((F (k := k) (S := S)).map π) =
      (F (k := k) (S := S)).map π ↔ t ≫ π = π
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (F (k := k) (S := S)).map_comp]
  exact (F (k := k) (S := S)).map_injective.eq_iff

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomCover.rightMinimal_iff
statement:
theorem rightMinimal_iff {A B : PModule.{u,0,u} k S} (π : A ⟶ B) :
    (∀ t : End A, t ≫ π = π → IsIso t) ↔
      (∀ T : End ((F (k := k) (S := S)).obj A),
        T ≫ (F (k := k) (S := S)).map π =
          (F (k := k) (S := S)).map π → IsIso T)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h T hT
    let t : End A := (F (k := k) (S := S)).preimage T
    have htmap : (F (k := k) (S := S)).map t = T :=
      (F (k := k) (S := S)).map_preimage T
    have ht : t ≫ π = π :=
      (map_comp_eq_map_iff (k := k) (S := S) π t).mp (htmap ▸ hT)
    rw [← htmap]
    exact (isIso_map_iff (k := k) (S := S) t).mpr (h t ht)
  · intro h t ht
    apply (isIso_map_iff (k := k) (S := S) t).mp
    exact h _ ((map_comp_eq_map_iff (k := k) (S := S) π t).mpr ht)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomCover.pointwise_surjective_of_postcompose_surjective
statement:
theorem pointwise_surjective_of_postcompose_surjective
    {A B : PModule.{u,0,u} k S} (π : A ⟶ B)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) π))
    (a : S) : Function.Surjective (π.app a).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hsurj (encode B a x)
  let y : A.obj a :=
    (((inclusion (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ g).app a).hom (HookInfinity.birth a))
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  have hg' : g ≫ π = encode B a x := hg
  have h := congrArg (fun f : L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ B =>
    (((inclusion (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ f).app a).hom
      (HookInfinity.birth a))) hg'
  change (π.app a).hom y =
    (((inclusion (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ encode B a x).app a).hom
      (HookInfinity.birth a)) at h
  rw [encode_birth] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomCover.rankProjectiveCover_iff
statement:
theorem rankProjectiveCover_iff {A B : PModule.{u,0,u} k S}
    (π : A ⟶ B) (hfd : ∀ a, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj a)) :
    IsRankProjectiveCover π ↔
      Module.Projective (E (k := k) (S := S))
        (L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ A) ∧
      Function.Surjective (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) π) ∧
      (∀ T : End ((F (k := k) (S := S)).obj A),
        T ≫ (F (k := k) (S := S)).map π =
          (F (k := k) (S := S)).map π → IsIso T)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨(rankProjective_iff_homProjective A hfd).mp h.term_rank_projective,
      ?_, (rightMinimal_iff π).mp h.endomorphism_isIso⟩
    exact (rankExact_iff_postcompose_surjective
      h.row_rank_exact.toIsPointwiseShortExact hfd).mp h.row_rank_exact
  · rintro ⟨hproj, hsurj, hmin⟩
    have hpoint : ∀ a, Function.Surjective (π.app a).hom :=
      pointwise_surjective_of_postcompose_surjective π hsurj
    have hshort : IsPointwiseShortExact (kernel.ι π) π :=
      RankKernel.shortExact π hpoint
    refine ⟨(rankProjective_iff_homProjective A hfd).mpr hproj, ?_,
      (rightMinimal_iff π).mpr hmin⟩
    exact (rankExact_iff_postcompose_surjective hshort hfd).mpr hsurj

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomCover.minimalResolution_row_homCover
statement:
theorem minimalResolution_row_homCover
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S}
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    (i : Fin R.resolution.length) :
    Module.Projective (E (k := k) (S := S))
      (L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ R.resolution.term i) ∧
    Function.Surjective (postcompose (k := k) (S := S)
      (R.resolution.quotient i)) ∧
    (∀ T : End ((F (k := k) (S := S)).obj (R.resolution.term i)),
      T ≫ (F (k := k) (S := S)).map (R.resolution.quotient i) =
        (F (k := k) (S := S)).map (R.resolution.quotient i) → IsIso T)
proof:
:= by
  exact (rankProjectiveCover_iff (R.resolution.quotient i)
    (R.resolution.row_rank_exact i).finiteDimensional).mp (R.quotient_is_cover i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomCover.Examples.zero_identity_homCover
statement:
theorem zero_identity_homCover :
    Module.Projective QE (QL ⟶ (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 2))) ∧
    Function.Surjective (postcompose (k := ℚ) (S := Fin 2)
      (𝟙 (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 2)))) ∧
    (∀ T : End (QF.obj (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 2))),
      T ≫ QF.map (𝟙 (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 2))) =
        QF.map (𝟙 (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 2))) → IsIso T)
proof:
:= by
  exact (rankProjectiveCover_iff (k := ℚ) (S := Fin 2)
    (𝟙 (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 2))) (by intro a; infer_instance)).mp
    FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionKanExamples.zero_identity_isRankProjectiveCover

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomCover.Examples.principalUpset_identity_homCover
statement:
theorem principalUpset_identity_homCover (a : Fin 2) :
    (Module.Projective QE (QL ⟶ HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) a) ∧
    Function.Surjective (postcompose (k := ℚ) (S := Fin 2)
      (𝟙 (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) a))) ∧
    (∀ T : End (QF.obj (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) a)),
      T ≫ QF.map (𝟙 (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) a)) =
        QF.map (𝟙 (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) a)) → IsIso T)) ∧
    ∃ x : (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) a).obj a, x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact (rankProjectiveCover_iff (k := ℚ) (S := Fin 2)
      (𝟙 (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) a)) (by intro p; infer_instance)).mp
      (FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionKanExamples.principalUpset_identity_isRankProjectiveCover a)
  · exact (FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionKanExamples.principalUpset_identity_iso_minimal_cover a).2

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.Examples.two_step_flag_at_half_mass
statement:
private theorem two_step_flag_at_half_mass :
    ({{0}, {0, 1}} : Finset (Finset (Fin 2))) ∈ subdivision (openRips d 2) (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro s hs
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hs
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl
    · refine ⟨⟨by simp, ?_⟩, by norm_num⟩
      intro v hv w hw
      simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hv hw
      subst v; subst w
      norm_num [d, twoPointMetric]
    · exact ⟨openRips_mono d (by norm_num) edge_above_boundary, by norm_num⟩
  · intro s hs t ht
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hs ht
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl <;> rcases ht with rfl | rfl <;> simp

  exact ⟨(TDA.Simplicial.simplicialSingletonH0Equiv ℚ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2))).symm 1,
    TDA.Simplicial.simplicialSingletonH0Equiv_symm_one_ne_zero ℚ _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.ApproximationExamples.scaled_nonatomic_approximation
statement:
private theorem scaled_nonatomic_approximation (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (ε : ℝ≥0∞) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ D : FiniteWeightedDiagram, atomicMeasure D univ = 3 / 2 ∧
      boundaryTransportDistance p scaledBandLaw (atomicMeasure D) < ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hmass, hnear⟩ := exists_atomicMeasure_approx_same_mass p hp scaledBandLaw
    (by rw [scaledBandLaw_moment]; finiteness) ε hε
  exact ⟨D, hmass.trans scaledBandLaw_mass, hnear⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.ApproximationExamples.noncompact_approximation_with_optimizer
statement:
private theorem noncompact_approximation_with_optimizer (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (ε : ℝ≥0∞) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ (D : FiniteWeightedDiagram) (π : Measure PlanSpace),
      atomicMeasure D univ = 1 ∧ IsBoundaryPlan π rayLaw (atomicMeasure D) ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) ^ (1 / p) =
        boundaryTransportDistance p rayLaw (atomicMeasure D) ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) ^ (1 / p) < ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hmass, hnear⟩ := exists_atomicMeasure_approx_same_mass p hp rayLaw
    (by rw [rayLaw_moment]; simp) ε hε
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (atomicMeasure D) := atomicMeasure_isFinite D
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, _, hroot⟩ := exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan_rooted p hp rayLaw (atomicMeasure D)
  exact ⟨D, π, by simpa using hmass, hπ, hroot, hroot.trans_lt hnear⟩

      boundaryTransportDistance p 0 (atomicMeasure D) < ε
proof:

  obtain ⟨D, hmass, hnear⟩ := exists_atomicMeasure_approx_same_mass p hp 0 (by simp) ε hε
  exact ⟨D, Measure.measure_univ_eq_zero.mp (by simpa using hmass), hnear⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.replicate_count

private theorem replicate_count (n : ℕ) (p : FiniteInterval 1 → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :

proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.one_stage_barcode

      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).mpr
      intro i j hij
      have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst i; subst j
      rw [rank_barcodeMap]
      unfold structureMapRank
      rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, replicate_count]
      simp [oneBar]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.proper_linear_map
statement:
theorem proper_linear_map :
    ¬ (∀ i, Function.Injective (projection.app i).hom) ∧
      ¬ (∀ i, Function.Surjective (projection.app i).hom)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have he := h 0 (show (projection.app 0).hom (0, 0) = (projection.app 0).hom (0, 1) from rfl)
    have := congrArg Prod.snd he
    norm_num at this
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h 0 (0, 1)
    have := congrArg Prod.snd hx
    change (0 : ℚ) = 1 at this
    norm_num at this

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.rank_one_partial_matching
statement:
theorem rank_one_partial_matching :
    Fintype.card (BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two)) = 2 ∧
    Fintype.card {p : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two) × BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two) //
      inducedMap projection p.1 = some p.2} = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · simp [BarcodeOccurrence, two_barcode]
  · rw [← Fintype.card_congr (imageOccurrenceEquivPairs projection)]
    simp [BarcodeOccurrence, projection_barcode]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.duplicate_identity
statement:
theorem duplicate_identity :
    ∃ i j : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two), i ≠ j ∧
      inducedMap (𝟙 two) i = some i ∧ inducedMap (𝟙 two) j = some j
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (rankBarcode two).toList.length = 2 := by rw [two_barcode]; simp
  let i : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let j : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two) := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  have hne : i ≠ j := by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; simp [i, j] at this
  exact ⟨i, j, hne, inducedMap_id two i, inducedMap_id two j⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.terminal_pair
statement:
theorem terminal_pair :
    ∃ i j : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two), inducedMap projection i = some j ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode two) i).death = 1 ∧ (occurrence (rankBarcode two) j).death = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (rankBarcode (finiteImage projection)).toList.length = 1 := by
    rw [projection_barcode]; simp
  let a : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode (finiteImage projection)) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  refine ⟨imageSourceEmbedding projection a, imageTargetEmbedding projection a,
    (inducedMap_eq_some_iff projection _ _).mpr ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  all_goals
    have hdeath (x : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two)) :
        (occurrence (rankBarcode two) x).death = 1 := by
      have hb := (occurrence (rankBarcode two) x).birth_lt_death
      have hd := (occurrence (rankBarcode two) x).death_le_size
      omega
    exact hdeath _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.zero_image_barcode
statement: private theorem zero_image_barcode : rankBarcode (finiteImage (0 : two ⟶ two)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_stage_barcode]
  have hd : Module.finrank ℚ ((finiteImage (0 : two ⟶ two)).obj 0) = 0 := by
    change Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (0 : (ℚ × ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] (ℚ × ℚ))) = 0
    rw [LinearMap.range_zero]
    simp
  rw [hd]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.zero_matching
statement:
theorem zero_matching (i : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode two)) :
    inducedMap (0 : two ⟶ two) i = none
proof:
:= by
  apply (inducedMap_eq_none_iff _ _).mpr
  rintro ⟨a, _⟩
  have hlen : (rankBarcode (finiteImage (0 : two ⟶ two))).toList.length = 0 := by
    rw [zero_image_barcode]; simp
  have := a.isLt
  change a.val < (rankBarcode (finiteImage (0 : two ⟶ two))).toList.length at this
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.overlap_image_nonzero
statement: private theorem overlap_image_nonzero : rankBarcode (finiteImage overlap) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let x : (intervalModule (k := ℚ) sourceBar).obj (1 : Fin 3) :=
    ⟨1, by simp [FiniteInterval.fiber, FiniteInterval.alive, sourceBar]⟩
  let v : (finiteImage overlap).obj (1 : Fin 3) := ⟨(overlap.app 1).hom x, x, rfl⟩
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have he := congrArg (fun y : (finiteImage overlap).obj (1 : Fin 3) => y.val.val) h
    norm_num [v, x, overlap, overlapLinear, sourceBar, targetBar, FiniteInterval.alive] at he
    have he' := congrArg Subtype.val he
    change (1 : ℚ) = 0 at he'
    exact one_ne_zero he'
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank ℚ ((finiteImage overlap).obj (1 : Fin 3)) :=
    Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr ⟨v, hv⟩
  intro hB
  have hr := structureMapRank_rankBarcode (finiteImage overlap) (1 : Fin 3) 1 (le_refl _)
  rw [hB, rank_barcodeMap] at hr
  simp only [Multiset.countP_zero] at hr
  have hs : structureMapRank (finiteImage overlap) (1 : Fin 3) 1 (le_refl _) =
      Module.finrank ℚ ((finiteImage overlap).obj (1 : Fin 3)) := by
    unfold structureMapRank
    rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id]
    simp
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.singleton_count
statement:
private theorem singleton_count {n : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval n) (p : FiniteInterval n → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] : ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval n)).countP p = if p I then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.cons_zero, Multiset.countP_cons]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.single_barcode
statement:
private theorem single_barcode (I : FiniteInterval 3) :
    rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I) = {I}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {I}) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).mpr
      intro i j hij
      rw [rank_barcodeMap]
      change Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (intervalMap (k := ℚ) I hij)) = _
      rw [intervalMap_finrank_range]
      simp only [interval_alive_endpoints_iff I hij, singleton_count]
    _ = {I} := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.single_occurrence
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := Multiset.mem_toList.mp (List.get_mem (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)).toList a)
  change occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈ _ at hmem
  have hmem' : occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈
      ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3)) := Eq.mp
    (congrArg (fun B : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3) =>
      occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈ B) (single_barcode I)) hmem
  simpa using hmem'

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.nontrivial_endpoints
statement:
theorem nontrivial_endpoints :
    ∃ (i : BarcodeOccurrence 3 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) sourceBar)))
      (j : BarcodeOccurrence 3 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) targetBar))),
      inducedMap overlap i = some j ∧
      (occurrence _ i).birth = 1 ∧ (occurrence _ i).death = 3 ∧
      (occurrence _ j).birth = 0 ∧ (occurrence _ j).death = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : 0 < (rankBarcode (finiteImage overlap)).toList.length := by
    rw [Multiset.length_toList]
    exact Multiset.card_pos.mpr overlap_image_nonzero
  let a : BarcodeOccurrence 3 (rankBarcode (finiteImage overlap)) := ⟨0, hlen⟩
  refine ⟨imageSourceEmbedding overlap a, imageTargetEmbedding overlap a,
    (inducedMap_eq_some_iff overlap _ _).mpr ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact congrArg FiniteInterval.birth (single_occurrence sourceBar _)
  · exact congrArg FiniteInterval.death (single_occurrence sourceBar _)
  · exact congrArg FiniteInterval.birth (single_occurrence targetBar _)
  · exact congrArg FiniteInterval.death (single_occurrence targetBar _)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedMatchingExamples.empty_chain
statement:
theorem empty_chain : IsEmpty (BarcodeOccurrence 0 (rankBarcode empty)) ∧
    ∀ i : BarcodeOccurrence 0 (rankBarcode empty), inducedMap (𝟙 empty) i = some i
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, inducedMap_id empty⟩
  change IsEmpty (Fin (rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 0)))).toList.length)
  rw [rankBarcode_barcodeModule]
  simp only [Multiset.toList_zero, List.length_nil]
  exact inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.exists_finite_saturating_matching_of_hausdorff_lt
statement:
theorem exists_finite_saturating_matching_of_hausdorff_lt
    {X Y : Type u} [LinearOrder X] [LinearOrder Y]
    [MetricSpace X] [MetricSpace Y]
    (k : Type v) [Field k]
    {Z : Type w} [MetricSpace Z] {f : X → Z} {g : Y → Z}
    (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g)
    (hfin : hausdorffEDist (range f) (range g) ≠ ⊤)
    {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (hε : 2 * hausdorffDist (range f) (range g) < (ε : ℝ))
    (hX : TotallyBounded (univ : Set X))
    (hY : TotallyBounded (univ : Set Y))
    (n : ℕ)
    (F_X : Finset ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule
      (Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded k hX n)).finiteOccurrences))
    (F_Y : Finset ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule
      (Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded k hY n)).finiteOccurrences))
    (hLongX : ∀ x ∈ F_X, 2 * (ε : ℝ) <
      ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule
        (Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded k hX n)).finitePoint x).2 -
      ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule
        (Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded k hX n)).finitePoint x).1)
    (hLongY : ∀ y ∈ F_Y, 2 * (ε : ℝ) <
      ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule
        (Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded k hY n)).finitePoint y).2 -
      ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule
        (Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded k hY n)).finitePoint y).1)
    (E_X : Finset ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule
      (Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded k hX n)).essentialOccurrences))
    (E_Y : Finset ((LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule
      (Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded k hY n)).essentialOccurrences)) :
    FiniteSaturatingMatching ε
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule
        (Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded k hX n))
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule
        (Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded k hY n))
      F_X F_Y E_X E_Y
proof:
:= by
  exact RealInterleaving.exists_finite_saturating_matching
      (Rips.hausdorffInterleavingOfLt k hf hg hfin hε n)
      (Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded k hX n)
      (Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded k hY n)
      F_X F_Y hLongX hLongY E_X E_Y

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleDiagram_reindex_map
statement:
theorem moduleDiagram_reindex_map (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ) (φ : ℝ ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (φ (c i)))) :
    (moduleDiagram c (reindex φ.toOrderHom M) hfd).map φ =
      moduleDiagram (c.trans φ) M hfd
proof:
:= by
  unfold moduleDiagram
  apply Diagram.ext
  rw [Diagram.map_points, RealBarcode.ofIndexBars_points,
    RealBarcode.ofIndexBars_points, Multiset.map_map]
  apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
  intro I hI
  unfold RealBarcode.endpoints
  by_cases hd : I.death < m
  · simp [hd, RelEmbedding.trans_apply]
  · simp [hd, RelEmbedding.trans_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.expEmb_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem expEmb_apply (t : ℝ) : expEmb t = Real.exp t
proof:
:=
  by
    change OrderEmbedding.ofStrictMono Real.exp Real.exp_strictMono t = Real.exp t
    exact congrFun (OrderEmbedding.coe_ofStrictMono Real.exp_strictMono) t

name: TDA.Persistence.expEmb_toOrderHom
statement: theorem expEmb_toOrderHom : expEmb.toOrderHom = expHom
proof:
:= by
  apply OrderHom.ext _ _
  exact funext (fun t => rfl)

name: TDA.Persistence.positiveGrid_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveGrid_apply (f : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (i : Fin (logCriticalValues f).card) :
    positiveGrid f i = Real.exp (logGrid f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [positiveGrid, RelEmbedding.trans_apply, expEmb_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.mem_range_positiveGrid_iff
statement:
theorem mem_range_positiveGrid_iff (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    x ∈ Set.range (positiveGrid f) ↔ x ∈ f.criticalValues ∧ 0 < x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [positiveGrid_apply]
    exact exp_logGrid_mem f i
  · rintro ⟨hx, hpos⟩
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (f.mem_criticalValues x).1 hx
    have hposσ : 0 < f.value σ := by simpa [hσ] using hpos
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_logGrid_eq f σ hposσ
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    rw [positiveGrid_apply, hi, Real.exp_log hposσ, hσ]

name: TDA.Persistence.refines_positiveGrid
statement:
theorem refines_positiveGrid (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    Refines (positiveGrid f) f.criticalValue
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [positiveGrid_apply, FilterFunction.criticalValue,
    Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
  exact (exp_logGrid_mem f i).1

name: TDA.Persistence.card_le_one_of_mem_sublevel_positiveGrid
statement:
private theorem card_le_one_of_mem_sublevel_positiveGrid
    {f : FilterFunction K ℝ} (hf : PositiveOnEdges f) {t : ℝ}
    (ht : ∀ i, t < positiveGrid f i) :
    ∀ s ∈ f.sublevel t, s.card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsK, hst⟩ := (f.mem_sublevel_iff _ s).1 hs
  by_contra hcard
  have hv := hf ⟨s, hsK⟩ (show 2 ≤ s.card by omega)
  have hcrit : f.value ⟨s, hsK⟩ ∈ f.criticalValues :=
    (f.mem_criticalValues _).2 ⟨⟨s, hsK⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (mem_range_positiveGrid_iff f _).2 ⟨hcrit, hv⟩
  have hti := ht i
  rw [hi] at hti
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hst) hti

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelModule_isConstructible_positiveGrid
proof:
:= by
  have zero_left' : ∀ t, (∀ i, t < positiveGrid f i) →
      IsZero ((sublevelModule R f n).obj t) := by
    intro t ht
    change IsZero (simplicialHomology (f.sublevel t) R n)
    exact isZero_simplicialHomology_of_card_le_one R
      (card_le_one_of_mem_sublevel_positiveGrid hf ht) hn
  exact
    { zero_left := zero_left'
      isIso_map := by
        intro s t hst h
        by_cases hzero : cellIndex (positiveGrid f) t = 0
        · have hs_zero : cellIndex (positiveGrid f) s = 0 := h.trans hzero
          change IsIso (simplicialHomologyIncl R (f.sublevel_mono hst) n)
          exact (zero_left' s ((cellIndex_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hs_zero)).isIso
            (zero_left' t ((cellIndex_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hzero)) _
        · have hs_nonzero : cellIndex (positiveGrid f) s ≠ 0 := by
            intro hs_zero
            apply hzero
            rw [← h, hs_zero]
          have hs_pos : 0 < (cellIndex (positiveGrid f) s).val :=
            Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (fun h => hs_nonzero (Fin.ext h))
          have hcard : 0 < (logCriticalValues f).card := by
            have hs_lt := (cellIndex (positiveGrid f) s).isLt
            omega
          let i₀ : Fin (logCriticalValues f).card := ⟨0, hcard⟩
          have hi₀ : positiveGrid f i₀ ≤ s := by
            apply (lt_cellIndex_iff (positiveGrid f) i₀ s).1
            simpa [i₀] using hs_pos
          have hspos : 0 < s := by
            exact lt_of_lt_of_le
              (by rw [positiveGrid_apply]; exact Real.exp_pos _) hi₀
          have heq : f.sublevel s = f.sublevel t := by
            apply le_antisymm (f.sublevel_mono hst)
            intro σ hσ
            obtain ⟨hσK, hσt⟩ := (f.mem_sublevel_iff _ σ).1 hσ
            rcases le_or_gt (f.value ⟨σ, hσK⟩) 0 with hv | hv
            · exact (f.mem_sublevel_iff _ σ).2 ⟨hσK, hv.trans hspos.le⟩
            · have hcrit : f.value ⟨σ, hσK⟩ ∈ f.criticalValues :=
                (f.mem_criticalValues _).2 ⟨⟨σ, hσK⟩, rfl⟩
              obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (mem_range_positiveGrid_iff f _).2 ⟨hcrit, hv⟩
              have hle : positiveGrid f i ≤ t := by simpa [hi] using hσt
              have hit : i.val < (cellIndex (positiveGrid f) t).val :=
                (lt_cellIndex_iff _ i t).2 hle
              rw [← h] at hit
              have his := (lt_cellIndex_iff _ i s).1 hit
              exact (f.mem_sublevel_iff _ σ).2 ⟨hσK, by simpa [hi] using his⟩
          exact isIso_simplicialHomologyIncl_of_eq R heq
            (f.sublevel_mono hst) n }

name: TDA.Persistence.logDgm_map_exp
statement:
theorem logDgm_map_exp {f : FilterFunction K ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hf : PositiveOnEdges f) : (logDgm k f n).map expEmb = dgm k f n
proof:
:= by
  unfold logDgm
  change
    (moduleDiagram (logGrid f)
      (reindex expEmb.toOrderHom (sublevelModule k f n))
      (fun i => logModule_finiteDimensional k n f (logGrid f i))).map expEmb =
      dgm k f n
  rw [moduleDiagram_reindex_map k (logGrid f) expEmb (sublevelModule k f n)
    (fun i => logModule_finiteDimensional k n f (logGrid f i))]
  change moduleDiagram (positiveGrid f) (sublevelModule k f n)
      (fun i => logModule_finiteDimensional k n f (logGrid f i)) = dgm k f n
  rw [← moduleDiagram_refinement (sublevelModule k f n) (refines_positiveGrid f)
    (sublevelModule_isConstructible_positiveGrid k hn hf)
    (fun i => logModule_finiteDimensional k n f (logGrid f i))]
  exact moduleDiagram_sublevelModule k n f

name: TDA.Persistence.logDgm_points_eq_map_log
statement:
theorem logDgm_points_eq_map_log {f : FilterFunction K ℝ} {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hf : PositiveOnEdges f) :
    (logDgm k f n).points =
      (dgm k f n).points.map (fun p => (Real.log p.1, WithTop.map Real.log p.2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← logDgm_map_exp k hn hf, Diagram.map_points, Multiset.map_map]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Multiset.map_id' (logDgm k f n).points]
  apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := p
  cases d <;> simp [Function.comp_def]

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_birth_pos
statement:
theorem dgm_birth_pos {f : FilterFunction K ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hf : PositiveOnEdges f) {p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ} (hp : p ∈ (dgm k f n).points) :
    0 < p.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← logDgm_map_exp k hn hf, Diagram.map_points] at hp
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hp
  simpa [expEmb_apply] using Real.exp_pos q.1

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_death_pos
statement:
theorem dgm_death_pos {f : FilterFunction K ℝ} {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hf : PositiveOnEdges f) {p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ} (hp : p ∈ (dgm k f n).points) :
    (0 : WithTop ℝ) < p.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← logDgm_map_exp k hn hf, Diagram.map_points] at hp
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hp
  cases q.2 with
  | top => simp
  | coe d =>
      simp only [WithTop.map_coe, expEmb_apply]
      exact WithTop.coe_pos.mpr (Real.exp_pos d)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRepresentationRealExamples.coarse_apply

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRepresentationRealExamples.initial_zero
statement: private theorem initial_zero : observations.dim 0 = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRepresentationRealExamples.real_endpoints
statement:
theorem real_endpoints : (observations.realDiagram coarse).points =
    ((-1 : ℝ), (4 : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ (1 / 10, ⊤) ::ₘ 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : ∀ i : Fin 3, FiniteDimensional ℚ
      ((reindex (Fin.succOrderEmb 3).toOrderHom observations.toPModule).obj i) := fun i =>
    show FiniteDimensional ℚ (observations.toPModule.obj i.succ) from inferInstance
  rw [MatrixSequence.realDiagram_eq_ofIndexBars,
    rankBarcode_eq_of_iso positiveIso]

    MatrixSequenceExamples.compositeZero.barcode).points = _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRepresentationRealExamples.refined_real_endpoints

theorem refined_real_endpoints :
    (moduleDiagram fine (observations.realModule coarse) (fun _ => inferInstance)).points =
      ((-1 : ℝ), (4 : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ (1 / 10, ⊤) ::ₘ 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRepresentationRealExamples.critical_and_tail_indices
statement:
theorem critical_and_tail_indices :
    cellIndex coarse (-1) = 1 ∧ cellIndex coarse (1 / 10) = 2 ∧
      cellIndex coarse 4 = 3 ∧ cellIndex coarse 100 = 3
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact cellIndex_critical coarse 0
  · exact cellIndex_critical coarse 1
  · exact cellIndex_critical coarse 2
  · exact cellIndex_of_last_le coarse 100 (by change (4 : ℝ) ≤ 100; norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.Examples.characteristic_two_distances
statement:
theorem characteristic_two_distances :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance (module (k := ZMod 2) source) (module target) = 1 ∧

name: TDA.Persistence.abs_mul_sub_mul
statement:
private theorem abs_mul_sub_mul {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (u v : ℝ) :
    |c * u - c * v| = c * |u - v|
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePairCost_scale
statement:
theorem finitePairCost_scale (p q : ℝ × ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    finitePairCost (scaleFinitePair c p) (scaleFinitePair c q) =
      ENNReal.ofReal c * finitePairCost p q
proof:
:= by
  unfold finitePairCost scaleFinitePair
  rw [abs_mul_sub_mul hc, abs_mul_sub_mul hc, ← mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ hc,
    ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.diagonalCost_scale
statement:
theorem diagonalCost_scale (p : ℝ × ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    diagonalCost (scaleFinitePair c p) = ENNReal.ofReal c * diagonalCost p
proof:
:= by
  unfold diagonalCost scaleFinitePair
  rw [abs_mul_sub_mul hc, mul_div_assoc, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPairCost_scale
statement:
theorem essentialPairCost_scale (b b' : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    essentialPairCost (c * b) (c * b') = ENNReal.ofReal c * essentialPairCost b b'
proof:
:= by
  unfold essentialPairCost
  rw [abs_mul_sub_mul hc, ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.cost_scale_le
statement:
private theorem cost_scale_le (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ) (b : E₁ → ℝ) (b' : E₂ → ℝ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    M.cost (scaleFinitePair c ∘ x) (scaleFinitePair c ∘ y)
        (fun i => c * b i) (fun j => c * b' j) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal c * M.cost x y b b'
proof:
:= by
  apply M.cost_le_of
  · intro i
    have h := M.source_le_cost x y b b' i
    revert h
    cases M.finite i with
    | none =>
      intro h
      change diagonalCost (scaleFinitePair c (x i)) ≤ _
      rw [diagonalCost_scale _ hc]
      exact mul_le_mul_right h _
    | some j =>
      intro h
      change finitePairCost (scaleFinitePair c (x i)) (scaleFinitePair c (y j)) ≤ _
      rw [finitePairCost_scale _ _ hc]
      exact mul_le_mul_right h _
  · intro j
    by_cases hj : ∃ i, M.finite i = some j
    · rw [if_pos hj]
      exact zero_le
    · rw [if_neg hj]
      have h := M.target_le_cost x y b b' j
      rw [if_neg hj] at h
      change diagonalCost (scaleFinitePair c (y j)) ≤ _
      rw [diagonalCost_scale _ hc]
      exact mul_le_mul_right h _
  · intro k
    rw [essentialPairCost_scale _ _ hc]
    exact mul_le_mul_right (M.essential_le_cost x y b b' k) _

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.cost_scale
statement:
theorem cost_scale (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ) (b : E₁ → ℝ) (b' : E₂ → ℝ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    M.cost (scaleFinitePair c ∘ x) (scaleFinitePair c ∘ y)
        (fun i => c * b i) (fun j => c * b' j) =
      ENNReal.ofReal c * M.cost x y b b'
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (cost_scale_le M x y b b' hc.le)
  have h := cost_scale_le M (scaleFinitePair c ∘ x) (scaleFinitePair c ∘ y)
    (fun i => c * b i) (fun j => c * b' j) (inv_nonneg.2 hc.le)
  have hpair : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, scaleFinitePair c⁻¹ (scaleFinitePair c p) = p := by
    intro p
    simp [scaleFinitePair, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hc.ne']
  have hx : scaleFinitePair c⁻¹ ∘ (scaleFinitePair c ∘ x) = x := funext fun i => hpair (x i)
  have hy : scaleFinitePair c⁻¹ ∘ (scaleFinitePair c ∘ y) = y := funext fun j => hpair (y j)
  have hb : (fun i => c⁻¹ * (c * b i)) = b := funext fun i => inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hc.ne' _
  have hb' : (fun j => c⁻¹ * (c * b' j)) = b' :=
    funext fun j => inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hc.ne' _
  simp only [hx, hy, hb, hb'] at h
  calc
    ENNReal.ofReal c * M.cost x y b b' ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal c * (ENNReal.ofReal c⁻¹ * M.cost (scaleFinitePair c ∘ x)
          (scaleFinitePair c ∘ y) (fun i => c * b i) (fun j => c * b' j)) :=
      mul_le_mul_right h _
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hc.le, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne',
        ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_scale
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_scale {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ) (b : E₁ → ℝ) (b' : E₂ → ℝ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    presentationBottleneck (scaleFinitePair c ∘ x) (scaleFinitePair c ∘ y)
        (fun i => c * b i) (fun j => c * b' j) =
      ENNReal.ofReal c * presentationBottleneck x y b b'
proof:
:= by
  unfold presentationBottleneck
  rw [ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.2 hc).ne' ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]
  exact iInf_congr fun M => M.cost_scale x y b b' hc

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_scale
statement:
theorem bottleneck_scale (D E : Diagram ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    bottleneck (D.scale c hc) (E.scale c hc) = ENNReal.ofReal c * bottleneck D E
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation (D.scale c hc) (E.scale c hc)
    (scaleFinitePair c ∘ fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
    (scaleFinitePair c ∘ fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
    (fun i : D.essentialOccurrences => c * i.1)
    (fun j : E.essentialOccurrences => c * j.1)
    ((Multiset.map_univ _ _).trans (finitePart_scale_points D hc).symm)
    ((Multiset.map_univ _ _).trans (finitePart_scale_points E hc).symm)
    ((Multiset.map_univ _ _).trans (essentialPart_scale_points D hc).symm)
    ((Multiset.map_univ _ _).trans (essentialPart_scale_points E hc).symm)]
  unfold bottleneck
  exact presentationBottleneck_scale _ _ _ _ hc

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_scale
statement:
theorem dgm_scale (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (n : ℕ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :

proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_dgm_scale
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_scale (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) (n : ℕ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (f.scale c hc) n) (dgm k (g.scale c hc) n) =
      ENNReal.ofReal c * bottleneck (dgm k f n) (dgm k g n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dgm_scale, dgm_scale]
  exact bottleneck_scale _ _ hc

name: TDA.Persistence.translateFilterFunction_eq_map
statement:
theorem translateFilterFunction_eq_map {V : Type*} [LinearOrder V]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    translateFilterFunction f c = f.map (OrderIso.addRight c).toOrderEmbedding
proof:

  ext s

name: TDA.Persistence.translateDiagram_eq_map
statement:
theorem translateDiagram_eq_map (D : Diagram ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    translateDiagram D c = D.map (OrderIso.addRight c).toOrderEmbedding
proof:

  apply Diagram.ext
  change D.points.map (translateDiagramPoint c) = D.points.map _
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (hD : essentialPart D.points = 0) (hE : essentialPart E.points = 0)
    {m : ℕ}
    (hcard : Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences ≤ m)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hB : bottleneck D E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R) :
proof:
|finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) - (bottleneck D E).toReal| ≤
      ((((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) - 1) * R := by
  have hfinite := bottleneck_lt_top_of_essentialParts_eq_zero D E hD hE
  have hb : (bottleneck D E).toReal ≤ R := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hR] using
      (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hfinite.ne ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mpr hB
  have hlower := bottleneck_toReal_le_finitePMatchingCost hp D E hD hE
  have hcount : ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences +
      Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (max 1 m : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcard.trans (le_max_right 1 m)
  have hexp : 0 ≤ p⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (zero_le_one.trans hp)
  have hfactor : 1 ≤ ((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ :=
    Real.one_le_rpow (by exact_mod_cast le_max_left 1 m) hexp
  have hupper := (finitePMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck hp D E hfinite).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.rpow_le_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hcount hexp)
      ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlower)]
  calc
    _ ≤ (((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) * (bottleneck D E).toReal -
        (bottleneck D E).toReal := sub_le_sub_right hupper _
    _ = ((((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) - 1) * (bottleneck D E).toReal := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (sub_nonneg.mpr hfactor)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (hD : essentialPart D.points = 0) (hE : essentialPart E.points = 0)
    {m : ℕ}
    (hcard : Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences ≤ m)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hB : bottleneck D E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R) :
proof:
|finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) - (bottleneck D E).toReal| ≤
      ((((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) - 1) * R := by
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  exact finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound hp D E hD hE hcard hR hB

name: TDA.Persistence.uniform_errorEnvelope_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : ((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (max 1 m : ℕ) := by exact_mod_cast le_max_left 1 m
    linarith
  have hfactor : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => ((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹)
      atTop (𝓝 1) := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_zero, Function.comp_def] using
      (Real.continuousAt_const_rpow (a := ((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ)) (b := 0) hbase).tendsto.comp
        (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => p⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0))
  simpa only [sub_self, zero_mul] using (hfactor.sub_const 1).mul_const R

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck
    (m : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun p : ℝ => fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ =>
        finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : z.1.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
          (fun q : z.2.finiteOccurrences => q.1))
      (fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ => (bottleneck z.1 z.2).toReal) atTop
      {z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ |
        essentialPart z.1.points = 0 ∧ essentialPart z.2.points = 0 ∧
        Fintype.card z.1.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card z.2.finiteOccurrences ≤ m ∧
        bottleneck z.1 z.2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R}
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  filter_upwards [(uniform_errorEnvelope_tendsto m R).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε),
    eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with p herror hp
  intro z hz
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm]
  exact (finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound hp z.1 z.2
    hz.1 hz.2.1 hz.2.2.1 hR hz.2.2.2).trans_lt herror

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck
    (m : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun p : ℝ => fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ =>
        finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : z.1.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
          (fun q : z.2.finiteOccurrences => q.1))
      (fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ => (bottleneck z.1 z.2).toReal) atTop
      {z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ |
        essentialPart z.1.points = 0 ∧ essentialPart z.2.points = 0 ∧
        Fintype.card z.1.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card z.2.finiteOccurrences ≤ m ∧
        bottleneck z.1 z.2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R}
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using
    finitePMatchingCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck m R hR

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.occurrencePoint_multiset
statement:
theorem occurrencePoint_multiset (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Occurrences D)).val.map (occurrencePoint D) = D.points
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.univ_disjSum_univ, Finset.val_disjSum, Multiset.disjSum, Multiset.map_add,
    Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_map]
  change ((Finset.univ : Finset D.finiteOccurrences).val.map
    (fun p => (p.1.1, (p.1.2 : WithTop ℝ)))) +
      ((Finset.univ : Finset D.essentialOccurrences).val.map (fun b => (b.1, ⊤))) = _
  erw [← Multiset.map_map (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop ℝ))),
    ← Multiset.map_map (fun b : ℝ => (b, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))),
    Multiset.map_univ_coe, Multiset.map_univ_coe]
  exact parts_reconstruct D.points

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.familyLinear_some
statement:
private theorem familyLinear_some {ι κ : Type} (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ) (G : κ → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (τ : κ → Option ι)
    (f : ∀ j i, τ j = some i → (F i ⟶ (shift ε).obj (G j)))
    (t : ℝ) (j : κ) (i : ι) (hi : τ j = some i) :
    familyLinear ε F G τ f t j = (((f j i hi).app t).hom).comp (LinearMap.proj i)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∃ i, τ j = some i := ⟨i, hi⟩
  unfold familyLinear
  erw [dif_pos h]
  have heq : h.choose = i := Option.some.inj (h.choose_spec.symm.trans hi)
  subst i
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.familyLinear_none
statement:
private theorem familyLinear_none {ι κ : Type} (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ) (G : κ → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (τ : κ → Option ι)
    (f : ∀ j i, τ j = some i → (F i ⟶ (shift ε).obj (G j)))
    (t : ℝ) (j : κ) (hj : τ j = none) : familyLinear ε F G τ f t j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : ¬ ∃ i, τ j = some i := by simp [hj]
  exact dif_neg h

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.familyMap_app_some
statement:
private theorem familyMap_app_some {ι κ : Type} (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ) (G : κ → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (τ : κ → Option ι)
    (f : ∀ j i, τ j = some i → (F i ⟶ (shift ε).obj (G j)))
    (t : ℝ) (x : (familyModule F).obj t) (j : κ) (i : ι) (hi : τ j = some i) :
    ((familyMap ε F G τ f).app t).hom x j = ((f j i hi).app t).hom (x i)
proof:
:= by
  change familyLinear ε F G τ f t j x = _
  erw [familyLinear_some ε F G τ f t j i hi]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.familyMap_app_none
statement:
private theorem familyMap_app_none {ι κ : Type} (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ) (G : κ → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (τ : κ → Option ι)
    (f : ∀ j i, τ j = some i → (F i ⟶ (shift ε).obj (G j)))
    (t : ℝ) (x : (familyModule F).obj t) (j : κ) (hj : τ j = none) :
    ((familyMap ε F G τ f).app t).hom x j = 0
proof:
:= by
  change familyLinear ε F G τ f t j x = 0
  erw [familyLinear_none ε F G τ f t j hj]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.selection_reverse
statement:
private theorem selection_reverse {D E : Diagram ℝ}
    (M : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences E.essentialOccurrences) (i : Occurrences D) (j : Occurrences E) :
    selection M i = some j ↔ selection M.reverse j = some i
proof:
:= by
  cases i with
  | inl i =>
    cases j with
    | inl j => simp [selection, OccurrenceMatching.reverse_finite_some_iff]
    | inr j => simp [selection]
  | inr i =>
    cases j with
    | inl j => simp [selection]
    | inr j =>
      change some (Sum.inr (M.essential i) : Occurrences E) = some (.inr j) ↔
        some (Sum.inr (M.essential.symm j) : Occurrences D) = some (.inr i)
      simp only [Option.some.injEq, Sum.inr.injEq]
      exact M.essential.eq_symm_apply.symm.trans eq_comm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.finite_positive
statement:
theorem finite_positive {D : Diagram ℝ} (hD : D.IsPositive)
    (i : D.finiteOccurrences) : i.1.1 < i.1.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨b, d⟩, hmem, heq⟩ :=
    (Multiset.mem_filterMap _ _).mp (Multiset.coe_mem (x := i))
  cases d with
  | top => simp [finitePart] at heq
  | coe d =>
    simp only [finitePart, Option.some.injEq] at heq
    have h := hD (b, (d : WithTop ℝ)) hmem
    have hi : i.1 = (b, d) := heq.symm
    simpa only [hi, WithTop.coe_lt_coe] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translate_obj
statement:
@[simp] private theorem translate_obj (a : ℝ) (P : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (translate a P).obj t = P.obj (t + a)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateMap_app
statement:
@[simp] private theorem translateMap_app {P Q : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ Q) (a t : ℝ) : (translateMap f a).app t = f.app (t + a)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.reindexEqIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] private theorem reindexEqIso_hom_app {a b : ℝ →o ℝ} (h : ∀ t, a t = b t)
    (P : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (reindexEqIso h P).hom.app t = P.map (eqToHom (h t))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateEqIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] private theorem translateEqIso_hom_app {a b : ℝ} (h : a = b)
    (P : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (translateEqIso h P).hom.app t = P.map (eqToHom (congrArg (fun c : ℝ => t + c) h))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateEqIso_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] private theorem translateEqIso_inv_app {a b : ℝ} (h : a = b)
    (P : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (translateEqIso h P).inv.app t =
      P.map (eqToHom (congrArg (fun c : ℝ => t + c) h.symm))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateShiftIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] private theorem translateShiftIso_hom_app (a : ℝ)
    (P : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (translateShiftIso a P).hom.app t =
      P.map (eqToHom (show (t + a) + (ε : ℝ) = t + (a + (ε : ℝ)) by ring))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateInterleavingMap_app
statement:
@[simp] private theorem translateInterleavingMap_app {P Q : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ (shift ε).obj Q) (a b : ℝ) (h : a + (ε : ℝ) = b) (t : ℝ) :
    (translateInterleavingMap f a b h).app t =
      f.app (t + a) ≫ Q.map (eqToHom (show (t + a) + (ε : ℝ) = t + b by
        rw [add_assoc]
        exact congrArg (fun x : ℝ => t + x) h))
proof:
:= by
  subst b
  simp [translateInterleavingMap, CategoryTheory.NatTrans.comp_app,
    translateMap_app, translateShiftIso_hom_app, translateEqIso_hom_app]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairModule_map_apply
statement:
private theorem pairModule_map_apply {P Q : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    {s t : ℝ} (e : s ⟶ t) (x : P.obj s) (y : Q.obj s) :
    ((pairModule P Q).map e).hom (x, y) =
      ((P.map e).hom x, (Q.map e).hom y)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairMap_app_apply
statement:
@[simp] private theorem pairMap_app_apply {P Q P' Q' : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ P') (h : P ⟶ Q') (j : Q ⟶ Q') (t : ℝ)
    (x : P.obj t) (y : Q.obj t) :
    ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((pairMap f g h j).app t) (x, y) =
      ((f.app t).hom x + (g.app t).hom y, (h.app t).hom x + (j.app t).hom y)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairMap_ext
statement:
private theorem pairMap_ext {P Q P' Q' : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f f' : P ⟶ P') (g g' : Q ⟶ P') (h h' : P ⟶ Q') (j j' : Q ⟶ Q')
    (hf : f = f') (hg : g = g') (hh : h = h') (hj : j = j') :
    pairMap f g h j = pairMap f' g' h' j'
proof:
:= by
  subst f'
  subst g'
  subst h'
  subst j'
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairMap_diag_comp
statement:
private theorem pairMap_diag_comp {P Q P' Q' P'' Q'' : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ P') (j : Q ⟶ Q') (f' : P' ⟶ P'') (g' : Q' ⟶ P'')
    (h' : P' ⟶ Q'') (j' : Q' ⟶ Q'') :
    pairMap f 0 0 j ≫ pairMap f' g' h' j' =
      pairMap (f ≫ f') (j ≫ g') (f ≫ h') (j ≫ j')
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    pairMap_app_apply, zero_add, add_zero]
  change (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((pairMap f' g' h' j').app t))
      ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((pairMap f 0 0 j).app t)) (x, y)) = _
  simp [pairMap_app_apply, NatTrans.app_zero, map_add]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairMap_comp_diag
statement:
private theorem pairMap_comp_diag {P Q P' Q' P'' Q'' : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ P') (h : P ⟶ Q') (j : Q ⟶ Q')
    (f' : P' ⟶ P'') (j' : Q' ⟶ Q'') :
    pairMap f g h j ≫ pairMap f' 0 0 j' =
      pairMap (f ≫ f') (g ≫ f') (h ≫ j') (j ≫ j')
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    pairMap_app_apply]
  change (ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((pairMap f' 0 0 j').app t))
      ((ModuleCat.Hom.hom ((pairMap f g h j).app t)) (x, y)) = _
  simp [pairMap_app_apply, map_add]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairMap_diag_transition
statement:
private theorem pairMap_diag_transition (P Q : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ)
    (d : ℝ≥0) :
    pairMap (RealShift.transition d P) 0 0 (RealShift.transition d Q) =
      RealShift.transition d (pairModule P Q)
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  rw [pairMap_app_apply]
  simp only [NatTrans.app_zero, ModuleCat.hom_zero, map_zero,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add, add_zero]
  simp only [RealShift.transition_app, structureMap]
  change ((P.map (homOfLE (le_add_of_nonneg_right d.coe_nonneg))).hom x,
      (Q.map (homOfLE (le_add_of_nonneg_right d.coe_nonneg))).hom y) =
    ((pairModule P Q).map (homOfLE (le_add_of_nonneg_right d.coe_nonneg))).hom (x, y)
  rw [pairModule_map_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairDescMap_app_apply
statement:
@[simp] private theorem pairDescMap_app_apply {P Q R : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ R) (g : Q ⟶ R) (t : ℝ) (x : P.obj t) (y : Q.obj t) :
    ((pairDescMap f g).app t).hom (x, y) =
      (f.app t).hom x + (g.app t).hom y
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairInl_app_apply
statement:
@[simp] private theorem pairInl_app_apply {P Q : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ} (t : ℝ)
    (x : P.obj t) : (pairInl (P := P) (Q := Q)).app t x = (x, 0)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairInr_app_apply
statement:
@[simp] private theorem pairInr_app_apply {P Q : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ} (t : ℝ)
    (y : Q.obj t) : (pairInr (P := P) (Q := Q)).app t y = (0, y)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairInr_pairMap_app_apply
statement:
@[simp] private theorem pairInr_pairMap_app_apply
    {P Q P' Q' : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ P') (h : P ⟶ Q') (j : Q ⟶ Q')
    (t : ℝ) (y : Q.obj t) :
    ((pairInr ≫ pairMap f g h j).app t).hom y =
      ((g.app t).hom y, (j.app t).hom y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairInr_comp_pairMap
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  simp [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    pairInr_pairMap_app_apply, pairInl_app_apply, pairInr_app_apply,
    NatTrans.app_add, ModuleCat.hom_add]
  change ((g.app t).hom y, (j.app t).hom y) =
    ((g.app t).hom y, 0) + (0, (j.app t).hom y)
  ext
  · change (g.app t).hom y = (g.app t).hom y + 0
    simp
  · change (j.app t).hom y = 0 + (j.app t).hom y
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairInl_comp_pairMap
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    pairInl_app_apply, pairInr_app_apply, NatTrans.app_add, ModuleCat.hom_add]
  change ((f.app t).hom x, (h.app t).hom x) =
    ((f.app t).hom x, 0) + (0, (h.app t).hom x)
  ext
  · change (f.app t).hom x = (f.app t).hom x + 0
    simp
  · change (h.app t).hom x = 0 + (h.app t).hom x
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairInl_pairDescMap
statement:
private theorem pairInl_pairDescMap {P Q R : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ R) (g : Q ⟶ R) : pairInl ≫ pairDescMap f g = f
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    pairInl_app_apply, pairDescMap_app_apply, map_zero, add_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairInr_pairDescMap
statement:
private theorem pairInr_pairDescMap {P Q R : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ R) (g : Q ⟶ R) : pairInr ≫ pairDescMap f g = g
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro y
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    pairInr_app_apply, pairDescMap_app_apply, map_zero, zero_add]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairInl_pairDescMap_comp
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc pairInl, pairInl_pairDescMap]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairInr_pairDescMap_comp
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc pairInr, pairInr_pairDescMap]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairInl_pairDescMap_comp_comp
statement:
private theorem pairInl_pairDescMap_comp_comp
    {P Q R S T : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ R) (g : Q ⟶ R) (h : R ⟶ S) (j : S ⟶ T) :
    pairInl ≫ ((pairDescMap f g ≫ h) ≫ j) = (f ≫ h) ≫ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc pairInl, pairInl_pairDescMap]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairInr_pairDescMap_comp_comp
statement:
private theorem pairInr_pairDescMap_comp_comp
    {P Q R S T : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ R) (g : Q ⟶ R) (h : R ⟶ S) (j : S ⟶ T) :
    pairInr ≫ ((pairDescMap f g ≫ h) ≫ j) = (g ≫ h) ≫ j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc pairInr, pairInr_pairDescMap]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairModule_hom_ext
statement:
private theorem pairModule_hom_ext {P Q R : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f g : pairModule P Q ⟶ R)
    (hinl : pairInl ≫ f = pairInl ≫ g)
    (hinr : pairInr ≫ f = pairInr ≫ g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  have h1 := congrArg (fun q => (q.app t).hom x) hinl
  have h2 := congrArg (fun q => (q.app t).hom y) hinr
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    pairInl_app_apply] at h1
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    pairInr_app_apply] at h2
  have hp : (x, y) = (x, 0) + (0, y) := by ext <;> simp
  change (f.app t).hom (x, y) = (g.app t).hom (x, y)
  have hpf := congrArg (fun z : P.obj t × Q.obj t => (f.app t).hom z) hp
  have hpg := congrArg (fun z : P.obj t × Q.obj t => (g.app t).hom z) hp
  calc
    (f.app t).hom (x, y) = (f.app t).hom ((x, 0) + (0, y)) := hpf
    _ = (f.app t).hom (x, 0) + (f.app t).hom (0, y) :=
      map_add (f.app t).hom (x, 0) (0, y)
    _ = (g.app t).hom (x, 0) + (g.app t).hom (0, y) := by rw [h1, h2]
    _ = (g.app t).hom ((x, 0) + (0, y)) :=
      (map_add (g.app t).hom (x, 0) (0, y)).symm
    _ = (g.app t).hom (x, y) := hpg.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.compIso_pairModule_hom
statement:
private theorem compIso_pairModule_hom (P Q : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ)
    (d : ℝ≥0) :
    (RealShift.compIso d d (pairModule P Q)).hom =
      pairMap (RealShift.compIso d d P).hom 0 0
        (RealShift.compIso d d Q).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  change ((shift d).obj ((shift d).obj P)).obj t at x
  change ((shift d).obj ((shift d).obj Q)).obj t at y
  conv_lhs => rw [RealShift.compIso_hom_app d d (pairModule P Q) t]
  have hpm := pairMap_app_apply (f := (RealShift.compIso d d P).hom)
    (g := 0) (h := 0) (j := (RealShift.compIso d d Q).hom) t x y
  conv_rhs => erw [hpm]
  simp only [NatTrans.app_zero, ModuleCat.hom_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add, add_zero]
  change ((P.map (eqToHom (show (t + (d : ℝ)) + (d : ℝ) =
      t + ((d + d : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) by simp [add_assoc]))).hom x,
      (Q.map (eqToHom (show (t + (d : ℝ)) + (d : ℝ) =
      t + ((d + d : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) by simp [add_assoc]))).hom y) =
    (((RealShift.compIso d d P).hom.app t).hom x,
      ((RealShift.compIso d d Q).hom.app t).hom y)
  rw [RealShift.compIso_hom_app, RealShift.compIso_hom_app]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairMap_comp_pairDescMap_zero
statement:
private theorem pairMap_comp_pairDescMap_zero {P Q R S : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ R) (g : Q ⟶ R) (h : P ⟶ S) (j : Q ⟶ S) (a : S ⟶ R)
    (hf : h ≫ a = -f) (hg : j ≫ a = -g) :
    pairMap f g h j ≫ pairDescMap (𝟙 R) a = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  have hx := congrArg (fun q => (q.app t).hom x) hf
  have hy := congrArg (fun q => (q.app t).hom y) hg
  change (a.app t).hom ((h.app t).hom x) = -((f.app t).hom x) at hx
  change (a.app t).hom ((j.app t).hom y) = -((g.app t).hom y) at hy
  change (f.app t).hom x + (g.app t).hom y +
    (a.app t).hom ((h.app t).hom x + (j.app t).hom y) = 0
  rw [map_add, hx, hy]
  abel

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairMap_comp_pairDescMap_zero_general
statement:
private theorem pairMap_comp_pairDescMap_zero_general
    {P Q R S T : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ R) (g : Q ⟶ R) (h : P ⟶ S) (j : Q ⟶ S)
    (a : R ⟶ T) (b : S ⟶ T)
    (hf : f ≫ a = -(h ≫ b)) (hg : g ≫ a = -(j ≫ b)) :
    pairMap f g h j ≫ pairDescMap a b = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩
  have hx := congrArg (fun q => (q.app t).hom x) hf
  have hy := congrArg (fun q => (q.app t).hom y) hg
  change (a.app t).hom ((f.app t).hom x) =
    -((b.app t).hom ((h.app t).hom x)) at hx
  change (a.app t).hom ((g.app t).hom y) =
    -((b.app t).hom ((j.app t).hom y)) at hy
  change (a.app t).hom ((f.app t).hom x + (g.app t).hom y) +
      (b.app t).hom ((h.app t).hom x + (j.app t).hom y) = 0
  rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  abel

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateToShiftStructure_self_transition
statement:
private theorem translateToShiftStructure_self_transition
    (P : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) (a : ℝ) (d : ℝ≥0)
    (ha : a ≤ (d : ℝ) + a) :
    translateToShiftStructure P a a d ha = RealShift.transition d (translate a P)
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  dsimp only [translateToShiftStructure, RealShift.transition_app,
    structureMap, translate_obj, translateOrder]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateInterleavingMap_shift_naturality
statement:
private theorem translateInterleavingMap_shift_naturality
    {P Q : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ} (f : P ⟶ (shift ε).obj Q)
    (a a' b b' : ℝ) (d : ℝ≥0)
    (hab : a + (ε : ℝ) = b) (ha'b' : a' + (ε : ℝ) = b')
    (hA : a ≤ (d : ℝ) + a') (hB : b ≤ (d : ℝ) + b') :
    translateInterleavingMap f a b hab ≫
        translateToShiftStructure Q b b' d hB =
      translateToShiftStructure P a a' d hA ≫
        (shift d).map (translateInterleavingMap f a' b' ha'b')
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, translateInterleavingMap_app,
    translateToShiftStructure, RealShift.shift_map_app, RealShift.shift_obj,
    RealShift.translation_apply]
  let eA : (t + a) ⟶ ((t + (d : ℝ)) + a') :=
    homOfLE (by
      calc
        t + a ≤ t + ((d : ℝ) + a') := by
          simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_left hA t
        _ = (t + (d : ℝ)) + a' := by ring)
  have hn := f.naturality eA
  change P.map eA ≫ f.app ((t + (d : ℝ)) + a') =
    f.app (t + a) ≫ Q.map ((translation ε).toFunctor.map eA) at hn
  let e1 : (RealShift.translation ε).toFunctor.obj (t + a) ⟶ t + b :=
    eqToHom (by
      change (t + a) + (ε : ℝ) = t + b
      rw [add_assoc, hab])
  let eB : t + b ⟶ (t + (d : ℝ)) + b' := homOfLE (by
    calc
      t + b ≤ t + ((d : ℝ) + b') := by
        simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_left hB t
      _ = (t + (d : ℝ)) + b' := by ring)
  let e2 : (RealShift.translation ε).toFunctor.obj
      ((t + (d : ℝ)) + a') ⟶ (t + (d : ℝ)) + b' :=
    eqToHom (by
      change ((t + (d : ℝ)) + a') + (ε : ℝ) = (t + (d : ℝ)) + b'
      rw [add_assoc, ha'b'])
  have hpath : e1 ≫ eB = ((translation ε).toFunctor.map eA) ≫ e2 := by
    apply Subsingleton.elim
  let f0 : P.obj (t + a) ⟶ Q.obj ((RealShift.translation ε).toFunctor.obj (t + a)) :=
    f.app (t + a)
  let f1 : P.obj ((t + (d : ℝ)) + a') ⟶
      Q.obj ((RealShift.translation ε).toFunctor.obj ((t + (d : ℝ)) + a')) :=
    f.app ((t + (d : ℝ)) + a')
  have hn' := hn
  change P.map eA ≫ f1 = f0 ≫ Q.map ((translation ε).toFunctor.map eA) at hn'
  dsimp only [structureMap]
  change (f0 ≫ Q.map e1) ≫ Q.map eB =
    (P.map eA ≫ f1) ≫ Q.map e2
  calc
    (f0 ≫ Q.map e1) ≫ Q.map eB =
        f0 ≫ (Q.map e1 ≫ Q.map eB) := by
          exact Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = f0 ≫ Q.map (e1 ≫ eB) := by
          rw [← Q.map_comp]
    _ = f0 ≫ Q.map (((translation ε).toFunctor.map eA) ≫ e2) := by
          rw [hpath]
    _ = f0 ≫
        (Q.map ((translation ε).toFunctor.map eA) ≫ Q.map e2) := by
          rw [Q.map_comp]
    _ = (f0 ≫ Q.map ((translation ε).toFunctor.map eA)) ≫ Q.map e2 := by
          exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (P.map eA ≫ f1) ≫ Q.map e2 := by
          rw [← hn']

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateStructure_comp
statement:
private theorem translateStructure_comp (P : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ)
    (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    translateStructure P a b hab ≫ translateStructure P b c hbc =
      translateStructure P a c (hab.trans hbc)
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  change structureMap P (add_le_add_right hab t) ≫
      structureMap P (add_le_add_right hbc t) =
    structureMap P (add_le_add_right (hab.trans hbc) t)
  exact structureMap_comp P _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateStructure_shift_naturality
statement:
private theorem translateStructure_shift_naturality
    (P : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) (a a' b b' : ℝ) (d : ℝ≥0)
    (hab : a ≤ b) (ha'b' : a' ≤ b')
    (hA : a ≤ (d : ℝ) + a') (hB : b ≤ (d : ℝ) + b') :
    translateToShiftStructure P a a' d hA ≫
        (shift d).map (translateStructure P a' b' ha'b') =
      translateStructure P a b hab ≫
        translateToShiftStructure P b b' d hB
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  dsimp only [translateToShiftStructure, translateStructure,
    RealShift.shift_map_app, RealShift.shift_obj, translate_obj]
  change structureMap P _ ≫ structureMap P _ =
    structureMap P _ ≫ structureMap P _
  erw [structureMap_comp, structureMap_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateToShiftStructure_comp_compIso
statement:
private theorem translateToShiftStructure_comp_compIso
    (P : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) (a b c : ℝ) (d : ℝ≥0)
    (hab : a ≤ (d : ℝ) + b) (hbc : b ≤ (d : ℝ) + c)
    (hac : a ≤ ((d + d : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) + c) :
    translateToShiftStructure P a b d hab ≫
        (shift d).map (translateToShiftStructure P b c d hbc) ≫
        (RealShift.compIso d d (translate c P)).hom =
      translateToShiftStructure P a c (d + d) hac
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, translateToShiftStructure,
    RealShift.shift_map_app, RealShift.compIso_hom_app]
  change P.map _ ≫ P.map _ ≫ P.map _ = P.map _
  erw [← P.map_comp, ← P.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.shift_pairMap
statement:
private theorem shift_pairMap {P Q P' Q' : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ P') (h : P ⟶ Q') (j : Q ⟶ Q') (d : ℝ≥0) :
    (shift d).map (pairMap f g h j) =
      pairMap ((shift d).map f) ((shift d).map g)
        ((shift d).map h) ((shift d).map j)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.shift_pairModule_obj
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.shift_map_neg
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  simp [RealShift.shift_map_app]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.shift_map_zero
statement:
private theorem shift_map_zero {P Q : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ} (d : ℝ≥0) :
    (shift d).map (0 : P ⟶ Q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  simp [RealShift.shift_map_app]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateEqIso_inv_comp_translateStructure
statement:
private theorem translateEqIso_inv_comp_translateStructure
    (P : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (h : a = b) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (translateEqIso h P).inv ≫ translateStructure P a b hab =
      𝟙 (translate b P)
proof:
:= by
  subst b
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  simp [NatTrans.comp_app, translateEqIso_inv_app, translateStructure,
    translate_obj, translateOrder]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateInterleavingMap_comp
statement:
private theorem translateInterleavingMap_comp (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)
    (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a + (ε : ℝ) = b) (hbc : b + (ε : ℝ) = c)
    (hac : a ≤ c) :
    translateInterleavingMap i.φ a b hab ≫ translateInterleavingMap i.ψ b c hbc =
      translateStructure M a c hac
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, translateInterleavingMap_app]
  let e : (t + a) + (ε : ℝ) ⟶ t + b := eqToHom (by rw [add_assoc, hab])
  have hn := i.ψ.naturality e
  change N.map e ≫ i.ψ.app (t + b) =
    i.ψ.app ((t + a) + (ε : ℝ)) ≫ M.map ((translation ε).toFunctor.map e) at hn
  change (i.φ.app (t + a) ≫ N.map e) ≫
      (i.ψ.app (t + b) ≫ M.map _) = M.map _
  erw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (N.map e), hn]
  erw [Category.assoc,
    ← Category.assoc (i.φ.app (t + a)) (i.ψ.app ((t + a) + (ε : ℝ))),
    i.φ_ψ_structureMap]
  unfold structureMap
  erw [← M.map_comp, ← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateInterleavingMap_ψφ_comp
statement:
private theorem translateInterleavingMap_ψφ_comp (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)
    (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a + (ε : ℝ) = b) (hbc : b + (ε : ℝ) = c)
    (hac : a ≤ c) :
    translateInterleavingMap i.ψ a b hab ≫ translateInterleavingMap i.φ b c hbc =
      translateStructure N a c hac
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, translateInterleavingMap_app]
  let e : (t + a) + (ε : ℝ) ⟶ t + b := eqToHom (by rw [add_assoc, hab])
  have hn := i.φ.naturality e
  change M.map e ≫ i.φ.app (t + b) =
    i.φ.app ((t + a) + (ε : ℝ)) ≫ N.map ((translation ε).toFunctor.map e) at hn
  change (i.ψ.app (t + a) ≫ M.map e) ≫
      (i.φ.app (t + b) ≫ N.map _) = N.map _
  erw [Category.assoc, ← Category.assoc (M.map e), hn]
  erw [Category.assoc,
    ← Category.assoc (i.ψ.app (t + a)) (i.φ.app ((t + a) + (ε : ℝ))),
    i.symm.φ_ψ_structureMap]
  unfold structureMap
  erw [← N.map_comp, ← N.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateEqIso_inv_comp_interleavingMap
statement:
private theorem translateEqIso_inv_comp_interleavingMap
    {P Q : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ} (f : P ⟶ (shift ε).obj Q)
    (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a + (ε : ℝ) = c) (hbc : b + (ε : ℝ) = c)
    (h : a = b) :
    (translateEqIso h P).inv ≫ translateInterleavingMap f a c hab =
      translateInterleavingMap f b c hbc
proof:
:= by
  subst b
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  simp [translateEqIso_inv_app, translateInterleavingMap_app]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translateStructure_comp_interleavingMap
statement:
private theorem translateStructure_comp_interleavingMap
    {P Q : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ} (f : P ⟶ (shift ε).obj Q)
    (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hbc : b + (ε : ℝ) = c) (hac : a + (ε : ℝ) = c) :
    translateStructure P a b hab ≫ translateInterleavingMap f b c hbc =
      translateInterleavingMap f a c hac
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, translateInterleavingMap_app]
  let e : t + a ⟶ t + b := homOfLE (add_le_add_right hab t)
  have hn := f.naturality e
  change P.map e ≫ f.app (t + b) =
    f.app (t + a) ≫ Q.map ((translation ε).toFunctor.map e) at hn
  change P.map e ≫ (f.app (t + b) ≫ Q.map _) = f.app (t + a) ≫ Q.map _
  erw [← Category.assoc, hn, Category.assoc, ← Q.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.interpolationDelta_eq_nndist
statement:
private theorem interpolationDelta_eq_nndist (s r : InterpolationTime ε)
    (hsr : s.1 ≤ r.1) : interpolationDelta s r hsr = nndist s.1 r.1
proof:
:= by
  apply NNReal.coe_injective
  change r.1 - s.1 = dist s.1 r.1
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hsr)]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.interpolationTarget_forward_backward_comp
statement:
private theorem interpolationTarget_forward_backward_comp
    (s r : InterpolationTime ε) (hsr : s.1 ≤ r.1) :
    interpolationTargetForward (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr ≫
        (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
          (interpolationTargetBackward (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr) ≫
        (RealShift.compIso (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) (interpolationTarget s)).hom =
      RealShift.transition (interpolationDelta s r hsr + interpolationDelta s r hsr)
        (interpolationTarget s)
proof:
:= by
  unfold interpolationTargetForward interpolationTargetBackward
  dsimp only [interpolationTarget]
  erw [shift_pairMap, shift_map_zero, shift_map_zero]
  change pairMap (translateToShiftStructure M (-s.1) (-r.1)
      (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _) 0 0
      (translateToShiftStructure N (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (r.1 - (ε : ℝ))
        (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _) ≫
    pairMap ((shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
      (translateToShiftStructure M (-r.1) (-s.1) (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _)) 0 0
      ((shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
        (translateToShiftStructure N (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (s.1 - (ε : ℝ))
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _)) ≫
    (RealShift.compIso (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
      (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
      (pairModule (translate (-s.1) M) (translate (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N))).hom =
      RealShift.transition (interpolationDelta s r hsr + interpolationDelta s r hsr)
        (pairModule (translate (-s.1) M) (translate (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N))
  erw [compIso_pairModule_hom]
  let d := interpolationDelta s r hsr
  let f := translateToShiftStructure M (-s.1) (-r.1) d (by
    rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith)
  let j := translateToShiftStructure N (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) d (by
    rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith)
  let fb := (shift d).map (translateToShiftStructure M (-r.1) (-s.1) d (by
    rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith))
  let jb := (shift d).map (translateToShiftStructure N (r.1 - (ε : ℝ))
    (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) d (by
      rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith))
  let cm := (RealShift.compIso d d (translate (-s.1) M)).hom
  let cn := (RealShift.compIso d d (translate (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N)).hom
  change pairMap f 0 0 j ≫ pairMap fb 0 0 jb ≫ pairMap cm 0 0 cn =
    RealShift.transition (d + d) (pairModule (translate (-s.1) M)
      (translate (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N))
  have hfirst := pairMap_diag_comp
    (f := f) (j := j) (f' := fb)
    (g' := 0) (h' := 0)
    (j' := jb)
  have hsecond := pairMap_diag_comp
    (f := f ≫ fb) (j := j ≫ jb) (f' := cm)
    (g' := 0) (h' := 0)
    (j' := cn)
  have hmatrix :
      pairMap f 0 0 j ≫ pairMap fb 0 0 jb ≫ pairMap cm 0 0 cn =
        pairMap (RealShift.transition (d + d) (translate (-s.1) M)) 0 0
          (RealShift.transition (d + d) (translate (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N)) := by
    calc
      _ = (pairMap f 0 0 j ≫ pairMap fb 0 0 jb) ≫ pairMap cm 0 0 cn :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (pairMap (f ≫ fb) 0 0 (j ≫ jb)) ≫ pairMap cm 0 0 cn := by
        calc
          _ = (pairMap (f ≫ fb) (j ≫ (0 : _)) (f ≫ (0 : _)) (j ≫ jb)) ≫
              pairMap cm 0 0 cn := congrArg (fun x => x ≫ pairMap cm 0 0 cn) hfirst
          _ = (pairMap (f ≫ fb) 0 0 (j ≫ jb)) ≫ pairMap cm 0 0 cn := by
            simp only [comp_zero]
      _ = pairMap ((f ≫ fb) ≫ cm) 0 0 ((j ≫ jb) ≫ cn) := by
        rw [hsecond]
        simp only [comp_zero]
      _ = pairMap (RealShift.transition (d + d) (translate (-s.1) M)) 0 0
          (RealShift.transition (d + d) (translate (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N)) := by
        apply pairMap_ext
        · calc
            _ = translateToShiftStructure M (-s.1) (-s.1) (d + d) (by
              simp only [NNReal.coe_add]
              linarith [d.coe_nonneg]) :=
              translateToShiftStructure_comp_compIso M (-s.1) (-r.1) (-s.1) d
                (by rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith)
                (by rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith)
                (by simp only [NNReal.coe_add]; linarith [d.coe_nonneg])
            _ = RealShift.transition (d + d) (translate (-s.1) M) :=
              translateToShiftStructure_self_transition M (-s.1) _ (by
                simp only [NNReal.coe_add]
                linarith [d.coe_nonneg])
        · simp
        · simp
        · calc
            _ = translateToShiftStructure N (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (s.1 - (ε : ℝ))
                (d + d) (by
                  simp only [NNReal.coe_add]
                  linarith [d.coe_nonneg]) :=
              translateToShiftStructure_comp_compIso N (s.1 - (ε : ℝ))
                (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) d
                (by rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith)
                (by rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith)
                (by simp only [NNReal.coe_add]; linarith [d.coe_nonneg])
            _ = RealShift.transition (d + d) (translate (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N) :=
              translateToShiftStructure_self_transition N (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) _
                (by simp only [NNReal.coe_add]; linarith [d.coe_nonneg])
