  have hdiag := pairMap_diag_transition (translate (-s.1) M)
    (translate (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N) (d + d)
  exact hmatrix.trans hdiag

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.interpolationTarget_backward_forward_comp
statement:
private theorem interpolationTarget_backward_forward_comp
    (s r : InterpolationTime ε) (hsr : s.1 ≤ r.1) :
    interpolationTargetBackward (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr ≫
        (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
          (interpolationTargetForward (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr) ≫
        (RealShift.compIso (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) (interpolationTarget r)).hom =
      RealShift.transition (interpolationDelta s r hsr + interpolationDelta s r hsr)
        (interpolationTarget r)
proof:
:= by
  unfold interpolationTargetBackward interpolationTargetForward
  dsimp only [interpolationTarget]
  erw [shift_pairMap, shift_map_zero, shift_map_zero]
  change pairMap (translateToShiftStructure M (-r.1) (-s.1)
      (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _) 0 0
      (translateToShiftStructure N (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (s.1 - (ε : ℝ))
        (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _) ≫
    pairMap ((shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
      (translateToShiftStructure M (-s.1) (-r.1) (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _)) 0 0
      ((shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
        (translateToShiftStructure N (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (r.1 - (ε : ℝ))
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _)) ≫
    (RealShift.compIso (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
      (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
      (pairModule (translate (-r.1) M) (translate (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N))).hom =
      RealShift.transition (interpolationDelta s r hsr + interpolationDelta s r hsr)
        (pairModule (translate (-r.1) M) (translate (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N))
  erw [compIso_pairModule_hom]
  let d := interpolationDelta s r hsr
  let f := translateToShiftStructure M (-r.1) (-s.1) d (by
    rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith)
  let j := translateToShiftStructure N (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) d (by
    rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith)
  let fb := (shift d).map (translateToShiftStructure M (-s.1) (-r.1) d (by
    rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith))
  let jb := (shift d).map (translateToShiftStructure N (s.1 - (ε : ℝ))
    (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) d (by
      rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith))
  let cm := (RealShift.compIso d d (translate (-r.1) M)).hom
  let cn := (RealShift.compIso d d (translate (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N)).hom
  change pairMap f 0 0 j ≫ pairMap fb 0 0 jb ≫ pairMap cm 0 0 cn =
    RealShift.transition (d + d) (pairModule (translate (-r.1) M)
      (translate (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N))
  have hfirst := pairMap_diag_comp (f := f) (j := j) (f' := fb)
    (g' := 0) (h' := 0) (j' := jb)
  have hsecond := pairMap_diag_comp (f := f ≫ fb) (j := j ≫ jb) (f' := cm)
    (g' := 0) (h' := 0) (j' := cn)
  have hmatrix :
      pairMap f 0 0 j ≫ pairMap fb 0 0 jb ≫ pairMap cm 0 0 cn =
        pairMap (RealShift.transition (d + d) (translate (-r.1) M)) 0 0
          (RealShift.transition (d + d) (translate (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N)) := by
    calc
      _ = (pairMap f 0 0 j ≫ pairMap fb 0 0 jb) ≫ pairMap cm 0 0 cn :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (pairMap (f ≫ fb) 0 0 (j ≫ jb)) ≫ pairMap cm 0 0 cn := by
        calc
          _ = (pairMap (f ≫ fb) (j ≫ (0 : _)) (f ≫ (0 : _)) (j ≫ jb)) ≫
              pairMap cm 0 0 cn := congrArg (fun x => x ≫ pairMap cm 0 0 cn) hfirst
          _ = (pairMap (f ≫ fb) 0 0 (j ≫ jb)) ≫ pairMap cm 0 0 cn := by
            simp only [comp_zero]
      _ = pairMap ((f ≫ fb) ≫ cm) 0 0 ((j ≫ jb) ≫ cn) := by
        rw [hsecond]
        simp only [comp_zero]
      _ = pairMap (RealShift.transition (d + d) (translate (-r.1) M)) 0 0
          (RealShift.transition (d + d) (translate (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N)) := by
        apply pairMap_ext
        · calc
            _ = translateToShiftStructure M (-r.1) (-r.1) (d + d) (by
                simp only [NNReal.coe_add]
                linarith [d.coe_nonneg]) :=
              translateToShiftStructure_comp_compIso M (-r.1) (-s.1) (-r.1) d
                (by rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith)
                (by rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith)
                (by simp only [NNReal.coe_add]; linarith [d.coe_nonneg])
            _ = RealShift.transition (d + d) (translate (-r.1) M) :=
              translateToShiftStructure_self_transition M (-r.1) _ (by
                simp only [NNReal.coe_add]
                linarith [d.coe_nonneg])
        · simp
        · simp
        · calc
            _ = translateToShiftStructure N (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (r.1 - (ε : ℝ))
                (d + d) (by
                  simp only [NNReal.coe_add]
                  linarith [d.coe_nonneg]) :=
              translateToShiftStructure_comp_compIso N (r.1 - (ε : ℝ))
                (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) d
                (by rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith)
                (by rw [show (d : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl]; linarith)
                (by simp only [NNReal.coe_add]; linarith [d.coe_nonneg])
            _ = RealShift.transition (d + d) (translate (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N) :=
              translateToShiftStructure_self_transition N (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) _ (by
                simp only [NNReal.coe_add]
                linarith [d.coe_nonneg])
  have hdiag := pairMap_diag_transition (translate (-r.1) M)
    (translate (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) N) (d + d)
  exact hmatrix.trans hdiag

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.interpolationRelation_naturality
statement:
private theorem interpolationRelation_naturality
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (s r : InterpolationTime ε)
    (hsr : s.1 ≤ r.1) :
    interpolationSourceForward (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr ≫
        (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map (interpolationRelation i r) =
      interpolationRelation i s ≫ interpolationTargetForward
        (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr
proof:
:= by
  unfold interpolationSourceForward interpolationTargetForward interpolationRelation
  dsimp only [interpolationSource, interpolationTarget]
  erw [shift_pairMap]
  erw [pairMap_diag_comp]
  erw [pairMap_comp_diag]
  apply pairMap_ext
  · exact translateStructure_shift_naturality M
      (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) (-s.1) (-r.1)
      (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
      (by linarith [s.2.2])
      (by linarith [r.2.2])
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith [hsr])
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith)

  · have hψ := translateInterleavingMap_shift_naturality i.ψ
      (-(ε : ℝ) - s.1) (-(ε : ℝ) - r.1) (-s.1) (-r.1)
      (interpolationDelta s r hsr) (by ring) (by ring)
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith)
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith)
    calc
      translateToShiftStructure N (-ε - s.1) (-ε - r.1)
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ ≫
          (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
            (-translateInterleavingMap i.ψ (-ε - r.1) (-r.1) _) =
        translateToShiftStructure N (-ε - s.1) (-ε - r.1)
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ ≫
          (-((shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
            (translateInterleavingMap i.ψ (-ε - r.1) (-r.1) _))) := by
              rw [shift_map_neg]
      _ = -(translateToShiftStructure N (-ε - s.1) (-ε - r.1)
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ ≫
          (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
            (translateInterleavingMap i.ψ (-ε - r.1) (-r.1) _)) := by
              rw [Preadditive.comp_neg]
      _ = -((translateInterleavingMap i.ψ (-ε - s.1) (-s.1) _ ≫
          translateToShiftStructure M (-s.1) (-r.1)
            (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _)) := by rw [hψ.symm]
      _ = (-translateInterleavingMap i.ψ (-ε - s.1) (-s.1) _) ≫
          translateToShiftStructure M (-s.1) (-r.1)
            (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ := by rw [Preadditive.neg_comp]
  · have hφ := translateInterleavingMap_shift_naturality i.φ
      (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
      (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
      (by ring) (by ring)
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith [hsr])
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith [hsr])
    calc
      translateToShiftStructure M (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ ≫
          (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
            (-translateInterleavingMap i.φ (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
              (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) _) =
        translateToShiftStructure M (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
          (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ ≫
          (-((shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
            (translateInterleavingMap i.φ (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
              (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) _))) := by rw [shift_map_neg]
      _ = -(translateToShiftStructure M (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
          (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ ≫
          (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
            (translateInterleavingMap i.φ (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
              (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) _)) := by rw [Preadditive.comp_neg]
      _ = -((translateInterleavingMap i.φ (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
          (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) _ ≫
          translateToShiftStructure N (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (r.1 - (ε : ℝ))
            (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _)) := by rw [hφ.symm]
      _ = (-translateInterleavingMap i.φ (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
          (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) _) ≫
          translateToShiftStructure N (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (r.1 - (ε : ℝ))
            (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ := by rw [Preadditive.neg_comp]
  · exact translateStructure_shift_naturality N
      (-(ε : ℝ) - s.1) (-(ε : ℝ) - r.1)
      (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
      (by linarith [s.2.1])
      (by linarith [r.2.1])
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith)
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.interpolationRelation_reverse_naturality
statement:
private theorem interpolationRelation_reverse_naturality
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (s r : InterpolationTime ε)
    (hsr : s.1 ≤ r.1) :
    interpolationSourceBackward (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr ≫
        (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map (interpolationRelation i s) =
      interpolationRelation i r ≫ interpolationTargetBackward
        (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr
proof:
:= by
  unfold interpolationSourceBackward interpolationTargetBackward interpolationRelation
  dsimp only [interpolationSource, interpolationTarget]
  erw [shift_pairMap]
  erw [pairMap_diag_comp]
  erw [pairMap_comp_diag]
  apply pairMap_ext
  · exact translateStructure_shift_naturality M
      (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) (-r.1) (-s.1)
      (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
      (by linarith [r.2.2])
      (by linarith [s.2.2])
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith)
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith [hsr])
  · have hψ := translateInterleavingMap_shift_naturality i.ψ
      (-(ε : ℝ) - r.1) (-(ε : ℝ) - s.1) (-r.1) (-s.1)
      (interpolationDelta s r hsr) (by ring) (by ring)
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith [hsr])
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith [hsr])
    calc
      translateToShiftStructure N (-ε - r.1) (-ε - s.1)
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ ≫
          (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
            (-translateInterleavingMap i.ψ (-ε - s.1) (-s.1) _) =
        translateToShiftStructure N (-ε - r.1) (-ε - s.1)
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ ≫
          (-((shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
            (translateInterleavingMap i.ψ (-ε - s.1) (-s.1) _))) := by
              rw [shift_map_neg]
      _ = -(translateToShiftStructure N (-ε - r.1) (-ε - s.1)
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ ≫
          (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
            (translateInterleavingMap i.ψ (-ε - s.1) (-s.1) _)) := by
              rw [Preadditive.comp_neg]
      _ = -((translateInterleavingMap i.ψ (-ε - r.1) (-r.1) _ ≫
          translateToShiftStructure M (-r.1) (-s.1)
            (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _)) := by rw [hψ.symm]
      _ = (-translateInterleavingMap i.ψ (-ε - r.1) (-r.1) _) ≫
          translateToShiftStructure M (-r.1) (-s.1)
            (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ := by rw [Preadditive.neg_comp]
  · have hφ := translateInterleavingMap_shift_naturality i.φ
      (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
      (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
      (by ring) (by ring)
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith [hsr])
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith)
    calc
      translateToShiftStructure M (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ ≫
          (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
            (-translateInterleavingMap i.φ (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
              (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) _) =
        translateToShiftStructure M (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
          (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ ≫
          (-((shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
            (translateInterleavingMap i.φ (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
              (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) _))) := by rw [shift_map_neg]
      _ = -(translateToShiftStructure M (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
          (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ ≫
          (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
            (translateInterleavingMap i.φ (s.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
              (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) _)) := by rw [Preadditive.comp_neg]
      _ = -((translateInterleavingMap i.φ (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
          (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) _ ≫
          translateToShiftStructure N (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (s.1 - (ε : ℝ))
            (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _)) := by rw [hφ.symm]
      _ = (-translateInterleavingMap i.φ (r.1 - 2 * (ε : ℝ))
          (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) _) ≫
          translateToShiftStructure N (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (s.1 - (ε : ℝ))
            (interpolationDelta s r hsr) _ := by rw [Preadditive.neg_comp]
  · exact translateStructure_shift_naturality N
      (-(ε : ℝ) - r.1) (-(ε : ℝ) - s.1)
      (r.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
      (by linarith [r.2.1])
      (by linarith [s.2.1])
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith [hsr])
      (by rw [show (interpolationDelta s r hsr : ℝ) = r.1 - s.1 by rfl];
          linarith)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.startN_offsets
statement:
private theorem startN_offsets :
    (-(ε : ℝ) - (startTime ε).1) = (startTime ε).1 - (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [startTime]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.startNTransport_comp_psi
statement:
private theorem startNTransport_comp_psi (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    startNTransport (ε := ε) (N := N) ≫
      translateInterleavingMap i.ψ (-(ε : ℝ) - (startTime ε).1)
        (-(startTime ε).1) (by dsimp [startTime]; ring) =
    translateInterleavingMap i.ψ ((startTime ε).1 - (ε : ℝ))
      (-(startTime ε).1) (by dsimp [startTime]; ring)
proof:
:= by
  exact translateEqIso_inv_comp_interleavingMap i.ψ _ _ _
    (by dsimp [startTime]; ring) (by dsimp [startTime]; ring) (startN_offsets (ε := ε))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.startNTransport_comp_structure
statement:
private theorem startNTransport_comp_structure :
    startNTransport (ε := ε) (N := N) ≫
      translateStructure N (-(ε : ℝ) - (startTime ε).1)
        ((startTime ε).1 - (ε : ℝ)) (by rw [startN_offsets (ε := ε)]) =
    𝟙 (translate ((startTime ε).1 - (ε : ℝ)) N)
proof:
:= by
  exact translateEqIso_inv_comp_translateStructure N _ _
    (startN_offsets (ε := ε)) (by rw [startN_offsets (ε := ε)])

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.interpolationRelation_inr
statement:
private theorem interpolationRelation_inr (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)
    (s : InterpolationTime ε) (hs : s.1 = 0) :
    (translateEqIso (show -(ε : ℝ) - s.1 = s.1 - (ε : ℝ) by rw [hs]; ring) N).inv ≫
      pairInr ≫ interpolationRelation i s =
    -(translateInterleavingMap i.ψ (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)) (-s.1)
        (by rw [hs]; ring) ≫ pairInl) + pairInr
proof:
:= by
  let ns := -(ε : ℝ) - s.1
  let nt := s.1 - (ε : ℝ)
  let mt := -s.1
  have hnsnt : ns = nt := by dsimp [ns, nt]; rw [hs]; ring
  have hψ := translateEqIso_inv_comp_interleavingMap i.ψ ns nt mt
    (by dsimp [ns, mt]; ring) (by dsimp [nt, mt]; rw [hs]; ring) hnsnt
  have hN := translateEqIso_inv_comp_translateStructure N ns nt hnsnt
    (le_of_eq hnsnt)
  have hψ' : (translateEqIso hnsnt N).inv ≫
      translateInterleavingMap i.ψ ns mt (by dsimp [ns, mt]; ring) =
      translateInterleavingMap i.ψ nt mt (by dsimp [nt, mt]; rw [hs]; ring) := by
    simpa [ns, nt, mt] using hψ
  have hN' : (translateEqIso hnsnt N).inv ≫
      translateStructure N ns nt (le_of_eq hnsnt) = 𝟙 (translate nt N) := by
    simpa [ns, nt] using hN
  dsimp only [interpolationRelation]
  rw [pairInr_comp_pairMap]
  dsimp [ns, nt, mt] at hψ hN ⊢
  rw [Preadditive.comp_add]
  rw [← Category.assoc (translateEqIso hnsnt N).inv
    (-translateInterleavingMap i.ψ ns mt (by dsimp [ns, mt]; ring)) pairInl]
  rw [← Category.assoc (translateEqIso hnsnt N).inv
    (translateStructure N ns nt (le_of_eq hnsnt)) pairInr]
  rw [Preadditive.comp_neg, hψ', hN']
  simp [nt, mt, Preadditive.comp_neg, Category.id_comp, Preadditive.neg_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.endRelation_inl
statement:
private theorem endRelation_inl (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    (translateEqIso (show (ε : ℝ) - 2 * (ε : ℝ) = -(ε : ℝ) by ring) M).inv ≫
      pairInl ≫ interpolationRelation i (endTime ε) =
    pairInl + -(endPhi i ≫ pairInr)
proof:
:= by
  let ms := (ε : ℝ) - 2 * (ε : ℝ)
  let mt := -(ε : ℝ)
  let nt := (ε : ℝ) - (ε : ℝ)
  have hms : ms = mt := by dsimp [ms, mt]; ring
  have hφ := translateEqIso_inv_comp_interleavingMap i.φ ms mt nt
    (by dsimp [ms, nt]; ring) (by dsimp [mt, nt]; ring) hms
  have hM := translateEqIso_inv_comp_translateStructure M ms mt hms
    (le_of_eq hms)
  have hφ' : (translateEqIso hms M).inv ≫
      translateInterleavingMap i.φ ms nt (by dsimp [ms, nt]; ring) =
        translateInterleavingMap i.φ mt nt (by dsimp [mt, nt]; ring) := by
    simpa [ms, mt, nt] using hφ
  have hM' : (translateEqIso hms M).inv ≫
      translateStructure M ms mt (le_of_eq hms) = 𝟙 (translate mt M) := by
    simpa [ms, mt] using hM
  dsimp only [interpolationRelation]
  rw [pairInl_comp_pairMap]
  dsimp [ms, mt, nt] at hφ hM ⊢
  rw [Preadditive.comp_add]
  rw [← Category.assoc (translateEqIso hms M).inv
    (translateStructure M ms mt (le_of_eq hms)) pairInl]
  rw [← Category.assoc (translateEqIso hms M).inv
    (-translateInterleavingMap i.φ ms nt (by dsimp [ms, nt]; ring)) pairInr]
  rw [Preadditive.comp_neg, hM', hφ']
  simp [endPhi, mt, nt, Preadditive.comp_neg, Category.id_comp, Preadditive.neg_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.startCompare_kills
statement:
private theorem startCompare_kills (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    interpolationRelation i (startTime ε) ≫ startCompare i = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold startCompare
  erw [← Category.assoc]
  suffices interpolationRelation i (startTime ε) ≫
      pairDescMap (𝟙 (translate (-(startTime ε).1) M))
        (translateInterleavingMap i.ψ ((startTime ε).1 - (ε : ℝ)) (-(startTime ε).1)
          (by change (0 - (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) = -0; ring)) = 0 by
    rw [this, zero_comp]
  unfold interpolationRelation
  dsimp only [startTime]
  apply pairMap_comp_pairDescMap_zero
  · rw [Preadditive.neg_comp, translateInterleavingMap_comp]
  · rw [neg_neg]
    exact translateStructure_comp_interleavingMap i.ψ _ _ _ _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.startInclude_comp_startDesc
statement:
private theorem startInclude_comp_startDesc (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    startInclude i ≫ startDesc i = 𝟙 M
proof:
:= by
  unfold startInclude startDesc interpolatingModule
  dsimp only [startTime, interpolationTarget]
  simp only [Category.assoc, startProjection, cokernel.π_desc, startCompare]
  rw [← Category.assoc pairInl]
  rw [pairInl_pairDescMap]
  simp [translateZeroMap, Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.startCompare_comp_startInclude
statement:
private theorem startCompare_comp_startInclude (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    startCompare i ≫ startInclude i = startProjection i
proof:
:= by
  apply pairModule_hom_ext
  · unfold startCompare startInclude
    rw [pairInl_pairDescMap_comp_comp]
    simp [translateZeroMap, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Category.assoc]
  · let ψ₀ := translateInterleavingMap i.ψ ((startTime ε).1 - (ε : ℝ))
      (-(startTime ε).1) (by dsimp [startTime]; ring)
    have hrel := interpolationRelation_inr i (startTime ε)
      (by dsimp [startTime])
    have hzero : (-(ψ₀ ≫ pairInl) + pairInr) ≫
        cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε)) = 0 := by
      calc
        _ = (startNTransport (ε := ε) (N := N) ≫ pairInr ≫
            interpolationRelation i (startTime ε)) ≫
              cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε)) := by
                exact congrArg (fun f => f ≫
                  cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε))) hrel.symm
        _ = startNTransport (ε := ε) (N := N) ≫ pairInr ≫
            (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε) ≫
              cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε))) := by
                simp [Category.assoc]
        _ = 0 := by simp [cokernel.condition]
    have hcol : (ψ₀ ≫ pairInl) ≫
        cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε)) =
      pairInr ≫ cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε)) := by
      have hz : -((ψ₀ ≫ pairInl) ≫
          cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε))) +
          (pairInr ≫ cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε))) = 0 := by
        simpa [Category.assoc] using hzero
      calc
        (ψ₀ ≫ pairInl) ≫ cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε)) =
            (ψ₀ ≫ pairInl) ≫ cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε)) + 0 := by simp
        _ = (ψ₀ ≫ pairInl) ≫ cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε)) +
            (-(ψ₀ ≫ pairInl) ≫ cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε)) +
              pairInr ≫ cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε))) := by rw [hz]
        _ = pairInr ≫ cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε)) := by abel
    have hcol' : (ψ₀ ≫ pairInl) ≫ startProjection i =
        pairInr ≫ startProjection i := by
      simpa [startProjection, interpolatingModule] using hcol
    calc
      pairInr ≫ startCompare i ≫ startInclude i =
          (ψ₀ ≫ pairInl) ≫ startProjection i := by
            unfold startCompare startInclude
            rw [pairInr_pairDescMap_comp_comp]
            dsimp only [startTime]
            simp [startProjection, startTime, ψ₀, translateZeroMap,
              Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Category.assoc]
            exact Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = pairInr ≫ startProjection i := hcol'

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.startDesc_comp_startInclude
statement:
private theorem startDesc_comp_startInclude (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    startDesc i ≫ startInclude i = 𝟙 (interpolatingModule i (startTime ε))
proof:
:= by
  have h_epi : Epi (startProjection i) := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (startTime ε)))
    infer_instance
  letI := h_epi
  apply (cancel_epi (startProjection i)).1
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [show startProjection i ≫ startDesc i = startCompare i by
    simp [startProjection, startDesc, interpolatingModule]]
  rw [startCompare_comp_startInclude]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.endCompare_kills
statement:
private theorem endCompare_kills (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    interpolationRelation i (endTime ε) ≫ endCompare i = 0
proof:
:= by
  let ms := (ε : ℝ) - 2 * (ε : ℝ)
  let mt := -(ε : ℝ)
  let n := -(ε : ℝ) - (ε : ℝ)
  let c := (ε : ℝ) - (ε : ℝ)
  let ψ₀ := translateInterleavingMap i.ψ n mt (by dsimp [n, mt]; ring)
  let φ₀ := translateInterleavingMap i.φ ms c (by dsimp [ms, c]; ring)
  have hMcomp : translateStructure M ms mt (by dsimp [ms, mt]; linarith [ε.coe_nonneg])
      ≫ endPhi i = φ₀ := by
    exact translateStructure_comp_interleavingMap i.φ ms mt c
      (by dsimp [ms, mt]; linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]) (by dsimp [mt, c]; ring)
      (by dsimp [ms, c]; linarith [ε.coe_nonneg])
  have hNcomp : ψ₀ ≫ endPhi i =
      translateStructure N n c (by dsimp [n, c]; linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]) := by
    exact translateInterleavingMap_ψφ_comp i n mt c
      (by dsimp [n, mt]; ring) (by dsimp [mt, c]; ring)
      (by dsimp [n, c]; linarith [ε.coe_nonneg])
  have hfirst : translateStructure M ms mt (by dsimp [ms, mt]; linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]) ≫
      (endPhi i ≫ endNZero (N := N)) =
      -((-φ₀) ≫ endNZero (N := N)) := by
    rw [← Category.assoc, hMcomp]
    simp [Preadditive.neg_comp]
  have hsecond : -ψ₀ ≫ (endPhi i ≫ endNZero (N := N)) =
      -(translateStructure N n c (by dsimp [n, c]; linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]) ≫
        endNZero (N := N)) := by
    apply neg_injective
    rw [← Category.assoc, hNcomp]
  unfold endCompare interpolationRelation
  dsimp only [endTime]
  apply pairMap_comp_pairDescMap_zero_general
  · simpa [ms, mt, c, φ₀, Preadditive.neg_comp, Category.assoc] using hfirst
  · simpa [n, c, ψ₀, φ₀, Preadditive.neg_comp, Category.assoc] using hsecond

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.endInclude_comp_endDesc
statement:
private theorem endInclude_comp_endDesc (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    endInclude i ≫ endDesc i = 𝟙 N
proof:
:= by
  unfold endInclude endDesc interpolatingModule
  dsimp only [endTime, interpolationTarget]
  simp only [Category.assoc, endProjection, cokernel.π_desc, endCompare]
  rw [pairInr_pairDescMap]
  simp [endNZero, translateZeroMap, Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.endCompare_comp_endInclude
statement:
private theorem endCompare_comp_endInclude (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    endCompare i ≫ endInclude i = endProjection i
proof:
:= by
  apply pairModule_hom_ext
  · let τ := (translateEqIso
      (show (ε : ℝ) - 2 * (ε : ℝ) = -(ε : ℝ) by ring) M).inv
    have hrel := endRelation_inl i
    have hzero : (pairInl + -(endPhi i ≫ pairInr)) ≫
        cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε)) = 0 := by
      calc
        _ = (τ ≫ pairInl ≫ interpolationRelation i (endTime ε)) ≫
            cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε)) := by
              exact congrArg (fun f => f ≫
                cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε))) hrel.symm
        _ = τ ≫ pairInl ≫
            (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε) ≫
              cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε))) := by
                simp [Category.assoc]
        _ = 0 := by simp [cokernel.condition]
    have hcol : pairInl ≫ cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε)) =
        (endPhi i ≫ pairInr) ≫ cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε)) := by
      have hz : (pairInl ≫ cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε))) +
          -((endPhi i ≫ pairInr) ≫
            cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε))) = 0 := by
        simpa [Preadditive.add_comp, Preadditive.neg_comp, Category.assoc] using hzero
      calc
        pairInl ≫ cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε)) =
            (pairInl ≫ cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε)) +
              -(endPhi i ≫ pairInr) ≫
                cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε))) +
              (endPhi i ≫ pairInr) ≫
                cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε)) := by
                  simp [Category.assoc, Preadditive.comp_neg]
        _ = (endPhi i ≫ pairInr) ≫
            cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε)) := by
              rw [hz]
              simp
    calc
      pairInl ≫ endCompare i ≫ endInclude i =
          (endPhi i ≫ pairInr) ≫ endProjection i := by
            unfold endCompare endInclude
            rw [← Category.assoc pairInl]
            rw [pairInl_pairDescMap]
            simp [endProjection, endNZero, translateZeroMap,
              Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Category.assoc]
            exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = pairInl ≫ endProjection i := by
        simpa [endProjection, interpolatingModule, Category.assoc] using hcol.symm
  · unfold endCompare endInclude
    rw [← Category.assoc pairInr]
    rw [pairInr_pairDescMap]
    simp [endProjection, endNZero, translateZeroMap,
      Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc, Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.endDesc_comp_endInclude
statement:
private theorem endDesc_comp_endInclude (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    endDesc i ≫ endInclude i = 𝟙 (interpolatingModule i (endTime ε))
proof:
:= by
  have h_epi : Epi (endProjection i) := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π (interpolationRelation i (endTime ε)))
    infer_instance
  letI := h_epi
  apply (cancel_epi (endProjection i)).1
  rw [← Category.assoc]
  rw [show endProjection i ≫ endDesc i = endCompare i by
    simp [endProjection, endDesc, interpolatingModule]]
  rw [endCompare_comp_endInclude]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.translate_qTame
statement:
private theorem translate_qTame (P : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) (hP : P.QTame) (c : ℝ) :
    (translate c P).QTame
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have hlt : a + c < b + c := by linarith
  have h := hP (a + c) (b + c) hlt
  change FiniteDimensional k (LinearMap.range
    (structureMapLinear (reindex (translateOrder c) P) hab.le))
  rw [structureMapLinear_reindex]
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.pairModule_qTame
statement:
private theorem pairModule_qTame {P Q : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (hP : P.QTame) (hQ : Q.QTame) : (pairModule P Q).QTame
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  let f := structureMapLinear P hab.le
  let g := structureMapLinear Q hab.le
  have hf : FiniteDimensional k (LinearMap.range f) := hP a b hab
  have hg : FiniteDimensional k (LinearMap.range g) := hQ a b hab
  letI := hf
  letI := hg
  change FiniteDimensional k (LinearMap.range (f.prodMap g))
  rw [LinearMap.range_prodMap]
  have hp : FiniteDimensional k (↥(LinearMap.range f) × ↥(LinearMap.range g)) := by
    infer_instance
  letI := hp
  exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective
    (submoduleProdEquiv (LinearMap.range f) (LinearMap.range g)).toLinearMap
    (submoduleProdEquiv (LinearMap.range f) (LinearMap.range g)).injective

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.qTame_cokernel
statement:
private theorem qTame_cokernel {A B : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ} (f : A ⟶ B)
    (hB : B.QTame) : (cokernel f).QTame
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  let πa := (cokernel.π f).app a
  let πb := (cokernel.π f).app b
  let g := structureMapLinear B hab.le
  let L := structureMapLinear (cokernel f) hab.le
  have hπ : Function.Surjective πa.hom := by
    have h_epi : Epi (cokernel.π f) := by infer_instance
    exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp
      ((NatTrans.epi_iff_epi_app (cokernel.π f)).mp h_epi a)
  have hcomp : L.comp πa.hom = πb.hom.comp g := by
    have hn := (cokernel.π f).naturality (homOfLE hab.le)
    change B.map (homOfLE hab.le) ≫ (cokernel.π f).app b =
      (cokernel.π f).app a ≫ (cokernel f).map (homOfLE hab.le) at hn
    have hn' := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom hn
    change πb.hom.comp g = L.comp πa.hom at hn'
    exact hn'.symm
  have hrange : LinearMap.range L = LinearMap.range (πb.hom.comp g) := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hπ x
      refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
      change πb.hom (g z) = L x
      rw [← hz]
      exact (congrArg (fun q => q z) hcomp).symm
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨πa.hom x, ?_⟩
      change L (πa.hom x) = πb.hom (g x)
      exact congrArg (fun q => q x) hcomp
  have hg : FiniteDimensional k (LinearMap.range g) := hB a b hab
  letI := hg
  let gr : B.obj a →ₗ[k] LinearMap.range g :=
    g.codRestrict (LinearMap.range g) (fun x => ⟨x, rfl⟩)
  have hfactor : πb.hom.comp g =
      (πb.hom.comp (LinearMap.range g).subtype).comp gr := by
    ext x
    rfl
  rw [hrange, hfactor]
  exact finiteDimensional_range_of_factorization _ _ _ rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.interpolatingModule_qTame
statement:
theorem interpolatingModule_qTame (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)
    (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame) (s : InterpolationTime ε) :
    (interpolatingModule i s).QTame
proof:
:= by
  apply qTame_cokernel (interpolationRelation i s)
  exact pairModule_qTame (translate_qTame M hM (-s.1))
    (translate_qTame N hN (s.1 - (ε : ℝ)))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.interpolatingMapOfLe_projection
statement:
private theorem interpolatingMapOfLe_projection
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (s r : InterpolationTime ε)
    (hsr : s.1 ≤ r.1) :
    interpolatingProjection i s ≫ interpolatingMapOfLe i s r hsr =
      interpolationTargetForward (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr ≫
        (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
          (interpolatingProjection i r)
proof:
:= by
  simp [interpolatingMapOfLe, interpolatingProjection, interpolatingModule, Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.interpolatingMapReverse_projection
statement:
private theorem interpolatingMapReverse_projection
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (s r : InterpolationTime ε)
    (hsr : s.1 ≤ r.1) :
    interpolatingProjection i r ≫ interpolatingMapReverse i s r hsr =
      interpolationTargetBackward (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr ≫
        (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
          (interpolatingProjection i s)
proof:
:= by
  simp [interpolatingMapReverse, interpolatingProjection, interpolatingModule, Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.interpolatingMapOfLe_reverse_comp
statement:
private theorem interpolatingMapOfLe_reverse_comp
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (s r : InterpolationTime ε)
    (hsr : s.1 ≤ r.1) :
    interpolatingMapOfLe i s r hsr ≫
        (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
          (interpolatingMapReverse i s r hsr) ≫
        (RealShift.compIso (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) (interpolatingModule i s)).hom =
      RealShift.transition (interpolationDelta s r hsr + interpolationDelta s r hsr)
        (interpolatingModule i s)
proof:
:= by
  let d := interpolationDelta s r hsr
  let ps := interpolatingProjection i s
  let pr := interpolatingProjection i r
  let tf := interpolationTargetForward (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr
  let tb := interpolationTargetBackward (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr
  let mf := interpolatingMapOfLe i s r hsr
  let mb := interpolatingMapReverse i s r hsr
  let sr := (shift d).map pr
  let sp := (shift d).map ps
  let sg := (shift d).map mb
  let tbf := (shift d).map tb
  let ssf := (shift d).map sp
  let cq := (RealShift.compIso d d (interpolatingModule i s)).hom
  let ct := (RealShift.compIso d d
    (interpolationTarget (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s)).hom
  let p2 := (shift (d + d)).map ps
  have h_epi : Epi ps := by
    dsimp [ps, interpolatingProjection, interpolatingModule]
    infer_instance
  letI := h_epi
  have hprojf : ps ≫ mf = tf ≫ sr :=
    interpolatingMapOfLe_projection i s r hsr
  have hprojb : pr ≫ mb = tb ≫ sp :=
    interpolatingMapReverse_projection i s r hsr
  have hmap : sr ≫ sg = (shift d).map (pr ≫ mb) := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  have hexpand : (shift d).map (tb ≫ sp) = tbf ≫ ssf := by
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
  have hcompIso := RealShift.compIso_naturality d d ps
  have htarget := interpolationTarget_forward_backward_comp
    (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr
  have htarget' : (tf ≫ tbf) ≫ ct =
      RealShift.transition (d + d) (interpolationTarget s) :=
    (Category.assoc tf tbf ct).trans htarget
  apply (cancel_epi ps).1
  change ps ≫ mf ≫ sg ≫ cq =
    ps ≫ RealShift.transition (d + d) (interpolatingModule i s)
  calc
    _ = ((ps ≫ mf) ≫ sg) ≫ cq := by
      exact (Category.assoc ps mf (sg ≫ cq)).symm.trans
        (Category.assoc (ps ≫ mf) sg cq).symm
    _ = ((tf ≫ sr) ≫ sg) ≫ cq :=
      congrArg (fun f => (f ≫ sg) ≫ cq) hprojf
    _ = (tf ≫ (sr ≫ sg)) ≫ cq :=
      congrArg (fun f => f ≫ cq) (Category.assoc tf sr sg)
    _ = (tf ≫ (shift d).map (pr ≫ mb)) ≫ cq :=
      congrArg (fun f => (tf ≫ f) ≫ cq) hmap
    _ = (tf ≫ (shift d).map (tb ≫ sp)) ≫ cq :=
      congrArg (fun f => (tf ≫ f) ≫ cq)
        (congrArg ((shift d).map) hprojb)
    _ = (tf ≫ (tbf ≫ ssf)) ≫ cq :=
      congrArg (fun f => (tf ≫ f) ≫ cq) hexpand
    _ = ((tf ≫ tbf) ≫ ssf) ≫ cq :=
      congrArg (fun f => f ≫ cq) (Category.assoc tf tbf ssf).symm
    _ = (tf ≫ tbf) ≫ (ssf ≫ cq) := Category.assoc (tf ≫ tbf) ssf cq
    _ = (tf ≫ tbf) ≫ (ct ≫ p2) :=
      congrArg (fun f => (tf ≫ tbf) ≫ f) hcompIso
    _ = ((tf ≫ tbf) ≫ ct) ≫ p2 :=
      (Category.assoc (tf ≫ tbf) ct p2).symm
    _ = RealShift.transition (d + d) (interpolationTarget s) ≫ p2 :=
      congrArg (fun f => f ≫ p2) htarget'
    _ = ps ≫ RealShift.transition (d + d) (interpolatingModule i s) :=
      (RealShift.transition_naturality (d + d) ps).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.interpolatingMapReverse_forward_comp
statement:
private theorem interpolatingMapReverse_forward_comp
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (s r : InterpolationTime ε)
    (hsr : s.1 ≤ r.1) :
    interpolatingMapReverse i s r hsr ≫
        (shift (interpolationDelta s r hsr)).map
          (interpolatingMapOfLe i s r hsr) ≫
        (RealShift.compIso (interpolationDelta s r hsr)
          (interpolationDelta s r hsr) (interpolatingModule i r)).hom =
      RealShift.transition (interpolationDelta s r hsr + interpolationDelta s r hsr)
        (interpolatingModule i r)
proof:
:= by
  let d := interpolationDelta s r hsr
  let ps := interpolatingProjection i s
  let pr := interpolatingProjection i r
  let tf := interpolationTargetForward (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr
  let tb := interpolationTargetBackward (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr
  let mf := interpolatingMapOfLe i s r hsr
  let mb := interpolatingMapReverse i s r hsr
  let sp := (shift d).map ps
  let sr := (shift d).map pr
  let sg := (shift d).map mf
  let tbf := (shift d).map tf
  let ssr := (shift d).map sr
  let cq := (RealShift.compIso d d (interpolatingModule i r)).hom
  let ct := (RealShift.compIso d d
    (interpolationTarget (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) r)).hom
  let p2 := (shift (d + d)).map pr
  have h_epi : Epi pr := by
    dsimp [pr, interpolatingProjection, interpolatingModule]
    infer_instance
  letI := h_epi
  have hprojf : ps ≫ mf = tf ≫ sr :=
    interpolatingMapOfLe_projection i s r hsr
  have hprojb : pr ≫ mb = tb ≫ sp :=
    interpolatingMapReverse_projection i s r hsr
  have hmap : sp ≫ sg = (shift d).map (ps ≫ mf) := by
    rw [← Functor.map_comp]
  have hexpand : (shift d).map (tf ≫ sr) = tbf ≫ ssr := by
    rw [Functor.map_comp]
  have hcompIso := RealShift.compIso_naturality d d pr
  have htarget := interpolationTarget_backward_forward_comp
    (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) s r hsr
  have htarget' : (tb ≫ tbf) ≫ ct =
      RealShift.transition (d + d) (interpolationTarget (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) r) :=
    (Category.assoc tb tbf ct).trans htarget
  apply (cancel_epi pr).1
  change pr ≫ mb ≫ sg ≫ cq =
    pr ≫ RealShift.transition (d + d) (interpolatingModule i r)
  calc
    _ = ((pr ≫ mb) ≫ sg) ≫ cq := by
      exact (Category.assoc pr mb (sg ≫ cq)).symm.trans
        (Category.assoc (pr ≫ mb) sg cq).symm
    _ = ((tb ≫ sp) ≫ sg) ≫ cq :=
      congrArg (fun f => (f ≫ sg) ≫ cq) hprojb
    _ = (tb ≫ (sp ≫ sg)) ≫ cq :=
      congrArg (fun f => f ≫ cq) (Category.assoc tb sp sg)
    _ = (tb ≫ (shift d).map (ps ≫ mf)) ≫ cq :=
      congrArg (fun f => (tb ≫ f) ≫ cq) hmap
    _ = (tb ≫ (shift d).map (tf ≫ sr)) ≫ cq :=
      congrArg (fun f => (tb ≫ f) ≫ cq)
        (congrArg ((shift d).map) hprojf)
    _ = (tb ≫ (tbf ≫ ssr)) ≫ cq :=
      congrArg (fun f => (tb ≫ f) ≫ cq) hexpand
    _ = ((tb ≫ tbf) ≫ ssr) ≫ cq :=
      congrArg (fun f => f ≫ cq) (Category.assoc tb tbf ssr).symm
    _ = (tb ≫ tbf) ≫ (ssr ≫ cq) := Category.assoc (tb ≫ tbf) ssr cq
    _ = (tb ≫ tbf) ≫ (ct ≫ p2) :=
      congrArg (fun f => (tb ≫ tbf) ≫ f) hcompIso
    _ = ((tb ≫ tbf) ≫ ct) ≫ p2 :=
      (Category.assoc (tb ≫ tbf) ct p2).symm
    _ = RealShift.transition (d + d)
          (interpolationTarget (k := k) (M := M) (N := N) r) ≫ p2 :=
      congrArg (fun f => f ≫ p2) htarget'
    _ = pr ≫ RealShift.transition (d + d) (interpolatingModule i r) :=
      (RealShift.transition_naturality (d + d) pr).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.interpolatingModule_qTame_interpolation
statement:
theorem interpolatingModule_qTame_interpolation
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame) :
    Nonempty (interpolatingModule i (startTime ε) ≅ M) ∧
      Nonempty (interpolatingModule i (endTime ε) ≅ N) ∧
      (∀ s, (interpolatingModule i s).QTame) ∧
      (∀ s r, Nonempty (RealInterleaving (nndist s.1 r.1)
        (interpolatingModule i s) (interpolatingModule i r)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨interpolatingModuleStartIso i⟩, ⟨interpolatingModuleEndIso i⟩,
    interpolatingModule_qTame i hM hN,
    fun s r => ⟨interpolatingModuleInterleaving i s r⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.exists_qTame_interpolating_family
statement:
theorem exists_qTame_interpolating_family
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame) :
    ∃ F : InterpolationTime ε → PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ,
      Nonempty (F (startTime ε) ≅ M) ∧ Nonempty (F (endTime ε) ≅ N) ∧
      (∀ s, (F s).QTame) ∧
      (∀ s r, Nonempty (RealInterleaving (nndist s.1 r.1) (F s) (F r)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨interpolatingModule i, interpolatingModule_qTame_interpolation i hM hN⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.not_mem_upper
statement: theorem not_mem_upper {c : Cut α} {t : α} (ht : t ∈ c.lower) : t ∉ c.upper
proof:
:=
  fun hu => lt_irrefl t (c.lower_lt_upper ht hu)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.lower_of_le
statement:
theorem lower_of_le {c : Cut α} {s t : α} (hst : s ≤ t)
    (ht : t ∈ c.lower) : s ∈ c.lower
proof:
:= by
  rcases c.mem_lower_or_upper s with hs | hs
  · exact hs
  · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hst) (c.lower_lt_upper ht hs))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.upper_of_le
statement:
theorem upper_of_le {c : Cut α} {s t : α} (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hs : s ∈ c.upper) : t ∈ c.upper
proof:
:= by
  rcases c.mem_lower_or_upper t with ht | ht
  · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hst) (c.lower_lt_upper ht hs))
  · exact ht

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.exists_eq_iInf_of_directed
statement:
theorem exists_eq_iInf_of_directed {V : Type w} [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V]
    [FiniteDimensional k V] {ι : Type*} [Nonempty ι] (S : ι → Submodule k V)
    (hS : Directed (· ≥ ·) S) : ∃ i, S i = ⨅ j, S j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ i, Module.finrank k (S i) = n := by
    obtain ⟨i⟩ := ‹Nonempty ι›
    exact ⟨_, i, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hmin (j : ι) : Module.finrank k (S i) ≤ Module.finrank k (S j) := by
    rw [hi]
    exact Nat.find_min' hex ⟨j, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨i, le_antisymm (le_iInf fun j => ?_) (iInf_le _ i)⟩
  obtain ⟨a, hai, haj⟩ := hS i j
  have heq : S a = S i := Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hai
    (le_antisymm (Submodule.finrank_mono hai) (hmin a))
  exact heq ▸ haj

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.range_le_range
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨structureMapLinear M hab x,
    (LinearMap.congr_fun (structureMapLinear_comp M hab hbt) x).symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.imagePlus_eq_range
statement:
theorem imagePlus_eq_range (c : Cut α) {t : α} [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (ht : t ∈ c.upper) :
    ∃ s : {s // s ∈ c.upper ∧ s ≤ t},
      imagePlus M c t = LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M s.property.2)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty {s // s ∈ c.upper ∧ s ≤ t} := ⟨⟨t, ht, le_rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_eq_iInf_of_directed
    (fun s : {s // s ∈ c.upper ∧ s ≤ t} =>
      LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M s.property.2)) (by
    intro a b
    rcases le_total a.val b.val with hab | hba
    · exact ⟨a, le_rfl, range_le_range M hab b.property.2⟩
    · exact ⟨b, range_le_range M hba a.property.2, le_rfl⟩)
  exact ⟨s, hs.symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.imagePlus_map_mem
statement:
theorem imagePlus_map_mem (c : Cut α) {p q : α} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    {x : M.obj p} (hx : x ∈ imagePlus M c p) :
    structureMapLinear M hpq x ∈ imagePlus M c q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [imagePlus, Submodule.mem_iInf] at hx ⊢
  intro s
  rcases le_total s.val p with hsp | hps
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx ⟨s, s.property.1, hsp⟩
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    rw [structureMapLinear_comp M hsp hpq, LinearMap.comp_apply, hz]
  · refine ⟨structureMapLinear M hps x, ?_⟩
    exact (LinearMap.congr_fun (structureMapLinear_comp M hps s.property.2) x).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.imagePlus_map_surjective
statement:
theorem imagePlus_map_surjective (c : Cut α) {p q : α}
    [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (hpq : p ≤ q) (hp : p ∈ c.upper)
    {y : M.obj q} (hy : y ∈ imagePlus M c q) :
    ∃ x ∈ imagePlus M c p, structureMapLinear M hpq x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := imagePlus_eq_range M c hp
  have hys := ((Submodule.mem_iInf _).mp hy) ⟨s, s.property.1, s.property.2.trans hpq⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hys
  refine ⟨structureMapLinear M s.property.2 z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hs]
    exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
  · rw [structureMapLinear_comp M s.property.2 hpq, LinearMap.comp_apply] at hz
    exact hz

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.kernelPlus_map_mem_iff
statement:
theorem kernelPlus_map_mem_iff (c : Cut α) {p q : α} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hq : q ∈ c.lower) (x : M.obj p) :
    structureMapLinear M hpq x ∈ kernelPlus M c q ↔ x ∈ kernelPlus M c p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kernelPlus, Submodule.mem_iInf, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  constructor
  · intro hx r
    have hqr : q ≤ r := (c.lower_lt_upper hq r.property.1).le
    have he := hx ⟨r, r.property.1, hqr⟩
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← structureMapLinear_comp M hpq hqr] at he
    exact he
  · intro hx r
    have he := hx ⟨r, r.property.1, hpq.trans r.property.2⟩
    rw [structureMapLinear_comp M hpq r.property.2, LinearMap.comp_apply] at he
    exact he

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.intervalPlus_map_mem
statement:
theorem intervalPlus_map_mem (l r : Cut α) {p q : α} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hq : q ∈ r.lower) {x : M.obj p} (hx : x ∈ intervalPlus M l r p) :
    structureMapLinear M hpq x ∈ intervalPlus M l r q
proof:
:=
  ⟨imagePlus_map_mem M l hpq hx.1,
    (kernelPlus_map_mem_iff M r hpq hq x).mpr hx.2⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.intervalPlus_map_surjective
statement:
theorem intervalPlus_map_surjective (l r : Cut α) {p q : α}
    [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hp : p ∈ l.upper) (hq : q ∈ r.lower)
    {y : M.obj q} (hy : y ∈ intervalPlus M l r q) :
    ∃ x ∈ intervalPlus M l r p, structureMapLinear M hpq x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := imagePlus_map_surjective M l hpq hp hy.1
  refine ⟨x, ⟨hx, ?_⟩, hxy⟩
  apply (kernelPlus_map_mem_iff M r hpq hq x).mp
  rw [hxy]
  exact hy.2

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.kernel_le_kernel
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  change structureMapLinear M (hta.trans hab) x = 0
  rw [structureMapLinear_comp M hta hab, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx, map_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.kernelPlus_eq_kernel
statement:
theorem kernelPlus_eq_kernel (c : Cut α) {t : α} [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (hne : ∃ r ∈ c.upper, t ≤ r) :
    ∃ r : {r // r ∈ c.upper ∧ t ≤ r},
      kernelPlus M c t = LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M r.property.2)
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty {r // r ∈ c.upper ∧ t ≤ r} := by
    obtain ⟨r, hr, htr⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨⟨r, hr, htr⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := exists_eq_iInf_of_directed
    (fun r : {r // r ∈ c.upper ∧ t ≤ r} =>
      LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M r.property.2)) (by
    intro a b
    rcases le_total a.val b.val with hab | hba
    · exact ⟨a, le_rfl, kernel_le_kernel M a.property.2 hab⟩
    · exact ⟨b, kernel_le_kernel M b.property.2 hba, le_rfl⟩)
  exact ⟨r, hr.symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.imageMinus_le_imagePlus
statement:
theorem imageMinus_le_imagePlus (c : Cut α) (t : α) :
    imageMinus M c t ≤ imagePlus M c t
proof:
:= by
  apply iSup_le
  intro s
  apply le_iInf
  intro r
  exact range_le_range M (c.lower_lt_upper s.property.1 r.property.1).le r.property.2

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.kernelMinus_le_kernelPlus
statement:
theorem kernelMinus_le_kernelPlus (c : Cut α) (t : α) :
    kernelMinus M c t ≤ kernelPlus M c t
proof:
:= by
  apply iSup_le
  intro s
  apply le_iInf
  intro r
  exact kernel_le_kernel M s.property.2 (c.lower_lt_upper s.property.1 r.property.1).le

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.intervalMinus_le_intervalPlus
statement:
theorem intervalMinus_le_intervalPlus (l r : Cut α) (t : α) :
    intervalMinus M l r t ≤ intervalPlus M l r t
proof:
:=
  sup_le (inf_le_inf_right _ (imageMinus_le_imagePlus M l t))
    (inf_le_inf_left _ (kernelMinus_le_kernelPlus M r t))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.imageMinus_map_eq
statement:
theorem imageMinus_map_eq (c : Cut α) {p q : α} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hp : p ∈ c.upper) :
    (imageMinus M c p).map (structureMapLinear M hpq) = imageMinus M c q
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    apply iSup_le
    intro s x hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx
    apply (le_iSup (fun s : {s // s ∈ c.lower ∧ s ≤ q} =>
      LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M s.property.2))
      ⟨s, s.property.1, s.property.2.trans hpq⟩)
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    rw [structureMapLinear_comp M s.property.2 hpq, LinearMap.comp_apply, hz]
  · apply iSup_le
    intro s x hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hx
    have hsp : s.val ≤ p := (c.lower_lt_upper s.property.1 hp).le
    refine ⟨structureMapLinear M hsp z, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (le_iSup (fun s : {s // s ∈ c.lower ∧ s ≤ p} =>
        LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M s.property.2))
        ⟨s, s.property.1, hsp⟩) ⟨z, rfl⟩
    · rw [structureMapLinear_comp M hsp hpq, LinearMap.comp_apply] at hz
      exact hz

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.kernelMinus_map_mem
statement:
theorem kernelMinus_map_mem (c : Cut α) {p q : α} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    {x : M.obj p} (hx : x ∈ kernelMinus M c p) :
    structureMapLinear M hpq x ∈ kernelMinus M c q
proof:
:= by
  have hle : kernelMinus M c p ≤
      (kernelMinus M c q).comap (structureMapLinear M hpq) := by
    apply iSup_le
    intro s z hz
    rcases le_total q s.val with hqs | hsq
    · apply (le_iSup (fun r : {r // r ∈ c.lower ∧ q ≤ r} =>
        LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M r.property.2)) ⟨s, s.property.1, hqs⟩)
      change structureMapLinear M hqs (structureMapLinear M hpq z) = 0
      rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← structureMapLinear_comp M hpq hqs]
      exact hz
    · have he : structureMapLinear M hpq z = 0 := by
        rw [structureMapLinear_comp M s.property.2 hsq, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hz, map_zero]
      change structureMapLinear M hpq z ∈ kernelMinus M c q
      rw [he]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  exact hle hx

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.ker_le_kernelMinus
statement:
theorem ker_le_kernelMinus (c : Cut α) {p q : α} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hq : q ∈ c.lower) :
    LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M hpq) ≤ kernelMinus M c p
proof:
:=
  le_iSup (fun r : {r // r ∈ c.lower ∧ p ≤ r} =>
    LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M r.property.2)) ⟨q, hq, hpq⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.imagePlus_map_eq
statement:
theorem imagePlus_map_eq (c : Cut α) {p q : α} [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)]
    (hpq : p ≤ q) (hp : p ∈ c.upper) :
    (imagePlus M c p).map (structureMapLinear M hpq) = imagePlus M c q
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact imagePlus_map_mem M c hpq hx
  · intro y hy
    exact imagePlus_map_surjective M c hpq hp hy

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.kernelPlus_comap_eq
statement:
theorem kernelPlus_comap_eq (c : Cut α) {p q : α} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hq : q ∈ c.lower) :
    (kernelPlus M c q).comap (structureMapLinear M hpq) = kernelPlus M c p
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact kernelPlus_map_mem_iff M c hpq hq x

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.mem_kernelMinus_iff
statement:
theorem mem_kernelMinus_iff (c : Cut α) {t : α} (ht : t ∈ c.lower) {x : M.obj t} :
    x ∈ kernelMinus M c t ↔
      ∃ r : {r // r ∈ c.lower ∧ t ≤ r}, structureMapLinear M r.property.2 x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : Nonempty {r // r ∈ c.lower ∧ t ≤ r} := ⟨⟨t, ht, le_rfl⟩⟩
  apply Submodule.mem_iSup_of_directed
  intro a b
  rcases le_total a.val b.val with hab | hba
  · exact ⟨b, kernel_le_kernel M a.property.2 hab, le_rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨a, le_rfl, kernel_le_kernel M b.property.2 hba⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.kernelMinus_map_mem_iff
statement:
theorem kernelMinus_map_mem_iff (c : Cut α) {p q : α} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hq : q ∈ c.lower) (x : M.obj p) :
    structureMapLinear M hpq x ∈ kernelMinus M c q ↔ x ∈ kernelMinus M c p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (mem_kernelMinus_iff M c hq).mp hx
    apply (le_iSup (fun r : {r // r ∈ c.lower ∧ p ≤ r} =>
      LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M r.property.2))
      ⟨r, r.property.1, hpq.trans r.property.2⟩)
    change structureMapLinear M (hpq.trans r.property.2) x = 0
    rw [structureMapLinear_comp M hpq r.property.2, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    exact hr
  · exact kernelMinus_map_mem M c hpq

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.kernelMinus_comap_eq
statement:
theorem kernelMinus_comap_eq (c : Cut α) {p q : α} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hq : q ∈ c.lower) :
    (kernelMinus M c q).comap (structureMapLinear M hpq) = kernelMinus M c p
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact kernelMinus_map_mem_iff M c hpq hq x

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.intervalMinus_map_eq
statement:
theorem intervalMinus_map_eq (l r : Cut α) {p q : α} [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)]
    (hpq : p ≤ q) (hp : p ∈ l.upper) (hq : q ∈ r.lower) :
    (intervalMinus M l r p).map (structureMapLinear M hpq) = intervalMinus M l r q
proof:
:= by
  have hbirth : (imageMinus M l p ⊓ kernelPlus M r p).map (structureMapLinear M hpq) =
      imageMinus M l q ⊓ kernelPlus M r q := by
    rw [← kernelPlus_comap_eq M r hpq hq,
      ← Submodule.map_inf_eq_map_inf_comap, imageMinus_map_eq M l hpq hp]
  have hdeath : (imagePlus M l p ⊓ kernelMinus M r p).map (structureMapLinear M hpq) =
      imagePlus M l q ⊓ kernelMinus M r q := by
    rw [← kernelMinus_comap_eq M r hpq hq,
      ← Submodule.map_inf_eq_map_inf_comap, imagePlus_map_eq M l hpq hp]
  simpa only [intervalMinus, Submodule.map_sup] using congrArg₂ (· ⊔ ·) hbirth hdeath

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.intervalPlusMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intervalPlusMap_apply (l r : Cut α) {p q : α} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hq : q ∈ r.lower) (x : intervalPlus M l r p) :
    (intervalPlusMap M l r hpq hq x : M.obj q) = structureMapLinear M hpq x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.intervalPlusMap_surjective
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := intervalPlus_map_surjective M l r hpq hp hq y.property
  exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Subtype.ext hxy⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.intervalMinusInPlus_comap_eq
statement:
theorem intervalMinusInPlus_comap_eq (l r : Cut α) {p q : α}
    [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (hpq : p ≤ q) (hp : p ∈ l.upper)
    (hq : q ∈ r.lower) :
    (intervalMinusInPlus M l r q).comap (intervalPlusMap M l r hpq hq) =
      intervalMinusInPlus M l r p
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change structureMapLinear M hpq x.val ∈ intervalMinus M l r q ↔
    x.val ∈ intervalMinus M l r p
  have hmap := intervalMinus_map_eq M l r hpq hp hq
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rw [← hmap] at hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, he⟩ := hx
    have hd : x.val - z ∈ intervalMinus M l r p := by
      apply (le_sup_right : imagePlus M l p ⊓ kernelMinus M r p ≤ intervalMinus M l r p)
      refine ⟨Submodule.sub_mem _ x.property.1
        ((intervalMinus_le_intervalPlus M l r p hz).1), ?_⟩
      apply ker_le_kernelMinus M r hpq hq
      change structureMapLinear M hpq (x.val - z) = 0
      rw [map_sub, he, sub_self]
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using Submodule.add_mem (intervalMinus M l r p) hd hz
  · intro hx
    rw [← hmap]
    exact ⟨x.val, hx, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.intervalQuotientMap_injective
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
  rw [intervalQuotientMap, Submodule.ker_mapQ,
    intervalMinusInPlus_comap_eq M l r hpq hp hq, Submodule.mkQ_map_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.intervalQuotientMap_surjective
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (intervalMinusInPlus M l r q).mkQ_surjective y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := intervalPlusMap_surjective M l r hpq hp hq y
  exact ⟨(intervalMinusInPlus M l r p).mkQ x, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.intervalQuotientEquiv_mkQ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem intervalQuotientEquiv_mkQ (l r : Cut α) {p q : α}
    [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (hpq : p ≤ q) (hp : p ∈ l.upper)
    (hq : q ∈ r.lower) (x : intervalPlus M l r p) :
    intervalQuotientEquiv M l r hpq hp hq ((intervalMinusInPlus M l r p).mkQ x) =
      (intervalMinusInPlus M l r q).mkQ (intervalPlusMap M l r hpq hq x)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.structureMapLinear_intervalPlusModule
statement:
@[simp]
theorem structureMapLinear_intervalPlusModule (l r : Cut α) {s t : support l r}
    (h : s ≤ t) :
    structureMapLinear (intervalPlusModule M l r) h =
      intervalPlusMap M l r h t.property.2
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.intervalPlus_evaluation_surjective_real
statement:
theorem intervalPlus_evaluation_surjective_real (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ)
    [∀ t, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)] (l r : Cut ℝ) (t : support l r) :
    Function.Surjective (CompatibleSections.evaluation (intervalPlusModule M l r) t)
proof:
:= by
  apply CompatibleSections.evaluation_surjective_real
  intro s t h
  rw [structureMapLinear_intervalPlusModule]
  exact intervalPlusMap_surjective M l r h s.property.1 t.property.2

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.exists_intervalPlus_compatible_lift_real
statement:
theorem exists_intervalPlus_compatible_lift_real (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ)
    [∀ t, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)] (l r : Cut ℝ) (t : support l r)
    (y : M.obj t.val) (hy : y ∈ intervalPlus M l r t.val) :
    ∃ x : ∀ s : support l r, M.obj s.val,
      x t = y ∧ (∀ s, x s ∈ intervalPlus M l r s.val) ∧
      ∀ s t : support l r, ∀ h : s ≤ t, structureMapLinear M h (x s) = x t
proof:
:= by
  apply CompatibleSections.exists_compatible_lift_real M (support l r)
    (fun s => intervalPlus M l r s.val)
    (fun _ t h _ hx => intervalPlus_map_mem M l r h t.property.2 hx)
    (fun s t h _ hy => intervalPlus_map_surjective M l r h s.property.1 t.property.2 hy)
    t y hy

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.mem_ker_intervalQuotientEvaluation
statement:
theorem mem_ker_intervalQuotientEvaluation (l r : Cut α) (t : support l r)
    (x : CompatibleSections.sections (intervalPlusModule M l r)) :
    x ∈ (intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r t).ker ↔
      (x.val t).val ∈ intervalMinus M l r t.val
proof:
:= by
  change (Submodule.Quotient.mk (x.val t) : intervalQuotient M l r t.val) = 0 ↔ _
  exact Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (p := intervalMinusInPlus M l r t.val)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.intervalQuotientEvaluation_surjective_real
statement:
theorem intervalQuotientEvaluation_surjective_real (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ)
    [∀ t, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)] (l r : Cut ℝ) (t : support l r) :
    Function.Surjective (intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r t)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (intervalMinusInPlus M l r t.val).mkQ_surjective y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := intervalPlus_evaluation_surjective_real M l r t z
  change x.val t = z at hx
  exact ⟨x, congrArg (intervalMinusInPlus M l r t.val).mkQ hx⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.intervalQuotientEvaluation_naturality
statement:
theorem intervalQuotientEvaluation_naturality (l r : Cut α) {s t : support l r}
    [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj s.val)] (h : s ≤ t)
    (x : CompatibleSections.sections (intervalPlusModule M l r)) :
    intervalQuotientMap M l r h s.property.1 t.property.2
      (intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s x) = intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r t x
proof:
:= by
  change (intervalMinusInPlus M l r t.val).mkQ
    (intervalPlusMap M l r h t.property.2 (x.val s)) =
      (intervalMinusInPlus M l r t.val).mkQ (x.val t)
  congr 1
  rw [← structureMapLinear_intervalPlusModule]
  exact CompatibleSections.compatible (intervalPlusModule M l r) x h

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.ker_intervalQuotientEvaluation_eq
statement:
theorem ker_intervalQuotientEvaluation_eq [∀ t, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (l r : Cut α) (s t : support l r) :
    (intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s).ker = (intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r t).ker
proof:
:= by
  have hforward (a b : support l r) (h : a ≤ b)
      (x : CompatibleSections.sections (intervalPlusModule M l r)) :
      intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r a x = 0 ↔
        intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r b x = 0 := by
    have he := intervalQuotientEvaluation_naturality M l r h x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rw [← he, hx, map_zero]
    · intro hx
      apply intervalQuotientMap_injective M l r h a.property.1 b.property.2
      rw [he, hx, map_zero]
  ext x
  rcases le_total s t with h | h
  · exact hforward s t h x
  · exact (hforward t s h x).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.isCompl_sectionComplement
statement:
theorem isCompl_sectionComplement (l r : Cut α) (t : support l r) :
    IsCompl (intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r t).ker (sectionComplement M l r t)
proof:
:=
  ((intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r t).ker.exists_isCompl).choose_spec

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.isCompl_sectionComplement_at
statement:
theorem isCompl_sectionComplement_at [∀ t, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (l r : Cut α) (t s : support l r) :
    IsCompl (intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s).ker (sectionComplement M l r t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ker_intervalQuotientEvaluation_eq M l r t s]
  exact isCompl_sectionComplement M l r t

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.sectionComplement_quotientEvaluation_bijective_real
statement:
theorem sectionComplement_quotientEvaluation_bijective_real (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ)
    [∀ t, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)] (l r : Cut ℝ) (t s : support l r) :
    Function.Bijective ((intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s).comp
      (sectionComplement M l r t).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := isCompl_sectionComplement_at M l r t s
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    change intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s x.val =
      intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s y.val at hxy
    have hk : x.val - y.val ∈ (intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s).ker := by
      change intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s (x.val - y.val) = 0
      rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hc.disjoint (x.val - y.val) hk
      ((sectionComplement M l r t).sub_mem x.property y.property))
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := intervalQuotientEvaluation_surjective_real M l r s y
    obtain ⟨z, hz, w, hw, hzw⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp
      (show x ∈ (intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s).ker ⊔ sectionComplement M l r t by
        rw [hc.sup_eq_top]; trivial)
    refine ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, ?_⟩
    change intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s w = y
    calc
      intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s w = intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s (z + w) := by
        rw [map_add, LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hz, zero_add]
      _ = intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s x := congrArg _ hzw
      _ = y := hx

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.isCompl_sectionComplementAt_real
statement:
theorem isCompl_sectionComplementAt_real (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ)
    [∀ t, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)] (l r : Cut ℝ) (t s : support l r) :
    IsCompl (intervalMinusInPlus M l r s.val) (sectionComplementAt M l r t s)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := isCompl_sectionComplement_at M l r t s
  refine ⟨Submodule.disjoint_def.mpr ?_, codisjoint_iff.mpr (top_unique ?_)⟩
  · intro x hx hxW
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hxW
    have hw0 : w = 0 := Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hc.disjoint w
      ((mem_ker_intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s w).mpr hx) hw
    rw [hw0]
    exact map_zero (intervalPlusEvaluation M l r s)
  · intro x _
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (sectionComplement_quotientEvaluation_bijective_real M l r t s).surjective
      ((intervalMinusInPlus M l r s.val).mkQ x)
    let z : intervalPlus M l r s.val := intervalPlusEvaluation M l r s w.val
    have hz : z ∈ sectionComplementAt M l r t s := ⟨w.val, w.property, rfl⟩
    have hdiff : x - z ∈ intervalMinusInPlus M l r s.val := by
      apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (p := intervalMinusInPlus M l r s.val)).mp
      change (intervalMinusInPlus M l r s.val).mkQ (x - z) = 0
      rw [map_sub]
      change (intervalMinusInPlus M l r s.val).mkQ x -
        intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s w.val = 0
      rw [show intervalQuotientEvaluation M l r s w.val =
        (intervalMinusInPlus M l r s.val).mkQ x from hw, sub_self]
    exact Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨x - z, hdiff, z, hz, sub_add_cancel x z⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.sectionComplementAt_map_eq
statement:
theorem sectionComplementAt_map_eq (l r : Cut α) (t : support l r)
    {s q : support l r} (h : s ≤ q) :
    (sectionComplementAt M l r t s).map (intervalPlusMap M l r h q.property.2) =
      sectionComplementAt M l r t q
proof:
:= by
  rw [sectionComplementAt, ← Submodule.map_comp]
  congr 1
  ext x
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (CompatibleSections.compatible (intervalPlusModule M l r) x h)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.sectionComplementFiber_map_mem
statement:
theorem sectionComplementFiber_map_mem (l r : Cut α) (t : support l r)
    {s q : α} (h : s ≤ q) {x : M.obj s} (hx : x ∈ sectionComplementFiber M l r t s) :
    structureMapLinear M h x ∈ sectionComplementFiber M l r t q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs : s ∈ support l r
  · rw [sectionComplementFiber, dif_pos hs] at hx
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hu
    by_cases hq : q ∈ support l r
    · rw [sectionComplementFiber, dif_pos hq]
      refine ⟨w.val ⟨q, hq⟩, ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      exact (congrArg Subtype.val
        (CompatibleSections.compatible (intervalPlusModule M l r) w
          (show (⟨s, hs⟩ : support l r) ≤ ⟨q, hq⟩ from h))).symm
    · rw [sectionComplementFiber, dif_neg hq, Submodule.mem_bot]
      have hqu : q ∈ r.upper := by
        rcases r.mem_lower_or_upper q with hql | hqu
        · exact False.elim (hq ⟨upper_of_le h hs.1, hql⟩)
        · exact hqu
      exact ((Submodule.mem_iInf _).mp (w.val ⟨s, hs⟩).property.2) ⟨q, hqu, h⟩
  · simp only [sectionComplementFiber, dif_neg hs, Submodule.mem_bot] at hx
    subst x
    simpa only [map_zero] using Submodule.zero_mem (sectionComplementFiber M l r t q)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cut.sectionComplementFiber_eq_bot
statement:
theorem sectionComplementFiber_eq_bot (l r : Cut α) (t : support l r) {s : α}
    (hs : s ∉ support l r) : sectionComplementFiber M l r t s = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [sectionComplementFiber, dif_neg hs]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_eq_zero_iff (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν = 0 ↔ μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    let R : ℝ≥0∞ := μ univ + ν univ + 1
    have hRtop : R < ∞ := ENNReal.add_lt_top.mpr
      ⟨ENNReal.add_lt_top.mpr ⟨measure_lt_top μ _, measure_lt_top ν _⟩, by simp⟩
    have hRpos : 0 < R := (zero_lt_one : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < 1).trans_le le_add_self
    have htotal : μ univ + ν univ ≤ R := le_self_add
    obtain ⟨γ, hγ₁, hγ₂, hcost⟩ :=
      exists_minimizing_reservoirPlan p (by linarith) μ ν R hRtop hRpos htotal
    have hnorm : eLpNorm (fun z : Space × Space => dist z.1 z.2)
        (ENNReal.ofReal p) γ = 0 := by
      rw [eLpNorm_dist_eq_collapsedPowerCost p (by linarith) γ, hcost,
        ← boundaryTransportPowerValue_eq_reservoirPowerValue p hp μ ν R hRtop htotal]
      exact hzero
    have hae : (fun z : Space × Space => dist z.1 z.2) =ᵐ[γ] 0 :=
      (eLpNorm_eq_zero_iff (p := ENNReal.ofReal p)
        (by fun_prop : AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun z : Space × Space => dist z.1 z.2) γ)
        (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff.mpr (by linarith))).mp hnorm
    have hcoord : Prod.fst =ᵐ[γ] Prod.snd := by
      filter_upwards [hae] with z hz
      exact (dist_eq_zero.mp hz)
    have hres : reservoirMeasure μ R = reservoirMeasure ν R := by
      calc
        reservoirMeasure μ R = γ.map Prod.fst := hγ₁.symm
        _ = γ.map Prod.snd := Measure.map_congr hcoord
        _ = reservoirMeasure ν R := hγ₂
    have hmap : μ.map Space.point = ν.map Space.point := by
      have hr := congrArg (fun η : Measure Space => η.restrict (Set.range Space.point)) hres
      simpa [reservoirMeasure_restrict_interior] using hr
    exact measurableEmbedding_point.map_injective hmap
  · rintro rfl
    exact boundaryTransportDistance_self p (by linarith) μ

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.glue_reservoirCouplings
statement:
private theorem glue_reservoirCouplings
    (π σ : Measure (Space × Space)) [IsFiniteMeasure π] [IsFiniteMeasure σ]
    (hmiddle : π.map Prod.snd = σ.map Prod.fst) :
    ∃ τ : Measure ((Space × Space) × Space),
      τ.map Prod.fst = π ∧
      τ.map (fun a => (a.1.2, a.2)) = σ
proof:
:= by
  let κ := σ.condKernel
  let τ : Measure ((Space × Space) × Space) :=
    π ⊗ₘ (κ.comap Prod.snd (measurable_snd : Measurable (Prod.snd : Space × Space → Space)))
  refine ⟨τ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact Measure.fst_compProd π (κ.comap Prod.snd (measurable_snd : Measurable (Prod.snd : Space × Space → Space)))
  · apply Measure.ext
    intro s hs
    rw [Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop : Measurable
      (fun a : (Space × Space) × Space => (a.1.2, a.2))) hs,
      Measure.compProd_apply (hs.preimage (by fun_prop))]
    have hmeas : Measurable (fun y : Space => κ y (Prod.mk y ⁻¹' s)) :=
      ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.measurable_kernel_prodMk_left hs
    have hsection (a : Space × Space) :
        (κ.comap Prod.snd (measurable_snd : Measurable (Prod.snd : Space × Space → Space))) a
          ((fun z : Space => (a, z)) ⁻¹' ((fun b : (Space × Space) × Space => (b.1.2, b.2)) ⁻¹' s)) =
        κ a.2 (Prod.mk a.2 ⁻¹' s) := rfl
    simp_rw [hsection]
    rw [← lintegral_map hmeas measurable_snd, hmiddle]
    calc
      (∫⁻ y, κ y (Prod.mk y ⁻¹' s) ∂σ.map Prod.fst) =
          (σ.fst ⊗ₘ σ.condKernel) s := (Measure.compProd_apply hs).symm
      _ = σ s := congrArg (fun η : Measure (Space × Space) => η s)
        (σ.disintegrate σ.condKernel)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_triangle
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_triangle (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (μ ν ξ : Measure Interior)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] [IsFiniteMeasure ξ] :
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ ξ ≤
      boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν + boundaryTransportDistance p ν ξ
proof:
:= by
  let R : ℝ≥0∞ := μ univ + ν univ + ξ univ + 1
  have hRtop : R < ∞ := by
    simp only [R]
    exact ENNReal.add_lt_top.mpr ⟨ENNReal.add_lt_top.mpr
      ⟨ENNReal.add_lt_top.mpr ⟨measure_lt_top μ _, measure_lt_top ν _⟩,
       measure_lt_top ξ _⟩, by simp⟩
  have hRpos : 0 < R := (zero_lt_one : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < 1).trans_le le_add_self
  have hμν : μ univ + ν univ ≤ R := by
    calc
      μ univ + ν univ ≤ μ univ + ν univ + ξ univ := le_self_add
      _ ≤ R := le_self_add
  have hνξ : ν univ + ξ univ ≤ R := by
    calc
      ν univ + ξ univ ≤ ν univ + ξ univ + μ univ := le_self_add
      _ = μ univ + ν univ + ξ univ := by ac_rfl
      _ ≤ R := le_self_add
  have hμξ : μ univ + ξ univ ≤ R := by
    calc
      μ univ + ξ univ ≤ μ univ + ξ univ + ν univ := le_self_add
      _ = μ univ + ν univ + ξ univ := by ac_rfl
      _ ≤ R := le_self_add
  obtain ⟨π, hπ₁, hπ₂, hπcost⟩ :=
    exists_minimizing_reservoirPlan p (by linarith) μ ν R hRtop hRpos hμν
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ₁, hσ₂, hσcost⟩ :=
    exists_minimizing_reservoirPlan p (by linarith) ν ξ R hRtop hRpos hνξ
  have hπmass : π univ = R := by
    have h := congrArg (fun η : Measure Space => η univ) hπ₁
    simpa [Measure.map_apply measurable_fst MeasurableSet.univ,
      reservoirMeasure_mass μ R (le_self_add.trans hμν)] using h
  have hσmass : σ univ = R := by
    have h := congrArg (fun η : Measure Space => η univ) hσ₁
    simpa [Measure.map_apply measurable_fst MeasurableSet.univ,
      reservoirMeasure_mass ν R (le_self_add.trans hνξ)] using h
  obtain ⟨τ, hτxy, hτyz⟩ := @glue_reservoirCouplings π σ
    ⟨hπmass ▸ hRtop⟩ ⟨hσmass ▸ hRtop⟩ (hπ₂.trans hσ₁.symm)
  let γ : Measure (Space × Space) := τ.map (fun a => (a.1.1, a.2))
  have hγ₁ : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R := by
    dsimp only [γ]
    rw [Measure.map_map measurable_fst (by fun_prop)]
    have heq : (Prod.fst ∘ fun a : (Space × Space) × Space => (a.1.1, a.2)) =
        Prod.fst ∘ Prod.fst := rfl
    rw [heq, ← Measure.map_map measurable_fst measurable_fst, hτxy, hπ₁]
  have hγ₂ : γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ξ R := by
    dsimp only [γ]
    rw [Measure.map_map measurable_snd (by fun_prop)]
    have heq : (Prod.snd ∘ fun a : (Space × Space) × Space => (a.1.1, a.2)) =
        Prod.snd ∘ (fun a : (Space × Space) × Space => (a.1.2, a.2)) := rfl
    rw [heq, ← Measure.map_map measurable_snd (by fun_prop), hτyz, hσ₂]
  let e : ℝ≥0∞ := ENNReal.ofReal p
  let dxy : (Space × Space) × Space → ℝ := fun a => dist a.1.1 a.1.2
  let dyz : (Space × Space) × Space → ℝ := fun a => dist a.1.2 a.2
  have hγcost : reservoirDistance p μ ξ R ≤
      eLpNorm (fun z : Space × Space => dist z.1 z.2) e γ := by
    dsimp only [e]
    rw [eLpNorm_dist_eq_collapsedPowerCost p (by linarith) γ]
    exact ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow
      (reservoirPowerValue_le_plan p μ ξ R γ hγ₁ hγ₂) (one_div_nonneg.mpr (by linarith))
  have hmono : eLpNorm (fun z : Space × Space => dist z.1 z.2) e γ ≤
      eLpNorm (dxy + dyz) e τ := by
    dsimp only [γ]
    rw [eLpNorm_map_measure
      (by fun_prop : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun z : Space × Space => dist z.1 z.2)
        (τ.map (fun a => (a.1.1, a.2))))
      (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable (fun a : (Space × Space) × Space => (a.1.1, a.2)) τ)]
    exact eLpNorm_mono_ae_real (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun a => by
      simpa [dxy, dyz] using dist_triangle a.1.1 a.1.2 a.2)
  have hxy_norm : eLpNorm dxy e τ = reservoirDistance p μ ν R := by
    change eLpNorm ((fun z : Space × Space => dist z.1 z.2) ∘ Prod.fst) e τ = _
    rw [← eLpNorm_map_measure
      (by fun_prop : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun z : Space × Space => dist z.1 z.2) (τ.map Prod.fst))
      (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable Prod.fst τ), hτxy,
      eLpNorm_dist_eq_collapsedPowerCost p (by linarith), hπcost]
    rfl
  have hyz_norm : eLpNorm dyz e τ = reservoirDistance p ν ξ R := by
    change eLpNorm ((fun z : Space × Space => dist z.1 z.2) ∘
      (fun a : (Space × Space) × Space => (a.1.2, a.2))) e τ = _
    rw [← eLpNorm_map_measure
      (by fun_prop : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun z : Space × Space => dist z.1 z.2)
          (τ.map (fun a => (a.1.2, a.2))))
      (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable (fun a : (Space × Space) × Space => (a.1.2, a.2)) τ),
      hτyz, eLpNorm_dist_eq_collapsedPowerCost p (by linarith), hσcost]
    rfl
  calc
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ ξ = reservoirDistance p μ ξ R :=
      boundaryTransportDistance_eq_reservoirDistance p hp μ ξ R hRtop hμξ
    _ ≤ eLpNorm (fun z : Space × Space => dist z.1 z.2) e γ := hγcost
    _ ≤ eLpNorm (dxy + dyz) e τ := hmono
    _ ≤ eLpNorm dxy e τ + eLpNorm dyz e τ :=
      eLpNorm_add_le (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
        (by simpa [e] using (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hp))
    _ = boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν + boundaryTransportDistance p ν ξ := by
      rw [hxy_norm, hyz_norm,
        ← boundaryTransportDistance_eq_reservoirDistance p hp μ ν R hRtop hμν,
        ← boundaryTransportDistance_eq_reservoirDistance p hp ν ξ R hRtop hνξ]

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_isPositive
statement:
theorem dgm_isPositive
    (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ) :
    (dgm k f n).IsPositive
proof:
:=
  ofIndexBars_isPositive _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.bottomHomology_subsingleton
statement:
private theorem bottomHomology_subsingleton (n : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (simplicialHomology (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Subsingleton (Chain (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n) :=
    ⟨fun a b => (emptyChain_eq_zero k n a).trans (emptyChain_eq_zero k n b).symm⟩
  letI : Subsingleton (simplicialCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n) :=
    inferInstance
  letI : HasQuotient (simplicialCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n)
      (Submodule k (simplicialCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n)) :=
    Submodule.hasQuotient (R := k)
      (M := simplicialCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n)
  letI : Subsingleton (simplicialCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n ⧸
      simplicialBoundaries (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n) := inferInstance
  letI : Subsingleton
      (↑(ModuleCat.of k (LinearMap.ker
        ((simplicialChainComplex (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k).sc n).g.hom ⧸
        LinearMap.range ((simplicialChainComplex
          (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k).sc n).moduleCatToCycles))) := by
    change Subsingleton (simplicialCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n ⧸
      simplicialBoundaries (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n)
    infer_instance
  let e := (homologyKernelQuotient.{u,u,u} k
    (simplicialChainComplex (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k) n).toLinearEquiv
  exact ⟨fun a b => e.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.bottomMapRank_zero
proof:
:= by
  letI := bottomHomology_subsingleton k (V := V) n
  have hz : (simplicialHomologyIncl k h n).hom = 0 := by
    ext x
    have hx : x = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    simp [hx]
  rw [hz, LinearMap.range_zero]
  exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton (R := k)

name: TDA.Persistence.cut_of_grade
statement:
private theorem cut_of_grade (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α)
    (r : α) (i : Fin f.criticalValues.card)
    (hr : f.sublevel r = f.gradeFiltration i) (j : Fin f.criticalValues.card) :
    f.criticalValue j ≤ r ↔ j ≤ i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hj
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (f.mem_criticalValues _).1 (f.criticalValue_mem j)
    have hmem : σ.val ∈ f.gradeFiltration i := by
      rw [← hr]
      exact (f.mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem r σ).2 (hσ ▸ hj)
    have hle : f.criticalValue j ≤ f.criticalValue i := by
      rw [f.gradeFiltration_apply] at hmem
      exact hσ ▸ (f.mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem _ σ).1 hmem
    exact f.criticalValue.le_iff_le.mp hle
  · intro hji
    have hi : f.criticalValue i ≤ r := by
      obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (f.mem_criticalValues _).1 (f.criticalValue_mem i)
      have hm : σ.val ∈ f.gradeFiltration i := by
        rw [f.gradeFiltration_apply]
        exact (f.mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem _ σ).2 (le_of_eq hσ)
      rw [← hr] at hm
      exact hσ ▸ (f.mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem _ σ).1 hm
    exact (f.criticalValue.monotone hji).trans hi

name: TDA.Persistence.cut_of_bot
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_not_ge
  intro hj
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (f.mem_criticalValues _).1 (f.criticalValue_mem j)
  have hm : σ.val ∈ f.sublevel r :=
    (f.mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem r σ).2 (hσ ▸ hj)
  rw [hr] at hm
  exact (TDA.Filtration.mem_bot_iff σ.val).mp hm

name: TDA.Persistence.incl_eq_square
statement:
private theorem incl_eq_square {A B A' B' : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    (hA : A = A') (hB : B = B') (h : A ≤ B) (h' : A' ≤ B') (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl k h n ≫
        CategoryTheory.eqToHom
          (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C k n) hB) =
      CategoryTheory.eqToHom
          (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C k n) hA) ≫
        simplicialHomologyIncl k h' n
proof:
:= by
  subst A'
  subst B'
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.incl_rank_congr
statement:
