private theorem incl_rank_congr {A B A' B' : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    (hA : A = A') (hB : B = B') (h : A ≤ B) (h' : A' ≤ B') (n : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k h n).hom) =
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k h' n).hom)
proof:
:= by
  subst A'
  subst B'
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.same_stage_identity
statement:
private theorem same_stage_identity (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α)
    (n : ℕ) (r s : α) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (C : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (hr : f.sublevel r = C) (hs : f.sublevel s = C) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.sublevel_mono hrs) n ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun D => simplicialHomology D k n) hs) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun D => simplicialHomology D k n) hr)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [simplicialHomologyIncl_id, Category.comp_id] using
    incl_eq_square k hr hs (f.sublevel_mono hrs) (le_refl C) n

name: TDA.Persistence.last_tail_identity
statement:
private theorem last_tail_identity (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α)
    (n : ℕ) (hN : 0 < f.criticalValues.card)
    (r s : α) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hr : f.criticalValue
      ⟨f.criticalValues.card - 1, Nat.sub_lt hN (by decide)⟩ ≤ r) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.sublevel_mono hrs) n ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun D => simplicialHomology D k n)
          (f.sublevel_eq_self_of_last_le hN s (hr.trans hrs))) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun D => simplicialHomology D k n)
        (f.sublevel_eq_self_of_last_le hN r hr))
proof:
:= by
  exact same_stage_identity k f n r s hrs K
    (f.sublevel_eq_self_of_last_le hN r hr)
    (f.sublevel_eq_self_of_last_le hN s (hr.trans hrs))

name: TDA.Persistence.threshold_two_step
statement:
private theorem threshold_two_step (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α)
    (n : ℕ) (r s t : α) (hrs : r ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.sublevel_mono (hrs.trans hst)) n =
      simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.sublevel_mono hrs) n ≫
        simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.sublevel_mono hst) n
proof:
:= by
  exact simplicialHomologyIncl_comp k (f.sublevel_mono hrs)
    (f.sublevel_mono hst) n

name: TDA.Persistence.indexPoint_slice_threshold
statement:
private theorem indexPoint_slice_threshold (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α)
    (I : FiniteInterval f.criticalValues.card) (r s : α)
    (i j : Fin f.criticalValues.card)
    (hri : ∀ b : Fin f.criticalValues.card,
      f.criticalValue b ≤ r ↔ b ≤ i)
    (hsj : ∀ d : Fin f.criticalValues.card,
      f.criticalValue d ≤ s ↔ d ≤ j) :
    (point f.criticalValue I).1 ≤ r ∧
        (s : WithTop α) < (point f.criticalValue I).2 ↔
      I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hb, hd⟩
    have hb' := (hri ⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩).1 hb
    constructor
    · exact hb'
    · by_cases hdeath : I.death < f.criticalValues.card
      · have hd' : s < f.criticalValue ⟨I.death, hdeath⟩ := by
          simpa [point, hdeath] using hd
        have hnot : ¬ (⟨I.death, hdeath⟩ : Fin f.criticalValues.card) ≤ j := by
          intro h
          exact (not_lt_of_ge ((hsj _).2 h)) hd'
        exact Fin.lt_def.mp (lt_of_not_ge hnot)
      · omega
  · rintro ⟨hb, hd⟩
    constructor
    · exact (hri ⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩).2 hb
    · by_cases hdeath : I.death < f.criticalValues.card
      · have hjd : j < (⟨I.death, hdeath⟩ : Fin f.criticalValues.card) := by
          exact Fin.lt_def.mpr hd
        have hsnot : ¬ f.criticalValue ⟨I.death, hdeath⟩ ≤ s := by
          intro h
          exact (not_le_of_gt hjd) ((hsj _).1 h)
        simpa [point, hdeath] using lt_of_not_ge hsnot
      · simp [point, hdeath]

name: TDA.Persistence.countP_threshold_grades
statement:
private theorem countP_threshold_grades (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α)
    (n : ℕ) (r s : α) (i j : Fin f.criticalValues.card)
    (hri : ∀ b : Fin f.criticalValues.card,
      f.criticalValue b ≤ r ↔ b ≤ i)
    (hsj : ∀ d : Fin f.criticalValues.card,
      f.criticalValue d ≤ s ↔ d ≤ j) :
    (dgm k f n).points.countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ r ∧ (s : WithTop α) < p.2) =
      (gradeHomologyBarcode k f n).countP
        (fun I => I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change ((gradeHomologyBarcode k f n).map (point f.criticalValue)).countP _ = _
  rw [Multiset.countP_map, ← Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter]
  refine Multiset.countP_congr rfl ?_
  intro I _
  exact propext (indexPoint_slice_threshold f I r s i j hri hsj)

name: TDA.Persistence.rank_sublevelHomologyMap
statement:
theorem rank_sublevelHomologyMap
    (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ)
    (r s : α) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    Module.finrank k
      (LinearMap.range
        (TDA.Simplicial.simplicialHomologyIncl k
          (f.sublevel_mono hrs) n).hom) =
      (dgm k f n).points.countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ r ∧ (s : WithTop α) < p.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases f.sublevel_eq_bot_or_grade r with hr | ⟨i, _, hr⟩
  · rw [incl_rank_congr k hr rfl (f.sublevel_mono hrs)
        (bot_le : (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) ≤ f.sublevel s) n,
      bottomMapRank_zero k n]
    have hzero : (dgm k f n).points.countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ r ∧ (s : WithTop α) < p.2) = 0 := by
      change ((gradeHomologyBarcode k f n).map (point f.criticalValue)).countP _ = 0
      apply Multiset.countP_eq_zero.mpr
      intro p hp hpred
      obtain ⟨I, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hp
      have hb := (cut_of_bot f r hr
        (⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩ :
          Fin f.criticalValues.card))
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hpred.1) hb
    exact hzero.symm
  · rcases f.sublevel_eq_bot_or_grade s with hs | ⟨j, _, hs⟩
    · have hbot : f.sublevel r = ⊥ :=
        le_antisymm (by simpa [hs] using f.sublevel_mono hrs) bot_le
      have hcontra : False := by
        have := cut_of_bot f r hbot i
        exact (not_lt_of_ge ((cut_of_grade f r i hr i).2 le_rfl)) this
      exact hcontra.elim
    · have hij : i ≤ j :=
        (cut_of_grade f s j hs i).1
          (((cut_of_grade f r i hr i).2 le_rfl).trans hrs)
      rw [incl_rank_congr k hr hs (f.sublevel_mono hrs)
        (f.gradeFiltration.monotone hij) n,
        rank_gradeHomologyMap k f n i j hij]
      exact (countP_threshold_grades k f n r s i j
        (cut_of_grade f r i hr) (cut_of_grade f s j hs)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.same_stage_rank
statement:
private theorem same_stage_rank (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (n : ℕ) (r s : α) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (C : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (hr : f.sublevel r = C) (hs : f.sublevel s = C) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.sublevel_mono hrs) n).hom) =
      Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology C k n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [incl_rank_congr k hr hs (f.sublevel_mono hrs) (le_refl C) n,
    simplicialHomologyIncl_id]
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
    (LinearMap.id : simplicialHomology C k n →ₗ[k] simplicialHomology C k n)) = _
  rw [LinearMap.range_id]
  exact finrank_top k (simplicialHomology C k n)

name: TDA.Persistence.same_gap_identity
statement:
private theorem same_gap_identity (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin f.criticalValues.card) (r s : α) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hr : f.criticalValue i ≤ r)
    (hs : ∀ j : Fin f.criticalValues.card, i < j → s < f.criticalValue j) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.sublevel_mono hrs) n ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C k n)
          (f.sublevel_eq_grade_of_gap i s (hr.trans hrs) hs)) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C k n)
        (f.sublevel_eq_grade_of_gap i r hr
          (fun j hij => hrs.trans_lt (hs j hij))))
proof:
:= by
  exact same_stage_identity k f n r s hrs (f.gradeFiltration i)
    (f.sublevel_eq_grade_of_gap i r hr (fun j hij => hrs.trans_lt (hs j hij)))
    (f.sublevel_eq_grade_of_gap i s (hr.trans hrs) hs)

name: TDA.Persistence.same_gap_rank
statement:
private theorem same_gap_rank (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (n : ℕ) (i : Fin f.criticalValues.card) (r s : α) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hr : f.criticalValue i ≤ r)
    (hs : ∀ j : Fin f.criticalValues.card, i < j → s < f.criticalValue j) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.sublevel_mono hrs) n).hom) =
      Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (f.gradeFiltration i) k n)
proof:
:= by
  exact same_stage_rank k f n r s hrs (f.gradeFiltration i)
    (f.sublevel_eq_grade_of_gap i r hr (fun j hij => hrs.trans_lt (hs j hij)))
    (f.sublevel_eq_grade_of_gap i s (hr.trans hrs) hs)

name: TDA.Persistence.last_tail_rank
statement:
private theorem last_tail_rank (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (n : ℕ) (hN : 0 < f.criticalValues.card)
    (r s : α) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (hr : f.criticalValue
      ⟨f.criticalValues.card - 1, Nat.sub_lt hN (by decide)⟩ ≤ r) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.sublevel_mono hrs) n).hom) =
      Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology K k n)
proof:
:= by
  exact same_stage_rank k f n r s hrs K
    (f.sublevel_eq_self_of_last_le hN r hr)
    (f.sublevel_eq_self_of_last_le hN s (hr.trans hrs))

name: TDA.Persistence.threshold_grade_square
statement:
private theorem threshold_grade_square (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (n : ℕ) (r s : α) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (i j : Fin f.criticalValues.card) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hr : f.sublevel r = f.gradeFiltration i)
    (hs : f.sublevel s = f.gradeFiltration j) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.sublevel_mono hrs) n ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C k n) hs) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C k n) hr) ≫
        simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.gradeFiltration.monotone hij) n
proof:
:= by
  exact incl_eq_square k hr hs (f.sublevel_mono hrs)
    (f.gradeFiltration.monotone hij) n

name: TDA.Persistence.threshold_grade_two_step
statement:
private theorem threshold_grade_two_step (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (n : ℕ) (r s t : α) (hrs : r ≤ s) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (i j l : Fin f.criticalValues.card) (hij : i ≤ j) (hjl : j ≤ l)
    (hr : f.sublevel r = f.gradeFiltration i)
    (hs : f.sublevel s = f.gradeFiltration j)
    (ht : f.sublevel t = f.gradeFiltration l) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.sublevel_mono (hrs.trans hst)) n ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C k n) ht) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C k n) hr) ≫
        (simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.gradeFiltration.monotone hij) n ≫
          simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.gradeFiltration.monotone hjl) n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [threshold_two_step k f n r s t hrs hst, Category.assoc,
    threshold_grade_square k f n s t hst j l hjl hs ht,
    ← Category.assoc, threshold_grade_square k f n r s hrs i j hij hr hs,
    Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.essential_total
statement:
private theorem essential_total (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (n : ℕ) (hN : 0 < f.criticalValues.card) :
    (dgm k f n).points.countP (fun p => p.2 = (⊤ : WithTop α)) =
      Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology K k n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let last : Fin f.criticalValues.card :=
    ⟨f.criticalValues.card - 1, Nat.sub_lt hN (by decide)⟩
  have hlast (i : Fin f.criticalValues.card) : i ≤ last := by
    apply Fin.le_def.mpr
    have hi := i.isLt
    dsimp [last]
    omega
  have hcount : (dgm k f n).points.countP (fun p => p.2 = (⊤ : WithTop α)) =
      (dgm k f n).points.countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ f.criticalValue last ∧
          (f.criticalValue last : WithTop α) < p.2) := by
    apply Multiset.countP_congr rfl
    intro p hp
    change p ∈ (gradeHomologyBarcode k f n).map (point f.criticalValue) at hp
    obtain ⟨I, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hp
    have hb := f.criticalValue.monotone
      (hlast ⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩)
    by_cases hd : I.death < f.criticalValues.card
    · have hdeath := f.criticalValue.monotone (hlast ⟨I.death, hd⟩)
      simp [point, hd, not_lt_of_ge hdeath]
    · simp [point, hd, hb]
  rw [hcount, ← rank_sublevelHomologyMap k f n
    (f.criticalValue last) (f.criticalValue last) le_rfl]
  exact last_tail_rank k f n hN _ _ le_rfl le_rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_eq_ofIndexBars_of_iso
statement:
theorem dgm_eq_ofIndexBars_of_iso
    (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval f.criticalValues.card))
    (e : simplicialHomologyPModule k f.gradeFiltration n ≅
      barcodeModule (k := k) B) :
    dgm k f n =
      ofIndexBars f.criticalValue f.criticalValue.strictMono B
proof:
:= by
  unfold dgm gradeHomologyBarcode
  rw [rankBarcode_eq_of_iso_barcodeModule B e]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimensionExamples.zero_projectiveDimension
statement: theorem zero_projectiveDimension : projectiveDimension (F.obj Z) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  exact (projectiveDimension_eq_bot_iff _).mpr
    ((isZero_hom_obj_iff Z).mpr (isZero_zero _))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimensionExamples.principalHook_projectiveDimension
statement: theorem principalHook_projectiveDimension : projectiveDimension (F.obj H) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (projectiveDimension_eq_zero_iff _).mpr
  constructor
  · apply (projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_zero (F.obj H)).mpr
    exact (hasProjectiveDimensionLE_iff principalHookMinimalResolution 0).mpr
      (fun j hj => principalHook_positive_terms_are_zero principalHookMinimalResolution hj)
  · intro h
    have hz := (isZero_hom_obj_iff H).mp h
    have hId := hz.eq_of_src (𝟙 H) 0
    have hb := congrArg (fun f : H ⟶ H =>
      (f.app 0).hom (HookInfinity.birth (R := ℚ) (0 : Fin 2))) hId
    exact HookInfinity.birth_ne_zero (k := ℚ) (0 : Fin 2) (by simpa using hb)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimensionExamples.principalHook_padding_boundary
statement:
theorem principalHook_padding_boundary :
    IsZero (principalHookMinimalResolution.termAt 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : projectiveDimension (F.obj H) ≤ (0 : ℕ) := by
    rw [principalHook_projectiveDimension]
    rfl
  exact (FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.projectiveDimension_le_iff
    principalHookMinimalResolution 0).mp hd 1 (by decide)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimensionExamples.zero_row
statement: private theorem zero_row : IsRankExact (0 : Z ⟶ Z) (𝟙 Z)
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ p, Subsingleton (Z.obj p) := fun p =>
    ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)
  have hs : IsPointwiseShortExact (0 : Z ⟶ Z) (𝟙 Z) := by
    constructor
    · intro p x y _
      exact (ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)).elim x y
    · intro p x
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    · intro p
      simp
      exact top_unique (by
        intro x _
        change x = 0
        exact Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  exact hs.rankExact_of_section (𝟙 Z) (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimensionExamples.paddedZero_higher_degree
statement:
theorem paddedZero_higher_degree :
    (paddedZeroMinimalResolution 3).resolution.length = 3 ∧
      IsZero ((paddedZeroMinimalResolution 3).termAt 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  have hd : projectiveDimension (F.obj Z) ≤ (1 : ℕ) := by
    rw [zero_projectiveDimension]
    exact bot_le
  exact (FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.projectiveDimension_le_iff
    (paddedZeroMinimalResolution 3) 1).mp hd 2 (by decide)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.cross_left_fiber_le
statement:
private theorem cross_left_fiber_le (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (W₁ W₂ : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    fiber (R := R) (crossLeft ε W₁ W₂) a ≤
      fiber (R := R) (crossRight ε W₁ W₂) (CoordinateShift.translation ε a)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx g hg i
  cases g with
  | inl g =>
    have h : W₁.grade g i ≤ a i := by
      simpa [crossLeft, GradedGenerators.sum, Sum.elim] using hx hg i
    simpa [crossRight, GradedGenerators.sum, Sum.elim,
      GradedGenerators.shiftGrade, CoordinateShift.translation_apply]
      using add_le_add_right h (ε : ℝ)
  | inr g =>
    have h : W₂.grade g i + (ε : ℝ) ≤ a i := by
      simpa [crossLeft, GradedGenerators.sum, Sum.elim,
        GradedGenerators.shiftGrade]
        using hx hg i
    have h' : W₂.grade g i ≤ a i + (ε : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith [ε.coe_nonneg]
    simpa [crossRight, GradedGenerators.sum, Sum.elim,
      CoordinateShift.translation_apply] using h'

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.cross_right_fiber_le
statement:
private theorem cross_right_fiber_le (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (W₁ W₂ : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    fiber (R := R) (crossRight ε W₁ W₂) a ≤
      fiber (R := R) (crossLeft ε W₁ W₂) (CoordinateShift.translation ε a)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx g hg i
  cases g with
  | inl g =>
    have h : W₁.grade g i + (ε : ℝ) ≤ a i := by
      simpa [crossRight, GradedGenerators.sum, Sum.elim,
        GradedGenerators.shiftGrade]
        using hx hg i
    have h' : W₁.grade g i ≤ a i + (ε : ℝ) := by
      nlinarith [ε.coe_nonneg]
    simpa [crossLeft, GradedGenerators.sum, Sum.elim,
      CoordinateShift.translation_apply] using h'
  | inr g =>
    have h : W₂.grade g i ≤ a i := by
      simpa [crossRight, GradedGenerators.sum, Sum.elim] using hx hg i
    simpa [crossLeft, GradedGenerators.sum, Sum.elim,
      GradedGenerators.shiftGrade, CoordinateShift.translation_apply]
      using add_le_add_right h (ε : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delayed_grade_eq_translation
statement:
private theorem delayed_grade_eq_translation (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (Y : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) (y : Y.Carrier) :
    (Y.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade y =
      CoordinateShift.translation ε (Y.grade y)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delaySource_birth
statement:
theorem delaySource_birth (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (Y : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    (M : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (f : module (R := R) Y ⟶ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj M)
    (y : Y.Carrier) :
    (delaySource ε Y M f).app ((Y.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade y)
      (birth (Y.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) y) =
    M.map (eqToHom (delayed_grade_eq_translation ε Y y).symm)
      (f.app (Y.grade y) (birth Y y))
proof:
:=
  lift_birth (Y.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) M _ y

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delaySource_comp_zero
statement:
theorem delaySource_comp_zero (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (Y : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (f : module (R := R) Y ⟶ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj M)
    (ρ : M ⟶ N)
    (h : delaySource ε Y M f ≫ ρ = 0) :
    f ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map ρ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext_birth Y
  intro y
  let t := Y.grade y
  let d := (Y.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade y
  let e : d = CoordinateShift.translation ε t := delayed_grade_eq_translation ε Y y
  have hy := congrArg
    (fun q : module (R := R) (Y.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ⟶ N =>
      q.app d (birth (Y.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) y)) h
  change ρ.app d ((delaySource ε Y M f).app d
    (birth (Y.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) y)) = 0 at hy
  rw [delaySource_birth] at hy
  have hn := ρ.naturality (eqToHom e)
  have hv := congrArg
    (fun q : M.obj d ⟶ N.obj (CoordinateShift.translation ε t) =>
      q (M.map (eqToHom e.symm) (f.app t (birth Y y)))) hn
  change ρ.app (CoordinateShift.translation ε t)
        (M.map (eqToHom e) (M.map (eqToHom e.symm)
          (f.app t (birth Y y)))) =
    N.map (eqToHom e) (ρ.app d (M.map (eqToHom e.symm)
      (f.app t (birth Y y)))) at hv
  have hy' : ρ.app d (M.map (eqToHom e.symm)
      (f.app t (birth Y y))) = 0 := by
    simpa [d, t, e] using hy
  rw [hy', map_zero] at hv
  have hc : M.map (eqToHom e) (M.map (eqToHom e.symm)
        (f.app t (birth Y y))) = f.app t (birth Y y) := by
    calc
      _ = M.map (eqToHom e.symm ≫ eqToHom e) (f.app t (birth Y y)) := by
        rw [Functor.map_comp]
        rfl
      _ = _ := by simp
  change ρ.app (CoordinateShift.translation ε t) (f.app t (birth Y y)) = 0
  simpa only [hc] using hv

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossData.finite
statement:
theorem CrossData.finite (h : Finite C.W₁.Carrier ∧ Finite C.W₂.Carrier ∧
    Finite C.Y₁.Carrier ∧ Finite C.Y₂.Carrier) :
    C.leftPresentation.IsFinite ∧ C.rightPresentation.IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨hW₁, hW₂, hY₁, hY₂⟩
  have : Finite C.W₁.Carrier := hW₁
  have : Finite C.W₂.Carrier := hW₂
  have : Finite C.Y₁.Carrier := hY₁
  have : Finite C.Y₂.Carrier := hY₂
  let : Fintype C.W₁.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let : Fintype C.W₂.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let : Fintype C.Y₁.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let : Fintype C.Y₂.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite _
  change (Finite (C.W₁.Carrier ⊕ C.W₂.Carrier) ∧
      Finite (C.Y₁.Carrier ⊕ C.Y₂.Carrier)) ∧
    (Finite (C.W₁.Carrier ⊕ C.W₂.Carrier) ∧
      Finite (C.Y₁.Carrier ⊕ C.Y₂.Carrier))
  exact ⟨⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩, ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossData.primitiveLR_vanish
proof:
:= by
  have hv : C.leftDelayed ≫ C.rightPresentation.cover = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg
      (fun f : module (R := R) C.rightPresentation.relations ⟶
          C.rightPresentation.presented =>
        sumInl (C.Y₁.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) C.Y₂ ≫ f)
      C.rightPresentation.relations_vanish
    have hz : sumInl (R := R) (C.Y₁.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) C.Y₂ ≫
        (0 : module (R := R) C.rightPresentation.relations ⟶
          C.rightPresentation.presented) = 0 := by
      apply NatTrans.ext
      funext a
      rfl
    rw [hz] at h
    simpa [CrossData.rightPresentation, ← Category.assoc] using h
  exact delaySource_comp_zero ε C.Y₁
    (C.r₁ ≫ crossFreeLR ε C.W₁ C.W₂) C.rightPresentation.cover hv

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossData.oppositeLR_birth
statement:
private theorem CrossData.oppositeLR_birth
    (y : C.Y₂.Carrier)
    (h : C.Y₂.grade y ≤ CoordinateShift.translation ε
      ((C.Y₂.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade y)) :
    (crossFreeLR ε C.W₁ C.W₂).app
        ((C.Y₂.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade y)
        (C.rightDelayed.app ((C.Y₂.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade y)
          (birth (C.Y₂.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) y)) =
      structureMapLinear (module (R := R) (crossRight ε C.W₁ C.W₂)) h
        (C.r₂.app (C.Y₂.grade y) (birth C.Y₂ y))
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [CrossData.rightDelayed, delaySource_birth]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossData.oppositeLR_vanish
proof:
:= by
  have hr : C.r₂ ≫ C.rightPresentation.cover = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg
      (fun f : module (R := R) C.rightPresentation.relations ⟶
          C.rightPresentation.presented =>
        sumInr (C.Y₁.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) C.Y₂ ≫ f)
      C.rightPresentation.relations_vanish
    have hz : sumInr (R := R) (C.Y₁.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) C.Y₂ ≫
        (0 : module (R := R) C.rightPresentation.relations ⟶
          C.rightPresentation.presented) = 0 := by
      apply NatTrans.ext
      funext a
      rfl
    rw [hz] at h
    simpa [CrossData.rightPresentation, ← Category.assoc] using h
  apply hom_ext_birth (C.Y₂.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))
  intro y
  let d := (C.Y₂.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade y
  let t := C.Y₂.grade y
  let x := C.r₂.app t (birth C.Y₂ y)
  have ht : t ≤ CoordinateShift.translation ε d := by
    intro i
    dsimp [t, d, CoordinateShift.translation, GradedGenerators.shiftGrade]
    change C.Y₂.grade y i ≤
      (C.Y₂.grade y i - -(ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)
    nlinarith [ε.coe_nonneg]
  have hx : C.rightPresentation.cover.app t x = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg
      (fun q : module (R := R) C.Y₂ ⟶ C.rightPresentation.presented =>
        q.app t (birth C.Y₂ y)) hr
    change C.rightPresentation.cover.app t x = 0 at h
    exact h
  have hn := C.rightPresentation.cover.naturality (homOfLE ht)
  have hv := congrArg
    (fun q : (module (R := R) (crossRight ε C.W₁ C.W₂)).obj t ⟶
        C.rightPresentation.presented.obj (CoordinateShift.translation ε d) =>
      q x) hn
  change C.rightPresentation.cover.app (CoordinateShift.translation ε d)
      (structureMapLinear (module (R := R) (crossRight ε C.W₁ C.W₂)) ht x) =
    structureMapLinear C.rightPresentation.presented ht
      (C.rightPresentation.cover.app t x) at hv
  rw [hx, map_zero] at hv
  change C.rightPresentation.cover.app (CoordinateShift.translation ε d)
    ((crossFreeLR ε C.W₁ C.W₂).app d
      (C.rightDelayed.app d (birth (C.Y₂.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) y))) = 0
  rw [C.oppositeLR_birth y ht]
  exact hv

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossData.leftRelationsCross_vanish
statement:
theorem CrossData.leftRelationsCross_vanish :
    C.leftPresentation.relationMap ≫ crossFreeLR ε C.W₁ C.W₂ ≫
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map C.rightPresentation.cover = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply sumHom_ext C.Y₁ (C.Y₂.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))
  · calc
      _ = C.r₁ ≫ crossFreeLR ε C.W₁ C.W₂ ≫
          (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map C.rightPresentation.cover := by
        simp [CrossData.leftPresentation, ← Category.assoc]
      _ = 0 := C.primitiveLR_vanish
      _ = sumInl (R := R) C.Y₁ (C.Y₂.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫
          (0 : module (R := R) C.leftPresentation.relations ⟶
            (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj C.rightPresentation.presented) := by
        apply NatTrans.ext
        funext a
        rfl
  · calc
      _ = C.rightDelayed ≫ crossFreeLR ε C.W₁ C.W₂ ≫
          (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map C.rightPresentation.cover := by
        simp [CrossData.leftPresentation, ← Category.assoc]
      _ = 0 := C.oppositeLR_vanish
      _ = sumInr (R := R) C.Y₁ (C.Y₂.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫
          (0 : module (R := R) C.leftPresentation.relations ⟶
            (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj C.rightPresentation.presented) := by
        apply NatTrans.ext
        funext a
        rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossData.cover_quotientLR

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossData.primitiveRL_vanish
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossData.oppositeRL_birth

  rw [CrossData.leftDelayed, delaySource_birth]

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossData.oppositeRL_vanish

  change C.leftPresentation.cover.app (CoordinateShift.translation ε d)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.source_inverse
statement:
private theorem source_inverse (f : M ⟶ N) (i : inducedDomain f) :
    imageSourceEmbedding f ((imageOccurrenceEquivDomain f).symm i) = i.val
proof:
:=
  Equiv.apply_ofInjective_symm (imageSourceEmbedding f).injective i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMatching_from_image
statement:
theorem inducedMatching_from_image (f : M ⟶ N)
    (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode (finiteImage f))) :
    inducedMatching f ⟨imageSourceEmbedding f a, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩ = imageTargetEmbedding f a
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (imageTargetEmbedding f)
    (Equiv.ofInjective_symm_apply (imageSourceEmbedding f).injective a)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem inducedMap_eq_some_iff (f : M ⟶ N)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    inducedMap f i = some j ↔
      ∃ a, imageSourceEmbedding f a = i ∧ imageTargetEmbedding f a = j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases hi : i ∈ inducedDomain f
    · refine ⟨(imageOccurrenceEquivDomain f).symm ⟨i, hi⟩, source_inverse f _, ?_⟩
      simpa [inducedMap, hi, inducedMatching] using h
    · simp [inducedMap, hi] at h
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hj⟩
    have hi : i ∈ inducedDomain f := ⟨a, ha⟩
    have he : (⟨i, hi⟩ : inducedDomain f) = ⟨imageSourceEmbedding f a, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext ha.symm
    have hm : inducedMatching f ⟨i, hi⟩ = j := by
      rw [he, inducedMatching_from_image, hj]
    simp [inducedMap, hi, hm]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_eq_some_iff_unique
statement:
theorem inducedMap_eq_some_iff_unique (f : M ⟶ N)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    inducedMap f i = some j ↔
      ∃! a, imageSourceEmbedding f a = i ∧ imageTargetEmbedding f a = j
proof:
:= by
  rw [inducedMap_eq_some_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hj⟩
    exact ⟨a, ⟨ha, hj⟩, fun b hb => (imageSourceEmbedding f).injective (hb.1.trans ha.symm)⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, _⟩
    exact ⟨a, ha⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_domain
statement:
theorem inducedMap_domain (f : M ⟶ N) (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    (∃ j, inducedMap f i = some j) ↔ i ∈ inducedDomain f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    obtain ⟨a, ha, _⟩ := (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f i j).mp hj
    exact ⟨a, ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    exact ⟨imageTargetEmbedding f a, (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f _ _).mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem inducedMap_eq_none_iff (f : M ⟶ N) (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    inducedMap f i = none ↔ i ∉ inducedDomain f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hi : i ∈ inducedDomain f <;> simp [inducedMap, hi]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_range
statement:
theorem inducedMap_range (f : M ⟶ N) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    (∃ i, inducedMap f i = some j) ↔ j ∈ Set.range (imageTargetEmbedding f)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    obtain ⟨a, _, ha⟩ := (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f i j).mp hi
    exact ⟨a, ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    exact ⟨imageSourceEmbedding f a, (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f _ _).mpr ⟨a, rfl, ha⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_injective
statement:
theorem inducedMap_injective (f : M ⟶ N)
    (i i' : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (hi : inducedMap f i = some j) (hi' : inducedMap f i' = some j) : i = i'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hj⟩ := (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f i j).mp hi
  obtain ⟨a', ha', hj'⟩ := (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f i' j).mp hi'
  have he := (imageTargetEmbedding f).injective (hj.trans hj'.symm)
  exact ha.symm.trans (he ▸ ha')

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_intermediate_endpoints
statement:
theorem inducedMap_intermediate_endpoints (f : M ⟶ N)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (h : inducedMap f i = some j) :
    ∃ a, imageSourceEmbedding f a = i ∧ imageTargetEmbedding f a = j ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode (finiteImage f)) a).birth = (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode (finiteImage f)) a).death = (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩ := (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f i j).mp h
  exact ⟨a, rfl, rfl,
    (epiEmbedding_birth (toFiniteImage f) (toFiniteImage_surjective f) a).symm,
    (monoEmbedding_death (fromFiniteImage f) (fromFiniteImage_injective f) a).symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_endpoints
statement:
theorem inducedMap_endpoints (f : M ⟶ N)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (h : inducedMap f i = some j) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birth ≤ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth < (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ≤ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩ := (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f i j).mp h
  have hb := epiEmbedding_birth (toFiniteImage f) (toFiniteImage_surjective f) a
  have hd := monoEmbedding_death (fromFiniteImage f) (fromFiniteImage_injective f) a
  have hblo := monoEmbedding_birth_le (fromFiniteImage f) (fromFiniteImage_injective f) a
  have hdhi := epiEmbedding_death_le (toFiniteImage f) (toFiniteImage_surjective f) a
  change (occurrence _ (imageSourceEmbedding f a)).birth = _ at hb
  change (occurrence _ (imageTargetEmbedding f a)).death = _ at hd
  change _ ≤ (occurrence _ (imageSourceEmbedding f a)).death at hdhi
  have hbar := (occurrence (rankBarcode (finiteImage f)) a).birth_lt_death
  change (occurrence _ (imageTargetEmbedding f a)).birth ≤ _ at hblo
  rw [hb, hd]
  exact ⟨hblo, hbar, hdhi⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.twoPoint_gromovWasserstein_singleton
statement:
theorem twoPoint_gromovWasserstein_singleton (ε : ℝ≥0) (hε : ε ≤ 1)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    gromovWasserstein p (twoPointLaw ε hε) (PMF.pure (() : Unit)) =
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (2 * (ε : ℝ≥0∞) * ((1 - ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞)) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [gromovWasserstein_of_subsingleton]
  simp only [twoPointLaw, expectation_map]
  congr 2
  simp [expectation, tsum_fintype, Fintype.sum_bool, twoPointWeights, PMF.ofFintype_apply,
    Real.dist_eq, ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hp, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.weighted_twoPoint_sampleLaw_bound
statement:
theorem weighted_twoPoint_sampleLaw_bound (ε : ℝ≥0) (hε : ε ≤ 1)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (n degree : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    wasserstein p bottleneck
      (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) (twoPointLaw ε hε) n (degree + 1))
      (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) (PMF.pure (() : Unit)) n (degree + 1)) ≤
      (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ p⁻¹ *
        (2 * gromovWasserstein p (twoPointLaw ε hε)
          (PMF.pure (() : Unit)))
proof:
:=
  wasserstein_sampleLaw_le_gromovWasserstein (ZMod 2)
    (twoPointLaw ε hε) (PMF.pure (() : Unit)) hp n degree hn

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.weighted_twoPoint_sampleLaw_bound_degreeZero
statement:
theorem weighted_twoPoint_sampleLaw_bound_degreeZero (ε : ℝ≥0) (hε : ε ≤ 1)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    wasserstein p bottleneck
      (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) (twoPointLaw ε hε) n 0)
      (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) (PMF.pure (() : Unit)) n 0) ≤
      (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ p⁻¹ *
        (2 * gromovWasserstein p (twoPointLaw ε hε)
          (PMF.pure (() : Unit)))
proof:
:=
  wasserstein_sampleLaw_le_gromovWasserstein_allDegrees (ZMod 2)
    (twoPointLaw ε hε) (PMF.pure (() : Unit)) hp n 0 hn

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.epsilonPointBase_injective
statement: private theorem epsilonPointBase_injective : Function.Injective epsilonPointBase

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.epsilonUnitMetric_dist
statement:
private theorem epsilonUnitMetric_dist (b c : Bool) :
    epsilonUnitMetric.dist b c = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * epsilonBaseMetric.dist b c
proof:
:= by
  change dist (epsilonPointUnit b) (epsilonPointUnit c) =
    (1 / 2 : ℝ) * dist (epsilonPointBase b) (epsilonPointBase c)

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.rips_diameter_scale
statement:
private theorem rips_diameter_scale {V : Type*} (d e : MetricSpace V) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hdist : ∀ x y, e.dist x y = c * d.dist x y)
    (s : Finset V) :
    Rips.diameter e s = c * Rips.diameter d s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (Rips.diameter_le_iff e s _).2
    refine ⟨mul_nonneg hc.le (Rips.diameter_nonneg d s), ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    rw [hdist]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Rips.dist_le_diameter d hx hy) hc.le
  · have hbase : Rips.diameter d s ≤ c⁻¹ * Rips.diameter e s := by
      apply (Rips.diameter_le_iff d s _).2
      refine ⟨mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le) (Rips.diameter_nonneg e s), ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy
      have hdist' : d.dist x y = c⁻¹ * e.dist x y := by
        rw [hdist]
        field_simp
      rw [hdist']
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Rips.dist_le_diameter e hx hy)
        (inv_nonneg.mpr hc.le)
    calc
      c * Rips.diameter d s ≤ c * (c⁻¹ * Rips.diameter e s) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbase hc.le
      _ = Rips.diameter e s := by field_simp

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.epsilonUnitFilter_eq_scale
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  rw [Rips.filter_value, FilterFunction.scale_value, Rips.filter_value,
    rips_diameter_scale epsilonBaseMetric epsilonUnitMetric (1 / 2) (by norm_num)
      epsilonUnitMetric_dist]

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.epsilonBaseDgm_eq_twoPoints
statement:
private theorem epsilonBaseDgm_eq_twoPoints :
    dgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter epsilonBaseMetric) 0 = diagram (ZMod 2) (Fin 2) 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : MetricSpace Bool := epsilonBaseMetric
  let e : Bool ≃ᵢ Fin 2 :=
    { boolFinTwo with
      isometry_toFun := Isometry.of_dist_eq (by
        intro b c
        change dist (TwoPoints.pts (boolFinTwo b)) (TwoPoints.pts (boolFinTwo c)) =
          dist (epsilonPointBase b) (epsilonPointBase c)
        cases b <;> cases c <;>
          norm_num [boolFinTwo, epsilonPointBase, TwoPoints.pts, Real.dist_eq]) }
  rw [diagram_eq_dgm]
  exact dgm_eq_of_isometryEquiv (ZMod 2) e 0

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.epsilonTwoPoint_fullH0_points

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.singleton_fullH0_points
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagram_eq_dgm]
  let d : MetricSpace (Fin 1) := inferInstance
  let D := dgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter d) 0
  have hd0 : Rips.diameter d (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [show (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)) = {0} by decide]
    exact Rips.diameter_singleton d 0
  have hfin : finitePart D.points = 0 := by
    have h := card_finiteOccurrences_dgm_fullComplex_le (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter d) 0
    apply Multiset.card_eq_zero.mp
    have hc : Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences = 0 := by
      apply Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
      simpa [D] using h
    simpa only [Multiset.card_coe] using hc
  have hess : essentialPart D.points = {0} := by
    have hc := Rips.card_essentialPart_dgm_zero (ZMod 2) d
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Multiset.card_eq_one.mp hc
    have hbmem : b ∈ essentialPart D.points := by rw [hb]; simp
    have hbounds := (Rips.dgm_coordinates_le_diameter (ZMod 2) d 0).2 b hbmem
    have hb0 : b = 0 := by linarith [hd0]
    simpa [hb0] using hb
  have h := parts_reconstruct D.points
  simpa only [hfin, hess, Multiset.map_zero, Multiset.map_singleton, zero_add] using h.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.repeatedDraws_diagram_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem repeatedDraws_diagram_eq_singleton (b : Fin 2) :
    sampleDiagram (ZMod 2) (repeatedDraws b) 0 = diagram (ZMod 2) (Fin 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  let t : Fin 2 → Fin 2 := repeatedDraws b
  letI : Subsingleton (Sample t) := ⟨by
    intro a c
    apply Subtype.ext
    rcases a.property with ⟨i, hi⟩
    rcases c.property with ⟨j, hj⟩
    simpa [t, repeatedDraws] using hi.symm.trans hj⟩
  let e : Sample t ≃ᵢ Fin 1 :=
    { Equiv.ofBijective (fun _ : Sample t => (0 : Fin 1))
        ⟨fun a c _ => Subsingleton.elim a c,
         fun y => ⟨sampleProjection t 0, Subsingleton.elim _ y⟩⟩ with
      isometry_toFun := by
        intro a c
        have hac : a = c := Subsingleton.elim a c
        subst c
        simp }
  exact diagram_eq_of_isometryEquiv (ZMod 2) e 0

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.mass_ge_half_of_two_orders
statement:
private theorem mass_ge_half_of_two_orders (D : Diagram ℝ) (y₀ y₁ : Fin 2)
    (h₀ : sampleDiagram (ZMod 2)
      (Fin.cons (0 : Fin 2) (Fin.cons y₀ Fin.elim0)) 0 = D)
    (h₁ : sampleDiagram (ZMod 2)
      (Fin.cons (1 : Fin 2) (Fin.cons y₁ Fin.elim0)) 0 = D) :
    (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ≤ (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) uniformTwoPoints 2 0) D
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmass : expectation (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) uniformTwoPoints 2 0)
      (fun E => if E = D then 1 else 0) =
      (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) uniformTwoPoints 2 0) D := by
    simp [expectation]
  rw [← hmass]
  unfold sampleLaw
  rw [expectation_map]
  rw [iid_succ, expectation_bind]
  simp only [expectation_map, iid_succ, expectation_bind, iid_zero, expectation_pure]
  unfold expectation
  simp only [tsum_fintype]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_two]
  calc
    (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ = uniformTwoPoints 0 * (uniformTwoPoints y₀ *
        if (sampleDiagram (ZMod 2)
          (Fin.cons (0 : Fin 2) (Fin.cons y₀ Fin.elim0)) 0) = D
          then 1 else 0) + uniformTwoPoints 1 * (uniformTwoPoints y₁ *
        if (sampleDiagram (ZMod 2)
          (Fin.cons (1 : Fin 2) (Fin.cons y₁ Fin.elim0)) 0) = D
          then 1 else 0) := by
      simp only [h₀, h₁, ↓reduceIte, mul_one, uniformTwoPoints, PMF.ofFintype_apply]
      calc
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ = 2 * (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
          rw [ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
          simp
        _ = (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ +
            (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by ring
    _ ≤ uniformTwoPoints 0 * (∑ x_1 : Fin 2, uniformTwoPoints x_1 *
        if (sampleDiagram (ZMod 2)
          (Fin.cons (0 : Fin 2) (Fin.cons x_1 Fin.elim0)) 0) = D
          then 1 else 0) + uniformTwoPoints 1 * (∑ x_1 : Fin 2, uniformTwoPoints x_1 *
        if (sampleDiagram (ZMod 2)
          (Fin.cons (1 : Fin 2) (Fin.cons x_1 Fin.elim0)) 0) = D
          then 1 else 0) := by
      gcongr
      · simpa only [tsum_fintype] using (ENNReal.le_tsum (f := fun x_1 : Fin 2 =>
          uniformTwoPoints x_1 * if (sampleDiagram (ZMod 2)
            (Fin.cons (0 : Fin 2) (Fin.cons x_1 Fin.elim0)) 0) = D
            then 1 else 0) y₀)
      · simpa only [tsum_fintype] using (ENNReal.le_tsum (f := fun x_1 : Fin 2 =>
          uniformTwoPoints x_1 * if (sampleDiagram (ZMod 2)
            (Fin.cons (1 : Fin 2) (Fin.cons x_1 Fin.elim0)) 0) = D
            then 1 else 0) y₁)

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.uniformTwoPoints_nontrivial_fullH0_mass
statement:
theorem uniformTwoPoints_nontrivial_fullH0_mass :
    (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ≤
      (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) uniformTwoPoints 2 0) (diagram (ZMod 2) (Fin 2) 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply mass_ge_half_of_two_orders _ 1 0
  · change sampleDiagram (ZMod 2) distinctDraws 0 = _
    exact sampleDiagram_eq_diagram_of_surjective (ZMod 2) distinctDraws (by
      intro i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [distinctDraws]) 0
  · exact sampleDiagram_eq_diagram_of_surjective (ZMod 2)
      (Fin.cons (1 : Fin 2) (Fin.cons 0 Fin.elim0)) (by
        intro i
        fin_cases i <;> simp) 0

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.uniformTwoPoints_singleton_fullH0_mass
statement:
theorem uniformTwoPoints_singleton_fullH0_mass :
    (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ≤
      (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) uniformTwoPoints 2 0) (diagram (ZMod 2) (Fin 1) 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply mass_ge_half_of_two_orders _ 0 1
  · have ht : (Fin.cons (0 : Fin 2) (Fin.cons 0 Fin.elim0) : Fin 2 → Fin 2) =
        repeatedDraws 0 := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    exact (congrArg (fun t : Fin 2 → Fin 2 => sampleDiagram (ZMod 2) t 0) ht).trans
      (repeatedDraws_diagram_eq_singleton 0)
  · have ht : (Fin.cons (1 : Fin 2) (Fin.cons 1 Fin.elim0) : Fin 2 → Fin 2) =
        repeatedDraws 1 := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    exact (congrArg (fun t : Fin 2 → Fin 2 => sampleDiagram (ZMod 2) t 0) ht).trans
      (repeatedDraws_diagram_eq_singleton 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.distinctDraws_ne_repeatedDraws

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.uniformTwoPoints_sampleLaw_nonconstant
statement:
theorem uniformTwoPoints_sampleLaw_nonconstant :
    ∃ D E : Diagram ℝ, D ≠ E ∧

      0 < (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) uniformTwoPoints 2 0) E
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨diagram (ZMod 2) (Fin 2) 0, diagram (ZMod 2) (Fin 1) 0, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have hc := congrArg (fun D : Diagram ℝ => D.points.card) h
    rw [two_points_diagram, singleton_fullH0_points] at hc
    norm_num at hc
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) uniformTwoPoints_nontrivial_fullH0_mass
  · exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) uniformTwoPoints_singleton_fullH0_mass

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.epsilonRepeatedDraws_diagram_eq_singleton

    intro a c
    apply Subtype.ext
    rcases a.property with ⟨i, hi⟩

    simpa [t, epsilonRepeatedDraws] using hi.symm.trans hj⟩

        ⟨fun a c _ => Subsingleton.elim a c,
         fun y => ⟨sampleProjection t 0, Subsingleton.elim _ y⟩⟩ with

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.epsilonTwoDraws_diagram
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> cases c
  · have h : epsilonTwoDraws false false = epsilonRepeatedDraws false := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
    change sampleDiagram (ZMod 2)
      (Fin.cons false (Fin.cons false Fin.elim0)) 0 = _
    rw [show Fin.cons false (Fin.cons false Fin.elim0) = epsilonRepeatedDraws false by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl, if_pos rfl]

  · have h : Function.Surjective (epsilonTwoDraws false true) := by
      intro x
      cases x
      · exact ⟨0, by simp [epsilonTwoDraws]⟩
      · exact ⟨1, by simp [epsilonTwoDraws]⟩
    rw [if_neg (by decide)]
    exact sampleDiagram_eq_diagram_of_surjective (ZMod 2) _ h 0
  · have h : Function.Surjective (epsilonTwoDraws true false) := by
      intro x
      cases x
      · exact ⟨1, by simp [epsilonTwoDraws]⟩
      · exact ⟨0, by simp [epsilonTwoDraws]⟩
    rw [if_neg (by decide)]
    exact sampleDiagram_eq_diagram_of_surjective (ZMod 2) _ h 0
  · have h : epsilonTwoDraws true true = epsilonRepeatedDraws true := by
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.epsilon_bar_diagonalCost
statement:

proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalCost]
  have hreal : |(1 : ℝ) - 0| / 2 = (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ := by norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.epsilonTwoPoint_bottleneck_singleton
statement:
theorem epsilonTwoPoint_bottleneck_singleton :
    bottleneck (diagram (ZMod 2) Bool 0) (diagram (ZMod 2) (Fin 1) 0) =
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x : Fin 1 → ℝ × ℝ := fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))
  let y : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ := Fin.elim0
  let b : Fin 1 → ℝ := fun _ => 0
  let D : Diagram ℝ := orderedQ 1 1 (x, b)
  let E : Diagram ℝ := orderedQ 0 1 (y, b)
  have hD : diagram (ZMod 2) Bool 0 = D := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    rw [epsilonTwoPoint_fullH0_points]
    simp [D, x, b, orderedQ, List.ofFn_succ]
    change ((0 : ℝ), (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ
        (((0 : ℝ), ((1 : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ 0) =
      ((0 : ℝ), ((1 : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ
        (((0 : ℝ), (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ 0)
    exact Multiset.cons_swap _ _ _
  have hE : diagram (ZMod 2) (Fin 1) 0 = E := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    rw [singleton_fullH0_points]
    simp [E, y, b, orderedQ, List.ofFn_succ]
  have hfD : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map x = finitePart D.points := by
    change (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map x =
      finitePart (orderedQ 1 1 (x, b)).points
    rw [finitePart_orderedQ]
    simp [x]
  have hfE : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map y = finitePart E.points := by
    change (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map y =
      finitePart (orderedQ 0 1 (y, b)).points
    rw [finitePart_orderedQ]
    simp [y]
  have heD : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map b = essentialPart D.points := by
    change (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map b =
      essentialPart (orderedQ 1 1 (x, b)).points
    rw [essentialPart_orderedQ]
    simp [b]
  have heE : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map b = essentialPart E.points := by
    change (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map b =
      essentialPart (orderedQ 0 1 (y, b)).points
    rw [essentialPart_orderedQ]
    simp [b]
  rw [hD, hE, bottleneck_eq_presentation D E x y b b hfD hfE heD heE]
  let M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 1) (Fin 0) (Fin 1) (Fin 1) :=
    { finite := fun _ => none
      finite_injective := by simp
      essential := Equiv.refl _ }
  have hupper : presentationBottleneck
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)))
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : ℝ)) ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ M.cost x y b b := presentationBottleneck_le_cost x y b b M
      _ = (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ := by
        simp [M, OccurrenceMatching.cost, essentialPairCost, x, y, b]
        exact epsilon_bar_diagonalCost
  have hlower : (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ ≤ presentationBottleneck
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)))
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : ℝ)) := by
    have hhalf : (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ = diagonalCost ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) := by
      exact epsilon_bar_diagonalCost.symm
    apply le_iInf
    intro M
    unfold OccurrenceMatching.cost
    apply le_trans ?_ (le_max_left _ _)
    have h := Finset.le_sup (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)))
      (f := fun i => match M.finite i with
        | some j => finitePairCost (x i) (y j)
        | none => diagonalCost (x i))
      (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin 1))
    rw [hhalf]
    cases hm : M.finite 0 with
    | none =>
        simp [hm, x, diagonalCost]
    | some j => exact Fin.elim0 j
  exact le_antisymm hupper hlower

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.epsilonTwoPoint_sampleLaw_nontrivial_mass
statement:
theorem epsilonTwoPoint_sampleLaw_nontrivial_mass (ε : ℝ≥0) (hε : ε ≤ 1) :
    (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) (twoPointWeights ε hε) 2 0) (diagram (ZMod 2) Bool 0) =
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε : ℝ≥0∞) * ((1 - ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let μ := twoPointWeights ε hε
  let D := diagram (ZMod 2) Bool 0
  have hmass : expectation (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) μ 2 0)
      (fun E => if E = D then 1 else 0) = (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) μ 2 0) D := by
    simp [expectation]
  rw [← hmass]
  unfold sampleLaw
  rw [expectation_map, iid_succ, expectation_bind]
  simp only [expectation_map, iid_succ, expectation_bind, iid_zero, expectation_pure]
  simp [expectation, tsum_fintype, epsilonTwoDraws_diagram,
    epsilonSingleton_ne_twoPoint, twoPointWeights, PMF.ofFintype_apply, μ, D]

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.epsilonTwoPoint_realSampleLaw_nontrivial_mass
statement:
theorem epsilonTwoPoint_realSampleLaw_nontrivial_mass (ε : ℝ≥0) (hε : ε ≤ 1) :
    (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) (twoPointLaw ε hε) 2 0) (diagram (ZMod 2) Bool 0) =
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε : ℝ≥0∞) * ((1 - ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show twoPointLaw ε hε = (twoPointWeights ε hε).map epsilonPointUnit by rfl]
  rw [sampleLaw_map_isometry (ZMod 2) (twoPointWeights ε hε) epsilonPointUnit
    epsilonPointUnit_isometry 2 0]
  exact epsilonTwoPoint_sampleLaw_nontrivial_mass ε hε

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.epsilonTwoPoint_sampleLaw_nontrivial_mass_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem epsilonTwoPoint_sampleLaw_nontrivial_mass_tendsto_zero :
    Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ≥0 =>
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε : ℝ≥0∞) * ((1 - ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞))
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ≥0 → ℝ≥0∞ := fun ε =>
    (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε : ℝ≥0∞) * ((1 - ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞)
  have hcoe : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ≥0 => (ε : ℝ≥0∞)) (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.coe_zero] using
      (ENNReal.continuous_coe.continuousAt (x := 0)).tendsto
  have hupper : Tendsto (fun ε : ℝ≥0 => (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε : ℝ≥0∞))
      (𝓝 0) (𝓝 0) := by
    have hm : Continuous (fun x : ℝ≥0∞ => (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * x) :=
      ENNReal.continuous_const_mul (by norm_num)
    have hc : Continuous (fun ε : ℝ≥0 => (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε : ℝ≥0∞)) :=
      hm.comp ENNReal.continuous_coe
    simpa using (hc.continuousAt (x := 0)).tendsto
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hupper
  · intro ε
    exact bot_le
  · intro ε
    have hsubNN : (1 - ε : ℝ≥0) ≤ 1 := tsub_le_self
    have hsub : ((1 - ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 1 := by
      exact_mod_cast hsubNN
    calc
      f ε = ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε : ℝ≥0∞)) * ((1 - ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) := rfl
      _ ≤ ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε : ℝ≥0∞)) * 1 := by gcongr
      _ = (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε : ℝ≥0∞) := by simp

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsSamplingExamples.twoPoint_pair_sampleLaw_bound_degreeZero
statement:
theorem twoPoint_pair_sampleLaw_bound_degreeZero (ε ε' : ℝ≥0) (hε : ε ≤ 1)
    (hε' : ε' ≤ 1) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    wasserstein p bottleneck
        (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) (twoPointLaw ε hε) 2 0)
        (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) (twoPointLaw ε' hε') 2 0) ≤
        2 * gromovWasserstein p (twoPointLaw ε hε) (twoPointLaw ε' hε') ∧
      (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) (twoPointLaw ε hε) 2 0) (diagram (ZMod 2) Bool 0) =
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε : ℝ≥0∞) * ((1 - ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ∧
      (sampleLaw (ZMod 2) (twoPointLaw ε' hε') 2 0) (diagram (ZMod 2) Bool 0) =
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε' : ℝ≥0∞) * ((1 - ε' : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ∧
      ((2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε : ℝ≥0∞) * ((1 - ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) ≠
          (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε' : ℝ≥0∞) * ((1 - ε' : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) →
        sampleLaw (ZMod 2) (twoPointLaw ε hε) 2 0 ≠
          sampleLaw (ZMod 2) (twoPointLaw ε' hε') 2 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := epsilonTwoPoint_realSampleLaw_nontrivial_mass ε hε
  have h₂ := epsilonTwoPoint_realSampleLaw_nontrivial_mass ε' hε'
  refine ⟨?_, h₁, h₂, fun hne hlaw => hne ?_⟩
  · simpa using wasserstein_sampleLaw_le_gromovWasserstein_allDegrees (ZMod 2)
      (twoPointLaw ε hε) (twoPointLaw ε' hε') hp 2 0 le_rfl
  · rw [← h₁, ← h₂, hlaw]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_finiteRestriction_le_card_mul_cost
statement:
theorem totalFiniteCost_finiteRestriction_le_card_mul_cost
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J E F) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E → ℝ) (c : F → ℝ) :
    M.finiteRestriction.totalFiniteCost x y ≤
      ((Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M.cost x y b c).toReal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfinite := (occurrenceMatching_cost_lt_top x y b c M).ne
  have hs (i : I) :
      (match M.finite i with
        | some j => (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal
        | none => (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal) ≤ (M.cost x y b c).toReal := by
    have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono hfinite (M.source_le_cost x y b c i)
    cases hi : M.finite i <;> simpa only [hi] using h
  have ht (j : J) :
      (if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal) ≤
        (M.cost x y b c).toReal := by
    have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono hfinite (M.target_le_cost x y b c j)
    split_ifs with hj <;> simpa only [hj, if_true, if_false, ENNReal.toReal_zero] using h
  unfold totalFiniteCost
  change (∑ i, _) + (∑ j, _) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ (∑ _i : I, (M.cost x y b c).toReal) +
        ∑ _j : J, (M.cost x y b c).toReal :=
      add_le_add (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hs i))
        (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ht j))
    _ = _ := by simp [Nat.cast_add, add_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_card_mul_bottleneck
statement:
theorem finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_card_mul_bottleneck
    (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
        (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1) ≤
      ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (bottleneck D E).toReal
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (bottleneck_optimal_iff D E).mpr
    ((bottleneck_lt_top_iff D E).mp hfinite)
  calc
    _ ≤ M.finiteRestriction.totalFiniteCost _ _ :=
      finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost _ _ M.finiteRestriction
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [hM] using M.totalFiniteCost_finiteRestriction_le_card_mul_cost
        (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1)

name: TDA.Persistence.matchCommonEssential_cost
statement:
private theorem matchCommonEssential_cost (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (he : essentialPart D.points = essentialPart E.points)
    (m : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :
    (matchCommonEssential D E he m).cost (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1)
        (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) =
      m.cost (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [matchCommonEssential, OccurrenceMatching.cost, essentialPairCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.commonEssential_bottleneck_lt_top
statement:
private theorem commonEssential_bottleneck_lt_top (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (he : essentialPart D.points = essentialPart E.points) : bottleneck D E < ⊤
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_lt_top_iff D E).mpr (congrArg Multiset.card he)

name: TDA.Persistence.commonEssential_bottleneck_toReal_le_matching
statement:
private theorem commonEssential_bottleneck_toReal_le_matching {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (D E : Diagram ℝ) (he : essentialPart D.points = essentialPart E.points) :
    (bottleneck D E).toReal ≤ finitePMatchingCost p
      (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1) (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfinite := commonEssential_bottleneck_lt_top D E he
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_minimizing_pMatching p
    (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1) (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
  have hcost := m.cost_le_ofReal_root_totalFinitePowerCost hp
    (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim
  have hroot : m.finiteRestriction.totalFinitePowerCost p
      (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) ^ p⁻¹ =
      finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) := by
    have hrestriction : m.finiteRestriction = m := by
      apply OccurrenceMatching.ext (M := m.finiteRestriction) (N := m)
      · rfl
      · ext k
        exact PEmpty.elim k
    rw [hrestriction]
    exact hm
  rw [hroot] at hcost
  have hB := (bottleneck_le_matching D E (matchCommonEssential D E he m)).trans
    ((matchCommonEssential_cost D E he m).le.trans hcost)
  have hreal := (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hfinite.ne ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mpr hB
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (finitePMatchingCost_nonneg p _ _)] using hreal

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_of_essentialParts_eq
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_of_essentialParts_eq
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (he : essentialPart D.points = essentialPart E.points)
    {m : ℕ}
    (hcard : Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences ≤ m)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hB : bottleneck D E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R) :
proof:
|finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) - (bottleneck D E).toReal| ≤
      ((((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) - 1) * R := by
  have hfinite := commonEssential_bottleneck_lt_top D E he
  have hb : (bottleneck D E).toReal ≤ R := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hR] using
      (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hfinite.ne ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mpr hB
  have hlower := commonEssential_bottleneck_toReal_le_matching hp D E he
  have hcount : ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences +
      Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (max 1 m : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcard.trans (le_max_right 1 m)
  have hexp : 0 ≤ p⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr (zero_le_one.trans hp)
  have hfactor : 1 ≤ ((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ :=
    Real.one_le_rpow (by exact_mod_cast le_max_left 1 m) hexp
  have hupper := (finitePMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck hp D E hfinite).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.rpow_le_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hcount hexp)
      ENNReal.toReal_nonneg)
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlower)]
  calc
    _ ≤ (((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) * (bottleneck D E).toReal -
        (bottleneck D E).toReal := sub_le_sub_right hupper _
    _ = ((((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) - 1) * (bottleneck D E).toReal := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb (sub_nonneg.mpr hfactor)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_of_essentialParts_eq
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_of_essentialParts_eq
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (he : essentialPart D.points = essentialPart E.points)
    {m : ℕ}
    (hcard : Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences ≤ m)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hB : bottleneck D E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R) :
proof:
|finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) - (bottleneck D E).toReal| ≤
      ((((max 1 m : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) - 1) * R := by
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  exact finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_of_essentialParts_eq
    hp D E he hcard hR hB

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_of_essentialParts_eq
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_of_essentialParts_eq
    (m : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun p : ℝ => fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ =>
        finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : z.1.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
          (fun q : z.2.finiteOccurrences => q.1))
      (fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ => (bottleneck z.1 z.2).toReal) atTop
      {z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ |
        essentialPart z.1.points = essentialPart z.2.points ∧
        Fintype.card z.1.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card z.2.finiteOccurrences ≤ m ∧
        bottleneck z.1 z.2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R}
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mpr
  intro ε hε
  filter_upwards [(uniform_errorEnvelope_tendsto m R).eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε),
    eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with p herror hp
  intro z hz
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm]
  exact (finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_of_essentialParts_eq hp z.1 z.2
    hz.1 hz.2.1 hR hz.2.2).trans_lt herror

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_of_essentialParts_eq
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_of_essentialParts_eq
    (m : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun p : ℝ => fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ =>
        finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : z.1.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
          (fun q : z.2.finiteOccurrences => q.1))
      (fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ => (bottleneck z.1 z.2).toReal) atTop
      {z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ |
        essentialPart z.1.points = essentialPart z.2.points ∧
        Fintype.card z.1.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card z.2.finiteOccurrences ≤ m ∧
        bottleneck z.1 z.2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R}
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using
    finitePMatchingCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_of_essentialParts_eq m R hR

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.GaussianSpectral.norm_phase
statement: private theorem norm_phase (σ : ℝ) (p ω : Plane) : ‖phase σ p ω‖ = 1
proof:
:=
  Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I _

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.GaussianSpectral.phase_mul_conj
statement:
private theorem phase_mul_conj (σ : ℝ) (p q ω : Plane) :
    phase σ p ω * conj (phase σ q ω) = phase σ (p - q) ω
proof:
:= by
  rw [phase, phase, ← Complex.exp_conj, ← Complex.exp_add, phase]
  congr 1
  simp only [map_mul, map_div₀, conj_ofReal, conj_I, inner_sub_left,
    Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_sub]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.GaussianSpectral.fullSupport
statement: private theorem fullSupport : (stdGaussian Plane).IsOpenPosMeasure
proof:
:= by
  have : (gaussianReal 0 1).IsOpenPosMeasure :=
    (gaussianReal_absolutelyContinuous' 0 one_ne_zero).isOpenPosMeasure
  unfold stdGaussian
  apply Continuous.isOpenPosMeasure_map (by fun_prop)
  intro p
  refine ⟨fun i => (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Plane).repr p i, ?_⟩
  exact (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ Plane).sum_repr p

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.GaussianSpectral.integral_phase
proof:
:= by
  have h := charFun_stdGaussian (σ⁻¹ • p)
  rw [charFun_apply] at h
  have hphase : (fun ω : Plane => phase σ p ω) =
      fun ω => Complex.exp (⟪ω, σ⁻¹ • p⟫_ℝ * Complex.I) := by
    funext ω
    simp [phase, inner_smul_right, div_eq_mul_inv]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hphase, h]
  norm_cast
  congr 1
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs, inv_pow]
  by_cases hσ : σ = 0
  · simp [hσ]
  · field_simp [hσ]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.GaussianSpectral.phase_mean
statement:
private theorem phase_mean (σ : ℝ) (μ : Measure Plane) (ω : Plane) :
    (∫ p, phase σ p ω ∂μ) = charFun μ (σ⁻¹ • ω)
proof:
:= by
  rw [charFun_apply]
  congr 1
  ext p
  simp [phase, inner_smul_right, div_eq_mul_inv]
  congr 1
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.GaussianSpectral.bounded_continuous_integrable
statement:
private theorem bounded_continuous_integrable {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A]
    [MeasurableSpace A] [BorelSpace A] [SecondCountableTopology A]
    (μ : Measure A) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] {f : A → ℂ} (hf : Continuous f)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ C) : Integrable f μ
proof:
:=
  (integrable_const C).mono' hf.stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hC)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.GaussianSpectral.spectral_cross
statement:
private theorem spectral_cross (σ : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Plane)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] :
    (∫ p, ∫ q, (Real.exp (-‖p - q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2)) : ℂ) ∂ν ∂μ) =
      ∫ ω, charFun μ (σ⁻¹ • ω) * conj (charFun ν (σ⁻¹ • ω)) ∂stdGaussian Plane
proof:
:= by
  have hswap (p : Plane) :
      (∫ q, ∫ ω, phase σ p ω * conj (phase σ q ω) ∂stdGaussian Plane ∂ν) =
        ∫ ω, ∫ q, phase σ p ω * conj (phase σ q ω) ∂ν ∂stdGaussian Plane := by
    apply integral_integral_swap
    apply bounded_continuous_integrable _ (by unfold phase; fun_prop) 1
    intro x
    change ‖phase σ p x.2 * conj (phase σ x.1 x.2)‖ ≤ 1
    simp [norm_phase]
  have hinner (p ω : Plane) :
      (∫ q, phase σ p ω * conj (phase σ q ω) ∂ν) =
        phase σ p ω * conj (charFun ν (σ⁻¹ • ω)) := by
    rw [integral_const_mul, integral_conj, phase_mean]
  calc
    _ = ∫ p, ∫ q, ∫ ω, phase σ p ω * conj (phase σ q ω) ∂stdGaussian Plane ∂ν ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with p
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with q
      simp_rw [phase_mul_conj, integral_phase]
    _ = ∫ p, ∫ ω, phase σ p ω * conj (charFun ν (σ⁻¹ • ω)) ∂stdGaussian Plane ∂μ := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with p
      rw [hswap]
      simp_rw [hinner]
    _ = ∫ ω, ∫ p, phase σ p ω * conj (charFun ν (σ⁻¹ • ω)) ∂μ ∂stdGaussian Plane := by
      apply integral_integral_swap
      apply bounded_continuous_integrable _
        (by unfold phase; fun_prop) (ν.real univ)
      intro x
      change ‖phase σ x.1 x.2 * conj (charFun ν (σ⁻¹ • x.2))‖ ≤ ν.real univ
      simpa only [norm_mul, norm_phase, one_mul, norm_conj] using
        norm_charFun_le (μ := ν) (σ⁻¹ • x.2)
    _ = _ := by simp_rw [integral_mul_const, phase_mean]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.GaussianSpectral.eq_of_gaussian_integrals
statement:
theorem eq_of_gaussian_integrals {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (μ ν : Measure Plane)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (h : ∀ p : Plane,
      (∫ q, Real.exp (-‖p - q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2)) ∂μ) =
        ∫ q, Real.exp (-‖p - q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2)) ∂ν) : μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  let a : Plane → ℂ := fun ω => charFun μ (σ⁻¹ • ω)
  let b : Plane → ℂ := fun ω => charFun ν (σ⁻¹ • ω)
  let γ := stdGaussian Plane
  have ha : Continuous a := (continuous_charFun (μ := μ)).comp (by fun_prop)
  have hb : Continuous b := (continuous_charFun (μ := ν)).comp (by fun_prop)
  have hprod (ξ ζ : Measure Plane) [IsFiniteMeasure ξ] [IsFiniteMeasure ζ] :
      Integrable (fun ω => charFun ξ (σ⁻¹ • ω) * conj (charFun ζ (σ⁻¹ • ω))) γ := by
    apply bounded_continuous_integrable _ (by fun_prop) (ξ.real univ * ζ.real univ)
    intro ω
    rw [norm_mul, norm_conj]
    exact mul_le_mul (norm_charFun_le _) (norm_charFun_le _) (norm_nonneg _)
      (measureReal_nonneg (μ := ξ))
  have hcross (ξ : Measure Plane) [IsFiniteMeasure ξ] :
      (∫ ω, charFun ξ (σ⁻¹ • ω) * conj (a ω) ∂γ) =
        ∫ ω, charFun ξ (σ⁻¹ • ω) * conj (b ω) ∂γ := by
    rw [← spectral_cross, ← spectral_cross]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [] with p
    simpa only [← integral_complex_ofReal] using congrArg Complex.ofReal (h p)
  have hzero : (∫ ω, (a ω - b ω) * conj (a ω - b ω) ∂γ) = 0 := by
    have hexpand : (fun ω => (a ω - b ω) * conj (a ω - b ω)) =
        fun ω => (a ω * conj (a ω) - a ω * conj (b ω)) -
          (b ω * conj (a ω) - b ω * conj (b ω)) := by
      funext ω
      rw [map_sub]
      ring
    rw [hexpand]
    dsimp only [a, b]
    simp only [a, b] at hcross
    have hout := integral_sub ((hprod μ μ).sub (hprod μ ν))
      ((hprod ν μ).sub (hprod ν ν))
    have hleft := integral_sub (hprod μ μ) (hprod μ ν)
    have hright := integral_sub (hprod ν μ) (hprod ν ν)
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hout hleft hright
    rw [hout, hleft, hright, hcross μ, hcross ν]
    simp
  have hi : Integrable (fun ω => ‖a ω - b ω‖ ^ 2) γ := by
    apply (integrable_const ((μ.real univ + ν.real univ) ^ 2)).mono'
      ((ha.sub hb).norm.pow 2).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    filter_upwards [] with ω
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) _ 2
    exact (norm_sub_le _ _).trans (add_le_add (norm_charFun_le _) (norm_charFun_le _))
  have hreal : (∫ ω, ‖a ω - b ω‖ ^ 2 ∂γ) = 0 := by
    have hcast : (fun ω => (a ω - b ω) * conj (a ω - b ω)) =
        fun ω => ((‖a ω - b ω‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      funext ω
      simpa only [Complex.ofReal_pow] using Complex.mul_conj' (a ω - b ω)
    rw [hcast, integral_complex_ofReal] at hzero
    exact_mod_cast hzero
  have hae : a =ᵐ[γ] b := by
    have hz := (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => sq_nonneg ‖a ω - b ω‖) hi).1 hreal
    filter_upwards [hz] with ω hω
    exact sub_eq_zero.1 (norm_eq_zero.1 (eq_zero_of_pow_eq_zero hω))
  have : γ.IsOpenPosMeasure := fullSupport
  have hab : a = b := Measure.eq_of_ae_eq hae ha hb
  apply Measure.ext_of_charFun
  funext t
  have ht := congrFun hab (σ • t)
  simpa [a, b, smul_smul, hσ] using ht

name: TDA.Persistence.singleton_squared_face_smooth
statement:
private theorem singleton_squared_face_smooth
    (s : TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun t : ℝ => (nonlinearSingletonFilter t).value s) Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  change ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) Set.univ

name: TDA.Persistence.singleton_squared_ordering
statement:
private theorem singleton_squared_ordering (t : ℝ) (_ : t ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) :
    OrderingEquivalent (nonlinearSingletonFilter 1) (nonlinearSingletonFilter t)
proof:
:= by
  intro s r
  simp [nonlinearSingletonFilter, Examples.singletonFilter]

name: TDA.Persistence.singleton_squared_face_first
statement:
private theorem singleton_squared_face_first
    (s : TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => (nonlinearSingletonFilter t).value s) 1 1 = 2
proof:
:= by
  change fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ t) ^ 2) 1 1 = 2
  rw [squareLinear_fderiv]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.singleton_squared_face_second
statement:
private theorem singleton_squared_face_second
    (s : TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => (nonlinearSingletonFilter t).value s)) 1 1 1 = 2
proof:
:= by
  change fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ t) ^ 2)) 1 1 1 = 2
  rw [squareLinear_secondFDeriv_apply]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_singleton_face_coefficients
statement:
theorem nonlinear_singleton_face_coefficients
    (e : CompatibleOrder (nonlinearSingletonFilter (1 : ℝ)))
    (s r : TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) :
    faceLossCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0 squaredEssentialBirthSum s = 2 ∧
    faceLossHessianCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0
      squaredEssentialBirthSum s r = 2
proof:
:= by
  have hD := sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_c2_fderiv (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0
    isOpen_univ (Set.mem_univ (1 : ℝ)) singleton_squared_face_smooth
    singleton_squared_ordering squaredEssentialBirthSum (squaredEssentialBirthSum_c2_all _)
  have hf : (fun t : ℝ => squaredEssentialBirthSum
      (dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearSingletonFilter t) 0)) = (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 4) :=
    funext nonlinear_singleton_scalar_loss
  rw [hf] at hD
  have hp : HasFDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 4)
      ((4 : ℝ) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) 1 := by
    simpa using (hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) (1 : ℝ)).pow 4
  rw [hp.fderiv] at hD
  have hfirst : 4 = faceLossCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0
      squaredEssentialBirthSum default * 2 := by
    simpa only [Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton, smul_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, singleton_squared_face_first, mul_one] using
      congrArg (fun A : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ => A 1) hD
  have hb : faceLossCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0
      squaredEssentialBirthSum default = 2 := by linarith
  have hH := sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_second_fderiv (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0
    isOpen_univ (Set.mem_univ (1 : ℝ)) singleton_squared_face_smooth
    singleton_squared_ordering squaredEssentialBirthSum (squaredEssentialBirthSum_c2_all _)
  have hval := congrArg (fun A : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ => A 1 1) hH
  rw [faceCoordinateLossHessian_apply] at hval
  have hscalar := nonlinear_singleton_second_derivative
  change fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => squaredEssentialBirthSum
    (dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearSingletonFilter t) 0))) 1 1 1 = 12 at hscalar
  rw [hscalar] at hval
  have hsecond : 12 = faceLossHessianCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0
      squaredEssentialBirthSum default default * 2 * 2 + 2 * 2 := by
    simpa only [Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton, singleton_squared_face_first,
      singleton_squared_face_second, hb] using hval
  have hg : faceLossHessianCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0
      squaredEssentialBirthSum default default = 2 := by linarith
  simpa only [Subsingleton.elim s default, Subsingleton.elim r default] using And.intro hb hg

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_singleton_face_hessian_terms
statement:
theorem nonlinear_singleton_face_hessian_terms
    (e : CompatibleOrder (nonlinearSingletonFilter (1 : ℝ))) :
    (∑ s : TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)),
      ∑ r : TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)),
      faceLossHessianCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0
        squaredEssentialBirthSum s r *
        fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => (nonlinearSingletonFilter t).value s) 1 1 *
        fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => (nonlinearSingletonFilter t).value r) 1 1) = 8 ∧
    (∑ s : TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)),
      faceLossCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0 squaredEssentialBirthSum s *
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => (nonlinearSingletonFilter t).value s)) 1 1 1) = 4
proof:
:= by
  have hc := nonlinear_singleton_face_coefficients e default default
  simp only [Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton, singleton_squared_face_first,
    singleton_squared_face_second, hc.1, hc.2]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_singleton_face_hessian
statement:
theorem nonlinear_singleton_face_hessian
    (e : CompatibleOrder (nonlinearSingletonFilter (1 : ℝ))) :
    faceCoordinateLossHessian (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0 squaredEssentialBirthSum 1 1 = 12
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceCoordinateLossHessian_apply, (nonlinear_singleton_face_hessian_terms e).1,
    (nonlinear_singleton_face_hessian_terms e).2]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_singleton_face_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem nonlinear_singleton_face_hasFDerivAt
    (e : CompatibleOrder (nonlinearSingletonFilter (1 : ℝ))) :
    HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => squaredEssentialBirthSum
      (dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearSingletonFilter t) 0)))
      (faceCoordinateLossHessian (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0 squaredEssentialBirthSum) 1
proof:
:=
  sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_hasFDerivAt_fderiv (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0
    isOpen_univ (Set.mem_univ (1 : ℝ)) singleton_squared_face_smooth
    singleton_squared_ordering squaredEssentialBirthSum (squaredEssentialBirthSum_c2_all _)

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_singleton_face_example
statement:
theorem nonlinear_singleton_face_example :
    ∃ e : CompatibleOrder (nonlinearSingletonFilter (1 : ℝ)),
      faceCoordinateLossHessian (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0 squaredEssentialBirthSum 1 1 = 12 ∧
      HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => squaredEssentialBirthSum
        (dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearSingletonFilter t) 0)))
        (faceCoordinateLossHessian (ZMod 2) nonlinearSingletonFilter e 0 squaredEssentialBirthSum) 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_compatibleOrder (nonlinearSingletonFilter (1 : ℝ))

    nonlinear_singleton_face_hasFDerivAt e⟩

statement:
private theorem split_shortExact (A B : PModule.{0,0,0} ℚ (Fin 2)) :
    IsPointwiseShortExact (biprod.inl : A ⟶ A ⊞ B) (biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ p : Fin 2,
      ((ShortComplex.mk (biprod.inl : A ⟶ A ⊞ B) (biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B) (by simp)).map
        ((evaluation (Fin 2) (ModuleCat.{0} ℚ)).obj p)).ShortExact := fun p =>
    ((ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct A B).map
      ((evaluation (Fin 2) (ModuleCat.{0} ℚ)).obj p)).shortExact
  exact ⟨fun p => (h p).moduleCat_injective_f, fun p => (h p).moduleCat_surjective_g,
    fun p => (h p).exact.moduleCat_range_eq_ker⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RankExactPushoutExamples.middle_finiteDimensional
statement:
private theorem middle_finiteDimensional {A B C : PModule.{0,0,0} ℚ (Fin 2)}
    {ι : A ⟶ B} {π : B ⟶ C} (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional ℚ (A.obj p)] [∀ p, FiniteDimensional ℚ (C.obj p)]
    (p : Fin 2) : FiniteDimensional ℚ (B.obj p)
proof:
:=
  Module.Finite.of_exact (f := (ι.app p).hom) (g := (π.app p).hom)
    (LinearMap.exact_iff.mpr (hs.range_eq_ker p).symm) (hs.surjective p)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankExactPushoutExamples.truncation_pushout_rankExact_dying
statement:
theorem truncation_pushout_rankExact_dying :
    (∃ l : upset.obj 0, l ≠ 0) ∧ truncation ≠ 0 ∧
    IsRankExact (Limits.pushout.inr (biprod.inl : upset ⟶ upset ⊞ dying) truncation)
      (splitRow.toIsPointwiseShortExact.pushoutQuotient truncation) ∧
    (∃ y : (Limits.pushout (biprod.inl : upset ⟶ upset ⊞ dying) truncation).obj 0,
      y ≠ 0 ∧
        ((splitRow.toIsPointwiseShortExact.pushoutQuotient truncation).app 0).hom y = 0) ∧
    ∃ x : (Limits.pushout (biprod.inl : upset ⟶ upset ⊞ dying) truncation).obj 0,
      ((splitRow.toIsPointwiseShortExact.pushoutQuotient truncation).app 0).hom x ≠ 0 ∧
        structureMapLinear (Limits.pushout (biprod.inl : upset ⟶ upset ⊞ dying) truncation)
          (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrow := splitRow.pushout truncation
  refine ⟨⟨HookInfinity.birth (R := ℚ) (0 : Fin 2), HookInfinity.birth_ne_zero _⟩, ?_, hrow,
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have he : ((truncation.app 0).hom (HookInfinity.birth (R := ℚ) (0 : Fin 2))) =
        dyingVector := HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth _ _ _
    rw [h] at he
    exact dyingVector_ne_zero (by simpa using he.symm)
  · refine ⟨((Limits.pushout.inr (biprod.inl : upset ⟶ upset ⊞ dying) truncation).app 0).hom
      dyingVector, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hy
      have hy' : ((Limits.pushout.inr (biprod.inl : upset ⟶ upset ⊞ dying) truncation).app 0).hom
          dyingVector =
          ((Limits.pushout.inr (biprod.inl : upset ⟶ upset ⊞ dying) truncation).app 0).hom 0 := by
        rw [map_zero]
        exact hy
      exact dyingVector_ne_zero (hrow.toIsPointwiseShortExact.injective 0 hy')
    · exact congrArg (fun g : dying ⟶ dying => (g.app 0).hom dyingVector)
        (splitRow.toIsPointwiseShortExact.pushoutQuotient_inr truncation)
  · obtain ⟨x, hx, hdie⟩ := hrow.lift_kernel (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide)
      dyingVector dyingVector_dies
    exact ⟨x, by rw [hx]; exact dyingVector_ne_zero, hdie⟩

      (fun A : FaceIndex 1 0 => faceModule (k := ℚ) lowerGenerator A) oneFace) := inferInstance
  have hinj := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp
    ((NatTrans.mono_iff_mono_app _).mp (inferInstance : Mono
      (biproduct.ι (fun A : FaceIndex 1 0 => faceModule (k := ℚ) lowerGenerator A)
        oneFace)) 0)
  have hz' : ((biproduct.ι
      (fun A : FaceIndex 1 0 => faceModule (k := ℚ) lowerGenerator A) oneFace).app 0).hom
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := ℚ) (faceJoin lowerGenerator oneFace)) = 0 := by
    change lowerTargetBirth = 0

          (fun A : FaceIndex 1 0 => faceModule (k := ℚ) lowerGenerator A) oneFace).app 0).hom 0 := by

  have hbirth : HookInfinity.birth (R := ℚ)
      (faceJoin lowerGenerator oneFace) = 0 := hinj heq
  have hbirth' : HookInfinity.birth (R := ℚ) (0 : ℕ) = 0 := by

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.Examples.splitRow_shortExact
