private theorem splitRow_shortExact : IsPointwiseShortExact splitInclusion splitProjection where
  injective
proof:
:= by
    intro p x y hxy
    change (LinearMap.inl ℚ ℚ ℚ) x = (LinearMap.inl ℚ ℚ ℚ) y at hxy
    exact LinearMap.inl_injective hxy
  surjective := by
    intro p y
    refine ⟨(0, y), ?_⟩
    change (LinearMap.snd ℚ ℚ ℚ) (0, y) = y
    rfl
  range_eq_ker := by
    intro p
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      change (LinearMap.snd ℚ ℚ ℚ) ((LinearMap.inl ℚ ℚ ℚ) x) = 0
      simp
    · intro hz
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hz
      rcases z with ⟨x, y⟩
      change y = 0 at hz
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      change (x, 0) = (x, y)
      simp [hz]

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectiveHomDimension.homMaps_exact_at
statement:
theorem homMaps_exact_at (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    Function.Exact
      ((H (k := k) (S := S)).map (firstEmbedding M)).hom
      (homDifferential M).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : Function.Exact
      (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) (firstEmbedding M))
      (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) (quotientProjection M)) := by
    let hs := cokernelRow M
    have hExact := homShortComplex_exact (k := k) (S := S) hs
    rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff] at hExact
    intro f
    constructor
    · intro hf
      have hfπ : f ≫ quotientProjection M = 0 := by
        simpa only [postcompose_apply] using hf
      have hfπ' : ((H (k := k) (S := S)).map (quotientProjection M)).hom f = 0 := by
        change f ≫ quotientProjection M = 0
        exact hfπ
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hExact f hfπ'
      exact ⟨g, by
        change ((H (k := k) (S := S)).map (firstEmbedding M)).hom g = f
        exact hg⟩
    · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
      have hg' : g ≫ firstEmbedding M = f := by
        simpa only [postcompose_apply] using hg
      change f ≫ quotientProjection M = 0
      calc
        f ≫ quotientProjection M = (g ≫ firstEmbedding M) ≫ quotientProjection M := by
          rw [hg']
        _ = g ≫ (firstEmbedding M ≫ quotientProjection M) := Category.assoc _ _ _
        _ = 0 := by rw [(cokernelRow M).comp_eq_zero]; simp
  intro f
  constructor
  · intro hf
    have hδ : f ≫ differential M = 0 := by
      change f ≫ differential M = 0
      exact hf
    haveI : Mono (secondEmbedding M) := secondEmbedding_mono M
    have hπ : f ≫ quotientProjection M = 0 := by
      apply (cancel_mono (secondEmbedding M)).mp
      calc
        (f ≫ quotientProjection M) ≫ secondEmbedding M = f ≫ differential M := by
          simp [differential, Category.assoc]
        _ = 0 := hδ
        _ = 0 ≫ secondEmbedding M := by simp
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := (hbase f).mp (by simpa only [postcompose_apply] using hπ)
    exact ⟨g, by
      change g ≫ firstEmbedding M = f at hg
      exact hg⟩
  · rintro ⟨g, hg⟩
    have hg' : g ≫ firstEmbedding M = f := by
      change g ≫ firstEmbedding M = f at hg
      exact hg
    change f ≫ differential M = 0
    rw [← hg', Category.assoc, firstEmbedding_comp_differential]
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectiveHomDimension.hom_firstEmbedding_mono
statement:
theorem hom_firstEmbedding_mono (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    Mono ((H (k := k) (S := S)).map (firstEmbedding M))
proof:
:= by
  apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mpr
  intro f g h
  change f ≫ firstEmbedding M = g ≫ firstEmbedding M at h
  exact (cancel_mono (firstEmbedding M)).mp h

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectiveHomDimension.firstShortComplex_shortExact
statement:
theorem firstShortComplex_shortExact (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] : (firstShortComplex M).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let f := homDifferential M
  have hex : Function.Exact
      ((H (k := k) (S := S)).map (firstEmbedding M)).hom f.hom :=
    homMaps_exact_at M
  have hExact : (firstShortComplex M).Exact := by
    rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff]
    intro x hx
    have hx' : (homImageFactor M).hom x = 0 := by
      change (firstShortComplex M).g x = 0 at hx
      exact hx
    have hfx : f.hom x = 0 := by
      have hfac : f.hom x = (Abelian.image.ι f).hom
          ((Abelian.factorThruImage f).hom x) := by
        have h := congrArg (fun q => q.hom x) (Abelian.image.fac f).symm
        calc
          f.hom x = ((Abelian.factorThruImage f ≫ Abelian.image.ι f).hom) x := h
          _ = (Abelian.image.ι f).hom ((Abelian.factorThruImage f).hom x) := by
            rw [ModuleCat.hom_comp]
            exact LinearMap.comp_apply _ _ _
      rw [hfac, hx']
      simp
    exact (hex x).mp hfx
  have hmono : Mono ((H (k := k) (S := S)).map (firstEmbedding M)) :=
    hom_firstEmbedding_mono M
  have hepi : Epi (homImageFactor M) := inferInstance
  haveI : Mono (firstShortComplex M).f := hmono
  haveI : Epi (firstShortComplex M).g := hepi
  exact ⟨hExact⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectiveHomDimension.secondShortComplex_shortExact
statement:
theorem secondShortComplex_shortExact (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] : (secondShortComplex M).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let f := homDifferential M
  let Q := ShortComplex.mk f (cokernel.π f) (cokernel.condition f)
  have hExact : (secondShortComplex M).Exact := by
    exact (Q.exact_iff_exact_image_ι).mp (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel f)
  have hmono : Mono (homImageInclusion M) := inferInstance
  have hepi : Epi (homCokernelProjection M) := inferInstance
  haveI : Mono (secondShortComplex M).f := hmono
  haveI : Epi (secondShortComplex M).g := hepi
  exact ⟨hExact⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectiveHomDimension.hom_firstInjective_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem hom_firstInjective_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (firstInjective M))
      (maxComplementCard (S := S) - 1)
proof:
:=
  FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_max (firstInjective M)

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectiveHomDimension.hom_secondInjective_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem hom_secondInjective_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (secondInjective M))
      (maxComplementCard (S := S) - 1)
proof:
:=
  FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_max (secondInjective M)

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectiveHomDimension.hom_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_actualCokernel
statement:
theorem hom_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_actualCokernel
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (d : ℕ)
    (hD : maxComplementCard (S := S) - 1 ≤ d)
    (hC : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (homCokernel M) (d + 2)) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj M) d
proof:
:= by
  have hI₀ : HasProjectiveDimensionLT
      ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (firstInjective M)) (d + 1) := by
    letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (firstInjective M))
        (maxComplementCard (S := S) - 1 + 1) := hom_firstInjective_hasProjectiveDimensionLE M
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ _ _ (Nat.succ_le_succ hD)
  have hI₁ : HasProjectiveDimensionLT
      ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (secondInjective M)) (d + 2) :=
    by
      letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT ((H (k := k) (S := S)).obj (secondInjective M))
          (maxComplementCard (S := S) - 1 + 1) := hom_secondInjective_hasProjectiveDimensionLE M
      exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ _ _ (by
        exact (Nat.succ_le_succ hD).trans (Nat.le_succ _))
  have hC' : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (homCokernel M) (d + 3) := hC
  have hImage : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (homImage M) (d + 2) :=
    (secondShortComplex_shortExact M).hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₁ (d + 2) hI₁ hC'
  exact (firstShortComplex_shortExact M).hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₁ (d + 1) hI₀ hImage

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectiveHomDimension.minimalResolution_termAt_isZero_of_actualCokernel
statement:
theorem minimalResolution_termAt_isZero_of_actualCokernel
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)]
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) (d : ℕ)
    (hD : maxComplementCard (S := S) - 1 ≤ d)
    (hC : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (homCokernel M) (d + 2)) :
    ∀ j, d < j → IsZero (R.termAt j)
proof:
:=
  (FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_iff R d).mp
    (hom_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_actualCokernel M d hD hC)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_add
statement:
private theorem finitePart_add {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    (s t : Multiset (α × WithTop α)) :
    finitePart (s + t) = finitePart s + finitePart t
proof:
:= by
  exact Multiset.filterMap_add _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_add
statement:
private theorem essentialPart_add {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    (s t : Multiset (α × WithTop α)) :
    essentialPart (s + t) = essentialPart s + essentialPart t
proof:
:= by
  exact Multiset.filterMap_add _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.filterMap_none
statement:
private theorem filterMap_none {β γ : Type*} (s : Multiset β) :
    s.filterMap (fun _ => (none : Option γ)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | @cons a s ih => simpa using ih

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_finiteEmbed
statement:
private theorem finitePart_finiteEmbed {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    (s : Multiset (α × α)) : finitePart (s.map finiteEmbed) = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePart, Multiset.filterMap_map]
  simpa only [finiteEmbed, Function.comp_def] using (Multiset.filterMap_some s)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_essentialEmbed
statement:
private theorem finitePart_essentialEmbed {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    (s : Multiset α) : finitePart (s.map essentialEmbed) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePart, Multiset.filterMap_map]
  simpa only [essentialEmbed, Function.comp_def] using (filterMap_none (γ := α × α) s)

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_finiteEmbed
statement:
private theorem essentialPart_finiteEmbed {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    (s : Multiset (α × α)) : essentialPart (s.map finiteEmbed) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [essentialPart, Multiset.filterMap_map]
  simpa only [finiteEmbed, Function.comp_def] using (filterMap_none (γ := α) s)

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_essentialEmbed
statement:
private theorem essentialPart_essentialEmbed {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    (s : Multiset α) : essentialPart (s.map essentialEmbed) = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [essentialPart, Multiset.filterMap_map]
  simpa only [essentialEmbed, Function.comp_def] using (Multiset.filterMap_some s)

name: TDA.Persistence.parts_reconstruct
statement:
theorem parts_reconstruct {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    (s : Multiset (α × WithTop α)) :
    (finitePart s).map (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop α))) +
      (essentialPart s).map (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop α))) = s
proof:
:= by
  change (finitePart s).map finiteEmbed + (essentialPart s).map essentialEmbed = s
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [finitePart, essentialPart]
  | @cons p s ih =>
    obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := p
    cases d with
    | top =>
      simpa [finitePart, essentialPart, finiteEmbed, essentialEmbed,
        Multiset.map_cons, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using ih
    | coe d =>
      simpa [finitePart, essentialPart, finiteEmbed, essentialEmbed,
        Multiset.map_cons, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using ih

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_orderedQ
statement:
theorem finitePart_orderedQ {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α)) :
    finitePart (orderedQ m n z).points =
      (Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.1)).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)
proof:
:= by
  change finitePart (((Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.1)).filter
    (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)).map finiteEmbed +
    (Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.2)).map essentialEmbed) = _
  rw [finitePart_add, finitePart_finiteEmbed, finitePart_essentialEmbed, add_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_orderedQ
statement:
theorem essentialPart_orderedQ {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α)) :
    essentialPart (orderedQ m n z).points =
      Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.2)
proof:
:= by
  change essentialPart (((Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.1)).filter
    (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)).map finiteEmbed +
    (Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.2)).map essentialEmbed) = _
  rw [essentialPart_add, essentialPart_finiteEmbed, essentialPart_essentialEmbed, zero_add]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_offDiagonal
statement:
private theorem finitePart_offDiagonal {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (D : Diagram α) :
    ∀ p ∈ finitePart D.points, p.1 ≠ p.2
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩ := (Multiset.mem_filterMap _ _).mp hp
  obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := q
  cases d with
  | top => simp at hqp
  | coe d =>
    have hd := D.offDiagonal (b, (d : WithTop α)) hq
    simp at hqp
    subst p
    simpa using hd

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_filter
statement:
private theorem finitePart_filter {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (D : Diagram α) :
    (finitePart D.points).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2) = finitePart D.points
proof:
:= by
  exact Multiset.filter_eq_self.mpr (finitePart_offDiagonal D)

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_append
statement:
theorem orderedQ_append {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n m' n' : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α))
    (w : (Fin m' → α × α) × (Fin n' → α)) :
    (orderedQ (m + m') (n + n')
      (Fin.append z.1 w.1, Fin.append z.2 w.2)).points =
      (orderedQ m n z).points + (orderedQ m' n' w).points
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orderedQ, List.ofFn_fin_append, ← Multiset.coe_add,
    Multiset.filter_add, Multiset.map_add]
  ac_rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_eq_iff
statement:
theorem orderedQ_eq_iff {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n m' n' : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α))
    (w : (Fin m' → α × α) × (Fin n' → α)) :
    orderedQ m n z = orderedQ m' n' w ↔
      (Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.1)).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2) =
        (Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn w.1)).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2) ∧
      Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.2) =
        Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn w.2)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · exact (finitePart_orderedQ m n z).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun D : Diagram α => finitePart D.points) h).trans
          (finitePart_orderedQ m' n' w))
    · exact (essentialPart_orderedQ m n z).symm.trans
        ((congrArg (fun D : Diagram α => essentialPart D.points) h).trans
          (essentialPart_orderedQ m' n' w))
  · rintro ⟨hf, he⟩
    apply Diagram.ext
    change _ + _ = _ + _
    rw [hf, he]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_enumerate
proof:
:= by
  let l := (finitePart D.points).toList
  refine ⟨l.length, l.get, ?_⟩
  rw [List.ofFn_get, Multiset.coe_toList, finitePart_filter]

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_enumerate
proof:
:= by
  let l := (essentialPart D.points).toList
  refine ⟨l.length, l.get, ?_⟩
  rw [List.ofFn_get, Multiset.coe_toList]

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_surjective
statement:
theorem orderedQ_surjective {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (D : Diagram α) :
    ∃ (m n : ℕ) (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α)),
      orderedQ m n z = D
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, x, hx⟩ := finitePart_enumerate D
  obtain ⟨n, y, hy⟩ := essentialPart_enumerate D
  refine ⟨m, n, (x, y), ?_⟩
  apply Diagram.ext
  change _ + _ = D.points
  rw [hx, hy]
  exact parts_reconstruct D.points

name: TDA.Persistence.ofFn_removeNth
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have henum {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → β) :
      Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn f) = (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin r)).val.map f := by
    rw [List.ofFn_eq_map]
    change Multiset.map f (↑(List.finRange r) : Multiset (Fin r)) = _
    rw [← Finset.val_univ_fin]
  rw [henum x, henum (Fin.removeNth k x), Fin.univ_succAbove m k]
  simp only [Finset.cons_val, Multiset.map_cons, Finset.map_val, Multiset.map_map]
  change x k ::ₘ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).val.map (x ∘ k.succAbove) =
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).val.map (fun i => x (k.succAbove i)) + {x k}
  rw [← Multiset.singleton_add]
  exact add_comm _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_zeroLength
statement:
theorem orderedQ_zeroLength {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (x : Fin (m + 1) → α × α) (y : Fin n → α)
    (k : Fin (m + 1)) (hk : (x k).1 = (x k).2) :
    orderedQ m n (Fin.removeNth k x, y) =
      orderedQ (m + 1) n (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  apply (orderedQ_eq_iff m n (m + 1) n (Fin.removeNth k x, y) (x, y)).mpr
  constructor
  · rw [ofFn_removeNth x k, Multiset.filter_add]
    simp [hk]
  · rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.zero_mem_gridCoordinates
statement: theorem zero_mem_gridCoordinates (i : Fin n) : 0 ∈ D.gridCoordinates hD i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.embedding_generatorGridPoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem embedding_generatorGridPoint (g : D.generators.Carrier) :
    (D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding (D.generatorGridPoint hD g) = D.generators.grade g

@[simp] theorem embedding_relationGridPoint (y : D.relations.Carrier) :

proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.generator_mem_grid
statement:
private theorem generator_mem_grid (g : D.generators.Carrier) :
    D.generators.grade g ∈ Set.range (D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding

  ⟨D.generatorGridPoint hD g, rfl⟩

private theorem relation_mem_grid (y : D.relations.Carrier) :
    D.relations.grade y ∈ Set.range (D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.grid_isLeftKanExtension
statement:
theorem grid_isLeftKanExtension : D.presented.IsLeftKanExtension
    (L := (D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding.monotone.functor) (𝟙 (D.gridModule hD))
proof:
:=
  D.isLeftKanExtension (D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding
    (generator_mem_grid D hD) (relation_mem_grid D hD)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.gridHomEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem gridHomEquiv_apply (N : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) (f : D.presented ⟶ N) :
    D.gridHomEquiv hD N f = (D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding.monotone.functor.whiskerLeft f
proof:
:=
  D.restrictionHomEquiv_apply _ _ _ N f

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.gridHomEquiv_symm_restrict
statement:
theorem gridHomEquiv_symm_restrict (N : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (α : D.gridModule hD ⟶ (D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding.monotone.functor ⋙ N) :
    (D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding.monotone.functor.whiskerLeft
      ((D.gridHomEquiv hD N).symm α) = α
proof:
:=
  D.restrictionHomEquiv_symm_restrict _ _ _ N α

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_finiteGridKan
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_finiteGridKan
    (M : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    ∃ (G : CoordinateGrid n) (N : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R G.Point),
      Nonempty (G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtension N ≅ M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hM
  exact ⟨D.gridCoordinates hD, D.gridModule hD, ⟨D.gridKanIso hD ≪≫ e⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_pfd_finiteGridKan
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_pfd_finiteGridKan
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (M : PModule.{u,0,max u w} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    ∃ (G : CoordinateGrid n) (N : PModule.{u,0,max u w} k G.Point),
      (∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj p)) ∧
        Nonempty (G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtension N ≅ M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hM
  refine ⟨D.gridCoordinates hD, D.gridModule hD, ?_, ⟨D.gridKanIso hD ≪≫ e⟩⟩
  intro p
  exact D.finiteDimensional_of_finite_generators hD.1 ((D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding p)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_pfd_nonempty_finiteGridKan
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_pfd_nonempty_finiteGridKan
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (M : PModule.{u,0,max u w} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    ∃ (G : CoordinateGrid n) (N : PModule.{u,0,max u w} k G.Point),
      (∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj p)) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin n, (G i).Nonempty) ∧
          Nonempty (G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtension N ≅ M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hM
  refine ⟨D.gridCoordinates hD, D.gridModule hD, ?_, ?_, ⟨D.gridKanIso hD ≪≫ e⟩⟩
  · intro p
    exact D.finiteDimensional_of_finite_generators hD.1
      ((D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding p)
  · intro i
    exact ⟨0, D.zero_mem_gridCoordinates hD i⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.exists_relation_distortion_le_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem exists_relation_distortion_le_hausdorffDist
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} {Z : Type w}
    [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [Nonempty X]
    [MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] [MetricSpace Z]
    {f : X → Z} {g : Y → Z} (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g) :
    ∃ C : SetRel X Y,
      Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x, y) ∈ C) ∧
      Relator.LeftTotal (fun y x => (y, x) ∈ C.inv) ∧
      ∀ x x' y y', (x, y) ∈ C → (x', y') ∈ C →
        |dist x x' - dist y y'| ≤ 2 * hausdorffDist (range f) (range g)
proof:
:= by
  let r := hausdorffDist (range f) (range g)
  let C : SetRel X Y := {p | dist (f p.1) (g p.2) ≤ r}
  have hfin : hausdorffEDist (range f) (range g) ≠ ⊤ :=
    hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded (range_nonempty _) (range_nonempty _)
      (isCompact_range hf.continuous).isBounded (isCompact_range hg.continuous).isBounded
  refine ⟨C, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨y, rfl⟩, hy⟩ :=
      (isCompact_range hg.continuous).exists_infDist_eq_dist (range_nonempty g) (f x)
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    change dist (f x) (g y) ≤ r
    rw [← hy]
    exact infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem (mem_range_self x) hfin
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, hx⟩ :=
      (isCompact_range hf.continuous).exists_infDist_eq_dist (range_nonempty f) (g y)
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    change dist (f x) (g y) ≤ r
    rw [dist_comm, ← hx]
    dsimp only [r]
    rw [hausdorffDist_comm]
    exact infDist_le_hausdorffDist_of_mem (mem_range_self y)
      (by simpa only [hausdorffEDist_comm] using hfin)
  · intro x x' y y' hxy hx'y'
    change dist (f x) (g y) ≤ r at hxy
    change dist (f x') (g y') ≤ r at hx'y'
    rw [← hf.dist_eq, ← hg.dist_eq]
    apply abs_sub_le_iff.mpr
    constructor
    · have h₁ := dist_triangle (f x) (g y) (f x')
      have h₂ := dist_triangle (g y) (g y') (f x')
      rw [dist_comm (g y') (f x')] at h₂
      linarith
    · have h₁ := dist_triangle (g y) (f x) (g y')
      have h₂ := dist_triangle (f x) (f x') (g y')
      rw [dist_comm (g y) (f x)] at h₁
      linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_dgm_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {Z : Type w} [MetricSpace Z] {f : X → Z} {g : Y → Z}
    (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
      (dgm k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace Y)) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * hausdorffDist (range f) (range g))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hI, hdist⟩ := exists_relation_distortion_le_hausdorffDist hf hg
  let ε : ℝ≥0 := ⟨2 * hausdorffDist (range f) (range g),
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hausdorffDist_nonneg⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞) := bottleneck_dgm_le_of_relation (C := C) (ε := ε)
      inferInstance inferInstance hC hI hdist k n
    _ = _ := ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq ε

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_dgm_le_two_mul_ghDist
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_le_two_mul_ghDist (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
      (dgm k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace Y)) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ghDist X Y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hausdorffDist_optimal] using
    bottleneck_dgm_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist k
      (isometry_optimalGHInjl X Y) (isometry_optimalGHInjr X Y) n

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.dgm_eq_of_isometryEquiv
statement:
theorem dgm_eq_of_isometryEquiv (k : Type u) [Field k] (e : X ≃ᵢ Y) (n : ℕ) :
    dgm k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n =
      dgm k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace Y)) n
proof:
:= by
  apply (bottleneck_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp
  apply le_antisymm _ zero_le
  have h := bottleneck_dgm_le_of_relation (C := Function.graph e) (ε := 0)
    (inferInstance : MetricSpace X) (inferInstance : MetricSpace Y)
    (fun x => ⟨e x, rfl⟩)
    (fun y => ⟨e.symm y, e.apply_symm_apply y⟩)
    (by
      rintro x x' y y' rfl rfl
      simp only [e.dist_eq, sub_self, abs_zero, NNReal.coe_zero, le_refl]) k n
  simpa only [ENNReal.coe_zero] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.diagram_isPositive
statement:
theorem diagram_isPositive (k : Type v) [Field k] (X : Type u)
    [Fintype X] [MetricSpace X] (n : ℕ) : (diagram k X n).IsPositive
proof:
:=
  dgm_isPositive k (Rips.filter (labelsMetric (inferInstance : MetricSpace X) :
    MetricSpace (FiniteLabels.{u, v} X))) n

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.diagram_eq_dgm
statement:
theorem diagram_eq_dgm (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Type u) [Fintype X]
    [MetricSpace X] [LinearOrder X] (n : ℕ) :
    diagram k X n = dgm k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_diagram_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem bottleneck_diagram_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist (k : Type z) [Field k]
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} {Z : Type w}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [MetricSpace X] [MetricSpace Y]
    [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y] [MetricSpace Z]
    {f : X → Z} {g : Y → Z} (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (diagram k X n) (diagram k Y n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * hausdorffDist (range f) (range g))
proof:
:= by
  let : MetricSpace (FiniteLabels.{u, z} X) := labelsMetric (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)
  let : MetricSpace (FiniteLabels.{v, z} Y) := labelsMetric (inferInstance : MetricSpace Y)
  let : Nonempty (FiniteLabels.{u, z} X) := (labelsEquiv X).nonempty
  let : Nonempty (FiniteLabels.{v, z} Y) := (labelsEquiv Y).nonempty
  have h := bottleneck_dgm_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist k
    (hf.comp (labelsIsometryEquiv X).isometry)
    (hg.comp (labelsIsometryEquiv Y).isometry) n
  simpa only [diagram, range_comp, IsometryEquiv.range_eq_univ, image_univ] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_diagram_le_two_mul_ghDist
statement:
theorem bottleneck_diagram_le_two_mul_ghDist (k : Type z) [Field k]
    (X : Type u) (Y : Type v) [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [MetricSpace X] [MetricSpace Y] [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y] (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (diagram k X n) (diagram k Y n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ghDist X Y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hausdorffDist_optimal] using
    bottleneck_diagram_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist k
      (isometry_optimalGHInjl X Y) (isometry_optimalGHInjr X Y) n

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.diagram_eq_of_isometryEquiv
statement:
theorem diagram_eq_of_isometryEquiv (k : Type z) [Field k]
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [MetricSpace X] [MetricSpace Y]
    (e : X ≃ᵢ Y) (n : ℕ) : diagram k X n = diagram k Y n

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_diagram_le_of_relation
statement:
theorem bottleneck_diagram_le_of_relation (k : Type z) [Field k]
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y]
    [MetricSpace X] [MetricSpace Y] {C : SetRel X Y} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (hC : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x, y) ∈ C))
    (hI : Relator.LeftTotal (fun y x => (y, x) ∈ C.inv))
    (h : ∀ x x' y y', (x, y) ∈ C → (x', y') ∈ C →
      |dist x x' - dist y y'| ≤ (ε : ℝ)) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (diagram k X n) (diagram k Y n) ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  let : MetricSpace (FiniteLabels.{u, z} X) := labelsMetric (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)
  let : MetricSpace (FiniteLabels.{v, z} Y) := labelsMetric (inferInstance : MetricSpace Y)
  let D : SetRel (FiniteLabels.{u, z} X) (FiniteLabels.{v, z} Y) :=
    {p | (labelsEquiv X p.1, labelsEquiv Y p.2) ∈ C}
  apply bottleneck_dgm_le_of_relation (C := D) (ε := ε)
    (inferInstance : MetricSpace (FiniteLabels.{u, z} X))
    (inferInstance : MetricSpace (FiniteLabels.{v, z} Y)) _ _ _ k n
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hC (labelsEquiv X x)
    exact ⟨(labelsEquiv Y).symm y, by simpa [D] using hy⟩
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hI (labelsEquiv Y y)
    exact ⟨(labelsEquiv X).symm x, by simpa [D] using hx⟩
  · intro x x' y y' hxy hx'y'
    exact h _ _ _ _ hxy hx'y'

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_diagram_le_two_mul_of_hausdorffDist_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_diagram_le_two_mul_of_hausdorffDist_le (k : Type z) [Field k]
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} {Z : Type w}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [MetricSpace X] [MetricSpace Y]
    [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y] [MetricSpace Z]
    {f : X → Z} {g : Y → Z} (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : hausdorffDist (range f) (range g) ≤ r) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (diagram k X n) (diagram k Y n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * r)
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_diagram_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist k hf hg n).trans
    (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hr (by norm_num)))

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_diagram_le_two_mul_sampling_errors
statement:
theorem bottleneck_diagram_le_two_mul_sampling_errors (k : Type z) [Field k]
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} {Z : Type w}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [MetricSpace X] [MetricSpace Y]
    [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y] [MetricSpace Z]
    {f : X → Z} {g : Y → Z} (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g)
    (S : Set Z) {ε δ : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hX : hausdorffEDist (range f) S ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε)
    (hY : hausdorffEDist (range g) S ≤ ENNReal.ofReal δ) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (diagram k X n) (diagram k Y n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (ε + δ))
proof:
:= by
  apply bottleneck_diagram_le_two_mul_of_hausdorffDist_le k hf hg _ n
  apply ENNReal.toReal_le_of_le_ofReal (add_nonneg hε hδ)
  have h : hausdorffEDist (range f) (range g) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ε + ENNReal.ofReal δ :=
    hausdorffEDist_triangle.trans (add_le_add hX (by
      simpa only [hausdorffEDist_comm] using hY))
  simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_add hε hδ] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.tendsto_bottleneck_diagram_of_hausdorffDist_tendsto_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun i => ENNReal.ofReal (2 * hausdorffDist (range (f i)) (range g))) l (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using
      ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal (h.const_mul 2)
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hlim
    (fun _ => bot_le) (fun i => bottleneck_diagram_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist k (hf i) hg n)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.singleton_count
statement:
private theorem singleton_count {n : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval n) (p : FiniteInterval n → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] : ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval n)).countP p = if p I then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.cons_zero, Multiset.countP_cons]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.single_barcode
statement:
private theorem single_barcode (I : FiniteInterval 4) :
    rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I) = {I}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {I}) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).mpr
      intro i j hij
      rw [rank_barcodeMap]
      change Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (intervalMap (k := ℚ) I hij)) = _
      rw [intervalMap_finrank_range]
      simp only [interval_alive_endpoints_iff I hij, singleton_count]
    _ = {I} := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.alive_of_target
statement:
private theorem alive_of_target (I J : FiniteInterval 4) (hb : I.birth = J.birth)
    (hd : J.death ≤ I.death) (i : Fin 4) (hi : J.alive i) : I.alive i
proof:
:=
  ⟨hb ▸ hi.1, hi.2.trans_le hd⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.zero_of_not_alive
statement:
private theorem zero_of_not_alive (I : FiniteInterval 4) (i : Fin 4)
    (hi : ¬ I.alive i) (x : I.fiber (k := ℚ) i) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h := x.property
  simpa [FiniteInterval.fiber, hi] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.truncate_surjective
statement:
private theorem truncate_surjective (I J : FiniteInterval 4) (hb : I.birth = J.birth)
    (hd : J.death ≤ I.death) (i : Fin 4) : Function.Surjective ((truncate I J hb hd).app i).hom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro y
  change ∃ x : I.fiber (k := ℚ) i, truncateLinear I J hb hd i x = y
  by_cases hi : J.alive i
  · have hI := alive_of_target I J hb hd i hi
    refine ⟨⟨y.val, by simp [FiniteInterval.fiber, hI]⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [truncateLinear, dif_pos hi]
    rfl
  · have hy : y = 0 := zero_of_not_alive J i hi y
    subst y
    exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.first_surjective
statement: private theorem first_surjective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Surjective (first.app i).hom
proof:
:=
  truncate_surjective long middle rfl (by decide) i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.single_occurrence
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := Multiset.mem_toList.mp (List.get_mem (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)).toList a)
  change occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈ _ at hmem
  have hmem' : occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈
      ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4)) := Eq.mp
    (congrArg (fun B : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4) =>
      occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈ B) (single_barcode I)) hmem
  simpa using hmem'

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.theta_forward
statement: private theorem theta_forward (i : Fin 4) : i ≤ theta i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> decide

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.truncate_kernel_short
statement:
private theorem truncate_kernel_short (I J : FiniteInterval 4) (hb : I.birth = J.birth)
    (hd : J.death ≤ I.death)
    (hkill : ∀ i, I.alive i → ¬ J.alive i → ¬ I.alive (theta i)) :
    TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteKernel (truncate I J hb hd))
proof:
:= by
  apply (kernel_translationTrivial_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro i x hx
  change intervalMap I (theta_forward i) x = 0
  by_cases hi : I.alive i
  · by_cases hj : J.alive i
    · change truncateLinear I J hb hd i x = 0 at hx
      have hxval : x.val = 0 := by
        simpa [truncateLinear, hj] using congrArg Subtype.val hx
      have hxzero : x = 0 := Subtype.ext hxval
      rw [hxzero, map_zero]
    · apply Subtype.ext
      simp [intervalMap, hkill i hi hj]
  · rw [zero_of_not_alive I i hi x, map_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.first_kernel_short
statement: private theorem first_kernel_short : TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteKernel first)
proof:
:=
  truncate_kernel_short long middle rfl (by decide) (by
    intro i; fin_cases i <;> norm_num [long, middle, theta, FiniteInterval.alive])

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.noninjective_translation
statement: theorem noninjective_translation : theta 0 = 1 ∧ theta 1 = 1 ∧ ¬ Function.Injective theta
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro h
  have he := congrArg Fin.val (h (show theta 0 = theta 1 from rfl))
  norm_num at he

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.finite_death_bound_attained
statement:
theorem finite_death_bound_attained :
    TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteKernel first) ∧
      ∃ j : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) middle)),
        (occurrence _ j).death = 2 ∧
        (occurrence _ (epiEmbedding first first_surjective j)).death = 3 ∧
        (occurrence _ (epiEmbedding first first_surjective j)).death ≤
          (occurrence _ j).translatedDeath theta ∧
        (occurrence _ j).translatedDeath theta = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) middle)).toList.length = 1 := by
    rw [single_barcode]; simp
  let j : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) middle)) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  exact ⟨first_kernel_short, j,
    congrArg FiniteInterval.death (single_occurrence middle j),
    congrArg FiniteInterval.death (single_occurrence long _),
    (epiEmbedding_death_bounds_of_kernelTrivial theta theta_forward first first_surjective
      first_kernel_short j).2, by rw [single_occurrence]; rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.later_surjective
statement: private theorem later_surjective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Surjective (later.app i).hom
proof:
:=
  truncate_surjective laterLong laterShort rfl (by decide) i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.later_kernel_short
statement: private theorem later_kernel_short : TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteKernel later)
proof:
:=
  truncate_kernel_short laterLong laterShort rfl (by decide) (by
    intro i; fin_cases i <;> norm_num [laterLong, laterShort, theta, FiniteInterval.alive])

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.positive_birth_count
statement:
theorem positive_birth_count :
    TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteKernel later) ∧
      birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterLong)) 1 1 = 1 ∧
      birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterLong)) 1 (theta 1).val ≤
        birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterShort)) 1 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨later_kernel_short, ?_, birthSuffixCount_translated_le_of_kernelTrivial
    theta theta_forward later later_surjective later_kernel_short 1 1 (le_refl _)⟩
  simp [single_barcode, birthSuffixCount, singleton_count, laterLong]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.identity_kernel_short
statement:
private theorem identity_kernel_short {n : ℕ} (M : PModule.{0,0,0} ℚ (Fin n))
    (t : Fin n →o Fin n) (ht : ∀ i, i ≤ t i) : TranslationTrivial t ht (finiteKernel (𝟙 M))
proof:
:= by
  apply (kernel_translationTrivial_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro i x hx
  change x = 0 at hx
  simp [hx]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.terminal_coverage
statement:
theorem terminal_coverage (i : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode terminal)) :
    (occurrence _ i).death = 4 ∧ (occurrence _ i).translatedDeath theta = 4 ∧
      ∃! j, epiEmbedding (𝟙 terminal) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) j = i
proof:
:= by
  have he := single_occurrence (⟨0, 4, by decide, by decide⟩ : FiniteInterval 4) i
  refine ⟨congrArg FiniteInterval.death he, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [he]; rfl
  · apply epiEmbedding_covers_long_of_kernelTrivial theta theta_forward
      (𝟙 terminal) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) (identity_kernel_short _ _ _) i
    rw [he]; decide

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.eraseShort_surjective
statement: private theorem eraseShort_surjective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Surjective (eraseShort.app i).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  funext t
  have ht := t.isLt
  change t.val < (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4)).toList.length at ht
  have hlen : (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4)).toList.length = 0 := by simp
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.eraseShort_kernel_short
statement:
private theorem eraseShort_kernel_short :
    TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteKernel eraseShort)
proof:
:= by
  apply (kernel_translationTrivial_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro i x _hx
  change intervalMap short (theta_forward i) x = 0
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hi : ¬ short.alive (theta i) := by
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [short, theta, FiniteInterval.alive]
  simp [intervalMap, hi]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.threshold_unmatched
statement:
theorem threshold_unmatched (i : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode shortSource)) :
    TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteKernel eraseShort) ∧
      (occurrence _ i).death = (theta (occurrence _ i).birthStage).val ∧
      i ∉ Set.range (epiEmbedding eraseShort eraseShort_surjective)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨eraseShort_kernel_short, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [single_occurrence]; rfl
  · rintro ⟨j, _⟩
    have hlen : (rankBarcode zeroModule).toList.length = 0 := by
      change (rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4)))).toList.length = 0
      rw [rankBarcode_barcodeModule]; simp
    have hj := j.isLt
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.short_matched_death_bound
statement:
theorem short_matched_death_bound :
    ∃ i : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode shortSource),
      (occurrence _ i).death = (theta (occurrence _ i).birthStage).val ∧
      epiEmbedding (𝟙 shortSource) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) i = i ∧
      (occurrence _ i).death ≤ (occurrence _ i).translatedDeath theta
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (rankBarcode shortSource).toList.length = 1 := by rw [single_barcode]; simp
  let i : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode shortSource) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  have hd := epiEmbedding_death_bounds_of_kernelTrivial theta theta_forward (𝟙 shortSource)
    (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) (identity_kernel_short _ _ _) i
  refine ⟨i, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [single_occurrence]; rfl
  · rw [epiEmbedding_id]; rfl
  · simpa only [epiEmbedding_id, Function.Embedding.refl_apply] using hd.2

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.duplicate_long_coverage
statement:
theorem duplicate_long_coverage :
    ∃ i j : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode duplicates), i ≠ j ∧
      (∃! a, epiEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) a = i) ∧
      (∃! a, epiEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) a = j)
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (rankBarcode duplicates).toList.length = 2 := by
    change (rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) (Multiset.replicate 2 _))).toList.length = 2
    rw [rankBarcode_barcodeModule]; simp
  let i : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode duplicates) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let j : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode duplicates) := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  have hlong (a : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode duplicates)) :
      (theta (occurrence _ a).birthStage).val < (occurrence (rankBarcode duplicates) a).death := by
    have hm := Multiset.mem_toList.mp (List.get_mem (rankBarcode duplicates).toList a)
    change occurrence (rankBarcode duplicates) a ∈ rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ)
      (Multiset.replicate 2 (⟨0, 4, by decide, by decide⟩ : FiniteInterval 4))) at hm
    have hm' := Eq.mp (congrArg (fun B : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4) =>
      occurrence (rankBarcode duplicates) a ∈ B) (rankBarcode_barcodeModule (k := ℚ) _)) hm
    have ha := (Multiset.mem_replicate.mp hm').2
    rw [ha]; decide
  refine ⟨i, j, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; norm_num [i, j] at this
  · exact epiEmbedding_covers_long_of_kernelTrivial theta theta_forward (𝟙 duplicates)
      (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) (identity_kernel_short _ _ _) i (hlong i)
  · exact epiEmbedding_covers_long_of_kernelTrivial theta theta_forward (𝟙 duplicates)
      (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) (identity_kernel_short _ _ _) j (hlong j)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.identity_translation
statement:
theorem identity_translation (i : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode duplicates)) :
    (occurrence _ (epiEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) i)).death =
      (occurrence (rankBarcode duplicates) i).death ∧
      ∃! j, epiEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) j = i
proof:
:= by
  have hk := identity_kernel_short duplicates OrderHom.id (fun _ => le_rfl)
  have hd := epiEmbedding_death_bounds_of_kernelTrivial OrderHom.id (fun _ => le_rfl)
    (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) hk i
  rw [FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_id] at hd
  exact ⟨Nat.le_antisymm hd.2 hd.1, epiEmbedding_covers_long_of_kernelTrivial
    OrderHom.id (fun _ => le_rfl) (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) hk i
      (occurrence _ i).birth_lt_death⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.fixed_point_rejects_shortness
statement:
theorem fixed_point_rejects_shortness :
    ¬ TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteKernel eraseFixed)
proof:
:= by
  intro hk
  have h := (kernel_translationTrivial_iff theta theta_forward eraseFixed).mp hk 1
  let x : fixedSource.obj (1 : Fin 4) := ⟨1, by
    simp [FiniteInterval.fiber, FiniteInterval.alive, fixedBar]⟩
  have hx : x ∈ LinearMap.ker (eraseFixed.app 1).hom := by
    change (0 : fixedSource.obj (1 : Fin 4) →ₗ[ℚ] zeroModule.obj 1) x = 0
    rfl
  have hz := h hx
  change structureMapLinear fixedSource (show (1 : Fin 4) ≤ 1 from le_rfl) x = 0 at hz
  rw [structureMapLinear_self] at hz
  have he := congrArg Subtype.val hz
  change (1 : ℚ) = 0 at he
  exact one_ne_zero he

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.empty_chain
statement:
theorem empty_chain :
    TranslationTrivial OrderHom.id (fun _ : Fin 0 => le_rfl) (finiteKernel (𝟙 empty)) ∧
      IsEmpty (BarcodeOccurrence 0 (rankBarcode empty))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => Fin.elim0 i, ?_⟩
  change IsEmpty (Fin (rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 0)))).toList.length)
  rw [rankBarcode_barcodeModule]
  simp only [Multiset.toList_zero, List.length_nil]
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.overlap_kernel_short
statement: private theorem overlap_kernel_short : TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteKernel overlap)
proof:
:= by
  apply (kernel_translationTrivial_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro i x hx
  change intervalMap sourceBar (theta_forward i) x = 0
  fin_cases i
  · simp [intervalMap, sourceBar, theta, FiniteInterval.alive]
    rfl
  · have h1 : Function.Injective (overlap.app (1 : Fin 4)).hom := by
      change Function.Injective (overlapLinear 1)
      have hactive : sourceBar.alive (1 : Fin 4) ∧ targetBar.alive (1 : Fin 4) := by
        norm_num [sourceBar, targetBar, FiniteInterval.alive]
      simp only [overlapLinear, dif_pos hactive]
      exact Submodule.inclusion_injective _
    have hxzero : x = 0 := h1 (by simpa using hx)
    rw [hxzero, map_zero]
  · simp [intervalMap, sourceBar, theta, FiniteInterval.alive]
    rfl
  · simp [intervalMap, sourceBar, theta, FiniteInterval.alive]
    rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.overlap_cokernel_short
statement: private theorem overlap_cokernel_short : TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteCokernel overlap)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cokernel_translationTrivial_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro i y _hy
  change y ∈ LinearMap.range (overlapLinear (theta i))
  by_cases ht : targetBar.alive (theta i)
  · have hs : sourceBar.alive (theta i) := by
      fin_cases i <;> simp_all [targetBar, sourceBar, theta, FiniteInterval.alive]
    refine ⟨⟨y.val, by simp [FiniteInterval.fiber, hs]⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [overlapLinear, hs, ht]
  · have hy : y = 0 := zero_of_not_alive targetBar (theta i) ht y
    subst y
    exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.proper_overlap_shortness
statement:
theorem proper_overlap_shortness :
    ¬ (∀ i, Function.Injective (overlap.app i).hom) ∧
      ¬ (∀ i, Function.Surjective (overlap.app i).hom) ∧
      TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteKernel overlap) ∧
      TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteCokernel overlap)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, overlap_kernel_short, overlap_cokernel_short⟩
  · intro h
    let x : (intervalModule (k := ℚ) sourceBar).obj (2 : Fin 4) := ⟨1, by
      simp [FiniteInterval.fiber, FiniteInterval.alive, sourceBar]⟩
    have hz : (overlap.app 2).hom x = (overlap.app 2).hom 0 := by
      change overlapLinear 2 x = overlapLinear 2 0
      simp [overlapLinear, sourceBar, targetBar, FiniteInterval.alive]
      rfl
    have he := congrArg Subtype.val (h 2 hz)
    change (1 : ℚ) = 0 at he
    exact one_ne_zero he
  · intro h
    let y : (intervalModule (k := ℚ) targetBar).obj (0 : Fin 4) := ⟨1, by
      simp [FiniteInterval.fiber, FiniteInterval.alive, targetBar]⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h 0 y
    have he := congrArg Subtype.val hx
    norm_num [overlap, overlapLinear, sourceBar, targetBar, FiniteInterval.alive, y] at he

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.overlap_two_sided_bounds
statement:
theorem overlap_two_sided_bounds :
    ∃ (i : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) sourceBar)))
      (j : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) targetBar))),
      inducedMap overlap i = some j ∧
      (occurrence _ i).birth = 1 ∧ (occurrence _ i).death = 3 ∧
      (occurrence _ j).birth = 0 ∧ (occurrence _ j).death = 2 ∧
      (occurrence _ i).birth ≤ (theta (occurrence _ j).birthStage).val ∧
      (occurrence _ i).death ≤ (occurrence _ j).translatedDeath theta ∧
      (theta (occurrence _ j).birthStage).val = 1 ∧
      (occurrence _ j).translatedDeath theta = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) sourceBar)).toList.length = 1 := by
    rw [single_barcode]; simp
  let i : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) sourceBar)) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  have hlong : (theta (occurrence _ i).birthStage).val < (occurrence _ i).death := by
    rw [single_occurrence]; decide
  obtain ⟨j, hj, _⟩ := inducedMap_covers_long_source_of_kernelTrivial
    theta theta_forward overlap overlap_kernel_short i hlong
  have hbounds := inducedMap_endpoint_bounds_of_shortness theta theta theta_forward theta_forward
    overlap overlap_kernel_short overlap_cokernel_short i j hj
  refine ⟨i, j, hj, congrArg FiniteInterval.birth (single_occurrence sourceBar i),
    congrArg FiniteInterval.death (single_occurrence sourceBar i),
    congrArg FiniteInterval.birth (single_occurrence targetBar j),
    congrArg FiniteInterval.death (single_occurrence targetBar j), hbounds.2.1,
    hbounds.2.2.2.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [single_occurrence]; rfl
  · rw [single_occurrence]; rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.overlap_unique_source
statement:
theorem overlap_unique_source (j : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) targetBar))) :
    ∃! i, inducedMap overlap i = some j
proof:
:= by
  apply inducedMap_covers_long_target_of_cokernelTrivial theta theta_forward
    overlap overlap_cokernel_short j
  rw [single_occurrence]; decide

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.realGrid_apply
statement:
private theorem realGrid_apply (i : Fin 4) : realGrid i =
    if i.val = 0 then (0 : ℝ) else if i.val = 1 then 1 else if i.val = 2 then 3 else 4
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.realGrid_theta
statement: private theorem realGrid_theta : FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation realGrid 1 = theta
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.ext
  intro i
  apply Fin.succ_injective 4
  rw [FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation_succ]
  apply (FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_eq_succ_iff realGrid (theta i) _).mpr
  constructor
  · fin_cases i <;> norm_num [realGrid_apply, theta]
  · intro j hj
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [theta, realGrid_apply, Fin.lt_def] at *

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.overlap_real_kernel
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [realGrid_theta] using overlap_kernel_short

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.overlap_real_cokernel
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [realGrid_theta] using overlap_cokernel_short

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.erase_real_kernel
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [realGrid_theta] using eraseShort_kernel_short

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.erase_real_cokernel
proof:
:= by
  apply (cokernel_translationTrivial_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro i
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (eraseShort_surjective
    (FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation realGrid 1 i))]
  exact le_top

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.real_threshold_unmatched
statement:
theorem real_threshold_unmatched :
    ∃ p, (RealInduced.matching realGrid eraseShort 1 1
      erase_real_kernel erase_real_cokernel).finite p = none ∧ p.1 = (0, 1) ∧
      p.1.2 - p.1.1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (rankBarcode shortSource).toList.length = 1 := by
    rw [single_barcode]; simp
  let i : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode shortSource) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨p, _hp, hpv⟩ := RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv_finite realGrid _ i (by
    rw [single_occurrence]; decide)
  rw [single_occurrence] at hpv
  have hv : (p.1.1, (p.1.2 : WithTop ℝ)) = (0, (1 : WithTop ℝ)) :=
    hpv.trans (by rfl)
  have hv' : p.1 = (0, 1) := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ × WithTop ℝ => z.1) hv
    · exact WithTop.coe_injective (congrArg (fun z : ℝ × WithTop ℝ => z.2) hv)
  have hempty : (RealInduced.diagram realGrid zeroModule).points = 0 := by
    change (ofIndexBars realGrid realGrid.strictMono
      (rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4))))).points = 0
    rw [rankBarcode_barcodeModule, RealBarcode.ofIndexBars_points, Multiset.map_zero]
  refine ⟨p, ?_, hv', by rw [hv']; norm_num⟩
  cases h : (RealInduced.matching realGrid eraseShort 1 1
      erase_real_kernel erase_real_cokernel).finite p with
  | none => rfl
  | some q =>
    have hq : q.1 ∈ finitePart (RealInduced.diagram realGrid zeroModule).points := Multiset.coe_mem
    have hm := Eq.mp (congrArg (fun s : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ) =>
      q.1 ∈ finitePart s) hempty) hq
    simp [finitePart] at hm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.real_overlap_defects_nonzero
statement:
theorem real_overlap_defects_nonzero :
    ¬ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (finiteKernel overlap) ∧
      ¬ CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (finiteCokernel overlap)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    apply proper_overlap_shortness.1
    intro i
    rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot]
    apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
    intro x hx
    have he := (finiteKernel_map_eq_zero_iff overlap (le_refl i)).mp
      ((hz.obj i).eq_zero_of_src (structureMap (finiteKernel overlap) (le_refl i))) hx
    simpa only [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.ker_id, Submodule.mem_bot] using he
  · intro hz
    apply proper_overlap_shortness.2.1
    intro i
    apply LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp
    apply top_unique
    have he := (finiteCokernel_map_eq_zero_iff overlap (le_refl i)).mp
      ((hz.obj i).eq_zero_of_src (structureMap (finiteCokernel overlap) (le_refl i)))
    simpa only [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id] using he

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInducedTranslationExamples.real_overlap_bounds_attained
statement:
theorem real_overlap_bounds_attained :
    ∃ p q, realOverlapMatching.finite p = some q ∧ p.1 = (1, 4) ∧ q.1 = (0, 3) ∧
      RealEndpointBounds 1 1 (p.1.1, (p.1.2 : WithTop ℝ))
        (q.1.1, (q.1.2 : WithTop ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, _⟩ := overlap_two_sided_bounds
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpv⟩ := RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv_finite realGrid _ i (by
    rw [single_occurrence]; decide)
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqv⟩ := RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv_finite realGrid _ j (by
    rw [single_occurrence]; decide)
  rw [single_occurrence] at hpv hqv
  have hpv' : (p.1.1, (p.1.2 : WithTop ℝ)) = (1, (4 : WithTop ℝ)) :=
    hpv.trans (by rfl)
  have hqv' : (q.1.1, (q.1.2 : WithTop ℝ)) = (0, (3 : WithTop ℝ)) :=
    hqv.trans (by rfl)
  have hpPair : p.1 = (1, 4) := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ × WithTop ℝ => z.1) hpv'
    · exact WithTop.coe_injective (congrArg (fun z : ℝ × WithTop ℝ => z.2) hpv')
  have hqPair : q.1 = (0, 3) := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · exact congrArg (fun z : ℝ × WithTop ℝ => z.1) hqv'
    · exact WithTop.coe_injective (congrArg (fun z : ℝ × WithTop ℝ => z.2) hqv')
  have hm : RealInduced.sumMap realGrid overlap (.inl p) = some (.inl q) := by
    rw [← hp, ← hq]
    apply (RealInduced.sumMap_eq_some_iff realGrid overlap _ _).mpr
    simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hij
  have hm' := (RealInduced.matching_finite_eq_some_iff realGrid overlap 1 1
    overlap_real_kernel overlap_real_cokernel p q).mpr hm
  exact ⟨p, q, hm', hpPair, hqPair,
    (RealInduced.matching_bounds realGrid overlap 1 1 overlap_real_kernel overlap_real_cokernel).finite_bounds p q hm'⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.birth_partition
statement:
private theorem birth_partition {N : ℕ} (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N))
    (a b : Fin N) (hab : b.val = a.val + 1) :
    B.countP (fun I => I.birth = b.val) +
      B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ a.val ∧ b.val < I.death) =
      B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ b.val ∧ b.val < I.death)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction B using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons I B ih =>
    simp only [Multiset.countP_cons]
    rw [← ih]
    have hI := I.birth_lt_death
    split_ifs <;> omega

name: TDA.Persistence.death_partition
statement:
private theorem death_partition {N : ℕ} (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N))
    (a b : Fin N) (hab : b.val = a.val + 1) :
    B.countP (fun I => I.death = b.val) +
      B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ a.val ∧ b.val < I.death) =
      B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ a.val ∧ a.val < I.death)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction B using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons I B ih =>
    simp only [Multiset.countP_cons]
    rw [← ih]
    have hI := I.birth_lt_death
    split_ifs <;> omega

name: TDA.Persistence.prefix_rank_eq_count
statement:
private theorem prefix_rank_eq_count (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (a b : Fin (faceCount K + 1)) (hab : a ≤ b) :
    structureMapRank (facePrefixModule k e n) a b hab =
      (facePrefixBarcode k e n).countP
        (fun I => I.birth ≤ a.val ∧ b.val < I.death)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rank_barcodeMap (k := k) (facePrefixBarcode k e n) a b hab]
  exact (structureMapRank_rankBarcode (facePrefixModule k e n) a b hab).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.faceBirthCount_add_rank
statement:
theorem faceBirthCount_add_rank (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) :
    faceBirthCount k e n i +
      structureMapRank (facePrefixModule k e n)
        ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
        ⟨i.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt⟩
        (Fin.le_def.mpr (Nat.le_succ _)) =
      Module.finrank k ((facePrefixModule k e n).obj
        ⟨i.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let a : Fin (faceCount K + 1) := ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
  let b : Fin (faceCount K + 1) := ⟨i.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt⟩
  have hab : a ≤ b := by apply Fin.le_def.mpr; dsimp [a, b]; omega
  have hp := birth_partition (facePrefixBarcode k e n) a b (by rfl)
  have hself : structureMapRank (facePrefixModule k e n) b b le_rfl =
      Module.finrank k ((facePrefixModule k e n).obj b) := by
    unfold structureMapRank
    rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id]
    simp
  rw [← hself, prefix_rank_eq_count k e n a b hab,
    prefix_rank_eq_count k e n b b le_rfl]
  exact hp

name: TDA.Persistence.faceDeathCount_add_rank
statement:
theorem faceDeathCount_add_rank (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) :
    faceDeathCount k e n i +
      structureMapRank (facePrefixModule k e n)
        ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
        ⟨i.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt⟩
        (Fin.le_def.mpr (Nat.le_succ _)) =
      Module.finrank k ((facePrefixModule k e n).obj
        ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩)
proof:
:= by
  let a : Fin (faceCount K + 1) := ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
  let b : Fin (faceCount K + 1) := ⟨i.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt⟩
  have hab : a ≤ b := by apply Fin.le_def.mpr; dsimp [a, b]; omega
  have hp := death_partition (facePrefixBarcode k e n) a b (by rfl)
  have hself : structureMapRank (facePrefixModule k e n) a a le_rfl =
      Module.finrank k ((facePrefixModule k e n).obj a) := by
    unfold structureMapRank
    rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id]
    simp
  rw [← hself, prefix_rank_eq_count k e n a b hab,
    prefix_rank_eq_count k e n a a le_rfl]
  exact hp

name: TDA.Persistence.faceBirthCount_eq_cokernel
statement:
theorem faceBirthCount_eq_cokernel (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) :
    faceBirthCount k e n i =
      Module.finrank k (((facePrefixModule k e n).obj
        ⟨i.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt⟩) ⧸
        LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear (facePrefixModule k e n)
          (Fin.le_def.mpr (Nat.le_succ _) :
            (⟨i.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩ : Fin (faceCount K + 1)) ≤
              ⟨i.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt⟩)))
proof:
:= by
  let a : Fin (faceCount K + 1) := ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
  let b : Fin (faceCount K + 1) := ⟨i.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt⟩
  let h : a ≤ b := Fin.le_def.mpr (Nat.le_succ _)
  have hr := faceBirthCount_add_rank k e n i
  have hq := Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
    (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear (facePrefixModule k e n) h))
  change faceBirthCount k e n i +
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear (facePrefixModule k e n) h)) =
      Module.finrank k ((facePrefixModule k e n).obj b) at hr
  change Module.finrank k (((facePrefixModule k e n).obj b) ⧸
      LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear (facePrefixModule k e n) h)) +
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear (facePrefixModule k e n) h)) =
      Module.finrank k ((facePrefixModule k e n).obj b) at hq
  exact Nat.add_right_cancel (hr.trans hq.symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.faceDeathCount_eq_kernel
statement:
theorem faceDeathCount_eq_kernel (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) :
    faceDeathCount k e n i =
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear (facePrefixModule k e n)
        (Fin.le_def.mpr (Nat.le_succ _) :
          (⟨i.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩ : Fin (faceCount K + 1)) ≤
            ⟨i.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt⟩)))
proof:
:= by
  let a : Fin (faceCount K + 1) := ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
  let b : Fin (faceCount K + 1) := ⟨i.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt⟩
  let h : a ≤ b := Fin.le_def.mpr (Nat.le_succ _)
  have hr := faceDeathCount_add_rank k e n i
  have hk := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
    (structureMapLinear (facePrefixModule k e n) h)
  change faceDeathCount k e n i +
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear (facePrefixModule k e n) h)) =
      Module.finrank k ((facePrefixModule k e n).obj a) at hr
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear (facePrefixModule k e n) h)) +
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear (facePrefixModule k e n) h)) =
        Module.finrank k ((facePrefixModule k e n).obj a) at hk
  change faceDeathCount k e n i =
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear (facePrefixModule k e n) h))
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.faceStep_map_eq
statement:
private theorem faceStep_map_eq (e : CompatibleOrder f) (i : Fin (faceCount K))
    (n : ℕ) :
    structureMapLinear (facePrefixModule k e n)
      (Fin.le_def.mpr (Nat.le_succ _) :
        (⟨i.val, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩ : Fin (faceCount K + 1)) ≤
          ⟨i.val + 1, Nat.succ_lt_succ i.isLt⟩) =
      (simplicialHomologyIncl k (faceStepAttachment e i).inclusion n).hom
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.faceBirthCount_of_surjective
statement:
private theorem faceBirthCount_of_surjective (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) (n : ℕ)
    (h : Function.Surjective (simplicialHomologyIncl k
      (faceStepAttachment e i).inclusion n).hom) :
    faceBirthCount k e n i = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceBirthCount_eq_cokernel, faceStep_map_eq]
  change Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (e.prefixComplex (i.val + 1)) k n ⧸
    LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k (faceStepAttachment e i).inclusion n).hom) = 0
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr h]
  exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton (R := k)

name: TDA.Persistence.faceDeathCount_of_injective
statement:
private theorem faceDeathCount_of_injective (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) (n : ℕ)
    (h : Function.Injective (simplicialHomologyIncl k
      (faceStepAttachment e i).inclusion n).hom) :
    faceDeathCount k e n i = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceDeathCount_eq_kernel, faceStep_map_eq]
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (simplicialHomologyIncl k
    (faceStepAttachment e i).inclusion n).hom) = 0
  rw [LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr h]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.faceBirthCount_of_cokernel_one
statement:
private theorem faceBirthCount_of_cokernel_one (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) (n : ℕ)
    (h : Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (e.prefixComplex (i.val + 1)) k n ⧸
      LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k
        (faceStepAttachment e i).inclusion n).hom) = 1) :
    faceBirthCount k e n i = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceBirthCount_eq_cokernel, faceStep_map_eq]
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.faceDeathCount_of_kernel_one
statement:
private theorem faceDeathCount_of_kernel_one (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) (n : ℕ)
    (h : Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (simplicialHomologyIncl k
      (faceStepAttachment e i).inclusion n).hom) = 1) :
    faceDeathCount k e n i = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [faceDeathCount_eq_kernel, faceStep_map_eq]
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.faceStep_unique_event
statement:
theorem faceStep_unique_event (e : CompatibleOrder f) (i : Fin (faceCount K)) :
    ∃ q : ℕ,
      ((faceBirthCount k e q i = 1 ∧ faceDeathCount k e q i = 0 ∧
          ∀ r : ℕ, r ≠ q →
            faceBirthCount k e r i = 0 ∧ faceDeathCount k e r i = 0) ∨
       (faceBirthCount k e q i = 0 ∧ faceDeathCount k e q i = 1 ∧
          ∀ r : ℕ, r ≠ q →
            faceBirthCount k e r i = 0 ∧ faceDeathCount k e r i = 0))
proof:
:= by
  let A := faceStepAttachment e i
  letI : Finite (TotalFace (e.prefixComplex (i.val + 1))) :=
    Finite.of_injective
      (fun s => (⟨s.1, ((e.mem_prefixComplex (i.val + 1) s.1).mp s.2).1⟩ : TotalFace K))
      (by
        intro x y h
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact congrArg (fun t : TotalFace K => t.1) h)
  let q := (e.enum i).val.card - 1
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · let A0 : SimplexAttachment (e.prefixComplex i.val)
        (e.prefixComplex (i.val + 1)) 0 := hq ▸ A
    obtain ⟨hinj, hcoker, hrest⟩ := A0.isolatedVertex_birth k
    refine ⟨0, Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · exact faceBirthCount_of_cokernel_one k e i 0 hcoker
    · exact faceDeathCount_of_injective k e i 0 hinj
    · intro r hr
      obtain ⟨hrinj, hrsurj⟩ := hrest r (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hr)
      exact ⟨faceBirthCount_of_surjective k e i r hrsurj,
        faceDeathCount_of_injective k e i r hrinj⟩
  · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, q = p + 1 := by
      refine ⟨q - 1, ?_⟩
      omega
    let Ap : SimplexAttachment (e.prefixComplex i.val)
        (e.prefixComplex (i.val + 1)) (p + 1) := hp ▸ A
    by_cases hz : Ap.attachingHomologyClass k = 0
    · obtain ⟨hinj, hcoker, hrest, _⟩ := Ap.positive_birth k hz
      refine ⟨p + 1, Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · exact faceBirthCount_of_cokernel_one k e i (p + 1) hcoker
      · exact faceDeathCount_of_injective k e i (p + 1) hinj
      · intro r hr
        obtain ⟨hrinj, hrsurj⟩ := hrest r hr
        exact ⟨faceBirthCount_of_surjective k e i r hrsurj,
          faceDeathCount_of_injective k e i r hrinj⟩
    · obtain ⟨hsurj, _, hker, hrest⟩ := Ap.positive_death k hz
      refine ⟨p, Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
      · exact faceBirthCount_of_surjective k e i p hsurj
      · exact faceDeathCount_of_kernel_one k e i p hker
      · intro r hr
        obtain ⟨hrinj, hrsurj⟩ := hrest r hr
        exact ⟨faceBirthCount_of_surjective k e i r hrsurj,
          faceDeathCount_of_injective k e i r hrinj⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.faceTemplate_death_count
statement:
theorem faceTemplate_death_count (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) :
    (faceTemplatePairs k e n).countP (fun pair => pair.2 = i) =
      faceDeathCount k e n i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold faceTemplatePairs faceDeathCount
  generalize hB : facePrefixBarcode k e n = B
  have hpos : ∀ I ∈ B, 0 < I.birth := by
    intro I hI
    exact facePrefixBarcode_birth_pos k e n I (hB.symm ▸ hI)
  clear hB
  induction B using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons I B ih =>
    have hp : 0 < I.birth := hpos I (by simp)
    have hpB : ∀ J ∈ B, 0 < J.birth := by
      intro J hJ
      exact hpos J (by simp [hJ])
    simp only [Multiset.filterMap_cons]
    split_ifs with hb hd
    · simp only [Option.map_some, Option.getD_some,
        Multiset.singleton_add, Multiset.countP_cons]
      rw [ih hpB]
      simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
      change B.countP (fun I => I.death = i.val + 1) +
          (if I.death - 1 = i.val then 1 else 0) =
        B.countP (fun I => I.death = i.val + 1) +
          (if I.death = i.val + 1 then 1 else 0)
      have hI := I.birth_lt_death
      split_ifs <;> omega
    · simp only [Option.map_none, Option.getD_none, zero_add,
        Multiset.countP_cons]
      rw [ih hpB]
      have hneq : I.death ≠ i.val + 1 := by omega
      simp [hneq]

name: TDA.Persistence.faceTemplate_birth_count
statement:
theorem faceTemplate_birth_count (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) :
    (faceTemplatePairs k e n).countP (fun pair => pair.1 = i) +
      (faceTemplateEssential k e n).count i = faceBirthCount k e n i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold faceTemplatePairs faceTemplateEssential faceBirthCount
  generalize hB : facePrefixBarcode k e n = B
  have hpos : ∀ I ∈ B, 0 < I.birth := by
    intro I hI
    exact facePrefixBarcode_birth_pos k e n I (hB.symm ▸ hI)
  clear hB
  induction B using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons I B ih =>
    have hp : 0 < I.birth := hpos I (by simp)
    have hpB : ∀ J ∈ B, 0 < J.birth := by
      intro J hJ
      exact hpos J (by simp [hJ])
    by_cases hd : I.death ≤ faceCount K
    · simp only [Multiset.filterMap_cons]
      simp only [dif_pos hp, dif_pos hd, if_pos hd,
        Option.map_some, Option.getD_some, Option.map_none,
        Option.getD_none, Multiset.singleton_add, zero_add,
        Multiset.countP_cons]
      have htail := ih hpB
      simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
      simp only [Fin.ext_iff] at htail
      have hI := I.birth_lt_death
      split_ifs with hidx hborn
      all_goals
        first
        | change I.birth - 1 = i.val at hidx
        | change I.birth - 1 ≠ i.val at hidx
        omega
    · simp only [Multiset.filterMap_cons]
      simp only [dif_pos hp, dif_neg hd, if_neg hd]
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.getD_some, Option.map_none,
        Option.getD_none, Multiset.singleton_add, zero_add,
        Multiset.count_cons, Multiset.countP_cons]
      have htail := ih hpB
      simp only [Fin.ext_iff]
      simp only [Fin.ext_iff] at htail
      have hI := I.birth_lt_death
      split_ifs with hidx hborn
      all_goals
        first
        | change I.birth - 1 = i.val at hidx
        | change I.birth - 1 ≠ i.val at hidx
        | change i.val = I.birth - 1 at hidx
        | change i.val ≠ I.birth - 1 at hidx
        omega

name: TDA.Persistence.faceTemplate_unique_endpoint
statement:
theorem faceTemplate_unique_endpoint (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) :
    ∃ q : ℕ,
      (((faceTemplatePairs k e q).countP (fun pair => pair.1 = i) +
            (faceTemplateEssential k e q).count i = 1 ∧
          (faceTemplatePairs k e q).countP (fun pair => pair.2 = i) = 0 ∧
          ∀ r : ℕ, r ≠ q →
            (faceTemplatePairs k e r).countP (fun pair => pair.1 = i) +
                (faceTemplateEssential k e r).count i = 0 ∧
              (faceTemplatePairs k e r).countP (fun pair => pair.2 = i) = 0) ∨
       ((faceTemplatePairs k e q).countP (fun pair => pair.1 = i) +
            (faceTemplateEssential k e q).count i = 0 ∧
          (faceTemplatePairs k e q).countP (fun pair => pair.2 = i) = 1 ∧
          ∀ r : ℕ, r ≠ q →
            (faceTemplatePairs k e r).countP (fun pair => pair.1 = i) +
                (faceTemplateEssential k e r).count i = 0 ∧
              (faceTemplatePairs k e r).countP (fun pair => pair.2 = i) = 0))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [faceTemplate_birth_count, faceTemplate_death_count] using
    faceStep_unique_event k e i

name: TDA.Persistence.faceTemplate_endpoint_count_le_one
statement:
theorem faceTemplate_endpoint_count_le_one (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) (n : ℕ) :
    (faceTemplatePairs k e n).countP (fun pair => pair.1 = i) +
      (faceTemplateEssential k e n).count i +
      (faceTemplatePairs k e n).countP (fun pair => pair.2 = i) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, h⟩ := faceTemplate_unique_endpoint k e i
  rcases h with ⟨hb, hd, hother⟩ | ⟨hb, hd, hother⟩
  · by_cases hn : n = q
    · subst n; omega
    · obtain ⟨hz, hz'⟩ := hother n hn
      omega
  · by_cases hn : n = q
    · subst n; omega
    · obtain ⟨hz, hz'⟩ := hother n hn
      omega

name: TDA.Persistence.faceTemplate_endpoint_degrees_disjoint
statement:
theorem faceTemplate_endpoint_degrees_disjoint (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) (n r : ℕ) (hnr : n ≠ r)
    (hn : 0 < (faceTemplatePairs k e n).countP (fun pair => pair.1 = i) +
      (faceTemplateEssential k e n).count i +
      (faceTemplatePairs k e n).countP (fun pair => pair.2 = i)) :
    (faceTemplatePairs k e r).countP (fun pair => pair.1 = i) +
      (faceTemplateEssential k e r).count i +
      (faceTemplatePairs k e r).countP (fun pair => pair.2 = i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, h⟩ := faceTemplate_unique_endpoint k e i
  rcases h with ⟨hb, hd, hother⟩ | ⟨hb, hd, hother⟩
  · have hnq : n = q := by
      by_contra hne
      obtain ⟨hz, hz'⟩ := hother n hne
      omega
    obtain ⟨hz, hz'⟩ := hother r (by omega)
    omega
  · have hnq : n = q := by
      by_contra hne
      obtain ⟨hz, hz'⟩ := hother n hne
      omega
    obtain ⟨hz, hz'⟩ := hother r (by omega)
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.multiset_count_le_countP
statement:
private theorem multiset_count_le_countP {X : Type*} [DecidableEq X]
    (s : Multiset X) (x : X) (p : X → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (hx : p x) : s.count x ≤ s.countP p
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons y s ih =>
    simp only [Multiset.count_cons, Multiset.countP_cons]
    split_ifs with h₁ h₂ <;> simp_all <;> omega

name: TDA.Persistence.faceTemplatePairs_count_le_one
statement:
theorem faceTemplatePairs_count_le_one (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (pair : Fin (faceCount K) × Fin (faceCount K)) :
    (faceTemplatePairs k e n).count pair ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := faceTemplate_endpoint_count_le_one k e pair.1 n
  have hle := multiset_count_le_countP (faceTemplatePairs k e n) pair
    (fun x => x.1 = pair.1) rfl
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.faceTemplateEssential_count_le_one
statement:
theorem faceTemplateEssential_count_le_one (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) :
    (faceTemplateEssential k e n).count i ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := faceTemplate_endpoint_count_le_one k e i n
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.faceDeathCount_eq_zero_of_card_ne
statement:
theorem faceDeathCount_eq_zero_of_card_ne (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) (h : (e.enum i).val.card ≠ n + 2) :
    faceDeathCount k e n i = 0
proof:
:= by
  let A := faceStepAttachment e i
  letI : Finite (TotalFace (e.prefixComplex (i.val + 1))) :=
    Finite.of_injective
      (fun s => (⟨s.1, ((e.mem_prefixComplex (i.val + 1) s.1).mp s.2).1⟩ : TotalFace K))
      (by
        intro x y hxy
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact congrArg (fun t : TotalFace K => t.1) hxy)
  let q := (e.enum i).val.card - 1
  have hq_def : q = (e.enum i).val.card - 1 := rfl
  have hpos : 0 < (e.enum i).val.card :=
    Finset.card_pos.mpr (K.isRelLowerSet_faces (e.enum i).property).1
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · let A0 : SimplexAttachment (e.prefixComplex i.val)
        (e.prefixComplex (i.val + 1)) 0 := hq ▸ A
    obtain ⟨hinj, _, hrest⟩ := A0.isolatedVertex_birth k
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst n
      exact faceDeathCount_of_injective k e i 0 hinj
    · obtain ⟨hrinj, _⟩ := hrest n (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)
      exact faceDeathCount_of_injective k e i n hrinj
  · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, q = p + 1 := by
      refine ⟨q - 1, ?_⟩
      omega
    let Ap : SimplexAttachment (e.prefixComplex i.val)
        (e.prefixComplex (i.val + 1)) (p + 1) := hp ▸ A
    by_cases hz : Ap.attachingHomologyClass k = 0
    · obtain ⟨hinj, _, hrest, _⟩ := Ap.positive_birth k hz
      by_cases hn : n = p + 1
      · obtain rfl := hn
        exact faceDeathCount_of_injective k e i (p + 1) hinj
      · obtain ⟨hrinj, _⟩ := hrest n hn
        exact faceDeathCount_of_injective k e i n hrinj
    · obtain ⟨_, _, hker, hrest⟩ := Ap.positive_death k hz
      by_cases hn : n = p
      · exfalso
        obtain rfl := hn
        apply h
        omega
      · obtain ⟨hrinj, _⟩ := hrest n hn
        exact faceDeathCount_of_injective k e i n hrinj

name: TDA.Persistence.faceBirthCount_eq_zero_of_card_ne
statement:
theorem faceBirthCount_eq_zero_of_card_ne (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) (h : (e.enum i).val.card ≠ n + 1) :
    faceBirthCount k e n i = 0
proof:
:= by
  let A := faceStepAttachment e i
  letI : Finite (TotalFace (e.prefixComplex (i.val + 1))) :=
    Finite.of_injective
      (fun s => (⟨s.1, ((e.mem_prefixComplex (i.val + 1) s.1).mp s.2).1⟩ : TotalFace K))
      (by
        intro x y hxy
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact congrArg (fun t : TotalFace K => t.1) hxy)
  let q := (e.enum i).val.card - 1
  have hq_def : q = (e.enum i).val.card - 1 := rfl
  have hpos : 0 < (e.enum i).val.card :=
    Finset.card_pos.mpr (K.isRelLowerSet_faces (e.enum i).property).1
  by_cases hq : q = 0
  · let A0 : SimplexAttachment (e.prefixComplex i.val)
        (e.prefixComplex (i.val + 1)) 0 := hq ▸ A
    obtain ⟨_, hcoker, hrest⟩ := A0.isolatedVertex_birth k
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · exfalso
      obtain rfl := hn
      apply h
      omega
    · obtain ⟨_, hrsurj⟩ := hrest n (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn)
      exact faceBirthCount_of_surjective k e i n hrsurj
  · obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ : ∃ p : ℕ, q = p + 1 := by
      refine ⟨q - 1, ?_⟩
      omega
    let Ap : SimplexAttachment (e.prefixComplex i.val)
        (e.prefixComplex (i.val + 1)) (p + 1) := hp ▸ A
    by_cases hz : Ap.attachingHomologyClass k = 0
    · obtain ⟨_, hcoker, hrest, _⟩ := Ap.positive_birth k hz
      by_cases hn : n = p + 1
      · exfalso
        obtain rfl := hn
        apply h
        omega
      · obtain ⟨_, hrsurj⟩ := hrest n hn
        exact faceBirthCount_of_surjective k e i n hrsurj
    · obtain ⟨hsurj, _, _, hrest⟩ := Ap.positive_death k hz
      by_cases hn : n = p
      · obtain rfl := hn
        exact faceBirthCount_of_surjective k e i _ hsurj
      · obtain ⟨_, hrsurj⟩ := hrest n hn
        exact faceBirthCount_of_surjective k e i n hrsurj

name: TDA.Persistence.append_mixed_reversed_essential
statement:
private theorem append_mixed_reversed_essential :
    (orderedQ 6 4 (Fin.append appendLeft.1 appendRight.1,
      Fin.append appendLeft.2 appendRight.2)).points =
      (orderedQ 3 2 appendLeft).points + (orderedQ 3 2 appendRight).points
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.append_mixed_counts
statement:
private theorem append_mixed_counts :
    (orderedQ 6 4 (Fin.append appendLeft.1 appendRight.1,
      Fin.append appendLeft.2 appendRight.2)).points.count (0, (2 : WithTop ℚ)) = 2 ∧
    (orderedQ 6 4 (Fin.append appendLeft.1 appendRight.1,
      Fin.append appendLeft.2 appendRight.2)).points.count (2, (1 : WithTop ℚ)) = 2 ∧
    (orderedQ 6 4 (Fin.append appendLeft.1 appendRight.1,
      Fin.append appendLeft.2 appendRight.2)).points.count (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)) = 3 ∧
    (orderedQ 6 4 (Fin.append appendLeft.1 appendRight.1,
      Fin.append appendLeft.2 appendRight.2)).points.count (3, (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)) = 1 ∧
    (orderedQ 6 4 (Fin.append appendLeft.1 appendRight.1,
      Fin.append appendLeft.2 appendRight.2)).points.count (1, (1 : WithTop ℚ)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  decide
