name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.mem_minimalComplement_pi_iff
statement:
theorem mem_minimalComplement_pi_iff (p x : ∀ i, T i) :
    x ∈ minimalComplement p ↔
      ∃ i, x i ∈ minimalComplement (p i) ∧ ∀ j, j ≠ i → x j = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hx
    change Minimal (fun z : (∀ j, T j) => ¬ z ≤ p) x at hx
    have houtside : ¬ x ≤ p := hx.prop
    have hactive : ∃ i, ¬ x i ≤ p i := by
      change ¬ (∀ i, x i ≤ p i) at houtside
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      exact houtside h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hactive
    let y : (∀ j, T j) := Function.update (fun _ => ⊥) i (x i)
    have hyx : y ≤ x := by
      intro j
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [y]
      · simp [y, Function.update_of_ne hji]
    have hyoutside : ¬ y ≤ p := by
      intro h
      exact hi (by simpa [y] using h i)
    have hxy : y = x := hx.eq_of_le hyoutside hyx
    refine ⟨i, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change Minimal (fun a : T i => ¬ a ≤ p i) (x i)
      refine ⟨hi, ?_⟩
      intro a ha hax
      let z : (∀ j, T j) := Function.update x i a
      have hzoutside : ¬ z ≤ p := by
        intro hz
        exact ha (by simpa [z] using hz i)
      have hzx : z ≤ x := by
        intro j
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · subst j
          simpa [z] using hax
        · simp [z, Function.update_of_ne hji]
      have hzx' : z = x := hx.eq_of_le hzoutside hzx
      have haz : a = x i := by
        simpa [z] using congrFun hzx' i
      rw [← haz]
    · intro j hji
      have hj : y j = x j := congrFun hxy j
      simpa [y, Function.update_of_ne hji] using hj.symm
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, hbottom⟩
    change Minimal (fun z : (∀ j, T j) => ¬ z ≤ p) x
    change Minimal (fun a : T i => ¬ a ≤ p i) (x i) at hi
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hle
      exact hi.prop (hle i)
    · intro y hy hyx
      have hyi : ¬ y i ≤ p i := by
        by_contra hle
        apply hy
        intro j
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · subst j
          exact hle
        · have hybot : y j = ⊥ :=
            le_antisymm (by simpa [hbottom j hji] using hyx j) bot_le
          rw [hybot]
          exact bot_le
      have hiy : y i = x i := hi.eq_of_le hyi (hyx i)
      intro j
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst j
        exact hiy.symm.le
      · rw [hbottom j hji]
        exact bot_le

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.minimalComplement_pi_active_injective
statement:
private theorem minimalComplement_pi_active_injective (p : ∀ i, T i) :
    Function.Injective (minimalComplement_pi_active p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x y hxy
  apply Subtype.ext
  let i := minimalComplement_pi_active p x
  let hx := Classical.choose_spec
    (mem_minimalComplement_pi_iff p x.1 |>.mp x.2)
  let hy := Classical.choose_spec
    (mem_minimalComplement_pi_iff p y.1 |>.mp y.2)
  have hxmin : Minimal (fun a : T i => ¬ a ≤ p i) (x.1 i) := hx.1
  have hactive : i = minimalComplement_pi_active p y := by
    simpa [i] using hxy
  have hymin : Minimal (fun a : T i => ¬ a ≤ p i) (y.1 i) := by
    rw [hactive]
    exact hy.1
  have hcoord : x.1 i = y.1 i :=
    le_antisymm (hxmin.le hymin.prop) (hymin.le hxmin.prop)
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst j
    exact hcoord
  · have hxi : x.1 j = ⊥ := hx.2 j hj
    have hyi : y.1 j = ⊥ := by
      apply hy.2 j
      intro h
      exact hj (h.trans hactive.symm)
    rw [hxi, hyi]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.complementCard_pi_le_card
statement:
theorem complementCard_pi_le_card (p : ∀ i, T i) :
    complementCard p ≤ Fintype.card ι
proof:
:= by
  unfold complementCard
  exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective (minimalComplement_pi_active p)
    (minimalComplement_pi_active_injective p)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.maxComplementCard_pi_le_card
statement:
theorem maxComplementCard_pi_le_card :
    maxComplementCard (S := ∀ i, T i) ≤ Fintype.card ι
proof:
:= by
  unfold maxComplementCard
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro p hp
  exact complementCard_pi_le_card p

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.minimalComplement_withTop_oldTop
statement:
theorem minimalComplement_withTop_oldTop :
    minimalComplement ((⊤ : S) : WithTop S) = {⊤}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    change Minimal (fun y : WithTop S => ¬ y ≤ ((⊤ : S) : WithTop S)) x at hx
    have hxout : ¬ x ≤ ((⊤ : S) : WithTop S) := hx.prop
    have hxtop : x = ⊤ := by
      cases x with
      | top => rfl
      | coe a => exact (hxout (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).elim
    simp [hxtop]
  · intro hx
    have hxtop : x = (⊤ : WithTop S) := by simpa using hx
    subst x
    change Minimal (fun y : WithTop S => ¬ y ≤ ((⊤ : S) : WithTop S)) ⊤
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact not_le_of_gt (WithTop.coe_lt_top (⊤ : S))
    · intro y hy hyle
      cases y with
      | top => rfl
      | coe a => exact (hy (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)).elim

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.mem_minimalComplement_withTop_coe_iff
statement:
theorem mem_minimalComplement_withTop_coe_iff (p a : S) (hp : p ≠ ⊤) :
    (a : WithTop S) ∈ minimalComplement (p : WithTop S) ↔
      a ∈ minimalComplement p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro ha
    change Minimal (fun x : WithTop S => ¬ x ≤ (p : WithTop S)) (a : WithTop S) at ha
    change Minimal (fun x : S => ¬ x ≤ p) a
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [WithTop.coe_le_coe] using ha.prop
    · intro b hb hba
      have hb' : ¬ (b : WithTop S) ≤ (p : WithTop S) := by
        simpa only [WithTop.coe_le_coe] using hb
      have hba' : (b : WithTop S) ≤ (a : WithTop S) := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr hba
      have heq := ha.eq_of_le hb' hba'
      exact (WithTop.coe_injective heq).symm.le
  · intro ha
    change Minimal (fun x : WithTop S => ¬ x ≤ (p : WithTop S)) (a : WithTop S)
    change Minimal (fun x : S => ¬ x ≤ p) a at ha
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [WithTop.coe_le_coe] using ha.prop
    · intro b hb hba
      cases b with
      | top => exact (not_le_of_gt (WithTop.coe_lt_top a) hba).elim
      | coe b =>
        have hb' : ¬ b ≤ p := by simpa only [WithTop.coe_le_coe] using hb
        have hba' : b ≤ a := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp hba
        have heq := ha.eq_of_le hb' hba'
        exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr heq.symm.le

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.minimalComplement_withTop_coe_ne_top
statement:
private theorem minimalComplement_withTop_coe_ne_top (p : S) (hp : p ≠ ⊤)
    (x : minimalComplement (p : WithTop S)) : x.1 ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro hx
  have hxmem : x.1 ∈ minimalComplement (p : WithTop S) := x.2
  change Minimal (fun y : WithTop S => ¬ y ≤ (p : WithTop S)) x.1 at hxmem
  have htopmem : ¬ ((⊤ : S) : WithTop S) ≤ (p : WithTop S) := by
    intro h
    apply hp
    exact ((WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp h).antisymm le_top).symm
  have hcoetop : ((⊤ : S) : WithTop S) ≤ x.1 := by
    rw [hx]
    exact le_top
  have heq := hxmem.eq_of_le htopmem hcoetop
  have hcoene : ((⊤ : S) : WithTop S) ≠ (⊤ : WithTop S) := by simp
  exact hcoene (by simpa [hx] using heq)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.minimalComplement_withTop_coe_val_spec
proof:
:=
  WithTop.coe_untop x.1 (minimalComplement_withTop_coe_ne_top (S := S) p hp x)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.maxComplementCard_withTop_le
statement:
theorem maxComplementCard_withTop_le :
    maxComplementCard (S := WithTop S) ≤ max 1 (maxComplementCard (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype (WithTop S) := Fintype.ofFinite (WithTop S)
  unfold maxComplementCard
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro p hp
  cases p with
  | top =>
      have hzero : complementCard (S := WithTop S) (⊤ : WithTop S) = 0 :=
        (complementCard_eq_zero_iff (S := WithTop S) _).2 rfl
      rw [hzero]
      exact Nat.zero_le _
  | coe p =>
      by_cases hptop : p = (⊤ : S)
      · subst p
        have hone :
            complementCard (S := WithTop S) ((⊤ : S) : WithTop S) = 1 := by
          simp [complementCard, minimalComplement_withTop_oldTop (S := S)]
        rw [hone]
        exact Nat.le_max_left _ _
      · have hcard :
            complementCard (S := WithTop S) (p : WithTop S) = complementCard (S := S) p := by
          unfold complementCard
          exact Fintype.card_congr
            (minimalComplement_withTop_coe_equiv (S := S) p hptop)
        rw [hcard]
        exact (complementCard_le_maxComplementCard (S := S) p).trans
          (Nat.le_max_right _ _)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.mem_minimalComplement_pair_iff
statement:
theorem mem_minimalComplement_pair_iff (p x : PairPoset S) :
    x ∈ minimalComplement p ↔
      (∃ a : minimalComplement p.val.1,
        (a.1 : WithTop S) ≤ p.val.2 ∧ x.val.1 = a.1 ∧ x.val.2 = a.1) ∨
      (∃ b : minimalComplement p.val.2, x.val.1 = ⊥ ∧ x.val.2 = b.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hx
    change Minimal (fun z : PairPoset S => ¬ z ≤ p) x at hx
    let a := x.val.1
    let b := x.val.2
    let j := p.val.1
    let k := p.val.2
    have hnot : ¬ (a ≤ j ∧ b ≤ k) := by
      intro hab
      apply hx.prop
      change x.val ≤ p.val
      exact Prod.mk_le_mk.mpr (by simpa [a, b, j, k] using hab)
    by_cases haj : a ≤ j
    · have hbk : ¬ b ≤ k := by
        intro hbk
        exact hnot ⟨haj, hbk⟩
      let q := bottomPair (S := S) b
      have hqout : ¬ q ≤ p := by
        intro hq
        change q.val ≤ p.val at hq
        exact hbk (Prod.mk_le_mk.mp hq).2
      have hqx : q ≤ x := by
        change q.val ≤ x.val
        exact Prod.mk_le_mk.mpr ⟨bot_le, le_rfl⟩
      have hqx' : q = x := hx.eq_of_le hqout hqx
      have hbmin : b ∈ minimalComplement k := by
        change Minimal (fun c : WithTop S => ¬ c ≤ k) b
        refine ⟨hbk, ?_⟩
        intro c hc hcb
        let qc := bottomPair (S := S) c
        have hqcout : ¬ qc ≤ p := by
          intro hqc
          change qc.val ≤ p.val at hqc
          exact hc (Prod.mk_le_mk.mp hqc).2
        have hqcx : qc ≤ x := by
          apply le_trans (show qc ≤ q from ?_) hqx
          change qc.val ≤ q.val
          exact Prod.mk_le_mk.mpr ⟨bot_le, hcb⟩
        have heq : qc = x := hx.eq_of_le hqcout hqcx
        have hc_x := congrArg (fun r : PairPoset S => r.val.2) heq
        have hb_x := congrArg (fun r : PairPoset S => r.val.2) hqx'
        exact (hc_x.trans hb_x.symm).symm.le
      have hfirst := congrArg (fun r : PairPoset S => r.val.1) hqx'
      have hsecond := congrArg (fun r : PairPoset S => r.val.2) hqx'
      exact Or.inr ⟨⟨b, hbmin⟩, hfirst.symm, hsecond.symm⟩
    · have hdiagout : ¬ diagonalPair (S := S) a ≤ p := by
        intro hdiag
        change (a, a) ≤ p.val at hdiag
        exact haj (Prod.mk_le_mk.mp hdiag).1
      have hdiagx : diagonalPair (S := S) a ≤ x := by
        change (a, a) ≤ x.val
        exact Prod.mk_le_mk.mpr ⟨le_rfl, x.property⟩
      have hdiag_eq : diagonalPair (S := S) a = x := hx.eq_of_le hdiagout hdiagx
      have hak : a ≤ k := by
        by_contra hak
        let q := bottomPair (S := S) a
        have hqout : ¬ q ≤ p := by
          intro hq
          change q.val ≤ p.val at hq
          exact hak (Prod.mk_le_mk.mp hq).2
        have hqx : q ≤ x := by
          change q.val ≤ x.val
          exact Prod.mk_le_mk.mpr ⟨bot_le, x.property⟩
        have hq_eq : q = x := hx.eq_of_le hqout hqx
        have hfirst := congrArg (fun r : PairPoset S => r.val.1) hq_eq
        have haeq : (⊥ : WithTop S) = a := by simpa [q, bottomPair] using hfirst
        exact haj (haeq ▸ (bot_le : (⊥ : WithTop S) ≤ j))
      have hamin : a ∈ minimalComplement j := by
        change Minimal (fun c : WithTop S => ¬ c ≤ j) a
        refine ⟨haj, ?_⟩
        intro c hc hca
        let qc := diagonalPair (S := S) c
        have hqcout : ¬ qc ≤ p := by
          intro hqc
          change qc.val ≤ p.val at hqc
          exact hc (Prod.mk_le_mk.mp hqc).1
        have hqcx : qc ≤ x := by
          change qc.val ≤ x.val
          exact Prod.mk_le_mk.mpr ⟨hca, hca.trans x.property⟩
        have heq : qc = x := hx.eq_of_le hqcout hqcx
        have hc_a := congrArg (fun r : PairPoset S => r.val.1) heq
        exact hc_a.symm.le
      have hfirst := congrArg (fun r : PairPoset S => r.val.1) hdiag_eq.symm
      have hsecond := congrArg (fun r : PairPoset S => r.val.2) hdiag_eq.symm
      exact Or.inl ⟨⟨a, hamin⟩, hak, hfirst, hsecond⟩
  · rintro (⟨a, hak, hfirst, hsecond⟩ | ⟨b, hfirst, hsecond⟩)
    · have hx : x = diagonalPair (S := S) a.1 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact Prod.ext hfirst hsecond
      subst x
      change Minimal (fun z : PairPoset S => ¬ z ≤ p) (diagonalPair (S := S) a.1)
      have hamin : Minimal (fun c : WithTop S => ¬ c ≤ p.val.1) a.1 := by
        change Minimal (fun c : WithTop S => ¬ c ≤ p.val.1) a.1
        exact a.2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro hle
        exact hamin.prop ((Prod.mk_le_mk.mp (show (a.1, a.1) ≤ p.val from hle)).1)
      · intro q hq hqa
        have hqa' := hqa
        change q.val ≤ (a.1, a.1) at hqa'
        have hqle := Prod.mk_le_mk.mp hqa'
        have hqsecond : q.val.2 ≤ p.val.2 := hqle.2.trans hak
        have hqfirst : ¬ q.val.1 ≤ p.val.1 := by
          intro hqj
          exact hq (Prod.mk_le_mk.mpr ⟨hqj, hqsecond⟩)
        have hfirst : q.val.1 = a.1 := hamin.eq_of_le hqfirst hqle.1
        have hsecond : q.val.2 = a.1 := by
          apply le_antisymm hqle.2
          exact hfirst.symm.le.trans q.property
        have hqeq : q = diagonalPair (S := S) a.1 := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact Prod.ext hfirst hsecond
        exact hqeq.symm.le
    · have hx : x = bottomPair (S := S) b.1 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact Prod.ext hfirst hsecond
      subst x
      change Minimal (fun z : PairPoset S => ¬ z ≤ p) (bottomPair (S := S) b.1)
      have hbmin : Minimal (fun c : WithTop S => ¬ c ≤ p.val.2) b.1 := by
        change Minimal (fun c : WithTop S => ¬ c ≤ p.val.2) b.1
        exact b.2
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · intro hle
        exact hbmin.prop ((Prod.mk_le_mk.mp (show (⊥, b.1) ≤ p.val from hle)).2)
      · intro q hq hqb
        have hqb' := hqb
        change q.val ≤ (⊥, b.1) at hqb'
        have hqle := Prod.mk_le_mk.mp hqb'
        have hfirst : q.val.1 = ⊥ := le_antisymm hqle.1 bot_le
        have hqsecond : ¬ q.val.2 ≤ p.val.2 := by
          intro hqk
          exact hq (Prod.mk_le_mk.mpr ⟨by simpa [hfirst] using (bot_le : (⊥ : WithTop S) ≤ p.val.1), hqk⟩)
        have hsecond : q.val.2 = b.1 := hbmin.eq_of_le hqsecond hqle.2
        have hqeq : q = bottomPair (S := S) b.1 := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact Prod.ext hfirst hsecond
        exact hqeq.symm.le

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.pair_bottom_witness
proof:
:= by
  rcases (mem_minimalComplement_pair_iff p x.1).mp x.2 with hdiag | hbottom
  · rcases hdiag with ⟨a, hrest⟩
    have hfirst := hrest.2.1
    have hle : a.1 ≤ p.val.1 := hfirst ▸ h
    have hamin : Minimal (fun c : WithTop S => ¬ c ≤ p.val.1) a.1 := a.2
    exact (hamin.prop hle).elim
  · rcases hbottom with ⟨b, hrest⟩
    refine ⟨b, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext hrest.1 hrest.2

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.pair_diagonal_witness
proof:
:= by
  rcases (mem_minimalComplement_pair_iff p x.1).mp x.2 with hdiag | hbottom
  · rcases hdiag with ⟨a, hrest⟩
    have hak := hrest.1
    have hfirst := hrest.2.1
    have hsecond := hrest.2.2
    refine ⟨⟨a, hak⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Prod.ext hfirst hsecond
  · rcases hbottom with ⟨b, hrest⟩
    have hfirst := hrest.1
    have hle : x.1.val.1 ≤ p.val.1 := hfirst ▸ (bot_le : (⊥ : WithTop S) ≤ p.val.1)
    exact (h hle).elim

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.pairBottomWitness_spec
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (pair_bottom_witness p x h)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.pairDiagonalWitness_spec
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (pair_diagonal_witness p x h)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.complementCard_pair_eq
statement:
theorem complementCard_pair_eq (p : PairPoset S) :
    complementCard (S := PairPoset S) p =
      Fintype.card (diagonalPairComplement p) +
        complementCard (S := WithTop S) p.val.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold complementCard
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (minimalComplement_pair_equiv (S := S) p)]
  simp [Fintype.card_sum, complementCard]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.diagonalPairComplement_card_le
statement:
theorem diagonalPairComplement_card_le (p : PairPoset S) :
    Fintype.card (diagonalPairComplement p) ≤ complementCard (S := WithTop S) p.val.1
proof:
:= by
  unfold complementCard
  exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.complementCard_pair_le_add
statement:
theorem complementCard_pair_le_add (p : PairPoset S) :
    complementCard (S := PairPoset S) p ≤
      complementCard (S := WithTop S) p.val.1 +
        complementCard (S := WithTop S) p.val.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [complementCard_pair_eq]
  exact Nat.add_le_add_right (diagonalPairComplement_card_le p) _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.maxComplementCard_pair_le
statement:
theorem maxComplementCard_pair_le :
    maxComplementCard (S := PairPoset S) ≤
      2 * max 1 (maxComplementCard (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  unfold maxComplementCard
  apply Finset.sup_le
  intro p hp
  have hfirst : complementCard (S := WithTop S) p.val.1 ≤
      max 1 (maxComplementCard (S := S)) := by
    exact (complementCard_le_maxComplementCard (S := WithTop S) p.val.1).trans
      (maxComplementCard_withTop_le (S := S))
  have hsecond : complementCard (S := WithTop S) p.val.2 ≤
      max 1 (maxComplementCard (S := S)) := by
    exact (complementCard_le_maxComplementCard (S := WithTop S) p.val.2).trans
      (maxComplementCard_withTop_le (S := S))
  calc
    complementCard p ≤
        complementCard (S := WithTop S) p.val.1 +
          complementCard (S := WithTop S) p.val.2 := complementCard_pair_le_add p
    _ ≤ max 1 (maxComplementCard (S := S)) +
          max 1 (maxComplementCard (S := S)) := Nat.add_le_add hfirst hsecond
    _ = 2 * max 1 (maxComplementCard (S := S)) := by omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.maxComplementCard_coordinateGrid_le
statement:
theorem maxComplementCard_coordinateGrid_le
    (hG : ∀ i : Fin n, (G i).Nonempty) :
    letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
    maxComplementCard (S := G.Point) ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
  letI (i : Fin n) : Fintype {x : ℝ // x ∈ G i} := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI (i : Fin n) : Nonempty {x : ℝ // x ∈ G i} := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hG i
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  letI (i : Fin n) : OrderBot {x : ℝ // x ∈ G i} := Fintype.toOrderBot _
  letI (i : Fin n) : OrderTop {x : ℝ // x ∈ G i} := Fintype.toOrderTop _
  simpa [CoordinateGrid.Point] using
    (maxComplementCard_pi_le_card (ι := Fin n)
      (T := fun i => {x : ℝ // x ∈ G i}))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.maxComplementCard_withTop_coordinateGrid_le
statement:
theorem maxComplementCard_withTop_coordinateGrid_le (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hG : ∀ i : Fin n, (G i).Nonempty) :
    letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
    maxComplementCard (S := WithTop G.Point) ≤ n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
  letI (i : Fin n) : Fintype {x : ℝ // x ∈ G i} := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI (i : Fin n) : Nonempty {x : ℝ // x ∈ G i} := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hG i
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  letI (i : Fin n) : OrderBot {x : ℝ // x ∈ G i} := Fintype.toOrderBot _
  letI (i : Fin n) : OrderTop {x : ℝ // x ∈ G i} := Fintype.toOrderTop _
  have hgrid := maxComplementCard_coordinateGrid_le G hG
  exact (maxComplementCard_withTop_le (S := G.Point)).trans
    (max_le_iff.mpr ⟨hn, hgrid⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.maxComplementCard_pair_coordinateGrid_le
statement:
theorem maxComplementCard_pair_coordinateGrid_le (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hG : ∀ i : Fin n, (G i).Nonempty) :
    letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
    letI : Lattice (PairPoset G.Point) := pairPosetLattice (S := G.Point)
    letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset G.Point) :=
      pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := G.Point)
    maxComplementCard (S := PairPoset G.Point) ≤ 2 * n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
  letI (i : Fin n) : Fintype {x : ℝ // x ∈ G i} := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI (i : Fin n) : Nonempty {x : ℝ // x ∈ G i} := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hG i
    exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩⟩
  letI (i : Fin n) : OrderBot {x : ℝ // x ∈ G i} := Fintype.toOrderBot _
  letI (i : Fin n) : OrderTop {x : ℝ // x ∈ G i} := Fintype.toOrderTop _
  letI : Lattice (PairPoset G.Point) := pairPosetLattice (S := G.Point)
  letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset G.Point) := pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := G.Point)
  have hgrid := maxComplementCard_coordinateGrid_le G hG
  exact (maxComplementCard_pair_le (S := G.Point)).trans
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (max_le_iff.mpr ⟨hn, hgrid⟩))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.wholeLine_map_preserves_coefficients
statement:
theorem wholeLine_map_preserves_coefficients {s t : ℝ} (h : s ≤ t)
    (x : SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) (Set.univ : Set ℝ) s) :
    ((structureMapLinear wholeLine h x :
      SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) (Set.univ : Set ℝ) t) : ℚ) = (x : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [wholeLine] using
    (SupportInterval.structureMap_val (k := ℚ) (Set.univ : Set ℝ)
      Set.ordConnected_univ h x)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.leftOpen_fiber_nonzero_below
statement:
theorem leftOpen_fiber_nonzero_below (a p : ℝ) (h : p < a) :
    ∃ x : SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) (Set.Iio a) p, (x : ℚ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨SupportInterval.one (k := ℚ) (Set.Iio a) (p := p)
    (Set.mem_Iio.mpr h), ?_⟩
  simp [SupportInterval.one]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.leftClosed_endpoint_nonzero
statement:
theorem leftClosed_endpoint_nonzero (a : ℝ) :
    ∃ x : SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) (Set.Iic a) a, (x : ℚ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨SupportInterval.one (k := ℚ) (Set.Iic a) (p := a)
    (Set.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl), ?_⟩
  simp [SupportInterval.one]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.leftClosed_map_to_endpoint
statement:
theorem leftClosed_map_to_endpoint (a p : ℝ) (h : p ≤ a) :
    structureMapLinear (leftClosedRay a) h
      (SupportInterval.one (k := ℚ) (Set.Iic a) (p := p) (Set.mem_Iic.mpr h)) =
    SupportInterval.one (k := ℚ) (Set.Iic a) (p := a) (Set.mem_Iic.mpr le_rfl)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [SupportInterval.structureMap_val]
  simp [SupportInterval.one]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.leftOpen_endpoint_is_zero
statement:
theorem leftOpen_endpoint_is_zero (a : ℝ) :
    Subsingleton ((leftOpenRay a).obj a)
proof:
:= by
  change Subsingleton (SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) (Set.Iio a) a)
  constructor
  intro x y
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hx := SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := ℚ) (Set.Iio a)
    (show a ∉ Set.Iio a by simp) x
  have hy := SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := ℚ) (Set.Iio a)
    (show a ∉ Set.Iio a by simp) y
  exact hx.trans hy.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.leftOpen_map_to_endpoint_is_zero
statement:
theorem leftOpen_map_to_endpoint_is_zero (a p : ℝ) (h : p < a) :
    structureMapLinear (leftOpenRay a) (le_of_lt h) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (SupportInterval.structureMap_eq_zero_iff (k := ℚ) (Set.Iio a)
    (inferInstance : (Set.Iio a).OrdConnected) (le_of_lt h)).2
  rintro ⟨_, ha⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_Iio] at ha
  exact (lt_irrefl a) ha

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.singleton_fiber_nonzero
statement:
theorem singleton_fiber_nonzero (a : ℝ) :
    ∃ x : SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) ({a} : Set ℝ) a, (x : ℚ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨SupportInterval.one (k := ℚ) ({a} : Set ℝ) (p := a) (by simp), ?_⟩
  simp [SupportInterval.one]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.singleton_strict_map_zero
statement:
theorem singleton_strict_map_zero {s t a : ℝ} (h : s < t) :
    structureMapLinear (singletonInterval a) (le_of_lt h) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (SupportInterval.structureMap_eq_zero_iff (k := ℚ) ({a} : Set ℝ)
    (inferInstance : ({a} : Set ℝ).OrdConnected) (le_of_lt h)).2
  rintro ⟨hs, ht⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hs ht
  subst s
  subst t
  exact (lt_irrefl a) h

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.empty_family_fiber_is_subsingleton
statement:
theorem empty_family_fiber_is_subsingleton (t : ℝ) :
    Subsingleton ((AlgebraicFamily.familyModule emptyFamily).obj t)
proof:
:= by
  change Subsingleton (DirectSum Empty (fun e => (emptyFamily e).obj t))
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.endpoint_pos
statement: theorem endpoint_pos (n : ℕ) : 0 < endpoint n
proof:
:= by
  simpa [endpoint] using (Nat.one_div_pos_of_nat (α := ℝ) (n := n))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.endpoint_strict_antitone
statement: theorem endpoint_strict_antitone (n : ℕ) : endpoint (n + 1) < endpoint n
proof:
:= by
  simpa [endpoint] using
    (Nat.one_div_lt_one_div (α := ℝ) (Nat.lt_succ_self n))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.endpoint_antitone
statement: theorem endpoint_antitone {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) : endpoint n ≤ endpoint m
proof:
:= by
  simpa [endpoint] using (Nat.one_div_le_one_div (α := ℝ) h)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.accumulatingInterval_nonempty
statement: theorem accumulatingInterval_nonempty (n : ℕ) : (accumulatingInterval n).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨endpoint n, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨endpoint_strict_antitone n, le_rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.accumulatingInterval_disjoint_of_lt
statement:
theorem accumulatingInterval_disjoint_of_lt {i j : ℕ} (hij : i < j) :
    Disjoint (accumulatingInterval i) (accumulatingInterval j)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro x hx hy
  have hj : endpoint j ≤ endpoint (i + 1) := endpoint_antitone (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hij)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hy.2.trans hj)) hx.1

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.accumulatingInterval_disjoint
statement:
theorem accumulatingInterval_disjoint {i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (accumulatingInterval i) (accumulatingInterval j)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
  · exact accumulatingInterval_disjoint_of_lt h
  · exact (accumulatingInterval_disjoint_of_lt h).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.activeIndices_subsingleton
statement: theorem activeIndices_subsingleton (x : ℝ) : Set.Subsingleton (activeIndices x)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi j hj
  by_contra hij
  exact (Set.disjoint_left.mp (accumulatingInterval_disjoint hij)) hi hj

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.activeIndices_finite
statement: theorem activeIndices_finite (x : ℝ) : (activeIndices x).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hne : (activeIndices x).Nonempty
  · rcases hne with ⟨n, hn⟩
    refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_singleton n) ?_
    intro m hm
    have hmn : m = n := activeIndices_subsingleton x hm hn
    simp [hmn]
  · have hempty : activeIndices x = ∅ := by
      ext n
      simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      exact fun hn => hne ⟨n, hn⟩
    simp [hempty]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.infinitely_many_nonempty_occurrences
statement:
theorem infinitely_many_nonempty_occurrences :
    Set.Infinite {n : ℕ | (accumulatingInterval n).Nonempty}
proof:
:= by
  have hset : {n : ℕ | (accumulatingInterval n).Nonempty} = Set.univ := by
    ext n
    simp [accumulatingInterval_nonempty]
  rw [hset]
  exact Set.infinite_univ

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.occurrence_points_accumulate_at_zero
statement:
theorem occurrence_points_accumulate_at_zero :
    Tendsto endpoint atTop (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  change Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1)) atTop (nhds 0)
  exact tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalExamples.occurrence_point_lies_in_interval
statement: theorem occurrence_point_lies_in_interval (n : ℕ) : endpoint n ∈ accumulatingInterval n
proof:
:=
  ⟨endpoint_strict_antitone n, le_rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.diagonalCost_translate
statement:
private theorem diagonalCost_translate (p : ℝ × ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    diagonalCost (translateFinitePair a p) = diagonalCost p
proof:
:= by
  unfold diagonalCost translateFinitePair
  rw [show (p.2 + a) - (p.1 + a) = p.2 - p.1 by ring]

name: TDA.Persistence.occurrenceMatching_cost_translate
statement:
private theorem occurrenceMatching_cost_translate
    {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*} [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ) (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    M.cost (translateFinitePair a ∘ x) (translateFinitePair a ∘ y)
      (fun i => b i + a) (fun j => c j + a) = M.cost x y b c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold OccurrenceMatching.cost
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.sup_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    cases h : M.finite i with
    | none => simp [h, diagonalCost_translate]
    | some j => simp [h, finitePairCost_translate]
  · congr 1
    · apply Finset.sup_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      by_cases h : ∃ i, M.finite i = some j
      · simp [h]
      · simp [h, diagonalCost_translate]
    · apply Finset.sup_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      simp [essentialPairCost_translate]

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_translate
statement:
private theorem presentationBottleneck_translate
    {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*} [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck (translateFinitePair a ∘ x) (translateFinitePair a ∘ y)
      (fun i => b i + a) (fun j => c j + a) =
      presentationBottleneck x y b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold presentationBottleneck
  exact iInf_congr fun M => occurrenceMatching_cost_translate M x y b c a

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_map_translate_points
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finitePart, Multiset.filterMap_map, Multiset.map_filterMap]
  apply congrArg (fun f : (ℝ × WithTop ℝ) → Option (ℝ × ℝ) => s.filterMap f)
  funext p
  obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := p
  cases d <;> rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_map_translate_points
proof:
:= by
  simp only [essentialPart, Multiset.filterMap_map, Multiset.map_filterMap]
  apply congrArg (fun f : (ℝ × WithTop ℝ) → Option ℝ => s.filterMap f)
  funext p
  obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := p
  cases d <;> rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_translateDiagram_points
statement:
theorem finitePart_translateDiagram_points (D : Diagram ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    finitePart (translateDiagram D a).points =
      (finitePart D.points).map (fun p => (p.1 + a, p.2 + a))
proof:
:= by
  exact finitePart_map_translate_points D.points a

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_translateDiagram_points
statement:
theorem essentialPart_translateDiagram_points (D : Diagram ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    essentialPart (translateDiagram D a).points =
      (essentialPart D.points).map (fun b => b + a)
proof:
:= by
  exact essentialPart_map_translate_points D.points a

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_translateDiagram
statement:
theorem bottleneck_translateDiagram (D E : Diagram ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    bottleneck (translateDiagram D a) (translateDiagram E a) = bottleneck D E
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation (translateDiagram D a) (translateDiagram E a)
    (translateFinitePair a ∘ fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
    (translateFinitePair a ∘ fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
    (fun i : D.essentialOccurrences => i.1 + a)
    (fun j : E.essentialOccurrences => j.1 + a)
    ((Multiset.map_univ _ _).trans (finitePart_translateDiagram_points D a).symm)
    ((Multiset.map_univ _ _).trans (finitePart_translateDiagram_points E a).symm)
    ((Multiset.map_univ _ _).trans (essentialPart_translateDiagram_points D a).symm)
    ((Multiset.map_univ _ _).trans (essentialPart_translateDiagram_points E a).symm)]
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation D E
    (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
    (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
    (fun i : D.essentialOccurrences => i.1)
    (fun j : E.essentialOccurrences => j.1)
    (Multiset.map_univ_coe _)
    (Multiset.map_univ_coe _)
    (Multiset.map_univ_coe _)
    (Multiset.map_univ_coe _)]
  exact presentationBottleneck_translate _ _ _ _ a

name: TDA.Persistence.positiveOnEdges_scale_iff
statement:
theorem positiveOnEdges_scale_iff {f : FilterFunction K ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    PositiveOnEdges (f.scale c hc) ↔ PositiveOnEdges f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h σ hσ
    exact pos_of_mul_pos_right (by simpa using h σ hσ) hc.le
  · intro h σ hσ
    simpa using mul_pos hc (h σ hσ)

name: TDA.Persistence.PositiveOnEdges.scale
proof:
:=
  (positiveOnEdges_scale_iff hc).2 hf

name: TDA.Persistence.logCriticalValues_scale
statement:
theorem logCriticalValues_scale (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    logCriticalValues (f.scale c hc) =
      (logCriticalValues f).image (fun x => x + Real.log c)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hlog⟩ := (mem_logCriticalValues (f.scale c hc) x).1 hx
    have hσ' : 0 < f.value σ :=
      pos_of_mul_pos_right (by simpa using hσ) hc.le
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨Real.log (f.value σ),
      (mem_logCriticalValues f _).2 ⟨σ, hσ', rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← hlog, FilterFunction.scale_value, Real.log_mul hc.ne' hσ'.ne']
    ring
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hlog⟩ := (mem_logCriticalValues f y).1 hy
    apply (mem_logCriticalValues (f.scale c hc) _).2
    refine ⟨σ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa using mul_pos hc hσ
    · rw [FilterFunction.scale_value, Real.log_mul hc.ne' hσ.ne', hlog]
      ring

name: TDA.Persistence.logCriticalValues_scale_card
statement:
theorem logCriticalValues_scale_card (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (logCriticalValues (f.scale c hc)).card = (logCriticalValues f).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [logCriticalValues_scale]
  exact Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (add_left_injective (Real.log c))

name: TDA.Persistence.logGrid_scale_apply
statement:
theorem logGrid_scale_apply (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (i : Fin (logCriticalValues (f.scale c hc)).card) :
    logGrid (f.scale c hc) i =
      logGrid f (Fin.cast (logCriticalValues_scale_card f hc) i) + Real.log c
proof:
:= by
  let h := logCriticalValues_scale_card f hc
  have hmem : ∀ i : Fin (logCriticalValues (f.scale c hc)).card,
      logGrid f (Fin.cast h i) + Real.log c ∈ logCriticalValues (f.scale c hc) := by
    intro i
    have hi : logGrid f (Fin.cast h i) ∈ logCriticalValues f :=
      logGrid_mem f (Fin.cast h i)
    have himage : logGrid f (Fin.cast h i) + Real.log c ∈
        (logCriticalValues f).image (fun x => x + Real.log c) :=
      Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨logGrid f (Fin.cast h i), hi, rfl⟩
    exact (Finset.ext_iff.mp (logCriticalValues_scale f hc) _).mpr himage
  have hmono : StrictMono (fun i : Fin (logCriticalValues (f.scale c hc)).card =>
      logGrid f (Fin.cast h i) + Real.log c) := by
    intro i j hij
    exact add_lt_add_left ((logGrid f).strictMono (Fin.cast_strictMono h hij)) _
  have heq := Finset.orderEmbOfFin_unique (s := logCriticalValues (f.scale c hc))
    (k := (logCriticalValues (f.scale c hc)).card) rfl hmem hmono
  simpa [logGrid, h] using (congrFun heq i).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.logDgm_scale_points
statement:
theorem logDgm_scale_points (k : Type u) [Field k] {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (hf : PositiveOnEdges f) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (logDgm k (f.scale c hc) n).points =
      (logDgm k f n).points.map (translateDiagramPoint (Real.log c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDgm_points_eq_map_log k hn (hf.scale hc),
    dgm_scale k f n hc, Diagram.scale, Diagram.map_points,
    Multiset.map_map, logDgm_points_eq_map_log k hn hf, Multiset.map_map]
  apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := p
  have hb := dgm_birth_pos k hn hf hp
  have hd := dgm_death_pos k hn hf hp
  cases d with
  | top =>
    have hlog : Real.log (c * b) = Real.log b + Real.log c := by
      rw [Real.log_mul hc.ne' hb.ne']
      ring
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · change Real.log (c * b) = Real.log b + Real.log c
      exact hlog
    · change (⊤ : WithTop ℝ) = ⊤
      rfl
  | coe d =>
    have hd' : 0 < d := WithTop.coe_pos.mp hd
    refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
    · change Real.log (c * b) = Real.log b + Real.log c
      rw [Real.log_mul hc.ne' hb.ne']
      ring
    · change (Real.log (c * d) : WithTop ℝ) =
        ((Real.log d + Real.log c : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)
      exact congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : WithTop ℝ)) (by
        rw [Real.log_mul hc.ne' hd'.ne']
        ring)

name: TDA.Persistence.logDgm_scale
statement:
theorem logDgm_scale (k : Type u) [Field k] {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (hf : PositiveOnEdges f) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    logDgm k (f.scale c hc) n = translateDiagram (logDgm k f n) (Real.log c)
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  simpa [translateDiagram] using logDgm_scale_points k hn f hf hc

name: TDA.Persistence.logDgm_scale_scale
statement:
theorem logDgm_scale_scale (k : Type u) [Field k] {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (hf : PositiveOnEdges f) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    logDgm k ((f.scale a ha).scale b hb) n =
      translateDiagram (logDgm k f n) (Real.log a + Real.log b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FilterFunction.scale_scale, logDgm_scale k hn f hf (mul_pos hb ha)]
  rw [Real.log_mul hb.ne' ha.ne']
  rw [add_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.scale_inv_scale
statement:
private theorem scale_inv_scale (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (f.scale c hc).scale c⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hc) = f
proof:
:= by
  apply FilterFunction.ext
  intro s
  simp [FilterFunction.scale_value, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hc.ne']

name: TDA.Persistence.logModule_scale_shiftIso_of_le_one_hom_app
statement:
theorem logModule_scale_shiftIso_of_le_one_hom_app
    (R : Type v) [Ring R] (n : ℕ) (f : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) (t : ℝ) :
    (logModule_scale_shiftIso_of_le_one R n f hc hc1).hom.app t =
      eqToHom (by
        exact congrArg (fun g =>
          ((shift (logParam c⁻¹)).obj (logModule R g n)).obj t)
          (scale_inv_scale f hc).symm) ≫
        eqToHom (by
          rw [shift_obj, logModule_eq_reindex R n
            ((f.scale c hc).scale c⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hc)), sublevelModule_scale]
          rfl) ≫
        (sublevelModule R (f.scale c hc) n).map (eqToHom (by
          change (c⁻¹)⁻¹ * Real.exp (t + (logParam c⁻¹ : ℝ)) = Real.exp t
          rw [exp_add_logParam ((one_le_inv₀ hc).2 hc1) t]
          exact inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (inv_pos.mpr hc).ne' _)) ≫
        eqToHom (by
          rw [logModule_eq_reindex R n (f.scale c hc)]
          rfl)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [logModule_scale_shiftIso_of_le_one, Iso.trans_hom, NatTrans.comp_app,
    eqToIso.hom, eqToHom_app]
  rw [logModule_scale_shiftIso_hom_app]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_logDgm_scale
statement:
theorem bottleneck_logDgm_scale (k : Type u) [Field k] {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) (hf : PositiveOnEdges f) (hg : PositiveOnEdges g)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    bottleneck (logDgm k (f.scale c hc) n) (logDgm k (g.scale c hc) n) =
      bottleneck (logDgm k f n) (logDgm k g n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [logDgm_scale k hn f hf hc, logDgm_scale k hn g hg hc]
  exact bottleneck_translateDiagram _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_logModule_scale
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_logModule_scale
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) (hf : PositiveOnEdges f) (hg : PositiveOnEdges g)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    realInterleavingDistance (logModule k (f.scale c hc) n)
        (logModule k (g.scale c hc) n) =
      realInterleavingDistance (logModule k f n) (logModule k g n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bottleneck_logDgm_eq_realInterleavingDistance k hn
      (hf.scale hc) (hg.scale hc),
    ← bottleneck_logDgm_eq_realInterleavingDistance k hn hf hg,
    bottleneck_logDgm_scale k hn f g hf hg hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.filter_eq_scale_of_dist
proof:
:= by
  apply FilterFunction.ext
  intro s
  change Rips.diameter d' s.val = c * Rips.diameter d s.val
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (Rips.diameter_le_iff d' s.val _).2
    refine ⟨mul_nonneg hc.le (Rips.diameter_nonneg d s.val), ?_⟩
    intro v hv w hw
    rw [h]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Rips.dist_le_diameter d hv hw) hc.le
  · have hdiv : Rips.diameter d s.val ≤ Rips.diameter d' s.val / c := by
      apply (Rips.diameter_le_iff d s.val _).2
      refine ⟨div_nonneg (Rips.diameter_nonneg d' s.val) hc.le, ?_⟩
      intro v hv w hw
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hc).2
      calc
        d.dist v w * c = c * d.dist v w := mul_comm _ _
        _ = d'.dist v w := (h v w).symm
        _ ≤ Rips.diameter d' s.val := Rips.dist_le_diameter d' hv hw
    simpa [mul_comm] using (le_div_iff₀ hc).1 hdiv

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.radiusAt_smul
statement:
private theorem radiusAt_smul (p : V → X) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (y : X)
    (s : Finset V) :
    TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt (fun v => c • p v) (c • y) s =
      c * TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt p y s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt_le_iff _ _ _ _).2
    refine ⟨mul_nonneg hc.le (TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt_nonneg p y s), ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    rw [dist_smul₀, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (TDA.Filtration.Cech.dist_le_radiusAt p y hv) hc.le
  · have hdiv : TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt p y s ≤
        TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt (fun v => c • p v) (c • y) s / c := by
      apply (TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt_le_iff p y s _).2
      refine ⟨div_nonneg
        (TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt_nonneg (fun v => c • p v) (c • y) s) hc.le, ?_⟩
      intro v hv
      apply (le_div_iff₀ hc).2
      calc
        dist y (p v) * c = c * dist y (p v) := mul_comm _ _
        _ = dist (c • y) (c • p v) := by
          rw [dist_smul₀, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hc]
        _ ≤ TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt (fun v => c • p v) (c • y) s :=
          TDA.Filtration.Cech.dist_le_radiusAt (fun v => c • p v) (c • y) hv
    simpa [mul_comm] using (le_div_iff₀ hc).1 hdiv

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.filter_smul
statement:
theorem filter_smul (p : V → X) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    Cech.filter (fun v => c • p v) = (Cech.filter p).scale c hc
proof:
:= by
  let e : X ≃ X :=
    { toFun := fun y => c • y
      invFun := fun x => c⁻¹ • x
      left_inv := by
        intro y
        change c⁻¹ • (c • y) = y
        rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_smul]
      right_inv := by
        intro x
        change c • (c⁻¹ • x) = x
        rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne', one_smul] }
  apply FilterFunction.ext
  intro s
  change (⨅ x : X, TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt (fun v => c • p v) x s.val) =
    c * ⨅ y : X, TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt p y s.val
  calc
    (⨅ x : X, TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt (fun v => c • p v) x s.val) =
        ⨅ y : X, TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt (fun v => c • p v) (c • y) s.val :=
      (e.surjective.iInf_comp _).symm
    _ = ⨅ y : X, c * TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt p y s.val := by
      apply iInf_congr
      intro y
      exact radiusAt_smul p hc y s.val
    _ = c * ⨅ y : X, TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt p y s.val := by
      rw [Real.mul_iInf_of_nonneg hc.le]

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_logDgm_rips_cech_scale
statement:
theorem bottleneck_logDgm_rips_cech_scale
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fintype V] (d d' : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (h : ∀ v w, d'.dist v w = c * d.dist v w) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    bottleneck (logDgm k (Rips.filter d') n)
        (logDgm k (Cech.filter (fun v => c • p v)) n) =
      bottleneck (logDgm k (Rips.filter d) n) (logDgm k (Cech.filter p) n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rips.filter_eq_scale_of_dist d d' hc h, filter_smul p hc]
  exact bottleneck_logDgm_scale (V := V) (K := Rips.fullComplex V) k hn _ _
    (positiveOnEdges_rips d) (positiveOnEdges_cech d p hd) hc

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cut_at_critical
statement:
private theorem cut_at_critical (h : Refines c d) (i : Fin n) :
    sampledEndpoint (criticalSample c d) (i.val + 1) = (h.embedding i).val
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin m =>
      (criticalSample c d j).val < i.val + 1) = Finset.Iio (h.embedding i) := by
    ext j
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_Iio]
    change (cellIndex c (d j)).val < i.val + 1 ↔ j < h.embedding i
    calc
      _ ↔ ¬ i.val < (cellIndex c (d j)).val := by omega
      _ ↔ ¬ c i ≤ d j := not_congr (lt_cellIndex_iff c i (d j))
      _ ↔ d j < c i := not_le
      _ ↔ j < h.embedding i := by rw [← h.embedding_value i, d.lt_iff_lt]
  unfold sampledEndpoint
  rw [hs, Fin.card_Iio]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cut_positive
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Fin.val_mk, show e - 1 + 1 = e by omega] using
    cut_at_critical h ⟨e - 1, by omega⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cut_terminal
statement: private theorem cut_terminal : sampledEndpoint (criticalSample c d) (n + 1) = m
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin m =>
      (criticalSample c d j).val < n + 1) = Finset.univ := by
    ext j
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, iff_true]
    exact (criticalSample c d j).isLt
  unfold sampledEndpoint
  rw [hs, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.restricted_real_endpoint
statement:
private theorem restricted_real_endpoint (h : Refines c d)
    (I : FiniteInterval (n + 1)) (hb : 0 < I.birth) :
    Option.map (RealBarcode.endpoints d) (I.restrictAlong (criticalSample c d)) =
      some (RealBarcode.endpoints c (RealBarcode.dropZero I hb))
proof:
:= by
  have hbd := I.birth_lt_death
  have hdn := I.death_le_size
  let b : Fin n := ⟨I.birth - 1, by omega⟩
  have hbcut := cut_positive h I.birth hb (by omega)
  change sampledEndpoint (criticalSample c d) I.birth = (h.embedding b).val at hbcut
  by_cases hd : I.death < n + 1
  · let e : Fin n := ⟨I.death - 1, by omega⟩
    have hdcut := cut_positive h I.death (by omega) (by omega)
    change sampledEndpoint (criticalSample c d) I.death = (h.embedding e).val at hdcut
    have hbe : b < e := by change I.birth - 1 < I.death - 1; omega
    have hlt : (h.embedding b).val < (h.embedding e).val := h.embedding.strictMono hbe
    simp only [FiniteInterval.restrictAlong, hbcut, hdcut, dif_pos hlt, Option.map_some]
    apply congrArg some
    apply Prod.ext
    · change d (h.embedding b) = c b
      exact h.embedding_value b
    · dsimp only [RealBarcode.endpoints, RealBarcode.dropZero]
      erw [dif_pos (h.embedding e).isLt, dif_pos (show I.death - 1 < n by omega)]
      exact congrArg (fun x : ℝ => (x : WithTop ℝ)) (h.embedding_value e)
  · have he : I.death = n + 1 := by omega
    have hdcut : sampledEndpoint (criticalSample c d) I.death = m := by
      rw [he]; exact cut_terminal
    have hlt := (h.embedding b).isLt
    simp only [FiniteInterval.restrictAlong, hbcut, hdcut, dif_pos hlt, Option.map_some]
    apply congrArg some
    apply Prod.ext
    · change d (h.embedding b) = c b
      exact h.embedding_value b
    · dsimp only [RealBarcode.endpoints, RealBarcode.dropZero]
      simp [he]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.ofIndexBars_refinement
statement:
private theorem ofIndexBars_refinement (h : Refines c d)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval (n + 1))) (hb : ∀ I ∈ B, 0 < I.birth) :
    ofIndexBars d d.strictMono (reindexBarcode (criticalSample c d) B) =
      ofIndexBars c c.strictMono (reindexBarcode (Fin.succOrderEmb n).toOrderHom B)
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  rw [RealBarcode.ofIndexBars_points, RealBarcode.ofIndexBars_points]
  simp only [reindexBarcode, Multiset.map_filterMap]
  revert hb
  induction B using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => intro _; rfl
  | @cons I B ih =>
    intro hb
    have hi : 0 < I.birth := hb I (Multiset.mem_cons_self _ _)
    have ht : ∀ J ∈ B, 0 < J.birth := fun J hJ => hb J (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hJ)
    have he := restricted_real_endpoint h I hi
    simpa only [Multiset.filterMap_cons, he, RealBarcode.restrictAlong_succ I hi,
      Option.map_some, Option.getD_some] using
      congrArg (fun s => {RealBarcode.endpoints c (RealBarcode.dropZero I hi)} + s) (ih ht)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.finiteDimensional_of_isConstructible
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_of_isConstructible (hM : IsConstructible c M)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))) (t : ℝ) :
    FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional k ((reindex (cellIndex c) (sample c M)).obj t) := by
    change FiniteDimensional k ((sample c M).obj (cellIndex c t))
    exact finiteDimensional_sample c M hfd _
  exact ((reconstructionIso c M hM).app t).toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram_refinement
statement:
theorem moduleDiagram_refinement (h : Refines c d) (hM : IsConstructible c M)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))) :
    moduleDiagram d M (fun j => finiteDimensional_of_isConstructible M hM hfd (d j)) =
      moduleDiagram c M hfd
proof:
:= by
  let A := sample c M
  have : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj i) := finiteDimensional_sample c M hfd
  have : ∀ j, FiniteDimensional k ((reindex d.toOrderHom M).obj j) := by
    intro j
    change FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (d j))
    exact finiteDimensional_of_isConstructible M hM hfd (d j)
  have : ∀ j, FiniteDimensional k ((reindex (criticalSample c d) A).obj j) := by
    intro j
    change FiniteDimensional k (A.obj (criticalSample c d j))
    infer_instance
  have : ∀ j, FiniteDimensional k ((reindex c.toOrderHom M).obj j) := by
    intro j
    change FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c j))
    exact hfd j
  have e : reindex (criticalSample c d) A ≅ reindex d.toOrderHom M :=
    Functor.isoWhiskerLeft d.toOrderHom.toFunctor (reconstructionIso c M hM)
  unfold moduleDiagram
  rw [rankBarcode_eq_of_iso e.symm, rankBarcode_reindex A]
  change ofIndexBars d d.strictMono (reindexBarcode (criticalSample c d) (sampleBarcode c M hfd)) = _
  rw [ofIndexBars_refinement h _ (sampleBarcode_birth_pos c M hfd),
    ← moduleDiagram_eq_reindex_sample c M hfd]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.count_birth_step
statement:
private theorem count_birth_step (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s)) (b c : ℕ)
    (hb : 0 < b) :
    B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ b ∧ c < I.death) =
      birthSuffixCount B b c + B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ b - 1 ∧ c < I.death)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction B using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [birthSuffixCount]
  | @cons I B ih =>
    simp only [birthSuffixCount, Multiset.countP_cons] at ih ⊢
    split_ifs <;> omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.previous_image_le
statement:
private theorem previous_image_le (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s)) (b c : ℕ)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hc : c < s) :
    LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M
      (show (⟨b - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin s) ≤ ⟨c, hc⟩ from by change b - 1 ≤ c; omega)) ≤
    LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M
      (show (⟨b, by omega⟩ : Fin s) ≤ ⟨c, hc⟩ from hbc))
proof:
:= by
  rw [structureMapLinear_comp M
    (show (⟨b - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin s) ≤ ⟨b, by omega⟩ from by change b - 1 ≤ b; omega)
    (show (⟨b, by omega⟩ : Fin s) ≤ ⟨c, hc⟩ from hbc)]
  exact LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.previous_image_finrank
statement:
private theorem previous_image_finrank (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (b c : ℕ)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hc : c < s) :
    Module.finrank k (birthPreviousImage M b c hb hbc hc) =
      structureMapRank M ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩ (by change b - 1 ≤ c; omega)
proof:
:= by
  unfold birthPreviousImage structureMapRank
  rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq, Submodule.map_comap_subtype,
    inf_of_le_right (previous_image_le M b c hb hbc hc)]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthSuffixCount_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem birthSuffixCount_eq_finrank (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (b c : ℕ)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hc : c < s) :
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode M) b c =
      Module.finrank k ((LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M
        (show (⟨b, Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hbc hc⟩ : Fin s) ≤ ⟨c, hc⟩ from hbc))) ⧸
          birthPreviousImage M b c hb hbc hc)
proof:
:= by
  have hcounts := count_birth_step (rankBarcode M) b c hb
  have hcurrent := structureMapRank_rankBarcode M ⟨b, by omega⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩ hbc
  have hprevious := structureMapRank_rankBarcode M ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩
    (by change b - 1 ≤ c; omega)
  rw [rank_barcodeMap] at hcurrent hprevious
  have hdim := (birthPreviousImage M b c hb hbc hc).finrank_quotient_add_finrank
  rw [previous_image_finrank] at hdim
  change _ + _ = structureMapRank M ⟨b, by omega⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩ hbc at hdim
  change (rankBarcode M).countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ b ∧ c < I.death) = _ at hcurrent
  change (rankBarcode M).countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ b - 1 ∧ c < I.death) = _ at hprevious
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthSuffixCount_zero
statement:
theorem birthSuffixCount_zero (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (c : ℕ) (hc : c < s) :
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode M) 0 c =
      structureMapRank M ⟨0, by omega⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩ (by change 0 ≤ c; omega)
proof:
:= by
  have h := structureMapRank_rankBarcode M ⟨0, by omega⟩ ⟨c, hc⟩
    (by change 0 ≤ c; omega)
  rw [rank_barcodeMap] at h
  simpa [birthSuffixCount, Nat.le_zero] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.naturality_apply
statement:
private theorem naturality_apply {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s)} (p : M ⟶ N)
    {a c : Fin s} (h : a ≤ c) (x : M.obj a) :
    (p.app c).hom (structureMapLinear M h x) =
      structureMapLinear N h ((p.app a).hom x)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f : M.obj a ⟶ N.obj c => f.hom x) (p.naturality (homOfLE h))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.imageMap_surjective
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨y, x, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hp a x
  refine ⟨⟨structureMapLinear M h z, z, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact naturality_apply p h z

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.imageMap_previous
statement:
private theorem imageMap_previous {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s)} (p : M ⟶ N)
    (b c : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hc : c < s) :
    birthPreviousImage M b c hb hbc hc ≤
      (birthPreviousImage N b c hb hbc hc).comap
        (imageMap p (show (⟨b, by omega⟩ : Fin s) ≤ ⟨c, hc⟩ from hbc))
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨y, hy⟩
  change (p.app _).hom x.val ∈ LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear N _)
  refine ⟨(p.app ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).hom y, ?_⟩
  rw [← naturality_apply, hy]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthQuotientMap_surjective
statement:
private theorem birthQuotientMap_surjective {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s)} (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (b c : ℕ) (hb : 0 < b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hc : c < s) :
    Function.Surjective (birthQuotientMap p b c hb hbc hc)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  induction y using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H y =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := imageMap_surjective p hp
      (show (⟨b, by omega⟩ : Fin s) ≤ ⟨c, hc⟩ from hbc) y
    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk x, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthSuffixCount_le_of_surjective
statement:
theorem birthSuffixCount_le_of_surjective {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s)}
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj i)]
    (p : M ⟶ N) (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (b c : ℕ) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hc : c < s) :
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode N) b c ≤ birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode M) b c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · subst b
    rw [birthSuffixCount_zero M c hc, birthSuffixCount_zero N c hc]
    exact LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_surjective (imageMap_surjective p hp _)
  · have hbpos : 0 < b := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hb
    rw [birthSuffixCount_eq_finrank M b c hbpos hbc hc,
      birthSuffixCount_eq_finrank N b c hbpos hbc hc]
    exact LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_surjective
      (birthQuotientMap_surjective p hp b c hbpos hbc hc)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInterval.alive_middle
statement:
private theorem alive_middle {N : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval N) {i j ℓ : Fin N}
    (hij : i ≤ j) (hjℓ : j ≤ ℓ) (hi : I.alive i) (hℓ : I.alive ℓ) : I.alive j
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨hi.1.trans (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp hij),
    (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp hjℓ).trans_lt hℓ.2⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapLinear_intervalModule
statement:
private theorem structureMapLinear_intervalModule {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (I : FiniteInterval N) {i j : Fin N} (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapLinear (intervalModule (k := k) I) hij = intervalMap (k := k) I hij
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.intervalMap_finrank_range
statement:
theorem intervalMap_finrank_range {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (I : FiniteInterval N) {i j : Fin N} (hij : i ≤ j)
    [decAlive : Decidable (I.alive i ∧ I.alive j)] :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (intervalMap (k := k) I hij)) =
      if I.alive i ∧ I.alive j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : I.alive i ∧ I.alive j
  · rw [if_pos h]
    have hi : I.fiber (k := k) i = ⊤ := by simp [FiniteInterval.fiber, h.1]
    have hmap : intervalMap (k := k) I hij =
        Submodule.inclusion (by simp [FiniteInterval.fiber, h.1, h.2]) := by
      simp [intervalMap, h]
    have hinj : Function.Injective (intervalMap (k := k) I hij) := by
      rw [hmap]
      exact Submodule.inclusion_injective _
    rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hinj, hi]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg h]
    have hmap : intervalMap (k := k) I hij = 0 := by simp [intervalMap, h]
    rw [hmap]
    simp [LinearMap.range_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.interval_alive_endpoints_iff
statement:
theorem interval_alive_endpoints_iff {N : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval N)
    {i j : Fin N} (hij : i ≤ j) :
    (I.alive i ∧ I.alive j) ↔ I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hi, hj⟩
    exact ⟨hi.1, hj.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hb, jd⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hb, (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp hij).trans_lt jd⟩,
      ⟨hb.trans (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp hij), jd⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTameDiagramMultiplicity_rectangle_counts
statement:
theorem qTameDiagramMultiplicity_rectangle_counts (k : Type v) [Field k]
    (hX : TotallyBounded (univ : Set X)) (n : ℕ)
    (a b c d : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) (hcd : c < d) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ),
      (∀ p, p ∈ S ↔ p ∈ rectangleCell a b c d ∧
        0 < qTameDiagramMultiplicity k hX n p) ∧
      persistenceMeasureValue
        (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
        hab.le hbc.le hcd.le =
        ∑ p ∈ S, qTameDiagramMultiplicity k hX n p
proof:
:= by
  exact moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_rectangle_counts
    (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
    (qTame_of_totallyBounded k hX n) a b c d hab hbc hcd

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTameDiagramMultiplicity_essential_counts
statement:
theorem qTameDiagramMultiplicity_essential_counts (k : Type v) [Field k]
    (hX : TotallyBounded (univ : Set X)) (n : ℕ)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Cut ℝ),
      (∀ birth, birth ∈ S ↔ birth ∈ cutCell a b ∧
        0 < qTameDiagramMultiplicity k hX n (birth, infinityCut)) ∧
      essentialMeasureValue
        (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n) hab =
        ∑ birth ∈ S, qTameDiagramMultiplicity k hX n (birth, infinityCut)
proof:
:= by
  exact moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_essential_counts
    (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
    (qTame_of_totallyBounded k hX n) hab

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTameDiagramMultiplicity_tail_counts
statement:
theorem qTameDiagramMultiplicity_tail_counts (k : Type v) [Field k]
    (hX : TotallyBounded (univ : Set X)) (n : ℕ)
    (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ),
      (∀ p, p ∈ S ↔ p ∈ tailRectangleCell a b c ∧
        0 < qTameDiagramMultiplicity k hX n p) ∧
      persistenceTailMeasureValue
        (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
        hab.le hbc.le =
        ∑ p ∈ S, qTameDiagramMultiplicity k hX n p
proof:
:= by
  exact moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_tail_counts
    (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
    (qTame_of_totallyBounded k hX n) a b c hab hbc

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTameDiagramMultiplicity_tail_locally_finite
statement:
theorem qTameDiagramMultiplicity_tail_locally_finite (k : Type v) [Field k]
    (hX : TotallyBounded (univ : Set X)) (n : ℕ)
    (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) :
    Set.Finite {p | p ∈ tailRectangleCell a b c ∧
      0 < qTameDiagramMultiplicity k hX n p}
proof:
:= by
  exact moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_tail_locally_finite
    (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
    (qTame_of_totallyBounded k hX n) a b c hab hbc

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTameDiagramMultiplicity_countable_support
proof:
:= by
  exact moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_countable_support
    (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
    (qTame_of_totallyBounded k hX n)

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.uniform_limits
statement:
private theorem uniform_limits {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V] [Fintype V]
    {X : Type w} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) : uniformLimits (V := V) (X := X) k n R
proof:
:=
  ⟨Cech.finitePMatchingCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck k n hn R hR,
    Cech.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck k n hn R hR⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.error_bounds
statement:
private theorem error_bounds {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V] [Fintype V]
    {X : Type w} [PseudoMetricSpace X] {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (a b : V → X) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hδ : Cech.displacement a b ≤ R) : errorBounds p k a b n R
proof:
:=
  ⟨Cech.finitePMatchingCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound hp k a b hn hR hδ,
    Cech.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound hp k a b hn hR hδ⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.radius_pos
statement: private theorem radius_pos : 0 < radius
proof:
:= by
  have h := sqrt_five_bounds.2.1
  dsimp only [radius]
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.acute_points
statement:
private theorem acute_points :
    acuteDiagram.points = {((Real.sqrt 5 / 2 : ℝ), ((5 / 4 : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ))}
proof:
:=
  triangle_cech_dgm_one

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.right_points
statement: private theorem right_points : rightDiagram.points = 0
proof: := RightTriangle.rightTriangle_cech_dgm_one

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.acute_finitePart
statement:
private theorem acute_finitePart :
    finitePart acuteDiagram.points = {((Real.sqrt 5 / 2, 5 / 4) : ℝ × ℝ)}
proof:
:= by
  rw [acute_points]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.right_finitePart
statement: private theorem right_finitePart : finitePart rightDiagram.points = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [right_points]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.acute_card
statement: private theorem acute_card : Fintype.card acuteDiagram.finiteOccurrences = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Multiset.card_coe, acute_finitePart, Multiset.card_singleton]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.right_card
statement: private theorem right_card : Fintype.card rightDiagram.finiteOccurrences = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Multiset.card_coe, right_finitePart, Multiset.card_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.acute_coordinates
statement:
private theorem acute_coordinates (q : acuteDiagram.finiteOccurrences) :
    q.1 = ((Real.sqrt 5 / 2, 5 / 4) : ℝ × ℝ)
proof:
:=
  Multiset.mem_singleton.mp
    (by simpa only [acute_finitePart] using (Multiset.coe_mem (x := q)))

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.diagram_counts
statement:
private theorem diagram_counts :
    Fintype.card acuteDiagram.finiteOccurrences = 1 ∧
    Fintype.card rightDiagram.finiteOccurrences = 0 ∧
    2 * Nat.choose (Fintype.card (Fin 3)) (1 + 2) = 2
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨acute_card, right_card, by norm_num [Nat.choose]⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.label_distances
statement:
private theorem label_distances (v : Fin 3) :
    dist (acute v) (right v) = if v = 2 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases v
  · norm_num [acute, right]; decide
  · norm_num [acute, right]; decide
  · change dist (acute 2) (right 2) = 1
    calc
      dist (acute 2) (right 2) = √(dist (acute 2) (right 2) ^ 2) :=
        (Real.sqrt_sq dist_nonneg).symm
      _ = 1 := by
        rw [Triangle.dist_sq]
        norm_num [acute, right]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.acute_right_displacement
statement: private theorem acute_right_displacement : Cech.displacement acute right = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (Cech.displacement_le_iff acute right 1).2
    refine ⟨by norm_num, fun v => ?_⟩
    rw [label_distances]
    split <;> norm_num
  · calc
      1 = dist (acute 2) (right 2) := by rw [label_distances]; norm_num
      _ ≤ Cech.displacement acute right := Cech.dist_le_displacement acute right 2

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.acute_diagonal
statement:
private theorem acute_diagonal :
    diagonalCost ((Real.sqrt 5 / 2, 5 / 4) : ℝ × ℝ) = ENNReal.ofReal radius
proof:
:= by
  have h : 0 < (5 / 4 : ℝ) - Real.sqrt 5 / 2 := by linarith [sqrt_five_bounds.2.1]
  dsimp only [diagonalCost, radius]
  rw [abs_of_pos h]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.right_eq_empty_rips
statement: private theorem right_eq_empty_rips : rightDiagram = dgm (ZMod 2) ripsT 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  rw [right_points, triangle_rips_dgm_one]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.acute_right_bottleneck
statement:
private theorem acute_right_bottleneck :
    bottleneck acuteDiagram rightDiagram = ENNReal.ofReal radius
proof:
:= by
  rw [right_eq_empty_rips, bottleneck_comm]
  exact triangle_bottleneck_one

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.acute_right_matching_reindex
statement:
private theorem acute_right_matching_reindex (p : ℝ) :
    matching p acuteDiagram rightDiagram =
      finitePMatchingCost p (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((Real.sqrt 5 / 2, 5 / 4) : ℝ × ℝ))
        (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let u := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq acute_card).symm
  let v := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq right_card).symm
  have hx : (fun q : acuteDiagram.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ∘ u =
      fun _ : Fin 1 => ((Real.sqrt 5 / 2, 5 / 4) : ℝ × ℝ) := by
    funext i
    exact acute_coordinates _
  have hy : (fun q : rightDiagram.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ∘ v =
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) := by
    funext i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  simpa only [hx, hy] using
    (finitePMatchingCost_reindex u v p (fun q : acuteDiagram.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
      (fun q : rightDiagram.finiteOccurrences => q.1)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.acute_right_matching
statement:
private theorem acute_right_matching {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    matching p acuteDiagram rightDiagram = radius
proof:
:= by
  rw [acute_right_matching_reindex, finitePMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right]
  simp only [acute_diagonal, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal radius_pos.le, Fin.sum_univ_one]
  exact Real.rpow_rpow_inv radius_pos.le (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp))

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.acute_right_costs
statement:
private theorem acute_right_costs {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    0 < radius ∧ bottleneck acuteDiagram rightDiagram = ENNReal.ofReal radius ∧
    matching p acuteDiagram rightDiagram = radius ∧
    transport p acuteDiagram rightDiagram = radius
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨radius_pos, acute_right_bottleneck, acute_right_matching hp, ?_⟩
  rw [transport, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  exact acute_right_matching hp

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.acute_right_budget_and_uniform
statement:
private theorem acute_right_budget_and_uniform :
    (acute, right) ∈ {z : (Fin 3 → Plane) × (Fin 3 → Plane) |
      Cech.displacement z.1 z.2 ≤ 1} ∧
    uniformLimits (V := Fin 3) (X := Plane) (ZMod 2) 1 1
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨by change Cech.displacement acute right ≤ 1; exact acute_right_displacement.le,
    uniform_limits (ZMod 2) 1 (le_refl 1) (by norm_num)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.acute_right_error_examples
proof:
:= by
  have hδ : Cech.displacement acute right ≤ 1 := acute_right_displacement.le
  exact ⟨error_bounds (by norm_num) (ZMod 2) acute right (le_refl 1) (by norm_num) hδ,
    error_bounds (by norm_num) (ZMod 2) acute right (le_refl 1) (by norm_num) hδ⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.acute_right_errors_zero
proof:
:= by
  rcases acute_right_costs hp with ⟨hr, hB, hm, ht⟩
  simp only [hB, hm, ht, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hr.le, sub_self, abs_zero, and_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.nonempty_zero_radius
statement:
private theorem nonempty_zero_radius {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    Fintype.card acuteDiagram.finiteOccurrences = 1 ∧
    (acute, acute) ∈ {z : (Fin 3 → Plane) × (Fin 3 → Plane) |
      Cech.displacement z.1 z.2 ≤ 0} ∧ bottleneck acuteDiagram acuteDiagram = 0 ∧
    matching p acuteDiagram acuteDiagram = 0 ∧ transport p acuteDiagram acuteDiagram = 0 ∧
    errorBounds p (ZMod 2) acute acute 1 0 ∧
    uniformLimits (V := Fin 3) (X := Plane) (ZMod 2) 1 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨acute_card, by simp, bottleneck_self _, finitePMatchingCost_self hp _,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_self hp _, ?_, uniform_limits (ZMod 2) 1 (le_refl 1) le_rfl⟩
  exact error_bounds hp (ZMod 2) acute acute (le_refl 1) le_rfl (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.diagram_points_zero_of_parts
statement:
private theorem diagram_points_zero_of_parts (D : Diagram ℝ)
    (hf : finitePart D.points = 0) (he : essentialPart D.points = 0) : D.points = 0
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.empty_diagram
statement:
private theorem empty_diagram {X : Type w} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (a : Fin 0 → X) (n : ℕ) : (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter a) n).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  let : IsEmpty (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 0))) :=
    ⟨fun s => by obtain ⟨v, _⟩ := s.property; exact Fin.elim0 v⟩
  exact dgm_empty_faces (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter a) n

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.empty_label_controls
statement:
private theorem empty_label_controls {X : Type w} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (a b : Fin 0 → X) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (a, b) ∈ {z : (Fin 0 → X) × (Fin 0 → X) | Cech.displacement z.1 z.2 ≤ 0} ∧
    Fintype.card (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter a) 1).finiteOccurrences = 0 ∧
    bottleneck (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter a) 1) (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter b) 1) = 0 ∧
    matching p (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter a) 1) (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter b) 1) = 0 ∧
    transport p (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter a) 1) (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter b) 1) = 0 ∧
    2 * Nat.choose (Fintype.card (Fin 0)) (1 + 2) = 0 ∧
    max 1 (2 * Nat.choose (Fintype.card (Fin 0)) (1 + 2)) = 1 ∧
    errorBounds p (ZMod 2) a b 1 0 ∧
    uniformLimits (V := Fin 0) (X := X) (ZMod 2) 1 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc (c : Fin 0 → X) :
      Fintype.card (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter c) 1).finiteOccurrences = 0 := by
    rw [Multiset.card_coe, empty_diagram c 1]
    rfl
  let : IsEmpty (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter a) 1).finiteOccurrences :=
    Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp (hc a)
  let : IsEmpty (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter b) 1).finiteOccurrences :=
    Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp (hc b)
  have heq : dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter a) 1 = dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter b) 1 := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    rw [empty_diagram a 1, empty_diagram b 1]
  refine ⟨by simp, hc a, ?_, finitePMatchingCost_empty hp _ _,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty hp _ _, by norm_num [Nat.choose],
    by norm_num [Nat.choose], ?_,
    uniform_limits (ZMod 2) 1 (le_refl 1) le_rfl⟩
  · rw [heq]
    exact bottleneck_self _
  · exact error_bounds hp (ZMod 2) a b (le_refl 1) le_rfl (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.repeated_points
statement: private theorem repeated_points : repeatedDiagram.points = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact diagram_points_zero_of_parts _
    (TotalPersistenceRipsCechExamples.repeated_cech_finitePart_eq_zero 1)
    (Cech.essentialPart_dgm_eq_zero (ZMod 2) Repeated.pts (le_refl 1))

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.repeated_label_controls
statement:
private theorem repeated_label_controls {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    ¬Function.Injective Repeated.pts ∧ repeatedDiagram.points = 0 ∧
    (Repeated.pts, Repeated.pts) ∈ {z : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 2 → ℝ) |
      Cech.displacement z.1 z.2 ≤ 0} ∧
    matching p repeatedDiagram repeatedDiagram = 0 ∧
    transport p repeatedDiagram repeatedDiagram = 0 ∧
    errorBounds p (ZMod 2) Repeated.pts Repeated.pts 1 0 ∧
    uniformLimits (V := Fin 2) (X := ℝ) (ZMod 2) 1 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, repeated_points, by simp, finitePMatchingCost_self hp _,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_self hp _, ?_,
    uniform_limits (ZMod 2) 1 (le_refl 1) le_rfl⟩
  · intro h
    have he : (0 : Fin 2) = 1 := h (by rfl)
    exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1) he
  · exact error_bounds hp (ZMod 2) Repeated.pts Repeated.pts (le_refl 1) le_rfl (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.repeated_minimum
statement:
theorem repeated_minimum :
    finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost 2 (fun _ : Fin 2 => ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ))
      (fun _ : Unit => (0, 2)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan _ _ _ repeatedHalfPlan).trans_eq
      repeated_fractional_cost
  · rw [finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
    apply (le_finitePowerMatchingCost_iff _ _ _ _).mpr
    intro M
    cases h0 : M.finite 0 with
    | none =>
      cases h1 : M.finite 1 with
      | none =>
        norm_num [OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost,
          Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.exists_fin_succ, h0, h1, diagonalCost, Real.rpow_two]
        simp
      | some j =>
        cases j
        norm_num [OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost,
          Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.exists_fin_succ, h0, h1, finitePairCost, diagonalCost, Real.rpow_two]
    | some j =>
      cases j
      cases h1 : M.finite 1 with
      | none =>
        norm_num [OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost,
          Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.exists_fin_succ, h0, h1, finitePairCost, diagonalCost, Real.rpow_two]
      | some j =>
        cases j
        have h := M.finite_injective 0 1 () h0 h1
        norm_num at h
