name: TDA.Persistence.ofIndexBars_points'
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_self_scale_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_self_scale_le (D : Diagram ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {M : ℝ}
    (hfin : ∀ p ∈ finitePart D.points, |p.1| ≤ M ∧ |p.2| ≤ M)
    (hess : ∀ b ∈ essentialPart D.points, |b| ≤ M) :
    bottleneck D (D.scale c hc) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (|1 - c| * M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation D (D.scale c hc)
    (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
    (scaleFinitePair c ∘ fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
    (fun e : D.essentialOccurrences => e.1)
    (fun e : D.essentialOccurrences => c * e.1)
    (Multiset.map_univ_coe _)
    ((Multiset.map_univ _ _).trans (finitePart_scale_points' D hc).symm)
    (Multiset.map_univ_coe _)
    ((Multiset.map_univ _ _).trans (essentialPart_scale_points' D hc).symm)]
  let matching : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences D.finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences D.essentialOccurrences :=
    ⟨some, fun i i' j hi hi' => Option.some.inj (hi.trans hi'.symm), Equiv.refl _⟩
  refine (presentationBottleneck_le_cost
    (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
    (scaleFinitePair c ∘ fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
    (fun e : D.essentialOccurrences => e.1)
    (fun e : D.essentialOccurrences => c * e.1) matching).trans ?_
  apply OccurrenceMatching.cost_le_of matching
  · intro i
    change finitePairCost i.1 (scaleFinitePair c i.1) ≤ _
    have hi : i.1 ∈ finitePart D.points := Multiset.coe_mem (x := i)
    have hdiff (a : ℝ) : |a - c * a| = |1 - c| * |a| := by
      rw [← one_sub_mul, abs_mul]
    unfold finitePairCost scaleFinitePair
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    rw [hdiff, hdiff, ← mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ (abs_nonneg (1 - c))]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (max_le (hfin i.1 hi).1 (hfin i.1 hi).2) (abs_nonneg _)
  · intro j
    rw [if_pos ⟨j, rfl⟩]
    exact zero_le
  · intro i
    change essentialPairCost i.1 (c * i.1) ≤ _
    have hi : i.1 ∈ essentialPart D.points := Multiset.coe_mem (x := i)
    unfold essentialPairCost
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    rw [← one_sub_mul, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hess i.1 hi) (abs_nonneg _)

name: TDA.Persistence.mem_criticalValues_of_mem_finitePart_dgm
proof:
:= by
  unfold dgm at hp
  rw [ofIndexBars_points'] at hp
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzp⟩ := (Multiset.mem_filterMap _ _).mp hp
  obtain ⟨I, hI, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hz
  by_cases hdeath : I.death < f.criticalValues.card
  · let ib : Fin (f.criticalValues.card) :=
      ⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩
    let id : Fin (f.criticalValues.card) := ⟨I.death, hdeath⟩
    have hpoint : (f.criticalValue ib, f.criticalValue id) = p := by
      apply Option.some.inj
      simpa [indexEndpoints, ib, id, hdeath] using hzp
    have hbirth := TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.criticalValue_mem f ib
    have hdeath' := TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.criticalValue_mem f id
    have hfirst := congrArg Prod.fst hpoint
    have hsecond := congrArg Prod.snd hpoint
    exact ⟨hfirst ▸ hbirth, hsecond ▸ hdeath'⟩
  · simp [indexEndpoints, hdeath] at hzp

name: TDA.Persistence.mem_criticalValues_of_mem_essentialPart_dgm
proof:
:= by
  unfold dgm at hb
  rw [ofIndexBars_points'] at hb
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzb⟩ := (Multiset.mem_filterMap _ _).mp hb
  obtain ⟨I, hI, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hz
  by_cases hdeath : I.death < f.criticalValues.card
  · simp [indexEndpoints, hdeath] at hzb
  · let ib : Fin (f.criticalValues.card) :=
      ⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩
    have hpoint : f.criticalValue ib = b := by
      apply Option.some.inj
      simpa [indexEndpoints, ib, hdeath] using hzb
    have hbirth := TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.criticalValue_mem f ib
    exact hpoint ▸ hbirth

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter_value_le_diameter_univ
statement:
theorem filter_value_le_diameter_univ {V : Type u} [Fintype V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) (s : TotalFace (fullComplex V)) :
    (Rips.filter d).value s ≤ diameter d Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [filter_value]
  exact diameter_mono d (Finset.subset_univ _)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.rips_dgm_coordinate_bounds
statement:
private theorem rips_dgm_coordinate_bounds (d : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ x ∈ finitePart (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).points,
      |x.1| ≤ Rips.diameter d Finset.univ ∧ |x.2| ≤ Rips.diameter d Finset.univ) ∧
      (∀ b ∈ essentialPart (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).points,
        |b| ≤ Rips.diameter d Finset.univ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x hx
    have hcrit := TDA.Persistence.mem_criticalValues_of_mem_finitePart_dgm
      k (Rips.filter d) hx
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ :=
      (TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues
        (Rips.filter d) x.1).1 hcrit.1
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ :=
      (TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues
        (Rips.filter d) x.2).1 hcrit.2
    have hxnonneg : 0 ≤ x.1 := by
      rw [← hs, Rips.filter_value]
      exact Rips.diameter_nonneg d _
    have hxle : x.1 ≤ Rips.diameter d Finset.univ := by
      rw [← hs]
      exact TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter_value_le_diameter_univ d s
    have hynonneg : 0 ≤ x.2 := by
      rw [← ht, Rips.filter_value]
      exact Rips.diameter_nonneg d _
    have hyle : x.2 ≤ Rips.diameter d Finset.univ := by
      rw [← ht]
      exact TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter_value_le_diameter_univ d t
    exact ⟨by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hxnonneg] using hxle,
      by simpa [abs_of_nonneg hynonneg] using hyle⟩
  · intro b hb
    have hcrit := TDA.Persistence.mem_criticalValues_of_mem_essentialPart_dgm
      k (Rips.filter d) hb
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ :=
      (TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues
        (Rips.filter d) b).1 hcrit
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ b := by
      rw [← hs, Rips.filter_value]
      exact Rips.diameter_nonneg d _
    have hle : b ≤ Rips.diameter d Finset.univ := by
      rw [← hs]

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_rips_scale_le
statement:
private theorem bottleneck_rips_scale_le (d : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n)
        ((dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Rips.diameter d Finset.univ / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := bottleneck_self_scale_le (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n)
    (c := (2 : ℝ)⁻¹) (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)
    (M := Rips.diameter d Finset.univ)
    (rips_dgm_coordinate_bounds k d n).1
    (rips_dgm_coordinate_bounds k d n).2
  have hfactor :
      |(1 : ℝ) - (2 : ℝ)⁻¹| * Rips.diameter d Finset.univ =
        Rips.diameter d Finset.univ / 2 := by
    rw [show |(1 : ℝ) - (2 : ℝ)⁻¹| = (1 : ℝ) / 2 by norm_num]
    ring
  rw [← hfactor]
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_rips_sub_cech_le
statement:
theorem norm_diagramEmbedding_rips_sub_cech_le (d : MetricSpace V)
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (n : ℕ)
    (σ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (Rips.diameter d Finset.univ / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := bottleneck_rips_cech_dgm_le_half_diameter k d p hd n
  have hfinite : bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n)
      (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) < ⊤ := hbound.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hreal : (bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n)
      (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n)).toReal ≤ Rips.diameter d Finset.univ / 2 := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
      (div_nonneg (Rips.diameter_nonneg d Finset.univ) zero_le_two)] using
      ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hbound
  exact (WeightedKernel.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ hA hB w _ _
    (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (dgm_isPositive k _ n) hfinite).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreal
        (mul_nonneg (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB)
          (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

  exact (WeightedKernel.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ τ hA hB w D _ _

statement:
theorem norm_diagramEmbedding_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le [Fintype V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (σ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (logDgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (logDgm k (Cech.filter p) n)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_diagramEmbedding_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le_bottleneck k d p hd hn σ hA hB w
  have h' := h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (toReal_bottleneck_logDgm_rips_cech_le k d p hd hn)
    (mul_nonneg (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))
  rw [card_finiteOccurrences_logDgm k hn (positiveOnEdges_rips d),
    card_finiteOccurrences_logDgm k hn (positiveOnEdges_cech d p hd)] at h'
  exact h'

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_diagramGaussianFeature_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le
statement:
theorem norm_diagramGaussianFeature_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le [Fintype V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (σ τ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w (logDgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w (logDgm k (Cech.filter p) n)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_diagramGaussianFeature_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le_bottleneck k d p hd hn σ τ hA hB w
  have h' := h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (toReal_bottleneck_logDgm_rips_cech_le k d p hd hn)
    (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB)
      (abs_nonneg τ)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))
  rw [card_finiteOccurrences_logDgm k hn (positiveOnEdges_rips d),
    card_finiteOccurrences_logDgm k hn (positiveOnEdges_cech d p hd)] at h'
  exact h'

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le [Fintype V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)

        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (logDgm k (Cech.filter p) n)| ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
proof:

  have h' := h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (toReal_bottleneck_logDgm_rips_cech_le k d p hd hn)
    (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le
statement:
theorem norm_finiteDiagramImage_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le [Fintype V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {Kp : Type*} [Fintype Kp] {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (P : Kp → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P (logDgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P (logDgm k (Cech.filter p) n)‖ ≤
      PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_finiteDiagramImage_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le_bottleneck k d p hd hn hσ hA hB w
    P hm hdisj
  have h' := h.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (toReal_bottleneck_logDgm_rips_cech_le k d p hd hn)
    (mul_nonneg (PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_nonneg hσ hA hB)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))
  rw [card_finiteOccurrences_logDgm k hn (positiveOnEdges_rips d),
    card_finiteOccurrences_logDgm k hn (positiveOnEdges_cech d p hd)] at h'
  exact h'

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le_arctan
statement:
theorem norm_diagramEmbedding_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le_arctan [Fintype V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (σ : ℝ) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)
          (logDgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)
          (logDgm k (Cech.filter p) n)‖ ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    norm_diagramEmbedding_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le k d p hd hn σ hC Real.pi_div_two_pos.le
      (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le_arctan
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le_arctan [Fintype V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (σ τ : ℝ) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    |WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) D
          (logDgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) D
          (logDgm k (Cech.filter p) n)| ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le k d p hd hn σ τ hC
      Real.pi_div_two_pos.le (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) D

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le_arctan
statement:
theorem norm_finiteDiagramImage_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le_arctan [Fintype V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {Kp : Type*} [Fintype Kp] {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (P : Kp → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) P
          (logDgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) P
          (logDgm k (Cech.filter p) n)‖ ≤
      (2 * C + 3 * √(π / 2) / σ) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.log 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    norm_finiteDiagramImage_logDgm_rips_sub_cech_le k d p hd hn hσ hC
      Real.pi_div_two_pos.le (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) P hm hdisj

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.inclusion_projection_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusion_projection_self {ι : Type} [Finite ι]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (i : ι) :
    inclusion (k := k) R i ≫ projection R i = 𝟙 ((R i).module)
proof:
:= by
  exact biproduct.ι_π_self (fun j : ι => (R j).module (k := k)) i

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.inclusion_projection_ne
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusion_projection_ne {ι : Type} [Finite ι]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) {i j : ι} (h : i ≠ j) :
    inclusion (k := k) R i ≫ projection R j = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact biproduct.ι_π_ne (fun j : ι => (R j).module (k := k)) h

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.sum_projection_inclusion
statement:
theorem sum_projection_inclusion {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) :
    ∑ i, projection (k := k) R i ≫ inclusion R i = 𝟙 (module (k := k) R)
proof:
:=
  biproduct.total (f := fun j : ι => (R j).module (k := k))

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_composite
statement:
theorem component_composite {ι κ ν : Type}
    [Finite ι] [Fintype κ] [Finite ν]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (T : ν → Rectangle n)
    (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : module (k := k) R ⟶ (shift ε).obj (module S))
    (g : module (k := k) S ⟶ (shift ε).obj (module T))
    (i : ι) (i' : ν) :
    ∑ j : κ, component (k := k) R S ε f i j ≫
        (shift ε).map (component (k := k) S T ε g j i') =
      inclusion (k := k) R i ≫ f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫
        (shift ε).map ((shift ε).map (projection (k := k) T i'))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [component, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [← Preadditive.comp_sum]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [← Preadditive.sum_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [← Preadditive.comp_sum]
  rw [← Functor.map_sum]
  have hs : (∑ a : κ, projection (k := k) S a ≫ inclusion S a ≫ g) = g := by
    simp only [← Category.assoc]
    rw [← Preadditive.sum_comp, sum_projection_inclusion, Category.id_comp]
  rw [hs]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_interleaving_sum
statement:
theorem component_interleaving_sum {ι κ : Type}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (module (k := k) R) (module S))
    (i i' : ι) :
    (∑ j : κ, component (k := k) R S ε I.φ i j ≫
      (shift ε).map (component S R ε I.ψ j i')) ≫
        (compIso ε ε ((R i').module (k := k))).hom =
      inclusion (k := k) R i ≫ transition (ε + ε) (module R) ≫
        (shift (ε + ε)).map (projection R i')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [component_composite]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [compIso_naturality ε ε (projection (k := k) R i')]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, I.φ_ψ]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_interleaving_sum_ne
statement:
theorem component_interleaving_sum_ne {ι κ : Type}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (module (k := k) R) (module S))
    {i i' : ι} (h : i ≠ i') :
    (∑ j : κ, component (k := k) R S ε I.φ i j ≫
      (shift ε).map (component S R ε I.ψ j i')) ≫
        (compIso ε ε ((R i').module (k := k))).hom = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [component_interleaving_sum R S ε I i i']
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [transition_naturality (ε + ε) (inclusion (k := k) R i)]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, inclusion_projection_ne R h,
    Functor.map_zero, comp_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleFamily.component_interleaving_sum_self
statement:
theorem component_interleaving_sum_self {ι κ : Type}
    [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (module (k := k) R) (module S))
    (i : ι) :
    (∑ j : κ, component (k := k) R S ε I.φ i j ≫
      (shift ε).map (component S R ε I.ψ j i)) ≫
        (compIso ε ε ((R i).module (k := k))).hom =
      transition (ε + ε) ((R i).module (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [component_interleaving_sum R S ε I i i]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [transition_naturality (ε + ε) (inclusion (k := k) R i)]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, inclusion_projection_self]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.le_of_path
statement: theorem le_of_path {i j : FiniteLine N} (p : Quiver.Path i j) : i.index ≤ j.index
proof:
:= by
  induction p with
  | nil => exact le_rfl
  | @cons j k p e ih =>
    have he := e.down
    change i.index.val ≤ k.index.val
    have hi : i.index.val ≤ j.index.val := ih
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.nonempty_path
statement:
private theorem nonempty_path (i j : FiniteLine N) (h : i.index ≤ j.index) :
    Nonempty (Quiver.Path i j)
proof:
:= by
  have aux : ∀ n, ∀ j : FiniteLine N, j.index.val = n → i.index ≤ j.index →
      Nonempty (Quiver.Path i j) := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro j hj hij
      by_cases heq : i = j
      · subst j
        exact ⟨.nil⟩
      · have hlt : i.index.val < j.index.val := by
          have hne : i.index.val ≠ j.index.val := by
            intro he
            exact heq (FiniteLine.ext (Fin.ext he))
          change i.index.val ≤ j.index.val at hij
          omega
        let k : FiniteLine N := ⟨⟨j.index.val - 1, by omega⟩⟩
        have hkn : k.index.val < n := by dsimp [k]; omega
        have hik : i.index ≤ k.index := by change i.index.val ≤ j.index.val - 1; omega
        obtain ⟨p⟩ := ih k.index.val hkn k rfl hik
        exact ⟨p.cons ⟨by dsimp [k]; omega⟩⟩
  exact aux j.index.val j rfl h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.path_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem path_self (i : FiniteLine N) (h : i.index ≤ i.index) :
    path h = (Quiver.Path.nil : Quiver.Path i i)
proof: := Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.path_adjacent
statement:
theorem path_adjacent {i j : FiniteLine N} (h : i.index.val + 1 = j.index.val) :
    path (show i.index ≤ j.index by change i.index.val ≤ j.index.val; omega) =
      Quiver.Hom.toPath (⟨h⟩ : i ⟶ j)
proof: := Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.path_comp
statement:
theorem path_comp {i j k : FiniteLine N} (hij : i.index ≤ j.index)
    (hjk : j.index ≤ k.index) :
    (path hij).comp (path hjk) = path (hij.trans hjk)
proof: := Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.moduleOfAdjacent_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem moduleOfAdjacent_obj (V : Fin N → ModuleCat.{w} R)
    (step : ∀ (i j : Fin N), i.val + 1 = j.val → (V i ⟶ V j)) (i : Fin N) :
    (moduleOfAdjacent V step).obj i = V i
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_adjacent
statement:
@[simp]
theorem structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_adjacent (V : Fin N → ModuleCat.{w} R)
    (step : ∀ (i j : Fin N), i.val + 1 = j.val → (V i ⟶ V j))
    {i j : Fin N} (h : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    structureMap (moduleOfAdjacent V step) (show i ≤ j by omega) = step i j h
proof:
:= by
  change (Paths.lift _).map
    (path (i := ⟨i⟩) (j := ⟨j⟩) (show i ≤ j by omega)) = _
  rw [path_adjacent (i := ⟨i⟩) (j := ⟨j⟩) h]
  exact Paths.lift_toPath _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.naturality_of_adjacent
statement:
theorem naturality_of_adjacent {M W : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)}
    (α : ∀ i, M.obj i ⟶ W.obj i)
    (hα : ∀ (i j : Fin N) (h : i.val + 1 = j.val),
      structureMap M (show i ≤ j by omega) ≫ α j =
        α i ≫ structureMap W (show i ≤ j by omega))
    {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    structureMap M h ≫ α j = α i ≫ structureMap W h
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ∀ {a b : FiniteLine N} (p : Quiver.Path a b),
      structureMap M (le_of_path p) ≫ α b.index =
        α a.index ≫ structureMap W (le_of_path p) := by
    intro a b p
    induction p with
    | nil => simp
    | @cons b c p e ih =>
      have hbc : b.index ≤ c.index := by
        have he := e.down
        change b.index.val ≤ c.index.val
        omega
      have hs := hα b.index c.index e.down
      have hm := structureMap_comp M (le_of_path p) hbc
      have hw := structureMap_comp W (le_of_path p) hbc
      rw [← hm, ← hw, Category.assoc, hs, ← Category.assoc, ih, Category.assoc]
  exact hp (path h)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.homMk_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homMk_app {M W : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)} (α) (hα) (i : Fin N) :
    (homMk (M := M) (W := W) α hα).app i = α i
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.homOfAdjacent_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem homOfAdjacent_app (V W : Fin N → ModuleCat.{w} R) (step step') (α) (hα)
    (i : Fin N) : (homOfAdjacent V W step step' α hα).app i = α i
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.isoOfAdjacent_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfAdjacent_hom_app {M W : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)} (e) (he) (i : Fin N) :
    (isoOfAdjacent (M := M) (W := W) e he).hom.app i = (e i).hom
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.isoOfAdjacent_inv_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem isoOfAdjacent_inv_app {M W : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)} (e) (he) (i : Fin N) :
    (isoOfAdjacent (M := M) (W := W) e he).inv.app i = (e i).inv
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_path
statement:
theorem structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_path (V : Fin N → ModuleCat.{w} R)
    (step : ∀ (i j : Fin N), i.val + 1 = j.val → (V i ⟶ V j))
    {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    structureMap (moduleOfAdjacent V step) h =
      (Paths.lift (⟨fun a => V a.index,
        fun {a b} e => step a.index b.index e.down⟩ :
          FiniteLine N ⥤q ModuleCat.{w} R)).map (path h)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_last
statement:
theorem structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_last (V : Fin N → ModuleCat.{w} R)
    (step : ∀ (i j : Fin N), i.val + 1 = j.val → (V i ⟶ V j))
    {i j k : Fin N} (hij : i ≤ j) (hjk : j.val + 1 = k.val) :
    structureMap (moduleOfAdjacent V step) (show i ≤ k by omega) =
      structureMap (moduleOfAdjacent V step) hij ≫ step j k hjk
proof:
:= by
  have hc := structureMap_comp (moduleOfAdjacent V step) hij (show j ≤ k by omega)
  erw [structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_adjacent V step hjk] at hc
  exact hc.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.adjacentRecovery_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjacentRecovery_hom_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)) (i : Fin N) :
    (adjacentRecovery M).hom.app i = 𝟙 (M.obj i)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.adjacentRecovery_inv_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem adjacentRecovery_inv_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)) (i : Fin N) :
    (adjacentRecovery M).inv.app i = 𝟙 (M.obj i)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.structureMap_adjacentRecovery
statement:
@[simp]
theorem structureMap_adjacentRecovery (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N))
    {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    structureMap (moduleOfAdjacent M.obj (adjacentMap M)) h = structureMap M h
proof:
:= by
  have hn := (adjacentRecovery M).hom.naturality (homOfLE h)
  change structureMap (moduleOfAdjacent M.obj (adjacentMap M)) h ≫ 𝟙 _ =
    𝟙 _ ≫ structureMap M h at hn
  exact (Category.comp_id _).symm.trans (hn.trans (Category.id_comp _))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.adjacentRecovery_naturality
statement:
theorem adjacentRecovery_naturality {M W : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)} (α : M ⟶ W) :
    homOfAdjacent M.obj W.obj (adjacentMap M) (adjacentMap W) α.app
      (fun _ _ h => α.naturality (homOfLE (show _ ≤ _ by omega))) ≫
        (adjacentRecovery W).hom = (adjacentRecovery M).hom ≫ α
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext i
  change α.app i ≫ 𝟙 _ = 𝟙 _ ≫ α.app i
  exact (Category.comp_id _).trans (Category.id_comp _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.pathEquivalence_functor_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pathEquivalence_functor_obj (i : Paths (FiniteLine N)) :
    (pathEquivalence N).functor.obj i = i.index
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.pathEquivalence_inverse_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem pathEquivalence_inverse_obj (i : Fin N) :
    (pathEquivalence N).inverse.obj i = (⟨i⟩ : FiniteLine N)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_obj_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_obj_obj (F : Paths (FiniteLine N) ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R)
    (i : Fin N) :
    ((representationEquivalence R N).functor.obj F).obj i = F.obj ⟨i⟩
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_structureMap
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_structureMap
    (F : Paths (FiniteLine N) ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R) {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    structureMap ((representationEquivalence R N).functor.obj F) h = F.map (path h)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_map_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_map_app
    {F G : Paths (FiniteLine N) ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R} (α : F ⟶ G) (i : Fin N) :
    ((representationEquivalence R N).functor.map α).app i = α.app ⟨i⟩
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_inverse_map
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_inverse_map (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N))
    {i j : Paths (FiniteLine N)} (p : i ⟶ j) :
    ((representationEquivalence R N).inverse.obj M).map p =
      structureMap M (le_of_path p)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_inverse_map_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_inverse_map_app
    {M W : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)} (α : M ⟶ W) (i : Paths (FiniteLine N)) :
    ((representationEquivalence R N).inverse.map α).app i = α.app i.index
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_unitIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_unitIso_hom_app
    (F : Paths (FiniteLine N) ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R) (i : Paths (FiniteLine N)) :
    ((representationEquivalence R N).unitIso.hom.app F).app i = 𝟙 (F.obj i)
proof:
:= by
  change (𝟙 _ ≫ F.map _ ≫ 𝟙 _) = _
  rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  have he : (pathEquivalence N).unitIso.hom.app i = 𝟙 i := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  change F.map ((pathEquivalence N).unitIso.hom.app i) = _
  erw [he, F.map_id]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_counitIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_counitIso_hom_app
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin N)) (i : Fin N) :
    ((representationEquivalence R N).counitIso.hom.app M).app i = 𝟙 (M.obj i)
proof:
:= by
  change (𝟙 _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ 𝟙 _) = _
  rw [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  have he : (pathEquivalence N).counitIso.hom.app i = 𝟙 i := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [he, M.map_id]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_map_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_map_id (F : Paths (FiniteLine N) ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R) :
    (representationEquivalence R N).functor.map (𝟙 F) =
      𝟙 ((representationEquivalence R N).functor.obj F)
proof:
:=
  (representationEquivalence R N).functor.map_id F

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLine.representationEquivalence_map_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem representationEquivalence_map_comp
    {F G H : Paths (FiniteLine N) ⥤ ModuleCat.{w} R} (α : F ⟶ G) (β : G ⟶ H) :
    (representationEquivalence R N).functor.map (α ≫ β) =
      (representationEquivalence R N).functor.map α ≫
        (representationEquivalence R N).functor.map β
proof:
:=
  (representationEquivalence R N).functor.map_comp α β

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.lipschitzWith_arctan
statement: theorem lipschitzWith_arctan : LipschitzWith 1 Real.arctan
proof:
:= by
  refine lipschitzWith_of_nnnorm_deriv_le Real.differentiable_arctan fun x => ?_
  rw [Real.deriv_arctan, ← NNReal.coe_le_coe, coe_nnnorm, NNReal.coe_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity), div_le_one₀ hpos]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg x]

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.abs_arctan_sub_arctan_le
statement:
theorem abs_arctan_sub_arctan_le (x y : ℝ) :
    |Real.arctan x - Real.arctan y| ≤ |x - y|
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, Real.dist_eq] using lipschitzWith_arctan.dist_le_mul x y

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.arctanWeight_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem arctanWeight_apply (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (u : ℝ × ℝ) :
    arctanWeight C hC u = Real.arctan (C * max u.2 0)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.arctanWeight_birthPersistence
statement:
theorem arctanWeight_birthPersistence (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p.1 ≤ p.2) :
    arctanWeight C hC (birthPersistence p) = Real.arctan (C * (p.2 - p.1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [arctanWeight_apply, birthPersistence, max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hp)]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_arctan
statement:
theorem stabilityConstant_arctan (σ C : ℝ) :
    stabilityConstant σ C (π / 2) = 2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)
proof:
:= by
  unfold stabilityConstant
  rw [mul_div_assoc', div_div]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_embedding_sub_le_arctan
statement:
theorem norm_embedding_sub_le_arctan {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (σ : ℝ)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    ‖embedding σ (arctanWeight C hC) x - embedding σ (arctanWeight C hC) y‖ ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) * finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    norm_embedding_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost σ hC Real.pi_div_two_pos.le
      (arctanWeight C hC) x y hx hy

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_arctan
statement:
theorem norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_arctan (σ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (hD : D.IsPositive) (hE : E.IsPositive) (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    ‖diagramEmbedding σ (arctanWeight C hC) D - diagramEmbedding σ (arctanWeight C hC) E‖ ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) *
        ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (bottleneck D E).toReal
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ hC Real.pi_div_two_pos.le
      (arctanWeight C hC) D E hD hE hfinite

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_arctan
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_arctan (σ τ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (D E E' : Diagram ℝ)
    (hE : E.IsPositive) (hE' : E'.IsPositive) :
    |gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ (arctanWeight C hC) D E -
        gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ (arctanWeight C hC) D E'| ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) / |τ| *
        finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
          (fun p : E'.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost σ τ hC
      Real.pi_div_two_pos.le (arctanWeight C hC) D E E' hE hE'

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_arctan_card_mul_bottleneck
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_arctan_card_mul_bottleneck (σ τ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (D E E' : Diagram ℝ) (hE : E.IsPositive) (hE' : E'.IsPositive)
    (hfinite : bottleneck E E' < ⊤) :
    |gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ (arctanWeight C hC) D E -
        gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ (arctanWeight C hC) D E'| ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E'.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (bottleneck E E').toReal
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ τ hC Real.pi_div_two_pos.le
      (arctanWeight C hC) D E E' hE hE' hfinite

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerivedOneExamples.rational_unit_zero_derived_one_isZero
statement:
theorem rational_unit_zero_derived_one_isZero :
    IsZero (((extensionFunctor (k := ℚ) (S := Unit)).leftDerived 1).obj
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := ℚ) (S := Unit))).obj
        (ModuleCat.of (RightQuotient (k := ℚ) (S := Unit)) PUnit)))
proof:
:=
  extension_leftDerived_one_isZero_zero (k := ℚ) (S := Unit)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerivedOneExamples.rational_unit_vertex_derived_one_isZero
statement:
theorem rational_unit_vertex_derived_one_isZero :
    IsZero (((extensionFunctor (k := ℚ) (S := Unit)).leftDerived 1).obj
      (RightVertexRestrictedModule (k := ℚ) (S := Unit) unitStrictVertex))
proof:
:=
  rightVertexExtension_leftDerived_one_isZero (k := ℚ) (S := Unit) unitStrictVertex

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.toPModule_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem toPModule_obj (A : MatrixSequence R N) (i : Fin N) :
    A.toPModule.obj i = A.stage i
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.structureMapLinear_adjacent
statement:
@[simp] theorem structureMapLinear_adjacent (A : MatrixSequence R N)
    (i j : Fin N) (h : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    structureMapLinear A.toPModule (show i ≤ j by omega) = (A.step i j h).toLin'
proof:
:= by
  unfold structureMapLinear toPModule
  rw [FiniteLine.structureMap_moduleOfAdjacent_adjacent]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.toLin_compositeMatrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem toLin_compositeMatrix (A : MatrixSequence R N) {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    (A.compositeMatrix h).toLin' = structureMapLinear A.toPModule h
proof:
:= by
  exact Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix' _

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.structureMapLinear_apply
proof:
:= by
  rw [← toLin_compositeMatrix]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.compositeMatrix_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem compositeMatrix_self (A : MatrixSequence R N) (i : Fin N) :
    A.compositeMatrix (le_refl i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold compositeMatrix
  rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.toMatrix'_id]

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.compositeMatrix_adjacent
statement:
@[simp] theorem compositeMatrix_adjacent (A : MatrixSequence R N)
    (i j : Fin N) (h : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    A.compositeMatrix (show i ≤ j by omega) = A.step i j h
proof:
:= by
  simp [compositeMatrix, structureMapLinear_adjacent A i j h]

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.compositeMatrix_comp
proof:
:= by
  unfold compositeMatrix
  rw [structureMapLinear_comp A.toPModule hij hjl, LinearMap.toMatrix'_comp]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.compositeMatrix_succ
statement:
theorem compositeMatrix_succ (A : MatrixSequence R N) {i j l : Fin N}
    (hij : i ≤ j) (hjl : j.val + 1 = l.val) :
    A.compositeMatrix (hij.trans (show j ≤ l by omega)) =
      A.step j l hjl * A.compositeMatrix hij
proof:
:= by
  rw [compositeMatrix_comp A hij (show j ≤ l by omega), compositeMatrix_adjacent A j l hjl]

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {F G : Hom A B} (h : ∀ i, F.app i = G.app i) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  cases F with
  | mk f hf =>
    cases G with
    | mk g hg =>
      have he : f = g := funext h
      cases he
      rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.id_app
statement: @[simp] theorem id_app (A : MatrixSequence R N) (i : Fin N) : (id A).app i = 1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.comp_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem comp_app (F : Hom A B) (G : Hom B C) (i : Fin N) :
    (F.comp G).app i = G.app i * F.app i
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.id_comp
statement: @[simp] theorem id_comp (F : Hom A B) : (id A).comp F = F
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.comp_id
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_id (F : Hom A B) : F.comp (id B) = F
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.comp_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_assoc {D : MatrixSequence R N} (F : Hom A B) (G : Hom B C) (H : Hom C D) :
    (F.comp G).comp H = F.comp (G.comp H)
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp [Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.toNatTrans_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNatTrans_app (F : Hom A B) (i : Fin N) :
    (F.toNatTrans.app i).hom = (F.app i).toLin'
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.toNatTrans_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNatTrans_id (A : MatrixSequence R N) :
    (id A).toNatTrans = 𝟙 A.toPModule
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext i
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  change Matrix.toLin' (1 : Matrix (Fin (A.dim i)) (Fin (A.dim i)) R) = LinearMap.id
  exact Matrix.toLin'_one

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.toNatTrans_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem toNatTrans_comp (F : Hom A B) (G : Hom B C) :
    (F.comp G).toNatTrans = F.toNatTrans ≫ G.toNatTrans
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext i
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  change (G.app i * F.app i).toLin' = (G.app i).toLin'.comp (F.app i).toLin'
  exact Matrix.toLin'_mul _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.Hom.compositeMatrix_comm
statement:
theorem compositeMatrix_comm (F : Hom A B) {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    B.compositeMatrix h * F.app i = F.app j * A.compositeMatrix h
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.toLin'.injective
  simp only [Matrix.toLin'_mul, toLin_compositeMatrix]
  exact (congrArg (fun f => f.hom) (F.toNatTrans.naturality (homOfLE h))).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.ofBases_dim
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofBases_dim (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i)) (i : Fin N) :
    (ofBases M d b).dim i = d i
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.ofBases_step
statement:
theorem ofBases_step (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i)) (i j : Fin N)
    (h : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    (ofBases M d b).step i j h =
      LinearMap.toMatrix (b i) (b j) (structureMapLinear M (show i ≤ j by omega))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.ofBases_step_toLin
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofBases_step_toLin (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i)) (i j : Fin N)
    (h : i.val + 1 = j.val) :
    ((ofBases M d b).step i j h).toLin' =
      (b j).equivFun.toLinearMap.comp ((structureMapLinear M (show i ≤ j by omega)).comp
        (b i).equivFun.symm.toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  exact Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix' _

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.coordinateIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateIso_hom_app (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i)) (i : Fin N) :
    ((coordinateIso M d b).hom.app i).hom = (b i).equivFun.toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.coordinateIso_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateIso_inv_app (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i)) (i : Fin N) :
    ((coordinateIso M d b).inv.app i).hom = (b i).equivFun.symm.toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.coordinateIso_naturality
statement:
theorem coordinateIso_naturality (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i)) {i j : Fin N} (h : i ≤ j) :
    (b j).equivFun.toLinearMap.comp (structureMapLinear M h) =
      (structureMapLinear (ofBases M d b).toPModule h).comp (b i).equivFun.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f => f.hom) ((coordinateIso M d b).hom.naturality (homOfLE h))

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.basisChangeIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem basisChangeIso_hom_app (M : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)) (d e : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i))
    (c : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (e i)) R (M.obj i)) (i : Fin N) :
    ((basisChangeIso M d e b c).hom.app i).hom =
      (c i).equivFun.toLinearMap.comp (b i).equivFun.symm.toLinearMap
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.ofBases_standard
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofBases_standard (A : MatrixSequence R N) :
    ofBases A.toPModule A.dim (fun i => Pi.basisFun R (Fin (A.dim i))) = A
proof:
:= by
  cases A with
  | mk d s =>
    change MatrixSequence.mk d _ = MatrixSequence.mk d s
    congr 1
    funext i j h
    dsimp [ofBases]
    rw [Pi.basisFun_equivFun, Pi.basisFun_equivFun]
    change LinearMap.toMatrix' (structureMapLinear (MatrixSequence.mk d s).toPModule _) = s i j h
    rw [structureMapLinear_adjacent _ i j h]
    change LinearMap.toMatrix' (s i j h).toLin' = s i j h
    exact LinearMap.toMatrix'_toLin' _

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.coordinateHom_toNatTrans
statement:
theorem coordinateHom_toNatTrans {M L : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin N)} (α : M ⟶ L)
    (d e : Fin N → ℕ) (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) R (M.obj i))
    (c : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (e i)) R (L.obj i)) :
    (coordinateHom α d e b c).toNatTrans =
      (coordinateIso M d b).inv ≫ α ≫ (coordinateIso L e c).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext i x
  change (Matrix.toLin' (LinearMap.toMatrix' _)) x = _
  rw [Matrix.toLin'_toMatrix']
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.coordinateHom_standard_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateHom_standard_app {A B : MatrixSequence R N} (F : Hom A B)
    (i : Fin N) :
    (coordinateHom F.toNatTrans A.dim B.dim
      (fun j => Pi.basisFun R (Fin (A.dim j)))
      (fun j => Pi.basisFun R (Fin (B.dim j)))).app i = F.app i
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [coordinateHom]
  rw [Pi.basisFun_equivFun, Pi.basisFun_equivFun]
  change LinearMap.toMatrix' (F.app i).toLin' = F.app i
  exact LinearMap.toMatrix'_toLin' _

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.barcode_eq_of_linearEquiv
statement:
theorem barcode_eq_of_linearEquiv (A B : MatrixSequence k N)
    (e : ∀ i, (Fin (A.dim i) → k) ≃ₗ[k] (Fin (B.dim i) → k))
    (he : ∀ i j (h : i.val + 1 = j.val),
      (e j).toLinearMap.comp (A.step i j h).toLin' =
        (B.step i j h).toLin'.comp (e i).toLinearMap) : A.barcode = B.barcode
proof:
:=
  rankBarcode_eq_of_iso (isoOfLinearEquiv A B e he)

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.barcode_ofBases
statement:
theorem barcode_ofBases (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (d : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) k (M.obj i)) :
    (ofBases M d b).barcode = rankBarcode M
proof:
:=
  (rankBarcode_eq_of_iso (coordinateIso M d b)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.barcode_basisChange
statement:
theorem barcode_basisChange (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N)) (d e : Fin N → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (d i)) k (M.obj i))
    (c : ∀ i, Basis (Fin (e i)) k (M.obj i)) :
    (ofBases M d b).barcode = (ofBases M e c).barcode
proof:
:=
  rankBarcode_eq_of_iso (basisChangeIso M d e b c)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumInl_birth
statement:
@[simp] theorem sumInl_birth (g : W.Carrier) :
    (sumInl (R := R) W V).app (W.grade g) (birth W g) =
      birth (W.sum V) (Sum.inl g)
proof:
:=
  lift_birth W (module (W.sum V)) _ g

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumInr_birth
statement:
@[simp] theorem sumInr_birth (g : V.Carrier) :
    (sumInr (R := R) W V).app (V.grade g) (birth V g) =
      birth (W.sum V) (Sum.inr g)
proof:
:=
  lift_birth V (module (W.sum V)) _ g

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumInl_generator
statement:
theorem sumInl_generator (g : W.Carrier) {a : P} (h : W.grade g ≤ a) :
    (sumInl (R := R) W V).app a (generator W g h) =
      generator (W.sum V) (Sum.inl g) h
proof:
:= by
  have hn := (sumInl (R := R) W V).naturality (homOfLE h)
  have hv := congrArg (fun q => q (birth (R := R) W g)) hn
  change (sumInl W V).app a (generator W g h) =
    (module (R := R) (W.sum V)).map (homOfLE h)
      ((sumInl W V).app (W.grade g) (birth W g)) at hv
  rw [sumInl_birth] at hv
  exact hv

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumInr_generator
statement:
theorem sumInr_generator (g : V.Carrier) {a : P} (h : V.grade g ≤ a) :
    (sumInr (R := R) W V).app a (generator V g h) =
      generator (W.sum V) (Sum.inr g) h
proof:
:= by
  have hn := (sumInr (R := R) W V).naturality (homOfLE h)
  have hv := congrArg (fun q => q (birth (R := R) V g)) hn
  change (sumInr W V).app a (generator V g h) =
    (module (R := R) (W.sum V)).map (homOfLE h)
      ((sumInr W V).app (V.grade g) (birth V g)) at hv
  rw [sumInr_birth] at hv
  exact hv

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumDesc_birth_inl
statement:
@[simp] theorem sumDesc_birth_inl {M : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P}
    (f : module (R := R) W ⟶ M) (g : module (R := R) V ⟶ M)
    (x : W.Carrier) :
    (sumDesc W V f g).app (W.grade x) (birth (W.sum V) (Sum.inl x)) =
      f.app (W.grade x) (birth W x)
proof:
:=
  lift_birth (W.sum V) M _ (Sum.inl x)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumDesc_birth_inr
statement:
@[simp] theorem sumDesc_birth_inr {M : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P}
    (f : module (R := R) W ⟶ M) (g : module (R := R) V ⟶ M)
    (y : V.Carrier) :
    (sumDesc W V f g).app (V.grade y) (birth (W.sum V) (Sum.inr y)) =
      g.app (V.grade y) (birth V y)
proof:
:=
  lift_birth (W.sum V) M _ (Sum.inr y)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumInl_sumDesc
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := lift_unique W M (fun x => f.app (W.grade x) (birth W x))
    (sumInl W V ≫ sumDesc W V f g) (by intro x; simp)
  exact hleft.trans
    (lift_unique W M (fun x => f.app (W.grade x) (birth W x)) f (fun _ => rfl)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumInr_sumDesc
proof:
:= by
  have hright := lift_unique V M (fun y => g.app (V.grade y) (birth V y))
    (sumInr W V ≫ sumDesc W V f g) (by intro y; simp)
  exact hright.trans
    (lift_unique V M (fun y => g.app (V.grade y) (birth V y)) g (fun _ => rfl)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumDesc_unique
proof:
:= by
  let s := fun z : (W.sum V).Carrier =>
    h.app ((W.sum V).grade z) (birth (W.sum V) z)
  have hdesc := lift_unique (W.sum V) M s
    (sumDesc W V (sumInl W V ≫ h) (sumInr W V ≫ h)) (by
      intro z
      cases z with
      | inl x =>
        change (sumDesc W V (sumInl W V ≫ h) (sumInr W V ≫ h)).app
          (W.grade x) (birth (W.sum V) (Sum.inl x)) =
            h.app (W.grade x) (birth (W.sum V) (Sum.inl x))
        rw [sumDesc_birth_inl]
        change h.app (W.grade x) ((sumInl W V).app (W.grade x) (birth W x)) = _
        rw [sumInl_birth]
      | inr y =>
        change (sumDesc W V (sumInl W V ≫ h) (sumInr W V ≫ h)).app
          (V.grade y) (birth (W.sum V) (Sum.inr y)) =
            h.app (V.grade y) (birth (W.sum V) (Sum.inr y))
        rw [sumDesc_birth_inr]
        change h.app (V.grade y) ((sumInr W V).app (V.grade y) (birth V y)) = _
        rw [sumInr_birth])
  exact hdesc.trans (lift_unique (W.sum V) M s h (fun _ => rfl)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumHom_ext
proof:
:= by
  calc
    f = sumDesc W V (sumInl W V ≫ f) (sumInr W V ≫ f) :=
      (sumDesc_unique W V f).symm
    _ = sumDesc W V (sumInl W V ≫ g) (sumInr W V ≫ g) := by rw [hW, hV]
    _ = g := sumDesc_unique W V g

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_le_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_le_of_nonempty {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (h : Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M N)) : realInterleavingDistance M N ≤ ε
proof:
:=
  iInf₂_le ε h

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.distance_le
statement:
theorem RealInterleaving.distance_le {ε : ℝ≥0} (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    realInterleavingDistance M N ≤ ε
proof: := realInterleavingDistance_le_of_nonempty ⟨i⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.le_realInterleavingDistance_iff
statement:
theorem le_realInterleavingDistance_iff {r : ℝ≥0∞} :
    r ≤ realInterleavingDistance M N ↔
      ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M N) → r ≤ ε
proof: := le_iInf₂_iff

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_lt_iff
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_lt_iff {r : ℝ≥0∞} :
    realInterleavingDistance M N < r ↔
      ∃ ε : ℝ≥0, (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < r ∧ Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M N)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [realInterleavingDistance, iInf_lt_iff, exists_prop]
  exact exists_congr fun _ => and_comm

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_eq_top_iff :
    realInterleavingDistance M N = ⊤ ↔ ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, IsEmpty (RealInterleaving ε M N)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [realInterleavingDistance, iInf_eq_top, ENNReal.coe_ne_top, imp_false,
    not_nonempty_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.distance_eq_zero
statement:
theorem RealInterleaving.distance_eq_zero (i : RealInterleaving 0 M N) :
    realInterleavingDistance M N = 0
proof:
:=
  nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 (by simpa using i.distance_le)

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_self
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_self (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    realInterleavingDistance M M = 0
proof: := (RealInterleaving.refl 0 M).distance_eq_zero

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_of_iso
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_of_iso (e : M ≅ N) :
    realInterleavingDistance M N = 0
proof: := (RealInterleaving.ofIso e).distance_eq_zero

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_comm
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_comm (M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    realInterleavingDistance M N = realInterleavingDistance N M
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_iInf₂ fun _ ⟨i⟩ => i.symm.distance_le)
    (le_iInf₂ fun _ ⟨i⟩ => i.symm.distance_le)

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_triangle
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_triangle (M N P : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    realInterleavingDistance M P ≤ realInterleavingDistance M N +
      realInterleavingDistance N P
proof:
:= by
  apply ENNReal.le_iInf₂_add_iInf₂
  intro ε hi δ hj
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := hi
  obtain ⟨j⟩ := hj
  simpa only [ENNReal.coe_add] using (i.trans j).distance_le

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_congr
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_congr (e : M ≅ M') (d : N ≅ N') :
    realInterleavingDistance M N = realInterleavingDistance M' N'
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_iInf₂ fun _ ⟨i⟩ => (i.congr e.symm d.symm).distance_le)
    (le_iInf₂ fun _ ⟨i⟩ => (i.congr e d).distance_le)

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_iff :
    realInterleavingDistance M N = 0 ↔
      ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, 0 < ε → Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M N)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, ⟨i⟩⟩ :=
      realInterleavingDistance_lt_iff.1 (h.trans_lt (ENNReal.coe_pos.2 hε))
    exact ⟨i.mono (ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.1 hδ).le⟩
  · intro h
    refine nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 (ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε _ => ?_)
    simpa using realInterleavingDistance_le_of_nonempty (h ε hε)

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityCrossingFixtures.threePoints_cases
statement:
private theorem threePoints_cases (s : TotalFace threePoints) :
    s = v0 ∨ s = v1 ∨ s = v2
proof:
:= by
  have classify : ∀ q : Finset (Fin 3), q.Nonempty → q.card ≤ 1 →
      q = {0} ∨ q = {1} ∨ q = {2} := by decide
  have hc := classify s.1 s.2.1 s.2.2
  rcases hc with h | h | h <;> simp_all [v0, v1, v2, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityCrossingFixtures.vertex_values
statement:
private theorem vertex_values (a b c : ℝ) :
    (threePointFilter a b c).value v0 = a ∧
    (threePointFilter a b c).value v1 = b ∧
    (threePointFilter a b c).value v2 = c
proof:
:= by
  simp [threePointFilter, v0, v1, v2]

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityCrossingFixtures.forwardFun_bijective

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityCrossingFixtures.reverseFun_bijective

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityCrossingFixtures.reverse_face_lt

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityCrossingFixtures.forward_endpoint_mono
statement:
private theorem forward_endpoint_mono (t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Monotone ((intervalFilter endpointBefore endpointAfter t).value ∘ forwardOrder)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hij' := Fin.le_def.mp hij
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [forwardOrder, forwardFun, intervalFilter_value, endpointBefore,
      endpointAfter, vertex_values] at *
  all_goals have := t.2.1; have := t.2.2; first | omega | linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityCrossingFixtures.forward_before_mono
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hij' := Fin.le_def.mp hij
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [forwardOrder, forwardFun, intervalFilter_value,
      beforeFilter, afterFilter, vertex_values] at *
  all_goals first | omega | linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityCrossingFixtures.reverse_after_mono
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hij' := Fin.le_def.mp hij
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [reverseOrder, reverseFun, intervalFilter_value,
      beforeFilter, afterFilter, vertex_values] at *
  all_goals first | omega | linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityCrossingFixtures.endpoint_crossing_closed_order
statement:
theorem endpoint_crossing_closed_order :
    ∃ e : CompatibleOrder (intervalFilter endpointBefore endpointAfter half),
      ∀ t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        Monotone ((intervalFilter endpointBefore endpointAfter t).value ∘ e.enum)
proof:
:=
  ⟨endpointOrder, forward_endpoint_mono⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityCrossingFixtures.simultaneous_crossing_closed_orders
statement:
theorem simultaneous_crossing_closed_orders :
    (∀ t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 →
      Monotone ((intervalFilter beforeFilter afterFilter t).value ∘ beforeOrder.enum)) ∧
    (∀ t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 1 / 2 ≤ (t : ℝ) →
      Monotone ((intervalFilter beforeFilter afterFilter t).value ∘ afterOrder.enum))
proof:
:=
  ⟨forward_before_mono, reverse_after_mono⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityCrossingFixtures.persistent_tie_and_simultaneous_crossing
statement:
theorem persistent_tie_and_simultaneous_crossing :
    (∀ t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      (intervalFilter beforeFilter afterFilter t).value v0 =
        (intervalFilter beforeFilter afterFilter t).value v1) ∧
    (intervalFilter beforeFilter afterFilter half).value v0 =
      (intervalFilter beforeFilter afterFilter half).value v2 ∧
    (intervalFilter beforeFilter afterFilter half).value v1 =
      (intervalFilter beforeFilter afterFilter half).value v2 ∧
    (intervalFilter beforeFilter afterFilter zero).value v0 <
      (intervalFilter beforeFilter afterFilter zero).value v2 ∧
    (intervalFilter beforeFilter afterFilter one).value v2 <
      (intervalFilter beforeFilter afterFilter one).value v0
proof:
:= by
  simp [intervalFilter_value, beforeFilter, afterFilter, vertex_values,
    half, zero, one]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityCrossingFixtures.crossing_at_left_endpoint
statement:
theorem crossing_at_left_endpoint :
    (intervalFilter endpointBefore endpointAfter zero).value v0 =
      (intervalFilter endpointBefore endpointAfter zero).value v1 ∧
    (∀ t : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, 0 < (t : ℝ) →
      (intervalFilter endpointBefore endpointAfter t).value v0 <
        (intervalFilter endpointBefore endpointAfter t).value v1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp [intervalFilter_value, endpointBefore, endpointAfter, vertex_values, zero]
  · intro t ht
    simpa [intervalFilter_value, endpointBefore, endpointAfter, vertex_values] using ht

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.SupNormDiagramExamples.TwoPoints.dgm_eq
statement:
theorem dgm_eq (k : Type) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    dgm k (Cech.filter pts) n =
      (dgm k (Rips.filter metric) n).scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)
proof:
:=
  dgm_eq_scale_rips_real k metric pts metric_dist n

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.SupNormDiagramExamples.TwoPoints.scaled_edge_value
statement:
theorem scaled_edge_value :
    ((Rips.filter metric).scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)).value edgeFace = 1 ∧
      ((Rips.filter metric).scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)).value edgeFace =
        (Cech.filter pts).value edgeFace
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((Rips.filter metric).scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)).value edgeFace = 1 := by
    rw [FilterFunction.scale_value, rips_value]
    norm_num
  exact ⟨h, h.trans cech_value.symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.SupNormDiagramExamples.Triangle.dgm_eq

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.SupNormDiagramExamples.Triangle.dgm_eq_zero

theorem dgm_eq_zero (k : Type) [Field k] :

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.SupNormDiagramExamples.Triangle.dgm_eq_one

theorem dgm_eq_one (k : Type) [Field k] :

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.SupNormDiagramExamples.Triangle.scaled_tri_value
statement:
theorem scaled_tri_value :
    ((Rips.filter metric).scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)).value triFace = 1 ∧
      ((Rips.filter metric).scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)).value triFace =

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.SupNormDiagramExamples.Triangle.filter_identity_tri
statement:
theorem filter_identity_tri :
    (Cech.filter pts).value triFace =
      ((Rips.filter metric).scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)).value triFace
proof:
:= by
  rw [← filter_eq_scale_rips metric pts metric_dist]

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.SupNormDiagramExamples.MovedPoint.bottleneck_eq_half
statement:
theorem bottleneck_eq_half (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n) =
      ENNReal.ofReal 2⁻¹ *
        bottleneck (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.metric) n)
          (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricQ) n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [filter_eq_scale_rips_real TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.metric p
      TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.metric_dist,
    filter_eq_scale_rips_real metricQ q metricQ_dist]
  exact bottleneck_dgm_scale ℚ _ _ n _

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.SupNormDiagramExamples.MovedPoint.pairwiseDiscrepancy_le
statement:
theorem pairwiseDiscrepancy_le :
    Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.metric metricQ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy
  refine (Finset.fold_max_le _).mpr ⟨zero_le_one, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨v, w⟩ _
  change |dist (TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.pts v)
      (TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.pts w) - dist (q v) (q w)| ≤ 1
  fin_cases v <;> fin_cases w <;>
    norm_num [TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.pts, q, Real.dist_eq]

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.SupNormDiagramExamples.MovedPoint.bottleneck_le_half
statement:
theorem bottleneck_le_half (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_eq_half n]
  calc
    ENNReal.ofReal 2⁻¹ *
          bottleneck (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.metric) n)
            (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricQ) n) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal 2⁻¹ * ENNReal.ofReal
          (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.metric metricQ) :=
      mul_le_mul_right (Rips.bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy ℚ _ _ n) _
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 2⁻¹ * ENNReal.ofReal 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_right (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal pairwiseDiscrepancy_le) _
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
      norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.SupNormDiagramExamples.MovedPoint.half_lt_one
statement: theorem half_lt_one : ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2) < 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_one]
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff one_pos).2 (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.transition_inflate
statement:
theorem transition_inflate (h : ε ≤ δ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    transition ε M ≫ shiftLE h M = transition δ M
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  rw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateInterleaving.inflated_composite
statement:
theorem inflated_composite (h : ε ≤ δ)
    (f : M ⟶ (shift ε).obj N) (g : N ⟶ (shift ε).obj M) :
    (f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom) ≫
        shiftLE (add_le_add h h) M =
      (f ≫ shiftLE h N) ≫
        (shift δ).map (g ≫ shiftLE h M) ≫
          (compIso δ δ M).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Functor.map_comp]
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  dsimp only [NatTrans.comp_app, shift_map_app, shiftLE_app, compIso_hom_app]
  repeat' erw [Category.assoc]
  erw [g.naturality_assoc]
  change f.app a ≫ g.app (translation ε a) ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ =
    f.app a ≫ g.app (translation ε a) ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _
  repeat' erw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ext
proof:
:= by
  cases D
  cases E

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteDecoratedMultiset_count
statement:
private theorem finiteDecoratedMultiset_count (D : Diagram ℝ)
    (p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) (hp : p.2 ≠ infinityCut) :
    (finiteDecoratedMultiset D).count p =
      (D.points.map diagramDecoratedPoint).count p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [finiteDecoratedMultiset, finiteDecoratedMultisetOf]
  exact Multiset.count_filter_of_pos hp

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialDecoratedMultisetOf_count
statement:
private theorem essentialDecoratedMultisetOf_count
    (s : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ)) (birth : Cut ℝ) :
    (essentialDecoratedMultisetOf s).count birth =
      (s.map diagramDecoratedPoint).count (birth, infinityCut)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [essentialDecoratedMultisetOf]
  | @cons q s ih =>
      rcases q with ⟨b, d⟩
      cases d with
      | top =>
          have hL : essentialDecoratedMultisetOf ((b, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ s) =
              minusCut b ::ₘ essentialDecoratedMultisetOf s := by
            simp [essentialDecoratedMultisetOf, diagramDecoratedPoint]
          have hR : (((b, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ s).map diagramDecoratedPoint) =
              (minusCut b, infinityCut) ::ₘ (s.map diagramDecoratedPoint) := by
            simp [diagramDecoratedPoint]
          rw [hL, hR]
          simp [Multiset.count_cons, ih]
      | coe d =>
          have hne : minusCut d ≠ infinityCut := by
            intro heq
            have hm : minusCut d ∈ cutCell (d - 1) d := by
              simp [cutCell, minusCut]
            exact infinityCut_not_mem_cutCell (d - 1) d (heq ▸ hm)
          have hne' : infinityCut ≠ minusCut d := Ne.symm hne
          have hL : essentialDecoratedMultisetOf ((b, (d : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ s) =
              essentialDecoratedMultisetOf s := by
            unfold essentialDecoratedMultisetOf
            rw [Multiset.map_cons]
            have hnone : (fun p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ =>
                if p.2 = infinityCut then some p.1 else none)
                (minusCut b, minusCut d) = none := by
              simp [hne]
            exact Multiset.filterMap_cons_none _ _ hnone
          have hR : (((b, (d : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ s).map diagramDecoratedPoint) =
              (minusCut b, minusCut d) ::ₘ (s.map diagramDecoratedPoint) := by
            simp [diagramDecoratedPoint]
          rw [hL, hR]
          simp [Multiset.count_cons, ih, hne']

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialDecoratedMultiset_count
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simpa [essentialDecoratedMultiset, essentialDecoratedMultisetOf] using
    essentialDecoratedMultisetOf_count D.points birth

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteDecoratedMultisetOf_endpoints
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [finiteDecoratedMultisetOf, finitePart, Multiset.filter_map,
    Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_filter_eq_filterMap, Multiset.map_filterMap]
  apply congrArg (fun f : (ℝ × WithTop ℝ) → Option (ℝ × ℝ) => s.filterMap f)
  funext p
  rcases p with ⟨b, d⟩
  cases d with
  | top => simp [diagramDecoratedPoint]
  | coe d =>
      have hne : minusCut d ≠ infinityCut := by
        intro heq
        have hm : minusCut d ∈ cutCell (d - 1) d := by
          simp [cutCell, minusCut]
        exact infinityCut_not_mem_cutCell (d - 1) d (heq ▸ hm)
      simp [diagramDecoratedPoint, cutEndpoint_minusCut, hne]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteDecoratedMultiset_endpoints
proof:
:= by
  exact finiteDecoratedMultisetOf_endpoints D.points

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialDecoratedMultisetOf_endpoints
statement:
private theorem essentialDecoratedMultisetOf_endpoints
    (s : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ)) :
    (essentialDecoratedMultisetOf s).map cutEndpoint = essentialPart s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [essentialDecoratedMultisetOf, essentialPart, Multiset.map_filterMap,
    Multiset.filterMap_map]
  apply congrArg (fun f : (ℝ × WithTop ℝ) → Option ℝ => s.filterMap f)
  funext p
  rcases p with ⟨b, d⟩
  cases d with
  | top => simp [diagramDecoratedPoint, cutEndpoint_minusCut]
  | coe d =>
      have hne : minusCut d ≠ infinityCut := by
        intro heq
        have hm : minusCut d ∈ cutCell (d - 1) d := by
          simp [cutCell, minusCut]
        exact infinityCut_not_mem_cutCell (d - 1) d (heq ▸ hm)
