name: TDA.Persistence.essentialDecoratedMultiset_endpoints
statement:
private theorem essentialDecoratedMultiset_endpoints (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    (essentialDecoratedMultiset D).map cutEndpoint = essentialPart D.points
proof:
:= by
  simpa [essentialDecoratedMultiset, essentialDecoratedMultisetOf] using
    essentialDecoratedMultisetOf_endpoints D.points

name: TDA.Persistence.map_univ_eq_of_equiv_local
statement:
private theorem map_univ_eq_of_equiv_local {A B C : Type*}
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] (x : A → C) (y : B → C)
    (e : A ≃ B) (h : ∀ a, y (e a) = x a) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset A).val.map x =
      (Finset.univ : Finset B).val.map y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (Finset.univ : Finset A).val.map x =
        (Finset.univ : Finset A).val.map (y ∘ e) := by
          congr 1
          funext a
          exact (h a).symm
    _ = ((Finset.univ : Finset A).map e.toEmbedding).val.map y := by
          rw [Finset.map_val, Multiset.map_map]
          rfl
    _ = (Finset.univ : Finset B).val.map y := by rw [Finset.map_univ_equiv]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteOccurrence_endpoints
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := Diagram.toLocallyFiniteFiniteOccurrenceEquiv D hD
  let x := (D.toLocallyFinite hD).finitePoint
  let y : finiteDecoratedMultiset D → ℝ × ℝ :=
    fun p => (cutEndpoint p.1.1, cutEndpoint p.1.2)
  have hv : ∀ o, y (e o) = x o := by
    intro o
    rfl
  calc
    _ = (Finset.univ : Finset (finiteDecoratedMultiset D)).val.map y :=
      map_univ_eq_of_equiv_local x y e hv
    _ = (finiteDecoratedMultiset D).map (fun p =>
        (cutEndpoint p.1, cutEndpoint p.2)) := by
          calc
            _ = ((Finset.univ : Finset (finiteDecoratedMultiset D)).val.map
                (fun p => p.1)).map (fun p => (cutEndpoint p.1, cutEndpoint p.2)) := by
                  simp only [y, Multiset.map_map]
                  rfl
            _ = _ := by rw [Multiset.map_univ_coe]
    _ = finitePart D.points := finiteDecoratedMultiset_endpoints D

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialOccurrence_endpoints
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := Diagram.toLocallyFiniteEssentialOccurrenceEquiv D hD
  let x := (D.toLocallyFinite hD).essentialBirth
  let y : essentialDecoratedMultiset D → ℝ := fun p => cutEndpoint p.1
  have hv : ∀ o, y (e o) = x o := by
    intro o
    rfl
  calc
    _ = (Finset.univ : Finset (essentialDecoratedMultiset D)).val.map y :=
      map_univ_eq_of_equiv_local x y e hv
    _ = (essentialDecoratedMultiset D).map cutEndpoint := by
          calc
            _ = ((Finset.univ : Finset (essentialDecoratedMultiset D)).val.map
                (fun p => p.1)).map cutEndpoint := by
                  simp only [y, Multiset.map_map]
                  rfl
            _ = _ := by rw [Multiset.map_univ_coe]
    _ = essentialPart D.points := essentialDecoratedMultiset_endpoints D

name: TDA.Persistence.iSup_eq_finset_sup
statement:
private theorem iSup_eq_finset_sup {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (f : α → ℝ≥0∞) : (⨆ a, f a) = (Finset.univ : Finset α).sup f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply iSup_le
    intro a
    exact Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ a)
  · apply Finset.sup_le
    intro a _
    exact le_iSup f a

name: TDA.Persistence.matchingCost_eq_cost
statement:
private theorem matchingCost_eq_cost
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram}
    [Fintype D.finiteOccurrences] [Fintype E.finiteOccurrences]
    [Fintype D.essentialOccurrences] [Fintype E.essentialOccurrences]
    (M : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences E.essentialOccurrences) :
    LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.matchingCost M =
      M.cost D.finitePoint E.finitePoint D.essentialBirth E.essentialBirth
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.matchingCost OccurrenceMatching.cost
  simp only [iSup_eq_finset_sup]
  apply congrArg₂ max
  · apply Finset.sup_congr
    · ext i
      simp
    · intro i hi
      cases h : M.finite i <;> rfl
  · apply congrArg₂ max
    · apply Finset.sup_congr
      · ext j
        simp
      · intro j hj
        by_cases h : ∃ i, M.finite i = some j
        · simp [h]
        · simp [h]
    · apply Finset.sup_congr
      · ext b
        simp
      · intro b hb
        simp

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_toLocallyFinite
statement:
theorem bottleneck_toLocallyFinite (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (hD : D.IsPositive) (hE : E.IsPositive) :
    (D.toLocallyFinite hD).bottleneck (E.toLocallyFinite hE) = bottleneck D E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D' := D.toLocallyFinite hD
  let E' := E.toLocallyFinite hE
  have hfinite :
      (Finset.univ : Finset D'.finiteOccurrences).val.map D'.finitePoint =
        finitePart D.points := finiteOccurrence_endpoints D hD
  have hfinite' :
      (Finset.univ : Finset E'.finiteOccurrences).val.map E'.finitePoint =
        finitePart E.points := finiteOccurrence_endpoints E hE
  have hess :
      (Finset.univ : Finset D'.essentialOccurrences).val.map D'.essentialBirth =
        essentialPart D.points := essentialOccurrence_endpoints D hD
  have hess' :
      (Finset.univ : Finset E'.essentialOccurrences).val.map E'.essentialBirth =
        essentialPart E.points := essentialOccurrence_endpoints E hE
  calc
    D'.bottleneck E' = presentationBottleneck D'.finitePoint E'.finitePoint
        D'.essentialBirth E'.essentialBirth := by
          unfold LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.bottleneck presentationBottleneck
          apply iInf_congr
          intro M
          exact matchingCost_eq_cost M
    _ = bottleneck D E := by
      symm
      exact bottleneck_eq_presentation D E D'.finitePoint E'.finitePoint
        D'.essentialBirth E'.essentialBirth hfinite hfinite' hess hess'

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_dgm_lt_top_supNorm
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_lt_top_supNorm (d e : MetricSpace V) (p q : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n) < ⊤
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e p q hd he n).trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy (d e : MetricSpace V)
    (p q : V → ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (n : ℕ) :
    (bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)).toReal ≤
      Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e / 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal
      (div_nonneg (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy_nonneg d e) zero_le_two)] using
    ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
      (bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e p q hd he n)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy (d e : MetricSpace V)
    (p q : V → ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (n : ℕ)
    (σ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e / 2)
proof:
:=
  (WeightedKernel.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ hA hB w _ _
    (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (dgm_isPositive k _ n)
    (bottleneck_dgm_lt_top_supNorm k d e p q hd he n)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e p q hd he n)
        (mul_nonneg (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy (d e : MetricSpace V)
    (p q : V → ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (n : ℕ)
    (σ τ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e / 2)
proof:
:=
  (WeightedKernel.norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ τ hA hB w _ _
    (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (dgm_isPositive k _ n)
    (bottleneck_dgm_lt_top_supNorm k d e p q hd he n)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e p q hd he n)
        (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB)
          (abs_nonneg τ)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy (d e : MetricSpace V)
    (p q : V → ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (n : ℕ)
    (σ τ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    |WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)| ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e / 2)
proof:
:=
  (WeightedKernel.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ τ hA hB w D _ _
    (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (dgm_isPositive k _ n)
    (bottleneck_dgm_lt_top_supNorm k d e p q hd he n)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e p q hd he n)
        (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB)
          (abs_nonneg τ)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan
statement:
theorem norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan
    (d e : MetricSpace V) (p q : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (n : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)
          (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)
          (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e / 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e p q hd he n σ hC
      Real.pi_div_two_pos.le (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan
    (d e : MetricSpace V) (p q : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (n : ℕ)
    (σ τ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    |WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) D
          (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) D
          (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)| ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e / 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e p q hd he n σ τ hC
      Real.pi_div_two_pos.le (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) D

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_real
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_real (d e : MetricSpace V)
    (q q' : V → ℝ) (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q' v) (q' w)) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter q') n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [filter_eq_scale_rips_real d q hd, filter_eq_scale_rips_real e q' he,
    bottleneck_dgm_scale k (Rips.filter d) (Rips.filter e) n _]
  calc
    ENNReal.ofReal 2⁻¹ *
          bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal 2⁻¹ * ENNReal.ofReal (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e) :=
      mul_le_mul_right (Rips.bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e n) _
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e / 2) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num), inv_mul_eq_div]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.repeated_root
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.repeated_first
statement:
private theorem repeated_first :
    finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost repeated (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) = 2
proof:

    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.repeated_upper_sharp
statement:
private theorem repeated_upper_sharp (p : ℝ) :
    finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost repeated (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 - p⁻¹) *
        finitePBoundaryTransportCost p repeated (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [repeated_first, repeated_root, ← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.repeated_three_halves

    finitePBoundaryTransportCost (3 / 2) repeated (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) =
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ∧
      finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost repeated (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) =
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) *
          finitePBoundaryTransportCost (3 / 2) repeated (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · norm_num only [repeated_root, inv_div, one_mul]
  · convert repeated_upper_sharp (3 / 2) using 2; norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.empty_comparison

      finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
        (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) = (0 : ℝ) ^ (1 - p⁻¹) * 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty hp _ _
  · simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.fractional_candidate_square_lt_power
proof:

  norm_num [threeQuarterPlan, FiniteBoundaryPlan.powerCost, FiniteBoundaryPlan.linearCost,
    FiniteBoundaryPlan.deletionMass, FiniteBoundaryPlan.insertionMass,

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.optimized_comparisons
statement:
private theorem optimized_comparisons {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    {r s : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    comparisonBounds r s x y
proof:
:=
  ⟨finitePMatchingCost_le_of_exponent_le hr hrs x y,
    finitePMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_of_exponent_le hr hrs x y,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_of_exponent_le hr hrs x y,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_of_exponent_le hr hrs x y⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.empty_two_exponents
statement:
private theorem empty_two_exponents {r s : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    finitePMatchingCost r emptyFamily emptyFamily = 0 ∧
    finitePMatchingCost s emptyFamily emptyFamily = 0 ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost r emptyFamily emptyFamily = 0 ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost s emptyFamily emptyFamily = 0 ∧
    comparisonBounds r s emptyFamily emptyFamily
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨finitePMatchingCost_empty hr _ _, finitePMatchingCost_empty (hr.trans hrs) _ _,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty hr _ _,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty (hr.trans hrs) _ _,
    optimized_comparisons hr hrs _ _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.empty_equal_three_halves
statement:
private theorem empty_equal_three_halves :
    finitePMatchingCost (3 / 2) emptyFamily emptyFamily = 0 ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost (3 / 2) emptyFamily emptyFamily = 0 ∧
    (0 : ℝ) ^ (((3 / 2 : ℝ)⁻¹) - (3 / 2 : ℝ)⁻¹) = 1 ∧
    comparisonBounds (3 / 2) (3 / 2) emptyFamily emptyFamily
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨finitePMatchingCost_empty (by norm_num) _ _,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty (by norm_num) _ _, by simp,
    optimized_comparisons (by norm_num) le_rfl _ _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.equal_exponents
statement:
private theorem equal_exponents {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ((Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (r⁻¹ - r⁻¹) = 1 ∧
    comparisonBounds r r x y
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨by simp, optimized_comparisons hr le_rfl x y⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.oneBar_positive
statement: private theorem oneBar_positive (i : Fin 1) : (oneBar i).1 < (oneBar i).2
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [oneBar]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.one_bar_roots
statement:
private theorem one_bar_roots (t : ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost t oneBar emptyFamily = 1 ∧
    finitePMatchingCost t emptyFamily oneBar = 1 ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost t oneBar emptyFamily = 1 ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost t emptyFamily oneBar = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost,
    finitePMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right, finitePMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_left]
  norm_num [oneBar, diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.one_bar_two_exponents
statement:
private theorem one_bar_two_exponents :
    comparisonBounds (3 / 2) 3 oneBar emptyFamily ∧
    comparisonBounds (3 / 2) 3 emptyFamily oneBar ∧
    (1 : ℝ) ^ (((3 / 2 : ℝ)⁻¹) - (3 : ℝ)⁻¹) = 1 ∧
    finitePMatchingCost (3 / 2) oneBar emptyFamily = finitePMatchingCost 3 oneBar emptyFamily ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost (3 / 2) oneBar emptyFamily =
      (1 : ℝ) ^ (((3 / 2 : ℝ)⁻¹) - (3 : ℝ)⁻¹) *
        finitePBoundaryTransportCost 3 oneBar emptyFamily ∧
    finitePMatchingCost (3 / 2) emptyFamily oneBar = finitePMatchingCost 3 emptyFamily oneBar ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost (3 / 2) emptyFamily oneBar =
      (1 : ℝ) ^ (((3 / 2 : ℝ)⁻¹) - (3 : ℝ)⁻¹) *
        finitePBoundaryTransportCost 3 emptyFamily oneBar
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨optimized_comparisons (by norm_num) (by norm_num) _ _,
    optimized_comparisons (by norm_num) (by norm_num) _ _, by simp, ?_⟩
  simp only [(one_bar_roots (3 / 2)).1, (one_bar_roots 3).1,
    (one_bar_roots (3 / 2)).2.1, (one_bar_roots 3).2.1,
    (one_bar_roots (3 / 2)).2.2.1, (one_bar_roots 3).2.2.1,
    (one_bar_roots (3 / 2)).2.2.2, (one_bar_roots 3).2.2.2,
    Real.one_rpow, one_mul, and_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.repeated_positive
statement: private theorem repeated_positive (i : Fin 2) : (repeated i).1 < (repeated i).2
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [repeated]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.repeated_both_roots
proof:
:= by
  have h := repeated_root t
  exact ⟨by simpa only [emptyFamily, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using h, h⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.repeated_two_exponents_sharp
statement:
private theorem repeated_two_exponents_sharp :
    finitePMatchingCost (3 / 2) repeated emptyFamily = (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ∧
    finitePMatchingCost 3 repeated emptyFamily = (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost (3 / 2) repeated emptyFamily = (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost 3 repeated emptyFamily = (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) ∧
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (((3 / 2 : ℝ)⁻¹) - (3 : ℝ)⁻¹) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) ∧
    finitePMatchingCost (3 / 2) repeated emptyFamily =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * finitePMatchingCost 3 repeated emptyFamily ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost (3 / 2) repeated emptyFamily =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * finitePBoundaryTransportCost 3 repeated emptyFamily ∧
    comparisonBounds (3 / 2) 3 repeated emptyFamily
proof:
:= by
  have hsharp : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((3 / 2 : ℝ)⁻¹) =
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) * (2 : ℝ) ^ ((3 : ℝ)⁻¹) := by
    rw [← Real.rpow_add (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
    congr 1
    norm_num
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    optimized_comparisons (by norm_num) (by norm_num) _ _⟩
  · norm_num only [(repeated_both_roots (3 / 2)).1, inv_div, one_mul]
  · simpa only [one_div] using (repeated_both_roots 3).1
  · norm_num only [(repeated_both_roots (3 / 2)).2, inv_div, one_mul]
  · simpa only [one_div] using (repeated_both_roots 3).2
  · norm_num
  · simpa only [(repeated_both_roots (3 / 2)).1, (repeated_both_roots 3).1] using hsharp
  · simpa only [(repeated_both_roots (3 / 2)).2, (repeated_both_roots 3).2] using hsharp

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.switchTarget_positive
statement:
private theorem switchTarget_positive (j : Fin 1) :
    (switchTarget j).1 < (switchTarget j).2
proof: := by norm_num [switchTarget]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.switch_roots
statement:
private theorem switch_roots :
    finitePMatchingCost 1 oneBar switchTarget = 3 / 2 ∧
    finitePMatchingCost 2 oneBar switchTarget = Real.sqrt 2 ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost 1 oneBar switchTarget = 3 / 2 ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost 2 oneBar switchTarget = Real.sqrt 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : finitePBoundaryTransportCost 1 oneBar switchTarget = 3 / 2 := by
    unfold oneBar switchTarget
    rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost, FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.switch_power_one]
    norm_num
  have h2 : finitePBoundaryTransportCost 2 oneBar switchTarget = Real.sqrt 2 := by
    unfold oneBar switchTarget
    rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost, FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.switch_power_two]
    norm_num [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  exact ⟨by simpa only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using h1,
    by simpa only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using h2, h1, h2⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.switch_optimizers_and_comparison
statement:
private theorem switch_optimizers_and_comparison :
    FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.pairSingletons.totalFinitePowerCost 1 oneBar switchTarget =
      finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost 1 oneBar switchTarget ∧
    finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost 2 oneBar switchTarget <
      FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.pairSingletons.totalFinitePowerCost 2 oneBar switchTarget ∧
    (FiniteBoundaryPlan.zero : FiniteBoundaryPlan (Fin 1) (Fin 1)).powerCost 2 oneBar switchTarget =
      finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost 2 oneBar switchTarget ∧
    comparisonBounds 1 2 oneBar switchTarget
proof:
:=
  ⟨FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.optimizer_changes_with_exponent.1,
    FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.optimizer_changes_with_exponent.2,
    FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.deleting_both_optimal_at_two,
    optimized_comparisons le_rfl (by norm_num) _ _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.mixed_positive
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro i <;> fin_cases i <;> norm_num [mixedSource, mixedTarget]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.mixed_charges_and_power
statement:
private theorem mixed_charges_and_power (t : ℝ) :
    (finitePairCost (mixedSource 0) (mixedTarget 0)).toReal = 1 ∧
    (diagonalCost (mixedSource 1)).toReal = 1 ∧
    (diagonalCost (mixedTarget 1)).toReal = 2 ∧
    mixedMatching.finite 0 = some 0 ∧ mixedMatching.finite 1 = none ∧
    mixedMatching.totalFinitePowerCost t mixedSource mixedTarget = 2 + (2 : ℝ) ^ t
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [mixedSource, mixedTarget, mixedMatching, OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost,
    OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.exists_fin_succ,
    finitePairCost, diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.mixed_square_and_comparison
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, optimized_comparisons (by norm_num) (by norm_num) _ _⟩
  rw [(mixed_charges_and_power 2).2.2.2.2.2, Real.rpow_two]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.farTarget_positive
statement:
private theorem farTarget_positive (j : Fin 1) :
    (farTarget j).1 < (farTarget j).2
proof: := by norm_num [farTarget]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.half_plan_nonzero_costs
statement:
private theorem half_plan_nonzero_costs :
    (finitePairCost (oneBar 0) (farTarget 0)).toReal = 6 ∧
    (diagonalCost (oneBar 0)).toReal = 1 ∧
    (diagonalCost (farTarget 0)).toReal = 1 ∧
    FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.halfPlan.deletionMass 0 = 1 / 2 ∧
    FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.halfPlan.insertionMass 0 = 1 / 2 ∧
    FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.halfPlan.powerCost 1 oneBar farTarget = 4 ∧
    FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.halfPlan.powerCost 2 oneBar farTarget = 19
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [oneBar, farTarget, FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.halfPlan,
    FiniteBoundaryPlan.powerCost, FiniteBoundaryPlan.linearCost,
    FiniteBoundaryPlan.deletionMass, FiniteBoundaryPlan.insertionMass,
    finitePairCost, diagonalCost, Real.rpow_two]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.half_plan_root_increases
statement:
private theorem half_plan_root_increases :
    FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.halfPlan.powerCost 2 oneBar farTarget ^ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ =
      Real.sqrt 19 ∧
    FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.halfPlan.powerCost 1 oneBar farTarget <
      FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.halfPlan.powerCost 2 oneBar farTarget ^ (2 : ℝ)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [half_plan_nonzero_costs.2.2.2.2.2.1, half_plan_nonzero_costs.2.2.2.2.2.2]
  constructor
  · norm_num [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  · rw [show (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ = 1 / 2 by norm_num, ← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    exact (Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 4)).mpr (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostComparisonExamples.far_optimized_roots
statement:
private theorem far_optimized_roots :
    finitePMatchingCost 1 oneBar farTarget = 2 ∧
    finitePMatchingCost 2 oneBar farTarget = Real.sqrt 2 ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost 1 oneBar farTarget = 2 ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost 2 oneBar farTarget = Real.sqrt 2 ∧
    comparisonBounds 1 2 oneBar farTarget
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : finitePMatchingCost 1 oneBar farTarget = 2 := by
    unfold oneBar farTarget
    rw [finitePMatchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_singleton]
    norm_num [finitePairCost, diagonalCost]
  have h2 : finitePMatchingCost 2 oneBar farTarget = Real.sqrt 2 := by
    unfold oneBar farTarget
    rw [finitePMatchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_singleton]
    norm_num [finitePairCost, diagonalCost, Real.rpow_two, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  exact ⟨h1, h2, by simpa only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using h1,
    by simpa only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using h2,
    optimized_comparisons le_rfl (by norm_num) _ _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.alphaLE_chain_split
statement:
theorem alphaLE_chain_split {n : ℕ} (R S T : Rectangle n)
    (hRT : alphaLE R T) : alphaLE R S ∨ alphaLE S T
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hRS : alphaLE R S
  · exact Or.inl hRS
  right
  have hSR : alphaValue S < alphaValue R ∨
      (alphaValue S = alphaValue R ∧ alphaPlus S < alphaPlus R) := by
    unfold alphaLE at hRS
    rcases lt_trichotomy (alphaValue S) (alphaValue R) with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · have hn : ¬ alphaPlus R ≤ alphaPlus S := by
        intro hp
        exact hRS (Or.inr ⟨h.symm, hp⟩)
      exact Or.inr ⟨h, Nat.lt_of_not_ge hn⟩
    · exact False.elim (hRS (Or.inl h))
  unfold alphaLE at hRT ⊢
  rcases hSR with h | ⟨h, hp⟩
  · exact Or.inl (h.trans_le (hRT.elim le_of_lt (fun x => x.1.le)))
  · rcases hRT with hRT | ⟨he, hpRT⟩
    · exact Or.inl (h ▸ hRT)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h.trans he, hp.le.trans hpRT⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.decoratedLE_refl
statement: theorem decoratedLE_refl (a : ℝ) (p : Bool) : decoratedLE a a p p
proof:
:=
  Or.inr ⟨rfl, le_rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.decoratedLE_value
statement:
theorem decoratedLE_value {a b : ℝ} {p q : Bool}
    (h : decoratedLE a b p q) : a ≤ b
proof:
:=
  h.elim le_of_lt (fun x => x.1.le)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.decoratedLE_of_lt
statement:
theorem decoratedLE_of_lt {a b : ℝ} (h : a < b) (p q : Bool) :
    decoratedLE a b p q
proof: := Or.inl h

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.decoratedLE_add_mono
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | ⟨h, hp⟩
  · exact Or.inl (by linarith)
  · rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hδρ with hlt | he
    · exact Or.inl (by linarith)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨by simpa [← he] using h, hp⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.interval_lower_le_mem
statement:
private theorem interval_lower_le_mem (I : BoundedInterval) {p : ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ I.support) : I.lower ≤ p
proof:
:=
  hp.1.elim le_of_lt (fun h => h.1.le)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.interval_mem_le_upper
statement:
private theorem interval_mem_le_upper (I : BoundedInterval) {p : ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ I.support) : p ≤ I.upper
proof:
:=
  hp.2.elim le_of_lt (fun h => h.1.le)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.interval_exists_mem_lt
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : I.lower = p
  · exact ⟨p, hp, le_rfl, he ▸ ht⟩
  have hpl : I.lower < p := lt_of_le_of_ne (interval_lower_le_mem I hp) he
  let x := min p ((I.lower + t) / 2)
  have hxlow : I.lower < x := lt_min hpl (by linarith)
  have hxp : x ≤ p := min_le_left _ _
  have hxt : x < t := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨x, ⟨Or.inl hxlow, ?_⟩, hxp, hxt⟩
  by_cases hxp' : x = p
  · simpa [hxp'] using hp.2
  · exact Or.inl ((lt_of_le_of_ne hxp hxp').trans_le (interval_mem_le_upper I hp))

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.interval_exists_mem_gt
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : I.upper = p
  · exact ⟨p, hp, le_rfl, he ▸ ht⟩
  have hpu : p < I.upper := lt_of_le_of_ne (interval_mem_le_upper I hp) (Ne.symm he)
  let x := max p ((I.upper + t) / 2)
  have hxup : x < I.upper := max_lt hpu (by linarith)
  have hpx : p ≤ x := le_max_left _ _
  have htx : t < x := lt_of_lt_of_le (by linarith) (le_max_right _ _)
  refine ⟨x, ⟨?_, Or.inl hxup⟩, hpx, htx⟩
  by_cases hpx' : x = p
  · simpa [hpx'] using hp.1
  · exact Or.inl ((interval_lower_le_mem I hp).trans_lt
      (lt_of_le_of_ne hpx (Ne.symm hpx')))

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.interval_lower_mem_of_closed
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Or.inr ⟨rfl, hc⟩, ?_⟩
  by_cases hlt : I.lower < I.upper
  · exact Or.inl hlt
  have heq : I.lower = I.upper := by
    have := interval_lower_le_mem I hp
    have := interval_mem_le_upper I hp
    linarith
  have hpe : p = I.upper := by
    have := interval_lower_le_mem I hp
    have := interval_mem_le_upper I hp
    linarith
  rcases hp.2 with h | ⟨_, h⟩
  · exfalso; linarith
  · exact Or.inr ⟨heq, h⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.interval_upper_mem_of_closed
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, Or.inr ⟨rfl, hc⟩⟩
  by_cases hlt : I.lower < I.upper
  · exact Or.inl hlt
  have heq : I.lower = I.upper := by
    have := interval_lower_le_mem I hp
    have := interval_mem_le_upper I hp
    linarith
  have hpe : p = I.lower := by
    have := interval_lower_le_mem I hp
    have := interval_mem_le_upper I hp
    linarith
  rcases hp.1 with h | ⟨_, h⟩
  · exfalso; linarith
  · exact Or.inr ⟨heq, h⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.lower_bound_of_backward
statement:
private theorem lower_bound_of_backward (A B : BoundedInterval)
    (ε p : ℝ) (hp : p ∈ A.support)
    (h : ∀ x, x ∈ A.support → x ≤ p → x + ε ∈ B.support) :
    decoratedLE B.lower (A.lower + ε) (!B.lowerClosed) (!A.lowerClosed)
proof:
:= by
  have hval : B.lower ≤ A.lower + ε := by
    by_contra hn
    have hlt : A.lower < B.lower - ε := by linarith
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxp, hxt⟩ := interval_exists_mem_lt A hp hlt
    have hb := interval_lower_le_mem B (h x hx hxp)
    linarith
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hval with hlt | he
  · exact Or.inl hlt
  refine Or.inr ⟨he, ?_⟩
  cases hc : A.lowerClosed
  · simp
  · have hB : B.lowerClosed = true := by
      have hA := interval_lower_mem_of_closed A hp hc
      have hm := (h A.lower hA (interval_lower_le_mem A hp)).1
      rcases hm with hh | ⟨_, hh⟩
      · exfalso; linarith
      · exact hh
    simp [hB]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.upper_bound_of_forward
statement:
private theorem upper_bound_of_forward (A B : BoundedInterval)
    (ε p : ℝ) (hp : p + ε ∈ B.support)
    (h : ∀ y, y ∈ B.support → p + ε ≤ y → y - ε ∈ A.support) :
    decoratedLE B.upper (A.upper + ε) B.upperClosed A.upperClosed
proof:
:= by
  have hval : B.upper ≤ A.upper + ε := by
    by_contra hn
    have hlt : A.upper + ε < B.upper := by linarith
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hpy, hty⟩ := interval_exists_mem_gt B hp hlt
    have ha := interval_mem_le_upper A (h y hy hpy)
    linarith
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hval with hlt | he
  · exact Or.inl hlt
  refine Or.inr ⟨he, ?_⟩
  cases hc : B.upperClosed
  · simp
  · have hA : A.upperClosed = true := by
      have hB := interval_upper_mem_of_closed B hp hc
      have hm := (h B.upper hB (interval_mem_le_upper B hp)).2
      rcases hm with hh | ⟨_, hh⟩
      · exfalso; linarith
      · exact hh
    simp [hA]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.lower_mem_of_bound
statement:
private theorem lower_mem_of_bound (A B : BoundedInterval) (ρ : ℝ)
    (h : decoratedLE B.lower (A.lower + ρ)
      (!B.lowerClosed) (!A.lowerClosed))
    {x : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ A.support) :
    B.lower < x + ρ ∨ (B.lower = x + ρ ∧ B.lowerClosed = true)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | ⟨he, hp⟩
  · exact Or.inl (by have := interval_lower_le_mem A hx; linarith)
  rcases hx.1 with hax | ⟨hax, hc⟩
  · exact Or.inl (by linarith)
  · right
    refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
    cases hB : B.lowerClosed
    · have : False := by
        simp only [hB, hc, Bool.not_false, Bool.not_true] at hp
        have hh := Bool.toNat_le_toNat hp
        norm_num at hh
      exact this.elim
    · rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.upper_mem_of_bound
statement:
private theorem upper_mem_of_bound (A B : BoundedInterval) (ρ : ℝ)
    (h : decoratedLE B.upper (A.upper + ρ) B.upperClosed A.upperClosed)
    {y : ℝ} (hy : y ∈ B.support) :
    y - ρ < A.upper ∨ (y - ρ = A.upper ∧ A.upperClosed = true)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | ⟨he, hp⟩
  · exact Or.inl (by have hyu := interval_mem_le_upper B hy; linarith)
  rcases hy.2 with hyu | ⟨hyu, hc⟩
  · exact Or.inl (by linarith)
  · right
    refine ⟨by linarith, ?_⟩
    cases hA : A.upperClosed
    · have : False := by
        simp only [hA, hc] at hp
        have hh := Bool.toNat_le_toNat hp
        norm_num at hh
      exact this.elim
    · rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.compatible_of_endpoint_bounds
statement:
theorem compatible_of_endpoint_bounds {n : ℕ} (R S : Rectangle n) (ρ : ℝ≥0)
    (h : ∀ j, decoratedLE (endpoint S j)
      (endpoint R j + (ρ : ℝ)) (plus S j) (plus R j))
    {p q : Fin n → ℝ} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hpR : p ∈ R.support) (hqS : translation ρ q ∈ S.support) :
    q ∈ R.support ∧ translation ρ p ∈ S.support
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i
    have hlo := (hpR i).1
    have hu := upper_mem_of_bound (R i) (S i) (ρ : ℝ)
      (h (i, true)) (hqS i)
    constructor
    · rcases hlo with hlo | ⟨hlo, hc⟩
      · exact Or.inl (hlo.trans_le (hpq i))
      · by_cases he : p i = q i
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hlo.trans he, hc⟩
        · exact Or.inl (lt_of_le_of_ne (hlo.le.trans (hpq i))
            (by intro hh; exact he (by linarith)))
    · simpa [translation_apply] using hu
  · intro i
    have hl := lower_mem_of_bound (R i) (S i) (ρ : ℝ)
      (h (i, false)) (hpR i)
    have hu := (hqS i).2
    constructor
    · simpa [translation_apply] using hl
    · rcases hu with hu | ⟨hu, hc⟩
      · exact Or.inl ((show (translation ρ p) i ≤ (translation ρ q) i from
          (translation ρ).monotone' hpq i).trans_lt hu)
      · by_cases he : p i = q i
        · exact Or.inr ⟨by simpa [translation_apply, he] using hu, hc⟩
        · exact Or.inl (by
            have hpqlt := lt_of_le_of_ne (hpq i) he
            change q i + (ρ : ℝ) = (S i).upper at hu
            change p i + (ρ : ℝ) < (S i).upper
            linarith)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.comparisonLinear_val
statement:
private theorem comparisonLinear_val {n : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ρ : ℝ≥0) (p : Fin n → ℝ)
    (x : SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) R.support p) :
    ((comparisonLinear R S ρ p x) : k) =
      if translation ρ p ∈ S.support then (x : k) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : translation ρ p ∈ S.support <;>
    simp [comparisonLinear, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.comparison_app_val
statement:
theorem comparison_app_val {n : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ρ : ℝ≥0)
    (h : ∀ j, decoratedLE (endpoint S j)
      (endpoint R j + (ρ : ℝ)) (plus S j) (plus R j))
    (p : Fin n → ℝ) (x : SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) R.support p) :
    ((show SupportInterval.fiber S.support (translation ρ p) from
      ((comparison R S ρ h).app p).hom x) : k) =
      if translation ρ p ∈ S.support then (x : k) else 0
proof:
:=
  comparisonLinear_val R S ρ p x

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.sum_erase_bound
statement:
private theorem sum_erase_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (r s : ι → ℝ) (δ : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, s i ≤ r i + δ) (j : ι) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.univ.erase j, (s i - r i)) ≤
      ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) * δ
proof:
:= by
  let t : Finset ι := Finset.univ.erase j
  have ht : t.card = Fintype.card ι - 1 := by
    simp [t, Finset.card_erase_of_mem]
  calc
    (∑ i ∈ t, (s i - r i)) ≤ ∑ _i ∈ t, δ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      linarith [hf i]
    _ = ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) * δ := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      rw [ht]
      have hc : 1 ≤ Fintype.card ι := by
        exact Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨j⟩
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hc]
      norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.sum_reverse_bound
statement:
private theorem sum_reverse_bound {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (r s : ι → ℝ) (δ : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, s i ≤ r i + δ)
    (ha : ∑ i, r i ≤ ∑ i, s i) (j : ι) :
    r j ≤ s j + ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) * δ
proof:
:= by
  let t : Finset ι := Finset.univ.erase j
  have hrest := sum_erase_bound r s δ hf j
  have htotal : 0 ≤ ∑ i, (s i - r i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr ha
  have hsplit : (∑ i, (s i - r i)) =
      (∑ i ∈ t, (s i - r i)) + (s j - r j) := by
    exact (Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ (fun i => s i - r i)
      (Finset.mem_univ j)).symm
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.sum_reverse_decorated
statement:
private theorem sum_reverse_decorated {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (r s : ι → ℝ) (pr ps : ι → Bool) (δ : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, decoratedLE (s i) (r i + δ) (ps i) (pr i))
    (ha : (∑ i, r i) < (∑ i, s i) ∨
      ((∑ i, r i) = (∑ i, s i) ∧
        (∑ i, (pr i).toNat) ≤ (∑ i, (ps i).toNat))) (j : ι) :
    decoratedLE (r j) (s j + ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) * δ)
      (pr j) (ps j)
proof:
:= by
  have hfvalue (i : ι) : s i ≤ r i + δ := decoratedLE_value (hf i)
  have havalue : (∑ i, r i) ≤ (∑ i, s i) :=
    ha.elim le_of_lt (fun h => h.1.le)
  have hv := sum_reverse_bound r s δ hfvalue havalue j
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hv with hlt | he
  · exact Or.inl hlt
  right
  refine ⟨he, ?_⟩
  let t : Finset ι := Finset.univ.erase j
  have hrest := sum_erase_bound r s δ hfvalue j
  have hsplit : (∑ i, (s i - r i)) =
      (∑ i ∈ t, (s i - r i)) + (s j - r j) := by
    exact (Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ (fun i => s i - r i)
      (Finset.mem_univ j)).symm
  have htotal : 0 ≤ ∑ i, (s i - r i) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact sub_nonneg.mpr havalue
  have htotal0 : (∑ i, (s i - r i)) = 0 := by linarith
  have hrestEq : (∑ i ∈ t, (s i - r i)) = ∑ _i ∈ t, δ := by
    have ht : t.card = Fintype.card ι - 1 := by
      simp [t, Finset.card_erase_of_mem]
    have hc : 1 ≤ Fintype.card ι := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨j⟩
    have hconst : (∑ _i ∈ t, δ) =
        ((Fintype.card ι : ℝ) - 1) * δ := by
      simp only [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
      rw [ht, Nat.cast_sub hc]
      norm_num
    rw [hconst]
    linarith
  have hsat (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ t) : s i = r i + δ := by
    have heq := (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le
      (fun i (_hi : i ∈ t) => show s i - r i ≤ δ by linarith [hfvalue i])).mp hrestEq i hi
    linarith
  have hplusRest : (∑ i ∈ t, (ps i).toNat) ≤
      ∑ i ∈ t, (pr i).toNat := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i hi
    have hb := (hf i).resolve_left (by linarith [hsat i hi])
    rcases hb with ⟨_, hp⟩
    exact Bool.toNat_le_toNat hp
  have haplus : (∑ i, (pr i).toNat) ≤ (∑ i, (ps i).toNat) := by
    rcases ha with hlt | ⟨heq, hp⟩
    · have : (∑ i, r i) = (∑ i, s i) := by
        rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at htotal0
        linarith [htotal0]
      exact False.elim ((ne_of_lt hlt) this)
    · exact hp
  have hsplitPr : (∑ i, (pr i).toNat) =
      (∑ i ∈ t, (pr i).toNat) + (pr j).toNat := by
    exact (Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ (fun i => (pr i).toNat)
      (Finset.mem_univ j)).symm
  have hsplitPs : (∑ i, (ps i).toNat) =
      (∑ i ∈ t, (ps i).toNat) + (ps j).toNat := by
    exact (Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ (fun i => (ps i).toNat)
      (Finset.mem_univ j)).symm
  cases hpr : pr j <;> cases hps : ps j <;> simp_all; omega

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.reverse_value_of_alphaLE
statement:
theorem reverse_value_of_alphaLE {n : ℕ} (R S : Rectangle n) (δ : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ j, endpoint S j ≤ endpoint R j + δ)
    (ha : alphaLE R S) (j : Fin n × Bool) :
    endpoint R j ≤ endpoint S j + ((2 * n : ℝ) - 1) * δ
proof:
:= by
  have hh : alphaValue R ≤ alphaValue S :=
    ha.elim le_of_lt (fun h => h.1.le)
  have h := sum_reverse_bound (endpoint R) (endpoint S) δ hf hh j
  simpa [alphaValue, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_bool,
    Nat.cast_mul, mul_comm] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.reverse_endpoint_bounds_of_alphaLE
statement:
theorem reverse_endpoint_bounds_of_alphaLE {n : ℕ}
    (R S : Rectangle n) (δ : ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ j, decoratedLE (endpoint S j) (endpoint R j + δ)
      (plus S j) (plus R j))
    (ha : alphaLE R S) (j : Fin n × Bool) :
    decoratedLE (endpoint R j)
      (endpoint S j + ((2 * n : ℝ) - 1) * δ)
      (plus R j) (plus S j)
proof:
:= by
  have h := sum_reverse_decorated (endpoint R) (endpoint S)
    (plus R) (plus S) δ hf ha j
  simpa [alphaValue, alphaPlus, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin,
    Fintype.card_bool, Nat.cast_mul, mul_comm] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.exists_nonzero_shifted_component
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_shifted_component {n : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (p : Fin n → ℝ) (hpR : p ∈ R.support)
      (_hpS : translation ε p ∈ S.support),
      (f.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  apply hf
  ext p x
  by_cases hpR : p ∈ R.support
  · have hx : x = (x : k) • SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp [SupportInterval.one]
    rw [hx, map_smul]
    by_cases hpS : translation ε p ∈ S.support
    · have hz := hn p hpR hpS
      change (x : k) • (f.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one R.support hpR) = 0
      rw [hz]
      exact smul_zero (x : k)
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact SupportInterval.val_eq_zero S.support hpS _
  · have hx : x = 0 := Subtype.ext (SupportInterval.val_eq_zero R.support hpR x)
    rw [hx]
    change (f.app p).hom 0 = 0
    exact map_zero _

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.mem_shifted_target_of_le
statement:
theorem mem_shifted_target_of_le {n : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module)
    {p q : Fin n → ℝ} (hpR : p ∈ R.support)
    (hne : (f.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR) ≠ 0)
    (hqp : q ≤ p) (hqR : q ∈ R.support) :
    translation ε q ∈ S.support
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hqS
  have hzero : (f.app q).hom (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hqR) = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact SupportInterval.val_eq_zero S.support hqS _
  have hsource : structureMapLinear (R.module (k := k)) hqp
      (SupportInterval.one R.support hqR) = SupportInterval.one R.support hpR := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [SupportInterval.structureMap_val]
    simp [hpR, SupportInterval.one]
  have hnat := congrArg
    (fun F => F.hom (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hqR))
    (f.naturality (homOfLE hqp))
  change (f.app p).hom (structureMapLinear R.module hqp
      (SupportInterval.one R.support hqR)) =
    structureMapLinear ((shift ε).obj S.module) hqp
      ((f.app q).hom (SupportInterval.one R.support hqR)) at hnat
  rw [hsource, hzero, map_zero] at hnat
  exact hne hnat

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.mem_source_of_le_shifted
statement:
theorem mem_source_of_le_shifted {n : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module)
    {p q : Fin n → ℝ} (hpR : p ∈ R.support)
    (_hpS : translation ε p ∈ S.support)
    (hne : (f.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR) ≠ 0)
    (hpq : p ≤ q) (hqS : translation ε q ∈ S.support) :
    q ∈ R.support
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hqR
  have hsource : structureMapLinear (R.module (k := k)) hpq
      (SupportInterval.one R.support hpR) = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact SupportInterval.val_eq_zero R.support hqR _
  have hnat := congrArg
    (fun F => F.hom (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR))
    (f.naturality (homOfLE hpq))
  change (f.app q).hom (structureMapLinear R.module hpq
      (SupportInterval.one R.support hpR)) =
    structureMapLinear ((shift ε).obj S.module) hpq
      ((f.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one R.support hpR)) at hnat
  rw [hsource, map_zero] at hnat
  classical
  let z : SupportInterval.fiber S.support (translation ε p) :=
    (f.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one R.support hpR)
  change (0 : SupportInterval.fiber S.support (translation ε q)) =
    structureMapLinear S.module ((translation ε).monotone' hpq) z at hnat
  have hv := congrArg (fun y : SupportInterval.fiber S.support (translation ε q) =>
    (y : k)) hnat
  rw [SupportInterval.structureMap_val] at hv
  change (0 : k) = if translation ε q ∈ S.support then (z : k) else 0 at hv
  rw [if_pos hqS] at hv
  apply hne
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hv.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.withCoord_self
statement:
private theorem withCoord_self {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (x : ℝ) :
    withCoord p i x i = x
proof: := by simp [withCoord]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.withCoord_le
statement:
private theorem withCoord_le {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (x : ℝ)
    (h : x ≤ p i) : withCoord p i x ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [withCoord, hji, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.le_withCoord
statement:
private theorem le_withCoord {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) (x : ℝ)
    (h : p i ≤ x) : p ≤ withCoord p i x
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [withCoord, hji, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.withCoord_mem
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    simpa [withCoord] using hx
  · simpa [withCoord, hji] using hp j

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.translation_withCoord_mem
statement:
private theorem translation_withCoord_mem {n : ℕ} (S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (p : Fin n → ℝ) (hp : translation ε p ∈ S.support)
    (i : Fin n) (y : ℝ) (hy : y ∈ (S i).support) :
    translation ε (withCoord p i (y - (ε : ℝ))) ∈ S.support
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    simpa [withCoord, translation_apply] using hy
  · simpa [withCoord, hji, translation_apply] using hp j

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds
statement:
theorem shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds {n : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (j : Fin n × Bool) :
    decoratedLE (endpoint S j) (endpoint R j + (ε : ℝ))
      (plus S j) (plus R j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpR, hpS, hne⟩ := exists_nonzero_shifted_component R S ε f hf
  rcases j with ⟨i, b⟩
  cases b
  · change decoratedLE (S i).lower ((R i).lower + (ε : ℝ))
        (!(S i).lowerClosed) (!(R i).lowerClosed)
    apply lower_bound_of_backward (R i) (S i) (ε : ℝ) (p i) (hpR i)
    intro x hx hxp
    let q := withCoord p i x
    have hqR : q ∈ R.support := withCoord_mem R p hpR i x hx
    have hqp : q ≤ p := withCoord_le p i x hxp
    have hqS := mem_shifted_target_of_le R S ε f hpR hne hqp hqR
    simpa [q, withCoord, translation_apply] using hqS i
  · change decoratedLE (S i).upper ((R i).upper + (ε : ℝ))
        (S i).upperClosed (R i).upperClosed
    apply upper_bound_of_forward (R i) (S i) (ε : ℝ) (p i) (hpS i)
    intro y hy hpy
    let q := withCoord p i (y - (ε : ℝ))
    have hpq : p ≤ q := le_withCoord p i (y - (ε : ℝ)) (by linarith)
    have hqS : translation ε q ∈ S.support :=
      translation_withCoord_mem S ε p hpS i y hy
    have hqR := mem_source_of_le_shifted R S ε f hpR hpS hne hpq hqS
    simpa [q, withCoord] using hqR i

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.middle_mem_of_endpointClose
statement:
theorem middle_mem_of_endpointClose {n : ℕ} (R S : Rectangle n)
    (ρ : ℝ≥0)
    (h : endpointClose (ρ : ℝ) R S) (p : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ R.support)
    (h2 : translation (ρ + ρ) p ∈ R.support) :
    translation ρ p ∈ S.support
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have hl := lower_mem_of_bound (R i) (S i) (ρ : ℝ)
    (h (i, false)).2 (hp i)
  have hu := upper_mem_of_bound (S i) (R i) (ρ : ℝ)
    (h (i, true)).1 (h2 i)
  constructor
  · simpa [translation_apply] using hl
  · have he : (translation (ρ + ρ) p) i - (ρ : ℝ) =
        (translation ρ p) i := by
      simp [translation_apply, NNReal.coe_add]
      ring
    rw [he] at hu
    exact hu

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.comparison_composite
statement:
theorem comparison_composite {n : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ρ : ℝ≥0)
    (h : endpointClose (ρ : ℝ) R S) :
    comparison R S ρ (fun j => (h j).2) ≫
      (shift ρ).map (comparison S R ρ (fun j => (h j).1)) ≫
        (compIso ρ ρ (R.module (k := k))).hom =
          transition (ρ + ρ) (R.module (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext p
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hcomp : translation ρ (translation ρ p) ≤ translation (ρ + ρ) p :=
    le_of_eq (by funext i; simp [translation_apply, NNReal.coe_add, add_assoc])
  have hstep : p ≤ translation (ρ + ρ) p := by
    intro i
    change p i ≤ p i + ((ρ + ρ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (ρ + ρ).coe_nonneg
  change ((structureMapLinear R.module hcomp
    (comparisonLinear S R ρ (translation ρ p)
      (comparisonLinear R S ρ p x))) : k) =
    ((structureMapLinear R.module hstep x) : k)
  rw [SupportInterval.structureMap_val, SupportInterval.structureMap_val,
    comparisonLinear_val, comparisonLinear_val]
  have heq : translation ρ (translation ρ p) = translation (ρ + ρ) p := by
    funext i
    simp [translation_apply, NNReal.coe_add, add_assoc]
  rw [heq]
  by_cases hp : p ∈ R.support
  · by_cases h2 : translation (ρ + ρ) p ∈ R.support
    · have hm := middle_mem_of_endpointClose R S ρ h p hp h2
      simp [h2, hm]
    · simp [h2]
  · have hx := SupportInterval.val_eq_zero R.support hp x
    simp [hx]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.epsilon_le_stability_radius
statement:
private theorem epsilon_le_stability_radius {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    (ε : ℝ) ≤ ((2 * n : ℝ) - 1) * (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hn' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hh : 0 ≤ ((2 * n : ℝ) - 2) * (ε : ℝ) :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) ε.coe_nonneg
  nlinarith

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.nonzero_path_endpointClose
statement:
theorem nonzero_path_endpointClose {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (R S T : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (hRT : alphaLE R T)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (g : S.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj T.module) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    endpointClose (((2 * n : ℝ) - 1) * (ε : ℝ)) R S ∨
      endpointClose (((2 * n : ℝ) - 1) * (ε : ℝ)) S T
proof:
:= by
  have hε := epsilon_le_stability_radius hn ε
  rcases alphaLE_chain_split R S T hRT with hRS | hST
  · left
    intro j
    exact ⟨reverse_endpoint_bounds_of_alphaLE R S (ε : ℝ)
      (shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds R S ε f hf) hRS j,
      decoratedLE_add_mono (shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds R S ε f hf j) hε⟩
  · right
    intro j
    exact ⟨reverse_endpoint_bounds_of_alphaLE S T (ε : ℝ)
      (shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds S T ε g hg) hST j,
      decoratedLE_add_mono (shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds S T ε g hg j) hε⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius_coe
statement:
private theorem stabilityRadius_coe {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    (stabilityRadius n ε : ℝ) = ((2 * n : ℝ) - 1) * (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hnat : 1 ≤ 2 * n := by omega
  simp only [stabilityRadius, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_natCast]
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hnat]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.nonzero_path_interleaving
statement:
theorem nonzero_path_interleaving {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (R S T : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (hRT : alphaLE R T)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (g : S.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj T.module) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving (stabilityRadius n ε)
      (R.module (k := k)) S.module) ∨
      Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving (stabilityRadius n ε)
        (S.module (k := k)) T.module)
proof:
:= by
  rcases nonzero_path_endpointClose hn R S T ε hRT f hf g hg with h | h
  · left
    exact ⟨interleavingOfEndpointClose R S (stabilityRadius n ε)
      (by simpa only [stabilityRadius_coe hn ε] using h)⟩
  · right
    exact ⟨interleavingOfEndpointClose S T (stabilityRadius n ε)
      (by simpa only [stabilityRadius_coe hn ε] using h)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.alphaValue_eq_sum
statement:
private theorem alphaValue_eq_sum {n : ℕ} (R : Rectangle n) :
    alphaValue R = ∑ i, ((R i).lower + (R i).upper)
proof:
:= by
  simp [alphaValue, endpoint, Fintype.sum_prod_type, add_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.cross_coordinate_bound
statement:
private theorem cross_coordinate_bound {n : ℕ} (R T : Rectangle n)
    (δ : ℝ) (hα : alphaValue R ≤ alphaValue T)
    (hl : ∀ i, (T i).lower ≤ (R i).lower + 2 * δ)
    (hu : ∀ i, (T i).upper ≤ (R i).upper + 2 * δ) (j : Fin n) :
    ((R j).upper - (R j).lower) + ((T j).upper - (T j).lower) ≤
      4 * ((n : ℝ) - 1) * δ + 2 * ((T j).upper - (R j).lower)
proof:
:= by
  have hb := sum_erase_bound
    (fun i => (R i).lower + (R i).upper)
    (fun i => (T i).lower + (T i).upper) (4 * δ)
    (fun i => by linarith [hl i, hu i]) j
  have hs : (∑ i, (((T i).lower + (T i).upper) -
      ((R i).lower + (R i).upper))) = alphaValue T - alphaValue R := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, alphaValue_eq_sum, alphaValue_eq_sum]
  have he := Finset.sum_erase_add (s := Finset.univ)
    (fun i => ((T i).lower + (T i).upper) - ((R i).lower + (R i).upper))
    (Finset.mem_univ j)
  rw [hs] at he
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hb
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleStabilityGeometry.nonzero_path_support
statement:
theorem nonzero_path_support {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (R S T : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (hRT : alphaLE R T)
    (hR : ∃ p, p ∈ R.support ∧
      translation (stabilityRadius n ε + stabilityRadius n ε) p ∈ R.support)
    (hT : ∃ p, p ∈ T.support ∧
      translation (stabilityRadius n ε + stabilityRadius n ε) p ∈ T.support)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (g : S.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj T.module) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    ∃ p, p ∈ R.support ∧ translation ε p ∈ S.support ∧
      translation (ε + ε) p ∈ T.support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨pR, hpR, hpR'⟩ := hR
  obtain ⟨pT, hpT, hpT'⟩ := hT
  let w : ℝ := 2 * (stabilityRadius n ε : ℝ)
  have hw : 2 * (ε : ℝ) ≤ w := by
    dsimp [w]
    rw [stabilityRadius_coe hn ε]
    have hn' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    nlinarith [ε.coe_nonneg]
  have hstepR (j : Fin n) := (R j).exists_mem_add_iff w (by
    dsimp [w]; positivity)
  have hstepT (j : Fin n) := (T j).exists_mem_add_iff w (by
    dsimp [w]; positivity)
  have hwidthR (j : Fin n) := (hstepR j).mp
    ⟨pR j, hpR j, by simpa [translation_apply, w, NNReal.coe_add, two_mul] using hpR' j⟩
  have hwidthT (j : Fin n) := (hstepT j).mp
    ⟨pT j, hpT j, by simpa [translation_apply, w, NNReal.coe_add, two_mul] using hpT' j⟩
  have hRf (j : Fin n × Bool) := shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds R S ε f hf j
  have hSg (j : Fin n × Bool) := shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds S T ε g hg j
  have hl (j : Fin n) : (T j).lower ≤ (R j).lower + 2 * (ε : ℝ) := by
    have h₁ := decoratedLE_value (hRf (j, false))
    have h₂ := decoratedLE_value (hSg (j, false))
    simp only [endpoint, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte] at h₁ h₂
    linarith
  have hu (j : Fin n) : (T j).upper ≤ (R j).upper + 2 * (ε : ℝ) := by
    have h₁ := decoratedLE_value (hRf (j, true))
    have h₂ := decoratedLE_value (hSg (j, true))
    simp only [endpoint, ↓reduceIte] at h₁ h₂
    linarith
  have hex (j : Fin n) : ∃ x, x ∈ (R j).support ∧
      x + 2 * (ε : ℝ) ∈ (T j).support := by
    have hr : w ≤ (R j).upper - (R j).lower :=
      (hwidthR j).elim le_of_lt (fun h => h.1.le)
    have ht : w ≤ (T j).upper - (T j).lower :=
      (hwidthT j).elim le_of_lt (fun h => h.1.le)
    have hb := cross_coordinate_bound R T (ε : ℝ)
      (hRT.elim le_of_lt (fun h => h.1.le)) hl hu j
    have hw' : w = (4 * (n : ℝ) - 2) * (ε : ℝ) := by
      dsimp [w]; rw [stabilityRadius_coe hn ε]; ring
    have hc : (R j).lower + 2 * (ε : ℝ) ≤ (T j).upper := by
      nlinarith [hw]
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hc with hc | hc
    · let x := ((R j).lower + (T j).upper - 2 * (ε : ℝ)) / 2
      refine ⟨x, ⟨Or.inl ?_, Or.inl ?_⟩, ⟨Or.inl ?_, Or.inl ?_⟩⟩ <;>
        dsimp [x] <;> linarith [hl j, hu j]
    · have hwr : w = (R j).upper - (R j).lower := by nlinarith
      have hwt : w = (T j).upper - (T j).lower := by nlinarith
      have hrclosed : (R j).lowerClosed = true := by
        rcases hwidthR j with h | h
        · exact False.elim (by linarith)
        · exact h.2.1
      have htclosed : (T j).upperClosed = true := by
        rcases hwidthT j with h | h
        · exact False.elim (by linarith)
        · exact h.2.2
      exact ⟨(R j).lower, interval_lower_mem_of_closed (R j) (hpR j) hrclosed,
        hc ▸ interval_upper_mem_of_closed (T j) (hpT j) htclosed⟩
  choose p hpR₀ hpT₀ using hex
  refine ⟨p, hpR₀, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    have hlo := lower_mem_of_bound (R j) (S j) (ε : ℝ) (hRf (j, false)) (hpR₀ j)
    have hup := upper_mem_of_bound (S j) (T j) (ε : ℝ) (hSg (j, true)) (hpT₀ j)
    constructor
    · simpa [translation_apply] using hlo
    · have he : p j + 2 * (ε : ℝ) - (ε : ℝ) = (translation ε p) j := by
        simp only [translation_apply]
        ring
      rw [he] at hup
      exact hup
  · intro j
    simpa [translation_apply, NNReal.coe_add, two_mul] using hpT₀ j

name: TDA.Persistence.quotient_finrank_le_of_surjective_subspace
statement:
private theorem quotient_finrank_le_of_surjective_subspace
    {X Y : Type w} [AddCommGroup X] [Module k X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module k Y]
    [FiniteDimensional k X] (E L : Submodule k X) (f : L →ₗ[k] Y)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hE : E.comap L.subtype ≤ LinearMap.ker f) :
    Module.finrank k Y ≤ Module.finrank k (X ⧸ E)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := E.comap L.subtype
  let g : L ⧸ Q →ₗ[k] Y := Q.liftQ f hE
  have hg : Function.Surjective g := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hf y
    exact ⟨Q.mkQ x, hx⟩
  let j : L ⧸ Q →ₗ[k] X ⧸ E := Q.mapQ E L.subtype le_rfl
  have hj : Function.Injective j := by
    apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
    exact Submodule.ker_liftQ_eq_bot _ _ _ (by
      intro x hx
      exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero E).mp hx)
  exact (LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_surjective hg).trans
    (LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hj)

name: TDA.Persistence.quotient_finrank_le_of_image
statement:
private theorem quotient_finrank_le_of_image
    {X Y : Type w} [AddCommGroup X] [Module k X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module k Y]
    (U E : Submodule k X) (V F : Submodule k Y) (f : X →ₗ[k] Y)
    [FiniteDimensional k U]
    (hV : V ≤ U.map f) (hE : E ⊓ V.comap f ≤ F.comap f) :
    Module.finrank k (V ⧸ F.comap V.subtype) ≤
      Module.finrank k (U ⧸ E.comap U.subtype)
proof:
:= by
  let L : Submodule k U := V.comap (f.comp U.subtype)
  let g : L →ₗ[k] V :=
    (f.comp (U.subtype.comp L.subtype)).codRestrict V (fun x => x.property)
  have hg : Function.Surjective g := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hV y.property
    refine ⟨⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · change f x ∈ V
      simpa only [hxy] using y.property
    · exact Subtype.ext hxy
  let q := (F.comap V.subtype).mkQ
  apply quotient_finrank_le_of_surjective_subspace (E.comap U.subtype) L (q.comp g)
    ((F.comap V.subtype).mkQ_surjective.comp hg)
  intro x hx
  change q (g x) = 0
  apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr
  exact hE ⟨hx, x.property⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.shifted_naturality
statement:
private theorem shifted_naturality (f : M ⟶ (RealShift.shift ε).obj N)
    {s t : ℝ} (h : s ≤ t) :
    (f.app t).hom.comp (structureMapLinear M h) =
      (structureMapLinear N (add_le_add h (le_refl (ε : ℝ)))).comp (f.app s).hom
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom (f.naturality (homOfLE h))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.crossing_factorization
statement:
theorem crossing_factorization (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) {b C : ℝ}
    (h : b + (ε : ℝ) ≤ C) :
    (i.ψ.app C).hom.comp
        ((structureMapLinear N h).comp (i.φ.app b).hom) =
      structureMapLinear M (show b ≤ C + (ε : ℝ) by
        have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith)
proof:
:= by
  erw [← LinearMap.comp_assoc, shifted_naturality i.ψ h,
    LinearMap.comp_assoc]
  have hi := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom (i.φ_ψ_structureMap b)
  change (i.ψ.app (b + (ε : ℝ))).hom.comp (i.φ.app b).hom = _ at hi
  erw [hi, ← structureMapLinear_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.crossing_to_shift
statement:
private theorem crossing_to_shift (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) {C d : ℝ}
    (h : C + (ε : ℝ) ≤ d) :
    (i.φ.app d).hom.comp
        ((structureMapLinear M h).comp (i.ψ.app C).hom) =
      structureMapLinear N (show C ≤ d + (ε : ℝ) by
        have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith)
proof:
:= by
  erw [← LinearMap.comp_assoc, shifted_naturality i.φ h,
    LinearMap.comp_assoc]
  have hi := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom (i.symm.φ_ψ_structureMap C)
  change (i.φ.app (C + (ε : ℝ))).hom.comp (i.ψ.app C).hom = _ at hi
  erw [hi, ← structureMapLinear_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.measure_box_shifted
statement:
private theorem measure_box_shifted (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)
    {A b C d : ℝ} (hab : A + (ε : ℝ) ≤ b) (hbc : b + (ε : ℝ) ≤ C)
    (hcd : C + (ε : ℝ) ≤ d)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage N hbc)] :
    persistenceMeasureValue M hab
        (show b ≤ C + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith) hcd ≤
      persistenceMeasureValue N
        (show A ≤ b + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith) hbc
        (show C ≤ d + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith)
proof:
:= by
  have hab' : A ≤ b + (ε : ℝ) := by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith
  have hbc' : b ≤ C + (ε : ℝ) := by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith
  have hcd' : C ≤ d + (ε : ℝ) := by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith
  have hAC : A ≤ C := hab'.trans hbc
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceKernel N hbc hcd') :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_left
  apply quotient_finrank_le_of_image
    (persistenceKernel N hbc hcd') (persistenceKernel N hAC hcd')
    (persistenceKernel M hbc' hcd) (persistenceKernel M (hab.trans hbc') hcd)
    (i.ψ.app C).hom
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hy.1
    let z := structureMapLinear N hbc ((i.φ.app b).hom x)
    have hz : (i.ψ.app C).hom z = y := by
      have hi := LinearMap.congr_fun (i.crossing_factorization hbc) x
      exact hi.trans hx
    refine ⟨z, ⟨⟨(i.φ.app b).hom x, rfl⟩, ?_⟩, hz⟩
    change structureMapLinear N hcd' z = 0
    have hd := LinearMap.congr_fun (i.crossing_to_shift hcd) z
    change (i.φ.app d).hom (structureMapLinear M hcd ((i.ψ.app C).hom z)) = _ at hd
    rw [hz, show structureMapLinear M hcd y = 0 from hy.2, map_zero] at hd
    exact hd.symm
  · intro z hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hz.1.1
    refine ⟨?_, hz.2.2⟩
    refine ⟨(i.ψ.app A).hom x, ?_⟩
    have hi := LinearMap.congr_fun (shifted_naturality i.ψ hAC) x
    change (i.ψ.app C).hom (structureMapLinear N hAC x) = _ at hi
    rw [hx] at hi
    exact hi.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.persistenceMeasureValue_box_le
statement:
theorem persistenceMeasureValue_box_le (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)
    {a b c d : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (hgap : b + (ε : ℝ) ≤ c - (ε : ℝ))
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage N hgap)] :
    persistenceMeasureValue M hab
        (show b ≤ c by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith) hcd ≤
      persistenceMeasureValue N
        (show a - (ε : ℝ) ≤ b + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith)
        hgap (show c - (ε : ℝ) ≤ d + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith)
proof:
:= by
  have h := i.measure_box_shifted
    (show (a - (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) ≤ b by simpa using hab) hgap
    (show (c - (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) ≤ d by simpa using hcd)
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.persistenceMeasureValue_box_le_of_qTame
statement:
theorem persistenceMeasureValue_box_le_of_qTame (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)
    (hN : N.QTame) {a b c d : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (hgap : 2 * (ε : ℝ) < c - b) :
    persistenceMeasureValue M hab
        (show b ≤ c by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith) hcd ≤
      persistenceMeasureValue N
        (show a - (ε : ℝ) ≤ b + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith)
        (show b + (ε : ℝ) ≤ c - (ε : ℝ) by linarith)
        (show c - (ε : ℝ) ≤ d + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith)
proof:
:= by
  have hcross : b + (ε : ℝ) < c - (ε : ℝ) := by linarith
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage N hcross.le) := hN _ _ hcross
  exact i.persistenceMeasureValue_box_le hab hcd hcross.le

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.quotientProjection_surjective
statement:
theorem quotientProjection_surjective (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (p : S) :
    Function.Surjective ((quotientProjection M).app p).hom
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (cokernel.π (firstEmbedding M)) := inferInstance
  have hEpi : Epi (quotientProjection M) := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π (firstEmbedding M))
    infer_instance
  have hApp : Epi ((quotientProjection M).app p) :=
    (NatTrans.epi_iff_epi_app (quotientProjection M)).mp hEpi p
  exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp hApp

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.quotient_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem quotient_finiteDimensional (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (p : S) :
    FiniteDimensional k ((quotient M).obj p)
proof:
:= by
  letI : FiniteDimensional k ((firstInjective M).obj p) :=
    FiniteInjectivePresentation.finiteDimensional M p
  exact FiniteDimensional.of_surjective ((quotientProjection M).app p).hom
    (quotientProjection_surjective M p)

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.differential_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem differential_eq (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    differential M = quotientProjection M ≫ secondEmbedding M
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.firstEmbedding_comp_differential
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem firstEmbedding_comp_differential
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    firstEmbedding M ≫ differential M = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : firstEmbedding M ≫ quotientProjection M = 0 := by
    change firstEmbedding M ≫ cokernel.π (firstEmbedding M) = 0
    exact cokernel.condition _
  calc
    firstEmbedding M ≫ differential M =
        (firstEmbedding M ≫ quotientProjection M) ≫ secondEmbedding M := by
          simp [differential, Category.assoc]
    _ = 0 := by rw [hzero, zero_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.firstInjective_injective
statement:
theorem firstInjective_injective (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) :
    Injective (firstInjective M)
proof: := inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.secondInjective_injective
statement:
theorem secondInjective_injective (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    Injective (secondInjective M)
proof: := inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.firstEmbedding_mono
statement:
theorem firstEmbedding_mono (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] : Mono (firstEmbedding M)
proof: := inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.secondEmbedding_mono
statement:
theorem secondEmbedding_mono (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] : Mono (secondEmbedding M)
proof:
:= by
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k ((quotient M).obj p) := quotient_finiteDimensional M
  exact FiniteInjectivePresentation.embedding_mono (quotient M)

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.firstEmbedding_π
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem firstEmbedding_π (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (t : Index M) :
    firstEmbedding M ≫ biproduct.π (family M) t = summandMap M t
proof:
:=
  embedding_π M t

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.firstEmbedding_π_app_val
statement:
theorem firstEmbedding_π_app_val (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (t : Index M) (q : S) (x : M.obj q) :
    (((biproduct.π (family M) t).app q).hom
      (((firstEmbedding M).app q).hom x) : k) =
      if h : q ≤ t.1 then coordinate M t.1 t.2 (structureMapLinear M h x) else 0
proof:
:=
  embedding_π_app_val M t q x

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.range_firstEmbedding_eq_ker_differential
statement:
theorem range_firstEmbedding_eq_ker_differential
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (p : S) :
    LinearMap.range ((firstEmbedding M).app p).hom =
      LinearMap.ker ((differential M).app p).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hrow := cokernelRow M
  have hmono : Function.Injective ((secondEmbedding M).app p).hom := by
    apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp
    exact (NatTrans.mono_iff_mono_app _).mp (secondEmbedding_mono M) p
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
    have hzero := congrArg (fun f => (f.app p).hom y)
      (cokernel.condition (firstEmbedding M))
    change ((quotientProjection M).app p).hom
      (((firstEmbedding M).app p).hom y) = 0 at hzero
    change ((secondEmbedding M).app p).hom
      (((quotientProjection M).app p).hom (((firstEmbedding M).app p).hom y)) = 0
    rw [hzero, map_zero]
  · intro hx
    have hπzero : ((quotientProjection M).app p).hom x = 0 := by
      apply hmono
      have hx' := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx
      have hcomp : ((differential M).app p).hom =
          ((secondEmbedding M).app p).hom.comp ((quotientProjection M).app p).hom := rfl
      rw [hcomp, LinearMap.comp_apply] at hx'
      rw [hx', map_zero]
    rw [hrow.range_eq_ker p]
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hπzero

name: TDA.Persistence.TwoInjectivePresentation.shortComplex_exact
statement:
theorem shortComplex_exact (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] : (shortComplex M).Exact
proof:
:= by
  let S' := shortComplex M
  apply S'.exact_iff_kernel_ι_comp_cokernel_π_zero.mpr
  ext p x
  have hzero : (S'.g.app p).hom (((kernel.ι S'.g).app p).hom x) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f => (f.app p).hom x) (kernel.condition S'.g)
    exact h
  have heq : LinearMap.range ((firstEmbedding M).app p).hom =
      LinearMap.ker (S'.g.app p).hom := by
    change LinearMap.range ((firstEmbedding M).app p).hom =
      LinearMap.ker ((differential M).app p).hom
    exact range_firstEmbedding_eq_ker_differential M p
  have hxker : ((kernel.ι S'.g).app p).hom x ∈ LinearMap.ker (S'.g.app p).hom :=
    LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hzero
  have hrange : ((kernel.ι S'.g).app p).hom x ∈
      LinearMap.range ((firstEmbedding M).app p).hom := by
    rw [← heq] at hxker
    exact hxker
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y : M.obj p,
      ((firstEmbedding M).app p).hom y = ((kernel.ι S'.g).app p).hom x := by
    exact (LinearMap.mem_range.mp hrange)
  change ((quotientProjection M).app p).hom (((kernel.ι S'.g).app p).hom x) = 0
  rw [← hy]
  have h := congrArg (fun f => (f.app p).hom y) (cokernel.condition (firstEmbedding M))
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialBirthSum_orderedQ
statement:
theorem essentialBirthSum_orderedQ (m n : ℕ) (z : DiagramCoordinates m n) :
    essentialBirthSum (orderedQ m n z) = ∑ i : Fin n, z.2 i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [essentialBirthSum, essentialPart_orderedQ]
  simp [List.sum_ofFn]

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialBirthSum_c1_all
statement:
theorem essentialBirthSum_c1_all (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    C1ThroughAllRepresentatives essentialBirthSum D
proof:
:= by
  intro m n z _
  refine ⟨Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.mem_univ z, ?_⟩
  apply contDiffOn_univ.mpr
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun w : DiagramCoordinates m n => ∑ i : Fin n, w.2 i) := by
    apply ContDiff.sum
    intro i _
    fun_prop
  simpa [Function.comp_def, essentialBirthSum_orderedQ] using hs

name: TDA.Persistence.singleton_essential_loss
statement:
theorem singleton_essential_loss (x : ℝ) :
    essentialBirthSum (dgm (ZMod 2) (Examples.singletonFilter x) 0) = x
proof:
:= by
  have hd : dgm (ZMod 2) (Examples.singletonFilter x) 0 =
      orderedQ 0 1 (Fin.elim0, fun _ => x) := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    rw [Examples.singleton_points]
    simp [orderedQ]
  rw [hd, essentialBirthSum_orderedQ]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.singleton_essential_loss_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem singleton_essential_loss_hasDerivAt (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ =>
      essentialBirthSum (dgm (ZMod 2) (Examples.singletonFilter t) 0)) 1 x
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (fun t : ℝ =>
      essentialBirthSum (dgm (ZMod 2) (Examples.singletonFilter t) 0)) =
      (fun t : ℝ => t) := by
    funext t
    exact singleton_essential_loss t
  rw [hf]
  exact hasDerivAt_id x

name: TDA.Persistence.singleton_essential_face_coefficient
statement:
theorem singleton_essential_face_coefficient :
    ∃ e : CompatibleOrder (Examples.singletonFilter (0 : ℝ)),
      ∀ s : TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)),
        faceLossCoefficient (ZMod 2) Examples.singletonFilter e 0
          essentialBirthSum s = 1
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℝ → FilterFunction (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) ℝ :=
    Examples.singletonFilter
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_compatibleOrder (F 0)
  have hF : ∀ s : TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)),
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x : ℝ => (F x).value s) Set.univ := by
    intro s
    change ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x : ℝ => x) Set.univ
    exact contDiffOn_id
  have horder : ∀ x ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ),
      OrderingEquivalent (F 0) (F x) := by
    intro x _ s t
    simp [F, Examples.singletonFilter]
  have hm : Fintype.card (TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) = 1 := by
    decide
  letI : Unique (TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) :=
    Classical.choice (Fintype.card_eq_one_iff_nonempty_unique.mp hm)
  have hD := sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_fderiv (ZMod 2) F e 0
    isOpen_univ (Set.mem_univ (0 : ℝ)) hF horder
    essentialBirthSum (essentialBirthSum_c1_all _)
  have hf : (fun x : ℝ => essentialBirthSum (dgm (ZMod 2) (F x) 0)) =
      (fun x : ℝ => x) := by
    funext x
    exact singleton_essential_loss x
  rw [hf] at hD
  refine ⟨e, fun s => ?_⟩
  have hs := congrArg (fun T : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ => T 1) hD
  have hsd : s = default := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst s
  have hface : fderiv ℝ (fun x : ℝ => (F x).value default) 0 1 = 1 := by
    change fderiv ℝ (fun x : ℝ => x) 0 1 = 1
    simp
  simpa [F, Finset.sum_apply, smul_apply, hface] using hs.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.signedCoordinateFunctional_apply
statement:
theorem signedCoordinateFunctional_apply (m n : ℕ)
    (z : DiagramCoordinates m n) :
    signedCoordinateFunctional m n z =
      ∑ i : Fin m, ((z.1 i).2 - (z.1 i).1)
proof:
:= by
