name: TDA.Persistence.signedFiniteEndpointDifference_fderiv_full
statement:
theorem signedFiniteEndpointDifference_fderiv_full (m n : ℕ)
    (z : DiagramCoordinates m n) :
    fderiv ℝ (signedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘ orderedQ m n) z =
      signedCoordinateFunctional m n
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (signedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘ orderedQ m n) =
      signedCoordinateFunctional m n := by
    funext w
    rw [Function.comp_apply, signedFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ,
      signedCoordinateFunctional_apply]
  rw [hf]
  exact (signedCoordinateFunctional m n).hasFDerivAt.fderiv

name: TDA.Persistence.signed_finite_birth_slot_coefficient
statement:
theorem signed_finite_birth_slot_coefficient
    {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V] {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    [Fintype (TotalFace K)] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {E : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (F : E → FilterFunction K ℝ) {x₀ : E}
    (e : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) (p : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (faceLiftCounts k F e p).1) :
    faceLossSlotCoefficient k F e p signedFiniteEndpointDifference (.inl (.inl i)) = -1
proof:
:= by
  unfold faceLossSlotCoefficient
  rw [signedFiniteEndpointDifference_fderiv_full]
  rw [signedCoordinateFunctional_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp [faceLossUnit, faceLossSlotPack]
  · intro j _ hji
    simp [faceLossUnit, faceLossSlotPack, hji]
  · intro hi
    exact (hi (Finset.mem_univ i)).elim

name: TDA.Persistence.signed_finite_death_slot_coefficient
statement:
theorem signed_finite_death_slot_coefficient
    {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V] {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    [Fintype (TotalFace K)] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {E : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (F : E → FilterFunction K ℝ) {x₀ : E}
    (e : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) (p : ℕ)
    (i : Fin (faceLiftCounts k F e p).1) :
    faceLossSlotCoefficient k F e p signedFiniteEndpointDifference (.inl (.inr i)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold faceLossSlotCoefficient
  rw [signedFiniteEndpointDifference_fderiv_full]
  rw [signedCoordinateFunctional_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
  · simp [faceLossUnit, faceLossSlotPack]
  · intro j _ hji
    simp [faceLossUnit, faceLossSlotPack, hji]
  · intro hi
    exact (hi (Finset.mem_univ i)).elim

name: TDA.Persistence.moving_tied_edge_signed_loss_zero
statement:
theorem moving_tied_edge_signed_loss_zero (x : ℝ) :
    signedFiniteEndpointDifference
      (dgm (ZMod 2) (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter x) 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, n, L, hL, _⟩ := Examples.moving_tied_edge_lift
  obtain ⟨hfactor, hdiag⟩ := hL x

name: TDA.Persistence.moving_tied_edge_signed_loss_hasDerivAt
statement:
theorem moving_tied_edge_signed_loss_hasDerivAt (x : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => signedFiniteEndpointDifference
      (dgm (ZMod 2) (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter t) 0)) 0 x
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (fun t : ℝ => signedFiniteEndpointDifference
      (dgm (ZMod 2) (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter t) 0)) =
      (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
    funext t

name: TDA.Persistence.moving_tied_edge_pair_contributions_cancel
statement:
theorem moving_tied_edge_pair_contributions_cancel
    (e : CompatibleOrder (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter (0 : ℝ)))
    (i : Fin (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1) :
    faceLossSlotCoefficient (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0
        signedFiniteEndpointDifference (.inl (.inl i)) *
      fderiv ℝ (fun x : ℝ => (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter x).value
        (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0
          (.inl (.inl i)))) 0 1 +
    faceLossSlotCoefficient (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0
        signedFiniteEndpointDifference (.inl (.inr i)) *
      fderiv ℝ (fun x : ℝ => (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter x).value
        (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0
          (.inl (.inr i)))) 0 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [signed_finite_birth_slot_coefficient,
    signed_finite_death_slot_coefficient]
  have hb : fderiv ℝ (fun x : ℝ => (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter x).value
      (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0
        (.inl (.inl i)))) 0 1 = 1 := by
    change fderiv ℝ (fun x : ℝ => x) 0 1 = 1
    simp
  have hd : fderiv ℝ (fun x : ℝ => (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter x).value
      (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0
        (.inl (.inr i)))) 0 1 = 1 := by
    change fderiv ℝ (fun x : ℝ => x) 0 1 = 1
    simp
  rw [hb, hd]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.moving_tied_edge_nonvacuous_cancellation
statement:
theorem moving_tied_edge_nonvacuous_cancellation :
    ∃ (e : CompatibleOrder (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter (0 : ℝ)))
      (i : Fin (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1),
      faceLossSlotCoefficient (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0
        signedFiniteEndpointDifference (.inl (.inl i)) = -1 ∧
      faceLossSlotCoefficient (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0
        signedFiniteEndpointDifference (.inl (.inr i)) = 1 ∧
      faceLossSlotCoefficient (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0
          signedFiniteEndpointDifference (.inl (.inl i)) *
        fderiv ℝ (fun x : ℝ => (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter x).value
          (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0
            (.inl (.inl i)))) 0 1 +
      faceLossSlotCoefficient (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0
          signedFiniteEndpointDifference (.inl (.inr i)) *
        fderiv ℝ (fun x : ℝ => (Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter x).value
          (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0
            (.inl (.inr i)))) 0 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, hpos⟩ := Examples.moving_tied_edge_has_finite_slot
  let i : Fin (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) Examples.movingTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1 :=
    ⟨0, hpos⟩
  exact ⟨e, i, signed_finite_birth_slot_coefficient _ _ e 0 i,
    signed_finite_death_slot_coefficient _ _ e 0 i,
    moving_tied_edge_pair_contributions_cancel e i⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdgeBox_bounds
statement:
private theorem nonlinearEdgeBox_bounds (x : ℝ × ℝ) (hx : x ∈ nonlinearEdgeBox) :
    0 < 1 + x.1 ∧ 1 + x.1 < 3 + x.2 + x.1 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hs, ht⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨hs₁, hs₂⟩ := abs_lt.mp hs
  obtain ⟨ht₁, ht₂⟩ := abs_lt.mp ht
  constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg x.1]

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdgeFilter_value
statement:
private theorem nonlinearEdgeFilter_value (x : ℝ × ℝ) (hx : x ∈ nonlinearEdgeBox)
    (s : TotalFace edgeK) :
    (nonlinearEdgeFilter x).value s =
      if s.val = ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) then 0
      else if s.val = ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) then 1 + x.1
      else 3 + x.2 + x.1 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hb, hd⟩ := nonlinearEdgeBox_bounds x hx
  simp only [nonlinearEdgeFilter, max_eq_right hd.le,
    max_eq_right (le_trans hb.le hd.le)]

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdgeFilter_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem nonlinearEdgeFilter_contDiffOn (σ : TotalFace edgeK) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (nonlinearEdgeFilter x).value σ) nonlinearEdgeBox
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun x : ℝ × ℝ =>
      if σ.val = ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) then 0
      else if σ.val = ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) then 1 + x.1
      else 3 + x.2 + x.1 ^ 2) := by
    split_ifs <;> fun_prop
  apply hs.contDiffOn.congr
  intro x hx
  exact nonlinearEdgeFilter_value x hx σ

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdgeFilter_ordering
statement:
theorem nonlinearEdgeFilter_ordering (x y : ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : x ∈ nonlinearEdgeBox) (hy : y ∈ nonlinearEdgeBox) :
    OrderingEquivalent (nonlinearEdgeFilter x) (nonlinearEdgeFilter y)
proof:
:= by
  intro σ τ
  rw [nonlinearEdgeFilter_value x hx σ, nonlinearEdgeFilter_value x hx τ,
    nonlinearEdgeFilter_value y hy σ, nonlinearEdgeFilter_value y hy τ]
  obtain ⟨hb, hd⟩ := nonlinearEdgeBox_bounds x hx
  obtain ⟨hb', hd'⟩ := nonlinearEdgeBox_bounds y hy
  rcases edge_face_cases σ with hσ | hσ | hσ <;>
    rcases edge_face_cases τ with hτ | hτ | hτ <;>
    norm_num [hσ, hτ, Finset.ext_iff] <;> constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdgeFilter_points
statement:
theorem nonlinearEdgeFilter_points (x : ℝ × ℝ) (hx : x ∈ nonlinearEdgeBox) :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearEdgeFilter x) 0).points =
      ({(0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)),
        (1 + x.1, ((3 + x.2 + x.1 ^ 2 : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ))} :
        Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun a => if a = 2 then 0 else if a = 5 then 1 + x.1
    else 3 + x.2 + x.1 ^ 2
  have hφ : StrictMonoOn φ (Set.range edgeFilter.value) := by
    rintro a ⟨σ, rfl⟩ b ⟨τ, rfl⟩ hlt
    obtain ⟨hb, hd⟩ := nonlinearEdgeBox_bounds x hx
    rcases edge_face_cases σ with hσ | hσ | hσ <;>
      rcases edge_face_cases τ with hτ | hτ | hτ <;>
      norm_num [edgeFilter, hσ, hτ, φ, Finset.ext_iff] at hlt <;>
      norm_num [edgeFilter, hσ, hτ, φ, Finset.ext_iff]
    all_goals linarith
  have hvalue : ∀ s : TotalFace edgeK,
      (nonlinearEdgeFilter x).value s = φ (edgeFilter.value s) := by
    intro s
    rw [nonlinearEdgeFilter_value x hx]
    rcases edge_face_cases s with hs | hs | hs <;>
      norm_num [edgeFilter, hs, φ, Finset.ext_iff]
  rw [dgm_points_map_of_strictMonoOn (ZMod 2) edgeFilter
    (nonlinearEdgeFilter x) φ hφ hvalue 0, edge_points]
  norm_num [φ]

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdgeCoordinates_faces
statement:
theorem nonlinearEdgeCoordinates_faces (x : ℝ × ℝ) (hx : x ∈ nonlinearEdgeBox) :

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdgeCoordinates_factorization
statement:
theorem nonlinearEdgeCoordinates_factorization (x : ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : x ∈ nonlinearEdgeBox) :
    dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearEdgeFilter x) 0 =
      orderedQ 1 1 (nonlinearEdgeCoordinates x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  rw [nonlinearEdgeFilter_points x hx]
  have hne := ne_of_lt (nonlinearEdgeBox_bounds x hx).2
  simp only [orderedQ, nonlinearEdgeCoordinates]
  simp [hne]
  exact Multiset.pair_comm _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdgeCoordinates_expansion

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdgeCoordinates_hasFDerivAt
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasFDerivAt (x := x)
  have hsq := (hs.mul hs).smul_const edgeDeathUnit
  have hh := ((hasFDerivAt_const (nonlinearEdgeCoordinates 0) x).add
    edgeLinearCoordinates.hasFDerivAt).add hsq
  have heq : (fun y : ℝ × ℝ => nonlinearEdgeCoordinates 0 +
      edgeLinearCoordinates y + (y.1 * y.1) • edgeDeathUnit) = nonlinearEdgeCoordinates := by
    funext y
    simpa [pow_two] using (nonlinearEdgeCoordinates_expansion y).symm
  change HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ × ℝ => nonlinearEdgeCoordinates 0 +
    edgeLinearCoordinates y + (y.1 * y.1) • edgeDeathUnit) _ x at hh
  rw [heq] at hh
  convert hh using 1 <;> ext h <;>
    simp [edgeDeathDirection, edgeDeathUnit, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply]
  all_goals ring

  (nonlinearEdgeCoordinates_hasFDerivAt x).fderiv

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdgeCoordinates_second_fderiv
proof:
:= by
  have hs := ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ ℝ).hasFDerivAt (x := x)).const_mul 2
  have hh := (hasFDerivAt_const edgeLinearCoordinates x).add
    (hs.smul_const edgeDeathDirection)
  have heq : (fun y : ℝ × ℝ => edgeLinearCoordinates +
      (2 * y.1) • edgeDeathDirection) = fderiv ℝ nonlinearEdgeCoordinates := by
    funext y
    exact (nonlinearEdgeCoordinates_fderiv y).symm
  change HasFDerivAt (fun y : ℝ × ℝ => edgeLinearCoordinates +
    (2 * y.1) • edgeDeathDirection) _ x at hh
  rw [heq] at hh
  simpa using hh.fderiv

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdge_squared_loss

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdge_coordinate_hessian
statement:
theorem nonlinearEdge_coordinate_hessian (h k : ℝ × ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘ orderedQ 1 1))
      (nonlinearEdgeCoordinates 0)
      (fderiv ℝ nonlinearEdgeCoordinates 0 h)
      (fderiv ℝ nonlinearEdgeCoordinates 0 k) =
      2 * (h.2 - h.1) * (k.2 - k.1)

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdge_curvature_hessian

      (nonlinearEdgeCoordinates 0)
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ nonlinearEdgeCoordinates) 0 h k) =
      8 * h.1 * k.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [(squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_hasFDerivAt 1 1
    (nonlinearEdgeCoordinates 0)).fderiv, nonlinearEdgeCoordinates_second_fderiv]
  simp [signedCoordinateFunctional_apply, nonlinearEdgeCoordinates,
    edgeDeathDirection, edgeDeathUnit]

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdge_squared_loss_hasFDerivAt_fderiv

theorem nonlinearEdge_squared_loss_hasFDerivAt_fderiv :

      (fun x => dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearEdgeFilter x) 0)))
      (secondDerivativeChain (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘ orderedQ 1 1)
        nonlinearEdgeCoordinates 0) 0
proof:
:= by

    nonlinearEdgeBox_zero (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_c2_all _)

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdge_squared_loss_hessian
statement:
theorem nonlinearEdge_squared_loss_hessian (h k : ℝ × ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘
      (fun x => dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearEdgeFilter x) 0))) 0 h k =
      2 * (h.2 - h.1) * (k.2 - k.1) + 8 * h.1 * k.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [nonlinearEdge_squared_loss_hasFDerivAt_fderiv.fderiv,
    secondDerivativeChain_apply, nonlinearEdge_coordinate_hessian,
    nonlinearEdge_curvature_hessian]

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdge_squared_loss_hessian_entries
statement:
theorem nonlinearEdge_squared_loss_hessian_entries :
    let B := fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘
      (fun x => dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearEdgeFilter x) 0))) (0 : ℝ × ℝ)
    B (1, 0) (1, 0) = 10 ∧ B (1, 0) (0, 1) = -2 ∧
      B (0, 1) (1, 0) = -2 ∧ B (0, 1) (0, 1) = 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [nonlinearEdge_squared_loss_hessian]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.LossExamples.nonlinearEdge_hessian_contribution_entries

name: TDA.Persistence.prepEmptyOrdering
proof:
:= by
  intro s _
  exact ((mem_bot_iff s.val).mp s.property).elim

name: TDA.Persistence.f0_empty_common
statement:
private theorem f0_empty_common (V : Type u) [LinearOrder V]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (α : Type v) (β : Type w)
    [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β] (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ E : Multiset (TotalFace (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) ×
        Option (TotalFace (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V))),
      E = 0 ∧
      (dgm k (prepEmptyFilter V α) n).points = E.map (fun p =>
        ((prepEmptyFilter V α).value p.1,
          p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop α)
            (fun t => ((prepEmptyFilter V α).value t : WithTop α)))) ∧
      (dgm k (prepEmptyFilter V β) n).points = E.map (fun p =>
        ((prepEmptyFilter V β).value p.1,
          p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop β)
            (fun t => ((prepEmptyFilter V β).value t : WithTop β))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hf, hg⟩ := dgm_common_face_endpoints_of_orderingEquivalent k
    (prepEmptyFilter V α) (prepEmptyFilter V β) (prepEmptyOrdering V α β) n
  have hz : E = 0 := by
    apply Multiset.eq_zero_of_forall_notMem
    intro p _
    exact ((mem_bot_iff p.1.val).mp p.1.property).elim
  exact ⟨E, hz, hf, hg⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.f0_empty_diagrams
statement:
private theorem f0_empty_diagrams (V : Type u) [LinearOrder V]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (α : Type v) (β : Type w)
    [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β] (n : ℕ) :
    (dgm k (prepEmptyFilter V α) n).points = 0 ∧
      (dgm k (prepEmptyFilter V β) n).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hf, hg⟩ := f0_empty_common V k α β n
  subst E
  simpa using And.intro hf hg

name: TDA.Persistence.f0_inhabited_to_empty
proof:
:=
  f0_empty_diagrams (Fin 2) (ZMod 2) ℚ Empty n

name: TDA.Persistence.f0_empty_domain_phi
statement:
private theorem f0_empty_domain_phi (n : ℕ) :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) (prepEmptyFilter (Fin 2) ℚ) n).points =
      (dgm (ZMod 2) (prepEmptyFilter (Fin 2) Empty) n).points.map
        (fun p => ((Empty.elim p.1 : ℚ), WithTop.map (Empty.elim : Empty → ℚ) p.2))
proof:
:= by
  apply dgm_points_map_of_strictMonoOn (ZMod 2)
    (prepEmptyFilter (Fin 2) Empty) (prepEmptyFilter (Fin 2) ℚ)
    (Empty.elim : Empty → ℚ)
  · intro a
    exact a.elim
  · intro s
    exact ((mem_bot_iff s.val).mp s.property).elim

name: TDA.Persistence.prepEdgeFaceCases
statement:
private theorem prepEdgeFaceCases (s : TotalFace prepEdgeK) :
    s.val = ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∨
    s.val = ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∨
    s.val = ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2))
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ t : Finset (Fin 2), t.Nonempty →
      t = ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∨ t = ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∨
      t = ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2)) := by decide
  exact h s.val s.property

name: TDA.Persistence.prepEdgeValues
statement:
private theorem prepEdgeValues :
    prepEdgeSource.value prepEdgeV0 = 2 ∧
    prepEdgeSource.value prepEdgeV1 = 5 ∧
    prepEdgeSource.value prepEdgeE01 = 9 ∧
    prepEdgeTarget.value prepEdgeV0 = 3 ∧
    prepEdgeTarget.value prepEdgeV1 = 6 ∧
    prepEdgeTarget.value prepEdgeE01 = 10
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [prepEdgeSource, prepEdgeTarget, prepEdgeV0, prepEdgeV1, prepEdgeE01,
    Finset.ext_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.prepEdgeRange
statement: private theorem prepEdgeRange : Set.range prepEdgeSource.value = ({2, 5, 9} : Set ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    rcases prepEdgeFaceCases s with h | h | h <;>
      norm_num [prepEdgeSource, h, Finset.ext_iff]
  · intro hb
    simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hb
    rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨prepEdgeV0, prepEdgeValues.1⟩
    · exact ⟨prepEdgeV1, prepEdgeValues.2.1⟩
    · exact ⟨prepEdgeE01, prepEdgeValues.2.2.1⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.f3_support_strict
statement: private theorem f3_support_strict : StrictMonoOn prepSupportPhi (Set.range prepEdgeSource.value)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prepEdgeRange]
  intro a ha b hb hab
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha hb
  rcases ha with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    norm_num [prepSupportPhi] at *

name: TDA.Persistence.f3_away_collision
statement: private theorem f3_away_collision : prepSupportPhi 0 = prepSupportPhi 1
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [prepSupportPhi]

name: TDA.Persistence.f3_not_global_monotone
statement: private theorem f3_not_global_monotone : ¬ Monotone prepSupportPhi
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := h (show (2 : ℚ) ≤ 3 by norm_num)
  norm_num [prepSupportPhi] at hc

name: TDA.Persistence.f3_value_transport
statement:
private theorem f3_value_transport (s : TotalFace prepEdgeK) :
    prepEdgeTarget.value s = prepSupportPhi (prepEdgeSource.value s)
proof:
:= by
  rcases prepEdgeFaceCases s with h | h | h <;>
    norm_num [prepEdgeSource, prepEdgeTarget, prepSupportPhi, h, Finset.ext_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.f3_ordering
statement: private theorem f3_ordering : OrderingEquivalent prepEdgeSource prepEdgeTarget
proof:
:= by
  intro s t
  rw [f3_value_transport s, f3_value_transport t]
  exact (f3_support_strict.le_iff_le ⟨s, rfl⟩ ⟨t, rfl⟩).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.f3_common_face_endpoints
statement:
private theorem f3_common_face_endpoints (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ E : Multiset (TotalFace prepEdgeK × Option (TotalFace prepEdgeK)),
      (dgm (ZMod 2) prepEdgeSource n).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (prepEdgeSource.value p.1, p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)
          (fun t => (prepEdgeSource.value t : WithTop ℚ)))) ∧
      (dgm (ZMod 2) prepEdgeTarget n).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (prepEdgeTarget.value p.1, p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)
          (fun t => (prepEdgeTarget.value t : WithTop ℚ))))
proof:
:=
  dgm_common_face_endpoints_of_orderingEquivalent (ZMod 2)
    prepEdgeSource prepEdgeTarget f3_ordering n

name: TDA.Persistence.f3_points_map
statement:
private theorem f3_points_map (n : ℕ) :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) prepEdgeTarget n).points =
      (dgm (ZMod 2) prepEdgeSource n).points.map
        (fun p => (prepSupportPhi p.1, WithTop.map prepSupportPhi p.2))
proof:
:=
  dgm_points_map_of_strictMonoOn (ZMod 2) prepEdgeSource prepEdgeTarget
    prepSupportPhi f3_support_strict f3_value_transport n

name: TDA.Persistence.f3_ambient_threshold_failure
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hm : prepEdgeV0.val ∈ prepEdgeSource.sublevel 3 := by
      apply (prepEdgeSource.mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem 3 prepEdgeV0).mpr
      rw [prepEdgeValues.1]
      norm_num
    rw [h] at hm
    exact (mem_bot_iff _).mp hm
  · apply prepEdgeTarget.sublevel_eq_bot_of_forall_lt
    intro s
    rcases prepEdgeFaceCases s with h | h | h <;>
      norm_num [prepEdgeTarget, prepSupportPhi, h, Finset.ext_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.f5_generic_common
statement:
private theorem f5_generic_common {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {α : Type v} {β : Type w}
    [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β] {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    [Fintype (TotalFace K)] (f : FilterFunction K α) (g : FilterFunction K β)
    (hfg : OrderingEquivalent f g) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ E : Multiset (TotalFace K × Option (TotalFace K)),
      (dgm k f n).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (f.value p.1, p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop α) (fun t => (f.value t : WithTop α)))) ∧
      (dgm k g n).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (g.value p.1, p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop β) (fun t => (g.value t : WithTop β))))
proof:
:=
  dgm_common_face_endpoints_of_orderingEquivalent k f g hfg n

name: TDA.Persistence.f5_generic_points_map
statement:
private theorem f5_generic_points_map {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {α : Type v} {β : Type w}
    [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β] {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    [Fintype (TotalFace K)] (f : FilterFunction K α) (g : FilterFunction K β)
    (φ : α → β) (hφ : StrictMonoOn φ (Set.range f.value))
    (hvalue : ∀ s : TotalFace K, g.value s = φ (f.value s)) (n : ℕ) :
    (dgm k g n).points = (dgm k f n).points.map
      (fun p => (φ p.1, WithTop.map φ p.2))
proof:
:=
  dgm_points_map_of_strictMonoOn k f g φ hφ hvalue n

name: TDA.Persistence.f5_lifted_strict
statement:
private theorem f5_lifted_strict :
    StrictMonoOn f5_lifted_phi.{v,w} (Set.range f5_lifted_source.{v}.value)
proof:
:= by
  intro a _ b _ hab
  change a.down + 1 < b.down + 1
  have hab' : a.down < b.down := hab
  simpa only [add_comm] using add_lt_add_right hab' (1 : ℚ)

name: TDA.Persistence.f5_lifted_value
statement:
private theorem f5_lifted_value (s : TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) :
    f5_lifted_target.{w}.value s = f5_lifted_phi.{v,w} (f5_lifted_source.{v}.value s)
proof:
:= by
  apply ULift.ext
  norm_num [f5_lifted_target, f5_lifted_phi, f5_lifted_source]

name: TDA.Persistence.f5_nonempty_face
statement:
private theorem f5_nonempty_face :
    Nonempty (TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨{0}, (mem_singletonFace_iff _ _).mpr rfl⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.f5_lifted_ordering

name: TDA.Persistence.f5_lifted_common
statement:
private theorem f5_lifted_common (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ E : Multiset (TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) ×
        Option (TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)))),
      (dgm (ZMod 2) f5_lifted_source.{v} n).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (f5_lifted_source.{v}.value p.1,
          p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop (ULift.{v} ℚ))
            (fun t => (f5_lifted_source.{v}.value t : WithTop (ULift.{v} ℚ))))) ∧
      (dgm (ZMod 2) f5_lifted_target.{w} n).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (f5_lifted_target.{w}.value p.1,

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_constant_critical
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues, Finset.mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, h⟩
    exact h.symm
  · intro h
    subst x
    exact ⟨s, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_constant_card
proof:
:= by
  rw [f1_constant_critical s b]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_constant_value
statement:
private theorem f1_constant_value {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)}
    [Fintype (TotalFace K)] (s : TotalFace K) (b : ℚ)
    (i : Fin (f1_constant K b).criticalValues.card) :
    (f1_constant K b).criticalValue i = b
proof:
:= by
  have h := (f1_constant K b).criticalValue_mem i
  simpa only [f1_constant_critical s b, Finset.mem_singleton] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_constant_stage
statement:
private theorem f1_constant_stage {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)}
    [Fintype (TotalFace K)] (s : TotalFace K) (b : ℚ)
    (i : Fin (f1_constant K b).criticalValues.card) :
    (f1_constant K b).gradeFiltration i = K
proof:
:= by
  rw [FilterFunction.gradeFiltration_apply, f1_constant_value s b i]
  apply le_antisymm ((f1_constant K b).sublevel_le b)
  intro t ht
  exact ((f1_constant K b).mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem b ⟨t, ht⟩).mpr le_rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_constant_barcode
statement:
private theorem f1_constant_barcode {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)}
    [Fintype (TotalFace K)] (s : TotalFace K) (b : ℚ) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialHomology K (ZMod 2) 0) = d) :
    gradeHomologyBarcode (ZMod 2) (f1_constant K b) 0 =
      Multiset.replicate d (f1_constant_bar s b)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    gradeHomologyBarcode (ZMod 2) (f1_constant K b) 0 =
        rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ZMod 2)
          (Multiset.replicate d (f1_constant_bar s b))) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff
        (simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2) (f1_constant K b).gradeFiltration 0)
        (barcodeModule (k := ZMod 2)
          (Multiset.replicate d (f1_constant_bar s b)))).mpr
      intro i j hij
      have hc := f1_constant_card s b
      have hi : i.val = 0 := by have := i.isLt; omega
      have hj : j.val = 0 := by have := j.isLt; omega
      have he : j = i := Fin.ext (hj.trans hi.symm)
      subst j
      have hr : structureMapRank
          (simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2) (f1_constant K b).gradeFiltration 0)
          i i hij = d := by
        unfold structureMapRank
        rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top,
          simplicialHomologyPModule_obj, f1_constant_stage s b i]
        exact hd
      rw [hr, rank_barcodeMap]
      symm
      calc
        _ = (Multiset.replicate d (f1_constant_bar s b)).card := by
          apply Multiset.countP_eq_card.mpr
          intro I hI
          have heI : I = f1_constant_bar s b := Multiset.eq_of_mem_replicate hI
          rw [heI]
          simp [f1_constant_bar, hi]
        _ = d := Multiset.card_replicate _ _
    _ = _ := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_constant_points
statement:
private theorem f1_constant_points {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)}
    [Fintype (TotalFace K)] (s : TotalFace K) (b : ℚ) (d : ℕ)
    (hd : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialHomology K (ZMod 2) 0) = d) :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) (f1_constant K b) 0).points =
      Multiset.replicate d (b, (⊤ : WithTop ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dgm, f1_constant_barcode s b d hd]
  change (Multiset.replicate d (f1_constant_bar s b)).map
    (fun I => ((f1_constant K b).criticalValue
      ⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩,
      if hd' : I.death < (f1_constant K b).criticalValues.card then
        ((f1_constant K b).criticalValue ⟨I.death, hd'⟩ : WithTop ℚ)
      else (⊤ : WithTop ℚ))) = _
  simp [Multiset.map_replicate, f1_constant_bar, f1_constant_card s b,
    f1_constant_value s b]

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_dimension
proof:
:=
  (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv (ZMod 2) (0 : Fin 2)).finrank_eq.trans
    (Module.finrank_self (ZMod 2))

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_source_points
proof:
:= by
  simpa [f1_source] using f1_constant_points f1_face 2 1 f1_dimension

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_target_points
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_no_finite

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_ordering

proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_strict
statement: private theorem f1_strict : StrictMonoOn f1_phi (Set.range f1_source.value)

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_value

proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_common
statement:
private theorem f1_common :
    ∃ E : Multiset (TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) ×
        Option (TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)))),
      (dgm (ZMod 2) f1_source 0).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (f1_source.value p.1, p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)
          (fun t => (f1_source.value t : WithTop ℚ)))) ∧
      (dgm (ZMod 2) f1_target 0).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (f1_target.value p.1, p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)
          (fun t => (f1_target.value t : WithTop ℚ))))

    f1_source f1_target f1_ordering 0

name: TDA.Persistence.f1_points_map
statement:
private theorem f1_points_map :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) f1_target 0).points =
      (dgm (ZMod 2) f1_source 0).points.map
        (fun p => (f1_phi p.1, WithTop.map f1_phi p.2))

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_mem
statement:
private theorem f4_mem (s : Finset (Fin 2)) :
    s ∈ f4_K ↔ s = {0} ∨ s = {1}
proof:
:= by
  change s ∈ singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) ∨ s ∈ singletonFace (1 : Fin 2) ↔ _
  rw [mem_singletonFace_iff, mem_singletonFace_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_vertices_card
statement: private theorem f4_vertices_card : Fintype.card (Face f4_K 0) = 2
proof: := by decide

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_short_f_zero
statement:
private theorem f4_short_f_zero :
    ((simplicialChainComplex f4_K (ZMod 2)).sc 0).f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (simplicialChainComplex f4_K (ZMod 2)).d 1 0 = 0 := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    ext c
    change (boundary f4_K (ZMod 2) 0) c = 0
    have hc : c = 0 := by
      change Chain f4_K (ZMod 2) 1 at c
      exact Subsingleton.elim c 0
    rw [hc]
    exact map_zero _
  change (simplicialChainComplex f4_K (ZMod 2)).d
    ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev 0) 0 = 0
  rw [ChainComplex.prev]
  exact hf

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_short_g_zero
statement:
private theorem f4_short_g_zero :
    ((simplicialChainComplex f4_K (ZMod 2)).sc 0).g = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (simplicialChainComplex f4_K (ZMod 2)).d
    0 ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).next 0) = 0
  rw [ChainComplex.next_nat_zero]
  exact simplicialChainComplex_d_zero f4_K (ZMod 2) 0

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_dimension
statement:
private theorem f4_dimension :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialHomology f4_K (ZMod 2) 0) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [f4_H0_equiv.finrank_eq]
  rw [Module.finrank_finsupp_self]
  exact f4_vertices_card

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_rank
proof:
:= by
  change structureMapRank
    (simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2) f4_source.gradeFiltration 0) i j hij = 2
  have hc : f4_source.criticalValues.card = 1 := f1_constant_card f4_face 2
  have he : j = i := by
    apply Fin.ext
    have hi := i.isLt
    have hj := j.isLt
    omega
  subst j
  unfold structureMapRank
  rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top,
    simplicialHomologyPModule_obj]
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
    (simplicialHomology ((f1_constant f4_K 2).gradeFiltration i) (ZMod 2) 0) = 2
  rw [f1_constant_stage f4_face 2 i]
  exact f4_dimension

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_source_points
statement:
private theorem f4_source_points :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) f4_source 0).points =
      ({((2 : ℚ), (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)), ((2 : ℚ), (⊤ : WithTop ℚ))} :
        Multiset (ℚ × WithTop ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [f4_source, Multiset.replicate_succ] using
    f1_constant_points f4_face 2 2 f4_dimension

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_target_points
statement:
private theorem f4_target_points :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) f4_target 0).points =
      ({((3 : ℚ), (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)), ((3 : ℚ), (⊤ : WithTop ℚ))} :
        Multiset (ℚ × WithTop ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [f4_target, Multiset.replicate_succ] using
    f1_constant_points f4_face 3 2 f4_dimension

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_counts

:= by
  rw [f4_source_points, f4_target_points]

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_moving_points
statement:
private theorem f4_moving_points (x : ℝ) :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) (f4_moving x) 0).points =
      ({(2 + x, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)), (2 + x, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))} :
        Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  have hmap := dgm_points_map_of_strictMonoOn (ZMod 2)
    f4_source (f4_moving x) (fun q : ℚ => (q : ℝ) + x)
    (by intro a _ b _ hab; simpa [add_comm] using (add_lt_add_right (show (a : ℝ) < (b : ℝ) by exact_mod_cast hab) x))
    (by intro s; simp [f4_source, f1_constant, f4_moving]) 0
  rw [hmap, f4_source_points]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_moving_smooth_lift
statement:
private theorem f4_moving_smooth_lift :
    ∃ (m l : ℕ) (L : ℝ → (Fin m → ℝ × ℝ) × (Fin l → ℝ)),
      (∀ x : ℝ, dgm (ZMod 2) (f4_moving x) 0 = orderedQ m l (L x) ∧
        (dgm (ZMod 2) (f4_moving x) 0).points.count
          (2 + x, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) = 2) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 L Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  have hF : ∀ s : TotalFace f4_K,
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x : ℝ => (f4_moving x).value s) Set.univ := by
    intro s
    change ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x : ℝ => 2 + x) Set.univ
    exact contDiffOn_const.add contDiffOn_id
  have horder : ∀ x ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ),
      OrderingEquivalent (f4_moving 0) (f4_moving x) := by
    intro x _ s t
    simp [f4_moving]
  obtain ⟨m, l, L, hfactor, hsmooth⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_face_lift (ZMod 2) f4_moving
      (x₀ := 0) isOpen_univ (Set.mem_univ 0) hF horder 0
  refine ⟨m, l, L, ?_, hsmooth⟩
  intro x
  constructor
  · exact hfactor x (Set.mem_univ x)
  · rw [f4_moving_points]
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_no_finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [f4_source_points, f4_target_points]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_ordering
statement: private theorem f4_ordering : OrderingEquivalent f4_source f4_target
proof:
:= by
  intro s t
  constructor <;> intro _ <;> exact le_rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_strict
statement: private theorem f4_strict : StrictMonoOn f1_phi (Set.range f4_source.value)
proof:
:= by
  intro a _ b _ hab
  simpa only [f1_phi, add_comm] using add_lt_add_right hab (1 : ℚ)

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_value
statement:
private theorem f4_value (s : TotalFace f4_K) :
    f4_target.value s = f1_phi (f4_source.value s)
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [f4_source, f4_target, f1_constant, f1_phi]

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_common
statement:
private theorem f4_common :
    ∃ E : Multiset (TotalFace f4_K × Option (TotalFace f4_K)),
      (dgm (ZMod 2) f4_source 0).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (f4_source.value p.1, p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)
          (fun t => (f4_source.value t : WithTop ℚ)))) ∧
      (dgm (ZMod 2) f4_target 0).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (f4_target.value p.1, p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)
          (fun t => (f4_target.value t : WithTop ℚ))))
proof:
:=
  dgm_common_face_endpoints_of_orderingEquivalent (ZMod 2)
    f4_source f4_target f4_ordering 0

name: TDA.Persistence.f4_points_map
statement:
private theorem f4_points_map :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) f4_target 0).points =
      (dgm (ZMod 2) f4_source 0).points.map
        (fun p => (f1_phi p.1, WithTop.map f1_phi p.2))
proof:
:=
  dgm_points_map_of_strictMonoOn (ZMod 2) f4_source f4_target
    f1_phi f4_strict f4_value 0

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_values
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_values :
    prepEdgeSource.value prepEdgeV0 = 2 ∧
    prepEdgeSource.value prepEdgeV1 = 5 ∧
    prepEdgeSource.value prepEdgeE01 = 9
proof:
:=
  ⟨prepEdgeValues.1, prepEdgeValues.2.1, prepEdgeValues.2.2.1⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_critical_set
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_critical_set :
    prepEdgeSource.criticalValues = ({2, 5, 9} : Finset ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  constructor
  · intro hb
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := (prepEdgeSource.mem_criticalValues b).1 hb
    rcases prepEdgeFaceCases σ with h | h | h <;>
      simp [prepEdgeSource, h, Finset.ext_iff] at hσ ⊢
    all_goals (subst b; simp_all)
  · intro hb
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hb
    rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact (prepEdgeSource.mem_criticalValues 2).2 ⟨prepEdgeV0, f2_edge_values.1⟩
    · exact (prepEdgeSource.mem_criticalValues 5).2 ⟨prepEdgeV1, f2_edge_values.2.1⟩
    · exact (prepEdgeSource.mem_criticalValues 9).2 ⟨prepEdgeE01, f2_edge_values.2.2⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_card
statement: private theorem f2_edge_card : prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card = 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [f2_edge_critical_set]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_critical
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_critical :
    prepEdgeSource.criticalValue f2_edge_i0 = 2 ∧
    prepEdgeSource.criticalValue f2_edge_i1 = 5 ∧
    prepEdgeSource.criticalValue f2_edge_i2 = 9
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := prepEdgeSource.criticalValue_mem f2_edge_i0
  have h1 := prepEdgeSource.criticalValue_mem f2_edge_i1
  have h2 := prepEdgeSource.criticalValue_mem f2_edge_i2
  have h01 : prepEdgeSource.criticalValue f2_edge_i0 < prepEdgeSource.criticalValue f2_edge_i1 :=
    prepEdgeSource.criticalValue.strictMono (by apply Fin.lt_def.mpr; decide)
  have h12 : prepEdgeSource.criticalValue f2_edge_i1 < prepEdgeSource.criticalValue f2_edge_i2 :=
    prepEdgeSource.criticalValue.strictMono (by apply Fin.lt_def.mpr; decide)
  simp only [f2_edge_critical_set, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h0 h1 h2
  rcases h0 with h0 | h0 | h0 <;>
    rcases h1 with h1 | h1 | h1 <;>
    rcases h2 with h2 | h2 | h2 <;>
    simp_all <;> linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_mem_sublevel
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_mem_sublevel (r : ℚ) (s : Finset (Fin 2)) :
    s ∈ prepEdgeSource.sublevel r ↔
      (s = {0} ∧ (2 : ℚ) ≤ r) ∨
      (s = {1} ∧ (5 : ℚ) ≤ r) ∨
      (s = {0, 1} ∧ (9 : ℚ) ≤ r)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨hsK, hv⟩ := (prepEdgeSource.mem_sublevel_iff r s).1 hs
    rcases prepEdgeFaceCases (⟨s, hsK⟩ : TotalFace prepEdgeK) with h | h | h
    · left
      refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      have hs : (⟨s, hsK⟩ : TotalFace prepEdgeK) = prepEdgeV0 := Subtype.ext h
      rw [hs, f2_edge_values.1] at hv
      exact hv
    · right; left
      refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      have hs : (⟨s, hsK⟩ : TotalFace prepEdgeK) = prepEdgeV1 := Subtype.ext h
      rw [hs, f2_edge_values.2.1] at hv
      exact hv
    · right; right
      refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      have hs : (⟨s, hsK⟩ : TotalFace prepEdgeK) = prepEdgeE01 := Subtype.ext h
      rw [hs, f2_edge_values.2.2] at hv
      exact hv
  · rintro (⟨rfl, hr⟩ | ⟨rfl, hr⟩ | ⟨rfl, hr⟩)
    · exact (prepEdgeSource.mem_sublevel_iff r _).2
        ⟨prepEdgeV0.property, by simpa [prepEdgeSource, prepEdgeV0] using hr⟩
    · exact (prepEdgeSource.mem_sublevel_iff r _).2
        ⟨prepEdgeV1.property, by simpa [prepEdgeSource, prepEdgeV1, Finset.ext_iff] using hr⟩
    · exact (prepEdgeSource.mem_sublevel_iff r _).2
        ⟨prepEdgeE01.property, by simpa [prepEdgeSource, prepEdgeE01, Finset.ext_iff] using hr⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_region0
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_region0 (r : ℚ) (hlo : (2 : ℚ) ≤ r) (hhi : r < 5) :
    prepEdgeSource.sublevel r = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  change s ∈ prepEdgeSource.sublevel r ↔ s ∈ singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)
  rw [f2_edge_mem_sublevel]
  have h9 : ¬ (9 : ℚ) ≤ r := by linarith
  simp [mem_singletonFace_iff, hlo, not_le.mpr hhi, h9]

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_region1
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_region1 (r : ℚ) (hlo : (5 : ℚ) ≤ r) (hhi : r < 9) :
    prepEdgeSource.sublevel r = f2_edge_twoVertices
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  change s ∈ prepEdgeSource.sublevel r ↔ s ∈ f2_edge_twoVertices
  rw [f2_edge_mem_sublevel]
  have h2 : (2 : ℚ) ≤ r := by linarith
  have h9 : ¬ (9 : ℚ) ≤ r := by linarith
  simp only [h2, hlo, h9, and_true, and_false, or_false]
  change (s = {0} ∨ s = {1}) ↔ (s = {0} ∨ s = {1})
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_region2
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_region2 (r : ℚ) (hlo : (9 : ℚ) ≤ r) :
    prepEdgeSource.sublevel r = prepEdgeK
proof:
:= by
  apply prepEdgeSource.sublevel_eq_self_of_last_le
    (by rw [f2_edge_card]; decide) r
  have hlast : (⟨prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card - 1,
      Nat.sub_lt (show 0 < prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card by rw [f2_edge_card]; decide)
        (by decide)⟩ : Fin prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card) = f2_edge_i2 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    change prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card - 1 = 2
    have hc := f2_edge_card
    omega
  rw [hlast, f2_edge_critical.2.2]
  exact hlo

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_stage0
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_stage0 : prepEdgeSource.gradeFiltration f2_edge_i0 =
    singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prepEdgeSource.gradeFiltration_apply, f2_edge_critical.1]
  exact f2_edge_region0 2 le_rfl (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_stage1
statement: private theorem f2_edge_stage1 : prepEdgeSource.gradeFiltration f2_edge_i1 = f2_edge_twoVertices
proof:
:= by
  rw [prepEdgeSource.gradeFiltration_apply, f2_edge_critical.2.1]
  exact f2_edge_region1 5 le_rfl (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_stage2
statement: private theorem f2_edge_stage2 : prepEdgeSource.gradeFiltration f2_edge_i2 = prepEdgeK
proof:
:= by
  rw [prepEdgeSource.gradeFiltration_apply, f2_edge_critical.2.2]
  exact f2_edge_region2 9 le_rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edgeTwo_face0_card
statement: private theorem f2_edgeTwo_face0_card : Fintype.card (Face f2_edge_twoVertices 0) = 2
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edgeTwo_short_f_zero
statement:
private theorem f2_edgeTwo_short_f_zero :
    ((simplicialChainComplex f2_edge_twoVertices (ZMod 2)).sc 0).f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (simplicialChainComplex f2_edge_twoVertices (ZMod 2)).d 1 0 = 0 := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    ext c
    change (boundary f2_edge_twoVertices (ZMod 2) 0) c = 0
    have hc : c = 0 := by
      change Chain f2_edge_twoVertices (ZMod 2) 1 at c
      exact Subsingleton.elim c 0
    rw [hc]
    exact map_zero _
  change (simplicialChainComplex f2_edge_twoVertices (ZMod 2)).d
    ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev 0) 0 = 0
  rw [ChainComplex.prev]
  exact hf

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edgeTwo_short_g_zero
statement:
private theorem f2_edgeTwo_short_g_zero :
    ((simplicialChainComplex f2_edge_twoVertices (ZMod 2)).sc 0).g = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (simplicialChainComplex f2_edge_twoVertices (ZMod 2)).d
    0 ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).next 0) = 0
  rw [ChainComplex.next_nat_zero]
  exact simplicialChainComplex_d_zero f2_edge_twoVertices (ZMod 2) 0

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_H0_stage0
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplicialHomologyPModule_obj, f2_edge_stage0]
  exact (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv (ZMod 2) (0 : Fin 2)).finrank_eq.trans
    (Module.finrank_self (ZMod 2))

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_H0_stage1
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplicialHomologyPModule_obj, f2_edge_stage1]
  rw [f2_edgeTwoH0Equiv.finrank_eq]
  rw [Module.finrank_finsupp_self]
  exact f2_edgeTwo_face0_card

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_vertex_bijective
statement: private theorem f2_edge_vertex_bijective : Function.Bijective f2_edge_vertex
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j h
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> first | rfl | simp [f2_edge_vertex] at hv
  · intro σ
    have hc : σ.1 = {(0 : Fin 2)} ∨ σ.1 = {(1 : Fin 2)} := by
      have h : ∀ t : Finset (Fin 2), t.card = 1 →
          t = {0} ∨ t = {1} := by decide
      exact h σ.1 σ.2.2
    rcases hc with hc | hc
    · exact ⟨0, Subtype.ext (by simpa [f2_edge_vertex] using hc.symm)⟩
    · exact ⟨1, Subtype.ext (by simpa [f2_edge_vertex] using hc.symm)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_face_unique
statement: private theorem f2_edge_face_unique (σ : Face prepEdgeK 1) : σ = f2_edge_face
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h : ∀ t : Finset (Fin 2), t.card = 2 → t = {0, 1} := by decide
  exact h σ.1 σ.2.2

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_face_orderEmb
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Finset.orderEmbOfFin_unique'
  intro i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [f2_edge_face]

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_deleted0
statement: private theorem f2_edge_deleted0 : deletedFace prepEdgeK 0 f2_edge_face 0 = f2_edge_vertex 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change f2_edge_face.1.erase (f2_edge_face.1.orderEmbOfFin f2_edge_face.2.2 0) =
    (f2_edge_vertex 1).1
  rw [f2_edge_face_orderEmb]
  decide

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_deleted1
statement: private theorem f2_edge_deleted1 : deletedFace prepEdgeK 0 f2_edge_face 1 = f2_edge_vertex 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change f2_edge_face.1.erase (f2_edge_face.1.orderEmbOfFin f2_edge_face.2.2 1) =
    (f2_edge_vertex 0).1
  rw [f2_edge_face_orderEmb]
  decide

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_boundary
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundary_single]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, f2_edge_deleted0]
  have hdel : deletedFace prepEdgeK 0 f2_edge_face (Fin.succ 0) = f2_edge_vertex 0 := by
    simpa using f2_edge_deleted1
  rw [hdel]
  norm_num
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_vertex_ne
statement: private theorem f2_edge_vertex_ne : f2_edge_vertex 0 ≠ f2_edge_vertex 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
  norm_num [f2_edge_vertex] at hv

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_face0_card
statement: private theorem f2_edge_face0_card : Fintype.card (Face prepEdgeK 0) = 2
proof:
:= by
  exact Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective f2_edge_vertex f2_edge_vertex_bijective).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_face1_card
statement: private theorem f2_edge_face1_card : Fintype.card (Face prepEdgeK 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_chain0_finrank
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_chain0_finrank :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (Chain prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_finsupp_self]
  exact f2_edge_face0_card

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_chain1_finrank
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_chain1_finrank :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (Chain prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_finsupp_self]
  exact f2_edge_face1_card

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_boundary_nonzero
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_boundary_nonzero :
    boundary prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0 (Finsupp.single f2_edge_face 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hc := congrArg (fun c : Chain prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0 => c (f2_edge_vertex 1)) h
  rw [f2_edge_boundary] at hc
  simp [f2_edge_vertex_ne.symm] at hc

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_boundaries_finrank
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_boundaries_finrank :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialBoundaries prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let S := (simplicialChainComplex prepEdgeK (ZMod 2)).sc 0
  let : FiniteDimensional (ZMod 2) (↑S.X₁) := by
    change FiniteDimensional (ZMod 2)
      (Chain prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev 0))
    rw [ChainComplex.prev]
    exact finiteDimensional_finsupp
  let : FiniteDimensional (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range S.moduleCatToCycles) :=
    inferInstance
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (LinearMap.range S.moduleCatToCycles) := by
    apply Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
    let z : simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0 :=
      ⟨boundary prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0 (Finsupp.single f2_edge_face 1), by
        rw [simplicialCycles_zero]; trivial⟩
    have hz : z ∈ simplicialBoundaries prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0 :=
      (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff (ZMod 2) prepEdgeK 0 z).2
        ⟨Finsupp.single f2_edge_face 1, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, ?_⟩
    intro hz
    have hc : z = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hz
    apply f2_edge_boundary_nonzero
    exact congrArg (fun t : simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0 =>
      (t : Chain prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0)) hc
  have hle := LinearMap.finrank_range_le S.moduleCatToCycles
  have hdim := f2_edge_chain1_finrank
  have hsource : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (↑S.X₁) = 1 := by
    change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (Chain prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev 0)) = 1
    rw [ChainComplex.prev]
    exact hdim
  rw [hsource] at hle
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range S.moduleCatToCycles) = 1
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_H0_stage2
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplicialHomologyPModule_obj, f2_edge_stage2]
  let : Finite (Face prepEdgeK 0) := inferInstance
  let : FiniteDimensional (ZMod 2) (Chain prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) :=
    finiteDimensional_finsupp
  let : FiniteDimensional (ZMod 2) (simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) :=
    inferInstance
  let : HasQuotient (simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0)
      (Submodule (ZMod 2) (simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0)) :=
    Submodule.hasQuotient (R := ZMod 2) (M := simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0)
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
    ((simplicialChainComplex prepEdgeK (ZMod 2)).homology 0) = 1
  rw [(homologyKernelQuotient.{0,0,0} (ZMod 2)
    (simplicialChainComplex prepEdgeK (ZMod 2)) 0).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq]
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
    (simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0 ⧸ simplicialBoundaries prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = 1
  have hq : Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0 ⧸ simplicialBoundaries prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) +
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialBoundaries prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) =
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) := by
    exact Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank _
  have hc : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = 2 := by
    rw [simplicialCycles_zero, finrank_top]
    exact f2_edge_chain0_finrank
  have hb := f2_edge_boundaries_finrank
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_coeffSum_single
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_coeffSum_single (i : Fin 2) (a : ZMod 2) :
    f2_edge_coeffSum (Finsupp.single (f2_edge_vertex i) a) = a
proof:
:= by
  exact Finsupp.lsum_single (ZMod 2)
    (fun _ : Face prepEdgeK 0 => LinearMap.id) _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_coeffSum_boundary
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_coeffSum_boundary :
    f2_edge_coeffSum.comp (boundary prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro σ a
  have hσ : σ = f2_edge_face := f2_edge_face_unique σ
  subst σ
  change f2_edge_coeffSum (boundary prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0
      (Finsupp.single f2_edge_face a)) = 0
  rw [f2_edge_boundary, map_sub, f2_edge_coeffSum_single, f2_edge_coeffSum_single]
  exact sub_self a

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_vertex0_not_boundary
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_vertex0_not_boundary :
    f2_edge_vertex0_cycle ∉ simplicialBoundaries prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
    (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff (ZMod 2) prepEdgeK 0 f2_edge_vertex0_cycle).1 hz
  have hs := congrArg f2_edge_coeffSum hc
  have hzero := congrArg (fun f : Chain prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 1 →ₗ[ZMod 2] ZMod 2 => f c)
    f2_edge_coeffSum_boundary
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hzero
  rw [hzero] at hs
  change 0 = f2_edge_coeffSum (Finsupp.single (f2_edge_vertex 0) 1) at hs
  rw [f2_edge_coeffSum_single] at hs
  exact one_ne_zero hs.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_vertex0_class_nonzero
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_vertex0_class_nonzero :
    (simplicialBoundaries prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0).mkQ f2_edge_vertex0_cycle ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  exact f2_edge_vertex0_not_boundary
    ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).1 hz)

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_singleton_le
statement: private theorem f2_edge_singleton_le : singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) ≤ prepEdgeK
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  have h : s = ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) :=
    (mem_singletonFace_iff 0 s).1 hs
  subst s
  change ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)).Nonempty
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_two_le
statement: private theorem f2_edge_two_le : f2_edge_twoVertices ≤ prepEdgeK
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  rcases (show s = ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∨ s = {1} from hs) with h | h
  · subst s
    change ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)).Nonempty
    simp
  · subst s
    change ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)).Nonempty
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_cycle_inclusion
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [simplicialCycleIncl_coe]
  change chainIncl (ZMod 2) f2_edge_singleton_le 0
      (Finsupp.single (singletonVertex (0 : Fin 2)) 1) =
    Finsupp.single (f2_edge_vertex 0) 1
  rw [chainIncl_single]
  have hface : faceIncl f2_edge_singleton_le 0 (singletonVertex (0 : Fin 2)) =
      f2_edge_vertex 0 := Subtype.ext rfl
  rw [hface]

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_singleton_map_nonzero
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_singleton_map_nonzero :
    (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) f2_edge_singleton_le 0).hom ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let : HasQuotient (simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2) 0)
      (Submodule (ZMod 2)
        (simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2) 0)) :=
    Submodule.hasQuotient (R := ZMod 2)
      (M := simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2) 0)
  let : HasQuotient (simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0)
      (Submodule (ZMod 2) (simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0)) :=
    Submodule.hasQuotient (R := ZMod 2)
      (M := simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0)
  let q := (simplicialBoundaries (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2) 0).mkQ
    f2_edge_source_cycle
  let e0 := (homologyKernelQuotient.{0,0,0} (ZMod 2)
    (simplicialChainComplex (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2)) 0).toLinearEquiv
  let e1 := (homologyKernelQuotient.{0,0,0} (ZMod 2)
    (simplicialChainComplex prepEdgeK (ZMod 2)) 0).toLinearEquiv
  let x := e0.symm q
  have hnat : e1 ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) f2_edge_singleton_le 0).hom x) =
      (simplicialBoundaries prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0).mkQ f2_edge_vertex0_cycle := by
    have hh := simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality
      (ZMod 2) f2_edge_singleton_le 0
    have hx := congrArg (fun f : simplicialHomology
      (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2) 0 ⟶
      ModuleCat.of (ZMod 2) (simplicialCycles prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0 ⧸
        simplicialBoundaries prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) => f.hom x) hh
    change e1 ((simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) f2_edge_singleton_le 0).hom x) =
      simplicialQuotientIncl (ZMod 2) f2_edge_singleton_le 0 (e0 x) at hx
    rw [show e0 x = q from e0.apply_symm_apply q,
      simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ, f2_edge_cycle_inclusion] at hx
    exact hx
  intro hz
  rw [hz] at hnat
  change e1 (0 : simplicialHomology prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = _ at hnat
  have he : e1 (0 : simplicialHomology prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = 0 := e1.map_zero
  exact f2_edge_vertex0_class_nonzero (hnat.symm.trans he)

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_map_comp
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_map_comp :
    simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) f2_edge_singleton_le 0 =
      simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) f2_edge_singleton_two 0 ≫
        simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) f2_edge_two_le 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : f2_edge_singleton_le = f2_edge_singleton_two.trans f2_edge_two_le :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [h]
  exact simplicialHomologyIncl_comp (ZMod 2) f2_edge_singleton_two f2_edge_two_le 0

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_singleton_two_nonzero
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_singleton_two_nonzero :
    (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) f2_edge_singleton_two 0).hom ≠ 0
proof:
:= by

  apply f2_edge_singleton_map_nonzero
  have hc := congrArg (fun f : simplicialHomology
    (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2) 0 ⟶
    simplicialHomology prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0 => f.hom) f2_edge_map_comp
  simpa [hz] using hc

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_two_full_nonzero
statement:

    (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) (ZMod 2) 0 ⟶

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_rank_one_of_nonzero
statement:
private theorem f2_rank_one_of_nonzero
    {A B : Type} [AddCommGroup A] [Module (ZMod 2) A]
    [AddCommGroup B] [Module (ZMod 2) B]
    [FiniteDimensional (ZMod 2) A]
    (hA : Module.finrank (ZMod 2) A = 1)
    (f : A →ₗ[ZMod 2] B) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range f) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ∃ x : A, f x ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    apply hf
    ext x
    simpa using (not_not.mp (not_exists.mp h x))
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hx
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range f) := by
    apply Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨f x, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    exact fun he => hx (congrArg Subtype.val he)
  have hle := LinearMap.finrank_range_le f
  rw [hA] at hle
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_rank_01
proof:
:= by
  exact f2_rank_one_of_nonzero
    ((simplicialSingletonH0Equiv (ZMod 2) (0 : Fin 2)).finrank_eq.trans
      (Module.finrank_self (ZMod 2))) _ f2_edge_singleton_two_nonzero

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_rank_02

:= by

    ((simplicialSingletonH0Equiv (ZMod 2) (0 : Fin 2)).finrank_eq.trans
      (Module.finrank_self (ZMod 2))) _ f2_edge_singleton_map_nonzero

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_rank_12
proof:
:= by
  have hle := LinearMap.finrank_range_le
    (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) f2_edge_two_le 0).hom
  have hpos : 0 < Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) f2_edge_two_le 0).hom) := by
    apply Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
    have hx : ∃ x, (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) f2_edge_two_le 0).hom x ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      apply f2_edge_two_full_nonzero
      ext x
      simpa using (not_not.mp (not_exists.mp h x))
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    exact fun he => hx (congrArg Subtype.val he)
  have htarget : Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (simplicialHomology prepEdgeK (ZMod 2) 0) = 1 := by
    have hh := f2_edge_H0_stage2
    change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (simplicialHomology (prepEdgeSource.gradeFiltration f2_edge_i2) (ZMod 2) 0) = 1 at hh
    rw [f2_edge_stage2] at hh
    exact hh
  have hle' := Submodule.finrank_le
    (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) f2_edge_two_le 0).hom)
  rw [htarget] at hle'
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_rank_congr
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_rank_congr {A B A' B' : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)}
    (hA : A = A') (hB : B = B') (h : A ≤ B) (h' : A' ≤ B') :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) h 0).hom) =
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) h' 0).hom)
proof:
:= by
  cases hA
  cases hB
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_barcode
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_barcode :
    gradeHomologyBarcode (ZMod 2) prepEdgeSource 0 =
      ({f2_edge_bar03, f2_edge_bar12} :
        Multiset (FiniteInterval prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    gradeHomologyBarcode (ZMod 2) prepEdgeSource 0 =
        rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ZMod 2)
          ({f2_edge_bar03, f2_edge_bar12} :
            Multiset (FiniteInterval prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card))) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff
        (simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2) prepEdgeSource.gradeFiltration 0)
        (barcodeModule (k := ZMod 2)
          ({f2_edge_bar03, f2_edge_bar12} :
            Multiset (FiniteInterval prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card)))).mpr
      intro i j hij
      have hi : i = f2_edge_i0 ∨ i = f2_edge_i1 ∨ i = f2_edge_i2 := by
        have hv := i.isLt
        have hc := f2_edge_card
        rcases (show i.val = 0 ∨ i.val = 1 ∨ i.val = 2 by omega) with h | h | h
        · exact Or.inl (Fin.ext h)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Fin.ext h))
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Fin.ext h))
      have hj : j = f2_edge_i0 ∨ j = f2_edge_i1 ∨ j = f2_edge_i2 := by
        have hv := j.isLt
        have hc := f2_edge_card
        rcases (show j.val = 0 ∨ j.val = 1 ∨ j.val = 2 by omega) with h | h | h
        · exact Or.inl (Fin.ext h)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Fin.ext h))
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Fin.ext h))
      rcases hi with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl | rfl
      all_goals simp only [f2_edge_i0, f2_edge_i1, f2_edge_i2, Fin.mk_le_mk] at hij
      all_goals simp at hij
      all_goals rw [rank_barcodeMap]
      all_goals first
        | rw [f2_edge_grade_rank_00]
        | rw [f2_edge_grade_rank_01]
        | rw [f2_edge_grade_rank_02]
        | rw [f2_edge_grade_rank_11]
        | rw [f2_edge_grade_rank_12]
        | rw [f2_edge_grade_rank_22]
      all_goals
        rw [show ({f2_edge_bar03, f2_edge_bar12} :
          Multiset (FiniteInterval prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card)) =
            f2_edge_bar03 ::ₘ f2_edge_bar12 ::ₘ 0 by rfl,
          Multiset.countP_cons, Multiset.countP_cons]
        simp [f2_edge_bar03, f2_edge_bar12, f2_edge_i0, f2_edge_i1, f2_edge_i2]
      all_goals rfl
    _ = _ := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_points
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_points :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) prepEdgeSource 0).points =
      ({((2 : ℚ), (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)), ((5 : ℚ), (9 : WithTop ℚ))} :
        Multiset (ℚ × WithTop ℚ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dgm, f2_edge_barcode]
  change ({f2_edge_bar03, f2_edge_bar12} :
    Multiset (FiniteInterval prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card)).map
      (fun I =>
        (prepEdgeSource.criticalValue
          ⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩,
          if hd : I.death < prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card then
            (prepEdgeSource.criticalValue ⟨I.death, hd⟩ : WithTop ℚ)
          else (⊤ : WithTop ℚ))) = _
  simp [f2_edge_bar03, f2_edge_bar12, f2_edge_card]
  have hc0 : ∀ h : 0 < prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card,
      prepEdgeSource.criticalValue ⟨0, h⟩ = 2 := by
    intro h
    have he : (⟨0, h⟩ : Fin prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card) = f2_edge_i0 := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [he]
    exact f2_edge_critical.1
  have hc1 : ∀ h : 1 < prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card,
      prepEdgeSource.criticalValue ⟨1, h⟩ = 5 := by
    intro h
    have he : (⟨1, h⟩ : Fin prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card) = f2_edge_i1 := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [he]
    exact f2_edge_critical.2.1
  have hc2 : ∀ h : 2 < prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card,
      prepEdgeSource.criticalValue ⟨2, h⟩ = 9 := by
    intro h
    have he : (⟨2, h⟩ : Fin prepEdgeSource.criticalValues.card) = f2_edge_i2 := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [he]
    exact f2_edge_critical.2.2
  simp [hc0, hc1, hc2]

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_edge_incl_eq_square
statement:
private theorem f2_edge_incl_eq_square {A B A' B' : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)}
    (hA : A = A') (hB : B = B') (h : A ≤ B) (h' : A' ≤ B') :
    simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) h 0 ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C (ZMod 2) 0) hB) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C (ZMod 2) 0) hA) ≫
        simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) h' 0
proof:
:= by
  subst A'
  subst B'
  simp

statement:
private theorem f2_numerical_points_map :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) prepEdgeSource 0).points =
      ({((2 : ℚ), (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)), ((5 : ℚ), (9 : WithTop ℚ))} :
        Multiset (ℚ × WithTop ℚ)) ∧
    (dgm (ZMod 2) prepEdgeTarget 0).points =
      ({((3 : ℚ), (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)), ((6 : ℚ), (10 : WithTop ℚ))} :

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_numerical_common_endpoints
statement:
private theorem f2_numerical_common_endpoints :
    ∃ E : Multiset (TotalFace prepEdgeK × Option (TotalFace prepEdgeK)),
      (dgm (ZMod 2) prepEdgeSource 0).points =
        ({((2 : ℚ), (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)), ((5 : ℚ), (9 : WithTop ℚ))} :
          Multiset (ℚ × WithTop ℚ)) ∧
      (dgm (ZMod 2) prepEdgeTarget 0).points =
        ({((3 : ℚ), (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)), ((6 : ℚ), (10 : WithTop ℚ))} :
          Multiset (ℚ × WithTop ℚ)) ∧
      (dgm (ZMod 2) prepEdgeSource 0).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (prepEdgeSource.value p.1, p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)
          (fun t => (prepEdgeSource.value t : WithTop ℚ)))) ∧
      (dgm (ZMod 2) prepEdgeTarget 0).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (prepEdgeTarget.value p.1, p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop ℚ)
          (fun t => (prepEdgeTarget.value t : WithTop ℚ))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hf, hg⟩ := f3_common_face_endpoints 0
  exact ⟨E, f2_edge_points, f2_target_points, hf, hg⟩

statement:
private theorem f2_matched_inclusion_square :
    simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        (prepEdgeSource.sublevel_mono (show (2 : ℚ) ≤ 5 by norm_num)) 0 ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C (ZMod 2) 0) f2_matched_second) =
    eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C (ZMod 2) 0) f2_matched_first) ≫
      simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        (prepEdgeTarget.sublevel_mono (show (3 : ℚ) ≤ 6 by norm_num)) 0

  f2_edge_incl_eq_square f2_matched_first f2_matched_second _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_source_rank_dimension
statement:
private theorem f2_source_rank_dimension :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        (prepEdgeSource.sublevel_mono (show (2 : ℚ) ≤ 5 by norm_num)) 0).hom) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (simplicialHomology (prepEdgeSource.sublevel 5) (ZMod 2) 0) = 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact (f2_edge_rank_congr
      (f2_edge_region0 2 le_rfl (by norm_num))
      (f2_edge_region1 5 le_rfl (by norm_num)) _ f2_edge_singleton_two).trans
        f2_edge_rank_01
  · have h := f2_edge_H0_stage1
    change Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (simplicialHomology (prepEdgeSource.gradeFiltration f2_edge_i1) (ZMod 2) 0) = 2 at h
    rw [f2_edge_stage1] at h
    rw [f2_edge_region1 5 le_rfl (by norm_num)]
    exact h

    Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      (simplicialHomology (prepEdgeTarget.sublevel 6) (ZMod 2) 0) = 2

  · exact (f2_edge_rank_congr f2_matched_first f2_matched_second _ _).symm.trans

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_source_inclusion_composition
statement:
private theorem f2_source_inclusion_composition :

    (prepEdgeSource.sublevel_mono (show (2 : ℚ) ≤ 5 by norm_num))
    (prepEdgeSource.sublevel_mono (show (5 : ℚ) ≤ 9 by norm_num)) 0

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_target_inclusion_composition
statement:
private theorem f2_target_inclusion_composition :
    simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        (prepEdgeTarget.sublevel_mono (show (3 : ℚ) ≤ 10 by norm_num)) 0 =
      simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
          (prepEdgeTarget.sublevel_mono (show (3 : ℚ) ≤ 6 by norm_num)) 0 ≫
        simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
          (prepEdgeTarget.sublevel_mono (show (6 : ℚ) ≤ 10 by norm_num)) 0

    (prepEdgeTarget.sublevel_mono (show (3 : ℚ) ≤ 6 by norm_num))
    (prepEdgeTarget.sublevel_mono (show (6 : ℚ) ≤ 10 by norm_num)) 0

name: TDA.Persistence.f2_matched_composition_square
statement:
private theorem f2_matched_composition_square :
    (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        (prepEdgeSource.sublevel_mono (show (2 : ℚ) ≤ 5 by norm_num)) 0 ≫
      simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        (prepEdgeSource.sublevel_mono (show (5 : ℚ) ≤ 9 by norm_num)) 0) ≫
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C (ZMod 2) 0) f2_matched_third) =
    eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C (ZMod 2) 0) f2_matched_first) ≫
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
          (prepEdgeTarget.sublevel_mono (show (3 : ℚ) ≤ 6 by norm_num)) 0 ≫
        simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
          (prepEdgeTarget.sublevel_mono (show (6 : ℚ) ≤ 10 by norm_num)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← f2_source_inclusion_composition, ← f2_target_inclusion_composition]
  exact f2_edge_incl_eq_square f2_matched_first f2_matched_third _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridKan.Examples.floorHookVector_ne_zero_of_floor
statement:
private theorem floorHookVector_ne_zero_of_floor (k : Type) [Field k]
    (a : Fin 2 → ℝ) (ha : planarGrid.HasLowerPoint a)
    (hf : planarGrid.floor a ha = planarLower) : floorHookVector k a ha ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let hA := planarLower_le (planarGrid.floor a ha)
  let hBack : planarGrid.floor a ha ≤ planarLower := by
    rw [hf]
  intro hz
  have hcomp := structureMapLinear_comp (finiteHook k) hA hBack
  have hid := (structureMapLinear_self (finiteHook k) (hA.trans hBack)).symm.trans hcomp
  change structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hA (finiteHookDyingVector k) = 0 at hz
  have hzero := congrArg (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hBack) hz
  have hvec : finiteHookDyingVector k = 0 := by
    calc
      finiteHookDyingVector k =
          (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hBack)
            ((structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hA) (finiteHookDyingVector k)) := by
              have heq := congrArg (fun f => f (finiteHookDyingVector k)) hid
              simpa only [LinearMap.id_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply] using heq
      _ = 0 := by simpa only [map_zero] using hzero
  exact finiteHookDyingVector_ne_zero k hvec

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridKan.Examples.floorHookVector_between
statement:
private theorem floorHookVector_between (k : Type) [Field k] :
    structureMapLinear (finiteHook k)
      (planarGrid.floor_mono gradeA_le_gradeC gradeA_hasLowerPoint gradeC_hasLowerPoint)
      (floorHookVector k gradeA gradeA_hasLowerPoint) =
        floorHookVector k gradeC gradeC_hasLowerPoint
proof:
:= by
  let hA := planarLower_le (planarGrid.floor gradeA gradeA_hasLowerPoint)
  let hAC := planarGrid.floor_mono gradeA_le_gradeC gradeA_hasLowerPoint gradeC_hasLowerPoint
  let hC := planarLower_le (planarGrid.floor gradeC gradeC_hasLowerPoint)
  change structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hAC
      (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hA (finiteHookDyingVector k)) =
    structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hC (finiteHookDyingVector k)
  have hrel : hA.trans hAC = hC := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  calc
    structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hAC
        (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hA (finiteHookDyingVector k)) =
        (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hAC).comp
          (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hA) (finiteHookDyingVector k) := rfl
    _ = structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) (hA.trans hAC) (finiteHookDyingVector k) := by
      rw [← structureMapLinear_comp]
    _ = structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hC (finiteHookDyingVector k) := by rw [hrel]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridKan.Examples.floorHookVector_dies
statement:
private theorem floorHookVector_dies (k : Type) [Field k] :
    structureMapLinear (finiteHook k)
      (planarGrid.floor_mono gradeC_le_gradeB gradeC_hasLowerPoint gradeB_hasLowerPoint)
      (floorHookVector k gradeC gradeC_hasLowerPoint) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let hC := planarLower_le (planarGrid.floor gradeC gradeC_hasLowerPoint)
  let hCB := planarGrid.floor_mono gradeC_le_gradeB gradeC_hasLowerPoint gradeB_hasLowerPoint
  let hB := planarLower_le (planarGrid.floor gradeB gradeB_hasLowerPoint)
  change structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hCB
      (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hC (finiteHookDyingVector k)) = 0
  have hrel : hC.trans hCB = hB := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  calc
    structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hCB
        (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hC (finiteHookDyingVector k)) =
        (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hCB).comp
          (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hC) (finiteHookDyingVector k) := rfl
    _ = structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) (hC.trans hCB) (finiteHookDyingVector k) := by
      rw [← structureMapLinear_comp]
    _ = structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hB (finiteHookDyingVector k) := by rw [hrel]
    _ = 0 := by
      change structureMapLinear (finiteHook k)
        (planarLower_le (planarGrid.floor gradeB gradeB_hasLowerPoint))
        (finiteHookDyingVector k) = 0
      rw [floor_gradeB]
      rw [finiteHookDyingVector_eq_unit]
      exact Hook.generator_dies planarLower_lt_upper (𝟙 (finiteHook k))

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridKan.Examples.floorHookVector_dies_from_A
statement:
private theorem floorHookVector_dies_from_A (k : Type) [Field k] :
    structureMapLinear (finiteHook k)
      (planarGrid.floor_mono gradeA_le_gradeB gradeA_hasLowerPoint gradeB_hasLowerPoint)
      (floorHookVector k gradeA gradeA_hasLowerPoint) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let hA := planarLower_le (planarGrid.floor gradeA gradeA_hasLowerPoint)
  let hAB := planarGrid.floor_mono gradeA_le_gradeB gradeA_hasLowerPoint gradeB_hasLowerPoint
  let hC := planarLower_le (planarGrid.floor gradeC gradeC_hasLowerPoint)
  let hCB := planarGrid.floor_mono gradeC_le_gradeB gradeC_hasLowerPoint gradeB_hasLowerPoint
  change structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hAB
      (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hA (finiteHookDyingVector k)) = 0
  have hrel : hA.trans hAB = hC.trans hCB := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  calc
    structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hAB
        (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hA (finiteHookDyingVector k)) =
        (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hAB).comp
          (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hA) (finiteHookDyingVector k) := rfl
    _ = structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) (hA.trans hAB) (finiteHookDyingVector k) := by
      rw [← structureMapLinear_comp]
    _ = structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) (hC.trans hCB) (finiteHookDyingVector k) := by
      rw [hrel]
    _ = (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hCB).comp
        (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hC) (finiteHookDyingVector k) := by
      rw [structureMapLinear_comp]
    _ = structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hCB
        (structureMapLinear (finiteHook k) hC (finiteHookDyingVector k)) := rfl
    _ = 0 := floorHookVector_dies k

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridKan.Examples.kanHookVector_ne_zero
statement: theorem kanHookVector_ne_zero (k : Type) [Field k] : kanHookVector k ≠ 0
proof:

  have hfloor : floorHookVector k gradeA gradeA_hasLowerPoint = 0 := by

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridKan.Examples.within_cell_transition_preserves_vector
statement:
theorem within_cell_transition_preserves_vector (k : Type) [Field k] :
    structureMapLinear (planarGrid.lan.obj (finiteHook k)) gradeA_le_gradeC
      (kanHookVector k) = kanHookVectorAtC k
proof:
:= by
  apply (planarGrid.appIso (finiteHook k) gradeC gradeC_hasLowerPoint).toLinearEquiv.injective
  change (planarGrid.appIso (finiteHook k) gradeC gradeC_hasLowerPoint).hom.hom
      (structureMapLinear (planarGrid.lan.obj (finiteHook k)) gradeA_le_gradeC
        (kanHookVector k)) =
      (planarGrid.appIso (finiteHook k) gradeC gradeC_hasLowerPoint).hom.hom
        (kanHookVectorAtC k)
  rw [planarGrid.appIso_structureMap_apply (M := finiteHook k)
    gradeA_le_gradeC gradeA_hasLowerPoint gradeC_hasLowerPoint]
  simpa [kanHookVector, kanHookVectorAtC] using floorHookVector_between k

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridKan.Examples.across_cell_transition_kills_vector
statement:
theorem across_cell_transition_kills_vector (k : Type) [Field k] :
    structureMapLinear (planarGrid.lan.obj (finiteHook k)) gradeC_le_gradeB
      (kanHookVectorAtC k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (planarGrid.appIso (finiteHook k) gradeB gradeB_hasLowerPoint).toLinearEquiv.injective
  change (planarGrid.appIso (finiteHook k) gradeB gradeB_hasLowerPoint).hom.hom
      (structureMapLinear (planarGrid.lan.obj (finiteHook k)) gradeC_le_gradeB
        (kanHookVectorAtC k)) =
      (planarGrid.appIso (finiteHook k) gradeB gradeB_hasLowerPoint).hom.hom 0
  rw [planarGrid.appIso_structureMap_apply (M := finiteHook k)
    gradeC_le_gradeB gradeC_hasLowerPoint gradeB_hasLowerPoint]
  simpa [kanHookVectorAtC] using floorHookVector_dies k

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridKan.Examples.quotient_map_at_gradeA
statement:
theorem quotient_map_at_gradeA (k : Type) [Field k]
    (m : (planarGrid.lan.obj (FiniteHookDeflation.module (finiteHook k))).obj gradeA) :
    (planarGrid.appIso (finiteHook k) gradeA gradeA_hasLowerPoint).hom.hom
        (((planarGrid.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π (finiteHook k))).app gradeA).hom m) =
      ((FiniteHookDeflation.π (finiteHook k)).app
        (planarGrid.floor gradeA gradeA_hasLowerPoint)).hom
        ((planarGrid.appIso (FiniteHookDeflation.module (finiteHook k)) gradeA
          gradeA_hasLowerPoint).hom.hom m)
proof:
:= by
  exact planarGrid.appIso_map_apply (FiniteHookDeflation.π (finiteHook k)) gradeA
    gradeA_hasLowerPoint m

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridKan.Examples.rankExact_lifts_nonzero_dying_vector
statement:
theorem rankExact_lifts_nonzero_dying_vector (k : Type) [Field k] :
    ∃ m : (planarGrid.lan.obj (FiniteHookDeflation.module (finiteHook k))).obj gradeA,
      ((planarGrid.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π (finiteHook k))).app gradeA).hom m =
          kanHookVector k ∧
        m ≠ 0 ∧
        structureMapLinear (planarGrid.lan.obj (FiniteHookDeflation.module (finiteHook k)))
          gradeA_le_gradeB m = 0
proof:
:= by
  let hs := planarGrid.lan_isRankExact (FiniteHookDeflation.rankExact (finiteHook k))
  have hdie : structureMapLinear (planarGrid.lan.obj (finiteHook k)) gradeA_le_gradeB
      (kanHookVector k) = 0 := by
    have h := planarGrid.appIso_structureMap_apply (M := finiteHook k)
      gradeA_le_gradeB gradeA_hasLowerPoint gradeB_hasLowerPoint (kanHookVector k)
    have hzero : structureMapLinear (finiteHook k)
        (planarGrid.floor_mono gradeA_le_gradeB gradeA_hasLowerPoint gradeB_hasLowerPoint)
        ((planarGrid.appIso (finiteHook k) gradeA gradeA_hasLowerPoint).hom.hom
          (kanHookVector k)) = 0 := by
      simpa [kanHookVector] using floorHookVector_dies_from_A k
    apply (planarGrid.appIso (finiteHook k) gradeB gradeB_hasLowerPoint).toLinearEquiv.injective
    change (planarGrid.appIso (finiteHook k) gradeB gradeB_hasLowerPoint).hom.hom
        (structureMapLinear (planarGrid.lan.obj (finiteHook k)) gradeA_le_gradeB
          (kanHookVector k)) =
      (planarGrid.appIso (finiteHook k) gradeB gradeB_hasLowerPoint).hom.hom 0
    simpa only [map_zero] using h.trans hzero
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hmdeath⟩ := hs.lift_kernel gradeA_le_gradeB (kanHookVector k) hdie
  refine ⟨m, hm, ?_, hmdeath⟩
  intro hm0
  have hz : kanHookVector k = 0 := by
    rw [← hm, hm0, map_zero]
  have hsource := congrArg
    (fun x => (planarGrid.appIso (finiteHook k) gradeA gradeA_hasLowerPoint).hom.hom x) hz
  have hvec : floorHookVector k gradeA gradeA_hasLowerPoint = 0 := by
    simpa [kanHookVector] using hsource
  exact floorHookVectorA_ne_zero k hvec

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridKan.Examples.characteristic_two_nonzero_dying_lift
statement:
theorem characteristic_two_nonzero_dying_lift :
    ∃ m : (planarGrid.lan.obj (FiniteHookDeflation.module (finiteHook (ZMod 2)))).obj gradeA,
      ((planarGrid.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π (finiteHook (ZMod 2)))).app gradeA).hom m =
          kanHookVector (ZMod 2) ∧
        m ≠ 0 ∧
        structureMapLinear
          (planarGrid.lan.obj (FiniteHookDeflation.module (finiteHook (ZMod 2))))
          gradeA_le_gradeB m = 0
proof:
:=
  rankExact_lifts_nonzero_dying_vector (ZMod 2)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridKan.Examples.zeroDim_identity_rankExact
statement:
private theorem zeroDim_identity_rankExact :
    IsRankExact (𝟙 zeroDimPrincipalUpset) (0 : zeroDimPrincipalUpset ⟶ 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hshort : IsPointwiseShortExact (𝟙 zeroDimPrincipalUpset)
      (0 : zeroDimPrincipalUpset ⟶ 0) := by
    constructor
    · intro p x y h
      simpa using h
    · intro p x
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      exact (ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)).elim _ _
    · intro p
      ext x
      simp
  exact hshort.rankExact_of_section (0 : 0 ⟶ zeroDimPrincipalUpset) (by simp)

proof:
