name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridKan.Examples.zero_dim_principal_upset_lan_nonzero
statement:
theorem zero_dim_principal_upset_lan_nonzero :
    ∃ x : (zeroGrid.lan.obj zeroDimPrincipalUpset).obj zeroGridGrade, x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let ha := zeroGrid_hasLowerPoint
  let p := zeroGrid.floor zeroGridGrade ha
  have hp : zeroGridPoint ≤ p := by
    have heq : zeroGridPoint = p := by
      change zeroGridPoint = zeroGrid.floor zeroGridGrade zeroGrid_hasLowerPoint
      exact zeroGrid_floor.symm
    exact heq ▸ le_rfl
  let e := HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := ℚ) hp
  let v := e.symm 1
  let x := (zeroGrid.appIso zeroDimPrincipalUpset zeroGridGrade ha).inv.hom v
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  intro hx
  have h := congrArg
    (fun y => (zeroGrid.appIso zeroDimPrincipalUpset zeroGridGrade ha).hom.hom y) hx
  have hv : v = 0 := by
    simpa [x] using h
  have hone : (1 : ℚ) = 0 := by
    have he := congrArg e hv
    simp [v] at he
  exact one_ne_zero hone

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGridKan.Examples.principal_upset_unbounded_tail
statement:
theorem principal_upset_unbounded_tail (r : Fin 2 → ℝ) (hr : ∀ i, 2 ≤ r i) :
    ∃ x : (planarGrid.lan.obj
      (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) planarLower)).obj r, x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let ha : planarGrid.HasLowerPoint r := by
    refine ⟨planarUpper, ?_⟩
    intro i
    change (2 : ℝ) ≤ r i
    exact hr i
  let p := planarGrid.floor r ha
  have hbirth : planarLower ≤ p := planarLower_le p
  let e := HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := ℚ) hbirth
  let v := e.symm 1
  let x := (planarGrid.appIso (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) planarLower) r ha).inv.hom v
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  intro hx
  have hv : v = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun y => (planarGrid.appIso
      (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) planarLower) r ha).hom.hom y) hx
    simpa [x] using h
  have hone : (1 : ℚ) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg e hv
    simp [v] at h
  exact one_ne_zero hone

name: TDA.Persistence.death_telescope
statement:
private theorem death_telescope (r : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ) (x c d : ℕ)
    (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    (∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc c d,
      (r x ((y : ℤ) - 1) - r ((x : ℤ) - 1) ((y : ℤ) - 1) -
        r x y + r ((x : ℤ) - 1) y)) =
      (r x c - r ((x : ℤ) - 1) c) -
        (r x d - r ((x : ℤ) - 1) d)
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℕ → ℤ := fun n =>
    -(r x ((n : ℤ) - 1) - r ((x : ℤ) - 1) ((n : ℤ) - 1))
  have h := Finset.sum_Ico_sub F (show c + 1 ≤ d + 1 by omega)
  rw [Finset.Ico_add_one_add_one_eq_Ioc] at h
  convert h using 1
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro y hy
    dsimp [F]
    have hc : (y : ℤ) + 1 - 1 = (y : ℤ) := by omega
    rw [hc]
    ring
  · dsimp [F]
    have hc : (c : ℤ) + 1 - 1 = (c : ℤ) := by omega
    have hd : (d : ℤ) + 1 - 1 = (d : ℤ) := by omega
    rw [hc, hd]
    ring

name: TDA.Persistence.birth_telescope
statement:
private theorem birth_telescope (r : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ) (a b : ℕ) (t : ℤ)
    (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc a b, (r x t - r ((x : ℤ) - 1) t)) =
      r b t - r ((a : ℤ) - 1) t
proof:
:= by
  let F : ℕ → ℤ := fun n => r ((n : ℤ) - 1) t
  have h := Finset.sum_Icc_sub hab F
  convert h using 1
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    dsimp [F]
    have hc : (x : ℤ) + 1 - 1 = (x : ℤ) := by omega
    rw [hc]
  · dsimp [F]
    have hc : (b : ℤ) + 1 - 1 = (b : ℤ) := by omega
    rw [hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.rectangle_telescope
statement:
private theorem rectangle_telescope (r : ℤ → ℤ → ℤ)
    (a b c d : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    (∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc a b, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc c d,
      (r x ((y : ℤ) - 1) - r ((x : ℤ) - 1) ((y : ℤ) - 1) -
        r x y + r ((x : ℤ) - 1) y)) =
      r b c - r ((a : ℤ) - 1) c - r b d + r ((a : ℤ) - 1) d
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc a b,
        ((r x c - r ((x : ℤ) - 1) c) -
          (r x d - r ((x : ℤ) - 1) d)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x hx
      exact death_telescope r x c d hcd
    _ = _ := by
      rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
        birth_telescope r a b c hab, birth_telescope r a b d hab]
      ring

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleMultiplicityInteger_sum_rectangle
statement:
theorem moduleMultiplicityInteger_sum_rectangle
    (a b c d : ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c)
    (hcd : c ≤ d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    (∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc a b, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc c d,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger M x y) =
      moduleRankInteger M (b : ℤ) (c : ℤ) -
      moduleRankInteger M ((a : ℤ) - 1) (c : ℤ) -
      moduleRankInteger M (b : ℤ) (d : ℤ) +
      moduleRankInteger M ((a : ℤ) - 1) (d : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  clear hbc hd
  exact rectangle_telescope (moduleRankInteger M) a b c d hab hcd

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger
statement:
theorem structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger
    (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    (structureMapRank M i j hij : ℤ) =
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (i.val + 1), ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc j.val N,
        moduleMultiplicityInteger M b d
proof:
:= by
  have h := moduleMultiplicityInteger_sum_rectangle M 0 i.val j.val N
    (Nat.zero_le _) (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp hij) (Nat.le_of_lt j.isLt) (le_refl N)
  rw [← Nat.range_succ_eq_Icc_zero] at h
  have hsource := moduleRankInteger_neg_one M (j.val : ℤ)
  have hsourceN := moduleRankInteger_neg_one M (N : ℤ)
  have htarget := moduleRankInteger_at_size M (i.val : ℤ)
  have hrank := moduleRankInteger_fin M i j hij
  conv at h => rhs; simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_sub]
  rw [hsource, hsourceN, htarget, hrank] at h
  conv at h => rhs; simp only [sub_zero, add_zero]
  exact h.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.smul_app_apply
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.unitAt_ne_zero
statement:
theorem unitAt_ne_zero (t : HookTag P) (p : P) (hp : birth t ≤ p)
    (hdeath : ¬ death t ≤ p) : unitAt (k := k) t p hp ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | inl ab =>
      have hmem : p ∈ Hook.support ab.val.1 ab.val.2 := by
        refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
        intro h
        exact hdeath (by simpa [death] using h)
      intro hzero
      have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hzero
      change ((structureMapLinear (Hook.module (k := k) ab.val.1 ab.val.2)
        hp (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support ab.val.1 ab.val.2)
          (Hook.birth_mem ab.property))) : k) = 0 at hval
      rw [SupportInterval.structureMap_val] at hval
      simp [hmem, SupportInterval.one] at hval
  | inr a =>
      intro hzero
      have hpa : a ≤ p := by simpa [birth] using hp
      have hunit : HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hpa
          (unitAt (k := k) (.inr a) p hp) = 1 := by
        change HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hpa
          (structureMapLinear (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) hpa
            (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) a)) = 1
        rw [HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe_structureMap
          (R := k) (le_refl a) hpa, HookInfinity.fiberEquiv_birth]
      have hzero' : unitAt (k := k) (.inr a) p hp = 0 := hzero
      have hval := congrArg (HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hpa) hzero'
      have hone : (1 : k) = 0 := by
        calc
          1 = HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hpa
              (unitAt (k := k) (.inr a) p hp) := hunit.symm
          _ = HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hpa 0 := hval
          _ = 0 := map_zero _
      exact one_ne_zero hone

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.finiteTargetMapZero
statement:
private theorem finiteTargetMapZero
    (ab cd : FiniteHookDeflation.StrictPair P)
    (h : HomCondition (.inl ab) (.inl cd)) :
    structureMapLinear (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2) ab.property.le
      (unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) ab.val.1 h.1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc : cd.val.1 ≤ ab.val.1 ∧ cd.val.2 ≤ ab.val.2 ∧
      ¬ cd.val.2 ≤ ab.val.1 := by
    simpa [HomCondition, endpoints, birth, death] using h
  have htargetZero : structureMapLinear
      (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2) (hc.1.trans ab.property.le) = 0 := by
    exact SupportInterval.structureMap_eq_zero_of_not_mem
      (Hook.support cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
      (Hook.support_ordConnected cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
      (hc.1.trans ab.property.le) (fun hx => hx.2.2 hc.2.1)
  change structureMapLinear (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
      ab.property.le
      (structureMapLinear (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
        hc.1 (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
          (Hook.birth_mem cd.property))) = 0
  have hcv : structureMapLinear (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
      ab.property.le
        (structureMapLinear (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
          hc.1 (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
            (Hook.birth_mem cd.property))) =
      structureMapLinear (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
        (hc.1.trans ab.property.le)
        (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
          (Hook.birth_mem cd.property)) := by
    simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply] using
      (congrArg
        (fun f : (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2).obj cd.val.1 →ₗ[k]
            (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2).obj ab.val.2 =>
          f (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
            (Hook.birth_mem cd.property)))
        (structureMapLinear_comp (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
          hc.1 ab.property.le)).symm
  rw [hcv, htargetZero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.normalizedHom_app_birth
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalizedHom_app_birth (s t : HookTag P) (h : HomCondition s t) :
    ((normalizedHom (k := k) s t h).app (birth s)).hom (birthUnit (k := k) s) =
      unitAt (k := k) t (birth s) h.1
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | inl ab =>
      cases t with
      | inl cd =>
          have hp : cd.val.1 ≤ ab.val.1 := by
            simpa [HomCondition, endpoints, birth, death] using h.1
          change ((Hook.fromGenerator ab.property (hookModule (k := k) (.inl cd))
              (unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) ab.val.1 hp)
              (finiteTargetMapZero (k := k) ab cd h)).app ab.val.1).hom
              (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support ab.val.1 ab.val.2)
                (Hook.birth_mem ab.property)) =
            unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) ab.val.1 h.1
          exact Hook.fromGenerator_birth ab.property _ _ _
      | inr c => simp [HomCondition, endpoints, birth, death] at h
  | inr a =>
      cases t with
      | inl cd =>
          change ((HookInfinity.fromBirth a (hookModule (k := k) (.inl cd))
              (unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) a
                (by simpa [HomCondition, endpoints, birth, death] using h.1))).app a).hom
              (HookInfinity.birth a) = unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) a h.1
          exact HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth a _ _
      | inr b =>
          change ((HookInfinity.fromBirth a (hookModule (k := k) (.inr b))
              (unitAt (k := k) (.inr b) a
                (by simpa [HomCondition, endpoints, birth, death] using h.1))).app a).hom
              (HookInfinity.birth a) = unitAt (k := k) (.inr b) a h.1
          exact HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth a _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.unitAt_span
statement:
theorem unitAt_span (t : HookTag P) (p : P) (hp : birth t ≤ p)
    (x : (hookModule (k := k) t).obj p) :
    x = unitCoefficient (k := k) t p hp x • unitAt (k := k) t p hp
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases t with
  | inl cd =>
      let S := Hook.support cd.val.1 cd.val.2
      have hbirth : cd.val.1 ≤ p := by simpa [birth] using hp
      change SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S p at x
      let u : SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S p :=
        unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) p hp
      have hunitval : u.val = if p ∈ S then 1 else 0 := by
        change (structureMapLinear (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
          hbirth
          (SupportInterval.one S (Hook.birth_mem cd.property)) : k) = _
        rw [SupportInterval.structureMap_val S (Hook.support_ordConnected cd.val.1 cd.val.2)
          hbirth (SupportInterval.one S (Hook.birth_mem cd.property))]
        simp [S, SupportInterval.one]
      have hxval : x.val = if p ∈ S then x.val else 0 := by
        by_cases hmem : p ∈ S
        · simp [hmem]
        · simp [hmem, SupportInterval.val_eq_zero S hmem x]
      apply Subtype.ext
      change x.val = x.val * u.val
      rw [hxval, hunitval]
      by_cases hmem : p ∈ S <;> simp [hmem]
  | inr a =>
      have hpa : a ≤ p := by simpa [birth] using hp
      change (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a).obj p at x
      let u : (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a).obj p :=
        unitAt (k := k) (.inr a) p hp
      have hu : HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hpa u = 1 := by
        change HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hpa
          (structureMapLinear (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) hpa
            (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) a)) = 1
        rw [HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe_structureMap (R := k) (le_rfl : a ≤ a) hpa,
          HookInfinity.fiberEquiv_birth]
      apply (HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hpa).injective
      change HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hpa x =
        HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hpa
          (unitCoefficient (k := k) (.inr a) p hp x • u)
      rw [map_smul, hu]
      simp only [unitCoefficient, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.hom_eq_smul_normalized
statement:
theorem hom_eq_smul_normalized (s t : HookTag P) (h : HomCondition s t)
    (f : hookModule (k := k) s ⟶ hookModule (k := k) t) :
    ∃ c : k, f = c • normalizedHom (k := k) s t h
proof:
:= by
  let m := (f.app (birth s)).hom (birthUnit (k := k) s)
  let c := unitCoefficient (k := k) t (birth s) h.1 m
  have hspan := unitAt_span (k := k) t (birth s) h.1 m
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  cases s with
  | inl ab =>
      cases t with
      | inl cd =>
          let f' : hookModule (k := k) (.inl ab) ⟶ hookModule (k := k) (.inl cd) := f
          let g : hookModule (k := k) (.inl ab) ⟶ hookModule (k := k) (.inl cd) :=
            normalizedHom (k := k) (.inl ab) (.inl cd) h
          apply (Hook.homEquivKernel ab.property
            (hookModule (k := k) (.inl cd))).injective
          apply Subtype.ext
          have hnorm : (g.app ab.val.1).hom
              (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support ab.val.1 ab.val.2)
                (Hook.birth_mem ab.property)) =
              unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) ab.val.1 h.1 := by
            exact normalizedHom_app_birth (k := k) (.inl ab) (.inl cd) h
          have hfirst : (f'.app ab.val.1).hom
              (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support ab.val.1 ab.val.2)
                (Hook.birth_mem ab.property)) = m := rfl
          have hsecond : m = c • unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) ab.val.1 h.1 := by
            change m = unitCoefficient (k := k) (.inl cd) ab.val.1 h.1 m •
              unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) ab.val.1 h.1
            exact hspan
          have hthird : c • unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) ab.val.1 h.1 =
              c • (g.app ab.val.1).hom
                (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support ab.val.1 ab.val.2)
                  (Hook.birth_mem ab.property)) := by rw [hnorm]
          exact hfirst.trans (hsecond.trans hthird)
      | inr b => exact (homCondition_finite_infinite ab b h).elim
  | inr a =>
      cases t with
      | inl cd =>
          let f' : hookModule (k := k) (.inr a) ⟶ hookModule (k := k) (.inl cd) := f
          let g : hookModule (k := k) (.inr a) ⟶ hookModule (k := k) (.inl cd) :=
            normalizedHom (k := k) (.inr a) (.inl cd) h
          apply (HookInfinity.homEquivFiber a
            (hookModule (k := k) (.inl cd))).injective
          have hnorm : (g.app a).hom (HookInfinity.birth a) =
              unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) a h.1 := by
            exact normalizedHom_app_birth (k := k) (.inr a) (.inl cd) h
          have hfirst : (f'.app a).hom (HookInfinity.birth a) = m := rfl
          have hsecond : m = c • unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) a h.1 := by
            change m = unitCoefficient (k := k) (.inl cd) a h.1 m •
              unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) a h.1
            exact hspan
          have hthird : c • unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) a h.1 =
              c • (g.app a).hom (HookInfinity.birth a) := by rw [hnorm]
          exact hfirst.trans (hsecond.trans hthird)
      | inr b =>
          let f' : hookModule (k := k) (.inr a) ⟶ hookModule (k := k) (.inr b) := f
          let g : hookModule (k := k) (.inr a) ⟶ hookModule (k := k) (.inr b) :=
            normalizedHom (k := k) (.inr a) (.inr b) h
          apply (HookInfinity.homEquivFiber a
            (hookModule (k := k) (.inr b))).injective
          have hnorm : (g.app a).hom (HookInfinity.birth a) =
              unitAt (k := k) (.inr b) a h.1 := by
            exact normalizedHom_app_birth (k := k) (.inr a) (.inr b) h
          have hfirst : (f'.app a).hom (HookInfinity.birth a) = m := rfl
          have hsecond : m = c • unitAt (k := k) (.inr b) a h.1 := by
            change m = unitCoefficient (k := k) (.inr b) a h.1 m •
              unitAt (k := k) (.inr b) a h.1
            exact hspan
          have hthird : c • unitAt (k := k) (.inr b) a h.1 =
              c • (g.app a).hom (HookInfinity.birth a) := by rw [hnorm]
          exact hfirst.trans (hsecond.trans hthird)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.hom_scalar_unique
statement:
theorem hom_scalar_unique (s t : HookTag P) (h : HomCondition s t)
    (f : hookModule (k := k) s ⟶ hookModule (k := k) t) :
    ∃! c : k, f = c • normalizedHom (k := k) s t h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hom_eq_smul_normalized (k := k) s t h f
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  intro d hd
  let n := normalizedHom (k := k) s t h
  have heq : c • n = d • n := hc.symm.trans hd
  have hca : ((c • n).app (birth s)).hom (birthUnit (k := k) s) =
      c • unitAt (k := k) t (birth s) h.1 := by
    calc
      _ = c • ((n.app (birth s)).hom (birthUnit (k := k) s)) :=
        smul_app_apply n c (birth s) (birthUnit (k := k) s)
      _ = c • unitAt (k := k) t (birth s) h.1 := by
        rw [normalizedHom_app_birth]
  have hda : ((d • n).app (birth s)).hom (birthUnit (k := k) s) =
      d • unitAt (k := k) t (birth s) h.1 := by
    calc
      _ = d • ((n.app (birth s)).hom (birthUnit (k := k) s)) :=
        smul_app_apply n d (birth s) (birthUnit (k := k) s)
      _ = d • unitAt (k := k) t (birth s) h.1 := by
        rw [normalizedHom_app_birth]
  have heval := congrArg
    (fun g : hookModule (k := k) s ⟶ hookModule (k := k) t =>
      (g.app (birth s)).hom (birthUnit (k := k) s)) heq
  have hscalar : c • unitAt (k := k) t (birth s) h.1 =
      d • unitAt (k := k) t (birth s) h.1 := hca.symm.trans (heval.trans hda)
  cases t with
  | inl cd =>
      let S := Hook.support cd.val.1 cd.val.2
      let u := unitAt (k := k) (.inl cd) (birth s) h.1
      have hbirth : cd.val.1 ≤ birth s := by
        simpa [endpoints, birth, death] using h.1
      have hdeath : ¬ cd.val.2 ≤ birth s := by
        simpa [endpoints, birth, death] using h.2.2
      have hmem : birth s ∈ S := ⟨hbirth, hdeath⟩
      have hunit : u.val = 1 := by
        change (structureMapLinear (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2) hbirth
          (SupportInterval.one S (Hook.birth_mem cd.property)) : k) = 1
        rw [SupportInterval.structureMap_val]
        simp [S, hmem, SupportInterval.one]
      have hval := congrArg (fun x : SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S (birth s) => x.val)
        hscalar
      change c * u.val = d * u.val at hval
      rw [hunit, mul_one, mul_one] at hval
      exact hval.symm
  | inr b =>
      let u := unitAt (k := k) (.inr b) (birth s) h.1
      change (HookInfinity.module (R := k) b).obj (birth s) at u
      have hba : b ≤ birth s := by simpa [endpoints, birth, death] using h.1
      have hunit : HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hba u = 1 := by
        change HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hba
          (structureMapLinear (HookInfinity.module (R := k) b) hba
            (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) b)) = 1
        rw [HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe_structureMap (R := k) (le_rfl : b ≤ b) hba,
          HookInfinity.fiberEquiv_birth]
      have hval := congrArg (HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hba) hscalar
      change HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hba (c • u) =
        HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hba (d • u) at hval
      simp only [LinearEquiv.map_smul, hunit, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hval
      simpa using hval.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.normalizedHom_ne_zero
statement:
theorem normalizedHom_ne_zero (s t : HookTag P) (h : HomCondition s t) :
    normalizedHom (k := k) s t h ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have heval := congrArg
    (fun f : hookModule (k := k) s ⟶ hookModule (k := k) t =>
      (f.app (birth s)).hom (birthUnit (k := k) s)) hz
  rw [normalizedHom_app_birth] at heval
  exact unitAt_ne_zero (k := k) t (birth s) h.1 h.2.2 heval

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.hom_nonzero_implies_condition
statement:
theorem hom_nonzero_implies_condition (s t : HookTag P)
    (f : hookModule (k := k) s ⟶ hookModule (k := k) t) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    HomCondition s t
proof:
:= by
  have horder := FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.rankProjectiveHook_hom_nonzero_order
    s t f hf
  cases s with
  | inl ab =>
      cases t with
      | inl cd =>
          have ho : cd.val.1 ≤ ab.val.1 ∧ cd.val.2 ≤ ab.val.2 := by
            simpa [FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.rankProjectiveHookHomOrder] using horder
          have hdiagonal : ¬ cd.val.2 ≤ ab.val.1 := by
            intro hd
            have hnot : ab.val.1 ∉ Hook.support cd.val.1 cd.val.2 := by
              intro hx
              exact hx.2 hd
            have hzero : f = 0 := by
              apply (Hook.homEquivKernel ab.property
                (hookModule (k := k) (.inl cd))).injective
              apply Subtype.ext
              apply Subtype.ext
              exact SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (Hook.support cd.val.1 cd.val.2) hnot _
            exact hf hzero
          simpa [HomCondition, endpoints, birth, death] using
            ⟨ho.1, ho.2, hdiagonal⟩
      | inr b =>
          simp [FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.rankProjectiveHookHomOrder] at horder
  | inr a =>
      cases t with
      | inl cd =>
          have hbirth : cd.val.1 ≤ a := by
            simpa [FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.rankProjectiveHookHomOrder] using horder
          have hdiagonal : ¬ cd.val.2 ≤ a := by
            intro hd
            have hnot : a ∉ Hook.support cd.val.1 cd.val.2 := by
              intro hx
              exact hx.2 hd
            have hzero : f = 0 := by
              apply (HookInfinity.homEquivFiber a
                (hookModule (k := k) (.inl cd))).injective
              apply Subtype.ext
              exact SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (Hook.support cd.val.1 cd.val.2) hnot _
            exact hf hzero
          simpa [HomCondition, endpoints, birth, death] using And.intro hbirth hdiagonal
      | inr b =>
          simpa [HomCondition, endpoints, birth, death,
            FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.rankProjectiveHookHomOrder] using horder

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.exists_nonzero_hom_iff
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_hom_iff (s t : HookTag P) :
    (∃ f : hookModule (k := k) s ⟶ hookModule (k := k) t, f ≠ 0) ↔
      HomCondition s t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
    exact hom_nonzero_implies_condition (k := k) s t f hf
  · intro h
    exact ⟨normalizedHom (k := k) s t h, normalizedHom_ne_zero (k := k) s t h⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.hom_eq_zero_of_not_condition
statement:
theorem hom_eq_zero_of_not_condition (s t : HookTag P) (h : ¬ HomCondition s t)
    (f : hookModule (k := k) s ⟶ hookModule (k := k) t) : f = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hf
  exact h (hom_nonzero_implies_condition (k := k) s t f hf)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.normalizedHom_app_unitAt
statement:
theorem normalizedHom_app_unitAt (s t : HookTag P) (h : HomCondition s t)
    {p : P} (hp : birth s ≤ p) :
    ((normalizedHom (k := k) s t h).app p).hom
      (unitAt (k := k) s p hp) =
        unitAt (k := k) t p (h.1.trans hp)
proof:
:= by
  let f := normalizedHom (k := k) s t h
  have hnat : (f.app p).hom (unitAt (k := k) s p hp) =
      structureMapLinear (hookModule (k := k) t) hp
        ((f.app (birth s)).hom (birthUnit (k := k) s)) := by
    have hnatural := congrArg
      (fun g : (hookModule (k := k) s).obj (birth s) ⟶
          (hookModule (k := k) t).obj p => g.hom (birthUnit (k := k) s))
      (f.naturality (homOfLE hp))
    change (f.app p).hom
        (structureMapLinear (hookModule (k := k) s) hp (birthUnit (k := k) s)) =
      structureMapLinear (hookModule (k := k) t) hp
        ((f.app (birth s)).hom (birthUnit (k := k) s))
    exact hnatural
  have hcomp : structureMapLinear (hookModule (k := k) t) hp
      (unitAt (k := k) t (birth s) h.1) =
      unitAt (k := k) t p (h.1.trans hp) := by
    change structureMapLinear (hookModule (k := k) t) hp
        (structureMapLinear (hookModule (k := k) t) h.1 (birthUnit (k := k) t)) =
      structureMapLinear (hookModule (k := k) t) (h.1.trans hp)
        (birthUnit (k := k) t)
    exact (congrArg
      (fun g : (hookModule (k := k) t).obj (birth t) →ₗ[k]
          (hookModule (k := k) t).obj p => g (birthUnit (k := k) t))
      (structureMapLinear_comp (hookModule (k := k) t) h.1 hp)).symm
  rw [hnat, normalizedHom_app_birth]
  exact hcomp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.normalizedHom_comp_of_condition
statement:
theorem normalizedHom_comp_of_condition (s t u : HookTag P)
    (hst : HomCondition s t) (htu : HomCondition t u) (hsu : HomCondition s u) :
    normalizedHom (k := k) s t hst ≫ normalizedHom (k := k) t u htu =
      normalizedHom (k := k) s u hsu
proof:
:= by
  let f := normalizedHom (k := k) s t hst
  let g := normalizedHom (k := k) t u htu
  have hbirth : ((f ≫ g).app (birth s)).hom (birthUnit (k := k) s) =
      ((normalizedHom (k := k) s u hsu).app (birth s)).hom
        (birthUnit (k := k) s) := by
    change (g.app (birth s)).hom
        ((f.app (birth s)).hom (birthUnit (k := k) s)) =
      ((normalizedHom (k := k) s u hsu).app (birth s)).hom
        (birthUnit (k := k) s)
    calc
      _ = (g.app (birth s)).hom
          (unitAt (k := k) t (birth s) hst.1) := by
        rw [normalizedHom_app_birth]
      _ = unitAt (k := k) u (birth s) (htu.1.trans hst.1) :=
        normalizedHom_app_unitAt (k := k) t u htu hst.1
      _ = ((normalizedHom (k := k) s u hsu).app (birth s)).hom
          (birthUnit (k := k) s) := by
        rw [normalizedHom_app_birth]
  cases s with
  | inl ab =>
      apply (Hook.homEquivKernel ab.property (hookModule (k := k) u)).injective
      apply Subtype.ext
      change ((f ≫ g).app (birth (.inl ab))).hom (birthUnit (k := k) (.inl ab)) =
        ((normalizedHom (k := k) (.inl ab) u hsu).app (birth (.inl ab))).hom
          (birthUnit (k := k) (.inl ab))
      exact hbirth

  | inr a =>
      apply (HookInfinity.homEquivFiber a (hookModule (k := k) u)).injective
      change ((f ≫ g).app (birth (.inr a))).hom (birthUnit (k := k) (.inr a)) =
        ((normalizedHom (k := k) (.inr a) u hsu).app (birth (.inr a))).hom
          (birthUnit (k := k) (.inr a))
      exact hbirth

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.composite_endpoint_order
statement:
theorem composite_endpoint_order (s t u : HookTag P)
    (hst : HomCondition s t) (htu : HomCondition t u) :
    birth u ≤ birth s ∧ death u ≤ death s
proof:
:=
  ⟨htu.1.trans hst.1, htu.2.1.trans hst.2.1⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.normalizedHom_comp_of_not_condition
statement:
theorem normalizedHom_comp_of_not_condition (s t u : HookTag P)
    (hst : HomCondition s t) (htu : HomCondition t u)
    (hsu : ¬ HomCondition s u) :
    normalizedHom (k := k) s t hst ≫ normalizedHom (k := k) t u htu = 0
proof:
:=
  hom_eq_zero_of_not_condition (k := k) s u hsu _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.composite_condition_iff_no_diagonal
statement:
theorem composite_condition_iff_no_diagonal (s t u : HookTag P)
    (hst : HomCondition s t) (htu : HomCondition t u) :
    HomCondition s u ↔ ¬ death u ≤ birth s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hbirth, hdeath⟩ := composite_endpoint_order s t u hst htu
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.2.2
  · exact fun h => ⟨hbirth, hdeath, h⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHom.normalizedHom_comp_of_diagonal
statement:
theorem normalizedHom_comp_of_diagonal (s t u : HookTag P)
    (hst : HomCondition s t) (htu : HomCondition t u)
    (hdiag : death u ≤ birth s) :
    normalizedHom (k := k) s t hst ≫ normalizedHom (k := k) t u htu = 0
proof:
:=
  normalizedHom_comp_of_not_condition (k := k) s t u hst htu
    (fun h => h.2.2 hdiag)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.gaussian_zero_at_infty
statement:
private theorem gaussian_zero_at_infty {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun p => kernel σ p q) (cocompact (ℝ × ℝ)) (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  let e := (WithLp.homeomorphProd 2 ℝ ℝ).symm
  have he : Tendsto e (cocompact (ℝ × ℝ)) (cocompact GaussianSpectral.Plane) :=
    e.isClosedEmbedding.tendsto_cocompact
  have ht : Tendsto (fun p => e p - e q) (cocompact (ℝ × ℝ))
      (cocompact GaussianSpectral.Plane) :=
    (Homeomorph.subRight (e q)).isClosedEmbedding.tendsto_cocompact.comp he
  have hn := tendsto_norm_cocompact_atTop.comp ht
  have hp := (tendsto_pow_atTop (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)).comp hn
  have hd := hp.atTop_div_const (by positivity : 0 < 2 * σ ^ 2)
  have hz := Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp (tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp hd)
  have hker (p : ℝ × ℝ) : kernel σ p q =
      Real.exp (-‖e p - e q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2)) := by
    rw [kernel_eq_gaussian]
    rfl
  simpa only [hker, Function.comp_def, neg_div] using hz

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.gaussianSection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem gaussianSection_apply {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    gaussianSection hσ q p = kernel σ p q
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.rkhsFunction_zero_at_infty
statement:
theorem rkhsFunction_zero_at_infty {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (f : Space σ) :
    Tendsto f (cocompact (ℝ × ℝ)) (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  let S : Submodule ℝ (Space σ) :=
    { carrier := {g | ∃ h : C₀(ℝ × ℝ, ℝ), ∀ p, h p = g p}
      zero_mem' := ⟨0, fun p => by simp [RKHS.coe_zero]⟩
      add_mem' := by
        rintro g h ⟨g₀, hg⟩ ⟨h₀, hh⟩
        exact ⟨g₀ + h₀, fun p => by simp [hg p, hh p, RKHS.coe_add]⟩
      smul_mem' := by
        rintro c g ⟨g₀, hg⟩
        exact ⟨c • g₀, fun p => by simp [hg p, RKHS.coe_smul]⟩ }
  have hclosed : IsClosed (S : Set (Space σ)) := by
    have hpre := ZeroAtInftyContinuousMap.isClosed_range_toBCF.preimage
      (rkhsToBCFCLM σ).continuous
    convert hpre using 1
    ext g
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨g₀, hg⟩
      exact ⟨g₀, by ext p; exact hg p⟩
    · rintro ⟨g₀, hg⟩
      exact ⟨g₀, fun p => congrArg (fun g : (ℝ × ℝ) →ᵇ ℝ => g p) hg⟩
  have hspan : Submodule.span ℝ {RKHS.kerFun (Space σ) p c | (p) (c)} ≤ S := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro _ ⟨p, c, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨c • gaussianSection hσ p, ?_⟩
    intro q
    simp [gaussianSection, RKHS.kerFun_apply, RKHS.OfKernel.kernel_ofKernel,
      kernelOp_apply, mul_comm]
  have htop : S = ⊤ := by
    apply top_le_iff.1
    rw [← RKHS.kerFun_dense (𝕜 := ℝ) (H := Space σ)]
    exact Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ hspan hclosed
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := show f ∈ S by rw [htop]; trivial
  have heq : (g : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) = f := funext hg
  rw [← heq]
  exact zero_at_infty g

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.rkhsToC0_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rkhsToC0_apply {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (f : Space σ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    rkhsToC0 hσ f p = f p
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_rkhsToC0_le
statement:
theorem norm_rkhsToC0_le {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (f : Space σ) :
    ‖rkhsToC0 hσ f‖ ≤ ‖f‖
proof:
:=
  (BoundedContinuousFunction.norm_le (norm_nonneg f)).2
    (norm_rkhsFunction_apply_le σ f)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.rkhsToC0CLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rkhsToC0CLM_apply {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (f : Space σ) :
    rkhsToC0CLM hσ f = rkhsToC0 hσ f
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_rkhsToC0CLM_le
statement: theorem norm_rkhsToC0CLM_le {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) : ‖rkhsToC0CLM hσ‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_le_bound _ zero_le_one
  intro f
  simpa only [rkhsToC0CLM_apply, one_mul] using norm_rkhsToC0_le hσ f

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.rkhsToC0_featureAt
statement:
@[simp] theorem rkhsToC0_featureAt {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    rkhsToC0 hσ (featureAt σ p) = gaussianSection hσ p
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  simp only [rkhsToC0_apply, featureAt_apply, gaussianSection_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.gaussian_sections_dense
statement:
theorem gaussian_sections_dense {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) :
    Dense (Submodule.span ℝ (range (gaussianSection hσ)) : Set C₀(ℝ × ℝ, ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let S := (Submodule.span ℝ (range (gaussianSection hσ))).topologicalClosure
  suffices htop : S = ⊤ by
    apply dense_iff_closure_eq.2
    exact congrArg (fun T : Submodule ℝ C₀(ℝ × ℝ, ℝ) => (T : Set C₀(ℝ × ℝ, ℝ))) htop
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := SetLike.exists_of_lt (lt_top_iff_ne_top.2 hne)
  have hSclosed : IsClosed (S : Set C₀(ℝ × ℝ, ℝ)) :=
    Submodule.isClosed_topologicalClosure _
  obtain ⟨L, u, hLu, huf⟩ := geometric_hahn_banach_closed_point S.convex
    hSclosed hf.2
  have hvanish (g : C₀(ℝ × ℝ, ℝ)) (hg : g ∈ S) : L g = 0 := by
    by_contra hLg
    have hu := hLu (((u + 1) / L g) • g) (S.smul_mem _ hg)
    rw [map_smul, smul_eq_mul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ hLg] at hu
    linarith
  obtain ⟨μ, ν, hμ, hν, _, _, hrepr⟩ :=
    TDA.Topology.C0MeasureRepresentation.exists_finite_regular_measure_sub L
  let := hμ
  let := hν
  have hembed : positiveEmbedding σ μ = positiveEmbedding σ ν := by
    apply DFunLike.ext
    intro p
    rw [positiveEmbedding_apply, positiveEmbedding_apply]
    have hp := hvanish (gaussianSection hσ p)
      (Submodule.le_topologicalClosure _ (Submodule.subset_span (mem_range_self p)))
    rw [hrepr] at hp
    simpa only [gaussianSection_apply, kernel_symm, sub_eq_zero] using hp
  have hμν := positiveEmbedding_injective hσ μ ν hembed
  have hLzero : L = 0 := by
    ext g
    simp [hrepr, hμν]
  have hu := hLu 0 S.zero_mem
  simp only [hLzero, zero_apply] at hu huf
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.exists_gaussian_span_approx
statement:
theorem exists_gaussian_span_approx {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (f : C₀(ℝ × ℝ, ℝ))
    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ g ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (range (gaussianSection hσ)), ‖g - f‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hdist⟩ := Metric.mem_closure_iff.1 (gaussian_sections_dense hσ f) ε hε
  exact ⟨g, hg, by simpa [dist_eq_norm, norm_sub_rev] using hdist⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.denseRange_rkhsToC0
statement: theorem denseRange_rkhsToC0 {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) : DenseRange (rkhsToC0CLM hσ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : Submodule.span ℝ (range (gaussianSection hσ)) ≤
      (rkhsToC0CLM hσ).range := by
    apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro _ ⟨p, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨featureAt σ p, by simp⟩
  intro f
  exact closure_mono hsub (gaussian_sections_dense hσ f)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.empty
statement:
private theorem empty (V : Type u) [LinearOrder V] (α : Type w)
    [LinearOrder α] (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    (emptyFilter V α).criticalValues.card = 0 ∧
    gradeHomologyBarcode k (emptyFilter V α) n = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (emptyFilter V α).criticalValues.card = 0 := by
    rw [((emptyFilter V α).criticalValues_eq_empty_iff).2 rfl]
    rfl
  constructor
  · exact hc
  · have hi : IsEmpty (Fin (emptyFilter V α).criticalValues.card) := by
      rw [hc]
      infer_instance
    letI := hi
    simp [gradeHomologyBarcode, rankBarcode]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_H0
statement:
private theorem singleton_H0 (k : Type) [Field k] :
    Module.finrank k ((simplicialHomologyPModule k singletonFilter.gradeFiltration 0).obj s0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplicialHomologyPModule_obj, singleton_stage]
  exact (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv k (0 : Fin 2)).finrank_eq.trans (Module.finrank_self k)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_H1
statement:
private theorem singleton_H1 (k : Type) [Field k] :
    Module.finrank k ((simplicialHomologyPModule k singletonFilter.gradeFiltration 1).obj s0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplicialHomologyPModule_obj, singleton_stage]
  have hc : Subsingleton (Chain (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 1) :=
    ⟨fun a b => (singletonHigherChain_eq_zero (0 : Fin 2) k 0 a).trans
      (singletonHigherChain_eq_zero (0 : Fin 2) k 0 b).symm⟩
  letI : Subsingleton (Chain (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 1) := hc
  letI : Subsingleton (simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 1) :=
    inferInstance
  letI : HasQuotient (simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 1)
      (Submodule k (simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 1)) :=
    Submodule.hasQuotient (R := k)
      (M := simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 1)
  letI : Subsingleton (simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 1 ⧸
      simplicialBoundaries (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 1) := inferInstance
  letI : Subsingleton
      (↑(ModuleCat.of k (LinearMap.ker
        ((simplicialChainComplex (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k).sc 1).g.hom ⧸
        LinearMap.range ((simplicialChainComplex
          (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k).sc 1).moduleCatToCycles))) := by
    change Subsingleton (simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 1 ⧸
      simplicialBoundaries (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 1)
    infer_instance
  have hz : Subsingleton (simplicialHomology (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 1) := by
    let e := (homologyKernelQuotient k
      (simplicialChainComplex (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k) 1).toLinearEquiv
    exact ⟨fun a b => e.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
  letI := hz
  exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton (R := k)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_barcode_H1
statement:
private theorem singleton_barcode_H1 (k : Type) [Field k] :
    gradeHomologyBarcode k singletonFilter 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    gradeHomologyBarcode k singletonFilter 1 =
        rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := k)
          (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval singletonFilter.criticalValues.card))) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff
        (simplicialHomologyPModule k singletonFilter.gradeFiltration 1)
        (barcodeModule (k := k)
          (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval singletonFilter.criticalValues.card)))).mpr
      intro i j hij
      have hi : i = s0 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        have h := i.isLt
        change i.val = 0
        have hc := singleton_values
        omega
      have hj : j = s0 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        have h := j.isLt
        change j.val = 0
        have hc := singleton_values
        omega
      subst i
      subst j
      rw [rank_barcodeMap]
      have hr : structureMapRank
          (simplicialHomologyPModule k singletonFilter.gradeFiltration 1) s0 s0 hij = 0 := by
        unfold structureMapRank
        rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
        exact singleton_H1 k
      simpa using hr
    _ = _ := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_Q
statement:
private theorem singleton_Q :
    Module.finrank ℚ ((simplicialHomologyPModule ℚ singletonFilter.gradeFiltration 0).obj s0) = 1 ∧
    gradeHomologyBarcode ℚ singletonFilter 0 =
      ({singletonBar} : Multiset (FiniteInterval singletonFilter.criticalValues.card)) ∧
    Module.finrank ℚ ((simplicialHomologyPModule ℚ singletonFilter.gradeFiltration 1).obj s0) = 0 ∧
    gradeHomologyBarcode ℚ singletonFilter 1 = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨singleton_H0 ℚ, singleton_barcode ℚ, singleton_H1 ℚ, singleton_barcode_H1 ℚ⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.singleton_ZMod2
statement:
private theorem singleton_ZMod2 :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) ((simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2)
      singletonFilter.gradeFiltration 0).obj s0) = 1 ∧
    gradeHomologyBarcode (ZMod 2) singletonFilter 0 =
      ({singletonBar} : Multiset (FiniteInterval singletonFilter.criticalValues.card)) ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) ((simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2)
      singletonFilter.gradeFiltration 1).obj s0) = 0 ∧
    gradeHomologyBarcode (ZMod 2) singletonFilter 1 = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨singleton_H0 (ZMod 2), singleton_barcode (ZMod 2), singleton_H1 (ZMod 2),
    singleton_barcode_H1 (ZMod 2)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_values
statement:
private theorem two_values : twoFilter.criticalValues = {0, 1} ∧
    twoFilter.criticalValues.card = 2
proof: := by decide

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_critical
statement:
private theorem two_critical :
    twoFilter.criticalValue t0 = 0 ∧ twoFilter.criticalValue t1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := twoFilter.criticalValue_mem t0
  have h1 := twoFilter.criticalValue_mem t1
  have hlt : twoFilter.criticalValue t0 < twoFilter.criticalValue t1 :=
    twoFilter.criticalValue.strictMono (by
      apply Fin.lt_def.mpr
      decide)
  simp only [two_values.1, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at h0 h1
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_critical0
statement: private theorem two_critical0 : twoFilter.criticalValue t0 = 0
proof: := two_critical.1

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_critical1
statement: private theorem two_critical1 : twoFilter.criticalValue t1 = 1
proof: := two_critical.2

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_stage0
statement:
private theorem two_stage0 :
    twoFilter.gradeFiltration t0 = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twoFilter.gradeFiltration_apply, two_critical0]
  ext s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨hsK, hv⟩ := (twoFilter.mem_sublevel_iff 0 s).mp hs
    have hmem : s = ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∨ s = {1} := hsK
    rcases hmem with h | h
    · exact h
    · subst s
      simp [twoFilter] at hv
  · intro hs
    have h : s = ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) := hs
    subst s
    exact (twoFilter.mem_sublevel_iff 0 _).mpr ⟨Or.inl rfl, by simp [twoFilter]⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_stage1
statement: private theorem two_stage1 : twoFilter.gradeFiltration t1 = twoVertices
proof:
:= by
  rw [twoFilter.gradeFiltration_apply, two_critical1]
  apply twoFilter.sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
  intro s
  by_cases h : s.val = ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) <;> simp [twoFilter, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_face0_card
statement: private theorem two_face0_card : Fintype.card (Face twoVertices 0) = 2
proof: := by decide

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_short_f_zero
statement:
private theorem two_short_f_zero (k : Type) [Field k] :
    ((simplicialChainComplex twoVertices k).sc 0).f = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (simplicialChainComplex twoVertices k).d 1 0 = 0 := by
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    ext c
    change (boundary twoVertices k 0) c = 0
    have hc : c = 0 := by
      change Chain twoVertices k 1 at c
      exact Subsingleton.elim c 0
    rw [hc]
    exact map_zero _
  change (simplicialChainComplex twoVertices k).d
    ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev 0) 0 = 0
  rw [ChainComplex.prev]
  exact hf

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_short_g_zero
statement:
private theorem two_short_g_zero (k : Type) [Field k] :
    ((simplicialChainComplex twoVertices k).sc 0).g = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (simplicialChainComplex twoVertices k).d
    0 ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).next 0) = 0
  rw [ChainComplex.next_nat_zero]
  exact simplicialChainComplex_d_zero twoVertices k 0

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_H0_stage0
statement:
private theorem two_H0_stage0 (k : Type) [Field k] :
    Module.finrank k ((simplicialHomologyPModule k twoFilter.gradeFiltration 0).obj t0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplicialHomologyPModule_obj, two_stage0]
  exact (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv k (0 : Fin 2)).finrank_eq.trans (Module.finrank_self k)

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_H0_stage1
statement:
private theorem two_H0_stage1 (k : Type) [Field k] :
    Module.finrank k ((simplicialHomologyPModule k twoFilter.gradeFiltration 0).obj t1) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplicialHomologyPModule_obj, two_stage1]
  rw [(twoH0Equiv k).finrank_eq]
  change Module.finrank k (Chain twoVertices k 0) = 2
  rw [Module.finrank_finsupp_self]
  exact two_face0_card

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_boundaries_zero
statement:
private theorem two_boundaries_zero (k : Type) [Field k] :
    simplicialBoundaries twoVertices k 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  let S := (simplicialChainComplex twoVertices k).sc 0
  have hm : S.moduleCatToCycles = 0 := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    change S.f.hom x = 0
    rw [two_short_f_zero k]
    rfl
  change LinearMap.range S.moduleCatToCycles = ⊥
  rw [hm]
  exact LinearMap.range_zero

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_map_rank
statement:
private theorem two_map_rank (k : Type) [Field k] :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl k (show singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) ≤ twoVertices
        from le_sup_left) 0).hom) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let h : singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) ≤ twoVertices := le_sup_left
  let z : simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 0 :=
    ⟨Finsupp.single (singletonVertex (0 : Fin 2)) 1, by
      rw [simplicialCycles_zero]
      trivial⟩
  letI : HasQuotient (simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 0)
      (Submodule k (simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 0)) :=
    Submodule.hasQuotient (R := k)
      (M := simplicialCycles (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 0)
  letI : HasQuotient (simplicialCycles twoVertices k 0)
      (Submodule k (simplicialCycles twoVertices k 0)) :=
    Submodule.hasQuotient (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles twoVertices k 0)
  let q := (simplicialBoundaries (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 0).mkQ z
  have htarget : (simplicialBoundaries twoVertices k 0).mkQ
      (simplicialCycleIncl k h 0 z) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    let P : Submodule k (simplicialCycles twoVertices k 0) :=
      simplicialBoundaries twoVertices k 0
    have hP : P = ⊥ := two_boundaries_zero k
    have hc : simplicialCycleIncl k h 0 z = 0 := by
      have hm : simplicialCycleIncl k h 0 z ∈ P := by
        simpa only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] using hz
      rw [hP] at hm
      simpa using hm
    have hchain := congrArg (fun x : simplicialCycles twoVertices k 0 =>
      (x : Chain twoVertices k 0)) hc
    rw [simplicialCycleIncl_coe, chainIncl_single] at hchain
    simp [z] at hchain
  have hquot : simplicialQuotientIncl k h 0 q ≠ 0 := by
    rw [show simplicialQuotientIncl k h 0 q =
      (simplicialBoundaries twoVertices k 0).mkQ
        (simplicialCycleIncl k h 0 z) from simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ k h 0 z]
    exact htarget
  let e0 := (homologyKernelQuotient.{0,0,0} k
    (simplicialChainComplex (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k) 0).toLinearEquiv
  let e1 := (homologyKernelQuotient.{0,0,0} k
    (simplicialChainComplex twoVertices k) 0).toLinearEquiv
  let x := e0.symm q
  have hnat : e1 ((simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom x) =
      simplicialQuotientIncl k h 0 q := by
    have hh := simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality k h 0
    have hx := congrArg (fun f : simplicialHomology (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 0 ⟶
      ModuleCat.of k (simplicialCycles twoVertices k 0 ⧸ simplicialBoundaries twoVertices k 0) =>
      f.hom x) hh
    change e1 ((simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom x) =
      simplicialQuotientIncl k h 0 (e0 x) at hx
    exact hx.trans (by rw [show e0 x = q from e0.apply_symm_apply q])
  have himage : (simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    apply hquot
    have hz := congrArg e1 hx
    exact hnat.symm.trans (hz.trans e1.map_zero)
  have hrpos : 0 < Module.finrank k
      (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom) := by
    apply Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mpr
    refine ⟨⟨(simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom x, ⟨x, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩
    exact fun hy => himage (congrArg Subtype.val hy)
  have hrle := LinearMap.finrank_range_le (simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom
  have hd : Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) k 0) = 1 :=
    (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv k (0 : Fin 2)).finrank_eq.trans (Module.finrank_self k)
  rw [hd] at hrle
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.incl_rank_congr
statement:
private theorem incl_rank_congr (k : Type) [Field k]
    {A B A' B' : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)}
    (hA : A = A') (hB : B = B') (h : A ≤ B) (h' : A' ≤ B') :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom) =
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k h' 0).hom)
proof:
:= by
  cases hA
  cases hB
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_barcode
proof:
:= by
  calc
    gradeHomologyBarcode k twoFilter 0 =
        rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := k) ({twoBar02, twoBar12} :
          Multiset (FiniteInterval twoFilter.criticalValues.card))) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff
        (simplicialHomologyPModule k twoFilter.gradeFiltration 0)
        (barcodeModule (k := k) ({twoBar02, twoBar12} :
          Multiset (FiniteInterval twoFilter.criticalValues.card)))).mpr
      intro i j hij
      have hi : i = t0 ∨ i = t1 := by
        have hb := i.isLt
        have hcard := two_values.2
        rcases (show i.val = 0 ∨ i.val = 1 by omega) with h | h
        · left; apply Fin.ext; exact h
        · right; apply Fin.ext; exact h
      have hj : j = t0 ∨ j = t1 := by
        have hb := j.isLt
        have hcard := two_values.2
        rcases (show j.val = 0 ∨ j.val = 1 by omega) with h | h
        · left; apply Fin.ext; exact h
        · right; apply Fin.ext; exact h
      rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hj with rfl | rfl
      · rw [rank_barcodeMap]
        have hr : structureMapRank
            (simplicialHomologyPModule k twoFilter.gradeFiltration 0) t0 t0 hij = 1 := by
          unfold structureMapRank
          rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
          exact two_H0_stage0 k
        rw [hr]
        decide
      · rw [rank_barcodeMap]
        have hr : structureMapRank
            (simplicialHomologyPModule k twoFilter.gradeFiltration 0) t0 t1 hij = 1 := by
          change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
            (simplicialHomologyIncl k (twoFilter.gradeFiltration.monotone hij) 0).hom) = 1
          exact (incl_rank_congr k two_stage0 two_stage1 _ _).trans (two_map_rank k)
        rw [hr]
        decide
      · have h : ¬ t1 ≤ t0 := by
          intro hh
          have := Fin.le_def.mp hh
          change (1 : ℕ) ≤ 0 at this
          omega
        exact (h hij).elim
      · rw [rank_barcodeMap]
        have hr : structureMapRank
            (simplicialHomologyPModule k twoFilter.gradeFiltration 0) t1 t1 hij = 2 := by
          unfold structureMapRank
          rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
          exact two_H0_stage1 k
        rw [hr]
        decide
    _ = _ := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_Q
statement:
private theorem two_Q :
    Module.finrank ℚ ((simplicialHomologyPModule ℚ twoFilter.gradeFiltration 0).obj t0) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank ℚ ((simplicialHomologyPModule ℚ twoFilter.gradeFiltration 0).obj t1) = 2 ∧
    Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl ℚ (show singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) ≤ twoVertices
        from le_sup_left) 0).hom) = 1 ∧
    gradeHomologyBarcode ℚ twoFilter 0 =
      ({twoBar02, twoBar12} : Multiset (FiniteInterval twoFilter.criticalValues.card))
proof:
:=
  ⟨two_H0_stage0 ℚ, two_H0_stage1 ℚ, two_map_rank ℚ, two_barcode ℚ⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Examples.two_ZMod2
statement:
private theorem two_ZMod2 :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) ((simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2)
      twoFilter.gradeFiltration 0).obj t0) = 1 ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) ((simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2)
      twoFilter.gradeFiltration 0).obj t1) = 2 ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) (show singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) ≤ twoVertices
        from le_sup_left) 0).hom) = 1 ∧
    gradeHomologyBarcode (ZMod 2) twoFilter 0 =
      ({twoBar02, twoBar12} : Multiset (FiniteInterval twoFilter.criticalValues.card))
proof:
:=
  ⟨two_H0_stage0 (ZMod 2), two_H0_stage1 (ZMod 2), two_map_rank (ZMod 2),
    two_barcode (ZMod 2)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.hom_ext_birth
statement:
theorem hom_ext_birth (W : GradedGenerators.{v,w} P)
    {M : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} {f g : module (R := R) W ⟶ M}
    (h : ∀ i, f.app (W.grade i) (birth (R := R) W i) =
      g.app (W.grade i) (birth (R := R) W i)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  exact (lift_unique (R := R) W M _ f h).trans
    (lift_unique (R := R) W M _ g (fun _ => rfl)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.hom_ext_birth
statement:
theorem Presentation.hom_ext_birth
    (D : Presentation.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P))
    {M : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} {f g : D.presented ⟶ M}
    (h : ∀ i, (D.cover ≫ f).app (D.generators.grade i) (birth D.generators i) =
      (D.cover ≫ g).app (D.generators.grade i) (birth D.generators i)) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  have : Epi D.cover := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π D.relationMap)
    infer_instance
  exact (cancel_epi D.cover).mp (TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.hom_ext_birth D.generators h)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.postcomp_injective_of_birth_injective
statement:
theorem Presentation.postcomp_injective_of_birth_injective
    (D : Presentation.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P))
    {M N : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} (ρ : M ⟶ N)
    (hG : ∀ g : D.generators.Carrier,
      Function.Injective (ρ.app (D.generators.grade g))) :
    Function.Injective (fun f : D.presented ⟶ M => f ≫ ρ)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  apply D.hom_ext_birth
  intro i
  apply hG i
  exact congrArg (fun q => q.app (D.generators.grade i)
    (D.cover.app (D.generators.grade i) (birth D.generators i))) h

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.exists_lift_of_birth_surjective_relation_injective
statement:
theorem Presentation.exists_lift_of_birth_surjective_relation_injective
    (D : Presentation.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P))
    {M N : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} (ρ : M ⟶ N)
    (hG : ∀ g : D.generators.Carrier,
      Function.Surjective (ρ.app (D.generators.grade g)))
    (hY : ∀ y : D.relations.Carrier,
      Function.Injective (ρ.app (D.relations.grade y)))
    (f : D.presented ⟶ N) : ∃ l : D.presented ⟶ M, l ≫ ρ = f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : ∀ g : D.generators.Carrier, M.obj (D.generators.grade g) :=
    fun g => Classical.choose
      (hG g ((D.cover ≫ f).app (D.generators.grade g) (birth D.generators g)))
  let lG := lift (R := R) D.generators M s
  have hl : lG ≫ ρ = D.cover ≫ f := by
    apply TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.hom_ext_birth D.generators
    intro g
    change ρ.app (D.generators.grade g)
      ((lift (R := R) D.generators M s).app (D.generators.grade g)
        (birth D.generators g)) = _
    rw [lift_birth]
    exact Classical.choose_spec
      (hG g ((D.cover ≫ f).app (D.generators.grade g) (birth D.generators g)))
  have hrel : D.relationMap ≫ lG = 0 := by
    apply TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.hom_ext_birth D.relations
    intro y
    apply hY y
    have hz : D.relationMap ≫ (lG ≫ ρ) = 0 := by
      rw [hl, ← Category.assoc, D.relations_vanish, zero_comp]
    have he := congrArg (fun q => q.app (D.relations.grade y)
      (birth (R := R) D.relations y)) hz
    simpa using he
  refine ⟨D.desc lG hrel, ?_⟩
  have : Epi D.cover := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π D.relationMap)
    infer_instance
  apply (cancel_epi D.cover).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, D.cover_desc]
  exact hl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.postcomp_bijective_of_birth_bijective_relation_injective
statement:
theorem Presentation.postcomp_bijective_of_birth_bijective_relation_injective
    (D : Presentation.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P))
    {M N : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} (ρ : M ⟶ N)
    (hG : ∀ g : D.generators.Carrier,
      Function.Bijective (ρ.app (D.generators.grade g)))
    (hY : ∀ y : D.relations.Carrier,
      Function.Injective (ρ.app (D.relations.grade y))) :
    Function.Bijective (fun f : D.presented ⟶ M => f ≫ ρ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨D.postcomp_injective_of_birth_injective ρ (fun g => (hG g).1),
    D.exists_lift_of_birth_surjective_relation_injective ρ (fun g => (hG g).2) hY⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionKanExamples.principalUpset_has_finiteRankProjectiveResolution
statement:
theorem principalUpset_has_finiteRankProjectiveResolution
    (hn : 0 < n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Nonempty (FiniteRankProjectiveResolution
      (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a))
proof:
:= by
  apply FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_finiteRankProjectiveResolution
    hn
  exact GradedFree.free_finitelyPresented (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ)
    (HookInfinity.generators (P := Fin n → ℝ) a)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionKanExamples.principalUpset_has_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
statement:
theorem principalUpset_has_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
    (hn : 0 < n) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∃ R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k)
        (M := HookInfinity.module (R := k) a),
      ∀ i, IsRankProjectiveCover (R.resolution.quotient i)) ∧
      ∃ x : (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a).obj a, x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨R⟩ :=
      FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
        hn (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a)
        (GradedFree.free_finitelyPresented (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ)
          (HookInfinity.generators (P := Fin n → ℝ) a))
    exact ⟨R, R.quotient_is_cover⟩
  · let e := HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) (i := a) (a := a) le_rfl
    refine ⟨e.symm 1, ?_⟩
    intro hx
    have hone := congrArg e hx
    exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0) (by simpa using hone)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionKanExamples.identity_isRankProjectiveCover
statement:
private theorem identity_isRankProjectiveCover
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hfd : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p))
    (hprojective : IsRankProjective M) : IsRankProjectiveCover (𝟙 M)
proof:
:= by
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hfd
  refine ⟨hprojective, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact RankKernel.rankExact (𝟙 M)
      (fun p x => ⟨x, rfl⟩)
      (by
        intro a b hab x hx
        exact ⟨x, by simp, hx⟩)
  · intro u hu
    have hu' : u = 𝟙 M := by simpa using hu
    rw [hu']
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionKanExamples.zero_identity_isRankProjectiveCover
statement:
theorem zero_identity_isRankProjectiveCover :
    IsRankProjectiveCover (𝟙 (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 2)))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionKanExamples.zero_selected_minimal_cover_index_isEmpty

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionKanExamples.principalUpset_identity_iso_minimal_cover
statement:
theorem principalUpset_identity_iso_minimal_cover (a : Fin 2) :
    (∃ e : HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) a ≅
        (⨁ (principalUpsetSelectedMinimalHookSumCover a).cover.summand),
      e.hom ≫ (principalUpsetSelectedMinimalHookSumCover a).cover.quotient =
        𝟙 (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) a)) ∧
      ∃ x : (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) a).obj a, x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact IsRankProjectiveCover.exists_iso_over_quotient
      (principalUpset_identity_isRankProjectiveCover a)
      (principalUpsetSelectedMinimalHookSumCover a).isRankProjectiveCover
  · let e := HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := ℚ) (i := a) (a := a) le_rfl
    refine ⟨e.symm 1, ?_⟩
    intro hx
    have hone := congrArg e hx
    exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℚ) ≠ 0) (by simpa using hone)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.hookSumTag_mem_grid
statement:
private theorem hookSumTag_mem_grid {ι : Type} [Fintype ι]
    (T : ι → RankProjectiveHookTag (Fin n → ℝ)) (j : ι) :
    rankProjectiveHookTagInGrid (hookSumCoordinateGrid T) (T j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases ht : T j with
  | inl ab =>
      constructor
      · intro i
        apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
        refine ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        rw [ht]
        simp [rankProjectiveHookTagCoordinates]
      · intro i
        apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
        refine ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        rw [ht]
        simp [rankProjectiveHookTagCoordinates]
  | inr a =>
      intro i
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      rw [ht]
      simp [rankProjectiveHookTagCoordinates]

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.rankProjectiveHookTagFromGrid_intoGrid
statement:
private theorem rankProjectiveHookTagFromGrid_intoGrid
    (G : CoordinateGrid n) (t : RankProjectiveHookTag (Fin n → ℝ))
    (ht : rankProjectiveHookTagInGrid G t) :
    rankProjectiveHookTagFromGrid G (rankProjectiveHookTagIntoGrid G t ht) = t
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | inl ab =>
      rcases ht with ⟨hb, hd⟩
      change Sum.inl
        ⟨(G.embedding (fun i => ⟨ab.val.1 i, hb i⟩),
          G.embedding (fun i => ⟨ab.val.2 i, hd i⟩)), _⟩ = Sum.inl ab
      apply congrArg Sum.inl
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Prod.ext
      · funext i
        rfl
      · funext i
        rfl
  | inr a =>
      change Sum.inr (G.embedding (fun i => ⟨a i, ht i⟩)) = Sum.inr a
      apply congrArg Sum.inr
      funext i
      rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.rankProjectiveHookTagIntoGrid_eq_iff
statement:
private theorem rankProjectiveHookTagIntoGrid_eq_iff
    (G : CoordinateGrid n) {s t : RankProjectiveHookTag (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hs : rankProjectiveHookTagInGrid G s) (ht : rankProjectiveHookTagInGrid G t) :
    rankProjectiveHookTagIntoGrid G s hs = rankProjectiveHookTagIntoGrid G t ht ↔
      s = t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := congrArg (rankProjectiveHookTagFromGrid G) h
    rw [rankProjectiveHookTagFromGrid_intoGrid, rankProjectiveHookTagFromGrid_intoGrid] at h'
    exact h'
  · intro h
    cases h
    have hproof : hs = ht := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    cases hproof
    rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.rankProjectiveHookSum_multiplicity_unique_of_iso
statement:
theorem rankProjectiveHookSum_multiplicity_unique_of_iso
    {m r : ℕ} (F : Fin m → RankProjectiveHookTag (Fin n → ℝ))
    (H : Fin r → RankProjectiveHookTag (Fin n → ℝ))
    (e : Nonempty
      ((⨁ fun i => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (F i)) ≅
        ⨁ fun j => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (H j)))
    (c : RankProjectiveHookTag (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    Fintype.card {i : Fin m // F i = c} =
      Fintype.card {j : Fin r // H j = c}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T : Fin m ⊕ (Fin r ⊕ Unit) → RankProjectiveHookTag (Fin n → ℝ) :=
    Sum.elim F (Sum.elim H (fun _ => c))
  let G := hookSumCoordinateGrid T
  let F' : Fin m → RankProjectiveHookTag G.Point := fun i => hookSumGridTag T (.inl i)
  let H' : Fin r → RankProjectiveHookTag G.Point := fun j =>
    hookSumGridTag T (.inr (.inl j))
  let c' : RankProjectiveHookTag G.Point := hookSumGridTag T (.inr (.inr ()))
  rcases e with ⟨e⟩
  let eF : G.lan.obj (⨁ fun i => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (F' i)) ≅
      ⨁ fun i => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (F i) :=
    (G.lanBiproductIso (fun i => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (F' i))).trans
      (biproduct.mapIso (fun i => hookSumGridTagLanIso T (.inl i)))
  let eH : G.lan.obj (⨁ fun j => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (H' j)) ≅
      ⨁ fun j => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (H j) :=
    (G.lanBiproductIso (fun j => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (H' j))).trans
      (biproduct.mapIso (fun j => hookSumGridTagLanIso T (.inr (.inl j))))
  let eGrid := eF.trans (e.trans eH.symm)
  let eGridHom := G.lanMapPreimage eGrid.hom
  let eGridInv := G.lanMapPreimage eGrid.inv
  have hmapHom : G.lan.map eGridHom = eGrid.hom := G.lan_map_preimage eGrid.hom
  have hmapInv : G.lan.map eGridInv = eGrid.inv := G.lan_map_preimage eGrid.inv
  have hleft : eGridHom ≫ eGridInv = 𝟙 _ := by
    apply G.lan_map_injective
    calc
      G.lan.map (eGridHom ≫ eGridInv) = G.lan.map eGridHom ≫ G.lan.map eGridInv :=
        Functor.map_comp _ _ _
      _ = eGrid.hom ≫ eGrid.inv := by rw [hmapHom, hmapInv]
      _ = 𝟙 _ := eGrid.hom_inv_id
      _ = G.lan.map (𝟙 _) := by simp
  have hright : eGridInv ≫ eGridHom = 𝟙 _ := by
    apply G.lan_map_injective
    calc
      G.lan.map (eGridInv ≫ eGridHom) = G.lan.map eGridInv ≫ G.lan.map eGridHom :=
        Functor.map_comp _ _ _
      _ = eGrid.inv ≫ eGrid.hom := by rw [hmapHom, hmapInv]
      _ = 𝟙 _ := eGrid.inv_hom_id
      _ = G.lan.map (𝟙 _) := by simp
  let eFinite :
      (⨁ fun i => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (F' i)) ≅
        ⨁ fun j => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (H' j) :=
    ⟨eGridHom, eGridInv, hleft, hright⟩
  have hfinite :=
    FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookSum_multiplicity_unique
      F' H' ⟨eFinite⟩ c'
  have hFiff (i : Fin m) : F i = c ↔ F' i = c' := by
    exact (rankProjectiveHookTagIntoGrid_eq_iff G
      (hookSumTag_mem_grid T (.inl i)) (hookSumTag_mem_grid T (.inr (.inr ())))).symm
  have hHiff (j : Fin r) : H j = c ↔ H' j = c' := by
    exact (rankProjectiveHookTagIntoGrid_eq_iff G
      (hookSumTag_mem_grid T (.inr (.inl j))) (hookSumTag_mem_grid T (.inr (.inr ())))).symm
  let eFCard : {i : Fin m // F i = c} ≃ {i : Fin m // F' i = c'} := {
    toFun := fun i => ⟨i.1, (hFiff i.1).mp i.2⟩
    invFun := fun i => ⟨i.1, (hFiff i.1).mpr i.2⟩
    left_inv := by intro i; cases i; rfl
    right_inv := by intro i; cases i; rfl
  }
  let eHCard : {j : Fin r // H j = c} ≃ {j : Fin r // H' j = c'} := {
    toFun := fun j => ⟨j.1, (hHiff j.1).mp j.2⟩
    invFun := fun j => ⟨j.1, (hHiff j.1).mpr j.2⟩
    left_inv := by intro j; cases j; rfl
    right_inv := by intro j; cases j; rfl
  }
  calc
    Fintype.card {i : Fin m // F i = c} =
        Fintype.card {i : Fin m // F' i = c'} := Fintype.card_congr eFCard
    _ = Fintype.card {j : Fin r // H' j = c'} := hfinite
    _ = Fintype.card {j : Fin r // H j = c} := (Fintype.card_congr eHCard).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_rankProjective_iff_exists_hook_sum
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_rankProjective_iff_exists_hook_sum
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    IsRankProjective M ↔
      ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ t : Fin m → RankProjectiveHookTag (Fin n → ℝ),
        Nonempty (M ≅ ⨁ fun i => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (t i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hR
    obtain ⟨G, A, hA, e, hcover, _, _⟩ :=
      finitelyPresented_exists_finiteHookRankExactCover hM
    let C : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point := FiniteHookDeflation.module A
    let Q : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ) := ⨁ fun t => G.embeddedCoverFamily A t
    let c : G.lan.obj C ≅ Q := G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A
    let f : G.lan.obj C ⟶ G.lan.obj A := G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)
    let π : Q ⟶ M := c.inv ≫ f ≫ e.hom
    let ι : G.lan.obj (kernel (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)) ⟶ Q :=
      G.lan.map (kernel.ι (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)) ≫ c.hom
    have hπ : IsRankExact ι π := by
      simpa [ι, π, c, f, Category.assoc] using hcover
    obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := hR _ _ _ ι π hπ (𝟙 M)
    let t : G.lan.obj A ⟶ G.lan.obj C := e.hom ≫ β ≫ c.inv
    have ht : t ≫ f = 𝟙 (G.lan.obj A) := by
      apply (cancel_mono e.hom).mp
      have hβ' : β ≫ c.inv ≫ f ≫ e.hom = 𝟙 M := by
        simpa [π, f, Category.assoc] using hβ
      change (t ≫ f) ≫ e.hom = e.hom
      calc
        (t ≫ f) ≫ e.hom = e.hom ≫ (β ≫ c.inv ≫ f ≫ e.hom) := by
          simp [t, Category.assoc]
        _ = e.hom := by rw [hβ']; simp
    let s : A ⟶ C := G.lanMapPreimage t
    have hmap : G.lan.map s = t := G.lan_map_preimage t
    have hs : s ≫ FiniteHookDeflation.π A = 𝟙 A := by
      apply G.lan_map_injective
      calc
        G.lan.map (s ≫ FiniteHookDeflation.π A) =
            G.lan.map s ≫ G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) :=
          Functor.map_comp _ _ _
        _ = t ≫ f := by
          simpa [f] using congrArg
            (fun g => g ≫ G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)) hmap
        _ = 𝟙 (G.lan.obj A) := ht
        _ = G.lan.map (𝟙 A) := by simp
    have hAproj : IsRankProjective A :=
      (FiniteHookDeflation.isRankProjective A).of_retract s
        (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) hs
    obtain ⟨S, ⟨eA⟩⟩ :=
      (FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjective_iff_exists_canonical_subfamily
        A hA).mp hAproj
    let tagsS : S → RankProjectiveHookTag (Fin n → ℝ) :=
      fun i => embeddedCoverTag G A i.1
    let v : Fin (Fintype.card S) ≃ S := (Fintype.equivFin S).symm
    let tags : Fin (Fintype.card S) → RankProjectiveHookTag (Fin n → ℝ) :=
      fun i => tagsS (v i)
    let summands : Fin (Fintype.card S) → PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ) :=
      fun i => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (tags i)
    let eLanA := G.lan.mapIso eA
    let eBip := G.lanBiproductIso (fun i : S => FiniteHookDeflation.family A i.1)
    let eHooks := biproduct.mapIso (fun i : S =>
      embeddedCoverOccurrenceLanIso G A i.1)
    have hfamily :
        summands ∘ v.symm =
          (fun i : S => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (tagsS i)) := by
      funext i
      simp [summands, tags, tagsS]
    have eReindex :
        (⨁ fun i : S => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (tagsS i)) ≅ ⨁ summands := by
      simpa only [hfamily] using (biproduct.reindex v.symm summands)
    refine ⟨Fintype.card S, tags, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨e.symm.trans (eLanA.trans (eBip.trans (eHooks.trans eReindex)))⟩
  · rintro ⟨m, t, ⟨e⟩⟩
    have hsum : IsRankProjective
        (⨁ fun i : Fin m => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (t i)) :=
      IsRankProjective.biproduct _ (fun i => by
        cases t i with
        | inl ab => exact Hook.isRankProjective ab.property
        | inr a => exact HookInfinity.isRankProjective a)
    exact hsum.of_iso e.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.endpointIndexMultiset_nodup
statement:
private theorem endpointIndexMultiset_nodup :
    (endpointIndexMultiset k F e p).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Multiset.nodup_iff_count_le_one.mpr
  intro i
  have h := faceTemplate_endpoint_count_le_one k e i p
  simpa only [endpointIndexMultiset, Multiset.count_add, Multiset.count_map,
    Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter, eq_comm, add_assoc, add_comm, add_left_comm] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.faceLossSlotFace_injective
statement:
theorem faceLossSlotFace_injective :
    Function.Injective (faceLossSlotFace k F e p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P := faceTemplatePairs k e p
  let C := faceTemplateEssential k e p
  let A := P.map Prod.fst
  let B := P.map Prod.snd
  have hM : (A + B + C).Nodup := endpointIndexMultiset_nodup k F e p
  have hAB : (A + B).Nodup := (Multiset.nodup_add.mp hM).1
  have hA : A.Nodup := (Multiset.nodup_add.mp hAB).1
  have hB : B.Nodup := (Multiset.nodup_add.mp hAB).2.1
  have hC : C.Nodup := (Multiset.nodup_add.mp hM).2.1
  have hABdis : Disjoint A B := (Multiset.nodup_add.mp hAB).2.2
  have hACdis : Disjoint A C :=
    (Multiset.disjoint_add_left.mp (Multiset.nodup_add.mp hM).2.2).1
  have hBCdis : Disjoint B C :=
    (Multiset.disjoint_add_left.mp (Multiset.nodup_add.mp hM).2.2).2
  have hAget : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin P.toList.length => (P.toList.get i).1) := by
    have hd : (P.toList.map Prod.fst).Nodup := by
      have hm : (↑(P.toList.map Prod.fst) : Multiset _) = A := by
        simp only [← Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.coe_toList]
        rfl
      exact Multiset.coe_nodup.mp (hm.symm ▸ hA)
    intro i j hij
    have hij' : (P.toList.map Prod.fst).get
        ⟨i.val, by simpa using i.isLt⟩ =
        (P.toList.map Prod.fst).get ⟨j.val, by simpa using j.isLt⟩ := by
      simpa [List.get, List.getElem_map] using hij
    have hv := congrArg (fun t : Fin (P.toList.map Prod.fst).length => t.val)
      (hd.injective_get hij')
    exact Fin.ext hv
  have hBget : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin P.toList.length => (P.toList.get i).2) := by
    have hd : (P.toList.map Prod.snd).Nodup := by
      have hm : (↑(P.toList.map Prod.snd) : Multiset _) = B := by
        simp only [← Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.coe_toList]
        rfl
      exact Multiset.coe_nodup.mp (hm.symm ▸ hB)
    intro i j hij
    have hij' : (P.toList.map Prod.snd).get
        ⟨i.val, by simpa using i.isLt⟩ =
        (P.toList.map Prod.snd).get ⟨j.val, by simpa using j.isLt⟩ := by
      simpa [List.get, List.getElem_map] using hij
    have hv := congrArg (fun t : Fin (P.toList.map Prod.snd).length => t.val)
      (hd.injective_get hij')
    exact Fin.ext hv
  have hCget : Function.Injective (fun i : Fin C.toList.length => C.toList.get i) := by
    have hd : C.toList.Nodup := by
      have hm : (↑C.toList : Multiset _) = C := by simp
      exact Multiset.coe_nodup.mp (hm.symm ▸ hC)
    exact hd.injective_get
  have hAmem (i : Fin P.toList.length) : (P.toList.get i).1 ∈ A := by
    exact Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨P.toList.get i,
      Multiset.mem_toList.mp (List.get_mem P.toList i), rfl⟩
  have hBmem (i : Fin P.toList.length) : (P.toList.get i).2 ∈ B := by
    exact Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨P.toList.get i,
      Multiset.mem_toList.mp (List.get_mem P.toList i), rfl⟩
  have hCmem (i : Fin C.toList.length) : C.toList.get i ∈ C :=
    Multiset.mem_toList.mp (List.get_mem C.toList i)
  intro j j' h
  have hi := e.enum.injective h
  rcases j with ((i | i) | i) <;> rcases j' with ((j | j) | j)
  all_goals simp only [faceLossSlotIndex] at hi
  · exact congrArg (fun a => Sum.inl (Sum.inl a)) (hAget hi)
  · exact ((Multiset.disjoint_left.mp hABdis) (hAmem i) (hi ▸ hBmem j)).elim
  · exact ((Multiset.disjoint_left.mp hACdis) (hAmem i) (hi ▸ hCmem j)).elim
  · exact ((Multiset.disjoint_left.mp hABdis) (hAmem j) (hi.symm ▸ hBmem i)).elim
  · exact congrArg (fun a => Sum.inl (Sum.inr a)) (hBget hi)
  · exact ((Multiset.disjoint_left.mp hBCdis) (hBmem i) (hi ▸ hCmem j)).elim
  · exact ((Multiset.disjoint_left.mp hACdis) (hAmem j) (hi.symm ▸ hCmem i)).elim
  · exact ((Multiset.disjoint_left.mp hBCdis) (hBmem j) (hi.symm ▸ hCmem i)).elim
  · exact congrArg Sum.inr (hCget hi)

@[simp] theorem faceLossSlotRead_pack (w : FaceLossSlot k F e p → ℝ)
