name: TDA.Persistence.faceValueSelectionLinear_norm_le
statement:
private theorem faceValueSelectionLinear_norm_le (v : TotalFace K → ℝ) :
    ‖faceValueSelectionLinear k F e p v‖ ≤ ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (norm_prod_le_iff).2
  constructor
  · apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg v)).2
    intro i
    apply (norm_prod_le_iff).2
    exact ⟨norm_le_pi_norm v _, norm_le_pi_norm v _⟩
  · apply (pi_norm_le_iff_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg v)).2
    intro i
    exact norm_le_pi_norm v _

name: TDA.Persistence.faceValueSelection_norm_le_one
statement: theorem faceValueSelection_norm_le_one : ‖faceValueSelection k F e p‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous_norm_le _ zero_le_one (by
    intro v
    simpa using faceValueSelectionLinear_norm_le k F e p v)

name: TDA.Persistence.fixedFaceLift_eq_selection
statement:
theorem fixedFaceLift_eq_selection (x : E) :
    fixedFaceLift k F e p x =
      faceValueSelection k F e p (allFaceValues F x)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.faceValueSelection_single_eq_unit
statement:
theorem faceValueSelection_single_eq_unit (j : FaceLossSlot k F e p) :
    faceValueSelection k F e p
      (Pi.single (M := fun _ : TotalFace K => ℝ) (faceLossSlotFace k F e p j) 1) =
      faceLossUnit k F e p j
proof:
:= by
  have hinj := faceLossSlotFace_injective k F e p
  change faceLossSlotPack k F e p
      (fun j' => (Pi.single (M := fun _ : TotalFace K => ℝ)
        (faceLossSlotFace k F e p j) (1 : ℝ))
        (faceLossSlotFace k F e p j')) =
    faceLossSlotPack k F e p
      (Pi.single (M := fun _ : FaceLossSlot k F e p => ℝ) j 1)
  congr 1
  funext j'
  simp only [Pi.single_apply, hinj.eq_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.faceValueSelection_single_eq_zero
statement:
theorem faceValueSelection_single_eq_zero (s : TotalFace K)
    (h : s ∉ Set.range (faceLossSlotFace k F e p)) :
    faceValueSelection k F e p (Pi.single (M := fun _ : TotalFace K => ℝ) s 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change faceLossSlotPack k F e p
      (fun j => (Pi.single (M := fun _ : TotalFace K => ℝ) s (1 : ℝ))
        (faceLossSlotFace k F e p j)) = 0
  have hz : (fun j => (Pi.single (M := fun _ : TotalFace K => ℝ) s (1 : ℝ))
      (faceLossSlotFace k F e p j)) = 0 := by
    funext j
    have hne : s ≠ faceLossSlotFace k F e p j := by
      intro heq
      exact h ⟨j, heq.symm⟩
    simp [Pi.single_apply, hne]
  rw [hz]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.fixedFaceLift_slot_derivative
statement:
theorem fixedFaceLift_slot_derivative {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (j : FaceLossSlot k F e p) (h : E) :
    faceLossSlotRead k F e p j (fderiv ℝ (fixedFaceLift k F e p) x₀ h) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value (faceLossSlotFace k F e p j)) x₀ h
proof:
:= by
  have hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ (allFaceValues F) x₀ :=
    ((contDiffOn_pi.mpr hF).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt_one
  have hL : fderiv ℝ (fixedFaceLift k F e p) x₀ =
      (faceValueSelection k F e p).comp (fderiv ℝ (allFaceValues F) x₀) := by
    have hc := ((faceValueSelection k F e p).hasFDerivAt.comp x₀
      hG.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
    simpa only [Function.comp_def, ← fixedFaceLift_eq_selection] using hc
  rw [hL]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hs : faceLossSlotRead k F e p j
      (faceValueSelection k F e p (fderiv ℝ (allFaceValues F) x₀ h)) =
      (fderiv ℝ (allFaceValues F) x₀ h) (faceLossSlotFace k F e p j) := by
    rcases j with ((i | i) | i) <;> rfl
  rw [hs]
  change (fderiv ℝ (fun x s => (F x).value s) x₀) h
      (faceLossSlotFace k F e p j) = _
  rw [fderiv_pi (fun s =>
    ((hF s).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt_one)]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.faceLossCoefficient_selected
statement:
theorem faceLossCoefficient_selected (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (j : FaceLossSlot k F e p) :
    faceLossCoefficient k F e p W (faceLossSlotFace k F e p j) =
      faceLossSlotCoefficient k F e p W j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold faceLossCoefficient
  split_ifs with h
  · exact congrArg (faceLossSlotCoefficient k F e p W)
      ((faceLossSlotFace_injective k F e p) (Classical.choose_spec h))
  · exact (h ⟨j, rfl⟩).elim

name: TDA.Persistence.faceLossCoefficient_unused
statement:
theorem faceLossCoefficient_unused (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (s : TotalFace K)
    (h : s ∉ Set.range (faceLossSlotFace k F e p)) :
    faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [faceLossCoefficient, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.faceLossCoefficient_eq_basis
statement:
theorem faceLossCoefficient_eq_basis (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (s : TotalFace K) :
    faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s =
      fderiv ℝ (W ∘ orderedQ (faceLiftCounts k F e p).1
        (faceLiftCounts k F e p).2) (fixedFaceLift k F e p x₀)
        (faceValueSelection k F e p
          (Pi.single (M := fun _ : TotalFace K => ℝ) s 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs : s ∈ Set.range (faceLossSlotFace k F e p)
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := hs
    rw [faceLossCoefficient_selected, faceValueSelection_single_eq_unit]
    rfl
  · rw [faceLossCoefficient_unused k F e p W s hs,
      faceValueSelection_single_eq_zero k F e p s hs]
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.linearFunctional_face_sum
statement:
theorem linearFunctional_face_sum {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (T : (I → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : I → ℝ) :
    T v = ∑ i : I, T (Pi.single (M := fun _ : I => ℝ) i 1) * v i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  conv_lhs => rw [pi_eq_sum_univ' v]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.allFaceValues_fderiv_apply
statement:
theorem allFaceValues_fderiv_apply {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (s : TotalFace K) (h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (allFaceValues F) x₀ h s =
      fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀ h
proof:
:= by
  change (fderiv ℝ (fun x t => (F x).value t) x₀) h s = _
  rw [fderiv_pi (fun t =>
    ((hF t).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt_one)]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.fixedFaceLift_fderiv_eq_selection
statement:
theorem fixedFaceLift_fderiv_eq_selection {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) U) :
    fderiv ℝ (fixedFaceLift k F e p) x₀ =
      (faceValueSelection k F e p).comp (fderiv ℝ (allFaceValues F) x₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ (allFaceValues F) x₀ :=
    ((contDiffOn_pi.mpr hF).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt_one
  have hc := ((faceValueSelection k F e p).hasFDerivAt.comp x₀
    hG.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, ← fixedFaceLift_eq_selection] using hc

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_c1_neighborhood
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_c1_neighborhood
    (e : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) (p : ℕ) {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) :
    ∃ N : Set E, IsOpen N ∧ x₀ ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ U ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => W (dgm k (F x) p)) N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hNo, hNx, hNU, hNc⟩ :=
    localLift_scalar_c1 (fun x => dgm k (F x) p) W
      (faceLiftCounts k F e p).1 (faceLiftCounts k F e p).2
      (fixedFaceC1Lift k F e p hU hF horder) x₀ hx hW
  exact ⟨N, hNo, hNx, hNU, hNc⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_hasFDerivAt {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun x => W (dgm k (F x) p))
      (∑ s : TotalFace K, faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s •
        fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀) x₀
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Q := (faceLiftCounts k F e p).1
  let H := (faceLiftCounts k F e p).2
  let D := fderiv ℝ (W ∘ orderedQ Q H) (fixedFaceLift k F e p x₀)
  let R := faceValueSelection k F e p
  let G := fderiv ℝ (allFaceValues F) x₀
  have hchain : HasFDerivAt (fun x => W (dgm k (F x) p))
      (D.comp (fderiv ℝ (fixedFaceLift k F e p) x₀)) x₀ := by
    simpa only [D, Function.comp_def, fixedFaceC1Lift] using
      localLift_scalar_hasFDerivAt (fun x => dgm k (F x) p) W Q H
        (fixedFaceC1Lift k F e p hU hF horder) x₀ hx hW
  have hder : D.comp (fderiv ℝ (fixedFaceLift k F e p) x₀) =
      ∑ s : TotalFace K, faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s •
        fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀ := by
    ext h
    rw [fixedFaceLift_fderiv_eq_selection k F e p hU hx hF]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, Finset.sum_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    have hexp : D (R (G h)) =
        ∑ s : TotalFace K,
          D (R (Pi.single (M := fun _ : TotalFace K => ℝ) s 1)) * (G h) s := by
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] using
        linearFunctional_face_sum (D.comp R) (G h)
    change D (R (G h)) = _
    rw [hexp]
    calc
      (∑ s : TotalFace K,
          D (R (Pi.single (M := fun _ : TotalFace K => ℝ) s 1)) * (G h) s) =
          ∑ s : TotalFace K, faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s *
            fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀ h := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro s _
              rw [faceLossCoefficient_eq_basis k F e p W s,
                allFaceValues_fderiv_apply F hU hx hF s h]
      _ = (∑ s : TotalFace K, faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s •
          fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀) h := by
            simp [Finset.sum_apply, smul_apply]
  rw [hder] at hchain
  exact hchain

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_fderiv
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_fderiv {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun x => W (dgm k (F x) p)) x₀ =
      ∑ s : TotalFace K, faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s •
        fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀
proof:
:=
  (sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_hasFDerivAt k F e p hU hx hF horder W hW).fderiv

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_norm_bound
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_norm_bound {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => W (dgm k (F x) p)) x₀‖ ≤
      ∑ s : TotalFace K, |faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s| *
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_fderiv k F e p hU hx hF horder W hW]
  calc
    ‖∑ s : TotalFace K, faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s •
        fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀‖ ≤
      ∑ s : TotalFace K, ‖faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s •
        fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = _ := by simp [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_derivative_independent
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_derivative_independent
    (e' : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) :
    (∑ s : TotalFace K, faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s •
      fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀) =
    (∑ s : TotalFace K, faceLossCoefficient k F e' p W s •
      fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_fderiv k F e p hU hx hF horder W hW,
    ← sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_fderiv k F e' p hU hx hF horder W hW]

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_direction_independent
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_direction_independent
    (e' : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) (h : E) :
    (∑ s : TotalFace K, faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s •
      fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀) h =
    (∑ s : TotalFace K, faceLossCoefficient k F e' p W s •
      fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀) h
proof:
:= by
  rw [sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_derivative_independent k F e p e' hU hx hF horder W hW]

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_empty_fderiv
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_empty_fderiv (hm : faceCount K = 0)
    {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun x => W (dgm k (F x) p)) x₀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_compatibleOrder (F x₀)
  have : IsEmpty (TotalFace K) := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hm
  simpa using sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_fderiv k F e p hU hx hF horder W hW

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_any_lifts_independent
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_any_lifts_independent
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n m' n' : ℕ)
    (L : LocalDiagramLift (fun x => dgm k (F x) p) m n)
    (L' : LocalDiagramLift (fun x => dgm k (F x) p) m' n')
    (hx : x₀ ∈ L.carrier) (hx' : x₀ ∈ L'.carrier)
    (hW : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) :
    (fderiv ℝ (W ∘ orderedQ m n) (L.coordinates x₀)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ L.coordinates x₀) =
      (fderiv ℝ (W ∘ orderedQ m' n') (L'.coordinates x₀)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ L'.coordinates x₀)
proof:
:=
  localLift_scalar_derivative_independent (fun x => dgm k (F x) p)
    W m n m' n' L L' x₀ hx hx' hW

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.genericDiagramOccurrence_eq_diagramOccurrence
statement:
@[simp] theorem genericDiagramOccurrence_eq_diagramOccurrence
    (p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ) :
    TDA.Persistence.diagramDecoratedPoint p = diagramOccurrence p
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_multiplicity_eq
statement:
theorem qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_multiplicity_eq (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [Fintype X] (n : ℕ) (p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) :
    (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram k
      (Set.finite_univ.totallyBounded : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X)) n).multiplicity p =
      ((diagram k X n).toLocallyFinite (diagram_isPositive k X n)).multiplicity p
proof:
:= by
  have hleft :
      (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram k
        (Set.finite_univ.totallyBounded : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X)) n).multiplicity p =
        qTameDiagramMultiplicity k
          (Set.finite_univ.totallyBounded : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X)) n p := rfl
  have hright :
      ((diagram k X n).toLocallyFinite (diagram_isPositive k X n)).multiplicity p =
        ((diagram k X n).points.map TDA.Persistence.diagramDecoratedPoint).count p := by
    unfold Diagram.toLocallyFinite
    exact count_decEq_irrel p _
  have hmap : TDA.Persistence.diagramDecoratedPoint = diagramOccurrence := by
    funext q
    exact genericDiagramOccurrence_eq_diagramOccurrence q
  rw [hleft, hright]
  rw [hmap]
  exact qTameDiagramMultiplicity_eq_diagramOccurrenceCount (X := X) k n p

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_eq_finite
statement:
private theorem qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_eq_finite (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [Fintype X] (n : ℕ) :
    qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram k
        (Set.finite_univ.totallyBounded : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X)) n =
      (diagram k X n).toLocallyFinite (diagram_isPositive k X n)
proof:
:= by
  apply LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ext
  funext p
  exact qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_multiplicity_eq k n p

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_eq_finite
statement:
theorem qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_eq_finite
    {X Y : Type u} [LinearOrder X] [MetricSpace X] [Fintype X]
    [LinearOrder Y] [MetricSpace Y] [Fintype Y]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := X) k
      (Set.finite_univ.totallyBounded : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X)) n).bottleneck
      (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := Y) k
        (Set.finite_univ.totallyBounded : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set Y)) n) =
      bottleneck (diagram k X n) (diagram k Y n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_eq_finite (X := X) k n,
    qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_eq_finite (X := Y) k n]
  exact bottleneck_toLocallyFinite (diagram k X n) (diagram k Y n)
    (diagram_isPositive k X n) (diagram_isPositive k Y n)

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_le_of_hausdorff_lt
statement:
theorem qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_le_of_hausdorff_lt
    {X Y : Type u} [LinearOrder X] [MetricSpace X]
    [LinearOrder Y] [MetricSpace Y]
    {Z : Type v} [MetricSpace Z] {f : X → Z} {g : Y → Z}
    (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g)
    (hfin : Metric.hausdorffEDist (Set.range f) (Set.range g) ≠ ⊤)
    {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 2 * Metric.hausdorffDist (Set.range f) (Set.range g) < (ε : ℝ))
    (hX : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X))
    (hY : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set Y))
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := X) k hX n).bottleneck
      (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := Y) k hY n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let hQX := qTame_of_totallyBounded k hX n
  let hQY := qTame_of_totallyBounded k hY n
  simpa [qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram, hQX, hQY] using
    TDA.Persistence.qTame_bottleneck_le_of_realInterleaving
      (Rips.hausdorffInterleavingOfLt k hf hg hfin hε n) hQX hQY

name: TDA.Persistence.multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_of_subset
statement:
theorem multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_of_subset {C C' : SetRel X Y} {a : ℝ}
    (hCT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hC'T : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C'))
    (hC : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G a C) (hsub : C' ⊆ C) (n : ℕ) :
    multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R hC'T (hC.of_subset hsub) n =
      multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R hCT hC n
proof:
:= by
  let f : X → Y := fun x => Classical.choose (hC'T x)
  have hf : Function.graph f ⊆ C' := by
    intro ⟨x,y⟩ hxy
    change f x = y at hxy
    rw [← hxy]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hC'T x)
  rw [multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_eq R hC'T _ hf,
    multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_eq R hCT hC (hf.trans hsub)]

name: TDA.Persistence.identityTotal
statement:
private theorem identityTotal (V : Type*) :
    Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ (SetRel.id : SetRel V V))
proof:
:=
  fun x => ⟨x,rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.identityRelation
statement:
private theorem identityRelation (F : SimplicialFiltration ℝ X) (γ : ℝ≥0) :
    IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F F (γ : ℝ) SetRel.id
proof:
:= by
  apply (isShiftedSimplicialRelation_graph_iff id).mpr
  intro t σ hσ
  exact (inclusionVertexMap (F.monotone (le_add_of_nonneg_right γ.coe_nonneg))).map_face σ hσ

name: TDA.Persistence.identityMap_transition
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  change (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R (identityTotal X) (identityRelation F γ) n).app t = _
  rw [multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_app R _ _ (f := id) (Set.Subset.refl _)]
  change simplicialHomologyMap R _ n = simplicialHomologyIncl R _ n
  have hm : ((identityRelation F γ).of_subordinate (Set.Subset.refl _)).vertexMap t =
      inclusionVertexMap (F.monotone (le_add_of_nonneg_right γ.coe_nonneg)) :=
    VertexMap.ext (fun _ => rfl)
  rw [hm, simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion]

name: TDA.Persistence.roundTrip_transition
statement:
private theorem roundTrip_transition {C : SetRel X Y} {D : SetRel Y X} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (hCT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hDT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun y x => (y,x) ∈ D))
    (hC : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G (ε : ℝ) C)
    (hD : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation G F (ε : ℝ) D)
    (hdiag : SetRel.id ⊆ C.comp D) (n : ℕ) :
    multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal R hCT hC n ≫
      (RealShift.shift ε).map (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal R hDT hD n) ≫
      (RealShift.compIso ε ε (simplicialHomologyPModule R F n)).hom =
    RealShift.transition (ε + ε) (simplicialHomologyPModule R F n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal_comp]
  exact (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_of_subset R _ (identityTotal X)
    (show IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F F ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) (C.comp D) from hC.comp hD)
    hdiag n).symm.trans (identityMap_transition R F (ε + ε) n)

name: TDA.Persistence.multivaluedSimplicialHomologyInterleaving_φ
statement:
@[simp] theorem multivaluedSimplicialHomologyInterleaving_φ
    {C : SetRel X Y} {D : SetRel Y X} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (hCT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hDT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun y x => (y,x) ∈ D))
    (hC : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G (ε : ℝ) C)
    (hD : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation G F (ε : ℝ) D)
    (hX : SetRel.id ⊆ C.comp D) (hY : SetRel.id ⊆ D.comp C) (n : ℕ) :
    (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyInterleaving R hCT hDT hC hD hX hY n).φ =
      multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal R hCT hC n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.multivaluedSimplicialHomologyInterleaving_ψ
statement:
@[simp] theorem multivaluedSimplicialHomologyInterleaving_ψ
    {C : SetRel X Y} {D : SetRel Y X} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (hCT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hDT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun y x => (y,x) ∈ D))
    (hC : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G (ε : ℝ) C)
    (hD : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation G F (ε : ℝ) D)
    (hX : SetRel.id ⊆ C.comp D) (hY : SetRel.id ⊆ D.comp C) (n : ℕ) :
    (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyInterleaving R hCT hDT hC hD hX hY n).ψ =
      multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal R hDT hD n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.indexPoint_positive
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [indexPoint]
  split_ifs with hd
  · exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (hv (show (⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩ : Fin N) < ⟨I.death, hd⟩ from I.birth_lt_death))
  · exact WithTop.coe_lt_top _

name: TDA.Persistence.ofIndexBars_isPositive
statement:
theorem ofIndexBars_isPositive (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) :
    (ofIndexBars v hv B).IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hp with ⟨I, _, rfl⟩
  exact indexPoint_positive v hv I

name: TDA.Persistence.indexPoint_eq_finite
statement:
private theorem indexPoint_eq_finite (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v)
    (I : FiniteInterval N) (b d : Fin N) :
    indexPoint v I = (v b, (v d : WithTop α)) ↔
      I.birth = b.val ∧ I.death = d.val
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hb : v ⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩ = v b :=
      congrArg Prod.fst h
    have hb' : I.birth = b.val := congrArg Fin.val (hv.injective hb)
    by_cases hd : I.death < N
    · have hdeath : (v ⟨I.death, hd⟩ : WithTop α) = (v d : WithTop α) := by
        simpa [indexPoint, hd] using congrArg Prod.snd h
      have hd' : I.death = d.val :=
        congrArg Fin.val (hv.injective (WithTop.coe_injective hdeath))
      exact ⟨hb', hd'⟩
    · have hdeath : (⊤ : WithTop α) = (v d : WithTop α) := by
        simpa [indexPoint, hd] using congrArg Prod.snd h
      simp at hdeath
  · rintro ⟨hb, hd⟩
    have hfin : I.death < N := hd ▸ d.isLt
    have hbi : (⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩ : Fin N) = b := Fin.ext hb
    have hdi : (⟨I.death, hfin⟩ : Fin N) = d := Fin.ext hd
    simp [indexPoint, hfin, hbi, hdi]

name: TDA.Persistence.indexPoint_eq_essential
statement:
private theorem indexPoint_eq_essential (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v)
    (I : FiniteInterval N) (b : Fin N) :
    indexPoint v I = (v b, (⊤ : WithTop α)) ↔
      I.birth = b.val ∧ I.death = N
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hb : v ⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩ = v b :=
      congrArg Prod.fst h
    have hb' : I.birth = b.val := congrArg Fin.val (hv.injective hb)
    by_cases hd : I.death < N
    · have hdeath : (v ⟨I.death, hd⟩ : WithTop α) = (⊤ : WithTop α) := by
        simpa [indexPoint, hd] using congrArg Prod.snd h
      simp at hdeath
    · exact ⟨hb', Nat.le_antisymm I.death_le_size (Nat.le_of_not_gt hd)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hb, hd⟩
    have hbi : (⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩ : Fin N) = b := Fin.ext hb
    have hnot : ¬ I.death < N := by omega
    simp [indexPoint, hnot, hbi]

name: TDA.Persistence.ofIndexBars_count_finite
statement:
theorem ofIndexBars_count_finite (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (b d : Fin N) :
    (ofIndexBars v hv B).points.count (v b, (v d : WithTop α)) =
      barcodeMultiplicity B b.val d.val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [show (ofIndexBars v hv B).points = B.map (indexPoint v) from rfl,
    Multiset.count_map]
  rw [← Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter]
  refine Multiset.countP_congr rfl ?_
  intro I _
  apply propext
  simpa [eq_comm] using (indexPoint_eq_finite v hv I b d)

name: TDA.Persistence.ofIndexBars_count_essential
statement:
theorem ofIndexBars_count_essential (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (b : Fin N) :
    (ofIndexBars v hv B).points.count (v b, (⊤ : WithTop α)) =
      barcodeMultiplicity B b.val N
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [show (ofIndexBars v hv B).points = B.map (indexPoint v) from rfl,
    Multiset.count_map]
  rw [← Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter]
  refine Multiset.countP_congr rfl ?_
  intro I _
  apply propext
  simpa [eq_comm] using (indexPoint_eq_essential v hv I b)

name: TDA.Persistence.indexPoint_injective
statement:
private theorem indexPoint_injective (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v) :
    Function.Injective (indexPoint v)
proof:
:= by
  intro I J h
  have hb : I.birth = J.birth := by
    have hh := congrArg Prod.fst h
    exact congrArg Fin.val (hv.injective hh)
  have hd : I.death = J.death := by
    by_cases hi : I.death < N
    · by_cases hj : J.death < N
      · have hh : (v ⟨I.death, hi⟩ : WithTop α) = (v ⟨J.death, hj⟩ : WithTop α) := by
          simpa [indexPoint, hi, hj] using congrArg Prod.snd h
        exact congrArg Fin.val (hv.injective (WithTop.coe_injective hh))
      · have hh : (v ⟨I.death, hi⟩ : WithTop α) = (⊤ : WithTop α) := by
          simpa [indexPoint, hi, hj] using congrArg Prod.snd h
        simp at hh
    · by_cases hj : J.death < N
      · have hh : (⊤ : WithTop α) = (v ⟨J.death, hj⟩ : WithTop α) := by
          simpa [indexPoint, hi, hj] using congrArg Prod.snd h
        simp at hh
      · have hI := I.death_le_size
        have hJ := J.death_le_size
        omega
  cases I; cases J
  congr

name: TDA.Persistence.ofIndexBars_injective
statement:
theorem ofIndexBars_injective (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v) :
    Function.Injective (ofIndexBars v hv)
proof:
:= by
  intro B C h
  apply Multiset.map_injective (indexPoint_injective v hv)
  exact congrArg Diagram.points h

name: TDA.Persistence.indexPoint_slice
statement:
private theorem indexPoint_slice (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v)
    (I : FiniteInterval N) (i j : Fin N) :
    (indexPoint v I).1 ≤ v i ∧ (v j : WithTop α) < (indexPoint v I).2 ↔
      I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death
proof:
:= by
  have hbirth : (indexPoint v I).1 ≤ v i ↔ I.birth ≤ i.val := by
    change v ⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩ ≤ v i ↔ _
    exact (hv.le_iff_le).trans Fin.le_iff_val_le_val
  by_cases hd : I.death < N
  · have hdeath : (v j : WithTop α) < (indexPoint v I).2 ↔ j.val < I.death := by
      change (v j : WithTop α) < (if h : I.death < N then (v ⟨I.death, h⟩ : WithTop α) else ⊤) ↔ _
      simp only [dif_pos hd, WithTop.coe_lt_coe]
      exact (hv.lt_iff_lt).trans Fin.lt_def
    exact and_congr hbirth hdeath
  · have hterminal : I.death = N := by
      have hle := I.death_le_size
      omega
    have hdeath : (v j : WithTop α) < (indexPoint v I).2 ↔ j.val < I.death := by
      simp [indexPoint, hterminal, j.isLt]
    exact and_congr hbirth hdeath

name: TDA.Persistence.ofIndexBars_countP_grades
statement:
theorem ofIndexBars_countP_grades (v : Fin N → α) (hv : StrictMono v)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (i j : Fin N) :
    (ofIndexBars v hv B).points.countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ v i ∧ (v j : WithTop α) < p.2) =
      B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (B.map (indexPoint v)).countP
    (fun p => p.1 ≤ v i ∧ (v j : WithTop α) < p.2) = _
  rw [Multiset.countP_map, ← Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter]
  refine Multiset.countP_congr rfl ?_
  intro I _
  exact propext (indexPoint_slice v hv I i j)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostExamples.singleton_cost_cases
statement:
private theorem singleton_cost_cases
    (M : OccurrenceMatching Unit Unit PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.totalFiniteCost (fun _ => p) (fun _ => q) =
      match M.finite () with
      | none => (diagonalCost p).toReal + (diagonalCost q).toReal
      | some _ => (finitePairCost p q).toReal
proof:
:= by
  cases h : M.finite () with
  | none => simp [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, h]
  | some j => cases j; simp [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostExamples.singleton_minimum
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_min
    · have h := finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost
        (fun _ : Unit => p) (fun _ : Unit => q) pairSingletons
      simpa [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, pairSingletons] using h
    · simpa using finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_diagonalSum
        (fun _ : Unit => p) (fun _ : Unit => q)
  · apply (le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro M
    rw [singleton_cost_cases]
    cases M.finite ()
    · exact min_le_right _ _
    · exact min_le_left _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostExamples.pairing_preferred
proof:
:= by
  rw [singleton_minimum]
  norm_num [finitePairCost, diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostExamples.deletion_preferred
proof:
:= by
  rw [singleton_minimum]
  norm_num [finitePairCost, diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostExamples.coincident_singletons_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [singleton_minimum]
  norm_num [finitePairCost, diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostExamples.repeated_to_empty
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  norm_num [diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostExamples.empty_minimum
proof: := by simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostExamples.near_singletons_image_bound
statement:
private theorem near_singletons_image_bound {K : Type*} [Fintype K]
    {σ A B : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖PersistenceImage.image σ w P (fun _ : Unit => ((0, 4) : ℝ × ℝ)) -
      PersistenceImage.image σ w P (fun _ : Unit => (1, 5))‖ ≤
      PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant σ A B
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [pairing_preferred, mul_one] using
    PersistenceImage.norm_image_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost hσ hA hB w P hm hd
      (fun _ : Unit => ((0, 4) : ℝ × ℝ)) (fun _ : Unit => (1, 5))
      (fun _ => by norm_num) (fun _ => by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.zeroDiagram_barcode
statement: theorem zeroDiagram_barcode (N : ℕ) : rankBarcode (zeroDiagram (k := k) N) = 0
proof:
:=
  rankBarcode_eq_of_iso_barcodeModule 0 (zeroDiagramIso N)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.zeroThreeStages_decomposition
statement:
theorem zeroThreeStages_decomposition : rankBarcode (zeroDiagram (k := k) 3) = 0 ∧
    Nonempty (zeroDiagram (k := k) 3 ≅
      barcodeModule (k := k) (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨zeroDiagram_barcode 3, ⟨zeroDiagramIso 3⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.oneStagePair_barcode
statement:
theorem oneStagePair_barcode : rankBarcode (oneStagePair (k := k)) =
    Multiset.replicate 2 bar01
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rankBarcode_barcodeModule (k := k) (Multiset.replicate 2 bar01)]
  apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).2
  intro i j hij
  fin_cases i
  fin_cases j
  rw [rank_barcodeMap]
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : (k × k) →ₗ[k] (k × k))) = _
  rw [LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
  simp [Module.finrank_prod, bar01, -Multiset.cons_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.delayedBirthFiber_mono
statement:
private theorem delayedBirthFiber_mono {i j : Fin 3} (hij : i ≤ j) :
    delayedBirthFiber (k := k) i ≤ delayedBirthFiber (k := k) j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hi : i.val < 2
  · simp only [delayedBirthFiber, if_pos hi]
    exact bot_le
  · have hj : ¬ j.val < 2 := by
      have h := Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp hij
      omega
    simp only [delayedBirthFiber, if_neg hi, if_neg hj]
    exact le_refl _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.delayedBirth_zero_initial
statement:
theorem delayedBirth_zero_initial :
    Module.finrank k ((delayedBirthDiagram (k := k)).obj (0 : Fin 3)) = 0 ∧
    Module.finrank k ((delayedBirthDiagram (k := k)).obj (1 : Fin 3)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank k (delayedBirthFiber (k := k) 0) = 0 ∧
    Module.finrank k (delayedBirthFiber (k := k) 1) = 0
  simp [delayedBirthFiber]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.delayedBirth_final_dimension
statement:
theorem delayedBirth_final_dimension :
    Module.finrank k ((delayedBirthDiagram (k := k)).obj (2 : Fin 3)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank k (delayedBirthFiber (k := k) 2) = 1
  simp [delayedBirthFiber]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.delayedBirth_barcode
statement:
theorem delayedBirth_barcode : rankBarcode (delayedBirthDiagram (k := k)) =
    ({bar23} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rankBarcode_barcodeModule (k := k) ({bar23} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3))]
  apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).2
  intro i j hij
  rw [rank_barcodeMap]
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
    (Submodule.inclusion (delayedBirthFiber_mono (k := k) hij))) = _
  rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (Submodule.inclusion_injective _)]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp_all [delayedBirthFiber, bar23, ← Multiset.cons_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.scalarTransitionDiagram_map
statement:
theorem scalarTransitionDiagram_map (c : k) (x : k) :
    structureMapLinear (scalarTransitionDiagram c) (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) x =
      c * x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.scalarTransitionIso_final
statement:
theorem scalarTransitionIso_final (c : k) (hc : c ≠ 0) (x : k) :
    ((scalarTransitionIso c hc).hom.app (1 : Fin 2)).hom x = c⁻¹ * x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.identityTransition_barcode
statement:
theorem identityTransition_barcode : rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram k) =
    ({bar02} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rankBarcode_barcodeModule (k := k) ({bar02} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2))]
  apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).2
  intro i j hij
  rw [rank_barcodeMap]
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k)) = _
  rw [LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top, Module.finrank_self]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [bar02, ← Multiset.cons_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.scalarTransition_barcode
statement:
theorem scalarTransition_barcode (c : k) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    rankBarcode (scalarTransitionDiagram c) = ({bar02} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rankBarcode_eq_of_iso (scalarTransitionIso c hc), identityTransition_barcode]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.zeroTransition_barcode
statement:
theorem zeroTransition_barcode : rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram k) =
    ({bar01two, bar12} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rankBarcode_barcodeModule (k := k)
    ({bar01two, bar12} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 2))]
  apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).2
  intro i j hij
  rw [rank_barcodeMap]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · unfold structureMapRank
    rw [structureMapLinear_self]
    change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k)) = _
    rw [LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top, Module.finrank_self]
    simp [bar01two, bar12, ← Multiset.cons_zero]
  · change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (0 : k →ₗ[k] k)) = _
    rw [LinearMap.range_zero, finrank_bot]
    simp [bar01two, bar12, ← Multiset.cons_zero]
  · change (1 : ℕ) ≤ 0 at hij
    omega
  · unfold structureMapRank
    rw [structureMapLinear_self]
    change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k)) = _
    rw [LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top, Module.finrank_self]
    simp [bar01two, bar12, ← Multiset.cons_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.identity_zero_same_dimensions_different_barcodes
statement:
theorem identity_zero_same_dimensions_different_barcodes :
    (∀ i : Fin 2, Module.finrank k ((identityTransitionDiagram k).obj i) =
      Module.finrank k ((zeroTransitionDiagram k).obj i)) ∧
    rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram k) ≠ rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram k) ∧
    ¬ Nonempty (identityTransitionDiagram k ≅ zeroTransitionDiagram k)
proof:
:= by
  have hbarcode : rankBarcode (identityTransitionDiagram k) ≠
      rankBarcode (zeroTransitionDiagram k) := by
    rw [identityTransition_barcode, zeroTransition_barcode]
    intro h
    have hcard := congrArg Multiset.card h
    simp at hcard
  exact ⟨fun _ => rfl, hbarcode, fun ⟨e⟩ => hbarcode (rankBarcode_eq_of_iso e)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.emptyIndex_barcode
statement: theorem emptyIndex_barcode (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 0)) : rankBarcode M = 0
proof:
:=
  rankBarcode_eq_of_iso_barcodeModule 0 (emptyIndexIso M)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteDecompositionExamples.oneStagePair_decomposition_unique
statement:
theorem oneStagePair_decomposition_unique (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval 1))
    (e : oneStagePair (k := k) ≅ barcodeModule (k := k) B) :
    B = Multiset.replicate 2 bar01
proof:
:=
  barcode_decomposition_unique (oneStagePair (k := k)) B
    (Multiset.replicate 2 bar01) e oneStagePairIso

name: TDA.Persistence.EssentialVanishingExamples.hollowReal_value_le_one
statement:
theorem hollowReal_value_le_one :
    ∀ s : TotalFace HollowTriangle.C.toPre, hollowReal.value s ≤ (1 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro s
  change ((s.val.card - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ 1
  have hs := s.property
  change s.val ∈ HollowTriangle.C.faces at hs
  change s.val ∈
    ({{0}, {1}, {2}, {0, 1}, {1, 2}, {0, 2}} : Finset (Finset (Fin 3))) at hs
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hs
  rcases hs with h | h | h | h | h | h <;> simp [h]

name: TDA.Persistence.EssentialVanishingExamples.hollowTriangle_finrank_one_from_item14
statement:
theorem hollowTriangle_finrank_one_from_item14 :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
        (simplicialHomology HollowTriangle.C.toPre (ZMod 2) 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hdiag :
      (dgm (ZMod 2) hollowReal 1).points = {((1 : ℝ), (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))} := by
    rw [← moduleDiagram_sublevelModule]
    exact hollowReal_moduleDiagram_one
  have hrank := card_essentialPart_dgm_eq_finrank
    (ZMod 2) hollowReal 1 1 hollowReal_value_le_one
  rw [hdiag] at hrank
  have hcard :
      (essentialPart ({((1 : ℝ), (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))})).card = 1 := by
    simp [essentialPart]
    rfl
  rw [hcard] at hrank
  exact hrank.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.EssentialVanishingExamples.hollowTriangle_not_isApexCone
statement:
theorem hollowTriangle_not_isApexCone :
    ∀ v, ¬ IsApexCone HollowTriangle.C.toPre v
proof:
:= by
  intro v hK
  have hz : IsZero (simplicialHomology HollowTriangle.C.toPre (ZMod 2) 1) :=
    hK.isZero_simplicialHomology_succ (ZMod 2) 0
  have hs : Subsingleton (simplicialHomology HollowTriangle.C.toPre (ZMod 2) 1) :=
    ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hz
  have hzero :
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
          (simplicialHomology HollowTriangle.C.toPre (ZMod 2) 1) = 0 := by
    haveI := hs
    exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton (R := ZMod 2)
  rw [hollowTriangle_finrank_one_from_item14] at hzero
  norm_num at hzero

name: TDA.Persistence.EssentialVanishingExamples.triangle_cech_finiteDiagramImage_size_uniform
statement:
theorem triangle_cech_finiteDiagramImage_size_uniform
    (q : Fin 3 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ A B : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P
          (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter Triangle.pts) 1) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P
          (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter q) 1)‖ ≤
      PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant σ A B * 2 * Cech.displacement Triangle.pts q
proof:
:= by
  have h := Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_choose_mul_displacement
    (k := ZMod 2) Triangle.pts q 1 hσ hA hB w P hm hd
  norm_num [Nat.choose] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.EssentialVanishingExamples.triangle_cech_finiteDiagramImage_arctan_size_uniform
statement:
theorem triangle_cech_finiteDiagramImage_arctan_size_uniform
    (q : Fin 3 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ C : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) P
          (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter Triangle.pts) 1) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) P
          (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter q) 1)‖ ≤
      (2 * C + 3 * √(π / 2) / σ) * 2 * Cech.displacement Triangle.pts q
proof:
:= by
  have h := Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_choose_mul_displacement
    (k := ZMod 2) Triangle.pts q 1 (σ := σ) (A := C) (B := π / 2) hσ hC
      Real.pi_div_two_pos.le (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) P hm hd
  norm_num [Nat.choose] at h
  simpa only [PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_arctan] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.EssentialVanishingExamples.triangle_cech_diagramEmbedding_arctan_size_uniform
statement:
theorem triangle_cech_diagramEmbedding_arctan_size_uniform
    (q : Fin 3 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    {σ C : ℝ} (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)
          (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter Triangle.pts) 1) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)
          (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter q) 1)‖ ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) * 2 * Cech.displacement Triangle.pts q
proof:
:= by
  have h := Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_choose_mul_displacement
    (k := ZMod 2) Triangle.pts q 1 σ (A := C) (B := π / 2) hC
      Real.pi_div_two_pos.le (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)
  norm_num [Nat.choose] at h
  simpa only [WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_arctan] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.scaleGrid_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleGrid_apply (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (g : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    scaleGrid c hc g i = c * g i
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_scaleGrid
statement:
theorem cellIndex_scaleGrid (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (g : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    cellIndex (scaleGrid c hc g) t = cellIndex g (c⁻¹ * t)
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  change (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => c * g i ≤ t)).card =
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => g i ≤ c⁻¹ * t)).card
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact (le_inv_mul_iff₀ hc).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.IsConstructible.scale
statement:
theorem IsConstructible.scale {g : Fin n ↪o ℝ} {M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ}
    (hM : IsConstructible g M) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    IsConstructible (scaleGrid c hc g) (PModule.scale c hc M) where
  zero_left t ht
proof:
:= by
    change IsZero (M.obj (c⁻¹ * t))
    apply hM.zero_left (c⁻¹ * t)
    intro i
    exact (inv_mul_lt_iff₀ hc).2 (by simpa only [scaleGrid_apply] using ht i)
  isIso_map s t hst hd := by
    change IsIso (structureMap M ((PModule.scaleHom c hc).monotone hst))
    apply hM.isIso_map
    rw [cellIndex_scaleGrid, cellIndex_scaleGrid] at hd
    exact hd

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.finiteDimensional_scaledCritical
proof:
:= by
  change FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c⁻¹ * (c * g i)))
  rw [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hc.ne']
  exact hfd i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.endpoints_scale
statement:
private theorem endpoints_scale (g : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (I : FiniteInterval n) :
    RealBarcode.endpoints (scaleGrid c hc g) I =
      (c * (RealBarcode.endpoints g I).1,
        WithTop.map (c * ·) (RealBarcode.endpoints g I).2)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only [RealBarcode.endpoints]
  split_ifs <;> simp [scaleGrid_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.ofIndexBars_scaleGrid
statement:
theorem ofIndexBars_scaleGrid (g : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval n)) :
    ofIndexBars (scaleGrid c hc g) (scaleGrid c hc g).strictMono B =
      (ofIndexBars g g.strictMono B).scale c hc
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  change B.map (RealBarcode.endpoints (scaleGrid c hc g)) =
    (B.map (RealBarcode.endpoints g)).map
      (fun p => (c * p.1, WithTop.map (c * ·) p.2))
  rw [Multiset.map_map]
  congr 1
  funext I
  exact endpoints_scale g c hc I

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram_scale
statement:
theorem moduleDiagram_scale (g : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (g i))) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    moduleDiagram (scaleGrid c hc g) (PModule.scale c hc M)
        (finiteDimensional_scaledCritical hfd c hc) =
      (moduleDiagram g M hfd).scale c hc
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k ((reindex g.toOrderHom M).obj i) := hfd
  let : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k
      ((reindex (scaleGrid c hc g).toOrderHom (PModule.scale c hc M)).obj i) :=
    finiteDimensional_scaledCritical hfd c hc
  unfold moduleDiagram
  rw [rankBarcode_eq_of_iso (scaledCriticalIso g M c hc), ofIndexBars_scaleGrid]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.bottleneck_moduleDiagram_scale
statement:
theorem bottleneck_moduleDiagram_scale
    {g : Fin n ↪o ℝ} {d : Fin m ↪o ℝ}
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ} {N : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ}
    (hM : IsConstructible g M) (hN : IsConstructible d N)
    (hfdM : ∀ j, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (g j)))
    (hfdN : ∀ j, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj (d j))) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    bottleneck
        (moduleDiagram (scaleGrid c hc g) (PModule.scale c hc M)
          (finiteDimensional_scaledCritical hfdM c hc))
        (moduleDiagram (scaleGrid c hc d) (PModule.scale c hc N)
          (finiteDimensional_scaledCritical hfdN c hc)) =
      ENNReal.ofReal c * realInterleavingDistance M N
proof:
:= by
  calc
    bottleneck
        (moduleDiagram (scaleGrid c hc g) (PModule.scale c hc M)
          (finiteDimensional_scaledCritical hfdM c hc))
        (moduleDiagram (scaleGrid c hc d) (PModule.scale c hc N)
          (finiteDimensional_scaledCritical hfdN c hc)) =
        bottleneck ((moduleDiagram g M hfdM).scale c hc)
          ((moduleDiagram d N hfdN).scale c hc) := by
            rw [moduleDiagram_scale, moduleDiagram_scale]
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal c * bottleneck (moduleDiagram g M hfdM)
          (moduleDiagram d N hfdN) := bottleneck_scale _ _ hc
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal c * realInterleavingDistance M N := by
      rw [bottleneck_eq_distance hM hN hfdM hfdN]

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.mem_full
statement:
@[simp] private theorem mem_full {V : Type} (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) ↔ s.Nonempty
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.vertex_chain
statement:
private theorem vertex_chain {V W : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder W]
    (R : Type) [Ring R] {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W} (f : VertexMap K L) (x : V)
    (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ K) (hy : ({f x} : Finset W) ∈ L) (a : R) :
    vertexChainMap R f 0 (Finsupp.single (vertex K x hx) a) =
      Finsupp.single (vertex L (f x) hy) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexChainMap_vertex]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [vertexImageFace, tupleFace]
  dsimp
  rw [← Finset.image_image, Finset.image_orderEmbOfFin_univ]
  simp [vertex]

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.vClass_map
statement:
private theorem vClass_map {V W : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder W]
    (R : Type) [Ring R] {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W} (f : VertexMap K L) (x : V)
    (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ K) (hy : ({f x} : Finset W) ∈ L) (a : R) :
    (simplicialHomologyMap R f 0).hom (vClass R K x hx a) = vClass R L (f x) hy a
proof:
:=
  simplicialHomologyMap_class R f 0 _ _ (vertex_chain R f x hx hy a)

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.vClass_nonzero
statement:
private theorem vClass_nonzero {V : Type} [LinearOrder V]
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (x : V) (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ K) :
    vClass ℚ K x hx 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hq := congrArg (homologyKernelQuotient ℚ (simplicialChainComplex K ℚ) 0).hom.hom hz
  unfold vClass at hq
  rw [simplicialHomologyClass_quotient, map_zero] at hq
  exact zeroVertexCycle_not_boundary K ℚ (vertex K x hx)
    ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hq)

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.univTotal

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.univBirth
proof:
:= by
  intro t σ hσ τ hτ _
  by_cases ht : a ≤ t
  · have hb : b ≤ t + (b-a) := by linarith
    simpa [birth, hb] using hτ
  · simp [birth, ht] at hσ

proof:

  intro _ _ _ _ hτ _

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.compSub
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨x,z⟩ h
  change g (f x) = z at h
  subst z

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.composite_image
statement:
private theorem composite_image {V W U : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder W] [LinearOrder U]
    (R : Type) [Ring R]
    {F : SimplicialFiltration ℝ V} {G : SimplicialFiltration ℝ W}
    {H : SimplicialFiltration ℝ U} {ε δ : ℝ} {C : SetRel V W} {D : SetRel W U}
    (hCT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hDT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun y z => (y,z) ∈ D))
    (hC : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G ε C) (hD : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation G H δ D)
    {f : V → W} {g : W → U} (hf : Function.graph f ⊆ C) (hg : Function.graph g ⊆ D)
    (t : ℝ) (x : V) (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ F t)
    (hy : ({g (f x)} : Finset U) ∈ H (t + (ε + δ))) (a : R) :
    ((multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R hCT hC 0 ≫
      reindexNatTrans (OrderHomClass.toOrderHom (OrderIso.addRight ε))
        (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R hDT hD 0) ≫
      (shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso R H ε δ 0).hom).app t).hom
      (vClass R (F t) x hx a) = vClass R (H (t + (ε + δ))) (g (f x)) hy a
proof:
:= by
  rw [multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp,
    multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_app R _ (hC.comp hD) (compSub hf hg)]
  exact vClass_map R _ x hx hy a

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.canonical_image
statement:
private theorem canonical_image {V W : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder W]
    (R : Type) [Ring R] {F : SimplicialFiltration ℝ V} {G : SimplicialFiltration ℝ W}
    {a : ℝ} {C : SetRel V W} (hT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hC : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G a C) {f : V → W}
    (hf : Function.graph f ⊆ C) (t : ℝ) (x : V)
    (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ F t) (hy : ({f x} : Finset W) ∈ G (t+a)) (r : R) :
    ((multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R hT hC 0).app t).hom (vClass R (F t) x hx r) =
      vClass R (G (t+a)) (f x) hy r
proof:
:= by
  rw [multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_app R hT hC hf]
  exact vClass_map R _ x hx hy r

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.transition_image
statement:
private theorem transition_image {V : Type} [LinearOrder V] (R : Type) [Ring R]
    (F : SimplicialFiltration ℝ V) (γ : ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ) (x : V)
    (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ F t) (hy : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ F (t+(γ:ℝ))) (r : R) :
    ((RealShift.transition γ (simplicialHomologyPModule R F 0)).app t).hom
      (vClass R (F t) x hx r) = vClass R (F (t+(γ:ℝ))) x hy r
proof:
:= by
  change (simplicialHomologyIncl R (F.monotone (le_add_of_nonneg_right γ.coe_nonneg)) 0).hom _ = _
  rw [← simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion]
  exact vClass_map R _ x hx hy r

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.zeroIso_image
statement:
private theorem zeroIso_image {V : Type} [LinearOrder V] (R : Type) [Ring R]
    (F : SimplicialFiltration ℝ V) (t : ℝ) (x : V)
    (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ F (t+0)) (hy : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ F t) (r : R) :
    ((RealShift.zeroIso (simplicialHomologyPModule R F 0)).hom.app t).hom
      (vClass R (F (t+0)) x hx r) = vClass R (F t) x hy r
proof:
:= by
  change (simplicialHomologyIncl R (F.monotone (le_of_eq (add_zero t))) 0).hom _ = _
  rw [← simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion]
  exact vClass_map R _ x hx hy r

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.bornForward

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.born_triangles
statement:
private theorem born_triangles :
    ((((bornI ℚ).φ ≫ (RealShift.shift 1).map (bornI ℚ).ψ ≫
      (RealShift.compIso 1 1 (simplicialHomologyPModule ℚ point0 0)).hom).app 0).hom
        (vClass ℚ (point0 0) 0 (by norm_num [birth]) 1)) =
      vClass ℚ (point0 (0+((1+1:ℝ≥0):ℝ))) 0 (by norm_num [birth]) 1 ∧
    ((((bornI ℚ).ψ ≫ (RealShift.shift 1).map (bornI ℚ).φ ≫
      (RealShift.compIso 1 1 (simplicialHomologyPModule ℚ edge1 0)).hom).app 1).hom
        (vClass ℚ (edge1 1) 1 (by norm_num [birth]) 1)) =
      vClass ℚ (edge1 (1+((1+1:ℝ≥0):ℝ))) 1 (by norm_num [birth]) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [(bornI ℚ).φ_ψ,(bornI ℚ).ψ_φ]
  exact ⟨transition_image ℚ point0 (1+1) 0 0 _ _ 1,
    transition_image ℚ edge1 (1+1) 1 1 _ _ 1⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.isolated_classes_differ
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have hq := congrArg (homologyKernelQuotient ℚ (simplicialChainComplex isolatedK ℚ) 0).hom.hom hc
  unfold vClass at hq
  rw [simplicialHomologyClass_quotient, simplicialHomologyClass_quotient] at hq
  have hb := (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).mp hq
  obtain ⟨c, hcb⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff ℚ isolatedK 0 _).mp hb
  have hz : c = 0 := by
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro σ
    exact isEmptyElim σ
  rw [hz, map_zero] at hcb
  have hv := congrArg (fun c : Chain isolatedK ℚ 0 => c (vertex isolatedK 0 (isolated_vertex 0))) hcb
  norm_num [vCycle, vertex] at hv

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.chooseGeometry
statement: private theorem chooseGeometry : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation pointF isolatedF 0 chooseD
proof:
:= by
  let _ : DecidableEq (Fin 2) := Classical.decEq _
  apply (isShiftedSimplicialRelation_graph_iff chooseZero).mpr
  intro t σ hσ
  change σ.Nonempty at hσ
  change σ.image chooseZero ∈ isolatedK
  have he : σ.image chooseZero = {0} := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨y,_,hy⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
      exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr hy.symm
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := hσ
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y,hy,(Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx).symm⟩
  rw [he]
  exact isolated_vertex 0

    badComposite ≠ RealShift.transition (0+0) (simplicialHomologyPModule ℚ isolatedF 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro he
  have hc := congrArg (fun m => (m.app 0).hom
    (vClass ℚ isolatedK 1 (isolated_vertex 1) 1)) he
  rw [bad_roundTrip_image] at hc
  exact isolated_classes_differ (hc.trans (transition_image ℚ isolatedF (0+0) 0 1
    (isolated_vertex 1) (isolated_vertex 1) 1))

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.infinite_isomorphism_nonzero

      vClass ℚ (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ℕ) 0 (by simp) 1 := by
    change ((RealShift.zeroIso (simplicialHomologyPModule ℚ naturalF 0)).hom.app 0).hom
      (((infiniteI ℚ).φ.app 0).hom (vClass ℚ pointK 0 (by simp) 1)) = _
    rw [infinite_forward_image]

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.ghostGeometry
statement:
private theorem ghostGeometry : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation
    (constF ghostSource) (constF ghostTarget) 0 ghostRelation
proof:
:= by
  intro t σ hσ τ hτ hsub
  change σ.Nonempty ∧ σ ⊆ {0} at hσ
  change τ.Nonempty ∧ τ ⊆ {0,1}
  refine ⟨hτ,?_⟩
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x,hx,hxy⟩ := hsub hy
  have hxs : x=0 := Finset.mem_singleton.mp (hσ.2 hx)
  rcases hxy with ⟨_,hy0|hy1⟩ | ⟨hx1,_⟩
  · apply Finset.mem_insert.mpr
    exact Or.inl hy0
  · apply Finset.mem_insert.mpr
    exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr hy1)
  · exact False.elim ((by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1) (hxs.symm.trans hx1))

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.ghostInvGeometry
statement:
private theorem ghostInvGeometry : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation
    (constF ghostTarget) (constF ghostSource) 0 ghostRelation.inv
proof:
:= by
  intro t σ hσ τ hτ hsub
  change σ.Nonempty ∧ σ ⊆ {0,1} at hσ
  change τ.Nonempty ∧ τ ⊆ {0}
  refine ⟨hτ,?_⟩
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨y,hy,hxy⟩ := hsub hx
  change (x=0 ∧ (y=0 ∨ y=1)) ∨ (x=1 ∧ y=2) at hxy
  rcases hxy with ⟨hx0,_⟩ | ⟨_,hy2⟩
  · exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr hx0
  · have hn : (2 : Fin 3) ∉ ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 3)) := by decide
    exact False.elim (hn (hy2 ▸ hσ.2 hy))

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.ghost_support
statement:
private theorem ghost_support :
    ((1 : Fin 2),(2 : Fin 3)) ∈ ghostRelation ∧
    ({(1 : Fin 2)} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∉ ghostSource ∧
    ({(2 : Fin 3)} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∉ ghostTarget
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Or.inr ⟨rfl,rfl⟩,?_,?_⟩
  · change ¬(({1} : Finset (Fin 2)).Nonempty ∧ ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ⊆ {0})
    decide
  · change ¬(({2} : Finset (Fin 3)).Nonempty ∧ ({2} : Finset (Fin 3)) ⊆ {0,1})
    decide

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.coefficient_fields
statement:
private theorem coefficient_fields (R : Type) [Ring R] (a : R) :
    simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R (0 : Fin 1)
      (((coefficientI R).φ.app 0).hom (vClass R (singletonFace (0 : Fin 1)) 0 rfl a)) = a ∧
    simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R (0 : Fin 1)
      (((coefficientI R).ψ.app 0).hom (vClass R (singletonFace (0 : Fin 1)) 0 rfl a)) = a
proof:
:= by
  have he := canonical_image R singletonTotal singletonRelation (f := id) (Set.Subset.refl _)
    0 0 rfl rfl a
  constructor
  · calc
      _ = simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R 0 (vClass R (singletonFace (0 : Fin 1)) 0 rfl a) :=
        congrArg (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R (0 : Fin 1)) he
      _ = a := simplicialSingletonH0Equiv_class R (0 : Fin 1) a
  · calc
      _ = simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R 0 (vClass R (singletonFace (0 : Fin 1)) 0 rfl a) :=
        congrArg (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R (0 : Fin 1)) he
      _ = a := simplicialSingletonH0Equiv_class R (0 : Fin 1) a

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedInterleavingExamples.coefficient_triangles
statement:
private theorem coefficient_triangles (R : Type) [Ring R] (a : R) :
    simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R (0 : Fin 1)
      ((((coefficientI R).φ ≫ (RealShift.shift 1).map (coefficientI R).ψ ≫
        (RealShift.compIso 1 1 (simplicialHomologyPModule R singletonF 0)).hom).app 0).hom
          (vClass R (singletonFace (0 : Fin 1)) 0 rfl a)) = a ∧
    simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R (0 : Fin 1)
      ((((coefficientI R).ψ ≫ (RealShift.shift 1).map (coefficientI R).φ ≫
        (RealShift.compIso 1 1 (simplicialHomologyPModule R singletonF 0)).hom).app 0).hom
          (vClass R (singletonFace (0 : Fin 1)) 0 rfl a)) = a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [(coefficientI R).φ_ψ]
    exact (congrArg (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R (0 : Fin 1))
      (transition_image R singletonF (1+1) 0 0 rfl rfl a)).trans
      (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv_class R (0 : Fin 1) a)
  · rw [(coefficientI R).ψ_φ]
    exact (congrArg (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R (0 : Fin 1))
      (transition_image R singletonF (1+1) 0 0 rfl rfl a)).trans
      (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv_class R (0 : Fin 1) a)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.contentMultiplicity_le
statement:
theorem contentMultiplicity_le (m : AddContent ℕ C) {x : X} {U : Set X}
    (hU : U ∈ C) (hx : x ∈ U) : contentMultiplicity m x ≤ m U
proof:
:=
  csInf_le' ⟨U, hU, hx, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.exists_cell_eq_contentMultiplicity
statement:
theorem exists_cell_eq_contentMultiplicity (m : AddContent ℕ C) (x : X)
    (hx : ∃ U ∈ C, x ∈ U) :
    ∃ U ∈ C, x ∈ U ∧ m U = contentMultiplicity m x
proof:
:= by
  exact csInf_mem (s := {n | ∃ U ∈ C, x ∈ U ∧ m U = n}) (by
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU⟩ := hx
    exact ⟨m U, U, hU, hxU, rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.exists_positive_content_atom
statement:
theorem exists_positive_content_atom [TopologicalSpace X] (hC : IsSetSemiring C)
    (m : AddContent ℕ C) (hOpen : ∀ U ∈ C, IsOpen U) {K : Set X}
    (hK : K ∈ C) (hCompact : IsCompact K) (hpos : 0 < m K) :
    ∃ x ∈ K, 0 < contentMultiplicity m x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  let Z := {U : Set X // U ∈ C ∧ m U = 0}
  have hcover : K ⊆ ⋃ U : Z, U.val := by
    intro x hx
    have hz : contentMultiplicity m x = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      exact hn ⟨x, hx, Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne⟩
    obtain ⟨U, hUC, hxU, heq⟩ := exists_cell_eq_contentMultiplicity m x ⟨K, hK, hx⟩
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨U, hUC, heq.trans hz⟩, hxU⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hCompact.elim_finite_subcover (fun U : Z => U.val)
    (fun U => hOpen U.val U.property.1) hcover
  let J : Finset (Set X) := t.image Subtype.val
  have hJC : (J : Set (Set X)) ⊆ C := by
    intro U hU
    obtain ⟨V, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hU
    exact V.property.1
  have hKJ : K ⊆ ⋃₀ (J : Set (Set X)) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨U, hUt, hxU⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht hx)
    exact mem_sUnion.mpr ⟨U.val, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨U, hUt, rfl⟩, hxU⟩
  have hle := addContent_le_sum_of_subset_sUnion (m := m) hC hJC hK hKJ
  have hsum : ∑ U ∈ J, m U = 0 := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro U hU
    obtain ⟨V, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hU
    exact V.property.2
  rw [hsum] at hle
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) hpos

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.pointContent_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (if x ∈ U then 1 else 0) ≤ m U
  split_ifs with hxU
  · exact (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hx).trans (contentMultiplicity_le m hU hxU)
  · exact Nat.zero_le _

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.subtractPointContent_apply
statement:
theorem subtractPointContent_apply (m : AddContent ℕ C) (x : X)
    (hx : 0 < contentMultiplicity m x) (U : Set X) :
    subtractPointContent m x hx U = m U - if x ∈ U then 1 else 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.exists_local_atomic_representation
statement:
theorem exists_local_atomic_representation [TopologicalSpace X] (hC : IsSetSemiring C)
    (m : AddContent ℕ C) (hOpen : ∀ U ∈ C, IsOpen U) {K : Set X}
    (hK : K ∈ C) (hCompact : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ points : Multiset X, (∀ x ∈ points, x ∈ K) ∧
      ∀ U ∈ C, U ⊆ K → m U = (points.filter (· ∈ U)).card
proof:
:= by
  have haux : ∀ n (m : AddContent ℕ C), m K = n →
      ∃ points : Multiset X, (∀ x ∈ points, x ∈ K) ∧
        ∀ U ∈ C, U ⊆ K → m U = (points.filter (· ∈ U)).card := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro m hm
      refine ⟨0, by simp, ?_⟩
      intro U hU hUK
      have hle := addContent_mono (m := m) hC hU hK hUK
      simp only [Multiset.filter_zero, Multiset.card_zero]
      omega
    | succ n ih =>
      intro m hm
      obtain ⟨x, hxK, hx⟩ := exists_positive_content_atom hC m hOpen hK hCompact (by omega)
      let m' := subtractPointContent m x hx
      have hm' : m' K = n := by
        change m K - (if x ∈ K then 1 else 0) = n
        rw [if_pos hxK, hm]
        omega
      obtain ⟨points, hpoints, hrepr⟩ := ih m' hm'
      refine ⟨x ::ₘ points, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro y hy
        rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp hy with rfl | hy
        · exact hxK
        · exact hpoints y hy
      · intro U hU hUK
        have hcount := hrepr U hU hUK
        have hrestore := Nat.sub_add_cancel (pointContent_le m hx hU)
        change (m U - (if x ∈ U then 1 else 0)) + (if x ∈ U then 1 else 0) = m U at hrestore
        change m U - (if x ∈ U then 1 else 0) = _ at hcount
        by_cases hxU : x ∈ U
        · simp only [hxU, if_true] at hcount hrestore
          simp only [Multiset.filter_cons_of_pos _ hxU, Multiset.card_cons]
          rw [← hcount]
          exact hrestore.symm
        · simp only [hxU, if_false, Nat.sub_zero] at hcount
          simpa only [Multiset.filter_cons_of_neg _ hxU] using hcount
  exact haux (m K) m rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.exists_cell_separating_multiset
statement:
theorem exists_cell_separating_multiset (hC : IsSetSemiring C) {x : X}
    (hSep : ∀ y : X, x ≠ y → ∃ U ∈ C, x ∈ U ∧ y ∉ U)
    (points : Multiset X) {K : Set X} (hK : K ∈ C) (hxK : x ∈ K) :
    ∃ U ∈ C, x ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ K ∧ ∀ y ∈ points, y ∈ U → y = x
proof:
:= by
  induction points using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨K, hK, hxK, subset_rfl, by simp⟩
  | @cons y points ih =>
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, hUK, hpoints⟩ := ih
    by_cases hyx : y = x
    · refine ⟨U, hU, hxU, hUK, ?_⟩
      intro z hz hzU
      rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl | hz
      · exact hyx
      · exact hpoints z hz hzU
    · obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hyV⟩ := hSep y (Ne.symm hyx)
      refine ⟨U ∩ V, hC.inter_mem _ hU _ hV, ⟨hxU, hxV⟩,
        inter_subset_left.trans hUK, ?_⟩
      intro z hz hzUV
      rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp hz with rfl | hz
      · exact (hyV hzUV.2).elim
      · exact hpoints z hz hzUV.1

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.contentMultiplicity_eq_count
statement:
theorem contentMultiplicity_eq_count (hC : IsSetSemiring C) {x : X}
    (hSep : ∀ y : X, x ≠ y → ∃ U ∈ C, x ∈ U ∧ y ∉ U)
    (m : AddContent ℕ C) {K : Set X} (hK : K ∈ C) (points : Multiset X)
    (hRepr : ∀ U ∈ C, U ⊆ K → m U = (points.filter (· ∈ U)).card)
    (hxK : x ∈ K) : contentMultiplicity m x = points.count x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, hUK, hOnly⟩ :=
      exists_cell_separating_multiset hC hSep points hK hxK
    have hfilter : points.filter (· ∈ U) = points.filter (· = x) := by
      apply Multiset.filter_congr
      intro y hy
      constructor
      · exact hOnly y hy
      · rintro rfl
        exact hxU
    calc contentMultiplicity m x ≤ m U := contentMultiplicity_le m hU hxU
      _ = (points.filter (· ∈ U)).card := hRepr U hU hUK
      _ = points.count x := by
        rw [hfilter]
        simpa using congrArg Multiset.card (Multiset.filter_eq' points x)
  · obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hmin⟩ := exists_cell_eq_contentMultiplicity m x ⟨K, hK, hxK⟩
    have hKV := hC.inter_mem K hK V hV
    calc points.count x = (points.filter (· ∈ K ∩ V)).count x :=
        (Multiset.count_filter_of_pos ⟨hxK, hxV⟩).symm
      _ ≤ (points.filter (· ∈ K ∩ V)).card := Multiset.count_le_card _ _
      _ = m (K ∩ V) := by
        convert (hRepr _ hKV inter_subset_left).symm using 2
        congr 1
      _ ≤ m V := addContent_mono hC hKV hV inter_subset_right
      _ = contentMultiplicity m x := hmin

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.finite_positive_content_support
statement:
theorem finite_positive_content_support [TopologicalSpace X] (hC : IsSetSemiring C)
    (m : AddContent ℕ C) (hOpen : ∀ U ∈ C, IsOpen U)
    {K : Set X} (hSep : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y : X, x ≠ y → ∃ U ∈ C, x ∈ U ∧ y ∉ U)
    (hK : K ∈ C) (hCompact : IsCompact K) :
    Set.Finite {x | x ∈ K ∧ 0 < contentMultiplicity m x}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨points, _, hRepr⟩ := exists_local_atomic_representation hC m hOpen hK hCompact
  apply points.toFinset.finite_toSet.subset
  intro x hx
  change x ∈ K ∧ 0 < contentMultiplicity m x at hx
  rw [contentMultiplicity_eq_count hC (hSep x hx.1) m hK points hRepr hx.1] at hx
  exact Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr (Multiset.count_pos.mp hx.2)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.content_eq_sum_multiplicity
statement:
theorem content_eq_sum_multiplicity [TopologicalSpace X] (hC : IsSetSemiring C)
    (m : AddContent ℕ C) (hOpen : ∀ U ∈ C, IsOpen U)
    {K : Set X} (hSep : ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y : X, x ≠ y → ∃ U ∈ C, x ∈ U ∧ y ∉ U)
    (hK : K ∈ C) (hCompact : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ S : Finset X, (∀ x, x ∈ S ↔ x ∈ K ∧ 0 < contentMultiplicity m x) ∧
      m K = ∑ x ∈ S, contentMultiplicity m x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨points, hpoints, hRepr⟩ := exists_local_atomic_representation hC m hOpen hK hCompact
  have hcount := fun x hxK => contentMultiplicity_eq_count hC (hSep x hxK) m hK points hRepr hxK
  refine ⟨points.toFinset, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hxpoints := Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hx
      have hxK := hpoints x hxpoints
      exact ⟨hxK, (hcount x hxK).symm ▸ Multiset.count_pos.mpr hxpoints⟩
    · rintro ⟨hxK, hxpos⟩
      rw [hcount x hxK] at hxpos
      exact Multiset.mem_toFinset.mpr (Multiset.count_pos.mp hxpos)
  · calc m K = points.card := by
          rw [hRepr K hK subset_rfl, Multiset.filter_eq_self.mpr hpoints]
         _ = ∑ x ∈ points.toFinset, points.count x := points.toFinset_sum_count_eq.symm
         _ = ∑ x ∈ points.toFinset, contentMultiplicity m x := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro x hx
          exact (hcount x (hpoints x (Multiset.mem_toFinset.mp hx))).symm

    Tendsto (fun n => (diagonalAtom n).1) atTop (𝓝 ((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  exact (tendsto_const_nhds : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0)).prodMk_nhds
    (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1))

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianUniversalityExamples.diagonalAtom_escape
statement: theorem diagonalAtom_escape : Tendsto diagonalAtom atTop (cocompact UpperPoint)
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_def.2
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hKs⟩ := mem_cocompact.1 hs
  have hclosed : IsClosed (Subtype.val '' K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) :=
    (hK.image continuous_subtype_val).isClosed
  have hnot : ((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) ∉ (Subtype.val '' K : Set (ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    rintro ⟨p, _, hp⟩
    have hpos := p.2
    rw [hp] at hpos
    exact (lt_irrefl (0 : ℝ)) hpos
  have hev := diagonalAtom_limit.eventually (hclosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hnot)
  filter_upwards [hev] with n hn
  apply hKs
  intro hnK
  exact hn ⟨diagonalAtom n, hnK, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianUniversalityExamples.restricted_section_not_c0

theorem restricted_section_not_c0 :
    ¬ ∃ f : C₀(UpperPoint, ℝ), ∀ p, f p = kernel 1 p.1 (0, 1)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨f, hf⟩
  have hz := (zero_at_infty f).comp diagonalAtom_escape
  have hc : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => kernel 1 p (0, 1)) := by
    unfold kernel
    fun_prop
  have hk := (hc.tendsto ((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ))).comp diagonalAtom_limit
  have heq : (fun n => f (diagonalAtom n)) =
      fun n => kernel 1 (diagonalAtom n).1 (0, 1) := funext fun n => hf _
  change Tendsto (fun n => f (diagonalAtom n)) atTop (𝓝 0) at hz
  rw [heq] at hz
  have hzero := tendsto_nhds_unique hk hz
  exact (Real.exp_pos _).ne' hzero

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianUniversalityExamples.two_coincident_weighted_atoms
statement:
theorem two_coincident_weighted_atoms :
    weightedPersistenceEmbedding 1 persistenceWeight
        (Measure.sum fun _ : Fin 2 => Measure.dirac unitBar) =
      (2 : ℝ) • featureAt 1 (0, 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedPersistenceEmbedding_finite 1 persistenceWeight (fun _ : Fin 2 => unitBar)
    (fun _ => (persistenceWeight_pos unitBar).le)]
  norm_num [unitBar, persistenceWeight, Fin.sum_univ_two, two_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianUniversalityExamples.infiniteDiagramMeasure_weighted_finite
statement:
theorem infiniteDiagramMeasure_weighted_finite :
    (∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (persistenceWeight p) ∂infiniteDiagramMeasure) < ∞
proof:
:= by
  rw [infiniteDiagramMeasure, countableDiagramMeasure_weighted_mass]
  simp only [persistenceWeight, diagonalAtom, sub_zero]
  exact (summable_geometric_of_abs_lt_one (by norm_num : |(1 / 2 : ℝ)| < 1)).tsum_ofReal_lt_top

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianUniversalityExamples.infiniteDiagramMeasure_regular
statement: theorem infiniteDiagramMeasure_regular : infiniteDiagramMeasure.Regular
proof: := inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianUniversalityExamples.recover_infiniteDiagram
statement:
theorem recover_infiniteDiagram (ν : Measure UpperPoint)
    (hν : (∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (persistenceWeight p) ∂ν) < ∞) :
    weightedPersistenceEmbedding 1 persistenceWeight infiniteDiagramMeasure =
      weightedPersistenceEmbedding 1 persistenceWeight ν ↔ infiniteDiagramMeasure = ν
proof:
:=
  weightedPersistenceEmbedding_eq_iff (by norm_num) persistenceWeight
    persistenceWeight_continuous.measurable persistenceWeight_pos _ _
    infiniteDiagramMeasure_weighted_finite hν

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianUniversalityExamples.zero_weight_all_equal
statement:
theorem zero_weight_all_equal (σ : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure UpperPoint) :
    weightedPersistenceEmbedding σ (fun _ => 0) μ =
      weightedPersistenceEmbedding σ (fun _ => 0) ν
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianUniversalityExamples.zero_weight_not_injective
statement:
theorem zero_weight_not_injective (σ : ℝ) :
    ¬ Function.Injective (weightedPersistenceEmbedding σ (fun _ => 0))
proof:
:= by
  intro hinj
  have heq := hinj (zero_weight_all_equal σ 0 (Measure.dirac unitBar))
  have hmass := congrArg (fun μ : Measure UpperPoint => μ univ) heq
  simp at hmass

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianUniversalityExamples.zero_bandwidth_atoms_equal

theorem zero_bandwidth_atoms_equal :
    signedEmbedding 0 (VectorMeasure.dirac ((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)) 1) =

proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianUniversalityExamples.zero_bandwidth_not_injective
statement: theorem zero_bandwidth_not_injective : ¬ Function.Injective (signedEmbedding 0)

  have hatom := congrArg
    (fun μ : SignedMeasure (ℝ × ℝ) => μ {((0 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ))}) heq
