name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.nonzero_finite_hook_has_canonical_classification
statement:
theorem nonzero_finite_hook_has_canonical_classification (i d : P) (hid : i < d) :
    ∃ S : Finset (FiniteHookDeflation.Index (Hook.module (k := k) i d)),
      Nonempty (Hook.module (k := k) i d ≅
        ⨁ fun t : S => FiniteHookDeflation.family (Hook.module (k := k) i d) t.1)
proof:
:= by
  apply (rankProjective_iff_exists_canonical_subfamily
    (M := Hook.module (k := k) i d) (fun _ => inferInstance)).mp
  exact Hook.isRankProjective hid

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.zero_has_empty_canonical_classification
statement:
theorem zero_has_empty_canonical_classification :
    ∃ S : Finset (FiniteHookDeflation.Index (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P)),
      S = ∅ ∧ Nonempty ((0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) ≅
        ⨁ fun t : S => FiniteHookDeflation.family (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) t.1)
proof:
:= by
  let M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P := 0
  letI (p : P) : Subsingleton (M.obj p) :=
    ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)
  letI (ab : FiniteHookDeflation.StrictPair P) :
      Subsingleton (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M ab.property.le)) := by
    infer_instance
  have hcard : Fintype.card (FiniteHookDeflation.Index M) = 0 := by
    rw [FiniteHookDeflation.card_index]
    simp [FiniteHookDeflation.Index, M, Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton]
  have hindex : IsEmpty (FiniteHookDeflation.Index M) :=
    Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hcard
  have hRP : IsRankProjective M := by
    intro L A B ι π h α
    exact ⟨0, (isZero_zero _).eq_of_src _ _⟩
  have hfd : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := by
    intro p
    infer_instance
  obtain ⟨S, e⟩ :=
    (rankProjective_iff_exists_canonical_subfamily M hfd).mp hRP
  have hS : S = ∅ := by
    ext t
    exact isEmptyElim (hindex.false t)
  exact ⟨S, hS, e⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.HookCokernel.hook_isZero
statement: theorem hook_isZero (i : P) : IsZero (Hook.module (k := k) i i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Functor.isZero_iff]
  intro p
  rw [ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton]
  constructor
  intro x y
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hp : p ∉ Hook.support i i := fun h => h.2 h.1
  exact (SupportInterval.val_eq_zero _ hp x).trans
    (SupportInterval.val_eq_zero _ hp y).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.HookCokernel.projection_birth
statement:
@[simp] theorem projection_birth {i j : P} (h : i < j) :
    ((projection (k := k) i j).app i).hom (HookInfinity.birth i) =
      SupportInterval.one (Hook.support i j) (Hook.birth_mem h)
proof:
:= by
  unfold projection
  rw [dif_pos (Hook.birth_mem h)]
  exact HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.HookCokernel.inclusion_projection
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem inclusion_projection {i j : P} (h : i ≤ j) :
    inclusion (k := k) h ≫ projection i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact SupportInterval.val_eq_zero _ (Hook.death_not_mem i j) _

name: TDA.Persistence.HookCokernel.dies
proof:
:= by
  have hn := congrArg (fun t : (HookInfinity.module (R := k) i).obj i ⟶ M.obj j =>
    t.hom (HookInfinity.birth i)) (φ.naturality (homOfLE h))
  have hz := congrArg (fun t : HookInfinity.module (R := k) j ⟶ M =>
    (t.app j).hom (HookInfinity.birth j)) hφ
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.comp_apply, inclusion,
    HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth, NatTrans.app_zero, ModuleCat.hom_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hz
  exact hn.symm.trans hz

name: TDA.Persistence.HookCokernel.projection_desc
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem projection_desc {i j : P} (h : i ≤ j)
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P} (φ : HookInfinity.module (R := k) i ⟶ M)
    (hφ : inclusion h ≫ φ = 0) :
    projection i j ≫ desc h φ hφ = φ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hij : i < j
  · apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
    simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.comp_apply, projection_birth hij]
    unfold desc
    rw [dif_pos hij]
    exact Hook.fromGenerator_birth hij _ _ _
  · have heq : i = j := eq_of_le_of_not_lt h hij
    subst j
    have hinc : inclusion (k := k) (le_rfl : i ≤ i) = 𝟙 _ := by
      apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
      simp [inclusion]
    have hzero : φ = 0 := by simpa [hinc] using hφ
    simp [desc, hzero]

name: TDA.Persistence.HookCokernel.hom_ext
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i < j
  · apply Hook.hom_ext hij
    have he := congrArg (fun t : HookInfinity.module (R := k) i ⟶ M =>
      (t.app i).hom (HookInfinity.birth i)) hab
    simpa only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.comp_apply, projection_birth hij] using he
  · have heq : i = j := eq_of_le_of_not_lt h hij
    subst j
    exact (hook_isZero (k := k) i).eq_of_src a b

name: TDA.Persistence.HookCokernel.projection_iso
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem projection_iso {i j : P} (h : i ≤ j) :
    cokernel.π (inclusion (k := k) h) ≫ (iso (k := k) h).hom = projection i j
proof:
:= by
  exact (cokernelIsCokernel (inclusion (k := k) h)).comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom
    (isCokernel (k := k) h) WalkingParallelPair.one

name: TDA.Persistence.HookCokernel.rankProjective
statement:
theorem rankProjective {i j : P} (h : i ≤ j) :
    IsRankProjective (Hook.module (k := k) i j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hij : i < j
  · exact Hook.isRankProjective hij
  · have heq : i = j := eq_of_le_of_not_lt h hij
    subst j
    intro L M N ι π hs α
    exact ⟨0, (zero_comp).trans ((hook_isZero (k := k) i).eq_of_src 0 α)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.diagramPair_mem_uniformBudget
statement:
private theorem diagramPair_mem_uniformBudget (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (a b : V → X) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {R : ℝ}
    (hδ : Cech.displacement a b ≤ R) :
    (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n, dgm k (Cech.filter b) n) ∈
      {z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ |
        essentialPart z.1.points = 0 ∧ essentialPart z.2.points = 0 ∧
        Fintype.card z.1.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card z.2.finiteOccurrences ≤
          2 * Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) ∧
        bottleneck z.1 z.2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨essentialPart_dgm_eq_zero k a hn, essentialPart_dgm_eq_zero k b hn, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n).finiteOccurrences +
      Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter b) n).finiteOccurrences ≤
        2 * Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2)
    have ha := card_finiteOccurrences_dgm_fullComplex_le k (Cech.filter a) n
    have hb := card_finiteOccurrences_dgm_fullComplex_le k (Cech.filter b) n
    simpa only [two_mul] using Nat.add_le_add ha hb
  · exact (bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement k a b n).trans
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hδ)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.finitePMatchingCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (k : Type u) [Field k] (a b : V → X)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hδ : Cech.displacement a b ≤ R) :
proof:
|finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter b) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1) -
        (bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter b) n)).toReal| ≤
      ((((max 1 (2 * Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2)) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) - 1) * R := by
  have h := diagramPair_mem_uniformBudget k a b hn hδ
  exact finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound hp _ _
    h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 hR h.2.2.2

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (k : Type u) [Field k] (a b : V → X)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hδ : Cech.displacement a b ≤ R) :
    |finitePBoundaryTransportCost p
        (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter b) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1) -
        (bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter b) n)).toReal| ≤
      ((((max 1 (2 * Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2)) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) - 1) * R
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  exact finitePMatchingCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound hp k a b hn hR hδ

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.finitePMatchingCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun p : ℝ => fun z : (V → X) × (V → X) =>
        finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter z.1) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
          (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter z.2) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1))
      (fun z : (V → X) × (V → X) =>
        (bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter z.1) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter z.2) n)).toReal)
      atTop {z : (V → X) × (V → X) | Cech.displacement z.1 z.2 ≤ R}
proof:
:= by
  have h := (finitePMatchingCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck
    (2 * Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2)) R hR).comp
      (fun z : (V → X) × (V → X) => (dgm k (Cech.filter z.1) n, dgm k (Cech.filter z.2) n))
  exact h.mono fun z hz => diagramPair_mem_uniformBudget k z.1 z.2 hn hz

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun p : ℝ => fun z : (V → X) × (V → X) =>
        finitePBoundaryTransportCost p
          (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter z.1) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
          (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter z.2) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1))
      (fun z : (V → X) × (V → X) =>
        (bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter z.1) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter z.2) n)).toReal)
      atTop {z : (V → X) × (V → X) | Cech.displacement z.1 z.2 ≤ R}
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using
    finitePMatchingCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck (V := V) (X := X) k n hn R hR

name: TDA.Persistence.cut_mem_cell_of_endpoint_inside
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, y, hcell⟩ := hc
  rcases cut_eq_minus_or_plus_of_mem_cutCell hcell with hminus | hplus
  · rw [hminus]
    change a ∈ (minusCut (cutEndpoint c)).lower ∧ b ∈ (minusCut (cutEndpoint c)).upper
    exact ⟨by simpa [minusCut] using ha, by simpa [minusCut] using hb.le⟩
  · rw [hplus]
    change a ∈ (plusCut (cutEndpoint c)).lower ∧ b ∈ (plusCut (cutEndpoint c)).upper
    exact ⟨by simpa [plusCut] using ha.le, by simpa [plusCut] using hb⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteOccurrence_neighbors_finite
statement:
private theorem finiteOccurrence_neighbors_finite
    (D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (x : D.finiteOccurrences)
    (hlong : 2 * (ε : ℝ) < (D.finitePoint x).2 - (D.finitePoint x).1) :
    Finite {y : E.finiteOccurrences //
      finitePairCost (D.finitePoint x) (E.finitePoint y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let birth := (D.finitePoint x).1
  let death := (D.finitePoint x).2
  let δ := ((ε : ℝ) + (death - birth) / 2) / 2
  have hgap : birth < death := by
    exact D.finiteEndpointOrder x.1.1 x.1.2.1 x.1.2.2
  have hεδ : (ε : ℝ) < δ := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  have hδgap : δ < (death - birth) / 2 := by dsimp [δ]; linarith
  have hδ : 0 < δ := by linarith
  let a := birth - δ
  let b := birth + δ
  let c := death - δ
  let d := death + δ
  have hab : a < b := by dsimp [a, b]; linarith
  have hbc : b < c := by dsimp [b, c]; linarith
  have hcd : c < d := by dsimp [c, d]; linarith
  let S : Set (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) :=
    {p | p ∈ rectangleCell a b c d ∧ 0 < E.multiplicity p}
  have hS : S.Finite := by
    exact E.locallyFiniteRectangle a b c d hab hbc hcd
  let Tokens := {p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ // p ∈ S}
  letI : Finite Tokens := hS
  let emb : {y : E.finiteOccurrences //
      finitePairCost (D.finitePoint x) (E.finitePoint y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)} →
      Σ p : Tokens, Fin (E.multiplicity p.1) := fun y => by
    have hcost := y.2
    have hmax : max |birth - (E.finitePoint y.1).1|
        |death - (E.finitePoint y.1).2| ≤ (ε : ℝ) := by
      have h := (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (NNReal.coe_nonneg ε)).1 hcost
      simpa [finitePairCost, birth, death] using h
    have hb : |(E.finitePoint y.1).1 - birth| ≤ (ε : ℝ) := by
      have := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hmax
      simpa [abs_sub_comm] using this
    have hd : |(E.finitePoint y.1).2 - death| ≤ (ε : ℝ) := by
      have := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hmax
      simpa [abs_sub_comm] using this
    have hborn : a < cutEndpoint y.1.1.1.1 ∧ cutEndpoint y.1.1.1.1 < b := by
      have hb' : |cutEndpoint y.1.1.1.1 - birth| ≤ (ε : ℝ) := by
        simpa [LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.finitePoint, birth] using hb
      constructor <;> dsimp [a, b] <;> rw [abs_le] at hb' <;> dsimp [δ] at * <;> linarith
    have hdead : c < cutEndpoint y.1.1.1.2 ∧ cutEndpoint y.1.1.1.2 < d := by
      have hd' : |cutEndpoint y.1.1.1.2 - death| ≤ (ε : ℝ) := by
        simpa [LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.finitePoint, death] using hd
      constructor <;> dsimp [c, d] <;> rw [abs_le] at hd' <;> dsimp [δ] at * <;> linarith
    have hend := E.finiteEndpoints y.1.1.1 y.1.1.2.1 y.1.1.2.2
    have hcell1 := cut_mem_cell_of_endpoint_inside hend.1 hborn.1 hborn.2
    have hcell2 := cut_mem_cell_of_endpoint_inside hend.2 hdead.1 hdead.2
    exact ⟨⟨y.1.1.1, ⟨⟨hcell1, hcell2⟩, y.1.1.2.1⟩⟩, y.1.2⟩
  have hemb : Function.Injective emb := by
    intro y z h
    rcases y with ⟨⟨⟨p, hp⟩, iy⟩, hy⟩
    rcases z with ⟨⟨⟨q, hq⟩, iz⟩, hz⟩
    dsimp [emb] at h
    have hpq : p = q := congrArg
      (fun t : Σ p : Tokens, Fin (E.multiplicity p.1) => t.1.1) h
    have hij : (iy : ℕ) = iz := congrArg
      (fun t : Σ p : Tokens, Fin (E.multiplicity p.1) => (t.2 : ℕ)) h
    subst q
    have hidx : iy = iz := Fin.ext hij
    subst iz
    rfl
  exact Finite.of_injective emb hemb

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialOccurrence_neighbors_finite
statement:
private theorem essentialOccurrence_neighbors_finite
    (D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (x : D.essentialOccurrences) :
    Finite {y : E.essentialOccurrences //
      essentialPairCost (D.essentialBirth x) (E.essentialBirth y) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let birth := D.essentialBirth x
  let δ := (ε : ℝ) + 1
  let a := birth - δ
  let b := birth + δ
  let c := b + 1
  have hab : a < b := by dsimp [a, b, δ]; linarith
  have hbc : b < c := by dsimp [c]; linarith
  let S : Set (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) :=
    {p | p ∈ tailRectangleCell a b c ∧ 0 < E.multiplicity p}
  have hS : S.Finite := E.locallyFiniteTail a b c hab hbc
  let Tokens := {p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ // p ∈ S}
  letI : Finite Tokens := hS
  let emb : {y : E.essentialOccurrences //
      essentialPairCost (D.essentialBirth x) (E.essentialBirth y) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)} → Σ p : Tokens, Fin (E.multiplicity p.1) := fun y => by
    have hcost : |birth - E.essentialBirth y.1| ≤ (ε : ℝ) := by
      apply (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (NNReal.coe_nonneg ε)).1
      simpa [essentialPairCost] using y.2
    have hb : |E.essentialBirth y.1 - birth| ≤ (ε : ℝ) := by
      simpa [abs_sub_comm] using hcost
    have hbirth : a < cutEndpoint y.1.1.1 ∧ cutEndpoint y.1.1.1 < b := by
      have hb' : |cutEndpoint y.1.1.1 - birth| ≤ (ε : ℝ) := by
        simpa [LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.essentialBirth, birth] using hb
      constructor <;> dsimp [a, b, δ] <;> rw [abs_le] at hb' <;> linarith
    have hend := E.essentialBirthEndpoint y.1.1.1 y.1.1.2
    have hcell := cut_mem_cell_of_endpoint_inside hend hbirth.1 hbirth.2
    have hc : c ∈ infinityCut.lower := by
      simp [infinityCut, cutOfLowerSet]
    exact ⟨⟨(y.1.1.1, infinityCut), ⟨hcell, hc⟩, y.1.1.2⟩, y.1.2⟩
  have hemb : Function.Injective emb := by
    intro y z h
    rcases y with ⟨⟨⟨birth, hb⟩, iy⟩, hy⟩
    rcases z with ⟨⟨⟨birth', hb'⟩, iz⟩, hz⟩
    dsimp [emb] at h
    have hpoint : (birth, infinityCut) = (birth', infinityCut) := congrArg
      (fun t : Σ p : Tokens, Fin (E.multiplicity p.1) => t.1.1) h
    have hbirth : birth = birth' := congrArg Prod.fst hpoint
    have hij : (iy : ℕ) = iz := congrArg
      (fun t : Σ p : Tokens, Fin (E.multiplicity p.1) => (t.2 : ℕ)) h
    subst birth'
    have hidx : iy = iz := Fin.ext hij
    subst iz
    rfl
  exact Finite.of_injective emb hemb

name: TDA.Persistence.finite_sourceCandidates_finite
statement:
private theorem finite_sourceCandidates_finite
    (D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (s : Finset (LongFiniteOccurrence D ε)) :
    (finiteSourceCandidates D E ε s).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := {x : LongFiniteOccurrence D ε // x ∈ s}
  let N : L → Type := fun x =>
    {y : E.finiteOccurrences //
      finitePairCost (D.finitePoint x.1.1) (E.finitePoint y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)}
  letI : Fintype L := Finset.Subtype.fintype s
  have hN : ∀ x : L, Finite (N x) := by
    intro x
    exact finiteOccurrence_neighbors_finite D E ε x.1.1 x.1.2
  letI : ∀ x : L, Finite (N x) := hN
  letI : ∀ x : L, Fintype (N x) := fun x => Fintype.ofFinite (N x)
  let SigmaN := Σ x : L, N x
  letI : Fintype SigmaN := inferInstance
  let f : SigmaN → D.finiteOccurrences × E.finiteOccurrences :=
    fun q => (q.1.1.1, q.2.1)
  have hImage : (Set.image f (Set.univ : Set SigmaN)).Finite := Set.finite_univ.image f
  have heq : finiteSourceCandidates D E ε s = Set.image f Set.univ := by
    ext e
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, hx, hfirst, hcost⟩
      rcases e with ⟨a, b⟩
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hfirst
      subst a
      refine ⟨⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨b, ?_⟩⟩, Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      · exact hcost
      · rfl
    · rintro ⟨q, -, hEq⟩
      rcases q with ⟨x, y⟩
      have hfirst := congrArg Prod.fst hEq
      have hsecond := congrArg Prod.snd hEq
      rcases e with ⟨a, b⟩
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hfirst hsecond
      subst a
      subst b
      exact ⟨x.1, x.2, rfl, y.2⟩
  rw [heq]
  exact hImage

name: TDA.Persistence.finite_targetCandidates_finite
statement:
private theorem finite_targetCandidates_finite
    (D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (s : Finset (LongFiniteOccurrence E ε)) :
    (finiteTargetCandidates D E ε s).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := {y : LongFiniteOccurrence E ε // y ∈ s}
  let N : L → Type := fun y =>
    {x : D.finiteOccurrences //
      finitePairCost (D.finitePoint x) (E.finitePoint y.1.1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)}
  letI : Fintype L := Finset.Subtype.fintype s
  have hN : ∀ y : L, Finite (N y) := by
    intro y
    let Rev := {x : D.finiteOccurrences //
      finitePairCost (E.finitePoint y.1.1) (D.finitePoint x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)}
    let f : Rev → N y := fun x => ⟨x.1, by
      simpa only [finitePairCost_comm] using x.2⟩
    have hf : Function.Bijective f := by
      constructor
      · intro x z h
        apply Subtype.ext
        simpa [f] using congrArg Subtype.val h
      · intro x
        exact ⟨⟨x.1, by simpa only [finitePairCost_comm] using x.2⟩, rfl⟩
    letI : Finite Rev := finiteOccurrence_neighbors_finite E D ε y.1.1 y.1.2
    exact Finite.of_equiv Rev (Equiv.ofBijective f hf)
  letI : ∀ y : L, Finite (N y) := hN
  letI : ∀ y : L, Fintype (N y) := fun y => Fintype.ofFinite (N y)
  let SigmaN := Σ y : L, N y
  letI : Fintype SigmaN := inferInstance
  let f : SigmaN → D.finiteOccurrences × E.finiteOccurrences :=
    fun q => (q.2.1, q.1.1.1)
  have hImage : (Set.image f (Set.univ : Set SigmaN)).Finite := Set.finite_univ.image f
  have heq : finiteTargetCandidates D E ε s = Set.image f Set.univ := by
    ext e
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hsecond, hcost⟩
      rcases e with ⟨a, b⟩
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hsecond
      subst b
      refine ⟨⟨⟨y, hy⟩, ⟨a, ?_⟩⟩, Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      · exact hcost
      · rfl
    · rintro ⟨q, -, hEq⟩
      rcases q with ⟨y, x⟩
      have hfirst := congrArg Prod.fst hEq
      have hsecond := congrArg Prod.snd hEq
      rcases e with ⟨a, b⟩
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hfirst hsecond
      subst a
      subst b
      exact ⟨y.1, y.2, rfl, x.2⟩
  rw [heq]
  exact hImage

name: TDA.Persistence.finite_essentialSourceCandidates_finite
statement:
private theorem finite_essentialSourceCandidates_finite
    (D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram) (ε : ℝ≥0)

name: TDA.Persistence.finite_essentialTargetCandidates_finite

    {x : D.essentialOccurrences //
      essentialPairCost (D.essentialBirth x) (E.essentialBirth y.1) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)}

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteCandidates_finite
statement:
private theorem finiteCandidates_finite
    (D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : MatchingIndex D E ε) : (finiteCandidates D E ε I).Finite
proof:
:= by
  exact (finite_sourceCandidates_finite D E ε I.1.1).union
    (finite_targetCandidates_finite D E ε I.1.2)

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialCandidates_finite
statement:
private theorem essentialCandidates_finite
    (D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : MatchingIndex D E ε) : (essentialCandidates D E ε I).Finite
proof:
:= by
  exact (finite_essentialSourceCandidates_finite D E ε I.2.1).union
    (finite_essentialTargetCandidates_finite D E ε I.2.2)

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteCandidates_mono
statement:
private theorem finiteCandidates_mono
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    {I J : MatchingIndex D E ε} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    finiteCandidates D E ε I ⊆ finiteCandidates D E ε J
proof:
:= by
  intro e he
  rcases Set.mem_or_mem_of_mem_union he with hs | ht
  · left
    rcases hs with ⟨x, hx, hEq, hcost⟩
    rcases e with ⟨a, b⟩
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hEq
    subst a
    exact ⟨x, hIJ.1.1 hx, rfl, hcost⟩
  · right
    rcases ht with ⟨y, hy, hEq, hcost⟩
    rcases e with ⟨a, b⟩
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hEq
    subst b
    exact ⟨y, hIJ.1.2 hy, rfl, hcost⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialCandidates_mono
statement:
private theorem essentialCandidates_mono
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    {I J : MatchingIndex D E ε} (hIJ : I ≤ J) :
    essentialCandidates D E ε I ⊆ essentialCandidates D E ε J
proof:
:= by

  rcases Set.mem_or_mem_of_mem_union he with hs | ht
  · left
    rcases hs with ⟨x, hx, hEq, hcost⟩
    rcases e with ⟨a, b⟩
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hEq
    subst a
    exact ⟨x, hIJ.2.1 hx, rfl, hcost⟩
  · right
    rcases ht with ⟨y, hy, hEq, hcost⟩
    rcases e with ⟨a, b⟩
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hEq
    subst b
    exact ⟨y, hIJ.2.2 hy, rfl, hcost⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteCandidates_cost
proof:
:= by
  rcases Set.mem_or_mem_of_mem_union he with hs | ht
  · rcases hs with ⟨x, hx, hEq, hcost⟩
    exact hcost
  · rcases ht with ⟨y, hy, hEq, hcost⟩
    exact hcost

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialCandidates_cost
proof:
:= by
  rcases Set.mem_or_mem_of_mem_union he with hs | ht
  · rcases hs with ⟨x, hx, hEq, hcost⟩

  · rcases ht with ⟨y, hy, hEq, hcost⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.restrictLocalMatchingState_id
statement:
private theorem restrictLocalMatchingState_id
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    {I : MatchingIndex D E ε} (s : LocalMatchingState D E ε I) :
    restrictLocalMatchingState (le_rfl : I ≤ I) s = s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Finset.ext
    intro e
    simp only [restrictLocalMatchingState, Finset.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
    constructor
    · exact And.left
    · intro he
      exact ⟨he, s.2.finiteCandidates e he⟩
  · apply Finset.ext
    intro e
    simp only [restrictLocalMatchingState, Finset.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
    constructor
    · exact And.left
    · intro he
      exact ⟨he, s.2.essentialCandidates e he⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.restrictLocalMatchingState_comp
statement:
private theorem restrictLocalMatchingState_comp
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    {I J K : MatchingIndex D E ε} (hIJ : I ≤ J) (hJK : J ≤ K)
    (s : LocalMatchingState D E ε K) :
    restrictLocalMatchingState hIJ (restrictLocalMatchingState hJK s) =
      restrictLocalMatchingState (le_trans hIJ hJK) s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply Finset.ext
    intro e
    simp only [restrictLocalMatchingState, Finset.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨he, hJ⟩, hI⟩
      exact ⟨he, hI⟩
    · rintro ⟨he, hI⟩
      exact ⟨⟨he, finiteCandidates_mono hIJ hI⟩, hI⟩
  · apply Finset.ext
    intro e
    simp only [restrictLocalMatchingState, Finset.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨he, hJ⟩, hI⟩
      exact ⟨he, hI⟩
    · rintro ⟨he, hI⟩
      exact ⟨⟨he, essentialCandidates_mono hIJ hI⟩, hI⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.map_encodeFinset
statement:
private theorem map_encodeFinset {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (C : Set α)
    [DecidablePred C]
    (s : Finset α) (h : ∀ a ∈ s, a ∈ C) :
    (encodeFinset C s h).map (Function.Embedding.subtype C) = s
proof:
:= by
  rw [encodeFinset]
  exact Finset.subtype_map_of_mem h

name: TDA.Persistence.finite_localMatchingState
statement:
private theorem finite_localMatchingState
    (D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : MatchingIndex D E ε) : Finite (LocalMatchingState D E ε I)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let CF := {e : D.finiteOccurrences × E.finiteOccurrences //
    e ∈ finiteCandidates D E ε I}
  let CG := {e : D.essentialOccurrences × E.essentialOccurrences //
    e ∈ essentialCandidates D E ε I}
  letI : Fintype CF := (finiteCandidates_finite D E ε I).fintype
  letI : Fintype CG := (essentialCandidates_finite D E ε I).fintype
  letI : DecidablePred (finiteCandidates D E ε I) :=
    Classical.decPred (finiteCandidates D E ε I)
  letI : DecidablePred (essentialCandidates D E ε I) :=
    Classical.decPred (essentialCandidates D E ε I)
  let encode : LocalMatchingState D E ε I → Finset CF × Finset CG := fun s =>
    (encodeFinset _ s.1.1 s.2.finiteCandidates,
      encodeFinset _ s.1.2 s.2.essentialCandidates)
  have hencode : Function.Injective encode := by
    intro s t h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Prod.ext
    · have h' := congrArg (fun p : Finset CF × Finset CG =>
          p.1.map (Function.Embedding.subtype _)) h
      have hs := map_encodeFinset (finiteCandidates D E ε I) s.1.1
        s.2.finiteCandidates
      have ht := map_encodeFinset (finiteCandidates D E ε I) t.1.1
        t.2.finiteCandidates
      exact hs.symm.trans (h'.trans ht)
    · have h' := congrArg (fun p : Finset CF × Finset CG =>
          p.2.map (Function.Embedding.subtype _)) h
      have hs := map_encodeFinset (essentialCandidates D E ε I) s.1.2
        s.2.essentialCandidates
      have ht := map_encodeFinset (essentialCandidates D E ε I) t.1.2
        t.2.essentialCandidates
      exact hs.symm.trans (h'.trans ht)
  exact Finite.of_injective encode hencode

name: TDA.Persistence.localMatchingState_nonempty
statement:
private theorem localMatchingState_nonempty
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {ε : ℝ≥0} {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame)
    (I : MatchingIndex (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM)
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN) ε) :
    Nonempty (LocalMatchingState (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM)
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN) ε I)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram := LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM
  let E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram := LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN
  let F_M := I.1.1.image Subtype.val
  let F_N := I.1.2.image Subtype.val
  have hLongM : ∀ x ∈ F_M, 2 * (ε : ℝ) < (D.finitePoint x).2 - (D.finitePoint x).1 := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hx with ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact z.2
  have hLongN : ∀ x ∈ F_N, 2 * (ε : ℝ) < (E.finitePoint x).2 - (E.finitePoint x).1 := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hx with ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    exact z.2
  obtain ⟨FEdges, hFR, hFL, hFC, hFCoverL, hFCoverR,
      EEdges, hER, hEL, hEC, hECoverL, hECoverR⟩ :=
    i.exists_finite_saturating_matching hM hN F_M F_N hLongM hLongN I.2.1 I.2.2
  let F := FEdges.filter (fun e => decide (e ∈ finiteCandidates D E ε I))
  let G := EEdges.filter (fun e => decide (e ∈ essentialCandidates D E ε I))
  refine ⟨⟨(F, G), ?_⟩⟩
  constructor
  · intro e he
    simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq, D, E] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2
  · intro a b c hab hac
    exact hFR a b c (Finset.mem_filter.mp hab).1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hac).1
  · intro a b c hab hac
    exact hFL a b c (Finset.mem_filter.mp hab).1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hac).1
  · intro x hx
    have hxFM : x.1 ∈ F_M := Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hFCoverL x.1 hxFM
    refine ⟨y, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hxy, ?_⟩⟩
    have hCandidate : (x.1, y) ∈ finiteCandidates D E ε I := by
      apply Set.mem_union_left
      exact ⟨x, hx, rfl, hFC x.1 y hxy⟩
    simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using hCandidate
  · intro y hy
    have hyFN : y.1 ∈ F_N := Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := hFCoverR y.1 hyFN
    refine ⟨x, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hxy, ?_⟩⟩
    have hCandidate : (x, y.1) ∈ finiteCandidates D E ε I := by
      apply Set.mem_union_right
      exact ⟨y, hy, rfl, hFC x y.1 hxy⟩
    simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using hCandidate
  · intro e he
    simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq, D, E] using (Finset.mem_filter.mp he).2
  · intro a b c hab hac
    exact hER a b c (Finset.mem_filter.mp hab).1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hac).1
  · intro a b c hab hac
    exact hEL a b c (Finset.mem_filter.mp hab).1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hac).1
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hECoverL x hx
    refine ⟨y, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hxy, ?_⟩⟩
    have hCandidate : (x, y) ∈ essentialCandidates D E ε I := by
      apply Set.mem_union_left
      exact ⟨x, hx, rfl, hEC x y hxy⟩
    simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using hCandidate
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := hECoverR y hy
    refine ⟨x, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hxy, ?_⟩⟩
    have hCandidate : (x, y) ∈ essentialCandidates D E ε I := by
      apply Set.mem_union_right
      exact ⟨y, hy, rfl, hEC x y hxy⟩
    simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using hCandidate

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_qModule_coherent_matchingStates
statement:
private theorem exists_qModule_coherent_matchingStates
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {ε : ℝ≥0} {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame) :
    Nonempty (CoherentMatchingStates (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM)
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN) ε)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram := LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM
  let E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram := LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN
  let F := matchingStateFunctor D E ε
  letI : ∀ j : (MatchingIndex D E ε)ᵒᵖ, Finite (F.obj j) := by
    intro j
    simpa [F, matchingStateFunctor] using finite_localMatchingState D E ε j.unop
  letI : ∀ j : (MatchingIndex D E ε)ᵒᵖ, Nonempty (F.obj j) := by
    intro j
    simpa [F, D, E, matchingStateFunctor] using localMatchingState_nonempty i hM hN j.unop
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := nonempty_sections_of_finite_inverse_system F
  refine ⟨{ state := fun I => u (op I), coherent := ?_ }⟩
  intro I J hIJ
  have hsec := hu (homOfLE hIJ).op
  change restrictLocalMatchingState hIJ (u (op J)) = u (op I) at hsec
  exact hsec

name: TDA.Persistence.section_finiteEdge_mono
statement:
private theorem section_finiteEdge_mono
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (u : CoherentMatchingStates D E ε)
    {I J : MatchingIndex D E ε} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    {x : D.finiteOccurrences} {y : E.finiteOccurrences}
    (he : (x, y) ∈ (u.state I).1.1) :
    (x, y) ∈ (u.state J).1.1
proof:
:= by
  have hsec := u.coherent hIJ
  have hm : (x, y) ∈ (restrictLocalMatchingState hIJ (u.state J)).1.1 := by
    rw [hsec]
    exact he
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).1

name: TDA.Persistence.section_essentialEdge_mono
statement:
private theorem section_essentialEdge_mono
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (u : CoherentMatchingStates D E ε)
    {I J : MatchingIndex D E ε} (hIJ : I ≤ J)
    {x : D.essentialOccurrences} {y : E.essentialOccurrences}
    (he : (x, y) ∈ (u.state I).1.2) :
    (x, y) ∈ (u.state J).1.2
proof:
:= by
  have hsec := u.coherent hIJ
  have hm : (x, y) ∈ (restrictLocalMatchingState hIJ (u.state J)).1.2 := by
    rw [hsec]
    exact he
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).1

name: TDA.Persistence.sectionFiniteEdge_right_injective
proof:
:= by
  rcases hy with ⟨I, hy, _⟩
  rcases hz with ⟨J, hz, _⟩
  let K := I ⊔ J
  have hyK := section_finiteEdge_mono u (le_sup_left : I ≤ K) hy
  have hzK := section_finiteEdge_mono u (le_sup_right : J ≤ K) hz
  exact (u.state K).property.finiteRightInjective x y z hyK hzK

name: TDA.Persistence.sectionFiniteEdge_left_injective
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨I, hx, _⟩
  rcases hz with ⟨J, hz, _⟩
  let K := I ⊔ J
  have hxK := section_finiteEdge_mono u (le_sup_left : I ≤ K) hx
  have hzK := section_finiteEdge_mono u (le_sup_right : J ≤ K) hz
  exact (u.state K).property.finiteLeftInjective x y z hxK hzK

name: TDA.Persistence.sectionEssentialEdge_right_injective
proof:
:= by
  rcases hy with ⟨I, hy, _⟩
  rcases hz with ⟨J, hz, _⟩
  let K := I ⊔ J
  have hyK := section_essentialEdge_mono u (le_sup_left : I ≤ K) hy
  have hzK := section_essentialEdge_mono u (le_sup_right : J ≤ K) hz
  exact (u.state K).property.essentialRightInjective x y z hyK hzK

name: TDA.Persistence.sectionEssentialEdge_left_injective
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨I, hx, _⟩
  rcases hz with ⟨J, hz, _⟩
  let K := I ⊔ J
  have hxK := section_essentialEdge_mono u (le_sup_left : I ≤ K) hx
  have hzK := section_essentialEdge_mono u (le_sup_right : J ≤ K) hz
  exact (u.state K).property.essentialLeftInjective x y z hxK hzK

name: TDA.Persistence.sectionFiniteEdge_cost
proof:
:= by
  exact hxy.choose_spec.2

name: TDA.Persistence.sectionEssentialEdge_cost
statement:
private theorem sectionEssentialEdge_cost
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (u : CoherentMatchingStates D E ε)
    {x : D.essentialOccurrences} {y : E.essentialOccurrences}
    (hxy : sectionEssentialEdge D E ε u x y) :
    essentialPairCost (D.essentialBirth x) (E.essentialBirth y) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact hxy.choose_spec.2

name: TDA.Persistence.sectionFiniteEdge_left_covered
statement:
private theorem sectionFiniteEdge_left_covered
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (u : CoherentMatchingStates D E ε) (x : LongFiniteOccurrence D ε) :
    ∃ y : E.finiteOccurrences, sectionFiniteEdge D E ε u x.1 y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I : MatchingIndex D E ε := (({x}, ∅), (∅, ∅))
  have hx : x ∈ I.1.1 := by simp [I]
  obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := (u.state I).property.finiteLeftCovered x hx
  refine ⟨y, I, hxy, ?_⟩
  exact finiteCandidates_cost ((u.state I).property.finiteCandidates (x.1, y) hxy)

name: TDA.Persistence.sectionFiniteEdge_right_covered
statement:
private theorem sectionFiniteEdge_right_covered
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (u : CoherentMatchingStates D E ε) (y : LongFiniteOccurrence E ε) :
    ∃ x : D.finiteOccurrences, sectionFiniteEdge D E ε u x y.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I : MatchingIndex D E ε := ((∅, {y}), (∅, ∅))
  have hy : y ∈ I.1.2 := by simp [I]
  obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := (u.state I).property.finiteRightCovered y hy
  refine ⟨x, I, hxy, ?_⟩
  exact finiteCandidates_cost ((u.state I).property.finiteCandidates (x, y.1) hxy)

name: TDA.Persistence.sectionEssentialEdge_left_covered
statement:
private theorem sectionEssentialEdge_left_covered
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (u : CoherentMatchingStates D E ε) (x : D.essentialOccurrences) :
    ∃ y, sectionEssentialEdge D E ε u x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I : MatchingIndex D E ε := ((∅, ∅), ({x}, ∅))
  have hx : x ∈ I.2.1 := by simp [I]
  obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := (u.state I).property.essentialLeftCovered x hx
  refine ⟨y, I, hxy, ?_⟩
  exact essentialCandidates_cost ((u.state I).property.essentialCandidates (x, y) hxy)

name: TDA.Persistence.sectionEssentialEdge_right_covered
statement:
private theorem sectionEssentialEdge_right_covered
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (u : CoherentMatchingStates D E ε) (y : E.essentialOccurrences) :
    ∃ x, sectionEssentialEdge D E ε u x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I : MatchingIndex D E ε := ((∅, ∅), (∅, {y}))
  have hy : y ∈ I.2.2 := by simp [I]
  obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := (u.state I).property.essentialRightCovered y hy
  refine ⟨x, I, hxy, ?_⟩
  exact essentialCandidates_cost ((u.state I).property.essentialCandidates (x, y) hxy)

name: TDA.Persistence.sectionFiniteMap_some_iff
statement:
private theorem sectionFiniteMap_some_iff
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (u : CoherentMatchingStates D E ε)
    {x : D.finiteOccurrences} {y : E.finiteOccurrences} :
    sectionFiniteMap u x = some y ↔ sectionFiniteEdge D E ε u x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold sectionFiniteMap
  split_ifs with h
  · constructor
    · intro heq
      have hchoose : Classical.choose h = y := Option.some.inj heq
      subst y
      exact Classical.choose_spec h
    · intro hxy
      have hEq := sectionFiniteEdge_right_injective u (Classical.choose_spec h) hxy
      subst y
      rfl
  · constructor
    · intro heq
      simp at heq
    · intro hxy
      exact (h ⟨y, hxy⟩).elim

name: TDA.Persistence.sectionEssentialEquiv_edge
statement:
private theorem sectionEssentialEquiv_edge
    {D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (u : CoherentMatchingStates D E ε) (x : D.essentialOccurrences) :
    sectionEssentialEdge D E ε u x (sectionEssentialEquiv u x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change sectionEssentialEdge D E ε u x
    (Classical.choose (sectionEssentialEdge_left_covered u x))
  exact Classical.choose_spec (sectionEssentialEdge_left_covered u x)

name: TDA.Persistence.diagonalCost_le_of_length_le
statement:
private theorem diagonalCost_le_of_length_le
    (D : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram) (x : D.finiteOccurrences) {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (hLen : (D.finitePoint x).2 - (D.finitePoint x).1 ≤ 2 * (ε : ℝ)) :
    diagonalCost (D.finitePoint x) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold diagonalCost
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
  have horder : (D.finitePoint x).1 < (D.finitePoint x).2 := by
    simpa [LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.finitePoint] using
      D.finiteEndpointOrder x.1.1 x.1.2.1 x.1.2.2
  have hgap : 0 ≤ (D.finitePoint x).2 - (D.finitePoint x).1 := sub_nonneg.mpr horder.le
  rw [abs_of_nonneg hgap]
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.occurrenceMatchingOfSection_cost_le
statement:
private theorem occurrenceMatchingOfSection_cost_le
    (D E : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (u : CoherentMatchingStates D E ε) :
    LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.matchingCost (occurrenceMatchingOfSection D E ε u) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change max
    (⨆ x, match sectionFiniteMap u x with
      | some y => finitePairCost (D.finitePoint x) (E.finitePoint y)
      | none => diagonalCost (D.finitePoint x))
    (max
      (⨆ y, if ∃ x, sectionFiniteMap u x = some y then 0 else diagonalCost (E.finitePoint y))
      (⨆ x, essentialPairCost (D.essentialBirth x)
        (E.essentialBirth (sectionEssentialEquiv u x)))) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)
  have hSource : (⨆ x, match sectionFiniteMap u x with
      | some y => finitePairCost (D.finitePoint x) (E.finitePoint y)
      | none => diagonalCost (D.finitePoint x)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ) := by
    apply iSup_le
    intro x
    cases hm : sectionFiniteMap u x with
    | some y =>
        have hxy := (sectionFiniteMap_some_iff u).1 hm
        simpa [hm] using sectionFiniteEdge_cost u hxy
    | none =>
        have hLong : ¬ 2 * (ε : ℝ) <
            (D.finitePoint x).2 - (D.finitePoint x).1 := by
          intro h
          let xLong : LongFiniteOccurrence D ε := ⟨x, h⟩
          obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := sectionFiniteEdge_left_covered u xLong
          have hsome := (sectionFiniteMap_some_iff u).2 hxy
          rw [hm] at hsome
          cases hsome
        have hLen : (D.finitePoint x).2 - (D.finitePoint x).1 ≤ 2 * (ε : ℝ) :=
          le_of_not_gt hLong
        simpa [hm] using diagonalCost_le_of_length_le D x hLen
  have hTarget : (⨆ y, if ∃ x, sectionFiniteMap u x = some y then 0
      else diagonalCost (E.finitePoint y)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ) := by
    apply iSup_le
    intro y
    by_cases hmatched : ∃ x, sectionFiniteMap u x = some y
    · simp [hmatched]
    · have hLong : ¬ 2 * (ε : ℝ) <
          (E.finitePoint y).2 - (E.finitePoint y).1 := by
        intro h
        let yLong : LongFiniteOccurrence E ε := ⟨y, h⟩
        obtain ⟨x, hxy⟩ := sectionFiniteEdge_right_covered u yLong
        exact hmatched ⟨x, (sectionFiniteMap_some_iff u).2 hxy⟩
      have hLen : (E.finitePoint y).2 - (E.finitePoint y).1 ≤ 2 * (ε : ℝ) :=
        le_of_not_gt hLong
      simpa [hmatched] using diagonalCost_le_of_length_le E y hLen
  have hEssential : (⨆ x, essentialPairCost (D.essentialBirth x)
      (E.essentialBirth (sectionEssentialEquiv u x))) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ) := by
    apply iSup_le
    intro x
    exact sectionEssentialEdge_cost u (sectionEssentialEquiv_edge u x)
  exact max_le hSource (max_le hTarget hEssential)

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_occurrenceMatching_cost_le_of_realInterleaving
statement:
theorem exists_occurrenceMatching_cost_le_of_realInterleaving
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {ε : ℝ≥0} {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame) :
    ∃ m : OccurrenceMatching
        (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM).finiteOccurrences
        (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN).finiteOccurrences
        (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM).essentialOccurrences
        (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN).essentialOccurrences,
      LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.matchingCost m ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u⟩ := exists_qModule_coherent_matchingStates i hM hN
  exact ⟨occurrenceMatchingOfSection _ _ ε u, occurrenceMatchingOfSection_cost_le _ _ ε u⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.qTame_bottleneck_le_of_realInterleaving
statement:
theorem qTame_bottleneck_le_of_realInterleaving
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {ε : ℝ≥0} {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ}
    (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame) :
    LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.bottleneck
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM)
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_occurrenceMatching_cost_le_of_realInterleaving i hM hN
  exact (iInf_le _ m).trans hm

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.vertex_chain
statement:
private theorem vertex_chain {V W : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder W]
    (R : Type) [Ring R] {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W} (f : VertexMap K L) (x : V)
    (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ K) (hy : ({f x} : Finset W) ∈ L) (a : R) :
    vertexChainMap R f 0 (Finsupp.single (vertex K x hx) a) =
      Finsupp.single (vertex L (f x) hy) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexChainMap_vertex]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [vertexImageFace, tupleFace]
  dsimp
  rw [← Finset.image_image, Finset.image_orderEmbOfFin_univ]
  simp [vertex]

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.vClass_map
statement:
private theorem vClass_map {V W : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder W]
    (R : Type) [Ring R] {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W} (f : VertexMap K L) (x : V)
    (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ K) (hy : ({f x} : Finset W) ∈ L) (a : R) :
    (simplicialHomologyMap R f 0).hom (vClass R K x hx a) = vClass R L (f x) hy a
proof:
:=
  simplicialHomologyMap_class R f 0 _ _ (vertex_chain R f x hx hy a)

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.vClass_nonzero
statement:
private theorem vClass_nonzero {V : Type} [LinearOrder V]
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (x : V) (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ K) :
    vClass ℚ K x hx 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hq := congrArg (homologyKernelQuotient ℚ (simplicialChainComplex K ℚ) 0).hom.hom hz
  unfold vClass at hq
  rw [simplicialHomologyClass_quotient, map_zero] at hq
  exact zeroVertexCycle_not_boundary K ℚ (vertex K x hx)
    ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hq)

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.canonical_image
statement:
private theorem canonical_image {V W : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder W]
    (R : Type) [Ring R] {F : SimplicialFiltration ℝ V} {G : SimplicialFiltration ℝ W}
    {a : ℝ} {C : SetRel V W} (hT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hC : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G a C) {f : V → W}
    (hf : Function.graph f ⊆ C) (t : ℝ) (x : V)
    (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ F t) (hy : ({f x} : Finset W) ∈ G (t+a)) (r : R) :
    ((multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R hT hC 0).app t).hom (vClass R (F t) x hx r) =
      vClass R (G (t+a)) (f x) hy r
proof:
:= by
  rw [multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_app R hT hC hf]
  exact vClass_map R _ x hx hy r

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.transition_image
statement:
private theorem transition_image {V : Type} [LinearOrder V] (R : Type) [Ring R]
    (F : SimplicialFiltration ℝ V) (γ : ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ) (x : V)
    (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ F t) (hy : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ F (t+(γ:ℝ))) (r : R) :
    ((RealShift.transition γ (simplicialHomologyPModule R F 0)).app t).hom
      (vClass R (F t) x hx r) = vClass R (F (t+(γ:ℝ))) x hy r
proof:
:= by
  change (simplicialHomologyIncl R (F.monotone (le_add_of_nonneg_right γ.coe_nonneg)) 0).hom _ = _
  rw [← simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion]
  exact vClass_map R _ x hx hy r

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.zeroIso_image
statement:
private theorem zeroIso_image {V : Type} [LinearOrder V] (R : Type) [Ring R]
    (F : SimplicialFiltration ℝ V) (t : ℝ) (x : V)
    (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ F (t+0)) (hy : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ F t) (r : R) :
    ((RealShift.zeroIso (simplicialHomologyPModule R F 0)).hom.app t).hom
      (vClass R (F (t+0)) x hx r) = vClass R (F t) x hy r
proof:
:= by
  change (simplicialHomologyIncl R (F.monotone (le_of_eq (add_zero t))) 0).hom _ = _
  rw [← simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion]
  exact vClass_map R _ x hx hy r

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.discrete_dist
statement:
@[simp] private theorem discrete_dist (V : Type) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (x y : V) :
    (discreteMetric V c hc).dist x y = @ite ℝ (x = y) (Classical.propDecidable _) 0 c
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.rv
statement:
private theorem rv {V : Type} (d : MetricSpace V) (t : ℝ) (x : V) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    ({x} : Finset V) ∈ rf d t
proof:
:= by
  apply (Rips.mem_sublevel_iff d t _).mpr
  exact ⟨by simp, by simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq, d.dist_self] using ht⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.discrete_no_edges
statement:
private theorem discrete_no_edges {V : Type} (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t < c) : IsEmpty (Face (rf (discreteMetric V c hc) t) 1)
proof:
:= ⟨by
  classical
  intro σ
  have hcard := σ.2.2
  obtain ⟨x,hx,y,hy,hxy⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp (by omega : 1 < σ.1.card)
  have h := ((Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).mp σ.2.1).2 x hx y hy
  change (if x = y then 0 else c) ≤ t at h
  rw [if_neg hxy] at h
  exact (not_le.mpr ht) h⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.classes_differ
statement:
private theorem classes_differ {V : Type} [LinearOrder V]
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) [IsEmpty (Face K 1)] (x y : V)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ K) (hy : ({y} : Finset V) ∈ K) :
    vClass ℚ K x hx 1 ≠ vClass ℚ K y hy 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have hq := congrArg (homologyKernelQuotient ℚ (simplicialChainComplex K ℚ) 0).hom.hom hc
  unfold vClass at hq
  rw [simplicialHomologyClass_quotient, simplicialHomologyClass_quotient] at hq
  obtain ⟨c,hc⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff ℚ K 0 _).mp ((Submodule.Quotient.eq _).mp hq)
  have hz : c = 0 := by
    ext σ
    exact isEmptyElim σ
  rw [hz,map_zero] at hc
  have hv : vertex K y hy ≠ vertex K x hx := by
    intro he
    exact hxy (Finset.singleton_injective (congrArg Subtype.val he).symm)
  have hh := congrArg (fun c : Chain K ℚ 0 => c (vertex K x hx)) hc
  simp [vCycle, hv] at hh

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.forward_image
statement:
private theorem forward_image {V W : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder W]
    (R : Type) [Ring R] (dV : MetricSpace V) (dW : MetricSpace W)
    {C : SetRel V W} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (hT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hI : Relator.LeftTotal (fun y x => (y,x) ∈ C.inv))
    (h : ∀ x x' y y', (x,y) ∈ C → (x',y') ∈ C →
      |dV.dist x x' - dW.dist y y'| ≤ (ε : ℝ))
    {f : V → W} (hf : Function.graph f ⊆ C) (t : ℝ) (x : V)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hs : 0 ≤ t+(ε:ℝ)) (a : R) :
    (((Rips.relationInterleaving R dV dW hT hI h 0).φ).app t).hom
      (rc R dV t x ht a) = rc R dW (t+(ε:ℝ)) (f x) hs a
proof:
:=
  canonical_image R hT (Rips.isShiftedSimplicialRelation_of_distortion dV dW h) hf
    t x (rv dV t x ht) (rv dW _ _ hs) a

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.backward_image
statement:
private theorem backward_image {V W : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder W]
    (R : Type) [Ring R] (dV : MetricSpace V) (dW : MetricSpace W)
    {C : SetRel V W} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (hT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hI : Relator.LeftTotal (fun y x => (y,x) ∈ C.inv))
    (h : ∀ x x' y y', (x,y) ∈ C → (x',y') ∈ C →
      |dV.dist x x' - dW.dist y y'| ≤ (ε : ℝ))
    {g : W → V} (hg : Function.graph g ⊆ C.inv) (t : ℝ) (y : W)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (hs : 0 ≤ t+(ε:ℝ)) (a : R) :
    (((Rips.relationInterleaving R dV dW hT hI h 0).ψ).app t).hom
      (rc R dW t y ht a) = rc R dV (t+(ε:ℝ)) (g y) hs a
proof:
:= by
  exact canonical_image R hI
    (Rips.isShiftedSimplicialRelation_of_distortion dW dV (by
      intro y y' x x' hy hy'
      simpa only [abs_sub_comm] using h x x' y y' hy hy'))
    hg t y (rv dW t y ht) (rv dV _ _ hs) a

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.pairTotal
statement: private theorem pairTotal : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ pairC)
proof:
:=

proof:

  · subst x'; simp [dTwo,dThree,discreteMetric]

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.pair_fields
statement:
private theorem pair_fields :
    ((pairI.φ.app 0).hom (rc ℚ dTwo 0 0 (by norm_num) 1) =
      rc ℚ dThree (0+((1:ℝ≥0):ℝ)) false (by norm_num) 1) ∧
    ((pairI.ψ.app 0).hom (rc ℚ dThree 0 true (by norm_num) 1) =
      rc ℚ dTwo (0+((1:ℝ≥0):ℝ)) 1 (by norm_num) 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact forward_image ℚ dTwo dThree pairTotal pairInvTotal pairBound
      (Set.Subset.refl _) 0 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) 1
  · exact backward_image ℚ dTwo dThree pairTotal pairInvTotal pairBound
      pairInvGraph 0 true (by norm_num) (by norm_num) 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.pair_images_nonzero

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.pair_difference_survives
statement:
private theorem pair_difference_survives :
    (pairI.φ.app 0).hom
      (rc ℚ dTwo 0 0 (by norm_num) 1 - rc ℚ dTwo 0 1 (by norm_num) 1) =
        rc ℚ dThree (0+((1:ℝ≥0):ℝ)) false (by norm_num) 1 - rc ℚ dThree (0+((1:ℝ≥0):ℝ)) true (by norm_num) 1 ∧
    (pairI.φ.app 0).hom
      (rc ℚ dTwo 0 0 (by norm_num) 1 - rc ℚ dTwo 0 1 (by norm_num) 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : (pairI.φ.app 0).hom
      (rc ℚ dTwo 0 0 (by norm_num) 1 - rc ℚ dTwo 0 1 (by norm_num) 1) =
        rc ℚ dThree (0+((1:ℝ≥0):ℝ)) false (by norm_num) 1 - rc ℚ dThree (0+((1:ℝ≥0):ℝ)) true (by norm_num) 1 := by
    rw [map_sub,pair_fields.1]
    congr 1
    exact forward_image ℚ dTwo dThree pairTotal pairInvTotal pairBound
      (Set.Subset.refl _) 0 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) 1
  refine ⟨he, ?_⟩
  rw [he,sub_ne_zero]
  letI := discrete_no_edges (V := Bool) 3 (by norm_num) (0+((1:ℝ≥0):ℝ)) (by norm_num)
  exact classes_differ _ false true Bool.false_ne_true _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.pair_triangles

private theorem pair_triangles :
    ((((pairI.φ ≫ (RealShift.shift 1).map pairI.ψ ≫
      (RealShift.compIso 1 1 (sublevelModule ℚ (Rips.filter dTwo) 0)).hom).app 0).hom
        (rc ℚ dTwo 0 0 (by norm_num) 1)) = rc ℚ dTwo (0+((1+1:ℝ≥0):ℝ)) 0 (by norm_num) 1) ∧
    ((((pairI.ψ ≫ (RealShift.shift 1).map pairI.φ ≫
      (RealShift.compIso 1 1 (sublevelModule ℚ (Rips.filter dThree) 0)).hom).app 0).hom
        (rc ℚ dThree 0 true (by norm_num) 1)) = rc ℚ dThree (0+((1+1:ℝ≥0):ℝ)) true (by norm_num) 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [pairI.φ_ψ]
    exact transition_image ℚ (rf dTwo) (1+1) 0 0 _ _ 1
  · rw [pairI.ψ_φ]
    exact transition_image ℚ (rf dThree) (1+1) 0 true _ _ 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.pair_geometry_zero_fails

proof:

  intro h
  have hσ : ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ rf dTwo 2 := by
    apply (Rips.mem_sublevel_iff dTwo 2 _).mpr
    refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
    intro x _ y _
    rw [discrete_dist]
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  have hh := h 2 {0,1} hσ {false,true} (by simp) (by
    intro y hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_coe,Finset.mem_insert,Finset.mem_singleton] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl
    · exact ⟨0,by simp,by change finTwoEquiv 0 = false; rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨1,by simp,by change finTwoEquiv 1 = true; rfl⟩)
  have hd := ((Rips.mem_sublevel_iff dThree _ _).mp hh).2 false (by simp) true (by simp)
  norm_num [dThree,discreteMetric] at hd

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.singleton_stage
statement:
private theorem singleton_stage {V : Type} [Subsingleton V] (d : MetricSpace V)
    (t : ℝ) (x : V) (ht : 0 ≤ t) : rf d t = singletonFace x
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro σ hσ
    change σ = {x}
    obtain ⟨z,hz⟩ := ((Rips.mem_sublevel_iff d t σ).mp hσ).1
    ext y
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro _; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    · intro _; simpa only [Subsingleton.elim z y] using hz
  · intro σ hσ
    change σ = {x} at hσ
    subst σ
    exact rv d t x ht

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.classEquiv_class
statement:
private theorem classEquiv_class {V : Type} [LinearOrder V] (R : Type) [Ring R]
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (x : V) (hK : K = singletonFace x)
    (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ K) (a : R) : classEquiv R K x hK (vClass R K x hx a) = a
proof:
:= by
  subst K
  change simplicialSingletonH0Equiv R x (vClass R (singletonFace x) x rfl a) = a
  exact simplicialSingletonH0Equiv_class R x a

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsRelationInterleavingExamples.coefficient_evaluations
statement:
private theorem coefficient_evaluations (R : Type) [Ring R] (a : R) :
    coefficientEvaluations R a
proof:
:= by
  have hf := forward_image R dUnit dPoint coefficientTotal coefficientInvTotal coefficientBound
    (Set.Subset.refl _) 0 () (by norm_num) (by norm_num) a
  have hg := backward_image R dUnit dPoint coefficientTotal coefficientInvTotal coefficientBound
    (g := fun _ => ()) (by intro p _; exact Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    0 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) a
  refine ⟨⟨?_,?_⟩,⟨?_,?_⟩⟩
  · exact (congrArg (singletonAt R dPoint (0+((1:ℝ≥0):ℝ)) 0 (by norm_num)) hf).trans
      (classEquiv_class R _ 0 _ _ a)
  · exact (congrArg (singletonAt R dUnit (0+((1:ℝ≥0):ℝ)) () (by norm_num)) hg).trans
      (classEquiv_class R _ () _ _ a)
  · rw [(coefficientI R).φ_ψ]
    exact (congrArg (singletonAt R dUnit (0+((1+1:ℝ≥0):ℝ)) () (by norm_num))
      (transition_image R (rf dUnit) (1+1) 0 ()
        (rv dUnit 0 () (by norm_num)) (rv dUnit _ () (by norm_num)) a)).trans
      (classEquiv_class R _ () _ _ a)
  · rw [(coefficientI R).ψ_φ]
    exact (congrArg (singletonAt R dPoint (0+((1+1:ℝ≥0):ℝ)) 0 (by norm_num))
      (transition_image R (rf dPoint) (1+1) 0 0
        (rv dPoint 0 0 (by norm_num)) (rv dPoint _ 0 (by norm_num)) a)).trans
      (classEquiv_class R _ 0 _ _ a)

statement:

    bottleneck (orderedQ 0 0 emptyInput)

proof:
:= by
  have h : translateDiagram (orderedQ 0 0 emptyInput) c = orderedQ 0 0 emptyInput := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    simp [translateDiagram, translateDiagramPoint, emptyInput, orderedQ]
  rw [h]
  exact bottleneck_self _

name: TDA.Persistence.TranslationExamples.finite_only_translation_counterexample
statement:
theorem finite_only_translation_counterexample :
    bottleneck (orderedQ 1 0 finiteSource) (orderedQ 1 0 finiteTarget) =
      ENNReal.ofReal 1
proof:
:= by
  let x : Fin 1 → ℝ × ℝ := fun _ => (0, 2)
  let y : Fin 1 → ℝ × ℝ := fun _ => (3, 5)
  have hx : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map x =
      finitePart (orderedQ 1 0 finiteSource).points := by
    rw [finitePart_orderedQ]
    simp [finiteSource, x]
  have hy : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map y =
      finitePart (orderedQ 1 0 finiteTarget).points := by
    rw [finitePart_orderedQ]
    simp [finiteTarget, y]
  have hb : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = essentialPart (orderedQ 1 0 finiteSource).points := by
    rw [essentialPart_orderedQ]
    simp [finiteSource]
  have hc : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = essentialPart (orderedQ 1 0 finiteTarget).points := by
    rw [essentialPart_orderedQ]
    simp [finiteTarget]
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation (orderedQ 1 0 finiteSource)
    (orderedQ 1 0 finiteTarget) x y (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ)
    (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) hx hy hb hc]
  apply le_antisymm
  · let M₀ : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 1) (Fin 1) (Fin 0) (Fin 0) :=
      ⟨fun _ => none, by simp, Equiv.refl _⟩
    have hcost : M₀.cost x y Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 = ENNReal.ofReal 1 := by
      simp [OccurrenceMatching.cost, M₀, x, y, diagonalCost]
      norm_num
    exact (presentationBottleneck_le_cost x y Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 M₀).trans_eq hcost
  · unfold presentationBottleneck
    apply le_iInf
    intro M
    have hsource := M.source_le_cost x y Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 0
    cases h : M.finite 0 with
    | none =>
      calc
        ENNReal.ofReal 1 = diagonalCost (x 0) := by norm_num [x, diagonalCost]
        _ ≤ M.cost x y Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 := by simpa [h] using hsource
    | some j =>
      calc
        ENNReal.ofReal 1 ≤ finitePairCost (x 0) (y j) := by
          norm_num [x, y, finitePairCost]
        _ ≤ M.cost x y Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 := by simpa [h] using hsource

name: TDA.Persistence.TranslationExamples.finite_only_shift_three_distance
statement:
theorem finite_only_shift_three_distance :
    bottleneck (orderedQ 1 0 finiteSource)
      (translateDiagram (orderedQ 1 0 finiteSource) 3) = ENNReal.ofReal 1
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : translateDiagram (orderedQ 1 0 finiteSource) 3 =
      orderedQ 1 0 finiteTarget := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    norm_num [translateDiagram, translateDiagramPoint, orderedQ, finiteSource, finiteTarget]
  rw [hshift]
  exact finite_only_translation_counterexample

name: TDA.Persistence.TranslationExamples.isolated_vertex_translation_exact
statement:
theorem isolated_vertex_translation_exact (a c : ℝ) :
    bottleneck
      (dgm (ZMod 2) (StabilityExamples.vertexFilter a) 0)
      (dgm (ZMod 2)
        (translateFilterFunction (StabilityExamples.vertexFilter a) c) 0) =
      ENNReal.ofReal |c|
proof:
:= by
  have hfilter :
      translateFilterFunction (StabilityExamples.vertexFilter a) c =
        StabilityExamples.vertexFilter (a + c) := by
    rfl
  rw [hfilter, StabilityExamples.vertex_bottleneck_sharp]
  simp [show a - (a + c) = -c by ring]

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_liftIndexUniverse
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_liftIndexUniverse
    (M : PModule.{u,v,u} R P)
    (hM : FinitelyPresented.{u,v,0} (R := R) (P := P) M) :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,v,u} (R := R) (P := P) M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hM
  haveI : Finite D.generators.Carrier := hD.1
  haveI : Finite D.relations.Carrier := hD.2
  refine ⟨D.liftIndexUniverse, ?_, ⟨D.liftIndexUniversePresentedIso.trans e⟩⟩
  · change Finite (D.generators.liftIndexUniverse.Carrier) ∧
      Finite (D.relations.liftIndexUniverse.Carrier)
    exact ⟨Finite.of_injective ULift.down ULift.down_injective,
      Finite.of_injective ULift.down ULift.down_injective⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_lowerIndexUniverse
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_lowerIndexUniverse
    (M : PModule.{u,v,u} R P)
    (hM : FinitelyPresented.{u,v,u} (R := R) (P := P) M) :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,v,0} (R := R) (P := P) M
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hM
  have : Finite D.generators.Carrier := hD.1
  have : Finite D.relations.Carrier := hD.2
  let D' : Presentation.{u,v,0} (R := R) (P := P) :=
    { generators := D.generators.lowerFiniteIndexUniverse
      relations := D.relations.lowerFiniteIndexUniverse
      relationMap := D.relations.lowerFiniteIndexUniverseIso.hom ≫
        D.relationMap ≫ D.generators.lowerFiniteIndexUniverseIso.inv }
  have eD : D'.presented ≅ D.presented := by
    change cokernel D'.relationMap ≅ cokernel D.relationMap
    apply cokernel.mapIso (f := D'.relationMap) D.relationMap
      D.relations.lowerFiniteIndexUniverseIso
      D.generators.lowerFiniteIndexUniverseIso
    simp [D', Category.assoc]
  refine ⟨D', ?_, ⟨eD.trans e⟩⟩
  exact ⟨inferInstanceAs (Finite (Fin _)), inferInstanceAs (Finite (Fin _))⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleDiagramMultiplicity_countable_support
statement:
theorem moduleDiagramMultiplicity_countable_support (hM : M.QTame) :
    Set.Countable {p | 0 < moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p}
proof:
:= by
  let T : RationalRectangle → Set (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) := fun q =>
    {p | p ∈ rectangleCell (q.val.1.1 : ℝ) q.val.1.2 q.val.2.1 q.val.2.2 ∧
      0 < moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p}
  have hT : ∀ q, (T q).Finite := by
    intro q
    exact moduleDiagramMultiplicity_locally_finite M hM
      (rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells _ _ _ _ (by exact_mod_cast q.property.2.1))
  apply (countable_iUnion (fun q => (hT q).countable)).mono
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hpU⟩ := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_visible_of_pos M hM hp
  rcases hU with rfl | ⟨a, b, c, d, hab, hbc, hcd, rfl⟩
  · exact hpU.elim
  · obtain ⟨A, _, hAa⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (show a - 1 < a by linarith)
    obtain ⟨B, hbB, hBmid⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (show b < (b + c) / 2 by linarith)
    obtain ⟨C, hmidC, hCc⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (show (b + c) / 2 < c by linarith)
    obtain ⟨D, hdD, _⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (lt_add_one d)
    have hAB : A < B := by exact_mod_cast (hAa.trans (hab.trans hbB))
    have hBC : B < C := by exact_mod_cast (hBmid.trans hmidC)
    have hCD : C < D := by exact_mod_cast (hCc.trans (hcd.trans hdD))
    let q : RationalRectangle := ⟨((A, B), (C, D)), hAB, hBC, hCD⟩
    refine mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨q, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨⟨⟨Cut.lower_of_le hAa.le hpU.1.1, Cut.upper_of_le hbB.le hpU.1.2⟩,
      ⟨Cut.lower_of_le hCc.le hpU.2.1, Cut.upper_of_le hdD.le hpU.2.2⟩⟩, hp⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleEssentialMultiplicity_countable_support
statement:
theorem moduleEssentialMultiplicity_countable_support (hM : M.QTame) :
    Set.Countable {birth | 0 < moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM birth}
proof:
:= by
  let T : (ℚ × ℚ) → Set (Cut ℝ) := fun q =>
    {birth | birth ∈ cutCell (q.1 : ℝ) q.2 ∧ 0 < moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM birth}
  have hT : ∀ q, (T q).Finite := by
    intro q
    exact moduleEssentialMultiplicity_locally_finite M hM (cutCell_mem_cutCells _ _)
  apply (countable_iUnion (fun q => (hT q).countable)).mono
  intro birth hb
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hbU⟩ := moduleEssentialMultiplicity_visible_of_pos M hM hb
  obtain ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩ := hU
  obtain ⟨A, _, hAa⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (show a - 1 < a by linarith)
  obtain ⟨B, hbB, _⟩ := exists_rat_btwn (lt_add_one b)
  exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨(A, B), ⟨⟨Cut.lower_of_le hAa.le hbU.1,
    Cut.upper_of_le hbB.le hbU.2⟩, hb⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_countable_support
statement:
theorem moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_countable_support (hM : M.QTame) :
    Set.Countable {p | 0 < moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p}
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_countable_support M hM
  have hess := (moduleEssentialMultiplicity_countable_support M hM).image
    (fun birth => (birth, infinityCut))
  apply (hfinite.union hess).mono
  intro p hp
  change 0 < moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p at hp
  by_cases hInf : p.2 = infinityCut
  · right
    refine ⟨p.1, ?_, Prod.ext rfl hInf.symm⟩
    change 0 < moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM p.1
    simpa only [moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity, if_pos hInf] using hp
  · left
    change 0 < moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p
    simpa only [moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity, if_neg hInf] using hp

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.val_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem val_eq_zero {p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (h : ¬ alive p t) (x : fiber (k := k) p t) : (x : k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [fiber, if_neg h, Submodule.mem_bot] using x.property

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.map_val
statement:
theorem map_val (p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ) {s t : ℝ} (f : s ⟶ t)
    (x : fiber (k := k) p s) :
    ((show fiber (k := k) p t from ((intervalModule p).map f).hom x) : k) = if alive p t then (x : k) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (((if h : alive p s ∧ alive p t then
    Submodule.inclusion (show fiber (k := k) p s ≤ fiber p t by
      simp [fiber, h.1, h.2]) else 0) x) : k) = _
  by_cases hs : alive p s <;> by_cases ht : alive p t
  · simp [hs, ht]
  · simp [hs, ht]
  · simp [hs, ht, val_eq_zero hs x]
  · simp [hs, ht]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.comparisonLinear_val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : alive q t <;> simp [comparisonLinear, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.cancel_shift_lt
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithTop.add_lt_add_iff_right (WithTop.coe_ne_top :
    ((ε : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ) ≠ ⊤)).mp
  simpa only [← WithTop.coe_add] using h.trans_le he

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.comparison_app_val
statement:
theorem comparison_app_val (ε : ℝ≥0) (p q : ℝ × WithTop ℝ)
    (hb : q.1 ≤ p.1 + (ε : ℝ))
    (hd : q.2 ≤ p.2 + ((ε : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)) (t : ℝ)
    (x : fiber (k := k) p t) :
    ((show fiber (k := k) q (t + (ε : ℝ)) from ((comparison ε p q hb hd).app t).hom x) : k) =
      if alive q (t + (ε : ℝ)) then (x : k) else 0
proof:
:=
  comparisonLinear_val p q t _ x

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.middle_alive
statement:
private theorem middle_alive (ε : ℝ≥0) (p q : ℝ × WithTop ℝ)
    (hb : q.1 ≤ p.1 + (ε : ℝ))
    (hd : p.2 ≤ q.2 + ((ε : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)) (t : ℝ)
    (hs : alive p t) (ht : alive p (t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) :
    alive q (t + (ε : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hb.trans (add_le_add hs.1 le_rfl), ?_⟩
  apply cancel_shift_lt ε (e := p.2) _ hd
  simpa only [NNReal.coe_add, add_assoc] using ht.2

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.transition_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem transition_eq_zero_iff (ε : ℝ≥0) (b d : ℝ) :
    transition (ε + ε) (intervalModule (k := k) (b, (d : WithTop ℝ))) = 0 ↔
      d - b ≤ 2 * (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    by_contra h
    have hlt : b + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) < d := by
      simp only [NNReal.coe_add]; linarith [lt_of_not_ge h]
    have hb : alive (b, (d : WithTop ℝ)) b :=
      ⟨le_rfl, WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right (NNReal.coe_nonneg (ε + ε))) hlt)⟩
    have ht : alive (b, (d : WithTop ℝ)) (b + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :=
      ⟨le_add_of_nonneg_right (NNReal.coe_nonneg (ε + ε)), WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr hlt⟩
    let x : fiber (k := k) (b, (d : WithTop ℝ)) b := ⟨1, by simp [fiber, hb]⟩
    have hx : ((transition (ε + ε) (intervalModule (k := k) (b, (d : WithTop ℝ)))).app b).hom x = 0 := by
      rw [hz]; rfl
    have hv := congrArg (fun y : fiber (k := k) (b, (d : WithTop ℝ))
      (b + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) => (y : k)) hx
    change ((show fiber (k := k) (b, (d : WithTop ℝ))
      (b + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) from
        ((intervalModule (b, (d : WithTop ℝ))).map
          (homOfLE (le_add_of_nonneg_right (NNReal.coe_nonneg (ε + ε))))).hom x) : k) = 0 at hv
    erw [map_val] at hv
    exact one_ne_zero (by simpa only [if_pos ht, x] using hv)
  · intro h
    apply NatTrans.ext
    funext t
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    change ((show fiber (k := k) (b, (d : WithTop ℝ))
      (t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) from
        ((intervalModule (b, (d : WithTop ℝ))).map
          (homOfLE (le_add_of_nonneg_right (NNReal.coe_nonneg (ε + ε))))).hom x) : k) = 0
    erw [map_val]
    by_cases hs : alive (b, (d : WithTop ℝ)) t
    · have ht : ¬ alive (b, (d : WithTop ℝ)) (t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) := by
        intro ht
        have hdeath := WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp ht.2
        have hbirth := hs.1
        simp only [NNReal.coe_add] at hdeath
        linarith
      simp only [if_neg ht]
    · simp [val_eq_zero hs x]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.interleaved_zero_iff
statement:
theorem interleaved_zero_iff (ε : ℝ≥0) (b d : ℝ) :
    Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε (intervalModule (k := k) (b, (d : WithTop ℝ))) 0) ↔
      d - b ≤ 2 * (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:=
  (RealInterleaving.nonempty_zero_iff _ _).trans (transition_eq_zero_iff ε b d)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.comparison_eq_zero_of_death_le
statement:
theorem comparison_eq_zero_of_death_le (ε : ℝ≥0) (p q : ℝ × WithTop ℝ)
    (hb : q.1 ≤ p.1 + (ε : ℝ))
    (hd : q.2 ≤ p.2 + ((ε : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ))
    (htouch : q.2 ≤ ((p.1 + (ε : ℝ) : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)) :
    comparison (k := k) ε p q hb hd = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ((show fiber (k := k) q (t + (ε : ℝ)) from
    ((comparison ε p q hb hd).app t).hom x) : k) = 0
  erw [comparison_app_val]
  by_cases hs : alive p t
  · have ht : ¬ alive q (t + (ε : ℝ)) := by
      intro h
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (htouch.trans (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr
        (add_le_add hs.1 le_rfl)))) h.2
    simp only [if_neg ht]
  · simp [val_eq_zero hs x]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.comparison_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem comparison_ne_zero_iff (ε : ℝ≥0) (p q : ℝ × WithTop ℝ)
    (hp : (p.1 : WithTop ℝ) < p.2)
    (hb : q.1 ≤ p.1 + (ε : ℝ))
    (hd : q.2 ≤ p.2 + ((ε : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ)) :
    comparison (k := k) ε p q hb hd ≠ 0 ↔
      ((p.1 + (ε : ℝ) : ℝ) : WithTop ℝ) < q.2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hn
    by_contra ht
    exact hn (comparison_eq_zero_of_death_le ε p q hb hd (le_of_not_gt ht))
  · intro ht hz
    have hs : alive p p.1 := ⟨le_rfl, hp⟩
    have hq : alive q (p.1 + (ε : ℝ)) := ⟨hb, ht⟩
    let x : fiber (k := k) p p.1 := ⟨1, by simp [fiber, hs]⟩
    have hx : ((comparison (k := k) ε p q hb hd).app p.1).hom x = 0 := by
      rw [hz]; rfl
    have hv := congrArg (fun y : fiber (k := k) q (p.1 + (ε : ℝ)) => (y : k)) hx
    erw [comparison_app_val] at hv
    change (if alive q (p.1 + (ε : ℝ)) then (1 : k) else 0) = 0 at hv
    exact one_ne_zero (by simpa only [if_pos hq] using hv)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.essential_not_interleaved_zero
statement:
theorem essential_not_interleaved_zero (ε : ℝ≥0) (b : ℝ) :
    ¬ Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε (intervalModule (k := k) (b, ⊤)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro hi
  have hz := (RealInterleaving.nonempty_zero_iff _ _).mp hi
  have hb : alive (b, ⊤) b := ⟨le_rfl, WithTop.coe_lt_top b⟩
  have ht : alive (b, ⊤) (b + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) :=
    ⟨le_add_of_nonneg_right (NNReal.coe_nonneg (ε + ε)), WithTop.coe_lt_top _⟩
  let x : fiber (k := k) (b, ⊤) b := ⟨1, by simp [fiber, hb]⟩
  have hx : ((transition (ε + ε) (intervalModule (k := k) (b, ⊤))).app b).hom x = 0 := by
    rw [hz]; rfl
  have hv := congrArg (fun y : fiber (k := k) (b, ⊤)
    (b + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) => (y : k)) hx
  change ((show fiber (k := k) (b, ⊤) (b + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) from
    ((intervalModule (b, ⊤)).map
      (homOfLE (le_add_of_nonneg_right (NNReal.coe_nonneg (ε + ε))))).hom x) : k) = 0 at hv
  erw [map_val] at hv
  exact one_ne_zero (by simpa only [if_pos ht, x] using hv)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateRealBridge.evaluate_diagonal
statement: @[simp] theorem evaluate_diagonal (t : ℝ) : evaluate (diagonal t) = t
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal_evaluate

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem fromReal_obj (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (a : Fin 1 → ℝ) :
    (fromReal M).obj a = M.obj (a 0)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateRealBridge.interleaving_nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem interleaving_nonempty_iff (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M N) ↔
      Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ε (fromReal M) (fromReal N))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i⟩
    exact ⟨toCoordinate i⟩
  · rintro ⟨i⟩
    exact ⟨toReal i⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateRealBridge.distance_eq
statement:
theorem distance_eq (M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance (fromReal M) (fromReal N) =
      realInterleavingDistance M N
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (le_realInterleavingDistance_iff).2
    intro ε h
    exact coordinateInterleavingDistance_le_of_nonempty
      ((interleaving_nonempty_iff ε M N).mp h)
  · apply (le_coordinateInterleavingDistance_iff).2
    intro ε h
    exact realInterleavingDistance_le_of_nonempty
      ((interleaving_nonempty_iff ε M N).mpr h)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.oneCoordinateHook_finitelyPresented
statement:
private theorem oneCoordinateHook_finitelyPresented :
    GradedFree.FinitelyPresented (R := ℚ) (P := Fin 1 → ℝ) oneCoordinateHook
proof:
:=
  GradedFree.free_finitelyPresented (R := ℚ) (P := Fin 1 → ℝ)
    (HookInfinity.generators (P := Fin 1 → ℝ) (0 : Fin 1 → ℝ))

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.oneCoordinateHook_nonzero_fiber
statement:
theorem oneCoordinateHook_nonzero_fiber :
    ∃ x : oneCoordinateHook.obj (0 : Fin 1 → ℝ), x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let e := HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := ℚ) (i := (0 : Fin 1 → ℝ))
    (a := (0 : Fin 1 → ℝ)) le_rfl
  refine ⟨e.symm 1, ?_⟩
  intro hx
  have hone := congrArg e hx
  simp at hone

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.twoCoordinateHook_finitelyPresented
statement:
private theorem twoCoordinateHook_finitelyPresented :
    GradedFree.FinitelyPresented (R := ℚ) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ) twoCoordinateHook
proof:
:=
  GradedFree.free_finitelyPresented (R := ℚ) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.twoCoordinateHook_nonzero_fiber
statement:
theorem twoCoordinateHook_nonzero_fiber :
    ∃ x : twoCoordinateHook.obj (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ), x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let e := HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := ℚ) (i := (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ))
    (a := (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ)) le_rfl
  refine ⟨e.symm 1, ?_⟩
  intro hx

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.inactiveZeroDelay_condition
statement:
private theorem inactiveZeroDelay_condition (δ : ℝ≥0) (_i : Fin 1) :
    inactiveZeroDelay δ _i ≤ δ ∨ IsZero (inactiveZeroFamily _i)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.inactiveZero_reverse_component
statement:
theorem inactiveZero_reverse_component (δ : ℝ≥0) (i : Fin 1) :
    finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent δ inactiveZeroFamily (inactiveZeroDelay δ) i
      (inactiveZeroDelay_condition δ i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply finiteFamilyDelayReverseComponent_eq_zero
  change ¬ δ + 1 ≤ δ
  exact not_le_of_gt (lt_add_of_pos_right δ zero_lt_one)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.inactiveZeroComparison_ι_reverse
statement:
theorem inactiveZeroComparison_ι_reverse (δ : ℝ≥0) (i : Fin 1) :
    biproduct.ι (fun j => (shift (inactiveZeroDelay δ j)).obj
        (inactiveZeroFamily j)) i ≫
        (inactiveZeroDelayComparison δ).reverse = 0
proof:
:= by
  change biproduct.ι (fun j => (shift (inactiveZeroDelay δ j)).obj
      (inactiveZeroFamily j)) i ≫
      (finiteFamilyDelayComparison δ inactiveZeroFamily (inactiveZeroDelay δ)
        (inactiveZeroDelay_condition δ)).reverse = 0
  rw [finiteFamilyDelayComparison_ι_reverse]
  rw [inactiveZero_reverse_component]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelUnshiftedExamples.unshiftedSchanuelLeftSummand_appendZeros
statement:
theorem unshiftedSchanuelLeftSummand_appendZeros
    {M N : PModule.{0,0,0} ℚ (Fin 2 → ℝ)}
    (R : FiniteRankProjectiveResolution M) (S : FiniteRankProjectiveResolution N)
    (rpad spad : ℕ) (j : Fin (max R.length S.length)) :
    unshiftedSchanuelLeftSummand (R.appendZeros rpad) (S.appendZeros spad)
        ⟨j.val, by
          have hmax : max R.length S.length ≤
              max (R.length + rpad) (S.length + spad) :=
            max_le_max (Nat.le_add_right _ _) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
          simpa [FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.appendZeros_length] using
            (lt_of_lt_of_le j.isLt hmax)⟩ =
      unshiftedSchanuelLeftSummand R S j
proof:
:= by
  simp [unshiftedSchanuelLeftSummand,
    FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_appendZeros]
