name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.inclusion_apply_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusion_apply_self (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (i : ι) (t : ℝ) (x : (F i).obj t) :
    DirectSum.component k ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) i
      (((inclusion F i).app t).hom x) = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change DirectSum.component k ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) i
    (DirectSum.lof k ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) i x) = x
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.inclusion_apply_ne
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusion_apply_ne (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    {i j : ι} (hij : i ≠ j) (t : ℝ) (x : (F i).obj t) :
    DirectSum.component k ι (fun l => (F l).obj t) j
      (((inclusion F i).app t).hom x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change DirectSum.component k ι (fun l => (F l).obj t) j
    (DirectSum.lof k ι (fun l => (F l).obj t) i x) = 0
  rw [DirectSum.component.of]
  simp [hij]

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.inclusion_desc
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusion_desc (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ} (η : ∀ i, F i ⟶ M) (i : ι) :
    inclusion F i ≫ desc F η = η i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext t x
  change DirectSum.toModule k ι (M.obj t) (fun j => ((η j).app t).hom)
    (DirectSum.lof k ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) i x) = ((η i).app t).hom x
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.structureMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem structureMap_apply (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    {s t : ℝ} (h : s ≤ t) (x : (familyModule F).obj s) (i : ι) :
    DirectSum.component k ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) i
      (structureMapLinear (familyModule F) h x) =
      structureMapLinear (F i) h
        (DirectSum.component k ι (fun j => (F j).obj s) i x)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change DirectSum.component k ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) i
    (DirectSum.lmap (fun j : ι => ((F j).map (homOfLE h)).hom) x) =
    ((F i).map (homOfLE h)).hom
      (DirectSum.component k ι (fun j => (F j).obj s) i x)
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.toProduct_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem toProduct_apply (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (x : (familyModule F).obj t) (i : ι) :
    ((toProduct F).app t).hom x i =
      DirectSum.component k ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) i x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.toProduct_injective
statement:
theorem toProduct_injective (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    Function.Injective (((toProduct F).app t).hom)
proof:
:= by
  change Function.Injective (DFinsupp.coeFnLinearMap k :
    DirectSum ι (fun i => (F i).obj t) →ₗ[k] ∀ i, (F i).obj t)
  exact DFunLike.coe_injective

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.toProduct_surjective
statement:
theorem toProduct_surjective (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (h : Set.Finite {i | Nontrivial ((F i).obj t)}) :
    Function.Surjective (((toProduct F).app t).hom)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x
  let y : DirectSum ι (fun i => (F i).obj t) :=
    DFinsupp.mk h.toFinset (fun i : (↑h.toFinset : Set ι) => x i)
  refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
  funext i
  change y i = x i
  by_cases hi : i ∈ h.toFinset
  · exact DFinsupp.mk_of_mem hi
  · have hn : ¬Nontrivial ((F i).obj t) := by simpa using hi
    exact @Subsingleton.elim ((F i).obj t)
      (not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp hn) _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.productIso_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem productIso_hom (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (h : ∀ t, Set.Finite {i | Nontrivial ((F i).obj t)}) :
    (productIso F h).hom = toProduct F
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.finite_nontrivial_of_finiteDimensional
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A := {i | Nontrivial ((F i).obj t)}
  have hn (i : A) : ∃ x : (F i).obj t, x ≠ 0 := by
    exact @exists_ne ((F i).obj t) i.property 0
  choose v hv using hn
  let w (i : A) : DirectSum ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) :=
    DirectSum.lof k ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) i.val (v i)
  have hw : LinearIndependent k w := by
    rw [linearIndependent_iff']
    intro s c hc i hi
    have he := congrArg (DirectSum.component k ι (fun j => (F j).obj t) i.val) hc
    have hsum : (∑ j ∈ s, c j •
        DirectSum.component k ι (fun l => (F l).obj t) i.val (w j)) = c i • v i := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
      · simp [w]
      · intro j _ hji
        have hval : j.val ≠ i.val := fun h => hji (Subtype.ext h)
        simp [w, DirectSum.component.of, hval]
      · simp [hi]
    have he' : (∑ j ∈ s, c j •
        DirectSum.component k ι (fun l => (F l).obj t) i.val (w j)) = 0 := by
      have hmap := map_sum (DirectSum.component k ι (fun l => (F l).obj t) i.val)
        (fun j : A => c j • w j) s
      calc
        _ = ∑ j ∈ s,
            DirectSum.component k ι (fun l => (F l).obj t) i.val (c j • w j) := by
              simp only [map_smul]
        _ = DirectSum.component k ι (fun l => (F l).obj t) i.val
            (∑ j ∈ s, c j • w j) := hmap.symm
        _ = DirectSum.component k ι (fun l => (F l).obj t) i.val 0 := he
        _ = 0 := map_zero _
    rw [hsum] at he'
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp he').resolve_right (hv i)
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (DirectSum ι (fun j => (F j).obj t)) := by
    change FiniteDimensional k ((familyModule F).obj t)
    infer_instance
  letI := hw.finite
  exact Set.toFinite A

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.finite_nontrivial_of_iso
proof:
:= by
  letI := hM t
  letI : FiniteDimensional k ((familyModule F).obj t) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv ((e.app t).toLinearEquiv)
  exact finite_nontrivial_of_finiteDimensional F t

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.finite_observed_nontrivial
statement:
theorem finite_observed_nontrivial (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (h : ∀ t, Set.Finite {i | Nontrivial ((F i).obj t)})
    {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N → ℝ) :
    Set.Finite {i | ∃ n, Nontrivial ((F i).obj (c n))}
proof:
:= by
  have he : {i | ∃ n, Nontrivial ((F i).obj (c n))} =
      ⋃ n : Fin N, {i | Nontrivial ((F i).obj (c n))} := by
    ext i
    simp
  rw [he]
  exact Set.finite_iUnion (fun n => h (c n))

name: TDA.Persistence.AlgebraicFamily.finite_observed_nontrivial_of_iso
proof:
:=
  finite_observed_nontrivial F (finite_nontrivial_of_iso F e hM) c

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.measurable_directLeg

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.measurableSet_directRegion

    ((measurable_unpoint.comp measurable_fst).dist (measurable_unpoint.comp measurable_snd))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.interiorIncl_mem_image

    diagonalProjection x ∉ interiorIncl '' s

  rintro ⟨y, _, h⟩
  have hy : (diagonalProjection x).1.1 < (diagonalProjection x).1.2 := by
    rw [← h]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.direct_first

proof:

  ext ⟨x, y⟩
  cases x <;> cases y <;>

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.delete_first

proof:

  change diagonalProjection (unpoint z.2) ∈ interiorIncl '' s ↔ False
  exact ⟨fun h => diagonalProjection_not_mem_image _ _ h, False.elim⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.boundaryPlan_first
statement:
private theorem boundaryPlan_first (γ : Measure (Space × Space)) (s : Set Interior)
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) : boundaryPlan γ (firstFiber s) = γ (firstCut s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryPlan, Measure.add_apply, Measure.add_apply,
    Measure.map_apply measurable_directMap (measurableSet_firstFiber hs),
    Measure.map_apply measurable_deleteMap (measurableSet_firstFiber hs),
    Measure.map_apply measurable_insertMap (measurableSet_firstFiber hs),
    Measure.restrict_apply ((measurableSet_firstFiber hs).preimage measurable_directMap),
    Measure.restrict_apply ((measurableSet_firstFiber hs).preimage measurable_deleteMap),
    insert_first, measure_empty, add_zero, direct_first, delete_first]
  exact measure_inter_add_sdiff _ measurableSet_directRegion

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.boundaryPlan_second
statement:
private theorem boundaryPlan_second (γ : Measure (Space × Space)) (s : Set Interior)
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) : boundaryPlan γ (secondFiber s) = γ (secondCut s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryPlan, Measure.add_apply, Measure.add_apply,
    Measure.map_apply measurable_directMap (measurableSet_secondFiber hs),
    Measure.map_apply measurable_deleteMap (measurableSet_secondFiber hs),
    Measure.map_apply measurable_insertMap (measurableSet_secondFiber hs),
    Measure.restrict_apply ((measurableSet_secondFiber hs).preimage measurable_directMap),
    Measure.restrict_apply ((measurableSet_secondFiber hs).preimage measurable_insertMap),
    delete_second, measure_empty, add_zero, direct_second, insert_second]
  exact measure_inter_add_sdiff _ measurableSet_directRegion

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.boundaryPlan_admissible
statement:
theorem boundaryPlan_admissible (γ : Measure (Space × Space))
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hfirst : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R)
    (hsecond : γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R) :
    IsBoundaryPlan (boundaryPlan γ) μ ν
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint (s : Set Interior) : Space.point ⁻¹' (Space.point '' s) = s := by
    ext x
    simp
  constructor
  · intro s hs
    rw [boundaryPlan_first γ s hs]
    change γ (Prod.fst ⁻¹' (Space.point '' s)) = μ s
    rw [← Measure.map_apply measurable_fst
      (measurableEmbedding_point.measurableSet_image.mpr hs), hfirst,
      reservoirMeasure_apply_interior μ R
        (measurableEmbedding_point.measurableSet_image.mpr hs) (by simp), hpoint]
  · intro s hs
    rw [boundaryPlan_second γ s hs]
    change γ (Prod.snd ⁻¹' (Space.point '' s)) = ν s
    rw [← Measure.map_apply measurable_snd
      (measurableEmbedding_point.measurableSet_image.mpr hs), hsecond,
      reservoirMeasure_apply_interior ν R
        (measurableEmbedding_point.measurableSet_image.mpr hs) (by simp), hpoint]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.directMap_cost
statement:
private theorem directMap_cost (p : ℝ) (z : Space × Space) :
    planPowerCost p (directMap z) = ENNReal.ofReal (dist (unpoint z.1) (unpoint z.2) ^ p)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.deleteMap_cost
statement:
private theorem deleteMap_cost (p : ℝ) (z : Space × Space) :
    planPowerCost p (deleteMap z) = ENNReal.ofReal (depth (unpoint z.1) ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  change ENNReal.ofReal (dist (interiorIncl _) (diagonalProjection _) ^ p) = _
  rw [deleteLeg_distance]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.insertMap_cost
statement:
private theorem insertMap_cost (p : ℝ) (z : Space × Space) :
    planPowerCost p (insertMap z) = ENNReal.ofReal (depth (unpoint z.2) ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  change ENNReal.ofReal (dist (diagonalProjection _) (interiorIncl _) ^ p) = _
  rw [insertLeg_distance]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.depth_power_sum_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add (Real.rpow_nonneg (depth_nonneg x) p)
    (Real.rpow_nonneg (depth_nonneg y) p)]
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    (Real.add_rpow_le_rpow_add (depth_nonneg x) (depth_nonneg y) hp)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.directRegion_points
statement:
private theorem directRegion_points (x y : Interior) :
    (Space.point x, Space.point y) ∈ directRegion ↔ dist x y ≤ depth x + depth y
proof:
:= by
  change ((Space.point x ∈ range Space.point ∧ Space.point y ∈ range Space.point) ∧
    dist x y ≤ depth x + depth y) ↔ _
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.reverseCost_points
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : dist x y ≤ depth x + depth y
  · have hD := (directRegion_points x y).mpr h
    have hA : (Space.point x, Space.point y) ∉ deleteRegion := by
      exact fun ha => ha.2 hD
    have hB : (Space.point x, Space.point y) ∉ insertRegion := by
      exact fun hb => hb.2 hD
    simp only [reverseCost, Pi.add_apply, Set.indicator_of_mem hD,
      Set.indicator_of_notMem hA, Set.indicator_of_notMem hB, Function.comp_apply,
      directMap_cost, unpoint_point, add_zero, if_pos h]
  · have hD : (Space.point x, Space.point y) ∉ directRegion := by
      exact fun hd => h ((directRegion_points x y).mp hd)
    have hA : (Space.point x, Space.point y) ∈ deleteRegion :=
      ⟨⟨x, rfl⟩, hD⟩
    have hB : (Space.point x, Space.point y) ∈ insertRegion :=
      ⟨⟨y, rfl⟩, hD⟩
    simp only [reverseCost, Pi.add_apply, Set.indicator_of_notMem hD,
      Set.indicator_of_mem hA, Set.indicator_of_mem hB, Function.comp_apply,
      deleteMap_cost, insertMap_cost, unpoint_point, zero_add, if_neg h]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.reverseCost_le
statement:
private theorem reverseCost_le (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (z : Space × Space) :
    reverseCost p z ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (dist z.1 z.2 ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  rcases z with ⟨x, y⟩
  cases x with
  | boundary =>
    cases y with
    | boundary =>
      simp [reverseCost, directRegion, deleteRegion, insertRegion, firstInterior,
        secondInterior]
    | point y =>
      simp [reverseCost, directRegion, deleteRegion, insertRegion, firstInterior,
        secondInterior, insertMap_cost]
  | point x =>
    cases y with
    | boundary =>
      simp [reverseCost, directRegion, deleteRegion, insertRegion, firstInterior,
        secondInterior, deleteMap_cost]
    | point y =>
      rw [reverseCost_points]
      change _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (dist (Space.point x) (Space.point y) ^ p)
      rw [dist_point_point]
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [min_eq_left h]
      · rw [min_eq_right (lt_of_not_ge h).le]
        exact depth_power_sum_le p hp x y

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.boundaryPlan_cost_eq
statement:
private theorem boundaryPlan_cost_eq (p : ℝ) (γ : Measure (Space × Space)) :
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂boundaryPlan γ) = ∫⁻ z, reverseCost p z ∂γ
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryPlan, lintegral_add_measure, lintegral_add_measure,
    lintegral_map (measurable_planPowerCost p) measurable_directMap,
    lintegral_map (measurable_planPowerCost p) measurable_deleteMap,
    lintegral_map (measurable_planPowerCost p) measurable_insertMap]
  rw [← lintegral_indicator measurableSet_directRegion,
    ← lintegral_indicator measurableSet_deleteRegion,
    ← lintegral_indicator measurableSet_insertRegion]
  have hD : Measurable (directRegion.indicator (planPowerCost p ∘ directMap)) :=
    ((measurable_planPowerCost p).comp measurable_directMap).indicator
      measurableSet_directRegion
  have hA : Measurable (deleteRegion.indicator (planPowerCost p ∘ deleteMap)) :=
    ((measurable_planPowerCost p).comp measurable_deleteMap).indicator
      measurableSet_deleteRegion
  simp only [reverseCost, Pi.add_apply]
  rw [lintegral_add_left (show Measurable (fun z =>
    directRegion.indicator (planPowerCost p ∘ directMap) z +
      deleteRegion.indicator (planPowerCost p ∘ deleteMap) z) from hD.add hA),
    lintegral_add_left hD]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.boundaryPlan_cost_le
statement:
theorem boundaryPlan_cost_le (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (γ : Measure (Space × Space)) :
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂boundaryPlan γ) ≤
      ∫⁻ z, ENNReal.ofReal (dist z.1 z.2 ^ p) ∂γ
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryPlan_cost_eq]
  exact lintegral_mono (reverseCost_le p hp)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.exists_boundaryPlan_cost_le
statement:
theorem exists_boundaryPlan_cost_le (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (γ : Measure (Space × Space)) (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hfirst : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R)
    (hsecond : γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R) :
    ∃ π : Measure PlanSpace, IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) ≤
        ∫⁻ z, ENNReal.ofReal (dist z.1 z.2 ^ p) ∂γ
proof:
:=
  ⟨boundaryPlan γ, boundaryPlan_admissible γ μ ν R hfirst hsecond,
    boundaryPlan_cost_le p hp γ⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.boundaryPlan_finite
statement:
theorem boundaryPlan_finite (γ : Measure (Space × Space))
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν] (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hfirst : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R)
    (hsecond : γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (boundaryPlan γ)
proof:
:=
  boundaryPlan_isFiniteMeasure (boundaryPlan_admissible γ μ ν R hfirst hsecond)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.boundaryPlan_zero
statement: theorem boundaryPlan_zero : boundaryPlan 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [boundaryPlan]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.boundaryPlan_boundaryAtom
statement:
theorem boundaryPlan_boundaryAtom :
    boundaryPlan (Measure.dirac (Space.boundary, Space.boundary)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [boundaryPlan, restrict_dirac, directRegion, deleteRegion, insertRegion,
    firstInterior, secondInterior]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.far_shortcut_reverse_cost
statement:
theorem far_shortcut_reverse_cost :
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost 2 z ∂boundaryPlan
      (Measure.dirac (Space.point farSource, Space.point farTarget))) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryPlan_cost_eq]
  rw [lintegral_dirac]
  rw [reverseCost_points]
  norm_num [farSource, farTarget, depth_eq, Subtype.dist_eq, Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.far_shortcut_original_cost
statement:
theorem far_shortcut_original_cost :
    (∫⁻ z : Space × Space, ENNReal.ofReal (dist z.1 z.2 ^ (2 : ℝ))
      ∂Measure.dirac (Space.point farSource, Space.point farTarget)) = 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_dirac]
  change ENNReal.ofReal (dist (Space.point farSource) (Space.point farTarget) ^ (2 : ℝ)) = 4
  rw [show dist (Space.point farSource) (Space.point farTarget) = 2 from far_points_shortcut]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.singlePairReservoirCompetitor_first
statement:
theorem singlePairReservoirCompetitor_first (x y : Interior) :
    (singlePairReservoirCompetitor x y).map Prod.fst =
      reservoirMeasure (Measure.dirac x) 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [singlePairReservoirCompetitor, Measure.map_add _ _ measurable_fst,
    Measure.map_dirac' measurable_fst, Measure.map_dirac' measurable_fst]
  have hsub : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) - 1 = 1 := by
    exact ENNReal.sub_eq_of_eq_add (b := 1) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  simp [reservoirMeasure, Measure.map_dirac' continuous_point.measurable, hsub]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.singlePairReservoirCompetitor_second
statement:
theorem singlePairReservoirCompetitor_second (x y : Interior) :
    (singlePairReservoirCompetitor x y).map Prod.snd =
      reservoirMeasure (Measure.dirac y) 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [singlePairReservoirCompetitor, Measure.map_add _ _ measurable_snd,
    Measure.map_dirac' measurable_snd, Measure.map_dirac' measurable_snd]
  have hsub : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) - 1 = 1 := by
    exact ENNReal.sub_eq_of_eq_add (b := 1) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  simp [reservoirMeasure, Measure.map_dirac' continuous_point.measurable, hsub]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.singlePairReservoirCompetitor_admissible
statement:
theorem singlePairReservoirCompetitor_admissible (x y : Interior) :
    IsBoundaryPlan (boundaryPlan (singlePairReservoirCompetitor x y))
      (Measure.dirac x) (Measure.dirac y)
proof:
:=
  boundaryPlan_admissible _ _ _ 2 (singlePairReservoirCompetitor_first x y)
    (singlePairReservoirCompetitor_second x y)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.Reverse.far_reservoir_cost_reduction
statement:
theorem far_reservoir_cost_reduction :
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost 2 z ∂boundaryPlan (singlePairReservoirCompetitor farSource farTarget)) = 2 ∧
    (∫⁻ z : Space × Space, ENNReal.ofReal (dist z.1 z.2 ^ (2 : ℝ))
      ∂singlePairReservoirCompetitor farSource farTarget) = 4
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [boundaryPlan_cost_eq, singlePairReservoirCompetitor, lintegral_add_measure,
      ← boundaryPlan_cost_eq, far_shortcut_reverse_cost, lintegral_dirac]
    simp [reverseCost, directRegion, deleteRegion, insertRegion, firstInterior,
      secondInterior]
  · rw [singlePairReservoirCompetitor, lintegral_add_measure,
      far_shortcut_original_cost, lintegral_dirac]
    norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.birthVector_ne_zero
statement: private theorem birthVector_ne_zero : birthVector ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  fun h => (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℚ) ≠ 0) (congrArg Subtype.val h)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.birthVector_dies
statement:
private theorem birthVector_dies :
    structureMapLinear dyingModule (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) birthVector = 0
proof:
:=
  Hook.generator_dies (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) < 1) (𝟙 dyingModule)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.composed_actual_kernel
statement:
theorem composed_actual_kernel :
    IsRankExact (kernel.ι (FiniteHookDeflation.π (FiniteHookDeflation.module dyingModule) ≫
      FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule))
      (FiniteHookDeflation.π (FiniteHookDeflation.module dyingModule) ≫
        FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule)
proof:
:=
  ((FiniteHookDeflation.rankExact (FiniteHookDeflation.module dyingModule)).isRankDeflation.comp
    (FiniteHookDeflation.rankExact dyingModule).isRankDeflation).rankExact_kernel

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.composed_dying_nonzero
statement:
theorem composed_dying_nonzero :
    ∃ x : (FiniteHookDeflation.module (FiniteHookDeflation.module dyingModule)).obj 0,
      (((FiniteHookDeflation.π (FiniteHookDeflation.module dyingModule) ≫
        FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule).app 0).hom x) ≠ 0 ∧
      structureMapLinear (FiniteHookDeflation.module (FiniteHookDeflation.module dyingModule))
        (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hdie⟩ := composed_actual_kernel.lift_kernel
    (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) birthVector birthVector_dies
  exact ⟨x, by rw [hx]; exact birthVector_ne_zero, hdie⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.pulled_actual_kernel
statement:
theorem pulled_actual_kernel :
    IsRankExact (kernel.ι (pullback.snd (FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule) twice))
      (pullback.snd (FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule) twice)
proof:
:=
  ((FiniteHookDeflation.rankExact dyingModule).isRankDeflation.pullback_snd twice).rankExact_kernel

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.pulled_dying_nonzero
statement:
theorem pulled_dying_nonzero :
    ∃ x : (pullback (FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule) twice).obj 0,
      (((pullback.snd (FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule) twice).app 0).hom x) ≠ 0 ∧
      structureMapLinear (pullback (FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule) twice)
        (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hdie⟩ := pulled_actual_kernel.lift_kernel
    (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) birthVector birthVector_dies
  exact ⟨x, by rw [hx]; exact birthVector_ne_zero, hdie⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.zero_pair_vector
statement:
theorem zero_pair_vector :
    ∃ x : (pullback (FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule) (0 : dyingModule ⟶ dyingModule)).obj 0,
      (((pullback.fst (FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule) (0 : dyingModule ⟶ dyingModule)).app 0).hom x)
        = 0 ∧
      (((pullback.snd (FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule) (0 : dyingModule ⟶ dyingModule)).app 0).hom x)
        ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨PullbackFiber.mk (FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule)
    (0 : dyingModule ⟶ dyingModule) 0 0 birthVector (by simp), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact PullbackFiber.fst_mk _ _ _ _ _ _
  · rw [PullbackFiber.snd_mk]
    exact birthVector_ne_zero

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.zero_basechange_rankExact
statement:
theorem zero_basechange_rankExact :
    IsRankExact (kernel.ι (pullback.snd (FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule)
      (0 : dyingModule ⟶ dyingModule)))
      (pullback.snd (FiniteHookDeflation.π dyingModule) (0 : dyingModule ⟶ dyingModule))
proof:
:=
  ((FiniteHookDeflation.rankExact dyingModule).isRankDeflation.pullback_snd
    (0 : dyingModule ⟶ dyingModule)).rankExact_kernel

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.ordinaryQuotient_surjective
statement:
private theorem ordinaryQuotient_surjective (p : Fin 2) :
    Function.Surjective (ordinaryQuotient.app p).hom
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases p
  · intro x
    refine ⟨(x : ℚ) • HookInfinity.birth (R := ℚ) (0 : Fin 2), ?_⟩
    change ((HookInfinity.fromBirth 0 dyingModule birthVector).app 0).hom
      ((x : ℚ) • HookInfinity.birth (R := ℚ) (0 : Fin 2)) = x
    rw [map_smul, HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth]
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [birthVector, SupportInterval.one]
  · intro x
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rw [map_zero]
    exact (Subtype.ext (SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (Hook.support (0 : Fin 2) 1)
      (Hook.death_not_mem 0 1) x)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.ordinaryQuotient_not_admissible
statement: private theorem ordinaryQuotient_not_admissible : ¬ IsRankDeflation ordinaryQuotient
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hdie⟩ := h.rankExact_kernel.lift_kernel
    (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) birthVector birthVector_dies
  have hm0 : m = 0 := by
    apply (HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := ℚ) (le_refl (0 : Fin 2))).injective
    rw [map_zero]
    have he := HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe_structureMap (R := ℚ)
      (le_refl (0 : Fin 2)) (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) m
    rw [hdie, map_zero] at he
    exact he.symm
  rw [hm0, map_zero] at hm
  exact birthVector_ne_zero hm.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.epi_not_rankDeflation
statement:
theorem epi_not_rankDeflation :
    (∀ p, Function.Surjective (ordinaryQuotient.app p).hom) ∧
      ¬ IsRankDeflation ordinaryQuotient
proof:
:=
  ⟨ordinaryQuotient_surjective, ordinaryQuotient_not_admissible⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.zero_module
statement: theorem zero_module : IsRankDeflation (𝟙 (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 1)))
proof:
:=
  IsRankDeflation.id _

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.empty_poset
statement: theorem empty_poset : IsRankDeflation (𝟙 (0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 0)))
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ p : Fin 0, FiniteDimensional ℚ ((0 : PModule ℚ (Fin 0)).obj p) :=
    fun p => Fin.elim0 p
  exact IsRankDeflation.id _

name: TDA.Persistence.RankDeflationExamples.characteristic_two
statement:
theorem characteristic_two :
    let N := Hook.module (k := ZMod 2) (0 : Fin 2) 1
    let f : N ⟶ N := (2 : ZMod 2) • 𝟙 N
    f = 0 ∧ IsRankDeflation (pullback.snd (FiniteHookDeflation.π N) f)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  constructor
  · have h : (2 : ZMod 2) = 0 := by decide
    rw [h, zero_smul]
  · exact (FiniteHookDeflation.rankExact _).isRankDeflation.pullback_snd _

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.extensionLinear_val
statement:
private theorem extensionLinear_val (p : P) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P)
    (l : M.obj p →ₗ[k] k) (q : P) (x : M.obj q) :
    (extensionLinear p M l q x : k) =
      if h : q ≤ p then l (structureMapLinear M h x) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : q ≤ p <;> simp [extensionLinear, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.extension_app_val
statement:
theorem extension_app_val (p : P) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P)
    (l : M.obj p →ₗ[k] k) (q : P) (x : M.obj q) :
    (((extension p M l).app q).hom x : k) =
      if h : q ≤ p then l (structureMapLinear M h x) else 0
proof:
:=
  extensionLinear_val p M l q x

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.evaluation_extension
statement:
@[simp] theorem evaluation_extension (p : P) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P)
    (l : M.obj p →ₗ[k] k) : evaluation p M (extension p M l) = l
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change (((extension p M l).app p).hom x : k) = l x
  rw [extension_app_val]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.app_val
statement:
theorem app_val (p : P) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P)
    (f : M ⟶ module p) (q : P) (x : M.obj q) :
    ((f.app q).hom x : k) =
      if h : q ≤ p then evaluation p M f (structureMapLinear M h x) else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : q ≤ p
  · have hn := congrArg (fun g => (g.hom x : k)) (f.naturality (homOfLE h))
    change evaluation p M f (structureMapLinear M h x) =
      (structureMapLinear (module p) h ((f.app q).hom x) : k) at hn
    rw [SupportInterval.structureMap_val, if_pos (show p ∈ Set.Iic p from le_rfl)] at hn
    simpa [h] using hn.symm
  · simpa [h] using SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (Set.Iic p) h ((f.app q).hom x)

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.hom_ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem hom_ext (p : P) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P)
    {f g : M ⟶ module p} (h : evaluation p M f = evaluation p M g) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext q x
  rw [app_val, app_val, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.extension_evaluation
statement:
@[simp] theorem extension_evaluation (p : P) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} k P)
    (f : M ⟶ module p) : extension p M (evaluation p M f) = f
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext p M
  exact evaluation_extension p M _

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.evaluation_precomp
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetInjective.extension_precomp
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext p M
  simp [evaluation_precomp]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTorExamples.bool_degree_one_leftDerived_isZero
statement:
theorem bool_degree_one_leftDerived_isZero {k : Type} [Field k] :
    IsZero (((vertexTensor (k := k) (S := Bool) boolStrictVertex).leftDerived 1).obj
      (diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := Bool)))

      (diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := Bool)))

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTorExamples.bool_degree_zero_leftDerived_not_isZero
statement:
theorem bool_degree_zero_leftDerived_not_isZero {k : Type} [Field k] :
    ¬ IsZero (((vertexTensor (k := k) (S := Bool) boolStrictVertex).leftDerived 0).obj
      (diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := Bool)))

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTorExamples.bool_degree_zero_unit_law
statement:
theorem bool_degree_zero_unit_law {k : Type} [Field k] :
    (diagonalQuotient_leftDerivedZeroIso (k := k) (S := Bool) boolStrictVertex).hom
      (((Functor.leftDerivedZeroIsoSelf
        (vertexTensor (k := k) (S := Bool) boolStrictVertex)).app
        (diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := Bool))).inv.hom
        (mk (k := k) (S := Bool) boolStrictVertex
          (diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := Bool)) 1)) = (1 : k)
proof:
:=
  diagonalQuotient_leftDerivedZeroIso_hom_unit

name: TDA.Persistence.fixedFaceLift_contDiffOn_cr
statement:
theorem fixedFaceLift_contDiffOn_cr (r : ℕ∞ω) (F : E → FilterFunction K ℝ)
    {x₀ : E} (e : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) (n : ℕ) {U : Set E}
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ r (fun x => (F x).value s) U) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ r (fixedFaceLift k F e n) U
proof:
:= by
  apply ContDiffOn.prodMk
  · apply contDiffOn_pi.mpr
    intro i
    exact (hF (e.enum ((faceTemplatePairs k e n).toList.get i).1)).prodMk
      (hF (e.enum ((faceTemplatePairs k e n).toList.get i).2))
  · apply contDiffOn_pi.mpr
    intro i
    exact hF (e.enum ((faceTemplateEssential k e n).toList.get i))

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagram_scalar_contDiffOn_cr
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagram_scalar_contDiffOn_cr (r : ℕ∞ω)
    (F : E → FilterFunction K ℝ) {x₀ : E} {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ r (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (n : ℕ) (Vloss : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hV : CrThroughAllRepresentatives r Vloss (dgm k (F x₀) n)) :
    ∃ U' : Set E, IsOpen U' ∧ x₀ ∈ U' ∧ U' ⊆ U ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ r (fun x => Vloss (dgm k (F x) n)) U'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_compatibleOrder (F x₀)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, fixedFaceCrLift] using
    localLift_scalar_cr r (fun x => dgm k (F x) n) Vloss
      (faceLiftCounts k F e n).1 (faceLiftCounts k F e n).2
      (fixedFaceCrLift k r F e n hU hF horder) x₀ hx₀ hV

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagram_scalar_contDiffOn_cr_of_mem_relative_orderChamber
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagram_scalar_contDiffOn_cr_of_mem_relative_orderChamber
    (r : ℕ∞ω) (F : E → FilterFunction K ℝ) {D : Set E} (hD : IsOpen D)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ r (fun x => (F x).value s) D)
    {x₀ : E} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ D)
    (hchamber : (⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ : D) ∈
      orderChamber (fun x : D => fun s : TotalFace K => (F x).value s))
    (n : ℕ) (Vloss : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hV : CrThroughAllRepresentatives r Vloss (dgm k (F x₀) n)) :
    ∃ U : Set E, IsOpen U ∧ x₀ ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ D ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ r (fun x => Vloss (dgm k (F x) n)) U
proof:
:= by
  let G : D → FilterFunction K ℝ := fun x => F x
  have hcont : ∀ s : TotalFace K, Continuous (fun x : D => (G x).value s) := by
    intro s
    exact (hF s).continuousOn.domRestrict
  obtain ⟨W, hWo, hxW, _, hWoEq⟩ :=
    FilterFunction.exists_open_orderingEquivalent_of_mem_orderChamber
      G hcont hchamber
  let U : Set E := Subtype.val '' W
  have hU : IsOpen U := hD.isOpenMap_subtype_val W hWo
  have hxU : x₀ ∈ U := ⟨⟨x₀, hx₀⟩, hxW, rfl⟩
  have hUD : U ⊆ D := by
    rintro x ⟨y, _, rfl⟩
    exact y.property
  have horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact hWoEq y hy
  obtain ⟨U', hU', hxU', hsubset, hs⟩ :=
    sublevelDiagram_scalar_contDiffOn_cr k r F hU hxU
      (fun s => (hF s).mono hUD) horder n Vloss hV
  exact ⟨U', hU', hxU', hsubset.trans hUD, hs⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.strict_iff_unequal
statement:
private theorem strict_iff_unequal (F : E → FilterFunction K ℝ)
    {x₀ : E} (e : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) (n : ℕ)
    (x : E) (horder : OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (p : Fin (faceCount K) × Fin (faceCount K))
    (hp : p ∈ faceTemplatePairs k e n) :
    ((F x₀).value (e.enum p.1) < (F x₀).value (e.enum p.2)) ↔
      (pairValues (F x) e p).1 ≠ (pairValues (F x) e p).2
proof:
:= by
  have hpord := (faceTemplatePairs_lt k e n p hp).le
  have hle₀ := e.monotone hpord
  rw [lt_iff_le_and_ne]
  have hne := not_congr (horder.value_eq_iff (e.enum p.1) (e.enum p.2))
  exact ⟨fun h => hne.mp h.2, fun h => ⟨hle₀, hne.mpr h⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.strictFaceLift_factorization
statement:
theorem strictFaceLift_factorization (F : E → FilterFunction K ℝ)
    {x₀ : E} (e : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) (n : ℕ)
    {U : Set E} (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x)) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, dgm k (F x) n =
      orderedQ (strictFaceLiftCounts k F e n).1
        (strictFaceLiftCounts k F e n).2 (strictFaceLift k F e n x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [fixedFaceLift_factorization k F e n horder x hx]
  apply (orderedQ_eq_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr
  constructor
  · change (Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn (fun i =>
        pairValues (F x) e ((faceTemplatePairs k e n).toList.get i)))).filter
        (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2) =
      (Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn (fun i =>
        pairValues (F x) e ((strictFacePairList k F e n).get i)))).filter
        (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)
    simp only [List.ofFn_comp', List.ofFn_get, ← Multiset.map_coe]
    rw [Multiset.filter_map, Multiset.filter_map]
    rw [show (strictFacePairList k F e n : Multiset _) =
      strictFacePairs k F e n by
        simp only [strictFacePairList, strictFacePairs, ← Multiset.filter_coe,
          Multiset.coe_toList], Multiset.coe_toList]
    unfold strictFacePairs
    rw [Multiset.filter_filter]
    congr 1
    apply Multiset.filter_congr
    intro p hp
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    exact ⟨fun h => ⟨h, (strict_iff_unequal k F e n x (horder x hx) p hp).mpr h⟩,
      fun h => h.1⟩
  · simp [strictFaceLift, strictFaceLiftCounts, fixedFaceLift, faceLiftCounts]

  · apply (Finset.fold_max_le 1).mpr
    refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨i, j⟩ _
    change |(if i = j then 0 else 1) - (if i = j then 0 else 2)| ≤ 1
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · have h := Rips.abs_dist_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy metricOne metricTwo 0 1

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseAugmentation_birth_value
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseAugmentation_birth_value (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (i : Fin 4) (h : signedStaircaseVertices i ≤ x) :
    (((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom
      (GradedFree.generator (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i h)).val = 1
proof:
:= by
  let p := signedStaircaseVertices i
  let S := signedStaircaseSupport
  have hp : p ∈ S := ⟨i, le_rfl⟩
  have hx : x ∈ S := ⟨i, h⟩
  have hg := GradedFree.generator_eq_structureMap
    (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i h
  rw [hg]
  have hn := congrArg (fun f => f.hom
    (GradedFree.birth (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i))
    ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).naturality (homOfLE h))
  change ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom
      (structureMapLinear (signedStaircaseF0 (k := k)) h
        (GradedFree.birth (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i)) =
    structureMapLinear (signedStaircaseModule (k := k)) h
      (((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app p).hom
        (GradedFree.birth (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i)) at hn
  have hbirth : ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app p).hom
      (GradedFree.birth (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i) =
        SupportInterval.one S hp := by
    change ((GradedFree.lift (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators
      (signedStaircaseModule (k := k))
      (fun j => SupportInterval.one signedStaircaseSupport ⟨j, le_rfl⟩)).app
        (signedStaircaseVertices i)).hom
      (GradedFree.birth (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i) =
        SupportInterval.one signedStaircaseSupport ⟨i, le_rfl⟩
    exact GradedFree.lift_birth (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators
      (signedStaircaseModule (k := k))
      (fun j => SupportInterval.one signedStaircaseSupport ⟨j, le_rfl⟩) i
  rw [hbirth] at hn
  have hval := SupportInterval.structureMap_val (k := k) S
    (GeneratedUpsetResolution.generatedSupport_ordConnected signedStaircaseVertices)
    h (SupportInterval.one S hp)
  calc
    (((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom
      (GradedFree.generator (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i h)).val =
        (structureMapLinear (signedStaircaseModule (k := k)) h
          (SupportInterval.one S hp)).val := congrArg Subtype.val hn
    _ = 1 := by
      change ((structureMapLinear (SupportInterval.module S
        (GeneratedUpsetResolution.generatedSupport_ordConnected signedStaircaseVertices)) h
        (SupportInterval.one S hp) : SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S x) : k) = 1
      rw [hval]
      simp [hx, SupportInterval.one]

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseAugmentation_sum
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseAugmentation_sum (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (y : (signedStaircaseF0 (k := k)).obj x) :
    (((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom y).val =
      Finsupp.linearCombination k (fun _ : Fin 4 => (1 : k)) y.val
proof:
:= by
  let E := GradedFree.fiberEquiv (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators x
  let L : GradedFree.fiber (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators x →ₗ[k] k :=
    (Submodule.subtype (SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) signedStaircaseSupport x)).comp
      ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom
  let R : GradedFree.fiber (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators x →ₗ[k] k :=
    (Finsupp.linearCombination k (fun _ : Fin 4 => (1 : k))).comp
      (Submodule.subtype _)
  have hcomp : L.comp E.symm.toLinearMap = R.comp E.symm.toLinearMap := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro i a
    have hsingle : E.symm (Finsupp.single i a) =
        a • GradedFree.generator (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i.1 i.2 := by
      have hbase : E.symm (Finsupp.single i (1 : k)) =
          GradedFree.generator (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i.1 i.2 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp_symm_single _ _ _
      calc
        E.symm (Finsupp.single i a) = E.symm (a • Finsupp.single i (1 : k)) := by
          congr 1
          exact (Finsupp.smul_single_one i a).symm
        _ = a • E.symm (Finsupp.single i (1 : k)) := map_smul _ _ _
        _ = a • GradedFree.generator (R := k)
            signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i.1 i.2 := by rw [hbase]
    have hLgen : L (GradedFree.generator (R := k)
        signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i.1 i.2) = 1 := by
      change (((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom
        (GradedFree.generator (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i.1 i.2)).val = 1
      exact signedStaircaseAugmentation_birth_value x i.1 i.2
    have hRgen : R (GradedFree.generator (R := k)
        signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i.1 i.2) = 1 := by
      change Finsupp.linearCombination k (fun _ : Fin 4 => (1 : k))
        (Finsupp.single i.1 (1 : k)) = 1
      simp [Finsupp.linearCombination_single]
    change L (E.symm (Finsupp.single i a)) = R (E.symm (Finsupp.single i a))
    rw [hsingle]
    simp [map_smul, hLgen, hRgen]
  have hLR : L = R := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro y
    have hy := congrArg (fun f => f (E y)) hcomp
    simpa [LinearMap.comp_apply] using hy
  change L y = _
  rw [hLR]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePathIncidence_coeff
statement:
private theorem signedStaircasePathIncidence_coeff (w : Fin 3 →₀ k) :
    signedStaircasePathIncidence (k := k) w 0 = -w 0 ∧
    signedStaircasePathIncidence (k := k) w 1 = w 0 - w 1 ∧
    signedStaircasePathIncidence (k := k) w 2 = w 1 - w 2 ∧
    signedStaircasePathIncidence (k := k) w 3 = w 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [signedStaircasePathIncidence, Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite_apply,
    Fintype.linearCombination_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> constructor <;> ring

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseDifferential_generator
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseDifferential_generator (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (j : Fin 3) (h : signedStaircaseJoins j ≤ x) :
    ((signedStaircaseDifferential (k := k)).app x).hom
        (GradedFree.generator (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators j h) =
      structureMapLinear (signedStaircaseF0 (k := k)) h
        (signedStaircaseRelation (k := k) j)
proof:
:= by
  have hbirth : ((signedStaircaseDifferential (k := k)).app
      (signedStaircaseJoins j)).hom
        (GradedFree.birth (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators j) =
      signedStaircaseRelation (k := k) j := by
    change ((GradedFree.lift (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators
      (signedStaircaseF0 (k := k)) (signedStaircaseRelation (k := k))).app
        (signedStaircaseJoins j)).hom
      (GradedFree.birth (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators j) = _
    exact GradedFree.lift_birth (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators
      (signedStaircaseF0 (k := k)) (signedStaircaseRelation (k := k)) j
  have hn := congrArg (fun f => f.hom
      (GradedFree.birth (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators j))
    ((signedStaircaseDifferential (k := k)).naturality (homOfLE h))
  change ((signedStaircaseDifferential (k := k)).app x).hom
      (structureMapLinear (signedStaircaseF1 (k := k)) h
        (GradedFree.birth (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators j)) =
    structureMapLinear (signedStaircaseF0 (k := k)) h
      (((signedStaircaseDifferential (k := k)).app (signedStaircaseJoins j)).hom
        (GradedFree.birth (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators j)) at hn
  rw [hbirth] at hn
  rw [GradedFree.generator_eq_structureMap]
  exact hn

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePathIncidence_single
proof:
:= by
  simp [signedStaircasePathIncidence, Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite_apply,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_single]

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseDifferential_coefficients
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseDifferential_coefficients (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (y : (signedStaircaseF1 (k := k)).obj x) :
    (((signedStaircaseDifferential (k := k)).app x).hom y).val =
      signedStaircasePathIncidence (k := k)
        (signedStaircaseActiveEdgeEmbed (k := k) x
          ((GradedFree.fiberEquiv (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators x) y))
proof:
:= by
  let E := GradedFree.fiberEquiv (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators x
  let J := signedStaircaseActiveEdgeEmbed (k := k) x
  let L : GradedFree.fiber (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators x →ₗ[k]
      (Fin 4 →₀ k) := (Submodule.subtype _).comp
        ((signedStaircaseDifferential (k := k)).app x).hom
  let R : GradedFree.fiber (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators x →ₗ[k]
      (Fin 4 →₀ k) := (signedStaircasePathIncidence (k := k)).comp
        (J.comp E.toLinearMap)
  have hcomp : L.comp E.symm.toLinearMap =
      (signedStaircasePathIncidence (k := k)).comp J := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
    intro i a
    have hsingle : E.symm (Finsupp.single i a) =
        a • GradedFree.generator (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators
          i.1 i.2 := by
      have hbase : E.symm (Finsupp.single i (1 : k)) =
          GradedFree.generator (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators i.1 i.2 := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp_symm_single _ _ _
      calc
        E.symm (Finsupp.single i a) = E.symm (a • Finsupp.single i (1 : k)) := by
          congr 1
          exact (Finsupp.smul_single_one i a).symm
        _ = a • E.symm (Finsupp.single i (1 : k)) := map_smul _ _ _
        _ = a • GradedFree.generator (R := k)
            signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators i.1 i.2 := by rw [hbase]
    change L (E.symm (Finsupp.single i a)) =
      signedStaircasePathIncidence (k := k) (J (Finsupp.single i a))
    rw [hsingle]
    have hD := signedStaircaseDifferential_generator (k := k) x i.1 i.2
    have hL : L (GradedFree.generator (R := k)
        signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators i.1 i.2) =
        Finsupp.single i.1.succ (1 : k) - Finsupp.single i.1.castSucc 1 := by
      calc
        L (GradedFree.generator (R := k)
            signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators i.1 i.2) =
            ((structureMapLinear (signedStaircaseF0 (k := k)) i.2
              (signedStaircaseRelation (k := k) i.1)).val) := congrArg Subtype.val hD
        _ = (signedStaircaseRelation (k := k) i.1).val := by
          change (structureMapLinear
            (GradedFree.module signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators) i.2
            (signedStaircaseRelation (k := k) i.1)).val = _
          rfl
        _ = Finsupp.single i.1.succ (1 : k) - Finsupp.single i.1.castSucc 1 := by
          simp [signedStaircaseRelation, GradedFree.generator]
    rw [map_smul, hL]
    have hJ : J (Finsupp.single i a) = a • Finsupp.single i.1 (1 : k) := by
      change ((Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp (R := k)
        {j : Fin 3 | signedStaircaseJoins j ≤ x}).symm
          (Finsupp.single i a) : Fin 3 →₀ k) = _
      rw [Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp_symm_single]
      exact (Finsupp.smul_single_one i.1 a).symm
    rw [hJ, map_smul, signedStaircasePathIncidence_single]
  have hLR : L = R := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    have hz := congrArg (fun f => f (E z)) hcomp
    simpa [L, R, LinearMap.comp_apply] using hz
  change L y = R y
  rw [hLR]

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseJoin_le_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · intro r
      have hv := h r
      fin_cases j <;> fin_cases r <;>
        norm_num [signedStaircaseJoins, signedStaircaseVertices] at hv ⊢ <;> linarith
    · intro r
      have hv := h r
      fin_cases j <;> fin_cases r <;>
        norm_num [signedStaircaseJoins, signedStaircaseVertices] at hv ⊢ <;> linarith
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ r
    have hv₁ := h₁ r
    have hv₂ := h₂ r
    fin_cases j <;> fin_cases r <;>
      norm_num [signedStaircaseJoins, signedStaircaseVertices] at hv₁ hv₂ ⊢ <;> linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseVertices_between
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseVertices_between (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    {i j l : Fin 4} (hij : i ≤ j) (hjl : j ≤ l)
    (hi : signedStaircaseVertices i ≤ x) (hl : signedStaircaseVertices l ≤ x) :
    signedStaircaseVertices j ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  fin_cases r
  · change (j.val : ℝ) ≤ x 0
    have hjl' : (j.val : ℝ) ≤ l.val := by exact_mod_cast (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp hjl)
    have hl' := hl 0
    change (l.val : ℝ) ≤ x 0 at hl'
    exact hjl'.trans hl'
  · change (3 : ℝ) - (j.val : ℝ) ≤ x 1
    have hij' : (i.val : ℝ) ≤ j.val := by exact_mod_cast (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp hij)
    have hcoord : (3 : ℝ) - (j.val : ℝ) ≤ 3 - (i.val : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hi' := hi 1
    change (3 : ℝ) - (i.val : ℝ) ≤ x 1 at hi'
    exact hcoord.trans hi'

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseJoin_crossing
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseJoin_crossing (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) (j : Fin 3)
    {a b : Fin 4} (ha : a.val ≤ j.val) (hb : j.val < b.val)
    (hax : signedStaircaseVertices a ≤ x) (hbx : signedStaircaseVertices b ≤ x) :
    signedStaircaseJoins j ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  have hja : a ≤ j.castSucc := Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr (by simpa using ha)
  have hjb : j.succ ≤ b := Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr (by
    have hval : j.val + 1 ≤ b.val := by omega
    simpa using hval)
  have hjstep : j.castSucc ≤ j.succ := Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr (by simp)
  have hleft := signedStaircaseVertices_between x hja (hjstep.trans hjb) hax hbx
  have hright := signedStaircaseVertices_between x (hja.trans hjstep) hjb hax hbx
  exact (signedStaircaseJoin_le_iff x j).2 ⟨hleft, hright⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePathInverse_coeff
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases j <;> simp [signedStaircasePathInverse]

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePathInverse_incidence
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  have hc := signedStaircasePathIncidence_coeff
    (w := signedStaircasePathInverse (k := k) c)
  fin_cases i
  · simp [signedStaircasePathInverse_coeff, hc]
  · simp [signedStaircasePathInverse_coeff, hc]
  · simp [signedStaircasePathInverse_coeff, hc]
    have hs : c 0 + c 1 + c 3 = -c 2 := by linear_combination hsum
    calc
      -c 1 + -c 0 - c 3 = -(c 0 + c 1 + c 3) := by ring
      _ = c 2 := by rw [hs]; simp
  · simp [signedStaircasePathInverse_coeff, hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseLinearCombination_one
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [c.sum_fintype (fun _ a => a) (by simp)]
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_succ] <;> abel

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : y.val ∈ Finsupp.supported k k
      {g : Fin 4 | signedStaircaseVertices g ≤ x} := by
    change y.val ∈ GradedFree.fiber (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators x
    exact y.property
  rw [Finsupp.mem_supported] at hmem
  by_contra hne
  exact hi (hmem (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hne))

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePathInverse_zero_of_inactive
statement:
private theorem signedStaircasePathInverse_zero_of_inactive (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (y : (signedStaircaseF0 (k := k)).obj x)
    (hsum : y.val 0 + y.val 1 + y.val 2 + y.val 3 = 0)
    (j : Fin 3) (hj : ¬ signedStaircaseJoins j ≤ x) :
    signedStaircasePathInverse (k := k) y.val j = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hleft : ∃ i : Fin 4, i.val ≤ j.val ∧ signedStaircaseVertices i ≤ x
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, hax⟩ := hleft
    have hright (b : Fin 4) (hb : j.val < b.val)
        (hbx : signedStaircaseVertices b ≤ x) : False :=
      hj (signedStaircaseJoin_crossing x j ha hb hax hbx)
    fin_cases j
    · have h1 : ¬ signedStaircaseVertices 1 ≤ x := by
        intro hh
        exact hright 1 (by norm_num) hh
      have h2 : ¬ signedStaircaseVertices 2 ≤ x := by
        intro hh
        exact hright 2 (by norm_num) hh
      have h3 : ¬ signedStaircaseVertices 3 ≤ x := by
        intro hh
        exact hright 3 (by norm_num) hh
      have hz1 := signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive x y 1 h1
      have hz2 := signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive x y 2 h2
      have hz3 := signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive x y 3 h3
      rw [signedStaircasePathInverse_coeff]
      simp [hz1, hz2, hz3] at hsum ⊢
      exact hsum
    · have h2 : ¬ signedStaircaseVertices 2 ≤ x := by
        intro hh
        exact hright 2 (by norm_num) hh
      have h3 : ¬ signedStaircaseVertices 3 ≤ x := by
        intro hh
        exact hright 3 (by norm_num) hh
      have hz2 := signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive x y 2 h2
      have hz3 := signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive x y 3 h3
      rw [signedStaircasePathInverse_coeff]
      simp [hz2, hz3] at hsum ⊢
      linear_combination -hsum
    · have h3 : ¬ signedStaircaseVertices 3 ≤ x := by
        intro hh
        exact hright 3 (by norm_num) hh
      have hz3 := signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive x y 3 h3
      rw [signedStaircasePathInverse_coeff]
      simp [hz3]
  · have hleftzero (i : Fin 4) (hi : i.val ≤ j.val) :
        ¬ signedStaircaseVertices i ≤ x := by
      intro hix
      exact hleft ⟨i, hi, hix⟩
    fin_cases j
    · have hz0 := signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive x y 0 (hleftzero 0 (by norm_num))
      rw [signedStaircasePathInverse_coeff]
      simp [hz0]
    · have hz0 := signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive x y 0 (hleftzero 0 (by norm_num))
      have hz1 := signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive x y 1 (hleftzero 1 (by norm_num))
      rw [signedStaircasePathInverse_coeff]
      simp [hz0, hz1]
    · have hz0 := signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive x y 0 (hleftzero 0 (by norm_num))
      have hz1 := signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive x y 1 (hleftzero 1 (by norm_num))
      have hz2 := signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive x y 2 (hleftzero 2 (by norm_num))
      rw [signedStaircasePathInverse_coeff]
      simp [hz0, hz1, hz2] at hsum ⊢
      exact hsum

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePathInverse_mem
statement:
private theorem signedStaircasePathInverse_mem (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (y : (signedStaircaseF0 (k := k)).obj x)
    (hsum : y.val 0 + y.val 1 + y.val 2 + y.val 3 = 0) :
    signedStaircasePathInverse (k := k) y.val ∈
      GradedFree.fiber (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators x
proof:
:= by
  change signedStaircasePathInverse (k := k) y.val ∈ Finsupp.supported k k
    {j : Fin 3 | signedStaircaseJoins j ≤ x}
  rw [Finsupp.mem_supported]
  intro j hj
  by_contra hnot
  have hz := signedStaircasePathInverse_zero_of_inactive x y hsum j hnot
  exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hj) hz

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseActiveEdgeEmbed_fiberEquiv
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseActiveEdgeEmbed_fiberEquiv (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (y : (signedStaircaseF1 (k := k)).obj x) :
    signedStaircaseActiveEdgeEmbed (k := k) x
        (GradedFree.fiberEquiv (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators x y) = y.val
proof:
:= by
  change ((Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp (R := k)
      {j : Fin 3 | signedStaircaseJoins j ≤ x}).symm
      (GradedFree.fiberEquiv (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators x y) :
        Fin 3 →₀ k) = y.val
  exact congrArg Subtype.val
    ((Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp (R := k)
      {j : Fin 3 | signedStaircaseJoins j ≤ x}).left_inv y)

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePathIncidence_sum_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedStaircaseLinearCombination_one]
  have hc := signedStaircasePathIncidence_coeff (k := k) w
  rw [hc.1, hc.2.1, hc.2.2.1, hc.2.2.2]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseAugmentation_sum_coeff
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseAugmentation_sum_coeff (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (y : (signedStaircaseF0 (k := k)).obj x) :
    (((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom y).val =
      y.val 0 + y.val 1 + y.val 2 + y.val 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedStaircaseAugmentation_sum, signedStaircaseLinearCombination_one]

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePathIncidence_injective
statement:
private theorem signedStaircasePathIncidence_injective :
    Function.Injective (signedStaircasePathIncidence (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have h0 : a 0 = b 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun c : Fin 4 →₀ k => c 0) hab
    have ha := signedStaircasePathIncidence_coeff (k := k) a
    have hb := signedStaircasePathIncidence_coeff (k := k) b
    rw [ha.1, hb.1] at h
    exact neg_injective h
  have h1 : a 1 = b 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun c : Fin 4 →₀ k => c 1) hab
    have ha := signedStaircasePathIncidence_coeff (k := k) a
    have hb := signedStaircasePathIncidence_coeff (k := k) b
    rw [ha.2.1, hb.2.1] at h
    linear_combination h0 - h
  have h2 : a 2 = b 2 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun c : Fin 4 →₀ k => c 2) hab
    have ha := signedStaircasePathIncidence_coeff (k := k) a
    have hb := signedStaircasePathIncidence_coeff (k := k) b
    rw [ha.2.2.1, hb.2.2.1] at h
    linear_combination h1 - h
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro j
  fin_cases j <;> assumption

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseDifferential_injective_at
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseDifferential_injective_at (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    Function.Injective ((signedStaircaseDifferential (k := k)).app x).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro y z hyz
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hcoeff := congrArg Subtype.val hyz
  have hy := signedStaircaseDifferential_coefficients x y
  have hz := signedStaircaseDifferential_coefficients x z
  rw [signedStaircaseActiveEdgeEmbed_fiberEquiv] at hy hz
  rw [hy, hz] at hcoeff
  have heq := signedStaircasePathIncidence_injective hcoeff
  exact heq

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseDifferential_augmentation_zero_at
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseDifferential_augmentation_zero_at (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (y : (signedStaircaseF1 (k := k)).obj x) :
    ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom
      (((signedStaircaseDifferential (k := k)).app x).hom y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [signedStaircaseAugmentation_sum_coeff, signedStaircaseDifferential_coefficients,
    signedStaircaseActiveEdgeEmbed_fiberEquiv]
  rw [← signedStaircaseLinearCombination_one]
  exact signedStaircasePathIncidence_sum_zero (k := k) _

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseRangeEqKer
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    exact signedStaircaseDifferential_augmentation_zero_at x y
  · intro hz
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hz
    have hsum : z.val 0 + z.val 1 + z.val 2 + z.val 3 = 0 := by
      have hv := congrArg Subtype.val hz
      rw [signedStaircaseAugmentation_sum_coeff] at hv
      exact hv
    let w : (signedStaircaseF1 (k := k)).obj x :=
      ⟨signedStaircasePathInverse (k := k) z.val,
        signedStaircasePathInverse_mem x z hsum⟩
    refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hd := signedStaircaseDifferential_coefficients x w
    rw [signedStaircaseActiveEdgeEmbed_fiberEquiv,
      signedStaircasePathInverse_incidence z.val hsum] at hd
    exact hd

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseAugmentation_surjective_at
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseAugmentation_surjective_at (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    Function.Surjective ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  by_cases hx : x ∈ signedStaircaseSupport
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
    let a : k := z.val
    refine ⟨a • GradedFree.generator (R := k)
      signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i hi, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (((GradedFree.lift (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators
      (signedStaircaseModule (k := k))
      (fun j => SupportInterval.one signedStaircaseSupport ⟨j, le_rfl⟩)).app x).hom
        (a • GradedFree.generator (R := k)
          signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i hi)).val = z.val
    let f := ((GradedFree.lift (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators
      (signedStaircaseModule (k := k))
      (fun j => SupportInterval.one signedStaircaseSupport ⟨j, le_rfl⟩)).app x).hom
    have hmap := map_smul f a
      (GradedFree.generator (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i hi)
    have hb : (f (GradedFree.generator (R := k)
        signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i hi)).val = 1 := by
      change (((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom
        (GradedFree.generator (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i hi)).val = 1
      exact signedStaircaseAugmentation_birth_value x i hi
    calc
      (f (a • GradedFree.generator (R := k)
          signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i hi)).val =
          (a • f (GradedFree.generator (R := k)
            signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i hi)).val := congrArg Subtype.val hmap
      _ = z.val := by
        change a * (f (GradedFree.generator (R := k)
          signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i hi)).val = z.val
        rw [hb]
        simp [a]
  · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (0 : k) = z.val
    exact (SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k) signedStaircaseSupport hx z).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePointwiseShortExact
statement:
private theorem signedStaircasePointwiseShortExact :
    IsPointwiseShortExact (signedStaircaseDifferential (k := k))
      (signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)) where
  injective
proof:
:= signedStaircaseDifferential_injective_at
  surjective := signedStaircaseAugmentation_surjective_at
  range_eq_ker := signedStaircaseRangeEqKer

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseSupport_upward_closed

private theorem signedStaircaseSupport_upward_closed {x y : Fin 2 → ℝ}
    (hxy : x ≤ y) (hx : x ∈ signedStaircaseSupport) : y ∈ signedStaircaseSupport
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨i, hi⟩
  exact ⟨i, hi.trans hxy⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseModule_structureMap_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  apply Subtype.ext
  change structureMapLinear
    (SupportInterval.module signedStaircaseSupport
      (GeneratedUpsetResolution.generatedSupport_ordConnected signedStaircaseVertices))
      hxy a = structureMapLinear
    (SupportInterval.module signedStaircaseSupport
      (GeneratedUpsetResolution.generatedSupport_ordConnected signedStaircaseVertices))
      hxy b at hab
  have hv := congrArg (fun z : (SupportInterval.module signedStaircaseSupport
      (GeneratedUpsetResolution.generatedSupport_ordConnected signedStaircaseVertices)).obj y =>
      z.val) hab
  change (structureMapLinear (SupportInterval.module signedStaircaseSupport
      (GeneratedUpsetResolution.generatedSupport_ordConnected signedStaircaseVertices)) hxy a).val =
    (structureMapLinear (SupportInterval.module signedStaircaseSupport
      (GeneratedUpsetResolution.generatedSupport_ordConnected signedStaircaseVertices)) hxy b).val at hv
  have hma := SupportInterval.structureMap_val (k := k) signedStaircaseSupport
    (GeneratedUpsetResolution.generatedSupport_ordConnected signedStaircaseVertices) hxy a
  have hmb := SupportInterval.structureMap_val (k := k) signedStaircaseSupport
    (GeneratedUpsetResolution.generatedSupport_ordConnected signedStaircaseVertices) hxy b
  rw [hma, hmb] at hv
  by_cases hy : y ∈ signedStaircaseSupport
  · simpa [hy] using hv
  · have hx : x ∉ signedStaircaseSupport := by
      intro hx
      exact hy (signedStaircaseSupport_upward_closed hxy hx)
    have ha := SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k) signedStaircaseSupport hx a
    have hb := SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k) signedStaircaseSupport hx b
    exact ha.trans hb.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseF0_structureMap_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  apply Subtype.ext
  change structureMapLinear (GradedFree.module signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators) hxy a =
    structureMapLinear (GradedFree.module signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators) hxy b at hab
  have hv := congrArg (fun z : (GradedFree.module signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators).obj y =>
    z.val) hab
  calc
    a.val = (structureMapLinear (GradedFree.module signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators) hxy a).val := by rfl
    _ = (structureMapLinear (GradedFree.module signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators) hxy b).val := hv
    _ = b.val := by rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseF1_structureMap_injective

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseRankExact
proof:
:= by
  let hs := signedStaircasePointwiseShortExact (k := k)
  refine { toIsPointwiseShortExact := hs, finiteDimensional := ?_, rank_add := ?_ }
  · intro x
    change FiniteDimensional k
      ((GradedFree.module (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators).obj x)
    exact GradedFree.finiteDimensional_fiber (k := k)
      signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators x
  · intro x y hxy
    haveI : FiniteDimensional k ((signedStaircaseF0 (k := k)).obj x) := by
      change FiniteDimensional k
        ((GradedFree.module (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators).obj x)
      exact GradedFree.finiteDimensional_fiber (k := k)
        signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators x
    apply (hs.rank_add_iff_lift_kernel hxy).2
    intro n hn
    have hn0 : n = 0 := by
      apply signedStaircaseModule_structureMap_injective (k := k) hxy
      simpa using hn
    refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [hn0]
    · simp

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseVertices_le_iff
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseVertices_le_iff {i j : Fin 4} :
    signedStaircaseVertices j ≤ signedStaircaseVertices i ↔ j = i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h0 := h 0
    have h1 := h 1
    change (j.val : ℝ) ≤ (i.val : ℝ) at h0
    change (3 : ℝ) - (j.val : ℝ) ≤ 3 - (i.val : ℝ) at h1
    have hji : j.val ≤ i.val := by exact_mod_cast h0
    have hijR : (i.val : ℝ) ≤ (j.val : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hij : i.val ≤ j.val := by exact_mod_cast hijR
    exact Fin.ext (Nat.le_antisymm hji hij)
  · rintro rfl
    exact le_rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseF0_fiber_at_vertex
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext j
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j
    simp
  · have hnot : ¬ signedStaircaseVertices j ≤ signedStaircaseVertices i := by
      intro h
      exact hji (signedStaircaseVertices_le_iff.mp h)
    have hz := signedStaircaseF0_coeff_zero_of_inactive
      (k := k) (signedStaircaseVertices i) y j hnot
    simpa [hji] using hz

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseF0_projective

    IsRankProjective (signedStaircaseF0 (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  let e := GradedFree.moduleBiproductIso (R := k)
    signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators
  apply IsRankProjective.of_iso
    (IsRankProjective.biproduct
      (fun i : Fin 4 => HookInfinity.module (R := k)
        (signedStaircaseVertices i))
      (by intro i; exact HookInfinity.isRankProjective _))
    e.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseAugmentation_is_cover
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseAugmentation_is_cover :
    IsRankProjectiveCover (signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
      FiniteDimensional k ((signedStaircaseF0 (k := k)).obj x) := by
    change FiniteDimensional k
      ((GradedFree.module signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators).obj x)
    exact GradedFree.finiteDimensional_fiber
      (k := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators x
  refine ⟨signedStaircaseF0_projective (k := k), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact RankKernel.rankExact
      (signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k))
      (signedStaircaseAugmentation_surjective_at (k := k))
      (by
        intro a b hab z hz
        have hz0 : z = 0 := by
          apply signedStaircaseModule_structureMap_injective (k := k) hab
          simpa using hz
        exact ⟨0, by simp [hz0], by simp⟩)
  · intro f hf
    have hf' : f = 𝟙 (signedStaircaseF0 (k := k)) := by
      apply GradedFree.hom_ext_birth (R := k)
        signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators
      intro i
      let p := signedStaircaseVertices i
      let b := GradedFree.birth (R := k) signedStaircaseDegreeZeroGenerators i
      have heq : ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app
          (signedStaircaseVertices i)).hom
          ((f.app (signedStaircaseVertices i)).hom b) =
            ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app
              (signedStaircaseVertices i)).hom b := by
        have hh := congrArg (fun q : signedStaircaseF0 (k := k) ⟶
            signedStaircaseModule (k := k) =>
              (q.app (signedStaircaseVertices i)).hom b) hf
        change ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app
          (signedStaircaseVertices i)).hom
          ((f.app (signedStaircaseVertices i)).hom b) =
            ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app
              (signedStaircaseVertices i)).hom b at hh
        exact hh
      have hbval : b.val = Finsupp.single i (1 : k) := by
        change Finsupp.single i 1 = _
        rfl
      have hscalar : ((f.app (signedStaircaseVertices i)).hom b).val i = 1 := by
        have hv := congrArg Subtype.val heq
        rw [signedStaircaseAugmentation_sum_coeff] at hv
        have hfib := signedStaircaseF0_fiber_at_vertex (k := k) i
          ((f.app (signedStaircaseVertices i)).hom b)
        have hright := signedStaircaseAugmentation_birth_value
          (k := k) (signedStaircaseVertices i) i le_rfl
        have hright' : (((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app
            (signedStaircaseVertices i)).hom b).val = 1 := by
          simpa [b, GradedFree.birth] using hright
        rw [hright'] at hv
        rw [← signedStaircaseLinearCombination_one] at hv
        rw [hfib, Finsupp.linearCombination_single] at hv
        simpa using hv
      have hbirth : (f.app (signedStaircaseVertices i)).hom b = b := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        rw [signedStaircaseF0_fiber_at_vertex (k := k) i
          ((f.app (signedStaircaseVertices i)).hom b), hscalar, hbval]
      exact hbirth
    rw [hf']
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseSecondRowRankExact
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hshort : IsPointwiseShortExact
      (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ signedStaircaseF1 (k := k))
      (𝟙 (signedStaircaseF1 (k := k))) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro p x y hxy
      exact (ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)).elim x y
    · intro p z
      exact ⟨z, rfl⟩
    · intro p
      apply Submodule.ext
      intro z
      simp [LinearMap.mem_range, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  letI (p : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
      FiniteDimensional k ((signedStaircaseF1 (k := k)).obj p) := by
    change FiniteDimensional k
      ((GradedFree.module signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators).obj p)
    exact GradedFree.finiteDimensional_fiber
      (k := k) signedStaircaseDegreeOneGenerators p
  exact hshort.rankExact_of_section
    (𝟙 (signedStaircaseF1 (k := k))) (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseSecondQuotient_is_cover
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseSecondQuotient_is_cover :
    IsRankProjectiveCover (𝟙 (signedStaircaseF1 (k := k)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  haveI (x : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
      FiniteDimensional k ((signedStaircaseF1 (k := k)).obj x) := by

    exact IsRankProjective.of_iso
      (IsRankProjective.biproduct
        (fun i : Fin 3 => HookInfinity.module (R := k)
          (signedStaircaseJoins i))
        (by intro i; exact HookInfinity.isRankProjective _)) e.symm
  · exact RankKernel.rankExact
      (𝟙 (signedStaircaseF1 (k := k)))
      (fun p x => ⟨x, rfl⟩)
      (by
        intro a b hab z hz
        exact ⟨z, by simp, hz⟩)
  · intro f hf
    have hf' : f = 𝟙 (signedStaircaseF1 (k := k)) := by simpa using hf
    rw [hf']
    infer_instance

:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePresentedMap_surjective
statement:
private theorem signedStaircasePresentedMap_surjective (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    : Function.Surjective ((signedStaircasePresentedMap (k := k)).app x).hom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := signedStaircasePresentedMap (k := k)
  intro z
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := signedStaircaseAugmentation_surjective_at (k := k) x z
  refine ⟨((signedStaircasePresentation (k := k)).cover.app x).hom y, ?_⟩
  have hdesc := (signedStaircasePresentation (k := k)).cover_desc
    (signedStaircasePresentationAugmentation (k := k))
    (signedStaircasePresentation_relation_killed' (k := k))
  have h := congrArg (fun g : signedStaircaseF0 (k := k) ⟶
      signedStaircaseModule (k := k) => (g.app x).hom y) hdesc
  change (f.app x).hom (((signedStaircasePresentation (k := k)).cover.app x).hom y) =
    ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom y at h
  exact h.trans hy

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePresentedMap_injective
statement:
private theorem signedStaircasePresentedMap_injective (x : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    : Function.Injective ((signedStaircasePresentedMap (k := k)).app x).hom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := signedStaircasePresentedMap (k := k)
  intro z z' hzz'
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (signedStaircasePresentation (k := k)).cover_surjective x (z - z')
  have hdesc := (signedStaircasePresentation (k := k)).cover_desc
    (signedStaircasePresentationAugmentation (k := k))
    (signedStaircasePresentation_relation_killed' (k := k))
  have hcomp := congrArg (fun g : signedStaircaseF0 (k := k) ⟶
      signedStaircaseModule (k := k) => (g.app x).hom y) hdesc
  change (f.app x).hom (((signedStaircasePresentation (k := k)).cover.app x).hom y) =
      ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom y at hcomp
  have hzero : ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom y = 0 := by
    calc
      ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom y =
          (f.app x).hom (((signedStaircasePresentation (k := k)).cover.app x).hom y) := hcomp.symm
      _ = (f.app x).hom (z - z') := by rw [hy]
      _ = (f.app x).hom z - (f.app x).hom z' := map_sub _ _ _
      _ = 0 := by rw [hzz']; exact sub_self _
  have hmem : y ∈ LinearMap.ker
      ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom :=
    (LinearMap.mem_ker
      (f := ((signedStaircaseAugmentation (k := k)).app x).hom)).mpr hzero
  rw [← (signedStaircasePointwiseShortExact (k := k)).range_eq_ker x] at hmem
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (LinearMap.mem_range
    (f := ((signedStaircaseDifferential (k := k)).app x).hom)).mp hmem
  have hkill := congrArg (fun g : signedStaircaseF1 (k := k) ⟶
      (signedStaircasePresentation (k := k)).presented => (g.app x).hom w)
    (signedStaircasePresentation (k := k)).relations_vanish
  change ((signedStaircasePresentation (k := k)).cover.app x).hom
      ((signedStaircaseDifferential (k := k)).app x |>.hom w) = 0 at hkill
  have hcoverzero : ((signedStaircasePresentation (k := k)).cover.app x).hom y = 0 := by
    rw [← hw]
    exact hkill
  have hsub : z - z' = 0 := by
    calc
      z - z' = ((signedStaircasePresentation (k := k)).cover.app x).hom y := hy.symm
      _ = 0 := hcoverzero
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hsub

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseDegreeZeroHookBetti
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseDegreeZeroHookBetti :
    (signedStaircaseMinimalResolution (k := k)).hookBettiMultiset
      (k := k) (n := 2) (signedStaircaseModule (k := k))
      (signedStaircaseModule_finitelyPresented (k := k)) 0 =
      hookTagMultiset (fun i : Fin 4 => Sum.inr (signedStaircaseVertices i))
proof:
:= by
  exact MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.hookBettiMultiset_eq_tagMultiset
    (M := signedStaircaseModule (k := k))
    (hM := signedStaircaseModule_finitelyPresented (k := k))
    (R := signedStaircaseMinimalResolution (k := k)) (j := 0)
    (signedStaircaseTermZeroHookSumPresentation (k := k))

    (signedStaircaseMinimalResolution (k := k)).hookBettiMultiset
      (k := k) (n := 2) (signedStaircaseModule (k := k))
      (signedStaircaseModule_finitelyPresented (k := k)) 1 =
      hookTagMultiset (fun i : Fin 3 => Sum.inr (signedStaircaseJoins i))
proof:

    (M := signedStaircaseModule (k := k))

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseMinimalResolution_barcode
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseMinimalResolution_barcode :
    (signedStaircaseMinimalResolution (k := k)).signedHookBarcode
      (k := k) (n := 2) (signedStaircaseModule (k := k))
      (signedStaircaseModule_finitelyPresented (k := k)) =
      signedStaircaseCenter
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (⟨
      (signedStaircaseMinimalResolution (k := k)).evenHookBetti
        (k := k) (n := 2) (signedStaircaseModule (k := k))
        (signedStaircaseModule_finitelyPresented (k := k)),
      (signedStaircaseMinimalResolution (k := k)).oddHookBetti
        (k := k) (n := 2) (signedStaircaseModule (k := k))
        (signedStaircaseModule_finitelyPresented (k := k))⟩ : SignedHookBarcode 2) =
    signedStaircaseCenter
  apply congrArg₂ (fun pos neg => (⟨pos, neg⟩ : SignedHookBarcode 2))
  · simp only [MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.evenHookBetti]
    have hlen : (signedStaircaseMinimalResolution (k := k)).resolution.length = 2 := rfl
    rw [hlen]
    have hdegrees : evenHookDegrees 2 = {0} := by decide
    rw [hdegrees]
    simp [signedStaircaseDegreeZeroHookBetti, signedStaircaseCenter]
  · simp only [MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.oddHookBetti]
    have hlen : (signedStaircaseMinimalResolution (k := k)).resolution.length = 2 := rfl
    rw [hlen]
    have hdegrees : oddHookDegrees 2 = {1} := by decide
    rw [hdegrees]
    simp [signedStaircaseDegreeOneHookBetti, signedStaircaseCenter]

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseIdentity_is_cover

private theorem signedStaircaseIdentity_is_cover
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ))

  · exact RankKernel.rankExact (𝟙 M) (fun _ x => ⟨x, rfl⟩)
      (by
        intro a b hab z hz
        exact ⟨z, by simp, hz⟩)
  · intro f hf
    have h : f = 𝟙 M := by simpa using hf
    rw [h]
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseLeftModule_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem signedStaircaseLeftModule_finitelyPresented :
    GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)
      (signedStaircaseLeftModule (k := k))

    (M := HookInfinity.module (R := k) a)

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePrincipalMinimalResolution_barcode
statement:
private theorem signedStaircasePrincipalMinimalResolution_barcode
    (a : Fin 2 → ℝ) :
    (signedStaircasePrincipalMinimalResolution (k := k) a).signedHookBarcode
      (k := k) (n := 2) (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a)
      (signedStaircasePrincipal_finitelyPresented (k := k) a) =
      ⟨{Sum.inr a}, 0⟩
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply congrArg₂ (fun pos neg => (⟨pos, neg⟩ : SignedHookBarcode 2))
  · simp only [MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.evenHookBetti]
    have hlen : (signedStaircasePrincipalMinimalResolution (k := k) a).resolution.length = 1 := by
      norm_num [signedStaircasePrincipalMinimalResolution]
    rw [hlen]
    have hdegrees : evenHookDegrees 1 = {0} := by decide
    rw [hdegrees]
    simp [signedStaircasePrincipalDegreeZeroHookBetti, hookTagMultiset]
  · simp only [MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.oddHookBetti]
    have hlen : (signedStaircasePrincipalMinimalResolution (k := k) a).resolution.length = 1 := by
      norm_num [signedStaircasePrincipalMinimalResolution]
    rw [hlen]
    have hdegrees : oddHookDegrees 1 = ∅ := by decide
    rw [hdegrees]
    simp
