name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseLeftCenter_family_matching
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseLeftCenter_family_matching :
    HookMatching.IsMatching (k := k) 1
      signedStaircaseLeftCenterSourceTags signedStaircaseLeftCenterTargetTags
      signedStaircaseIdentityMatching
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    have hji : i = j := by
      simpa [signedStaircaseIdentityMatching] using hij
    subst j
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [HookMatching.tagModule,
        FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule,
        signedStaircaseLeftCenterSourceTags,
        signedStaircaseLeftCenterTargetTags] using
        signedStaircasePrincipalInterleaving_radius_one
          (a := signedStaircaseVertices 0) (c := signedStaircaseVertices 0)
          (by intro r; fin_cases r <;> norm_num [signedStaircaseVertices])
          (by intro r; fin_cases r <;> norm_num [signedStaircaseVertices])
    · simpa [HookMatching.tagModule,
        FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule,
        signedStaircaseLeftCenterSourceTags,
        signedStaircaseLeftCenterTargetTags] using
        signedStaircasePrincipalInterleaving_radius_one
          (a := signedStaircaseJoins 0) (c := signedStaircaseVertices 1)
          (by intro r; fin_cases r <;> norm_num [signedStaircaseJoins, signedStaircaseVertices])
          (by intro r; fin_cases r <;> norm_num [signedStaircaseJoins, signedStaircaseVertices])
    · simpa [HookMatching.tagModule,
        FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule,
        signedStaircaseLeftCenterSourceTags,
        signedStaircaseLeftCenterTargetTags] using
        signedStaircasePrincipalInterleaving_radius_one
          (a := signedStaircaseJoins 1) (c := signedStaircaseVertices 2)
          (by intro r; fin_cases r <;> norm_num [signedStaircaseJoins, signedStaircaseVertices])
          (by intro r; fin_cases r <;> norm_num [signedStaircaseJoins, signedStaircaseVertices])
    · simpa [HookMatching.tagModule,
        FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule,
        signedStaircaseLeftCenterSourceTags,
        signedStaircaseLeftCenterTargetTags] using
        signedStaircasePrincipalInterleaving_radius_one
          (a := signedStaircaseJoins 2) (c := signedStaircaseVertices 3)
          (by intro r; fin_cases r <;> norm_num [signedStaircaseJoins, signedStaircaseVertices])
          (by intro r; fin_cases r <;> norm_num [signedStaircaseJoins, signedStaircaseVertices])
  · intro i hi
    simp [signedStaircaseIdentityMatching] at hi
  · intro j hj
    have hnot := hj j
    simp [signedStaircaseIdentityMatching] at hnot

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePrincipalTransition_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem signedStaircasePrincipalTransition_ne_zero
    (a : Fin 2 → ℝ) (ρ : NNReal) :
    CoordinateShift.transition (ρ + ρ) (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (HookMatching.principalHookCoefficient_ne_zero_iff
    (k := k) (ε := ρ + ρ)
    (CoordinateShift.transition (ρ + ρ) (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a))).mp
  rw [HookMatching.principalHookCoefficient_transition]
  exact one_ne_zero

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePrincipalInterleaving_maps_nonzero
statement:
private theorem signedStaircasePrincipalInterleaving_maps_nonzero
    {a c : Fin 2 → ℝ} (ρ : NNReal)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ρ
      (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) (HookInfinity.module (R := k) c)) :
    I.φ ≠ 0 ∧ I.ψ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hφ
    have htrans := signedStaircasePrincipalTransition_ne_zero (k := k) a ρ
    apply htrans
    have hzero : (0 : HookInfinity.module (R := k) a ⟶
        (CoordinateShift.shift (ρ + ρ)).obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a)) =
        CoordinateShift.transition (ρ + ρ) (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) := by
      have hcomp := I.φ_ψ
      rw [hφ] at hcomp
      simpa only [zero_comp] using hcomp
    exact hzero.symm
  · intro hψ
    have htrans := signedStaircasePrincipalTransition_ne_zero (k := k) c ρ
    apply htrans
    have hzero : (0 : HookInfinity.module (R := k) c ⟶
        (CoordinateShift.shift (ρ + ρ)).obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) c)) =
        CoordinateShift.transition (ρ + ρ) (HookInfinity.module (R := k) c) := by
      have hcomp := I.ψ_φ
      rw [hψ] at hcomp
      simpa only [zero_comp] using hcomp
    exact hzero.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircasePrincipalInterleaving_zero_impossible
statement:
private theorem signedStaircasePrincipalInterleaving_zero_impossible
    {a : Fin 2 → ℝ} (ρ : NNReal)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ρ (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) 0) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  have htrans := signedStaircasePrincipalTransition_ne_zero (k := k) a ρ
  have hφ : I.φ = 0 := by
    apply NatTrans.ext
    funext x
    exact (Functor.zero_obj (C := Fin 2 → ℝ) (D := ModuleCat.{u} k)
      (CoordinateShift.translation ρ x)).eq_of_tgt _ _
  have hzero : (0 : HookInfinity.module (R := k) a ⟶
      (CoordinateShift.shift (ρ + ρ)).obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a)) =
      CoordinateShift.transition (ρ + ρ) (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) := by
    have hcomp := I.φ_ψ
    rw [hφ] at hcomp
    simpa only [zero_comp] using hcomp
  exact htrans hzero.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseLeftRight_long_radius_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseLeftRight_long_radius_lower_bound
    {ρ : NNReal}
    (h : HasMultisetMatching (k := k) (n := 2) ρ
      (signedStaircaseLeft.positive + signedStaircaseRight.negative)
      (signedStaircaseRight.positive + signedStaircaseLeft.negative)) :
    (3 : ℝ) ≤ (ρ : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, ℓ, F, G, hF, hG, M, hM⟩ := h
  have hm : m = 1 := by
    simpa [HookMatching.hookTagMultiset_card,
      signedStaircaseLeft, signedStaircaseRight] using
      congrArg Multiset.card hF
  have hℓ : ℓ = 1 := by
    simpa [HookMatching.hookTagMultiset_card,
      signedStaircaseLeft, signedStaircaseRight] using
      congrArg Multiset.card hG
  subst m
  subst ℓ
  have hFtag : F 0 = Sum.inr (signedStaircaseVertices 0) := by
    have hF' : hookTagMultiset F = {Sum.inr (signedStaircaseVertices 0)} := by
      simpa [signedStaircaseLeft, signedStaircaseRight] using hF
    simpa [hookTagMultiset] using hF'
  have hGtag : G 0 = Sum.inr (signedStaircaseVertices 3) := by
    have hG' : hookTagMultiset G = {Sum.inr (signedStaircaseVertices 3)} := by
      simpa [signedStaircaseLeft, signedStaircaseRight] using hG
    simpa [hookTagMultiset] using hG'
  cases hp : M.finite 0 with
  | none =>
      obtain ⟨I⟩ := hM.source_zero 0 hp
      have I' : CoordinateInterleaving ρ
          (HookInfinity.module (R := k) (signedStaircaseVertices 0)) 0 := by
        simpa [HookMatching.tagModule,
          FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule, hFtag] using I
      exact False.elim
        (signedStaircasePrincipalInterleaving_zero_impossible (k := k) ρ I')
  | some j =>
      have hj : j = 0 := Fin.ext (by omega)
      subst j
      obtain ⟨I⟩ := hM.paired 0 0 hp
      have I' : CoordinateInterleaving ρ
          (HookInfinity.module (R := k) (signedStaircaseVertices 0))
          (HookInfinity.module (R := k) (signedStaircaseVertices 3)) := by
        simpa [HookMatching.tagModule,
          FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule,
          hFtag, hGtag] using I
      have hmaps := signedStaircasePrincipalInterleaving_maps_nonzero
        (k := k) ρ I'
      have hbirth := HookMatching.nonzero_principalHook_map_birth_bound
        (k := k) (ε := ρ) I'.φ hmaps.1
      have hcoord := hbirth 0
      norm_num [signedStaircaseVertices] at hcoord
      exact hcoord

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseLeftRight_matching_three
statement:
private theorem signedStaircaseLeftRight_matching_three :
    HasMultisetMatching (k := k) (n := 2) 3
      (signedStaircaseLeft.positive + signedStaircaseRight.negative)
      (signedStaircaseRight.positive + signedStaircaseLeft.negative)
proof:
:= by
  let F : Fin 1 → RealHookTag (n := 2) := fun _ =>
    Sum.inr (signedStaircaseVertices 0)
  let G : Fin 1 → RealHookTag (n := 2) := fun _ =>
    Sum.inr (signedStaircaseVertices 3)
  have hF : hookTagMultiset F =
      signedStaircaseLeft.positive + signedStaircaseRight.negative := by
    simp [F, signedStaircaseLeft, signedStaircaseRight, hookTagMultiset]
  have hG : hookTagMultiset G =
      signedStaircaseRight.positive + signedStaircaseLeft.negative := by
    simp [G, signedStaircaseLeft, signedStaircaseRight, hookTagMultiset]
  let M := signedStaircaseIdentityMatchingOne
  have hM : HookMatching.IsMatching (k := k) 3 F G M := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i j hij
      have hji : i = j := by simpa [M, signedStaircaseIdentityMatchingOne] using hij
      subst j
      fin_cases i
      exact ⟨by
        simpa [HookMatching.tagModule,
          FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule, F, G] using
          HookMatching.principalHookInterleavingOfBirthClose (k := k) 3
            (a := signedStaircaseVertices 0)
            (c := signedStaircaseVertices 3)
            (by intro r; fin_cases r <;> norm_num [signedStaircaseVertices])
            (by intro r; fin_cases r <;> norm_num [signedStaircaseVertices])⟩
    · intro i hi
      simp [M, signedStaircaseIdentityMatchingOne] at hi
    · intro j hj
      have hnot := hj j
      simp [M, signedStaircaseIdentityMatchingOne] at hnot
  exact HasMultisetMatching.intro F G hF hG M hM

  unfold signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_le_of_matching
      signedStaircaseLeftRight_matching_three).trans (by norm_num)
  · apply (le_hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_iff _ _ 3).2

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircase_signed_nontriangle
statement:
theorem signedStaircase_signed_nontriangle :
    signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity (k := k)
        signedStaircaseLeft signedStaircaseCenter +
      signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity (k := k)
        signedStaircaseCenter signedStaircaseRight <
      signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity (k := k)
        signedStaircaseLeft signedStaircaseRight
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedStaircaseLeftRight_distance_eq_three]
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt
    (add_le_add signedStaircaseLeftCenter_distance_le_one
      signedStaircaseCenterRight_distance_le_one)
    (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.not_forall_signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity_triangle
statement:
theorem not_forall_signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity_triangle :
    ¬ ∀ B₁ B₂ B₃ : SignedHookBarcode 2,
      signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity (k := k) B₁ B₃ ≤
        signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity (k := k) B₁ B₂ +
          signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity (k := k) B₂ B₃
proof:
:= by
  intro htriangle
  exact not_le_of_gt (signedStaircase_signed_nontriangle (k := k))
    (htriangle signedStaircaseLeft signedStaircaseCenter signedStaircaseRight)

name: TDA.Persistence.signedStaircaseModule_signed_nontriangle
statement:
theorem signedStaircaseModule_signed_nontriangle :
    signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity (k := k)
        (finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := 2) (by omega)
          (signedStaircaseLeftModule (k := k))
          (signedStaircaseLeftModule_finitelyPresented (k := k)))
        (finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := 2) (by omega)
          (signedStaircaseModule (k := k))
          (signedStaircaseModule_finitelyPresented (k := k))) +
      signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity (k := k)
        (finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := 2) (by omega)
          (signedStaircaseModule (k := k))
          (signedStaircaseModule_finitelyPresented (k := k)))
        (finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := 2) (by omega)
          (signedStaircaseRightModule (k := k))
          (signedStaircaseRightModule_finitelyPresented (k := k))) <
      signedHookBottleneckDissimilarity (k := k)
        (finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := 2) (by omega)
          (signedStaircaseLeftModule (k := k))
          (signedStaircaseLeftModule_finitelyPresented (k := k)))
        (finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := 2) (by omega)
          (signedStaircaseRightModule (k := k))
          (signedStaircaseRightModule_finitelyPresented (k := k)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [signedStaircaseLeftModule_barcode, signedStaircaseModule_barcode,
    signedStaircaseRightModule_barcode]
  exact signedStaircase_signed_nontriangle (k := k)

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_eq_resolution_termAt
statement:
@[simp] theorem MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_eq_resolution_termAt
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) (j : ℕ) :
    R.termAt j = R.resolution.termAt j
proof:
:= by
  simp [MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt,
    FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresented_unshiftedSchanuelLeftSummand_isZero
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_unshiftedSchanuelLeftSummand_isZero
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (hN : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) N)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    (S : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := N))
    {j : Fin (max R.resolution.length S.resolution.length)}
    (hj : 2 * n - 2 < j.val) :
    IsZero (unshiftedSchanuelLeftSummand R.resolution S.resolution j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : Even j.val
  · simpa [unshiftedSchanuelLeftSummand, he] using
      (FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_termAt_isZero
        hn M hM R j.val hj)
  · simpa [unshiftedSchanuelLeftSummand, he] using
      (FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_termAt_isZero
        hn N hN S j.val hj)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresented_unshiftedSchanuelRightSummand_isZero
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_unshiftedSchanuelRightSummand_isZero
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (hN : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) N)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    (S : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := N))
    {j : Fin (max R.resolution.length S.resolution.length)}
    (hj : 2 * n - 2 < j.val) :
    IsZero (unshiftedSchanuelRightSummand R.resolution S.resolution j)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : Even j.val
  · simpa [unshiftedSchanuelRightSummand, he] using
      (FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_termAt_isZero
        hn N hN S j.val hj)
  · simpa [unshiftedSchanuelRightSummand, he] using
      (FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_termAt_isZero
        hn M hM R j.val hj)

name: TDA.Persistence.unshifted_delay_radius
proof:
:= by
  rw [RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius]
  calc
    ε + ((2 * n - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) * ε =
        (1 + ((2 * n - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0)) * ε := by
          calc
            ε + ((2 * n - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) * ε =
                1 * ε + ((2 * n - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) * ε := by simp
            _ = (1 + ((2 * n - 2 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0)) * ε := by rw [add_mul]
    _ = ((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) * ε := by
      congr 2
      exact_mod_cast (show 1 + (2 * n - 2) = 2 * n - 1 by omega)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresented_exists_unshiftedSchanuel_interleaving
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_unshiftedSchanuel_interleaving
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (hN : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) N)
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (i : CoordinateInterleaving ε M N) :
    ∃ R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M),
      ∃ S : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := N),
        Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε)
          (unshiftedSchanuelLeftBiproduct R.resolution S.resolution)
          (unshiftedSchanuelRightBiproduct R.resolution S.resolution))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
    hn M hM
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
    hn N hN
  exact ⟨R, S, ⟨finitelyPresented_unshiftedSchanuel_interleaving
    hn M N hM hN R S ε i⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresented_unshiftedSchanuel_distance_le
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_unshiftedSchanuel_distance_le
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M)
    (hN : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) N)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    (S : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := N)) :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance
        (unshiftedSchanuelLeftBiproduct R.resolution S.resolution)
        (unshiftedSchanuelRightBiproduct R.resolution S.resolution) ≤
      ((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) * coordinateInterleavingDistance M N
proof:
:= by
  have hc : 2 * n - 1 ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hc0 : (((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hc
  have hct : (((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.coe_ne_top
  change coordinateInterleavingDistance
      (unshiftedSchanuelLeftBiproduct R.resolution S.resolution)
      (unshiftedSchanuelRightBiproduct R.resolution S.resolution) ≤
    ((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) *
      (⨅ ε : ℝ≥0, ⨅ (_ : Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ε M N)),
        (ε : ℝ≥0∞))
  rw [ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne hc0 hct]
  apply le_iInf
  intro ε
  rw [ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne hc0 hct]
  apply le_iInf
  intro hI
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := hI
  simpa [RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius, ENNReal.coe_mul] using
    (finitelyPresented_unshiftedSchanuel_interleaving hn M N hM hN R S ε i).distance_le

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.density1D_nonneg
statement: theorem density1D_nonneg (σ u x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ density1D σ u x
proof:
:=
  ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal_nonneg _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.density1D_formula
statement:
theorem density1D_formula {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (u x : ℝ) :
    density1D σ u x = (σ * Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ *
      Real.exp (-(x - u) ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  change (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi * σ ^ 2))⁻¹ *
    Real.exp (-(x - u) ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2)) = _
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (show 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi by positivity),
    Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hσ, mul_comm (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)) σ]

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.integrable_density1D
statement: theorem integrable_density1D (σ u : ℝ) : Integrable (density1D σ u)
proof:
:=
  ProbabilityTheory.integrable_gaussianPDFReal _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.integral_density1D
statement:
theorem integral_density1D {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (u : ℝ) :
    ∫ x, density1D σ u x = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ProbabilityTheory.integral_gaussianPDFReal_eq_one
  have h : (0 : NNReal) < ⟨σ ^ 2, sq_nonneg σ⟩ := by
    exact_mod_cast sq_pos_of_pos hσ
  exact ne_of_gt h

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.peak_nonneg
statement: theorem peak_nonneg (σ : ℝ) : 0 ≤ peak σ
proof: := by unfold peak; positivity

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.density1D_le_peak
statement: theorem density1D_le_peak (σ u x : ℝ) : density1D σ u x ≤ peak σ
proof:
:= by
  change peak σ * Real.exp (-(x - u) ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2)) ≤ peak σ
  have he : Real.exp (-(x - u) ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2)) ≤ 1 := by
    apply Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr
    exact div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.mpr (sq_nonneg _)) (by positivity)
  simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left he (peak_nonneg σ)

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.density1D_le_of_sq
statement:
private theorem density1D_le_of_sq {σ u v x : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (h : (x - v) ^ 2 ≤ (x - u) ^ 2) : density1D σ u x ≤ density1D σ v x
proof:
:= by
  change peak σ * Real.exp (-(x - u) ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2)) ≤
    peak σ * Real.exp (-(x - v) ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2))
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (peak_nonneg σ)
  apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
  apply (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right (by positivity : 0 < 2 * σ ^ 2)).2
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.integral_Iic_comp_sub
statement:
private theorem integral_Iic_comp_sub (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a u : ℝ) :
    (∫ x in Iic a, f (x - u)) = ∫ x in Iic (a - u), f x
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = ∫ x, (Iic a).indicator (fun x => f (x - u)) x :=
      (integral_indicator measurableSet_Iic).symm
    _ = ∫ x, (Iic a).indicator (fun x => f (x - u)) (x + u) :=
      (integral_add_right_eq_self _ u).symm
    _ = ∫ x, (Iic (a - u)).indicator f x := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with x
      have h : x + u ≤ a ↔ x ≤ a - u := by constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
      simp only [indicator_apply, mem_Iic, h, add_sub_cancel_right]
    _ = _ := integral_indicator measurableSet_Iic

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.integral_Iic_density1D
statement:
private theorem integral_Iic_density1D (σ u a : ℝ) :
    (∫ x in Iic a, density1D σ u x) = ∫ x in Iic (a - u), density1D σ 0 x
proof:
:= by
  have h : density1D σ u = fun x => density1D σ 0 (x - u) := by
    funext x
    simp [density1D, ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal]
  rw [h]
  exact integral_Iic_comp_sub _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.integral_abs_sub_of_le
statement:
private theorem integral_abs_sub_of_le {σ u v : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (huv : u ≤ v) :
    (∫ x, |density1D σ u x - density1D σ v x|) ≤ 2 * peak σ * (v - u)
proof:
:= by
  let m := (u + v) / 2
  have hu := integrable_density1D σ u
  have hv := integrable_density1D σ v
  have hd : Integrable (fun x => density1D σ u x - density1D σ v x) := hu.sub hv
  have habs : Integrable (fun x => |density1D σ u x - density1D σ v x|) := hd.abs
  have hleft (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Iic m) : density1D σ v x ≤ density1D σ u x := by
    apply density1D_le_of_sq hσ
    have hm : 0 ≤ u + v - 2 * x := by
      change x ≤ (u + v) / 2 at hx
      linarith
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr huv) hm]
  have hright (x : ℝ) (hx : x ∈ Ioi m) : density1D σ u x ≤ density1D σ v x := by
    apply density1D_le_of_sq hσ
    have hm : 0 ≤ 2 * x - u - v := by
      change (u + v) / 2 < x at hx
      linarith
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr huv) hm]
  have hl : (∫ x in Iic m, |density1D σ u x - density1D σ v x|) =
      ∫ x in Iic m, density1D σ u x - density1D σ v x := by
    apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic
    intro x hx
    exact abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hleft x hx))
  have hr : (∫ x in Ioi m, |density1D σ u x - density1D σ v x|) =
      -(∫ x in Ioi m, density1D σ u x - density1D σ v x) := by
    rw [← integral_neg]
    apply setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi
    intro x hx
    exact abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (hright x hx))
  have hz : (∫ x in Iic m, density1D σ u x - density1D σ v x) +
      (∫ x in Ioi m, density1D σ u x - density1D σ v x) = 0 := by
    rw [intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi hd.integrableOn hd.integrableOn,
      integral_sub hu hv, integral_density1D hσ, integral_density1D hσ, sub_self]
  have hsplit : (∫ x, |density1D σ u x - density1D σ v x|) =
      2 * (∫ x in Iic m, density1D σ u x - density1D σ v x) := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi habs.integrableOn habs.integrableOn,
      hl, hr]
    linarith
  have hinterval : (∫ x in Iic m, density1D σ u x - density1D σ v x) =
      ∫ x in (m - v)..(m - u), density1D σ 0 x := by
    rw [integral_sub hu.integrableOn hv.integrableOn,
      integral_Iic_density1D σ u m, integral_Iic_density1D σ v m]
    exact intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_sub_Iic
      (integrable_density1D σ 0).integrableOn (integrable_density1D σ 0).integrableOn
  have hb : (∫ x in (m - v)..(m - u), density1D σ 0 x) ≤ peak σ * (v - u) := by
    have h := intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on (show m - v ≤ m - u by linarith)
      (integrable_density1D σ 0).intervalIntegrable (intervalIntegrable_const)
      (fun x _ => density1D_le_peak σ 0 x)
    simpa [intervalIntegral.integral_const, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using h
  rw [hsplit, hinterval]
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.integral_abs_density1D_sub_le
statement:
theorem integral_abs_density1D_sub_le {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (u v : ℝ) :
    (∫ x, |density1D σ u x - density1D σ v x|) ≤ 2 * peak σ * |u - v|
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total u v with huv | hvu
  · simpa [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr huv)] using integral_abs_sub_of_le hσ huv
  · have h := integral_abs_sub_of_le hσ hvu
    simpa only [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hvu)] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.translationConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem translationConstant_nonneg {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    0 ≤ translationConstant σ
proof: := by unfold translationConstant; positivity

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.two_mul_peak
statement:
theorem two_mul_peak {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) :
    2 * peak σ = translationConstant σ
proof:
:= by
  unfold peak translationConstant
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (show 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi by positivity),
    Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hσ,
    Real.sqrt_mul (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num),
    Real.sqrt_div (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)]
  have h₂ : Real.sqrt 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by norm_num))
  have hπ : Real.sqrt Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr Real.pi_pos)
  field_simp
  nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)]

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.density2D_nonneg
statement: theorem density2D_nonneg (σ : ℝ) (u z : ℝ × ℝ) : 0 ≤ density2D σ u z
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg (density1D_nonneg _ _ _) (density1D_nonneg _ _ _)

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.integrable_density2D
statement: theorem integrable_density2D (σ : ℝ) (u : ℝ × ℝ) : Integrable (density2D σ u)
proof:
:=
  (integrable_density1D σ u.1).mul_prod (integrable_density1D σ u.2)

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.integral_density2D
statement:
theorem integral_density2D {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (u : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∫ z, density2D σ u z = 1
proof:
:= by
  change (∫ z, density1D σ u.1 z.1 * density1D σ u.2 z.2
    ∂(volume.prod volume)) = 1
  rw [integral_prod_mul, integral_density1D hσ, integral_density1D hσ, one_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.GaussianKernel.integral_abs_density2D_sub_le
statement:
theorem integral_abs_density2D_sub_le {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (u v : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (∫ z, |density2D σ u z - density2D σ v z|) ≤
      translationConstant σ * (|u.1 - v.1| + |u.2 - v.2|)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := (integrable_density1D σ u.1).sub (integrable_density1D σ v.1)
  have h₂ := (integrable_density1D σ u.2).sub (integrable_density1D σ v.2)
  have ha : Integrable (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
      |density1D σ u.1 z.1 - density1D σ v.1 z.1| * density1D σ u.2 z.2) :=
    h₁.abs.mul_prod (integrable_density1D σ u.2)
  have hb : Integrable (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
      density1D σ v.1 z.1 * |density1D σ u.2 z.2 - density1D σ v.2 z.2|) :=
    (integrable_density1D σ v.1).mul_prod h₂.abs
  have hd : Integrable (fun z => density2D σ u z - density2D σ v z) :=
    (integrable_density2D σ u).sub (integrable_density2D σ v)
  have hp (z : ℝ × ℝ) : |density2D σ u z - density2D σ v z| ≤
      |density1D σ u.1 z.1 - density1D σ v.1 z.1| * density1D σ u.2 z.2 +
      density1D σ v.1 z.1 * |density1D σ u.2 z.2 - density1D σ v.2 z.2| := by
    have he : density2D σ u z - density2D σ v z =
        (density1D σ u.1 z.1 - density1D σ v.1 z.1) * density1D σ u.2 z.2 +
        density1D σ v.1 z.1 * (density1D σ u.2 z.2 - density1D σ v.2 z.2) := by
      unfold density2D
      ring
    rw [he]
    simpa only [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (density1D_nonneg σ u.2 z.2),
      abs_of_nonneg (density1D_nonneg σ v.1 z.1)] using abs_add_le
      ((density1D σ u.1 z.1 - density1D σ v.1 z.1) * density1D σ u.2 z.2)
      (density1D σ v.1 z.1 * (density1D σ u.2 z.2 - density1D σ v.2 z.2))
  have hi := integral_mono hd.abs (ha.add hb) hp
  simp only [Pi.add_apply] at hi
  rw [integral_add ha hb] at hi
  simp only [Measure.volume_eq_prod] at hi
  rw [integral_prod_mul (fun x => |density1D σ u.1 x - density1D σ v.1 x|)
      (density1D σ u.2),
    integral_prod_mul (density1D σ v.1)
      (fun x => |density1D σ u.2 x - density1D σ v.2 x|),
    integral_density1D hσ, integral_density1D hσ, mul_one, one_mul] at hi
  calc
    _ ≤ (∫ x, |density1D σ u.1 x - density1D σ v.1 x|) +
        (∫ x, |density1D σ u.2 x - density1D σ v.2 x|) := hi
    _ ≤ 2 * peak σ * |u.1 - v.1| + 2 * peak σ * |u.2 - v.2| :=
      add_le_add (integral_abs_density1D_sub_le hσ _ _)
        (integral_abs_density1D_sub_le hσ _ _)
    _ = _ := by rw [two_mul_peak hσ]; ring

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.empty_discrepancy
statement:
private theorem empty_discrepancy (d e : MetricSpace (Fin 0)) :
    Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy]

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.singleton_discrepancy
statement:
private theorem singleton_discrepancy (d e : MetricSpace Unit) :
    Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy_nonneg d e)
  apply (Finset.fold_max_le 0).mpr
  refine ⟨le_rfl, ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨v, z⟩ _
  cases v
  cases z
  rw [d.dist_self, e.dist_self]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.empty_carrier
statement:
theorem empty_carrier (d e : MetricSpace (Fin 0)) (n : ℕ) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter d) n) =
        diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter e) n) ∧
      gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter d) n) =
        gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter e) n)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := Rips.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy ℚ d e n σ hA hB w
  have h₂ := Rips.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy ℚ d e n σ τ hA hB w D
  rw [empty_discrepancy, mul_zero] at h₁ h₂
  exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h₁ (norm_nonneg _))),
    sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h₂ (abs_nonneg _)))⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.singleton_carrier
statement:
theorem singleton_carrier (d e : MetricSpace Unit) (n : ℕ) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter d) n) =
        diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter e) n) ∧
      gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter d) n) =
        gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter e) n)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := Rips.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy ℚ d e n σ hA hB w
  have h₂ := Rips.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy ℚ d e n σ τ hA hB w D
  rw [singleton_discrepancy, mul_zero] at h₁ h₂
  exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h₁ (norm_nonneg _))),
    sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h₂ (abs_nonneg _)))⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.metricOne_dist
statement:
private theorem metricOne_dist (i j : Fin 2) :
    metricOne.dist i j = if i = j then 0 else 1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.metricTwo_dist
statement:
private theorem metricTwo_dist (i j : Fin 2) :
    metricTwo.dist i j = if i = j then 0 else 2
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.nonzero_discrepancy
statement: private theorem nonzero_discrepancy : Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy metricOne metricTwo = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (Finset.fold_max_le 1).mpr
    refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨i, j⟩ _
    change |(if i = j then 0 else 1) - (if i = j then 0 else 2)| ≤ 1
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · have h := Rips.abs_dist_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy metricOne metricTwo 0 1
    rw [metricOne_dist, metricTwo_dist] at h
    norm_num at h
    exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.perturbed_bounds
statement:
theorem perturbed_bounds (n : ℕ) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    ‖diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricOne) n) -
        diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricTwo) n)‖ ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricOne) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricTwo) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧
    |gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricOne) n) -
        gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricTwo) n)| ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricOne) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricTwo) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa only [nonzero_discrepancy, mul_one] using
      Rips.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy ℚ metricOne metricTwo n σ hA hB w
  · simpa only [nonzero_discrepancy, mul_one] using
      Rips.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy ℚ metricOne metricTwo n σ τ
        hA hB w D

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.perturbed_arctan
statement:
theorem perturbed_arctan (n : ℕ) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    |gaussianDiagramKernel 1 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) D
          (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricOne) n) -
        gaussianDiagramKernel 1 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) D
          (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricTwo) n)| ≤
      (2 + √2 * π / 2) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricOne) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricTwo) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Rips.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan ℚ metricOne
    metricTwo n 1 1 zero_le_one D
  rw [nonzero_discrepancy, mul_one] at h
  convert h using 2
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.obstructed_positive
statement: private theorem obstructed_positive : obstructedDiagram.IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  apply (orderedQ_isPositive_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro i
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.empty_positive
statement: private theorem empty_positive : emptyDiagram.IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  apply (orderedQ_isPositive_iff _ _ _).mpr
  intro i
  exact i.elim0

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.obstructed_finite
statement:
private theorem obstructed_finite :
    finitePart obstructedDiagram.points = {(0, 2)}
proof:
:= by
  simp [obstructedDiagram, finitePart_orderedQ, List.ofFn_succ]

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.empty_finite
statement: private theorem empty_finite : finitePart emptyDiagram.points = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [emptyDiagram, finitePart_orderedQ]

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.obstructed_bottleneck
statement: private theorem obstructed_bottleneck : bottleneck obstructedDiagram emptyDiagram = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply (bottleneck_eq_top_iff _ _).mpr
  simp [obstructedDiagram, emptyDiagram, essentialPart_orderedQ, List.ofFn_succ]

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.obstructed_norm
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagramEmbedding_eq_sum, diagramEmbedding_eq_sum, obstructed_finite, empty_finite,
    Multiset.map_singleton, Multiset.sum_singleton, Multiset.map_zero, Multiset.sum_zero,
    sub_zero, norm_smul, norm_featureAt, mul_one,
    arctanWeight_birthPersistence 1 zero_le_one (by norm_num)]
  norm_num [abs_of_pos (Real.arctan_pos.mpr two_pos)]

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsWeightedKernelExamples.infinite_bottleneck_boundary
statement:
theorem infinite_bottleneck_boundary :
    obstructedDiagram.IsPositive ∧ emptyDiagram.IsPositive ∧
      bottleneck obstructedDiagram emptyDiagram = ⊤ ∧
      ‖diagramEmbedding 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) obstructedDiagram -
          diagramEmbedding 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) emptyDiagram‖ = Real.arctan 2 ∧
      0 < Real.arctan 2 ∧
      ¬ ‖diagramEmbedding 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) obstructedDiagram -
          diagramEmbedding 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) emptyDiagram‖ ≤
        (2 * 1 + √2 * π / (2 * |(1 : ℝ)|)) *
          ((Fintype.card obstructedDiagram.finiteOccurrences +
            Fintype.card emptyDiagram.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (bottleneck obstructedDiagram emptyDiagram).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < Real.arctan 2 := Real.arctan_pos.mpr two_pos
  refine ⟨obstructed_positive, empty_positive, obstructed_bottleneck, obstructed_norm, hpos,
    ?_⟩
  rw [obstructed_norm, obstructed_bottleneck, ENNReal.toReal_top, mul_zero]
  exact not_le.mpr hpos

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofIndexed_apply (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior) (q : Interior) :
    ofIndexed w x q = ∑ i, if x i = q then w i else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [ofIndexed, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_apply_real
statement:
theorem ofIndexed_apply_real (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior) (q : Interior) :
    ((ofIndexed w x q : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = ∑ i, if x i = q then (w i : ℝ) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofIndexed_apply]
  rw [NNReal.coe_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_weight_zero_outside
statement:
private theorem ofIndexed_weight_zero_outside (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior)
    (i : I) (hi : x i ∉ (ofIndexed w x).support) : w i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ofIndexed w x (x i) = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hi
  rw [ofIndexed_apply] at hzero
  have hle : w i ≤ ∑ k, if x k = x i then w k else 0 := by
    calc
      w i = (if x i = x i then w i else 0) := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (a := i)
        (f := fun k => if x k = x i then w k else 0)
        (fun k _ => by positivity) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp (le_trans hle (le_of_eq hzero))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_weighted_sum
statement:
theorem ofIndexed_weighted_sum (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior)
    (f : Interior → ℝ) :
    ∑ q : (ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
      (((ofIndexed w x).weights q : ℝ) * f q.1) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * f (x i)
proof:
:= by
  let D := ofIndexed w x
  simp_rw [FiniteWeightedDiagram.weights, ofIndexed_apply_real]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : x i ∈ D.support
  · have hq : (∑ q : D.supportLabels,
        (if x i = q.1 then (w i : ℝ) else 0) * f q.1) = (w i : ℝ) * f (x i) := by
      classical
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨x i, hi⟩ : D.supportLabels)]
      · simp
      · intro q _ hq
        simp [Ne.symm (Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mpr hq)]
      · simp
    exact hq
  · have hw := ofIndexed_weight_zero_outside w x i hi
    simp [hw]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.sum_fibers
statement:
private theorem sum_fibers (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior) (f : I → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ i, x i ∉ (ofIndexed w x).support → f i = 0) :
    (∑ q : (ofIndexed w x).supportLabels, ∑ i, if x i = q.1 then f i else 0) =
      ∑ i, f i
proof:
:= by
  let D := ofIndexed w x
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : x i ∈ D.support
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨x i, hi⟩ : D.supportLabels)]
    · simp
    · intro q _ hq
      simp [Ne.symm (Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mpr hq)]
    · simp
  · have hfi := hf i hi
    simp [hfi]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.sum_fibers_weighted
statement:
private theorem sum_fibers_weighted (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior)
    (g : I → ℝ) (f : Interior → ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ i, x i ∉ (ofIndexed w x).support → g i = 0) :
    (∑ q : (ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
      (∑ i, if x i = q.1 then g i else 0) * f q.1) =
      ∑ i, g i * f (x i)
proof:
:= by
  let D := ofIndexed w x
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : x i ∈ D.support
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨x i, hi⟩ : D.supportLabels)]
    · simp
    · intro q _ hq
      simp [Ne.symm (Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mpr hq)]
    · simp
  · have hgi := hg i hi
    simp [hgi]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_weighted_sum_ennreal
statement:
theorem ofIndexed_weighted_sum_ennreal (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior)
    (f : Interior → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (∑ q : (ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
      ((ofIndexed w x).weights q : ℝ≥0∞) * f q.1) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ≥0∞) * f (x i)
proof:
:= by
  let D := ofIndexed w x
  have hcoe (q : Interior) : (D q : ℝ≥0∞) =
      ∑ i, if x i = q then (w i : ℝ≥0∞) else 0 := by
    rw [ofIndexed_apply]
    rw [ENNReal.ofNNReal_finsetSum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    split_ifs <;> simp
  change (∑ q : D.supportLabels, (D q.1 : ℝ≥0∞) * f q.1) = _
  simp_rw [hcoe, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  by_cases hi : x i ∈ D.support
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨x i, hi⟩ : D.supportLabels)]
    · simp
    · intro q _ hq
      simp [Ne.symm (Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mpr hq)]
    · simp
  · have hw := ofIndexed_weight_zero_outside w x i hi
    simp [hw]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_mass
statement:
theorem ofIndexed_mass (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior) :
    ∑ q : (ofIndexed w x).supportLabels, ((ofIndexed w x).weights q : ℝ) =
      ∑ i, (w i : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  simpa using ofIndexed_weighted_sum w x (fun _ => 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel_nonneg
statement:
theorem splittingKernel_nonneg (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior)
    (q : (ofIndexed w x).supportLabels) (i : I) :
    0 ≤ splittingKernel w x q i
proof:
:= by
  unfold splittingKernel
  split_ifs <;> positivity

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel_sum
statement:
theorem splittingKernel_sum (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior)
    (q : (ofIndexed w x).supportLabels) :
    (∑ i, splittingKernel w x q i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < (ofIndexed w x q.1 : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp q.2).bot_lt
  calc
    (∑ i, splittingKernel w x q i) =
        (∑ i, if x i = q.1 then (w i : ℝ) else 0) / (ofIndexed w x q.1 : ℝ) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_div]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          by_cases hi : x i = q.1 <;> simp [splittingKernel, hi]
    _ = (ofIndexed w x q.1 : ℝ) / (ofIndexed w x q.1 : ℝ) := by
      rw [ofIndexed_apply_real]
    _ = 1 := div_self (ne_of_gt hpos)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel_mass
statement:
theorem splittingKernel_mass (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior) (i : I) :
    (∑ q : (ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
      ((ofIndexed w x).weights q : ℝ) * splittingKernel w x q i) =
      (w i : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  let D := ofIndexed w x
  by_cases hi : x i ∈ D.support
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨x i, hi⟩ : D.supportLabels)]
    · change (D (x i) : ℝ) * (if x i = x i then (w i : ℝ) /
          (D (x i) : ℝ) else 0) = (w i : ℝ)
      simp only [ite_true]
      have hpos : 0 < (D (x i) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mp hi).bot_lt
      field_simp
    · intro q _ hq
      simp [splittingKernel, Ne.symm (Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mpr hq)]
    · simp
  · have hw := ofIndexed_weight_zero_outside w x i hi
    simp [splittingKernel, hw]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel_weighted_sum
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (i : I) : splittingKernel w x q i * f (x i) =
      splittingKernel w x q i * f q.1 := by
    by_cases hi : x i = q.1 <;> simp [splittingKernel, hi]
  simp_rw [hterm, ← Finset.sum_mul, splittingKernel_sum]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel_linear_sum
statement:
private theorem splittingKernel_linear_sum (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior)
    (g : (ofIndexed w x).supportLabels → ℝ) (f : Interior → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (∑ q : (ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
      splittingKernel w x q i * g q) * f (x i)) =
      ∑ q, g q * f q.1
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  calc
    (∑ i, (splittingKernel w x q i * g q) * f (x i)) =
        (∑ i, splittingKernel w x q i * f (x i)) * g q := by
          rw [Finset.sum_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          ring
    _ = g q * f q.1 := by
      rw [splittingKernel_weighted_sum]
      ring

name: TDA.Persistence.linearCost_reduced
statement:
private theorem linearCost_reduced {w : I → ℝ≥0} {v : J → ℝ≥0}
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v) (c : I → J → ℝ)
    (d : I → ℝ) (e : J → ℝ) :
    a.linearCost c d e =
      (∑ i, (w i : ℝ) * d i) + (∑ j, (v j : ℝ) * e j) +
        ∑ i, ∑ j, a.mass i j * (c i j - d i - e j)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.linearCost, weightedBoundaryLinearObjective,
    sub_mul, mul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun i j => a.mass i j * e j)]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.mass_eq_zero_of_source_zero
statement:
private theorem mass_eq_zero_of_source_zero (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (i : I) (j : J) (h : w i = 0) : a.mass i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hle : a.mass i j ≤ ∑ j, a.mass i j :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (a := j)
      (f := fun k => a.mass i k) (fun k _ => a.nonneg i k) (Finset.mem_univ j)
  exact le_antisymm (le_trans hle (by simpa [h] using a.row_le i)) (a.nonneg i j)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.mass_eq_zero_of_target_zero
statement:
private theorem mass_eq_zero_of_target_zero (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (i : I) (j : J) (h : v j = 0) : a.mass i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hle : a.mass i j ≤ ∑ i, a.mass i j :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (a := i)
      (f := fun k => a.mass k j) (fun k _ => a.nonneg k j) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact le_antisymm (le_trans hle (by simpa [h] using a.col_le j)) (a.nonneg i j)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.splitLift_matrix_sum
statement:
theorem splitLift_matrix_sum (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).weights
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).weights)
    (f : Interior → Interior → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, (splitLift x y b).mass i j * f (x i) (y j)) =
      ∑ q : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
        ∑ r : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).supportLabels,
          b.mass q r * f q.1 r.1
proof:
:= by
  let D := FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x
  let E := FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y
  let K := FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel w x
  let L := FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel v y
  change (∑ i, ∑ j,
    (∑ q : D.supportLabels, ∑ r : E.supportLabels, K q i * b.mass q r * L r j) *
      f (x i) (y j)) = _
  calc
    _ = ∑ j, ∑ i,
      (∑ q : D.supportLabels, K q i * (∑ r : E.supportLabels,
        b.mass q r * L r j)) * f (x i) (y j) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_comm]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro i _
          congr 1
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro q _
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro r _
          ring
    _ = ∑ j, ∑ q : D.supportLabels,
        (∑ r : E.supportLabels, b.mass q r * L r j) * f q.1 (y j) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          simpa only [K] using FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel_linear_sum w x
            (fun q => ∑ r : E.supportLabels, b.mass q r * L r j)
            (fun q => f q (y j))
    _ = ∑ q : D.supportLabels, ∑ j,
        (∑ r : E.supportLabels, b.mass q r * L r j) * f q.1 (y j) :=
      Finset.sum_comm
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro q _
      convert FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel_linear_sum v y
        (fun r => b.mass q r) (fun r => f q.1 r) using 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      congr 1
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      ring

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.aggregate_mass
statement:
theorem aggregate_mass (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (q : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).supportLabels)
    (r : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).supportLabels) :
    (a.aggregate x y).mass q r =
      ∑ i, if x i = q.1 then ∑ j, if y j = r.1 then a.mass i j else 0 else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.splitLift_mass
statement:
theorem splitLift_mass (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).weights
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).weights) (i : I) (j : J) :
    (b.splitLift x y).mass i j =
      ∑ q : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
        ∑ r : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).supportLabels,
          FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel w x q i * b.mass q r *
            FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel v y r j
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.matrix_indicator_sum
statement:
private theorem matrix_indicator_sum
    {D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram} (m : D.supportLabels → E.supportLabels → ℝ)
    (q₀ : D.supportLabels) (r₀ : E.supportLabels) :
    (∑ q : D.supportLabels, ∑ r : E.supportLabels,
      m q r * (if q.1 = q₀.1 then if r.1 = r₀.1 then 1 else 0 else 0)) =
      m q₀ r₀
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single q₀]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single r₀]
    · simp
    · intro r _ hr
      simp [Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mpr hr]
    · simp
  · intro q _ hq
    simp [Subtype.coe_ne_coe.mpr hq]
  · simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.aggregate_matrix_sum
statement:
theorem aggregate_matrix_sum (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior) (f : Interior → Interior → ℝ) :
    (∑ q : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
      ∑ r : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).supportLabels,
        (a.aggregate x y).mass q r * f q.1 r.1) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, a.mass i j * f (x i) (y j)
proof:
:= by
  let D := FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x
  let E := FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y
  change (∑ q : D.supportLabels, ∑ r : E.supportLabels,
    (∑ i, if x i = q.1 then ∑ j, if y j = r.1 then a.mass i j else 0 else 0) *
      f q.1 r.1) = _
  calc
    _ = ∑ r : E.supportLabels, ∑ q : D.supportLabels,
        (∑ i, if x i = q.1 then ∑ j, if y j = r.1 then a.mass i j else 0 else 0) *
          f q.1 r.1 := Finset.sum_comm
    _ = ∑ r : E.supportLabels, ∑ i,
        (∑ j, if y j = r.1 then a.mass i j else 0) * f (x i) r.1 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro r _
      simpa only using FiniteWeightedDiagram.sum_fibers_weighted w x
        (fun i => ∑ j, if y j = r.1 then a.mass i j else 0)
        (fun q => f q r.1) (fun i hi => by
          have hw := FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_weight_zero_outside w x i hi
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro j _
          by_cases hj : y j = r.1 <;>
            simp [hj, mass_eq_zero_of_source_zero a i j hw])
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ r : E.supportLabels,
        (∑ j, if y j = r.1 then a.mass i j else 0) * f (x i) r.1 :=
      Finset.sum_comm
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      exact FiniteWeightedDiagram.sum_fibers_weighted v y _ _ (fun j hj =>
        mass_eq_zero_of_target_zero a i j
          (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_weight_zero_outside v y j hj))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.aggregate_splitLift_mass
statement:
theorem aggregate_splitLift_mass (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).weights
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).weights)
    (q : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).supportLabels)
    (r : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).supportLabels) :
    ((b.splitLift x y).aggregate x y).mass q r = b.mass q r
proof:
:= by
  let f : Interior → Interior → ℝ := fun z t =>
    if z = q.1 then if t = r.1 then 1 else 0 else 0
  have h₁ := (b.splitLift x y).aggregate_matrix_sum x y f
  have h₂ := b.splitLift_matrix_sum x y f
  have hleft := matrix_indicator_sum ((b.splitLift x y).aggregate x y).mass q r
  have hright := matrix_indicator_sum b.mass q r
  calc
    ((b.splitLift x y).aggregate x y).mass q r =
        ∑ q' : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
          ∑ r' : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).supportLabels,
            ((b.splitLift x y).aggregate x y).mass q' r' * f q'.1 r'.1 := hleft.symm
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, (b.splitLift x y).mass i j * f (x i) (y j) := h₁
    _ = ∑ q' : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).supportLabels,
          ∑ r' : (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).supportLabels,
            b.mass q' r' * f q'.1 r'.1 := h₂
    _ = b.mass q r := hright

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_splitLift
statement:
theorem powerCost_splitLift (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).weights
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).weights) (p : ℝ) :
    (splitLift x y b).powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) =
      b.powerCost p
        (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).coordinates
        (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).coordinates
proof:
:= by
  let D := FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x
  let E := FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y
  let c : Interior → Interior → ℝ := fun q r => (finitePairCost q.1 r.1).toReal ^ p
  let d : Interior → ℝ := fun q => (diagonalCost q.1).toReal ^ p
  let e : Interior → ℝ := fun r => (diagonalCost r.1).toReal ^ p
  change (splitLift x y b).linearCost (fun i j => c (x i) (y j))
      (fun i => d (x i)) (fun j => e (y j)) =
    b.linearCost (fun q r => c q.1 r.1) (fun q => d q.1) (fun r => e r.1)
  rw [linearCost_reduced, linearCost_reduced]
  have hd := FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_weighted_sum w x d
  have he := FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_weighted_sum v y e
  have hc := splitLift_matrix_sum x y b (fun q r => c q r - d q - e r)
  simp only [FiniteWeightedDiagram.weights] at hd he ⊢
  rw [← hd, ← he, hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_aggregate
statement:
theorem powerCost_aggregate (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v) (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior) :
    (a.aggregate x y).powerCost p
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x).coordinates
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y).coordinates =
      a.powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1)
proof:
:= by
  let D := FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x
  let E := FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y
  let c : Interior → Interior → ℝ := fun q r => (finitePairCost q.1 r.1).toReal ^ p
  let d : Interior → ℝ := fun q => (diagonalCost q.1).toReal ^ p
  let e : Interior → ℝ := fun r => (diagonalCost r.1).toReal ^ p
  change (a.aggregate x y).linearCost (fun q r => c q.1 r.1)
      (fun q => d q.1) (fun r => e r.1) =
    a.linearCost (fun i j => c (x i) (y j)) (fun i => d (x i)) (fun j => e (y j))
  rw [linearCost_reduced, linearCost_reduced]
  have hd := FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_weighted_sum w x d
  have he := FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_weighted_sum v y e
  have hc := a.aggregate_matrix_sum x y (fun q r => c q r - d q - e r)
  simp only [FiniteWeightedDiagram.weights] at hd he
  simp only [FiniteWeightedDiagram.weights]
  rw [hd, he, hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_ofIndexed
statement:
theorem weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_ofIndexed (p : ℝ)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior) :
    weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) =
      powerBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x) (ofIndexed v y)
proof:
:= by
  let D := ofIndexed w x
  let E := ofIndexed v y
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerPlan p D E
    calc
      weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) ≤
          (b.splitLift x y).powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) :=
        weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan _ _ _ _ _ _
      _ = powerBoundaryTransportCost p D E := by
        rw [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_splitLift, hb]
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_minimizing_weightedPowerBoundaryPlan p w v
      (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1)
    calc
      powerBoundaryTransportCost p D E ≤
          (a.aggregate x y).powerCost p D.coordinates E.coordinates :=
        weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan _ _ _ _ _ _
      _ = weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1)
          (fun j => (y j).1) := by
        rw [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_aggregate, ha]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_ofIndexed
statement:
theorem weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_ofIndexed (p : ℝ)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior) :
    weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) =
      pBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x) (ofIndexed v y)
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (· ^ p⁻¹) (weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_ofIndexed p w v x y)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.aggregate_minimizing_powerPlan
statement:
theorem aggregate_minimizing_powerPlan (p : ℝ)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (ha : a.powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) =
      weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1)) :
    (a.aggregate x y).powerCost p (ofIndexed w x).coordinates
      (ofIndexed v y).coordinates = powerBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x)
      (ofIndexed v y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_aggregate, ha,
    weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_ofIndexed]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.splitLift_minimizing_powerPlan
statement:
theorem splitLift_minimizing_powerPlan (p : ℝ)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan (ofIndexed w x).weights (ofIndexed v y).weights)
    (hb : b.powerCost p (ofIndexed w x).coordinates
      (ofIndexed v y).coordinates = powerBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x)
      (ofIndexed v y)) :
    (b.splitLift x y).powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) =
      weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1)
        (fun j => (y j).1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_splitLift, hb,
    weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_ofIndexed]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.aggregate_minimizing_pPlan
statement:
theorem aggregate_minimizing_pPlan (p : ℝ)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (ha : a.powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) ^ p⁻¹ =
      weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1)) :
    (a.aggregate x y).powerCost p (ofIndexed w x).coordinates
      (ofIndexed v y).coordinates ^ p⁻¹ = pBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x)
      (ofIndexed v y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_aggregate, ha,
    weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_ofIndexed]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.splitLift_minimizing_pPlan
statement:
theorem splitLift_minimizing_pPlan (p : ℝ)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan (ofIndexed w x).weights (ofIndexed v y).weights)
    (hb : b.powerCost p (ofIndexed w x).coordinates
      (ofIndexed v y).coordinates ^ p⁻¹ = pBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x)
      (ofIndexed v y)) :
    (b.splitLift x y).powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) ^ p⁻¹ =
      weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1)
        (fun j => (y j).1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_splitLift, hb,
    weightedPBoundaryTransportCost_ofIndexed]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.exists_indexed_coalesced_minimizing_pPlans
statement:
theorem exists_indexed_coalesced_minimizing_pPlans {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior) :
    ∃ a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v,
      a.powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) ^ p⁻¹ =
        weightedPBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1)
          (fun j => (y j).1) ∧
      (a.aggregate x y).powerCost p (ofIndexed w x).coordinates
        (ofIndexed v y).coordinates ^ p⁻¹ = pBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x)
          (ofIndexed v y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_minimizing_weightedPBoundaryPlan hp w v
    (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1)
  exact ⟨a, ha, aggregate_minimizing_pPlan p w v x y a ha⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.exists_indexed_coalesced_minimizing_powerPlans
statement:
theorem exists_indexed_coalesced_minimizing_powerPlans (p : ℝ)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior) :
    ∃ a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v,
      a.powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) =
        weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1)
          (fun j => (y j).1) ∧
      (a.aggregate x y).powerCost p (ofIndexed w x).coordinates
        (ofIndexed v y).coordinates = powerBoundaryTransportCost p (ofIndexed w x)
          (ofIndexed v y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_minimizing_weightedPowerBoundaryPlan p w v
    (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1)
  exact ⟨a, ha, aggregate_minimizing_powerPlan p w v x y a ha⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerCost_ofUnitPlan_aggregate
statement:
theorem powerCost_ofUnitPlan_aggregate (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior) (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) :
    ((FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.ofUnitPlan a).aggregate x y).powerCost p
      (ofIndexed (fun _ : I => 1) x).coordinates
      (ofIndexed (fun _ : J => 1) y).coordinates =
      a.powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_aggregate,
    FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_ofUnitPlan]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerCost_splitLift_toUnitPlan
statement:
theorem powerCost_splitLift_toUnitPlan (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (b : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan
      (ofIndexed (fun _ : I => 1) x).weights
      (ofIndexed (fun _ : J => 1) y).weights) :
    ((b.splitLift x y).toUnitPlan).powerCost p
      (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) =
      b.powerCost p (ofIndexed (fun _ : I => 1) x).coordinates
        (ofIndexed (fun _ : J => 1) y).coordinates
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_toUnitPlan,
    FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.powerCost_splitLift]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.approximationBase_depth
statement: private theorem approximationBase_depth : depth approximationBase = 1
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [approximationBase, depth_eq]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.spaceApprox_interior
statement:
private theorem spaceApprox_interior (n : ℕ) (x : Interior) :
    spaceApprox n x ∈ Set.range Space.point
proof:
:=
  SimpleFunc.approxOn_mem continuous_point.measurable
    (show Space.point approximationBase ∈ Set.range Space.point from
      ⟨approximationBase, rfl⟩) n x

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.point_interiorQuantizer
statement:
private theorem point_interiorQuantizer (n : ℕ) (x : Interior) :
    Space.point (interiorQuantizer n x) = spaceApprox n x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := spaceApprox_interior n x
  change Space.point (unpointApprox (spaceApprox n x)) = spaceApprox n x
  rw [← hy]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicMeasure_quantizedDiagram
statement:
theorem atomicMeasure_quantizedDiagram (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (n : ℕ) :
    atomicMeasure (quantizedDiagram μ n) = μ.map (interiorQuantizer n)
proof:
:=
  atomicMeasure_simpleFuncDiagram μ _

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.quantizedDiagram_mass
statement:
theorem quantizedDiagram_mass (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (n : ℕ) : atomicMeasure (quantizedDiagram μ n) Set.univ = μ Set.univ
proof:
:=
  simpleFuncDiagram_mass μ _

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.quantizedDiagram_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem quantizedDiagram_zero (n : ℕ) :
    quantizedDiagram 0 n = 0
proof: := simpleFuncDiagram_zero _

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.spaceApprox_tendsto
statement:
private theorem spaceApprox_tendsto (x : Interior) :
    Tendsto (fun n => spaceApprox n x) atTop (𝓝 (Space.point x))
proof:
:=
  SimpleFunc.tendsto_approxOn continuous_point.measurable
    (show Space.point approximationBase ∈ Set.range Space.point from
      ⟨approximationBase, rfl⟩)
    (subset_closure (⟨x, rfl⟩ : Space.point x ∈ Set.range Space.point))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.interiorQuantizer_point_tendsto
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [point_interiorQuantizer] using spaceApprox_tendsto x

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurable_depth
statement: private theorem measurable_depth : Measurable depth
proof:
:= by
  have h : Continuous (fun x : Interior => (x.1.2 - x.1.1) / 2) := by fun_prop
  simpa only [← depth_eq] using h.measurable

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.quantizationError_measurable
statement:
private theorem quantizationError_measurable (p : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    Measurable (quantizationError p n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold quantizationError
  exact (ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const (y := p)).measurable.comp
    ((continuous_point.measurable.comp
      (interiorQuantizer n).measurable).edist continuous_point.measurable)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.quantizationError_tendsto
statement:
private theorem quantizationError_tendsto (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (x : Interior) :
    Tendsto (fun n => quantizationError p n x) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Tendsto (fun n => edist (Space.point (interiorQuantizer n x))
      (Space.point x)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [edist_self] using
      (interiorQuantizer_point_tendsto x).edist
        (tendsto_const_nhds (x := Space.point x))
  simpa only [quantizationError, ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hp, Function.comp_def] using
    (ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const (y := p) |>.tendsto 0).comp hd

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.quantizationError_le_depth
statement:
private theorem quantizationError_le_depth (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (n : ℕ) (x : Interior) :
    quantizationError p n x ≤
      ((1 : ℝ≥0∞) + ENNReal.ofReal (depth x)) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : edist (Space.point approximationBase) (Space.point x) ≤
      (1 : ℝ≥0∞) + ENNReal.ofReal (depth x) := by
    calc
      edist (Space.point approximationBase) (Space.point x) ≤
          edist (Space.point approximationBase) Space.boundary +
          edist Space.boundary (Space.point x) := edist_triangle _ _ _
      _ = (1 : ℝ≥0∞) + ENNReal.ofReal (depth x) := by
        simp [edist_dist, approximationBase, depth_eq]
  have happrox := SimpleFunc.edist_approxOn_le continuous_point.measurable
    (show Space.point approximationBase ∈ Set.range Space.point from
      ⟨approximationBase, rfl⟩) x n
  change edist (spaceApprox n x) (Space.point x) ≤
    edist (Space.point approximationBase) (Space.point x) at happrox
  unfold quantizationError
  rw [point_interiorQuantizer]
  exact ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (happrox.trans hbase) hp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.quantizationError_le_bound
proof:
:= by
  apply (quantizationError_le_depth p hp n x).trans
  have h := ENNReal.add_rpow_le_two_rpow_mul_rpow_add_rpow
    (1 : ℝ≥0∞) (ENNReal.ofReal (depth x)) hp
  simpa only [ENNReal.one_rpow, ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg (depth_nonneg x) hp,
    quantizationBound] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.quantizationBound_integrable
statement:
private theorem quantizationBound_integrable (p : ℝ)
    (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hmoment : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞) :
    (∫⁻ x, quantizationBound p x ∂μ) < ∞
proof:
:= by
  have hm : Measurable (fun x : Interior => ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p)) := by
    exact (measurable_depth.pow_const p).ennreal_ofReal
  unfold quantizationBound
  calc
    (∫⁻ x, (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ p * (1 + ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p)) ∂μ) =
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ p * (∫⁻ x, 1 + ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) := by
          exact lintegral_const_mul _ (measurable_const.add hm)
    _ = (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ p *
        ((∫⁻ _ : Interior, (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μ) +
          ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) := by
            rw [lintegral_add_left measurable_const]
    _ < ∞ := by
      rw [lintegral_const]
      finiteness

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.quantizationError_lintegral_tendsto
statement:
private theorem quantizationError_lintegral_tendsto (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hmoment : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫⁻ x, quantizationError p n x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h := tendsto_lintegral_of_dominated_convergence
    (μ := μ) (f := fun _ : Interior => (0 : ℝ≥0∞))
    (quantizationBound p)
    (fun n => quantizationError_measurable p n)
    (fun n => Filter.Eventually.of_forall
      (quantizationError_le_bound p (le_trans (by norm_num) hp) n))
    (quantizationBound_integrable p μ hmoment).ne
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => quantizationError_tendsto p (by linarith) x)
  simpa only [lintegral_zero] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.quantizationError_eq_cost
statement:
private theorem quantizationError_eq_cost (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (n : ℕ) (x : Interior) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((dist (Space.point x)
      (Space.point (interiorQuantizer n x))) ^ p) = quantizationError p n x
proof:
:= by
  rw [quantizationError, ← ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg dist_nonneg hp,
    ← edist_dist, edist_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_quantizedDiagram_tendsto
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_quantizedDiagram_tendsto
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hmoment : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞) :
    Tendsto (fun n => boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ
      (atomicMeasure (quantizedDiagram μ n))) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have herror := quantizationError_lintegral_tendsto p hp μ hmoment
  apply tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds herror
  · intro n
    exact bot_le
  · intro n
    simpa only [quantizedDiagram,
      quantizationError_eq_cost p (le_trans (by norm_num) hp)] using
      boundaryTransportPowerValue_simpleFuncDiagram_le p hp μ (interiorQuantizer n)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_quantizedDiagram_tendsto
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_quantizedDiagram_tendsto
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hmoment : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞) :
    Tendsto (fun n => boundaryTransportDistance p μ
      (atomicMeasure (quantizedDiagram μ n))) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < 1 / p := one_div_pos.mpr (by linarith)
  simpa only [boundaryTransportDistance, ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos hr,
    Function.comp_def] using
    ((ENNReal.continuous_rpow_const (y := 1 / p)).tendsto 0).comp
      (boundaryTransportPowerValue_quantizedDiagram_tendsto p hp μ hmoment)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.exists_atomicMeasure_approx_same_mass
statement:
theorem exists_atomicMeasure_approx_same_mass
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (hmoment : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞)
    (ε : ℝ≥0∞) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ D : FiniteWeightedDiagram,
      atomicMeasure D Set.univ = μ Set.univ ∧
      boundaryTransportDistance p μ (atomicMeasure D) < ε
proof:
:= by
  have hconv := boundaryTransportDistance_quantizedDiagram_tendsto p hp μ hmoment
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Filter.Eventually.exists
    (hconv.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hε))
  exact ⟨quantizedDiagram μ n, quantizedDiagram_mass μ n, hn⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.rankOfStructureMap_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem rankOfStructureMap_zero {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    rankOfStructureMap (0 : PModule.{u,v,u} k P) hab = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold rankOfStructureMap
  have htarget : Subsingleton ((0 : PModule.{u,v,u} k P).obj b) :=
    ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj b)
  have hrange : Subsingleton
      (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear (0 : PModule.{u,v,u} k P) hab)) :=
    ⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext (htarget.elim x.val y.val)⟩
  exact @Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton k _ _ _ _ _ hrange

name: TDA.Persistence.rankOfStructureMap_iso
proof:
:= by
  let ea : M.obj a ≃ₗ[k] N.obj a := (e.app a).toLinearEquiv
  let eb : M.obj b ≃ₗ[k] N.obj b := (e.app b).toLinearEquiv
  have hnat : (structureMapLinear N hab).comp ea.toLinearMap =
      eb.toLinearMap.comp (structureMapLinear M hab) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    have h := congrArg (fun f : M.obj a ⟶ N.obj b => f.hom x)
      (e.hom.naturality (homOfLE hab))
    change (e.app b).toLinearEquiv (structureMapLinear M hab x) =
      structureMapLinear N hab ((e.app a).toLinearEquiv x) at h
    exact h.symm
  have hrange := congrArg LinearMap.range hnat
  have hleft : LinearMap.range (eb.toLinearMap.comp (structureMapLinear M hab)) =
      Submodule.map eb.toLinearMap (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hab)) :=
    LinearMap.range_comp _ _
  have hsurj : LinearMap.range ea.toLinearMap = ⊤ :=
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr ea.surjective
  rw [LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top _ hsurj, hleft] at hrange
  calc
    rankOfStructureMap M hab =
        Module.finrank k (Submodule.map eb.toLinearMap
          (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hab))) := by
      unfold rankOfStructureMap
      exact (LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq eb _).symm
    _ = rankOfStructureMap N hab := by
      unfold rankOfStructureMap
      rw [← hrange]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankExactResolution.alternatingRowSum
statement:
private theorem alternatingRowSum :
    ∀ (m : ℕ) (r : Fin (m + 1) → ℤ) (q : Fin m → ℤ),
      (∀ i, q i = r i.succ + r i.castSucc) →
      (∑ i : Fin m, (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val * q i) =
        r 0 - (-1 : ℤ) ^ m * r (Fin.last m)
proof:
:= by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      intro r q _
      simp
  | succ m ih =>
      intro r q hrow
      let r' : Fin (m + 1) → ℤ := fun i => r i.succ
      let q' : Fin m → ℤ := fun i => q i.succ
      have hrow' : ∀ i, q' i = r' i.succ + r' i.castSucc := by
        intro i
        dsimp [q', r']
        simpa using hrow i.succ
      have htail := ih r' q' hrow'
      have hsign :
          (∑ i : Fin m, (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.succ.val * q i.succ) =
            -(∑ i : Fin m, (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val * q' i) := by
        calc
          _ = ∑ i : Fin m, -((-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val * q' i) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i _
            simp [q', Fin.val_succ, pow_succ, mul_comm]
          _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      simp only [Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, one_mul]
      rw [hrow 0, hsign, htail]
      simp [r', Fin.castSucc_zero, Fin.succ_last, pow_succ, mul_comm]
      ring

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankExactResolution.rank_eq_alternating_sum
statement:
theorem rank_eq_alternating_sum (R : FiniteRankExactResolution M)
    {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (rankOfStructureMap M hab : ℤ) =
      ∑ i : Fin R.length, (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val *
        (rankOfStructureMap (R.term i) hab : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let r : Fin (R.length + 1) → ℤ := fun i =>
    (rankOfStructureMap (R.kernel i) hab : ℤ)
  let q : Fin R.length → ℤ := fun i =>
    (rankOfStructureMap (R.term i) hab : ℤ)
  have hrow : ∀ i, q i = r i.succ + r i.castSucc := by
    intro i
    dsimp [q, r, rankOfStructureMap]
    exact_mod_cast (R.row_rank_exact i).rank_add hab
  have hsum := alternatingRowSum R.length r q hrow
  have hstart : r 0 = (rankOfStructureMap M hab : ℤ) := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact_mod_cast rankOfStructureMap_iso hab R.initial_iso
  have hfinish : r (Fin.last R.length) = 0 := by
    dsimp [r]
    rw [rankOfStructureMap_iso hab R.terminal_iso]
    simp
  rw [hstart, hfinish] at hsum
  simp only [mul_zero, sub_zero] at hsum
  exact hsum.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.rank_eq_alternating_sum
statement:
theorem rank_eq_alternating_sum (R : FiniteRankProjectiveResolution M)
    {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (rankOfStructureMap M hab : ℤ) =
      ∑ i : Fin R.length, (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val *
        (rankOfStructureMap (R.term i) hab : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  FiniteRankExactResolution.rank_eq_alternating_sum
    R.toFiniteRankExactResolution hab

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_toLp_sub_le_sqrt_two_mul
statement:
theorem norm_toLp_sub_le_sqrt_two_mul (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖WithLp.toLp 2 p - WithLp.toLp 2 q‖ ≤ √2 * ‖p - q‖
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 p - WithLp.toLp 2 q‖ ^ 2 = (p.1 - q.1) ^ 2 + (p.2 - q.2) ^ 2 := by
    rw [WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
    simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hn : ‖p - q‖ = max |p.1 - q.1| |p.2 - q.2| := by
    simp only [Prod.norm_def, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have ha : (p.1 - q.1) ^ 2 ≤ ‖p - q‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← sq_abs, hn]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (le_max_left _ _) 2
  have hb : (p.2 - q.2) ^ 2 ≤ ‖p - q‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← sq_abs, hn]
    exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (le_max_right _ _) 2
  have hle : ‖WithLp.toLp 2 p - WithLp.toLp 2 q‖ ^ 2 ≤ (√2 * ‖p - q‖) ^ 2 := by
    rw [h1, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
    linarith
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp hle

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_featureAt_sub_le_euclidean
statement:
theorem norm_featureAt_sub_le_euclidean (σ : ℝ) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖featureAt σ p - featureAt σ q‖ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 p - WithLp.toLp 2 q‖ / |σ|
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_sub_le_of_inner_eq_gaussian (norm_featureAt σ p) (norm_featureAt σ q)
    ((inner_featureAt σ p q).trans (kernel_eq_gaussian σ p q))
  rwa [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] at h

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_featureAt_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_featureAt_sub_le (σ : ℝ) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖featureAt σ p - featureAt σ q‖ ≤ √2 / |σ| * ‖p - q‖
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖WithLp.toLp 2 p - WithLp.toLp 2 q‖ / |σ| := norm_featureAt_sub_le_euclidean σ p q
    _ ≤ (√2 * ‖p - q‖) / |σ| :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (norm_toLp_sub_le_sqrt_two_mul p q) (abs_nonneg σ)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem stabilityConstant_nonneg (σ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    0 ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B
proof:
:=
  add_nonneg (mul_nonneg zero_le_two hA)
    (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2) hB) (abs_nonneg σ))

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.weight_lipschitz_nonneg
statement: private theorem weight_lipschitz_nonneg (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) : 0 ≤ A
proof:
:= by
  have h := w.lipschitz (0, 0) (0, 1)
  have hn : ‖((0 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) - (0, 1)‖ = 1 := by
    norm_num [Prod.norm_def]
  rw [hn, mul_one] at h
  exact (abs_nonneg _).trans h

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.embedding_eq_finiteFeatureSum
statement:
theorem embedding_eq_finiteFeatureSum {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (σ : ℝ)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) :
    embedding σ w x = finiteFeatureSum (weightedFeature σ w) x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_weightedFeature_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_weightedFeature_sub_le (σ : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖weightedFeature σ w p - weightedFeature σ w q‖ ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B * ‖p - q‖
proof:
:= by
  have hA := weight_lipschitz_nonneg w
