  have hw : |w (birthPersistence p) - w (birthPersistence q)| ≤ 2 * A * ‖p - q‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ A * ‖birthPersistence p - birthPersistence q‖ := w.lipschitz _ _
      _ ≤ A * (2 * ‖p - q‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_birthPersistence_sub_le p q) hA
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hwb : |w (birthPersistence p)| ≤ B := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (w.nonneg _)]
    exact w.bounded _
  have he : weightedFeature σ w p - weightedFeature σ w q =
      (w (birthPersistence p) - w (birthPersistence q)) • featureAt σ q +
        w (birthPersistence p) • (featureAt σ p - featureAt σ q) := by
    simp only [weightedFeature]
    module
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(w (birthPersistence p) - w (birthPersistence q)) • featureAt σ q‖ +
        ‖w (birthPersistence p) • (featureAt σ p - featureAt σ q)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = |w (birthPersistence p) - w (birthPersistence q)| * 1 +
        |w (birthPersistence p)| * ‖featureAt σ p - featureAt σ q‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_featureAt]
    _ ≤ (2 * A * ‖p - q‖) * 1 + B * (√2 / |σ| * ‖p - q‖) :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hw zero_le_one)
        (mul_le_mul hwb (norm_featureAt_sub_le σ p q) (norm_nonneg _) hB)
    _ = _ := by unfold stabilityConstant; ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_weightedFeature_le_diagonalCost
statement:
theorem norm_weightedFeature_le_diagonalCost (σ : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖weightedFeature σ w p‖ ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B * (diagonalCost p).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hw := w.lipschitz (birthPersistence p) (p.1, 0)
  have ht : ‖birthPersistence p - (p.1, 0)‖ = |p.2 - p.1| := by
    simp [birthPersistence, Prod.norm_def, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [w.zero_persistence, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (w.nonneg _), ht] at hw
  have hC : 2 * A ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B := by
    unfold stabilityConstant
    have : 0 ≤ √2 * B / |σ| :=
      div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg 2) hB) (abs_nonneg σ)
    linarith
  rw [weightedFeature, norm_smul, norm_featureAt, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (w.nonneg _)]
  calc
    _ ≤ A * |p.2 - p.1| := hw
    _ = (2 * A) * (diagonalCost p).toReal := by rw [diagonalCost_toReal]; ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.weightedFeature_diagonal
statement:
theorem weightedFeature_diagonal (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (b : ℝ) :
    weightedFeature σ w (b, b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedFeature, show birthPersistence (b, b) = (b, 0) by simp [birthPersistence],
    w.zero_persistence, zero_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_embedding_sub_le_matching
statement:
theorem norm_embedding_sub_le_matching {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (σ : ℝ)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    ‖embedding σ w x - embedding σ w y‖ ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B * M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:=
  M.norm_featureSum_sub_le (weightedFeature σ w) (stabilityConstant σ A B)
    (stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB)
    (fun p q _ _ => norm_weightedFeature_sub_le σ hB w p q)
    (fun p _ => norm_weightedFeature_le_diagonalCost σ hB w p) x y hx hy

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_embedding_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost
statement:
theorem norm_embedding_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost {I J : Type*} [Fintype I]
    [Fintype J] (σ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    ‖embedding σ w x - embedding σ w y‖ ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B * finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
  simpa only [hM] using norm_embedding_sub_le_matching σ hA hB w M x y hx hy

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck
statement:
theorem norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck (σ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hD : D.IsPositive)
    (hE : E.IsPositive) (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    ‖diagramEmbedding σ w D - diagramEmbedding σ w E‖ ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (bottleneck D E).toReal
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B * finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost
        (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1) (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1) :=
      norm_embedding_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost σ hA hB w _ _
        hD.finiteOccurrence hE.finiteOccurrence
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_card_mul_bottleneck D E hfinite)
        (stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.gaussianGram_diagramEmbedding_apply
statement:
theorem gaussianGram_diagramEmbedding_apply {κ : Type*} (σ τ : ℝ)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D : κ → Diagram ℝ) (a b : κ) :
    gaussianGram τ (fun a => diagramEmbedding σ w (D a)) a b =
      gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w (D a) (D b)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.inner_diagramGaussianFeature
statement:
theorem inner_diagramGaussianFeature (σ τ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (D E : Diagram ℝ) :
    ⟪diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w D, diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w E⟫_ℝ =
      gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D E
proof:
:=
  inner_gaussianFeature τ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le (σ τ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (D E : Diagram ℝ) :
    ‖diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w D - diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w E‖ ≤
      ‖diagramEmbedding σ w D - diagramEmbedding σ w E‖ / |τ|
proof:
:=
  norm_gaussianFeature_sub_le τ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le (σ τ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (D E E' : Diagram ℝ) :
    |gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D E - gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D E'| ≤
      ‖diagramEmbedding σ w E - diagramEmbedding σ w E'‖ / |τ|
proof:
:= by
  have h : gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D E - gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D E' =
      ⟪diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w D,
        diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w E - diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w E'⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [inner_sub_right, inner_diagramGaussianFeature, inner_diagramGaussianFeature]
  have hn : ‖diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w D‖ = 1 := norm_gaussianFeature τ _
  rw [h]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w D‖ *
        ‖diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w E - diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w E'‖ :=
      abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ = ‖diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w E - diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w E'‖ := by
      rw [hn, one_mul]
    _ ≤ _ := norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le σ τ w E E'

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_matching
statement:
theorem norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_matching (σ τ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hD : D.IsPositive)
    (hE : E.IsPositive)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :
    ‖diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w D - diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w E‖ ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        M.totalFiniteCost (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
          (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖diagramEmbedding σ w D - diagramEmbedding σ w E‖ / |τ| :=
      norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le σ τ w D E
    _ ≤ (stabilityConstant σ A B * M.totalFiniteCost (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
          (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)) / |τ| :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (norm_embedding_sub_le_matching σ hA hB w M _ _ hD.finiteOccurrence
          hE.finiteOccurrence)
        (abs_nonneg τ)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost
statement:
theorem norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost (σ τ : ℝ)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (hD : D.IsPositive) (hE : E.IsPositive) :
    ‖diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w D - diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w E‖ ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
          (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching
    (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1) (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
  simpa only [hM] using norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_matching σ τ hA hB w D E hD hE M

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_matching
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_matching (σ τ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D E E' : Diagram ℝ) (hE : E.IsPositive)
    (hE' : E'.IsPositive)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching E.finiteOccurrences E'.finiteOccurrences PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :
    |gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D E - gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D E'| ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        M.totalFiniteCost (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
          (fun p : E'.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖diagramEmbedding σ w E - diagramEmbedding σ w E'‖ / |τ| :=
      abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le σ τ w D E E'
    _ ≤ (stabilityConstant σ A B * M.totalFiniteCost (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
          (fun p : E'.finiteOccurrences => p.1)) / |τ| :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (norm_embedding_sub_le_matching σ hA hB w M _ _ hE.finiteOccurrence
          hE'.finiteOccurrence)
        (abs_nonneg τ)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost (σ τ : ℝ)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D E E' : Diagram ℝ)
    (hE : E.IsPositive) (hE' : E'.IsPositive) :
    |gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D E - gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D E'| ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
          (fun p : E'.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching
    (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1) (fun p : E'.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
  simpa only [hM] using abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_matching σ τ hA hB w D E E' hE hE' M

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck
statement:
theorem norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck (σ τ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hD : D.IsPositive)
    (hE : E.IsPositive) (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    ‖diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w D - diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w E‖ ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (bottleneck D E).toReal
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖diagramEmbedding σ w D - diagramEmbedding σ w E‖ / |τ| :=
      norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le σ τ w D E
    _ ≤ (stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (bottleneck D E).toReal) / |τ| :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ hA hB w D E hD hE hfinite)
        (abs_nonneg τ)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck (σ τ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D E E' : Diagram ℝ) (hE : E.IsPositive)
    (hE' : E'.IsPositive) (hfinite : bottleneck E E' < ⊤) :
    |gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D E - gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D E'| ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E'.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (bottleneck E E').toReal
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖diagramEmbedding σ w E - diagramEmbedding σ w E'‖ / |τ| :=
      abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le σ τ w D E E'
    _ ≤ (stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E'.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (bottleneck E E').toReal) / |τ| :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ hA hB w E E' hE hE' hfinite)
        (abs_nonneg τ)
    _ = _ := by ring

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_finiteRestriction_le_card_mul_cost_rpow
statement:
theorem totalFinitePowerCost_finiteRestriction_le_card_mul_cost_rpow
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J E F) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (b : E → ℝ) (c : F → ℝ) :
    M.finiteRestriction.totalFinitePowerCost p x y ≤
      ((Fintype.card I + Fintype.card J : ℕ) : ℝ) * (M.cost x y b c).toReal ^ p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)
  have hfinite := (occurrenceMatching_cost_lt_top x y b c M).ne
  have hs (i : I) :
      (match M.finite i with
        | some j => (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal ^ p
        | none => (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p) ≤ (M.cost x y b c).toReal ^ p := by
    have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono hfinite (M.source_le_cost x y b c i)
    cases hi : M.finite i <;> simp only [hi] at h ⊢ <;>
      exact Real.rpow_le_rpow ENNReal.toReal_nonneg h (zero_le_one.trans hp)
  have ht (j : J) :
      (if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ p) ≤
        (M.cost x y b c).toReal ^ p := by
    have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono hfinite (M.target_le_cost x y b c j)
    have hpow := Real.rpow_le_rpow ENNReal.toReal_nonneg h (zero_le_one.trans hp)
    split_ifs with hj <;>
      simpa only [hj, if_true, if_false, ENNReal.toReal_zero, Real.zero_rpow hp0] using hpow
  unfold totalFinitePowerCost totalBoundaryCost
  change (∑ i, _) + (∑ j, _) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ (∑ _i : I, (M.cost x y b c).toReal ^ p) +
        ∑ _j : J, (M.cost x y b c).toReal ^ p :=
      add_le_add (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hs i))
        (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ => ht j))
    _ = _ := by simp [Nat.cast_add, add_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_le_card_mul_bottleneck_rpow
statement:
theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_le_card_mul_bottleneck_rpow
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    finitePowerMatchingCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤
      ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (bottleneck D E).toReal ^ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (bottleneck_optimal_iff D E).mpr
    ((bottleneck_lt_top_iff D E).mp hfinite)
  calc
    _ ≤ M.finiteRestriction.totalFinitePowerCost p _ _ :=
      finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching p _ _ M.finiteRestriction
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [hM] using M.totalFinitePowerCost_finiteRestriction_le_card_mul_cost_rpow hp
        (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤
      (((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) *
        (bottleneck D E).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)
  have h := Real.rpow_le_rpow (finitePowerMatchingCost_nonneg p _ _)
    (finitePowerMatchingCost_le_card_mul_bottleneck_rpow hp D E hfinite)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (zero_le_one.trans hp))
  simpa only [finitePMatchingCost,
    Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg p),
    Real.rpow_rpow_inv ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hp0] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤
      (((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) *
        (bottleneck D E).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  exact finitePMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck hp D E hfinite

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_of_bottleneck_le
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_of_bottleneck_le
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hB : bottleneck D E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤
      (((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) *
        r
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite := hB.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hreal : (bottleneck D E).toReal ≤ r := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hr] using
      ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hB
  exact (finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck hp D E hfinite).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreal (Real.rpow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _))

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_cardBound_rpow_mul_of_bottleneck_le
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_cardBound_rpow_mul_of_bottleneck_le
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (D E : Diagram ℝ) {m : ℕ}
    (hcard : Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences ≤ m)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hB : bottleneck D E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * r
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences +
      Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast hcard
  exact (finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_of_bottleneck_le hp D E hr hB).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (Real.rpow_le_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hcast (inv_nonneg.mpr (zero_le_one.trans hp))) hr)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.expCharacter_apply
statement:
theorem expCharacter_apply (σ : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ)
    (z : Multiplicative (ℝ × ℝ)) :
    expCharacter σ p z =
      Real.exp ((z.toAdd.1 * p.1 + z.toAdd.2 * p.2) / σ ^ 2)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.expCharacter_injective
statement:
theorem expCharacter_injective {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (expCharacter σ)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq
  have h₁ := congrArg (fun f => f (Multiplicative.ofAdd ((1, 0) : ℝ × ℝ))) hpq
  have h₂ := congrArg (fun f => f (Multiplicative.ofAdd ((0, 1) : ℝ × ℝ))) hpq
  rw [expCharacter_apply, expCharacter_apply, toAdd_ofAdd] at h₁
  rw [expCharacter_apply, expCharacter_apply, toAdd_ofAdd] at h₂
  have hs : σ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hσ
  have hp₁ : p.1 = q.1 := by
    simpa using (div_left_inj' hs).mp (Real.exp_injective h₁)
  have hp₂ : p.2 = q.2 := by
    simpa using (div_left_inj' hs).mp (Real.exp_injective h₂)
  exact Prod.ext hp₁ hp₂

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.gaussFactor_pos
statement: theorem gaussFactor_pos (σ : ℝ) (z : ℝ × ℝ) : 0 < gaussFactor σ z
proof:
:=
  Real.exp_pos _

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.kernel_eq_factor
statement:
theorem kernel_eq_factor (σ : ℝ) (z p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    kernel σ z p = gaussFactor σ z * expCharacter σ p (Multiplicative.ofAdd z) *
      gaussFactor σ p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hσ : σ = 0
  · simp [kernel, gaussFactor, expCharacter, hσ]
  · simp only [kernel, gaussFactor, expCharacter_apply, toAdd_ofAdd]
    rw [← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    field_simp [hσ]
    ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.linearIndependent_kernelFun
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_kernelFun {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => fun z : ℝ × ℝ => kernel σ z p)
proof:
:= by
  have hchars : LinearIndependent ℝ
      (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (expCharacter σ p : Multiplicative (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ)) := by
    exact (linearIndependent_monoidHom (Multiplicative (ℝ × ℝ)) ℝ).comp
      (expCharacter σ) (expCharacter_injective hσ)
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s c hsum p hp
  have hsum' :
      ∑ q ∈ s, (c q * gaussFactor σ q) •
        (expCharacter σ q : Multiplicative (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ) = 0 := by
    funext z
    let z' : ℝ × ℝ := z.toAdd
    have hz := congrFun hsum z'
    have hz' : gaussFactor σ z' *
        (∑ q ∈ s, (c q * gaussFactor σ q) *
          expCharacter σ q (Multiplicative.ofAdd z')) = 0 := by
      calc
        gaussFactor σ z' *
            (∑ q ∈ s, (c q * gaussFactor σ q) *
              expCharacter σ q (Multiplicative.ofAdd z')) =
            ∑ q ∈ s, gaussFactor σ z' *
              ((c q * gaussFactor σ q) *
                expCharacter σ q (Multiplicative.ofAdd z')) := by
                  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        _ = ∑ q ∈ s, c q * kernel σ z' q := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro q hq
          rw [kernel_eq_factor]
          ring
        _ = 0 := by
          simpa only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.zero_apply, smul_eq_mul] using hz
    have hz'' := (mul_eq_zero.mp hz').resolve_left (gaussFactor_pos σ z').ne'
    simpa only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.zero_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, ofAdd_toAdd, z'] using hz''
  have hcoeff := (linearIndependent_iff'.mp hchars) s
    (fun q => c q * gaussFactor σ q) hsum' p hp
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hcoeff).resolve_right (gaussFactor_pos σ p).ne'

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.linearIndependent_featureAt
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_featureAt {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (featureAt σ)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearIndependent.of_comp
    ((RKHS.coeCLM ℝ : Space σ →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)).toLinearMap)
  have h : ((RKHS.coeCLM ℝ : Space σ →L[ℝ] (ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)).toLinearMap ∘
      featureAt σ) = fun p z => kernel σ z p := by
    funext p z
    exact featureAt_apply σ p z
  rw [h]
  exact linearIndependent_kernelFun hσ

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.featureAt_sum_ne_zero
statement:
theorem featureAt_sum_ne_zero {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) {x : ℝ × ℝ →₀ ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    (x.sum fun p a => a • featureAt σ p) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  apply hx
  exact (linearIndependent_iff_injective_finsuppLinearCombination.mp
    (linearIndependent_featureAt hσ)) (by
      simpa [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply] using hzero)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posDef_kernel
statement:
theorem posDef_kernel {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) :
    (Matrix.of (kernel σ) : Matrix (ℝ × ℝ) (ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(posSemidef_kernel σ).isHermitian, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hquad :
      x.sum (fun p a => x.sum (fun q b => star a *
        (Matrix.of (kernel σ) : Matrix (ℝ × ℝ) (ℝ × ℝ) ℝ) p q * b)) =
        ⟪x.sum (fun p a => a • featureAt σ p),
          x.sum (fun q b => b • featureAt σ q)⟫_ℝ := by
    simp only [Finsupp.sum, sum_inner, inner_sum, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_smul_right, Matrix.of_apply, star_trivial]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => by
      simp only [inner_featureAt, kernel_symm]
      ring
  rw [hquad]
  exact real_inner_self_pos.mpr (featureAt_sum_ne_zero hσ hx)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posDef_kernel_family
proof:
:= by
  exact (posDef_kernel hσ).submatrix hx

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.measureEmbedding_apply
statement:
theorem measureEmbedding_apply (σ : ℝ) (μ : ℝ × ℝ →₀ ℝ) (z : ℝ × ℝ) :
    measureEmbedding σ μ z = μ.sum fun p c => c * kernel σ z p
proof:
:= by
  rw [measureEmbedding, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
    ← RKHS.coeCLM_apply (𝕜 := ℝ), map_finsuppSum]
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, RKHS.coeCLM_apply, Pi.smul_apply, featureAt_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.measureEmbedding_single
statement:
theorem measureEmbedding_single (σ : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    measureEmbedding σ (Finsupp.single p c) = c • featureAt σ p
proof:
:= by
  simp [measureEmbedding, Finsupp.linearCombination_single]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.measureEmbedding_injective
statement:
theorem measureEmbedding_injective {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0) :
    Function.Injective (measureEmbedding σ)
proof:
:= by
  change Function.Injective (Finsupp.linearCombination ℝ (featureAt σ))
  exact linearIndependent_iff_injective_finsuppLinearCombination.mp
    (linearIndependent_featureAt hσ)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_measureEmbedding_sub_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem norm_measureEmbedding_sub_eq_zero_iff {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    {μ ν : ℝ × ℝ →₀ ℝ} :
    ‖measureEmbedding σ μ - measureEmbedding σ ν‖ = 0 ↔ μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact measureEmbedding_injective hσ (norm_sub_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
  · intro h
    subst ν
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.multiset_sum_single_apply
statement:
private theorem multiset_sum_single_apply {s : Multiset (ℝ × ℝ)}
    (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ((s.map fun p => Finsupp.single p (f p)).sum) q =
      (s.count q : ℝ) * f q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons a s ih =>
    simp only [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, Finsupp.add_apply,
      Finsupp.single_apply, Multiset.count_cons]
    by_cases h : q = a
    · subst q
      simp [ih]
      ring
    · simp [h, ih]
      intro h'
      exact absurd h'.symm h

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.weightedMeasure_apply
statement:
theorem weightedMeasure_apply {A B : ℝ} (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (D : Diagram ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    weightedMeasure w D p =
      ((finitePart D.points).count p : ℝ) * w (birthPersistence p)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [weightedMeasure] using
    multiset_sum_single_apply (s := finitePart D.points)
      (fun q => w (birthPersistence q)) p

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding_eq_measureEmbedding
statement:
theorem diagramEmbedding_eq_measureEmbedding {A B : ℝ} (σ : ℝ)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    diagramEmbedding σ w D = measureEmbedding σ (weightedMeasure w D)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagramEmbedding_eq_sum, weightedMeasure, measureEmbedding, map_multiset_sum]
  simp only [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_apply, Finsupp.linearCombination_single]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding_eq_iff_weightedMeasure_eq
statement:
theorem diagramEmbedding_eq_iff_weightedMeasure_eq {A B σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (D E : Diagram ℝ) :
    diagramEmbedding σ w D = diagramEmbedding σ w E ↔
      weightedMeasure w D = weightedMeasure w E
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagramEmbedding_eq_measureEmbedding, diagramEmbedding_eq_measureEmbedding]
  constructor
  · exact fun h => measureEmbedding_injective hσ h
  · intro h
    exact congrArg (measureEmbedding σ) h

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding_eq_iff
statement:
theorem diagramEmbedding_eq_iff {A B σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) {D E : Diagram ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ p ∈ finitePart D.points, 0 < w (birthPersistence p))
    (hE : ∀ p ∈ finitePart E.points, 0 < w (birthPersistence p)) :
    diagramEmbedding σ w D = diagramEmbedding σ w E ↔
      finitePart D.points = finitePart E.points
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hm : weightedMeasure w D = weightedMeasure w E :=
      (diagramEmbedding_eq_iff_weightedMeasure_eq hσ w D E).mp h
    apply Multiset.ext'
    intro p
    by_cases hpD : p ∈ finitePart D.points
    · have hc := congrArg (fun μ : ℝ × ℝ →₀ ℝ => μ p) hm
      rw [weightedMeasure_apply, weightedMeasure_apply] at hc
      have hcount : (finitePart D.points).count p =
          (finitePart E.points).count p :=
        Nat.cast_injective (mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (hD p hpD)) hc)
      exact hcount
    · by_cases hpE : p ∈ finitePart E.points
      · have hc := congrArg (fun μ : ℝ × ℝ →₀ ℝ => μ p) hm
        rw [weightedMeasure_apply, weightedMeasure_apply] at hc
        have hcount : (finitePart D.points).count p =
            (finitePart E.points).count p :=
          Nat.cast_injective (mul_right_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (hE p hpE)) hc)
        exact hcount
      · rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr hpD, Multiset.count_eq_zero.mpr hpE]
  · intro h
    apply (diagramEmbedding_eq_iff_weightedMeasure_eq hσ w D E).2
    unfold weightedMeasure
    rw [h]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.finitePart_mem_isPositive
statement:
private theorem finitePart_mem_isPositive {D : Diagram ℝ} (hD : D.IsPositive)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ finitePart D.points) : p.1 < p.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨b, d⟩, hbd, he⟩ := (Multiset.mem_filterMap _ _).mp hp
  cases d with
  | top => simp at he
  | coe d =>
    have hpos := hD (b, (d : WithTop ℝ)) hbd
    simp at he
    rw [← he]
    simpa using hpos

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding_eq_iff_of_isPositive
statement:
theorem diagramEmbedding_eq_iff_of_isPositive {A B σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (hw : ∀ u : ℝ × ℝ, 0 < u.2 → 0 < w u) {D E : Diagram ℝ}
    (hD : D.IsPositive) (hE : E.IsPositive) :
    diagramEmbedding σ w D = diagramEmbedding σ w E ↔
      finitePart D.points = finitePart E.points
proof:
:= by
  apply diagramEmbedding_eq_iff hσ w
  · intro p hp
    exact hw (birthPersistence p)
      (birthPersistence_snd_pos (finitePart_mem_isPositive hD hp))
  · intro p hp
    exact hw (birthPersistence p)
      (birthPersistence_snd_pos (finitePart_mem_isPositive hE hp))

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.eq_of_diagramEmbedding_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_diagramEmbedding_eq {A B σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) {D E : Diagram ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ p ∈ finitePart D.points, 0 < w (birthPersistence p))
    (hE : ∀ p ∈ finitePart E.points, 0 < w (birthPersistence p))
    (hess : essentialPart D.points = essentialPart E.points)
    (h : diagramEmbedding σ w D = diagramEmbedding σ w E) : D = E
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  calc
    D.points = (finitePart D.points).map (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop ℝ))) +
        (essentialPart D.points).map (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))) :=
      (parts_reconstruct D.points).symm
    _ = (finitePart E.points).map (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop ℝ))) +
        (essentialPart E.points).map (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))) := by
      rw [(diagramEmbedding_eq_iff hσ w hD hE).mp h, hess]
    _ = E.points := parts_reconstruct E.points

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.dist_diagramEmbedding_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem dist_diagramEmbedding_eq_zero_iff {A B σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) {D E : Diagram ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ p ∈ finitePart D.points, 0 < w (birthPersistence p))
    (hE : ∀ p ∈ finitePart E.points, 0 < w (birthPersistence p)) :
    ‖diagramEmbedding σ w D - diagramEmbedding σ w E‖ = 0 ↔
      finitePart D.points = finitePart E.points
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (diagramEmbedding_eq_iff hσ w hD hE).mp
      (norm_sub_eq_zero_iff.mp h)
  · intro h
    rw [norm_sub_eq_zero_iff]
    exact (diagramEmbedding_eq_iff hσ w hD hE).mpr h

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleDiagramComparisonExamples.ripsEdge_values
statement:
private theorem ripsEdge_values :
    ripsEdge.value edge_v0 = 0 ∧

      ripsEdge.value edge_e01 = 2
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).value edge_v0 = 0 := by
    change Rips.diameter TwoPoints.metric ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) = 0
    simp
  have h1 : (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).value edge_v1 = 0 := by
    change Rips.diameter TwoPoints.metric ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) = 0
    simp
  have he : (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).value edge_e01 = 2 := by
    change Rips.diameter TwoPoints.metric ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2)) = 2
    rw [Rips.diameter_pair, TwoPoints.metric_dist, TwoPoints.dist_pts]

private theorem ripsEdge_dgm (n : ℕ) :

proof:
:= by

      (Rips.fullComplexFintype : Fintype (TotalFace edgeK)) :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  exact congrArg (fun I => @dgm (Fin 2) _ (ZMod 2) _ ℝ _ edgeK I ripsEdge n) hI

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleDiagramComparisonExamples.ripsEdge_map_value
proof:
:= by
  rcases edge_face_cases s with h0 | h1 | he
  · change Rips.diameter TwoPoints.metric s.val = _
    rw [h0]
    simp
  · change Rips.diameter TwoPoints.metric s.val = _
    rw [h1]
    simp
  · change Rips.diameter TwoPoints.metric s.val = _
    rw [he]
    change Rips.diameter TwoPoints.metric ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2)) = 2
    rw [Rips.diameter_pair, TwoPoints.metric_dist, TwoPoints.dist_pts]

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleDiagramComparisonExamples.twoPoints_rips_dgm_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ripsEdge_dgm 0]
  let φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => if x ≤ 5 then 0 else 2
  have hφ : MonotoneOn φ (Set.range edgeFilter.value) := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    by_cases ha5 : a ≤ 5
    · by_cases hb5 : b ≤ 5 <;> simp [φ, ha5, hb5]
    · have hb5 : ¬ b ≤ 5 := fun hb' => ha5 (hab.trans hb')
      simp [φ, ha5, hb5]
  have hvalue : ∀ s, ripsEdge.value s = φ (edgeFilter.value s) := by
    intro s
    change (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).value s = φ (edgeFilter.value s)
    rw [ripsEdge_map_value]
    rcases edge_face_cases s with h0 | h1 | he
    · simp [edgeFilter, φ, h0] ; norm_num
    · simp [edgeFilter, φ, h1]
    · simp [edgeFilter, φ, he, Finset.ext_iff] ; norm_num
  rw [dgm_points_map_of_monotoneOn (ZMod 2) edgeFilter ripsEdge φ hφ hvalue 0]
  rw [edge_points]
  norm_num [φ, Multiset.filter_singleton]

    monotone_const.monotoneOn _
  have hvalue : ∀ s, constEdge.value s = φ (edgeFilter.value s) := by
    intro s
    rfl
  rw [dgm_points_map_of_monotoneOn (ZMod 2) edgeFilter constEdge φ hφ hvalue 0]
  rw [edge_points]
  norm_num [φ, Multiset.filter_singleton]

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleDiagramComparisonExamples.twoPoint_sublevel_card_le_one
statement:
private theorem twoPoint_sublevel_card_le_one
    (f : FilterFunction (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 2)) ℝ) {t : ℝ}
    (hedge : ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∉ f.sublevel t) :
    ∀ s ∈ f.sublevel t, s.card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  have hsK := (f.sublevel_le t) hs
  change s.Nonempty at hsK
  by_contra hcard
  have hle : s.card ≤ Fintype.card (Fin 2) := Finset.card_le_univ s
  have hscard : s.card = 2 := by
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hle
    omega
  have hfull : s = ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2)) := by
    simpa only [Finset.univ_fin2] using (Finset.eq_univ_of_card s hscard)
  apply hedge
  rw [← hfull]
  exact hs

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleDiagramComparisonExamples.twoPoint_sublevel_eq_full
statement:
private theorem twoPoint_sublevel_eq_full
    (f : FilterFunction (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 2)) ℝ) {t : ℝ}
    (hedge : ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ f.sublevel t) :
    f.sublevel t = Rips.fullComplex (Fin 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (f.sublevel_le t)
  intro s hs
  change s.Nonempty at hs
  have hsub : s ⊆ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2)) := by
    rw [← Finset.univ_fin2]
    exact Finset.subset_univ s
  exact ((f.sublevel t).isRelLowerSet_faces hedge).2 hsub hs

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleDiagramComparisonExamples.twoPoint_full_isZero
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hn1 : n = 1
  · subst n
    let A := twoPointEdgeAttachment
    have hq : A.attachingQuotientClass k ≠ 0 := by
      intro hq
      apply A.attachingClass_ne_zero_of_no_old_coface k
      apply (homologyKernelQuotient k
        (simplicialChainComplex twoPointVertices k) 0).toLinearEquiv.injective
      rw [A.attachingHomologyClass_equiv k, hq]
      exact ((homologyKernelQuotient k
        (simplicialChainComplex twoPointVertices k) 0).toLinearEquiv.map_zero).symm
    have hbij := A.homologyIncl_bijective_of_attachingClass_ne_zero k hq
    have hsource : IsZero (simplicialHomology twoPointVertices k 1) :=
      isZero_simplicialHomology_of_card_le_one k
        (by
          intro s hs
          change s.card = 1 at hs
          exact hs.le) le_rfl
    letI : Subsingleton (simplicialHomology twoPointVertices k 1) :=
      ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hsource
    letI : Subsingleton (simplicialHomology (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 2)) k 1) :=
      ⟨fun x y => by
        obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hbij.2 x
        obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := hbij.2 y
        exact hx'.symm.trans
          ((congrArg (fun z => (simplicialHomologyIncl k A.inclusion 1).hom z)
            (Subsingleton.elim x' y')).trans hy')⟩
    exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _
  · have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by omega
    letI : IsEmpty (Face (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 2)) n) :=
      ⟨fun σ => by
        have hcard := Finset.card_le_univ σ.1
        simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
        have hdeg := σ.2.2
        omega⟩
    exact isZero_simplicialHomology_of_isEmpty_face k n

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleDiagramComparisonExamples.twoPoint_sublevel_isZero
statement:
private theorem twoPoint_sublevel_isZero (k : Type) [Field k]
    (f : FilterFunction (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 2)) ℝ) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) (t : ℝ) :
    IsZero (simplicialHomology (f.sublevel t) k n)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hedge : ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ f.sublevel t
  · rw [twoPoint_sublevel_eq_full f hedge]
    exact twoPoint_full_isZero k hn
  · exact isZero_simplicialHomology_of_card_le_one k
      (twoPoint_sublevel_card_le_one f hedge) hn

name: TDA.Persistence.LogScaleDiagramComparisonExamples.twoPoints_bottleneck_zero
statement:
theorem twoPoints_bottleneck_zero :
    bottleneck (dgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric) 0)
        (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts) 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x : Fin 1 → ℝ × ℝ := fun _ => (0, 2)
  let y : Fin 1 → ℝ × ℝ := fun _ => (0, 1)
  let b : Fin 1 → ℝ := fun _ => 0
  let c : Fin 1 → ℝ := fun _ => 0
  have hx : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map x =
      finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric) 0).points := by
    simp [finitePart, x, twoPoints_rips_dgm_zero] ; rfl
  have hy : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map y =
      finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts) 0).points := by
    simp [finitePart, y, twoPoints_cech_dgm_zero] ; rfl
  have hb : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map b =
      essentialPart (dgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric) 0).points := by
    simp [essentialPart, b, twoPoints_rips_dgm_zero] ; rfl
  have hc : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map c =
      essentialPart (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts) 0).points := by
    simp [essentialPart, c, twoPoints_cech_dgm_zero] ; rfl
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation _ _ x y b c hx hy hb hc]
  apply le_antisymm
  · let M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 1) (Fin 1) (Fin 1) (Fin 1) :=
      ⟨fun _ => none, by simp, Equiv.refl _⟩
    have hcost : M.cost x y b c = 1 := by
      simp [OccurrenceMatching.cost, M, x, y, b, c, diagonalCost,
        essentialPairCost]
    exact (presentationBottleneck_le_cost x y b c M).trans_eq hcost
  · unfold presentationBottleneck
    apply le_iInf
    intro M
    have hsource := M.source_le_cost x y b c 0
    cases h : M.finite 0 with
    | none =>
        calc
          1 = diagonalCost (x 0) := by norm_num [x, diagonalCost]
          _ ≤ M.cost x y b c := by simpa [h] using hsource
    | some j =>
        have hj : j = 0 := Fin.eq_zero j
        subst j
        calc
          1 = finitePairCost (x 0) (y 0) := by norm_num [x, y, finitePairCost]
          _ ≤ M.cost x y b c := by simpa [h] using hsource

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.scaledBars_bottleneck

private theorem scaledBars_bottleneck (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    bottleneck (scaledBars n a) empty = ENNReal.ofReal a
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (scaledBars n a).finiteOccurrences :=
    Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by rw [scaledBars_card n ha]; exact hn)
  unfold empty
  rw [bottleneck_finite_only_empty _ (scaledBars_essentialPart n a)]
  simp only [scaledBars_coordinates n ha, scaled_diagonal ha]
  exact Finset.sup_const Finset.univ_nonempty _

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.scaledBars_matching
statement:
private theorem scaledBars_matching (n : ℕ) {a p : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    matching p (scaledBars n a) empty = (n : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * a
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)
  unfold matching
  rw [finitePMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right]
  simp only [scaledBars_coordinates n ha, scaled_diagonal ha, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal ha.le,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, scaledBars_card n ha, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg ha.le _),
    Real.rpow_rpow_inv ha.le hp0]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.scaledBars_transport
statement:
private theorem scaledBars_transport (n : ℕ) {a p : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    transport p (scaledBars n a) empty = (n : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * a
proof:
:= by
  rw [transport, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  exact scaledBars_matching n ha hp

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.nonempty_zero_radius
statement:
private theorem nonempty_zero_radius {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    Fintype.card (scaledBars 1 1).finiteOccurrences = 1 ∧
    (scaledBars 1 1, scaledBars 1 1) ∈ budgetSet 2 0 ∧
    matching p (scaledBars 1 1) (scaledBars 1 1) = 0 ∧
    transport p (scaledBars 1 1) (scaledBars 1 1) = 0 ∧ uniformLimits 2 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨scaledBars_card 1 (by norm_num), ?_, finitePMatchingCost_self hp _,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_self hp _, uniform_limits 2 (le_refl 0)⟩
  exact ⟨scaledBars_essentialPart 1 1, scaledBars_essentialPart 1 1,
    by norm_num [scaledBars_card 1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)], by simp [bottleneck_self]⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.zero_budget_error_bounds
statement:
private theorem zero_budget_error_bounds {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    |matching p empty empty - (bottleneck empty empty).toReal| ≤ 0 ∧
    |transport p empty empty - (bottleneck empty empty).toReal| ≤ 0 ∧
    |matching p (scaledBars 1 1) (scaledBars 1 1) -
      (bottleneck (scaledBars 1 1) (scaledBars 1 1)).toReal| ≤ 0 ∧
    |transport p (scaledBars 1 1) (scaledBars 1 1) -
      (bottleneck (scaledBars 1 1) (scaledBars 1 1)).toReal| ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have he := (empty_zero_budget hp).1
  have hs := (nonempty_zero_radius hp).2.1
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound hp empty empty
      he.1 he.2.1 he.2.2.1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) he.2.2.2
  · simpa using finitePBoundaryTransportCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound hp empty empty
      he.1 he.2.1 he.2.2.1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) he.2.2.2
  · simpa using finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound hp _ _
      hs.1 hs.2.1 hs.2.2.1 (le_refl (0 : ℝ)) hs.2.2.2
  · simpa using finitePBoundaryTransportCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound hp _ _
      hs.1 hs.2.1 hs.2.2.1 (le_refl (0 : ℝ)) hs.2.2.2

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.repeated_sharp
statement:
private theorem repeated_sharp {R p : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (scaledBars 2 R, empty) ∈ budgetSet 2 R ∧
    |matching p (scaledBars 2 R) empty - (bottleneck (scaledBars 2 R) empty).toReal| =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1) * R ∧
    |transport p (scaledBars 2 R) empty - (bottleneck (scaledBars 2 R) empty).toReal| =
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1) * R ∧ uniformLimits 2 R
proof:
:= by
  have hB := scaledBars_bottleneck 2 (by norm_num) hR
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ((2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1) * R :=
    mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.one_le_rpow (by norm_num)
      (inv_nonneg.mpr (zero_le_one.trans hp)))) hR.le
  have heq : (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * R - R = ((2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1) * R := by ring
  refine ⟨⟨scaledBars_essentialPart 2 R, empty_essentialPart,
    by norm_num [scaledBars_card 2 hR, empty_card], hB.le⟩, ?_, ?_, uniform_limits 2 hR.le⟩ <;>
    simp only [scaledBars_matching 2 hR hp, scaledBars_transport 2 hR hp,
      Nat.cast_ofNat, hB, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hR.le, heq, abs_of_nonneg hnonneg]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.repeated_three_halves
statement:
private theorem repeated_three_halves {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    |matching (3 / 2) (scaledBars 2 R) empty -
      (bottleneck (scaledBars 2 R) empty).toReal| = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) - 1) * R ∧
    |transport (3 / 2) (scaledBars 2 R) empty -
      (bottleneck (scaledBars 2 R) empty).toReal| = ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) - 1) * R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · convert (repeated_sharp hR (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2)).2.1 using 1
    norm_num
  · convert (repeated_sharp hR (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2)).2.2.1 using 1
    norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.singleBar_finitePart

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.singleBar_coordinates

private theorem singleBar_coordinates (b : ℝ) (q : (singleBar b).finiteOccurrences) :
    q.1 = ((b, b + 2) : ℝ × ℝ)
proof:

    (by simpa only [singleBar_finitePart] using (Multiset.coe_mem (x := q)))

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.singleBar_matching_reindex
statement:
private theorem singleBar_matching_reindex (p b c : ℝ) :
    matching p (singleBar b) (singleBar c) =
      finitePMatchingCost p (fun _ : Fin 1 => (b, b + 2))
        (fun _ : Fin 1 => (c, c + 2))
proof:
:= by
  let u := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (singleBar_card b)).symm
  let v := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (singleBar_card c)).symm
  simpa only [matching, Function.comp_def, singleBar_coordinates] using
    (finitePMatchingCost_reindex u v p (fun q : (singleBar b).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
      (fun q : (singleBar c).finiteOccurrences => q.1)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.switch_bottleneck
statement: private theorem switch_bottleneck : bottleneck (singleBar 0) (singleBar (3 / 2)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hf (b : ℝ) : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map (fun _ => (b, b + 2)) =
      finitePart (singleBar b).points := by simp [singleBar_finitePart]
  have he (b : ℝ) : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) =
      essentialPart (singleBar b).points := by simp [singleBar_essentialPart]
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation _ _ _ _ _ _ (hf 0) (hf (3 / 2)) (he 0) (he (3 / 2))]
  let delete : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 1) (Fin 1) (Fin 0) (Fin 0) :=
    ⟨fun _ => none, by simp, Equiv.refl _⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · calc
      _ ≤ delete.cost (fun _ => (0, 0 + 2)) (fun _ => (3 / 2, 3 / 2 + 2))
          Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 := iInf_le _ delete
      _ = 1 := by
        norm_num [delete, OccurrenceMatching.cost, diagonalCost]
        simp
  · apply le_iInf
    intro M
    have hs := M.source_le_cost (fun _ => (0, 0 + 2))
      (fun _ => (3 / 2, 3 / 2 + 2)) Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 0
    cases h : M.finite 0 with
    | none => simpa [h, diagonalCost] using hs
    | some j =>
      have : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ finitePairCost ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ) (3 / 2, 3 / 2 + 2) := by
        norm_num [finitePairCost]
      exact this.trans (by simpa [h] using hs)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.optimizer_change_in_budget
statement:
private theorem optimizer_change_in_budget :
    (singleBar 0, singleBar (3 / 2)) ∈ budgetSet 2 1 ∧
    matching 1 (singleBar 0) (singleBar (3 / 2)) = 3 / 2 ∧
    transport 1 (singleBar 0) (singleBar (3 / 2)) = 3 / 2 ∧
    matching 2 (singleBar 0) (singleBar (3 / 2)) = Real.sqrt 2 ∧
    transport 2 (singleBar 0) (singleBar (3 / 2)) = Real.sqrt 2 ∧
    FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.pairSingletons.totalFinitePowerCost 1
      (fun _ => (0, 2)) (fun _ => (3 / 2, 7 / 2)) = 3 / 2 ∧
    FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.pairSingletons.totalFinitePowerCost 2
      (fun _ => (0, 2)) (fun _ => (3 / 2, 7 / 2)) = 9 / 4 ∧
    (FiniteBoundaryPlan.zero : FiniteBoundaryPlan (Fin 1) (Fin 1)).powerCost 2
      (fun _ => (0, 2)) (fun _ => (3 / 2, 7 / 2)) = 2 ∧
    (FiniteBoundaryPlan.zero : FiniteBoundaryPlan (Fin 1) (Fin 1)).powerCost 1
      (fun _ => (0, 2)) (fun _ => (3 / 2, 7 / 2)) = 2 ∧
    (3 / 2 : ℝ) < 2 ∧ (2 : ℝ) < 9 / 4 ∧ uniformLimits 2 1
proof:
:= by
  have hm1 : matching 1 (singleBar 0) (singleBar (3 / 2)) = 3 / 2 := by
    rw [singleBar_matching_reindex, finitePMatchingCost,
      ← finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
    norm_num only [zero_add, show (3 / 2 : ℝ) + 2 = 7 / 2 by norm_num,
      FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.switch_power_one, inv_one, Real.rpow_one]
  have hm2 : matching 2 (singleBar 0) (singleBar (3 / 2)) = Real.sqrt 2 := by
    rw [singleBar_matching_reindex]
    norm_num [finitePMatchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_singleton, finitePairCost,
      diagonalCost, Real.rpow_two, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  have ht1 : transport 1 (singleBar 0) (singleBar (3 / 2)) = 3 / 2 := by
    rw [transport, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]; exact hm1
  have ht2 : transport 2 (singleBar 0) (singleBar (3 / 2)) = Real.sqrt 2 := by
    rw [transport, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]; exact hm2
  refine ⟨⟨singleBar_essentialPart 0, singleBar_essentialPart _,
    by rw [singleBar_card, singleBar_card],
    by simp [switch_bottleneck]⟩, hm1, ht1, hm2, ht2,
    ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, by norm_num, by norm_num, uniform_limits 2 (by norm_num)⟩
  · norm_num [FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.pairSingletons,
      OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost,
      finitePairCost, diagonalCost]
  · norm_num [FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.pairSingletons,
      OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost,
      finitePairCost, diagonalCost, Real.rpow_two]
  · simpa only [FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.switch_power_two] using
      FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.deleting_both_optimal_at_two
  · norm_num [FiniteBoundaryPlan.powerCost, FiniteBoundaryPlan.linearCost,
      FiniteBoundaryPlan.zero, FiniteBoundaryPlan.deletionMass, FiniteBoundaryPlan.insertionMass,
      finitePairCost, diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.missing_count
statement:
private theorem missing_count (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    essentialPart (scaledBars (2 ^ n) 1).points = 0 ∧
    Fintype.card (scaledBars (2 ^ n) 1).finiteOccurrences = 2 ^ n ∧
    bottleneck (scaledBars (2 ^ n) 1) empty = 1 ∧
    matching (n : ℝ) (scaledBars (2 ^ n) 1) empty = 2 ∧
    transport (n : ℝ) (scaledBars (2 ^ n) 1) empty = 2 ∧
    |matching (n : ℝ) (scaledBars (2 ^ n) 1) empty -
      (bottleneck (scaledBars (2 ^ n) 1) empty).toReal| = 1 ∧
    |transport (n : ℝ) (scaledBars (2 ^ n) 1) empty -
      (bottleneck (scaledBars (2 ^ n) 1) empty).toReal| = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hN : 0 < (2 : ℕ) ^ n := pow_pos (by norm_num) _
  have hB : bottleneck (scaledBars (2 ^ n) 1) empty = 1 := by
    simpa using scaledBars_bottleneck (2 ^ n) hN (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)
  have hpow : (((2 : ℕ) ^ n : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (n : ℝ)⁻¹ = 2 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    exact Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast (by norm_num) (by omega)
  have hm : matching (n : ℝ) (scaledBars (2 ^ n) 1) empty = 2 := by
    rw [scaledBars_matching _ (by norm_num) hp, hpow, mul_one]
  have ht : transport (n : ℝ) (scaledBars (2 ^ n) 1) empty = 2 := by
    rw [transport, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
    exact hm
  exact ⟨scaledBars_essentialPart _ _, scaledBars_card _ (by norm_num), hB, hm, ht,
    by norm_num [hm, hB], by norm_num [ht, hB]⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.missing_count_exponents_cofinal
statement:
private theorem missing_count_exponents_cofinal :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ)) atTop atTop
proof: := tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.missing_radius
statement:
private theorem missing_radius {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    let a := ((2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1)⁻¹
    0 < a ∧ essentialPart (scaledBars 2 a).points = 0 ∧
    Fintype.card (scaledBars 2 a).finiteOccurrences = 2 ∧
    bottleneck (scaledBars 2 a) empty = ENNReal.ofReal a ∧
    matching p (scaledBars 2 a) empty = (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * a ∧
    transport p (scaledBars 2 a) empty = (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * a ∧
    |matching p (scaledBars 2 a) empty - (bottleneck (scaledBars 2 a) empty).toReal| = 1 ∧
    |transport p (scaledBars 2 a) empty - (bottleneck (scaledBars 2 a) empty).toReal| = 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have hgap : 0 < (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1 :=
    sub_pos.mpr (Real.one_lt_rpow (by norm_num)
      (inv_pos.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)))
  have ha := inv_pos.mpr hgap
  have herr : ((2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1) * ((2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1)⁻¹ = 1 :=
    mul_inv_cancel₀ hgap.ne'
  have hsub : (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * ((2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1)⁻¹ -
      ((2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1)⁻¹ = 1 := by nlinarith only [herr]
  refine ⟨ha, scaledBars_essentialPart 2 _, scaledBars_card 2 ha,
    scaledBars_bottleneck 2 (by norm_num) ha, scaledBars_matching 2 ha hp,
    scaledBars_transport 2 ha hp, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    simp only [scaledBars_matching 2 ha hp, scaledBars_transport 2 ha hp,
      scaledBars_bottleneck 2 (by norm_num) ha, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal ha.le,
      Nat.cast_ofNat, hsub, abs_one]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePBottleneckUniformLimitExamples.essential_negative_control
statement:
private theorem essential_negative_control {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    let D := FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth 0
    let E := FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth 1
    Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences = 0 ∧
    Fintype.card D.essentialOccurrences = 1 ∧ Fintype.card E.essentialOccurrences = 1 ∧
    bottleneck D E = 1 ∧ matching p D E = 0 ∧ transport p D E = 0 ∧
    |matching p D E - (bottleneck D E).toReal| = 1 ∧
    |transport p D E - (bottleneck D E).toReal| = 1
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  obtain ⟨hm, hB⟩ := FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essential_births_zero_one hp
  have ht := hm
  rw [← finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] at ht
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, hB, hm, ht, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change Fintype.card (finitePart (FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth 0).points) +
      Fintype.card (finitePart (FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth 1).points) = 0
    rw [Multiset.card_coe, Multiset.card_coe]
    simp [FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth, finitePart_orderedQ]
  · change Fintype.card (essentialPart (FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth 0).points) = 1
    rw [Multiset.card_coe]
    simp [FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth, essentialPart_orderedQ]
  · change Fintype.card (essentialPart (FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth 1).points) = 1
    rw [Multiset.card_coe]
    simp [FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth, essentialPart_orderedQ]
  · norm_num [matching, hm, hB]
  · norm_num [transport, ht, hB]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelExamples.pair_posSemidef

proof:
:=
  posSemidef_kernel_family 1 pair

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelExamples.pair_quadratic
statement:
theorem pair_quadratic :
    star alternating ⬝ᵥ ((Matrix.of fun i j => kernel 1 (pair i) (pair j)) *ᵥ alternating) =
      2 - 2 * Real.exp (-1 / 2) ∧
    0 ≤ star alternating ⬝ᵥ
      ((Matrix.of fun i j => kernel 1 (pair i) (pair j)) *ᵥ alternating) ∧
    0 < 2 - 2 * Real.exp (-1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h : star alternating ⬝ᵥ
      ((Matrix.of fun i j => kernel 1 (pair i) (pair j)) *ᵥ alternating) =
        2 - 2 * Real.exp (-1 / 2) := by
    simp [dotProduct, mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, pair, alternating, kernel_adjacent,
      kernel_adjacent']
    ring
  exact ⟨h, pair_posSemidef.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg _, by linarith [exp_neg_half_lt_one]⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelExamples.flipped_quadratic
statement:
theorem flipped_quadratic :
    star alternating ⬝ᵥ (flipped *ᵥ alternating) = 2 - 2 * Real.exp (1 / 2) ∧
      2 - 2 * Real.exp (1 / 2) < 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp [dotProduct, mulVec, Fin.sum_univ_two, pair, alternating, flipped]
    norm_num
    ring
  · linarith [Real.add_one_lt_exp (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 by norm_num)]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelExamples.flipped_not_posSemidef
statement: theorem flipped_not_posSemidef : ¬ flipped.PosSemidef
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have h0 := h.dotProduct_mulVec_nonneg alternating
  obtain ⟨he, hneg⟩ := flipped_quadratic
  rw [he] at h0
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelExamples.single_distance
statement:
theorem single_distance :
    ‖embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 2)) - embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 3))‖ ^ 2 =
      2 - 2 * Real.exp (-1 / 2) ∧
    ‖embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 2)) -
      embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 3))‖ ^ 2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : ‖embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 2)) -
      embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 3))‖ ^ 2 = 2 - 2 * Real.exp (-1 / 2) := by
    rw [norm_embedding_sub_sq]
    simp [linearKernel, single, weight_two, weight_three, kernel_adjacent]
    ring
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  rw [h]
  linarith [exp_neg_half_lt_one]

      embedding 1 clippedWeight (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) = 0
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelExamples.singletonDiagram_embedding
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagramEmbedding_eq_sum]
  have hp : finitePart (singletonDiagram b d h).points = {(b, d)} := rfl
  rw [hp, Multiset.map_singleton, Multiset.sum_singleton]
  simp [embedding, finiteFeatureSum, single]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelExamples.gaussianDiagramGram_consumer
statement:
theorem gaussianDiagramGram_consumer :

      gaussianGram 1 (fun a => diagramEmbedding 1 clippedWeight (diagrams a)) 0 1 =
        Real.exp (-(2 - 2 * Real.exp (-1 / 2)) / 2)
proof:

    Matrix.cons_val_one, singletonDiagram_embedding, single_distance.1]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.transition_double_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem transition_double_eq_zero (A : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ)
    (h : ∀ t, structureMap A (show t ≤ (t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) from
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg).trans
        (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg)) = 0) :
    transition (ε + ε) A = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  have he : structureMap A (le_add_of_nonneg_right (NNReal.coe_nonneg (ε + ε))) =
        structureMap A (show t ≤ (t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) from
          (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg).trans
            (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg)) ≫
          A.map (eqToHom (show (t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) =
            t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) by simp [add_assoc])) := by
      change A.map _ = A.map _ ≫ A.map _
      rw [← A.map_comp]
      congr 1
  change structureMap A (le_add_of_nonneg_right (NNReal.coe_nonneg (ε + ε))) = 0
  rw [he, h t, zero_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.kernel_transition_eq_zero
statement:
theorem kernel_transition_eq_zero (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    transition (ε + ε) (kernel i.φ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply transition_double_eq_zero
  intro t
  let h : t ≤ (t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) :=
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg).trans
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg)
  have hn : structureMap (kernel i.φ) h ≫
      (kernel.ι i.φ).app ((t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)) =
      (kernel.ι i.φ).app t ≫ structureMap M h :=
    (kernel.ι i.φ).naturality (homOfLE h)
  apply (cancel_mono ((kernel.ι i.φ).app ((t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)))).mp
  rw [zero_comp, hn]
  change (kernel.ι i.φ).app t ≫ structureMap M h = 0
  erw [← i.φ_ψ_structureMap t, ← Category.assoc]
  have hc := congrArg (fun f => f.app t) (kernel.condition i.φ)
  change (kernel.ι i.φ).app t ≫ i.φ.app t = 0 at hc
  erw [hc, zero_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.cokernel_transition_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cokernel_transition_eq_zero (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    transition (ε + ε) (cokernel i.φ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply transition_double_eq_zero
  intro t
  let h : t ≤ (t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) :=
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg).trans
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg)
  have hn : structureMap ((shift ε).obj N) h ≫
      (cokernel.π i.φ).app ((t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)) =
      (cokernel.π i.φ).app t ≫ structureMap (cokernel i.φ) h :=
    (cokernel.π i.φ).naturality (homOfLE h)
  apply (cancel_epi ((cokernel.π i.φ).app t)).mp
  rw [comp_zero, ← hn]
  change structureMap N (add_le_add h le_rfl) ≫
    (cokernel.π i.φ).app ((t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)) = 0
  erw [← i.symm.φ_ψ_structureMap (t + (ε : ℝ)), Category.assoc]
  have hc := congrArg (fun f => f.app ((t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)))
    (cokernel.condition i.φ)
  change i.φ.app ((t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)) ≫
    (cokernel.π i.φ).app ((t + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)) = 0 at hc
  erw [hc, comp_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.of_iso
statement:
theorem of_iso {L₀ M₀ N₀ L M N : PModule.{u,v,u} k P}
    {ι : L₀ ⟶ M₀} {π : M₀ ⟶ N₀} (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π)
    (eL : L₀ ≅ L) (eM : M₀ ≅ M) (eN : N₀ ≅ N) :
    IsPointwiseShortExact (eL.inv ≫ ι ≫ eM.hom) (eM.inv ≫ π ≫ eN.hom)
proof:
:= by
  let f : L ⟶ M := eL.inv ≫ ι ≫ eM.hom
  let g : M ⟶ N := eM.inv ≫ π ≫ eN.hom
  have hzero : ι ≫ π = 0 := by
    ext a x
    have hx : (ι.app a).hom x ∈ LinearMap.range (ι.app a).hom := ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [hs.range_eq_ker a] at hx
    exact hx
  have hfg : f ≫ g = 0 := by
    calc
      f ≫ g = eL.inv ≫ (ι ≫ π) ≫ eN.hom := by simp [f, g, Category.assoc]
      _ = 0 := by simp [hzero]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a x y hxy
    have hM : Function.Injective (eM.hom.app a).hom :=
      (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance
    have hL : Function.Injective (eL.inv.app a).hom :=
      (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance
    have hmid : (ι.app a).hom ((eL.inv.app a).hom x) =
        (ι.app a).hom ((eL.inv.app a).hom y) := by
      apply hM
      simpa [f, NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp] using hxy
    apply hL
    exact hs.injective a hmid
  · intro a z
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hs.surjective a ((eN.inv.app a).hom z)
    refine ⟨(eM.hom.app a).hom m, ?_⟩
    change (eN.hom.app a).hom ((π.app a).hom
      ((eM.inv.app a).hom ((eM.hom.app a).hom m))) = z
    have hcancel : (eM.inv.app a).hom ((eM.hom.app a).hom m) = m := by
      simp
    rw [hcancel, hm]
    simp
  · intro a
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      have hz := congrArg (fun q : L ⟶ N => (q.app a).hom x) hfg
      simpa [f, g, NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp] using hz
    · intro hz
      have hN : Function.Injective (eN.hom.app a).hom :=
        (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance
      have hz' : (π.app a).hom ((eM.inv.app a).hom z) = 0 := by
        apply hN
        simpa [g, NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp] using hz
      have hmem : (eM.inv.app a).hom z ∈ LinearMap.range (ι.app a).hom := by
        rw [hs.range_eq_ker a]
        exact hz'
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hmem
      refine ⟨(eL.hom.app a).hom x, ?_⟩
      change (eM.hom.app a).hom ((ι.app a).hom
        ((eL.inv.app a).hom ((eL.hom.app a).hom x))) = z
      have hcancelL : (eL.inv.app a).hom ((eL.hom.app a).hom x) = x := by
        simp
      rw [hcancelL, hx]
      simp

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankExact.of_iso
statement:
theorem of_iso {L₀ M₀ N₀ L M N : PModule.{u,v,u} k P}
    {ι : L₀ ⟶ M₀} {π : M₀ ⟶ N₀} (hs : IsRankExact ι π)
    (eL : L₀ ≅ L) (eM : M₀ ≅ M) (eN : N₀ ≅ N) :
    IsRankExact (eL.inv ≫ ι ≫ eM.hom) (eM.inv ≫ π ≫ eN.hom)
proof:
:= by
  let f : L ⟶ M := eL.inv ≫ ι ≫ eM.hom
  let g : M ⟶ N := eM.inv ≫ π ≫ eN.hom
  let hs' := hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact.of_iso eL eM eN
  refine
    { toIsPointwiseShortExact := hs'
      finiteDimensional := ?_
      rank_add := ?_ }
  · intro a
    letI : FiniteDimensional k (M₀.obj a) := hs.finiteDimensional a
    exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective (eM.inv.app a).hom
      ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance)
  · intro a b hab
    letI : FiniteDimensional k (M.obj a) := by
      letI : FiniteDimensional k (M₀.obj a) := hs.finiteDimensional a
      exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective (eM.inv.app a).hom
        ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance)
    apply (hs'.rank_add_iff_lift_kernel hab).mpr
    intro z hz
    let z₀ := (eN.inv.app a).hom z
    have hz₀ : structureMapLinear N₀ hab z₀ = 0 := by
      have hn := congrArg (fun q : N₀.obj a ⟶ N.obj b => q.hom z₀)
        (eN.hom.naturality (homOfLE hab))
      change (eN.hom.app b).hom (structureMapLinear N₀ hab z₀) =
        structureMapLinear N hab ((eN.hom.app a).hom z₀) at hn
      have hcancel : (eN.hom.app a).hom z₀ = z := by
        simp [z₀]
      rw [hcancel, hz] at hn
      apply ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (eN.hom.app b)).mp inferInstance)
      simpa using hn
    obtain ⟨m₀, hm₀, hdie₀⟩ := hs.lift_kernel hab z₀ hz₀
    refine ⟨(eM.hom.app a).hom m₀, ?_, ?_⟩
    · change (eN.hom.app a).hom ((π.app a).hom
        ((eM.inv.app a).hom ((eM.hom.app a).hom m₀))) = z
      have hcancel : (eM.inv.app a).hom ((eM.hom.app a).hom m₀) = m₀ := by
        simp
      rw [hcancel, hm₀]
      simp [z₀]
    · have hn := congrArg (fun q : M₀.obj a ⟶ M.obj b => q.hom m₀)
        (eM.hom.naturality (homOfLE hab))
      change (eM.hom.app b).hom (structureMapLinear M₀ hab m₀) =
        structureMapLinear M hab ((eM.hom.app a).hom m₀) at hn
      rw [hdie₀, map_zero] at hn
      exact hn.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.coordinateInterleavingDistance_comm
statement:
theorem coordinateInterleavingDistance_comm
    (M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance M N = coordinateInterleavingDistance N M
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_iInf₂ fun _ ⟨i⟩ => i.symm.distance_le)
    (le_iInf₂ fun _ ⟨i⟩ => i.symm.distance_le)

name: TDA.Persistence.coordinateInterleavingDistance_triangle
statement:
theorem coordinateInterleavingDistance_triangle
    (M N P : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance M P ≤ coordinateInterleavingDistance M N +
      coordinateInterleavingDistance N P
proof:
:= by
  apply ENNReal.le_iInf₂_add_iInf₂
  intro ε hi δ hj
  obtain ⟨i⟩ := hi
  obtain ⟨j⟩ := hj
  simpa only [ENNReal.coe_add] using (i.trans j).distance_le

name: TDA.Persistence.coordinateInterleavingDistance_congr
statement:
theorem coordinateInterleavingDistance_congr (e : M ≅ M') (d : N ≅ N') :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance M N = coordinateInterleavingDistance M' N'
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (le_iInf₂ fun _ ⟨i⟩ => (i.congr e.symm d.symm).distance_le)
    (le_iInf₂ fun _ ⟨i⟩ => (i.congr e d).distance_le)

name: TDA.Persistence.coordinateInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem coordinateInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_iff :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance M N = 0 ↔
      ∀ ε : ℝ≥0, 0 < ε → Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ε M N)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, ⟨i⟩⟩ :=
      coordinateInterleavingDistance_lt_iff.1 (h.trans_lt (ENNReal.coe_pos.2 hε))
    exact ⟨i.mono (ENNReal.coe_lt_coe.1 hδ).le⟩
  · intro h
    refine nonpos_iff_eq_zero.1 (ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add fun ε hε _ => ?_)
    simpa using coordinateInterleavingDistance_le_of_nonempty (h ε hε)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.Examples.mergeMap_generator
statement:
private theorem mergeMap_generator (b : Bool) :
    (mergeMap.app (birth b)).hom (branchGenerator b) = (1 : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun f : branches b ⟶ forkModule =>
    (f.app (birth b)).hom (HookInfinity.birth (birth b)))
    (biproduct.ι_desc branchMap b)
  exact h.trans (HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth (birth b) forkModule (1 : ℚ))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.Examples.mergeMap_surjective
statement:
private theorem mergeMap_surjective (p : ForkGrade) :
    Function.Surjective (mergeMap.app p).hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, birth b ≤ p := by
    cases p
    · exact ⟨false, le_rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨true, le_rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨false, Or.inr rfl⟩
  intro n
  change ℚ at n
  let v := structureMapLinear branchSum hb (branchGenerator b)
  have hv : (mergeMap.app p).hom v = (1 : ℚ) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (branchGenerator b))
      (mergeMap.naturality (homOfLE hb))
    change (mergeMap.app p).hom v =
      structureMapLinear forkModule hb ((mergeMap.app (birth b)).hom (branchGenerator b)) at h
    exact h.trans (congrArg (structureMapLinear forkModule hb) (mergeMap_generator b))
  refine ⟨n • v, ?_⟩
  exact (map_smul (mergeMap.app p).hom n v).trans
    ((congrArg (fun x => n • x) hv).trans (mul_one n))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.Examples.merge_rankExact
statement: private theorem merge_rankExact : IsRankExact (kernel.ι mergeMap) mergeMap

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.Examples.projection_top_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem projection_top_eq_zero (s : forkModule ⟶ branchSum) (b : Bool) :
    ((biproduct.π branches b).app .top).hom ((s.app .top).hom (1 : ℚ)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hb : birth (!b) ≤ (.top : ForkGrade) := Or.inr rfl
  have hnot : ¬ birth b ≤ birth (!b) := by cases b <;> decide
  let α := s ≫ biproduct.π branches b
  have hz : (α.app (birth (!b))).hom (1 : ℚ) = 0 :=
    HookInfinity.fiber_eq_zero_of_not_le hnot _
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (1 : ℚ)) (α.naturality (homOfLE hb))
  change (α.app .top).hom (1 : ℚ) = structureMapLinear (branches b) hb
    ((α.app (birth (!b))).hom (1 : ℚ)) at h
  exact h.trans (by rw [hz, map_zero])

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.Examples.merge_not_split
statement: private theorem merge_not_split : ¬ ∃ s : forkModule ⟶ branchSum, s ≫ mergeMap = 𝟙 forkModule
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨s, hs⟩
  have hv : (s.app .top).hom (1 : ℚ) = 0 := by
    apply FiniteBiproduct.element_ext branches .top
    intro b
    exact (projection_top_eq_zero s b).trans (map_zero _).symm
  have h := congrArg (fun f : forkModule ⟶ forkModule => (f.app .top).hom (1 : ℚ)) hs
  change (mergeMap.app .top).hom ((s.app .top).hom (1 : ℚ)) = (1 : ℚ) at h
  rw [hv, map_zero] at h
  exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : ℚ) ≠ (1 : ℚ)) h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookDeflation.Examples.finite_death_nonzero_lift
statement:
theorem finite_death_nonzero_lift :
    ∃ m : (module finiteHook).obj 0, ((π finiteHook).app 0).hom m ≠ 0 ∧
      structureMapLinear (module finiteHook) (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  let n : finiteHook.obj 0 :=
    SupportInterval.one (Hook.support (0 : Fin 2) 1) (Hook.birth_mem (by decide))
  have hn : structureMapLinear finiteHook (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) n = 0 :=
    Hook.generator_dies (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) < 1) (𝟙 finiteHook)
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hdie⟩ := lift_kernel finiteHook (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) n hn
  refine ⟨m, ?_, hdie⟩
  rw [hm]
  intro h
  have hz := congrArg Subtype.val h
  exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℚ) ≠ 0) hz
