name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionHookBettiExamples.identity_isRankProjectiveCover
statement:
private theorem identity_isRankProjectiveCover
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hfd : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p))
    (hprojective : IsRankProjective M) : IsRankProjectiveCover (𝟙 M)
proof:
:= by
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hfd
  refine ⟨hprojective, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact RankKernel.rankExact (𝟙 M) (fun _ x => ⟨x, rfl⟩)
      (by
        intro a b hab x hx
        exact ⟨x, by simp, hx⟩)
  · intro u hu
    have hu' : u = 𝟙 M := by simpa using hu
    rw [hu']
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionHookBettiExamples.principalHook_identity_isRankProjectiveCover
statement:
private theorem principalHook_identity_isRankProjectiveCover :
    IsRankProjectiveCover (𝟙 principalHook)
proof:
:= by
  apply identity_isRankProjectiveCover principalHook
  · intro p
    infer_instance
  · exact HookInfinity.isRankProjective (i := (0 : Fin 2 → ℝ))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionHookBettiExamples.principalHook_positive_degree_terms_have_empty_hook_multiset
statement:
theorem principalHook_positive_degree_terms_have_empty_hook_multiset
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := ℚ) (M := principalHook))
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 0 < j) :
    R.hookBettiMultiset (k := ℚ) (n := 2) principalHook
      principalHook_finitelyPresented j = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply R.hookBettiMultiset_eq_zero_of_term_isZero
    (k := ℚ) (n := 2) principalHook principalHook_finitelyPresented
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := R.termAt_nonempty_iso principalHookIdentityMinimalResolution j
  have hzero : principalHookIdentityMinimalResolution.termAt j =
      (0 : PModule.{0,0,0} ℚ (Fin 2 → ℝ)) := by
    apply principalHookIdentityMinimalResolution.termAt_eq_zero
    change 1 ≤ j
    omega
  exact IsZero.of_iso (isZero_zero _) (e.trans (eqToIso hzero))

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.first_maps
statement:
theorem first_maps :
    structureMapLinear (compositeZero (k := k)) (show (0 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 by decide) =
      LinearMap.inl k k k ∧
    structureMapLinear (compositeIdentity (k := k)) (show (0 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 by decide) =
      LinearMap.inl k k k
proof: := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.second_maps
statement:
theorem second_maps :
    structureMapLinear (compositeZero (k := k)) (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 2 by decide) =
      LinearMap.snd k k k ∧
    structureMapLinear (compositeIdentity (k := k)) (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 2 by decide) =
      LinearMap.fst k k k
proof: := ⟨rfl, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.stage_dimensions
statement:
theorem stage_dimensions (i : Fin 3) :
    Module.finrank k ((compositeZero (k := k)).obj i) = (if i = 1 then 2 else 1) ∧
    Module.finrank k ((compositeIdentity (k := k)).obj i) = (if i = 1 then 2 else 1)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · change Module.finrank k k = 1 ∧ Module.finrank k k = 1
    simp [Module.finrank_self]
  · change Module.finrank k (k × k) = 2 ∧ Module.finrank k (k × k) = 2
    simp [Module.finrank_prod, Module.finrank_self]
  · change Module.finrank k k = 1 ∧ Module.finrank k k = 1
    simp [Module.finrank_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.first_ranks
statement:
theorem first_ranks :
    structureMapRank (compositeZero (k := k)) 0 1 (by decide) = 1 ∧
    structureMapRank (compositeIdentity (k := k)) 0 1 (by decide) = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;>
    change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.inl k k k)) = 1 <;>
    rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj LinearMap.inl_injective, Module.finrank_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.second_ranks
statement:
theorem second_ranks :
    structureMapRank (compositeZero (k := k)) 1 2 (by decide) = 1 ∧
    structureMapRank (compositeIdentity (k := k)) 1 2 (by decide) = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.snd k k k)) = 1
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr LinearMap.snd_surjective, finrank_top,
      Module.finrank_self]
  · change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.fst k k k)) = 1
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr LinearMap.fst_surjective, finrank_top,
      Module.finrank_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.composite_ranks
statement:
theorem composite_ranks :
    structureMapRank (compositeZero (k := k)) 0 2 (by decide) = 0 ∧
    structureMapRank (compositeIdentity (k := k)) 0 2 (by decide) = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      ((LinearMap.snd k k k).comp (LinearMap.inl k k k))) = 0
    have h : (LinearMap.snd k k k).comp (LinearMap.inl k k k) = 0 := by ext; rfl
    rw [h]
    simp
  · change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      ((LinearMap.fst k k k).comp (LinearMap.inl k k k))) = 1
    have h : (LinearMap.fst k k k).comp (LinearMap.inl k k k) = LinearMap.id := by
      ext; rfl
    rw [h, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top, Module.finrank_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.dimensions_and_adjacent_ranks_agree
statement:
theorem dimensions_and_adjacent_ranks_agree :
    (∀ i : Fin 3, Module.finrank k ((compositeZero (k := k)).obj i) =
      Module.finrank k ((compositeIdentity (k := k)).obj i)) ∧
    structureMapRank (compositeZero (k := k)) 0 1 (by decide) =
      structureMapRank (compositeIdentity (k := k)) 0 1 (by decide) ∧
    structureMapRank (compositeZero (k := k)) 1 2 (by decide) =
      structureMapRank (compositeIdentity (k := k)) 1 2 (by decide)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun i => (stage_dimensions i).1.trans (stage_dimensions i).2.symm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (first_ranks (k := k)).1.trans (first_ranks (k := k)).2.symm
  · exact (second_ranks (k := k)).1.trans (second_ranks (k := k)).2.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.not_iso
statement: theorem not_iso : ¬ Nonempty (compositeZero (k := k) ≅ compositeIdentity (k := k))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e⟩
  have h := structureMapRank_eq_of_iso e (0 : Fin 3) 2 (by decide)
  rw [(composite_ranks (k := k)).1, (composite_ranks (k := k)).2] at h
  exact Nat.zero_ne_one h

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.self_rank
proof:
:= by
  unfold structureMapRank
  rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.zero_rankBarcode
statement: theorem zero_rankBarcode : rankBarcode (compositeZero (k := k)) = zeroBarcode
proof:
:= by
  have h : rankBarcode (compositeZero (k := k)) =
      rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := k) zeroBarcode) := by
    apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).2
    intro i j hij
    rw [rank_barcodeMap]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp only [Fin.reduceFinMk] at *
    · rw [self_rank, (stage_dimensions (k := k) 0).1]
      decide
    · rw [(first_ranks (k := k)).1]
      decide
    · rw [(composite_ranks (k := k)).1]
      decide
    · norm_num [Fin.le_def] at hij
    · rw [self_rank, (stage_dimensions (k := k) 1).1]
      decide
    · rw [(second_ranks (k := k)).1]
      decide
    · norm_num [Fin.le_def] at hij
    · norm_num [Fin.le_def] at hij
    · rw [self_rank, (stage_dimensions (k := k) 2).1]
      decide
  simpa only [rankBarcode_barcodeModule] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.identity_rankBarcode
statement:
theorem identity_rankBarcode :
    rankBarcode (compositeIdentity (k := k)) = identityBarcode
proof:
:= by
  have h : rankBarcode (compositeIdentity (k := k)) =
      rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := k) identityBarcode) := by
    apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).2
    intro i j hij
    rw [rank_barcodeMap]
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp only [Fin.reduceFinMk] at *
    · rw [self_rank, (stage_dimensions (k := k) 0).2]
      decide
    · rw [(first_ranks (k := k)).2]
      decide
    · rw [(composite_ranks (k := k)).2]
      decide
    · norm_num [Fin.le_def] at hij
    · rw [self_rank, (stage_dimensions (k := k) 1).2]
      decide
    · rw [(second_ranks (k := k)).2]
      decide
    · norm_num [Fin.le_def] at hij
    · norm_num [Fin.le_def] at hij
    · rw [self_rank, (stage_dimensions (k := k) 2).2]
      decide
  simpa only [rankBarcode_barcodeModule] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.ThreeStageExamples.decompositions
statement:
theorem decompositions :
    Nonempty (compositeZero (k := k) ≅ barcodeModule (k := k) zeroBarcode) ∧
    Nonempty (compositeIdentity (k := k) ≅ barcodeModule (k := k) identityBarcode)
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨zero_decompositionIso⟩, ⟨identity_decompositionIso⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanWeightExamples.weight_values
statement:
theorem weight_values :
    w (birthPersistence (0, 1)) = π / 4 ∧
      w (birthPersistence (1, 1)) = 0 ∧ weightedFeature 1 w (1, 1) = 0 ∧
      w (birthPersistence (1, 0)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, weightedFeature_diagonal 1 w 1, ?_⟩
  · rw [arctanWeight_birthPersistence 1 zero_le_one (by norm_num)]
    norm_num [Real.arctan_one]
  · rw [arctanWeight_birthPersistence 1 zero_le_one le_rfl]
    simp
  · simp [birthPersistence]

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanWeightExamples.untruncated_not_weight
statement:
theorem untruncated_not_weight (A B : ℝ) :
    ¬ ∃ v : Weight A B, v.toFun = fun u => Real.arctan u.2
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
  have h := v.nonneg (0, -1)
  rw [hv] at h
  simp only [Real.arctan_neg, Real.arctan_one] at h
  linarith [Real.pi_pos]

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanWeightExamples.sup_bound_sharp
statement:
theorem sup_bound_sharp {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (A B' : ℝ) (hB' : B' < π / 2) :
    ¬ ∃ v : Weight A B', v.toFun = (arctanWeight C hC.le).toFun
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨v, hv⟩
  set y := (max B' 0 + π / 2) / 2 with hy
  have hmax : max B' 0 < π / 2 := max_lt hB' Real.pi_div_two_pos
  have hy0 : 0 < y := by have := le_max_right B' 0; linarith
  have hyπ : y < π / 2 := by linarith
  have hBy : B' < y := by have := le_max_left B' 0; linarith
  have ht : 0 < Real.tan y := Real.tan_pos_of_pos_of_lt_pi_div_two hy0 hyπ
  have h := v.bounded (0, Real.tan y / C)
  rw [hv] at h
  change Real.arctan (C * max (Real.tan y / C) 0) ≤ B' at h
  rw [max_eq_left (div_pos ht hC).le, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hC.ne',
    Real.arctan_tan (by linarith) hyπ] at h
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanWeightExamples.stabilityConstant_values
statement:
theorem stabilityConstant_values :
    stabilityConstant 1 1 (π / 2) = 2 + √2 * π / 2 ∧
      stabilityConstant 1 0 (π / 2) = √2 * π / 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> · rw [stabilityConstant_arctan]; norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanWeightExamples.w_two
statement: private theorem w_two : w (birthPersistence (0, 2)) = Real.arctan 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [arctanWeight_birthPersistence 1 zero_le_one (by norm_num)]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanWeightExamples.w_three
statement: private theorem w_three : w (birthPersistence (0, 3)) = Real.arctan 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [arctanWeight_birthPersistence 1 zero_le_one (by norm_num)]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanWeightExamples.single_sq
statement:
private theorem single_sq :
    ‖embedding 1 w (single (0, 2)) - embedding 1 w (single (0, 3))‖ ^ 2 =
      Real.arctan 2 ^ 2 + Real.arctan 3 ^ 2 -
        2 * Real.arctan 2 * Real.arctan 3 * Real.exp (-1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_embedding_sub_sq]
  simp only [linearKernel, single, Finset.univ_unique, Finset.sum_singleton, w_two, w_three,
    kernel_self, kernel_adjacent]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanWeightExamples.occurrence_bound
statement:
theorem occurrence_bound :
    ‖embedding 1 w (single (0, 2)) - embedding 1 w (single (0, 3))‖ ^ 2 =
        Real.arctan 2 ^ 2 + Real.arctan 3 ^ 2 -
          2 * Real.arctan 2 * Real.arctan 3 * Real.exp (-1 / 2) ∧
      ‖embedding 1 w (single (0, 2)) - embedding 1 w (single (0, 3))‖ ≤ 2 + √2 * π / 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨single_sq, ?_⟩
  have h := norm_embedding_sub_le_matching 1 zero_le_one Real.pi_div_two_pos.le w
    pairMatching (single (0, 2)) (single (0, 3)) (fun _ => by norm_num [single])
    (fun _ => by norm_num [single])
  rwa [pairMatching_cost, stabilityConstant_values.1, mul_one] at h

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanWeightExamples.diagramEmbedding_singleton
statement:
private theorem diagramEmbedding_singleton (b d : ℝ) (h : b ≠ d) :
    diagramEmbedding 1 w (singletonDiagram b d h) = embedding 1 w (single (b, d))
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagramEmbedding_eq_sum]
  have hp : finitePart (singletonDiagram b d h).points = {(b, d)} := rfl
  rw [hp, Multiset.map_singleton, Multiset.sum_singleton]
  simp [embedding, finiteFeatureSum, single]

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanWeightExamples.kernel_value
statement:
theorem kernel_value :
    gaussianDiagramKernel 1 1 w diagramTwo diagramThree =
        Real.exp (-(Real.arctan 2 ^ 2 + Real.arctan 3 ^ 2 -
          2 * Real.arctan 2 * Real.arctan 3 * Real.exp (-1 / 2)) / 2) ∧
      |1 - gaussianDiagramKernel 1 1 w diagramTwo diagramThree| ≤
        (2 + √2 * π / 2) *
          finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost (fun p : diagramTwo.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
            (fun p : diagramThree.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hself : gaussianDiagramKernel 1 1 w diagramTwo diagramTwo = 1 := by
    simp [gaussianDiagramKernel]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [gaussianDiagramKernel, diagramTwo, diagramThree, diagramEmbedding_singleton,
      diagramEmbedding_singleton, single_sq]
    norm_num
  · have h := abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_arctan 1 1 zero_le_one diagramTwo diagramTwo
      diagramThree diagram_stability.1 diagram_stability.2.1
    rw [hself] at h
    convert h using 2
    norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance_le_of_matching
proof:
:=
  iInf_le_of_le ε (iInf_le_of_le M (iInf_le _ hM))

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.le_bottleneckDistance_iff
statement:
theorem le_bottleneckDistance_iff (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    r ≤ bottleneckDistance (k := k) R S ↔ ∀ ε M, IsMatching (k := k) ε R S M → r ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bottleneckDistance, le_iInf_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance_lt_iff
statement:
theorem bottleneckDistance_lt_iff (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    bottleneckDistance (k := k) R S < r ↔
      ∃ (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : OccurrenceMatching ι κ PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}),
        (ε : ℝ≥0∞) < r ∧ IsMatching (k := k) ε R S M
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bottleneckDistance, iInf_lt_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ε, M, hM, hε⟩
    exact ⟨ε, M, hε, hM⟩
  · rintro ⟨ε, M, hε, hM⟩
    exact ⟨ε, M, hM, hε⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance_comm
statement:
theorem bottleneckDistance_comm (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) :
    bottleneckDistance (k := k) R S = bottleneckDistance (k := k) S R
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_iInf fun ε => le_iInf fun M => le_iInf fun hM =>
      bottleneckDistance_le_of_matching hM.reverse
  · exact le_iInf fun ε => le_iInf fun M => le_iInf fun hM =>
      bottleneckDistance_le_of_matching hM.reverse

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.interleavingDistance_le_bottleneckDistance
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_le_bottleneckDistance
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance (module (k := k) R) (module S) ≤
      bottleneckDistance (k := k) R S
proof:
:= by
  exact le_iInf fun ε => le_iInf fun M => le_iInf fun hM => hM.interleaving.distance_le

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance_le_interleavingDistance
statement:
theorem bottleneckDistance_le_interleavingDistance (hn : 0 < n)
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) :
    bottleneckDistance (k := k) R S ≤ ((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) *
      coordinateInterleavingDistance (module (k := k) R) (module S)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (2 * n - 1 : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by omega
  have hc0 : (((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hc
  have hct : (((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)) ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.coe_ne_top
  unfold coordinateInterleavingDistance
  rw [ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne hc0 hct]
  apply le_iInf
  intro ε
  rw [ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne hc0 hct]
  apply le_iInf
  intro hI
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_matching hn R S ε hI.some
  simpa [stabilityRadius, ENNReal.coe_mul] using bottleneckDistance_le_of_matching hM

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.two_sided_distance_bounds
statement:
theorem two_sided_distance_bounds (hn : 0 < n)
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance (module (k := k) R) (module S) ≤
      bottleneckDistance (k := k) R S ∧
    bottleneckDistance (k := k) R S ≤ ((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞) *
      coordinateInterleavingDistance (module (k := k) R) (module S)
proof:
:=
  ⟨interleavingDistance_le_bottleneckDistance R S,
    bottleneckDistance_le_interleavingDistance hn R S⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance_eq_interleavingDistance_one
statement:
theorem bottleneckDistance_eq_interleavingDistance_one
    (R : ι → Rectangle 1) (S : κ → Rectangle 1) :
    bottleneckDistance (k := k) R S =
      coordinateInterleavingDistance (module (k := k) R) (module S)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa using bottleneckDistance_le_interleavingDistance (k := k) (by decide : 0 < 1) R S
  · exact interleavingDistance_le_bottleneckDistance R S

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMap_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem structureMap_self (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) {p : P} (h : p ≤ p) :
    structureMap M h = 𝟙 (M.obj p)
proof:
:= by
  simp [structureMap]

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMap_comp
proof:
:= by
  change M.map (homOfLE hpq) ≫ M.map (homOfLE hqr) =
    M.map (homOfLE (hpq.trans hqr))
  rw [← M.map_comp, CategoryTheory.homOfLE_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapLinear_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem structureMapLinear_self (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) {p : P} (h : p ≤ p) :
    structureMapLinear M h = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  simp [structureMapLinear, structureMap_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapLinear_comp
statement:
theorem structureMapLinear_comp (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) {p q r : P}
    (hpq : p ≤ q) (hqr : q ≤ r) :
    structureMapLinear M (hpq.trans hqr) =
      (structureMapLinear M hqr).comp (structureMapLinear M hpq)
proof:
:= by
  change (structureMap M (hpq.trans hqr)).hom = _
  rw [← structureMap_comp M hpq hqr]
  exact ModuleCat.hom_comp _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.reindex_obj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reindex_obj {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] (u : Q →o P)
    (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) (q : Q) :
    (reindex u M).obj q = M.obj (u q)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMap_reindex
statement:
@[simp]
theorem structureMap_reindex {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] (u : Q →o P)
    (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) {q₁ q₂ : Q} (h : q₁ ≤ q₂) :
    structureMap (reindex u M) h = structureMap M (u.monotone' h)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapLinear_reindex
statement:
@[simp]
theorem structureMapLinear_reindex {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] (u : Q →o P)
    (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) {q₁ q₂ : Q} (h : q₁ ≤ q₂) :
    structureMapLinear (reindex u M) h = structureMapLinear M (u.monotone' h)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.reindex_id
statement:
theorem reindex_id (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) :
    reindex (OrderHom.id : P →o P) M = M
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.reindex_comp
statement:
theorem reindex_comp {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] {S : Type y} [Preorder S]
    (u : Q →o P) (v : S →o Q) (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) :
    reindex v (reindex u M) = reindex (u.comp v) M
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.reindexNatTrans_app
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reindexNatTrans_app {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] (u : Q →o P)
    {M N : PModule.{u,v,w} R P} (α : M ⟶ N) (q : Q) :
    (reindexNatTrans u α).app q = α.app (u q)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.reindexNatTrans_id
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reindexNatTrans_id {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] (u : Q →o P)
    (M : PModule.{u,v,w} R P) :
    reindexNatTrans u (𝟙 M) = 𝟙 (reindex u M)
proof:
:= by
  change Functor.whiskerLeft u.toFunctor (𝟙 M) = 𝟙 (u.toFunctor ⋙ M)
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.reindexNatTrans_comp
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reindexNatTrans_comp {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q]
    (u : Q →o P) {M N L : PModule.{u,v,w} R P} (α : M ⟶ N) (β : N ⟶ L) :
    reindexNatTrans u (α ≫ β) = reindexNatTrans u α ≫ reindexNatTrans u β
proof:
:= by
  change Functor.whiskerLeft u.toFunctor (α ≫ β) =
    Functor.whiskerLeft u.toFunctor α ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft u.toFunctor β
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.integerZeroTransition_map
statement:
theorem integerZeroTransition_map :
    structureMapLinear integerZeroTransition (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.integerZeroTransition_nonidentity
statement:
theorem integerZeroTransition_nonidentity :
    structureMapLinear integerZeroTransition (show (0 : Fin 2) ≤ 1 by decide) ≠ LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by

  have h₁ := congrArg (fun f : ℤ →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ => f 1) h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.mem_active
statement:
private theorem mem_active (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (i : Fin N) :
    i ∈ active c S ↔ c i ∈ S
proof: := by simp [active]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.sampledInterval_alive_iff
statement:
theorem sampledInterval_alive_iff (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : S.OrdConnected) (hne : (active c S).Nonempty) (i : Fin N) :
    (sampledInterval c S hne).alive i ↔ c i ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  let a := (active c S).min' hne
  let b := (active c S).max' hne
  have ha : c a ∈ S := (mem_active c S a).mp (Finset.min'_mem _ _)
  have hb : c b ∈ S := (mem_active c S b).mp (Finset.max'_mem _ _)
  have hmin : ∀ j : Fin N, c j ∈ S → a ≤ j := by
    intro j hj
    exact Finset.min'_le _ j ((mem_active c S j).mpr hj)
  have hmax : ∀ j : Fin N, c j ∈ S → j ≤ b := by
    intro j hj
    exact Finset.le_max' _ j ((mem_active c S j).mpr hj)
  constructor
  · intro hi
    change a.val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < b.val + 1 at hi
    have hai : a ≤ i := by
      exact Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr hi.1
    have hib : i ≤ b := by
      apply Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr
      omega
    exact hS.out ha hb ⟨c.monotone hai, c.monotone hib⟩
  · intro hi
    change a.val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < b.val + 1
    exact ⟨Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp (hmin i hi), by
      have h := Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp (hmax i hi)
      omega⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.sampled_structureMapRank
statement:
private theorem sampled_structureMapRank (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : S.OrdConnected) (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank (reindex c.toOrderHom (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S hS)) i j hij =
      if c i ∈ S ∧ c j ∈ S then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold structureMapRank
  rw [structureMapLinear_reindex]
  let hc : c i ≤ c j := c.monotone hij
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
    (structureMapLinear (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S hS) hc)) = _
  by_cases h : c i ∈ S ∧ c j ∈ S
  · rw [if_pos h]
    have hinj : Function.Injective
        (structureMapLinear (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S hS)
          (c.monotone hij)) := by
      intro x y hxy
      apply Subtype.ext
      have hv := congrArg (fun z : SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S (c j) => (z : k)) hxy
      rw [SupportInterval.structureMap_val S hS hc x,
        SupportInterval.structureMap_val S hS hc y] at hv
      simpa [h.2] using hv
    rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hinj]
    change Module.finrank k (SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S (c i)) = 1
    rw [show SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S (c i) = ⊤ by simp [SupportInterval.fiber, h.1]]
    simp
  · rw [if_neg h]
    have hz := (SupportInterval.structureMap_eq_zero_iff (k := k) S hS
      (c.monotone hij)).mpr h
    rw [hz]
    simp [LinearMap.range_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.sampled_structureMapRank_eq_interval
statement:
theorem sampled_structureMapRank_eq_interval (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : S.OrdConnected) (hne : (active c S).Nonempty)
    (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank (reindex c.toOrderHom (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S hS)) i j hij =
      structureMapRank (intervalModule (k := k) (sampledInterval c S hne)) i j hij
proof:
:= by
  rw [sampled_structureMapRank]
  change _ = Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
    (intervalMap (k := k) (sampledInterval c S hne) hij))
  rw [intervalMap_finrank_range]
  simp only [sampledInterval_alive_iff c S hS hne]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.sampled_rankBarcode_single
statement:
theorem sampled_rankBarcode_single (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : S.OrdConnected) (hne : (active c S).Nonempty) :
    rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S hS)) =
      {(sampledInterval c S hne)}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hrank : ∀ (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j),
      structureMapRank (reindex c.toOrderHom (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S hS)) i j hij =
        structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) ({sampledInterval c S hne} :
          Multiset (FiniteInterval N))) i j hij := by
    intro i j hij
    rw [sampled_structureMapRank, rank_barcodeMap]
    change (if c i ∈ S ∧ c j ∈ S then 1 else 0) =
      Multiset.countP (fun I : FiniteInterval N => I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death)
        ((sampledInterval c S hne) ::ₘ 0)
    simp only [Multiset.countP_cons, Multiset.countP_zero, zero_add]
    simp only [← interval_alive_endpoints_iff (sampledInterval c S hne) hij,
      sampledInterval_alive_iff c S hS hne]
  exact ((rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).2 hrank).trans
    (rankBarcode_barcodeModule ({sampledInterval c S hne} : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.sampled_rankBarcode_empty
statement:
theorem sampled_rankBarcode_empty (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : Set ℝ)
    (hS : S.OrdConnected) (hempty : active c S = ∅) :
    rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S hS)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hno (i : Fin N) : c i ∉ S := by
    intro hi
    have hm := (mem_active c S i).mpr hi
    simp [hempty] at hm
  have hrank : ∀ (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j),
      structureMapRank (reindex c.toOrderHom (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S hS)) i j hij =
        structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval N))) i j hij := by
    intro i j hij
    rw [sampled_structureMapRank, rank_barcodeMap]
    simp [hno i]
  exact ((rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).2 hrank).trans
    (rankBarcode_barcodeModule (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.finite_visible_occurrences
statement:
theorem finite_visible_occurrences {J : Type*} (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : J → Set ℝ)
    (hlocal : ∀ i : Fin N, {j : J | c i ∈ S j}.Finite) :
    {j : J | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ S j}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (⋃ i : Fin N, {j : J | c i ∈ S j}).Finite :=
    Set.finite_iUnion hlocal
  convert hf using 1
  ext j
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.finrank_range_piMap
statement:
private theorem finrank_range_piMap {J : Type*} [Fintype J] {A B : J → Type*}
    [∀ j, AddCommGroup (A j)] [∀ j, Module k (A j)]
    [∀ j, AddCommGroup (B j)] [∀ j, Module k (B j)]
    [∀ j, FiniteDimensional k (A j)] (f : ∀ j, A j →ₗ[k] B j) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.piMap f)) =
      ∑ j, Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (f j))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [(rangePiEquiv (k := k) f).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_pi_fintype]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.finite_family_sampled_rank
statement:
theorem finite_family_sampled_rank {k : Type*} [Field k] {J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : J → Set ℝ) (hS : ∀ j, (S j).OrdConnected)
    (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank
      (reindex c.toOrderHom (AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
        (fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a)))) i j hij =
      ∑ a : J, if c i ∈ S a ∧ c j ∈ S a then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : J → PModule.{_,0,_} k ℝ :=
    fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a)
  letI : ∀ t : Fin N, FiniteDimensional k
      ((c.toOrderHom.toFunctor ⋙ AlgebraicFamily.familyModule F).obj t) :=
    fun t => finite_sampled_family_finiteDimensional c S hS t
  letI : ∀ t : Fin N, FiniteDimensional k
      ((c.toOrderHom.toFunctor ⋙ RealBarcode.familyModule F).obj t) := by
    intro t
    change FiniteDimensional k (∀ a : J, (F a).obj (c t))
    infer_instance
  letI : FiniteDimensional k
      ((reindex c.toOrderHom (AlgebraicFamily.familyModule F)).obj i) :=
    finite_sampled_family_finiteDimensional c S hS i
  letI : FiniteDimensional k
      ((reindex c.toOrderHom (RealBarcode.familyModule F)).obj i) := by
    change FiniteDimensional k (∀ a : J, (F a).obj (c i))
    infer_instance
  let e := Functor.isoWhiskerLeft c.toOrderHom.toFunctor
    (AlgebraicFamily.finiteProductIso F)
  calc
    _ = structureMapRank (reindex c.toOrderHom (RealBarcode.familyModule F)) i j hij :=
      structureMapRank_eq_of_iso e i j hij
    _ = ∑ a : J, if c i ∈ S a ∧ c j ∈ S a then 1 else 0 := by
      change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
        (LinearMap.piMap (fun a : J =>
          structureMapLinear (F a) (c.monotone hij)))) = _
      rw [finrank_range_piMap]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a ha
      have hr := sampled_structureMapRank (k := k) c (S a) (hS a) i j hij
      change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
        (structureMapLinear (SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a))
          (c.monotone hij))) = _ at hr
      exact hr

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.countP_finset_sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih => simp [ha, Multiset.countP_add, ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.finite_family_rankBarcode
statement:
theorem finite_family_rankBarcode {k : Type*} [Field k] {J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : J → Set ℝ) (hS : ∀ a, (S a).OrdConnected) :
    rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom (AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
      (fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a)))) =
      finiteFamilyBarcode c S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := finiteFamilyBarcode c S
  have hrank : ∀ (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j),
      structureMapRank (reindex c.toOrderHom (AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
        (fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a)))) i j hij =
        structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) B) i j hij := by
    intro i j hij
    rw [finite_family_sampled_rank, rank_barcodeMap]
    change (∑ a : J, if c i ∈ S a ∧ c j ∈ S a then 1 else 0) =
      (∑ a : J, if h : (active c (S a)).Nonempty then
        ({(sampledInterval c (S a) h)} : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) else 0).countP
          (fun I => I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death)
    rw [countP_finset_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro a ha
    by_cases h : (active c (S a)).Nonempty
    · simp only [dif_pos h]
      change (if c i ∈ S a ∧ c j ∈ S a then 1 else 0) =
        Multiset.countP (fun I : FiniteInterval N => I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death)
          ((sampledInterval c (S a) h) ::ₘ 0)
      simp only [Multiset.countP_cons, Multiset.countP_zero, zero_add]
      simp only [← interval_alive_endpoints_iff (sampledInterval c (S a) h) hij,
        sampledInterval_alive_iff c (S a) (hS a) h]
    · simp only [dif_neg h, Multiset.countP_zero]
      have hi : c i ∉ S a := by
        intro hci
        exact h ⟨i, (mem_active c (S a) i).mpr hci⟩
      simp [hi]
  exact ((rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).2 hrank).trans (rankBarcode_barcodeModule B)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.toVisible_fromVisible
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro a
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp [toVisibleLinear, fromVisibleLinear]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.fromVisible_toVisible
statement:
private theorem fromVisible_toVisible {k : Type*} [Field k] {J : Type}
    (F : J → PModule.{_,0,_} k ℝ) (V : Set J) (t : ℝ)
    (hout : ∀ a : J, a ∉ V → Subsingleton ((F a).obj t)) :
    (fromVisibleLinear F V t).comp (toVisibleLinear F V t) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro a
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  by_cases ha : a ∈ V
  · simp [toVisibleLinear, fromVisibleLinear, ha]
  · have hx : x = 0 := @Subsingleton.elim ((F a).obj t) (hout a ha) x 0
    subst x
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.support_nontrivial_iff
statement:
private theorem support_nontrivial_iff {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (S : Set ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    Nontrivial (SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S t) ↔ t ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ht : t ∈ S
  · rw [show SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S t = ⊤ by
      simp [SupportInterval.fiber, ht]]
    constructor
    · intro _
      exact ht
    · intro _
      exact ⟨⟨0, trivial⟩, ⟨1, trivial⟩, by
        intro h
        exact zero_ne_one (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩
  · constructor
    · intro hn
      have hs : Subsingleton (SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S t) :=
        ⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext <| by
          rw [SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k) S ht x,
            SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k) S ht y]⟩
      exact False.elim ((not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mpr hs) hn)
    · exact False.elim ∘ ht

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.finite_visible_of_decomposition
statement:
theorem finite_visible_of_decomposition {k : Type*} [Field k] {J : Type}
    (M : PModule.{_,0,_} k ℝ) [∀ t : ℝ, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : J → Set ℝ) (hS : ∀ a, (S a).OrdConnected)
    (e : M ≅ AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
      (fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a))) :
    {a : J | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ S a}.Finite
proof:
:= by
  let F : J → PModule.{_,0,_} k ℝ :=
    fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a)
  have hf := AlgebraicFamily.finite_observed_nontrivial_of_iso F e
    (fun t => inferInstanceAs (FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t))) (fun i => c i)
  convert hf using 1
  ext a
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  exact exists_congr (fun i => (support_nontrivial_iff (k := k) (S a) (c i)).symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.rankBarcode_of_decomposition
statement:
theorem rankBarcode_of_decomposition {k : Type*} [Field k] {J : Type}
    (M : PModule.{_,0,_} k ℝ) [∀ t : ℝ, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : J → Set ℝ) (hS : ∀ a, (S a).OrdConnected)
    (e : M ≅ AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
      (fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a)))
    (hvisible : {a : J | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ S a}.Finite) :
    rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom M) =
      letI : Fintype {a : J | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ S a} := hvisible.fintype
      finiteFamilyBarcode c (fun a : {a : J | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ S a} => S a.val)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let V : Set J := {a | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ S a}
  letI : Fintype V := hvisible.fintype
  letI : ∀ t : Fin N, FiniteDimensional k ((reindex c.toOrderHom M).obj t) :=
    fun t => inferInstanceAs (FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c t)))
  letI : ∀ t : Fin N, FiniteDimensional k
      ((reindex c.toOrderHom (AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
        (fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a)))).obj t) := by
    intro t
    exact Module.Finite.equiv ((e.app (c t)).toLinearEquiv)
  letI : ∀ t : Fin N, FiniteDimensional k
      ((reindex c.toOrderHom (AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
        (fun a : V => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a.val) (hS a.val)))).obj t) :=
    fun t => finite_sampled_family_finiteDimensional c
      (fun a : V => S a.val) (fun a => hS a.val) t
  let eSample := Functor.isoWhiskerLeft c.toOrderHom.toFunctor e
  let eVisible := visibleFamilyIso (k := k) c S hS V (fun a h => h)
  calc
    rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom M) =
        rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom (AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
          (fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a)))) :=
      rankBarcode_eq_of_iso eSample
    _ = rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom (AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
          (fun a : V => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a.val) (hS a.val)))) :=
      rankBarcode_eq_of_iso eVisible
    _ = finiteFamilyBarcode c (fun a : V => S a.val) :=
      finite_family_rankBarcode c (fun a : V => S a.val) (fun a => hS a.val)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteObservation.rankBarcode_of_pfd_decomposition
statement:
theorem rankBarcode_of_pfd_decomposition {k : Type*} [Field k] {J : Type}
    (M : PModule.{_,0,_} k ℝ) [∀ t : ℝ, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) (S : J → Set ℝ) (hS : ∀ a, (S a).OrdConnected)
    (e : M ≅ AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
      (fun a => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (S a) (hS a))) :
    rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom M) =
      let hvisible : {a : J | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ S a}.Finite :=
        finite_visible_of_decomposition M c S hS e
      letI : Fintype {a : J | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ S a} := hvisible.fintype
      finiteFamilyBarcode c (fun a : {a : J | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ S a} => S a.val)
proof:
:=
  rankBarcode_of_decomposition M c S hS e
    (finite_visible_of_decomposition M c S hS e)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_of_real
proof:
:=
  ⟨IsHermitian.ext fun i j => by simpa using hs i j, fun x => by simpa using hq x⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.PosSemidef.real_symm
statement:
private theorem PosSemidef.real_symm {M : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hM : M.PosSemidef) (i j : ι) :
    M j i = M i j
proof:
:= by
  simpa using hM.isHermitian.apply i j

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.PosSemidef.real_quad
statement:
private theorem PosSemidef.real_quad {M : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hM : M.PosSemidef) (x : ι →₀ ℝ) :
    0 ≤ x.sum fun i a => x.sum fun j b => a * M i j * b
proof:
:= by
  simpa using hM.2 x

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_innerKernel
statement:
theorem posSemidef_innerKernel {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    (v : ι → E) : (Matrix.of fun i j => ⟪v i, v j⟫_ℝ).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  refine posSemidef_of_real (fun i j => by simp [real_inner_comm]) fun x => ?_
  have h : (x.sum fun i a => x.sum fun j b => a * (Matrix.of fun i j => ⟪v i, v j⟫_ℝ) i j * b) =
      ⟪x.sum fun i a => a • v i, x.sum fun j b => b • v j⟫_ℝ := by
    simp only [Finsupp.sum, sum_inner, inner_sum, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
      Matrix.of_apply]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by
      rw [real_inner_comm (v j) (v i)]
      ring
  rw [h]
  exact real_inner_self_nonneg

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_map_pow
statement:
theorem posSemidef_map_pow {M : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hM : M.PosSemidef) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (M.map (· ^ n)).PosSemidef
proof:
| 0 => by
    have h : M.map (· ^ 0) = Matrix.of fun (_ _ : ι) => ⟪(1 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)⟫_ℝ := by
      ext i j
      simp
    rw [h]
    exact posSemidef_innerKernel fun _ => (1 : ℝ)
  | n + 1 => by
    have h : M.map (· ^ (n + 1)) = Matrix.hadamard (M.map (· ^ n)) M := by
      ext i j
      simp [pow_succ]
    rw [h]
    exact (posSemidef_map_pow hM n).hadamard hM

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_map_exp
statement:
theorem posSemidef_map_exp {M : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hM : M.PosSemidef) :
    (M.map Real.exp).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  refine posSemidef_of_real (fun i j => by simp [PosSemidef.real_symm hM i j]) fun x => ?_
  have hterm : ∀ i j, HasSum (fun n : ℕ => x i * (M i j ^ n / n !) * x j)
      (x i * Real.exp (M i j) * x j) := by
    intro i j
    have h := NormedSpace.expSeries_div_hasSum_exp (M i j)
    rw [← congrFun Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ] at h
    exact (h.mul_left (x i)).mul_right (x j)
  have hsum : HasSum
      (fun n : ℕ => x.sum fun i a => x.sum fun j b => a * (M i j ^ n / n !) * b)
      (x.sum fun i a => x.sum fun j b => a * M.map Real.exp i j * b) := by
    simp only [Finsupp.sum, Matrix.map_apply]
    exact hasSum_sum fun i _ => hasSum_sum fun j _ => hterm i j
  refine hsum.nonneg fun n => ?_
  have hn := PosSemidef.real_quad
    ((posSemidef_map_pow hM n).smul (a := ((n ! : ℝ)⁻¹)) (by positivity)) x
  refine hn.trans_eq ?_
  simp only [Finsupp.sum, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.map_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_diag_mul_mul_diag
statement:
theorem posSemidef_diag_mul_mul_diag {M : Matrix ι ι ℝ} (hM : M.PosSemidef) (d : ι → ℝ) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j => d i * M i j * d j).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (Matrix.of fun i j => d i * M i j * d j) =
      Matrix.hadamard (Matrix.of fun i j => ⟪d i, d j⟫_ℝ) M := by
    ext i j
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.hadamard_apply, Real.inner_apply]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  exact (posSemidef_innerKernel d).hadamard hM

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_gaussianGram
statement: theorem posSemidef_gaussianGram (σ : ℝ) (v : ι → E) : (gaussianGram σ v).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * (2 * σ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by positivity
  have h := posSemidef_diag_mul_mul_diag
    (posSemidef_map_exp ((posSemidef_innerKernel v).smul hc))
    (fun i => Real.exp (-(2 * σ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖v i‖ ^ 2))
  convert h using 1
  ext i j
  simp only [gaussianGram, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.map_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  rw [norm_sub_sq_real]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.kernel_eq_gaussian
statement:
theorem kernel_eq_gaussian (σ : ℝ) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    kernel σ p q =
      Real.exp (-‖WithLp.toLp 2 p - WithLp.toLp 2 q‖ ^ 2 / (2 * σ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [kernel, WithLp.prod_norm_sq_eq_of_L2]
  simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.kernel_symm
statement: theorem kernel_symm (σ : ℝ) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) : kernel σ p q = kernel σ q p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kernel]
  congr 1
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.kernel_self
statement: @[simp] theorem kernel_self (σ : ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) : kernel σ p p = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [kernel]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.kernel_pos
statement: theorem kernel_pos (σ : ℝ) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) : 0 < kernel σ p q
proof: := Real.exp_pos _

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.kernel_le_one
statement: theorem kernel_le_one (σ : ℝ) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) : kernel σ p q ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg ?_ (by positivity))
  exact neg_nonpos.mpr (by positivity)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_kernel
statement:
theorem posSemidef_kernel (σ : ℝ) :
    (Matrix.of (kernel σ) : Matrix (ℝ × ℝ) (ℝ × ℝ) ℝ).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have h := posSemidef_gaussianGram σ (WithLp.toLp 2 : ℝ × ℝ → WithLp 2 (ℝ × ℝ))
  convert h using 1
  ext p q
  simp only [Matrix.of_apply, gaussianGram, kernel_eq_gaussian]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_kernel_family
statement:
theorem posSemidef_kernel_family {I : Type*} (σ : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j => kernel σ (x i) (x j)).PosSemidef
proof:
:=
  (posSemidef_kernel σ).submatrix x

name: TDA.Persistence.Diagram.IsPositive.finiteOccurrence
statement:
theorem Diagram.IsPositive.finiteOccurrence {D : Diagram ℝ} (hD : D.IsPositive)
    (p : D.finiteOccurrences) : p.1.1 < p.1.2
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p.1 ∈ finitePart D.points := Multiset.coe_mem (x := p)
  obtain ⟨⟨b, d⟩, hbd, he⟩ := (Multiset.mem_filterMap _ _).mp hp
  cases d with
  | top => simp at he
  | coe d =>
    have hpos := hD (b, (d : WithTop ℝ)) hbd
    simp at he
    rw [← he]
    simpa using hpos

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage_eq_zero_of_finitePart_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finiteDiagramImage_eq_zero_of_finitePart_eq_zero
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {A B : ℝ} (σ : ℝ) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (D : Diagram ℝ) (hD : finitePart D.points = 0) :
    finiteDiagramImage σ w P D = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : IsEmpty D.finiteOccurrences := by
    change IsEmpty (finitePart D.points)
    rw [hD]
    infer_instance
  exact finiteFeatureSum_empty _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck
statement:
theorem norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ A B : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hD : D.IsPositive) (hE : E.IsPositive)
    (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    ‖finiteDiagramImage σ w P D - finiteDiagramImage σ w P E‖ ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (bottleneck D E).toReal
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B * finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost
        (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1) (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1) :=
      norm_image_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost hσ hA hB w P hm hd _ _
        hD.finiteOccurrence hE.finiteOccurrence
    _ ≤ _ := by
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_card_mul_bottleneck D E hfinite)
        (stabilityConstant_nonneg hσ hA hB)

name: TDA.Persistence.CechWeightedKernelExamples.MovedPoint.bottleneck_bounds
statement:
theorem bottleneck_bounds (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n) < ⊤ ∧
      (bottleneck (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n)).toReal ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Cech.bottleneck_dgm_lt_top ℚ p q n, ?_⟩
  simpa only [displacement_eq] using Cech.toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement ℚ p q n

name: TDA.Persistence.CechWeightedKernelExamples.MovedPoint.kernel_bounds
statement:
theorem kernel_bounds (n : ℕ) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧
    |WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n)| ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa only [displacement_eq, mul_one] using
      Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_displacement ℚ p q n σ hA hB w
  · simpa only [displacement_eq, mul_one] using
      Cech.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_displacement ℚ p q n σ τ hA hB w D

name: TDA.Persistence.CechWeightedKernelExamples.MovedPoint.kernel_arctan
statement:
theorem kernel_arctan (n : ℕ) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    |WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel 1 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) D
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel 1 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) D
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n)| ≤
      (2 + √2 * π / 2) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Cech.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_displacement_arctan ℚ p q n 1 1
    zero_le_one D
  rw [displacement_eq, mul_one] at h
  convert h using 2
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.CechWeightedKernelExamples.ThreePoints.arctan_bounds
statement:
theorem arctan_bounds (n : ℕ) {K : Type*} [Fintype K] (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖finiteDiagramImage 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) P (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) -
        finiteDiagramImage 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) P (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      (2 + 3 * √(π / 2)) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one)
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one)
          (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      (2 + √2 * π / 2) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have h := Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_displacement_arctan ℚ p q n one_pos
      zero_le_one P hm hd
    rw [displacement_eq, mul_one] at h
    convert h using 2
    norm_num
  · have h := Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_displacement_arctan ℚ p q n 1 zero_le_one
    rw [displacement_eq, mul_one] at h
    convert h using 2
    norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.CechWeightedKernelExamples.coincide_of_displacement_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem coincide_of_displacement_eq_zero {V : Type} [LinearOrder V] [Fintype V]
    (p q : V → ℝ) (h0 : Cech.displacement p q = 0) {σ' : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ')
    (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (n : ℕ) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) =
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n) ∧
      WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) =
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n) ∧
      finiteDiagramImage σ' w P (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) =
        finiteDiagramImage σ' w P (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_displacement ℚ p q n σ hA hB w
  have h₂ := Cech.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_displacement ℚ p q n σ τ hA hB w D
  have h₃ := Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_displacement ℚ p q n hσ hA hB w P hm hd
  rw [h0, mul_zero] at h₁ h₂ h₃
  exact ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h₁ (norm_nonneg _))),
    sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h₂ (abs_nonneg _))),
    sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm h₃ (norm_nonneg _)))⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechWeightedKernelExamples.self_bounds
statement:
theorem self_bounds (p : Fin 2 → ℝ) {σ' : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ')
    (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (n : ℕ) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n)‖ ≤ 0 ∧
      |WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n)| ≤ 0 ∧
      ‖finiteDiagramImage σ' w P (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) -
        finiteDiagramImage σ' w P (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n)‖ ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_displacement ℚ p p n σ hA hB w
  have h₂ := Cech.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_displacement ℚ p p n σ τ hA hB w D
  have h₃ := Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_displacement ℚ p p n hσ hA hB w P hm hd
  rw [Cech.displacement_self, mul_zero] at h₁ h₂ h₃
  exact ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechWeightedKernelExamples.empty_coincide
statement:
theorem empty_coincide (p q : Fin 0 → ℝ) {σ' : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ')
    (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (n : ℕ) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) =
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n) ∧
      WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) =
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n) ∧
      finiteDiagramImage σ' w P (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter p) n) =
        finiteDiagramImage σ' w P (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter q) n)
proof:
:=
  coincide_of_displacement_eq_zero σ τ hA hB w P p q (Cech.displacement_of_isEmpty p q) hσ hm
    hd n D

name: TDA.Persistence.CechWeightedKernelExamples.Repeated.no_label_metric
statement:
theorem no_label_metric :
    ¬ ∃ d : MetricSpace (Fin 2), ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (pts v) (pts w)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨d, hd⟩
  have h : d.dist 0 1 = 0 := by
    rw [hd]
    simp [pts, TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Repeated.pts]
  have h01 : (0 : Fin 2) = 1 := @eq_of_dist_eq_zero _ d 0 1 h
  exact absurd h01 (by decide)

name: TDA.Persistence.CechWeightedKernelExamples.Repeated.displacement_eq
statement: theorem displacement_eq : Cech.displacement pts twoPoints = 2
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (Cech.displacement_le_iff pts twoPoints 2).2 ⟨zero_le_two, fun v => ?_⟩
    fin_cases v <;>
      norm_num [pts, twoPoints, TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Repeated.pts,
        TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.pts, Real.dist_eq]
  · have h := Cech.dist_le_displacement pts twoPoints 1
    norm_num [pts, twoPoints, TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Repeated.pts,
      TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.pts, Real.dist_eq] at h
    exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.CechWeightedKernelExamples.Repeated.cech_bounds
statement:
theorem cech_bounds {σ' : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ') (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) (n : ℕ) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter twoPoints) n)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter twoPoints) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2 ∧
    |WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n) -
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter twoPoints) n)| ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter twoPoints) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2 ∧
    ‖finiteDiagramImage σ' w P (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n) -
        finiteDiagramImage σ' w P (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter twoPoints) n)‖ ≤
      PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant σ' A B *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter pts) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Cech.filter twoPoints) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) * 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [displacement_eq] using
      Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_displacement ℚ pts twoPoints n σ hA hB w
  · simpa only [displacement_eq] using
      Cech.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_displacement ℚ pts twoPoints n σ τ hA hB w D
  · simpa only [displacement_eq] using
      Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_displacement ℚ pts twoPoints n hσ hA hB w P hm hd

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_finite_postcomp_tests
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_finite_postcomp_tests
    (M : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P)
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) (P := P) M) :
    ∃ S : Set P, S.Finite ∧
      ∀ {X Y : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} (ρ : X ⟶ Y),
        (∀ a ∈ S, Function.Bijective (ρ.app a)) →
          Function.Bijective (fun f : M ⟶ X => f ≫ ρ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hM
  let : Finite D.generators.Carrier := hD.1
  let : Finite D.relations.Carrier := hD.2
  let S : Set P := Set.range D.generators.grade ∪ Set.range D.relations.grade
  refine ⟨S, (Set.finite_range _).union (Set.finite_range _), ?_⟩
  intro X Y ρ hρ
  have hG : ∀ g, Function.Bijective (ρ.app (D.generators.grade g)) :=
    fun g => hρ _ (Or.inl ⟨g, rfl⟩)
  have hY : ∀ y, Function.Injective (ρ.app (D.relations.grade y)) :=
    fun y => (hρ _ (Or.inr ⟨y, rfl⟩)).1
  have hDρ := D.postcomp_bijective_of_birth_bijective_relation_injective ρ hG hY
  constructor
  · intro f g h
    apply (cancel_epi e.hom).mp
    apply hDρ.1
    simpa only [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun q => e.hom ≫ q) h
  · intro f
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hDρ.2 (e.hom ≫ f)
    refine ⟨e.inv ≫ l, ?_⟩
    change (e.inv ≫ l) ≫ ρ = f
    change l ≫ ρ = e.hom ≫ f at hl
    rw [Category.assoc, hl, ← Category.assoc, e.inv_hom_id, Category.id_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_translate
statement:
theorem totalFinitePowerCost_translate
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    M.totalFinitePowerCost p (Prod.map (· + t) (· + t) ∘ x)
      (Prod.map (· + t) (· + t) ∘ y) = M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [totalFinitePowerCost, finitePairCost, diagonalCost,
    Function.comp_apply, Prod.map_fst, Prod.map_snd, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_scale
statement:
theorem totalFinitePowerCost_scale
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    M.totalFinitePowerCost p (scaleFinitePair a ∘ x) (scaleFinitePair a ∘ y) =
      a ^ p * M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalFinitePowerCost totalBoundaryCost
  simp only [Function.comp_apply, finitePairCost_scale _ _ ha, diagonalCost_scale _ ha,
    ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal ha,
    Real.mul_rpow ha ENNReal.toReal_nonneg]
  rw [mul_add, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    cases M.finite i <;> rfl
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_translate
statement:
theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_translate (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    finitePowerMatchingCost p (Prod.map (· + t) (· + t) ∘ x)
      (Prod.map (· + t) (· + t) ∘ y) = finitePowerMatchingCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold finitePowerMatchingCost
  exact iInf_congr fun M => M.totalFinitePowerCost_translate p x y t

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_translate
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_translate (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost p (Prod.map (· + t) (· + t) ∘ x)
      (Prod.map (· + t) (· + t) ∘ y) = finitePMatchingCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finitePMatchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_translate]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_scale
statement:
theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_scale (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    finitePowerMatchingCost p (scaleFinitePair a ∘ x) (scaleFinitePair a ∘ y) =
      a ^ p * finitePowerMatchingCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerMatching p x y
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerMatching p
    (scaleFinitePair a ∘ x) (scaleFinitePair a ∘ y)
  apply le_antisymm
  · calc
      _ ≤ M.totalFinitePowerCost p (scaleFinitePair a ∘ x) (scaleFinitePair a ∘ y) :=
        finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching _ _ _ M
      _ = _ := by rw [M.totalFinitePowerCost_scale p x y ha, hM]
  · calc
      _ ≤ a ^ p * N.totalFinitePowerCost p x y :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching _ _ _ N)
          (Real.rpow_nonneg ha p)
      _ = _ := by rw [← N.totalFinitePowerCost_scale p x y ha, hN]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_scale
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_scale {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    finitePMatchingCost p (scaleFinitePair a ∘ x) (scaleFinitePair a ∘ y) =
      a * finitePMatchingCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans_le hp)
  rw [finitePMatchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_scale p x y ha,
    Real.mul_rpow (Real.rpow_nonneg ha p) (finitePowerMatchingCost_nonneg p x y),
    Real.rpow_rpow_inv ha hp0]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_scale

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.coarse_apply
statement: private theorem coarse_apply (i : Fin 2) : coarse i = if i = 0 then (0 : ℝ) else 2
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.input_constructible
statement: private theorem input_constructible : IsConstructible coarse input
proof:
:= by
  apply isConstructible_reindex
  have : Subsingleton ((intervalModule (k := ℚ) bar).obj 0) := by
    change Subsingleton (FiniteInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) bar 0)
    have hn : ¬ bar.alive 0 := by norm_num [FiniteInterval.alive, bar]
    simp only [FiniteInterval.fiber, if_neg hn]
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.witness_φ_zero
statement: private theorem witness_φ_zero : witness.φ = 0
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.threshold_fiber_nonzero
statement:
private theorem threshold_fiber_nonzero (t : ℝ) (ht : RealBarcode.alive (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) t) :
    ¬ IsZero (threshold.obj t)
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  let x : RealBarcode.fiber (k := ℚ) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) t :=
    ⟨1, by simp [RealBarcode.fiber, ht]⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun f : threshold.obj t ⟶ threshold.obj t =>
    (show RealBarcode.fiber (k := ℚ) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) t from f.hom x).val)
    (hz.eq_zero_of_src (𝟙 _))
  exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℚ) ≠ 0) h

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.input_nonzero
statement: private theorem input_nonzero : ¬ IsZero input
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  exact threshold_fiber_nonzero 0 (by norm_num [RealBarcode.alive])
    ((h.of_iso intervalIso.symm).obj 0)

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.shifted_input_nonzero
statement: private theorem shifted_input_nonzero : ¬ IsZero ((shift 1).obj input)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hz := h.obj (-1 : ℝ)
  change IsZero (input.obj ((-1 : ℝ) + 1)) at hz
  norm_num at hz
  exact threshold_fiber_nonzero 0 (by norm_num [RealBarcode.alive])
    (hz.of_iso (intervalIso.app 0).symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.nonzero_defects
statement:
theorem nonzero_defects :
    ¬ Mono witness.φ ∧ ¬ Epi witness.φ ∧
      ¬ IsZero (kernel witness.φ) ∧ ¬ IsZero (cokernel witness.φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => input_nonzero (IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero witness.φ witness_φ_zero),
    fun h => shifted_input_nonzero (IsZero.of_epi_eq_zero witness.φ witness_φ_zero), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [witness_φ_zero]
    intro h
    exact input_nonzero (h.of_iso kernelZeroIsoSource.symm)
  · rw [witness_φ_zero]
    intro h
    exact shifted_input_nonzero (h.of_iso cokernelZeroIsoTarget.symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.common_defects
statement:
theorem common_defects :
    let e := commonGrid coarse (shiftGrid 1 coarse)
    IsConstructible e (kernel witness.φ) ∧ IsConstructible e (cokernel witness.φ) ∧
      TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation e (1 + 1)) (le_sampleTranslation e (1 + 1))
        (finiteKernel (reindexNatTrans e.toOrderHom witness.φ)) ∧
      TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation e (1 + 1)) (le_sampleTranslation e (1 + 1))
        (finiteCokernel (reindexNatTrans e.toOrderHom witness.φ))
proof:
:=
  interleaving_critical_defects input_constructible input_constructible witness

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.fine_theta_one
statement: private theorem fine_theta_one : sampleTranslation fine 1 (1 : Fin 4) = 2
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.succ_injective 4
  rw [sampleTranslation_succ]
  apply (cellIndex_eq_succ_iff fine (2 : Fin 4) _).mpr
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change (1 : ℝ) ≤ 0 + 1
    norm_num
  intro j hj
  have hj3 : j = 3 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    have hjn := j.isLt
    change 2 < j.val at hj
    omega
  subst j
  change (0 : ℝ) + 1 < 2
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.threshold_sample_map_nonzero
proof:
:= by
  have hs : RealBarcode.alive (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) (fine (1 : Fin 4)) := by
    change RealBarcode.alive (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) 0
    norm_num [RealBarcode.alive]
  have ht : RealBarcode.alive (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ))
      (fine (sampleTranslation fine 1 (1 : Fin 4))) := by
    rw [fine_theta_one]
    change RealBarcode.alive (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) 1
    norm_num [RealBarcode.alive]
  let x : RealBarcode.fiber (k := ℚ) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) (fine (1 : Fin 4)) :=
    ⟨1, by simp [RealBarcode.fiber, hs]⟩
  intro hz
  have hx := congrArg (fun f : threshold.obj (fine (1 : Fin 4)) ⟶
      threshold.obj (fine (sampleTranslation fine 1 (1 : Fin 4))) =>
    (show RealBarcode.fiber (k := ℚ) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) _ from f.hom x).val) hz
  change (show RealBarcode.fiber (k := ℚ) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) _ from
    ((RealBarcode.intervalModule (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ))).map
      (homOfLE (fine.monotone (le_sampleTranslation fine 1 (1 : Fin 4))))).hom x).val = 0 at hx
  rw [RealBarcode.map_val] at hx
  exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℚ) ≠ 0) (by simpa only [if_pos ht, x] using hx)

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.shorter_parameter_rejected
statement:
theorem shorter_parameter_rejected :
    ¬ TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation fine 1) (le_sampleTranslation fine 1)
      (finiteKernel (reindexNatTrans fine.toOrderHom witness.φ))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hf : reindexNatTrans fine.toOrderHom witness.φ = 0 := by
    rw [witness_φ_zero]
    rfl
  change TranslationTrivial _ _ (kernel _) at h
  rw [hf] at h
  have hi := translationTrivial_of_iso _ _ kernelZeroIsoSource h
  have hr := translationTrivial_of_iso _ _
    (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft fine.toOrderHom.toFunctor intervalIso) hi
  exact threshold_sample_map_nonzero (hr (1 : Fin 4))

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.common_grid_negative

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.sampling_inclusion_projection
statement:
theorem sampling_inclusion_projection :
    (criticalKernelIso fine witness.φ).inv ≫ reindexNatTrans fine.toOrderHom (kernel.ι witness.φ) =
      kernel.ι (reindexNatTrans fine.toOrderHom witness.φ) ∧
    reindexNatTrans fine.toOrderHom (cokernel.π witness.φ) ≫ (criticalCokernelIso fine witness.φ).hom =
      cokernel.π (reindexNatTrans fine.toOrderHom witness.φ)

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.irregular_apply
statement:

    irregular i = if i = 0 then (-3 : ℝ) else if i = 1 then 0 else 10

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.small_first
statement: private theorem small_first : sampleTranslation irregular 1 (0 : Fin 3) = 0
proof:

  rw [sampleTranslation_succ]
  apply (cellIndex_eq_succ_iff irregular (0 : Fin 3) _).mpr
  refine ⟨by norm_num [irregular_apply], ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  have hjv : (0 : ℕ) < j.val := hj
  fin_cases j <;> norm_num [irregular_apply] at *

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.small_middle
statement: private theorem small_middle : sampleTranslation irregular 1 (1 : Fin 3) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.succ_injective 3
  rw [sampleTranslation_succ]
  apply (cellIndex_eq_succ_iff irregular (1 : Fin 3) _).mpr
  refine ⟨by norm_num [irregular_apply], ?_⟩
  intro j hj
  have hj2 : j = 2 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    have hjn := j.isLt
    change 1 < j.val at hj
    omega
  subst j

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.exact_boundary
statement: private theorem exact_boundary : sampleTranslation irregular 3 (0 : Fin 3) = 1

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.rounding_and_boundaries
statement:
theorem rounding_and_boundaries (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    sampleTranslation irregular 1 (0 : Fin 3) = 0 ∧
    sampleTranslation irregular 1 (1 : Fin 3) = 1 ∧
    sampleTranslation irregular 3 (0 : Fin 3) = 1 ∧
    irregular (sampleTranslation irregular 1 (1 : Fin 3)) < irregular 1 + 1 ∧
    sampleTranslation irregular δ (Fin.last 2) = Fin.last 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨small_first, small_middle, exact_boundary, ?_, sampleTranslation_last _ _⟩
  rw [small_middle]
  norm_num [irregular_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.oneGrid_apply
statement: private theorem oneGrid_apply (i : Fin 1) : oneGrid i = (0 : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.essential_constructible

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.essential_last_nonzero
statement: private theorem essential_last_nonzero : ¬ IsZero (essentialInput.obj 10)
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hr := hz.of_iso (essentialIso.app 10).symm
  have ha : RealBarcode.alive ((0 : ℝ), (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) 10 :=
    ⟨by norm_num, WithTop.coe_lt_top 10⟩
  let x : RealBarcode.fiber (k := ℚ) (0, ⊤) 10 :=
    ⟨1, by simp [RealBarcode.fiber, ha]⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun f : (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := ℚ) (0, ⊤)).obj 10 ⟶
      (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := ℚ) (0, ⊤)).obj 10 =>
    (show RealBarcode.fiber (k := ℚ) (0, ⊤) 10 from f.hom x).val)
    (hr.eq_zero_of_src (𝟙 _))
  exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℚ) ≠ 0) h

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.essential_tail_rejected
statement:
theorem essential_tail_rejected : IsConstructible irregular essentialInput ∧
    ∀ δ : ℝ≥0, ¬ TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation irregular δ)
      (le_sampleTranslation irregular δ) (reindex irregular.toOrderHom essentialInput)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Refines oneGrid irregular := by
    rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨1, by norm_num [oneGrid_apply, irregular_apply]⟩
  refine ⟨essential_constructible.refine hr, ?_⟩
  intro δ h
  have hz := h (Fin.last 2)
  have : IsIso (homOfLE (le_sampleTranslation irregular δ (Fin.last 2))) :=
    homOfLE_isIso_of_eq _ (sampleTranslation_last irregular δ).symm
  have : IsIso (structureMap (reindex irregular.toOrderHom essentialInput)
      (le_sampleTranslation irregular δ (Fin.last 2))) := by
    unfold structureMap
    infer_instance
  apply essential_last_nonzero
  change IsZero ((reindex irregular.toOrderHom essentialInput).obj (Fin.last 2))
  exact IsZero.of_mono_eq_zero _ hz

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.zero_of_zero_double_transition
statement:
private theorem zero_of_zero_double_transition {A : PModule.{0,0,0} ℚ ℝ}
    (h : transition (0 + 0) A = 0) : IsZero A
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero A).mpr
  have hz : transition 0 A = 0 := by
    rw [← transition_congr (show (0 : ℝ≥0) + 0 = 0 from zero_add 0) A, h, zero_comp]
  have ht := transition_zero A
  rw [hz, zero_comp] at ht
  exact ht.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.zero_parameter
statement:
theorem zero_parameter : ¬ IsZero input ∧ IsZero (kernel zeroWitness.φ) ∧
    IsZero (cokernel zeroWitness.φ) ∧
    sampleTranslation coarse 0 = OrderHom.id ∧
    TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation coarse 0) (le_sampleTranslation coarse 0)
      (finiteKernel (reindexNatTrans coarse.toOrderHom zeroWitness.φ)) ∧
    TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation coarse 0) (le_sampleTranslation coarse 0)
      (finiteCokernel (reindexNatTrans coarse.toOrderHom zeroWitness.φ))
proof:
:= by
  have ht : IsConstructible coarse ((shift 0).obj input) := by
    simpa only [shiftGrid_zero] using input_constructible.shift 0
  have hk := zero_of_zero_double_transition zeroWitness.kernel_transition_eq_zero
  have hc := zero_of_zero_double_transition zeroWitness.cokernel_transition_eq_zero
  exact ⟨input_nonzero, hk, hc, sampleTranslation_zero _,
    criticalKernel_translationTrivial input_constructible ht _ 0
      (hk.eq_zero_of_src _),
    criticalCokernel_translationTrivial input_constructible ht _ 0
      (hc.eq_zero_of_src _)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.empty_grid
statement:
theorem empty_grid (δ : ℝ≥0) : sampleTranslation empty δ = OrderHom.id ∧
    (∀ t, IsZero (zeroInput.obj t)) ∧
    TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation empty δ) (le_sampleTranslation empty δ)
      (finiteKernel (reindexNatTrans empty.toOrderHom (𝟙 zeroInput))) ∧
    TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation empty δ) (le_sampleTranslation empty δ)
      (finiteCokernel (reindexNatTrans empty.toOrderHom (𝟙 zeroInput)))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, (isConstructible_empty_iff _ _).mp empty_constructible,
    fun i => Fin.elim0 i, fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩
  apply DFunLike.ext
  intro i
  exact Fin.elim0 i

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.matching_critical_finite

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.shifted_induced_matching
statement:
theorem shifted_induced_matching :
    ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching (moduleDiagram coarse input matching_critical_finite).finiteOccurrences
        (translateDiagram (moduleDiagram coarse input matching_critical_finite) (-1)).finiteOccurrences
        (moduleDiagram coarse input matching_critical_finite).essentialOccurrences
        (translateDiagram (moduleDiagram coarse input matching_critical_finite) (-1)).essentialOccurrences,
      RealMatchingBounds 2 2 A
proof:
:= by
  have h := interleaving_shifted_induced_matching input_constructible input_constructible
    matching_critical_finite matching_critical_finite witness
  norm_num at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.single_barcode
statement:
private theorem single_barcode {s : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval s) :
    rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I) = {I}
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {I}) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).mpr
      intro i j hij
      rw [rank_barcodeMap]
      change Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (intervalMap (k := ℚ) I hij)) = _
      rw [intervalMap_finrank_range]
      simp [interval_alive_endpoints_iff I hij, ← Multiset.cons_zero, Multiset.countP_cons]
    _ = {I} := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.pullback_points
proof:
:= by
  let t : Fin s →o Fin (s + 1) := (cellIndex c).comp c.toOrderHom
  have ht : t = (Fin.succOrderEmb s).toOrderHom := by
    apply DFunLike.ext
    intro j
    exact cellIndex_critical c j
  unfold moduleDiagram
  change (ofIndexBars c c.strictMono
    (rankBarcode (reindex t (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)))).points = _
  rw [rankBarcode_reindex, single_barcode, ht, RealBarcode.ofIndexBars_points]
  rw [← Multiset.cons_zero]
  simp only [reindexBarcode, Multiset.filterMap_cons_some _ _ _ (RealBarcode.restrictAlong_succ I hI),
    Multiset.filterMap_zero, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.map_zero]
  exact Multiset.cons_zero _

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.input_points
statement:
private theorem input_points : (moduleDiagram coarse input matching_critical_finite).points =
    {((0 : ℝ), (2 : WithTop ℝ))}

  pullback_points coarse bar (by decide) matching_critical_finite

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.threshold_cost_attained
statement:
theorem threshold_cost_attained :
    ∃ p, threshold_matching.finite p = none ∧ p.1 = (0, 2) ∧ diagonalCost p.1 = 1 ∧
      threshold_matching.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1)
        (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hc : (finitePart (moduleDiagram coarse input matching_critical_finite).points).count (0, 2) = 1 := by
    rw [input_points]
    change ({((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ))} : Multiset (ℝ × ℝ)).count (0, 2) = 1
    simp
  let p : (moduleDiagram coarse input matching_critical_finite).finiteOccurrences :=
    ⟨(0, 2), ⟨0, by rw [hc]; decide⟩⟩
  have hn : threshold_matching.finite p = none := by
    cases h : threshold_matching.finite p with
    | none => rfl
    | some q =>
      have hq : q.1 ∈ finitePart (moduleDiagram empty zeroInput (fun j => Fin.elim0 j)).points :=
        Multiset.coe_mem
      have he := moduleDiagram_empty_grid empty zeroInput
      have hm := Eq.mp (congrArg (fun s : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ) => q.1 ∈ finitePart s) he) hq
      simp [finitePart] at hm
  have hd : diagonalCost p.1 = 1 := by norm_num [p, diagonalCost]
  refine ⟨p, hn, rfl, hd, le_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · exact interleavingMatching_cost_le input_constructible empty_constructible
      matching_critical_finite (fun j => Fin.elim0 j) zero_target_witness
  · have h := threshold_matching.source_le_cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1)
      (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) p
    simpa only [hn, hd] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.essential_critical_finite
statement:
private theorem essential_critical_finite (j : Fin 1) :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (essentialInput.obj (oneGrid j))
proof:
:= by
  change FiniteDimensional ℚ ((intervalModule (k := ℚ) essentialBar).obj (cellIndex oneGrid (oneGrid j)))
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleDefectExamples.essential_zero_infinite
statement:
theorem essential_zero_infinite :
    realInterleavingDistance essentialInput zeroInput = ⊤ ∧
      bottleneck (moduleDiagram oneGrid essentialInput essential_critical_finite)
        (moduleDiagram empty zeroInput (fun j => Fin.elim0 j)) = ⊤ ∧
      (∀ ε : ℝ≥0, IsEmpty (RealInterleaving ε essentialInput zeroInput)) ∧
      IsEmpty (OccurrenceMatching (moduleDiagram oneGrid essentialInput essential_critical_finite).finiteOccurrences
        (moduleDiagram empty zeroInput (fun j => Fin.elim0 j)).finiteOccurrences
        (moduleDiagram oneGrid essentialInput essential_critical_finite).essentialOccurrences
        (moduleDiagram empty zeroInput (fun j => Fin.elim0 j)).essentialOccurrences)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (moduleDiagram oneGrid essentialInput essential_critical_finite).points =
      {((0 : ℝ), (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))} :=
    pullback_points oneGrid essentialBar (by decide) essential_critical_finite
  have hcard : (essentialPart (moduleDiagram oneGrid essentialInput essential_critical_finite).points).card ≠
      (essentialPart (moduleDiagram empty zeroInput (fun j => Fin.elim0 j)).points).card := by
    rw [hp, moduleDiagram_empty_grid]
    change ({(0 : ℝ)} : Multiset ℝ).card ≠ (0 : Multiset ℝ).card
    simp
  have hi := (distance_eq_top_iff_essential_card_ne essential_constructible empty_constructible
    essential_critical_finite (fun j => Fin.elim0 j)).mpr hcard
  refine ⟨hi, ?_, realInterleavingDistance_eq_top_iff.mp hi, ?_⟩
  · rw [bottleneck_eq_distance essential_constructible empty_constructible
      essential_critical_finite (fun j => Fin.elim0 j), hi]
  · apply not_nonempty_iff.mp
    rw [occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff]
    simpa only [Multiset.card_coe] using hcard

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureExamples.ephemeral_strict_map

private theorem ephemeral_strict_map {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) :
    structureMapLinear (ephemeralModule (k := k)) hab.le = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureExamples.infinite_ephemeral_qTame
statement: theorem infinite_ephemeral_qTame : (ephemeralModule (k := k)).QTame

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureExamples.infinite_ephemeral_not_finiteDimensional

  exact not_finite ℕ
