name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureExamples.intervalImage_rank
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := structureMapLinear (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) p) hst
  by_cases h : RealBarcode.alive p s ∧ RealBarcode.alive p t
  · rw [if_pos h]
    have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
      intro y
      let x : RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) p s :=
        ⟨y.val, by simp [RealBarcode.fiber, h.1]⟩
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext
      simpa [f, structureMapLinear, structureMap, h.2] using
        RealBarcode.map_val p (homOfLE hst) x
    change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range f) = 1
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hf, finrank_top]
    change Module.finrank k (RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) p t) = 1
    rw [show RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) p t = ⊤ by
      unfold RealBarcode.fiber
      exact if_pos h.2]
    rw [finrank_top]
    exact Module.finrank_self k
  · rw [if_neg h]
    have hf : f = 0 := by
      ext x
      apply Subtype.ext
      change (f x).val = 0
      have hv : (f x).val = if RealBarcode.alive p t then x.val else 0 :=
        RealBarcode.map_val p (homOfLE hst) x
      rw [hv]
      by_cases ht : RealBarcode.alive p t
      · rw [if_pos ht]
        have hs : ¬ RealBarcode.alive p s := fun hs => h ⟨hs, ht⟩
        have hx : (show RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) p s from x).val = 0 := by
          simpa only [RealBarcode.fiber, if_neg hs, Submodule.mem_bot] using
            (show RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) p s from x).property
        exact hx
      · rw [if_neg ht]
    change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range f) = 0
    rw [hf, LinearMap.range_zero]
    exact finrank_bot k _

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureExamples.upper_edges_count_one
statement:
theorem upper_edges_count_one :
    persistenceMeasureValue (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)))
      (show (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 0 by norm_num) (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)
      (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := persistenceMeasureValue_four_rank
    (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)))
    (show (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 0 by norm_num) (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)
    (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
  simp only [intervalImage_rank] at h
  norm_num [RealBarcode.alive] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureExamples.lower_birth_edge_count_zero
statement:
theorem lower_birth_edge_count_zero :

      (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num) (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2 by norm_num)
      (show (3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := persistenceMeasureValue_four_rank
    (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)))
    (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num) (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2 by norm_num)
    (show (3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
  simp only [intervalImage_rank] at h
  norm_num [RealBarcode.alive] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureExamples.essential_interval_finite_rectangle_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h := persistenceMeasureValue_four_rank
    (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, ⊤)) hab hbc hcd
  simp only [intervalImage_rank, RealBarcode.alive, WithTop.coe_lt_top, and_true] at h
  have h₁ : (0 ≤ b ∧ 0 ≤ c) ↔ 0 ≤ b :=
    ⟨And.left, fun hb => ⟨hb, hb.trans hbc⟩⟩
  have h₂ : (0 ≤ a ∧ 0 ≤ c) ↔ 0 ≤ a :=
    ⟨And.left, fun ha => ⟨ha, (ha.trans hab).trans hbc⟩⟩
  have h₃ : (0 ≤ b ∧ 0 ≤ d) ↔ 0 ≤ b :=
    ⟨And.left, fun hb => ⟨hb, (hb.trans hbc).trans hcd⟩⟩
  have h₄ : (0 ≤ a ∧ 0 ≤ d) ↔ 0 ≤ a :=
    ⟨And.left, fun ha => ⟨ha, ((ha.trans hab).trans hbc).trans hcd⟩⟩
  simp only [h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄] at h
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureExamples.essential_interval_count_one
statement:
theorem essential_interval_count_one :
    essentialMeasureValue (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, ⊤))
      (show (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 0 by norm_num) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, h⟩ := exists_tail_eq_essentialMeasureValue
    (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, ⊤)) (show (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 0 by norm_num)
  have ht := persistenceTailMeasureValue_add_image
    (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, ⊤))
    (show (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 0 by norm_num) hc.le
  simp only [intervalImage_rank] at ht
  norm_num [RealBarcode.alive, hc.le] at ht
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelResolutionExamples.hook_finiteDimensional
statement:
private theorem hook_finiteDimensional (a : Fin 0 → ℝ) :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ ((hookModule).obj a)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelResolutionExamples.hook_projective
statement: private theorem hook_projective : IsRankProjective hookModule
proof:
:=

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelResolutionExamples.zeroIdRankExact
proof:
:= by
  have hshort : IsPointwiseShortExact (0 : zeroModule ⟶ P) (𝟙 P) := by
    constructor
    · intro a x y _
      exact (ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj a)).elim x y
    · intro a x
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    · intro a
      simp
  exact hshort.rankExact_of_section (𝟙 P) (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelResolutionExamples.idZeroRankExact
proof:
:= by
  have hshort : IsPointwiseShortExact (𝟙 P) (0 : P ⟶ zeroModule) := by
    constructor
    · intro _ x y h
      exact h
    · intro a y
      have hzero : Subsingleton (zeroModule.obj a) :=
        ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj a)
      exact ⟨0, hzero.elim _ _⟩
    · intro a
      simp
  exact hshort.rankExact_of_section (0 : zeroModule ⟶ P) (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuelResolutionExamples.twoTermRows
statement:
private theorem twoTermRows :
    ∀ i : Fin 2, IsRankExact (twoTermInclusion i) (twoTermQuotient i)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ i
  · change IsRankExact (𝟙 hookModule) (0 : hookModule ⟶ zeroModule)
    exact idZeroRankExact hookModule
  · intro j
    have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    subst j
    change IsRankExact (0 : zeroModule ⟶ hookModule) (𝟙 hookModule)
    exact zeroIdRankExact hookModule

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.natural_map_structure
statement:
private theorem natural_map_structure {F G : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (η : F ⟶ G) {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b) (x : F.obj a) :
    (η.app b).hom (structureMapLinear F hab x) =
      structureMapLinear G hab ((η.app a).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := congrArg (fun φ : F.obj a ⟶ G.obj b => φ.hom x)
    (η.naturality (homOfLE hab))
  exact hn

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.structureMap_apply_comp
statement:
private theorem structureMap_apply_comp (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P)
    {a b c : P} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (x : M.obj a) :
    structureMapLinear M hbc (structureMapLinear M hab x) =
      structureMapLinear M (hab.trans hbc) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← structureMapLinear_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le
proof:
:= by
  apply (faceJoin_le_iff g A (faceJoin f A)).mpr
  intro i hi
  exact (h i).trans (Finset.le_sup' (f := f) hi)

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.faceMap_birth
statement:
@[simp] theorem faceMap_birth {m : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) {r : ℕ} (A : FaceIndex m r) :
    ((faceMap (k := k) h A).app (faceJoin f A)).hom
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)) =
      structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g A) (faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h A)
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g A))
proof:
:=
  HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.faceMap_basis
statement:
private theorem faceMap_basis {m : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) {r : ℕ} (A : FaceIndex m r) {p : P}
    (hf : faceJoin f A ≤ p) :
    ((faceMap (k := k) h A).app p).hom
        (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f A) hf
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) =
      structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g A)
        ((faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h A).trans hf)
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g A))
proof:
:= by
  have hn := congrArg (fun φ : (faceModule (k := k) f A).obj (faceJoin f A) ⟶
      (faceModule (k := k) g A).obj p => φ.hom (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)))
    ((faceMap (k := k) h A).naturality (homOfLE hf))
  change ((faceMap (k := k) h A).app p).hom
      (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f A) hf
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) =
    structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g A) hf
      (((faceMap (k := k) h A).app (faceJoin f A)).hom
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) at hn
  calc
    _ = structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g A) hf
        (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g A)
          (faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h A)
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g A))) := by
          rw [hn, faceMap_birth]
    _ = structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g A)
        ((faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h A).trans hf)
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g A)) := by
          rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← structureMapLinear_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.faceMap_fiberCoefficient
proof:
:= by
  let eF := HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hf
  let eG := HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k)
    ((faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h A).trans hf)
  let x₀ := structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f A) hf
    (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))
  let y₀ := structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g A)
    ((faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h A).trans hf)
    (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g A))
  have hx₀ : eF x₀ = 1 := by
    rw [HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe_apply]
    change (structureMapLinear
      (GradedFree.module (R := k) (HookInfinity.generators (faceJoin f A))) hf
      (GradedFree.birth (R := k) (HookInfinity.generators (faceJoin f A)) ())).val () = 1
    have hval : (structureMapLinear
        (GradedFree.module (R := k) (HookInfinity.generators (faceJoin f A))) hf
        (GradedFree.birth (R := k) (HookInfinity.generators (faceJoin f A)) ())).val =
      (GradedFree.birth (R := k) (HookInfinity.generators (faceJoin f A)) ()).val := rfl
    rw [hval]
    simp [HookInfinity.generators, GradedFree.birth, GradedFree.generator]
  have hy₀ : eG y₀ = 1 := by
    rw [HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe_apply]
    change (structureMapLinear
      (GradedFree.module (R := k) (HookInfinity.generators (faceJoin g A)))
      ((faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h A).trans hf)
      (GradedFree.birth (R := k) (HookInfinity.generators (faceJoin g A)) ())).val () = 1
    have hval : (structureMapLinear
        (GradedFree.module (R := k) (HookInfinity.generators (faceJoin g A)))
        ((faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h A).trans hf)
        (GradedFree.birth (R := k) (HookInfinity.generators (faceJoin g A)) ())).val =
      (GradedFree.birth (R := k) (HookInfinity.generators (faceJoin g A)) ()).val := rfl
    rw [hval]
    simp [HookInfinity.generators, GradedFree.birth, GradedFree.generator]
  have hx : x = eF x • x₀ := by
    apply eF.injective
    simp [hx₀]
  conv_lhs => rw [hx]
  calc
    eG (((faceMap (k := k) h A).app p).hom (eF x • x₀)) =
        eG (eF x • ((faceMap (k := k) h A).app p).hom x₀) := by rw [map_smul]
    _ = eF x • eG (((faceMap (k := k) h A).app p).hom x₀) := by rw [map_smul]
    _ = eF x := by
      rw [faceMap_basis]
      have hy : eG (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g A)
          ((faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h A).trans hf)
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g A))) = 1 := by
        simpa [y₀] using hy₀
      rw [hy]
      simp

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.faceMap_app_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  by_cases hf : faceJoin f A ≤ p
  · apply (HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hf).injective
    have hcoef := congrArg (HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k)
      ((faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h A).trans hf)) hxy
    rw [faceMap_fiberCoefficient (k := k) h A hf x,
      faceMap_fiberCoefficient (k := k) h A hf y] at hcoef
    exact hcoef
  · have hx := HookInfinity.fiber_eq_zero_of_not_le (R := k) hf x
    have hy := HookInfinity.fiber_eq_zero_of_not_le (R := k) hf y
    exact hx.trans hy.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.faceMap_mono
proof:
:= by
  apply (NatTrans.mono_iff_mono_app _).2
  intro p
  exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).2 (faceMap_app_injective (k := k) h A p)

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.principalBirth_coefficient
statement:
theorem principalBirth_coefficient {i p : P} (h : i ≤ p) :
    HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) h
      (structureMapLinear (HookInfinity.module (R := k) i) h
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) i)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe_apply, HookInfinity.birth,
    HookInfinity.generators, GradedFree.birth, GradedFree.generator] using
      (HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe_structureMap (R := k)
        (le_rfl : i ≤ i) h (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) i))

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.faceMap_identity
statement:
theorem faceMap_identity {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) {r : ℕ} (A : FaceIndex m r) :
    faceMap (k := k) (fun _ => le_rfl) A = 𝟙 (faceModule (k := k) f A)
proof:
:= by
  apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
  simp [faceMap_birth, structureMapLinear_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.faceMap_comp
proof:
:= by
  let hgf := faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le hfg A
  let hvgA := faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le hvg A
  let hvf := faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le (fun i => (hvg i).trans (hfg i)) A
  apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
  apply (HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hvf).injective
  have hleft : HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hvf
      (((faceMap (k := k) hfg A ≫ faceMap (k := k) hvg A).app (faceJoin f A)).hom
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) = 1 := by
    have hfirst := faceMap_birth (k := k) hfg A
    have hsecond := faceMap_fiberCoefficient (k := k) hvg A hgf
      (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g A) hgf
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g A)))
    have hcoeff : HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hgf
        (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g A) hgf
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g A))) = 1 := by
      simpa using principalBirth_coefficient (k := k) hgf
    rw [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.comp_apply, hfirst]
    simpa [hgf, hvf, hvgA, hsecond] using hcoeff
  have hright : HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hvf
      (((faceMap (k := k) (fun i => (hvg i).trans (hfg i)) A).app
        (faceJoin f A)).hom (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) = 1 := by
    rw [faceMap_birth]
    simpa [hvf] using principalBirth_coefficient (k := k) hvf
  rw [hleft, hright]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.faceMap_inclusion_square
statement:
private theorem faceMap_inclusion_square {m : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) {r s : ℕ} (A : FaceIndex m r) (B : FaceIndex m s)
    (hBA : B.1 ⊆ A.1) :
    faceMap (k := k) h A ≫ inclusion (k := k) g A B hBA =
      inclusion (k := k) f A B hBA ≫ faceMap (k := k) h B
proof:
:= by
  let hgfA := faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h A
  let hgfB := faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h B
  let hfBA := faceJoin_mono f A B hBA
  let hgBA := faceJoin_mono g A B hBA
  let hleft := hgfB.trans hfBA
  let hright := hgBA.trans hgfA
  apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.comp_apply]
  rw [faceMap_birth]
  calc
    ((inclusion (k := k) g A B hBA).app (faceJoin f A)).hom
        (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g A) hgfA
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g A))) =
      structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g B) hgfA
        (((inclusion (k := k) g A B hBA).app (faceJoin g A)).hom
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g A))) := by
            exact natural_map_structure (inclusion (k := k) g A B hBA) hgfA _
    _ = structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g B) hgfA
        (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g B) hgBA
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g B))) := by rw [inclusion_birth]
    _ = structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g B) hleft
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g B)) := by
          rw [structureMap_apply_comp]
    _ = structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g B) hright
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g B)) := by
          rfl
    _ = structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g B) hfBA
        (((faceMap (k := k) h B).app (faceJoin f B)).hom
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f B))) := by
            rw [faceMap_birth, structureMap_apply_comp]
    _ = ((faceMap (k := k) h B).app (faceJoin f A)).hom
        (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) f B) hfBA
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f B))) := by
            symm
            exact natural_map_structure (faceMap (k := k) h B) hfBA _
    _ = ((faceMap (k := k) h B).app (faceJoin f A)).hom
        (((inclusion (k := k) f A B hBA).app (faceJoin f A)).hom
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) := by rw [inclusion_birth]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.faceMap_signedDeletionAt
statement:
private theorem faceMap_signedDeletionAt {m r : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) (A : FaceIndex m (r + 1)) (j : Fin (r + 2)) :
    faceMap (k := k) h A ≫ signedDeletionAt (k := k) g A j =
      signedDeletionAt (k := k) f A j ≫
        faceMap (k := k) h (eraseFaceAt A j)
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext p
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp only [signedDeletionAt, scalarMultiple, NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.comp_apply]
  have hsquare := congrArg (fun φ : faceModule (k := k) f A ⟶
      faceModule (k := k) g (eraseFaceAt A j) => (φ.app p).hom x)
    (faceMap_inclusion_square (k := k) h A (eraseFaceAt A j)
      (eraseFaceAt_subset A j))
  change ((-1 : k) ^ (j : ℕ) •
      ((inclusion (k := k) g A (eraseFaceAt A j) (eraseFaceAt_subset A j)).app p).hom)
      (((faceMap (k := k) h A).app p).hom x) =
    ((faceMap (k := k) h (eraseFaceAt A j)).app p).hom
      (((-1 : k) ^ (j : ℕ) •
        ((inclusion (k := k) f A (eraseFaceAt A j) (eraseFaceAt_subset A j)).app p).hom) x)
  conv_rhs => rw [LinearMap.smul_apply]
  rw [map_smul]
  exact congrArg (fun y => (-1 : k) ^ (j : ℕ) • y) hsquare

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.resolutionMap_ι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem resolutionMap_ι {m : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) (r : ℕ) (A : FaceIndex m r) :
    biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B) A ≫
        resolutionMap (k := k) h r =
      faceMap (k := k) h A ≫
        biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) g B) A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact biproduct.ι_map (fun A => faceMap (k := k) h A) A

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.resolutionMap_faceBirth
statement:
@[simp] theorem resolutionMap_faceBirth {m : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) (r : ℕ) (A : FaceIndex m r) :
    ((resolutionMap (k := k) h r).app (faceJoin f A)).hom
        ((biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B) A).app
          (faceJoin f A) (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) =
      (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) g B) A).app
        (faceJoin f A)
        (structureMapLinear (faceModule (k := k) g A) (faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h A)
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin g A)))
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (fun φ : faceModule (k := k) f A ⟶ term (k := k) g r =>
      (φ.app (faceJoin f A)).hom (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A)))
    (resolutionMap_ι (k := k) h r A)
  simpa only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.comp_apply, faceMap_birth] using he

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.resolutionMap_mono
statement:
theorem resolutionMap_mono {m : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) (r : ℕ) : Mono (resolutionMap (k := k) h r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : FaceIndex m r → PModule.{u,0,u} k P :=
    fun A => faceModule (k := k) f A
  let G : FaceIndex m r → PModule.{u,0,u} k P :=
    fun A => faceModule (k := k) g A
  letI : HasBiproduct F := inferInstance
  letI : HasBiproduct G := inferInstance
  letI : ∀ A : FaceIndex m r, Mono (faceMap (k := k) (r := r) h A) :=
    fun A => faceMap_mono (k := k) (r := r) h A
  change Mono (biproduct.map (fun A => faceMap (k := k) h A))
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.resolutionMap_app_injective
proof:
:= by
  exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp
    ((NatTrans.mono_iff_mono_app _).mp (resolutionMap_mono (k := k) h r) p)

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.resolutionMap_identity
statement:
theorem resolutionMap_identity {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ) :
    resolutionMap (k := k) (fun _ => le_rfl) r = 𝟙 (term (k := k) f r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply biproduct.hom_ext'
  intro A
  rw [resolutionMap_ι, faceMap_identity]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.resolutionMap_comp
statement:
theorem resolutionMap_comp {m : ℕ} {f g v : Fin m → P}
    (hfg : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) (hvg : ∀ i, v i ≤ g i) (r : ℕ) :
    resolutionMap (k := k) hfg r ≫ resolutionMap (k := k) hvg r =
      resolutionMap (k := k) (fun i => (hvg i).trans (hfg i)) r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply biproduct.hom_ext'
  intro A
  calc
    _ = (faceMap (k := k) hfg A ≫
        biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) g B) A) ≫
          resolutionMap (k := k) hvg r := by
            rw [← Category.assoc, resolutionMap_ι, Category.assoc]
    _ = faceMap (k := k) hfg A ≫
        (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) g B) A ≫
          resolutionMap (k := k) hvg r) := by rw [Category.assoc]
    _ = faceMap (k := k) hfg A ≫
        (faceMap (k := k) hvg A ≫
          biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) v B) A) := by
          rw [resolutionMap_ι]
    _ = (faceMap (k := k) hfg A ≫ faceMap (k := k) hvg A) ≫
        biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) v B) A := by
          rw [← Category.assoc]
    _ = faceMap (k := k) (fun i => (hvg i).trans (hfg i)) A ≫
        biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) v B) A := by
          rw [faceMap_comp]
    _ = biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B) A ≫
        resolutionMap (k := k) (fun i => (hvg i).trans (hfg i)) r := by
          rw [← resolutionMap_ι]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.resolutionMap_differential
statement:
theorem resolutionMap_differential {m : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) (r : ℕ) :
    resolutionMap (k := k) h (r + 1) ≫ differential (k := k) g r =
      differential (k := k) f r ≫ resolutionMap (k := k) h r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply biproduct.hom_ext'
  intro A
  calc
    _ = (faceMap (k := k) h A ≫
        biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m (r + 1) => faceModule (k := k) g B) A) ≫
          differential (k := k) g r := by
            rw [← Category.assoc, resolutionMap_ι, Category.assoc]
    _ = faceMap (k := k) h A ≫
        (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m (r + 1) => faceModule (k := k) g B) A ≫
          differential (k := k) g r) := by rw [Category.assoc]
    _ = faceMap (k := k) h A ≫
        (∑ j : Fin (r + 2), signedDeletionAt (k := k) g A j ≫
          biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) g B)
            (eraseFaceAt A j)) := by rw [differential_ι]
    _ = ∑ j : Fin (r + 2), faceMap (k := k) h A ≫
          (signedDeletionAt (k := k) g A j ≫
            biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) g B)
              (eraseFaceAt A j)) := by rw [Preadditive.comp_sum]
    _ = ∑ j : Fin (r + 2),
          (signedDeletionAt (k := k) f A j ≫
            faceMap (k := k) h (eraseFaceAt A j)) ≫
            biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) g B)
              (eraseFaceAt A j) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        rw [← Category.assoc, faceMap_signedDeletionAt, Category.assoc]
    _ = ∑ j : Fin (r + 2), signedDeletionAt (k := k) f A j ≫
          (faceMap (k := k) h (eraseFaceAt A j) ≫
            biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) g B)
              (eraseFaceAt A j)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        rw [Category.assoc]
    _ = ∑ j : Fin (r + 2), signedDeletionAt (k := k) f A j ≫
          (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B)
              (eraseFaceAt A j) ≫ resolutionMap (k := k) h r) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        rw [← resolutionMap_ι]
    _ = (∑ j : Fin (r + 2), signedDeletionAt (k := k) f A j ≫
          biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) f B)
            (eraseFaceAt A j)) ≫ resolutionMap (k := k) h r := by
        rw [Preadditive.sum_comp]
        simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m (r + 1) => faceModule (k := k) f B) A ≫
          differential (k := k) f r) ≫ resolutionMap (k := k) h r := by
        rw [← differential_ι]
    _ = biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m (r + 1) => faceModule (k := k) f B) A ≫
          (differential (k := k) f r ≫ resolutionMap (k := k) h r) := by
        rw [Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.generatedSupport_mono
statement:
theorem generatedSupport_mono {m : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) : generatedSupport f ⊆ generatedSupport g
proof:
:= by
  rintro p ⟨i, hi⟩
  exact ⟨i, (h i).trans hi⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.generatedSupport_comparison_compat
statement:
private theorem generatedSupport_comparison_compat {m : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) :
    ∀ p q, p ≤ q → p ∈ generatedSupport f → q ∈ generatedSupport g →
      (q ∈ generatedSupport f ↔ p ∈ generatedSupport g)
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hpq hp _
  constructor
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hp
    exact ⟨i, (h i).trans hi⟩
  · intro _
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hp
    exact ⟨i, hi.trans hpq⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.supportMap_app_val
statement:
theorem supportMap_app_val {m : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) {p : P} (hp : p ∈ generatedSupport f)
    (x : SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) (generatedSupport f) p) :
    (((supportMap (k := k) h).app p).hom x : k) = (x : k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [supportMap, SupportInterval.comparison_app_val]
  have hgp : p ∈ generatedSupport g := generatedSupport_mono h hp
  simp [hgp]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.supportMap_app_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  by_cases hp : p ∈ generatedSupport f
  · apply Subtype.ext
    have hx := supportMap_app_val (k := k) h hp x
    have hy := supportMap_app_val (k := k) h hp y
    calc
      (x : k) = (((supportMap (k := k) h).app p).hom x : k) := hx.symm
      _ = (((supportMap (k := k) h).app p).hom y : k) := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
      _ = (y : k) := hy
  · apply Subtype.ext
    rw [SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k) (generatedSupport f) hp x,
      SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k) (generatedSupport f) hp y]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.supportMap_mono
statement:
theorem supportMap_mono {m : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) : Mono (supportMap (k := k) h)
proof:
:= by
  apply (NatTrans.mono_iff_mono_app _).2
  intro p
  exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).2 (supportMap_app_injective (k := k) h p)

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.augmentationComponent_square
statement:
theorem augmentationComponent_square {m : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) (A : FaceIndex m 0) :
    faceMap (k := k) h A ≫ augmentationComponent (k := k) g A =
      augmentationComponent (k := k) f A ≫ supportMap (k := k) h
proof:
:= by
  apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  let p := faceJoin f A
  have hpF : p ∈ generatedSupport f := by
    exact faceJoin_mem_support f A
  have hpG : p ∈ generatedSupport g := generatedSupport_mono h hpF
  have hbirth : faceJoin g A ≤ p := by
    dsimp [p]
    exact faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le h A
  have hleft := augmentationComponent_val (k := k) g A hbirth hpG
  have hright := augmentationComponent_val (k := k) f A (le_rfl) hpF
  change (((augmentationComponent (k := k) g A).app p).hom
      (((faceMap (k := k) h A).app p).hom
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) : k) =
    (((supportMap (k := k) h).app p).hom
      (((augmentationComponent (k := k) f A).app p).hom
        (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) (faceJoin f A))) : k)
  rw [faceMap_birth]
  rw [supportMap_app_val (k := k) h hpF]
  exact hleft.trans hright.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.resolutionMap_augmentation
statement:
theorem resolutionMap_augmentation {m : ℕ} {f g : Fin m → P}
    (h : ∀ i, g i ≤ f i) :
    resolutionMap (k := k) h 0 ≫ augmentation (k := k) g =
      augmentation (k := k) f ≫ supportMap (k := k) h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply biproduct.hom_ext'
  intro A
  calc
    _ = (faceMap (k := k) h A ≫
        biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m 0 => faceModule (k := k) g B) A) ≫
          augmentation (k := k) g := by
            rw [← Category.assoc, resolutionMap_ι, Category.assoc]
    _ = faceMap (k := k) h A ≫
        (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m 0 => faceModule (k := k) g B) A ≫
          augmentation (k := k) g) := by rw [Category.assoc]
    _ = faceMap (k := k) h A ≫ augmentationComponent (k := k) g A := by
          rw [augmentation_ι]
    _ = augmentationComponent (k := k) f A ≫ supportMap (k := k) h := by
          rw [augmentationComponent_square]
    _ = (biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m 0 => faceModule (k := k) f B) A ≫
          augmentation (k := k) f) ≫ supportMap (k := k) h := by
            rw [← augmentation_ι]
    _ = biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m 0 => faceModule (k := k) f B) A ≫
          (augmentation (k := k) f ≫ supportMap (k := k) h) := by
            rw [Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.source_pos
statement: private theorem source_pos (b : Bool) : (source b).1 < (source b).2
proof: := by cases b <;> norm_num [source]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.target_pos
statement: private theorem target_pos (b : Bool) : (target b).1 < (target b).2
proof: := by cases b <;> norm_num [target, source]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.swap_cost
statement: private theorem swap_cost : swap.cost source target PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply swap.cost_le_of
  · intro i
    cases i <;> norm_num [swap, source, target, finitePairCost]
  · intro j
    have hj : ∃ i, swap.finite i = some j := ⟨!j, by cases j <;> rfl⟩
    simp [hj]
  · intro i
    exact i.elim

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.diagram_numeric_eq
statement:
private theorem diagram_numeric_eq {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    bottleneck (diagram x hx) (diagram y hy) =
      presentationBottleneck x y (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_eq_presentation
  · exact (diagram_finitePart x hx).symm
  · exact (diagram_finitePart y hy).symm
  · simp [diagram_essentialPart]
  · simp [diagram_essentialPart]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.shifted_exact_distances
statement:
theorem shifted_exact_distances :
    bottleneck (diagram source source_pos) (diagram target target_pos) = 1 ∧
    realInterleavingDistance (RealBarcode.realize (k := ℚ) (diagram source source_pos))
      (RealBarcode.realize (diagram target target_pos)) = 1 ∧
    RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance (k := ℚ)
      (fun i => halfOpenRectangle (source i) (source_pos i))
      (fun j => halfOpenRectangle (target j) (target_pos j)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hl : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ bottleneck (diagram source source_pos) (diagram target target_pos) := by
    rw [diagram_numeric_eq]
    apply le_iInf
    intro M
    have hs := M.source_le_cost source target Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 false
    apply le_trans _ hs
    cases hi : M.finite false with
    | none => norm_num [hi, diagonalCost, source]
    | some j => cases j <;> norm_num [hi, finitePairCost, source, target]
  have hu : bottleneck (diagram source source_pos) (diagram target target_pos) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [← rectangle_bottleneck_eq_diagram (k := ℚ)]
    exact RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance_le_of_matching
      (isMatching_of_cost (k := ℚ) source target source_pos target_pos 1 swap swap_cost)
  have hd := le_antisymm hu hl
  refine ⟨hd, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← diagram_bottleneck_eq_real_distance, hd]
  · rw [rectangle_bottleneck_eq_diagram, hd]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.copies_pos
statement: private theorem copies_pos (b : Bool) : (copies b).1 < (copies b).2
proof: := by norm_num [copies]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.empty_pos
statement: private theorem empty_pos (i : Fin 0) : (empty i).1 < (empty i).2
proof: := Fin.elim0 i

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.repeated_occurrences
statement:
theorem repeated_occurrences :
    (diagram copies copies_pos).points.count (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) = 2
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [diagram, copies, Multiset.map_const]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.eraseCopies_cost
statement: private theorem eraseCopies_cost : eraseCopies.cost copies empty PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply eraseCopies.cost_le_of
  · intro i
    norm_num [eraseCopies, copies, diagonalCost]
  · intro i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  · intro i
    exact i.elim

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.copies_exact_distance
statement:
theorem copies_exact_distance :
    realInterleavingDistance (RealBarcode.realize (k := ℚ) (diagram copies copies_pos))
      (RealBarcode.realize (diagram empty empty_pos)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← diagram_bottleneck_eq_real_distance, diagram_numeric_eq]
  change presentationBottleneck (fun _ : Bool => ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ))
    (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = 1
  rw [presentationBottleneck_constant_empty]
  norm_num [diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.copies_interleaving_iff
statement:
theorem copies_interleaving_iff (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε
      (RealBarcode.realize (k := ℚ) (diagram copies copies_pos))
      (RealBarcode.realize (diagram empty empty_pos))) ↔ 1 ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨I⟩
    have h := I.distance_le
    rw [copies_exact_distance] at h
    exact ENNReal.coe_le_coe.mp h
  · intro h
    exact ⟨copiesDeletion.mono h⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.farSource_pos
statement: private theorem farSource_pos (i : Unit) : (farSource i).1 < (farSource i).2
proof: := by norm_num [farSource]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.farTarget_pos
statement: private theorem farTarget_pos (i : Unit) : (farTarget i).1 < (farTarget i).2
proof: := by norm_num [farTarget]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.farMatching_actual
statement:
private theorem farMatching_actual : RectangleMatching.IsMatching (k := ℚ) 1
    (fun i => halfOpenRectangle (farSource i) (farSource_pos i))
    (fun j => halfOpenRectangle (farTarget j) (farTarget_pos j)) farMatching
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ _ => ⟨farPair⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    simp [farMatching] at hi
  · intro j hj
    have h := hj ()
    cases j
    simp [farMatching] at h

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.short_far_pruning
statement:
theorem short_far_pruning :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching Unit Unit PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      RectangleMatching.IsMatching (k := ℚ) 1
        (fun i => halfOpenRectangle (farSource i) (farSource_pos i))
        (fun j => halfOpenRectangle (farTarget j) (farTarget_pos j)) M ∧
      M.cost farSource farTarget PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim = 100 ∧
      ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching Unit Unit PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
        A.cost farSource farTarget PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim ≤ 1 ∧ A.finite () = none
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨farMatching, farMatching_actual, ?_, ?_⟩
  · norm_num [OccurrenceMatching.cost, farMatching, farSource, farTarget, finitePairCost]
  · obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_cost_matching farSource farTarget farSource_pos farTarget_pos
      1 farMatching farMatching_actual
    refine ⟨A, hA, ?_⟩
    cases ha : A.finite () with
    | none => rfl
    | some j =>
      have h := (A.source_le_cost farSource farTarget PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim ()).trans hA
      norm_num [ha, farSource, farTarget, finitePairCost] at h

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.Examples.empty_and_reversed_zero
statement:
theorem empty_and_reversed_zero :

name: TDA.Persistence.HookEndomorphismExamples.origin_lt_death
statement: private theorem origin_lt_death : origin < death
proof:
:= by
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne
  · intro i; norm_num [origin, death]
  · intro h
    have h0 := congrFun h 0
    norm_num [origin, death] at h0

name: TDA.Persistence.HookEndomorphismExamples.unbounded_hook
statement:
theorem unbounded_hook :
    Indecomposable (Hook.module (k := ℚ) origin death) ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → (fun i : Fin 2 => if i = 0 then t else 0) ∈
        Hook.support origin death
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Hook.indecomposable origin_lt_death, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  constructor
  · intro i
    simp only [origin]
    split_ifs
    · exact ht
    · exact le_rfl
  · intro h
    have h1 := h 1
    norm_num [death] at h1

name: TDA.Persistence.HookEndomorphismExamples.scalar_composition
statement:
theorem scalar_composition :
    (Hook.endRingEquiv (k := ℚ) origin_lt_death).symm 2 ≫
      (Hook.endRingEquiv (k := ℚ) origin_lt_death).symm 3 =
        (6 : ℚ) • 𝟙 (Hook.module (k := ℚ) origin death)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Hook.endRingEquiv_symm_apply origin_lt_death (6 : ℚ)]
  let e := Hook.endRingEquiv (k := ℚ) origin_lt_death
  apply e.injective
  change e (e.symm 3 * e.symm 2) = e (e.symm 6)
  rw [map_mul, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply, RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply,
    RingEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.HookEndomorphismExamples.repeated_hook_not_indecomposable
statement:
theorem repeated_hook_not_indecomposable :
    ¬ Indecomposable (Hook.module (k := ℚ) origin death ⊞ Hook.module origin death)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rcases h.2 _ _ (Iso.refl _) with h0 | h0 <;>
    exact (Hook.indecomposable (k := ℚ) origin_lt_death).1 h0

name: TDA.Persistence.HookEndomorphismExamples.infinite_death
statement: theorem infinite_death : Indecomposable (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) origin)
proof:
:=
  HookInfinity.indecomposable origin

name: TDA.Persistence.HookEndomorphismExamples.finite_ne_infinite
statement:
theorem finite_ne_infinite :
    ¬ Nonempty (Hook.module (k := ℚ) origin death ≅ HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) origin)
proof:
:=
  Hook.not_nonempty_iso_infinity origin_lt_death

name: TDA.Persistence.HookEndomorphismExamples.recover_finite_endpoints
statement:
theorem recover_finite_endpoints {i j : Fin 2 → ℝ} (hij : i < j)
    (e : Hook.module (k := ℚ) origin death ≅ Hook.module i j) :
    i = origin ∧ j = death
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hi, hj⟩ := Hook.endpoints_eq_of_iso origin_lt_death hij e
  exact ⟨hi.symm, hj.symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.HookEndomorphismExamples.recover_infinite_birth
statement:
theorem recover_infinite_birth {i : Fin 2 → ℝ}
    (e : HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) origin ≅ HookInfinity.module i) : i = origin
proof:
:=
  (HookInfinity.birth_eq_of_iso e).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.HookEndomorphismExamples.characteristic_two
statement:
theorem characteristic_two :
    Indecomposable (Hook.module (k := ZMod 2) (0 : Fin 2) 1) ∧
      (Hook.endRingEquiv (k := ZMod 2) (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) < 1))
        ((1 : ZMod 2) • 𝟙 (Hook.module (k := ZMod 2) (0 : Fin 2) 1) +
          (1 : ZMod 2) • 𝟙 (Hook.module (k := ZMod 2) (0 : Fin 2) 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact Hook.indecomposable (by decide)
  · simp only [one_smul]
    change (Hook.endRingEquiv (k := ZMod 2) (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) < 1))
      ((1 : End (Hook.module (k := ZMod 2) (0 : Fin 2) 1)) + 1) = 0
    rw [map_add, map_one]
    decide

name: TDA.Persistence.HookEndomorphismExamples.degenerate_hook
statement:
theorem degenerate_hook :
    IsZero (Hook.module (k := ℚ) origin origin) ∧
      ¬ Indecomposable (Hook.module (k := ℚ) origin origin)
proof:
:=
  ⟨Hook.isZero_of_le le_rfl, fun h => h.1 (Hook.isZero_of_le le_rfl)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.signedFiniteEndpointDifference_cr_all
statement:
theorem signedFiniteEndpointDifference_cr_all (r : ℕ∞ω) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    CrThroughAllRepresentatives r signedFiniteEndpointDifference D
proof:
:= by
  intro m n z _
  refine ⟨Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.mem_univ z, ?_⟩
  apply contDiffOn_univ.mpr
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ r (fun w : DiagramCoordinates m n =>
      ∑ i : Fin m, ((w.1 i).2 - (w.1 i).1)) := by
    apply ContDiff.sum
    intro i _
    fun_prop
  simpa [Function.comp_def, signedFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ] using hs

name: TDA.Persistence.repeatedEssentialCoordinates_contDiff

theorem repeatedEssentialCoordinates_contDiff (r : ℕ∞ω) :

name: TDA.Persistence.repeatedEssentialCoordinates_equal_births

name: TDA.Persistence.emptyDiagram_scalar_continuous
statement:
theorem emptyDiagram_scalar_continuous (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ)

      (orderedQ 0 0 (Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0))) :

      ContinuousOn (fun _ : ℝ => V (orderedQ 0 0 (Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0))) U
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.absoluteLoss_diagonal_restriction
statement:
theorem absoluteLoss_diagonal_restriction (t : ℝ) :
    absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference
      (orderedQ 1 0 (diagonalInsertion 0 1 0
        ((Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0), fun _ => t))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : orderedQ 1 0 (diagonalInsertion 0 1 0
      ((Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0), fun _ => t)) =
      orderedQ 0 0 (Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0) := by
    simpa using orderedQ_diagonalInsertion 0 1 0
      ((Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0), fun _ => t)
  rw [h]
  simp [absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ]

name: TDA.Persistence.absoluteLoss_diagonal_not_ambient_c1
statement:
theorem absoluteLoss_diagonal_not_ambient_c1 :
    (ContDiff ℝ (∞ : ℕ∞ω) (fun t : ℝ =>
      absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference
        (orderedQ 1 0 (diagonalInsertion 0 1 0
          ((Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0), fun _ => t))))) ∧
      ¬ CrThroughAllRepresentatives 1 absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference
        (orderedQ 0 0 (Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have h : (fun t : ℝ => absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference
        (orderedQ 1 0 (diagonalInsertion 0 1 0
          ((Fin.elim0, Fin.elim0), fun _ => t)))) = fun _ => 0 := by
      funext t
      exact absoluteLoss_diagonal_restriction t
    rw [h]
    exact contDiff_const
  · exact absoluteFiniteEndpointDifference_not_c1_empty

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.two_sub_two_mul_exp_le
statement:
theorem two_sub_two_mul_exp_le (r s : ℝ) :
    2 - 2 * Real.exp (-r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2)) ≤ r ^ 2 / s ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne s 0 with rfl | _
  · norm_num
  · have h := Real.add_one_le_exp (-(r ^ 2 / s ^ 2) / 2)
    have he : -r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2) = -(r ^ 2 / s ^ 2) / 2 := by ring
    rw [he]
    linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_sub_sq_eq_of_inner_eq_gaussian
statement:
theorem norm_sub_sq_eq_of_inner_eq_gaussian {u v : H} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    {r s : ℝ} (huv : ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ = Real.exp (-r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2))) :
    ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 = 2 - 2 * Real.exp (-r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_sub_sq_real, hu, hv, huv]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_sub_le_of_inner_eq_gaussian
statement:
theorem norm_sub_le_of_inner_eq_gaussian {u v : H} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hv : ‖v‖ = 1)
    {r s : ℝ} (huv : ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ = Real.exp (-r ^ 2 / (2 * s ^ 2))) :
    ‖u - v‖ ≤ |r| / |s|
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : (|r| / |s|) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 / s ^ 2 := by rw [div_pow, sq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hle : ‖u - v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (|r| / |s|) ^ 2 := by
    rw [norm_sub_sq_eq_of_inner_eq_gaussian hu hv huv, hsq]
    exact two_sub_two_mul_exp_le r s
  exact (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (div_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (abs_nonneg _))).mp hle

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_scalarOp
statement:
theorem posSemidef_scalarOp {X : Type*} {k : Matrix X X ℝ} (hk : k.PosSemidef) :
    (Matrix.of fun x y => k x y • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).PosSemidef
proof:
:= by
  have hsymm (x y : X) : k x y = k y x := by
    simpa using hk.isHermitian.apply y x
  have hH : (Matrix.of fun x y => k x y • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).IsHermitian := by
    refine Matrix.IsHermitian.ext fun x y => ?_
    ext
    simp [ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_id, hsymm x y]
  have h3 : (Matrix.of fun x y => k x y • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).IsHermitian ∧
      ∀ vv : X →₀ ℝ, 0 ≤ RCLike.re (vv.sum fun x t => vv.sum fun x' t' =>
        ⟪(Matrix.of fun x y => k x y • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) x' x t, t'⟫_ℝ) := by
    refine ⟨hH, fun vv => ?_⟩
    have h := hk.2 vv
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply, _root_.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, RCLike.re_to_real, Real.inner_apply]
    refine h.trans_eq ?_
    simp only [Finsupp.sum, star_trivial]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => by
      rw [hsymm q p]
      ring
  exact (RKHS.posSemidef_tfae.out 2 0).mp h3

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.gaussianKernelOp_apply
statement:
theorem gaussianKernelOp_apply (τ : ℝ) (a b : E) (t : ℝ) :
    gaussianKernelOp τ a b t = Real.exp (-‖a - b‖ ^ 2 / (2 * τ ^ 2)) * t
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_gaussianKernelOp
statement: theorem posSemidef_gaussianKernelOp (τ : ℝ) : (gaussianKernelOp (E := E) τ).PosSemidef
proof:
:=
  posSemidef_scalarOp (posSemidef_gaussianGram τ id)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.gaussianFeature_apply
statement:
theorem gaussianFeature_apply (τ : ℝ) (a z : E) :
    gaussianFeature τ a z = Real.exp (-‖z - a‖ ^ 2 / (2 * τ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaussianFeature, RKHS.kerFun_apply, RKHS.OfKernel.kernel_ofKernel,
    gaussianKernelOp_apply, mul_one]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.inner_gaussianFeature
statement:
theorem inner_gaussianFeature (τ : ℝ) (a b : E) :
    ⟪gaussianFeature τ a, gaussianFeature τ b⟫_ℝ = Real.exp (-‖a - b‖ ^ 2 / (2 * τ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  change ⟪RKHS.kerFun (GaussianSpace τ E) a 1, gaussianFeature τ b⟫_ℝ = _
  rw [RKHS.kerFun_inner, gaussianFeature_apply, Real.inner_apply, one_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_gaussianFeature
statement: theorem norm_gaussianFeature (τ : ℝ) (a : E) : ‖gaussianFeature τ a‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := inner_gaussianFeature τ a a
  rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, sub_self, norm_zero] at h
  norm_num at h
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact h
  · linarith [norm_nonneg (gaussianFeature τ a)]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_gaussianFeature_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_gaussianFeature_sub_le (τ : ℝ) (a b : E) :
    ‖gaussianFeature τ a - gaussianFeature τ b‖ ≤ ‖a - b‖ / |τ|
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_sub_le_of_inner_eq_gaussian (norm_gaussianFeature τ a)
    (norm_gaussianFeature τ b) (inner_gaussianFeature τ a b)
  rwa [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)] at h

name: TDA.Persistence.fixedFaceLift_factorization
statement:
theorem fixedFaceLift_factorization (F : E → FilterFunction K ℝ)
    {x₀ : E} (e : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) (n : ℕ)
    {U : Set E} (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x)) :
    ∀ x ∈ U, dgm k (F x) n =
      orderedQ (faceLiftCounts k F e n).1 (faceLiftCounts k F e n).2
        (fixedFaceLift k F e n x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hm : Monotone ((F x).value ∘ e.enum) :=
    (horder x hx).monotone_comp e
  rw [← evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm k e (F x) hm n]
  apply evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_orderedQ_of_enumerations k e (F x) hm n
  · simpa only [fixedFaceLift, faceLiftCounts, List.ofFn_comp',
      List.ofFn_get, ← Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.coe_toList]
  · simpa only [fixedFaceLift, faceLiftCounts, List.ofFn_comp',
      List.ofFn_get, ← Multiset.map_coe, Multiset.coe_toList]

name: TDA.Persistence.fixedFaceLift_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem fixedFaceLift_contDiffOn (F : E → FilterFunction K ℝ)
    {x₀ : E} (e : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) (n : ℕ)
    {U : Set E}
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) U) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fixedFaceLift k F e n) U
proof:
:= by
  apply ContDiffOn.prodMk
  · apply contDiffOn_pi.mpr
    intro i
    exact (hF (e.enum ((faceTemplatePairs k e n).toList.get i).1)).prodMk
      (hF (e.enum ((faceTemplatePairs k e n).toList.get i).2))
  · apply contDiffOn_pi.mpr
    intro i
    exact hF (e.enum ((faceTemplateEssential k e n).toList.get i))

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_smooth_face_lift
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_face_lift (F : E → FilterFunction K ℝ)
    {x₀ : E} {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (m l : ℕ) (L : E → (Fin m → ℝ × ℝ) × (Fin l → ℝ)),
      (∀ x ∈ U, dgm k (F x) n = orderedQ m l (L x)) ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 L U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_compatibleOrder (F x₀)
  exact ⟨(faceLiftCounts k F e n).1, (faceLiftCounts k F e n).2,
    fixedFaceLift k F e n,
    fixedFaceLift_factorization k F e n horder,
    fixedFaceLift_contDiffOn k F e n hF⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_smooth_face_lift_of_mem_relative_orderChamber
statement:
theorem exists_smooth_face_lift_of_mem_relative_orderChamber
    (F : E → FilterFunction K ℝ) {D : Set E} (hD : IsOpen D)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) D)
    {x₀ : E} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ D)
    (hchamber : (⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ : D) ∈
      orderChamber (fun x : D => fun s : TotalFace K => (F x).value s))
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (U : Set E), IsOpen U ∧ x₀ ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ D ∧
      ∃ (m l : ℕ) (L : E → (Fin m → ℝ × ℝ) × (Fin l → ℝ)),
        (∀ x ∈ U, dgm k (F x) n = orderedQ m l (L x)) ∧
        ContDiffOn ℝ 1 L U
proof:
:= by
  let G : D → FilterFunction K ℝ := fun x => F x
  have hcont : ∀ s : TotalFace K,
      Continuous (fun x : D => (G x).value s) := by
    intro s
    exact (hF s).continuousOn.domRestrict
  obtain ⟨W, hWo, hxW, _, hWoEq⟩ :=
    FilterFunction.exists_open_orderingEquivalent_of_mem_orderChamber
      G hcont hchamber
  let U : Set E := Subtype.val '' W
  have hU : IsOpen U := hD.isOpenMap_subtype_val W hWo
  have hxU : x₀ ∈ U := ⟨⟨x₀, hx₀⟩, hxW, rfl⟩
  have hUD : U ⊆ D := by
    rintro x ⟨y, _, rfl⟩
    exact y.property
  have horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact hWoEq y hy
  obtain ⟨m, l, L, hfactor, hsmooth⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_face_lift k F hU hxU (fun s => (hF s).mono hUD)
      horder n
  exact ⟨U, hU, hxU, hUD, m, l, L, hfactor, hsmooth⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_self {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) : finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x x = 0
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_comm
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_comm (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y = finitePBoundaryTransportCost p y x
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_triangle
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_triangle {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (z : K → ℝ × ℝ) :

      finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y + finitePBoundaryTransportCost p y z

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_zero_of_equiv
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_zero_of_equiv {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (e : I ≃ J) (he : ∀ i, x i = y (e i)) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y = 0

:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_zero_iff {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y = 0 ↔ ∃ e : I ≃ J, ∀ i, x i = y (e i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  exact finitePMatchingCost_eq_zero_iff hp x y hx hy

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.faceSupDifference_filter_le
statement:
theorem faceSupDifference_filter_le (d e : MetricSpace V) :
    faceSupDifference (Rips.filter d) (Rips.filter e) ≤ Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Finset.fold_max_le _).mpr
  exact ⟨Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy_nonneg d e,
    fun s _ => Rips.abs_diameter_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy d e s.val⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (d e : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e)
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_dgm_le_faceSupDifference k (Rips.filter d) (Rips.filter e) n).trans
    (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (faceSupDifference_filter_le d e))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_birth_bounds_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_birth_bounds_of_cokernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f.app i).hom)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) (monoEmbedding f hf i)).birth ≤
        (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ≤
        (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode N) (monoEmbedding f hf i)).birthStage).val
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨monoEmbedding_birth_le f hf i, ?_⟩
  let a := monoEmbedding f hf i
  let I := occurrence (rankBarcode M) i
  let J := occurrence (rankBarcode N) a
  have hd : J.death = I.death := monoEmbedding_death f hf i
  change I.birth ≤ (theta J.birthStage).val
  by_cases hlong : (theta J.birthStage).val < J.death
  · by_contra h
    have hbefore := deathOrdinal_lt_deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode N) a
    have hafter := deathPrefixCount_le_deathOrdinal (rankBarcode M) i
      (theta J.birthStage).val (lt_of_not_ge h)
    have hcounts := deathPrefixCount_le_translated_of_cokernelTrivial
      theta hTheta f hf hc J.birthStage J.death hlong J.death_le_size
    change deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode N) J.birth J.death ≤
      deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode M) (theta J.birthStage).val J.death at hcounts
    have ho := monoEmbedding_ordinal f hf i
    change deathOrdinal (rankBarcode N) a < deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode N) J.birth J.death
      at hbefore
    change deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode M) (theta J.birthStage).val I.death ≤
      deathOrdinal (rankBarcode M) i at hafter
    change deathOrdinal (rankBarcode N) a = deathOrdinal (rankBarcode M) i at ho
    rw [hd] at hbefore hcounts
    omega
  · 
    have hshort : J.death ≤ (theta J.birthStage).val := le_of_not_gt hlong
    exact (Nat.le_of_lt I.birth_lt_death).trans (hd ▸ hshort)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_covers_long_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_covers_long_of_cokernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f.app i).hom)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (hlong : (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).birthStage).val <
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).death) :
    ∃! i, monoEmbedding f hf i = a
proof:
:= by
  let J := occurrence (rankBarcode N) a
  have hlo := deathOrdinal_lt_deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode N) a
  have hcounts := deathPrefixCount_le_translated_of_cokernelTrivial
    theta hTheta f hf hc J.birthStage J.death hlong J.death_le_size
  have hcard := deathPrefixCount_le_card (rankBarcode M) (theta J.birthStage).val J.death
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := (monoEmbedding_mem_range_iff f hf a).mpr
    (hlo.trans_le (hcounts.trans hcard))
  exact ⟨i, hi, fun i' hi' => (monoEmbedding f hf).injective (hi'.trans hi.symm)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_unmatched_short_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_unmatched_short_of_cokernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f.app i).hom)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) (ha : a ∉ Set.range (monoEmbedding f hf)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).death ≤
      (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).birthStage).val
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨i, hi, _⟩ := monoEmbedding_covers_long_of_cokernelTrivial
    theta hTheta f hf hc a (lt_of_not_ge h)
  exact ha ⟨i, hi⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.critical_set_eq_range
statement:
private theorem critical_set_eq_range (f : FilterFunction K α) :
    (f.criticalValues : Set α) = Set.range f.value
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  exact f.mem_criticalValues a

name: TDA.Persistence.critical_card_eq
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using Fintype.card_congr (criticalIso f g e).toEquiv

name: TDA.Persistence.diagram_aligned
statement:
private theorem diagram_aligned (f : FilterFunction K α) (N : ℕ)
    (hN : f.criticalValues.card = N) (n : ℕ) :
    (dgm k f n).points =
      (rankBarcode (simplicialHomologyPModule k (alignedFiltration f N hN) n)).map
        (endpointPoint (enumeration f N hN))
proof:
:= by
  subst N
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.enumeration_corresponds
statement:
private theorem enumeration_corresponds (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (g : FilterFunction K β) (N : ℕ)
    (hf : f.criticalValues.card = N) (hg : g.criticalValues.card = N)
    (e : Set.range f.value ≃o Set.range g.value) (i : Fin N) :
    (e ⟨enumeration f N hf i,
      (f.mem_criticalValues _).1 (Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ hf i)⟩).val =
      enumeration g N hg i
proof:
:= by
  let F : Fin N → β := fun j =>
    (e ⟨enumeration f N hf j,
      (f.mem_criticalValues _).1 (Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ hf j)⟩).val
  have hmem (j : Fin N) : F j ∈ g.criticalValues :=
    (g.mem_criticalValues _).2 (e _).property
  have hmono : StrictMono F := by
    intro a b hab
    exact e.strictMono ((enumeration f N hf).strictMono hab)
  exact congrFun (Finset.orderEmbOfFin_unique hg hmem hmono) i

name: TDA.Persistence.inclusion_square
statement:
private theorem inclusion_square {A B A' B' : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    (hA : A = A') (hB : B = B') (h : A ≤ B) (h' : A' ≤ B') (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl k h n ≫
        eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C k n) hB) =
      eqToHom (congrArg (fun C => simplicialHomology C k n) hA) ≫
        simplicialHomologyIncl k h' n
proof:
:= by
  subst A'
  subst B'
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.inclusion_rank_eq
statement:
private theorem inclusion_rank_eq {A B A' B' : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    (hA : A = A') (hB : B = B') (h : A ≤ B) (h' : A' ≤ B') (n : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k h n).hom) =
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k h' n).hom)
proof:
:= by
  subst A'
  subst B'
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.common_at_card
statement:
private theorem common_at_card (f : FilterFunction K α) (g : FilterFunction K β)
    (hfg : OrderingEquivalent f g) (N : ℕ)
    (hf : f.criticalValues.card = N) (hg : g.criticalValues.card = N)
    (e : Set.range f.value ≃o Set.range g.value)
    (he : ∀ s : TotalFace K, (e ⟨f.value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩).val = g.value s)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ E : Multiset (TotalFace K × Option (TotalFace K)),
      (dgm k f n).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (f.value p.1, p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop α) (fun t => (f.value t : WithTop α)))) ∧
      (dgm k g n).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (g.value p.1, p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop β) (fun t => (g.value t : WithTop β))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have attained (i : Fin N) : ∃ s : TotalFace K, f.value s = enumeration f N hf i :=
    (f.mem_criticalValues _).1 (Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ hf i)
  let face : Fin N → TotalFace K := fun i => Classical.choose (attained i)
  have hface (i : Fin N) : f.value (face i) = enumeration f N hf i :=
    Classical.choose_spec (attained i)
  have htarget (i : Fin N) : g.value (face i) = enumeration g N hg i := by
    rw [← he (face i)]
    have hs : (⟨f.value (face i), ⟨face i, rfl⟩⟩ : Set.range f.value) =
        ⟨enumeration f N hf i,
          (f.mem_criticalValues _).1 (Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ hf i)⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext (hface i)
    rw [hs]
    exact enumeration_corresponds f g N hf hg e i
  have hstage (i : Fin N) : alignedFiltration f N hf i = alignedFiltration g N hg i := by
    change f.sublevel (enumeration f N hf i) = g.sublevel (enumeration g N hg i)
    rw [← hface i, ← htarget i]
    exact hfg.sublevel_eq (face i)
  have hsquare (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :=
    inclusion_square k (hstage i) (hstage j)
      ((alignedFiltration f N hf).monotone hij)
      ((alignedFiltration g N hg).monotone hij) n
  have hbarcode :
      rankBarcode (simplicialHomologyPModule k (alignedFiltration f N hf) n) =
        rankBarcode (simplicialHomologyPModule k (alignedFiltration g N hg) n) := by
    apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).2
    intro i j hij
    exact inclusion_rank_eq k (hstage i) (hstage j)
      ((alignedFiltration f N hf).monotone hij)
      ((alignedFiltration g N hg).monotone hij) n
  let witness : FiniteInterval N → TotalFace K × Option (TotalFace K) := fun I =>
    (face ⟨I.birth, lt_of_lt_of_le I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size⟩,
      if hd : I.death < N then some (face ⟨I.death, hd⟩) else none)
  let B := rankBarcode (simplicialHomologyPModule k (alignedFiltration f N hf) n)
  refine ⟨B.map witness, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [diagram_aligned k f N hf n, Multiset.map_map]
    apply congrArg (fun t => B.map t)
    funext I
    dsimp [endpointPoint, witness]
    split_ifs <;> simp [hface]
  · rw [diagram_aligned k g N hg n, ← hbarcode, Multiset.map_map]
    apply congrArg (fun t => B.map t)
    funext I
    dsimp [endpointPoint, witness]
    split_ifs <;> simp [htarget]

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_common_face_endpoints_of_orderingEquivalent
statement:
theorem dgm_common_face_endpoints_of_orderingEquivalent
    (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α)
    (g : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K β)
    (hfg : TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalent f g) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ E : Multiset (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K ×
        Option (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)),
      (dgm k f n).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (f.value p.1,
          p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop α) (fun t => (f.value t : WithTop α)))) ∧
      (dgm k g n).points = E.map (fun p =>
        (g.value p.1,
          p.2.elim (⊤ : WithTop β) (fun t => (g.value t : WithTop β))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := (orderingEquivalent_iff_exists_rangeOrderIso f g).1 hfg
  exact common_at_card k f g hfg f.criticalValues.card rfl
    (critical_card_eq f g e).symm e he n

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_points_map_of_strictMonoOn
statement:
theorem dgm_points_map_of_strictMonoOn
    (f : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K α)
    (g : TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction K β)
    (φ : α → β) (hφ : StrictMonoOn φ (Set.range f.value))
    (hvalue : ∀ s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K, g.value s = φ (f.value s))
    (n : ℕ) :
    (dgm k g n).points = (dgm k f n).points.map
      (fun p => (φ p.1, WithTop.map φ p.2))
proof:
:= by
  have hfg : OrderingEquivalent f g := by
    intro s t
    rw [hvalue s, hvalue t]
    constructor
    · intro h
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le h with hlt | heq
      · exact (hφ ⟨s, rfl⟩ ⟨t, rfl⟩ hlt).le
      · exact (congrArg φ heq).le
    · intro h
      by_contra hn
      exact (not_lt_of_ge h) (hφ ⟨t, rfl⟩ ⟨s, rfl⟩ (lt_of_not_ge hn))
  obtain ⟨E, hf, hg⟩ := dgm_common_face_endpoints_of_orderingEquivalent k f g hfg n
  rw [hf, hg, Multiset.map_map]
  apply congrArg (fun t => E.map t)
  funext p
  rcases p with ⟨s, d⟩
  cases d <;> simp [hvalue]

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy
    (d e : MetricSpace V) (p q : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (n : ℕ)
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e / 2)
proof:
:=
  (PersistenceImage.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck hσ hA hB w P hm hdisj
    _ _ (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (dgm_isPositive k _ n)
    (bottleneck_dgm_lt_top_supNorm k d e p q hd he n)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e p q hd he n)
        (mul_nonneg (PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_nonneg hσ hA hB)
          (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan
statement:
theorem norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan
    (d e : MetricSpace V) (p q : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (n : ℕ)
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hdisj : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) P
          (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) P
          (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      (2 * C + 3 * √(π / 2) / σ) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e / 2)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e p q hd he n hσ hC
      Real.pi_div_two_pos.le (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) P hm hdisj

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.finite_observed_scalar
statement:
theorem finite_observed_scalar {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) :
    Set.Finite {j : ScalarIndex M | ∃ i : Fin N, c i ∈ scalarSupport M j}
proof:
:=
  FiniteObservation.finite_visible_occurrences c (scalarSupport M)
    (fun i => scalar_finite_active M (c i))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.rankBarcode_eq_sampledBarcode
statement:
theorem rankBarcode_eq_sampledBarcode {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N ↪o ℝ) :
    rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom M) = sampledBarcode M c
proof:
:= by
  exact FiniteObservation.rankBarcode_of_pfd_decomposition M c
    (scalarSupport M) (scalarSupport_ordConnected M) (scalarIso M).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_small_radius_of_finite
statement:
private theorem exists_small_radius_of_finite {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (y : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (r ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) :
    ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t < ρ ∧ ∀ i, dist (y i) p ≤ r + t → dist (y i) p ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have aux : ∀ s : Finset ι, ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t < ρ ∧
      ∀ i ∈ s, dist (y i) p ≤ r + t → dist (y i) p ≤ r := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => exact ⟨ρ / 2, by positivity, by linarith, by simp⟩
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htρ, hts⟩ := ih
      by_cases hd : dist (y i) p ≤ r
      · refine ⟨t, ht, htρ, ?_⟩
        intro j hj hjr
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl | hj
        · exact hd
        · exact hts j hj hjr
      · have hd' : r < dist (y i) p := lt_of_not_ge hd
        refine ⟨min t ((dist (y i) p - r) / 2), lt_min ht (by linarith),
          lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) htρ, ?_⟩
        intro j hj hjr
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hj with rfl | hj
        · have := min_le_right t ((dist (y j) p - r) / 2)
          linarith
        · exact hts j hj (hjr.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_left _ _)))
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htρ, hts⟩ := aux Finset.univ
  exact ⟨t, ht, htρ, fun i => hts i (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.pointBall_card_eq_subtype
statement:
private theorem pointBall_card_eq_subtype {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    (PersistenceMeasureWindowMatching.pointBall x p r).card =
      Fintype.card {i : ι // dist (x i) p ≤ r}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [PersistenceMeasureWindowMatching.pointBall, Fintype.card_subtype]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteWindowTokens_finite
statement:
private theorem finiteWindowTokens_finite
    (D : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram) {R h : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hh : 0 < h) :
    Finite (finiteWindowTokens D R h)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := finiteWindowCompact R h
  have hbox : IsCompact (Set.Icc (-R) R ×ˢ Set.Icc (-R) R) :=
    isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hclosed : IsClosed {p : ℝ × ℝ | h ≤ p.2 - p.1} :=
    isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_snd.sub continuous_fst)
  have hK : IsCompact K := by
    exact hbox.inter_right hclosed
  let V : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ) := fun p => finiteWindowNeighborhood h p.1
  have hVo : ∀ p, IsOpen (V p) := by
    intro p
    exact isOpen_Ioo.prod isOpen_Ioo
  have hcover : K ⊆ ⋃ p : K, V p := by
    intro q hq
    let p : K := ⟨q, hq⟩
    refine Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨p, ?_⟩
    change q ∈ finiteWindowNeighborhood h q
    change q.1 ∈ Set.Ioo (q.1 - h / 4) (q.1 + h / 4) ∧
      q.2 ∈ Set.Ioo (q.2 - h / 4) (q.2 + h / 4)
    simp only [Set.mem_Ioo]
    constructor <;> constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hK.elim_finite_subcover V hVo hcover
  let T : K → Set (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) := fun z =>
    {p | p ∈ rectangleCell (z.1.1 - h / 4) (z.1.1 + h / 4)
        (z.1.2 - h / 4) (z.1.2 + h / 4) ∧ 0 < D.multiplicity p}
  have hT : ∀ z, (T z).Finite := by
    intro z
    have hz : h ≤ z.1.2 - z.1.1 := z.2.2
    have hab : z.1.1 - h / 4 < z.1.1 + h / 4 := by linarith
    have hbc : z.1.1 + h / 4 < z.1.2 - h / 4 := by linarith
    have hcd : z.1.2 - h / 4 < z.1.2 + h / 4 := by linarith
    exact D.locallyFiniteRectangle _ _ _ _ hab hbc hcd
  let U : Finset (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) := S.biUnion fun z => (hT z).toFinset
  have hwindowSupport : ∀ o : D.finiteOccurrences,
      finiteWindowPoint R h (D.finitePoint o) → o.1.1 ∈ U := by
    intro o ho
    let q : ℝ × ℝ := D.finitePoint o
    let z : ℝ × ℝ := (cutEndpoint o.1.1.1, cutEndpoint o.1.1.2)
    rcases ho with ⟨hb, hd, hlen⟩
    have hb' : |cutEndpoint o.1.1.1| < R := by
      simpa [LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.finitePoint] using hb
    have hd' : |cutEndpoint o.1.1.2| < R := by
      simpa [LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.finitePoint] using hd
    have hlen' : h < cutEndpoint o.1.1.2 - cutEndpoint o.1.1.1 := by
      simpa [LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.finitePoint] using hlen
    have hzK : z ∈ K := by
      change (z.1 ∈ Set.Icc (-R) R ∧ z.2 ∈ Set.Icc (-R) R) ∧ h ≤ z.2 - z.1
      rcases abs_lt.mp hb' with ⟨hbL, hbR⟩
      rcases abs_lt.mp hd' with ⟨hdL, hdR⟩
      exact ⟨⟨⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩, hlen'.le⟩
    have hmemV : q ∈ ⋃ z' ∈ S, V z' := hS (by simpa [z, q, LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.finitePoint] using hzK)
    obtain ⟨z', hz'S, hqV⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hmemV
    have hqV' : q.1 ∈ Set.Ioo (z'.1.1 - h / 4) (z'.1.1 + h / 4) ∧
        q.2 ∈ Set.Ioo (z'.1.2 - h / 4) (z'.1.2 + h / 4) := by
      simpa [V, finiteWindowNeighborhood] using hqV
    have hcoord1 : z'.1.1 - h / 4 < cutEndpoint o.1.1.1 ∧
        cutEndpoint o.1.1.1 < z'.1.1 + h / 4 := by
      simpa [q, LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.finitePoint] using hqV'.1
    have hcoord2 : z'.1.2 - h / 4 < cutEndpoint o.1.1.2 ∧
        cutEndpoint o.1.1.2 < z'.1.2 + h / 4 := by
      simpa [q, LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.finitePoint] using hqV'.2
    have hfin : o.1.1.2 ≠ infinityCut := o.1.2.2
    have hpos : 0 < D.multiplicity o.1.1 := o.1.2.1
    have hend := D.finiteEndpoints o.1.1 hpos hfin
    have hcell1 := cut_mem_cell_of_endpoint_inside hend.1 hcoord1.1 hcoord1.2
    have hcell2 := cut_mem_cell_of_endpoint_inside hend.2 hcoord2.1 hcoord2.2
    have hpT : o.1.1 ∈ T z' := by
      exact ⟨⟨hcell1, hcell2⟩, hpos⟩
    have hpU : o.1.1 ∈ U := by
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      exact ⟨z', hz'S, (hT z').mem_toFinset.mpr hpT⟩
    exact hpU
  let P := {p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ // p ∈ U ∧ 0 < D.multiplicity p ∧ p.2 ≠ infinityCut}
  letI : Fintype {p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ // p ∈ U} := inferInstance
  have hPfinite : Finite P := Finite.of_injective
    (fun p : P => (⟨p.1, p.2.1⟩ : {p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ // p ∈ U})) (by
      intro a b hab
      exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : {p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ // p ∈ U} => z.1) hab))
  letI : Finite P := hPfinite
  letI : Fintype P := Fintype.ofFinite P
  let V : Type := Σ p : P, Fin (D.multiplicity p.1)
  letI : Fintype V := inferInstance
  let emb : finiteWindowTokens D R h → V := fun o =>
    ⟨⟨o.1.1.1, ⟨hwindowSupport o.1 o.2, o.1.1.2.1, o.1.1.2.2⟩⟩, o.1.2⟩
  have hemb : Function.Injective emb := by
    intro a b hab
    apply Subtype.ext
    have h := Sigma.ext_iff.mp hab
    apply Sigma.ext
    · apply Subtype.ext
      exact congrArg (fun z : V => z.1.1) hab
    · exact h.2
  exact Finite.of_injective emb hemb

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialWindowTokens_finite
statement:
private theorem essentialWindowTokens_finite
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ} (hM : M.QTame)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    Finite (essentialWindowTokens (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM) R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM
  let a := -R - 1
  let b := R + 1
  have hab : a ≤ b := by dsimp [a, b]; linarith
  obtain ⟨S, hS, _⟩ := moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_essential_counts M hM hab
  let P : Type := {birth : Cut ℝ // birth ∈ S}
  letI : Fintype P := by
    dsimp [P]
    exact Fintype.ofFinset S (by simp)
  let V : Type := Σ birth : P, Fin (D.multiplicity (birth.1, infinityCut))
  letI : Fintype V := inferInstance
  let emb : essentialWindowTokens D R → V := fun o => by
    let birth := o.1.1.1
    have hpos : 0 < D.multiplicity (birth, infinityCut) := o.1.1.2
    have hcell' : birth ∈ cutCell a b :=
      cut_mem_cell_of_endpoint_inside (D.essentialBirthEndpoint birth hpos)
        (by dsimp [a]; have := abs_lt.mp o.2; linarith)
        (by dsimp [b]; have := abs_lt.mp o.2; linarith)
    exact ⟨⟨birth, (hS birth).mpr ⟨hcell', hpos⟩⟩, o.1.2⟩
  have hemb : Function.Injective emb := by
    intro x y hxy
    rcases x with ⟨⟨⟨birth, hbirth⟩, idx⟩, hxwin⟩
    rcases y with ⟨⟨⟨birth', hbirth'⟩, idx'⟩, hywin⟩
    have hb : birth = birth' := by
      have h := congrArg (fun z : V => z.1.1) hxy
      simpa [emb] using h
    subst birth'
    have hi : (idx : ℕ) = idx' := by
      have h := congrArg (fun z : V => (z.2 : ℕ)) hxy
      simpa [emb] using h
    have hi' : idx = idx' := Fin.ext hi
    subst idx'
    rfl
  exact Finite.of_injective emb hemb

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialWindowIntervalTokens_card_eq_measure
statement:
private theorem essentialWindowIntervalTokens_card_eq_measure
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ} (hM : M.QTame)
    {R a b : ℝ} (ha : -R < a) (hb : b < R) (hab : a ≤ b)
    [FW : Fintype (essentialWindowTokens
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM) R)]
    (FB : Fintype (essentialWindowIntervalTokens
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM) R a b)) :
    @Fintype.card (essentialWindowIntervalTokens
      (LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM) R a b) FB =
      essentialMeasureValue M hab
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram := LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM
  let I := essentialWindowTokens D R
  letI : Fintype I := FW
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hcount⟩ := moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_essential_counts M hM hab
  let P : Type := {birth : Cut ℝ // birth ∈ S}
  let T : Type := Σ birth : P, Fin (D.multiplicity (birth.1, infinityCut))
  let B := essentialWindowIntervalTokens D R a b
  letI : Fintype B := FB
  letI : Fintype P := by
    dsimp [P]
    exact Fintype.ofFinset S (by simp)
  letI : Fintype T := inferInstance
  let e : B ≃ T := {
    toFun := fun o => by
      let birth := o.1.1.1.1
      have hpos : 0 < D.multiplicity (birth, infinityCut) := o.1.1.1.2
      exact ⟨⟨birth, (hS birth).mpr ⟨o.2, hpos⟩⟩, o.1.1.2⟩
    invFun := fun z => by
      let birth := z.1.1
      have hmem := (hS birth).mp z.1.2
      have hpos : 0 < D.multiplicity (birth, infinityCut) := hmem.2
      let o : D.essentialOccurrences := ⟨⟨birth, hpos⟩, z.2⟩
      have hbounds := cutEndpoint_bounds hmem.1
      have hwindow : |cutEndpoint birth| < R := by
        rw [abs_lt]
        constructor <;> linarith
      exact ⟨⟨o, hwindow⟩, hmem.1⟩
    left_inv := by
      intro o
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Sigma.ext
      · apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      · rfl
    right_inv := by
      intro z
      apply Sigma.ext
      · apply Subtype.ext
        rfl
      · rfl
  }
  calc
    @Fintype.card B FB = Fintype.card T := Fintype.card_congr e
    _ = ∑ birth ∈ S, D.multiplicity (birth, infinityCut) := by
      rw [Fintype.card_sigma]
      simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
      change (∑ birth : P, D.multiplicity (birth.1, infinityCut)) = _
      exact (Finset.sum_subtype (s := S) (p := fun birth => birth ∈ S)
        (by intro birth; rfl) (fun birth => D.multiplicity (birth, infinityCut))).symm
    _ = essentialMeasureValue M hab := by
      simpa [D, LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule] using hcount.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPair_dist_eq_abs
statement:
private theorem essentialPair_dist_eq_abs (x y : ℝ) :
    dist (x, x) (y, y) = |x - y|
proof:
:= by
  simp [Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialWindow_ball_to_interval
statement:
private theorem essentialWindow_ball_to_interval
    (D : LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram) {R a b : ℝ}
    [FW : Fintype (essentialWindowTokens D R)]
    (center r : ℝ) (ha : a < center - r) (hb : center + r < b)
    (FB : Fintype (essentialWindowIntervalTokens D R a b)) :
    (PersistenceMeasureWindowMatching.pointBall
      (essentialWindowPointPairMap D R) (center, center) r).card ≤
      Fintype.card (essentialWindowIntervalTokens D R a b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I := essentialWindowTokens D R
  let B := essentialWindowIntervalTokens D R a b
  letI : Fintype I := FW
  letI : Fintype B := FB
  let A := {o : I // dist (essentialWindowPointPairMap D R o) (center, center) ≤ r}
  let f : A → B := fun o => by
    have hdist : |essentialWindowBirthMap D R o.1 - center| ≤ r := by
      simpa [essentialWindowPointPairMap, essentialPair_dist_eq_abs] using o.2
    have hcell0 := D.essentialBirthEndpoint o.1.1.1.1 o.1.1.1.2
    have hdist' : |cutEndpoint o.1.1.1.1 - center| ≤ r := by
      simpa [essentialWindowBirthMap] using hdist
    have hcoords := abs_le.mp hdist'
    have hcell : o.1.1.1.1 ∈ cutCell a b :=
      cut_mem_cell_of_endpoint_inside hcell0
        (by linarith [ha, hcoords.1])
        (by linarith [hb, hcoords.2])
    exact ⟨o.1, hcell⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hv := congrArg (fun z : B => z.1) hxy
    simpa [f] using hv
  have hcard : Fintype.card A =
      (PersistenceMeasureWindowMatching.pointBall
        (essentialWindowPointPairMap D R) (center, center) r).card :=
    (pointBall_card_eq_subtype _ _ _).symm
  rw [← hcard]
  exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialWindow_interval_to_ball
statement:
private theorem essentialWindow_interval_to_ball
