  refine ⟨FEdges, hFLeftInj, hFRightInj, ?_, hFSourceCover, hFTargetCover,
    ⟨EEdges, hELeftInj, hERightInj, ?_, hESourceCover, hETargetCover⟩⟩
  · intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxa, hyb, hxy⟩ := hFEdgeOut hab
    change x.1 = a at hxa
    change y.1 = b at hyb
    subst a
    subst b
    exact hFEdgeCost x y hxy
  · intro a b hab
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxa, hyb, hxy⟩ := hEEdgeOut hab
    change x.1 = a at hxa
    change y.1 = b at hyb
    subst a
    subst b
    exact hEEdgeCost x y hxy

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_continuousAt_pos
statement:
private theorem totalFinitePowerCost_continuousAt_pos
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ => M.totalFinitePowerCost q x y) p
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalFinitePowerCost totalBoundaryCost
  apply ContinuousAt.add
  · apply tendsto_finsetSum
    intro i _
    cases M.finite i <;> exact Real.continuousAt_const_rpow' hp.ne'
  · apply tendsto_finsetSum
    intro j _
    by_cases hj : ∃ i, M.finite i = some j
    · simpa only [if_pos hj] using
        (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) p).tendsto
    · simpa only [if_neg hj] using
        (Real.continuousAt_const_rpow' hp.ne' :
          ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ => (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ q) p).tendsto

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_continuousAt_pos
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :=
    occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff.mpr (by simp)
  have h : ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ => Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty
      (fun M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1} =>
        M.totalFinitePowerCost q x y)) p :=
    ContinuousAt.finset_inf'_apply Finset.univ_nonempty
      (fun M _ => M.totalFinitePowerCost_continuousAt_pos hp x y)
  simpa only [Finset.inf'_univ_eq_ciInf, finitePowerMatchingCost] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_continuousAt_pos
proof:
:= by
  exact (finitePowerMatchingCost_continuousAt_pos hp x y).rpow
    (continuousAt_id.inv₀ hp.ne') (Or.inr (inv_pos.mpr hp))

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_continuousOn
statement:
theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_continuousOn (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ => finitePowerMatchingCost p x y) (Set.Ici 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  exact (finitePowerMatchingCost_continuousAt_pos
    (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp) x y).continuousWithinAt

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_continuousOn
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_continuousOn (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ => finitePMatchingCost p x y) (Set.Ici 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  exact (finitePMatchingCost_continuousAt_pos
    (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp) x y).continuousWithinAt

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_continuousOn
statement:
theorem finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_continuousOn
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ => finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost p x y) (Set.Ici 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using
    finitePowerMatchingCost_continuousOn x y

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_continuousOn
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_continuousOn
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ContinuousOn (fun p : ℝ => finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y) (Set.Ici 1)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using
    finitePMatchingCost_continuousOn x y

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostLawsExamples.permuted_zero
statement:
private theorem permuted_zero :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost (positivePairs ∘ Equiv.swap 0 1) positivePairs = 0
proof:
:=
  finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_eq_zero_of_equiv _ _ (Equiv.swap 0 1) (fun _ => rfl)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostLawsExamples.permuted_presentations_differ
statement:
private theorem permuted_presentations_differ :
    positivePairs ∘ Equiv.swap 0 1 ≠ positivePairs
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hzero := congrArg (fun f => f 0) h
  norm_num [positivePairs, Function.comp_def] at hzero

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostLawsExamples.repeated_ne_singleton
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  obtain ⟨e, _⟩ := (finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_eq_zero_iff _ _
    (fun _ => by norm_num) (fun _ => by norm_num)).mp hz
  have hc := Fintype.card_congr e
  norm_num at hc

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostLawsExamples.diagonal_to_empty_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right]
  simp [diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostLawsExamples.diagonal_to_empty_has_no_equiv
statement: private theorem diagonal_to_empty_has_no_equiv : ¬ Nonempty (Unit ≃ Fin 0)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e⟩
  exact Fin.elim0 (e ())

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMatchingCostLawsExamples.four_paths
statement:
private theorem four_paths :
    (firstMatching.compose secondMatching).finite 0 = some 0 ∧
    (firstMatching.compose secondMatching).finite 1 = none ∧
    (¬ ∃ i, firstMatching.finite i = some 2) ∧ secondMatching.finite 2 = some 1 ∧
    (¬ ∃ i, firstMatching.finite i = some 3) ∧ secondMatching.finite 3 = none
proof:

    aggregatePlan).mass 0 0 = 1 / 16
  rw [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.splitLift_mass]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single sourceLabel]
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single targetLabel]
    · norm_num [FiniteWeightedDiagram.splittingKernel, aggregatePlan,
        FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.aggregate_mass, concentratedPlan,
        sourceLabel, targetLabel, FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed_apply,
        sourceCoordinates, targetCoordinates, sourceWeight, targetWeight,
        Fin.sum_univ_three, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    · intro r _ hne
      exact (hne (targetLabel_unique r)).elim
    · intro h
      exact (h (Finset.mem_univ targetLabel)).elim
  · intro q _ hne
    exact (hne (sourceLabel_unique q)).elim
  · intro h
    exact (h (Finset.mem_univ sourceLabel)).elim

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.Examples.boolWithTop_false_minimalComplement
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    change Minimal (fun y : WithTop Bool => ¬ y ≤ ((false : Bool) : WithTop Bool)) x at hx
    cases x with
    | top =>
        have hnot : ¬ ((true : Bool) : WithTop Bool) ≤ ((false : Bool) : WithTop Bool) := by
          norm_num
        have heq : ((true : Bool) : WithTop Bool) = (⊤ : WithTop Bool) :=
          hx.eq_of_le hnot le_top
        simp at heq
    | coe b =>
        cases b with
        | false => exact False.elim (hx.prop le_rfl)
        | true => rfl
  · intro hx
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst x
    change Minimal (fun y : WithTop Bool => ¬ y ≤ ((false : Bool) : WithTop Bool))
      ((true : Bool) : WithTop Bool)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · norm_num
    · intro y hy hyle
      cases y with
      | top => simp at hyle
      | coe b =>
          cases b with
          | false => simp at hy
          | true => exact le_rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.Examples.boolIntervalPair_complementCard_eq_two
statement:
theorem boolIntervalPair_complementCard_eq_two :
    letI : Lattice (PairPoset Bool) := pairPosetLattice (S := Bool)
    letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset Bool) := pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := Bool)
    complementCard (S := PairPoset Bool) boolIntervalPair = 2
proof:
:= by
  letI : Lattice (PairPoset Bool) := pairPosetLattice (S := Bool)
  letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset Bool) := pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := Bool)
  letI : Fintype (PairPoset Bool) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI : Fintype (diagonalPairComplement boolIntervalPair) :=
    diagonalPairComplementFintype boolIntervalPair
  rw [complementCard_pair_eq]
  have hdiag : Fintype.card (diagonalPairComplement boolIntervalPair) = 1 := by
    apply Fintype.card_eq_one_iff_nonempty_unique.mpr
    have hset := boolWithTop_false_minimalComplement
    let hmembership : (true : WithTop Bool) ∈
        minimalComplement ((false : Bool) : WithTop Bool) := by
      rw [hset]
      simp
    let a₀ : diagonalPairComplement boolIntervalPair :=
      ⟨⟨(true : WithTop Bool), hmembership⟩, by rfl⟩
    refine ⟨{ default := a₀, uniq := ?_ }⟩
    intro a
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Subtype.ext
    have ha : a.1.1 ∈ minimalComplement ((false : Bool) : WithTop Bool) := a.1.2
    rw [hset] at ha
    exact Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp ha
  have hbottom :
      complementCard (S := WithTop Bool) boolIntervalPair.val.2 = 1 := by
    change complementCard (S := WithTop Bool) ((⊤ : Bool) : WithTop Bool) = 1
    unfold complementCard
    let e : minimalComplement (S := WithTop Bool) ((⊤ : Bool) : WithTop Bool) ≃
        {x : WithTop Bool // x = ⊤} :=
      Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun x => by
        rw [boolWithTop_oldTop_minimalComplement]
        simp)
    calc
      Fintype.card (minimalComplement (S := WithTop Bool) ((⊤ : Bool) : WithTop Bool)) =
          Fintype.card {x : WithTop Bool // x = ⊤} := Fintype.card_congr e
      _ = 1 := by
        apply Fintype.card_eq_one_iff_nonempty_unique.mpr
        refine ⟨{ default := ⟨⊤, rfl⟩, uniq := ?_ }⟩
        intro x
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact x.property
  rw [hdiag, hbottom]

    change Nontrivial (SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) (Set.Iic p) p)
    exact Function.Injective.nontrivial
      (f := fun x : ℚ =>
        (⟨x, by simp [SupportInterval.fiber]⟩ :
          SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) (Set.Iic p) p))
      (by
        intro x y h
        exact congrArg
          (fun z : SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) (Set.Iic p) p => (z : ℚ)) h)
  exact false_of_nontrivial_of_subsingleton (rationalSingletonInjective.obj p)

  letI : ∀ q : singletonGrid.Point,

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteLatticeComplementCardinality.Examples.rationalSingletonInjective_resolution_positive_vanishing
statement:
theorem rationalSingletonInjective_resolution_positive_vanishing
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
      (k := ℚ) (M := rationalSingletonInjective))
    (j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) : IsZero (R.termAt j)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Injective rationalSingletonInjective := by
    simpa [rationalSingletonInjective] using
      (PrincipalDownsetInjective.isInjective (k := ℚ) rationalSingletonGridPoint)
  letI : ∀ q : singletonGrid.Point,
      FiniteDimensional ℚ (rationalSingletonInjective.obj q) := fun q => by
    change FiniteDimensional ℚ
      ((PrincipalDownsetInjective.module (k := ℚ)
        rationalSingletonGridPoint).obj q)
    infer_instance
  simpa using termAt_isZero_of_coordinateGrid
    (k := ℚ) singletonGrid rationalSingletonInjective singletonGrid_nonempty R j hj

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostLawsExamples.four_middle_roles
statement:
private theorem four_middle_roles :
    firstMatching.finite 0 = some 0 ∧ secondMatching.finite 0 = some 0 ∧
    firstMatching.finite 1 = some 1 ∧ secondMatching.finite 1 = none ∧
    (¬ ∃ i, firstMatching.finite i = some 2) ∧ secondMatching.finite 2 = some 1 ∧
    (¬ ∃ i, firstMatching.finite i = some 3) ∧ secondMatching.finite 3 = none ∧
    firstMatching.finite 2 = none ∧ (¬ ∃ j, secondMatching.finite j = some 2)
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostLawsExamples.four_path_power_costs
statement:
private theorem four_path_power_costs :
    firstMatching.totalFinitePowerCost 2 source middle = 11 ∧
    secondMatching.totalFinitePowerCost 2 middle target = 16 ∧
    (firstMatching.compose secondMatching).totalFinitePowerCost 2 source target = 19
proof:
:= by
  repeat constructor
  all_goals
    norm_num [OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost,
      OccurrenceMatching.compose, firstMatching, secondMatching, source, middle, target,
      Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.exists_fin_succ, finitePairCost, diagonalCost, Real.rpow_two]
    simp +decide
    norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostLawsExamples.four_path_root_budget
statement: private theorem four_path_root_budget : Real.sqrt 19 ≤ Real.sqrt 11 + 4
proof:
:= by
  have h := firstMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_compose_root_le secondMatching
    (p := 2) (by norm_num) source middle target
  obtain ⟨hM, hN, hcomp⟩ := four_path_power_costs
  rw [hM, hN, hcomp] at h
  norm_num [← Real.sqrt_eq_rpow] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostLawsExamples.singleton_root_eq_pair_of_le_diagonal
statement:
private theorem singleton_root_eq_pair_of_le_diagonal {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (a b : ℝ × ℝ) (hc : (finitePairCost a b).toReal ≤ (diagonalCost a).toReal) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun _ : Fin 1 => a) (fun _ : Fin 1 => b) =
      (finitePairCost a b).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)
  have hcost : (finitePairCost a b).toReal ^ p ≤
      (diagonalCost a).toReal ^ p + (diagonalCost b).toReal ^ p :=
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hc (zero_le_one.trans hp)).trans
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _))
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost, finitePMatchingCost,
    finitePowerMatchingCost_singleton, min_eq_left hcost]
  exact Real.rpow_rpow_inv ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hp0

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostLawsExamples.translated_roots
statement:
private theorem translated_roots {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0, 10) : ℝ × ℝ))
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1, 11)) = 1 ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((1, 11) : ℝ × ℝ))
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => (2, 12)) = 1 ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0, 10) : ℝ × ℝ))
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => (2, 12)) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have h01 := singleton_root_eq_pair_of_le_diagonal hp (0, 10) (1, 11)
    (by norm_num [finitePairCost, diagonalCost])
  have h12 := singleton_root_eq_pair_of_le_diagonal hp (1, 11) (2, 12)
    (by norm_num [finitePairCost, diagonalCost])
  have h02 := singleton_root_eq_pair_of_le_diagonal hp (0, 10) (2, 12)
    (by norm_num [finitePairCost, diagonalCost])
  norm_num [finitePairCost] at h01 h12 h02
  exact ⟨h01, h12, h02⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostLawsExamples.translated_triangle_sharp
statement:
private theorem translated_triangle_sharp {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0, 10) : ℝ × ℝ))
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => (2, 12)) =
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0, 10) : ℝ × ℝ))
        (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1, 11)) +
      finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((1, 11) : ℝ × ℝ))
        (fun _ : Fin 1 => (2, 12))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h01, h12, h02⟩ := translated_roots hp
  rw [h01, h12, h02]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostLawsExamples.translated_roots_two

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePMatchingCostLawsExamples.translated_roots_three_halves

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientResolutionComplex_differential_one

    (diagonalQuotientResolutionComplex (k := k) (S := S)).d 1 0 =
      diagonalIdealInclusion (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  change ChainComplex.of.d
    (fun n => match n with
      | 0 => regularModule (k := k) (S := S)
      | 1 => diagonalIdealModule (k := k) (S := S)
      | _ => zeroModule (k := k) (S := S))
    (fun n => match n with
      | 0 => diagonalIdealInclusion (k := k) (S := S)
      | _ => 0) 1 0 = _
  exact (ChainComplex.of_d
    (fun n => match n with
      | 0 => regularModule (k := k) (S := S)
      | 1 => diagonalIdealModule (k := k) (S := S)
      | _ => zeroModule (k := k) (S := S))

        exact (diagonalIdealQuotientRow (k := k) (S := S)).zero⟩).f 0 = _

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientVertexCoinvariantsEquiv_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalQuotientVertexCoinvariantsEquiv_mkQ
    (b : DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) :
    diagonalQuotientVertexCoinvariantsEquiv (k := k) (S := S) v
      (mk (k := k) (S := S) v
        (diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S)) b) =
      (vertexRelation (k := k) (R := Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
        (N := DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
        (vertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)).mkQ b
proof:
:= by
  simpa [diagonalQuotientVertexCoinvariantsEquiv, mk] using
    (coinvariantsEquiv_mkQ (k := k) (S := S) (v := v)
      (M := diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S))
      (N := DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
      ({ toFun := fun b => b
         invFun := fun b => b
         left_inv := fun _ => rfl
         right_inv := fun _ => rfl
         map_add' := fun _ _ => rfl } :
        ↑(diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S)) ≃+ DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
      (fun c b => by
        change (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
            (algebraMap k (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) c)) * b = c • b
        rw [Ideal.Quotient.mk_algebraMap, Algebra.smul_def])
      (fun _ _ => rfl) b)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.mappedResolution_term_one_isZero

    (diagonalIdealModule (k := k) (S := S)))

    (diagonalIdealVertexCoinvariants_eq_zero (k := k) (S := S) v _).symm

    IsZero ((mappedDiagonalQuotientResolution (k := k) (S := S) v).X n)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n =>
    cases n with
    | zero => omega
    | succ n =>
      change IsZero ((vertexTensor (k := k) (S := S) v).obj
        (zeroModule (k := k) (S := S)))

        (zeroModule_isZero (k := k) (S := S))

    cases n with

    | succ n =>

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientVertexCoinvariantsIso_hom_mkQ
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalQuotientVertexCoinvariantsIso_hom_mkQ
    (b : DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) :

      (mk (k := k) (S := S) v

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotient_leftDerivedZeroIso_hom_unit
statement:
@[simp] theorem diagonalQuotient_leftDerivedZeroIso_hom_unit :
    (diagonalQuotient_leftDerivedZeroIso (k := k) (S := S) v).hom
      (((Functor.leftDerivedZeroIsoSelf (vertexTensor (k := k) (S := S) v)).app
        (diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S))).inv.hom
        (mk (k := k) (S := S) v
          (diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S))
          (1 : DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))) =
      (1 : k)
proof:
:= by
  let η := (Functor.leftDerivedZeroIsoSelf (vertexTensor (k := k) (S := S) v)).app
    (diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S))
  change (diagonalQuotientVertexCoinvariantsIso (k := k) (S := S) v).hom
    (η.hom (η.inv.hom
      (mk (k := k) (S := S) v (diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S))
        (1 : DiagonalQuotient (k := k) (S := S))))) = (1 : k)
  rw [Iso.inv_hom_id_apply]
  simpa using diagonalQuotientVertexCoinvariantsIso_hom_mkQ (k := k) (S := S) v 1

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotient_leftDerivedZero_not_isZero

theorem diagonalQuotient_leftDerivedZero_not_isZero :
    ¬ IsZero (((vertexTensor (k := k) (S := S) v).leftDerived 0).obj
      (diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S)))

    (diagonalQuotient_leftDerivedZeroIso (k := k) (S := S) v).symm
  have hs : Subsingleton k := ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hk

name: TDA.Persistence.intervalFiberLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
private theorem intervalFiberLinearEquiv_apply {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {I J : FiniteInterval N} (h : I = J) (i : Fin N)
    (x : (intervalModule (k := k) I).obj i) :
    intervalFiberLinearEquiv (k := k) h i x = h ▸ x

name: TDA.Persistence.intervalFiberLinearEquiv_natural
statement:
private theorem intervalFiberLinearEquiv_natural {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {I J : FiniteInterval N} (h : I = J) {i j : Fin N} (hij : i ≤ j)
    (x : (intervalModule (k := k) I).obj i) :
    intervalFiberLinearEquiv (k := k) h j
        (structureMapLinear (intervalModule (k := k) I) hij x) =
      structureMapLinear (intervalModule (k := k) J) hij
        (intervalFiberLinearEquiv (k := k) h i x)
proof:
:= by

    structureMapLinear (intervalModule (k := k) I) hij x

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeEnumerationLinearEquiv_apply
statement:
private theorem barcodeEnumerationLinearEquiv_apply {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {xs ys : List (FiniteInterval N)} (hperm : xs.Perm ys) (i : Fin N)
    (x : ∀ t : Fin xs.length, (intervalModule (k := k) (xs.get t)).obj i)
    (hvalues : ∀ s : Fin ys.length,
      ys.get s = xs.get ((barcodeEnumerationIndexEquiv hperm).symm s))
    (s : Fin ys.length) :
    barcodeEnumerationLinearEquiv (k := k) hperm i x s =
      intervalFiberLinearEquiv (k := k) (hvalues s).symm i
        (x ((barcodeEnumerationIndexEquiv hperm).symm s))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := barcodeEnumerationIndexEquiv hperm
  change (LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft' k
      (fun t => (intervalModule (k := k) (xs.get t)).obj i) e).trans
    (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight (fun s =>
      intervalFiberLinearEquiv (k := k) (hvalues s).symm i)) x s =
    intervalFiberLinearEquiv (k := k) (hvalues s).symm i (x (e.symm s))
  rw [LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.piCongrRight_apply,
    LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft'_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.piRangeToRangePiMap_val
statement:
private theorem piRangeToRangePiMap_val {ι : Type*} {k : Type*} [Field k]
    {A B : ι → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (A i)] [∀ i, Module k (A i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (B i)] [∀ i, Module k (B i)]
    (f : ∀ i, A i →ₗ[k] B i) (y : ∀ i, LinearMap.range (f i)) :
    (piRangeToRangePiMap f y).val = fun i => (y i).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext i
  simp [piRangeToRangePiMap, LinearMap.piMap,
    Classical.choose_spec (LinearMap.mem_range.mp (y i).property)]

name: TDA.Persistence.finrank_range_piMap
statement:
private theorem finrank_range_piMap {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {k : Type*} [Field k]
    {A B : ι → Type*} [∀ i, AddCommGroup (A i)] [∀ i, Module k (A i)]
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (B i)] [∀ i, Module k (B i)]
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (A i)]
    (f : ∀ i, A i →ₗ[k] B i) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.piMap f)) =
      ∑ i, Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (f i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [(rangePiMapEquiv f).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_pi_fintype]

name: TDA.Persistence.list_get_sum_countP
statement:
private theorem list_get_sum_countP {α : Type*} (xs : List α) (p : α → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] :
    (∑ t : Fin xs.length, if p (xs.get t) then 1 else 0) =
      (xs : Multiset α).countP p
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a xs ih =>
      change (∑ t : Fin (xs.length + 1),
        if p ((a :: xs).get t) then 1 else 0) = (↑(a :: xs) : Multiset α).countP p
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      change (if p a then 1 else 0) +
        (∑ t : Fin xs.length, if p (xs.get t) then 1 else 0) =
          (↑(a :: xs) : Multiset α).countP p
      simp only [Multiset.coe_countP, List.countP_cons]
      simp only [Multiset.coe_countP] at ih
      rw [ih]
      simp [add_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.rank_barcodeMap
statement:
theorem rank_barcodeMap {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) B) i j hij =
      B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : ∀ t : BarcodeOccurrence N B,
      ((intervalModule (k := k) (B.toList.get t)).obj i) →ₗ[k]
        ((intervalModule (k := k) (B.toList.get t)).obj j) :=
    fun t => structureMapLinear (intervalModule (k := k) (B.toList.get t)) hij
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.piMap f)) = _
  rw [finrank_range_piMap f]
  calc
    (∑ t : BarcodeOccurrence N B, Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (f t))) =
        ∑ t : BarcodeOccurrence N B,
          if (B.toList.get t).birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < (B.toList.get t).death then 1 else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro t ht
      change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
        (structureMapLinear (intervalModule (k := k) (B.toList.get t)) hij)) = _
      change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
        (intervalMap (k := k) (B.toList.get t) hij)) = _
      simpa only [interval_alive_endpoints_iff (B.toList.get t) hij] using
        (intervalMap_finrank_range (k := k) (B.toList.get t) hij)
    _ = B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death) := by
      simpa only [Multiset.coe_toList] using
        (list_get_sum_countP B.toList (fun I => I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death))

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeRankInteger_nat
statement:
theorem barcodeRankInteger_nat {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (hj : j < N) :
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (i : ℤ) (j : ℤ) =
      (B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ i ∧ j < I.death) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : 0 ≤ (i : ℤ) ∧ (i : ℤ) ≤ (j : ℤ) ∧ (j : ℤ) < (N : ℤ) := by omega
  simp [barcodeRankInteger, h, rank_barcodeMap]

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeRankInteger_neg_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem barcodeRankInteger_neg_one {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (j : ℤ) :
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (-1) j = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [barcodeRankInteger]

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeRankInteger_at_size
statement:
@[simp] theorem barcodeRankInteger_at_size {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (i : ℤ) :
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B i (N : ℤ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [barcodeRankInteger]

name: TDA.Persistence.interval_indicator_difference
statement:
private theorem interval_indicator_difference {N : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval N)
    (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    (if I.birth ≤ b ∧ d - 1 < I.death then (1 : ℤ) else 0) -
      (if 0 < b ∧ I.birth ≤ b - 1 ∧ d - 1 < I.death then 1 else 0) -
      (if d < N ∧ I.birth ≤ b ∧ d < I.death then 1 else 0) +
      (if 0 < b ∧ d < N ∧ I.birth ≤ b - 1 ∧ d < I.death then 1 else 0) =
        if I.birth = b ∧ I.death = d then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hI : I.birth < I.death := I.birth_lt_death
  have hIN : I.death ≤ N := I.death_le_size
  by_cases hb : 0 < b
  by_cases hdN : d < N
  by_cases hbirth : I.birth ≤ b
  by_cases hbirthPrev : I.birth ≤ b - 1
  by_cases hdeathPrev : d - 1 < I.death
  by_cases hdeath : d < I.death
  all_goals
    simp_all
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.multiset_four_difference
statement:
private theorem multiset_four_difference {N : ℕ}
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    (B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ b ∧ d - 1 < I.death) : ℤ) -
      (B.countP (fun I => 0 < b ∧ I.birth ≤ b - 1 ∧ d - 1 < I.death) : ℤ) -
      (B.countP (fun I => d < N ∧ I.birth ≤ b ∧ d < I.death) : ℤ) +
      (B.countP (fun I => 0 < b ∧ d < N ∧ I.birth ≤ b - 1 ∧ d < I.death) : ℤ) =
        (barcodeMultiplicity B b d : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction B using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [barcodeMultiplicity]
  | cons I B ih =>
      simp only [Multiset.countP_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero,
        barcodeMultiplicity]
      simp only [barcodeMultiplicity] at ih
      have hsingle := interval_indicator_difference I b d hbd hd
      omega

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeRankInteger_birth_deathPrev
statement:
private theorem barcodeRankInteger_birth_deathPrev {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (b : ℤ) ((d : ℤ) - 1) =
      (B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ b ∧ d - 1 < I.death) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by omega
  have hbd' : b ≤ d - 1 := by omega
  have hd' : d - 1 < N := by omega
  have hcast : ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (d : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
  rw [← hcast]
  exact barcodeRankInteger_nat B b (d - 1) hbd' hd'

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeRankInteger_birthPrev_deathPrev
statement:
private theorem barcodeRankInteger_birthPrev_deathPrev {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B ((b : ℤ) - 1) ((d : ℤ) - 1) =
      (B.countP (fun I => 0 < b ∧ I.birth ≤ b - 1 ∧ d - 1 < I.death) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · have hcast : (b : ℤ) - 1 = -1 := by omega
    rw [hcast, barcodeRankInteger_neg_one]
    simp [hb]
  · have hbpos : 0 < b := by omega
    have hdpos : 0 < d := by omega
    have hbcast : ((b - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (b : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    have hdcast : ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (d : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    rw [← hbcast, ← hdcast]
    simpa only [hbpos, true_and] using
      (barcodeRankInteger_nat (k := k) B (b - 1) (d - 1) (by omega) (by omega))

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeRankInteger_birth_death
statement:
private theorem barcodeRankInteger_birth_death {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (b : ℤ) (d : ℤ) =
      (B.countP (fun I => d < N ∧ I.birth ≤ b ∧ d < I.death) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hdN : d = N
  · have hcast : (d : ℤ) = (N : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hdN
    rw [hcast, barcodeRankInteger_at_size]
    simp [hdN]
  · have hdlt : d < N := by omega
    simpa only [hdlt, true_and] using
      (barcodeRankInteger_nat (k := k) B b d (by omega) hdlt)

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeRankInteger_birthPrev_death
statement:
private theorem barcodeRankInteger_birthPrev_death {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B ((b : ℤ) - 1) (d : ℤ) =
      (B.countP (fun I => 0 < b ∧ d < N ∧ I.birth ≤ b - 1 ∧ d < I.death) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : b = 0
  · have hcast : (b : ℤ) - 1 = -1 := by omega
    rw [hcast, barcodeRankInteger_neg_one]
    simp [hb]
  · have hbpos : 0 < b := by omega
    by_cases hdN : d = N
    · have hcast : (d : ℤ) = (N : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hdN
      rw [hcast, barcodeRankInteger_at_size]
      simp [hdN]
    · have hdlt : d < N := by omega
      have hbcast : ((b - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (b : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
      rw [← hbcast]
      simpa only [hbpos, hdlt, true_and] using
        (barcodeRankInteger_nat (k := k) B (b - 1) d (by omega) hdlt)

name: TDA.Persistence.multiplicity_eq_rank_difference
statement:
theorem multiplicity_eq_rank_difference {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    (barcodeMultiplicity B b d : ℤ) =
      barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (b : ℤ) ((d : ℤ) - 1) -
        barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B ((b : ℤ) - 1) ((d : ℤ) - 1) -
        barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (b : ℤ) (d : ℤ) +
        barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B ((b : ℤ) - 1) (d : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [barcodeRankInteger_birth_deathPrev B b d hbd hd,
    barcodeRankInteger_birthPrev_deathPrev B b d hbd hd,
    barcodeRankInteger_birth_death B b d hbd hd,
    barcodeRankInteger_birthPrev_death B b d hbd hd]
  exact (multiset_four_difference B b d hbd hd).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeRankInteger_injective
statement:
theorem barcodeRankInteger_injective {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {B C : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)}
    (h : ∀ i j : ℤ, barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B i j =
      barcodeRankInteger (k := k) C i j) : B = C
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hm (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
      barcodeMultiplicity B b d = barcodeMultiplicity C b d := by
    have hB := multiplicity_eq_rank_difference (k := k) B b d hbd hd
    have hC := multiplicity_eq_rank_difference (k := k) C b d hbd hd
    have hcast : (barcodeMultiplicity B b d : ℤ) = barcodeMultiplicity C b d := by
      rw [hB, hC, h (b : ℤ) ((d : ℤ) - 1), h ((b : ℤ) - 1) ((d : ℤ) - 1),
        h (b : ℤ) (d : ℤ), h ((b : ℤ) - 1) (d : ℤ)]
    exact_mod_cast hcast
  apply Multiset.ext'
  intro I
  have hpred (J : FiniteInterval N) :
      (J.birth = I.birth ∧ J.death = I.death) ↔ J = I := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hb, hd⟩
      cases J with
      | mk jb jd hjb hjd =>
        cases I with
        | mk ib id hib hid =>
          simp_all
    · intro h
      subst J
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hB := hm I.birth I.death I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size
  have hBcount : B.count I = barcodeMultiplicity B I.birth I.death := by
    simpa [barcodeMultiplicity, Multiset.count, eq_comm] using
      (Multiset.countP_congr (s := B) (s' := B) rfl
        (fun J _ => propext (hpred J)))
  have hCcount : C.count I = barcodeMultiplicity C I.birth I.death := by
    simpa [barcodeMultiplicity, Multiset.count, eq_comm] using
      (Multiset.countP_congr (s := C) (s' := C) rfl
        (fun J _ => propext (hpred J)))
  rw [hBcount, hCcount, hB]

name: TDA.Persistence.emptyBarcode_rank_N0
statement:
@[simp] theorem emptyBarcode_rank_N0 {k : Type u} [Field k] (i j : ℤ) :
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) (N := 0) (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 0)) i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold barcodeRankInteger
  split
  · rename_i h
    omega
  · rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.rank_emptyBarcode
statement:
theorem rank_emptyBarcode {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)))
      i j hij = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rank_barcodeMap]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.rank_single_fullInterval_N1
statement:
theorem rank_single_fullInterval_N1 {k : Type u} [Field k] :
    let I : FiniteInterval 1 := ⟨0, 1, by omega, by omega⟩
    structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 1)))
      (0 : Fin 1) 0 (by omega) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp
  rw [rank_barcodeMap]
  change Multiset.countP (fun x : FiniteInterval 1 => x.birth = 0 ∧ 0 < x.death)
    ((⟨0, 1, by omega, by omega⟩ : FiniteInterval 1) ::ₘ 0) = 1
  rw [Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos (s := 0) (by simp)]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.rank_fullObservedInterval
statement:
theorem rank_fullObservedInterval {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k] (hN : 0 < N) :
    let I : FiniteInterval N := ⟨0, N, by omega, by omega⟩
    structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)))
      ⟨0, by omega⟩ ⟨N - 1, by omega⟩ (by
        apply Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr
        change (0 : ℕ) ≤ N - 1
        omega) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp
  rw [rank_barcodeMap]
  change Multiset.countP (fun I : FiniteInterval N => I.birth ≤ 0 ∧ N - 1 < I.death)
    ((⟨0, N, by omega, by omega⟩ : FiniteInterval N) ::ₘ 0) = 1
  rw [Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos (s := 0) (by simp; omega)]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.rank_duplicate_fullInterval_N1
statement:
theorem rank_duplicate_fullInterval_N1 {k : Type u} [Field k] :
    let I : FiniteInterval 1 := ⟨0, 1, by omega, by omega⟩
    structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k)
      (({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 1)) + {I})) (0 : Fin 1) 0 (by omega) = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp
  rw [rank_barcodeMap]
  change Multiset.countP (fun x : FiniteInterval 1 => x.birth ≤ 0 ∧ 0 < x.death)
    ((⟨0, 1, by omega, by omega⟩ : FiniteInterval 1) ::ₘ
      ((⟨0, 1, by omega, by omega⟩ : FiniteInterval 1) ::ₘ 0)) = 2
  rw [Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos (s := _ ::ₘ 0) (by norm_num),
    Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos (s := 0) (by norm_num)]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.fullInterval_boundary_difference
statement:
theorem fullInterval_boundary_difference {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k] (hN : 0 < N) :
    let I : FiniteInterval N := ⟨0, N, by omega, by omega⟩
    let B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N) := {I}
    (barcodeMultiplicity B 0 N : ℤ) =
      barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (0 : ℤ) ((N : ℤ) - 1) -
        barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (-1) ((N : ℤ) - 1) -
        barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (0 : ℤ) (N : ℤ) +
        barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (-1) (N : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp
  exact multiplicity_eq_rank_difference (k := k) _ 0 N (by omega) (by omega)

name: TDA.Persistence.fullInterval_boundary_rank_sum_one
statement:
theorem fullInterval_boundary_rank_sum_one {N : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (hN : 0 < N) :
    let I : FiniteInterval N := ⟨0, N, by omega, by omega⟩
    let B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N) := {I}
    barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (0 : ℤ) ((N : ℤ) - 1) -
      barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (-1) ((N : ℤ) - 1) -
      barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (0 : ℤ) (N : ℤ) +
      barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B (-1) (N : ℤ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp
  have hfirst : barcodeRankInteger (k := k)
      (({(⟨0, N, by omega, by omega⟩ : FiniteInterval N)} : Multiset _))
      (0 : ℤ) ((N : ℤ) - 1) = 1 := by
    have hnat := barcodeRankInteger_nat (k := k)
      (({(⟨0, N, by omega, by omega⟩ : FiniteInterval N)} : Multiset _))
      0 (N - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    have hcast : ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (N : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
    rw [← hcast]
    change barcodeRankInteger (k := k)
      (({(⟨0, N, by omega, by omega⟩ : FiniteInterval N)} : Multiset _))
      ((0 : ℕ) : ℤ) ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = 1
    rw [hnat]
    change (Multiset.countP
      (fun I : FiniteInterval N => I.birth ≤ 0 ∧ N - 1 < I.death)
      ((⟨0, N, by omega, by omega⟩ : FiniteInterval N) ::ₘ 0) : ℤ) = 1
    rw [Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos (s := 0) (by simp; omega)]
    simp
  rw [hfirst, barcodeRankInteger_neg_one, barcodeRankInteger_at_size,
    barcodeRankInteger_neg_one]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.equal_dimensions_different_structureMapRanks
statement:
theorem equal_dimensions_different_structureMapRanks {k : Type u} [Field k] :
    (∀ i : Fin 2,
      Module.finrank k ((identityTransitionDiagram k).obj i) =
        Module.finrank k ((zeroTransitionDiagram k).obj i)) ∧
      structureMapRank (identityTransitionDiagram k) (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by omega) = 1 ∧
      structureMapRank (zeroTransitionDiagram k) (0 : Fin 2) 1 (by omega) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    change Module.finrank k k = Module.finrank k k
    rfl
  · change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k)) = 1
    rw [LinearMap.range_id]
    rw [finrank_top]
    exact Module.finrank_self k
  · change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (0 : k →ₗ[k] k)) = 0
    rw [LinearMap.range_zero]
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cutCell_lower_decoration_example
statement:
theorem cutCell_lower_decoration_example :
    minusCut (0 : ℝ) ∉ cutCell 0 1 ∧ plusCut (0 : ℝ) ∈ cutCell 0 1
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [cutCell, minusCut, plusCut]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cutCell_upper_decoration_example
statement:
theorem cutCell_upper_decoration_example :
    minusCut (1 : ℝ) ∈ cutCell 0 1 ∧ plusCut (1 : ℝ) ∉ cutCell 0 1
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [cutCell, minusCut, plusCut]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.finiteNatCells_ring
statement:
private theorem finiteNatCells_ring : IsSetRing {U : Set ℕ | U.Finite} where
  empty_mem
proof:
:= finite_empty
  union_mem := by
    intro U V hU hV
    exact hU.union hV
  sdiff_mem := by
    intro U V hU _
    exact hU.sdiff

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.counting_contentMultiplicity
statement:
theorem counting_contentMultiplicity (n : ℕ) :
    contentMultiplicity finiteNatCountingContent n = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle := contentMultiplicity_le finiteNatCountingContent (finite_singleton n)
    (mem_singleton n)
  change contentMultiplicity finiteNatCountingContent n ≤ ({n} : Set ℕ).ncard at hle
  simp only [ncard_singleton] at hle
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hnU, hmin⟩ := exists_cell_eq_contentMultiplicity finiteNatCountingContent n
    ⟨{n}, finite_singleton n, mem_singleton n⟩
  have hpos : 0 < contentMultiplicity finiteNatCountingContent n := by
    rw [← hmin]
    exact (Set.ncard_pos hU).mpr ⟨n, hnU⟩
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.counting_content_infinite_support
statement:
theorem counting_content_infinite_support :
    Set.Infinite {n : ℕ | 0 < contentMultiplicity finiteNatCountingContent n}
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [counting_contentMultiplicity, Nat.zero_lt_one, ofPred_true] using
    (Set.infinite_univ : Set.Infinite (Set.univ : Set ℕ))

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.counting_content_local_representation
statement:
theorem counting_content_local_representation (K : Set ℕ) (hK : K.Finite) :
    ∃ points : Multiset ℕ, (∀ n ∈ points, n ∈ K) ∧
      ∀ U : Set ℕ, U.Finite → U ⊆ K → U.ncard = (points.filter (· ∈ U)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact exists_local_atomic_representation finiteNatCells_ring.isSetSemiring
    finiteNatCountingContent (fun _ _ => isOpen_discrete _) hK hK.isCompact

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.inverse_displacement
statement:
private theorem inverse_displacement :
    ∀ w v, (w, v) ∈ C.inv → dist (q w) (p v) ≤ (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro w v hwv
  exact (dist_comm _ _).trans_le (h v w hwv)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.relationInterleaving_φ
statement:
@[simp] theorem relationInterleaving_φ (n : ℕ) :
    (relationInterleaving R p q hCT hIT h n).φ =
      multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal R hCT
        (Cech.isShiftedSimplicialRelation_of_dist_le p q h) n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.relationInterleaving_ψ
statement:
@[simp] theorem relationInterleaving_ψ (n : ℕ) :
    (relationInterleaving R p q hCT hIT h n).ψ =
      multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal R hIT
        (Cech.isShiftedSimplicialRelation_of_dist_le q p (by
          intro w v hwv

private theorem fd_of_injective

    (i : X ⟶ Y) (hi : Function.Injective i.hom)
    (hY : FiniteDimensional k (restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) Y)) :
    FiniteDimensional k (restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) X)
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexProjectiveDimension.restricted_finite_of_restrictScalars_finite
statement:
private theorem restricted_finite_of_restrictScalars_finite

    (hM : FiniteDimensional k (restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M)) :
    Module.Finite (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) M
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexProjectiveDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_vertex
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_vertex
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    (hM : FiniteDimensional k (restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M))
    (d : ℕ)
    (hV : HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((V (k := k) (S := S)).obj M) d) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE M d
proof:
:= by
  induction d generalizing M with
  | zero =>
      apply (projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_zero M).mp
      exact projective_of_vertex_projective (k := k) (S := S) M
        ((projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_zero _).mpr hV)
  | succ d ih =>
      letI : Module.Finite (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) M :=
        restricted_finite_of_restrictScalars_finite (k := k) (S := S) M hM
      obtain ⟨n, f, hf⟩ := Module.Finite.exists_fin' (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) M
      let F : ModuleCat (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) := finiteFreeModule (k := k) (S := S) n
      let sf := LinearMap.shortComplexKer f
      have hsf : sf.ShortExact := LinearMap.shortExact_shortComplexKer hf
      let hcomp : sf.f ≫ sf.g = 0 := sf.zero
      let targetRow : ShortComplex (PModule.{u,0,u} k (PairPoset S)) :=
        ShortComplex.mk ((V (k := k) (S := S)).map sf.f)
          ((V (k := k) (S := S)).map sf.g) (by
            rw [← Functor.map_comp, hcomp]
            simp)
      have hpoint : IsPointwiseShortExact
          ((V (k := k) (S := S)).map sf.f)
          ((V (k := k) (S := S)).map sf.g) :=
        (rightIncidenceShortExact_iff_vertexPointwise (k := k) (S := S)
          sf.f sf.g hcomp).mp hsf
      have htarget : targetRow.ShortExact := hpoint.shortExact
      have hmiddleProj : Projective ((V (k := k) (S := S)).obj F) := by
        exact finiteFreeVertex_projective (k := k) (S := S) n
      have hmiddle : HasProjectiveDimensionLT ((V (k := k) (S := S)).obj F) (d + 1) :=
        hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ 1 (d + 1) (by omega)
      let K : ModuleCat (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) :=
        ModuleCat.of (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)) (LinearMap.ker f)
      let inclusion : K ⟶ F := ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.ker f).subtype
      have hFfd := finiteFreeModule_finiteDimensional (k := k) (S := S) n
      have hKfd := fd_of_injective (k := k) (S := S) inclusion
        (LinearMap.ker f).injective_subtype hFfd
      have hVK : HasProjectiveDimensionLE ((V (k := k) (S := S)).obj K) d := by
        have hVK' : HasProjectiveDimensionLT ((V (k := k) (S := S)).obj K) (d + 1) :=
          htarget.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₁ (d + 1) hmiddle hV
        exact hVK'
      have hK : HasProjectiveDimensionLE K d :=
        ih K hKfd hVK
      have hfree : HasProjectiveDimensionLT F (d + 2) := by
        have hproj : Projective F := finiteFreeModule_projective (k := k) (S := S) n
        have h₁ : HasProjectiveDimensionLT F 1 :=
          projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLT_one.mp hproj
        exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ 1 (d + 2) (by omega)
      have htargetM : HasProjectiveDimensionLT M (d + 2) := by
        have hK' : HasProjectiveDimensionLT K (d + 1) := hK
        exact hsf.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃ (d + 1) hK' hfree
      exact htargetM

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexProjectiveDimension.quotientHom_comp_algebraMap
statement:
theorem quotientHom_comp_algebraMap :
    algebraMap k (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) =
      (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S)).comp
        (algebraMap k (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  simp [quotientHom]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexProjectiveDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    [OrderBot S] [OrderTop S]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.RightIncidence (k := k) (S := S)))
    (hM : FiniteDimensional k (restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S) M)) :
    letI : Lattice (PairPoset S) := pairPosetLattice (S := S)
    letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset S) := pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := S)
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE M (maxComplementCard (S := PairPoset S))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Lattice (PairPoset S) := pairPosetLattice (S := S)
  letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset S) := pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := S)
  have hpfd : ∀ p : PairPoset S,
      FiniteDimensional k (((V (k := k) (S := S)).obj M).obj p) := by
    intro p
    exact (finiteDimensional_iff_vertexFibers (k := k) (S := S) M).mp hM p
  letI : ∀ p : PairPoset S,
      FiniteDimensional k (((V (k := k) (S := S)).obj M).obj p) := hpfd
  have hV := OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE (k := k)
    ((V (k := k) (S := S)).obj M)
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_vertex (k := k) (S := S) M hM _ hV

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexProjectiveDimension.quotient_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem quotient_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    [OrderBot S] [OrderTop S]
    (N : ModuleCat.{u} (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    (hN : FiniteDimensional k (restrictRightQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S) N)) :
    letI : Lattice (PairPoset S) := pairPosetLattice (S := S)
    letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset S) := pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := S)
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE N (maxComplementCard (S := PairPoset S))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Lattice (PairPoset S) := pairPosetLattice (S := S)
  letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset S) := pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := S)
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (restrictRightQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S) N) := hN
  have hRes : FiniteDimensional k (restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := S)
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)) :=
    (quotientRestrictionIso (k := k) (S := S) N).toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  have hR := hasProjectiveDimensionLE (k := k) (S := S)
    ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N) hRes
  exact extension_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_restricted (k := k) (S := S) N _ hR

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexProjectiveDimension.coordinateGrid_rightIncidence_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem coordinateGrid_rightIncidence_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    {n : ℕ} (G : CoordinateGrid n) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hG : ∀ i : Fin n, (G i).Nonempty)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.RightIncidence
      (k := k) (S := G.Point)))
    (hM : FiniteDimensional k (restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := G.Point) M)) :
    letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE M (2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
  letI : Lattice (PairPoset G.Point) := pairPosetLattice (S := G.Point)
  letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset G.Point) := pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := G.Point)
  have hcount := maxComplementCard_pair_coordinateGrid_le G hn hG
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT M
      (maxComplementCard (S := PairPoset G.Point) + 1) :=
    hasProjectiveDimensionLE (k := k) (S := G.Point) M hM
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge M _ _ (Nat.succ_le_succ hcount)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexProjectiveDimension.coordinateGrid_rightQuotient_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem coordinateGrid_rightQuotient_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    {n : ℕ} (G : CoordinateGrid n) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hG : ∀ i : Fin n, (G i).Nonempty)
    (N : ModuleCat.{u} (IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.RightQuotient
      (k := k) (S := G.Point)))
    (hN : FiniteDimensional k (restrictRightQuotientModule (k := k) (S := G.Point) N)) :
    letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE N (2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
  letI : Lattice (PairPoset G.Point) := pairPosetLattice (S := G.Point)
  letI : BoundedOrder (PairPoset G.Point) := pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := G.Point)
  have hcount := maxComplementCard_pair_coordinateGrid_le G hn hG
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT N
      (maxComplementCard (S := PairPoset G.Point) + 1) :=
    quotient_hasProjectiveDimensionLE (k := k) (S := G.Point) N hN
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge N _ _ (Nat.succ_le_succ hcount)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.Examples.box_significant
statement: private theorem box_significant (n : ℕ) : Significant 6 (closedBox n)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ => 0, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro j <;>
    norm_num [Rectangle.support, BoundedInterval.support, closedBox, translation_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.Examples.repeated_two_sided
statement:
theorem repeated_two_sided :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching Bool Bool PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      IsMatching (k := ℚ) 3 (fun _ => closedBox 2) (fun _ => closedBox 2) M ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ j, M.finite i = some j) ∧ (∀ j, ∃ i, M.finite i = some j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_matching (k := ℚ) (by decide : 0 < 2)
    (fun _ : Bool => closedBox 2) (fun _ : Bool => closedBox 2) 1
    (CoordinateInterleaving.refl 1 _)
  have hM' : IsMatching (k := ℚ) 3 (fun _ => closedBox 2) (fun _ => closedBox 2) M := by
    simpa [RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius] using hM
  have hs : Significant (3 + 3) (closedBox 2) := by
    norm_num
    exact box_significant 2
  exact ⟨M, hM', fun i => hM'.source_covered i hs,
    fun j => hM'.target_covered j hs⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.Examples.singleton_significant_zero
statement: private theorem singleton_significant_zero : Significant 0 singleton
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.Examples.zero_parameter_coverage
statement:
theorem zero_parameter_coverage :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching Bool Bool PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      IsMatching (k := ℚ) 0 (fun _ => singleton) (fun _ => singleton) M ∧
      (∀ i, ∃ j, M.finite i = some j) ∧ (∀ j, ∃ i, M.finite i = some j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_matching (k := ℚ) (by decide : 0 < 1)
    (fun _ : Bool => singleton) (fun _ : Bool => singleton) 0
    (CoordinateInterleaving.refl 0 _)
  have hM' : IsMatching (k := ℚ) 0 (fun _ => singleton) (fun _ => singleton) M := by
    simpa [RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius] using hM
  have hs : Significant (0 + 0) singleton := by simpa using singleton_significant_zero
  exact ⟨M, hM', fun i => hM'.source_covered i hs,
    fun j => hM'.target_covered j hs⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.Examples.halfOpen_zero
statement:
theorem halfOpen_zero :
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving 1 ((bar false).module (k := ℚ)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply (interleaved_zero_iff _ _).mpr
  rintro ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩
  have h := hp 0
  have h' := hp' 0
  norm_num only [show (1 + 1 : ℝ≥0) = 2 by norm_num] at h'
  change (0 < p 0 ∨ (0 = p 0 ∧ true = true)) ∧ _ at h
  change _ ∧ (p 0 + 2 < 2 ∨ (p 0 + 2 = 2 ∧ false = true)) at h'
  rcases h.1 with h | ⟨h, _⟩ <;>
    (rcases h'.2 with h' | ⟨_, h'⟩ <;> simp_all <;> linarith)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.Examples.closed_not_zero
statement:
theorem closed_not_zero :
    ¬ Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving 1 ((bar true).module (k := ℚ)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [interleaved_zero_iff, not_not]
  refine ⟨fun _ => 0, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro j <;>
    norm_num [Rectangle.support, BoundedInterval.support, bar, translation_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.Examples.empty_target_deletion
statement:
theorem empty_target_deletion :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching Unit (Fin 0) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      IsMatching (k := ℚ) 1 (fun _ => bar false) (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) M ∧
      M.finite () = none
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_matching (by decide : 0 < 1) _ _ 1 deleteBar
  refine ⟨M, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius] using hM
  · cases h : M.finite () with
    | none => rfl
    | some j => exact Fin.elim0 j

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.Examples.empty_source_deletion
statement:
theorem empty_source_deletion :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 0) Unit PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      IsMatching (k := ℚ) 1 (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) (fun _ => bar false) M ∧
      Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving 1 ((bar false).module (k := ℚ)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_matching (by decide : 0 < 1) _ _ 1 deleteBar.symm
  have hM' : IsMatching (k := ℚ) 1 (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) (fun _ => bar false) M := by
    simpa [RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius] using hM
  exact ⟨M, hM', hM'.target_zero () (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.Examples.empty_families
statement:

    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 0) (Fin 0) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      IsMatching (k := ℚ) (n := 1) 0 (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) M

    (exists_matching (k := ℚ) (by decide : 0 < 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.powerCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem powerCost_nonneg (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : 0 ≤ a.powerCost p x y
proof:
:=
  a.linearCost_nonneg _ _ _
    (fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _)
    (fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _)
    (fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.exists_powerMatching_cost_le
statement:

    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y ≤ a.powerCost p x y
proof:

  a.exists_matching_linearCost_le _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBoundaryPlan.matchingPowerCost_le_powerCost
