    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePowerMatchingCost p x y ≤ a.powerCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := a.exists_powerMatching_cost_le p x y
  exact (finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching p x y M).trans hM

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan
statement:
theorem finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) :
    finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost p x y ≤ a.powerCost p x y
proof:
:=
  ciInf_le ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨b, rfl⟩; exact b.powerCost_nonneg p x y⟩ a

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost
statement:
theorem finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost p x y = finitePowerMatchingCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerMatching p x y
    calc
      _ ≤ (FiniteBoundaryPlan.ofMatching M).powerCost p x y :=
        finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan _ _ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [FiniteBoundaryPlan.powerCost_ofMatching, hM]
  · exact le_ciInf fun a => a.matchingPowerCost_le_powerCost p x y

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : 0 ≤ finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  exact finitePowerMatchingCost_nonneg p x y

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_minimizing_powerBoundaryPlan
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_powerBoundaryPlan (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      (FiniteBoundaryPlan.ofMatching M).powerCost p x y = finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerMatching p x y
  exact ⟨M, by rw [FiniteBoundaryPlan.powerCost_ofMatching,
    finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost, hM]⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y = finitePMatchingCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost, finitePMatchingCost,
    finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : 0 ≤ finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y
proof:
:=
  Real.rpow_nonneg (finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg p x y) _

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y ≤ a.powerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:=
  Real.rpow_le_rpow (finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg p x y)
    (finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan p x y a)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_trans zero_le_one hp))

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_minimizing_pBoundaryPlan
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_pBoundaryPlan (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      (FiniteBoundaryPlan.ofMatching M).powerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹ = finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerBoundaryPlan p x y
  exact ⟨M, by rw [hM]; rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_iInf {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y = ⨅ a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J, a.powerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hbd : BddBelow (Set.range fun a : FiniteBoundaryPlan I J => a.powerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹) := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (a.powerCost_nonneg p x y) _
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_ciInf fun a => finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan hp x y a
  · obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_pBoundaryPlan p x y
    exact (ciInf_le hbd (FiniteBoundaryPlan.ofMatching M)).trans_eq hM

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_one
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost 1 x y = finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_one,
    finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_one
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost 1 x y = finiteFirstOrderBoundaryTransportCost x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [finitePBoundaryTransportCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right
statement:
theorem finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right [IsEmpty J]
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost p x y = ∑ i, (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left
statement:
theorem finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left [IsEmpty I]
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost p x y = ∑ j, (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_left]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_empty [IsEmpty I] [IsEmpty J]
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost p x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right]; exact Fintype.sum_empty _

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right [IsEmpty J]
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y = (∑ i, (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost, finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left [IsEmpty I]
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y = (∑ j, (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ p) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost, finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_left]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty [IsEmpty I] [IsEmpty J]
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  exact finitePMatchingCost_empty hp x y

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_reindex
statement:
theorem finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_reindex {I' J' : Type*} [Fintype I'] [Fintype J']
    (u : I' ≃ I) (v : J' ≃ J) (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost p (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) = finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_reindex]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_reindex
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_reindex {I' J' : Type*} [Fintype I'] [Fintype J']
    (u : I' ≃ I) (v : J' ≃ J) (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) = finitePBoundaryTransportCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost, finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_reindex]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.zeroHomologyCoefficientSum_natural
statement:
theorem zeroHomologyCoefficientSum_natural
    [Nonempty V] {K L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} (h : K ≤ L) :
    (zeroHomologyCoefficientSum k L).comp (simplicialHomologyIncl k h 0).hom =
      zeroHomologyCoefficientSum k K
proof:
:= by
  have hcompose :
      VertexMap.comp (inclusionVertexMap h)
          (pointCollapseVertexMap L (h0Basepoint (V := V))) =
        pointCollapseVertexMap K (h0Basepoint (V := V)) := by
    apply VertexMap.ext
    intro v
    rfl
  have hmap := simplicialHomologyMap_comp k (inclusionVertexMap h)
    (pointCollapseVertexMap L (h0Basepoint (V := V))) 0
  rw [hcompose, simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion] at hmap
  have hmapHom := congrArg (fun f => f.hom) hmap
  simp only [ModuleCat.hom_comp] at hmapHom
  simp only [zeroHomologyCoefficientSum]
  rw [LinearMap.comp_assoc, ← hmapHom]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.zeroHomologyCoefficientSum_vertex
statement:
theorem zeroHomologyCoefficientSum_vertex
    [Nonempty V] (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (σ : Face K 0) (a : k) :
    zeroHomologyCoefficientSum k K
      (simplicialHomologyClass k K 0 (a • zeroVertexCycle K k σ)) = a
proof:
:= by
  let v₀ := h0Basepoint (V := V)
  let P := TDA.Filtration.singletonFace v₀
  have hface : vertexImageFace (pointCollapseVertexMap K v₀) σ
      (fun i j _ => Fin.ext (by omega)) = singletonVertex v₀ :=
    Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hchain : vertexChainMap k (pointCollapseVertexMap K v₀) 0
      (a • zeroVertexCycle K k σ : Chain K k 0) =
        (a • zeroVertexCycle P k (singletonVertex v₀) : Chain P k 0) := by
    change vertexChainMap k (pointCollapseVertexMap K v₀) 0
        (a • Finsupp.single σ (1 : k)) =
      a • Finsupp.single (singletonVertex v₀) (1 : k)
    rw [map_smul, vertexChainMap_vertex, hface]
  rw [zeroHomologyCoefficientSum, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hclass := simplicialHomologyMap_class (R := k) (f := pointCollapseVertexMap K v₀)
    (n := 0) (z := a • zeroVertexCycle K k σ)
    (w := a • zeroVertexCycle P k (singletonVertex v₀)) hchain
  have hcycle : (a • zeroVertexCycle P k (singletonVertex v₀) : simplicialCycles P k 0) =
      ⟨Finsupp.single (singletonVertex v₀) a, by
        rw [simplicialCycles_zero]
        trivial⟩ := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [zeroVertexCycle, Finsupp.smul_single]
  rw [hclass]
  rw [hcycle]
  exact simplicialSingletonH0Equiv_class k v₀ a

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.reducedSublevelH0_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem reducedSublevelH0_finiteDimensional [Fintype V] [Nonempty V] (d : MetricSpace V)
    (i : Fin (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d).criticalValues.card) :
    FiniteDimensional k
      ((reducedSublevelH0Module k d).obj ((TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d).criticalValue i))
proof:
:= by
  let f := TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d
  letI : FiniteDimensional k ((sublevelModule k f 0).obj (f.criticalValue i)) :=
    sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k 0 f i
  exact RankKernel.finiteDimensional (sublevelH0Augmentation k d) (f.criticalValue i)

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.ripsZeroCriticalValue_mem
statement:
private theorem ripsZeroCriticalValue_mem [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) :
    (0 : ℝ) ∈ (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d).criticalValues
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v⟩ := ‹Nonempty V›
  apply (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d).mem_criticalValues 0 |>.2
  refine ⟨⟨{v}, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
  simp [TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter, TDA.Filtration.Rips.diameter_singleton]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.ripsCriticalValue_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  let f := TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (f.mem_criticalValues (f.criticalValue i)).1 (f.criticalValue_mem i)
  rw [← hs, TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter_value]
  exact TDA.Filtration.Rips.diameter_nonneg d s.1

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.sublevelH0Augmentation_surjective
statement:
private theorem sublevelH0Augmentation_surjective [Nonempty V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    Function.Surjective ((sublevelH0Augmentation k d).app t).hom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨v⟩ := ‹Nonempty V›
  let K := (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d).sublevelFiltration t
  have hvertex : {v} ∈ K := by
    change {v} ∈ (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d).sublevel t
    rw [TDA.Filtration.Rips.mem_sublevel_iff]
    refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx hy
    subst x
    subst y
    simpa using ht
  let σ : Face K 0 := ⟨{v}, hvertex, by simp⟩
  intro a
  refine ⟨simplicialHomologyClass k K 0 (a • zeroVertexCycle K k σ), ?_⟩
  have hcollapse : (sublevelH0Augmentation k d).app t =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (zeroHomologyCoefficientSum k K) := by
    rfl
  rw [hcollapse]
  change zeroHomologyCoefficientSum k K
    (simplicialHomologyClass k K 0 (a • zeroVertexCycle K k σ)) = a
  exact zeroHomologyCoefficientSum_vertex k K σ a

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.sublevelH0Augmentation_rankExact
statement:
private theorem sublevelH0Augmentation_rankExact [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) :
    IsRankExact
      (kernel.ι (reindexNatTrans (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d).criticalValue.toOrderHom
        (sublevelH0Augmentation k d)))
      (reindexNatTrans (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d).criticalValue.toOrderHom
        (sublevelH0Augmentation k d))
proof:
:= by
  let f := TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d
  let c := f.criticalValue
  let π := reindexNatTrans c.toOrderHom (sublevelH0Augmentation k d)
  letI : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k
      ((reindex c.toOrderHom (sublevelModule k f 0)).obj i) := by
    intro i
    change FiniteDimensional k ((sublevelModule k f 0).obj (c i))
    exact sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k 0 f i
  apply RankKernel.rankExact π
  · intro i
    exact sublevelH0Augmentation_surjective k d (ripsCriticalValue_nonneg d i)
  · intro a b hab n hn
    have hn0 : n = 0 := by
      change n = 0 at hn
      exact hn
    subst n
    refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact map_zero _
    · exact map_zero _

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.ripsFirstCriticalValue_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem ripsFirstCriticalValue_eq_zero [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) :
    (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d).criticalValue
      ⟨0, Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨0, ripsZeroCriticalValue_mem d⟩⟩ = 0
proof:
:= by
  let f := TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d
  let c := f.criticalValue
  obtain ⟨v⟩ := ‹Nonempty V›
  let s : TotalFace (TDA.Filtration.Rips.fullComplex V) := ⟨{v}, by simp⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := f.exists_criticalValue_eq s
  have hzero : c j = 0 := by
    rw [hj, TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter_value, TDA.Filtration.Rips.diameter_singleton]
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ c ⟨0, Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨0, ripsZeroCriticalValue_mem d⟩⟩ :=
    ripsCriticalValue_nonneg d _
  have hfirst : (⟨0, Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨0, ripsZeroCriticalValue_mem d⟩⟩ :
      Fin f.criticalValues.card) ≤ j := Fin.le_def.mpr (Nat.zero_le _)
  have hle : c ⟨0, Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨0, ripsZeroCriticalValue_mem d⟩⟩ ≤ 0 := by
    calc
      c ⟨0, Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨0, ripsZeroCriticalValue_mem d⟩⟩ ≤ c j := c.monotone hfirst
      _ = 0 := hzero
  exact le_antisymm hle hnonneg

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.finitePart_add_local
statement:
private theorem finitePart_add_local {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α]
    (s t : Multiset (α × WithTop α)) :
    finitePart (s + t) = finitePart s + finitePart t
proof:
:= by
  exact Multiset.filterMap_add _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.finitePart_top_singleton
statement:
private theorem finitePart_top_singleton {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (b : α) :
    finitePart ({(b, (⊤ : WithTop α))} : Multiset (α × WithTop α)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePart]
  rw [← Multiset.cons_zero]
  change Multiset.filterMap (fun p : α × WithTop α =>
    match p.2 with
    | none => none
    | some q => some (p.1, q)) ((b, (⊤ : WithTop α)) ::ₘ 0) = 0
  rw [Multiset.filterMap_cons_none _ _ (by rfl)]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.ripsH0CriticalBarcode_decomposition
statement:
private theorem ripsH0CriticalBarcode_decomposition [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (d : MetricSpace V)
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k
      ((reindex (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d).criticalValue.toOrderHom
        (sublevelModule k (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d) 0)).obj i)] :
    rankBarcode (reindex (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d).criticalValue.toOrderHom
      (sublevelModule k (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d) 0)) =
      reducedCriticalH0Barcode k d +
        {zeroBornEssentialInterval
          (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d).criticalValues.card
          (Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨0, ripsZeroCriticalValue_mem d⟩)}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d
  let c := f.criticalValue
  let M := reindex c.toOrderHom (sublevelModule k f 0)
  let N := reindex c.toOrderHom ((Functor.const ℝ).obj (ModuleCat.of k k))
  let π := reindexNatTrans c.toOrderHom (sublevelH0Augmentation k d)
  let K := kernel π
  let hn : 0 < f.criticalValues.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨0, ripsZeroCriticalValue_mem d⟩
  let I₀ := zeroBornEssentialInterval f.criticalValues.card hn
  let B := reducedCriticalH0Barcode k d + {I₀}
  letI : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i) := by
    intro i
    change FiniteDimensional k ((sublevelModule k f 0).obj (c i))
    exact sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k 0 f i
  letI : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (K.obj i) := by
    intro i
    exact RankKernel.finiteDimensional π i
  have hExact := sublevelH0Augmentation_rankExact k d
  have hbarcode : rankBarcode M = rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := k) B) := by
    apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff M (barcodeModule (k := k) B)).2
    intro i j hij
    have hrank := hExact.rank_add hij
    have hsum : structureMapRank M i j hij = structureMapRank K i j hij + 1 := by
      change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hij)) =
        Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear K hij)) + 1
      have hrank' := hrank
      change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hij)) =
        Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear K hij)) +
          Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear N hij)) at hrank'
      have hdim : Module.finrank k
          (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear N hij)) = 1 := by
        rw [structureMapLinear_reindex]
        simp only [N, structureMapLinear, structureMap, Functor.const_obj_map,
          ModuleCat.hom_id]
        change Module.finrank k
          (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k)) = 1
        rw [LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
        exact Module.finrank_self k
      rw [hdim] at hrank'
      exact hrank'
    have hcount : B.countP (fun I : FiniteInterval f.criticalValues.card =>
        I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death) = structureMapRank K i j hij + 1 := by
      dsimp [B, reducedCriticalH0Barcode, zeroBornEssentialInterval]
      rw [Multiset.countP_add]
      have hI : (0 : ℕ) ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < f.criticalValues.card := by
        constructor
        · exact Nat.zero_le _
        · exact j.isLt
      have hK := structureMapRank_rankBarcode K i j hij
      rw [rank_barcodeMap] at hK
      have hsingle :
          ({I₀} : Multiset (FiniteInterval f.criticalValues.card)).countP
              (fun I : FiniteInterval f.criticalValues.card =>
                I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death) = 1 := by
        rw [← Multiset.cons_zero, Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos]
        · simp
        · simpa [I₀, zeroBornEssentialInterval] using hI
      rw [hK, hsingle]
    calc
      structureMapRank M i j hij = structureMapRank K i j hij + 1 := hsum
      _ = B.countP (fun I : FiniteInterval f.criticalValues.card =>
            I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death) := hcount.symm
      _ = structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) B) i j hij :=
        (rank_barcodeMap B i j hij).symm
  change rankBarcode M = _
  calc
    rankBarcode M =
        rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := k) B) := hbarcode
    _ = B := rankBarcode_barcodeModule B
    _ = reducedCriticalH0Barcode k d +
          {zeroBornEssentialInterval f.criticalValues.card hn} := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.reducedSublevelH0Diagram_points_addEssential
statement:
private theorem reducedSublevelH0Diagram_points_addEssential [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) :
    (reducedSublevelH0Diagram k d).points + {(0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))} =
      (dgm k (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d) 0).points
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f := TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d
  let c := f.criticalValue
  let hn : 0 < f.criticalValues.card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨0, ripsZeroCriticalValue_mem d⟩
  let I₀ := zeroBornEssentialInterval f.criticalValues.card hn
  letI : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k
      ((reindex c.toOrderHom (sublevelModule k f 0)).obj i) := by
    intro i
    change FiniteDimensional k ((sublevelModule k f 0).obj (c i))
    exact sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k 0 f i
  letI : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k
      ((reindex c.toOrderHom (reducedSublevelH0Module k d)).obj i) :=
    reducedSublevelH0_finiteDimensional k d
  have hgridIso :
      rankBarcode (reindex c.toOrderHom (reducedSublevelH0Module k d)) =
        reducedCriticalH0Barcode k d := by
    let π := reindexNatTrans c.toOrderHom (sublevelH0Augmentation k d)
    letI : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k ((kernel π).obj i) := by
      intro i
      exact RankKernel.finiteDimensional π i
    exact rankBarcode_eq_of_iso (criticalKernelIso c (sublevelH0Augmentation k d))
  have hfirst := ripsFirstCriticalValue_eq_zero d
  have hI : RealBarcode.endpoints c I₀ = (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) := by
    dsimp [RealBarcode.endpoints, I₀, zeroBornEssentialInterval]
    rw [hfirst]
    simp
  rw [← moduleDiagram_sublevelModule k 0 f]
  simp only [reducedSublevelH0Diagram, FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram,
    RealBarcode.ofIndexBars_points]
  rw [hgridIso, ripsH0CriticalBarcode_decomposition k d]
  rw [Multiset.map_add]
  rw [Multiset.map_singleton]
  rw [hI]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.reducedSublevelH0Diagram_points_eq_finitePart
statement:
theorem reducedSublevelH0Diagram_points_eq_finitePart [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) :
    (reducedSublevelH0Diagram k d).points =
      (finitePart (dgm k (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d) 0).points).map
        (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpoints := reducedSublevelH0Diagram_points_addEssential k d
  have hfullEss := TDA.Persistence.Rips.card_essentialPart_dgm_zero (k := k) d
  have hessCard : (essentialPart (reducedSublevelH0Diagram k d).points).card = 0 := by
    have hc := congrArg (fun s => (essentialPart s).card) hpoints
    have hc' :
        (essentialPart (reducedSublevelH0Diagram k d).points).card +
            (essentialPart ({(0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))} : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ))).card = 1 := by
      simpa [essentialPart, Multiset.filterMap_add] using hc.trans hfullEss
    have hsingle :
        (essentialPart ({(0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))} : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ))).card = 1 := by
      rw [essentialPart]
      change (Multiset.filterMap (fun p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ =>
        match p.2 with
        | none => some p.1
        | some _ => none) ((0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ 0)).card = 1
      rw [Multiset.filterMap_cons_some _ _ _ (by rfl)]
      simp
    rw [hsingle] at hc'
    omega
  have hess : essentialPart (reducedSublevelH0Diagram k d).points = 0 :=
    Multiset.card_eq_zero.mp hessCard
  have hparts := parts_reconstruct (reducedSublevelH0Diagram k d).points
  rw [hess, Multiset.map_zero, add_zero] at hparts
  have hfinite :
      finitePart (dgm k (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d) 0).points =
        finitePart (reducedSublevelH0Diagram k d).points := by
    rw [← hpoints, finitePart_add_local, finitePart_top_singleton, add_zero]
  calc
    (reducedSublevelH0Diagram k d).points =
        (finitePart (reducedSublevelH0Diagram k d).points).map
          (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop ℝ))) := hparts.symm
    _ = (finitePart (dgm k (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d) 0).points).map
          (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop ℝ))) := by rw [← hfinite]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.reducedSublevelH0Diagram_points_eq_eraseEssential
statement:
theorem reducedSublevelH0Diagram_points_eq_eraseEssential [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) :
    (dgm k (TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter d) 0).points.erase (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) =
      (reducedSublevelH0Diagram k d).points
proof:
:= by
  rw [← reducedSublevelH0Diagram_points_addEssential k d]
  rw [Multiset.erase_add_right_pos
    (reducedSublevelH0Diagram k d).points (by simp)]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.kernelAt_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem kernelAt_zero {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) :
    kernelAt (k := k) f 0 = GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.target (k := k) f
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.kernelAt_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem kernelAt_one {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) :
    kernelAt (k := k) f 1 = kernel (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation (k := k) f)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.kernelAt_succ_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem kernelAt_succ_succ {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ) :
    kernelAt (k := k) f (r + 2) =
      kernel (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.differential (k := k) f r)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.kernelInclusionAt_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem kernelInclusionAt_zero {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) :
    kernelInclusionAt (k := k) f 0 =
      kernel.ι (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation (k := k) f)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.kernelInclusionAt_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem kernelInclusionAt_succ {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ) :
    kernelInclusionAt (k := k) f (r + 1) =
      kernel.ι (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.differential (k := k) f r)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.kernelQuotientAt_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem kernelQuotientAt_zero {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) :
    kernelQuotientAt (k := k) f 0 =
      GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation (k := k) f
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.kernelQuotientAt_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem kernelQuotientAt_one {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) :
    kernelQuotientAt (k := k) f 1 =
      kernelRowLift (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation_range_eq_ker (k := k) f)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.kernelQuotientAt_succ_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem kernelQuotientAt_succ_succ {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ) :
    kernelQuotientAt (k := k) f (r + 2) =
      kernelRowLift (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.differential_range_eq_ker (k := k) f r)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.row_rankExact
statement:
theorem row_rankExact {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ) :
    IsRankExact (kernelInclusionAt (k := k) f r) (kernelQuotientAt (k := k) f r)
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero => exact GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation_rankExact (k := k) f
  | succ r =>
    cases r with
    | zero => exact GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.zero_kernelRow_rankExact (k := k) f
    | succ r =>
      simpa [kernelInclusionAt, kernelQuotientAt] using
        GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.succ_kernelRow_rankExact (k := k) f r

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.quotient_comp_preceding_inclusion
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem quotient_comp_preceding_inclusion {m : ℕ}
    (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ) :
    kernelQuotientAt (k := k) f (r + 1) ≫ kernelInclusionAt (k := k) f r =
      GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.differential (k := k) f r
proof:
:= by
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    exact kernelRowLift_ι
      (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation_range_eq_ker (k := k) f)
  | succ r =>
    exact kernelRowLift_ι
      (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.differential_range_eq_ker (k := k) f r)

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.terminalKernel_isZero
statement:
theorem terminalKernel_isZero {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) :
    IsZero (kernelAt (k := k) f m)
proof:
:= by
  let hrow := row_rankExact (k := k) f m
  haveI : Epi (kernelQuotientAt (k := k) f m) :=
    (NatTrans.epi_iff_epi_app (kernelQuotientAt (k := k) f m)).mpr fun p =>
      (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mpr (hrow.surjective p)
  exact IsZero.of_epi (kernelQuotientAt (k := k) f m)
    (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.term_isZero_of_degree_ge (k := k) f (Nat.le_refl m))

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.resolution_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem resolution_length {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) :
    (resolution (k := k) f).length = m
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.resolution_term
statement:
@[simp] theorem resolution_term {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (i : Fin m) :
    (resolution (k := k) f).term i = GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.term (k := k) f i.val
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.resolution_kernel
statement:
@[simp] theorem resolution_kernel {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    (resolution (k := k) f).kernel i = kernelAt (k := k) f i.val
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.resolution_inclusion
statement:
@[simp] theorem resolution_inclusion {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (i : Fin m) :
    (resolution (k := k) f).inclusion i = kernelInclusionAt (k := k) f i.val
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.resolution_quotient
statement:
@[simp] theorem resolution_quotient {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (i : Fin m) :
    (resolution (k := k) f).quotient i = kernelQuotientAt (k := k) f i.val
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.resolution_initial_iso_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem resolution_initial_iso_hom {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) :
    (resolution (k := k) f).initial_iso.hom = 𝟙 _
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.resolution_augmentation
statement:
@[simp] theorem resolution_augmentation {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (resolution (k := k) f).quotient ⟨0, hm⟩ =
      GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation (k := k) f
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.resolution_differential
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem resolution_differential {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P)
    (r : ℕ) (hr : r + 1 < m) :
    (resolution (k := k) f).quotient
        (Fin.cast (resolution_length (k := k) f).symm ⟨r + 1, hr⟩) ≫
        (resolution (k := k) f).inclusion
          (Fin.cast (resolution_length (k := k) f).symm ⟨r, by omega⟩) =
      GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.differential (k := k) f r
proof:
:= by
  simpa [resolution, kernelQuotientAt, kernelInclusionAt] using
    quotient_comp_preceding_inclusion (k := k) f r

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.complementResolution_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem complementResolution_length {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (complementResolution (k := k) f hm).length = m
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.complementResolution_term
statement:
@[simp] theorem complementResolution_term {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (hm : 0 < m)
    (i : Fin m) :
      (complementResolution (k := k) f hm).term
        ⟨i.val, by simpa only [complementResolution_length] using i.isLt⟩ =
          GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.term (k := k) f i.val
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.complementResolution_initial_iso_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem complementResolution_initial_iso_hom {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    (complementResolution f hm).initial_iso.hom =
      (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.targetIso (k := k) f hm).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp [complementResolution, FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.ofIso, resolution, kernelAt]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.complement_augmentation
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem complement_augmentation {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P)
    (hm : 0 < m) :
    (complementResolution (k := k) f hm).quotient
        ⟨0, by simpa only [complementResolution_length] using hm⟩ ≫
        (complementResolution (k := k) f hm).initial_iso.hom =
      GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation (k := k) f ≫
        (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.targetIso (k := k) f hm).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp [complementResolution, FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.ofIso, resolution, kernelAt]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.complement_augmentation_projection
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem complement_augmentation_projection {m : ℕ}
    (f : Fin m → P) (hm : 0 < m) :
    cokernel.π (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.inclusion (k := k) f 0) ≫
        (resolution (k := k) f).quotient ⟨0, hm⟩ ≫
          (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.targetIso (k := k) f hm).hom =
      GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.bottomFamily m) ≫
      GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.targetProjection (k := k) f hm
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (cokernel.π (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.inclusion (k := k) f 0) ≫
        GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation (k := k) f) ≫
          (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.targetIso (k := k) f hm).hom := by
      simp
    _ = (GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation
        (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.bottomFamily m) ≫
          cokernel.π (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.supportInclusion (k := k) f)) ≫
            (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.targetIso (k := k) f hm).hom := by
      rw [GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.projection_augmentation]
    _ = GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation
        (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.bottomFamily m) ≫
          GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.targetProjection (k := k) f hm := by
      rw [Category.assoc, GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.projection_targetIso]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.rank_eq_alternating_sum
statement:
theorem rank_eq_alternating_sum {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    (rankOfStructureMap (k := k) (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.target (k := k) f) hab : ℤ) =
      ∑ i : Fin m, (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val *
        (rankOfStructureMap (k := k)
          (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.term (k := k) f i.val) hab : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.rank_eq_alternating_sum (resolution (k := k) f) hab

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.complement_rank_eq_alternating_sum
statement:
theorem complement_rank_eq_alternating_sum {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (hm : 0 < m)
    {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b) :
      (rankOfStructureMap (k := k)
      (SupportInterval.module (k := k)
        (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.complementSupport f)
        (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.complementSupport_ordConnected f)) hab : ℤ) =
      ∑ i : Fin m, (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val *
        (rankOfStructureMap (k := k)
          (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.term (k := k) f i.val) hab : ℤ)
proof:
:=
  FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.rank_eq_alternating_sum
    (complementResolution (k := k) f hm) hab

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.singleton_count
statement:
private theorem singleton_count {n : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval n) (p : FiniteInterval n → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] : ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval n)).countP p = if p I then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.cons_zero, Multiset.countP_cons]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.single_barcode
statement:
private theorem single_barcode (I : FiniteInterval 3) :
    rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I) = {I}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {I}) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).mpr
      intro i j hij
      rw [rank_barcodeMap]
      change Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (intervalMap (k := ℚ) I hij)) = _
      rw [intervalMap_finrank_range]
      simp only [interval_alive_endpoints_iff I hij, singleton_count]
    _ = {I} := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.alive_of_target
statement:
private theorem alive_of_target (I J : FiniteInterval 3) (hb : I.birth = J.birth)
    (hd : J.death ≤ I.death) (i : Fin 3) (hi : J.alive i) : I.alive i
proof:
:=
  ⟨hb ▸ hi.1, hi.2.trans_le hd⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.zero_of_not_alive
statement:
private theorem zero_of_not_alive (I : FiniteInterval 3) (i : Fin 3)
    (hi : ¬ I.alive i) (x : I.fiber (k := ℚ) i) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h := x.property
  simpa [FiniteInterval.fiber, hi] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.truncate_surjective
statement:
private theorem truncate_surjective (I J : FiniteInterval 3) (hb : I.birth = J.birth)
    (hd : J.death ≤ I.death) (i : Fin 3) : Function.Surjective ((truncate I J hb hd).app i).hom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro y
  change ∃ x : I.fiber (k := ℚ) i, truncateLinear I J hb hd i x = y
  by_cases hi : J.alive i
  · have hI := alive_of_target I J hb hd i hi
    refine ⟨⟨y.val, by simp [FiniteInterval.fiber, hI]⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [truncateLinear, dif_pos hi]
    rfl
  · have hy : y = 0 := zero_of_not_alive J i hi y
    subst y
    exact ⟨0, map_zero _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.first_surjective
statement: private theorem first_surjective (i : Fin 3) : Function.Surjective (first.app i).hom
proof:
:=
  truncate_surjective long middle rfl (by decide) i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.second_surjective
statement: private theorem second_surjective (i : Fin 3) : Function.Surjective (second.app i).hom
proof:
:=
  truncate_surjective middle short rfl (by decide) i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.single_occurrence
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := Multiset.mem_toList.mp (List.get_mem (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)).toList a)
  change occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈ _ at hmem
  have hmem' : occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈
      ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3)) := Eq.mp
    (congrArg (fun B : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3) =>
      occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈ B) (single_barcode I)) hmem
  simpa using hmem'

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.unequal_death_embedding
statement:
theorem unequal_death_embedding :
    ∃ i : BarcodeOccurrence 3 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) middle)),
      (occurrence _ i).death = 2 ∧
      (occurrence _ (epiEmbedding first first_surjective i)).death = 3 ∧
      (occurrence _ (epiEmbedding first first_surjective i)).birth = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) middle)).toList.length = 1 := by
    rw [single_barcode]; simp
  let i : BarcodeOccurrence 3 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) middle)) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  exact ⟨i, congrArg FiniteInterval.death (single_occurrence middle i),
    congrArg FiniteInterval.death (single_occurrence long _),
    congrArg FiniteInterval.birth (single_occurrence long _)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.three_death_composition
statement:
theorem three_death_composition :
    epiEmbedding (first ≫ second) (fun i => (second_surjective i).comp (first_surjective i)) =
      (epiEmbedding second second_surjective).trans (epiEmbedding first first_surjective)
proof:
:=
  epiEmbedding_comp first second first_surjective second_surjective

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.positive_birth_quotient
statement:
theorem positive_birth_quotient :
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterShort)) 1 1 = 1 ∧
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterShort)) 1 1 =
      Module.finrank ℚ ((LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterShort)
        (show (1 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 from le_refl _))) ⧸
          birthPreviousImage (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterShort) 1 1
            (Nat.zero_lt_succ 0) (le_refl 1) (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_succ 1))) ∧
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterShort)) 1 1 ≤
      birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) laterLong)) 1 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, birthSuffixCount_eq_finrank _ _ _ (by decide) (by decide) (by decide),
    birthSuffixCount_le_of_surjective (truncate laterLong laterShort rfl (by decide))
      (truncate_surjective laterLong laterShort rfl (by decide)) _ _ (by decide) (by decide)⟩
  simp [single_barcode, birthSuffixCount, singleton_count, laterShort]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.replicate_count
statement:
private theorem replicate_count (n : ℕ) (p : FiniteInterval 1 → Prop) [DecidablePred p] :
    (Multiset.replicate n oneBar).countP p = if p oneBar then n else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.countP_cons, ih]
    split_ifs <;> omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.copies_barcode
statement: private theorem copies_barcode (n : ℕ) : rankBarcode (copies n) = Multiset.replicate n oneBar
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) (Multiset.replicate n oneBar)) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).mpr
      intro i j hij
      rw [rank_barcodeMap]
      change Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range
        (LinearMap.id : (Fin n → ℚ) →ₗ[ℚ] (Fin n → ℚ))) =
          (Multiset.replicate n oneBar).countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < I.death)
      rw [LinearMap.range_id, replicate_count]
      simp [oneBar]

    _ = _ := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.dropLast_surjective
statement: private theorem dropLast_surjective (i : Fin 1) : Function.Surjective (dropLast.app i).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  refine ⟨fun a => if h : a.val < 2 then y ⟨a.val, h⟩ else 0, ?_⟩
  funext a
  change (if h : a.val < 2 then y ⟨a.val, h⟩ else 0) = y a
  rw [dif_pos a.isLt]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.duplicate_occurrences_distinct
statement:
theorem duplicate_occurrences_distinct :
    ∃ i j : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode (copies 2)),
      i ≠ j ∧ epiEmbedding dropLast dropLast_surjective i ≠
        epiEmbedding dropLast dropLast_surjective j
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (rankBarcode (copies 2)).toList.length = 2 := by
    rw [copies_barcode]; simp
  let i : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode (copies 2)) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let j : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode (copies 2)) := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  have hne : i ≠ j := by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; simp [i, j] at this
  exact ⟨i, j, hne, fun h => hne ((epiEmbedding _ _).injective h)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.duplicate_terminal_count
statement:
theorem duplicate_terminal_count : birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (copies 2)) 0 0 = 2 ∧
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode (copies 2)) 0 0 = structureMapRank (copies 2) 0 0 (le_refl _) ∧
    ∀ i : BarcodeOccurrence 1 (rankBarcode (copies 2)),
      (occurrence _ (epiEmbedding dropLast dropLast_surjective i)).death = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, birthSuffixCount_zero _ _ (by decide), ?_⟩
  · rw [copies_barcode]
    unfold birthSuffixCount
    rw [replicate_count]
    norm_num [oneBar]
  · intro i
    apply epiEmbedding_terminal
    have := (occurrence (rankBarcode (copies 2)) i).birth_lt_death
    have := (occurrence (rankBarcode (copies 2)) i).death_le_size
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.empty_chain
statement:
theorem empty_chain : IsEmpty (BarcodeOccurrence 0 (rankBarcode empty)) ∧
    epiEmbedding (𝟙 empty) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) = Function.Embedding.refl _
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, epiEmbedding_id empty⟩
  change IsEmpty (Fin (rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 0)))).toList.length)
  rw [rankBarcode_barcodeModule]
  simp only [Multiset.toList_zero, List.length_nil]
  exact inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteEpiMatchingExamples.rank_domination_insufficient
statement:
theorem rank_domination_insufficient :
    (∀ (i j : Fin 3) (h : i ≤ j),
      structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {laterShort}) i j h ≤
        structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {long}) i j h) ∧
    ¬ ∃ e : BarcodeOccurrence 3 ({laterShort} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3)) ↪
        BarcodeOccurrence 3 ({long} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 3)),
      ∀ i, (occurrence {long} (e i)).birth = (occurrence {laterShort} i).birth
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j h
    rw [rank_barcodeMap, rank_barcodeMap]
    rw [singleton_count, singleton_count]
    have hi := i.isLt
    have hj := j.isLt
    simp [long, laterShort]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    have h := he ⟨0, by simp⟩
    simp [occurrence, long, laterShort] at h

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.essentialPart_dgm_empty
statement:
private theorem essentialPart_dgm_empty (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (a : V → X) [IsEmpty V] (n : ℕ) :
    essentialPart (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Multiset.eq_zero_of_forall_notMem
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨s, _⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues (Cech.filter a) b).mp
    (mem_criticalValues_of_mem_essentialPart_dgm k (Cech.filter a) hb)
  obtain ⟨v, _⟩ := (Rips.mem_fullComplex_iff s.val).mp s.property
  exact isEmptyElim v

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.essentialParts_dgm_eq
statement:
private theorem essentialParts_dgm_eq (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (a b : V → X) (n : ℕ) :
    essentialPart (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n).points =
      essentialPart (dgm k (Cech.filter b) n).points
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hV : Nonempty V
  · letI := hV
    cases n with
    | zero => rw [essentialPart_dgm_zero_eq_singleton k a,
        essentialPart_dgm_zero_eq_singleton k b]
    | succ n => rw [essentialPart_dgm_eq_zero k a (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n)),
        essentialPart_dgm_eq_zero k b (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le n))]
  · letI : IsEmpty V := ⟨fun v => hV ⟨v⟩⟩
    rw [essentialPart_dgm_empty k a n, essentialPart_dgm_empty k b n]

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.diagramPair_mem_commonEssentialBudget
statement:
private theorem diagramPair_mem_commonEssentialBudget (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (a b : V → X) (n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hδ : Cech.displacement a b ≤ R) :
    (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n, dgm k (Cech.filter b) n) ∈
      {z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ |
        essentialPart z.1.points = essentialPart z.2.points ∧
        Fintype.card z.1.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card z.2.finiteOccurrences ≤
          2 * Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) ∧
        bottleneck z.1 z.2 ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨essentialParts_dgm_eq k a b n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have ha := card_finiteOccurrences_dgm_fullComplex_le k (Cech.filter a) n
    have hb := card_finiteOccurrences_dgm_fullComplex_le k (Cech.filter b) n
    simpa only [two_mul] using Nat.add_le_add ha hb
  · exact (bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement k a b n).trans
      (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hδ)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.finitePMatchingCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_allDegrees
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_allDegrees
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (k : Type u) [Field k] (a b : V → X)
    (n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hδ : Cech.displacement a b ≤ R) :
proof:
|finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter b) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1) -
        (bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter b) n)).toReal| ≤
      ((((max 1 (2 * Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2)) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) - 1) * R := by
  have h := diagramPair_mem_commonEssentialBudget k a b n hδ
  exact finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_of_essentialParts_eq
    hp _ _ h.1 h.2.1 hR h.2.2

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_allDegrees
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_allDegrees
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (k : Type u) [Field k] (a b : V → X)
    (n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hδ : Cech.displacement a b ≤ R) :
    |finitePBoundaryTransportCost p
        (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter b) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1) -
        (bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter b) n)).toReal| ≤
      ((((max 1 (2 * Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2)) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) - 1) * R
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  exact finitePMatchingCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_allDegrees
    hp k a b n hR hδ

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.finitePMatchingCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_allDegrees
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_allDegrees
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun p : ℝ => fun z : (V → X) × (V → X) =>
        finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter z.1) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
          (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter z.2) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1))
      (fun z : (V → X) × (V → X) =>
        (bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter z.1) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter z.2) n)).toReal)
      atTop {z : (V → X) × (V → X) | Cech.displacement z.1 z.2 ≤ R}
proof:
:= by
  have h := (finitePMatchingCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_of_essentialParts_eq
    (2 * Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2)) R hR).comp
      (fun z : (V → X) × (V → X) => (dgm k (Cech.filter z.1) n, dgm k (Cech.filter z.2) n))
  exact h.mono fun z hz => diagramPair_mem_commonEssentialBudget k z.1 z.2 n hz

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_allDegrees
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_allDegrees
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun p : ℝ => fun z : (V → X) × (V → X) =>
        finitePBoundaryTransportCost p
          (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter z.1) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
          (fun q : (dgm k (Cech.filter z.2) n).finiteOccurrences => q.1))
      (fun z : (V → X) × (V → X) =>
        (bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter z.1) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter z.2) n)).toReal)
      atTop {z : (V → X) × (V → X) | Cech.displacement z.1 z.2 ≤ R}
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using
    finitePMatchingCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_allDegrees
      (V := V) (X := X) k n R hR

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.realModule_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem realModule_obj (A : MatrixSequence k (n + 1))
    (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (t : ℝ) :

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.realModule_structureMapLinear
statement:

      (A.compositeMatrix ((cellIndex c).monotone h)).toLin'

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.realModule_obj_critical
statement:

    (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin n) :

proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.isZero_initial
statement:
theorem isZero_initial (A : MatrixSequence k (n + 1)) (hA : A.dim 0 = 0) :
    IsZero (A.toPModule.obj 0)
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton (A.toPModule.obj 0) := by

    rw [hA]
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.realModule_isConstructible
statement:
theorem realModule_isConstructible (A : MatrixSequence k (n + 1))
    (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (hA : A.dim 0 = 0) : IsConstructible c (A.realModule c)
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.criticalIndex
statement:
private theorem criticalIndex (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) :
    (cellIndex c).comp c.toOrderHom = (Fin.succOrderEmb n).toOrderHom
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.ext
  intro i
  exact cellIndex_critical c i

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.realDiagram_eq_ofIndexBars
statement:
theorem realDiagram_eq_ofIndexBars (A : MatrixSequence k (n + 1)) (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) :
    A.realDiagram c = ofIndexBars c c.strictMono
      (rankBarcode (reindex (Fin.succOrderEmb n).toOrderHom A.toPModule))
proof:
:= by
  letI : ∀ i : Fin n, FiniteDimensional k
      ((reindex c.toOrderHom (A.realModule c)).obj i) := fun i =>
    show FiniteDimensional k ((A.realModule c).obj (c i)) from inferInstance
  letI : ∀ i : Fin n, FiniteDimensional k
      ((reindex (Fin.succOrderEmb n).toOrderHom A.toPModule).obj i) := fun i =>
    show FiniteDimensional k (A.toPModule.obj i.succ) from inferInstance
  unfold realDiagram moduleDiagram
  rw [rankBarcode_eq_of_iso (A.criticalSampleIso c)]

name: TDA.Persistence.MatrixSequence.realDiagram_refinement
statement:
theorem realDiagram_refinement (A : MatrixSequence k (n + 1))
    (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (d : Fin m ↪o ℝ) (hA : A.dim 0 = 0) (h : Refines c d) :
    moduleDiagram d (A.realModule c) (fun _ => inferInstance) = A.realDiagram c
proof:
:=
  moduleDiagram_refinement (A.realModule c) h (A.realModule_isConstructible c hA)
    (fun _ => inferInstance)

name: TDA.Persistence.IntervalCompatibility.support_ordConnected

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.InfiniteMetricStabilityExamples.reciprocalSampleMap_injective
statement:
private theorem reciprocalSampleMap_injective (N : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (reciprocalSampleMap N)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  cases i with
  | none =>
      cases j with
      | none => rfl
      | some j =>
          have hj : 0 < (1 : ℝ) / (j.val + 1) := by positivity
          simp [reciprocalSampleMap] at hij
          linarith
  | some i =>
      cases j with
      | none =>
          have hi : 0 < (1 : ℝ) / (i.val + 1) := by positivity
          simp [reciprocalSampleMap] at hij
          linarith
      | some j =>
          have hrecip : (1 : ℝ) / (i.val + 1) = 1 / (j.val + 1) := by
            simpa [reciprocalSampleMap] using hij
          have hden : (i.val : ℝ) + 1 = (j.val : ℝ) + 1 := by
            field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero i.val),
              Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero j.val)] at hrecip
            linarith
          have hval : (i.val : ℝ) = (j.val : ℝ) := by linarith
          exact congrArg some (Fin.ext (by exact_mod_cast hval))

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.InfiniteMetricStabilityExamples.reciprocalTargetSet_isCompact
statement: private theorem reciprocalTargetSet_isCompact : IsCompact reciprocalTargetSet
proof:
:= by
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (n + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  simpa [reciprocalTargetSet] using hlim.isCompact_insert_range

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.InfiniteMetricStabilityExamples.reciprocalTarget_infinite
statement: theorem reciprocalTarget_infinite : Infinite ReciprocalTarget
proof:
:= by
  apply Infinite.of_injective (fun n : ℕ =>
    (⟨(1 : ℝ) / (n + 1), Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_range_self n)⟩ :
      ReciprocalTarget))
  intro m n h
  have h' := congrArg (fun x : ReciprocalTarget => (x : ℝ)) h
  have hden : (m : ℝ) + 1 = (n : ℝ) + 1 := by
    change (1 : ℝ) / (m + 1) = 1 / (n + 1) at h'
    field_simp [Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero m),
      Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.succ_ne_zero n)] at h'
    linarith
  have hmn : (m : ℝ) = n := by linarith
  exact_mod_cast hmn

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.InfiniteMetricStabilityExamples.reciprocalTarget_compactSpace
statement: private theorem reciprocalTarget_compactSpace : CompactSpace ReciprocalTarget
proof:
:=
  isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp reciprocalTargetSet_isCompact

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.InfiniteMetricStabilityExamples.reciprocalTarget_totallyBounded
statement:
private theorem reciprocalTarget_totallyBounded :
    TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set ReciprocalTarget)
proof:
:= by
  letI : CompactSpace ReciprocalTarget := reciprocalTarget_compactSpace
  exact isCompact_univ.totallyBounded

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.InfiniteMetricStabilityExamples.tendsto_reciprocalSample_qTameDiagram_bottleneck
statement:
theorem tendsto_reciprocalSample_qTameDiagram_bottleneck
    (k : Type*) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun N : ℕ =>
        (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := Option (Fin (N + 1))) k
          (Set.finite_univ.totallyBounded :
            TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set (Option (Fin (N + 1))))) n).bottleneck
          (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := ReciprocalTarget) k
            reciprocalTarget_totallyBounded n))
      atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  letI : CompactSpace ReciprocalTarget := reciprocalTarget_compactSpace
  let g : ReciprocalTarget → ℝ := Subtype.val
  have hg : Isometry g := isometry_subtype_coe
  have hY : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set ReciprocalTarget) :=
    isCompact_univ.totallyBounded
  let f : ∀ N, Option (Fin (N + 1)) → ℝ := reciprocalSampleMap
  have hf : ∀ N, Isometry (f N) := by
    intro N
    exact MetricSpace.isometry_induced _ (reciprocalSampleMap_injective N)
  have hhaus : ∀ N,
      hausdorffDist (Set.range (f N)) (Set.range g) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / (N + 1) := by
    intro N
    apply hausdorffDist_le_of_mem_dist (by positivity)
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
      cases i with
      | none =>
          refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact ⟨⟨0, Set.mem_insert _ _⟩, rfl⟩
          · simp only [f, reciprocalSampleMap, dist_self]
            positivity
      | some i =>
          refine ⟨f N (some i), ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact ⟨⟨f N (some i), Set.mem_insert_of_mem _
              (Set.mem_range_self i.val)⟩, rfl⟩
          · simp only [dist_self]
            positivity
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
      have hy : (y : ℝ) = 0 ∨ ∃ m : ℕ, (1 : ℝ) / (m + 1) = (y : ℝ) := by
        simpa [reciprocalTargetSet, Set.mem_insert_iff] using y.property
      rcases hy with hy | ⟨m, hy⟩
      · refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
        · exact ⟨none, rfl⟩
        · simpa [g, hy] using
            (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 : ℝ) / (N + 1) by positivity)
      · by_cases hm : m ≤ N
        · let i : Fin (N + 1) := ⟨m, by omega⟩
          refine ⟨f N (some i), ⟨some i, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
          simp [g, f, reciprocalSampleMap, i, hy]
          positivity
        · let i : Fin (N + 1) := Fin.last N
          have hrecip : (1 : ℝ) / (m + 1) ≤ 1 / (N + 1) := by
            have hm_lt : N < m := Nat.lt_of_not_ge hm
            have hmNat : N + 1 ≤ m + 1 := by omega
            have hm' : (N : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (m : ℝ) + 1 := by
              exact_mod_cast hmNat
            exact one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) hm'
          refine ⟨f N (some i), ⟨some i, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
          simp only [g, f, reciprocalSampleMap]
          rw [← hy]
          have hlast : (i.val : ℝ) = N := by simp [i]
          rw [hlast, Real.dist_eq, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hrecip)]
          have hN : 0 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / (N + 1) := by positivity
          have hm_nonneg : 0 ≤ (1 : ℝ) / (m + 1) := by positivity
          linarith
  have hhausTendsto :
      Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => hausdorffDist (Set.range (f N)) (Set.range g))
        atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have hr : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (1 : ℝ) / (N + 1)) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
    exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hr
      (fun _ => hausdorffDist_nonneg) hhaus
  exact tendsto_qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_of_hausdorffDist_tendsto_zero
    (k := k) (X := fun N => Option (Fin (N + 1))) ReciprocalTarget
    (f := f) (g := g) hf hg hY hhausTendsto n

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_empty_empty
statement:
theorem bottleneck_empty_empty :
    bottleneck (orderedQ 0 0 emptyRealInput) (orderedQ 0 0 emptyRealInput) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := bottleneck_orderedQ_le_norm 0 0 emptyRealInput emptyRealInput
  have hz : bottleneck (orderedQ 0 0 emptyRealInput)
      (orderedQ 0 0 emptyRealInput) ≤ 0 := by simpa using h
  exact le_antisymm hz bot_le

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_reversed_singleton_empty
statement:
theorem bottleneck_reversed_singleton_empty :
    bottleneck (orderedQ 1 0 reversedInput) (orderedQ 0 0 emptyRealInput) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx := orderedQ_finite_occurrences 1 0 reversedInput
  have hy : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) =
        finitePart (orderedQ 0 0 emptyRealInput).points := by
    simp [finitePart_orderedQ]
  have hb : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) =
        essentialPart (orderedQ 1 0 reversedInput).points := by
    simp [essentialPart_orderedQ]
  have hc : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) =
        essentialPart (orderedQ 0 0 emptyRealInput).points := by
    simp [essentialPart_orderedQ]
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation (orderedQ 1 0 reversedInput)
    (orderedQ 0 0 emptyRealInput)
    (fun i : NonDiagonalIndices 1 reversedInput.1 => reversedInput.1 i.1)
    (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
    (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) hx hy hb hc]
  haveI : Nonempty (NonDiagonalIndices 1 reversedInput.1) :=
    ⟨⟨0, by norm_num [reversedInput]⟩⟩
  change presentationBottleneck
    (fun _ : NonDiagonalIndices 1 reversedInput.1 => ((3 : ℝ), (1 : ℝ)))
    Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 = 1
  rw [presentationBottleneck_constant_empty]
  norm_num [diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_one_sided_diagonal
statement:
theorem bottleneck_one_sided_diagonal :
    bottleneck (orderedQ 1 0 reversedInput) (orderedQ 1 0 diagonalInput) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hd : orderedQ 1 0 diagonalInput = orderedQ 0 0 emptyRealInput := by
    apply (orderedQ_eq_iff 1 0 0 0 diagonalInput emptyRealInput).mpr
    constructor <;> simp [diagonalInput, emptyRealInput]
  rw [hd]
  exact bottleneck_reversed_singleton_empty

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_essential_singletons
statement:
theorem bottleneck_essential_singletons :
    bottleneck (orderedQ 0 1 (essentialInput 1))
      (orderedQ 0 1 (essentialInput 4)) = 3
proof:
:= by
  have hf₁ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) =
        finitePart (orderedQ 0 1 (essentialInput 1)).points := by
    simp [finitePart_orderedQ]
  have hf₂ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) =
        finitePart (orderedQ 0 1 (essentialInput 4)).points := by
    simp [finitePart_orderedQ]
  have he₁ := orderedQ_essential_occurrences 0 1 (essentialInput 1)
  have he₂ := orderedQ_essential_occurrences 0 1 (essentialInput 4)
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation _ _
    (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
    (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℝ)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => (4 : ℝ))
    hf₁ hf₂ (by simpa [essentialInput] using he₁)
      (by simpa [essentialInput] using he₂)]
  rw [presentationBottleneck_essential_singletons]
  norm_num [essentialPairCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_unequal_essential_counts
statement:
theorem bottleneck_unequal_essential_counts :
    bottleneck (orderedQ 0 0 emptyRealInput)
      (orderedQ 0 1 (essentialInput 1)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply (bottleneck_eq_top_iff _ _).mpr
  simp [essentialPart_orderedQ, emptyRealInput, essentialInput]

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_repeated_pair_detected
statement:
theorem bottleneck_repeated_pair_detected :
    bottleneck (orderedQ 2 0 duplicatedInput) (orderedQ 1 0 singleInput) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hf₁ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)).val.map (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ))) =
      finitePart (orderedQ 2 0 duplicatedInput).points := by
    rw [finitePart_orderedQ]
    simp [duplicatedInput, List.ofFn_eq_map, ← Finset.val_univ_fin]
    rfl
  have hf₂ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ))) =
      finitePart (orderedQ 1 0 singleInput).points := by
    rw [finitePart_orderedQ]
    simp [singleInput, List.ofFn_eq_map, ← Finset.val_univ_fin]
  have he₁ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = essentialPart (orderedQ 2 0 duplicatedInput).points := by
    simp [essentialPart_orderedQ]
  have he₂ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = essentialPart (orderedQ 1 0 singleInput).points := by
    simp [essentialPart_orderedQ]
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation _ _
    (fun _ : Fin 2 => ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)))
    (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)))
    (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ)
    hf₁ hf₂ he₁ he₂]
  rw [presentationBottleneck_two_equal_vs_one]
  norm_num [diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.leftRank
statement:
private theorem leftRank :
    structureMapRank (twoStage (leftProjection (k := k))) 0 1 (by decide) = 1
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (leftProjection (k := k))) = 1
  have h : leftProjection (k := k) =
      (LinearMap.inl k k k).comp (LinearMap.fst k k k) := by
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    rfl
  have hf : LinearMap.range (LinearMap.fst k k k) = ⊤ :=
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (LinearMap.fst_surjective)
  rw [h, LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top _ hf]
  rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (LinearMap.inl_injective)]
  exact Module.finrank_self k

    rfl
  have hf : LinearMap.range (LinearMap.fst k k k) = ⊤ :=
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (LinearMap.fst_surjective)
  rw [h, LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top _ hf]
  rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (LinearMap.inr_injective)]
  exact Module.finrank_self k

name: TDA.Persistence.onePairTwoBars
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.mem_family
statement:
private theorem mem_family (b : Bool) (i : Fin 3) {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 2 < a) (ha' : a < 9) : (fun _ => a) ∈ (family b i).support
proof:
:= by
  intro j
  cases b <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [family, source, target, openInterval, BoundedInterval.support] <;>
    constructor <;> linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.significant_family
statement:
private theorem significant_family (b : Bool) (i : Fin 3) {δ : ℝ≥0}
    (hδ : δ ≤ 6) : Significant δ (family b i)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun _ => (5 / 2 : ℝ), mem_family b i (by norm_num) (by norm_num), ?_⟩
  change (fun _ => 5 / 2 + (δ : ℝ)) ∈ (family b i).support
  apply mem_family
  · have := δ.coe_nonneg; linarith
  · have : (δ : ℝ) ≤ 6 := hδ; linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.coefficient_injective
statement:
private theorem coefficient_injective (R S : Rectangle 2) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    Function.Injective (coefficientHom (k := k) R S ε)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  by_contra hne
  apply (shiftedCoefficient_ne_zero_iff R S ε (f - g)).mpr hne
  change coefficientHom R S ε (f - g) = 0
  rw [map_sub, h, sub_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.coefficient_entry
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : admissible b i j
  · change coefficientHom _ _ 1 (entry b i j) = _
    rw [entry, dif_pos h, map_zsmul]
    have hc : coefficientHom (k := k) _ _ 1 (comparison _ _ 1 h) = 1 :=
      shiftedCoefficient_comparison _ _ 1 h
        (mem_family b i (a := 3) (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
        (by
          have he : translation 1 (fun _ : Fin 2 => (3 : ℝ)) = (fun _ => 4) := by
            funext c; norm_num [translation_apply]
          rw [he]
          exact mem_family (!b) j (a := 4) (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
    rw [hc]; simp
  · have hz : matrix b i j = 0 := by
      by_contra hn; exact h (admissible_of_matrix_ne_zero b i j hn)
    simp [entry, h, shiftedCoefficient_zero, hz]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.matrix_inverse
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases l <;>
    norm_num [matrix, Fin.sum_univ_succ]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.matrix_law
statement:
private theorem matrix_law (A B : Fin 3 → Rectangle 2)
    (f : ∀ i j, (A i).module (k := k) ⟶ (shift 1).obj (B j).module)
    (g : ∀ j l, (B j).module (k := k) ⟶ (shift 1).obj (A l).module)
    (hα : ∀ i l, alphaLE (A i) (A l))
    (hs : ∀ i, Significant 6 (A i))
    (hinv : ∀ i l, (∑ j, shiftedCoefficient (A i) (B j) 1 (f i j) *
      shiftedCoefficient (B j) (A l) 1 (g j l)) = if i = l then 1 else 0) :
    mapOfComponents A B 1 f ≫ (shift 1).map (mapOfComponents B A 1 g) ≫
      (compIso 1 1 (module A)).hom = transition (1 + 1) (module A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply component_ext A A (1 + 1)
  intro i l
  apply coefficient_injective
  rw [← component_composite_shift]
  simp only [component_mapOfComponents, Preadditive.sum_comp]
  change coefficientHom _ _ (1 + 1) (∑ j : Fin 3, _) = _
  rw [map_sum]
  have hpath (j : Fin 3) :
      coefficientHom (k := k) _ _ (1 + 1)
        (f i j ≫ (shift 1).map (g j l) ≫
          (compIso 1 1 ((A l).module)).hom) =
        shiftedCoefficient (A i) (B j) 1 (f i j) *
          shiftedCoefficient (B j) (A l) 1 (g j l) := by
    change shiftedCoefficient _ _ _ _ = _
    exact shiftedCoefficient_composite (by norm_num) _ _ _ 1 (hα i l)
      (by change Significant _ (A i); convert hs i using 1; norm_num [stabilityRadius])
      (by change Significant _ (A l); convert hs l using 1; norm_num [stabilityRadius]) _ _
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : Fin 3, shiftedCoefficient (A i) (B j) 1 (f i j) *
        shiftedCoefficient (B j) (A l) 1 (g j l) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact hpath j
    _ = if i = l then 1 else 0 := hinv i l
    _ = _ := ?_
  by_cases h : i = l
  · subst l
    rw [if_pos rfl, component_transition_self]
    exact (shiftedCoefficient_transition _ _
      ((hs i).of_le (by norm_num))).symm
  · rw [if_neg h, component_transition_ne _ _ h]
    exact (shiftedCoefficient_zero _ _ _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.forward_component_coefficient
statement:
theorem forward_component_coefficient (i j : Fin 3) :
    shiftedCoefficient (source i) (target j) 1
      (component source target 1 (interleaving (k := k)).φ i j) =
      (![![1, 1, 1], ![1, 1, 0], ![1, 0, 1]] : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → k) i j
proof:
:= by
  change shiftedCoefficient _ _ 1 (component _ _ 1 (mapOfComponents _ _ 1 _) i j) = _
  have h := coefficient_entry (k := k) false i j
  calc
    _ = shiftedCoefficient (source i) (target j) 1 (entry false i j) :=
      congrArg (shiftedCoefficient (k := k) (source i) (target j) 1)
        (component_mapOfComponents source target 1 (entry false) i j)
    _ = (matrix false i j : k) := h
    _ = _ := by fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [matrix]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.reverse_component_coefficient
statement:
theorem reverse_component_coefficient (i j : Fin 3) :
    shiftedCoefficient (target i) (source j) 1
      (component target source 1 (interleaving (k := k)).ψ i j) =
      (![![-1, 1, 1], ![1, 0, -1], ![1, -1, 0]] : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → k) i j
proof:
:= by
  change shiftedCoefficient _ _ 1 (component _ _ 1 (mapOfComponents _ _ 1 _) i j) = _
  have h := coefficient_entry (k := k) true i j
  calc
    _ = shiftedCoefficient (target i) (source j) 1 (entry true i j) :=
      congrArg (shiftedCoefficient (k := k) (target i) (source j) 1)
        (component_mapOfComponents target source 1 (entry true) i j)
    _ = (matrix true i j : k) := h
    _ = _ := by fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num [matrix]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.isMatching_three
statement:
theorem isMatching_three : IsMatching (k := k) 3 source target matching where
  paired
proof:
:= by
    intro i j h
    have he : i = j := Option.some.inj h
    subst j
    exact ⟨interleavingOfEndpointClose _ _ 3 (endpointClose_three i i)⟩
  source_zero := by intro i h; cases h
  target_zero := by intro j h; exact False.elim (h j rfl)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.forced_partner
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Significant (ρ + ρ) (source i) :=
    significant_family false i (by have : (ρ : ℝ) < 3 := hρ; exact_mod_cast (by linarith :
      (ρ : ℝ) + (ρ : ℝ) ≤ 6))
  have ht := (significant_iff_transition_ne_zero (k := k) _ _).mp hs
  have hf : I.φ ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply ht; rw [← I.φ_ψ, h]; simp
  have hg : I.ψ ≠ 0 := by intro h; apply ht; rw [← I.φ_ψ, h]; simp
  have h₁ := decoratedLE_value (shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds _ _ _ I.ψ hg (0, true))
  have h₂ := decoratedLE_value (shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds _ _ _ I.φ hf (1, false))
  have h₃ := decoratedLE_value (shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds _ _ _ I.φ hf (1, true))
  have h₄ := decoratedLE_value (shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds _ _ _ I.ψ hg (0, false))
  have hr : (ρ : ℝ) < 3 := hρ
  by_contra hj
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> norm_num at hi <;> norm_num at hj
  all_goals norm_num [endpoint, source, target, openInterval] at h₁ h₂ h₃ h₄
  all_goals linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.matching_radius_ge_three
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hρ : ρ < 3 := lt_of_not_ge h
  have hs (i : Fin 3) : Significant (ρ + ρ) (source i) :=
    significant_family false i (by have : (ρ : ℝ) < 3 := hρ; exact_mod_cast (by linarith :
      (ρ : ℝ) + (ρ : ℝ) ≤ 6))
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hM.source_covered 1 (hs 1)
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hM.source_covered 2 (hs 2)
  obtain ⟨Ij⟩ := hM.paired 1 j hj
  obtain ⟨Il⟩ := hM.paired 2 l hl
  have hj0 := forced_partner hρ (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 0) Ij
  have hl0 := forced_partner hρ (by decide : (2 : Fin 3) ≠ 0) Il
  subst j; subst l
  have he := M.finite_injective 1 2 0 hj hl
  exact (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2) he

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.bottleneckDistance_eq_three
statement: theorem bottleneckDistance_eq_three : bottleneckDistance (k := k) source target = 3
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact bottleneckDistance_le_of_matching isMatching_three
  · apply (le_bottleneckDistance_iff source target 3).mpr
    intro ρ M hM
    exact_mod_cast matching_radius_ge_three hM

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.interleaving_radius_ge_one
statement:
theorem interleaving_radius_ge_one {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (module (k := k) source) (module target)) : 1 ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_matching (by decide : 0 < 2) source target ε I
  have h := matching_radius_ge_three hM
  have h' : (3 : ℝ) ≤ 3 * (ε : ℝ) := by
    simpa [stabilityRadius] using (show (3 : ℝ) ≤ (stabilityRadius 2 ε : ℝ) from h)
  exact_mod_cast (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (ε : ℝ))

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.interleavingDistance_eq_one
statement:
theorem interleavingDistance_eq_one :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance (module (k := k) source) (module target) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact interleaving.distance_le
  · apply le_coordinateInterleavingDistance_iff.mpr
    rintro ε ⟨I⟩
    exact_mod_cast interleaving_radius_ge_one I

  rw [bottleneckDistance_eq_three, interleavingDistance_eq_one, mul_one]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleSharpExample.fails_smaller_constant
statement:

      c * coordinateInterleavingDistance (module (k := k) source) (module target)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneckDistance_eq_three, interleavingDistance_eq_one, mul_one]
  exact not_le_of_gt hc

name: TDA.Persistence.SublevelConstructibleExamples.finrank_sublevelHomology
statement:
private theorem finrank_sublevelHomology {V : Type} [LinearOrder V]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} [Fintype (TotalFace K)] (f : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialHomology (f.sublevel t) (ZMod 2) n) =
      (dgm (ZMod 2) f n).points.countP (fun p => p.1 ≤ t ∧ (t : WithTop ℝ) < p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rank_sublevelHomologyMap (ZMod 2) f n t t le_rfl]
  have h : simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2) (f.sublevel_mono (le_refl t)) n = 𝟙 _ :=
    simplicialHomologyIncl_id (ZMod 2) (f.sublevel t) n
  rw [h, ModuleCat.hom_id, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]

name: TDA.Persistence.SublevelConstructibleExamples.sublevelHomology_finiteDimensional
statement:
private theorem sublevelHomology_finiteDimensional {V : Type} [LinearOrder V]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} [Fintype (TotalFace K)] (f : FilterFunction K ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    FiniteDimensional (ZMod 2) (simplicialHomology (f.sublevel t) (ZMod 2) n)
proof:
:= by
  let _ : Finite (Face K n) := faceFiniteOfTotalFinite K n
  let _ : Finite (Face (f.sublevel t) n) :=
    Finite.of_injective (faceIncl (f.sublevel_le t) n) (by
      intro a b hab
      exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun s : Face K n => s.1) hab))
  infer_instance

  change IsZero (simplicialHomology (tiedReal.sublevel t) (ZMod 2) 1)
  have := sublevelHomology_finiteDimensional tiedReal 1 t
  have hfin :
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialHomology (tiedReal.sublevel t) (ZMod 2) 1) = 0 := by
    rw [finrank_sublevelHomology, tiedReal_dgm_one, Multiset.countP_zero]

  change IsZero (simplicialHomology (emptyReal.sublevel t) (ZMod 2) n)
