name: TDA.Persistence.SublevelConstructibleExamples.not_isConstructible_gridAbove
statement:
theorem not_isConstructible_gridAbove (a : ℝ) :
    ¬ IsConstructible (gridAbove a) (sublevelModule (ZMod 2) (vertexFilter a) 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hz := h.zero_left a (fun _ => by change a < a + 1; linarith)
  change IsZero (simplicialHomology ((vertexFilter a).sublevel a) (ZMod 2) 0) at hz
  rw [(vertexFilter a).sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le a (fun _ => le_rfl)] at hz
  have := ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.1 hz
  have : Subsingleton (ZMod 2) :=
    (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv (ZMod 2) (0 : Fin 2)).toEquiv.symm.subsingleton
  exact zero_ne_one (Subsingleton.elim (0 : ZMod 2) 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.SublevelConstructibleExamples.not_isConstructible_gridZero
statement:
theorem not_isConstructible_gridZero :
    ¬ IsConstructible gridZero (sublevelModule (ZMod 2) filledReal 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hcell : cellIndex gridZero 0 = cellIndex gridZero 1 := by
    have h0 := (lt_cellIndex_iff gridZero 0 0).2 (by change (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0; exact le_rfl)
    have h1 := (lt_cellIndex_iff gridZero 0 1).2 (by change (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1; norm_num)
    have h0' := (cellIndex gridZero 0).isLt
    have h1' := (cellIndex gridZero 1).isLt
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [Fin.val_zero] at h0 h1
    omega
  have := h.isIso_map 0 1 zero_le_one hcell
  have hdim := (asIso (structureMap (sublevelModule (ZMod 2) filledReal 0)
    (zero_le_one : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1))).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq
  change Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialHomology (filledReal.sublevel 0) (ZMod 2) 0) =
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (simplicialHomology (filledReal.sublevel 1) (ZMod 2) 0) at hdim
  rw [finrank_sublevelHomology, finrank_sublevelHomology, filledReal_dgm_zero] at hdim
  simp only [Multiset.insert_eq_cons, ← Multiset.cons_zero, Multiset.countP_cons,
    Multiset.countP_zero] at hdim
  norm_num at hdim

name: TDA.Persistence.oneDimensionalHookEndpoints_positive
statement:
theorem oneDimensionalHookEndpoints_positive
    (t : RealHookTag (n := 1)) :
    (oneDimensionalHookEndpoints t).1 < (oneDimensionalHookEndpoints t).2
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | inl ab =>
      have hle : ab.val.1 0 ≤ ab.val.2 0 := ab.property.1 0
      have hne : ab.val.1 0 ≠ ab.val.2 0 := by
        intro heq
        apply ab.property.2
        intro i
        fin_cases i
        exact heq.symm.le
      exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne)
  | inr a => exact WithTop.coe_lt_top _

name: TDA.Persistence.oneDimensional_strictAt
statement:
private theorem oneDimensional_strictAt {a b : Fin 1 → ℝ} (hab : a < b) :
    a 0 < b 0
proof:
:= by
  have hle : a 0 ≤ b 0 := hab.1 0
  have hne : a 0 ≠ b 0 := by
    intro heq
    apply hab.2
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    exact heq.symm.le
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteHook_support_eq_alive
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [Hook.support, RealBarcode.alive, Pi.le_def,
    Fin.forall_fin_one, not_le]

name: TDA.Persistence.principalHook_alive_iff
statement:
private theorem principalHook_alive_iff (a x : Fin 1 → ℝ) :
    a ≤ x ↔ RealBarcode.alive (a 0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) (x 0)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h 0, WithTop.coe_lt_top _⟩
  · intro h i
    fin_cases i
    exact h.1

name: TDA.Persistence.principalHookFiberEquiv_val
statement:
private theorem principalHookFiberEquiv_val (a x : Fin 1 → ℝ)
    (hax : a ≤ x) (v : (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a).obj x) :
    (principalHookFiberEquiv (k := k) a x v).val =
      HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hax v
proof:
:= by
  have htop : RealBarcode.fiber (k := k)
      (a 0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) (x 0) = ⊤ := by
    change (if RealBarcode.alive (a 0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) (x 0) then
      (⊤ : Submodule k k) else (⊥ : Submodule k k)) = (⊤ : Submodule k k)
    rw [if_pos ((principalHook_alive_iff a x).mp hax)]
  simp [principalHookFiberEquiv, hax, htop, Submodule.topEquiv,
    LinearEquiv.ofEq_symm, LinearEquiv.coe_ofEq_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.oneDimensionalHookDiagram_isPositive
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  change p ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).val.map
    (fun i => oneDimensionalHookEndpoints (T i)) at hp
  obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hp
  exact oneDimensionalHookEndpoints_positive (T i)

name: TDA.Persistence.hookTagMultiset_eq_univ_map
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [hookTagMultiset]
  | succ m ih =>
      rw [hookTagMultiset]
      rw [ih (fun i : Fin m => T i.succ)]
      simp

name: TDA.Persistence.oneDimensionalHookDiagram_points
statement:
theorem oneDimensionalHookDiagram_points {m : ℕ}
    (T : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := 1)) :
    (oneDimensionalHookDiagram T).points =
      Multiset.map oneDimensionalHookEndpoints (hookTagMultiset T)
proof:
:= by
  change (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).val.map
      (fun i => oneDimensionalHookEndpoints (T i)) = _
  rw [hookTagMultiset_eq_univ_map]
  rw [Multiset.map_map]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.oneDimensionalHookEndpoints_endpointTag
statement:
theorem oneDimensionalHookEndpoints_endpointTag
    (p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ) (hp : (p.1 : WithTop ℝ) < p.2) :
    oneDimensionalHookEndpoints (oneDimensionalEndpointTag p hp) = p
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨b, d⟩
  cases d with
  | top => rfl
  | coe d =>
      simp [oneDimensionalEndpointTag, oneDimensionalHookEndpoints]

name: TDA.Persistence.oneDimensionalEndpointTag_endpoints
statement:
theorem oneDimensionalEndpointTag_endpoints
    (t : RealHookTag (n := 1)) :
    oneDimensionalEndpointTag (oneDimensionalHookEndpoints t)
      (oneDimensionalHookEndpoints_positive t) = t
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | inl ab =>
      rcases ab with ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab⟩
      simp only [oneDimensionalHookEndpoints, oneDimensionalEndpointTag]
      apply congrArg Sum.inl
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply Prod.ext
      · funext i
        fin_cases i
        rfl
      · funext i
        fin_cases i
        rfl
  | inr a =>
      simp only [oneDimensionalHookEndpoints, oneDimensionalEndpointTag]
      apply congrArg Sum.inr
      funext i
      fin_cases i
      rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.oneDimensionalEndpointTagOnPositive_endpoints
statement:
theorem oneDimensionalEndpointTagOnPositive_endpoints
    (t : RealHookTag (n := 1)) :
    oneDimensionalEndpointTagOnPositive
      ⟨oneDimensionalHookEndpoints t, oneDimensionalHookEndpoints_positive t⟩ = t
proof:
:=
  oneDimensionalEndpointTag_endpoints t

name: TDA.Persistence.oneDimensionalHookEndpoints_injective
statement:
theorem oneDimensionalHookEndpoints_injective :
    ∀ {a b : RealHookTag (n := 1)},
      oneDimensionalHookEndpoints a = oneDimensionalHookEndpoints b → a = b
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  let pa : {p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ // (p.1 : WithTop ℝ) < p.2} :=
    ⟨oneDimensionalHookEndpoints a, oneDimensionalHookEndpoints_positive a⟩
  let pb : {p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ // (p.1 : WithTop ℝ) < p.2} :=
    ⟨oneDimensionalHookEndpoints b, oneDimensionalHookEndpoints_positive b⟩
  have hp : pa = pb := Subtype.ext h
  have ht := congrArg oneDimensionalEndpointTagOnPositive hp
  calc
    a = oneDimensionalEndpointTagOnPositive pa :=
      (oneDimensionalEndpointTagOnPositive_endpoints a).symm
    _ = oneDimensionalEndpointTagOnPositive pb := ht
    _ = b := oneDimensionalEndpointTagOnPositive_endpoints b

name: TDA.Persistence.positiveDiagram_hookPresentation_diagram
statement:
theorem positiveDiagram_hookPresentation_diagram (D : Diagram ℝ)
    (hD : D.IsPositive) :
    oneDimensionalHookDiagram
        (positiveDiagram_hookPresentation (k := k) D hD).tag = D
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  let xs := D.points.toList
  let T : Fin xs.length → RealHookTag (n := 1) := fun i =>
    oneDimensionalEndpointTag (xs.get i) (hD (xs.get i) (by
      exact Multiset.mem_toList.mp (List.get_mem xs i)))
  have hEndpoints (i : Fin xs.length) :
      oneDimensionalHookEndpoints (T i) = xs.get i :=
    oneDimensionalHookEndpoints_endpointTag _ _
  unfold positiveDiagram_hookPresentation
  rw [oneDimensionalHookDiagram_points]
  change Multiset.map oneDimensionalHookEndpoints
      (hookTagMultiset T) = D.points
  rw [hookTagMultiset_eq_univ_map]
  calc
    Multiset.map oneDimensionalHookEndpoints
        ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin xs.length)).val.map T) =
        (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin xs.length)).val.map
          (fun i => oneDimensionalHookEndpoints (T i)) := by
      rw [Multiset.map_map]
      rfl
    _ = (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin xs.length)).val.map (fun i => xs.get i) := by
      exact Multiset.map_congr rfl (fun i hi => hEndpoints i)
    _ = D.points := by
      rw [Fin.univ_val_map, List.ofFn_get]
      exact Multiset.coe_toList D.points

name: TDA.Persistence.oneDimensional_coordinate_le_iff
statement:
private theorem oneDimensional_coordinate_le_iff
    (a : Fin 1 → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    a ≤ CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t ↔ a 0 ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h 0
  · intro h i
    fin_cases i
    exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.oneDimensional_grade_threshold_of_cell
statement:
private theorem oneDimensional_grade_threshold_of_cell
    {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) {critical : Set ℝ}
    (hcover : ∀ q, q ∈ critical → ∃ i, c i = q)
    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hsame : FiniteConstructible.cellIndex c s = FiniteConstructible.cellIndex c t)
    (q : ℝ) (hq : q ∈ critical) : q ≤ s ↔ q ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover q hq
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.trans hst
  · intro ht
    by_contra hs
    have hslt : s < c i := by simpa [hi] using lt_of_not_ge hs
    have hti : c i ≤ t := by simpa [hi] using ht
    have hcountT :=
      (FiniteConstructible.lt_cellIndex_iff c i t).mpr hti
    have hnotS : ¬ i.val < (FiniteConstructible.cellIndex c s).val := by
      intro h
      exact (not_le_of_gt hslt) ((FiniteConstructible.lt_cellIndex_iff c i s).mp h)
    have hcountS : (FiniteConstructible.cellIndex c s).val ≤ i.val :=
      Nat.le_of_not_gt hnotS
    have hval : (FiniteConstructible.cellIndex c s).val =
        (FiniteConstructible.cellIndex c t).val := congrArg Fin.val hsame
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresented_oneDimensional_constructible
statement:
private theorem finitelyPresented_oneDimensional_constructible
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 1 → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0}
      (R := k) (P := Fin 1 → ℝ) M) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ c : Fin n ↪o ℝ,
      FiniteConstructible.IsConstructible c
        (reindex CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal M) ∧
      ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k
        ((reindex CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal M).obj (c i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hMlift := GradedFree.finitelyPresented_liftIndexUniverse M hM
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hM
  let S : Finset ℝ := (D.criticalCoordinates_finite hD 0).toFinset ∪ {0}
  let n := S.card
  let c : Fin n ↪o ℝ := S.orderEmbOfFin (k := n) rfl
  have hrange : Set.range c = (S : Set ℝ) := by
    simpa [c] using (Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin S (k := n) rfl)
  have hcover : ∀ q, q ∈ D.criticalCoordinates 0 → ∃ i, c i = q := by
    intro q hq
    have hqS : q ∈ (S : Set ℝ) := by
      simp [S, hq]
    have hr : q ∈ Set.range c := by rw [hrange]; exact hqS
    exact Set.mem_range.mp hr
  let Mreal := reindex CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal M
  have hgrid : FiniteConstructible.IsConstructible c Mreal := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      have hfree : IsZero
          ((GradedFree.module (R := k) D.generators).obj
            (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t)) := by
        have hbelow (g : D.generators.Carrier) :
            ¬ D.generators.grade g ≤ CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t := by
          have hg : D.generators.grade g 0 ∈ D.criticalCoordinates 0 :=
            Set.mem_union_left _ ⟨g, rfl⟩
          obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hcover _ hg
          have hti : t < D.generators.grade g 0 := by
            simpa [hi] using ht i
          intro h
          exact (not_le_of_gt hti)
            ((oneDimensional_coordinate_le_iff (D.generators.grade g) t).mp h)
        letI : IsEmpty
            {g : D.generators.Carrier // D.generators.grade g ≤
              CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t} :=
          ⟨fun ⟨g, hg⟩ => hbelow g hg⟩
        have hsub : Subsingleton
            ({g : D.generators.Carrier // D.generators.grade g ≤
              CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t} →₀ k) := by
          refine ⟨fun f g => ?_⟩
          apply Finsupp.ext
          intro i
          exact isEmptyElim i
        haveI : Subsingleton
            ((GradedFree.module (R := k) D.generators).obj
              (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t)) := by
          change Subsingleton (GradedFree.fiber (R := k) D.generators
            (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t))
          refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
          apply (GradedFree.fiberEquiv (R := k) D.generators
            (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t)).injective
          exact hsub.elim _ _
        exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _
      have hpresented : IsZero (D.presented.obj (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t)) := by
        haveI : Subsingleton (D.presented.obj (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t)) := by
          refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
          obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := D.cover_surjective (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t) x
          obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := D.cover_surjective (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t) y
          letI : Subsingleton
              ((GradedFree.module (R := k) D.generators).obj
                (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t)) :=
            ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero hfree
          calc
            x = D.cover.app (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t) x' := hx'.symm
            _ = D.cover.app (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t) y' := by
              congr 1
              exact Subsingleton.elim x' y'
            _ = y := hy'
        exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _
      exact IsZero.of_iso hpresented (e.app (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t)).symm
    · intro s t hst hsame
      have hgrade (q : ℝ) (hq : q ∈ D.criticalCoordinates 0) :
          q ≤ s ↔ q ≤ t :=
        oneDimensional_grade_threshold_of_cell c hcover hst hsame q hq
      have hG (g : D.generators.Carrier) :
          D.generators.grade g ≤ CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal s ↔
            D.generators.grade g ≤ CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t := by
        have hg : D.generators.grade g 0 ∈ D.criticalCoordinates 0 :=
          Set.mem_union_left _ ⟨g, rfl⟩
        constructor
        · intro h
          apply (oneDimensional_coordinate_le_iff _ _).mpr
          apply (hgrade _ hg).mp
          exact (oneDimensional_coordinate_le_iff _ _).mp h
        · intro h
          apply (oneDimensional_coordinate_le_iff _ _).mpr
          apply (hgrade _ hg).mpr
          exact (oneDimensional_coordinate_le_iff _ _).mp h
      have hY (y : D.relations.Carrier) :
          D.relations.grade y ≤ CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal s ↔
            D.relations.grade y ≤ CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t := by
        have hy : D.relations.grade y 0 ∈ D.criticalCoordinates 0 :=
          Set.mem_union_right _ ⟨y, rfl⟩
        constructor
        · intro h
          apply (oneDimensional_coordinate_le_iff _ _).mpr
          apply (hgrade _ hy).mp
          exact (oneDimensional_coordinate_le_iff _ _).mp h
        · intro h
          apply (oneDimensional_coordinate_le_iff _ _).mpr
          apply (hgrade _ hy).mpr
          exact (oneDimensional_coordinate_le_iff _ _).mp h
      have hDmap : IsIso
          (structureMap D.presented (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal.monotone hst)) :=
        D.structureMap_isIso_of_birth_iff (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal.monotone hst) hG hY
      have hn := e.hom.naturality
        (homOfLE (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal.monotone hst))
      have hcomp : IsIso
          (e.hom.app (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal s) ≫
            M.map (homOfLE (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal.monotone hst))) := by
        rw [← hn]
        exact IsIso.comp_isIso' hDmap (inferInstance : IsIso (e.hom.app (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal t)))
      have hMmap : IsIso
          (M.map (homOfLE (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal.monotone hst))) :=
        @IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left _ _ _ _ _
        (e.hom.app (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal s))
        (M.map (homOfLE (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal.monotone hst)))
        (inferInstance) hcomp
      change IsIso (M.map (homOfLE (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal.monotone hst)))
      exact hMmap
  have hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (Mreal.obj (c i)) := by
    intro i
    exact GradedFree.finitelyPresented_finiteDimensional M hMlift
      (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal (c i))
  exact ⟨n, c, by simpa [Mreal] using hgrid, by simpa [Mreal] using hfd⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.resolution_kernel_one_isZero
statement:
private theorem resolution_kernel_one_isZero
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 1 → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 1 → ℝ) M)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    (hL : 0 < R.resolution.length) :
    IsZero (R.resolution.kernel (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (R.resolution.length + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hlt : 1 < R.resolution.length
  · let i : Fin R.resolution.length := ⟨1, hlt⟩
    have hterm : IsZero (R.resolution.term i) := by
      have h :=
        FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_termAt_isZero
          (k := k) (n := 1) (by omega) M hM R 1 (by omega)
      exact IsZero.of_iso h (eqToIso (R.termAt_eq hlt).symm)
    have hkernel : IsZero (R.resolution.kernel i.castSucc) := by
      apply Functor.isZero
      intro p
      letI hsrc : Subsingleton ((R.resolution.term i).obj p) :=
        ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (hterm.obj p)
      letI : Subsingleton ((R.resolution.kernel i.castSucc).obj p) := by
        refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
        have hx : x = 0 := by
          obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (R.resolution.row_rank_exact i).surjective p x
          have hz0 : z = 0 := hsrc.elim z 0
          simpa [hz0] using hz.symm
        have hy : y = 0 := by
          obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (R.resolution.row_rank_exact i).surjective p y
          have hz0 : z = 0 := hsrc.elim z 0
          simpa [hz0] using hz.symm
        exact hx.trans hy.symm
      exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _
    have hidx : i.castSucc = (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (R.resolution.length + 1)) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    exact IsZero.of_iso hkernel
      (eqToIso (congrArg R.resolution.kernel hidx))
  · have hlen : R.resolution.length = 1 := by omega
    have hidx : (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (R.resolution.length + 1)) =
        Fin.last R.resolution.length := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simpa [hlen]
    have eK : R.resolution.kernel ⟨1, by omega⟩ ≅ 0 :=
      (eqToIso (congrArg R.resolution.kernel hidx)).trans R.resolution.terminal_iso
    exact IsZero.of_iso (isZero_zero _) eK

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.signedHookBarcode_eq_degreeZero
statement:
theorem MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.signedHookBarcode_eq_degreeZero
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 1 → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0}
      (R := k) (P := Fin 1 → ℝ) M)
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
    (P : FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := 1) (R.termAt 0)) :
    (R.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := 1) M hM).positive =
        hookTagMultiset P.tag ∧
    (R.signedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := 1) M hM).negative = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hterm (j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) : IsZero (R.termAt j) := by
    exact FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_termAt_isZero
      (k := k) (n := 1) (by omega) M hM R j (by omega)
  have hbetti_zero (j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) :
      R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := 1) M hM j = 0 :=
    R.hookBettiMultiset_eq_zero_of_term_isZero M hM (hterm j hj)
  have hbetti_tag :
      R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := 1) M hM 0 =
        hookTagMultiset P.tag :=
    R.hookBettiMultiset_eq_tagMultiset M hM 0 P
  have heven :
      R.evenHookBetti (k := k) (n := 1) M hM =
        hookTagMultiset P.tag := by
    have hsum : R.evenHookBetti (k := k) (n := 1) M hM =
        R.hookBettiMultiset (k := k) (n := 1) M hM 0 := by
      classical
      by_cases hL : 0 < R.resolution.length
      · have h0 : 0 ∈ evenHookDegrees R.resolution.length := by
          simp [evenHookDegrees, hL]
        unfold MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.evenHookBetti evenHookDegrees
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single 0]
        · intro j hj hj0
          have hjpos : 0 < j := by omega
          exact hbetti_zero j hjpos
        · intro hnot
          exact (hnot h0).elim
      · have hL0 : R.resolution.length = 0 := by omega
        have hzero := R.hookBettiMultiset_eq_zero_of_length_le
          M hM (j := 0) (by omega)
        simp [MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.evenHookBetti,
          evenHookDegrees, hL0, hzero]
    exact hsum.trans hbetti_tag
  have hodd : R.oddHookBetti (k := k) (n := 1) M hM = 0 := by
    classical
    unfold MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.oddHookBetti oddHookDegrees
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    have hoddj : Odd j := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
    exact hbetti_zero j hoddj.pos
  change (R.evenHookBetti (k := k) (n := 1) M hM =
        hookTagMultiset P.tag) ∧
      (R.oddHookBetti (k := k) (n := 1) M hM = 0)
  exact ⟨heven, hodd⟩

proof:
:= by

statement:

    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram_eq_resolution
statement:
theorem finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram_eq_resolution
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hX : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0}
      (R := k) (P := Fin 1 → ℝ) (CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal M))
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
      (k := k) (M := CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal M))
    (P : FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := 1)
      (R.termAt 0)) :
    finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram M hX =
      oneDimensionalHookDiagram P.tag
proof:
:= by
  let X := CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal M
  have hchoice := TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode_eq
    (k := k) (n := 1) (by omega) X hX R
  have hterms := R.signedHookBarcode_eq_degreeZero X hX P
  have hpositive :
      (TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := 1)
        (by omega) X hX).positive = hookTagMultiset P.tag := by
    exact (congrArg (fun C : SignedHookBarcode 1 => C.positive) hchoice).trans
      hterms.1
  apply Diagram.ext
  change Multiset.map oneDimensionalHookEndpoints
      (TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresentedSignedHookBarcode (k := k) (n := 1)
        (by omega) X hX).positive =
    (oneDimensionalHookDiagram P.tag).points
  rw [hpositive, oneDimensionalHookDiagram_points]

name: TDA.Persistence.oneDimensionalIsConstructible_of_iso
statement:
private theorem oneDimensionalIsConstructible_of_iso
    {r : ℕ} {c : Fin r ↪o ℝ} {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ}
    (e : M ≅ N) (hM : FiniteConstructible.IsConstructible c M) :
    FiniteConstructible.IsConstructible c N
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht
    exact IsZero.of_iso (hM.zero_left t ht) (e.app t).symm
  · intro s t hst hcell
    have hMmap : IsIso (structureMap M hst) := hM.isIso_map s t hst hcell
    have hn := e.hom.naturality (homOfLE hst)
    have hcomp : IsIso (e.hom.app s ≫ structureMap N hst) := by
      change IsIso (e.hom.app s ≫ N.map (homOfLE hst))
      rw [hn.symm]
      exact IsIso.comp_isIso' hMmap (inferInstance : IsIso (e.hom.app t))
    exact @IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left _ _ _ _ _
      (e.hom.app s) (structureMap N hst) (inferInstance) hcomp

name: TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresented_exists_oneDimensionalConstructible
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_oneDimensionalConstructible
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hX : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0}
      (R := k) (P := Fin 1 → ℝ) (CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal M)) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, ∃ c : Fin r ↪o ℝ,
      FiniteConstructible.IsConstructible c M ∧
      ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, c, hC, _hfd⟩ :=
    finitelyPresented_oneDimensional_constructible
      (k := k) (CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal M) hX
  let e := oneDimensionalDiagonalFromRealIso (k := k) M
  have hCM := oneDimensionalIsConstructible_of_iso (k := k) e hC
  let X := CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal M
  let hX' := GradedFree.finitelyPresented_liftIndexUniverse X hX
  have hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i)) := by
    intro i
    exact GradedFree.finitelyPresented_finiteDimensional X hX'
      (CoordinateRealBridge.diagonal (c i))
  exact ⟨r, c, hCM, hfd⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram_eq_moduleDiagram
statement:
theorem finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram_eq_moduleDiagram
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hX : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0}
      (R := k) (P := Fin 1 → ℝ) (CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal M))
    {r : ℕ} (c : Fin r ↪o ℝ)
    (hC : FiniteConstructible.IsConstructible c M)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))) :
    finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram M hX =
      FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram c M hfd
proof:
:= by
  let X := CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal M
  let R := Classical.choice
    (FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
      (k := k) (n := 1) (by omega) X hX)
  let P0 := Classical.choice
    (R.exists_hook_sum_presentation (k := k) (n := 1) X hX 0)
  let PX : FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := 1) X :=
    ⟨P0.count, P0.tag,
      (minimalResolution_degreeZeroIso (k := k) X hX R).symm.trans P0.iso⟩
  let D := FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram c M hfd
  let Q := positiveDiagram_hookPresentation (k := k) D
    (FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram_isPositive c M hfd)
  have e : X ≅ CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal (RealBarcode.realize (k := k) D) :=
    oneDimensionalFromRealIso (k := k)
      (FiniteConstructible.barcodeRealizationIso c M hC hfd)
  have htags : hookTagMultiset PX.tag = hookTagMultiset Q.tag :=
    PX.tagMultiset_eq_of_iso Q e
  have hPQ : oneDimensionalHookDiagram P0.tag = oneDimensionalHookDiagram Q.tag := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    rw [oneDimensionalHookDiagram_points, oneDimensionalHookDiagram_points, htags]
  have hP := finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram_eq_resolution
    (k := k) M hX R P0
  have hQ := positiveDiagram_hookPresentation_diagram (k := k) D
    (FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram_isPositive c M hfd)
  calc
    finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram M hX =
        oneDimensionalHookDiagram P0.tag := hP
    _ = oneDimensionalHookDiagram Q.tag := hPQ
    _ = D := hQ

name: TDA.Persistence.finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcode_bottleneck_eq_distance
statement:
theorem finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcode_bottleneck_eq_distance
    (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0}
      (R := k) (P := Fin 1 → ℝ) (CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal M))
    (hN : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0}
      (R := k) (P := Fin 1 → ℝ) (CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal N)) :
    bottleneck (finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram M hM)
        (finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram N hN) =
      realInterleavingDistance M N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, c, hC, hfd⟩ :=
    finitelyPresented_exists_oneDimensionalConstructible (k := k) M hM
  obtain ⟨s, d, hD, hgd⟩ :=
    finitelyPresented_exists_oneDimensionalConstructible (k := k) N hN
  rw [finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram_eq_moduleDiagram
      (k := k) M hM c hC hfd,
    finitelyPresentedOneDimensionalBarcodeDiagram_eq_moduleDiagram
      (k := k) N hN d hD hgd]
  exact FiniteConstructible.bottleneck_eq_distance hC hD hfd hgd

private theorem rankExact_zeroQuotient
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (hM : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) M) :
    IsRankExact (𝟙 M) (0 : M ⟶ (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P))
proof:
:= by

    fun p => GradedFree.finitelyPresented_finiteDimensional M hM p

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationCompositeKernelExamples.arbitrary_field_nonzero_composite_kernel
statement:
theorem arbitrary_field_nonzero_composite_kernel {k : Type u} [Field k] :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)
      (Limits.kernel
        ((0 : (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented ⟶
            (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ))) ≫
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶
            (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ))))) ∧
    IsRankExact
      (Limits.kernel.ι
        ((0 : (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented ⟶
            (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ))) ≫
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶
            (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)))))
      ((0 : (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented ⟶
          (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ))) ≫
        (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶
          (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)))) ∧
    ∃ x : (Limits.kernel
        ((0 : (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented ⟶
            (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ))) ≫
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶
            (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ))))).obj
        ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2).grade (0 : Fin 2)),
      x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let D := (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented
  let π : D ⟶ (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) := 0
  let σ : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶
      (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) := 0
  have hD : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ) D :=
    (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).finitelyPresented
      (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation_finite k 2)
  have hzero : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)
      (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) := zero_finitelyPresented
  have hsπ : IsRankExact (𝟙 D) π := rankExact_zeroQuotient hD
  have hsσ : IsRankExact (𝟙 (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ))) σ :=
    rankExact_zeroQuotient hzero
  have hresult := hsπ.comp_finitelyPresented hsσ hD hzero
  let lift : D ⟶ Limits.kernel (π ≫ σ) :=
    Limits.kernel.lift (π ≫ σ) (𝟙 D) (by simp [π, σ])
  let p := (FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2).grade (0 : Fin 2)
  let x := (lift.app p).hom (FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2)
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    have hLift : lift ≫ Limits.kernel.ι (π ≫ σ) = 𝟙 D := by
      dsimp [lift]
      rw [Limits.kernel.lift_ι]
    have hvalue : ((Limits.kernel.ι (π ≫ σ)).app p).hom
        ((lift.app p).hom (FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2)) =
          FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun f : D ⟶ D => (f.app p).hom
        (FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2)) hLift
      simpa using h
    have hzeroValue : ((Limits.kernel.ι (π ≫ σ)).app p).hom
        ((lift.app p).hom (FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2)) = 0 := by
      simpa [x] using congrArg ((Limits.kernel.ι (π ≫ σ)).app p).hom hx
    exact FinitePresentationKanExamples.surviving_generator 2 (hvalue.symm.trans hzeroValue)
  exact ⟨hresult.1, hresult.2, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationCompositeKernelExamples.split_rankExact
statement:
private theorem split_rankExact {k : Type u} [Field k] {P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    (A B : PModule.{u,0,u} k P)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj p)] [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (B.obj p)] :
    IsRankExact (biprod.inl : A ⟶ A ⊞ B) (biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ p : P,
      ((ShortComplex.mk (biprod.inl : A ⟶ A ⊞ B) (biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B) (by simp)).map
        ((evaluation P (ModuleCat.{u} k)).obj p)).ShortExact := fun p =>
    ((ShortComplex.Splitting.ofHasBinaryBiproduct A B).map
      ((evaluation P (ModuleCat.{u} k)).obj p)).shortExact
  have hs : IsPointwiseShortExact (biprod.inl : A ⟶ A ⊞ B) (biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B) :=
    ⟨fun p => (h p).moduleCat_injective_f, fun p => (h p).moduleCat_surjective_g,
      fun p => (h p).exact.moduleCat_range_eq_ker⟩
  let : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k ((A ⊞ B).obj p) := fun p =>
    Module.Finite.of_exact (f := ((biprod.inl : A ⟶ A ⊞ B).app p).hom)
      (g := ((biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B).app p).hom)
      (LinearMap.exact_iff.mpr (hs.range_eq_ker p).symm) (hs.surjective p)
  exact hs.rankExact_of_section biprod.inr (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationCompositeKernelExamples.arbitrary_field_split_composite_kernel
statement:
theorem arbitrary_field_split_composite_kernel {k : Type u} [Field k] :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (Limits.kernel (firstSplitQuotient k ≫ secondSplitQuotient k)) ∧
      IsRankExact (Limits.kernel.ι (firstSplitQuotient k ≫ secondSplitQuotient k))
        (firstSplitQuotient k ≫ secondSplitQuotient k) ∧
      ∃ x : (Limits.kernel (firstSplitQuotient k ≫ secondSplitQuotient k)).obj
          ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2).grade (0 : Fin 2)),
        ((Limits.kernel.ι (firstSplitQuotient k ≫ secondSplitQuotient k) ≫
          firstSplitQuotient k).app
            ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2).grade (0 : Fin 2))).hom x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let X := presentedModule k
  have hX : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ) X :=
    (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).finitelyPresented
      (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation_finite k 2)
  let : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (X.obj p) :=
    fun p => GradedFree.finitelyPresented_finiteDimensional X hX p
  have hsσ := split_rankExact X X
  let : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k ((X ⊞ X).obj p) := hsσ.finiteDimensional
  have hsπ := split_rankExact X (X ⊞ X)
  have hresult := hsπ.comp_finitelyPresented hsσ hX hX
  let j : X ⟶ X ⊞ (X ⊞ X) := biprod.inl ≫ biprod.inr
  have hj : j ≫ (firstSplitQuotient k ≫ secondSplitQuotient k) = 0 := by simp [j, X]
  let lift := Limits.kernel.lift (firstSplitQuotient k ≫ secondSplitQuotient k) j hj
  let p := (FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2).grade (0 : Fin 2)
  refine ⟨hresult.1, hresult.2,
    (lift.app p).hom (FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2), ?_⟩
  intro h0
  have hcomp : lift ≫ Limits.kernel.ι (firstSplitQuotient k ≫ secondSplitQuotient k) ≫
      firstSplitQuotient k ≫ biprod.fst = 𝟙 X := by
    simp [lift, j, X]
  have hv := congrArg (fun f : X ⟶ X =>
    (f.app p).hom (FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2)) hcomp
  change ((biprod.fst : X ⊞ X ⟶ X).app p).hom
      (((Limits.kernel.ι (firstSplitQuotient k ≫ secondSplitQuotient k) ≫
        firstSplitQuotient k).app p).hom
          ((lift.app p).hom (FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2))) =
    FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2 at hv
  rw [h0, map_zero] at hv
  exact FinitePresentationKanExamples.surviving_generator 2 hv.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.mem_largeFaceSubfaces
statement:
private theorem mem_largeFaceSubfaces {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (a : Index) (U s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ largeFaceSubfaces p a U ↔
      s = U ∨ (s ⊆ U ∧ s ∈ openCech p (radius a) ∧
        mass a ≤ (s.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [largeFaceSubfaces]

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.largeFaceSubfaces_biUnion
statement:
private theorem largeFaceSubfaces_biUnion {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (a : Index) (U : Finset V) :
    (largeFaceSubfaces p a U).biUnion id = U
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.Subset.antisymm
  · intro v hv
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hvs⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hv
    rcases (mem_largeFaceSubfaces p a U s).mp hs with hEq | hsmall
    · simpa [hEq] using hvs
    · exact hsmall.1 hvs
  · intro v hv
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨U, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, hv⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.largeFaceSubfaces_mono
statement:
private theorem largeFaceSubfaces_mono {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (a : Index) {U W : Finset V}
    (hU : U ∈ openCech p (radius a))
    (hlarge : mass a ≤ (U.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V)
    (hUW : U ⊆ W) : largeFaceSubfaces p a U ⊆ largeFaceSubfaces p a W
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  rcases (mem_largeFaceSubfaces p a U s).mp hs with hEq | hsmall
  · subst s
    apply (mem_largeFaceSubfaces p a W U).2
    right
    exact ⟨hUW, hU, hlarge⟩
  · apply (mem_largeFaceSubfaces p a W s).2
    right
    exact ⟨hsmall.1.trans hUW, hsmall.2.1, hsmall.2.2⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.largeFaceNerve_face_of_subfaces
statement:
private theorem largeFaceNerve_face_of_subfaces {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (a : Index) (S : Finset (Finset V)) (U : Finset V)
    (hS : S.Nonempty)
    (hvalid : ∀ s ∈ S, s ∈ openCech p (radius a) ∧
      mass a ≤ (s.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V)
    (hbelow : S.biUnion id ⊆ U)
    (hU : U ∈ openCech p (radius a)) :
    S ∈ largeFaceNerveBifiltration p a
proof:
:= by
  apply (mem_largeFaceNerve_iff p a S).2
  refine ⟨hS, hvalid, ?_⟩
  have hUnionNonempty : (S.biUnion id).Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hS
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (hvalid s hs).1.1
    exact ⟨v, Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨s, hs, hv⟩⟩
  exact (openCech p (radius a)).isRelLowerSet_faces hU |>.2 hbelow hUnionNonempty

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.largeFaceNerve_union_mem
statement:
private theorem largeFaceNerve_union_mem {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (a : Index) {S : Finset (Finset V)}
    (hS : S ∈ largeFaceNerveBifiltration p a) :
    S.biUnion id ∈ openCech p (radius a) ∧
      mass a ≤ ((S.biUnion id).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V
proof:
:= by
  have hdata := (mem_largeFaceNerve_iff p a S).mp hS
  refine ⟨hdata.2.2, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hdata.1
  have hsub : s ⊆ S.biUnion id := by
    intro v hv
    exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨s, hs, hv⟩
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  have hcardReal : (s.card : ℝ) ≤ ((S.biUnion id).card : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcard
  exact (hdata.2.1 s hs).2.trans
    (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hcardReal (by positivity))

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.largeFaceSubfaces_mem_nerve
statement:
private theorem largeFaceSubfaces_mem_nerve {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (a : Index) (U : Finset V)
    (hU : U ∈ openCech p (radius a))
    (hlarge : mass a ≤ (U.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V) :
    largeFaceSubfaces p a U ∈ largeFaceNerveBifiltration p a
proof:
:= by
  apply largeFaceNerve_face_of_subfaces p a _ U
  · exact ⟨U, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩
  · intro s hs
    rcases (mem_largeFaceSubfaces p a U s).mp hs with hEq | hsmall
    · subst s
      exact ⟨hU, hlarge⟩
    · exact ⟨hsmall.2.1, hsmall.2.2⟩
  · rw [largeFaceSubfaces_biUnion]
  · exact hU

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.largeFaceSubfaces_union_map_eq_id
statement:
private theorem largeFaceSubfaces_union_map_eq_id {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (a : Index) :
    VertexMap.comp (largeFaceSubfacesVertexMap p a)
        (largeFaceUnionVertexMap p a) =
    VertexMap.id (subdivision (openCech p (radius a)) (mass a))
proof:
:= by
  apply VertexMap.ext
  intro U
  change (largeFaceSubfaces p a U).biUnion id = U
  exact largeFaceSubfaces_biUnion p a U

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.flag_maximum_subset
statement:
private theorem flag_maximum_subset {W : Type*}
    (S : Finset (Finset W)) (hne : S.Nonempty)
    (hchain : ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ t ∈ S, s ⊆ t ∨ t ⊆ s) :
    ∃ t ∈ S, ∀ s ∈ S, s ⊆ t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image S Finset.card hne
  refine ⟨t, ht, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  rcases hchain s hs t ht with hst | hts
  · exact hst
  · have heq : t = s := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hts (hmax s hs)
    simpa [heq]

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.faceUnion_inclusion_contiguous_lastVertex
statement:
private theorem faceUnion_inclusion_contiguous_lastVertex {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (a : Index) :
    Contiguous
      (VertexMap.comp (largeFaceUnionVertexMap p a)
        (inclusionVertexMap (subdivision_openCech_le_largeFaceNerve p a)))
      (lastVertexMap (TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover p a)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : DecidableEq (Finset V) := Classical.decEq _
  intro C hC
  change C ∈ barycentricSubdivision (TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover p a)) at hC
  have hflag := (mem_subdivision_iff
    (TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover p a)) 0 C).mp hC
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hmax⟩ := flag_maximum_subset C hflag.1 hflag.2.2
  have hTvalid := largeFaceNerve_union_mem p a (hflag.2.1 T hT).1
  let labels := C.image (fun S => S.biUnion id) ∪ C.image (fun S => lastVertex S)
  have hlabels : labels ∈ largeFaceNerveBifiltration p a := by
    apply largeFaceNerve_face_of_subfaces p a labels (T.biUnion id)
    · obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hflag.1
      exact ⟨S.biUnion id,
        Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩)⟩
    · intro s hs
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hs with hs | hs
      · obtain ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
        exact largeFaceNerve_union_mem p a (hflag.2.1 S hS).1
      · obtain ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
        have hdata := (mem_largeFaceNerve_iff p a S).mp (hflag.2.1 S hS).1
        have hlast : lastVertex S ∈ S := by
          rw [lastVertex_of_nonempty S hdata.1]
          exact Finset.max'_mem S hdata.1
        exact hdata.2.1 _ hlast
    · intro v hv
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hvs⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hv
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hs with hs | hs
      · obtain ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hvt⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hvs
        exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨t, hmax S hS ht, hvt⟩
      · obtain ⟨S, hS, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
        have hdata := (mem_largeFaceNerve_iff p a S).mp (hflag.2.1 S hS).1
        have hlast : lastVertex S ∈ S := by
          rw [lastVertex_of_nonempty S hdata.1]
          exact Finset.max'_mem S hdata.1
        exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨lastVertex S, hmax S hS hlast, hvs⟩
    · exact hTvalid.1
  change labels ∈ largeFaceNerveBifiltration p a
  exact hlabels

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.inclusion_contiguous_subfaces_lastVertex
statement:
private theorem inclusion_contiguous_subfaces_lastVertex {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (a : Index) :
    Contiguous
      (inclusionVertexMap (subdivision_openCech_le_largeFaceNerve p a))
      (VertexMap.comp (largeFaceSubfacesVertexMap p a)
        (lastVertexMap (TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover p a))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : DecidableEq (Finset V) := Classical.decEq _
  intro C hC
  change C ∈ subdivision (openCech p (radius a)) (mass a) at hC
  have hflag := (mem_subdivision_iff
    (openCech p (radius a)) (mass a) C).mp hC
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hmax⟩ := flag_maximum_subset C hflag.1 hflag.2.2
  have hUvalid := hflag.2.1 U hU
  let labels := C ∪ C.image (fun W => lastVertex (largeFaceSubfaces p a W))
  have hlabels : labels ∈ largeFaceNerveBifiltration p a := by
    apply largeFaceNerve_face_of_subfaces p a labels U
    · obtain ⟨W, hW⟩ := hflag.1
      exact ⟨W, Finset.mem_union_left _ hW⟩
    · intro s hs
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hs with hs | hs
      · exact hflag.2.1 s hs
      · obtain ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
        have hWvalid := hflag.2.1 W hW
        have hWnerve := largeFaceSubfaces_mem_nerve p a W hWvalid.1 hWvalid.2
        have hdata := (mem_largeFaceNerve_iff p a (largeFaceSubfaces p a W)).mp hWnerve
        have hlast : lastVertex (largeFaceSubfaces p a W) ∈
            largeFaceSubfaces p a W := by
          rw [lastVertex_of_nonempty _ hdata.1]
          exact Finset.max'_mem _ hdata.1
        rcases (mem_largeFaceSubfaces p a W _).mp hlast with hEq | hsmall
        · simpa [hEq] using hWvalid
        · exact ⟨hsmall.2.1, hsmall.2.2⟩
    · intro v hv
      obtain ⟨s, hs, hvs⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hv
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hs with hs | hs
      · exact hmax s hs hvs
      · obtain ⟨W, hW, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hs
        have hWvalid := hflag.2.1 W hW
        have hWnerve := largeFaceSubfaces_mem_nerve p a W hWvalid.1 hWvalid.2
        have hdata := (mem_largeFaceNerve_iff p a (largeFaceSubfaces p a W)).mp hWnerve
        have hlast : lastVertex (largeFaceSubfaces p a W) ∈
            largeFaceSubfaces p a W := by
          rw [lastVertex_of_nonempty _ hdata.1]
          exact Finset.max'_mem _ hdata.1
        rcases (mem_largeFaceSubfaces p a W _).mp hlast with hEq | hsmall
        · have hvW : v ∈ W := by simpa [hEq] using hvs
          exact hmax W hW hvW
        · exact hmax W hW (hsmall.1 hvs)
    · exact hUvalid.1
  change C.image id ∪ C.image (fun W => lastVertex (largeFaceSubfaces p a W)) ∈
    (largeFaceNerveBifiltration p).toFun a
  change labels ∈ (largeFaceNerveBifiltration p).toFun a at hlabels
  simpa [Finset.image_id, labels] using hlabels

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.faceUnion_inclusion_homology_eq
statement:
private theorem faceUnion_inclusion_homology_eq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (a : Index) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialHomologyMap R (largeFaceUnionVertexMap p a) n ≫
        simplicialHomologyIncl R
          (subdivision_openCech_le_largeFaceNerve p a) n =
      (barycentricHomologyIso R (TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover p a)) n).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous.simplicialHomologyMap_eq R
    (faceUnion_inclusion_contiguous_lastVertex p a) n
  rw [simplicialHomologyMap_comp, simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion] at h
  change simplicialHomologyMap R (largeFaceUnionVertexMap p a) n ≫
      simplicialHomologyIncl R (subdivision_openCech_le_largeFaceNerve p a) n =
    (barycentricHomologyIso R (TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover p a)) n).hom at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.inclusion_subfaces_homology_eq
statement:
private theorem inclusion_subfaces_homology_eq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (a : Index) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl R
        (subdivision_openCech_le_largeFaceNerve p a) n =
      simplicialHomologyMap R (largeFaceSubfacesVertexMap p a) n ≫
        (barycentricHomologyIso R (TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover p a)) n).hom
proof:
:= by
  have h := TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous.simplicialHomologyMap_eq R
    (inclusion_contiguous_subfaces_lastVertex p a) n
  change simplicialHomologyMap R (inclusionVertexMap
      (subdivision_openCech_le_largeFaceNerve p a)) n =
    simplicialHomologyMap R
      (VertexMap.comp (largeFaceSubfacesVertexMap p a)
        (lastVertexMap (TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover p a)))) n at h
  rw [simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion, simplicialHomologyMap_comp] at h
  change simplicialHomologyIncl R (subdivision_openCech_le_largeFaceNerve p a) n =
      simplicialHomologyMap R (largeFaceSubfacesVertexMap p a) n ≫
        (barycentricHomologyIso R (TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover p a)) n).hom at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.cechHomologyToLargeFaceNerve_isIso
statement:
theorem cechHomologyToLargeFaceNerve_isIso {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.RipsInterleavingExamples.twoPoints_distance_le_rat

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.RipsInterleavingExamples.twoPoints_edge_mem_cech_exp_zero
statement:
theorem twoPoints_edge_mem_cech_exp_zero :
    TwoPoints.edge ∈ (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts).sublevel (Real.exp 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Real.exp_zero]
  exact (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem _ _ TwoPoints.edgeFace).2
    TwoPoints.cech_value.le

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.RipsInterleavingExamples.twoPoints_edge_not_mem_rips
statement:
theorem twoPoints_edge_not_mem_rips {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : (ε : ℝ) < Real.log 2) :
    TwoPoints.edge ∉ (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).sublevel (Real.exp (0 + ε))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hv := (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem _ _ TwoPoints.edgeFace).1 h
  rw [TwoPoints.rips_value, zero_add] at hv
  have := (Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)).1 hε
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.RipsInterleavingExamples.twoPoints_not_hGF
statement:
theorem twoPoints_not_hGF {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : (ε : ℝ) < Real.log 2) :
    ¬ ∀ t, Filtration.reindex expHom (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts).sublevelFiltration t ≤
      Filtration.reindex expHom (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).sublevelFiltration (t + ε)
proof:
:=
  fun h => twoPoints_edge_not_mem_rips hε (h 0 twoPoints_edge_mem_cech_exp_zero)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.RipsInterleavingExamples.twoPoints_edge_mem_rips_logParam
statement:
theorem twoPoints_edge_mem_rips_logParam :
    TwoPoints.edge ∈ (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).sublevel (Real.exp (0 + logParam 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [exp_add_logParam one_le_two, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  exact TwoPoints.edge_mem_rips_two

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.RipsInterleavingExamples.twoPoints_vertex_mem_rips
statement:
theorem twoPoints_vertex_mem_rips (t : ℝ) :
    ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).sublevel (Real.exp t)
proof:
:= by
  refine (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).2 ⟨Finset.singleton_nonempty 0, ?_⟩
  rw [Rips.filter_value, Rips.diameter_singleton]
  exact (Real.exp_pos t).le

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.RipsInterleavingExamples.twoPoints_vertex_mem_cech
statement:
theorem twoPoints_vertex_mem_cech (t : ℝ) :
    ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ (Cech.filter TwoPoints.pts).sublevel (Real.exp t)
proof:
:=
  sublevel_le_sublevel_of_le
    (Cech.filter_value_le_rips TwoPoints.metric TwoPoints.pts TwoPoints.metric_dist) _
    (twoPoints_vertex_mem_rips t)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.RipsInterleavingExamples.twoPoints_rips_sublevel_neg

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.RipsInterleavingExamples.twoPoints_factor_one
statement:
theorem twoPoints_factor_one :
    (ripsToCech (ZMod 2) 0 TwoPoints.metric TwoPoints.pts TwoPoints.metric_dist ≫
        cechToRips (ZMod 2) 0 TwoPoints.metric TwoPoints.pts TwoPoints.metric_dist).app 1 =
      structureMap (sublevelModule (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric) 0)
        (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ripsToCech_comp_cechToRips]
  exact ripsDouble_app_of_nonneg (ZMod 2) 0 TwoPoints.metric zero_le_one

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.RipsInterleavingExamples.twoPoints_rips_sublevel_two_mul_neg
statement:
theorem twoPoints_rips_sublevel_two_mul_neg :
    (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).sublevel (2 * -1) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  Rips.sublevel_eq_bot_of_neg _ (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.RipsInterleavingExamples.twoPoints_factor_neg_one
statement:
theorem twoPoints_factor_neg_one :
    (ripsToCech (ZMod 2) 0 TwoPoints.metric TwoPoints.pts TwoPoints.metric_dist ≫
        cechToRips (ZMod 2) 0 TwoPoints.metric TwoPoints.pts TwoPoints.metric_dist).app (-1) =
      simplicialHomologyIncl (ZMod 2)
        (K := (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).sublevel (-1))
        (L := (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).sublevel (2 * -1))
        (by rw [twoPoints_rips_sublevel_neg]; exact bot_le) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ripsToCech_comp_cechToRips]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.simplicialHomologyPModule_obj

name: TDA.Persistence.simplicialHomologyPModule_structureMap
