name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.coarse_apply
statement: private theorem coarse_apply (i : Fin 2) : coarse i = if i = 0 then (1 : ℝ) else 3
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.bars_birth_pos
statement: private theorem bars_birth_pos (I : FiniteInterval 3) (hI : I ∈ bars) : 0 < I.birth
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bars, Multiset.mem_cons, Multiset.notMem_zero, or_false] at hI
  rcases hI with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> decide

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.initial_zero
statement: private theorem initial_zero : IsZero ((barcodeModule (k := ℚ) bars).obj 0)
proof:
:= by
  have : Subsingleton ((barcodeModule (k := ℚ) bars).obj 0) := by
    change Subsingleton (∀ i : Fin bars.toList.length,
      FiniteInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) (bars.toList.get i) 0)
    refine ⟨fun x y => funext (fun i => ?_)⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hb := bars_birth_pos _ (Multiset.mem_toList.mp (List.get_mem bars.toList i))
    have hn : ¬ (bars.toList.get i).alive 0 := by
      simp only [FiniteInterval.alive, Fin.val_zero]; omega
    have hx : (x i : ℚ) = 0 := by
      simpa only [FiniteInterval.fiber, if_neg hn, Submodule.mem_bot] using (x i).property
    have hy : (y i : ℚ) = 0 := by
      simpa only [FiniteInterval.fiber, if_neg hn, Submodule.mem_bot] using (y i).property
    exact hx.trans hy.symm
  exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.input_constructible
statement: private theorem input_constructible : IsConstructible coarse input
proof:
:=
  isConstructible_reindex coarse _ initial_zero

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.critical_finite
statement: private theorem critical_finite (i : Fin 2) : FiniteDimensional ℚ (input.obj (coarse i))
proof:
:= by
  change FiniteDimensional ℚ ((barcodeModule (k := ℚ) bars).obj (cellIndex coarse (coarse i)))
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.coarse_diagram
statement:
private theorem coarse_diagram : moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite =
    ofIndexBars coarse coarse.strictMono (reindexBarcode (Fin.succOrderEmb 2).toOrderHom bars)
proof:
:= by
  let s : Fin 2 →o Fin 3 := (cellIndex coarse).comp coarse.toOrderHom
  have hs : s = (Fin.succOrderEmb 2).toOrderHom := by
    apply DFunLike.ext
    intro i
    exact cellIndex_critical coarse i
  unfold moduleDiagram
  change ofIndexBars coarse coarse.strictMono
    (rankBarcode (reindex s (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) bars))) = _
  rw [rankBarcode_reindex, rankBarcode_barcodeModule, hs]

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.input_points
statement:
private theorem input_points : (moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite).points =
    ((1 : ℝ), (3 : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ (1, (3 : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ (3, ⊤) ::ₘ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coarse_diagram, RealBarcode.ofIndexBars_points]
  have hf := RealBarcode.restrictAlong_succ finiteBar (show 0 < finiteBar.birth by decide)
  have he := RealBarcode.restrictAlong_succ essentialBar (show 0 < essentialBar.birth by decide)
  simp only [reindexBarcode, bars, Multiset.filterMap_cons_some _ _ _ hf,
    Multiset.filterMap_cons_some _ _ _ he, Multiset.filterMap_zero,
    Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.map_zero]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.shifted_points
statement:
theorem shifted_points :
    (moduleDiagram (shiftGrid 2 coarse) ((shift 2).obj input)
      (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical coarse input critical_finite 2)).points =
        ((-1 : ℝ), (1 : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ (-1, (1 : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ (1, ⊤) ::ₘ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [moduleDiagram_shift]
  change (moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite).points.map _ = _
  rw [input_points]
  norm_num [translateDiagramPoint]

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.shifted_support
statement:
theorem shifted_support (t : ℝ) (ht : 1 ≤ t) :
    ((-1 : ℝ), (1 : WithTop ℝ)) ∈
      (moduleDiagram (shiftGrid 2 coarse) ((shift 2).obj input)
        (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical coarse input critical_finite 2)).points ∧
      RealBarcode.alive (-1, (1 : WithTop ℝ)) (-1) ∧
      ¬ RealBarcode.alive (-1, (1 : WithTop ℝ)) 1 ∧
      RealBarcode.alive (1, ⊤) 1 ∧ RealBarcode.alive (1, ⊤) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [shifted_points]
  refine ⟨by simp, ⟨le_rfl, ?_⟩, ?_,
    ⟨le_rfl, WithTop.coe_lt_top _⟩, ⟨ht, WithTop.coe_lt_top _⟩⟩
  · exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (by norm_num)
  · intro h
    exact lt_irrefl _ h.2

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.shifted_refines
statement: private theorem shifted_refines : Refines (shiftGrid 2 coarse) fine
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
  fin_cases i
  · exact ⟨1, by norm_num [fine, shiftGrid_apply, coarse_apply]; rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨3, by norm_num [fine, shiftGrid_apply, coarse_apply]; rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.fine_finite
statement:
private theorem fine_finite (i : Fin 5) :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (((shift 2).obj input).obj (fine i))
proof:
:=
  finiteDimensional_of_isConstructible ((shift 2).obj input) (input_constructible.shift 2)
    (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical coarse input critical_finite 2) (fine i)

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.shifted_refined_points
statement:
theorem shifted_refined_points :
    (moduleDiagram fine ((shift 2).obj input) fine_finite).points =
      ((-1 : ℝ), (1 : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ (-1, (1 : WithTop ℝ)) ::ₘ (1, ⊤) ::ₘ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := moduleDiagram_shift_refinement coarse fine input input_constructible
    critical_finite 2 shifted_refines
  rw [h]
  rw [← moduleDiagram_shift coarse input critical_finite 2]
  exact shifted_points

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.shifted_multiplicities
statement:
theorem shifted_multiplicities :
    (moduleDiagram fine ((shift 2).obj input) fine_finite).points.count
        (-1, (1 : WithTop ℝ)) = 2 ∧
      (moduleDiagram fine ((shift 2).obj input) fine_finite).points.count (1, ⊤) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [shifted_refined_points]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.distinct_duplicate_labels
statement:
theorem distinct_duplicate_labels (a : ℝ) :
    let D := moduleDiagram fine ((shift 2).obj input) fine_finite
    ∃ p q : D.finiteOccurrences, p ≠ q ∧ p.1 = q.1 ∧
      finiteTranslationEquiv D a p ≠ finiteTranslationEquiv D a q
proof:
:= by
  let D := moduleDiagram fine ((shift 2).obj input) fine_finite
  have hc : (finitePart D.points).count (-1, 1) = 2 := by
    change (finitePart (moduleDiagram fine ((shift 2).obj input) fine_finite).points).count
      (-1, 1) = 2
    rw [shifted_refined_points]
    change (((-1, 1) : ℝ × ℝ) ::ₘ (-1, 1) ::ₘ 0).count (-1, 1) = 2
    norm_num
  let p : D.finiteOccurrences := ⟨(-1, 1), ⟨0, by rw [hc]; decide⟩⟩
  let q : D.finiteOccurrences := ⟨(-1, 1), ⟨1, by rw [hc]; decide⟩⟩
  have hpq : p ≠ q := by
    intro h
    have hi := congrArg (fun x : D.finiteOccurrences => x.2.val) h
    norm_num [p, q] at hi
  exact ⟨p, q, hpq, rfl, fun h => hpq ((finiteTranslationEquiv D a).injective h)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.common_grid_shift
statement:
theorem common_grid_shift (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    let e := commonGrid coarse (shiftGrid ε coarse)
    moduleDiagram e ((shift ε).obj input)
        (fun j => finiteDimensional_of_isConstructible ((shift ε).obj input)
          (input_constructible.shift ε)
          (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical coarse input critical_finite ε) (e j)) =
      translateDiagram (moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite) (-(ε : ℝ))
proof:
:=
  moduleDiagram_shift_refinement coarse _ input input_constructible critical_finite ε
    (refines_commonGrid_right _ _)

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.refined_shift_matching
statement:
theorem refined_shift_matching :
    ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching (moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite).finiteOccurrences
        (moduleDiagram fine ((shift 2).obj input) fine_finite).finiteOccurrences
        (moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite).essentialOccurrences
        (moduleDiagram fine ((shift 2).obj input) fine_finite).essentialOccurrences,
      (∀ i, ∃ j, A.finite i = some j ∧ j.1 = (i.1.1 - 2, i.1.2 - 2)) ∧
      (∀ j, ∃ i, A.finite i = some j) ∧
      (∀ i, (A.essential i).1 = i.1 - 2) ∧
      A.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) ≤ 2
proof:
:=
  exists_shift_refinement_matching coarse fine input input_constructible critical_finite 2
    shifted_refines

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.occurrence_round_trip
statement:
theorem occurrence_round_trip (D : Diagram ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    (∀ p : D.finiteOccurrences,
      ((translatedMatching D a).untranslateTarget a).finite p = some p) ∧
    (∀ p : D.essentialOccurrences,
      ((translatedMatching D a).untranslateTarget a).essential p = p)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p
    simp [OccurrenceMatching.untranslateTarget, OccurrenceMatching.relabel, translatedMatching]
  · intro p
    simp [OccurrenceMatching.untranslateTarget, OccurrenceMatching.relabel, translatedMatching]

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.unmatched_round_trip
statement:
theorem unmatched_round_trip (a : ℝ) :
    let D := moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite
    let A := (deletedFiniteMatching D a).untranslateTarget a
    (∀ i, A.finite i = none) ∧ (∀ j, ¬ ∃ i, A.finite i = some j) ∧
      (∀ b, A.essential b = b)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    exact (OccurrenceMatching.untranslateTarget_finite_eq_none_iff a _ i).mpr rfl
  · intro j ⟨i, hi⟩
    have h := (OccurrenceMatching.untranslateTarget_finite_eq_some_iff a _ i j).mp hi
    contradiction
  · intro b
    simp [deletedFiniteMatching, OccurrenceMatching.untranslateTarget, OccurrenceMatching.relabel]

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.inverse_values
statement:
theorem inverse_values (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (p : (translateDiagram (moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite) (-(ε : ℝ))).finiteOccurrences)
    (b : (translateDiagram (moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite) (-(ε : ℝ))).essentialOccurrences) :
    ((finiteTranslationEquiv _ (-(ε : ℝ))).symm p).1 =
        (p.1.1 + (ε : ℝ), p.1.2 + (ε : ℝ)) ∧
      ((essentialTranslationEquiv _ (-(ε : ℝ))).symm b).1 = b.1 + (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add] using finiteTranslationEquiv_symm_value _ (-(ε : ℝ)) p
  · simpa only [sub_neg_eq_add] using essentialTranslationEquiv_symm_value _ (-(ε : ℝ)) b

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.shift_matching
statement:
theorem shift_matching (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    let D := moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite
    let E := moduleDiagram (shiftGrid ε coarse) ((shift ε).obj input)
      (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical coarse input critical_finite ε)
    ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences
        D.essentialOccurrences E.essentialOccurrences,
      (∀ i, ∃ j, A.finite i = some j ∧
        j.1 = (i.1.1 - (ε : ℝ), i.1.2 - (ε : ℝ))) ∧
      (∀ j, ∃ i, A.finite i = some j) ∧
      (∀ i, (A.essential i).1 = i.1 - (ε : ℝ)) ∧
      A.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) ≤ ε
proof:
:=
  exists_shift_matching coarse input critical_finite ε

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.zero_shift
statement:
theorem zero_shift :
    moduleDiagram (shiftGrid 0 coarse) ((shift 0).obj input)
        (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical coarse input critical_finite 0) =
      moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite ∧
    (translatedMatching (moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite) 0).cost
      (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, le_antisymm ?_ zero_le⟩
  · rw [moduleDiagram_shift, NNReal.coe_zero, neg_zero, translateDiagram_zero]
  · simpa using translatedMatching_cost_le (moduleDiagram coarse input critical_finite) 0

name: TDA.Persistence.ConstructibleShiftBarcodeExamples.empty_shift
statement:
theorem empty_shift (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    (moduleDiagram (shiftGrid ε empty) ((shift ε).obj (0 : PModule.{0,0,0} ℚ ℝ))
      (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical empty _ (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) ε)).points = 0
proof:
:=
  moduleDiagram_empty_grid _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.point_mem_iff
statement:
private theorem point_mem_iff (a : ℝ) (p : Fin 1 → ℝ) :
    p ∈ (point a).support ↔ ∀ j, p j = a
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp j
    have h := hp j
    change (a < p j ∨ (a = p j ∧ true = true)) ∧
      (p j < a ∨ (p j = a ∧ true = true)) at h
    have hu := h.2
    rcases h.1 with h | ⟨h, _⟩ <;>
      (rcases hu with h' | ⟨h', _⟩ <;> linarith)
  · intro h j
    simp [point, BoundedInterval.support, h j]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.point_zero
statement:
private theorem point_zero (a : ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ε ((point a).module (k := ℚ)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply (interleaved_zero_iff _ _).mpr
  rintro ⟨p, hp, hq⟩
  have hp' := (point_mem_iff a p).mp hp 0
  have hq' := (point_mem_iff a (translation (ε + ε) p)).mp hq 0
  change p 0 + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = a at hq'
  rw [NNReal.coe_add] at hq'
  have he : 0 < (ε : ℝ) := hε
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.point_not_zero
statement:
theorem point_not_zero (a : ℝ) :
    ¬ Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving 0 ((point a).module (k := ℚ)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [interleaved_zero_iff, not_not]
  refine ⟨fun _ => a, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro j <;>
    norm_num [point, Rectangle.support, BoundedInterval.support, translation_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.mixed_matching
statement: private theorem mixed_matching : IsMatching (k := ℚ) 1 source target swapDelete
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro (_ | b) j h
    · simp [swapDelete] at h
    · cases b <;> simp [swapDelete] at h <;> subst j <;>
        exact ⟨CoordinateInterleaving.refl 1 _⟩
  · rintro (_ | b) h
    · exact point_zero 0 1 (by norm_num)
    · simp [swapDelete] at h
  · rintro (_ | b) h
    · exact point_zero 20 1 (by norm_num)
    · exact False.elim (h (some (!b)) (by cases b <;> rfl))

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.mixed_components
statement:
theorem mixed_components :
    component source target 1 mixedInterleaving.φ (some false) (some true) ≠ 0 ∧
    component source target 1 mixedInterleaving.φ none (some false) = 0 ∧
    component target source 1 mixedInterleaving.ψ none (some false) = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨I, hφ, _⟩ := mixed_matching.interleaving_components (some false) (some true) rfl
    change component source target 1 mixed_matching.interleaving.φ _ _ ≠ 0
    rw [hφ]
    intro hz
    have hs : Significant (1 + 1) (source (some false)) := by
      refine ⟨fun _ => 0, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> intro j <;>
        norm_num [source, longBar, Rectangle.support, BoundedInterval.support, translation_apply]
    have hn := (significant_iff_transition_ne_zero (k := ℚ) _ _).mp hs
    have he := I.φ_ψ
    rw [hz, zero_comp] at he
    exact hn he.symm
  · exact ⟨mixed_matching.interleaving_component_zero none (some false) (by decide),
      mixed_matching.interleaving_reverse_component_zero (some false) none (by decide)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.mixed_distance_bounds
statement:
theorem mixed_distance_bounds :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance (module (k := ℚ) source) (module target) ≤ 1 ∧
    bottleneckDistance (k := ℚ) source target ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨mixedInterleaving.distance_le, bottleneckDistance_le_of_matching mixed_matching⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.point_matching
statement:
private theorem point_matching (ε : ℝ≥0) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    IsMatching (k := ℚ) ε (fun _ : Unit => point 0) empty (eraseAll Unit (Fin 0))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j; exact Fin.elim0 j
  · intro i _; exact point_zero 0 ε hε
  · intro j; exact Fin.elim0 j

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.point_bottleneck_zero
statement:
theorem point_bottleneck_zero :
    bottleneckDistance (k := ℚ) (fun _ : Unit => point 0) empty = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp
  apply ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add
  intro ε hε _
  simpa using bottleneckDistance_le_of_matching (point_matching ε hε)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.point_interleavingDistance_zero
statement:
theorem point_interleavingDistance_zero :
    coordinateInterleavingDistance (module (k := ℚ) (fun _ : Unit => point 0))
      (module empty) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp
  simpa [point_bottleneck_zero] using
    interleavingDistance_le_bottleneckDistance (k := ℚ) (fun _ : Unit => point 0) empty

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.point_no_zero_matching
statement:
theorem point_no_zero_matching :
    ¬ ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching Unit (Fin 0) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      IsMatching (k := ℚ) 0 (fun _ => point 0) empty M
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨M, hM⟩
  have hm : M.finite () = none := by
    cases h : M.finite () with
    | none => rfl
    | some j => exact Fin.elim0 j
  exact point_not_zero 0 (hM.source_zero () hm)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.point_no_zero_interleaving
statement:
theorem point_no_zero_interleaving :
    ¬ Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving 0
      (module (k := ℚ) (fun _ : Unit => point 0)) (module empty))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨I⟩
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_matching (by decide : 0 < 1) _ _ 0 I
  apply point_no_zero_matching
  exact ⟨M, by simpa [stabilityRadius] using hM⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.halfOpen_matching
statement:
private theorem halfOpen_matching : IsMatching (k := ℚ) 1
    (fun _ : Unit => halfOpen) empty (eraseAll Unit (Fin 0))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j; exact Fin.elim0 j
  · intro i _; exact RectangleMatching.Examples.halfOpen_zero
  · intro j; exact Fin.elim0 j

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.critical_closed_no_matching
statement:
theorem critical_closed_no_matching :
    ¬ ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching Unit (Fin 0) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      IsMatching (k := ℚ) 1 (fun _ => criticalClosed) empty M
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨M, hM⟩
  have hm : M.finite () = none := by
    cases h : M.finite () with
    | none => rfl
    | some j => exact Fin.elim0 j
  exact RectangleMatching.Examples.closed_not_zero (hM.source_zero () hm)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMatching.DistanceExamples.empty_bottleneck_zero
statement:
theorem empty_bottleneck_zero : bottleneckDistance (k := ℚ) (n := 2)
    (fun i : Fin 0 => Fin.elim0 i) (fun i : Fin 0 => Fin.elim0 i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp
  simpa [coordinateInterleavingDistance_self] using
    bottleneckDistance_le_interleavingDistance (k := ℚ) (by decide : 0 < 2)
      (fun i : Fin 0 => Fin.elim0 i) (fun i : Fin 0 => Fin.elim0 i)

name: TDA.Persistence.natTrans_apply
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun g : M.obj i ⟶ L.obj j => g.hom x) (a.naturality f)

name: TDA.Persistence.totalDimension_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem totalDimension_eq_of_iso {M L : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N)} (e : M ≅ L) :
    totalDimension M = totalDimension L
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact (e.app i).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq

name: TDA.Persistence.totalDimension_pointwiseProd
statement:
theorem totalDimension_pointwiseProd (M L : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (L.obj i)] :
    totalDimension (pointwiseProd M L) = totalDimension M + totalDimension L
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalDimension
  change (∑ i, Module.finrank k (M.obj i × L.obj i)) = _
  simp_rw [Module.finrank_prod]
  exact Finset.sum_add_distrib

name: TDA.Persistence.split_retract_apply
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun g : A ⟶ A => (g.app i).hom a) h

name: TDA.Persistence.finrank_split
statement:
theorem finrank_split {A M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N)}
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj i)]
    (inc : A ⟶ M) (ret : M ⟶ A) (h : inc ≫ ret = 𝟙 A) (i : Fin N) :
    Module.finrank k (M.obj i) = Module.finrank k (A.obj i) +
      Module.finrank k ((splitComplement ret).obj i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [((splitIso inc ret h).app i).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq]
  exact Module.finrank_prod

name: TDA.Persistence.totalDimension_split
statement:
theorem totalDimension_split {A M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N)}
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj i)]
    (inc : A ⟶ M) (ret : M ⟶ A) (h : inc ≫ ret = 𝟙 A) :
    totalDimension M = totalDimension A + totalDimension (splitComplement ret)
proof:
:= by
  rw [totalDimension_eq_of_iso (splitIso inc ret h), totalDimension_pointwiseProd]

name: TDA.Persistence.subsingleton_of_totalDimension_zero
statement:
theorem subsingleton_of_totalDimension_zero (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (h : totalDimension M = 0) (i : Fin N) :
    Subsingleton (M.obj i)
proof:
:= by
  apply (Module.finrank_zero_iff (R := k) (M := M.obj i)).mp
  exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)).mp h i
    (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_dgm_lt_top
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_lt_top (d e : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n) < ⊤
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e n).trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy (d e : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ) :
    (bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n)).toReal ≤
      Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy_nonneg d e)] using
    ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e n)

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy (d e : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ)
    (σ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:=
  (WeightedKernel.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ hA hB w _ _
    (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (bottleneck_dgm_lt_top k d e n)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e n)
        (mul_nonneg (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy (d e : MetricSpace V)
    (n : ℕ) (σ τ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:=
  (WeightedKernel.norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ τ hA hB w _ _
    (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (bottleneck_dgm_lt_top k d e n)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e n)
        (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB)
          (abs_nonneg τ)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy (d e : MetricSpace V)
    (n : ℕ) (σ τ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    |WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n)| ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:=
  (WeightedKernel.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ τ hA hB w D _ _
    (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (bottleneck_dgm_lt_top k d e n)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e n)
        (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB)
          (abs_nonneg τ)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan
statement:
theorem norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan (d e : MetricSpace V)
    (n : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)
          (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)
          (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n)‖ ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e n σ hC Real.pi_div_two_pos.le
      (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan (d e : MetricSpace V)
    (n : ℕ) (σ τ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    |WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) D
          (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) D
          (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n)| ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e n σ τ hC
      Real.pi_div_two_pos.le (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) D

name: TDA.Persistence.pairCoefficient_continuous
statement:
private theorem pairCoefficient_continuous {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    {f g : α → ℝ × ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
    Continuous (fun a => (finitePairCost (f a) (g a)).toReal)
proof:
:= by
  have he (x y : ℝ × ℝ) : (finitePairCost x y).toReal =
      max |x.1 - y.1| |x.2 - y.2| :=
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal ((abs_nonneg _).trans (le_max_left _ _))
  simpa only [he, Pi.sub_apply] using (hf.fst.sub hg.fst).abs.max (hf.snd.sub hg.snd).abs

name: TDA.Persistence.diagonalCoefficient_continuous
statement:
private theorem diagonalCoefficient_continuous {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    {f : α → ℝ × ℝ} (hf : Continuous f) :
    Continuous (fun a => (diagonalCost (f a)).toReal)
proof:
:= by
  have he (x : ℝ × ℝ) : (diagonalCost x).toReal = |x.2 - x.1| / 2 :=
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (div_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num))
  simpa only [he, Pi.sub_apply] using (hf.snd.sub hf.fst).abs.div_const (2 : ℝ)

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_joint_continuousAt_pos
statement:
private theorem totalFinitePowerCost_joint_continuousAt_pos
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) {z : JointCostInput I J}
    (hp : 0 < z.1) :
    ContinuousAt (fun w : JointCostInput I J =>
      M.totalFinitePowerCost w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) z
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalFinitePowerCost totalBoundaryCost
  apply ContinuousAt.add
  · apply tendsto_finsetSum
    intro i _
    have hx : Continuous (fun w : JointCostInput I J => w.2.1 i) :=
      (continuous_apply i).comp continuous_snd.fst
    cases M.finite i with
    | none =>
      exact (diagonalCoefficient_continuous hx).continuousAt.rpow
        continuous_fst.continuousAt (Or.inr hp)
    | some j =>
      have hy : Continuous (fun w : JointCostInput I J => w.2.2 j) :=
        (continuous_apply j).comp continuous_snd.snd
      exact (pairCoefficient_continuous hx hy).continuousAt.rpow
        continuous_fst.continuousAt (Or.inr hp)
  · apply tendsto_finsetSum
    intro j _
    by_cases hj : ∃ i, M.finite i = some j
    · simpa only [if_pos hj] using
        (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : JointCostInput I J => (0 : ℝ)) z).tendsto
    · have hy : Continuous (fun w : JointCostInput I J => w.2.2 j) :=
        (continuous_apply j).comp continuous_snd.snd
      simpa only [if_neg hj] using
        ((diagonalCoefficient_continuous hy).continuousAt.rpow
          continuous_fst.continuousAt (Or.inr hp)).tendsto

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_joint_continuousAt_pos
statement:
private theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_joint_continuousAt_pos
    {z : JointCostInput I J} (hp : 0 < z.1) :
    ContinuousAt (fun w : JointCostInput I J =>
      finitePowerMatchingCost w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) z
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :=
    occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff.mpr (by simp)
  have h : ContinuousAt (fun w : JointCostInput I J =>
      Finset.univ.inf' Finset.univ_nonempty
        (fun M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1} =>
          M.totalFinitePowerCost w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2)) z :=
    ContinuousAt.finset_inf'_apply Finset.univ_nonempty
      (fun M _ => M.totalFinitePowerCost_joint_continuousAt_pos hp)
  simpa only [Finset.inf'_univ_eq_ciInf, finitePowerMatchingCost] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_joint_continuousAt_pos
statement:
private theorem finitePMatchingCost_joint_continuousAt_pos

      finitePMatchingCost w.1 w.2.1 w.2.2) z
proof:

  exact (finitePowerMatchingCost_joint_continuousAt_pos hp).rpow
    (continuous_fst.continuousAt.inv₀ hp.ne') (Or.inr (inv_pos.mpr hp))

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_joint_continuousOn

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankProjectiveCover.ofIso
proof:
:= by
  let π' : A ⟶ B := eA.inv ≫ π ≫ eB.hom
  let eK : kernel π ≅ kernel π' :=
    kernel.mapIso π π' eA eB (by simp [π'])
  refine ⟨hπ.term_rank_projective.of_iso eA, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [π', eK] using hπ.row_rank_exact.of_iso eK eA eB
  · intro u hu
    let u₀ : End A₀ := eA.hom ≫ u ≫ eA.inv
    have hu₀ : u₀ ≫ π = π := by
      apply (cancel_mono eB.hom).1
      simpa [u₀, π', Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun f => eA.hom ≫ f) hu
    haveI : IsIso u₀ := hπ.endomorphism_isIso u₀ hu₀
    have hu_eq : u = eA.inv ≫ u₀ ≫ eA.hom := by
      simp [u₀, Category.assoc]
    rw [hu_eq]
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankProjectiveCover.postcomposeIso
proof:
:= by
  simpa using hπ.ofIso (Iso.refl A) e

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankProjectiveCover.zero_identity
statement:
private theorem zero_identity :
    IsRankProjectiveCover (𝟙 (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P))
proof:
:= by
  let hsub : ∀ p, Subsingleton ((0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P).obj p) := fun p =>
    ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)
  letI : ∀ p, Subsingleton ((0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P).obj p) := hsub
  let hfd : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k ((0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P).obj p) := by
    intro p
    infer_instance
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k ((0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P).obj p) := hfd
  have hzero : IsRankProjective (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) := by
    intro L A B ι π hs α
    exact ⟨0, (isZero_zero _).eq_of_src _ _⟩
  refine ⟨hzero, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact RankKernel.rankExact (𝟙 (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P))
      (fun _ x => ⟨x, rfl⟩)
      (by
        intro a b hab x hx
        exact ⟨x, Subsingleton.elim _ _, hx⟩)
  · intro u hu
    have hu' : u = 𝟙 (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) :=
      (isZero_zero _).eq_of_src _ _
    rw [hu']
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankProjectiveCover.zero_map
statement:
private theorem zero_map :
    IsRankProjectiveCover (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) ⟶ 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) ⟶ 0) = 𝟙 0 :=
    (isZero_zero _).eq_of_src _ _
  rw [hEq]
  exact IsRankProjectiveCover.zero_identity (k := k) (P := P)

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  simp [MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt, Nat.not_lt.mpr h]

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_eq
statement:
theorem MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_eq
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) {j : ℕ}
    (h : j < R.resolution.length) :
    R.termAt j = R.resolution.term ⟨j, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.kernelAt_eq_recorded
statement:
private theorem MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.kernelAt_eq_recorded
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) {j : ℕ}
    (h : j ≤ R.resolution.length) :
    R.kernelAt j = R.resolution.kernel ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_le h⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.kernelAt
  rw [dif_pos h]

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.kernelAt_eq_castSucc
statement:
private theorem MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.kernelAt_eq_castSucc
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) {j : ℕ}
    (h : j < R.resolution.length) :
    R.kernelAt j = R.resolution.kernel (Fin.castSucc (⟨j, h⟩ : Fin R.resolution.length))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    R.kernelAt j = R.resolution.kernel ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_of_lt h)⟩ :=
      R.kernelAt_eq_recorded (Nat.le_of_lt h)
    _ = R.resolution.kernel (Fin.castSucc (⟨j, h⟩ : Fin R.resolution.length)) := by
      congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.kernelAt_eq_last
statement:
private theorem MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.kernelAt_eq_last
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) :
    R.kernelAt R.resolution.length =
      R.resolution.kernel (Fin.last R.resolution.length)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    R.kernelAt R.resolution.length =
        R.resolution.kernel ⟨R.resolution.length, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_refl _)⟩ :=
      R.kernelAt_eq_recorded (j := R.resolution.length) (Nat.le_refl _)
    _ = R.resolution.kernel (Fin.last R.resolution.length) := by
      congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.coverAt
statement:
private theorem MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.coverAt
    (R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) (j : ℕ) :
    IsRankProjectiveCover (R.quotientAt j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : j < R.resolution.length
  · let i : Fin R.resolution.length := ⟨j, h⟩
    let eT : R.resolution.term i ≅ R.termAt j :=
      (eqToIso (R.termAt_eq h)).symm
    let eK : R.resolution.kernel i.castSucc ≅ R.kernelAt j :=
      (eqToIso (R.kernelAt_eq_castSucc h)).symm
    have hq : R.quotientAt j = eT.inv ≫ R.resolution.quotient i ≫ eK.hom := by
      unfold MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.quotientAt
      rw [dif_pos h]
    rw [hq]
    exact (R.quotient_is_cover i).ofIso eT eK
  · by_cases hj : j = R.resolution.length
    · subst j
      have hCover := (IsRankProjectiveCover.zero_identity (k := k) (P := P)).ofIso
        (Iso.refl (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P)) R.terminalTargetIso
      have hmap : (𝟙 (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) ≫ R.terminalTargetIso.hom) =
          (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) ⟶ R.kernelAt R.resolution.length) :=
        (isZero_zero _).eq_of_src _ _
      have hq : R.quotientAt R.resolution.length = 0 := by
        simp [MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.quotientAt]
      rw [hq]
      have hterm : R.termAt R.resolution.length = 0 :=
        R.termAt_eq_zero (Nat.le_refl _)
      rw [hterm]
      simpa [hmap] using hCover
    · have hlen : R.resolution.length < j := by omega
      have hq : R.quotientAt j = 0 := by
        simp [MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.quotientAt, h]
      rw [hq]
      have hterm : R.termAt j = 0 := R.termAt_eq_zero (Nat.le_of_lt hlen)
      have hkernel : R.kernelAt j = 0 := by
        simp [MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.kernelAt,
          Nat.not_le_of_gt hlen]
      rw [hterm, hkernel]
      exact IsRankProjectiveCover.zero_map (k := k) (P := P)

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.quotientAt_eq_zero_of_length_le
proof:
:= by
  unfold MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.quotientAt
  rw [dif_neg (Nat.not_lt.mpr h)]

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_nonempty_iso
statement:
theorem MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_nonempty_iso
    (R S : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) (j : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (R.termAt j ≅ S.termAt j)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨(R.compareStage S j (R.kernelIsoAt S j)).termIso⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_rank_eq
statement:
theorem MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_rank_eq
    (R S : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M)) (j : ℕ)
    {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    rankOfStructureMap (R.termAt j) hab = rankOfStructureMap (S.termAt j) hab
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := R.termAt_nonempty_iso S j
  exact rankOfStructureMap_iso hab e

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurable_collapsePlanPair
statement: theorem measurable_collapsePlanPair : Measurable collapsePlanPair
proof:
:= by
  unfold collapsePlanPair
  exact (measurable_collapse.comp (by fun_prop)).prodMk
    (measurable_collapse.comp (by fun_prop))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapsedAugmentation_mass
statement:
theorem collapsedAugmentation_mass (π : Measure PlanSpace) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hπR : π Set.univ ≤ R) :
    collapsedAugmentation π R Set.univ = R
proof:
:= by
  rw [collapsedAugmentation, Measure.add_apply,
    Measure.map_apply measurable_collapsePlanPair MeasurableSet.univ,
    Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp only [preimage_univ, Measure.dirac_apply' _ MeasurableSet.univ,
    Set.indicator_univ, Pi.one_apply, mul_one]
  simpa only [add_comm] using (add_tsub_cancel_of_le hπR)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapsedAugmentation_isFiniteMeasure
statement:
theorem collapsedAugmentation_isFiniteMeasure (π : Measure PlanSpace)
    (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hR : R < ∞) (hπR : π Set.univ ≤ R) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (collapsedAugmentation π R)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rw [collapsedAugmentation_mass π R hπR]; exact hR⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.firstCollapse_preimage
statement:
private theorem firstCollapse_preimage (s : Set Space)
    (hb : Space.boundary ∉ s) :
    (fun z : PlanSpace => collapse z.1.1) ⁻¹' s =
      firstFiber (Space.point ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  change collapse z.1.1 ∈ s ↔ z.1.1 ∈ interiorIncl '' (Space.point ⁻¹' s)
  constructor
  · intro hz
    unfold collapse at hz
    split_ifs at hz with h
    · exact ⟨⟨z.1.1.1, h⟩, hz, rfl⟩
    · exact (hb hz).elim
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
    rw [← heq]
    change Space.point x ∈ s at hx
    simpa only [interiorIncl, collapse_interior] using hx

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.secondCollapse_preimage
statement:
private theorem secondCollapse_preimage (s : Set Space)
    (hb : Space.boundary ∉ s) :
    (fun z : PlanSpace => collapse z.1.2) ⁻¹' s =
      secondFiber (Space.point ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  change collapse z.1.2 ∈ s ↔ z.1.2 ∈ interiorIncl '' (Space.point ⁻¹' s)
  constructor
  · intro hz
    unfold collapse at hz
    split_ifs at hz with h
    · exact ⟨⟨z.1.2.1, h⟩, hz, rfl⟩
    · exact (hb hz).elim
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
    rw [← heq]
    change Space.point x ∈ s at hx
    simpa only [interiorIncl, collapse_interior] using hx

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapsedAugmentation_first_noboundary
statement:
private theorem collapsedAugmentation_first_noboundary
    {π : Measure PlanSpace} {μ ν : Measure Interior}
    (hπ : IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    {s : Set Space} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hb : Space.boundary ∉ s) :
    (collapsedAugmentation π R).map Prod.fst s = reservoirMeasure μ R s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop : Measurable (Prod.fst : Space × Space → Space)) hs,
    collapsedAugmentation, Measure.add_apply,
    Measure.map_apply measurable_collapsePlanPair
      ((by fun_prop : Measurable (Prod.fst : Space × Space → Space)) hs),
    Measure.smul_apply]
  have hpre : collapsePlanPair ⁻¹' (Prod.fst ⁻¹' s) =
      firstFiber (Space.point ⁻¹' s) := firstCollapse_preimage s hb
  rw [hpre, hπ.first _ (continuous_point.measurable hs)]
  simp [Measure.dirac_apply, hb, reservoirMeasure_apply_interior μ R hs hb]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapsedAugmentation_second_noboundary
statement:
private theorem collapsedAugmentation_second_noboundary
    {π : Measure PlanSpace} {μ ν : Measure Interior}
    (hπ : IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    {s : Set Space} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hb : Space.boundary ∉ s) :
    (collapsedAugmentation π R).map Prod.snd s = reservoirMeasure ν R s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop : Measurable (Prod.snd : Space × Space → Space)) hs,
    collapsedAugmentation, Measure.add_apply,
    Measure.map_apply measurable_collapsePlanPair
      ((by fun_prop : Measurable (Prod.snd : Space × Space → Space)) hs),
    Measure.smul_apply]
  have hpre : collapsePlanPair ⁻¹' (Prod.snd ⁻¹' s) =
      secondFiber (Space.point ⁻¹' s) := secondCollapse_preimage s hb
  rw [hpre, hπ.second _ (continuous_point.measurable hs)]
  simp [Measure.dirac_apply, hb, reservoirMeasure_apply_interior ν R hs hb]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measure_eq_of_away_boundary_and_mass
statement:
private theorem measure_eq_of_away_boundary_and_mass
    (A B : Measure Space) (hAfinite : A Set.univ < ∞)
    (hmass : A Set.univ = B Set.univ)
    (haway : ∀ s, MeasurableSet s → Space.boundary ∉ s → A s = B s) :
    A = B
proof:
:= by
  apply Measure.ext
  intro s hs
  by_cases hb : Space.boundary ∈ s
  · have hbc : Space.boundary ∉ sᶜ := by simpa using hb
    have hcomp : A sᶜ = B sᶜ := haway sᶜ hs.compl hbc
    have hAfinComp : A sᶜ ≠ ∞ :=
      ((measure_mono (subset_univ _)).trans_lt hAfinite).ne
    have hBfinite : B Set.univ < ∞ := by rw [← hmass]; exact hAfinite
    have hBfinComp : B sᶜ ≠ ∞ :=
      ((measure_mono (subset_univ _)).trans_lt hBfinite).ne
    have hAs : A s = A Set.univ - A sᶜ := by
      simpa only [compl_compl] using (measure_compl hs.compl hAfinComp)
    have hBs : B s = B Set.univ - B sᶜ := by
      simpa only [compl_compl] using (measure_compl hs.compl hBfinComp)
    rw [hAs, hBs, hmass, hcomp]
  · exact haway s hs hb

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapsedAugmentation_first_marginal
statement:
theorem collapsedAugmentation_first_marginal
    {π : Measure PlanSpace} {μ ν : Measure Interior}
    (hπ : IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν) (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hR : R < ∞)
    (htotal : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R) :
    (collapsedAugmentation π R).map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R
proof:
:= by
  have hπR : π Set.univ ≤ R := (boundaryPlan_mass_le hπ).trans htotal
  have hμR : μ Set.univ ≤ R := le_self_add.trans htotal
  have hA : ((collapsedAugmentation π R).map Prod.fst) Set.univ = R := by
    rw [Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop : Measurable (Prod.fst : Space × Space → Space))
      MeasurableSet.univ, preimage_univ]
    exact collapsedAugmentation_mass π R hπR
  have hB : reservoirMeasure μ R Set.univ = R :=
    reservoirMeasure_mass μ R hμR
  apply measure_eq_of_away_boundary_and_mass _ _ (by rw [hA]; exact hR)
  · rw [hA, hB]
  · intro s hs hb
    exact collapsedAugmentation_first_noboundary hπ R hs hb

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapsedAugmentation_second_marginal
statement:
theorem collapsedAugmentation_second_marginal
    {π : Measure PlanSpace} {μ ν : Measure Interior}
    (hπ : IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν) (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hR : R < ∞)
    (htotal : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R) :
    (collapsedAugmentation π R).map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R
proof:
:= by
  have hπR : π Set.univ ≤ R := (boundaryPlan_mass_le hπ).trans htotal
  have hνR : ν Set.univ ≤ R := by
    calc
      ν Set.univ ≤ ν Set.univ + μ Set.univ := le_self_add
      _ = μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ := add_comm _ _
      _ ≤ R := htotal
  have hA : ((collapsedAugmentation π R).map Prod.snd) Set.univ = R := by
    rw [Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop : Measurable (Prod.snd : Space × Space → Space))
      MeasurableSet.univ, preimage_univ]
    exact collapsedAugmentation_mass π R hπR
  have hB : reservoirMeasure ν R Set.univ = R :=
    reservoirMeasure_mass ν R hνR
  apply measure_eq_of_away_boundary_and_mass _ _ (by rw [hA]; exact hR)
  · rw [hA, hB]
  · intro s hs hb
    exact collapsedAugmentation_second_noboundary hπ R hs hb

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapsePlanPair_dist_le
statement:
theorem collapsePlanPair_dist_le (z : PlanSpace) :
    dist (collapse z.1.1) (collapse z.1.2) ≤ dist z.1.1 z.1.2
proof:
:= by
  have h := lipschitz_collapse.dist_le_mul z.1.1 z.1.2
  simpa using h

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapsePlanPair_powerCost_le
statement:
theorem collapsePlanPair_powerCost_le (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (z : PlanSpace) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((dist (collapse z.1.1) (collapse z.1.2)) ^ p) ≤
      planPowerCost p z
proof:
:= by
  unfold planPowerCost
  exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    (Real.rpow_le_rpow dist_nonneg (collapsePlanPair_dist_le z) hp)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurable_collapsedPowerCost
statement: theorem measurable_collapsedPowerCost (p : ℝ) : Measurable (collapsedPowerCost p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold collapsedPowerCost
  fun_prop

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapsedAugmentation_cost_le
statement:
theorem collapsedAugmentation_cost_le (π : Measure PlanSpace) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂collapsedAugmentation π R) ≤
      ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π
proof:
:= by
  rw [collapsedAugmentation, lintegral_add_measure, lintegral_smul_measure,
    lintegral_map (measurable_collapsedPowerCost p) measurable_collapsePlanPair]
  have hb : (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂Measure.dirac
      (Space.boundary, Space.boundary)) = 0 := by
    simp [collapsedPowerCost, Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']
  rw [hb]
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]
  exact lintegral_mono fun z => collapsePlanPair_powerCost_le p hp.le z

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapsedAugmentation_forward
statement:
theorem collapsedAugmentation_forward
    {π : Measure PlanSpace} {μ ν : Measure Interior}
    (hπ : IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν) (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hR : R < ∞)
    (htotal : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R)
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (collapsedAugmentation π R).map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R ∧
      (collapsedAugmentation π R).map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R ∧
      (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂collapsedAugmentation π R) ≤
        ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π
proof:
:=
  ⟨collapsedAugmentation_first_marginal hπ R hR htotal,
    collapsedAugmentation_second_marginal hπ R hR htotal,
    collapsedAugmentation_cost_le π R p (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_displacement
statement:
theorem norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_displacement (p q : V → X) (n : ℕ)
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ A B : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Cech.displacement p q
proof:
:=
  (PersistenceImage.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck hσ hA hB w P hm hd _ _
    (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (bottleneck_dgm_lt_top k p q n)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement k p q n)
        (mul_nonneg (PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_nonneg hσ hA hB) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_displacement_arctan
statement:
theorem norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_displacement_arctan (p q : V → X) (n : ℕ)
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ C : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) P
          (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) P
          (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      (2 * C + 3 * √(π / 2) / σ) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Cech.displacement p q
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_displacement k p q n hσ hC Real.pi_div_two_pos.le
      (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) P hm hd

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceTailSpace_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem persistenceTailSpace_finiteDimensional {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    FiniteDimensional k (PersistenceTailSpace M hab hbc)
proof:
:= by
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceTailMeasureValue_add_image
statement:
theorem persistenceTailMeasureValue_add_image {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab hbc +
      Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M (hab.trans hbc)) =
        Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M hbc)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
    ((persistenceImage M (hab.trans hbc)).comap (persistenceImage M hbc).subtype)
  rw [(Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe (persistenceImage_mono M hab hbc)).finrank_eq] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceMeasureValue_add_tail
statement:
theorem persistenceMeasureValue_add_tail {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    persistenceMeasureValue M hab hbc hcd +
      persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab (hbc.trans hcd) =
        persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab hbc
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M (hbc.trans hcd)) :=
    persistenceImage_finiteDimensional_target M hbc hcd
  have h₁ := persistenceTailMeasureValue_add_image M hab hbc
  have h₂ := persistenceTailMeasureValue_add_image M hab (hbc.trans hcd)
  have h₃ := persistenceMeasureValue_four_rank M hab hbc hcd
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceTailMeasureValue_antitone
statement:
theorem persistenceTailMeasureValue_antitone {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab (hbc.trans hcd) ≤
      persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab hbc
proof:
:= by
  have := persistenceMeasureValue_add_tail M hab hbc hcd
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceTailMeasureValue_split_birth
statement:
theorem persistenceTailMeasureValue_split_birth {a x b c : ℝ}
    (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    persistenceTailMeasureValue M (hax.trans hxb) hbc =
      persistenceTailMeasureValue M hax (hxb.trans hbc) +
        persistenceTailMeasureValue M hxb hbc
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M (hxb.trans hbc)) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (persistenceImage_mono M hxb hbc)
  have h₁ := persistenceTailMeasureValue_add_image M (hax.trans hxb) hbc
  have h₂ := persistenceTailMeasureValue_add_image M hax (hxb.trans hbc)
  have h₃ := persistenceTailMeasureValue_add_image M hxb hbc
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialMeasureValue_le_tail
statement:
theorem essentialMeasureValue_le_tail {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b < c) :
    essentialMeasureValue M hab ≤ persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab hbc.le
proof:
:=
  csInf_le' ⟨c, hbc, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialMeasureValue_le_crossing_rank
statement:
theorem essentialMeasureValue_le_crossing_rank {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b < c)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc.le)] :
    essentialMeasureValue M hab ≤ Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M hbc.le)
proof:
:= by
  have h := persistenceTailMeasureValue_add_image M hab hbc.le
  have h' := essentialMeasureValue_le_tail M hab hbc
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_tail_eq_essentialMeasureValue
statement:
theorem exists_tail_eq_essentialMeasureValue {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ (c : ℝ) (hbc : b < c),
      persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab hbc.le = essentialMeasureValue M hab
proof:
:= by
  exact csInf_mem (s := {n | ∃ (c : ℝ) (hbc : b < c),
    persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab hbc.le = n})
    ⟨persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab (show b ≤ b + 1 by linarith),
      b + 1, by linarith, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_eventually
statement:
theorem PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_eventually (hM : M.QTame)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ (c : ℝ) (hbc : b < c), ∀ (d : ℝ) (hcd : c ≤ d),
      persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab (hbc.le.trans hcd) = essentialMeasureValue M hab
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hbc, hc⟩ := exists_tail_eq_essentialMeasureValue M hab
  refine ⟨c, hbc, fun d hcd => ?_⟩
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc.le) := hM b c hbc
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (persistenceTailMeasureValue_antitone M hab hbc.le hcd).trans_eq hc
  · exact essentialMeasureValue_le_tail M hab (hbc.trans_le hcd)

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.QTame.persistenceMeasureValue_eventually_zero
statement:
theorem PModule.QTame.persistenceMeasureValue_eventually_zero (hM : M.QTame)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ (c : ℝ) (hbc : b < c), ∀ (d : ℝ) (hcd : c ≤ d),
      persistenceMeasureValue M hab hbc.le hcd = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hbc, hc⟩ := PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_eventually M hM hab
  refine ⟨c, hbc, fun d hcd => ?_⟩
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc.le) := hM b c hbc
  have h := persistenceMeasureValue_add_tail M hab hbc.le hcd
  rw [hc d hcd, hc c le_rfl] at h
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_split_birth
statement:
theorem PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_split_birth (hM : M.QTame)
    {a x b : ℝ} (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) :
    essentialMeasureValue M (hax.trans hxb) =
      essentialMeasureValue M hax + essentialMeasureValue M hxb
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, hb₀, h₀⟩ := PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_eventually M hM (hax.trans hxb)
  obtain ⟨c₁, _, h₁⟩ := PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_eventually M hM hax
  obtain ⟨c₂, _, h₂⟩ := PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_eventually M hM hxb
  let d := max c₀ (max c₁ c₂)
  have h₀d : c₀ ≤ d := le_max_left _ _
  have h₁d : c₁ ≤ d := (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have h₂d : c₂ ≤ d := (le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hbd : b < d := hb₀.trans_le h₀d
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbd.le) := hM b d hbd
  have h := persistenceTailMeasureValue_split_birth M hax hxb hbd.le
  rw [h₀ d h₀d, h₁ d h₁d, h₂ d h₂d] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_self (hM : M.QTame) (a : ℝ) :
    essentialMeasureValue M (le_refl a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_split_birth M hM (le_refl a) (le_refl a)
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.ioc01
statement: private theorem ioc01 : Finset.Ioc (0 : ℕ) 1 = {1}
proof: := by decide

name: TDA.Persistence.ioc02
statement: private theorem ioc02 : Finset.Ioc (0 : ℕ) 2 = {1, 2}
proof: := by decide

name: TDA.Persistence.ioc12
statement: private theorem ioc12 : Finset.Ioc (1 : ℕ) 2 = {2}
proof: := by decide

name: TDA.Persistence.range2
statement: private theorem range2 : Finset.range 2 = {0, 1}
proof: := by decide

name: TDA.Persistence.emptyRectangle
statement:
private theorem emptyRectangle (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 0))
    [∀ i : Fin 0, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] :
    (∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc 0 0, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 0,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger M x y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.oneStageReconstruction
proof:
:= by
  simpa [ioc01] using
    structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger M 0 0 (le_refl _)

name: TDA.Persistence.oneStageFieldReconstruction
statement:
private theorem oneStageFieldReconstruction :
    (structureMapRank (oneStageDiagram (k := k)) 0 0 (le_refl _) : ℤ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [oneStageReconstruction, oneStageField]

name: TDA.Persistence.oneStageZeroReconstruction
statement:
private theorem oneStageZeroReconstruction :
    (structureMapRank (oneStageZeroDiagram (k := k)) 0 0 (le_refl _) : ℤ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [oneStageReconstruction, oneStageZero]

name: TDA.Persistence.emptyDeathRectangle
statement:
private theorem emptyDeathRectangle (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2))
    [∀ i : Fin 2, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] :
    (∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc 0 0, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc 1 1,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger M x y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.singleBirthRectangle
statement:
private theorem singleBirthRectangle (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2))
    [∀ i : Fin 2, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] :
    (∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc 0 0, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 2,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger M x y) =
      (structureMapRank M 0 0 (le_refl _) : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := moduleMultiplicityInteger_sum_rectangle M 0 0 0 2
    (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_ofNat, zero_sub] at h
  have hneg := moduleRankInteger_neg_one M (2 : ℤ)
  have hneg0 := moduleRankInteger_neg_one M (0 : ℤ)
  have hterm := moduleRankInteger_at_size M (0 : ℤ)
  change moduleRankInteger M 0 2 = 0 at hterm
  have hself := moduleRankInteger_fin M (0 : Fin 2) 0 (le_refl _)
  change moduleRankInteger M 0 0 = _ at hself
  rw [hneg, hneg0, hterm, hself] at h
  simpa using h

name: TDA.Persistence.identityReconstruction
statement:
private theorem identityReconstruction :
    (structureMapRank (identityTransitionDiagram k) 0 0 (le_refl _) : ℤ) = 1 ∧
    (structureMapRank (identityTransitionDiagram k) 0 1 (by decide) : ℤ) = 1 ∧
    (structureMapRank (identityTransitionDiagram k) 1 1 (le_refl _) : ℤ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hm := identityTwoStage (k := k)
  constructor
  · rw [structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger]
    simp [Finset.range_one, ioc02, hm.1, hm.2.1]
  constructor
  · rw [structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger]
    simp [Finset.range_one, hm.2.1]
  · rw [structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger]
    simp [range2, hm.2.1, hm.2.2]

name: TDA.Persistence.zeroReconstruction
statement:
private theorem zeroReconstruction :
    (structureMapRank (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 0 0 (le_refl _) : ℤ) = 1 ∧
    (structureMapRank (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 0 1 (by decide) : ℤ) = 0 ∧
    (structureMapRank (zeroTransitionDiagram k) 1 1 (le_refl _) : ℤ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hm := zeroTwoStage (k := k)
  constructor
  · rw [structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger]
    simp [Finset.range_one, ioc02, hm.1, hm.2.1]
  constructor
  · rw [structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger]
    simp [Finset.range_one, hm.2.1]
  · rw [structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger]
    simp [range2, hm.2.1, hm.2.2]

name: TDA.Persistence.truncatedContrast
statement:
private theorem truncatedContrast :
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range 1, ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 1,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger (identityTransitionDiagram k) b d) = 0 ∧
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range 1, ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 1,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger (zeroTransitionDiagram k) b d) = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa only [Finset.range_one, ioc01, Finset.sum_singleton] using
      (identityTwoStage (k := k)).1
  · simpa only [Finset.range_one, ioc01, Finset.sum_singleton] using
      (zeroTwoStage (k := k)).1

name: TDA.Persistence.doubleTransitionRank
statement:
private theorem doubleTransitionRank :
    structureMapRank (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := k)) 0 1 (by decide) = 2
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : (k × k) →ₗ[k] (k × k))) = 2
  rw [LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top, Module.finrank_prod, Module.finrank_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.doubleMultiplicity
statement:
private theorem doubleMultiplicity :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := k)) 0 1 = 0 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := k)) 0 2 = 2 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := k)) 1 2 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := twoStageValues (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := k))
  rw [doubleTransitionRank] at h
  have hdim : Module.finrank k (k × k) = 2 := by
    simp [Module.finrank_prod]
  have hdim0 : Module.finrank k ((doubleIdentityDiagram (k := k)).obj (0 : Fin 2)) = 2 := hdim
  have hdim1 : Module.finrank k ((doubleIdentityDiagram (k := k)).obj (1 : Fin 2)) = 2 := hdim
  simpa only [hdim0, hdim1, Nat.cast_ofNat, sub_self] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.doubleReconstruction
statement:
private theorem doubleReconstruction :
    (structureMapRank (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := k)) 0 1 (by decide) : ℤ) =
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range 1, ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 1 2,
        moduleMultiplicityInteger (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := k)) b d
proof:
:= by
  exact structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger
    (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := k)) 0 1 (by decide)

name: TDA.Persistence.doubleReconstructionEvaluated
proof:
:= by
  rw [← doubleReconstruction]
  exact_mod_cast doubleTransitionRank (k := k)

name: TDA.Persistence.rationalFixtures
statement:
private theorem rationalFixtures :
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range 1, ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 1,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger (identityTransitionDiagram ℚ) b d) = 0 ∧
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range 1, ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 1,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger (zeroTransitionDiagram ℚ) b d) = 1 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := ℚ)) 0 2 = 2 ∧
    (structureMapRank (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := ℚ)) 0 1 (by decide) : ℤ) = 2 ∧
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range 1, ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 1 2,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := ℚ)) b d) = 2
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨(truncatedContrast (k := ℚ)).1, (truncatedContrast (k := ℚ)).2,
    (doubleMultiplicity (k := ℚ)).2.1,
    by exact_mod_cast (doubleTransitionRank (k := ℚ)),
    doubleReconstructionEvaluated (k := ℚ)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.binaryFixtures
statement:
private theorem binaryFixtures :
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range 1, ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 1,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger (identityTransitionDiagram (ZMod 2)) b d) = 0 ∧
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range 1, ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 1,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger (zeroTransitionDiagram (ZMod 2)) b d) = 1 ∧
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := ZMod 2)) 0 2 = 2 ∧
    (structureMapRank (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := ZMod 2)) 0 1 (by decide) : ℤ) = 2 ∧
    (∑ b ∈ Finset.range 1, ∑ d ∈ Finset.Ioc 1 2,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger (doubleIdentityDiagram (k := ZMod 2)) b d) = 2
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨(truncatedContrast (k := ZMod 2)).1, (truncatedContrast (k := ZMod 2)).2,
    (doubleMultiplicity (k := ZMod 2)).2.1,
    by exact_mod_cast (doubleTransitionRank (k := ZMod 2)),
    doubleReconstructionEvaluated (k := ZMod 2)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationHookKernel.Examples.rational_presentation_actual_cover_kernel_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem rational_presentation_actual_cover_kernel_finitelyPresented :
    ∃ (G : CoordinateGrid 2) (A : PModule ℚ G.Point)
      (hA : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional ℚ (A.obj p))
      (e : G.lan.obj A ≅ (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation ℚ 2).presented),
      IsRankExact
        (G.lan.map (kernel.ι (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)) ≫
          (G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).hom)
        ((G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).inv ≫
          G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) ≫ e.hom) ∧
      IsRankProjective (⨁ fun t => G.embeddedCoverFamily A t) ∧
      FinitelyPresented.{0,0,0}
        (kernel ((G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).inv ≫
          G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) ≫ e.hom))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, A, hA, e, hrank, hprojective, hkernel⟩ :=
    GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_finiteHookRankExactCoverKernel
      ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation ℚ 2).finitelyPresented
        (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation_finite ℚ 2))
  exact ⟨G, A, hA, e, hrank, hprojective, hkernel⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationHookKernel.Examples.characteristic_two_presentation_actual_cover_kernel_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem characteristic_two_presentation_actual_cover_kernel_finitelyPresented :

        (G.lan.map (kernel.ι (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)) ≫
          (G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).hom)

          G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) ≫ e.hom) ∧
      IsRankProjective (⨁ fun t => G.embeddedCoverFamily A t) ∧
      FinitelyPresented.{0,0,0}
        (kernel ((G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).inv ≫
          G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) ≫ e.hom))

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationHookKernel.Examples.empty_family_lan_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem empty_family_lan_finitelyPresented
    {k : Type} [Field k] {n : ℕ} (G : CoordinateGrid n) :
    FinitelyPresented.{0,0,0}
      (G.lan.obj (GradedFree.module (R := k)
        (⟨Empty, Empty.elim⟩ : GradedFree.GradedGenerators.{0,0} G.Point)))
proof:

  let W : GradedFree.GradedGenerators.{0,0} G.Point := ⟨Empty, Empty.elim⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationHookKernel.Examples.zero_empty_index_actual_cover_kernel_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem zero_empty_index_actual_cover_kernel_finitelyPresented
    (k : Type) [Field k] :
    ∃ (G : CoordinateGrid 0) (A : PModule k G.Point)
      (hA : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj p))
      (e : G.lan.obj A ≅ (0 : PModule k (Fin 0 → ℝ))),
      FinitelyPresented.{0,0,0}
        (kernel ((G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).inv ≫
          G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) ≫ e.hom))
proof:
:= by
  let W : GradedFree.GradedGenerators.{0,0} (Fin 0 → ℝ) := ⟨Empty, Empty.elim⟩
  have hzero : IsZero (GradedFree.module (R := k) W) := by
    apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
    apply GradedFree.hom_ext_birth W
    intro g
    exact g.elim
  have hfp : FinitelyPresented.{0,0,0}
      (0 : PModule k (Fin 0 → ℝ)) :=
    GradedFree.finitelyPresented_of_iso (GradedFree.free_finitelyPresented W)
      hzero.isoZero
  obtain ⟨G, A, hA, e, _, _, hkernel⟩ :=
    GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_finiteHookRankExactCoverKernel hfp
  exact ⟨G, A, hA, e, hkernel⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationHookKernel.Examples.finitelyPresented_actual_cover_kernel_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_actual_cover_kernel_finiteDimensional
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    ∃ (G : CoordinateGrid n) (A : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point)
      (hA : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj p))
      (e : G.lan.obj A ≅ M),
      IsRankExact
        (G.lan.map (kernel.ι (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)) ≫
          (G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).hom)
        ((G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).inv ≫
          G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) ≫ e.hom) ∧
      IsRankProjective (⨁ fun t => G.embeddedCoverFamily A t) ∧
      ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k
        ((kernel ((G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).inv ≫
          G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) ≫ e.hom)).obj p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, A, hA, e, hrank, hprojective, hkernel⟩ :=
    GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_finiteHookRankExactCoverKernel hM
  refine ⟨G, A, hA, e, hrank, hprojective, ?_⟩
  intro p
  exact GradedFree.finitelyPresented_finiteDimensional _ hkernel p

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentationExamples.boolSource_le_target

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentationExamples.boolRegular_transition_value
statement:
theorem boolRegular_transition_value {k : Type} [Field k] :
    (vertexStructureMap (k := k) (S := Bool) (boolRegular k)
      boolSource_le_target (boolRegularSourceUnit k) : boolRegular k) =
      IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := Bool)
        boolSource boolTarget boolSource_le_target
proof:
:= by

  change IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := Bool)
      boolSource boolTarget boolSource_le_target *
    IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := Bool)
      boolSource boolSource le_rfl = _

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentationExamples.boolRegular_transition_nonzero

    IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := Bool)
      boolSource boolTarget boolSource_le_target ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hcoeff := congrArg
    (fun a : RightIncidence (k := k) (S := Bool) =>
      (MulOpposite.unop a : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := Bool)) boolSource boolTarget) h
  simp [IncidenceQuotientBaseChange.rightIncidenceMatrixUnit,
    FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.delta_apply] at hcoeff

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentationExamples.boolZero_fibers_subsingleton

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentationExamples.boolRegular_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem boolRegular_finiteDimensional {k : Type} [Field k] :
    FiniteDimensional k (restrictedKModule (k := k) (S := Bool) (boolRegular k))
proof:
:= by
  change FiniteDimensional k (RightIncidence (k := k) (S := Bool))
  have hfd : FiniteDimensional k
      (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := Bool)) :=
    IncidenceRegularVertex.incidence_finiteDimensional (k := k) (S := Bool)
  letI := hfd
  exact (MulOpposite.opLinearEquiv k :
    FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := Bool) ≃ₗ[k]
      RightIncidence (k := k) (S := Bool)).finiteDimensional

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentationExamples.boolRegularDoubleEnd_ne_identity
statement: theorem boolRegularDoubleEnd_ne_identity : boolRegularDoubleEnd ≠ 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hval : (2 : RightIncidence (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)) = 1 := by
    have hh := congrArg
      (fun f : RightIncidence (k := ℚ) (S := Bool) →ₗ[RightIncidence (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)]
        RightIncidence (k := ℚ) (S := Bool) => f 1)
      (congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom h)
    simpa [boolRegularDoubleEnd, LinearMap.mulRight_apply] using hh
  have hone : (1 : RightIncidence (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hcoeff := congrArg
      (fun a : RightIncidence (k := ℚ) (S := Bool) =>
        (MulOpposite.unop a : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence
          (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)) boolSource boolSource) hzero
    have hcoeff' : (1 : ℚ) = 0 := by
      simpa [IncidenceAlgebra.one_apply, IncidenceAlgebra.zero_apply] using hcoeff
    exact one_ne_zero hcoeff'
  letI : Nontrivial (RightIncidence (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)) := ⟨⟨1, 0, hone⟩⟩
  have hzero : (1 : RightIncidence (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)) = 0 := by
    calc
      (1 : RightIncidence (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)) = 2 - 1 := by norm_num
      _ = 1 - 1 := by rw [hval]
      _ = 0 := sub_self _
  exact one_ne_zero hzero

theorem boolRegularDoubleEnd_recovered :

      boolRegularDoubleEnd

    (boolRegular ℚ) (boolRegular ℚ)).symm_apply_apply _

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentationExamples.boolSplit_comp_eq_zero
statement: private theorem boolSplit_comp_eq_zero : boolSplitInclusion ≫ boolSplitProjection = 0
proof:
:= by

  ext x
  simp [boolSplitInclusion, boolSplitProjection, LinearMap.inl_apply, LinearMap.snd_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexRepresentationExamples.boolSplitShortComplex_shortExact
statement: private theorem boolSplitShortComplex_shortExact : boolSplitShortComplex.ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let R := RightIncidence (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)
  have hrange : LinearMap.range (LinearMap.inl R R R) =
      LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.snd R R R) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      simp [LinearMap.inl_apply, LinearMap.snd_apply]
    · intro hz
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hz
      rcases z with ⟨x, y⟩
      change y = 0 at hz
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      simp [hz]
  let C := boolSplitShortComplex
  have hexact : C.Exact := by
    apply (ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker C).2
    change LinearMap.range (LinearMap.inl R R R) =
      LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.snd R R R)
    exact hrange
  letI : Mono C.f := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective C.f).2 (by
    change Function.Injective (LinearMap.inl R R R)
    exact LinearMap.inl_injective)
  letI : Epi C.g := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective C.g).2 (by
    change Function.Surjective (LinearMap.snd R R R)
    exact LinearMap.snd_surjective)
  exact ⟨hexact⟩
