statement:
theorem boolSplitShortComplex_vertexPointwise :
    IsPointwiseShortExact
      ((vertexFunctor (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)).map boolSplitInclusion)
      ((vertexFunctor (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)).map boolSplitProjection)
proof:
:=
  (rightIncidenceShortExact_iff_vertexPointwise (k := ℚ) (S := Bool)
    boolSplitInclusion boolSplitProjection boolSplit_comp_eq_zero).mp
      boolSplitShortComplex_shortExact

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.finiteSourceCharge_nonneg
statement:
private theorem finiteSourceCharge_nonneg
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (i : I) : 0 ≤ finiteSourceCharge M x y i
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteSourceCharge
  cases M.finite i <;> exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.finiteTargetCharge_nonneg
statement:
private theorem finiteTargetCharge_nonneg
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (j : J) : 0 ≤ finiteTargetCharge M y j
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteTargetCharge
  split_ifs <;> first | exact le_rfl | exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_eq_chargeSums
statement:
private theorem totalFinitePowerCost_eq_chargeSums
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y =
      (∑ i, finiteSourceCharge M x y i ^ p) + ∑ j, finiteTargetCharge M y j ^ p
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalFinitePowerCost totalBoundaryCost
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    cases h : M.finite i <;> simp only [finiteSourceCharge, h]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    unfold finiteTargetCharge
    split_ifs <;> simp only [Real.zero_rpow hp]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_eq_symmetricSums
statement:
private theorem totalFinitePowerCost_eq_symmetricSums
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y =
      (∑ i, ∑ j, if M.finite i = some j then (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal ^ p else 0) +
      (∑ i, if ∃ j, M.finite i = some j then 0 else (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p) +
      ∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have hs (i : I) :
      (match M.finite i with
        | some j => (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal ^ p
        | none => (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p) =
      (∑ j, if M.finite i = some j then (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal ^ p else 0) +
        (if ∃ j, M.finite i = some j then 0 else (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p) := by
    cases M.finite i <;> simp
  unfold totalFinitePowerCost totalBoundaryCost
  change (∑ i, match M.finite i with
    | some j => (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal ^ p
    | none => (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p) +
    (∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ p) = _
  simp_rw [hs]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_reverse
statement:
theorem totalFinitePowerCost_reverse
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) (p : ℝ)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.reverse.totalFinitePowerCost p y x = M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [totalFinitePowerCost_eq_symmetricSums, totalFinitePowerCost_eq_symmetricSums]
  simp_rw [reverse_finite_some_iff, finitePairCost_comm (y _) (x _)]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  abel

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.sourcePathCharge_le
statement:
private theorem sourcePathCharge_le
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (N : OccurrenceMatching J K PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (z : K → ℝ × ℝ) (i : I) :
    finiteSourceCharge (M.compose N) x z i ≤ finiteSourceCharge M x y i +
      (match M.finite i with | some j => finiteSourceCharge N y z j | none => 0)
proof:
:= by
  cases hm : M.finite i with
  | none => simp [finiteSourceCharge, compose, hm]
  | some j =>
    cases hn : N.finite j with
    | none =>
      simpa [finiteSourceCharge, compose, hm, hn] using
        diagonal_toReal_le_pair_add (x i) (y j)
    | some k =>
      simpa [finiteSourceCharge, compose, hm, hn, finitePairCost_toReal, dist_eq_norm] using
        dist_triangle (x i) (y j) (z k)

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.targetPathCharge_nonneg
statement:
private theorem targetPathCharge_nonneg
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (N : OccurrenceMatching J K PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) (z : K → ℝ × ℝ) (j : J) :
    0 ≤ targetPathCharge M N z j
proof:
:= by
  unfold targetPathCharge
  cases N.finite j
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact finiteTargetCharge_nonneg _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.targetPathCharge_le
statement:
private theorem targetPathCharge_le
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (N : OccurrenceMatching J K PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (z : K → ℝ × ℝ) (j : J) :
    targetPathCharge M N z j ≤ finiteTargetCharge M y j +
      (if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else finiteSourceCharge N y z j)
proof:
:= by
  cases hn : N.finite j with
  | none =>
    simp only [targetPathCharge, hn]
    exact add_nonneg (finiteTargetCharge_nonneg M y j)
      (by split_ifs <;> first | exact le_rfl | exact finiteSourceCharge_nonneg N y z j)
  | some k =>
    by_cases hm : ∃ i, M.finite i = some j
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hm
      have hc : ∃ i, (M.compose N).finite i = some k := ⟨i, by simp [compose, hi, hn]⟩
      simp [targetPathCharge, finiteTargetCharge, hn, hc,
        show ∃ i, M.finite i = some j from ⟨i, hi⟩]
    · have hdiag : (diagonalCost (z k)).toReal ≤
          (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal + (finitePairCost (y j) (z k)).toReal := by
        simpa only [finitePairCost_comm, add_comm] using
          diagonal_toReal_le_pair_add (z k) (y j)
      calc
        _ ≤ (diagonalCost (z k)).toReal := by
          simp only [targetPathCharge, hn]
          unfold finiteTargetCharge
          split_ifs <;> first | exact ENNReal.toReal_nonneg | exact le_rfl
        _ ≤ _ := by simpa [finiteTargetCharge, finiteSourceCharge, hm, hn] using hdiag

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.sum_targetPath_powers
statement:
private theorem sum_targetPath_powers
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (N : OccurrenceMatching J K PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (z : K → ℝ × ℝ) :
    (∑ j, targetPathCharge M N z j ^ p) + ∑ k, finiteTargetCharge N z k ^ p =
      ∑ k, finiteTargetCharge (M.compose N) z k ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have hncomp (k : K) (hn : ¬ ∃ j, N.finite j = some k) :
      ¬ ∃ i, (M.compose N).finite i = some k := by
    rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    cases hm : M.finite i with
    | none => simp [compose, hm] at hi
    | some j => exact hn ⟨j, by simpa [compose, hm] using hi⟩
  have hmap : (∑ j, targetPathCharge M N z j ^ p) =
      ∑ k, if ∃ j, N.finite j = some k then finiteTargetCharge (M.compose N) z k ^ p else 0 := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ j, match N.finite j with
          | some k => finiteTargetCharge (M.compose N) z k ^ p | none => 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j _
        cases hn : N.finite j <;> simp [targetPathCharge, hn, Real.zero_rpow hp]
      _ = _ := N.sum_matched _
  rw [hmap, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  by_cases hn : ∃ j, N.finite j = some k
  · simp [finiteTargetCharge, hn, Real.zero_rpow hp]
  · simp [finiteTargetCharge, hn, hncomp k hn]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.sum_middle_powers
statement:
private theorem sum_middle_powers
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (f : J → ℝ) :
    (∑ i, (match M.finite i with | some j => f j | none => 0) ^ p) +
        (∑ j, (if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else f j) ^ p) = ∑ j, f j ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have hmap : (∑ i, (match M.finite i with | some j => f j | none => 0) ^ p) =
      ∑ j, if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then f j ^ p else 0 := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i, match M.finite i with | some j => f j ^ p | none => 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        cases M.finite i <;> simp [Real.zero_rpow hp]
      _ = _ := M.sum_matched _
  rw [hmap, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  split_ifs <;> simp [Real.zero_rpow hp]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_compose_root_le
statement:
theorem totalFinitePowerCost_compose_root_le
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (N : OccurrenceMatching J K PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (z : K → ℝ × ℝ) :
    (M.compose N).totalFinitePowerCost p x z ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹ + N.totalFinitePowerCost p y z ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)
  let A : I ⊕ J ⊕ K → ℝ := Sum.elim (finiteSourceCharge M x y)
    (Sum.elim (finiteTargetCharge M y) (fun _ => 0))
  let B : I ⊕ J ⊕ K → ℝ := Sum.elim
    (fun i => match M.finite i with | some j => finiteSourceCharge N y z j | none => 0)
    (Sum.elim (fun j => if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else finiteSourceCharge N y z j)
      (finiteTargetCharge N z))
  let C : I ⊕ J ⊕ K → ℝ := Sum.elim (finiteSourceCharge (M.compose N) x z)
    (Sum.elim (targetPathCharge M N z) (finiteTargetCharge N z))
  have hA : ∀ t, 0 ≤ A t := by
    intro t
    rcases t with i | j | k
    · exact finiteSourceCharge_nonneg _ _ _ _
    · exact finiteTargetCharge_nonneg _ _ _
    · exact le_rfl
  have hB : ∀ t, 0 ≤ B t := by
    intro t
    rcases t with i | j | k
    · dsimp only [B, Sum.elim_inl]
      cases M.finite i <;> first | exact le_rfl | exact finiteSourceCharge_nonneg N y z _
    · dsimp [B]
      split_ifs <;> first | exact le_rfl | exact finiteSourceCharge_nonneg _ _ _ _
    · exact finiteTargetCharge_nonneg _ _ _
  have hC : ∀ t, 0 ≤ C t := by
    intro t
    rcases t with i | j | k
    · exact finiteSourceCharge_nonneg _ _ _ _
    · exact targetPathCharge_nonneg _ _ _ _
    · exact finiteTargetCharge_nonneg _ _ _
  have hpath : ∀ t, C t ≤ A t + B t := by
    intro t
    rcases t with i | j | k
    · exact sourcePathCharge_le M N x y z i
    · exact targetPathCharge_le M N y z j
    · simp [A, B, C]
  have hsumA : (∑ t, A t ^ p) = M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y := by
    simp only [A, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
      Real.zero_rpow hp0, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
    exact (totalFinitePowerCost_eq_chargeSums M hp0 x y).symm
  have hsumB : (∑ t, B t ^ p) = N.totalFinitePowerCost p y z := by
    simp only [B, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
    rw [← add_assoc, sum_middle_powers M hp0]
    exact (totalFinitePowerCost_eq_chargeSums N hp0 y z).symm
  have hsumC : (∑ t, C t ^ p) = (M.compose N).totalFinitePowerCost p x z := by
    simp only [C, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
    rw [sum_targetPath_powers M N hp0]
    exact (totalFinitePowerCost_eq_chargeSums (M.compose N) hp0 x z).symm
  have hpowers : (∑ t, C t ^ p) ≤ ∑ t, (A t + B t) ^ p :=
    Finset.sum_le_sum fun t _ => Real.rpow_le_rpow (hC t) (hpath t) (zero_le_one.trans hp)
  have hroot := Real.rpow_le_rpow
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun t _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (hC t) p)) hpowers
    (inv_nonneg.mpr (zero_le_one.trans hp))
  have hminkowski : (∑ t, (A t + B t) ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ ≤
      (∑ t, A t ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ + (∑ t, B t ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ := by
    simpa only [abs_of_nonneg (hA _), abs_of_nonneg (hB _),
      abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg (hA _) (hB _)), one_div] using
      Real.Lp_add_le Finset.univ A B hp
  rw [← hsumC, ← hsumA, ← hsumB]
  exact hroot.trans hminkowski

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_eq_zero_iff_totalFiniteCost_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem totalFinitePowerCost_eq_zero_iff_totalFiniteCost_eq_zero
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) {p : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y = 0 ↔ M.totalFiniteCost x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [totalFinitePowerCost_eq_chargeSums M hp x y]
  change (∑ i, finiteSourceCharge M x y i ^ p) + (∑ j, finiteTargetCharge M y j ^ p) = 0 ↔
    (∑ i, finiteSourceCharge M x y i) + (∑ j, finiteTargetCharge M y j) = 0
  rw [add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (finiteSourceCharge_nonneg M x y i) p)
    (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (finiteTargetCharge_nonneg M y j) p),
    add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => finiteSourceCharge_nonneg M x y i)
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => finiteTargetCharge_nonneg M y j)]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
    (fun i _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (finiteSourceCharge_nonneg M x y i) p),
    Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg
      (fun j _ => Real.rpow_nonneg (finiteTargetCharge_nonneg M y j) p),
    Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun i _ => finiteSourceCharge_nonneg M x y i),
    Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => finiteTargetCharge_nonneg M y j)]
  simp only [Real.rpow_eq_zero (finiteSourceCharge_nonneg M x y _) hp,
    Real.rpow_eq_zero (finiteTargetCharge_nonneg M y _) hp]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_eq_zero_iff_firstOrder_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_eq_zero_iff_firstOrder_eq_zero
    {p : ℝ} (hp : p ≠ 0) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePowerMatchingCost p x y = 0 ↔ finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerMatching p x y
    have hzero := (M.totalFinitePowerCost_eq_zero_iff_totalFiniteCost_eq_zero hp x y).mp
      (hM.trans hz)
    exact le_antisymm ((finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_le_totalFiniteCost x y M).trans_eq hzero)
      (finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_nonneg x y)
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_occurrenceMatching x y
    have hzero := (M.totalFinitePowerCost_eq_zero_iff_totalFiniteCost_eq_zero hp x y).mpr
      (hM.trans hz)
    exact le_antisymm ((finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching p x y M).trans_eq hzero)
      (finitePowerMatchingCost_nonneg p x y)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem finitePMatchingCost_self {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost p x x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)
  have hz := (finitePowerMatchingCost_eq_zero_iff_firstOrder_eq_zero hp0 x x).mpr
    (finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_self x)
  simp only [finitePMatchingCost, hz, Real.zero_rpow (inv_ne_zero hp0)]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_comm
statement:
theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_comm (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePowerMatchingCost p x y = finitePowerMatchingCost p y x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerMatching p x y
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerMatching p y x
  apply le_antisymm
  · calc
      _ ≤ N.reverse.totalFinitePowerCost p x y := finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching _ _ _ _
      _ = N.totalFinitePowerCost p y x := N.totalFinitePowerCost_reverse p y x
      _ = _ := hN
  · calc
      _ ≤ M.reverse.totalFinitePowerCost p y x := finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching _ _ _ _
      _ = M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y := M.totalFinitePowerCost_reverse p x y
      _ = _ := hM

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_comm
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_comm (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost p x y = finitePMatchingCost p y x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finitePMatchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_comm p x y]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_triangle
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_triangle {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (z : K → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost p x z ≤ finitePMatchingCost p x y + finitePMatchingCost p y z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_pMatching p x y
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_minimizing_pMatching p y z
  calc
    _ ≤ (M.compose N).totalFinitePowerCost p x z ^ p⁻¹ :=
      finitePMatchingCost_le_matching hp x z (M.compose N)
    _ ≤ M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹ + N.totalFinitePowerCost p y z ^ p⁻¹ :=
      M.totalFinitePowerCost_compose_root_le N hp x y z
    _ = _ := by rw [hM, hN]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_eq_zero_of_equiv
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_eq_zero_of_equiv {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (e : I ≃ J) (he : ∀ i, x i = y (e i)) :
    finitePMatchingCost p x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hx : y ∘ e = x := funext (fun i => (he i).symm)
  have h := finitePMatchingCost_reindex e (Equiv.refl J) p y y
  rw [hx] at h
  exact h.trans (finitePMatchingCost_self hp y)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_eq_zero_iff {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    finitePMatchingCost p x y = 0 ↔ ∃ e : I ≃ J, ∀ i, x i = y (e i)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)
  rw [finitePMatchingCost, Real.rpow_eq_zero (finitePowerMatchingCost_nonneg p x y)
    (inv_ne_zero hp0), finitePowerMatchingCost_eq_zero_iff_firstOrder_eq_zero hp0 x y]
  exact finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost_eq_zero_iff x y hx hy

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicMeasure_simpleFuncDiagram
statement:
theorem atomicMeasure_simpleFuncDiagram (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (T : Interior →ₛ Interior) :
    atomicMeasure (simpleFuncDiagram μ T) = μ.map T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [simpleFuncDiagram, atomicMeasure_ofIndexed]
  simp_rw [ENNReal.coe_toNNReal (ne_top_of_le_ne_top (measure_ne_top μ Set.univ)
    (measure_mono (subset_univ _)))]
  exact (Finset.sum_coe_sort T.range
    (fun q => μ (T ⁻¹' {q}) • Measure.dirac q)).trans
    (((Measure.ae_mem_finset_iff_map_eq_sum_dirac
    (f := T) (μ := μ) (s := T.range) T.measurable.aemeasurable).mp
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall T.mem_range_self)).symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.simpleFuncDiagram_mass
statement:
theorem simpleFuncDiagram_mass (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (T : Interior →ₛ Interior) :
    atomicMeasure (simpleFuncDiagram μ T) Set.univ = μ Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomicMeasure_simpleFuncDiagram, Measure.map_apply T.measurable MeasurableSet.univ]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.simpleFuncDiagram_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem simpleFuncDiagram_zero (T : Interior →ₛ Interior) :
    simpleFuncDiagram 0 T = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [simpleFuncDiagram, FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.quantizerCapacity_finite
statement:
private theorem quantizerCapacity_finite (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] :
    quantizerCapacity μ < ∞
proof:
:= by
  unfold quantizerCapacity
  finiteness

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.quantizerCapacity_le
statement:
private theorem quantizerCapacity_le (μ : Measure Interior) :
    μ Set.univ + μ Set.univ ≤ quantizerCapacity μ
proof:
:= by
  unfold quantizerCapacity
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right bot_le

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.simpleFuncReservoirPlan_first
statement:
theorem simpleFuncReservoirPlan_first (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (T : Interior →ₛ Interior) :
    (simpleFuncReservoirPlan μ T).map Prod.fst =
      reservoirMeasure μ (quantizerCapacity μ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold simpleFuncReservoirPlan reservoirMeasure
  have hpair : Measurable (fun x => (Space.point x, Space.point (T x))) :=
    continuous_point.measurable.prodMk (continuous_point.measurable.comp T.measurable)
  rw [Measure.map_add _ _ measurable_fst, Measure.map_smul,
    Measure.map_map measurable_fst hpair]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, Measure.map_dirac]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.simpleFuncReservoirPlan_second
statement:
theorem simpleFuncReservoirPlan_second (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (T : Interior →ₛ Interior) :
    (simpleFuncReservoirPlan μ T).map Prod.snd =
      reservoirMeasure (atomicMeasure (simpleFuncDiagram μ T)) (quantizerCapacity μ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomicMeasure_simpleFuncDiagram]
  unfold simpleFuncReservoirPlan reservoirMeasure
  have hpair : Measurable (fun x => (Space.point x, Space.point (T x))) :=
    continuous_point.measurable.prodMk (continuous_point.measurable.comp T.measurable)
  rw [Measure.map_add _ _ measurable_snd, Measure.map_smul,
    Measure.map_map measurable_snd hpair]
  · simp only [Function.comp_def, Measure.map_dirac]
    congr 1
    · rw [Measure.map_map]
      · rfl
      · exact continuous_point.measurable
      · exact T.measurable
    · rw [Measure.map_apply T.measurable MeasurableSet.univ]
      rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_simpleFuncDiagram_le
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_simpleFuncDiagram_le
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (T : Interior →ₛ Interior) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ (atomicMeasure (simpleFuncDiagram μ T)) ≤
      ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((dist (Space.point x) (Space.point (T x))) ^ p) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  let R := quantizerCapacity μ
  have hmass : μ Set.univ + atomicMeasure (simpleFuncDiagram μ T) Set.univ ≤ R := by
    rw [simpleFuncDiagram_mass]
    exact quantizerCapacity_le μ
  rw [boundaryTransportPowerValue_eq_reservoirPowerValue p hp μ
    (atomicMeasure (simpleFuncDiagram μ T)) R (quantizerCapacity_finite μ) hmass]
  apply (reservoirPowerValue_le_plan p μ _ R (simpleFuncReservoirPlan μ T)
    (simpleFuncReservoirPlan_first μ T) (simpleFuncReservoirPlan_second μ T)).trans
  unfold simpleFuncReservoirPlan
  have hpair : Measurable (fun x => (Space.point x, Space.point (T x))) :=
    continuous_point.measurable.prodMk (continuous_point.measurable.comp T.measurable)
  rw [lintegral_add_measure, lintegral_smul_measure]
  rw [lintegral_map (measurable_collapsedPowerCost p) hpair]
  simp [collapsedPowerCost, Real.zero_rpow (by linarith : p ≠ 0)]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_simpleFuncDiagram_le
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_simpleFuncDiagram_le
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (T : Interior →ₛ Interior) :
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ (atomicMeasure (simpleFuncDiagram μ T)) ≤
      (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal
        ((dist (Space.point x) (Space.point (T x))) ^ p) ∂μ) ^ (1 / p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold boundaryTransportDistance
  exact ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow
    (boundaryTransportPowerValue_simpleFuncDiagram_le p hp μ T)
    (one_div_nonneg.mpr (by linarith))

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceImage_mono
statement:
theorem persistenceImage_mono {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    persistenceImage M (hab.trans hbc) ≤ persistenceImage M hbc
proof:
:= by
  unfold persistenceImage
  rw [structureMapLinear_comp M hab hbc]
  exact LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceKernel_mono
proof:
:=
  inf_le_inf_right _ (persistenceImage_mono M hab hbc)

name: TDA.Persistence.image_restricted_range
proof:
:= by
  unfold persistenceImage
  rw [structureMapLinear_comp M hbc hcd,
    LinearMap.range_comp, Submodule.range_subtype]
  exact (LinearMap.range_comp (structureMapLinear M hbc)
    (structureMapLinear M hcd)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.restricted_kernel_finrank
statement:
private theorem restricted_kernel_finrank {c d : ℝ} (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (U : Submodule k (M.obj c)) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker ((structureMapLinear M hcd).comp U.subtype)) =
      Module.finrank k (U ⊓ LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M hcd) :
        Submodule k (M.obj c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq U
    (LinearMap.ker ((structureMapLinear M hcd).comp U.subtype))]
  change Module.finrank k (Submodule.map U.subtype
    (LinearMap.ker ((structureMapLinear M hcd).domRestrict U))) = _
  rw [LinearMap.ker_domRestrict, Submodule.map_comap_subtype]

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceImage_finrank_drop
statement:
theorem persistenceImage_finrank_drop {b c d : ℝ} (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M hbc) =
      Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M (hbc.trans hcd)) +
        Module.finrank k (persistenceKernel M hbc hcd)
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
    ((structureMapLinear M hcd).comp (persistenceImage M hbc).subtype)
  rw [image_restricted_range M hbc hcd, restricted_kernel_finrank M hcd] at h
  exact h.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceMeasureSpace_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem persistenceMeasureSpace_finiteDimensional {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    FiniteDimensional k (PersistenceMeasureSpace M hab hbc hcd)
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceKernel M hbc hcd) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_left
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.QTame.persistenceMeasureSpace_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem PModule.QTame.persistenceMeasureSpace_finiteDimensional
    (hM : M.QTame) {a b c d : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b < c) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    FiniteDimensional k (PersistenceMeasureSpace M hab hbc.le hcd)
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc.le) := hM b c hbc
  exact TDA.Persistence.persistenceMeasureSpace_finiteDimensional M hab hbc.le hcd

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceMeasureValue_add_kernel
statement:
theorem persistenceMeasureValue_add_kernel {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    persistenceMeasureValue M hab hbc hcd +
      Module.finrank k (persistenceKernel M (hab.trans hbc) hcd) =
        Module.finrank k (persistenceKernel M hbc hcd)
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceKernel M hbc hcd) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_left
  have h := Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank
    ((persistenceKernel M (hab.trans hbc) hcd).comap
      (persistenceKernel M hbc hcd).subtype)
  rw [(Submodule.comapSubtypeEquivOfLe
    (persistenceKernel_mono M hab hbc hcd)).finrank_eq] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceMeasureValue_four_rank
statement:
theorem persistenceMeasureValue_four_rank {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    (persistenceMeasureValue M hab hbc hcd : ℤ) =
      Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M hbc) -
        Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M (hab.trans hbc)) -
        Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M (hbc.trans hcd)) +
        Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M ((hab.trans hbc).trans hcd))
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M (hab.trans hbc)) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (persistenceImage_mono M hab hbc)
  have h₁ := persistenceImage_finrank_drop M hbc hcd
  have h₂ := persistenceImage_finrank_drop M (hab.trans hbc) hcd
  have h₃ := persistenceMeasureValue_add_kernel M hab hbc hcd
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceImage_finiteDimensional_target
statement:
theorem persistenceImage_finiteDimensional_target {b c d : ℝ}
    (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M (hbc.trans hcd))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← image_restricted_range M hbc hcd]
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceMeasureValue_split_birth
statement:
theorem persistenceMeasureValue_split_birth {a x b c d : ℝ}
    (hax : a ≤ x) (hxb : x ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    persistenceMeasureValue M (hax.trans hxb) hbc hcd =
      persistenceMeasureValue M hax (hxb.trans hbc) hcd +
        persistenceMeasureValue M hxb hbc hcd
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M (hxb.trans hbc)) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (persistenceImage_mono M hxb hbc)
  have h := persistenceMeasureValue_four_rank M (hax.trans hxb) hbc hcd
  have h₁ := persistenceMeasureValue_four_rank M hax (hxb.trans hbc) hcd
  have h₂ := persistenceMeasureValue_four_rank M hxb hbc hcd
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceMeasureValue_split_death
statement:
theorem persistenceMeasureValue_split_death {a b c y d : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcy : c ≤ y) (hyd : y ≤ d)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    persistenceMeasureValue M hab hbc (hcy.trans hyd) =
      persistenceMeasureValue M hab hbc hcy +
        persistenceMeasureValue M hab (hbc.trans hcy) hyd
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M (hbc.trans hcy)) :=
    persistenceImage_finiteDimensional_target M hbc hcy
  have h := persistenceMeasureValue_four_rank M hab hbc (hcy.trans hyd)
  have h₁ := persistenceMeasureValue_four_rank M hab hbc hcy
  have h₂ := persistenceMeasureValue_four_rank M hab (hbc.trans hcy) hyd
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceMeasureValue_le_crossing_rank
statement:
theorem persistenceMeasureValue_le_crossing_rank {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    persistenceMeasureValue M hab hbc hcd ≤ Module.finrank k (persistenceImage M hbc)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := persistenceMeasureValue_add_kernel M hab hbc hcd
  have h₂ := persistenceImage_finrank_drop M hbc hcd
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceMeasureValue_mono
statement:
theorem persistenceMeasureValue_mono {a a' b' b c c' d' d : ℝ}
    (haa : a ≤ a') (hab : a' ≤ b') (hbb : b' ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c)
    (hcc : c ≤ c') (hcd : c' ≤ d') (hdd : d' ≤ d)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc)] :
    persistenceMeasureValue M hab ((hbb.trans hbc).trans hcc) hcd ≤
      persistenceMeasureValue M ((haa.trans hab).trans hbb) hbc
        ((hcc.trans hcd).trans hdd)
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M (hbb.trans hbc)) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (persistenceImage_mono M hbb hbc)
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M ((hbb.trans hbc).trans hcc)) :=
    persistenceImage_finiteDimensional_target M (hbb.trans hbc) hcc
  have h₁ := persistenceMeasureValue_split_birth M (haa.trans hab) hbb hbc
    ((hcc.trans hcd).trans hdd)
  have h₂ := persistenceMeasureValue_split_birth M haa hab (hbb.trans hbc)
    ((hcc.trans hcd).trans hdd)
  have h₃ := persistenceMeasureValue_split_death M hab (hbb.trans hbc) hcc
    (hcd.trans hdd)
  have h₄ := persistenceMeasureValue_split_death M hab ((hbb.trans hbc).trans hcc)
    hcd hdd
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceMeasureValue_eq_zero_of_crossing_eq_zero
statement:
theorem persistenceMeasureValue_eq_zero_of_crossing_eq_zero {a b c d : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d)
    (hzero : structureMapLinear M hbc = 0) :
    persistenceMeasureValue M hab hbc hcd = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : persistenceKernel M hbc hcd = ⊥ := by
    simp [persistenceKernel, persistenceImage, hzero]
  unfold persistenceMeasureValue PersistenceMeasureSpace
  rw [h]
  exact Module.finrank_eq_zero_of_subsingleton k _

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceMeasureValue_birth_self
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank k (persistenceKernel M hac hcd ⧸
    (persistenceKernel M hac hcd).comap (persistenceKernel M hac hcd).subtype) = 0
  rw [Submodule.comap_subtype_self]
  exact Module.finrank_eq_zero_of_subsingleton k _

name: TDA.Persistence.persistenceMeasureValue_death_self
proof:
:= by
  have h : persistenceKernel M hbc (le_refl c) = ⊥ := by
    unfold persistenceKernel
    rw [structureMapLinear_self]
    simp
  unfold persistenceMeasureValue PersistenceMeasureSpace
  rw [h]
  exact Module.finrank_eq_zero_of_subsingleton k _

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.pushoutCokernelComparison_π
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pushoutCokernelComparison_π
    {X Y Z : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X ⟶ Z) :
    Limits.cokernel.π (biprod.lift f (-g)) ≫ (pushoutCokernelComparison f g).hom =
      biprod.desc (Limits.pushout.inl f g) (Limits.pushout.inr f g)
proof:
:= by
  let hc := cokernelIsCokernel (biprod.lift f (-g))
  let hp := CategoryTheory.Abelian.BiproductToPushoutIsCokernel.isColimitBiproductToPushout f g
  simpa [pushoutCokernelComparison, hc, hp,
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.BiproductToPushoutIsCokernel.biproductToPushout] using
      (IsColimit.comp_coconePointUniqueUpToIso_hom hc hp WalkingParallelPair.one)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.pushoutCokernelComparison_inl
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pushoutCokernelComparison_inl
    {X Y Z : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X ⟶ Z) :
    biprod.inl ≫ Limits.cokernel.π (biprod.lift f (-g)) ≫
        (pushoutCokernelComparison f g).hom = Limits.pushout.inl f g
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.pushoutCokernelComparison_inr
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pushoutCokernelComparison_inr
    {X Y Z : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X ⟶ Z) :
    biprod.inr ≫ Limits.cokernel.π (biprod.lift f (-g)) ≫
        (pushoutCokernelComparison f g).hom = Limits.pushout.inr f g
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_pushout
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_pushout
    {X Y Z : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : X ⟶ Z)
    (hX : FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P) X)
    (hY : FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P) Y)
    (hZ : FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P) Z) :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P) (Limits.pushout f g)
proof:
:= by
  have hYZ : FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P) (Y ⊞ Z) :=
    finitelyPresented_biprod hY hZ
  have hCoker : FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P)
      (Limits.cokernel (biprod.lift f (-g))) :=
    finitelyPresented_cokernel (biprod.lift f (-g)) hX hYZ
  exact finitelyPresented_of_iso hCoker (pushoutCokernelComparison f g)

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankExact.pushout_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem IsRankExact.pushout_finitelyPresented
    (hs : IsRankExact ι π) (f : L ⟶ L')
    (hL : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) L)
    (hM : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) M)
    (hL' : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) L') :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) (Limits.pushout ι f) ∧
      IsRankExact (Limits.pushout.inr ι f)
        (hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact.pushoutQuotient f)
proof:
:= by
  letI : ∀ p : P, FiniteDimensional k (L'.obj p) :=
    fun p => GradedFree.finitelyPresented_finiteDimensional L' hL' p
  exact ⟨GradedFree.finitelyPresented_pushout ι f hL hM hL', hs.pushout f⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteOccurrenceMatching.padded_injective
statement:
private theorem padded_injective {α β : Type} [Fintype α] (P : α → Prop)
    (f : {a // P a} → β) (hf : Injective f) : Injective (padded P f)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x y h
  cases x with
  | inl a =>
    cases y with
    | inl b =>
      by_cases ha : P a <;> by_cases hb : P b
      · simp only [padded, dif_pos ha, dif_pos hb, Sum.inl.injEq] at h
        exact congrArg Sum.inl (congrArg Subtype.val (hf h))
      · simp [padded, ha, hb] at h
      · simp [padded, ha, hb] at h
      · simp only [padded, dif_neg ha, dif_neg hb, Sum.inr.injEq] at h
        apply congrArg Sum.inl
        apply (Fintype.equivFin α).injective
        apply Fin.ext
        omega
    | inr m =>
      by_cases ha : P a
      · simp [padded, ha] at h
      · simp only [padded, dif_neg ha, Sum.inr.injEq] at h
        omega
  | inr m =>
    cases y with
    | inl b =>
      by_cases hb : P b
      · simp [padded, hb] at h
      · simp only [padded, dif_neg hb, Sum.inr.injEq] at h
        omega
    | inr l =>
      simp only [padded, Sum.inr.injEq] at h
      congr 1
      omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteOccurrenceMatching.exists_two_sided
statement:
theorem exists_two_sided {α β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (P : α → Prop) (Q : β → Prop) (r : α → β → Prop)
    (f : {a // P a} → β) (hf : Injective f) (hfr : ∀ a, r a.val (f a))
    (g : {b // Q b} → α) (hg : Injective g) (hgr : ∀ b, r (g b) b.val) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching α β PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      (∀ a b, M.finite a = some b → r a b) ∧
      (∀ a, P a → ∃ b, M.finite a = some b) ∧
      (∀ b, Q b → ∃ a, M.finite a = some b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : ∀ a, paddedRelation P Q r a (padded P f a) := by
    rintro (a | m)
    · by_cases h : P a
      · simpa only [padded, dif_pos h, paddedRelation] using hfr ⟨a, h⟩
      · simp [padded, paddedRelation, h]
    · trivial
  have hq : ∀ b, paddedRelation P Q r (padded Q g b) b := by
    rintro (b | m)
    · by_cases h : Q b
      · simpa only [padded, dif_pos h, paddedRelation] using hgr ⟨b, h⟩
      · simp [padded, paddedRelation, h]
    · trivial
  obtain ⟨h, hbij, hr⟩ := Function.Embedding.schroeder_bernstein_of_rel
    (padded_injective P f hf) (padded_injective Q g hg) (paddedRelation P Q r) hp hq
  let σ : α → Option β := fun a => match h (.inl a) with
    | .inl b => some b
    | .inr _ => none
  have hs (a : α) (b : β) : σ a = some b ↔ h (.inl a) = .inl b := by
    cases hh : h (.inl a) <;> simp [σ, hh]
  refine ⟨⟨σ, ?_, Equiv.refl _⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro a a' b ha ha'
    exact Sum.inl.inj (hbij.1 ((hs a b).mp ha |>.trans ((hs a' b).mp ha').symm))
  · intro a b hab
    have hh := hr (.inl a)
    rw [(hs a b).mp hab] at hh
    exact hh
  · intro a ha
    have hh := hr (.inl a)
    cases he : h (.inl a) with
    | inl b => exact ⟨b, (hs a b).mpr he⟩
    | inr m =>
      rw [he] at hh
      exact False.elim (hh ha)
  · intro b hb
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hbij.2 (.inl b)
    have hh := hr a
    rw [ha] at hh
    cases a with
    | inl a => exact ⟨a, (hs a b).mpr ha⟩
    | inr m => exact False.elim (hh hb)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.filter_eq_scale_rips
statement:
theorem filter_eq_scale_rips (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) :
    Cech.filter p = (Rips.filter d).scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  rw [FilterFunction.scale_value, Cech.filter_value_eq_rips_div_two d p hd s, div_eq_inv_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.rips_eq_scale_filter
statement:
theorem rips_eq_scale_filter (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) :
    Rips.filter d = (Cech.filter p).scale 2 zero_lt_two
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  rw [FilterFunction.scale_value, Cech.filter_value_eq_rips_div_two d p hd s]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.filter_eq_scale_rips_real
statement:
theorem filter_eq_scale_rips_real (d : MetricSpace V) (q : V → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) :
    Cech.filter q = (Rips.filter d).scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.dgm_eq_scale_rips
statement:
theorem dgm_eq_scale_rips (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (n : ℕ) :
    dgm k (Cech.filter p) n =
      (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)
proof:
:= by
  rw [filter_eq_scale_rips d p hd]
  exact dgm_scale k (Rips.filter d) n _

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.dgm_eq_scale_rips_real
statement:
theorem dgm_eq_scale_rips_real (d : MetricSpace V) (q : V → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (n : ℕ) :
    dgm k (Cech.filter q) n =
      (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).scale 2⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 zero_lt_two)
proof:
:= by
  rw [filter_eq_scale_rips_real d q hd]
  exact dgm_scale k (Rips.filter d) n _

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_dgm_eq_half_rips
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_eq_half_rips (d e : MetricSpace V) (p q : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n) =
      ENNReal.ofReal 2⁻¹ *
        bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [filter_eq_scale_rips d p hd, filter_eq_scale_rips e q he]
  exact bottleneck_dgm_scale k (Rips.filter d) (Rips.filter e) n _

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_le_half_pairwiseDiscrepancy (d e : MetricSpace V) (p q : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_dgm_eq_half_rips k d e p q hd he n]
  calc
    ENNReal.ofReal 2⁻¹ *
          bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal 2⁻¹ * ENNReal.ofReal (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e) :=
      mul_le_mul_right (Rips.bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e n) _
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e / 2) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num), inv_mul_eq_div]

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleHom_apply (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (t : ℝ) :
    scaleHom c hc t = c⁻¹ * t
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scale_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem scale_obj (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (scale c hc M).obj t = M.obj (c⁻¹ * t)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.structureMap_scale
statement:
theorem structureMap_scale (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ)
    {s t : ℝ} (h : s ≤ t) :
    structureMap (scale c hc M) h =
      structureMap M ((scaleHom c hc).monotone h)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleOneIndex
statement: private theorem scaleOneIndex (t : ℝ) : scaleHom 1 one_pos t = t
proof:
:= by
  simp [scaleHom]

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleScaleIndex
statement:
private theorem scaleScaleIndex (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) (t : ℝ) :
    (scaleHom a ha).comp (scaleHom b hb) t = scaleHom (b * a) (mul_pos hb ha) t
proof:
:= by
  change a⁻¹ * (b⁻¹ * t) = (b * a)⁻¹ * t
  rw [mul_inv_rev]
  exact (mul_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleInvIndex
statement:
private theorem scaleInvIndex (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (t : ℝ) :
    (scaleHom c hc).comp (scaleHom c⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 hc)) t = t
proof:
:= by
  change c⁻¹ * ((c⁻¹)⁻¹ * t) = t
  rw [inv_inv, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hc.ne']

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleShiftIndex
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaleHom_apply, scaleHom_apply]
  calc
    c⁻¹ * (t + ((Real.toNNReal c * ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) =
        c⁻¹ * (t + c * (ε : ℝ)) := by
      congr 1
      simp only [NNReal.coe_mul, Real.coe_toNNReal _ hc.le]
    _ = c⁻¹ * t + c⁻¹ * (c * (ε : ℝ)) := by rw [mul_add]
    _ = c⁻¹ * t + (ε : ℝ) := by rw [inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hc.ne']

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleOneIndex'
statement:
private theorem scaleOneIndex' (t : ℝ) :
    (scaleHom 1 one_pos).comp (OrderHom.id : ℝ →o ℝ) t = t
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleScaleIndex'
proof: := scaleScaleIndex a b ha hb t

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleInvIndex'
proof:
:= by
  simpa using scaleInvIndex c hc t

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleShiftIndex'
proof:
:= by
  exact scaleShiftIndex c hc ε t

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleOneIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleOneIso_hom_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (scaleOneIso M).hom.app t = M.map (eqToHom (scaleOneIndex t))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleOneIso_naturality
statement:
theorem scaleOneIso_naturality {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    reindexNatTrans (scaleHom 1 one_pos) f ≫ (scaleOneIso N).hom =
      (scaleOneIso M).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  exact (f.naturality (eqToHom (scaleOneIndex t))).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleScaleIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaleScaleIso_hom_app (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (scaleScaleIso a b ha hb M).hom.app t =
      M.map (eqToHom (scaleScaleIndex a b ha hb t))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleScaleIso_naturality
statement:
theorem scaleScaleIso_naturality (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    reindexNatTrans (scaleHom b hb) (reindexNatTrans (scaleHom a ha) f) ≫
        (scaleScaleIso a b ha hb N).hom =
      (scaleScaleIso a b ha hb M).hom ≫
        reindexNatTrans (scaleHom (b * a) (mul_pos hb ha)) f
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  exact (f.naturality (eqToHom (scaleScaleIndex a b ha hb t))).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.PModule.scaleInvIso_naturality
statement:
theorem scaleInvIso_naturality {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    reindexNatTrans (scaleHom c⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 hc))
        (reindexNatTrans (scaleHom c hc) f) ≫ (scaleInvIso hc N).hom =
      (scaleInvIso hc M).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext

private theorem scaleShiftIso_inv_app (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (ε : ℝ≥0)

theorem scaleShiftIso_naturality (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (shift (Real.toNNReal c * ε)).map (reindexNatTrans (scaleHom c hc) f) ≫
        (scaleShiftIso c hc ε N).hom =
      (scaleShiftIso c hc ε M).hom ≫
        reindexNatTrans (scaleHom c hc) ((shift ε).map f)

:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  exact (f.naturality (eqToHom (scaleShiftIndex c hc ε t))).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.scale_equation
statement:
private theorem scale_equation (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (t : ℝ) :
    (reindexNatTrans (PModule.scaleHom c hc) i.φ ≫
        (PModule.scaleShiftIso c hc ε N).inv).app t ≫
      (reindexNatTrans (PModule.scaleHom c hc) i.ψ ≫
        (PModule.scaleShiftIso c hc ε M).inv).app
        (t + ((Real.toNNReal c * ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) ≫
      (compIso (Real.toNNReal c * ε) (Real.toNNReal c * ε)
        (PModule.scale c hc M)).hom.app t =
    (transition (Real.toNNReal c * ε + Real.toNNReal c * ε)
      (PModule.scale c hc M)).app t
proof:
:= by
  change
    i.φ.app (PModule.scaleHom c hc t) ≫
        (PModule.scaleShiftIso c hc ε N).inv.app t ≫
      i.ψ.app (PModule.scaleHom c hc
        (t + ((Real.toNNReal c * ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ))) ≫
        (PModule.scaleShiftIso c hc ε M).inv.app
          (t + ((Real.toNNReal c * ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) ≫
      (compIso (Real.toNNReal c * ε) (Real.toNNReal c * ε)
        (PModule.scale c hc M)).hom.app t =
    (transition (Real.toNNReal c * ε + Real.toNNReal c * ε)
      (PModule.scale c hc M)).app t
  rw [PModule.scaleShiftIso_inv_app, PModule.scaleShiftIso_inv_app]
  simp only [compIso_hom_app, transition_app]
  erw [i.ψ.naturality_assoc]
  erw [← Category.assoc (i.φ.app (PModule.scaleHom c hc t))
    (i.ψ.app (PModule.scaleHom c hc t + (ε : ℝ))), i.φ_ψ_structureMap]
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  repeat' erw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.scale_φ_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem scale_φ_app (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (t : ℝ) :
    (i.scale c hc).φ.app t =
      i.φ.app (PModule.scaleHom c hc t) ≫
        (PModule.scaleShiftIso c hc ε N).inv.app t
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.scale_ψ_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem scale_ψ_app (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (t : ℝ) :
    (i.scale c hc).ψ.app t =
      i.ψ.app (PModule.scaleHom c hc t) ≫
        (PModule.scaleShiftIso c hc ε M).inv.app t
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.nonempty_realInterleaving_scale_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_realInterleaving_scale_iff (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    Nonempty (RealInterleaving (Real.toNNReal c * ε)
      (PModule.scale c hc M) (PModule.scale c hc N)) ↔
      Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M N)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i⟩
    have j := i.scale c⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 hc)
    have h : Real.toNNReal c⁻¹ * (Real.toNNReal c * ε) = ε := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.toNNReal_mul (inv_nonneg.2 hc.le),
        inv_mul_cancel₀ hc.ne', Real.toNNReal_one, one_mul]
    have j' := j.congr (PModule.scaleInvIso hc M) (PModule.scaleInvIso hc N)
    rw [h] at j'
    exact ⟨j'⟩
  · rintro ⟨i⟩
    exact ⟨i.scale c hc⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_scale
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_scale (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    realInterleavingDistance (PModule.scale c hc M) (PModule.scale c hc N) =
      ENNReal.ofReal c * realInterleavingDistance M N
proof:
:= by
  have hc0 : ENNReal.ofReal c ≠ 0 := (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.2 hc).ne'
  have hct : ENNReal.ofReal c ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  apply le_antisymm
  · calc
      realInterleavingDistance (PModule.scale c hc M) (PModule.scale c hc N) ≤
          ⨅ (ε : ℝ≥0) (_ : Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M N)),
            ENNReal.ofReal c * (ε : ℝ≥0∞) := by
        refine le_iInf fun ε => le_iInf fun hε => ?_
        obtain ⟨i⟩ := hε
        change realInterleavingDistance (PModule.scale c hc M) (PModule.scale c hc N) ≤
          (Real.toNNReal c : ℝ≥0∞) * (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
        rw [← ENNReal.coe_mul]
        exact RealInterleaving.distance_le (i.scale c hc)
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal c * realInterleavingDistance M N := by
      symm
      simp only [realInterleavingDistance,
        ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne hc0 hct]
  · refine le_iInf₂ fun δ hδ => ?_
    obtain ⟨j⟩ := hδ
    have hback : Nonempty (RealInterleaving (Real.toNNReal c⁻¹ * δ) M N) := by
      have j' := j.scale c⁻¹ (inv_pos.2 hc)
      have j'' := j'.congr (PModule.scaleInvIso hc M) (PModule.scaleInvIso hc N)
      exact ⟨j''⟩
    have hdist := RealInterleaving.distance_le (Classical.choice hback)
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_right hdist (ENNReal.ofReal c)
    calc
      ENNReal.ofReal c * realInterleavingDistance M N ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal c * (Real.toNNReal c⁻¹ * δ : ℝ≥0∞) := hmul
      _ = (δ : ℝ≥0∞) := by
        have h : Real.toNNReal c * Real.toNNReal c⁻¹ = 1 := by
          rw [← Real.toNNReal_mul hc.le, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc.ne', Real.toNNReal_one]
        change ((Real.toNNReal c : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) *
            ((Real.toNNReal c⁻¹ * δ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) = δ
        rw [← ENNReal.coe_mul, ← mul_assoc, h, one_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_scale_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_scale_eq_top_iff (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    realInterleavingDistance (PModule.scale c hc M) (PModule.scale c hc N) = ⊤ ↔
      realInterleavingDistance M N = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [realInterleavingDistance_scale c hc M N]
  simp [ENNReal.mul_eq_top, (ENNReal.ofReal_pos.2 hc).ne', ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionExamples.zeroIdRankExact
proof:
:= by
  have hshort : IsPointwiseShortExact (0 : zeroModule ⟶ Q) (𝟙 Q) := by
    constructor
    · intro p x y _
      exact (ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)).elim x y
    · intro p x
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    · intro p
      simp
  exact hshort.rankExact_of_section (𝟙 Q) (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionExamples.idZeroRankExact
proof:
:= by
  have hshort : IsPointwiseShortExact (𝟙 Q) (0 : Q ⟶ zeroModule) := by
    constructor
    · intro _ x y h
      exact h
    · intro p y
      have hzero : Subsingleton (zeroModule.obj p) :=
        ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)
      exact ⟨0, hzero.elim _ _⟩
    · intro p
      simp
  exact hshort.rankExact_of_section (0 : zeroModule ⟶ Q) (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionExamples.nonzeroHook_birth_rank
statement:
private theorem nonzeroHook_birth_rank :

  rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionExamples.oneTermRows

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolutionExamples.contractibleRows

  · change IsRankExact (𝟙 nonzeroHook) (0 : nonzeroHook ⟶ zeroModule)
    exact idZeroRankExact nonzeroHook
  · intro j

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE (p : S) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE
      ((FiniteRankProjectiveHomExact.homFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).obj
        (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module p)) (complementCard p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h := FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_length
    (resolution (k := k) p)
  rw [resolution_length] at h
  have he : max 1 (complementCard p) = (complementCard p - 1) + 1 := by omega
  rw [he] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankDimension.termAt_isZero

proof:
:=
  (FiniteRankProjectiveHomDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_iff R _).mp
    (hasProjectiveDimensionLE p) j hj

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_isometric_totallyBounded
statement:
private theorem hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_isometric_totallyBounded
    {X Y : Type u} {Z : Type v}
    [MetricSpace X] [MetricSpace Y] [MetricSpace Z]
    [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y]
    {f : X → Z} {g : Y → Z} (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g)
    (hX : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X))
    (hY : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set Y)) :
    Metric.hausdorffEDist (Set.range f) (Set.range g) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hfrange : Set.range f = f '' Set.univ := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨x, Set.mem_univ x, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨x, _, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have hgrange : Set.range g = g '' Set.univ := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨y, Set.mem_univ y, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, _, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
  have hfb : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range f) := by
    rw [hfrange]
    exact hf.lipschitz.isBounded_image hX.isBounded
  have hgb : Bornology.IsBounded (Set.range g) := by
    rw [hgrange]
    exact hg.lipschitz.isBounded_image hY.isBounded
  exact Metric.hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded
    (range_nonempty f) (range_nonempty g) hfb hgb

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.contentMultiplicity_eq_of_values_eq
statement:
private theorem contentMultiplicity_eq_of_values_eq
    {X : Type*} {C : Set (Set X)} {m₁ m₂ : AddContent ℕ C}
    (hval : ∀ U ∈ C, m₁ U = m₂ U) (x : X) :
    contentMultiplicity m₁ x = contentMultiplicity m₂ x
proof:
:= by
  unfold contentMultiplicity
  congr 1
  ext n
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨U, hU, hxU, hn⟩
    exact ⟨U, hU, hxU, (hval U hU).symm.trans hn⟩
  · rintro ⟨U, hU, hxU, hn⟩
    exact ⟨U, hU, hxU, (hval U hU).trans hn⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.persistenceMeasureValue_eq_of_interleavingIso
statement:
private theorem persistenceMeasureValue_eq_of_interleavingIso
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {M N : PModule k ℝ}
    (e : M ≅ N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame)
    {a b c d : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbc : b < c) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    persistenceMeasureValue M hab hbc.le hcd =
      persistenceMeasureValue N hab hbc.le hcd
proof:
:= by
  let i := RealInterleaving.ofIso e
  have hMN := i.persistenceMeasureValue_box_le_of_qTame hN hab hcd
    (by simpa using (sub_pos.mpr hbc))
  have hNM := i.symm.persistenceMeasureValue_box_le_of_qTame hM hab hcd
    (by simpa using (sub_pos.mpr hbc))
  exact le_antisymm (by simpa using hMN) (by simpa using hNM)

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.essentialMeasureValue_eq_of_interleavingIso
statement:
private theorem essentialMeasureValue_eq_of_interleavingIso
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {M N : PModule k ℝ}
    (e : M ≅ N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    essentialMeasureValue M hab = essentialMeasureValue N hab
proof:
:= by
  let i := RealInterleaving.ofIso e
  have hMN := i.essentialMeasureValue_box_le_of_qTame hN hab
  have hNM := i.symm.essentialMeasureValue_box_le_of_qTame hM hab
  exact le_antisymm (by simpa using hMN) (by simpa using hNM)

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.moduleRectangleValue_eq_of_interleavingIso
statement:
private theorem moduleRectangleValue_eq_of_interleavingIso
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {M N : PModule k ℝ}
    (e : M ≅ N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame)
    (U : Set (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ)) :
    moduleRectangleValue M U = moduleRectangleValue N U
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hU : U = ∅
  · simp [moduleRectangleValue, hU]
  · simp only [moduleRectangleValue, if_neg hU]
    let I := rectangleCellBox U
    by_cases hsep : I.upper 0 < I.lower 1
    · rw [persistenceBoxValue_of_separated M I hsep,
        persistenceBoxValue_of_separated N I hsep]
      have hMN := (RealInterleaving.ofIso e).persistenceMeasureValue_box_le_of_qTame
        hN (I.lower_lt_upper 0).le (I.lower_lt_upper 1).le
        (by simpa using (sub_pos.mpr hsep))
      have hNM := (RealInterleaving.ofIso e).symm.persistenceMeasureValue_box_le_of_qTame
        hM (I.lower_lt_upper 0).le (I.lower_lt_upper 1).le
        (by simpa using (sub_pos.mpr hsep))
      exact le_antisymm (by simpa using hMN) (by simpa using hNM)
    · simp [persistenceBoxValue, I, hsep]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_of_interleavingIso
statement:
private theorem moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_of_interleavingIso
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {M N : PModule k ℝ}
    (e : M ≅ N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame)
    (p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) :
    moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p = moduleDiagramMultiplicity N hN p
proof:
:= by
  apply contentMultiplicity_eq_of_values_eq
  intro U hU
  change moduleRectangleValue M U = moduleRectangleValue N U
  exact moduleRectangleValue_eq_of_interleavingIso e hM hN U

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.moduleEssentialMultiplicity_eq_of_interleavingIso
statement:
private theorem moduleEssentialMultiplicity_eq_of_interleavingIso
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {M N : PModule k ℝ}
    (e : M ≅ N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame)
    (birth : Cut ℝ) :
    moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM birth = moduleEssentialMultiplicity N hN birth
proof:
:= by
  apply contentMultiplicity_eq_of_values_eq
  intro U hU
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := hU
  rw [essentialCutContent_apply M hM hab, essentialCutContent_apply N hN hab]
  exact essentialMeasureValue_eq_of_interleavingIso e hM hN hab

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.ofQModule_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem ofQModule_eq_of_iso
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {M N : PModule k ℝ}
    (e : M ≅ N) (hM : M.QTame) (hN : N.QTame) :
    LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hM =
      LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule hN
proof:
:= by
  apply LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ext
  funext p
  by_cases hInf : p.2 = infinityCut
  · have hess := moduleEssentialMultiplicity_eq_of_interleavingIso e hM hN p.1
    simp [LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule, moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity,
      hInf, hess]
  · have hfin := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_of_interleavingIso e hM hN p
    simp [LocallyFiniteDecoratedDiagram.ofQModule, moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity,
      hInf, hfin]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_eq_of_isometryEquiv
statement:
theorem qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_eq_of_isometryEquiv
    {X Y : Type u} [LinearOrder X] [MetricSpace X]
    [LinearOrder Y] [MetricSpace Y]
    (k : Type v) [Field k] (e : X ≃ᵢ Y)
    (hX : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X))
    (hY : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set Y)) (n : ℕ) :
    qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := X) k hX n =
      qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := Y) k hY n
proof:
:= by
  exact ofQModule_eq_of_iso
    (sublevelModuleIsoOfIsometryEquiv (X := X) k e n)
    (qTame_of_totallyBounded k hX n) (qTame_of_totallyBounded k hY n)

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_le_of_hausdorffDist
statement:
theorem qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_le_of_hausdorffDist
    {X Y : Type u} {Z : Type v}
    [LinearOrder X] [MetricSpace X] [Nonempty X]
    [LinearOrder Y] [MetricSpace Y] [Nonempty Y] [MetricSpace Z]
    {f : X → Z} {g : Y → Z} (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g)
    (hX : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X))
    (hY : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set Y))
    (k : Type z) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := X) k hX n).bottleneck
      (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := Y) k hY n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * Metric.hausdorffDist (Set.range f) (Set.range g))
proof:
:= by
  let δ : ℝ≥0 := ⟨2 * Metric.hausdorffDist (Set.range f) (Set.range g),
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hausdorffDist_nonneg⟩
  have hfin := hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_isometric_totallyBounded hf hg hX hY
  calc
    _ ≤ (δ : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      apply ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add
      intro η hη _
      have hε : 2 * Metric.hausdorffDist (Set.range f) (Set.range g) <
          ((δ + η : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
        change 2 * Metric.hausdorffDist (Set.range f) (Set.range g) <
          2 * Metric.hausdorffDist (Set.range f) (Set.range g) + (η : ℝ)
        exact lt_add_of_pos_right _ hη
      simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal, ENNReal.coe_add] using
        (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_le_of_hausdorff_lt
          hf hg hfin hε hX hY k n)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq δ]
      rw [show (δ : ℝ) = 2 * Metric.hausdorffDist (Set.range f) (Set.range g) by rfl]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_le_two_mul_ghDist
statement:
theorem qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_le_two_mul_ghDist
    {X Y : Type u}
    [LinearOrder X] [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [Nonempty X]
    [LinearOrder Y] [MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
    (k : Type v) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := X) k
        (isCompact_univ.totallyBounded : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X)) n).bottleneck
      (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := Y) k
        (isCompact_univ.totallyBounded : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set Y)) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * ghDist X Y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [hausdorffDist_optimal] using
    qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_le_of_hausdorffDist
      (isometry_optimalGHInjl X Y) (isometry_optimalGHInjr X Y)
      (isCompact_univ.totallyBounded : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set X))
      (isCompact_univ.totallyBounded : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set Y)) k n

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.tendsto_qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_of_hausdorffDist_tendsto_zero
statement:
theorem tendsto_qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_of_hausdorffDist_tendsto_zero
    (k : Type w) [Field k] {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι}
    (X : ι → Type u) (Y : Type u) {Z : Type v}
    [∀ i, Fintype (X i)] [∀ i, LinearOrder (X i)]
    [LinearOrder Y] [MetricSpace Y] [Nonempty Y]
    [∀ i, MetricSpace (X i)] [∀ i, Nonempty (X i)] [MetricSpace Z]
    {f : ∀ i, X i → Z} {g : Y → Z}
    (hf : ∀ i, Isometry (f i)) (hg : Isometry g)
    (hY : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set Y))
    (h : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun i => Metric.hausdorffDist (Set.range (f i)) (Set.range g)) l (𝓝 0))
    (n : ℕ) :
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun i =>
        (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := X i) k
          (Set.finite_univ.totallyBounded : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set (X i))) n).bottleneck
          (qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram (X := Y) k hY n))
      l (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun i => ENNReal.ofReal
        (2 * Metric.hausdorffDist (Set.range (f i)) (Set.range g))) l (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [mul_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using
      ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal (h.const_mul 2)
  exact tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds hlim
    (fun _ => bot_le) (fun i => by
      exact qTameLocallyFiniteDiagram_bottleneck_le_of_hausdorffDist
        (hf i) hg
        (Set.finite_univ.totallyBounded : TotallyBounded (Set.univ : Set (X i)))
        hY k n)

name: TDA.Persistence.isZero_simplicialHomology_of_isEmpty_face

    have h1 := hK σ.1 σ.2.1
