name: TDA.Persistence.mem_logCriticalValues
statement:
theorem mem_logCriticalValues (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    x ∈ logCriticalValues f ↔
      ∃ σ : TotalFace K, 0 < f.value σ ∧ Real.log (f.value σ) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [logCriticalValues, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter,
    FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, ⟨⟨σ, rfl⟩, hc⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨σ, hc, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨⟨σ, rfl⟩, hσ⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.logGrid_mem
statement:
theorem logGrid_mem (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (i : Fin (logCriticalValues f).card) :
    logGrid f i ∈ logCriticalValues f
proof:
:=
  Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ rfl i

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_logGrid_eq
statement:
theorem exists_logGrid_eq (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (σ : TotalFace K) (hσ : 0 < f.value σ) :
    ∃ i, logGrid f i = Real.log (f.value σ)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : Real.log (f.value σ) ∈ Set.range (logGrid f) := by
    rw [logGrid, Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
    exact (mem_logCriticalValues f _).2 ⟨σ, hσ, rfl⟩
  exact hmem

name: TDA.Persistence.exp_logGrid_mem
statement:
theorem exp_logGrid_mem (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (i : Fin (logCriticalValues f).card) :
    Real.exp (logGrid f i) ∈ f.criticalValues ∧ 0 < Real.exp (logGrid f i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, hσ, hlog⟩ := (mem_logCriticalValues f _).1 (logGrid_mem f i)
  refine ⟨?_, Real.exp_pos _⟩
  rw [← hlog, Real.exp_log hσ]
  exact (f.mem_criticalValues _).2 ⟨σ, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevel_exp_eq_of_cellIndex_eq
statement:
theorem sublevel_exp_eq_of_cellIndex_eq (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t)
    (h : cellIndex (logGrid f) s = cellIndex (logGrid f) t) :
    f.sublevel (Real.exp s) = f.sublevel (Real.exp t)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (f.sublevel_mono (Real.exp_le_exp.2 hst))
  intro σ hσ
  obtain ⟨hσK, hσt⟩ := (f.mem_sublevel_iff _ σ).1 hσ
  refine (f.mem_sublevel_iff _ σ).2 ⟨hσK, ?_⟩
  rcases le_or_gt (f.value ⟨σ, hσK⟩) 0 with hv | hv
  · exact hv.trans (Real.exp_pos s).le
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_logGrid_eq f ⟨σ, hσK⟩ hv
    have hit : i.val < (cellIndex (logGrid f) t).val :=
      (lt_cellIndex_iff _ i t).2 (hi ▸ (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hv).2 hσt)
    rw [← h] at hit
    have his := (lt_cellIndex_iff _ i s).1 hit
    rw [hi] at his
    exact (Real.log_le_iff_le_exp hv).1 his

name: TDA.Persistence.card_le_one_of_mem_sublevel_exp
statement:
theorem card_le_one_of_mem_sublevel_exp {f : FilterFunction K ℝ} (hf : PositiveOnEdges f)
    {t : ℝ} (ht : ∀ i, t < logGrid f i) : ∀ s ∈ f.sublevel (Real.exp t), s.card ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsK, hst⟩ := (f.mem_sublevel_iff _ s).1 hs
  by_contra hcard
  have hv := hf ⟨s, hsK⟩ (show 2 ≤ s.card by omega)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := exists_logGrid_eq f ⟨s, hsK⟩ hv
  have hti := ht i
  rw [hi, Real.lt_log_iff_exp_lt hv] at hti
  exact absurd hst (not_le.2 hti)

name: TDA.Persistence.logModule_isConstructible
statement:
theorem logModule_isConstructible {f : FilterFunction K ℝ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hf : PositiveOnEdges f) : IsConstructible (logGrid f) (logModule R f n) where
  zero_left t ht
proof:
:= by
    change IsZero (simplicialHomology (f.sublevel (Real.exp t)) R n)
    exact isZero_simplicialHomology_of_card_le_one R (card_le_one_of_mem_sublevel_exp hf ht) hn
  isIso_map s t hst h :=
    isIso_simplicialHomologyIncl_of_eq R (sublevel_exp_eq_of_cellIndex_eq f hst h)
      (f.sublevel_mono (Real.exp_le_exp.2 hst)) n

name: TDA.Persistence.logModule_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem logModule_finiteDimensional (n : ℕ) (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    FiniteDimensional k ((logModule k f n).obj t)
proof:
:= by
  change FiniteDimensional k (simplicialHomology (f.sublevel (Real.exp t)) k n)
  let _ : Finite (Face K n) := faceFiniteOfTotalFinite K n
  let _ : Finite (Face (f.sublevel (Real.exp t)) n) :=
    Finite.of_injective (faceIncl (f.sublevel_le _) n) (by
      intro a b hab
      exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun s : Face K n => s.1) hab))
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_logDgm_eq_realInterleavingDistance
statement:
theorem bottleneck_logDgm_eq_realInterleavingDistance {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    {f g : FilterFunction K ℝ} (hf : PositiveOnEdges f) (hg : PositiveOnEdges g) :
    bottleneck (logDgm k f n) (logDgm k g n) =
      realInterleavingDistance (logModule k f n) (logModule k g n)
proof:
:=
  bottleneck_eq_distance (logModule_isConstructible k n hn hf)
    (logModule_isConstructible k n hn hg) _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_logDgm_le_log
statement:
theorem bottleneck_logDgm_le_log {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {f g : FilterFunction K ℝ} {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hgf : ∀ s, g.value s ≤ f.value s) (hfc : ∀ s, f.value s ≤ c * g.value s)
    (hg : PositiveOnEdges g) :
    bottleneck (logDgm k f n) (logDgm k g n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_logDgm_eq_realInterleavingDistance k hn (hg.of_le hgf) hg]
  exact realInterleavingDistance_log_le k n hc hgf hfc

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_logDgm_rips_cech_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_logDgm_rips_cech_le [Fintype V] (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    bottleneck (logDgm k (Rips.filter d) n) (logDgm k (Cech.filter p) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log 2)
proof:
:=
  bottleneck_logDgm_le_log k hn one_le_two (Cech.filter_value_le_rips d p hd)
    (Cech.rips_le_two_mul_filter_value d p hd) (positiveOnEdges_cech d p hd)

name: TDA.Persistence.not_isConstructible_logModule_zero
statement:
theorem not_isConstructible_logModule_zero (k : Type v) [Field k] {m : ℕ} (c : Fin m ↪o ℝ)
    {f : FilterFunction K ℝ} (σ : TotalFace K) (hσ : σ.val.card = 1) (hfσ : f.value σ ≤ 0) :
    ¬ IsConstructible c (logModule k f 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro hM
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t : ℝ, ∀ i, t < c i := by
    cases m with
    | zero => exact ⟨0, fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩
    | succ m' =>
      exact ⟨c 0 - 1, fun i => by
        have := c.monotone (Fin.zero_le i)
        linarith⟩
  have hz : IsZero (simplicialHomology (f.sublevel (Real.exp t)) k 0) := hM.zero_left t ht
  have hσL : σ.val ∈ f.sublevel (Real.exp t) :=
    (f.mem_sublevel_iff _ _).2 ⟨σ.2, hfσ.trans (Real.exp_pos t).le⟩
  let τ : Face (f.sublevel (Real.exp t)) 0 := ⟨σ.val, hσL, hσ⟩
  let _ : Finite (TotalFace (f.sublevel (Real.exp t))) :=
    Finite.of_injective (fun s : TotalFace (f.sublevel (Real.exp t)) =>
      (⟨s.1, f.sublevel_le _ s.2⟩ : TotalFace K)) (by
        intro a b hab
        exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun s : TotalFace K => s.1) hab))
  have hpos := finrank_homologyIncl_range_pos_of_vertex (f.sublevel (Real.exp t)) k
    (le_refl (f.sublevel (Real.exp t))) τ
  have h0 : simplicialHomologyIncl k (le_refl (f.sublevel (Real.exp t))) 0 = 0 :=
    hz.eq_of_src _ _
  rw [h0, ModuleCat.hom_zero, LinearMap.range_zero, finrank_bot] at hpos
  exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.bottleneck_dgm_lt_top
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_lt_top (p q : V → X) (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n) < ⊤
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement k p q n).trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement
statement:
theorem toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement (p q : V → X) (n : ℕ) :
    (bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)).toReal ≤
      Cech.displacement p q
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Cech.displacement_nonneg p q)] using
    ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top (bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement k p q n)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_displacement
statement:
theorem norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_displacement (p q : V → X) (n : ℕ)
    (σ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Cech.displacement p q
proof:
:=
  (WeightedKernel.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ hA hB w _ _
    (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (bottleneck_dgm_lt_top k p q n)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement k p q n)
        (mul_nonneg (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_displacement
statement:
theorem norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_displacement (p q : V → X) (n : ℕ)
    (σ τ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramGaussianFeature σ τ w (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Cech.displacement p q
proof:
:=
  (WeightedKernel.norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ τ hA hB w _ _
    (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (bottleneck_dgm_lt_top k p q n)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement k p q n)
        (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB)
          (abs_nonneg τ)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_displacement
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_displacement (p q : V → X) (n : ℕ)
    (σ τ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    |WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ w D (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)| ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Cech.displacement p q
proof:
:=
  (WeightedKernel.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck σ τ hA hB w D _ _
    (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (bottleneck_dgm_lt_top k p q n)).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (toReal_bottleneck_dgm_le_displacement k p q n)
        (mul_nonneg (div_nonneg (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB)
          (abs_nonneg τ)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_displacement_arctan
statement:
theorem norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_displacement_arctan (p q : V → X) (n : ℕ) (σ : ℝ)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)
          (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)
          (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Cech.displacement p q
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_displacement k p q n σ hC Real.pi_div_two_pos.le
      (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_displacement_arctan
statement:
theorem abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_displacement_arctan (p q : V → X) (n : ℕ)
    (σ τ : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    |WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) D
          (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.gaussianDiagramKernel σ τ (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) D
          (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)| ≤
      (2 * C + √2 * π / (2 * |σ|)) / |τ| *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Cech.displacement p q
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le_displacement k p q n σ τ hC Real.pi_div_two_pos.le
      (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC) D

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.inclusion_projection
proof:
:=
  biproduct.ι_π_self _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.encode_birth
statement:
@[simp] theorem encode_birth (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) (a : S) (x : M.obj a) :
    (((inclusion (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ encode M a x).app a).hom
      (HookInfinity.birth a)) = x
proof:
:= by
  change (((inclusion (k := k) (S := S) a ≫
      (projection (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ HookInfinity.fromBirth a M x)).app a).hom
      (HookInfinity.birth a)) = x
  rw [← Category.assoc, inclusion_projection, Category.id_comp]
  exact HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth a M x

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.encode_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem encode_zero (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) (a : S) :
    encode M a 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : HookInfinity.fromBirth a M 0 = 0 := by
    apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
    simp
  simp [encode, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.encode_birth_generator
statement:
theorem encode_birth_generator (a : S) :
    inclusion (k := k) (S := S) a ≫
      encode (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) a (HookInfinity.birth a) =
        𝟙 (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a)
proof:
:= by
  apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
  exact encode_birth (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) a (HookInfinity.birth a)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.encode_add
statement:
private theorem encode_add (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) (a : S)
    (x y : M.obj a) : encode M a (x + y) = encode M a x + encode M a y
proof:
:= by
  have h : HookInfinity.fromBirth a M (x + y) =
      HookInfinity.fromBirth a M x + HookInfinity.fromBirth a M y := by
    apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
    simp
  simp [encode, h, Preadditive.comp_add]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.encode_smul
statement:
private theorem encode_smul (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) (a : S)
    (r : k) (x : M.obj a) : encode M a (r • x) = r • encode M a x
proof:
:= by
  have h : HookInfinity.fromBirth a M (r • x) =
      r • HookInfinity.fromBirth a M x := by
    apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
    simp
  simp [encode, h, Linear.comp_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.scalar_as_end_action
statement:
private theorem scalar_as_end_action (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    (r : k) (g : L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ M) :
    (MulOpposite.op (r • (𝟙 (L (k := k) (S := S)))) : E (k := k) (S := S)) • g =
      r • g
proof:
:= by
  change (r • 𝟙 (L (k := k) (S := S))) ≫ g = r • g
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.map_scalar
statement:
private theorem map_scalar (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    (T : (L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ M) →ₗ[E (k := k) (S := S)]
      (L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ N)) (r : k)
    (g : L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ M) : T (r • g) = r • T g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← scalar_as_end_action M r g, map_smul, scalar_as_end_action N r (T g)]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.evaluate
statement:
private theorem evaluate (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    (T : (L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ M) →ₗ[E (k := k) (S := S)]
      (L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ N))
    (g : L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ M) (a : S) (x : (L (k := k) (S := S)).obj a) :
    ((T g).app a).hom x =
      fiberMap M N T a ((g.app a).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  let u : HookInfinity.module (R := k) a ⟶ L (k := k) (S := S) :=
    HookInfinity.fromBirth a (L (k := k) (S := S)) x
  let e : End (L (k := k) (S := S)) :=
    projection (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ u
  have hu : u ≫ g = HookInfinity.fromBirth a M ((g.app a).hom x) := by
    apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
    simp [u]
  have h1 : e ≫ g = encode M a ((g.app a).hom x) := by
    simpa [e, encode, Category.assoc] using
      congrArg (fun v : HookInfinity.module (R := k) a ⟶ M =>
        projection (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ v) hu
  have h2 : T (e ≫ g) = e ≫ T g := by
    exact T.map_smul (MulOpposite.op e) g
  have h3 := congrArg
    (fun f : L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ N =>
      (((inclusion (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ f).app a).hom
        (HookInfinity.birth a))) (h1 ▸ h2)
  have heval :
      (((inclusion (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ e ≫ T g).app a).hom
        (HookInfinity.birth a)) = ((T g).app a).hom x := by
    have hie : inclusion (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ e = u := by
      change inclusion (k := k) (S := S) a ≫
        (projection (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ u) = u
      rw [← Category.assoc, inclusion_projection, Category.id_comp]
    rw [← Category.assoc, hie]
    simp [u]
  exact heval.symm.trans h3.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.preimage_app
statement:
theorem preimage_app (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    (T : (L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ M) →ₗ[E (k := k) (S := S)]
      (L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ N)) (a : S) (x : M.obj a) :
    ((preimage M N T).app a).hom x =
      (((inclusion (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ T (encode M a x)).app a).hom
        (HookInfinity.birth a))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.postcompose_preimage
statement:
@[simp] theorem postcompose_preimage (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    (T : (L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ M) →ₗ[E (k := k) (S := S)]
      (L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ N)) :
    postcompose (k := k) (S := S) (preimage M N T) = T
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro g
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  exact (evaluate M N T g a x).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.preimage_postcompose
statement:
@[simp] theorem preimage_postcompose (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    (f : M ⟶ N) :
    preimage M N (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) f) = f
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change (f.app a).hom
    (((inclusion (k := k) (S := S) a ≫ encode M a x).app a).hom
      (HookInfinity.birth a)) = (f.app a).hom x
  rw [encode_birth]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomFullyFaithful.rankProjective_iff_homProjective
statement:
theorem rankProjective_iff_homProjective (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    (hfd : ∀ a, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj a)) :
    IsRankProjective M ↔
      Module.Projective (E (k := k) (S := S))
        (L (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ M)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact FiniteRankProjectiveHomProjective.hom_from_hookSum_isProjective M hfd h
  · intro h A B C ι π hs α
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective
        (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) π) :=
      (rankExact_iff_postcompose_surjective (k := k) (S := S)
        hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact hs.finiteDimensional).mp hs
    obtain ⟨lift, hlift⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property (h := h)
      (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) π)
      (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) α) hsurj
    let β : M ⟶ B := preimage M B lift
    refine ⟨β, ?_⟩
    have hmap : postcompose (k := k) (S := S) (β ≫ π) =
        postcompose (k := k) (S := S) α := by
      rw [postcompose_comp, show postcompose (k := k) (S := S) β = lift from
        postcompose_preimage M B lift]
      exact hlift
    calc
      β ≫ π = preimage M C (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) (β ≫ π)) :=
        (preimage_postcompose M C (β ≫ π)).symm
      _ = preimage M C (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) α) := congrArg _ hmap
      _ = α := preimage_postcompose M C α

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.gridOrigin_lt_top

    norm_num

    norm_num [gridOrigin, gridTop] at h0

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.finiteHook_finitelyPresented

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.infinityHook_finitelyPresented

proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.nonzero_finite_hook_classifies
statement:
theorem nonzero_finite_hook_classifies :
    (∃ x : (Hook.module (k := ℚ) birth death).obj birth, x ≠ 0) ∧
      ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ t : Fin m → RankProjectiveHookTag P,
        Nonempty (Hook.module (k := ℚ) birth death ≅
          ⨁ fun i => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) (t i))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨SupportInterval.one (Hook.support birth death)
      (Hook.birth_mem birth_lt_death), ?_⟩
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
    simp [SupportInterval.one] at hv
  · exact (GradedFree.finitelyPresented_rankProjective_iff_exists_hook_sum
      (k := ℚ) (n := 1) (M := Hook.module (k := ℚ) birth death)
      finiteHook_finitelyPresented).mp
        (Hook.isRankProjective birth_lt_death)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.unbounded_principal_upset_classifies
statement:
theorem unbounded_principal_upset_classifies :
    (∀ r : P, ∃ a : P, r ≤ a ∧
      ∃ x : (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) birth).obj a, x ≠ 0) ∧
      ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ t : Fin m → RankProjectiveHookTag P,
        Nonempty (HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) birth ≅
          ⨁ fun i => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) (t i))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro r
    let a : P := fun i => max (birth i) (r i)
    have hba : birth ≤ a := by
      intro i
      exact le_max_left _ _
    have hra : r ≤ a := by
      intro i
      exact le_max_right _ _
    let e := HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := ℚ) hba
    refine ⟨a, hra, e.symm 1, ?_⟩
    intro hx
    have hone := congrArg e hx
    exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℚ) ≠ 0) (by simpa using hone)
  · exact (GradedFree.finitelyPresented_rankProjective_iff_exists_hook_sum
      (k := ℚ) (n := 1) (M := HookInfinity.module (R := ℚ) birth)
      infinityHook_finitelyPresented).mp
        (HookInfinity.isRankProjective birth)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.reordered_mixed_hook_sum_preserves_every_multiplicity
statement:
theorem reordered_mixed_hook_sum_preserves_every_multiplicity
    (c : RankProjectiveHookTag P) :
    Fintype.card {i : Fin 3 // mixedHookTags i = c} =
      Fintype.card {i : Fin 3 // mixedHookTags (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1 i) = c}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let σ : Fin 3 ≃ Fin 3 := Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 3) 1
  let reordered : Fin 3 → RankProjectiveHookTag P := fun i => mixedHookTags (σ i)
  have hReordered : (fun i : Fin 3 =>
      rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) (reordered i)) =
      (fun i : Fin 3 => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) (mixedHookTags i)) ∘ σ := by
    funext i
    rfl
  have e : (⨁ fun i : Fin 3 =>
      rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) (mixedHookTags i)) ≅
      ⨁ fun i : Fin 3 => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) (reordered i) := by
    simpa only [hReordered] using
      (biproduct.reindex σ
        (fun i : Fin 3 => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) (mixedHookTags i))).symm
  simpa [σ, reordered] using
    GradedFree.rankProjectiveHookSum_multiplicity_unique_of_iso
      (k := ℚ) (n := 1) mixedHookTags reordered ⟨e⟩ c

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.empty_hook_sums_have_equal_every_multiplicity
statement:
theorem empty_hook_sums_have_equal_every_multiplicity
    (c : RankProjectiveHookTag P) :
    Fintype.card {i : Fin 0 // (Fin.elim0 i : RankProjectiveHookTag P) = c} =
      Fintype.card {i : Fin 0 // (Fin.elim0 i : RankProjectiveHookTag P) = c}
proof:
:= by
  exact GradedFree.rankProjectiveHookSum_multiplicity_unique_of_iso
    (k := ℚ) (n := 1) Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 ⟨Iso.refl
      (⨁ fun i : Fin 0 => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ)
        (Fin.elim0 i : RankProjectiveHookTag P))⟩ c

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.repeatedFiniteHook_finitelyPresented
proof:
:= by
  let A : Fin 2 → PModule ℚ grid.Point := fun _ =>
    Hook.module (k := ℚ) gridOrigin gridTop
  have hA : FinitelyPresented (R := ℚ) (P := grid.Point) (⨁ A) :=
    GradedFree.pfd_finitelyPresented_of_finite_poset (⨁ A) (by
      intro p
      letI : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional ℚ ((A i).obj p) := by
        intro i
        dsimp [A]
        infer_instance
      letI : FiniteDimensional ℚ (∀ i, (A i).obj p) := by
        infer_instance
      exact (FiniteBiproduct.fiberIsoPi A p).symm.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional)
  have hLan : FinitelyPresented (R := ℚ) (P := P) (grid.lan.obj (⨁ A)) :=

  have e : grid.lan.obj (⨁ A) ≅
      ⨁ fun _ : Fin 2 => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) finiteTag := by
    simpa [A, finiteTag, rankProjectiveHookModule, birth, death] using

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.repeated_finite_hook_classifies
statement:
theorem repeated_finite_hook_classifies :
    IsRankProjective (⨁ fun _ : Fin 2 => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) finiteTag) ∧
      ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ t : Fin m → RankProjectiveHookTag P,
        Nonempty ((⨁ fun _ : Fin 2 => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) finiteTag) ≅
          ⨁ fun i => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) (t i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : PModule ℚ P :=
    ⨁ fun _ : Fin 2 => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) finiteTag
  let C := GradedFree.finitelyPresented_rankProjective_iff_exists_hook_sum
    (k := ℚ) (n := 1) (M := M) repeatedFiniteHook_finitelyPresented
  have hRP := C.mpr ⟨2, fun _ : Fin 2 => finiteTag, ⟨Iso.refl M⟩⟩
  exact ⟨hRP, C.mp hRP⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.zero_finitelyPresented
statement:
private theorem zero_finitelyPresented :
    FinitelyPresented.{0,0,0} (R := ℚ) (P := P) (0 : PModule.{0,0,0} ℚ P)
proof:
:= by
  let W : GradedGenerators.{0,0} P := ⟨Empty, Empty.elim⟩
  letI : Finite W.Carrier := inferInstanceAs (Finite Empty)
  have hz : IsZero (GradedFree.module (R := ℚ) W : PModule.{0,0,0} ℚ P) := by
    apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
    apply GradedFree.hom_ext_birth W
    intro g
    exact g.elim
  have hfree : FinitelyPresented.{0,0,0} (R := ℚ) (P := P)
      (GradedFree.module (R := ℚ) W) := GradedFree.free_finitelyPresented W
  exact GradedFree.finitelyPresented_of_iso hfree hz.isoZero

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.emptyTaggedSum_isZero
statement:
private theorem emptyTaggedSum_isZero (t : Fin 0 → RankProjectiveHookTag P) :
    IsZero (⨁ fun i : Fin 0 => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) (t i))
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
  apply biproduct.hom_ext'
  intro i
  exact Fin.elim0 i

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationRankProjectiveClassification.Examples.zero_empty_tagged_sum_classifies
statement:
theorem zero_empty_tagged_sum_classifies :
    IsRankProjective (0 : PModule ℚ P) ∧
      ∃ t : Fin 0 → RankProjectiveHookTag P,
        Nonempty ((0 : PModule ℚ P) ≅
          ⨁ fun i => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) (t i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have ezero : IsZero (0 : PModule ℚ P) := isZero_zero _
  let t : Fin 0 → RankProjectiveHookTag P := Fin.elim0
  let e : (0 : PModule ℚ P) ≅
      ⨁ fun i : Fin 0 => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := ℚ) (t i) :=
    ezero.isoZero ≪≫ (emptyTaggedSum_isZero t).isoZero.symm
  have hRP := (GradedFree.finitelyPresented_rankProjective_iff_exists_hook_sum
    (k := ℚ) (n := 1) (M := (0 : PModule ℚ P))
    zero_finitelyPresented).mpr ⟨0, Fin.elim0, ⟨e⟩⟩
  exact ⟨hRP, t, ⟨e⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.finiteDimensional_sample
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_sample (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    FiniteDimensional k ((sample c M).obj j)
proof:
:= by
  cases j using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
    have : Subsingleton ((sample c M).obj 0) :=
      ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp (isZero_zero (ModuleCat k))
    infer_instance
  | succ i => exact hfd i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.rankBarcode_birth_pos
statement:
theorem rankBarcode_birth_pos (A : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin (n + 1)))
    [∀ j, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj j)] (hzero : IsZero (A.obj 0))
    (I : FiniteInterval (n + 1)) (hI : I ∈ rankBarcode A) : 0 < I.birth
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have : Subsingleton (A.obj 0) := ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hzero
  have hr : structureMapRank A 0 0 le_rfl = 0 := by
    change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (structureMapLinear A (show (0 : Fin (n + 1)) ≤ 0 from le_rfl))) = 0
    exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
  have hc := (structureMapRank_rankBarcode (M := A) 0 0 le_rfl).trans hr
  rw [rank_barcodeMap] at hc
  change (rankBarcode A).countP (fun J => J.birth ≤ 0 ∧ 0 < J.death) = 0 at hc
  have hn := (Multiset.countP_eq_zero.mp hc) I hI
  have := I.birth_lt_death
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sampleBarcode_birth_pos
statement:
theorem sampleBarcode_birth_pos (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i)))
    (I : FiniteInterval (n + 1)) (hI : I ∈ sampleBarcode c M hfd) : 0 < I.birth
proof:
:= by
  have hSampleFD : ∀ j, FiniteDimensional k ((sample c M).obj j) :=
    finiteDimensional_sample c M hfd
  exact rankBarcode_birth_pos (sample c M) (isZero_zero (ModuleCat k)) I hI

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sampleBarcode_empty_grid
statement:
theorem sampleBarcode_empty_grid (c : Fin 0 ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ) :
    sampleBarcode c M (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiset.eq_zero_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro I hI
  have hb := sampleBarcode_birth_pos c M (fun i => Fin.elim0 i) I hI
  have := I.birth_lt_death
  have := I.death_le_size
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram_eq_reindex_sample
statement:
theorem moduleDiagram_eq_reindex_sample (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))) :
    moduleDiagram c M hfd = ofIndexBars c c.strictMono
      (reindexBarcode (Fin.succOrderEmb n).toOrderHom (sampleBarcode c M hfd))
proof:
:= by
  have hSampleFD : ∀ j, FiniteDimensional k ((sample c M).obj j) :=
    finiteDimensional_sample c M hfd
  have hCriticalFD : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k ((reindex c.toOrderHom M).obj i) := hfd
  unfold moduleDiagram sampleBarcode
  rw [← rankBarcode_reindex]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram_isPositive
statement:
theorem moduleDiagram_isPositive (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i))) : (moduleDiagram c M hfd).IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  rw [moduleDiagram_eq_reindex_sample]
  exact ofIndexBars_isPositive _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.moduleDiagram_empty_grid
statement:
theorem moduleDiagram_empty_grid (c : Fin 0 ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ) :
    (moduleDiagram c M (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [moduleDiagram_eq_reindex_sample, sampleBarcode_empty_grid]
  simp [reindexBarcode, ofIndexBars]

name: TDA.Persistence.shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso_hom_app
    (H : SimplicialFiltration ℝ Z) (ε δ : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso R H ε δ n).hom.app t =
      (simplicialHomologyPModule R H n).map (eqToHom (add_assoc t ε δ))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp
statement:
theorem shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp {f : X → Y} {g : Y → Z}
    (hf : IsShiftedSimplicial F G ε f) (hg : IsShiftedSimplicial G H δ g) (n : ℕ) :
    shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap R hf n ≫
      reindexNatTrans (OrderHomClass.toOrderHom (OrderIso.addRight ε))
        (shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap R hg n) ≫
      (shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso R H ε δ n).hom =
    shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap R (hf.comp hg) n
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  change simplicialHomologyMap R (hf.vertexMap t) n ≫
      simplicialHomologyMap R (hg.vertexMap (t + ε)) n ≫
      simplicialHomologyIncl R (H.monotone (le_of_eq (add_assoc t ε δ))) n =
    simplicialHomologyMap R ((hf.comp hg).vertexMap t) n
  rw [← simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion, ← simplicialHomologyMap_comp,
    ← simplicialHomologyMap_comp]
  exact congrArg (fun q => simplicialHomologyMap R q n) (VertexMap.ext (fun _ => rfl))

name: TDA.Persistence.shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp_app
statement:
theorem shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp_app {f : X → Y} {g : Y → Z}
    (hf : IsShiftedSimplicial F G ε f) (hg : IsShiftedSimplicial G H δ g) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap R hf n).app t ≫
      (shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap R hg n).app (t + ε) ≫
      (simplicialHomologyPModule R H n).map (eqToHom (add_assoc t ε δ)) =
    (shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap R (hf.comp hg) n).app t
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun q => q.app t) (shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp R hf hg n)

name: TDA.Persistence.comp_subordinate
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨x,z⟩ hxz
  change g (f x) = z at hxz
  subst z
  exact ⟨f x, hf rfl, hg rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp
statement:
theorem multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp {C : SetRel X Y} {D : SetRel Y Z}
    (hCT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hDT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun y z => (y,z) ∈ D))
    (hC : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G ε C)
    (hD : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation G H δ D) (n : ℕ) :
    multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R hCT hC n ≫
      reindexNatTrans (OrderHomClass.toOrderHom (OrderIso.addRight ε))
        (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R hDT hD n) ≫
      (shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso R H ε δ n).hom =
    multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R
      (Relator.LeftTotal.trans (r₁₃ := fun x z => (x,z) ∈ C.comp D)
        (fun _ y _ hxy hyz => ⟨y,hxy,hyz⟩) hCT hDT)
      (hC.comp hD) n
proof:
:= by
  let f : X → Y := fun x => Classical.choose (hCT x)
  let g : Y → Z := fun y => Classical.choose (hDT y)
  have hf : Function.graph f ⊆ C := by
    intro ⟨x,y⟩ hxy
    change f x = y at hxy
    rw [← hxy]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hCT x)
  have hg : Function.graph g ⊆ D := by
    intro ⟨y,z⟩ hyz
    change g y = z at hyz
    rw [← hyz]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hDT y)
  rw [multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_eq R hCT hC hf,
    multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_eq R hDT hD hg,
    multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_eq R _ (hC.comp hD) (comp_subordinate hf hg)]
  exact shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp R _ _ n

name: TDA.Persistence.multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp_app
statement:
theorem multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp_app {C : SetRel X Y} {D : SetRel Y Z}
    (hCT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hDT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun y z => (y,z) ∈ D))
    (hC : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G ε C)
    (hD : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation G H δ D) (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R hCT hC n).app t ≫
      (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R hDT hD n).app (t + ε) ≫
      (simplicialHomologyPModule R H n).map (eqToHom (add_assoc t ε δ)) =
    (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R
      (Relator.LeftTotal.trans (r₁₃ := fun x z => (x,z) ∈ C.comp D)
        (fun _ y _ hxy hyz => ⟨y,hxy,hyz⟩) hCT hDT)
      (hC.comp hD) n).app t
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun q => q.app t) (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp R hCT hDT hC hD n)

name: TDA.Persistence.shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso_nnreal
statement:
theorem shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso_nnreal (H : SimplicialFiltration ℝ Z)
    (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) :
    shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso R H (ε : ℝ) (δ : ℝ) n =
      RealShift.compIso ε δ (simplicialHomologyPModule R H n)
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal_comp
statement:
theorem multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal_comp {C : SetRel X Y} {D : SetRel Y Z}
    {ε δ : ℝ≥0}
    (hCT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hDT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun y z => (y,z) ∈ D))
    (hC : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G (ε : ℝ) C)
    (hD : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation G H (δ : ℝ) D) (n : ℕ) :
    multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal R hCT hC n ≫
      (RealShift.shift ε).map (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal R hDT hD n) ≫
      (RealShift.compIso ε δ (simplicialHomologyPModule R H n)).hom =
    multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal R
      (Relator.LeftTotal.trans (r₁₃ := fun x z => (x,z) ∈ C.comp D)
        (fun _ y _ hxy hyz => ⟨y,hxy,hyz⟩) hCT hDT)
      (show IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F H ((ε + δ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) (C.comp D) from hC.comp hD) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso_nnreal]
  exact multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp R hCT hDT hC hD n

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomProjective.hookHom_split
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  simp [hookHomToEnd, endToHookHom, Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomProjective.endRing_projective
proof:
:= by
  let e : (EndRing (k := k) (S := S)) ≃ₗ[HomScalars (k := k) (S := S)]
      HomScalars (k := k) (S := S) :=
    MulOpposite.opLinearEquiv (R := HomScalars (k := k) (S := S))
      (M := EndRing (k := k) (S := S))
  exact Module.Projective.of_equiv' e.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomProjective.hookHom_isProjective
statement:
theorem hookHom_isProjective (t : HookTag (S := S)) :
    Module.Projective (HomScalars (k := k) (S := S))
      (HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ hookFamily (k := k) (S := S) t)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Projective (HomScalars (k := k) (S := S))
      (EndRing (k := k) (S := S)) := endRing_projective (k := k) (S := S)
  exact Module.Projective.of_split
    (hookHomToEnd (k := k) (S := S) t)
    (endToHookHom (k := k) (S := S) t)
    (hookHom_split (k := k) (S := S) t)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomProjective.homBiproductEquivPi_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem homBiproductEquivPi_apply {I : Type} [Fintype I]
    (F : I → PModule.{u,0,u} k S) (f : HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ ⨁ F) (i : I) :
    homBiproductEquivPi (k := k) (S := S) F f i = f ≫ biproduct.π F i
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomProjective.family_eq_hookFamily
statement:
private theorem family_eq_hookFamily {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S}
    (i : FiniteHookDeflation.Index M) :
    FiniteHookDeflation.family M i =
      hookFamily (k := k) (S := S) (indexTag (S := S) i)
proof:
:= by
  cases i <;> rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomProjective.hom_from_hookSum_isProjective
statement:
theorem hom_from_hookSum_isProjective (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    (hfd : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)) (hRP : IsRankProjective M) :
    Module.Projective (HomScalars (k := k) (S := S))
      (HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨I, hI⟩ :=
    (FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjective_iff_exists_canonical_subfamily
      M hfd).mp hRP
  let F : I → PModule.{u,0,u} k S := fun i => FiniteHookDeflation.family M i.1
  let e : M ≅ ⨁ F := Classical.choice hI
  have hSummand (i : I) : Module.Projective (HomScalars (k := k) (S := S))
      (HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ F i) := by
    let tag := indexTag (S := S) i.1
    letI : Module.Projective (HomScalars (k := k) (S := S))
        (HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ hookFamily (k := k) (S := S) tag) :=
      hookHom_isProjective (k := k) (S := S) tag
    let eHook : F i ≅ hookFamily (k := k) (S := S) tag :=
      eqToIso (family_eq_hookFamily (M := M) i.1)
    exact Module.Projective.of_equiv'
      (homPostcomposeLinearEquiv (k := k) (S := S) eHook).symm
  have hPi : Module.Projective (HomScalars (k := k) (S := S))
      (∀ i, HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ F i) := by
    letI : ∀ i, Module.Projective (HomScalars (k := k) (S := S))
        (HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ F i) := hSummand
    exact Module.Projective.of_equiv'
      (DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype (HomScalars (k := k) (S := S)) I
        (fun i => HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ F i))
  have hBiproduct : Module.Projective (HomScalars (k := k) (S := S))
      (HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ ⨁ F) :=
    Module.Projective.of_equiv'
      (homBiproductEquivPi (k := k) (S := S) F).symm
  exact Module.Projective.of_equiv'
    (homPostcomposeLinearEquiv (k := k) (S := S) e).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_arctan
statement:
theorem stabilityConstant_arctan (σ C : ℝ) :
    stabilityConstant σ C (π / 2) = 2 * C + 3 * √(π / 2) / σ
proof:
:= by
  have key : π / 2 * √(2 / π) = √(π / 2) := by
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) / π = (π / 2)⁻¹ from (inv_div π 2).symm, Real.sqrt_inv,
      ← div_eq_mul_inv, Real.div_sqrt]
  unfold stabilityConstant GaussianKernel.translationConstant
  rw [show 3 * (π / 2) * (√(2 / π) / σ) = 3 * (π / 2 * √(2 / π)) / σ by ring, key]

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_image_sub_le_arctan
statement:
theorem norm_image_sub_le_arctan {I J K : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [Fintype K]
    {σ C : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    ‖image σ (arctanWeight C hC) P x - image σ (arctanWeight C hC) P y‖ ≤
      (2 * C + 3 * √(π / 2) / σ) * finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    norm_image_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost hσ hC Real.pi_div_two_pos.le
      (arctanWeight C hC) P hm hd x y hx hy

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_arctan
statement:
theorem norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_arctan {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ C : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hD : D.IsPositive) (hE : E.IsPositive)
    (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    ‖finiteDiagramImage σ (arctanWeight C hC) P D -
        finiteDiagramImage σ (arctanWeight C hC) P E‖ ≤
      (2 * C + 3 * √(π / 2) / σ) *
        ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
          (bottleneck D E).toReal
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck hσ hC Real.pi_div_two_pos.le
      (arctanWeight C hC) P hm hd D E hD hE hfinite

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage_eq_sum
statement:
theorem finiteDiagramImage_eq_sum {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {A B : ℝ} (σ : ℝ) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    finiteDiagramImage σ w P D = ((finitePart D.points).map (feature σ w P)).sum
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteDiagramImage, image, finiteFeatureSum, Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum]
  exact congrArg Multiset.sum (Multiset.map_univ (finitePart D.points) (feature σ w P))

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan
statement:
theorem norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (d e : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ)
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ C : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖finiteDiagramImage σ (arctanWeight C hC) P (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        finiteDiagramImage σ (arctanWeight C hC) P (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n)‖ ≤
      (2 * C + 3 * √(π / 2) / σ) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_arctan] using
    norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e n hσ hC Real.pi_div_two_pos.le
      (arctanWeight C hC) P hm hd

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.kanComparison_fac
statement:
theorem kanComparison_fac :
    (embeddingFunctor e).leftKanExtensionUnit ((embeddingFunctor e) ⋙ D.presented) ≫
      (embeddingFunctor e).whiskerLeft (D.kanComparison e) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:=
  Functor.descOfIsLeftKanExtension_fac _ _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.comparison_surjective
statement:
private theorem comparison_surjective (a : P) (ha : a ∈ Set.range e) :
    Function.Surjective ((D.kanComparison e).app a).hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := ha
  exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.comparison_injective
statement:
private theorem comparison_injective (a : P) (ha : a ∈ Set.range e) :
    Function.Injective ((D.kanComparison e).app a).hom
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := ha
  exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.section_comparison
statement:
private theorem section_comparison :
    comparisonSection D e hG hY ≫ D.kanComparison e = 𝟙 _
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (D.exists_lift_of_birth_surjective_relation_injective
    (D.kanComparison e) (fun g => comparison_surjective D e _ (hG g))
    (fun y => comparison_injective D e _ (hY y)) (𝟙 _))

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.comparison_section
statement:
private theorem comparison_section :
    D.kanComparison e ≫ comparisonSection D e hG hY = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  let η := (embeddingFunctor e).leftKanExtensionUnit ((embeddingFunctor e) ⋙ D.presented)
  apply Functor.hom_ext_of_isLeftKanExtension (D.restrictionLan e) η
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext q
  apply (cancel_mono ((D.kanComparison e).app (e q))).mp
  have he := NatTrans.congr_app (section_comparison D e hG hY) (e q)
  change (comparisonSection D e hG hY).app (e q) ≫ (D.kanComparison e).app (e q) = 𝟙 _ at he
  let u : D.presented.obj (e q) ⟶ (D.restrictionLan e).obj (e q) := η.app q
  change (u ≫ ((D.kanComparison e).app (e q) ≫
      (comparisonSection D e hG hY).app (e q))) ≫ (D.kanComparison e).app (e q) =
    (u ≫ 𝟙 ((D.restrictionLan e).obj (e q))) ≫ (D.kanComparison e).app (e q)
  simp only [Category.assoc, he, Category.comp_id]

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.kanIso_hom
statement: theorem kanIso_hom : (D.kanIso e hG hY).hom = D.kanComparison e
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.isLeftKanExtension
statement:
theorem isLeftKanExtension : D.presented.IsLeftKanExtension
    (𝟙 ((embeddingFunctor e) ⋙ D.presented))
proof:
:=
  Functor.isLeftKanExtension_of_iso (D.kanIso e hG hY)
    ((embeddingFunctor e).leftKanExtensionUnit ((embeddingFunctor e) ⋙ D.presented))
    (𝟙 _) (D.kanComparison_fac e)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.kanIso_inv_restrict
statement:
theorem kanIso_inv_restrict :
    (embeddingFunctor e).whiskerLeft (D.kanIso e hG hY).inv =
      (embeddingFunctor e).leftKanExtensionUnit ((embeddingFunctor e) ⋙ D.presented)
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext q
  change (D.kanIso e hG hY).inv.app (e q) = _
  apply (cancel_mono ((D.kanComparison e).app (e q))).mp
  have h₁ := NatTrans.congr_app (D.kanIso e hG hY).inv_hom_id (e q)
  have h₂ := NatTrans.congr_app (D.kanComparison_fac e) q
  exact h₁.trans h₂.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.restrictionHomEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem restrictionHomEquiv_apply (N : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R P) (f : D.presented ⟶ N) :
    D.restrictionHomEquiv e hG hY N f = (embeddingFunctor e).whiskerLeft f
proof:
:= by
  change (𝟙 ((embeddingFunctor e) ⋙ D.presented)) ≫
    (embeddingFunctor e).whiskerLeft f = (embeddingFunctor e).whiskerLeft f
  exact Category.id_comp _

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.restrictionHomEquiv_symm_restrict
statement:
theorem restrictionHomEquiv_symm_restrict (N : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R P)
    (α : (embeddingFunctor e) ⋙ D.presented ⟶ (embeddingFunctor e) ⋙ N) :
    (embeddingFunctor e).whiskerLeft ((D.restrictionHomEquiv e hG hY N).symm α) = α
proof:
:= by
  rw [← restrictionHomEquiv_apply]
  exact (D.restrictionHomEquiv e hG hY N).apply_symm_apply α

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.restrictionHomEquiv_symm_unique
statement:
theorem restrictionHomEquiv_symm_unique (N : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R P)
    (α : (embeddingFunctor e) ⋙ D.presented ⟶ (embeddingFunctor e) ⋙ N)
    (f : D.presented ⟶ N) (hf : (embeddingFunctor e).whiskerLeft f = α) :
    f = (D.restrictionHomEquiv e hG hY N).symm α
proof:
:= by
  apply (D.restrictionHomEquiv e hG hY N).injective
  rw [restrictionHomEquiv_apply, hf, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDimension.finiteLength_bound_of_vertex_modules
statement:
private theorem finiteLength_bound_of_vertex_modules
    (n : ℕ)
    (hvertex : ∀ v : StrictVertex S,
      HasProjectiveDimensionLT (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) n)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    (hM : IsFiniteLength (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLT M n
proof:
:= by
  let C := RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)
  suffices h : ∀ (M : Type u) [AddCommGroup M] [Module C M],
      IsFiniteLength C M → HasProjectiveDimensionLT (ModuleCat.of C M) n by
    exact h M.carrier hM
  intro M _ _ hM
  induction hM with
  | @of_subsingleton M _ _ hsub =>
    letI : Subsingleton M := hsub
    have hzero : Limits.IsZero (ModuleCat.of C M) := ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _
    letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (ModuleCat.of C M) 0 :=
      hzero.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ 0 n (Nat.zero_le n)
  | @of_simple_quotient M _ _ N _ _ ih =>
    let T : ShortComplex (ModuleCat C) :=
      ShortComplex.mk (ModuleCat.ofHom N.subtype) (ModuleCat.ofHom N.mkQ) (by
        ext x
        exact (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ N).apply_apply_eq_zero x)
    have hT : T.ShortExact := ModuleCat.shortComplex_shortExact T
      (LinearMap.exact_subtype_mkQ N) N.injective_subtype N.mkQ_surjective
    let Q : ModuleCat C := ModuleCat.of C (M ⧸ N)
    letI : IsSimpleModule C (M ⧸ N) := inferInstance
    obtain ⟨v, ⟨e⟩, _⟩ :=
      simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex (k := k) (S := S) Q
    letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) n :=
      hvertex v
    exact hT.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₂ n ih
      (hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso e.symm n)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_vertex_bound
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_vertex_bound
    (n : ℕ)
    (hvertex : ∀ v : StrictVertex S,
      HasProjectiveDimensionLT (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) n)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    (hM : IsFiniteLength (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLT M n
proof:
:=
  finiteLength_bound_of_vertex_modules n hvertex M hM

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_vertex_bound
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_vertex_bound
    (d : ℕ)
    (hvertex : ∀ v : StrictVertex S,
      HasProjectiveDimensionLE (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) d)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    (hM : IsFiniteLength (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE M d
proof:
:= by
  change HasProjectiveDimensionLT M (d + 1)
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_vertex_bound (k := k) (S := S) (d + 1)
    hvertex M hM

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDimension.rightVertexModule_isFiniteLength
statement:
theorem rightVertexModule_isFiniteLength (v : StrictVertex S) :
    IsFiniteLength (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
      (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v)
proof:
:= by
  let M := RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v
  letI : IsSimpleModule (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M :=
    rightVertexModule_isSimpleModule (k := k) (S := S) v
  have hbot : IsCoatom (⊥ : Submodule (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M) :=
    isSimpleOrder_iff_isCoatom_bot.mp inferInstance
  letI : IsSimpleModule (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
      (M ⧸ (⊥ : Submodule (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M)) :=
    isSimpleModule_iff_isCoatom.mpr hbot
  exact IsFiniteLength.of_simple_quotient (N := (⊥ : Submodule _ M))
    IsFiniteLength.of_subsingleton

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDimension.projectiveDimension_le_iSup_vertex
statement:
theorem projectiveDimension_le_iSup_vertex
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    (hM : IsFiniteLength (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M) :
    projectiveDimension M ≤
      ⨆ v : StrictVertex S,
        projectiveDimension (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v)
proof:
:= by
  let D : WithBot ℕ∞ :=
    ⨆ v : StrictVertex S,
      projectiveDimension (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v)
  change projectiveDimension M ≤ D
  unfold CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension
  apply sInf_le
  simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
  intro i hi
  apply hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_vertex_bound (k := k) (S := S) i _ M hM
  intro v
  apply (CategoryTheory.projectiveDimension_lt_iff).mp
  exact (le_iSup
    (fun v : StrictVertex S =>
      projectiveDimension (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v)) v).trans_lt hi

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDimension.finiteLength_uniform_projectiveDimensionLE_iff
statement:
theorem finiteLength_uniform_projectiveDimensionLE_iff (d : ℕ) :
    (∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)),
      IsFiniteLength (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M →
        HasProjectiveDimensionLE M d) ↔
    (∀ v : StrictVertex S,
      HasProjectiveDimensionLE (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) d)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h v
    exact h _ (rightVertexModule_isFiniteLength (k := k) (S := S) v)
  · intro h M hM
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_vertex_bound (k := k) (S := S) d h M hM

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDimension.isFiniteLength_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem isFiniteLength_of_finiteDimensional
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    (hM : FiniteDimensional k
      (restrictRightQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S) M)) :
    IsFiniteLength (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M
proof:
:= by
  let C := RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)
  letI : Module k M := (restrictRightQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S) M).isModule
  letI : IsScalarTower k C M := IsScalarTower.of_compHom k C M
  have hfinite : FiniteDimensional k M := hM
  letI : FiniteDimensional k M := hfinite
  have hNoetherian : IsNoetherian k M := inferInstance
  have hArtinian : IsArtinian k M := inferInstance
  letI : IsNoetherian C M := isNoetherian_of_tower k hNoetherian
  letI : IsArtinian C M := isArtinian_of_tower k hArtinian
  exact (isFiniteLength_iff_isNoetherian_isArtinian (R := C) (M := M)).2
    ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDimension.rightVertexModule_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem rightVertexModule_finiteDimensional (v : StrictVertex S) :
    FiniteDimensional k
      (restrictRightQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S)
        (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v))
proof:
:= by
  exact ((rightVertexModule_restrictKIso (k := k) (S := S) v).symm.toLinearEquiv).finiteDimensional

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDimension.projectiveDimension_le_iSup_vertex_of_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem projectiveDimension_le_iSup_vertex_of_finiteDimensional
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    (hM : FiniteDimensional k
      (restrictRightQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S) M)) :
    projectiveDimension M ≤
      ⨆ v : StrictVertex S,
        projectiveDimension (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v)
proof:
:=
  projectiveDimension_le_iSup_vertex (k := k) (S := S) M
    (isFiniteLength_of_finiteDimensional (k := k) (S := S) M hM)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDimension.finiteDimensional_uniform_projectiveDimensionLE_iff
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_uniform_projectiveDimensionLE_iff (d : ℕ) :
    (∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)),
      FiniteDimensional k (restrictRightQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S) M) →
        HasProjectiveDimensionLE M d) ↔
    (∀ v : StrictVertex S,
      HasProjectiveDimensionLE (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) d)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h v
    exact h _ (rightVertexModule_finiteDimensional (k := k) (S := S) v)
  · intro h M hM
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_vertex_bound (k := k) (S := S) d h M
      (isFiniteLength_of_finiteDimensional (k := k) (S := S) M hM)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInjectivePresentation.Examples.Downset.earlier_fiber_nonzero
statement:
theorem earlier_fiber_nonzero :
    ∃ x : (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module (k := ℚ) (2 : ℕ)).obj 0, x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨SupportInterval.one (Set.Iic (2 : ℕ)) (by decide), ?_⟩
  intro h

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.quotient_exact_at
statement:
private theorem quotient_exact_at
    {A B C A' B' C' : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (uA : A ⟶ A') (uB : B ⟶ B') (uC : C ⟶ C')
    (b : B ⟶ C) (a' : A' ⟶ B') (b' : B' ⟶ C')
    (dA : cokernel uA ⟶ cokernel uB) (dB : cokernel uB ⟶ cokernel uC)
    (hA : cokernel.π uA ≫ dA = a' ≫ cokernel.π uB)
    (hB : cokernel.π uB ≫ dB = b' ≫ cokernel.π uC)
    (hsquare : uB ≫ b' = b ≫ uC)
    (htarget : ∀ p (x : B'.obj p), (b'.app p).hom x = 0 →
      ∃ y, (a'.app p).hom y = x)
    (hsource : ∀ p (x : C.obj p) (y : B'.obj p),
      (uC.app p).hom x = (b'.app p).hom y → ∃ z, (b.app p).hom z = x)
    (p : P) (x : (cokernel uB).obj p) (hx : (dB.app p).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ y, (dA.app p).hom y = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := GeneratedAtBottom.cokernel_projection_surjective uB p x
  have hcycle : ((cokernel.π uC).app p).hom ((b'.app p).hom x') = 0 := by
    have he := comp_apply hB p x'
    simpa only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.comp_apply] using he.symm.trans hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (cokernel_projection_zero_iff uC p _).mp hcycle
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hsource p z x' hz
  have hcycle' : (b'.app p).hom (x' - (uB.app p).hom w) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, comp_apply hsquare p w]
    change (b'.app p).hom x' - (uC.app p).hom ((b.app p).hom w) = 0
    rw [hw, hz, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := htarget p _ hcycle'
  refine ⟨((cokernel.π uA).app p).hom y, ?_⟩
  rw [comp_apply hA p y]
  change ((cokernel.π uB).app p).hom ((a'.app p).hom y) = _
  rw [hy, map_sub]
  have hzero : ((cokernel.π uB).app p).hom ((uB.app p).hom w) = 0 :=
    (cokernel_projection_zero_iff uB p _).mpr ⟨w, rfl⟩
  rw [hzero, sub_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation_surjective_at
statement:
theorem augmentation_surjective_at {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P) :
    Function.Surjective ((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := GeneratedAtBottom.cokernel_projection_surjective
    (supportInclusion (k := k) f) p z
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation_surjective_at
    (k := k) (bottomFamily m) p x
  exact ⟨((cokernel.π (inclusion (k := k) f 0)).app p).hom y,
    comp_apply (projection_augmentation (k := k) f) p y⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.differential_exact_at_succ
statement:
theorem differential_exact_at_succ {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P) (r : ℕ)
    (x : (term (k := k) f (r + 1)).obj p)
    (hx : ((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ y : (term (k := k) f (r + 2)).obj p,
      ((differential (k := k) f (r + 1)).app p).hom y = x
proof:
:= by
  refine quotient_exact_at _ _ _
    (GeneratedUpsetResolution.differential (k := k) f r) _ _ _ _
    (projection_differential f (r + 1)) (projection_differential f r)
    (resolutionMap_differential (g := bottomFamily m) (fun _ => bot_le) r)
    (fun p y hy => GeneratedUpsetResolution.differential_exact_at_succ
      (bottomFamily m) p r y hy) ?_ p x hx
  intro q z y hz
  cases r with
  | zero =>
    apply GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation_exact_at_zero (k := k) f q z
    apply supportMap_app_injective (k := k) (g := bottomFamily m) (fun _ => bot_le) q
    rw [map_zero]
    have hs := comp_apply (resolutionMap_augmentation (k := k)
      (f := f) (g := bottomFamily m) (fun _ => bot_le)) q z
    change ((GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation (k := k) (bottomFamily m)).app q).hom
      (((inclusion (k := k) f 0).app q).hom z) =
      ((supportInclusion (k := k) f).app q).hom
        (((GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation (k := k) f).app q).hom z) at hs
    change ((supportInclusion (k := k) f).app q).hom
      (((GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation (k := k) f).app q).hom z) = 0
    rw [← hs, hz]
    exact comp_apply (GeneratedUpsetResolution.differential_comp_augmentation
      (k := k) (bottomFamily m)) q y
  | succ r =>
    apply GeneratedUpsetResolution.differential_exact_at_succ (k := k) f q r z
    apply resolutionMap_app_injective (k := k) (g := bottomFamily m)
      (fun _ => bot_le) r q
    rw [map_zero]
    have hs := comp_apply (resolutionMap_differential (k := k)
      (f := f) (g := bottomFamily m) (fun _ => bot_le) r) q z
    change ((GeneratedUpsetResolution.differential (k := k) (bottomFamily m) r).app q).hom
      (((inclusion (k := k) f (r + 1)).app q).hom z) =
      ((inclusion (k := k) f r).app q).hom
        (((GeneratedUpsetResolution.differential (k := k) f r).app q).hom z) at hs
    change ((inclusion (k := k) f r).app q).hom
      (((GeneratedUpsetResolution.differential (k := k) f r).app q).hom z) = 0
    rw [← hs, hz]
    exact comp_apply (GeneratedUpsetResolution.differential_comp_differential
      (k := k) (bottomFamily m) r) q y

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation_exact_at_zero
statement:
theorem augmentation_exact_at_zero {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P)
    (x : (term (k := k) f 0).obj p)
    (hx : ((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom x = 0) :
    ∃ y : (term (k := k) f 1).obj p,
      ((differential (k := k) f 0).app p).hom y = x
proof:
:= by
  exact quotient_exact_at _ _ _ (GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation (k := k) f)
    _ _ _ _ (projection_differential f 0) (projection_augmentation f)
    (resolutionMap_augmentation (g := bottomFamily m) (fun _ => bot_le))
    (fun p y hy => GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation_exact_at_zero
      (bottomFamily m) p y hy)
    (fun p z _ _ => GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation_surjective_at f p z) p x hx

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.rawProjection_ι
statement:
private theorem rawProjection_ι {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ)
    (A : FaceIndex m r) :
    biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) (bottomFamily m) B) A ≫

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.inclusion_rawProjection

    inclusion (k := k) f r ≫ rawProjection (k := k) f r = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply biproduct.hom_ext'
  intro A
  rw [← Category.assoc, inclusion, resolutionMap_ι, Category.assoc,
    rawProjection_ι, ← Category.assoc, faceMap_eq_hookInclusion,
    HookCokernel.inclusion_projection, zero_comp, comp_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.rawProjection_desc
proof:
:= by

  simp only [rawDesc, biproduct.ι_desc]
  exact HookCokernel.projection_desc _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.rawProjection_hom_ext
proof:
:= by

  apply biproduct.hom_ext'
  intro A
  apply HookCokernel.hom_ext
    (faceJoin_le_of_pointwise_le (f := f) (g := bottomFamily m) (fun _ => bot_le) A)
  have he := congrArg (fun t => biproduct.ι
    (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) (bottomFamily m) B) A ≫ t) h
  simpa only [← Category.assoc, rawProjection_ι] using he

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.projection_rawIso

private theorem projection_rawIso {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ) :

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.projection_hookSumIso_ι
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)] theorem projection_hookSumIso_ι {m : ℕ}
    (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ) (A : FaceIndex m r) :
    biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => faceModule (k := k) (bottomFamily m) B) A ≫
      cokernel.π (inclusion (k := k) f r) ≫ (hookSumIso f r).hom =
    HookCokernel.projection (faceJoin (bottomFamily m) A) (faceJoin f A) ≫
      (faceHookIso f A).hom ≫
        biproduct.ι (fun B : FaceIndex m r => Hook.module (k := k) ⊥ (faceJoin f B)) A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [hookSumIso, Iso.trans_hom]
  rw [← Category.assoc (cokernel.π (inclusion (k := k) f r)), projection_rawIso,
    ← Category.assoc, rawProjection_ι, Category.assoc, biproduct.mapIso_hom,
    biproduct.ι_map]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.bottomTerm_generated
statement:
private theorem bottomTerm_generated (m r : ℕ) :
    GeneratedAtBottom (GeneratedUpsetResolution.term (k := k) (bottomFamily (P := P) m) r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let F : FaceIndex m r → PModule.{u,0,u} k P := fun A => faceModule (k := k) (bottomFamily m) A
  have hF : ∀ A : FaceIndex m r, GeneratedAtBottom (F A) := by
    intro A
    change GeneratedAtBottom (HookInfinity.module (R := k) (faceJoin (bottomFamily m) A))
    rw [faceJoin_bottom]
    intro p y
    refine ⟨(HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) (le_rfl : (⊥ : P) ≤ ⊥)).symm
      (HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) (bot_le : (⊥ : P) ≤ p) y), ?_⟩
    apply (HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) (bot_le : (⊥ : P) ≤ p)).injective
    rw [HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe_structureMap]
    exact LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  intro p y
  choose x hx using fun A => hF A p (((biproduct.π F A).app p).hom y)
  let e := FiniteBiproduct.fiberIsoPi F ⊥
  refine ⟨e.inv.hom x, ?_⟩
  apply FiniteBiproduct.element_ext F p
  intro A
  have hcoord : ((biproduct.π F A).app ⊥).hom (e.inv.hom x) = x A := by
    have he := FiniteBiproduct.fiberIsoPi_hom_π F ⊥ A
    have ht := congrArg (fun t : (⨁ F).obj ⊥ ⟶ (F A).obj ⊥ => t.hom (e.inv.hom x)) he
    change (e.hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.proj A)).hom (e.inv.hom x) = _ at ht
    have hinv : e.hom.hom (e.inv.hom x) = x := by
      exact congrArg (fun t => t.hom x) e.inv_hom_id
    simpa only [ModuleCat.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_ofHom, LinearMap.proj_apply, hinv] using ht.symm
  have hn := congrArg (fun t : (⨁ F).obj ⊥ ⟶ (F A).obj p => t.hom (e.inv.hom x))
    ((biproduct.π F A).naturality (homOfLE (bot_le : (⊥ : P) ≤ p)))
  change ((biproduct.π F A).app p).hom
    (structureMapLinear (⨁ F) bot_le (e.inv.hom x)) =
      structureMapLinear (F A) bot_le (((biproduct.π F A).app ⊥).hom (e.inv.hom x)) at hn
  rw [hn, hcoord, hx]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.range_eq_ker_of_cycles
statement:
private theorem range_eq_ker_of_cycles {A B C : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (a : A ⟶ B) (b : B ⟶ C) (hz : a ≫ b = 0)
    (h : ∀ p (x : B.obj p), (b.app p).hom x = 0 → ∃ y, (a.app p).hom y = x)
    (p : P) : LinearMap.range (a.app p).hom = LinearMap.ker (b.app p).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
    exact comp_apply hz p y
  · exact h p x

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation_range_eq_ker
statement:
theorem augmentation_range_eq_ker {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P) :
    LinearMap.range ((differential (k := k) f 0).app p).hom =
      LinearMap.ker ((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom
proof:
:=
  range_eq_ker_of_cycles _ _ (differential_comp_augmentation f)
    (augmentation_exact_at_zero f) p

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.differential_range_eq_ker
statement:
theorem differential_range_eq_ker {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ) (p : P) :
    LinearMap.range ((differential (k := k) f (r + 1)).app p).hom =
      LinearMap.ker ((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom
proof:
:=
  range_eq_ker_of_cycles _ _ (differential_comp_differential f r)
    (fun p => differential_exact_at_succ f p r) p

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.resolution_pointwise_exact_at
statement:
theorem resolution_pointwise_exact_at {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (p : P) :
    Function.Surjective ((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom ∧
      LinearMap.range ((differential (k := k) f 0).app p).hom =
        LinearMap.ker ((augmentation (k := k) f).app p).hom ∧
      ∀ r, LinearMap.range ((differential (k := k) f (r + 1)).app p).hom =
        LinearMap.ker ((differential (k := k) f r).app p).hom
proof:
:=
  ⟨augmentation_surjective_at f p, augmentation_range_eq_ker f p,
    fun r => differential_range_eq_ker f r p⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.kernelLift_surjective
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  have hz : ((kernel.ι b).app p).hom z ∈ LinearMap.ker (b.app p).hom := by
    exact comp_apply (kernel.condition b) p z
  rw [← he p] at hz
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨x, RankKernel.injective b p ?_⟩
  exact (comp_apply (kernelRowLift_ι he) p x).trans hx

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation_rankExact
statement:
theorem augmentation_rankExact {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) :
    IsRankExact (kernel.ι (augmentation (k := k) f)) (augmentation (k := k) f)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsPointwiseShortExact.rankExact_of_generatedAtBottom
    (RankKernel.shortExact _ (augmentation_surjective_at f))
  · exact GeneratedAtBottom.of_surjective (term_generatedAtBottom f 1)
      (kernelRowLift (augmentation_range_eq_ker f))
      (kernelLift_surjective (augmentation_range_eq_ker f))
  · exact term_finiteDimensional f 0

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.zero_kernelRow_rankExact
statement:
theorem zero_kernelRow_rankExact {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) :
    IsRankExact (kernel.ι (differential (k := k) f 0))
      (kernelRowLift (augmentation_range_eq_ker (k := k) f))
proof:
:=
  rankExact_kernelRow (differential_range_eq_ker f 0) (augmentation_range_eq_ker f)
    (term_generatedAtBottom f 2) (term_finiteDimensional f 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.succ_kernelRow_rankExact
statement:
theorem succ_kernelRow_rankExact {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (r : ℕ) :
    IsRankExact (kernel.ι (differential (k := k) f (r + 1)))
      (kernelRowLift (differential_range_eq_ker (k := k) f r))
proof:
:=
  rankExact_kernelRow (differential_range_eq_ker f (r + 1))
    (differential_range_eq_ker f r) (term_generatedAtBottom f (r + 3))
    (term_finiteDimensional f (r + 2))

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.term_isZero_of_degree_ge
statement:
theorem term_isZero_of_degree_ge {m r : ℕ} (f : Fin m → P) (hmr : m ≤ r) :

    (GeneratedUpsetResolution.term_isZero_of_degree_ge (bottomFamily m) hmr)

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.term_bottomFamily_isZero
statement:
theorem term_bottomFamily_isZero (m r : ℕ) :
    IsZero (term (k := k) (bottomFamily (P := P) m) r)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : inclusion (k := k) (bottomFamily (P := P) m) r = 𝟙 _ :=
    resolutionMap_identity _ r
  have : Epi (inclusion (k := k) (bottomFamily (P := P) m) r) := by
    rw [hi]
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.term_fin_zero_isZero
statement:
theorem term_fin_zero_isZero (f : Fin 0 → P) (r : ℕ) :

statement: theorem target_fin_zero_isZero (f : Fin 0 → P) : IsZero (target (k := k) f)
