name: TDA.Persistence.diagonalCost_le_max
statement:
theorem diagonalCost_le_max (b d a : ℝ) :
    |d - b| / 2 ≤ max |b - a| |d - a|
proof:
:= by
  have h := abs_sub_le d a b
  rw [abs_sub_comm a b] at h
  have h₁ : |b - a| ≤ max |b - a| |d - a| := le_max_left _ _
  have h₂ : |d - a| ≤ max |b - a| |d - a| := le_max_right _ _
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.diagonalCost_midpoint
statement:
theorem diagonalCost_midpoint (b d : ℝ) :
    |d - b| / 2 = max |b - (b + d) / 2| |d - (b + d) / 2|
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : b - (b + d) / 2 = (b - d) / 2 := by ring
  have h₂ : d - (b + d) / 2 = (d - b) / 2 := by ring
  rw [h₁, h₂, abs_div, abs_div, abs_sub_comm b d]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem ext {M N : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂}
    (hf : M.finite = N.finite) (he : M.essential = N.essential) : M = N
proof:
:= by
  cases M
  cases N
  cases hf
  cases he
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.sup_univ_reindex
statement:
private theorem sup_univ_reindex {A B : Type*} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]
    (e : A ≃ B) (f : B → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset A).sup (fun a => f (e a)) =
      (Finset.univ : Finset B).sup f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact Finset.sup_le fun a _ => Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ (e a))
  · apply Finset.sup_le
    intro b _
    simpa using (Finset.le_sup (s := (Finset.univ : Finset A))
      (f := fun a => f (e a)) (Finset.mem_univ (e.symm b)))

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.cost_relabel
statement:
theorem cost_relabel {F₁' F₂' E₁' E₂' : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁'] [Fintype F₂'] [Fintype E₁'] [Fintype E₂']
    (u : F₁' ≃ F₁) (v : F₂' ≃ F₂)
    (s : E₁' ≃ E₁) (t : E₂' ≃ E₂)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) :
    (M.relabel u v s t).cost (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) (b ∘ s) (c ∘ t) =
      M.cost x y b c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold cost
  congr 1
  · have hf (i : F₁') :
        (match (M.relabel u v s t).finite i with
          | some j => finitePairCost (x (u i)) (y (v j))
          | none => diagonalCost (x (u i))) =
        (match M.finite (u i) with
          | some j => finitePairCost (x (u i)) (y j)
          | none => diagonalCost (x (u i))) := by
        cases h : M.finite (u i) with
        | none => simp [relabel, h]
        | some j => simp [relabel, h]
    have h := sup_univ_reindex u
        (fun i => match M.finite i with
          | some j => finitePairCost (x i) (y j)
          | none => diagonalCost (x i))
    calc
      _ = (Finset.univ : Finset F₁').sup (fun i =>
          match M.finite (u i) with
          | some j => finitePairCost (x (u i)) (y j)
          | none => diagonalCost (x (u i))) := by
            apply Finset.sup_congr rfl
            intro i _
            simpa only [Function.comp_apply] using hf i
      _ = _ := h
  · congr 1
    · have hh (j : F₂') :
          (∃ i : F₁', (M.relabel u v s t).finite i = some j) ↔
            ∃ i : F₁, M.finite i = some (v j) := by
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
          refine ⟨u i, ?_⟩
          cases h : M.finite (u i) with
          | none => simp [relabel, h] at hi
          | some k =>
            simp [relabel, h] at hi
            have hk : k = v j := by simpa using congrArg v hi
            simpa [hk] using h
        · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
          exact ⟨u.symm i, by simp [relabel, hi]⟩
      have hv := sup_univ_reindex v
        (fun j => if ∃ i : F₁, M.finite i = some j then 0 else diagonalCost (y j))
      simpa only [Function.comp_apply, hh] using hv
    · have hs := sup_univ_reindex s
        (fun i => essentialPairCost (b i) (c (M.essential i)))
      simpa [relabel, Function.comp_apply] using hs

name: TDA.Persistence.fintypeOccurrenceEquiv_value
statement:
@[simp] theorem fintypeOccurrenceEquiv_value {A B : Type*}
    [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [DecidableEq B]
    (f : A → B) (a : A) :
    ((fintypeOccurrenceEquiv f a : ((Finset.univ : Finset A).val.map f)) : B) = f a
proof:
:= by
  exact Multiset.mapEquiv_apply _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.occurrenceCast_value
statement:
private theorem occurrenceCast_value {B : Type*} [DecidableEq B]
    {s t : Multiset B} (h : s = t) (p : s) :
    ((Equiv.cast (congrArg Multiset.ToType h) p : t) : B) =
      (p : B)
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨M⟩
    exact Fintype.card_congr M.essential
  · intro h
    let e : E₁ ≃ E₂ := Fintype.equivOfCardEq h
    exact ⟨⟨fun _ => none, by simp, e⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_relabel
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_relabel {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ F₁' F₂' E₁' E₂' : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    [Fintype F₁'] [Fintype F₂'] [Fintype E₁'] [Fintype E₂']
    (u : F₁' ≃ F₁) (v : F₂' ≃ F₂)
    (s : E₁' ≃ E₁) (t : E₂' ≃ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) (b ∘ s) (c ∘ t) =
      presentationBottleneck x y b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold presentationBottleneck
  let e := OccurrenceMatching.relabelEquiv u v s t
  calc
    (⨅ M : OccurrenceMatching F₁' F₂' E₁' E₂',
      M.cost (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) (b ∘ s) (c ∘ t)) =
        ⨅ M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂,
          (e M).cost (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) (b ∘ s) (c ∘ t) :=
            (e.surjective.iInf_comp _).symm
    _ = ⨅ M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂, M.cost x y b c := by
      apply iInf_congr
      intro M
      exact OccurrenceMatching.cost_relabel u v s t M x y b c

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_eq_of_multiset_eq
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_eq_of_multiset_eq
    {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ F₁' F₂' E₁' E₂' : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    [Fintype F₁'] [Fintype F₂'] [Fintype E₁'] [Fintype E₂']
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ)
    (x' : F₁' → ℝ × ℝ) (y' : F₂' → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b' : E₁' → ℝ) (c' : E₂' → ℝ)
    (hx : (Finset.univ : Finset F₁).val.map x =
      (Finset.univ : Finset F₁').val.map x')
    (hy : (Finset.univ : Finset F₂).val.map y =
      (Finset.univ : Finset F₂').val.map y')
    (hb : (Finset.univ : Finset E₁).val.map b =
      (Finset.univ : Finset E₁').val.map b')
    (hc : (Finset.univ : Finset E₂).val.map c =
      (Finset.univ : Finset E₂').val.map c') :
    presentationBottleneck x' y' b' c' = presentationBottleneck x y b c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let u := (presentationEquiv x' x hx.symm).1
  let v := (presentationEquiv y' y hy.symm).1
  let s := (presentationEquiv b' b hb.symm).1
  let t := (presentationEquiv c' c hc.symm).1
  have hu : x ∘ u = x' := funext (presentationEquiv x' x hx.symm).2
  have hv : y ∘ v = y' := funext (presentationEquiv y' y hy.symm).2
  have hs : b ∘ s = b' := funext (presentationEquiv b' b hb.symm).2
  have ht : c ∘ t = c' := funext (presentationEquiv c' c hc.symm).2
  simpa only [hu, hv, hs, ht] using
    presentationBottleneck_relabel u v s t x y b c

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_eq_presentation
statement:
theorem bottleneck_eq_presentation (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ)
    (hx : (Finset.univ : Finset F₁).val.map x = finitePart D.points)
    (hy : (Finset.univ : Finset F₂).val.map y = finitePart E.points)
    (hb : (Finset.univ : Finset E₁).val.map b = essentialPart D.points)
    (hc : (Finset.univ : Finset E₂).val.map c = essentialPart E.points) :
    bottleneck D E = presentationBottleneck x y b c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold bottleneck
  apply (presentationBottleneck_eq_of_multiset_eq
    (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
    (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
    (fun p : D.essentialOccurrences => p.1)
    (fun p : E.essentialOccurrences => p.1)
    x y b c ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_).symm
  · exact (Multiset.map_univ_coe _).trans hx.symm
  · exact (Multiset.map_univ_coe _).trans hy.symm
  · exact (Multiset.map_univ_coe _).trans hb.symm
  · exact (Multiset.map_univ_coe _).trans hc.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_le_matching
statement:
theorem bottleneck_le_matching (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences E.essentialOccurrences) :
    bottleneck D E ≤
      M.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1)
proof:
:= by
  exact iInf_le _ M

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_le_cost
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_le_cost {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂) :
    presentationBottleneck x y b c ≤ M.cost x y b c
proof:
:= by
  exact iInf_le _ M

name: TDA.Persistence.occurrenceMatching_cost_lt_top
statement:
theorem occurrenceMatching_cost_lt_top {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂) : M.cost x y b c < ⊤
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold OccurrenceMatching.cost
  simp only [max_lt_iff, Finset.sup_lt_iff (show (0 : ℝ≥0∞) < ⊤ by simp),
    Finset.mem_univ, forall_const, true_implies]
  constructor
  · intro i
    split <;> simp [finitePairCost, diagonalCost]
  constructor
  · intro j
    split <;> simp [diagonalCost]
  · intro k
    simp [essentialPairCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_optimal_iff
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_optimal_iff {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) :
    (∃ M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂,
      M.cost x y b c = presentationBottleneck x y b c) ↔
      Fintype.card E₁ = Fintype.card E₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨M, _⟩
    exact occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff.mp ⟨M⟩
  · intro h
    letI : Nonempty (OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂) :=
      occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff.mpr h
    exact exists_eq_ciInf_of_finite

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_lt_top_iff
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_lt_top_iff {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck x y b c < ⊤ ↔
      Fintype.card E₁ = Fintype.card E₂
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hc
    have hempty : IsEmpty (OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂) :=
      not_nonempty_iff.mp (fun hm => hc (occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff.mp hm))
    simp [presentationBottleneck] at h
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨M, hm⟩ := (presentationBottleneck_optimal_iff x y b c).mpr h
    rw [← hm]
    exact occurrenceMatching_cost_lt_top x y b c M

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_lt_top_iff
statement:
theorem bottleneck_lt_top_iff (D E : Diagram ℝ) :
    bottleneck D E < ⊤ ↔
      (essentialPart D.points).card = (essentialPart E.points).card
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [bottleneck, Multiset.card_coe] using
    (presentationBottleneck_lt_top_iff
      (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
      (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
      (fun b : D.essentialOccurrences => b.1)
      (fun b : E.essentialOccurrences => b.1))

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_optimal_iff
statement:
theorem bottleneck_optimal_iff (D E : Diagram ℝ) :
    (∃ M : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences
        D.essentialOccurrences E.essentialOccurrences,
      M.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) =
        bottleneck D E) ↔
      (essentialPart D.points).card = (essentialPart E.points).card
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [bottleneck, Multiset.card_coe] using
    (presentationBottleneck_optimal_iff
      (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
      (fun p : E.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
      (fun b : D.essentialOccurrences => b.1)
      (fun b : E.essentialOccurrences => b.1))

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem bottleneck_eq_top_iff (D E : Diagram ℝ) :
    bottleneck D E = ⊤ ↔
      (essentialPart D.points).card ≠ (essentialPart E.points).card
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h hc
    have hl := (bottleneck_lt_top_iff D E).mpr hc
    simp [h] at hl
  · intro h
    by_contra hn
    have hl : bottleneck D E < ⊤ := lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hn
    exact h ((bottleneck_lt_top_iff D E).mp hl)

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_finite_occurrences
statement:
theorem orderedQ_finite_occurrences (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → ℝ × ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (NonDiagonalIndices m z.1)).val.map
      (fun i => z.1 i.1) = finitePart (orderedQ m n z).points
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter
          (fun i => (z.1 i).1 ≠ (z.1 i).2)).val.map z.1 := by
        simpa only [Subtype.restrict_def, Function.comp_apply] using
          (Finset.univ_val_map_subtype_restrict z.1
            (fun i => (z.1 i).1 ≠ (z.1 i).2))
    _ = finitePart (orderedQ m n z).points := by
      rw [finitePart_orderedQ]
      rw [Finset.filter_val, List.ofFn_eq_map]
      change ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).val.filter
          (fun i => (z.1 i).1 ≠ (z.1 i).2)).map z.1 =
        (((List.finRange m : List (Fin m)) : Multiset (Fin m)).map z.1).filter
          (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)
      rw [← Finset.val_univ_fin, Multiset.filter_map]
      rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_essential_occurrences
statement:
theorem orderedQ_essential_occurrences (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → ℝ × ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val.map z.2 =
      essentialPart (orderedQ m n z).points
proof:
:= by
  rw [essentialPart_orderedQ, List.ofFn_eq_map]
  change (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n)).val.map z.2 =
    ((List.finRange n : List (Fin n)) : Multiset (Fin n)).map z.2
  rw [← Finset.val_univ_fin]

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_birth_difference_le_norm
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := norm_fst_le (z.1 i - w.1 i)
  have h₂ := norm_le_pi_norm (z.1 - w.1) i
  have h₃ := norm_fst_le (z - w)
  simpa [Pi.sub_apply, Prod.fst_sub, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h₁.trans (h₂.trans h₃)

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_death_difference_le_norm
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := norm_snd_le (z.1 i - w.1 i)
  have h₂ := norm_le_pi_norm (z.1 - w.1) i
  have h₃ := norm_fst_le (z - w)
  simpa [Pi.sub_apply, Prod.snd_sub, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h₁.trans (h₂.trans h₃)

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_essential_difference_le_norm
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := norm_le_pi_norm (z.2 - w.2) i
  have h₂ := norm_snd_le (z - w)
  simpa [Pi.sub_apply, Prod.snd_sub, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h₁.trans h₂

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedOccurrenceMatching_cost_le
statement:
theorem orderedOccurrenceMatching_cost_le (m n : ℕ)
    (z w : (Fin m → ℝ × ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (orderedOccurrenceMatching m n z w).cost
      (fun i => z.1 i.1) (fun i => w.1 i.1) z.2 w.2 ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ‖z - w‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold OccurrenceMatching.cost
  apply max_le_iff.mpr
  constructor
  · apply Finset.sup_le
    intro i _
    by_cases hw : (w.1 i.1).1 ≠ (w.1 i.1).2
    · simp only [orderedOccurrenceMatching, dif_pos hw, Option.map_some]
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      exact max_le (orderedQ_birth_difference_le_norm z w i.1)
        (orderedQ_death_difference_le_norm z w i.1)
    · have heq : (w.1 i.1).1 = (w.1 i.1).2 := of_not_not hw
      simp only [orderedOccurrenceMatching, dif_neg hw]
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      have hd := diagonalCost_le_max (z.1 i.1).1 (z.1 i.1).2 (w.1 i.1).1
      apply hd.trans
      apply max_le
      · exact orderedQ_birth_difference_le_norm z w i.1
      · simpa only [← heq] using orderedQ_death_difference_le_norm z w i.1
  · apply max_le_iff.mpr
    constructor
    · apply Finset.sup_le
      intro j _
      by_cases hm : ∃ i, (orderedOccurrenceMatching m n z w).finite i = some j
      · simp [hm]
      · have hz : (z.1 j.1).1 = (z.1 j.1).2 := by
          by_contra hn
          apply hm
          refine ⟨⟨j.1, hn⟩, ?_⟩
          simp [orderedOccurrenceMatching, j.2]
        simp only [if_neg hm]
        apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        have hd := diagonalCost_le_max (w.1 j.1).1 (w.1 j.1).2 (z.1 j.1).1
        apply hd.trans
        apply max_le
        · simpa only [abs_sub_comm] using orderedQ_birth_difference_le_norm z w j.1
        · simpa only [hz, abs_sub_comm] using orderedQ_death_difference_le_norm z w j.1
    · apply Finset.sup_le
      intro k _
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
      exact orderedQ_essential_difference_le_norm z w k

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_orderedQ_le_norm
statement:
theorem bottleneck_orderedQ_le_norm (m n : ℕ)
    (z w : (Fin m → ℝ × ℝ) × (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    bottleneck (orderedQ m n z) (orderedQ m n w) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ‖z - w‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation (orderedQ m n z) (orderedQ m n w)
    (fun i : NonDiagonalIndices m z.1 => z.1 i.1)
    (fun i : NonDiagonalIndices m w.1 => w.1 i.1)
    z.2 w.2
    (orderedQ_finite_occurrences m n z)
    (orderedQ_finite_occurrences m n w)
    (orderedQ_essential_occurrences m n z)
    (orderedQ_essential_occurrences m n w)]
  exact (presentationBottleneck_le_cost _ _ _ _
    (orderedOccurrenceMatching m n z w)).trans
      (orderedOccurrenceMatching_cost_le m n z w)

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_orderedQ_eq_of_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [hz, hw]

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_singleton_empty
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_singleton_empty (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck (fun _ : Fin 1 => p)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = diagonalCost p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc (M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 1) (Fin 0) (Fin 0) (Fin 0)) :
      M.cost (fun _ : Fin 1 => p) Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 = diagonalCost p := by
    have hf : M.finite = fun _ => none := by
      funext i
      cases h : M.finite i with
      | none => rfl
      | some j => exact Fin.elim0 j
    simp [OccurrenceMatching.cost, hf]
  have hM : Nonempty (OccurrenceMatching (Fin 1) (Fin 0) (Fin 0) (Fin 0)) :=
    occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff.mpr (by simp)
  simp [presentationBottleneck, hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_constant_empty
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_constant_empty {F : Type*}
    [Fintype F] [Nonempty F] (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck (fun _ : F => p)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = diagonalCost p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc (M : OccurrenceMatching F (Fin 0) (Fin 0) (Fin 0)) :
      M.cost (fun _ : F => p) Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 = diagonalCost p := by
    have hf : M.finite = fun _ => none := by
      funext i
      cases h : M.finite i with
      | none => rfl
      | some j => exact Fin.elim0 j
    simp [OccurrenceMatching.cost, hf, Finset.sup_const]
  have hM : Nonempty (OccurrenceMatching F (Fin 0) (Fin 0) (Fin 0)) :=
    occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff.mpr (by simp)
  simp [presentationBottleneck, hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_finite_empty
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_finite_empty {F : Type*}
    [Fintype F] (x : F → ℝ × ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck x (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) =
      (Finset.univ : Finset F).sup (fun i => diagonalCost (x i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc (M : OccurrenceMatching F (Fin 0) (Fin 0) (Fin 0)) :
      M.cost x Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 =
        (Finset.univ : Finset F).sup (fun i => diagonalCost (x i)) := by
    have hf : M.finite = fun _ => none := by
      funext i
      cases h : M.finite i with
      | none => rfl
      | some j => exact Fin.elim0 j
    simp [OccurrenceMatching.cost, hf]
  have hM : Nonempty (OccurrenceMatching F (Fin 0) (Fin 0) (Fin 0)) :=
    occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff.mpr (by simp)
  simp [presentationBottleneck, hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_essential_singletons
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_essential_singletons (b c : ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => b) (fun _ : Fin 1 => c) = essentialPairCost b c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc (M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 0) (Fin 0) (Fin 1) (Fin 1)) :
      M.cost Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 (fun _ : Fin 1 => b) (fun _ : Fin 1 => c) =
        essentialPairCost b c := by
    simp [OccurrenceMatching.cost]
  have hM : Nonempty (OccurrenceMatching (Fin 0) (Fin 0) (Fin 1) (Fin 1)) :=
    occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff.mpr (by simp)
  simp [presentationBottleneck, hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_two_equal_vs_one
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_two_equal_vs_one (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck (fun _ : Fin 2 => p) (fun _ : Fin 1 => p)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = diagonalCost p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M₀ : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 2) (Fin 1) (Fin 0) (Fin 0) :=
    ⟨fun _ => none, by simp, Equiv.refl _⟩
  have h₀ : M₀.cost (fun _ : Fin 2 => p) (fun _ : Fin 1 => p)
      Fin.elim0 Fin.elim0 = diagonalCost p := by
    simp [OccurrenceMatching.cost, M₀]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (presentationBottleneck_le_cost _ _ _ _ M₀).trans_eq h₀
  · apply le_iInf
    intro M
    have hu : ∃ i : Fin 2, M.finite i = none := by
      by_cases h₁ : M.finite 0 = none
      · exact ⟨0, h₁⟩
      · by_cases h₂ : M.finite 1 = none
        · exact ⟨1, h₂⟩
        · have h₁' : M.finite 0 = some 0 := by
            cases hh : M.finite 0 with
            | none => exact (h₁ hh).elim
            | some j => fin_cases j; simpa using hh
          have h₂' : M.finite 1 = some 0 := by
            cases hh : M.finite 1 with
            | none => exact (h₂ hh).elim
            | some j => fin_cases j; simpa using hh
          have he := M.finite_injective 0 1 0 h₁' h₂'
          exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1) he |>.elim
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hu
    unfold OccurrenceMatching.cost
    apply le_trans ?_ (le_max_left _ _)
    have hle := (Finset.le_sup (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)))
      (f := fun i => match M.finite i with
        | some j => finitePairCost ((fun _ : Fin 2 => p) i) ((fun _ : Fin 1 => p) j)
        | none => diagonalCost ((fun _ : Fin 2 => p) i)) (Finset.mem_univ i))
    convert hle using 1
    · simp [hi]
    · apply Finset.sup_congr
      · ext j
        simp
      · intro j _
        cases h : M.finite j <;> simp [h]

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_finite_only_empty
statement:
theorem bottleneck_finite_only_empty (D : Diagram ℝ)
    (he : essentialPart D.points = 0) :
    bottleneck D (orderedQ 0 0
      ((Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ), (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ))) =
        (Finset.univ : Finset D.finiteOccurrences).sup
          (fun p => diagonalCost p.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hf : (Finset.univ : Finset D.finiteOccurrences).val.map
      (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1) = finitePart D.points :=
    Multiset.map_univ_coe _
  have hz : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) =
        finitePart (orderedQ 0 0
          ((Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ), (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ))).points := by
    simp [finitePart_orderedQ]
  have hd : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = essentialPart D.points := by simp [he]
  have he' : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) =
        essentialPart (orderedQ 0 0
          ((Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ), (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ))).points := by
    simp [essentialPart_orderedQ]
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation D
    (orderedQ 0 0 ((Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ), (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ)))
    (fun p : D.finiteOccurrences => p.1)
    (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
    (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ)
    hf hz hd he']
  exact presentationBottleneck_finite_empty _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.list_count
statement:
private theorem list_count (xs : List (FiniteInterval s)) (p : FiniteInterval s → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] :
    (∑ i : Fin xs.length, if p (xs.get i) then 1 else 0) =
      (xs : Multiset (FiniteInterval s)).countP p
proof:
:= by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons I xs ih =>
    change (∑ i : Fin (xs.length + 1), if p ((I :: xs).get i) then 1 else 0) = _
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    change (if p I then 1 else 0) + (∑ i : Fin xs.length, if p (xs.get i) then 1 else 0) = _
    rw [ih]
    by_cases h : p I <;> simp [Multiset.coe_countP, h, add_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.occurrence_count
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_subtype, Finset.card_filter]
  change (∑ i : Fin B.toList.length, if p (B.toList.get i) then 1 else 0) = _
  calc
    _ = (B.toList : Multiset (FiniteInterval s)).countP p := list_count B.toList p
    _ = B.countP p := congrArg (Multiset.countP p) (Multiset.coe_toList B)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.suffix_card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (suffixEquiv B b c),
    occurrence_count B (fun I => I.birth = b ∧ c < I.death)]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birth_card
statement:
private theorem birth_card (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s)) (b : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (BirthOccurrence B b) = birthSuffixCount B b b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (birthEquiv B b), occurrence_count B (fun I => I.birth = b)]
  unfold birthSuffixCount
  apply Multiset.countP_congr rfl
  intro I _
  apply propext
  have := I.birth_lt_death
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.death_antitone
proof:
:=
  Prod.Lex.monotone_fst _ _ h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.lt_of_death_gt
proof:
:=
  Prod.Lex.toLex_lt_toLex.mpr (Or.inl h)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.ordinal_lt_suffix
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r := (birthEnumeration B b).symm x
  let f : Fin (r.val + 1) → {i : BirthOccurrence B b // c < (occurrence B i.index).death} :=
    fun a => by
      let q : Fin (Fintype.card (BirthOccurrence B b)) := ⟨a.val, by have := r.isLt; omega⟩
      have hqr : q ≤ r := by change a.val ≤ r.val; have := a.isLt; omega
      refine ⟨birthEnumeration B b q, ?_⟩
      have h := death_antitone B b ((birthEnumeration B b).monotone hqr)
      have hr : birthEnumeration B b r = x := (birthEnumeration B b).apply_symm_apply x
      rw [hr] at h
      exact hc.trans_le h
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a d h
    apply Fin.ext
    have he := congrArg Subtype.val h
    change birthEnumeration B b ⟨a.val, _⟩ = birthEnumeration B b ⟨d.val, _⟩ at he
    exact congrArg (fun q : Fin (Fintype.card (BirthOccurrence B b)) => q.val)
      ((birthEnumeration B b).injective he)
  have h := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  rw [Fintype.card_fin, suffix_card] at h
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.suffix_le_ordinal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r := (birthEnumeration B b).symm x
  let f : {i : BirthOccurrence B b // c < (occurrence B i.index).death} → Fin r.val :=
    fun i => ⟨((birthEnumeration B b).symm i.val).val,
      (birthEnumeration B b).symm.strictMono
        (lt_of_death_gt B b (hc.trans_lt i.property))⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a d h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply (birthEnumeration B b).symm.injective
    exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun a : Fin r.val => a.val) h)
  have h := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  rwa [Fintype.card_fin, suffix_card] at h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthOrdinal_lt_birthSuffixCount
statement:
theorem birthOrdinal_lt_birthSuffixCount (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s B) (c : ℕ) (hc : c < (occurrence B i).death) :
    birthOrdinal B i < birthSuffixCount B (occurrence B i).birth c
proof:
:=
  ordinal_lt_suffix B _ c ⟨i, rfl⟩ hc

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthSuffixCount_le_birthOrdinal
statement:
theorem birthSuffixCount_le_birthOrdinal (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s B) (c : ℕ) (hc : (occurrence B i).death ≤ c) :
    birthSuffixCount B (occurrence B i).birth c ≤ birthOrdinal B i
proof:
:=
  suffix_le_ordinal B _ c ⟨i, rfl⟩ hc

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthSuffixCount_le_card
statement:
theorem birthSuffixCount_le_card (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s)) (b c : ℕ) :
    birthSuffixCount B b c ≤ Fintype.card (BirthOccurrence B b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← suffix_card]
  exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birth_card_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : Nonempty (BirthOccurrence (rankBarcode N) b)
  · obtain ⟨x⟩ := h
    have hbs : b < s := by
      have := (occurrence (rankBarcode N) x.index).birth_lt_death
      have := (occurrence (rankBarcode N) x.index).death_le_size
      rw [x.birth_eq] at *
      omega
    rw [birth_card, birth_card]
    exact birthSuffixCount_le_of_surjective p hp b b (le_refl b) hbs
  · have := not_nonempty_iff.mp h
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.groupEmbedding_rank
statement:
private theorem groupEmbedding_rank (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom) (b : ℕ)
    (x : BirthOccurrence (rankBarcode N) b) :
    ((birthEnumeration (rankBarcode M) b).symm (groupEmbedding p hp b x)).val =
      ((birthEnumeration (rankBarcode N) b).symm x).val
proof:
:= by
  simp [groupEmbedding]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.ordinal_in_group
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | mk i hi => cases hi; rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.mapOccurrence_birth
statement:
private theorem mapOccurrence_birth (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom) (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode M) (mapOccurrence p hp i)).birth =
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) i).birth
proof:
:=
  (groupEmbedding p hp _ ⟨i, rfl⟩).birth_eq

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.mapOccurrence_in_group
statement:
private theorem mapOccurrence_in_group (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom) (b : ℕ)
    (x : BirthOccurrence (rankBarcode N) b) :
    mapOccurrence p hp x.index = (groupEmbedding p hp b x).index
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | mk i hi => cases hi; rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.mapOccurrence_ordinal
proof:
:= by
  let b := (occurrence (rankBarcode N) i).birth
  let x : BirthOccurrence (rankBarcode N) b := ⟨i, rfl⟩
  rw [mapOccurrence_in_group p hp b x, ordinal_in_group,
    groupEmbedding_rank, ← ordinal_in_group]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.occurrence_eq_of_birth_ordinal
proof:
:= by
  let b := (occurrence B i).birth
  let x : BirthOccurrence B b := ⟨i, rfl⟩
  let y : BirthOccurrence B b := ⟨j, hb.symm⟩
  have hxy : (birthEnumeration B b).symm x = (birthEnumeration B b).symm y := by
    apply Fin.ext
    rw [← ordinal_in_group B b x, ← ordinal_in_group B b y]
    exact ho
  exact congrArg BirthOccurrence.index ((birthEnumeration B b).symm.injective hxy)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_birth
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_birth (p : M ⟶ N) (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp i)).birth =
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) i).birth
proof: := mapOccurrence_birth p hp i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_ordinal
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_ordinal (p : M ⟶ N) (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    birthOrdinal (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp i) = birthOrdinal (rankBarcode N) i
proof:
:=
  mapOccurrence_ordinal p hp i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_death_le
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_death_le (p : M ⟶ N) (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) i).death ≤
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp i)).death
proof:
:= by
  let I := occurrence (rankBarcode N) i
  let x : BirthOccurrence (rankBarcode N) I.birth := ⟨i, rfl⟩
  let y := groupEmbedding p hp I.birth x
  change I.death ≤ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) y.index).death
  by_contra h
  have hlo := ordinal_lt_suffix (rankBarcode N) I.birth (I.death - 1) x (by
    change I.death - 1 < I.death
    have := I.birth_lt_death
    omega)
  have hhi := suffix_le_ordinal (rankBarcode M) I.birth (I.death - 1) y (by omega)
  have hcounts := birthSuffixCount_le_of_surjective p hp I.birth (I.death - 1)
    (by have := I.birth_lt_death; omega) (by have := I.death_le_size; have := I.birth_lt_death; omega)
  have he := groupEmbedding_rank p hp I.birth x
  change ((birthEnumeration (rankBarcode N) I.birth).symm x).val <
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode N) I.birth (I.death - 1) at hlo
  change ((birthEnumeration (rankBarcode M) I.birth).symm y).val =
    ((birthEnumeration (rankBarcode N) I.birth).symm x).val at he
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_terminal
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_terminal (p : M ⟶ N) (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) (hi : (occurrence (rankBarcode N) i).death = s) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp i)).death = s
proof:
:= by
  have h := epiEmbedding_death_le p hp i
  have := (occurrence (rankBarcode M) (epiEmbedding p hp i)).death_le_size
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_eq_iff
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_eq_iff (p : M ⟶ N) (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    epiEmbedding p hp i = a ↔
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) a).birth = (occurrence (rankBarcode N) i).birth ∧
      birthOrdinal (rankBarcode M) a = birthOrdinal (rankBarcode N) i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨epiEmbedding_birth p hp i, epiEmbedding_ordinal p hp i⟩
  · rintro ⟨hb, ho⟩
    exact occurrence_eq_of_birth_ordinal (rankBarcode M) _ _
      ((epiEmbedding_birth p hp i).trans hb.symm)
      ((epiEmbedding_ordinal p hp i).trans ho.symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_mem_range_iff
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_mem_range_iff (p : M ⟶ N)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom)
    (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    a ∈ Set.range (epiEmbedding p hp) ↔
      birthOrdinal (rankBarcode M) a <
        Fintype.card (BirthOccurrence (rankBarcode N) (occurrence (rankBarcode M) a).birth)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [epiEmbedding_birth, epiEmbedding_ordinal]
    exact ((birthEnumeration (rankBarcode N) _).symm ⟨i, rfl⟩).isLt
  · intro ha
    let q : Fin (Fintype.card (BirthOccurrence (rankBarcode N)
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) a).birth)) := ⟨birthOrdinal (rankBarcode M) a, ha⟩
    let x := birthEnumeration (rankBarcode N) (occurrence (rankBarcode M) a).birth q
    refine ⟨x.index, (epiEmbedding_eq_iff p hp _ a).mpr ⟨x.birth_eq.symm, ?_⟩⟩
    rw [ordinal_in_group (rankBarcode N) _ x]
    simp [x, q]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_id
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_id (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] :
    epiEmbedding (𝟙 M) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) = Function.Embedding.refl _
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.Embedding.ext
  intro i
  exact occurrence_eq_of_birth_ordinal (rankBarcode M) _ i
    (epiEmbedding_birth (𝟙 M) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) i)
    (epiEmbedding_ordinal (𝟙 M) (fun _ => Function.surjective_id) i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.epiEmbedding_comp
statement:
theorem epiEmbedding_comp {P : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s)}
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (P.obj i)] (p : M ⟶ N) (q : N ⟶ P)
    (hp : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (p.app i).hom) (hq : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (q.app i).hom) :
    epiEmbedding (p ≫ q) (fun i => (hq i).comp (hp i)) =
      (epiEmbedding q hq).trans (epiEmbedding p hp)
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.Embedding.ext
  intro i
  apply occurrence_eq_of_birth_ordinal (rankBarcode M)
  · exact (epiEmbedding_birth _ _ i).trans
      ((epiEmbedding_birth p hp _).trans (epiEmbedding_birth q hq i)).symm
  · exact (epiEmbedding_ordinal _ _ i).trans
      ((epiEmbedding_ordinal p hp _).trans (epiEmbedding_ordinal q hq i)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.translation_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem translation_apply (ε : ℝ≥0) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    translation ε a i = a i + (ε : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.shift_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_obj (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) : ((shift ε).obj M).obj a = M.obj (translation ε a)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.shift_map_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_map_app (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)} (f : M ⟶ N) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    ((shift ε).map f).app a = f.app (translation ε a)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.shift_structureMap
statement:
theorem shift_structureMap (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (h : a ≤ b) :
    structureMap ((shift ε).obj M) h = structureMap M ((translation ε).monotone' h)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.zeroIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroIso_hom_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (zeroIso M).hom.app a = M.map (eqToHom (show translation 0 a = a by
      funext i; simp))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.zeroIso_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroIso_inv_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (zeroIso M).inv.app a = M.map (eqToHom (show translation 0 a = a by
      funext i; simp).symm)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.compIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem compIso_hom_app (ε δ : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (compIso ε δ M).hom.app a = M.map (eqToHom
      (show translation δ (translation ε a) = translation (ε + δ) a by
        funext i; simp [add_assoc]))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.zeroIso_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem zeroIso_naturality
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (shift 0).map f ≫ (zeroIso N).hom = (zeroIso M).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  exact (f.naturality (eqToHom (show translation 0 a = a by funext i; simp))).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.zeroIso_inv_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem zeroIso_inv_naturality
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (zeroIso M).inv ≫ (shift 0).map f = f ≫ (zeroIso N).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  exact f.naturality (eqToHom (show translation 0 a = a by funext i; simp).symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.compIso_naturality
statement:
theorem compIso_naturality (ε δ : ℝ≥0)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (shift ε).map ((shift δ).map f) ≫ (compIso ε δ N).hom =
      (compIso ε δ M).hom ≫ (shift (ε + δ)).map f
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  exact (f.naturality _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.congrIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem congrIso_hom_app {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε = δ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (congrIso h M).hom.app a =
      M.map (eqToHom (congrArg (fun e : ℝ≥0 => translation e a) h))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.congrIso_refl
statement:
@[simp] theorem congrIso_refl (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    congrIso (rfl : ε = ε) M = Iso.refl _
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  exact M.map_id _

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.compIso_zero_left
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem compIso_zero_left (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (compIso 0 ε M).hom ≫ (congrIso (zero_add ε) M).hom =
      (zeroIso ((shift ε).obj M)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  rw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.compIso_zero_right
statement:
theorem compIso_zero_right (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (compIso ε 0 M).hom ≫ (congrIso (add_zero ε) M).hom =
      (shift ε).map (zeroIso M).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  rw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.compIso_assoc
statement:
theorem compIso_assoc (ε δ γ : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (compIso ε δ ((shift γ).obj M)).hom ≫ (compIso (ε + δ) γ M).hom =
      (shift ε).map (compIso δ γ M).hom ≫ (compIso ε (δ + γ) M).hom ≫
        (congrIso (add_assoc ε δ γ).symm M).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _
  erw [← M.map_comp, ← M.map_comp, ← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.transition_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem transition_app (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (transition ε M).app a = structureMap M
      (show a ≤ translation ε a from fun i => by
        change a i ≤ a i + (ε : ℝ)
        exact le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.transition_naturality
statement:
theorem transition_naturality (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    f ≫ transition ε N = transition ε M ≫ (shift ε).map f
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  change f.app a ≫ N.map _ = M.map _ ≫ f.app (translation ε a)
  exact (f.naturality _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.shiftLE_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftLE_app {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε ≤ δ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (shiftLE h M).app a = structureMap M
      (show translation ε a ≤ translation δ a from fun i => by
        change a i + (ε : ℝ) ≤ a i + (δ : ℝ)
        exact add_le_add le_rfl h)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.transition_zero
statement:
theorem transition_zero (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    transition 0 M ≫ (zeroIso M).hom = 𝟙 M
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = 𝟙 _
  erw [← M.map_comp]
  exact (congrArg M.map (Subsingleton.elim _ (𝟙 a))).trans (M.map_id a)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.transition_zero_eq
statement:
theorem transition_zero_eq (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    transition 0 M = (zeroIso M).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (zeroIso M).hom).mp
  rw [transition_zero, Iso.inv_hom_id]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.transition_congr
statement:
theorem transition_congr {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε = δ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    transition ε M ≫ (congrIso h M).hom = transition δ M
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  simp only [congrIso_refl, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateShift.transition_add
statement:
theorem transition_add (ε δ : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    transition ε M ≫ (shift ε).map (transition δ M) ≫
      (compIso ε δ M).hom = transition (ε + δ) M
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  erw [← M.map_comp, ← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSectionsExamples.signChangeModule_surjective
statement:
theorem signChangeModule_surjective (I : Set ℝ) (s t : I) (h : s ≤ t) :
    Function.Surjective (structureMapLinear (signChangeModule I) h)
proof:
:=
  ((signFrame s.val).symm.trans (signFrame t.val)).surjective

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSectionsExamples.exists_prescribed_section
statement:
theorem exists_prescribed_section (I : Set ℝ) (t : I) :
    ∃ x : sections (signChangeModule I), x.val t = (1 : ℚ)
proof:
:=
  evaluation_surjective_real (signChangeModule I) (signChangeModule_surjective I) t (1 : ℚ)

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSectionsExamples.exists_section_open_left_tail
statement:
theorem exists_section_open_left_tail :
    ∃ x : sections (signChangeModule (Set.Iio 1)), x.val ⟨0, by norm_num⟩ = (1 : ℚ)
proof:
:=
  exists_prescribed_section _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSectionsExamples.exists_section_closed_interval
statement:
theorem exists_section_closed_interval :
    ∃ x : sections (signChangeModule (Set.Icc (-1) 1)), x.val ⟨0, by norm_num⟩ = (1 : ℚ)
proof:
:=
  exists_prescribed_section _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSectionsExamples.exists_section_singleton
statement:
theorem exists_section_singleton :
    ∃ x : sections (signChangeModule {0}), x.val ⟨0, rfl⟩ = (1 : ℚ)
proof:
:=
  exists_prescribed_section _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.CompatibleSectionsExamples.crossing_zero_map_one
statement:
theorem crossing_zero_map_one :
    structureMapLinear (signChangeModule Set.univ)
      (show (⟨-1, Set.mem_univ _⟩ : (Set.univ : Set ℝ)) ≤ ⟨1, Set.mem_univ _⟩ by norm_num)
      (1 : ℚ) = (-1 : ℚ)
proof:
:= by
  change signFrame 1 ((signFrame (-1)).symm (1 : ℚ)) = -1
  norm_num [signFrame]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AtomicExamples.single_power_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost_zero_right]
  change (∑ i : ↥(Finsupp.single point w).support,
    ((Finsupp.single point w) i.1 : ℝ) * (diagonalCost i.1.1).toReal ^ p) = w * 2 ^ p
  calc
    _ = ∑ z ∈ (Finsupp.single point w).support,
        ((Finsupp.single point w) z : ℝ) * (diagonalCost z.1).toReal ^ p :=
      Finset.sum_coe_sort (Finsupp.single point w).support _
    _ = _ := by
      by_cases hw : w = 0
      · simp [hw]
      · rw [Finsupp.support_single point hw, Finset.sum_singleton, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
        norm_num [point, diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AtomicExamples.fractional_powered_cost
statement:
private theorem fractional_powered_cost :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue 2 (atomicMeasure halfDiagram) (atomicMeasure 0) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic_eq_native 2 (by norm_num)]
  norm_num [halfDiagram, single_power_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AtomicExamples.fractional_rooted_cost
statement:
private theorem fractional_rooted_cost :
    boundaryTransportDistance 1 (atomicMeasure halfDiagram) (atomicMeasure 0) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryTransportDistance_atomic_eq_native 1 (by norm_num)]
  change ENNReal.ofReal
    ((FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost 1 halfDiagram 0) ^ (1 : ℝ)⁻¹) = 1
  norm_num [halfDiagram, single_power_zero, ENNReal.ofReal_div_of_pos]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AtomicExamples.coincident_half_masses
statement:
private theorem coincident_half_masses :
    atomicMeasure (halfDiagram + halfDiagram) {point} = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomicMeasure_singleton]
  norm_num [halfDiagram]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AtomicExamples.coalesced_powered_cost
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : halfDiagram + halfDiagram = Finsupp.single point 1 := by
    unfold halfDiagram
    rw [← Finsupp.single_add, show (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0) + 1 / 2 = 1 by norm_num]
  rw [hsum, boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic_eq_native 2 (by norm_num)]
  norm_num [single_power_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AtomicExamples.zero_powered_cost
statement:
private theorem zero_powered_cost (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p (atomicMeasure 0) (atomicMeasure 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic_eq_native p hp]
  simp [FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AtomicExamples.fractional_minimizer
statement:
private theorem fractional_minimizer :
    ∃ π : Measure PlanSpace,
      IsBoundaryPlan π (atomicMeasure halfDiagram) (atomicMeasure 0) ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost 2 z ∂π) = 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hcost⟩ := exists_atomic_minimizing_boundaryPlan 2 (by norm_num) halfDiagram 0
  exact ⟨π, hπ, hcost.trans fractional_powered_cost⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexCharacter_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightVertexCharacter_apply (v : StrictVertex S)
    (c : RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) :
    rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v c =
      vertexQuotientCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v (MulOpposite.unop c)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexCharacter_algebraMap
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightVertexCharacter_algebraMap (v : StrictVertex S) (a : k) :
    rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) a) = a
proof:
:= by
  simp [rightVertexCharacter]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexCharacter_surjective
statement:
theorem rightVertexCharacter_surjective (v : StrictVertex S) :
    Function.Surjective (rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  exact ⟨algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) a,
    rightVertexCharacter_algebraMap (k := k) (S := S) v a⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.incidence_sum_apply
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih => simp [hi, IncidenceAlgebra.add_apply, ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.incidence_sum_diagonal_delta
statement:
theorem incidence_sum_diagonal_delta :
    (∑ p : PairPoset S, delta (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl) =
      (1 : Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext a b hab
  rw [incidence_sum_apply]
  by_cases h : a = b
  · subst b
    simp [IncidenceAlgebra.one_apply, delta_apply]
  · rw [IncidenceAlgebra.one_apply]
    simp only [if_neg h]
    change (∑ p : PairPoset S, if a = p ∧ b = p then (1 : k) else 0) = 0
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro p hp
    by_cases hap : a = p
    · subst p
      simp [h, eq_comm]
    · simp [hap]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightMatrixUnit_diagonal_sum
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightMatrixUnit_diagonal_sum :
    (∑ p : PairPoset S,
      rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [rightMatrixUnit]
  rw [← Finset.op_sum, ← map_sum (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))),
    incidence_sum_diagonal_delta]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightMatrixUnit_mul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightMatrixUnit_mul (p q r s : PairPoset S)
    (hpq : p ≤ q) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq *
        rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r s hrs =
      if h : s = p then
        rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r q (by subst p; exact hrs.trans hpq)
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
  simp only [MulOpposite.unop_mul, rightMatrixUnit, MulOpposite.unop_op]
  rw [← map_mul, delta_mul]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexCharacter_rightMatrixUnit
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightVertexCharacter_rightMatrixUnit (v : StrictVertex S)
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq) =
        if v.1 = p ∧ v.1 = q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [rightMatrixUnit, rightVertexCharacter, vertexQuotientCharacter_mk,
    vertexCharacter_delta]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightMatrixUnit_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightMatrixUnit_smul (v : StrictVertex S)
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (t : RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) :
    rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq • t =
      (if v.1 = p ∧ v.1 = q then t else 0)
proof:
:= by
  change rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq) • t = _
  simp [rightMatrixUnit, rightVertexCharacter, vertexQuotientCharacter_mk]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexModule_smul
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightVertexModule_smul (v : StrictVertex S)
    (c : RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
    (t : RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) :
    c • t = rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v c • t
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexCharacter_matrixScalar
statement:
theorem rightVertexCharacter_matrixScalar (v : StrictVertex S)
    (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q) (a : k) :
    rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
      (algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) a *
        rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq) =
      a * rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
        (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq)
proof:
:= by
  simp [map_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightMatrixUnit_eq_zero_of_isDiagonal
statement:
theorem rightMatrixUnit_eq_zero_of_isDiagonal (p : PairPoset S)
    (hp : IsDiagonal (S := S) p) :
    rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl = 0
proof:
:= by
  change MulOpposite.op
    (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
      (delta (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl)) = MulOpposite.op 0
  have hq : Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
      (delta (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl) = 0 := by
    rw [Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem]
    apply diagonalIdeal_mem_delta_of_cross (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl
    change p.val.2 ≤ p.val.1
    rw [hp]
  rw [hq]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexModule_isSimpleModule
statement:
theorem rightVertexModule_isSimpleModule (v : StrictVertex S) :
    IsSimpleModule (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
      (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v)
proof:
:= by
  let χ := rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
  letI : RingHomSurjective χ := ⟨rightVertexCharacter_surjective (k := k) (S := S) v⟩
  letI : Module (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) k := Module.compHom k χ
  let f : k →ₛₗ[χ] k :=
    { toFun := id
      map_add' := by intro a b; rfl
      map_smul' := by intro a b; rfl }
  have hf : Function.Bijective f := by
    constructor <;> intro a <;> simp [f]
  exact (LinearMap.isSimpleModule_iff_of_bijective f hf).2 inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightMatrixUnit_smul_on_maximal_active
statement:
private theorem rightMatrixUnit_smul_on_maximal_active
    (M : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    (p : PairPoset S)
    (hmax : Maximal (fun t : PairPoset S => t ∈ activeVertices (k := k) (S := S) M) p)
    (m : M) (r s : PairPoset S) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r s hrs •
        (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m) =
      if r = p ∧ s = p then rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_smul]
  rw [rightMatrixUnit_mul]
  by_cases hr : r = p
  · subst r
    by_cases hs : s = p
    · subst s
      simp
    · have hps : p < s := lt_of_le_of_ne hrs (Ne.symm hs)
      have hzero : rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p s hrs • m = 0 := by
        by_contra hne
        have hfix : rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) s s le_rfl •
            (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p s hrs • m) =
              rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p s hrs • m := by
          rw [smul_smul]
          rw [rightMatrixUnit_mul]
          simp
        have hsActive : s ∈ activeVertices (k := k) (S := S) M := by
          simp only [activeVertices, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
          refine ⟨rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p s hrs • m, ?_⟩
          simpa only [hfix] using hne
        have hsp : s ≤ p := hmax.2 hsActive (le_of_lt hps)
        exact (not_lt_of_ge hsp) hps
      simp [hs, hzero]
  · have hpr : p ≠ r := Ne.symm hr
    simp [hr, hpr]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightMatrixUnit_scalar_mul
statement:
private theorem rightMatrixUnit_scalar_mul (p q : PairPoset S) (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (a : k) :
    MulOpposite.op (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
      (a • delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq)) =
      rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq *
        algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [Algebra.smul_def]
  change MulOpposite.op (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
      (algebraMap k (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) a *
        delta (k := k) (S := S) p q hpq)) = _
  rw [map_mul]
  simp [rightMatrixUnit]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightQuotient_mk_eq_matrixUnit_sum
statement:
private theorem rightQuotient_mk_eq_matrixUnit_sum
    (a : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    MulOpposite.op (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) a) =
      ∑ cp : ComparablePair S,
        rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) cp.1.1 cp.1.2 cp.2 *
          algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) (a cp.1.1 cp.1.2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  conv_lhs => rw [incidence_eq_deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S) a]
  rw [FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.deltaExpansion]
  rw [map_sum (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)))]
  rw [Finset.op_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro cp hcp
  exact rightMatrixUnit_scalar_mul (k := k) (S := S)
    cp.1.1 cp.1.2 cp.2 (a cp.1.1 cp.1.2)

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightMatrixUnit_scalar_smul_on_maximal_active
statement:
private theorem rightMatrixUnit_scalar_smul_on_maximal_active
    (M : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    (p : PairPoset S)
    (hmax : Maximal (fun t : PairPoset S => t ∈ activeVertices (k := k) (S := S) M) p)
    (m : M) (r s : PairPoset S) (hrs : r ≤ s) (a : k) :
    (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r s hrs *
      algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) a) •
        (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m) =
      if r = p ∧ s = p then
        a • (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m) else 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r s hrs •
          (algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) a •
            (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m)) := by
          rw [mul_smul]
    _ = rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r s hrs •
          (a • (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m)) := by
          rw [algebraMap_smul]
    _ = a • (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r s hrs •
          (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m)) := by
          exact (smul_comm a (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) r s hrs)
            (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m)).symm
    _ = if r = p ∧ s = p then
          a • (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m) else 0 := by
          rw [rightMatrixUnit_smul_on_maximal_active M p hmax m r s hrs]
          by_cases h : r = p ∧ s = p <;> simp [h]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexCharacter_eigen_on_maximal_active
statement:
private theorem rightVertexCharacter_eigen_on_maximal_active
    (M : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    (v : StrictVertex S) (hmax : Maximal
      (fun t : PairPoset S => t ∈ activeVertices (k := k) (S := S) M) v.1)
    (m : M) (hmActive :
      rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) v.1 v.1 le_rfl • m ≠ 0)
    (c : RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) :
    c • (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) v.1 v.1 le_rfl • m) =
      algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
        (rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v c) •
          (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) v.1 v.1 le_rfl • m)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective (MulOpposite.unop c)
  let c' : RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S) :=
    MulOpposite.op (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) a)
  have hc : c' = c := by
    simpa [c'] using congrArg MulOpposite.op ha
  have hchar : rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v c = a v.1 v.1 := by
    rw [← hc]
    simp [c', rightVertexCharacter_apply, vertexQuotientCharacter_mk,
      TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensor.vertexCharacter_apply]
  let x := rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) v.1 v.1 le_rfl • m
  have hsum : (∑ cp : ComparablePair S,
      (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) cp.1.1 cp.1.2 cp.2 *
        algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) (a cp.1.1 cp.1.2)) • x) =
      algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) (a v.1 v.1) • x := by
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem
      (⟨(v.1, v.1), le_rfl⟩ : ComparablePair S) (Finset.mem_univ _)]
    · rw [rightMatrixUnit_scalar_smul_on_maximal_active
        (k := k) (S := S) M v.1 hmax m v.1 v.1 le_rfl
        (a v.1 v.1)]
      rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, rfl⟩]
      exact (IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul (R := k)
        (A := RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) (r := a v.1 v.1) (x := x)).symm
    · intro cp hcp hcpNe
      have hnot : ¬(cp.1.1 = v.1 ∧ cp.1.2 = v.1) := by
        intro h
        apply hcpNe
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact Prod.ext h.1 h.2
      rw [rightMatrixUnit_scalar_smul_on_maximal_active
        (k := k) (S := S) M v.1 hmax m cp.1.1 cp.1.2 cp.2
        (a cp.1.1 cp.1.2)]
      simp [x, hnot]
  calc
    c • x = c' • x := by rw [hc]
    _ = (∑ cp : ComparablePair S,
        rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) cp.1.1 cp.1.2 cp.2 *
          algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) (a cp.1.1 cp.1.2)) • x := by
        change MulOpposite.op (Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) a) • x = _
        rw [rightQuotient_mk_eq_matrixUnit_sum]
    _ = ∑ cp : ComparablePair S,
        (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) cp.1.1 cp.1.2 cp.2 *
          algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) (a cp.1.1 cp.1.2)) • x :=
        by rw [Finset.sum_smul]
    _ = algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) (a v.1 v.1) • x := hsum
    _ = algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
          (rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v c) • x := by rw [hchar]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexModuleGeneratedMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightVertexModuleGeneratedMap_apply
    [Module (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) k]
    (M : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    (v : StrictVertex S) (x : M)
    (hscalar : ∀ (c : RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) (t : k),
      c • t = rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v c • t)
    (hχ : ∀ c : RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S),
      c • x = algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
        (rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v c) • x) (t : k) :
    rightVertexModuleGeneratedMap (k := k) (S := S) M v x hscalar hχ t =
      algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) t • x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.rightVertexModule_iso_iff
statement:
theorem rightVertexModule_iso_iff (v w : StrictVertex S) :
    Nonempty (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v ≅
      RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) w) ↔ v = w
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i⟩
    by_contra hvw
    have hvertices : v.1 ≠ w.1 := by
      intro h
      exact hvw (Subtype.ext h)
    let e := rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) v.1 v.1 le_rfl
    letI : Module (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) k :=
      (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v).isModule
    letI : Module (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
        (↑(RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) w)) :=
      (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) w).isModule
    have hsource : e • (1 : k) = 1 := by
      change rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
        (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) v.1 v.1 le_rfl) * 1 = 1
      rw [rightVertexCharacter_rightMatrixUnit]
      simp
    let m : k := 1
    have hχ : rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) w e = 0 := by
      have hvertices' : w.1 ≠ v.1 := Ne.symm hvertices
      change rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) w
        (rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) v.1 v.1 le_rfl) = 0
      rw [rightVertexCharacter_rightMatrixUnit]
      simp [hvertices']
    have hmap : i.hom.hom m = 0 := by
      calc
        i.hom.hom m = i.hom.hom (e • m) := by
          rw [hsource]
        _ = e • i.hom.hom m := i.hom.hom.map_smul e m
        _ = 0 := by
          change rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) w e • i.hom.hom m = 0
          rw [hχ]
          simp
    have hone : (1 : k) = 0 := by
      let i' := i.toLinearEquiv
      have hm : m = 0 := by
        have hmap' : i' m = 0 := by
          change i.hom.hom m = 0
          exact hmap
        have heq : i' m = i' 0 := by rw [hmap']; simp
        exact i'.injective heq
      calc
        1 = m := by simp [m]
        _ = 0 := hm
    exact one_ne_zero hone
  · intro h
    subst w
    exact ⟨Iso.refl _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex
statement:
theorem simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex
    (M : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    [IsSimpleModule (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M] :
    ∃! v : StrictVertex S,
      Nonempty (M ≅ RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Nontrivial M := IsSimpleModule.nontrivial
    (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_ne (0 : M)
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := hm
  have hsum : (∑ p : PairPoset S,
      rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m) = m := by
    calc
      (∑ p : PairPoset S,
          rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m) =
          (∑ p : PairPoset S,
            rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl) • m := by
              rw [Finset.sum_smul]
      _ = m := by
        rw [rightMatrixUnit_diagonal_sum]
        exact one_smul (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) m
  have hactive : (activeVertices (k := k) (S := S) M).Nonempty := by
    by_contra hnone
    have hz : ∀ p : PairPoset S,
        rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m = 0 := by
      intro p
      by_contra hp
      apply hnone
      refine ⟨p, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩⟩
      exact ⟨m, hp⟩
    have hmEq : m = 0 := by
      calc
        m = ∑ p : PairPoset S,
            rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m := hsum.symm
        _ = ∑ p : PairPoset S, 0 := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro p hp
              exact hz p
        _ = 0 := by simp
    exact hm0 hmEq
  obtain ⟨p, hmax⟩ := (activeVertices (k := k) (S := S) M).exists_maximal hactive
  have hpActive : p ∈ activeVertices (k := k) (S := S) M := hmax.1
  obtain ⟨m₀, hmActive⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hpActive).2
  have hpNotDiagonal : ¬ IsDiagonal (S := S) p := by
    intro hpDiagonal
    have hz := rightMatrixUnit_eq_zero_of_isDiagonal (k := k) (S := S) p hpDiagonal
    rw [hz, zero_smul] at hmActive
    exact hmActive rfl
  have hneq : p.val.1 ≠ p.val.2 := by
    intro h
    exact hpNotDiagonal h
  let v : StrictVertex S := ⟨p, lt_of_le_of_ne p.property hneq⟩
  let x : M := rightMatrixUnit (k := k) (S := S) p p le_rfl • m₀
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := hmActive
  have heigen (c : RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) :
      c • x = algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S))
        (rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v c) • x := by
    simpa [x, v] using rightVertexCharacter_eigen_on_maximal_active
      (k := k) (S := S) M v hmax m₀ hmActive c
  letI : Module (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) k :=
    Module.compHom k (rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v)
  have hV : RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v =
      ModuleCat.of (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) k := rfl
  letI : IsSimpleModule (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) k := by
    let χ := rightVertexCharacter (k := k) (S := S) v
    letI : RingHomSurjective χ :=
      ⟨rightVertexCharacter_surjective (k := k) (S := S) v⟩
    let g : k →ₛₗ[χ] k :=
      { toFun := id
        map_add' := by intro a b; rfl
        map_smul' := by intro a b; rfl }
    have hg : Function.Bijective g := by
      constructor <;> intro a <;> simp [g]
    exact (LinearMap.isSimpleModule_iff_of_bijective g hg).2 inferInstance
  let f := rightVertexModuleGeneratedMap (k := k) (S := S) M v x
    (by intro c t; rfl) heigen
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hxzero : f (1 : k) = 0 := by rw [hzero]; simp
    apply hx
    change algebraMap k (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) 1 • x = 0 at hxzero
    simpa using hxzero
  let e : k ≃ₗ[RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)] M :=
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective f (LinearMap.bijective_of_ne_zero hf)
  have i₀ : RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v ≅ M := by
    simpa [hV] using e.toModuleIso
  refine ⟨v, ⟨i₀.symm⟩, ?_⟩
  intro w ⟨i⟩
  have hIso : Nonempty (RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v ≅
      RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) w) := ⟨i₀ ≪≫ i⟩
  exact ((rightVertexModule_iso_iff (k := k) (S := S) v w).mp hIso).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex_and_derivedZero
statement:
theorem simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex_and_derivedZero
    (M : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    [IsSimpleModule (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M] :
    ∃! v : StrictVertex S,
      Nonempty (M ≅ RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) ∧
      Nonempty (restrictRightQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S) M ≅
        (((TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.vertexTensor (k := k) (S := S) v).leftDerived 0).obj
          (TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientModule
            (k := k) (S := S))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, ⟨i⟩, hunique⟩ := simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex (k := k) (S := S) M
  refine ⟨v, ⟨⟨i⟩, ⟨simpleModule_leftDerivedZeroIso (k := k) (S := S) M v i⟩⟩, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  exact hunique w hw.1

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientSimple.simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex_positiveLeftDerived_isZero
statement:
theorem simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex_positiveLeftDerived_isZero
    (M : ModuleCat (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)))
    [IsSimpleModule (RightQuotient (k := k) (S := S)) M]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃! v : StrictVertex S,
      Nonempty (M ≅ RightVertexModule (k := k) (S := S) v) ∧
      CategoryTheory.Limits.IsZero (((TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTensorFunctor.vertexTensor
        (k := k) (S := S) v).leftDerived n).obj
        (TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotientModule (k := k) (S := S)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hmodule, hunique⟩ := simpleModule_existsUnique_vertex (k := k) (S := S) M
  refine ⟨v, ⟨hmodule, TDA.Persistence.IncidenceVertexTor.diagonalQuotient_leftDerived_pos_isZero
    (k := k) (S := S) v n hn⟩, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  exact hunique w hw.1

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.exists_relation_distortion_le_of_hausdorffDist_lt
statement:
theorem exists_relation_distortion_le_of_hausdorffDist_lt
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v} {Z : Type w}
    [MetricSpace X] [MetricSpace Y] [MetricSpace Z]
    {f : X → Z} {g : Y → Z} (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g)
    (hfin : hausdorffEDist (range f) (range g) ≠ ⊤)
    {ε : ℝ≥0} (hε : 2 * hausdorffDist (range f) (range g) < (ε : ℝ)) :
    ∃ C : SetRel X Y,
      Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x, y) ∈ C) ∧
      Relator.LeftTotal (fun y x => (y, x) ∈ C.inv) ∧
      ∀ x x' y y', (x, y) ∈ C → (x', y') ∈ C →
        |dist x x' - dist y y'| ≤ (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : hausdorffDist (range f) (range g) < (ε : ℝ) / 2 := by linarith
  let C : SetRel X Y := {p | dist (f p.1) (g p.2) < (ε : ℝ) / 2}
  refine ⟨C, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨y, rfl⟩, hy⟩ :=
      exists_dist_lt_of_hausdorffDist_lt (mem_range_self x) hr hfin
    exact ⟨y, hy⟩
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, hx⟩ :=
      exists_dist_lt_of_hausdorffDist_lt' (mem_range_self y) hr hfin
    exact ⟨x, hx⟩
  · intro x x' y y' hxy hx'y'
    change dist (f x) (g y) < (ε : ℝ) / 2 at hxy
    change dist (f x') (g y') < (ε : ℝ) / 2 at hx'y'
    rw [← hf.dist_eq, ← hg.dist_eq]
    have h := dist_dist_dist_le (f x) (f x') (g y) (g y')
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at h
    exact h.trans (by linarith)

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.realInterleavingDistance_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist_of_ne_top
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist_of_ne_top
    {Z : Type w} [MetricSpace Z] {f : X → Z} {g : Y → Z}
    (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g)
    (hfin : hausdorffEDist (range f) (range g) ≠ ⊤) (n : ℕ) :
    realInterleavingDistance (sublevelModule R (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
      (sublevelModule R (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace Y)) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * hausdorffDist (range f) (range g))
proof:
:= by
  let δ : ℝ≥0 := ⟨2 * hausdorffDist (range f) (range g),
    mul_nonneg (by norm_num) hausdorffDist_nonneg⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ (δ : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      apply ENNReal.le_of_forall_pos_le_add
      intro η hη _
      have hε : 2 * hausdorffDist (range f) (range g) < ((δ + η : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
        change 2 * hausdorffDist (range f) (range g) <
          2 * hausdorffDist (range f) (range g) + (η : ℝ)
        exact lt_add_of_pos_right _ hη
      simpa only [ENNReal.coe_add] using
        (hausdorffInterleavingOfLt R hf hg hfin hε n).distance_le
    _ = _ := ENNReal.coe_nnreal_eq δ

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.realInterleavingDistance_le_two_mul_hausdorffEDist
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_le_two_mul_hausdorffEDist
    {Z : Type w} [MetricSpace Z] {f : X → Z} {g : Y → Z}
    (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g) (n : ℕ) :
    realInterleavingDistance (sublevelModule R (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
      (sublevelModule R (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace Y)) n) ≤
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * hausdorffEDist (range f) (range g)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hfin : hausdorffEDist (range f) (range g) = ⊤
  · simp [hfin]
  · have h := realInterleavingDistance_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist_of_ne_top R hf hg hfin n
    have heq : ENNReal.ofReal (2 * hausdorffDist (range f) (range g)) =
        (2 : ℝ≥0∞) * hausdorffEDist (range f) (range g) := by
      rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num), hausdorffDist, ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfin]
      norm_num
    exact h.trans_eq heq

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.realInterleavingDistance_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist_of_totallyBounded
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist_of_totallyBounded
    [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y] {Z : Type w} [MetricSpace Z]
    {f : X → Z} {g : Y → Z} (hf : Isometry f) (hg : Isometry g)
    (hX : TotallyBounded (range f)) (hY : TotallyBounded (range g)) (n : ℕ) :
    realInterleavingDistance (sublevelModule R (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n)
      (sublevelModule R (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace Y)) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (2 * hausdorffDist (range f) (range g))
proof:
:=
  realInterleavingDistance_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist_of_ne_top R hf hg
    (hausdorffEDist_ne_top_of_nonempty_of_bounded (range_nonempty _) (range_nonempty _)
      hX.isBounded hY.isBounded) n

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_le_card_rpow_mul_faceSupDifference
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_le_card_rpow_mul_faceSupDifference
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : (dgm k f n).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : (dgm k g n).finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤
      (((Fintype.card (dgm k f n).finiteOccurrences +
        Fintype.card (dgm k g n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) *
        faceSupDifference f g
proof:
:=
  finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_card_rpow_mul_of_bottleneck_le hp _ _
    (faceSupDifference_nonneg f g) (bottleneck_dgm_le_faceSupDifference k f g n)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_le_cardBound_rpow_mul_faceSupDifference
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_le_cardBound_rpow_mul_faceSupDifference
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) (n : ℕ) {m : ℕ}
    (hcard : Fintype.card (dgm k f n).finiteOccurrences +
      Fintype.card (dgm k g n).finiteOccurrences ≤ m) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : (dgm k f n).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : (dgm k g n).finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤
      (m : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * faceSupDifference f g
proof:
:=
  finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_cardBound_rpow_mul_of_bottleneck_le hp _ _ hcard
    (faceSupDifference_nonneg f g) (bottleneck_dgm_le_faceSupDifference k f g n)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelInjectivityExamples.duplicate_quadratic_zero
statement:
theorem duplicate_quadratic_zero :
    (Finsupp.single 0 1 - Finsupp.single 1 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℝ).sum
        (fun i a => (Finsupp.single 0 1 - Finsupp.single 1 1 : Fin 2 →₀ ℝ).sum
          (fun j b => star a *
            (Matrix.of fun i j => kernel 1 (duplicate i) (duplicate j)) i j * b)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [Finsupp.sum_fintype, Fin.sum_univ_two, duplicate, Matrix.of_apply,
    kernel_self]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelInjectivityExamples.duplicate_not_posDef
statement:
theorem duplicate_not_posDef :
    ¬ (Matrix.of fun i j => kernel 1 (duplicate i) (duplicate j)).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  let v : Fin 2 →₀ ℝ := Finsupp.single 0 1 - Finsupp.single 1 1
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro hv
    have hv0 := congrArg (fun f : Fin 2 →₀ ℝ => f 0) hv
    simp [v] at hv0
  have hp := h.2 hv
  have hz : v.sum (fun i a => v.sum (fun j b => star a *
      (Matrix.of fun i j => kernel 1 (duplicate i) (duplicate j)) i j * b)) = 0 := by
    simpa [v] using duplicate_quadratic_zero
  rw [hz] at hp
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelInjectivityExamples.twice_embedding_ne_singleton
statement:
theorem twice_embedding_ne_singleton :
    diagramEmbedding 1 clippedWeight twice ≠
      diagramEmbedding 1 clippedWeight (singletonDiagram 0 2 (by norm_num))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hTwice : ∀ p ∈ finitePart twice.points,
      0 < clippedWeight (birthPersistence p) := by
    intro p hp
    have hf : finitePart twice.points = {(0, 2), (0, 2)} := rfl
    rw [hf, Multiset.insert_eq_cons, Multiset.mem_cons, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hp
    rcases hp with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num [clippedWeight, birthPersistence]
  have hSingle : ∀ p ∈ finitePart (singletonDiagram 0 2 (by norm_num)).points,
      0 < clippedWeight (birthPersistence p) := by
    intro p hp
    have hf : finitePart (singletonDiagram 0 2 (by norm_num)).points = {(0, 2)} := rfl
    rw [hf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hp
    subst p
    norm_num [clippedWeight, birthPersistence]
  have hfin := (diagramEmbedding_eq_iff (σ := 1) (by norm_num)
    clippedWeight hTwice hSingle).mp h
  have hfTwice : finitePart twice.points = {(0, 2), (0, 2)} := rfl
  have hfSingle : finitePart (singletonDiagram 0 2 (by norm_num)).points = {(0, 2)} := rfl
  rw [hfTwice, hfSingle] at hfin
  have hc := congrArg (fun s : Multiset (ℝ × ℝ) => s.count (0, 2)) hfin
  norm_num at hc

name: TDA.Persistence.countP_finset_sum
statement:
private theorem countP_finset_sum {α ι : Type*} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → Multiset α) :
    (∑ x ∈ s, f x).countP p = ∑ x ∈ s, (f x).countP p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert a s ha ih => simp [ha, Multiset.countP_add, ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.countP_replicate_interval
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih => simp [Multiset.replicate_succ, Multiset.countP_cons, ih]; split_ifs <;> omega

name: TDA.Persistence.rankBarcode_count
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let fb : Fin N := ⟨b, by omega⟩
  let fd : Fin (N + 1) := ⟨d, by omega⟩
  unfold barcodeMultiplicity rankBarcode
  rw [countP_finset_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single fb]
  · rw [countP_finset_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single fd]
    · simpa [fb, fd, hbd] using
        (countP_replicate_interval
          (⟨b, d, hbd, hd⟩ : FiniteInterval N)
          (moduleMultiplicityInteger M b d).toNat b d)
    · intro y hy hne
      by_cases h : fb.val < y.val
      · simp [h, countP_replicate_interval]
        have : y.val ≠ d := by
          intro he
          apply hne
          exact Fin.ext he
        simp [this]
      · simp [h]
    · simp [fd]
  · intro x hx hne
    rw [countP_finset_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro y hy
    by_cases h : x.val < y.val
    · simp [h, countP_replicate_interval]
      have : x.val ≠ b := by
        intro he
        apply hne
        exact Fin.ext he
      simp [this]
    · simp [h]
  · simp [fb]

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode
