theorem barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (b d : ℕ)
    (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    (barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode M) b d : ℤ) =
      moduleMultiplicityInteger M b d
proof:

  exact Int.toNat_of_nonneg (moduleMultiplicityInteger_nonneg M b d hbd hd)

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleRankInteger_barcodeModule
statement:
private theorem moduleRankInteger_barcodeModule (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N))
    (i j : ℤ) :
    moduleRankInteger (barcodeModule (k := k) B) i j =
      barcodeRankInteger (k := k) B i j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold moduleRankInteger barcodeRankInteger
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleMultiplicityInteger_barcodeModule
statement:
private theorem moduleMultiplicityInteger_barcodeModule
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) (b d : ℕ)
    (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (barcodeModule (k := k) B) b d =
      (barcodeMultiplicity B b d : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [multiplicity_eq_rank_difference (k := k) B b d hbd hd]
  simp only [moduleMultiplicityInteger, moduleRankInteger_barcodeModule]

name: TDA.Persistence.rankBarcode_integer_ranks
proof:
:= by
  let B := rankBarcode M
  have hB := structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger
    (barcodeModule (k := k) B) i j hij
  have hM := structureMapRank_eq_sum_moduleMultiplicityInteger M i j hij
  rw [hB, hM]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b hb
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d hd
  have hbd : b < d := by
    have hbi : b ≤ i.val := Finset.mem_range_succ_iff.mp hb
    have hjd : j.val < d := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hd |>.1
    have hij' := Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp hij
    omega
  have hdN : d ≤ N := (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hd).2
  rw [moduleMultiplicityInteger_barcodeModule B b d hbd hdN,
    barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode M b d hbd hdN]

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapRank_rankBarcode
statement:
theorem structureMapRank_rankBarcode (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) (rankBarcode M)) i j hij =
      structureMapRank M i j hij
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast rankBarcode_integer_ranks M i j hij

name: TDA.Persistence.rankBarcode_barcodeModule
statement:
theorem rankBarcode_barcodeModule (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N)) :
    rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := k) B) = B
proof:
:= by
  apply rankBarcode_count_eq
  intro b d hbd hd
  have hnew := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := k) B) b d hbd hd
  rw [moduleMultiplicityInteger_barcodeModule B b d hbd hd] at hnew
  exact_mod_cast hnew

name: TDA.Persistence.rankBarcode_eq_iff
statement:
theorem rankBarcode_eq_iff
    (L : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N))
    [∀ i : Fin N, FiniteDimensional k (L.obj i)] :
    rankBarcode M = rankBarcode L ↔
      ∀ (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j),
        structureMapRank M i j hij = structureMapRank L i j hij
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i j hij
    calc
      structureMapRank M i j hij =
          structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) (rankBarcode M)) i j hij :=
        (structureMapRank_rankBarcode M i j hij).symm
      _ = structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) (rankBarcode L)) i j hij := by rw [h]
      _ = structureMapRank L i j hij := structureMapRank_rankBarcode L i j hij
  · intro h
    apply rankBarcode_count_eq
    intro b d hbd hd
    have heq : moduleMultiplicityInteger M b d = moduleMultiplicityInteger L b d := by
      have hrank : ∀ i j, moduleRankInteger M i j = moduleRankInteger L i j := by
        intro i j
        classical
        unfold moduleRankInteger
        split_ifs with hv
        · have hi := Int.toNat_of_nonneg hv.1
          have hj := Int.toNat_of_nonneg (hv.1.trans hv.2.1)
          have hle : i.toNat ≤ j.toNat := by omega
          have hr := h ⟨i.toNat, by omega⟩ ⟨j.toNat, by omega⟩
            (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr hle)
          simpa using congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℤ)) hr
        · rfl
      simp only [moduleMultiplicityInteger, hrank]
    have hm := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode M b d hbd hd
    have hl := barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode L b d hbd hd
    exact_mod_cast hm.trans (heq.trans hl.symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.comp_eq_zero
statement: theorem comp_eq_zero (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) : ι ≫ π = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext p x
  have hx : (ι.app p).hom x ∈ LinearMap.range (ι.app p).hom := ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [hs.range_eq_ker p] at hx
  exact hx

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.kernelComparison_ι
statement:
private theorem kernelComparison_ι (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) :
    kernelComparison hs ≫ kernel.ι π = ι
proof: := kernel.lift_ι π ι hs.comp_eq_zero

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.kernelComparison_injective
statement:
private theorem kernelComparison_injective (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) (p : P) :
    Function.Injective ((kernelComparison hs).app p).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply hs.injective p
  have hx := congrArg (fun f : L ⟶ M => (f.app p).hom x) (kernelComparison_ι hs)
  have hy := congrArg (fun f : L ⟶ M => (f.app p).hom y) (kernelComparison_ι hs)
  exact hx.symm.trans ((congrArg ((kernel.ι π).app p).hom hxy).trans hy)

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.kernelComparison_surjective
statement:
private theorem kernelComparison_surjective (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) (p : P) :
    Function.Surjective ((kernelComparison hs).app p).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  have hz : ((kernel.ι π).app p).hom z ∈ LinearMap.ker (π.app p).hom :=
    congrArg (fun f : kernel π ⟶ N => (f.app p).hom z) (kernel.condition π)
  rw [← hs.range_eq_ker p] at hz
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  apply RankKernel.injective π p
  have he := congrArg (fun f : L ⟶ M => (f.app p).hom x) (kernelComparison_ι hs)
  exact he.trans hx

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.kernelIso_hom_ι
statement:
theorem kernelIso_hom_ι (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) :
    hs.kernelIso.hom ≫ kernel.ι π = ι
proof: := kernelComparison_ι hs

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.shortExact
statement:
theorem shortExact (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) :
    (ShortComplex.mk ι π hs.comp_eq_zero).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let Q := ShortComplex.mk ι π hs.comp_eq_zero
  have hEpi : Epi π := (NatTrans.epi_iff_epi_app π).2 (fun p =>
    (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).2 (hs.surjective p))
  let K := ShortComplex.mk (kernel.ι π) π (kernel.condition π)
  have hK : K.ShortExact := ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk'
    (ShortComplex.exact_kernel π) inferInstance hEpi
  have hinv : (hs.kernelIso).inv ≫ ι = kernel.ι π := by
    calc
      (hs.kernelIso).inv ≫ ι = (hs.kernelIso).inv ≫
          ((hs.kernelIso).hom ≫ kernel.ι π) := by rw [hs.kernelIso_hom_ι]
      _ = kernel.ι π := by simp [Category.assoc]
  let e : K ≅ Q := ShortComplex.isoMk (hs.kernelIso).symm (Iso.refl _)
    (Iso.refl _) hinv
  exact ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso e hK

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankDeflation.splitKernelIso_hom_snd
statement:
theorem splitKernelIso_hom_snd (hs : IsRankDeflation π) (hN : IsRankProjective N) :
    (hs.splitKernelIso hN).hom ≫ biprod.snd = π
proof:
:= by
  change biprod.lift _ π ≫ biprod.snd = π
  exact biprod.lift_snd _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankDeflation.splitKernelIso_inl_inv
statement:
theorem splitKernelIso_inl_inv (hs : IsRankDeflation π) (hN : IsRankProjective N) :
    biprod.inl ≫ (hs.splitKernelIso hN).inv = kernel.ι π
proof:
:= by
  change biprod.inl ≫ biprod.desc (kernel.ι π) _ = kernel.ι π
  exact biprod.inl_desc _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_mem_points
statement:
private theorem finitePart_mem_points {α : Type w} [LinearOrder α]
    {D : Diagram α} {x : α × α} (hx : x ∈ finitePart D.points) :
    (x.1, (x.2 : WithTop α)) ∈ D.points
proof:
:= by
  rw [← parts_reconstruct D.points]
  exact Multiset.mem_add.mpr <|
    Or.inl (Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_mem_points
statement:
private theorem essentialPart_mem_points {α : Type w} [LinearOrder α]
    {D : Diagram α} {b : α} (hb : b ∈ essentialPart D.points) :
    (b, (⊤ : WithTop α)) ∈ D.points
proof:
:= by
  rw [← parts_reconstruct D.points]
  exact Multiset.mem_add.mpr <|
    Or.inr (Multiset.mem_map.mpr ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_finitePart_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem dgm_finitePart_mem_Icc {f : FilterFunction K ℝ} {M : ℝ} (n : ℕ)
    (h0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ f.value s) (hM : ∀ s, f.value s ≤ M) :
    ∀ x ∈ finitePart (dgm k f n).points,
      0 ≤ x.1 ∧ x.1 < x.2 ∧ x.2 ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ :=
    (TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues f x.1).1
      (mem_criticalValues_of_mem_finitePart_dgm k f hx).1
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ :=
    (TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues f x.2).1
      (mem_criticalValues_of_mem_finitePart_dgm k f hx).2
  have hpos := dgm_isPositive k f n _ (finitePart_mem_points hx)
  have hlt : x.1 < x.2 := WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp hpos
  refine ⟨?_, hlt, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hs]
    exact h0 s
  · rw [← ht]
    exact hM t

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_essentialPart_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem dgm_essentialPart_mem_Icc {f : FilterFunction K ℝ} {M : ℝ} (n : ℕ)
    (h0 : ∀ s, 0 ≤ f.value s) (hM : ∀ s, f.value s ≤ M) :
    ∀ b ∈ essentialPart (dgm k f n).points, 0 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ M
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ :=
    (TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues f b).1
      (mem_criticalValues_of_mem_essentialPart_dgm k f hb)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← hs]
    exact h0 s
  · rw [← hs]
    exact hM s

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.dgm_coordinates_le_diameter
statement:
theorem dgm_coordinates_le_diameter (d : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ x ∈ finitePart (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).points,
      0 ≤ x.1 ∧ x.1 < x.2 ∧ x.2 ≤ Rips.diameter d Finset.univ) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ essentialPart (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).points,
      0 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ Rips.diameter d Finset.univ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply dgm_finitePart_mem_Icc k n
    · intro s
      simpa [Rips.filter_value] using Rips.diameter_nonneg d s.val
    · intro s
      exact Rips.filter_value_le_diameter_univ d s
  · apply dgm_essentialPart_mem_Icc k n
    · intro s
      simpa [Rips.filter_value] using Rips.diameter_nonneg d s.val
    · intro s
      exact Rips.filter_value_le_diameter_univ d s

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.dgm_coordinates_le_radiusAt
statement:
theorem dgm_coordinates_le_radiusAt (p : V → X) (x : X) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ y ∈ finitePart (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).points,
      0 ≤ y.1 ∧ y.1 < y.2 ∧ y.2 ≤ Cech.radiusAt p x Finset.univ) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ essentialPart (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).points,
      0 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ Cech.radiusAt p x Finset.univ)
proof:
:= by
  have hM (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
      (Cech.filter p).value s ≤ Cech.radiusAt p x Finset.univ := by
    exact (Cech.filter_value_le_radiusAt p s x).trans
      (Cech.radiusAt_mono p x (Finset.subset_univ _))
  constructor
  · apply dgm_finitePart_mem_Icc k n
    · intro s
      exact Cech.filter_value_nonneg p s
    · exact hM
  · apply dgm_essentialPart_mem_Icc k n
    · intro s
      exact Cech.filter_value_nonneg p s
    · exact hM

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.dgm_coordinates_le_diameter
statement:
theorem dgm_coordinates_le_diameter (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ y ∈ finitePart (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).points,
      0 ≤ y.1 ∧ y.1 < y.2 ∧ y.2 ≤ Rips.diameter d Finset.univ) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ essentialPart (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).points,
      0 ≤ b ∧ b ≤ Rips.diameter d Finset.univ)
proof:
:= by
  have hM (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
      (Cech.filter p).value s ≤ Rips.diameter d Finset.univ :=
    (Cech.filter_value_le_rips d p hd s).trans
      (Rips.filter_value_le_diameter_univ d s)
  constructor
  · apply dgm_finitePart_mem_Icc k n
    · intro s
      exact Cech.filter_value_nonneg p s
    · exact hM
  · apply dgm_essentialPart_mem_Icc k n
    · intro s
      exact Cech.filter_value_nonneg p s
    · exact hM

name: TDA.Persistence.templatePairs_card_le_face
statement:
private theorem templatePairs_card_le_face (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ) :
    (faceTemplatePairs k e n).card ≤ Nat.card (Face K (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s := faceTemplatePairs k e n
  let m := s.map Prod.snd
  let good : Fin (faceCount K) → Prop :=
    fun i => (e.enum i).val.card = n + 2
  have hm_mem : ∀ i ∈ m, i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (faceCount K))) := by
    simp
  have hsum := Multiset.sum_count_eq_card hm_mem
  have hcount (i : Fin (faceCount K)) : m.count i ≤ if good i then 1 else 0 := by
    have hcm : m.count i = faceDeathCount k e n i := by
      simpa [m, Multiset.count_map, Multiset.countP_eq_card_filter, eq_comm] using
        (faceTemplate_death_count k e n i)
    rw [hcm]
    by_cases hi : good i
    · simp only [if_pos hi]
      have hone := faceTemplate_endpoint_count_le_one k e i n
      have hd := faceTemplate_death_count k e n i
      omega
    · simp only [if_neg hi]
      exact (faceDeathCount_eq_zero_of_card_ne k e n i (by simpa [good] using hi)).le
  calc
    s.card = m.card := by simp [m]
    _ = ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (faceCount K))), m.count i := hsum.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (faceCount K))), if good i then 1 else 0 := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hcount i
    _ = (Finset.univ.filter good).card := by
      exact (Finset.card_filter _ _).symm
    _ = Nat.card {i : Fin (faceCount K) // good i} := by
      simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype]
    _ = Nat.card (Face K (n + 1)) := by
      exact Nat.card_congr (faceIndexEquiv e (n + 1))

name: TDA.Persistence.templateEssential_card_le_face
statement:
private theorem templateEssential_card_le_face (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ) :
    (faceTemplateEssential k e n).card ≤ Nat.card (Face K n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let good : Fin (faceCount K) → Prop :=
    fun i => (e.enum i).val.card = n + 1
  have hs_mem : ∀ i ∈ faceTemplateEssential k e n,
      i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (faceCount K))) := by
    simp
  have hsum := Multiset.sum_count_eq_card hs_mem
  have hcount (i : Fin (faceCount K)) :
      (faceTemplateEssential k e n).count i ≤ if good i then 1 else 0 := by
    by_cases hi : good i
    · simp only [if_pos hi]
      exact faceTemplateEssential_count_le_one k e n i
    · simp only [if_neg hi]
      have hbirth := faceTemplate_birth_count k e n i
      have hzero := faceBirthCount_eq_zero_of_card_ne k e n i (by simpa [good] using hi)
      have hnonneg := Nat.zero_le ((faceTemplateEssential k e n).count i)
      omega
  calc
    (faceTemplateEssential k e n).card =
        ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (faceCount K))),
          (faceTemplateEssential k e n).count i := hsum.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (faceCount K))), if good i then 1 else 0 := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => hcount i
    _ = (Finset.univ.filter good).card := by
      exact (Finset.card_filter _ _).symm
    _ = Nat.card {i : Fin (faceCount K) // good i} := by
      simp [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype]
    _ = Nat.card (Face K n) := by
      exact Nat.card_congr (faceIndexEquiv e n)

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_add'
statement:
private theorem finitePart_add' {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (s t : Multiset (β × WithTop β)) :
    finitePart (s + t) = finitePart s + finitePart t
proof:
:= by
  unfold finitePart
  exact Multiset.filterMap_add _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_finiteEmbed'
statement:
private theorem finitePart_finiteEmbed' {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (s : Multiset (β × β)) :
    finitePart (s.map (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop β)))) = s
proof:
:= by
  unfold finitePart
  rw [Multiset.filterMap_map]
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | @cons p s ih => simp [ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_essentialEmbed'
statement:
private theorem finitePart_essentialEmbed' {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (s : Multiset β) :
    finitePart (s.map (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop β)))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold finitePart
  rw [Multiset.filterMap_map]
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | @cons b s ih => simp [ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_dgm_card_le_templatePairs
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm k e f e.monotone n]

  change
    (finitePart
      ( (((faceTemplatePairs k e n).map (pairValues f e)).filter
          (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)).map
        (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop α))) +
        ((faceTemplateEssential k e n).map (birthValue f e)).map
          (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop α))))).card ≤
      (faceTemplatePairs k e n).card
  rw [finitePart_add', finitePart_finiteEmbed', finitePart_essentialEmbed']
  simp only [add_zero]
  exact
    (Multiset.card_le_card
      (Multiset.filter_le
        (p := fun p : α × α => p.1 ≠ p.2)
        ((faceTemplatePairs k e n).map (pairValues f e)))).trans
      (Multiset.card_map _ _).le

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_add'
statement:
private theorem essentialPart_add' {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (s t : Multiset (β × WithTop β)) :
    essentialPart (s + t) = essentialPart s + essentialPart t
proof:
:= by
  unfold essentialPart
  exact Multiset.filterMap_add _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_finiteEmbed'
statement:
private theorem essentialPart_finiteEmbed' {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (s : Multiset (β × β)) :
    essentialPart (s.map (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop β)))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold essentialPart
  rw [Multiset.filterMap_map]
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | @cons p s ih => simp [ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_essentialEmbed'
statement:
private theorem essentialPart_essentialEmbed' {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (s : Multiset β) :
    essentialPart (s.map (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop β)))) = s
proof:
:= by
  unfold essentialPart
  rw [Multiset.filterMap_map]
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | @cons b s ih => simp [ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_dgm_card_le_templateEssential
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm k e f e.monotone n]
  change
    (essentialPart
      ( (((faceTemplatePairs k e n).map (pairValues f e)).filter
          (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)).map
        (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop α))) +
        ((faceTemplateEssential k e n).map (birthValue f e)).map
          (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop α))))).card ≤
      (faceTemplateEssential k e n).card
  rw [essentialPart_add', essentialPart_finiteEmbed', essentialPart_essentialEmbed']
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.card_finitePart_dgm_le
statement:
theorem card_finitePart_dgm_le (f : FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ) :
    (finitePart (dgm k f n).points).card ≤ Nat.card (Face K (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_compatibleOrder f
  exact (finitePart_dgm_card_le_templatePairs k e n).trans
    (templatePairs_card_le_face k e n)

name: TDA.Persistence.card_essentialPart_dgm_le
statement:
theorem card_essentialPart_dgm_le (f : FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ) :
    (essentialPart (dgm k f n).points).card ≤ Nat.card (Face K n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := exists_compatibleOrder f
  exact (essentialPart_dgm_card_le_templateEssential k e n).trans
    (templateEssential_card_le_face k e n)

name: TDA.Persistence.card_face_fullComplex
statement:
theorem card_face_fullComplex (n : ℕ) :
    Nat.card (Face (Rips.fullComplex V) n) =
      Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : Face (Rips.fullComplex V) n ≃
      {s // s ∈ Finset.powersetCard (n + 1) (Finset.univ : Finset V)} :=
    { toFun := fun s => ⟨s.1, by
        rw [Finset.mem_powersetCard]
        exact ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, s.2.2⟩⟩
      invFun := fun s => ⟨s.1, by
        have hs := Finset.mem_powersetCard.mp s.2
        have hpos : 0 < s.1.card := by omega
        exact ⟨Finset.card_pos.mp hpos, by simpa using hs.2⟩⟩
      left_inv := by intro s; apply Subtype.ext; simp
      right_inv := by intro s; apply Subtype.ext; simp }
  calc
    Nat.card (Face (Rips.fullComplex V) n) =
        Nat.card {s // s ∈ Finset.powersetCard (n + 1) (Finset.univ : Finset V)} :=
      Nat.card_congr e
    _ = (Finset.powersetCard (n + 1) (Finset.univ : Finset V)).card :=
      Nat.card_eq_finsetCard _
    _ = Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 1) := by
      simp [Finset.card_powersetCard]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.totalPersistence_dgm_le
statement:
theorem Rips.totalPersistence_dgm_le (d : MetricSpace V) (n p : ℕ) :
    (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).totalPersistence p ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) *
        Rips.diameter d Finset.univ ^ p
proof:
:= by
  let M := Rips.diameter d Finset.univ
  have hcoord : ∀ x ∈ finitePart (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).points,
      x.1 ∈ Set.Icc 0 M ∧ x.2 ∈ Set.Icc 0 M := by
    intro x hx
    have h := (Rips.dgm_coordinates_le_diameter k d n).1 x hx
    exact ⟨⟨h.1, h.2.1.le.trans h.2.2⟩,
      ⟨h.1.trans h.2.1.le, h.2.2⟩⟩
  have htotal := totalPersistence_le_of_coordinates_mem_Icc
    (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) p M hcoord
  have hcardNat : Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences ≤
      Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) := by
    rw [Multiset.card_coe]
    calc
      (finitePart (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).points).card ≤
          Nat.card (Face (Rips.fullComplex V) (n + 1)) :=
        card_finitePart_dgm_le k (Rips.filter d) n
      _ = Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) := by
        simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using card_face_fullComplex (V := V) (n + 1)
  have hcard : (Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcardNat
  dsimp [M] at htotal ⊢
  exact htotal.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard
    (pow_nonneg (Rips.diameter_nonneg d Finset.univ) p))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.totalPersistence_dgm_le_radiusAt
statement:
theorem Cech.totalPersistence_dgm_le_radiusAt {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (p : V → X) (x : X) (n q : ℕ) :
    (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).totalPersistence q ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) *

proof:
:= by
  let M := Cech.radiusAt p x Finset.univ
  have hcoord : ∀ y ∈ finitePart (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).points,
      y.1 ∈ Set.Icc 0 M ∧ y.2 ∈ Set.Icc 0 M := by
    intro y hy
    have h := (Cech.dgm_coordinates_le_radiusAt k p x n).1 y hy
    exact ⟨⟨h.1, h.2.1.le.trans h.2.2⟩,
      ⟨h.1.trans h.2.1.le, h.2.2⟩⟩
  have htotal := totalPersistence_le_of_coordinates_mem_Icc
    (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) q M hcoord
  have hcardNat : Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences ≤
      Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) := by
    rw [Multiset.card_coe]
    calc
      (finitePart (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).points).card ≤
          Nat.card (Face (Rips.fullComplex V) (n + 1)) :=
        card_finitePart_dgm_le k (Cech.filter p) n
      _ = Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) := by
        simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using card_face_fullComplex (V := V) (n + 1)
  have hcard : (Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcardNat
  dsimp [M] at htotal ⊢
  exact htotal.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard
    (pow_nonneg (Cech.radiusAt_nonneg p x Finset.univ) q))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.totalPersistence_dgm_le_diameter
statement:
theorem Cech.totalPersistence_dgm_le_diameter {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (n q : ℕ) :
    (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).totalPersistence q ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) *
        Rips.diameter d Finset.univ ^ q
proof:
:= by
  let M := Rips.diameter d Finset.univ
  have hcoord : ∀ y ∈ finitePart (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).points,
      y.1 ∈ Set.Icc 0 M ∧ y.2 ∈ Set.Icc 0 M := by
    intro y hy
    have h := (Cech.dgm_coordinates_le_diameter k d p hd n).1 y hy
    exact ⟨⟨h.1, h.2.1.le.trans h.2.2⟩,
      ⟨h.1.trans h.2.1.le, h.2.2⟩⟩
  have htotal := totalPersistence_le_of_coordinates_mem_Icc
    (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) q M hcoord
  have hcardNat : Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences ≤
      Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) := by
    rw [Multiset.card_coe]
    calc
      (finitePart (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).points).card ≤
          Nat.card (Face (Rips.fullComplex V) (n + 1)) :=
        card_finitePart_dgm_le k (Cech.filter p) n
      _ = Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) := by
        simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using card_face_fullComplex (V := V) (n + 1)
  have hcard : (Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcardNat
  dsimp [M] at htotal ⊢
  exact htotal.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcard
    (pow_nonneg (Rips.diameter_nonneg d Finset.univ) q))

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_choose_mul_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_choose_mul_pairwiseDiscrepancy
    (d e : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        (2 * (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ)) *
          Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy
    k d e n σ hA hB w
  have hdNat : Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences ≤
      Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) := by
    rw [Multiset.card_coe]
    calc
      (finitePart (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).points).card ≤
          Nat.card (Face (Rips.fullComplex V) (n + 1)) :=
        card_finitePart_dgm_le k (Rips.filter d) n
      _ = Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) := by
        simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using card_face_fullComplex (V := V) (n + 1)
  have heNat : Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences ≤
      Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) := by
    rw [Multiset.card_coe]
    calc
      (finitePart (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).points).card ≤
          Nat.card (Face (Rips.fullComplex V) (n + 1)) :=
        card_finitePart_dgm_le k (Rips.filter e) n
      _ = Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) := by
        simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using card_face_fullComplex (V := V) (n + 1)
  have hd : (Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hdNat
  have he : (Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast heNat
  have hcount :
      ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
        Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        2 * (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by
    calc
      ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
        Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) =
          (Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) +
            (Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) := by
              norm_num
      _ ≤ (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) +
            (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := add_le_add hd he
      _ = 2 * (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by ring
  exact hbase.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount
      (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB))
    (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy_nonneg d e))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.continuous_bandPoint
statement: private theorem continuous_bandPoint : Continuous bandPoint
proof:
:= by
  exact (continuous_id.prodMk (continuous_id.add continuous_const)).subtype_mk _

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.bandLaw_noAtoms
statement: private theorem bandLaw_noAtoms : NullSingletonClass bandLaw
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x
  rw [bandLaw, Measure.map_apply continuous_bandPoint.measurable (measurableSet_singleton x)]
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  calc
    (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) (bandPoint ⁻¹' {x}) ≤
        (volume.restrict (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) {x.1.1} := by
      apply measure_mono
      intro t ht
      have h : bandPoint t = x := ht
      exact congrArg (fun z : Interior => z.1.1) h
    _ = 0 := measure_singleton _

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.bandLaw_moment
statement:
private theorem bandLaw_moment (p : ℝ) :
    (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂bandLaw) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [bandLaw, lintegral_map (by simp_rw [depth_eq]; fun_prop) continuous_bandPoint.measurable]
  have hdepth (t : ℝ) : depth (bandPoint t) = 1 := by
    simp [depth_eq, bandPoint]
  simp only [hdepth, Real.one_rpow, ENNReal.ofReal_one, lintegral_one]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.nonatomic_minimizer
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hcost⟩ := exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan 2 (by norm_num) bandLaw 0
  refine ⟨π, hπ, hcost.trans ?_⟩

    bandLaw_moment]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.half_ne_zero
statement: private theorem half_ne_zero : half ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun t : unitInterval => (t : ℝ)) h
  norm_num [half] at this

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.rayLaw_moment
statement:
private theorem rayLaw_moment (p : ℝ) :
    (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂rayLaw) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [rayLaw, lintegral_map (by simp_rw [depth_eq]; fun_prop) ((measurable_of_countable rayPoint))]
  have hdepth (n : ℕ) : depth (rayPoint n) = 1 := by simp [depth_eq, rayPoint]
  simp only [hdepth, Real.one_rpow, ENNReal.ofReal_one, lintegral_one]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.rayLaw_first_moment_diverges
statement:
private theorem rayLaw_first_moment_diverges :
    ¬ Integrable (fun x : Interior => x.1.1) rayLaw
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hn := (integrable_map_measure (by fun_prop : AEStronglyMeasurable
    (fun x : Interior => x.1.1) rayLaw)
    ((measurable_of_countable rayPoint)).aemeasurable).1 h
  have hs := (ProbabilityTheory.integrable_geometricMeasure_iff half_ne_zero).1 hn
  have hweight (n : ℕ) : (1 - (half : ℝ)) ^ n * (half : ℝ) *
      ‖(rayPoint n).1.1‖ = 2 := by
    simp only [half, rayPoint, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ (n + 2))]
    rw [pow_add]
    norm_num
    calc
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ n * (1 / 2) * (2 ^ n * 4) =
          ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * 2) ^ n * 2 := by rw [mul_pow]; ring
      _ = 2 := by norm_num
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun _ : ℕ => (2 : ℝ)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, hweight] using hs.tendsto_atTop_zero
  have hbad : (2 : ℝ) = 0 := tendsto_nhds_unique tendsto_const_nhds hlim
  norm_num at hbad

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.rayLaw_no_compact_full_measure
statement:
private theorem rayLaw_no_compact_full_measure (K : Set Interior) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    rayLaw Kᶜ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  apply rayLaw_first_moment_diverges
  have h : IntegrableOn (fun x : Interior => x.1.1) K rayLaw :=
    (continuous_fst.comp continuous_subtype_val).continuousOn.integrableOn_compact hK
  have heq : rayLaw.restrict K = rayLaw :=
    Measure.restrict_eq_self_of_ae_mem (mem_ae_iff.mpr hzero)
  simpa only [IntegrableOn, heq] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.rayLaw_ambient_first_moment_diverges
statement:
private theorem rayLaw_ambient_first_moment_diverges :
    ¬ Integrable (fun x : Interior => ‖x.1‖) rayLaw
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply rayLaw_first_moment_diverges
  refine h.mono (by fun_prop) (.of_forall fun x => ?_)
  change ‖x.1.1‖ ≤ ‖‖x.1‖‖
  rw [norm_norm, Prod.norm_def]
  exact le_max_left _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.unbounded_minimizer
statement:
private theorem unbounded_minimizer :
    ∃ π : Measure PlanSpace, IsBoundaryPlan π rayLaw bandLaw ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost 2 z ∂π) = boundaryTransportPowerValue 2 rayLaw bandLaw ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost 2 z ∂π) < ∞
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_finite_cost_minimizing_boundaryPlan 2 (by norm_num) rayLaw bandLaw
    (by rw [rayLaw_moment]; simp) (by rw [bandLaw_moment]; simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.unbounded_rooted_minimizer
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, _, hroot⟩ := exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan_rooted 2 (by norm_num) rayLaw 0
  refine ⟨π, hπ, hroot.trans ?_⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.zero_minimizer
