name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.measurable_distantDeleteLeg
statement: private theorem measurable_distantDeleteLeg : Measurable distantDeleteLeg
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.measurable
  exact (continuous_interiorIncl.prodMk continuous_const).subtype_mk _

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.infiniteCostPlan_admissible
statement: private theorem infiniteCostPlan_admissible : IsBoundaryPlan infiniteCostPlan rayLaw 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro s hs
    rw [infiniteCostPlan, Measure.map_apply measurable_distantDeleteLeg
      (measurableSet_firstFiber hs)]
    congr 1
    ext x
    change interiorIncl x ∈ interiorIncl '' s ↔ x ∈ s
    exact interiorIncl_injective.mem_set_image
  · intro s hs
    rw [infiniteCostPlan, Measure.map_apply measurable_distantDeleteLeg
      (measurableSet_secondFiber hs)]
    have hempty : distantDeleteLeg ⁻¹' secondFiber s = ∅ := by
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨y, _, hy⟩
        have h : y.1 = (0, 0) := congrArg Subtype.val hy
        have := y.2
        simp [h] at this
      · simp
    simp [hempty]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.infiniteCostPlan_cost
statement: private theorem infiniteCostPlan_cost : (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost 1 z ∂infiniteCostPlan) = ∞
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hfin : (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost 1 z ∂infiniteCostPlan) < ∞ := lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hne
  rw [infiniteCostPlan, lintegral_map (measurable_planPowerCost 1)
    measurable_distantDeleteLeg] at hfin
  have hbound (x : Interior) :
      ENNReal.ofReal ‖x.1.1‖ ≤ planPowerCost 1 (distantDeleteLeg x) := by
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    change ‖x.1.1‖ ≤ dist x.1 (0, 0) ^ (1 : ℝ)
    simp only [Real.rpow_one, Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact le_max_left _ _
  apply rayLaw_first_moment_diverges
  exact ⟨by fun_prop,
    (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_norm _).2 ((lintegral_mono hbound).trans_lt hfin)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.AttainmentExamples.finite_optimum_with_infinite_competitor
statement:
private theorem finite_optimum_with_infinite_competitor :
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost 1 z ∂infiniteCostPlan) = ∞ ∧
      ∃ π : Measure PlanSpace, IsBoundaryPlan π rayLaw 0 ∧
        (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost 1 z ∂π) = 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨infiniteCostPlan_cost, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨π, hπ, hcost⟩ := exists_minimizing_boundaryPlan 1 (by norm_num) rayLaw 0
  refine ⟨π, hπ, hcost.trans ?_⟩
  rw [boundaryTransportPowerValue_zero_target 1 (by norm_num) rayLaw (measure_lt_top _ _),
    rayLaw_moment]

name: TDA.Persistence.ofReal_le_add_of_le
statement:
private theorem ofReal_le_add_of_le {a b c : ℝ} (h : a ≤ b + c) :
    ENNReal.ofReal a ≤ ENNReal.ofReal b + ENNReal.ofReal c
proof:
:=
  (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h).trans ENNReal.ofReal_add_le

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePairCost_self
statement: theorem finitePairCost_self (p : ℝ × ℝ) : finitePairCost p p = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [finitePairCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePairCost_comm
statement:
theorem finitePairCost_comm (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePairCost p q = finitePairCost q p
proof:
:= by
  simp [finitePairCost, abs_sub_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePairCost_triangle
statement:
theorem finitePairCost_triangle (p q r : ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePairCost p r ≤ finitePairCost p q + finitePairCost q r
proof:
:= by
  apply ofReal_le_add_of_le
  have h₁ := abs_sub_le p.1 q.1 r.1
  have h₂ := abs_sub_le p.2 q.2 r.2
  have h₃ : |p.1 - q.1| ≤ max |p.1 - q.1| |p.2 - q.2| := le_max_left _ _
  have h₄ : |p.2 - q.2| ≤ max |p.1 - q.1| |p.2 - q.2| := le_max_right _ _
  have h₅ : |q.1 - r.1| ≤ max |q.1 - r.1| |q.2 - r.2| := le_max_left _ _
  have h₆ : |q.2 - r.2| ≤ max |q.1 - r.1| |q.2 - r.2| := le_max_right _ _
  exact max_le (by linarith) (by linarith)

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPairCost_self
statement: theorem essentialPairCost_self (b : ℝ) : essentialPairCost b b = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [essentialPairCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPairCost_comm
statement:
theorem essentialPairCost_comm (b c : ℝ) :
    essentialPairCost b c = essentialPairCost c b
proof:
:= by
  simp [essentialPairCost, abs_sub_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPairCost_triangle
statement:
theorem essentialPairCost_triangle (b c d : ℝ) :
    essentialPairCost b d ≤ essentialPairCost b c + essentialPairCost c d
proof:
:=
  ofReal_le_add_of_le (abs_sub_le b c d)

name: TDA.Persistence.diagonalCost_le_pair_add
statement:
theorem diagonalCost_le_pair_add (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    diagonalCost p ≤ finitePairCost p q + diagonalCost q
proof:
:= by
  unfold diagonalCost finitePairCost
  apply ofReal_le_add_of_le
  have h₁ := abs_sub_le p.2 q.2 p.1
  have h₂ := abs_sub_le q.2 q.1 p.1
  have h₃ : |q.1 - p.1| = |p.1 - q.1| := abs_sub_comm _ _
  have h₄ : |p.1 - q.1| ≤ max |p.1 - q.1| |p.2 - q.2| := le_max_left _ _
  have h₅ : |p.2 - q.2| ≤ max |p.1 - q.1| |p.2 - q.2| := le_max_right _ _
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.diagonalCost_le_pair_add_rev
statement:
theorem diagonalCost_le_pair_add_rev (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    diagonalCost q ≤ diagonalCost p + finitePairCost p q
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_comm, finitePairCost_comm]
  exact diagonalCost_le_pair_add q p

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.source_le_cost
statement:
theorem source_le_cost (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) (i : F₁) :
    (match M.finite i with
      | some j => finitePairCost (x i) (y j)
      | none => diagonalCost (x i)) ≤ M.cost x y b c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Finset.le_sup (s := (Finset.univ : Finset F₁))
    (f := fun i => match M.finite i with
      | some j => finitePairCost (x i) (y j)
      | none => diagonalCost (x i)) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans
      (le_max_left _ _)

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.target_le_cost
statement:
theorem target_le_cost (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) (j : F₂) :
    (if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else diagonalCost (y j)) ≤
      M.cost x y b c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Finset.le_sup (s := (Finset.univ : Finset F₂))
    (f := fun j => if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else diagonalCost (y j))
    (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.essential_le_cost
statement:
theorem essential_le_cost (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) (k : E₁) :
    essentialPairCost (b k) (c (M.essential k)) ≤ M.cost x y b c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Finset.le_sup (s := (Finset.univ : Finset E₁))
    (f := fun k => essentialPairCost (b k) (c (M.essential k)))
    (Finset.mem_univ k)).trans ((le_max_right _ _).trans (le_max_right _ _))

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.cost_le_of
statement:
theorem cost_le_of (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) (r : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hs : ∀ i, (match M.finite i with
      | some j => finitePairCost (x i) (y j)
      | none => diagonalCost (x i)) ≤ r)
    (ht : ∀ j, (if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else diagonalCost (y j)) ≤ r)
    (he : ∀ k, essentialPairCost (b k) (c (M.essential k)) ≤ r) :
    M.cost x y b c ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold cost
  apply max_le_iff.mpr
  constructor
  · exact Finset.sup_le (fun i _ => hs i)
  · apply max_le_iff.mpr
    exact ⟨Finset.sup_le (fun j _ => ht j), Finset.sup_le (fun k _ => he k)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.reverse_finite_some_iff
statement:
theorem reverse_finite_some_iff (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (j : F₂) (i : F₁) : M.reverse.finite j = some i ↔ M.finite i = some j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    change (if he : ∃ k, M.finite k = some j then some he.choose else none) = some i at h
    split_ifs at h with he
    · have hi : he.choose = i := Option.some.inj h
      simpa [hi] using he.choose_spec
  · intro h
    have he : ∃ k, M.finite k = some j := ⟨i, h⟩
    have hi : he.choose = i := M.finite_injective _ _ _ he.choose_spec h
    change (if he : ∃ k, M.finite k = some j then some he.choose else none) = some i
    simp [he, hi]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.cost_reverse_le
statement:
private theorem cost_reverse_le (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) :
    M.reverse.cost y x c b ≤ M.cost x y b c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply cost_le_of
  · intro j
    cases hr : M.reverse.finite j with
    | none =>
      have hn : ¬ ∃ i, M.finite i = some j := by
        intro ⟨i, hi⟩
        have hc := hr.symm.trans ((reverse_finite_some_iff M j i).mpr hi)
        cases hc
      simpa [hr, hn] using target_le_cost M x y b c j
    | some i =>
      have hi := (reverse_finite_some_iff M j i).mp hr
      simpa [hr, hi, finitePairCost_comm] using source_le_cost M x y b c i
  · intro i
    by_cases hi : ∃ j, M.reverse.finite j = some i
    · simp [hi]
    · have hm : M.finite i = none := by
        cases h : M.finite i with
        | none => rfl
        | some j => exact (hi ⟨j, (reverse_finite_some_iff M j i).mpr h⟩).elim
      simpa [hi, hm] using source_le_cost M x y b c i
  · intro k
    simpa [reverse, essentialPairCost_comm] using
      essential_le_cost M x y b c (M.essential.symm k)

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.reverse_reverse
statement:
theorem reverse_reverse (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂) :
    M.reverse.reverse = M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply ext
  · funext i
    cases h : M.finite i with
    | none =>
      have hh : M.reverse.reverse.finite i = none := by
        cases h' : M.reverse.reverse.finite i with
        | none => rfl
        | some j =>
          have hj := (reverse_finite_some_iff M.reverse i j).mp h'
          have hi := (reverse_finite_some_iff M j i).mp hj
          simp [h] at hi
      exact hh
    | some j =>
      exact (reverse_finite_some_iff M.reverse i j).mpr
        ((reverse_finite_some_iff M j i).mpr h)
  · change M.essential.symm.symm = M.essential
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.cost_reverse
statement:
theorem cost_reverse (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) :
    M.reverse.cost y x c b = M.cost x y b c
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (cost_reverse_le M x y b c)
  simpa [reverse_reverse] using cost_reverse_le M.reverse y x c b

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.cost_compose_le
statement:
theorem cost_compose_le (M : OccurrenceMatching F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂)
    (N : OccurrenceMatching F₂ F₃ E₂ E₃)
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ) (z : F₃ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) (d : E₃ → ℝ) :
    (M.compose N).cost x z b d ≤ M.cost x y b c + N.cost y z c d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply cost_le_of
  · intro i
    cases hm : M.finite i with
    | none =>
      have h := source_le_cost M x y b c i
      simpa [compose, hm] using le_trans h (le_add_of_nonneg_right bot_le)
    | some j =>
      cases hn : N.finite j with
      | none =>
        have h₁ : finitePairCost (x i) (y j) ≤ M.cost x y b c := by
          simpa [hm] using source_le_cost M x y b c i
        have h₂ : diagonalCost (y j) ≤ N.cost y z c d := by
          simpa [hn] using source_le_cost N y z c d j
        have h := (diagonalCost_le_pair_add (x i) (y j)).trans (add_le_add h₁ h₂)
        simpa [compose, hm, hn] using h
      | some k =>
        have h₁ : finitePairCost (x i) (y j) ≤ M.cost x y b c := by
          simpa [hm] using source_le_cost M x y b c i
        have h₂ : finitePairCost (y j) (z k) ≤ N.cost y z c d := by
          simpa [hn] using source_le_cost N y z c d j
        have h := (finitePairCost_triangle (x i) (y j) (z k)).trans
          (add_le_add h₁ h₂)
        simpa [compose, hm, hn] using h
  · intro k
    by_cases hk : ∃ i, (M.compose N).finite i = some k
    · simp [hk]
    · by_cases hn : ∃ j, N.finite j = some k
      · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hn
        have hm : ¬ ∃ i, M.finite i = some j := by
          rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
          apply hk
          exact ⟨i, by simp [compose, hi, hj]⟩
        have h₁ : diagonalCost (y j) ≤ M.cost x y b c := by
          simpa [hm] using target_le_cost M x y b c j
        have h₂ : finitePairCost (y j) (z k) ≤ N.cost y z c d := by
          simpa [hj] using source_le_cost N y z c d j
        have h := (diagonalCost_le_pair_add_rev (y j) (z k)).trans
          (add_le_add h₁ h₂)
        simpa [hk] using h
      · have h : diagonalCost (z k) ≤ N.cost y z c d := by
          simpa [hn] using target_le_cost N y z c d k
        simpa [hk] using le_trans h (le_add_of_nonneg_left bot_le)
  · intro k
    have h₁ := essential_le_cost M x y b c k
    have h₂ := essential_le_cost N y z c d (M.essential k)
    exact (essentialPairCost_triangle (b k) (c (M.essential k))
      (d (N.essential (M.essential k)))).trans (add_le_add h₁ h₂)

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_self
statement: theorem bottleneck_self (D : Diagram ℝ) : bottleneck D D = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences D.finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences D.essentialOccurrences :=
    ⟨some, by intro i i' j hi hi'; exact Option.some.inj (hi.trans hi'.symm), Equiv.refl _⟩
  have hc : M.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1)
      (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) = 0 := by
    simp [OccurrenceMatching.cost, M, finitePairCost_self, essentialPairCost_self]
  exact le_antisymm ((bottleneck_le_matching D D M).trans_eq hc) bot_le

name: TDA.Persistence.presentationBottleneck_comm
statement:
theorem presentationBottleneck_comm {F₁ F₂ E₁ E₂ : Type*}
    [Fintype F₁] [Fintype F₂] [Fintype E₁] [Fintype E₂]
    (x : F₁ → ℝ × ℝ) (y : F₂ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (b : E₁ → ℝ) (c : E₂ → ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck x y b c = presentationBottleneck y x c b
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_iInf
    intro M
    exact (presentationBottleneck_le_cost x y b c M.reverse).trans_eq
      (OccurrenceMatching.cost_reverse M y x c b)
  · apply le_iInf
    intro M
    exact (presentationBottleneck_le_cost y x c b M.reverse).trans_eq
      (OccurrenceMatching.cost_reverse M x y b c)

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_comm
statement: theorem bottleneck_comm (D E : Diagram ℝ) : bottleneck D E = bottleneck E D
proof:
:=
  presentationBottleneck_comm _ _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_triangle
statement:
theorem bottleneck_triangle (D E F : Diagram ℝ) :
    bottleneck D F ≤ bottleneck D E + bottleneck E F
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hDE : bottleneck D E = ⊤
  · simp [hDE]
  by_cases hEF : bottleneck E F = ⊤
  · simp [hEF]
  have hcardDE := (bottleneck_lt_top_iff D E).mp (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hDE)
  have hcardEF := (bottleneck_lt_top_iff E F).mp (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr hEF)
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (bottleneck_optimal_iff D E).mpr hcardDE
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := (bottleneck_optimal_iff E F).mpr hcardEF
  calc
    bottleneck D F ≤ (M.compose N).cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1)
        (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) := bottleneck_le_matching D F _
    _ ≤ M.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) +
        N.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) :=
          OccurrenceMatching.cost_compose_le M N _ _ _ _ _ _
    _ = bottleneck D E + bottleneck E F := by rw [hM, hN]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePart_offDiagonal_point
statement:
private theorem finitePart_offDiagonal_point (D : Diagram ℝ)
    {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ finitePart D.points) : p.1 ≠ p.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩ := (Multiset.mem_filterMap _ _).mp hp
  obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := q
  cases d with
  | top => simp [finitePart] at hqp
  | coe d =>
    have hd := D.offDiagonal (b, (d : WithTop ℝ)) hq
    simp [finitePart] at hqp
    subst p
    simpa using hd

name: TDA.Persistence.diagonalCost_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem diagonalCost_ne_zero {p : ℝ × ℝ} (h : p.1 ≠ p.2) :
    diagonalCost p ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hr : |p.2 - p.1| / 2 ≤ 0 := by
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mp hz
  have hn : p.2 - p.1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h.symm
  have hp : 0 < |p.2 - p.1| := abs_pos.mpr hn
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePairCost_eq_zero_iff
statement:
private theorem finitePairCost_eq_zero_iff (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePairCost p q = 0 ↔ p = q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hm : max |p.1 - q.1| |p.2 - q.2| ≤ 0 :=
      ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mp h
    have h₁ : |p.1 - q.1| = 0 :=
      le_antisymm ((le_max_left _ _).trans hm) (abs_nonneg _)
    have h₂ : |p.2 - q.2| = 0 :=
      le_antisymm ((le_max_right _ _).trans hm) (abs_nonneg _)
    exact Prod.ext (sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp h₁))
      (sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp h₂))
  · rintro rfl
    exact finitePairCost_self p

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPairCost_eq_zero_iff
statement:
private theorem essentialPairCost_eq_zero_iff (b c : ℝ) :
    essentialPairCost b c = 0 ↔ b = c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hr : |b - c| ≤ 0 := ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mp h
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp (le_antisymm hr (abs_nonneg _)))
  · rintro rfl
    exact essentialPairCost_self b

name: TDA.Persistence.map_univ_eq_of_equiv
statement:
private theorem map_univ_eq_of_equiv {A B C : Type*}
    [Fintype A] [Fintype B] (x : A → C) (y : B → C)
    (e : A ≃ B) (h : ∀ i, y (e i) = x i) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset A).val.map x = (Finset.univ : Finset B).val.map y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    (Finset.univ : Finset A).val.map x =
        (Finset.univ : Finset A).val.map (y ∘ e) := by
          congr 1
          funext i
          exact (h i).symm
    _ = ((Finset.univ : Finset A).map e.toEmbedding).val.map y := by
          rw [Finset.map_val, Multiset.map_map]
          rfl
    _ = (Finset.univ : Finset B).val.map y := by rw [Finset.map_univ_equiv]

name: TDA.Persistence.diagram_eq_of_parts
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, n, z, hD⟩ := orderedQ_surjective D
  obtain ⟨m', n', w, hE⟩ := orderedQ_surjective E
  rw [← hD, ← hE] at hf he ⊢
  exact (orderedQ_eq_iff m n m' n' z w).mpr
    ⟨(finitePart_orderedQ m n z).symm.trans (hf.trans (finitePart_orderedQ m' n' w)),
     (essentialPart_orderedQ m n z).symm.trans
       (he.trans (essentialPart_orderedQ m' n' w))⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem bottleneck_eq_zero_iff (D E : Diagram ℝ) :
    bottleneck D E = 0 ↔ D = E
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hzero
    have hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤ := by simp [hzero]
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (bottleneck_optimal_iff D E).mpr
      ((bottleneck_lt_top_iff D E).mp hfinite)
    have hcost : M.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1)
        (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) = 0 := hM.trans hzero
    have hs (i : D.finiteOccurrences) : ∃ j, M.finite i = some j := by
      cases hi : M.finite i with
      | some j => exact ⟨j, rfl⟩
      | none =>
        have hd : diagonalCost i.1 ≤ 0 := by
          simpa [hi, hcost] using OccurrenceMatching.source_le_cost M
            (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) i
        exact (diagonalCost_ne_zero
          (finitePart_offDiagonal_point D (Multiset.coe_mem (x := i)))
          (le_antisymm hd bot_le)).elim
    have ht (j : E.finiteOccurrences) : ∃ i, M.finite i = some j := by
      by_contra hn
      have hd : diagonalCost j.1 ≤ 0 := by
        simpa [hn, hcost] using OccurrenceMatching.target_le_cost M
          (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) j
      exact diagonalCost_ne_zero
        (finitePart_offDiagonal_point E (Multiset.coe_mem (x := j)))
        (le_antisymm hd bot_le)
    let f : D.finiteOccurrences → E.finiteOccurrences := fun i => (hs i).choose
    have hf (i : D.finiteOccurrences) : M.finite i = some (f i) := (hs i).choose_spec
    have hfi : Function.Injective f := by
      intro i i' he
      exact M.finite_injective i i' (f i) (hf i) (he ▸ hf i')
    have hfs : Function.Surjective f := by
      intro j
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ht j
      exact ⟨i, Option.some.inj ((hf i).symm.trans hi)⟩
    let e : D.finiteOccurrences ≃ E.finiteOccurrences := Equiv.ofBijective f ⟨hfi, hfs⟩
    have hvalue (i : D.finiteOccurrences) : (e i).1 = i.1 := by
      have hc : finitePairCost i.1 (f i).1 = 0 := by
        apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
        simpa [hf i, hcost] using OccurrenceMatching.source_le_cost M
          (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) i
      exact (finitePairCost_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hc |>.symm
    have hevalue (k : D.essentialOccurrences) :
        (M.essential k).1 = k.1 := by
      have hc : essentialPairCost k.1 (M.essential k).1 = 0 := by
        apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
        simpa [hcost] using OccurrenceMatching.essential_le_cost M
          (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) k
      exact ((essentialPairCost_eq_zero_iff _ _).mp hc).symm
    apply diagram_eq_of_parts
    · calc
        finitePart D.points = (Finset.univ : Finset D.finiteOccurrences).val.map
            (fun p => p.1) := (Multiset.map_univ_coe _).symm
        _ = (Finset.univ : Finset E.finiteOccurrences).val.map (fun p => p.1) :=
          map_univ_eq_of_equiv _ _ e hvalue
        _ = finitePart E.points := Multiset.map_univ_coe _
    · calc
        essentialPart D.points = (Finset.univ : Finset D.essentialOccurrences).val.map
            (fun p => p.1) := (Multiset.map_univ_coe _).symm
        _ = (Finset.univ : Finset E.essentialOccurrences).val.map (fun p => p.1) :=
          map_univ_eq_of_equiv _ _ M.essential hevalue
        _ = essentialPart E.points := Multiset.map_univ_coe _
  · rintro rfl
    exact bottleneck_self D

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.chosenLift_cover
statement:
@[simp] theorem Presentation.chosenLift_cover :
    D.chosenLift V chosen ≫ D.cover = D.chosenMap V chosen
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (D.exists_lift V (D.chosenMap V chosen))

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.sumInl_adjoinRelation
statement:
@[simp] theorem Presentation.sumInl_adjoinRelation :
    sumInl D.relations V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relationMap =
      D.relationMap ≫ sumInl D.generators V
proof:
:=
  sumInl_sumDesc D.relations V _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.sumInr_adjoinRelation
statement:
@[simp] theorem Presentation.sumInr_adjoinRelation :
    sumInr D.relations V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relationMap =
      sumInr D.generators V - D.chosenLift V chosen ≫ sumInl D.generators V
proof:
:=
  sumInr_sumDesc D.relations V _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.sumInl_adjoinCollapse
statement:
@[simp] theorem Presentation.sumInl_adjoinCollapse :
    sumInl D.generators V ≫ D.adjoinCollapse V chosen = D.cover
proof:
:=
  sumInl_sumDesc D.generators V _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.sumInr_adjoinCollapse
statement:
@[simp] theorem Presentation.sumInr_adjoinCollapse :
    sumInr D.generators V ≫ D.adjoinCollapse V chosen = D.chosenMap V chosen
proof:
:=
  sumInr_sumDesc D.generators V _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.adjoinRelation_collapse
statement:
theorem Presentation.adjoinRelation_collapse :
    (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relationMap ≫ D.adjoinCollapse V chosen = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply sumHom_ext D.relations V
  · calc
      sumInl D.relations V ≫
          ((D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relationMap ≫ D.adjoinCollapse V chosen) =
        (sumInl D.relations V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relationMap) ≫
          D.adjoinCollapse V chosen := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (D.relationMap ≫ sumInl D.generators V) ≫ D.adjoinCollapse V chosen :=
        congrArg (· ≫ D.adjoinCollapse V chosen) (D.sumInl_adjoinRelation V chosen)
      _ = D.relationMap ≫ (sumInl D.generators V ≫ D.adjoinCollapse V chosen) :=
        Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = D.relationMap ≫ D.cover :=
        congrArg (D.relationMap ≫ ·) (D.sumInl_adjoinCollapse V chosen)
      _ = 0 := D.relations_vanish
      _ = sumInl D.relations V ≫ (0 : _ ⟶ D.presented) := by simp
  · calc
      sumInr D.relations V ≫
          ((D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relationMap ≫ D.adjoinCollapse V chosen) =
        (sumInr D.relations V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relationMap) ≫
          D.adjoinCollapse V chosen := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = (sumInr D.generators V -
          D.chosenLift V chosen ≫ sumInl D.generators V) ≫
            D.adjoinCollapse V chosen :=
        congrArg (· ≫ D.adjoinCollapse V chosen) (D.sumInr_adjoinRelation V chosen)
      _ = (sumInr D.generators V ≫ D.adjoinCollapse V chosen) -
          ((D.chosenLift V chosen ≫ sumInl D.generators V) ≫
            D.adjoinCollapse V chosen) := sub_comp _ _ _
      _ = D.chosenMap V chosen - (D.chosenLift V chosen ≫ D.cover) := by
        rw [D.sumInr_adjoinCollapse V chosen, Category.assoc,
          D.sumInl_adjoinCollapse V chosen]
      _ = 0 := by rw [D.chosenLift_cover V chosen]; simp
      _ = sumInr D.relations V ≫ (0 : _ ⟶ D.presented) := by simp

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.adjoinCover_forget
statement:
@[simp] theorem Presentation.adjoinCover_forget :
    (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover ≫ D.adjoinForget V chosen =
      D.adjoinCollapse V chosen
proof:
:=
  (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover_desc _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.oldRelation_adjoinCover
statement:
theorem Presentation.oldRelation_adjoinCover :
    D.relationMap ≫
      (sumInl D.generators V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrelzero : ((D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relationMap ≫
      (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover :
        module (R := R) (D.relations.sum V) ⟶
          (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).presented) = 0 :=
    (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relations_vanish
  calc
    D.relationMap ≫
        (sumInl D.generators V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover) =
      (D.relationMap ≫ sumInl D.generators V) ≫
        (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (sumInl D.relations V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relationMap) ≫
        (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover := by
          exact (congrArg (· ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover)
            (D.sumInl_adjoinRelation V chosen)).symm
    _ = sumInl D.relations V ≫
        ((D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relationMap ≫
          (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover) := Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = 0 := by
      exact (congrArg (sumInl D.relations V ≫ ·)
        hrelzero).trans (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.cover_adjoinInclude
statement:
@[simp] theorem Presentation.cover_adjoinInclude :
    D.cover ≫ D.adjoinInclude V chosen =
      sumInl D.generators V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover
proof:
:=
  D.cover_desc _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.sumInr_adjoinCover
statement:
theorem Presentation.sumInr_adjoinCover :
    sumInr D.generators V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover =
      D.chosenMap V chosen ≫ D.adjoinInclude V chosen
proof:
:= by
  have hrelzero : ((D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relationMap ≫
      (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover :
        module (R := R) (D.relations.sum V) ⟶
          (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).presented) = 0 :=
    (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relations_vanish
  have hzero :
      (sumInr D.generators V - D.chosenLift V chosen ≫ sumInl D.generators V) ≫
        (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = (sumInr D.relations V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relationMap) ≫
            (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover := by
              rw [D.sumInr_adjoinRelation V chosen]
      _ = sumInr D.relations V ≫
            ((D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).relationMap ≫
              (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover) := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = 0 := by
        exact (congrArg (sumInr D.relations V ≫ ·)
          hrelzero).trans (by simp)
  have hdiff : (sumInr D.generators V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover) -
      ((D.chosenLift V chosen ≫ sumInl D.generators V) ≫
        (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover) = 0 :=
    (sub_comp _ _ _).symm.trans hzero
  have heq := sub_eq_zero.mp hdiff
  calc
    sumInr D.generators V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover =
        (D.chosenLift V chosen ≫ sumInl D.generators V) ≫
          (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover := heq
    _ = D.chosenLift V chosen ≫
          (sumInl D.generators V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover) :=
            Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = D.chosenLift V chosen ≫ (D.cover ≫ D.adjoinInclude V chosen) := by
      rw [D.cover_adjoinInclude V chosen]
    _ = (D.chosenLift V chosen ≫ D.cover) ≫ D.adjoinInclude V chosen :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = D.chosenMap V chosen ≫ D.adjoinInclude V chosen := by
      rw [D.chosenLift_cover V chosen]

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.adjoinInclude_forget
statement:
theorem Presentation.adjoinInclude_forget :
    D.adjoinInclude V chosen ≫ D.adjoinForget V chosen = 𝟙 D.presented
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Epi D.cover := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π D.relationMap)
    infer_instance
  apply (cancel_epi D.cover).mp
  calc
    D.cover ≫ (D.adjoinInclude V chosen ≫ D.adjoinForget V chosen) =
        (D.cover ≫ D.adjoinInclude V chosen) ≫ D.adjoinForget V chosen :=
      (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
    _ = (sumInl D.generators V ≫ (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover) ≫
          D.adjoinForget V chosen := by rw [D.cover_adjoinInclude V chosen]
    _ = sumInl D.generators V ≫
          ((D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).cover ≫ D.adjoinForget V chosen) :=
      Category.assoc _ _ _
    _ = sumInl D.generators V ≫ D.adjoinCollapse V chosen := by
      exact congrArg (sumInl D.generators V ≫ ·) (D.adjoinCover_forget V chosen)
    _ = D.cover := D.sumInl_adjoinCollapse V chosen
    _ = D.cover ≫ 𝟙 D.presented := by simp

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.adjoinForget_include
statement:
theorem Presentation.adjoinForget_include :
    D.adjoinForget V chosen ≫ D.adjoinInclude V chosen =
      𝟙 (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).presented
proof:
:= by
  let E := D.adjoinRedundant V chosen
  have hc : Epi E.cover := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π E.relationMap)
    infer_instance
  apply (cancel_epi E.cover).mp
  have hW : (sumInl D.generators V ≫ E.cover) ≫ D.adjoinForget V chosen =
      D.cover := by
    calc
      _ = sumInl D.generators V ≫ (E.cover ≫ D.adjoinForget V chosen) :=
        Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = sumInl D.generators V ≫ D.adjoinCollapse V chosen :=
        congrArg (sumInl D.generators V ≫ ·) (D.adjoinCover_forget V chosen)
      _ = D.cover := D.sumInl_adjoinCollapse V chosen
  have hV : (sumInr D.generators V ≫ E.cover) ≫ D.adjoinForget V chosen =
      D.chosenMap V chosen := by
    calc
      _ = sumInr D.generators V ≫ (E.cover ≫ D.adjoinForget V chosen) :=
        Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = sumInr D.generators V ≫ D.adjoinCollapse V chosen :=
        congrArg (sumInr D.generators V ≫ ·) (D.adjoinCover_forget V chosen)
      _ = D.chosenMap V chosen := D.sumInr_adjoinCollapse V chosen
  apply sumHom_ext D.generators V
  · calc
      sumInl D.generators V ≫ (E.cover ≫
          (D.adjoinForget V chosen ≫ D.adjoinInclude V chosen)) =
        ((sumInl D.generators V ≫ E.cover) ≫ D.adjoinForget V chosen) ≫
          D.adjoinInclude V chosen :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = D.cover ≫ D.adjoinInclude V chosen :=
        congrArg (· ≫ D.adjoinInclude V chosen) hW
      _ = sumInl D.generators V ≫ E.cover := D.cover_adjoinInclude V chosen
      _ = sumInl D.generators V ≫ (E.cover ≫ 𝟙 E.presented) :=
        (congrArg (sumInl D.generators V ≫ ·) (Category.comp_id E.cover)).symm
  · calc
      sumInr D.generators V ≫ (E.cover ≫
          (D.adjoinForget V chosen ≫ D.adjoinInclude V chosen)) =
        ((sumInr D.generators V ≫ E.cover) ≫ D.adjoinForget V chosen) ≫
          D.adjoinInclude V chosen :=
        (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm.trans (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
      _ = D.chosenMap V chosen ≫ D.adjoinInclude V chosen :=
        congrArg (· ≫ D.adjoinInclude V chosen) hV
      _ = sumInr D.generators V ≫ E.cover :=
        (D.sumInr_adjoinCover V chosen).symm
      _ = sumInr D.generators V ≫ (E.cover ≫ 𝟙 E.presented) :=
        (congrArg (sumInr D.generators V ≫ ·) (Category.comp_id E.cover)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.adjoinRedundant_finite
statement:
theorem Presentation.adjoinRedundant_finite (hD : D.IsFinite) [Finite V.Carrier] :
    (D.adjoinRedundant V chosen).IsFinite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change Finite (D.generators.Carrier ⊕ V.Carrier) ∧
    Finite (D.relations.Carrier ⊕ V.Carrier)
  let : Finite D.generators.Carrier := hD.1
  let : Finite D.relations.Carrier := hD.2
  let : Fintype D.generators.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite D.generators.Carrier
  let : Fintype D.relations.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite D.relations.Carrier
  let : Fintype V.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite V.Carrier
  exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.halfOpen_support
statement:
theorem halfOpen_support (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p.1 < p.2) (a : Fin 1 → ℝ) :
    a ∈ (halfOpenRectangle p hp).support ↔ p.1 ≤ a 0 ∧ a 0 < p.2
proof:
:= by
  simp [Rectangle.support, halfOpenRectangle, BoundedInterval.support,
    Fin.forall_fin_one, le_iff_lt_or_eq]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.interval_module_eq
statement:
theorem interval_module_eq (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p.1 < p.2) :
    (halfOpenRectangle p hp).module (k := k) =
      CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k)
        (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hS : (halfOpenRectangle p hp).support =
      {a : Fin 1 → ℝ | RealBarcode.alive (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop ℝ)) (a 0)} := by
    ext a
    simpa [RealBarcode.alive] using halfOpen_support p hp a
  unfold Rectangle.module
  simp only [hS]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.halfOpen_interleaved_zero_iff
statement:
theorem halfOpen_interleaved_zero_iff (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p.1 < p.2) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ε ((halfOpenRectangle p hp).module (k := k)) 0) ↔
      p.2 - p.1 ≤ 2 * (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨I⟩
    apply (RealBarcode.interleaved_zero_iff (k := k) ε p.1 p.2).mp
    exact ⟨CoordinateRealBridge.toReal (I.congr (intervalIso p hp) fromRealZeroIso.symm)⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨I⟩ := (RealBarcode.interleaved_zero_iff (k := k) ε p.1 p.2).mpr h
    exact ⟨(CoordinateRealBridge.toCoordinate I).congr (intervalIso p hp).symm fromRealZeroIso⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.pairCost_le_of_significant
statement:
theorem pairCost_le_of_significant (R S : Rectangle 1) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (R.module (k := k)) S.module)
    (h : Significant (ε + ε) R ∨ Significant (ε + ε) S) :
    finitePairCost ((R 0).lower, (R 0).upper) ((S 0).lower, (S 0).upper) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  have hn : I.φ ≠ 0 ∧ I.ψ ≠ 0 := by
    rcases h with h | h
    · have ht := (significant_iff_transition_ne_zero (k := k) R (ε + ε)).mp h
      constructor
      · intro hz
        apply ht
        rw [← I.φ_ψ, hz]
        simp
      · intro hz
        apply ht
        rw [← I.φ_ψ, hz]
        simp
    · have ht := (significant_iff_transition_ne_zero (k := k) S (ε + ε)).mp h
      constructor
      · intro hz
        apply ht
        rw [← I.ψ_φ, hz]
        simp
      · intro hz
        apply ht
        rw [← I.ψ_φ, hz]
        simp
  have hbl := decoratedLE_value (shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds R S ε I.φ hn.1 (0, false))
  have hbu := decoratedLE_value (shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds S R ε I.ψ hn.2 (0, false))
  have hdl := decoratedLE_value (shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds R S ε I.φ hn.1 (0, true))
  have hdu := decoratedLE_value (shifted_hom_endpoint_bounds S R ε I.ψ hn.2 (0, true))
  dsimp [endpoint] at hbl hbu hdl hdu
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_coe.mpr
  exact max_le (abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
    (abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.decoratedLE_same
statement:
private theorem decoratedLE_same {a b : ℝ} (h : a ≤ b) (p : Bool) :
    decoratedLE a b p p
proof:
:=
  (lt_or_eq_of_le h).elim Or.inl (fun he => Or.inr ⟨he, le_rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.trim_some_iff
statement:
private theorem trim_some_iff {ι κ : Type}
    (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ × ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching ι κ PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) (i : ι) (j : κ) :
    (trim x y ε M).finite i = some j ↔
      M.finite i = some j ∧ finitePairCost (x i) (y j) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  simp [trim]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.isMatching_of_cost
statement:
theorem isMatching_of_cost (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2)
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : OccurrenceMatching ι κ PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (h : M.cost x y PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim ≤ ε) :
    RectangleMatching.IsMatching (k := k) ε
      (fun i => halfOpenRectangle (x i) (hx i))
      (fun j => halfOpenRectangle (y j) (hy j)) M
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j hij
    have hc := (M.source_le_cost x y PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim i).trans h
    rw [hij] at hc
    exact ⟨pairInterleavingOfCost (x i) (y j) (hx i) (hy j) ε hc⟩
  · intro i hi
    have hc := (M.source_le_cost x y PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim i).trans h
    rw [hi] at hc
    have hl : |(x i).2 - (x i).1| / 2 ≤ (ε : ℝ) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_coe.mp hc
    rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr (hx i))] at hl
    exact (halfOpen_interleaved_zero_iff (x i) (hx i) ε).mpr (by linarith)
  · intro j hj
    have hn : ¬ ∃ i, M.finite i = some j := by rintro ⟨i, hi⟩; exact hj i hi
    have hc := (M.target_le_cost x y PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim j).trans h
    rw [if_neg hn] at hc
    have hl : |(y j).2 - (y j).1| / 2 ≤ (ε : ℝ) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_coe.mp hc
    rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr (hy j))] at hl
    exact (halfOpen_interleaved_zero_iff (y j) (hy j) ε).mpr (by linarith)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.exists_cost_matching
statement:
theorem exists_cost_matching (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2)
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : OccurrenceMatching ι κ PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (hM : RectangleMatching.IsMatching (k := k) ε
      (fun i => halfOpenRectangle (x i) (hx i))
      (fun j => halfOpenRectangle (y j) (hy j)) M) :
    ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching ι κ PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      A.cost x y PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  let A := trim x y ε M
  have hdiag (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p.1 < p.2)
      (hz : ¬ Significant (ε + ε) (halfOpenRectangle p hp)) : diagonalCost p ≤ ε := by
    have hi := (RectangleMatching.interleaved_zero_iff (k := k) _ ε).mpr hz
    have hl := (halfOpen_interleaved_zero_iff p hp ε).mp hi
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_coe.mpr
    rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hp)]
    linarith
  refine ⟨A, A.cost_le_of x y PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim ε ?_ ?_ (fun i => nomatch i)⟩
  · intro i
    cases ha : A.finite i with
    | some j =>
      exact (trim_some_iff x y ε M i j).mp ha |>.2
    | none =>
      apply hdiag (x i) (hx i)
      intro hi
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hM.source_covered i hi
      obtain ⟨I⟩ := hM.paired i j hj
      have hc := pairCost_le_of_significant _ _ ε I (Or.inl hi)
      have he := (trim_some_iff x y ε M i j).mpr ⟨hj, hc⟩
      rw [ha] at he
      contradiction
  · intro j
    split_ifs with hj
    · exact zero_le
    · apply hdiag (y j) (hy j)
      intro hjlong
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hM.target_covered j hjlong
      obtain ⟨I⟩ := hM.paired i j hi
      have hc := pairCost_le_of_significant _ _ ε I (Or.inr hjlong)
      exact hj ⟨i, (trim_some_iff x y ε M i j).mpr ⟨hi, hc⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.bottleneck_eq_presentation
statement:
theorem bottleneck_eq_presentation (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance (k := k)
      (fun i => halfOpenRectangle (x i) (hx i))
      (fun j => halfOpenRectangle (y j) (hy j)) =
        presentationBottleneck x y (PEmpty.elim : PEmpty.{1} → ℝ)
          (PEmpty.elim : PEmpty.{1} → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_iInf
    intro M
    let C := M.cost x y (PEmpty.elim : PEmpty.{1} → ℝ) PEmpty.elim
    have hC : C ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt (occurrenceMatching_cost_lt_top x y _ _ M)
    have hc : C ≤ (C.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) := (ENNReal.coe_toNNReal hC).symm.le
    have hM := isMatching_of_cost (k := k) x y hx hy C.toNNReal M hc
    simpa only [ENNReal.coe_toNNReal hC] using
      RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance_le_of_matching hM
  · apply (RectangleMatching.le_bottleneckDistance_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro ε M hM
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := exists_cost_matching x y hx hy ε M hM
    exact (presentationBottleneck_le_cost x y _ _ A).trans hA

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.familyIso_hom_apply
statement:
theorem familyIso_hom_apply (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2)
    (a : Fin 1 → ℝ)
    (v : (RectangleFamily.module (k := k) (fun i => halfOpenRectangle (x i) (hx i))).obj a)
    (i : ι) :
    ((familyIso x hx).hom.app a).hom v i =
      ((intervalIso (x i) (hx i)).hom.app a).hom
        (((RectangleFamily.projection (k := k)
          (fun j => halfOpenRectangle (x j) (hx j)) i).app a).hom v)
proof:
:= by
  let F := fun i => RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) ((x i).1, ((x i).2 : WithTop ℝ))
  have he := IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_hom_comp
    (biproduct.isLimit (fun i => CoordinateRealBridge.fromReal (F i))) (familyIsLimit F) ⟨i⟩
  have hπ : (familyIso x hx).hom ≫ (familyCone F).π.app ⟨i⟩ =
      RectangleFamily.projection (k := k) (fun j => halfOpenRectangle (x j) (hx j)) i ≫
        (intervalIso (x i) (hx i)).hom := by
    exact (Category.assoc _ _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (fun f => biproduct.map (fun j => (intervalIso (x j) (hx j)).hom) ≫ f) he).trans
        (biproduct.map_π _ i))
  exact congrArg (fun f => (f.app a).hom v) hπ

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.diagram_isPositive
statement:
theorem diagram_isPositive (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) :
    (diagram x hx).IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hp
  exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (hx i)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.diagram_finitePart
statement:
theorem diagram_finitePart (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) :
    finitePart (diagram x hx).points = (Finset.univ : Finset ι).val.map x
proof:
:= by
  unfold diagram finitePart
  rw [Multiset.filterMap_map]
  exact congrFun (Multiset.filterMap_eq_map x) (Finset.univ : Finset ι).val

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.diagram_essentialPart
statement:
theorem diagram_essentialPart (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) :
    essentialPart (diagram x hx).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiset.eq_zero_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro p
  simp [diagram, essentialPart, Multiset.filterMap_map, Function.comp_def,
    Multiset.mem_filterMap]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.diagram_bottleneck_eq_presentation
statement:
theorem diagram_bottleneck_eq_presentation (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    bottleneck (diagram x hx) (diagram y hy) =
      presentationBottleneck x y (PEmpty.elim : PEmpty.{1} → ℝ)
        (PEmpty.elim : PEmpty.{1} → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_eq_presentation
  · exact (diagram_finitePart x hx).symm
  · exact (diagram_finitePart y hy).symm
  · simp [diagram_essentialPart]
  · simp [diagram_essentialPart]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.rectangle_bottleneck_eq_diagram
statement:
theorem rectangle_bottleneck_eq_diagram (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance (k := k)
      (fun i => halfOpenRectangle (x i) (hx i))
      (fun j => halfOpenRectangle (y j) (hy j)) = bottleneck (diagram x hx) (diagram y hy)
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_eq_presentation x y hx hy).trans (diagram_bottleneck_eq_presentation x y hx hy).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.rectangle_bottleneck_eq_real_distance
statement:
theorem rectangle_bottleneck_eq_real_distance (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance (k := k)
      (fun i => halfOpenRectangle (x i) (hx i))
      (fun j => halfOpenRectangle (y j) (hy j)) =
        realInterleavingDistance (RealBarcode.realize (k := k) (diagram x hx))
          (RealBarcode.realize (diagram y hy))
proof:
:= by
  rw [RectangleMatching.bottleneckDistance_eq_interleavingDistance_one]
  rw [coordinateInterleavingDistance_congr (realizationIso x hx) (realizationIso y hy)]
  exact CoordinateRealBridge.distance_eq _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.diagram_bottleneck_eq_real_distance
statement:
theorem diagram_bottleneck_eq_real_distance (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    bottleneck (diagram x hx) (diagram y hy) =
      realInterleavingDistance (RealBarcode.realize (k := k) (diagram x hx))
        (RealBarcode.realize (diagram y hy))
proof:
:=
  (rectangle_bottleneck_eq_diagram (k := k) x y hx hy).symm.trans
    (rectangle_bottleneck_eq_real_distance x y hx hy)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.real_distance_zero_iff_diagram_eq
statement:
theorem real_distance_zero_iff_diagram_eq (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    realInterleavingDistance (RealBarcode.realize (k := k) (diagram x hx))
      (RealBarcode.realize (diagram y hy)) = 0 ↔ diagram x hx = diagram y hy
proof:
:= by
  rw [← diagram_bottleneck_eq_real_distance]
  exact bottleneck_eq_zero_iff _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.real_distance_zero_iff_iso
statement:
theorem real_distance_zero_iff_iso (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    realInterleavingDistance (RealBarcode.realize (k := k) (diagram x hx))
      (RealBarcode.realize (diagram y hy)) = 0 ↔
        Nonempty (RealBarcode.realize (k := k) (diagram x hx) ≅
          RealBarcode.realize (diagram y hy))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨eqToIso (congrArg (RealBarcode.realize (k := k))
      ((real_distance_zero_iff_diagram_eq x y hx hy).mp h))⟩
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    exact realInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_of_iso e

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.interleaving_iff_cost_matching
statement:
theorem interleaving_iff_cost_matching (x : ι → ℝ × ℝ) (y : κ → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε (RealBarcode.realize (k := k) (diagram x hx))
      (RealBarcode.realize (diagram y hy))) ↔
      ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching ι κ PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
        A.cost x y PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨I⟩
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := RectangleMatching.exists_matching (k := k) (by decide : 0 < 1)
      (fun i => halfOpenRectangle (x i) (hx i)) (fun j => halfOpenRectangle (y j) (hy j))
      ε (ofRealInterleaving x y hx hy I)
    have hM' : RectangleMatching.IsMatching (k := k) ε
        (fun i => halfOpenRectangle (x i) (hx i))
        (fun j => halfOpenRectangle (y j) (hy j)) M := by
      simpa [stabilityRadius] using hM
    exact exists_cost_matching x y hx hy ε M hM'
  · rintro ⟨M, hM⟩
    exact ⟨toRealInterleaving x y hx hy (isMatching_of_cost x y hx hy ε M hM).interleaving⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.upperOpen_lower_lt_upper
statement:
theorem upperOpen_lower_lt_upper (R : Rectangle 1) (hu : (R 0).upperClosed = false) :

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.rectangle_eq_halfOpen
statement:
theorem rectangle_eq_halfOpen (R : Rectangle 1)
    (hl : (R 0).lowerClosed = true) (hu : (R 0).upperClosed = false) :
    R = halfOpenRectangle ((R 0).lower, (R 0).upper) (upperOpen_lower_lt_upper R hu)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  change (⟨(R 0).lower, (R 0).upper, (R 0).lowerClosed,
      (R 0).upperClosed, (R 0).nonempty⟩ : BoundedInterval) = _
  simp only [halfOpenRectangle, BoundedInterval.mk.injEq]
  simpa only [true_and] using And.intro hl hu

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleBarcodeBridge.empty_interval_isZero
statement:
theorem empty_interval_isZero (p : ℝ × ℝ) (h : p.2 ≤ p.1) :
    IsZero (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply Functor.isZero
  intro t
  change IsZero (ModuleCat.of k (RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop ℝ)) t))
  have hn : ¬ RealBarcode.alive (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop ℝ)) t := by
    rintro ⟨hl, hu⟩
    exact not_lt_of_ge (h.trans hl) (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp hu)
  have : Subsingleton (RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop ℝ)) t) := by
    simp only [RealBarcode.fiber, if_neg hn]
    infer_instance
  exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.tail_box_shifted
statement:
private theorem tail_box_shifted (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)
    {A b C : ℝ} (hab : A + (ε : ℝ) ≤ b) (hbc : b + (ε : ℝ) ≤ C)
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage N hbc)] :
    persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab
        (show b ≤ C + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith) ≤
      persistenceTailMeasureValue N
        (show A ≤ b + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith) hbc
proof:
:= by
  have hab' : A ≤ b + (ε : ℝ) := by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith
  have hbc' : b ≤ C + (ε : ℝ) := by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith
  let U := persistenceImage N hbc
  let E := persistenceImage N (hab'.trans hbc)
  let V := persistenceImage M hbc'
  let F := persistenceImage M (hab.trans hbc')
  let L : Submodule k U := V.comap ((i.ψ.app C).hom.comp U.subtype)
  let g : L →ₗ[k] V :=
    ((i.ψ.app C).hom.comp (U.subtype.comp L.subtype)).codRestrict V
      (fun x => x.property)
  have hg : Function.Surjective g := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := y.property
    let z := structureMapLinear N hbc ((i.φ.app b).hom x)
    have hz : (i.ψ.app C).hom z = y.val := by
      have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (i.crossing_factorization hbc) x
      exact h.trans hx
    refine ⟨⟨⟨z, ⟨(i.φ.app b).hom x, rfl⟩⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · change (i.ψ.app C).hom z ∈ V
      rw [hz]
      exact y.property
    · exact Subtype.ext hz
  let Q := (E.comap U.subtype).comap L.subtype
  let q := (F.comap V.subtype).mkQ
  have hQ : Q ≤ LinearMap.ker (q.comp g) := by
    intro z hz
    change q (g z) = 0
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mpr
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨(i.ψ.app A).hom x, ?_⟩
    have hn := congrArg ModuleCat.Hom.hom
      (i.ψ.naturality (homOfLE (hab'.trans hbc)))
    have hn' := LinearMap.congr_fun hn x
    change (i.ψ.app C).hom (structureMapLinear N (hab'.trans hbc) x) =
      structureMapLinear M (hab.trans hbc') ((i.ψ.app A).hom x) at hn'
    rw [hx] at hn'
    exact hn'.symm
  let f : L ⧸ Q →ₗ[k] V ⧸ F.comap V.subtype := Q.liftQ (q.comp g) hQ
  have hf : Function.Surjective f := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (F.comap V.subtype).mkQ_surjective y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hg z
    exact ⟨Q.mkQ x, by change q (g x) = y; rw [hx]; exact hz⟩
  let j : L ⧸ Q →ₗ[k] U ⧸ E.comap U.subtype :=
    Q.mapQ (E.comap U.subtype) L.subtype le_rfl
  have hj : Function.Injective j := by
    apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
    exact Submodule.ker_liftQ_eq_bot _ _ _ (by
      intro x hx
      exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero (E.comap U.subtype)).mp hx)
  exact (LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_surjective hf).trans
    (LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective hj)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.persistenceTailMeasureValue_box_le
statement:
theorem persistenceTailMeasureValue_box_le (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)
    {a b c : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hgap : b + (ε : ℝ) ≤ c - (ε : ℝ))
    [FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage N hgap)] :
    persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab
        (show b ≤ c by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith) ≤
      persistenceTailMeasureValue N
        (show a - (ε : ℝ) ≤ b + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith) hgap
proof:
:= by
  have h := i.tail_box_shifted
    (show (a - (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) ≤ b by simpa using hab) hgap
  simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.essentialMeasureValue_box_le_of_qTame
statement:
theorem essentialMeasureValue_box_le_of_qTame (i : RealInterleaving ε M N)
    (hN : N.QTame) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    essentialMeasureValue M hab ≤ essentialMeasureValue N
      (show a - (ε : ℝ) ≤ b + (ε : ℝ) by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith)
proof:
:= by
  have hab' : a - (ε : ℝ) ≤ b + (ε : ℝ) := by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hE⟩ := exists_tail_eq_essentialMeasureValue N hab'
  have : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage N hC.le) := hN _ _ hC
  have hbC : b < C + (ε : ℝ) := by have := ε.coe_nonneg; linarith
  have h := i.tail_box_shifted
    (show (a - (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) ≤ b by simpa using hab) hC.le
  have h' : persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab hbC.le ≤
      persistenceTailMeasureValue N hab' hC.le := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using h
  exact (essentialMeasureValue_le_tail M hab hbC).trans (h'.trans_eq hE)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finite_uniform_right_slack
statement:
private theorem finite_uniform_right_slack {ι : Type v} (S : Set ι) (hS : S.Finite)
    (Q : ι → ℝ → Prop)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ S, ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ → δ ≤ ε → Q a δ) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ → δ ≤ ε → ∀ a ∈ S, Q a δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Set.Finite.induction_on_subset
    (motive := fun T _ => ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ → δ ≤ ε → ∀ a ∈ T, Q a δ)
    S hS ?_ ?_
  · refine ⟨1, zero_lt_one, ?_⟩
    intro δ _ _ a ha
    cases ha
  · intro a T haS _ _ hT
    obtain ⟨εa, hεa, hQa⟩ := h a haS
    obtain ⟨εT, hεT, hQT⟩ := hT
    refine ⟨min εa εT, lt_min hεa hεT, ?_⟩
    intro δ hδ hδmin b hb
    rcases Set.mem_insert_iff.mp hb with rfl | hbT
    · exact hQa δ hδ (le_trans hδmin (min_le_left _ _))
    · exact hQT δ hδ (le_trans hδmin (min_le_right _ _)) b hbT

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_pos_postcomp_shiftLE_bijective
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_pos_postcomp_shiftLE_bijective
    (M N : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := R) M) (hN : FinitelyPresented (R := R) N)
    (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ η : ℝ≥0, 0 < η ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ≥0, δ ≤ η →
      Function.Bijective (fun f : M ⟶ (shift ε).obj N =>
        f ≫ shiftLE (show ε ≤ ε + δ from le_self_add) N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, htest⟩ := finitelyPresented_exists_finite_postcomp_tests M hM
  let Q : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ → Prop := fun a δ => ∀ hδ : 0 ≤ δ,
    IsIso (structureMap N
      (show translation ε a ≤ (fun i => translation ε a i + δ) from
        fun _ => le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ))
  have hlocal : ∀ a ∈ S, ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 ≤ δ → δ ≤ η → Q a δ := by
    intro a _
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hstable⟩ :=
      finitelyPresented_exists_pos_structureMap_isIso N hN (translation ε a)
    exact ⟨η, hη, fun δ hδ hδη _ => hstable δ hδ hδη⟩
  obtain ⟨η, hη, huniform⟩ := finite_uniform_right_slack S hS Q hlocal
  refine ⟨⟨η, hη.le⟩, hη, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ
  apply htest
  intro a ha
  have hstable := huniform δ δ.coe_nonneg hδ a ha δ.coe_nonneg
  have htarget : translation (ε + δ) a =
      (fun i => translation ε a i + (δ : ℝ)) := by
    funext i
    simp only [translation_apply, NNReal.coe_add, add_assoc]
  have hiso : IsIso ((shiftLE (show ε ≤ ε + δ from le_self_add) N).app a) := by
    let e := N.mapIso (eqToIso htarget.symm)
    have hcomparison : (shiftLE (show ε ≤ ε + δ from le_self_add) N).app a =
        structureMap N
          (show translation ε a ≤ (fun i => translation ε a i + (δ : ℝ)) from
            fun _ => le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg) ≫ e.hom := by
      change N.map _ = N.map _ ≫ N.map _
      erw [← N.map_comp]
      congr 1
    rw [hcomparison]
    exact IsIso.comp_isIso' hstable e.isIso_hom
  exact (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mp hiso
