name: TDA.Persistence.shiftNegPos_inverse_coherence
statement:
private theorem shiftNegPos_inverse_coherence (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (shiftNegPosIso (k := k) (n := n) ε M).inv =
      (shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε
        ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj M)).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext p
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  ext x
  rw [CoordinateShift.shift_map_app, shiftNegPosIso_inv_app,
    shiftPosNegIso_inv_app]
  change (M.map (eqToHom
      (translationPosNeg_eq_id' (n := n) ε (CoordinateShift.translation ε p)).symm)).hom x =
    (M.map ((CoordinateShift.translation ε).toFunctor.map (eqToHom
      (translationNegPos_eq_id' (n := n) ε p).symm))).hom x
  have hmap := orderFunctor_map_eqToHom (CoordinateShift.translation ε)
    (translationNegPos_eq_id' (n := n) ε p).symm
  have hproof : congrArg (CoordinateShift.translation ε)
      (translationNegPos_eq_id' (n := n) ε p).symm =
      (translationPosNeg_eq_id' (n := n) ε
        (CoordinateShift.translation ε p)).symm := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hmaps := hmap.trans (congrArg eqToHom hproof)
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) (congrArg M.map hmaps)

name: TDA.Persistence.shiftNegPosIso_naturality
statement:
private theorem shiftNegPosIso_naturality (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (shiftNegPosIso (k := k) (n := n) ε M).hom ≫ f =
      (shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).map f) ≫
        (shiftNegPosIso (k := k) (n := n) ε N).hom
proof:
:= by
  change (shiftNegPosNatIso (k := k) (n := n) ε).hom.app M ≫ f =
    (shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map
      ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).map f) ≫
      (shiftNegPosNatIso (k := k) (n := n) ε).hom.app N
  exact ((shiftNegPosNatIso (k := k) (n := n) ε).hom.naturality f).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.shiftPosNegIso_naturality
statement:
private theorem shiftPosNegIso_naturality (ε : ℝ≥0)
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε M).hom ≫ f =
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map ((shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map f) ≫
        (shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε N).hom
proof:
:= by
  change (shiftPosNegNatIso (k := k) (n := n) ε).hom.app M ≫ f =
    (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
      ((shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map f) ≫
      (shiftPosNegNatIso (k := k) (n := n) ε).hom.app N
  exact ((shiftPosNegNatIso (k := k) (n := n) ε).hom.naturality f).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.zero_isRankProjective
statement:
private theorem zero_isRankProjective :
    IsRankProjective (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  intro L M N ι π hs α
  exact ⟨0, (isZero_zero _).eq_of_src _ _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.zeroTargetRow_rankExact
statement:
private theorem zeroTargetRow_rankExact {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (e : M ≅ 0) :
    IsRankExact (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) ⟶ 0)
      (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) ⟶ M)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub (p : Fin n → ℝ) : Subsingleton (M.obj p) := by
    refine ⟨fun x y => ?_⟩
    apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective (e.hom.app p)).mp inferInstance
    exact (ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)).elim _ _
  refine {
    toIsPointwiseShortExact := {
      injective := fun p => by
        intro x y _
        letI : Subsingleton ((0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)).obj p) :=
          ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)
        exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
      surjective := fun p y => ⟨0, (hsub p).elim _ _⟩
      range_eq_ker := fun p => by
        letI : Subsingleton ((0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)).obj p) :=
          ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)
        ext x
        have hx : x = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        subst x
        simp
    }
    finiteDimensional := fun p => by
      letI : Subsingleton ((0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)).obj p) :=
        ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)
      letI : Finite ((0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)).obj p) := Finite.of_subsingleton
      infer_instance
    rank_add := ?_
  }
  intro a b hab
  have hrange : Subsingleton
      (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hab)) :=
    ⟨fun x y => Subtype.ext ((hsub b).elim x.val y.val)⟩
  letI := hrange
  have hrank : Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hab)) = 0 :=
    Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton
  change rankOfStructureMap (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) hab =
    rankOfStructureMap (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) hab +
      rankOfStructureMap M hab
  simp only [rankOfStructureMap_zero]
  change 0 = 0 + Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hab))
  rw [hrank]

name: TDA.Persistence.biprodFiberIso_fst
statement:
private theorem biprodFiberIso_fst
    (A B : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) (p : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B p).hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.fst k (A.obj p) (B.obj p)) =
      (biprod.fst : A ⊞ B ⟶ A).app p
proof:
:= by
  let F := (evaluation (Fin n → ℝ) (ModuleCat.{u} k)).obj p
  letI := preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_preservesBinaryProduct F (X := A) (Y := B)
  let e := ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd (A.obj p) (B.obj p)
  have he : e.hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.fst k (A.obj p) (B.obj p)) =
      biprod.fst := by
    calc
      e.hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.fst k (A.obj p) (B.obj p)) =
          e.hom ≫ e.inv ≫ biprod.fst := by
            rw [← ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd_inv_comp_fst]
      _ = biprod.fst := by simp
  calc
    (biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B p).hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.fst k (A.obj p) (B.obj p)) =
      (Functor.mapBiprod F A B).hom ≫ biprod.fst := by
        dsimp [biprodFiberIso]
        rw [Category.assoc, he]
        rfl
    _ = F.map biprod.fst := by
      change biprod.lift (F.map biprod.fst) (F.map biprod.snd) ≫ biprod.fst = _
      rw [biprod.lift_fst]
    _ = (biprod.fst : A ⊞ B ⟶ A).app p := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.biprodFiberIso_snd
statement:
private theorem biprodFiberIso_snd
    (A B : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) (p : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B p).hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd k (A.obj p) (B.obj p)) =
      (biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B).app p
proof:
:= by
  let F := (evaluation (Fin n → ℝ) (ModuleCat.{u} k)).obj p
  letI := preservesBinaryBiproduct_of_preservesBinaryProduct F (X := A) (Y := B)
  let e := ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd (A.obj p) (B.obj p)
  have he : e.hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd k (A.obj p) (B.obj p)) =
      biprod.snd := by
    calc
      e.hom ≫ ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd k (A.obj p) (B.obj p)) =
          e.hom ≫ e.inv ≫ biprod.snd := by
            rw [← ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd_inv_comp_snd]
      _ = biprod.snd := by simp
  calc
    (biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B p).hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.snd k (A.obj p) (B.obj p)) =
      (Functor.mapBiprod F A B).hom ≫ biprod.snd := by
        dsimp [biprodFiberIso]
        rw [Category.assoc, he]
        rfl
    _ = F.map biprod.snd := by
      change biprod.lift (F.map biprod.fst) (F.map biprod.snd) ≫ biprod.snd = _
      rw [biprod.lift_snd]
    _ = (biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B).app p := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.biprodMap_fiber
statement:
private theorem biprodMap_fiber
    {A B A' B' : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (f : A ⟶ A') (g : B ⟶ B') (p : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B p).hom ≫
        ModuleCat.ofHom ((f.app p).hom.prodMap (g.app p).hom) =
      (biprod.map f g).app p ≫
        (biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A' B' p).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Prod.ext
  · have hsrc : ((biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B p).hom.hom x).1 =
        ((biprod.fst : A ⊞ B ⟶ A).app p).hom x := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : (A ⊞ B).obj p ⟶ A.obj p => q.hom x)
        (biprodFiberIso_fst (k := k) (n := n) A B p)
      simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply] using h
    have htgt :
        (LinearMap.fst k (A'.obj p) (B'.obj p))
          ((biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A' B' p).hom.hom
            (((biprod.map f g).app p).hom x)) =
          ((biprod.fst : A' ⊞ B' ⟶ A').app p).hom (((biprod.map f g).app p).hom x) := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : (A' ⊞ B').obj p ⟶ A'.obj p =>
        q.hom (((biprod.map f g).app p).hom x))
        (biprodFiberIso_fst (k := k) (n := n) A' B' p)
      simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply] using h
    have hnat : ((biprod.fst : A' ⊞ B' ⟶ A').app p).hom (((biprod.map f g).app p).hom x) =
        (f.app p).hom (((biprod.fst : A ⊞ B ⟶ A).app p).hom x) := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : A ⊞ B ⟶ A' => (q.app p).hom x)
        (biprod.map_fst (f := f) (g := g))
      exact h
    calc
      _ = (f.app p).hom (((biprod.fst : A ⊞ B ⟶ A).app p).hom x) := by
        change (f.app p).hom ((biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B p).hom.hom x).1 = _
        rw [hsrc]
      _ = ((biprod.fst : A' ⊞ B' ⟶ A').app p).hom (((biprod.map f g).app p).hom x) := hnat.symm
      _ = _ := htgt.symm

  · have hsrc : ((biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B p).hom.hom x).2 =
        ((biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B).app p).hom x := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : (A ⊞ B).obj p ⟶ B.obj p => q.hom x)
        (biprodFiberIso_snd (k := k) (n := n) A B p)
      simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply] using h
    have htgt :
        (LinearMap.snd k (A'.obj p) (B'.obj p))
          ((biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A' B' p).hom.hom
            (((biprod.map f g).app p).hom x)) =
          ((biprod.snd : A' ⊞ B' ⟶ B').app p).hom (((biprod.map f g).app p).hom x) := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : (A' ⊞ B').obj p ⟶ B'.obj p =>
        q.hom (((biprod.map f g).app p).hom x))
        (biprodFiberIso_snd (k := k) (n := n) A' B' p)
      simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply] using h
    have hnat : ((biprod.snd : A' ⊞ B' ⟶ B').app p).hom (((biprod.map f g).app p).hom x) =
        (g.app p).hom (((biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B).app p).hom x) := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : A ⊞ B ⟶ B' => (q.app p).hom x)
        (biprod.map_snd (f := f) (g := g))
      exact h
    calc
      _ = (g.app p).hom (((biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B).app p).hom x) := by
        change (g.app p).hom ((biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B p).hom.hom x).2 = _
        rw [hsrc]
      _ = ((biprod.snd : A' ⊞ B' ⟶ B').app p).hom (((biprod.map f g).app p).hom x) := hnat.symm
      _ = _ := htgt.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.biprodMap_fiber_apply
statement:
private theorem biprodMap_fiber_apply
    {A B A' B' : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (f : A ⟶ A') (g : B ⟶ B') (p : Fin n → ℝ)
    (x : (A ⊞ B).obj p) :
    ((biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A' B' p).hom.hom
      (((biprod.map f g).app p).hom x)) =
      (f.app p).hom.prodMap (g.app p).hom
        ((biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B p).hom.hom x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q : (A ⊞ B).obj p ⟶
      ModuleCat.of k (A'.obj p × B'.obj p) => q.hom x)
    (biprodMap_fiber (k := k) (n := n) f g p)
  simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply] using h.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.biprodStructureMap_fiber
statement:
private theorem biprodStructureMap_fiber
    (A B : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) {a b : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (x : (A ⊞ B).obj a) :
    ((biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B b).hom.hom
      (structureMapLinear (A ⊞ B) hab x)) =
      (structureMapLinear A hab).prodMap (structureMapLinear B hab)
        ((biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B a).hom.hom x)
proof:
:= by
  let ea := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B a
  let eb := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B b
  apply Prod.ext
  · have hsrc : (ea.hom.hom x).1 =
        ((biprod.fst : A ⊞ B ⟶ A).app a).hom x := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : (A ⊞ B).obj a ⟶ A.obj a => q.hom x)
        (biprodFiberIso_fst (k := k) (n := n) A B a)
      simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply] using h
    have htgt : (eb.hom.hom (structureMapLinear (A ⊞ B) hab x)).1 =
        ((biprod.fst : A ⊞ B ⟶ A).app b).hom (structureMapLinear (A ⊞ B) hab x) := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : (A ⊞ B).obj b ⟶ A.obj b =>
        q.hom (structureMapLinear (A ⊞ B) hab x))
        (biprodFiberIso_fst (k := k) (n := n) A B b)
      simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply] using h
    have hnat := congrArg (fun q : (A ⊞ B).obj a ⟶ A.obj b => q.hom x)
      ((biprod.fst : A ⊞ B ⟶ A).naturality (homOfLE hab))
    change ((biprod.fst : A ⊞ B ⟶ A).app b).hom
        (structureMapLinear (A ⊞ B) hab x) =
      (structureMapLinear A hab)
        (((biprod.fst : A ⊞ B ⟶ A).app a).hom x) at hnat
    calc
      (eb.hom.hom (structureMapLinear (A ⊞ B) hab x)).1 =
          ((biprod.fst : A ⊞ B ⟶ A).app b).hom
            (structureMapLinear (A ⊞ B) hab x) := htgt
      _ = (structureMapLinear A hab)
          (((biprod.fst : A ⊞ B ⟶ A).app a).hom x) := hnat
      _ = (structureMapLinear A hab) ((ea.hom.hom x).1) := by rw [hsrc]
      _ = ((structureMapLinear A hab).prodMap (structureMapLinear B hab)
          (ea.hom.hom x)).1 := rfl
  · have hsrc : (ea.hom.hom x).2 =
        ((biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B).app a).hom x := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : (A ⊞ B).obj a ⟶ B.obj a => q.hom x)
        (biprodFiberIso_snd (k := k) (n := n) A B a)
      simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply] using h
    have htgt : (eb.hom.hom (structureMapLinear (A ⊞ B) hab x)).2 =
        ((biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B).app b).hom (structureMapLinear (A ⊞ B) hab x) := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : (A ⊞ B).obj b ⟶ B.obj b =>
        q.hom (structureMapLinear (A ⊞ B) hab x))
        (biprodFiberIso_snd (k := k) (n := n) A B b)
      simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply] using h
    have hnat := congrArg (fun q : (A ⊞ B).obj a ⟶ B.obj b => q.hom x)
      ((biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B).naturality (homOfLE hab))
    change ((biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B).app b).hom
        (structureMapLinear (A ⊞ B) hab x) =
      (structureMapLinear B hab)
        (((biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B).app a).hom x) at hnat
    calc
      (eb.hom.hom (structureMapLinear (A ⊞ B) hab x)).2 =
          ((biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B).app b).hom
            (structureMapLinear (A ⊞ B) hab x) := htgt
      _ = (structureMapLinear B hab)
          (((biprod.snd : A ⊞ B ⟶ B).app a).hom x) := hnat
      _ = (structureMapLinear B hab) ((ea.hom.hom x).2) := by rw [hsrc]
      _ = ((structureMapLinear A hab).prodMap (structureMapLinear B hab)
          (ea.hom.hom x)).2 := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.biprod
proof:
:= by
    let e₀ := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B p
    let e₁ := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A' B' p
    intro x y h
    apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective e₀.hom).mp inferInstance
    apply Prod.ext
    · have hx := biprodMap_fiber_apply (k := k) (n := n) f f' p x
      have hy := biprodMap_fiber_apply (k := k) (n := n) f f' p y
      have heq := congrArg e₁.hom.hom h
      have hc : (f.app p).hom.prodMap (f'.app p).hom (e₀.hom.hom x) =
          (f.app p).hom.prodMap (f'.app p).hom (e₀.hom.hom y) := by
        rw [← hx, ← hy]
        exact heq
      exact hA.injective p (congrArg Prod.fst hc)
    · have hx := biprodMap_fiber_apply (k := k) (n := n) f f' p x
      have hy := biprodMap_fiber_apply (k := k) (n := n) f f' p y
      have heq := congrArg e₁.hom.hom h
      have hc : (f.app p).hom.prodMap (f'.app p).hom (e₀.hom.hom x) =
          (f.app p).hom.prodMap (f'.app p).hom (e₀.hom.hom y) := by
        rw [← hx, ← hy]
        exact heq
      exact hB.injective p (congrArg Prod.snd hc)
  surjective p := by
    let e₀ := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B p
    let e₁ := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A' B' p
    let e₂ := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A'' B'' p
    intro z
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hA.surjective p (e₂.hom.hom z).1
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hB.surjective p (e₂.hom.hom z).2
    refine ⟨e₁.inv.hom (x, y), ?_⟩
    apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective e₂.hom).mp inferInstance
    calc
      e₂.hom.hom (((biprod.map g g').app p).hom (e₁.inv.hom (x, y))) =
          (g.app p).hom.prodMap (g'.app p).hom
            (e₁.hom.hom (e₁.inv.hom (x, y))) :=
        biprodMap_fiber_apply (k := k) (n := n) g g' p _
      _ = e₂.hom.hom z := by simp [hx, hy]
  range_eq_ker p := by
    let e₀ := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A B p
    let e₁ := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A' B' p
    let e₂ := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A'' B'' p
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective e₂.hom).mp inferInstance
      change (e₂.hom.hom (((biprod.map g g').app p).hom
          (((biprod.map f f').app p).hom x))) = e₂.hom.hom 0
      calc
        e₂.hom.hom (((biprod.map g g').app p).hom
            (((biprod.map f f').app p).hom x)) =
            (g.app p).hom.prodMap (g'.app p).hom
              (e₁.hom.hom (((biprod.map f f').app p).hom x)) :=
          biprodMap_fiber_apply (k := k) (n := n) g g' p _
        _ = (g.app p).hom.prodMap (g'.app p).hom
            ((f.app p).hom.prodMap (f'.app p).hom (e₀.hom.hom x)) := by
          rw [biprodMap_fiber_apply (k := k) (n := n) f f' p x]
        _ = 0 := by
          apply Prod.ext
          · have hmem : (f.app p).hom (e₀.hom.hom x).1 ∈
                LinearMap.range (f.app p).hom := ⟨(e₀.hom.hom x).1, rfl⟩
            rw [hA.range_eq_ker p] at hmem
            exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hmem
          · have hmem : (f'.app p).hom (e₀.hom.hom x).2 ∈
                LinearMap.range (f'.app p).hom := ⟨(e₀.hom.hom x).2, rfl⟩
            rw [hB.range_eq_ker p] at hmem
            exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hmem
        _ = e₂.hom.hom 0 := by simp
    · intro hz
      change ((biprod.map g g').app p).hom z = 0 at hz
      have hz' : (g.app p).hom.prodMap (g'.app p).hom (e₁.hom.hom z) = 0 := by
        rw [← biprodMap_fiber_apply (k := k) (n := n) g g' p z]
        simp [hz]
      have hxker : (e₁.hom.hom z).1 ∈ LinearMap.ker (g.app p).hom :=
        LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (by simpa using congrArg Prod.fst hz')
      have hyker : (e₁.hom.hom z).2 ∈ LinearMap.ker (g'.app p).hom :=
        LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr (by simpa using congrArg Prod.snd hz')
      rw [← hA.range_eq_ker p] at hxker
      rw [← hB.range_eq_ker p] at hyker
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hxker
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hyker
      refine ⟨e₀.inv.hom (x, y), ?_⟩
      apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective e₁.hom).mp inferInstance
      calc
        e₁.hom.hom (((biprod.map f f').app p).hom (e₀.inv.hom (x, y))) =
            (f.app p).hom.prodMap (f'.app p).hom
              (e₀.hom.hom (e₀.inv.hom (x, y))) :=
          biprodMap_fiber_apply (k := k) (n := n) f f' p _
        _ = e₁.hom.hom z := by simp [hx, hy]

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankExact.biprod
proof:
:= by
  let hshort := hA.toIsPointwiseShortExact.biprod hB.toIsPointwiseShortExact
  refine {
    toIsPointwiseShortExact := hshort
    finiteDimensional := ?_
    rank_add := ?_
  }
  · intro p
    let e := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A' B' p
    letI : FiniteDimensional k (A'.obj p) := hA.finiteDimensional p
    letI : FiniteDimensional k (B'.obj p) := hB.finiteDimensional p
    letI : FiniteDimensional k (A'.obj p × B'.obj p) := inferInstance
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective e.inv.hom := by
      intro x
      exact ⟨e.hom.hom x, by simp⟩
    exact FiniteDimensional.of_surjective e.inv.hom hsurj
  · intro a b hab
    let hmidA := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A' B' a
    let hmidB := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A' B' b
    let hquotA := biprodFiberIso (k := k) (n := n) A'' B'' a
    letI : FiniteDimensional k (A'.obj a) := hA.finiteDimensional a
    letI : FiniteDimensional k (B'.obj a) := hB.finiteDimensional a
    letI : FiniteDimensional k (A'.obj a × B'.obj a) := inferInstance
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective hmidA.inv.hom := by
      intro x
      exact ⟨hmidA.hom.hom x, by simp⟩
    letI : FiniteDimensional k ((A' ⊞ B').obj a) :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_surjective hmidA.inv.hom hsurj
    apply (hshort.rank_add_iff_lift_kernel hab).mpr
    intro z hz
    have hzpair : (structureMapLinear A'' hab).prodMap
        (structureMapLinear B'' hab) (hquotA.hom.hom z) = 0 := by
      rw [← biprodStructureMap_fiber (k := k) (n := n) A'' B'' hab z]
      simp [hz]
    have hza : structureMapLinear A'' hab (hquotA.hom.hom z).1 = 0 := by
      simpa using congrArg Prod.fst hzpair
    have hzb : structureMapLinear B'' hab (hquotA.hom.hom z).2 = 0 := by
      simpa using congrArg Prod.snd hzpair
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxdie⟩ := hA.lift_kernel hab (hquotA.hom.hom z).1 hza
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hydie⟩ := hB.lift_kernel hab (hquotA.hom.hom z).2 hzb
    let w := hmidA.inv.hom (x, y)
    refine ⟨w, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective hquotA.hom).mp inferInstance
      calc
        hquotA.hom.hom (((biprod.map g g').app a).hom w) =
            (g.app a).hom.prodMap (g'.app a).hom
              (hmidA.hom.hom w) :=
          biprodMap_fiber_apply (k := k) (n := n) g g' a w
        _ = hquotA.hom.hom z := by simp [w, hx, hy]
    · apply (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective hmidB.hom).mp inferInstance
      rw [biprodStructureMap_fiber (k := k) (n := n) A' B' hab w]
      have hw : hmidA.hom.hom w = (x, y) := by
        change hmidA.hom.hom (hmidA.inv.hom (x, y)) = (x, y)
        have h := congrArg (fun q : ModuleCat.of k (A'.obj a × B'.obj a) ⟶
            ModuleCat.of k (A'.obj a × B'.obj a) => q.hom (x, y))
          hmidA.inv_hom_id
        simpa [ModuleCat.comp_apply] using h
      rw [hw]
      have hpair : (structureMapLinear A' hab).prodMap
          (structureMapLinear B' hab) (x, y) = 0 := Prod.ext hxdie hydie
      simpa using hpair

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankProjective.biprod
proof:
:= by
  intro L M N ι π hs α
  obtain ⟨βP, hβP⟩ := hP L M N ι π hs (biprod.inl ≫ α)
  obtain ⟨βQ, hβQ⟩ := hQ L M N ι π hs (biprod.inr ≫ α)
  refine ⟨biprod.desc βP βQ, ?_⟩
  apply biprod.hom_ext'
  · simpa only [← Category.assoc, biprod.inl_desc] using hβP
  · simpa only [← Category.assoc, biprod.inr_desc] using hβQ

name: TDA.Persistence.isZeroZeroBiprod
statement:
private theorem isZeroZeroBiprod :
    IsZero ((0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) ⊞ 0)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro Y
    refine ⟨{ default := (0 : (0 ⊞ 0) ⟶ Y), uniq := ?_ }⟩
    intro f
    apply biprod.hom_ext'
    · exact (isZero_zero _).eq_of_src
        (biprod.inl ≫ f) 0
    · exact (isZero_zero _).eq_of_src
        (biprod.inr ≫ f) 0
  · intro Y
    refine ⟨{ default := (0 : Y ⟶ (0 ⊞ 0)), uniq := ?_ }⟩
    intro f
    apply biprod.hom_ext
    · exact (isZero_zero _).eq_of_tgt
        (f ≫ biprod.fst) (0 ≫ biprod.fst)
    · exact (isZero_zero _).eq_of_tgt
        (f ≫ biprod.snd) (0 ≫ biprod.snd)

name: TDA.Persistence.projectiveIdentityRow
statement:
private theorem projectiveIdentityRow
    (P : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hfd : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (P.obj p)) :
    IsRankExact (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) ⟶ P) (𝟙 P)
proof:
:= by
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (P.obj p) := hfd
  have hs : IsPointwiseShortExact
      (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) ⟶ P) (𝟙 P) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro p x y _
      exact (ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)).elim _ _
    · intro p y
      exact ⟨y, by simp⟩
    · intro p
      ext x
      simp
  exact hs.rankExact_of_section (𝟙 P) (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.appendZeros_length
proof:
:= by
  induction count with
  | zero => simp [appendZeros]
  | succ count ih =>
      simp [appendZeros, appendZero, ih, Nat.add_assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_eq_term
proof:
:= by
  simp [termAt, hj]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  simp [termAt, not_lt.mpr hj]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_appendZero
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j < R.length
  · have hj' : j < (R.appendZero).length := by
      simp [FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.appendZero]
      omega
    rw [termAt_eq_term (R := R.appendZero) hj', termAt_eq_term (R := R) hj]
    change (Fin.lastCases (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
      (fun i => R.term i) ⟨j, hj'⟩) = R.term ⟨j, hj⟩
    have hidx : (⟨j, hj'⟩ : Fin (R.length + 1)) = (⟨j, hj⟩ : Fin R.length).castSucc := by
      ext
      rfl
    rw [hidx, Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
  · rw [termAt_eq_zero (R := R) (Nat.le_of_not_gt hj)]
    by_cases hj' : j < (R.appendZero).length
    · have hlast : j = R.length := by
        simp [FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.appendZero] at hj'
        omega
      subst j
      rw [termAt_eq_term (R := R.appendZero) (by
        simp [FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.appendZero])]
      change @Fin.lastCases R.length
          (fun _ : Fin (R.length + 1) => PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
          (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) (fun i => R.term i)
          (Fin.last R.length) = 0
      simp
    · simp [termAt, hj']

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_appendZeros
proof:
:= by
  induction count with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ count ih =>
      rw [appendZeros, termAt_appendZero, ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.identity_termAt
statement:
private theorem identity_termAt
    (P : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)) (hP : IsRankProjective P)
    (hfd : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (P.obj p)) (j : ℕ) :
    (FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.identity P hP hfd).termAt j =
      if j = 0 then P else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j = 0
  · subst j
    rw [termAt_eq_term (R := FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.identity P hP hfd) (by
      simp [FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.identity])]
    rfl
  · have hjlen : (FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.identity P hP hfd).length ≤ j := by
      simp [FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.identity]
      omega
    rw [termAt_eq_zero (R := FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.identity P hP hfd) hjlen]
    simp [hj]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.length_tail
statement:
@[simp] theorem FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.length_tail
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (R : FiniteRankProjectiveResolution M) (hpos : 0 < R.length) :
    (R.tail hpos).length = R.length - 1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_tail
statement:
theorem FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.termAt_tail
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (R : FiniteRankProjectiveResolution M) (hpos : 0 < R.length) (j : ℕ) :
    (R.tail hpos).termAt j = R.termAt (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j < R.length - 1
  · have hj' : j < (R.tail hpos).length := by simpa using hj
    have hjR : j + 1 < R.length := by omega
    rw [termAt_eq_term (R := R.tail hpos) hj', termAt_eq_term (R := R) hjR]
    rfl
  · have hj' : (R.tail hpos).length ≤ j := by simpa using Nat.le_of_not_gt hj
    have hjR : R.length ≤ j + 1 := by omega
    rw [termAt_eq_zero (R := R.tail hpos) hj', termAt_eq_zero (R := R) hjR]

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankProjective.shift
proof:
:= by
  intro L M N ι π hs α
  let hs' : IsRankExact ((shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map ι)
      ((shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map π) :=
    hs.reindex (translationNeg (n := n) ε)
  let α' : Q ⟶ (shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).obj N :=
    (shiftNegPosIso (k := k) (n := n) ε Q).inv ≫
      (shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map α
  obtain ⟨β', hβ'⟩ := hQ _ _ _
    ((shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map ι)
    ((shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map π) hs' α'
  refine ⟨(CoordinateShift.shift ε).map β' ≫
    (shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε M).hom, ?_⟩
  calc
    ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).map β' ≫
          (shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε M).hom) ≫ π =
        (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map β' ≫
          (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
            ((shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map π) ≫
          (shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε N).hom := by
            rw [Category.assoc, shiftPosNegIso_naturality (k := k) (n := n) ε π]
    _ = (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
          (β' ≫ (shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map π) ≫
          (shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε N).hom := by
            exact congrArg (fun f => f ≫ (shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε N).hom)
              ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).map_comp β'
                ((shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map π))
    _ = (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map α' ≫
          (shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε N).hom := by rw [hβ']
    _ = α := by
          dsimp [α']
          rw [Functor.map_comp, shiftNegPos_inverse_coherence]
          calc
            ((shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε
                ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj Q)).inv ≫
                (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
                  ((shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map α)) ≫
                (shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε N).hom =
                (shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε
                  ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj Q)).inv ≫
                  ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
                    ((shiftNeg (k := k) (n := n) ε).map α) ≫
                    (shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε N).hom) :=
                  Category.assoc _ _ _
            _ = (shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε
                  ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj Q)).inv ≫
                  ((shiftPosNegIso (k := k) (n := n) ε
                    ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj Q)).hom ≫ α) := by
                  exact congrArg _
                    (shiftPosNegIso_naturality (k := k) (n := n) ε α).symm
            _ = α := by simp

name: TDA.Persistence.resolutionBiproductSplitFinSucc_inl_hom
proof:
:= by

  intro j

    simp [resolutionBiproductSplitFinSucc, biproduct.uniqueUpToIso,
      Category.assoc, biproduct.lift_π,

name: TDA.Persistence.resolutionBiproductSplitFinSucc_inv_fst
proof:
:= by

      Category.assoc, biproduct.ι_desc,
      biproduct.ι_π_ne _ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm]

name: TDA.Persistence.isZero_biproduct_of_isZero
statement:
private theorem isZero_biproduct_of_isZero {ι : Type} [Finite ι]

private theorem selector_subordinate {C : SetRel X Y}

proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨x,y⟩ hxy

  rw [← hxy]

      (RealShift.shift ε).obj (simplicialHomologyPModule R G n)

name: TDA.Persistence.multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal_eq

@[simp] theorem multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMapNNReal_eq {C : SetRel X Y} {δ : ℝ≥0}
    (hTotal : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hC : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G (δ : ℝ) C) (n : ℕ) :

name: TDA.Persistence.shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap_id
statement:
theorem shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap_id (F : SimplicialFiltration ℝ X) (n : ℕ) :
    shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap R (isShiftedSimplicial_id F) n ≫
      (RealShift.zeroIso (simplicialHomologyPModule R F n)).hom =
        𝟙 (simplicialHomologyPModule R F n)
proof:
:= by
  have he : shiftedSimplicialHomologyMap R (isShiftedSimplicial_id F) n =
      RealShift.transition 0 (simplicialHomologyPModule R F n) := by
    apply NatTrans.ext
    funext t
    have hm : (isShiftedSimplicial_id F).vertexMap t =
        inclusionVertexMap (show F t ≤ F (t + 0) by simp) := by
      apply VertexMap.ext
      intro x
      rfl
    change simplicialHomologyMap R _ n = _
    rw [hm, simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion]
    rfl
  rw [he]
  exact RealShift.transition_zero _

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_infinity
statement:
@[simp] theorem moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_infinity (hM : M.QTame) (birth : Cut ℝ) :
    moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM (birth, infinityCut) =
      moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM birth
proof:
:= by
  simp [moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_of_mem_rectangleCell
statement:
theorem moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_of_mem_rectangleCell (hM : M.QTame)
    {a b c d : ℝ} {p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ} (hp : p ∈ rectangleCell a b c d) :
    moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p = moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p
proof:
:= by
  have hne : p.2 ≠ infinityCut := by
    intro h
    exact infinityCut_not_mem_cutCell c d (h ▸ hp.2)
  exact if_neg hne

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_rectangle_counts
statement:
theorem moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_rectangle_counts (hM : M.QTame)
    (a b c d : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) (hcd : c < d) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ),
      (∀ p, p ∈ S ↔ p ∈ rectangleCell a b c d ∧
        0 < moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p) ∧
      persistenceMeasureValue M hab.le hbc.le hcd.le =
        ∑ p ∈ S, moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hcount⟩ := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_rectangle_counts M hM a b c d hab hbc hcd
  refine ⟨S, ?_, hcount.trans ?_⟩
  · intro p
    constructor
    · intro hp
      obtain ⟨hpK, hpos⟩ := (hS p).mp hp
      exact ⟨hpK, (moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_of_mem_rectangleCell M hM hpK).symm ▸ hpos⟩
    · rintro ⟨hpK, hpos⟩
      rw [moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_of_mem_rectangleCell M hM hpK] at hpos
      exact (hS p).mpr ⟨hpK, hpos⟩
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p hp
    exact (moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_of_mem_rectangleCell M hM ((hS p).mp hp).1).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_essential_counts
statement:
theorem moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_essential_counts (hM : M.QTame)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Cut ℝ),
      (∀ birth, birth ∈ S ↔ birth ∈ cutCell a b ∧
        0 < moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM (birth, infinityCut)) ∧
      essentialMeasureValue M hab =
        ∑ birth ∈ S, moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM (birth, infinityCut)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_infinity] using
    moduleEssentialMultiplicity_strip_counts M hM hab

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_tail_counts
statement:
theorem moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_tail_counts (hM : M.QTame)
    (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ),
      (∀ p, p ∈ S ↔ p ∈ tailRectangleCell a b c ∧
        0 < moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p) ∧
      persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab.le hbc.le =
        ∑ p ∈ S, moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c₀, hbc₀, hstable⟩ := PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_eventually M hM hab.le
  let C := max c₀ (c + 1)
  have h₀C : c₀ ≤ C := le_max_left _ _
  have hcC : c < C := (lt_add_one c).trans_le (le_max_right _ _)
  have hbC : b < C := hbc.trans hcC
  have hTail : persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab.le hbC.le = essentialMeasureValue M hab.le :=
    hstable C h₀C
  have hzero : ∀ d (hCd : C ≤ d), persistenceMeasureValue M hab.le hbC.le hCd = 0 := by
    intro d hCd
    let : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbC.le) := hM b C hbC
    have h := persistenceMeasureValue_add_tail M hab.le hbC.le hCd
    rw [hstable C h₀C, hstable d (h₀C.trans hCd)] at h
    omega
  have hNoLate : ∀ p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ, p.1 ∈ cutCell a b → C ∈ p.2.lower →
      moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p = 0 := by
    intro p hpBirth hpC
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hpU⟩ := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_visible_of_pos M hM (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne)
    rcases hU with rfl | ⟨e, f, g, d, _, _, _, rfl⟩
    · exact hpU.elim
    · have hCd : C < d := p.2.lower_lt_upper hpC hpU.2.2
      have hpR : p ∈ rectangleCell a b C d := ⟨hpBirth, hpC, hpU.2.2⟩
      have hle := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_le_content M hM
        (rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells a b C d hbC) hpR
      rw [moduleRectangleContent_apply M hM a b C d hab hbC hCd, hzero d hCd.le] at hle
      omega
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hFcount⟩ := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_rectangle_counts M hM a b c C hab hbc hcC
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hEcount⟩ := moduleEssentialMultiplicity_strip_counts M hM hab.le
  let E' : Finset (Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) := E.image (fun birth => (birth, infinityCut))
  let S := F ∪ E'
  have hSupport : ∀ p, p ∈ S ↔ p ∈ tailRectangleCell a b c ∧
      0 < moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p := by
    intro p
    constructor
    · intro hp
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hp with hpF | hpE
      · obtain ⟨hpR, hpos⟩ := (hF p).mp hpF
        refine ⟨⟨hpR.1, hpR.2.1⟩, ?_⟩
        exact (moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_of_mem_rectangleCell M hM hpR).symm ▸ hpos
      · obtain ⟨birth, hbE, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpE
        obtain ⟨hbK, hpos⟩ := (hE birth).mp hbE
        exact ⟨⟨hbK, mem_lower_infinityCut c⟩, by simpa using hpos⟩
    · rintro ⟨hpK, hpos⟩
      by_cases hInf : p.2 = infinityCut
      · have hess : 0 < moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM p.1 := by
          simpa only [moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity, if_pos hInf] using hpos
        exact Finset.mem_union_right F (Finset.mem_image.mpr
          ⟨p.1, (hE p.1).mpr ⟨hpK.1, hess⟩, Prod.ext rfl hInf.symm⟩)
      · have hfinite : 0 < moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p := by
          simpa only [moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity, if_neg hInf] using hpos
        have hpC : C ∈ p.2.upper := by
          rcases p.2.mem_lower_or_upper C with hpC | hpC
          · have hz := hNoLate p hpK.1 hpC
            omega
          · exact hpC
        exact Finset.mem_union_left E' ((hF p).mpr ⟨⟨hpK.1, hpK.2, hpC⟩, hfinite⟩)
  have hFE : Disjoint F E' := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro p hpF hpE
    obtain ⟨birth, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpE
    exact infinityCut_not_mem_cutCell c C ((hF _).mp hpF).1.2
  have hFsum : ∑ p ∈ F, moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p =
      persistenceMeasureValue M hab.le hbc.le hcC.le := by
    rw [hFcount]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro p hpF
    exact moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_of_mem_rectangleCell M hM ((hF p).mp hpF).1
  have hEsum : ∑ p ∈ E', moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p =
      essentialMeasureValue M hab.le := by
    change ∑ p ∈ E.image (fun birth => (birth, infinityCut)),
      moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p = _
    rw [Finset.sum_image (by
      intro x _ y _ hxy
      exact congrArg Prod.fst hxy)]
    simpa only [moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_infinity] using hEcount.symm
  have hsum : ∑ p ∈ S, moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p =
      persistenceTailMeasureValue M hab.le hbc.le := by
    change ∑ p ∈ F ∪ E', moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p = _
    rw [Finset.sum_union hFE, hFsum, hEsum]
    let : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hbc.le) := hM b c hbc
    have h := persistenceMeasureValue_add_tail M hab.le hbc.le hcC.le
    rw [hTail] at h
    exact h
  exact ⟨S, hSupport, hsum.symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_tail_locally_finite
statement:
theorem moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_tail_locally_finite (hM : M.QTame)
    (a b c : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hbc : b < c) :
    Set.Finite {p | p ∈ tailRectangleCell a b c ∧
      0 < moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM p}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, _⟩ := moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_tail_counts M hM a b c hab hbc
  exact S.finite_toSet.subset (fun p hp => (hS p).mpr hp)

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.not_le_iff_exists_minimalComplement
statement:
theorem not_le_iff_exists_minimalComplement (p q : S) :
    ¬ q ≤ p ↔ ∃ a ∈ minimalComplement p, a ≤ q
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hq
    obtain ⟨a, haq, ha⟩ := exists_minimal_le_of_wellFoundedLT (fun x => ¬ x ≤ p) q hq
    exact ⟨a, ha, haq⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, haq⟩ hq
    exact (show Minimal (fun x => ¬ x ≤ p) a from ha).prop (haq.trans hq)

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.minimalComplement_eq_empty_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem minimalComplement_eq_empty_iff (p : S) :
    minimalComplement p = ∅ ↔ p = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply top_le_iff.mp
    by_contra hp
    obtain ⟨a, ha, _⟩ := (not_le_iff_exists_minimalComplement p ⊤).mp hp
    simp [h] at ha
  · rintro rfl
    ext a
    simp [minimalComplement, Minimal]

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.range_complementEnumeration
statement:
theorem range_complementEnumeration (p : S) :
    Set.range (complementEnumeration p) = minimalComplement p
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    exact ((Fintype.equivFin (minimalComplement p)).symm i).property
  · intro ha
    refine ⟨Fintype.equivFin (minimalComplement p) ⟨a, ha⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [complementEnumeration]

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.complementEnumeration_injective
statement:
theorem complementEnumeration_injective (p : S) :
    Function.Injective (complementEnumeration p)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.coe_injective.comp (Fintype.equivFin (minimalComplement p)).symm.injective

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.complementCard_eq_zero_iff
statement: @[simp] theorem complementCard_eq_zero_iff (p : S) : complementCard p = 0 ↔ p = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [complementCard, Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff]
  rw [Set.isEmpty_coe_sort, minimalComplement_eq_empty_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.complementSupport_eq
statement:
theorem complementSupport_eq (p : S) :
    GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.complementSupport (complementEnumeration p) = Set.Iic p
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  change (¬ ∃ i, complementEnumeration p i ≤ q) ↔ q ≤ p
  have hgen : (∃ i, complementEnumeration p i ≤ q) ↔ ¬ q ≤ p := by
    rw [not_le_iff_exists_minimalComplement]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
      exact ⟨_, (range_complementEnumeration p).le ⟨i, rfl⟩, hi⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, ha, haq⟩
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := (range_complementEnumeration p).symm.le ha
      exact ⟨i, haq⟩
  rw [hgen, not_not]

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.nonTopResolution_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem nonTopResolution_length (p : S) (hp : 0 < complementCard p) :
    (nonTopResolution (k := k) p hp).length = complementCard p
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.nonTopResolution_term
statement:
@[simp] theorem nonTopResolution_term (p : S) (hp : 0 < complementCard p)
    (i : Fin (complementCard p)) :
    (nonTopResolution (k := k) p hp).term i =
      GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.term (k := k) (complementEnumeration p) i.val
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.nonTopResolution_augmentation
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nonTopResolution_augmentation (p : S) (hp : 0 < complementCard p) :
    (nonTopResolution (k := k) p hp).quotient ⟨0, hp⟩ ≫
      (nonTopResolution (k := k) p hp).initial_iso.hom =
    GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation (k := k) (complementEnumeration p) ≫
      (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.targetIso (k := k) (complementEnumeration p) hp).hom ≫
        (complementIso p).hom
proof:
:= by
  simp [nonTopResolution, FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.ofIso,
    GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.complementResolution,
    GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.resolution,
    GeneratedUpsetQuotientFiniteResolution.kernelAt]

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.nonTopResolution_augmentation_projection
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem nonTopResolution_augmentation_projection (p : S)
    (hp : 0 < complementCard p) :
    cokernel.π (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.inclusion (k := k) (complementEnumeration p) 0) ≫
      ((nonTopResolution (k := k) p hp).quotient ⟨0, hp⟩ ≫
        (nonTopResolution (k := k) p hp).initial_iso.hom) =
    GeneratedUpsetResolution.augmentation
      (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.bottomFamily (complementCard p)) ≫
        GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.targetProjection (k := k) (complementEnumeration p) hp ≫
          (complementIso p).hom
proof:
:= by
  change cokernel.π (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.inclusion (k := k)
    (complementEnumeration p) 0) ≫
      (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.augmentation (k := k) (complementEnumeration p) ≫
        (GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.targetIso (k := k) (complementEnumeration p) hp).hom ≫
          (complementIso p).hom) = _
  rw [← Category.assoc, GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.projection_augmentation]
  simp only [Category.assoc, GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.projection_targetIso_assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.topHookIso_hom_coefficient
statement:
@[simp] theorem topHookIso_hom_coefficient (q : S)
    (x : (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module (k := k) (⊤ : S)).obj q) :
    HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) (bot_le : (⊥ : S) ≤ q)
      (((topHookIso (k := k) (S := S)).hom.app q).hom x) = (x : k)
proof:
:= by
  change HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) (bot_le : (⊥ : S) ≤ q)
    ((HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) (bot_le : (⊥ : S) ≤ q)).symm (x : k)) = _
  exact LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _

    (topResolution (k := k) (S := S)).quotient ⟨0, by rw [topResolution_length]; decide⟩ ≫
      (topResolution (k := k) (S := S)).initial_iso.hom =
        𝟙 (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module (k := k) (⊤ : S))
proof:
:= by
  change 𝟙 _ ≫ 𝟙 _ = _
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.resolution_length
statement:
@[simp] theorem resolution_length (p : S) :
    (resolution (k := k) p).length = max 1 (complementCard p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hp : p = ⊤
  · subst p
    rw [show complementCard (⊤ : S) = 0 from (complementCard_eq_zero_iff _).mpr rfl]
    simp only [resolution]
    rfl
  · have hc : 0 < complementCard p := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      (fun h => hp ((complementCard_eq_zero_iff p).mp h))
    rw [resolution, dif_neg hp, nonTopResolution_length]
    exact (max_eq_right (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hc)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleavingDistanceExamples.ephemeral_not_isZero
statement: private theorem ephemeral_not_isZero : ¬ IsZero ephemeral
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hs : Subsingleton (pointFiber 0) := ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp (h.obj 0)
  let one : pointFiber 0 := ⟨1, by simp [pointFiber]⟩
  have heq := congrArg (fun x : pointFiber 0 => (x : ℚ)) (hs.elim one 0)
  exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℚ) ≠ 0) heq

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleavingDistanceExamples.ephemeral_transition_zero
statement:
private theorem ephemeral_transition_zero (ε : ℝ≥0) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    transition (ε + ε) ephemeral = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hn : ¬ (t = 0 ∧ t + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) = 0) := by
    rintro ⟨ht, he⟩
    have hp : (0 : ℝ) < ε := hε
    simp only [NNReal.coe_add, ht, zero_add] at he
    linarith
  have hn' : ¬ (t = 0 ∧ t + ((ε : ℝ) + (ε : ℝ)) = 0) := by
    simpa only [NNReal.coe_add] using hn
  simp [transition, structureMap, ephemeral, pointMap, hn']
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.AdditiveFeaturesExamples.halfPersistence_sub_le
statement:
private theorem halfPersistence_sub_le (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖halfPersistence p - halfPersistence q‖ ≤ ‖p - q‖
proof:
:= by
  have he : halfPersistence p - halfPersistence q =
      ((p.2 - q.2) - (p.1 - q.1)) / 2 := by unfold halfPersistence; ring
  rw [he, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div]
  rw [abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 2)]
  simp only [Prod.norm_def, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have ht : |(p.2 - q.2) - (p.1 - q.1)| ≤ |p.2 - q.2| + |p.1 - q.1| := by
    simpa only [sub_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg] using
      abs_sub_le (p.2 - q.2) 0 (p.1 - q.1)
  have h₁ := le_max_left |p.1 - q.1| |p.2 - q.2|
  have h₂ := le_max_right |p.1 - q.1| |p.2 - q.2|
  linarith

    (fun p _ => by simpa only [one_mul] using le_of_eq (halfPersistence_norm p)) duplicate target
    (fun _ => by norm_num [duplicate]) (by intro j; fin_cases j <;> norm_num [target])

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossPresentationExamples.delayedDeath_relation_ne_zero
statement: theorem delayedDeath_relation_ne_zero : delayedDeath.r₁ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hv := congrArg (fun f : module (R := ℤ) (oneGrade 2) ⟶
      module (crossLeft 1 (oneGrade 0) noGrades) =>
    (f.app (fun _ => 2) (birth (oneGrade 2) ())).val (Sum.inl ())) h
  have hb : delayedDeath.r₁.app ((oneGrade 2).grade ()) (birth (oneGrade 2) ()) =
      deathVector := lift_birth (oneGrade 2) _ (fun _ => deathVector) ()
  change (delayedDeath.r₁.app ((oneGrade 2).grade ())
    (birth (oneGrade 2) ())).val (Sum.inl ()) = 0 at hv
  rw [hb] at hv
  change (Finsupp.single (Sum.inl () : Unit ⊕ Empty) (1 : ℤ)) (Sum.inl ()) = 0 at hv
  rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same] at hv
  exact Int.one_ne_zero hv

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityExamples.vertex_criticalValues
statement:
private theorem vertex_criticalValues (a : ℝ) :
    (vertexFilter a).criticalValues = {a}
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  constructor
  · intro hb
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := ((vertexFilter a).mem_criticalValues b).1 hb
    exact Finset.mem_singleton.mpr (by simpa [vertexFilter] using hσ.symm)
  · intro hb
    have hface : ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) :=
      (mem_singletonFace_iff _ _).2 rfl
    have hb' : b = a := Finset.mem_singleton.mp hb
    subst b
    exact ((vertexFilter a).mem_criticalValues a).2 ⟨⟨{0}, hface⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityExamples.vertex_critical
statement:
private theorem vertex_critical (a : ℝ) :
    (vertexFilter a).criticalValue (vertex_i a) = a
proof:
:= by
  have h := (vertexFilter a).criticalValue_mem (vertex_i a)
  simpa [vertex_criticalValues] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityExamples.vertex_stage
statement:
private theorem vertex_stage (a : ℝ) :
    (vertexFilter a).gradeFiltration (vertex_i a) = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [(vertexFilter a).gradeFiltration_apply, vertex_critical]
  apply (vertexFilter a).sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
  intro s
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityExamples.vertex_h0
statement:
private theorem vertex_h0 (a : ℝ) :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
      ((simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2)
        (vertexFilter a).gradeFiltration 0).obj (vertex_i a)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [simplicialHomologyPModule_obj, vertex_stage]
  exact (simplicialSingletonH0Equiv (ZMod 2) (0 : Fin 2)).finrank_eq.trans
    (Module.finrank_self (ZMod 2))

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityExamples.vertex_barcode
proof:
:= by
  calc
    gradeHomologyBarcode (ZMod 2) (vertexFilter a) 0 =
        rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ZMod 2)
          ({vertex_bar a} :
            Multiset (FiniteInterval (vertexFilter a).criticalValues.card))) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff
        (simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2) (vertexFilter a).gradeFiltration 0)
        (barcodeModule (k := ZMod 2)
          ({vertex_bar a} :
            Multiset (FiniteInterval (vertexFilter a).criticalValues.card)))).mpr
      intro i j hij
      have hi : i = vertex_i a := by
        apply Fin.ext
        have hh := i.isLt
        have hc := vertex_card a
        omega
      have hj : j = vertex_i a := by
        apply Fin.ext
        have hh := j.isLt
        have hc := vertex_card a
        omega
      subst i
      subst j
      rw [rank_barcodeMap]
      have hr : structureMapRank
          (simplicialHomologyPModule (ZMod 2) (vertexFilter a).gradeFiltration 0)
          (vertex_i a) (vertex_i a) hij = 1 := by
        unfold structureMapRank
        rw [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.range_id, finrank_top]
        exact vertex_h0 a
      rw [hr]
      rw [show ({vertex_bar a} :
        Multiset (FiniteInterval (vertexFilter a).criticalValues.card)) =
          vertex_bar a ::ₘ 0 by rfl, Multiset.countP_cons]
      simp [vertex_bar, vertex_i]
    _ = _ := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityExamples.vertex_points
proof:
:= by
  rw [dgm, vertex_barcode]
  simp [ofIndexBars, vertex_bar]
  change ((vertexFilter a).criticalValue (vertex_i a),
      if hd : 1 < (vertexFilter a).criticalValues.card then
        ((vertexFilter a).criticalValue ⟨1, hd⟩ : WithTop ℝ)
      else (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) = (a, ⊤)
  simp [vertex_card, vertex_critical]

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityExamples.vertex_orderedQ
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  simpa [orderedQ] using vertex_points a

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityExamples.vertex_faceSupDifference
statement:
private theorem vertex_faceSupDifference (a b : ℝ) :
    faceSupDifference (vertexFilter a) (vertexFilter b) = |a - b|
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · unfold faceSupDifference
    apply (Finset.fold_max_le |a - b|).mpr
    constructor
    · exact abs_nonneg _
    · intro σ _
      rfl
  · let σ : TotalFace (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) :=
      ⟨{0}, (mem_singletonFace_iff _ _).2 rfl⟩
    simpa [vertexFilter] using
      (abs_face_difference_le (vertexFilter a) (vertexFilter b) σ)

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityExamples.vertex_bottleneck_sharp
statement:
theorem vertex_bottleneck_sharp (a b : ℝ) :
    bottleneck (dgm (ZMod 2) (vertexFilter a) 0)
      (dgm (ZMod 2) (vertexFilter b) 0) = ENNReal.ofReal |a - b|
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertex_orderedQ, vertex_orderedQ]
  have hf₁ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) =
        finitePart (orderedQ 0 1 ((Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ), fun _ => a)).points := by
    simp [finitePart_orderedQ]
  have hf₂ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) =
        finitePart (orderedQ 0 1 ((Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ), fun _ => b)).points := by
    simp [finitePart_orderedQ]
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation _ _
    (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
    (fun _ : Fin 1 => a) (fun _ : Fin 1 => b)
    hf₁ hf₂
    (by simpa using (orderedQ_essential_occurrences 0 1
      ((Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ), fun _ : Fin 1 => a)))
    (by simpa using (orderedQ_essential_occurrences 0 1
      ((Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ), fun _ : Fin 1 => b)))]
  exact presentationBottleneck_essential_singletons a b

name: TDA.Persistence.StabilityExamples.vertex_stability_bound_sharp
statement:
theorem vertex_stability_bound_sharp (a b : ℝ) :
    bottleneck (dgm (ZMod 2) (vertexFilter a) 0)
      (dgm (ZMod 2) (vertexFilter b) 0) =
        ENNReal.ofReal (faceSupDifference (vertexFilter a) (vertexFilter b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertex_bottleneck_sharp, vertex_faceSupDifference]

name: TDA.Persistence.C2ThroughAllRepresentatives.c1
statement:
theorem C2ThroughAllRepresentatives.c1 {V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ} {D : Diagram ℝ}
    (hV : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives V D) : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives V D
proof:
:= by
  intro m n z hz
  obtain ⟨W, hW, hzW, hs⟩ := hV m n z hz
  exact ⟨W, hW, hzW, hs.of_le (by norm_num)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.secondDerivativeChain_apply
statement:
theorem secondDerivativeChain_apply (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (x h k : E) :
    secondDerivativeChain g f x h k =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (f x) (fderiv ℝ f x h) (fderiv ℝ f x k) +
      fderiv ℝ g (f x) (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x h k)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.secondDerivativeChain_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem secondDerivativeChain_hasFDerivAt (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (x : E)
    (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g (f x)) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x) :
    HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ (g ∘ f)) (secondDerivativeChain g f x) x
proof:
:= by
  have hdf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x :=
    (hf.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt_one
  have hdg : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) (f x) :=
    (hg.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiableAt_one
  have hc := (hdg.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hf.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt)
    |>.clm_comp hdf.hasFDerivAt
  have heq : fderiv ℝ (g ∘ f) =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      fun y => (fderiv ℝ g (f y)).comp (fderiv ℝ f y) := by
    filter_upwards [hf.eventually (by norm_num),
      hf.continuousAt (hg.eventually (by norm_num))] with y hfy hgy
    change ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g (f y) at hgy
    exact fderiv_comp y (hgy.differentiableAt (by norm_num))
      (hfy.differentiableAt (by norm_num))
  simpa only [secondDerivativeChain, Function.comp_apply, add_comm] using hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq

name: TDA.Persistence.secondDerivativeChain_fderiv
statement:
theorem secondDerivativeChain_fderiv (g : F → G) (f : E → F) (x : E)
    (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g (f x)) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (g ∘ f)) x = secondDerivativeChain g f x
proof:
:=
  (secondDerivativeChain_hasFDerivAt g f x hg hf).fderiv

name: TDA.Persistence.secondDerivative_linear_postcomp
statement:
theorem secondDerivative_linear_postcomp (R : F →L[ℝ] G) (g : E → F) (x : E)
    (hg : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 g x) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => R (g y))) x =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ E F G R).comp (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ g) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (fun y => R (g y)) = R ∘ g from rfl,
    secondDerivativeChain_fderiv R g x R.contDiff.contDiffAt hg]
  have hR : fderiv ℝ (R : F → G) = fun _ => R :=
    funext fun y => R.fderiv
  simp [secondDerivativeChain, hR]

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_c2
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_c2 {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalC2DiagramLift B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) :
    ∃ U : Set E, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ L.carrier ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (V ∘ B) U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hWopen, hzW, hW⟩ := hV m n (L.coordinates x)
    (L.factorization x hx).symm
  let U := L.carrier ∩ L.coordinates ⁻¹' W
  have hUopen : IsOpen U :=
    L.smooth_two.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage L.isOpen_carrier hWopen
  have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ((V ∘ orderedQ m n) ∘ L.coordinates) U :=
    hW.comp (L.smooth_two.mono Set.inter_subset_left) Set.inter_subset_right
  refine ⟨U, hUopen, ⟨hx, hzW⟩, Set.inter_subset_left, ?_⟩
  apply hcomp.congr
  intro y hy
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [L.factorization y hy.1]

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_hasFDerivAt_fderiv
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_hasFDerivAt_fderiv
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalC2DiagramLift B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ (V ∘ B))
      (secondDerivativeChain (V ∘ orderedQ m n) L.coordinates x) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hWopen, hzW, hW⟩ := hV m n (L.coordinates x)
    (L.factorization x hx).symm
  have hg := hW.contDiffAt (hWopen.mem_nhds hzW)
  have hf := L.smooth_two.contDiffAt (L.isOpen_carrier.mem_nhds hx)
  have heq : (V ∘ B) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] ((V ∘ orderedQ m n) ∘ L.coordinates) := by
    filter_upwards [L.isOpen_carrier.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [L.factorization y hy]
  exact (secondDerivativeChain_hasFDerivAt _ _ x hg hf).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq.fderiv

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_second_fderiv
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_second_fderiv
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalC2DiagramLift B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (V ∘ B)) x =
      secondDerivativeChain (V ∘ orderedQ m n) L.coordinates x
proof:
:=
  (localLift_scalar_hasFDerivAt_fderiv B V m n L x hx hV).fderiv

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_second_fderiv_symmetric
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_second_fderiv_symmetric
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalC2DiagramLift B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) (h k : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (V ∘ B)) x h k =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (V ∘ B)) x k h
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, _, hs⟩ := localLift_scalar_c2 B V m n L x hx hV
  exact (hs.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hxU)).isSymmSndFDerivAt (by norm_num) h k

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_secondDerivativeChain_symmetric
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_secondDerivativeChain_symmetric
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalC2DiagramLift B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) (h k : E) :
    secondDerivativeChain (V ∘ orderedQ m n) L.coordinates x h k =
      secondDerivativeChain (V ∘ orderedQ m n) L.coordinates x k h
proof:
:= by
  rw [← localLift_scalar_second_fderiv B V m n L x hx hV]
  exact localLift_scalar_second_fderiv_symmetric B V m n L x hx hV h k

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_second_derivative_independent
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_second_derivative_independent
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (m n m' n' : ℕ) (L : LocalC2DiagramLift B m n)
    (L' : LocalC2DiagramLift B m' n') (x : E)
    (hx : x ∈ L.carrier) (hx' : x ∈ L'.carrier)
    (hV : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) :
    secondDerivativeChain (V ∘ orderedQ m n) L.coordinates x =
      secondDerivativeChain (V ∘ orderedQ m' n') L'.coordinates x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← localLift_scalar_second_fderiv B V m n L x hx hV,
    ← localLift_scalar_second_fderiv B V m' n' L' x hx' hV]
