name: TDA.Persistence.RealMatchingBounds.diagonal_le
proof:
:= by
  apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_coe.mpr
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (RealBarcode.finite_positive hD i).le)]
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.RealMatchingBounds.untranslateTarget_cost_le
statement:
theorem untranslateTarget_cost_le {D E : Diagram ℝ} (hD : D.IsPositive) (hE : E.IsPositive)
    (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (A : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences (translateDiagram E (-(ε : ℝ))).finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences (translateDiagram E (-(ε : ℝ))).essentialOccurrences)
    (h : RealMatchingBounds (ε + ε) (ε + ε) A) :
    (A.untranslateTarget (-(ε : ℝ))).cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1)
      (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  apply OccurrenceMatching.cost_le_of
  · intro i
    cases hi : (A.untranslateTarget (-(ε : ℝ))).finite i with
    | none =>
      have hs := h.source_short i ((A.untranslateTarget_finite_eq_none_iff _ i).mp hi)
      exact diagonal_le hD ε i (by simpa only [NNReal.coe_add] using hs)
    | some j =>
      have hm := (A.untranslateTarget_finite_eq_some_iff _ i j).mp hi
      have hb := h.finite_bounds i _ hm
      simp only [RealEndpointBounds, finiteTranslationEquiv_value, NNReal.coe_add] at hb
      apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_coe.mpr
      apply max_le
      · exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hb.1], by linarith [hb.2.1]⟩
      · exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hb.2.2.2.1], by linarith [hb.2.2.2.2]⟩
  · intro j
    split_ifs with hj
    · exact zero_le
    · have hn : ∀ i, A.finite i ≠ some (finiteTranslationEquiv E (-(ε : ℝ)) j) := by
        intro i hi
        exact hj ⟨i, (A.untranslateTarget_finite_eq_some_iff _ i j).mpr hi⟩
      have hs := h.target_short _ hn
      rw [finiteTranslationEquiv_value] at hs
      apply diagonal_le hE ε j
      simpa only [NNReal.coe_add, Prod.fst, Prod.snd, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub] using hs
  · intro b
    have hb := h.essential_bounds b
    have hv := A.untranslateTarget_essential_value (-(ε : ℝ)) b
    simp only [RealEndpointBounds, NNReal.coe_add] at hb
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_coe.mpr
    rw [hv]
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hb.1], by linarith [hb.2.1]⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.interleavingMatching_cost_le
statement:
theorem interleavingMatching_cost_le {ε : ℝ≥0} (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    (interleavingMatching hM hN hfdM hfdN i).cost
      (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:=
  RealMatchingBounds.untranslateTarget_cost_le (moduleDiagram_isPositive c M hfdM)
    (moduleDiagram_isPositive d N hfdN) ε _
    (interleaving_shifted_induced_matching hM hN hfdM hfdN i).choose_spec

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.bottleneck_le_of_interleaving
statement:
theorem bottleneck_le_of_interleaving {ε : ℝ≥0} (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    bottleneck (moduleDiagram c M hfdM) (moduleDiagram d N hfdN) ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_le_matching _ _ (interleavingMatching hM hN hfdM hfdN i)).trans
    (interleavingMatching_cost_le hM hN hfdM hfdN i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.bottleneck_le_distance
statement:
theorem bottleneck_le_distance :
    bottleneck (moduleDiagram c M hfdM) (moduleDiagram d N hfdN) ≤
      realInterleavingDistance M N
proof:
:=
  le_realInterleavingDistance_iff.mpr fun _ ⟨i⟩ => bottleneck_le_of_interleaving hM hN hfdM hfdN i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.bottleneck_eq_distance
statement:
theorem bottleneck_eq_distance :
    bottleneck (moduleDiagram c M hfdM) (moduleDiagram d N hfdN) =
      realInterleavingDistance M N
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (bottleneck_le_distance hM hN hfdM hfdN)
    (distance_le_bottleneck c d M N hM hN hfdM hfdN)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.interleaving_iff_matching
statement:
theorem interleaving_iff_matching (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M N) ↔
      ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching (moduleDiagram c M hfdM).finiteOccurrences
          (moduleDiagram d N hfdN).finiteOccurrences
          (moduleDiagram c M hfdM).essentialOccurrences (moduleDiagram d N hfdN).essentialOccurrences,
        A.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i⟩
    exact ⟨interleavingMatching hM hN hfdM hfdN i, interleavingMatching_cost_le hM hN hfdM hfdN i⟩
  · rintro ⟨A, hA⟩
    exact ⟨matchingInterleaving c d M N hM hN hfdM hfdN ε A hA⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.distance_eq_top_iff_essential_card_ne
statement:
theorem distance_eq_top_iff_essential_card_ne :
    realInterleavingDistance M N = ⊤ ↔
      (essentialPart (moduleDiagram c M hfdM).points).card ≠
        (essentialPart (moduleDiagram d N hfdN).points).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bottleneck_eq_distance hM hN hfdM hfdN]
  exact bottleneck_eq_top_iff _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.mem_fixedColumn_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_fixedColumn_iff
    (M : ModuleCat (R (k := k) (S := S))) (q : Pair (S := S)) (m : M) :
    m ∈ fixedColumn (k := k) (S := S) M q ↔
      columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • m = m
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.columnMapHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] private theorem columnMapHom_apply
    {M N : ModuleCat (R (k := k) (S := S))} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (x : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) M) (q : Pair (S := S)) :
    columnMapHom (k := k) (S := S) f x q = ⟨f.hom (x q), by
      change columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • f.hom (x q) = f.hom (x q)
      rw [← f.hom.map_smul]
      exact congrArg f.hom (x q).property⟩
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.columnAction_map_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem columnAction_map_apply
    {M N : ModuleCat (R (k := k) (S := S))} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (x : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) M) (q : Pair (S := S)) :
    ((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).map f x q : N) = f.hom (x q)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.assembleAction_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem assembleAction_apply
    (M : ModuleCat (R (k := k) (S := S)))
    (x : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M x =
      ∑ q : Pair (S := S), columnAssembler (k := k) (S := S) q • (x q : M)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.assembleAction_natural
statement:
theorem assembleAction_natural
    {M N : ModuleCat (R (k := k) (S := S))} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (x : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) M) :
    assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) N
      (columnMapHom (k := k) (S := S) f x) =
        f.hom (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M x)
proof:
:= by
  change (∑ q : Pair (S := S), columnAssembler (k := k) (S := S) q • f.hom (x q)) =
    f.hom (∑ q : Pair (S := S), columnAssembler (k := k) (S := S) q • (x q : M))
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q hq
  exact (f.hom.map_smul (columnAssembler (k := k) (S := S) q) (x q)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.columnProjector_mul_self
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [columnProjector]
  rw [← MulOpposite.op_mul]
  apply MulOpposite.op_injective
  rw [delta_mul]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.columnAssembler_mem_kernel
statement:
private theorem columnAssembler_mem_kernel (q : Pair (S := S)) :
    columnAssembler (k := k) (S := S) q ∈ J (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : MulOpposite.unop (columnAssembler (k := k) (S := S) q) ∈
      FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.DiagonalIdeal
        (k := k) (S := S) := by
    change delta (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) q
      (diagonalFloor_le (S := S) q) ∈
        FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.DiagonalIdeal
          (k := k) (S := S)
    exact diagonalIdeal_mem_delta_of_cross
      (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) q
      (diagonalFloor_le (S := S) q)
      (by
        change (diagonalFloor (S := S) q).val.2 ≤ q.val.1
        simp [diagonalFloor])
  exact (mem_kernel_iff_unop_mem (k := k) (S := S)
    (columnAssembler (k := k) (S := S) q)).2 hmem

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.columnProjector_mem_kernel
statement:
private theorem columnProjector_mem_kernel (q : Pair (S := S)) :
    columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q ∈ J (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : MulOpposite.unop (columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q) ∈
      FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.DiagonalIdeal
        (k := k) (S := S) := by
    change delta (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q)
      (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) le_rfl ∈
        FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.DiagonalIdeal
          (k := k) (S := S)
    exact diagonalIdeal_mem_delta_of_cross
      (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q)
      (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) le_rfl
      (by
        change (diagonalFloor (S := S) q).val.2 ≤
          (diagonalFloor (S := S) q).val.1
        simp [diagonalFloor])
  exact (mem_kernel_iff_unop_mem (k := k) (S := S)
    (columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q)).2 hmem

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.kernel_smul_mem_assembleRange
statement:
private theorem kernel_smul_mem_assembleRange
    (M : ModuleCat (R (k := k) (S := S)))
    (a : R (k := k) (S := S)) (ha : a ∈ J (k := k) (S := S)) (m : M) :
    a • m ∈ (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M).range
proof:
:= by
  let u : FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.DiagonalIdeal
      (k := k) (S := S) :=
    ⟨MulOpposite.unop a,
      (mem_kernel_iff_unop_mem (k := k) (S := S) a).1 ha⟩
  let z := kernelColumnFamily (k := k) (S := S) M a ha m
  have hreassemble :
      assembleColumns (k := k) (S := S) (includeColumns (k := k) (S := S) u) = u := by
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun
      (assembleColumns_comp_includeColumns (k := k) (S := S)) u
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  rw [assembleAction_apply]
  calc
    (∑ q : Pair (S := S), columnAssembler (k := k) (S := S) q • (z q : M)) =
        ∑ q : Pair (S := S),
          MulOpposite.op
            (includeColumns (k := k) (S := S) u q *
              delta (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) q
                (diagonalFloor_le (S := S) q)) • m := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro q hq
          change columnAssembler (k := k) (S := S) q •
              (MulOpposite.op (includeColumns (k := k) (S := S) u q) • m) = _
          rw [smul_smul]
          congr 1
    _ = (∑ q : Pair (S := S),
          MulOpposite.op
            (includeColumns (k := k) (S := S) u q *
              delta (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) q
                (diagonalFloor_le (S := S) q))) • m := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_smul]
    _ = MulOpposite.op
          (∑ q : Pair (S := S),
            includeColumns (k := k) (S := S) u q *
              delta (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) q
                (diagonalFloor_le (S := S) q)) • m := by
          congr 1
          simp
    _ = MulOpposite.op
          (assembleColumns (k := k) (S := S)
            (includeColumns (k := k) (S := S) u)).1 • m := by
          rw [← assembleColumns_eq_sum_mul_delta (k := k) (S := S)]
    _ = MulOpposite.op u.1 • m := by rw [hreassemble]
    _ = a • m := by simp [u]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.assembleAction_range_eq_relation
statement:
theorem assembleAction_range_eq_relation
    (M : ModuleCat (R (k := k) (S := S))) :
    (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M).range =
      (relation (k := k) (S := S) M).toAddSubgroup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply AddSubgroup.ext
  intro m
  change (∃ x, assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M x = m) ↔
    m ∈ relation (k := k) (S := S) M
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
    rw [relation_eq_kernel_smul_top (k := k) (S := S)]
    change assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M x ∈
      (J (k := k) (S := S) • (⊤ : Submodule (R (k := k) (S := S)) M))
    rw [assembleAction_apply]
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro q hq
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul
      (columnAssembler_mem_kernel (k := k) (S := S) q) Submodule.mem_top
  · intro hm
    change m ∈ Submodule.span (R (k := k) (S := S))
      (Set.range fun z : (J (k := k) (S := S)) × M =>
        (z.1 : R (k := k) (S := S)) • z.2) at hm
    have hspan (x : M) (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span (R (k := k) (S := S))
        (Set.range fun z : (J (k := k) (S := S)) × M =>
          (z.1 : R (k := k) (S := S)) • z.2)) :
        ∀ r : R (k := k) (S := S),
          r • x ∈ (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M).range := by
      induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem y hy =>
        obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hy
        rcases z with ⟨a, y₀⟩
        subst y
        intro r
        rw [smul_smul]
        exact kernel_smul_mem_assembleRange (k := k) (S := S) M (r * a)
          (Ideal.mul_mem_left (J (k := k) (S := S)) r a.property) y₀
      | zero =>
        intro r
        simp
      | add x y hx hy ihx ihy =>
        intro r
        rw [smul_add]
        exact (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M).range.add_mem
          (ihx r) (ihy r)
      | smul r x hx ih =>
        intro s
        rw [smul_smul]
        exact ih (s * r)
    simpa using hspan m hm 1

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.columnAction_restrict_isZero
statement:
theorem columnAction_restrict_isZero
    (N : ModuleCat (C (k := k) (S := S))) :
    IsZero ((columnAction (k := k) (S := S)).obj
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : ModuleCat (R (k := k) (S := S)) :=
    (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N
  have hfixedZero (x : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) M)
      (q : Pair (S := S)) : (x q : M) = 0 := by
    have hkill : columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • (x q : M) = 0 :=
      kernel_smul_restricted (k := k) (S := S) N
        (columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q)
        (columnProjector_mem_kernel (k := k) (S := S) q) (x q : M)
    calc
      (x q : M) = columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • (x q : M) :=
        (x q).property.symm
      _ = 0 := hkill
  letI : Subsingleton (ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) M) := ⟨by
    intro x y
    funext q
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hfixedZero x q, hfixedZero y q]⟩
  change IsZero (AddCommGrpCat.of (ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) M))
  exact AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.mul_diagonalDelta_apply
statement:
private theorem mul_diagonalDelta_apply
    (a : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (d p t : Pair (S := S)) :
    (a * delta (k := k) (S := S) d d le_rfl) p t =
      if t = d then a p d else 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mul_delta_right_apply_column (k := k) (S := S) a d d p t le_rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.assembleAction_regular_formula
statement:
private theorem assembleAction_regular_formula
    (x : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S)
      (regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S))) :
    MulOpposite.unop
        (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S)
          (regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) x) =
      (assembleColumns (k := k) (S := S)
        (regularColumns (k := k) (S := S) x)).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [assembleColumns_eq_sum_mul_delta (k := k) (S := S)]
  change MulOpposite.unop
      (∑ q : Pair (S := S),
        columnAssembler (k := k) (S := S) q • (x q : regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S))) = _
  change ((MulOpposite.opAddEquiv :
      FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S) ≃+
        R (k := k) (S := S)).symm.toAddMonoidHom)
      (∑ q : Pair (S := S),
        columnAssembler (k := k) (S := S) q • (x q : regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S))) = _
  rw [map_sum]
  simp [columnAssembler, regularColumns, regularColumnModule, MulOpposite.unop_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.assembleAction_regular_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem assembleAction_regular_eq_zero
    {x : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S)
      (regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S))}
    (hx : assembleAction (k := k) (S := S)
      (regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  let g := regularColumns (k := k) (S := S) x
  have hcols : assembleColumns (k := k) (S := S) g = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    calc
      (assembleColumns (k := k) (S := S) g).1 =
          MulOpposite.unop (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S)
            (regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) x) :=
        (assembleAction_regular_formula (k := k) (S := S) x).symm
      _ = 0 := by
        have h := congrArg MulOpposite.unop hx
        simpa using h
  have hcoeff (q p : Pair (S := S)) : g q p (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg
      (fun a : FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.DiagonalIdeal
        (k := k) (S := S) => a.1 p q) hcols
    simpa [g, assembleColumns_apply] using h
  have hfixed (q : Pair (S := S)) :
      g q * delta (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q)
        (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) le_rfl = g q := by
    have hp := (x q).property
    change columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q *
        ((x q : regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) : R (k := k) (S := S)) =
      ((x q : regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) : R (k := k) (S := S)) at hp
    have hp' := congrArg MulOpposite.unop hp
    change MulOpposite.unop ((x q : regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) :
      R (k := k) (S := S)) *
        delta (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q)
          (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) le_rfl =
      MulOpposite.unop ((x q : regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) :
        R (k := k) (S := S)) at hp'
    change g q * delta (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q)
        (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) le_rfl = g q
    exact hp'
  have hg (q : Pair (S := S)) : g q = 0 := by
    ext p t
    by_cases ht : t = diagonalFloor (S := S) q
    · subst t
      exact hcoeff q p
    · have hpt := congrArg
        (fun a : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S) => a p t)
        (hfixed q)
      rw [mul_diagonalDelta_apply (g q) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) p t] at hpt
      simp [ht] at hpt
      exact hpt.symm
  funext q
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply MulOpposite.unop_injective
  change MulOpposite.unop
    ((x q : regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) : R (k := k) (S := S)) = 0
  simpa [g, regularColumns] using hg q

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.assembleAction_regular_injective
statement:
theorem assembleAction_regular_injective :
    Function.Injective
      (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S)
        (regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hzero : assembleAction (k := k) (S := S)
      (regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) (x - y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hxy]
    simp
  have hsub := assembleAction_regular_eq_zero (k := k) (S := S) hzero
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hsub

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.assembleAction_finsupp_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  funext q
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext i
  let ev : ModuleCat.of (R (k := k) (S := S))
      (ι →₀ R (k := k) (S := S)) ⟶ regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S) :=
    ModuleCat.ofHom (Finsupp.lapply i)
  have hmap : columnMapHom (k := k) (S := S) ev x = 0 :=
    assembleAction_regular_eq_zero (k := k) (S := S) (by
      calc
        assembleAction (k := k) (S := S)
            (regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S))
            (columnMapHom (k := k) (S := S) ev x) =
            ev.hom (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S)
              (ModuleCat.of (R (k := k) (S := S)) (ι →₀ R (k := k) (S := S))) x) :=
          assembleAction_natural (k := k) (S := S) ev x
        _ = 0 := by simp [hx])
  have hq := congrArg (fun y : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S)
      (regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) => (y q : regularColumnModule (k := k) (S := S))) hmap
  change (Finsupp.lapply i) (x q : ι →₀ R (k := k) (S := S)) = 0 at hq
  simpa [Finsupp.lapply_apply] using hq

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.assembleAction_projective_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem assembleAction_projective_eq_zero
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (R (k := k) (S := S))) [Projective M]
    {x : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) M}
    (hx : assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : Module.Projective (R (k := k) (S := S)) M :=
    ModuleCat.projective_of_module_projective M
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.Projective.out (R := R (k := k) (S := S)) (P := M)
  let sf : M ⟶ ModuleCat.of (R (k := k) (S := S))
      (M →₀ R (k := k) (S := S)) := ModuleCat.ofHom s
  have hfree : columnMapHom (k := k) (S := S) sf x = 0 :=
    assembleAction_finsupp_eq_zero (k := k) (S := S) (by
      calc
        assembleAction (k := k) (S := S)
            (ModuleCat.of (R (k := k) (S := S)) (M →₀ R (k := k) (S := S)))
            (columnMapHom (k := k) (S := S) sf x) =
            sf.hom (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M x) :=
          assembleAction_natural (k := k) (S := S) sf x
        _ = 0 := by simp [hx])
  funext q
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hq := congrArg (fun y : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S)
      (ModuleCat.of (R (k := k) (S := S)) (M →₀ R (k := k) (S := S))) => (y q : M →₀ R (k := k) (S := S))) hfree
  change s (x q : M) = 0 at hq
  have hr := congrArg (Finsupp.linearCombination (R (k := k) (S := S)) id) hq
  change (x q : M) = 0
  simpa only [map_zero, hs (x q : M)] using hr

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.assembleAction_projective_injective
statement:
theorem assembleAction_projective_injective
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (R (k := k) (S := S))) [Projective M] :
    Function.Injective (assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hzero : assembleAction (k := k) (S := S) M (x - y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hxy]
    simp
  have hsub := assembleAction_projective_eq_zero (k := k) (S := S) M hzero
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hsub

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.columnAction_map_exact
statement:
theorem columnAction_map_exact
    (T : ShortComplex (ModuleCat (R (k := k) (S := S)))) (hT : T.Exact) :
    (T.map (columnAction (k := k) (S := S))).Exact
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hExact := (T.moduleCat_exact_iff).mp hT
  apply (ShortComplex.ab_exact_iff _).2
  intro x hx
  change columnMapHom (k := k) (S := S) T.g x = 0 at hx
  have hzero (q : Pair (S := S)) : T.g.hom (x q : T.X₂) = 0 := by
    have hq := congrArg (fun y : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) T.X₃ =>
      (y q : T.X₃)) hx
    change T.g.hom (x q : T.X₂) = 0 at hq
    exact hq
  choose y hy using fun q => hExact (x q) (hzero q)
  have hfixed (q : Pair (S := S)) :
      columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q •
        (columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • y q) =
          columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • y q := by
    calc
      columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q •
          (columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • y q) =
          (columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q *
            columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q) • y q := by rw [smul_smul]
      _ = columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • y q := by
        rw [columnProjector_mul_self]
  let z : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) T.X₁ :=
    fun q => ⟨columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • y q, hfixed q⟩
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  change columnMapHom (k := k) (S := S) T.f z = x
  funext q
  apply Subtype.ext
  calc
    T.f.hom (columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • y q) =
        columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • T.f.hom (y q) := by
          rw [T.f.hom.map_smul]
    _ = columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • x q := by rw [hy q]
    _ = x q := (x q).property

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientColumnAction.columnAction_map_shortExact
statement:
theorem columnAction_map_shortExact
    (T : ShortComplex (ModuleCat (R (k := k) (S := S)))) (hT : T.ShortExact) :
    (T.map (columnAction (k := k) (S := S))).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hExact := columnAction_map_exact (k := k) (S := S) T hT.exact
  have hInjective : Function.Injective T.f := hT.moduleCat_injective_f
  have hMono : Mono ((T.map (columnAction (k := k) (S := S))).f) :=
    (AddCommGrpCat.mono_iff_injective _).2 (by
      intro x y hxy
      funext q
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply hInjective
      have hq := congrArg (fun z => (z q : T.X₂)) hxy
      change T.f.hom (x q) = T.f.hom (y q)
      exact hq)
  have hSurjective : Function.Surjective T.g := hT.moduleCat_surjective_g
  have hEpi : Epi ((T.map (columnAction (k := k) (S := S))).g) :=
    (AddCommGrpCat.epi_iff_surjective _).2 (by
      intro x
      choose y hy using fun q : Pair (S := S) => hSurjective (x q)
      have hfixed (q : Pair (S := S)) :
          columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q •
            (columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • y q) =
              columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • y q := by
        calc
          columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q •
              (columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • y q) =
              (columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q *
                columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q) • y q := by rw [smul_smul]
          _ = columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • y q := by
            rw [columnProjector_mul_self]
      let z : ColumnObject (k := k) (S := S) T.X₂ :=
        fun q => ⟨columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • y q, hfixed q⟩
      refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
      change columnMapHom (k := k) (S := S) T.g z = x
      funext q
      apply Subtype.ext
      calc
        T.g.hom (columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • y q) =
            columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • T.g.hom (y q) := by
              rw [T.g.hom.map_smul]
        _ = columnProjector (k := k) (S := S) q • x q := by rw [hy q]
        _ = x q := (x q).property)
  exact { exact := hExact, mono_f := hMono, epi_g := hEpi }

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_finiteHookRankExactCover
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_finiteHookRankExactCover
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    ∃ (G : CoordinateGrid n) (A : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point)
      (hA : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj p))
      (e : G.lan.obj A ≅ M),
      IsRankExact
        (G.lan.map (kernel.ι (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)) ≫
          (G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).hom)
        ((G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).inv ≫
          G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) ≫ e.hom) ∧
      IsRankProjective (⨁ fun t => G.embeddedCoverFamily A t) ∧
      (∀ a : Fin n → ℝ,
        FiniteDimensional k
          ((G.lan.obj (kernel (FiniteHookDeflation.π A))).obj a))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, A, hA, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_pfd_finiteGridKan
      M hM
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj p) := hA
  let c := G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A
  let hsGrid := FiniteHookDeflation.rankExact A
  let hsLan := G.lan_isRankExact hsGrid
  let left :
      G.lan.obj (kernel (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)) ⟶
        ⨁ fun t => G.embeddedCoverFamily A t :=
    G.lan.map (kernel.ι (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)) ≫ c.hom
  let right :
      (⨁ fun t => G.embeddedCoverFamily A t) ⟶ M :=
    c.inv ≫ G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) ≫ e.hom
  have htransport : IsRankExact left right := by
    simpa [left, right, c, Category.assoc] using
      hsLan.of_iso (Iso.refl _) c e
  have hprojective : IsRankProjective (⨁ fun t => G.embeddedCoverFamily A t) :=
    (G.lan_isRankProjective (FiniteHookDeflation.module A)
      (FiniteHookDeflation.isRankProjective A)).of_iso c
  refine ⟨G, A, hA, e, ?_, hprojective, ?_⟩
  · exact htransport
  · intro a
    letI : FiniteDimensional k
        ((G.lan.obj (FiniteHookDeflation.module A)).obj a) :=
      G.lan_finiteDimensional (FiniteHookDeflation.module A) a
    exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective
      ((G.lan.map (kernel.ι (FiniteHookDeflation.π A))).app a).hom
      (hsLan.injective a)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHookSumPresentation.hookTagMultiset_biproduct
statement:
theorem FiniteHookSumPresentation.hookTagMultiset_biproduct
    {J : Type} [Fintype J]
    (X : J → PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (P : ∀ j, FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := n) (X j)) :
    hookTagMultiset (FiniteHookSumPresentation.biproduct
      (k := k) (n := n) X P).tag =
      ∑ j, hookTagMultiset (P j).tag
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I := Σ j, Fin (P j).count
  let e : Fin (Fintype.card I) ≃ I := flattenedHookIndex (k := k) P
  let tag := flattenedHookTag (k := k) P
  ext t
  unfold FiniteHookSumPresentation.biproduct
  change (hookTagMultiset tag).count t = _
  calc
    (hookTagMultiset tag).count t = Fintype.card {r : Fin (Fintype.card I) // tag r = t} :=
      hookTagMultiset_count tag t
    _ = Fintype.card (Σ j, {a : Fin (P j).count // (P j).tag a = t}) := by
      let indexedTag : I → RealHookTag (n := n) :=
        fun a => (P a.1).tag a.2
      let eToFiber : {r : Fin (Fintype.card I) // tag r = t} ≃
          {a : I // indexedTag a = t} :=
        e.subtypeEquiv (by intro r; rfl)
      let fiberSigma : {a : I // indexedTag a = t} ≃
          (Σ j : J, {a : Fin (P j).count // (P j).tag a = t}) := {
        toFun := fun a => ⟨a.1.1, ⟨a.1.2, a.2⟩⟩
        invFun := fun a => ⟨⟨a.1, a.2.1⟩, a.2.2⟩
        left_inv := by rintro ⟨⟨j, a⟩, h⟩; rfl
        right_inv := by rintro ⟨j, ⟨a, h⟩⟩; rfl }
      let occurrenceEquiv := eToFiber.trans fiberSigma
      exact Fintype.card_congr occurrenceEquiv
    _ = ∑ j, Fintype.card {a : Fin (P j).count // (P j).tag a = t} :=
      Fintype.card_sigma
    _ = (∑ j, hookTagMultiset (P j).tag).count t := by
      rw [Multiset.count_sum']
      simp only [hookTagMultiset_count]

name: TDA.Persistence.HasMultisetMatching.intro
statement:
theorem HasMultisetMatching.intro {ρ : ℝ≥0}
    {A B : Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n))} {m ℓ : ℕ}
    (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n)) (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (hF : hookTagMultiset F = A) (hG : hookTagMultiset G = B)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin m) (Fin ℓ) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (hM : HookMatching.IsMatching (k := k) ρ F G M) :
    HasMultisetMatching (k := k) ρ A B
proof:
:=
  ⟨m, ℓ, F, G, hF, hG, M, hM⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.HasMultisetMatching.elim
statement:
theorem HasMultisetMatching.elim {ρ : ℝ≥0}
    {A B : Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n))}
    (h : HasMultisetMatching (k := k) ρ A B) :
    ∃ (m ℓ : ℕ) (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n))
        (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n)),
      hookTagMultiset F = A ∧ hookTagMultiset G = B ∧
        ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin m) (Fin ℓ) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
          HookMatching.IsMatching (k := k) ρ F G M

name: TDA.Persistence.hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_le_of_matching
statement:
theorem hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_le_of_matching
    {A B : Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n))} {ρ : ℝ≥0}
    (h : HasMultisetMatching (k := k) ρ A B) :
    hookMultisetBottleneckDistance (k := k) A B ≤ ρ
proof:
:=
  iInf_le_of_le ρ (iInf_le _ h)

name: TDA.Persistence.le_hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_iff
statement:
theorem le_hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_iff
    (A B : Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n))) (r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    r ≤ hookMultisetBottleneckDistance (k := k) A B ↔
      ∀ ρ, ∀ _h : HasMultisetMatching (k := k) ρ A B, r ≤ (ρ : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hookMultisetBottleneckDistance, le_iInf_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_lt_iff
statement:
theorem hookMultisetBottleneckDistance_lt_iff
    (A B : Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n))) (r : ℝ≥0∞) :
    hookMultisetBottleneckDistance (k := k) A B < r ↔
      ∃ ρ, ∃ _h : HasMultisetMatching (k := k) ρ A B, (ρ : ℝ≥0∞) < r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hookMultisetBottleneckDistance, iInf_lt_iff, exists_prop]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.diagonalFloor_le

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.le_diagonalFloor_iff_crossesDiagonal
statement:
theorem le_diagonalFloor_iff_crossesDiagonal (p q : PairPoset S) :
    p ≤ diagonalFloor (S := S) q ↔ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q
proof:
:= by
  change (p.val.1 ≤ q.val.1 ∧ p.val.2 ≤ q.val.1) ↔ p.val.2 ≤ q.val.1
  constructor

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.diagonalIdeal_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
    (f : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) (p q : PairPoset S)
    (h : ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q) : f.1 p q = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hpq : p ≤ q
  · exact crossingDeltaSpan_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
      (k := k) (S := S) f.1
      ((mem_diagonalIdeal_iff_mem_crossingDeltaSpan
        (k := k) (S := S) f.1).1 f.property) p q h
  · exact f.1.eq_zero_of_not_le' hpq

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.mem_diagonalIdeal_iff_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
statement:
theorem mem_diagonalIdeal_iff_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses (f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) :
    f ∈ DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S) ↔
      ∀ p q : PairPoset S, ¬ CrossesDiagonal (S := S) p q → f p q = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf p q h
    exact diagonalIdeal_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
      (k := k) (S := S) ⟨f, hf⟩ p q h
  · intro hf
    classical
    rw [incidence_eq_deltaExpansion (k := k) (S := S) f]
    change (∑ c ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ComparablePair S)),
      f c.val.1 c.val.2 •
        delta (k := k) (S := S) c.val.1 c.val.2 c.property) ∈
      DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro c hc
    by_cases hcross : CrossesDiagonal (S := S) c.val.1 c.val.2
    · simpa only [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, smul_one_mul] using
        (Ideal.mul_mem_left (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
          (algebraMap k (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (f c.val.1 c.val.2))
          (diagonalIdeal_mem_delta_of_cross (k := k) (S := S)
            c.val.1 c.val.2 c.property hcross))
    · rw [hf c.val.1 c.val.2 hcross]
      simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.mul_apply_truncate_at
statement:
private theorem mul_apply_truncate_at
    (a f : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (p q r : PairPoset S)
    (hrq : r ≤ q) (hz : ∀ x, ¬ x ≤ r → f x q = 0) :
    (a * f) p q = ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc p r, a p x * f x q
proof:
:= by
  rw [IncidenceAlgebra.mul_apply]
  have hsub : Finset.Icc p r ⊆ Finset.Icc p q := by
    intro x hx
    rcases Finset.mem_Icc.mp hx with ⟨hpx, hxr⟩
    exact Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hpx, hxr.trans hrq⟩
  exact (Finset.sum_subset hsub (by
    intro x hx hxnot
    have hnot : ¬ x ≤ r := by
      intro hxr
      exact hxnot (Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_Icc.mp hx).1, hxr⟩)
    rw [hz x hnot]
    simp)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.includeColumns_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem includeColumns_apply
    (f : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) (q p t : PairPoset S) :
    includeColumns (k := k) (S := S) f q p t =
      if t = diagonalFloor (S := S) q then f.1 p q else 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.mul_delta_right_apply_column
statement:
theorem mul_delta_right_apply_column
    (a : Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (d q p t : PairPoset S)
    (hdq : d ≤ q) :
    (a * delta (k := k) (S := S) d q hdq) p t =
      if t = q then a p d else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ht : t = q
  · subst t
    by_cases hpd : p ≤ d
    · rw [IncidenceAlgebra.mul_apply]
      have hdmem : d ∈ Finset.Icc p q := Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hpd, hdq⟩
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single d]
      · simp [delta_apply]
      · intro x hx hxd
        simp [delta_apply, hxd]
      · intro h
        exact (h hdmem).elim
    · rw [IncidenceAlgebra.mul_apply]
      have ha : a p d = 0 := a.eq_zero_of_not_le' hpd
      simp only [if_pos rfl, ha]
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro x hx
      have hxd : x ≠ d := by
        intro h
        subst x
        exact hpd (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hx).1
      simp [delta_apply, hxd]
  · rw [IncidenceAlgebra.mul_apply]
    simp only [if_neg ht]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    simp [delta_apply, ht]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.includeColumns_mul_diagonalFloorIdempotent
statement:
theorem includeColumns_mul_diagonalFloorIdempotent
    (f : DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) (q : PairPoset S) :
    includeColumns (k := k) (S := S) f q *
        delta (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q)
          (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) le_rfl =
      includeColumns (k := k) (S := S) f q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext p t
  rw [mul_delta_right_apply_column (k := k) (S := S)
    (includeColumns (k := k) (S := S) f q) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q)
    (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) p t le_rfl]
  by_cases ht : t = diagonalFloor (S := S) q
  · subst t
    simp
  · simp [ht]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.assembleValue_mem_diagonalIdeal
statement:
private theorem assembleValue_mem_diagonalIdeal
    (g : ColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) :
    assembleValue (k := k) (S := S) g ∈ DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  apply (mem_diagonalIdeal_iff_coeff_zero_of_not_crosses
    (k := k) (S := S) (assembleValue (k := k) (S := S) g)).2
  intro p q hcross
  apply (g q).eq_zero_of_not_le'
  intro hp
  exact hcross ((le_diagonalFloor_iff_crossesDiagonal (S := S) p q).1 hp)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.assembleColumns_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem assembleColumns_apply
    (g : ColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) (p q : PairPoset S) :
    (assembleColumns (k := k) (S := S) g).1 p q =
      g q p (diagonalFloor (S := S) q)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.incidenceFinsetSum_apply_column
statement:
private theorem incidenceFinsetSum_apply_column {ι : Type}
    (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
    (p q : PairPoset S) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, g i) p q = ∑ i ∈ s, g i p q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i s hi ih => simp [hi, IncidenceAlgebra.add_apply, ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.assembleColumns_eq_sum_mul_delta
statement:
theorem assembleColumns_eq_sum_mul_delta
    (g : ColumnModule (k := k) (S := S)) :
    (assembleColumns (k := k) (S := S) g).1 =
      ∑ q : PairPoset S,
        g q * delta (k := k) (S := S) (diagonalFloor (S := S) q) q
          (diagonalFloor_le (S := S) q)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext p t
  rw [assembleColumns_apply, incidenceFinsetSum_apply_column]
  simp_rw [mul_delta_right_apply_column]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.assembleColumns_comp_includeColumns
statement:
theorem assembleColumns_comp_includeColumns :
    (assembleColumns (k := k) (S := S)).comp
      (includeColumns (k := k) (S := S)) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro f
  apply Subtype.ext
  ext p q
  simp [includeColumns, assembleColumns, assembleValue, includeColumn]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.columnModule_projective
statement:
theorem columnModule_projective :
    Module.Projective (Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
      (ColumnModule (k := k) (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  exact Module.Projective.of_basis
    (Pi.basisFun (Incidence (k := k) (S := S)) (PairPoset S))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.diagonalIdeal_projective
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_projective :
    Module.Projective (Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
      (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  letI := columnModule_projective (k := k) (S := S)
  exact Module.Projective.of_split
    (includeColumns (k := k) (S := S))
    (assembleColumns (k := k) (S := S))
    (assembleColumns_comp_includeColumns (k := k) (S := S))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveDiagonalIdealProjective.diagonalIdeal_projective_object
statement:
theorem diagonalIdeal_projective_object :
    CategoryTheory.Projective
      (ModuleCat.of (Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
        (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)))
proof:
:= by
  letI := diagonalIdeal_projective (k := k) (S := S)
  exact inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureWindowMatching.pointBall_zero
statement:
private theorem pointBall_zero (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    pointBall x p 0 = pointFiber x p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i
  simp [pointBall, pointFiber, dist_eq_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureWindowMatching.sourceBall_two_eq_fiber
statement:
private theorem sourceBall_two_eq_fiber
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hsep : ∀ i i', x i ≠ x i' → 2 * δ < dist (x i) (x i'))
    (p : ℝ × ℝ) (i₀ : I) (hi₀ : x i₀ = p) :
    pointBall x p (2 * δ) = pointFiber x p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i
  simp only [pointBall, pointFiber, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · intro hdist
    by_contra hne
    have hne' : x i ≠ x i₀ := by
      intro h
      exact hne (h.trans hi₀)
    have hs := hsep i i₀ hne'
    rw [hi₀] at hs
    linarith
  · intro h
    simpa [h, dist_self] using (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * δ by positivity)

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureWindowMatching.sourceCluster_card_eq
statement:
private theorem sourceCluster_card_eq
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hsep : ∀ i i', x i ≠ x i' → 2 * δ < dist (x i) (x i'))
    (hxy0 : ∀ i, (pointBall x (x i) 0).card ≤ (pointBall y (x i) δ).card)
    (hyxδ : ∀ i, (pointBall y (x i) δ).card ≤ (pointBall x (x i) (2 * δ)).card)
    (i₀ : I) :
    (pointFiber x (x i₀)).card = (pointBall y (x i₀) δ).card
proof:
:= by
  have hxy0' := hxy0 i₀
  rw [pointBall_zero] at hxy0'
  have hyxδ' := hyxδ i₀
  have hx2 := sourceBall_two_eq_fiber x hδ hsep (x i₀) i₀ rfl
  rw [hx2] at hyxδ'
  exact le_antisymm (by simpa using hxy0') hyxδ'

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureWindowMatching.exists_finite_window_matching_of_center_counts
statement:
theorem exists_finite_window_matching_of_center_counts
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (exit : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hsepX : ∀ i i', x i ≠ x i' → 2 * δ < dist (x i) (x i'))
    (hxy0 : ∀ i, (pointBall x (x i) 0).card ≤ (pointBall y (x i) δ).card)
    (hyxδ : ∀ i, (pointBall y (x i) δ).card ≤ (pointBall x (x i) (2 * δ)).card)
    (hyx0 : ∀ j, δ < exit (y j) →
      (pointBall y (y j) 0).card ≤ (pointBall x (y j) δ).card) :
    ∃ f : I → J,
      Function.Injective f ∧
      (∀ i, dist (x i) (y (f i)) ≤ δ) ∧
      (∀ j, δ < exit (y j) → ∃ i, f i = j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcluster (p : ℝ × ℝ) (i₀ : I) (hi₀ : x i₀ = p) :
      (pointFiber x p).card = (pointBall y p δ).card := by
    subst p
    exact sourceCluster_card_eq x y hδ hsepX hxy0 hyxδ i₀
  have hHall : ∀ s : Finset I,
      s.card ≤ (Finset.univ.filter fun j => ∃ i ∈ s, dist (y j) (x i) ≤ δ).card := by
    intro s
    let P : Finset (ℝ × ℝ) := s.image x
    let N : ℝ × ℝ → Finset J := fun p => pointBall y p δ
    have hdis : (P : Set (ℝ × ℝ)).PairwiseDisjoint N := by
      intro p hp q hq hpq
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      obtain ⟨i', hi', hiEq⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
      subst q
      apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
      intro j hj hj'
      have h1 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
      have h2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj').2
      have hdist := dist_triangle (x i) (y j) (x i')
      rw [dist_comm (x i) (y j)] at hdist
      have hsep := hsepX i i' (by
        intro heq
        apply hpq
        simpa [heq] using hiEq.symm)
      linarith
    calc
      s.card = ∑ p ∈ P, (s.filter fun i => x i = p).card :=
        Finset.card_eq_sum_card_image x s
      _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ P, (N p).card := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro p hp
        obtain ⟨i₀, hi₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
        have hsmall : (s.filter fun i => x i = x i₀).card ≤
            (pointFiber x (x i₀)).card := by
          apply Finset.card_le_card
          intro i hi
          exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2⟩
        exact hsmall.trans_eq (hcluster (x i₀) i₀ rfl)
      _ = (P.biUnion N).card := (Finset.card_biUnion hdis).symm
      _ = (Finset.univ.filter fun j => ∃ i ∈ s, dist (y j) (x i) ≤ δ).card := by
        congr 1
        ext j
        simp only [P, N, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_image, pointBall,
          Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        aesop
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hclose⟩ :=
    (Fintype.all_card_le_filter_rel_iff_exists_injective
      (fun i j => dist (y j) (x i) ≤ δ)).mp hHall
  refine ⟨f, hf, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    simpa only [dist_comm] using hclose i
  · intro j hj
    have hpositive : 0 < (pointBall x (y j) δ).card := by
      have hYpos : 0 < (pointFiber y (y j)).card := by
        apply Finset.card_pos.mpr
        exact ⟨j, by simp [pointFiber]⟩
      have h := hyx0 j hj
      rw [pointBall_zero] at h
      exact hYpos.trans_le (by simpa using h)
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hpositive
    have hclose' : dist (x i) (y j) ≤ δ := by
      simpa [pointBall, dist_comm] using hi
    let A : Finset I := pointFiber x (x i)
    let B : Finset J := pointBall y (x i) δ
    have hA_image : A.image f = B := by
      have hsub : A.image f ⊆ B := by
        intro j' hj'
        obtain ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hj'
        have hci := hclose i'
        have hpoint : x i' = x i := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi').2
        simpa [A, B, pointBall, hpoint, dist_comm] using hci
      have hAcard : A.card = B.card := by
        simpa [A, B] using hcluster (x i) i rfl
      apply Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub
      rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hf]
      exact hAcard.symm.le
    have hjB : j ∈ B := by
      simp [B, pointBall, dist_comm, hclose']
    have hjImage : j ∈ A.image f := hA_image.symm ▸ hjB
    obtain ⟨i', _, hi'⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hjImage
    exact ⟨i', hi'⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.index_point_multiset
statement:
private theorem index_point_multiset {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval n)) :
    (Finset.univ : Finset (BarcodeOccurrence n B)).val.map
        (fun i => endpoints c (occurrence B i)) =
      (Finset.univ : Finset (Occurrences (ofIndexBars c c.strictMono B))).val.map
        (occurrencePoint _)
proof:
:= by
  rw [occurrencePoint_multiset, ofIndexBars_points]
  calc
    _ = ((Finset.univ : Finset (BarcodeOccurrence n B)).val.map
          (fun i => occurrence B i)).map (endpoints c) := by rw [Multiset.map_map]; rfl
    _ = B.map (endpoints c) := by
      rw [Fin.univ_val_map]
      change ((List.ofFn (fun i => B.toList.get i) : List (FiniteInterval n)) :
        Multiset (FiniteInterval n)).map _ = _
      rw [List.ofFn_get, Multiset.coe_toList]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv_value
statement:
theorem indexOccurrenceEquiv_value {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval n)) (i : BarcodeOccurrence n B) :
    occurrencePoint _ (indexOccurrenceEquiv c B i) = endpoints c (occurrence B i)
proof:
:=
  (presentationEquiv (fun i => endpoints c (occurrence B i)) (occurrencePoint _)
    (index_point_multiset c B)).2 i

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv_symm_value
statement:
theorem indexOccurrenceEquiv_symm_value {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval n)) (i : Occurrences (ofIndexBars c c.strictMono B)) :
    endpoints c (occurrence B ((indexOccurrenceEquiv c B).symm i)) = occurrencePoint _ i
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using
    (indexOccurrenceEquiv_value c B ((indexOccurrenceEquiv c B).symm i)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv_finite
statement:
theorem indexOccurrenceEquiv_finite {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval n)) (i : BarcodeOccurrence n B)
    (hi : (occurrence B i).death < n) :
    ∃ p, indexOccurrenceEquiv c B i = .inl p ∧
      (p.1.1, (p.1.2 : WithTop ℝ)) = endpoints c (occurrence B i)
proof:
:= by
  have hv := indexOccurrenceEquiv_value c B i
  cases h : indexOccurrenceEquiv c B i with
  | inl p => exact ⟨p, rfl, by simpa only [h, occurrencePoint] using hv⟩
  | inr b =>
    have hd := congrArg Prod.snd hv
    simp [h, occurrencePoint, endpoints, hi] at hd

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv_essential
statement:
theorem indexOccurrenceEquiv_essential {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval n)) (i : BarcodeOccurrence n B)
    (hi : (occurrence B i).death = n) :
    ∃ b, indexOccurrenceEquiv c B i = .inr b ∧
      b.1 = c (occurrence B i).birthStage
proof:
:= by
  have hv := indexOccurrenceEquiv_value c B i
  cases h : indexOccurrenceEquiv c B i with
  | inl p =>
    have hd := congrArg Prod.snd hv
    simp [h, occurrencePoint, endpoints, hi] at hd
  | inr b =>
    refine ⟨b, rfl, ?_⟩
    simpa only [h, occurrencePoint, endpoints, FiniteInterval.birthStage]
      using (congrArg Prod.fst hv)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.endpoints_bounds
statement:
private theorem endpoints_bounds {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (δK δC : ℝ≥0) (I J : FiniteInterval n)
    (hb : J.birth ≤ I.birth) (hb' : I.birth ≤ (sampleTranslation c δC J.birthStage).val)
    (hover : I.birth < J.death) (hd : J.death ≤ I.death)
    (hd' : I.death ≤ J.translatedDeath (sampleTranslation c δK)) :
    RealEndpointBounds δK δC (RealBarcode.endpoints c I) (RealBarcode.endpoints c J)
proof:
:= by
  have hb₀ : c J.birthStage ≤ c I.birthStage := c.monotone hb
  have hb₁ : c I.birthStage ≤ c J.birthStage + (δC : ℝ) :=
    (c.monotone hb').trans (sampleTranslation_value_le c δC J.birthStage)
  refine ⟨hb₀, hb₁, ?_⟩
  by_cases hj : J.death < n
  · rw [FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_of_lt J _ hj] at hd'
    have hi : I.death < n := hd'.trans_lt (sampleTranslation c δK ⟨J.death, hj⟩).isLt
    dsimp only [RealBarcode.endpoints]
    rw [dif_pos hi, dif_pos hj]
    change c I.birthStage < c ⟨J.death, hj⟩ ∧
      c ⟨J.death, hj⟩ ≤ c ⟨I.death, hi⟩ ∧
      c ⟨I.death, hi⟩ ≤ c ⟨J.death, hj⟩ + (δK : ℝ)
    exact ⟨c.strictMono hover, c.monotone hd,
      (c.monotone hd').trans (sampleTranslation_value_le c δK ⟨J.death, hj⟩)⟩
  · have hi : ¬ I.death < n := fun hi => hj (hd.trans_lt hi)
    simp only [RealBarcode.endpoints, dif_neg hi, dif_neg hj]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.endpoints_short
statement:
private theorem endpoints_short {n : ℕ} (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (I : FiniteInterval n) (h : I.death ≤ (sampleTranslation c δ I.birthStage).val) :
    (RealBarcode.endpoints c I).2 ≤
      ((RealBarcode.endpoints c I).1 + (δ : ℝ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : I.death < n := h.trans_lt (sampleTranslation c δ I.birthStage).isLt
  change (if hd : I.death < n then (c ⟨I.death, hd⟩ : WithTop ℝ) else ⊤) ≤ _
  rw [dif_pos hi]
  exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr
    ((c.monotone h).trans (sampleTranslation_value_le c δ I.birthStage))

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteOption_some_iff
statement:
private theorem finiteOption_some_iff {F E : Type} (o : Option (F ⊕ E)) (j : F) :
    finiteOption o = some j ↔ o = some (.inl j)
proof:
:= by
  cases o with
  | none => simp [finiteOption]
  | some q => cases q <;> simp [finiteOption]

name: TDA.Persistence.splitMatching_finite_some_iff
statement:
private theorem splitMatching_finite_some_iff {F G E H : Type}
    (σ : F ⊕ E → Option (G ⊕ H))
    (hinj : ∀ i i' j, σ i = some j → σ i' = some j → i = i')
    (htotal : ∀ b, ∃ c, σ (.inr b) = some (.inr c))
    (hsurj : ∀ c, ∃ b, σ (.inr b) = some (.inr c)) (i : F) (j : G) :
    (splitMatching σ hinj htotal hsurj).finite i = some j ↔ σ (.inl i) = some (.inl j)
proof:
:=
  finiteOption_some_iff _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.splitMatching_essential_match
statement:
private theorem splitMatching_essential_match {F G E H : Type}
    (σ : F ⊕ E → Option (G ⊕ H))
    (hinj : ∀ i i' j, σ i = some j → σ i' = some j → i = i')
    (htotal : ∀ b, ∃ c, σ (.inr b) = some (.inr c))
    (hsurj : ∀ c, ∃ b, σ (.inr b) = some (.inr c)) (b : E) :
    σ (.inr b) = some (.inr ((splitMatching σ hinj htotal hsurj).essential b))
proof:
:=
  (htotal b).choose_spec

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.RealInduced.sumMap_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem sumMap_eq_some_iff (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (i : RealBarcode.Occurrences (diagram c M))
    (j : RealBarcode.Occurrences (diagram c N)) :
    sumMap c f i = some j ↔
      inducedMap f ((RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv c (rankBarcode M)).symm i) =
        some ((RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv c (rankBarcode N)).symm j)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sumMap
  cases h : inducedMap f ((RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv c (rankBarcode M)).symm i) with
  | none => simp
  | some q =>
    simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq]
    exact (Equiv.eq_symm_apply _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.RealInduced.sumMap_injective
statement:
theorem sumMap_injective (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (i i' : RealBarcode.Occurrences (diagram c M))
    (j : RealBarcode.Occurrences (diagram c N))
    (hi : sumMap c f i = some j) (hi' : sumMap c f i' = some j) : i = i'
proof:
:=
  (RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv c (rankBarcode M)).symm.injective
    (inducedMap_injective f _ _ _ ((sumMap_eq_some_iff c f i j).mp hi)
      ((sumMap_eq_some_iff c f i' j).mp hi'))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.RealInduced.sumMap_bounds
statement:
theorem sumMap_bounds (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (f : M ⟶ N) (δK δC : ℝ≥0)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial (FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation c δK)
      (FiniteConstructible.le_sampleTranslation c δK) (finiteKernel f))
    (hc : TranslationTrivial (FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation c δC)
      (FiniteConstructible.le_sampleTranslation c δC) (finiteCokernel f))
    (i : RealBarcode.Occurrences (diagram c M))
    (j : RealBarcode.Occurrences (diagram c N)) (h : sumMap c f i = some j) :
    RealEndpointBounds δK δC (RealBarcode.occurrencePoint _ i) (RealBarcode.occurrencePoint _ j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv_symm_value c (rankBarcode M) i,
    ← RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv_symm_value c (rankBarcode N) j]
  have hb := inducedMap_endpoint_bounds_of_shortness _ _ _ _ f hk hc _ _
    ((sumMap_eq_some_iff c f i j).mp h)
  exact FiniteConstructible.endpoints_bounds c δK δC _ _ hb.1 hb.2.1 hb.2.2.1
    hb.2.2.2.1 hb.2.2.2.2

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.RealInduced.sumMap_source_short
statement:
private theorem sumMap_source_short (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (f : M ⟶ N) (δK : ℝ≥0)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial (FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation c δK)
      (FiniteConstructible.le_sampleTranslation c δK) (finiteKernel f))
    (i : RealBarcode.Occurrences (diagram c M)) (h : sumMap c f i = none) :
    (RealBarcode.occurrencePoint _ i).2 ≤
      ((RealBarcode.occurrencePoint _ i).1 + (δK : ℝ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : inducedMap f ((RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv c (rankBarcode M)).symm i) = none :=
    Option.map_eq_none_iff.mp h
  rw [← RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv_symm_value c (rankBarcode M) i]
  exact FiniteConstructible.endpoints_short c δK _
    (inducedMap_unmatched_source_short_of_kernelTrivial _ _ f hk _ hn)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.RealInduced.sumMap_target_short
statement:
private theorem sumMap_target_short (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (f : M ⟶ N) (δC : ℝ≥0)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial (FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation c δC)
      (FiniteConstructible.le_sampleTranslation c δC) (finiteCokernel f))
    (j : RealBarcode.Occurrences (diagram c N)) (h : ∀ i, sumMap c f i ≠ some j) :
    (RealBarcode.occurrencePoint _ j).2 ≤
      ((RealBarcode.occurrencePoint _ j).1 + (δC : ℝ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hn (a : BarcodeOccurrence n (rankBarcode M)) :
      inducedMap f a ≠ some ((RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv c (rankBarcode N)).symm j) := by
    intro ha
    apply h (RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv c (rankBarcode M) a)
    apply (sumMap_eq_some_iff c f _ j).mpr
    simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using ha
  rw [← RealBarcode.indexOccurrenceEquiv_symm_value c (rankBarcode N) j]
  exact FiniteConstructible.endpoints_short c δC _
    (inducedMap_unmatched_target_short_of_cokernelTrivial _ _ f hc _ hn)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.RealInduced.no_cross
statement:
private theorem no_cross (i : (diagram c M).finiteOccurrences)
    (b : (diagram c N).essentialOccurrences) : sumMap c f (.inl i) ≠ some (.inr b)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hb := sumMap_bounds c f δK δC hk hc _ _ h
  simp [RealEndpointBounds, RealBarcode.occurrencePoint] at hb

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.RealInduced.essential_total
statement:
private theorem essential_total (b : (diagram c M).essentialOccurrences) :
    ∃ d, sumMap c f (.inr b) = some (.inr d)
proof:
:= by
  cases h : sumMap c f (.inr b) with
  | none =>
    have hs := sumMap_source_short c f δK hk (.inr b) h
    simp [RealBarcode.occurrencePoint] at hs
  | some j =>
    cases j with
    | inl j =>
      have hb := sumMap_bounds c f δK δC hk hc _ _ h
      simp [RealEndpointBounds, RealBarcode.occurrencePoint] at hb
    | inr d => exact ⟨d, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.RealInduced.essential_surjective
statement:
private theorem essential_surjective (d : (diagram c N).essentialOccurrences) :
    ∃ b, sumMap c f (.inr b) = some (.inr d)
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ i, sumMap c f i = some (.inr d) := by
    by_contra! hn
    have hs := sumMap_target_short c f δC hc (.inr d) hn
    simp [RealBarcode.occurrencePoint] at hs
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex
  cases i with
  | inl i => exact False.elim (no_cross c f δK δC hk hc i d hi)
  | inr b => exact ⟨b, hi⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.RealInduced.matching_finite_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem matching_finite_eq_some_iff (i : (diagram c M).finiteOccurrences)
    (j : (diagram c N).finiteOccurrences) :
    (matching c f δK δC hk hc).finite i = some j ↔
      sumMap c f (.inl i) = some (.inl j)
proof:
:=
  splitMatching_finite_some_iff _ _ _ _ i j

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.RealInduced.matching_essential_match
statement:
theorem matching_essential_match (b : (diagram c M).essentialOccurrences) :
    sumMap c f (.inr b) = some (.inr ((matching c f δK δC hk hc).essential b))
proof:
:=
  splitMatching_essential_match _ _ _ _ b

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.RealInduced.matching_essential_eq_iff
statement:
theorem matching_essential_eq_iff (b : (diagram c M).essentialOccurrences)
    (d : (diagram c N).essentialOccurrences) :
    (matching c f δK δC hk hc).essential b = d ↔
      sumMap c f (.inr b) = some (.inr d)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← h]
    exact matching_essential_match c f δK δC hk hc b
  · intro h
    exact Sum.inr.inj (Option.some.inj
      ((matching_essential_match c f δK δC hk hc b).symm.trans h))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.RealInduced.matching_bounds
statement: theorem matching_bounds : RealMatchingBounds δK δC (matching c f δK δC hk hc)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    exact sumMap_bounds c f δK δC hk hc (.inl i) (.inl j)
      ((matching_finite_eq_some_iff c f δK δC hk hc i j).mp hij)
  · intro b
    exact sumMap_bounds c f δK δC hk hc _ _ (matching_essential_match c f δK δC hk hc b)
  · intro i hi
    have hn : sumMap c f (.inl i) = none := by
      cases h : sumMap c f (.inl i) with
      | none => rfl
      | some j =>
        cases j with
        | inl j =>
          have hh := (matching_finite_eq_some_iff c f δK δC hk hc i j).mpr h
          rw [hi] at hh
          contradiction
        | inr b => exact False.elim (no_cross c f δK δC hk hc i b h)
    have hs := sumMap_source_short c f δK hk (.inl i) hn
    have hr : i.1.2 ≤ i.1.1 + (δK : ℝ) := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp hs
    linarith
  · intro j hj
    have hn (i : RealBarcode.Occurrences (diagram c M)) :
        sumMap c f i ≠ some (.inl j) := by
      intro hi
      cases i with
      | inl i => exact hj i ((matching_finite_eq_some_iff c f δK δC hk hc i j).mpr hi)
      | inr b =>
        have hb := sumMap_bounds c f δK δC hk hc _ _ hi
        simp [RealEndpointBounds, RealBarcode.occurrencePoint] at hb
    have hs := sumMap_target_short c f δC hc (.inl j) hn
    have hr : j.1.2 ≤ j.1.1 + (δC : ℝ) := WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp hs
    linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.RealMatchingBounds.covers_long_source
statement:
theorem covers_long_source (h : RealMatchingBounds δK δC A) (i : D.finiteOccurrences)
    (hlong : (δK : ℝ) < i.1.2 - i.1.1) : ∃! j, A.finite i = some j
proof:
:= by
  cases hi : A.finite i with
  | none => exact False.elim (not_lt_of_ge (h.source_short i hi) hlong)
  | some j => exact ⟨j, rfl, fun j' hj' => Option.some.inj hj'.symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RealMatchingBounds.covers_long_target
statement:
theorem covers_long_target (h : RealMatchingBounds δK δC A) (j : E.finiteOccurrences)
    (hlong : (δC : ℝ) < j.1.2 - j.1.1) : ∃! i, A.finite i = some j
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ i, A.finite i = some j := by
    by_contra! hn
    exact not_lt_of_ge (h.target_short j hn) hlong
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hex
  exact ⟨i, hi, fun i' hi' => A.finite_injective i' i j hi' hi⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.squaredEssentialBirthSum_orderedQ
statement:
theorem squaredEssentialBirthSum_orderedQ (m n : ℕ) (z : DiagramCoordinates m n) :
    squaredEssentialBirthSum (orderedQ m n z) = (∑ i : Fin n, z.2 i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [squaredEssentialBirthSum, essentialBirthSum_orderedQ]

name: TDA.Persistence.squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ
statement:
theorem squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ (m n : ℕ)
    (z : DiagramCoordinates m n) :
    squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference (orderedQ m n z) =
      (∑ i : Fin m, ((z.1 i).2 - (z.1 i).1)) ^ 2
proof:
