name: TDA.Persistence.essentialBirthFunctional_apply
statement:
theorem essentialBirthFunctional_apply (m n : ℕ) (z : DiagramCoordinates m n) :
    essentialBirthFunctional m n z = ∑ i : Fin n, z.2 i
proof:
:= by
  simp [essentialBirthFunctional, Finset.sum_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.squareLinear_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem squareLinear_hasFDerivAt {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (A : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun w => (A w) ^ 2) ((2 * A z) • A) z
proof:
:= by
  simpa using A.hasFDerivAt.pow 2

name: TDA.Persistence.squareLinear_fderiv
statement:
theorem squareLinear_fderiv {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (A : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun w => (A w) ^ 2) z = (2 * A z) • A
proof:
:=
  (squareLinear_hasFDerivAt A z).fderiv

name: TDA.Persistence.squareLinear_hasFDerivAt_fderiv
statement:
theorem squareLinear_hasFDerivAt_fderiv
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (A : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z : E) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun w => fderiv ℝ (fun q => (A q) ^ 2) w)
      (((2 : ℝ) • A).smulRight A) z
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [squareLinear_fderiv]
  exact (A.hasFDerivAt.const_mul 2).smul_const A

name: TDA.Persistence.squareLinear_secondFDeriv_apply
statement:
theorem squareLinear_secondFDeriv_apply
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (A : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (z h k : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ (fun q => (A q) ^ 2) w) z h k =
      2 * A h * A k
proof:
:= by
  rw [(squareLinear_hasFDerivAt_fderiv A z).fderiv]
  simp [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, mul_assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_hasFDerivAt (m n : ℕ)
    (z : DiagramCoordinates m n) :
    HasFDerivAt (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘ orderedQ m n)
      ((2 * signedCoordinateFunctional m n z) • signedCoordinateFunctional m n) z
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Function.comp_def, squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ,
    signedCoordinateFunctional_apply] using squareLinear_hasFDerivAt
      (signedCoordinateFunctional m n) z

name: TDA.Persistence.squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_secondFDeriv_apply
statement:
theorem squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_secondFDeriv_apply (m n : ℕ)
    (z h k : DiagramCoordinates m n) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun w => fderiv ℝ
      (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘ orderedQ m n) w) z h k =
      2 * signedCoordinateFunctional m n h * signedCoordinateFunctional m n k
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘ orderedQ m n) =
      (fun w => (signedCoordinateFunctional m n w) ^ 2) := by
    funext w
    simp [Function.comp_def, squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ,
      signedCoordinateFunctional_apply]
  rw [hf]
  exact squareLinear_secondFDeriv_apply _ _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialBirthSum_c2_all
statement:
theorem essentialBirthSum_c2_all (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    C2ThroughAllRepresentatives essentialBirthSum D
proof:
:= by
  intro m n z _
  refine ⟨Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.mem_univ z, contDiffOn_univ.mpr ?_⟩
  have hf : (essentialBirthSum ∘ orderedQ m n) = essentialBirthFunctional m n := by
    funext w
    rw [Function.comp_apply, essentialBirthSum_orderedQ, essentialBirthFunctional_apply]
  rw [hf]
  exact (essentialBirthFunctional m n).contDiff

name: TDA.Persistence.squaredEssentialBirthSum_c2_all
statement:
theorem squaredEssentialBirthSum_c2_all (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    C2ThroughAllRepresentatives squaredEssentialBirthSum D
proof:
:= by
  intro m n z _
  refine ⟨Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.mem_univ z, contDiffOn_univ.mpr ?_⟩
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun w : DiagramCoordinates m n => ∑ i : Fin n, w.2 i) := by
    apply ContDiff.sum
    intro i _
    fun_prop
  simpa [Function.comp_def, squaredEssentialBirthSum_orderedQ] using hs.pow 2

name: TDA.Persistence.signedFiniteEndpointDifference_c2_all
statement:
theorem signedFiniteEndpointDifference_c2_all (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    C2ThroughAllRepresentatives signedFiniteEndpointDifference D
proof:
:= by
  intro m n z _
  refine ⟨Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.mem_univ z, contDiffOn_univ.mpr ?_⟩
  have hf : (signedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘ orderedQ m n) = signedCoordinateFunctional m n := by
    funext w
    rw [Function.comp_apply, signedFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ,
      signedCoordinateFunctional_apply]
  rw [hf]
  exact (signedCoordinateFunctional m n).contDiff

name: TDA.Persistence.squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_c2_all
statement:
theorem squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_c2_all (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    C2ThroughAllRepresentatives squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference D
proof:
:= by
  intro m n z _
  refine ⟨Set.univ, isOpen_univ, Set.mem_univ z, contDiffOn_univ.mpr ?_⟩
  simpa [Function.comp_def, squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_orderedQ,
    signedCoordinateFunctional_apply] using (signedCoordinateFunctional m n).contDiff.pow 2

name: TDA.Persistence.quadraticCurve_fderiv
statement:
theorem quadraticCurve_fderiv {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (R : ℝ →L[ℝ] E) (x : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => R (t ^ 2)) x = (2 * x) • R
proof:
:= by
  have hq := squareLinear_hasFDerivAt (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) x
  have hc := R.hasFDerivAt.comp x hq
  simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_smul, Function.comp_def] using hc.fderiv

name: TDA.Persistence.quadraticCurve_secondFDeriv_apply
statement:
theorem quadraticCurve_secondFDeriv_apply
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (R : ℝ →L[ℝ] E) (x h k : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => R (t ^ 2))) x h k = R (2 * h * k)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) x := by fun_prop
  rw [secondDerivative_linear_postcomp R (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) x hc]
  change R (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2)) x h k) = _
  exact congrArg R (squareLinear_secondFDeriv_apply (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) x h k)

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_singleton_scalar_loss
statement:
theorem nonlinear_singleton_scalar_loss (t : ℝ) :
    squaredEssentialBirthSum (dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearSingletonFilter t) 0) = t ^ 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [squaredEssentialBirthSum, nonlinearSingletonFilter, singleton_essential_loss]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.singletonBirthLinear_apply
statement:
theorem singletonBirthLinear_apply (t : ℝ) :
    singletonBirthLinear t = (Fin.elim0, fun _ => t)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · funext i
    exact Fin.elim0 i
  · ext i
    simp [singletonBirthLinear]

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_singleton_chain_terms
statement:
theorem nonlinear_singleton_chain_terms :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (squaredEssentialBirthSum ∘ orderedQ 0 1))
        (nonlinearSingletonLift.coordinates 1)
        (fderiv ℝ nonlinearSingletonLift.coordinates 1 1)
        (fderiv ℝ nonlinearSingletonLift.coordinates 1 1) = 8 ∧
    fderiv ℝ (squaredEssentialBirthSum ∘ orderedQ 0 1)
        (nonlinearSingletonLift.coordinates 1)
        (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ nonlinearSingletonLift.coordinates) 1 1 1) = 4
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (squaredEssentialBirthSum ∘ orderedQ 0 1) =
      (fun w => (essentialBirthFunctional 0 1 w) ^ 2) := by
    funext w
    simp [Function.comp_def, squaredEssentialBirthSum_orderedQ, essentialBirthFunctional_apply]
  have h1 := quadraticCurve_fderiv singletonBirthLinear 1
  have h2 := quadraticCurve_secondFDeriv_apply singletonBirthLinear 1 1 1
  change fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (squaredEssentialBirthSum ∘ orderedQ 0 1))
      (singletonBirthLinear (1 ^ 2))
      (fderiv ℝ (fun t => singletonBirthLinear (t ^ 2)) 1 1)
      (fderiv ℝ (fun t => singletonBirthLinear (t ^ 2)) 1 1) = 8 ∧
    fderiv ℝ (squaredEssentialBirthSum ∘ orderedQ 0 1)
      (singletonBirthLinear (1 ^ 2))
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun t => singletonBirthLinear (t ^ 2))) 1 1 1) = 4
  rw [hf, h1, h2, squareLinear_secondFDeriv_apply, squareLinear_fderiv]
  norm_num [essentialBirthFunctional_apply, singletonBirthLinear_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_singleton_second_derivative
statement:
theorem nonlinear_singleton_second_derivative :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (squaredEssentialBirthSum ∘
      (fun t : ℝ => dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearSingletonFilter t) 0))) 1 1 1 = 12
proof:
:= by
  rw [localLift_scalar_second_fderiv _ _ 0 1 nonlinearSingletonLift 1
    (Set.mem_univ _) (squaredEssentialBirthSum_c2_all _), secondDerivativeChain_apply]
  rw [nonlinear_singleton_chain_terms.1, nonlinear_singleton_chain_terms.2]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_tied_edge_signed_loss_zero
statement:
theorem nonlinear_tied_edge_signed_loss_zero (t : ℝ) :
    signedFiniteEndpointDifference (dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter t) 0) = 0
proof:
:=
  moving_tied_edge_signed_loss_zero (t ^ 2)

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_tied_edge_squared_loss_zero
statement:
theorem nonlinear_tied_edge_squared_loss_zero (t : ℝ) :
    squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference (dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter t) 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference, nonlinear_tied_edge_signed_loss_zero]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_tied_edge_pair_curvature_cancel
statement:
theorem nonlinear_tied_edge_pair_curvature_cancel
    (e : CompatibleOrder (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter (0 : ℝ)))
    (i : Fin (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1) :
    faceLossSlotCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0
      signedFiniteEndpointDifference (.inl (.inl i)) = -1 ∧
    faceLossSlotCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0
      signedFiniteEndpointDifference (.inl (.inr i)) = 1 ∧
    faceLossSlotCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0
        signedFiniteEndpointDifference (.inl (.inl i)) *
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter t).value
        (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 (.inl (.inl i))))) 1 1 1 +
    faceLossSlotCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0
        signedFiniteEndpointDifference (.inl (.inr i)) *
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter t).value
        (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 (.inl (.inr i))))) 1 1 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [signed_finite_birth_slot_coefficient, signed_finite_death_slot_coefficient]
  change -1 = -1 ∧ 1 = 1 ∧
    -1 * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2)) 1 1 1 +
      1 * fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2)) 1 1 1 = 0
  rw [show (fun t : ℝ => t ^ 2) =
    (fun t => (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ t) ^ 2) from rfl,
    squareLinear_secondFDeriv_apply]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_tied_edge_has_finite_slot
statement:
theorem nonlinear_tied_edge_has_finite_slot :
    ∃ e : CompatibleOrder (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter (0 : ℝ)),
      0 < (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₀, hpos⟩ := Examples.moving_tied_edge_has_finite_slot
  let e : CompatibleOrder (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter (0 : ℝ)) :=
    e₀.transfer (by intro i j _; change (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 0 ^ 2; exact le_rfl)
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  change 0 < (faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) e 0).toList.length
  have heq : faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) e 0 = faceTemplatePairs (ZMod 2) e₀ 0 :=
    faceTemplatePairs_transfer (ZMod 2) e₀ (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter 0)
      (by intro i j _; change (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 0 ^ 2; exact le_rfl) 0
  rw [heq]
  exact hpos

name: TDA.Persistence.tiedFullLinear_apply
statement:
theorem tiedFullLinear_apply (m n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) :
    tiedFullLinear m n t = (fun _ => (t, t), fun _ => t)
proof:
:= by
  ext i <;> simp [tiedFullLinear]

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_tied_edge_fixed_lift
statement:
theorem nonlinear_tied_edge_fixed_lift
    (e : CompatibleOrder (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter (0 : ℝ))) (t : ℝ) :
    fixedFaceLift (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 t =
      tiedFullLinear (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1
        (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).2 (t ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tiedFullLinear_apply]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_tied_edge_ambient_birth_hessian
statement:
theorem nonlinear_tied_edge_ambient_birth_hessian
    (e : CompatibleOrder (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter (0 : ℝ)))
    (i : Fin (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘
      orderedQ (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1
        (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).2))
      (fixedFaceLift (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 0)
      (faceLossUnit (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 (.inl (.inl i)))
      (faceLossUnit (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 (.inl (.inl i))) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_secondFDeriv_apply]
  have ha : signedCoordinateFunctional _ _
      (faceLossUnit (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 (.inl (.inl i))) = -1 := by
    rw [signedCoordinateFunctional_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp [faceLossUnit, faceLossSlotPack]
    · intro j _ hji
      simp [faceLossUnit, faceLossSlotPack, hji]
    · intro hi
      exact (hi (Finset.mem_univ i)).elim
  rw [ha]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_tied_edge_hessian_pullback_zero
statement:
theorem nonlinear_tied_edge_hessian_pullback_zero
    (e : CompatibleOrder (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter (0 : ℝ))) (t h k : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘
      orderedQ (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1
        (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).2))
      (fixedFaceLift (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 t)
      (fderiv ℝ (fixedFaceLift (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0) t h)
      (fderiv ℝ (fixedFaceLift (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0) t k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf : fixedFaceLift (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 =
      fun t => tiedFullLinear (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1
        (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).2 (t ^ 2) :=
    funext (nonlinear_tied_edge_fixed_lift e)
  rw [squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference_secondFDeriv_apply, hf, quadraticCurve_fderiv]
  simp [signedCoordinateFunctional_apply, tiedFullLinear_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_tied_edge_squared_second_derivative
statement:
theorem nonlinear_tied_edge_squared_second_derivative (t : ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (𝕜 := ℝ) (fderiv ℝ (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘
      (fun x : ℝ => dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter x) 0))) 0 t
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘
      (fun x : ℝ => dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter x) 0)) =
      (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
    funext x
    exact nonlinear_tied_edge_squared_loss_zero x
  rw [hf]
  have hdf : fderiv ℝ (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) =
      (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) := by
    funext x
    exact fderiv_const_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) 0
  rw [hdf]
  exact hasFDerivAt_const _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_tied_edge_face_curvature_cancel
statement:
theorem nonlinear_tied_edge_face_curvature_cancel
    (e : CompatibleOrder (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter (0 : ℝ)))
    (i : Fin (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1) :
    faceLossCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0
      signedFiniteEndpointDifference
      (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 (.inl (.inl i))) = -1 ∧
    faceLossCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0
      signedFiniteEndpointDifference
      (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 (.inl (.inr i))) = 1 ∧
    faceLossCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0
        signedFiniteEndpointDifference
        (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 (.inl (.inl i))) *
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter t).value
        (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 (.inl (.inl i))))) 1 1 1 +
    faceLossCoefficient (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0
        signedFiniteEndpointDifference
        (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 (.inl (.inr i))) *
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun t : ℝ => (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter t).value
        (faceLossSlotFace (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 (.inl (.inr i))))) 1 1 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [faceLossCoefficient_selected]
  exact nonlinear_tied_edge_pair_curvature_cancel e i

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_tied_edge_nonvacuous_hessian_cancellation
statement:
theorem nonlinear_tied_edge_nonvacuous_hessian_cancellation :
    ∃ (e : CompatibleOrder (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter (0 : ℝ)))
      (i : Fin (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1),
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘
      orderedQ (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1
        (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).2))
      (fixedFaceLift (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 0)
      (faceLossUnit (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 (.inl (.inl i)))
      (faceLossUnit (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 (.inl (.inl i))) = 2 ∧
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (squaredSignedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘
      orderedQ (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1
        (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).2))
      (fixedFaceLift (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0 1)
      (fderiv ℝ (fixedFaceLift (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0) 1 1)
      (fderiv ℝ (fixedFaceLift (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0) 1 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, hpos⟩ := nonlinear_tied_edge_has_finite_slot
  let i : Fin (faceLiftCounts (ZMod 2) nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter e 0).1 := ⟨0, hpos⟩
  exact ⟨e, i, nonlinear_tied_edge_ambient_birth_hessian e i,
    nonlinear_tied_edge_hessian_pullback_zero e 1 1 1⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.nonlinear_tied_edge_signed_second_derivative
statement:
theorem nonlinear_tied_edge_signed_second_derivative (t : ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (𝕜 := ℝ) (fderiv ℝ (signedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘
      (fun x : ℝ => dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter x) 0))) 0 t
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (signedFiniteEndpointDifference ∘
      (fun x : ℝ => dgm (ZMod 2) (nonlinearTiedEdgeFilter x) 0)) =
      (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
    funext x
    exact nonlinear_tied_edge_signed_loss_zero x
  rw [hf]
  have hdf : fderiv ℝ (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ)) =
      (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ)) := by
    funext x
    exact fderiv_const_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) 0
  rw [hdf]
  exact hasFDerivAt_const _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.uniform_limits
statement:
private theorem uniform_limits {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V] [Fintype V]
    {X : Type w} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ)
    {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) : uniformLimits (V := V) (X := X) k n R
proof:
:=
  ⟨Cech.finitePMatchingCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_allDegrees k n R hR,
    Cech.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_allDegrees k n R hR⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.error_bounds
statement:
private theorem error_bounds {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V] [Fintype V]
    {X : Type w} [PseudoMetricSpace X] {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (a b : V → X) (n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hδ : Cech.displacement a b ≤ R) : errorBounds p k a b n R
proof:
:=
  ⟨Cech.finitePMatchingCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_allDegrees hp k a b n hR hδ,
    Cech.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_allDegrees
      hp k a b n hR hδ⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.card_of_empty_finitePart
statement:
private theorem card_of_empty_finitePart (D : Diagram ℝ) (h : finitePart D.points = 0) :
    Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Multiset.card_coe, h, Multiset.card_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.matching_presentation
statement:
private theorem matching_presentation {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (D E : Diagram ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : Finset.univ.val.map x = finitePart D.points)
    (hy : Finset.univ.val.map y = finitePart E.points) (p : ℝ) :
    matching p D E = finitePMatchingCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  let u := finiteEnum D x hx
  let v := finiteEnum E y hy
  have hu : (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ∘ u.1 = x := funext u.2
  have hv : (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ∘ v.1 = y := funext v.2
  simpa only [hu, hv] using (finitePMatchingCost_reindex u.1 v.1 p
    (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1) (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.constant_value
statement:
private theorem constant_value {V X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (x : X) (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    (Cech.filter (fun _ : V => x)).value s = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ (Cech.filter_value_nonneg _ _)
  exact (Cech.filter_value_le_radiusAt _ s x).trans
    ((Cech.radiusAt_le_iff _ x s.val 0).mpr ⟨le_rfl, by simp⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.constant_finitePart
statement:
private theorem constant_finitePart {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V] [Fintype V]
    {X : Type w} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (k : Type u) [Field k] (x : X) (n : ℕ) :
    finitePart (dgm k (Cech.filter (fun _ : V => x)) n).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiset.eq_zero_of_forall_notMem
  intro q hq
  have h := dgm_finitePart_mem_Icc k n
    (fun s => (constant_value x s).ge) (fun s => (constant_value x s).le) q hq
  linarith [h.1, h.2.1, h.2.2]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.singleton_finitePart
statement:
private theorem singleton_finitePart {X : Type w} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (k : Type) [Field k] (a : Fin 1 → X) :
    finitePart (dgm k (Cech.filter a) 0).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := card_finiteOccurrences_dgm_fullComplex_le k (Cech.filter a) 0
  have hc : Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter a) 0).finiteOccurrences = 0 := by
    apply Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero
    simpa using h
  apply Multiset.card_eq_zero.mp
  simpa only [Multiset.card_coe] using hc

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.singleton_points
proof:
:= by
  have h := parts_reconstruct (dgm k (Cech.filter a) 0).points
  simpa only [singleton_finitePart k a, Cech.essentialPart_dgm_zero_eq_singleton k a,
    Multiset.map_zero, Multiset.map_singleton, zero_add] using h.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.singleton_costs
statement:
private theorem singleton_costs {X : Type w} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (k : Type) [Field k] (a b : Fin 1 → X) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    essentialPart (dgm k (Cech.filter a) 0).points = ({0} : Multiset ℝ) ∧
    Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter a) 0).finiteOccurrences = 0 ∧
    bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter a) 0) (dgm k (Cech.filter b) 0) = 0 ∧
    matching p (dgm k (Cech.filter a) 0) (dgm k (Cech.filter b) 0) = 0 ∧
    transport p (dgm k (Cech.filter a) 0) (dgm k (Cech.filter b) 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have ha := card_of_empty_finitePart _ (singleton_finitePart k a)
  have hb := card_of_empty_finitePart _ (singleton_finitePart k b)
  letI := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp ha
  letI := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hb
  have he : dgm k (Cech.filter a) 0 = dgm k (Cech.filter b) 0 := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    rw [singleton_points k a, singleton_points k b]
  refine ⟨Cech.essentialPart_dgm_zero_eq_singleton k a, ha, ?_,
    finitePMatchingCost_empty hp _ _, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty hp _ _⟩
  rw [he]
  exact bottleneck_self _

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.singleton_displacement
statement:
private theorem singleton_displacement (x y : ℝ) :
    Cech.displacement (oneCloud x) (oneCloud y) = |x - y|
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (Cech.displacement_le_iff _ _ _).mpr ⟨abs_nonneg _, fun _ => by
      simp only [oneCloud, Real.dist_eq]; exact le_rfl⟩
  · simpa only [oneCloud, Real.dist_eq] using
      Cech.dist_le_displacement (oneCloud x) (oneCloud y) 0

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.singleton_zero_budget
statement:
private theorem singleton_zero_budget (k : Type) [Field k] (x : ℝ)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    Cech.displacement (oneCloud x) (oneCloud x) = 0 ∧
    2 * Nat.choose (Fintype.card (Fin 1)) (0 + 2) = 0 ∧
    errorBounds p k (oneCloud x) (oneCloud x) 0 0 ∧
    uniformLimits (V := Fin 1) (X := ℝ) k 0 0
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨by simp, by norm_num [Nat.choose],
    error_bounds hp k _ _ 0 le_rfl (by simp), uniform_limits k 0 le_rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.singleton_moving_budget
statement:
private theorem singleton_moving_budget (k : Type) [Field k] (x y : ℝ)
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (oneCloud x, oneCloud y) ∈ {z : (Fin 1 → ℝ) × (Fin 1 → ℝ) |
      Cech.displacement z.1 z.2 ≤ |x-y|} ∧
    errorBounds p k (oneCloud x) (oneCloud y) 0 |x-y| ∧
    uniformLimits (V := Fin 1) (X := ℝ) k 0 |x-y|
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨(singleton_displacement x y).le,
    error_bounds hp k _ _ 0 (abs_nonneg _) (singleton_displacement x y).le,
    uniform_limits k 0 (abs_nonneg _)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.empty_diagram
statement:
private theorem empty_diagram {X : Type w} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (k : Type) [Field k] (a : Fin 0 → X) (n : ℕ) :
    (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsEmpty (TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 0))) :=
    ⟨fun s => by obtain ⟨v, _⟩ := s.property; exact Fin.elim0 v⟩
  exact dgm_empty_faces k (Cech.filter a) n

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.empty_costs
statement:
private theorem empty_costs {X : Type w} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (k : Type) [Field k] (a b : Fin 0 → X) (n : ℕ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    finitePart (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n).points = 0 ∧
    essentialPart (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n).points = 0 ∧
    Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n).finiteOccurrences = 0 ∧
    Cech.displacement a b = 0 ∧
    bottleneck (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter b) n) = 0 ∧
    matching p (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter b) n) = 0 ∧
    transport p (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n) (dgm k (Cech.filter b) n) = 0 ∧
    errorBounds p k a b n 0 ∧ uniformLimits (V := Fin 0) (X := X) k n 0
proof:
:= by
  have hf (c : Fin 0 → X) : finitePart (dgm k (Cech.filter c) n).points = 0 := by
    rw [empty_diagram k c n]
    rfl
  have he : essentialPart (dgm k (Cech.filter a) n).points = 0 := by
    rw [empty_diagram k a n]
    rfl
  have ha := card_of_empty_finitePart _ (hf a)
  have hb := card_of_empty_finitePart _ (hf b)
  letI := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp ha
  letI := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hb
  have heq : dgm k (Cech.filter a) n = dgm k (Cech.filter b) n := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    rw [empty_diagram k a n, empty_diagram k b n]
  refine ⟨hf a, he, ha, by simp, ?_, finitePMatchingCost_empty hp _ _,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty hp _ _,
    error_bounds hp k a b n le_rfl (by simp), uniform_limits k n le_rfl⟩
  rw [heq]
  exact bottleneck_self _

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.two_displacement
statement: private theorem two_displacement : Cech.displacement twoA twoB = 4
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (Cech.displacement_le_iff _ _ _).mpr
    refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [twoA, twoB, Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.pts, Real.dist_eq]
  · have h := Cech.dist_le_displacement twoA twoB 1
    norm_num [twoA, twoB, Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.pts, Real.dist_eq] at h
    exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.two_bottleneck
statement: private theorem two_bottleneck : bottleneck twoDA twoDB = ENNReal.ofReal (3 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation twoDA twoDB
    (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), 1)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), 3))
    (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : ℝ))
    two_presentations.1 two_presentations.2
    (by simp [two_parts.2.2.1]) (by simp [two_parts.2.2.2])]
  let M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 1) (Fin 1) (Fin 1) (Fin 1) :=
    ⟨fun _ => none, by simp, Equiv.refl _⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (presentationBottleneck_le_cost _ _ _ _ M).trans_eq
    norm_num [M, OccurrenceMatching.cost, finitePairCost, diagonalCost, essentialPairCost,
      reduceCtorEq]
    rw [if_neg (by decide : (none : Option (Fin 1)) ≠ some 0)]
    exact max_eq_right (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by norm_num))
  · apply le_iInf
    intro N
    cases h : N.finite 0 with
    | none =>
      have hn : ¬ ∃ i, N.finite i = some (0 : Fin 1) := by
        rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        have hi0 : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        simp [hi0, h] at hi
      have ht := N.target_le_cost
        (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), 1)) (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), 3))
        (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (0 : Fin 1)
      simpa [hn, diagonalCost] using ht
    | some j =>
      have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      have hs := N.source_le_cost
        (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), 1)) (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), 3))
        (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (0 : Fin 1)
      have htwo : ENNReal.ofReal 2 ≤ N.cost
          (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), 1)) (fun _ => ((0 : ℝ), 3))
          (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ => (0 : ℝ)) := by
        norm_num [h, hj, finitePairCost] at hs
        convert hs using 1 <;> norm_num
      exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by norm_num : (3 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ 2)).trans htwo

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.two_matching
statement:
private theorem two_matching (p : ℝ) : matching p twoDA twoDB =
    (min ((2 : ℝ) ^ p) (((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ p) + ((3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ p))) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [matching_presentation _ _ _ _ two_presentations.1 two_presentations.2,
    finitePMatchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_singleton]
  norm_num [finitePairCost, diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.two_costs_at_one
statement:
private theorem two_costs_at_one :
    matching 1 twoDA twoDB = 2 ∧ transport 1 twoDA twoDB = 2 ∧
    |matching 1 twoDA twoDB - (bottleneck twoDA twoDB).toReal| = 1 / 2 ∧
    |transport 1 twoDA twoDB - (bottleneck twoDA twoDB).toReal| = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hm : matching 1 twoDA twoDB = 2 := by
    rw [two_matching]
    norm_num
  have ht : transport 1 twoDA twoDB = 2 := by
    rw [transport, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
    exact hm
  norm_num [hm, ht, two_bottleneck]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.two_costs_at_two
proof:
:= by
  rw [show transport 2 twoDA twoDB = matching 2 twoDA twoDB from
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost _ _ _]
  norm_num [two_matching, Real.rpow_two, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.two_bounds_and_uniform
statement:
private theorem two_bounds_and_uniform {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (twoA, twoB) ∈ {z : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 2 → ℝ) |
      Cech.displacement z.1 z.2 ≤ 4} ∧
    errorBounds p (ZMod 2) twoA twoB 0 4 ∧
    errorBounds (3 / 2) (ZMod 2) twoA twoB 0 4 ∧
    uniformLimits (V := Fin 2) (X := ℝ) (ZMod 2) 0 4
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨two_displacement.le,
    error_bounds hp _ _ _ 0 (by norm_num) two_displacement.le,
    error_bounds (by norm_num) _ _ _ 0 (by norm_num) two_displacement.le,
    uniform_limits _ 0 (by norm_num)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.two_pair_power
statement:
private theorem two_pair_power (p : ℝ) :
    twoCanonicalPair.totalFinitePowerCost p
      (fun q : twoDA.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
      (fun q : twoDB.finiteOccurrences => q.1) = (2 : ℝ) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  let u := (finiteEnum twoDA (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), 1)) two_presentations.1).1.symm
  let v := (finiteEnum twoDB (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), 3)) two_presentations.2).1.symm
  have hu : (fun q : twoDA.finiteOccurrences => q.1) =
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), 1)) ∘ u := by
    funext q
    exact two_source_value q
  have hv : (fun q : twoDB.finiteOccurrences => q.1) =
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0 : ℝ), 3)) ∘ v := by
    funext q
    exact two_target_value q
  rw [hu, hv]
  change (FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.pairSingletons.relabel u v
    (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _)).totalFinitePowerCost _ _ _ = _
  rw [OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_relabel]
  norm_num [FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.pairSingletons,
    OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost,
    finitePairCost, diagonalCost, reduceCtorEq]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.two_zero_plan_power
statement:
private theorem two_zero_plan_power (p : ℝ) :
    (FiniteBoundaryPlan.zero : FiniteBoundaryPlan twoDA.finiteOccurrences
      twoDB.finiteOccurrences).powerCost p
      (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ p + (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ p
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [FiniteBoundaryPlan.powerCost, FiniteBoundaryPlan.linearCost,
    FiniteBoundaryPlan.zero, FiniteBoundaryPlan.deletionMass, FiniteBoundaryPlan.insertionMass,
    two_source_value, two_target_value, two_counts.1, two_counts.2.1, diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.two_real_optimizer_change
statement:
private theorem two_real_optimizer_change :
    (FiniteBoundaryPlan.ofMatching twoCanonicalPair).powerCost 1
        (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) =
      (transport 1 twoDA twoDB) ^ (1 : ℝ) ∧
    (transport 2 twoDA twoDB) ^ (2 : ℝ) <
      (FiniteBoundaryPlan.ofMatching twoCanonicalPair).powerCost 2
        (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) ∧
    (FiniteBoundaryPlan.zero : FiniteBoundaryPlan twoDA.finiteOccurrences
      twoDB.finiteOccurrences).powerCost 2 (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) =
      (transport 2 twoDA twoDB) ^ (2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [FiniteBoundaryPlan.powerCost_ofMatching, FiniteBoundaryPlan.powerCost_ofMatching,
    two_pair_power, two_pair_power, two_zero_plan_power,
    two_costs_at_one.2.1, two_costs_at_two.2]
  simp only [Real.rpow_one, Real.rpow_two]
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5 / 2)]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.deleting_common_essential
statement:
private theorem deleting_common_essential {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) :
    presentationBottleneck x (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : ℝ)) =
      Finset.univ.sup (fun i => diagonalCost (x i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M : OccurrenceMatching I (Fin 0) (Fin 1) (Fin 1) :=
    ⟨fun _ => none, by simp, Equiv.refl _⟩
  letI : Nonempty (OccurrenceMatching I (Fin 0) (Fin 1) (Fin 1)) := ⟨M⟩
  have hc (N : OccurrenceMatching I (Fin 0) (Fin 1) (Fin 1)) :
      N.cost x Fin.elim0 (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) =
        Finset.univ.sup (fun i => diagonalCost (x i)) := by
    have hn (i : I) : N.finite i = none := by
      cases h : N.finite i with
      | none => rfl
      | some j => exact Fin.elim0 j
    simp [OccurrenceMatching.cost, hn, essentialPairCost]
  simp only [presentationBottleneck, hc, ciInf_const]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.tri_parts
statement:
private theorem tri_parts :
    finitePart triDA.points = {((0 : ℝ), 1), (0, Real.sqrt 5 / 2)} ∧
    finitePart triDB.points = 0 ∧
    essentialPart triDA.points = ({0} : Multiset ℝ) ∧
    essentialPart triDB.points = ({0} : Multiset ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, constant_finitePart (ZMod 2) (triA 0) 0,
    Cech.essentialPart_dgm_zero_eq_singleton _ _,
    Cech.essentialPart_dgm_zero_eq_singleton _ _⟩
  change finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) TriangleCechRipsExamples.cechT 0).points = _
  rw [TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_cech_dgm_zero]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.tri_presentations

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.tri_displacement
statement: private theorem tri_displacement : Cech.displacement triA triB ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  apply (Cech.displacement_le_iff _ _ _).mpr
  refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro i
  change dist (triA i) (triA 0) ≤ 3
  fin_cases i
  · simp
  · change dist (Cech.Examples.Triangle.pts 1) (Cech.Examples.Triangle.pts 0) ≤ 3
    rw [dist_comm, TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_dist01]
    norm_num
  · change dist (Cech.Examples.Triangle.pts 2) (Cech.Examples.Triangle.pts 0) ≤ 3
    rw [dist_comm, TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_dist02]
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5), Real.sqrt_nonneg (5 : ℝ)]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.tri_bottleneck
statement: private theorem tri_bottleneck : bottleneck triDA triDB = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt 5 / 4)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation triDA triDB triValues (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
    (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : ℝ)) (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : ℝ))
    tri_presentations.1 tri_presentations.2
    (by simp [tri_parts.2.2.1]) (by simp [tri_parts.2.2.2]), deleting_common_essential]
  have hs : 2 ≤ Real.sqrt 5 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5), Real.sqrt_nonneg (5 : ℝ)]
  have hdiv : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 5 / 2 := by positivity
  norm_num [Finset.univ_fin2, triValues, diagonalCost, abs_of_nonneg hdiv,
    show |0 - Real.sqrt 5 / 2| = Real.sqrt 5 / 2 by rw [zero_sub, abs_neg,
      abs_of_nonneg hdiv]]
  rw [show Real.sqrt 5 / 2 / 2 = Real.sqrt 5 / 4 by ring]
  exact max_eq_right (show ENNReal.ofReal (1 / 2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt 5 / 4) from
    ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by linarith))

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.tri_costs
proof:
:= by
  have hm : matching p triDA triDB =
      ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ p + (Real.sqrt 5 / 4) ^ p) ^ p⁻¹ := by
    rw [matching_presentation _ _ _ _ tri_presentations.1 tri_presentations.2,
      finitePMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    have hs : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt 5 / 2 := by positivity
    norm_num [triValues, diagonalCost, abs_of_nonneg hs,
      show |0 - Real.sqrt 5 / 2| = Real.sqrt 5 / 2 by rw [zero_sub, abs_neg,
        abs_of_nonneg hs]]
    rw [show Real.sqrt 5 / 2 / 2 = Real.sqrt 5 / 4 by ring,
      ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)]
  exact ⟨hm, (finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost _ _ _).trans hm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.tri_nonzero_error
proof:
:= by
  rw [(tri_costs (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).1,
    (tri_costs (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)).2, tri_bottleneck,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (by positivity)]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.tri_bounds_and_uniform
statement:
private theorem tri_bounds_and_uniform {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (triA, triB) ∈ {z : (Fin 3 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ×
      (Fin 3 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) | Cech.displacement z.1 z.2 ≤ 3} ∧
    errorBounds p (ZMod 2) triA triB 0 3 ∧
    errorBounds (3 / 2) (ZMod 2) triA triB 0 3 ∧
    uniformLimits (V := Fin 3) (X := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) (ZMod 2) 0 3
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨tri_displacement,
    error_bounds hp _ _ _ 0 (by norm_num) tri_displacement,
    error_bounds (by norm_num) _ _ _ 0 (by norm_num) tri_displacement,
    uniform_limits _ 0 (by norm_num)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.value_zero_on_face
statement:
private theorem value_zero_on_face {V X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (a : V → X) (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) (x : X)
    (hx : ∀ v ∈ s.val, a v = x) : (Cech.filter a).value s = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ (Cech.filter_value_nonneg _ _)
  exact (Cech.filter_value_le_radiusAt a s x).trans
    ((Cech.radiusAt_le_iff a x s.val 0).mpr ⟨le_rfl, fun v hv => by simp [hx v hv]⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.repeated_mixed_value
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (Cech.filter_value_le_radiusAt repeatedA s 1).trans
    apply (Cech.radiusAt_le_iff repeatedA 1 s.val 1).mpr
    refine ⟨by norm_num, fun i _ => ?_⟩
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [repeatedA, Real.dist_eq]
  · rw [Cech.filter_value]
    apply le_ciInf
    intro x
    have h0 := Cech.dist_le_radiusAt repeatedA x hv
    have h2 := Cech.dist_le_radiusAt repeatedA x htwo
    rw [hzero] at h0
    change dist x (2 : ℝ) ≤ Cech.radiusAt repeatedA x s.val at h2
    have hd : (2 : ℝ) ≤ dist x 0 + dist x 2 := by
      have h := dist_triangle_left (0 : ℝ) 2 x
      norm_num [Real.dist_eq] at h ⊢
      exact h
    linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.repeated_enum_values
statement:
private theorem repeated_enum_values
    (i : Fin (faceCount Reduction.Examples.FilledTriangle.C.toPre)) :
    (TriangleCechRipsExamples.pullTriangle (Cech.filter repeatedA)).value
      (Reduction.Examples.FilledTriangle.e.enum i) = repeatedVals i.val
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · change (Cech.filter repeatedA).value ⟨{0}, by simp⟩ = _
    rw [TriangleCechRipsExamples.cech_value_singleton]
    norm_num [repeatedVals]
  · change (Cech.filter repeatedA).value ⟨{1}, by simp⟩ = _
    rw [TriangleCechRipsExamples.cech_value_singleton]
    norm_num [repeatedVals]
  · change (Cech.filter repeatedA).value ⟨{2}, by simp⟩ = _
    rw [TriangleCechRipsExamples.cech_value_singleton]
    norm_num [repeatedVals]
  · change (Cech.filter repeatedA).value ⟨{0, 1}, by simp⟩ = _
    rw [value_zero_on_face repeatedA _ 0 (by
      intro v hv
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
      rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;> rfl)]
    norm_num [repeatedVals]
  · change (Cech.filter repeatedA).value ⟨{1, 2}, by simp⟩ = _
    rw [repeated_mixed_value _ 1 (by simp) rfl (by simp)]
    norm_num [repeatedVals]
  · change (Cech.filter repeatedA).value ⟨{0, 2}, by simp⟩ = _
    rw [repeated_mixed_value _ 0 (by simp) rfl (by simp)]
    norm_num [repeatedVals]
  · change (Cech.filter repeatedA).value ⟨{0, 1, 2}, by simp⟩ = _
    rw [repeated_mixed_value _ 0 (by simp) rfl (by simp)]
    norm_num [repeatedVals]

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.repeated_monotone_enum
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.CechFinitePBottleneckAllDegreesExamples.singleton_translation_boundary
statement:
private theorem singleton_translation_boundary {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    essentialPart baseSingleton.points = ({0} : Multiset ℝ) ∧
    essentialPart shiftedSingleton.points = ({1} : Multiset ℝ) ∧
    (essentialPart baseSingleton.points).card = 1 ∧
    (essentialPart shiftedSingleton.points).card = 1 ∧
    essentialPart shiftedSingleton.points ≠ ({0} : Multiset ℝ) ∧
    matching p baseSingleton shiftedSingleton = 0 ∧
    transport p baseSingleton shiftedSingleton = 0 ∧
    bottleneck baseSingleton shiftedSingleton = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : baseSingleton = FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth 0 := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    rw [singleton_points]
    simp [FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth, orderedQ, List.ofFn_succ]
  have hshift : shiftedSingleton = FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth 1 := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    rw [shifted_singleton_points]
    simp [FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth, orderedQ, List.ofFn_succ]
  have hc := FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essential_births_zero_one hp
  have he : essentialPart shiftedSingleton.points = ({1} : Multiset ℝ) := by
    rw [shifted_singleton_points]
    rfl
  have hb := Cech.essentialPart_dgm_zero_eq_singleton (ZMod 2) (oneCloud 0)
  have hm : matching p baseSingleton shiftedSingleton = 0 := by
    rw [hbase, hshift]
    exact hc.1
  refine ⟨hb, he, by rw [hb]; rfl, by rw [he]; rfl, ?_, hm,
    (finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost _ _ _).trans hm, ?_⟩
  · rw [he]
    norm_num
  · rw [hbase, hshift]
    exact hc.2

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomQuotientDimensionExamples.rationalHookMap_nonzero
statement: private theorem rationalHookMap_nonzero : rationalHookMap ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  let x : rationalHookSum.obj 0 :=
    (biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := ℚ) (S := Fin 2)) rationalHookTag).app 0
      (HookInfinity.birth (R := ℚ) (0 : Fin 2))
  have hx : (rationalHookMap.app 0).hom x = (1 : ℚ) := by
    change ((HookInfinity.fromBirth (R := ℚ) 0 rationalSource (1 : ℚ)).app 0).hom
      (((biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := ℚ) (S := Fin 2)) rationalHookTag ≫
        biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := ℚ) (S := Fin 2)) rationalHookTag).app 0).hom
          (HookInfinity.birth (R := ℚ) (0 : Fin 2))) = (1 : ℚ)
    rw [biproduct.ι_π_self]
    change ((HookInfinity.fromBirth (R := ℚ) 0 rationalSource (1 : ℚ)).app 0).hom
      (HookInfinity.birth (R := ℚ) (0 : Fin 2)) = (1 : ℚ)
    exact HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth _ _ _
  have hval : (rationalHookMap.app 0).hom x = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : rationalHookSum ⟶ rationalSource => (f.app 0).hom x) hzero
    simpa using h
  rw [hx] at hval
  exact (by norm_num : (1 : ℚ) ≠ 0) hval

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomQuotientDimensionExamples.singletonGrid_Hom_projective
statement:
theorem singletonGrid_Hom_projective :
    letI : BoundedOrder singletonGrid.Point :=
      coordinateGridBoundedOrder singletonGrid singletonGrid_nonempty
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE
      ((homFunctor (k := ℚ) (S := singletonGrid.Point)).obj singletonGridModule) 0

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedAtBottom.structureMap_surjective
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hM b y
  refine ⟨structureMapLinear M (show (⊥ : P) ≤ a from bot_le) x, ?_⟩
  have hbotA : (⊥ : P) ≤ a := bot_le
  have hbotB : (⊥ : P) ≤ b := bot_le
  have htrans : hbotA.trans hab = hbotB := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  calc
    structureMapLinear M hab (structureMapLinear M hbotA x) =
        structureMapLinear M (hbotA.trans hab) x := by
          rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← structureMapLinear_comp]
    _ = structureMapLinear M hbotB x := by rw [htrans]
    _ = y := hx

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedAtBottom.of_surjective
proof:
:= by
  change ∀ p, Function.Surjective
    (structureMapLinear N (show (⊥ : P) ≤ p from bot_le))
  intro p y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hq p y
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := hM p x
  refine ⟨(q.app ⊥).hom x₀, ?_⟩
  have hn := congrArg (fun f : M.obj ⊥ ⟶ N.obj p => f.hom x₀)
    (q.naturality (homOfLE (show (⊥ : P) ≤ p from bot_le)))
  change (q.app p).hom
      (structureMapLinear M (show (⊥ : P) ≤ p from bot_le) x₀) =
    structureMapLinear N (show (⊥ : P) ≤ p from bot_le) ((q.app ⊥).hom x₀) at hn
  rw [hx₀, hx] at hn
  exact hn.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedAtBottom.cokernel_projection_surjective
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Epi (cokernel.π f) := inferInstance
  have hpi : Epi ((cokernel.π f).app p) :=
    (NatTrans.epi_iff_epi_app (cokernel.π f)).mp (inferInstance : Epi (cokernel.π f)) p
  exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).mp hpi

  of_surjective hN (cokernel.π f) (cokernel_projection_surjective f)

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.comp_eq_zero_of_range_eq_ker
statement:
theorem comp_eq_zero_of_range_eq_ker {X Y Z : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (h : ∀ p, LinearMap.range (f.app p).hom = LinearMap.ker (g.app p).hom) :
    f ≫ g = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext p x
  have hx : (f.app p).hom x ∈ LinearMap.range (f.app p).hom := ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [h p] at hx
  exact hx

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.rankExact_of_surjective_left
statement:
theorem rankExact_of_surjective_left {ι : A ⟶ B} {π : B ⟶ C}
    (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π)
    (hι : ∀ {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b),
      Function.Surjective (structureMapLinear A hab))
    (hB : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (B.obj p)) : IsRankExact ι π where
  toIsPointwiseShortExact
proof:
:= hs
  finiteDimensional := hB
  rank_add := by
    intro a b hab
    letI := hB a
    apply (hs.rank_add_iff_lift_kernel hab).mpr
    intro cₐ hcₐ
    obtain ⟨bₐ, hbₐ⟩ := hs.surjective a cₐ
    have hdie : (π.app b).hom (structureMapLinear B hab bₐ) = 0 := by
      have hn := congrArg (fun f : B.obj a ⟶ C.obj b => f.hom bₐ)
        (π.naturality (homOfLE hab))
      change (π.app b).hom (structureMapLinear B hab bₐ) =
        structureMapLinear C hab ((π.app a).hom bₐ) at hn
      simpa [hbₐ, hcₐ] using hn
    have himage : structureMapLinear B hab bₐ ∈ LinearMap.range (ι.app b).hom := by
      rw [hs.range_eq_ker b]
      exact hdie
    obtain ⟨a_b, ha_b⟩ := himage
    obtain ⟨aₐ, haₐ⟩ := hι hab a_b
    let b₀ := bₐ - (ι.app a).hom aₐ
    refine ⟨b₀, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hzero : (π.app a).hom ((ι.app a).hom aₐ) = 0 := by
        have hc := congrArg (fun f : A ⟶ C => (f.app a).hom aₐ) hs.comp_eq_zero
        exact hc
      simp [b₀, map_sub, hbₐ, hzero]
    · have hn := congrArg (fun f : A.obj a ⟶ B.obj b => f.hom aₐ)
        (ι.naturality (homOfLE hab))
      change (ι.app b).hom (structureMapLinear A hab aₐ) =
        structureMapLinear B hab ((ι.app a).hom aₐ) at hn
      calc
        structureMapLinear B hab b₀ =
            structureMapLinear B hab bₐ -
              structureMapLinear B hab ((ι.app a).hom aₐ) := by simp [b₀]
        _ = (ι.app b).hom a_b -
              (ι.app b).hom (structureMapLinear A hab aₐ) := by
                rw [← ha_b, hn.symm]
        _ = 0 := by rw [haₐ]; simp

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.rankExact_of_generatedAtBottom
proof:
:=
  rankExact_of_surjective_left hs hA.structureMap_surjective hB

name: TDA.Persistence.kernelRowLift_ι
proof:
:=
  kernel.lift_ι c b (IsPointwiseShortExact.comp_eq_zero_of_range_eq_ker b c hC)

name: TDA.Persistence.kernelRowLeftLift_surjective
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  have hz : ((kernel.ι b).app p).hom z ∈ LinearMap.ker (b.app p).hom := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : kernel b ⟶ C => (f.app p).hom z) (kernel.condition b)
    exact h
  rw [← hB p] at hz
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  apply RankKernel.injective b p
  have he := congrArg (fun f : A ⟶ B => (f.app p).hom x)
    (kernel.lift_ι b a
      (IsPointwiseShortExact.comp_eq_zero_of_range_eq_ker a b hB))
  exact he.trans hx

name: TDA.Persistence.kernelRowLift_surjective
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  have hz : ((kernel.ι c).app p).hom z ∈ LinearMap.ker (c.app p).hom := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : kernel c ⟶ D => (f.app p).hom z) (kernel.condition c)
    exact h
  rw [← hC p] at hz
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hz
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  apply RankKernel.injective c p
  have he := congrArg (fun f : B ⟶ C => (f.app p).hom x) (kernelRowLift_ι hC)
  exact he.trans hx

name: TDA.Persistence.kernelRowPointwiseShortExact
statement:
private theorem kernelRowPointwiseShortExact {b : B ⟶ C} {c : C ⟶ D}
    (hC : ∀ p, LinearMap.range (b.app p).hom = LinearMap.ker (c.app p).hom) :
    IsPointwiseShortExact (kernel.ι b) (kernelRowLift hC) where
  injective
proof:
:= RankKernel.injective b
  surjective := kernelRowLift_surjective hC
  range_eq_ker := by
    intro p
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
      apply RankKernel.injective c p
      have he := congrArg (fun f : B ⟶ C => (f.app p).hom
        (((kernel.ι b).app p).hom z)) (kernelRowLift_ι hC)
      change ((kernel.ι c).app p).hom
          (((kernelRowLift hC).app p).hom (((kernel.ι b).app p).hom z)) = _ at he
      rw [he]
      have hz := congrArg (fun f : kernel b ⟶ C => (f.app p).hom z) (kernel.condition b)
      change (b.app p).hom (((kernel.ι b).app p).hom z) = 0 at hz
      simpa using hz
    · intro hx
      have hbzero : (b.app p).hom x = 0 := by
        have he := congrArg (fun f : B ⟶ C => (f.app p).hom x)
          (kernelRowLift_ι hC)
        change ((kernel.ι c).app p).hom (((kernelRowLift hC).app p).hom x) =
          (b.app p).hom x at he
        rw [hx, map_zero] at he
        exact he.symm
      have hrange : x ∈ LinearMap.range ((kernel.ι b).app p).hom := by
        rw [RankKernel.range_eq_ker b p]
        exact hbzero
      obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hrange
      exact ⟨z, hz⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.rankExact_kernelRow
statement:
theorem rankExact_kernelRow [OrderBot P]
    {a : A ⟶ B} {b : B ⟶ C} {c : C ⟶ D}
    (hB : ∀ p, LinearMap.range (a.app p).hom = LinearMap.ker (b.app p).hom)
    (hC : ∀ p, LinearMap.range (b.app p).hom = LinearMap.ker (c.app p).hom)
    (hA : GeneratedAtBottom A) (hBfd : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (B.obj p)) :
    IsRankExact (kernel.ι b) (kernelRowLift hC)
proof:
:= by
  have hAtoKer : GeneratedAtBottom (kernel b) := by
    apply GeneratedAtBottom.of_surjective hA (kernelRowLeftLift hB)
    exact kernelRowLeftLift_surjective hB
  exact IsPointwiseShortExact.rankExact_of_generatedAtBottom
    (kernelRowPointwiseShortExact hC) hAtoKer hBfd

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.le_floor_iff
statement:
theorem le_floor_iff (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (p : G.Point) :
    G.embedding p ≤ a ↔ p ≤ G.floor a ha
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact G.le_floor a ha
  · intro hp
    exact (G.embedding.monotone hp).trans (G.floor_le a ha)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.floor_eq_iff
statement:
theorem floor_eq_iff (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (p : G.Point) :
    G.floor a ha = p ↔ G.embedding p ≤ a ∧ ∀ q : G.Point, G.embedding q ≤ a → q ≤ p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨G.floor_le a ha, fun _ hq => G.le_floor a ha hq⟩
  · intro h
    exact le_antisymm (h.2 _ (G.floor_le a ha)) (G.le_floor a ha h.1)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.floor_mono

proof:
:=
  G.le_floor b hb ((G.floor_le a ha).trans hab)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.eLpNorm_dist_eq_collapsedPowerCost
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_dist_eq_collapsedPowerCost (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (γ : Measure (Space × Space)) :
    eLpNorm (fun z : Space × Space => dist z.1 z.2) (ENNReal.ofReal p) γ =
      (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂γ) ^ (1 / p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eLpNorm_eq_lintegral_rpow_enorm_toReal
    (ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff.mpr hp) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp.le]
  congr 1
  apply lintegral_congr
  intro z
  simp only [collapsedPowerCost]
  rw [Real.enorm_eq_ofReal (dist_nonneg : 0 ≤ dist z.1 z.2),
    ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg dist_nonneg hp.le]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.iInf_rpow
statement:
private theorem iInf_rpow {ι : Sort*} (f : ι → ℝ≥0∞) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    (⨅ i, f i) ^ a = ⨅ i, (f i) ^ a
proof:
:= by
  exact (ENNReal.orderIsoRpow a ha).map_iInf f

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.eLpNorm_edist_eq_dist
statement:
theorem eLpNorm_edist_eq_dist (q : ℝ≥0∞) (γ : Measure (Space × Space)) :
    eLpNorm (fun z : Space × Space => edist z.1 z.2) q γ =
      eLpNorm (fun z : Space × Space => dist z.1 z.2) q γ
proof:
:= by
  apply eLpNorm_congr_enorm_ae
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
    rw [enorm_eq_self, edist_dist, Real.enorm_eq_ofReal dist_nonneg]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirDistance_eq_iInf_eLpNorm
statement:
theorem reservoirDistance_eq_iInf_eLpNorm (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞) :
    reservoirDistance p μ ν R =
      ⨅ γ : Measure (Space × Space),
        ⨅ (_ : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R ∧
          γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R),
          eLpNorm (fun z : Space × Space => edist z.1 z.2) (ENNReal.ofReal p) γ
proof:
:= by
  unfold reservoirDistance reservoirPowerValue
  have ha : 0 < 1 / p := one_div_pos.mpr hp
  rw [iInf_rpow (a := 1 / p) (fun γ : Measure (Space × Space) =>
    ⨅ (_ : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R ∧
      γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R),
      ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂γ) ha]
  simp_rw [iInf_rpow (a := 1 / p) (ha := ha),
    ← eLpNorm_dist_eq_collapsedPowerCost p hp, ← eLpNorm_edist_eq_dist]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_eq_iInf_eLpNorm
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_eq_iInf_eLpNorm (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hRtop : R < ∞)
    (htotal : μ univ + ν univ ≤ R) :
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν =
      ⨅ γ : Measure (Space × Space),
        ⨅ (_ : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R ∧
          γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R),
          eLpNorm (fun z : Space × Space => edist z.1 z.2) (ENNReal.ofReal p) γ
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryTransportDistance_eq_reservoirDistance p hp μ ν R hRtop htotal]
  exact reservoirDistance_eq_iInf_eLpNorm p (by linarith) μ ν R

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_eq_normalized_iInf_eLpNorm
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_eq_normalized_iInf_eLpNorm
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R)
    (htotal : μ univ + ν univ ≤ R) :
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν = R ^ (1 / p) *
      (⨅ γ : Measure (Space × Space),
        ⨅ (_ : γ.map Prod.fst = normalizedReservoirMeasure μ R ∧
          γ.map Prod.snd = normalizedReservoirMeasure ν R),
          eLpNorm (fun z : Space × Space => edist z.1 z.2) (ENNReal.ofReal p) γ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryTransportDistance_eq_normalizedReservoirDistance p hp μ ν R hRtop hRpos htotal,
    reservoirDistance_eq_iInf_eLpNorm p (by linarith)]
  rw [normalizedReservoirMeasure_eq_reservoirMeasure_inv μ R hRtop hRpos,
    normalizedReservoirMeasure_eq_reservoirMeasure_inv ν R hRtop hRpos]

    (hT : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) T) :

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankExact.pullback_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem IsRankExact.pullback_finitelyPresented
    (hs : IsRankExact ι π) (f : T ⟶ N)
    (hL : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) L)
    (hT : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) T) :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) (Limits.pullback π f) ∧
      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P)
        (Limits.kernel (Limits.pullback.snd π f)) ∧
      IsRankExact (Limits.kernel.ι (Limits.pullback.snd π f))
        (Limits.pullback.snd π f)
proof:
:= by
  let hsPB := hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact.pullback_pointwise f
  have hPB : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) (Limits.pullback π f) :=
    hsPB.finitelyPresented_middle hL hT
  have hKernel :
      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P)
        (Limits.kernel (Limits.pullback.snd π f)) :=
    finitelyPresented_of_iso hL hsPB.kernelIso
  letI : ∀ p : P, FiniteDimensional k (T.obj p) :=
    fun p => GradedFree.finitelyPresented_finiteDimensional T hT p
  have hPBDeflation : IsRankDeflation (Limits.pullback.snd π f) :=
    hs.isRankDeflation.pullback_snd f
  exact ⟨hPB, hKernel, hPBDeflation.rankExact_kernel⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureEssentialBoxExamples.interval_qTame

proof:

    (0, ⊤) (1 / 4, ⊤) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by simp) (by simp)
  have h := i.essentialMeasureValue_box_le_of_qTame (interval_qTame _)
    (show (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 0 by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.uniform_limits

proof:
:=
  ⟨finitePMatchingCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_of_essentialParts_eq m R hR,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendstoUniformlyOn_bottleneck_of_essentialParts_eq m R hR⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.bottleneck_le_deletions
statement:
private theorem bottleneck_le_deletions (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (he : essentialPart D.points = essentialPart E.points) (r : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hD : ∀ q : D.finiteOccurrences, diagonalCost q.1 ≤ r)
    (hE : ∀ q : E.finiteOccurrences, diagonalCost q.1 ≤ r) :
    bottleneck D E ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  refine (bottleneck_le_matching D E (deleteFinite D E he)).trans ?_
  apply OccurrenceMatching.cost_le_of
  · exact hD
  · intro j
    simpa [deleteFinite] using hE j
  · intro k
    change essentialPairCost k.1 k.1 ≤ r
    simp only [essentialPairCost_self, zero_le]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.block_essential

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.reordered_essential

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.block_finite

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.reordered_finite
statement: private theorem reordered_finite : finitePart reorderedBlock.points = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.reordered_zero_budget
statement:
private theorem reordered_zero_budget {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    essentialPart essentialBlock.points = essentialPart reorderedBlock.points ∧
    Fintype.card essentialBlock.essentialOccurrences = 3 ∧
    (essentialPart essentialBlock.points).count (-3) = 2 ∧
    essentialBlock.IsPositive ∧ reorderedBlock.IsPositive ∧
    (essentialBlock, reorderedBlock) ∈ budgetSet 0 0 ∧
    matching p essentialBlock reorderedBlock = 0 ∧
    transport p essentialBlock reorderedBlock = 0 ∧
    bottleneck essentialBlock reorderedBlock = 0 ∧ uniformLimits 0 0
proof:
:= by
  have he := block_essential.trans reordered_essential.symm
  have hB : bottleneck essentialBlock reorderedBlock = 0 :=
    le_antisymm (bottleneck_le_deletions _ _ he 0 (fun q => isEmptyElim q)
      (fun q => isEmptyElim q)) bot_le
  refine ⟨he, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ⟨he, by simp, by simp [hB]⟩,
    finitePMatchingCost_empty hp _ _, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty hp _ _, hB,
    uniform_limits 0 le_rfl⟩
  · simp only [Multiset.card_coe, block_essential]; norm_num
  · norm_num [block_essential]
  · exact (orderedQ_isPositive_iff _ _ _).mpr fun i => Fin.elim0 i
  · exact (orderedQ_isPositive_iff _ _ _).mpr fun i => Fin.elim0 i

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.arbitrary_essential_zero_budget
statement:
private theorem arbitrary_essential_zero_budget (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    Fintype.card (essentialFamily n a).essentialOccurrences = n ∧
    Fintype.card (essentialFamily n a).finiteOccurrences = 0 ∧
    (essentialFamily n a).IsPositive ∧
    (essentialFamily n a, essentialFamily n a) ∈ budgetSet 0 0 ∧
    bottleneck (essentialFamily n a) (essentialFamily n a) = 0 ∧
    matching p (essentialFamily n a) (essentialFamily n a) = 0 ∧
    transport p (essentialFamily n a) (essentialFamily n a) = 0 ∧ uniformLimits 0 0
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Fintype.card (essentialFamily n a).finiteOccurrences = 0 := by
    rw [finite_card]
    simp [essentialFamily, finitePart_orderedQ]
  let : IsEmpty (essentialFamily n a).finiteOccurrences := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hc
  refine ⟨?_, hc, ?_, ⟨rfl, by simp, by simp [bottleneck_self]⟩, bottleneck_self _,
    finitePMatchingCost_empty hp _ _, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty hp _ _,
    uniform_limits 0 le_rfl⟩
  · rw [essential_card]
    simp [essentialFamily, essentialPart_orderedQ]
  · exact (orderedQ_isPositive_iff _ _ _).mpr fun i => Fin.elim0 i

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.scaled_essential
statement:
private theorem scaled_essential (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) :

proof:
