name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.scaled_finite
statement:
private theorem scaled_finite (n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    finitePart (scaledBars n R).points = Multiset.replicate n ((0, 2 * R) : ℝ × ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (0 : ℝ) ≠ 2 * R := by linarith
  simp [scaledBars, finitePart_orderedQ, List.ofFn_const, Multiset.coe_replicate, hne]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.scaled_card
statement:
private theorem scaled_card (n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    Fintype.card (scaledBars n R).finiteOccurrences = n
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Multiset.card_coe, scaled_finite n hR, Multiset.card_replicate]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.scaled_value
statement:
private theorem scaled_value (n : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (q : (scaledBars n R).finiteOccurrences) : q.1 = ((0, 2 * R) : ℝ × ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact Multiset.eq_of_mem_replicate
    (by simpa only [scaled_finite n hR] using (Multiset.coe_mem (x := q)))

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.scaled_diagonal
statement:
private theorem scaled_diagonal {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    diagonalCost ((0, 2 * R) : ℝ × ℝ) = ENNReal.ofReal R
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [diagonalCost]
  congr 1
  rw [sub_zero, abs_of_pos (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * R)]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.scaled_bottleneck
statement:
private theorem scaled_bottleneck (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    bottleneck (scaledBars n R) essentialBlock = ENNReal.ofReal R
proof:
:= by
  have he := scaled_essential n R
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact bottleneck_le_deletions _ _ he _ (fun q => by
      rw [scaled_value n hR q, scaled_diagonal hR]) (fun q => isEmptyElim q)
  · obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (bottleneck_optimal_iff _ _).mpr (congrArg Multiset.card he)
    let : Nonempty (scaledBars n R).finiteOccurrences :=
      Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by rw [scaled_card n hR]; exact hn)
    let q : (scaledBars n R).finiteOccurrences := Classical.choice inferInstance
    have h := M.source_le_cost (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1)
      (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) q
    rw [hM] at h
    cases hf : M.finite q with
    | none => simpa only [hf, scaled_value n hR, scaled_diagonal hR] using h
    | some j => exact isEmptyElim j

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.scaled_matching
statement:
private theorem scaled_matching (n : ℕ) {R p : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    matching p (scaledBars n R) essentialBlock = (n : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * R
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)
  rw [matching, finitePMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right]
  simp only [scaled_value n hR, scaled_diagonal hR, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hR.le,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, scaled_card n hR, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Real.rpow_nonneg hR.le _),
    Real.rpow_rpow_inv hR.le hp0]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.sharp_common_essential
statement:
private theorem sharp_common_essential {R p : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    essentialPart (scaledBars 2 R).points = {-3, -3, 7} ∧
    Fintype.card (scaledBars 2 R).finiteOccurrences = 2 ∧
    (scaledBars 2 R).IsPositive ∧
    (scaledBars 2 R, essentialBlock) ∈ budgetSet 2 R ∧
    bottleneck (scaledBars 2 R) essentialBlock = ENNReal.ofReal R ∧
    matching p (scaledBars 2 R) essentialBlock = (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * R ∧
    transport p (scaledBars 2 R) essentialBlock = (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * R ∧
    |matching p (scaledBars 2 R) essentialBlock -
      (bottleneck (scaledBars 2 R) essentialBlock).toReal| = ((2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1) * R ∧
    |transport p (scaledBars 2 R) essentialBlock -
      (bottleneck (scaledBars 2 R) essentialBlock).toReal| = ((2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1) * R ∧
    uniformLimits 2 R
proof:
:= by
  have hB := scaled_bottleneck 2 (by decide) hR
  have hm : matching p (scaledBars 2 R) essentialBlock = (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * R := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat] using scaled_matching 2 hR hp
  have ht : transport p (scaledBars 2 R) essentialBlock = (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * R := by
    rw [transport, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]; exact hm
  have hfactor : 1 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ :=
    Real.one_le_rpow (by norm_num) (inv_nonneg.mpr (zero_le_one.trans hp))
  have herr : (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * R - R = ((2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1) * R := by ring
  refine ⟨(scaled_essential 2 R).trans block_essential, scaled_card 2 hR, ?_,
    ⟨scaled_essential 2 R, by simp [scaled_card 2 hR], hB.le⟩, hB, hm, ht, ?_, ?_,
    uniform_limits 2 hR.le⟩
  · apply (orderedQ_isPositive_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro i; dsimp; linarith
  · rw [hm, hB, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hR.le, herr,
      abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hfactor) hR.le)]
  · rw [ht, hB, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hR.le, herr,
      abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hfactor) hR.le)]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.sharp_fractional
statement:
private theorem sharp_fractional {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
    |matching (3 / 2) (scaledBars 2 R) essentialBlock - R| =
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) - 1) * R ∧
    |transport (3 / 2) (scaledBars 2 R) essentialBlock - R| =
        ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) - 1) * R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, hB, _, _, hm, ht, _⟩ :=
    sharp_common_essential hR (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 2)
  norm_num [hB, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hR.le] at hm ht
  exact ⟨hm, ht⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.sharp_bounds
proof:
:= by
  have hB := scaled_bottleneck 2 (by decide) hR
  have h : (scaledBars 2 R, essentialBlock) ∈ budgetSet 2 R :=
    ⟨scaled_essential 2 R, by simp [scaled_card 2 hR], hB.le⟩
  have hm := finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_of_essentialParts_eq
    hp _ _ h.1 h.2.1 hR.le h.2.2
  have ht := finitePBoundaryTransportCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_of_essentialParts_eq
    hp _ _ h.1 h.2.1 hR.le h.2.2
  exact ⟨by simpa [hB, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hR.le] using hm,
    by simpa [hB, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hR.le] using ht⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.singleton_essential
statement:
private theorem singleton_essential (x : ℝ × ℝ) :
    essentialPart (singleton x).points = essentialPart essentialBlock.points
proof:
:= by
  simp [singleton, essentialBlock, essentialPart_orderedQ]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.singleton_finite
statement:
private theorem singleton_finite (x : ℝ × ℝ) (hx : x.1 ≠ x.2) :
    finitePart (singleton x).points = {x}
proof:
:= by
  simp [singleton, finitePart_orderedQ, List.ofFn_succ, hx]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.singleton_card
statement:
private theorem singleton_card (x : ℝ × ℝ) (hx : x.1 ≠ x.2) :
    Fintype.card (singleton x).finiteOccurrences = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Multiset.card_coe, singleton_finite x hx, Multiset.card_singleton]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.singleton_value
statement:
private theorem singleton_value (x : ℝ × ℝ) (hx : x.1 ≠ x.2)
    (q : (singleton x).finiteOccurrences) : q.1 = x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [singleton_finite x hx, Multiset.mem_singleton] using Multiset.coe_mem (x := q)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.singleton_matching
statement:
private theorem singleton_matching (p : ℝ) (x y : ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : x.1 ≠ x.2) (hy : y.1 ≠ y.2) :
    matching p (singleton x) (singleton y) =
      finitePMatchingCost p (fun _ : Fin 1 => x) (fun _ : Fin 1 => y)
proof:
:= by
  let u := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (singleton_card x hx)).symm
  let v := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (singleton_card y hy)).symm
  have h := finitePMatchingCost_reindex u v p
    (fun q : (singleton x).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
    (fun q : (singleton y).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
  have hu : (fun q : (singleton x).finiteOccurrences => q.1) ∘ u =
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => x) := by
    funext i
    exact singleton_value x hx (u i)
  have hv : (fun q : (singleton y).finiteOccurrences => q.1) ∘ v =
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => y) := by
    funext j
    exact singleton_value y hy (v j)
  rw [hu, hv] at h
  exact h.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.switch_left_value
statement:
private theorem switch_left_value (q : switchLeft.finiteOccurrences) :
    q.1 = ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ)
proof: := singleton_value _ (by norm_num) q

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.switch_right_value
statement:
private theorem switch_right_value (q : switchRight.finiteOccurrences) :
    q.1 = ((3 / 2, 7 / 2) : ℝ × ℝ)
proof: := singleton_value _ (by norm_num) q

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.switch_left_card
statement: private theorem switch_left_card : Fintype.card switchLeft.finiteOccurrences = 1
proof:
:=
  singleton_card _ (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.switch_right_card
statement: private theorem switch_right_card : Fintype.card switchRight.finiteOccurrences = 1
proof:
:=
  singleton_card _ (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.switch_positive
statement: private theorem switch_positive : switchLeft.IsPositive ∧ switchRight.IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · unfold switchLeft singleton
    apply (orderedQ_isPositive_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro i; norm_num
  · unfold switchRight singleton
    apply (orderedQ_isPositive_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro i; norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.switch_essential
statement:
private theorem switch_essential :
    essentialPart switchLeft.points = essentialPart switchRight.points
proof:
:=
  (singleton_essential _).trans (singleton_essential _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.switch_bottleneck
statement: private theorem switch_bottleneck : bottleneck switchLeft switchRight = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (0 : ℝ) ≠ 2 := by norm_num
  have hy : (3 / 2 : ℝ) ≠ 7 / 2 := by norm_num
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply bottleneck_le_deletions _ _ switch_essential 1
    · intro q; norm_num [switchLeft, singleton_value _ hx q, diagonalCost]
    · intro q; norm_num [switchRight, singleton_value _ hy q, diagonalCost]
  · obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := (bottleneck_optimal_iff _ _).mpr
      (congrArg Multiset.card switch_essential)
    let : Nonempty switchLeft.finiteOccurrences :=
      Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by rw [switchLeft, singleton_card _ hx]; decide)
    let q : switchLeft.finiteOccurrences := Classical.choice inferInstance
    have h := M.source_le_cost (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1)
      (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) q
    have hq : q.1 = ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ) := singleton_value _ hx q
    cases hf : M.finite q with
    | none => simpa [hf, hq, diagonalCost, hM] using h
    | some j =>
      have hj : j.1 = ((3 / 2, 7 / 2) : ℝ × ℝ) := singleton_value _ hy j
      have hpair : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ finitePairCost q.1 j.1 := by
        norm_num [hq, hj, finitePairCost]
      exact hpair.trans (by simpa only [hf, hM] using h)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.switch_membership
statement: private theorem switch_membership : (switchLeft, switchRight) ∈ budgetSet 2 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨switch_essential, ?_, by simp [switch_bottleneck]⟩
  rw [switch_left_card, switch_right_card]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.switch_root_values
statement:
private theorem switch_root_values :
    matching 1 switchLeft switchRight = 3 / 2 ∧
    matching 2 switchLeft switchRight = (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∧
    transport 1 switchLeft switchRight = 3 / 2 ∧
    transport 2 switchLeft switchRight = (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∧ uniformLimits 2 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmatch (p : ℝ) := singleton_matching p (0, 2) (3 / 2, 7 / 2)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hm1 : matching 1 switchLeft switchRight = 3 / 2 := by
    rw [switchLeft, switchRight, hmatch, finitePMatchingCost,
      ← finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost,
      FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.switch_power_one]
    norm_num
  have hm2 : matching 2 switchLeft switchRight = (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
    rw [switchLeft, switchRight, hmatch, finitePMatchingCost,
      ← finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost,
      FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.switch_power_two]
    norm_num
  exact ⟨hm1, hm2, by rw [transport, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]; exact hm1,
    by rw [transport, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]; exact hm2,
    uniform_limits 2 (by norm_num)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.singleton_power
statement:
private theorem singleton_power (p : ℝ) :
    finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : switchLeft.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : switchRight.finiteOccurrences => q.1) =
      finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost p (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ))
        (fun _ : Fin 1 => (3 / 2, 7 / 2))
proof:
:= by
  let u := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (singleton_card (0, 2) (by norm_num))).symm
  let v := (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq
    (singleton_card ((3 / 2, 7 / 2) : ℝ × ℝ) (by norm_num))).symm
  simp only [finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  have h := finitePowerMatchingCost_reindex u v p
    (fun q : switchLeft.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
    (fun q : switchRight.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
  have hu : (fun q : switchLeft.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ∘ u =
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    funext i
    exact switch_left_value (u i)
  have hv : (fun q : switchRight.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ∘ v =
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((3 / 2, 7 / 2) : ℝ × ℝ)) := by
    funext j
    exact switch_right_value (v j)
  rw [hu, hv] at h
  exact h.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.optimizer_change
statement:
private theorem optimizer_change :
    (∃ M : OccurrenceMatching switchLeft.finiteOccurrences switchRight.finiteOccurrences
        PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      M.totalFinitePowerCost 1 (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) =
        finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost 1 (fun q : switchLeft.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
          (fun q : switchRight.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ∧
      finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost 2 (fun q : switchLeft.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
          (fun q : switchRight.finiteOccurrences => q.1) <
        M.totalFinitePowerCost 2 (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1)) ∧
    (FiniteBoundaryPlan.zero : FiniteBoundaryPlan switchLeft.finiteOccurrences
      switchRight.finiteOccurrences).powerCost 2 (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) =
      finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost 2 (fun q : switchLeft.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : switchRight.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
proof:
:= by
  let u := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq (singleton_card (0, 2) (by norm_num))
  let v := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq
    (singleton_card ((3 / 2, 7 / 2) : ℝ × ℝ) (by norm_num))
  let M := FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.pairSingletons.relabel u v
    (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _)
  have hx : (fun q : switchLeft.finiteOccurrences => q.1) =
      (fun _ => ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ)) := funext switch_left_value
  have hy : (fun q : switchRight.finiteOccurrences => q.1) =
      (fun _ => ((3 / 2, 7 / 2) : ℝ × ℝ)) := funext switch_right_value
  have hM (p : ℝ) : M.totalFinitePowerCost p (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) =
      FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.pairSingletons.totalFinitePowerCost p
        (fun _ => (0, 2)) (fun _ => (3 / 2, 7 / 2)) := by
    have h := OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_relabel u v
      FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.pairSingletons p
      (fun _ => (0, 2)) (fun _ => (3 / 2, 7 / 2))
    rw [hx, hy]
    simpa only [Function.comp_def] using h
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.optimizer_changes_with_exponent
  refine ⟨⟨M, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hM, singleton_power]; exact h1
  · rw [hM, singleton_power]; exact h2
  · rw [singleton_power, FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.switch_power_two]
    rw [hx, hy]
    have hcL : (finitePart switchLeft.points).card = 1 := by
      rw [← finite_card]
      exact switch_left_card
    have hcR : (finitePart switchRight.points).card = 1 := by
      rw [← finite_card]
      exact switch_right_card
    norm_num [FiniteBoundaryPlan.powerCost, FiniteBoundaryPlan.linearCost,
      FiniteBoundaryPlan.zero, FiniteBoundaryPlan.deletionMass,
      FiniteBoundaryPlan.insertionMass, diagonalCost, Real.rpow_two,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, hcL, hcR]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.switch_bounds
statement:
private theorem switch_bounds {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    |matching p switchLeft switchRight - (1 : ℝ)| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1 ∧
    |transport p switchLeft switchRight - (1 : ℝ)| ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ - 1 ∧
    (switchLeft, switchRight) ∈ budgetSet 2 1 ∧ uniformLimits 2 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := switch_membership
  have hm := finitePMatchingCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_of_essentialParts_eq
    hp _ _ h.1 h.2.1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) h.2.2
  have ht := finitePBoundaryTransportCost_abs_sub_bottleneck_le_uniformBound_of_essentialParts_eq
    hp _ _ h.1 h.2.1 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1) h.2.2
  exact ⟨by simpa [switch_bottleneck] using hm, by simpa [switch_bottleneck] using ht,
    h, uniform_limits 2 (by norm_num)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.cardinality_is_insufficient
statement:
private theorem cardinality_is_insufficient {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    Fintype.card (essentialBirth 0).essentialOccurrences = 1 ∧
    Fintype.card (essentialBirth 1).essentialOccurrences = 1 ∧
    essentialPart (essentialBirth 0).points ≠ essentialPart (essentialBirth 1).points ∧
    Fintype.card (essentialBirth 0).finiteOccurrences +
      Fintype.card (essentialBirth 1).finiteOccurrences = 0 ∧
    bottleneck (essentialBirth 0) (essentialBirth 1) = 1 ∧
    matching p (essentialBirth 0) (essentialBirth 1) = 0 ∧
    transport p (essentialBirth 0) (essentialBirth 1) = 0 ∧
    |matching p (essentialBirth 0) (essentialBirth 1) -
      (bottleneck (essentialBirth 0) (essentialBirth 1)).toReal| = 1 ∧
    |transport p (essentialBirth 0) (essentialBirth 1) -
      (bottleneck (essentialBirth 0) (essentialBirth 1)).toReal| = 1 ∧
    ((((max 1 0 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) - 1) * 1 = 0 ∧
    (essentialBirth 0, essentialBirth 1) ∉ budgetSet 0 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hm, hB⟩ := FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essential_births_zero_one hp
  have ht : transport p (essentialBirth 0) (essentialBirth 1) = 0 := by
    rw [transport, finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]; exact hm
  have hne : essentialPart (essentialBirth 0).points ≠
      essentialPart (essentialBirth 1).points := by
    norm_num [essentialBirth, FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth,
      essentialPart_orderedQ, List.ofFn_succ]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, hne, ?_, hB, hm, ht, ?_, ?_, by simp, fun h => hne h.1⟩
  · rw [essential_card]
    simp [essentialBirth, FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth,
      essentialPart_orderedQ]
  · rw [essential_card]
    simp [essentialBirth, FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth,
      essentialPart_orderedQ]
  · rw [finite_card, finite_card]
    simp [essentialBirth, FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth,
      finitePart_orderedQ]
  · norm_num [matching, hm, hB]
  · norm_num [transport, ht, hB]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.unequal_counts_excluded
statement:
private theorem unequal_counts_excluded {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (essentialPart (essentialBirth 0).points).card ≠ (essentialPart empty.points).card ∧
    bottleneck (essentialBirth 0) empty = ⊤ ∧
    (∀ R : ℝ, ¬ bottleneck (essentialBirth 0) empty ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ R : ℝ, (essentialBirth 0, empty) ∉ budgetSet m R) ∧
    matching p (essentialBirth 0) empty = 0 ∧ transport p (essentialBirth 0) empty = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcounts : (essentialPart (essentialBirth 0).points).card ≠
      (essentialPart empty.points).card := by
    simp [essentialBirth, FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth,
      empty, essentialPart_orderedQ]
  have hB : bottleneck (essentialBirth 0) empty = ⊤ :=
    (bottleneck_eq_top_iff _ _).mpr hcounts
  have hR (R : ℝ) : ¬ bottleneck (essentialBirth 0) empty ≤ ENNReal.ofReal R := by
    rw [hB, top_le_iff]
    exact ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  let : IsEmpty (essentialBirth 0).finiteOccurrences := by
    apply Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp
    rw [finite_card]
    simp [essentialBirth, FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.essentialBirth,
      finitePart_orderedQ]
  exact ⟨hcounts, hB, hR, fun _ R h => hR R h.2.2, finitePMatchingCost_empty hp _ _,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_empty hp _ _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.essential_free_inclusion
statement:
private theorem essential_free_inclusion (m : ℕ) (R : ℝ) :
    oldBudgetSet m R ⊆ budgetSet m R
proof:
:=
  fun _ h => ⟨h.1.trans h.2.1.symm, h.2.2⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.essential_free_restriction
statement:
private theorem essential_free_restriction (m : ℕ) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 ≤ R) :
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun p : ℝ => fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ => matching p z.1 z.2)
      (fun z => (bottleneck z.1 z.2).toReal) atTop (oldBudgetSet m R) ∧
    TendstoUniformlyOn
      (fun p : ℝ => fun z : Diagram ℝ × Diagram ℝ => transport p z.1 z.2)
      (fun z => (bottleneck z.1 z.2).toReal) atTop (oldBudgetSet m R)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(uniform_limits m hR).1.mono (essential_free_inclusion m R),
    (uniform_limits m hR).2.mono (essential_free_inclusion m R)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCommonEssentialBottleneckExamples.essential_free_examples
statement:
private theorem essential_free_examples {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    (empty, empty) ∈ oldBudgetSet 0 0 ∧
    (FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars 1, empty) ∈ oldBudgetSet 1 1 ∧
    (FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars 1).IsPositive ∧
    Fintype.card (FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars 1).finiteOccurrences = 1 ∧
    bottleneck (FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars 1) empty = 1 ∧
    matching p (FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars 1) empty = 1 ∧
    transport p (FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars 1) empty = 1 ∧
    uniformLimits 0 0 ∧ uniformLimits 1 1
proof:
:= by
  have he : empty = FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars 0 := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    simp [empty, FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars, orderedQ]
  obtain ⟨hm, ht⟩ := FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.singleton_empty_costs hp
  have hB := FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.singleton_empty_bottleneck
  have hc : Fintype.card (FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars 1).finiteOccurrences = 1 := by
    rw [finite_card]
    simp [FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars, finitePart_orderedQ,
      List.ofFn_succ]
  have hess : essentialPart (FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars 1).points = 0 := by
    simp [FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars, essentialPart_orderedQ]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_, by simp, by simp [bottleneck_self]⟩, ?_,
    FinitePBottleneckLimitExamples.unitBars_positive 1, hc, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    uniform_limits 0 le_rfl, uniform_limits 1 (by norm_num)⟩
  · simp [empty, essentialPart_orderedQ]
  · simp [empty, essentialPart_orderedQ]
  · refine ⟨hess, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [empty, essentialPart_orderedQ]
    · simp [hc]
    · simpa only [he, ENNReal.ofReal_one] using hB.le
  · simpa only [he] using hB
  · simpa only [he, Nat.cast_one, Real.one_rpow, one_mul] using hm
  · simpa only [he, Nat.cast_one, Real.one_rpow, one_mul] using ht

name: TDA.Persistence.Diagram.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem Diagram.ext {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] {D E : Diagram α}
    (h : D.points = E.points) : D = E
proof:
:= by
  cases D; cases E; cases h; rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.ofFn_perm
statement:
private theorem ofFn_perm {β : Type*} {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → β) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) :
    (Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn (f ∘ σ))) = Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn f)
proof:
:= by
  exact Quot.sound (Equiv.Perm.ofFn_comp_perm σ f)

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_perm
statement:
theorem orderedQ_perm {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (x : Fin m → α × α) (y : Fin n → α) :
    orderedQ m n (x ∘ σ, y ∘ τ) = orderedQ m n (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  apply Diagram.ext
  simp only [orderedQ, ofFn_perm]

name: TDA.Persistence.count_ofFn
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.ofFn_eq_map]
  change (Multiset.map f (Multiset.ofList (List.finRange k))).count b = _
  rw [Multiset.count_map]
  rw [← Finset.val_univ_fin k]
  calc
    (Multiset.filter (fun a : Fin k => b = f a) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)).val).card =
        (Finset.filter (fun a : Fin k => b = f a) Finset.univ).card := by
          exact (congrArg Multiset.card
            (Finset.filter_val (p := fun a : Fin k => b = f a) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)))).symm
    _ = (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin k => f i = b)).card := by
      congr 1
      ext i
      simp [eq_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteEmbed_injective
statement:
private theorem finiteEmbed_injective {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] :
    Function.Injective (fun p : α × α => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop α)))
proof:
:= by
  intro p q h
  cases p with
  | mk a b =>
    cases q with
    | mk c d =>
      have h₁ : a = c := congrArg Prod.fst h
      have h₂ : b = d := by simpa using congrArg Prod.snd h
      simp [h₁, h₂]

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_count_finite
statement:
theorem orderedQ_count_finite {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α)) (b d : α) :
    (orderedQ m n z).points.count (b, (d : WithTop α)) =
      if b = d then 0 else
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin m => z.1 i = (b, d))).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [orderedQ, Multiset.count_add]
  have he : ((Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.2)).map
      (fun a => (a, (⊤ : WithTop α)))).count (b, (d : WithTop α)) = 0 := by
    rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero]
    intro h
    rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp h with ⟨a, _, ha⟩
    have htop : (⊤ : WithTop α) = (d : WithTop α) := congrArg Prod.snd ha
    simp at htop
  rw [he, Nat.add_zero]
  have hm := Multiset.count_map_eq_count'
      (fun p : α × α => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop α)))
      ((Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.1)).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2))
      finiteEmbed_injective (b, d)
  change _ = _ at hm
  rw [hm, Multiset.count_filter, count_ofFn]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_count_essential
statement:
theorem orderedQ_count_essential {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α)) (b : α) :
    (orderedQ m n z).points.count (b, (⊤ : WithTop α)) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin n => z.2 j = b)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [orderedQ, Multiset.count_add]
  have hf : (((Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.1)).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)).map
      (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop α)))).count (b, (⊤ : WithTop α)) = 0 := by
    rw [Multiset.count_eq_zero]
    intro h
    rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp h with ⟨p, _, hp⟩
    have htop : (p.2 : WithTop α) = ⊤ := congrArg Prod.snd hp
    simp at htop
  rw [hf, Nat.zero_add]
  have hi : Function.Injective (fun a : α => (a, (⊤ : WithTop α))) := by
    intro a c h
    exact congrArg Prod.fst h
  rw [Multiset.count_map_eq_count' (fun a : α => (a, (⊤ : WithTop α))) _ hi b]
  exact count_ofFn z.2 b

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_isPositive_iff
statement:
theorem orderedQ_isPositive_iff {α : Type u} [LinearOrder α] (m n : ℕ)
    (z : (Fin m → α × α) × (Fin n → α)) :
    (orderedQ m n z).IsPositive ↔ ∀ i, (z.1 i).1 ≤ (z.1 i).2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hp i
    by_contra hn
    have hgt : (z.1 i).2 < (z.1 i).1 := lt_of_not_ge hn
    have hmem : ((z.1 i).1, ((z.1 i).2 : WithTop α)) ∈ (orderedQ m n z).points := by
      apply Multiset.mem_add.mpr
      left
      apply Multiset.mem_map.mpr
      refine ⟨z.1 i, ?_, rfl⟩
      apply Multiset.mem_filter.mpr
      constructor
      · exact List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩
      · exact ne_of_gt hgt
    have hlt : (z.1 i).1 < (z.1 i).2 := by
      simpa using hp _ hmem
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (le_of_lt hgt)) hlt
  · intro hle p hp
    change p ∈ (orderedQ m n z).points at hp
    rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp hp with hp | hp
    · rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hp with ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
      have hqmem : q ∈ Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn z.1) := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hqmem
      have hqle : q.1 ≤ q.2 := by simpa [hi] using hle i
      have hqne : q.1 ≠ q.2 := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
      have hqlt : q.1 < q.2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hqle hqne
      simpa using hqlt
    · rcases Multiset.mem_map.mp hp with ⟨b, _, rfl⟩
      simp

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerivedOne.mem_kernel_iff_unop_mem
statement:
theorem mem_kernel_iff_unop_mem (r : R (k := k) (S := S)) :
    r ∈ J (k := k) (S := S) ↔
      MulOpposite.unop r ∈ DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  change r ∈ RingHom.ker (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S)) ↔ _
  rw [RingHom.mem_ker]
  change MulOpposite.op
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)) (MulOpposite.unop r)) = 0 ↔ _
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
        (MulOpposite.unop r) = 0 := MulOpposite.op_injective (by simpa using h)
    exact Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mp h'
  · intro h
    have h' : Ideal.Quotient.mk (DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S))
        (MulOpposite.unop r) = 0 := Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem.mpr h
    simpa using congrArg MulOpposite.op h'

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerivedOne.quotientKernel_mul_self
statement:
theorem quotientKernel_mul_self :
    J (k := k) (S := S) * J (k := k) (S := S) = J (k := k) (S := S)
proof:
:= by
  let I := DiagonalIdeal (k := k) (S := S)
  let e := diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S)
  let K := J (k := k) (S := S)
  letI : K.IsTwoSided := inferInstance
  letI : (K * K).IsTwoSided := inferInstance
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact Ideal.mul_le_right
  · intro x hx
    have he : MulOpposite.op e ∈ K := by
      apply (mem_kernel_iff_unop_mem (k := k) (S := S) (MulOpposite.op e)).2
      change e ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun z :
        FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S) ×
          FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S) => z.1 * e * z.2)
      apply Ideal.subset_span
      exact ⟨(1, 1), by simp [e]⟩
    have hxI := (mem_kernel_iff_unop_mem (k := k) (S := S) x).1 hx
    have hspan : MulOpposite.unop x ∈
        Ideal.span (Set.range fun z :
          FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S) ×
            FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S) => z.1 * e * z.2) := by
      change MulOpposite.unop x ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun z :
        FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S) ×
          FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S) =>
            z.1 * diagonalIdempotent (k := k) (S := S) * z.2) at hxI
      simpa [e] using hxI
    have htarget (a : FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S))
        (ha : a ∈ Ideal.span (Set.range fun z :
          FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S) ×
            FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.Incidence (k := k) (S := S) => z.1 * e * z.2)) :
        MulOpposite.op a ∈ K * K := by
      induction ha using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem z hz =>
        obtain ⟨⟨b, c⟩, rfl⟩ := hz
        have h₁ : MulOpposite.op c * MulOpposite.op e ∈ K :=
          Ideal.mul_mem_left K _ he
        have h₂ : MulOpposite.op e * MulOpposite.op b ∈ K :=
          Ideal.mul_mem_right (MulOpposite.op b) K he
        have hp := Ideal.mul_mem_mul h₁ h₂
        have he₂ : MulOpposite.op e * MulOpposite.op e = MulOpposite.op e := by
          exact congrArg MulOpposite.op (diagonalIdempotent_mul_self (k := k) (S := S))
        have hrepr : MulOpposite.op (b * e * c) =
            (MulOpposite.op c * MulOpposite.op e) *
              (MulOpposite.op e * MulOpposite.op b) := by
          calc
            MulOpposite.op (b * e * c) =
                MulOpposite.op c * (MulOpposite.op e * MulOpposite.op b) := by simp
            _ = MulOpposite.op c *
                ((MulOpposite.op e * MulOpposite.op e) * MulOpposite.op b) := by rw [he₂]
            _ = (MulOpposite.op c * MulOpposite.op e) *
                (MulOpposite.op e * MulOpposite.op b) := by simp [mul_assoc]
        rw [hrepr]
        exact hp
      | zero => simp
      | add a b ha hb h₁ h₂ =>
        simpa using Ideal.add_mem (K * K) h₁ h₂
      | smul r a ha h₁ =>
        change MulOpposite.op (r * a) ∈ K * K
        rw [MulOpposite.op_mul]
        exact Ideal.mul_mem_right (MulOpposite.op r) (K * K) h₁
    have hx' := htarget (MulOpposite.unop x) hspan
    simpa using hx'

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerivedOne.relation_eq_kernel_smul_top
statement:
theorem relation_eq_kernel_smul_top
    (M : ModuleCat (R (k := k) (S := S))) :
    relation (k := k) (S := S) M =
      J (k := k) (S := S) • (⊤ : Submodule (R (k := k) (S := S)) M)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.smul_mem_smul z.1.property Submodule.mem_top
  · refine Submodule.smul_le.2 ?_
    intro a ha m hm
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    exact ⟨(⟨a, ha⟩, m), rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerivedOne.kernel_smul_restricted
statement:
theorem kernel_smul_restricted
    (N : ModuleCat (C (k := k) (S := S)))
    (a : R (k := k) (S := S)) (ha : a ∈ J (k := k) (S := S))
    (n : (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N) :
    a • n = 0
proof:
:= by
  change quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) a • (n : N) = 0
  have hq : quotientHom (k := k) (S := S) a = 0 := (RingHom.mem_ker).1 ha
  rw [hq, zero_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerivedOne.relation_restricted_eq_bot
statement:
theorem relation_restricted_eq_bot
    (N : ModuleCat (C (k := k) (S := S))) :
    relation (k := k) (S := S)
        ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [relation_eq_kernel_smul_top]
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine Submodule.smul_le.2 ?_
    intro a ha n hn
    exact (Submodule.mem_bot _).2
      (kernel_smul_restricted (k := k) (S := S) N a ha n)
  · exact bot_le

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerivedOne.extension_maps_shortExact_restricted
statement:
theorem extension_maps_shortExact_restricted
    {X Y : ModuleCat (R (k := k) (S := S))}
    (N : ModuleCat (C (k := k) (S := S)))
    (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)
    (hfg : f ≫ g = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).ShortExact) :
    ((ShortComplex.mk f g hfg).map (extensionFunctor (k := k) (S := S))).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let S₀ := ShortComplex.mk f g hfg
  let E := extensionFunctor (k := k) (S := S)
  let QX := relation (k := k) (S := S) X
  let QY := relation (k := k) (S := S) Y
  let q := quotientHom (k := k) (S := S)
  have hJY_le_range :
      J (k := k) (S := S) • (⊤ : Submodule (R (k := k) (S := S)) Y) ≤
        LinearMap.range f.hom := by
    rw [hS.exact.moduleCat_range_eq_ker]
    refine Submodule.smul_le.2 ?_
    intro a ha y hy
    change g.hom (a • y) = 0
    rw [g.hom.map_smul, kernel_smul_restricted (k := k) (S := S) N a ha]
  have hJY_eq_range :
      J (k := k) (S := S) • (⊤ : Submodule (R (k := k) (S := S)) Y) =
        J (k := k) (S := S) • LinearMap.range f.hom := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · calc
        J (k := k) (S := S) • (⊤ : Submodule (R (k := k) (S := S)) Y) =
            (J (k := k) (S := S) * J (k := k) (S := S)) •
              (⊤ : Submodule (R (k := k) (S := S)) Y) := by
                rw [quotientKernel_mul_self (k := k) (S := S)]
        _ = J (k := k) (S := S) •
            (J (k := k) (S := S) • (⊤ : Submodule (R (k := k) (S := S)) Y)) :=
              Submodule.mul_smul _ _ _
        _ ≤ J (k := k) (S := S) • LinearMap.range f.hom :=
              smul_mono_right _ hJY_le_range
    · exact smul_mono_right _ le_top
  have hrelation_map : QX.map f.hom = QY := by
    rw [show QX = J (k := k) (S := S) • (⊤ : Submodule (R (k := k) (S := S)) X) from
      relation_eq_kernel_smul_top (k := k) (S := S) X]
    rw [Submodule.map_smul'', Submodule.map_top]
    rw [← hJY_eq_range]
    exact (relation_eq_kernel_smul_top (k := k) (S := S) Y).symm
  have hinj : Function.Injective f.hom :=
    (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective f).mp (show Mono f from hS.mono_f)
  have hmono : Mono ((S₀.map E).f) := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mpr (by
    intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨x₀, rfl⟩ := QX.mkQ_surjective x
    obtain ⟨y₀, rfl⟩ := QX.mkQ_surjective y
    change (extensionMap (k := k) (S := S) f).hom (QX.mkQ x₀) =
      (extensionMap (k := k) (S := S) f).hom (QX.mkQ y₀) at hxy
    rw [extensionMap_mkQ] at hxy
    have hdiff : f.hom (x₀ - y₀) ∈ QY := by
      have hh := (Submodule.Quotient.eq QY).1 hxy
      simpa only [map_sub] using hh
    have hpre : x₀ - y₀ ∈ (QX.map f.hom).comap f.hom :=
      Submodule.mem_comap.mpr (by simpa [hrelation_map] using hdiff)
    rw [Submodule.comap_map_eq_of_injective hinj] at hpre
    apply (Submodule.Quotient.eq QX).2
    exact hpre)
  have hright : (S₀.map E).Exact ∧ Epi ((S₀.map E).g) :=
    (S₀.map E).exact_and_epi_g_iff_g_is_cokernel |>.2
      ⟨CokernelCofork.mapIsColimit _ hS.gIsCokernel E⟩
  exact { exact := hright.1, mono_f := hmono, epi_g := hright.2 }

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerivedOne.extensionMappedResolution_exactAt_one
statement:
theorem extensionMappedResolution_exactAt_one
    (N : ModuleCat (C (k := k) (S := S)))
    (P : ProjectiveResolution
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N)) :
    (extensionMappedResolution (k := k) (S := S) P).ExactAt 1
proof:
:= by
  let E := extensionFunctor (k := k) (S := S)
  let p₀ := P.π.f 0
  let i := kernel.ι p₀
  let d₁₀ := P.complex.d 1 0
  let d₂₁ := P.complex.d 2 1
  let φ := kernel.lift p₀ d₁₀ P.complex_d_comp_π_f_zero
  have hp₀ : Epi p₀ := inferInstance
  have hkernelRow : (ShortComplex.mk i p₀ (kernel.condition p₀)).ShortExact := by
    exact { exact := ShortComplex.exact_kernel p₀ }
  have hEkernelRow :
      ((ShortComplex.mk i p₀ (kernel.condition p₀)).map E).ShortExact :=
    extension_maps_shortExact_restricted (k := k) (S := S) N i p₀
      (kernel.condition p₀) hkernelRow
  have hφEpi : Epi φ := P.exact₀.epi_kernelLift
  have hzero : d₂₁ ≫ φ = 0 := by
    apply (cancel_mono i).1
    calc
      d₂₁ ≫ φ ≫ i = d₂₁ ≫ d₁₀ := by
        change d₂₁ ≫ (kernel.lift p₀ d₁₀ P.complex_d_comp_π_f_zero ≫
          kernel.ι p₀) = _
        rw [kernel.lift_ι]
      _ = 0 := P.complex.d_comp_d 2 1 0
      _ = 0 ≫ i := zero_comp.symm
  let T := ShortComplex.mk d₂₁ φ hzero
  let U := ShortComplex.mk d₂₁ d₁₀ (P.complex.d_comp_d 2 1 0)
  let α : T ⟶ U :=
    { τ₁ := 𝟙 _
      τ₂ := 𝟙 _
      τ₃ := i
      comm₁₂ := by simp [T, U]
      comm₂₃ := by
        change d₁₀ = φ ≫ i
        change d₁₀ = kernel.lift p₀ d₁₀ P.complex_d_comp_π_f_zero ≫ kernel.ι p₀
        rw [kernel.lift_ι] }
  have hTExact : T.Exact :=
    (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono α).2 (P.exact_succ 0)
  have hTgEpi : Epi T.g := hφEpi
  letI : Epi T.g := hTgEpi
  have hTmapRight : (T.map E).Exact ∧ Epi ((T.map E).g) :=
    (T.map E).exact_and_epi_g_iff_g_is_cokernel |>.2
      ⟨CokernelCofork.mapIsColimit _ hTExact.gIsCokernel E⟩
  let β : T.map E ⟶ U.map E :=
    { τ₁ := 𝟙 _
      τ₂ := 𝟙 _
      τ₃ := E.map i
      comm₁₂ := by
        change 𝟙 _ ≫ E.map d₂₁ = E.map d₂₁ ≫ 𝟙 _
        simp only [Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
      comm₂₃ := by
        change 𝟙 _ ≫ E.map d₁₀ = E.map φ ≫ E.map i
        rw [Category.id_comp, ← E.map_comp]
        change E.map d₁₀ = E.map
          (kernel.lift p₀ d₁₀ P.complex_d_comp_π_f_zero ≫ kernel.ι p₀)
        rw [kernel.lift_ι] }
  have hEimono : Mono (E.map i) := hEkernelRow.mono_f
  letI : Mono (E.map i) := hEimono
  have hβEpi : Epi β.τ₁ := by
    change Epi (𝟙 (T.map E).X₁)
    infer_instance
  letI : Epi β.τ₁ := hβEpi
  have hβIso : IsIso β.τ₂ := by
    change IsIso (𝟙 (T.map E).X₂)
    infer_instance
  letI : IsIso β.τ₂ := hβIso
  have hβMono : Mono β.τ₃ := by
    change Mono (E.map i)
    exact hEimono
  letI : Mono β.τ₃ := hβMono
  have hUmapExact : (U.map E).Exact :=
    (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono β).1 hTmapRight.1
  change ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj P.complex).ExactAt 1
  rw [HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff' _ 2 1 0 (by simp) (by simp)]
  change (U.map E).Exact
  exact hUmapExact

name: TDA.Persistence.IncidenceQuotientDerivedOne.extension_leftDerived_one_isZero
statement:
theorem extension_leftDerived_one_isZero
    (N : ModuleCat (C (k := k) (S := S))) :
    IsZero (((extensionFunctor (k := k) (S := S)).leftDerived 1).obj
      ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N))
proof:
:= by
  let E := extensionFunctor (k := k) (S := S)
  let M := (ModuleCat.restrictScalars (quotientHom (k := k) (S := S))).obj N
  let P := ProjectiveResolution.of M
  have hExact := extensionMappedResolution_exactAt_one (k := k) (S := S) N P
  have hHomology : IsZero (P.complex |> fun K =>
      ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj K).homology 1) := by
    rw [← HomologicalComplex.exactAt_iff_isZero_homology]
    exact hExact
  exact IsZero.of_iso hHomology (P.isoLeftDerivedObj E 1)

theorem extension_leftDerived_one_isZero_zero :

        (ModuleCat.of (C (k := k) (S := S)) PUnit)))
proof:
:=
  extension_leftDerived_one_isZero (k := k) (S := S)
    (ModuleCat.of (C (k := k) (S := S)) PUnit)

name: TDA.Persistence.TotalPersistenceRipsCechExamples.triangle_cech_radius_le_three
statement:
private theorem triangle_cech_radius_le_three :
    Cech.radiusAt Triangle.pts (Triangle.pts 0) Finset.univ ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cech.radiusAt_le_iff]
  constructor
  · norm_num
  · intro v hv
    fin_cases v
    · simp
    · exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num [Triangle.pts, Triangle.pts_zero, Triangle.pts_one])
    · exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num [Triangle.pts, Triangle.pts_zero, Triangle.pts_one, Triangle.pts_two])

proof:
:= by
  calc
    (finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter Triangle.pts) 1).points).card ≤
        Nat.card (Face (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 3)) (1 + 1)) :=
      card_finitePart_dgm_le (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter Triangle.pts) 1
    _ = Nat.choose (Fintype.card (Fin 3)) ((1 + 1) + 1) :=
      card_face_fullComplex (V := Fin 3) (n := 1 + 1)
    _ = 1 := by norm_num [Nat.choose]

name: TDA.Persistence.TotalPersistenceRipsCechExamples.triangle_cech_totalPersistence_one_le
statement:

    (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter Triangle.pts) 1).totalPersistence 1 ≤ 3
proof:
:= by
  have htotal := Cech.totalPersistence_dgm_le_radiusAt
    (k := ZMod 2) Triangle.pts (Triangle.pts 0) 1 1

name: TDA.Persistence.TotalPersistenceRipsCechExamples.triangle_card_finitePart_two_eq_zero
statement:
theorem triangle_card_finitePart_two_eq_zero :
    (finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter Triangle.pts) 2).points).card = 0 ∧
      (finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter Triangle.metric) 2).points).card = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hcech :
      (finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter Triangle.pts) 2).points).card ≤ 0 := by
    calc
      (finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter Triangle.pts) 2).points).card ≤
          Nat.card (Face (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 3)) (2 + 1)) :=
        card_finitePart_dgm_le (ZMod 2) (Cech.filter Triangle.pts) 2
      _ = Nat.choose (Fintype.card (Fin 3)) ((2 + 1) + 1) :=
        card_face_fullComplex (V := Fin 3) (n := 2 + 1)
      _ = 0 := by norm_num [Nat.choose]
  have hrips :
      (finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter Triangle.metric) 2).points).card ≤ 0 := by
    calc
      (finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter Triangle.metric) 2).points).card ≤
          Nat.card (Face (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 3)) (2 + 1)) :=
        card_finitePart_dgm_le (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter Triangle.metric) 2
      _ = Nat.choose (Fintype.card (Fin 3)) ((2 + 1) + 1) :=
        card_face_fullComplex (V := Fin 3) (n := 2 + 1)
      _ = 0 := by norm_num [Nat.choose]
  exact ⟨Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hcech, Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero hrips⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.TotalPersistenceRipsCechExamples.repeated_cech_radius_zero

    Cech.radiusAt Repeated.pts (0 : ℝ) (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) = 0

:= by

  · rw [Cech.radiusAt_le_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.TotalPersistenceRipsCechExamples.repeated_cech_finitePart_eq_zero

proof:

  intro x hx

    (k := ZMod 2) Repeated.pts (0 : ℝ) n).1 x hx
  rw [repeated_cech_radius_zero] at hcoord
  linarith [hcoord.1, hcoord.2.1, hcoord.2.2]

name: TDA.Persistence.TotalPersistenceRipsCechExamples.twoPoints_rips_totalPersistence_zero
statement:
theorem twoPoints_rips_totalPersistence_zero :
    (dgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric) 0).totalPersistence 0 = 1 ∧
      (dgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric) 0).totalPersistence 0 =
        Fintype.card (dgm (ZMod 2) (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric) 0).finiteOccurrences
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationPullbackExamples.identityQuotient_rankExact
statement:
private theorem identityQuotient_rankExact
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (hM : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) M) :
    IsRankExact (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) ⟶ M) (𝟙 M)
proof:
:= by
  letI : ∀ p : P, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) :=
    fun p => GradedFree.finitelyPresented_finiteDimensional M hM p
  have hs : IsPointwiseShortExact (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) ⟶ M) (𝟙 M) := by
    constructor
    · intro p x y _
      exact (ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (Functor.zero_obj p)).elim _ _
    · intro p x
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    · intro p
      simp
  exact hs.rankExact_of_section (𝟙 M) (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationPullbackExamples.arbitrary_field_repeated_extension_and_pullback
statement:
theorem arbitrary_field_repeated_extension_and_pullback
    {k : Type u} [Field k] :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented ∧
      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (Limits.pullback (𝟙 (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented)
          (𝟙 (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented)) ∧
      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (Limits.kernel (Limits.pullback.snd
          (𝟙 (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented)
          (𝟙 (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented))) ∧
      IsRankExact
        (Limits.kernel.ι (Limits.pullback.snd
          (𝟙 (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented)
          (𝟙 (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented)))
        (Limits.pullback.snd
          (𝟙 (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented)
          (𝟙 (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented)) ∧
      ∃ x : (Limits.pullback
          (𝟙 (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented)
          (𝟙 (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented)).obj
          ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2).grade (0 : Fin 2)),
        x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let D := FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2
  have hD : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ) D.presented :=
    D.finitelyPresented (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation_finite k 2)
  have hs : IsRankExact (0 : (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)) ⟶ D.presented)
      (𝟙 D.presented) := identityQuotient_rankExact hD
  have hMiddle := hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact.finitelyPresented_middle
    zero_finitelyPresented hD
  have hPullback := hs.pullback_finitelyPresented (𝟙 D.presented)
    zero_finitelyPresented hD
  let p := (FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2).grade (0 : Fin 2)
  let x := PullbackFiber.mk (𝟙 D.presented) (𝟙 D.presented) p
    (FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2)
    (FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2) (by simp)
  have hx : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have he := congrArg ((Limits.pullback.fst (𝟙 D.presented) (𝟙 D.presented)).app p).hom h
    have hz : FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2 = 0 := by
      simpa [x, PullbackFiber.fst_mk] using he
    exact FinitePresentationKanExamples.surviving_generator 2 hz
  exact ⟨hMiddle, hPullback.1, hPullback.2.1, hPullback.2.2, ⟨x, hx⟩⟩

        (𝟙 (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ))))) ∧

        (𝟙 (0 : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin 2 → ℝ)))

private theorem relationMap_generator {k : Type u} [Field k] (p : Fin 2 → ℝ)
    (h : (FinitePresentationKanExamples.relations 2).grade () ≤ p) :
    (((FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).relationMap.app p).hom
      (GradedFree.generator (R := k) (FinitePresentationKanExamples.relations 2) () h)).val =
      Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : k)
proof:
:= by
  have he := GradedFree.fiberLift_generator (R := k) (FinitePresentationKanExamples.relations 2) p
    (fun g => structureMapLinear (GradedFree.module (R := k) (FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2))
      g.property (GradedFree.generator (R := k) (FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2)
        (0 : Fin 2) generator_le_relation)) () h

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationPullbackExamples.relationMap_injective
proof:
:= by
  let D := FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2
  let Y := FinitePresentationKanExamples.relations 2
  let f₁ : GradedFree.fiber (R := k) Y p →ₗ[k] k :=
    (Finsupp.lapply (0 : Fin 2)) ∘ₗ
      (GradedFree.fiber (R := k) (FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2) p).subtype ∘ₗ
        (D.relationMap.app p).hom
  let f₂ : GradedFree.fiber (R := k) Y p →ₗ[k] k :=
    (Finsupp.lapply ()) ∘ₗ (GradedFree.fiber (R := k) Y p).subtype
  have h₁ := GradedFree.fiberLift_unique (R := k) Y p (fun _ => (1 : k)) f₁ (by
    intro g h
    cases g
    change (((D.relationMap.app p).hom (GradedFree.generator (R := k) Y () h)).val) (0 : Fin 2) = 1
    rw [relationMap_generator p h]
    exact Finsupp.single_eq_same)
  have h₂ := GradedFree.fiberLift_unique (R := k) Y p (fun _ => (1 : k)) f₂ (by
    intro g h
    cases g
    change (Finsupp.single () (1 : k)) () = 1
    rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same])
  intro x y hxy
  have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun (h₁.trans h₂.symm) x
  have hy := LinearMap.congr_fun (h₁.trans h₂.symm) y
  have hcoeff : x.val () = y.val () := by
    change f₂ x = f₂ y
    rw [← hx, ← hy]
    change ((D.relationMap.app p).hom x).val (0 : Fin 2) =
      ((D.relationMap.app p).hom y).val (0 : Fin 2)
    rw [hxy]
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Finsupp.ext
  intro u
  cases u
  exact hcoeff

statement:
private theorem relationRow_shortExact {k : Type u} [Field k] :
    IsPointwiseShortExact (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).relationMap
      (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover where
  injective
proof:
:= relationMap_injective
  surjective p := (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover_surjective p
  range_eq_ker p := by
    have h := (ShortComplex.exact_cokernel
      (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).relationMap).map_of_epi_of_preservesCokernel
        ((evaluation (Fin 2 → ℝ) (ModuleCat.{u} k)).obj p) inferInstance inferInstance
    exact h.moduleCat_range_eq_ker

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationPullbackExamples.arbitrary_field_relation_row_extension_and_pullback
statement:
theorem arbitrary_field_relation_row_extension_and_pullback {k : Type u} [Field k] :
    (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).relationMap ≠ 0 ∧
      (∃ x : (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).presented.obj
        ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2).grade (0 : Fin 2)), x ≠ 0) ∧
      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (GradedFree.module (R := k) (FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2)) ∧
      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (Limits.pullback (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover
          (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover) ∧
      ∃ x : (Limits.pullback (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover
          (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover).obj
          ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.relations 2).grade ()),
        ((Limits.pullback.fst (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover
            (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover).app
            ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.relations 2).grade ())).hom x ≠
          ((Limits.pullback.snd (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover
            (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2).cover).app
            ((FinitePresentationKanExamples.relations 2).grade ())).hom x
proof:
:= by
  let D := FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation k 2
  let Y := FinitePresentationKanExamples.relations 2
  let W := FinitePresentationKanExamples.generators 2
  have hs := relationRow_shortExact (k := k)
  have hY : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ) (GradedFree.module (R := k) Y) :=
    GradedFree.free_finitelyPresented Y
  have hW : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ) (GradedFree.module (R := k) W) :=
    GradedFree.free_finitelyPresented W
  have hD : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin 2 → ℝ) D.presented :=
    D.finitelyPresented (FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation_finite k 2)
  let q := Y.grade ()
  let g : (GradedFree.module (R := k) D.generators).obj q :=
    GradedFree.generator (R := k) W (0 : Fin 2) generator_le_relation
  have hg : g ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have he := congrArg (fun z : (GradedFree.module (R := k) D.generators).obj q =>
      z.val (0 : Fin 2)) h
    change (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : k)) 0 = 0 at he
    rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same] at he
    exact one_ne_zero he
  have hgdies : (D.cover.app q).hom g = (D.cover.app q).hom 0 := by
    rw [map_zero]
    have hv := congrArg (fun α : GradedFree.module (R := k) Y ⟶ D.presented =>
      (α.app q).hom (GradedFree.birth (R := k) Y ())) D.relations_vanish
    change (D.cover.app q).hom ((D.relationMap.app q).hom
      (GradedFree.generator (R := k) Y () le_rfl)) = 0 at hv
    have hr : (D.relationMap.app q).hom (GradedFree.generator (R := k) Y () le_rfl) = g :=
      Subtype.ext (relationMap_generator q le_rfl)
    rwa [hr] at hv
  refine ⟨FinitePresentationKanExamples.relation_nonzero k 2,
    ⟨FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue k 2,
      FinitePresentationKanExamples.surviving_generator 2⟩,
    hs.finitelyPresented_middle hY hD,
    hs.finitelyPresented_pullback D.cover hY hW, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨PullbackFiber.mk D.cover D.cover q g 0 hgdies, ?_⟩
  intro h
  have h₁ := PullbackFiber.fst_mk D.cover D.cover q g 0 hgdies
  have h₂ := PullbackFiber.snd_mk D.cover D.cover q g 0 hgdies
  exact hg (h₁.symm.trans (h.trans h₂))

    have : Subsingleton ((RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) p).obj t) := by

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleavingExamples.interval_map_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x : RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) p s := ⟨1, by simp [RealBarcode.fiber, hs]⟩
  have hcoeff : (show RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) p t from
      (structureMap (RealBarcode.intervalModule p) h).hom x).val = 1 := by
    change (((if hp : RealBarcode.alive p s ∧ RealBarcode.alive p t then
        Submodule.inclusion (show RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) p s ≤ RealBarcode.fiber p t by
          simp [RealBarcode.fiber, hp.1, hp.2]) else 0) x)).val = 1
    rw [dif_pos ⟨hs, ht⟩]
    rfl
  intro heq
  have hx := congrArg (fun f : (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) p).obj s ⟶
      (RealBarcode.intervalModule p).obj t =>
      (show RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) p t from f.hom x).val) heq
  rw [hcoeff] at hx
  exact one_ne_zero hx

theorem open_closed_interval_distance_zero (R : Type*) [Ring R] (n : ℕ) :
    realInterleavingDistance
      (sublevelModule R (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace OpenInterval)) n)
      (sublevelModule R (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace ClosedInterval)) n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty OpenInterval := ⟨⟨1 / 2, by norm_num⟩⟩
  let : Nonempty ClosedInterval := ⟨⟨0, by norm_num⟩⟩
  have hX : TotallyBounded (range (Subtype.val : OpenInterval → ℝ)) := by
    rw [open_range]
    exact isCompact_Icc.totallyBounded.subset Ioo_subset_Icc_self
  have hY : TotallyBounded (range (Subtype.val : ClosedInterval → ℝ)) := by
    rw [closed_range]
    exact isCompact_Icc.totallyBounded
  have h := Rips.realInterleavingDistance_le_two_mul_hausdorffDist_of_totallyBounded R
    (subtype_isometry (Ioo 0 1)) (subtype_isometry (Icc 0 1)) hX hY n
  exact nonpos_iff_eq_zero.mp (by simpa only [interval_hausdorffDist, mul_zero,
    ENNReal.ofReal_zero] using h)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.sampledEndpoint_succ
statement:
theorem sampledEndpoint_succ (e : ℕ) (he : 0 < e) (hen : e ≤ n + 1) :
    sampledEndpoint (Fin.succOrderEmb n).toOrderHom e = e - 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold sampledEndpoint
  have hset : Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ((Fin.succOrderEmb n) i).val < e) =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => i.val < e - 1) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    change i.val + 1 < e ↔ i.val < e - 1
    omega
  change (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ((Fin.succOrderEmb n) i).val < e)).card = e - 1
  rw [hset, Fin.card_filter_val_lt, Nat.min_eq_right (by omega)]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.restrictAlong_succ
statement:
theorem restrictAlong_succ (I : FiniteInterval (n + 1)) (hb : 0 < I.birth) :
    I.restrictAlong (Fin.succOrderEmb n).toOrderHom = some (dropZero I hb)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < I.death := hb.trans I.birth_lt_death
  have hbn : I.birth ≤ n + 1 := Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_of_lt I.birth_lt_death) I.death_le_size
  simp only [FiniteInterval.restrictAlong, sampledEndpoint_succ I.birth hb hbn,
    sampledEndpoint_succ I.death hd I.death_le_size]
  have hlt : I.birth - 1 < I.death - 1 := by have := I.birth_lt_death; omega
  simp only [dif_pos hlt]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.critical_le_iff
statement:
private theorem critical_le_iff (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    c i ≤ t ↔ i.val + 1 ≤ (FiniteConstructible.cellIndex c t).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [← FiniteConstructible.lt_cellIndex_iff]
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.lt_critical_iff
statement:
private theorem lt_critical_iff (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    t < c i ↔ (FiniteConstructible.cellIndex c t).val ≤ i.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [← not_le, critical_le_iff]
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.alive_endpoints_dropZero
statement:
theorem alive_endpoints_dropZero (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (I : FiniteInterval (n + 1)) (hb : 0 < I.birth) (t : ℝ) :
    alive (endpoints c (dropZero I hb)) t ↔
      I.alive (FiniteConstructible.cellIndex c t)
proof:
:= by
  have hbd := I.birth_lt_death
  have hdn := I.death_le_size
  have hq := (FiniteConstructible.cellIndex c t).isLt
  dsimp only [alive, endpoints, dropZero, FiniteInterval.alive]
  split_ifs with hd
  · rw [WithTop.coe_lt_coe, critical_le_iff, lt_critical_iff]
    dsimp only
    omega
  · simp only [WithTop.coe_lt_top, and_true]
    rw [critical_le_iff]
    dsimp only
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.endpoints_dropZero_finite
statement:
theorem endpoints_dropZero_finite (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (I : FiniteInterval (n + 1)) (hb : 0 < I.birth) (hd : I.death ≤ n) :
    (endpoints c (dropZero I hb)).2 =
      (c ⟨I.death - 1, by have := I.birth_lt_death; omega⟩ : WithTop ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : I.death - 1 < n := by have := I.birth_lt_death; omega
  simp [endpoints, dropZero, hlt]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.endpoints_dropZero_essential
statement:
theorem endpoints_dropZero_essential (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (I : FiniteInterval (n + 1)) (hb : 0 < I.birth) (hd : I.death = n + 1) :
    (endpoints c (dropZero I hb)).2 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  simp [endpoints, dropZero, hd]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.reindexBarcode_succ_card
statement:
theorem reindexBarcode_succ_card (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval (n + 1)))
    (hB : ∀ I ∈ B, 0 < I.birth) :
    (reindexBarcode (Fin.succOrderEmb n).toOrderHom B).card = B.card
proof:
:= by
  revert hB
  induction B using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => intro _; rfl
  | @cons I B ih =>
    intro hB
    have hI := hB I (Multiset.mem_cons_self I B)
    have htail : ∀ J ∈ B, 0 < J.birth := fun J hJ => hB J (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hJ)
    simp only [reindexBarcode, Multiset.filterMap_cons_some _ _ _ (restrictAlong_succ I hI),
      Multiset.card_cons]
    exact congrArg (· + 1) (ih htail)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.pointEnumeration_points
statement:
private theorem pointEnumeration_points (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval (n + 1))) (hB : ∀ I ∈ B, 0 < I.birth) :
    (ofIndexBars c c.strictMono (reindexBarcode (Fin.succOrderEmb n).toOrderHom B)).points =
      (pointEnumeration c B hB : Multiset _)
proof:
:= by
  let f (I : FiniteInterval (n + 1)) :=
    (I.restrictAlong (Fin.succOrderEmb n).toOrderHom).map (endpoints c)
  let p (i : Fin B.toList.length) := endpoints c
    (dropZero (B.toList.get i) (hB _ (Multiset.mem_toList.mp (List.get_mem B.toList i))))
  have hf (i : Fin B.toList.length) : f (B.toList.get i) = some (p i) := by
    dsimp [f, p]
    rw [restrictAlong_succ]
    rfl
  have hlist : B.toList.filterMap f = List.ofFn p := by
    calc
      B.toList.filterMap f = (List.finRange B.toList.length).filterMap
          (fun i => f (B.toList.get i)) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [← List.ofFn_get B.toList, List.ofFn_eq_map]
        rw [List.filterMap_map]
        rfl
      _ = (List.finRange B.toList.length).map p :=
        List.filterMap_eq_map_iff_forall_eq_some.mpr (fun i _ => hf i)
      _ = List.ofFn p := List.ofFn_eq_map.symm
  rw [ofIndexBars_points, reindexBarcode, Multiset.map_filterMap]
  change Multiset.filterMap f B = (List.ofFn p : Multiset _)
  calc
    Multiset.filterMap f B = Multiset.filterMap f (B.toList : Multiset _) :=
      congrArg (Multiset.filterMap f) (Multiset.coe_toList B).symm
    _ = (B.toList.filterMap f : Multiset _) := rfl
    _ = (List.ofFn p : Multiset _) := congrArg (fun xs : List (ℝ × WithTop ℝ) => (xs : Multiset (ℝ × WithTop ℝ))) hlist

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.essentialSignedPrimitive_sub
statement:
theorem essentialSignedPrimitive_sub (hM : M.QTame) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    essentialSignedPrimitive M b - essentialSignedPrimitive M a =
      (essentialMeasureValue M hab : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : 0 ≤ a
  · have hb : 0 ≤ b := ha.trans hab
    have h := PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_split_birth M hM ha hab
    simp only [essentialSignedPrimitive, dif_pos ha, dif_pos hb]
    omega
  · by_cases hb : 0 ≤ b
    · have ha0 : a ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge ha
      have h := PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_split_birth M hM ha0 hb
      simp only [essentialSignedPrimitive, dif_neg ha, dif_pos hb]
      omega
    · have hb0 : b ≤ 0 := le_of_not_ge hb
      have h := PModule.QTame.essentialMeasureValue_split_birth M hM hab hb0
      simp only [essentialSignedPrimitive, dif_neg ha, dif_neg hb]
      omega

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.preimage_cutCell_minusCut
statement:
theorem preimage_cutCell_minusCut (a b : ℝ) :
    minusCut ⁻¹' cutCell a b = Ioc a b
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  simp [cutCell, minusCut]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.preimage_mem_intervals
statement:
private theorem preimage_mem_intervals {U : Set (Cut ℝ)} (hU : U ∈ cutCells) :
    minusCut ⁻¹' U ∈ {s : Set ℝ | ∃ a b, a ≤ b ∧ s = Ioc a b}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := hU
  exact ⟨a, b, hab, preimage_cutCell_minusCut a b⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.essentialSignedContent_apply
statement:
theorem essentialSignedContent_apply (hM : M.QTame) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    essentialSignedContent M (cutCell a b) = (essentialMeasureValue M hab : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  change AddContent.onIoc (essentialSignedPrimitive M) (minusCut ⁻¹' cutCell a b) = _
  rw [preimage_cutCell_minusCut, AddContent.onIoc_apply hab, essentialSignedPrimitive_sub M hM hab]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.essentialSignedContent_nonneg
statement:
theorem essentialSignedContent_nonneg (hM : M.QTame) (U : Set (Cut ℝ)) (hU : U ∈ cutCells) :
    0 ≤ essentialSignedContent M U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, hab, rfl⟩ := hU
  rw [essentialSignedContent_apply M hM hab]
  exact Int.natCast_nonneg _

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.essentialCutContent_apply
statement:
theorem essentialCutContent_apply (hM : M.QTame) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    essentialCutContent M hM (cutCell a b) = essentialMeasureValue M hab
proof:
:= by
  change (essentialSignedContent M (cutCell a b)).toNat = _
  rw [essentialSignedContent_apply M hM hab]
  exact Int.toNat_natCast _

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.pullbackInclusion_fst
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pullbackInclusion_fst (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) (f : T ⟶ N) :
    hs.pullbackInclusion f ≫ Limits.pullback.fst π f = ι
proof:
:=
  Limits.pullback.lift_fst _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.pullbackInclusion_snd
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pullbackInclusion_snd (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) (f : T ⟶ N) :
    hs.pullbackInclusion f ≫ Limits.pullback.snd π f = 0
proof:
:=
  Limits.pullback.lift_snd _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.pullback_pointwise
statement:
theorem pullback_pointwise (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) (f : T ⟶ N) :
    IsPointwiseShortExact (hs.pullbackInclusion f) (Limits.pullback.snd π f) where
  injective p
proof:
:= by
    intro x y hxy
    have hfst := congrArg ((Limits.pullback.fst π f).app p).hom hxy
    have hcomp : (hs.pullbackInclusion f ≫ Limits.pullback.fst π f).app p =
        (ι.app p) := by simp
    have hx := congrArg (fun g : L.obj p ⟶ M.obj p => g.hom x) hcomp
    have hy := congrArg (fun g : L.obj p ⟶ M.obj p => g.hom y) hcomp
    apply hs.injective p
    calc
      (ι.app p).hom x =
          ((Limits.pullback.fst π f).app p).hom
            (((hs.pullbackInclusion f).app p).hom x) := hx.symm
      _ = ((Limits.pullback.fst π f).app p).hom
          (((hs.pullbackInclusion f).app p).hom y) := hfst
      _ = (ι.app p).hom y := hy
  surjective p t := by
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hs.surjective p ((f.app p).hom t)
    exact ⟨PullbackFiber.mk π f p m t hm, PullbackFiber.snd_mk π f p m t hm⟩
  range_eq_ker p := by
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
      have hcomp := congrArg (fun g : L ⟶ T => (g.app p).hom x)
        (hs.pullbackInclusion_snd f)
      change ((Limits.pullback.snd π f).app p).hom
        (((hs.pullbackInclusion f).app p).hom x) = 0
      have hcomp' : ((Limits.pullback.snd π f).app p).hom
          (((hs.pullbackInclusion f).app p).hom x) =
            ((0 : L ⟶ T).app p).hom x := by
        simpa only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply] using hcomp
      exact hcomp'.trans (by simp)
    · intro hy
      change ((Limits.pullback.snd π f).app p).hom y = 0 at hy
      have hπy : (π.app p).hom (((Limits.pullback.fst π f).app p).hom y) = 0 := by
        have h := congrArg (fun g : Limits.pullback π f ⟶ N => (g.app p).hom y)
          (Limits.pullback.condition (f := π) (g := f))
        change (π.app p).hom (((Limits.pullback.fst π f).app p).hom y) =
          (f.app p).hom (((Limits.pullback.snd π f).app p).hom y) at h
        rw [hy] at h
        simpa using h
      have hmem : ((Limits.pullback.fst π f).app p).hom y ∈
          LinearMap.range (ι.app p).hom := by
        exact (hs.range_eq_ker p).symm ▸ (LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hπy)
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hmem
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      apply PullbackFiber.element_ext π f p
      ·
        have hcomp := congrArg (fun g : L ⟶ M => (g.app p).hom x)
          (hs.pullbackInclusion_fst f)
        calc
          ((Limits.pullback.fst π f).app p).hom
              (((hs.pullbackInclusion f).app p).hom x) = (ι.app p).hom x := by
            simpa only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply] using hcomp
          _ = ((Limits.pullback.fst π f).app p).hom y := hx
      ·
        have hcomp := congrArg (fun g : L ⟶ T => (g.app p).hom x)
          (hs.pullbackInclusion_snd f)
        simpa only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply] using
          (hcomp.trans hy.symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.finitelyPresented_middle
statement:
theorem IsPointwiseShortExact.finitelyPresented_middle
    (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π)
    (hL : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) L)
    (hN : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) N) :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨E, hE, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hN
  letI : Finite E.generators.Carrier := hE.1
  letI : Finite E.relations.Carrier := hE.2
  let Q := module (R := k) E.generators
  let c : Q ⟶ N := E.cover ≫ e.hom
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := GradedFree.exists_lift_of_surjective
    (R := k) E.generators π hs.surjective c
  let s : Q ⟶ Limits.pullback π c :=
    Limits.pullback.lift b (𝟙 Q) (by simpa [c] using hb)
  have hssec : s ≫ Limits.pullback.snd π c = 𝟙 Q := by
    change Limits.pullback.lift b (𝟙 Q) _ ≫ Limits.pullback.snd π c = 𝟙 Q
    rw [Limits.pullback.lift_snd]
  let hpb := hs.pullback_pointwise c
  let S : ShortComplex (PModule.{u,0,u} k P) :=
    ShortComplex.mk (hs.pullbackInclusion c) (Limits.pullback.snd π c)
      hpb.comp_eq_zero
  have hS : S.ShortExact := by
    simpa [S] using hpb.shortExact
  let splitIso : Limits.pullback π c ≅ L ⊞ Q :=
    ShortComplex.Splitting.isoBinaryBiproduct
      (ShortComplex.Splitting.ofExactOfSection S hS.exact s hssec hS.mono_f)
  have hQ : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) Q := by
    change FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P)
      (module (R := k) E.generators)
    exact GradedFree.free_finitelyPresented E.generators
  have hPullback :
      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) (Limits.pullback π c) :=
    finitelyPresented_of_iso (finitelyPresented_biprod hL hQ) splitIso.symm
  let A := module (R := k) E.relations
  have hA : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) A := by
    change FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P)
      (module (R := k) E.relations)
    exact GradedFree.free_finitelyPresented E.relations
  have hrelPB : (0 : A ⟶ M) ≫ π = E.relationMap ≫ c := by
    rw [zero_comp, ← Category.assoc, E.relations_vanish]
    simp
  let r : A ⟶ Limits.pullback π c :=
    Limits.pullback.lift (f := π) (g := c) 0 E.relationMap hrelPB
  have hrSnd : r ≫ Limits.pullback.snd π c = E.relationMap :=
    Limits.pullback.lift_snd (f := π) (g := c) 0 E.relationMap hrelPB
  let q : Limits.pullback π c ⟶ M := Limits.pullback.fst π c
  have hrq : r ≫ q = 0 := by
    change Limits.pullback.lift 0 E.relationMap _ ≫ Limits.pullback.fst π c = 0
    rw [Limits.pullback.lift_fst]
  let C : ShortComplex (PModule.{u,0,u} k P) := ShortComplex.mk r q hrq
  have hKernelLift : ∀ p,
      Function.Surjective ((kernel.lift q r hrq).app p).hom := by
    intro p z
    let y := ((kernel.ι q).app p).hom z
    let t := ((Limits.pullback.snd π c).app p).hom y
    have hyq : (q.app p).hom y = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun g : kernel q ⟶ M => (g.app p).hom z)
        (kernel.condition q)
      change (q.app p).hom (((kernel.ι q).app p).hom z) = 0 at h
      exact h
    have hfst : ((Limits.pullback.fst π c).app p).hom y = 0 := by
      simpa [q] using hyq
    have hcy : (c.app p).hom t = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun g : Limits.pullback π c ⟶ N => (g.app p).hom y)
        (Limits.pullback.condition (f := π) (g := c))
      change (π.app p).hom (((Limits.pullback.fst π c).app p).hom y) =
        (c.app p).hom (((Limits.pullback.snd π c).app p).hom y) at h
      calc
        (c.app p).hom t = (π.app p).hom (((Limits.pullback.fst π c).app p).hom y) := by
          simpa [t] using h.symm
        _ = 0 := by rw [hfst]; simp
    have hcoverzero : (E.cover.app p).hom t = 0 := by
      have hinj : Function.Injective (e.hom.app p).hom :=
        (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance
      have hezero : (e.hom.app p).hom ((E.cover.app p).hom t) = 0 := by
        simpa only [c, NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply] using hcy
      exact hinj (by simpa using hezero)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (E.cover_eq_zero_iff_mem_relation_range p t).mp hcoverzero
    have hrx : (r.app p).hom x = y := by
      apply PullbackFiber.element_ext π c p
      · have h := congrArg (fun g : A ⟶ M => (g.app p).hom x) hrq
        have hfst_r : ((Limits.pullback.fst π c).app p).hom ((r.app p).hom x) = 0 := by
          simpa [q, NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply] using h
        calc
          ((Limits.pullback.fst π c).app p).hom ((r.app p).hom x) = 0 := hfst_r
          _ = ((Limits.pullback.fst π c).app p).hom y := hfst.symm
      · have h := congrArg (fun g : A ⟶ Q => (g.app p).hom x) hrSnd
        calc
          ((Limits.pullback.snd π c).app p).hom ((r.app p).hom x) =
              (E.relationMap.app p).hom x := by
                simpa only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply] using h
          _ = t := hx
          _ = ((Limits.pullback.snd π c).app p).hom y := rfl
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    apply RankKernel.injective q p
    calc
      ((kernel.ι q).app p).hom (((kernel.lift q r hrq).app p).hom x) =
          (r.app p).hom x := by
            have h := congrArg (fun g : A ⟶ Limits.pullback π c => (g.app p).hom x)
              (kernel.lift_ι q r hrq)
            simpa only [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply] using h
      _ = y := hrx
  have hEpi : Epi (kernel.lift q r hrq) :=
    (NatTrans.epi_iff_epi_app _).2 (fun p =>
      (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).2 (hKernelLift p))
  have hExact : C.Exact := C.exact_iff_epi_kernel_lift.mpr hEpi
  letI : Epi E.cover := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π E.relationMap)
    infer_instance
  letI : Epi e.hom := inferInstance
  letI : Epi c := by
    dsimp [c]
    infer_instance
  have hqEpi : Epi q := by
    change Epi (Limits.pullback.fst π c)
    infer_instance
  letI : Epi C.g := by
    change Epi q
    exact hqEpi
  have cokerIso : Limits.cokernel r ≅ M :=
    (cokernelIsCokernel r).coconePointUniqueUpToIso hExact.gIsCokernel
  have hCoker :
      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) (Limits.cokernel r) :=
    finitelyPresented_cokernel r hA hPullback
  exact finitelyPresented_of_iso hCoker cokerIso

name: TDA.Persistence.ModuleScalingExamples.twoPoints_value_le_two
statement:
private theorem twoPoints_value_le_two (σ : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 2))) :
    (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).value σ ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rips.filter_value]
  have hsub : σ.val ⊆ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2)) := by
    intro v hv
    fin_cases v <;> simp
  calc
    Rips.diameter TwoPoints.metric σ.val ≤ Rips.diameter TwoPoints.metric {0, 1} :=
      Rips.diameter_mono _ hsub
    _ = 2 := by rw [Rips.diameter_pair, TwoPoints.metric_dist, TwoPoints.dist_pts]

name: TDA.Persistence.ModuleScalingExamples.twoPoints_scaled_value_difference_le
statement:
private theorem twoPoints_scaled_value_difference_le
    (σ : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 2))) :
    |(Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).value σ -
        ((Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).scale 2 two_pos).value σ| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  let v := (Rips.filter TwoPoints.metric).value σ
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ v := by
    dsimp [v]
    exact Rips.diameter_nonneg _ _
  have hv2 : v ≤ 2 := twoPoints_value_le_two σ
  rw [FilterFunction.scale_value]
  change |v - 2 * v| ≤ 2
  rw [show v - 2 * v = -v by ring, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hv0]
  exact hv2

name: TDA.Persistence.ModuleScalingExamples.scaleOne_distance
statement:
theorem scaleOne_distance (M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    realInterleavingDistance (PModule.scale 1 one_pos M) (PModule.scale 1 one_pos N) =
      realInterleavingDistance M N
proof:
:= by
  rw [realInterleavingDistance_scale 1 one_pos, ENNReal.ofReal_one, one_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.ModuleScalingExamples.scaleOne_distance_of_iso
statement:
theorem scaleOne_distance_of_iso (M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    realInterleavingDistance (PModule.scale 1 one_pos M) (PModule.scale 1 one_pos N) =
      realInterleavingDistance M N
proof:
:=
  realInterleavingDistance_congr (PModule.scaleOneIso M) (PModule.scaleOneIso N)

name: TDA.Persistence.ModuleScalingExamples.scaleOne_moduleDiagram
statement:
theorem scaleOne_moduleDiagram {n : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (g : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ)
    (hfd : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (g i))) :
    moduleDiagram (FiniteConstructible.scaleGrid 1 one_pos g)
        (PModule.scale 1 one_pos M)

name: TDA.Persistence.ModuleScalingExamples.essential_interval_obj_not_isZero

private theorem essential_interval_obj_not_isZero :
    ¬ IsZero ((RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := ℚ) (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))).obj 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hs : Subsingleton (RealBarcode.fiber (k := ℚ) (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) 0) :=
    ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp hzero
  let one : RealBarcode.fiber (k := ℚ) (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) 0 :=
    ⟨1, by simp [RealBarcode.fiber, RealBarcode.alive]⟩
  have heq := hs.elim (0 : RealBarcode.fiber (k := ℚ) (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) 0) one
  exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : ℚ) ≠ 1) (congrArg Subtype.val heq)

name: TDA.Persistence.ModuleScalingExamples.const_essential_distance_top
statement:
private theorem const_essential_distance_top :
    realInterleavingDistance
        ((Functor.const ℝ).obj
          ((RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := ℚ) (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))).obj 0))
        (0 : PModule.{0,0,0} ℚ ℝ) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply realInterleavingDistance_eq_top_iff.mpr
  intro ε
  apply not_nonempty_iff.mp
  intro hi
  have htrans := (RealInterleaving.nonempty_zero_iff ε
    ((Functor.const ℝ).obj
      ((RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := ℚ) (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))).obj 0))).mp hi
  have happ := congrArg (fun z => z.app (0 : ℝ)) htrans
  have hzero : (𝟙 (((Functor.const ℝ).obj
      ((RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := ℚ) (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))).obj 0)).obj 0) :
      _ ⟶ _) = 0 := by
    change structureMap ((Functor.const ℝ).obj
      ((RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := ℚ) (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))).obj 0))
        (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0 + ((ε + ε : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) from by positivity) = 0 at happ
    change ((Functor.const ℝ).obj
      ((RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := ℚ) (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))).obj 0)).map _ = 0 at happ
    change (𝟙 ((RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := ℚ) (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))).obj 0) :
      _ ⟶ _) = 0 at happ
    exact happ
  exact essential_interval_obj_not_isZero
    ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr hzero)
