name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.planSpace_iff_not_both_diagonal
statement:
theorem planSpace_iff_not_both_diagonal (z : ClosedHalfPlane × ClosedHalfPlane) :
    z ∈ Set.range (Subtype.val : PlanSpace → ClosedHalfPlane × ClosedHalfPlane) ↔
      ¬ (z.1.1.1 = z.1.1.2 ∧ z.2.1.1 = z.2.1.2)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, rfl⟩ ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    rcases e.2 with h | h
    · exact (ne_of_lt h) h₁
    · exact (ne_of_lt h) h₂
  · intro h
    by_cases h₁ : z.1.1.1 < z.1.1.2
    · exact ⟨⟨z, Or.inl h₁⟩, rfl⟩
    · have heq₁ : z.1.1.1 = z.1.1.2 :=
        le_antisymm z.1.2 (le_of_not_gt h₁)
      have h₂ : z.2.1.1 < z.2.1.2 := by
        by_contra hn
        exact h ⟨heq₁, le_antisymm z.2.2 (le_of_not_gt hn)⟩
      exact ⟨⟨z, Or.inr h₂⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.planSpace_cover
statement:
private theorem planSpace_cover :
    (Set.univ : Set PlanSpace) = firstFiber Set.univ ∪ secondFiber Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro _
    rcases z.2 with h | h
    · left
      exact ⟨⟨z.1.1.1, h⟩, Set.mem_univ _, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
    · right
      exact ⟨⟨z.1.2.1, h⟩, Set.mem_univ _, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
  · intro _
    trivial

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryPlan_mass_le
statement:
theorem boundaryPlan_mass_le {π : Measure PlanSpace} {μ ν : Measure Interior}
    (hπ : IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν) : π Set.univ ≤ μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [planSpace_cover]
  exact (measure_union_le _ _).trans_eq
    (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (hπ.first _ MeasurableSet.univ)
      (hπ.second _ MeasurableSet.univ))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryPlan_mass_lt_top

:=

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurableSet_secondFiber
statement:
theorem measurableSet_secondFiber {s : Set Interior} (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    MeasurableSet (secondFiber s)
proof:
:= by
  exact (measurableEmbedding_interiorIncl.measurableSet_image.mpr hs).preimage
    (by fun_prop : Measurable (fun z : PlanSpace => z.1.2))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.diagonalBoundaryPlan_admissible
statement:
theorem diagonalBoundaryPlan_admissible (μ ν : Measure Interior) :
    IsBoundaryPlan (diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν) μ ν
proof:
:= by
  have hfirstDelete (s : Set Interior) : deleteLeg ⁻¹' firstFiber s = s := by
    ext x
    change interiorIncl x ∈ interiorIncl '' s ↔ x ∈ s
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
      exact (interiorIncl_injective hxy).symm ▸ hy
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hfirstInsert (s : Set Interior) : insertLeg ⁻¹' firstFiber s = ∅ := by
    ext x
    change diagonalProjection x ∈ interiorIncl '' s ↔ False
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, _, heq⟩
      have h : (diagonalProjection x).1.1 < (diagonalProjection x).1.2 := by
        rw [← heq]
        exact y.2
      simp [diagonalProjection] at h
    · intro h
      exact False.elim h
  have hsecondDelete (s : Set Interior) : deleteLeg ⁻¹' secondFiber s = ∅ := by
    ext x
    change diagonalProjection x ∈ interiorIncl '' s ↔ False
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, _, heq⟩
      have h : (diagonalProjection x).1.1 < (diagonalProjection x).1.2 := by
        rw [← heq]
        exact y.2
      simp [diagonalProjection] at h
    · intro h
      exact False.elim h
  have hsecondInsert (s : Set Interior) : insertLeg ⁻¹' secondFiber s = s := by
    ext x
    change interiorIncl x ∈ interiorIncl '' s ↔ x ∈ s
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
      exact (interiorIncl_injective hxy).symm ▸ hy
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · intro s hs
    rw [diagonalBoundaryPlan, Measure.add_apply,
      Measure.map_apply measurable_deleteLeg (measurableSet_firstFiber hs),
      Measure.map_apply measurable_insertLeg (measurableSet_firstFiber hs)]
    rw [hfirstDelete, hfirstInsert]
    simp
  · intro s hs
    rw [diagonalBoundaryPlan, Measure.add_apply,
      Measure.map_apply measurable_deleteLeg (measurableSet_secondFiber hs),
      Measure.map_apply measurable_insertLeg (measurableSet_secondFiber hs)]
    rw [hsecondDelete, hsecondInsert]
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.diagonalBoundaryPlan_mass
statement:
theorem diagonalBoundaryPlan_mass (μ ν : Measure Interior) :
    diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν Set.univ = μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalBoundaryPlan, Measure.add_apply,
    Measure.map_apply measurable_deleteLeg MeasurableSet.univ,
    Measure.map_apply measurable_insertLeg MeasurableSet.univ]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.deleteLeg_distance
statement:
theorem deleteLeg_distance (x : Interior) :
    dist (interiorIncl x) (diagonalProjection x) = depth x
proof:
:= by
  rw [depth_eq]
  change dist x.1 ((x.1.1 + x.1.2) / 2, (x.1.1 + x.1.2) / 2) =
    (x.1.2 - x.1.1) / 2
  rw [Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
  rw [← diagonalCost_midpoint x.1.1 x.1.2]
  rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr x.2)]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.insertLeg_distance
statement:
theorem insertLeg_distance (x : Interior) :
    dist (diagonalProjection x) (interiorIncl x) = depth x
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_comm]
  exact deleteLeg_distance x

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurable_planPowerCost
statement: theorem measurable_planPowerCost (p : ℝ) : Measurable (planPowerCost p)
proof:
:= by
  unfold planPowerCost
  fun_prop

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.diagonalBoundaryPlan_cost
statement:
theorem diagonalBoundaryPlan_cost (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior) :
    ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν =
      (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) +
      (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂ν)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalBoundaryPlan, lintegral_add_measure,
    lintegral_map (measurable_planPowerCost p) measurable_deleteLeg,
    lintegral_map (measurable_planPowerCost p) measurable_insertLeg]
  simp only [planPowerCost, deleteLeg, insertLeg, deleteLeg_distance, insertLeg_distance]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.diagonalBoundaryPlan_cost_lt_top
statement:
theorem diagonalBoundaryPlan_cost_lt_top (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (hμ : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞)
    (hν : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂ν) < ∞) :
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν) < ∞
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagonalBoundaryPlan_cost]
  exact ENNReal.add_lt_top.mpr ⟨hμ, hν⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.exists_finite_cost_boundaryPlan
statement:
theorem exists_finite_cost_boundaryPlan (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (hμ : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞)
    (hν : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂ν) < ∞) :
    ∃ π : Measure PlanSpace, IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) < ∞
proof:
:=
  ⟨diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν, diagonalBoundaryPlan_admissible μ ν,
    diagonalBoundaryPlan_cost_lt_top p μ ν hμ hν⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_le_diagonalPlan
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_le_diagonalPlan (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν ≤
      ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν
proof:
:= by
  exact (iInf_le (fun π : Measure PlanSpace =>
    ⨅ (_ : IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν), ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π)
    (diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν)).trans
      (iInf_le (fun _ : IsBoundaryPlan (diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν) μ ν =>
        ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂diagonalBoundaryPlan μ ν)
        (diagonalBoundaryPlan_admissible μ ν))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_lt_top
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_lt_top (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (hμ : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞)
    (hν : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂ν) < ∞) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν < ∞
proof:
:=
  (boundaryTransportPowerValue_le_diagonalPlan p μ ν).trans_lt
    (diagonalBoundaryPlan_cost_lt_top p μ ν hμ hν)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.ofRelations_at_birth
statement:
@[simp] theorem Presentation.ofRelations_at_birth
    (W Y : GradedGenerators.{v,w} P)
    (r : ∀ y : Y.Carrier, (module (R := R) W).obj (Y.grade y))
    (y : Y.Carrier) :
    (Presentation.ofRelations (R := R) W Y r).relationMap.app (Y.grade y)
      (birth (R := R) Y y) = r y
proof:
:=
  lift_birth (R := R) Y (module W) r y

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.cover_surjective
statement:
theorem Presentation.cover_surjective (a : P) :
    Function.Surjective (D.cover.app a)
proof:
:= by
  have hcover : Epi D.cover := by
    change Epi (cokernel.π D.relationMap)
    infer_instance
  exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective (D.cover.app a)).mp
    ((NatTrans.epi_iff_epi_app D.cover).mp hcover a)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.exists_lift
statement:
theorem Presentation.exists_lift (W : GradedGenerators.{v,w} P)
    (f : module (R := R) W ⟶ D.presented) :
    ∃ l : module (R := R) W ⟶ module D.generators, l ≫ D.cover = f
proof:
:=
  exists_lift_of_surjective (R := R) W D.cover D.cover_surjective f

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.relations_vanish
statement: theorem Presentation.relations_vanish : D.relationMap ≫ D.cover = 0
proof:
:=
  cokernel.condition D.relationMap

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.cover_desc
proof:
:=
  cokernel.π_desc D.relationMap f hf

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.desc_unique
statement:
theorem Presentation.desc_unique {M : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P}
    (f : module (R := R) D.generators ⟶ M) (hf : D.relationMap ≫ f = 0)
    (g : D.presented ⟶ M) (hg : D.cover ≫ g = f) :
    g = D.desc f hf
proof:
:= by
  apply Cofork.IsColimit.hom_ext (cokernelIsCokernel D.relationMap)
  exact hg.trans (D.cover_desc f hf).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem Presentation.finitelyPresented (hD : D.IsFinite) :
    FinitelyPresented (R := R) (P := P) D.presented
proof:
:=
  ⟨D, hD, ⟨Iso.refl _⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_of_iso
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨i⟩⟩ := hM
  exact ⟨D, hD, ⟨i ≪≫ e⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.free_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem free_finitelyPresented (W : GradedGenerators.{v,w} P)
    [Finite W.Carrier] : FinitelyPresented (R := R) (P := P) (module (R := R) W)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨zeroRelationPresentation (R := R) W W, ?_,
    ⟨zeroRelationPresentedIso (R := R) W W⟩⟩
  change Finite W.Carrier ∧ Finite W.Carrier
  exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.kernel_translationTrivial_toFiniteImage_iff
statement:
theorem kernel_translationTrivial_toFiniteImage_iff (theta : Fin s →o Fin s)
    (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N) :
    TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel (toFiniteImage f)) ↔
      TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [kernel_translationTrivial_iff, kernel_translationTrivial_iff]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro i
  change LinearMap.ker (f.app i).hom.rangeRestrict ≤ _ ↔ _
  rw [LinearMap.ker_rangeRestrict]

name: TDA.Persistence.cokernel_translationTrivial_fromFiniteImage_iff
statement:
theorem cokernel_translationTrivial_fromFiniteImage_iff (theta : Fin s →o Fin s)
    (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N) :
    TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel (fromFiniteImage f)) ↔
      TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cokernel_translationTrivial_iff, cokernel_translationTrivial_iff]
  apply forall_congr'
  intro i
  change _ ≤ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.range (f.app (theta i)).hom).subtype ↔ _
  rw [Submodule.range_subtype]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_death_bounds_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem inducedMap_death_bounds_of_kernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel f))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (h : inducedMap f i = some j) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ≤ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ≤
        (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).translatedDeath theta
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩ := (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f i j).mp h
  have he := epiEmbedding_death_bounds_of_kernelTrivial theta hTheta
    (toFiniteImage f) (toFiniteImage_surjective f)
      ((kernel_translationTrivial_toFiniteImage_iff theta hTheta f).mpr hk) a
  have hd := monoEmbedding_death (fromFiniteImage f) (fromFiniteImage_injective f) a
  change (occurrence _ (imageTargetEmbedding f a)).death =
    (occurrence (rankBarcode (finiteImage f)) a).death at hd
  refine ⟨hd.trans_le he.1, ?_⟩
  exact he.2.trans_eq (FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_congr _ _ theta hd.symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_birth_bounds_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem inducedMap_birth_bounds_of_cokernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (h : inducedMap f i = some j) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birth ≤ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ≤
        (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birthStage).val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl, rfl⟩ := (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f i j).mp h
  have hb := epiEmbedding_birth (toFiniteImage f) (toFiniteImage_surjective f) a
  change (occurrence _ (imageSourceEmbedding f a)).birth =
    (occurrence (rankBarcode (finiteImage f)) a).birth at hb
  rw [hb]
  exact monoEmbedding_birth_bounds_of_cokernelTrivial theta hTheta
    (fromFiniteImage f) (fromFiniteImage_injective f)
      ((cokernel_translationTrivial_fromFiniteImage_iff theta hTheta f).mpr hc) a

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_endpoint_bounds_of_shortness
statement:
theorem inducedMap_endpoint_bounds_of_shortness
    (thetaK thetaC : Fin s →o Fin s) (hK : ∀ i, i ≤ thetaK i) (hC : ∀ i, i ≤ thetaC i)
    (f : M ⟶ N) (hk : TranslationTrivial thetaK hK (finiteKernel f))
    (hc : TranslationTrivial thetaC hC (finiteCokernel f))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (h : inducedMap f i = some j) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birth ≤ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth ≤
        (thetaC (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birthStage).val ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth < (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ≤ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ∧
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ≤
        (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).translatedDeath thetaK
proof:
:= by
  have hb := inducedMap_birth_bounds_of_cokernelTrivial thetaC hC f hc i j h
  have hd := inducedMap_death_bounds_of_kernelTrivial thetaK hK f hk i j h
  exact ⟨hb.1, hb.2, (inducedMap_endpoints f i j h).2.1, hd⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_covers_long_source_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem inducedMap_covers_long_source_of_kernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel f))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M))
    (hlong : (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birthStage).val <
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death) :
    ∃! j, inducedMap f i = some j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, _⟩ := epiEmbedding_covers_long_of_kernelTrivial theta hTheta
    (toFiniteImage f) (toFiniteImage_surjective f)
      ((kernel_translationTrivial_toFiniteImage_iff theta hTheta f).mpr hk) i hlong
  have hj := (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f i (imageTargetEmbedding f a)).mpr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨imageTargetEmbedding f a, hj, fun _ hj' => Option.some.inj (hj'.symm.trans hj)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_covers_long_target_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem inducedMap_covers_long_target_of_cokernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N))
    (hlong : (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birthStage).val <
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death) :
    ∃! i, inducedMap f i = some j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, _⟩ := monoEmbedding_covers_long_of_cokernelTrivial theta hTheta
    (fromFiniteImage f) (fromFiniteImage_injective f)
      ((cokernel_translationTrivial_fromFiniteImage_iff theta hTheta f).mpr hc) j hlong
  have hi := (inducedMap_eq_some_iff f (imageSourceEmbedding f a) j).mpr ⟨a, rfl, ha⟩
  exact ⟨imageSourceEmbedding f a, hi, fun i' hi' => inducedMap_injective f i' _ j hi' hi⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_unmatched_source_short_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem inducedMap_unmatched_source_short_of_kernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hk : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel f))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (hi : inducedMap f i = none) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ≤
      (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birthStage).val
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨j, hj, _⟩ := inducedMap_covers_long_source_of_kernelTrivial
    theta hTheta f hk i (lt_of_not_ge h)
  rw [hi] at hj
  contradiction

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.inducedMap_unmatched_target_short_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem inducedMap_unmatched_target_short_of_cokernelTrivial
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (j : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) (hj : ∀ i, inducedMap f i ≠ some j) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).death ≤
      (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode N) j).birthStage).val
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨i, hi, _⟩ := inducedMap_covers_long_target_of_cokernelTrivial
    theta hTheta f hc j (lt_of_not_ge h)
  exact hj i hi

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.exampleInterval_qTame
statement:
private theorem exampleInterval_qTame (p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ) :
    (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) p).QTame
proof:
:=
  PModule.qTame_of_finiteDimensional _ (fun t => by
    change FiniteDimensional k (RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) p t)
    infer_instance)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.interval_has_decorated_unit_atom
statement:
theorem interval_has_decorated_unit_atom :
    ∃ p ∈ rectangleCell (-1 : ℝ) 0 1 2,
      moduleDiagramMultiplicity
        (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)))
        (exampleInterval_qTame _) p = 1
proof:
:= by
  let M := RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ))
  have hM := exampleInterval_qTame (k := k) (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ))
  have hK : rectangleCell (-1 : ℝ) 0 1 2 ∈ separatedRectangleCells :=
    rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells _ _ _ _ (by norm_num)
  have hcount : moduleRectangleContent M hM (rectangleCell (-1 : ℝ) 0 1 2) = 1 := by
    rw [moduleRectangleContent_apply M hM _ _ _ _ (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    exact PersistenceMeasureExamples.upper_edges_count_one
  obtain ⟨p, hpK, hp⟩ := exists_moduleDiagram_atom_of_positive M hM hK (by omega)
  have hle := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_le_content M hM hK hpK
  refine ⟨p, hpK, ?_⟩
  change moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p = 1
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.infinite_ephemeral_extracted_diagram_zero
statement:
theorem infinite_ephemeral_extracted_diagram_zero (p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) :
    moduleDiagramMultiplicity _
      (PersistenceMeasureExamples.infinite_ephemeral_qTame (k := k)) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_zero_of_rectangle_zero
  intro a b c d hab hbc hcd
  exact PersistenceMeasureExamples.infinite_ephemeral_rectangle_zero hab.le hbc hcd.le

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.distance_le_iff_interleaving
statement:
theorem distance_le_iff_interleaving (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    realInterleavingDistance M N ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞) ↔
      Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M N)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hb : bottleneck (moduleDiagram c M hfdM) (moduleDiagram d N hfdN) ≤ ε := by
      rw [bottleneck_eq_distance hM hN hfdM hfdN]
      exact h
    have hf := hb.trans_lt (ENNReal.coe_lt_top (r := ε))
    obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := (bottleneck_optimal_iff _ _).mpr
      ((bottleneck_lt_top_iff _ _).mp hf)
    exact ⟨matchingInterleaving c d M N hM hN hfdM hfdN ε A (hA.le.trans hb)⟩
  · exact realInterleavingDistance_le_of_nonempty

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.interleaving_at_distance
statement:
theorem interleaving_at_distance (hf : realInterleavingDistance M N ≠ ⊤) :
    Nonempty (RealInterleaving (realInterleavingDistance M N).toNNReal M N)
proof:
:= by
  apply (distance_le_iff_interleaving hM hN hfdM hfdN _).mp
  exact (ENNReal.coe_toNNReal hf).symm.le

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.distance_eq_zero_iff_iso
statement:
theorem distance_eq_zero_iff_iso :
    realInterleavingDistance M N = 0 ↔ Nonempty (M ≅ N)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨i⟩ := (distance_le_iff_interleaving hM hN hfdM hfdN 0).mp (by simp [h])
    exact ⟨i.toIso⟩
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    exact realInterleavingDistance_eq_zero_of_iso e

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.interleaving_parameters_eq_Ici
statement:
theorem interleaving_parameters_eq_Ici (hf : realInterleavingDistance M N ≠ ⊤) :
    {ε : ℝ≥0 | Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M N)} =
      Set.Ici (realInterleavingDistance M N).toNNReal
proof:
:= by
  ext ε
  rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, ← distance_le_iff_interleaving hM hN hfdM hfdN,
    ← ENNReal.coe_toNNReal hf, ENNReal.coe_le_coe]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.isClosed_interleaving_parameters
statement:
theorem isClosed_interleaving_parameters :
    IsClosed {ε : ℝ≥0 | Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M N)}
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : realInterleavingDistance M N = ⊤
  · have he : {ε : ℝ≥0 | Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M N)} = ∅ := by
      ext ε
      simp only [Set.mem_ofPred_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
      intro h
      have hle := realInterleavingDistance_le_of_nonempty h
      rw [hf] at hle
      exact ENNReal.coe_ne_top (top_le_iff.mp hle)
    rw [he]
    exact isClosed_empty
  · rw [interleaving_parameters_eq_Ici hM hN hfdM hfdN hf]
    exact isClosed_Ici

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHomDimension.componentMapPi_injective
statement:
theorem componentMapPi_injective (X Y : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) :
    Function.Injective (componentMapPi (k := k) X Y)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext p
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have hp : (componentMapPi (k := k) X Y f) p =
      (componentMapPi (k := k) X Y g) p := congrFun h p
  have hx := congrArg (fun φ : X.obj p →ₗ[k] Y.obj p => φ x) hp
  simpa [componentMapPi] using hx

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteHomDimension.finiteDimensional_hom
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_hom [Fintype S]
    (X Y : PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    (hX : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (X.obj p))
    (hY : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (Y.obj p)) :
    FiniteDimensional k (X ⟶ Y)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (X.obj p) := hX
  haveI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (Y.obj p) := hY
  exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective (componentMapPi (k := k) X Y)
    (componentMapPi_injective (k := k) X Y)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.birth_le_death
statement: private theorem birth_le_death (n : ℕ) : (generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2) ≤ (relations n).grade ()
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  norm_num [generators, relations]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.presentation_finite
statement: theorem presentation_finite : (presentation R n).IsFinite
proof:
:=
  ⟨inferInstanceAs (Finite (Fin 2)), inferInstanceAs (Finite Unit)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.relation_nonzero
statement: theorem relation_nonzero [Nontrivial R] : (presentation R n).relationMap ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := congrArg (fun f : module (R := R) (relations n) ⟶ module (generators n) =>
    ((f.app ((relations n).grade ())).hom (GradedFree.birth (relations n) ())).val (0 : Fin 2)) h
  have hb := Presentation.ofRelations_at_birth (R := R) (generators n) (relations n)
    (fun _ => GradedFree.generator (generators n) (0 : Fin 2) (birth_le_death n)) ()
  change (((presentation R n).relationMap.app ((relations n).grade ())).hom
    (GradedFree.birth (relations n) ())).val (0 : Fin 2) = 0 at he
  rw [hb] at he
  change (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : R)) 0 = 0 at he
  rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same] at he
  exact one_ne_zero he

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.keepSecond_relation
statement: private theorem keepSecond_relation : (presentation R n).relationMap ≫ keepSecond R n = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply GradedFree.hom_ext_birth (relations n)
  intro y
  cases y
  change ((keepSecond R n).app ((relations n).grade ())).hom
    (((presentation R n).relationMap.app ((relations n).grade ())).hom
      (GradedFree.birth (relations n) ())) = 0
  have hr := Presentation.ofRelations_at_birth (R := R) (generators n) (relations n)
    (fun _ => GradedFree.generator (generators n) (0 : Fin 2) (birth_le_death n)) ()
  have h₁ := congrArg ((keepSecond R n).app ((relations n).grade ())).hom hr
  have hn := congrArg (fun f => f.hom (GradedFree.birth (R := R) (generators n) (0 : Fin 2)))
    ((keepSecond R n).naturality (homOfLE (birth_le_death n)))
  change ((keepSecond R n).app ((relations n).grade ())).hom
      (structureMapLinear (module (R := R) (generators n)) (birth_le_death n)
        (GradedFree.birth (generators n) (0 : Fin 2))) =
    structureMapLinear (HookInfinity.module ((generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2))) (birth_le_death n)
      (((keepSecond R n).app ((generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2))).hom (GradedFree.birth (generators n) (0 : Fin 2))) at hn
  have hb : ((keepSecond R n).app ((generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2))).hom
      (GradedFree.birth (generators n) (0 : Fin 2)) = 0 :=
    GradedFree.lift_birth (generators n) _
      (fun g : Fin 2 => if g = 0 then 0 else HookInfinity.birth (R := R) ((generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2))) 0
  have h₂ := hn.trans ((congrArg
    (structureMapLinear (HookInfinity.module (R := R) ((generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2)))
      (birth_le_death n)) hb).trans (map_zero _))
  have h₃ := congrArg ((keepSecond R n).app ((relations n).grade ())).hom
    (GradedFree.generator_eq_structureMap (R := R) (generators n) (0 : Fin 2) (birth_le_death n))
  exact h₁.trans (h₃.trans h₂)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.secondValue_image
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (fun f : module (R := R) (generators n) ⟶
      HookInfinity.module ((generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2)) =>
    (f.app ((generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2))).hom (GradedFree.birth (generators n) (1 : Fin 2)))
      ((presentation R n).cover_desc (keepSecond R n) (keepSecond_relation R n))
  change ((keepSecondDesc R n).app ((generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2))).hom (secondValue R n) = _ at he
  have hb := GradedFree.lift_birth (R := R) (generators n)
    (HookInfinity.module (R := R) ((generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2)))
    (fun g : Fin 2 => if g = 0 then 0 else HookInfinity.birth (R := R) ((generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2)))
    (1 : Fin 2)
  exact he.trans (hb.trans (if_neg (by decide : (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0)))

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.surviving_generator
statement: theorem surviving_generator {k : Type u} [Field k] : secondValue k n ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have he := secondValue_image k n
  rw [h, map_zero] at he
  exact HookInfinity.birth_ne_zero ((generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2)) he.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.repeated_births
statement:
theorem repeated_births [Nontrivial R] :
    (presentation R n).generatorGridPoint (presentation_finite R n) (0 : Fin 2) =
      (presentation R n).generatorGridPoint (presentation_finite R n) (1 : Fin 2) ∧
    GradedFree.birth (R := R) (generators n) (0 : Fin 2) ≠ GradedFree.birth (R := R) (generators n) (1 : Fin 2)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rfl
  · intro h
    have he := congrArg (fun x : (module (R := R) (generators n)).obj ((generators n).grade (0 : Fin 2)) =>
      x.val (0 : Fin 2)) h
    change (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : R)) 0 = (Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : R)) 0 at he
    simp only [Finsupp.single_eq_same, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1)] at he
    exact one_ne_zero he

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.integer_reconstruction
statement:
theorem integer_reconstruction :
    (presentation ℤ 2).relationMap ≠ 0 ∧
    Nonempty (((presentation ℤ 2).gridCoordinates (presentation_finite ℤ 2)).embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtension
      ((presentation ℤ 2).gridModule (presentation_finite ℤ 2)) ≅ (presentation ℤ 2).presented)
proof:
:=
  ⟨relation_nonzero ℤ 2, ⟨(presentation ℤ 2).gridKanIso (presentation_finite ℤ 2)⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.field_grid
statement:
theorem field_grid :
    ∃ (G : CoordinateGrid 2) (N : PModule ℚ G.Point),
      (∀ p, FiniteDimensional ℚ (N.obj p)) ∧
        Nonempty (G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtension N ≅ (presentation ℚ 2).presented)
proof:
:=
  GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_pfd_finiteGridKan _
    ((presentation ℚ 2).finitelyPresented (presentation_finite ℚ 2))

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.extendedDouble_eq
statement: theorem extendedDouble_eq : extendedDouble = (2 : ℚ) • 𝟙 (presentation ℚ 2).presented
proof:
:= by
  let D := presentation ℚ 2
  let hD := presentation_finite ℚ 2
  change (D.gridHomEquiv hD D.presented).symm
    ((D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding.monotone.functor.whiskerLeft ((2 : ℚ) • 𝟙 D.presented)) = _
  rw [← D.gridHomEquiv_apply hD D.presented ((2 : ℚ) • 𝟙 D.presented)]
  exact (D.gridHomEquiv hD D.presented).symm_apply_apply _

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.extendedDouble_nonzero
statement: theorem extendedDouble_nonzero : extendedDouble ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [extendedDouble_eq] at h
  have he := congrArg (fun f : (presentation ℚ 2).presented ⟶ (presentation ℚ 2).presented =>
    (f.app ((generators 2).grade (0 : Fin 2))).hom (secondValue ℚ 2)) h
  change (2 : ℚ) • secondValue ℚ 2 = 0 at he
  exact (smul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℚ) ≠ 0) (surviving_generator 2)) he

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.characteristic_two
statement:
theorem characteristic_two :
    let D := presentation (ZMod 2) 2
    let hD := presentation_finite (ZMod 2) 2
    D.relationMap ≠ 0 ∧ secondValue (ZMod 2) 2 ≠ 0 ∧
      (D.gridHomEquiv hD D.presented).symm
        ((D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding.monotone.functor.whiskerLeft
          ((2 : ZMod 2) • 𝟙 D.presented)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨relation_nonzero (ZMod 2) 2, surviving_generator 2, ?_⟩
  let D := presentation (ZMod 2) 2
  let hD := presentation_finite (ZMod 2) 2
  change (D.gridHomEquiv hD D.presented).symm
    ((D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding.monotone.functor.whiskerLeft ((2 : ZMod 2) • 𝟙 D.presented)) = 0
  rw [← D.gridHomEquiv_apply hD D.presented ((2 : ZMod 2) • 𝟙 D.presented), Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have h2 : (2 : ZMod 2) = 0 := by decide
  rw [h2, zero_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.no_coordinates
statement:
theorem no_coordinates :
    let D := presentation ℚ 0
    let hD := presentation_finite ℚ 0
    Fintype.card (D.gridCoordinates hD).Point = 1 ∧ secondValue ℚ 0 ≠ 0 ∧
      Nonempty ((D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtension
        (D.gridModule hD) ≅ D.presented)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨?_, surviving_generator 0, ⟨(presentation ℚ 0).gridKanIso (presentation_finite ℚ 0)⟩⟩
  simp [CoordinateGrid.Point]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.no_relations
statement:
theorem no_relations :
    let D := zeroRelationPresentation (R := R) (generators n) (noGenerators n)
    let hD : D.IsFinite := ⟨inferInstanceAs (Finite (Fin 2)), inferInstanceAs (Finite Empty)⟩
    Nonempty ((D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtension
      (D.gridModule hD) ≅ module (R := R) (generators n))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let D := zeroRelationPresentation (R := R) (generators n) (noGenerators n)
  let hD : D.IsFinite := ⟨inferInstanceAs (Finite (Fin 2)), inferInstanceAs (Finite Empty)⟩
  exact ⟨D.gridKanIso hD ≪≫ zeroRelationPresentedIso (generators n) (noGenerators n)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.zero_module
statement:
theorem zero_module :
    ∃ (G : CoordinateGrid n) (N : PModule.{u,0,u} R G.Point),
      Nonempty (G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtension N ≅ (0 : PModule R (Fin n → ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  have hz : IsZero (module (R := R) (noGenerators n)) := by
    apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
    apply GradedFree.hom_ext_birth (noGenerators n)
    intro g
    exact g.elim
  exact GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_finiteGridKan _
    (finitelyPresented_of_iso (free_finitelyPresented (noGenerators n)) hz.isoZero)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePresentationKanExamples.zero_ring
statement:
theorem zero_ring :
    let D := presentation (ZMod 1) 2
    let hD := presentation_finite (ZMod 1) 2
    Nonempty ((D.gridCoordinates hD).embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtension
      (D.gridModule hD) ≅ D.presented)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(presentation (ZMod 1) 2).gridKanIso (presentation_finite (ZMod 1) 2)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureBoxExamples.interval_qTame
statement:
private theorem interval_qTame (p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ) :
    (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) p).QTame
proof:
:= by
  apply PModule.qTame_of_finiteDimensional
  intro t
  change FiniteDimensional k (RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) p t)
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureBoxExamples.displaced_interval_box_nonzero
statement:
theorem displaced_interval_box_nonzero :
    1 ≤ persistenceMeasureValue
      (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (1 / 4, (9 / 4 : ℝ)))
      (show (-5 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4 by norm_num)
      (show (1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 3 / 4 by norm_num)
      (show (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 9 / 4 by norm_num)
proof:
:= by
  let i := RealBarcode.interleavingOfBounds (k := k) (1 / 4 : ℝ≥0)
    (0, (2 : WithTop ℝ)) (1 / 4, (9 / 4 : ℝ))
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (by rw [← WithTop.coe_ofNat, ← WithTop.coe_add, WithTop.coe_le_coe]; norm_num)
    (by rw [← WithTop.coe_ofNat, ← WithTop.coe_add, WithTop.coe_le_coe]; norm_num)
  have h := i.persistenceMeasureValue_box_le_of_qTame (interval_qTame _)
    (show (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 0 by norm_num) (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)
    (by norm_num)
  rw [PersistenceMeasureExamples.upper_edges_count_one] at h
  norm_num at h ⊢
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.fixedFaceLift_contDiffOn_two
proof:
:= by
  apply ContDiffOn.prodMk
  · apply contDiffOn_pi.mpr
    intro i
    exact (hF (e.enum ((faceTemplatePairs k e p).toList.get i).1)).prodMk
      (hF (e.enum ((faceTemplatePairs k e p).toList.get i).2))
  · apply contDiffOn_pi.mpr
    intro i

name: TDA.Persistence.faceLossHessianCoefficient_selected
statement:
theorem faceLossHessianCoefficient_selected (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (j l : FaceLossSlot k F e p) :
    faceLossHessianCoefficient k F e p W
      (faceLossSlotFace k F e p j) (faceLossSlotFace k F e p l) =
      faceLossSlotHessian k F e p W j l
proof:
:= by
  unfold faceLossHessianCoefficient faceLossSlotHessian
  rw [faceValueSelection_single_eq_unit, faceValueSelection_single_eq_unit]

name: TDA.Persistence.faceLossHessianCoefficient_unused_left
statement:
theorem faceLossHessianCoefficient_unused_left (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (s t : TotalFace K) (hs : s ∉ Set.range (faceLossSlotFace k F e p)) :
    faceLossHessianCoefficient k F e p W s t = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold faceLossHessianCoefficient
  rw [faceValueSelection_single_eq_zero k F e p s hs]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.faceLossHessianCoefficient_unused_right
statement:
theorem faceLossHessianCoefficient_unused_right (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (s t : TotalFace K) (ht : t ∉ Set.range (faceLossSlotFace k F e p)) :
    faceLossHessianCoefficient k F e p W s t = 0
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.faceCoordinateLossHessian_apply
statement:
theorem faceCoordinateLossHessian_apply (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (h q : E) :
    faceCoordinateLossHessian k F e p W h q =
      (∑ s : TotalFace K, ∑ t : TotalFace K,
        faceLossHessianCoefficient k F e p W s t *
          fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀ h *
          fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value t) x₀ q) +
      ∑ s : TotalFace K, faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s *
        fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s)) x₀ h q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [faceCoordinateLossHessian, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, mul_assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.bilinearFunctional_face_sum
statement:
private theorem bilinearFunctional_face_sum {I : Type*} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (T : (I → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (I → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (a b : I → ℝ) :
    T a b = ∑ i : I, ∑ j : I,
      T (Pi.single (M := fun _ : I => ℝ) i 1)
        (Pi.single (M := fun _ : I => ℝ) j 1) * a i * b j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (T.flip b) a = _
  rw [linearFunctional_face_sum (T.flip b) a]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  change T (Pi.single i 1) b * a i = _
  rw [linearFunctional_face_sum (T (Pi.single i 1)) b, Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.allFaceValues_second_fderiv_apply
statement:
theorem allFaceValues_second_fderiv_apply {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (s : TotalFace K) (h q : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (allFaceValues F)) x₀ h q s =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s)) x₀ h q
proof:
:= by
  have hG := (contDiffOn_pi.mpr hF).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
  have heq := secondDerivative_linear_postcomp
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj s : (TotalFace K → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (allFaceValues F) x₀ hG
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, allFaceValues, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply] using
    (congrArg (fun A => A h q) heq).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.fixedFaceLift_second_fderiv_eq_selection
statement:
theorem fixedFaceLift_second_fderiv_eq_selection {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (F x).value s) U) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fixedFaceLift k F e p)) x₀ =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ E (TotalFace K → ℝ)
        (DiagramCoordinates (faceLiftCounts k F e p).1 (faceLiftCounts k F e p).2)
          (faceValueSelection k F e p)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (allFaceValues F)) x₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hG := (contDiffOn_pi.mpr hF).contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, ← fixedFaceLift_eq_selection] using
    secondDerivative_linear_postcomp (faceValueSelection k F e p)
      (allFaceValues F) x₀ hG

name: TDA.Persistence.fixedFaceLift_slot_second_derivative
statement:
theorem fixedFaceLift_slot_second_derivative {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (j : FaceLossSlot k F e p) (h q : E) :
    faceLossSlotRead k F e p j
      (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fixedFaceLift k F e p)) x₀ h q) =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value (faceLossSlotFace k F e p j)))
        x₀ h q
proof:
:= by
  rw [fixedFaceLift_second_fderiv_eq_selection k F e p hU hx hF]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply]
  have hs : faceLossSlotRead k F e p j
      (faceValueSelection k F e p (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (allFaceValues F)) x₀ h q)) =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (allFaceValues F)) x₀ h q (faceLossSlotFace k F e p j) := by
    rcases j with ((i | i) | i) <;> rfl
  rw [hs, allFaceValues_second_fderiv_apply F hU hx hF]

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_c2_neighborhood
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_c2_neighborhood (e : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) (p : ℕ) {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) :
    ∃ N : Set E, IsOpen N ∧ x₀ ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ U ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => W (dgm k (F x) p)) N
proof:
:= by
  exact localLift_scalar_c2 (fun x => dgm k (F x) p) W
    (faceLiftCounts k F e p).1 (faceLiftCounts k F e p).2
    (fixedFaceC2Lift k F e p hU hF horder) x₀ hx hW

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_c2_fderiv
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_c2_fderiv {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun x => W (dgm k (F x) p)) x₀ =
      ∑ s : TotalFace K, faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s •
        fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀
proof:
:=
  sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_fderiv k F e p hU hx
    (fun s => (hF s).of_le (by norm_num)) horder W hW.c1

name: TDA.Persistence.secondDerivativeChain_eq_faceCoordinateLossHessian
statement:
theorem secondDerivativeChain_eq_faceCoordinateLossHessian {U : Set E}
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) :
    secondDerivativeChain
      (W ∘ orderedQ (faceLiftCounts k F e p).1 (faceLiftCounts k F e p).2)
      (fixedFaceLift k F e p) x₀ = faceCoordinateLossHessian k F e p W
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := fderiv ℝ (W ∘ orderedQ (faceLiftCounts k F e p).1
    (faceLiftCounts k F e p).2) (fixedFaceLift k F e p x₀)
  let H := fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (W ∘ orderedQ (faceLiftCounts k F e p).1
    (faceLiftCounts k F e p).2)) (fixedFaceLift k F e p x₀)
  let R := faceValueSelection k F e p
  let G := fderiv ℝ (allFaceValues F) x₀
  let J := fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (allFaceValues F)) x₀
  have hFone : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => (F x).value s) U :=
    fun s => (hF s).of_le (by norm_num)
  ext h q
  rw [secondDerivativeChain_apply, faceCoordinateLossHessian_apply,
    fixedFaceLift_fderiv_eq_selection k F e p hU hx hFone,
    fixedFaceLift_second_fderiv_eq_selection k F e p hU hx hF]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.compL_apply]
  change H (R (G h)) (R (G q)) + D (R (J h q)) = _
  have hexp : H (R (G h)) (R (G q)) =
      ∑ s : TotalFace K, ∑ t : TotalFace K,
        faceLossHessianCoefficient k F e p W s t * G h s * G q t := by
    let T : (TotalFace K → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (TotalFace K → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ (TotalFace K → ℝ) _ ℝ).flip R).comp (H.comp R)
    exact bilinearFunctional_face_sum T (G h) (G q)
  have hcurv : D (R (J h q)) =
      ∑ s : TotalFace K, faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s * J h q s := by
    change (D.comp R) (J h q) = _
    rw [linearFunctional_face_sum (D.comp R) (J h q)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s _
    rw [faceLossCoefficient_eq_basis k F e p W s]
    rfl
  rw [hexp, hcurv]
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s _
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro t _
    rw [allFaceValues_fderiv_apply F hU hx hFone,
      allFaceValues_fderiv_apply F hU hx hFone]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s _
    rw [allFaceValues_second_fderiv_apply F hU hx hF]

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_hasFDerivAt_fderiv
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_hasFDerivAt_fderiv {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ (fun x => W (dgm k (F x) p)))
      (faceCoordinateLossHessian k F e p W) x₀
proof:
:= by
  have hc := localLift_scalar_hasFDerivAt_fderiv
    (fun x => dgm k (F x) p) W
    (faceLiftCounts k F e p).1 (faceLiftCounts k F e p).2
    (fixedFaceC2Lift k F e p hU hF horder) x₀ hx hW
  change HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ (fun x => W (dgm k (F x) p)))
    (secondDerivativeChain
      (W ∘ orderedQ (faceLiftCounts k F e p).1 (faceLiftCounts k F e p).2)
        (fixedFaceLift k F e p) x₀) x₀ at hc
  rwa [secondDerivativeChain_eq_faceCoordinateLossHessian k F e p hU hx hF W] at hc

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_second_fderiv
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_second_fderiv {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)

    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)

name: TDA.Persistence.faceLossHessianCoefficient_symmetric
statement:
theorem faceLossHessianCoefficient_symmetric {U : Set E} (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) (s t : TotalFace K) :
    faceLossHessianCoefficient k F e p W s t =
      faceLossHessianCoefficient k F e p W t s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hNo, hzN, hN⟩ := hW (faceLiftCounts k F e p).1
    (faceLiftCounts k F e p).2 (fixedFaceLift k F e p x₀)
    (fixedFaceLift_factorization k F e p horder x₀ hx).symm
  exact (hN.contDiffAt (hNo.mem_nhds hzN)).isSymmSndFDerivAt (by norm_num) _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.faceCoordinateLossHessian_symmetric
statement:
theorem faceCoordinateLossHessian_symmetric {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) (h q : E) :
    faceCoordinateLossHessian k F e p W h q = faceCoordinateLossHessian k F e p W q h
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_second_fderiv k F e p hU hx hF horder W hW]
  obtain ⟨N, hNo, hxN, _, hN⟩ := sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_c2_neighborhood
    k F e p hU hx hF horder W hW
  exact (hN.contDiffAt (hNo.mem_nhds hxN)).isSymmSndFDerivAt (by norm_num) h q

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteFaceHessian_norm_bound
statement:
private theorem finiteFaceHessian_norm_bound {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (γ : I → I → ℝ) (β : I → ℝ) (A : I → E →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (J : I → E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ‖(∑ i : I, ∑ j : I, γ i j • (A i).smulRight (A j)) + ∑ i : I, β i • J i‖ ≤
      (∑ i : I, ∑ j : I, |γ i j| * ‖A i‖ * ‖A j‖) + ∑ i : I, |β i| * ‖J i‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hdouble : ‖∑ i : I, ∑ j : I, γ i j • (A i).smulRight (A j)‖ ≤
      ∑ i : I, ∑ j : I, |γ i j| * ‖A i‖ * ‖A j‖ := by
    refine le_trans (norm_sum_le (E := E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) Finset.univ
      (fun i => ∑ j : I, γ i j • (A i).smulRight (A j))) ?_
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    calc
      ‖∑ j : I, γ i j • (A i).smulRight (A j)‖ ≤
        ∑ j : I, ‖γ i j • (A i).smulRight (A j)‖ := norm_sum_le (E := E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ j : I, |γ i j| * ‖(A i).smulRight (A j)‖ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro j _
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le (γ i j) ((A i).smulRight (A j))
      _ = _ := by simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.norm_smulRight_apply, mul_assoc]
  have hsingle : ‖∑ i : I, β i • J i‖ ≤ ∑ i : I, |β i| * ‖J i‖ := by
    calc
      ‖∑ i : I, β i • J i‖ ≤ ∑ i : I, ‖β i • J i‖ := norm_sum_le (E := E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ) _ _
      _ ≤ _ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_smul_le (β i) (J i)
  exact (norm_add_le
    (∑ i : I, ∑ j : I, γ i j • (A i).smulRight (A j))
    (∑ i : I, β i • J i)).trans (add_le_add hdouble hsingle)

name: TDA.Persistence.faceCoordinateLossHessian_norm_bound
statement:
theorem faceCoordinateLossHessian_norm_bound (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) :
    ‖faceCoordinateLossHessian k F e p W‖ ≤
      (∑ s : TotalFace K, ∑ t : TotalFace K,
        |faceLossHessianCoefficient k F e p W s t| *
          ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀‖ *
          ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value t) x₀‖) +
      ∑ s : TotalFace K, |faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s| *
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s)) x₀‖
proof:
:= by
  exact finiteFaceHessian_norm_bound
    (faceLossHessianCoefficient k F e p W) (faceLossCoefficient k F e p W)
    (fun s => fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀)
    (fun s => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s)) x₀)

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_second_norm_bound
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_second_norm_bound {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => W (dgm k (F x) p))) x₀‖ ≤
      (∑ s : TotalFace K, ∑ t : TotalFace K,
        |faceLossHessianCoefficient k F e p W s t| *
          ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀‖ *
          ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value t) x₀‖) +
      ∑ s : TotalFace K, |faceLossCoefficient k F e p W s| *
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s)) x₀‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_second_fderiv k F e p hU hx hF horder W hW]
  exact faceCoordinateLossHessian_norm_bound k F e p W

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_second_derivative_independent
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_second_derivative_independent
    (e' : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)

proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_any_c2_lifts_independent

name: TDA.Persistence.faceCoordinateLossHessian_of_face_second_deriv_zero
statement:

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_second_fderiv_of_face_second_deriv_zero
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_second_fderiv_of_face_second_deriv_zero
    {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hx : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (F x).value s) U)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))

    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => W (dgm k (F x) p))) x₀ =
      ∑ s : TotalFace K, ∑ t : TotalFace K,
        faceLossHessianCoefficient k F e p W s t •
          (fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀).smulRight
            (fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value t) x₀)

name: TDA.Persistence.tiedFaceValues_fderiv_eq
statement:
theorem tiedFaceValues_fderiv_eq {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U) (hx : x₀ ∈ U)

proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.faceLossHessianCoefficient_eq_scatter
statement:
theorem faceLossHessianCoefficient_eq_scatter (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (s t : TotalFace K) :
    faceLossHessianCoefficient k F e p W s t =
      if hs : s ∈ Set.range (faceLossSlotFace k F e p) then
        if ht : t ∈ Set.range (faceLossSlotFace k F e p) then
          faceLossSlotHessian k F e p W (Classical.choose hs) (Classical.choose ht)
        else 0
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  split_ifs with hs ht
  · simpa only [Classical.choose_spec hs, Classical.choose_spec ht] using
      faceLossHessianCoefficient_selected k F e p W
        (Classical.choose hs) (Classical.choose ht)
  · exact faceLossHessianCoefficient_unused_right k F e p W s t ht
  · exact faceLossHessianCoefficient_unused_left k F e p W s t hs

name: TDA.Persistence.affineFaceValues_second_fderiv_zero
statement:
theorem affineFaceValues_second_fderiv_zero {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U) (A : TotalFace K → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : TotalFace K → ℝ)
    (haff : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ∀ x ∈ U, (F x).value s = b s + A s x)
    (s : TotalFace K) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s)) x₀ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun x => (F x).value s) =ᶠ[𝓝 x₀] (fun x => b s + A s x) := by
    filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with x hxU
    exact haff s x hxU
  have hd : fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) =ᶠ[𝓝 x₀] (fun _ => A s) := by
    refine heq.fderiv.trans (Filter.Eventually.of_forall ?_)
    intro x
    exact ((A s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (b s)).fderiv
  rw [hd.fderiv_eq]
  exact fderiv_const_apply (A s)

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_affine_second_fderiv
statement:
theorem sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_affine_second_fderiv {U : Set E} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (hx : x₀ ∈ U) (A : TotalFace K → E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : TotalFace K → ℝ)
    (haff : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ∀ x ∈ U, (F x).value s = b s + A s x)
    (horder : ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x))
    (W : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (hW : C2ThroughAllRepresentatives W (dgm k (F x₀) p)) :
    fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun x => W (dgm k (F x) p))) x₀ =
      ∑ s : TotalFace K, ∑ t : TotalFace K,
        faceLossHessianCoefficient k F e p W s t • (A s).smulRight (A t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hF : ∀ s : TotalFace K, ContDiffOn ℝ 2 (fun x => (F x).value s) U := by
    intro s
    apply ((contDiff_const.add (A s).contDiff).contDiffOn).congr
    intro x hxU
    exact haff s x hxU
  rw [sublevelDiagramScalarLoss_second_fderiv_of_face_second_deriv_zero
    k F e p hU hx hF horder W hW
      (affineFaceValues_second_fderiv_zero F hU hx A b haff)]
  have hd : ∀ s : TotalFace K, fderiv ℝ (fun x => (F x).value s) x₀ = A s := by
    intro s
    have heq : (fun x => (F x).value s) =ᶠ[𝓝 x₀] (fun x => b s + A s x) := by
      filter_upwards [hU.mem_nhds hx] with x hxU
      exact haff s x hxU
    rw [heq.fderiv_eq]
    exact ((A s).hasFDerivAt.const_add (b s)).fderiv
  simp only [hd]
