name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.image_le_map_translated_image
statement:
private theorem image_le_map_translated_image (theta : Fin s →o Fin s)
    (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (b c : Fin s) (hbc : theta b ≤ c) :
    LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear N ((hTheta b).trans hbc)) ≤
      (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hbc)).map (f.app c).hom
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
  have himg := (cokernel_translationTrivial_iff theta hTheta f).mp hc b
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := himg ⟨x, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨structureMapLinear M hbc z, ⟨z, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [naturality_apply, hz]
  exact (congrArg (fun L => L x) (structureMapLinear_comp N (hTheta b) hbc)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathSubspace_le_map_translated
statement:
private theorem deathSubspace_le_map_translated (theta : Fin s →o Fin s)
    (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f.app i).hom)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (b : Fin s) (d : ℕ) (hbd : b.val < d) (htd : (theta b).val < d) (hd : d < s) :
    deathSubspace N b.val d hbd hd ≤
      (deathSubspace M (theta b).val d htd hd).map (f.app ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩).hom
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨hy, hk⟩
  have htc : theta b ≤ (⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin s) := by
    change (theta b).val ≤ d - 1
    omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hfx⟩ := image_le_map_translated_image theta hTheta f hc b _ htc hy
  refine ⟨x, ⟨hx, ?_⟩, hfx⟩
  apply hf ⟨d, hd⟩
  rw [map_zero, naturality_apply, hfx]
  exact hk

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathPrefixCount_le_translated_of_cokernelTrivial
statement:
theorem deathPrefixCount_le_translated_of_cokernelTrivial
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj i)]
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hf : ∀ i, Function.Injective (f.app i).hom)
    (hc : TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteCokernel f))
    (b : Fin s) (d : ℕ) (htd : (theta b).val < d) (hd : d ≤ s) :
    deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode N) b.val d ≤
      deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode M) (theta b).val d
proof:
:= by
  have hbtheta : b.val ≤ (theta b).val := hTheta b
  have hbd : b.val < d := by omega
  by_cases hds : d < s
  · rw [deathPrefixCount_eq_finrank N b.val d hbd hds,
      deathPrefixCount_eq_finrank M (theta b).val d htd hds]
    exact (Submodule.finrank_mono
      (deathSubspace_le_map_translated theta hTheta f hf hc b d hbd htd hds)).trans
        (Submodule.finrank_map_le _ _)
  · have hdeq : d = s := by omega
    subst d
    rw [deathPrefixCount_terminal N b.val hbd,
      deathPrefixCount_terminal M (theta b).val htd]
    have htc : theta b ≤ (⟨s - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin s) := by
      change (theta b).val ≤ s - 1
      omega
    exact (Submodule.finrank_mono
      (image_le_map_translated_image theta hTheta f hc b _ htc)).trans
        (Submodule.finrank_map_le _ _)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuel.app_naturality
statement:
private theorem app_naturality {A B : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (η : A ⟶ B) {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (x : A.obj a) :
    (η.app b).hom (structureMapLinear A hab x) =
      structureMapLinear B hab ((η.app a).hom x)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) (η.naturality (homOfLE hab))

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuel.structure_square
statement:
private theorem structure_square (A : PModule.{u,0,u} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    {a b c d : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) (hbd : b ≤ d)
    (hac : a ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d) (x : A.obj a) :
    structureMapLinear A hbd (structureMapLinear A hab x) =
      structureMapLinear A hcd (structureMapLinear A hac x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← structureMapLinear_comp,
    ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← structureMapLinear_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuel.forward_condition
proof:
:= by
  let p := ((pullback.snd ((shift ε).map β) (α ≫ i.φ)).app a).hom x
  have hc := congrArg (fun f : leftPullback α β i ⟶ (shift ε).obj N => (f.app a).hom x)
    (pullback.condition (f := (shift ε).map β) (g := α ≫ i.φ))
  change (β.app (translation ε a)).hom (forwardSecond α β i a x) =
    (i.φ.app a).hom ((α.app a).hom p) at hc
  have hi := congrArg (fun f => f.hom ((α.app a).hom p)) (i.φ_ψ_structureMap a)
  change (i.ψ.app (translation ε a)).hom ((i.φ.app a).hom ((α.app a).hom p)) =
    structureMapLinear M (CoordinateInterleaving.twice_le ε a) ((α.app a).hom p) at hi
  change (α.app (translation ε (translation ε a))).hom
      (structureMapLinear P (CoordinateInterleaving.twice_le ε a) p) =
    (i.ψ.app (translation ε a)).hom
      ((β.app (translation ε a)).hom (forwardSecond α β i a x))
  exact (app_naturality α (CoordinateInterleaving.twice_le ε a) p).trans
    (hi.symm.trans (congrArg (i.ψ.app (translation ε a)).hom hc.symm))

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuel.forwardLinear_fst
proof:
:=
  PullbackFiber.fst_liftLinear ((shift ε).map α) (β ≫ i.ψ) (translation ε a)
    (forwardFirst α β i a) (forwardSecond α β i a) (forward_condition α β i a) x

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuel.forwardLinear_snd
proof:
:=
  PullbackFiber.snd_liftLinear ((shift ε).map α) (β ≫ i.ψ) (translation ε a)
    (forwardFirst α β i a) (forwardSecond α β i a) (forward_condition α β i a) x

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuel.forward_fst_app
statement:
theorem forward_fst_app (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : (leftPullback α β i).obj a) :
    ((pullback.fst ((shift ε).map α) (β ≫ i.ψ)).app (translation ε a)).hom
      (((forward α β i).app a).hom x) =
        structureMapLinear P (CoordinateInterleaving.twice_le ε a)
          (((pullback.snd ((shift ε).map β) (α ≫ i.φ)).app a).hom x)
proof:
:=
  forwardLinear_fst α β i a x

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuel.forward_snd_app
statement:
theorem forward_snd_app (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : (leftPullback α β i).obj a) :
    ((pullback.snd ((shift ε).map α) (β ≫ i.ψ)).app (translation ε a)).hom
      (((forward α β i).app a).hom x) =
        ((pullback.fst ((shift ε).map β) (α ≫ i.φ)).app a).hom x
proof:
:=
  forwardLinear_snd α β i a x

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuel.reverse_fst_app
statement:
theorem reverse_fst_app (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : (rightPullback α β i).obj a) :
    ((pullback.fst ((shift ε).map β) (α ≫ i.φ)).app (translation ε a)).hom
      (((reverse α β i).app a).hom x) =
        structureMapLinear Q (CoordinateInterleaving.twice_le ε a)
          (((pullback.snd ((shift ε).map α) (β ≫ i.ψ)).app a).hom x)
proof:
:=
  forward_fst_app β α i.symm a x

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuel.reverse_snd_app
statement:
theorem reverse_snd_app (a : Fin n → ℝ) (x : (rightPullback α β i).obj a) :
    ((pullback.snd ((shift ε).map β) (α ≫ i.φ)).app (translation ε a)).hom
      (((reverse α β i).app a).hom x) =
        ((pullback.fst ((shift ε).map α) (β ≫ i.ψ)).app a).hom x
proof:
:=
  forward_snd_app β α i.symm a x

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuel.forward_reverse_app
statement:
theorem forward_reverse_app (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (forward α β i).app a ≫ (reverse α β i).app (translation ε a) =
      structureMap (leftPullback α β i) (CoordinateInterleaving.twice_le ε a)
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  apply PullbackFiber.element_ext ((shift ε).map β) (α ≫ i.φ)
    (translation ε (translation ε a))
  · have h₁ := reverse_fst_app α β i (translation ε a) (((forward α β i).app a).hom x)
    have h₂ := congrArg (structureMapLinear Q (CoordinateInterleaving.twice_le ε (translation ε a)))
      (forward_snd_app α β i a x)
    have h₃ := (app_naturality (pullback.fst ((shift ε).map β) (α ≫ i.φ))
      (CoordinateInterleaving.twice_le ε a) x).symm
    exact h₁.trans (h₂.trans h₃)
  · have h₁ := reverse_snd_app α β i (translation ε a) (((forward α β i).app a).hom x)
    have h₂ := forward_fst_app α β i a x
    have h₃ := (app_naturality (pullback.snd ((shift ε).map β) (α ≫ i.φ))
      (CoordinateInterleaving.twice_le ε a) x).symm
    exact h₁.trans (h₂.trans h₃)

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuel.reverse_forward_app
statement:
theorem reverse_forward_app (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (reverse α β i).app a ≫ (forward α β i).app (translation ε a) =
      structureMap (rightPullback α β i) (CoordinateInterleaving.twice_le ε a)
proof:
:=
  forward_reverse_app β α i.symm a

name: TDA.Persistence.RankSchanuel.shift_deflation
statement:
private theorem shift_deflation {A B : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    {f : A ⟶ B} (hf : IsRankDeflation f) (δ : ℝ≥0) : IsRankDeflation ((shift δ).map f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, ι, hs⟩ := hf
  exact (hs.reindex (translation δ)).isRankDeflation

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.inclusion_eq_faceMap
statement:
private theorem inclusion_eq_faceMap {a b : S} (h : a ≤ b) :
    HookCokernel.inclusion (k := k) h =
      GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.faceMap (k := k)
        (f := fun _ : Fin 1 => b) (g := fun _ : Fin 1 => a)
        (fun _ => h) singletonFace
proof:
:= by
  apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
  simp [HookCokernel.inclusion, GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.faceMap,
    GeneratedUpsetResolution.faceModule, GeneratedUpsetResolution.faceJoin,
    singletonFace]
  exact congrArg (fun h' : a ≤ b =>
    structureMapLinear (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) h'
      (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) a)) (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.hookCokernel_inclusion_mono
statement:
theorem hookCokernel_inclusion_mono {a b : S} (h : a ≤ b) :
    Mono (HookCokernel.inclusion (k := k) h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [inclusion_eq_faceMap (k := k) h]
  exact GeneratedUpsetResolutionMap.faceMap_mono (k := k)
    (f := fun _ : Fin 1 => b) (g := fun _ => a) (fun _ => h) singletonFace

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.hookShortExact
statement:
private theorem hookShortExact {a b : S} (h : a ≤ b) :
    (ShortComplex.mk (HookCokernel.inclusion (k := k) h)
      (HookCokernel.projection (k := k) a b)
      (HookCokernel.inclusion_projection (k := k) h)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let R := ShortComplex.mk (HookCokernel.inclusion (k := k) h)
    (HookCokernel.projection (k := k) a b)
    (HookCokernel.inclusion_projection (k := k) h)
  have hcolim : IsColimit (CokernelCofork.ofπ R.g R.zero) :=
    HookCokernel.isCokernel (k := k) h
  have hexepi : R.Exact ∧ Epi R.g := R.exact_and_epi_g_iff_g_is_cokernel.mpr ⟨hcolim⟩
  exact ShortComplex.ShortExact.mk' hexepi.1 (hookCokernel_inclusion_mono (k := k) h) hexepi.2

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.finiteHook_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_one
statement:
theorem finiteHook_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_one {a b : S} (h : a ≤ b) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (Hook.module (k := k) a b) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hrow := hookShortExact (k := k) h
  have h₁ : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (HookInfinity.module (R := k) b) 1 := inferInstance
  have h₂ : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) 2 :=
    hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ 1 2 (by omega)
  exact hrow.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃ 1 h₁ h₂

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.infiniteHook_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_one
statement:
private theorem infiniteHook_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_one (a : S) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Projective (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) := inferInstance
  have h₀ : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) 1 :=
    projective_iff_hasProjectiveDimensionLT_one.mp hp
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ 1 2 (by omega)

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.rankProjective_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_one
statement:
theorem rankProjective_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_one
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p))
    (hR : IsRankProjective M) : HasProjectiveDimensionLE M 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨J, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    (rankProjective_iff_exists_canonical_subfamily (k := k) (P := S) M hM).mp hR
  have hsum : HasProjectiveDimensionLE
      (⨁ fun i : J => FiniteHookDeflation.family M i.1) 1 := by
    apply FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_biproduct
      (C := PModule.{u,0,u} k S) (I := J)
      (F := fun i : J => FiniteHookDeflation.family M i.1) 1
    intro i
    cases i.1 with
    | inl t => exact finiteHook_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_one (k := k) t.1.property.le
    | inr t => exact infiniteHook_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_one (k := k) t.1
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT
      (⨁ fun i : J => FiniteHookDeflation.family M i.1) 2 := hsum
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso e.symm 2

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.pointwiseShortExact_toShortExact
statement:
private theorem pointwiseShortExact_toShortExact
    {A B C : PModule.{u,0,u} k S} {f : A ⟶ B} {g : B ⟶ C}
    (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact f g) :
    (ShortComplex.mk f g hs.comp_eq_zero).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  exact hs.shortExact

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.finiteRows_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
private theorem finiteRows_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    (n : ℕ) (K : Fin (n + 1) → PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    (P : Fin n → PModule.{u,0,u} k S)
    (f : ∀ i, K i.succ ⟶ P i) (g : ∀ i, P i ⟶ K i.castSucc)
    (w : ∀ i, f i ≫ g i = 0)
    (hex : ∀ i, (ShortComplex.mk (f i) (g i) (w i)).ShortExact)
    (hmiddle : ∀ i, HasProjectiveDimensionLE (P i) 1)
    (hlast : IsZero (K (Fin.last n))) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (K 0) n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have hz : IsZero (K 0) := by simpa using hlast
      letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (K 0) 0 := hz.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_zero
      exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge (K 0) 0 1 (by omega)
  | succ n ih =>
      have htail : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (K 1) n := by
        apply ih (fun i => K i.succ) (fun i => P i.succ)
          (fun i => f i.succ) (fun i => g i.succ) (fun i => w i.succ)
          (fun i => hex i.succ) (fun i => hmiddle i.succ) ?_
        simpa using hlast
      have hmid : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (P 0) 2 := hmiddle 0
      have hmid' : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (P 0) (n + 2) :=
        hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge (P 0) 2 (n + 2) (by omega)
      exact (hex 0).hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₃ (n + 1) htail hmid'

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.finiteRankProjectiveResolution_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem finiteRankProjectiveResolution_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S} (R : FiniteRankProjectiveResolution M) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE M R.length
proof:
:= by
  have hlast : IsZero (R.kernel (Fin.last R.length)) :=
    IsZero.of_iso (isZero_zero _) R.terminal_iso
  have hrows : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (R.kernel 0) R.length :=
    finiteRows_hasProjectiveDimensionLE R.length R.kernel R.term R.inclusion R.quotient
      (fun i => (R.row_rank_exact i).toIsPointwiseShortExact.comp_eq_zero)
      (fun i => pointwiseShortExact_toShortExact (R.row_rank_exact i).toIsPointwiseShortExact)
      (fun i => rankProjective_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_one (k := k) (R.term i)
        (R.row_rank_exact i).finiteDimensional (R.term_rank_projective i)) hlast
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (R.kernel 0) (R.length + 1) := hrows
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_iso R.initial_iso (R.length + 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.principalDownset_hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem principalDownset_hasProjectiveDimensionLE (p : S) :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module (k := k) p)
      (complementCard (S := S) p)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = ⊤
  · subst p
    have hHook : Projective (HookInfinity.module (R := k) (⊥ : S)) := inferInstance
    have hproj : Projective (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module (k := k) (⊤ : S)) :=
      hHook.of_iso (PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.topHookIso (k := k) (S := S)).symm
    have hzero : complementCard (⊤ : S) = 0 :=
      (complementCard_eq_zero_iff (⊤ : S)).mpr rfl
    rw [hzero]
    letI : Projective (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module (k := k) (⊤ : S)) := hproj
    exact (inferInstance : HasProjectiveDimensionLT
      (PrincipalDownsetInjective.module (k := k) (⊤ : S)) 1)
  · have hpos : 0 < complementCard (S := S) p := by
      apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
      intro hz
      exact hp ((complementCard_eq_zero_iff (S := S) p).mp hz)
    let R := PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.resolution (k := k) p
    have hR := finiteRankProjectiveResolution_hasProjectiveDimensionLE (k := k) R
    have hlen : R.length = complementCard (S := S) p := by
      rw [PrincipalDownsetRankResolution.resolution_length]
      exact max_eq_right (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hpos)
    simpa [hlen] using hR

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.injective_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_max
statement:
theorem injective_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_max
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] [Injective M] :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE M (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype (FiniteInjectivePresentation.Index (k := k) (P := S) M) :=
    FiniteInjectivePresentation.indexFintype (k := k) (P := S) M
  let I := FiniteInjectivePresentation.Index (k := k) (P := S) M
  have hsum : HasProjectiveDimensionLE
      (⨁ fun i : I => FiniteInjectivePresentation.family M i)
      (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S)) := by
    apply FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_biproduct
      (C := PModule.{u,0,u} k S) (I := I)
      (F := fun i : I => FiniteInjectivePresentation.family M i)
      (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S))
    intro i
    have hp := principalDownset_hasProjectiveDimensionLE (k := k) i.1
    letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (FiniteInjectivePresentation.family M i)
        (complementCard (S := S) i.1 + 1) := hp
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ _ _
      (Nat.succ_le_succ (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.complementCard_le_maxComplementCard
        (S := S) i.1))
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT
      (FiniteInjectivePresentation.module M)
      (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S) + 1) := by
    change HasProjectiveDimensionLT
      (⨁ fun i : I => FiniteInjectivePresentation.family M i)
      (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S) + 1)
    exact hsum
  exact (show Retract M (FiniteInjectivePresentation.module M) from
    ⟨FiniteInjectivePresentation.embedding M,
      FiniteInjectivePresentation.retraction M,
      FiniteInjectivePresentation.embedding_retraction M⟩).hasProjectiveDimensionLT _

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.uniformBound_improve
statement:
private theorem uniformBound_improve {d : ℕ}
    (hD : FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S) ≤ d)
    (hU : UniformBound (k := k) (S := S) (d + 1)) :
    UniformBound (k := k) (S := S) d
proof:
:= by
  intro M hM
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hM
  let Q := TwoInjectivePresentation.quotient M
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (Q.obj p) :=
    TwoInjectivePresentation.quotient_finiteDimensional M
  let R := TwoInjectivePresentation.cokernelRow M
  have hrow := pointwiseShortExact_toShortExact (k := k) R
  have hI : HasProjectiveDimensionLE (TwoInjectivePresentation.firstInjective M)
      (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S)) :=
    injective_hasProjectiveDimensionLE_of_max (k := k)
      (TwoInjectivePresentation.firstInjective M)
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (TwoInjectivePresentation.firstInjective M)
      (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S) + 1) := hI
  have hI' : HasProjectiveDimensionLT (TwoInjectivePresentation.firstInjective M) (d + 1) :=
    hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge _ _ _ (Nat.succ_le_succ hD)
  have hQ : HasProjectiveDimensionLE Q (d + 1) := hU Q
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT Q (d + 2) := hQ
  exact hrow.hasProjectiveDimensionLT_X₁ (d + 1) hI' inferInstance

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.uniformBound_descend
statement:
private theorem uniformBound_descend (q : ℕ) :
    UniformBound (k := k) (S := S)
      (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S) + q) →
    UniformBound (k := k) (S := S)
      (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  induction q with
  | zero => simpa
  | succ q ih =>
      intro h
      have h' : UniformBound (k := k) (S := S)
          ((FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S) + q) + 1) := by
        simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using h
      have hstep := uniformBound_improve (k := k) (S := S)
        (d := FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S) + q)
        (by omega) h'
      exact ih hstep

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE M (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S))
proof:
:= by
  let N := 3 * Fintype.card S + 2
  have hfinite : UniformBound (k := k) (S := S) N := by
    intro X hX
    letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (X.obj p) := hX
    obtain ⟨R, hlen⟩ :=
      TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.exists_finiteRankProjectiveResolution_with_recorded_length
      (k := k) X hX
    have hR := finiteRankProjectiveResolution_hasProjectiveDimensionLE (k := k) R
    simpa [N, hlen] using hR
  have hlift : UniformBound (k := k) (S := S)
      (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S) + N) := by
    intro X hX
    letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (X.obj p) := hX
    letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT X (N + 1) := hfinite X
    exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge X (N + 1)
      (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard (S := S) + N + 1) (by omega)
  exact uniformBound_descend (k := k) (S := S) N hlift M

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_coordinateGrid
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_coordinateGrid
    {n : ℕ} (G : CoordinateGrid n) (hG : ∀ i : Fin n, (G i).Nonempty)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE M n
proof:
:= by
  letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
  have hcount := maxComplementCard_coordinateGrid_le G hG
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT M (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard
      (S := G.Point) + 1) := hasProjectiveDimensionLE (k := k) M
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge M _ _ (Nat.succ_le_succ hcount)

name: TDA.Persistence.OrdinaryFiniteLatticeDimension.hasProjectiveDimensionLE_pairCoordinateGrid
statement:
theorem hasProjectiveDimensionLE_pairCoordinateGrid
    {n : ℕ} (G : CoordinateGrid n) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hG : ∀ i : Fin n, (G i).Nonempty)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset G.Point))
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
    letI : Lattice (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset G.Point) :=
      pairPosetLattice (S := G.Point)
    letI : BoundedOrder (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset G.Point) :=
      pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := G.Point)
    HasProjectiveDimensionLE M (2 * n)
proof:
:= by
  letI : BoundedOrder G.Point := coordinateGridBoundedOrder G hG
  letI : Lattice (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset G.Point) :=
    pairPosetLattice (S := G.Point)
  letI : BoundedOrder (FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset G.Point) :=
    pairPosetBoundedOrder (S := G.Point)
  have hcount := maxComplementCard_pair_coordinateGrid_le G hn hG
  letI : HasProjectiveDimensionLT M (FiniteInjectiveRankDimension.maxComplementCard
      (S := FiniteRankProjectiveEndAlgebra.PairPoset G.Point) + 1) :=
    hasProjectiveDimensionLE (k := k) M
  exact hasProjectiveDimensionLT_of_ge M _ _ (Nat.succ_le_succ hcount)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.exponent_ge_one
statement: private theorem exponent_ge_one (t : ℝ) : 1 ≤ exponent t
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [exponent]
  linarith [sq_nonneg t]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.exponent_pos
statement: private theorem exponent_pos (t : ℝ) : 0 < exponent t
proof:
:=
  zero_lt_one.trans_le (exponent_ge_one t)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.exponent_continuous
statement: private theorem exponent_continuous : Continuous exponent
proof:
:=
  continuous_const.add (continuous_id.pow 2)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.costsAt_of_matching
proof:
:=
  ⟨hpower, hroot, by simpa only [finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using hpower,
    by simpa only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using hroot⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.four_path_costs_continuous
statement:
private theorem four_path_costs_continuous {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    (x : ℝ → I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : ℝ → J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : Continuous x) (hy : Continuous y) : fourPathCostsContinuous x y
proof:
:= by
  have htuple : Continuous (fun t => (exponent t, (x t, y t))) :=
    exponent_continuous.prodMk (hx.prodMk hy)
  have hpower := (finitePowerMatchingCost_joint_continuousOn (I := I) (J := J)).comp_continuous
    htuple exponent_ge_one
  have hroot := (finitePMatchingCost_joint_continuousOn (I := I) (J := J)).comp_continuous
    htuple exponent_ge_one
  have hplanPower :=
    (finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_joint_continuousOn (I := I) (J := J)).comp_continuous
      htuple exponent_ge_one
  have hplanRoot :=
    (finitePBoundaryTransportCost_joint_continuousOn (I := I) (J := J)).comp_continuous
      htuple exponent_ge_one
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hpower
  · simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hroot
  · simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hplanPower
  · simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hplanRoot

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.four_joint_continuousWithinAt
statement:
private theorem four_joint_continuousWithinAt {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    fourJointContinuousWithinAt p x y
proof:
:=
  ⟨finitePowerMatchingCost_joint_continuousOn _ hp,
    finitePMatchingCost_joint_continuousOn _ hp,
    finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost_joint_continuousOn _ hp,
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost_joint_continuousOn _ hp⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.empty_values
statement:
private theorem empty_values {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p) :
    costsAt p emptyFamily emptyFamily 0 0
proof:
:= by
  apply costsAt_of_matching (finitePowerMatchingCost_empty _ _ _)
  rw [finitePMatchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_empty,
    Real.zero_rpow (inv_ne_zero hp.ne')]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.empty_joint_and_path_continuity
statement:
private theorem empty_joint_and_path_continuity :
    fourJointContinuousWithinAt 1 emptyFamily emptyFamily ∧
    fourJointContinuousWithinAt (3 / 2) emptyFamily emptyFamily ∧
    fourPathCostsContinuous (fun _ => emptyFamily) (fun _ => emptyFamily) ∧
    ∀ t, costsAt (exponent t) emptyFamily emptyFamily 0 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨four_joint_continuousWithinAt le_rfl _ _,
    four_joint_continuousWithinAt (by norm_num) _ _,
    four_path_costs_continuous _ _ continuous_const continuous_const,
    fun t => empty_values (exponent_pos t)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.moving_positive
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro i <;> dsimp [movingSource, movingTarget] <;> linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.moving_lifetimes_and_nonconstant
statement:
private theorem moving_lifetimes_and_nonconstant :
    (∀ t i, (movingSource t i).2 - (movingSource t i).1 = 2) ∧
    (∀ t j, (movingTarget t j).2 - (movingTarget t j).1 = 2) ∧
    exponent 0 ≠ exponent 1 ∧ movingSource 0 ≠ movingSource 1 ∧ movingTarget 0 ≠ movingTarget 1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, by norm_num [exponent], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t i
    dsimp [movingSource]
    ring
  · intro t j
    dsimp [movingTarget]
    ring
  · intro h
    have he := congrArg (fun f : Fin 1 → ℝ × ℝ => (f 0).1) h
    norm_num [movingSource] at he
  · intro h
    have he := congrArg (fun f : Fin 1 → ℝ × ℝ => (f 0).1) h
    norm_num [movingTarget] at he

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.moving_charges
statement:
private theorem moving_charges (t : ℝ) :
    (finitePairCost (movingSource t 0) (movingTarget t 0)).toReal = 2 * |t| ∧
    (diagonalCost (movingSource t 0)).toReal = 1 ∧
    (diagonalCost (movingTarget t 0)).toReal = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hb : t - -t = 2 * t := by ring
  have hd : (t + 2) - (2 - t) = 2 * t := by ring
  have hs : (t + 2) - t = 2 := by ring
  have ht : (2 - t) - -t = 2 := by ring
  norm_num [movingSource, movingTarget, finitePairCost, diagonalCost, hb, hd, hs, ht,
    abs_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal, mul_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (abs_nonneg t)]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.moving_values
statement:
private theorem moving_values (t : ℝ) :
    costsAt (exponent t) (movingSource t) (movingTarget t)
      (min ((2 * |t|) ^ exponent t) 2)
      ((min ((2 * |t|) ^ exponent t) 2) ^ (exponent t)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hc := moving_charges t
  have hpower : finitePowerMatchingCost (exponent t) (movingSource t) (movingTarget t) =
      min ((2 * |t|) ^ exponent t) 2 := by
    unfold movingSource movingTarget at hc ⊢
    rw [finitePowerMatchingCost_singleton, hc.1, hc.2.1, hc.2.2]
    norm_num
  exact costsAt_of_matching hpower (by rw [finitePMatchingCost, hpower])

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.moving_path_continuity
statement: private theorem moving_path_continuity : fourPathCostsContinuous movingSource movingTarget
proof:
:= by
  apply four_path_costs_continuous
  · exact continuous_pi (fun _ => continuous_id.prodMk (continuous_id.add continuous_const))
  · exact continuous_pi (fun _ => continuous_id.neg.prodMk (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.moving_zero_values
statement:
private theorem moving_zero_values :

proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.moving_half_candidates
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by norm_num [exponent], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · norm_num [pairingPower, exponent, movingSource, movingTarget,
      FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.pairSingletons, OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost,
      OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost, finitePairCost, diagonalCost]
  · norm_num [deletingPower, exponent, movingSource, movingTarget,
      FiniteBoundaryPlan.powerCost, FiniteBoundaryPlan.linearCost, FiniteBoundaryPlan.zero,
      FiniteBoundaryPlan.deletionMass, FiniteBoundaryPlan.insertionMass, finitePairCost, diagonalCost]
  · simpa [exponent] using moving_values (1 / 2)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.moving_one_candidates
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨by norm_num [exponent], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · norm_num [pairingPower, exponent, movingSource, movingTarget,
      FinitePBoundaryTransportExamples.pairSingletons, OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost,
      OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost, finitePairCost, diagonalCost, Real.rpow_two]
  · norm_num [deletingPower, exponent, movingSource, movingTarget,
      FiniteBoundaryPlan.powerCost, FiniteBoundaryPlan.linearCost, FiniteBoundaryPlan.zero,
      FiniteBoundaryPlan.deletionMass, FiniteBoundaryPlan.insertionMass,
      finitePairCost, diagonalCost, Real.rpow_two]
  · have h := moving_values 1
    norm_num [exponent, Real.rpow_two] at h
    simpa only [show exponent 1 = 2 by norm_num [exponent]] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.moving_optimizer_switch
statement:
private theorem moving_optimizer_switch :
    pairingPower (1 / 2) = finitePowerMatchingCost (exponent (1 / 2))
      (movingSource (1 / 2)) (movingTarget (1 / 2)) ∧
    pairingPower (1 / 2) < deletingPower (1 / 2) ∧
    deletingPower 1 = finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost (exponent 1) (movingSource 1) (movingTarget 1) ∧
    deletingPower 1 < pairingPower 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [moving_half_candidates.2.1, moving_half_candidates.2.2.1,
    moving_half_candidates.2.2.2.1, moving_one_candidates.2.1,
    moving_one_candidates.2.2.1, moving_one_candidates.2.2.2.2.2.1]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.repeated_positive_and_labels
proof:
:= by

  intro i
  dsimp [repeated]
  linarith [exponent_pos t]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.repeated_charge
statement:
private theorem repeated_charge (t : ℝ) (i : Fin 2) :
    (diagonalCost (repeated t i)).toReal = exponent t
proof:
:= by
  have h : (t + 2 * exponent t) - t = 2 * exponent t := by ring
  have hp := exponent_pos t
  simp [repeated, diagonalCost, h, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * exponent t),
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp.le]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.repeated_values
statement:
private theorem repeated_values (t : ℝ) :
    costsAt (exponent t) (repeated t) emptyFamily
      (2 * exponent t ^ exponent t) ((2 * exponent t ^ exponent t) ^ (exponent t)⁻¹) ∧
    costsAt (exponent t) emptyFamily (repeated t)
      (2 * exponent t ^ exponent t) ((2 * exponent t ^ exponent t) ^ (exponent t)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : finitePowerMatchingCost (exponent t) (repeated t) emptyFamily =
      2 * exponent t ^ exponent t := by
    rw [finitePowerMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, repeated_charge]
    ring
  have hl : finitePowerMatchingCost (exponent t) emptyFamily (repeated t) =
      2 * exponent t ^ exponent t := by
    rw [finitePowerMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_left]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_two, repeated_charge]
    ring
  exact ⟨costsAt_of_matching hr (by rw [finitePMatchingCost, hr]),
    costsAt_of_matching hl (by rw [finitePMatchingCost, hl])⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.repeated_path_continuity
proof:
:= by
  have hr : Continuous repeated := continuous_pi (fun _ => continuous_id.prodMk
    (continuous_id.add (continuous_const.mul exponent_continuous)))
  exact ⟨four_path_costs_continuous _ _ hr continuous_const,
    four_path_costs_continuous _ _ continuous_const hr⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.crossing_charge
statement:
private theorem crossing_charge (t : ℝ) :
    (diagonalCost (crossing t 0)).toReal = |t|
proof:
:= by
  have h : -t - t = (-2 : ℝ) * t := by ring
  rw [diagonalCost, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (div_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (by norm_num))]
  dsimp [crossing]
  rw [h, abs_mul]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.crossing_values
statement:
private theorem crossing_values (t : ℝ) :
    costsAt (exponent t) (crossing t) emptyFamily (|t| ^ exponent t) |t|
proof:
:= by
  have hp : finitePowerMatchingCost (exponent t) (crossing t) emptyFamily = |t| ^ exponent t := by
    rw [finitePowerMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right]
    simpa using congrArg (fun a : ℝ => a ^ exponent t) (crossing_charge t)
  apply costsAt_of_matching hp
  rw [finitePMatchingCost, hp]
  exact Real.rpow_rpow_inv (abs_nonneg t) (exponent_pos t).ne'

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.crossing_classification
statement:
private theorem crossing_classification :
    (∀ t, t < 0 → ∀ i, (crossing t i).1 < (crossing t i).2) ∧
    (∀ i, (crossing 0 i).1 = (crossing 0 i).2) ∧
    (∀ t, 0 < t → ∀ i, (crossing t i).2 < (crossing t i).1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t ht i
    dsimp [crossing]
    linarith
  · intro i
    simp [crossing]
  · intro t ht i
    dsimp [crossing]
    linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.crossing_path_continuity
statement:

    fourPathCostsContinuous crossing (fun _ => emptyFamily)

    (continuous_pi (fun _ => continuous_id.prodMk continuous_id.neg)) continuous_const

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.empty_zero_exponent

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.moving_identical_powered
proof:
:= by

    unfold movingSource

    have hd : q + 2 - q = 2 := by ring

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.tendsto_zero_of_positive_values
statement:
private theorem tendsto_zero_of_positive_values {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : ∀ q, 0 < q → f q = 0) : Tendsto f (𝓝[Set.Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with q hq
  exact (hf q hq).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.zero_boundary_limits
statement:
private theorem zero_boundary_limits :
    Tendsto (fun q : ℝ => finitePMatchingCost q emptyFamily emptyFamily)
      (𝓝[Set.Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧
    Tendsto (fun q : ℝ => finitePBoundaryTransportCost q emptyFamily emptyFamily)
      (𝓝[Set.Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧
    Tendsto (fun q : ℝ => finitePowerMatchingCost q (movingSource q) (movingSource q))
      (𝓝[Set.Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 0) ∧
    Tendsto (fun q : ℝ => finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost q (movingSource q) (movingSource q))
      (𝓝[Set.Ioi 0] 0) (𝓝 0)
proof:
:=
  ⟨tendsto_zero_of_positive_values (fun _ hq => (empty_values hq).2.1),
    tendsto_zero_of_positive_values (fun _ hq => (empty_values hq).2.2.2),
    tendsto_zero_of_positive_values (fun _ hq => (moving_identical_powered hq).1),
    tendsto_zero_of_positive_values (fun _ hq => (moving_identical_powered hq).2)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePCostJointContinuityExamples.zero_boundary_values_differ_from_limits
statement:
private theorem zero_boundary_values_differ_from_limits :
    finitePMatchingCost 0 emptyFamily emptyFamily ≠ 0 ∧
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost 0 emptyFamily emptyFamily ≠ 0 ∧
    finitePowerMatchingCost 0 (movingSource 0) (movingSource 0) ≠ 0 ∧
    finitePowerBoundaryTransportCost 0 (movingSource 0) (movingSource 0) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [empty_zero_exponent.2.1, empty_zero_exponent.2.2.2,
    moving_identical_zero_exponent.1, moving_identical_zero_exponent.2]
