name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.pixelIntegral_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem pixelIntegral_apply (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (k : K) :
    pixelIntegral P f k = ∫ z in P k, f z
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_pixelIntegral_le
statement:
theorem norm_pixelIntegral_le (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (f : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f) :
    ‖pixelIntegral P f‖ ≤ ∫ z, |f z|
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [PiLp.norm_eq_of_L1]
  change (∑ k, |∫ z in P k, f z|) ≤ _
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ k, ∫ z in P k, |f z| := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro k _
      simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
        norm_integral_le_integral_norm (f := f) (μ := volume.restrict (P k))
    _ = ∫ z in ⋃ k, P k, |f z| :=
      (integral_iUnion_fintype hm hd (fun _ => hf.abs.integrableOn)).symm
    _ ≤ _ := setIntegral_le_integral hf.abs (ae_of_all _ (fun z => abs_nonneg (f z)))

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_pixelIntegral_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_pixelIntegral_sub_le (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (f g : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ) (hf : Integrable f) (hg : Integrable g) :
    ‖pixelIntegral P f - pixelIntegral P g‖ ≤ ∫ z, |f z - g z|
proof:
:= by
  have he : pixelIntegral P f - pixelIntegral P g = pixelIntegral P (fun z => f z - g z) := by
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro k
    change (∫ z in P k, f z) - (∫ z in P k, g z) = ∫ z in P k, f z - g z
    exact (integral_sub hf.integrableOn hg.integrableOn).symm
  rw [he]
  exact norm_pixelIntegral_le P hm hd _ (hf.sub hg)

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_gaussianPixels_le_one
statement:
theorem norm_gaussianPixels_le_one {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (u : ℝ × ℝ) : ‖pixelIntegral P (density2D σ u)‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ z, |density2D σ u z| :=
      norm_pixelIntegral_le P hm hd _ (integrable_density2D σ u)
    _ = 1 := by
      simp_rw [abs_of_nonneg (density2D_nonneg σ u _)]
      exact integral_density2D hσ u

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_gaussianPixels_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_gaussianPixels_sub_le {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (u v : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖pixelIntegral P (density2D σ u) - pixelIntegral P (density2D σ v)‖ ≤
      translationConstant σ * (|u.1 - v.1| + |u.2 - v.2|)
proof:
:=
  (norm_pixelIntegral_sub_le P hm hd _ _ (integrable_density2D σ u)
    (integrable_density2D σ v)).trans (integral_abs_density2D_sub_le hσ u v)

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.feature_apply
statement:
theorem feature_apply {A B : ℝ} (σ : ℝ) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (k : K) :
    feature σ w P p k = ∫ z in P k, w (birthPersistence p) *
      density2D σ (birthPersistence p) z
proof:
:= by
  change w (birthPersistence p) * (∫ z in P k, density2D σ (birthPersistence p) z) = _
  exact (integral_const_mul _ _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.integrable_weighted_density
statement:
theorem integrable_weighted_density {A B : ℝ} (σ : ℝ) (w : Weight A B)
    (p : ℝ × ℝ) : Integrable (fun z => w (birthPersistence p) *
      density2D σ (birthPersistence p) z)
proof:
:=
  (integrable_density2D σ (birthPersistence p)).const_mul _

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_feature_le_weight
statement:
theorem norm_feature_le_weight {σ A B : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖feature σ w P p‖ ≤ w (birthPersistence p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [feature, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (w.nonneg _)]
  simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (norm_gaussianPixels_le_one hσ P hm hd (birthPersistence p)) (w.nonneg _)

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.birthPersistence_l1_sub_le
statement:
theorem birthPersistence_l1_sub_le (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    |(birthPersistence p).1 - (birthPersistence q).1| +
      |(birthPersistence p).2 - (birthPersistence q).2| ≤ 3 * ‖p - q‖
proof:
:= by
  have ht : |(p.2 - q.2) - (p.1 - q.1)| ≤ |p.2 - q.2| + |p.1 - q.1| := by
    simpa only [sub_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg] using
      abs_sub_le (p.2 - q.2) 0 (p.1 - q.1)
  simp only [birthPersistence, Prod.norm_def, Prod.fst_sub, Prod.snd_sub, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [show p.2 - p.1 - (q.2 - q.1) = (p.2 - q.2) - (p.1 - q.1) by ring]
  have h₁ := le_max_left |p.1 - q.1| |p.2 - q.2|
  have h₂ := le_max_right |p.1 - q.1| |p.2 - q.2|
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_nonneg
statement:
theorem stabilityConstant_nonneg {σ A B : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) :
    0 ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B
proof:
:= by
  unfold stabilityConstant
  have hc := translationConstant_nonneg hσ
  positivity

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_feature_sub_le
statement:
theorem norm_feature_sub_le {σ A B : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : Weight A B) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) (p q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖feature σ w P p - feature σ w P q‖ ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B * ‖p - q‖
proof:
:= by
  let u := birthPersistence p
  let v := birthPersistence q
  let G := fun a => pixelIntegral P (density2D σ a)
  have hc := translationConstant_nonneg hσ
  have hv : ‖G v‖ ≤ 1 := norm_gaussianPixels_le_one hσ P hm hd v
  have hg : ‖G u - G v‖ ≤ (3 * translationConstant σ) * ‖p - q‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ translationConstant σ * (|u.1 - v.1| + |u.2 - v.2|) :=
        norm_gaussianPixels_sub_le hσ P hm hd u v
      _ ≤ translationConstant σ * (3 * ‖p - q‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (birthPersistence_l1_sub_le p q) hc
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hw : |w u - w v| ≤ (2 * A) * ‖p - q‖ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ A * ‖u - v‖ := w.lipschitz u v
      _ ≤ A * (2 * ‖p - q‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_birthPersistence_sub_le p q) hA
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hwb : |w u| ≤ B := by rw [abs_of_nonneg (w.nonneg _)]; exact w.bounded _
  have he : feature σ w P p - feature σ w P q =
      (w u - w v) • G v + w u • (G u - G v) := by
    dsimp [feature, G, u, v]
    module
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖(w u - w v) • G v‖ + ‖w u • (G u - G v)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ = |w u - w v| * ‖G v‖ + |w u| * ‖G u - G v‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    _ ≤ ((2 * A) * ‖p - q‖) * 1 + B * ((3 * translationConstant σ) * ‖p - q‖) :=
      add_le_add (mul_le_mul hw hv (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
        (mul_le_mul hwb hg (norm_nonneg _) hB)
    _ = _ := by unfold stabilityConstant; ring

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_feature_diagonal_le
statement:
theorem norm_feature_diagonal_le {σ A B : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : Weight A B) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) (p : ℝ × ℝ) (hp : p.1 < p.2) :
    ‖feature σ w P p‖ ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B * (diagonalCost p).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hw := w.lipschitz (birthPersistence p) (p.1, 0)
  have ht : ‖birthPersistence p - (p.1, 0)‖ = p.2 - p.1 := by
    simp [birthPersistence, Prod.norm_def, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hp)]
    exact hp.le
  rw [w.zero_persistence, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (w.nonneg _), ht] at hw
  have hcost : (diagonalCost p).toReal = (p.2 - p.1) / 2 := by
    rw [diagonalCost_toReal, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hp)]
  have hC : 2 * A ≤ stabilityConstant σ A B := by
    unfold stabilityConstant
    have hc := translationConstant_nonneg hσ
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ 3 * B * translationConstant σ := by positivity
    linarith
  calc
    _ ≤ w (birthPersistence p) := norm_feature_le_weight hσ w P hm hd p
    _ ≤ A * (p.2 - p.1) := hw
    _ = (2 * A) * (diagonalCost p).toReal := by rw [hcost]; ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC ENNReal.toReal_nonneg

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.image_apply
statement:
theorem image_apply {I : Type*} [Fintype I] {A B : ℝ} (σ : ℝ) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (k : K) :
    image σ w P x k = ∫ z in P k, ∑ i, w (birthPersistence (x i)) *
      density2D σ (birthPersistence (x i)) z
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsum (s : Finset I) : (∑ i ∈ s, feature σ w P (x i)) k =
      ∑ i ∈ s, feature σ w P (x i) k := by
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => simp
    | @insert i s hi ih => simp [Finset.sum_insert hi, PiLp.add_apply, ih]
  change (∑ i, feature σ w P (x i)) k = _
  rw [hsum]
  simp_rw [feature_apply]
  exact (integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ =>
    (integrable_weighted_density σ w (x i)).integrableOn)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceImage.norm_image_sub_le_matching
statement:
theorem norm_image_sub_le_matching {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J]
    {σ A B : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ k, MeasurableSet (P k))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j)))
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, (x i).1 < (x i).2) (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 < (y j).2) :
    ‖image σ w P x - image σ w P y‖ ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B * M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:=
  M.norm_featureSum_sub_le (feature σ w P) (stabilityConstant σ A B)
    (stabilityConstant_nonneg hσ hA hB)
    (fun p q _ _ => norm_feature_sub_le hσ hA hB w P hm hd p q)
    (fun p hp => norm_feature_diagonal_le hσ hB w P hm hd p hp) x y hx hy

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.Refines.refl
statement: theorem Refines.refl (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) : Refines c c
proof: := Set.Subset.refl _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.Refines.trans
statement:
theorem Refines.trans {c : Fin n ↪o ℝ} {d : Fin m ↪o ℝ} {e : Fin l ↪o ℝ}
    (h : Refines c d) (h' : Refines d e) : Refines c e
proof: := Set.Subset.trans h h'

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.Refines.embedding_value
statement:
@[simp] theorem Refines.embedding_value {c : Fin n ↪o ℝ} {d : Fin m ↪o ℝ}
    (h : Refines c d) (i : Fin n) : d (h.embedding i) = c i
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (h ⟨i, rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.Refines.embedding_unique
statement:
theorem Refines.embedding_unique {c : Fin n ↪o ℝ} {d : Fin m ↪o ℝ}
    (h : Refines c d) (e : Fin n ↪o Fin m) (he : ∀ i, d (e i) = c i) : e = h.embedding
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.ext
  intro i
  apply d.injective
  rw [he, h.embedding_value]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.range_commonGrid
statement:
theorem range_commonGrid (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (d : Fin m ↪o ℝ) :
    Set.range (commonGrid c d) = Set.range c ∪ Set.range d
proof:
:= by
  rw [commonGrid, Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
  ext x
  simp [criticalValues]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.refines_commonGrid_left
statement:
theorem refines_commonGrid_left (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (d : Fin m ↪o ℝ) :
    Refines c (commonGrid c d)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [range_commonGrid]
  exact Or.inl hx

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.refines_commonGrid_right
statement:
theorem refines_commonGrid_right (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (d : Fin m ↪o ℝ) :
    Refines d (commonGrid c d)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [range_commonGrid]
  exact Or.inr hx

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_eq_of_refines
proof:
:= by
  have hp (i : Fin n) : c i ≤ s ↔ c i ≤ t := by
    rw [← h.embedding_value i, ← lt_cellIndex_iff d (h.embedding i) s,
      ← lt_cellIndex_iff d (h.embedding i) t, hd]
  apply Fin.ext
  change (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => c i ≤ s)).card =
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => c i ≤ t)).card
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  exact hp i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.IsConstructible.refine
proof:
:= hM.zero_left t (fun i => by
    simpa only [h.embedding_value] using ht (h.embedding i))
  isIso_map s t hst hd := hM.isIso_map s t hst (cellIndex_eq_of_refines h hd)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.shiftGrid_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftGrid_apply (ε : ℝ≥0) (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    shiftGrid ε c i = c i - (ε : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.shiftGrid_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem shiftGrid_zero (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) : shiftGrid 0 c = c
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_shiftGrid
statement:
theorem cellIndex_shiftGrid (ε : ℝ≥0) (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    cellIndex (shiftGrid ε c) t = cellIndex c (t + (ε : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  change (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => c i - (ε : ℝ) ≤ t)).card =
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => c i ≤ t + (ε : ℝ))).card
  congr 1
  ext i
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.IsConstructible.shift
statement:
theorem IsConstructible.shift {c : Fin n ↪o ℝ}
    (hM : IsConstructible c M) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    IsConstructible (shiftGrid ε c) ((shift ε).obj M) where
  zero_left t ht
proof:
:= hM.zero_left (t + (ε : ℝ)) (fun i =>
    (lt_sub_iff_add_lt).mp (ht i))
  isIso_map s t hst hd := by
    change IsIso (structureMap M (add_le_add hst le_rfl))
    apply hM.isIso_map
    simpa only [cellIndex_shiftGrid] using hd

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.common_shift_constructible
statement:
theorem common_shift_constructible {c : Fin n ↪o ℝ} {d : Fin m ↪o ℝ}
    (hM : IsConstructible c M) (hN : IsConstructible d N) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    IsConstructible (commonGrid c (shiftGrid ε d)) M ∧
      IsConstructible (commonGrid c (shiftGrid ε d)) ((shift ε).obj N)
proof:
:=
  ⟨hM.refine (refines_commonGrid_left _ _),
    (hN.shift ε).refine (refines_commonGrid_right _ _)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsQTameExamples.empty_qTame
statement:
theorem empty_qTame (k : Type*) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace (∅ : Set ℝ))) n).QTame
proof:
:= by
  apply Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded
  apply Metric.totallyBounded_iff.mpr
  intro ε _
  exact ⟨∅, Set.finite_empty, fun x _ => False.elim x.property⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsQTameExamples.unitInterval_qTame
statement:
theorem unitInterval_qTame (k : Type*) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace UnitInterval)) n).QTame
proof:
:=
  Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded k isCompact_univ.totallyBounded n

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsQTameExamples.unitInterval_zero_not_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem unitInterval_zero_not_finiteDimensional (k : Type*) [Field k] :
    ¬ FiniteDimensional k
      ((sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace UnitInterval)) 0).obj 0)

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteKernel_ι_fiberIso
statement:
theorem finiteKernel_ι_fiberIso (f : M ⟶ N) (i : Fin s) :
    (finiteKernelFiberIso f i).inv ≫ (kernel.ι f).app i =
      ModuleCat.ofHom (LinearMap.ker (f.app i).hom).subtype
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finiteKernelFiberIso, Iso.trans_inv]
  have hp := PreservesKernel.iso_inv_ι ((evaluation (Fin s) (ModuleCat k)).obj i) f
  change (PreservesKernel.iso ((evaluation (Fin s) (ModuleCat k)).obj i) f).inv ≫
    (kernel.ι f).app i = kernel.ι (f.app i) at hp
  rw [Category.assoc, hp, ModuleCat.kernelIsoKer_inv_kernel_ι]

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteKernel_ι_range
statement:
theorem finiteKernel_ι_range (f : M ⟶ N) (i : Fin s) :
    LinearMap.range ((kernel.ι f).app i).hom = LinearMap.ker (f.app i).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun g : finiteKernel f ⟶ N => (g.app i).hom z) (kernel.condition f)
    exact h
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨(finiteKernelFiberIso f i).inv.hom ⟨x, hx⟩, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg (fun g : ModuleCat.of k (LinearMap.ker (f.app i).hom) ⟶ M.obj i =>
      g.hom ⟨x, hx⟩) (finiteKernel_ι_fiberIso f i)

name: TDA.Persistence.finiteKernel_map_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem finiteKernel_map_eq_zero_iff (f : M ⟶ N) {a b : Fin s} (h : a ≤ b) :
    structureMap (finiteKernel f) h = 0 ↔
      LinearMap.ker (f.app a).hom ≤ LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M h)
proof:
:= by
  have hn := (kernel.ι f).naturality (homOfLE h)
  change structureMap (finiteKernel f) h ≫ (kernel.ι f).app b =
    (kernel.ι f).app a ≫ structureMap M h at hn
  constructor
  · intro hz x hx
    rw [← finiteKernel_ι_range f a] at hx
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hx
    have he := congrArg (fun g : (finiteKernel f).obj a ⟶ M.obj b => g.hom z) hn
    rw [hz, zero_comp] at he
    exact he.symm
  · intro hk
    apply (cancel_mono ((kernel.ι f).app b)).mp
    rw [zero_comp, hn]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro z
    exact hk (by rw [← finiteKernel_ι_range f a]; exact ⟨z, rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.kernel_translationTrivial_iff
statement:
theorem kernel_translationTrivial_iff (theta : Fin s →o Fin s)
    (hTheta : ∀ i, i ≤ theta i) (f : M ⟶ N) :
    TranslationTrivial theta hTheta (finiteKernel f) ↔
      ∀ i, LinearMap.ker (f.app i).hom ≤ LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M (hTheta i))
proof:
:=
  forall_congr' (fun i => finiteKernel_map_eq_zero_iff f (hTheta i))

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.hw
statement: private theorem hw (x : UpperPoint) : 0 < upperWeight w x
proof:
:=
  upperWeight_arctan_pos (by norm_num) x

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.weight_value
statement:
private theorem weight_value (x : UpperPoint) :
    upperWeight w x = Real.arctan (x.val.2 - x.val.1)
proof:
:=
  PersistenceImage.arctanWeight_birthPersistence 1 (by norm_num) x.property.le |>.trans
    (by simp)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.arctan_feature_evaluation
statement:
theorem arctan_feature_evaluation :
    T 1 (baseFeature (upperKernel 1) p) q = Real.arctan 2 * Real.exp (-1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [upperWeightIsometry_apply, baseFeature_apply, weight_value]
  norm_num [upperKernel, kernel, p, q]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.arctan_center_section
statement:
theorem arctan_center_section :
    T 1 (Real.arctan 1 • baseFeature (upperKernel 1) p) =
      weightedFeature (upperKernel 1) (upperWeight w) p
proof:
:= by
  have h := weightIsometry_smul_baseFeature (upperKernel 1) (upperWeight w)
    (fun x => (hw x).ne') p
  simpa only [weight_value, p, sub_zero, T, upperWeightIsometry] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.arctan_section_inverse_norm
statement:
theorem arctan_section_inverse_norm :
    (T 1).symm (weightedFeature (upperKernel 1) (upperWeight w) p) q =
      weightedFeature (upperKernel 1) (upperWeight w) p q / Real.arctan 2 ∧
    ‖T 1 (baseFeature (upperKernel 1) p)‖ = ‖baseFeature (upperKernel 1) p‖
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simpa [T, arctanUpperWeightIsometry, weight_value, q] using
      upperWeightIsometry_symm_apply 1 w (upperWeight_arctan_pos (by norm_num))
        (weightedFeature (upperKernel 1) (upperWeight w) p) q
  · exact (T 1).norm_map _

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.arctan_completed_inverse
statement:
theorem arctan_completed_inverse (f : UpperSpace 1) (F : WeightedUpperSpace 1 w)
    (x : UpperPoint) :
    T 1 f x = upperWeight w x * f x ∧
    (T 1).symm F x = F x / upperWeight w x ∧
    (T 1).symm (T 1 f) = f ∧ T 1 ((T 1).symm F) = F
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨upperWeightIsometry_apply 1 w hw f x,
    upperWeightIsometry_symm_apply 1 w hw F x,
    (T 1).symm_apply_apply f, (T 1).apply_symm_apply F⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.arctan_weights_approach_zero
statement:
theorem arctan_weights_approach_zero (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ x : UpperPoint, 0 < upperWeight w x ∧ upperWeight w x < ε
proof:
:= by
  let x : UpperPoint := ⟨(0, ε / 2), by dsimp; linarith⟩
  refine ⟨x, upperWeight_arctan_pos (by norm_num) x, ?_⟩
  have h := w.lipschitz (birthPersistence x.val) (0, 0)
  have hz := w.zero_persistence 0
  have hn := w.nonneg (birthPersistence x.val)
  simp only [hz, sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hn] at h
  have hx : ‖birthPersistence x.val - (0, 0)‖ = ε / 2 := by
    simp [x, birthPersistence, Prod.norm_def, abs_of_pos hε,
      max_eq_right (by linarith : 0 ≤ ε / 2)]
  rw [hx] at h
  change w (birthPersistence x.val) < ε
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.finite_distance_formula
statement:
private theorem finite_distance_formula (σ : ℝ) :
    ‖embedding σ w (fun i => (twice i).val) -
      embedding σ w (fun j => (once j).val)‖ ^ 2 =
    4 * (Real.arctan 2) ^ 2 + (Real.arctan 3) ^ 2 -
      4 * Real.arctan 2 * Real.arctan 3 * Real.exp (-1 / (2 * σ ^ 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_embedding_sub_sq]
  norm_num [linearKernel, twice, once, w, PersistenceImage.arctanWeight_apply,
    birthPersistence, q, r, Fin.sum_univ_two, kernel]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.repeated_arctan_distance
statement:
theorem repeated_arctan_distance :
    ‖weightedUpperEmbedding 1 w twice - weightedUpperEmbedding 1 w once‖ ^ 2 =
      4 * (Real.arctan 2) ^ 2 + (Real.arctan 3) ^ 2 -
        4 * Real.arctan 2 * Real.arctan 3 * Real.exp (-1 / 2) ∧
    ‖embedding 1 w (fun i => (twice i).val) -
      embedding 1 w (fun j => (once j).val)‖ ^ 2 =
      4 * (Real.arctan 2) ^ 2 + (Real.arctan 3) ^ 2 -
        4 * Real.arctan 2 * Real.arctan 3 * Real.exp (-1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := finite_distance_formula 1
  simp only [one_pow, mul_one] at h
  exact ⟨by rw [norm_weightedUpperEmbedding_sub]; exact h, h⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.repeated_arctan_distance_pos
statement:
theorem repeated_arctan_distance_pos :
    0 < ‖weightedUpperEmbedding 1 w twice - weightedUpperEmbedding 1 w once‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [repeated_arctan_distance.1]
  have h₂ : 0 < Real.arctan 2 := Real.arctan_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have h₃ : 0 < Real.arctan 3 := Real.arctan_pos.mpr (by norm_num)
  have he : Real.exp (-1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
  have hp := mul_pos (mul_pos h₂ h₃) (sub_pos.mpr he)
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * Real.arctan 2 - Real.arctan 3)]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.zero_bandwidth_distance
statement:
theorem zero_bandwidth_distance :
    (T 0).symm (T 0 (upperEmbedding 0 w twice)) = upperEmbedding 0 w twice ∧
    ‖weightedUpperEmbedding 0 w twice - weightedUpperEmbedding 0 w once‖ ^ 2 =
      (2 * Real.arctan 2 - Real.arctan 3) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(T 0).symm_apply_apply _, ?_⟩
  rw [norm_weightedUpperEmbedding_sub, finite_distance_formula]
  norm_num
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.finiteKernel_value
statement:
private theorem finiteKernel_value (i j : Fin 2) :
    finiteKernel i j = if i = j then 1 else Real.exp (-1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [finiteKernel, WeightedKernelExamples.pair, kernel]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.vanishing_weight_obstruction
statement:
theorem vanishing_weight_obstruction :
    ‖obstruction‖ ^ 2 = 1 - (Real.exp (-1 / 2)) ^ 2 ∧
    0 < ‖obstruction‖ ^ 2 ∧
    ∀ i, erasingWeight i * obstruction i = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn : ‖obstruction‖ ^ 2 = 1 - (Real.exp (-1 / 2)) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    simp only [obstruction, inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_smul_right, inner_baseFeature, finiteKernel_value, ite_true,
      if_neg (show (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1 by decide), if_neg (show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide)]
    ring
  refine ⟨hn, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hn]
    have hp := Real.exp_pos (-1 / 2)
    have he : Real.exp (-1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1 := Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr (by norm_num)
    nlinarith
  · intro i
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [erasingWeight, obstruction, RKHS.coe_sub, RKHS.coe_smul,
        baseFeature_apply, finiteKernel_value]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.no_vanishing_weight_isometry
statement:
theorem no_vanishing_weight_isometry :
    ¬ ∃ S : BaseSpace finiteKernel ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] WeightedSpace finiteKernel erasingWeight,
      ∀ (F : BaseSpace finiteKernel) (i : Fin 2), S F i = erasingWeight i * F i
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨S, hS⟩
  have hz : S obstruction = 0 := by
    apply RKHS.ext
    intro i
    rw [hS, vanishing_weight_obstruction.2.2]
    simp
  have hn : ‖obstruction‖ = 0 := by
    rw [← S.norm_map obstruction, hz, norm_zero]
  have hp := vanishing_weight_obstruction.2.1
  rw [hn] at hp
  norm_num at hp

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.finiteEssential_positive
statement: private theorem finiteEssential_positive : finiteEssential.IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hz' : z = ((0 : ℝ), (2 : WithTop ℝ)) ∨ z = ((0 : ℝ), (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) := by
    simpa [finiteEssential, WeightedKernelInjectivityExamples.finiteEssentialDiagram] using hz
  rcases hz' with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.finiteOnly_positive
statement: private theorem finiteOnly_positive : finiteOnly.IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hz' : z = ((0 : ℝ), (2 : WithTop ℝ)) := by simpa [finiteOnly, singletonDiagram] using hz
  subst z
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.essentialOnly_positive
statement: private theorem essentialOnly_positive : essentialOnly.IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hz' : z = ((0 : ℝ), (⊤ : WithTop ℝ)) := by
    simpa [essentialOnly, WeightedKernelExamples.essentialOnly] using hz
  subst z
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.essential_parts_omitted
statement:
theorem essential_parts_omitted :
    weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding 1 w finiteEssential finiteEssential_positive =
      weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding 1 w finiteOnly finiteOnly_positive ∧
    weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding 1 w essentialOnly essentialOnly_positive = 0 ∧
    ‖weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding 1 w finiteEssential finiteEssential_positive -
      weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding 1 w essentialOnly essentialOnly_positive‖ =
      ‖diagramEmbedding 1 w finiteEssential - diagramEmbedding 1 w essentialOnly‖
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, norm_weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding_sub 1 w _ _ _ _⟩
  · apply norm_sub_eq_zero_iff.mp
    rw [norm_weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding_sub]
    rw [diagramEmbedding_eq_sum, diagramEmbedding_eq_sum,
      show finitePart finiteEssential.points = {(0, 2)} from rfl,
      show finitePart finiteOnly.points = {(0, 2)} from rfl]
    simp
  · apply norm_eq_zero.mp
    apply (sq_eq_zero_iff).mp
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, inner_weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding]
    rw [diagramEmbedding_eq_sum, show finitePart essentialOnly.points = 0 from rfl]
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelIsometryExamples.empty_weighted_upper
statement:
theorem empty_weighted_upper :
    weightedUpperEmbedding 1 w (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → UpperPoint) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [weightedUpperEmbedding]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.infinityFiber_subsingleton
statement:
private theorem infinityFiber_subsingleton {P : Type v} [Preorder P]
    (i a : P) (hia : ¬ i ≤ a) :
    Subsingleton ((HookInfinity.module (R := k) i).obj a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x y
  exact (HookInfinity.fiber_eq_zero_of_not_le hia x).trans
    (HookInfinity.fiber_eq_zero_of_not_le hia y).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.infinityFiberIso_apply
statement:
private theorem infinityFiberIso_apply (i : G.Point) {a : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (hia : G.embedding i ≤ a)
    (x : (G.lan.obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) i)).obj a) :
    HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hia
        ((infinityFiberIso G i a).hom.hom x) =
      HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) ((G.le_floor_iff a ha i).mp hia)
        ((G.appIso (HookInfinity.module (R := k) i) a ha).hom.hom x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [infinityFiberIso, ha, hia]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.infinityLanIso_apply_coefficient
statement:
theorem infinityLanIso_apply_coefficient (i : G.Point) {a : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (hia : G.embedding i ≤ a)
    (x : (G.lan.obj (HookInfinity.module (R := k) i)).obj a) :
    HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hia
      (((G.infinityLanIso i).hom.app a).hom x) =
    HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) ((G.le_floor_iff a ha i).mp hia)
      ((G.appIso (HookInfinity.module (R := k) i) a ha).hom.hom x)
proof:
:=
  by simpa [infinityLanIso] using infinityFiberIso_apply G i ha hia x

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.supportFiber_subsingleton
statement:
private theorem supportFiber_subsingleton {P : Type v} [Preorder P]
    (S : Set P) (a : P)
    (ha : a ∉ S) : Subsingleton (SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S a)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x y
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hx : (x : k) = 0 := SupportInterval.val_eq_zero S ha x
  have hy : (y : k) = 0 := SupportInterval.val_eq_zero S ha y
  exact hx.trans hy.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.hookSupport_floor_iff
statement:
private theorem hookSupport_floor_iff (i d : G.Point) {a : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    Hook.support i d (G.floor a ha) ↔
      Hook.support (G.embedding i) (G.embedding d) a
proof:
:= by
  change (i ≤ G.floor a ha ∧ ¬ d ≤ G.floor a ha) ↔
    (G.embedding i ≤ a ∧ ¬ G.embedding d ≤ a)
  exact and_congr (Iff.symm (G.le_floor_iff a ha i))
    (not_congr (Iff.symm (G.le_floor_iff a ha d)))

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.hookFiberIso_hom_val
statement:
private theorem hookFiberIso_hom_val (i d : G.Point) {a : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (hsa : a ∈ Hook.support (G.embedding i) (G.embedding d))
    (x : (G.lan.obj (Hook.module (k := k) i d)).obj a) :
    (((hookFiberIso G i d a).hom.hom x :
      SupportInterval.fiber (k := k)
        (Hook.support (G.embedding i) (G.embedding d)) a) : k) =
      (((G.appIso (Hook.module (k := k) i d) a ha).hom.hom x :
        SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) (Hook.support i d) (G.floor a ha)) : k)
proof:
:= by
  let p := G.floor a ha
  have hsp : p ∈ Hook.support i d := (G.hookSupport_floor_iff i d ha).mpr hsa
  simp [hookFiberIso, ha, p, LinearEquiv.coe_ofEq_apply, hsp, hsa]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.hookLanIso_apply_coefficient
statement:
theorem hookLanIso_apply_coefficient (i d : G.Point) {a : Fin n → ℝ}
    (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (hsa : a ∈ Hook.support (G.embedding i) (G.embedding d))
    (x : (G.lan.obj (Hook.module (k := k) i d)).obj a) :
    (((G.hookLanIso i d).hom.app a).hom x :
      SupportInterval.fiber (k := k)
        (Hook.support (G.embedding i) (G.embedding d)) a) =
      (((G.appIso (Hook.module (k := k) i d) a ha).hom.hom x :
        SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) (Hook.support i d) (G.floor a ha)) : k)
proof:
:=
  hookFiberIso_hom_val G i d ha hsa x

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.finiteHookDeflationLanIso_hom_π
statement:
theorem finiteHookDeflationLanIso_hom_π
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point) (t : FiniteHookDeflation.Index M) :
    (G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso M).hom ≫
        biproduct.π (embeddedCoverFamily G M) t =
      G.lan.map (biproduct.π (FiniteHookDeflation.family M) t) ≫
        (embeddedCoverFamilyIso G M t).hom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (G.lanBiproductIso (FiniteHookDeflation.family M)).hom ≫
      biproduct.map (fun j => (embeddedCoverFamilyIso G M j).hom) ≫
        biproduct.π (embeddedCoverFamily G M) t = _
  calc
    _ = (G.lanBiproductIso (FiniteHookDeflation.family M)).hom ≫
        (biproduct.π (fun j => G.lan.obj (FiniteHookDeflation.family M j)) t ≫
          (embeddedCoverFamilyIso G M t).hom) := by
          rw [biproduct.map_π]
    _ = ((G.lanBiproductIso (FiniteHookDeflation.family M)).hom ≫
        biproduct.π (fun j => G.lan.obj (FiniteHookDeflation.family M j)) t) ≫
          (embeddedCoverFamilyIso G M t).hom := by rw [← Category.assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [G.lanBiproductIso_hom_π]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.finiteHookDeflationLanIso_inv_ι
statement:
theorem finiteHookDeflationLanIso_inv_ι
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point) (t : FiniteHookDeflation.Index M) :
    biproduct.ι (embeddedCoverFamily G M) t ≫
        (G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso M).inv =
      (embeddedCoverFamilyIso G M t).inv ≫
        G.lan.map (biproduct.ι (FiniteHookDeflation.family M) t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change biproduct.ι (embeddedCoverFamily G M) t ≫
      biproduct.map (fun j => (embeddedCoverFamilyIso G M j).inv) ≫
        (G.lanBiproductIso (FiniteHookDeflation.family M)).inv = _
  calc
    _ = (biproduct.ι (embeddedCoverFamily G M) t ≫
        biproduct.map (fun j => (embeddedCoverFamilyIso G M j).inv)) ≫
          (G.lanBiproductIso (FiniteHookDeflation.family M)).inv := by
          rw [← Category.assoc]
    _ = ((embeddedCoverFamilyIso G M t).inv ≫
        biproduct.ι (fun j => G.lan.obj (FiniteHookDeflation.family M j)) t) ≫
          (G.lanBiproductIso (FiniteHookDeflation.family M)).inv := by
          rw [biproduct.ι_map]
    _ = (embeddedCoverFamilyIso G M t).inv ≫
        biproduct.ι (fun j => G.lan.obj (FiniteHookDeflation.family M j)) t ≫
          (G.lanBiproductIso (FiniteHookDeflation.family M)).inv := by
          rw [← Category.assoc]
    _ = _ := by rw [CoordinateGrid.lanBiproductIso_inv_ι]

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_list_interval_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_list_interval_decomposition (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N))
    [∀ i : Fin N, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] :
    ∃ xs : List (FiniteInterval N), Nonempty (M ≅ barcodeModuleOfList (k := k) xs)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  generalize hd : totalDimension M = d
  induction d using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing M with
  | h d ih =>
    by_cases hzero : d = 0
    · exact ⟨[], ⟨zeroDimensionIso M (hd.trans hzero)⟩⟩
    · have hpos : 0 < totalDimension M := by omega
      obtain ⟨I, C, hC, ⟨e⟩, hlt⟩ := exists_interval_summand M hpos
      let : ∀ i : Fin N, FiniteDimensional k (C.obj i) := hC
      obtain ⟨xs, ⟨f⟩⟩ := ih (totalDimension C) (by omega) C rfl
      exact ⟨I :: xs, ⟨e ≪≫ pointwiseProdIso (Iso.refl _) f ≪≫
        barcodeModuleOfListConsIso I xs⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_barcode_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_barcode_decomposition (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N))
    [∀ i : Fin N, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] :
    ∃ B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N), Nonempty (M ≅ barcodeModule (k := k) B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨xs, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_list_interval_decomposition M
  exact ⟨↑xs, ⟨e ≪≫ barcodeModuleOfListIso xs⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.nonempty_rankBarcodeIso
statement:
theorem nonempty_rankBarcodeIso (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N))
    [∀ i : Fin N, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] :
    Nonempty (M ≅ barcodeModule (k := k) (rankBarcode M))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨B, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_barcode_decomposition M
  have hB : rankBarcode M = B := rankBarcode_eq_of_iso_barcodeModule B e
  exact ⟨e ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (barcodeModule (k := k)) hB.symm)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.nonempty_iso_iff_rankBarcode_eq
statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_iff_rankBarcode_eq :
    Nonempty (M ≅ L) ↔ rankBarcode M = rankBarcode L
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    exact rankBarcode_eq_of_iso e
  · intro h
    exact ⟨rankBarcodeIso M ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (barcodeModule (k := k)) h) ≪≫
      (rankBarcodeIso L).symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.nonempty_iso_iff_structureMapRank_eq
statement:
theorem nonempty_iso_iff_structureMapRank_eq :
    Nonempty (M ≅ L) ↔ ∀ (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j),
      structureMapRank M i j hij = structureMapRank L i j hij
proof:
:=
  (nonempty_iso_iff_rankBarcode_eq M L).trans (rankBarcode_eq_iff M L)

name: TDA.Persistence.barcode_decomposition_unique
statement:
theorem barcode_decomposition_unique (B C : Multiset (FiniteInterval N))
    (e : M ≅ barcodeModule (k := k) B) (f : M ≅ barcodeModule (k := k) C) : B = C
proof:
:=
  (rankBarcode_eq_of_iso_barcodeModule B e).symm.trans
    (rankBarcode_eq_of_iso_barcodeModule C f)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.prefix_card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (prefixEquiv B b d),
    occurrence_count B (fun I => I.birth ≤ b ∧ I.death = d)]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.death_card
statement:
private theorem death_card (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s)) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) :
    Fintype.card (DeathOccurrence B d) = deathPrefixCount B (d - 1) d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.card_congr (deathEquiv B d), occurrence_count B (fun I => I.death = d)]
  unfold deathPrefixCount
  apply Multiset.countP_congr rfl
  intro I _
  apply propext
  have := I.birth_lt_death
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birth_mono
proof:
:=
  Prod.Lex.monotone_fst _ _ h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.lt_of_birth_lt
proof:
:=
  Prod.Lex.toLex_lt_toLex.mpr (Or.inl h)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.ordinal_lt_prefix
statement:
private theorem ordinal_lt_prefix (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s)) (d : ℕ)
    (x : DeathOccurrence B d) :
    ((deathEnumeration B d).symm x).val <
      deathPrefixCount B (occurrence B x.index).birth d
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r := (deathEnumeration B d).symm x
  let f : Fin (r.val + 1) → {i : DeathOccurrence B d //
      (occurrence B i.index).birth ≤ (occurrence B x.index).birth} := fun a => by
    let q : Fin (Fintype.card (DeathOccurrence B d)) := ⟨a.val, by have := r.isLt; omega⟩
    have hqr : q ≤ r := by change a.val ≤ r.val; have := a.isLt; omega
    exact ⟨deathEnumeration B d q, by
      simpa [r] using birth_mono B d ((deathEnumeration B d).monotone hqr)⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a b h
    apply Fin.ext
    have he := congrArg Subtype.val h
    change deathEnumeration B d ⟨a.val, _⟩ = deathEnumeration B d ⟨b.val, _⟩ at he
    exact congrArg (fun q : Fin (Fintype.card (DeathOccurrence B d)) => q.val)
      ((deathEnumeration B d).injective he)
  have h := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  rw [Fintype.card_fin, prefix_card] at h
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.prefix_le_ordinal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let r := (deathEnumeration B d).symm x
  let f : {i : DeathOccurrence B d // (occurrence B i.index).birth ≤ b} → Fin r.val :=
    fun i => ⟨((deathEnumeration B d).symm i.val).val,
      (deathEnumeration B d).symm.strictMono
        (lt_of_birth_lt B d (i.property.trans_lt hb))⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro a c h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply (deathEnumeration B d).symm.injective
    exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun a : Fin r.val => a.val) h)
  have h := Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf
  rwa [Fintype.card_fin, prefix_card] at h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathOrdinal_lt_deathPrefixCount
statement:
theorem deathOrdinal_lt_deathPrefixCount (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s B) :
    deathOrdinal B i < deathPrefixCount B (occurrence B i).birth (occurrence B i).death
proof:
:=
  ordinal_lt_prefix B _ ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathPrefixCount_le_deathOrdinal
statement:
theorem deathPrefixCount_le_deathOrdinal (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s))
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s B) (b : ℕ) (hb : b < (occurrence B i).birth) :
    deathPrefixCount B b (occurrence B i).death ≤ deathOrdinal B i
proof:
:=
  prefix_le_ordinal B b _ ⟨i, rfl⟩ hb

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathPrefixCount_le_card
statement:
theorem deathPrefixCount_le_card (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s)) (b d : ℕ) :
    deathPrefixCount B b d ≤ Fintype.card (DeathOccurrence B d)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prefix_card]
  exact Fintype.card_subtype_le _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.death_card_le
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases h : Nonempty (DeathOccurrence (rankBarcode M) d)
  · obtain ⟨x⟩ := h
    have hdpos : 0 < d := by
      have := (occurrence (rankBarcode M) x.index).birth_lt_death
      rw [x.death_eq] at this
      omega
    have hds : d ≤ s := x.death_eq ▸ (occurrence (rankBarcode M) x.index).death_le_size
    rw [death_card _ _ hdpos, death_card _ _ hdpos]
    exact deathPrefixCount_le_of_injective j hj _ _ (by omega) hds
  · have := not_nonempty_iff.mp h
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.mapOccurrence_death
statement:
private theorem mapOccurrence_death (j : M ⟶ N)
    (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom) (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) (mapOccurrence j hj i)).death =
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death
proof:
:=
  (groupEmbedding j hj _ ⟨i, rfl⟩).death_eq

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.occurrence_eq_of_death_ordinal
proof:
:= by
  let d := (occurrence B i).death
  let x : DeathOccurrence B d := ⟨i, rfl⟩
  let y : DeathOccurrence B d := ⟨j, hd.symm⟩
  have hxy : (deathEnumeration B d).symm x = (deathEnumeration B d).symm y := by
    apply Fin.ext
    rw [← ordinal_in_group B d x, ← ordinal_in_group B d y]
    exact ho
  exact congrArg DeathOccurrence.index ((deathEnumeration B d).symm.injective hxy)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_death
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_death (j : M ⟶ N) (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) (monoEmbedding j hj i)).death =
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death
proof: := mapOccurrence_death j hj i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_ordinal
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_ordinal (j : M ⟶ N) (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    deathOrdinal (rankBarcode N) (monoEmbedding j hj i) = deathOrdinal (rankBarcode M) i
proof:
:=
  mapOccurrence_ordinal j hj i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_birth_le
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_birth_le (j : M ⟶ N) (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) :
    (occurrence (rankBarcode N) (monoEmbedding j hj i)).birth ≤
      (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).birth
proof:
:= by
  let I := occurrence (rankBarcode M) i
  let x : DeathOccurrence (rankBarcode M) I.death := ⟨i, rfl⟩
  let y := groupEmbedding j hj I.death x
  change (occurrence (rankBarcode N) y.index).birth ≤ I.birth
  by_contra h
  have hlo := ordinal_lt_prefix (rankBarcode M) I.death x
  have hhi := prefix_le_ordinal (rankBarcode N) I.birth I.death y (lt_of_not_ge h)
  have hcounts := deathPrefixCount_le_of_injective j hj I.birth I.death
    I.birth_lt_death I.death_le_size
  have he := groupEmbedding_rank j hj I.death x
  change ((deathEnumeration (rankBarcode M) I.death).symm x).val <
    deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode M) I.birth I.death at hlo
  change ((deathEnumeration (rankBarcode N) I.death).symm y).val =
    ((deathEnumeration (rankBarcode M) I.death).symm x).val at he
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_eq_iff
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_eq_iff (j : M ⟶ N) (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom)
    (i : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode M)) (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    monoEmbedding j hj i = a ↔
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).death = (occurrence (rankBarcode M) i).death ∧
      deathOrdinal (rankBarcode N) a = deathOrdinal (rankBarcode M) i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨monoEmbedding_death j hj i, monoEmbedding_ordinal j hj i⟩
  · rintro ⟨hd, ho⟩
    exact occurrence_eq_of_death_ordinal (rankBarcode N) _ _
      ((monoEmbedding_death j hj i).trans hd.symm)
      ((monoEmbedding_ordinal j hj i).trans ho.symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_mem_range_iff
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_mem_range_iff (j : M ⟶ N)
    (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom)
    (a : BarcodeOccurrence s (rankBarcode N)) :
    a ∈ Set.range (monoEmbedding j hj) ↔
      deathOrdinal (rankBarcode N) a <
        Fintype.card (DeathOccurrence (rankBarcode M) (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).death)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [monoEmbedding_death, monoEmbedding_ordinal]
    exact ((deathEnumeration (rankBarcode M) _).symm ⟨i, rfl⟩).isLt
  · intro ha
    let q : Fin (Fintype.card (DeathOccurrence (rankBarcode M)
      (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).death)) := ⟨deathOrdinal (rankBarcode N) a, ha⟩
    let x := deathEnumeration (rankBarcode M) (occurrence (rankBarcode N) a).death q
    refine ⟨x.index, (monoEmbedding_eq_iff j hj _ a).mpr ⟨x.death_eq.symm, ?_⟩⟩
    rw [ordinal_in_group (rankBarcode M) _ x]
    simp [x, q]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_id
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_id (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] :
    monoEmbedding (𝟙 M) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) = Function.Embedding.refl _
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.Embedding.ext
  intro i
  exact occurrence_eq_of_death_ordinal (rankBarcode M) _ i
    (monoEmbedding_death (𝟙 M) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) i)
    (monoEmbedding_ordinal (𝟙 M) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.monoEmbedding_comp
statement:
theorem monoEmbedding_comp {P : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s)}
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (P.obj i)] (j : M ⟶ N) (l : N ⟶ P)
    (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom) (hl : ∀ i, Function.Injective (l.app i).hom) :
    monoEmbedding (j ≫ l) (fun i => (hl i).comp (hj i)) =
      (monoEmbedding j hj).trans (monoEmbedding l hl)
proof:
:= by
  apply Function.Embedding.ext
  intro i
  apply occurrence_eq_of_death_ordinal (rankBarcode P)
  · exact (monoEmbedding_death _ _ i).trans
      ((monoEmbedding_death l hl _).trans (monoEmbedding_death j hj i)).symm
  · exact (monoEmbedding_ordinal _ _ i).trans
      ((monoEmbedding_ordinal l hl _).trans (monoEmbedding_ordinal j hj i)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.persistenceBoxValue_of_separated
statement:
theorem persistenceBoxValue_of_separated (I : Box (Fin 2)) (hI : I.upper 0 < I.lower 1) :
    persistenceBoxValue M I =
      persistenceMeasureValue M (I.lower_lt_upper 0).le hI.le (I.lower_lt_upper 1).le
proof:
:= by
  simp only [persistenceBoxValue, dif_pos hI]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.persistenceBoxAdditiveMap_apply
statement:
theorem persistenceBoxAdditiveMap_apply (hM : M.QTame) (I : Box (Fin 2))
    (hI : I.upper 0 < I.lower 1) (J : Box (Fin 2)) :
    persistenceBoxAdditiveMap M hM I hI J = persistenceBoxValue M J
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.persistenceBoxValue_sum_partition
statement:
theorem persistenceBoxValue_sum_partition (hM : M.QTame) (I : Box (Fin 2))
    (hI : I.upper 0 < I.lower 1) (π : Prepartition I) (hπ : π.IsPartition) :
    ∑ J ∈ π.boxes, persistenceBoxValue M J = persistenceBoxValue M I
proof:
:=
  (persistenceBoxAdditiveMap M hM I hI).sum_partition_boxes le_rfl hπ

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.directLeg_firstFiber
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.directLeg_secondFiber

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.diagonalProjection_not_image
statement:
private theorem diagonalProjection_not_image (x : Interior) (s : Set Interior) :
    diagonalProjection x ∉ interiorIncl '' s
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨y, _, heq⟩
  have h : (diagonalProjection x).1.1 < (diagonalProjection x).1.2 := by
    rw [← heq]
    exact y.2
  simp [diagonalProjection] at h

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.deleteLeg_firstFiber
statement:
@[simp] theorem deleteLeg_firstFiber (x : Interior) (s : Set Interior) :

proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.insertLeg_secondFiber
statement:
@[simp] theorem insertLeg_secondFiber (x : Interior) (s : Set Interior) :

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicMeasure_apply
statement:
theorem atomicMeasure_apply (D : FiniteWeightedDiagram) (s : Set Interior)
    (hs : MeasurableSet s) :
    atomicMeasure D s =
      ∑ i : D.supportLabels, if i.1 ∈ s then (D.weights i : ℝ≥0∞) else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [atomicMeasure, Set.indicator, hs]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicMeasure_mass
statement:
theorem atomicMeasure_mass (D : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    atomicMeasure D Set.univ = ∑ i : D.supportLabels, (D.weights i : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomicMeasure_apply D Set.univ MeasurableSet.univ]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicMeasure_isFinite
statement:
theorem atomicMeasure_isFinite (D : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (atomicMeasure D)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  rw [atomicMeasure_mass]
  exact ENNReal.sum_lt_top.mpr (fun i _ => ENNReal.coe_lt_top)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicMeasure_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem atomicMeasure_zero :
    atomicMeasure (0 : FiniteWeightedDiagram) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [atomicMeasure]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicMeasure_singleton
statement:
theorem atomicMeasure_singleton (D : FiniteWeightedDiagram) (x : Interior) :
    atomicMeasure D {x} = (D x : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomicMeasure_apply D {x} (measurableSet_singleton x)]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ D.support
  · let i : D.supportLabels := ⟨x, hx⟩
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · simp [i, FiniteWeightedDiagram.weights]
    · intro j _ hji
      have hne : j.1 ≠ x := by
        intro heq
        exact hji (Subtype.ext heq)
      simp [hne]
    · intro hi
      exact (hi (Finset.mem_univ i)).elim
  · have hzero : D x = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hx
    rw [hzero]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    have hne : i.1 ≠ x := by
      intro heq
      exact hx (heq ▸ i.2)
    simp [hne]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.sourceBalance_ennreal
statement:
private theorem sourceBalance_ennreal (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram)
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan D.weights E.weights) (i : D.supportLabels) :
    (∑ j : E.supportLabels, ENNReal.ofReal (a.mass i j)) +
      ENNReal.ofReal (a.deletionMass i) = (D.weights i : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (s := Finset.univ)
    (fun j _ => a.nonneg i j),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_add (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => a.nonneg i j)
      (a.deletionMass_nonneg i), a.source_balance]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.targetBalance_ennreal
statement:
private theorem targetBalance_ennreal (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram)
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan D.weights E.weights) (j : E.supportLabels) :
    (∑ i : D.supportLabels, ENNReal.ofReal (a.mass i j)) +
      ENNReal.ofReal (a.insertionMass j) = (E.weights j : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (s := Finset.univ)
    (fun i _ => a.nonneg i j),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_add (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => a.nonneg i j)
      (a.insertionMass_nonneg j), a.target_balance]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicBoundaryPlan_admissible
statement:
theorem atomicBoundaryPlan_admissible (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram)
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan D.weights E.weights) :
    IsBoundaryPlan (atomicBoundaryPlan D E a) (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro s hs
    rw [atomicMeasure_apply D s hs]
    simp [atomicBoundaryPlan, Set.indicator,
      measurableSet_firstFiber hs]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    by_cases hi : i.1 ∈ s
    · simp only [if_pos hi]
      exact sourceBalance_ennreal D E a i
    · simp [hi]
  · intro s hs
    rw [atomicMeasure_apply E s hs]
    simp [atomicBoundaryPlan, Set.indicator,
      measurableSet_secondFiber hs]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    by_cases hj : j.1 ∈ s
    · simp only [if_pos hj]
      exact targetBalance_ennreal D E a j
    · simp [hj]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.planPowerCost_directLeg
statement:
@[simp] theorem planPowerCost_directLeg (p : ℝ) {D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram}
    (i : D.supportLabels) (j : E.supportLabels) :
    planPowerCost p (directLeg i j) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((finitePairCost (D.coordinates i) (E.coordinates j)).toReal ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  simp [planPowerCost, directLeg, interiorIncl, FiniteWeightedDiagram.coordinates,
    Subtype.dist_eq, finitePairCost_toReal, dist_eq_norm]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.planPowerCost_deleteLeg
statement:
@[simp] theorem planPowerCost_deleteLeg (p : ℝ) (x : Interior) :
    planPowerCost p (deleteLeg x) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((diagonalCost x.1).toReal ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  simp [planPowerCost, deleteLeg, deleteLeg_distance, depth]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.planPowerCost_insertLeg
statement:
@[simp] theorem planPowerCost_insertLeg (p : ℝ) (x : Interior) :
    planPowerCost p (insertLeg x) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((diagonalCost x.1).toReal ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  simp [planPowerCost, insertLeg, insertLeg_distance, depth]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicBoundaryPlan_cost_sum
statement:
theorem atomicBoundaryPlan_cost_sum (p : ℝ) (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram)
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan D.weights E.weights) :
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂atomicBoundaryPlan D E a) =
      (∑ i : D.supportLabels, ∑ j : E.supportLabels,
        ENNReal.ofReal (a.mass i j) *
          ENNReal.ofReal ((finitePairCost (D.coordinates i) (E.coordinates j)).toReal ^ p)) +
      (∑ i : D.supportLabels, ENNReal.ofReal (a.deletionMass i) *
        ENNReal.ofReal ((diagonalCost (D.coordinates i)).toReal ^ p)) +
      ∑ j : E.supportLabels, ENNReal.ofReal (a.insertionMass j) *
        ENNReal.ofReal ((diagonalCost (E.coordinates j)).toReal ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  simp [atomicBoundaryPlan, lintegral_add_measure, lintegral_finsetSum_measure,
    lintegral_smul_measure, FiniteWeightedDiagram.coordinates]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicBoundaryPlan_cost_native
statement:
theorem atomicBoundaryPlan_cost_native (p : ℝ) (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram)
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan D.weights E.weights) :
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂atomicBoundaryPlan D E a) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (a.powerCost p D.coordinates E.coordinates)
proof:
:= by
  let c : D.supportLabels → E.supportLabels → ℝ := fun i j =>
    (finitePairCost (D.coordinates i) (E.coordinates j)).toReal ^ p
  let d : D.supportLabels → ℝ := fun i =>
    (diagonalCost (D.coordinates i)).toReal ^ p
  let e : E.supportLabels → ℝ := fun j =>
    (diagonalCost (E.coordinates j)).toReal ^ p
  have hc (i : D.supportLabels) (j : E.supportLabels) : 0 ≤ c i j :=
    Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _
  have hd (i : D.supportLabels) : 0 ≤ d i :=
    Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _
  have he (j : E.supportLabels) : 0 ≤ e j :=
    Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _
  rw [atomicBoundaryPlan_cost_sum]
  change (∑ i, ∑ j, ENNReal.ofReal (a.mass i j) * ENNReal.ofReal (c i j)) +
      (∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (a.deletionMass i) * ENNReal.ofReal (d i)) +
      (∑ j, ENNReal.ofReal (a.insertionMass j) * ENNReal.ofReal (e j)) = _
  simp_rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (a.nonneg _ _),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (a.deletionMass_nonneg _),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (a.insertionMass_nonneg _)]
  simp_rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (s := Finset.univ)
    (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (a.nonneg _ j) (hc _ j))]
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (s := Finset.univ)
    (fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (a.nonneg i j) (hc i j)),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (s := Finset.univ)
      (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (a.deletionMass_nonneg i) (hd i)),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg (s := Finset.univ)
      (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (a.insertionMass_nonneg j) (he j))]
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
        mul_nonneg (a.nonneg i j) (hc i j))
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (a.deletionMass_nonneg i) (hd i)),
    ← ENNReal.ofReal_add
      (add_nonneg
        (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
          mul_nonneg (a.nonneg i j) (hc i j))
        (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => mul_nonneg (a.deletionMass_nonneg i) (hd i)))
      (Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => mul_nonneg (a.insertionMass_nonneg j) (he j))]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic_le_plan
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic_le_plan (p : ℝ)
    (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram)
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan D.weights E.weights) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (a.powerCost p D.coordinates E.coordinates)
proof:
:= by
  exact (boundaryTransportPowerValue_le_plan p
    (atomicBoundaryPlan_admissible D E a)).trans_eq
      (atomicBoundaryPlan_cost_native p D E a)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic_le_native
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic_le_native (p : ℝ)
    (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost p D E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := FiniteWeightedDiagram.exists_minimizing_powerPlan p D E
  exact (boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic_le_plan p D E a).trans_eq
    (congrArg ENNReal.ofReal ha)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurableSet_atomicPairCell
