  (measurableSet_firstFiber (measurableSet_singleton i.1)).inter
    (measurableSet_secondFiber (measurableSet_singleton j.1))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicPairCell_disjoint_right
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro z hzj hzk
  have hj : z ∈ secondFiber {j.1} := hzj.2
  have hk : z ∈ secondFiber {k.1} := hzk.2
  rcases hj with ⟨x, hx, heqj⟩
  rcases hk with ⟨y, hy, heqk⟩
  have hxy : x = y := interiorIncl_injective (heqj.trans heqk.symm)
  have hjk' : j.1 = k.1 := by simpa using hx.symm.trans (hxy.trans hy)
  exact hjk (Subtype.ext hjk')

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicPairCell_disjoint_left
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
  intro z hzi hzk
  have hi : z ∈ firstFiber {i.1} := hzi.1
  have hk : z ∈ firstFiber {k.1} := hzk.1
  rcases hi with ⟨x, hx, heqi⟩
  rcases hk with ⟨y, hy, heqk⟩
  have hxy : x = y := interiorIncl_injective (heqi.trans heqk.symm)
  have hik' : i.1 = k.1 := by simpa using hx.symm.trans (hxy.trans hy)
  exact hik (Subtype.ext hik')

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicPairCell_row_measure_le
statement:
private theorem atomicPairCell_row_measure_le {D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram}
    (π : Measure PlanSpace) (i : D.supportLabels) :
    (∑ j : E.supportLabels, π (atomicPairCell i j)) ≤
      π (firstFiber {i.1})
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : PairwiseDisjoint (Set.univ : Set E.supportLabels)
      (fun j => atomicPairCell i j) := by
    intro j _ k _ hjk
    exact atomicPairCell_disjoint_right i hjk
  have hsum := measure_biUnion_finset (μ := π) (s := Finset.univ) (by simpa using hdisj)
    (fun j _ => measurableSet_atomicPairCell i j)
  rw [← hsum]
  exact measure_mono (by
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
    rcases hz with ⟨j, _, hzj⟩
    exact hzj.1)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicPairCell_col_measure_le
statement:
private theorem atomicPairCell_col_measure_le {D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram}
    (π : Measure PlanSpace) (j : E.supportLabels) :
    (∑ i : D.supportLabels, π (atomicPairCell i j)) ≤
      π (secondFiber {j.1})
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : PairwiseDisjoint (Set.univ : Set D.supportLabels)
      (fun i => atomicPairCell i j) := by
    intro i _ k _ hik
    exact atomicPairCell_disjoint_left j hik
  have hsum := measure_biUnion_finset (μ := π) (s := Finset.univ) (by simpa using hdisj)
    (fun i _ => measurableSet_atomicPairCell i j)
  rw [← hsum]
  exact measure_mono (by
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion] at hz
    rcases hz with ⟨i, _, hzi⟩
    exact hzi.2)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurableSet_atomicDeleteCell
statement:
theorem measurableSet_atomicDeleteCell {D : FiniteWeightedDiagram}
    (i : D.supportLabels) : MeasurableSet (atomicDeleteCell i)
proof:
:=
  (measurableSet_firstFiber (measurableSet_singleton i.1)).diff
    (measurableSet_secondFiber MeasurableSet.univ)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurableSet_atomicInsertCell
statement:
theorem measurableSet_atomicInsertCell {E : FiniteWeightedDiagram}
    (j : E.supportLabels) : MeasurableSet (atomicInsertCell j)
proof:
:=
  (measurableSet_secondFiber (measurableSet_singleton j.1)).diff
    (measurableSet_firstFiber MeasurableSet.univ)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapse_eq_boundary_of_not_secondFiber
statement:
private theorem collapse_eq_boundary_of_not_secondFiber (z : PlanSpace)
    (hz : z ∉ secondFiber Set.univ) : collapse z.1.2 = Space.boundary
proof:
:= by
  have h : ¬ z.1.2.1.1 < z.1.2.1.2 := by
    intro h
    exact hz ⟨⟨z.1.2.1, h⟩, Set.mem_univ _, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
  simp [collapse, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapse_eq_boundary_of_not_firstFiber
statement:
private theorem collapse_eq_boundary_of_not_firstFiber (z : PlanSpace)
    (hz : z ∉ firstFiber Set.univ) : collapse z.1.1 = Space.boundary
proof:
:= by
  have h : ¬ z.1.1.1.1 < z.1.1.1.2 := by
    intro h
    exact hz ⟨⟨z.1.1.1, h⟩, Set.mem_univ _, Subtype.ext rfl⟩
  simp [collapse, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicDeleteCell_cost_le
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : z.1.1 = interiorIncl i.1 := by
    rcases hz.1 with ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
    have hxi : x = i.1 := hx
    exact hxi ▸ heq.symm
  have hbound := collapsePlanPair_powerCost_le p hp z
  rw [hfirst, collapse_eq_boundary_of_not_secondFiber z hz.2] at hbound
  simpa only [interiorIncl, collapse_interior, dist_point_boundary,
    depth, FiniteWeightedDiagram.coordinates] using hbound

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicInsertCell_cost_le
proof:
:= by
  have hsecond : z.1.2 = interiorIncl j.1 := by
    rcases hz.1 with ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
    have hxj : x = j.1 := hx
    exact hxj ▸ heq.symm
  have hbound := collapsePlanPair_powerCost_le p hp z
  rw [hsecond, collapse_eq_boundary_of_not_firstFiber z hz.2] at hbound
  simpa only [interiorIncl, collapse_interior, dist_boundary_point,
    depth, FiniteWeightedDiagram.coordinates] using hbound

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.secondFiber_support_eq_iUnion
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, x, rfl, heq⟩
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨j, x, hx, heq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
    exact ⟨x, hx ▸ j.2, heq⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.firstFiber_support_eq_iUnion
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, x, rfl, heq⟩
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨i, x, hx, heq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
    exact ⟨x, hx ▸ i.2, heq⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicMeasure_support_compl_zero
statement:
private theorem atomicMeasure_support_compl_zero (D : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    atomicMeasure D (↑D.support : Set Interior)ᶜ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomicMeasure_apply D _ (D.support.finite_toSet.measurableSet.compl)]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.secondFiber_outside_support_null
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  calc
    _ ≤ π (secondFiber (↑E.support : Set Interior)ᶜ) := by
      apply measure_mono
      rintro z ⟨⟨x, _, heq⟩, hnot⟩
      refine ⟨x, ?_, heq⟩
      intro hx
      exact hnot ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
    _ = atomicMeasure E (↑E.support : Set Interior)ᶜ :=
      hπ.second _ (E.support.finite_toSet.measurableSet.compl)
    _ = 0 := atomicMeasure_support_compl_zero E

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.firstFiber_outside_support_null
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
  calc
    _ ≤ π (firstFiber (↑D.support : Set Interior)ᶜ) := by
      apply measure_mono
      rintro z ⟨⟨x, _, heq⟩, hnot⟩
      refine ⟨x, ?_, heq⟩
      intro hx
      exact hnot ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
    _ = atomicMeasure D (↑D.support : Set Interior)ᶜ :=
      hπ.first _ (D.support.finite_toSet.measurableSet.compl)
    _ = 0 := atomicMeasure_support_compl_zero D

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicPairCell_row_measure_eq
statement:
private theorem atomicPairCell_row_measure_eq {D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram}
    (π : Measure PlanSpace) (i : D.supportLabels) :
    (∑ j : E.supportLabels, π (atomicPairCell i j)) =
      π (firstFiber {i.1} ∩ secondFiber (↑E.support : Set Interior))
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : PairwiseDisjoint (Set.univ : Set E.supportLabels)
      (fun j => atomicPairCell i j) := by
    intro j _ k _ hjk
    exact atomicPairCell_disjoint_right i hjk
  rw [← measure_biUnion_finset (μ := π) (s := Finset.univ)
    (by simpa using hdisj) (fun j _ => measurableSet_atomicPairCell i j)]
  congr 1
  ext z
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Set.iUnion_true, Set.mem_iUnion, atomicPairCell,
    Set.mem_inter_iff]
  rw [secondFiber_support_eq_iUnion]
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  tauto

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicPairCell_col_measure_eq
statement:
private theorem atomicPairCell_col_measure_eq {D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram}
    (π : Measure PlanSpace) (j : E.supportLabels) :
    (∑ i : D.supportLabels, π (atomicPairCell i j)) =
      π (secondFiber {j.1} ∩ firstFiber (↑D.support : Set Interior))
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : PairwiseDisjoint (Set.univ : Set D.supportLabels)
      (fun i => atomicPairCell i j) := by
    intro i _ k _ hik
    exact atomicPairCell_disjoint_left j hik
  rw [← measure_biUnion_finset (μ := π) (s := Finset.univ)
    (by simpa using hdisj) (fun i _ => measurableSet_atomicPairCell i j)]
  congr 1
  ext z
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Set.iUnion_true, Set.mem_iUnion, atomicPairCell,
    Set.mem_inter_iff]
  rw [firstFiber_support_eq_iUnion]
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  tauto

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measure_sdiff_eq_of_null_between
statement:
private theorem measure_sdiff_eq_of_null_between {α : Type*} [MeasurableSpace α]
    (π : Measure α) (s t u : Set α) (htu : t ⊆ u)
    (hu : MeasurableSet u) (hnull : π (u \ t) = 0) :
    π (s \ t) = π (s \ u)
proof:
:= by
  have hpart := measure_sdiff_add_inter (μ := π) (s \ t) hu
  have hzero : π ((s \ t) ∩ u) = 0 := by
    apply le_antisymm ?_ bot_le
    calc
      _ ≤ π (u \ t) := by
        apply measure_mono
        rintro x ⟨⟨_, hxt⟩, hxu⟩
        exact ⟨hxu, hxt⟩
      _ = 0 := hnull
  have heq : (s \ t) \ u = s \ u := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_sdiff]
    constructor
    · exact fun h => ⟨h.1.1, h.2⟩
    · exact fun h => ⟨⟨h.1, fun hxt => h.2 (htu hxt)⟩, h.2⟩
  rw [hzero, add_zero, heq] at hpart
  exact hpart.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicPairCell_row_delete_balance
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomicPairCell_row_measure_eq]
  have hpart := measure_inter_add_sdiff (μ := π) (firstFiber {i.1})
    (measurableSet_secondFiber E.support.finite_toSet.measurableSet)
  rw [measure_sdiff_eq_of_null_between π (firstFiber {i.1})
    (secondFiber (↑E.support : Set Interior)) (secondFiber Set.univ)
    (by
      rintro z ⟨x, _, heq⟩
      exact ⟨x, Set.mem_univ _, heq⟩)
    (measurableSet_secondFiber MeasurableSet.univ)
    (secondFiber_outside_support_null hπ)] at hpart
  change π (firstFiber {i.1} ∩ secondFiber (↑E.support : Set Interior)) +
    π (atomicDeleteCell i) = (D.weights i : ℝ≥0∞)
  exact hpart.trans ((hπ.first _ (measurableSet_singleton i.1)).trans
    (atomicMeasure_singleton D i.1))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicPairCell_col_insert_balance
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomicPairCell_col_measure_eq]
  have hpart := measure_inter_add_sdiff (μ := π) (secondFiber {j.1})
    (measurableSet_firstFiber D.support.finite_toSet.measurableSet)
  rw [measure_sdiff_eq_of_null_between π (secondFiber {j.1})
    (firstFiber (↑D.support : Set Interior)) (firstFiber Set.univ)
    (by
      rintro z ⟨x, _, heq⟩
      exact ⟨x, Set.mem_univ _, heq⟩)
    (measurableSet_firstFiber MeasurableSet.univ)
    (firstFiber_outside_support_null hπ)] at hpart
  change π (secondFiber {j.1} ∩ firstFiber (↑D.support : Set Interior)) +
    π (atomicInsertCell j) = (E.weights j : ℝ≥0∞)
  exact hpart.trans ((hπ.second _ (measurableSet_singleton j.1)).trans
    (atomicMeasure_singleton E j.1))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.extractedAtomicPlan_mass
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.extractedAtomicPlan_deletionMass
proof:
:= by
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (atomicMeasure D) := atomicMeasure_isFinite D
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (atomicMeasure E) := atomicMeasure_isFinite E
  have : IsFiniteMeasure π := boundaryPlan_isFiniteMeasure hπ
  have hfinite (s : Set PlanSpace) : π s ≠ ∞ :=
    ((measure_mono (subset_univ s)).trans_lt (measure_lt_top π Set.univ)).ne
  have hbal := atomicPairCell_row_delete_balance hπ i
  have hreal := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hbal
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add (by exact (ENNReal.sum_lt_top.mpr
      (fun j _ => (hfinite _).lt_top)).ne) (hfinite _),
    ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun j _ => hfinite _)] at hreal
  simp only [ENNReal.coe_toReal] at hreal
  simp only [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.deletionMass, extractedAtomicPlan_mass]
  linarith only [hreal]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.extractedAtomicPlan_insertionMass
proof:
:= by
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (atomicMeasure D) := atomicMeasure_isFinite D
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (atomicMeasure E) := atomicMeasure_isFinite E
  have : IsFiniteMeasure π := boundaryPlan_isFiniteMeasure hπ
  have hfinite (s : Set PlanSpace) : π s ≠ ∞ :=
    ((measure_mono (subset_univ s)).trans_lt (measure_lt_top π Set.univ)).ne
  have hbal := atomicPairCell_col_insert_balance hπ j
  have hreal := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hbal
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add (by exact (ENNReal.sum_lt_top.mpr
      (fun i _ => (hfinite _).lt_top)).ne) (hfinite _),
    ENNReal.toReal_sum (fun i _ => hfinite _)] at hreal
  simp only [ENNReal.coe_toReal] at hreal
  simp only [FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan.insertionMass, extractedAtomicPlan_mass]
  linarith only [hreal]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.firstFiber_singleton_label_eq
proof:
:= by
  rcases hi with ⟨x, hx, heqx⟩
  rcases hk with ⟨y, hy, heqy⟩
  have hxy : x = y := interiorIncl_injective (heqx.trans heqy.symm)
  exact Subtype.ext (hx.symm.trans (hxy.trans hy))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.secondFiber_singleton_label_eq
proof:
:= by
  rcases hj with ⟨x, hx, heqx⟩
  rcases hk with ⟨y, hy, heqy⟩
  have hxy : x = y := interiorIncl_injective (heqx.trans heqy.symm)
  exact Subtype.ext (hx.symm.trans (hxy.trans hy))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurableSet_atomicCell
statement:
private theorem measurableSet_atomicCell {D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram}
    (a : AtomicCellIndex D E) : MeasurableSet (atomicCell a)
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨i, j⟩ | i | j
  · exact measurableSet_atomicPairCell i j
  · exact measurableSet_atomicDeleteCell i
  · exact measurableSet_atomicInsertCell j

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicCell_unique
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨i, j⟩ | i | j <;> rcases b with ⟨k, l⟩ | k | l
  · exact congrArg Sum.inl (Prod.ext
      (firstFiber_singleton_label_eq ha.1 hb.1)
      (secondFiber_singleton_label_eq ha.2 hb.2))
  · exact False.elim (hb.2 (by
      rcases ha.2 with ⟨x, _, heq⟩
      exact ⟨x, Set.mem_univ _, heq⟩))
  · exact False.elim (hb.2 (by
      rcases ha.1 with ⟨x, _, heq⟩
      exact ⟨x, Set.mem_univ _, heq⟩))
  · exact False.elim (ha.2 (by
      rcases hb.2 with ⟨x, _, heq⟩
      exact ⟨x, Set.mem_univ _, heq⟩))
  · exact congrArg (Sum.inr ∘ Sum.inl)
      (firstFiber_singleton_label_eq ha.1 hb.1)
  · exact False.elim (hb.2 (by
      rcases ha.1 with ⟨x, _, heq⟩
      exact ⟨x, Set.mem_univ _, heq⟩))
  · exact False.elim (ha.2 (by
      rcases hb.1 with ⟨x, _, heq⟩
      exact ⟨x, Set.mem_univ _, heq⟩))
  · exact False.elim (ha.2 (by
      rcases hb.1 with ⟨x, _, heq⟩
      exact ⟨x, Set.mem_univ _, heq⟩))
  · exact congrArg (Sum.inr ∘ Sum.inr)
      (secondFiber_singleton_label_eq ha.1 hb.1)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicCell_charge_le
statement:
private theorem atomicCell_charge_le (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    {D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram} (a : AtomicCellIndex D E)
    {z : PlanSpace} (hz : z ∈ atomicCell a) :
    atomicCellCharge p a ≤ planPowerCost p z
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨i, j⟩ | i | j
  · have hfirst : z.1.1 = interiorIncl i.1 := by
      rcases hz.1 with ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
      exact hx ▸ heq.symm
    have hsecond : z.1.2 = interiorIncl j.1 := by
      rcases hz.2 with ⟨x, hx, heq⟩
      exact hx ▸ heq.symm
    have heq : z = directLeg i j := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact Prod.ext hfirst hsecond
    simpa only [heq, atomicCellCharge, planPowerCost_directLeg] using
      (le_refl (atomicCellCharge p (Sum.inl (i, j))))
  · exact atomicDeleteCell_cost_le p hp i hz
  · exact atomicInsertCell_cost_le p hp j hz

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicCell_charge_integral_le
statement:
private theorem atomicCell_charge_integral_le (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    {D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram} (π : Measure PlanSpace)
    (a : AtomicCellIndex D E) :
    atomicCellCharge p a * π (atomicCell a) ≤
      ∫⁻ z in atomicCell a, planPowerCost p z ∂π
proof:
:= by
  let s := atomicCell a
  have hs : MeasurableSet s := measurableSet_atomicCell a
  calc
    _ = ∫⁻ z, s.indicator (fun _ => atomicCellCharge p a) z ∂π := by
      rw [lintegral_indicator_const hs]
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ z, s.indicator (planPowerCost p) z ∂π := by
      apply lintegral_mono
      intro z
      by_cases hz : z ∈ s
      · simpa [Set.indicator_of_mem hz] using atomicCell_charge_le p hp a hz
      · simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz]
    _ = _ := lintegral_indicator hs (planPowerCost p)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicCell_charge_sum_le_cost
statement:
private theorem atomicCell_charge_sum_le_cost (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    {D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram} (π : Measure PlanSpace) :
    (∑ a : AtomicCellIndex D E,
      atomicCellCharge p a * π (atomicCell a)) ≤
      ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π
proof:
:= by
  have hdisj : Pairwise (fun a b : AtomicCellIndex D E =>
      Disjoint (atomicCell a) (atomicCell b)) := by
    intro a b hab
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro z ha hb
    exact hab (atomicCell_unique ha hb)
  have hrestr : π.restrict (⋃ a : AtomicCellIndex D E, atomicCell a) =
      Measure.sum (fun a : AtomicCellIndex D E => π.restrict (atomicCell a)) :=
    Measure.restrict_iUnion hdisj measurableSet_atomicCell
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ a : AtomicCellIndex D E,
        ∫⁻ z in atomicCell a, planPowerCost p z ∂π :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => atomicCell_charge_integral_le p hp π a)
    _ = ∫⁻ z in (⋃ a : AtomicCellIndex D E, atomicCell a),
        planPowerCost p z ∂π := by
      rw [hrestr, lintegral_sum_measure, tsum_fintype]
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π := by
      simpa only [Measure.restrict_univ] using
        (lintegral_mono_set (μ := π) (f := planPowerCost p) (Set.subset_univ _))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.extractedAtomicPlan_cost_eq_cell_sum
statement:
private theorem extractedAtomicPlan_cost_eq_cell_sum (p : ℝ)
    {D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram} {π : Measure PlanSpace}
    (hπ : IsBoundaryPlan π (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E)) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((extractedAtomicPlan π hπ).powerCost p
      D.coordinates E.coordinates) =
      ∑ a : AtomicCellIndex D E,
        atomicCellCharge p a * π (atomicCell a)
proof:
:= by
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (atomicMeasure D) := atomicMeasure_isFinite D
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (atomicMeasure E) := atomicMeasure_isFinite E
  have : IsFiniteMeasure π := boundaryPlan_isFiniteMeasure hπ
  have hfinite (s : Set PlanSpace) : π s ≠ ∞ :=
    ((measure_mono (subset_univ s)).trans_lt (measure_lt_top π Set.univ)).ne
  rw [← atomicBoundaryPlan_cost_native p D E (extractedAtomicPlan π hπ),
    atomicBoundaryPlan_cost_sum]
  simp_rw [extractedAtomicPlan_mass hπ, extractedAtomicPlan_deletionMass hπ,
    extractedAtomicPlan_insertionMass hπ]
  simp_rw [ENNReal.ofReal_toReal (hfinite _)]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fintype.sum_prod_type, atomicCell,
    atomicCellCharge, add_assoc]
  simp only [mul_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.extractedAtomicPlan_cost_le
statement:
theorem extractedAtomicPlan_cost_le (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    {D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram} {π : Measure PlanSpace}
    (hπ : IsBoundaryPlan π (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E)) :
    ENNReal.ofReal ((extractedAtomicPlan π hπ).powerCost p
      D.coordinates E.coordinates) ≤
      ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π
proof:
:= by
  rw [extractedAtomicPlan_cost_eq_cell_sum p hπ]
  exact atomicCell_charge_sum_le_cost p hp π

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.native_le_boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic
statement:
theorem native_le_boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost p D E) ≤
      boundaryTransportPowerValue p (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_iInf
  intro π
  apply le_iInf
  intro hπ
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    (weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_le_plan p D.weights E.weights
      D.coordinates E.coordinates (extractedAtomicPlan π hπ))).trans
    (extractedAtomicPlan_cost_le p hp hπ)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic_eq_native
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic_eq_native (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost p D E)
proof:
:= by
  exact le_antisymm (boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic_le_native p D E)
    (native_le_boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic p hp D E)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.exists_atomic_minimizing_boundaryPlan
statement:
theorem exists_atomic_minimizing_boundaryPlan (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    ∃ π : Measure PlanSpace,
      IsBoundaryPlan π (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E) ∧
      (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) =
        boundaryTransportPowerValue p (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := FiniteWeightedDiagram.exists_minimizing_powerPlan p D E
  refine ⟨atomicBoundaryPlan D E a, atomicBoundaryPlan_admissible D E a, ?_⟩
  rw [atomicBoundaryPlan_cost_native, ha,
    boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic_eq_native p hp]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_atomic_eq_native
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_atomic_eq_native (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram) :
    boundaryTransportDistance p (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (FiniteWeightedDiagram.pBoundaryTransportCost p D E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryTransportDistance,
    boundaryTransportPowerValue_atomic_eq_native p (zero_le_one.trans hp) D E]
  change (ENNReal.ofReal (FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost p D E)) ^
      (1 / p) =
    ENNReal.ofReal ((FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost p D E) ^ p⁻¹)
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ FiniteWeightedDiagram.powerBoundaryTransportCost p D E :=
    weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost_nonneg p D.weights E.weights
      D.coordinates E.coordinates
  simpa only [one_div] using
    (ENNReal.ofReal_rpow_of_nonneg hnonneg
      (one_div_nonneg.mpr (zero_le_one.trans hp)))

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.cost_le_ofReal_root_totalFinitePowerCost
statement:
theorem cost_le_ofReal_root_totalFinitePowerCost [IsEmpty A]
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J A B) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (b : A → ℝ) (c : B → ℝ) :
    M.cost x y b c ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (M.finiteRestriction.totalFinitePowerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let source : I → ℝ≥0∞ := fun i => match M.finite i with
    | some j => finitePairCost (x i) (y j)
    | none => diagonalCost (x i)
  let target : J → ℝ≥0∞ := fun j =>
    if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else diagonalCost (y j)
  let S := M.finiteRestriction.totalFinitePowerCost p x y
  have hp0 : p ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)
  have hp_pos : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := M.finiteRestriction.totalFinitePowerCost_nonneg p x y
  have hsum : S = (∑ i, (source i).toReal ^ p) + ∑ j, (target j).toReal ^ p := by
    dsimp only [S, totalFinitePowerCost, totalBoundaryCost, finiteRestriction, source, target]
    congr 1
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      cases M.finite i <;> rfl
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      by_cases h : ∃ i, M.finite i = some j
      · simp only [h, if_true, ENNReal.toReal_zero, Real.zero_rpow hp0]
      · simp only [h, if_false]
  have hs_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ i, (source i).toReal ^ p :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _
  have ht_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∑ j, (target j).toReal ^ p :=
    Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _
  apply M.cost_le_of x y b c (ENNReal.ofReal (S ^ p⁻¹))
  · intro i
    change source i ≤ _
    have hpow : (source i).toReal ^ p ≤ S := by
      rw [hsum]
      exact (Finset.single_le_sum
        (fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg p)
        (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right ht_nonneg)
    have hroot := (Real.le_rpow_inv_iff_of_pos ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hS hp_pos).mpr hpow
    have hfinite : source i ≠ ⊤ := by
      dsimp only [source]
      cases M.finite i <;> simp [finitePairCost, diagonalCost]
    calc
      source i = ENNReal.ofReal (source i).toReal := (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfinite).symm
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (S ^ p⁻¹) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hroot
  · intro j
    change target j ≤ _
    have hpow : (target j).toReal ^ p ≤ S := by
      rw [hsum]
      exact (Finset.single_le_sum
        (fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg p)
        (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left hs_nonneg)
    have hroot := (Real.le_rpow_inv_iff_of_pos ENNReal.toReal_nonneg hS hp_pos).mpr hpow
    have hfinite : target j ≠ ⊤ := by
      dsimp only [target]
      split_ifs <;> simp [diagonalCost]
    calc
      target j = ENNReal.ofReal (target j).toReal := (ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfinite).symm
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (S ^ p⁻¹) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hroot
  · intro k
    exact isEmptyElim k

name: TDA.Persistence.isEmpty_essentialOccurrences_of_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem isEmpty_essentialOccurrences_of_eq_zero (D : Diagram ℝ)
    (hD : essentialPart D.points = 0) : IsEmpty D.essentialOccurrences
proof:
:= by
  apply Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp
  simp only [Multiset.card_coe, hD, Multiset.card_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_lt_top_of_essentialParts_eq_zero
statement:
theorem bottleneck_lt_top_of_essentialParts_eq_zero (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (hD : essentialPart D.points = 0) (hE : essentialPart E.points = 0) :
    bottleneck D E < ⊤
proof:
:=
  (bottleneck_lt_top_iff D E).mpr (by simp only [hD, hE])

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_le_ofReal_finitePMatchingCost
statement:
theorem bottleneck_le_ofReal_finitePMatchingCost {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hD : essentialPart D.points = 0) (hE : essentialPart E.points = 0) :
    bottleneck D E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
      (finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let := isEmpty_essentialOccurrences_of_eq_zero D hD
  let := isEmpty_essentialOccurrences_of_eq_zero E hE
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := exists_minimizing_pMatching p
    (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1) (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
  let M : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences E.essentialOccurrences :=
    { finite := m.finite
      finite_injective := m.finite_injective
      essential := Equiv.equivOfIsEmpty _ _ }
  have hcost := M.cost_le_ofReal_root_totalFinitePowerCost hp
    (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1)
  have hroot : M.finiteRestriction.totalFinitePowerCost p
      (fun q => q.1) (fun q => q.1) ^ p⁻¹ =
      finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) := by
    change m.totalFinitePowerCost p _ _ ^ p⁻¹ = _
    exact hm
  rw [hroot] at hcost
  exact (bottleneck_le_matching D E M).trans hcost

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_toReal_le_finitePMatchingCost
statement:
theorem bottleneck_toReal_le_finitePMatchingCost {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hD : essentialPart D.points = 0) (hE : essentialPart E.points = 0) :
    (bottleneck D E).toReal ≤
      finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite := bottleneck_lt_top_of_essentialParts_eq_zero D E hD hE
  have h := (ENNReal.toReal_le_toReal hfinite.ne ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top).mpr
    (bottleneck_le_ofReal_finitePMatchingCost hp D E hD hE)
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (finitePMatchingCost_nonneg p _ _)] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_le_ofReal_finitePBoundaryTransportCost
statement:
theorem bottleneck_le_ofReal_finitePBoundaryTransportCost {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hD : essentialPart D.points = 0) (hE : essentialPart E.points = 0) :
    bottleneck D E ≤ ENNReal.ofReal
      (finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost]
  exact bottleneck_le_ofReal_finitePMatchingCost hp D E hD hE

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_tendsto_bottleneck
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_tendsto_bottleneck (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (hD : essentialPart D.points = 0) (hE : essentialPart E.points = 0) :
    Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
      (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1)) atTop (𝓝 (bottleneck D E).toReal)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let N := Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences
  have hfinite := bottleneck_lt_top_of_essentialParts_eq_zero D E hD hE
  by_cases hN : N = 0
  · have hcards := Nat.add_eq_zero_iff.mp hN
    let : IsEmpty D.finiteOccurrences := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hcards.1
    let : IsEmpty E.finiteOccurrences := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hcards.2
    have hB : (bottleneck D E).toReal = 0 := by
      have h := bottleneck_toReal_le_finitePMatchingCost (p := 1) (by norm_num) D E hD hE
      rw [finitePMatchingCost_empty (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1)] at h
      exact le_antisymm h ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
    rw [hB]
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.congr'
    filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)] with p hp
    exact (finitePMatchingCost_empty hp _ _).symm
  · have hNcast : (N : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hN
    have hfactor : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => (N : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 1) := by
      simpa only [Real.rpow_zero, Function.comp_def] using
        (Real.continuousAt_const_rpow (a := (N : ℝ)) (b := 0) hNcast).tendsto.comp
          (tendsto_inv_atTop_zero : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => p⁻¹) atTop (𝓝 0))
    have hupper : Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => (N : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹ * (bottleneck D E).toReal)
        atTop (𝓝 (bottleneck D E).toReal) := by
      simpa only [one_mul] using hfactor.mul_const (bottleneck D E).toReal
    apply tendsto_const_nhds.squeeze' hupper
    · exact (eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)).mono fun p hp =>
        bottleneck_toReal_le_finitePMatchingCost hp D E hD hE
    · exact (eventually_ge_atTop (1 : ℝ)).mono fun p hp =>
        finitePMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck hp D E hfinite

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendsto_bottleneck
statement:
theorem finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendsto_bottleneck (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (hD : essentialPart D.points = 0) (hE : essentialPart E.points = 0) :
    Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
      (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1)) atTop (𝓝 (bottleneck D E).toReal)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using
    finitePMatchingCost_tendsto_bottleneck D E hD hE

name: TDA.Persistence.ofReal_finitePMatchingCost_tendsto_bottleneck
statement:
theorem ofReal_finitePMatchingCost_tendsto_bottleneck (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (hD : essentialPart D.points = 0) (hE : essentialPart E.points = 0) :
    Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal
      (finitePMatchingCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1))) atTop (𝓝 (bottleneck D E))
proof:
:= by
  have hfinite := bottleneck_lt_top_of_essentialParts_eq_zero D E hD hE
  simpa only [ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hfinite.ne] using
    ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal (finitePMatchingCost_tendsto_bottleneck D E hD hE)

name: TDA.Persistence.ofReal_finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendsto_bottleneck
statement:
theorem ofReal_finitePBoundaryTransportCost_tendsto_bottleneck (D E : Diagram ℝ)
    (hD : essentialPart D.points = 0) (hE : essentialPart E.points = 0) :
    Tendsto (fun p : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal
      (finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1))) atTop (𝓝 (bottleneck D E))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_eq_matchingCost] using
    ofReal_finitePMatchingCost_tendsto_bottleneck D E hD hE

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_cokernel
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_cokernel
    {M N : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (hM : FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P) M)
    (hN : FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P) N) :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P) (Limits.cokernel f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨d⟩⟩ := hM
  obtain ⟨E, hE, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hN
  letI : Finite D.generators.Carrier := hD.1
  letI : Finite D.relations.Carrier := hD.2
  letI : Finite E.generators.Carrier := hE.1
  letI : Finite E.relations.Carrier := hE.2
  let f' := d.hom ≫ f ≫ e.inv
  obtain ⟨α, hα⟩ := E.exists_lift D.generators (D.cover ≫ f')
  let F := D.cokernelPresentation E α
  have hF : F.IsFinite := by
    change Finite E.generators.Carrier ∧
      Finite (E.relations.sum D.generators).Carrier
    exact ⟨hE.1, finite_sum_type hE.2 hD.1⟩
  let cokerIso := D.cokernelComparison E f' α hα
  have hFP' : FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P) (Limits.cokernel f') :=
    finitelyPresented_of_iso (F.finitelyPresented hF) cokerIso.symm
  let inputIso : Limits.cokernel f' ≅ Limits.cokernel f :=
    cokernel.mapIso (f := f') f d e (by simp [f', Category.assoc])
  exact finitelyPresented_of_iso hFP' inputIso

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_biprod
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_biprod
    {M N : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P}
    (hM : FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P) M)
    (hN : FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P) N) :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P) (M ⊞ N)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨d⟩⟩ := hM
  obtain ⟨E, hE, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hN
  letI : Finite D.generators.Carrier := hD.1
  letI : Finite D.relations.Carrier := hD.2
  letI : Finite E.generators.Carrier := hE.1
  letI : Finite E.relations.Carrier := hE.2
  let F := D.biprodPresentation E
  have hF : F.IsFinite := by
    change Finite (D.generators.sum E.generators).Carrier ∧
      Finite (D.relations.sum E.relations).Carrier
    exact ⟨finite_sum_type hD.1 hE.1, finite_sum_type hD.2 hE.2⟩
  let isoDE := D.biprodComparison E
  let isoInput : D.presented ⊞ E.presented ≅ M ⊞ N :=
    (biprod.mapIso d e)
  have hFP : FinitelyPresented.{u,v,w} (R := R) (P := P)
      (D.presented ⊞ E.presented) :=
    finitelyPresented_of_iso (F.finitelyPresented hF) isoDE.symm
  exact finitelyPresented_of_iso hFP isoInput

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.preimage_rectangleCell
statement:
theorem preimage_rectangleCell (a b c d : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (hcd : c < d) :
    minusCutPair ⁻¹' rectangleCell a b c d = (rectangleBox a b c d hab hcd : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  ext x

    rectangleBox, Fin.forall_fin_two]

    minusCutPair ⁻¹' boxRectangleCell I = (I : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  ext x

    Fin.forall_fin_two]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.boxRectangleCell_injective
statement: theorem boxRectangleCell_injective : Function.Injective boxRectangleCell
proof:
:= by
  intro I J h
  apply Box.injective_coe
  rw [← preimage_boxRectangleCell I, ← preimage_boxRectangleCell J, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.boxRectangleCell_nonempty
