proof:
:=
  ⟨minusCutPair I.upper, by
    have h : I.upper ∈ (I : Set (Fin 2 → ℝ)) := I.upper_mem
    rw [← preimage_boxRectangleCell I] at h
    exact h⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.exists_boxRectangleCell
proof:
:= by
  rcases hU with hU | ⟨a, b, c, d, hab, hbc, hcd, rfl⟩
  · exact (hne hU).elim
  · exact ⟨rectangleBox a b c d hab hcd, hbc, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.sampledEndpoint_le
statement:
private theorem sampledEndpoint_le (s : Fin N →o Fin L) (e : ℕ) :
    sampledEndpoint s e ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  unfold sampledEndpoint
  calc
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin N => (s j).val < e)).card ≤
        (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin N)).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
    _ = N := by simp

name: TDA.Persistence.sampledEndpoint_mono
statement:
private theorem sampledEndpoint_mono (s : Fin N →o Fin L) {a b : ℕ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) : sampledEndpoint s a ≤ sampledEndpoint s b
proof:
:= by
  unfold sampledEndpoint
  apply Finset.card_le_card
  intro j hj
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hj ⊢
  exact hj.trans_le hab

name: TDA.Persistence.sampledEndpoint_zero
statement:
private theorem sampledEndpoint_zero (s : Fin N →o Fin L) :
    sampledEndpoint s 0 = 0
proof: := by simp [sampledEndpoint]

name: TDA.Persistence.sampledEndpoint_size
statement:
private theorem sampledEndpoint_size (s : Fin N →o Fin L) :
    sampledEndpoint s L = N
proof:
:= by
  simp [sampledEndpoint]

name: TDA.Persistence.lt_sampledEndpoint_iff
statement:
theorem lt_sampledEndpoint_iff (s : Fin N →o Fin L) (e : ℕ) (j : Fin N) :
    j.val < sampledEndpoint s e ↔ (s j).val < e
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [sampledEndpoint] using
    (Fin.lt_card_filter_univ_iff_apply_of_imp
      (j := j) (fun i : Fin N => (s i).val < e)
      (by
        intro i j hji hi
        exact (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp (s.monotone' hji)).trans_lt hi))

name: TDA.Persistence.sampledEndpoint_le_val_iff
statement:
private theorem sampledEndpoint_le_val_iff (s : Fin N →o Fin L) (e : ℕ) (j : Fin N) :
    sampledEndpoint s e ≤ j.val ↔ e ≤ (s j).val
proof:
:= by
  have h := lt_sampledEndpoint_iff s e j
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInterval.restrictAlong_eq_none_iff
statement:
theorem restrictAlong_eq_none_iff (s : Fin N →o Fin L) (I : FiniteInterval L) :
    I.restrictAlong s = none ↔ ∀ j : Fin N, ¬ I.alive (s j)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hn j hj
    have hmono := sampledEndpoint_mono s (Nat.le_of_lt I.birth_lt_death)
    have hnot : ¬ sampledEndpoint s I.birth < sampledEndpoint s I.death := by
      intro hlt
      simp [restrictAlong, hlt] at hn
    have heq : sampledEndpoint s I.birth = sampledEndpoint s I.death := by omega
    have hb := (sampledEndpoint_le_val_iff s I.birth j).2 hj.1
    have hd := (lt_sampledEndpoint_iff s I.death j).2 hj.2
    omega
  · intro h
    by_cases hlt : sampledEndpoint s I.birth < sampledEndpoint s I.death
    · have hbound : sampledEndpoint s I.birth < N :=
        hlt.trans_le (sampledEndpoint_le s I.death)
      let j : Fin N := ⟨sampledEndpoint s I.birth, hbound⟩
      have hj : I.alive (s j) := by
        constructor
        · apply (sampledEndpoint_le_val_iff s I.birth j).1
          rfl
        · apply (lt_sampledEndpoint_iff s I.death j).1
          exact hlt
      exact False.elim (h j hj)
    · simp [restrictAlong, hlt]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInterval.alive_restrictAlong
statement:
theorem alive_restrictAlong (s : Fin N →o Fin L) (I : FiniteInterval L)
    (J : FiniteInterval N) (h : I.restrictAlong s = some J) (j : Fin N) :
    J.alive j ↔ I.alive (s j)
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : sampledEndpoint s I.birth < sampledEndpoint s I.death := by
    by_contra hn
    simp [restrictAlong, hn] at h
  have hJ : J = ⟨sampledEndpoint s I.birth, sampledEndpoint s I.death,
      hlt, sampledEndpoint_le s I.death⟩ := by
    simpa [restrictAlong, hlt] using h.symm
  subst J
  simp only [alive]
  exact Iff.and (sampledEndpoint_le_val_iff s I.birth j)
    (lt_sampledEndpoint_iff s I.death j)

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapRank_reindex
statement:
theorem structureMapRank_reindex (s : Fin N →o Fin L)
    (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank (reindex s M) i j hij =
      structureMapRank M (s i) (s j) (s.monotone' hij)
proof:
:= by
  unfold structureMapRank
  rw [structureMapLinear_reindex]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.rankInteger_reindex_nat
statement:
private theorem rankInteger_reindex_nat (s : Fin N →o Fin L)
    (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (hj : j < N) :
    moduleRankInteger (reindex s M) (i : ℤ) (j : ℤ) =
      moduleRankInteger M ((s ⟨i, by omega⟩).val : ℤ)
        ((s ⟨j, hj⟩).val : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let fi : Fin N := ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let fj : Fin N := ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hfin : fi ≤ fj := Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr hij
  have hs : s fi ≤ s fj := s.monotone' hfin
  have hleft := moduleRankInteger_fin (reindex s M) fi fj hfin
  have hright := moduleRankInteger_fin M (s fi) (s fj) hs
  rw [hleft, hright]
  exact_mod_cast structureMapRank_reindex M s fi fj hfin

name: TDA.Persistence.multiplicity_reindex_four_ranks
statement:
private theorem multiplicity_reindex_four_ranks (s : Fin N →o Fin L)
    (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (reindex s M) b d =
      let A := if b = 0 then 0 else (s ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val + 1
      let B := (s ⟨b, by omega⟩).val
      let C := (s ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩).val
      let D := if hdN : d < N then (s ⟨d, hdN⟩).val else L
      moduleRankInteger M (B : ℤ) (C : ℤ) -
        moduleRankInteger M ((A : ℤ) - 1) (C : ℤ) -
        moduleRankInteger M (B : ℤ) (D : ℤ) +
        moduleRankInteger M ((A : ℤ) - 1) (D : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℕ := if b = 0 then 0 else (s ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val + 1
  let B : ℕ := (s ⟨b, by omega⟩).val
  let C : ℕ := (s ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩).val
  let D : ℕ := if hdN : d < N then (s ⟨d, hdN⟩).val else L
  have hc : ((d - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (d : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
  have hBC : moduleRankInteger (reindex s M) (b : ℤ) ((d : ℤ) - 1) =
      moduleRankInteger M (B : ℤ) (C : ℤ) := by
    rw [← hc]
    simpa [B, C] using rankInteger_reindex_nat M s b (d - 1) (by omega) (by omega)
  have hAC : moduleRankInteger (reindex s M) ((b : ℤ) - 1) ((d : ℤ) - 1) =
      moduleRankInteger M ((A : ℤ) - 1) (C : ℤ) := by
    by_cases hb : b = 0
    · subst b
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_sub, A, if_pos rfl]
      rw [moduleRankInteger_neg_one, moduleRankInteger_neg_one]
    · have ha : ((b - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (b : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
      have ha' : ((A : ℤ) - 1) = ((s ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val : ℤ) := by
        simp [A, hb]
      rw [← ha, ← hc, ha']
      simpa [C] using rankInteger_reindex_nat M s (b - 1) (d - 1)
        (by omega) (by omega)
  have hBD : moduleRankInteger (reindex s M) (b : ℤ) (d : ℤ) =
      moduleRankInteger M (B : ℤ) (D : ℤ) := by
    by_cases hdN : d < N
    · simpa [B, D, hdN] using rankInteger_reindex_nat M s b d (by omega) hdN
    · have hdeq : d = N := by omega
      have ht := moduleRankInteger_at_size (reindex s M) (b : ℤ)
      have hs := moduleRankInteger_at_size M (B : ℤ)
      simpa [D, hdN, hdeq] using ht.trans hs.symm
  have hAD : moduleRankInteger (reindex s M) ((b : ℤ) - 1) (d : ℤ) =
      moduleRankInteger M ((A : ℤ) - 1) (D : ℤ) := by
    by_cases hb : b = 0
    · subst b
      simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_sub, A, if_pos rfl]
      rw [moduleRankInteger_neg_one, moduleRankInteger_neg_one]
    · have ha : ((b - 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) = (b : ℤ) - 1 := by omega
      have ha' : ((A : ℤ) - 1) = ((s ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val : ℤ) := by
        simp [A, hb]
      by_cases hdN : d < N
      · rw [← ha, ha']
        simpa [D, hdN] using rankInteger_reindex_nat M s (b - 1) d
          (by omega) hdN
      · have hdeq : d = N := by omega
        have ht := moduleRankInteger_at_size (reindex s M) ((b : ℤ) - 1)
        have hs := moduleRankInteger_at_size M ((A : ℤ) - 1)
        simpa [D, hdN, hdeq] using ht.trans hs.symm
  change moduleMultiplicityInteger (reindex s M) b d =
    moduleRankInteger M (B : ℤ) (C : ℤ) -
      moduleRankInteger M ((A : ℤ) - 1) (C : ℤ) -
      moduleRankInteger M (B : ℤ) (D : ℤ) +
      moduleRankInteger M ((A : ℤ) - 1) (D : ℤ)
  unfold moduleMultiplicityInteger
  rw [hBC, hAC, hBD, hAD]

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleMultiplicityInteger_reindex
statement:
theorem moduleMultiplicityInteger_reindex (s : Fin N →o Fin L)
    (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    moduleMultiplicityInteger (reindex s M) b d =
      let A := if b = 0 then 0 else (s ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val + 1
      let B := (s ⟨b, by omega⟩).val
      let C := (s ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩).val
      let D := if hdN : d < N then (s ⟨d, hdN⟩).val else L
      ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc A B, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc C D,
        moduleMultiplicityInteger M x y
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℕ := if b = 0 then 0 else (s ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val + 1
  let B : ℕ := (s ⟨b, by omega⟩).val
  let C : ℕ := (s ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩).val
  let D : ℕ := if hdN : d < N then (s ⟨d, hdN⟩).val else L
  have hfour := multiplicity_reindex_four_ranks M s b d hbd hd
  change moduleMultiplicityInteger (reindex s M) b d =
    ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc A B, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc C D,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger M x y
  change moduleMultiplicityInteger (reindex s M) b d =
    moduleRankInteger M (B : ℤ) (C : ℤ) -
      moduleRankInteger M ((A : ℤ) - 1) (C : ℤ) -
      moduleRankInteger M (B : ℤ) (D : ℤ) +
      moduleRankInteger M ((A : ℤ) - 1) (D : ℤ) at hfour
  by_cases hAB : A ≤ B
  · have hBC : B ≤ C := by
      change (s ⟨b, by omega⟩).val ≤ (s ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩).val
      exact Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp
        (s.monotone' (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr (by change b ≤ d - 1; omega)))
    have hCD : C ≤ D := by
      by_cases hdN : d < N
      · have hle : (⟨d - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin N) ≤ ⟨d, hdN⟩ :=
          Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr (by change d - 1 ≤ d; omega)
        simpa [C, D, hdN] using Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp (s.monotone' hle)
      · simp [C, D, hdN]
    have hDL : D ≤ L := by
      by_cases hdN : d < N
      · simp [D, hdN]
      · simp [D, hdN]
    exact hfour.trans
      (moduleMultiplicityInteger_sum_rectangle M A B C D hAB hBC hCD hDL).symm
  · have hb : b ≠ 0 := by
      intro hzero
      subst b
      have hAzero : A = 0 := rfl
      omega
    have hprev : (s ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val ≤ B := by
      change (s ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val ≤ (s ⟨b, by omega⟩).val
      exact Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp
        (s.monotone' (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr (by change b - 1 ≤ b; omega)))
    have heq : ((A : ℤ) - 1) = (B : ℤ) := by
      have hA : A = (s ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val + 1 := by simp [A, hb]
      omega
    have hempty : Finset.Icc A B = ∅ := Finset.Icc_eq_empty_of_lt (by omega)
    rw [hfour, heq, hempty]
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.countP_filterMap
statement:
private theorem countP_filterMap {α β : Type*} (f : α → Option β)
    (B : Multiset α) (p : β → Prop) [DecidablePred p]
    [DecidablePred (fun a : α => ∃ b, f a = some b ∧ p b)] :
    (Multiset.filterMap f B).countP p =
      B.countP (fun a => ∃ b, f a = some b ∧ p b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction B using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons a B ih =>
    cases h : f a with
    | none => simpa [Multiset.filterMap_cons_none a B h, h] using ih
    | some b =>
      rw [Multiset.filterMap_cons_some f a B h,
        Multiset.countP_cons, Multiset.countP_cons, ih]
      have hp : (∃ c, f a = some c ∧ p c) ↔ p b := by simp [h]
      simp only [hp]

name: TDA.Persistence.countP_reindexBarcode
statement:
private theorem countP_reindexBarcode (s : Fin N →o Fin L)
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval L)) (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    (reindexBarcode s B).countP
        (fun J => J.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < J.death) =
      B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ (s i).val ∧ (s j).val < I.death)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [reindexBarcode, countP_filterMap]
  apply Multiset.countP_congr (s := B) (s' := B) rfl
  intro I _
  apply propext
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨J, hJ, hp⟩
    have hAliveJ := (interval_alive_endpoints_iff J hij).2 hp
    have hAliveI : I.alive (s i) ∧ I.alive (s j) :=
      ⟨(FiniteInterval.alive_restrictAlong s I J hJ i).1 hAliveJ.1,
        (FiniteInterval.alive_restrictAlong s I J hJ j).1 hAliveJ.2⟩
    exact (interval_alive_endpoints_iff I (s.monotone' hij)).1 hAliveI
  · intro hp
    have hAliveI : I.alive (s i) ∧ I.alive (s j) :=
      (interval_alive_endpoints_iff I (s.monotone' hij)).2 hp
    cases hres : I.restrictAlong s with
    | none =>
      exact False.elim ((FiniteInterval.restrictAlong_eq_none_iff s I).1 hres i hAliveI.1)
    | some J =>
      refine ⟨J, rfl, ?_⟩
      apply (interval_alive_endpoints_iff J hij).1
      exact ⟨(FiniteInterval.alive_restrictAlong s I J hres i).2 hAliveI.1,
        (FiniteInterval.alive_restrictAlong s I J hres j).2 hAliveI.2⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.rankBarcode_reindex
statement:
theorem rankBarcode_reindex (s : Fin N →o Fin L) :
    rankBarcode (reindex s M) = reindexBarcode s (rankBarcode M)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ∀ (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j),
      structureMapRank (reindex s M) i j hij =
        structureMapRank
          (barcodeModule (k := k) (reindexBarcode s (rankBarcode M))) i j hij := by
    intro i j hij
    calc
      structureMapRank (reindex s M) i j hij =
          structureMapRank M (s i) (s j) (s.monotone' hij) :=
        structureMapRank_reindex M s i j hij
      _ = structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) (rankBarcode M))
          (s i) (s j) (s.monotone' hij) :=
        (structureMapRank_rankBarcode M (s i) (s j) (s.monotone' hij)).symm
      _ = (rankBarcode M).countP
          (fun I => I.birth ≤ (s i).val ∧ (s j).val < I.death) :=
        rank_barcodeMap (k := k) (rankBarcode M) (s i) (s j) (s.monotone' hij)
      _ = (reindexBarcode s (rankBarcode M)).countP
          (fun J => J.birth ≤ i.val ∧ j.val < J.death) :=
        (countP_reindexBarcode s (rankBarcode M) i j hij).symm
      _ = structureMapRank
          (barcodeModule (k := k) (reindexBarcode s (rankBarcode M))) i j hij :=
        (rank_barcodeMap (k := k) (reindexBarcode s (rankBarcode M)) i j hij).symm
  have heq := (rankBarcode_eq_iff (reindex s M)
    (barcodeModule (k := k) (reindexBarcode s (rankBarcode M)))).2 hr
  exact heq.trans (rankBarcode_barcodeModule (k := k) (reindexBarcode s (rankBarcode M)))

name: TDA.Persistence.barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode_reindex
statement:
theorem barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode_reindex (s : Fin N →o Fin L)
    (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ N) :
    barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (reindex s M)) b d =
      let A := if b = 0 then 0 else (s ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val + 1
      let B := (s ⟨b, by omega⟩).val
      let C := (s ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩).val
      let D := if hdN : d < N then (s ⟨d, hdN⟩).val else L
      ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc A B, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc C D,
        barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode M) x y
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℕ := if b = 0 then 0 else (s ⟨b - 1, by omega⟩).val + 1
  let B : ℕ := (s ⟨b, by omega⟩).val
  let C : ℕ := (s ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩).val
  let D : ℕ := if hdN : d < N then (s ⟨d, hdN⟩).val else L
  have hBC : B ≤ C := by
    change (s ⟨b, by omega⟩).val ≤ (s ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩).val
    exact Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mp
      (s.monotone' (Fin.le_iff_val_le_val.mpr (by change b ≤ d - 1; omega)))
  have hD : D ≤ L := by
    by_cases hdN : d < N
    · simp [D, hdN]
    · simp [D, hdN]
  have hInt : (barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (reindex s M)) b d : ℤ) =
      ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc A B, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc C D,
        (barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode M) x y : ℤ) := by
    rw [barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode (reindex s M) b d hbd hd,
      moduleMultiplicityInteger_reindex M s b d hbd hd]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro y hy
    have hxy : x < y := by
      have hx' := Finset.mem_Icc.mp hx
      have hy' := Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hy
      omega
    have hyL : y ≤ L := (Finset.mem_Ioc.mp hy).2.trans hD
    exact (barcodeMultiplicity_rankBarcode M x y hxy hyL).symm
  change barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode (reindex s M)) b d =
    ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc A B, ∑ y ∈ Finset.Ioc C D,
      barcodeMultiplicity (rankBarcode M) x y
  exact_mod_cast hInt

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.Examples.hookClass_coordinate
statement:
private theorem hookClass_coordinate {m r : ℕ} (f : Fin m → ℕ) (A B : FaceIndex m r)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ Hook.support 0 (faceJoin f A)) :
    (((biproduct.π (fun C : FaceIndex m r => Hook.module (k := ℚ) 0 (faceJoin f C)) B).app p).hom
      (((hookSumIso (k := ℚ) f r).hom.app p).hom (hookClass f A p hp)) : ℚ) =
      if A = B then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold hookClass
  have he := congrArg (fun t : (⨁ (fun C : FaceIndex m r =>
    Hook.module (k := ℚ) 0 (faceJoin f C))) ⟶ _ =>
      (t.app p).hom (((biproduct.ι (fun C : FaceIndex m r =>
        Hook.module (k := ℚ) 0 (faceJoin f C)) A).app p).hom (SupportInterval.one _ hp)))
    (hookSumIso (k := ℚ) f r).inv_hom_id
  change ((hookSumIso (k := ℚ) f r).hom.app p).hom
    (((hookSumIso (k := ℚ) f r).inv.app p).hom _) = _ at he
  simp only [NatTrans.id_app] at he
  rw [he]
  change (((biproduct.ι (fun C : FaceIndex m r =>
    Hook.module (k := ℚ) 0 (faceJoin f C)) A ≫
      biproduct.π (fun C : FaceIndex m r => Hook.module (k := ℚ) 0 (faceJoin f C)) B).app p).hom
        (SupportInterval.one _ hp) : ℚ) = _
  by_cases hAB : A = B
  · subst B
    rw [biproduct.ι_π_self, if_pos rfl]
    rfl
  · rw [biproduct.ι_π_ne _ hAB, if_neg hAB]
    rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.Examples.hookClass_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem hookClass_ne_zero {m r : ℕ} (f : Fin m → ℕ) (A : FaceIndex m r)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : p ∈ Hook.support 0 (faceJoin f A)) : hookClass f A p hp ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have h := hookClass_coordinate f A A p hp
  rw [hz, map_zero, map_zero] at h
  norm_num at h

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.Examples.one_generator_quotient_nonzero
statement:
theorem one_generator_quotient_nonzero :
    ∃ x : (term (k := ℚ) (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℕ)) 0).obj 0, x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let A : FaceIndex 1 0 := singletonFaceIndex 0
  have hp : 0 ∈ Hook.support 0 (faceJoin (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℕ)) A) := by
    simp [A, faceJoin_singleton, Hook.support]
  exact ⟨hookClass _ A 0 hp, hookClass_ne_zero _ A 0 hp⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.Examples.repeated_occurrence_classes_distinct
statement:
theorem repeated_occurrence_classes_distinct :
    ∃ x y : (term (k := ℚ) (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 : ℕ)) 0).obj 0,
      x ≠ 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ x ≠ y
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin 2 → ℕ := fun _ => 1
  let A : FaceIndex 2 0 := singletonFaceIndex 0
  let B : FaceIndex 2 0 := singletonFaceIndex 1
  have hpA : 0 ∈ Hook.support 0 (faceJoin f A) := by simp [A, f, Hook.support]
  have hpB : 0 ∈ Hook.support 0 (faceJoin f B) := by simp [B, f, Hook.support]
  have hAB : A ≠ B := by decide
  refine ⟨hookClass f A 0 hpA, hookClass f B 0 hpB,
    hookClass_ne_zero f A 0 hpA, hookClass_ne_zero f B 0 hpB, ?_⟩
  intro hxy
  have hx := hookClass_coordinate f A A 0 hpA
  have hy := hookClass_coordinate f B A 0 hpB
  rw [hxy] at hx
  rw [if_pos rfl] at hx
  rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hAB)] at hy
  exact zero_ne_one (hy.symm.trans hx)

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.Examples.two_generator_positive_quotient_nonzero
statement:
theorem two_generator_positive_quotient_nonzero :
    ∃ x : (term (k := ℚ) (fun i : Fin 2 => i.val + 1) 1).obj 0, x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let A : FaceIndex 2 1 := ⟨Finset.univ, by decide⟩
  have hp : 0 ∈ Hook.support 0 (faceJoin (fun i : Fin 2 => i.val + 1) A) := by
    refine ⟨Nat.zero_le _, ?_⟩
    intro h
    have h1 : 1 ≤ faceJoin (fun i : Fin 2 => i.val + 1) A := by
      exact Finset.le_sup' (f := fun i : Fin 2 => i.val + 1) (show (0 : Fin 2) ∈ A.1 by simp [A])
    omega
  exact ⟨hookClass _ A 0 hp, hookClass_ne_zero _ A 0 hp⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.Examples.two_generator_kernel_row_rankExact
statement:
theorem two_generator_kernel_row_rankExact :
    IsRankExact
      (kernel.ι (differential (k := ℚ) (fun i : Fin 2 => i.val + 1) 0))
      (kernelRowLift (augmentation_range_eq_ker (k := ℚ) (fun i : Fin 2 => i.val + 1)))
proof:
:=
  zero_kernelRow_rankExact _

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.Examples.bottom_generator_quotients_zero
statement:
theorem bottom_generator_quotients_zero (r : ℕ) :
    IsZero (term (k := ℚ) (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : ℕ)) r)
proof:
:=
  term_bottomFamily_isZero 1 r

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.Examples.repeated_target_projection_coefficient
statement:
theorem repeated_target_projection_coefficient :
    (((targetProjection (k := ℚ) (fun _ : Fin 2 => (1 : ℕ)) (by decide)).app 0).hom
      (SupportInterval.one _ (mem_generatedSupport_bottom (by decide : 0 < 2) 0)) : ℚ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [targetProjection_val, if_pos]
  · rfl
  · simp [complementSupport]

name: TDA.Persistence.GeneratedUpsetQuotientResolution.Examples.empty_family_quotients_zero
statement:
theorem empty_family_quotients_zero (r : ℕ) :
    IsZero (term (k := ℚ) (fun i : Fin 0 => (Fin.elim0 i : ℕ)) r) ∧
      IsZero (target (k := ℚ) (fun i : Fin 0 => (Fin.elim0 i : ℕ)))
proof:
:=
  ⟨term_fin_zero_isZero _ r, target_fin_zero_isZero _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem totalBoundaryCost_nonneg (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (c : I → J → ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (v : J → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ c i j) (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ j, 0 ≤ v j) :
    0 ≤ M.totalBoundaryCost c u v
proof:
:= by
  apply add_nonneg
  · apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro i _
    cases M.finite i with
    | some j => exact hc i j
    | none => exact hu i
  · apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro j _
    split_ifs
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact hv j

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost_relabel
statement:
theorem totalBoundaryCost_relabel (u : I' ≃ I) (v : J' ≃ J)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (c : I → J → ℝ) (uCost : I → ℝ) (vCost : J → ℝ) :
    (M.relabel u v (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _)).totalBoundaryCost (fun i j => c (u i) (v j)) (uCost ∘ u) (vCost ∘ v) =
      M.totalBoundaryCost c uCost vCost
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold totalBoundaryCost
  congr 1
  · have hf (i : I') :
        (match (M.relabel u v (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _)).finite i with
          | some j => c (u i) (v j)
          | none => uCost (u i)) =
        (match M.finite (u i) with
          | some j => c (u i) j
          | none => uCost (u i)) := by
      cases h : M.finite (u i) <;> simp [relabel, h]
    calc
      _ = ∑ i : I', match M.finite (u i) with
          | some j => c (u i) j
          | none => uCost (u i) := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i _
            exact hf i
      _ = _ := u.sum_comp (fun i => match M.finite i with
          | some j => c i j
          | none => uCost i)
  · have hh (j : J') :
        (∃ i : I', (M.relabel u v (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _)).finite i = some j) ↔
          ∃ i : I, M.finite i = some (v j) := by
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        refine ⟨u i, ?_⟩
        cases h : M.finite (u i) with
        | none => simp [relabel, h] at hi
        | some k =>
          simp [relabel, h] at hi
          have hk : k = v j := v.symm_apply_eq.mp hi
          exact congrArg some hk
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        exact ⟨u.symm i, by simp [relabel, hi]⟩
    simpa only [Function.comp_apply, hh] using v.sum_comp
      (fun j => if ∃ i, M.finite i = some j then 0 else vCost j)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.Significant.of_le
statement:
theorem Significant.of_le {n : ℕ} {δ ρ : ℝ≥0} (hδρ : δ ≤ ρ)
    {R : Rectangle n} (h : Significant ρ R) : Significant δ R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩ := h
  refine ⟨p, hp, R.ordConnected.out hp hp' ?_⟩
  constructor
  · intro j
    change p j ≤ p j + (δ : ℝ)
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg
  · intro j
    change p j + (δ : ℝ) ≤ p j + (ρ : ℝ)
    exact add_le_add le_rfl (show (δ : ℝ) ≤ (ρ : ℝ) from hδρ)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shifted_coefficient_eq_of_le
statement:
theorem shifted_coefficient_eq_of_le {n : ℕ} {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module)
    {p q : Fin n → ℝ} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hpR : p ∈ R.support) (hqR : q ∈ R.support)
    (hqS : translation ε q ∈ S.support) :
    shiftedCoefficientAt R S ε f p hpR =
      shiftedCoefficientAt R S ε f q hqR
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hn := congrArg
    (fun v => ((show SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S.support (translation ε q)
      from v.hom (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR)) : k))
    (f.naturality (homOfLE hpq))
  have hm : structureMapLinear R.module hpq
      (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR) =
      SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hqR := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [SupportInterval.structureMap_val]
    simp [hqR, SupportInterval.one]
  change ((show SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S.support (translation ε q) from
      (f.app q).hom (structureMapLinear R.module hpq
        (SupportInterval.one R.support hpR))) : k) =
    (structureMapLinear S.module ((translation ε).monotone' hpq)
      ((f.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one R.support hpR)) : k) at hn
  rw [hm] at hn
  change _ = ((structureMapLinear (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S.support S.ordConnected)
    ((translation ε).monotone' hpq)
    ((f.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one R.support hpR))) : k) at hn
  have hv : ((structureMapLinear (SupportInterval.module (k := k) S.support
      S.ordConnected) ((translation ε).monotone' hpq)
      ((f.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one R.support hpR))) : k) =
      shiftedCoefficientAt R S ε f p hpR := by
    have hs := SupportInterval.structureMap_val S.support S.ordConnected
      ((translation ε).monotone' hpq)
      ((f.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one R.support hpR))
    change _ = if translation ε q ∈ S.support then
      shiftedCoefficientAt R S ε f p hpR else 0 at hs
    rw [if_pos hqS] at hs
    exact hs
  rw [hv] at hn
  simpa only [shiftedCoefficientAt] using hn.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shifted_coefficient_eq
statement:
theorem shifted_coefficient_eq {n : ℕ} {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module)
    {p q : Fin n → ℝ} (hpR : p ∈ R.support)
    (hpS : translation ε p ∈ S.support)
    (hqR : q ∈ R.support) (hqS : translation ε q ∈ S.support) :
    shiftedCoefficientAt R S ε f p hpR =
      shiftedCoefficientAt R S ε f q hqR
proof:
:= by
  have hmR := R.inf_mem hpR hqR
  have hmS : translation ε (p ⊓ q) ∈ S.support := by
    intro i
    by_cases h : p i ≤ q i
    · simpa [translation_apply, Pi.inf_apply, min_eq_left h] using hpS i
    · have h' : q i ≤ p i := le_of_not_ge h
      simpa [translation_apply, Pi.inf_apply, min_eq_right h'] using hqS i
  have hmp := shifted_coefficient_eq_of_le R S ε f inf_le_left hmR hpR hpS
  have hmq := shifted_coefficient_eq_of_le R S ε f inf_le_right hmR hqR hqS
  exact hmp.symm.trans hmq

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shiftedCoefficient_eq_at
statement:
theorem shiftedCoefficient_eq_at {n : ℕ} {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module)
    {p : Fin n → ℝ} (hpR : p ∈ R.support)
    (hpS : translation ε p ∈ S.support) :
    shiftedCoefficient R S ε f = shiftedCoefficientAt R S ε f p hpR
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h : ∃ p, p ∈ R.support ∧ translation ε p ∈ S.support := ⟨p, hpR, hpS⟩
  simp only [shiftedCoefficient, dif_pos h]
  exact shifted_coefficient_eq R S ε f
    (Classical.choose_spec h).1 (Classical.choose_spec h).2 hpR hpS

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shiftedCoefficient_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem shiftedCoefficient_zero {n : ℕ} {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    shiftedCoefficient (k := k) R S ε 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold shiftedCoefficient
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shiftedCoefficient_add
statement:
theorem shiftedCoefficient_add {n : ℕ} {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f g : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module) :
    shiftedCoefficient R S ε (f + g) =
      shiftedCoefficient R S ε f + shiftedCoefficient R S ε g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold shiftedCoefficient
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · exact (add_zero (0 : k)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shiftedCoefficient_sum
statement:
theorem shiftedCoefficient_sum {n : ℕ} {k : Type*} [Field k]
    {ι : Type*} (R S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0) (A : Finset ι)
    (f : ι → (R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module)) :
    shiftedCoefficient R S ε (∑ i ∈ A, f i) =
      ∑ i ∈ A, shiftedCoefficient R S ε (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction A using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert i A hi ih => simp [hi, shiftedCoefficient_add, ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shifted_app_val
statement:
theorem shifted_app_val {n : ℕ} {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module)
    {p : Fin n → ℝ} (hpR : p ∈ R.support)
    (hpS : translation ε p ∈ S.support)
    (x : SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) R.support p) :
    ((show SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S.support (translation ε p) from
      (f.app p).hom x) : k) = (x : k) * shiftedCoefficient R S ε f
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedCoefficient_eq_at R S ε f hpR hpS]
  have hx : x = (x : k) • SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [SupportInterval.one]
  calc
    _ = ((show SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S.support (translation ε p) from
        (f.app p).hom ((x : k) • SupportInterval.one R.support hpR)) : k) :=
      congrArg (fun z => ((show SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S.support
        (translation ε p) from (f.app p).hom z) : k)) hx
    _ = _ := by rw [map_smul]; rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shiftedCoefficient_comparison
statement:
theorem shiftedCoefficient_comparison {n : ℕ} {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (h : ∀ j, RectangleStabilityGeometry.decoratedLE
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.endpoint S j)
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.endpoint R j + (ε : ℝ))
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.plus S j) (RectangleStabilityGeometry.plus R j))
    {p : Fin n → ℝ} (hpR : p ∈ R.support)
    (hpS : translation ε p ∈ S.support) :
    shiftedCoefficient (k := k) R S ε
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.comparison R S ε h) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [shiftedCoefficient_eq_at R S ε _ hpR hpS]
  have hv := RectangleStabilityGeometry.comparison_app_val R S ε h p
    (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR)
  change shiftedCoefficientAt R S ε _ p hpR =
    if translation ε p ∈ S.support then 1 else 0 at hv
  simpa only [if_pos hpS] using hv

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shiftedCoefficient_ne_zero_iff
statement:
theorem shiftedCoefficient_ne_zero_iff {n : ℕ} {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module) :
    shiftedCoefficient R S ε f ≠ 0 ↔ f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h hf
    exact h (hf ▸ shiftedCoefficient_zero R S ε)
  · intro hf
    obtain ⟨p, hpR, hpS, hne⟩ :=
      RectangleStabilityGeometry.exists_nonzero_shifted_component R S ε f hf
    rw [shiftedCoefficient_eq_at R S ε f hpR hpS]
    intro hz
    apply hne
    exact Subtype.ext hz

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shiftedCoefficient_composite_at
statement:
private theorem shiftedCoefficient_composite_at {n : ℕ} {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (R S T : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module)
    (g : S.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj T.module)
    {p : Fin n → ℝ} (hpR : p ∈ R.support)
    (hpS : translation ε p ∈ S.support)
    (hpT : translation (ε + ε) p ∈ T.support) :
    shiftedCoefficient R T (ε + ε)
      (f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫ (compIso ε ε T.module).hom) =
      shiftedCoefficient R S ε f * shiftedCoefficient S T ε g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have he : translation ε (translation ε p) = translation (ε + ε) p := by
    funext i
    simp [translation_apply, NNReal.coe_add, add_assoc]
  have hpT' : translation ε (translation ε p) ∈ T.support := he ▸ hpT
  rw [shiftedCoefficient_eq_at R T (ε + ε) _ hpR hpT]
  let x : SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S.support (translation ε p) :=
    (f.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR)
  let y : SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) T.support (translation ε (translation ε p)) :=
    (g.app (translation ε p)).hom x
  have hgval := shifted_app_val S T ε g hpS hpT' x
  have hyval : (y : k) = (x : k) * shiftedCoefficient S T ε g := hgval
  have hfval := shifted_app_val R S ε f hpR hpS
    (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR)
  have hcomp : translation ε (translation ε p) ≤ translation (ε + ε) p :=
    le_of_eq he
  change ((structureMapLinear (SupportInterval.module (k := k) T.support T.ordConnected)
    hcomp y) : k) = _
  rw [SupportInterval.structureMap_val]
  change (if translation (ε + ε) p ∈ T.support then (y : k) else 0) = _
  rw [if_pos hpT, hyval]
  have hxval : ((show SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) S.support
      (translation ε p) from x) : k) = shiftedCoefficient R S ε f := by
    change (x : k) = (1 : k) * shiftedCoefficient R S ε f at hfval
    simpa only [one_mul] using hfval
  rw [hxval]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shiftedCoefficient_composite
statement:
theorem shiftedCoefficient_composite {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (R S T : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (hRT : RectangleStabilityGeometry.alphaLE R T)
    (hR : ∃ p, p ∈ R.support ∧
      translation (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
        RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) p ∈ R.support)
    (hT : ∃ p, p ∈ T.support ∧
      translation (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
        RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) p ∈ T.support)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module)
    (g : S.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj T.module) :
    shiftedCoefficient R T (ε + ε)
      (f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫ (compIso ε ε T.module).hom) =
      shiftedCoefficient R S ε f * shiftedCoefficient S T ε g
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · subst f
    simp
  by_cases hg : g = 0
  · subst g
    simp
  obtain ⟨p, hpR, hpS, hpT⟩ :=
    RectangleStabilityGeometry.nonzero_path_support hn R S T ε hRT hR hT f hf g hg
  exact shiftedCoefficient_composite_at R S T ε f g hpR hpS hpT

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.composite_ne_zero_of_significant
statement:
theorem composite_ne_zero_of_significant {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (R S T : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (hRT : RectangleStabilityGeometry.alphaLE R T)
    (hR : Significant (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
      RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) R)
    (hT : Significant (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
      RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) T)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module) (hf : f ≠ 0)
    (g : S.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj T.module) (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hc := shiftedCoefficient_composite hn R S T ε hRT hR hT f g
  have hne := mul_ne_zero ((shiftedCoefficient_ne_zero_iff R S ε f).2 hf)
    ((shiftedCoefficient_ne_zero_iff S T ε g).2 hg)
  have hc₀ : shiftedCoefficient R T (ε + ε)
      (f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫ (compIso ε ε T.module).hom) = 0 := by
    simp only [← Category.assoc, hz]
    simp
  exact hne (hc.symm.trans hc₀)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.shiftedCoefficient_transition
statement:
theorem shiftedCoefficient_transition {n : ℕ} {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (R : Rectangle n) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (h : ∃ p, p ∈ R.support ∧ translation δ p ∈ R.support) :
    shiftedCoefficient (k := k) R R δ (transition δ R.module) = 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp'⟩ := h
  rw [shiftedCoefficient_eq_at R R δ _ hp hp']
  change ((structureMapLinear (SupportInterval.module (k := k) R.support R.ordConnected)
    (show p ≤ translation δ p from fun j => le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg)
    (SupportInterval.one R.support hp)) : k) = 1
  rw [SupportInterval.structureMap_val]
  change (if translation δ p ∈ R.support then (1 : k) else 0) = 1
  rw [if_pos hp']

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.significant_iff_transition_ne_zero
statement:
theorem significant_iff_transition_ne_zero {n : ℕ} {k : Type*} [Field k]
    (R : Rectangle n) (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    Significant δ R ↔ transition δ (R.module (k := k)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← shiftedCoefficient_ne_zero_iff R R δ]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [shiftedCoefficient_transition R δ h]
    exact one_ne_zero
  · intro h
    by_contra hn
    change ¬ (∃ p, p ∈ R.support ∧ translation δ p ∈ R.support) at hn
    exact h (by simp [shiftedCoefficient, hn])

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.path_eq_zero_of_not_neighbor
statement:
theorem path_eq_zero_of_not_neighbor {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {k : Type*} [Field k] (R S T : Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (hRT : RectangleStabilityGeometry.alphaLE R T)
    (f : R.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj S.module)
    (g : S.module (k := k) ⟶ (shift ε).obj T.module)
    (hRS : ¬ Neighbor (k := k) (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) R S)
    (hST : ¬ Neighbor (k := k) (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) S T) :
    f ≫ (shift ε).map g = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f = 0
  · simp [hf]
  by_cases hg : g = 0
  · subst g
    change f ≫ 0 = 0
    simp
  rcases RectangleStabilityGeometry.nonzero_path_interleaving hn R S T ε hRT f hf g hg
    with h | h
  · exact False.elim (hRS h)
  · exact False.elim (hST h)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.component_path_zero_outside
statement:
theorem component_path_zero_outside {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {ι κ : Type} [Finite ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : RectangleFamily.module (k := k) R ⟶
      (shift ε).obj (RectangleFamily.module S))
    (g : RectangleFamily.module (k := k) S ⟶
      (shift ε).obj (RectangleFamily.module R))
    (A : Finset ι) {i i' : ι} (hi : i ∈ A) (hi' : i' ∈ A)
    (hα : RectangleStabilityGeometry.alphaLE (R i) (R i'))
    {j : κ} (hj : j ∉ neighbors (k := k) R S A
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε)) :
    RectangleFamily.component R S ε f i j ≫
      (shift ε).map (RectangleFamily.component S R ε g j i') = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnot (l : ι) (hl : l ∈ A) :
      ¬ Neighbor (k := k) (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε)
        (R l) (S j) := by
    intro h
    apply hj
    simp only [neighbors, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact ⟨l, hl, h⟩
  have hnot' : ¬ Neighbor (k := k)
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (S j) (R i') := by
    intro h
    exact hnot i' hi' ⟨(Classical.choice h).symm⟩
  exact path_eq_zero_of_not_neighbor hn (R i) (S j) (R i') ε hα
    (RectangleFamily.component R S ε f i j)
    (RectangleFamily.component S R ε g j i') (hnot i hi) hnot'

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.component_sum_neighbors
statement:
theorem component_sum_neighbors {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {ι κ : Type} [Finite ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : RectangleFamily.module (k := k) R ⟶
      (shift ε).obj (RectangleFamily.module S))
    (g : RectangleFamily.module (k := k) S ⟶
      (shift ε).obj (RectangleFamily.module R))
    (A : Finset ι) {i i' : ι} (hi : i ∈ A) (hi' : i' ∈ A)
    (hα : RectangleStabilityGeometry.alphaLE (R i) (R i')) :
    ∑ j ∈ neighbors (k := k) R S A (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε),
      RectangleFamily.component R S ε f i j ≫
        (shift ε).map (RectangleFamily.component S R ε g j i') =
      ∑ j : κ, RectangleFamily.component R S ε f i j ≫
        (shift ε).map (RectangleFamily.component S R ε g j i')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)
  intro j _ hj
  exact component_path_zero_outside hn R S ε f g A hi hi' hα hj

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.card_le_of_triangular_product
statement:
theorem card_le_of_triangular_product
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {ι κ : Type*}
    [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] [Fintype κ]
    (G : Matrix ι κ k) (F : Matrix κ ι k)
    (hbelow : ∀ ⦃i i' : ι⦄, i' < i → (G * F) i i' = 0)
    (hdiag : ∀ i : ι, (G * F) i i = 1) :
    Fintype.card ι ≤ Fintype.card κ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have htri : (G * F).IsUpperTriangular := by
    intro i i' h
    exact hbelow h
  have hdet : (G * F).det ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_of_isUpperTriangular htri]
    simp only [hdiag, Finset.prod_const_one]
    exact one_ne_zero
  calc
    Fintype.card ι = (G * F).rank :=
      (Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hdet).symm
    _ ≤ G.rank := Matrix.rank_mul_le_left G F
    _ ≤ Fintype.card κ := Matrix.rank_le_card_width G

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleHall.card_le_neighbors
statement:
theorem card_le_neighbors {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {k : Type*} [Field k] {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (R : ι → Rectangle n) (S : κ → Rectangle n) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (RectangleFamily.module (k := k) R)
      (RectangleFamily.module S)) (A : Finset ι)
    (hA : ∀ i ∈ A, Significant
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
        RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (R i)) :
    A.card ≤ (neighbors (k := k) R S A
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := neighbors (k := k) R S A (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε)
  let key (i : A) : (ℝ ×ₗ ℕ) ×ₗ Fin (Fintype.card A) :=
    toLex (toLex (RectangleStabilityGeometry.alphaValue (R i),
      RectangleStabilityGeometry.alphaPlus (R i)), (Fintype.equivFin A) i)
  let : LinearOrder A := LinearOrder.lift' key (by
    intro i j hij
    apply (Fintype.equivFin A).injective
    exact congrArg (fun z => (ofLex z).2) hij)
  have hα {i i' : A} (h : i ≤ i') :
      RectangleStabilityGeometry.alphaLE (R i) (R i') := by
    change key i ≤ key i' at h
    have hh := Prod.Lex.monotone_fst _ _ h
    exact Prod.Lex.toLex_le_toLex.mp hh
  let F : Matrix B A k := fun j i => shiftedCoefficient (R i) (S j) ε
    (RectangleFamily.component R S ε I.φ i j)
  let G : Matrix A B k := fun i j => shiftedCoefficient (S j) (R i) ε
    (RectangleFamily.component S R ε I.ψ j i)
  have entry (i i' : A) (h : RectangleStabilityGeometry.alphaLE (R i) (R i')) :
      (G * F) i' i = shiftedCoefficient (R i) (R i') (ε + ε)
        ((∑ j : κ, RectangleFamily.component R S ε I.φ i j ≫
          (shift ε).map (RectangleFamily.component S R ε I.ψ j i')) ≫
            (compIso ε ε ((R i').module (k := k))).hom) := by
    calc
      (G * F) i' i = ∑ j ∈ B,
          shiftedCoefficient (R i) (S j) ε (RectangleFamily.component R S ε I.φ i j) *
          shiftedCoefficient (S j) (R i') ε (RectangleFamily.component S R ε I.ψ j i') := by
        change (∑ j : B,
          shiftedCoefficient (S j) (R i') ε (RectangleFamily.component S R ε I.ψ j i') *
          shiftedCoefficient (R i) (S j) ε (RectangleFamily.component R S ε I.φ i j)) = _
        calc
          _ = ∑ j ∈ B,
              shiftedCoefficient (S j) (R i') ε
                (RectangleFamily.component S R ε I.ψ j i') *
              shiftedCoefficient (R i) (S j) ε
                (RectangleFamily.component R S ε I.φ i j) :=
            Finset.sum_coe_sort B _
          _ = _ := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j hj
            exact mul_comm _ _
      _ = ∑ j ∈ B, shiftedCoefficient (R i) (R i') (ε + ε)
          (RectangleFamily.component R S ε I.φ i j ≫
            (shift ε).map (RectangleFamily.component S R ε I.ψ j i') ≫
              (compIso ε ε ((R i').module (k := k))).hom) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        exact (shiftedCoefficient_composite hn (R i) (S j) (R i') ε h
          (hA i i.property) (hA i' i'.property) _ _).symm
      _ = shiftedCoefficient (R i) (R i') (ε + ε)
          ((∑ j ∈ B, RectangleFamily.component R S ε I.φ i j ≫
            (shift ε).map (RectangleFamily.component S R ε I.ψ j i')) ≫
              (compIso ε ε ((R i').module (k := k))).hom) := by
        rw [Preadditive.sum_comp, shiftedCoefficient_sum]
        simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = _ := by
        rw [component_sum_neighbors hn R S ε I.φ I.ψ A i.property i'.property h]
  have hbelow : ∀ ⦃i i' : A⦄, i' < i → (G * F) i i' = 0 := by
    intro i i' h
    rw [entry i' i (hα (le_of_lt h)),
      RectangleFamily.component_interleaving_sum_ne R S ε I
        (show (i' : ι) ≠ (i : ι) from fun he => (ne_of_lt h) (Subtype.ext he)),
      shiftedCoefficient_zero]
  have hε : ε ≤ RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε := by
    have hnat : 1 ≤ 2 * n - 1 := by omega
    have hc : (1 : ℝ≥0) ≤ ((2 * n - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ≥0) := by exact_mod_cast hnat
    simpa only [one_mul, RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (show 0 ≤ ε from zero_le)
  have hdiag (i : A) : (G * F) i i = 1 := by
    rw [entry i i (hα le_rfl), RectangleFamily.component_interleaving_sum_self R S ε I]
    exact shiftedCoefficient_transition (R i) (ε + ε)
      (Significant.of_le (add_le_add hε hε) (hA i i.property))
  have hc := card_le_of_triangular_product G F hbelow hdiag
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe] using hc

name: TDA.Persistence.totalPersistence_nonneg
statement:
theorem totalPersistence_nonneg (D : Diagram ℝ) (p : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ D.totalPersistence p
proof:
:= by
  unfold Diagram.totalPersistence
  apply Multiset.sum_nonneg
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hy
  exact pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) _

name: TDA.Persistence.totalPersistence_zero
statement:
theorem totalPersistence_zero (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    D.totalPersistence 0 = Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences
proof:
:= by
  simp [Diagram.totalPersistence, Multiset.map_const', Multiset.card_coe]

name: TDA.Persistence.totalPersistence_empty
statement:
theorem totalPersistence_empty (D : Diagram ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (h : finitePart D.points = 0) : D.totalPersistence p = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [Diagram.totalPersistence, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.totalPersistence_scale
statement:
theorem totalPersistence_scale (D : Diagram ℝ) (p : ℕ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    (D.scale c hc).totalPersistence p = c ^ p * D.totalPersistence p
proof:
:= by
  unfold Diagram.totalPersistence
  rw [Diagram.scale, finitePart_map_points, Multiset.map_map]
  have hmap :
      (finitePart D.points).map
          ((fun x => |x.2 - x.1| ^ p) ∘
            fun x => ((OrderIso.mulLeft₀ c hc).toOrderEmbedding x.1,
              (OrderIso.mulLeft₀ c hc).toOrderEmbedding x.2)) =
        (finitePart D.points).map (fun x => c ^ p * |x.2 - x.1| ^ p) := by
    apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    show |c * x.2 - c * x.1| ^ p = c ^ p * |x.2 - x.1| ^ p
    have hx' : c * x.2 - c * x.1 = c * (x.2 - x.1) := by ring
    rw [hx', abs_mul, abs_of_pos hc, mul_pow]
  rw [hmap, Multiset.sum_map_mul_left]

name: TDA.Persistence.totalPersistence_translateDiagram
statement:
theorem totalPersistence_translateDiagram (D : Diagram ℝ) (a : ℝ) (p : ℕ) :
    (translateDiagram D a).totalPersistence p = D.totalPersistence p
proof:
:= by
  unfold Diagram.totalPersistence
  rw [translateDiagram_eq_map, finitePart_map_points, Multiset.map_map]
  apply congrArg (fun s : Multiset ℝ => s.sum)
  apply Multiset.map_congr rfl
  intro x hx
  show |(x.2 + a) - (x.1 + a)| ^ p = |x.2 - x.1| ^ p
  have hx' : (x.2 + a) - (x.1 + a) = x.2 - x.1 := by ring
  rw [hx']

name: TDA.Persistence.totalPersistence_le_card_mul_pow
statement:
theorem totalPersistence_le_card_mul_pow (D : Diagram ℝ) (p : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ x ∈ finitePart D.points, |x.2 - x.1| ≤ M) (_hM0 : 0 ≤ M) :
    D.totalPersistence p ≤ Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences * M ^ p
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : ∀ s : Multiset (ℝ × ℝ),
        (∀ x ∈ s, |x.2 - x.1| ≤ M) →
        (s.map (fun x => |x.2 - x.1| ^ p)).sum ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * M ^ p := by
    intro s
    refine Multiset.induction_on s ?_ ?_
    · intro hs
      simp
    · intro x s ih hs
      have hx : |x.2 - x.1| ^ p ≤ M ^ p :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hs x (by simp)) p
      have hs' : ∀ y ∈ s, |y.2 - y.1| ≤ M := by
        intro y hy
        exact hs y (by simp [hy])
      have htail := ih hs'
      rw [Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, Multiset.card_cons, Nat.cast_add,
        Nat.cast_one, add_one_mul]
      linarith
  unfold Diagram.totalPersistence
  have hcard : Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences = (finitePart D.points).card :=
    Multiset.card_coe _
  rw [hcard]
  exact hsum (finitePart D.points) hM

name: TDA.Persistence.totalPersistence_le_of_coordinates_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem totalPersistence_le_of_coordinates_mem_Icc (D : Diagram ℝ) (p : ℕ) (M : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ finitePart D.points,
      x.1 ∈ Set.Icc 0 M ∧ x.2 ∈ Set.Icc 0 M) :
    D.totalPersistence p ≤ Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences * M ^ p
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hs : finitePart D.points = 0
  · have hcard : Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences = 0 := by
      rw [Multiset.card_coe, hs]
      simp
    simp [Diagram.totalPersistence, hs, hcard]
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hs
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (h x hx).1.1 (h x hx).1.2
    apply totalPersistence_le_card_mul_pow D p M _ hM0
    intro y hy
    rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
    constructor <;> linarith [(h y hy).1.1, (h y hy).1.2, (h y hy).2.1, (h y hy).2.2]

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_dist01
statement: theorem triangle_dist01 : dist (Triangle.pts 0) (Triangle.pts 1) = 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    dist (Triangle.pts 0) (Triangle.pts 1) =
        √(dist (Triangle.pts 0) (Triangle.pts 1) ^ 2) :=
      (Real.sqrt_sq dist_nonneg).symm
    _ = 2 := by
      rw [Triangle.dist_sq]
      norm_num [Triangle.pts_zero, Triangle.pts_one]

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_rips_value_tri
statement:
theorem triangle_rips_value_tri :
    ripsT.value ⟨Triangle.tri, by simp [Triangle.tri]⟩ = √5
proof:
:= by
  change Rips.diameter Triangle.metric Triangle.tri = √5
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (Rips.diameter_le_iff Triangle.metric Triangle.tri √5).2
      ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro v hv w hw
    rw [Triangle.metric_dist]
    simp only [Triangle.tri, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv hw
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hw with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by positivity) (by
        norm_num [Triangle.pts_zero, Triangle.pts_one, Triangle.pts_two] <;>
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5 by norm_num)])
  · have h := Rips.diameter_mono Triangle.metric (s := Triangle.edge02)
      (t := Triangle.tri) (by decide)
    calc
      √5 = Rips.diameter Triangle.metric ({0, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)) := by
        rw [Rips.diameter_pair, Triangle.metric_dist, triangle_dist02]
      _ ≤ Rips.diameter Triangle.metric Triangle.tri := h

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.cech_value_singleton
statement:
theorem cech_value_singleton {V X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (p : V → X) (v : V) :
    (Cech.filter p).value ⟨{v}, Finset.singleton_nonempty v⟩ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (Cech.filter_value_le_radiusAt p ⟨{v}, Finset.singleton_nonempty v⟩ (p v)).trans ?_
    exact (Cech.radiusAt_le_iff p (p v) {v} 0).2 ⟨le_rfl, by simp⟩
  · exact Cech.filter_value_nonneg p ⟨{v}, Finset.singleton_nonempty v⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_cech_value_edge01
statement:
theorem triangle_cech_value_edge01 :
    cechT.value ⟨Triangle.edge01, by simp [Triangle.edge01]⟩ = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (Cech.filter_value_le_radiusAt Triangle.pts _ !₂[1, 0]).trans ?_
    refine (Cech.radiusAt_le_iff Triangle.pts !₂[1, 0] Triangle.edge01 1).2
      ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    simp only [Triangle.edge01, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl
    · exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num [Triangle.pts_zero])
    · exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num [Triangle.pts_one])
  · have h := Cech.rips_le_two_mul_filter_value Triangle.metric Triangle.pts
      Triangle.metric_dist ⟨Triangle.edge01, by simp [Triangle.edge01]⟩
    rw [triangle_rips_value_edge01] at h
    linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_cech_value_edge02
statement:
theorem triangle_cech_value_edge02 :
    cechT.value ⟨Triangle.edge02, by simp [Triangle.edge02]⟩ = √5 / 2
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (Cech.filter_value_le_radiusAt Triangle.pts _ !₂[1 / 2, 1]).trans ?_
    refine (Cech.radiusAt_le_iff Triangle.pts !₂[1 / 2, 1] Triangle.edge02 (√5 / 2)).2
      ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    simp only [Triangle.edge02, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl
    · exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by positivity) (by
        norm_num [Triangle.pts_zero] <;>
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5 by norm_num)])
    · exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by positivity) (by
        norm_num [Triangle.pts_two] <;>
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5 by norm_num)])
  · have h := Cech.rips_le_two_mul_filter_value Triangle.metric Triangle.pts
      Triangle.metric_dist ⟨Triangle.edge02, by simp [Triangle.edge02]⟩
    rw [triangle_rips_value_edge02] at h
    linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_cech_value_edge12
statement:
theorem triangle_cech_value_edge12 :
    cechT.value ⟨Triangle.edge12, by simp [Triangle.edge12]⟩ = √5 / 2
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (Cech.filter_value_le_radiusAt Triangle.pts _ !₂[3 / 2, 1]).trans ?_
    refine (Cech.radiusAt_le_iff Triangle.pts !₂[3 / 2, 1] Triangle.edge12 (√5 / 2)).2
      ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro v hv

    rcases hv with rfl | rfl
    · exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by positivity) (by
        norm_num [Triangle.pts_one] <;>
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5 by norm_num)])
    · exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by positivity) (by
        norm_num [Triangle.pts_two] <;>
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5 by norm_num)])

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_cech_value_tri
statement:
theorem triangle_cech_value_tri :
    cechT.value ⟨Triangle.tri, by simp [Triangle.tri]⟩ = 5 / 4
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (Cech.filter_value_le_radiusAt Triangle.pts _ !₂[1, 3 / 4]).trans ?_
    refine (Cech.radiusAt_le_iff Triangle.pts !₂[1, 3 / 4] Triangle.tri (5 / 4)).2
      ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    simp only [Triangle.tri, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num [Triangle.pts_zero])
    · exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num [Triangle.pts_one])
    · exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num [Triangle.pts_two])
  · refine le_ciInf ?_
    intro x
    by_contra h
    have hlt : Cech.radiusAt Triangle.pts x Triangle.tri < 5 / 4 := lt_of_not_ge h
    have h0d : dist x (Triangle.pts 0) < 5 / 4 :=
      (Cech.dist_le_radiusAt Triangle.pts x (s := Triangle.tri) (v := 0)
        (by simp [Triangle.tri])).trans_lt hlt
    have h1d : dist x (Triangle.pts 1) < 5 / 4 :=
      (Cech.dist_le_radiusAt Triangle.pts x (s := Triangle.tri) (v := 1)
        (by simp [Triangle.tri])).trans_lt hlt
    have h2d : dist x (Triangle.pts 2) < 5 / 4 :=
      (Cech.dist_le_radiusAt Triangle.pts x (s := Triangle.tri) (v := 2)
        (by simp [Triangle.tri])).trans_lt hlt
    have h0sq : dist x (Triangle.pts 0) ^ 2 < (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have hn : 0 ≤ dist x (Triangle.pts 0) := dist_nonneg
      exact (sq_lt_sq₀ hn (by norm_num)).2 h0d
    have h1sq : dist x (Triangle.pts 1) ^ 2 < (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have hn : 0 ≤ dist x (Triangle.pts 1) := dist_nonneg
      exact (sq_lt_sq₀ hn (by norm_num)).2 h1d
    have h2sq : dist x (Triangle.pts 2) ^ 2 < (5 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by
      have hn : 0 ≤ dist x (Triangle.pts 2) := dist_nonneg
      exact (sq_lt_sq₀ hn (by norm_num)).2 h2d
    rw [Triangle.dist_sq] at h0sq h1sq h2sq
    norm_num [Triangle.pts_zero, Triangle.pts_one, Triangle.pts_two] at h0sq h1sq h2sq
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0 - 1), sq_nonneg (x 1 - 3 / 4)]

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.sqrt_five_bounds
statement: theorem sqrt_five_bounds : 1 < √5 / 2 ∧ √5 / 2 < 5 / 4 ∧ 2 < √5
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have h := (Real.lt_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)).2
      (show (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 < 5 by norm_num)
    nlinarith
  constructor
  · have h := (Real.sqrt_lt' (show (0 : ℝ) < 5 / 2 by norm_num)).2
      (show (5 : ℝ) < (5 / 2) ^ 2 by norm_num)
    nlinarith
  · exact (Real.lt_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)).2
      (show (2 : ℝ) ^ 2 < 5 by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.filledTriangle_toPre_eq
statement:
theorem filledTriangle_toPre_eq :
    FilledTriangle.C.toPre = Rips.fullComplex (Fin 3)
proof:
:= by
  apply PreAbstractSimplicialComplex.ext
  ext s
  change s ∈ FilledTriangle.C.faces ↔ s.Nonempty
  revert s
  decide +kernel

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.pullTriangle_value
statement:
@[simp] theorem pullTriangle_value
    (g : FilterFunction (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 3)) ℝ)
    (s : TotalFace FilledTriangle.C.toPre) :
    (pullTriangle g).value s = g.value ⟨s.val, by
      rw [← filledTriangle_toPre_eq]
      exact s.property⟩
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.dgm_eq_of_complex_eq
statement:
private theorem dgm_eq_of_complex_eq
    {V : Type u} [LinearOrder V] {α : Type w} [LinearOrder α]
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {K L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    [iK : Fintype (TotalFace K)] [iL : Fintype (TotalFace L)]
    (h : K = L) (f : FilterFunction L α) (g : FilterFunction K α)
    (hfg : ∀ s, g.value s = f.value ⟨s.val, h ▸ s.property⟩) (n : ℕ) :
    @dgm V _ k _ α _ K iK g n = @dgm V _ k _ α _ L iL f n
proof:
:= by
  subst L
  have hgf : g = f := by
    apply FilterFunction.ext
    intro s
    simpa using hfg s
  subst f
  have hi : iK = iL := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  cases hi
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.dgm_pullTriangle
statement:
theorem dgm_pullTriangle (k : Type) [Field k]
    (g : FilterFunction (Rips.fullComplex (Fin 3)) ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    dgm k (pullTriangle g) n = dgm k g n
proof:
:= by
  exact dgm_eq_of_complex_eq k filledTriangle_toPre_eq g (pullTriangle g)
    (fun s => by simp [pullTriangle]) n

proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_bottleneck_zero
statement:
theorem triangle_bottleneck_zero :
    bottleneck (dgm (ZMod 2) ripsT 0) (dgm (ZMod 2) cechT 0) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (√5 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let x : Fin 2 → ℝ × ℝ := ![(0, 2), (0, √5)]
  let y : Fin 2 → ℝ × ℝ := ![(0, 1), (0, √5 / 2)]
  let b : Fin 1 → ℝ := fun _ => 0
  let c : Fin 1 → ℝ := fun _ => 0
  have hx : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)).val.map x =
      finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) ripsT 0).points := by
    simp [finitePart, x, triangle_rips_dgm_zero] <;> rfl
  have hy : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)).val.map y =
      finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) cechT 0).points := by
    simp [finitePart, y, triangle_cech_dgm_zero] <;> rfl
  have hb : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map b =
      essentialPart (dgm (ZMod 2) ripsT 0).points := by
    simp [essentialPart, b, triangle_rips_dgm_zero] <;> rfl
  have hc : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map c =
      essentialPart (dgm (ZMod 2) cechT 0).points := by
    simp [essentialPart, c, triangle_cech_dgm_zero] <;> rfl
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation _ _ x y b c hx hy hb hc]
  apply le_antisymm
  · let M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (Fin 1) (Fin 1) :=
      ⟨fun i => some i, by
        intro i i' j hi hi'
        exact Option.some.inj (hi.trans hi'.symm), Equiv.refl _⟩
    have hs : |√5 - √5 / 2| = √5 / 2 := by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg]
      · ring
      · nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (5 : ℝ)]
    have hcost : M.cost x y b c = ENNReal.ofReal (√5 / 2) := by
      rcases sqrt_five_bounds with ⟨h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
      have hsmall : (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (√5 / 2) := by
        simpa using ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (le_of_lt h₁)
      have hbase : |(2 : ℝ) - 1| = 1 := by
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 - 1)]
        norm_num
      simp [OccurrenceMatching.cost, M, x, y, b, c, finitePairCost, diagonalCost,
        essentialPairCost, Fin.univ_succ, Finset.sup_insert, Finset.sup_singleton,
        hbase, hs, max_eq_right (le_of_lt h₁), max_eq_right hsmall]
    exact (presentationBottleneck_le_cost x y b c M).trans_eq hcost
  · unfold presentationBottleneck
    apply le_iInf
    intro M
    have hsource := M.source_le_cost x y b c 1
    cases h : M.finite 1 with
    | none =>
        calc
          ENNReal.ofReal (√5 / 2) = diagonalCost (x 1) := by
            simp [x, diagonalCost, abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg 5)]
          _ ≤ M.cost x y b c := by simpa [h] using hsource
    | some j =>
        fin_cases j
        · have hsminus : 0 ≤ √5 - 1 := by
            nlinarith [sqrt_five_bounds.2.2]
          calc
            ENNReal.ofReal (√5 / 2) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (√5 - 1) :=
              ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (by nlinarith [sqrt_five_bounds.2.2])
            _ = finitePairCost (x 1) (y 0) := by
              simp [x, y, finitePairCost, hsminus, abs_of_nonneg hsminus]
            _ ≤ M.cost x y b c := by simpa [h] using hsource
        · have hs : |√5 - √5 / 2| = √5 / 2 := by
            rw [abs_of_nonneg]
            · ring
            · nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg (5 : ℝ)]
          calc
            ENNReal.ofReal (√5 / 2) = finitePairCost (x 1) (y 1) := by
              simp [x, y, finitePairCost, hs]
            _ ≤ M.cost x y b c := by simpa [h] using hsource

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_bottleneck_one
statement:
theorem triangle_bottleneck_one :
    bottleneck (dgm (ZMod 2) ripsT 1) (dgm (ZMod 2) cechT 1) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((5 / 4 - √5 / 2) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [bottleneck_comm]
  let x : Fin 1 → ℝ × ℝ := fun _ => (√5 / 2, 5 / 4)
  let y : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ := Fin.elim0
  let b : Fin 0 → ℝ := Fin.elim0
  let c : Fin 0 → ℝ := Fin.elim0
  have hx : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map x =
      finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) cechT 1).points := by
    simp [finitePart, x, triangle_cech_dgm_one] <;> rfl
  have hy : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map y =
      finitePart (dgm (ZMod 2) ripsT 1).points := by
    simp [finitePart, y, triangle_rips_dgm_one] <;> rfl
  have hb : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map b =
      essentialPart (dgm (ZMod 2) cechT 1).points := by
    simp [essentialPart, b, triangle_cech_dgm_one] <;> rfl
  have hc : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map c =
      essentialPart (dgm (ZMod 2) ripsT 1).points := by
    simp [essentialPart, c, triangle_rips_dgm_one] <;> rfl
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation _ _ x y b c hx hy hb hc]
  change presentationBottleneck (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((√5 / 2 : ℝ), (5 / 4 : ℝ)))
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = _
  rw [presentationBottleneck_singleton_empty]
  have hpos : 0 < (5 / 4 : ℝ) - √5 / 2 := by
    nlinarith [sqrt_five_bounds.2.1]
  unfold diagonalCost
  rw [abs_of_pos hpos]

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_logBottleneck_one
statement:
theorem triangle_logBottleneck_one :
    bottleneck (logDgm (ZMod 2) ripsT 1) (logDgm (ZMod 2) cechT 1) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (5 / 4) / 4)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [bottleneck_comm]
  let x : Fin 1 → ℝ × ℝ :=
    fun _ => (Real.log (5 / 4) / 2, Real.log (5 / 4))
  let y : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ := Fin.elim0
  let b : Fin 0 → ℝ := Fin.elim0
  let c : Fin 0 → ℝ := Fin.elim0
  have hx : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 1)).val.map x =
      finitePart (logDgm (ZMod 2) cechT 1).points := by
    simp [finitePart, x, triangle_cech_logDgm_one] <;> rfl
  have hy : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map y =
      finitePart (logDgm (ZMod 2) ripsT 1).points := by
    simp [finitePart, y, triangle_rips_logDgm_one]
  have hb : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map b =
      essentialPart (logDgm (ZMod 2) cechT 1).points := by
    simp [essentialPart, b, triangle_cech_logDgm_one] <;> rfl
  have hc : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 0)).val.map c =
      essentialPart (logDgm (ZMod 2) ripsT 1).points := by
    simp [essentialPart, c, triangle_rips_logDgm_one]
  rw [bottleneck_eq_presentation _ _ x y b c hx hy hb hc]
  change presentationBottleneck
      (fun _ : Fin 1 => ((Real.log (5 / 4) / 2 : ℝ), (Real.log (5 / 4) : ℝ)))
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) = _
  rw [presentationBottleneck_singleton_empty]
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log (5 / 4) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hpos : 0 < Real.log (5 / 4) - Real.log (5 / 4) / 2 := by
    linarith
  unfold diagonalCost
  rw [abs_of_pos hpos]
  congr 1
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_logInterleaving_one

theorem triangle_logInterleaving_one :

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_logBottleneck_one_lt_log_two
statement:
theorem triangle_logBottleneck_one_lt_log_two :
    bottleneck (logDgm (ZMod 2) ripsT 1) (logDgm (ZMod 2) cechT 1) <
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log 2)
proof:

  apply (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_ofReal_iff (Real.log_pos (by norm_num))).2
  have hlog : Real.log (5 / 4) < Real.log 2 :=
    Real.log_lt_log (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have hpos : 0 < Real.log (5 / 4) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_cech_finrank_one
statement:
theorem triangle_cech_finrank_one :
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2)
        (simplicialHomology (cechT.sublevel (6 / 5)) (ZMod 2) 1) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_sublevelHomology_eq_countP (ZMod 2) cechT 1 (6 / 5),
    triangle_cech_dgm_one]
  have hs : √5 ≤ (12 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 5 by norm_num), Real.sqrt_nonneg (5 : ℝ)]
  have hbirth : √5 / 2 ≤ (6 / 5 : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith
  have hdeath : (6 / 5 : ℝ) < 5 / 4 := by norm_num
  rw [← Multiset.cons_zero,
    Multiset.countP_cons_of_pos (s := 0)
      ⟨hbirth, WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 hdeath⟩,
    Multiset.countP_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_radius_ne_log_one
statement:
theorem triangle_radius_ne_log_one :
    (5 / 4 - √5 / 2) / 2 ≠ Real.log (5 / 4) / 4
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hlog : Real.log (5 / 4) / 4 ≤ (1 / 16 : ℝ) := by
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (show (0 : ℝ) < 5 / 4 by norm_num)
    nlinarith
  have hsqrt : √5 < (9 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    exact (Real.sqrt_lt' (show (0 : ℝ) < 9 / 4 by norm_num)).2
      (show (5 : ℝ) < (9 / 4) ^ 2 by norm_num)
  have hradius : (1 / 16 : ℝ) < (5 / 4 - √5 / 2) / 2 := by
    nlinarith
  nlinarith

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.triangle_logBottleneck_one_ne_zero
statement:
theorem triangle_logBottleneck_one_ne_zero :
    bottleneck (logDgm (ZMod 2) ripsT 1) (logDgm (ZMod 2) cechT 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [triangle_logBottleneck_one]
  intro h
  have hlog : 0 < Real.log (5 / 4) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hpos : 0 < Real.log (5 / 4) / 4 := by linarith
  have hz : Real.log (5 / 4) / 4 ≤ 0 := ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero.mp h
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.RightTriangle.pts_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pts_zero : pts 0 = !₂[0, 0]
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.RightTriangle.pts_one

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.RightTriangle.pts_injective
statement: theorem pts_injective : Function.Injective pts
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  have hx : pts i 0 = pts j 0 :=
    congrArg (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => z 0) h
  have hy : pts i 1 = pts j 1 :=
    congrArg (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => z 1) h
  have hx' : ∀ k : Fin 3, pts k 0 = ![0, 2, 2] k := by
    intro k
    fin_cases k <;> rfl
  have hy' : ∀ k : Fin 3, pts k 1 = ![0, 0, 2] k := by
    intro k
    fin_cases k <;> rfl
  rw [hx', hx'] at hx
  rw [hy', hy'] at hy
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    first | rfl | (norm_num at hx; done) | (norm_num at hy; done)

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.RightTriangle.metric_dist
statement: theorem metric_dist (v w : Fin 3) : metric.dist v w = dist (pts v) (pts w)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.RightTriangle.dist01
statement: private theorem dist01 : dist (pts 0) (pts 1) = 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    dist (pts 0) (pts 1) = √(dist (pts 0) (pts 1) ^ 2) :=
      (Real.sqrt_sq dist_nonneg).symm
    _ = 2 := by
      rw [Triangle.dist_sq]
      norm_num [pts_zero, pts_one]

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.RightTriangle.dist12
statement: private theorem dist12 : dist (pts 1) (pts 2) = 2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    dist (pts 1) (pts 2) = √(dist (pts 1) (pts 2) ^ 2) :=
      (Real.sqrt_sq dist_nonneg).symm
    _ = 2 := by
      rw [Triangle.dist_sq]
      norm_num [pts_one, pts_two]

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.RightTriangle.dist02
statement: private theorem dist02 : dist (pts 0) (pts 2) = 2 * √2
proof:
:= by
  calc
    dist (pts 0) (pts 2) = √(dist (pts 0) (pts 2) ^ 2) :=
      (Real.sqrt_sq dist_nonneg).symm
    _ = 2 * √2 := by
      apply (Real.sqrt_eq_iff_eq_sq (by positivity) (by positivity)).2
      rw [Triangle.dist_sq]
      norm_num [pts_zero, pts_two] <;>
        nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)]

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.RightTriangle.rightTriangle_rips_value_tri
statement:
theorem rightTriangle_rips_value_tri :
    (Rips.filter metric).value ⟨tri, by simp [tri]⟩ = 2 * √2
proof:
:= by
  change Rips.diameter metric tri = 2 * √2
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (Rips.diameter_le_iff metric tri (2 * √2)).2
      ⟨by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro v hv w hw
    rw [metric_dist]
    simp only [tri, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv hw
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hw with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by positivity) (by
        norm_num [pts_zero, pts_one, pts_two] <;>
          nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num)])
  · have h := Rips.diameter_mono metric (s := edge02) (t := tri) (by decide)
    calc
      2 * √2 = Rips.diameter metric ({0, 2} : Finset (Fin 3)) := by
        rw [Rips.diameter_pair, metric_dist, dist02]
      _ ≤ Rips.diameter metric tri := h

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.RightTriangle.rightTriangle_cech_value_edge01

  · refine (Cech.filter_value_le_radiusAt pts _ !₂[1, 0]).trans ?_
    refine (Cech.radiusAt_le_iff pts !₂[1, 0] edge01 1).2
      ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
    intro v hv
    simp only [edge01, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
    rcases hv with rfl | rfl
    · exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num [pts_zero])
    · exact Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le (by norm_num)
        (by norm_num [pts_one])
  · have h := Cech.rips_le_two_mul_filter_value metric pts metric_dist
      ⟨edge01, by simp [edge01]⟩
    rw [rightTriangle_rips_value_edge01] at h
    linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.RightTriangle.cech_enum_values
statement:
private theorem cech_enum_values (i : Fin (faceCount FilledTriangle.C.toPre)) :
    (pullTriangle (Cech.filter pts)).value (FilledTriangle.e.enum i) = cechVals i.val
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · show (Cech.filter pts).value ⟨{0}, by simp⟩ = cechVals 0
    rw [cech_value_singleton]
    norm_num [cechVals]
  · show (Cech.filter pts).value ⟨{1}, by simp⟩ = cechVals 1
    rw [cech_value_singleton]
    norm_num [cechVals]
  · show (Cech.filter pts).value ⟨{2}, by simp⟩ = cechVals 2
    rw [cech_value_singleton]
    norm_num [cechVals]
  · show (Cech.filter pts).value ⟨edge01, by simp [edge01]⟩ = cechVals 3
    rw [rightTriangle_cech_value_edge01]
    norm_num [cechVals]
  · show (Cech.filter pts).value ⟨edge12, by simp [edge12]⟩ = cechVals 4
    rw [rightTriangle_cech_value_edge12]
    norm_num [cechVals]
  · show (Cech.filter pts).value ⟨edge02, by simp [edge02]⟩ = cechVals 5
    rw [rightTriangle_cech_value_edge02]
    norm_num [cechVals]
  · show (Cech.filter pts).value ⟨tri, by simp [tri]⟩ = cechVals 6
    rw [rightTriangle_cech_value_tri]
    norm_num [cechVals]

proof:

  fin_cases i
  · show (Rips.filter metric).value ⟨{0}, by simp⟩ = ripsVals 0
    rw [Rips.filter_value]
    calc
      Rips.diameter metric ({0} : Finset (Fin 3)) = 0 :=
        Rips.diameter_singleton _ _
      _ = ripsVals 0 := by norm_num [ripsVals]
  · show (Rips.filter metric).value ⟨{1}, by simp⟩ = ripsVals 1
    rw [Rips.filter_value]
    calc
      Rips.diameter metric ({1} : Finset (Fin 3)) = 0 :=
        Rips.diameter_singleton _ _
      _ = ripsVals 1 := by norm_num [ripsVals]
  · show (Rips.filter metric).value ⟨{2}, by simp⟩ = ripsVals 2
    rw [Rips.filter_value]
    calc
      Rips.diameter metric ({2} : Finset (Fin 3)) = 0 :=
        Rips.diameter_singleton _ _
      _ = ripsVals 2 := by norm_num [ripsVals]
  · show (Rips.filter metric).value ⟨edge01, by simp [edge01]⟩ = ripsVals 3
    rw [rightTriangle_rips_value_edge01]
    norm_num [ripsVals]
  · show (Rips.filter metric).value ⟨edge12, by simp [edge12]⟩ = ripsVals 4
    rw [rightTriangle_rips_value_edge12]
    norm_num [ripsVals]
  · show (Rips.filter metric).value ⟨edge02, by simp [edge02]⟩ = ripsVals 5
    rw [rightTriangle_rips_value_edge02]
    norm_num [ripsVals]
  · show (Rips.filter metric).value ⟨tri, by simp [tri]⟩ = ripsVals 6
    rw [rightTriangle_rips_value_tri]
    norm_num [ripsVals]

name: TDA.Persistence.TriangleCechRipsExamples.RightTriangle.cech_monotone_enum

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.sum_projection_inclusion
statement:
theorem sum_projection_inclusion {m : ℕ} (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n)) :
    ∑ i, projection (k := k) F i ≫ inclusion F i = 𝟙 (familyModule (k := k) F)
proof:
:=
  biproduct.total (f := fun i : Fin m => tagModule (k := k) (F i))

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.component_composite
statement:
theorem component_composite {m ℓ q : ℕ}
    (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n)) (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (H : Fin q → RealHookTag (n := n)) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (f : familyModule (k := k) F ⟶ (shift ε).obj (familyModule (k := k) G))
    (g : familyModule (k := k) G ⟶ (shift ε).obj (familyModule (k := k) H))
    (i : Fin m) (l : Fin q) :
    ∑ j : Fin ℓ, component (k := k) F G ε f i j ≫
      (shift ε).map (component (k := k) G H ε g j l) =
      inclusion (k := k) F i ≫ f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫
        (shift ε).map ((shift ε).map (projection (k := k) H l))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [component, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]
  rw [← Preadditive.comp_sum]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [← Preadditive.sum_comp]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp]
  rw [← Preadditive.comp_sum]
  rw [← Functor.map_sum]
  have hs : (∑ a : Fin ℓ, projection (k := k) G a ≫ inclusion G a ≫ g) = g := by
    simp only [← Category.assoc]
    rw [← Preadditive.sum_comp, sum_projection_inclusion, Category.id_comp]
  rw [hs]
  simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.component_interleaving_sum
statement:
theorem component_interleaving_sum {m ℓ : ℕ}
    (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n)) (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (familyModule (k := k) F)
      (familyModule (k := k) G)) (i i' : Fin m) :
    (∑ j : Fin ℓ, component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j ≫
      (shift ε).map (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i')) ≫
        (compIso ε ε (tagModule (k := k) (F i'))).hom =
      inclusion (k := k) F i ≫ transition (ε + ε) (familyModule (k := k) F) ≫
        (shift (ε + ε)).map (projection (k := k) F i')
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [component_composite]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [compIso_naturality ε ε (projection (k := k) F i')]
  simp only [← Category.assoc, I.φ_ψ]

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.component_interleaving_sum_ne
statement:
theorem component_interleaving_sum_ne {m ℓ : ℕ}
    (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n)) (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (familyModule (k := k) F)
      (familyModule (k := k) G)) {i i' : Fin m} (h : i ≠ i') :
    (∑ j : Fin ℓ, component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j ≫
      (shift ε).map (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i')) ≫
        (compIso ε ε (tagModule (k := k) (F i'))).hom = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [component_interleaving_sum F G ε I i i']
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [transition_naturality (ε + ε) (inclusion (k := k) F i)]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, inclusion_projection_ne F h,
    Functor.map_zero, comp_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.component_interleaving_sum_self
statement:
theorem component_interleaving_sum_self {m ℓ : ℕ}
    (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n)) (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (familyModule (k := k) F)
      (familyModule (k := k) G)) (i : Fin m) :
    (∑ j : Fin ℓ, component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j ≫
      (shift ε).map (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i)) ≫
        (compIso ε ε (tagModule (k := k) (F i))).hom =
      transition (ε + ε) (tagModule (k := k) (F i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [component_interleaving_sum F G ε I i i]
  simp only [← Category.assoc]
  rw [transition_naturality (ε + ε) (inclusion (k := k) F i)]
  simp only [Category.assoc, ← Functor.map_comp, inclusion_projection_self]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.exists_matching_of_zero_interleaving
statement:
theorem exists_matching_of_zero_interleaving {m ℓ : ℕ}
    (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving 0 (familyModule (k := k) F)
      (familyModule (k := k) G)) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin m) (Fin ℓ) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      IsMatching (k := k) 0 F G M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P : FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := n)
      (familyModule (k := k) F) := ⟨m, F, Iso.refl _⟩
  let Q : FiniteHookSumPresentation (k := k) (n := n)
      (familyModule (k := k) G) := ⟨ℓ, G, Iso.refl _⟩
  have htags := P.tagMultiset_eq_of_iso Q I.toIso
  have hlen : m = ℓ := by
    have hc := congrArg Multiset.card htags
    simpa only [hookTagMultiset_card] using hc
  have hcard (c : RealHookTag (n := n)) :
      Fintype.card {i : Fin m // F i = c} =
        Fintype.card {j : Fin ℓ // G j = c} := by
    have hc := congrArg (fun s : Multiset (RealHookTag (n := n)) => s.count c) htags
    simpa only [hookTagMultiset_count] using hc
  let E : ∀ c : RealHookTag (n := n),
      {i : Fin m // F i = c} ≃ {j : Fin ℓ // G j = c} :=
    fun c => Fintype.equivOfCardEq (hcard c)
  let eF : Fin m ≃ Σ c : RealHookTag (n := n), {i : Fin m // F i = c} :=
    { toFun := fun i => ⟨F i, ⟨i, rfl⟩⟩
      invFun := fun x => x.2.1
      left_inv := by intro i; rfl
      right_inv := by
        rintro ⟨c, ⟨i, hi⟩⟩
        cases hi
        rfl }
  let eG : Fin ℓ ≃ Σ c : RealHookTag (n := n), {j : Fin ℓ // G j = c} :=
    { toFun := fun j => ⟨G j, ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩
      invFun := fun x => x.2.1
      left_inv := by intro j; rfl
      right_inv := by
        rintro ⟨c, ⟨j, hj⟩⟩
        cases hj
        rfl }
  let eFiber :
      (Σ c : RealHookTag (n := n), {i : Fin m // F i = c}) ≃
        (Σ c : RealHookTag (n := n), {j : Fin ℓ // G j = c}) :=
    { toFun := fun x => ⟨x.1, E x.1 x.2⟩
      invFun := fun y => ⟨y.1, (E y.1).symm y.2⟩
      left_inv := by intro x; cases x with | mk c i => simp
      right_inv := by intro y; cases y with | mk c j => simp }
  let e : Fin m ≃ Fin ℓ := eF.trans (eFiber.trans eG.symm)
  let σ : Fin m → Fin ℓ := e
  have hσtag (i : Fin m) : G (σ i) = F i := by
    have he := eG.apply_symm_apply (eFiber (eF i))
    change eG (σ i) = eFiber (eF i) at he
