  have hts : ¬ tagNeighbor (k := k)
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (F i) (G j) := by
    intro h
    apply hj
    simp only [tagNeighbors, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact ⟨i, hi, h⟩
  have hsu : ¬ tagNeighbor (k := k)
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (G j) (F i') := by
    intro h
    apply hj
    simp only [tagNeighbors, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    rcases h with ⟨I⟩
    exact ⟨i', hi', ⟨I.symm⟩⟩
  exact tagScalarPathZeroOfNoNeighbors (k := k) hn ε hα hts hsu
    (component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j)
    (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i')

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.tagScalarSumNeighbors
statement:
private theorem tagScalarSumNeighbors (hn : 0 < n)
    {m ℓ : ℕ}
    (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n)) (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (familyModule (k := k) F)
      (familyModule (k := k) G))
    (A : Finset (Fin m)) {i i' : Fin m} (hi : i ∈ A) (hi' : i' ∈ A)
    (hα : tagOrderValue (F i) ≤ tagOrderValue (F i')) :
    ∑ j ∈ tagNeighbors (k := k) F G A
        (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε),
      tagScalar (k := k) (ε + ε) (F i) (F i')
        (component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j ≫
          (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
            (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i') ≫
          (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε (tagModule (k := k) (F i'))).hom) =
      tagScalar (k := k) (ε + ε) (F i) (F i')
        ((∑ j : Fin ℓ,
          component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j ≫
            (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
              (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i')) ≫
          (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε (tagModule (k := k) (F i'))).hom)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := tagNeighbors (k := k) F G A
    (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε)
  change (∑ j ∈ B,
      tagScalar (k := k) (ε + ε) (F i) (F i')
        (component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j ≫
          (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
            (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i') ≫
          (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε (tagModule (k := k) (F i'))).hom)) = _
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : Fin ℓ,
        tagScalar (k := k) (ε + ε) (F i) (F i')
          (component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j ≫
            (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
              (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i') ≫
            (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε (tagModule (k := k) (F i'))).hom) := by
      apply Finset.sum_subset (Finset.subset_univ B)
      intro j _ hj
      exact tagScalarComponentPathZeroOutside (k := k) hn F G ε I A hi hi'
        hα hj
    _ = tagScalar (k := k) (ε + ε) (F i) (F i')
        ((∑ j : Fin ℓ,
          component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j ≫
            (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
              (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i')) ≫
          (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε (tagModule (k := k) (F i'))).hom) := by
      rw [Preadditive.sum_comp, tagScalar_sum]
      simp only [Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.tagSignificant_of_le
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | inl ab => exact finiteSignificant_of_le hδρ h
  | inr a => trivial

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.tagNeighbor_symm
statement:
private theorem tagNeighbor_symm {ρ : ℝ≥0} {t s : RealHookTag (n := n)}
    (h : tagNeighbor (k := k) ρ t s) : tagNeighbor (k := k) ρ s t
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨I⟩
  exact ⟨I.symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.card_le_neighbors
statement:
theorem card_le_neighbors (hn : 0 < n)
    {m ℓ : ℕ} (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n)) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (familyModule (k := k) F)
      (familyModule (k := k) G)) (A : Finset (Fin m))
    (hA : ∀ i ∈ A, tagSignificant
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
        RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (F i)) :
    A.card ≤ (tagNeighbors (k := k) F G A
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ρ := RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε
  let B := tagNeighbors (k := k) F G A ρ
  let key (i : A) : ℝ ×ₗ Fin (Fintype.card A) :=
    toLex (tagOrderValue (F i), (Fintype.equivFin A) i)
  let ord : LinearOrder A := LinearOrder.lift' key (by
    intro i j hij
    apply (Fintype.equivFin A).injective
    exact congrArg (fun z => (ofLex z).2) hij)
  letI : LinearOrder A := ord
  letI : LE A := ord.toPartialOrder.toPreorder.toLE
  letI : LT A := ord.toPartialOrder.toPreorder.toLT
  have hα {i i' : A} (h : i ≤ i') :
      tagOrderValue (F i) ≤ tagOrderValue (F i') := by
    change key i ≤ key i' at h
    exact Prod.Lex.monotone_fst _ _ h
  let Fm : Matrix B A k := fun j i => tagScalar (k := k) ε (F i) (G j)
    (component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j)
  let Gm : Matrix A B k := fun i j => tagScalar (k := k) ε (G j) (F i)
    (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i)
  have hε : ε ≤ ρ := by
    dsimp [ρ]
    exact stabilityRadius_ge_epsilon hn ε
  have hεε : ε + ε ≤ ρ + ρ := add_le_add hε hε
  have entry (i i' : A) (h : tagOrderValue (F i) ≤ tagOrderValue (F i')) :
      (Gm * Fm) i' i = tagScalar (k := k) (ε + ε) (F i) (F i')
        ((∑ j : Fin ℓ,
          component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j ≫
            (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
              (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i')) ≫
          (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε (tagModule (k := k) (F i'))).hom) := by
    calc
      (Gm * Fm) i' i = ∑ j ∈ B,
          tagScalar (k := k) ε (F i) (G j)
            (component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j) *
          tagScalar (k := k) ε (G j) (F i')
            (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i') := by
        change (∑ j : B,
          tagScalar (k := k) ε (G j) (F i')
            (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i') *
          tagScalar (k := k) ε (F i) (G j)
            (component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j)) = _
        calc
          _ = ∑ j ∈ B,
              tagScalar (k := k) ε (G j) (F i')
                (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i') *
              tagScalar (k := k) ε (F i) (G j)
                (component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j) :=
            Finset.sum_coe_sort B _
          _ = _ := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro j hj
            exact mul_comm _ _
      _ = ∑ j ∈ B,
          tagScalar (k := k) (ε + ε) (F i) (F i')
            (component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j ≫
              (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
                (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i') ≫
              (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε (tagModule (k := k) (F i'))).hom) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        exact (tagScalar_composite (k := k) hn ε h
          (hA i.val i.property)
          (hA i'.val i'.property)
          (component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j)
          (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i')).symm
      _ = tagScalar (k := k) (ε + ε) (F i) (F i')
          ((∑ j : Fin ℓ,
            component (k := k) F G ε I.φ i j ≫
              (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
                (component (k := k) G F ε I.ψ j i')) ≫
            (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε (tagModule (k := k) (F i'))).hom) := by
        exact tagScalarSumNeighbors (k := k) hn F G ε I A i.property i'.property
          h
  have hbelow : ∀ ⦃i i' : A⦄, i' < i → (Gm * Fm) i i' = 0 := by
    intro i i' h
    have hle : @LE.le A ord.toPartialOrder.toPreorder.toLE i' i :=
      ((@Preorder.lt_iff_le_not_ge A ord.toPartialOrder.toPreorder i' i).mp h).1
    have hne : i' ≠ i := by
      intro heq
      have hlt := (@Preorder.lt_iff_le_not_ge A ord.toPartialOrder.toPreorder
        i' i).mp h
      apply hlt.2
      simpa [heq] using (ord.toPartialOrder.toPreorder.le_refl i)
    rw [entry i' i (hα hle),
      component_interleaving_sum_ne F G ε I
        (show (i' : Fin m) ≠ (i : Fin m) from fun he => hne (Subtype.ext he))]
    simp
  have hdiag (i : A) : (Gm * Fm) i i = 1 := by
    rw [entry i i (hα (ord.toPartialOrder.toPreorder.le_refl i)),
      component_interleaving_sum_self F G ε I i.val]
    exact tagScalar_transition
      (tagSignificant_of_le hεε (hA i.val i.property))
  have hc := RectangleHall.card_le_of_triangular_product Gm Fm hbelow hdiag
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe, B] using hc

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.exists_significant_injection
statement:
theorem exists_significant_injection (hn : 0 < n)
    {m ℓ : ℕ} (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n)) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (familyModule (k := k) F)
      (familyModule (k := k) G)) :
    ∃ f : {i // tagSignificant
        (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
          RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (F i)} → Fin ℓ,
      Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ i, tagNeighbor (k := k)
        (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (F i.val) (G (f i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Fintype.all_card_le_filter_rel_iff_exists_injective
    (fun (i : {i // tagSignificant
        (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
          RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (F i)}) (j : Fin ℓ) =>
      tagNeighbor (k := k) (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε)
        (F i.val) (G j))).mp
  intro A
  let A' : Finset (Fin m) := A.image Subtype.val
  have hA : ∀ i ∈ A', tagSignificant
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε +
        RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) (F i) := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
    exact a.property
  have h := card_le_neighbors (k := k) hn F G ε I A' hA
  have he : tagNeighbors (k := k) F G A'
      (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun j => ∃ a ∈ A,
        tagNeighbor (k := k) (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε)
          (F a.val) (G j)) := by
    ext j
    simp [tagNeighbors, A']
  rw [he, Finset.card_image_of_injective A Subtype.val_injective] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.tagInterleavedZero_of_not_significant
statement:
private theorem tagInterleavedZero_of_not_significant
    (t : RealHookTag (n := n)) (ρ : ℝ≥0)
    (h : ¬ tagSignificant (ρ + ρ) t) :
    Nonempty (CoordinateInterleaving ρ (tagModule (k := k) t) 0)
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | inl ab =>
    exact (finiteInterleaved_zero_iff (k := k) ab ρ).mpr
      (by simpa [tagSignificant] using h)
  | inr a => exact False.elim (h trivial)

name: TDA.Persistence.HookMatching.exists_matching
statement:
theorem exists_matching (hn : 0 < n)
    {m ℓ : ℕ} (F : Fin m → RealHookTag (n := n))
    (G : Fin ℓ → RealHookTag (n := n)) (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (I : CoordinateInterleaving ε (familyModule (k := k) F)
      (familyModule (k := k) G)) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching (Fin m) (Fin ℓ) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      IsMatching (k := k) (RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε) F G M
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hε : ε = 0
  · subst ε
    simpa [RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius] using
      exists_matching_of_zero_interleaving (k := k) F G I
  · let ρ := RectangleStabilityGeometry.stabilityRadius n ε
    let P := fun i => tagSignificant (ρ + ρ) (F i)
    let Q := fun j => tagSignificant (ρ + ρ) (G j)
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfr⟩ := exists_significant_injection (k := k) hn F G ε I
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hgr⟩ := exists_significant_injection (k := k) hn G F ε I.symm
    obtain ⟨M, hp, hs, ht⟩ :=
      FiniteOccurrenceMatching.exists_two_sided P Q
        (fun i j => tagNeighbor (k := k) ρ (F i) (G j))
        f hf hfr g hg (fun j => tagNeighbor_symm (k := k) (hgr j))
    refine ⟨M, hp, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro i hi
      apply tagInterleavedZero_of_not_significant (k := k) (F i) ρ
      intro hsig
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hs i hsig
      simp [hi] at hj
    · intro i hi
      apply tagInterleavedZero_of_not_significant (k := k) (G i) ρ
      intro hsig
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := ht i hsig
      exact hi j hj

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankProjectiveCover.exists_iso_over_quotient
statement:
theorem exists_iso_over_quotient {P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    {A B C : PModule.{u,0,u} k P} {π : A ⟶ C} {ρ : B ⟶ C}
    (hπ : IsRankProjectiveCover π) (hρ : IsRankProjectiveCover ρ) :
    ∃ e : A ≅ B, e.hom ≫ ρ = π
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := hπ.term_rank_projective
    (kernel ρ) B C (kernel.ι ρ) ρ hρ.row_rank_exact π
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hρ.term_rank_projective
    (kernel π) A C (kernel.ι π) π hπ.row_rank_exact ρ
  have hfg : (f ≫ g) ≫ π = π := by
    calc
      (f ≫ g) ≫ π = f ≫ (g ≫ π) := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = f ≫ ρ := by rw [hg]
      _ = π := hf
  have hgf : (g ≫ f) ≫ ρ = ρ := by
    calc
      (g ≫ f) ≫ ρ = g ≫ (f ≫ ρ) := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = g ≫ π := by rw [hf]
      _ = ρ := hg
  letI : IsIso (f ≫ g) := hπ.endomorphism_isIso (f ≫ g) hfg
  letI : IsIso (g ≫ f) := hρ.endomorphism_isIso (g ≫ f) hgf
  let r : B ⟶ A := g ≫ (asIso (f ≫ g)).inv
  let l : B ⟶ A := (asIso (g ≫ f)).inv ≫ g
  have hfr : f ≫ r = 𝟙 A := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact (asIso (f ≫ g)).hom_inv_id
  have hlf : l ≫ f = 𝟙 B := by
    dsimp [l]
    rw [Category.assoc]
    exact (asIso (g ≫ f)).inv_hom_id
  have hrl : r = l := by
    calc
      r = (𝟙 B) ≫ r := by simp
      _ = (l ≫ f) ≫ r := by rw [hlf]
      _ = l ≫ (f ≫ r) := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = l := by rw [hfr]; simp
  refine ⟨⟨f, r, hfr, ?_⟩, hf⟩
  rw [hrl]
  exact hlf

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.hook_hom_nonzero_implies_endpoint_order
statement:
theorem hook_hom_nonzero_implies_endpoint_order
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] {i j m n : P} (hij : i < j) (_hmn : m < n)
    (f : Hook.module (k := k) i j ⟶ Hook.module (k := k) m n) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    m ≤ i ∧ n ≤ j
proof:
:= by
  let v := (Hook.homEquivKernel hij (Hook.module (k := k) m n)) f
  have hv : v.val ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hf
    exact (Hook.homEquivKernel hij (Hook.module (k := k) m n)).injective
      (Subtype.ext hzero)
  have hsupport : i ∈ Hook.support m n := by
    by_contra hi
    apply hv
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (Hook.support m n) hi v.val
  refine ⟨hsupport.1, ?_⟩
  by_contra hnj
  have hdie : structureMapLinear (Hook.module (k := k) m n) hij.le v.val = 0 :=
    v.property
  have hdieval :
      (structureMapLinear (Hook.module (k := k) m n) hij.le v.val).val = 0 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val hdie
  have hjSupport : j ∈ Hook.support m n := ⟨hsupport.1.trans hij.le, hnj⟩
  have hval := SupportInterval.structureMap_val (Hook.support m n)
    (Hook.support_ordConnected m n) hij.le v.val
  rw [if_pos hjSupport] at hval
  have hvzero : v.val = 0 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hval.symm.trans hdieval
  exact hv hvzero

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.HookSumCover.term_isRankProjective
statement:
theorem HookSumCover.term_isRankProjective {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P]
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P} (C : HookSumCover M) :
    IsRankProjective (⨁ C.summand)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsRankProjective.biproduct
  intro i
  have hTag : IsRankProjective
      (FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (C.tag i)) := by
    cases C.tag i with
    | inl ab => exact Hook.isRankProjective ab.property
    | inr a => exact HookInfinity.isRankProjective a
  exact hTag.of_iso (eqToIso (C.summand_eq_tag i)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.canonicalFamily_eq_tag
statement:
private theorem canonicalFamily_eq_tag {P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P} (t : FiniteHookDeflation.Index M) :
    FiniteHookDeflation.family M t =
      FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)
        (canonicalHookTag t)
proof:
:= by
  cases t <;> rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.exists_minimalHookSumCover
statement:
theorem exists_minimalHookSumCover {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P]
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hfd : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)) :
    Nonempty (MinimalHookSumCover M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hasCover : ℕ → Prop := fun m => ∃ C : HookSumCover M, C.length = m
  have hCover : ∃ m, hasCover m := by
    refine ⟨(canonicalHookSumCover M hfd).length, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨canonicalHookSumCover M hfd, rfl⟩
  let m := Nat.find hCover
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := Nat.find_spec hCover
  refine ⟨⟨C, ?_⟩⟩
  intro D
  calc
    C.length = m := hC
    _ ≤ D.length := Nat.find_min' hCover (show hasCover D.length from ⟨D, rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.HookSumCover.exists_smaller_of_kernel_section
statement:
theorem HookSumCover.exists_smaller_of_kernel_section
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P] {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (C : HookSumCover M) (i : C.Index)
    (s : C.summand i ⟶ ⨁ C.summand)
    (hs : s ≫ biproduct.π C.summand i = 𝟙 (C.summand i))
    (hq : s ≫ C.quotient = 0) :
    ∃ D : HookSumCover M, D.length < C.length
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S := {j : C.Index // j ≠ i}
  let F := Subtype.restrict (fun j : C.Index => j ≠ i) C.summand
  let t : (⨁ C.summand) ⟶ ⨁ F :=
    biproduct.toSubtype C.summand fun j => j ≠ i
  let u : (⨁ F) ⟶ ⨁ C.summand :=
    biproduct.fromSubtype C.summand fun j => j ≠ i
  let h : C.summand i ⟶ ⨁ F := s ≫ t
  let r : (⨁ C.summand) ⟶ ⨁ F :=
    t - biproduct.π C.summand i ≫ h
  let q' : (⨁ F) ⟶ M := u ≫ C.quotient
  have hιtCompl (j : C.Index) (hji : j ≠ i) :
      biproduct.ι C.summand j ≫ t =
        biproduct.ι F ⟨j, hji⟩ := by
    dsimp [t, F]
    simpa using (biproduct.ι_toSubtype_subtype
      (f := C.summand) (p := fun j => j ≠ i) ⟨j, hji⟩)
  have hιtDrop : biproduct.ι C.summand i ≫ t = 0 := by
    dsimp [t]
    rw [biproduct.ι_toSubtype]
    simp
  have hprojection : t ≫ u = 𝟙 (⨁ C.summand) -
      biproduct.π C.summand i ≫ biproduct.ι C.summand i := by
    apply biproduct.hom_ext'
    intro j
    by_cases hij : j = i
    · subst j
      dsimp [t, u]
      calc
        biproduct.ι C.summand i ≫
            (biproduct.toSubtype C.summand (fun j => j ≠ i)) ≫
              (biproduct.fromSubtype C.summand (fun j => j ≠ i)) = 0 := by
          have h := congrArg (fun f => f ≫
              biproduct.fromSubtype C.summand (fun j => j ≠ i)) hιtDrop
          simpa [Category.assoc] using h
        _ = biproduct.ι C.summand i ≫
            (𝟙 (⨁ C.summand) - biproduct.π C.summand i ≫ biproduct.ι C.summand i) := by
          simp
    · calc
        biproduct.ι C.summand j ≫ t ≫ u =
            (biproduct.ι C.summand j ≫ t) ≫ u := by rw [Category.assoc]
        _ = biproduct.ι C.summand j := by
              rw [hιtCompl j hij]
              dsimp [u, F]
              exact biproduct.ι_fromSubtype C.summand (fun j => j ≠ i) ⟨j, hij⟩
        _ = biproduct.ι C.summand j ≫
            (𝟙 (⨁ C.summand) - biproduct.π C.summand i ≫ biproduct.ι C.summand i) := by
          simp [Category.assoc, hij]
  have hsection_complement : s ≫ t ≫ u = s - biproduct.ι C.summand i := by
    calc
      s ≫ t ≫ u = s ≫ (𝟙 (⨁ C.summand) -
          biproduct.π C.summand i ≫ biproduct.ι C.summand i) := by rw [hprojection]
      _ = s - (s ≫ biproduct.π C.summand i) ≫ biproduct.ι C.summand i := by
        simp [Category.assoc]
      _ = s - biproduct.ι C.summand i := by rw [hs]; simp
  have hr : r ≫ u = 𝟙 (⨁ C.summand) - biproduct.π C.summand i ≫ s := by
    dsimp [r, h]
    calc
      (t - biproduct.π C.summand i ≫ (s ≫ t)) ≫ u =
          t ≫ u - biproduct.π C.summand i ≫ (s ≫ t ≫ u) := by
            simp [Category.assoc]
      _ = (𝟙 (⨁ C.summand) - biproduct.π C.summand i ≫
          biproduct.ι C.summand i) - biproduct.π C.summand i ≫
            (s ≫ t ≫ u) := by rw [hprojection]
      _ = (𝟙 (⨁ C.summand) - biproduct.π C.summand i ≫
          biproduct.ι C.summand i) - biproduct.π C.summand i ≫
            (s - biproduct.ι C.summand i) := by rw [hsection_complement]
      _ = 𝟙 (⨁ C.summand) - biproduct.π C.summand i ≫ s := by
            simp only [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.comp_sub, Category.id_comp]
            abel
  have hfactor : C.quotient = r ≫ q' := by
    calc
      C.quotient = (𝟙 (⨁ C.summand) - biproduct.π C.summand i ≫ s) ≫ C.quotient := by
        symm
        rw [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.id_comp, Category.assoc, hq]
        simp
      _ = (r ≫ u) ≫ C.quotient := by rw [hr]
      _ = r ≫ u ≫ C.quotient := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = r ≫ q' := by rfl
  have hfd (p : P) : FiniteDimensional k ((⨁ F).obj p) := by
    letI : ∀ j : S, FiniteDimensional k ((F j).obj p) := fun j => by
      let e := eqToIso (C.summand_eq_tag j.1)
      letI : FiniteDimensional k
          ((FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)
            (C.tag j.1)).obj p) := by
        cases C.tag j.1 with
        | inl ab =>
            change FiniteDimensional k ((Hook.module (k := k) ab.val.1 ab.val.2).obj p)
            infer_instance
        | inr a =>
            change FiniteDimensional k ((HookInfinity.module (R := k) a).obj p)
            infer_instance
      exact (e.app p).toLinearEquiv.symm.finiteDimensional
    exact FiniteBiproduct.finiteDimensional F p
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k ((⨁ F).obj p) := hfd
  have hsurj (p : P) : Function.Surjective (q'.app p).hom := by
    intro z
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := C.row_rank_exact.surjective p z
    refine ⟨(r.app p).hom x, ?_⟩
    have he := congrArg (fun f : (⨁ C.summand).obj p ⟶ M.obj p => f.hom x)
      (congrArg (fun f : (⨁ C.summand) ⟶ M => f.app p) hfactor)
    simpa [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp] using he.symm.trans hx
  have hlift {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b) (z : M.obj a)
      (hz : structureMapLinear M hab z = 0) :
      ∃ x : (⨁ F).obj a,
        (q'.app a).hom x = z ∧
          structureMapLinear (⨁ F) hab x = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hdie⟩ := C.row_rank_exact.lift_kernel hab z hz
    refine ⟨(r.app a).hom x, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have he := congrArg (fun f : (⨁ C.summand).obj a ⟶ M.obj a => f.hom x)
        (congrArg (fun f : (⨁ C.summand) ⟶ M => f.app a) hfactor)
      simpa [NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp] using he.symm.trans hx
    · have hn := congrArg (fun f : (⨁ C.summand).obj a ⟶
        (⨁ F).obj b => f.hom x) (r.naturality (homOfLE hab))
      change (r.app b).hom (structureMapLinear (⨁ C.summand) hab x) =
        structureMapLinear (⨁ F) hab ((r.app a).hom x) at hn
      simpa [hdie] using hn.symm
  let D : HookSumCover M := {
    Index := S
    instFintypeIndex := inferInstance
    summand := F
    tag := fun j => C.tag j.1
    summand_eq_tag := fun j => C.summand_eq_tag j.1
    quotient := q'
    row_rank_exact := RankKernel.rankExact q' hsurj hlift
  }
  have hcard : Fintype.card S + 1 = Fintype.card C.Index := by
    have hcomp := Fintype.card_subtype_compl (fun j : C.Index => j = i)
    have hsingleton : Fintype.card {j : C.Index // j = i} = 1 := by simp
    change Fintype.card {j : C.Index // j ≠ i} + 1 = Fintype.card C.Index
    rw [hcomp, hsingleton]
    exact Nat.sub_add_cancel (by have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card C.Index := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨i⟩; omega)
  refine ⟨D, ?_⟩
  change Fintype.card S < Fintype.card C.Index
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.rankProjectiveHookEnd_isIso_of_ne_zero
statement:
private theorem rankProjectiveHookEnd_isIso_of_ne_zero
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    (t : FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.RankProjectiveHookTag P)
    (f : End (FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) t))
    (hf : f ≠ 0) : IsIso f
proof:
:= by
  let e := rankProjectiveHookEndRingEquiv (k := k) t
  have he : e f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hf
    exact e.injective (by simpa using hz)
  have hunit : IsUnit (e f) := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr he
  have hunit' : IsUnit f := by
    have hm := IsUnit.map e.symm.toRingHom hunit
    simpa [e] using hm
  exact CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso _ |>.mp hunit'

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.MinimalHookSumCover.kernel_diagonal_component_eq_zero
statement:
theorem MinimalHookSumCover.kernel_diagonal_component_eq_zero
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P] {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (C : MinimalHookSumCover M) (i : C.cover.Index)
    (f : C.cover.summand i ⟶ kernel C.cover.quotient) :
    f ≫ kernel.ι C.cover.quotient ≫ biproduct.π C.cover.summand i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e : C.cover.summand i ≅
      FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (C.cover.tag i) :=
    eqToIso (C.cover.summand_eq_tag i)
  let α : End (C.cover.summand i) :=
    f ≫ kernel.ι C.cover.quotient ≫ biproduct.π C.cover.summand i
  by_contra hα
  let β : End (FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)
      (C.cover.tag i)) := e.inv ≫ α ≫ e.hom
  have hβ : β ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hconj : α = e.hom ≫ β ≫ e.inv := by
      dsimp [β]
      simp [Category.assoc]
    have hαzero : α = 0 := by rw [hconj, hzero]; simp
    exact hα hαzero
  letI : IsIso β := rankProjectiveHookEnd_isIso_of_ne_zero (C.cover.tag i) β hβ
  let αInv : End (C.cover.summand i) := e.hom ≫ inv β ≫ e.inv
  have hβdef : β = e.inv ≫ α ≫ e.hom := rfl
  have hαInv : αInv ≫ α = 𝟙 (C.cover.summand i) := by
    dsimp [αInv]
    calc
      e.hom ≫ inv β ≫ e.inv ≫ α =
          e.hom ≫ inv β ≫ (e.inv ≫ α ≫ e.hom) ≫ e.inv := by
            simp [Category.assoc]
      _ = e.hom ≫ inv β ≫ β ≫ e.inv := by rw [← hβdef]
      _ = 𝟙 (C.cover.summand i) := by simp [Category.assoc]
  let s : C.cover.summand i ⟶ ⨁ C.cover.summand :=
    αInv ≫ f ≫ kernel.ι C.cover.quotient
  have hs : s ≫ biproduct.π C.cover.summand i = 𝟙 (C.cover.summand i) := by
    dsimp [s, α]
    calc
      αInv ≫ f ≫ kernel.ι C.cover.quotient ≫ biproduct.π C.cover.summand i =
          αInv ≫ α := rfl
      _ = 𝟙 (C.cover.summand i) := hαInv
  have hq : s ≫ C.cover.quotient = 0 := by
    dsimp [s]
    simp [Category.assoc]
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := HookSumCover.exists_smaller_of_kernel_section C.cover i s hs hq
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (C.minimal D)) hD

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.MinimalHookSumCover.kernel_component_eq_zero_of_iso
statement:
theorem MinimalHookSumCover.kernel_component_eq_zero_of_iso
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P] {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (C : MinimalHookSumCover M) (i : C.cover.Index)
    (X : PModule.{u,0,u} k P)
    (e : X ≅ FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule
      (k := k) (C.cover.tag i))
    (f : X ⟶ kernel C.cover.quotient) :
    f ≫ kernel.ι C.cover.quotient ≫ biproduct.π C.cover.summand i = 0
proof:
:= by
  let eTarget : C.cover.summand i ≅
      FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (C.cover.tag i) :=
    eqToIso (C.cover.summand_eq_tag i)
  let eIso : X ≅ C.cover.summand i := e.trans eTarget.symm
  have hdiag := C.kernel_diagonal_component_eq_zero i (eIso.inv ≫ f)
  have hpre : eIso.hom ≫
      (eIso.inv ≫ f ≫ kernel.ι C.cover.quotient ≫
        biproduct.π C.cover.summand i) = 0 := by
    simpa [Category.assoc] using congrArg (fun g => eIso.hom ≫ g) hdiag
  calc
    f ≫ kernel.ι C.cover.quotient ≫ biproduct.π C.cover.summand i =
        eIso.hom ≫ (eIso.inv ≫ f ≫ kernel.ι C.cover.quotient ≫
          biproduct.π C.cover.summand i) := by simp [Category.assoc]
    _ = 0 := by rw [hpre]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.MinimalHookSumCover.quotient_component_ne_zero
statement:
theorem MinimalHookSumCover.quotient_component_ne_zero
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P] {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (C : MinimalHookSumCover M) (i : C.cover.Index) :
    biproduct.ι C.cover.summand i ≫ C.cover.quotient ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro hzero
  have hs : biproduct.ι C.cover.summand i ≫ biproduct.π C.cover.summand i =
      𝟙 (C.cover.summand i) := biproduct.ι_π_self _ _
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := HookSumCover.exists_smaller_of_kernel_section C.cover i
    (biproduct.ι C.cover.summand i) hs hzero
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (C.minimal D)) hD

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitePosetRank_mono
statement:
theorem finitePosetRank_mono {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P]
    {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b) : finitePosetRank a ≤ finitePosetRank b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective
    (fun x : {p : P // p ≤ a} => (⟨x.1, x.2.trans hab⟩ : {p : P // p ≤ b}))
    (by
      intro x y h
      exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : {p : P // p ≤ b} => (z : P)) h))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitePosetRank_strictMono
statement:
theorem finitePosetRank_strictMono {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P]
    {a b : P} (hab : a < b) : finitePosetRank a < finitePosetRank b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change Fintype.card {p : P // p ≤ a} < Fintype.card {p : P // p ≤ b}
  apply Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective
    (fun x : {p : P // p ≤ a} => (⟨x.1, x.2.trans hab.le⟩ : {p : P // p ≤ b}))
    (by
      intro x y h
      exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : {p : P // p ≤ b} => (z : P)) h))
  intro hsurj
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj ⟨b, le_rfl⟩
  have hval : (x.1 : P) = b := congrArg (fun z : {p : P // p ≤ b} => (z : P)) hx
  have hba : b ≤ a := by simpa [hval] using x.2
  exact (not_le_of_gt hab) hba

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.rankProjectiveHookHomOrder_weight_strict
statement:
theorem rankProjectiveHookHomOrder_weight_strict
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P]
    (s t : FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.RankProjectiveHookTag P)
    (h : rankProjectiveHookHomOrder s t) (hne : s ≠ t) :
    rankProjectiveHookTagWeight t < rankProjectiveHookTagWeight s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  cases s with
  | inl ab =>
    cases t with
    | inl cd =>
      have hbirth := finitePosetRank_mono h.1
      have hdeath := finitePosetRank_mono h.2
      by_cases hb : cd.val.1 = ab.val.1
      · have hd : cd.val.2 < ab.val.2 :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne h.2 (by
            intro heq
            apply hne
            congr 1
            exact Subtype.ext (Prod.ext hb.symm heq.symm))
        have hrank := finitePosetRank_strictMono hd
        simp only [rankProjectiveHookTagWeight]
        omega
      · have hb' : cd.val.1 < ab.val.1 := lt_of_le_of_ne h.1 hb
        have hrank := finitePosetRank_strictMono hb'
        simp only [rankProjectiveHookTagWeight]
        omega
    | inr a => exact h.elim
  | inr a =>
    cases t with
    | inl cd =>
      have hbirth := finitePosetRank_mono h
      have hdeath : finitePosetRank cd.val.2 ≤ Fintype.card P := by
        simpa [finitePosetRank] using
          (Fintype.card_subtype_le (fun b : P => b ≤ cd.val.2))
      simp only [rankProjectiveHookTagWeight]
      omega
    | inr b =>
      by_cases hab : b = a
      · subst b
        exact (hne rfl).elim
      · have hba : b < a := lt_of_le_of_ne h hab
        have hrank := finitePosetRank_strictMono hba
        simp only [rankProjectiveHookTagWeight]
        omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.rankProjectiveHook_hom_nonzero_order
statement:
theorem rankProjectiveHook_hom_nonzero_order
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P]
    (s t : FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.RankProjectiveHookTag P)
    (f : FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) s ⟶
      FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) t)
    (hf : f ≠ 0) : rankProjectiveHookHomOrder s t
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | inl ab =>
    cases t with
    | inl cd =>
      exact hook_hom_nonzero_implies_endpoint_order ab.property cd.property f hf
    | inr b =>
      let v := (Hook.homEquivKernel ab.property
        (HookInfinity.module (R := k) b)) f
      have hv : v.val ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        apply hf
        exact (Hook.homEquivKernel ab.property
          (HookInfinity.module (R := k) b)).injective (Subtype.ext hzero)
      have hbi : b ≤ ab.val.1 := by
        by_contra hbi
        exact hv (HookInfinity.fiber_eq_zero_of_not_le hbi v.val)
      have hdie : structureMapLinear (HookInfinity.module (R := k) b)
          ab.property.le v.val = 0 := v.property
      have hcoeff : HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hbi v.val = 0 := by
        calc
          HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hbi v.val =
              HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) (hbi.trans ab.property.le)
                (structureMapLinear (HookInfinity.module (R := k) b)
                  ab.property.le v.val) := by
                    exact (HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe_structureMap hbi ab.property.le v.val).symm
          _ = 0 := by rw [hdie, map_zero]
      exact (False.elim (hv
        ((HookInfinity.fiberEquivOfLe (R := k) hbi).injective hcoeff)))
  | inr a =>
    cases t with
    | inl cd =>
      let v := (HookInfinity.homEquivFiber (R := k) a
        (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2)) f
      have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        apply hf
        exact (HookInfinity.homEquivFiber (R := k) a
          (Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2)).injective hzero
      have hbirth : cd.val.1 ≤ a := by
        by_contra h
        have ha : a ∉ Hook.support cd.val.1 cd.val.2 := by
          intro ha
          exact h ha.1
        apply hv
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (Hook.support cd.val.1 cd.val.2) ha v
      exact hbirth
    | inr b =>
      let v := (HookInfinity.homEquivFiber (R := k) a
        (HookInfinity.module (R := k) b)) f
      have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
        intro hzero
        apply hf
        exact (HookInfinity.homEquivFiber (R := k) a
          (HookInfinity.module (R := k) b)).injective hzero
      by_contra hba
      exact hv (HookInfinity.fiber_eq_zero_of_not_le hba v)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.minimalHookCover_differential_component_weight_strict
statement:
theorem minimalHookCover_differential_component_weight_strict
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P] {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (C : MinimalHookSumCover M)
    (D : MinimalHookSumCover (kernel C.cover.quotient))
    (i : C.cover.Index) (j : D.cover.Index)
    (hcomponent : biproduct.ι D.cover.summand j ≫ D.cover.quotient ≫
      kernel.ι C.cover.quotient ≫ biproduct.π C.cover.summand i ≠ 0) :
    rankProjectiveHookTagWeight (C.cover.tag i) <
      rankProjectiveHookTagWeight (D.cover.tag j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let eSource : D.cover.summand j ≅
      FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (D.cover.tag j) :=
    eqToIso (D.cover.summand_eq_tag j)
  let eTarget : C.cover.summand i ≅
      FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (C.cover.tag i) :=
    eqToIso (C.cover.summand_eq_tag i)
  have htags : D.cover.tag j ≠ C.cover.tag i := by
    intro htag
    let eTag : FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)
        (D.cover.tag j) ≅
        FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (C.cover.tag i) :=
      eqToIso (congrArg
        (FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)) htag)
    let e : D.cover.summand j ≅
        FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (C.cover.tag i) :=
      eSource.trans eTag
    have hz := C.kernel_component_eq_zero_of_iso i _ e
      (biproduct.ι D.cover.summand j ≫ D.cover.quotient)
    apply hcomponent
    simpa [Category.assoc] using hz
  let f : D.cover.summand j ⟶ C.cover.summand i :=
    biproduct.ι D.cover.summand j ≫ D.cover.quotient ≫
      kernel.ι C.cover.quotient ≫ biproduct.π C.cover.summand i
  let g : FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)
        (D.cover.tag j) ⟶
      FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (C.cover.tag i) :=
    eSource.inv ≫ f ≫ eTarget.hom
  have hg : g ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hcomponent
    have hrecover : eSource.hom ≫ g ≫ eTarget.inv = f := by
      dsimp [g, f]
      simp [Category.assoc]
    change f = 0
    rw [← hrecover, hz]
    simp
  have horder := rankProjectiveHook_hom_nonzero_order
    (D.cover.tag j) (C.cover.tag i) g hg
  exact rankProjectiveHookHomOrder_weight_strict
    (D.cover.tag j) (C.cover.tag i) horder htags

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.MinimalHookSumCover.endomorphism_sub_id_component_weight_strict
statement:
theorem MinimalHookSumCover.endomorphism_sub_id_component_weight_strict
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P] {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (C : MinimalHookSumCover M)
    (u : End (⨁ C.cover.summand))
    (hu : u ≫ C.cover.quotient = C.cover.quotient)
    (i j : C.cover.Index)
    (hcomponent : biproduct.components (u - (1 : End (⨁ C.cover.summand))) i j ≠ 0) :
    rankProjectiveHookTagWeight (C.cover.tag j) <
      rankProjectiveHookTagWeight (C.cover.tag i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let δ : End (⨁ C.cover.summand) := u - (1 : End (⨁ C.cover.summand))
  have hδq : δ ≫ C.cover.quotient = 0 := by
    dsimp [δ]
    rw [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.sub_comp, Category.id_comp, hu]
    simp
  let e : (⨁ C.cover.summand) ⟶ kernel C.cover.quotient :=
    kernel.lift C.cover.quotient δ hδq
  have he : e ≫ kernel.ι C.cover.quotient = δ :=
    kernel.lift_ι C.cover.quotient δ hδq
  have hcomponent' : biproduct.components δ i j =
      biproduct.ι C.cover.summand i ≫ e ≫ kernel.ι C.cover.quotient ≫
        biproduct.π C.cover.summand j := by
    dsimp [biproduct.components]
    rw [← he]
    simp [Category.assoc]
  have htags : C.cover.tag i ≠ C.cover.tag j := by
    intro htag
    let eSource : C.cover.summand i ≅
        FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)
          (C.cover.tag i) :=
      eqToIso (C.cover.summand_eq_tag i)
    let eTag : FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)
        (C.cover.tag i) ≅
        FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)
          (C.cover.tag j) :=
      eqToIso (congrArg
        (FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)) htag)
    let eIso := eSource.trans eTag
    have hz := C.kernel_component_eq_zero_of_iso j _ eIso
      (biproduct.ι C.cover.summand i ≫ e)
    have hzero : biproduct.components δ i j = 0 := by
      rw [hcomponent']
      exact hz
    apply hcomponent
    simpa [δ] using hzero
  let eSource : C.cover.summand i ≅
      FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)
        (C.cover.tag i) :=
    eqToIso (C.cover.summand_eq_tag i)
  let eTarget : C.cover.summand j ≅
      FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)
        (C.cover.tag j) :=
    eqToIso (C.cover.summand_eq_tag j)
  let g : FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)
      (C.cover.tag i) ⟶
      FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)
        (C.cover.tag j) :=
    eSource.inv ≫ biproduct.components δ i j ≫ eTarget.hom
  have hrecover : eSource.hom ≫ g ≫ eTarget.inv = biproduct.components δ i j := by
    dsimp [g]
    simp [Category.assoc]
  have hg : g ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hzero : biproduct.components δ i j = 0 := by
      rw [← hrecover, hz]
      simp
    apply hcomponent
    simpa [δ] using hzero
  have horder := rankProjectiveHook_hom_nonzero_order
    (C.cover.tag i) (C.cover.tag j) g hg
  exact rankProjectiveHookHomOrder_weight_strict
    (C.cover.tag i) (C.cover.tag j) horder htags

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.HookSumCover.term_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem HookSumCover.term_finiteDimensional
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P] {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (C : HookSumCover M) (p : P) :
    FiniteDimensional k ((⨁ C.summand).obj p)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k ((C.summand i).obj p) := fun i => by
    let e := eqToIso (C.summand_eq_tag i)
    letI : FiniteDimensional k
        ((FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k)
          (C.tag i)).obj p) := by
      cases C.tag i with
      | inl ab => change FiniteDimensional k ((Hook.module (k := k) ab.val.1 ab.val.2).obj p); infer_instance
      | inr a => change FiniteDimensional k ((HookInfinity.module (R := k) a).obj p); infer_instance
    exact (e.app p).toLinearEquiv.symm.finiteDimensional
  exact FiniteBiproduct.finiteDimensional C.summand p

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.HookSumCover.kernel_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem HookSumCover.kernel_finiteDimensional
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P] {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (C : HookSumCover M) :
    ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k ((kernel C.quotient).obj p)
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  letI : FiniteDimensional k ((⨁ C.summand).obj p) := C.term_finiteDimensional p
  exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective ((kernel.ι C.quotient).app p).hom
    ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.HookSumCover.isZero_of_isEmpty_index
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := emptyBiproductIsoZero C.summand
  have hterm (p : P) (x : (⨁ C.summand).obj p) : x = 0 := by
    apply (e.app p).toLinearEquiv.injective
    exact (ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (R := k)
      (Functor.zero_obj p)).elim _ _
  have hM (p : P) (y : M.obj p) : y = 0 := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := C.row_rank_exact.surjective p y
    have hx0 : (C.quotient.app p).hom x = 0 := by rw [hterm p x]; simp
    rw [hx0] at hx
    exact hx.symm
  apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero M).mpr
  ext p x
  simp [hM p x]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.exists_nonzero_differential_component
statement:
private theorem exists_nonzero_differential_component
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P] {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (C : MinimalHookSumCover M)
    (D : MinimalHookSumCover (kernel C.cover.quotient)) (j : D.cover.Index) :
    ∃ i : C.cover.Index,
      biproduct.ι D.cover.summand j ≫ D.cover.quotient ≫
        kernel.ι C.cover.quotient ≫ biproduct.π C.cover.summand i ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : D.cover.summand j ⟶ ⨁ C.cover.summand :=
    biproduct.ι D.cover.summand j ≫ D.cover.quotient ≫ kernel.ι C.cover.quotient
  have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hzero : biproduct.ι D.cover.summand j ≫ D.cover.quotient = 0 := by
      apply (cancel_mono (kernel.ι C.cover.quotient)).mp
      simpa [f, Category.assoc] using hz
    exact D.quotient_component_ne_zero j hzero
  by_contra hnone
  push Not at hnone
  apply hf
  apply biproduct.hom_ext
  intro i
  simpa [f, Category.assoc] using hnone i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.iteratedMinimalHookCover_weight_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem iteratedMinimalHookCover_weight_lower_bound
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P]
    (X : PointwisePfdModule (k := k) P) :
    ∀ n (i : (iteratedMinimalHookCover X n).cover.Index),
      n ≤ rankProjectiveHookTagWeight ((iteratedMinimalHookCover X n).cover.tag i)
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro i
      exact Nat.zero_le _
  | succ n ih =>
      intro j
      let C := iteratedMinimalHookCover X n
      let D := iteratedMinimalHookCover X (n + 1)
      obtain ⟨i, hcomponent⟩ := exists_nonzero_differential_component C D j
      have hstrict := minimalHookCover_differential_component_weight_strict
        C D i j hcomponent
      have hprevious := ih i
      change rankProjectiveHookTagWeight
          ((iteratedMinimalHookCover X n).cover.tag i) <
        rankProjectiveHookTagWeight
          ((iteratedMinimalHookCover X (n + 1)).cover.tag j) at hstrict
      change n ≤ rankProjectiveHookTagWeight
          ((iteratedMinimalHookCover X n).cover.tag i) at hprevious
      omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitePosetRank_le_card
statement:
private theorem finitePosetRank_le_card
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P] (a : P) :
    finitePosetRank a ≤ Fintype.card P
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold finitePosetRank
  exact Fintype.card_le_of_injective Subtype.val Subtype.val_injective

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.rankProjectiveHookTagWeight_le_card
statement:
private theorem rankProjectiveHookTagWeight_le_card
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P]
    (t : FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.RankProjectiveHookTag P) :
    rankProjectiveHookTagWeight t ≤ 3 * Fintype.card P + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | inl ab =>
      have hb := finitePosetRank_le_card ab.val.1
      have hd := finitePosetRank_le_card ab.val.2
      change finitePosetRank ab.val.1 + finitePosetRank ab.val.2 ≤
        3 * Fintype.card P + 1
      omega
  | inr a =>
      have ha := finitePosetRank_le_card a
      change finitePosetRank a + 2 * Fintype.card P + 1 ≤
        3 * Fintype.card P + 1
      omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.biproduct_components_comp
statement:
private theorem biproduct_components_comp
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P]
    {I : Type} [Fintype I] (F : I → PModule.{u,0,u} k P)
    (f g : End (⨁ F)) (i j : I) :
    biproduct.components (f ≫ g) i j =
      ∑ l : I, biproduct.components f i l ≫ biproduct.components g l j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change biproduct.ι F i ≫ (f ≫ g) ≫ biproduct.π F j = _
  calc
    biproduct.ι F i ≫ (f ≫ g) ≫ biproduct.π F j =
        (biproduct.ι F i ≫ f) ≫
          (∑ l : I, biproduct.π F l ≫ biproduct.ι F l) ≫
          (g ≫ biproduct.π F j) := by
            rw [biproduct.total]
            simp [Category.assoc]
    _ = ∑ l : I,
        ((biproduct.ι F i ≫ f) ≫ biproduct.π F l) ≫
          (biproduct.ι F l ≫ (g ≫ biproduct.π F j)) := by
            simp only [CategoryTheory.Preadditive.comp_sum,
              CategoryTheory.Preadditive.sum_comp, Category.assoc]
    _ = ∑ l : I,
        biproduct.components f i l ≫ biproduct.components g l j := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro l hl
          simp [biproduct.components, Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.nilpotent_of_strictly_lowering_biproduct_components
statement:
private theorem nilpotent_of_strictly_lowering_biproduct_components
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P]
    {I : Type} [Fintype I] (F : I → PModule.{u,0,u} k P)
    (weight : I → ℕ) (bound : ℕ) (hbound : ∀ i, weight i ≤ bound)
    (f : End (⨁ F))
    (hstrict : ∀ i j, biproduct.components f i j ≠ 0 → weight j < weight i) :
    IsNilpotent f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpower : ∀ r i j,
      biproduct.components (f ^ r) i j ≠ 0 → r + weight j ≤ weight i := by
    intro r
    induction r with
    | zero =>
        intro i j hcomponent
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst j
          simp
        · have hzero : biproduct.components (1 : End (⨁ F)) i j = 0 := by
            simp [biproduct.components, hij]
          have hneq : biproduct.components (1 : End (⨁ F)) i j ≠ 0 := by
            simpa only [pow_zero] using hcomponent
          exact False.elim (hneq hzero)
    | succ r ihr =>
        intro i j hcomponent
        have hpower_comp : (f ^ (r + 1) : End (⨁ F)) = f ≫ f ^ r := by
          rw [pow_succ, End.mul_def]
        have hmatrix := biproduct_components_comp F f (f ^ r) i j
        rw [← hpower_comp] at hmatrix
        have hterm : ∃ l : I,
            biproduct.components f i l ≫ biproduct.components (f ^ r) l j ≠ 0 := by
          by_contra hnone
          have hzero (l : I) :
              biproduct.components f i l ≫ biproduct.components (f ^ r) l j = 0 := by
            by_contra hne
            exact hnone ⟨l, hne⟩
          have hsum :
              ∑ l : I, biproduct.components f i l ≫
                biproduct.components (f ^ r) l j = 0 := by
            apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
            intro l hl
            exact hzero l
          apply hcomponent
          rw [hmatrix]
          exact hsum
        obtain ⟨l, hcomp⟩ := hterm
        have hleft : biproduct.components f i l ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz
          apply hcomp
          simp [hz]
        have hright : biproduct.components (f ^ r) l j ≠ 0 := by
          intro hz
          apply hcomp
          simp [hz]
        have hleftWeight := hstrict i l hleft
        have hrightWeight := ihr l j hright
        omega
  have hzero : (f ^ (bound + 1) : End (⨁ F)) = 0 := by
    apply (biproduct.matrixEquiv (f := F) (g := F)).injective
    funext i
    funext j
    change biproduct.components (f ^ (bound + 1)) i j =
      biproduct.components (0 : End (⨁ F)) i j
    have hcomponent : biproduct.components (f ^ (bound + 1)) i j = 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      have hle := hpower (bound + 1) i j hne
      have hle' := hbound i
      omega
    rw [hcomponent]
    simp [biproduct.components]
  exact ⟨bound + 1, hzero⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.MinimalHookSumCover.endomorphism_over_quotient_isIso
statement:
theorem MinimalHookSumCover.endomorphism_over_quotient_isIso
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P] {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (C : MinimalHookSumCover M)
    (u : End (⨁ C.cover.summand))
    (hu : u ≫ C.cover.quotient = C.cover.quotient) : IsIso u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let δ : End (⨁ C.cover.summand) := u - (1 : End (⨁ C.cover.summand))
  let weight : C.cover.Index → ℕ := fun i =>
    rankProjectiveHookTagWeight (C.cover.tag i)
  have hbound (i : C.cover.Index) : weight i ≤ 3 * Fintype.card P + 1 :=
    rankProjectiveHookTagWeight_le_card (C.cover.tag i)
  have hstrict : ∀ i j, biproduct.components δ i j ≠ 0 → weight j < weight i := by
    intro i j hcomponent
    apply C.endomorphism_sub_id_component_weight_strict u hu i j
    simpa [δ] using hcomponent
  have hnilpotent := nilpotent_of_strictly_lowering_biproduct_components
    C.cover.summand weight (3 * Fintype.card P + 1) hbound δ hstrict
  have hunit : IsUnit (1 + δ : End (⨁ C.cover.summand)) :=
    hnilpotent.isUnit_one_add
  have hu_eq : u = (1 : End (⨁ C.cover.summand)) + δ := by
    simpa [δ, add_comm] using
      (sub_add_cancel u (1 : End (⨁ C.cover.summand))).symm
  have hunit' : IsUnit u := by
    rw [hu_eq]
    exact hunit
  exact CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso _ |>.mp hunit'

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.MinimalHookSumCover.isRankProjectiveCover
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨C.cover.term_isRankProjective, C.cover.row_rank_exact, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  exact C.endomorphism_over_quotient_isIso u hu

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.exists_finiteRankProjectiveResolution_with_recorded_length
statement:
theorem exists_finiteRankProjectiveResolution_with_recorded_length
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P]
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)) :
    ∃ R : FiniteRankProjectiveResolution M,
      R.length = 3 * Fintype.card P + 2
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ofPointwisePfdFinitePoset M hM, ?_⟩
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.exists_finiteRankProjectiveResolution_of_pfd_finitePoset
statement:
theorem exists_finiteRankProjectiveResolution_of_pfd_finitePoset
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P]
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)) :
    Nonempty (FiniteRankProjectiveResolution M)
proof:
:=
  ⟨ofPointwisePfdFinitePoset M hM⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_of_pfd_finitePoset
statement:
theorem exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_of_pfd_finitePoset
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P]
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)) :
    Nonempty (MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let X : PointwisePfdModule (k := k) P := ⟨M, hM⟩
  refine ⟨⟨ofPointwisePfdFinitePoset M hM, ?_⟩⟩
  intro i
  change IsRankProjectiveCover ((iteratedMinimalHookCover X i.val).cover.quotient)
  exact (iteratedMinimalHookCover X i.val).isRankProjectiveCover

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_with_hook_sum_terms_of_pfd_finitePoset
statement:
theorem exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_with_hook_sum_terms_of_pfd_finitePoset
    {P : Type} [PartialOrder P] [Fintype P]
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)) :
    ∃ R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M),
      ∀ i, ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ t : Fin m →
        FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.RankProjectiveHookTag P,
        Nonempty (R.resolution.term i ≅
          ⨁ fun j => FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule
            (k := k) (t j))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let X : PointwisePfdModule (k := k) P := ⟨M, hM⟩
  let R : MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M) := {
    resolution := ofPointwisePfdFinitePoset M hM
    quotient_is_cover := fun i => by
      change IsRankProjectiveCover ((iteratedMinimalHookCover X i.val).cover.quotient)
      exact (iteratedMinimalHookCover X i.val).isRankProjectiveCover
  }
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro i
  let C := iteratedMinimalHookCover X i.val
  let eIndex : Fin (Fintype.card C.cover.Index) ≃ C.cover.Index :=
    (Fintype.equivFin C.cover.Index).symm
  let t : Fin (Fintype.card C.cover.Index) →
      FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.RankProjectiveHookTag P :=
    fun j => C.cover.tag (eIndex j)
  refine ⟨Fintype.card C.cover.Index, t, ?_⟩
  let eTag : (⨁ C.cover.summand) ≅
      ⨁ fun j : C.cover.Index =>
        FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule
          (k := k) (C.cover.tag j) :=
    biproduct.mapIso (fun j => eqToIso (C.cover.summand_eq_tag j))
  let F : C.cover.Index → PModule.{u,0,u} k P := fun j =>
    FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (C.cover.tag j)
  let eReindex : (⨁ fun j : Fin (Fintype.card C.cover.Index) => F (eIndex j)) ≅
      ⨁ F := biproduct.reindex eIndex F
  have hterm : R.resolution.term i = ⨁ C.cover.summand := rfl
  refine ⟨(eqToIso hterm).trans (eTag.trans eReindex.symm)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.lanMinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
statement:
theorem lanMinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (G : CoordinateGrid n)

:=
  ⟨G.lanMinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolutionObj R⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_finiteRankProjectiveResolution
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_finiteRankProjectiveResolution
    {n : ℕ} (_hn : 0 < n) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0}
      (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    Nonempty (FiniteRankProjectiveResolution M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨G, A, hA, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_pfd_finiteGridKan M hM
  let R := Classical.choice
    (exists_finiteRankProjectiveResolution_of_pfd_finitePoset A hA)
  exact ⟨CoordinateGrid.lanFiniteRankProjectiveResolutionOfReconstruction G R e⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.finitelyPresented_exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution
    {n : ℕ} (_hn : 0 < n) (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ))
    (hM : GradedFree.FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0}
      (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    Nonempty (MinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution (k := k) (M := M))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨G, A, hA, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_pfd_finiteGridKan M hM
  obtain ⟨R⟩ :=
    FiniteRankProjectiveResolution.exists_minimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution_of_pfd_finitePoset
      A hA
  obtain ⟨R'⟩ := G.lanMinimalFiniteRankProjectiveResolution R

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delayed_shift_fiber_eq
statement:
private theorem delayed_shift_fiber_eq (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    fiber (R := R) W a =
      fiber (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) (CoordinateShift.translation ε a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fiber
  congr 1
  ext g
  change (∀ i, W.grade g i ≤ a i) ↔
    (∀ i, W.grade g i - -(ε : ℝ) ≤ a i + (ε : ℝ))
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delayedShiftIso_delaySource
statement:
theorem delayedShiftIso_delaySource (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    (M : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ))
    (f : module (R := R) W ⟶ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj M) :
    (delayedShiftIso (R := R) ε W).hom ≫
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (delaySource ε W M f) = f
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext_birth W
  intro g
  let t := W.grade g
  let d := (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade g
  have e : d = CoordinateShift.translation ε t := by funext i; simp [d, t]
  have hx : (delayedShiftIso (R := R) ε W).hom.app t (birth W g) =
      (module (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))).map (eqToHom e)
        (birth (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g) := by apply Subtype.ext; rfl
  change (delaySource ε W M f).app (CoordinateShift.translation ε t)
    ((delayedShiftIso (R := R) ε W).hom.app t (birth W g)) = f.app t (birth W g)
  rw [hx]
  have hn := (delaySource ε W M f).naturality (eqToHom e)
  have hv := congrArg (fun q => q (birth (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g)) hn
  change (delaySource ε W M f).app (CoordinateShift.translation ε t)
      ((module (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))).map (eqToHom e)
        (birth (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g)) =
    M.map (eqToHom e) ((delaySource ε W M f).app d
      (birth (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g)) at hv
  rw [hv, delaySource_birth]
  change M.map (eqToHom e) (M.map (eqToHom e.symm) (f.app t (birth W g))) = _
  calc
    _ = M.map (eqToHom e.symm ≫ eqToHom e) (f.app t (birth W g)) := by
      rw [Functor.map_comp]
      rfl
    _ = _ := by simp

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.shift_map_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, CoordinateShift.translation ε b = a :=
    ⟨fun i => a i - (ε : ℝ), by funext i; simp⟩
  subst a
  exact congrArg (fun q => q.app b) h

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delayedShiftIso_postcomp_injective
statement:
theorem delayedShiftIso_postcomp_injective (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    (M : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    Function.Injective (fun f : module (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ⟶ M =>
      (delayedShiftIso ε W).hom ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map f)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  exact shift_map_injective ε ((cancel_epi (delayedShiftIso (R := R) ε W).hom).mp h)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delayedShiftIso_advance
statement:
theorem delayedShiftIso_advance (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    (delayedShiftIso (R := R) ε W).hom ≫
      (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (delayedAdvance ε W) ≫
      (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε (module W)).hom =
        CoordinateShift.transition (ε + ε) (module W)
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumInl_crossFreeLR
statement:
theorem sumInl_crossFreeLR (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (W V : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    sumInl W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫ crossFreeLR (R := R) ε W V =
      (delayedShiftIso ε W).hom ≫
        (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (sumInl (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V)
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext_birth W
  intro g
  change (crossFreeLR (R := R) ε W V).app (W.grade g)
      ((sumInl W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))).app (W.grade g) (birth W g)) =
    (sumInl (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V).app
      (CoordinateShift.translation ε (W.grade g))
      ((delayedShiftIso ε W).hom.app (W.grade g) (birth W g))
  rw [sumInl_birth]
  have hx : (delayedShiftIso (R := R) ε W).hom.app (W.grade g) (birth W g) =
      generator (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g (by intro i; simp) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  rw [hx]
  exact (sumInl_generator (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V g
    (by intro i; simp)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumInr_crossFreeLR
statement:
theorem sumInr_crossFreeLR (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (W V : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    sumInr W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ≫ crossFreeLR (R := R) ε W V =
      delayedAdvance ε V ≫
        (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (sumInr (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V)
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext_birth (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))
  intro g
  let a := (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade g
  change (crossFreeLR (R := R) ε W V).app a
      ((sumInr W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))).app a
        (birth (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g)) =
    (sumInr (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V).app (CoordinateShift.translation ε a)
      ((delayedAdvance ε V).app a (birth (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g))
  rw [sumInr_birth]
  have hx : (delayedAdvance (R := R) ε V).app a
      (birth (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g) =
      generator V g (by
        intro i
        change V.grade g i ≤ (V.grade g i - -(ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)
        linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]) := by apply Subtype.ext; rfl
  rw [hx]
  exact (sumInr_generator (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V g
    (by intro i; change V.grade g i ≤ (V.grade g i - -(ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)
        linarith [ε.coe_nonneg])).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumInl_crossFreeRL
statement:
theorem sumInl_crossFreeRL (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (W V : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    sumInl (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V ≫ crossFreeRL (R := R) ε W V =
      delayedAdvance ε W ≫
        (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (sumInl W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext_birth (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))
  intro g
  let a := (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))).grade g
  change (crossFreeRL (R := R) ε W V).app a
      ((sumInl (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V).app a
        (birth (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g)) =
    (sumInl W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))).app (CoordinateShift.translation ε a)
      ((delayedAdvance ε W).app a (birth (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g))
  rw [sumInl_birth]
  have hx : (delayedAdvance (R := R) ε W).app a
      (birth (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g) =
      generator W g (by
        intro i
        change W.grade g i ≤ (W.grade g i - -(ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)
        linarith [ε.coe_nonneg]) := by apply Subtype.ext; rfl
  rw [hx]
  exact (sumInl_generator (R := R) W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g
    (by intro i; change W.grade g i ≤ (W.grade g i - -(ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ)
        linarith [ε.coe_nonneg])).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sumInr_crossFreeRL
statement:
theorem sumInr_crossFreeRL (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (W V : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ)) :
    sumInr (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V ≫ crossFreeRL (R := R) ε W V =
      (delayedShiftIso ε V).hom ≫
        (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (sumInr W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  apply hom_ext_birth V
  intro g
  change (crossFreeRL (R := R) ε W V).app (V.grade g)
      ((sumInr (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) V).app (V.grade g) (birth V g)) =
    (sumInr W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ)))).app
      (CoordinateShift.translation ε (V.grade g))
      ((delayedShiftIso ε V).hom.app (V.grade g) (birth V g))
  rw [sumInr_birth]
  have hx : (delayedShiftIso (R := R) ε V).hom.app (V.grade g) (birth V g) =
      generator (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g (by intro i; simp) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  rw [hx]
  exact (sumInr_generator (R := R) W (V.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) g
    (by intro i; simp)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delaySource_comp_interleaving
proof:
:= by
  apply delayedShiftIso_postcomp_injective ε W ((CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj N)
  apply (cancel_mono (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε N).hom).mp
  calc
    _ = b ≫ (i.ψ ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map i.φ ≫
        (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε N).hom) := by
      simp only [Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, delayedShiftIso_delaySource]
    _ = b ≫ CoordinateShift.transition (ε + ε) N := by rw [i.ψ_φ]
    _ = CoordinateShift.transition (ε + ε) (module W) ≫
        (CoordinateShift.shift (ε + ε)).map b :=
      CoordinateShift.transition_naturality (ε + ε) b
    _ = (delayedShiftIso ε W).hom ≫
        (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map (delayedAdvance ε W) ≫
        (CoordinateShift.compIso ε ε (module W)).hom ≫
        (CoordinateShift.shift (ε + ε)).map b := by
      rw [← delayedShiftIso_advance ε W]
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc, CoordinateShift.compIso_naturality]

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.delaySource_comp_zero_iff
statement:
theorem delaySource_comp_zero_iff (ε : ℝ≥0)
    (W : GradedGenerators.{0,w} (Fin n → ℝ))
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,max u w} R (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (f : module (R := R) W ⟶ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).obj M) (ρ : M ⟶ N) :
    delaySource ε W M f ≫ ρ = 0 ↔ f ≫ (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map ρ = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact delaySource_comp_zero ε W f ρ
  · intro h
    apply delayedShiftIso_postcomp_injective ε W N
    dsimp only
    have hz : (delayedShiftIso (R := R) ε W).hom ≫
        (CoordinateShift.shift ε).map
          (0 : module (R := R) (W.shiftGrade (-(ε : ℝ))) ⟶ N) = 0 := by
      apply NatTrans.ext
      funext a
      rfl
    rw [hz]
    simpa only [Functor.map_comp, ← Category.assoc, delayedShiftIso_delaySource] using h

proof:

      (fun _ : Fin 2 => (0, 2)) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
      (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ)]

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingDistanceExamples.coarse_cells
statement:
private theorem coarse_cells {s t : ℝ} (h : cellIndex twoGrid s = cellIndex twoGrid t) :
    cellIndex oneGrid s = cellIndex oneGrid t
proof:
:= by
  have hzGrid : twoGrid 0 ≤ s ↔ twoGrid 0 ≤ t := by
    rw [← lt_cellIndex_iff, ← lt_cellIndex_iff, h]
  have hzero : twoGrid 0 = 0 := by
    change ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) = 0
    norm_num
  have hz : 0 ≤ s ↔ 0 ≤ t := by simpa only [hzero] using hzGrid
  by_cases hs : 0 ≤ s
  · rw [cellIndex_of_last_le oneGrid s hs, cellIndex_of_last_le oneGrid t (hz.mp hs)]
  · have ht : t < 0 := lt_of_not_ge (fun ht => hs (hz.mpr ht))
    rw [(cellIndex_eq_zero_iff oneGrid s).mpr (fun _ => lt_of_not_ge hs),
      (cellIndex_eq_zero_iff oneGrid t).mpr (fun _ => ht)]

  zero_left t ht
proof:
:= one_constructible.zero_left t (fun _ => by
    change t < 0
    have h := ht 0
    change t < ((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) at h
    simpa using h)
  isIso_map s t h heq := one_constructible.isIso_map s t h (coarse_cells heq)

name: TDA.Persistence.MatchingInterleavingDistanceExamples.step_finite

  by_cases ht : 0 ≤ t
  · rw [cellIndex_of_last_le oneGrid t ht]
    change FiniteDimensional ℚ ℚ
    infer_instance
  · rw [(cellIndex_eq_zero_iff oneGrid t).mpr (fun _ => lt_of_not_ge ht)]
    change FiniteDimensional ℚ (0 : ModuleCat ℚ)
    have : Subsingleton (0 : ModuleCat ℚ) :=
      ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mp (isZero_zero (ModuleCat ℚ))
    infer_instance

    ((inner_featureAt σ p q).trans (kernel_eq_gaussian σ p q)), kernel_eq_gaussian]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelStabilityExamples.feature_distance

      ‖featureAt 1 (0, 2) - featureAt 1 (0, 3)‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      ‖featureAt 1 (0, 2) - featureAt 1 (0, 3)‖ ≤ √2
proof:
:= by

  · simpa [toLp_distance] using norm_featureAt_sub_le_euclidean 1 (0, 2) (0, 3)
  · have h := norm_featureAt_sub_le 1 (0, 2) (0, 3)
