name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelStabilityExamples.bandwidth_negative_control
statement:
theorem bandwidth_negative_control :
    ‖featureAt (1 / 2) (0, 2) - featureAt (1 / 2) (0, 3)‖ ^ 2 = 2 - 2 * Real.exp (-2) ∧
      ‖((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)) - (0, 3)‖ ^ 2 < 2 - 2 * Real.exp (-2) ∧
      ¬ ‖featureAt (1 / 2) (0, 2) - featureAt (1 / 2) (0, 3)‖ ≤ ‖((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)) - (0, 3)‖ ∧
      ‖featureAt (1 / 2) (0, 2) - featureAt (1 / 2) (0, 3)‖ ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ‖featureAt (1 / 2) (0, 2) - featureAt (1 / 2) (0, 3)‖ ^ 2 =
      2 - 2 * Real.exp (-2) := by
    rw [featureAt_sub_sq]
    norm_num [kernel]
  have hlt : ‖((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)) - (0, 3)‖ ^ 2 < 2 - 2 * Real.exp (-2) := by
    rw [max_distance]
    linarith [exp_neg_two_lt]
  refine ⟨hsq, hlt, fun h => ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h0 := norm_nonneg (featureAt (1 / 2) (0, 2) - featureAt (1 / 2) (0, 3))
    rw [max_distance] at h hlt
    nlinarith
  · have h := norm_featureAt_sub_le_euclidean (1 / 2) (0, 2) (0, 3)
    rw [toLp_distance] at h
    norm_num at h
    exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelStabilityExamples.zero_bandwidth
statement:
theorem zero_bandwidth :
    featureAt 0 (0, 2) = featureAt 0 (0, 3) ∧
      ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)) - WithLp.toLp 2 ((0 : ℝ), (3 : ℝ))‖ / |(0 : ℝ)| = 0 ∧
      √2 / |(0 : ℝ)| * ‖((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)) - (0, 3)‖ = 0 ∧
      ‖featureAt 0 (0, 2) - featureAt 0 (0, 3)‖ ≤
        ‖WithLp.toLp 2 ((0 : ℝ), (2 : ℝ)) - WithLp.toLp 2 ((0 : ℝ), (3 : ℝ))‖ / |(0 : ℝ)|
proof:
:= by
  have h : ‖featureAt 0 (0, 2) - featureAt 0 (0, 3)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
    rw [featureAt_sub_sq]
    simp [kernel]
  refine ⟨sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp h)),
    by simp, by simp, norm_featureAt_sub_le_euclidean 0 (0, 2) (0, 3)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelStabilityExamples.pairMatching_cost
statement:
theorem pairMatching_cost :
    pairMatching.totalFiniteCost (single (0, 2)) (single (0, 3)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, pairMatching, single, Prod.norm_def]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelStabilityExamples.matched_stability
statement:
theorem matched_stability :
    ‖embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 2)) - embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 3))‖ ≤
        2 + √2 ∧
      ‖embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 2)) -
          embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 3))‖ ≤
        (2 + √2) * finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost (single (0, 2)) (single (0, 3)) ∧
      ‖embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 2)) -
          embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 3))‖ ^ 2 = 2 - 2 * Real.exp (-1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ∀ i, (single (0, 2) i).1 < (single (0, 2) i).2 := fun _ => by norm_num [single]
  have hy : ∀ j, (single (0, 3) j).1 < (single (0, 3) j).2 := fun _ => by norm_num [single]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, single_distance.1⟩
  · have h := norm_embedding_sub_le_matching 1 zero_le_one zero_le_one clippedWeight
      pairMatching _ _ hx hy
    rwa [pairMatching_cost, stabilityConstant_one, mul_one] at h
  · have h := norm_embedding_sub_le_finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost 1 zero_le_one zero_le_one
      clippedWeight _ _ hx hy
    rwa [stabilityConstant_one] at h

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelStabilityExamples.emptyMatching_cost
statement:
theorem emptyMatching_cost :
    emptyMatching.totalFiniteCost (single (0, 2)) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost, emptyMatching, single]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelStabilityExamples.unmatched_stability
statement:
theorem unmatched_stability :
    ‖embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 2))‖ ≤ 2 + √2 ∧
      ‖embedding 1 clippedWeight (single (0, 2))‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := norm_embedding_sub_le_matching 1 zero_le_one zero_le_one clippedWeight
    emptyMatching (single (0, 2)) (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ)
    (fun _ => by norm_num [single]) (fun j => j.elim0)
  rw [emptyMatching_cost, stabilityConstant_one, mul_one, diagonal_embedding.2,
    sub_zero] at h
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  rw [embedding_eq_finiteFeatureSum]
  simp [finiteFeatureSum, single, weightedFeature, norm_featureAt, weight_two]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelStabilityExamples.diagonal_point
statement:
theorem diagonal_point :
    weightedFeature 1 clippedWeight (1, 1) = 0 ∧
      stabilityConstant 1 1 1 * (diagonalCost (1, 1)).toReal = 0 ∧
      ‖weightedFeature 1 clippedWeight (1, 1)‖ ≤
        stabilityConstant 1 1 1 * (diagonalCost (1, 1)).toReal
proof:
:=
  ⟨weightedFeature_diagonal 1 clippedWeight 1, by simp,
    norm_weightedFeature_le_diagonalCost 1 zero_le_one clippedWeight (1, 1)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelStabilityExamples.diagramEmbedding_singleton
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagramEmbedding_eq_sum]
  have hp : finitePart (singletonDiagram b d h).points = {(b, d)} := rfl
  rw [hp, Multiset.map_singleton, Multiset.sum_singleton]
  simp [embedding, finiteFeatureSum, single]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelStabilityExamples.card_singleton
statement:
private theorem card_singleton (b d : ℝ) (h : b ≠ d) :
    Fintype.card (singletonDiagram b d h).finiteOccurrences = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : finitePart (singletonDiagram b d h).points = {(b, d)} := rfl
  classical
  rw [Fintype.card_eq_nat_card]
  change Nat.card (finitePart (singletonDiagram b d h).points) = 1
  rw [hp, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Multiset.card_coe, Multiset.card_singleton]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelStabilityExamples.diagram_stability
statement:
theorem diagram_stability :
    diagramTwo.IsPositive ∧ diagramThree.IsPositive ∧ bottleneck diagramTwo diagramThree < ⊤ ∧
      Fintype.card diagramTwo.finiteOccurrences +
        Fintype.card diagramThree.finiteOccurrences = 2 ∧
      ‖diagramEmbedding 1 clippedWeight diagramTwo -
          diagramEmbedding 1 clippedWeight diagramThree‖ ≤
        (2 + √2) * 2 * (bottleneck diagramTwo diagramThree).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hD : diagramTwo.IsPositive := by
    intro p hp
    simp only [diagramTwo, singletonDiagram, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hp
    subst hp
    norm_num
  have hE : diagramThree.IsPositive := by
    intro p hp
    simp only [diagramThree, singletonDiagram, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hp
    subst hp
    norm_num
  have hfin : bottleneck diagramTwo diagramThree < ⊤ :=
    (bottleneck_lt_top_iff _ _).mpr rfl
  have hcard : Fintype.card diagramTwo.finiteOccurrences +
      Fintype.card diagramThree.finiteOccurrences = 2 := by
    rw [diagramTwo, diagramThree, card_singleton, card_singleton]
  refine ⟨hD, hE, hfin, hcard, ?_⟩
  have h := norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck 1 zero_le_one zero_le_one
    clippedWeight _ _ hD hE hfin
  rwa [hcard, stabilityConstant_one, Nat.cast_ofNat] at h

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernelStabilityExamples.second_level
statement:
theorem second_level :
    gaussianDiagramKernel 1 1 clippedWeight diagramTwo diagramTwo = 1 ∧
      gaussianDiagramKernel 1 1 clippedWeight diagramTwo diagramThree =
        Real.exp (-(2 - 2 * Real.exp (-1 / 2)) / 2) ∧
      |1 - Real.exp (-(2 - 2 * Real.exp (-1 / 2)) / 2)| ≤
        ‖diagramEmbedding 1 clippedWeight diagramTwo -
          diagramEmbedding 1 clippedWeight diagramThree‖ / 1 ∧
      ‖diagramGaussianFeature 1 1 clippedWeight diagramTwo -
          diagramGaussianFeature 1 1 clippedWeight diagramThree‖ ≤
        ‖diagramEmbedding 1 clippedWeight diagramTwo -
          diagramEmbedding 1 clippedWeight diagramThree‖
proof:
:= by
  have hself : gaussianDiagramKernel 1 1 clippedWeight diagramTwo diagramTwo = 1 := by
    simp [gaussianDiagramKernel]
  have hcross : gaussianDiagramKernel 1 1 clippedWeight diagramTwo diagramThree =
      Real.exp (-(2 - 2 * Real.exp (-1 / 2)) / 2) := by
    have h := gaussianDiagramGram_consumer.2
    rw [gaussianGram_diagramEmbedding_apply] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨hself, hcross, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := abs_gaussianDiagramKernel_sub_le 1 1 clippedWeight diagramTwo diagramTwo
      diagramThree
    rwa [hself, hcross, abs_one] at h
  · simpa using norm_diagramGaussianFeature_sub_le 1 1 clippedWeight diagramTwo diagramThree

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.lan_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem lan_finiteDimensional (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k G.Point)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] (a : Fin n → ℝ) :
    FiniteDimensional k ((G.lan.obj M).obj a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ha : G.HasLowerPoint a
  · exact (G.appIso M a ha).symm.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  · let := ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero (G.isZero_obj_of_not_hasLowerPoint M a ha)
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.lan_isPointwiseShortExact
statement:
theorem lan_isPointwiseShortExact (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) :
    IsPointwiseShortExact (G.lan.map ι) (G.lan.map π) where
  injective a
proof:
:= by
    classical
    intro x y hxy
    by_cases ha : G.HasLowerPoint a
    · let eL := (G.appIso L a ha).toLinearEquiv
      let eM := (G.appIso M a ha).toLinearEquiv
      apply eL.injective
      apply hs.injective (G.floor a ha)
      exact (G.appIso_map_apply ι a ha x).symm.trans
        ((congrArg eM hxy).trans (G.appIso_map_apply ι a ha y))
    · exact (G.eq_zero_of_not_hasLowerPoint L a ha x).trans
        (G.eq_zero_of_not_hasLowerPoint L a ha y).symm
  surjective a := by
    classical
    intro z
    by_cases ha : G.HasLowerPoint a
    · let eM := (G.appIso M a ha).toLinearEquiv
      let eN := (G.appIso N a ha).toLinearEquiv
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hs.surjective (G.floor a ha) (eN z)
      refine ⟨eM.symm m, ?_⟩
      apply eN.injective
      exact (G.appIso_map_apply π a ha (eM.symm m)).trans
        ((congrArg (π.app (G.floor a ha)).hom (eM.apply_symm_apply m)).trans hm)
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      exact (map_zero _).trans (G.eq_zero_of_not_hasLowerPoint N a ha z).symm
  range_eq_ker a := by
    classical
    ext z
    change (∃ x, ((G.lan.map ι).app a).hom x = z) ↔ ((G.lan.map π).app a).hom z = 0
    by_cases ha : G.HasLowerPoint a
    · let eL := (G.appIso L a ha).toLinearEquiv
      let eM := (G.appIso M a ha).toLinearEquiv
      let eN := (G.appIso N a ha).toLinearEquiv
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
        apply eN.injective
        have hx : (ι.app (G.floor a ha)).hom (eL x) ∈
            LinearMap.range (ι.app (G.floor a ha)).hom := ⟨eL x, rfl⟩
        rw [hs.range_eq_ker] at hx
        exact (G.appIso_map_apply π a ha (((G.lan.map ι).app a).hom x)).trans
          ((congrArg (π.app (G.floor a ha)).hom (G.appIso_map_apply ι a ha x)).trans
            (hx.trans (map_zero eN).symm))
      · intro hz
        have hz₀ : (π.app (G.floor a ha)).hom (eM z) = 0 :=
          (G.appIso_map_apply π a ha z).symm.trans ((congrArg eN hz).trans (map_zero eN))
        have hr : eM z ∈ LinearMap.range (ι.app (G.floor a ha)).hom := by
          rw [hs.range_eq_ker]
          exact hz₀
        obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hr
        refine ⟨eL.symm x, ?_⟩
        apply eM.injective
        exact (G.appIso_map_apply ι a ha (eL.symm x)).trans
          ((congrArg (ι.app (G.floor a ha)).hom (eL.apply_symm_apply x)).trans hx)
    · constructor
      · intro _
        exact G.eq_zero_of_not_hasLowerPoint N a ha _
      · intro _
        exact ⟨0, (map_zero _).trans (G.eq_zero_of_not_hasLowerPoint M a ha z).symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.lan_lift_kernel
statement:
theorem lan_lift_kernel (hs : IsRankExact ι π) {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (z : (G.lan.obj N).obj a) (hz : structureMapLinear (G.lan.obj N) hab z = 0) :
    ∃ m : (G.lan.obj M).obj a,
      ((G.lan.map π).app a).hom m = z ∧ structureMapLinear (G.lan.obj M) hab m = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ha : G.HasLowerPoint a
  · have hb := G.hasLowerPoint_mono hab ha
    let eMa := (G.appIso M a ha).toLinearEquiv
    let eMb := (G.appIso M b hb).toLinearEquiv
    let eNa := (G.appIso N a ha).toLinearEquiv
    let eNb := (G.appIso N b hb).toLinearEquiv
    have hz₀ : structureMapLinear N (G.floor_mono hab ha hb) (eNa z) = 0 :=
      (G.appIso_structureMap_apply N hab ha hb z).symm.trans
        ((congrArg eNb hz).trans (map_zero eNb))
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hdie⟩ := hs.lift_kernel (G.floor_mono hab ha hb) (eNa z) hz₀
    refine ⟨eMa.symm m, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply eNa.injective
      exact (G.appIso_map_apply π a ha (eMa.symm m)).trans
        ((congrArg (π.app (G.floor a ha)).hom (eMa.apply_symm_apply m)).trans hm)
    · apply eMb.injective
      exact (G.appIso_structureMap_apply M hab ha hb (eMa.symm m)).trans
        ((congrArg (structureMapLinear M (G.floor_mono hab ha hb))
          (eMa.apply_symm_apply m)).trans (hdie.trans (map_zero eMb).symm))
  · exact ⟨0, (map_zero _).trans (G.eq_zero_of_not_hasLowerPoint N a ha z).symm, map_zero _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.lan_isRankExact
statement: theorem lan_isRankExact (hs : IsRankExact ι π) : IsRankExact (G.lan.map ι) (G.lan.map π)
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hs.finiteDimensional
  refine
    { toIsPointwiseShortExact := G.lan_isPointwiseShortExact hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact
      finiteDimensional := fun a => G.lan_finiteDimensional M a
      rank_add := ?_ }
  intro a b hab
  let : FiniteDimensional k ((G.lan.obj M).obj a) := G.lan_finiteDimensional M a
  exact ((G.lan_isPointwiseShortExact hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact).rank_add_iff_lift_kernel hab).mpr
    (G.lan_lift_kernel hs hab)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.pfd_finitelyPresented_of_finite_poset
statement:
theorem pfd_finitelyPresented_of_finite_poset
    (A : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hA : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj p)) :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj p) := hA
  let W : GradedGenerators.{0,0} P :=
    ⟨Σ p : P, Fin (Module.finrank k (A.obj p)), fun g => g.1⟩
  letI : Fintype W.Carrier := inferInstance
  let B (p : P) := Module.finBasis k (A.obj p)
  let cover : module (R := k) W ⟶ A :=
    GradedFree.lift W A (fun g => B g.1 g.2)
  have cover_birth (p : P) (i : Fin (Module.finrank k (A.obj p))) :
      (cover.app p).hom (GradedFree.birth W ⟨p, i⟩) = B p i := by
    simpa [cover, W, B] using
      (GradedFree.lift_birth W A (fun g => B g.1 g.2) ⟨p, i⟩)
  have cover_surjective (p : P) : Function.Surjective (cover.app p).hom := by
    intro x
    let y : (module (R := k) W).obj p :=
      ∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank k (A.obj p)),
        (B p).repr x i • GradedFree.birth W ⟨p, i⟩
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    dsimp [y]
    rw [map_sum]
    trans ∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank k (A.obj p)), (B p).repr x i • B p i
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [map_smul, cover_birth]
    · exact (B p).sum_repr x
  have cover_finite (p : P) :
      FiniteDimensional k ((module (R := k) W).obj p) :=
    GradedFree.finiteDimensional_fiber W p
  let Y : GradedGenerators.{0,0} P :=
    ⟨Σ p : P, Fin (Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (cover.app p).hom)), fun g => g.1⟩
  letI : Fintype Y.Carrier := inferInstance
  let C (p : P) := Module.finBasis k (LinearMap.ker (cover.app p).hom)
  let rel : module (R := k) Y ⟶ module (R := k) W :=
    GradedFree.lift Y (module (R := k) W) (fun g => (C g.1 g.2).val)
  have rel_birth (p : P)
      (i : Fin (Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (cover.app p).hom))) :
      (rel.app p).hom (GradedFree.birth Y ⟨p, i⟩) = (C p i).val := by
    simpa [rel, Y, C] using
      (GradedFree.lift_birth Y (module (R := k) W)
        (fun g => (C g.1 g.2).val) ⟨p, i⟩)
  let D : Presentation.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) :=
    ⟨W, Y, rel⟩
  have rel_comp_cover : rel ≫ cover = 0 := by
    apply GradedFree.hom_ext_birth Y
    intro g
    change (cover.app g.1).hom
      ((rel.app g.1).hom (GradedFree.birth Y g)) = 0
    rw [rel_birth]
    exact (C g.1 g.2).property
  have relation_range_eq_kernel (p : P) :
      LinearMap.range (rel.app p).hom = LinearMap.ker (cover.app p).hom := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
      have hz := congrArg (fun f : (module (R := k) Y).obj p ⟶ A.obj p => f.hom x)
        (NatTrans.congr_app rel_comp_cover p)
      change (cover.app p).hom ((rel.app p).hom x) = 0 at hz
      exact hz
    · intro y hy
      let Cy := Module.finBasis k (LinearMap.ker (cover.app p).hom)
      let y' : LinearMap.ker (cover.app p).hom := ⟨y, hy⟩
      let x : (module (R := k) Y).obj p :=
        ∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (cover.app p).hom)),
          Cy.repr y' i • GradedFree.birth Y ⟨p, i⟩
      refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
      dsimp [x]
      rw [map_sum]
      trans ∑ i : Fin (Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (cover.app p).hom)),
          Cy.repr y' i • (Cy i).val
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [map_smul, rel_birth]
      · simpa only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul] using
          congrArg Subtype.val (Cy.sum_repr y')
  let q : D.presented ⟶ A := D.desc cover rel_comp_cover
  have q_cover : D.cover ≫ q = cover := D.cover_desc cover rel_comp_cover
  have q_surjective (p : P) : Function.Surjective (q.app p).hom := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := cover_surjective p x
    refine ⟨(D.cover.app p).hom y, ?_⟩
    have he := congrArg (fun f : (module (R := k) W).obj p ⟶ A.obj p => f.hom y)
      (NatTrans.congr_app q_cover p)
    change (q.app p).hom ((D.cover.app p).hom y) = (cover.app p).hom y at he
    exact he.trans hy
  have q_injective (p : P) : Function.Injective (q.app p).hom := by
    intro x y hxy
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := D.cover_surjective p x
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ := D.cover_surjective p y
    have hxy₀ : (cover.app p).hom x₀ = (cover.app p).hom y₀ := by
      calc
        (cover.app p).hom x₀ = (q.app p).hom ((D.cover.app p).hom x₀) := by
          have he := congrArg (fun f : (module (R := k) W).obj p ⟶ A.obj p => f.hom x₀)
            (NatTrans.congr_app q_cover p)
          exact he.symm
        _ = (q.app p).hom x := by rw [hx₀]
        _ = (q.app p).hom y := hxy
        _ = (q.app p).hom ((D.cover.app p).hom y₀) := by rw [hy₀]
        _ = (cover.app p).hom y₀ := by
          have he := congrArg (fun f : (module (R := k) W).obj p ⟶ A.obj p => f.hom y₀)
            (NatTrans.congr_app q_cover p)
          exact he
    have hker : x₀ - y₀ ∈ LinearMap.ker (cover.app p).hom := by
      change (cover.app p).hom (x₀ - y₀) = 0
      rw [map_sub, hxy₀, sub_self]
    have hrel : x₀ - y₀ ∈ LinearMap.range (rel.app p).hom :=
      (relation_range_eq_kernel p).symm ▸ hker
    have hcoverzero :=
      (D.cover_eq_zero_iff_mem_relation_range p (x₀ - y₀)).2 hrel
    have hcovereq : (D.cover.app p).hom x₀ = (D.cover.app p).hom y₀ := by
      exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (by
        change (D.cover.app p).hom (x₀ - y₀) = 0 at hcoverzero
        simpa only [map_sub] using hcoverzero))
    rw [← hx₀, ← hy₀, hcovereq]
  letI (p : P) : IsIso (q.app p) :=
    (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective _).mpr ⟨q_injective p, q_surjective p⟩
  letI : IsIso q := NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app q
  refine ⟨D, ?_, ⟨asIso q⟩⟩
  exact ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_lan_of_finiteGrid
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_lan_of_finiteGrid
    (G : CoordinateGrid n)
    {A : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point}
    (hA : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := G.Point) A) :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) (G.lan.obj A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hA
  letI : Finite D.generators.Carrier := hD.1
  letI : Finite D.relations.Carrier := hD.2
  letI : Fintype D.generators.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI : Fintype D.relations.Carrier := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let eW := G.lanFreeIso (k := k) D.generators
  let eY := G.lanFreeIso (k := k) D.relations
  let φ :
      module (R := k) (G.embeddedGenerators D.relations) ⟶
        module (R := k) (G.embeddedGenerators D.generators) :=
    eY.inv ≫ G.lan.map D.relationMap ≫ eW.hom
  let D' : Presentation.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) :=
    ⟨G.embeddedGenerators D.generators, G.embeddedGenerators D.relations, φ⟩
  have hSquare : φ ≫ eW.symm.hom = eY.symm.hom ≫ G.lan.map D.relationMap := by
    simp [φ, Category.assoc]
  let quotientIso :=
    cokernel.mapIso (f := φ) (G.lan.map D.relationMap) eY.symm eW.symm hSquare ≪≫
      (PreservesCokernel.iso G.lan D.relationMap).symm
  have hD' : D'.IsFinite := by
    change Finite D'.generators.Carrier ∧ Finite D'.relations.Carrier
    exact ⟨hD.1, hD.2⟩
  refine ⟨D', hD', ?_⟩
  exact ⟨quotientIso ≪≫ G.lan.mapIso e⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_finiteHookRankExactCoverKernel
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_exists_finiteHookRankExactCoverKernel
    {M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin n → ℝ)}
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := k) (P := Fin n → ℝ) M) :
    ∃ (G : CoordinateGrid n) (A : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point)
      (hA : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj p))
      (e : G.lan.obj A ≅ M),
      IsRankExact
        (G.lan.map (kernel.ι (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)) ≫
          (G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).hom)
        ((G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).inv ≫
          G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) ≫ e.hom) ∧
      IsRankProjective (⨁ fun t => G.embeddedCoverFamily A t) ∧
      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0}
        (kernel ((G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A).inv ≫
          G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) ≫ e.hom))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G, A, hA, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
    TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_exists_pfd_finiteGridKan M hM
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj p) := hA
  let c := G.finiteHookDeflationLanIso A
  let hsGrid := FiniteHookDeflation.rankExact A
  let hsShort := G.lan_isPointwiseShortExact hsGrid.toIsPointwiseShortExact
  let hsLan := G.lan_isRankExact hsGrid
  let left := G.lan.map (kernel.ι (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)) ≫ c.hom
  let right := c.inv ≫ G.lan.map (FiniteHookDeflation.π A) ≫ e.hom
  have hsActualShort : IsPointwiseShortExact left right := by
    simpa [left, right, c, Category.assoc] using
      hsShort.of_iso (Iso.refl _) c e
  have hsActual : IsRankExact left right := by
    simpa [left, right, c, Category.assoc] using
      hsLan.of_iso (Iso.refl _) c e
  have hGridKernel :
      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := G.Point)
        (kernel (FiniteHookDeflation.π A)) :=
    GradedFree.pfd_finitelyPresented_of_finite_poset
      (kernel (FiniteHookDeflation.π A))
      (FiniteHookDeflation.kernel_finiteDimensional A)
  have hLanKernel := GradedFree.finitelyPresented_lan_of_finiteGrid G hGridKernel
  have hActualKernel :=
    GradedFree.finitelyPresented_of_iso hLanKernel
      (IsPointwiseShortExact.kernelIso hsActualShort)
  refine ⟨G, A, hA, e, hsActual, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact
      (G.lan_isRankProjective (FiniteHookDeflation.module A)
        (FiniteHookDeflation.isRankProjective A)).of_iso c
  · exact hActualKernel

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.distance_le_matching_cost
statement:
theorem distance_le_matching_cost (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hD : D.IsPositive) (hE : E.IsPositive)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching D.finiteOccurrences E.finiteOccurrences
      D.essentialOccurrences E.essentialOccurrences) :
    realInterleavingDistance (realize (k := k) D) (realize E) ≤
      M.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1)
proof:
:= by
  let C := M.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1)
  have hC : C ≠ ⊤ := ne_of_lt (occurrenceMatching_cost_lt_top _ _ _ _ M)
  have hc : C ≤ (C.toNNReal : ℝ≥0∞) := (ENNReal.coe_toNNReal hC).symm.le
  have i := matchingInterleaving (k := k) D E hD hE C.toNNReal M hc
  simpa only [ENNReal.coe_toNNReal hC] using i.distance_le

name: TDA.Persistence.RealBarcode.distance_le_bottleneck
statement:
theorem distance_le_bottleneck (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hD : D.IsPositive) (hE : E.IsPositive) :
    realInterleavingDistance (realize (k := k) D) (realize E) ≤ bottleneck D E
proof:
:= by
  exact le_iInf fun M => distance_le_matching_cost D E hD hE M

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.distance_le_bottleneck
statement:
theorem distance_le_bottleneck (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (d : Fin m ↪o ℝ)
    (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M) (hN : IsConstructible d N)
    (hfdM : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c i)))
    (hfdN : ∀ j, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj (d j))) :
    realInterleavingDistance M N ≤
      bottleneck (moduleDiagram c M hfdM) (moduleDiagram d N hfdN)
proof:
:= by
  rw [realInterleavingDistance_congr (barcodeRealizationIso c M hM hfdM)
    (barcodeRealizationIso d N hN hfdN)]
  exact RealBarcode.distance_le_bottleneck _ _ (moduleDiagram_isPositive c M hfdM)
    (moduleDiagram_isPositive d N hfdN)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation_succ
statement:
theorem sampleTranslation_succ (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (δ : ℝ≥0) (i : Fin n) :
    (sampleTranslation c δ i).succ = cellIndex c (c i + (δ : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  have hp := (lt_cellIndex_iff c i (c i + (δ : ℝ))).mpr
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg)
  change (cellIndex c (c i + (δ : ℝ))).val - 1 + 1 = _
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.le_sampleTranslation
statement:
theorem le_sampleTranslation (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (δ : ℝ≥0) (i : Fin n) :
    i ≤ sampleTranslation c δ i
proof:
:= by
  have hp := (lt_cellIndex_iff c i (c i + (δ : ℝ))).mpr
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg)
  change i.val ≤ (cellIndex c (c i + (δ : ℝ))).val - 1
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation_value_le
statement:
theorem sampleTranslation_value_le (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (δ : ℝ≥0) (i : Fin n) :
    c (sampleTranslation c δ i) ≤ c i + (δ : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (lt_cellIndex_iff c _ _).mp
  rw [← sampleTranslation_succ c δ i]
  exact Nat.lt_succ_self _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_sampleTranslation
statement:
theorem cellIndex_sampleTranslation (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (δ : ℝ≥0) (i : Fin n) :
    cellIndex c (c (sampleTranslation c δ i)) = cellIndex c (c i + (δ : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cellIndex_critical, sampleTranslation_succ]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem sampleTranslation_zero (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) :
    sampleTranslation c 0 = OrderHom.id
proof:
:= by
  apply DFunLike.ext
  intro i
  apply Fin.succ_injective n
  rw [sampleTranslation_succ]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sampleTranslation_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem sampleTranslation_last (c : Fin (n + 1) ↪o ℝ) (δ : ℝ≥0) :
    sampleTranslation c δ (Fin.last n) = Fin.last n
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (Fin.le_last _) (le_sampleTranslation c δ _)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.critical_structureMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem critical_structureMap_eq_zero (hA : IsConstructible c A) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hz : transition δ A = 0) (i : Fin n) :
    structureMap (reindex c.toOrderHom A) (le_sampleTranslation c δ i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hv := sampleTranslation_value_le c δ i
  have : IsIso (structureMap A hv) := hA.isIso_map _ _ hv (cellIndex_sampleTranslation c δ i)
  apply (cancel_mono (structureMap A hv)).mp
  change structureMap A (c.monotone (le_sampleTranslation c δ i)) ≫ structureMap A hv =
    (0 : A.obj (c i) ⟶ A.obj (c (sampleTranslation c δ i))) ≫ structureMap A hv
  rw [zero_comp, structureMap_comp]
  exact congrArg (fun f => f.app (c i)) hz

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.critical_translationTrivial
statement:
theorem critical_translationTrivial (hM : IsConstructible c M) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hz : transition δ M = 0) :
    TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation c δ) (le_sampleTranslation c δ)
      (reindex c.toOrderHom M)
proof: := critical_structureMap_eq_zero hM δ hz

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.translationTrivial_of_iso
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  apply (cancel_epi (e.hom.app i)).mp
  rw [comp_zero]
  change e.hom.app i ≫ C.map (homOfLE (hθ i)) = 0
  rw [← e.hom.naturality]
  change structureMap B (hθ i) ≫ e.hom.app (θ i) = 0
  rw [hB i, zero_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.criticalKernel_translationTrivial
statement:
theorem criticalKernel_translationTrivial (hM : IsConstructible c M)
    (hN : IsConstructible c N) (f : M ⟶ N) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hz : transition δ (kernel f) = 0) :
    TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation c δ) (le_sampleTranslation c δ)
      (finiteKernel (reindexNatTrans c.toOrderHom f))
proof:
:=
  translationTrivial_of_iso _ _ (criticalKernelIso c f)
    (critical_translationTrivial (hM.kernel hN f) δ hz)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.criticalCokernel_translationTrivial
statement:
theorem criticalCokernel_translationTrivial (hM : IsConstructible c M)
    (hN : IsConstructible c N) (f : M ⟶ N) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hz : transition δ (cokernel f) = 0) :
    TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation c δ) (le_sampleTranslation c δ)
      (finiteCokernel (reindexNatTrans c.toOrderHom f))
proof:
:=
  translationTrivial_of_iso _ _ (criticalCokernelIso c f)
    (critical_translationTrivial (hM.cokernel hN f) δ hz)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.interleaving_critical_defects
statement:
theorem interleaving_critical_defects {m : ℕ} {d : Fin m ↪o ℝ} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (hM : IsConstructible c M) (hN : IsConstructible d N) (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    let e := commonGrid c (shiftGrid ε d)
    IsConstructible e (kernel i.φ) ∧ IsConstructible e (cokernel i.φ) ∧
      TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation e (ε + ε)) (le_sampleTranslation e (ε + ε))
        (finiteKernel (reindexNatTrans e.toOrderHom i.φ)) ∧
      TranslationTrivial (sampleTranslation e (ε + ε)) (le_sampleTranslation e (ε + ε))
        (finiteCokernel (reindexNatTrans e.toOrderHom i.φ))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hMe, hNe⟩ := common_shift_constructible hM hN ε
  exact ⟨hMe.kernel hNe i.φ, hMe.cokernel hNe i.φ,
    criticalKernel_translationTrivial hMe hNe i.φ (ε + ε) i.kernel_transition_eq_zero,
    criticalCokernel_translationTrivial hMe hNe i.φ (ε + ε) i.cokernel_transition_eq_zero⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.inducedOccurrenceMatching_bounds
statement:
theorem inducedOccurrenceMatching_bounds : RealMatchingBounds δK δC
    (inducedOccurrenceMatching c M N hfdM hfdN hM hN f δK δC hk hc)
proof:
:= by
  let : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k ((reindex c.toOrderHom M).obj i) := hfdM
  let : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k ((reindex c.toOrderHom N).obj i) := hfdN
  exact FiniteBarcode.RealInduced.matching_bounds c (reindexNatTrans c.toOrderHom f) δK δC
    (criticalKernel_translationTrivial hM hN f δK hk)
    (criticalCokernel_translationTrivial hM hN f δC hc)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.interleaving_shifted_induced_matching
statement:
theorem interleaving_shifted_induced_matching {c : Fin n ↪o ℝ} {d : Fin m ↪o ℝ}
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ} (hM : IsConstructible c M) (hN : IsConstructible d N)
    (hfdM : ∀ j, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (c j)))
    (hfdN : ∀ j, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj (d j)))
    {ε : ℝ≥0} (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) :
    ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching (moduleDiagram c M hfdM).finiteOccurrences
        (translateDiagram (moduleDiagram d N hfdN) (-(ε : ℝ))).finiteOccurrences
        (moduleDiagram c M hfdM).essentialOccurrences
        (translateDiagram (moduleDiagram d N hfdN) (-(ε : ℝ))).essentialOccurrences,
      RealMatchingBounds (ε + ε) (ε + ε) A
proof:
:= by
  let e := commonGrid c (shiftGrid ε d)
  obtain ⟨hMe, hNe⟩ := common_shift_constructible hM hN ε
  let hMeFD := fun j => finiteDimensional_of_isConstructible M hM hfdM (e j)
  let hNeFD := fun j => finiteDimensional_of_isConstructible ((shift ε).obj N) (hN.shift ε)
    (finiteDimensional_shiftedCritical d N hfdN ε) (e j)
  let A := inducedOccurrenceMatching e M ((shift ε).obj N) hMeFD hNeFD hMe hNe i.φ
    (ε + ε) (ε + ε) i.kernel_transition_eq_zero i.cokernel_transition_eq_zero
  have H : ∃ B : OccurrenceMatching (moduleDiagram e M hMeFD).finiteOccurrences
      (moduleDiagram e ((shift ε).obj N) hNeFD).finiteOccurrences
      (moduleDiagram e M hMeFD).essentialOccurrences
      (moduleDiagram e ((shift ε).obj N) hNeFD).essentialOccurrences,
      RealMatchingBounds (ε + ε) (ε + ε) B :=
    ⟨A, inducedOccurrenceMatching_bounds e M ((shift ε).obj N) hMeFD hNeFD hMe hNe i.φ
      (ε + ε) (ε + ε) i.kernel_transition_eq_zero i.cokernel_transition_eq_zero⟩
  rw [moduleDiagram_refinement M (refines_commonGrid_left c (shiftGrid ε d)) hM hfdM,
    moduleDiagram_shift_refinement d e N hN hfdN ε (refines_commonGrid_right c (shiftGrid ε d))] at H
  exact H

name: TDA.Persistence.IntervalCompatibility.evaluation_surjective
statement: theorem evaluation_surjective (t : ℝ) : Function.Surjective (evaluation t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro q
  let v : SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) ({t} : Set ℝ) t :=
    ⟨q, by simp [SupportInterval.fiber]⟩
  refine ⟨DirectSum.lof ℚ ℝ (fun j => (singletonModule j).obj t) t v, ?_⟩
  change ((DirectSum.component ℚ ℝ (fun j => (singletonModule j).obj t) t
    (DirectSum.lof ℚ ℝ (fun j => (singletonModule j).obj t) t v) :
      SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) ({t} : Set ℝ) t) : ℚ) = q
  simp [v]

name: TDA.Persistence.IntervalCompatibility.evaluation_injective
statement: theorem evaluation_injective (t : ℝ) : Function.Injective (evaluation t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x y h
  change DirectSum ℝ (fun j => (singletonModule j).obj t) at x y
  apply DFinsupp.ext
  intro j
  by_cases hj : j = t
  · subst j
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact h
  · have htj : t ∉ ({j} : Set ℝ) := by simpa using (Ne.symm hj)
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := ℚ) ({j} : Set ℝ) htj (x j)).trans
      (SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := ℚ) ({j} : Set ℝ) htj (y j)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.IntervalCompatibility.evaluation_strict_map_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hz : structureMapLinear (singletonModule t) h.le = 0 :=
    (SupportInterval.structureMap_eq_zero_iff (k := ℚ) ({t} : Set ℝ)
      Set.ordConnected_singleton h.le).mpr (by
        intro hh
        exact (ne_of_lt h) (by simpa using hh.1))
  have hcomp : DirectSum.component ℚ ℝ (fun j => (singletonModule j).obj t) t
      (structureMapLinear singletonFamily h.le x) = 0 := by
    rw [AlgebraicFamily.structureMap_apply singletonModule h.le x t, hz]
    rfl
  change (Submodule.subtype (SupportInterval.fiber (k := ℚ) ({t} : Set ℝ) t))
    (DirectSum.component ℚ ℝ (fun j => (singletonModule j).obj t) t
      (structureMapLinear singletonFamily h.le x)) = 0
  rw [hcomp]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.appIso_inv
statement:
theorem appIso_inv (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    (G.appIso M a ha).inv =
      (G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtensionUnit M).app (G.floor a ha) ≫
        structureMap (G.lan.obj M) (G.floor_le a ha)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.kanInclusion_appIso_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem kanInclusion_appIso_hom (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    G.kanInclusion M a ha ≫ (G.appIso M a ha).hom = 𝟙 _
proof: := (G.appIso M a ha).inv_hom_id

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.appIso_hom_kanInclusion
statement:
@[simp] theorem appIso_hom_kanInclusion (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    (G.appIso M a ha).hom ≫ G.kanInclusion M a ha = 𝟙 _
proof: := (G.appIso M a ha).hom_inv_id

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.isZero_obj_of_not_hasLowerPoint
statement:
theorem isZero_obj_of_not_hasLowerPoint (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : ¬ G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    IsZero ((G.lan.obj M).obj a)
proof:
:= by
  let : IsEmpty (CostructuredArrow G.embedding.monotone.functor a) :=
    ⟨fun t => ha ⟨t.left, leOfHom t.hom⟩⟩
  let E := Functor.LeftExtension.mk (G.lan.obj M)
    (G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtensionUnit M)
  have hc : IsColimit (E.coconeAt a) :=
    Functor.isPointwiseLeftKanExtensionLeftKanExtensionUnit G.embedding.monotone.functor M a
  have hi := isColimitEquivIsInitialOfIsEmpty (ModuleCat.{w} R) (E.coconeAt a) hc
  apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
  exact hi.hom_ext _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.eq_zero_of_not_hasLowerPoint
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_not_hasLowerPoint (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : ¬ G.HasLowerPoint a)
    (x : (G.lan.obj M).obj a) : x = 0

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.lan_map_preimage
proof:
:= by
  let i := G.embedding.monotone.functor
  let ηA := i.lanUnit.app A
  let ηC := i.lanUnit.app C
  letI : (G.lan.obj A).IsLeftKanExtension ηA := by
    change (i.lan.obj A).IsLeftKanExtension (i.lanUnit.app A)
    infer_instance
  apply Functor.hom_ext_of_isLeftKanExtension (G.lan.obj A) ηA
    (G.lan.map (G.lanMapPreimage f)) f
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext p
  have hn := NatTrans.congr_app
    (i.lanUnit.naturality (G.lanMapPreimage f)) p
  change (G.lanMapPreimage f).app p ≫ ηC.app p =
    ηA.app p ≫ (G.lan.map (G.lanMapPreimage f)).app (i.obj p) at hn
  haveI : IsIso (ηC.app p) :=
    (Functor.isPointwiseLeftKanExtensionLeftKanExtensionUnit i C (i.obj p)).isIso_hom_app
  have hidx : i.obj p = G.embedding p := rfl
  let ηCinv := (G.lanUnitIso C).inv.app p
  have hcancel : ηCinv ≫ ηC.app p = 𝟙 _ := by
    simpa [ηCinv, lanUnitIso, ηC, i] using
      (G.lanUnitIso C).inv_hom_id_app p
  simp only [NatTrans.comp_app, Functor.whiskerLeft_app]
  have hpre : (G.lanMapPreimage f).app p ≫ ηC.app p =
      ηA.app p ≫ f.app (i.obj p) := by
    change (((ηA.app p ≫ f.app (i.obj p)) ≫ ηCinv) ≫ ηC.app p) =
      ηA.app p ≫ f.app (i.obj p)
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, hcancel]
    simp [i, ← hidx]
  rw [← hn, hpre]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.lan_map_surjective
statement:
theorem lan_map_surjective {A C : PModule.{u,0,w} R G.Point} :
    Function.Surjective (fun θ : A ⟶ C => G.lan.map θ)
proof:
:= by
  intro f
  exact ⟨G.lanMapPreimage f, G.lan_map_preimage f⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.lan_map_injective
statement:
theorem lan_map_injective {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R G.Point}
    {θ θ' : M ⟶ N} (h : G.lan.map θ = G.lan.map θ') : θ = θ'
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext p
  let ηM := G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtensionUnit M
  let ηN := G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtensionUnit N
  have hηN : IsIso (ηN.app p) :=
    (Functor.isPointwiseLeftKanExtensionLeftKanExtensionUnit
      G.embedding.monotone.functor N (G.embedding p)).isIso_hom_app
  have hθ := NatTrans.congr_app
    (G.embedding.monotone.functor.lanUnit.naturality θ) p
  have hθ' := NatTrans.congr_app
    (G.embedding.monotone.functor.lanUnit.naturality θ') p
  change θ.app p ≫ ηN.app p = ηM.app p ≫ (G.lan.map θ).app (G.embedding p) at hθ
  change θ'.app p ≫ ηN.app p = ηM.app p ≫ (G.lan.map θ').app (G.embedding p) at hθ'
  have hcomp : θ.app p ≫ ηN.app p = θ'.app p ≫ ηN.app p := by
    rw [hθ, hθ', h]
  letI : IsIso (ηN.app p) := hηN
  exact (cancel_mono (ηN.app p)).mp hcomp

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.kanInclusion_naturality
statement:
theorem kanInclusion_naturality (θ : M ⟶ N) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    G.kanInclusion M a ha ≫ (G.lan.map θ).app a =
      θ.app (G.floor a ha) ≫ G.kanInclusion N a ha
proof:
:= by
  let p := G.floor a ha
  let uM : M.obj p ⟶ (G.lan.obj M).obj (G.embedding p) :=
    (G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtensionUnit M).app p
  let uN : N.obj p ⟶ (G.lan.obj N).obj (G.embedding p) :=
    (G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtensionUnit N).app p
  have hu := NatTrans.congr_app (G.embedding.monotone.functor.lanUnit.naturality θ) p
  change θ.app p ≫ uN = uM ≫ (G.lan.map θ).app (G.embedding p) at hu
  have hn := (G.lan.map θ).naturality (homOfLE (G.floor_le a ha))
  change structureMap (G.lan.obj M) (G.floor_le a ha) ≫ (G.lan.map θ).app a =
    (G.lan.map θ).app (G.embedding p) ≫ structureMap (G.lan.obj N) (G.floor_le a ha) at hn
  change (uM ≫ structureMap (G.lan.obj M) (G.floor_le a ha)) ≫ (G.lan.map θ).app a =
    θ.app p ≫ (uN ≫ structureMap (G.lan.obj N) (G.floor_le a ha))
  rw [Category.assoc, hn, ← Category.assoc, ← hu, Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.appIso_naturality
statement:
theorem appIso_naturality (θ : M ⟶ N) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) :
    (G.lan.map θ).app a ≫ (G.appIso N a ha).hom =
      (G.appIso M a ha).hom ≫ θ.app (G.floor a ha)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (G.kanInclusion M a ha)).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, G.kanInclusion_naturality, Category.assoc,
    G.kanInclusion_appIso_hom, Category.comp_id, ← Category.assoc,
    G.kanInclusion_appIso_hom, Category.id_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.appIso_map_apply
statement:
theorem appIso_map_apply (θ : M ⟶ N) (a : Fin n → ℝ) (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a)
    (x : (G.lan.obj M).obj a) :
    (G.appIso N a ha).hom.hom (((G.lan.map θ).app a).hom x) =
      (θ.app (G.floor a ha)).hom ((G.appIso M a ha).hom.hom x)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) (G.appIso_naturality θ a ha)

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.kanInclusion_structureMap
statement:
theorem kanInclusion_structureMap {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (hb : G.HasLowerPoint b) :
    G.kanInclusion M a ha ≫ structureMap (G.lan.obj M) hab =
      structureMap M (G.floor_mono hab ha hb) ≫ G.kanInclusion M b hb
proof:
:= by
  let p := G.floor a ha
  let q := G.floor b hb
  let up : M.obj p ⟶ (G.lan.obj M).obj (G.embedding p) :=
    (G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtensionUnit M).app p
  let uq : M.obj q ⟶ (G.lan.obj M).obj (G.embedding q) :=
    (G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtensionUnit M).app q
  have hn := (G.embedding.monotone.functor.leftKanExtensionUnit M).naturality
    (homOfLE (G.floor_mono hab ha hb))
  change structureMap M (G.floor_mono hab ha hb) ≫ uq =
    up ≫ structureMap (G.lan.obj M) (G.embedding.monotone (G.floor_mono hab ha hb)) at hn
  change (up ≫ structureMap (G.lan.obj M) (G.floor_le a ha)) ≫ structureMap (G.lan.obj M) hab =
    structureMap M (G.floor_mono hab ha hb) ≫ (uq ≫ structureMap (G.lan.obj M) (G.floor_le b hb))
  rw [Category.assoc, structureMap_comp, ← Category.assoc, hn, Category.assoc, structureMap_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.appIso_structureMap
statement:
theorem appIso_structureMap {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (hb : G.HasLowerPoint b) :
    structureMap (G.lan.obj M) hab ≫ (G.appIso M b hb).hom =
      (G.appIso M a ha).hom ≫ structureMap M (G.floor_mono hab ha hb)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_epi (G.kanInclusion M a ha)).mp
  rw [← Category.assoc, G.kanInclusion_structureMap, Category.assoc,
    G.kanInclusion_appIso_hom, Category.comp_id, ← Category.assoc,
    G.kanInclusion_appIso_hom, Category.id_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.appIso_structureMap_apply
statement:
theorem appIso_structureMap_apply {a b : Fin n → ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (ha : G.HasLowerPoint a) (hb : G.HasLowerPoint b) (x : (G.lan.obj M).obj a) :
    (G.appIso M b hb).hom.hom (structureMapLinear (G.lan.obj M) hab x) =
      structureMapLinear M (G.floor_mono hab ha hb) ((G.appIso M a ha).hom.hom x)
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f => f.hom x) (G.appIso_structureMap M hab ha hb)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.support_ordConnected
statement: theorem support_ordConnected (l r : Cut ℝ) : (support l r).OrdConnected
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  intro a ha b hb x hx
  exact ⟨upper_of_le hx.1 ha.1, lower_of_le hx.2 hb.2⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.globalEval_val_on_support
statement:
private theorem globalEval_val_on_support (i : IntervalIndex) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ support i.val.1 i.val.2) (w : globalComplement M i) :
    (globalEval M i t w).val =
      (intervalPlusEvaluation M i.val.1 i.val.2 ⟨t, ht⟩ w.val).val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [globalEval, ht]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.globalEval_bijective_on_support
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    have he : intervalPlusEvaluation M i.val.1 i.val.2 ⟨t, ht⟩ x.val =
        intervalPlusEvaluation M i.val.1 i.val.2 ⟨t, ht⟩ y.val := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      have h := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
      rw [globalEval_val_on_support M i t ht x,
        globalEval_val_on_support M i t ht y] at h
      exact h
    exact (sectionComplement_quotientEvaluation_bijective_real M
      i.val.1 i.val.2 (anchor i) ⟨t, ht⟩).1
      (congrArg (intervalMinusInPlus M i.val.1 i.val.2 t).mkQ he)
  · intro x
    have hx : x.val ∈ sectionComplementFiber M i.val.1 i.val.2 (anchor i) t :=
      x.property
    simp only [sectionComplementFiber, dif_pos ht] at hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwz⟩ := hz
    refine ⟨⟨w, hw⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [globalEval_val_on_support M i t ht]
    rw [hwz]
    exact hzx

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.globalEval_map_on_support
statement:
private theorem globalEval_map_on_support (i : IntervalIndex)
    {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    (hp : p ∈ support i.val.1 i.val.2)
    (hq : q ∈ support i.val.1 i.val.2)
    (w : globalComplement M i) :
    structureMapLinear (intervalFamily M i) hpq (globalEval M i p w) =
      globalEval M i q w
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change structureMapLinear M hpq (globalEval M i p w).val =
    (globalEval M i q w).val
  rw [globalEval_val_on_support M i p hp,
    globalEval_val_on_support M i q hq]
  have he := CompatibleSections.compatible
    (intervalPlusModule M i.val.1 i.val.2) w.val
    (show (⟨p, hp⟩ : support i.val.1 i.val.2) ≤ ⟨q, hq⟩ from hpq)
  have he' := congrArg Subtype.val he
  change structureMapLinear M hpq
      (intervalPlusEvaluation M i.val.1 i.val.2 ⟨p, hp⟩ w.val).val =
    (intervalPlusEvaluation M i.val.1 i.val.2 ⟨q, hq⟩ w.val).val at he'
  exact he'

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.copiesFiberEquiv_lof
statement:
private theorem copiesFiberEquiv_lof (i : IntervalIndex) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ support i.val.1 i.val.2)
    (a : Fin (Module.finrank k (globalComplement M i)))
    (x : (cutIntervalModule (k := k) i).obj t) :
    copiesFiberEquiv M i t ht
      (DirectSum.lof k _ (fun _ => (cutIntervalModule (k := k) i).obj t) a x) =
      (x.val : k) • globalEval M i t (globalBasis M i a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change globalEvalEquiv M i t ht
      ((globalBasis M i).repr.symm
        ((Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite k k
          (Fin (Module.finrank k (globalComplement M i)))).symm
          ((LinearEquiv.piCongrRight
            (fun _ : Fin (Module.finrank k (globalComplement M i)) =>
              scalarFiberEquiv (k := k) i t ht))
            ((DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype k _
              (fun _ => (cutIntervalModule (k := k) i).obj t))
              (DirectSum.lof k _ (fun _ => (cutIntervalModule (k := k) i).obj t) a x))))) = _
  rw [DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype_lof]
  have hpi : (LinearEquiv.piCongrRight
      (fun _ : Fin (Module.finrank k (globalComplement M i)) =>
        scalarFiberEquiv (k := k) i t ht)) (Pi.single a x) =
      Pi.single a (x.val : k) := by
    funext b
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst b
      simp only [LinearEquiv.piCongrRight_apply, Pi.single_apply]
      change scalarFiberEquiv (k := k) i t ht x = x.val
      rfl
    · have hba : b ≠ a := Ne.symm hab
      simp only [LinearEquiv.piCongrRight_apply, Pi.single_apply, if_neg hba, map_zero]
  rw [hpi, Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite_symm_single]
  simp [globalEvalEquiv]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.copiesToInterval_app_supported
statement:
private theorem copiesToInterval_app_supported (i : IntervalIndex) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ support i.val.1 i.val.2) :
    ((copiesToInterval M i).app t).hom =
      (copiesFiberEquiv M i t ht).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply DirectSum.linearMap_ext
  intro a
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change (cutIntervalModule (k := k) i).obj t at x
  change DirectSum.toModule k _ ((intervalFamily M i).obj t)
      (fun j => ((basisInclusion M i j).app t).hom)
      (DirectSum.lof k _ (fun _ => (cutIntervalModule (k := k) i).obj t) a x) =
    copiesFiberEquiv M i t ht
      (DirectSum.lof k _ (fun _ => (cutIntervalModule (k := k) i).obj t) a x)
  rw [DirectSum.toModule_lof, copiesFiberEquiv_lof]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.copiesToInterval_app_bijective
statement:
private theorem copiesToInterval_app_bijective (i : IntervalIndex) (t : ℝ) :
    Function.Bijective ((copiesToInterval M i).app t).hom
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ht : t ∈ support i.val.1 i.val.2
  · rw [copiesToInterval_app_supported M i t ht]
    exact (copiesFiberEquiv M i t ht).bijective
  · have hscalar : Subsingleton ((cutIntervalModule (k := k) i).obj t) := by
      constructor
      intro x y
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k)
        (support i.val.1 i.val.2) ht x,
        SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k)
        (support i.val.1 i.val.2) ht y]
    have htarget : Subsingleton ((intervalFamily M i).obj t) := by
      change Subsingleton (sectionComplementFiber M i.val.1 i.val.2 (anchor i) t)
      rw [sectionComplementFiber_eq_bot M i.val.1 i.val.2 (anchor i) ht]
      infer_instance
    constructor
    · intro x y _
      apply DirectSum.ext_component k
      intro a
      exact @Subsingleton.elim _ (show Subsingleton ((copies M i a).obj t) from hscalar) _ _
    · intro y
      exact ⟨0, @Subsingleton.elim _ htarget _ _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.scalarSupport_nonempty
statement:
theorem scalarSupport_nonempty (j : ScalarIndex M) :
    (scalarSupport M j).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  j.1.property

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.scalarSupport_ordConnected
statement:
theorem scalarSupport_ordConnected (j : ScalarIndex M) :
    (scalarSupport M j).OrdConnected
proof:
:=
  support_ordConnected j.1.val.1 j.1.val.2

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.scalarFiber_nontrivial_iff
statement:
theorem scalarFiber_nontrivial_iff (j : ScalarIndex M) (t : ℝ) :
    Nontrivial ((scalarFamily M j).obj t) ↔ t ∈ scalarSupport M j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases ht : t ∈ scalarSupport M j
  · constructor
    · intro _; exact ht
    · intro _
      change Nontrivial (SupportInterval.fiber (k := k) (scalarSupport M j) t)
      refine ⟨⟨0, by simp [SupportInterval.fiber, ht]⟩,
        ⟨1, by simp [SupportInterval.fiber, ht]⟩, ?_⟩
      intro h
      exact zero_ne_one (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  · constructor
    · intro hn
      have hsub : Subsingleton ((scalarFamily M j).obj t) := by
        constructor
        intro x y
        apply Subtype.ext
        rw [SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k)
          (scalarSupport M j) ht x,
          SupportInterval.val_eq_zero (k := k)
          (scalarSupport M j) ht y]
      exact False.elim (not_nontrivial ((scalarFamily M j).obj t) hn)
    · intro h; exact (ht h).elim

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.scalar_finite_active
statement:
theorem scalar_finite_active (t : ℝ) :
    Set.Finite {j : ScalarIndex M | t ∈ scalarSupport M j}
proof:
:= by
  have h := AlgebraicFamily.finite_nontrivial_of_iso
    (scalarFamily M) (scalarIso M).symm
    (fun t => inferInstance) t
  have heq : {j : ScalarIndex M | t ∈ scalarSupport M j} =
      {j : ScalarIndex M | Nontrivial ((scalarFamily M j).obj t)} := by
    ext j
    exact (scalarFiber_nontrivial_iff M j t).symm
  rwa [heq]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealIntervalDecomposition.exists_interval_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_interval_decomposition :
    ∃ (J : Type) (I : J → Set ℝ) (hI : ∀ j, (I j).OrdConnected),
      (∀ j, (I j).Nonempty) ∧
      Nonempty (M ≅ AlgebraicFamily.familyModule
        (fun j => SupportInterval.module (k := k) (I j) (hI j))) ∧
      ∀ t, Set.Finite {j | t ∈ I j}
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨ScalarIndex M, scalarSupport M, scalarSupport_ordConnected M,
    scalarSupport_nonempty M, ⟨(scalarIso M).symm⟩, scalar_finite_active M⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.expHom_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem expHom_apply (t : ℝ) : expHom t = Real.exp t
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.logModule_obj
statement:
theorem logModule_obj (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (logModule R f n).obj t = simplicialHomology (f.sublevel (Real.exp t)) R n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.logModule_eq_reindex
statement:
theorem logModule_eq_reindex (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    logModule R f n = reindex expHom (sublevelModule R f n)
proof:
:=
  simplicialHomologyPModule_reindex R n expHom f.sublevelFiltration

name: TDA.Persistence.coe_logParam
statement: theorem coe_logParam {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 ≤ c) : (logParam c : ℝ) = Real.log c
proof:
:=
  Real.coe_toNNReal _ (Real.log_nonneg hc)

name: TDA.Persistence.exp_add_logParam
statement:
theorem exp_add_logParam {c : ℝ} (hc : 1 ≤ c) (t : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (t + logParam c) = c * Real.exp t
proof:
:= by
  rw [coe_logParam hc, Real.exp_add, Real.exp_log (by linarith), mul_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.log_sublevel_le_of_le
statement:
theorem log_sublevel_le_of_le (hgf : ∀ s, g.value s ≤ f.value s) (t : ℝ) :
    f.sublevel (Real.exp t) ≤ g.sublevel (Real.exp (t + logParam c))
proof:
:=
  (sublevel_le_sublevel_of_le hgf _).trans
    (g.sublevel_mono (Real.exp_le_exp.2 (le_add_of_nonneg_right (NNReal.coe_nonneg _))))

name: TDA.Persistence.log_sublevel_le_of_le_mul
statement:
theorem log_sublevel_le_of_le_mul (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hfc : ∀ s, f.value s ≤ c * g.value s)
    (t : ℝ) : g.sublevel (Real.exp t) ≤ f.sublevel (Real.exp (t + logParam c))
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsK, hsr⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff g _ s).1 hs
  refine (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff f _ s).2 ⟨hsK, ?_⟩
  rw [exp_add_logParam hc]
  exact (hfc _).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsr (by linarith))

name: TDA.Persistence.logInterleaving_φ_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem logInterleaving_φ_app (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hgf : ∀ s, g.value s ≤ f.value s)
    (hfc : ∀ s, f.value s ≤ c * g.value s) (t : ℝ) :
    (logInterleaving R n hc hgf hfc).φ.app t =
      simplicialHomologyIncl R (log_sublevel_le_of_le hgf t) n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.logInterleaving_ψ_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem logInterleaving_ψ_app (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hgf : ∀ s, g.value s ≤ f.value s)
    (hfc : ∀ s, f.value s ≤ c * g.value s) (t : ℝ) :
    (logInterleaving R n hc hgf hfc).ψ.app t =
      simplicialHomologyIncl R (log_sublevel_le_of_le_mul hc hfc t) n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_log_le
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_log_le (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hgf : ∀ s, g.value s ≤ f.value s)
    (hfc : ∀ s, f.value s ≤ c * g.value s) :
    realInterleavingDistance (logModule R f n) (logModule R g n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log c)
proof:
:=
  (logInterleaving R n hc hgf hfc).distance_le

name: TDA.Persistence.twoMul_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem twoMul_apply (r : ℝ) : twoMul r = 2 * r
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.realInterleavingDistance_rips_cech_log_le
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_rips_cech_log_le (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) :
    realInterleavingDistance (logModule R (Rips.filter d) n)
        (logModule R (Cech.filter p) n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log 2)
proof:
:=
  (ripsCechLogInterleaving R n d p hd).distance_le

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.sublevel_le_sublevel_two_mul
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsK, hsr⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff f r s).1 hs
  refine (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff f _ s).2 ⟨hsK, ?_⟩
  have := hf ⟨s, hsK⟩
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.cech_sublevel_le_rips_two_mul
statement:
theorem cech_sublevel_le_rips_two_mul (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (r : ℝ) :
    (Cech.filter p).sublevel r ≤ (Rips.filter d).sublevel (2 * r)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsK, hsr⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff _ r s).1 hs
  refine (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ s).2 ⟨hsK, ?_⟩
  have := Cech.rips_le_two_mul_filter_value d p hd ⟨s, hsK⟩
  linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.ripsToCech_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem ripsToCech_app (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (r : ℝ) :
    (ripsToCech R n d p hd).app r = simplicialHomologyIncl R
      (sublevel_le_sublevel_of_le (Cech.filter_value_le_rips d p hd) r) n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.ripsToCech_comp_cechToRips
statement:
theorem ripsToCech_comp_cechToRips (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) :
    ripsToCech R n d p hd ≫ cechToRips R n d p hd = ripsDouble R n d
proof:
:=
  inclusionHom_comp R n _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.cechToRips_comp_ripsToCech
statement:
theorem cechToRips_comp_ripsToCech (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) :
    cechToRips R n d p hd ≫ reindexNatTrans twoMul (ripsToCech R n d p hd) =
      cechDouble R n p
proof:
:=
  inclusionHom_comp R n (H := Filtration.reindex twoMul (Cech.filter p).sublevelFiltration)
    _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.ripsDouble_app_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem ripsDouble_app_of_nonneg (d : MetricSpace V) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (ripsDouble R n d).app r =
      structureMap (sublevelModule R (Rips.filter d) n) (show r ≤ 2 * r by linarith)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.cechDouble_app_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem cechDouble_app_of_nonneg (p : V → X) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    (cechDouble R n p).app r =
      structureMap (sublevelModule R (Cech.filter p) n) (show r ≤ 2 * r by linarith)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.quadraticEssentialCoordinates_swap_nontrivial
statement:
theorem quadraticEssentialCoordinates_swap_nontrivial (t : ℝ) :
    quadraticEssentialCoordinates t ≠ swappedQuadraticEssentialCoordinates t
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hzero := congrArg (fun z : DiagramCoordinates 0 2 => z.2 0) h
  simp [quadraticEssentialCoordinates, swappedQuadraticEssentialCoordinates] at hzero

name: TDA.Persistence.swappedQuadraticEssentialCoordinates_factorization
statement:
theorem swappedQuadraticEssentialCoordinates_factorization (t : ℝ) :
    orderedQ 0 2 (swappedQuadraticEssentialCoordinates t) = quadraticEssentialDiagram t
proof:
:= by
  simpa [swappedQuadraticEssentialCoordinates, quadraticEssentialCoordinates,
    quadraticEssentialDiagram] using orderedQ_perm 0 2 (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.swap 0 1)
      (quadraticEssentialCoordinates t).1 (quadraticEssentialCoordinates t).2

name: TDA.Persistence.paddedQuadraticEssentialCoordinates_factorization
statement:
theorem paddedQuadraticEssentialCoordinates_factorization (t : ℝ) :
    orderedQ 1 2 (paddedQuadraticEssentialCoordinates t) = quadraticEssentialDiagram t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← swappedQuadraticEssentialCoordinates_factorization t]

name: TDA.Persistence.quadraticEssentialDiagram_scalar_loss
statement:
theorem quadraticEssentialDiagram_scalar_loss (t : ℝ) :
    essentialBirthSum (quadraticEssentialDiagram t) = 1 + 2 * t ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [quadraticEssentialDiagram, essentialBirthSum_orderedQ,
    quadraticEssentialCoordinates, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.quadraticEssentialDiagram_scalar_fderiv
proof:
:= by
  have hf : (essentialBirthSum ∘ quadraticEssentialDiagram) =
      (fun t : ℝ => 1 + 2 * t ^ 2) := by
    funext t
    exact quadraticEssentialDiagram_scalar_loss t
  rw [hf]
  have hd := ((squareLinear_hasFDerivAt (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ) x).const_mul 2).const_add 1
  simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_smul,
    show (2 : ℝ) * (2 * x) = 4 * x by ring] using hd.fderiv

name: TDA.Persistence.quadraticEssentialDiagram_scalar_hasFDerivAt_fderiv
statement:
theorem quadraticEssentialDiagram_scalar_hasFDerivAt_fderiv (x : ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (fderiv ℝ (essentialBirthSum ∘ quadraticEssentialDiagram))
      (((4 : ℝ) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).smulRight
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)) x
proof:
:= by
  have hf : fderiv ℝ (essentialBirthSum ∘ quadraticEssentialDiagram) =
      fun t => (4 * t) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ :=
    funext quadraticEssentialDiagram_scalar_fderiv
  rw [hf]
  exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ).hasFDerivAt.const_mul 4).smul_const
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ)

proof:

  simp [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, mul_assoc]

statement:

        quadraticEssentialLift.coordinates x h k = 4 * h * k ∧
      secondDerivativeChain (essentialBirthSum ∘ orderedQ 1 2)
        paddedQuadraticEssentialLift.coordinates x h k = 4 * h * k

  have hvalue : secondDerivativeChain (essentialBirthSum ∘ orderedQ 0 2)
      quadraticEssentialLift.coordinates x h k = 4 * h * k := by
    rw [← hv]
    exact quadraticEssentialDiagram_scalar_secondFDeriv_apply x h k
  exact ⟨hvalue, by rw [← quadraticEssentialLift_second_derivative_padding x]; exact hvalue⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.ofBoundaryAssignment_some_iff
statement:
theorem ofBoundaryAssignment_some_iff (e : (I ⊕ J) ≃ (J ⊕ I)) (i : I) (j : J) :
    (ofBoundaryAssignment e).finite i = some j ↔ e (.inl i) = .inl j
proof:
:= by
  cases h : e (.inl i) <;> simp [ofBoundaryAssignment, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.completionMap_leftInverse
statement:
private theorem completionMap_leftInverse
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :
    Function.LeftInverse (completionMap M.reverse) (completionMap M)
proof:
:= by
  intro z
  cases z with
  | inl i =>
    cases h : M.finite i with
    | some j =>
      have hr := (M.reverse_finite_some_iff j i).mpr h
      simp [completionMap, h, hr]
    | none => simp [completionMap, h, reverse_reverse]
  | inr j =>
    cases h : M.reverse.finite j with
    | some i =>
      have hr := (M.reverse_finite_some_iff j i).mp h
      simp [completionMap, h, hr, reverse_reverse]
    | none => simp [completionMap, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.ofBoundaryAssignment_toBoundaryAssignment
statement:
theorem ofBoundaryAssignment_toBoundaryAssignment
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :
    ofBoundaryAssignment M.toBoundaryAssignment = M
proof:
:= by
  apply OccurrenceMatching.ext
  · funext i
    cases h : M.finite i <;> simp [ofBoundaryAssignment, toBoundaryAssignment, completionMap, h]
  · exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost_ofBoundaryAssignment
statement:
theorem totalBoundaryCost_ofBoundaryAssignment (e : (I ⊕ J) ≃ (J ⊕ I))
    (c : I → J → ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (v : J → ℝ) :
    (ofBoundaryAssignment e).totalBoundaryCost c u v = boundaryAssignmentCostWith c u v e
proof:
:= by
  have hs (i : I) :
      (match (ofBoundaryAssignment e).finite i with
        | some j => c i j
        | none => u i) =
      boundaryAssignmentEntryWith c u v (.inl i) (e (.inl i)) := by
    cases h : e (.inl i) <;> simp [ofBoundaryAssignment, boundaryAssignmentEntryWith, h]
  have hc (z : I ⊕ J) : dummyTargetChargeWith e v (e z) =
      match z with
      | .inl _ => 0
      | .inr _ => boundaryAssignmentEntryWith c u v z (e z) := by
    cases z with
    | inl i =>
      cases h : e (.inl i) with
      | inl j => simp only [dummyTargetChargeWith, ← h, e.symm_apply_apply]
      | inr k => rfl
    | inr j =>
      cases h : e (.inr j) with
      | inl k => simp only [dummyTargetChargeWith, ← h, e.symm_apply_apply, boundaryAssignmentEntryWith]
      | inr i => rfl
  have ht (j : J) :
      (if ∃ i, (ofBoundaryAssignment e).finite i = some j then 0
        else v j) = dummyTargetChargeWith e v (.inl j) := by
    simp_rw [ofBoundaryAssignment_some_iff]
    cases h : e.symm (.inl j) with
    | inl i =>
      have he : e (.inl i) = .inl j := by rw [← h, e.apply_symm_apply]
      simp [dummyTargetChargeWith, h, show ∃ i, e (.inl i) = .inl j from ⟨i, he⟩]
    | inr k =>
      have hn : ¬ ∃ i, e (.inl i) = .inl j := by
        rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        have := congrArg e.symm hi
        rw [e.symm_apply_apply, h] at this
        cases this
      simp [dummyTargetChargeWith, h, hn]
  have hr := e.sum_comp (dummyTargetChargeWith e v)
  simp_rw [hc] at hr
  simp only [Fintype.sum_sum_type, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add] at hr
  calc
    _ = (∑ i, boundaryAssignmentEntryWith c u v (.inl i) (e (.inl i))) +
        ∑ j, dummyTargetChargeWith e v (.inl j) :=
      congrArg₂ (· + ·) (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hs i))
        (Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => ht j))
    _ = _ := by
      unfold boundaryAssignmentCostWith
      rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type, hr]
      simp [dummyTargetChargeWith]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFiniteCost_ofBoundaryAssignment
statement:
theorem totalFiniteCost_ofBoundaryAssignment (e : (I ⊕ J) ≃ (J ⊕ I))
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    (ofBoundaryAssignment e).totalFiniteCost x y = boundaryAssignmentCost x y e
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = (ofBoundaryAssignment e).totalBoundaryCost
        (fun i j => (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal)
        (fun i => (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal) (fun j => (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal) := rfl
    _ = boundaryAssignmentCostWith
        (fun i j => (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal)
        (fun i => (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal) (fun j => (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal) e :=
      totalBoundaryCost_ofBoundaryAssignment e _ _ _
    _ = _ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro z _
      cases z with
      | inl i => cases e (.inl i) <;> rfl
      | inr j => cases e (.inr j) <;> rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.boundaryAssignmentCostWith_toBoundaryAssignment
statement:
theorem boundaryAssignmentCostWith_toBoundaryAssignment
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (c : I → J → ℝ) (u : I → ℝ) (v : J → ℝ) :
    boundaryAssignmentCostWith c u v M.toBoundaryAssignment = M.totalBoundaryCost c u v
proof:

  rw [← totalBoundaryCost_ofBoundaryAssignment, ofBoundaryAssignment_toBoundaryAssignment]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.boundaryAssignmentCost_toBoundaryAssignment
statement:
theorem boundaryAssignmentCost_toBoundaryAssignment
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    boundaryAssignmentCost x y M.toBoundaryAssignment = M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← totalFiniteCost_ofBoundaryAssignment, ofBoundaryAssignment_toBoundaryAssignment]

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.pushoutQuotient_inl
statement:
@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem pushoutQuotient_inl (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) (f : L ⟶ L') :
    Limits.pushout.inl ι f ≫ hs.pushoutQuotient f = π

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.pushoutQuotient_inr

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.fiberPushoutShortExact
statement:
private theorem fiberPushoutShortExact (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) (p : P)
    (f : L.obj p ⟶ L'.obj p) :
    (ShortComplex.mk (Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) f) (fiberPushoutQuotient hs p f)
      (by
        change Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) f ≫
          Limits.pushout.desc (π.app p) (0 : L'.obj p ⟶ N.obj p) _ = 0
        exact Limits.pushout.inr_desc (π.app p) (0 : L'.obj p ⟶ N.obj p) _)).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let S : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
    ShortComplex.mk (ι.app p) (π.app p) (pointZero hs p)
  have hSExact : S.Exact := by
    apply (ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff_range_eq_ker S).2
    exact hs.range_eq_ker p
  haveI : Mono (ι.app p) := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).2 (hs.injective p)
  haveI : Epi (π.app p) := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).2 (hs.surjective p)
  have hSShort : S.ShortExact := ⟨hSExact⟩
  let q : Limits.pushout (ι.app p) f ⟶ N.obj p :=
    Limits.pushout.desc (π.app p) (0 : L'.obj p ⟶ N.obj p)
      (by rw [pointZero hs p]; simp)
  have hqInl : Limits.pushout.inl (ι.app p) f ≫ q = π.app p := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact Limits.pushout.inl_desc _ _ _
  have hqInr : Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) f ≫ q = 0 := by
    dsimp [q]
    exact Limits.pushout.inr_desc _ _ _
  have hqzero : Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) f ≫ q = 0 := by
    exact hqInr
  have hqcolim : IsColimit (CokernelCofork.ofπ q hqzero) := by
    let kill {Z : ModuleCat.{u} k} (v : Limits.pushout (ι.app p) f ⟶ Z)
        (hv : Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) f ≫ v = 0) :
        (ι.app p) ≫ (Limits.pushout.inl (ι.app p) f ≫ v) = 0 := by
      calc
        (ι.app p) ≫ (Limits.pushout.inl (ι.app p) f ≫ v) =
            ((ι.app p) ≫ Limits.pushout.inl (ι.app p) f) ≫ v := by simp only [Category.assoc]
        _ = (f ≫ Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) f) ≫ v := by rw [Limits.pushout.condition]
        _ = f ≫ (Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) f ≫ v) := by simp only [Category.assoc]
        _ = 0 := by rw [hv]; simp
    let factor {Z : ModuleCat.{u} k} (v : Limits.pushout (ι.app p) f ⟶ Z)
        (hv : Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) f ≫ v = 0) : N.obj p ⟶ Z :=
      (CokernelCofork.IsColimit.desc' hSShort.gIsCokernel
        (Limits.pushout.inl (ι.app p) f ≫ v) (kill v hv)).1
    have factor_fac {Z : ModuleCat.{u} k} (v : Limits.pushout (ι.app p) f ⟶ Z)
        (hv : Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) f ≫ v = 0) :
        (π.app p) ≫ factor v hv = Limits.pushout.inl (ι.app p) f ≫ v :=
      (CokernelCofork.IsColimit.desc' hSShort.gIsCokernel
        (Limits.pushout.inl (ι.app p) f ≫ v) (kill v hv)).2
    refine CokernelCofork.IsColimit.ofπ q hqzero
      (fun {Z} v hv => factor v hv)
      (fun {Z} v hv => by
        apply Limits.pushout.hom_ext
        · calc
            Limits.pushout.inl (ι.app p) f ≫ q ≫ factor v hv =
                (π.app p) ≫ factor v hv := by
                  rw [← Category.assoc, hqInl]
            _ = Limits.pushout.inl (ι.app p) f ≫ v := factor_fac v hv
        · calc
            Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) f ≫ q ≫ factor v hv = 0 := by
              rw [← Category.assoc, hqInr]
              simp
            _ = Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) f ≫ v := by rw [hv])
      (fun {Z} v hv m hm => by
        letI : Epi (π.app p) := hSShort.epi_g
        apply (cancel_epi (π.app p)).1
        calc
          (π.app p) ≫ m = (Limits.pushout.inl (ι.app p) f ≫ q) ≫ m := by
            rw [hqInl]
          _ = Limits.pushout.inl (ι.app p) f ≫ v := by rw [Category.assoc, hm]
          _ = (π.app p) ≫ factor v hv := (factor_fac v hv).symm)
  let T : ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
    ShortComplex.mk (Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) f) q hqzero
  have hTExact : T.Exact := ShortComplex.exact_of_g_is_cokernel _ hqcolim
  haveI : Mono T.f := by
    dsimp [T]
    infer_instance
  haveI : Epi T.g := by
    dsimp [T]
    exact Cofork.IsColimit.epi hqcolim
  simpa [T, q, fiberPushoutQuotient] using (show T.ShortExact from ⟨hTExact⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.fiberPushout_injective
proof:
:= by
  exact (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).1
    (fiberPushoutShortExact hs p f).mono_f

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.fiberPushout_surjective
proof:
:= by
  exact (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).1
    (fiberPushoutShortExact hs p f).epi_g

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.fiberPushout_range_eq_ker
statement:
private theorem fiberPushout_range_eq_ker (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) (p : P)
    (f : L.obj p ⟶ L'.obj p) :
    LinearMap.range (Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) f).hom =
      LinearMap.ker (fiberPushoutQuotient hs p f).hom
proof:
:=
  ShortComplex.Exact.moduleCat_range_eq_ker (fiberPushoutShortExact hs p f).exact

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.pushoutObjIso_quotient
statement:
private theorem pushoutObjIso_quotient (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) (f : L ⟶ L')
    (p : P) :
    (Limits.pushoutObjIso ι f p).inv ≫ (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p =
      fiberPushoutQuotient hs p (f.app p)
proof:
:= by
  refine Limits.pushout.hom_ext ?_ ?_
  · calc
      Limits.pushout.inl (ι.app p) (f.app p) ≫ (Limits.pushoutObjIso ι f p).inv ≫
          (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p =
          (pushout.inl ι f).app p ≫ (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p := by
            change (Limits.pushout.inl (ι.app p) (f.app p) ≫
              (Limits.pushoutObjIso ι f p).inv) ≫ (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p = _
            rw [Limits.inl_comp_pushoutObjIso_inv]
      _ = (π.app p) := by
        have h := NatTrans.congr_app (pushoutQuotient_inl hs f) p
        change ((pushout.inl ι f).app p ≫ (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p) = π.app p at h
        exact h
      _ = pushout.inl (ι.app p) (f.app p) ≫ fiberPushoutQuotient hs p (f.app p) := by
        exact (Limits.pushout.inl_desc (π.app p) 0 _).symm
  · calc
      Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) (f.app p) ≫ (Limits.pushoutObjIso ι f p).inv ≫
          (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p =
          (pushout.inr ι f).app p ≫ (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p := by
            change (Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) (f.app p) ≫
              (Limits.pushoutObjIso ι f p).inv) ≫ (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p = _
            rw [Limits.inr_comp_pushoutObjIso_inv]
      _ = 0 := by
        have h := NatTrans.congr_app (pushoutQuotient_inr hs f) p
        change ((pushout.inr ι f).app p ≫ (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p) = 0 at h
        exact h
      _ = pushout.inr (ι.app p) (f.app p) ≫ fiberPushoutQuotient hs p (f.app p) := by
        exact (Limits.pushout.inr_desc (π.app p) 0 _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.pushout_pointwise
statement:
theorem pushout_pointwise (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) (f : L ⟶ L') :
    IsPointwiseShortExact (Limits.pushout.inr ι f) (hs.pushoutQuotient f) where
  injective p
proof:
:= by
    let e := Limits.pushoutObjIso ι f p
    have hinr := Limits.inr_comp_pushoutObjIso_hom ι f p
    have hinj := fiberPushout_injective hs p (f.app p)
    intro x y hxy
    have h := congrArg e.hom.hom hxy
    have hfiber : (Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) (f.app p)).hom x =
        (Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) (f.app p)).hom y := by
      calc
        (Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) (f.app p)).hom x =
            ((Limits.pushout.inr ι f).app p ≫ e.hom).hom x := by rw [hinr]
        _ = e.hom.hom (((Limits.pushout.inr ι f).app p).hom x) := by
            rw [ModuleCat.comp_apply]
        _ = e.hom.hom (((Limits.pushout.inr ι f).app p).hom y) := h
        _ = ((Limits.pushout.inr ι f).app p ≫ e.hom).hom y := by
            rw [ModuleCat.comp_apply]
        _ = (Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) (f.app p)).hom y := by rw [hinr]
    exact hinj hfiber
  surjective p := by
    let e := Limits.pushoutObjIso ι f p
    have hq := pushoutObjIso_quotient hs f p
    intro n
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := fiberPushout_surjective hs p (f.app p) n
    refine ⟨e.inv.hom x, ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (fun g : pushout (ι.app p) (f.app p) ⟶ N.obj p => g.hom x) hq
    simpa [hx] using h
  range_eq_ker p := by
    let e := Limits.pushoutObjIso ι f p
    have hinr := Limits.inr_comp_pushoutObjIso_hom ι f p
    have hq := pushoutObjIso_quotient hs f p
    have hq' : e.hom ≫ fiberPushoutQuotient hs p (f.app p) =
        (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p := by
      calc
        e.hom ≫ fiberPushoutQuotient hs p (f.app p) =
            e.hom ≫ (e.inv ≫ (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p) := by rw [hq]
        _ = (e.hom ≫ e.inv) ≫ (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p := by
            rw [← Category.assoc]
        _ = (𝟙 _) ≫ (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p := by rw [e.hom_inv_id]
        _ = (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p := by simp
    have hexact := fiberPushout_range_eq_ker hs p (f.app p)
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
      have happ := NatTrans.congr_app (pushoutQuotient_inr hs f) p
      change ((Limits.pushout.inr ι f).app p ≫ (hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p) = 0 at happ
      change ((hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p).hom
        (((Limits.pushout.inr ι f).app p).hom y) = 0
      have hzero := congrArg (fun g : L'.obj p ⟶ N.obj p => g.hom y) happ
      simpa using hzero
    · intro hx
      change ((hs.pushoutQuotient f).app p).hom x = 0 at hx
      have hxq : (fiberPushoutQuotient hs p (f.app p)).hom (e.hom.hom x) = 0 := by
        have h := congrArg (fun g : (Limits.pushout ι f).obj p ⟶ N.obj p =>
          g.hom x) hq'
        simpa using h.trans hx
      have hxrange : e.hom.hom x ∈
          LinearMap.range (Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) (f.app p)).hom := by
        rw [hexact]
        exact hxq
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hxrange
      refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
      have he : Function.Injective e.hom.hom :=
        (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance
      apply he
      change e.hom.hom (((Limits.pushout.inr ι f).app p).hom y) = e.hom.hom x
      calc
        e.hom.hom (((Limits.pushout.inr ι f).app p).hom y) =
            ((Limits.pushout.inr ι f).app p ≫ e.hom).hom y := by
              rw [ModuleCat.comp_apply]
        _ = (Limits.pushout.inr (ι.app p) (f.app p)).hom y := by rw [hinr]
        _ = e.hom.hom x := hy

name: TDA.Persistence.pushoutFiber_finiteDimensional
proof:
:= by
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hs.finiteDimensional p
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p × L'.obj p) := inferInstance
  let sourceIso := ModuleCat.biprodIsoProd (M.obj p) (L'.obj p)
  let BP : ModuleCat.{u} k := M.obj p ⊞ L'.obj p
  let PO : ModuleCat.{u} k := Limits.pushout (ι.app p) (f.app p)
  letI : FiniteDimensional k BP :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_surjective sourceIso.inv.hom
      ((ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective sourceIso.inv).mp inferInstance)
  let e := Limits.pushoutObjIso ι f p
  let φ : BP ⟶ PO :=
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.BiproductToPushoutIsCokernel.biproductToPushout
      (C := ModuleCat.{u} k) (ι.app p) (f.app p)
  have hφcolim :=
    CategoryTheory.Abelian.BiproductToPushoutIsCokernel.isColimitBiproductToPushout
      (C := ModuleCat.{u} k) (ι.app p) (f.app p)
  have hφepi : Epi φ := Cofork.IsColimit.epi hφcolim
  have hφsurj : Function.Surjective φ.hom := (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).1 hφepi
  haveI : FiniteDimensional k PO :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_surjective φ.hom hφsurj
  exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective e.hom.hom
    ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance)

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankExact.pushout
statement:
theorem IsRankExact.pushout (hs : IsRankExact ι π) (f : L ⟶ L')
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (L'.obj p)] :
    IsRankExact (Limits.pushout.inr ι f) (hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact.pushoutQuotient f)
proof:
:= by
  let hs' := hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact.pushout_pointwise f
  refine { toIsPointwiseShortExact := hs', finiteDimensional := ?_, rank_add := ?_ }
  · intro p
    exact pushoutFiber_finiteDimensional hs f p
  · intro a b hab
    letI : FiniteDimensional k ((Limits.pushout ι f).obj a) :=
      pushoutFiber_finiteDimensional hs f a
    apply (hs'.rank_add_iff_lift_kernel hab).mpr
    intro n hn
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmdie⟩ := hs.lift_kernel hab n hn
    refine ⟨((Limits.pushout.inl ι f).app a).hom m, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hq := congrArg (fun g : M ⟶ N => (g.app a).hom m)
        (hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact.pushoutQuotient_inl f)
      exact hq.trans hm
    · have h := congrArg
        (fun α : M.obj a ⟶ (Limits.pushout ι f).obj b => α.hom m)
        ((Limits.pushout.inl ι f).naturality (homOfLE hab))
      change ((Limits.pushout.inl ι f).app b).hom (structureMapLinear M hab m) =
        structureMapLinear (Limits.pushout ι f) hab (((Limits.pushout.inl ι f).app a).hom m) at h
      rw [hmdie, map_zero] at h
      exact h.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finiteDimensional_fiber
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_fiber (W : GradedGenerators.{v,w} P)
    [Finite W.Carrier] (a : P) :
    FiniteDimensional k ((module (R := k) W).obj a)
proof:
:= by
  change FiniteDimensional k (fiber (R := k) W a)
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.Presentation.finiteDimensional_of_finite_generators
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional_of_finite_generators
    (D : GradedFree.Presentation.{u,v,w} (R := k) (P := P))
    (hW : Finite D.generators.Carrier) (a : P) :
    FiniteDimensional k (D.presented.obj a)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Finite D.generators.Carrier := hW
  haveI : FiniteDimensional k ((module (R := k) D.generators).obj a) :=
    finiteDimensional_fiber D.generators a
  apply FiniteDimensional.of_surjective (D.cover.app a).hom
  exact D.cover_surjective a

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.finitelyPresented_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem finitelyPresented_finiteDimensional
    (M : PModule.{u,v,max u w} k P)
    (hM : FinitelyPresented (R := k) (P := P) M) (a : P) :
    FiniteDimensional k (M.obj a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨D, hD, ⟨e⟩⟩ := hM
  letI : FiniteDimensional k (D.presented.obj a) :=
    D.finiteDimensional_of_finite_generators hD.1 a
  exact (e.app a).toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional

proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.realInterleavingDistance_le_of_relation
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_le_of_relation (n : ℕ) :
    realInterleavingDistance (sublevelModule R (Rips.filter dX) n)
      (sublevelModule R (Rips.filter dY) n) ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
