:=
  (relationInterleaving R dX dY hCT hIT h n).distance_le

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_dgm_le_of_relation
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_le_of_relation [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter dX) n) (dgm k (Rips.filter dY) n) ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← moduleDiagram_sublevelModule k n (Rips.filter dX),
    ← moduleDiagram_sublevelModule k n (Rips.filter dY)]
  exact FiniteConstructible.bottleneck_le_of_interleaving
    (sublevelModule_isConstructible k n (Rips.filter dX))
    (sublevelModule_isConstructible k n (Rips.filter dY))
    (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n (Rips.filter dX))
    (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n (Rips.filter dY))
    (relationInterleaving k dX dY hCT hIT h n)

name: TDA.Persistence.RipsQTameDiagramExamples.unitInterval_infinite_fiber_with_diagram
statement:
theorem unitInterval_infinite_fiber_with_diagram (k : Type*) [Field k] :
    ¬ FiniteDimensional k
        ((sublevelModule k (Rips.filter
          (inferInstance : MetricSpace RipsQTameExamples.UnitInterval)) 0).obj 0) ∧
      Set.Countable {p | 0 < Rips.qTameDiagramMultiplicity k
        (X := RipsQTameExamples.UnitInterval) isCompact_univ.totallyBounded 0 p} ∧
      Set.Finite {p | p ∈ RectangleMeasure.tailRectangleCell (-1) 0 1 ∧
        0 < Rips.qTameDiagramMultiplicity k
          (X := RipsQTameExamples.UnitInterval) isCompact_univ.totallyBounded 0 p}
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨RipsQTameExamples.unitInterval_zero_not_finiteDimensional k,
    Rips.qTameDiagramMultiplicity_countable_support k isCompact_univ.totallyBounded 0, ?_⟩
  exact Rips.qTameDiagramMultiplicity_tail_locally_finite k
    isCompact_univ.totallyBounded 0 (-1) 0 1 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem totalFinitePowerCost_nonneg (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : 0 ≤ M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y
proof:
:=
  M.totalBoundaryCost_nonneg _ _ _
    (fun _ _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _)
    (fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _)
    (fun _ => Real.rpow_nonneg ENNReal.toReal_nonneg _)

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem totalFinitePowerCost_one (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    M.totalFinitePowerCost 1 x y = M.totalFiniteCost x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalFinitePowerCost totalBoundaryCost totalFiniteCost
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    cases M.finite i <;> simp only [Real.rpow_one]
  · simp only [Real.rpow_one]

name: TDA.Persistence.OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_relabel
statement:
theorem totalFinitePowerCost_relabel {I' J' : Type*} [Fintype I'] [Fintype J']
    (u : I' ≃ I) (v : J' ≃ J) (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1})
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    (M.relabel u v (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _)).totalFinitePowerCost p (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) =
      M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y
proof:
:=
  totalBoundaryCost_relabel u v M
    (fun i j => (finitePairCost (x i) (y j)).toReal ^ p)
    (fun i => (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p)
    (fun j => (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ p)

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_minimizing_powerMatching
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_powerMatching (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y = finitePowerMatchingCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :=
    occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff.mpr (by simp)
  exact exists_eq_ciInf_of_finite

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching
statement:
theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :
    finitePowerMatchingCost p x y ≤ M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y
proof:
:=
  ciInf_le ⟨0, by rintro _ ⟨N, rfl⟩; exact N.totalFinitePowerCost_nonneg p x y⟩ M

name: TDA.Persistence.le_finitePowerMatchingCost_iff
statement:
theorem le_finitePowerMatchingCost_iff (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    c ≤ finitePowerMatchingCost p x y ↔
      ∀ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}, c ≤ M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h M
    exact h.trans (finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching p x y M)
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerMatching p x y
    exact hM ▸ h M

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_nonneg (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    0 ≤ finitePowerMatchingCost p x y
proof:
:=
  (le_finitePowerMatchingCost_iff p x y 0).mpr fun M => M.totalFinitePowerCost_nonneg p x y

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_nonneg
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_nonneg (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    0 ≤ finitePMatchingCost p x y
proof: := Real.rpow_nonneg (finitePowerMatchingCost_nonneg p x y) _

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_le_matching
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_le_matching {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    (M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :
    finitePMatchingCost p x y ≤ M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:=
  Real.rpow_le_rpow (finitePowerMatchingCost_nonneg p x y)
    (finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching p x y M) (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_trans zero_le_one hp))

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_minimizing_pMatching
statement:
theorem exists_minimizing_pMatching (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹ = finitePMatchingCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerMatching p x y
  exact ⟨M, by rw [hM]; rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_eq_iInf
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_eq_iInf {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost p x y =
      ⨅ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}, M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  let : Nonempty (OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1}) :=
    occurrenceMatching_nonempty_iff.mpr (by simp)
  have hbd : BddBelow (Set.range fun M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1} =>
      M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y ^ p⁻¹) := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rintro _ ⟨M, rfl⟩
    exact Real.rpow_nonneg (M.totalFinitePowerCost_nonneg p x y) _
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact le_ciInf fun M => finitePMatchingCost_le_matching hp x y M
  · obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_pMatching p x y
    exact (ciInf_le hbd M).trans_eq hM

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_one (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePowerMatchingCost 1 x y = finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finitePowerMatchingCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost_one,
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem finitePMatchingCost_one (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost 1 x y = finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost x y
proof:
:= by
  simp [finitePMatchingCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right
statement:
theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right [IsEmpty J]
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePowerMatchingCost p x y = ∑ i, (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerMatching p x y
  have hn (i : I) : M.finite i = none := by
    cases h : M.finite i with
    | none => rfl
    | some j => exact isEmptyElim j
  rw [← hM]
  simp [OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost, hn]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_left
statement:
theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_left [IsEmpty I]
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePowerMatchingCost p x y = ∑ j, (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerMatching p x y
  rw [← hM]
  simp [OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_empty [IsEmpty I] [IsEmpty J]
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) : finitePowerMatchingCost p x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePowerMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right]; exact Fintype.sum_empty _

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right [IsEmpty J]
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost p x y = (∑ i, (diagonalCost (x i)).toReal ^ p) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePMatchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_right]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_left
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_left [IsEmpty I]
    (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost p x y = (∑ j, (diagonalCost (y j)).toReal ^ p) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePMatchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_of_isEmpty_left]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_empty
statement:
@[simp] theorem finitePMatchingCost_empty [IsEmpty I] [IsEmpty J]
    {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost p x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finitePMatchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_empty]
  exact Real.zero_rpow (inv_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)))

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_reindex
statement:
theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_reindex {I' J' : Type*} [Fintype I'] [Fintype J']
    (u : I' ≃ I) (v : J' ≃ J) (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePowerMatchingCost p (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) = finitePowerMatchingCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerMatching p x y
    calc
      _ ≤ (M.relabel u v (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _)).totalFinitePowerCost
          p (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) := finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching _ _ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [M.totalFinitePowerCost_relabel, hM]
  · obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_minimizing_powerMatching p (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v)
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=
      (OccurrenceMatching.relabelEquiv u v (Equiv.refl PEmpty.{1})
        (Equiv.refl PEmpty.{1})).surjective N
    have hcost := M.totalFinitePowerCost_relabel u v p x y
    change M.relabel u v (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _) = N at hM
    rw [hM] at hcost
    calc
      _ ≤ M.totalFinitePowerCost p x y := finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching _ _ _ _
      _ = _ := hcost.symm.trans hN

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePMatchingCost_reindex
statement:
theorem finitePMatchingCost_reindex {I' J' : Type*} [Fintype I'] [Fintype J']
    (u : I' ≃ I) (v : J' ≃ J) (p : ℝ) (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePMatchingCost p (x ∘ u) (y ∘ v) = finitePMatchingCost p x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [finitePMatchingCost, finitePowerMatchingCost_reindex]

name: TDA.Persistence.finitePowerMatchingCost_singleton
statement:
theorem finitePowerMatchingCost_singleton (p : ℝ) (x y : ℝ × ℝ) :
    finitePowerMatchingCost p (fun _ : Fin 1 => x) (fun _ : Fin 1 => y) =
      min ((finitePairCost x y).toReal ^ p)
        ((diagonalCost x).toReal ^ p + (diagonalCost y).toReal ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  let pair : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 1) (Fin 1) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1} :=
    ⟨fun i => some i, by intro i i' j hi hi'; simpa using hi.trans hi'.symm, Equiv.refl _⟩
  let delete : OccurrenceMatching (Fin 1) (Fin 1) PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1} :=
    ⟨fun _ => none, by simp, Equiv.refl _⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_min
    · simpa [pair, OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost]
        using finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching p (fun _ => x) (fun _ => y) pair
    · simpa [delete, OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost]
        using finitePowerMatchingCost_le_matching p (fun _ => x) (fun _ => y) delete
  · apply (le_finitePowerMatchingCost_iff p _ _ _).mpr
    intro M
    cases h : M.finite 0 with
    | none =>
      have hf (i : Fin 1) : M.finite i = none := by
        have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        simpa only [hi] using h
      simp [OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost, hf]
    | some j =>
      have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst j
      have hf (i : Fin 1) : M.finite i = some 0 := by
        have hi : i = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
        simpa only [hi] using h
      simp [OccurrenceMatching.totalFinitePowerCost, OccurrenceMatching.totalBoundaryCost, hf]

name: TDA.Persistence.structureMapRank_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem structureMapRank_eq_of_iso (e : M ≅ L)
    (i j : Fin N) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank M i j hij = structureMapRank L i j hij
proof:
:= by
  let E₀ := (e.app i).toLinearEquiv
  let E₁ := (e.app j).toLinearEquiv
  have hnat := NatIso.naturality_1 e (homOfLE hij)
  have hlin := congrArg (fun f : L.obj i ⟶ L.obj j => f.hom) hnat
  have hconj : structureMapLinear L hij =
      (E₁ : M.obj j →ₗ[k] L.obj j).comp
        ((structureMapLinear M hij).comp (E₀.symm : L.obj i →ₗ[k] M.obj i)) := by
    simpa only [E₀, E₁, structureMapLinear, structureMap,
      ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_assoc,
      Iso.toLinearEquiv_symm, Iso.toLinearMap_toLinearEquiv,
      Iso.app_hom, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.app] using hlin.symm
  have hsource : LinearMap.range (E₀.symm : L.obj i →ₗ[k] M.obj i) = ⊤ :=
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr E₀.symm.surjective
  unfold structureMapRank
  rw [hconj, LinearMap.range_comp]
  rw [LinearMap.range_comp_of_range_eq_top _ hsource]
  exact (E₁.finrank_map_eq (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hij))).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.rankBarcode_eq_of_iso
statement:
theorem rankBarcode_eq_of_iso (e : M ≅ L) :
    rankBarcode M = rankBarcode L
proof:
:= by
  apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff M L).2
  intro i j hij
  exact structureMapRank_eq_of_iso e i j hij

name: TDA.Persistence.rankBarcode_eq_of_iso_barcodeModule
statement:
theorem rankBarcode_eq_of_iso_barcodeModule
    (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval N))
    (e : M ≅ barcodeModule (k := k) B) : rankBarcode M = B
proof:
:= by
  calc
    rankBarcode M = rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := k) B) :=
      rankBarcode_eq_of_iso e
    _ = B := rankBarcode_barcodeModule B

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.homology_obj
statement:
theorem homology_obj (d : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ) (p : Index) :
    (homology R d n).obj p = simplicialHomology (bifiltration d p) R n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.homology_structureMap
statement:
theorem homology_structureMap (d : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ)
    {p q : Index} (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    structureMap (homology R d n) hpq =
      simplicialHomologyIncl R ((bifiltration d).monotone hpq) n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.cechBifiltration_eq
statement:
theorem cechBifiltration_eq {ι : Type w} [Fintype ι] (d : MetricSpace V)
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) :
    cechBifiltration p = bifiltration d
proof:
:= by
  apply OrderHom.ext
  funext a
  exact subdivision_openCech_eq d p hd a

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.cechHomology_eq
statement:
theorem cechHomology_eq {ι : Type w} [Fintype ι] (d : MetricSpace V)
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialHomologyPModule R (cechBifiltration p) n = homology R d n
proof:
:= by
  rw [cechBifiltration_eq d p hd]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.distanceCoordinates_cechHomology_eq
statement:
theorem distanceCoordinates_cechHomology_eq (d : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ) :
    simplicialHomologyPModule R (cechBifiltration (distanceCoordinates d)) n =
      homology R d n
proof:
:=
  cechHomology_eq R d (distanceCoordinates d)
    (fun v w => (distanceCoordinates_dist d v w).symm) n

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.metricInterleaving_left
statement:
theorem metricInterleaving_left (d e : MetricSpace V) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hde : ∀ v w, |d.dist v w - e.dist v w| ≤ 2 * δ) (n : ℕ) :
    (copy δ false).toFunctor ⋙ metricInterleaving R d e δ hde n = homology R d n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.metricInterleaving_right
statement:
theorem metricInterleaving_right (d e : MetricSpace V) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hde : ∀ v w, |d.dist v w - e.dist v w| ≤ 2 * δ) (n : ℕ) :
    (copy δ true).toFunctor ⋙ metricInterleaving R d e δ hde n = homology R e n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.pairwiseInterleaving_left
statement:
theorem pairwiseInterleaving_left (d e : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ) :
    (copy (perturbationParam d e) false).toFunctor ⋙ pairwiseInterleaving R d e n =
      homology R d n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.pairwiseInterleaving_right
statement:
theorem pairwiseInterleaving_right (d e : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ) :
    (copy (perturbationParam d e) true).toFunctor ⋙ pairwiseInterleaving R d e n =
      homology R e n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.SubdivisionRips.relabelVertex_symm_apply
statement:
theorem relabelVertex_symm_apply (e : V ≃ W) (s : Finset V) :
    relabelVertex e.symm (relabelVertex e s) = s
proof:
:= by
  simp [relabelVertex, Finset.map_map]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.count_death_step
statement:
private theorem count_death_step (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s)) (b d : ℕ)
    (hd : 0 < d) :
    B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ b ∧ d - 1 < I.death) =
      deathPrefixCount B b d + B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ b ∧ d < I.death)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction B using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [deathPrefixCount]
  | @cons I B ih =>
    simp only [deathPrefixCount, Multiset.countP_cons] at ih ⊢
    split_ifs <;> omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.count_terminal
statement:
private theorem count_terminal (B : Multiset (FiniteInterval s)) (b : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    B.countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ b ∧ s - 1 < I.death) = deathPrefixCount B b s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold deathPrefixCount
  apply Multiset.countP_congr rfl
  intro I _
  have := I.death_le_size
  apply propext
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hb, hd⟩
    exact ⟨hb, by omega⟩
  · rintro ⟨hb, hd⟩
    exact ⟨hb, by omega⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.finrank_restricted_kernel
statement:
private theorem finrank_restricted_kernel (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    {a c d : Fin s} (hac : a ≤ c) (hcd : c ≤ d) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker ((structureMapLinear M hcd).comp
      (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hac)).subtype)) =
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hac) ⊓
      LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M hcd) : Submodule k (M.obj c))
proof:
:= by
  let U := LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hac)
  rw [← Submodule.finrank_map_subtype_eq U
    (LinearMap.ker ((structureMapLinear M hcd).comp U.subtype))]
  change Module.finrank k (Submodule.map U.subtype
    (LinearMap.ker ((structureMapLinear M hcd).domRestrict U))) = _
  rw [LinearMap.ker_domRestrict, Submodule.map_comap_subtype]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathPrefixCount_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem deathPrefixCount_eq_finrank (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (b d : ℕ) (hbd : b < d) (hd : d < s) :
    deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode M) b d =
      Module.finrank k (deathSubspace M b d hbd hd)
proof:
:= by
  let a : Fin s := ⟨b, by omega⟩
  let c : Fin s := ⟨d - 1, by omega⟩
  let e : Fin s := ⟨d, hd⟩
  have hac : a ≤ c := by change b ≤ d - 1; omega
  have hce : c ≤ e := by change d - 1 ≤ d; omega
  have hcounts := count_death_step (rankBarcode M) b d (by omega)
  have hbefore := structureMapRank_rankBarcode M a c hac
  have hafter := structureMapRank_rankBarcode M a e (hac.trans hce)
  rw [rank_barcodeMap] at hbefore hafter
  have hdrop := structureMapRank_drop M a c e hac hce
  rw [finrank_restricted_kernel] at hdrop
  change structureMapRank M a c hac = structureMapRank M a e (hac.trans hce) +
    Module.finrank k (deathSubspace M b d hbd hd) at hdrop
  change (rankBarcode M).countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ b ∧ d - 1 < I.death) = _ at hbefore
  change (rankBarcode M).countP (fun I => I.birth ≤ b ∧ d < I.death) = _ at hafter
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathPrefixCount_terminal
statement:
theorem deathPrefixCount_terminal (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (b : ℕ) (hb : b < s) :
    deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode M) b s =
      structureMapRank M ⟨b, hb⟩ ⟨s - 1, by omega⟩ (by change b ≤ s - 1; omega)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← count_terminal _ _ (by omega)]
  have h := structureMapRank_rankBarcode M ⟨b, hb⟩ ⟨s - 1, by omega⟩
    (by change b ≤ s - 1; omega)
  rw [rank_barcodeMap] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathSubspaceMap_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hj _ (congrArg Subtype.val h)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.imageMap_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hj _ (congrArg Subtype.val hxy)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.deathPrefixCount_le_of_injective
statement:
theorem deathPrefixCount_le_of_injective {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin s)}
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj i)]
    (j : M ⟶ N) (hj : ∀ i, Function.Injective (j.app i).hom) (b d : ℕ)
    (hbd : b < d) (hd : d ≤ s) :
    deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode M) b d ≤ deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode N) b d
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hds : d < s
  · rw [deathPrefixCount_eq_finrank M b d hbd hds,
      deathPrefixCount_eq_finrank N b d hbd hds]
    exact LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (deathSubspaceMap_injective j hj b d hbd hds)
  · have hdeq : d = s := by omega
    subst d
    rw [deathPrefixCount_terminal M b hbd, deathPrefixCount_terminal N b hbd]
    exact LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_injective (imageMap_injective j hj _)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomExact.postcompose_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem postcompose_apply {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k S} (f : M ⟶ N)
    (g : HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ M) :
    postcompose (k := k) (S := S) f g = g ≫ f
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomExact.postcompose_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem postcompose_id (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k S) :
    postcompose (k := k) (S := S) (𝟙 M) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomExact.postcompose_comp
statement:
@[simp] theorem postcompose_comp {M N Q : PModule.{u,0,u} k S}
    (f : M ⟶ N) (g : N ⟶ Q) :
    postcompose (k := k) (S := S) (f ≫ g) =
      (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) g).comp
        (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) f)
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomExact.homFunctor_map_apply
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomExact.hookSum_isRankProjective
statement:
theorem hookSum_isRankProjective :
    IsRankProjective (HookSum (k := k) (S := S))
proof:
:=
  IsRankProjective.biproduct (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) (by
    intro t
    cases t with
    | inl ab => exact Hook.isRankProjective ab.property
    | inr a => exact HookInfinity.isRankProjective a)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomExact.rankExact_iff_postcompose_surjective
statement:
theorem rankExact_iff_postcompose_surjective
    {A B C : PModule.{u,0,u} k S} {ι : A ⟶ B} {π : B ⟶ C}
    (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π)
    (hfd : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (B.obj p)) :
    IsRankExact ι π ↔ Function.Surjective (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) π)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hr g
    obtain ⟨g', hg'⟩ := hookSum_isRankProjective (k := k) (S := S)
      A B C ι π hr g
    exact ⟨g', by simpa using hg'⟩
  · intro hsurj
    refine ⟨hs, hfd, ?_⟩
    intro a b hab
    letI : FiniteDimensional k (B.obj a) := hfd a
    apply (hs.rank_add_iff_lift_kernel hab).mpr
    intro c hc
    by_cases habEq : a = b
    · subst b
      have hc' : c = 0 := by simpa only [structureMapLinear_self, LinearMap.id_apply] using hc
      exact ⟨0, by simp [hc'], by simp⟩
    · have hab' : a < b := lt_of_le_of_ne hab habEq
      let t : HookTag (S := S) := .inl ⟨(a, b), hab'⟩
      let H : PModule.{u,0,u} k S := hookFamily (k := k) (S := S) t
      have hH : H = Hook.module (k := k) a b := rfl
      let gen : (Hook.module (k := k) a b).obj a :=
        SupportInterval.one (Hook.support a b) (Hook.birth_mem hab')
      let θ : Hook.module (k := k) a b ⟶ C :=
        (Hook.homEquivKernel hab' C).symm ⟨c, hc⟩
      have hθ : (θ.app a).hom gen = c := by
        exact congrArg Subtype.val
          ((Hook.homEquivKernel hab' C).apply_symm_apply ⟨c, hc⟩)
      let θ' : HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ C :=
        biproduct.π (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t ≫ eqToHom hH ≫ θ
      obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := hsurj θ'
      let incl : Hook.module (k := k) a b ⟶ HookSum (k := k) (S := S) :=
        eqToHom hH.symm ≫ biproduct.ι (hookFamily (k := k) (S := S)) t
      let lift : Hook.module (k := k) a b ⟶ B := incl ≫ g
      have hg' : g ≫ π = θ' := by
        change postcompose (k := k) (S := S) π g = θ'
        exact hg
      have hlift : lift ≫ π = θ := by
        dsimp [lift]
        calc
          (incl ≫ g) ≫ π = incl ≫ (g ≫ π) := Category.assoc _ _ _
          _ = incl ≫ θ' := congrArg (fun q => incl ≫ q) hg'
          _ = θ := by simp [incl, θ']
      refine ⟨(lift.app a).hom gen, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have h := congrArg (fun φ : Hook.module (k := k) a b ⟶ C =>
          (φ.app a).hom gen) hlift
        simpa [hθ] using h
      · exact Hook.generator_dies hab' lift

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomExact.homShortComplex_exact
statement:
theorem homShortComplex_exact
    {A B C : PModule.{u,0,u} k S} {ι : A ⟶ B} {π : B ⟶ C}
    (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) :
    (homShortComplex (k := k) (S := S) hs).Exact
proof:
:= by
  let S' := homShortComplex (k := k) (S := S) hs
  have hExact : S'.Exact := by
    rw [ShortComplex.moduleCat_exact_iff]
    intro f hf
    change postcompose (k := k) (S := S) π f = 0 at hf
    change HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ B at f
    let e := hs.kernelIso
    let fk : HookSum (k := k) (S := S) ⟶ kernel π :=
      kernel.lift π f hf
    refine ⟨fk ≫ e.inv, ?_⟩
    change postcompose (k := k) (S := S) ι (fk ≫ e.inv) = f
    dsimp [postcompose]
    have hfactor : fk ≫ kernel.ι π = f := by
      dsimp [fk]
      exact kernel.lift_ι π f hf
    have heι : e.hom ≫ kernel.ι π = ι := hs.kernelIso_hom_ι
    calc
      (fk ≫ e.inv) ≫ ι = (fk ≫ e.inv) ≫ (e.hom ≫ kernel.ι π) := by
        exact congrArg (fun q => (fk ≫ e.inv) ≫ q) heι.symm
      _ = ((fk ≫ e.inv) ≫ e.hom) ≫ kernel.ι π := Category.assoc _ _ _
      _ = fk ≫ kernel.ι π := by simp
      _ = f := hfactor
  simpa only [S'] using hExact

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveHomExact.homFunctor_map_shortExact
statement:
theorem homFunctor_map_shortExact
    {A B C : PModule.{u,0,u} k S} {ι : A ⟶ B} {π : B ⟶ C}
    (hs : IsRankExact ι π) :
    (homShortComplex (k := k) (S := S) hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact).ShortExact
proof:
:= by
  let S' := homShortComplex (k := k) (S := S) hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) π) :=
    (rankExact_iff_postcompose_surjective (k := k) (S := S)
      hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact hs.finiteDimensional).mp hs
  have hinj : Function.Injective (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) ι) := by
    intro f g h
    ext p x
    exact hs.injective p (congrArg (fun q => (q.app p).hom x) h)
  have hExact : S'.Exact :=
    homShortComplex_exact (k := k) (S := S) hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact
  haveI : Mono S'.f :=
    (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).2 (by
      change Function.Injective (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) ι)
      exact hinj)
  haveI : Epi S'.g :=
    (ModuleCat.epi_iff_surjective _).2 (by
      change Function.Surjective (postcompose (k := k) (S := S) π)
      exact hsurj)
  exact ⟨hExact⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicMeasure_ofIndexed
statement:
theorem atomicMeasure_ofIndexed (w : I → ℝ≥0) (x : I → Interior) :

  rw [atomicMeasure_apply _ s hs]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.atomicBoundaryPlan_ofIndexed_minimizing
statement:
theorem atomicBoundaryPlan_ofIndexed_minimizing (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (w : I → ℝ≥0) (v : J → ℝ≥0)
    (x : I → Interior) (y : J → Interior)
    (a : FiniteWeightedBoundaryPlan w v)
    (ha : a.powerCost p (fun i => (x i).1) (fun j => (y j).1) =
      weightedPowerBoundaryTransportCost p w v (fun i => (x i).1)
        (fun j => (y j).1)) :
    IsBoundaryPlan
      (atomicBoundaryPlan (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x)
        (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y) (a.aggregate x y))
      (atomicMeasure (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x))
      (atomicMeasure (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y)) ∧
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂atomicBoundaryPlan
      (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x) (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y)
      (a.aggregate x y)) =
      boundaryTransportPowerValue p
        (atomicMeasure (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed w x))
        (atomicMeasure (FiniteWeightedDiagram.ofIndexed v y))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact atomicBoundaryPlan_admissible _ _ _
  · rw [atomicBoundaryPlan_cost_native,
      FiniteWeightedDiagram.aggregate_minimizing_powerPlan p w v x y a ha,

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.singleton_value_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ (Cech.filter_value_nonneg a _)
  apply (Cech.filter_value_le_radiusAt a _ (a v)).trans
  exact (Cech.radiusAt_le_iff a (a v) {v} 0).mpr ⟨le_rfl, by simp⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.zero_mem_essentialPart_dgm
statement:
private theorem zero_mem_essentialPart_dgm (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (a : V → X) [Nonempty V] :
    0 ∈ essentialPart (dgm k (Cech.filter a) 0).points
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨v⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty V)
  let f := Cech.filter a
  let t := Cech.radiusAt a (a v) Finset.univ
  have ht : 0 ≤ t := Cech.radiusAt_nonneg a (a v) Finset.univ
  have hstage : f.sublevel t = Rips.fullComplex V :=
    sublevel_eq_fullComplex a (a v) le_rfl
  have hfull (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) : f.value s ≤ t := by
    apply (f.mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem t s).mp
    rw [hstage]
    exact s.property
  let σ : Face (f.sublevel 0) 0 :=
    ⟨{v}, (f.mem_sublevel_iff 0 {v}).mpr
      ⟨by simp, (singleton_value_eq_zero a v).le⟩, by simp⟩
  have hrank := finrank_homologyIncl_range_pos_of_vertex
    (f.sublevel 0) k (f.sublevel_mono ht) σ
  rw [rank_sublevelHomologyMap k f 0 0 t ht] at hrank
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hb, hd⟩ := Multiset.countP_pos.mp hrank
  have htop : p.2 = ⊤ := by
    by_contra hne
    have hparts : p ∈
        (finitePart (dgm k f 0).points).map (fun q => (q.1, (q.2 : WithTop ℝ))) +
          (essentialPart (dgm k f 0).points).map (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))) := by
      rw [parts_reconstruct]
      exact hp
    rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp hparts with hfinite | hessential
    · obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hfinite
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues f q.2).mp
        (mem_criticalValues_of_mem_finitePart_dgm k f hq).2
      have hdeath : q.2 ≤ t := by
        rw [← hs]
        exact hfull s
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr hdeath)) hd
    · obtain ⟨b, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hessential
      exact hne rfl
  have hessential : p.1 ∈ essentialPart (dgm k f 0).points := by
    apply (Multiset.mem_filterMap _ _).mpr
    exact ⟨p, hp, by simp [htop]⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues f p.1).mp
    (mem_criticalValues_of_mem_essentialPart_dgm k f hessential)
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ p.1 := by
    rw [← hs]
    exact Cech.filter_value_nonneg a s
  have hbirth : p.1 = 0 := le_antisymm hb hnonneg
  simpa only [hbirth] using hessential

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.essentialPart_dgm_zero_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem essentialPart_dgm_zero_eq_singleton (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (a : V → X) [Nonempty V] :
    essentialPart (dgm k (Cech.filter a) 0).points = ({0} : Multiset ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Multiset.card_eq_one.mp (card_essentialPart_dgm_zero k a)
  have hz : (0 : ℝ) = b := by
    simpa only [hb, Multiset.mem_singleton] using zero_mem_essentialPart_dgm k a
  simpa only [← hz] using hb

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.descendAt_apply
proof:
:= by
  simp [descendAt, LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective_symm_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.descend_image_apply
statement:
private theorem descend_image_apply {a c : Fin s} (h : a ≤ c) (x : M.obj a) :
    descendAt theta hTheta p hp hk c
      (structureMapLinear N h ((p.app a).hom x)) =
        structureMapLinear M (h.trans (hTheta c)) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← naturality_apply, descendAt_apply]
  exact (congrArg (fun L => L x) (structureMapLinear_comp M h (hTheta c))).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.translatedImageMap_surjective
statement:
private theorem translatedImageMap_surjective (b c : Fin s) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    Function.Surjective (translatedImageMap theta hTheta p hp hk b c hbc)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨_, x, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨⟨structureMapLinear N hbc ((p.app b).hom x), (p.app b).hom x, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact descend_image_apply theta hTheta p hp hk hbc x

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.translatedImageMap_previous
statement:
private theorem translatedImageMap_previous (b c : Fin s) (hb : 0 < b.val) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    birthPreviousImage N b.val c.val hb hbc c.isLt ≤
      (birthPreviousImage M b.val (theta c).val hb (hbc.trans (hTheta c))
        (theta c).isLt).comap (translatedImageMap theta hTheta p hp hk b c hbc)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨y, hy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hp ⟨b.val - 1, by omega⟩ y
  change descendAt theta hTheta p hp hk c x.val ∈ LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M _)
  change structureMapLinear N _ ((p.app _).hom z) = x.val at hy
  rw [← hy]
  exact ⟨z, (descend_image_apply theta hTheta p hp hk
    (show (⟨b.val - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin s) ≤ c from by change b.val - 1 ≤ c.val; omega) z).symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.translatedBirthQuotientMap_surjective
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  induction y using Submodule.Quotient.induction_on with
  | H y =>
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := translatedImageMap_surjective theta hTheta p hp hk b c hbc y
    exact ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk x, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteBarcode.birthSuffixCount_translated_le_of_kernelTrivial
statement:
theorem birthSuffixCount_translated_le_of_kernelTrivial
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj i)]
    (b c : Fin s) (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode M) b.val (theta c).val ≤
      birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode N) b.val c.val
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : b.val = 0
  · let z : Fin s := ⟨0, (Nat.zero_le c.val).trans_lt c.isLt⟩
    have hbz : b = z := Fin.ext hb
    subst b
    change birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode M) 0 (theta c).val ≤
      birthSuffixCount (rankBarcode N) 0 c.val
    rw [birthSuffixCount_zero M _ (theta c).isLt, birthSuffixCount_zero N _ c.isLt]
    exact LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_surjective
      (translatedImageMap_surjective theta hTheta p hp hk z c hbc)
  · have hbpos : 0 < b.val := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hb
    rw [birthSuffixCount_eq_finrank M b.val (theta c).val hbpos
      (hbc.trans (hTheta c)) (theta c).isLt,
      birthSuffixCount_eq_finrank N b.val c.val hbpos hbc c.isLt]
    exact LinearMap.finrank_le_finrank_of_surjective
      (translatedBirthQuotientMap_surjective theta hTheta p hp hk b c hbpos hbc)

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.stabilityConstant_values
statement:
theorem stabilityConstant_values :
    PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant 1 1 (π / 2) = 2 + 3 * √(π / 2) ∧
      PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant 1 0 (π / 2) = 3 * √(π / 2)
proof:

  constructor <;> · rw [PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_arctan]; norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.zero_weight_image
statement:
theorem zero_weight_image {K : Type*} [Fintype K] (σ : ℝ) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (D : Diagram ℝ) : finiteDiagramImage σ (arctanWeight 0 le_rfl) P D = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [finiteDiagramImage_eq_sum]
  refine Multiset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨u, -, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hx
  rw [feature, PersistenceImage.arctanWeight_apply, zero_mul, Real.arctan_zero, zero_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.zero_weight_embedding
statement:
theorem zero_weight_embedding (σ : ℝ) (D : Diagram ℝ) :
    WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (arctanWeight 0 le_rfl) D = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding_eq_sum]
  refine Multiset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨u, -, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hx
  rw [PersistenceImage.arctanWeight_apply, zero_mul, Real.arctan_zero, zero_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.zero_weight_not_sharp
statement:
theorem zero_weight_not_sharp {K : Type*} [Fintype K] (σ : ℝ) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (D E : Diagram ℝ) :
    ‖finiteDiagramImage σ (arctanWeight 0 le_rfl) P D -
        finiteDiagramImage σ (arctanWeight 0 le_rfl) P E‖ = 0 ∧
      ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (arctanWeight 0 le_rfl) D -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ (arctanWeight 0 le_rfl) E‖ = 0 ∧
      0 < PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant 1 0 (π / 2) ∧
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant 1 0 (π / 2) = √2 * π / 2 ∧
      0 < WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant 1 0 (π / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant 1 0 (π / 2) = √2 * π / 2 := by
    rw [WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_arctan]; norm_num
  refine ⟨by simp [zero_weight_image], by simp [zero_weight_embedding], ?_, hk, ?_⟩
  · rw [stabilityConstant_values.2]
    have : 0 < √(π / 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr Real.pi_div_two_pos
    positivity
  · rw [hk]
    have : 0 < √2 := by positivity
    have := Real.pi_pos
    positivity

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.obstructed_norm

  rw [finiteDiagramImage_eq_sum, finiteDiagramImage_eq_sum, obstructed_finite, empty_finite,
    Multiset.map_singleton, Multiset.sum_singleton, Multiset.map_zero, Multiset.sum_zero,
    sub_zero, feature, norm_smul, norm_wholePlane, mul_one,
    arctanWeight_birthPersistence 1 zero_le_one (by norm_num)]
  norm_num [abs_of_pos (Real.arctan_pos.mpr two_pos)]

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.infinite_bottleneck_boundary
statement:
theorem infinite_bottleneck_boundary :
    obstructedDiagram.IsPositive ∧ emptyDiagram.IsPositive ∧
      bottleneck obstructedDiagram emptyDiagram = ⊤ ∧
      ‖finiteDiagramImage 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) wholePlane obstructedDiagram -
          finiteDiagramImage 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) wholePlane emptyDiagram‖ =
        Real.arctan 2 ∧
      0 < Real.arctan 2 ∧
      ¬ ‖finiteDiagramImage 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) wholePlane obstructedDiagram -
          finiteDiagramImage 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) wholePlane emptyDiagram‖ ≤
        (2 * 1 + 3 * √(π / 2) / 1) *
          ((Fintype.card obstructedDiagram.finiteOccurrences +
            Fintype.card emptyDiagram.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            (bottleneck obstructedDiagram emptyDiagram).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < Real.arctan 2 := Real.arctan_pos.mpr two_pos
  refine ⟨obstructed_positive, empty_positive, obstructed_bottleneck, obstructed_norm, hpos,
    ?_⟩
  rw [obstructed_norm, obstructed_bottleneck, ENNReal.toReal_top, mul_zero]
  exact not_le.mpr hpos

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.metricOne_dist
statement:
private theorem metricOne_dist (i j : Fin 2) :
    metricOne.dist i j = if i = j then 0 else 1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.metricTwo_dist
statement:
private theorem metricTwo_dist (i j : Fin 2) :
    metricTwo.dist i j = if i = j then 0 else 2
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.nonzero_discrepancy
statement: private theorem nonzero_discrepancy : Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy metricOne metricTwo = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (Finset.fold_max_le 1).mpr
    refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨i, j⟩ _
    change |(if i = j then 0 else 1) - (if i = j then 0 else 2)| ≤ 1
    split_ifs <;> norm_num
  · have h := Rips.abs_dist_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy metricOne metricTwo 0 1
    rw [metricOne_dist, metricTwo_dist] at h
    norm_num at h
    exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.ArctanPersistenceImageExamples.rips_perturbed_arctan
statement:
theorem rips_perturbed_arctan (n : ℕ) {K : Type*} [Fintype K] (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j)) (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖finiteDiagramImage 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) P (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricOne) n) -
        finiteDiagramImage 1 (arctanWeight 1 zero_le_one) P
          (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricTwo) n)‖ ≤
      (2 + 3 * √(π / 2)) *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricOne) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm ℚ (Rips.filter metricTwo) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Rips.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy_arctan ℚ metricOne
    metricTwo n one_pos zero_le_one P hm hd
  rw [nonzero_discrepancy, mul_one] at h
  convert h using 2
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.inv_mul_sub_eq_one_sub_inv_mul
proof:
:= by
  have hinvtop : R⁻¹ ≠ ∞ := ENNReal.inv_ne_top.mpr hRpos.ne'
  rw [ENNReal.mul_sub (fun _ _ => hinvtop), ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hRpos.ne' hRtop.ne]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.normalizedReservoirMeasure_eq_reservoirMeasure_inv
statement:
theorem normalizedReservoirMeasure_eq_reservoirMeasure_inv
    (μ : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R) :
    normalizedReservoirMeasure μ R = reservoirMeasure (R⁻¹ • μ) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hcoef := inv_mul_sub_eq_one_sub_inv_mul R (μ Set.univ) hRtop hRpos
  apply Measure.ext
  intro s hs
  simp only [normalizedReservoirMeasure, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    reservoirMeasure, Measure.add_apply, Measure.map_smul]
  rw [mul_add]
  congr 1
  rw [← mul_assoc, hcoef]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.scaledReservoirPair_originalMass_le_one
statement:
theorem scaledReservoirPair_originalMass_le_one (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R)
    (htotal : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R) :
    (R⁻¹ • μ) Set.univ + (R⁻¹ • ν) Set.univ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  calc
    R⁻¹ * μ Set.univ + R⁻¹ * ν Set.univ = R⁻¹ * (μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ) := by
      rw [mul_add]
    _ ≤ R⁻¹ * R := by
      simpa only [mul_comm R⁻¹] using mul_le_mul_left htotal R⁻¹
    _ = 1 := ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hRpos.ne' hRtop.ne

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.scaledReservoirPair_isProbability
statement:
theorem scaledReservoirPair_isProbability (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R)
    (htotal : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (reservoirMeasure (R⁻¹ • μ) 1) ∧
      IsProbabilityMeasure (reservoirMeasure (R⁻¹ • ν) 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases normalizedReservoirPair_isProbability μ ν R hRtop hRpos htotal with ⟨hμ, hν⟩
  exact ⟨by
      rw [← normalizedReservoirMeasure_eq_reservoirMeasure_inv μ R hRtop hRpos]
      exact hμ,
    by
      rw [← normalizedReservoirMeasure_eq_reservoirMeasure_inv ν R hRtop hRpos]
      exact hν⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirMeasure_scale_back
proof:
:= by
  rw [← normalizedReservoirMeasure_eq_reservoirMeasure_inv μ R hRtop hRpos,
    normalizedReservoirMeasure, smul_smul, mul_comm R R⁻¹,
    ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hRpos.ne' hRtop.ne, one_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirCompetitor_scale_down
statement:
private theorem reservoirCompetitor_scale_down (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R) (γ : Measure (Space × Space))
    (hγ : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R ∧
      γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R) :
    (R⁻¹ • γ).map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure (R⁻¹ • μ) 1 ∧
      (R⁻¹ • γ).map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure (R⁻¹ • ν) 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [Measure.map_smul, hγ.1]
    simpa only [normalizedReservoirMeasure] using
      normalizedReservoirMeasure_eq_reservoirMeasure_inv μ R hRtop hRpos
  · rw [Measure.map_smul, hγ.2]
    simpa only [normalizedReservoirMeasure] using
      normalizedReservoirMeasure_eq_reservoirMeasure_inv ν R hRtop hRpos

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirCompetitor_scale_up
statement:
private theorem reservoirCompetitor_scale_up (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R) (η : Measure (Space × Space))
    (hη : η.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure (R⁻¹ • μ) 1 ∧
      η.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure (R⁻¹ • ν) 1) :
    (R • η).map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R ∧
      (R • η).map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [Measure.map_smul, hη.1]
    exact reservoirMeasure_scale_back μ R hRtop hRpos
  · rw [Measure.map_smul, hη.2]
    exact reservoirMeasure_scale_back ν R hRtop hRpos

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirPowerValue_normalization
statement:
theorem reservoirPowerValue_normalization (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R) :
    reservoirPowerValue p μ ν R =
      R * reservoirPowerValue p (R⁻¹ • μ) (R⁻¹ • ν) 1
proof:
:= by
  change (⨅ γ : Measure (Space × Space),
      ⨅ (_ : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R ∧
        γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R),
        ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂γ) =
    R * (⨅ η : Measure (Space × Space),
      ⨅ (_ : η.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure (R⁻¹ • μ) 1 ∧
        η.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure (R⁻¹ • ν) 1),
        ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂η)
  apply le_antisymm
  · simp_rw [ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne hRpos.ne' hRtop.ne]
    refine le_iInf fun η => le_iInf fun hη => ?_
    have hγ := reservoirCompetitor_scale_up μ ν R hRtop hRpos η hη
    calc
      (⨅ γ : Measure (Space × Space),
          ⨅ (_ : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure μ R ∧
            γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure ν R),
            ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂γ) ≤
          ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂(R • η) := by
        exact (iInf_le _ (R • η)).trans (iInf_le _ hγ)
      _ = R * ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂η := by
        rw [lintegral_smul_measure, smul_eq_mul]
  · simp_rw [ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne hRpos.ne' hRtop.ne]
    refine le_iInf fun γ => le_iInf fun hγ => ?_
    have hη := reservoirCompetitor_scale_down μ ν R hRtop hRpos γ hγ
    calc
      (⨅ η : Measure (Space × Space),
          ⨅ (_ : η.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure (R⁻¹ • μ) 1 ∧
            η.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure (R⁻¹ • ν) 1),
            R * ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂η) ≤
          R * ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂(R⁻¹ • γ) := by
        exact (iInf_le _ (R⁻¹ • γ)).trans (iInf_le _ hη)
      _ = ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost p z ∂γ := by
        rw [lintegral_smul_measure, smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc,
          ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hRpos.ne' hRtop.ne, one_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirDistance_normalization
statement:
theorem reservoirDistance_normalization (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R) :
    reservoirDistance p μ ν R =
      R ^ (1 / p) * reservoirDistance p (R⁻¹ • μ) (R⁻¹ • ν) 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold reservoirDistance
  rw [reservoirPowerValue_normalization p μ ν R hRtop hRpos,
    ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (one_div_nonneg.mpr hp.le)]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_eq_normalizedReservoirDistance
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_eq_normalizedReservoirDistance
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R)
    (htotal : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R) :
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν =
      R ^ (1 / p) * reservoirDistance p (R⁻¹ • μ) (R⁻¹ • ν) 1
proof:
:=
  (boundaryTransportDistance_eq_reservoirDistance p hp μ ν R hRtop htotal).trans
    (reservoirDistance_normalization p (lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp)
      μ ν R hRtop hRpos)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundedInterval.ordConnected
statement: theorem ordConnected (I : BoundedInterval) : I.support.OrdConnected
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x hx y hy z hz
  rcases hx with ⟨hx, _⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨_, hy⟩
  constructor
  · rcases hx with hx | ⟨hx, hc⟩
    · exact Or.inl (hx.trans_le hz.1)
    · by_cases h : x = z
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hx.trans h, hc⟩
      · exact Or.inl (hx ▸ lt_of_le_of_ne hz.1 h)
  · rcases hy with hy | ⟨hy, hc⟩
    · exact Or.inl (hz.2.trans_lt hy)
    · by_cases h : z = y
      · exact Or.inr ⟨h.trans hy, hc⟩
      · exact Or.inl (hy ▸ lt_of_le_of_ne hz.2 h)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundedInterval.exists_mem_add_iff
statement:
theorem exists_mem_add_iff (I : BoundedInterval) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (∃ x, x ∈ I.support ∧ x + δ ∈ I.support) ↔
      δ < I.upper - I.lower ∨
        (δ = I.upper - I.lower ∧ I.lowerClosed = true ∧ I.upperClosed = true)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hy⟩
    have hl : I.lower ≤ x := hx.1.elim le_of_lt (fun h => h.1.le)
    have hu : x + δ ≤ I.upper := hy.2.elim le_of_lt (fun h => h.1.le)
    by_cases h : δ < I.upper - I.lower
    · exact Or.inl h
    · have he : δ = I.upper - I.lower := by linarith
      have hx' : x = I.lower := by linarith
      have hy' : x + δ = I.upper := by linarith
      refine Or.inr ⟨he, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rcases hx.1 with hh | hh
        · exact False.elim (by linarith)
        · exact hh.2
      · rcases hy.2 with hh | hh
        · exact False.elim (by linarith)
        · exact hh.2
  · rintro (h | ⟨h, hl, hu⟩)
    · refine ⟨(I.lower + I.upper - δ) / 2, ?_, ?_⟩
      · exact ⟨Or.inl (by linarith), Or.inl (by linarith)⟩
      · exact ⟨Or.inl (by linarith), Or.inl (by linarith)⟩
    · refine ⟨I.lower, ⟨Or.inr ⟨rfl, hl⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
      · have hle : I.lower ≤ I.upper := by linarith
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hle with hh | hh
        · exact Or.inl hh
        · exact Or.inr ⟨hh, hu⟩
      · constructor
        · by_cases hd : δ = 0
          · exact Or.inr ⟨by simp [hd], hl⟩
          · have hdpos : 0 < δ := lt_of_le_of_ne hδ (Ne.symm hd)
            exact Or.inl (by linarith)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨by linarith, hu⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundedInterval.support_nonempty
statement: theorem support_nonempty (I : BoundedInterval) : I.support.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have h : (0 : ℝ) < I.upper - I.lower ∨
      (0 = I.upper - I.lower ∧ I.lowerClosed = true ∧ I.upperClosed = true) := by
    rcases I.nonempty with h | ⟨h, hl, hu⟩
    · exact Or.inl (by linarith)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨by linarith, hl, hu⟩
  obtain ⟨x, hx, _⟩ := (I.exists_mem_add_iff 0 le_rfl).mpr h
  exact ⟨x, hx⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rectangle.ordConnected
statement: theorem ordConnected {n : ℕ} (R : Rectangle n) : R.support.OrdConnected
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro p hp q hq r hr i
  exact (R i).ordConnected.out (hp i) (hq i) ⟨hr.1 i, hr.2 i⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rectangle.support_nonempty
statement: theorem support_nonempty {n : ℕ} (R : Rectangle n) : R.support.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose p hp using fun i => (R i).support_nonempty
  exact ⟨p, hp⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rectangle.inf_mem
statement:
theorem inf_mem {n : ℕ} (R : Rectangle n) {p q : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ R.support) (hq : q ∈ R.support) : p ⊓ q ∈ R.support
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  change min (p i) (q i) ∈ (R i).support
  rw [min_def]
  split_ifs
  · exact hp i
  · exact hq i

name: TDA.Persistence.Rectangle.hom_coefficient_eq
statement:
theorem hom_coefficient_eq {n : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (α : R.module (k := k) ⟶ S.module)
    {p q : Fin n → ℝ} (hpR : p ∈ R.support) (hpS : p ∈ S.support)
    (hqR : q ∈ R.support) (hqS : q ∈ S.support) :
    (((α.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR)) : k) =
      (((α.app q).hom (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hqR)) : k)
proof:
:= by
  have hmR := R.inf_mem hpR hqR
  have hmp := SupportInterval.coefficient_eq_of_le R.support S.support
    R.ordConnected S.ordConnected α inf_le_left hmR hpR hpS
  have hmq := SupportInterval.coefficient_eq_of_le R.support S.support
    R.ordConnected S.ordConnected α inf_le_right hmR hqR hqS
  exact hmp.symm.trans hmq

name: TDA.Persistence.Rectangle.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {n : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (R S : Rectangle n) (α β : R.module (k := k) ⟶ S.module)
    {p : Fin n → ℝ} (hpR : p ∈ R.support) (hpS : p ∈ S.support)
    (h : (((α.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR)) : k) =
      (((β.app p).hom (SupportInterval.one (k := k) R.support hpR)) : k)) : α = β
proof:
:= by
  ext q x
  by_cases hqR : q ∈ R.support
  · by_cases hqS : q ∈ S.support
    · rw [SupportInterval.app_val_eq_mul R.support S.support R.ordConnected
        S.ordConnected α hqR x,
        SupportInterval.app_val_eq_mul R.support S.support R.ordConnected
        S.ordConnected β hqR x,
        ← hom_coefficient_eq R S α hpR hpS hqR hqS,
        ← hom_coefficient_eq R S β hpR hpS hqR hqS, h]
    · rw [SupportInterval.val_eq_zero S.support hqS,
        SupportInterval.val_eq_zero S.support hqS]
  · have hx : x = 0 := Subtype.ext (SupportInterval.val_eq_zero R.support hqR x)
    simp [hx]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rectangle.exists_mem_add_iff
statement:
theorem exists_mem_add_iff {n : ℕ} (R : Rectangle n) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (∃ p, p ∈ R.support ∧ (fun i => p i + δ) ∈ R.support) ↔
      ∀ i, δ < (R i).upper - (R i).lower ∨
        (δ = (R i).upper - (R i).lower ∧
          (R i).lowerClosed = true ∧ (R i).upperClosed = true)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, hq⟩ i
    exact ((R i).exists_mem_add_iff δ hδ).mp ⟨p i, hp i, hq i⟩
  · intro h
    classical
    choose p hp hq using fun i => ((R i).exists_mem_add_iff δ hδ).mpr (h i)
    exact ⟨p, hp, hq⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rectangle.diagonal_maps_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem diagonal_maps_eq_zero_iff {n : ℕ} {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (R : Rectangle n) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (∀ p : Fin n → ℝ,
      structureMapLinear (R.module (k := k))
        (show p ≤ (fun i => p i + δ) from fun _i => le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ) = 0) ↔
      ∃ i, (R i).upper - (R i).lower < δ ∨
        ((R i).upper - (R i).lower = δ ∧
          ((R i).lowerClosed = false ∨ (R i).upperClosed = false))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hmap :
      (∀ p : Fin n → ℝ,
        structureMapLinear (R.module (k := k))
          (show p ≤ (fun i => p i + δ) from fun i => le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ) = 0) ↔
        ¬ ∃ p, p ∈ R.support ∧ (fun i => p i + δ) ∈ R.support := by
    constructor
    · intro h ⟨p, hp, hq⟩
      exact ((SupportInterval.structureMap_eq_zero_iff R.support R.ordConnected
        (show p ≤ (fun i => p i + δ) from fun i => le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ)).mp
        (h p)) ⟨hp, hq⟩
    · intro h p
      apply (SupportInterval.structureMap_eq_zero_iff R.support R.ordConnected
        (show p ≤ (fun i => p i + δ) from fun i => le_add_of_nonneg_right hδ)).mpr
      exact fun hp => h ⟨p, hp⟩
  rw [hmap, exists_mem_add_iff R δ hδ]
  push Not
  apply exists_congr
  intro i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hle, hn⟩
    by_cases hlt : (R i).upper - (R i).lower < δ
    · exact Or.inl hlt
    · have he : (R i).upper - (R i).lower = δ := by linarith
      right
      refine ⟨he, ?_⟩
      cases hcl : (R i).lowerClosed <;> cases hcu : (R i).upperClosed <;>
        simp_all
  · rintro (hlt | ⟨he, hc⟩)
    · exact ⟨hlt.le, fun h => False.elim (by linarith)⟩
    · refine ⟨he.le, ?_⟩
      intro _ hcl
      rcases hc with hc | hc
      · simp [hcl] at hc
      · simp [hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_of_lt
statement:
theorem FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_of_lt {s : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval s)
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (h : I.death < s) :
    I.translatedDeath theta = (theta ⟨I.death, h⟩).val
proof: := dif_pos h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_terminal
statement:
theorem FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_terminal {s : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval s)
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (h : I.death = s) : I.translatedDeath theta = s
proof:
:= by
  simp [translatedDeath, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_congr
statement:
theorem FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_congr {s : ℕ} (I J : FiniteInterval s)
    (theta : Fin s →o Fin s) (h : I.death = J.death) :
    I.translatedDeath theta = J.translatedDeath theta
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : I.death < s
  · have hj : J.death < s := h ▸ hi
    rw [translatedDeath_of_lt I theta hi, translatedDeath_of_lt J theta hj]
    exact congrArg (fun i : Fin s => (theta i).val) (Fin.ext h)
  · have hj : ¬ J.death < s := h ▸ hi
    simp only [translatedDeath, dif_neg hi, dif_neg hj]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_id
statement:
theorem FiniteInterval.translatedDeath_id {s : ℕ} (I : FiniteInterval s) :
    I.translatedDeath (OrderHom.id : Fin s →o Fin s) = I.death
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : I.death < s
  · rw [translatedDeath_of_lt I _ h]; rfl
  · have := I.death_le_size
    simp [translatedDeath, show I.death = s by omega]

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.crossing_eq_zero_of_isZero
statement:
private theorem crossing_eq_zero_of_isZero {b c : ℝ} (hbc : b ≤ c)
    (hb : IsZero (M.obj b)) : structureMapLinear M hbc = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (structureMap M hbc).hom = 0
  rw [hb.eq_of_src (structureMap M hbc) 0]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleDiagramMultiplicity_zero_below_birth_cell
statement:
theorem moduleDiagramMultiplicity_zero_below_birth_cell (hM : M.QTame)
    (T : ℝ) (hzero : ∀ t < T, IsZero (M.obj t)) {a b : ℝ} (hbT : b < T)
    {p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ} (hpBirth : p.1 ∈ cutCell a b) :
    moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hpos := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hpU⟩ := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_visible_of_pos M hM hpos
  rcases hU with rfl | ⟨e, f, g, d, _, hfg, hgd, rfl⟩
  · exact hpU.elim
  · have hpB : p.1 ∈ cutCell (max a e) (min b f) := by
      rw [← cutCell_inter]
      exact ⟨hpBirth, hpU.1⟩
    have hgap : min b f < g := (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt hfg
    have hmap := crossing_eq_zero_of_isZero M hgap.le
      (hzero _ ((min_le_left _ _).trans_lt hbT))
    have hle := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_le_content M hM
      (rectangleCell_mem_separatedRectangleCells (max a e) (min b f) g d hgap)
      (show p ∈ rectangleCell (max a e) (min b f) g d from ⟨hpB, hpU.2⟩)
    rw [moduleRectangleContent_apply M hM _ _ _ _ (lt_of_mem_cutCell hpB) hgap hgd,
      persistenceMeasureValue_eq_zero_of_crossing_eq_zero M _ _ _ hmap] at hle
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleEssentialMultiplicity_zero_below_birth_cell
statement:
theorem moduleEssentialMultiplicity_zero_below_birth_cell (hM : M.QTame)
    (T : ℝ) (hzero : ∀ t < T, IsZero (M.obj t)) {a b : ℝ} (hbT : b < T)
    {birth : Cut ℝ} (hb : birth ∈ cutCell a b) :
    moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM birth = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hab : a < b := lt_of_mem_cutCell hb
  have hcross : b < b + 1 := lt_add_one b
  let : FiniteDimensional k (persistenceImage M hcross.le) := hM b (b + 1) hcross
  have hmap := crossing_eq_zero_of_isZero M hcross.le (hzero b hbT)
  have hImage : persistenceImage M hcross.le = ⊥ := by simp [persistenceImage, hmap]
  have hle := essentialMeasureValue_le_crossing_rank M hab.le hcross
  rw [hImage, finrank_bot] at hle
  have hpoint := moduleEssentialMultiplicity_le_content M hM (cutCell_mem_cutCells a b) hb
  rw [essentialCutContent_apply M hM hab.le] at hpoint
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.exists_cell_below_of_endpoint_lt
proof:
:= by
  let u := (cutEndpoint birth + T) / 2
  have hru : cutEndpoint birth < u := by dsimp [u]; linarith
  have huT : u < T := by dsimp [u]; linarith
  have hBound : BddAbove birth.lower := ⟨b, fun _ ht => (birth.lower_lt_upper ht hb.2).le⟩
  have huNot : u ∉ birth.lower := fun hu => (not_le_of_gt hru) (le_csSup hBound hu)
  have hu := (birth.mem_lower_or_upper u).resolve_left huNot
  exact ⟨a, u, huT, hb.1, hu⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_birth_lower_bound
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  have hrT : cutEndpoint p.1 < T := lt_of_not_ge hn
  by_cases hInf : p.2 = infinityCut
  · have hess : 0 < moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM p.1 := by
      simpa only [moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity, if_pos hInf] using hp
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hpU⟩ := moduleEssentialMultiplicity_visible_of_pos M hM hess
    obtain ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩ := hU
    obtain ⟨a', b', hb'T, hpB⟩ := exists_cell_below_of_endpoint_lt hpU hrT
    have hz := moduleEssentialMultiplicity_zero_below_birth_cell M hM T hzero hb'T hpB
    omega
  · have hfinite : 0 < moduleDiagramMultiplicity M hM p := by
      simpa only [moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity, if_neg hInf] using hp
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hpU⟩ := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_visible_of_pos M hM hfinite
    rcases hU with rfl | ⟨a, b, c, d, _, _, _, rfl⟩
    · exact hpU.elim
    · obtain ⟨a', b', hb'T, hpB⟩ := exists_cell_below_of_endpoint_lt hpU.1 hrT
      have hz := moduleDiagramMultiplicity_zero_below_birth_cell M hM T hzero hb'T hpB
      omega

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.labelCount_image_eq_card
statement:
private theorem labelCount_image_eq_card {A : Type*} {Z : Type*} [Fintype A]
    (p : A → Z) (hp : Function.Injective p) (S : Finset A) :
    labelCount p (p '' (S : Set A)) = S.card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold labelCount
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter (fun a => p a ∈ p '' (S : Set A)) = S := by
    ext a
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    change p a ∈ p '' (S : Set A) ↔ a ∈ S
    rw [Set.mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, hb, hba⟩
      have : b = a := hp hba
      simpa [this] using hb
    · intro ha
      exact ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  rw [hfilter]

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.nearLabel_mass_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem nearLabel_mass_lower_bound {δ : ℝ≥0}
    {A : Type*} {B : Type*} {Z : Type*} [MetricSpace Z]
    [MeasurableSpace Z] [OpensMeasurableSpace Z]
    [Fintype A] [Nonempty A] [Fintype B] [Nonempty B]
    (p : A → Z) (q : B → Z) (hp : Function.Injective p) (hq : Function.Injective q)
    (hcost : levyProkhorovEDist (uniformMeasure p) (uniformMeasure q) <
      (δ : ℝ≥0∞))
    (S : Finset A) (T : Finset B)
    (hnear : ∀ b, b ∈ T ↔ ∃ a ∈ S, dist (q b) (p a) < (δ : ℝ))
    {a b : Index}
    (hlarge : mass a ≤ (S.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card A)
    (hcross : mass b + δ ≤ mass a) :
    mass b ≤ (T.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : MeasurableSpace Z := ‹MeasurableSpace Z›
  let leftImage : Set Z := p '' (S : Set A)
  let thickImage : Set Z := Metric.thickening (δ : ℝ) leftImage
  let rightImage : Set Z := q '' (T : Set B)
  have hleftFinite : leftImage.Finite := S.finite_toSet.image p
  have hrightFinite : rightImage.Finite := T.finite_toSet.image q
  have hleftMeas : MeasurableSet leftImage := hleftFinite.measurableSet
  have hthickMeas : MeasurableSet thickImage := isOpen_thickening.measurableSet
  have hrightMeas : MeasurableSet rightImage := hrightFinite.measurableSet
  have hLP := left_measure_le_of_levyProkhorovEDist_lt hcost hleftMeas
  have hsupported : uniformMeasure q thickImage ≤ uniformMeasure q rightImage :=
    uniformMeasure_apply_le_of_label_mem q q hthickMeas hrightMeas (by
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hyz⟩ := mem_thickening_iff.mp hy
      change z ∈ p '' (S : Set A) at hz
      rcases (Set.mem_image p (S : Set A) z).mp hz with ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
      have hynear : y ∈ T := (hnear y).2 ⟨x, hx, hyz⟩
      exact ⟨y, hynear, rfl⟩)
  have hmeasure : uniformMeasure p leftImage ≤ uniformMeasure q rightImage + (δ : ℝ≥0∞) :=
    hLP.trans (add_le_add hsupported le_rfl)
  have hmeasureReal := ENNReal.toReal_mono (by finiteness) hmeasure
  have hreal : (uniformMeasure p).real leftImage ≤
      (uniformMeasure q).real rightImage + (δ : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_add (measure_ne_top _ _) ENNReal.coe_ne_top,
      ENNReal.coe_toReal, Measure.real] using hmeasureReal
  rw [uniformMeasure_real p hleftMeas, labelCount_image_eq_card p hp S,
    uniformMeasure_real q hrightMeas, labelCount_image_eq_card q hq T] at hreal
  linarith

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.nearXY_mass_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem nearXY_mass_lower_bound {δ : ℝ≥0}
    (s : SupNormWitness X Y δ) {a b : Index} (S : Finset X)
    (hlarge : mass a ≤ (S.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card X)
    (hcross : mass b + δ ≤ mass a) :
    mass b ≤ ((nearXYLabel s S).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : MeasurableSpace ((X ⊕ Y) → ℝ) := borel _
  letI : BorelSpace ((X ⊕ Y) → ℝ) := ⟨rfl⟩
  apply nearLabel_mass_lower_bound s.left s.right s.left_isometry.injective
    s.right_isometry.injective s.cost_lt S (nearXYLabel s S) ?_ hlarge hcross
  intro y
  simp only [nearXYLabel, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.nearYX_mass_lower_bound
statement:
private theorem nearYX_mass_lower_bound {δ : ℝ≥0}
    (s : SupNormWitness X Y δ) {a b : Index} (T : Finset Y)
    (hlarge : mass a ≤ (T.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Y)
    (hcross : mass b + δ ≤ mass a) :
    mass b ≤ ((nearYXLabel s T).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card X
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : MeasurableSpace ((X ⊕ Y) → ℝ) := borel _
  letI : BorelSpace ((X ⊕ Y) → ℝ) := ⟨rfl⟩
  apply nearLabel_mass_lower_bound s.right s.left s.right_isometry.injective
    s.left_isometry.injective (by simpa only [levyProkhorovEDist_comm] using s.cost_lt)
    T (nearYXLabel s T) ?_ hlarge hcross
  intro x
  simp only [nearYXLabel, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.finset_nonempty_of_positive_mass
statement:
private theorem finset_nonempty_of_positive_mass {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (a : Index) (S : Finset V) (hS : mass a ≤ (S.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V) :
    S.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  have hEq : S = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne
  have hzero : mass a ≤ 0 := by simpa [hEq] using hS
  exact (not_le_of_gt (mass_pos a)) hzero

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.nearXY_nearYX_contiguous
statement:
private theorem nearXY_nearYX_contiguous {δ : ℝ≥0}
    (s : SupNormWitness X Y δ) {a b c : Index}
    (hab : mass b + δ ≤ mass a ∧ radius a + δ ≤ radius b)
    (hbc : mass c + δ ≤ mass b ∧ radius b + δ ≤ radius c)
    (hac : TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover s.left a) ≤
      TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover s.left c)) :
    TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous
      (VertexMap.comp (nearXYVertexMap s a b hab) (nearYXVertexMap s b c hbc))
      (inclusionVertexMap hac)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : DecidableEq (Finset X) := Classical.decEq _
  intro C hC
  obtain ⟨hCne, hCvalid, hCcenter⟩ := (mem_largeFaceNerve_iff s.left a C).mp hC
  obtain ⟨_, center, hcenter⟩ := hCcenter
  have hmassAC : mass c ≤ mass a :=
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg).trans
      (hbc.1.trans ((le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg).trans hab.1))
  have hradiusAC : radius a ≤ radius c :=
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg).trans
      (hab.2.trans ((le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg).trans hbc.2))
  let doubleNear (S : Finset X) := nearYXLabel s (nearXYLabel s S)
  let labels := C ∪ C.image doubleNear
  have hlabels : labels ∈ TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover s.left c) := by
    apply (mem_largeFaceNerve_iff s.left c labels).2
    have hvalid : ∀ S ∈ labels, S ∈ openCech s.left (radius c) ∧
        mass c ≤ (S.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card X := by
      intro S hS
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hS with hS | hS
      · have hlarge := (hCvalid S hS).2
        have hne := (hCvalid S hS).1.1
        have hcenterS : ∀ x ∈ S, dist center (s.left x) < radius c := by
          intro x hx
          exact (hcenter x (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨S, hS, hx⟩)).trans_le hradiusAC
        exact ⟨⟨hne, center, hcenterS⟩, hmassAC.trans hlarge⟩
      · obtain ⟨S₀, hS₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hS
        have hmid := nearXY_mass_lower_bound s S₀ (hCvalid S₀ hS₀).2 hab.1
        have hfinal := nearYX_mass_lower_bound s (nearXYLabel s S₀) hmid hbc.1
        have hfinalNe := finset_nonempty_of_positive_mass c (doubleNear S₀) hfinal
        have hcenterFinal : ∀ x ∈ doubleNear S₀, dist center (s.left x) < radius c := by
          intro x hx
          obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
          obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hyx₀⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
          have hx₀C : x₀ ∈ C.biUnion id := Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨S₀, hS₀, hx₀⟩
          calc
            dist center (s.left x) ≤ dist center (s.right y) + dist (s.right y) (s.left x) :=
              dist_triangle _ _ _
            _ ≤ (dist center (s.left x₀) + dist (s.left x₀) (s.right y)) +
                dist (s.right y) (s.left x) := by
              exact add_le_add (dist_triangle _ _ _) le_rfl
            _ < radius a + δ + δ := by
              have h₁ : dist center (s.left x₀) < radius a := by
                simpa only [Metric.mem_ball] using hcenter x₀ hx₀C
              have h₂ : dist (s.left x₀) (s.right y) < (δ : ℝ) := by
                simpa [dist_comm] using hyx₀
              have h₃ : dist (s.right y) (s.left x) < (δ : ℝ) := by
                simpa [dist_comm] using hxy
              linarith
            _ ≤ radius c := by
              have hδ : 0 ≤ (δ : ℝ) := δ.coe_nonneg
              linarith
        exact ⟨⟨hfinalNe, center, hcenterFinal⟩, hfinal⟩
    have hlabelsNe : labels.Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hCne
      exact ⟨S, Finset.mem_union_left _ hS⟩
    have hlabelsUnionNe : (labels.biUnion id).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hCne
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hCvalid S hS).1.1
      exact ⟨x, Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨S, Finset.mem_union_left _ hS, hx⟩⟩
    refine ⟨hlabelsNe, hvalid, ⟨hlabelsUnionNe, center, ?_⟩⟩
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨S, hS, hxS⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hx
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hS with hS | hS
    · have hxC : x ∈ C.biUnion id := Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨S, hS, hxS⟩
      exact (hcenter x hxC).trans_le hradiusAC
    · obtain ⟨S₀, hS₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hS
      have hmid := nearXY_mass_lower_bound s S₀ (hCvalid S₀ hS₀).2 hab.1
      have hfinal := nearYX_mass_lower_bound s (nearXYLabel s S₀) hmid hbc.1
      have hfinalNe := finset_nonempty_of_positive_mass c (doubleNear S₀) hfinal
      have hcenterFinal : ∀ x ∈ doubleNear S₀, dist center (s.left x) < radius c := by
        intro x hx'
        obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx').2
        obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hyx₀⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
        have hx₀C : x₀ ∈ C.biUnion id := Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨S₀, hS₀, hx₀⟩
        calc
          dist center (s.left x) ≤ dist center (s.right y) + dist (s.right y) (s.left x) :=
            dist_triangle _ _ _
          _ ≤ (dist center (s.left x₀) + dist (s.left x₀) (s.right y)) +
                dist (s.right y) (s.left x) := by
              exact add_le_add (dist_triangle _ _ _) le_rfl
          _ < radius a + δ + δ := by
              have h₁ : dist center (s.left x₀) < radius a := by
                simpa only [Metric.mem_ball] using hcenter x₀ hx₀C
              have h₂ : dist (s.left x₀) (s.right y) < (δ : ℝ) := by
                simpa [dist_comm] using hyx₀
              have h₃ : dist (s.right y) (s.left x) < (δ : ℝ) := by
                simpa [dist_comm] using hxy
              linarith
          _ ≤ radius c := by
              have hδ : 0 ≤ (δ : ℝ) := δ.coe_nonneg
              linarith
      exact hcenterFinal x hxS
  change C.image
      (VertexMap.comp (nearXYVertexMap s a b hab) (nearYXVertexMap s b c hbc)).toFun ∪
      C.image (inclusionVertexMap hac).toFun ∈
    TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover s.left c)
  simpa [labels, doubleNear, VertexMap.comp, Function.comp_def,
    nearXYVertexMap, nearYXVertexMap, inclusionVertexMap, Finset.union_comm] using hlabels

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.nearYX_nearXY_contiguous
statement:
private theorem nearYX_nearXY_contiguous {δ : ℝ≥0}
    (s : SupNormWitness X Y δ) {a b c : Index}
    (hab : mass b + δ ≤ mass a ∧ radius a + δ ≤ radius b)
    (hbc : mass c + δ ≤ mass b ∧ radius b + δ ≤ radius c)
    (hac : TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover s.right a) ≤
      TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover s.right c)) :
    TDA.Simplicial.Contiguous
      (VertexMap.comp (nearYXVertexMap s a b hab) (nearXYVertexMap s b c hbc))
      (inclusionVertexMap hac)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : DecidableEq (Finset Y) := Classical.decEq _
  intro C hC
  obtain ⟨hCne, hCvalid, hCcenter⟩ := (mem_largeFaceNerve_iff s.right a C).mp hC
  obtain ⟨_, center, hcenter⟩ := hCcenter
  have hmassAC : mass c ≤ mass a :=
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg).trans
      (hbc.1.trans ((le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg).trans hab.1))
  have hradiusAC : radius a ≤ radius c :=
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg).trans
      (hab.2.trans ((le_add_of_nonneg_right δ.coe_nonneg).trans hbc.2))
  let doubleNear (T : Finset Y) := nearXYLabel s (nearYXLabel s T)
  let labels := C ∪ C.image doubleNear
  have hlabels : labels ∈ TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover s.right c) := by
    apply (mem_largeFaceNerve_iff s.right c labels).2
    have hvalid : ∀ T ∈ labels, T ∈ openCech s.right (radius c) ∧
        mass c ≤ (T.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Y := by
      intro T hT
      rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hT with hT | hT
      · have hlarge := (hCvalid T hT).2
        have hne := (hCvalid T hT).1.1
        have hcenterT : ∀ y ∈ T, dist center (s.right y) < radius c := by
          intro y hy
          exact (hcenter y (Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨T, hT, hy⟩)).trans_le hradiusAC
        exact ⟨⟨hne, center, hcenterT⟩, hmassAC.trans hlarge⟩
      · obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hT
        have hmid := nearYX_mass_lower_bound s T₀ (hCvalid T₀ hT₀).2 hab.1
        have hfinal := nearXY_mass_lower_bound s (nearYXLabel s T₀) hmid hbc.1
        have hfinalNe := finset_nonempty_of_positive_mass c (doubleNear T₀) hfinal
        have hcenterFinal : ∀ y ∈ doubleNear T₀, dist center (s.right y) < radius c := by
          intro y hy
          obtain ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2
          obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, hxy₀⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
          have hy₀C : y₀ ∈ C.biUnion id := Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨T₀, hT₀, hy₀⟩
          calc
            dist center (s.right y) ≤ dist center (s.left x) + dist (s.left x) (s.right y) :=
              dist_triangle _ _ _
            _ ≤ (dist center (s.right y₀) + dist (s.right y₀) (s.left x)) +
                dist (s.left x) (s.right y) := by
              exact add_le_add (dist_triangle _ _ _) le_rfl
            _ < radius a + δ + δ := by
              have h₁ : dist center (s.right y₀) < radius a := by
                simpa only [Metric.mem_ball] using hcenter y₀ hy₀C
              have h₂ : dist (s.right y₀) (s.left x) < (δ : ℝ) := by
                simpa [dist_comm] using hxy₀
              have h₃ : dist (s.left x) (s.right y) < (δ : ℝ) := by
                simpa [dist_comm] using hyx
              linarith
            _ ≤ radius c := by
              have hδ : 0 ≤ (δ : ℝ) := δ.coe_nonneg
              linarith
        exact ⟨⟨hfinalNe, center, hcenterFinal⟩, hfinal⟩
    have hlabelsNe : labels.Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := hCne
      exact ⟨T, Finset.mem_union_left _ hT⟩
    have hlabelsUnionNe : (labels.biUnion id).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := hCne
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (hCvalid T hT).1.1
      exact ⟨y, Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨T, Finset.mem_union_left _ hT, hy⟩⟩
    refine ⟨hlabelsNe, hvalid, ⟨hlabelsUnionNe, center, ?_⟩⟩
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨T, hT, hyT⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.mp hy
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hT with hT | hT
    · have hyC : y ∈ C.biUnion id := Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨T, hT, hyT⟩
      exact (hcenter y hyC).trans_le hradiusAC
    · obtain ⟨T₀, hT₀, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hT
      have hmid := nearYX_mass_lower_bound s T₀ (hCvalid T₀ hT₀).2 hab.1
      have hfinal := nearXY_mass_lower_bound s (nearYXLabel s T₀) hmid hbc.1
      have hfinalNe := finset_nonempty_of_positive_mass c (doubleNear T₀) hfinal
      have hcenterFinal : ∀ y ∈ doubleNear T₀, dist center (s.right y) < radius c := by
        intro y hy'
        obtain ⟨x, hx, hyx⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy').2
        obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, hxy₀⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
        have hy₀C : y₀ ∈ C.biUnion id := Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨T₀, hT₀, hy₀⟩
        calc
          dist center (s.right y) ≤ dist center (s.left x) + dist (s.left x) (s.right y) :=
            dist_triangle _ _ _
          _ ≤ (dist center (s.right y₀) + dist (s.right y₀) (s.left x)) +
                dist (s.left x) (s.right y) := by
              exact add_le_add (dist_triangle _ _ _) le_rfl
          _ < radius a + δ + δ := by
              have h₁ : dist center (s.right y₀) < radius a := by
                simpa only [Metric.mem_ball] using hcenter y₀ hy₀C
              have h₂ : dist (s.right y₀) (s.left x) < (δ : ℝ) := by
                simpa [dist_comm] using hxy₀
              have h₃ : dist (s.left x) (s.right y) < (δ : ℝ) := by
                simpa [dist_comm] using hyx
              linarith
          _ ≤ radius c := by
              have hδ : 0 ≤ (δ : ℝ) := δ.coe_nonneg
              linarith
      exact hcenterFinal y hyT
  change C.image
      (VertexMap.comp (nearYXVertexMap s a b hab) (nearXYVertexMap s b c hbc)).toFun ∪
      C.image (inclusionVertexMap hac).toFun ∈
    TDA.Topology.nerve (largeFaceCover s.right c)
  simpa [labels, doubleNear, VertexMap.comp, Function.comp_def,
    nearXYVertexMap, nearYXVertexMap, inclusionVertexMap, Finset.union_comm] using hlabels

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.SupNormWitness.homologyInterleaving_left
statement:
theorem SupNormWitness.homologyInterleaving_left {δ : ℝ≥0}
    (s : SupNormWitness X Y δ) (R : Type w) [Ring R] (n : ℕ) :
    (copy δ false).toFunctor ⋙ s.homologyInterleaving R n =
      homology R (inferInstance : MetricSpace X) n
proof:
:= by
  refine CategoryTheory.Functor.ext (h_obj := fun a => by
    dsimp [Functor.comp_obj, SupNormWitness.homologyInterleaving,
      SupNormWitness.homologyInterleavingObj, copy]
    change (homology R (inferInstance : MetricSpace X) n).obj
      ((copy δ false).toFun a).point = (homology R (inferInstance : MetricSpace X) n).obj a
    rfl) ?_
  intro a b f
  let e := ripsHomologyToLargeFaceNerveIso R (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)
    s.left (fun x x' => (s.left_isometry.dist_eq x x').symm) n
  have hN : (s.largeFaceNerveHomologyInterleaving R n).map
      ((copy δ false).toFunctor.map f) =
      (simplicialHomologyPModule R (largeFaceNerveBifiltration s.left) n).map f := by
    change ((copy δ false).toFunctor ⋙
      s.largeFaceNerveHomologyInterleaving R n).map f = _
    rfl
  change (e.app a).hom ≫
      (s.largeFaceNerveHomologyInterleaving R n).map
        ((copy δ false).toFunctor.map f) ≫ (e.app b).inv =
    (homology R (inferInstance : MetricSpace X) n).map f
  rw [hN]
  have hnat' : (e.app a).hom ≫
      (simplicialHomologyPModule R (largeFaceNerveBifiltration s.left) n).map f =
      (homology R (inferInstance : MetricSpace X) n).map f ≫ (e.app b).hom := by
    change e.hom.app a ≫
        (simplicialHomologyPModule R (largeFaceNerveBifiltration s.left) n).map f =
      (homology R (inferInstance : MetricSpace X) n).map f ≫ e.hom.app b
    exact (e.hom.naturality f).symm
  calc
    (e.app a).hom ≫
        (simplicialHomologyPModule R (largeFaceNerveBifiltration s.left) n).map f ≫
        (e.app b).inv =
      ((homology R (inferInstance : MetricSpace X) n).map f ≫ (e.app b).hom) ≫
        (e.app b).inv := by rw [← Category.assoc, hnat']
    _ = (homology R (inferInstance : MetricSpace X) n).map f := by
      simp [Category.assoc]
