name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.subdivisionRipsHomologyInterleavingDistance_le_of_interleaving
statement:
theorem subdivisionRipsHomologyInterleavingDistance_le_of_interleaving
    (d : MetricSpace X) (e : MetricSpace Y) (R : Type w) [Ring R] (n : ℕ) {δ : ℝ≥0}
    (M : PModule.{w, 0, max u w} R (InterleavingIndex δ))
    (hl : (copy δ false).toFunctor ⋙ M = homology R d n)
    (hr : (copy δ true).toFunctor ⋙ M = homology R e n) :
    subdivisionRipsHomologyInterleavingDistance d e R n ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold subdivisionRipsHomologyInterleavingDistance
  refine (iInf_le _ δ).trans ?_
  rw [if_pos ⟨M, hl, hr⟩]

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.subdivisionRipsHomologyInterleavingDistance_le_gromovProkhorovEDist
statement:
theorem subdivisionRipsHomologyInterleavingDistance_le_gromovProkhorovEDist
    (d : MetricSpace X) (e : MetricSpace Y) (R : Type w) [Ring R] (n : ℕ) :
    subdivisionRipsHomologyInterleavingDistance d e R n ≤
      @gromovProkhorovEDist X Y d e inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance inferInstance
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : MetricSpace X := d
  letI : MetricSpace Y := e
  apply ENNReal.le_of_forall_nnreal_lt
  intro r hr
  by_contra hnot
  have hGP : gromovProkhorovEDist X Y < (r : ℝ≥0∞) := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  obtain ⟨δ, hGPδ, hδr⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_nnreal_btwn.mp hGP
  have hExists : SubdivisionRipsHomologyInterleavingExistsAt δ d e R n := by
    let s : SupNormWitness X Y δ := supNormWitness δ hGPδ
    exact ⟨s.homologyInterleaving R n, s.homologyInterleaving_left R n,
      s.homologyInterleaving_right R n⟩
  have hdist : subdivisionRipsHomologyInterleavingDistance d e R n ≤
      (δ : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    unfold subdivisionRipsHomologyInterleavingDistance
    exact (iInf_le
      (fun ε : ℝ≥0 =>
        if SubdivisionRipsHomologyInterleavingExistsAt ε d e R n then
          (ε : ℝ≥0∞) else ∞) δ).trans (by simp [hExists])
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hdist) (hδr.trans hr)

name: TDA.Topology.FiniteGromovProkhorov.subdivisionRipsHomologyInterleaving_of_isometric_embedding
statement:
theorem subdivisionRipsHomologyInterleaving_of_isometric_embedding
    (R : Type w) [Ring R] (n : ℕ) (i : X ↪ Y) (hi : Isometry i)
    (m : ℕ) (hcard : Fintype.card Y = Fintype.card X + m)
    (δ : ℝ≥0) (hδ : (m : ℝ) / Fintype.card Y < (δ : ℝ)) :
    ∃ M : PModule.{w, 0, max u w} R (InterleavingIndex δ),
      (copy δ false).toFunctor ⋙ M =
        homology R (inferInstance : MetricSpace X) n ∧
      (copy δ true).toFunctor ⋙ M =
        homology R (inferInstance : MetricSpace Y) n
proof:
:= by
  have hcardReal : (Fintype.card Y : ℝ) = (Fintype.card X : ℝ) + (m : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hcard
  have hfrac :
      ((Fintype.card Y : ℝ) - Fintype.card X) / Fintype.card Y =
        (m : ℝ) / Fintype.card Y := by
    rw [hcardReal]
    ring
  have hgp : gromovProkhorovEDist X Y ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal ((m : ℝ) / Fintype.card Y) := by
    rw [← hfrac]
    exact gromovProkhorovEDist_embedding_le i hi
  have hmass : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) / Fintype.card Y := by positivity
  have hstrict :
      ENNReal.ofReal ((m : ℝ) / Fintype.card Y) < (δ : ℝ≥0∞) :=
    (ENNReal.ofReal_lt_coe_iff hmass).2 hδ
  let s : SupNormWitness X Y δ := supNormWitness δ (hgp.trans_lt hstrict)
  exact ⟨s.homologyInterleaving R n, s.homologyInterleaving_left R n,
    s.homologyInterleaving_right R n⟩

    exact ⟨TwoPoints.pts 0, mem_range_self _, by norm_num [midpoint, TwoPoints.pts, Real.dist_eq]⟩
  · rintro x ⟨i, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨midpoint (), mem_range_self _, ?_⟩
    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [midpoint, TwoPoints.pts, Real.dist_eq]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.GromovHausdorffExamples.midpoint_sampling_bound
statement:
theorem midpoint_sampling_bound (k : Type) [Field k] (n : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (diagram k Unit n) (diagram k (Fin 2) n) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  simpa using bottleneck_diagram_le_two_mul_of_hausdorffDist_le k
    midpoint_isometry two_isometry midpoint_hausdorff_le_one n

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.GromovHausdorffExamples.midpoint_many_to_one
statement:
theorem midpoint_many_to_one :
    ∃ C : SetRel Unit (Fin 2), ((), 0) ∈ C ∧ ((), 1) ∈ C ∧
      ∀ x x' y y', (x, y) ∈ C → (x', y') ∈ C → |dist x x' - dist y y'| ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, _, hI, hdist⟩ :=
    exists_relation_distortion_le_hausdorffDist midpoint_isometry two_isometry
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hI 0
  obtain ⟨x', hx'⟩ := hI 1
  refine ⟨C, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [SetRel.mem_inv, Subsingleton.elim x ()] using hx
  · simpa only [SetRel.mem_inv, Subsingleton.elim x' ()] using hx'
  · intro a b y y' ha hb
    exact (hdist a b y y' ha hb).trans (by linarith [midpoint_hausdorff_le_one])

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.GromovHausdorffExamples.lifted_field_gh_bound
statement:
theorem lifted_field_gh_bound (n : ℕ) :

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.GromovHausdorffExamples.reversedEquiv_not_monotone

name: TDA.Persistence.ScalingExamples.vertex_bottleneck_scale

theorem vertex_bottleneck_scale (a b : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :

      ENNReal.ofReal c * ENNReal.ofReal |a - b|

theorem vertex_bottleneck_scale_agrees (a b : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :

name: TDA.Persistence.ScalingExamples.vertex_bottleneck_scale_eq_sharp

theorem vertex_bottleneck_scale_eq_sharp (a b : ℝ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :

name: TDA.Persistence.ScalingExamples.scale_vertex_distance

name: TDA.Persistence.ScalingExamples.bottleneck_essentialOne_empty

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.posSemidef_weightedKernel
statement:
theorem posSemidef_weightedKernel (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef] (g : X → ℝ) :
    (weightedKernel k g).PosSemidef
proof:
:=
  posSemidef_diag_mul_mul_diag Fact.out g

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.baseFeature_apply
statement:
theorem baseFeature_apply (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef] (x z : X) :
    baseFeature k x z = k z x
proof:
:= by
  rw [baseFeature, RKHS.kerFun_apply, RKHS.OfKernel.kernel_ofKernel]
  simp [scalarOp]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.inner_baseFeature
statement:
theorem inner_baseFeature (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef] (x y : X) :
    ⟪baseFeature k x, baseFeature k y⟫_ℝ = k x y
proof:
:= by
  change ⟪RKHS.kerFun (BaseSpace k) x 1, baseFeature k y⟫_ℝ = _
  rw [RKHS.kerFun_inner, baseFeature_apply, Real.inner_apply, one_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.weightedFeature_apply
statement:
theorem weightedFeature_apply (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef]
    (g : X → ℝ) (x z : X) : weightedFeature k g x z = g z * k z x * g x
proof:
:=
  baseFeature_apply (weightedKernel k g) x z

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.inner_weightedFeature
statement:
theorem inner_weightedFeature (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef]
    (g : X → ℝ) (x y : X) :
    ⟪weightedFeature k g x, weightedFeature k g y⟫_ℝ = g x * k x y * g y
proof:
:=
  inner_baseFeature (weightedKernel k g) x y

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.norm_sums_eq
statement:
private theorem norm_sums_eq (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef] (g : X → ℝ)
    (μ : X →₀ ℝ) : ‖weightedSum k g μ‖ = ‖baseSum k g μ‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, ← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  simp only [weightedSum, baseSum, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
    Finsupp.sum_inner, Finsupp.inner_sum, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
    inner_weightedFeature, inner_baseFeature]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.sums_eq_iff
statement:
private theorem sums_eq_iff (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef] (g : X → ℝ)
    (μ ν : X →₀ ℝ) : baseSum k g μ = baseSum k g ν ↔ weightedSum k g μ = weightedSum k g ν
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply norm_sub_eq_zero_iff.mp
    rw [← map_sub, norm_sums_eq, map_sub, h, sub_self, norm_zero]
  · intro h
    apply norm_sub_eq_zero_iff.mp
    rw [← map_sub, ← norm_sums_eq, map_sub, h, sub_self, norm_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.span_weighted_baseFeature
statement:
private theorem span_weighted_baseFeature (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef]
    (g : X → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, g x ≠ 0) :
    span ℝ (Set.range (fun x => g x • baseFeature k x)) =
      span ℝ (Set.range (baseFeature k))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply span_le.mpr
    rintro f ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (subset_span ⟨x, rfl⟩)
  · apply span_le.mpr
    rintro f ⟨x, rfl⟩
    have h := Submodule.smul_mem
      (span ℝ (Set.range (fun x => g x • baseFeature k x))) (g x)⁻¹
      (subset_span (Set.mem_range_self x))
    simpa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (hg x)] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.dense_baseSum
statement:
private theorem dense_baseSum (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef]
    (g : X → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, g x ≠ 0) : DenseRange (baseSum k g)
proof:
:= by
  change Dense (↑(LinearMap.range (baseSum k g)) : Set (BaseSpace k))
  apply Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr
  apply top_unique
  have hs : span ℝ {RKHS.kerFun (BaseSpace k) x v | (x) (v)} ≤
      LinearMap.range (baseSum k g) := by
    apply span_le.mpr
    rintro f ⟨x, v, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Finsupp.single x (v / g x), ?_⟩
    simp only [baseSum, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, smul_smul]
    rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (hg x)]
    simp [baseFeature, ← map_smul]
  have hc := Submodule.topologicalClosure_mono hs
  rw [RKHS.kerFun_dense] at hc
  exact hc

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.dense_weightedSum
statement:
private theorem dense_weightedSum (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef]
    (g : X → ℝ) : DenseRange (weightedSum k g)
proof:
:= by
  change Dense (↑(LinearMap.range (weightedSum k g)) : Set (WeightedSpace k g))
  apply Submodule.dense_iff_topologicalClosure_eq_top.mpr
  apply top_unique
  have hs : span ℝ {RKHS.kerFun (WeightedSpace k g) x v | (x) (v)} ≤
      LinearMap.range (weightedSum k g) := by
    apply span_le.mpr
    rintro f ⟨x, v, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Finsupp.single x v, ?_⟩
    simp [weightedSum, weightedFeature, baseFeature, ← map_smul]
  have hc := Submodule.topologicalClosure_mono hs
  rw [RKHS.kerFun_dense] at hc
  exact hc

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.weightIsometry_smul_baseFeature
statement:
theorem weightIsometry_smul_baseFeature (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef]
    (g : X → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, g x ≠ 0) (x : X) :
    weightIsometry k g hg (g x • baseFeature k x) = weightedFeature k g x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (LinearEquiv.refl ℝ (X →₀ ℝ)).extendOfIsometry_eq
    (baseSum k g) (weightedSum k g) (dense_baseSum k g hg) (dense_weightedSum k g)
    (norm_sums_eq k g) (Finsupp.single x 1)
  simpa [weightIsometry, baseSum, weightedSum] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.weightIsometry_apply
statement:
theorem weightIsometry_apply (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef]
    (g : X → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, g x ≠ 0) (f : BaseSpace k) (x : X) :
    weightIsometry k g hg f x = g x * f x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (weightIsometry k g hg).inner_map_map (g x • baseFeature k x) f
  rw [weightIsometry_smul_baseFeature] at h
  simpa [weightedFeature, baseFeature, RKHS.kerFun_inner, real_inner_smul_left,
    Real.inner_apply] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.weightIsometry_symm_apply
statement:
theorem weightIsometry_symm_apply (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef]
    (g : X → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, g x ≠ 0) (F : WeightedSpace k g) (x : X) :
    (weightIsometry k g hg).symm F x = F x / g x
proof:
:= by
  have h := weightIsometry_apply k g hg ((weightIsometry k g hg).symm F) x
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact (eq_div_iff (hg x)).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using h.symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.weightIsometry_sum
statement:
theorem weightIsometry_sum (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef]
    (g : X → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, g x ≠ 0) {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    (x : I → X) (c : I → ℝ) :
    weightIsometry k g hg (∑ i, c i • (g (x i) • baseFeature k (x i))) =
      ∑ i, c i • weightedFeature k g (x i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [map_smul, weightIsometry_smul_baseFeature]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.KernelWeight.weightIsometry_unique
statement:
theorem weightIsometry_unique (k : Matrix X X ℝ) [Fact k.PosSemidef]
    (g : X → ℝ) (hg : ∀ x, g x ≠ 0)
    (T : BaseSpace k ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] WeightedSpace k g)
    (hT : ∀ (f : BaseSpace k) (x : X), T f x = g x * f x) :
    T = weightIsometry k g hg
proof:
:= by
  ext f x
  rw [hT, weightIsometry_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.posSemidef_upperKernel
statement: theorem posSemidef_upperKernel (σ : ℝ) : (upperKernel σ).PosSemidef
proof:
:=
  posSemidef_kernel_family σ Subtype.val

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.upperWeightIsometry_apply
statement:
theorem upperWeightIsometry_apply (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (hw : ∀ p : UpperPoint, 0 < upperWeight w p) (f : UpperSpace σ) (p : UpperPoint) :
    upperWeightIsometry σ w hw f p = upperWeight w p * f p
proof:
:=
  KernelWeight.weightIsometry_apply _ _ _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.upperWeightIsometry_symm_apply
statement:
theorem upperWeightIsometry_symm_apply (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (hw : ∀ p : UpperPoint, 0 < upperWeight w p) (F : WeightedUpperSpace σ w)
    (p : UpperPoint) : (upperWeightIsometry σ w hw).symm F p = F p / upperWeight w p
proof:
:=
  KernelWeight.weightIsometry_symm_apply _ _ _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.upperWeightIsometry_embedding
statement:
theorem upperWeightIsometry_embedding {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (σ : ℝ)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (hw : ∀ p : UpperPoint, 0 < upperWeight w p)
    (x : I → UpperPoint) :
    upperWeightIsometry σ w hw (upperEmbedding σ w x) = weightedUpperEmbedding σ w x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [upperEmbedding, weightedUpperEmbedding, upperWeightIsometry] using
    KernelWeight.weightIsometry_sum (upperKernel σ) (upperWeight w)
      (fun p => (hw p).ne') x (fun _ => 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.inner_weightedUpperEmbedding
statement:
theorem inner_weightedUpperEmbedding {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (σ : ℝ)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (x : I → UpperPoint) (y : J → UpperPoint) :
    ⟪weightedUpperEmbedding σ w x, weightedUpperEmbedding σ w y⟫_ℝ =
      linearKernel σ w (fun i => (x i).val) (fun j => (y j).val)
proof:
:= by
  unfold weightedUpperEmbedding linearKernel
  rw [sum_inner]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [inner_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  rw [KernelWeight.inner_weightedFeature]
  simp only [upperWeight, upperKernel, Matrix.of_apply]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_weightedUpperEmbedding_sub
statement:
theorem norm_weightedUpperEmbedding_sub {I J : Type*} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] (σ : ℝ)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (x : I → UpperPoint) (y : J → UpperPoint) :
    ‖weightedUpperEmbedding σ w x - weightedUpperEmbedding σ w y‖ =
      ‖embedding σ w (fun i => (x i).val) - embedding σ w (fun j => (y j).val)‖
proof:
:= by
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [norm_sub_sq_real, norm_embedding_sub_sq]
  simp only [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, inner_weightedUpperEmbedding]
  ring

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.upperWeightIsometry_diagramEmbedding
statement:
theorem upperWeightIsometry_diagramEmbedding (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (hw : ∀ p : UpperPoint, 0 < upperWeight w p) (D : Diagram ℝ) (hD : D.IsPositive) :
    upperWeightIsometry σ w hw (upperDiagramEmbedding σ w D hD) =
      weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding σ w D hD
proof:
:=
  upperWeightIsometry_embedding σ w hw _

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.inner_weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding
statement:
theorem inner_weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (D : Diagram ℝ) (hD : D.IsPositive) (E : Diagram ℝ) (hE : E.IsPositive) :
    ⟪weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding σ w D hD, weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding σ w E hE⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪diagramEmbedding σ w D, diagramEmbedding σ w E⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding, weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding,
    inner_weightedUpperEmbedding, inner_diagramEmbedding]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.norm_weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding_sub
statement:
theorem norm_weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding_sub (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B)
    (D : Diagram ℝ) (hD : D.IsPositive) (E : Diagram ℝ) (hE : E.IsPositive) :
    ‖weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding σ w D hD - weightedUpperDiagramEmbedding σ w E hE‖ =
      ‖diagramEmbedding σ w D - diagramEmbedding σ w E‖
proof:
:=
  norm_weightedUpperEmbedding_sub σ w _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.upperWeight_arctan_pos
statement:
theorem upperWeight_arctan_pos {C : ℝ} (hC : 0 < C) (p : UpperPoint) :
    0 < upperWeight (PersistenceImage.arctanWeight C hC.le) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [upperWeight, PersistenceImage.arctanWeight_birthPersistence C hC.le p.property.le]
  exact Real.arctan_pos.mpr (mul_pos hC (sub_pos.mpr p.property))

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelFiltration_scale
statement:
theorem sublevelFiltration_scale (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
      (f.scale c hc).sublevelFiltration =
      Filtration.reindex (PModule.scaleHom c hc) f.sublevelFiltration
proof:
:= by
  apply OrderHom.ext
  funext r
  change (f.scale c hc).sublevel r = f.sublevel (PModule.scaleHom c hc r)
  rw [FilterFunction.scale_sublevel]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelModule_scale
statement:
theorem sublevelModule_scale (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    sublevelModule R (f.scale c hc) n =
      PModule.scale c hc (sublevelModule R f n)
proof:
:= by
  change simplicialHomologyPModule R (f.scale c hc).sublevelFiltration n =
    PModule.scale c hc (simplicialHomologyPModule R f.sublevelFiltration n)
  rw [sublevelFiltration_scale f c hc]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_sublevelModule_scale
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_sublevelModule_scale
    (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    realInterleavingDistance (sublevelModule R (f.scale c hc) n)
        (sublevelModule R (g.scale c hc) n) =
      ENNReal.ofReal c * realInterleavingDistance (sublevelModule R f n)
        (sublevelModule R g n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sublevelModule_scale, sublevelModule_scale]
  exact realInterleavingDistance_scale c hc _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelModule_scale_isConstructible
statement:
theorem sublevelModule_scale_isConstructible (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    IsConstructible (FiniteConstructible.scaleGrid c hc f.criticalValue)
      (sublevelModule R (f.scale c hc) n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sublevelModule_scale]
  exact IsConstructible.scale (sublevelModule_isConstructible R n f) c hc

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelModule_scale_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem sublevelModule_scale_finiteDimensional (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k
      ((sublevelModule k (f.scale c hc) n).obj
        (FiniteConstructible.scaleGrid c hc f.criticalValue i))
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  rw [sublevelModule_scale]
  exact finiteDimensional_scaledCritical (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n f) c hc i

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleDiagram_eq_of_eq
statement:
private theorem moduleDiagram_eq_of_eq {m : ℕ} {g : Fin m ↪o ℝ}
    {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k ℝ} (h : M = N)
    (hM : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj (g i)))
    (hN : ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj (g i))) :
    moduleDiagram g M hM = moduleDiagram g N hN
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleDiagram_sublevelModule_scale
statement:
theorem moduleDiagram_sublevelModule_scale (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) :
    moduleDiagram (FiniteConstructible.scaleGrid c hc f.criticalValue)
        (sublevelModule k (f.scale c hc) n)
        (sublevelModule_scale_finiteDimensional (k := k) (n := n) f c hc) =
      dgm k (f.scale c hc) n
proof:
:= by
  calc
    moduleDiagram (FiniteConstructible.scaleGrid c hc f.criticalValue)
        (sublevelModule k (f.scale c hc) n)
        (sublevelModule_scale_finiteDimensional (k := k) (n := n) f c hc) =
        moduleDiagram (FiniteConstructible.scaleGrid c hc f.criticalValue)
          (PModule.scale c hc (sublevelModule k f n))
          (finiteDimensional_scaledCritical (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n f) c hc) := by
      exact moduleDiagram_eq_of_eq (sublevelModule_scale k n f c hc)
        (sublevelModule_scale_finiteDimensional (k := k) (n := n) f c hc)
        (finiteDimensional_scaledCritical (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n f) c hc)
    _ = (moduleDiagram f.criticalValue (sublevelModule k f n)
          (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n f)).scale c hc := by
            exact moduleDiagram_scale f.criticalValue (sublevelModule k f n)
              (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n f) c hc
    _ = (dgm k f n).scale c hc := by
      rw [moduleDiagram_sublevelModule]
    _ = dgm k (f.scale c hc) n := (dgm_scale k f n hc).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.logModule_scale_index
proof:
:= by
  change c⁻¹ * Real.exp (t + (logParam c : ℝ)) = Real.exp t
  rw [exp_add_logParam hc1 t]
  exact inv_mul_cancel_left₀ hc.ne' _

name: TDA.Persistence.logModule_scale_source_eq
statement:
private theorem logModule_scale_source_eq (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (t : ℝ) :
    ((shift (logParam c)).obj (logModule R (f.scale c hc) n)).obj t =
      (sublevelModule R f n).obj
        ((PModule.scaleHom c hc).comp
          (expHom.comp (translation (logParam c))) t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shift_obj, logModule_eq_reindex R n (f.scale c hc), sublevelModule_scale]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.logModule_scale_target_eq
statement:
private theorem logModule_scale_target_eq (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (sublevelModule R f n).obj (expHom t) = (logModule R f n).obj t
proof:
:= by
  rw [logModule_eq_reindex R n f]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.logModule_scale_source_functor_eq
statement:
private theorem logModule_scale_source_functor_eq (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) :
    (shift (logParam c)).obj (logModule R (f.scale c hc) n) =
      reindex ((PModule.scaleHom c hc).comp
        (expHom.comp (translation (logParam c)))) (sublevelModule R f n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [logModule_eq_reindex R n (f.scale c hc), sublevelModule_scale]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.logModule_scale_target_functor_eq
statement:
private theorem logModule_scale_target_functor_eq (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    reindex expHom (sublevelModule R f n) = logModule R f n
proof:
:=
  (logModule_eq_reindex R n f).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.eqToHom_comp_comp_eqToHom_app
statement:
private theorem eqToHom_comp_comp_eqToHom_app {C : Type*} [Category C] {D : Type*} [Category D]
    {F F' G' G : C ⥤ D} (p : F = F') (α : F' ⟶ G') (q : G' = G) (t : C) :
    (eqToHom p ≫ α ≫ eqToHom q).app t =
      eqToHom (by rw [p]) ≫ α.app t ≫ eqToHom (by rw [q])
proof:
:= by
  subst p q
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.logModule_scale_shiftIso_hom_app
statement:
theorem logModule_scale_shiftIso_hom_app (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) {c : ℝ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hc1 : 1 ≤ c) (t : ℝ) :
    (logModule_scale_shiftIso R n f hc hc1).hom.app t =
    eqToHom (logModule_scale_source_eq R n f hc t) ≫
        (sublevelModule R f n).map (eqToHom (logModule_scale_index hc hc1 t)) ≫
        eqToHom (logModule_scale_target_eq R n f t)
proof:
:= by
  exact eqToHom_comp_comp_eqToHom_app (logModule_scale_source_functor_eq R n f hc) _
    (logModule_scale_target_functor_eq R n f) t

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurable_identityLeg
statement: theorem measurable_identityLeg : Measurable identityLeg
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.measurable
  unfold identityLeg
  exact (continuous_interiorIncl.prodMk continuous_interiorIncl).subtype_mk _

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.identityBoundaryPlan_admissible
statement:
theorem identityBoundaryPlan_admissible (μ : Measure Interior) :
    IsBoundaryPlan (identityBoundaryPlan μ) μ μ
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst (s : Set Interior) : identityLeg ⁻¹' firstFiber s = s := by
    ext x
    change interiorIncl x ∈ interiorIncl '' s ↔ x ∈ s
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
      exact (interiorIncl_injective hxy).symm ▸ hy
    · exact fun hx => ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hsecond (s : Set Interior) : identityLeg ⁻¹' secondFiber s = s := by
    ext x
    change interiorIncl x ∈ interiorIncl '' s ↔ x ∈ s
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
      exact (interiorIncl_injective hxy).symm ▸ hy
    · exact fun hx => ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  constructor
  · intro s hs
    rw [identityBoundaryPlan, Measure.map_apply measurable_identityLeg
      (measurableSet_firstFiber hs), hfirst]
  · intro s hs
    rw [identityBoundaryPlan, Measure.map_apply measurable_identityLeg
      (measurableSet_secondFiber hs), hsecond]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.identityBoundaryPlan_cost
statement:
theorem identityBoundaryPlan_cost (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (μ : Measure Interior) :
    ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂identityBoundaryPlan μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [identityBoundaryPlan,
    lintegral_map (measurable_planPowerCost p) measurable_identityLeg]
  simp [planPowerCost, identityLeg, Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_le_plan
proof:
:= by
  exact (iInf_le (fun τ : Measure PlanSpace =>
    ⨅ (_ : IsBoundaryPlan τ μ ν), ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂τ) π).trans
      (iInf_le (fun _ : IsBoundaryPlan π μ ν =>
        ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π) hπ)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_self
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_self (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) (μ : Measure Interior) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (boundaryTransportPowerValue_le_plan p
      (identityBoundaryPlan_admissible μ)).trans_eq (identityBoundaryPlan_cost p hp μ)
  · exact bot_le

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.transposePlan_involutive
statement:
@[simp] theorem transposePlan_involutive (z : PlanSpace) :
    transposePlan (transposePlan z) = z
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurable_transposePlan
statement: theorem measurable_transposePlan : Measurable transposePlan
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.measurable
  unfold transposePlan
  exact (continuous_subtype_val.snd.prodMk continuous_subtype_val.fst).subtype_mk _

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.transposePlan_map_map
statement:
theorem transposePlan_map_map (π : Measure PlanSpace) :
    (π.map transposePlan).map transposePlan = π
proof:
:= by
  rw [Measure.map_map measurable_transposePlan measurable_transposePlan]
  have h : transposePlan ∘ transposePlan = id := by
    funext z
    exact transposePlan_involutive z
  rw [h]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.transposePlan_preimage_firstFiber
statement:
@[simp] theorem transposePlan_preimage_firstFiber (s : Set Interior) :
    transposePlan ⁻¹' firstFiber s = secondFiber s
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.transposePlan_preimage_secondFiber
statement:
@[simp] theorem transposePlan_preimage_secondFiber (s : Set Interior) :
    transposePlan ⁻¹' secondFiber s = firstFiber s
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.transposePlan_admissible
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro s hs
    rw [Measure.map_apply measurable_transposePlan (measurableSet_firstFiber hs),
      transposePlan_preimage_firstFiber]
    exact hπ.second s hs
  · intro s hs
    rw [Measure.map_apply measurable_transposePlan (measurableSet_secondFiber hs),
      transposePlan_preimage_secondFiber]
    exact hπ.first s hs

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.planPowerCost_transpose
statement:
@[simp] theorem planPowerCost_transpose (p : ℝ) (z : PlanSpace) :
    planPowerCost p (transposePlan z) = planPowerCost p z
proof:
:= by
  simp [planPowerCost, transposePlan, dist_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.transposePlan_cost
statement:
theorem transposePlan_cost (p : ℝ) (π : Measure PlanSpace) :
    (∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π.map transposePlan) =
      ∫⁻ z, planPowerCost p z ∂π
proof:
:= by
  rw [lintegral_map (measurable_planPowerCost p) measurable_transposePlan]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportPowerValue_symm
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportPowerValue_symm (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior) :
    boundaryTransportPowerValue p μ ν = boundaryTransportPowerValue p ν μ
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply le_iInf
    intro π
    apply le_iInf
    intro hπ
    exact (boundaryTransportPowerValue_le_plan p (transposePlan_admissible hπ)).trans_eq
      (transposePlan_cost p π)
  · apply le_iInf
    intro π
    apply le_iInf
    intro hπ
    exact (boundaryTransportPowerValue_le_plan p (transposePlan_admissible hπ)).trans_eq
      (transposePlan_cost p π)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_self
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_self (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (μ : Measure Interior) : boundaryTransportDistance p μ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryTransportDistance, boundaryTransportPowerValue_self p
    hp]
  exact ENNReal.zero_rpow_of_pos (one_div_pos.mpr hp)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_symm
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_symm (p : ℝ) (μ ν : Measure Interior) :
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν = boundaryTransportDistance p ν μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [boundaryTransportDistance, boundaryTransportDistance,
    boundaryTransportPowerValue_symm]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.boundaryTransportDistance_lt_top
statement:
theorem boundaryTransportDistance_lt_top (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior)
    (hμ : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞)
    (hν : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂ν) < ∞) :
    boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν < ∞
proof:
:= by
  exact ENNReal.rpow_lt_top_of_nonneg
    (le_of_lt (one_div_pos.mpr hp))
    (boundaryTransportPowerValue_lt_top p μ ν hμ hν).ne

name: TDA.Persistence.empty_homology_subsingleton
statement:
private theorem empty_homology_subsingleton (n : ℕ) :
    Subsingleton (simplicialHomology (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Subsingleton (Chain (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n) :=
    ⟨fun a b => (emptyChain_eq_zero k n a).trans (emptyChain_eq_zero k n b).symm⟩
  letI : Subsingleton (simplicialCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n) :=
    inferInstance
  letI : HasQuotient (simplicialCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n)
      (Submodule k (simplicialCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n)) :=
    Submodule.hasQuotient (R := k)
      (M := simplicialCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n)
  letI : Subsingleton (simplicialCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n ⧸
      simplicialBoundaries (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n) := inferInstance
  letI : Subsingleton
      (↑(ModuleCat.of k (LinearMap.ker
        ((simplicialChainComplex (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k).sc n).g.hom ⧸
        LinearMap.range ((simplicialChainComplex
          (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k).sc n).moduleCatToCycles))) := by
    change Subsingleton (simplicialCycles (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n ⧸
      simplicialBoundaries (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k n)
    infer_instance
  let eqv := (homologyKernelQuotient.{u,u,u} k
    (simplicialChainComplex (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) k) n).toLinearEquiv
  exact ⟨fun a b => eqv.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.facePrefixBarcode_birth_pos
statement:
theorem facePrefixBarcode_birth_pos (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (I : FiniteInterval (faceCount K + 1))
    (hI : I ∈ facePrefixBarcode k e n) : 0 < I.birth
proof:
:= by
  let z : Fin (faceCount K + 1) := ⟨0, Nat.succ_pos _⟩
  have hzero : structureMapRank (facePrefixModule k e n) z z le_rfl = 0 := by
    have hsub : Subsingleton ((facePrefixModule k e n).obj z) := by
      change Subsingleton (simplicialHomology (e.prefixComplex 0) k n)
      rw [e.prefixComplex_zero]
      exact empty_homology_subsingleton k n
    unfold structureMapRank
    have hm : structureMapLinear (facePrefixModule k e n) (le_refl z) = 0 := by
      ext x
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hm, LinearMap.range_zero]
    exact Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton (R := k)
  have hcount : (facePrefixBarcode k e n).countP
      (fun J => J.birth ≤ z.val ∧ z.val < J.death) = 0 := by
    rw [← rank_barcodeMap (k := k) (facePrefixBarcode k e n) z z le_rfl]
    change structureMapRank
      (barcodeModule (k := k) (rankBarcode (facePrefixModule k e n))) z z le_rfl = 0
    rw [structureMapRank_rankBarcode]
    exact hzero
  have hnot := (Multiset.countP_eq_zero.mp hcount) I hI
  by_contra hb
  have hb0 : I.birth = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hb
  exact hnot ⟨by change I.birth ≤ 0; omega,
    by change 0 < I.death; rw [← hb0]; exact I.birth_lt_death⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.inclusion_rank_congr
statement:
private theorem inclusion_rank_congr {A B C D : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    (hA : A = C) (hB : B = D) (hab : A ≤ B) (hcd : C ≤ D) (n : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k hab n).hom) =
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (simplicialHomologyIncl k hcd n).hom)
proof:
:= by
  subst C
  subst D
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.faceGradeSample_map_rank
statement:
theorem faceGradeSample_map_rank (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (i j : Fin f.criticalValues.card) (hij : i ≤ j) :
    structureMapRank (reindex (faceGradeSample e) (facePrefixModule k e n)) i j hij =
      structureMapRank (simplicialHomologyPModule k f.gradeFiltration n) i j hij
proof:
:= by
  rw [structureMapRank_reindex]
  unfold structureMapRank
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl k (e.prefixComplex_mono
        (e.sublevelCount_mono (f.criticalValue.monotone hij))) n).hom) =
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range
      (simplicialHomologyIncl k (f.gradeFiltration.monotone hij) n).hom)
  have hi : e.prefixComplex (e.sublevelCount (f.criticalValue i)) = f.gradeFiltration i := by
    exact (e.sublevel_eq_prefixComplex _).symm.trans (f.gradeFiltration_apply i).symm
  have hj : e.prefixComplex (e.sublevelCount (f.criticalValue j)) = f.gradeFiltration j := by
    exact (e.sublevel_eq_prefixComplex _).symm.trans (f.gradeFiltration_apply j).symm
  exact inclusion_rank_congr k hi hj _ _ n

name: TDA.Persistence.gradeHomologyBarcode_eq_reindex_facePrefixBarcode
statement:
theorem gradeHomologyBarcode_eq_reindex_facePrefixBarcode
    (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ) :
    gradeHomologyBarcode k f n =
      reindexBarcode (faceGradeSample e) (facePrefixBarcode k e n)
proof:
:= by
  change rankBarcode (simplicialHomologyPModule k f.gradeFiltration n) =
    reindexBarcode (faceGradeSample e) (rankBarcode (facePrefixModule k e n))
  rw [← rankBarcode_reindex]
  apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff
    (simplicialHomologyPModule k f.gradeFiltration n)
    (reindex (faceGradeSample e) (facePrefixModule k e n))).2
  intro i j hij
  exact (faceGradeSample_map_rank k e n i j hij).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.faceTemplatePairs_mem_of_barcodeMultiplicity_pos
statement:
theorem faceTemplatePairs_mem_of_barcodeMultiplicity_pos
    (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n b d : ℕ)
    (hb : 0 < b) (hd : d ≤ faceCount K)
    (hpos : 0 < barcodeMultiplicity (facePrefixBarcode k e n) b d) :
    ∃ p ∈ faceTemplatePairs k e n,
      p.1.val = b - 1 ∧ p.2.val = d - 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hbirth, hdeath⟩ := Multiset.countP_pos.mp hpos
  have hbI : 0 < I.birth := by omega
  have hdI : I.death ≤ faceCount K := by omega
  refine ⟨(birthFaceIndex I hbI, deathFaceIndex I hdI), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (birthFaceIndex I hbI, deathFaceIndex I hdI) ∈
      (facePrefixBarcode k e n).filterMap (fun J =>
        if hJb : 0 < J.birth then
          if hJd : J.death ≤ faceCount K then
            some (birthFaceIndex J hJb, deathFaceIndex J hJd)
          else none
        else none)
    apply (Multiset.mem_filterMap _ _).mpr
    refine ⟨I, hI, ?_⟩
    simp only [dif_pos hbI, dif_pos hdI]
  · simpa only [birthFaceIndex] using congrArg (fun x : ℕ => x - 1) hbirth
  · simpa only [deathFaceIndex] using congrArg (fun x : ℕ => x - 1) hdeath

name: TDA.Persistence.faceTemplatePairs_lt
statement:
theorem faceTemplatePairs_lt (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (p : Fin (faceCount K) × Fin (faceCount K))
    (hp : p ∈ faceTemplatePairs k e n) : p.1 < p.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, _, hI⟩ := (Multiset.mem_filterMap _ _).mp hp
  split_ifs at hI with hb hd
  · cases hI
    apply Fin.lt_def.mpr
    change I.birth - 1 < I.death - 1
    have := I.birth_lt_death
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.facePrefixBarcode_empty
statement:
theorem facePrefixBarcode_empty (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (hm : faceCount K = 0) : facePrefixBarcode k e n = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiset.eq_zero_of_forall_notMem
  intro I hI
  have hb := facePrefixBarcode_birth_pos k e n I hI
  have hlt := I.birth_lt_death
  have hle := I.death_le_size
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.faceTemplatePairs_empty
statement:
theorem faceTemplatePairs_empty (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (hm : faceCount K = 0) : faceTemplatePairs k e n = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [faceTemplatePairs, facePrefixBarcode_empty k e n hm]

name: TDA.Persistence.faceTemplateEssential_empty
statement:
theorem faceTemplateEssential_empty (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (hm : faceCount K = 0) : faceTemplateEssential k e n = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [faceTemplateEssential, facePrefixBarcode_empty k e n hm]

name: TDA.Persistence.faceTemplatePairs_one_face
statement:
theorem faceTemplatePairs_one_face (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ)
    (hm : faceCount K = 1) : faceTemplatePairs k e n = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Multiset.eq_zero_of_forall_notMem
  intro p hp
  obtain ⟨I, hI, hpoint⟩ := (Multiset.mem_filterMap _ _).mp hp
  have hb := facePrefixBarcode_birth_pos k e n I hI
  split_ifs at hpoint with hb' hd
  · have hlt := I.birth_lt_death
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.faceGradeSample_endpoint
statement:
theorem faceGradeSample_endpoint (e : CompatibleOrder f) (t : ℕ)
    (ht : 0 < t) (hm : t ≤ faceCount K) :
    ∃ q : Fin f.criticalValues.card,
      f.criticalValue q = f.value (e.enum ⟨t - 1, by dsimp [faceCount] at hm ⊢; omega⟩) ∧
      sampledEndpoint (faceGradeSample e) t = q.val
proof:
:= by
  let b : Fin (faceCount K) := ⟨t - 1, by dsimp [faceCount] at hm ⊢; omega⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := f.exists_criticalValue_eq (e.enum b)
  refine ⟨q, by simpa [b] using hq, ?_⟩
  unfold sampledEndpoint
  have hs : (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin f.criticalValues.card =>
      ((faceGradeSample e) j).val < t)) = Finset.Iio q := by
    ext j
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_Iio]
    have hinc := e.value_le_iff_index_lt_sublevelCount (f.criticalValue j) b
    have heq : ((faceGradeSample e) j).val = e.sublevelCount (f.criticalValue j) := rfl
    rw [heq]
    have hc : e.sublevelCount (f.criticalValue j) < t ↔
        f.criticalValue j < f.value (e.enum b) := by
      constructor
      · intro hsmall
        by_contra hn
        have hle := hinc.mp (le_of_not_gt hn)
        have hbval : b.val = t - 1 := rfl
        omega
      · intro hlt
        by_contra hn
        have hlarge : b.val < e.sublevelCount (f.criticalValue j) := by
          have hbval : b.val = t - 1 := rfl
          omega
        exact (not_le_of_gt hlt) (hinc.mpr hlarge)
    rw [hc, ← hq]
    exact f.criticalValue.lt_iff_lt.trans Fin.lt_def
  rw [hs, Fin.card_Iio]

name: TDA.Persistence.facePoint_restrictAlong
statement:
private theorem facePoint_restrictAlong (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (I : FiniteInterval (faceCount K + 1)) (hb : 0 < I.birth) :
    facePoint e I = (I.restrictAlong (faceGradeSample e)).map
      (gradePoint f.criticalValue)
proof:
:= by
  have hbm : I.birth ≤ faceCount K := by
    have h1 := I.birth_lt_death
    have h2 := I.death_le_size
    omega
  obtain ⟨qb, hqb, hcutb⟩ := faceGradeSample_endpoint e I.birth hb hbm
  have hbidx : (⟨I.birth - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (faceCount K)) =
      birthFaceIndex I hb := rfl
  have hbirth : f.criticalValue qb = f.value (e.enum (birthFaceIndex I hb)) := by
    simpa [hbidx] using hqb
  by_cases hd : I.death ≤ faceCount K
  · obtain ⟨qd, hqd, hcutd⟩ := faceGradeSample_endpoint e I.death
      (lt_trans hb I.birth_lt_death) hd
    have hdidx : (⟨I.death - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (faceCount K)) =
        deathFaceIndex I hd := rfl
    have hdeath : f.criticalValue qd = f.value (e.enum (deathFaceIndex I hd)) := by
      simpa [hdidx] using hqd
    have hle : qb ≤ qd := by
      apply f.criticalValue.le_iff_le.mp
      rw [hbirth, hdeath]
      apply e.monotone
      apply Fin.le_def.mpr
      change I.birth - 1 ≤ I.death - 1
      have := I.birth_lt_death
      omega
    by_cases heq : qb = qd
    · have hv : f.value (e.enum (birthFaceIndex I hb)) =
          f.value (e.enum (deathFaceIndex I hd)) := by
        rw [← hbirth, ← hdeath, heq]
      have hc : ¬ sampledEndpoint (faceGradeSample e) I.birth <
          sampledEndpoint (faceGradeSample e) I.death := by
        rw [hcutb, hcutd, heq]
        exact lt_irrefl _
      simp [facePoint, hb, hd, hv, FiniteInterval.restrictAlong, hc]
    · have hlt : qb < qd := lt_of_le_of_ne hle heq
      have hc : sampledEndpoint (faceGradeSample e) I.birth <
          sampledEndpoint (faceGradeSample e) I.death := by
        rw [hcutb, hcutd]
        exact hlt
      have hv : f.value (e.enum (birthFaceIndex I hb)) ≠
          f.value (e.enum (deathFaceIndex I hd)) := by
        rw [← hbirth, ← hdeath]
        exact f.criticalValue.injective.ne heq
      simp [facePoint, hb, hd, hv, FiniteInterval.restrictAlong, hc,
        gradePoint, hcutb, hcutd, hbirth, hdeath, qd.isLt]
      exact hlt
  · have hterminal : I.death = faceCount K + 1 := by
      have := I.death_le_size
      omega
    have hsize : sampledEndpoint (faceGradeSample e) I.death = f.criticalValues.card := by
      rw [hterminal]
      unfold sampledEndpoint
      have hfull : (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin f.criticalValues.card =>
          ((faceGradeSample e) j).val < faceCount K + 1)) = Finset.univ := by
        apply Finset.filter_eq_self.mpr
        intro j _
        exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (e.sublevelCount_le_card (f.criticalValue j))
      rw [hfull]
      simp
    have hc : sampledEndpoint (faceGradeSample e) I.birth <
        sampledEndpoint (faceGradeSample e) I.death := by
      rw [hcutb, hsize]
      exact qb.isLt
    simp [facePoint, hb, hd, FiniteInterval.restrictAlong, hc,
      gradePoint, hcutb, hsize, hbirth]

name: TDA.Persistence.evaluateFaceTemplate_isPositive
statement:
theorem evaluateFaceTemplate_isPositive {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (e : CompatibleOrder f) (g : FilterFunction K β)
    (hg : Monotone (g.value ∘ e.enum)) (n : ℕ) :
    (evaluateFaceTemplate k e g hg n).IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  change p ∈ (((faceTemplatePairs k e n).map (pairValues g e)).filter
      (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2)).map (fun q => (q.1, (q.2 : WithTop β))) +
    ((faceTemplateEssential k e n).map (birthValue g e)).map
      (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop β))) at hp
  rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp hp with hp | hp
  · obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hp
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
    have hle := hg (faceTemplatePairs_lt k e n r hr).le
    have hne := (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
    exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne)
  · obtain ⟨q, _, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hp
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.evaluateFaceTemplate_constant_points
statement:
theorem evaluateFaceTemplate_constant_points {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (e : CompatibleOrder f) (g : FilterFunction K β)
    (hg : Monotone (g.value ∘ e.enum)) (n : ℕ) (c : β)
    (hc : ∀ s : TotalFace K, g.value s = c) :
    (evaluateFaceTemplate k e g hg n).points =
      (faceTemplateEssential k e n).map
        (fun _ => (c, (⊤ : WithTop β)))
proof:
:= by
  simp [evaluateFaceTemplate, pairValues, birthValue, hc]
  intro a b x y _ hca hcb
  exact hca.symm.trans hcb

name: TDA.Persistence.evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_orderedQ
statement:
theorem evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_orderedQ {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (e : CompatibleOrder f) (g : FilterFunction K β)
    (hg : Monotone (g.value ∘ e.enum)) (n : ℕ) :
    let P := (faceTemplatePairs k e n).map (pairValues g e)
    let U := (faceTemplateEssential k e n).map (birthValue g e)
    evaluateFaceTemplate k e g hg n =
      orderedQ P.toList.length U.toList.length (P.toList.get, U.toList.get)
proof:
:= by
  intro P U
  apply Diagram.ext
  simp only [evaluateFaceTemplate, orderedQ, List.ofFn_get, Multiset.coe_toList]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_orderedQ_of_enumerations
statement:
theorem evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_orderedQ_of_enumerations
    {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β] (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (g : FilterFunction K β) (hg : Monotone (g.value ∘ e.enum)) (n : ℕ)
    (m l : ℕ) (x : Fin m → β × β) (y : Fin l → β)
    (hx : Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn x) =
      (faceTemplatePairs k e n).map (pairValues g e))
    (hy : Multiset.ofList (List.ofFn y) =
      (faceTemplateEssential k e n).map (birthValue g e)) :
    evaluateFaceTemplate k e g hg n = orderedQ m l (x, y)
proof:
:= by
  let P := (faceTemplatePairs k e n).map (pairValues g e)
  let U := (faceTemplateEssential k e n).map (birthValue g e)
  rw [evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_orderedQ]
  apply (orderedQ_eq_iff P.toList.length U.toList.length m l
    (P.toList.get, U.toList.get) (x, y)).mpr
  constructor
  · simpa only [List.ofFn_get, Multiset.coe_toList] using
      congrArg (Multiset.filter (fun p : β × β => p.1 ≠ p.2)) hx.symm
  · simpa only [List.ofFn_get, Multiset.coe_toList] using hy.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.evaluateFaceTemplate_points_filterMap
statement:
private theorem evaluateFaceTemplate_points_filterMap
    (e : CompatibleOrder f) (n : ℕ) :
    (evaluateFaceTemplate k e f e.monotone n).points =
      (facePrefixBarcode k e n).filterMap (facePoint e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let B := facePrefixBarcode k e n
  have hpos : ∀ I ∈ B, 0 < I.birth := by
    intro I hI
    exact facePrefixBarcode_birth_pos k e n I hI
  change (((B.filterMap fun I =>
      if hb : 0 < I.birth then
        if hd : I.death ≤ faceCount K then
          some (birthFaceIndex I hb, deathFaceIndex I hd)
        else none
      else none).map (pairValues f e)).filter
      (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)).map (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop α))) +
    ((B.filterMap fun I =>
      if hb : 0 < I.birth then
        if I.death ≤ faceCount K then none
        else some (birthFaceIndex I hb)
      else none).map (birthValue f e)).map
      (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop α))) = B.filterMap (facePoint e)
  revert hpos
  induction B using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons I B ih =>
    intro hpos
    have hb : 0 < I.birth := hpos I (Multiset.mem_cons_self I B)
    have hposB : ∀ J ∈ B, 0 < J.birth := by
      intro J hJ
      exact hpos J (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hJ)
    specialize ih hposB
    by_cases hd : I.death ≤ faceCount K
    · by_cases hv : f.value (e.enum (birthFaceIndex I hb)) =
          f.value (e.enum (deathFaceIndex I hd))
      · simp [Multiset.filterMap_cons, hb, hd, hv, facePoint,
          pairValues, birthValue, ih, add_assoc]
        simpa only [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def, ne_eq] using ih
      · simp [Multiset.filterMap_cons, hb, hd, hv, facePoint,
          pairValues, birthValue, ih, add_assoc]
        simpa only [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def, ne_eq] using ih
    · simp [Multiset.filterMap_cons, hb, hd, facePoint,
        pairValues, birthValue, ih, add_assoc]
      simpa only [Multiset.map_map, Function.comp_def, ne_eq] using ih

name: TDA.Persistence.filterMap_congr_mem
proof:
:= by
  revert h
  induction B using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => intro _; simp
  | @cons x B ih =>
    intro h
    have hx := h x (Multiset.mem_cons_self x B)
    have hB : ∀ y ∈ B, a y = b y := by
      intro y hy
      exact h y (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hy)
    simp [Multiset.filterMap_cons, hx, ih hB]

name: TDA.Persistence.evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm
statement:
theorem evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (e : CompatibleOrder f) (g : FilterFunction K β)
    (hg : Monotone (g.value ∘ e.enum)) (n : ℕ) :
    evaluateFaceTemplate k e g hg n = dgm k g n
proof:
:= by
  let eg : CompatibleOrder g := e.transfer hg
  have htemplate : evaluateFaceTemplate k e g hg n =
      evaluateFaceTemplate k eg g eg.monotone n := by
    rfl
  rw [htemplate]
  apply Diagram.ext
  rw [evaluateFaceTemplate_points_filterMap]
  have hreindex := gradeHomologyBarcode_eq_reindex_facePrefixBarcode k eg n
  change (facePrefixBarcode k eg n).filterMap (facePoint eg) =
    (gradeHomologyBarcode k g n).map (gradePoint g.criticalValue)
  rw [hreindex]
  change (facePrefixBarcode k eg n).filterMap (facePoint eg) =
    ((facePrefixBarcode k eg n).filterMap
      (FiniteInterval.restrictAlong (faceGradeSample eg))).map
        (gradePoint g.criticalValue)
  classical
  rw [Multiset.map_filterMap]
  apply filterMap_congr_mem
  intro I hI
  exact facePoint_restrictAlong eg I (facePrefixBarcode_birth_pos k eg n I hI)

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_finite_death_from_faceTemplate
statement:
theorem dgm_finite_death_from_faceTemplate {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (e : CompatibleOrder f) (g : FilterFunction K β)
    (hg : Monotone (g.value ∘ e.enum)) (n : ℕ) (b d : β)
    (hp : (b, (d : WithTop β)) ∈ (dgm k g n).points) :
    ∃ p ∈ faceTemplatePairs k e n, g.value (e.enum p.2) = d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm k e g hg n] at hp
  change (b, (d : WithTop β)) ∈
    (((faceTemplatePairs k e n).map (pairValues g e)).filter
      (fun p => p.1 ≠ p.2)).map (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop β))) +
    ((faceTemplateEssential k e n).map (birthValue g e)).map
      (fun x => (x, (⊤ : WithTop β))) at hp
  rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp hp with hfinite | hessential
  · obtain ⟨q, hq, hqeq⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hfinite
    obtain ⟨p, hp', hpq⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp (Multiset.mem_filter.mp hq).1
    refine ⟨p, hp', ?_⟩
    subst q
    have hdeath := congrArg Prod.snd hqeq
    exact WithTop.coe_inj.mp hdeath
  · obtain ⟨x, _, hx⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hessential
    have hdeath := congrArg Prod.snd hx
    simp at hdeath

name: TDA.Persistence.facePrefixBarcode_sameEnumeration
statement:
theorem facePrefixBarcode_sameEnumeration {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (e : CompatibleOrder f) {g : FilterFunction K β}
    (e' : CompatibleOrder g) (henum : e.enum = e'.enum) (n : ℕ) :
    facePrefixBarcode k e n = facePrefixBarcode k e' n
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Monotone (g.value ∘ e.enum) := by
    simpa only [henum] using e'.monotone
  have he : e.transfer hg = e' := by
    cases e with
    | mk enum face_lt monotone =>
      cases e' with
      | mk enum' face_lt' monotone' =>
        dsimp at henum
        cases henum
        rfl
  rw [← he]
  exact (facePrefixBarcode_transfer k e g hg n).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.faceTemplatePairs_strict_orderingEquivalent
statement:
theorem faceTemplatePairs_strict_orderingEquivalent {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (e : CompatibleOrder f) (g : FilterFunction K β)
    (hfg : OrderingEquivalent f g) (n : ℕ) :
    (faceTemplatePairs k e n).filter
        (fun p => f.value (e.enum p.1) < f.value (e.enum p.2)) =
      (faceTemplatePairs k e n).filter
        (fun p => g.value (e.enum p.1) < g.value (e.enum p.2))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Multiset.filter_congr
  intro p _
  simpa only [lt_iff_not_ge] using
    (not_congr (hfg (e.enum p.2) (e.enum p.1)))

  apply Multiset.filter_congr

statement:
@[simp] theorem fromBirth_birth (i : P) (M : PModule.{u,v,u} R P) (m : M.obj i) :
    ((fromBirth i M m).app i).hom (birth i) = m
proof:
:=
  GradedFree.lift_birth (R := R) (generators i) M (fun _ => m) ()

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {i : P} {M : PModule.{u,v,u} R P} {α β : module (R := R) i ⟶ M}
    (h : (α.app i).hom (birth i) = (β.app i).hom (birth i)) : α = β
proof:
:= by
  have hα := GradedFree.lift_unique (R := R) (generators i) M
    (fun _ => (α.app i).hom (birth i)) α (by intro g; cases g; rfl)
  have hβ := GradedFree.lift_unique (R := R) (generators i) M
    (fun _ => (α.app i).hom (birth i)) β (by intro g; cases g; exact h.symm)
  exact hα.trans hβ.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.exists_lift_of_birth_surjective
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hπ ((α.app i).hom (birth i))
  refine ⟨fromBirth i M m, ?_⟩
  apply hom_ext
  change (π.app i).hom (((fromBirth i M m).app i).hom (birth i)) = _
  rw [fromBirth_birth]
  exact hm

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.exists_lift_of_surjective

:=
  exists_lift_of_birth_surjective π (hπ i) α

name: TDA.Persistence.HookInfinity.exists_lift_rankExact

theorem exists_lift_rankExact {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {i : P} {L M N : PModule.{u,v,u} k P} {ι : L ⟶ M} {π : M ⟶ N}
    (hs : IsRankExact ι π) (α : module (R := k) i ⟶ N) :
    ∃ β : module (R := k) i ⟶ M, β ≫ π = α
proof:
:=
  exists_lift_of_surjective π hs.surjective α

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.interval_qTame
statement:
private theorem interval_qTame (p : ℝ × WithTop ℝ) :
    (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) p).QTame
proof:
:=
  PModule.qTame_of_finiteDimensional _ (fun t => by
    change FiniteDimensional k (RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) p t)
    infer_instance)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.interval_zero_below_zero
statement:
private theorem interval_zero_below_zero (d : WithTop ℝ) (t : ℝ) (ht : t < 0) :
    IsZero ((RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, d)).obj t)
proof:
:= by
  apply ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton.mpr
  change Subsingleton (RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) (0, d) t)
  have hn : ¬ RealBarcode.alive (0, d) t := fun h => not_le_of_gt ht h.1
  have hbot : RealBarcode.fiber (k := k) (0, d) t = (⊥ : Submodule k k) := by
    unfold RealBarcode.fiber
    exact if_neg hn
  rw [hbot]
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.essential_interval_exact_boundary_atom
statement:
theorem essential_interval_exact_boundary_atom :
    moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, ⊤))
      (interval_qTame _) (minusCut 0, infinityCut) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let M := RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))
  have hM := interval_qTame (k := k) (0, (⊤ : WithTop ℝ))
  have hK : cutCell (-1 : ℝ) 0 ∈ cutCells := cutCell_mem_cutCells _ _
  have hcount : essentialCutContent M hM (cutCell (-1 : ℝ) 0) = 1 := by
    rw [essentialCutContent_apply M hM (show (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 0 by norm_num)]
    exact PersistenceMeasureExamples.essential_interval_count_one
  obtain ⟨birth, hbK, hbpos⟩ := exists_moduleEssential_atom_of_positive M hM hK (by omega)
  have hle := moduleEssentialMultiplicity_le_content M hM hK hbK
  have hbunit : moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM (birth, infinityCut) = 1 := by
    rw [moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_infinity]
    omega
  have hlower := moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity_birth_lower_bound M hM 0
    (interval_zero_below_zero (k := k) ⊤) (p := (birth, infinityCut)) (by omega)
  have hupper := (cutEndpoint_bounds hbK).2
  have hEndpoint : cutEndpoint birth = 0 := le_antisymm hupper hlower
  have hbirth : birth = minusCut 0 := by
    rcases cut_eq_minus_or_plus_of_mem_cutCell hbK with hm | hp
    · simpa only [hEndpoint] using hm
    · have heq : birth = plusCut 0 := by simpa only [hEndpoint] using hp
      have hu := hbK.2
      rw [heq] at hu
      norm_num [plusCut] at hu
  change moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity M hM (minusCut 0, infinityCut) = 1
  rw [← hbirth]
  exact hbunit

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.essential_interval_no_finite_death_atom
statement:
theorem essential_interval_no_finite_death_atom (p : Cut ℝ × Cut ℝ) (hp : p.2 ≠ infinityCut) :
    moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity (RealBarcode.intervalModule (k := k) (0, ⊤))
      (interval_qTame _) p = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [moduleExtendedDiagramMultiplicity, if_neg hp]
  apply moduleDiagramMultiplicity_eq_zero_of_rectangle_zero
  intro a b c d hab hbc hcd
  exact PersistenceMeasureExamples.essential_interval_finite_rectangle_zero hab.le hbc.le hcd.le

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.repeated_finite_part
statement:
private theorem repeated_finite_part :
    finitePart repeated.points = {((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ), (0, 2)}
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.repeated_essential_part
statement: private theorem repeated_essential_part : essentialPart repeated.points = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.essential_finite_part
statement: private theorem essential_finite_part : finitePart essential.points = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.essential_essential_part
statement: private theorem essential_essential_part : essentialPart essential.points = {(0 : ℝ)}
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.repeated_positive
statement: private theorem repeated_positive : repeated.IsPositive
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [Diagram.IsPositive, repeated]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.repeated_card
statement: private theorem repeated_card : Fintype.card repeated.finiteOccurrences = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.card_coe]
  rw [repeated_finite_part]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.empty_card
statement: private theorem empty_card : Fintype.card emptyDiagram.finiteOccurrences = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.card_coe]
  simp [emptyDiagram, finitePart]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.repeated_coordinates
statement:
private theorem repeated_coordinates (q : repeated.finiteOccurrences) :
    q.1 = ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Multiset.coe_mem (x := q)
  simpa [repeated_finite_part, eq_comm] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.repeated_to_empty
statement:
private theorem repeated_to_empty (p : ℝ) (E : Diagram ℝ)
    (hE : Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences = 0) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : repeated.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
      (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) = (2 : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  have : IsEmpty E.finiteOccurrences := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.mp hE
  rw [finitePBoundaryTransportCost_of_isEmpty_right]
  have hd : (diagonalCost ((0, 2) : ℝ × ℝ)).toReal = 1 := by norm_num [diagonalCost]
  simp only [repeated_coordinates, hd, Real.one_rpow, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    repeated_card, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_one]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.repeated_bottleneck
statement: private theorem repeated_bottleneck : bottleneck repeated emptyDiagram = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hz : emptyDiagram = orderedQ 0 0
      ((Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ × ℝ), (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → ℝ)) := by
    apply Diagram.ext
    simp [emptyDiagram, orderedQ]
  have : Nonempty repeated.finiteOccurrences := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by
    rw [repeated_card]; decide)
  rw [hz, bottleneck_finite_only_empty repeated repeated_essential_part]
  simp only [repeated_coordinates]
  norm_num [diagonalCost]
  exact Finset.sup_const Finset.univ_nonempty 1

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.repeated_bound_is_equality
statement:
private theorem repeated_bound_is_equality (p : ℝ) :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost p (fun q : repeated.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : emptyDiagram.finiteOccurrences => q.1) =
      (((Fintype.card repeated.finiteOccurrences +
        Fintype.card emptyDiagram.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ p⁻¹) *
        (bottleneck repeated emptyDiagram).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [repeated_to_empty p emptyDiagram empty_card, repeated_card, empty_card,
    repeated_bottleneck]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.repeated_squared_cost
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow] using repeated_to_empty 2 emptyDiagram empty_card

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.repeated_noninteger_cost
proof:
:= by
  simpa using repeated_to_empty ((3 : ℝ) / 2) emptyDiagram empty_card

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.repeated_not_bounded_by_bottleneck
statement:
private theorem repeated_not_bounded_by_bottleneck :
    ¬ finitePBoundaryTransportCost 2 (fun q : repeated.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : emptyDiagram.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤
      (bottleneck repeated emptyDiagram).toReal
proof:
:= by
  rw [repeated_to_empty 2 emptyDiagram empty_card, repeated_bottleneck]
  norm_num only [ENNReal.toReal_one]
  exact not_le_of_gt (Real.one_lt_rpow (by norm_num) (by norm_num))

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.empty_budget
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card emptyDiagram.finiteOccurrences +
      Fintype.card emptyDiagram.finiteOccurrences ≤ 0 := by norm_num only [empty_card]
  simpa using finitePBoundaryTransportCost_le_cardBound_rpow_mul_of_bottleneck_le
    hp emptyDiagram emptyDiagram hcard (r := 0) (le_refl 0) (by simp [bottleneck_self])

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.first_order_recovery
statement:
private theorem first_order_recovery (D E : Diagram ℝ) (hfinite : bottleneck D E < ⊤) :
    finiteFirstOrderMatchingCost (fun q : D.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : E.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤
      ((Fintype.card D.finiteOccurrences + Fintype.card E.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
        (bottleneck D E).toReal
proof:
:= by
  simpa using finitePMatchingCost_le_card_rpow_mul_bottleneck (p := 1) (le_refl 1)
    D E hfinite

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.essential_mismatch_top
statement: private theorem essential_mismatch_top : bottleneck repeated essential = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hc := (bottleneck_lt_top_iff repeated essential).mp (lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr h)
  rw [repeated_essential_part, essential_essential_part] at hc
  norm_num at hc

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.essential_mismatch_invalid_real_bound
statement:
private theorem essential_mismatch_invalid_real_bound :
    ¬ finitePBoundaryTransportCost 1 (fun q : repeated.finiteOccurrences => q.1)
        (fun q : essential.finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤
      (((Fintype.card repeated.finiteOccurrences +
        Fintype.card essential.finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 : ℝ)⁻¹) *
        (bottleneck repeated essential).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Fintype.card essential.finiteOccurrences = 0 := by
    rw [Multiset.card_coe]
    rw [essential_finite_part]
    rfl
  rw [repeated_to_empty 1 essential hc, essential_mismatch_top]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.triangle_finite_parts
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [triangleFilter, dgm_map, finitePart_map_points,
      Reduction.Examples.FilledTriangle.diagram_one]
    change Multiset.map (fun q : ℕ × ℕ => ((q.1 : ℝ), (q.2 : ℝ))) {(1, 2)} = _
    norm_num
  · rw [tiedTriangleFilter, dgm_map, finitePart_map_points,
      Reduction.Examples.FilledTriangle.tied_diagram_one]
    simp [finitePart]

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.triangle_card_budget
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Diagram.finiteOccurrences, Multiset.card_coe, triangle_finite_parts.1,
    triangle_finite_parts.2]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.triangle_face_perturbation
statement: private theorem triangle_face_perturbation : faceSupDifference triangleFilter tiedTriangleFilter ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold faceSupDifference
  apply (Finset.fold_max_le (1 : ℝ)).mpr
  refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro σ _
  have hc : σ.1.card ≤ 3 := (Finset.card_le_univ σ.1).trans_eq (by decide)
  have hd : σ.1.card - 1 ≤ 2 := by omega
  change |((σ.1.card - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - ((min (σ.1.card - 1) 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)| ≤ 1
  generalize σ.1.card - 1 = a at hd ⊢
  interval_cases a <;> norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.triangle_bound
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Fintype.card (dgm (ZMod 2) triangleFilter 1).finiteOccurrences +
      Fintype.card (dgm (ZMod 2) tiedTriangleFilter 1).finiteOccurrences ≤ 1 :=
    triangle_card_budget.le
  have h := finitePBoundaryTransportCost_dgm_le_cardBound_rpow_mul_faceSupDifference hp
    (ZMod 2) triangleFilter tiedTriangleFilter 1 hc
  have h' : finitePBoundaryTransportCost p
      (fun q : (dgm (ZMod 2) triangleFilter 1).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
      (fun q : (dgm (ZMod 2) tiedTriangleFilter 1).finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤
      faceSupDifference triangleFilter tiedTriangleFilter := by simpa using h
  exact h'.trans triangle_face_perturbation

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.triangle_squared
proof:
:=
  triangle_bound (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.FinitePFilterStabilityExamples.triangle_noninteger
statement:
private theorem triangle_noninteger :
    finitePBoundaryTransportCost ((3 : ℝ) / 2)
      (fun q : (dgm (ZMod 2) triangleFilter 1).finiteOccurrences => q.1)
      (fun q : (dgm (ZMod 2) tiedTriangleFilter 1).finiteOccurrences => q.1) ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  triangle_bound (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.mem_full
statement:
@[simp] private theorem mem_full {V : Type} (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) ↔ s.Nonempty
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.vertex_chain
statement:
private theorem vertex_chain {V W : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder W]
    (R : Type) [Ring R] {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W} (f : VertexMap K L) (x : V)
    (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ K) (hy : ({f x} : Finset W) ∈ L) (a : R) :
    vertexChainMap R f 0 (Finsupp.single (vertex K x hx) a) =
      Finsupp.single (vertex L (f x) hy) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexChainMap_vertex]
  congr 1
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [vertexImageFace, tupleFace]
  dsimp
  rw [← Finset.image_image, Finset.image_orderEmbOfFin_univ]
  simp [vertex]

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.vClass_map
statement:
private theorem vClass_map {V W : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder W]
    (R : Type) [Ring R] {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W} (f : VertexMap K L) (x : V)
    (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ K) (hy : ({f x} : Finset W) ∈ L) (a : R) :
    (simplicialHomologyMap R f 0).hom (vClass R K x hx a) = vClass R L (f x) hy a
proof:
:=
  simplicialHomologyMap_class R f 0 _ _ (vertex_chain R f x hx hy a)

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.vClass_nonzero
statement:
private theorem vClass_nonzero {V : Type} [LinearOrder V]
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (x : V) (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ K) :
    vClass ℚ K x hx 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hq := congrArg (homologyKernelQuotient ℚ (simplicialChainComplex K ℚ) 0).hom.hom hz
  unfold vClass at hq
  rw [simplicialHomologyClass_quotient, map_zero] at hq
  exact zeroVertexCycle_not_boundary K ℚ (vertex K x hx)
    ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hq)

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.univTotal
statement:
private theorem univTotal {V W : Type} (w : W) :
    Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ (Set.univ : SetRel V W))
proof:
:=
  fun _ => ⟨w, Set.mem_univ _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.subordinate_univ
statement:
private theorem subordinate_univ {V W : Type} (f : V → W) :
    Function.graph f ⊆ (Set.univ : SetRel V W)
proof: := Set.subset_univ _

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.univBirth
proof:
:= by
  intro t σ hσ τ hτ _
  by_cases ht : a ≤ t
  · have hb : b ≤ t + (b-a) := by linarith
    simpa [birth, hb] using hτ
  · simp [birth, ht] at hσ

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.fullRelation
proof:
:= by
  intro _ _ _ _ hτ _
  exact hτ

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.compTotal
statement:
private theorem compTotal {V W U : Type} {C : SetRel V W} {D : SetRel W U}
    (hC : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hD : Relator.LeftTotal (fun y z => (y,z) ∈ D)) :
    Relator.LeftTotal (fun x z => (x,z) ∈ C.comp D)
proof:
:=
  Relator.LeftTotal.trans (r₁₃ := fun x z => (x,z) ∈ C.comp D)
    (fun _ y _ hxy hyz => ⟨y,hxy,hyz⟩) hC hD

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.compSub
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨x,z⟩ h
  change g (f x) = z at h
  subst z
  exact ⟨f x,hf rfl,hg rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.composite_image
statement:
private theorem composite_image {V W U : Type} [LinearOrder V] [LinearOrder W] [LinearOrder U]
    (R : Type) [Ring R]
    {F : SimplicialFiltration ℝ V} {G : SimplicialFiltration ℝ W}
    {H : SimplicialFiltration ℝ U} {ε δ : ℝ} {C : SetRel V W} {D : SetRel W U}
    (hCT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x,y) ∈ C))
    (hDT : Relator.LeftTotal (fun y z => (y,z) ∈ D))
    (hC : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G ε C) (hD : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation G H δ D)
    {f : V → W} {g : W → U} (hf : Function.graph f ⊆ C) (hg : Function.graph g ⊆ D)
    (t : ℝ) (x : V) (hx : ({x} : Finset V) ∈ F t)
    (hy : ({g (f x)} : Finset U) ∈ H (t + (ε + δ))) (a : R) :
    ((multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R hCT hC 0 ≫
      reindexNatTrans (OrderHomClass.toOrderHom (OrderIso.addRight ε))
        (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R hDT hD 0) ≫
      (shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso R H ε δ 0).hom).app t).hom
      (vClass R (F t) x hx a) = vClass R (H (t + (ε + δ))) (g (f x)) hy a
proof:
:= by
  rw [multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp,
    multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_app R _ (hC.comp hD) (compSub hf hg)]
  exact vClass_map R _ x hx hy a

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.firstRelation
statement:
private theorem firstRelation : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation point0 edge1 1
    (Set.univ : SetRel (Fin 1) (Fin 2))
proof:
:= by
  simpa using univBirth (W := Fin 2) 0 1 pointK

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.secondRelation
statement:
private theorem secondRelation : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation edge1 triangle3 2
    (Set.univ : SetRel (Fin 2) (Fin 3))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [show (3 : ℝ) - 1 = 2 by norm_num] using univBirth (W := Fin 3) 1 3 edgeK

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.born_whole_composition
statement:
private theorem born_whole_composition (R : Type) [Ring R] :
    bornComposite R = multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap R
      (compTotal (univTotal (V := Fin 1) (0 : Fin 2)) (univTotal (V := Fin 2) (0 : Fin 3)))
      (firstRelation.comp secondRelation) 0
proof:
:=
  multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap_comp R _ _ _ _ 0

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.born_image
proof:
:=
  composite_image ℚ _ _ firstRelation secondRelation
    (subordinate_univ (fun _ : Fin 1 => i))
    (subordinate_univ (fun _ : Fin 2 => j)) 0 0 _ _ 1

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.born_nonzero
statement:
private theorem born_nonzero :
    ((bornComposite ℚ).app 0).hom (vClass ℚ (point0 0) 0 (by norm_num [birth]) 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [born_image 0 0]
  exact vClass_nonzero _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.born_canonical_composite_nonzero
statement:
private theorem born_canonical_composite_nonzero :
    ((multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap ℚ
      (compTotal (univTotal (V := Fin 1) (0 : Fin 2)) (univTotal (V := Fin 2) (0 : Fin 3)))
      (firstRelation.comp secondRelation) 0).app 0).hom
      (vClass ℚ (point0 0) 0 (by norm_num [birth]) 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← born_whole_composition]
  exact born_nonzero

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.born_selector_comparison
proof:
:=
  (born_image 0 0).symm.trans (born_image 1 2)

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.born_selectors_distinct
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1) (congrFun h 0)
  · intro h; exact (by decide : (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2) (congrFun h 0)

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.negativeRelation
statement:
private theorem negativeRelation : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation point2 edge1 (-1)
    (Set.univ : SetRel (Fin 1) (Fin 2))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [show (1 : ℝ) - 2 = -1 by norm_num] using univBirth (W := Fin 2) 2 1 pointK

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.collapseRelation
statement:
private theorem collapseRelation : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation edge1 point3 2
    (Set.univ : SetRel (Fin 2) (Fin 1))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [show (3 : ℝ) - 1 = 2 by norm_num] using univBirth (W := Fin 1) 1 3 edgeK

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.negative_positive_image
statement:
private theorem negative_positive_image :
    ((multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap ℚ (univTotal (V := Fin 1) (0 : Fin 2)) negativeRelation 0 ≫
      reindexNatTrans (OrderHomClass.toOrderHom (OrderIso.addRight (-1 : ℝ)))
        (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap ℚ (univTotal (V := Fin 2) (0 : Fin 1)) collapseRelation 0) ≫
      (shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso ℚ point3 (-1) 2 0).hom).app 2).hom
        (vClass ℚ (point2 2) 0 (by norm_num [birth]) 1) =
      vClass ℚ (point3 (2 + (-1 + 2))) 0 (by norm_num [birth]) 1
proof:
:=
  composite_image ℚ _ _ negativeRelation collapseRelation
    (subordinate_univ (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : Fin 2)))
    (subordinate_univ (fun _ : Fin 2 => (0 : Fin 1))) 2 0 _ _ 1

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.negative_positive_target_nonzero
statement:
private theorem negative_positive_target_nonzero :
    vClass ℚ (point3 (2 + (-1 + 2))) 0 (by norm_num [birth]) 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  vClass_nonzero _ _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.mixed_sign_degree_one
statement:
private theorem mixed_sign_degree_one :
    IsShiftedSimplicial point2 point3 1 (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : Fin 1))
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, show (-1 : ℝ) + 2 = 1 by norm_num] using
    (negativeRelation.of_subordinate (subordinate_univ (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : Fin 2)))).comp
      (collapseRelation.of_subordinate (subordinate_univ (fun _ : Fin 2 => (0 : Fin 1))))

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.negative_second_level
statement:
private theorem negative_second_level :
    (2 : ℝ) + (-1) = 1 ∧
    (reindexNatTrans (OrderHomClass.toOrderHom (OrderIso.addRight (-1 : ℝ)))
      (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap ℚ (univTotal (V := Fin 2) (0 : Fin 1)) collapseRelation 0)).app 2 =
    (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap ℚ (univTotal (V := Fin 2) (0 : Fin 1)) collapseRelation 0).app (2 + (-1))
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨by norm_num, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.mixed_sign_degree_zero_fails
statement:
private theorem mixed_sign_degree_zero_fails :
    ¬IsShiftedSimplicial point2 point3 0 (fun _ : Fin 1 => (0 : Fin 1))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hh := h 2 {0} (by norm_num [birth])
  norm_num [birth] at hh

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.parityShift
statement:
private theorem parityShift : IsShiftedSimplicial (constF (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex ℕ))
    (constF edgeK) 0 parity
proof:
:= by
  let : DecidableEq (Fin 2) := Classical.decEq _
  intro t σ hσ
  exact Finset.image_nonempty.mpr hσ

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.intermediate_image_infinite
statement:
private theorem intermediate_image_infinite :
    (SetRel.image (Set.univ : SetRel (Fin 1) ℕ) ({(0 : Fin 1)} : Set (Fin 1))).Infinite
proof:
:= by
  have he : SetRel.image (Set.univ : SetRel (Fin 1) ℕ) ({(0 : Fin 1)} : Set (Fin 1)) = Set.univ := by
    ext k
    constructor
    · intro _; trivial
    · intro _; exact ⟨0, by simp, Set.mem_univ _⟩
  rw [he]
  exact Set.infinite_univ

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.parity_composite_endpoints
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨0, by simp, (i : ℕ), Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  change parity (i : ℕ) = i
  exact Fin.ext (Nat.mod_eq_of_lt i.2)

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.infinite_composition_image
statement:
private theorem infinite_composition_image :
    ((multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap ℚ (univTotal (V := Fin 1) (0 : ℕ)) infiniteC 0 ≫
      reindexNatTrans (OrderHomClass.toOrderHom (OrderIso.addRight (0 : ℝ)))
        (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap ℚ (fun k => ⟨parity k,rfl⟩) parityD 0) ≫
      (shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso ℚ (constF edgeK) 0 0 0).hom).app 0).hom
      (vClass ℚ ((constF pointK) 0) 0 (by simp [constF]) 1) =
    vClass ℚ ((constF edgeK) (0 + (0 + 0))) 1 (by simp [constF]) 1
proof:
:= by
  exact composite_image ℚ _ _ infiniteC parityD
    (subordinate_univ (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : ℕ))) (Set.Subset.refl _) 0 0 _ _ 1

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.infinite_target_nonzero
statement:
private theorem infinite_target_nonzero :

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.signed_reversal_injection
statement:
private theorem signed_reversal_injection :
    vertexChainMap ℤ (VertexMap.comp (fullMap rev) (fullMap inj)) 1
      (orientedTuple edgeK ℤ (id : Fin 2 → Fin 2)) =
      -orientedTuple triangleK ℤ inj
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertexChainMap_comp]
  change vertexChainMap ℤ (fullMap inj) 1
    (vertexChainMap ℤ (fullMap rev) 1 (orientedTuple edgeK ℤ id)) = _
  rw [vertexChainMap_orientedTuple ℤ _ _ (by simp),
    vertexChainMap_orientedTuple ℤ _ _ (by simp [rev])]
  have hp := orientedTuple_comp_perm triangleK ℤ inj (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1)
  simpa [rev, inj, fullMap, Function.comp_def,
    Equiv.Perm.sign_swap (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) ≠ 1)] using hp

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.ghost_relation
statement:
private theorem ghost_relation :
    IsShiftedSimplicialRelation (constF (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) (constF ghostEdge) 0 ghostC
proof:
:= by
  intro t σ hσ τ hτ hsub
  have hσ0 : σ = {0} := hσ
  refine ⟨hτ, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hsub hy
  have hx0 : x = 0 := by simpa [hσ0] using hx
  have hy01 : y = 0 ∨ y = 1 := by simpa [ghostC, hx0] using hxy
  simpa using hy01

name: TDA.Persistence.SimplicialMultivaluedMapCompositionExamples.ghostCollapse_shift
statement:
private theorem ghostCollapse_shift : IsShiftedSimplicial (constF ghostEdge)
    (constF (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) 0 ghostCollapse
proof:
:= by
  let : DecidableEq (Fin 2) := Classical.decEq _
  intro t σ hσ
  change σ.image ghostCollapse = {0}
  ext z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    obtain ⟨y,hy,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hz
    have hy01 : y = 0 ∨ y = 1 := by simpa using hσ.2 hy
    rcases hy01 with rfl | rfl <;> simp [ghostCollapse]
  · intro hz
    have hz0 : z = 0 := by simpa using hz
    subst z
    obtain ⟨y,hy⟩ := hσ.1
    have hy01 : y = 0 ∨ y = 1 := by simpa using hσ.2 hy
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨y,hy,?_⟩
    rcases hy01 with rfl | rfl <;> simp [ghostCollapse]

        (multivaluedSimplicialHomologyMap ℚ (fun y => ⟨ghostCollapse y,rfl⟩) ghostD 0) ≫
      (shiftedSimplicialHomologyCompIso ℚ (constF (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2))) 0 0 0).hom).app 0).hom
        (vClass ℚ (singletonFace (0 : Fin 2)) 0 rfl 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have he := composite_image ℚ ghost_total (fun y => ⟨ghostCollapse y,rfl⟩)
    ghost_relation ghostD ghostSub (Set.Subset.refl _) 0 0 rfl
    (by simp [constF, ghostCollapse, ghostSelect, mem_singletonFace_iff]) 1
  intro hz
  exact vClass_nonzero _ _ _ (he.symm.trans hz)

    ({(2 : Fin 3)} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∉ ghostEdge ∧

    (1,1) ∈ ghostC.comp (Function.graph ghostCollapse)

  · intro h

    exact (by decide : (2 : Fin 3) ∉ ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 3))) hh
