name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankExact.comp_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem IsRankExact.comp_finitelyPresented
    (hsπ : IsRankExact ι π) (hsσ : IsRankExact κ σ)
    (hL : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) L)
    (hK : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) K) :
    FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) (Limits.kernel (π ≫ σ)) ∧
      IsRankExact (Limits.kernel.ι (π ≫ σ)) (π ≫ σ)
proof:
:= by
  have hKernelσ : FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) (Limits.kernel σ) :=
    finitelyPresented_of_iso hK hsσ.toIsPointwiseShortExact.kernelIso
  have hPullback :
      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P)
        (Limits.pullback π (Limits.kernel.ι σ)) :=
    hsπ.toIsPointwiseShortExact.finitelyPresented_pullback
      (Limits.kernel.ι σ) hL hKernelσ
  have hCompositeKernel :
      FinitelyPresented.{u,0,0} (R := k) (P := P) (Limits.kernel (π ≫ σ)) :=
    finitelyPresented_of_iso hPullback (kernelCompIsoPullback π σ).symm
  exact ⟨hCompositeKernel,
    (hsπ.isRankDeflation.comp hsσ.isRankDeflation).rankExact_kernel⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CoordinateGrid.lan_isRankProjective
statement:
theorem lan_isRankProjective (P : PModule.{u,0,u} k G.Point)
    (hP : IsRankProjective P) : IsRankProjective (G.lan.obj P)
proof:
:= by
  intro L M N ι π hs α
  let adj := G.embedding.monotone.functor.lanAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u} k)
  let α' : P ⟶ G.embedding.monotone.functor ⋙ N := (adj.homEquiv P N) α
  have hs' :
      IsRankExact (reindexNatTrans G.embedding.toOrderHom ι)
        (reindexNatTrans G.embedding.toOrderHom π) := hs.reindex G.embedding.toOrderHom
  obtain ⟨β', hβ'⟩ := hP _ _ _ _ _ hs' α'
  let β : G.lan.obj P ⟶ M := (adj.homEquiv P M).symm β'
  refine ⟨β, ?_⟩
  apply (adj.homEquiv P N).injective
  rw [adj.homEquiv_naturality_right]
  have hβcomp : (adj.homEquiv P M) β = β' := Equiv.apply_symm_apply _ _
  rw [hβcomp]
  change β' ≫ reindexNatTrans G.embedding.toOrderHom π = (adj.homEquiv P N) α
  exact hβ'

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureMatching.exists_small_radius
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have aux : ∀ s : Finset J, ∃ t, 0 < t ∧ t < ρ ∧
      ∀ j ∈ s, dist (y j) p ≤ r + t → dist (y j) p ≤ r := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty => exact ⟨ρ / 2, by positivity, by linarith, by simp⟩
    | @insert j s hj ih =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, htρ, hts⟩ := ih
      by_cases hd : dist (y j) p ≤ r
      · refine ⟨t, ht, htρ, ?_⟩
        intro l hl hlr
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hl with rfl | hl
        · exact hd
        · exact hts l hl hlr
      · have hd' : r < dist (y j) p := lt_of_not_ge hd
        refine ⟨min t ((dist (y j) p - r) / 2), lt_min ht (by linarith),
          lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) htρ, ?_⟩
        intro l hl hlr
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hl with rfl | hl
        · have := min_le_right t ((dist (y l) p - r) / 2)
          linarith
        · exact hts l hl (hlr.trans (add_le_add le_rfl (min_le_left _ _)))
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htρ, hts⟩ := aux Finset.univ
  exact ⟨t, ht, htρ, fun j => hts j (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureMatching.finiteBoxCount_box_le
statement:
theorem finiteBoxCount_box_le (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ)
    {ε : ℝ} (hbox : ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r →
      2 * (r + ε) < p.2 - p.1 → finiteBoxCount x p r ≤ finiteBoxCount y p (r + ε))
    (p : ℝ × ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hgap : 2 * (r + ε) < p.2 - p.1) :
    finiteBoxCount x p r ≤ finiteBoxCount y p (r + ε)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htρ, hty⟩ := exists_small_radius y p (r + ε)
    ((p.2 - p.1) / 2 - (r + ε)) (by linarith)
  have h := hbox p (r + t) (by linarith) (by linarith)
  refine (Finset.card_le_card ?_).trans (h.trans (Finset.card_le_card ?_))
  · intro i hi
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi ⊢
    linarith
  · intro j hj
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hj ⊢
    apply hty j
    linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureMatching.hall_injection_of_separated_counts
statement:
private theorem hall_injection_of_separated_counts
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) {ε : ℝ}
    (hsep : ∀ i i', x i ≠ x i' → 2 * ε < dist (x i) (x i'))
    (hcount : ∀ i, (Finset.univ.filter (fun i' => x i' = x i)).card ≤
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => dist (y j) (x i) ≤ ε)).card) :
    ∃ f : I → J, Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ i, dist (y (f i)) (x i) ≤ ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Fintype.all_card_le_filter_rel_iff_exists_injective
    (fun i j => dist (y j) (x i) ≤ ε)).mp
  intro s
  let P := s.image x
  let N := fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Finset.univ.filter (fun j => dist (y j) p ≤ ε)
  have hdis : (P : Set (ℝ × ℝ)).PairwiseDisjoint N := by
    intro p hp q hq hpq
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
    obtain ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
    apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro j hj hj'
    have hji := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
    have hji' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj').2
    have ht := dist_triangle (x i) (y j) (x i')
    rw [dist_comm (x i) (y j)] at ht
    have hs := hsep i i' hpq
    linarith
  calc
    s.card = ∑ p ∈ P, (s.filter (fun i => x i = p)).card :=
      Finset.card_eq_sum_card_image x s
    _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ P, (N p).card := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      exact (Finset.card_le_card (Finset.filter_subset_filter _ (Finset.subset_univ s))).trans
        (hcount i)
    _ = (P.biUnion N).card := (Finset.card_biUnion hdis).symm
    _ = (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => ∃ i ∈ s, dist (y j) (x i) ≤ ε)).card := by
      congr 1
      ext j
      simp only [P, N, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_filter,
        Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      aesop

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureMatching.separated_cluster_counts
statement:
private theorem separated_cluster_counts
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hgap : ∀ i, 4 * ε < (x i).2 - (x i).1)
    (hsep : ∀ i i', x i ≠ x i' → 2 * ε < dist (x i) (x i'))
    (hxy : ∀ p r, 0 < r → 2 * (r + ε) < p.2 - p.1 →
      finiteBoxCount x p r ≤ finiteBoxCount y p (r + ε))
    (hyx : ∀ p r, 0 < r → 2 * (r + ε) < p.2 - p.1 →
      finiteBoxCount y p r ≤ finiteBoxCount x p (r + ε))
    (i : I) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => dist (y j) (x i) ≤ ε)).card =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i' => x i' = x i)).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hzero : finiteBoxCount x (x i) 0 =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i' => x i' = x i)).card := by
    simp [finiteBoxCount]
  have htwo : finiteBoxCount x (x i) (ε + ε) =
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun i' => x i' = x i)).card := by
    unfold finiteBoxCount
    congr 1
    ext i'
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_contra hn
      have := hsep i' i hn
      linarith
    · rintro h
      simp only [h, dist_self]
      linarith
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h := finiteBoxCount_box_le y x hyx (x i) hε (by have := hgap i; linarith)
    rw [htwo] at h
    exact h
  · have h := finiteBoxCount_box_le x y hxy (x i) (le_refl 0)
      (by have := hgap i; linarith)
    rw [hzero, zero_add] at h
    exact h

name: TDA.Persistence.PersistenceMeasureMatching.exists_matching_of_separated_box_bounds
statement:
theorem exists_matching_of_separated_box_bounds
    (x : I → ℝ × ℝ) (y : J → ℝ × ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (hy : ∀ j, (y j).1 ≤ (y j).2)
    (hgap : ∀ i, 4 * ε < (x i).2 - (x i).1)
    (hsep : ∀ i i', x i ≠ x i' → 2 * ε < dist (x i) (x i'))
    (hxy : ∀ p r, 0 < r → 2 * (r + ε) < p.2 - p.1 →
      finiteBoxCount x p r ≤ finiteBoxCount y p (r + ε))
    (hyx : ∀ p r, 0 < r → 2 * (r + ε) < p.2 - p.1 →
      finiteBoxCount y p r ≤ finiteBoxCount x p (r + ε)) :
    ∃ M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1},
      (∀ i, ∃ j, M.finite i = some j) ∧
      M.cost x y PEmpty.elim PEmpty.elim ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcounts := separated_cluster_counts x y hε hgap hsep hxy hyx
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hclose⟩ := hall_injection_of_separated_counts x y hsep
    (fun i => (hcounts i).ge)
  have hcover : ∀ i j, dist (y j) (x i) ≤ ε → ∃ i', f i' = j := by
    intro i j hj
    let A := Finset.univ.filter (fun i' => x i' = x i)
    let B := Finset.univ.filter (fun j => dist (y j) (x i) ≤ ε)
    have hsub : A.image f ⊆ B := by
      intro j' hj'
      obtain ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hj'
      have hi := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi').2
      simp only [B, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      simpa only [hi] using hclose i'
    have heq : A.image f = B := Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by
      rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hf]
      exact (hcounts i).le)
    have hj' : j ∈ A.image f := heq ▸ (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hj⟩)
    obtain ⟨i', _, hi'⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hj'
    exact ⟨i', hi'⟩
  have hshort : ∀ j, (¬ ∃ i, f i = j) → (y j).2 - (y j).1 ≤ 2 * ε := by
    intro j hj
    by_contra hlong
    have hlong' : 2 * ε < (y j).2 - (y j).1 := lt_of_not_ge hlong
    have h := finiteBoxCount_box_le y x hyx (y j) (le_refl 0) (by simpa using hlong')
    have hpos : 0 < finiteBoxCount y (y j) 0 := by
      apply Finset.card_pos.mpr
      exact ⟨j, by simp⟩
    have hpos' : 0 < finiteBoxCount x (y j) ε := by simpa only [zero_add] using hpos.trans_le h
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Finset.card_pos.mp hpos'
    have hi' : dist (y j) (x i) ≤ ε := by
      simpa only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, dist_comm] using hi
    exact hj (hcover i j hi')
  let M : OccurrenceMatching I J PEmpty.{1} PEmpty.{1} := {
    finite := fun i => some (f i)
    finite_injective := by
      intro i i' j hi hi'
      exact hf ((Option.some.inj hi).trans (Option.some.inj hi').symm)
    essential := Equiv.refl PEmpty }
  refine ⟨M, fun i => ⟨f i, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  apply max_le
  · apply Finset.sup_le
    intro i _
    change finitePairCost (x i) (y (f i)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε
    apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
    have h := hclose i
    simpa only [dist_comm (y (f i)) (x i), Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq] using h
  · apply max_le
    · apply Finset.sup_le
      intro j _
      change (if ∃ i, some (f i) = some j then 0 else diagonalCost (y j)) ≤ _
      split_ifs with hj
      · exact zero_le
      · have hn : ¬ ∃ i, f i = j := by simpa using hj
        apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (hy j))]
        have := hshort j hn
        linarith
    · apply Finset.sup_le
      intro k _
      exact PEmpty.elim k

    CrThroughAllRepresentatives r' V D
proof:

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_cr
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_cr {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (r : ℕ∞ω) (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalCrDiagramLift r B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : CrThroughAllRepresentatives r V (B x)) :
    ∃ U : Set E, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ L.carrier ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ r (V ∘ B) U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hWopen, hzW, hW⟩ := hV m n (L.coordinates x)
    (L.factorization x hx).symm
  let U := L.carrier ∩ L.coordinates ⁻¹' W
  have hUopen : IsOpen U :=
    L.regular.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage L.isOpen_carrier hWopen
  have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ r ((V ∘ orderedQ m n) ∘ L.coordinates) U :=
    hW.comp (L.regular.mono Set.inter_subset_left) Set.inter_subset_right
  refine ⟨U, hUopen, ⟨hx, hzW⟩, Set.inter_subset_left, ?_⟩
  apply hcomp.congr
  intro y hy
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [L.factorization y hy.1]

statement:

name: TDA.Persistence.orderedQ_diagonalInsertion
statement:
theorem orderedQ_diagonalInsertion (m t n : ℕ)
    (z : DiagramCoordinates m n × (Fin t → ℝ)) :
    orderedQ (m + t) n (diagonalInsertion m t n z) = orderedQ m n z.1
proof:
:= by
  change orderedQ (m + t) n
    (Fin.append z.1.1 (fun i => (z.2 i, z.2 i)), z.1.2) = orderedQ m n z.1
  apply (orderedQ_eq_iff _ _ _ _ _ _).mpr
  constructor
  · simp only [List.ofFn_fin_append]
    simp [List.ofFn_eq_map, List.filter_map, Function.comp_def]
  · rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.contDiffOn_diagonalInsertion
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_diagonalInsertion (r : ℕ∞ω) (m t n : ℕ)
    (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (W : Set (DiagramCoordinates m n))
    (hV : ContDiffOn ℝ r (V ∘ orderedQ m n) W) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ r (V ∘ orderedQ (m + t) n ∘ diagonalInsertion m t n)
      ((fun z : DiagramCoordinates m n × (Fin t → ℝ) => z.1) ⁻¹' W)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : ContDiffOn ℝ r (fun z : DiagramCoordinates m n × (Fin t → ℝ) => z.1)
      ((fun z : DiagramCoordinates m n × (Fin t → ℝ) => z.1) ⁻¹' W) :=
    contDiff_fst.contDiffOn
  have hc := hV.comp hp (fun _ hz => hz)
  convert hc using 1
  ext z
  simp [Function.comp_def, orderedQ_diagonalInsertion]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.lt_cellIndex_iff
statement:
theorem lt_cellIndex_iff (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    i.val < (cellIndex c t).val ↔ c i ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hi
    have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter fun j => c j ≤ t) ⊆ Finset.Iio i := by
      intro j hj
      have hjt : c j ≤ t := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
      exact Finset.mem_Iio.mpr (c.lt_iff_lt.mp (hjt.trans_lt (lt_of_not_ge hi)))
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    simp only [Fin.card_Iio] at hcard
    change i.val < (Finset.univ.filter fun j => c j ≤ t).card at h
    omega
  · intro hi
    have hsub : Finset.Iic i ⊆ (Finset.univ.filter fun j => c j ≤ t) := by
      intro j hj
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _,
        (c.monotone (Finset.mem_Iic.mp hj)).trans hi⟩
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    simp only [Fin.card_Iic] at hcard
    exact hcard

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem cellIndex_eq_zero_iff (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    cellIndex c t = 0 ↔ ∀ i, t < c i
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i
    by_contra hi
    have := (lt_cellIndex_iff c i t).mpr (le_of_not_gt hi)
    simp [h] at this
  · intro h
    apply Fin.ext
    by_contra hz
    have hpos : 0 < (cellIndex c t).val := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hz
    have h0 : 0 < n := by
      by_contra hn
      have : n = 0 := by omega
      have := (cellIndex c t).isLt
      omega
    have hi := (lt_cellIndex_iff c ⟨0, h0⟩ t).mp hpos
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hi) (h _)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_eq_succ_iff
statement:
theorem cellIndex_eq_succ_iff (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin n) (t : ℝ) :
    cellIndex c t = i.succ ↔ c i ≤ t ∧ ∀ j, i < j → t < c j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨(lt_cellIndex_iff c i t).mp (by simp [h]), ?_⟩
    intro j hij
    by_contra hj
    have := (lt_cellIndex_iff c j t).mpr (le_of_not_gt hj)
    rw [h] at this
    have : i.val < j.val := hij
    simp only [Fin.val_succ] at *
    omega
  · rintro ⟨hi, hgap⟩
    apply Fin.ext
    have hlo := (lt_cellIndex_iff c i t).mpr hi
    have hhi : (cellIndex c t).val ≤ i.val + 1 := by
      by_contra h
      have hjn : i.val + 1 < n := by have := (cellIndex c t).isLt; omega
      let j : Fin n := ⟨i.val + 1, hjn⟩
      have hj := (lt_cellIndex_iff c j t).mp (by dsimp [j]; omega)
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hj) (hgap j (by change i.val < i.val + 1; omega))
    simpa only [Fin.val_succ] using Nat.le_antisymm hhi hlo

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_critical
statement:
@[simp] theorem cellIndex_critical (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i : Fin n) :
    cellIndex c (c i) = i.succ
proof:
:=
  (cellIndex_eq_succ_iff c i (c i)).mpr ⟨le_rfl, fun _ h => c.strictMono h⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_of_adjacent
statement:
theorem cellIndex_of_adjacent (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val) (t : ℝ) (hlo : c i ≤ t) (hhi : t < c j) :
    cellIndex c t = i.succ
proof:
:= by
  apply (cellIndex_eq_succ_iff c i t).mpr
  refine ⟨hlo, fun k hik => hhi.trans_le (c.monotone ?_)⟩
  change j.val ≤ k.val
  have : i.val < k.val := hik
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_of_last_le
statement:
theorem cellIndex_of_last_le (c : Fin (n + 1) ↪o ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (h : c (Fin.last n) ≤ t) : cellIndex c t = Fin.last (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cellIndex_eq_succ_iff c (Fin.last n) t).mpr
  exact ⟨h, fun j hj => (not_lt_of_ge (Fin.le_last j) hj).elim⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.cellIndex_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem cellIndex_empty (c : Fin 0 ↪o ℝ) (t : ℝ) : cellIndex c t = 0
proof:
:=
  (cellIndex_eq_zero_iff c t).mpr (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sample_obj_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_obj_zero (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    (sample c M).obj 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sample_obj_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_obj_succ (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) : (sample c M).obj i.succ = M.obj (c i)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.sample_structureMap_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem sample_structureMap_succ (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) {i j : Fin n} (h : i ≤ j) :
    structureMap (sample c M) (Fin.succ_le_succ_iff.mpr h) =
      structureMap M (c.monotone h)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.isConstructible_empty_iff
statement:
theorem isConstructible_empty_iff (c : Fin 0 ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    IsConstructible c M ↔ ∀ t, IsZero (M.obj t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h t
    exact h.zero_left t (fun i => Fin.elim0 i)
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun t _ => h t, fun s t _ _ => (h s).isIso (h t) _⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.isConstructible_reindex
statement:
theorem isConstructible_reindex (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (A : PModule.{u,0,w} R (Fin (n + 1))) (hA : IsZero (A.obj 0)) :
    IsConstructible c (reindex (cellIndex c) A) where
  zero_left t ht
proof:
:= by
    change IsZero (A.obj (cellIndex c t))
    rw [(cellIndex_eq_zero_iff c t).mpr ht]
    exact hA
  isIso_map s t h heq := by
    change IsIso (A.map (homOfLE ((cellIndex c).monotone h)))
    have := homOfLE_isIso_of_eq ((cellIndex c).monotone h) heq
    infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.comparisonMap_naturality
statement:
private theorem comparisonMap_naturality (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) {i j : Fin (n + 1)} (hij : i ≤ j)
    {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hs : ∀ k : Fin n, k.val < i.val → c k ≤ s)
    (ht : ∀ k : Fin n, k.val < j.val → c k ≤ t) :
    structureMap (sample c M) hij ≫ comparisonMap c M j t ht =
      comparisonMap c M i s hs ≫ structureMap M hst
proof:
:= by
  cases i using Fin.cases with
  | zero => exact (isZero_zero (ModuleCat R)).eq_of_src _ _
  | succ i =>
    cases j using Fin.cases with
    | zero => have := hij; simp at this
    | succ j =>
      change structureMap M _ ≫ structureMap M _ =
        structureMap M _ ≫ structureMap M _
      rw [structureMap_comp, structureMap_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.isIso_comparisonMap
statement:
private theorem isIso_comparisonMap (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) (t : ℝ) (hb : ∀ j : Fin n, j.val < i.val → c j ≤ t)
    (hq : cellIndex c t = i) : IsIso (comparisonMap c M i t hb)
proof:
:= by
  cases i using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
    exact (isZero_zero (ModuleCat R)).isIso
      (hM.zero_left t ((cellIndex_eq_zero_iff c t).mp hq)) _
  | succ i =>
    apply hM.isIso_map (c i) t
    exact (cellIndex_critical c i).trans hq.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.isIso_toOriginal_app
statement:
theorem isIso_toOriginal_app (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ)
    (hM : IsConstructible c M) (t : ℝ) : IsIso ((toOriginal c M).app t)
proof:
:=
  isIso_comparisonMap c M hM (cellIndex c t) t _ rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.reconstructionIso_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem reconstructionIso_hom (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M) :
    (reconstructionIso c M hM).hom = toOriginal c M
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.reconstructionIso_hom_naturality
statement:
theorem reconstructionIso_hom_naturality (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M) {s t : ℝ} (h : s ≤ t) :
    structureMap (reindex (cellIndex c) (sample c M)) h ≫
      (reconstructionIso c M hM).hom.app t =
    (reconstructionIso c M hM).hom.app s ≫ structureMap M h
proof:
:=
  (reconstructionIso c M hM).hom.naturality (homOfLE h)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.reconstructionIso_inv_naturality
statement:
theorem reconstructionIso_inv_naturality (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M) {s t : ℝ} (h : s ≤ t) :
    structureMap M h ≫ (reconstructionIso c M hM).inv.app t =
      (reconstructionIso c M hM).inv.app s ≫
        structureMap (reindex (cellIndex c) (sample c M)) h
proof:
:=
  (reconstructionIso c M hM).inv.naturality (homOfLE h)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.reconstructionIso_hom_inv_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem reconstructionIso_hom_inv_id (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M) :
    (reconstructionIso c M hM).hom ≫ (reconstructionIso c M hM).inv = 𝟙 _
proof:
:=
  (reconstructionIso c M hM).hom_inv_id

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteConstructible.reconstructionIso_inv_hom_id
statement:
@[simp] theorem reconstructionIso_inv_hom_id (c : Fin n ↪o ℝ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (hM : IsConstructible c M) :
    (reconstructionIso c M hM).inv ≫ (reconstructionIso c M hM).hom = 𝟙 M
proof:
:=
  (reconstructionIso c M hM).inv_hom_id

name: TDA.Persistence.PullbackFiber.fromBirth_condition
proof:
:= by
  apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
  change (π.app p).hom (((HookInfinity.fromBirth p M m).app p).hom _) =
    (f.app p).hom (((HookInfinity.fromBirth p T t).app p).hom _)
  simpa only [HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.PullbackFiber.fst_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem fst_mk (p : P) (m : M.obj p) (t : T.obj p)
    (h : (π.app p).hom m = (f.app p).hom t) :
    ((pullback.fst π f).app p).hom (mk π f p m t h) = m
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (fun α : HookInfinity.module (R := R) p ⟶ M =>
    (α.app p).hom (HookInfinity.birth p))
      (pullback.lift_fst (HookInfinity.fromBirth p M m)
        (HookInfinity.fromBirth p T t) (fromBirth_condition π f p m t h))
  exact he.trans (HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth p M m)

name: TDA.Persistence.PullbackFiber.snd_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem snd_mk (p : P) (m : M.obj p) (t : T.obj p)
    (h : (π.app p).hom m = (f.app p).hom t) :
    ((pullback.snd π f).app p).hom (mk π f p m t h) = t
proof:
:= by
  have he := congrArg (fun α : HookInfinity.module (R := R) p ⟶ T =>
    (α.app p).hom (HookInfinity.birth p))
      (pullback.lift_snd (HookInfinity.fromBirth p M m)
        (HookInfinity.fromBirth p T t) (fromBirth_condition π f p m t h))
  exact he.trans (HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth p T t)

name: TDA.Persistence.PullbackFiber.element_ext
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : HookInfinity.fromBirth p (pullback π f) x ≫ pullback.fst π f =
      HookInfinity.fromBirth p (pullback π f) y ≫ pullback.fst π f := by
    apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
    change ((pullback.fst π f).app p).hom
        (((HookInfinity.fromBirth p (pullback π f) x).app p).hom _) =
      ((pullback.fst π f).app p).hom
        (((HookInfinity.fromBirth p (pullback π f) y).app p).hom _)
    simpa only [HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth] using hfst
  have h₂ : HookInfinity.fromBirth p (pullback π f) x ≫ pullback.snd π f =
      HookInfinity.fromBirth p (pullback π f) y ≫ pullback.snd π f := by
    apply HookInfinity.hom_ext
    change ((pullback.snd π f).app p).hom
        (((HookInfinity.fromBirth p (pullback π f) x).app p).hom _) =
      ((pullback.snd π f).app p).hom
        (((HookInfinity.fromBirth p (pullback π f) y).app p).hom _)
    simpa only [HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth] using hsnd
  have he := pullback.hom_ext h₁ h₂
  simpa only [HookInfinity.fromBirth_birth] using congrArg
    (fun α : HookInfinity.module (R := R) p ⟶ pullback π f =>
      (α.app p).hom (HookInfinity.birth p)) he

name: TDA.Persistence.PullbackFiber.mk_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem mk_zero (p : P) :
    mk π f p 0 0 (by simp) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply element_ext π f p <;> simp

name: TDA.Persistence.PullbackFiber.fst_liftLinear
statement:
@[simp] theorem fst_liftLinear (p : P) (a : V →ₗ[R] M.obj p) (b : V →ₗ[R] T.obj p)
    (h : ∀ x, (π.app p).hom (a x) = (f.app p).hom (b x)) (x : V) :
    ((pullback.fst π f).app p).hom (liftLinear π f p a b h x) = a x
proof:
:=
  fst_mk π f p (a x) (b x) (h x)

name: TDA.Persistence.PullbackFiber.snd_liftLinear
statement:
@[simp] theorem snd_liftLinear (p : P) (a : V →ₗ[R] M.obj p) (b : V →ₗ[R] T.obj p)
    (h : ∀ x, (π.app p).hom (a x) = (f.app p).hom (b x)) (x : V) :
    ((pullback.snd π f).app p).hom (liftLinear π f p a b h x) = b x
proof:
:=
  snd_mk π f p (a x) (b x) (h x)

name: TDA.Persistence.PullbackFiber.finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem finiteDimensional (p : P) [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)]
    [FiniteDimensional k (T.obj p)] : FiniteDimensional k ((pullback π f).obj p)
proof:
:= by
  let F := ((pullback.fst π f).app p).hom.prod ((pullback.snd π f).app p).hom
  apply FiniteDimensional.of_injective F
  intro x y h
  exact element_ext π f p (congrArg Prod.fst h) (congrArg Prod.snd h)

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankExact.isRankDeflation
statement:
theorem IsRankExact.isRankDeflation {L : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    {ι : L ⟶ M} {π : M ⟶ N} (h : IsRankExact ι π) : IsRankDeflation π

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankDeflation.rankExact_kernel
statement:
theorem rankExact_kernel {π : M ⟶ N} (h : IsRankDeflation π) :
    IsRankExact (kernel.ι π) π
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, ι, hs⟩ := h
  let : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hs.finiteDimensional
  exact RankKernel.rankExact π hs.surjective hs.lift_kernel

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankDeflation.id
statement:
theorem id (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] :
    IsRankDeflation (𝟙 M)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsRankExact.isRankDeflation (ι := kernel.ι (𝟙 M))
  apply RankKernel.rankExact
  · intro p
    exact Function.surjective_id
  · intro a b hab n hn
    exact ⟨n, rfl, hn⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankDeflation.comp
statement:
theorem comp {π : M ⟶ N} {σ : N ⟶ O}
    (hπ : IsRankDeflation π) (hσ : IsRankDeflation σ) : IsRankDeflation (π ≫ σ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, ι, hπ⟩ := hπ
  obtain ⟨K, κ, hσ⟩ := hσ
  let : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hπ.finiteDimensional
  apply IsRankExact.isRankDeflation (ι := kernel.ι (π ≫ σ))
  apply RankKernel.rankExact
  · intro p
    exact (hσ.surjective p).comp (hπ.surjective p)
  · intro a b hab n hn
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmdie⟩ := hσ.lift_kernel hab n hn
    obtain ⟨l, hl, hldie⟩ := hπ.lift_kernel hab m hmdie
    refine ⟨l, ?_, hldie⟩
    change (σ.app a).hom ((π.app a).hom l) = n
    rw [hl, hm]

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankDeflation.pullback_snd
statement:
theorem pullback_snd {π : M ⟶ N} (hπ : IsRankDeflation π) (f : T ⟶ N)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (T.obj p)] : IsRankDeflation (pullback.snd π f)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L, ι, hs⟩ := hπ
  let : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hs.finiteDimensional
  let : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k ((pullback π f).obj p) :=
    fun p => PullbackFiber.finiteDimensional π f p
  apply IsRankExact.isRankDeflation (ι := kernel.ι (pullback.snd π f))
  apply RankKernel.rankExact
  · intro p n
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hs.surjective p ((f.app p).hom n)
    exact ⟨PullbackFiber.mk π f p m n hm, PullbackFiber.snd_mk π f p m n hm⟩
  · intro a b hab n hn
    have hfn : structureMapLinear N hab ((f.app a).hom n) = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun α => α.hom n) (f.naturality (homOfLE hab))
      change (f.app b).hom (structureMapLinear T hab n) =
        structureMapLinear N hab ((f.app a).hom n) at h
      exact h.symm.trans (by rw [hn, map_zero])
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmdie⟩ := hs.lift_kernel hab ((f.app a).hom n) hfn
    let x := PullbackFiber.mk π f a m n hm
    refine ⟨x, PullbackFiber.snd_mk π f a m n hm, ?_⟩
    apply PullbackFiber.element_ext π f b
    · have h := congrArg (fun α => α.hom x)
        ((pullback.fst π f).naturality (homOfLE hab))
      change ((pullback.fst π f).app b).hom
          (structureMapLinear (pullback π f) hab x) =
        structureMapLinear M hab (((pullback.fst π f).app a).hom x) at h
      rw [h]
      change structureMapLinear M hab
        (((pullback.fst π f).app a).hom (PullbackFiber.mk π f a m n hm)) = _
      rw [PullbackFiber.fst_mk, hmdie, map_zero]
    · have h := congrArg (fun α => α.hom x)
        ((pullback.snd π f).naturality (homOfLE hab))
      change ((pullback.snd π f).app b).hom
          (structureMapLinear (pullback π f) hab x) =
        structureMapLinear T hab (((pullback.snd π f).app a).hom x) at h
      rw [h]
      change structureMapLinear T hab
        (((pullback.snd π f).app a).hom (PullbackFiber.mk π f a m n hm)) = _
      rw [PullbackFiber.snd_mk, hn, map_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.isZero_simplicialHomology_bot
statement:
theorem isZero_simplicialHomology_bot (n : ℕ) :
    IsZero (simplicialHomology (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) R n)
proof:
:= by
  have hX : IsZero ((simplicialChainComplex (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) R).X n) := by
    rw [simplicialChainComplex_X]
    exact ModuleCat.isZero_of_subsingleton _
  exact ShortComplex.isZero_homology_of_isZero_X₂ _ hX

name: TDA.Persistence.isIso_simplicialHomologyIncl_of_eq
statement:
theorem isIso_simplicialHomologyIncl_of_eq {A B : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    (hAB : A = B) (h : A ≤ B) (n : ℕ) : IsIso (simplicialHomologyIncl R h n)
proof:
:= by
  subst hAB
  change IsIso (simplicialHomologyIncl R (le_refl A) n)
  rw [simplicialHomologyIncl_id]
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevel_eq_of_cellIndex_eq
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq_of_cellIndex_eq (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) {s t : ℝ} (hst : s ≤ t)
    (h : cellIndex f.criticalValue s = cellIndex f.criticalValue t) :
    f.sublevel s = f.sublevel t
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (f.sublevel_mono hst)
  intro σ hσ
  obtain ⟨hσK, hσt⟩ := (f.mem_sublevel_iff t σ).1 hσ
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := f.exists_criticalValue_eq ⟨σ, hσK⟩
  have hit : i.val < (cellIndex f.criticalValue t).val :=
    (lt_cellIndex_iff _ i t).2 (hi.le.trans hσt)
  rw [← h] at hit
  exact (f.mem_sublevel_iff s σ).2 ⟨hσK, hi.symm.le.trans ((lt_cellIndex_iff _ i s).1 hit)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevel_eq_bot_of_forall_criticalValue_lt
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq_bot_of_forall_criticalValue_lt (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) {t : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ i, t < f.criticalValue i) : f.sublevel t = ⊥
proof:
:=
  f.sublevel_eq_bot_of_forall_lt t fun σ => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := f.exists_criticalValue_eq σ
    exact hi ▸ h i

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelModule_isConstructible
statement:
theorem sublevelModule_isConstructible (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    IsConstructible f.criticalValue (sublevelModule R f n) where
  zero_left t ht
proof:
:= by
    change IsZero (simplicialHomology (f.sublevel t) R n)
    rw [sublevel_eq_bot_of_forall_criticalValue_lt f ht]
    exact isZero_simplicialHomology_bot R n
  isIso_map s t hst h :=
    isIso_simplicialHomologyIncl_of_eq R (sublevel_eq_of_cellIndex_eq f hst h)
      (f.sublevel_mono hst) n

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelModule_finiteDimensional
statement:
theorem sublevelModule_finiteDimensional (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    ∀ i, FiniteDimensional k ((sublevelModule k f n).obj (f.criticalValue i))
proof:
:=
  fun i => gradeHomology_finiteDimensional k f n i

name: TDA.Persistence.moduleDiagram_sublevelModule
statement:
theorem moduleDiagram_sublevelModule (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    moduleDiagram f.criticalValue (sublevelModule k f n)
      (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n f) = dgm k f n
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_dgm_eq_realInterleavingDistance
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_eq_realInterleavingDistance (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k f n) (dgm k g n) =
      realInterleavingDistance (sublevelModule k f n) (sublevelModule k g n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← moduleDiagram_sublevelModule k n f, ← moduleDiagram_sublevelModule k n g]
  exact bottleneck_eq_distance (sublevelModule_isConstructible k n f)
    (sublevelModule_isConstructible k n g) (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n f)
    (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n g)

name: TDA.Persistence.nonempty_sublevelInterleaving_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_sublevelInterleaving_iff (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε (sublevelModule k f n) (sublevelModule k g n)) ↔
      ∃ A : OccurrenceMatching (dgm k f n).finiteOccurrences (dgm k g n).finiteOccurrences
          (dgm k f n).essentialOccurrences (dgm k g n).essentialOccurrences,
        A.cost (fun p => p.1) (fun p => p.1) (fun b => b.1) (fun b => b.1) ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:=
  interleaving_iff_matching (sublevelModule_isConstructible k n f)
    (sublevelModule_isConstructible k n g) (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n f)
    (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n g) ε

name: TDA.Persistence.bottleneck_dgm_le_faceSupDifference_algebraic
statement:
theorem bottleneck_dgm_le_faceSupDifference_algebraic (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    bottleneck (dgm k f n) (dgm k g n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (faceSupDifference f g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bottleneck_dgm_eq_realInterleavingDistance]
  exact realInterleavingDistance_sublevel_le_faceSupDifference k n f g

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_sublevel_ne_top
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_sublevel_ne_top (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    realInterleavingDistance (sublevelModule k f n) (sublevelModule k g n) ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bottleneck_dgm_eq_realInterleavingDistance]
  exact ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
    (bottleneck_dgm_le_faceSupDifference_algebraic k n f g)

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_card_dgm_eq
statement:
theorem essentialPart_card_dgm_eq (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    (essentialPart (dgm k f n).points).card = (essentialPart (dgm k g n).points).card
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  exact realInterleavingDistance_sublevel_ne_top k n f g
    ((distance_eq_top_iff_essential_card_ne (sublevelModule_isConstructible k n f)
      (sublevelModule_isConstructible k n g) (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n f)
      (sublevelModule_finiteDimensional k n g)).2 hne)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.depth_eq
statement: @[simp] theorem depth_eq (x : Interior) : depth x = (x.1.2 - x.1.1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [depth, diagonalCost_toReal, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr x.2)]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.depth_pos
statement: theorem depth_pos (x : Interior) : 0 < depth x
proof:
:= by
  rw [depth_eq]
  exact div_pos (sub_pos.mpr x.2) (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.depth_nonneg
statement: theorem depth_nonneg (x : Interior) : 0 ≤ depth x
proof: := (depth_pos x).le

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.plane_depth_le_dist_add
statement:
private theorem plane_depth_le_dist_add (x y : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (diagonalCost x).toReal ≤ dist x y + (diagonalCost y).toReal
proof:
:= by
  have h := ENNReal.toReal_mono
    (show finitePairCost x y + diagonalCost y ≠ ⊤ by simp [finitePairCost, diagonalCost])
    (diagonalCost_le_pair_add x y)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add (by simp [finitePairCost]) (by simp [diagonalCost])] at h
  simpa only [finitePairCost_toReal, dist_eq_norm] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.depth_le_dist_add
statement: private theorem depth_le_dist_add (x y : Interior) : depth x ≤ dist x y + depth y
proof:
:=
  plane_depth_le_dist_add x.1 y.1

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_boundary_boundary
statement: @[simp] theorem rho_boundary_boundary : rho .boundary .boundary = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_point_boundary
statement: @[simp] theorem rho_point_boundary (x : Interior) : rho (.point x) .boundary = depth x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_boundary_point
statement: @[simp] theorem rho_boundary_point (x : Interior) : rho .boundary (.point x) = depth x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_point_point
statement:
@[simp] theorem rho_point_point (x y : Interior) :
    rho (.point x) (.point y) =
      min (finitePairCost x.1 y.1).toReal (depth x + depth y)
proof:
:= by
  simp [rho, finitePairCost_toReal, Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_nonneg
statement: private theorem rho_nonneg (x y : Space) : 0 ≤ rho x y
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> cases y <;> simp only [rho]
  · exact le_rfl
  · exact depth_nonneg _
  · exact depth_nonneg _
  · exact le_min dist_nonneg (add_nonneg (depth_nonneg _) (depth_nonneg _))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_self
statement: @[simp] theorem rho_self (x : Space) : rho x x = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | boundary => rfl
  | point x =>
    change min (dist x x) (depth x + depth x) = 0
    rw [dist_self]
    exact min_eq_left (add_nonneg (depth_nonneg x) (depth_nonneg x))

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_comm
statement: theorem rho_comm (x y : Space) : rho x y = rho y x
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> cases y <;> simp [rho, dist_comm, add_comm]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.depth_le_rho_add
statement:
private theorem depth_le_rho_add (x y : Interior) :
    depth x ≤ rho (.point x) (.point y) + depth y
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [rho]
  rw [min_add, le_min_iff]
  exact ⟨depth_le_dist_add x y, by linarith [depth_nonneg y]⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_triangle
statement: theorem rho_triangle (x y z : Space) : rho x z ≤ rho x y + rho y z
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | boundary =>
    cases y with
    | boundary => simp
    | point y =>
      cases z with
      | boundary => simpa using add_nonneg (depth_nonneg y) (depth_nonneg y)
      | point z => simpa [rho_comm, add_comm] using depth_le_rho_add z y
  | point x =>
    cases y with
    | boundary =>
      cases z with
      | boundary => simp
      | point z => exact min_le_right _ _
    | point y =>
      cases z with
      | boundary => exact depth_le_rho_add x y
      | point z =>
        dsimp [rho]
        rcases le_total (dist x y) (depth x + depth y) with hxy | hxy <;>
          rcases le_total (dist y z) (depth y + depth z) with hyz | hyz
        · rw [min_eq_left hxy, min_eq_left hyz]
          exact (min_le_left _ _).trans (dist_triangle x y z)
        · rw [min_eq_left hxy, min_eq_right hyz]
          exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (by linarith [depth_le_dist_add x y])
        · rw [min_eq_right hxy, min_eq_left hyz]
          exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (by linarith [depth_le_dist_add z y, dist_comm z y])
        · rw [min_eq_right hxy, min_eq_right hyz]
          exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (by linarith [depth_nonneg y])

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.rho_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem rho_eq_zero_iff (x y : Space) : rho x y = 0 ↔ x = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases x with
    | boundary =>
      cases y with
      | boundary => rfl
      | point y => exact False.elim ((depth_pos y).ne' h)
    | point x =>
      cases y with
      | boundary => exact False.elim ((depth_pos x).ne' h)
      | point y =>
        have hd : dist x y = 0 := by
          rcases min_eq_iff.mp h with h | h
          · exact h.1
          · exact False.elim ((add_pos (depth_pos x) (depth_pos y)).ne' h.1)
        exact congrArg Space.point (dist_eq_zero.mp hd)
  · rintro rfl
    exact rho_self x

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.dist_point_boundary
statement:
@[simp] theorem dist_point_boundary (x : Interior) :
    dist (.point x) (Space.boundary) = depth x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.dist_boundary_point
statement:
@[simp] theorem dist_boundary_point (x : Interior) :
    dist Space.boundary (.point x) = depth x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.dist_point_point
statement:
@[simp] theorem dist_point_point (x y : Interior) :
    dist (Space.point x) (Space.point y) = min (dist x y) (depth x + depth y)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.lipschitz_point
statement: theorem lipschitz_point : LipschitzWith 1 Space.point
proof:
:= by
  rw [lipschitzWith_iff_dist_le_mul]
  intro x y
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, dist_point_point]
  exact min_le_left _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.continuous_point
statement: theorem continuous_point : Continuous Space.point
proof: := lipschitz_point.continuous

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.cauchySeq_exists_tendsto
statement:
theorem cauchySeq_exists_tendsto (u : ℕ → Space) (hu : CauchySeq u) :
    ∃ x, Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 x)
proof:
:= by
  let d : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => dist (u n) Space.boundary
  have hd : CauchySeq d := by
    apply Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mpr
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mp hu ε hε
    exact ⟨N, fun m hm n hn =>
      (dist_dist_dist_le_left (u m) (u n) Space.boundary).trans_lt (hN m hm n hn)⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hd
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := ge_of_tendsto' ha (fun _ => dist_nonneg)
  by_cases haz : a = 0
  · refine ⟨Space.boundary, ?_⟩
    exact tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero.mpr (haz ▸ ha)
  · have hap : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha0 (Ne.symm haz)
    have hevent : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, a / 2 < d n :=
      (tendsto_order.mp ha).1 (a / 2) (by linarith)
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp hevent
    have hpoint (n : ℕ) (hn : N ≤ n) : ∃ x : Interior, u n = Space.point x := by
      cases h : u n with
      | boundary =>
        have := hN n hn
        simp [d, h] at this
        linarith
      | point x => exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    choose v hv using fun n => hpoint (n + N) (Nat.le_add_left N n)
    have hdepth (n : ℕ) : a / 2 < depth (v n) := by
      simpa [d, hv n] using hN (n + N) (Nat.le_add_left N n)
    have hvC : CauchySeq (fun n => (v n).1) := by
      apply Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mpr
      intro ε hε
      obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Metric.cauchySeq_iff.mp hu (min ε (a / 2))
        (lt_min hε (by linarith))
      refine ⟨M, fun m hm n hn => ?_⟩
      have hc := hM (m + N) (hm.trans (Nat.le_add_right m N))
        (n + N) (hn.trans (Nat.le_add_right n N))
      rw [hv m, hv n, dist_point_point] at hc
      rcases min_lt_iff.mp hc with hc | hc
      · exact hc.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
      · have hh := hc.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
        linarith [hdepth m, hdepth n]
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hvC
    have hpers : a ≤ z.2 - z.1 := by
      have ht : Tendsto (fun n => (v n).1.2 - (v n).1.1) atTop (𝓝 (z.2 - z.1)) :=
        (continuous_snd.tendsto z |>.comp hz).sub (continuous_fst.tendsto z |>.comp hz)
      apply ge_of_tendsto' ht
      intro n
      have hh := hdepth n
      rw [depth_eq] at hh
      linarith
    let z' : Interior := ⟨z, by linarith⟩
    have hvz : Tendsto v atTop (𝓝 z') :=
      tendsto_subtype_rng.mpr hz
    have htail : Tendsto (fun n => u (n + N)) atTop (𝓝 (Space.point z')) := by
      have h := continuous_point.tendsto z' |>.comp hvz
      simpa only [hv, Function.comp_def] using h
    exact ⟨Space.point z', (tendsto_add_atTop_iff_nat N).mp htail⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.isOpenEmbedding_point
statement: theorem isOpenEmbedding_point : IsOpenEmbedding Space.point
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpenEmbedding.of_continuous_injective_isOpenMap continuous_point (fun _ _ h => Space.point.inj h)
  intro s hs
  apply Metric.isOpen_iff.mpr
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hs x hx
  refine ⟨min ε (depth x), lt_min hε (depth_pos x), ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hy' : dist y (Space.point x) < min ε (depth x) := hy
  cases y with
  | boundary =>
    have : depth x < depth x := (lt_min_iff.mp hy').2
    exact (lt_irrefl _ this).elim
  | point y =>
    refine ⟨y, hball ?_, rfl⟩
    have hdirect : dist y x < ε := by
      rcases min_lt_iff.mp hy' with h | h
      · exact h.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
      · have : depth y + depth x < depth x := h.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
        linarith [depth_nonneg y]
    exact hdirect

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurableEmbedding_point
statement: theorem measurableEmbedding_point : MeasurableEmbedding Space.point
proof:
:=
  isOpenEmbedding_point.measurableEmbedding

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurableSet_iff_interior
statement:
theorem measurableSet_iff_interior (s : Set Space) :
    MeasurableSet s ↔ MeasurableSet (Space.point ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · exact fun h => measurableEmbedding_point.measurable h
  · intro h
    have heq : s = Space.point '' (Space.point ⁻¹' s) ∪
        (if Space.boundary ∈ s then {Space.boundary} else ∅) := by
      ext x
      cases x <;> simp
    rw [heq]
    apply (measurableEmbedding_point.measurableSet_image.mpr h).union
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapse_interior
statement: @[simp] theorem collapse_interior (x : Interior) : collapse ⟨x.1, x.2.le⟩ = Space.point x
proof:
:= by
  simp [collapse, x.2]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapse_diagonal
statement: @[simp] theorem collapse_diagonal (t : ℝ) : collapse ⟨(t, t), le_rfl⟩ = Space.boundary
proof:
:= by
  simp [collapse]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.diagonalCost_eq_zero_of_not_lt
statement:
private theorem diagonalCost_eq_zero_of_not_lt (x : ClosedHalfPlane) (h : ¬ x.1.1 < x.1.2) :
    (diagonalCost x.1).toReal = 0
proof:
:= by
  have heq : x.1.1 = x.1.2 := le_antisymm x.2 (le_of_not_gt h)
  simp [diagonalCost_toReal, heq]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.lipschitz_collapse
statement: theorem lipschitz_collapse : LipschitzWith 1 collapse
proof:
:= by
  rw [lipschitzWith_iff_dist_le_mul]
  intro x y
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul]
  unfold collapse
  split_ifs with hx hy hy
  · exact min_le_left _ _
  · change (diagonalCost x.1).toReal ≤ dist x.1 y.1
    simpa only [diagonalCost_eq_zero_of_not_lt y hy, add_zero] using
      plane_depth_le_dist_add x.1 y.1
  · change (diagonalCost y.1).toReal ≤ dist x.1 y.1
    simpa only [diagonalCost_eq_zero_of_not_lt x hx, add_zero, dist_comm] using
      plane_depth_le_dist_add y.1 x.1
  · exact dist_nonneg

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.collapse_surjective
statement: theorem collapse_surjective : Function.Surjective collapse
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  cases x with
  | boundary => exact ⟨⟨(0, 0), le_rfl⟩, collapse_diagonal 0⟩
  | point x => exact ⟨⟨x.1, x.2.le⟩, collapse_interior x⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.continuous_collapse
statement: theorem continuous_collapse : Continuous collapse
proof: := lipschitz_collapse.continuous

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.measurable_collapse
statement: theorem measurable_collapse : Measurable collapse
proof: := continuous_collapse.measurable

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.dist_collapse_boundary
statement:
theorem dist_collapse_boundary (x : ClosedHalfPlane) :
    dist (collapse x) Space.boundary = (x.1.2 - x.1.1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold collapse
  split_ifs with h
  · exact depth_eq ⟨x.1, h⟩
  · have heq : x.1.1 = x.1.2 := le_antisymm x.2 (le_of_not_gt h)
    simp [heq]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.far_points_shortcut
statement:
theorem far_points_shortcut :
    dist (Space.point ⟨(0, 2), by norm_num⟩)
      (Space.point ⟨(10, 12), by norm_num⟩) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_point_point]
  norm_num [depth_eq, Subtype.dist_eq, Prod.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.far_points_squared_shortcut_and_boundary_legs
statement:
theorem far_points_squared_shortcut_and_boundary_legs :
    dist (Space.point ⟨(0, 2), by norm_num⟩)
        (Space.point ⟨(10, 12), by norm_num⟩) ^ 2 = 4 ∧
      depth ⟨(0, 2), by norm_num⟩ ^ 2 + depth ⟨(10, 12), by norm_num⟩ ^ 2 = 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rw [far_points_shortcut]
    norm_num
  · norm_num [depth_eq]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.exists_point_dist_boundary_lt
statement:
theorem exists_point_dist_boundary_lt {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ x : Interior, 0 < dist (Space.point x) Space.boundary ∧
      dist (Space.point x) Space.boundary < ε
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨(0, ε), hε⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact depth_pos _
  · simp only [dist_point_boundary, depth_eq, sub_zero]
    linarith

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.denseRange_point
statement: theorem denseRange_point : DenseRange Space.point
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.denseRange_iff.mpr
  intro x ε hε
  cases x with
  | boundary =>
    obtain ⟨y, _, hy⟩ := exists_point_dist_boundary_lt hε
    exact ⟨y, by simpa only [dist_comm] using hy⟩
  | point x => exact ⟨x, by simpa using hε⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.exists_cut_topology
proof:
:= by
  let : TopologicalSpace (LowerSet ℝ) := Preorder.topology _
  let : OrderTopology (LowerSet ℝ) := ⟨rfl⟩
  let : TopologicalSpace (Cut ℝ) := TopologicalSpace.induced cutLowerSetEquiv inferInstance
  let e := (cutLowerSetEquiv (α := ℝ)).toHomeomorphOfIsInducing ⟨rfl⟩
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro U ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩
    exact e.isOpen_image.mp (isOpen_image_cutCell a b)
  · rintro U ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩
    exact e.isCompact_image.mp (isCompact_image_cutCell a b)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.cutCells_separate
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, _, rfl⟩ := hK
  obtain ⟨a', b', _, _, hx', hy'⟩ := exists_subcell_separating_cuts hxy hx
  exact ⟨cutCell a' b', cutCell_mem_cutCells _ _, hx', hy'⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleEssentialMultiplicity_locally_finite
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hOpen, hCompact⟩ := exists_cut_topology
  let := t
  exact finite_positive_content_support isSetSemiring_cutCells
    (essentialCutContent M hM) hOpen (cutCells_separate hK) hK (hCompact K hK)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleEssentialMultiplicity_content_counts
statement:
theorem moduleEssentialMultiplicity_content_counts (hM : M.QTame)
    {K : Set (Cut ℝ)} (hK : K ∈ cutCells) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Cut ℝ),
      (∀ birth, birth ∈ S ↔ birth ∈ K ∧ 0 < moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM birth) ∧
      essentialCutContent M hM K = ∑ birth ∈ S, moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM birth
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hOpen, hCompact⟩ := exists_cut_topology
  let := t
  exact content_eq_sum_multiplicity isSetSemiring_cutCells
    (essentialCutContent M hM) hOpen (cutCells_separate hK) hK (hCompact K hK)

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleEssentialMultiplicity_strip_counts
statement:
theorem moduleEssentialMultiplicity_strip_counts (hM : M.QTame) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) :
    ∃ S : Finset (Cut ℝ),
      (∀ birth, birth ∈ S ↔ birth ∈ cutCell a b ∧ 0 < moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM birth) ∧
      essentialMeasureValue M hab = ∑ birth ∈ S, moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM birth
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hcount⟩ := moduleEssentialMultiplicity_content_counts M hM
    (cutCell_mem_cutCells a b)
  exact ⟨S, hS, (essentialCutContent_apply M hM hab).symm.trans hcount⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.exists_moduleEssential_atom_of_positive
statement:
theorem exists_moduleEssential_atom_of_positive (hM : M.QTame)
    {K : Set (Cut ℝ)} (hK : K ∈ cutCells) (hpos : 0 < essentialCutContent M hM K) :
    ∃ birth ∈ K, 0 < moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM birth
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, hOpen, hCompact⟩ := exists_cut_topology
  let := t
  exact exists_positive_content_atom isSetSemiring_cutCells
    (essentialCutContent M hM) hOpen hK (hCompact K hK) hpos

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleEssentialMultiplicity_le_content
statement:
theorem moduleEssentialMultiplicity_le_content (hM : M.QTame)
    {K : Set (Cut ℝ)} (hK : K ∈ cutCells) {birth : Cut ℝ} (hb : birth ∈ K) :
    moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM birth ≤ essentialCutContent M hM K
proof:
:=
  contentMultiplicity_le _ hK hb

name: TDA.Persistence.RectangleMeasure.moduleEssentialMultiplicity_visible_of_pos
statement:
theorem moduleEssentialMultiplicity_visible_of_pos (hM : M.QTame)
    {birth : Cut ℝ} (hb : 0 < moduleEssentialMultiplicity M hM birth) :
    ∃ U ∈ cutCells, birth ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, U, hU, hbU, _⟩ := Nat.nonempty_of_pos_sInf hb
  exact ⟨U, hU, hbU⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.fiber_mono
statement: theorem fiber_mono {a b : P} (h : a ≤ b) : fiber (R := R) W a ≤ fiber W b
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx g hg
  exact (hx hg).trans h

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.fiber_eq_of_birth_iff
proof:
:= by
  unfold fiber
  congr 1
  ext g
  exact h g

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.structureMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem structureMap_apply {a b : P} (h : a ≤ b) (x : fiber (R := R) W a) :
    (structureMapLinear (module (R := R) W) h x : fiber (R := R) W b).val = x.val
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.generator_eq_structureMap
statement:
theorem generator_eq_structureMap (g : W.Carrier) {a : P} (h : W.grade g ≤ a) :
    generator (R := R) W g h =
      structureMapLinear (module (R := R) W) h (birth (R := R) W g)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.fiberLift_generator
statement:
@[simp] theorem fiberLift_generator {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V]
    (a : P) (v : {g : W.Carrier // W.grade g ≤ a} → V)
    (g : W.Carrier) (h : W.grade g ≤ a) :
    fiberLift (R := R) W a v (generator (R := R) W g h) = v ⟨g, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  have heq :
      (fiberEquiv (R := R) W a).symm (Finsupp.single ⟨g, h⟩ (1 : R)) =
        generator (R := R) W g h := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp_symm_single _ _ _
  rw [← heq]
  simp [fiberLift, Finsupp.linearCombination_single]

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.fiberLift_unique
statement:
theorem fiberLift_unique {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V]
    (a : P) (v : {g : W.Carrier // W.grade g ≤ a} → V)
    (f : fiber (R := R) W a →ₗ[R] V)
    (hf : ∀ g (h : W.grade g ≤ a), f (generator (R := R) W g h) = v ⟨g, h⟩) :
    f = fiberLift (R := R) W a v
proof:
:= by
  let e := fiberEquiv (R := R) W a
  have hb (i : {g : W.Carrier // W.grade g ≤ a}) :
      e.symm (Finsupp.basisSingleOne i) = generator (R := R) W i.val i.property := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change ((Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp (R := R) {g | W.grade g ≤ a}).symm
      (Finsupp.single i (1 : R)) : W.Carrier →₀ R) = Finsupp.single i.val 1
    exact Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp_symm_single (R := R)
      {g | W.grade g ≤ a} i (1 : R)
  have he : f.comp e.symm.toLinearMap =
      (fiberLift (R := R) W a v).comp e.symm.toLinearMap := by
    apply Finsupp.basisSingleOne.ext
    intro i
    change f (e.symm (Finsupp.basisSingleOne i)) =
      fiberLift (R := R) W a v (e.symm (Finsupp.basisSingleOne i))
    rw [hb]
    exact (hf i.val i.property).trans
      (fiberLift_generator (R := R) W a v i.val i.property).symm
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have hx := LinearMap.congr_fun he (e x)
  simpa using hx

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.lift_birth
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_birth (M : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P)
    (s : ∀ g : W.Carrier, M.obj (W.grade g)) (g : W.Carrier) :
    (lift (R := R) W M s).app (W.grade g) (birth (R := R) W g) = s g
proof:
:= by
  change fiberLift (R := R) W (W.grade g)
    (fun i => structureMapLinear M i.property (s i.val))
      (generator (R := R) W g le_rfl) = s g
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.lift_unique
statement:
theorem lift_unique (M : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P)
    (s : ∀ g : W.Carrier, M.obj (W.grade g))
    (f : module (R := R) W ⟶ M)
    (hf : ∀ g, f.app (W.grade g) (birth (R := R) W g) = s g) :
    f = lift (R := R) W M s
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext a
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply fiberLift_unique (R := R) W a
    (fun i => structureMapLinear M i.property (s i.val))
  intro g h
  have hn := f.naturality (homOfLE h)
  have hg : (generator (R := R) W g h) =
      structureMapLinear (module (R := R) W) h (birth (R := R) W g) :=
    generator_eq_structureMap (R := R) W g h
  change f.app a (generator (R := R) W g h) =
    structureMapLinear M h (s g)
  rw [hg]
  have := congrArg (fun q : (module (R := R) W).obj (W.grade g) ⟶ M.obj a =>
    q (birth (R := R) W g)) hn
  simpa [structureMapLinear, structureMap, hf g] using this

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.exists_lift_of_surjective
statement:
theorem exists_lift_of_surjective
    {M N : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} (ρ : N ⟶ M)
    (hρ : ∀ a, Function.Surjective (ρ.app a))
    (f : module (R := R) W ⟶ M) :
    ∃ l : module (R := R) W ⟶ N, l ≫ ρ = f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let s : ∀ g : W.Carrier, N.obj (W.grade g) :=
    fun g => Classical.choose (hρ (W.grade g) (f.app (W.grade g) (birth (R := R) W g)))
  refine ⟨lift (R := R) W N s, ?_⟩
  have h : lift (R := R) W N s ≫ ρ =
      lift (R := R) W M
        (fun g => f.app (W.grade g) (birth (R := R) W g)) := by
    apply lift_unique (R := R) W M
    intro g
    change ρ.app (W.grade g)
      ((lift (R := R) W N s).app (W.grade g) (birth (R := R) W g)) =
        f.app (W.grade g) (birth (R := R) W g)
    rw [lift_birth]
    exact Classical.choose_spec
      (hρ (W.grade g) (f.app (W.grade g) (birth (R := R) W g)))
  exact h.trans (lift_unique (R := R) W M _ f (fun _ => rfl)).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.sub_lifts_mem_ker
statement:
theorem sub_lifts_mem_ker
    {M N : PModule.{u,v,max u w} R P} (ρ : N ⟶ M)
    (f : module (R := R) W ⟶ M)
    (l₁ l₂ : module (R := R) W ⟶ N)
    (h₁ : l₁ ≫ ρ = f) (h₂ : l₂ ≫ ρ = f) (g : W.Carrier) :
    l₁.app (W.grade g) (birth (R := R) W g) -
      l₂.app (W.grade g) (birth (R := R) W g) ∈
        LinearMap.ker (ρ.app (W.grade g)).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub]
  have e₁ := congrArg (fun q : (module (R := R) W).obj (W.grade g) ⟶ M.obj (W.grade g) =>
    q (birth (R := R) W g)) (congrArg (fun q => q.app (W.grade g)) h₁)
  have e₂ := congrArg (fun q : (module (R := R) W).obj (W.grade g) ⟶ M.obj (W.grade g) =>
    q (birth (R := R) W g)) (congrArg (fun q => q.app (W.grade g)) h₂)
  simpa using congrArg₂ (· - ·) e₁ e₂

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.exists_finite_net_relation
statement:
theorem exists_finite_net_relation (hX : TotallyBounded (univ : Set X))
    (ε : ℝ≥0) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ F : Set X, F.Finite ∧ ∃ C : SetRel X F,
      Relator.LeftTotal (fun x y => (x, y) ∈ C) ∧
      Relator.LeftTotal (fun y x => (y, x) ∈ C.inv) ∧
      ∀ x x' y y', (x, y) ∈ C → (x', y') ∈ C →
        |dist x x' - dist y y'| ≤ (ε : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hcover⟩ := Metric.totallyBounded_iff.mp hX
    ((ε : ℝ) / 2) (by exact half_pos hε)
  let C : SetRel X F := {p | dist p.1 p.2.val < (ε : ℝ) / 2}
  refine ⟨F, hF, C, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hcover (mem_univ x))
    exact ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hxy⟩
  · intro y
    exact ⟨y.val, by change dist y.val y.val < (ε : ℝ) / 2; simpa using half_pos hε⟩
  · intro x x' y y' hxy hx'y'
    have hdist := dist_dist_dist_le x x' y.val y'.val
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hdist
    change dist x y.val < (ε : ℝ) / 2 at hxy
    change dist x' y'.val < (ε : ℝ) / 2 at hx'y'
    exact hdist.trans (by linarith)

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.qTame_of_totallyBounded
statement:
theorem qTame_of_totallyBounded (k : Type v) [Field k]
    (hX : TotallyBounded (univ : Set X)) (n : ℕ) :
    (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n).QTame
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  let ε : ℝ≥0 := ⟨(b - a) / 2, by linarith⟩
  have hε : 0 < ε := by change 0 < (b - a) / 2; linarith
  obtain ⟨F, hF, C, hCT, hIT, hC⟩ := exists_finite_net_relation hX ε hε
  let : Fintype F := hF.fintype
  let i := relationInterleaving k (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)
    (inferInstance : MetricSpace F) hCT hIT hC n
  have hmid : FiniteDimensional k
      ((sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace F)) n).obj
        (a + (ε : ℝ))) := by
    change FiniteDimensional k (simplicialHomology _ k n)
    infer_instance
  have h := i.finiteDimensional_range_structureMap a
  have hb : (a + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ) = b := by
    change (a + (b - a) / 2) + (b - a) / 2 = b
    ring
  have h' : ∀ ha : a ≤ (a + (ε : ℝ)) + (ε : ℝ),
      FiniteDimensional k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear
        (sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) n) ha)) :=
    fun _ => h
  rw [hb] at h'
  exact h' hab.le

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.not_finiteDimensional_zero_homology
statement:
theorem not_finiteDimensional_zero_homology [Infinite X] (k : Type v) [Field k] :
    ¬ FiniteDimensional k
      ((sublevelModule k (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)) 0).obj 0)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let K := (Rips.filter (inferInstance : MetricSpace X)).sublevel 0
  let vertex : X → Face K 0 := fun x => ⟨{x},
    (Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).2 ⟨by simp, by simp⟩, by simp⟩
  have hinj : Function.Injective vertex := by
    intro x y h
    exact Finset.singleton_injective (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  let : Infinite (Face K 0) := Infinite.of_injective vertex hinj
  let : IsEmpty (Face K 1) := ⟨by
    intro σ
    have hcard : 1 < σ.val.card := by have := σ.property.2; omega
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp hcard
    have hd := ((Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).mp σ.property.1).2 x hx y hy
    exact hxy (dist_le_zero.mp hd)⟩
  let S := (simplicialChainComplex K k).sc 0
  have hf : S.f = 0 := by
    change (simplicialChainComplex K k).d ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).prev 0) 0 = 0
    rw [ChainComplex.prev]
    apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
    ext c
    change Chain K k 1 at c
    change boundary K k 0 c = 0
    have hc : c = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hc, map_zero]
  have hg : S.g = 0 := by
    change (simplicialChainComplex K k).d 0 ((ComplexShape.down ℕ).next 0) = 0
    rw [ChainComplex.next_nat_zero]
    exact simplicialChainComplex_d_zero K k 0
  intro hdim
  let : FiniteDimensional k S.homology := hdim
  let : FiniteDimensional k (Chain K k 0) :=
    (ShortComplex.LeftHomologyData.ofZeros S hf hg).homologyIso.toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
  have hfinite : Finite (Face K 0) := Module.Finite.finite_basis
    (Finsupp.basisSingleOne : Module.Basis (Face K 0) k (Chain K k 0))
  exact @_root_.not_finite (Face K 0) inferInstance hfinite

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.translation_apply
statement: @[simp] theorem translation_apply (ε : ℝ≥0) (t : ℝ) : translation ε t = t + (ε : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.shift_obj
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_obj (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    ((shift ε).obj M).obj t = M.obj (t + (ε : ℝ))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.shift_map_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem shift_map_app (ε : ℝ≥0) {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ}
    (f : M ⟶ N) (t : ℝ) : ((shift ε).map f).app t = f.app (t + (ε : ℝ))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.shift_structureMap
statement:
theorem shift_structureMap (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) {s t : ℝ} (h : s ≤ t) :
    structureMap ((shift ε).obj M) h = structureMap M (add_le_add h le_rfl)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.zeroIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroIso_hom_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (zeroIso M).hom.app t = M.map (eqToHom (add_zero t))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.zeroIso_inv_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem zeroIso_inv_app (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (zeroIso M).inv.app t = M.map (eqToHom (add_zero t).symm)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.compIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem compIso_hom_app (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (compIso ε δ M).hom.app t =
      M.map (eqToHom (show (t + (ε : ℝ)) + (δ : ℝ) = t + ((ε + δ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) by
        simp [add_assoc]))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.zeroIso_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem zeroIso_naturality {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (shift 0).map f ≫ (zeroIso N).hom = (zeroIso M).hom ≫ f
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  exact (f.naturality (eqToHom (add_zero t))).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.zeroIso_inv_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem zeroIso_inv_naturality {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (zeroIso M).inv ≫ (shift 0).map f = f ≫ (zeroIso N).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  exact f.naturality (eqToHom (add_zero t).symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.compIso_naturality
statement:
theorem compIso_naturality (ε δ : ℝ≥0) {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    (shift ε).map ((shift δ).map f) ≫ (compIso ε δ N).hom =
      (compIso ε δ M).hom ≫ (shift (ε + δ)).map f
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  exact (f.naturality _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.congrIso_hom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem congrIso_hom_app {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε = δ)
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (congrIso h M).hom.app t =
      M.map (eqToHom (congrArg (fun a : ℝ≥0 => t + (a : ℝ)) h))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.congrIso_refl
statement:
@[simp] theorem congrIso_refl (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    congrIso (rfl : ε = ε) M = Iso.refl _
proof:
:= by
  apply Iso.ext
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  exact M.map_id _

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.compIso_zero_left
statement:
@[reassoc] theorem compIso_zero_left (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    (compIso 0 ε M).hom ≫ (congrIso (zero_add ε) M).hom =
      (zeroIso ((shift ε).obj M)).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  rw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.compIso_zero_right
statement:
theorem compIso_zero_right (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    (compIso ε 0 M).hom ≫ (congrIso (add_zero ε) M).hom =
      (shift ε).map (zeroIso M).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  rw [← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.compIso_assoc
statement:
theorem compIso_assoc (ε δ γ : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    (compIso ε δ ((shift γ).obj M)).hom ≫ (compIso (ε + δ) γ M).hom =
      (shift ε).map (compIso δ γ M).hom ≫ (compIso ε (δ + γ) M).hom ≫
        (congrIso (add_assoc ε δ γ).symm M).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _
  erw [← M.map_comp, ← M.map_comp, ← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.transition_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem transition_app (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    (transition ε M).app t = structureMap M (le_add_of_nonneg_right ε.coe_nonneg)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.transition_naturality
statement:
theorem transition_naturality (ε : ℝ≥0) {M N : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ} (f : M ⟶ N) :
    f ≫ transition ε N = transition ε M ≫ (shift ε).map f
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  exact (f.naturality _).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.transition_zero
statement:
theorem transition_zero (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    transition 0 M ≫ (zeroIso M).hom = 𝟙 M
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = 𝟙 _
  erw [← M.map_comp]
  exact (congrArg M.map (Subsingleton.elim _ (𝟙 t))).trans (M.map_id t)

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.transition_zero_eq
statement:
theorem transition_zero_eq (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    transition 0 M = (zeroIso M).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply (cancel_mono (zeroIso M).hom).mp
  rw [transition_zero, Iso.inv_hom_id]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.transition_congr
statement:
theorem transition_congr {ε δ : ℝ≥0} (h : ε = δ) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    transition ε M ≫ (congrIso h M).hom = transition δ M
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  simp only [congrIso_refl, Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]

name: TDA.Persistence.RealShift.transition_add
statement:
theorem transition_add (ε δ : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    transition ε M ≫ (shift ε).map (transition δ M) ≫ (compIso ε δ M).hom =
      transition (ε + δ) M
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext t
  change M.map _ ≫ M.map _ ≫ M.map _ = M.map _
  erw [← M.map_comp, ← M.map_comp]
  congr 1

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.ext
statement:
@[ext] theorem ext {i j : RealInterleaving ε M N} (hφ : i.φ = j.φ) (hψ : i.ψ = j.ψ) :
    i = j
proof: := by cases i; cases j; cases hφ; cases hψ; rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.φ_ψ_app
statement:
theorem φ_ψ_app (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (t : ℝ) :
    i.φ.app t ≫ i.ψ.app (t + (ε : ℝ)) ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom.app t =
      (transition (ε + ε) M).app t
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f => f.app t) i.φ_ψ

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.ψ_φ_app
statement:
theorem ψ_φ_app (i : RealInterleaving ε M N) (t : ℝ) :
    i.ψ.app t ≫ i.φ.app (t + (ε : ℝ)) ≫ (compIso ε ε N).hom.app t =
      (transition (ε + ε) N).app t
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun f => f.app t) i.ψ_φ

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.equations_iff
statement:
theorem equations_iff (f : M ⟶ (shift ε).obj N) (g : N ⟶ (shift ε).obj M) :
    (f ≫ (shift ε).map g ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom = transition (ε + ε) M ∧
      g ≫ (shift ε).map f ≫ (compIso ε ε N).hom = transition (ε + ε) N) ↔
    (∀ t, f.app t ≫ g.app (t + (ε : ℝ)) ≫ (compIso ε ε M).hom.app t =
      (transition (ε + ε) M).app t) ∧
    (∀ t, g.app t ≫ f.app (t + (ε : ℝ)) ≫ (compIso ε ε N).hom.app t =
      (transition (ε + ε) N).app t)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hf, hg⟩
    exact ⟨fun t => congrArg (fun f => f.app t) hf,
      fun t => congrArg (fun f => f.app t) hg⟩
  · rintro ⟨hf, hg⟩
    constructor
    · apply NatTrans.ext; funext t; exact hf t
    · apply NatTrans.ext; funext t; exact hg t

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.shift_isZero_zero
statement:
theorem shift_isZero_zero (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    IsZero ((shift ε).obj (0 : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Functor.isZero
  intro t
  exact Functor.zero_obj (t + (ε : ℝ))

name: TDA.Persistence.RealInterleaving.nonempty_zero_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_zero_iff (ε : ℝ≥0) (M : PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ) :
    Nonempty (RealInterleaving ε M 0) ↔ transition (ε + ε) M = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i⟩
    have hφ : i.φ = 0 := (shift_isZero_zero ε).eq_of_tgt _ _
    rw [← i.φ_ψ, hφ, zero_comp]
  · intro h
    refine ⟨⟨0, 0, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
    · rw [zero_comp, h]
    · exact (isZero_zero (PModule.{u,0,w} R ℝ)).eq_of_src _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.inclusionHom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusionHom_app (h : ∀ p, F p ≤ G p) (p : P) :
    (inclusionHom R n h).app p = simplicialHomologyIncl R (h p) n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.inclusionHom_refl
statement:
theorem inclusionHom_refl (F : SimplicialFiltration P V) :
    inclusionHom R n (fun p => le_refl (F p)) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext p
  exact simplicialHomologyIncl_id R (F p) n

name: TDA.Persistence.inclusionHom_comp
statement:
theorem inclusionHom_comp (hFG : ∀ p, F p ≤ G p) (hGH : ∀ p, G p ≤ H p) :
    inclusionHom R n hFG ≫ inclusionHom R n hGH =
      inclusionHom R n (fun p => (hFG p).trans (hGH p))
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext p
  exact (simplicialHomologyIncl_comp R (hFG p) (hGH p) n).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.simplicialHomologyPModule_reindex
statement:
theorem simplicialHomologyPModule_reindex {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] (u : Q →o P)
    (F : SimplicialFiltration P V) :
    simplicialHomologyPModule R (Filtration.reindex u F) n =
      reindex u (simplicialHomologyPModule R F n)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.reindexNatTrans_inclusionHom
statement:
theorem reindexNatTrans_inclusionHom {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q] (u : Q →o P)
    (h : ∀ p, F p ≤ G p) :
    reindexNatTrans u (inclusionHom R n h) =
      inclusionHom R n (F := Filtration.reindex u F) (G := Filtration.reindex u G)
        (fun q => h (u q))
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.incl_comp_comp
statement:
private theorem incl_comp_comp {K L M N : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    (h₁ : K ≤ L) (h₂ : L ≤ M) (h₃ : M ≤ N) (h : K ≤ N) :
    simplicialHomologyIncl R h₁ n ≫ simplicialHomologyIncl R h₂ n ≫
      simplicialHomologyIncl R h₃ n = simplicialHomologyIncl R h n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← simplicialHomologyIncl_comp, ← simplicialHomologyIncl_comp]

name: TDA.Persistence.inclusionInterleaving_φ_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusionInterleaving_φ_app (hFG : ∀ t, F t ≤ G (t + ε))
    (hGF : ∀ t, G t ≤ F (t + ε)) (t : ℝ) :
    (inclusionInterleaving R n hFG hGF).φ.app t = simplicialHomologyIncl R (hFG t) n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.inclusionInterleaving_ψ_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem inclusionInterleaving_ψ_app (hFG : ∀ t, F t ≤ G (t + ε))
    (hGF : ∀ t, G t ≤ F (t + ε)) (t : ℝ) :
    (inclusionInterleaving R n hFG hGF).ψ.app t = simplicialHomologyIncl R (hGF t) n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevel_le_sublevel_of_le
statement:
theorem sublevel_le_sublevel_of_le {α : Type w} [LinearOrder α]
    {f g : FilterFunction K α} (h : ∀ s, g.value s ≤ f.value s) (r : α) :
    f.sublevel r ≤ g.sublevel r
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsK, hsr⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff f r s).1 hs
  exact (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff g r s).2 ⟨hsK, (h _).trans hsr⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevel_le_sublevel_add
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsK, hsr⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff f r s).1 hs
  exact (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff g _ s).2 ⟨hsK, (h _).trans (add_le_add hsr le_rfl)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelInterleaving_φ_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem sublevelInterleaving_φ_app (h : ∀ s, |f.value s - g.value s| ≤ ε) (t : ℝ) :
    (sublevelInterleaving R n h).φ.app t =
      simplicialHomologyIncl R (K := f.sublevel t) (L := g.sublevel (t + ε))
        (sublevel_le_sublevel_add (fun s => by
          have := (abs_sub_le_iff.1 (h s)).2
          linarith) t) n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.sublevelInterleaving_ψ_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem sublevelInterleaving_ψ_app (h : ∀ s, |f.value s - g.value s| ≤ ε) (t : ℝ) :
    (sublevelInterleaving R n h).ψ.app t =
      simplicialHomologyIncl R (K := g.sublevel t) (L := f.sublevel (t + ε))
        (sublevel_le_sublevel_add (fun s => by
          have := (abs_sub_le_iff.1 (h s)).1
          linarith) t) n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_sublevel_le
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_sublevel_le (h : ∀ s, |f.value s - g.value s| ≤ ε) :
    realInterleavingDistance (sublevelModule R f n) (sublevelModule R g n) ≤ ε
proof:
:=
  (sublevelInterleaving R n h).distance_le

name: TDA.Persistence.realInterleavingDistance_sublevel_le_faceSupDifference
statement:
theorem realInterleavingDistance_sublevel_le_faceSupDifference [Fintype (TotalFace K)]
    (f g : FilterFunction K ℝ) :
    realInterleavingDistance (sublevelModule R f n) (sublevelModule R g n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (faceSupDifference f g)
proof:
:=
  realInterleavingDistance_sublevel_le R n (ε := Real.toNNReal (faceSupDifference f g))
    (fun s => (abs_face_difference_le f g s).trans (Real.le_coe_toNNReal _))

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.upperPoint_measurable
statement: private theorem upperPoint_measurable : MeasurableSet {p : ℝ × ℝ | p.1 < p.2}
proof:
:=
  isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_snd |>.measurableSet

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.finite_weightedPlaneMeasure
statement:
theorem finite_weightedPlaneMeasure (w : UpperPoint → ℝ) (μ : Measure UpperPoint)
    (hμ : (∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (w p) ∂μ) < ∞) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (weightedPlaneMeasure w μ)
proof:
:= by
  have := isFiniteMeasure_withDensity hμ.ne
  exact Measure.isFiniteMeasure_map _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.regular_weightedPlaneMeasure
statement:
theorem regular_weightedPlaneMeasure (w : UpperPoint → ℝ) (μ : Measure UpperPoint)
    (hμ : (∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (w p) ∂μ) < ∞) :
    (weightedPlaneMeasure w μ).Regular
proof:
:= by
  have := finite_weightedPlaneMeasure w μ hμ
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.regular_withDensity_weight
statement:
theorem regular_withDensity_weight (w : UpperPoint → ℝ) (μ : Measure UpperPoint)
    (hμ : (∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (w p) ∂μ) < ∞) :
    (μ.withDensity fun p => ENNReal.ofReal (w p)).Regular
proof:
:= by
  have := isFiniteMeasure_withDensity hμ.ne
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.weightedPlaneMeasure_atoms
statement:
theorem weightedPlaneMeasure_atoms {I : Type*} (w : UpperPoint → ℝ) (x : I → UpperPoint) :
    weightedPlaneMeasure w (Measure.sum fun i => Measure.dirac (x i)) =
      Measure.sum fun i => ENNReal.ofReal (w (x i)) • Measure.dirac (x i).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedPlaneMeasure, withDensity_sum,
    Measure.map_sum measurable_subtype_coe.aemeasurable]
  simp only [dirac_withDensity, Measure.map_smul,
    Measure.map_dirac' measurable_subtype_coe]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.weightedPersistenceEmbedding_finite
statement:
theorem weightedPersistenceEmbedding_finite {I : Type*} [Fintype I] (σ : ℝ)
    (w : UpperPoint → ℝ) (x : I → UpperPoint) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w (x i)) :
    weightedPersistenceEmbedding σ w (Measure.sum fun i => Measure.dirac (x i)) =
      ∑ i, w (x i) • featureAt σ (x i).1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [weightedPersistenceEmbedding, weightedPlaneMeasure_atoms, positiveEmbedding,
    Measure.sum_fintype]
  rw [integral_finsetSum_measure (fun i _ =>
    (integrable_featureAt σ (Measure.dirac (x i).1)).smul_measure ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top)]
  simp_rw [integral_smul_measure, integral_dirac, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hw _)]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.weightedPersistenceEmbedding_finite_occurrences
statement:
theorem weightedPersistenceEmbedding_finite_occurrences {I : Type*} [Fintype I]
    {A B : ℝ} (σ : ℝ) (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (x : I → UpperPoint) :
    weightedPersistenceEmbedding σ (upperWeight w)
        (Measure.sum fun i => Measure.dirac (x i)) =
      embedding σ w (fun i => (x i).1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedPersistenceEmbedding_finite σ (upperWeight w) x
    (fun i => w.nonneg (birthPersistence (x i).1))]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.integrable_weightedFeature
statement:
theorem integrable_weightedFeature (σ : ℝ) (w : UpperPoint → ℝ) (hw : Measurable w)
    (hpos : ∀ p, 0 ≤ w p) (μ : Measure UpperPoint)
    (hμ : (∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (w p) ∂μ) < ∞) :
    Integrable (fun p => w p • featureAt σ p.1) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hwint : Integrable w μ :=
    ⟨hw.aestronglyMeasurable, (hasFiniteIntegral_iff_ofReal
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hpos)).2 hμ⟩
  apply hwint.mono'
    (hw.stronglyMeasurable.smul
      ((continuous_featureAt σ).comp continuous_subtype_val).stronglyMeasurable).aestronglyMeasurable
  filter_upwards [] with p
  simp [norm_smul, norm_featureAt, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hpos p)]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.weightedPersistenceEmbedding_eq_integral
statement:
theorem weightedPersistenceEmbedding_eq_integral (σ : ℝ) (w : UpperPoint → ℝ)
    (hw : Measurable w) (hpos : ∀ p, 0 ≤ w p) (μ : Measure UpperPoint) :
    weightedPersistenceEmbedding σ w μ = ∫ p, w p • featureAt σ p.1 ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [weightedPersistenceEmbedding, positiveEmbedding, weightedPlaneMeasure,
    integral_map measurable_subtype_coe.aemeasurable
      (continuous_featureAt σ).stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable,
    integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul hw.ennreal_ofReal
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top) ]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with p
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (hpos p)]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.weightedPlaneMeasure_injective
statement:
theorem weightedPlaneMeasure_injective (w : UpperPoint → ℝ) (hw : Measurable w)
    (hpos : ∀ p, 0 < w p) : Function.Injective (weightedPlaneMeasure w)
proof:
:= by
  intro μ ν h
  have hd : μ.withDensity (fun p => ENNReal.ofReal (w p)) =
      ν.withDensity (fun p => ENNReal.ofReal (w p)) :=
    (MeasurableEmbedding.subtype_coe upperPoint_measurable).map_injective h
  have hrecover (ρ : Measure UpperPoint) :
      (ρ.withDensity (fun p => ENNReal.ofReal (w p))).withDensity
          (fun p => (ENNReal.ofReal (w p))⁻¹) = ρ := by
    apply withDensity_inv_same (hw.ennreal_ofReal)
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => ENNReal.ofReal_ne_zero_iff.2 (hpos p)
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
