  have hback := congrArg (fun ρ : Measure UpperPoint =>
    ρ.withDensity (fun p => (ENNReal.ofReal (w p))⁻¹)) hd
  simpa only [hrecover] using hback

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.weightedPersistenceEmbedding_eq_iff
statement:
theorem weightedPersistenceEmbedding_eq_iff {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (w : UpperPoint → ℝ) (hw : Measurable w) (hpos : ∀ p, 0 < w p)
    (μ ν : Measure UpperPoint)
    (hμ : (∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (w p) ∂μ) < ∞)
    (hν : (∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (w p) ∂ν) < ∞) :
    weightedPersistenceEmbedding σ w μ = weightedPersistenceEmbedding σ w ν ↔ μ = ν
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := finite_weightedPlaneMeasure w μ hμ
    have := finite_weightedPlaneMeasure w ν hν
    exact weightedPlaneMeasure_injective w hw hpos
      (positiveEmbedding_injective hσ _ _ h)
  · rintro rfl
    rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.weightedPersistenceEmbedding_eq_iff_continuous
statement:
theorem weightedPersistenceEmbedding_eq_iff_continuous {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (w : C(UpperPoint, ℝ)) (hpos : ∀ p, 0 < w p)
    (μ ν : Measure UpperPoint) [μ.Regular] [ν.Regular]
    (hμ : (∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (w p) ∂μ) < ∞)
    (hν : (∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (w p) ∂ν) < ∞) :
    weightedPersistenceEmbedding σ w μ = weightedPersistenceEmbedding σ w ν ↔ μ = ν
proof:
:=
  weightedPersistenceEmbedding_eq_iff hσ w w.continuous.measurable hpos μ ν hμ hν

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.countableDiagramMeasure_weighted_mass
statement:
theorem countableDiagramMeasure_weighted_mass (w : UpperPoint → ℝ) (x : ℕ → UpperPoint) :
    (∫⁻ p, ENNReal.ofReal (w p) ∂countableDiagramMeasure x) =
      ∑' n, ENNReal.ofReal (w (x n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [countableDiagramMeasure, lintegral_sum_measure]
  simp only [lintegral_dirac]

name: TDA.Persistence.WeightedKernel.countableDiagramEmbedding_eq_iff
statement:
theorem countableDiagramEmbedding_eq_iff {σ : ℝ} (hσ : σ ≠ 0)
    (w : C(UpperPoint, ℝ)) (hpos : ∀ p, 0 < w p) (x y : ℕ → UpperPoint)
    [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure (countableDiagramMeasure x)]
    [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure (countableDiagramMeasure y)]
    (hx : Summable fun n => w (x n)) (hy : Summable fun n => w (y n)) :
    weightedPersistenceEmbedding σ w (countableDiagramMeasure x) =
      weightedPersistenceEmbedding σ w (countableDiagramMeasure y) ↔
        countableDiagramMeasure x = countableDiagramMeasure y
proof:
:= by
  apply weightedPersistenceEmbedding_eq_iff_continuous hσ w hpos
  · rw [countableDiagramMeasure_weighted_mass]
    exact hx.tsum_ofReal_lt_top
  · rw [countableDiagramMeasure_weighted_mass]
    exact hy.tsum_ofReal_lt_top

name: TDA.Persistence.extractionInterval_alive
statement:
private theorem extractionInterval_alive (b t : Fin N) (hbt : b ≤ t) (i : Fin N) :
    (extractionInterval b t hbt).alive i ↔ b ≤ i ∧ i ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [FiniteInterval.alive, extractionInterval, Fin.le_iff_val_le_val]
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.intervalFiber_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem intervalFiber_eq_zero (I : FiniteInterval N) (i : Fin N)
    (hi : ¬ I.alive i) (x : I.fiber (k := k) i) : x.val = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [FiniteInterval.fiber, hi] using x.property

name: TDA.Persistence.extractionInclusionLinear_apply
statement:
private theorem extractionInclusionLinear_apply
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N)) (I : FiniteInterval N)
    (w : ∀ i, M.obj i) (i : Fin N) (x : I.fiber (k := k) i) :
    extractionInclusionLinear M I w i x = x.val • w i
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.extractionRetractionLinear_active
statement:
private theorem extractionRetractionLinear_active
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N)) (b t : Fin N) (hbt : b ≤ t)
    (ell : Module.Dual k (M.obj t)) (i : Fin N)
    (hi : (extractionInterval b t hbt).alive i) (x : M.obj i) :
    (extractionRetractionLinear M b t hbt ell i x).val =
      ell (structureMapLinear M ((extractionInterval_alive b t hbt i).mp hi).2 x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [extractionRetractionLinear, hi]

name: TDA.Persistence.extraction_split_identity
statement:
private theorem extraction_split_identity
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N)) (b t : Fin N) (hbt : b ≤ t)
    (w : ∀ i, M.obj i)
    (hw : ∀ (i j : Fin N) (_hbi : b ≤ i) (hij : i ≤ j),
      structureMapLinear M hij (w i) = w j)
    (hzero : ∀ i, t < i → w i = 0)
    (hbefore : ∀ i, i < b → ∀ x : M.obj i, x = 0)
    (ell : Module.Dual k (M.obj t)) (hell : ell (w t) = 1) :
    extractionInclusion M b t hbt w hw hzero ≫ extractionRetraction M b t hbt hbefore ell =
      𝟙 (intervalModule (k := k) (extractionInterval b t hbt))
proof:
:= by
  apply NatTrans.ext
  funext i
  apply ModuleCat.hom_ext
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change (extractionInterval b t hbt).fiber (k := k) i at x
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (extractionRetractionLinear M b t hbt ell i
    (extractionInclusionLinear M _ w i x)).val = x.val
  by_cases hi : (extractionInterval b t hbt).alive i
  · rw [extractionRetractionLinear_active M b t hbt ell i hi,
      extractionInclusionLinear_apply, map_smul, hw i t
        ((extractionInterval_alive b t hbt i).mp hi).1
        ((extractionInterval_alive b t hbt i).mp hi).2, map_smul, hell]
    simp
  · rw [intervalFiber_eq_zero (k := k) _ i hi x]
    simp [extractionRetractionLinear, hi]

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_interval_retract
statement:
theorem exists_interval_retract (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N))
    (hne : ∃ i, ∃ v : M.obj i, v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (I : FiniteInterval N) (ι : intervalModule (k := k) I ⟶ M)
      (π : M ⟶ intervalModule (k := k) I), ι ≫ π = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  let births : Finset (Fin N) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ∃ v : M.obj i, v ≠ 0)
  have hbirths : births.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨i, v, hv⟩ := hne
    exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, v, hv⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbmin⟩ := births.exists_min_image (fun i => i) hbirths
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hb).2
  have hbefore (i : Fin N) (hi : i < b) (x : M.obj i) : x = 0 := by
    by_contra hx
    have hbi := hbmin i (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, x, hx⟩)
    exact (not_le_of_gt hi) hbi
  let w : ∀ i, M.obj i := fun i => if hi : b ≤ i then structureMapLinear M hi v else 0
  have hwb : w b = v := by simp [w]
  have hw (i j : Fin N) (hbi : b ≤ i) (hij : i ≤ j) :
      structureMapLinear M hij (w i) = w j := by
    dsimp [w]
    rw [dif_pos hbi, dif_pos (hbi.trans hij), structureMapLinear_comp M hbi hij]
    rfl
  
  let surviving : Finset (Fin N) := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => w i ≠ 0)
  have hsurv : surviving.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨b, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩⟩
    rwa [hwb]
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htmax⟩ := surviving.exists_max_image (fun i => i) hsurv
  have hwt : w t ≠ 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp ht).2
  have hbt : b ≤ t := by
    by_contra h
    exact hwt (by simp [w, h])
  have hzero (i : Fin N) (hi : t < i) : w i = 0 := by
    by_contra hwi
    exact (not_le_of_gt hi) (htmax i (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hwi⟩))
  
  obtain ⟨ell, hell⟩ := Module.Projective.exists_dual_eq_one k hwt
  exact ⟨extractionInterval b t hbt, extractionInclusion M b t hbt w hw hzero,
    extractionRetraction M b t hbt hbefore ell,
    extraction_split_identity M b t hbt w hw hzero hbefore ell hell⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.totalDimension_intervalModule_pos
statement:
theorem totalDimension_intervalModule_pos (I : FiniteInterval N) :
    0 < totalDimension (intervalModule (k := k) I)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let b : Fin N := ⟨I.birth, I.birth_lt_death.trans_le I.death_le_size⟩
  have hb : I.alive b := ⟨le_rfl, I.birth_lt_death⟩
  have hdim : Module.finrank k ((intervalModule (k := k) I).obj b) = 1 := by
    change Module.finrank k (I.fiber (k := k) b) = 1
    have hf : I.fiber (k := k) b = ⊤ := by simp [FiniteInterval.fiber, hb]
    rw [hf]
    simp
  have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun i : Fin N =>
    Module.finrank k ((intervalModule (k := k) I).obj i))
    (fun i _ => Nat.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ b)
  change Module.finrank k ((intervalModule (k := k) I).obj b) ≤
    totalDimension (intervalModule (k := k) I) at hle
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.exists_interval_summand
statement:
theorem exists_interval_summand (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N))
    [∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj i)] (h : 0 < totalDimension M) :
    ∃ (I : FiniteInterval N) (C : PModule.{u,0,u} k (Fin N)),
      (∀ i, FiniteDimensional k (C.obj i)) ∧
      Nonempty (M ≅ pointwiseProd (intervalModule (k := k) I) C) ∧
      totalDimension C < totalDimension M
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ∃ i, ∃ v : M.obj i, v ≠ 0 := by
    obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.sum_pos_iff.mp h
    exact ⟨i, Module.finrank_pos_iff_exists_ne_zero.mp hi⟩
  obtain ⟨I, inc, ret, hsplit⟩ := exists_interval_retract M hne
  refine ⟨I, splitComplement ret, fun i => inferInstance, ⟨splitIso inc ret hsplit⟩, ?_⟩
  have hdim := totalDimension_split inc ret hsplit
  have hpos := totalDimension_intervalModule_pos (k := k) I
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.MetricExamples.reservoirMeasure_dirac_one
statement:
private theorem reservoirMeasure_dirac_one (x : Interior) :
    reservoirMeasure (Measure.dirac x) (1 : ℝ≥0∞) = Measure.dirac (Space.point x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reservoirMeasure, Measure.map_dirac' continuous_point.measurable]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.MetricExamples.unit_reservoir_marginal_forces_cost_four
statement:
private theorem unit_reservoir_marginal_forces_cost_four
    (γ : Measure (Space × Space))
    (hγ : γ.map Prod.fst = reservoirMeasure (Measure.dirac Reverse.farSource) 1 ∧
      γ.map Prod.snd = reservoirMeasure (Measure.dirac Reverse.farTarget) 1) :
    (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost 2 z ∂γ) = 4
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : γ.map Prod.fst = Measure.dirac (Space.point Reverse.farSource) :=
    hγ.1.trans (reservoirMeasure_dirac_one Reverse.farSource)
  have hsecond : γ.map Prod.snd = Measure.dirac (Space.point Reverse.farTarget) :=
    hγ.2.trans (reservoirMeasure_dirac_one Reverse.farTarget)
  have hfirst_map : ∀ᵐ y ∂γ.map Prod.fst, y = Space.point Reverse.farSource := by
    rw [hfirst]
    simp
  have hsecond_map : ∀ᵐ y ∂γ.map Prod.snd, y = Space.point Reverse.farTarget := by
    rw [hsecond]
    simp
  have hfirst_ae : ∀ᵐ z ∂γ, z.1 = Space.point Reverse.farSource :=
    (ae_map_iff (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable Prod.fst γ)
      (by measurability : MeasurableSet {y : Space | y = Space.point Reverse.farSource})).1
      hfirst_map
  have hsecond_ae : ∀ᵐ z ∂γ, z.2 = Space.point Reverse.farTarget :=
    (ae_map_iff (by fun_prop : AEMeasurable Prod.snd γ)
      (by measurability : MeasurableSet {y : Space | y = Space.point Reverse.farTarget})).1
      hsecond_map
  have hmass : γ Set.univ = 1 := by
    have hmap := congrArg (fun η : Measure Space => η Set.univ) hfirst
    rw [Measure.map_apply measurable_fst MeasurableSet.univ] at hmap
    simpa using hmap
  have hcost_ae : ∀ᵐ z ∂γ, collapsedPowerCost 2 z = 4 := by
    filter_upwards [hfirst_ae, hsecond_ae] with z hfst hsnd
    rw [collapsedPowerCost, hfst, hsnd]
    rw [show dist (Space.point Reverse.farSource) (Space.point Reverse.farTarget) = 2
      from far_points_shortcut]
    norm_num
  calc
    (∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost 2 z ∂γ) = ∫⁻ z, (4 : ℝ≥0∞) ∂γ :=
      lintegral_congr_ae hcost_ae
    _ = 4 := by rw [lintegral_const, hmass]; norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.MetricExamples.far_atoms_unit_capacity_value
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · let γ : Measure (Space × Space) :=
      Measure.dirac (Space.point Reverse.farSource, Space.point Reverse.farTarget)
    have hfirst : γ.map Prod.fst =
        reservoirMeasure (Measure.dirac Reverse.farSource) (1 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      dsimp [γ]
      rw [Measure.map_dirac' measurable_fst, reservoirMeasure_dirac_one]
    have hsecond : γ.map Prod.snd =
        reservoirMeasure (Measure.dirac Reverse.farTarget) (1 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
      dsimp [γ]
      rw [Measure.map_dirac' measurable_snd, reservoirMeasure_dirac_one]
    calc
      reservoirPowerValue 2 (Measure.dirac Reverse.farSource)
          (Measure.dirac Reverse.farTarget) (1 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤
          ∫⁻ z, collapsedPowerCost 2 z ∂γ :=
        reservoirPowerValue_le_plan 2 _ _ 1 γ hfirst hsecond
      _ = 4 := by
        simpa [γ, collapsedPowerCost] using Reverse.far_shortcut_original_cost
  · unfold reservoirPowerValue
    refine le_iInf fun γ => le_iInf fun hγ => ?_
    exact (unit_reservoir_marginal_forces_cost_four γ hγ).symm.le

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.MetricExamples.far_atoms_exceed_unit_capacity
proof:
:= by
  norm_num

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.MetricExamples.indexed_unit_dirac
proof:
:= by

  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.MetricExamples.far_atoms_boundary_value
proof:
:= by
  rw [← indexed_unit_dirac Reverse.farSource, ← indexed_unit_dirac Reverse.farTarget,
    boundaryTransportPowerValue_ofIndexed_unit 2 (by norm_num),
    finitePowerMatchingCost_singleton]
  norm_num [Reverse.farSource, Reverse.farTarget, finitePairCost, diagonalCost]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.MetricExamples.full_capacity_countercontrol

        (Measure.dirac Reverse.farTarget) = 2 ∧

        (Measure.dirac Reverse.farTarget) 2 = 2

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.MetricExamples.translated_powered_values

        (Measure.dirac (translatedPoint 1)) = 1 ∧
      boundaryTransportPowerValue 1 (Measure.dirac (translatedPoint 1))
        (Measure.dirac (translatedPoint 2)) = 1 ∧
      boundaryTransportPowerValue 1 (Measure.dirac (translatedPoint 0))
        (Measure.dirac (translatedPoint 2)) = 2
proof:
:= by

      boundaryTransportPowerValue 1 (Measure.dirac (translatedPoint a))
        (Measure.dirac (translatedPoint b)) =

        (translatedPoint b).1).toReal ^ (1 : ℝ))
        ((diagonalCost (translatedPoint a).1).toReal ^ (1 : ℝ) +
          (diagonalCost (translatedPoint b).1).toReal ^ (1 : ℝ))) := by
    rw [← indexed_unit_dirac (translatedPoint a), ← indexed_unit_dirac (translatedPoint b),
      boundaryTransportPowerValue_ofIndexed_unit 1 (by norm_num),
      finitePowerMatchingCost_singleton]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.MetricExamples.sharp_atomic_triangle

        (Measure.dirac (translatedPoint 2)) =
      boundaryTransportDistance 1 (Measure.dirac (translatedPoint 0))
        (Measure.dirac (translatedPoint 1)) +
      boundaryTransportDistance 1 (Measure.dirac (translatedPoint 1))
        (Measure.dirac (translatedPoint 2))
proof:

  rcases translated_powered_values with ⟨h01, h12, h02⟩
  norm_num [boundaryTransportDistance, h01, h12, h02]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.MetricExamples.approximation_distance_bounds
statement:
private theorem approximation_distance_bounds (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (μ ν : Measure Interior) [IsFiniteMeasure μ] [IsFiniteMeasure ν]
    (hμ : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ) < ∞)
    (hν : (∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂ν) < ∞)
    (ε : ℝ≥0∞) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ D E : FiniteWeightedDiagram,
      atomicMeasure D univ = μ univ ∧ atomicMeasure E univ = ν univ ∧
      boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν ≤
        boundaryTransportDistance p (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E) + (ε + ε) ∧
      boundaryTransportDistance p (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E) ≤
        boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν + (ε + ε)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hnearD⟩ := exists_atomicMeasure_approx_same_mass p hp μ hμ ε hε
  obtain ⟨E, hE, hnearE⟩ := exists_atomicMeasure_approx_same_mass p hp ν hν ε hε
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (atomicMeasure D) := atomicMeasure_isFinite D
  have : IsFiniteMeasure (atomicMeasure E) := atomicMeasure_isFinite E
  have hDrev : boundaryTransportDistance p (atomicMeasure D) μ ≤ ε := by
    rw [boundaryTransportDistance_symm]
    exact hnearD.le
  have hErev : boundaryTransportDistance p (atomicMeasure E) ν ≤ ε := by
    rw [boundaryTransportDistance_symm]
    exact hnearE.le
  refine ⟨D, E, hD, hE, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν ≤ boundaryTransportDistance p μ (atomicMeasure D) +
          boundaryTransportDistance p (atomicMeasure D) ν :=
        boundaryTransportDistance_triangle p hp μ (atomicMeasure D) ν
      _ ≤ boundaryTransportDistance p μ (atomicMeasure D) +
          (boundaryTransportDistance p (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E) +
            boundaryTransportDistance p (atomicMeasure E) ν) :=
        add_le_add le_rfl (boundaryTransportDistance_triangle p hp (atomicMeasure D)
          (atomicMeasure E) ν)
      _ ≤ ε + (boundaryTransportDistance p (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E) + ε) :=
        add_le_add hnearD.le (add_le_add le_rfl hErev)
      _ = boundaryTransportDistance p (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E) + (ε + ε) := by
        ac_rfl
  · calc
      boundaryTransportDistance p (atomicMeasure D) (atomicMeasure E) ≤
          boundaryTransportDistance p (atomicMeasure D) μ +
            boundaryTransportDistance p μ (atomicMeasure E) :=
        boundaryTransportDistance_triangle p hp (atomicMeasure D) μ (atomicMeasure E)
      _ ≤ boundaryTransportDistance p (atomicMeasure D) μ +
          (boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν + boundaryTransportDistance p ν (atomicMeasure E)) :=
        add_le_add le_rfl (boundaryTransportDistance_triangle p hp μ ν (atomicMeasure E))
      _ ≤ ε + (boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν + ε) :=
        add_le_add hDrev (add_le_add le_rfl hnearE.le)
      _ = boundaryTransportDistance p μ ν + (ε + ε) := by ac_rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.MetricExamples.fractionalLaw_mass
statement: private theorem fractionalLaw_mass : fractionalLaw univ = 3 / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [fractionalLaw, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.MetricExamples.fractional_probability_norm
statement:
private theorem fractional_probability_norm :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (normalizedReservoirMeasure fractionalLaw 2) ∧
      IsProbabilityMeasure (normalizedReservoirMeasure 0 2) ∧
      (2 : ℝ≥0∞) *
        (⨅ γ : Measure (Space × Space),
          ⨅ (_ : γ.map Prod.fst = normalizedReservoirMeasure fractionalLaw 2 ∧
            γ.map Prod.snd = normalizedReservoirMeasure 0 2),
            eLpNorm (fun z : Space × Space => edist z.1 z.2) 1 γ) = 3 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have htotal : fractionalLaw univ + (0 : Measure Interior) univ ≤ (2 : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    rw [fractionalLaw_mass]
    simpa using ((ENNReal.div_le_iff (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).2
      (by norm_num : (3 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 * 2) : (3 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2)
  rcases normalizedReservoirPair_isProbability fractionalLaw 0 2
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) htotal with ⟨hμ, hν⟩
  refine ⟨hμ, hν, ?_⟩
  have hnorm := boundaryTransportDistance_eq_normalized_iInf_eLpNorm 1 (by norm_num)
    fractionalLaw 0 2 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) htotal
  norm_num at hnorm
  rw [← hnorm, boundaryTransportDistance_zero_target 1 (by norm_num) fractionalLaw
    (by rw [fractionalLaw_mass]; finiteness)]
  norm_num [fractionalLaw, lintegral_smul_measure, depth_eq, Reverse.farSource]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.sampleProjection_surjective
statement:
theorem sampleProjection_surjective (t : Fin n → X) :
    Function.Surjective (sampleProjection t)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨x, i, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨i, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.dist_sampleProjection
statement:
@[simp] theorem dist_sampleProjection (t : Fin n → X) (i j : Fin n) :
    dist (sampleProjection t i) (sampleProjection t j) = dist (t i) (t j)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.sampleProjection_eq_iff
statement:
theorem sampleProjection_eq_iff (t : Fin n → X) (i j : Fin n) :
    sampleProjection t i = sampleProjection t j ↔ dist (t i) (t j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [sampleProjection, Subtype.ext_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.sampleDiagram_eq_of_isometry
statement:
theorem sampleDiagram_eq_of_isometry (k : Type w) [Field k]
    (f : X → Y) (hf : Isometry f) (t : Fin n → X) (degree : ℕ) :
    sampleDiagram k (fun i => f (t i)) degree = sampleDiagram k t degree
proof:
:= by
  let g : Sample t → Sample (fun i => f (t i)) := fun x =>
    ⟨f x.1, by
      rcases x.2 with ⟨i, hi⟩
      exact ⟨i, congrArg f hi⟩⟩
  have hg : Function.Bijective g := by
    constructor
    · intro a b hab
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hf.injective (congrArg Subtype.val hab)
    · rintro ⟨y, i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨sampleProjection t i, by apply Subtype.ext; rfl⟩
  let e : Sample t ≃ᵢ Sample (fun i => f (t i)) :=
    { Equiv.ofBijective g hg with
      isometry_toFun := by
        intro a b
        change edist (f a.1) (f b.1) = edist a.1 b.1
        exact hf a.1 b.1 }
  exact (diagram_eq_of_isometryEquiv k e degree).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.sampleDiagram_eq_of_range_eq
statement:
theorem sampleDiagram_eq_of_range_eq (k : Type w) [Field k]
    {m : ℕ} (t : Fin n → X) (s : Fin m → X) (h : Set.range t = Set.range s)
    (degree : ℕ) : sampleDiagram k t degree = sampleDiagram k s degree

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.sampleDiagram_eq_diagram_of_surjective
statement:
theorem sampleDiagram_eq_diagram_of_surjective (k : Type w) [Field k]
    [Fintype X] (t : Fin n → X) (ht : Function.Surjective t) (degree : ℕ) :
    sampleDiagram k t degree = diagram k X degree
proof:
:= by
  let e : Sample t ≃ᵢ X :=
    { Equiv.ofBijective Subtype.val ⟨Subtype.val_injective, fun x => by
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := ht x
        exact ⟨sampleProjection t i, rfl⟩⟩ with
      isometry_toFun := fun _ _ => rfl }
  exact diagram_eq_of_isometryEquiv k e degree

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_sampleDiagram_le
statement:
theorem bottleneck_sampleDiagram_le (k : Type w) [Field k]
    (t : Fin n → X) (s : Fin n → Y) {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (h : ∀ i j, |dist (t i) (t j) - dist (s i) (s j)| ≤ (ε : ℝ))
    (degree : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (sampleDiagram k t degree) (sampleDiagram k s degree) ≤ (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:
:= by
  let C : SetRel (Sample t) (Sample s) :=
    {p | ∃ i, p.1 = sampleProjection t i ∧ p.2 = sampleProjection s i}
  apply bottleneck_diagram_le_of_relation k (C := C) (ε := ε) _ _ _ degree
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := sampleProjection_surjective t x
    exact ⟨sampleProjection s i, i, rfl, rfl⟩
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := sampleProjection_surjective s y
    exact ⟨sampleProjection t i, i, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro x x' y y' ⟨i, rfl, rfl⟩ ⟨j, rfl, rfl⟩
    exact h i j

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.bottleneck_sampleDiagram_le_pairMaximum
statement:
theorem bottleneck_sampleDiagram_le_pairMaximum (k : Type w) [Field k]
    (t : Fin n → X × Y) (degree : ℕ) :
    bottleneck (sampleDiagram k (fun i => (t i).1) degree)
      (sampleDiagram k (fun i => (t i).2) degree) ≤ pairMaximum distortion t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hm : pairMaximum distortion t = ⊤
  · simp [hm]
  · have h := bottleneck_sampleDiagram_le k
        (fun i => (t i).1) (fun i => (t i).2)
        (ε := (pairMaximum distortion t).toNNReal) (fun i j => ?_) degree
    · simpa only [ENNReal.coe_toNNReal hm] using h
    · exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_iff_le_toReal hm).mp
        (cost_le_pairMaximum distortion t i j)

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.sampleLaw_map_isometry
statement:
theorem sampleLaw_map_isometry (k : Type w) [Field k]
    (μ : PMF X) (f : X → Y) (hf : Isometry f) (n degree : ℕ) :
    sampleLaw k (μ.map f) n degree = sampleLaw k μ n degree
proof:
:= by
  change (iid (μ.map f) n).map (fun t => sampleDiagram k t degree) =
    (iid μ n).map (fun t => sampleDiagram k t degree)
  rw [← iid_map μ f n, PMF.map_comp]
  congr 1
  funext t
  exact sampleDiagram_eq_of_isometry k f hf t degree

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.transportCost_sampleLaw_le
statement:
theorem transportCost_sampleLaw_le (k : Type w) [Field k]
    {μ : PMF X} {ν : PMF Y} (π : Coupling μ ν) {p : ℝ} (hp : 0 < p)
    (n degree : ℕ) :
    transportCost (fun D E => bottleneck D E ^ p)
      (sampleLaw k μ n degree) (sampleLaw k ν n degree) ≤
      (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) * π.distortionMoment p
proof:
:= by
  apply (transportCost_le_coupling _ _ _ (sampleLawCoupling k π n degree)).trans
  change expectation ((π.tuples n).joint.map
      (fun ts => (sampleDiagram k ts.1 degree, sampleDiagram k ts.2 degree)))
    (fun de => bottleneck de.1 de.2 ^ p) ≤ _
  rw [expectation_map]
  change expectation ((iid π.joint n).map
      (fun t => (fun i => (t i).1, fun i => (t i).2))) _ ≤ _
  rw [expectation_map]
  apply (expectation_mono _ (fun t => ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow
    (bottleneck_sampleDiagram_le_pairMaximum k t degree) hp.le)).trans
  exact expectation_pairMaximum_rpow_le π.joint distortion distortion_self distortion_comm hp n

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.wasserstein_sampleLaw_le_gromovWasserstein_allDegrees
statement:
theorem wasserstein_sampleLaw_le_gromovWasserstein_allDegrees (k : Type w) [Field k]
    (μ : PMF X) (ν : PMF Y) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (n q : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    wasserstein p bottleneck (sampleLaw k μ n q) (sampleLaw k ν n q) ≤
      (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ p⁻¹ * (2 * gromovWasserstein p μ ν)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 < p := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hp
  have hC0 : (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ p⁻¹ ≠ 0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    apply ENNReal.rpow_pos
    · exact_mod_cast Nat.choose_pos hn
    · exact ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _
  have hCtop : (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ p⁻¹ ≠ ⊤ :=
    ENNReal.rpow_ne_top_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hp0.le) (ENNReal.natCast_ne_top _)
  have hGW : 2 * gromovWasserstein p μ ν =
      ⨅ π : Coupling μ ν, π.distortionMoment p ^ p⁻¹ := by
    simp only [gromovWasserstein, ← mul_assoc]
    rw [ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel (by norm_num) (by norm_num), one_mul]
  rw [hGW, ENNReal.mul_iInf_of_ne hC0 hCtop]
  apply le_iInf
  intro π
  exact (ENNReal.rpow_le_rpow (transportCost_sampleLaw_le k π hp0 n q)
    (inv_nonneg.mpr hp0.le)).trans_eq
      (ENNReal.mul_rpow_of_nonneg _ _ (inv_nonneg.mpr hp0.le))

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.wasserstein_sampleLaw_le_gromovWasserstein
statement:
theorem wasserstein_sampleLaw_le_gromovWasserstein (k : Type w) [Field k]
    (μ : PMF X) (ν : PMF Y) {p : ℝ} (hp : 1 ≤ p) (n degree : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    wasserstein p bottleneck (sampleLaw k μ n (degree + 1)) (sampleLaw k ν n (degree + 1)) ≤
      (n.choose 2 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ p⁻¹ * (2 * gromovWasserstein p μ ν)
proof:
:=
  wasserstein_sampleLaw_le_gromovWasserstein_allDegrees k μ ν hp n (degree + 1) hn

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.wassersteinInfinity_sampleLaw_le_gromovWassersteinInfinity_allDegrees
statement:
theorem wassersteinInfinity_sampleLaw_le_gromovWassersteinInfinity_allDegrees
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (μ : PMF X) (ν : PMF Y) (n q : ℕ) :
    wassersteinInfinity bottleneck (sampleLaw k μ n q) (sampleLaw k ν n q) ≤
      2 * gromovWassersteinInfinity μ ν
proof:
:= by
  have hGW : 2 * gromovWassersteinInfinity μ ν =
      ⨅ π : Coupling μ ν, π.distortionInfinity := by
    simp only [gromovWassersteinInfinity, ← mul_assoc]
    rw [ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel (by norm_num) (by norm_num), one_mul]
  rw [hGW]
  apply le_iInf
  intro π
  apply (iInf_le _ (sampleLawCoupling k π n q)).trans
  change essentialSup ((π.tuples n).joint.map
      (fun ts => (sampleDiagram k ts.1 q, sampleDiagram k ts.2 q)))
    (fun de => bottleneck de.1 de.2) ≤ _
  rw [essentialSup_map]
  change essentialSup ((iid π.joint n).map
      (fun t => (fun i => (t i).1, fun i => (t i).2))) _ ≤ _
  rw [essentialSup_map]
  apply le_trans _ (essentialSup_pairMaximum_le π.joint distortion n)
  apply iSup_le
  intro t
  apply iSup_le
  intro ht
  exact (bottleneck_sampleDiagram_le_pairMaximum k t q).trans
    (le_iSup_of_le t (le_iSup_of_le ht le_rfl))

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.wassersteinInfinity_sampleLaw_le_gromovWassersteinInfinity
statement:
theorem wassersteinInfinity_sampleLaw_le_gromovWassersteinInfinity
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (μ : PMF X) (ν : PMF Y) (n degree : ℕ) :
    wassersteinInfinity bottleneck (sampleLaw k μ n (degree + 1)) (sampleLaw k ν n (degree + 1)) ≤
      2 * gromovWassersteinInfinity μ ν
proof:
:=
  wassersteinInfinity_sampleLaw_le_gromovWassersteinInfinity_allDegrees k μ ν n (degree + 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.kernelInclusion_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply hi
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: TDA.Persistence.kernelInclusion_range
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨l, rfl⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (π.app a).hom ((ι.app a).hom l.val) = 0
    have hr : (ι.app a).hom l.val ∈ LinearMap.range (ι.app a).hom := ⟨l.val, rfl⟩
    rw [hs.range_eq_ker a] at hr
    exact hr
  · intro hm
    have hz : (π.app a).hom m.val = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hm
    have hmrange : m.val ∈ LinearMap.range (ι.app a).hom := by
      rw [hs.range_eq_ker a]
      exact hz
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hmrange
    have hdie : structureMapLinear L hab l = 0 := by
      apply hs.injective b
      have hn := congrArg (fun f : L.obj a ⟶ M.obj b => f.hom l)
        (ι.naturality (homOfLE hab))
      change (ι.app b).hom (structureMapLinear L hab l) =
        structureMapLinear M hab ((ι.app a).hom l) at hn
      rw [hl, m.property] at hn
      simpa using hn
    exact ⟨⟨l, hdie⟩, Subtype.ext hl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.shortExact_finrank
statement:
private theorem shortExact_finrank (ι : L ⟶ M) (π : M ⟶ N)
    (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) (a : P)
    [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj a)] :
    Module.finrank k (M.obj a) =
      Module.finrank k (L.obj a) + Module.finrank k (N.obj a)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (π.app a).hom
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (hs.surjective a), finrank_top,
    ← hs.range_eq_ker a, LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (hs.injective a)] at hd
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.kernelMap_rank_formula
statement:
private theorem kernelMap_rank_formula (ι : L ⟶ M) (π : M ⟶ N)
    (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b)
    [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj a)] :
    Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (kernelMap π hab)) +
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear L hab)) =
        Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M hab))
proof:
:= by
  have hd := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (kernelMap π hab)
  rw [← kernelInclusion_range ι π hs hab,
    LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj (kernelInclusion_injective ι hab (hs.injective a))] at hd
  exact hd

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.rank_add_iff_lift_kernel
statement:
theorem IsPointwiseShortExact.rank_add_iff_lift_kernel
    {ι : L ⟶ M} {π : M ⟶ N} (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π)
    {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b)
    [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj a)] :
    (Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M hab)) =
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear L hab)) +
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear N hab))) ↔
    (∀ n : N.obj a, structureMapLinear N hab n = 0 →
      ∃ m : M.obj a, (π.app a).hom m = n ∧ structureMapLinear M hab m = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have : FiniteDimensional k (L.obj a) :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_injective (ι.app a).hom (hs.injective a)
  have : FiniteDimensional k (N.obj a) :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_surjective (π.app a).hom (hs.surjective a)
  have hdim := shortExact_finrank ι π hs a
  have hkernel := kernelMap_rank_formula ι π hs hab
  have hL := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (structureMapLinear L hab)
  have hM := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (structureMapLinear M hab)
  have hN := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker (structureMapLinear N hab)
  constructor
  · intro hr n hn
    have hfull : LinearMap.range (kernelMap π hab) = ⊤ := by
      apply Submodule.eq_top_of_finrank_eq
      omega
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp hfull) ⟨n, hn⟩
    exact ⟨m.val, congrArg Subtype.val hm, m.property⟩
  · intro hlift
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective (kernelMap π hab) := by
      intro n
      obtain ⟨m, hm, hdie⟩ := hlift n.val n.property
      exact ⟨⟨m, hdie⟩, Subtype.ext hm⟩
    have hfull := LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj
    have hdimrange : Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range (kernelMap π hab)) =
        Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear N hab)) := by
      rw [hfull, finrank_top]
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankExact.lift_kernel
statement:
theorem IsRankExact.lift_kernel {ι : L ⟶ M} {π : M ⟶ N} (hs : IsRankExact ι π)
    {a b : P} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (n : N.obj a) (hn : structureMapLinear N hab n = 0) :
    ∃ m : M.obj a, (π.app a).hom m = n ∧ structureMapLinear M hab m = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := hs.finiteDimensional a
  exact (hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact.rank_add_iff_lift_kernel hab).mp (hs.rank_add hab) n hn

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.rankExact_of_section
statement:
theorem IsPointwiseShortExact.rankExact_of_section
    {ι : L ⟶ M} {π : M ⟶ N} (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π)
    [∀ a, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj a)]
    (σ : N ⟶ M) (hσ : σ ≫ π = 𝟙 N) : IsRankExact ι π where
  toIsPointwiseShortExact
proof:
:= hs
  finiteDimensional _ := inferInstance
  rank_add := by
    intro a b hab
    apply (hs.rank_add_iff_lift_kernel hab).mpr
    intro n hn
    refine ⟨(σ.app a).hom n, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have he := congrArg (fun f : N ⟶ N => (f.app a).hom n) hσ
      exact he
    · have he := congrArg (fun f : N.obj a ⟶ M.obj b => f.hom n)
        (σ.naturality (homOfLE hab))
      change (σ.app b).hom (structureMapLinear N hab n) =
        structureMapLinear M hab ((σ.app a).hom n) at he
      rw [hn, map_zero] at he
      exact he.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.IsPointwiseShortExact.reindex
statement:
theorem IsPointwiseShortExact.reindex {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q]
    {ι : L ⟶ M} {π : M ⟶ N} (hs : IsPointwiseShortExact ι π) (f : Q →o P) :
    IsPointwiseShortExact (reindexNatTrans f ι) (reindexNatTrans f π) where
  injective q
proof:
:= hs.injective (f q)
  surjective q := hs.surjective (f q)
  range_eq_ker q := hs.range_eq_ker (f q)

name: TDA.Persistence.IsRankExact.reindex
statement:
theorem IsRankExact.reindex {Q : Type x} [Preorder Q]
    {ι : L ⟶ M} {π : M ⟶ N} (hs : IsRankExact ι π) (f : Q →o P) :
    IsRankExact (reindexNatTrans f ι) (reindexNatTrans f π) where
  toIsPointwiseShortExact
proof:
:= hs.toIsPointwiseShortExact.reindex f
  finiteDimensional q := hs.finiteDimensional (f q)
  rank_add hab := hs.rank_add (f.monotone hab)

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (d e : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ)
    {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ A B : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (w : Weight A B)
    (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ)) (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖finiteDiagramImage σ w P (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        finiteDiagramImage σ w P (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n)‖ ≤
      stabilityConstant σ A B *
        ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
          Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) *
            Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := bottleneck_dgm_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy k d e n
  have hfinite : bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n) < ⊤ :=
    hbound.trans_lt ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top
  have hreal : (bottleneck (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n)
      (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n)).toReal ≤ Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy_nonneg d e)] using
      ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hbound
  exact (norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_card_mul_bottleneck hσ hA hB w P hm hd _ _
    (dgm_isPositive k _ n) (dgm_isPositive k _ n) hfinite).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hreal (by
        exact mul_nonneg (stabilityConstant_nonneg hσ hA hB) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)))

name: TDA.Persistence.CutSubspacesExamples.support_before_after
statement:
theorem support_before_after (a b : ℝ) :
    support (cutBefore a) (cutAfter b) = Set.Icc a b
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [support, cutBefore, cutAfter]

name: TDA.Persistence.CutSubspacesExamples.support_after_before
statement:
theorem support_after_before (a b : ℝ) :
    support (cutAfter a) (cutBefore b) = Set.Ioo a b
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [support, cutBefore, cutAfter]

name: TDA.Persistence.CutSubspacesExamples.support_before_after_singleton
statement:
theorem support_before_after_singleton (a : ℝ) :
    support (cutBefore a) (cutAfter a) = {a}
proof:
:= by
  simp [support_before_after]

name: TDA.Persistence.CutSubspacesExamples.support_before_after_empty_of_reversed
statement:
theorem support_before_after_empty_of_reversed {a b : ℝ} (hba : b < a) :
    support (cutBefore a) (cutAfter b) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [support_before_after]
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_Icc, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
  intro hx
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hx.1.trans hx.2)) hba

name: TDA.Persistence.CutSubspacesExamples.ephemeralModule_pfd
statement:
theorem ephemeralModule_pfd (t : ℝ) :
    FiniteDimensional ℚ (ephemeralModule.obj t)
proof:
:= by
  change FiniteDimensional ℚ ℚ
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.CutSubspacesExamples.ephemeralModule_strict_map_zero
statement:
theorem ephemeralModule_strict_map_zero {s t : ℝ} (h : s < t) :
    structureMapLinear ephemeralModule h.le = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [structureMapLinear, structureMap, ephemeralModule, ne_of_lt h]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CutSubspacesExamples.ephemeralModule_self_map
statement:
theorem ephemeralModule_self_map (t : ℝ) :
    structureMapLinear ephemeralModule (le_rfl : t ≤ t) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  simp [structureMapLinear, structureMap, ephemeralModule]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CutSubspacesExamples.ephemeral_imagePlus_singleton_eq_top
statement:
theorem ephemeral_imagePlus_singleton_eq_top (t : ℝ) :
    imagePlus ephemeralModule (cutBefore t) t = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  simp only [imagePlus, Submodule.mem_iInf]
  intro s
  have hst : s.val = t := le_antisymm s.property.2 (by
    simpa [cutBefore] using s.property.1)
  have hmap : structureMapLinear ephemeralModule s.property.2 = LinearMap.id := by
    simp [structureMapLinear, structureMap, ephemeralModule, ← hst]
    rfl
  rw [hmap]
  exact ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CutSubspacesExamples.ephemeral_imageMinus_singleton_eq_bot
statement:
theorem ephemeral_imageMinus_singleton_eq_bot (t : ℝ) :
    imageMinus ephemeralModule (cutBefore t) t = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [imageMinus]
    apply iSup_le
    intro s
    have hst : s.val < t := s.property.1
    rw [ephemeralModule_strict_map_zero hst]
    simp
  · exact bot_le

name: TDA.Persistence.CutSubspacesExamples.ephemeral_kernelPlus_singleton_eq_top
statement:
theorem ephemeral_kernelPlus_singleton_eq_top (t : ℝ) :
    kernelPlus ephemeralModule (cutAfter t) t = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  apply top_unique
  intro x _
  simp only [kernelPlus, Submodule.mem_iInf]
  intro s
  have hts : t < s.val := by simpa [cutAfter] using s.property.1
  rw [ephemeralModule_strict_map_zero hts, LinearMap.mem_ker]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.CutSubspacesExamples.ephemeral_kernelMinus_singleton_eq_bot
statement:
theorem ephemeral_kernelMinus_singleton_eq_bot (t : ℝ) :
    kernelMinus ephemeralModule (cutAfter t) t = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [kernelMinus]
    apply iSup_le
    intro s
    have hst : s.val = t := le_antisymm (by
      simpa [cutAfter] using s.property.1) s.property.2
    have hmap : structureMapLinear ephemeralModule s.property.2 = LinearMap.id := by
      simp [structureMapLinear, structureMap, ephemeralModule, ← hst]
      rfl
    rw [hmap]
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : LinearMap.id x = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hx
    change x = 0
    simpa only [LinearMap.id_apply] using hx0
  · exact bot_le

name: TDA.Persistence.CutSubspacesExamples.ephemeral_singleton_interval_spaces
statement:
theorem ephemeral_singleton_interval_spaces (t : ℝ) :
    intervalPlus ephemeralModule (cutBefore t) (cutAfter t) t = ⊤ ∧
      intervalMinus ephemeralModule (cutBefore t) (cutAfter t) t = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp [intervalPlus, ephemeral_imagePlus_singleton_eq_top,
      ephemeral_kernelPlus_singleton_eq_top]
  · simp [intervalMinus, ephemeral_imagePlus_singleton_eq_top,
      ephemeral_imageMinus_singleton_eq_bot, ephemeral_kernelPlus_singleton_eq_top,
      ephemeral_kernelMinus_singleton_eq_bot]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.theta_forward
statement: private theorem theta_forward (i : Fin 4) : i ≤ theta i
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> decide

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.theta_positive
statement: private theorem theta_positive (i : Fin 4) : 1 ≤ (theta i).val
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i <;> decide

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.noninjective_translation
statement:
theorem noninjective_translation : theta 0 = 1 ∧ theta 1 = 1 ∧
    ¬ Function.Injective theta
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro h
  have he := h (show theta 0 = theta 1 from rfl)
  have := congrArg Fin.val he
  norm_num at this

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.singleton_count
statement:
private theorem singleton_count (I : FiniteInterval 4) (p : FiniteInterval 4 → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] : ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4)).countP p = if p I then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.cons_zero, Multiset.countP_cons]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.single_barcode
statement:
private theorem single_barcode (I : FiniteInterval 4) :
    rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I) = {I}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) {I}) := by
      apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff _ _).mpr
      intro i j hij
      rw [rank_barcodeMap]
      change Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range (intervalMap (k := ℚ) I hij)) = _
      rw [intervalMap_finrank_range]
      simp only [interval_alive_endpoints_iff I hij, singleton_count]
    _ = {I} := rankBarcode_barcodeModule _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.single_occurrence
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := Multiset.mem_toList.mp
    (List.get_mem (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)).toList a)
  change occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈
    rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I) at hmem
  have hm : occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈
      ({I} : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4)) :=
    Eq.mp (congrArg (fun B : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4) =>
      occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) I)) a ∈ B) (single_barcode I)) hmem
  exact Multiset.mem_singleton.mp hm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.fiber_le
statement:
private theorem fiber_le (I J : FiniteInterval 4) (hb : J.birth ≤ I.birth)
    (hd : I.death = J.death) (i : Fin 4) : I.fiber (k := ℚ) i ≤ J.fiber (k := ℚ) i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (if I.alive i then (⊤ : Submodule ℚ ℚ) else ⊥) ≤
    (if J.alive i then (⊤ : Submodule ℚ ℚ) else ⊥)
  by_cases hi : I.alive i
  · have hj : J.alive i := ⟨hb.trans hi.1, hi.2.trans_eq hd⟩
    rw [if_pos hi, if_pos hj]
  · rw [if_neg hi]
    exact bot_le

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.inclusion_injective
statement:
private theorem inclusion_injective (I J : FiniteInterval 4) (hb : J.birth ≤ I.birth)
    (hd : I.death = J.death) (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective ((inclusion I J hb hd).app i).hom
proof:
:=
  Submodule.inclusion_injective (fiber_le I J hb hd i)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.inclusion_surjective
proof:
:= by
  have halive : I.alive i ↔ J.alive i := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨hb.trans h.1, h.2.trans_eq hd⟩
    · intro h
      exact ⟨hi, h.2.trans_eq hd.symm⟩
  have he : I.fiber (k := ℚ) i = J.fiber (k := ℚ) i := by
    classical
    unfold FiniteInterval.fiber
    by_cases h : I.alive i
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (halive.mp h)]
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hj => h (halive.mpr hj))]
  intro y
  exact ⟨⟨y.val, he.symm ▸ y.property⟩, Subtype.ext rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.delayed_injective
statement:
private theorem delayed_injective (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 < d) (hs : d ≤ 4) (i : Fin 4) :
    Function.Injective ((delayed d hd hs).app i).hom
proof:
:=
  inclusion_injective _ _ _ _ i

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.delayed_short
statement:
private theorem delayed_short (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 < d) (hs : d ≤ 4) :
    TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteCokernel (delayed d hd hs))
proof:
:= by
  apply (cokernel_translationTrivial_iff theta theta_forward _).mpr
  intro i
  have hsurj := inclusion_surjective (late d hd hs) (early d hd hs) (by change (0 : ℕ) ≤ 1; decide) rfl
    (theta i) (theta_positive i)
  change Function.Surjective ((delayed d hd hs).app (theta i)).hom at hsurj
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj]
  exact le_top

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.finite_birth_bound_attained
statement:
theorem finite_birth_bound_attained :
    ∃ i : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) (late 3 (by decide) (by decide)))),
      (occurrence _ i).birth = 1 ∧
      (occurrence _ (monoEmbedding (delayed 3 (by decide) (by decide))
        (delayed_injective 3 (by decide) (by decide)) i)).birth = 0 ∧
      (occurrence _ i).birth =
        (theta (occurrence _ (monoEmbedding (delayed 3 (by decide) (by decide))
          (delayed_injective 3 (by decide) (by decide)) i)).birthStage).val ∧
      deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) (early 3 (by decide) (by decide)))) 0 3 ≤
        deathPrefixCount (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) (late 3 (by decide) (by decide)))) 1 3
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) (late 3 (by decide) (by decide)))).toList.length = 1 := by
    rw [single_barcode]; simp
  let i : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) (late 3 (by decide) (by decide)))) :=
    ⟨0, by omega⟩
  refine ⟨i, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [single_occurrence]; rfl
  · rw [single_occurrence]; rfl
  · rw [single_occurrence, single_occurrence]; rfl
  · exact deathPrefixCount_le_translated_of_cokernelTrivial theta theta_forward
      (delayed 3 (by decide) (by decide)) (delayed_injective 3 (by decide) (by decide))
        (delayed_short 3 (by decide) (by decide)) 0 3 (by decide) (by decide)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.terminal_coverage
statement:
theorem terminal_coverage :
    ∀ a : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) (early 4 (by decide) (by decide)))),
      (occurrence _ a).death = 4 ∧
        ∃! i, monoEmbedding (delayed 4 (by decide) (by decide))
          (delayed_injective 4 (by decide) (by decide)) i = a
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  refine ⟨congrArg FiniteInterval.death (single_occurrence _ a), ?_⟩
  apply monoEmbedding_covers_long_of_cokernelTrivial theta theta_forward
    (delayed 4 (by decide) (by decide)) (delayed_injective 4 (by decide) (by decide))
      (delayed_short 4 (by decide) (by decide)) a
  rw [single_occurrence]
  decide

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.short_injective
statement: private theorem short_injective (i : Fin 4) : Function.Injective (shortInclusion.app i).hom
proof:
:= by
  intro x y _
  have hlen : (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4)).toList.length = 0 := by simp
  apply funext
  intro t
  have ht := t.isLt
  change t.val < (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4)).toList.length at ht
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.short_cokernel
statement:
private theorem short_cokernel :
    TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteCokernel shortInclusion)
proof:
:= by
  apply (cokernel_translationTrivial_iff theta theta_forward _).mpr
  intro i y _
  have hdead : ¬ shortBar.alive (theta i) := by
    have := theta_positive i
    simp only [FiniteInterval.alive, shortBar] at *
    omega
  have : Subsingleton (shortTarget.obj (theta i)) := by
    change Subsingleton (shortBar.fiber (k := ℚ) (theta i))
    simpa [FiniteInterval.fiber, hdead] using
      (inferInstance : Subsingleton (↥(⊥ : Submodule ℚ ℚ)))
  have hy : y = 0 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [hy]
  exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.threshold_unmatched
statement:
theorem threshold_unmatched :
    TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteCokernel shortInclusion) ∧
      ∀ a : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode shortTarget),
        (occurrence _ a).death = (theta (occurrence _ a).birthStage).val ∧
          a ∉ Set.range (monoEmbedding shortInclusion short_injective)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨short_cokernel, ?_⟩
  intro a
  constructor
  · change (occurrence (rankBarcode (intervalModule (k := ℚ) shortBar)) a).death = _
    rw [single_occurrence]; rfl
  · rintro ⟨i, _⟩
    have hlen : (rankBarcode zeroModule).toList.length = 0 := by
      change (rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) (0 : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4)))).toList.length = 0
      rw [rankBarcode_barcodeModule]; simp
    have := i.isLt
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.identity_short
statement:
private theorem identity_short (K : PModule.{0,0,0} ℚ (Fin 4)) :
    TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteCokernel (𝟙 K))
proof:
:= by
  apply (cokernel_translationTrivial_iff theta theta_forward _).mpr
  intro i
  change _ ≤ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : K.obj (theta i) →ₗ[ℚ] K.obj (theta i))
  rw [LinearMap.range_id]
  exact le_top

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.short_matched_birth_bound
statement:
theorem short_matched_birth_bound :
    ∃ a : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode shortTarget),
      (occurrence _ a).death = (theta (occurrence _ a).birthStage).val ∧
      (occurrence _ a).birth ≤ (theta (occurrence _ a).birthStage).val ∧
      monoEmbedding (𝟙 shortTarget) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) a = a
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (rankBarcode shortTarget).toList.length = 1 := by
    rw [single_barcode]; simp
  let a : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode shortTarget) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  have hb := monoEmbedding_birth_bounds_of_cokernelTrivial theta theta_forward
    (𝟙 shortTarget) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) (identity_short shortTarget) a
  refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [single_occurrence]; rfl
  · simpa only [monoEmbedding_id, Function.Embedding.refl_apply] using hb.2
  · rw [monoEmbedding_id]; rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.duplicate_long_coverage
statement:
theorem duplicate_long_coverage :
    ∃ a b : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode duplicates), a ≠ b ∧
      (∃! i, monoEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) i = a) ∧
      (∃! i, monoEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) i = b)
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : (rankBarcode duplicates).toList.length = 2 := by
    change (rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ) (Multiset.replicate 2 _))).toList.length = 2
    rw [rankBarcode_barcodeModule]; simp
  let a : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode duplicates) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let b : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode duplicates) := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  have hlong (x : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode duplicates)) :
      (theta (occurrence (rankBarcode duplicates) x).birthStage).val <
        (occurrence (rankBarcode duplicates) x).death := by
    have hm := Multiset.mem_toList.mp (List.get_mem (rankBarcode duplicates).toList x)
    change occurrence (rankBarcode duplicates) x ∈ rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := ℚ)
      (Multiset.replicate 2 (early 4 (by decide) (by decide)))) at hm
    have hm' : occurrence (rankBarcode duplicates) x ∈
        Multiset.replicate 2 (early 4 (by decide) (by decide)) :=
      Eq.mp (congrArg (fun B : Multiset (FiniteInterval 4) =>
        occurrence (rankBarcode duplicates) x ∈ B)
          (rankBarcode_barcodeModule (k := ℚ) _)) hm
    have hx := (Multiset.mem_replicate.mp hm').2
    rw [hx]
    decide
  refine ⟨a, b, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    norm_num [a, b] at this
  · exact monoEmbedding_covers_long_of_cokernelTrivial theta theta_forward
      (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) (identity_short duplicates) a (hlong a)
  · exact monoEmbedding_covers_long_of_cokernelTrivial theta theta_forward
      (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) (identity_short duplicates) b (hlong b)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.identity_translation
statement:
theorem identity_translation :
    ∀ a : BarcodeOccurrence 4 (rankBarcode duplicates),
      (occurrence _ (monoEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) a)).birth =
        (occurrence _ a).birth ∧
      ∃! i, monoEmbedding (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) i = a
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  have hc : TranslationTrivial OrderHom.id (fun i : Fin 4 => le_rfl)
      (finiteCokernel (𝟙 duplicates)) := by
    apply (cokernel_translationTrivial_iff _ _ _).mpr
    intro i
    change _ ≤ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.id : duplicates.obj i →ₗ[ℚ] duplicates.obj i)
    rw [LinearMap.range_id]
    exact le_top
  have hb := monoEmbedding_birth_bounds_of_cokernelTrivial OrderHom.id
    (fun i : Fin 4 => le_rfl) (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) hc a
  refine ⟨Nat.le_antisymm hb.1 hb.2, ?_⟩
  exact monoEmbedding_covers_long_of_cokernelTrivial OrderHom.id
    (fun i : Fin 4 => le_rfl) (𝟙 duplicates) (fun _ => Function.injective_id) hc a
      (occurrence _ a).birth_lt_death

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteMonoTranslationExamples.fixed_point_rejects_shortness
statement:
theorem fixed_point_rejects_shortness :
    ¬ TranslationTrivial theta theta_forward (finiteCokernel fixedInclusion)
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have himg := (cokernel_translationTrivial_iff theta theta_forward fixedInclusion).mp hc 1
  let v : fixedTarget.obj (1 : Fin 4) := ⟨1, by
    simp [FiniteInterval.fiber, FiniteInterval.alive, fixedBar]⟩
  have hv : v ∈ LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear fixedTarget (theta_forward 1)) := by
    refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
    change structureMapLinear fixedTarget (show (1 : Fin 4) ≤ 1 from le_rfl) v = v
    rw [structureMapLinear_self]
    rfl
  have hz := himg hv
  change v ∈ LinearMap.range (0 : zeroModule.obj (1 : Fin 4) →ₗ[ℚ] fixedTarget.obj 1) at hz
  rw [LinearMap.range_zero] at hz
  have he : v = 0 := hz
  have := congrArg Subtype.val he
  norm_num [v] at this

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_c1
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_c1 {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalDiagramLift B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) :
    ∃ U : Set E, IsOpen U ∧ x ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ L.carrier ∧
      ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (V ∘ B) U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hWopen, hzW, hW⟩ := hV m n (L.coordinates x)
    (L.factorization x hx).symm
  let U := L.carrier ∩ L.coordinates ⁻¹' W
  have hUopen : IsOpen U :=
    L.smooth.continuousOn.isOpen_inter_preimage L.isOpen_carrier hWopen
  have hcomp : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ((V ∘ orderedQ m n) ∘ L.coordinates) U :=
    hW.comp (L.smooth.mono Set.inter_subset_left) Set.inter_subset_right
  refine ⟨U, hUopen, ⟨hx, hzW⟩, Set.inter_subset_left, ?_⟩
  apply hcomp.congr
  intro y hy
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [L.factorization y hy.1]

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_hasFDerivAt {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalDiagramLift B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) :
    HasFDerivAt (V ∘ B)
      ((fderiv ℝ (V ∘ orderedQ m n) (L.coordinates x)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ L.coordinates x)) x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W, hWopen, hzW, hW⟩ := hV m n (L.coordinates x)
    (L.factorization x hx).symm
  have hl : DifferentiableAt ℝ L.coordinates x :=
    (L.smooth.contDiffAt (L.isOpen_carrier.mem_nhds hx)).differentiableAt_one
  have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ (V ∘ orderedQ m n) (L.coordinates x) :=
    (hW.contDiffAt (hWopen.mem_nhds hzW)).differentiableAt_one
  have hcomp := (hg.hasFDerivAt.comp x hl.hasFDerivAt)
  apply hcomp.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [L.isOpen_carrier.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [L.factorization y hy]

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_fderiv
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_fderiv {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ) (m n : ℕ)
    (L : LocalDiagramLift B m n) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ L.carrier)
    (hV : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) :
    fderiv ℝ (V ∘ B) x =
      (fderiv ℝ (V ∘ orderedQ m n) (L.coordinates x)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ L.coordinates x)
proof:
:=
  (localLift_scalar_hasFDerivAt B V m n L x hx hV).fderiv

name: TDA.Persistence.localLift_scalar_derivative_independent
statement:
theorem localLift_scalar_derivative_independent
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    (B : E → Diagram ℝ) (V : Diagram ℝ → ℝ)
    (m n m' n' : ℕ) (L : LocalDiagramLift B m n)
    (L' : LocalDiagramLift B m' n') (x : E)
    (hx : x ∈ L.carrier) (hx' : x ∈ L'.carrier)
    (hV : C1ThroughAllRepresentatives V (B x)) :
    (fderiv ℝ (V ∘ orderedQ m n) (L.coordinates x)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ L.coordinates x) =
      (fderiv ℝ (V ∘ orderedQ m' n') (L'.coordinates x)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ L'.coordinates x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← localLift_scalar_fderiv B V m n L x hx hV,
    ← localLift_scalar_fderiv B V m' n' L' x hx' hV]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.exists_uniform_fitting_complement
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_fitting_complement (X : PModule.{u,0,u} k P)
    (hX : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (X.obj p)) (f : End X) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, 0 < n ∧ ∀ p,
      IsCompl (LinearMap.ker ((f.app p).hom ^ n))
        (LinearMap.range ((f.app p).hom ^ n))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (X.obj p) := hX
  have hEventually (p : P) :
      ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop,
        IsCompl (LinearMap.ker ((f.app p).hom ^ n))
          (LinearMap.range ((f.app p).hom ^ n)) := by
    exact ((f.app p).hom).eventually_isCompl_ker_pow_range_pow
  choose b hb using fun p => (Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (hEventually p))
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.sup b + 1, Nat.succ_pos _, ?_⟩
  intro p
  exact hb p (Finset.univ.sup b + 1)
    (le_trans (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ p)) (Nat.le_succ _))

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.natTrans_apply
statement:
private theorem natTrans_apply {A B : PModule.{u,0,u} k P} (f : A ⟶ B)

    (f.app q).hom ((A.map hpq).hom x) =
      (B.map hpq).hom ((f.app p).hom x)
proof:
:= by
  exact congrArg (fun g : A.obj p ⟶ B.obj q => g.hom x) (f.naturality hpq)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.split_apply
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun g : End A => (g.app p).hom a) h

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.isZero_obj_of_isZero
statement:
private theorem isZero_obj_of_isZero {A : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (hA : IsZero A) (p : P) : IsZero (A.obj p)
proof:
:= by
  apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
  simpa using congrArg (fun g : End A => g.app p)
    ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero A).mp hA)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.indecomposable_retract_iso
proof:
:= by
  let K := splitKernelDiagram ret
  have hsplit : B ≅ A ⊞ K := splitBiproductIso inc ret h
  rcases hB.2 A K hsplit with hA0 | hK
  · exact (hA.1 hA0).elim
  · have hKfiber (p : P) : IsZero (K.obj p) := isZero_obj_of_isZero hK p
    have hkerbot (p : P) : LinearMap.ker (ret.app p).hom = ⊥ := by
      have hs : Subsingleton (LinearMap.ker (ret.app p).hom) := by
        simpa [K, splitKernelDiagram] using
          (ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton).mp (hKfiber p)
      exact (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).2 (by
        intro x hx
        exact congrArg Subtype.val (hs.elim ⟨x, hx⟩ 0))
    have hInjective (p : P) : Function.Injective (ret.app p).hom :=
      (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot).mp (hkerbot p)
    have hSurjective (p : P) : Function.Surjective (ret.app p).hom := by
      intro a
      exact ⟨(inc.app p).hom a, split_apply inc ret h p a⟩
    have hIso (p : P) : IsIso (ret.app p) :=
      (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective (ret.app p)).mpr
        ⟨hInjective p, hSurjective p⟩
    letI (p : P) : IsIso (ret.app p) := hIso p
    letI : IsIso ret := NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app ret
    exact ⟨(asIso ret).symm⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.natTrans_app_hom_pow
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [Module.End.one_eq_id]
  | succ n ih =>
      simp [pow_succ, End.mul_def, NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp,
        Module.End.mul_eq_comp, ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.indecomposable_endomorphism_dichotomy
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (X.obj p) := hfd
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hfit⟩ := exists_uniform_fitting_complement X hfd f
  let g : End X := f ^ n
  have hfitg (p : P) : IsCompl (LinearMap.ker (g.app p).hom)
      (LinearMap.range (g.app p).hom) := by
    simpa [g, natTrans_app_hom_pow] using hfit p
  let K := kernelSubmoduleDiagram g
  let I := rangeSubmoduleDiagram g
  have hdec : X ≅ K ⊞ I := fittingBiproductIso g hfitg
  rcases hX.2 K I hdec with hK | hI
  · have hKfiber (p : P) : IsZero (K.obj p) := isZero_obj_of_isZero hK p
    have hkerbot (p : P) : LinearMap.ker (g.app p).hom = ⊥ := by
      have hs : Subsingleton (LinearMap.ker (g.app p).hom) := by
        simpa [K, kernelSubmoduleDiagram] using
          (ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton).mp (hKfiber p)
      exact (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).2 (by
      intro x hx
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (hs.elim ⟨x, hx⟩ 0))
    have hgInjective (p : P) : Function.Injective (g.app p).hom :=
      (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot).mp (by simpa [g, natTrans_app_hom_pow] using hkerbot p)
    have hInjective (p : P) : Function.Injective (f.app p).hom := by
      rcases n with _ | n'
      · exact (Nat.not_lt_zero _ hn).elim
      · intro x y hxy
        apply hgInjective p
        simp [g, pow_succ, hxy]
    have hIso (p : P) : IsIso (f.app p) :=
      (ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective (f.app p)).mpr
        ⟨hInjective p, LinearMap.surjective_of_injective (hInjective p)⟩
    letI (p : P) : IsIso (f.app p) := hIso p
    letI : IsIso f := NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app f
    exact Or.inl inferInstance
  · have hIfiber (p : P) : IsZero (I.obj p) := isZero_obj_of_isZero hI p
    have hrangebot (p : P) : LinearMap.range (g.app p).hom = ⊥ := by
      have hs : Subsingleton (LinearMap.range (g.app p).hom) := by
        simpa [I, rangeSubmoduleDiagram] using
          (ModuleCat.isZero_iff_subsingleton).mp (hIfiber p)
      exact (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).2 fun x hx =>
        congrArg Subtype.val (hs.elim ⟨x, hx⟩ 0)
    have happ (p : P) : (g.app p).hom = 0 :=
      (LinearMap.range_eq_bot).mp (hrangebot p)
    have hg0 : g = 0 := by
      apply NatTrans.ext
      funext p
      exact ModuleCat.hom_ext (happ p)
    exact Or.inr ⟨n, by simpa [g] using hg0⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.indecomposable_sum_eq_one_has_isIso
proof:
:= by
  rcases indecomposable_endomorphism_dichotomy hX hfd a with ha | ⟨n, hn⟩
  · exact Or.inl ha
  · have hnil : IsNilpotent a := ⟨n, hn⟩
    have hb : b = 1 - a := by
      calc
        b = a + b - a := by simp
        _ = 1 - a := by rw [hab]
    have hunit : IsUnit b := by
      rw [hb]
      exact hnil.isUnit_one_sub
    exact Or.inr (CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso b |>.mp hunit)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.indecomposable_sum_isIso
proof:
:= by
  letI : IsIso (a + b) := hab
  let c : End X := inv (a + b)
  have hsum : c * a + c * b = 𝟙 X := by
    calc
      c * a + c * b = c * (a + b) := by rw [← mul_add]
      _ = (a + b) ≫ c := by rw [CategoryTheory.End.mul_def]
      _ = 𝟙 X := by simp [c]
  rcases indecomposable_sum_eq_one_has_isIso hX hfd (c * a) (c * b) hsum with hca | hcb
  · have hc : IsUnit c := (CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso c).mpr (by dsimp [c]; infer_instance)
    have hcaUnit : IsUnit (c * a) := (CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso (c * a)).mpr hca
    exact Or.inl <| (CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso a).mp (hc.mul_left_iff.mp hcaUnit)
  · have hc : IsUnit c := (CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso c).mpr (by dsimp [c]; infer_instance)
    have hcbUnit : IsUnit (c * b) := (CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso (c * b)).mpr hcb
    exact Or.inr <| (CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso b).mp (hc.mul_left_iff.mp hcbUnit)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.indecomposable_finset_sum_isIso
statement:
private theorem indecomposable_finset_sum_isIso {X : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (hX : Indecomposable X) (hfd : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (X.obj p))
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → End X)
    (hsum : IsIso (∑ i ∈ s, a i)) : ∃ i ∈ s, IsIso (a i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      have hzero : IsIso (0 : End X) := by simpa using hsum
      letI : IsIso (0 : End X) := hzero
      have hid : (𝟙 X : End X) = 0 := by
        calc
          𝟙 X = (0 : End X) ≫ inv (0 : End X) :=
            (IsIso.hom_inv_id (0 : End X)).symm
          _ = 0 := zero_comp
      exact (hX.1 ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero X).mpr hid)).elim
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      have hsum' : IsIso (a i + ∑ j ∈ s, a j) := by
        simpa [Finset.sum_insert, hi] using hsum
      rcases indecomposable_sum_isIso hX hfd (a i) (∑ j ∈ s, a j) hsum' with hiIso | hsIso
      · exact ⟨i, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _, hiIso⟩
      · rcases ih hsIso with ⟨j, hjs, hjIso⟩
        exact ⟨j, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hjs, hjIso⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.indecomposable_biproduct_summand
statement:
theorem indecomposable_biproduct_summand {X : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k P)
    (hX : Indecomposable X) (hfd : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (X.obj p))
    (hF : ∀ i, Indecomposable (F i))
    (inc : X ⟶ ⨁ F) (ret : ⨁ F ⟶ X) (hret : inc ≫ ret = 𝟙 X) :
    ∃ i, Nonempty (X ≅ F i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a (i : ι) : End X :=
    (inc ≫ biproduct.π F i) ≫ (biproduct.ι F i ≫ ret)
  have hsum : ∑ i, a i = 𝟙 X := by
    calc
      ∑ i, a i = inc ≫ (∑ i, biproduct.π F i ≫ biproduct.ι F i) ≫ ret := by
        calc
          ∑ i, a i = ∑ i, inc ≫ biproduct.π F i ≫ biproduct.ι F i ≫ ret := by
            apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
            intro i hi
            simp [a, Category.assoc]
          _ = inc ≫ (∑ i, biproduct.π F i ≫ biproduct.ι F i) ≫ ret := by
            symm
            rw [← Category.assoc, Preadditive.comp_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp]
            simp only [Category.assoc]
      _ = inc ≫ 𝟙 (⨁ F) ≫ ret := by
        have htotal : (∑ i : ι, biproduct.π F i ≫ biproduct.ι F i) =
            𝟙 (⨁ F) := biproduct.total (f := F)
        exact congrArg (fun t : End (⨁ F) => inc ≫ t ≫ ret) htotal
      _ = 𝟙 X := by simpa using hret
  have hsumIso : IsIso (∑ i, a i) := by rw [hsum]; infer_instance
  obtain ⟨i, -, hai⟩ := indecomposable_finset_sum_isIso hX hfd Finset.univ a hsumIso
  let α : X ⟶ F i := inc ≫ biproduct.π F i
  let β : F i ⟶ X := biproduct.ι F i ≫ ret
  have hab : α ≫ β = a i := rfl
  letI : IsIso (α ≫ β) := by rw [hab]; exact hai
  let retIso : F i ⟶ X := β ≫ inv (α ≫ β)
  have hsplit : α ≫ retIso = 𝟙 X := by
    dsimp [retIso]
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    exact IsIso.hom_inv_id (α ≫ β)
  exact ⟨i, indecomposable_retract_iso hX (hF i) α retIso hsplit⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.biproduct_inclusions_linearIndependent
statement:
private theorem biproduct_inclusions_linearIndependent
    {ι J : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype J]
    (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (j : J → ι) (hj : Function.Injective j)
    (p : P) (x : ∀ t, (F (j t)).obj p) (hx : ∀ t, x t ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent k (fun t =>
      ((biproduct.ι F (j t)).app p).hom (x t))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iffₛ]
  intro f g h
  intro t
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun z => ((biproduct.π F (j t)).app p).hom z) h
  have hdiag :
      ((biproduct.π F (j t)).app p).hom
          (((biproduct.ι F (j t)).app p).hom (x t)) = x t := by
    change ((biproduct.ι F (j t) ≫ biproduct.π F (j t)).app p).hom (x t) = x t
    rw [biproduct.ι_π_self]
    simp
  have hproject (c : J → k) :
      ((biproduct.π F (j t)).app p).hom
          (∑ s, c s • ((biproduct.ι F (j s)).app p).hom (x s)) = c t • x t := by
    rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_single t]
    · simp [hdiag]
    · intro s hs hst
      have hne : j s ≠ j t := fun hEq => hst (hj hEq)
      have hz :
          ((biproduct.π F (j t)).app p).hom
            (((biproduct.ι F (j s)).app p).hom (x s)) = 0 := by
        change ((biproduct.ι F (j s) ≫ biproduct.π F (j t)).app p).hom (x s) = 0
        rw [biproduct.ι_π_ne F hne]
        simp
      simp [hz]
    · intro ht
      exact (ht (Finset.mem_univ t)).elim
  have hmul : f t • x t = g t • x t := by
    rw [← hproject f, ← hproject g]
    exact hcoord
  exact smul_left_injective k (hx t) hmul

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.sum_biprod_left
statement:
private theorem sum_biprod_left {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (G : κ → PModule.{u,0,u} k P) :
    (∑ i, (biprod.fst (X := ⨁ F) (Y := ⨁ G) ≫ biproduct.π F i) ≫
        (biproduct.ι F i ≫ biprod.inl (X := ⨁ F) (Y := ⨁ G))) =
      biprod.fst (X := ⨁ F) (Y := ⨁ G) ≫
        (∑ i, biproduct.π F i ≫ biproduct.ι F i) ≫
          biprod.inl (X := ⨁ F) (Y := ⨁ G)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  rw [← Category.assoc, Preadditive.comp_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.sum_biprod_right
statement:
private theorem sum_biprod_right {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (F : ι → PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (G : κ → PModule.{u,0,u} k P) :
    (∑ j, (biprod.snd (X := ⨁ F) (Y := ⨁ G) ≫ biproduct.π G j) ≫
        (biproduct.ι G j ≫ biprod.inr (X := ⨁ F) (Y := ⨁ G))) =
      biprod.snd (X := ⨁ F) (Y := ⨁ G) ≫
        (∑ j, biproduct.π G j ≫ biproduct.ι G j) ≫
          biprod.inr (X := ⨁ F) (Y := ⨁ G)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  rw [← Category.assoc, Preadditive.comp_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.sum_biprod_right_obj
statement:
private theorem sum_biprod_right_obj (X : PModule.{u,0,u} k P)
    {κ : Type} [Fintype κ] (G : κ → PModule.{u,0,u} k P) :
    (∑ j, (biprod.snd (X := X) (Y := ⨁ G) ≫ biproduct.π G j) ≫
        (biproduct.ι G j ≫ biprod.inr (X := X) (Y := ⨁ G))) =
      biprod.snd (X := X) (Y := ⨁ G) ≫
        (∑ j, biproduct.π G j ≫ biproduct.ι G j) ≫
          biprod.inr (X := X) (Y := ⨁ G)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  rw [← Category.assoc, Preadditive.comp_sum, Preadditive.sum_comp]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.biproduct_split_fin_succ_inl_hom
proof:
:= by
  apply biproduct.hom_ext
  intro j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) j <;>
    simp [biproduct_split_fin_succ, biproduct.uniqueUpToIso,
      Category.assoc, biproduct.lift_π,
      biproduct.ι_π_ne _ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.biproduct_split_fin_succ_inv_fst
proof:
:= by
  apply biproduct.hom_ext'
  intro i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) i <;>
    simp [biproduct_split_fin_succ, biproduct.uniqueUpToIso,
      Category.assoc, biproduct.ι_desc,
      biproduct.ι_π_ne _ (Fin.succ_ne_zero _).symm]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.totalFiberDimension_eq_of_iso
statement:
private theorem totalFiberDimension_eq_of_iso {M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k P}
    (e : M ≅ N) : totalFiberDimension M = totalFiberDimension N
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalFiberDimension
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  exact (e.app p).toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.totalFiberDimension_pointwiseProduct
statement:
private theorem totalFiberDimension_pointwiseProduct (M N : PModule.{u,0,u} k P)
    [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)] [∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (N.obj p)] :
    totalFiberDimension (pointwiseProduct M N) =
      totalFiberDimension M + totalFiberDimension N
proof:
:= by
  unfold totalFiberDimension
  change (∑ p, Module.finrank k (M.obj p × N.obj p)) = _
  simp_rw [Module.finrank_prod]
  exact Finset.sum_add_distrib

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.totalFiberDimension_biprod
proof:
:= by
  let e := pointwiseProductIsoBiprod M N
  exact (totalFiberDimension_eq_of_iso e).symm.trans
    (totalFiberDimension_pointwiseProduct M N)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.totalFiberDimension_pos_of_not_isZero
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hpos
  have hzero : totalFiberDimension M = 0 := Nat.eq_zero_of_not_pos hpos
  have hfiber (p : P) : Subsingleton (M.obj p) := by
    apply (Module.finrank_zero_iff (R := k) (M := M.obj p)).mp
    exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)).mp hzero p
      (Finset.mem_univ p)
  apply hM
  apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero M).mpr
  ext p x
  exact (hfiber p).elim _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.finiteDimensional_of_biprod_factor
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro p
    letI : FiniteDimensional k ((A ⊞ B).obj p) := (e.app p).toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
    exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective ((biprod.inl (X := A) (Y := B)).app p).hom
      ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance)
  · intro p
    letI : FiniteDimensional k ((A ⊞ B).obj p) := (e.app p).toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
    exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective ((biprod.inr (X := A) (Y := B)).app p).hom
      ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance)

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.exists_finite_indecomposable_decomposition
statement:
private theorem exists_finite_indecomposable_decomposition
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ F : Fin n → PModule.{u,0,u} k P,
      (∀ i, Indecomposable (F i)) ∧ Nonempty (M ≅ ⨁ F)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hM
  have aux : ∀ n (X : PModule.{u,0,u} k P), totalFiberDimension X = n →
      (∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (X.obj p)) →
        ∃ m : ℕ, ∃ F : Fin m → PModule.{u,0,u} k P,
          (∀ i, Indecomposable (F i)) ∧ Nonempty (X ≅ ⨁ F) := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro X hdim hfd
      letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (X.obj p) := hfd
      by_cases hXzero : IsZero X
      · let F : Fin 0 → PModule.{u,0,u} k P := Fin.elim0
        have hsumzero : IsZero (⨁ F) := by
          apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
          have htotal : (∑ i : Fin 0, biproduct.π F i ≫ biproduct.ι F i) =
              𝟙 (⨁ F) := biproduct.total (f := F)
          simpa using htotal.symm
        refine ⟨0, F, ?_, ⟨hXzero.iso hsumzero⟩⟩
        intro i
        exact Fin.elim0 i
      · by_cases hXindecomp : Indecomposable X
        · let F : Fin 1 → PModule.{u,0,u} k P := fun _ => X
          refine ⟨1, F, ?_, ⟨(biproductUniqueIso F).symm⟩⟩
          intro i
          exact hXindecomp
        · have hdecompose : ¬ ∀ A B, (X ≅ A ⊞ B) → IsZero A ∨ IsZero B := by
            intro h
            exact hXindecomp ⟨hXzero, h⟩
          push_neg at hdecompose
          rcases hdecompose with ⟨A, B, e, hAnz, hBnz⟩
          obtain ⟨hfdA, hfdB⟩ := finiteDimensional_of_biprod_factor e hfd
          letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (A.obj p) := hfdA
          letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (B.obj p) := hfdB
          have hAdim : totalFiberDimension A < n := by
            calc
              totalFiberDimension A < totalFiberDimension A + totalFiberDimension B :=
                Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right (totalFiberDimension_pos_of_not_isZero B hBnz)
              _ = totalFiberDimension (A ⊞ B) := (totalFiberDimension_biprod A B).symm
              _ = totalFiberDimension X := (totalFiberDimension_eq_of_iso e).symm
              _ = n := hdim
          have hBdim : totalFiberDimension B < n := by
            calc
              totalFiberDimension B < totalFiberDimension A + totalFiberDimension B :=
                Nat.lt_add_of_pos_left (totalFiberDimension_pos_of_not_isZero A hAnz)
              _ = totalFiberDimension (A ⊞ B) := (totalFiberDimension_biprod A B).symm
              _ = totalFiberDimension X := (totalFiberDimension_eq_of_iso e).symm
              _ = n := hdim
          obtain ⟨nA, FA, hFA, ⟨eA⟩⟩ := ih (totalFiberDimension A) hAdim A rfl hfdA
          obtain ⟨nB, FB, hFB, ⟨eB⟩⟩ := ih (totalFiberDimension B) hBdim B rfl hfdB
          let F : Fin (nA + nB) → PModule.{u,0,u} k P :=
            fun i => Sum.elim FA FB (finSumFinEquiv.symm i)
          have hF (i : Fin (nA + nB)) : Indecomposable (F i) := by
            cases hi : finSumFinEquiv.symm i with
            | inl j => simpa [F, hi] using hFA j
            | inr j => simpa [F, hi] using hFB j
          let ε : Fin nA ⊕ Fin nB ≃ Fin (nA + nB) := finSumFinEquiv
          have hfamily : F ∘ ε = Sum.elim FA FB := by
            funext i
            simp [F, ε, Function.comp_def]
          have eReindex : (⨁ Sum.elim FA FB) ≅ ⨁ F := by
            simpa only [hfamily] using (biproduct.reindex ε F)
          have eSum : (⨁ FA) ⊞ (⨁ FB) ≅ ⨁ F :=
            (biproduct_sum_iso FA FB).trans eReindex
          exact ⟨nA + nB, F, hF,
            ⟨e.trans ((biprod.mapIso eA eB).trans eSum)⟩⟩
  exact aux (totalFiberDimension M) M rfl hM

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.indecomposable_rankProjective_iso_hook
statement:
theorem indecomposable_rankProjective_iso_hook
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p))
    (hI : Indecomposable M) (hR : IsRankProjective M) :
    ∃ t : FiniteHookDeflation.Index M,
      Nonempty (M ≅ FiniteHookDeflation.family M t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨inc, hinc⟩ := FiniteHookDeflation.exists_retract M hR
  have hFamily : ∀ t, Indecomposable (FiniteHookDeflation.family M t) := by
    intro t
    cases t with
    | inl t => exact Hook.indecomposable t.1.property
    | inr t => exact HookInfinity.indecomposable t.1
  exact indecomposable_biproduct_summand (FiniteHookDeflation.family M)
    hI hM hFamily inc (FiniteHookDeflation.π M) hinc

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.hookTag_iso_of_nonzero_composite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let ec : End (hookTagModule (k := k) c) ≃+* k := hookTagEndRingEquiv c
  have hc : ec (α ≫ β) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply h
    exact ec.injective (by simpa using hz)
  have hunitScalar : IsUnit (ec (α ≫ β)) := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hc
  let ab : End (hookTagModule (k := k) c) := α ≫ β
  have hunit : IsUnit ab := by
    have hm := IsUnit.map ec.symm.toRingHom hunitScalar
    simpa [ec] using hm
  letI : IsIso ab := (CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso _).mp hunit
  let r : hookTagModule d ⟶ hookTagModule c := β ≫ inv ab
  have hsection : α ≫ r = 𝟙 (hookTagModule c) := by
    dsimp [r]
    rw [← Category.assoc]
    exact IsIso.hom_inv_id ab
  let p : End (hookTagModule d) := r ≫ α
  have hp : p ≫ p = p := by
    calc
      p ≫ p = r ≫ (α ≫ r) ≫ α := by simp [p, Category.assoc]
      _ = r ≫ 𝟙 _ ≫ α := by rw [hsection]
      _ = p := by simp [p]
  let ed : End (hookTagModule (k := k) d) ≃+* k := hookTagEndRingEquiv d
  have hpidem : IsIdempotentElem (ed p) := by
    change ed p * ed p = ed p
    simpa only [← map_mul, End.mul_def] using congrArg ed hp
  rcases IsIdempotentElem.iff_eq_zero_or_one.mp hpidem with hz | ho
  · have hp0 : p = 0 := ed.injective (by simpa using hz)
    have hα0 : α = 0 := by
      calc
        α = α ≫ p := by
          dsimp [p]
          rw [← Category.assoc, hsection]
          simp
        _ = 0 := by rw [hp0]; simp
    exact (h (by simp [hα0])).elim
  · have hp1 : p = 𝟙 (hookTagModule d) := ed.injective (by simpa using ho)
    exact ⟨⟨r, hsection, hp1⟩⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.hookTag_indecomposable
statement:
private theorem hookTag_indecomposable (c : HookTag P) :
    Indecomposable (hookTagModule (k := k) c)
proof:
:= by
  cases c with
  | inl ab => exact Hook.indecomposable ab.property
  | inr a => exact HookInfinity.indecomposable a
