name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.hookTag_eq_of_iso
statement:
private theorem hookTag_eq_of_iso {c d : HookTag P}
    (h : Nonempty (hookTagModule (k := k) c ≅ hookTagModule d)) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  cases c with
  | inl ab =>
    cases d with
    | inl cd =>
      have h' : Nonempty (Hook.module (k := k) ab.val.1 ab.val.2 ≅
          Hook.module (k := k) cd.val.1 cd.val.2) := by
        simpa [hookTagModule, rankProjectiveHookModule] using h
      rcases (Hook.nonempty_iso_iff ab.property cd.property).mp h' with ⟨ha, hd⟩
      have hab : ab = cd := Subtype.ext (Prod.ext ha hd)
      cases hab
      rfl
    | inr a =>
      have h' : Nonempty (Hook.module (k := k) ab.val.1 ab.val.2 ≅
          HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) := by
        simpa [hookTagModule, rankProjectiveHookModule] using h
      exact (Hook.not_nonempty_iso_infinity ab.property h').elim
  | inr a =>
    cases d with
    | inl ab =>
      have h' : Nonempty (Hook.module (k := k) ab.val.1 ab.val.2 ≅
          HookInfinity.module (R := k) a) := by
        rcases h with ⟨e⟩
        exact ⟨e.symm⟩
      exact (Hook.not_nonempty_iso_infinity ab.property h').elim
    | inr b =>
      have h' : Nonempty (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a ≅
          HookInfinity.module (R := k) b) := by
        simpa [hookTagModule, rankProjectiveHookModule] using h
      have hab : a = b := (HookInfinity.nonempty_iso_iff (k := k)).mp h'
      subst b
      rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.hookTag_component_sum
statement:
private theorem hookTag_component_sum {n m : ℕ}
    (F : Fin n → HookTag P) (G : Fin m → HookTag P)
    (e : (⨁ fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) ≅
      ⨁ fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) (i : Fin n) :
    ∑ j : Fin m,
      ((biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫ e.hom ≫
          biproduct.π (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j) ≫
        (biproduct.ι (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j ≫ e.inv ≫
          biproduct.π (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i)) =
      𝟙 (hookTagModule (k := k) (F i))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : Fin m,
          biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫ e.hom ≫
            (biproduct.π (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j ≫
              biproduct.ι (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j) ≫ e.inv ≫
              biproduct.π (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫ e.hom ≫
          (∑ j : Fin m,
            biproduct.π (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j ≫
              biproduct.ι (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j) ≫ e.inv ≫
          biproduct.π (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i := by
        symm
        calc
          _ = (biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫ e.hom) ≫
                (∑ j : Fin m,
                  biproduct.π (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j ≫
                    biproduct.ι (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j) ≫
                (e.inv ≫ biproduct.π (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i) := by
              simp only [Category.assoc]
          _ = (∑ j : Fin m,
                (biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫ e.hom) ≫
                  (biproduct.π (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j ≫
                    biproduct.ι (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j)) ≫
                (e.inv ≫ biproduct.π (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i) := by
              exact congrArg (fun f => f ≫
                (e.inv ≫ biproduct.π (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i))
                (Preadditive.comp_sum Finset.univ
                  (biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫ e.hom)
                  (fun j => biproduct.π (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j ≫
                    biproduct.ι (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j))
          _ = ∑ j : Fin m,
                ((biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫ e.hom) ≫
                  (biproduct.π (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j ≫
                    biproduct.ι (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j)) ≫
                  (e.inv ≫ biproduct.π (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i) := by
              exact Preadditive.sum_comp Finset.univ
                (fun j => (biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫ e.hom) ≫
                  (biproduct.π (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j ≫
                    biproduct.ι (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j))
                (e.inv ≫ biproduct.π (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i)
          _ = _ := by
              apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
              intro j hj
              simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫
          e.hom ≫ e.inv ≫
            biproduct.π (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i := by
        rw [biproduct.total]
        simp [Category.assoc]
    _ = 𝟙 (hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) := by
        calc
          _ = biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫
                𝟙 _ ≫ biproduct.π (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i :=
              congrArg (fun f => biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫
                f ≫ biproduct.π (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i) e.hom_inv_id
          _ = 𝟙 _ := by simp

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.exists_hookTag_iso_component
statement:
private theorem exists_hookTag_iso_component {n m : ℕ}
    (F : Fin n → HookTag P) (G : Fin m → HookTag P)
    (e : (⨁ fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) ≅
      ⨁ fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) (i : Fin n) :
    ∃ j : Fin m, IsIso
      (biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫ e.hom ≫
        biproduct.π (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let a (j : Fin m) : End (hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) :=
    (biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫ e.hom ≫
      biproduct.π (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j) ≫
    (biproduct.ι (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j ≫ e.inv ≫
      biproduct.π (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i)
  have hsum : ∑ j : Fin m, a j = 𝟙 (hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) :=
    hookTag_component_sum F G e i
  let ec : End (hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) ≃+* k :=
    hookTagEndRingEquiv (F i)
  have hscalar : (∑ j : Fin m, ec (a j)) = 1 := by
    rw [← map_sum, hsum]
    simp
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j : Fin m, ec (a j) ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    have hz : ∀ j : Fin m, ec (a j) = 0 := by
      intro j
      by_contra hj
      exact h ⟨j, hj⟩
    have hzero : (∑ j : Fin m, ec (a j)) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro j hj
      exact hz j
    rw [hzero] at hscalar
    exact zero_ne_one hscalar
  have hunitScalar : IsUnit (ec (a j)) := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hj
  have hunit : IsUnit (a j) := by
    have hm := IsUnit.map ec.symm.toRingHom hunitScalar
    simpa [ec] using hm
  letI : IsIso (a j) := (CategoryTheory.isUnit_iff_isIso _).mp hunit
  have hnonzero : a j ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hid : 𝟙 (hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) = 0 := by
      calc
        𝟙 (hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) = a j ≫ inv (a j) :=
          (IsIso.hom_inv_id (a j)).symm
        _ = 0 := by
          have hcomp := congrArg (fun f : End (hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) =>
            f ≫ inv (a j)) hz
          exact hcomp.trans zero_comp
    exact (hookTag_indecomposable (k := k) (F i)).1
      ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr hid)
  let α := biproduct.ι (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i ≫ e.hom ≫
      biproduct.π (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j
  let β := biproduct.ι (fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) j ≫ e.inv ≫
      biproduct.π (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) i
  have hcomp : α ≫ β = a j := rfl
  have hαβ : α ≫ β ≠ 0 := by rw [hcomp]; exact hnonzero
  exact ⟨j, by simpa [α] using hookTag_iso_of_nonzero_composite hαβ⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.fin_succ_hookTag_card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    Fintype.card {i : Fin (n + 1) // F i = c} =
        ∑ i : Fin (n + 1), (if F i = c then 1 else 0 : ℕ) := by
      rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
      symm
      exact Finset.sum_boole (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => F i = c) Finset.univ
    _ = (if F 0 = c then 1 else 0 : ℕ) +
        ∑ i : Fin n, (if F i.succ = c then 1 else 0 : ℕ) := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    _ = (if F 0 = c then 1 else 0 : ℕ) +
        Fintype.card {i : Fin n // F i.succ = c} := by
      congr 1
      rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
      exact Finset.sum_boole (R := ℕ) (fun i : Fin n => F i.succ = c) Finset.univ

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.hookTag_sum_multiplicity_unique
statement:
private theorem hookTag_sum_multiplicity_unique [DecidableEq P] :
    ∀ n m (F : Fin n → HookTag P) (G : Fin m → HookTag P),
      Nonempty ((⨁ fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) ≅
        ⨁ fun j => hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) →
      ∀ c : HookTag P,
        Fintype.card {i : Fin n // F i = c} =
          Fintype.card {j : Fin m // G j = c}
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    intro m F G he c
    classical
    rcases he with ⟨e⟩
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      let F0 : Fin 0 → PModule.{u,0,u} k P := fun i => hookTagModule (F i)
      let G0 : Fin m → PModule.{u,0,u} k P := fun j => hookTagModule (G j)
      have hzeroSource : IsZero (⨁ F0) := by
        apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
        have htotal : (∑ i : Fin 0, biproduct.π F0 i ≫ biproduct.ι F0 i) =
            𝟙 (⨁ F0) := biproduct.total (f := F0)
        simpa using htotal.symm
      have hidSource : 𝟙 (⨁ F0) = 0 := (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mp hzeroSource
      have hzeroTarget : IsZero (⨁ G0) := by
        apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
        calc
          𝟙 (⨁ G0) = e.inv ≫ e.hom := e.inv_hom_id.symm
          _ = e.inv ≫ 𝟙 (⨁ F0) ≫ e.hom := by rw [Category.id_comp]
          _ = 0 := by rw [hidSource]; simp
      have hfactor (j : Fin m) : IsZero (G0 j) := by
        apply (IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mpr
        have hcoord := congrArg
          (fun f : End (⨁ G0) => biproduct.ι G0 j ≫ f ≫ biproduct.π G0 j)
          ((IsZero.iff_id_eq_zero _).mp hzeroTarget)
        simpa [Category.assoc] using hcoord
      have hm : m = 0 := by
        by_contra hm
        have hp : 0 < m := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm
        exact (hookTag_indecomposable (k := k) (G ⟨0, hp⟩)).1 (hfactor ⟨0, hp⟩)
      subst m
      simp
    | succ n =>
      obtain ⟨j, hAlpha⟩ := exists_hookTag_iso_component F G e 0
      let α : hookTagModule (k := k) (F 0) ⟶ hookTagModule (k := k) (G j) :=
        biproduct.ι (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) 0 ≫
          e.hom ≫ biproduct.π (fun q : Fin m => hookTagModule (k := k) (G q)) j
      have hα : IsIso α := by simpa [α] using hAlpha
      letI : IsIso α := hα
      have hIso : Nonempty (hookTagModule (k := k) (F 0) ≅ hookTagModule (k := k) (G j)) :=
        ⟨asIso α⟩
      have htag : F 0 = G j := hookTag_eq_of_iso hIso
      cases m with
      | zero => exact Fin.elim0 j
      | succ m =>
        let σ : Fin (m + 1) ≃ Fin (m + 1) := Equiv.swap 0 j
        have hσ0 : σ 0 = j := by simp [σ]
        let G' : Fin (m + 1) → HookTag P := fun q => G (σ q)
        let reindex : (⨁ fun q => hookTagModule (k := k) (G' q)) ≅
            ⨁ fun q : Fin (m + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (G q) :=
          biproduct.reindex σ (fun q : Fin (m + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (G q))
        let e' : (⨁ fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) ≅
            ⨁ fun q => hookTagModule (k := k) (G' q) := e.trans reindex.symm
        let splitF := biproduct_split_fin_succ
          (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i))
        let splitG := biproduct_split_fin_succ
          (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (G' i))
        let E := splitF.trans (e'.trans splitG.symm)
        have hsplitF : biprod.inl ≫ splitF.hom =
            biproduct.ι (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) 0 :=
          biproduct_split_fin_succ_inl_hom _
        have hsplitG : splitG.inv ≫ biprod.fst =
            biproduct.π (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (G' i)) 0 :=
          biproduct_split_fin_succ_inv_fst _
        let targetIso : hookTagModule (k := k) (G' 0) ≅
            hookTagModule (k := k) (G j) :=
          eqToIso (congrArg (fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (G i)) hσ0)
        letI : IsIso targetIso.hom := targetIso.isIso_hom
        have htargetComponent : reindex.inv ≫
            biproduct.π (fun q : Fin (m + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (G' q)) 0 ≫
              targetIso.hom =
            biproduct.π (fun q : Fin (m + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (G q)) j := by
          change (biproduct.lift fun q : Fin (m + 1) =>
            biproduct.π (fun q : Fin (m + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (G q)) (σ q)) ≫
              biproduct.π (fun q : Fin (m + 1) =>
                hookTagModule (k := k) (G (σ q))) 0 ≫ targetIso.hom = _
          have hLift := biproduct.lift_π
            (fun q : Fin (m + 1) =>
              biproduct.π (fun q : Fin (m + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (G q)) (σ q)) 0
          calc
            _ = biproduct.π (fun q : Fin (m + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (G q))
                  (σ 0) ≫ targetIso.hom := congrArg (fun f => f ≫ targetIso.hom) hLift
            _ = _ := by
              dsimp [targetIso]
              exact biproduct.π_comp_eqToHom
                (fun q : Fin (m + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (G q)) hσ0
        have hfirstBare : biprod.inl ≫ E.hom ≫ biprod.fst =
            biproduct.ι (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) 0 ≫
              e'.hom ≫ biproduct.π (fun q : Fin (m + 1) =>
                hookTagModule (k := k) (G' q)) 0 := by
          change ((biprod.inl ≫ splitF.hom) ≫ e'.hom ≫ splitG.inv ≫ biprod.fst) = _
          rw [hsplitF]
          calc
            _ = (biproduct.ι (fun i : Fin (n + 1) =>
                    hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) 0 ≫ e'.hom) ≫
                  (splitG.inv ≫ biprod.fst) := by simp [Category.assoc]
            _ = (biproduct.ι (fun i : Fin (n + 1) =>
                    hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) 0 ≫ e'.hom) ≫
                  biproduct.π (fun q : Fin (m + 1) =>
                    hookTagModule (k := k) (G' q)) 0 := congrArg _ hsplitG
            _ = _ := by simp [Category.assoc]
        have hfirstTransport :
            (biprod.inl ≫ E.hom ≫ biprod.fst) ≫ targetIso.hom = α := by
          calc
            _ = (biproduct.ι (fun i : Fin (n + 1) =>
                  hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) 0 ≫ e'.hom ≫
                  biproduct.π (fun q : Fin (m + 1) =>
                    hookTagModule (k := k) (G' q)) 0) ≫ targetIso.hom :=
              congrArg (fun f => f ≫ targetIso.hom) hfirstBare
            _ = (biproduct.ι (fun i : Fin (n + 1) =>
                    hookTagModule (k := k) (F i)) 0 ≫ e.hom) ≫
                  (reindex.inv ≫ biproduct.π (fun q : Fin (m + 1) =>
                    hookTagModule (k := k) (G' q)) 0 ≫ targetIso.hom) := by
              simp [e', Category.assoc]
            _ = α := by
              rw [htargetComponent]
              rfl
        have hfirstEq : biprod.inl ≫ E.hom ≫ biprod.fst = α ≫ targetIso.inv := by
          apply (cancel_mono targetIso.hom).1
          calc
            (biprod.inl ≫ E.hom ≫ biprod.fst) ≫ targetIso.hom = α := hfirstTransport
            _ = (α ≫ targetIso.inv) ≫ targetIso.hom := by simp [Category.assoc]
        have hfirst : IsIso (biprod.inl ≫ E.hom ≫ biprod.fst) := by
          rw [hfirstEq]
          infer_instance
        letI : IsIso (biprod.inl ≫ E.hom ≫ biprod.fst) := hfirst
        let tailF : Fin n → HookTag P := fun i => F i.succ
        let tailG : Fin m → HookTag P := fun i => G' i.succ
        let tailIso : (⨁ fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (tailF i)) ≅
            ⨁ fun i => hookTagModule (k := k) (tailG i) := Biprod.isoElim E
        have htail : Fintype.card {i : Fin n // tailF i = c} =
            Fintype.card {i : Fin m // tailG i = c} :=
          ih n (Nat.lt_succ_self n) m tailF tailG ⟨tailIso⟩ c
        have htop : F 0 = G' 0 := by simpa [G', hσ0] using htag
        have hswap : Fintype.card {i : Fin (m + 1) // G' i = c} =
            Fintype.card {i : Fin (m + 1) // G i = c} :=
          Fintype.card_congr (σ.subtypeEquiv (by intro i; rfl))
        calc
          Fintype.card {i : Fin (n + 1) // F i = c} =
              (if F 0 = c then 1 else 0) +
                Fintype.card {i : Fin n // F i.succ = c} :=
            fin_succ_hookTag_card F c
          _ = (if G' 0 = c then 1 else 0) +
                Fintype.card {i : Fin m // G' i.succ = c} := by
            rw [htop, htail]
          _ = Fintype.card {i : Fin (m + 1) // G' i = c} :=
            (fin_succ_hookTag_card G' c).symm
          _ = Fintype.card {i : Fin (m + 1) // G i = c} := hswap

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjectiveHookSum_multiplicity_unique
statement:
theorem rankProjectiveHookSum_multiplicity_unique [DecidableEq P]
    {n m : ℕ} (F : Fin n → RankProjectiveHookTag P)
    (G : Fin m → RankProjectiveHookTag P)
    (h : Nonempty
      ((⨁ fun i => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (F i)) ≅
        ⨁ fun j => rankProjectiveHookModule (k := k) (G j)))
    (c : RankProjectiveHookTag P) :
    Fintype.card {i : Fin n // F i = c} =
      Fintype.card {j : Fin m // G j = c}
proof:
:= by
  exact hookTag_sum_multiplicity_unique n m F G h c

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.family_eq_hookTagModule
proof:
:= by
  cases t <;> rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.family_eq_of_hookTag_eq
proof:
:= by
  rw [family_eq_hookTagModule, family_eq_hookTagModule, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.hookTag_card_finite
statement:
private theorem hookTag_card_finite [DecidableEq P] (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P)
    (ab : FiniteHookDeflation.StrictPair P) :
    Fintype.card {t : FiniteHookDeflation.Index M // hookTag t = Sum.inl ab} =
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M ab.property.le))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype (FiniteHookDeflation.Index M) :=
    FiniteHookDeflation.indexFintype M
  let e : Fin (Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M ab.property.le))) ≃
      {t : FiniteHookDeflation.Index M // hookTag t = Sum.inl ab} := by
    refine Equiv.ofBijective (fun i => ⟨Sum.inl ⟨ab, i⟩, rfl⟩) ?_
    constructor
    · intro i j h
      have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
      cases hv
      rfl
    · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
      cases t with
      | inl q =>
        have hq : q.1 = ab := Sum.inl.inj ht
        cases hq
        exact ⟨q.2, by apply Subtype.ext; rfl⟩
      | inr q => cases ht
  simpa using Fintype.card_congr e.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.hookTag_card_infinite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype (FiniteHookDeflation.Index M) :=
    FiniteHookDeflation.indexFintype M
  let e : Fin (Module.finrank k (M.obj a)) ≃
      {t : FiniteHookDeflation.Index M // hookTag t = Sum.inr a} := by
    refine Equiv.ofBijective (fun i => ⟨Sum.inr ⟨a, i⟩, rfl⟩) ?_
    constructor
    · intro i j h
      have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
      cases hv
      rfl
    · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
      cases t with
      | inl q => cases ht
      | inr q =>
        have hq : q.1 = a := Sum.inr.inj ht
        cases hq
        exact ⟨q.2, by apply Subtype.ext; rfl⟩
  simpa using Fintype.card_congr e.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.finiteHookTag_source_card_le
statement:
private theorem finiteHookTag_source_card_le [DecidableEq P]
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p))
    {n : ℕ} (F : Fin n → PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (e : M ≅ ⨁ F)
    (tag : Fin n → HookTag P)
    (hIso : ∀ i, Nonempty (F i ≅ hookTagModule (tag i)))
    (ab : FiniteHookDeflation.StrictPair P) :
    Fintype.card {i : Fin n // tag i = Sum.inl ab} ≤
      Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M ab.property.le))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I := {i : Fin n // tag i = Sum.inl ab}
  letI : Fintype (FiniteHookDeflation.Index M) := FiniteHookDeflation.indexFintype M
  letI : Fintype I := Subtype.fintype _
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hM
  let eHook (i : I) : F i.val ≅ Hook.module (k := k) ab.val.1 ab.val.2 := by
    exact (Classical.choice (hIso i.val)).trans
      (eqToIso (by simpa [hookTagModule, rankProjectiveHookModule] using congrArg hookTagModule i.property))
  let x (i : I) : (F i.val).obj ab.val.1 :=
    ((eHook i).inv.app ab.val.1).hom
      (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support ab.val.1 ab.val.2)
        (Hook.birth_mem ab.property))
  have hx (i : I) : x i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hgen := congrArg ((eHook i).hom.app ab.val.1).hom hz
    have hgen' : (SupportInterval.one (Hook.support ab.val.1 ab.val.2)
        (Hook.birth_mem ab.property) : (Hook.module (k := k) ab.val.1 ab.val.2).obj ab.val.1) = 0 := by
      simpa [x, NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply] using hgen
    exact (one_ne_zero : (1 : k) ≠ 0) (congrArg Subtype.val hgen')
  have hliSum : LinearIndependent k (fun i : I =>
      ((biproduct.ι F i.val).app ab.val.1).hom (x i)) :=
    biproduct_inclusions_linearIndependent F (fun i : I => i.val)
      Subtype.val_injective ab.val.1 x hx
  have hkerIso : LinearMap.ker ((e.inv.app ab.val.1).hom) = ⊥ :=
    LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr ((e.app ab.val.1).toLinearEquiv.symm.injective)
  have hliM : LinearIndependent k (fun i : I =>
      (e.inv.app ab.val.1).hom (((biproduct.ι F i.val).app ab.val.1).hom (x i))) :=
    hliSum.map' (e.inv.app ab.val.1).hom hkerIso
  let v (i : I) : M.obj ab.val.1 :=
    (e.inv.app ab.val.1).hom (((biproduct.ι F i.val).app ab.val.1).hom (x i))
  have hdie (i : I) : structureMapLinear M ab.property.le (v i) = 0 := by
    let α : Hook.module (k := k) ab.val.1 ab.val.2 ⟶ M :=
      (eHook i).inv ≫ (biproduct.ι F i.val ≫ e.inv)
    simpa [v, x, α, NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply] using
      Hook.generator_dies ab.property α
  let w (i : I) : LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M ab.property.le) := ⟨v i, hdie i⟩
  have hliKer : LinearIndependent k w := by
    rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iffₛ]
    intro f g heq i
    have hval : ∑ j, f j • v j = ∑ j, g j • v j := by
      simpa [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul, w, v] using
        congrArg (fun z : LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M ab.property.le) =>
          (z : M.obj ab.val.1)) heq
    exact hliM.eq_coords_of_eq hval i
  simpa [I] using hliKer.fintype_card_le_finrank

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.infiniteHookTag_source_card_le
statement:
private theorem infiniteHookTag_source_card_le [DecidableEq P]
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p))
    {n : ℕ} (F : Fin n → PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (e : M ≅ ⨁ F)
    (tag : Fin n → HookTag P)
    (hIso : ∀ i, Nonempty (F i ≅ hookTagModule (tag i)))
    (a : P) :
    Fintype.card {i : Fin n // tag i = Sum.inr a} ≤
      Module.finrank k (M.obj a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let I := {i : Fin n // tag i = Sum.inr a}
  letI : Fintype (FiniteHookDeflation.Index M) := FiniteHookDeflation.indexFintype M
  letI : Fintype I := Subtype.fintype _
  letI : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p) := hM
  let eHook (i : I) : F i.val ≅ HookInfinity.module (R := k) a := by
    exact (Classical.choice (hIso i.val)).trans
      (eqToIso (by simpa [hookTagModule, rankProjectiveHookModule] using congrArg hookTagModule i.property))
  let x (i : I) : (F i.val).obj a :=
    ((eHook i).inv.app a).hom (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) a)
  have hx (i : I) : x i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hgen := congrArg ((eHook i).hom.app a).hom hz
    have hgen' : (HookInfinity.birth (R := k) a : (HookInfinity.module (R := k) a).obj a) = 0 := by
      simpa [x, NatTrans.comp_app, ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply] using hgen
    exact HookInfinity.birth_ne_zero a hgen'
  have hliSum : LinearIndependent k (fun i : I =>
      ((biproduct.ι F i.val).app a).hom (x i)) :=
    biproduct_inclusions_linearIndependent F (fun i : I => i.val)
      Subtype.val_injective a x hx
  have hkerIso : LinearMap.ker ((e.inv.app a).hom) = ⊥ :=
    LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr ((e.app a).toLinearEquiv.symm.injective)
  have hliM : LinearIndependent k (fun i : I =>
      (e.inv.app a).hom (((biproduct.ι F i.val).app a).hom (x i))) :=
    hliSum.map' (e.inv.app a).hom hkerIso
  simpa [I] using hliM.fintype_card_le_finrank

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.exists_hookTag_preserving_embedding
statement:
private theorem exists_hookTag_preserving_embedding [DecidableEq P]
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p))
    {n : ℕ} (F : Fin n → PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (e : M ≅ ⨁ F)
    (tag : Fin n → HookTag P)
    (hIso : ∀ i, Nonempty (F i ≅ hookTagModule (tag i))) :
    ∃ f : Fin n → FiniteHookDeflation.Index M,
      Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ i, hookTag (f i) = tag i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype (FiniteHookDeflation.Index M) := FiniteHookDeflation.indexFintype M
  have hcard (c : HookTag P) :
      Fintype.card {i : Fin n // tag i = c} ≤
        Fintype.card {t : FiniteHookDeflation.Index M // hookTag t = c} := by
    cases c with
    | inl ab =>
      calc
        Fintype.card {i : Fin n // tag i = Sum.inl ab} ≤
            Module.finrank k (LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M ab.property.le)) :=
          finiteHookTag_source_card_le M hM F e tag hIso ab
        _ = Fintype.card {t : FiniteHookDeflation.Index M // hookTag t = Sum.inl ab} :=
          (hookTag_card_finite M ab).symm
    | inr a =>
      calc
        Fintype.card {i : Fin n // tag i = Sum.inr a} ≤
            Module.finrank k (M.obj a) :=
          infiniteHookTag_source_card_le M hM F e tag hIso a
        _ = Fintype.card {t : FiniteHookDeflation.Index M // hookTag t = Sum.inr a} :=
          (hookTag_card_infinite M a).symm
  let emb (c : HookTag P) :
      {i : Fin n // tag i = c} ↪
        {t : FiniteHookDeflation.Index M // hookTag t = c} :=
    Classical.choice (Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le (hcard c))
  let Source : Type := Σ c : HookTag P, {i : Fin n // tag i = c}
  let Target : Type := Σ c : HookTag P,
    {t : FiniteHookDeflation.Index M // hookTag t = c}
  let sourceEquiv : Fin n ≃ Source :=
    (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv tag).symm
  let targetEquiv : Target ≃ FiniteHookDeflation.Index M :=
    Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv hookTag
  let sigmaEmbedding : Source ↪ Target := ⟨
    fun x => (⟨x.1, emb x.1 x.2⟩ : Target), by
      intro x y h
      rcases x with ⟨c, x⟩
      rcases y with ⟨d, y⟩
      have hcd : c = d := congrArg Sigma.fst h
      cases hcd
      have hxy : emb c x = emb c y := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact congrArg (fun z : Target => z.2.1) h
      have hxy' : x = y := (emb c).injective hxy
      subst y
      rfl
    ⟩
  let f : Fin n → FiniteHookDeflation.Index M :=
    targetEquiv ∘ sigmaEmbedding ∘ sourceEquiv
  refine ⟨f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (targetEquiv.injective.comp (sigmaEmbedding.injective.comp
      sourceEquiv.injective))
  · intro i
    change hookTag ((emb (tag i) ⟨i, rfl⟩).val) = tag i
    exact (emb (tag i) ⟨i, rfl⟩).property

name: TDA.Persistence.FiniteRankProjectiveClassification.rankProjective_iff_exists_canonical_subfamily
statement:
theorem rankProjective_iff_exists_canonical_subfamily
    (M : PModule.{u,0,u} k P) (hM : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj p)) :
    IsRankProjective M ↔
      ∃ S : Finset (FiniteHookDeflation.Index M),
        Nonempty (M ≅ ⨁ fun i : S => FiniteHookDeflation.family M i.1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hR
    obtain ⟨n, F, hF, ⟨eM⟩⟩ := exists_finite_indecomposable_decomposition M hM
    have hfd (i : Fin n) : ∀ p, FiniteDimensional k ((F i).obj p) := by
      intro p
      letI : FiniteDimensional k ((⨁ F).obj p) :=
        (eM.app p).toLinearEquiv.finiteDimensional
      exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective
        ((biproduct.ι F i).app p).hom
        ((ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective _).mp inferInstance)
    have hRPsum : IsRankProjective (⨁ F) := hR.of_iso eM
    have hRP (i : Fin n) : IsRankProjective (F i) := by
      exact hRPsum.of_retract (biproduct.ι F i) (biproduct.π F i)
        (biproduct.ι_π_self F i)
    have hTag : ∀ i : Fin n, ∃ c : HookTag P,
        Nonempty (F i ≅ hookTagModule c) := by
      intro i
      obtain ⟨t, ⟨e⟩⟩ :=
        indecomposable_rankProjective_iso_hook (F i) (hfd i) (hF i) (hRP i)
      refine ⟨hookTag t, ⟨e.trans (eqToIso (family_eq_hookTagModule t))⟩⟩
    choose tag hIso using hTag
    obtain ⟨f, hf, htag⟩ :=
      exists_hookTag_preserving_embedding M hM F eM tag hIso
    let S : Finset (FiniteHookDeflation.Index M) := Finset.univ.image f
    let g : Fin n → S := fun i => ⟨f i, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩
    have hg : Function.Bijective g := by
      constructor
      · intro i j hij
        exact hf (congrArg Subtype.val hij)
      · intro s
        rcases Finset.mem_image.mp s.property with ⟨i, -, hi⟩
        exact ⟨i, Subtype.ext hi⟩
    let eIndex : Fin n ≃ S := Equiv.ofBijective g hg
    let G : Fin n → PModule.{u,0,u} k P :=
      fun i => FiniteHookDeflation.family M (f i)
    let H : S → PModule.{u,0,u} k P :=
      fun i => FiniteHookDeflation.family M i.1
    have hFactorIso (i : Fin n) : F i ≅ G i := by
      have hEq : FiniteHookDeflation.family M (f i) = hookTagModule (tag i) :=
        (family_eq_hookTagModule (M := M) (f i)).trans
          (congrArg hookTagModule (htag i))
      exact (Classical.choice (hIso i)).trans (eqToIso hEq.symm)
    have hReindexFamily : H ∘ eIndex = G := by
      funext i
      rfl
    have eReindex : (⨁ G) ≅ ⨁ H := by
      simpa only [hReindexFamily] using (biproduct.reindex eIndex H)
    refine ⟨S, ⟨eM.trans ((biproduct.mapIso hFactorIso).trans eReindex)⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨S, ⟨e⟩⟩
    have hS : IsRankProjective
        (⨁ fun i : S => FiniteHookDeflation.family M i.1) :=
      IsRankProjective.biproduct _ (fun i => FiniteHookDeflation.family_isRankProjective M i.1)
    exact hS.of_iso e.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossPresentationConverseExamples.reconstruct_nonzero_relation
statement:
theorem reconstruct_nonzero_relation :
    ∃ C : CrossData (R := ℤ) (n := 1) 1, C.IsFinite ∧
      Nonempty (C.leftPresentation.presented ≅
        CrossPresentationExamples.delayedDeath.leftPresentation.presented) ∧
      Nonempty (C.rightPresentation.presented ≅
        CrossPresentationExamples.delayedDeath.rightPresentation.presented)
proof:
:=
  finitelyPresented_exists_crossPresentation
    (CrossPresentationExamples.delayedDeath.leftPresentation.finitelyPresented
      CrossPresentationExamples.delayedDeath_finite.1)
    (CrossPresentationExamples.delayedDeath.rightPresentation.finitelyPresented
      CrossPresentationExamples.delayedDeath_finite.2)
    CrossPresentationExamples.delayedDeath.quotientInterleaving

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossPresentationConverseExamples.basic_finite
statement: private theorem basic_finite : basic.IsFinite
proof:
:=
  ⟨inferInstanceAs (Finite Unit), inferInstanceAs (Finite Unit)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossPresentationConverseExamples.zero_parameter_redundant
statement:
theorem zero_parameter_redundant :
    ∃ C : CrossData (R := ℚ) (n := 1) 0, C.IsFinite ∧
      Nonempty (C.leftPresentation.presented ≅ basic.presented) ∧
      Nonempty (C.rightPresentation.presented ≅ redundant.presented)
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite W.Carrier := inferInstanceAs (Finite Unit)
  exact finitelyPresented_exists_crossPresentation
    (basic.finitelyPresented basic_finite)
    (redundant.finitelyPresented (basic.adjoinRedundant_finite W (fun _ => 0) basic_finite))
    (CoordinateInterleaving.ofIso (basic.adjoinRedundantIso W (fun _ => 0)).symm)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossPresentationConverseExamples.zero_finitelyPresented
statement:
theorem zero_finitelyPresented (n : ℕ) :
    FinitelyPresented (R := ℚ) (P := Fin n → ℝ)
      (zeroModule n)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossPresentationConverseExamples.zero_module_zero_dimension
statement:
theorem zero_module_zero_dimension (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ C : CrossData (R := ℚ) (n := 0) ε, C.IsFinite ∧
      Nonempty (C.leftPresentation.presented ≅ zeroModule 0) ∧
      Nonempty (C.rightPresentation.presented ≅ zeroModule 0)
proof:
:=
  finitelyPresented_exists_crossPresentation (zero_finitelyPresented 0)
    (zero_finitelyPresented 0) (CoordinateInterleaving.refl ε _)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossPresentationConverseExamples.zero_ring_zero_dimension
statement:
theorem zero_ring_zero_dimension (ε : ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ C : CrossData (R := ZMod 1) (n := 0) ε, C.IsFinite ∧
      Nonempty (C.leftPresentation.presented ≅ module (R := ZMod 1) oneZeroGrade) ∧
      Nonempty (C.rightPresentation.presented ≅ module (R := ZMod 1) oneZeroGrade)
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite oneZeroGrade.Carrier := inferInstanceAs (Finite Unit)
  exact finitelyPresented_exists_crossPresentation (free_finitelyPresented oneZeroGrade)
    (free_finitelyPresented oneZeroGrade) (CoordinateInterleaving.refl ε _)

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossPresentationConverseExamples.positive_field_shift
statement:
theorem positive_field_shift :
    ∃ C : CrossData (R := ℚ) (n := 1) 1, C.IsFinite ∧
      Nonempty (C.leftPresentation.presented ≅ module (R := ℚ) W) ∧
      Nonempty (C.rightPresentation.presented ≅ module (R := ℚ) (W.shiftGrade (-1)))
proof:
:= by
  let : Finite W.Carrier := inferInstanceAs (Finite Unit)
  let : Finite (W.shiftGrade (-1)).Carrier := inferInstanceAs (Finite Unit)
  let i : CoordinateInterleaving 1 (module (R := ℚ) W)
      (module (R := ℚ) (W.shiftGrade (-1))) :=
    CoordinateInterleaving.ofApp (delayedShiftIso (R := ℚ) 1 W).hom
      (delayedAdvance 1 W)
      (by intro a; apply ModuleCat.hom_ext; rfl)
      (by intro a; apply ModuleCat.hom_ext; rfl)
  exact finitelyPresented_exists_crossPresentation (free_finitelyPresented W)
    (free_finitelyPresented (W.shiftGrade (-1))) i

name: TDA.Persistence.GradedFree.CrossPresentationConverseExamples.finite_quotients
statement:
theorem finite_quotients {ε : ℝ≥0} (C : CrossData (R := ℚ) (n := 1) ε)
    (hC : C.IsFinite) : C.leftPresentation.IsFinite ∧ C.rightPresentation.IsFinite
proof:
:=
  C.finite hC

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirMeasure_apply_interior
statement:
theorem reservoirMeasure_apply_interior (μ : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    {s : Set Space} (hs : MeasurableSet s) (hb : Space.boundary ∉ s) :
    reservoirMeasure μ R s = μ (Space.point ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reservoirMeasure, Measure.add_apply, Measure.map_apply continuous_point.measurable hs,
    Measure.smul_apply]
  simp [Measure.dirac_apply, hb]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirMeasure_mass
statement:
theorem reservoirMeasure_mass (μ : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hmass : μ Set.univ ≤ R) :
    reservoirMeasure μ R Set.univ = R
proof:
:= by
  rw [reservoirMeasure, Measure.add_apply, Measure.map_apply continuous_point.measurable
    MeasurableSet.univ, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp only [preimage_univ, Measure.dirac_apply' Space.boundary MeasurableSet.univ]
  simp only [Set.indicator_univ, Pi.one_apply, mul_one]
  simpa only [add_comm] using (add_tsub_cancel_of_le hmass)

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirMeasure_pair_mass
statement:
theorem reservoirMeasure_pair_mass (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hmass : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R) :
    reservoirMeasure μ R Set.univ = R ∧ reservoirMeasure ν R Set.univ = R
proof:
:= by
  have hμ : μ Set.univ ≤ R :=
    (show μ Set.univ ≤ μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ from le_self_add).trans hmass
  have hν : ν Set.univ ≤ R :=
    (show ν Set.univ ≤ ν Set.univ + μ Set.univ from le_self_add).trans
      (by simpa [add_comm] using hmass)
  exact ⟨reservoirMeasure_mass μ R hμ, reservoirMeasure_mass ν R hν⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirMeasure_isFinite
statement:
theorem reservoirMeasure_isFinite (μ : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hR : R < ∞) (hmass : μ Set.univ ≤ R) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (reservoirMeasure μ R)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  rw [reservoirMeasure_mass μ R hmass]
  exact hR

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirMeasure_regular
statement:
theorem reservoirMeasure_regular (μ : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hR : R < ∞) (hmass : μ Set.univ ≤ R) :
    (reservoirMeasure μ R).Regular
proof:
:= by
  let := reservoirMeasure_isFinite μ R hR hmass
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirMeasure_isFinite_iff
statement:
theorem reservoirMeasure_isFinite_iff (μ : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hmass : μ Set.univ ≤ R) :
    IsFiniteMeasure (reservoirMeasure μ R) ↔ R < ∞
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hμR
    simpa only [reservoirMeasure_mass μ R hmass] using hμR.measure_univ_lt_top
  · exact fun hR => reservoirMeasure_isFinite μ R hR hmass

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirMeasure_restrict_interior
statement:
theorem reservoirMeasure_restrict_interior (μ : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞) :
    (reservoirMeasure μ R).restrict (Set.range Space.point) = μ.map Space.point
proof:
:= by
  apply Measure.ext
  intro s hs
  rw [Measure.restrict_apply hs]
  have hb : Space.boundary ∉ s ∩ Set.range Space.point := by
    rintro ⟨_, x, hx⟩
    cases hx
  rw [reservoirMeasure_apply_interior μ R
    (hs.inter measurableEmbedding_point.measurableSet_range) hb,
    Measure.map_apply continuous_point.measurable hs]
  simp [preimage_inter, preimage_range]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirMeasure_boundary_moment
statement:
theorem reservoirMeasure_boundary_moment (μ : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∫⁻ x, boundaryMomentIntegrand p x ∂reservoirMeasure μ R =
      ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : 0 ≤ p := hp.le
  have hdist : Continuous (fun x : Space => dist x Space.boundary) := by
    exact continuous_dist.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
  have hf : Measurable (boundaryMomentIntegrand p) :=
    ENNReal.measurable_ofReal.comp ((Real.continuous_rpow_const hp0).comp hdist).measurable
  rw [reservoirMeasure, lintegral_add_measure, lintegral_smul_measure,
    lintegral_map hf continuous_point.measurable]
  simp [boundaryMomentIntegrand, dist_point_boundary,
    Real.zero_rpow hp.ne']

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirMeasure_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem reservoirMeasure_zero (R : ℝ≥0∞) :
    reservoirMeasure (0 : Measure Interior) R = R • Measure.dirac Space.boundary
proof:
:= by
  simp [reservoirMeasure]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirMeasure_zero_boundary_moment
statement:
theorem reservoirMeasure_zero_boundary_moment (R : ℝ≥0∞) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∫⁻ x, boundaryMomentIntegrand p x ∂reservoirMeasure (0 : Measure Interior) R = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [reservoirMeasure_boundary_moment (0 : Measure Interior) R p hp]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.normalizedReservoirMeasure_zero
statement:
theorem normalizedReservoirMeasure_zero (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R) :
    normalizedReservoirMeasure (0 : Measure Interior) R = Measure.dirac Space.boundary
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedReservoirMeasure, reservoirMeasure_zero, smul_smul,
    ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hRpos.ne' hRtop.ne, one_smul]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.normalizedReservoirMeasure_mass
statement:
theorem normalizedReservoirMeasure_mass (μ : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R)
    (hmass : μ Set.univ ≤ R) :
    normalizedReservoirMeasure μ R Set.univ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedReservoirMeasure, Measure.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    reservoirMeasure_mass μ R hmass]
  exact ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hRpos.ne' hRtop.ne

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.normalizedReservoirMeasure_isProbability
statement:
theorem normalizedReservoirMeasure_isProbability (μ : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R)
    (hmass : μ Set.univ ≤ R) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (normalizedReservoirMeasure μ R)
proof:
:=
  ⟨normalizedReservoirMeasure_mass μ R hRtop hRpos hmass⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.normalizedReservoirPair_isProbability
statement:
theorem normalizedReservoirPair_isProbability (μ ν : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R)
    (htotal : μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ ≤ R) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (normalizedReservoirMeasure μ R) ∧
      IsProbabilityMeasure (normalizedReservoirMeasure ν R)
proof:
:= by
  have hμ : μ Set.univ ≤ R :=
    (show μ Set.univ ≤ μ Set.univ + ν Set.univ from le_self_add).trans htotal
  have hν : ν Set.univ ≤ R :=
    (show ν Set.univ ≤ ν Set.univ + μ Set.univ from le_self_add).trans
      (by simpa [add_comm] using htotal)
  exact ⟨normalizedReservoirMeasure_isProbability μ R hRtop hRpos hμ,
    normalizedReservoirMeasure_isProbability ν R hRtop hRpos hν⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.normalizedReservoirMeasure_restrict_interior
statement:
theorem normalizedReservoirMeasure_restrict_interior (μ : Measure Interior)
    (R : ℝ≥0∞) :
    (normalizedReservoirMeasure μ R).restrict (Set.range Space.point) =
      R⁻¹ • μ.map Space.point
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedReservoirMeasure, Measure.restrict_smul,
    reservoirMeasure_restrict_interior]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.normalizedReservoirMeasure_boundary_moment
statement:
theorem normalizedReservoirMeasure_boundary_moment (μ : Measure Interior)
    (R : ℝ≥0∞) (p : ℝ) (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∫⁻ x, boundaryMomentIntegrand p x ∂normalizedReservoirMeasure μ R =
      R⁻¹ * ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p) ∂μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedReservoirMeasure, lintegral_smul_measure,
    reservoirMeasure_boundary_moment μ R p hp,
    smul_eq_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.coe_normalizedReservoirProbability
statement:
@[simp] theorem coe_normalizedReservoirProbability (μ : Measure Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hRtop : R < ∞) (hRpos : 0 < R) (hmass : μ Set.univ ≤ R) :
    (normalizedReservoirProbability μ R hRtop hRpos hmass : Measure Space) =
      normalizedReservoirMeasure μ R
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirMeasure_dirac_mass
statement:
theorem reservoirMeasure_dirac_mass (x : Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞) (hR : 1 ≤ R) :
    reservoirMeasure (Measure.dirac x) R Set.univ = R
proof:
:= by
  apply reservoirMeasure_mass
  simpa using hR

name: TDA.Persistence.BoundaryTransport.reservoirMeasure_dirac_boundary_moment
statement:
theorem reservoirMeasure_dirac_boundary_moment (x : Interior) (R : ℝ≥0∞) (p : ℝ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    ∫⁻ y, boundaryMomentIntegrand p y ∂reservoirMeasure (Measure.dirac x) R =
      ENNReal.ofReal (depth x ^ p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reservoirMeasure_boundary_moment (μ := Measure.dirac x) (R := R) p (by linarith)]
  simp

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.birthCut_upper_at
statement:
private theorem birthCut_upper_at (t : α) (W : Submodule k (M.obj t))
    (hW : W ≠ ⊤) : t ∈ (birthCut M t W).upper
proof:
:= by
  change ¬ ∃ h : t ≤ t, LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M h) ≤ W
  rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
  have hr : LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M h) = ⊤ := by
    rw [structureMapLinear_self M h, LinearMap.range_id]
  exact hW (top_le_iff.mp (hr ▸ hh))

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.birth_imageMinus_le
statement:
private theorem birth_imageMinus_le (t : α) (W : Submodule k (M.obj t)) :
    imageMinus M (birthCut M t W) t ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  apply iSup_le
  intro s
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := s.property.1
  exact hh

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.birth_imagePlus_not_le
statement:
private theorem birth_imagePlus_not_le (t : α) [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (W : Submodule k (M.obj t)) (hW : W ≠ ⊤) :
    ¬ imagePlus M (birthCut M t W) t ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := imagePlus_eq_range M (birthCut M t W) (birthCut_upper_at M t W hW)
  intro h
  have hsW : LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M s.property.2) ≤ W := hs ▸ h
  exact s.property.1 ⟨s.property.2, hsW⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.deathCut_lower_at
statement:
private theorem deathCut_lower_at (t : α) (B W : Submodule k (M.obj t)) :
    t ∈ (deathCut M t B W).lower
proof:
:= by
  change t < t ∨ ∃ h : t ≤ t, B ⊓ LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M h) ≤ W
  right
  refine ⟨le_rfl, ?_⟩
  rw [structureMapLinear_self M (le_refl t), LinearMap.ker_id]
  exact (inf_le_right : B ⊓ ⊥ ≤ ⊥).trans bot_le

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.death_kernelMinus_le
statement:
private theorem death_kernelMinus_le (t : α) (B W : Submodule k (M.obj t)) :
    B ⊓ kernelMinus M (deathCut M t B W) t ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := (mem_kernelMinus_iff M (deathCut M t B W)
    (deathCut_lower_at M t B W)).mp hx.2
  have hgood : ∃ h : t ≤ r.val,
      B ⊓ LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M h) ≤ W := by
    rcases r.property.1 with hrt | hgood
    · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge r.property.2) hrt)
    · exact hgood
  obtain ⟨h, hW⟩ := hgood
  have : h = r.property.2 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst h
  exact hW ⟨hx.1, hr⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.death_kernelPlus_not_le
statement:
private theorem death_kernelPlus_not_le (t : α) [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (B W : Submodule k (M.obj t)) (hB : ¬ B ≤ W) :
    ¬ B ⊓ kernelPlus M (deathCut M t B W) t ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  by_cases hne : ∃ r ∈ (deathCut M t B W).upper, t ≤ r
  · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := kernelPlus_eq_kernel M (deathCut M t B W) hne
    have hgood : ∃ htr : t ≤ r.val,
        B ⊓ LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M htr) ≤ W :=
      ⟨r.property.2, hr ▸ h⟩
    exact r.property.1 (Or.inr hgood)
  · have hk : kernelPlus M (deathCut M t B W) t = ⊤ := by
      apply top_unique
      intro x hx
      change x ∈ ⨅ r : {r // r ∈ (deathCut M t B W).upper ∧ t ≤ r},
        LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M r.property.2)
      rw [Submodule.mem_iInf]
      intro r
      exact False.elim (hne ⟨r.val, r.property.1, r.property.2⟩)
    exact hB (by simpa [hk] using h)

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.exists_interval_escapes
statement:
theorem exists_interval_escapes (t : α) [FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (W : Submodule k (M.obj t)) (hW : W ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ l r : Cut α, t ∈ support l r ∧
      intervalMinus M l r t ≤ W ∧ ¬ intervalPlus M l r t ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  let l := birthCut M t W
  let B := imagePlus M l t
  let r := deathCut M t B W
  refine ⟨l, r, ⟨birthCut_upper_at M t W hW,
    deathCut_lower_at M t B W⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (imageMinus M l t ⊓ kernelPlus M r t) ⊔
      (imagePlus M l t ⊓ kernelMinus M r t) ≤ W
    exact sup_le (inf_le_left.trans (birth_imageMinus_le M t W))
      (death_kernelMinus_le M t B W)
  · exact death_kernelPlus_not_le M t B W (birth_imagePlus_not_le M t W hW)

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.complement_escapes
statement:
private theorem complement_escapes (l r : Cut α) (t : α)
    (D : Submodule k (intervalPlus M l r t))
    (hD : IsCompl (intervalMinusInPlus M l r t) D)
    (W : Submodule k (M.obj t))
    (hminus : intervalMinus M l r t ≤ W)
    (hplus : ¬ intervalPlus M l r t ≤ W) :
    ¬ D.map (intervalPlus M l r t).subtype ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  intro hDW
  apply hplus
  intro x hx
  have hmem : (⟨x, hx⟩ : intervalPlus M l r t) ∈
      intervalMinusInPlus M l r t ⊔ D := by
    rw [hD.codisjoint.eq_top]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hmem
  have haW : (a : M.obj t) ∈ W := hminus ha
  have hbW : (b : M.obj t) ∈ W := hDW ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
  have hab' := congrArg Subtype.val hab
  change (a : M.obj t) + b = x at hab'
  exact hab' ▸ W.add_mem haW hbW

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.chosenFiber_escapes_real
statement:
private theorem chosenFiber_escapes_real
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) [∀ t, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (t : ℝ) (W : Submodule k (M.obj t)) (hW : W ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ i : IntervalIndex, ¬ chosenFiber M t i ≤ W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, r, ht, hminus, hplus⟩ := exists_interval_escapes M t W hW
  let i : IntervalIndex := ⟨(l, r), ⟨t, ht⟩⟩
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  have h := complement_escapes M l r t
    (sectionComplementAt M l r (anchor i) ⟨t, ht⟩)
    (isCompl_sectionComplementAt_real M l r (anchor i) ⟨t, ht⟩)
    W hminus hplus
  change ¬ sectionComplementFiber M l r (anchor i) t ≤ W
  simpa only [sectionComplementFiber, dif_pos ht] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.chosenFiber_iSup_eq_top_real
statement:
theorem chosenFiber_iSup_eq_top_real
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) [∀ t, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (t : ℝ) : (⨆ i : IntervalIndex, chosenFiber M t i) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := chosenFiber_escapes_real M t
    (⨆ i : IntervalIndex, chosenFiber M t i) hne
  exact hi (le_iSup (chosenFiber M t) i)

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.imagePlus_le_imageMinus_of_birth_lt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs₂, hs₁⟩ := Set.exists_of_ssubset h
  have hs₁' : s ∈ l₁.upper := (l₁.mem_lower_or_upper s).resolve_left hs₁
  have hst : s ≤ t := (l₂.lower_lt_upper hs₂ ht).le
  exact (iInf_le (fun s : {s // s ∈ l₁.upper ∧ s ≤ t} =>
      LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M s.property.2)) ⟨s, hs₁', hst⟩).trans
    (le_iSup (fun s : {s // s ∈ l₂.lower ∧ s ≤ t} =>
      LinearMap.range (structureMapLinear M s.property.2)) ⟨s, hs₂, hst⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.kernelPlus_le_kernelMinus_of_death_lt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, hs₂, hs₁⟩ := Set.exists_of_ssubset h
  have hs₁' : s ∈ r₁.upper := (r₁.mem_lower_or_upper s).resolve_left hs₁
  have hts : t ≤ s := (r₁.lower_lt_upper ht hs₁').le
  exact (iInf_le (fun s : {s // s ∈ r₁.upper ∧ t ≤ s} =>
      LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M s.property.2)) ⟨s, hs₁', hts⟩).trans
    (le_iSup (fun s : {s // s ∈ r₂.lower ∧ t ≤ s} =>
      LinearMap.ker (structureMapLinear M s.property.2)) ⟨s, hs₂, hts⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.lower_subset_total
statement:
private theorem lower_subset_total (c d : Cut α) :
    c.lower ⊆ d.lower ∨ d.lower ⊆ c.lower
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : c.lower ⊆ d.lower
  · exact Or.inl h
  · right
    obtain ⟨a, hac, had⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp h
    have hau : a ∈ d.upper := (d.mem_lower_or_upper a).resolve_left had
    intro b hbd
    by_contra hbc
    have hbu : b ∈ c.upper := (c.mem_lower_or_upper b).resolve_left hbc
    exact (lt_asymm (c.lower_lt_upper hac hbu) (d.lower_lt_upper hbd hau))

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.eq_of_lower_eq
statement: private theorem eq_of_lower_eq (c d : Cut α) (h : c.lower = d.lower) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  have hu : c.upper = d.upper := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      rcases d.mem_lower_or_upper x with hd | hd
      · exact False.elim ((not_mem_upper (h.symm ▸ hd)) hx)
      · exact hd
    · intro hx
      rcases c.mem_lower_or_upper x with hc | hc
      · exact False.elim ((not_mem_upper (h ▸ hc)) hx)
      · exact hc
  cases c
  cases d
  cases h
  cases hu
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.complement_map_inter_minus_zero
statement:
private theorem complement_map_inter_minus_zero (l r : Cut α) (t : α)
    (D : Submodule k (intervalPlus M l r t))
    (hD : IsCompl (intervalMinusInPlus M l r t) D)
    (x : M.obj t) (hxD : x ∈ D.map (intervalPlus M l r t).subtype)
    (hxMinus : x ∈ intervalMinus M l r t) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hyD, rfl⟩ := hxD
  have hyMinus : y ∈ intervalMinusInPlus M l r t := hxMinus
  have hy0 := Submodule.disjoint_def.mp hD.disjoint y hyMinus hyD
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hy0

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.selected_zero_of_relation
statement:
private theorem selected_zero_of_relation (l r : Cut α) (t : α)
    (D : Submodule k (intervalPlus M l r t))
    (hD : IsCompl (intervalMinusInPlus M l r t) D)
    (x y z : M.obj t)
    (hxD : x ∈ D.map (intervalPlus M l r t).subtype)
    (hy : y ∈ imageMinus M l t)
    (hzImage : z ∈ imagePlus M l t)
    (hzKernel : z ∈ kernelMinus M r t)
    (hsum : x + y + z = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hxPlus : x ∈ intervalPlus M l r t := by
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hxD
    exact v.property
  have hzPlus : z ∈ kernelPlus M r t :=
    kernelMinus_le_kernelPlus M r t hzKernel
  have hyPlus : y ∈ kernelPlus M r t := by
    have hxyz : y + (x + z) = 0 := by simpa [add_comm, add_left_comm, add_assoc] using hsum
    have heq : y = -(x + z) := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hxyz
    rw [heq]
    exact (kernelPlus M r t).neg_mem
      ((kernelPlus M r t).add_mem hxPlus.2 hzPlus)
  have hxMinus : x ∈ intervalMinus M l r t := by
    have hyz : y + z ∈ intervalMinus M l r t :=
      (intervalMinus M l r t).add_mem
        (show y ∈ intervalMinus M l r t from
          (le_sup_left : imageMinus M l t ⊓ kernelPlus M r t ≤ intervalMinus M l r t)
            ⟨hy, hyPlus⟩)
        (show z ∈ intervalMinus M l r t from
          (le_sup_right : imagePlus M l t ⊓ kernelMinus M r t ≤ intervalMinus M l r t)
            ⟨hzImage, hzKernel⟩)
    have heq : x = -(y + z) := by
      apply eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left
      simpa [add_assoc] using hsum
    rw [heq]
    exact (intervalMinus M l r t).neg_mem hyz
  exact complement_map_inter_minus_zero M l r t D hD x hxD hxMinus

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.chosenFiber_le_intervalPlus_real
statement:
private theorem chosenFiber_le_intervalPlus_real
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) (t : ℝ) (i : IntervalIndex) :
    chosenFiber M t i ≤ intervalPlus M i.val.1 i.val.2 t
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x hx
  unfold chosenFiber sectionComplementFiber at hx
  split_ifs at hx with hs
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact y.property
  · exact (show x = 0 from hx) ▸ (intervalPlus M i.val.1 i.val.2 t).zero_mem

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.chosenFiber_nonzero_support_real
statement:
private theorem chosenFiber_nonzero_support_real
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) (t : ℝ) (i : IntervalIndex)
    (x : M.obj t) (hx : x ∈ chosenFiber M t i) (hne : x ≠ 0) :
    t ∈ support i.val.1 i.val.2
proof:
:= by
  by_contra ht
  have hz : chosenFiber M t i = ⊥ :=
    sectionComplementFiber_eq_bot M i.val.1 i.val.2 (anchor i) ht
  exact hne (by simpa [hz] using hx)

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.maximal_term_zero_real
statement:
private theorem maximal_term_zero_real
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) [∀ t, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (t : ℝ) (s : Finset IntervalIndex) (v : IntervalIndex → M.obj t)
    (hv : ∀ j ∈ s, v j ∈ chosenFiber M t j)
    (hsum : ∑ j ∈ s, v j = 0)
    (i : IntervalIndex) (hi : i ∈ s)
    (hbirth : ∀ j ∈ s, v j ≠ 0 → j.val.1.lower ⊆ i.val.1.lower)
    (hdeath : ∀ j ∈ s, v j ≠ 0 → j.val.1 = i.val.1 →
      j.val.2.lower ⊆ i.val.2.lower) : v i = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hvi
  have hti := chosenFiber_nonzero_support_real M t i (v i) (hv i hi) hvi
  let E := (s.erase i).filter (fun j => j.val.1.lower ≠ i.val.1.lower)
  let Z := (s.erase i).filter (fun j => j.val.1.lower = i.val.1.lower)
  have hE : ∑ j ∈ E, v j ∈ imageMinus M i.val.1 t := by
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro j hj
    have hjs : j ∈ s := (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).1).2
    by_cases hj0 : v j = 0
    · rw [hj0]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · have hlt : j.val.1.lower ⊂ i.val.1.lower :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne (hbirth j hjs hj0) (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
      exact imagePlus_le_imageMinus_of_birth_lt M j.val.1 i.val.1 t hlt hti.1
        ((chosenFiber_le_intervalPlus_real M t j) (hv j hjs)).1
  have hZI : ∑ j ∈ Z, v j ∈ imagePlus M i.val.1 t := by
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro j hj
    have hjs : j ∈ s := (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).1).2
    have hbirthEq := eq_of_lower_eq j.val.1 i.val.1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
    exact hbirthEq ▸ ((chosenFiber_le_intervalPlus_real M t j) (hv j hjs)).1
  have hZK : ∑ j ∈ Z, v j ∈ kernelMinus M i.val.2 t := by
    apply Submodule.sum_mem
    intro j hj
    have hjs : j ∈ s := (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).1).2
    by_cases hj0 : v j = 0
    · rw [hj0]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    · have hbirthEq := eq_of_lower_eq j.val.1 i.val.1 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
      have hdeathLe := hdeath j hjs hj0 hbirthEq
      have hjne : j ≠ i := (Finset.mem_erase.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).1).1
      have hdeathNe : j.val.2.lower ≠ i.val.2.lower := by
        intro heq
        apply hjne
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact Prod.ext hbirthEq (eq_of_lower_eq j.val.2 i.val.2 heq)
      have hlt : j.val.2.lower ⊂ i.val.2.lower :=
        lt_of_le_of_ne hdeathLe hdeathNe
      have htj := chosenFiber_nonzero_support_real M t j (v j) (hv j hjs) hj0
      exact kernelPlus_le_kernelMinus_of_death_lt M j.val.2 i.val.2 t hlt htj.2
        ((chosenFiber_le_intervalPlus_real M t j) (hv j hjs)).2
  have hsplit : (∑ j ∈ E, v j) + (∑ j ∈ Z, v j) =
      ∑ j ∈ s.erase i, v j := by
    simpa only [E, Z, not_not] using
      (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s.erase i)
        (fun j : IntervalIndex => j.val.1.lower ≠ i.val.1.lower) v)
  have hsel : v i + (∑ j ∈ E, v j) + (∑ j ∈ Z, v j) = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = v i + ((∑ j ∈ E, v j) + (∑ j ∈ Z, v j)) := by abel
      _ = v i + ∑ j ∈ s.erase i, v j := congrArg (v i + ·) hsplit
      _ = ∑ j ∈ s, v j := Finset.add_sum_erase s v hi
      _ = 0 := hsum
  have hD := isCompl_sectionComplementAt_real M i.val.1 i.val.2 (anchor i) ⟨t, hti⟩
  have hselected := selected_zero_of_relation M i.val.1 i.val.2 t
    (sectionComplementAt M i.val.1 i.val.2 (anchor i) ⟨t, hti⟩)
    hD (v i) (∑ j ∈ E, v j) (∑ j ∈ Z, v j) ?_ hE hZI hZK hsel
  · exact hvi hselected
  · simpa only [chosenFiber, sectionComplementFiber, dif_pos hti] using hv i hi

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.chosenFiber_iSupIndep_real
statement:
theorem chosenFiber_iSupIndep_real
    (M : PModule.{u,0,w} k ℝ) [∀ t, FiniteDimensional k (M.obj t)]
    (t : ℝ) : iSupIndep (chosenFiber M t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [iSupIndep_iff_finsetSum_eq_zero_imp_eq_zero]
  intro s v hv hsum i hi
  by_contra hvi
  let nz := s.filter (fun j => v j ≠ 0)
  have hnz : nz.Nonempty := ⟨i, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hi, hvi⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbmax⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_maximalFor (fun j : IntervalIndex => j.val.1.lower) nz hnz
  let same := nz.filter (fun j => j.val.1.lower = b.val.1.lower)
  have hsame : same.Nonempty :=
    ⟨b, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hb, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcmax⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_maximalFor (fun j : IntervalIndex => j.val.2.lower) same hsame
  have hcb : c.val.1.lower = b.val.1.lower := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hc).2
  have hcnz : c ∈ nz := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hc).1
  have hbirth : ∀ j ∈ s, v j ≠ 0 → j.val.1.lower ⊆ c.val.1.lower := by
    intro j hj hjne
    have hjnz : j ∈ nz := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hj, hjne⟩
    rw [hcb]
    rcases lower_subset_total j.val.1 b.val.1 with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact hbmax hjnz h
  have hdeath : ∀ j ∈ s, v j ≠ 0 → j.val.1 = c.val.1 →
      j.val.2.lower ⊆ c.val.2.lower := by
    intro j hj hjne hjbirth
    have hjnz : j ∈ nz := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hj, hjne⟩
    have hjsame : j ∈ same := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hjnz, by rw [hjbirth]; exact hcb⟩
    rcases lower_subset_total j.val.2 c.val.2 with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact hcmax hjsame h
  have hcs : c ∈ s := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hcnz).1
  have hc0 := maximal_term_zero_real M t s v hv hsum c hcs hbirth hdeath
  exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hcnz).2 hc0

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.sumToM_app
statement:
theorem sumToM_app (t : ℝ) :
    ((sumToM M).app t).hom = DirectSum.coeLinearMap (chosenFiber M t)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.sumToM_bijective
statement:
theorem sumToM_bijective (t : ℝ) :
    Function.Bijective (((sumToM M).app t).hom)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [sumToM_app]
  exact (DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_iff_iSupIndep_and_iSup_eq_top
    (chosenFiber M t)).mpr
    ⟨chosenFiber_iSupIndep_real M t, chosenFiber_iSup_eq_top_real M t⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.sumIso_hom
statement: theorem sumIso_hom : (sumIso M).hom = sumToM M
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.finite_active
statement:
theorem finite_active (t : ℝ) :
    Set.Finite {i : IntervalIndex | Nontrivial ((intervalFamily M i).obj t)}
proof:
:= by
  exact AlgebraicFamily.finite_nontrivial_of_iso (intervalFamily M) (sumIso M).symm
    (fun s => inferInstance) t

name: TDA.Persistence.CutDecomposition.finite_observed
statement:
theorem finite_observed {N : ℕ} (c : Fin N → ℝ) :
    Set.Finite {i : IntervalIndex | ∃ n, Nontrivial ((intervalFamily M i).obj (c n))}
proof:
:= by
  exact AlgebraicFamily.finite_observed_nontrivial (intervalFamily M)
    (finite_active M) c

name: TDA.Persistence.card_essentialPart_eq_countP
statement:
theorem card_essentialPart_eq_countP {α} [LinearOrder α]
    (s : Multiset (α × WithTop α)) :
    (essentialPart s).card = s.countP (fun p => p.2 = ⊤)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := congrArg
    (Multiset.countP (fun p : α × WithTop α => p.2 = ⊤))
    (parts_reconstruct s)
  simpa [Multiset.countP_add, Multiset.countP_map] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.card_essentialPart_dgm_eq_finrank
statement:
theorem card_essentialPart_dgm_eq_finrank (f : FilterFunction K α) (n : ℕ) (t : α)
    (ht : ∀ s, f.value s ≤ t) :
    (essentialPart (dgm k f n).points).card =
      Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology K k n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hparts : ∀ p ∈ (dgm k f n).points,
      p ∈ (finitePart (dgm k f n).points).map
          (fun q => (q.1, (q.2 : WithTop α))) +
        (essentialPart (dgm k f n).points).map
          (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop α))) := by
    intro p hp
    rw [parts_reconstruct]
    exact hp
  have hbirth : ∀ p ∈ (dgm k f n).points, p.1 ∈ f.criticalValues := by
    intro p hp
    rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp (hparts p hp) with hf | he
    · obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hf
      exact (mem_criticalValues_of_mem_finitePart_dgm k f hq).1
    · obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp he
      exact mem_criticalValues_of_mem_essentialPart_dgm k f hb
  have hdeath_le : ∀ p ∈ (dgm k f n).points, p.2 ≠ ⊤ →
      p.2 ≤ (t : WithTop α) := by
    intro p hp htop
    rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp (hparts p hp) with hf | he
    · obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp hf
      obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues f q.2).1
        (mem_criticalValues_of_mem_finitePart_dgm k f hq).2
      have hqle : q.2 ≤ t := by
        rw [← hs]
        exact ht s
      simpa using hqle
    · obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := Multiset.mem_map.mp he
      exact (htop rfl).elim
  have hcount :
      (dgm k f n).points.countP (fun p => p.2 = ⊤) =
        (dgm k f n).points.countP
          (fun p => p.1 ≤ t ∧ (t : WithTop α) < p.2) := by
    apply Multiset.countP_congr rfl
    intro p hp
    apply propext
    constructor
    · intro htop
      have hle : p.1 ≤ t := by
        obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues f p.1).1
          (hbirth p hp)
        rw [← hs]
        exact ht s
      exact ⟨hle, by simp [htop]⟩
    · rintro ⟨_, hlt⟩
      by_contra htop
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (hdeath_le p hp htop)) hlt
  have hrank := finrank_sublevelHomology_eq_countP k f n t
  rw [FilterFunction.sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le f t ht] at hrank
  calc
    (essentialPart (dgm k f n).points).card =
        (dgm k f n).points.countP (fun p => p.2 = ⊤) :=
      card_essentialPart_eq_countP _
    _ = (dgm k f n).points.countP
        (fun p => p.1 ≤ t ∧ (t : WithTop α) < p.2) := hcount
    _ = Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology K k n) := hrank.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_dgm_eq_zero_of_isZero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Multiset.eq_zero_of_forall_notMem
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨s₀, hs₀⟩ :=
    (FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues f b).1
      (mem_criticalValues_of_mem_essentialPart_dgm k f hb)
  let t : α := Finset.univ.sup' ⟨s₀, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    (fun s : TotalFace K => f.value s)
  have ht : ∀ s, f.value s ≤ t := by
    intro s
    exact Finset.le_sup' (fun q : TotalFace K => f.value q) (Finset.mem_univ s)
  have hcard := card_essentialPart_dgm_eq_finrank k f n t ht
  letI : Subsingleton (simplicialHomology K k n) :=
    ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero h
  have hzero : Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology K k n) = 0 :=
    Module.finrank_zero_of_subsingleton (R := k)
  have hcard0 : (essentialPart (dgm k f n).points).card = 0 :=
    hcard.trans hzero
  have hpos : 0 < (essentialPart (dgm k f n).points).card :=
    Multiset.card_pos_iff_exists_mem.mpr ⟨b, hb⟩
  exact Nat.not_lt_zero _ (hcard0 ▸ hpos)

name: TDA.Persistence.essentialPart_dgm_fullComplex_eq_zero
statement:
theorem essentialPart_dgm_fullComplex_eq_zero [Fintype V]
    (f : FilterFunction (Rips.fullComplex V) α) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    essentialPart (dgm k f n).points = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero
    (Nat.ne_zero_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one hn))
  apply essentialPart_dgm_eq_zero_of_isZero k f
  simpa only [Rips.fullComplex] using
    (TDA.Simplicial.isZero_simplicialHomology_top_succ
      (V := V) k m)

name: TDA.Persistence.card_essentialPart_dgm_fullComplex_zero
statement:
theorem card_essentialPart_dgm_fullComplex_zero [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (f : FilterFunction (Rips.fullComplex V) α) :
    (essentialPart (dgm k f 0).points).card = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty V)
  let s₀ : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V) :=
    ⟨{v}, (Rips.mem_fullComplex_iff _).2 (by simp)⟩
  let t : α := Finset.univ.sup' ⟨s₀, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    (fun s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V) => f.value s)
  have ht : ∀ s, f.value s ≤ t := by
    intro s
    exact Finset.le_sup' (fun q : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V) => f.value q)
      (Finset.mem_univ s)
  calc
    (essentialPart (dgm k f 0).points).card =
        Module.finrank k (simplicialHomology (Rips.fullComplex V) k 0) :=
      card_essentialPart_dgm_eq_finrank k f 0 t ht
    _ = 1 := by
      exact TDA.Simplicial.finrank_simplicialHomology_top_zero (V := V) k

name: TDA.Persistence.dgm_points_fullComplex_eq_finite
statement:
theorem dgm_points_fullComplex_eq_finite [Fintype V]
    (f : FilterFunction (Rips.fullComplex V) α) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (dgm k f n).points =
      (finitePart (dgm k f n).points).map
        (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop α)))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (dgm k f n).points =
        (finitePart (dgm k f n).points).map
            (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop α))) +
          (essentialPart (dgm k f n).points).map
            (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop α))) :=
      (parts_reconstruct (dgm k f n).points).symm
    _ = (finitePart (dgm k f n).points).map
        (fun p => (p.1, (p.2 : WithTop α))) := by
      rw [essentialPart_dgm_fullComplex_eq_zero k f hn]
      simp

statement:

    (f : FilterFunction (Rips.fullComplex V) ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card (dgm k f n).finiteOccurrences ≤
      Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.card_coe]
  calc
    (finitePart (dgm k f n).points).card ≤
        Nat.card (Face (Rips.fullComplex V) (n + 1)) :=
      card_finitePart_dgm_le k f n
    _ = Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) := by
      simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using card_face_fullComplex (V := V) (n + 1)

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_choose_mul_displacement
statement:
theorem norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_choose_mul_displacement
    (p q : V → X) (n : ℕ) (σ : ℝ) {A B : ℝ} (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) :
    ‖WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        WeightedKernel.diagramEmbedding σ w (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        (2 * (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ)) * Cech.displacement p q
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := norm_diagramEmbedding_sub_le_displacement
    k p q n σ hA hB w
  have hpNat : Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences ≤
      Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) :=
    card_finiteOccurrences_dgm_fullComplex_le k (Cech.filter p) n
  have hqNat : Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences ≤
      Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) :=
    card_finiteOccurrences_dgm_fullComplex_le k (Cech.filter q) n
  have hp : (Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hpNat
  have hq : (Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hqNat
  have hcount :
      ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
        Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        2 * (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by
    calc
      ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
        Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) =
          (Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) +
            (Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) := by
              norm_num
      _ ≤ (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) +
            (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := add_le_add hp hq
      _ = 2 * (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by ring
  exact hbase.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount
      (WeightedKernel.stabilityConstant_nonneg σ hA hB))
    (Cech.displacement_nonneg p q))

name: TDA.Persistence.Cech.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_choose_mul_displacement
statement:
theorem norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_choose_mul_displacement
    (p q : V → X) (n : ℕ) {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ A B : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n)‖ ≤
      PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        (2 * (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ)) * Cech.displacement p q
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_displacement
    k p q n hσ hA hB w P hm hd
  have hpNat := card_finiteOccurrences_dgm_fullComplex_le k (Cech.filter p) n
  have hqNat := card_finiteOccurrences_dgm_fullComplex_le k (Cech.filter q) n
  have hp : (Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hpNat
  have hq : (Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hqNat
  have hcount :
      ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
        Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        2 * (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by
    calc
      ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences +
        Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) =
          (Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter p) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) +
            (Fintype.card (dgm k (Cech.filter q) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) := by
              norm_num
      _ ≤ (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) +
            (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := add_le_add hp hq
      _ = 2 * (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by ring
  exact hbase.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount
      (PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_nonneg hσ hA hB))
    (Cech.displacement_nonneg p q))

name: TDA.Persistence.Rips.norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_choose_mul_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_choose_mul_pairwiseDiscrepancy
    (d e : MetricSpace V) (n : ℕ) {K : Type*} [Fintype K] {σ A B : ℝ}
    (hσ : 0 < σ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (w : PersistenceImage.Weight A B) (P : K → Set (ℝ × ℝ))
    (hm : ∀ j, MeasurableSet (P j))
    (hd : Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (P i) (P j))) :
    ‖PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n) -
        PersistenceImage.finiteDiagramImage σ w P (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n)‖ ≤
      PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant σ A B *
        (2 * (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ)) *
          Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:= by
  have hbase := norm_finiteDiagramImage_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy
    k d e n hσ hA hB w P hm hd
  have hdNat := card_finiteOccurrences_dgm_fullComplex_le k (Rips.filter d) n
  have heNat := card_finiteOccurrences_dgm_fullComplex_le k (Rips.filter e) n
  have hd' : (Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hdNat
  have he' : (Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) ≤
      (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by
    exact_mod_cast heNat
  have hcount :
      ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
        Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        2 * (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by
    calc
      ((Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences +
        Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℕ) : ℝ) =
          (Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter d) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) +
            (Fintype.card (dgm k (Rips.filter e) n).finiteOccurrences : ℝ) := by
              norm_num
      _ ≤ (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) +
            (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := add_le_add hd' he'
      _ = 2 * (Nat.choose (Fintype.card V) (n + 2) : ℝ) := by ring
  exact hbase.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hcount
      (PersistenceImage.stabilityConstant_nonneg hσ hA hB))
    (Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy_nonneg d e))

:= by
