name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.ThreePoints.metricP_dist
statement: theorem metricP_dist (v w : Fin 3) : metricP.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.ThreePoints.metricQ_dist
statement: theorem metricQ_dist (v w : Fin 3) : metricQ.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.ThreePoints.displacement_eq
statement: theorem displacement_eq : displacement p q = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (displacement_le_iff p q 1).2 ⟨zero_le_one, fun v => ?_⟩
    fin_cases v <;> norm_num [p, q, Real.dist_eq]
  · have h := dist_le_displacement p q 0
    norm_num [p, q, Real.dist_eq] at h
    exact h

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.ThreePoints.cech_value_p
statement: theorem cech_value_p : (filter p).value tri = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (filter_value_le_radiusAt p tri 1).trans
      ((radiusAt_le_iff p 1 _ 1).2 ⟨zero_le_one, fun v _ => ?_⟩)
    fin_cases v <;> norm_num [p, Real.dist_eq]
  · have h := rips_le_two_mul_filter_value metricP p metricP_dist tri
    have hd : metricP.dist 0 2 ≤ (Rips.filter metricP).value tri :=
      Rips.dist_le_diameter metricP (Finset.mem_univ _) (Finset.mem_univ _)
    rw [metricP_dist, p_zero, p_two, Real.dist_eq] at hd
    rw [Rips.filter_value] at h
    norm_num at hd
    linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.ThreePoints.cech_value_q
statement: theorem cech_value_q : (filter q).value tri = 2
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (filter_value_le_radiusAt q tri 1).trans
      ((radiusAt_le_iff q 1 _ 2).2 ⟨zero_le_two, fun v _ => ?_⟩)
    fin_cases v <;> norm_num [q, Real.dist_eq]
  · have h := rips_le_two_mul_filter_value metricQ q metricQ_dist tri
    have hd : metricQ.dist 0 2 ≤ (Rips.filter metricQ).value tri :=
      Rips.dist_le_diameter metricQ (Finset.mem_univ _) (Finset.mem_univ _)
    rw [metricQ_dist, q_zero, q_two, Real.dist_eq] at hd
    rw [Rips.filter_value] at h
    norm_num at hd
    linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.ThreePoints.abs_cech_value_sub_eq_displacement
statement:
theorem abs_cech_value_sub_eq_displacement :
    |(filter p).value tri - (filter q).value tri| = displacement p q
proof:
:= by
  rw [cech_value_p, cech_value_q, displacement_eq]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.ThreePoints.rips_value_p
statement: theorem rips_value_p : Rips.diameter metricP Finset.univ = 2
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (Rips.diameter_le_iff metricP _ 2).2 ⟨zero_le_two, fun v _ w _ => ?_⟩
    rw [metricP_dist]
    fin_cases v <;> fin_cases w <;> norm_num [p, Real.dist_eq]
  · have hd := Rips.dist_le_diameter metricP (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin 3))
      (Finset.mem_univ (2 : Fin 3))
    rw [metricP_dist, p_zero, p_two, Real.dist_eq] at hd
    norm_num at hd
    exact hd

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.ThreePoints.rips_value_q
statement: theorem rips_value_q : Rips.diameter metricQ Finset.univ = 4
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (Rips.diameter_le_iff metricQ _ 4).2 ⟨by norm_num, fun v _ w _ => ?_⟩
    rw [metricQ_dist]
    fin_cases v <;> fin_cases w <;> norm_num [q, Real.dist_eq]
  · have hd := Rips.dist_le_diameter metricQ (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin 3))
      (Finset.mem_univ (2 : Fin 3))
    rw [metricQ_dist, q_zero, q_two, Real.dist_eq] at hd
    norm_num at hd
    exact hd

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.ThreePoints.abs_rips_value_sub_eq_two_mul_displacement
statement:
theorem abs_rips_value_sub_eq_two_mul_displacement :
    |Rips.diameter metricP Finset.univ - Rips.diameter metricQ Finset.univ| =
      2 * displacement p q
proof:
:= by
  rw [rips_value_p, rips_value_q, displacement_eq]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.ThreePoints.pairwiseDiscrepancy_eq
statement: theorem pairwiseDiscrepancy_eq : Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy metricP metricQ = 2
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have h := pairwiseDiscrepancy_le_two_mul_displacement metricP metricQ p q
      metricP_dist metricQ_dist
    rw [displacement_eq] at h
    linarith
  · have h := Rips.abs_dist_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy metricP metricQ 0 2
    rw [metricP_dist, metricQ_dist, p_zero, p_two, q_zero, q_two, Real.dist_eq,
      Real.dist_eq] at h
    norm_num at h
    exact h

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.ThreePoints.pairwiseDiscrepancy_eq_two_mul_displacement
statement:
theorem pairwiseDiscrepancy_eq_two_mul_displacement :
    Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy metricP metricQ = 2 * displacement p q
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairwiseDiscrepancy_eq, displacement_eq]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.ThreePoints.cech_change_lt_rips_change
statement:
theorem cech_change_lt_rips_change :
    |(filter p).value tri - (filter q).value tri| <
      |(Rips.filter metricP).value tri - (Rips.filter metricQ).value tri|
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rips.filter_value, Rips.filter_value]
  change _ < |Rips.diameter metricP Finset.univ - Rips.diameter metricQ Finset.univ|
  rw [cech_value_p, cech_value_q, rips_value_p, rips_value_q]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.Swap.range_eq
statement: theorem range_eq : Set.range p = Set.range q
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_range, Fin.exists_fin_two, p, q, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one]
  tauto

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.Swap.displacement_eq
statement: theorem displacement_eq : displacement p q = 2
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine (displacement_le_iff p q 2).2 ⟨zero_le_two, fun v => ?_⟩
    fin_cases v <;> norm_num [p, q, Real.dist_eq]
  · have h := dist_le_displacement p q 0
    norm_num [p, q, Real.dist_eq] at h
    exact h

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.radiusAt_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem radiusAt_empty (p : V → X) (x : X) : radiusAt p x ∅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [radiusAt, Finset.fold_empty]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.DisplacementExamples.radiusAt_estimate_fails_of_neg
statement:
theorem radiusAt_estimate_fails_of_neg (p q : V → X) (x : X) :
    (∀ v ∈ (∅ : Finset V), dist (p v) (q v) ≤ -1) ∧
      ¬ radiusAt p x ∅ ≤ radiusAt q x ∅ + -1
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun v hv => absurd hv (Finset.notMem_empty v), ?_⟩
  rw [radiusAt_empty, radiusAt_empty]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.mem_prefixComplex
statement:
theorem mem_prefixComplex (e : CompatibleOrder f) (k : ℕ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ e.prefixComplex k ↔
      ∃ hs : s ∈ K, (e.enum.symm ⟨s, hs⟩).val < k
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.prefixComplex_zero
statement:
theorem prefixComplex_zero (e : CompatibleOrder f) :
    e.prefixComplex 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro s hs
    obtain ⟨_, hidx⟩ := (e.mem_prefixComplex 0 s).mp hs
    omega
  · exact bot_le

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.prefixComplex_eq_self_of_card_le
statement:
theorem prefixComplex_eq_self_of_card_le (e : CompatibleOrder f) (k : ℕ)
    (hk : Fintype.card (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K) ≤ k) :
    e.prefixComplex k = K
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    exact ((e.mem_prefixComplex k s).mp hs).1
  · intro hs
    exact (e.mem_prefixComplex k s).mpr ⟨hs, (e.enum.symm ⟨s, hs⟩).isLt.trans_le hk⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.prefixComplex_mono
statement:
theorem prefixComplex_mono (e : CompatibleOrder f) :
    Monotone e.prefixComplex
proof:
:= by
  intro k l hkl s hs
  obtain ⟨hsK, hsidx⟩ := (e.mem_prefixComplex k s).mp hs
  exact (e.mem_prefixComplex l s).mpr ⟨hsK, lt_of_lt_of_le hsidx hkl⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.sublevelCount_le_card
statement:
theorem sublevelCount_le_card (e : CompatibleOrder f) (r : α) :
    e.sublevelCount r ≤ Fintype.card (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)
proof:
:= by
  unfold sublevelCount
  exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans (Finset.card_fin _).le

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.sublevelCount_mono
statement:
theorem sublevelCount_mono (e : CompatibleOrder f) :
    Monotone e.sublevelCount
proof:
:= by
  intro r q hrq
  unfold sublevelCount
  apply Finset.card_le_card
  intro i hi
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hi ⊢
  exact hi.trans hrq

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.value_le_iff_index_lt_sublevelCount
statement:
theorem value_le_iff_index_lt_sublevelCount (e : CompatibleOrder f) (r : α)
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K))) :
    f.value (e.enum i) ≤ r ↔ i.val < e.sublevelCount r
proof:
:= by
  let S : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K))) :=
    Finset.univ.filter (fun j => f.value (e.enum j) ≤ r)
  have hcount : e.sublevelCount r = S.card := rfl
  constructor
  · intro hi
    have hsub : Finset.Iic i ⊆ S := by
      intro j hj
      have hji : j ≤ i := Finset.mem_Iic.mp hj
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (e.monotone hji).trans hi⟩
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Fin.card_Iic] at hcard
    omega
  · intro hi
    by_contra hnot
    have hsub : S ⊆ Finset.Iio i := by
      intro j hj
      have hjr : f.value (e.enum j) ≤ r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2
      apply Finset.mem_Iio.mpr
      by_contra hji
      have hij : i ≤ j := le_of_not_gt hji
      exact hnot ((e.monotone hij).trans hjr)
    have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    rw [Fin.card_Iio] at hcard
    omega

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.sublevel_eq_prefixComplex
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq_prefixComplex (e : CompatibleOrder f) (r : α) :
    f.sublevel r = e.prefixComplex (e.sublevelCount r)
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨hsK, hgrade⟩ := (f.mem_sublevel_iff r s).mp hs
    apply (e.mem_prefixComplex _ s).mpr
    refine ⟨hsK, ?_⟩
    have h := (e.value_le_iff_index_lt_sublevelCount r
      (e.enum.symm ⟨s, hsK⟩)).mp
    apply h
    simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using hgrade
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨hsK, hidx⟩ := (e.mem_prefixComplex _ s).mp hs
    apply (f.mem_sublevel_iff r s).mpr
    refine ⟨hsK, ?_⟩
    have h := (e.value_le_iff_index_lt_sublevelCount r
      (e.enum.symm ⟨s, hsK⟩)).mpr hidx
    simpa only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] using h

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.reindex_prefixFiltration
statement:
theorem reindex_prefixFiltration (e : CompatibleOrder f) :
    TDA.Filtration.reindex e.thresholdMap e.prefixFiltration =
      f.sublevelFiltration
proof:
:= by
  apply OrderHom.ext
  funext r
  exact (e.sublevel_eq_prefixComplex r).symm

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.dist_le_of_coord
statement:
theorem dist_le_of_coord {x y : Fin 2 → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (h0 : |x 0 - y 0| ≤ c)
    (h1 : |x 1 - y 1| ≤ c) : dist x y ≤ c
proof:
:=
  (dist_pi_le_iff hc).2 (Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨by rwa [Real.dist_eq], by rwa [Real.dist_eq]⟩)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.coord_le_dist
statement: theorem coord_le_dist (x y : Fin 2 → ℝ) (i : Fin 2) : |x i - y i| ≤ dist x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.dist_eq]
  exact dist_le_pi_dist x y i

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.pts_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pts_zero : pts 0 = ![0, 0]
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.pts_one
statement: @[simp] theorem pts_one : pts 1 = ![2, 0]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.pts_two
statement: @[simp] theorem pts_two : pts 2 = ![1, 2]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.pts_mk_two

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.pts_injective
statement: theorem pts_injective : Function.Injective pts
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  have h0 : pts i 0 = pts j 0 := congrFun h 0
  have hx : ∀ k : Fin 3, pts k 0 = ![0, 2, 1] k := by
    intro k
    fin_cases k <;> rfl
  rw [hx, hx] at h0
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> first | rfl | norm_num at h0

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.metric_dist
statement: theorem metric_dist (v w : Fin 3) : metric.dist v w = dist (pts v) (pts w)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.dist_pts_le
statement: theorem dist_pts_le (v w : Fin 3) : dist (pts v) (pts w) ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases v <;> fin_cases w <;>
    exact dist_le_of_coord (by norm_num) (by norm_num [abs_le])
      (by norm_num [abs_le])

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.dist_pts_zero_one
statement: theorem dist_pts_zero_one : dist (pts 0) (pts 1) = 2
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (dist_pts_le 0 1) ?_
  have := coord_le_dist (pts 0) (pts 1) 0
  norm_num at this
  exact this

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.tri_nonempty
statement: theorem tri_nonempty : tri.Nonempty
proof: := ⟨0, by simp [tri]⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.supNormWitness_tri
statement: theorem supNormWitness_tri : supNormWitness pts 1 tri tri_nonempty = ![1, 1]
proof:
:= by

    norm_num [supNormWitness, tri, Finset.sup'_insert, Finset.sup'_singleton]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.tri_mem_complex_one
statement: theorem tri_mem_complex_one : tri ∈ complex pts 1
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_complex_iff _ _ _).2 ⟨tri_nonempty, ![1, 1], ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  simp only [tri, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
  rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    exact dist_le_of_coord (by norm_num) (by norm_num [abs_le])
      (by norm_num [abs_le])

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.tri_not_mem_complex
statement: theorem tri_not_mem_complex {r : ℝ} (hr : r < 1) : tri ∉ complex pts r
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h2 := dist_le_two_mul_of_mem_complex pts h (v := 0) (w := 1)
    (by simp [tri]) (by simp [tri])
  rw [dist_pts_zero_one] at h2
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.rips_value
statement: theorem rips_value : (Rips.filter metric).value triFace = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rips.filter_value]
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (Rips.diameter_le_iff _ _ _).2
      ⟨by norm_num, fun v _ w _ => (metric_dist v w).trans_le (dist_pts_le v w)⟩
  · have := Rips.dist_le_diameter metric (s := tri) (v := 0) (w := 1)
      (by simp [tri]) (by simp [tri])
    rwa [metric_dist, dist_pts_zero_one] at this

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.cech_value
statement: theorem cech_value : (filter pts).value triFace = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [filter_value_eq_rips_div_two metric pts metric_dist, rips_value]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.complex_one_eq_ripsSublevel_two
statement: theorem complex_one_eq_ripsSublevel_two : complex pts 1 = (Rips.filter metric).sublevel 2
proof:
:= by

  rwa [mul_one] at h

statement: theorem tri_mem_complex_six_fifths : tri ∈ complex pts (6 / 5)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Triangle.euclidean_contrast

theorem euclidean_contrast :

  ⟨tri_mem_complex_six_fifths, Examples.Triangle.tri_not_mem_complex⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.pts_injective

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.metric_dist

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.dist_pts

proof:

  apply le_antisymm
  · exact dist_le_of_coord (by norm_num) (by norm_num [pts]) (by norm_num [pts])

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.edge_nonempty

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.edge_mem_complex_one

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.rips_value

proof:

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Diagonal.cech_value

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.Line.value_eq

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.SupNormExamples.EmptyIndex.mem_complex
statement:
theorem mem_complex {V : Type*} (p : V → Fin 0 → ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) {s : Finset V}
    (hs : s.Nonempty) : s ∈ complex p r
proof:
:=
  (mem_complex_iff_pairwise p r s).2 ⟨hs, fun v _ w _ => by
    rw [Subsingleton.elim (p v) (p w), dist_self]
    linarith⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.ext
statement: @[ext] theorem ext {f g : FilterFunction K α} (h : ∀ s, f.value s = g.value s) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  cases f
  cases g
  congr
  funext s
  exact h s

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.map_value
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_value (f : FilterFunction K α) (φ : α ↪o β) (s : TotalFace K) :
    (f.map φ).value s = φ (f.value s)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.map_sublevel_apply
statement:
theorem map_sublevel_apply (f : FilterFunction K α) (φ : α ↪o β) (r : α) :
    (f.map φ).sublevel (φ r) = f.sublevel r
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro s ⟨hs, h⟩
    exact ⟨hs, φ.le_iff_le.1 h⟩
  · rintro s ⟨hs, h⟩
    exact ⟨hs, φ.le_iff_le.2 h⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.map_sublevel_orderIso
statement:
theorem map_sublevel_orderIso (f : FilterFunction K α) (e : α ≃o β) (q : β) :
    (f.map e.toOrderEmbedding).sublevel q = f.sublevel (e.symm q)
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_sublevel_apply f e.toOrderEmbedding (e.symm q)
  simpa only [OrderIso.coe_toOrderEmbedding, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply] using h

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.orderingEquivalent_map
statement:
theorem orderingEquivalent_map (f : FilterFunction K α) (φ : α ↪o β) :
    OrderingEquivalent f (f.map φ)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ => φ.le_iff_le.symm

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.map_refl
statement: theorem map_refl (f : FilterFunction K α) : f.map (RelEmbedding.refl (· ≤ ·)) = f
proof:
:= by

  rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.map_map
statement:
theorem map_map (f : FilterFunction K α) (φ : α ↪o β) (ψ : β ↪o γ) :
    (f.map φ).map ψ = f.map (φ.trans ψ)
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.scale_value
statement:
@[simp] theorem scale_value (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (s : TotalFace K) : (f.scale c hc).value s = c * f.value s
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.scale_sublevel
statement:
theorem scale_sublevel (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c) (r : ℝ) :
    (f.scale c hc).sublevel r = f.sublevel (c⁻¹ * r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [scale, map_sublevel_orderIso, OrderIso.mulLeft₀_symm, OrderIso.mulLeft₀_apply]

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.scale_one
statement: theorem scale_one (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) : f.scale 1 one_pos = f
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  simp

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.scale_scale
statement:
theorem scale_scale (f : FilterFunction K ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    (f.scale a ha).scale b hb = f.scale (b * a) (mul_pos hb ha)
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  simp [mul_assoc]

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalent.refl
statement: theorem refl (f : FilterFunction K α) : OrderingEquivalent f f
proof:
:= by
  intro s t
  rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalent.symm
statement: theorem symm (hfg : OrderingEquivalent f g) : OrderingEquivalent g f
proof:
:= by
  intro s t
  exact (hfg s t).symm

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalent.trans
statement:
theorem trans (hfg : OrderingEquivalent f g) (hgh : OrderingEquivalent g h) :
    OrderingEquivalent f h
proof:
:= by
  intro s t
  exact (hfg s t).trans (hgh s t)

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalent.value_eq_iff
statement:
theorem value_eq_iff (hfg : OrderingEquivalent f g)
    (s t : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K) :
    f.value s = f.value t ↔ g.value s = g.value t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro he
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (hfg s t).mp he.le
    · exact (hfg t s).mp he.ge
  · intro he
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact (hfg s t).mpr he.le
    · exact (hfg t s).mpr he.ge

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalent.sublevel_eq
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq (hfg : OrderingEquivalent f g)
    (s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K) :
    f.sublevel (f.value s) = g.sublevel (g.value s)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨htK, hle⟩ := (f.mem_sublevel_iff _ _).mp ht
    exact (g.mem_sublevel_iff _ _).mpr
      ⟨htK, (hfg ⟨t, htK⟩ s).mp hle⟩
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨htK, hle⟩ := (g.mem_sublevel_iff _ _).mp ht
    exact (f.mem_sublevel_iff _ _).mpr
      ⟨htK, (hfg ⟨t, htK⟩ s).mpr hle⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.orderingEquivalent_iff_exists_rangeOrderIso
statement:
theorem orderingEquivalent_iff_exists_rangeOrderIso
    (f : FilterFunction K α) (g : FilterFunction K β) :
    OrderingEquivalent f g ↔
      ∃ e : Set.range f.value ≃o Set.range g.value,
        ∀ s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K,
          (e ⟨f.value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩).val = g.value s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hfg
    let F : Set.range f.value → Set.range g.value := fun a =>
      ⟨g.value (Classical.choose a.property),
        ⟨Classical.choose a.property, rfl⟩⟩
    have hF (s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K) :
        F ⟨f.value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩ = ⟨g.value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      apply (OrderingEquivalent.value_eq_iff hfg _ _).mp
      exact (Classical.choose_spec (show f.value s ∈ Set.range f.value from ⟨s, rfl⟩))
    have horder (a b : Set.range f.value) : F a ≤ F b ↔ a ≤ b := by
      rcases a with ⟨a, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩
      rcases b with ⟨b, ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩
      simp only [hF]
      exact (hfg s t).symm
    let emb : Set.range f.value ↪o Set.range g.value :=
      OrderEmbedding.ofMapLEIff F horder
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective emb := by
      rintro ⟨b, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩
      exact ⟨⟨f.value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩, hF s⟩
    let e : Set.range f.value ≃o Set.range g.value := OrderIso.ofSurjective emb hsurj
    refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
    intro s
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (hF s)
  · rintro ⟨e, he⟩
    intro s t
    have hs := he s
    have ht := he t
    have hm := map_le_map_iff e
      (a := (⟨f.value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩ : Set.range f.value))
      (b := (⟨f.value t, ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩ : Set.range f.value))
    change (e ⟨f.value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩).val ≤
      (e ⟨f.value t, ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩).val ↔ f.value s ≤ f.value t at hm
    rw [hs, ht] at hm
    exact hm.symm

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.lexKey_injective
statement:
theorem lexKey_injective (C : TDA.Simplicial.FiniteComplex n)
    (f : FilterFunction C.toPre α) :
    Function.Injective (lexKey C f)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hv := congrArg (fun k : Lex (α × Lex (ℕ × Colex (Finset (Fin n)))) =>
    ofColex ((_root_.ofLex ((_root_.ofLex k).2)).2)) h
  simpa [lexKey, _root_.ofLex_toLex, ofColex_toColex] using hv

proof:

  exact (sortedEnumeration C f).key_strictMono

  change Continuous (fun x : ℝ => if s.val = {0} then 0 else
    if s.val = {1} then x else max 0 x)

  · exact continuous_const
  · exact continuous_id
  · exact continuous_const.max continuous_id

name: TDA.Filtration.ClosedFixtures.edgeCard
statement: private theorem edgeCard : Fintype.card (TotalFace edgeC.toPre) = 3
proof: := by decide

name: TDA.Filtration.ClosedFixtures.fixedOrder_apply_cast
statement:
private theorem fixedOrder_apply_cast (i : Fin 3) :
    fixedOrder.enum (Fin.cast edgeCard.symm i) = edgeEnum3 i
proof:
:= by
  change edgeEnum3 ((Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin edgeCard))
    ((Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin edgeCard)).symm i)) = edgeEnum3 i
  simp

name: TDA.Filtration.ClosedFixtures.fixedOrder_apply
statement:
private theorem fixedOrder_apply (i : Fin (Fintype.card (TotalFace edgeC.toPre))) :
    fixedOrder.enum i = edgeEnum3 (Fin.cast edgeCard i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := fixedOrder_apply_cast (Fin.cast edgeCard i)
  simpa only [Fin.cast_cast, Fin.cast_eq_self] using h

name: TDA.Filtration.ClosedFixtures.edgeEnum3_values
statement:
private theorem edgeEnum3_values (x : ℝ) :
    (edgeFamily x).value (edgeEnum3 0) = 0 ∧
    (edgeFamily x).value (edgeEnum3 1) = x ∧
    (edgeFamily x).value (edgeEnum3 2) = max 0 x
proof:
:= by
  simp [edgeFamily, edgeEnum3,
    show ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ≠ {0} by decide,
    show ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ≠ {1} by decide]

name: TDA.Filtration.ClosedFixtures.edgeEnum3_mono
statement:
private theorem edgeEnum3_mono (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    Monotone ((edgeFamily x).value ∘ edgeEnum3)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp_all [edgeEnum3_values]

name: TDA.Filtration.ClosedFixtures.half_line_locus
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d, hd⟩
    have h := d.monotone (show Fin.cast edgeCard.symm (0 : Fin 3) ≤
      Fin.cast edgeCard.symm (1 : Fin 3) by simp)
    rw [hd] at h
    change (edgeFamily x).value (fixedOrder.enum (Fin.cast edgeCard.symm 0)) ≤
      (edgeFamily x).value (fixedOrder.enum (Fin.cast edgeCard.symm 1)) at h
    rw [fixedOrder_apply_cast, fixedOrder_apply_cast] at h
    change 0 ≤ x
    simpa only [(edgeEnum3_values x).1, (edgeEnum3_values x).2.1] using h
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨fixedOrder.transfer ?_, rfl⟩
    intro i j hij
    have h := edgeEnum3_mono x hx ((Fin.cast_le_cast edgeCard).mpr hij)
    change (edgeFamily x).value (fixedOrder.enum i) ≤
      (edgeFamily x).value (fixedOrder.enum j)
    rw [fixedOrder_apply, fixedOrder_apply]
    exact h

name: TDA.Filtration.ClosedFixtures.half_line_closed
proof:
:= by
  exact fixedOrder.isClosed_compatible_locus edgeFamily edgeFamily_continuous

name: TDA.Filtration.ClosedFixtures.half_line_tie
statement:
private theorem half_line_tie :
    ∃ d : CompatibleOrder (edgeFamily 0), d.enum = fixedOrder.enum
proof:
:= by
  have h : (0 : ℝ) ∈ {x : ℝ | 0 ≤ x} := by
    change (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0
    exact le_refl 0
  exact (Set.ext_iff.mp half_line_locus 0).mpr h

name: TDA.Filtration.ClosedFixtures.half_line_excludes_negative_one
statement:
private theorem half_line_excludes_negative_one :
    ¬ ∃ d : CompatibleOrder (edgeFamily (-1)), d.enum = fixedOrder.enum
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hx := (Set.ext_iff.mp half_line_locus (-1)).mp h
  norm_num at hx

name: TDA.Filtration.ClosedFixtures.negative_one_has_other_order
statement:
private theorem negative_one_has_other_order :
    ∃ d : CompatibleOrder (edgeFamily (-1)), d.enum ≠ fixedOrder.enum
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d⟩ := exists_compatibleOrder (edgeFamily (-1))
  exact ⟨d, fun h => half_line_excludes_negative_one ⟨d, h⟩⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.isShiftedSimplicialRelation_of_distortion
statement:
theorem isShiftedSimplicialRelation_of_distortion (dX : MetricSpace X) (dY : MetricSpace Y)
    {C : SetRel X Y} {ε : ℝ≥0}
    (h : ∀ x x' y y', (x,y) ∈ C → (x',y') ∈ C →
      |dX.dist x x' - dY.dist y y'| ≤ (ε : ℝ)) :
    IsShiftedSimplicialRelation (filter dX).sublevelFiltration
      (filter dY).sublevelFiltration (ε : ℝ) C
proof:
:= by
  intro t σ hσ τ hτ hsub
  apply (mem_sublevel_iff dY _ _).mpr
  refine ⟨hτ, ?_⟩
  intro y hy y' hy'
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hsub hy
  obtain ⟨x', hx', hxy'⟩ := hsub hy'
  have hd := ((mem_sublevel_iff dX t σ).mp hσ).2 x hx x' hx'
  have hb := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (h x x' y y' hxy hxy')).2
  linarith

  fin_cases j
  · exact ⟨1, by simp [edge], by norm_num [Subtype.dist_eq, q, Real.dist_eq]⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.WitnessExamples.Intrinsic.intrinsic_value
statement: theorem intrinsic_value : (filter (Set.rangeFactorization q)).value edgeFace = 2
proof:

  · have h := filter_value_le_rips metric (Set.rangeFactorization q) metric_dist_intrinsic
      edgeFace
    rwa [rips_value] at h
  · have : Nonempty (Set.range q) := ⟨Set.rangeFactorization q 0⟩
    refine le_ciInf fun x => ?_
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hfar⟩ := exists_far x
    exact hfar.trans (dist_le_radiusAt _ x hv)

name: TDA.Filtration.Examples.CompatibleOrderExistence.edgeNat_cases
statement:
private theorem edgeNat_cases (s : TotalFace edgeNat) :
    s = vertex0 ∨ s = vertex1 ∨ s = edge
proof:
:= by
  have hs : s.val ⊆ ({0, 1} : Finset ℕ) := s.property.2
  have hn : s.val.Nonempty := s.property.1
  by_cases h0 : 0 ∈ s.val
  · by_cases h1 : 1 ∈ s.val
    · right; right
      apply Subtype.ext
      change s.val = ({0, 1} : Finset ℕ)
      apply Finset.Subset.antisymm hs
      simp only [Finset.insert_subset_iff, Finset.singleton_subset_iff]
      exact ⟨h0, h1⟩
    · left
      apply Subtype.ext
      change s.val = ({0} : Finset ℕ)
      apply Finset.Subset.antisymm
      · intro x hx
        have hx' := hs hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx'
        rcases hx' with h | h
        · simpa using h
        · exact (h1 (h ▸ hx)).elim
      · simpa only [Finset.singleton_subset_iff] using h0
  · by_cases h1 : 1 ∈ s.val
    · right; left
      apply Subtype.ext
      change s.val = ({1} : Finset ℕ)
      apply Finset.Subset.antisymm
      · intro x hx
        have hx' := hs hx
        simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx'
        rcases hx' with h | h
        · exact (h0 (h ▸ hx)).elim
        · simpa using h
      · simpa only [Finset.singleton_subset_iff] using h1
    · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hn
      have hx' := hs hx
      simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx'
      rcases hx' with h | h
      · exact (h0 (h ▸ hx)).elim
      · exact (h1 (h ▸ hx)).elim

name: TDA.Filtration.Examples.CompatibleOrderExistence.graded_witness
statement:
private theorem graded_witness :
    ∃ h : CompatibleOrder gradedFilter,
      h.enum.symm vertex0 < h.enum.symm edge ∧
      h.enum.symm vertex1 < h.enum.symm edge ∧
      Monotone (gradedFilter.value ∘ h.enum)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h⟩ := exists_compatibleOrder gradedFilter
  refine ⟨h, ?_, ?_, h.monotone⟩
  · simpa using h.face_lt (h.enum.symm vertex0) (h.enum.symm edge)
      (by simpa using (show vertex0.val ⊂ edge.val by decide))
  · simpa using h.face_lt (h.enum.symm vertex1) (h.enum.symm edge)
      (by simpa using (show vertex1.val ⊂ edge.val by decide))

proof:

  refine ⟨h, ?_, ?_, h.monotone⟩
  · simpa using h.face_lt (h.enum.symm vertex0) (h.enum.symm edge)
      (by simpa using (show vertex0.val ⊂ edge.val by decide))
  · simpa using h.face_lt (h.enum.symm vertex1) (h.enum.symm edge)

name: TDA.Filtration.Examples.CompatibleOrderExistence.negative_not_mono
statement:
private theorem negative_not_mono :
    ¬ Monotone (negativeFilter.value ∘ edgeEnumCard)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h01 := h (show (0 : Fin 3) ≤ 1 from by decide)
  change negativeFilter.value (edgeEnumCard (0 : Fin 3)) ≤
    negativeFilter.value (edgeEnumCard (1 : Fin 3)) at h01
  have hh : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 0 := by
    simpa only [enum_zero, enum_one,
      negative_value_vertex0, negative_value_vertex1] using h01
  omega

name: TDA.Filtration.Examples.CompatibleOrderExistence.negative_not_reflection
proof:

  have hr := h
    (1 : Fin 3)
    (0 : Fin 3)
    (by simpa only [enum_zero, enum_one,
      negative_value_vertex0, negative_value_vertex1] using
        (show (0 : ℕ) < 1 by decide))
  exact (by decide : ¬ ((1 : Fin 3) < 0)) hr

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.nonneg_of_pairwise
statement:
private theorem nonneg_of_pairwise (p : V → ι → ℝ) {r : ℝ} {s : Finset V} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ s) (h : ∀ v ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, dist (p v) (p w) ≤ 2 * r) : 0 ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := h v hv v hv
  rw [dist_self] at h0
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.dist_supNormWitness_le
statement:
theorem dist_supNormWitness_le (p : V → ι → ℝ) {r : ℝ} {s : Finset V} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (h : ∀ v ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, dist (p v) (p w) ≤ 2 * r) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ s) :
    dist (supNormWitness p r s hs) (p v) ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  have hr := nonneg_of_pairwise p hv h
  refine (dist_pi_le_iff hr).2 fun i => ?_
  rw [Real.dist_eq, abs_le]
  have hle : p v i ≤ s.sup' hs (fun w => p w i) := Finset.le_sup' (fun w => p w i) hv
  have hge : s.sup' hs (fun w => p w i) ≤ p v i + 2 * r := by
    refine Finset.sup'_le hs _ fun w hw => ?_
    have h1 : dist (p w i) (p v i) ≤ 2 * r :=
      (dist_le_pi_dist (p w) (p v) i).trans (h w hw v hv)
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at h1
    linarith [le_abs_self (p w i - p v i)]
  simp only [supNormWitness]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.mem_complex_iff_pairwise
statement:
theorem mem_complex_iff_pairwise (p : V → ι → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ complex p r ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ ∀ v ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, dist (p v) (p w) ≤ 2 * r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    exact ⟨((mem_complex_iff p r s).1 hs).1,
      fun v hv w hw => dist_le_two_mul_of_mem_complex p hs hv hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨hs, h⟩
    exact (mem_complex_iff p r s).2
      ⟨hs, supNormWitness p r s hs, fun v hv => dist_supNormWitness_le p hs h hv⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_value_le_of_pairwise
statement:
theorem filter_value_le_of_pairwise (p : V → ι → ℝ) {r : ℝ}
    (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V))
    (h : ∀ v ∈ s.val, ∀ w ∈ s.val, dist (p v) (p w) ≤ 2 * r) :
    (filter p).value s ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ : s.val.Nonempty := s.property
  exact (filter_value_le_radiusAt p s (supNormWitness p r s.val s.property)).trans
    ((radiusAt_le_iff _ _ _ _).2 ⟨nonneg_of_pairwise p hv₀ h,
      fun v hv => dist_supNormWitness_le p s.property h hv⟩)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.complex_eq_ripsSublevel_two_mul
statement:
theorem complex_eq_ripsSublevel_two_mul (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (r : ℝ) :
    complex p r = (Rips.filter d).sublevel (2 * r)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (complex_le_ripsSublevel_two_mul d p hd r) fun s hs => ?_
  obtain ⟨hsn, h⟩ := (Rips.mem_sublevel_iff d (2 * r) s).1 hs
  exact (mem_complex_iff_pairwise p r s).2 ⟨hsn, fun v hv w hw => by
    rw [← hd]
    exact h v hv w hw⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_value_eq_rips_div_two
statement:
theorem filter_value_eq_rips_div_two (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    (filter p).value s = (Rips.filter d).value s / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hup : (filter p).value s ≤ (Rips.filter d).value s / 2 := by
    refine filter_value_le_of_pairwise p s fun v hv w hw => ?_
    rw [← hd, Rips.filter_value]
    have := Rips.dist_le_diameter d hv hw
    linarith
  have hlo := rips_le_two_mul_filter_value d p hd s
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.sublevel_eq_ripsSublevel_two_mul
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq_ripsSublevel_two_mul (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (r : ℝ) :
    (filter p).sublevel r = (Rips.filter d).sublevel (2 * r)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro s hs
    obtain ⟨hsK, hval⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff _ r s).1 hs
    rw [filter_value_eq_rips_div_two d p hd] at hval
    exact (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ s).2 ⟨hsK, by linarith⟩
  · intro s hs
    obtain ⟨hsK, hval⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ s).1 hs
    refine (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff _ r s).2 ⟨hsK, ?_⟩
    rw [filter_value_eq_rips_div_two d p hd]
    linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.orderingEquivalent_rips
statement:
theorem orderingEquivalent_rips (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) :
    OrderingEquivalent (filter p) (Rips.filter d)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t
  rw [filter_value_eq_rips_div_two d p hd s, filter_value_eq_rips_div_two d p hd t]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.isometry_lineEmbed
statement: private theorem isometry_lineEmbed : Isometry lineEmbed
proof:
:=
  Isometry.of_dist_eq fun x y => dist_pi_const x y

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.lipschitzWith_eval_zero
statement: private theorem lipschitzWith_eval_zero : LipschitzWith 1 fun y : Fin 1 → ℝ => y 0
proof:
:=
  LipschitzWith.mk_one fun x y => dist_le_pi_dist x y 0

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.complex_lineEmbed
statement:
private theorem complex_lineEmbed (q : V → ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    complex (lineEmbed ∘ q) r = complex q r
proof:
:=
  complex_comp_eq_of_retraction isometry_lineEmbed lipschitzWith_eval_zero
    (fun _ => rfl) r

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_lineEmbed_value
statement:
private theorem filter_lineEmbed_value (q : V → ℝ) (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    (filter (lineEmbed ∘ q)).value s = (filter q).value s
proof:
:=
  filter_comp_value_eq_of_retraction isometry_lineEmbed lipschitzWith_eval_zero
    (fun _ => rfl) s

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.dist_lineEmbed
statement:
private theorem dist_lineEmbed (q : V → ℝ) (v w : V) :
    dist ((lineEmbed ∘ q) v) ((lineEmbed ∘ q) w) = dist (q v) (q w)
proof:
:=
  isometry_lineEmbed.dist_eq (q v) (q w)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.mem_complex_iff_pairwise_real
statement:
theorem mem_complex_iff_pairwise_real (q : V → ℝ) (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ complex q r ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ ∀ v ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, dist (q v) (q w) ≤ 2 * r
proof:
:= by
  rw [← complex_lineEmbed, mem_complex_iff_pairwise]
  simp only [dist_lineEmbed]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.complex_eq_ripsSublevel_two_mul_real
statement:
theorem complex_eq_ripsSublevel_two_mul_real (d : MetricSpace V) (q : V → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (r : ℝ) :
    complex q r = (Rips.filter d).sublevel (2 * r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← complex_lineEmbed]
  exact complex_eq_ripsSublevel_two_mul d (lineEmbed ∘ q)
    (fun v w => (hd v w).trans (dist_lineEmbed q v w).symm) r

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_value_eq_rips_div_two_real
statement:
theorem filter_value_eq_rips_div_two_real (d : MetricSpace V) (q : V → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    (filter q).value s = (Rips.filter d).value s / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← filter_lineEmbed_value]
  exact filter_value_eq_rips_div_two d (lineEmbed ∘ q)
    (fun v w => (hd v w).trans (dist_lineEmbed q v w).symm) s

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.mem_fullComplex_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_fullComplex_iff (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ fullComplex V ↔ s.Nonempty
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.distance_nonneg
statement: private theorem distance_nonneg (d : MetricSpace V) (v w : V) : 0 ≤ d.dist v w
proof:
:= by
  let : MetricSpace V := d
  exact dist_nonneg

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.diameter_empty
statement: @[simp] theorem diameter_empty (d : MetricSpace V) : diameter d ∅ = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [diameter]

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.diameter_singleton
statement: @[simp] theorem diameter_singleton (d : MetricSpace V) (v : V) : diameter d {v} = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [diameter]

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.diameter_nonneg
statement: theorem diameter_nonneg (d : MetricSpace V) (s : Finset V) : 0 ≤ diameter d s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Finset.le_fold_max 0).mpr (Or.inl le_rfl)

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.diameter_le_iff
statement:
theorem diameter_le_iff (d : MetricSpace V) (s : Finset V) (r : ℝ) :
    diameter d s ≤ r ↔ 0 ≤ r ∧ ∀ v ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, d.dist v w ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold diameter
  rw [Finset.fold_max_le]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hr, h⟩
    exact ⟨hr, fun v hv w hw => h (v, w) (Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hv, hw⟩)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hr, h⟩
    exact ⟨hr, fun p hp => h p.1 (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).1 p.2
      (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).2⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.dist_le_diameter
statement:
theorem dist_le_diameter (d : MetricSpace V) {s : Finset V} {v w : V}
    (hv : v ∈ s) (hw : w ∈ s) : d.dist v w ≤ diameter d s
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Finset.le_fold_max _).mpr
    (Or.inr ⟨(v, w), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hv, hw⟩, le_rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.diameter_pos
statement:
theorem diameter_pos (d : MetricSpace V) {s : Finset V} (hs : 1 < s.card) :
    0 < diameter d s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, w, hw, hvw⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.1 hs
  let : MetricSpace V := d
  exact (dist_pos.2 hvw).trans_le (dist_le_diameter d hv hw)

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.diameter_mono
statement:
theorem diameter_mono (d : MetricSpace V) {s t : Finset V} (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    diameter d s ≤ diameter d t
proof:
:= by
  apply (diameter_le_iff d s _).mpr
  exact ⟨diameter_nonneg d t, fun _ hv _ hw => dist_le_diameter d (hst hv) (hst hw)⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.diameter_pair
statement:
theorem diameter_pair [DecidableEq V] (d : MetricSpace V) (v w : V) :
    diameter d {v, w} = d.dist v w
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (diameter_le_iff d _ _).mpr
    refine ⟨distance_nonneg d v w, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at ha hb
    rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl <;>
      simp [d.dist_comm]
  · exact dist_le_diameter d (by simp) (by simp)

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.filter_value
statement:
@[simp] theorem filter_value (d : MetricSpace V) (s : TotalFace (fullComplex V)) :
    (filter d).value s = diameter d s.val
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.mem_sublevel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_sublevel_iff (d : MetricSpace V) (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ (filter d).sublevel r ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ ∀ v ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, d.dist v w ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hs, hr⟩
    exact ⟨hs, ((diameter_le_iff d s r).mp hr).2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hs, h⟩
    refine ⟨hs, (diameter_le_iff d s r).mpr ⟨?_, h⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hs
    simpa only [d.dist_self] using h v hv v hv

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.sublevel_eq_bot_of_neg
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq_bot_of_neg (d : MetricSpace V) {r : ℝ} (hr : r < 0) :
    (filter d).sublevel r = ⊥
proof:
:=
  (filter d).sublevel_eq_bot_of_forall_lt r
    (fun s => hr.trans_le (diameter_nonneg d s.val))

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy_nonneg
statement:
theorem pairwiseDiscrepancy_nonneg (d e : MetricSpace V) :
    0 ≤ pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Finset.le_fold_max 0).mpr (Or.inl le_rfl)

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.abs_dist_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem abs_dist_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy (d e : MetricSpace V) (v w : V) :
    |d.dist v w - e.dist v w| ≤ pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Finset.le_fold_max _).mpr
    (Or.inr ⟨(v, w), Finset.mem_univ _, le_rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairwiseDiscrepancy_self (d : MetricSpace V) :
    pairwiseDiscrepancy d d = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm _ (pairwiseDiscrepancy_nonneg d d)
  exact (Finset.fold_max_le 0).mpr ⟨le_rfl, fun _ _ => by simp⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy_of_isEmpty
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairwiseDiscrepancy_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty V] (d e : MetricSpace V) :
    pairwiseDiscrepancy d e = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [pairwiseDiscrepancy]

name: TDA.Filtration.Rips.abs_diameter_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy
statement:
theorem abs_diameter_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy (d e : MetricSpace V) (s : Finset V) :
    |diameter d s - diameter e s| ≤ pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
proof:
:= by
  have hδ := pairwiseDiscrepancy_nonneg d e
  have hpair := abs_dist_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy d e
  have hde : diameter d s ≤ diameter e s + pairwiseDiscrepancy d e := by
    apply (diameter_le_iff d s _).mpr
    refine ⟨add_nonneg (diameter_nonneg e s) hδ, ?_⟩
    intro v hv w hw
    have h := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hpair v w)).1
    have he := dist_le_diameter e hv hw
    linarith
  have hed : diameter e s ≤ diameter d s + pairwiseDiscrepancy d e := by
    apply (diameter_le_iff e s _).mpr
    refine ⟨add_nonneg (diameter_nonneg d s) hδ, ?_⟩
    intro v hv w hw
    have h := (abs_sub_le_iff.mp (hpair v w)).2
    have hd := dist_le_diameter d hv hw
    linarith
  exact abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.mem_support_iff
statement:
theorem mem_support_iff (K : SimplicialFiltration P V) (p : P) (x : V) :
    x ∈ support K p ↔ ({x} : Finset V) ∈ K p
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.mem_bot_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_bot_iff (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) ↔ False
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.face_mono
statement:
theorem face_mono (K : SimplicialFiltration P V) {p q : P} (hpq : p ≤ q)
    {s : Finset V} (hs : s ∈ K p) : s ∈ K q
proof:
:=
  K.monotone hpq hs

name: TDA.Filtration.support_mono
statement:
theorem support_mono (K : SimplicialFiltration P V) {p q : P} (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    support K p ⊆ support K q
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  exact mem_support_iff K q x |>.2 (face_mono K hpq (mem_support_iff K p x |>.1 hx))

name: TDA.Filtration.support_eq_empty_of_eq_bot
statement:
theorem support_eq_empty_of_eq_bot (K : SimplicialFiltration P V) (p : P)
    (hp : K p = ⊥) : support K p = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [support, hp]

name: TDA.Filtration.mem_singletonFace_iff
statement:
theorem mem_singletonFace_iff (x : V) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ singletonFace x ↔ s = {x}
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.vertexBirth_zero
statement: theorem vertexBirth_zero (x : V) : vertexBirth x 0 = ⊥
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.vertexBirth_one
statement: theorem vertexBirth_one (x : V) : vertexBirth x 1 = singletonFace x
proof:

name: TDA.Filtration.mem_vertexBirth_iff
statement:
theorem mem_vertexBirth_iff (x : V) (p : Fin 2) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ vertexBirth x p ↔ p = 1 ∧ s = {x}
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases p <;> simp [vertexBirth_zero, vertexBirth_one, mem_singletonFace_iff]

name: TDA.Filtration.vertexBirth_support_zero
statement: theorem vertexBirth_support_zero (x : V) : support (vertexBirth x) 0 = ∅
proof:
:= by
  exact support_eq_empty_of_eq_bot (vertexBirth x) 0 (vertexBirth_zero x)

name: TDA.Filtration.vertexBirth_support_one
statement: theorem vertexBirth_support_one (x : V) : support (vertexBirth x) 1 = {x}
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp [support, vertexBirth_one, mem_singletonFace_iff]

name: TDA.Filtration.addSingletons_introduces_singleton
statement:
theorem addSingletons_introduces_singleton (x : V) :
    ({x} : Finset V) ∈ (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V).addSingletons
proof:

name: TDA.Filtration.reindex_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem reindex_apply {Q : Type w} [Preorder Q] (u : Q →o P)
    (K : SimplicialFiltration P V) (q : Q) : reindex u K q = K (u q)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.reindex_id

name: TDA.Filtration.reindex_comp

theorem reindex_comp {Q : Type w} [Preorder Q] {S : Type x} [Preorder S]
    (u : Q →o P) (v : S →o Q) (K : SimplicialFiltration P V) :
    reindex v (reindex u K) = reindex (u.comp v) K
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Issue92Fixtures.empty_case
statement:
private theorem empty_case (V : Type u) (α : Type w) [LinearOrder α] (r : α) :
    (emptyFilter V α).criticalValues = ∅ ∧
    (emptyFilter V α).criticalValues.card = 0 ∧
    IsEmpty (Fin (emptyFilter V α).criticalValues.card) ∧
    (emptyFilter V α).sublevel r = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have h : (emptyFilter V α).criticalValues = ∅ :=
    ((emptyFilter V α).criticalValues_eq_empty_iff).2 rfl
  have hc : (emptyFilter V α).criticalValues.card = 0 := by simp [h]
  refine ⟨h, hc, ?_, (emptyFilter V α).sublevel_bot r⟩
  rw [hc]
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Filtration.Issue92Fixtures.empty_ordered_grade
statement:
private theorem empty_ordered_grade :
    (emptyFilter Empty Empty).criticalValues.card = 0 ∧
    IsEmpty (Fin (emptyFilter Empty Empty).criticalValues.card) ∧
    ∃ G : TDA.Filtration.SimplicialFiltration
        (Fin (emptyFilter Empty Empty).criticalValues.card) Empty,
      G = (emptyFilter Empty Empty).gradeFiltration
proof:
:= by
  have h : (emptyFilter Empty Empty).criticalValues = ∅ :=
    ((emptyFilter Empty Empty).criticalValues_eq_empty_iff).2 rfl
  have hc : (emptyFilter Empty Empty).criticalValues.card = 0 := by simp [h]
  refine ⟨hc, ?_, ⟨(emptyFilter Empty Empty).gradeFiltration, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [hc]
  infer_instance

name: TDA.Filtration.Issue92Fixtures.singleton_values
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Filtration.Issue92Fixtures.singleton_case
statement:
private theorem singleton_case :
    singletonFilter.criticalValue s0 = 3 ∧
    singletonFilter.gradeFiltration s0 = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) ∧
    singletonFilter.sublevel 2 = ⊥ ∧
    singletonFilter.sublevel 3 = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) ∧
    ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∉ singletonFilter.gradeFiltration s0 ∧
    singletonFilter.gradeFiltration s0 ≠
      (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hv : singletonFilter.criticalValue s0 = 3 := by
    have hm := singletonFilter.criticalValue_mem s0
    simpa [singleton_values.1] using hm
  have hg : singletonFilter.gradeFiltration s0 = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) := by
    rw [singletonFilter.gradeFiltration_apply, hv]
    apply singletonFilter.sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
    intro s
    simp [singletonFilter]
  have hlow : singletonFilter.sublevel 2 = ⊥ := by
    apply singletonFilter.sublevel_eq_bot_of_forall_lt
    intro s
    norm_num [singletonFilter]
  have hnot : ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∉ singletonFilter.gradeFiltration s0 := by
    rw [hg]
    exact (mem_singletonFace_iff 0 {1}).not.mpr (by decide)
  have hat : singletonFilter.sublevel 3 = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) := by
    apply singletonFilter.sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
    intro s
    simp [singletonFilter]
  refine ⟨hv, hg, hlow, ?_, hnot, ?_⟩
  · exact hat
  · intro h
    have hx : ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ singletonFilter.gradeFiltration s0 := by
      rw [h]
      change ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)).Nonempty
      simp
    exact hnot hx

proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Filtration.Issue92Fixtures.tied_faces
statement:
private theorem tied_faces :
    tiedFilter.criticalValue t0 = 5 ∧
    tiedFilter.gradeFiltration t0 = (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) ∧
    ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ tiedFilter.gradeFiltration t0 ∧
    ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ tiedFilter.gradeFiltration t0 ∧
    ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ tiedFilter.gradeFiltration t0
proof:
:= by
  have hv : tiedFilter.criticalValue t0 = 5 := by
    have hm := tiedFilter.criticalValue_mem t0
    simpa [tied_case.2.1] using hm
  have hg : tiedFilter.gradeFiltration t0 =
      (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) := by
    rw [tiedFilter.gradeFiltration_apply, hv]
    apply tiedFilter.sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
    intro s
    simp [tiedFilter]
  rw [hg]
  refine ⟨hv, rfl, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)).Nonempty
    simp
  · change ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)).Nonempty
    simp
  · change ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 2)).Nonempty
    simp

name: TDA.Filtration.Issue92Fixtures.stepped_values
proof:
:= by

name: TDA.Filtration.Issue92Fixtures.stepped_entries
statement:
private theorem stepped_entries :
    steppedFilter.criticalValue e0 = 0 ∧
    steppedFilter.criticalValue e1 = 2 ∧
    steppedFilter.criticalValue e2 = 5
proof:
:= by
  have hm0 := steppedFilter.criticalValue_mem e0
  have hm1 := steppedFilter.criticalValue_mem e1
  have hm2 := steppedFilter.criticalValue_mem e2
  simp only [stepped_values.1, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hm0 hm1 hm2
  have h01 : steppedFilter.criticalValue e0 < steppedFilter.criticalValue e1 :=
    steppedFilter.criticalValue.strictMono (by decide)
  have h12 : steppedFilter.criticalValue e1 < steppedFilter.criticalValue e2 :=
    steppedFilter.criticalValue.strictMono (by decide)
  omega

name: TDA.Filtration.Issue92Fixtures.stepped_thresholds
statement:
private theorem stepped_thresholds :
    steppedFilter.sublevel (-1) = ⊥ ∧
    steppedFilter.sublevel 0 = steppedFilter.gradeFiltration e0 ∧
    steppedFilter.sublevel 1 = steppedFilter.gradeFiltration e0 ∧
    steppedFilter.sublevel 2 = steppedFilter.gradeFiltration e1 ∧
    steppedFilter.sublevel 4 = steppedFilter.gradeFiltration e1 ∧
    steppedFilter.sublevel 5 = steppedFilter.gradeFiltration e2 ∧
    steppedFilter.sublevel 6 = (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2))
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := stepped_entries
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply steppedFilter.sublevel_eq_bot_of_lt_first (by rw [stepped_values.2]; decide)
    change -1 < steppedFilter.criticalValue e0
    rw [h0]
    omega
  · rw [steppedFilter.gradeFiltration_apply, h0]
  · apply steppedFilter.sublevel_eq_grade_of_adjacent e0 e1 (by decide) 1
    · rw [h0]; omega
    · rw [h1]; omega
  · rw [steppedFilter.gradeFiltration_apply, h1]
  · apply steppedFilter.sublevel_eq_grade_of_adjacent e1 e2 (by decide) 4
    · rw [h1]; omega
    · rw [h2]; omega
  · rw [steppedFilter.gradeFiltration_apply, h2]
  · apply steppedFilter.sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
    intro s
    change (if s.val = {0,1} then (5 : ℤ) else if 1 ∈ s.val then 2 else 0) ≤ 6
    split_ifs <;> omega

name: TDA.Filtration.Issue92Fixtures.stepped_stage_faces
statement:
private theorem stepped_stage_faces :
    ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ steppedFilter.gradeFiltration e0 ∧
    ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∉ steppedFilter.gradeFiltration e0 ∧
    ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ steppedFilter.gradeFiltration e1 ∧
    ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ steppedFilter.gradeFiltration e1 ∧
    ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∉ steppedFilter.gradeFiltration e1 ∧
    steppedFilter.gradeFiltration e2 =
      (⊤ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2))
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨h0, h1, h2⟩ := stepped_entries
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [steppedFilter.gradeFiltration_apply, h0]
    rw [FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)).Nonempty
      simp
    · decide
  · rw [steppedFilter.gradeFiltration_apply, h0]
    rw [FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff]
    intro h
    have hv : steppedFilter.value ⟨{1}, h.1⟩ = 2 := by
      change (if ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) = {0,1} then (5 : ℤ)
        else if 1 ∈ ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) then 2 else 0) = 2
      decide
    omega
  · rw [steppedFilter.gradeFiltration_apply, h1]
    rw [FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)).Nonempty
      simp
    · decide
  · rw [steppedFilter.gradeFiltration_apply, h1]
    rw [FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)).Nonempty
      simp
    · decide
  · rw [steppedFilter.gradeFiltration_apply, h1]
    rw [FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff]
    intro h
    have hv : steppedFilter.value ⟨{0,1}, h.1⟩ = 5 := by
      change (if ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 2)) = {0,1} then (5 : ℤ)
        else if 1 ∈ ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 2)) then 2 else 0) = 5
      decide
    omega
  · rw [steppedFilter.gradeFiltration_apply, h2]
    apply steppedFilter.sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
    intro s
    change (if s.val = {0,1} then (5 : ℤ) else if 1 ∈ s.val then 2 else 0) ≤ 5
    split_ifs <;> omega

name: TDA.Filtration.Issue92Fixtures.coface_tie

    cofaceTieFilter.criticalValue.strictMono (by decide)

name: TDA.Filtration.Issue92Fixtures.rational_entries

  have hm2 := rationalFilter.criticalValue_mem q2
  simp only [rational_values.1, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hm0 hm1 hm2

proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  have hp : (h.enum (Fin.cast edge3_card.symm 1)).val ⊂
      (h.enum (Fin.cast edge3_card.symm 0)).val := by
    rw [hn 1, hn 0]
    decide
  have hi := h.face_lt _ _ hp
  exact (by decide : ¬ (Fin.cast edge3_card.symm (1 : Fin 3) <
    Fin.cast edge3_card.symm (0 : Fin 3))) hi

  exact baseSplitForwardMono ((Fin.castOrderIso edgeCard).monotone hij)

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderTransferExamples.splitForwardNotEquiv
statement:
private theorem splitForwardNotEquiv :
    ¬ OrderingEquivalent constantNat splitForward
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hf : splitForward.value v0 ≤ splitForward.value v1 :=
    (h v0 v1).mp (by decide)
  exact (by decide : ¬ splitForward.value v0 ≤ splitForward.value v1) hf

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderTransferExamples.directEnum

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderTransferExamples.directValues

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderTransferExamples.reversedValues

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderTransferExamples.reversedNotMono
statement:
private theorem reversedNotMono :
    ¬ Monotone (reversed.value ∘ suppliedOrder.enum)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hf : reversed.value (suppliedOrder.enum (Fin.cast edgeCard.symm 0)) ≤
      reversed.value (suppliedOrder.enum (Fin.cast edgeCard.symm 1)) :=
    h (by simp)

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.transfer_enum

theorem CompatibleOrder.transfer_enum (e : CompatibleOrder f)

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalent.monotone_comp

    (e : CompatibleOrder f) : Monotone (g.value ∘ e.enum)

name: TDA.Filtration.IsShiftedSimplicial.vertexMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem IsShiftedSimplicial.vertexMap_apply {f : X → Y}
    (hf : IsShiftedSimplicial F G ε f) (t : ℝ) (x : X) : hf.vertexMap t x = f x
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.IsShiftedSimplicialRelation.of_subordinate
proof:
:= by
  intro t σ hσ
  apply hC t σ hσ (σ.image f)
  · exact Finset.image_nonempty.mpr ((F t).isRelLowerSet_faces hσ).1
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    exact ⟨x, hx, hf rfl⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.IsShiftedSimplicialRelation.contiguous
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  apply hC t σ hσ
  · exact (Finset.image_nonempty.mpr ((F t).isRelLowerSet_faces hσ).1).mono
      Finset.subset_union_left
  · intro y hy
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hy with hy | hy
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
      exact ⟨x, hx, hf rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
      exact ⟨x, hx, hg rfl⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.isShiftedSimplicialRelation_graph_iff
statement:
theorem isShiftedSimplicialRelation_graph_iff (f : X → Y) :
    IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G ε (Function.graph f) ↔ IsShiftedSimplicial F G ε f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h.of_subordinate (Set.Subset.refl _)
  · intro hf t σ hσ τ hτ hsub
    apply ((G (t + ε)).isRelLowerSet_faces (hf t σ hσ)).2 _ hτ
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩ := hsub hy
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.isShiftedSimplicial_id
statement:
theorem isShiftedSimplicial_id (F : SimplicialFiltration ℝ X) :
    IsShiftedSimplicial F F 0 id

  simpa using hσ

name: TDA.Filtration.IsShiftedSimplicial.comp
proof:
:= by
  intro t σ hσ
  simpa only [Finset.image_image, add_assoc] using hg (t + ε) _ (hf t σ hσ)

name: TDA.Filtration.IsShiftedSimplicial.comp_vertexMap
statement:
theorem IsShiftedSimplicial.comp_vertexMap {f : X → Y} {g : Y → Z}
    (hf : IsShiftedSimplicial F G ε f) (hg : IsShiftedSimplicial G H δ g) (t : ℝ) :
    (hf.comp hg).vertexMap t = VertexMap.comp (VertexMap.comp (hf.vertexMap t)
      (hg.vertexMap (t + ε)))
      (inclusionVertexMap (H.monotone (le_of_eq (add_assoc t ε δ))))
proof:
:=
  VertexMap.ext (fun _ => rfl)

name: TDA.Filtration.finite_intermediate
statement:
private theorem finite_intermediate {C : SetRel X Y} {D : SetRel Y Z}
    {σ : Finset X} {τ : Finset Z} (hτ : τ.Nonempty)
    (hsub : (↑τ : Set Z) ⊆ (C.comp D).image ↑σ) :
    ∃ ρ : Finset Y, ρ.Nonempty ∧ (↑ρ : Set Y) ⊆ C.image ↑σ ∧
      (↑τ : Set Z) ⊆ D.image ↑ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hex (z : {z // z ∈ τ}) : ∃ y, y ∈ C.image ↑σ ∧ (y, z.1) ∈ D := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hxy, hyz⟩ := hsub z.2
    exact ⟨y, ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩, hyz⟩
  let w (z : {z // z ∈ τ}) : Y := Classical.choose (hex z)
  have hw (z : {z // z ∈ τ}) := Classical.choose_spec (hex z)
  refine ⟨τ.attach.image w, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hτ
    exact ⟨w ⟨z, hz⟩, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨z,hz⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩⟩
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨z, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    exact (hw z).1
  · intro z hz
    exact ⟨w ⟨z,hz⟩, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨z,hz⟩, Finset.mem_attach _ _, rfl⟩,
      (hw ⟨z,hz⟩).2⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.IsShiftedSimplicialRelation.comp
statement:
theorem IsShiftedSimplicialRelation.comp {C : SetRel X Y} {D : SetRel Y Z}
    (hC : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F G ε C)
    (hD : IsShiftedSimplicialRelation G H δ D) :
    IsShiftedSimplicialRelation F H (ε + δ) (C.comp D)
proof:
:= by
  intro t σ hσ τ hτ hsub
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hρC, hτD⟩ := finite_intermediate hτ hsub
  simpa only [add_assoc] using hD (t + ε) ρ (hC t σ hσ ρ hρ hρC) τ hτ hτD

name: TDA.Filtration.IsShiftedSimplicialRelation.of_subset
proof:
:= by
  intro t σ hσ τ hτ hτC
  exact hC t σ hσ τ hτ (hτC.trans (SetRel.image_subset_image_left hsub))

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.isClosed_compatible_locus
statement:
theorem CompatibleOrder.isClosed_compatible_locus
    (e : CompatibleOrder f0) (F : X → FilterFunction K α)
    (hF : ∀ s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K,
      Continuous (fun x => (F x).value s)) :
    IsClosed {x : X | ∃ d : CompatibleOrder (F x), d.enum = e.enum}
proof:
:= by
  have hclosed : IsClosed {x : X | Monotone ((F x).value ∘ e.enum)} := by
    have hpair : ∀ i j : Fin (Fintype.card (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)),
        IsClosed {x : X | i ≤ j → (F x).value (e.enum i) ≤ (F x).value (e.enum j)} := by
      intro i j
      by_cases hij : i ≤ j
      · simpa only [hij, true_implies] using
          (isClosed_le (hF (e.enum i)) (hF (e.enum j)))
      · simp only [hij, false_implies, Set.ofPred_true, isClosed_univ]
    have h := isClosed_iInter (fun i => isClosed_iInter (hpair i))
    convert h using 1
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_iInter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq]
    change Monotone ((F x).value ∘ e.enum) ↔
      ∀ i j, i ≤ j → (F x).value (e.enum i) ≤ (F x).value (e.enum j)
    rfl
  convert hclosed using 1
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨d, hd⟩
    change Monotone ((F x).value ∘ e.enum)
    rw [← hd]
    exact d.monotone
  · intro hm
    change Monotone ((F x).value ∘ e.enum) at hm
    exact ⟨e.transfer hm, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.complexFiltration_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem complexFiltration_apply (p : V → Z) (r : ℝ) :
    complexFiltration p r = complex p r
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.sublevelFiltration_eq_complexFiltration
statement:
theorem sublevelFiltration_eq_complexFiltration [ProperSpace Z] (p : V → Z) :
    (filter p).sublevelFiltration = complexFiltration p
proof:
:= by
  apply OrderHom.ext
  funext r
  exact sublevel_eq_complex p r

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt_le_add_of_relation
statement:
theorem radiusAt_le_add_of_relation (p : V → Z) (q : W → Z)
    {C : SetRel V W} {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 ≤ ε)
    (h : ∀ v w, (v, w) ∈ C → dist (p v) (q w) ≤ ε)
    (z : Z) {σ : Finset V} {τ : Finset W}
    (hsub : (↑τ : Set W) ⊆ C.image ↑σ) :
    radiusAt q z τ ≤ radiusAt p z σ + ε
proof:
:= by
  refine (radiusAt_le_iff q z τ _).2
    ⟨add_nonneg (radiusAt_nonneg p z σ) hε, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvw⟩ := hsub hw
  calc
    dist z (q w) ≤ dist z (p v) + dist (p v) (q w) := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ radiusAt p z σ + ε := add_le_add (dist_le_radiusAt p z hv) (h v w hvw)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_value_le_add_of_relation
statement:
theorem filter_value_le_add_of_relation (p : V → Z) (q : W → Z)
    {C : SetRel V W} {ε : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ v w, (v, w) ∈ C → dist (p v) (q w) ≤ ε)
    (σ : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) (τ : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex W))
    (hsub : (↑τ.val : Set W) ⊆ C.image ↑σ.val) :
    (filter q).value τ ≤ (filter p).value σ + ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := τ.property
  obtain ⟨v, _, hvw⟩ := hsub hw
  have hε := dist_nonneg.trans (h v w hvw)
  have : Nonempty Z := ⟨p v⟩
  have key : (filter q).value τ - ε ≤ (filter p).value σ := by
    rw [filter_value p]
    refine le_ciInf fun z => ?_
    have := (filter_value_le_radiusAt q τ z).trans
      (radiusAt_le_add_of_relation p q hε h z hsub)
    linarith
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.isShiftedSimplicialRelation_of_dist_le
statement:
theorem isShiftedSimplicialRelation_of_dist_le (p : V → Z) (q : W → Z)
    {C : SetRel V W} {ε : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ v w, (v, w) ∈ C → dist (p v) (q w) ≤ ε) :
    IsShiftedSimplicialRelation (filter p).sublevelFiltration
      (filter q).sublevelFiltration ε C
proof:
:= by
  intro r σ hσ τ hτ hsub
  obtain ⟨hσn, hσr⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff _ r σ).1 hσ
  exact (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff _ (r + ε) τ).2
    ⟨hτ, (filter_value_le_add_of_relation p q h ⟨σ, hσn⟩ ⟨τ, hτ⟩ hsub).trans
      (add_le_add hσr le_rfl)⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.isShiftedSimplicialRelation_complex_of_dist_le
statement:
theorem isShiftedSimplicialRelation_complex_of_dist_le (p : V → Z) (q : W → Z)
    {C : SetRel V W} {ε : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ v w, (v, w) ∈ C → dist (p v) (q w) ≤ ε) :
    IsShiftedSimplicialRelation (complexFiltration p) (complexFiltration q) ε C
proof:
:= by
  intro r σ hσ τ hτ hsub
  obtain ⟨_, z, hz⟩ := (mem_complex_iff p r σ).1 hσ
  refine (mem_complex_iff q (r + ε) τ).2 ⟨hτ, z, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvw⟩ := hsub hw
  exact (dist_triangle z (p v) (q w)).trans (add_le_add (hz v hv) (h v w hvw))

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.edgeCard
statement: private theorem edgeCard : Fintype.card (TotalFace edge3.toPre) = 3
proof: := by decide

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.enumPreimageCard
statement:
private theorem enumPreimageCard {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α]
    {f : FilterFunction edge3.toPre α} (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (s : TotalFace edge3.toPre) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => e.enum i = s)).card = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter (fun i => e.enum i = s) = {e.enum.symm s} := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro hi
      have h := congrArg e.enum.symm hi
      simpa using h
    · intro hi
      subst i
      exact e.enum.apply_symm_apply s
  simp [hfilter]

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.variableCountBetween
statement:
private theorem variableCountBetween (r : ℤ) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr5 : r < 5) :
    (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevelCount r = 1
proof:
:= by
  let e := ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter
  change (Finset.univ.filter
    (fun i => edgeVariableFilter.value (e.enum i) ≤ r)).card = 1
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter
      (fun i => edgeVariableFilter.value (e.enum i) ≤ r) =
      Finset.univ.filter
        (fun i => e.enum i = ⟨{1}, by decide⟩) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro hi
      by_cases hface : (e.enum i).val = {1}
      · exact Subtype.ext hface
      · have h5 : (5 : ℤ) ≤ r := by
          simpa [edgeVariableFilter, hface] using hi
        exact False.elim ((not_le_of_gt hr5) h5)
    · intro hi
      have hface := congrArg Subtype.val hi
      simp [edgeVariableFilter, hface, hr0]
  rw [hfilter]
  exact enumPreimageCard e ⟨{1}, by decide⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.variableCountNeg
statement:
private theorem variableCountNeg :
    (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevelCount (-1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let e := ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter
  change (Finset.univ.filter
    (fun i => edgeVariableFilter.value (e.enum i) ≤ (-1 : ℤ))).card = 0
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter
      (fun i => edgeVariableFilter.value (e.enum i) ≤ (-1 : ℤ)) = ∅ := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro hi
      by_cases hface : (e.enum i).val = {1}
      · simp [edgeVariableFilter, hface] at hi
      · simp [edgeVariableFilter, hface] at hi
    · intro hi
      simp at hi
  simp [hfilter]

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.variableCountAtLeastFive
statement:
private theorem variableCountAtLeastFive (r : ℤ) (hr5 : 5 ≤ r) :
    (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevelCount r = 3
proof:
:= by
  let e := ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter
  change (Finset.univ.filter
    (fun i => edgeVariableFilter.value (e.enum i) ≤ r)).card = 3
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter
      (fun i => edgeVariableFilter.value (e.enum i) ≤ r) = Finset.univ := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    by_cases hface : (e.enum i).val = {1}
    · simp only [edgeVariableFilter, hface]
      constructor
      · intro _
        trivial
      · intro _
        omega
    · simp [edgeVariableFilter, hface, hr5]
  rw [hfilter]
  simp [edgeCard]

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.ofLexEdgeEnum3_key_strict
statement:
private theorem ofLexEdgeEnum3_key_strict (f : FilterFunction edge3.toPre ℤ) :
    StrictMono (lexKey edge3 f ∘ edgeEnum3 f (ofLex edge3 f))
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  change lexKey edge3 f ((ofLex edge3 f).enum (Fin.cast edgeCard.symm i)) <
    lexKey edge3 f ((ofLex edge3 f).enum (Fin.cast edgeCard.symm j))
  apply ofLex_key_strictMono edge3 f
  simpa using hij

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.canonicalTiedEnumZero
statement:
private theorem canonicalTiedEnumZero :
    (edgeEnum3 (constantFilter edge3 5) canonicalTied 0).val = {0}
proof:
:= by
  let e := edgeEnum3 (constantFilter edge3 5) canonicalTied
  have hkey01 :
      lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) ⟨{0}, by decide⟩ <
        lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) ⟨{1}, by decide⟩ := by decide
  have hkey0edge :
      lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) ⟨{0}, by decide⟩ <
        lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) ⟨{0, 1}, by decide⟩ := by decide
  have hstrict := ofLexEdgeEnum3_key_strict (constantFilter edge3 5)
  have hmem : (e 0).val ∈ edge3.faces := (e 0).property
  have hcases : (e 0).val = {0} ∨ (e 0).val = {1} ∨
      (e 0).val = {0, 1} := by simpa [edge3] using hmem
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | hedge
  · exact h0
  · exfalso
    let i : Fin 3 := e.symm ⟨{0}, by decide⟩
    have hne : i ≠ 0 := by
      intro hi
      have happly := e.apply_symm_apply (⟨{0}, by decide⟩ : TotalFace edge3.toPre)
      have henum0 : e 0 = ⟨{0}, by decide⟩ := by simpa [i, hi] using happly
      have hv := congrArg Subtype.val henum0
      have hneq : ({0} : Finset (Fin 3)) ≠ {1} := by decide
      exact hneq (hv.symm.trans h1)
    have hi : (0 : Fin 3) < i := by omega
    have hlt := hstrict hi
    have henum0 : e 0 = ⟨{1}, by decide⟩ := Subtype.ext h1
    have henumi := e.apply_symm_apply (⟨{0}, by decide⟩ : TotalFace edge3.toPre)
    change lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) (e 0) <
      lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) (e i) at hlt
    rw [henum0, henumi] at hlt
    exact (lt_asymm hkey01 hlt)
  · exfalso
    let i : Fin 3 := e.symm ⟨{0}, by decide⟩
    have hne : i ≠ 0 := by
      intro hi
      have happly := e.apply_symm_apply (⟨{0}, by decide⟩ : TotalFace edge3.toPre)
      have henum0 : e 0 = ⟨{0}, by decide⟩ := by simpa [i, hi] using happly
      have hv := congrArg Subtype.val henum0
      have hneq : ({0} : Finset (Fin 3)) ≠ {0, 1} := by decide
      exact hneq (hv.symm.trans hedge)
    have hi : (0 : Fin 3) < i := by omega
    have hlt := hstrict hi
    have henum0 : e 0 = ⟨{0, 1}, by decide⟩ := Subtype.ext hedge
    have henumi := e.apply_symm_apply (⟨{0}, by decide⟩ : TotalFace edge3.toPre)
    have hkeyorder :
        lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) ⟨{0}, by decide⟩ <
          lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) ⟨{0, 1}, by decide⟩ := hkey0edge
    change lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) (e 0) <
      lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) (e i) at hlt
    rw [henum0, henumi] at hlt
    exact (lt_asymm hkeyorder hlt)

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.canonicalTiedEnumOne
statement:
private theorem canonicalTiedEnumOne :
    (edgeEnum3 (constantFilter edge3 5) canonicalTied 1).val = {1}
proof:
:= by
  let e := edgeEnum3 (constantFilter edge3 5) canonicalTied
  have hkey1edge :
      lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) ⟨{1}, by decide⟩ <
        lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) ⟨{0, 1}, by decide⟩ := by decide
  have hstrict := ofLexEdgeEnum3_key_strict (constantFilter edge3 5)
  have hmem : (e 1).val ∈ edge3.faces := (e 1).property
  have hcases : (e 1).val = {0} ∨ (e 1).val = {1} ∨
      (e 1).val = {0, 1} := by simpa [edge3] using hmem
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | hedge
  · exfalso
    have hzero : e 0 = ⟨{0}, by decide⟩ := Subtype.ext canonicalTiedEnumZero
    have hone : e 1 = ⟨{0}, by decide⟩ := Subtype.ext h0
    have hEq : e 0 = e 1 := hzero.trans hone.symm
    have hidx := e.injective hEq
    omega
  · exact h1
  · exfalso
    let i : Fin 3 := e.symm ⟨{1}, by decide⟩
    have hne0 : i ≠ 0 := by
      intro hi
      have happly := e.apply_symm_apply (⟨{1}, by decide⟩ : TotalFace edge3.toPre)
      have hone : e 0 = ⟨{1}, by decide⟩ := by simpa [i, hi] using happly
      have hv := congrArg Subtype.val hone
      have hzero : (e 0).val = {0} := canonicalTiedEnumZero
      have hneq : ({0} : Finset (Fin 3)) ≠ {1} := by decide
      exact hneq (hzero.symm.trans hv)
    have hne1 : i ≠ 1 := by
      intro hi
      have happly := e.apply_symm_apply (⟨{1}, by decide⟩ : TotalFace edge3.toPre)
      have hone : e 1 = ⟨{1}, by decide⟩ := by simpa [i, hi] using happly
      have hv := congrArg Subtype.val hone
      exact (by decide : ({1} : Finset (Fin 3)) ≠ {0, 1}) (hv.symm.trans hedge)
    have i2 : i = 2 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      omega
    have hlt := hstrict (by decide : (1 : Fin 3) < 2)
    have hone : e 1 = ⟨{0, 1}, by decide⟩ := Subtype.ext hedge
    have htwo : e 2 = ⟨{1}, by decide⟩ := by
      calc
        e 2 = e i := congrArg e i2.symm
        _ = ⟨{1}, by decide⟩ :=
          e.apply_symm_apply (⟨{1}, by decide⟩ : TotalFace edge3.toPre)
    change lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) (e 1) <
      lexKey edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5) (e 2) at hlt
    rw [hone, htwo] at hlt
    exact (lt_asymm hkey1edge hlt)

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.canonicalTiedEnumTwo
statement:
private theorem canonicalTiedEnumTwo :
    (edgeEnum3 (constantFilter edge3 5) canonicalTied 2).val = {0, 1}
proof:
:= by
  let e := edgeEnum3 (constantFilter edge3 5) canonicalTied
  have hmem : (e 2).val ∈ edge3.faces := (e 2).property
  have hcases : (e 2).val = {0} ∨ (e 2).val = {1} ∨
      (e 2).val = {0, 1} := by simpa [edge3] using hmem
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | hedge
  · exfalso
    have hzero : e 0 = ⟨{0}, by decide⟩ := Subtype.ext canonicalTiedEnumZero
    have htwo : e 2 = ⟨{0}, by decide⟩ := Subtype.ext h0
    have hEq : e 0 = e 2 := hzero.trans htwo.symm
    have hidx := e.injective hEq
    omega
  · exfalso
    have hone : e 1 = ⟨{1}, by decide⟩ := Subtype.ext canonicalTiedEnumOne
    have htwo : e 2 = ⟨{1}, by decide⟩ := Subtype.ext h1
    have hEq : e 1 = e 2 := hone.trans htwo.symm
    have hidx := e.injective hEq
    omega
  · exact hedge

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.canonicalTiedIndexZero
statement:
private theorem canonicalTiedIndexZero :
    (canonicalTied.enum.symm ⟨{0}, by decide⟩).val = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hidx : canonicalTied.enum.symm ⟨{0}, by decide⟩ = Fin.cast edgeCard.symm 0 := by
    apply canonicalTied.enum.injective
    calc
      canonicalTied.enum (canonicalTied.enum.symm ⟨{0}, by decide⟩) =
          ⟨{0}, by decide⟩ := canonicalTied.enum.apply_symm_apply _
      _ = canonicalTied.enum (Fin.cast edgeCard.symm 0) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        exact canonicalTiedEnumZero.symm
  simpa using congrArg Fin.val hidx

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.canonicalTiedIndexOne
statement:
private theorem canonicalTiedIndexOne :
    (canonicalTied.enum.symm ⟨{1}, by decide⟩).val = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hidx : canonicalTied.enum.symm ⟨{1}, by decide⟩ = Fin.cast edgeCard.symm 1 := by
    apply canonicalTied.enum.injective
    calc
      canonicalTied.enum (canonicalTied.enum.symm ⟨{1}, by decide⟩) =
          ⟨{1}, by decide⟩ := canonicalTied.enum.apply_symm_apply _
      _ = canonicalTied.enum (Fin.cast edgeCard.symm 1) := by
        apply Subtype.ext

  simpa using congrArg Fin.val hidx

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.canonicalTiedIndexTwo
statement:
private theorem canonicalTiedIndexTwo :

proof:

        apply Subtype.ext
        exact canonicalTiedEnumTwo.symm

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.empty0_all
statement:
private theorem empty0_all (k : ℕ) :
    (ofLex empty0 (emptyFilter empty0 rfl ℤ)).prefixComplex k = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Fintype.card (TotalFace empty0.toPre) = 0 := by decide
  have h := (ofLex empty0 (emptyFilter empty0 rfl ℤ)).prefixComplex_eq_self_of_card_le k
    (by omega)
  have he : empty0.toPre = ⊥ := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · intro s hs
      have hs' : s ∈ empty0.faces := hs
      simp [empty0] at hs'
    · exact bot_le
  exact h.trans he

proof:

  constructor
  · exact prefixComplex_eq_self_of_card_le _ 1 (by decide)
  · exact prefixComplex_eq_self_of_card_le _ 4 (by decide)

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.singletonCounts

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.singletonAbsentVertex

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.tiedCounts
