name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.canonicalPrefixOne
statement:
private theorem canonicalPrefixOne :
    canonicalTied.prefixComplex 1 = singleton3.toPre
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨hsK, hidx⟩ := (canonicalTied.mem_prefixComplex 1 s).mp hs
    have hcases : s = {0} ∨ s = {1} ∨ s = {0, 1} := by
      have hm : s ∈ edge3.faces := hsK
      simpa [edge3] using hm
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h01
    · subst s
      change ({0} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈ singleton3.faces
      simp [singleton3]
    · subst s
      have hi : (canonicalTied.enum.symm ⟨({1} : Finset (Fin 3)), hsK⟩).val = 1 := by
        simpa using canonicalTiedIndexOne
      rw [hi] at hidx
      omega
    · subst s
      have hi :
          (canonicalTied.enum.symm ⟨({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 3)), hsK⟩).val = 2 := by
        simpa using canonicalTiedIndexTwo
      rw [hi] at hidx
      omega
  · intro hs
    have hs0 : s = {0} := by
      have hm : s ∈ singleton3.faces := hs
      simp [singleton3] at hm
      exact hm
    subst s
    apply (canonicalTied.mem_prefixComplex 1 {0}).mpr
    refine ⟨by decide, ?_⟩
    simp [canonicalTiedIndexZero]

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.canonicalPrefixTwo
statement:
private theorem canonicalPrefixTwo :
    canonicalTied.prefixComplex 2 = twoVertices3.toPre
proof:
:= by
  ext s
  constructor
  · intro hs
    obtain ⟨hsK, hidx⟩ := (canonicalTied.mem_prefixComplex 2 s).mp hs
    have hcases : s = {0} ∨ s = {1} ∨ s = {0, 1} := by
      have hm : s ∈ edge3.faces := hsK
      simpa [edge3] using hm
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h01
    · subst s
      change ({0} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈ twoVertices3.faces
      simp [twoVertices3]
    · subst s
      have hi : (canonicalTied.enum.symm ⟨({1} : Finset (Fin 3)), hsK⟩).val = 1 := by
        simpa using canonicalTiedIndexOne
      rw [hi] at hidx
      change ({1} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈ twoVertices3.faces
      simp [twoVertices3]
    · subst s
      have hi :
          (canonicalTied.enum.symm ⟨({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 3)), hsK⟩).val = 2 := by
        simpa using canonicalTiedIndexTwo
      rw [hi] at hidx
      omega
  · intro hs
    change s ∈ twoVertices3.faces at hs
    simp [twoVertices3] at hs
    have hcases : s = {0} ∨ s = {1} := hs
    rcases hcases with h0 | h1
    · subst s
      apply (canonicalTied.mem_prefixComplex 2 {0}).mpr
      refine ⟨by decide, ?_⟩
      simp [canonicalTiedIndexZero]
    · subst s
      apply (canonicalTied.mem_prefixComplex 2 {1}).mpr
      refine ⟨by decide, ?_⟩
      simp [canonicalTiedIndexOne]

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.tiedCanonicalStages
statement:
private theorem tiedCanonicalStages :
    canonicalTied.prefixComplex 0 = ⊥ ∧
    canonicalTied.prefixComplex 1 = singleton3.toPre ∧
    canonicalTied.prefixComplex 2 = twoVertices3.toPre ∧
    canonicalTied.prefixComplex 3 = edge3.toPre
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨prefixComplex_zero _, canonicalPrefixOne, canonicalPrefixTwo,
    prefixComplex_eq_self_of_card_le _ 3 (by decide)⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.canonicalTiedIntermediateNotSublevel
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  have hone : ({0} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈ canonicalTied.prefixComplex 1 := by
    rw [canonicalPrefixOne]
    change ({0} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈ singleton3.faces
    simp [singleton3]
  have hzero : ({1} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∉ canonicalTied.prefixComplex 1 := by
    rw [canonicalPrefixOne]
    change ¬ ({1} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈ singleton3.faces
    simp [singleton3]
  have hr5 : (5 : ℤ) ≤ r := by
    have hm : ({0} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈
        (constantFilter edge3 5).sublevel r := hr ▸ hone
    exact ((constantFilter edge3 5).mem_sublevel_iff r {0}).mp hm |>.2
  have hm : ({1} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈ (constantFilter edge3 5).sublevel r := by
    exact ((constantFilter edge3 5).mem_sublevel_iff r {1}).mpr
      ⟨by decide, by simpa [constantFilter] using hr5⟩
  exact hzero (hr.symm ▸ hm)

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.absentVertex
proof:
:= by
  intro k h
  exact (by decide : ({2} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∉ edge3.toPre)
    (((ofLex edge3 (constantFilter edge3 5)).mem_prefixComplex k {2}).mp h).1

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.nonconstantRecovery
statement:
private theorem nonconstantRecovery :
    ∀ r ∈ ({-1, 0, 4, 5, 6} : Finset ℤ),
      edgeVariableFilter.sublevel r =
        (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).prefixComplex
          ((ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevelCount r)
proof:
:= by
  intro r _
  exact (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevel_eq_prefixComplex r

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.nonconstantCounts
statement:
private theorem nonconstantCounts :
    (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevelCount (-1) = 0 ∧
    (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevelCount 0 = 1 ∧
    (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevelCount 4 = 1 ∧
    (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevelCount 5 = 3 ∧
    (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevelCount 6 = 3
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨variableCountNeg, variableCountBetween 0 (by omega) (by omega),
    variableCountBetween 4 (by omega) (by omega),
    variableCountAtLeastFive 5 (by omega), variableCountAtLeastFive 6 (by omega)⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.nonconstantConcreteRecovery
statement:
private theorem nonconstantConcreteRecovery :
    edgeVariableFilter.sublevel (-1) =
        (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).prefixComplex 0 ∧
    edgeVariableFilter.sublevel 0 =
        (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).prefixComplex 1 ∧
    edgeVariableFilter.sublevel 4 =
        (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).prefixComplex 1 ∧
    edgeVariableFilter.sublevel 5 =
        (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).prefixComplex 3 ∧
    edgeVariableFilter.sublevel 6 =
        (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).prefixComplex 3
proof:
:= by
  rcases nonconstantCounts with ⟨hneg, hzero, hfour, hfive, hsix⟩
  exact ⟨by simpa [hneg] using (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevel_eq_prefixComplex (-1),
    by simpa [hzero] using (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevel_eq_prefixComplex 0,
    by simpa [hfour] using (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevel_eq_prefixComplex 4,
    by simpa [hfive] using (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevel_eq_prefixComplex 5,
    by simpa [hsix] using (ofLex edge3 edgeVariableFilter).sublevel_eq_prefixComplex 6⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.alternateFirst
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply (alternateOrder.mem_prefixComplex 1 {1}).mpr
    refine ⟨by decide, ?_⟩
    decide
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨_, hi⟩ := (alternateOrder.mem_prefixComplex 1 {0}).mp h
    have hn : ¬ (alternateOrder.enum.symm ⟨({0} : Finset (Fin 3)), by decide⟩).val < 1 := by
      decide
    exact hn hi

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.alternateSecond
statement:
private theorem alternateSecond :
    ({0} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈ alternateOrder.prefixComplex 2 ∧
    ({1} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈ alternateOrder.prefixComplex 2 ∧
    ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∉ alternateOrder.prefixComplex 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · apply (alternateOrder.mem_prefixComplex 2 {0}).mpr
    exact ⟨by decide, by decide⟩
  constructor
  · apply (alternateOrder.mem_prefixComplex 2 {1}).mpr
    exact ⟨by decide, by decide⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨_, hi⟩ := (alternateOrder.mem_prefixComplex 2 {0, 1}).mp h
    have hn : ¬ (alternateOrder.enum.symm
      ⟨({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 3)), by decide⟩).val < 2 := by decide
    exact hn hi

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.tiedIntermediateNotSublevel
statement:
private theorem tiedIntermediateNotSublevel :
    ¬ ∃ r : ℤ, alternateOrder.prefixComplex 1 = (constantFilter edge3 5).sublevel r
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
  have hone := alternateFirst.1
  have hzero := alternateFirst.2
  have hr5 : (5 : ℤ) ≤ r := by
    have hm : ({1} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈ (constantFilter edge3 5).sublevel r :=
      hr ▸ hone
    exact ((constantFilter edge3 5).mem_sublevel_iff r {1}).mp hm |>.2
  have hm : ({0} : Finset (Fin 3)) ∈ (constantFilter edge3 5).sublevel r := by
    exact ((constantFilter edge3 5).mem_sublevel_iff r {0}).mpr
      ⟨by decide, by simpa [constantFilter]⟩
  exact hzero (hr.symm ▸ hm)

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.alternateRecovery
proof:
:= by
  exact alternateOrder.sublevel_eq_prefixComplex r

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.rationalCount
statement:
private theorem rationalCount :
    (ofLex edge3 rationalFilter).sublevelCount (3 / 2 : ℚ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let e := ofLex edge3 rationalFilter
  change (Finset.univ.filter
    (fun i => rationalFilter.value (e.enum i) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℚ))).card = 1
  have hfilter : Finset.univ.filter
      (fun i => rationalFilter.value (e.enum i) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℚ)) =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun i => e.enum i = ⟨{0}, by decide⟩) := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro hi
      by_cases hzero : (e.enum i).val = {0}
      · exact Subtype.ext hzero
      · by_cases hone : (e.enum i).val = {1}
        · have h2 : (2 : ℚ) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℚ) := by
            simpa [rationalFilter, hzero, hone] using hi
          norm_num at h2
        · have h5 : (5 : ℚ) ≤ (3 / 2 : ℚ) := by
            simpa [rationalFilter, hzero, hone] using hi
          norm_num at h5
    · intro hi
      have hzero := congrArg Subtype.val hi
      norm_num [rationalFilter, hzero]
  rw [hfilter]
  exact enumPreimageCard e ⟨{0}, by decide⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrderPrefixExamples.rationalRecovery
proof:
:= by
  simpa [rationalCount] using
    (ofLex edge3 rationalFilter).sublevel_eq_prefixComplex (3 / 2 : ℚ)

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.empty_coordinates
statement:
private theorem empty_coordinates {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {β : Type v} (F : X → Fin 0 → β) :
    orderChamber F = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [orderChamber, eqLocus]

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.singleton_coordinates
statement:
private theorem singleton_coordinates {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {β : Type v} (F : X → Unit → β) :
    orderChamber F = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ i j : Unit, eqLocus F i j = Set.univ := by
    intro i j
    cases i; cases j
    simp [eqLocus]
  simp [orderChamber, h]

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.empty_parameters
statement:
private theorem empty_parameters {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    {β : Type v} [LinearOrder β] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderClosedTopology β]
    (F : Empty → ι → β)
    (hF : ∀ i, Continuous (fun x => F x i)) :
    IsOpen (orderChamber F) ∧ Dense (orderChamber F) ∧
      ∀ x₀ ∈ orderChamber F,
        ∃ U : Set Empty, IsOpen U ∧ x₀ ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ orderChamber F ∧
          ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ i j,
            (F x₀ i ≤ F x₀ j ↔ F x i ≤ F x j)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isOpen_orderChamber F, dense_orderChamber F hF, ?_⟩
  intro x₀ _
  exact x₀.elim

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.persistent_ties
statement:
private theorem persistent_ties {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {ι : Type v} {β : Type w} (g : X → β) :
    orderChamber (fun x (_ : ι) => g x) = Set.univ
proof:
:= by
  simp [orderChamber, eqLocus]

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.varying_tied_grades
statement:
private theorem varying_tied_grades :
    orderChamber (fun x : ℝ => fun _ : Fin 2 => x) = Set.univ
proof:
:=
  persistent_ties id

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.chamber_of_open_eq_status
statement:
private theorem chamber_of_open_eq_status {X : Type u} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {ι : Type v} {β : Type w} [TopologicalSpace β] [T2Space β]
    (F : X → ι → β) (hF : ∀ i, Continuous (fun x => F x i))
    (x₀ : X) (U : Set X) (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hxU : x₀ ∈ U)
    (hstatus : ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i j, F y i = F y j ↔ F x₀ i = F x₀ j) :
    x₀ ∈ orderChamber F
proof:
:= by
  intro hbad
  change x₀ ∈ ⋃ i, ⋃ j, frontier (eqLocus F i j) at hbad
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hbad
  obtain ⟨j, hfr⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hi
  by_cases heq : F x₀ i = F x₀ j
  · have hsub : U ⊆ eqLocus F i j := by
      intro y hy
      exact (hstatus y hy i j).mpr heq
    have hint : x₀ ∈ interior (eqLocus F i j) :=
      interior_maximal hsub hUopen hxU
    exact ((mem_interior_iff_notMem_frontier (s := eqLocus F i j) (x := x₀) heq).mp hint) hfr
  · have hclosed : IsClosed (eqLocus F i j) :=
      isClosed_eq (hF i) (hF j)
    exact heq (hclosed.frontier_subset hfr)

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.crossing_eq_locus
statement: private theorem crossing_eq_locus : eqLocus crossing 0 1 = ({0} : Set ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [eqLocus, crossing]

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.crossing_continuous
statement:
private theorem crossing_continuous (i : Fin 2) :
    Continuous (fun x => crossing x i)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · change Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ))
    exact continuous_const
  · change Continuous (fun x : ℝ => x)
    exact continuous_id

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.crossing_chamber
statement:
private theorem crossing_chamber :
    orderChamber crossing = ({0} : Set ℝ)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx hx0
    have hfr : frontier (eqLocus crossing 0 1) = ({0} : Set ℝ) := by
      rw [crossing_eq_locus, isClosed_singleton.frontier_eq, interior_singleton]
      simp
    have hbad : x ∈ frontier (eqLocus crossing 0 1) := by
      rw [hfr]
      exact hx0
    exact hx (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨0, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨1, hbad⟩⟩)
  · intro hx
    have hne : x ≠ 0 := by simpa using hx
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hneg | hpos
    · refine chamber_of_open_eq_status crossing crossing_continuous x
        (Set.Iio 0) isOpen_Iio hneg ?_
      intro y hy i j
      change y < 0 at hy
      have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := hy.ne
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [crossing, eq_comm]
    · refine chamber_of_open_eq_status crossing crossing_continuous x
        (Set.Ioi 0) isOpen_Ioi hpos ?_
      intro y hy i j
      change 0 < y at hy
      have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := hy.ne'
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [crossing, eq_comm]

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.crossing_weak_orders_differ
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h01 := h 0 1
  norm_num [crossing] at h01

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.crossing_no_stable_open_zero
statement:
private theorem crossing_no_stable_open_zero :
    ¬ ∃ U : Set ℝ, IsOpen U ∧ 0 ∈ U ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ i j : Fin 2,
        (crossing 0 i ≤ crossing 0 j ↔ crossing x i ≤ crossing x j)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨U, hopen, hzero, hcomp⟩
  have hsubset : U ⊆ ({0} : Set ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    have h01 := (hcomp x hx 0 1).mp (by norm_num [crossing])
    have h10 := (hcomp x hx 1 0).mp (by norm_num [crossing])
    have : x = 0 := le_antisymm (by simpa [crossing] using h10)
      (by simpa [crossing] using h01)
    simpa using this
  have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ interior ({0} : Set ℝ) :=
    interior_maximal hsubset hopen hzero
  simp [interior_singleton] at hmem

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.open_tie_eq_locus
statement:
private theorem open_tie_eq_locus :
    eqLocus openTie 1 2 = Set.Ici 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  change x = |x| ↔ 0 ≤ x
  exact eq_comm.trans abs_eq_self

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.open_tie_continuous
statement:
private theorem open_tie_continuous (i : Fin 3) :
    Continuous (fun x => openTie x i)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · change Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ))
    exact continuous_const
  · change Continuous (fun x : ℝ => x)
    exact continuous_id
  · change Continuous (fun x : ℝ => |x|)
    exact continuous_id.abs

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.open_tie_chamber
statement:
private theorem open_tie_chamber :
    orderChamber openTie = ({0} : Set ℝ)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx hx0
    have hfr : frontier (eqLocus openTie 1 2) = ({0} : Set ℝ) := by
      rw [open_tie_eq_locus, frontier_Ici]
    have hbad : x ∈ frontier (eqLocus openTie 1 2) := by
      rw [hfr]
      exact hx0
    exact hx (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨1, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨2, hbad⟩⟩)
  · intro hx
    have hne : x ≠ 0 := by simpa using hx
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hneg | hpos
    · refine chamber_of_open_eq_status openTie open_tie_continuous x
        (Set.Iio 0) isOpen_Iio hneg ?_
      intro y hy i j
      change y < 0 at hy
      have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := hy.ne
      have hxneg : x ≠ -x := by intro h; linarith
      have hyneg : y ≠ -y := by intro h; linarith
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
        simp_all [openTie, abs_of_neg hneg, abs_of_neg hy, eq_comm]
    · refine chamber_of_open_eq_status openTie open_tie_continuous x
        (Set.Ioi 0) isOpen_Ioi hpos ?_
      intro y hy i j
      change 0 < y at hy
      have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := hy.ne'
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
        simp_all [openTie, abs_of_nonneg hpos.le, abs_of_nonneg hy.le, eq_comm]

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.open_tie_positive_values
statement:
private theorem open_tie_positive_values (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    openTie x 1 = openTie x 2 ∧ openTie x 0 < openTie x 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [openTie, abs_of_nonneg hx.le, hx]

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.open_tie_negative_values
statement:
private theorem open_tie_negative_values (x : ℝ) (hx : x < 0) :
    openTie x 1 < openTie x 0 ∧ openTie x 0 < openTie x 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [openTie, abs_of_neg hx, hx]

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.open_tie_one_mem
statement: private theorem open_tie_one_mem : (1 : ℝ) ∈ orderChamber openTie
proof:
:= by
  rw [open_tie_chamber]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.open_tie_zero_not_mem
statement: private theorem open_tie_zero_not_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∉ orderChamber openTie
proof:

  rw [open_tie_chamber]
  simp

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.relative_tie
statement:
private theorem relative_tie (x : nonnegativeDomain) (i : Fin 2) :
    restrictedTie x i = x.val
proof:
:= by
  have hx := x.property
  change (0 : ℝ) ≤ x.val at hx
  fin_cases i <;> simp [restrictedTie, abs_of_nonneg hx]

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.relative_chamber
statement:
private theorem relative_chamber :
    orderChamber restrictedTie = Set.univ
proof:

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.relative_contains_zero
statement:
private theorem relative_contains_zero :
    (⟨0, by change (0 : ℝ) ≤ 0; exact le_rfl⟩ : nonnegativeDomain) ∈ orderChamber restrictedTie
proof:
:= by
  rw [relative_chamber]
  exact Set.mem_univ _

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.ambient_two_eq_locus
statement:

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.ambient_two_continuous

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.ambient_two_chamber
statement:
private theorem ambient_two_chamber :

    have hfr : frontier (eqLocus ambientTwo 0 1) = ({0} : Set ℝ) := by

  · intro hx

    · refine chamber_of_open_eq_status ambientTwo ambient_two_continuous x

      intro y hy i j

    · refine chamber_of_open_eq_status ambientTwo ambient_two_continuous x
        (Set.Ioi 0) isOpen_Ioi hpos ?_

      change 0 < y at hy

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.ambient_boundary_excluded
statement:
private theorem ambient_boundary_excluded :
    (0 : ℝ) ∉ orderChamber ambientTwo

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.arbitrary_relative_domain
statement:
private theorem arbitrary_relative_domain {E : Type u} [TopologicalSpace E]
    (D : Set E) {ι : Type v} [Finite ι] {β : Type w}
    [LinearOrder β] [TopologicalSpace β] [OrderClosedTopology β]
    (F : D → ι → β) (hF : ∀ i, Continuous (fun x => F x i)) :
    IsOpen (orderChamber F) ∧ Dense (orderChamber F) ∧
      ∀ x₀ ∈ orderChamber F,
        ∃ U : Set D, IsOpen U ∧ x₀ ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ orderChamber F ∧
          ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ i j,
            (F x₀ i ≤ F x₀ j ↔ F x i ≤ F x j)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨isOpen_orderChamber F, dense_orderChamber F hF,
    fun _ hx => exists_open_le_iff_of_mem_orderChamber F hF hx⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_family_continuous
statement:
private theorem edge_family_continuous (s : TotalFace edgeC.toPre) :
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (edgeFamily x).value s)
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous (fun x : ℝ => if s.val = {0} then 0 else
    if s.val = {1} then x else max 0 x)
  split_ifs
  · exact continuous_const
  · exact continuous_id
  · exact continuous_const.max continuous_id

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_card
statement: private theorem edge_card : Fintype.card (TotalFace edgeC.toPre) = 3
proof: := by decide

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_enum_apply
statement:
private theorem edge_enum_apply (i : Fin 3) :
    edgeEnum (Fin.cast edge_card.symm i) = edgeEnum3 i
proof:
:= by
  change edgeEnum3 ((Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin edge_card))
    ((Equiv.cast (congrArg Fin edge_card)).symm i)) = edgeEnum3 i
  simp

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_enum_apply_index
statement:
private theorem edge_enum_apply_index
    (i : Fin (Fintype.card (TotalFace edgeC.toPre))) :
    edgeEnum i = edgeEnum3 (Fin.cast edge_card i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := edge_enum_apply (Fin.cast edge_card i)
  simpa only [Fin.cast_cast, Fin.cast_eq_self] using h

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_values
statement:
private theorem edge_values (x : ℝ) :
    (edgeFamily x).value edgeV0 = 0 ∧
    (edgeFamily x).value edgeV1 = x ∧
    (edgeFamily x).value edgeFace = max 0 x
proof:
:= by
  simp [edgeFamily, edgeV0, edgeV1, edgeFace,
    show ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ≠ {0} by decide,
    show ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ≠ {1} by decide]

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_positive_same_weak_order
statement:
private theorem edge_positive_same_weak_order (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    OrderingEquivalent (edgeFamily 1) (edgeFamily x)
proof:
:= by
  have hxle : 0 ≤ x := hx.le
  intro s t
  have hs : s.val = {0} ∨ s.val = {1} ∨ s.val = {0,1} := by
    have hm := s.property
    change s.val ∈ edgeC.faces at hm
    simpa [edgeC] using hm
  have ht : t.val = {0} ∨ t.val = {1} ∨ t.val = {0,1} := by
    have hm := t.property
    change t.val ∈ edgeC.faces at hm
    simpa [edgeC] using hm
  rcases hs with hs | hs | hs <;> rcases ht with ht | ht | ht <;>
    simp_all [edgeFamily,
      show ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ≠ {0} by decide] <;>
      norm_num <;> exact hx

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_family_one_chamber
statement:
private theorem edge_family_one_chamber :
    (1 : ℝ) ∈ orderChamber (fun x s => (edgeFamily x).value s)
proof:
:= by
  apply chamber_of_open_eq_status
    (fun x s => (edgeFamily x).value s) edge_family_continuous
    1 (Set.Ioi 0) isOpen_Ioi (by norm_num)
  intro y hy s t
  have h := (edge_positive_same_weak_order y hy).value_eq_iff s t
  exact h.symm

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_positive_open_neighborhood
statement:
private theorem edge_positive_open_neighborhood :
    IsOpen (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) ∧ (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ioi 0 ∧
      Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ⊆
        orderChamber (fun x s => (edgeFamily x).value s) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ),
        OrderingEquivalent (edgeFamily 1) (edgeFamily x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isOpen_Ioi, by norm_num, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    apply chamber_of_open_eq_status
      (fun y s => (edgeFamily y).value s) edge_family_continuous
      x (Set.Ioi 0) isOpen_Ioi hx
    intro y hy s t
    have h := (edge_positive_same_weak_order x hx).value_eq_iff s t
    have h' := (edge_positive_same_weak_order y hy).value_eq_iff s t
    exact h'.symm.trans h
  · intro x hx
    exact edge_positive_same_weak_order x hx

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_positive_neighborhood
statement:
private theorem edge_positive_neighborhood :
    ∃ U : Set ℝ, IsOpen U ∧ (1 : ℝ) ∈ U ∧
      U ⊆ orderChamber (fun x s => (edgeFamily x).value s) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (edgeFamily 1) (edgeFamily x)
proof:
:=
  FilterFunction.exists_open_orderingEquivalent_of_mem_orderChamber
    edgeFamily edge_family_continuous edge_family_one_chamber

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_same_enum
statement:
private theorem edge_same_enum :
    ∃ U : Set ℝ, IsOpen U ∧ (1 : ℝ) ∈ U ∧
      U ⊆ orderChamber (fun x s => (edgeFamily x).value s) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ d : CompatibleOrder (edgeFamily x), d.enum = edgeOrderOne.enum
proof:
:=
  CompatibleOrder.exists_open_sameEnum_of_mem_orderChamber
    edgeFamily edge_family_continuous edge_family_one_chamber edgeOrderOne

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_zero_same_enum
statement:
private theorem edge_zero_same_enum :
    ∃ d : CompatibleOrder (edgeFamily 0), d.enum = edgeOrderOne.enum
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨edgeOrderOne.transfer ?_, rfl⟩
  intro i j _
  simp [edgeFamily]

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_zero_not_chamber
statement:
private theorem edge_zero_not_chamber :
    (0 : ℝ) ∉ orderChamber (fun x s => (edgeFamily x).value s)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : eqLocus (fun x s => (edgeFamily x).value s) edgeV0 edgeV1 =
      ({0} : Set ℝ) := by
    ext x
    simp [eqLocus, edge_values]
  have hfr : frontier (eqLocus (fun x s => (edgeFamily x).value s)
      edgeV0 edgeV1) = ({0} : Set ℝ) := by
    rw [heq, isClosed_singleton.frontier_eq, interior_singleton]
    simp
  intro hx
  have hbad : (0 : ℝ) ∈ frontier (eqLocus
      (fun x s => (edgeFamily x).value s) edgeV0 edgeV1) := by
    rw [hfr]
    simp
  exact hx (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    ⟨edgeV0, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨edgeV1, hbad⟩⟩)

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_zero_no_stable_open
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨U, hopen, hzero, hcomp⟩
  have hsubset : U ⊆ ({0} : Set ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    have h01 := (hcomp x hx edgeV0 edgeV1).mp (by simp [edge_values])
    have h10 := (hcomp x hx edgeV1 edgeV0).mp (by simp [edge_values])
    have hxeq : x = 0 := le_antisymm
      (by simpa [edge_values] using h10)
      (by simpa [edge_values] using h01)
    simpa using hxeq
  have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ interior ({0} : Set ℝ) :=
    interior_maximal hsubset hopen hzero
  simp [interior_singleton] at hmem

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.edge_negative_incompatible
statement:
private theorem edge_negative_incompatible :
    ¬ ∃ d : CompatibleOrder (edgeFamily (-1)), d.enum = edgeOrderOne.enum
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨d, hd⟩
  have h := d.monotone (show Fin.cast edge_card.symm (0 : Fin 3) ≤
    Fin.cast edge_card.symm (1 : Fin 3) by simp)
  rw [hd] at h
  change (edgeFamily (-1)).value (edgeOrderOne.enum (Fin.cast edge_card.symm 0)) ≤
    (edgeFamily (-1)).value (edgeOrderOne.enum (Fin.cast edge_card.symm 1)) at h
  simp [edgeOrderOne, edge_enum_apply, edgeEnum3, edgeFamily] at h
  norm_num at h

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.opposite_first_face
proof: := by decide

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.opposite_supplied_enum
statement:
private theorem opposite_supplied_enum :
    ∃ U : Set ℝ, IsOpen U ∧ (1 : ℝ) ∈ U ∧
      U ⊆ orderChamber (fun x s => (tiedEdge x).value s) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ d : CompatibleOrder (tiedEdge x), d.enum = oppositeOrder.enum
proof:
:= by
  exact CompatibleOrder.exists_open_sameEnum_of_mem_orderChamber tiedEdge
    (fun _ => by
      change Continuous (fun x : ℝ => x)
      exact continuous_id)
    (by
      rw [show orderChamber (fun x s => (tiedEdge x).value s) = Set.univ from
        persistent_ties id]
      exact Set.mem_univ _)
    oppositeOrder

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.parameter_constant_tied_filter
statement:
private theorem parameter_constant_tied_filter (x y : ℝ) :
    parameterConstantTiedEdge x = parameterConstantTiedEdge y
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.parameter_constant_tied_grades
statement:
private theorem parameter_constant_tied_grades (x : ℝ) (s : TotalFace edgeC.toPre) :
    (parameterConstantTiedEdge x).value s = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.parameter_constant_tied_continuous
statement:
private theorem parameter_constant_tied_continuous (s : TotalFace edgeC.toPre) :
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (parameterConstantTiedEdge x).value s)
proof:
:=
  continuous_const

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.parameter_constant_tied_chamber
statement:
private theorem parameter_constant_tied_chamber :
    orderChamber (fun x s => (parameterConstantTiedEdge x).value s) = Set.univ
proof:
:=
  persistent_ties (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ))

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.parameter_constant_opposite_faces
statement:
private theorem parameter_constant_opposite_faces :
    (parameterConstantOppositeOrder.enum (Fin.cast edge_card.symm 0)).val =
      ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∧
    (parameterConstantOppositeOrder.enum (Fin.cast edge_card.symm 1)).val =
      ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∧
    (parameterConstantOppositeOrder.enum (Fin.cast edge_card.symm 2)).val =
      ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin 2))
proof: := by decide

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderChamberExamples.parameter_constant_opposite_supplied_enum
statement:
private theorem parameter_constant_opposite_supplied_enum :
    ∃ U : Set ℝ, IsOpen U ∧ (1 : ℝ) ∈ U ∧
      U ⊆ orderChamber (fun x s => (parameterConstantTiedEdge x).value s) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ d : CompatibleOrder (parameterConstantTiedEdge x),
        d.enum = parameterConstantOppositeOrder.enum
proof:
:= by
  exact CompatibleOrder.exists_open_sameEnum_of_mem_orderChamber
    parameterConstantTiedEdge parameter_constant_tied_continuous
    (by rw [parameter_constant_tied_chamber]; exact Set.mem_univ _)
    parameterConstantOppositeOrder

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt_le_radiusAt_add_of_dist_le
proof:
:= by
  refine (radiusAt_le_iff p x s _).2 ⟨add_nonneg (radiusAt_nonneg q x s) hε, fun v hv => ?_⟩
  calc dist x (p v) ≤ dist x (q v) + dist (q v) (p v) := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ radiusAt q x s + ε :=
      add_le_add (dist_le_radiusAt q x hv) ((dist_comm _ _).trans_le (h v hv))

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.abs_radiusAt_sub_le_of_dist_le
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := radiusAt_le_radiusAt_add_of_dist_le p q x s hε h
  have h₂ := radiusAt_le_radiusAt_add_of_dist_le q p x s hε
    fun v hv => (dist_comm _ _).trans_le (h v hv)
  exact abs_sub_le_iff.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_value_le_add_of_dist_le
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ : s.val.Nonempty := s.property
  have hε : 0 ≤ ε := dist_nonneg.trans (h v₀ hv₀)
  have : Nonempty X := ⟨p v₀⟩
  have key : (filter p).value s - ε ≤ (filter q).value s := by
    rw [filter_value q]
    refine le_ciInf fun x => ?_
    have := (filter_value_le_radiusAt p s x).trans
      (radiusAt_le_radiusAt_add_of_dist_le p q x s.val hε h)
    linarith
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.abs_filter_value_sub_le_of_dist_le
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := filter_value_le_add_of_dist_le p q s h
  have h₂ := filter_value_le_add_of_dist_le q p s
    fun v hv => (dist_comm _ _).trans_le (h v hv)
  exact abs_sub_le_iff.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.displacement_nonneg
statement: theorem displacement_nonneg (p q : V → X) : 0 ≤ displacement p q
proof:
:=
  (Finset.le_fold_max 0).mpr (Or.inl le_rfl)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.dist_le_displacement
statement: theorem dist_le_displacement (p q : V → X) (v : V) : dist (p v) (q v) ≤ displacement p q
proof:
:=
  (Finset.le_fold_max _).mpr (Or.inr ⟨v, Finset.mem_univ _, le_rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.displacement_le_iff
statement:
theorem displacement_le_iff (p q : V → X) (ε : ℝ) :
    displacement p q ≤ ε ↔ 0 ≤ ε ∧ ∀ v, dist (p v) (q v) ≤ ε
proof:
:=
  (Finset.fold_max_le ε).trans (and_congr_right' ⟨fun h v => h v (Finset.mem_univ v),
    fun h v _ => h v⟩)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.displacement_comm
statement: theorem displacement_comm (p q : V → X) : displacement p q = displacement q p
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ p q : V → X, displacement p q ≤ displacement q p := fun p q =>
    (displacement_le_iff p q _).2 ⟨displacement_nonneg q p,
      fun v => (dist_comm _ _).trans_le (dist_le_displacement q p v)⟩
  exact le_antisymm (key p q) (key q p)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.displacement_self
statement: @[simp] theorem displacement_self (p : V → X) : displacement p p = 0
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((displacement_le_iff p p 0).2 ⟨le_rfl, fun _ => (dist_self _).le⟩)
    (displacement_nonneg p p)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.displacement_of_isEmpty
statement: @[simp] theorem displacement_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty V] (p q : V → X) : displacement p q = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [displacement, Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.fold_empty]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.abs_filter_value_sub_le_displacement
statement:
theorem abs_filter_value_sub_le_displacement (p q : V → X)
    (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    |(filter p).value s - (filter q).value s| ≤ displacement p q
proof:
:=
  abs_filter_value_sub_le_of_dist_le p q s fun v _ => dist_le_displacement p q v

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.pairwiseDiscrepancy_le_two_mul_displacement
statement:
theorem pairwiseDiscrepancy_le_two_mul_displacement (d e : MetricSpace V) (p q : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w)) :
    Rips.pairwiseDiscrepancy d e ≤ 2 * displacement p q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (Finset.fold_max_le _).2
    ⟨mul_nonneg zero_le_two (displacement_nonneg p q), ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨v, w⟩ -
  dsimp only
  rw [hd, he, ← Real.dist_eq]
  calc dist (dist (p v) (p w)) (dist (q v) (q w)) ≤ dist (p v) (q v) + dist (p w) (q w) :=
        dist_dist_dist_le _ _ _ _
    _ ≤ displacement p q + displacement p q :=
        add_le_add (dist_le_displacement p q v) (dist_le_displacement p q w)
    _ = 2 * displacement p q := by ring

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.abs_diameter_sub_le_two_mul_displacement
statement:
theorem abs_diameter_sub_le_two_mul_displacement (d e : MetricSpace V) (p q : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (he : ∀ v w, e.dist v w = dist (q v) (q w))
    (s : Finset V) :
    |Rips.diameter d s - Rips.diameter e s| ≤ 2 * displacement p q
proof:
:=
  (Rips.abs_diameter_sub_le_pairwiseDiscrepancy d e s).trans
    (pairwiseDiscrepancy_le_two_mul_displacement d e p q hd he)

name: TDA.Filtration.rankKey_injective
statement:
private theorem rankKey_injective (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (q : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K ≃
      Fin (Fintype.card (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K))) :
    Function.Injective (rankKey f q)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  apply q.injective
  have hq := congrArg
    (fun k : Lex (α × Lex (ℕ × Fin (Fintype.card (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)))) =>
      ((_root_.ofLex ((_root_.ofLex k).2)).2)) h
  simpa [rankKey, _root_.ofLex_toLex] using hq

name: TDA.Filtration.exists_compatibleOrder
statement:
theorem exists_compatibleOrder (f : FilterFunction K α) :
    Nonempty (CompatibleOrder f)
proof:
:= by
  let sorted := sortedEnumeration f
  refine ⟨⟨sorted.enum, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro i j hface
    have hkey : rankKey f sorted.rank (sorted.enum i) <
        rankKey f sorted.rank (sorted.enum j) := by
      apply Prod.Lex.toLex_lt_toLex.mpr
      have hgrade := f.mono hface.subset
      rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hgrade with hg | hg
      · exact Or.inl hg
      · right
        constructor
        · exact hg
        · apply Prod.Lex.toLex_lt_toLex.mpr
          exact Or.inl (Finset.card_lt_card hface)
    by_contra hnot
    have hji : j ≤ i := not_lt.mp hnot
    have hreverse := sorted.key_strictMono.monotone hji
    exact (not_le_of_gt hkey) hreverse
  · intro i j hij
    have hkey := sorted.key_strictMono.monotone hij
    change rankKey f sorted.rank (sorted.enum i) ≤
      rankKey f sorted.rank (sorted.enum j) at hkey
    exact Prod.Lex.monotone_fst _ _ hkey

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.monotone_enum_iff_reflects_lt
statement:
theorem CompatibleOrder.monotone_enum_iff_reflects_lt
    (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (e : Fin (Fintype.card (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)) ≃
      TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K) :
    Monotone (f.value ∘ e) ↔
      ∀ i j, f.value (e i) < f.value (e j) → i < j
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i j hij
    exact h.reflect_lt hij
  · intro h i j hij
    exact le_of_not_gt (fun hgrade => (not_lt_of_ge hij) (h j i hgrade))

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.mem_complex_iff
statement:
theorem mem_complex_iff (p : V → X) (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ complex p r ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ ∃ x : X, ∀ v ∈ s, dist x (p v) ≤ r
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.complex_mono
statement: theorem complex_mono (p : V → X) {r q : ℝ} (h : r ≤ q) : complex p r ≤ complex p q
proof:
:=
  TDA.Topology.nerve_mono fun _ => Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall h

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.singleton_mem_complex_iff
statement:
theorem singleton_mem_complex_iff (p : V → X) (r : ℝ) (v : V) :
    ({v} : Finset V) ∈ complex p r ↔ 0 ≤ r
proof:
:=
  (TDA.Topology.mem_nerve_singleton_iff _ v).trans Metric.nonempty_closedBall

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.complex_eq_bot_of_neg
statement: theorem complex_eq_bot_of_neg (p : V → X) {r : ℝ} (hr : r < 0) : complex p r = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, x, hx⟩ := (mem_complex_iff p r s).1 hs
  exact absurd (dist_nonneg.trans (hx v hv)) (not_le.2 hr)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.mem_complex_of_pairwise
statement:
theorem mem_complex_of_pairwise (p : V → X) {r : ℝ} {s : Finset V} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    (h : ∀ v ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, dist (p v) (p w) ≤ r) : s ∈ complex p r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := hs
  exact (mem_complex_iff p r s).2 ⟨⟨v₀, hv₀⟩, p v₀, fun v hv => h v₀ hv₀ v hv⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.dist_le_two_mul_of_mem_complex
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, x, hx⟩ := (mem_complex_iff p r s).1 hs
  calc dist (p v) (p w) ≤ dist x (p v) + dist x (p w) := dist_triangle_left _ _ _
    _ ≤ r + r := add_le_add (hx v hv) (hx w hw)
    _ = 2 * r := by ring

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.ripsSublevel_le_complex
statement:
theorem ripsSublevel_le_complex (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (r : ℝ) :
    (Rips.filter d).sublevel r ≤ complex p r
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsn, h⟩ := (Rips.mem_sublevel_iff d r s).1 hs
  exact mem_complex_of_pairwise p hsn fun v hv w hw => by
    rw [← hd]
    exact h v hv w hw

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.complex_le_ripsSublevel_two_mul
statement:
theorem complex_le_ripsSublevel_two_mul (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (r : ℝ) :
    complex p r ≤ (Rips.filter d).sublevel (2 * r)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  refine (Rips.mem_sublevel_iff d (2 * r) s).2
    ⟨((mem_complex_iff p r s).1 hs).1, fun v hv w hw => ?_⟩
  rw [hd]
  exact dist_le_two_mul_of_mem_complex p hs hv hw

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt_nonneg
statement: theorem radiusAt_nonneg (p : V → X) (x : X) (s : Finset V) : 0 ≤ radiusAt p x s
proof:
:=
  (Finset.le_fold_max 0).mpr (Or.inl le_rfl)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt_le_iff
statement:
theorem radiusAt_le_iff (p : V → X) (x : X) (s : Finset V) (r : ℝ) :
    radiusAt p x s ≤ r ↔ 0 ≤ r ∧ ∀ v ∈ s, dist x (p v) ≤ r
proof:
:=
  Finset.fold_max_le r

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.dist_le_radiusAt
statement:
theorem dist_le_radiusAt (p : V → X) (x : X) {s : Finset V} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ s) :
    dist x (p v) ≤ radiusAt p x s
proof:
:=
  (Finset.le_fold_max _).mpr (Or.inr ⟨v, hv, le_rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt_mono
statement:
theorem radiusAt_mono (p : V → X) (x : X) {s t : Finset V} (hst : s ⊆ t) :
    radiusAt p x s ≤ radiusAt p x t
proof:
:=
  (radiusAt_le_iff p x s _).mpr
    ⟨radiusAt_nonneg p x t, fun _ hv => dist_le_radiusAt p x (hst hv)⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt_le_radiusAt_add_dist
statement:
theorem radiusAt_le_radiusAt_add_dist (p : V → X) (x y : X) (s : Finset V) :
    radiusAt p x s ≤ radiusAt p y s + dist x y
proof:
:= by
  refine (radiusAt_le_iff p x s _).mpr
    ⟨add_nonneg (radiusAt_nonneg p y s) dist_nonneg, fun v hv => ?_⟩
  calc dist x (p v) ≤ dist x y + dist y (p v) := dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ dist x y + radiusAt p y s := add_le_add_right (dist_le_radiusAt p y hv) _
    _ = radiusAt p y s + dist x y := add_comm _ _

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.continuous_radiusAt
statement:
theorem continuous_radiusAt (p : V → X) (s : Finset V) :
    Continuous fun x => radiusAt p x s
proof:
:=
  (LipschitzWith.of_le_add fun x y => radiusAt_le_radiusAt_add_dist p x y s).continuous

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.bddBelow_range_radiusAt
statement:
theorem bddBelow_range_radiusAt (p : V → X) (s : Finset V) :
    BddBelow (Set.range fun x => radiusAt p x s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, by
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    exact radiusAt_nonneg p x s⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_value
statement:
@[simp] theorem filter_value (p : V → X) (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    (filter p).value s = ⨅ x : X, radiusAt p x s.val
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_value_nonneg
statement:
theorem filter_value_nonneg (p : V → X) (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    0 ≤ (filter p).value s
proof:
:=
  Real.iInf_nonneg fun x => radiusAt_nonneg p x s.val

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_value_le_radiusAt
statement:
theorem filter_value_le_radiusAt (p : V → X) (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) (x : X) :
    (filter p).value s ≤ radiusAt p x s.val
proof:
:=
  ciInf_le (bddBelow_range_radiusAt p s.val) x

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.complex_le_sublevel
statement: theorem complex_le_sublevel (p : V → X) (r : ℝ) : complex p r ≤ (filter p).sublevel r
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsn, x, hx⟩ := (mem_complex_iff p r s).1 hs
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ := hsn
  refine (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff _ r s).2 ⟨⟨v₀, hv₀⟩, ?_⟩
  exact (filter_value_le_radiusAt p ⟨s, ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩⟩ x).trans
    ((radiusAt_le_iff p x s r).2 ⟨dist_nonneg.trans (hx v₀ hv₀), hx⟩)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.exists_radiusAt_eq_value
statement:
theorem exists_radiusAt_eq_value [ProperSpace X] (p : V → X)
    (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    ∃ x, radiusAt p x s.val = (filter p).value s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ : s.val.Nonempty := s.property
  have : Nonempty X := ⟨p v₀⟩
  set R := radiusAt p (p v₀) s.val
  have hmem : p v₀ ∈ Metric.closedBall (p v₀) R :=
    Metric.mem_closedBall_self (radiusAt_nonneg p (p v₀) s.val)
  obtain ⟨y, -, hy⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (p v₀) R).exists_isMinOn ⟨_, hmem⟩
    (continuous_radiusAt p s.val).continuousOn
  have hglob : ∀ x, radiusAt p y s.val ≤ radiusAt p x s.val := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (p v₀) R
    · exact isMinOn_iff.mp hy x hx
    · rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, not_le] at hx
      exact (isMinOn_iff.mp hy _ hmem).trans (hx.le.trans (dist_le_radiusAt p x hv₀))
  exact ⟨y, le_antisymm (le_ciInf hglob) (filter_value_le_radiusAt p s y)⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.sublevel_eq_complex
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq_complex [ProperSpace X] (p : V → X) (r : ℝ) :
    (filter p).sublevel r = complex p r
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ (complex_le_sublevel p r)
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsn, hval⟩ := (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff _ r s).1 hs
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_radiusAt_eq_value p ⟨s, hsn⟩
  exact (mem_complex_iff p r s).2 ⟨hsn, x, ((radiusAt_le_iff p x s r).1 (hx.trans_le hval)).2⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_value_le_rips
statement:
theorem filter_value_le_rips (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    (filter p).value s ≤ (Rips.filter d).value s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ : s.val.Nonempty := s.property
  refine (filter_value_le_radiusAt p s (p v₀)).trans ((radiusAt_le_iff p _ _ _).2
    ⟨Rips.diameter_nonneg d s.val, fun v hv => ?_⟩)
  rw [Rips.filter_value, ← hd]
  exact Rips.dist_le_diameter d hv₀ hv

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.rips_le_two_mul_filter_value
statement:
theorem rips_le_two_mul_filter_value (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → X)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    (Rips.filter d).value s ≤ 2 * (filter p).value s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v₀, hv₀⟩ : s.val.Nonempty := s.property
  have : Nonempty X := ⟨p v₀⟩
  have key : (Rips.filter d).value s / 2 ≤ (filter p).value s := by
    refine le_ciInf fun x => ?_
    have h : Rips.diameter d s.val ≤ 2 * radiusAt p x s.val := by
      refine (Rips.diameter_le_iff d s.val _).2
        ⟨mul_nonneg zero_le_two (radiusAt_nonneg p x s.val), fun v hv w hw => ?_⟩
      rw [hd]
      calc dist (p v) (p w) ≤ dist x (p v) + dist x (p w) := dist_triangle_left _ _ _
        _ ≤ radiusAt p x s.val + radiusAt p x s.val :=
          add_le_add (dist_le_radiusAt p x hv) (dist_le_radiusAt p x hw)
        _ = 2 * radiusAt p x s.val := by ring
    rw [Rips.filter_value]
    linarith
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.pts_injective
statement: theorem pts_injective : Function.Injective pts
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> first | rfl | norm_num [pts] at h

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.metric_dist
statement: theorem metric_dist (v w : Fin 2) : metric.dist v w = dist (pts v) (pts w)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.edge_nonempty
statement: theorem edge_nonempty : edge.Nonempty
proof: := ⟨0, by simp [edge]⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.dist_pts
statement: theorem dist_pts : dist (pts 0) (pts 1) = 2
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [pts, Real.dist_eq]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.edge_mem_complex_one
statement: theorem edge_mem_complex_one : edge ∈ complex pts 1
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_complex_iff _ _ _).2 ⟨edge_nonempty, 1, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  simp only [edge, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
  rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num [pts, Real.dist_eq]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.edge_not_mem_complex
statement: theorem edge_not_mem_complex {r : ℝ} (hr : r < 1) : edge ∉ complex pts r
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h2 := dist_le_two_mul_of_mem_complex pts h (v := 0) (w := 1)
    (by simp [edge]) (by simp [edge])
  rw [dist_pts] at h2
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.edge_not_mem_rips_one
statement: theorem edge_not_mem_rips_one : edge ∉ (Rips.filter metric).sublevel 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h1 := ((Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).1 h).2 0 (by simp [edge]) 1 (by simp [edge])
  rw [metric_dist, dist_pts] at h1
  norm_num at h1

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.edge_mem_rips_two
statement: theorem edge_mem_rips_two : edge ∈ (Rips.filter metric).sublevel 2
proof:
:= by
  refine (Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).2 ⟨edge_nonempty, ?_⟩
  intro v hv w hw
  rw [metric_dist]
  simp only [edge, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv hw
  rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hw with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num [pts, Real.dist_eq]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.rips_value
statement: theorem rips_value : (Rips.filter metric).value edgeFace = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rips.filter_value]
  change Rips.diameter metric {0, 1} = 2
  rw [Rips.diameter_pair, metric_dist, dist_pts]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.cech_value
statement: theorem cech_value : (filter pts).value edgeFace = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem _ _ _).1
      (complex_le_sublevel pts 1 edge_mem_complex_one)
  · have h := rips_le_two_mul_filter_value metric pts metric_dist edgeFace
    rw [rips_value] at h
    linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.TwoPoints.rips_value_eq_two_mul_cech_value
statement:
theorem rips_value_eq_two_mul_cech_value :
    (Rips.filter metric).value edgeFace = 2 * (filter pts).value edgeFace
proof:
:= by
  rw [rips_value, cech_value]
  norm_num

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.pts_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pts_zero : pts 0 = !₂[0, 0]
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.pts_one
statement: @[simp] theorem pts_one : pts 1 = !₂[2, 0]
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.pts_two
statement: @[simp] theorem pts_two : pts 2 = !₂[1, 2]
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.dist_sq
statement:
theorem dist_sq (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    dist x y ^ 2 = (x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.dist_sq_eq, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, sq_abs, sq_abs]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.dist_le_of_sq_le
statement:
theorem dist_le_of_sq_le {x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (h : (x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 ≤ c ^ 2) : dist x y ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dist_sq] at h
  exact (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ dist_nonneg hc two_ne_zero).1 h

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.sq_le_of_dist_le
statement:
theorem sq_le_of_dist_le {x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} {c : ℝ} (h : dist x y ≤ c) :
    (x 0 - y 0) ^ 2 + (x 1 - y 1) ^ 2 ≤ c ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dist_sq]
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ dist_nonneg h 2

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.pts_injective
statement: theorem pts_injective : Function.Injective pts
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  have h0 : pts i 0 = pts j 0 := congrArg (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => z 0) h
  have hx : ∀ k : Fin 3, pts k 0 = ![0, 2, 1] k := by
    intro k
    fin_cases k <;> rfl
  rw [hx, hx] at h0
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> first | rfl | norm_num at h0

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.metric_dist
statement: theorem metric_dist (v w : Fin 3) : metric.dist v w = dist (pts v) (pts w)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.edge01_mem_complex
statement: theorem edge01_mem_complex : edge01 ∈ complex pts (6 / 5)
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_complex_iff _ _ _).2 ⟨⟨0, by simp [edge01]⟩, !₂[1, 0], ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  simp only [edge01, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
  rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;>
    exact dist_le_of_sq_le (by norm_num) (by norm_num [pts_zero, pts_one, pts_two])

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.edge02_mem_complex
statement: theorem edge02_mem_complex : edge02 ∈ complex pts (6 / 5)
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_complex_iff _ _ _).2 ⟨⟨0, by simp [edge02]⟩, !₂[1 / 2, 1], ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  simp only [edge02, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
  rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;>
    exact dist_le_of_sq_le (by norm_num) (by norm_num [pts_zero, pts_one, pts_two])

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.edge12_mem_complex
statement: theorem edge12_mem_complex : edge12 ∈ complex pts (6 / 5)
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_complex_iff _ _ _).2 ⟨⟨1, by simp [edge12]⟩, !₂[3 / 2, 1], ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  simp only [edge12, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
  rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;>
    exact dist_le_of_sq_le (by norm_num) (by norm_num [pts_zero, pts_one, pts_two])

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.tri_not_mem_complex
statement: theorem tri_not_mem_complex : tri ∉ complex pts (6 / 5)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨-, x, hx⟩ := (mem_complex_iff _ _ _).1 h
  have ha := sq_le_of_dist_le (hx 0 (by simp [tri]))
  have hb := sq_le_of_dist_le (hx 1 (by simp [tri]))
  have hc := sq_le_of_dist_le (hx 2 (by simp [tri]))
  norm_num [pts_zero, pts_one, pts_two] at ha hb hc
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0 - 1), sq_nonneg (x 1 - 3 / 4)]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.tri_mem_rips
statement: theorem tri_mem_rips : tri ∈ (Rips.filter metric).sublevel (12 / 5)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).2 ⟨⟨0, by simp [tri]⟩, ?_⟩
  intro v hv w hw
  rw [metric_dist]
  simp only [tri, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv hw
  rcases hv with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hw with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    exact dist_le_of_sq_le (by norm_num) (by norm_num [pts_zero, pts_one, pts_two])

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.not_le_of_sq
statement:
private theorem not_le_of_sq {v w : Fin 3} (h : (6 / 5 : ℝ) ^ 2 <
    (pts v 0 - pts w 0) ^ 2 + (pts v 1 - pts w 1) ^ 2) : ¬ metric.dist v w ≤ 6 / 5
proof:
:=
  fun hle => absurd (sq_le_of_dist_le (metric_dist v w ▸ hle)) (not_le.2 h)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.edge01_not_mem_rips
statement: theorem edge01_not_mem_rips : edge01 ∉ (Rips.filter metric).sublevel (6 / 5)
proof:
:= fun h =>
  not_le_of_sq (by norm_num [pts_zero, pts_one, pts_two])
    (((Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).1 h).2 0 (by simp [edge01]) 1 (by simp [edge01]))

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.edge02_not_mem_rips
statement: theorem edge02_not_mem_rips : edge02 ∉ (Rips.filter metric).sublevel (6 / 5)
proof:
:= fun h =>
  not_le_of_sq (by norm_num [pts_zero, pts_one, pts_two])
    (((Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).1 h).2 0 (by simp [edge02]) 2 (by simp [edge02]))

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.edge12_not_mem_rips
statement: theorem edge12_not_mem_rips : edge12 ∉ (Rips.filter metric).sublevel (6 / 5)
proof:
:= fun h =>
  not_le_of_sq (by norm_num [pts_zero, pts_one, pts_two])
    (((Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).1 h).2 1 (by simp [edge12]) 2 (by simp [edge12]))

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.rips_lt_complex
statement: theorem rips_lt_complex : (Rips.filter metric).sublevel (6 / 5) < complex pts (6 / 5)
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_not_ge (ripsSublevel_le_complex metric pts metric_dist _)
    fun h => edge01_not_mem_rips (h edge01_mem_complex)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Triangle.complex_lt_rips
statement: theorem complex_lt_rips : complex pts (6 / 5) < (Rips.filter metric).sublevel (2 * (6 / 5))
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_not_ge (complex_le_ripsSublevel_two_mul metric pts metric_dist _)
    fun h => tri_not_mem_complex (h (by norm_num; exact tri_mem_rips))

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Punctured.pts_injective
statement: theorem pts_injective : Function.Injective pts
proof:
:= by
  intro i j h
  have h0 := congrArg Subtype.val h
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> first | rfl | norm_num [pts] at h0

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Punctured.metric_dist
statement: theorem metric_dist (v w : Fin 2) : metric.dist v w = dist (pts v) (pts w)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Punctured.edge_nonempty
statement: theorem edge_nonempty : edge.Nonempty
proof: := ⟨0, by simp [edge]⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Punctured.edge_not_mem_complex_one
statement: theorem edge_not_mem_complex_one : edge ∉ complex pts 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨-, x, hx⟩ := (mem_complex_iff _ _ _).1 h
  have h0 := hx 0 (by simp [edge])
  have h1 := hx 1 (by simp [edge])
  simp only [Subtype.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, pts] at h0 h1
  norm_num at h0 h1
  obtain ⟨h0l, h0r⟩ := abs_le.1 h0
  obtain ⟨h1l, h1r⟩ := abs_le.1 h1
  exact x.2 (by linarith)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Punctured.cech_value
statement: theorem cech_value : (filter pts).value edgeFace = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · by_contra hlt
    rw [not_le] at hlt
    set ε := (filter pts).value edgeFace - 1 with hε
    have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < ε / 2 := by linarith
    have hup := filter_value_le_radiusAt pts edgeFace ⟨ε / 2, hpos.ne'⟩
    have hrad : radiusAt pts ⟨ε / 2, hpos.ne'⟩ edge ≤ 1 + ε / 2 := by
      refine (radiusAt_le_iff _ _ _ _).2 ⟨by linarith, fun v hv => ?_⟩
      simp only [edge, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hv
      rcases hv with rfl | rfl <;>
        · simp only [Subtype.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq, pts]
          norm_num
          rw [abs_le]
          constructor <;> linarith
    have : (filter pts).value edgeFace ≤ 1 + ε / 2 := hup.trans hrad
    linarith
  · have h := rips_le_two_mul_filter_value metric pts metric_dist edgeFace
    have hr : (Rips.filter metric).value edgeFace = 2 := by
      rw [Rips.filter_value]
      change Rips.diameter metric {0, 1} = 2
      rw [Rips.diameter_pair, metric_dist]
      norm_num [pts, Subtype.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
    rw [hr] at h
    linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Punctured.edge_mem_sublevel_one
statement: theorem edge_mem_sublevel_one : edge ∈ (filter pts).sublevel 1
proof:
:=
  (FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem _ _ edgeFace).2 cech_value.le

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Punctured.sublevel_ne_complex
statement: theorem sublevel_ne_complex : (filter pts).sublevel 1 ≠ complex pts 1
proof:
:= fun h =>
  edge_not_mem_complex_one (h ▸ edge_mem_sublevel_one)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Repeated.edge_card
statement: theorem edge_card : edge.card = 2
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Repeated.edge_mem_complex_zero
statement: theorem edge_mem_complex_zero : edge ∈ complex pts 0
proof:
:=
  mem_complex_of_pairwise pts ⟨0, by simp [edge]⟩ fun _ _ _ _ => by simp [pts]

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.Repeated.cech_value
statement: theorem cech_value : (filter pts).value edgeFace = 0
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm ((FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem _ _ _).1
    (complex_le_sublevel pts 0 edge_mem_complex_zero)) (filter_value_nonneg pts edgeFace)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.complex_neg_one_eq_bot
statement: theorem complex_neg_one_eq_bot (p : V → X) : complex p (-1) = ⊥
proof:
:=
  complex_eq_bot_of_neg p (by norm_num)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.Examples.singleton_not_mem_complex_neg_one
statement:
theorem singleton_not_mem_complex_neg_one (p : V → X) (v : V) :
    ({v} : Finset V) ∉ complex p (-1)
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have := (singleton_mem_complex_iff p (-1) v).1 h
  norm_num at this

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.exists_open_orderingEquivalent_of_mem_orderChamber
statement:
theorem FilterFunction.exists_open_orderingEquivalent_of_mem_orderChamber
    [Finite (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)]
    (F : X → FilterFunction K β)
    (hF : ∀ s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K,
      Continuous (fun x => (F x).value s))
    {x₀ : X}
    (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ orderChamber (fun x s => (F x).value s)) :
    ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x₀ ∈ U ∧
      U ⊆ orderChamber (fun x s => (F x).value s) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hUo, hxU, hUc, hUe⟩ :=
    exists_open_le_iff_of_mem_orderChamber
      (fun x s => (F x).value s) hF hx₀
  exact ⟨U, hUo, hxU, hUc, fun x hx s t => hUe x hx s t⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.CompatibleOrder.exists_open_sameEnum_of_mem_orderChamber
statement:
theorem CompatibleOrder.exists_open_sameEnum_of_mem_orderChamber
    [Fintype (TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K)]
    (F : X → FilterFunction K β)
    (hF : ∀ s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K,
      Continuous (fun x => (F x).value s))
    {x₀ : X}
    (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ orderChamber (fun x s => (F x).value s))
    (e : CompatibleOrder (F x₀)) :
    ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x₀ ∈ U ∧
      U ⊆ orderChamber (fun x s => (F x).value s) ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∃ d : CompatibleOrder (F x), d.enum = e.enum
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hUo, hxU, hUc, hUe⟩ :=
    FilterFunction.exists_open_orderingEquivalent_of_mem_orderChamber F hF hx₀
  refine ⟨U, hUo, hxU, hUc, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  let h : OrderingEquivalent (F x₀) (F x) := hUe x hx
  exact ⟨e.transferOfOrderingEquivalent h,
    e.transferOfOrderingEquivalent_enum h⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mass_pos
statement: @[simp] theorem mass_pos (p : Index) : 0 < mass p
proof: := (OrderDual.ofDual p.density).property

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.radius_pos
statement: @[simp] theorem radius_pos (p : Index) : 0 < radius p
proof: := p.scale.property

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.index_le_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem index_le_iff (p q : Index) :
    p ≤ q ↔ mass q ≤ mass p ∧ radius p ≤ radius q
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_subdivision_iff
statement:
theorem mem_subdivision_iff [Fintype V] (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (k : ℝ) (S : Finset (Finset V)) :
    S ∈ subdivision K k ↔ S.Nonempty ∧
      (∀ s ∈ S, s ∈ K ∧ k ≤ (s.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V) ∧
      ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ t ∈ S, s ⊆ t ∨ t ⊆ s
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_subdivision_iff_of_least
statement:
theorem mem_subdivision_iff_of_least [Fintype V] (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V)
    (k : ℝ) (S : Finset (Finset V)) {s₀ : Finset V} (hs₀ : s₀ ∈ S)
    (hleast : ∀ s ∈ S, s₀ ⊆ s) :
    S ∈ subdivision K k ↔
      (∀ s ∈ S, s ∈ K) ∧ k ≤ (s₀.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V ∧
      ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ t ∈ S, s ⊆ t ∨ t ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun s hs => (h.2.1 s hs).1, (h.2.1 s₀ hs₀).2, h.2.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hK, hk, hchain⟩
    refine ⟨⟨s₀, hs₀⟩, fun s hs => ⟨hK s hs, hk.trans ?_⟩, hchain⟩
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_card (hleast s hs))
      (by positivity)

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.subdivision_mono
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS
  exact ⟨hS.1, fun s hs => ⟨hKL (hS.2.1 s hs).1,
    hlk.trans (hS.2.1 s hs).2⟩, hS.2.2⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.subdivision_eq_bot_of_one_lt
statement:
theorem subdivision_eq_bot_of_one_lt [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) {k : ℝ} (hk : 1 < k) :
    subdivision K k = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro S hS
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hS.1
  have hsize : (s.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card V ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_one (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos)).2
    exact_mod_cast Finset.card_le_univ s
  exact (not_le_of_gt hk) ((hS.2.1 s hs).2.trans hsize)

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.subdivision_one_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem subdivision_one_eq_singleton [Fintype V] [Nonempty V]
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (hK : Finset.univ ∈ K) :
    subdivision K 1 = singletonFace (Finset.univ : Finset V)
proof:
:= by
  have hd : 0 < (Fintype.card V : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro S hS
    have hfull : ∀ s ∈ S, s = Finset.univ := by
      intro s hs
      have hsize := (hS.2.1 s hs).2
      have hge : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ≤ s.card := by
        simpa using (le_div_iff₀ hd).mp hsize
      apply Finset.eq_univ_of_card
      apply le_antisymm (Finset.card_le_univ s)
      exact_mod_cast hge
    apply (mem_singletonFace_iff _ _).2
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := hS.1
    exact Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.mpr ⟨hfull s hs ▸ hs, hfull⟩
  · intro S hS
    rw [(mem_singletonFace_iff _ _).mp hS]
    apply (mem_subdivision_iff K 1 {Finset.univ}).2
    simp [hK, ne_of_gt hd]

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_openRips_iff
statement:
theorem mem_openRips_iff (d : MetricSpace V) (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ openRips d r ↔ s.Nonempty ∧
      ∀ v ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, d.dist v w < 2 * r
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.openRips_mono
statement:
theorem openRips_mono (d : MetricSpace V) {r q : ℝ} (h : r ≤ q) :
    openRips d r ≤ openRips d q
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  exact ⟨hs.1, fun v hv w hw => (hs.2 v hv w hw).trans_le (by linarith)⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.bifiltration_apply
statement:
theorem bifiltration_apply [Fintype V] (d : MetricSpace V) (p : Index) :
    bifiltration d p = subdivision (openRips d (radius p)) (mass p)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_openRips_iff_diameter_lt
statement:
theorem mem_openRips_iff_diameter_lt (d : MetricSpace V) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ openRips d r ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ Rips.diameter d s < 2 * r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [mem_openRips_iff]
  simp only [Rips.diameter, Finset.fold_max_lt, Finset.mem_product]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hs, h⟩
    exact ⟨hs, by linarith, fun p hp => h p.1 hp.1 p.2 hp.2⟩
  · rintro ⟨hs, _, h⟩
    exact ⟨hs, fun v hv w hw => h (v, w) ⟨hv, hw⟩⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_openCech_iff
statement:
theorem mem_openCech_iff {X : Type w} [PseudoMetricSpace X] (p : V → X)
    (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ openCech p r ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ ∃ x, ∀ v ∈ s, dist x (p v) < r
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.openCech_eq_openRips
statement:
theorem openCech_eq_openRips {ι : Type w} [Fintype ι] (d : MetricSpace V)
    (p : V → ι → ℝ) (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w))
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : openCech p r = openRips d r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro s hs
    obtain ⟨hs, x, hx⟩ := (mem_openCech_iff p r s).mp hs
    refine ⟨hs, fun v hv w hw => ?_⟩
    rw [hd]
    exact (dist_triangle_left (p v) (p w) x).trans_lt (by linarith [hx v hv, hx w hw])
  · intro s hs
    have hdiam := ((mem_openRips_iff_diameter_lt d hr s).mp hs).2
    let q := (Rips.diameter d s / 2 + r) / 2
    have hqr : q < r := by dsimp [q]; linarith
    have hpair : ∀ v ∈ s, ∀ w ∈ s, dist (p v) (p w) ≤ 2 * q := by
      intro v hv w hw
      rw [← hd]
      have := Rips.dist_le_diameter d hv hw
      dsimp [q]
      linarith
    exact ⟨hs.1, Cech.supNormWitness p q s hs.1,
      fun v hv => (Cech.dist_supNormWitness_le p hs.1 hpair hv).trans_lt hqr⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.subdivision_openCech_eq
statement:
theorem subdivision_openCech_eq {ι : Type w} [Fintype ι] [Fintype V]
    (d : MetricSpace V) (p : V → ι → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ v w, d.dist v w = dist (p v) (p w)) (a : Index) :
    subdivision (openCech p (radius a)) (mass a) = bifiltration d a
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 0 < radius a := radius_pos a
  rw [openCech_eq_openRips d p hd hr]
  rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.distanceCoordinates_dist
statement:
theorem distanceCoordinates_dist [Fintype V] (d : MetricSpace V) (v w : V) :
    dist (distanceCoordinates d v) (distanceCoordinates d w) = d.dist v w
proof:
:= by
  let : MetricSpace V := d
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (dist_pi_le_iff dist_nonneg).2
    intro z
    simpa only [distanceCoordinates, Real.dist_eq, dist_comm z] using abs_dist_sub_le v w z
  · have h := dist_le_pi_dist (distanceCoordinates d v) (distanceCoordinates d w) v
    simpa [distanceCoordinates, Real.dist_eq] using h

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.isometry_distanceCoordinates
proof:
:= by
  let : MetricSpace V := d
  exact Isometry.of_dist_eq (distanceCoordinates_dist d)

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.bifiltration_le_of_dist_le
statement:
theorem bifiltration_le_of_dist_le [Fintype V] (d e : MetricSpace V) (δ : ℝ≥0)
    (hde : ∀ v w, e.dist v w ≤ d.dist v w + 2 * δ)
    {p q : Index} (hk : mass q ≤ mass p) (hr : radius p + δ ≤ radius q) :
    bifiltration d p ≤ bifiltration e q
proof:
:= by
  apply subdivision_mono ?_ hk
  intro s hs
  exact ⟨hs.1, fun v hv w hw => by
    have := hs.2 v hv w hw
    have := hde v w
    linarith⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_subdivision_relabel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_subdivision_relabel_iff [Fintype V] [Fintype W] (e : V ≃ W)
    (K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) (L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex W)
    (hKL : ∀ s, s.map e.toEmbedding ∈ L ↔ s ∈ K) (k : ℝ)
    (S : Finset (Finset V)) :
    S.map (relabelVertex e) ∈ subdivision L k ↔ S ∈ subdivision K k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_subdivision_iff, Finset.map_nonempty, Finset.forall_mem_map,
    relabelVertex, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, Finset.card_map, Finset.map_subset_map, hKL, ← Fintype.card_congr e]

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_openRips_relabel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_openRips_relabel_iff (e : V ≃ W) (d : MetricSpace V) (f : MetricSpace W)
    (h : ∀ v w, f.dist (e v) (e w) = d.dist v w) (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s.map e.toEmbedding ∈ openRips f r ↔ s ∈ openRips d r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_openRips_iff, Finset.map_nonempty, Finset.forall_mem_map,
    Equiv.coe_toEmbedding, h]

name: TDA.Filtration.SubdivisionRips.mem_bifiltration_relabel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_bifiltration_relabel_iff [Fintype V] [Fintype W] (e : V ≃ W)
    (d : MetricSpace V) (f : MetricSpace W)
    (h : ∀ v w, f.dist (e v) (e w) = d.dist v w)
    (p : Index) (S : Finset (Finset V)) :
    S.map (relabelVertex e) ∈ bifiltration f p ↔ S ∈ bifiltration d p
proof:
:=
  mem_subdivision_relabel_iff e _ _ (mem_openRips_relabel_iff e d f h (radius p)) (mass p) S

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.mem_criticalValues
statement:
theorem mem_criticalValues (f : FilterFunction K α) (a : α) :
    a ∈ f.criticalValues ↔ ∃ s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K, f.value s = a
proof:
:= by
  simp [criticalValues]

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.criticalValues_eq_empty_iff
statement:
theorem criticalValues_eq_empty_iff (f : FilterFunction K α) :
    f.criticalValues = ∅ ↔ K = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
    intro s hs
    have hm : f.value ⟨s, hs⟩ ∈ f.criticalValues :=
      (f.mem_criticalValues _).2 ⟨⟨s, hs⟩, rfl⟩
    simp [h] at hm
  · intro h
    ext a
    constructor
    · intro ha
      obtain ⟨s, _⟩ := (f.mem_criticalValues a).1 ha
      rw [h] at s
      exact ((TDA.Filtration.mem_bot_iff s.val).1 s.property).elim
    · intro ha
      simp at ha

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.criticalValue_mem
statement:
theorem criticalValue_mem (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (i : Fin (f.criticalValues.card)) :
    f.criticalValue i ∈ f.criticalValues
proof:
:=
  Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ rfl i

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.exists_criticalValue_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  have hr : a ∈ Set.range f.criticalValue := by
    rw [criticalValue, Finset.range_orderEmbOfFin]
    exact ha
  exact hr

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.exists_criticalValue_eq
statement:
theorem exists_criticalValue_eq (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K) :
    ∃ i : Fin (f.criticalValues.card), f.criticalValue i = f.value s
proof:
:= by
  apply f.exists_criticalValue_of_mem
  exact (f.mem_criticalValues _).2 ⟨s, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.gradeFiltration_apply
statement:
theorem gradeFiltration_apply (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (i : Fin (f.criticalValues.card)) :
    f.gradeFiltration i = f.sublevel (f.criticalValue i)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.sublevel_eq_bot_of_lt_first
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq_bot_of_lt_first (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (hN : 0 < f.criticalValues.card) (r : α)
    (hr : r < f.criticalValue ⟨0, hN⟩) :
    f.sublevel r = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply f.sublevel_eq_bot_of_forall_lt
  intro s
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := f.exists_criticalValue_eq s
  have h0 : (⟨0, hN⟩ : Fin (f.criticalValues.card)) ≤ i :=
    Fin.le_def.mpr (Nat.zero_le _)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hr ((f.criticalValue.monotone h0).trans_eq hi)

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.sublevel_eq_grade_of_gap
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq_grade_of_gap (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (i : Fin (f.criticalValues.card)) (r : α)
    (hlo : f.criticalValue i ≤ r)
    (hgap : ∀ j : Fin (f.criticalValues.card), i < j → r < f.criticalValue j) :
    f.sublevel r = f.gradeFiltration i
proof:
:= by
  rw [f.gradeFiltration_apply]
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro s hs
    obtain ⟨hsK, hsr⟩ := (f.mem_sublevel_iff r s).1 hs
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := f.exists_criticalValue_eq ⟨s, hsK⟩
    have hji : j ≤ i := by
      by_contra h
      have hij : i < j := lt_of_not_ge h
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hsr) (by simpa [hj] using hgap j hij)
    have hle : f.value ⟨s, hsK⟩ ≤ f.criticalValue i :=
      hj ▸ f.criticalValue.monotone hji
    exact (f.mem_sublevel_iff _ s).2 ⟨hsK, hle⟩
  · exact f.sublevel_mono hlo

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.sublevel_eq_grade_of_adjacent
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq_grade_of_adjacent (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (i j : Fin (f.criticalValues.card)) (hij : i.val + 1 = j.val)
    (r : α) (hlo : f.criticalValue i ≤ r) (hhi : r < f.criticalValue j) :
    f.sublevel r = f.gradeFiltration i
proof:
:= by
  apply f.sublevel_eq_grade_of_gap i r hlo
  intro k hik
  have hjk : j ≤ k := by
    apply Fin.le_def.mpr
    have hk : i.val < k.val := hik
    omega
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hhi (f.criticalValue.monotone hjk)

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.sublevel_eq_self_of_last_le
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq_self_of_last_le (f : FilterFunction K α)
    (hN : 0 < f.criticalValues.card) (r : α)
    (hr : f.criticalValue
      ⟨f.criticalValues.card - 1, Nat.sub_lt hN (by decide)⟩ ≤ r) :
    f.sublevel r = K
proof:
:= by
  apply f.sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
  intro s
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := f.exists_criticalValue_eq s
  have hilast : i ≤ (⟨f.criticalValues.card - 1,
      Nat.sub_lt hN (by decide)⟩ : Fin (f.criticalValues.card)) := by
    apply Fin.le_def.mpr
    change i.val ≤ f.criticalValues.card - 1
    have := i.isLt
    omega
  exact (hi ▸ (f.criticalValue.monotone hilast)).trans hr

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.sublevel_eq_bot_or_grade
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq_bot_or_grade (f : FilterFunction K α) (r : α) :
    f.sublevel r = ⊥ ∨
      ∃ i : Fin (f.criticalValues.card),
        f.criticalValue i ≤ r ∧ f.sublevel r = f.gradeFiltration i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let S : Finset α := f.criticalValues.filter (· ≤ r)
  by_cases hS : S.Nonempty
  · let a : α := S.max' hS
    have haS : a ∈ S := S.max'_mem hS
    have haC : a ∈ f.criticalValues := (Finset.mem_filter.mp haS).1
    have har : a ≤ r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp haS).2
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := f.exists_criticalValue_of_mem haC
    right
    refine ⟨i, hi.symm ▸ har, ?_⟩
    apply f.sublevel_eq_grade_of_gap i r (hi.symm ▸ har)
    intro j hij
    have hiaj : a < f.criticalValue j := hi ▸ f.criticalValue.strictMono hij
    by_contra h
    have hjr : f.criticalValue j ≤ r := le_of_not_gt h
    have hjS : f.criticalValue j ∈ S :=
      Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨f.criticalValue_mem j, hjr⟩
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (S.le_max' _ hjS)) hiaj
  · left
    apply f.sublevel_eq_bot_of_forall_lt
    intro s
    have hsC : f.value s ∈ f.criticalValues :=
      (f.mem_criticalValues _).2 ⟨s, rfl⟩
    have hsNot : f.value s ∉ S := fun hs => hS ⟨_, hs⟩
    exact lt_of_not_ge (fun hle => hsNot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hsC, hle⟩))

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt_comp_of_isometry
statement:
theorem radiusAt_comp_of_isometry (hf : Isometry f) (p : V → W) (x : W) (s : Finset V) :
    radiusAt (f ∘ p) (f x) s = radiusAt p x s
proof:
:= by
  unfold radiusAt
  congr 1
  funext v
  exact hf.dist_eq x (p v)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.complex_le_complex_comp
statement:
theorem complex_le_complex_comp (hf : Isometry f) (p : V → W) (r : ℝ) :
    complex p r ≤ complex (f ∘ p) r
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsn, x, hx⟩ := (mem_complex_iff p r s).1 hs
  exact (mem_complex_iff (f ∘ p) r s).2 ⟨hsn, f x, fun v hv => by
    rw [Function.comp_apply, hf.dist_eq]
    exact hx v hv⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_comp_value_le
statement:
theorem filter_comp_value_le (hf : Isometry f) (p : V → W)
    (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    (filter (f ∘ p)).value s ≤ (filter p).value s
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v₀, -⟩ : s.val.Nonempty := s.property
  have : Nonempty W := ⟨p v₀⟩
  refine le_ciInf fun x => ?_
  rw [← radiusAt_comp_of_isometry hf p x s.val]
  exact filter_value_le_radiusAt (f ∘ p) s (f x)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.dist_retract_le
proof:
:= by
  have h := hg.dist_le_mul x (f (p v))
  rw [hgp, NNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at h
  exact h

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.radiusAt_retract_le
proof:
:=
  (radiusAt_le_iff p (g x) s _).2 ⟨radiusAt_nonneg _ x s, fun v hv =>
    (dist_retract_le hg hgp x v).trans (dist_le_radiusAt (f ∘ p) x hv)⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.complex_comp_le_complex_of_retraction
statement:
theorem complex_comp_le_complex_of_retraction (hg : LipschitzWith 1 g) {p : V → W}
    (hgp : ∀ v, g (f (p v)) = p v) (r : ℝ) : complex (f ∘ p) r ≤ complex p r
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsn, x, hx⟩ := (mem_complex_iff (f ∘ p) r s).1 hs
  exact (mem_complex_iff p r s).2 ⟨hsn, g x, fun v hv =>
    (dist_retract_le hg hgp x v).trans (hx v hv)⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_value_le_filter_comp_value_of_retraction
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v₀, -⟩ : s.val.Nonempty := s.property
  have : Nonempty X := ⟨f (p v₀)⟩
  exact le_ciInf fun x =>
    (filter_value_le_radiusAt p s (g x)).trans (radiusAt_retract_le hg hgp x s.val)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.complex_comp_eq_of_retraction
statement:
theorem complex_comp_eq_of_retraction (hf : Isometry f) (hg : LipschitzWith 1 g) {p : V → W}
    (hgp : ∀ v, g (f (p v)) = p v) (r : ℝ) : complex (f ∘ p) r = complex p r
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (complex_comp_le_complex_of_retraction hg hgp r)
    (complex_le_complex_comp hf p r)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_comp_value_eq_of_retraction
statement:
theorem filter_comp_value_eq_of_retraction (hf : Isometry f) (hg : LipschitzWith 1 g)
    {p : V → W} (hgp : ∀ v, g (f (p v)) = p v) (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    (filter (f ∘ p)).value s = (filter p).value s
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (filter_comp_value_le hf p s)
    (filter_value_le_filter_comp_value_of_retraction hg hgp s)

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.complex_le_complex_val
statement:
theorem complex_le_complex_val (W : Set X) (p : V → W) (r : ℝ) :
    complex p r ≤ complex (Subtype.val ∘ p) r
proof:
:=
  complex_le_complex_comp isometry_subtype_coe p r

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_val_value_le
statement:
theorem filter_val_value_le (W : Set X) (p : V → W) (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    (filter (Subtype.val ∘ p)).value s ≤ (filter p).value s
proof:
:=
  filter_comp_value_le isometry_subtype_coe p s

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.complex_rangeFactorization_le
statement:
theorem complex_rangeFactorization_le (q : V → X) (r : ℝ) :
    complex (Set.rangeFactorization q) r ≤ complex q r
proof:
:=
  complex_le_complex_val (Set.range q) (Set.rangeFactorization q) r

name: TDA.Filtration.Cech.filter_value_le_filter_rangeFactorization_value
statement:
theorem filter_value_le_filter_rangeFactorization_value (q : V → X)
    (s : TotalFace (Rips.fullComplex V)) :
    (filter q).value s ≤ (filter (Set.rangeFactorization q)).value s
proof:
:=
  filter_val_value_le (Set.range q) (Set.rangeFactorization q) s

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_sublevel_iff (f : FilterFunction K α) (r : α) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ f.sublevel r ↔ ∃ hs : s ∈ K, f.value ⟨s, hs⟩ ≤ r
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_sublevel_iff_of_mem (f : FilterFunction K α) (r : α)
    (s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K) :
    s.val ∈ f.sublevel r ↔ f.value s ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_sublevel_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hs, h⟩
    have he : (⟨s.val, hs⟩ : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K) = s := Subtype.ext rfl
    simpa only [he] using h
  · intro h
    exact ⟨s.property, h⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.sublevel_le
statement:
theorem sublevel_le (f : FilterFunction K α) (r : α) :
    f.sublevel r ≤ K
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  exact (mem_sublevel_iff f r s).mp hs |>.1

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.sublevel_mono
statement: theorem sublevel_mono (f : FilterFunction K α) : Monotone f.sublevel
proof:
:= by
  intro r q hrq s hs
  rcases (mem_sublevel_iff f r s).mp hs with ⟨hsK, hsr⟩
  exact (mem_sublevel_iff f q s).mpr ⟨hsK, hsr.trans hrq⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.sublevelFiltration_apply
statement:
theorem sublevelFiltration_apply (f : FilterFunction K α) (r : α) :
    f.sublevelFiltration r = f.sublevel r
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.mem_support_sublevelFiltration_iff
statement:
theorem mem_support_sublevelFiltration_iff
    (f : FilterFunction K α) (r : α) (v : V) :
    v ∈ support f.sublevelFiltration r ↔
      ∃ hs : ({v} : Finset V) ∈ K, f.value ⟨{v}, hs⟩ ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  exact mem_sublevel_iff f r {v}

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le (f : FilterFunction K α) (r : α)
    (h : ∀ s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K, f.value s ≤ r) :
    f.sublevel r = K
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm (f.sublevel_le r)
  intro s hs
  exact (mem_sublevel_iff f r s).mpr ⟨hs, h ⟨s, hs⟩⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.sublevel_eq_bot_of_forall_lt
statement:
theorem sublevel_eq_bot_of_forall_lt (f : FilterFunction K α) (r : α)
    (h : ∀ s : TDA.Simplicial.TotalFace K, r < f.value s) :
    f.sublevel r = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro s hs
    rcases (mem_sublevel_iff f r s).mp hs with ⟨hsK, hsr⟩
    exact ((not_lt_of_ge hsr) (h ⟨s, hsK⟩)).elim
  · exact bot_le

name: TDA.Filtration.FilterFunction.sublevel_bot
statement:
theorem sublevel_bot (f : FilterFunction (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V) α)
    (r : α) : f.sublevel r = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact (f.sublevel_le r).trans le_rfl
  · exact bot_le

name: TDA.Filtration.isOpen_orderChamber
statement:
theorem isOpen_orderChamber [Finite ι] (F : X → ι → β) :
    IsOpen (orderChamber F)
proof:
:= by
  unfold orderChamber
  exact (isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun i =>
    isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun j => isClosed_frontier).isOpen_compl

name: TDA.Filtration.dense_orderChamber
statement:
theorem dense_orderChamber
    (F : X → ι → β)
    (hF : ∀ i, Continuous (fun x => F x i)) :
    Dense (orderChamber F)
proof:
