:= by
  let G : ι × ι → Set X := fun p => (frontier (eqLocus F p.1 p.2))ᶜ
  have hGopen : ∀ p, IsOpen (G p) := by
    intro p
    exact isClosed_frontier.isOpen_compl
  have hGdense : ∀ p, Dense (G p) := by
    intro p
    have hclosed : IsClosed (eqLocus F p.1 p.2) :=
      isClosed_eq (hF p.1) (hF p.2)
    exact interior_eq_empty_iff_dense_compl.mp (interior_frontier hclosed)
  have hinter : Dense (⋂₀ Set.range G) :=
    (Set.finite_range G).dense_sInter
      (by rintro s ⟨p, rfl⟩; exact hGopen p)
      (by rintro s ⟨p, rfl⟩; exact hGdense p)
  have heq : orderChamber F = ⋂₀ Set.range G := by
    ext x
    rw [Set.sInter_range]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      refine Set.mem_iInter.mpr fun p => ?_
      change x ∉ frontier (eqLocus F p.1 p.2)
      intro hfr
      exact hx (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨p.1, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨p.2, hfr⟩⟩)
    · intro hx
      change x ∉ ⋃ i, ⋃ j, frontier (eqLocus F i j)
      intro hbad
      obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hbad
      obtain ⟨j, hfr⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hi
      exact Set.mem_iInter.mp hx (i, j) hfr
  rw [heq]
  exact hinter

name: TDA.Filtration.exists_open_le_iff_of_mem_orderChamber
statement:
theorem exists_open_le_iff_of_mem_orderChamber
    (F : X → ι → β)
    (hF : ∀ i, Continuous (fun x => F x i))
    {x₀ : X} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ orderChamber F) :
    ∃ U : Set X, IsOpen U ∧ x₀ ∈ U ∧ U ⊆ orderChamber F ∧
      ∀ x ∈ U, ∀ i j,
        (F x₀ i ≤ F x₀ j ↔ F x i ≤ F x j)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hpair : ∀ i j : ι, ∃ W : Set X, IsOpen W ∧ x₀ ∈ W ∧
      ∀ x ∈ W, (F x₀ i ≤ F x₀ j ↔ F x i ≤ F x j) := by
    intro i j
    rcases lt_trichotomy (F x₀ i) (F x₀ j) with hij | heq | hji
    · refine ⟨{x | F x i < F x j}, isOpen_lt (hF i) (hF j), hij, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      exact iff_of_true hij.le hx.le
    · have hnot : x₀ ∉ frontier (eqLocus F i j) := by
        intro hfront
        exact hx₀ (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨j, hfront⟩⟩)
      have hmem : x₀ ∈ interior (eqLocus F i j) :=
        (mem_interior_iff_notMem_frontier (show x₀ ∈ eqLocus F i j from heq)).mpr hnot
      refine ⟨interior (eqLocus F i j), isOpen_interior, hmem, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      have hval : F x i = F x j :=
        (interior_subset (s := eqLocus F i j)) hx
      exact iff_of_true heq.le hval.le
    · refine ⟨{x | F x j < F x i}, isOpen_lt (hF j) (hF i), hji, ?_⟩
      intro x hx
      exact iff_of_false (not_le_of_gt hji) (not_le_of_gt hx)
  let W : ι × ι → Set X := fun p => Classical.choose (hpair p.1 p.2)
  have hWopen : ∀ p, IsOpen (W p) := fun p => (Classical.choose_spec (hpair p.1 p.2)).1
  have hWmem : ∀ p, x₀ ∈ W p := fun p => (Classical.choose_spec (hpair p.1 p.2)).2.1
  have hWcomp : ∀ p x, x ∈ W p →
      (F x₀ p.1 ≤ F x₀ p.2 ↔ F x p.1 ≤ F x p.2) :=
    fun p => (Classical.choose_spec (hpair p.1 p.2)).2.2
  refine ⟨orderChamber F ∩ ⋂ p, W p,
    (isOpen_orderChamber F).inter (isOpen_iInter_of_finite hWopen),
    ⟨hx₀, Set.mem_iInter.mpr hWmem⟩, Set.inter_subset_left, ?_⟩
  intro x hx i j
  exact hWcomp (i, j) x (Set.mem_iInter.mp hx.2 (i, j))

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.empty_equiv
statement:
private theorem empty_equiv (V : Type u') :
    OrderingEquivalent (emptyFilter V Unit) (emptyFilter V Empty)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t
  exact ((mem_bot_iff s.val).mp s.property).elim

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.empty_iso
statement:
private theorem empty_iso (V : Type u') :
    ∃ e : Set.range (emptyFilter V Unit).value ≃o
        Set.range (emptyFilter V Empty).value,
      ∀ s, (e ⟨(emptyFilter V Unit).value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩).val =
        (emptyFilter V Empty).value s
proof:
:=
  (orderingEquivalent_iff_exists_rangeOrderIso _ _).mp (empty_equiv V)

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.empty_fin0
statement:
private theorem empty_fin0 :
    OrderingEquivalent (emptyFilter (Fin 0) Unit) (emptyFilter (Fin 0) Empty) ∧
    (∃ e : Set.range (emptyFilter (Fin 0) Unit).value ≃o
        Set.range (emptyFilter (Fin 0) Empty).value,
      ∀ s, (e ⟨(emptyFilter (Fin 0) Unit).value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩).val =
        (emptyFilter (Fin 0) Empty).value s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨empty_equiv _, empty_iso _⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.empty_fin2
statement:
private theorem empty_fin2 :
    OrderingEquivalent (emptyFilter (Fin 2) Unit) (emptyFilter (Fin 2) Empty) ∧
    (∃ e : Set.range (emptyFilter (Fin 2) Unit).value ≃o
        Set.range (emptyFilter (Fin 2) Empty).value,
      ∀ s, (e ⟨(emptyFilter (Fin 2) Unit).value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩).val =
        (emptyFilter (Fin 2) Empty).value s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨empty_equiv _, empty_iso _⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.no_unit_to_empty
statement: private theorem no_unit_to_empty : ¬ Nonempty (Unit → Empty)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨φ⟩
  exact (φ ()).elim

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.singleton_equiv
statement: private theorem singleton_equiv : OrderingEquivalent singletonNat singletonInt
proof:
:= by
  intro s t
  simp [singletonNat, singletonInt]

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.singleton_attained
statement:
private theorem singleton_attained :
    singletonNat.sublevel (singletonNat.value singletonFace0) =
      singletonInt.sublevel (singletonInt.value singletonFace0) ∧
    singletonNat.sublevel 3 = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) ∧
    singletonInt.sublevel (-2) = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) ∧
    ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∉ singletonNat.sublevel 3
proof:
:= by
  have hn : singletonNat.sublevel 3 = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) := by
    apply FilterFunction.sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
    intro s
    exact le_refl 3
  have hi : singletonInt.sublevel (-2) = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) := by
    apply FilterFunction.sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
    intro s
    exact le_refl (-2 : ℤ)
  refine ⟨singleton_equiv.sublevel_eq singletonFace0, hn, hi, ?_⟩
  rw [hn]
  exact (mem_singletonFace_iff 0 {1}).not.mpr (by decide)

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.arbitrary_threshold_mismatch
statement:
private theorem arbitrary_threshold_mismatch :
    OrderingEquivalent singletonUnit singletonZeroInt ∧
    singletonUnit.sublevel () = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) ∧
    singletonZeroInt.sublevel (-1) = ⊥ ∧
    ∀ r : Unit, singletonUnit.sublevel r ≠ singletonZeroInt.sublevel (-1)
proof:
:= by
  have he : OrderingEquivalent singletonUnit singletonZeroInt := by
    intro s t
    simp [singletonUnit, singletonZeroInt]
  have hu : singletonUnit.sublevel () = singletonFace (0 : Fin 2) := by
    apply FilterFunction.sublevel_eq_self_of_forall_le
    intro s
    exact le_refl ()
  have hz : singletonZeroInt.sublevel (-1) = ⊥ := by
    apply FilterFunction.sublevel_eq_bot_of_forall_lt
    intro s
    norm_num [singletonZeroInt]
  refine ⟨he, hu, hz, ?_⟩
  intro r
  cases r
  rw [hu, hz]
  intro h
  have hs : ({0} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ (⊥ : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex (Fin 2)) := by
    rw [← h]
    exact singletonFace0.property
  exact (mem_bot_iff _).mp hs

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.edge_equiv
statement: private theorem edge_equiv : OrderingEquivalent edgeF edgeG
proof:
:= by
  intro s t
  change edgeF.value s ≤ edgeF.value t ↔
    2 * edgeF.value s + 1 ≤ 2 * edgeF.value t + 1
  omega

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.edge_values
statement:
private theorem edge_values :
    edgeF.value vertex0 = 0 ∧ edgeF.value vertex1 = 0 ∧
    edgeF.value edge = 1 ∧ edgeG.value vertex0 = 1 ∧
    edgeG.value vertex1 = 1 ∧ edgeG.value edge = 3
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.edge_iso_and_sublevels
statement:
private theorem edge_iso_and_sublevels :
    (∃ e : Set.range edgeF.value ≃o Set.range edgeG.value,
      (e ⟨edgeF.value vertex0, ⟨vertex0, rfl⟩⟩).val = edgeG.value vertex0 ∧
      (e ⟨edgeF.value vertex1, ⟨vertex1, rfl⟩⟩).val = edgeG.value vertex1 ∧
      (e ⟨edgeF.value edge, ⟨edge, rfl⟩⟩).val = edgeG.value edge) ∧
    edgeF.sublevel (edgeF.value vertex0) = edgeG.sublevel (edgeG.value vertex0) ∧
    edgeF.sublevel (edgeF.value vertex1) = edgeG.sublevel (edgeG.value vertex1) ∧
    edgeF.sublevel (edgeF.value edge) = edgeG.sublevel (edgeG.value edge)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := (orderingEquivalent_iff_exists_rangeOrderIso edgeF edgeG).mp edge_equiv
  exact ⟨⟨e, he vertex0, he vertex1, he edge⟩,
    edge_equiv.sublevel_eq vertex0,
    edge_equiv.sublevel_eq vertex1,
    edge_equiv.sublevel_eq edge⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.break_values
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.break_preserves_forward_strict
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  have ht : 0 ∈ t.val ∧ 1 ∈ t.val := by
    by_contra hn
    have : edgeF.value t = 0 := by simp [edgeF, hn]
    have hs : 0 ≤ edgeF.value s := by
      dsimp [edgeF]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    omega
  have hs : ¬ (0 ∈ s.val ∧ 1 ∈ s.val) := by
    intro hs
    have : edgeF.value s = 1 := by simp [edgeF, hs]
    have htmax : edgeF.value t ≤ 1 := by
      dsimp [edgeF]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    omega
  simp [edgeBreak, ht, hs]
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.break_not_equiv
statement: private theorem break_not_equiv : ¬ OrderingEquivalent edgeF edgeBreak
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hfalse : edgeBreak.value vertex1 ≤ edgeBreak.value vertex0 :=
    (h vertex1 vertex0).mp (by decide)
  norm_num [edgeBreak, vertex0, vertex1] at hfalse

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.cross_equiv
statement: private theorem cross_equiv : OrderingEquivalent edgeNat edgeF
proof:
:= by
  intro s t
  dsimp [edgeNat, edgeF]
  split_ifs <;> omega

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.cross_nat_int_mpr
statement: private theorem cross_nat_int_mpr : OrderingEquivalent edgeNat edgeF
proof:
:=
  (orderingEquivalent_iff_exists_rangeOrderIso edgeNat edgeF).mpr
    ((orderingEquivalent_iff_exists_rangeOrderIso edgeNat edgeF).mp cross_equiv)

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.cross_int_nat_mpr
statement: private theorem cross_int_nat_mpr : OrderingEquivalent edgeF edgeNat
proof:
:=
  (orderingEquivalent_iff_exists_rangeOrderIso edgeF edgeNat).mpr
    ((orderingEquivalent_iff_exists_rangeOrderIso edgeF edgeNat).mp cross_equiv.symm)

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.cross_both_directions
statement:
private theorem cross_both_directions :
    (∃ e : Set.range edgeNat.value ≃o Set.range edgeF.value,
      ∀ s, (e ⟨edgeNat.value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩).val = edgeF.value s) ∧
    (∃ e : Set.range edgeF.value ≃o Set.range edgeNat.value,
      ∀ s, (e ⟨edgeF.value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩).val = edgeNat.value s) ∧
    edgeNat.sublevel (edgeNat.value edge) = edgeF.sublevel (edgeF.value edge) ∧
    OrderingEquivalent edgeNat edgeF ∧ OrderingEquivalent edgeF edgeNat
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨(orderingEquivalent_iff_exists_rangeOrderIso edgeNat edgeF).mp cross_equiv,
    (orderingEquivalent_iff_exists_rangeOrderIso edgeF edgeNat).mp cross_equiv.symm,
    cross_equiv.sublevel_eq edge,
    cross_nat_int_mpr,
    cross_int_nat_mpr⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.OrderingEquivalentExamples.range_iso_unique
statement:
private theorem range_iso_unique
    {V : Type u'} {α : Type v'} {β : Type w'}
    [LinearOrder α] [LinearOrder β]
    {K : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V}
    (f : FilterFunction K α) (g : FilterFunction K β)
    (e d : Set.range f.value ≃o Set.range g.value)
    (he : ∀ s, (e ⟨f.value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩).val = g.value s)
    (hd : ∀ s, (d ⟨f.value s, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩).val = g.value s) : e = d
proof:
:= by
  apply OrderIso.ext
  funext a
  rcases a with ⟨a, ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (he s).trans (hd s).symm

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntrySet_closed
statement: theorem pairEntrySet_closed (x y : V) : IsClosed (pairEntrySet (η := η) time x y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold pairEntrySet
  exact isClosed_Ici.inter
    (isClosed_le (continuous_relaxedDistance hη (by linarith) time ht x y) continuous_id)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntrySet_nonempty
statement:
theorem pairEntrySet_nonempty (x y : V) :
    (pairEntrySet (η := η) time x y).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨3 * dist x y, ?_⟩
  have hr : 0 ≤ 3 * dist x y := by positivity
  have hx := weight_le hη (by linarith : η ≤ 1 / 2) hr (time x)
  have hy := weight_le hη (by linarith : η ≤ 1 / 2) hr (time y)
  change 0 ≤ 3 * dist x y ∧
    dist x y + weight η (time x) (3 * dist x y) +
      weight η (time y) (3 * dist x y) ≤ 3 * dist x y
  constructor
  · exact hr
  · nlinarith [dist_nonneg (x := x) (y := y)]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntrySet_bddBelow
statement:
theorem pairEntrySet_bddBelow (x y : V) :
    BddBelow (pairEntrySet (η := η) time x y)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntry_mem
statement:
theorem pairEntry_mem (x y : V) :
    pairEntry (η := η) time x y ∈ pairEntrySet (η := η) time x y
proof:
:=
  (pairEntrySet_closed hη hη' time ht x y).csInf_mem
    (pairEntrySet_nonempty hη hη' time x y)
    (pairEntrySet_bddBelow (η := η) time x y)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntry_nonneg
statement: theorem pairEntry_nonneg (x y : V) : 0 ≤ pairEntry (η := η) time x y
proof:
:=
  (pairEntry_mem hη hη' time ht x y).1

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntry_le_of_mem
proof:
:=
  csInf_le (pairEntrySet_bddBelow (η := η) time x y) hr

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntrySet_mono
proof:
:= by
  have hx := (weight_increment hη (by linarith : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (time x) (ht x) hr.1 hrs).2
  have hy := (weight_increment hη (by linarith : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (time y) (ht y) hr.1 hrs).2
  change 0 ≤ s ∧
    dist x y + weight η (time x) s + weight η (time y) s ≤ s
  constructor
  · exact hr.1.trans hrs
  · dsimp [pairEntrySet, relaxedDistance] at hr
    linarith [hr.2]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntry_le_iff
statement:
theorem pairEntry_le_iff (x y : V) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    pairEntry (η := η) time x y ≤ r ↔ relaxedDistance η time r x y ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact (pairEntrySet_mono hη hη' time ht x y
      (pairEntry_mem hη hη' time ht x y) h).2
  · intro h
    exact pairEntry_le_of_mem (η := η) time x y ⟨hr, h⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.dist_le_pairEntry
statement:
theorem dist_le_pairEntry (x y : V) :
    dist x y ≤ pairEntry (η := η) time x y
proof:
:= by
  have h := (pairEntry_mem hη hη' time ht x y).2
  have hx := weight_nonneg hη (pairEntry_nonneg hη hη' time ht x y) (time x)
  have hy := weight_nonneg hη (pairEntry_nonneg hη hη' time ht x y) (time y)
  dsimp [relaxedDistance] at h
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.activeUnion_mono
statement:
theorem activeUnion_mono (seed : V) (η : ℝ) {G H : Finset ℝ}
    (hGH : G ⊆ H) : activeUnion seed η G ≤ activeUnion seed η H
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hσa⟩ := hσ
  exact ⟨a, hGH ha, hσa⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.closedActiveComplex_le_activeUnion
statement:
theorem closedActiveComplex_le_activeUnion (seed : V) (η : ℝ) {G : Finset ℝ}
    {a : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ G) : closedActiveComplex seed η a ≤ activeUnion seed η G
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  exact ⟨a, ha, hσ⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionGrid_complete
statement:
theorem deletionGrid_complete (seed : V) (η r : ℝ) :
    DeletionComplete seed η (deletionGrid seed η r) r
proof:
:= by
  intro x t ht _ htr
  exact (mem_deletionGrid seed η r t).mpr (Or.inr ⟨htr, x, ht⟩)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionGrid_nonneg_le
statement:
theorem deletionGrid_nonneg_le (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) {r a : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (ha : a ∈ deletionGrid seed η r) : 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  rcases (mem_deletionGrid seed η r a).mp ha with rfl | ⟨har, x, hx⟩
  · exact ⟨hr, le_rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨deletionTime_nonneg seed hη hη' x a hx, har⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionComplete_erase_min
proof:
:= by
  intro x t ht hbefore htr
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hat⟩ := hbefore
  have htF : t ∈ F := hcomplete x t ht ⟨a, Finset.mem_of_mem_erase ha, hat⟩ htr
  have hdt : F.min' hF < t :=
    (Finset.min'_lt_of_mem_erase_min' F hF ha).trans_le hat
  exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨ne_of_gt hdt, htF⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.tailDeletionData_of_complete
statement:
theorem tailDeletionData_of_complete (seed : V) {η : ℝ}
    {F : Finset ℝ} {r : ℝ} (hF : F.Nonempty)
    (hbound : ∀ a ∈ F, 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ r)
    (hcomplete : DeletionComplete seed η F r)
    (hH : (F.erase (F.min' hF)).Nonempty) :
    TailDeletionData seed η F (F.erase (F.min' hF))
      (F.min' hF) ((F.erase (F.min' hF)).min' hH) where
  first_mem
proof:
:= Finset.min'_mem F hF
  next_mem := Finset.min'_mem _ hH
  tail_subset := Finset.erase_subset _ _
  first_or_tail := by
    intro a ha
    by_cases had : a = F.min' hF
    · exact Or.inl had
    · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨had, ha⟩)
  first_nonneg := (hbound _ (Finset.min'_mem F hF)).1
  first_lt_tail := by
    intro a ha
    exact Finset.min'_lt_of_mem_erase_min' F hF ha
  no_deletion := by
    intro x t ht hdt
    let H := F.erase (F.min' hF)
    let s := H.min' hH
    have hsr : s ≤ r := (hbound s (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase (Finset.min'_mem H hH))).2
    by_contra hst
    have htr : t ≤ r := (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hst)).trans hsr
    have htF : t ∈ F := hcomplete x t ht
      ⟨F.min' hF, Finset.min'_mem F hF, hdt.le⟩ htr
    have htH : t ∈ H := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨ne_of_gt hdt, htF⟩
    exact (not_lt_of_ge (Finset.min'_le H t htH)) (lt_of_not_ge hst)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.tailDeletion_inclusion_contiguous
statement:
theorem tailDeletion_inclusion_contiguous (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) {G H : Finset ℝ} {d s : ℝ}
    (data : TailDeletionData seed η G H d s) :
    Contiguous
      (VertexMap.comp (tailDeletionVertexMap seed hη hη' data)
        (inclusionVertexMap (activeUnion_mono seed η data.tail_subset)))
      (VertexMap.id (activeUnion seed η G))
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  change σ.image (deletionMap seed η d hη.le data.first_nonneg) ∪ σ.image id ∈
    activeUnion seed η G
  rw [Finset.image_id]
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hσa⟩ := hσ
  rcases data.first_or_tail a ha with had | haH
  · subst a
    refine ⟨d, data.first_mem, ?_⟩
    have hcont := inclusion_deletion_contiguous seed hη hη' data.first_nonneg σ hσa
    change σ.image (deletionMap seed η d hη.le data.first_nonneg) ∪ σ.image id ∈
      closedActiveComplex seed η d at hcont
    simpa only [Finset.image_id] using hcont
  · rw [deletionMap_image_later seed hη.le data.first_nonneg
      (data.first_lt_tail a haH) hσa, Finset.union_self]
    exact ⟨a, ha, hσa⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.inclusion_tailDeletion_contiguous
statement:
theorem inclusion_tailDeletion_contiguous (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) {G H : Finset ℝ} {d s : ℝ}
    (data : TailDeletionData seed η G H d s) :
    Contiguous
      (VertexMap.comp (inclusionVertexMap (activeUnion_mono seed η data.tail_subset))
        (tailDeletionVertexMap seed hη hη' data))
      (VertexMap.id (activeUnion seed η H))
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  change σ.image (deletionMap seed η d hη.le data.first_nonneg) ∪ σ.image id ∈
    activeUnion seed η H
  rw [Finset.image_id]
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hσa⟩ := hσ
  rw [deletionMap_image_later seed hη.le data.first_nonneg
    (data.first_lt_tail a ha) hσa, Finset.union_self]
  exact ⟨a, ha, hσa⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.tailDeletionHomologyIso_hom
proof:
:=
  simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion R _ n

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.nearestDistance_le
statement:
theorem nearestDistance_le {s : Finset V} {x y : V} (hy : y ∈ s) :
    nearestDistance s x ≤ dist x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [nearestDistance, dif_pos (show s.Nonempty from ⟨y, hy⟩)]
  exact Finset.inf'_le _ hy

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.exists_nearest
statement:
theorem exists_nearest {s : Finset V} (hs : s.Nonempty) (x : V) :
    ∃ y ∈ s, dist x y = nearestDistance s x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hmin⟩ := s.exists_min_image (dist x) hs
  refine ⟨y, hy, le_antisymm ?_ (nearestDistance_le hy)⟩
  simp only [nearestDistance, dif_pos hs]
  exact Finset.le_inf' hs (dist x) (fun z hz => hmin z hz)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.nearestDistance_nonneg
statement:
theorem nearestDistance_nonneg (s : Finset V) (x : V) :
    0 ≤ nearestDistance s x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hs : s.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨y, _, hy⟩ := exists_nearest hs x
    rw [← hy]
    exact dist_nonneg
  · simp [nearestDistance, hs]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.nearestDistance_of_mem
statement:
@[simp] theorem nearestDistance_of_mem {s : Finset V} {x : V} (hx : x ∈ s) :
    nearestDistance s x = 0
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (by simpa using nearestDistance_le (x := x) hx)
    (nearestDistance_nonneg s x)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.nearestDistance_pos
statement:
theorem nearestDistance_pos {s : Finset V} (hs : s.Nonempty) {x : V} (hx : x ∉ s) :
    0 < nearestDistance s x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := exists_nearest hs x
  rw [← heq]
  exact dist_pos.mpr (fun h => hx (h ▸ hy))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.nearestDistance_antitone
statement:
theorem nearestDistance_antitone {s t : Finset V} (hs : s.Nonempty) (hst : s ⊆ t)
    (x : V) : nearestDistance t x ≤ nearestDistance s x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := exists_nearest hs x
  rw [← heq]
  exact nearestDistance_le (hst hy)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.le_next
statement:
theorem le_next (seed : V) (s : Finset V) (x : V) :
    nearestDistance s x ≤ nearestDistance s (next seed s)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (Finset.univ.exists_max_image (nearestDistance s)
    ⟨seed, Finset.mem_univ seed⟩)).2 x (Finset.mem_univ x)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.prefix_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem prefix_zero (seed : V) : greedyPrefix seed 0 = {seed}
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.prefix_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem prefix_succ (seed : V) (n : ℕ) :
    greedyPrefix seed (n + 1) = insert (next seed (greedyPrefix seed n)) (greedyPrefix seed n)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.prefix_step
statement: theorem prefix_step (seed : V) (n : ℕ) : greedyPrefix seed n ⊆ greedyPrefix seed (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.subset_insert _ _

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.prefix_mono
statement: theorem prefix_mono (seed : V) : Monotone (greedyPrefix seed)
proof:
:=
  monotone_nat_of_le_succ (prefix_step seed)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.seed_mem_prefix
statement: theorem seed_mem_prefix (seed : V) (n : ℕ) : seed ∈ greedyPrefix seed n
proof:
:=
  prefix_mono seed (Nat.zero_le n) (by simp)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.prefix_nonempty
statement: theorem prefix_nonempty (seed : V) (n : ℕ) : (greedyPrefix seed n).Nonempty
proof:
:=
  ⟨seed, seed_mem_prefix seed n⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.vertex_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem vertex_zero (seed : V) : vertex seed 0 = seed
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.vertex_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertex_succ (seed : V) (n : ℕ) :
    vertex seed (n + 1) = next seed (greedyPrefix seed n)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.mem_prefix_iff
statement:
theorem mem_prefix_iff (seed : V) (n : ℕ) (x : V) :
    x ∈ greedyPrefix seed n ↔ ∃ i ≤ n, vertex seed i = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [eq_comm]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [prefix_succ, Finset.mem_insert, ih]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
      · exact ⟨n + 1, le_rfl, h.symm⟩
      · exact ⟨i, by omega, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, heq⟩
      by_cases hin : i ≤ n
      · exact Or.inr ⟨i, hin, heq⟩
      · have hindex : i = n + 1 := by omega
        exact Or.inl (by simpa [hindex] using heq.symm)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.radius_nonneg
statement: theorem radius_nonneg (seed : V) (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ radius seed n
proof:
:=
  nearestDistance_nonneg _ _

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.covering
statement:
theorem covering (seed : V) (n : ℕ) (x : V) :
    ∃ y ∈ greedyPrefix seed n, dist x y ≤ radius seed n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := exists_nearest (prefix_nonempty seed n) x
  exact ⟨y, hy, heq.trans_le (le_next seed _ x)⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.next_not_mem
statement:
theorem next_not_mem (seed : V) {n : ℕ} (h : greedyPrefix seed n ≠ Finset.univ) :
    next seed (greedyPrefix seed n) ∉ greedyPrefix seed n
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ : ∃ x, x ∉ greedyPrefix seed n := by
    by_contra! hall
    exact h (Finset.eq_univ_of_forall hall)
  have hpos := (nearestDistance_pos (prefix_nonempty seed n) hx).trans_le
    (le_next seed (greedyPrefix seed n) x)
  intro hn
  rw [nearestDistance_of_mem hn] at hpos
  exact (lt_irrefl 0) hpos

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.radius_antitone
statement: theorem radius_antitone (seed : V) : Antitone (radius seed)
proof:
:= by
  apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le
  intro n
  exact (nearestDistance_antitone (prefix_nonempty seed n) (prefix_step seed n) _).trans
    (le_next seed _ _)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.card_prefix
statement:
theorem card_prefix (seed : V) (n : ℕ) :
    (greedyPrefix seed n).card = min (n + 1) (Fintype.card V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcard : 0 < Fintype.card V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨seed⟩
  induction n with
  | zero => simp; omega
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases h : greedyPrefix seed n = Finset.univ
    · have hle : Fintype.card V ≤ n + 1 := by
        rw [h, Finset.card_univ] at ih
        omega
      simp [prefix_succ, h]
      omega
    · have hlt : (greedyPrefix seed n).card < Fintype.card V := by
        exact Finset.card_lt_card (Finset.ssubset_univ_iff.mpr h)
      rw [prefix_succ, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (next_not_mem seed h), ih]
      omega

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.prefix_eq_univ
statement:
theorem prefix_eq_univ (seed : V) {n : ℕ} (hn : Fintype.card V ≤ n + 1) :
    greedyPrefix seed n = Finset.univ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Finset.card_eq_iff_eq_univ _).mp
  rw [card_prefix]
  omega

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.vertex_bijective
statement:
theorem vertex_bijective (seed : V) :
    Function.Bijective (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card V) => vertex seed i.val)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply (Fintype.bijective_iff_surjective_and_card _).mpr
  refine ⟨?_, by simp⟩
  intro x
  have hcard : 0 < Fintype.card V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨seed⟩
  have hx : x ∈ greedyPrefix seed (Fintype.card V - 1) := by
    rw [prefix_eq_univ seed (by omega)]
    exact Finset.mem_univ x
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hix⟩ := (mem_prefix_iff seed _ x).mp hx
  exact ⟨⟨i, by omega⟩, hix⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.enumeration_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem enumeration_apply (seed : V) (i : Fin (Fintype.card V)) :
    enumeration seed i = vertex seed i.val
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.separation
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero => simp only [prefix_zero, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx hy; exact (hne (hx.trans hy.symm)).elim
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [prefix_succ, Finset.mem_insert] at hx hy
    have hrad := radius_antitone seed (Nat.le_succ n)
    rcases hx with rfl | hx <;> rcases hy with rfl | hy
    · exact (hne rfl).elim
    · exact hrad.trans (nearestDistance_le hy)
    · rw [dist_comm]
      exact hrad.trans (nearestDistance_le hx)
    · exact hrad.trans (ih hx hy)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.separation_succ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [prefix_succ, Finset.mem_insert] at hx hy
  rcases hx with rfl | hx <;> rcases hy with rfl | hy
  · exact (hne rfl).elim
  · exact nearestDistance_le hy
  · rw [dist_comm]; exact nearestDistance_le hx
  · exact separation seed n hx hy hne

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.radius_eq_zero_of_full
statement:
@[simp] theorem radius_eq_zero_of_full (seed : V) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : greedyPrefix seed n = Finset.univ) : radius seed n = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold radius
  exact nearestDistance_of_mem (hn ▸ Finset.mem_univ _)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.exists_radius_le
statement:
theorem exists_radius_le (seed : V) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    ∃ n, radius seed n ≤ δ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Fintype.card V, ?_⟩
  rw [radius_eq_zero_of_full seed (prefix_eq_univ seed (by omega))]
  exact hδ

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.radius_cutoff_le
statement:
theorem radius_cutoff_le (seed : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    radius seed (cutoff seed δ hδ) ≤ δ
proof:
:=
  Nat.find_spec (exists_radius_le seed hδ)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.lt_radius_before_cutoff
statement:
theorem lt_radius_before_cutoff (seed : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : n < cutoff seed δ hδ) : δ < radius seed n
proof:
:=
  lt_of_not_ge (Nat.find_min (exists_radius_le seed hδ) hn)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.threshold_net
statement:
theorem threshold_net (seed : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (∀ x, ∃ y ∈ greedyPrefix seed (cutoff seed δ hδ), dist x y ≤ δ) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ greedyPrefix seed (cutoff seed δ hδ),
      ∀ y ∈ greedyPrefix seed (cutoff seed δ hδ), x ≠ y → δ < dist x y)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := covering seed (cutoff seed δ hδ) x
    exact ⟨y, hy, hxy.trans (radius_cutoff_le seed δ hδ)⟩
  · intro x hx y hy hne
    generalize hk : cutoff seed δ hδ = k at hx hy
    cases k with
    | zero =>
      simp only [prefix_zero, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx hy
      exact (hne (hx.trans hy.symm)).elim
    | succ n =>
      exact (lt_radius_before_cutoff seed δ hδ (by omega)).trans_le
        (separation_succ seed n hx hy hne)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.mem_insertionIndex
statement: theorem mem_insertionIndex (seed x : V) : x ∈ greedyPrefix seed (insertionIndex seed x)
proof:
:=
  by
    unfold insertionIndex
    exact Nat.find_spec (p := fun n => x ∈ greedyPrefix seed n) _

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.not_mem_before_insertionIndex
statement:
theorem not_mem_before_insertionIndex (seed x : V) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : n < insertionIndex seed x) : x ∉ greedyPrefix seed n
proof:
:=
  Nat.find_min _ hn

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.insertionIndex_seed
statement: @[simp] theorem insertionIndex_seed (seed : V) : insertionIndex seed seed = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold insertionIndex
  exact (Nat.find_eq_zero _).mpr (by simp)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.insertionRadius_seed
statement: @[simp] theorem insertionRadius_seed (seed : V) : insertionRadius seed seed = none
proof:
:= by
  simp [insertionRadius]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.insertionIndex_eq_zero_iff
statement: theorem insertionIndex_eq_zero_iff (seed x : V) : insertionIndex seed x = 0 ↔ x = seed
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hx := mem_insertionIndex seed x
    simpa [h] using hx
  · intro h; subst x; exact insertionIndex_seed seed

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.mem_threshold_iff
statement:
theorem mem_threshold_iff (seed x : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    x ∈ greedyPrefix seed (cutoff seed δ hδ) ↔
      x = seed ∨ δ < radius seed (insertionIndex seed x - 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    by_cases hxs : x = seed
    · exact Or.inl hxs
    · right
      have hindex : 0 < insertionIndex seed x := by
        have := (insertionIndex_eq_zero_iff seed x).not.mpr hxs
        omega
      have hle : insertionIndex seed x ≤ cutoff seed δ hδ := by
        by_contra! hn
        exact not_mem_before_insertionIndex seed x hn hx
      exact lt_radius_before_cutoff seed δ hδ (by omega)
  · rintro (hxs | hrad)
    · subst x; exact seed_mem_prefix seed _
    · by_cases hi : insertionIndex seed x ≤ cutoff seed δ hδ
      · exact prefix_mono seed hi (mem_insertionIndex seed x)
      · have hle : cutoff seed δ hδ ≤ insertionIndex seed x - 1 := by omega
        have hmono := radius_antitone seed hle
        have hcut := radius_cutoff_le seed δ hδ
        linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.vertex_insertionIndex
statement: theorem vertex_insertionIndex (seed x : V) : vertex seed (insertionIndex seed x) = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x = seed
  · subst x; simp
  · have hi : 0 < insertionIndex seed x := by
      have := (insertionIndex_eq_zero_iff seed x).not.mpr hx
      omega
    have hnot := not_mem_before_insertionIndex seed x
      (show insertionIndex seed x - 1 < insertionIndex seed x by omega)
    have hmem := mem_insertionIndex seed x
    have heq : insertionIndex seed x = (insertionIndex seed x - 1) + 1 := by omega
    rw [heq, prefix_succ, Finset.mem_insert] at hmem
    rw [heq, vertex_succ]
    exact (hmem.resolve_right hnot).symm

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.insertionIndex_injective
statement: theorem insertionIndex_injective (seed : V) : Function.Injective (insertionIndex seed)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  rw [← vertex_insertionIndex seed x, ← vertex_insertionIndex seed y, hxy]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.insertionRadius_pos
statement:
theorem insertionRadius_pos (seed x : V) (hxs : x ≠ seed) :
    0 < radius seed (insertionIndex seed x - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hi : 0 < insertionIndex seed x := by
    have := (insertionIndex_eq_zero_iff seed x).not.mpr hxs
    omega
  have hnot := not_mem_before_insertionIndex seed x (show insertionIndex seed x - 1 <
    insertionIndex seed x by omega)
  have hx := mem_insertionIndex seed x
  have heq : insertionIndex seed x = (insertionIndex seed x - 1) + 1 := by omega
  rw [heq, prefix_succ, Finset.mem_insert] at hx
  have hxnext : x = next seed (greedyPrefix seed (insertionIndex seed x - 1)) :=
    hx.resolve_right hnot
  unfold radius
  rw [← hxnext]
  exact nearestDistance_pos (prefix_nonempty seed _) hnot

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.netPoint_mem
statement:
theorem netPoint_mem (seed : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (x : V) :
    netPoint seed δ hδ x ∈ greedyPrefix seed (cutoff seed δ hδ)
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec ((threshold_net seed δ hδ).1 x)).1

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.GreedyNet.dist_netPoint_le
statement:
theorem dist_netPoint_le (seed : V) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (x : V) :
    dist x (netPoint seed δ hδ x) ≤ δ
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec ((threshold_net seed δ hδ).1 x)).2

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.ClosedBallDoubling.iterated_cover
statement:
theorem ClosedBallDoubling.iterated_cover {Λ : ℕ} (hd : ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) Λ)
    (p : V) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (h : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : Finset V, C.card ≤ Λ ^ h ∧
      ∀ x, dist p x ≤ R → ∃ q ∈ C, dist q x ≤ R / (2 : ℝ) ^ h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction h with
  | zero => exact ⟨{p}, by simp, fun x hx => ⟨p, by simp, by simpa using hx⟩⟩
  | succ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨A, hA, hcover⟩ := ih
    have hrad : 0 < R / (2 : ℝ) ^ h := div_pos hR (by positivity)
    choose C hC hCcover using fun q : V => hd.2 q (R / (2 : ℝ) ^ h) hrad
    refine ⟨A.biUnion C, ?_, ?_⟩
    · calc
        (A.biUnion C).card ≤ ∑ q ∈ A, (C q).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
        _ ≤ ∑ _q ∈ A, Λ := Finset.sum_le_sum fun q _ => hC q
        _ = A.card * Λ := by simp
        _ ≤ Λ ^ h * Λ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right Λ hA
        _ = Λ ^ (h + 1) := (pow_succ Λ h).symm
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hqx⟩ := hcover x hx
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hzx⟩ := hCcover q x hqx
      refine ⟨z, Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨q, hq, hz⟩, ?_⟩
      convert hzx using 1
      rw [pow_succ]
      ring

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.ClosedBallDoubling.packing_bound
statement:
theorem ClosedBallDoubling.packing_bound {Λ : ℕ} (hd : ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) Λ)
    (p : V) {R δ : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (h : ℕ)
    (hratio : 2 * (R / (2 : ℝ) ^ h) < δ) (P : Finset V)
    (hball : ∀ x ∈ P, dist p x ≤ R)
    (hsep : ∀ x ∈ P, ∀ y ∈ P, x ≠ y → δ ≤ dist x y) :
    P.card ≤ Λ ^ h
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hcover⟩ := hd.iterated_cover p hR h
  let f (x : V) : V := if hx : x ∈ P then Classical.choose (hcover x (hball x hx)) else p
  have hf (x : V) (hx : x ∈ P) : f x ∈ C ∧ dist (f x) x ≤ R / (2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
    dsimp [f]
    rw [dif_pos hx]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (hcover x (hball x hx))
  apply (Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn f (fun x hx => (hf x hx).1) ?_).trans hC
  intro x hx y hy heq
  by_contra hxy
  have hsep' := hsep x hx y hy hxy
  have hfx := (hf x hx).2
  have hfy := (hf y hy).2
  have htri := dist_triangle x (f x) y
  rw [heq] at hfx
  rw [dist_comm x (f x), heq] at htri
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.ClosedBallDoubling.of_isometry_real
statement:
theorem ClosedBallDoubling.of_isometry_real (f : V → ℝ) (hf : Isometry f) :
    ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) 4
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro p R hR
  let bucket (k : Fin 4) (x : V) : Prop :=
    f p - R + (k.val : ℝ) * (R / 2) ≤ f x ∧
      f x ≤ f p - R + ((k.val : ℝ) + 1) * (R / 2)
  let q (k : Fin 4) : V := if h : ∃ x, bucket k x then Classical.choose h else p
  have hq (k : Fin 4) (x : V) (hx : bucket k x) : bucket k (q k) := by
    dsimp [q]
    rw [dif_pos (show ∃ x, bucket k x from ⟨x, hx⟩)]
    exact Classical.choose_spec (show ∃ x, bucket k x from ⟨x, hx⟩)
  refine ⟨Finset.univ.image q, (Finset.card_image_le).trans (by simp), ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hdist : |f p - f x| ≤ R := by
    rw [← Real.dist_eq, hf.dist_eq]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp hdist
  have hbucket : ∃ k : Fin 4, bucket k x := by
    by_cases h₀ : f x ≤ f p - R / 2
    · exact ⟨0, by dsimp [bucket]; norm_num; constructor <;> linarith⟩
    · by_cases h₁ : f x ≤ f p
      · exact ⟨1, by dsimp [bucket]; norm_num; constructor <;> linarith⟩
      · by_cases h₂ : f x ≤ f p + R / 2
        · exact ⟨2, by dsimp [bucket]; norm_num; constructor <;> linarith⟩
        · exact ⟨3, by dsimp [bucket]; norm_num; constructor <;> linarith⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hbucket
  refine ⟨q k, Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨k, Finset.mem_univ k, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [← hf.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
  apply abs_le.mpr
  have hqk := hq k x hk
  dsimp [bucket] at hk hqk
  constructor <;> linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.isIso_sparse_relaxed_all
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : 0 ≤ r
  · exact isIso_sparse_relaxed R seed hη hη' hr n
  · have hback : relaxedComplex η (deletionTime seed η) r ≤ sparseComplex seed η r := by
      intro σ hσ
      exact False.elim (hr hσ.2.1)
    let e : simplicialHomology (sparseComplex seed η r) R n ≅
        simplicialHomology (relaxedComplex η (deletionTime seed η) r) R n := {
      hom := simplicialHomologyIncl R
        (sparseComplex_le_relaxedComplex seed hη hη' r) n
      inv := simplicialHomologyIncl R hback n
      hom_inv_id := by
        rw [← simplicialHomologyIncl_comp, simplicialHomologyIncl_id]
      inv_hom_id := by
        rw [← simplicialHomologyIncl_comp, simplicialHomologyIncl_id]
    }
    exact Iso.isIso_hom e

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseToRelaxedHom_app
statement:
@[simp] theorem sparseToRelaxedHom_app (R : Type*) [Ring R] (seed : V)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) :
    (sparseToRelaxedHom R seed hη hη' n).app r =
      simplicialHomologyIncl R (sparseComplex_le_relaxedComplex seed hη hη' r) n
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.isIso_sparseToRelaxedHom
proof:
:= by
  rw [NatTrans.isIso_iff_isIso_app]
  intro r
  exact isIso_sparse_relaxed_all R seed hη hη' r n

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.approximationFactor_mul
statement:
theorem approximationFactor_mul {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) :
    (1 - 2 * η) * approximationFactor η = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 1 - 2 * η ≠ 0 := by linarith
  simp [approximationFactor, hden]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.one_le_approximationFactor
statement:
theorem one_le_approximationFactor {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) :
    1 ≤ approximationFactor η
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < 1 - 2 * η := by linarith
  have hmul := approximationFactor_mul hη hη'
  have hfac : 0 < approximationFactor η := by
    exact inv_pos.mpr hden
  nlinarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.approximationFactor_one_third
statement: @[simp] theorem approximationFactor_one_third : approximationFactor (1 / 3) = 3
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [approximationFactor]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.parameterOfTolerance_pos
statement:
theorem parameterOfTolerance_pos {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    0 < parameterOfTolerance τ
proof:
:= by
  unfold parameterOfTolerance
  exact div_pos hτ (by positivity)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.parameterOfTolerance_le_third
statement:
theorem parameterOfTolerance_le_third {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hτ' : τ ≤ 1) :
    parameterOfTolerance τ ≤ 1 / 3
proof:
:= by
  unfold parameterOfTolerance
  apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2 * (1 + τ))).mpr
  nlinarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.approximationFactor_parameterOfTolerance
statement:
theorem approximationFactor_parameterOfTolerance {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    approximationFactor (parameterOfTolerance τ) = 1 + τ
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 < 2 * (1 + τ) := by positivity
  unfold approximationFactor parameterOfTolerance
  field_simp
  ring

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.relaxed_le_rips_log
statement:
theorem relaxed_le_rips_log (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (t : ℝ) :
    relaxedComplex η (deletionTime seed η) (Real.exp t) ≤
      (Rips.filter inferInstance).sublevel
        (Real.exp (t + logParam (approximationFactor η)))
proof:
:= by
  have hc := one_le_approximationFactor hη hη'
  rw [exp_add_logParam hc]
  exact (relaxedComplex_le_rips hη.le (deletionTime seed η)).trans
    ((Rips.filter inferInstance).sublevel_mono
      (by have hfac : 1 ≤ approximationFactor η := hc
          nlinarith [Real.exp_pos t]))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.rips_le_relaxed_log
statement:
theorem rips_le_relaxed_log (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η)
    (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (t : ℝ) :
    (Rips.filter inferInstance).sublevel (Real.exp t) ≤
      relaxedComplex η (deletionTime seed η)
        (Real.exp (t + logParam (approximationFactor η)))
proof:
:= by
  have hc := one_le_approximationFactor hη hη'
  rw [exp_add_logParam hc]
  have heq : (1 - 2 * η) * (approximationFactor η * Real.exp t) = Real.exp t := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, approximationFactor_mul hη hη', one_mul]
  have hr : 0 ≤ approximationFactor η * Real.exp t :=
    mul_nonneg (le_trans zero_le_one hc) (Real.exp_pos t).le
  simpa only [heq] using
    (rips_le_relaxedComplex hη.le (by linarith) hr (deletionTime seed η))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseRipsLogDistance_le
statement:
theorem sparseRipsLogDistance_le (R : Type*) [Ring R] (seed : V) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (n : ℕ) :
    realInterleavingDistance
      (simplicialHomologyPModule R
        (Filtration.reindex expHom (sparseFiltration seed η)) n)
      (simplicialHomologyPModule R
        (Filtration.reindex expHom (Rips.filter (V := V) inferInstance).sublevelFiltration) n) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (approximationFactor η))
proof:
:=
  (sparseRipsLogInterleaving R seed hη hη' n).distance_le

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionTime_seed
statement: @[simp] theorem deletionTime_seed (seed : V) (η : ℝ) : deletionTime seed η seed = none
proof:
:= by
  simp [deletionTime]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.openActive_none
statement: @[simp] theorem openActive_none (r : ℝ) : OpenActive none r
proof: := trivial

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.closedActive_none
statement: @[simp] theorem closedActive_none (r : ℝ) : ClosedActive none r
proof: := trivial

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionTime_of_ne
statement:
theorem deletionTime_of_ne (seed : V) (η : ℝ) {x : V} (hx : x ≠ seed) :
    deletionTime seed η x = some
      (radius seed (insertionIndex seed x - 1) / (η * (1 - 2 * η)))
proof:
:= by
  simp [deletionTime, insertionRadius, (insertionIndex_eq_zero_iff seed x).not.mpr hx]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.parameter_pos
statement:
private theorem parameter_pos {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) :
    0 < η * (1 - 2 * η)
proof: := mul_pos hη (by linarith)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionTime_nonneg
statement:
theorem deletionTime_nonneg (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3)
    (x : V) : ∀ t ∈ deletionTime seed η x, 0 ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  by_cases hx : x = seed
  · simp [hx] at ht
  · rw [deletionTime_of_ne seed η hx] at ht
    have heq : t = radius seed (insertionIndex seed x - 1) / (η * (1 - 2 * η)) := by
      simpa [eq_comm] using ht
    rw [heq]
    exact div_nonneg (radius_nonneg seed _) (parameter_pos hη hη').le

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.netPoint_active_weight_zero
statement:
theorem netPoint_active_weight_zero (seed : V) {η r : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (x : V) :
    let q := netPoint seed (η * r) (mul_nonneg hη.le hr) x
    OpenActive (deletionTime seed η q) r ∧ weight η (deletionTime seed η q) r = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let q := netPoint seed (η * r) (mul_nonneg hη.le hr) x
  change OpenActive (deletionTime seed η q) r ∧ weight η (deletionTime seed η q) r = 0
  have hq := (mem_threshold_iff seed q (η * r) (mul_nonneg hη.le hr)).mp
    (netPoint_mem seed (η * r) (mul_nonneg hη.le hr) x)
  rcases hq with hq | hq
  · rw [hq, deletionTime_seed]
    simp [OpenActive]
  · by_cases hqs : q = seed
    · rw [hqs, deletionTime_seed]
      simp [OpenActive]
    · rw [deletionTime_of_ne seed η hqs]
      simp only [OpenActive, Option.elim_some, weight_some]
      have hp := parameter_pos hη hη'
      have hfactor : 0 < 1 - 2 * η := by linarith
      have hηr := mul_nonneg hη.le hr
      have htime : r < radius seed (insertionIndex seed q - 1) / (η * (1 - 2 * η)) := by
        apply (lt_div_iff₀ hp).mpr
        have hprod := mul_nonneg hη.le hηr
        have hbound : η * (1 - 2 * η) * r ≤ η * r := by nlinarith
        nlinarith
      refine ⟨htime, finiteWeight_of_le ?_⟩
      have hcancel : (1 - 2 * η) *
          (radius seed (insertionIndex seed q - 1) / (η * (1 - 2 * η))) =
          radius seed (insertionIndex seed q - 1) / η := by
        field_simp [ne_of_gt hη, ne_of_gt hfactor]
      rw [hcancel]
      exact (le_div_iff₀ hη).mpr (by nlinarith)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionMap_of_active
statement:
@[simp] theorem deletionMap_of_active (seed : V) {η r : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    {x : V} (hx : OpenActive (deletionTime seed η x) r) :
    deletionMap seed η r hη hr x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [deletionMap, hx]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionMap_active
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : OpenActive (deletionTime seed η x) r
  · simp [deletionMap, hx]
  · simpa [deletionMap, hx] using (netPoint_active_weight_zero seed hη hη' hr x).1

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionMap_domination
statement:
theorem deletionMap_domination (seed : V) {η r : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (x : V) :
    dist x (deletionMap seed η r hη.le hr x) ≤
      weight η (deletionTime seed η x) r -
        weight η (deletionTime seed η (deletionMap seed η r hη.le hr x)) r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hx : OpenActive (deletionTime seed η x) r
  · simp [deletionMap, hx]
  · have hxs : x ≠ seed := by
      intro h
      apply hx
      simp [h]
    have htime := deletionTime_of_ne seed η hxs
    have hfinite : 0 ≤ radius seed (insertionIndex seed x - 1) / (η * (1 - 2 * η)) :=
      div_nonneg (radius_nonneg seed _) (parameter_pos hη hη').le
    have hremoved : radius seed (insertionIndex seed x - 1) / (η * (1 - 2 * η)) ≤ r := by
      simpa [htime, OpenActive] using hx
    have hw : weight η (deletionTime seed η x) r = η * r := by
      rw [htime, weight_some]
      exact finiteWeight_of_time_le hη.le hfinite hremoved
    simp only [deletionMap, if_neg hx, hw]
    rw [(netPoint_active_weight_zero seed hη hη' hr x).2, sub_zero]
    exact dist_netPoint_le seed (η * r) (mul_nonneg hη.le hr) x

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.finiteWeight_eq_max_min
statement:
theorem finiteWeight_eq_max_min {η t : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) (r : ℝ) :
    finiteWeight η t r = max 0 (min ((r - (1 - 2 * η) * t) / 2) (η * r))
proof:
:= by
  have ha : 0 ≤ (1 - 2 * η) * t := mul_nonneg (by linarith) ht
  unfold finiteWeight
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂
  · have hm : min ((r - (1 - 2 * η) * t) / 2) (η * r) ≤ 0 :=
      (min_le_left _ _).trans (by linarith)
    exact (max_eq_left hm).symm
  · have hpos : 0 ≤ (r - (1 - 2 * η) * t) / 2 := by linarith
    have hmin : (r - (1 - 2 * η) * t) / 2 ≤ η * r := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 1 - 2 * η by linarith)
        (show 0 ≤ t - r by linarith)]
    rw [min_eq_left hmin, max_eq_right hpos]
  · have hr : 0 ≤ r := ht.trans (le_of_not_gt h₂)
    have hpos : 0 ≤ η * r := mul_nonneg hη hr
    have hmin : η * r ≤ (r - (1 - 2 * η) * t) / 2 := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 1 - 2 * η by linarith)
        (show 0 ≤ r - t by linarith)]
    rw [min_eq_right hmin, max_eq_right hpos]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.continuous_finiteWeight
statement:
theorem continuous_finiteWeight {η t : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (ht : 0 ≤ t) : Continuous (finiteWeight η t)
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : Continuous (fun r : ℝ =>
      max 0 (min ((r - (1 - 2 * η) * t) / 2) (η * r))) := by
    fun_prop
  convert hfun using 1
  funext r
  exact finiteWeight_eq_max_min hη hη' ht r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.continuous_weight
statement:
theorem continuous_weight {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (time : Option ℝ) (ht : ∀ t ∈ time, 0 ≤ t) :
    Continuous (weight η time)
proof:
:= by
  cases time with
  | none =>
      change Continuous (fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ))
      exact continuous_const
  | some t =>
      change Continuous (finiteWeight η t)
      exact continuous_finiteWeight hη hη' (ht t (by simp))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.continuous_relaxedDistance
statement:
theorem continuous_relaxedDistance {V : Type*} [MetricSpace V] {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2) (time : V → Option ℝ)
    (ht : ∀ x t, t ∈ time x → 0 ≤ t) (x y : V) :
    Continuous (relaxedDistance η time · x y)
proof:
:= by
  change Continuous (fun r : ℝ =>
    dist x y + weight η (time x) r + weight η (time y) r)
  exact (continuous_const.add (continuous_weight hη hη' (time x) (ht x))).add
    (continuous_weight hη hη' (time y) (ht y))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.cycleDist_comm
statement: private theorem cycleDist_comm (i j : Fin 4) : cycleDist i j = cycleDist j i
proof:

  · subst j; rfl
  · simp only [cycleDist, if_neg h, if_neg (Ne.symm h)]
    by_cases ha : adjacent i j
    · simp [ha, (adjacent_symm i j).mp ha]
    · have hb : ¬ adjacent j i := fun hb => ha ((adjacent_symm i j).mpr hb)

proof:

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.rips_one_eq_cycleK

private theorem rips_one_eq_cycleK :
    (Rips.filter inferInstance).sublevel 1 = cycleK
proof:
:= by
  ext σ
  change σ ∈ (Rips.filter inferInstance).sublevel 1 ↔ σ ∈ cycleK
  rw [Rips.mem_sublevel_iff]
  change (σ.Nonempty ∧ ∀ i ∈ σ, ∀ j ∈ σ, dist i j ≤ 1) ↔
    (σ.Nonempty ∧ ∀ i ∈ σ, ∀ j ∈ σ, i = j ∨ adjacent i j)
  simp only [dist_le_one_iff]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.cycleHomologyCycle_not_boundary
statement:
private theorem cycleHomologyCycle_not_boundary :
    cycleHomologyCycle ∉ simplicialBoundaries cycleK ℚ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hb
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff ℚ cycleK 1 _).mp hb
  have hc0 : c = 0 := by
    ext σ
    exact isEmptyElim σ
  rw [hc0, map_zero] at hc
  exact cycleChain_ne_zero hc.symm

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.cycleHomologyClass_ne_zero

private theorem cycleHomologyClass_ne_zero :

proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hq := congrArg
    (homologyKernelQuotient ℚ (simplicialChainComplex cycleK ℚ) 1).hom.hom hz
  rw [simplicialHomologyClass_quotient, map_zero] at hq
  exact cycleHomologyCycle_not_boundary ((Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).mp hq)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.nearestDistance_ge_one
statement:
private theorem nearestDistance_ge_one {s : Finset (Fin 4)} (hs : s.Nonempty)
    {x : Fin 4} (hx : x ∉ s) : 1 ≤ nearestDistance s x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := exists_nearest hs x
  rw [← heq]
  exact dist_ge_one_of_ne (fun h => hx (h ▸ hy))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.insertionRadius_ge_one
statement:
private theorem insertionRadius_ge_one {x : Fin 4} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    1 ≤ radius (0 : Fin 4) (insertionIndex 0 x - 1)
proof:
:= by
  letI : DecidableEq (Fin 4) := Classical.decEq _
  have hi : 0 < insertionIndex (0 : Fin 4) x := by
    have := (insertionIndex_eq_zero_iff (0 : Fin 4) x).not.mpr hx
    omega
  have hnot := not_mem_before_insertionIndex (0 : Fin 4) x
    (show insertionIndex (0 : Fin 4) x - 1 < insertionIndex 0 x by omega)
  have hmem := mem_insertionIndex (0 : Fin 4) x
  have heq : insertionIndex (0 : Fin 4) x = (insertionIndex 0 x - 1) + 1 := by omega
  rw [heq, prefix_succ, Finset.mem_insert] at hmem
  have hxnext : x = next (0 : Fin 4) (greedyPrefix 0 (insertionIndex 0 x - 1)) :=
    hmem.resolve_right hnot
  unfold radius
  rw [← hxnext]
  exact nearestDistance_ge_one (prefix_nonempty 0 _) hnot

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.deletionTime_ge_nine
statement:
private theorem deletionTime_ge_nine (x : Fin 4) :
    ∀ t ∈ deletionTime (0 : Fin 4) (1 / 3) x, 9 ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht
  by_cases hx : x = 0
  · simp [hx] at ht
  · rw [deletionTime_of_ne 0 (1 / 3) hx] at ht
    have heq : t = radius (0 : Fin 4) (insertionIndex 0 x - 1) /
      ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * (1 - 2 * (1 / 3 : ℝ))) := by
      simpa [eq_comm] using ht
    rw [heq]
    have hr := insertionRadius_ge_one hx
    norm_num at hr ⊢
    linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.weight_one_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem weight_one_eq_zero (x : Fin 4) :
    weight (1 / 3) (deletionTime (0 : Fin 4) (1 / 3) x) 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases htx : deletionTime (0 : Fin 4) (1 / 3) x with
  | none => simp [weight]
  | some t =>
      have ht : 9 ≤ t := deletionTime_ge_nine x t (by
        simpa only [Option.mem_def, one_div] using htx)
      simpa only [weight_some] using (finiteWeight_of_le (by nlinarith :
        (1 : ℝ) ≤ (1 - 2 * (1 / 3 : ℝ)) * t))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.closedActive_one
statement:
private theorem closedActive_one (x : Fin 4) :
    ClosedActive (deletionTime (0 : Fin 4) (1 / 3) x) 1
proof:
:= by
  cases htx : deletionTime (0 : Fin 4) (1 / 3) x with
  | none => trivial
  | some t =>
      have ht : 9 ≤ t := deletionTime_ge_nine x t (by
        simpa only [Option.mem_def, one_div] using htx)
      simpa [ClosedActive] using (show (1 : ℝ) ≤ t by linarith)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.sparse_eq_rips_one
statement:
theorem sparse_eq_rips_one :
    sparseComplex (0 : Fin 4) (1 / 3) 1 =
      (Rips.filter inferInstance).sublevel 1
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro σ hσ
    have hr := sparseComplex_le_relaxedComplex (0 : Fin 4)
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3) (by norm_num : (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3) 1 hσ
    apply (Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).mpr
    refine ⟨hr.1, ?_⟩
    intro x hx y hy
    have hxy := hr.2.2 x hx y hy
    simp only [relaxedDistance, weight_one_eq_zero, add_zero] at hxy
    exact hxy
  · intro σ hσ
    apply closedActiveComplex_le_sparseComplex (0 : Fin 4) (1 / 3) (by norm_num)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨hne, hdist⟩ := (Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).mp hσ
      refine ⟨hne, by norm_num, ?_⟩
      intro x hx y hy
      simpa only [relaxedDistance, ← one_div, weight_one_eq_zero, add_zero]
        using hdist x hx y hy
    · intro x hx
      exact closedActive_one x

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.sparseFilter_h1_nonzero
statement:
theorem sparseFilter_h1_nonzero :
    ∃ z : simplicialHomology ((sparseFilter (0 : Fin 4) (1 / 3)).sublevel 1) ℚ 1,
      z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sparseFilter_sublevel_eq (0 : Fin 4) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) 1,
    sparse_eq_rips_one, rips_one_eq_cycleK]
  exact ⟨simplicialHomologyClass ℚ cycleK 1 cycleHomologyCycle,
    cycleHomologyClass_ne_zero⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.sparse_relaxed_h1_nonzero
statement:
theorem sparse_relaxed_h1_nonzero :
    ∃ z : simplicialHomology (sparseComplex (0 : Fin 4) (1 / 3) 1) ℚ 1,
      (simplicialHomologyIncl ℚ
        (sparseComplex_le_relaxedComplex (0 : Fin 4)
          (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3)
          (by norm_num : (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3) 1) 1).hom z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsparse :
      ∃ z : simplicialHomology (sparseComplex (0 : Fin 4) (1 / 3) 1) ℚ 1,
        z ≠ 0 := by
    rw [sparse_eq_rips_one, rips_one_eq_cycleK]
    exact ⟨simplicialHomologyClass ℚ cycleK 1 cycleHomologyCycle,
      cycleHomologyClass_ne_zero⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hsparse
  let f := simplicialHomologyIncl ℚ
      (sparseComplex_le_relaxedComplex (0 : Fin 4)
        (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3)
        (by norm_num : (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3) 1) 1
  have hIso : IsIso f :=
    isIso_sparse_relaxed_all ℚ (0 : Fin 4)
      (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3 by norm_num)
      (show (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3 by norm_num) 1 1
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  intro hzero
  haveI : IsIso f := hIso
  have hinj : Function.Injective f.hom := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective f).mp inferInstance
  exact hz (hinj (by simpa [f] using hzero))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.leafPenalty_nonneg
statement: private theorem leafPenalty_nonneg (x : PendantCycle) : 0 ≤ leafPenalty x
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> norm_num [leafPenalty]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.leafDist_nonneg
statement: private theorem leafDist_nonneg (x y : PendantCycle) : 0 ≤ leafDist x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold leafDist
  split_ifs
  · norm_num
  · have hx := leafPenalty_nonneg x
    have hy := leafPenalty_nonneg y
    linarith [dist_nonneg (x := anchor x) (y := anchor y)]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.leafDist_pos_of_ne
statement:
private theorem leafDist_pos_of_ne {x y : PendantCycle} (hxy : x ≠ y) :
    0 < leafDist x y
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | none =>
      cases y with
      | none => exact False.elim (hxy rfl)
      | some j =>
          have hd := dist_nonneg (x := (0 : Fin 4)) (y := j)
          simp only [leafDist, reduceCtorEq, if_false, anchor, leafPenalty]
          linarith
  | some i =>
      cases y with
      | none =>
          have hd := dist_nonneg (x := i) (y := (0 : Fin 4))
          simp only [leafDist, reduceCtorEq, if_false, anchor, leafPenalty]
          linarith
      | some j =>
          have hij : i ≠ j := fun h => hxy (congrArg some h)
          have hd : 0 < dist i j := dist_pos.mpr hij
          simpa [leafDist, anchor, leafPenalty, hij] using hd

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.pendantRadius_eq_nearest
proof:
:= by
  letI : DecidableEq PendantCycle := Classical.decEq _
  have hi : 0 < insertionIndex (some (0 : Fin 4)) x := by
    have := (insertionIndex_eq_zero_iff (some (0 : Fin 4)) x).not.mpr hx
    omega
  have hnot := not_mem_before_insertionIndex (some (0 : Fin 4)) x
    (show insertionIndex (some (0 : Fin 4)) x - 1 < insertionIndex (some (0 : Fin 4)) x by omega)
  have hmem := mem_insertionIndex (some (0 : Fin 4)) x
  have heq : insertionIndex (some (0 : Fin 4)) x =
      (insertionIndex (some (0 : Fin 4)) x - 1) + 1 := by omega
  rw [heq, prefix_succ, Finset.mem_insert] at hmem
  have hxnext : x = next (some (0 : Fin 4))
      (greedyPrefix (some (0 : Fin 4)) (insertionIndex (some (0 : Fin 4)) x - 1)) :=
    hmem.resolve_right hnot
  unfold radius
  exact congrArg (nearestDistance
    (greedyPrefix (some (0 : Fin 4)) (insertionIndex (some (0 : Fin 4)) x - 1)))
    hxnext.symm

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.coreDist_ge_one
statement:
private theorem coreDist_ge_one {i : Fin 4} (hi : i ≠ 0)
    {y : PendantCycle} (hy : y ≠ some i) : 1 ≤ dist (some i) y
proof:
:= by
  cases y with
  | none =>
      have hd := dist_ge_one_of_ne hi
      change 1 ≤ dist i (0 : Fin 4) + 0 + 1 / 20
      linarith
  | some j =>
      have hij : i ≠ j := fun h => hy (congrArg some h.symm)
      change 1 ≤ leafDist (some i) (some j)
      simpa [leafDist, anchor, leafPenalty, hij] using
        (dist_ge_one_of_ne hij)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.coreRadius_ge_one
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (some i : PendantCycle) ≠ some (0 : Fin 4) := by simp [hi]
  rw [pendantRadius_eq_nearest hx]
  let s := greedyPrefix (some (0 : Fin 4))
    (insertionIndex (some (0 : Fin 4)) (some i) - 1)
  have hs : s.Nonempty := prefix_nonempty (some (0 : Fin 4)) _
  have hnot : (some i : PendantCycle) ∉ s :=
    not_mem_before_insertionIndex (some (0 : Fin 4)) (some i)
      (by have := (insertionIndex_eq_zero_iff (some (0 : Fin 4)) (some i)).not.mpr hx
          omega)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, heq⟩ := exists_nearest hs (some i)
  rw [← heq]
  exact coreDist_ge_one hi (fun h => hnot (h ▸ hy))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.pendantRadius_le
proof:
:= by
  rw [pendantRadius_eq_nearest (by simp)]
  have hseed : (some (0 : Fin 4)) ∈
      greedyPrefix (some (0 : Fin 4)) (insertionIndex (some (0 : Fin 4)) (none : PendantCycle) - 1) :=
    seed_mem_prefix (some (0 : Fin 4)) _
  have hle := nearestDistance_le (x := (none : PendantCycle)) hseed
  have hd : dist (none : PendantCycle) (some (0 : Fin 4)) = (1 / 20 : ℝ) := by
    change leafDist none (some (0 : Fin 4)) = _
    simp [leafDist, anchor, leafPenalty]
  simpa [hd] using hle

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.pendant_deleted_before_one
statement:
theorem pendant_deleted_before_one :
    ∃ t, deletionTime (some (0 : Fin 4)) (1 / 3) (none : PendantCycle) = some t ∧
      t < 1
proof:
:= by
  let t := radius (some (0 : Fin 4))
      (insertionIndex (some (0 : Fin 4)) (none : PendantCycle) - 1) /
        ((1 / 3 : ℝ) * (1 - 2 * (1 / 3 : ℝ)))
  refine ⟨t, deletionTime_of_ne (some (0 : Fin 4)) (1 / 3) (by simp), ?_⟩
  have hr := pendantRadius_le
  dsimp [t]
  norm_num at hr ⊢
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.pendant_inactive_one
statement:
theorem pendant_inactive_one :
    ¬ ClosedActive
      (deletionTime (some (0 : Fin 4)) (1 / 3) (none : Option (Fin 4))) 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hlt⟩ := pendant_deleted_before_one
  rw [ht]
  exact not_le_of_gt hlt

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.core_closedActive_one
statement:
private theorem core_closedActive_one (i : Fin 4) :
    ClosedActive (deletionTime (some (0 : Fin 4)) (1 / 3) (some i)) 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i; simp [ClosedActive]
  · rw [deletionTime_of_ne (some (0 : Fin 4)) (1 / 3) (by simp [hi])]
    have hr := coreRadius_ge_one hi
    norm_num [ClosedActive] at hr ⊢
    linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.core_weight_one_eq_zero
statement:
private theorem core_weight_one_eq_zero (i : Fin 4) :
    weight (1 / 3) (deletionTime (some (0 : Fin 4)) (1 / 3) (some i)) 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i; simp [weight]
  · rw [deletionTime_of_ne (some (0 : Fin 4)) (1 / 3) (by simp [hi]), weight_some]
    have hr := coreRadius_ge_one hi
    apply finiteWeight_of_le
    norm_num at hr ⊢
    linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.core_distance_eq
statement:
private theorem core_distance_eq (i j : Fin 4) :
    dist (some i : PendantCycle) (some j) = dist i j
proof:
:= by
  change leafDist (some i) (some j) = dist i j
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j; simp [leafDist, anchor, leafPenalty]
  · simp [leafDist, anchor, leafPenalty, hij]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.anchor_distance_le
statement:
private theorem anchor_distance_le (x y : PendantCycle) :
    dist (anchor x) (anchor y) ≤ dist x y
proof:
:= by
  change dist (anchor x) (anchor y) ≤ leafDist x y
  unfold leafDist
  split_ifs with h
  · subst y; simp
  · have hx := leafPenalty_nonneg x
    have hy := leafPenalty_nonneg y
    linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.coreSection_collapse
statement:
private theorem coreSection_collapse :
    VertexMap.comp coreSection pendantCollapse = VertexMap.id coreSparse
proof:
:= by
  apply VertexMap.ext
  intro i
  rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.H1Examples.deleted_pendant_h1_nonzero
statement:
theorem deleted_pendant_h1_nonzero :
    (∃ t : ℝ, deletionTime (some (0 : Fin 4)) (1 / 3) (none : Option (Fin 4)) = some t ∧
      t < 1) ∧
    ∃ z : simplicialHomology
        (sparseComplex (some (0 : Fin 4)) (1 / 3) 1) ℚ 1,
      z ≠ 0 ∧
      (simplicialHomologyIncl ℚ
        (sparseComplex_le_relaxedComplex (some (0 : Fin 4))
          (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3)
          (by norm_num : (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3) 1) 1).hom z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact pendant_deleted_before_one
  have hcore : ∃ z : simplicialHomology coreSparse ℚ 1, z ≠ 0 := by
    change ∃ z : simplicialHomology (sparseComplex (0 : Fin 4) (1 / 3) 1) ℚ 1,
      z ≠ 0
    rw [sparse_eq_rips_one, rips_one_eq_cycleK]
    exact ⟨simplicialHomologyClass ℚ cycleK 1 cycleHomologyCycle,
      cycleHomologyClass_ne_zero⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hcore
  let f := simplicialHomologyMap ℚ coreSection 1
  let g := simplicialHomologyMap ℚ pendantCollapse 1
  have hfg : f ≫ g = 𝟙 (simplicialHomology coreSparse ℚ 1) := by
    dsimp only [f, g]
    rw [← simplicialHomologyMap_comp, coreSection_collapse]
    exact simplicialHomologyMap_id ℚ coreSparse 1
  have hcomp : g.hom (f.hom z) = z := by
    have h := congrArg
      (fun q : simplicialHomology coreSparse ℚ 1 ⟶
          simplicialHomology coreSparse ℚ 1 => q.hom z) hfg
    simpa only [ModuleCat.hom_comp, LinearMap.comp_apply, ModuleCat.hom_id,
      LinearMap.id_apply] using h
  have hnonzero : f.hom z ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    rw [hzero, map_zero] at hcomp
    exact hz hcomp.symm
  let h := simplicialHomologyIncl ℚ
    (sparseComplex_le_relaxedComplex (some (0 : Fin 4))
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3)
      (by norm_num : (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3) 1) 1
  have hIso : IsIso h :=
    isIso_sparse_relaxed_all ℚ (some (0 : Fin 4))
      (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 3 by norm_num)
      (show (1 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 3 by norm_num) 1 1
  refine ⟨f.hom z, hnonzero, ?_⟩
  intro hzero
  haveI : IsIso h := hIso
  have hinj : Function.Injective h.hom := (ModuleCat.mono_iff_injective h).mp inferInstance
  exact hnonzero (hinj (by simpa [h] using hzero))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.relaxedDistance_comm
statement:
theorem relaxedDistance_comm (η : ℝ) (time : V → Option ℝ) (r : ℝ) (x y : V) :
    relaxedDistance η time r x y = relaxedDistance η time r y x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relaxedDistance, dist_comm]
  ring

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.relaxedDistance_left_le
proof:
:= by
  have htri : dist q y ≤ dist x q + dist x y := by
    simpa only [dist_comm q x] using dist_triangle q x y
  dsimp [relaxedDistance]
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.image_union_mem_relaxedComplex
statement:
theorem image_union_mem_relaxedComplex {η r : ℝ} (time : V → Option ℝ) (f : V → V)
    (hf : ∀ x, dist x (f x) ≤ weight η (time x) r - weight η (time (f x)) r)
    {σ : Finset V} (hσ : σ ∈ relaxedComplex η time r) :
    σ.image f ∪ σ ∈ relaxedComplex η time r
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hσ.1.mono Finset.subset_union_right, hσ.2.1, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_image] at hx hy
  rcases hx with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ | hx <;> rcases hy with ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ | hy
  · exact (relaxedDistance_left_le (y := f b) (hf a)).trans
      (by rw [relaxedDistance_comm η time r a (f b)]
          exact (relaxedDistance_left_le (y := a) (hf b)).trans (hσ.2.2 b hb a ha))
  · exact (relaxedDistance_left_le (hf a)).trans (hσ.2.2 a ha y hy)
  · rw [relaxedDistance_comm]
    exact (relaxedDistance_left_le (hf b)).trans (hσ.2.2 b hb x hx)
  · exact hσ.2.2 x hx y hy

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.closedActiveComplex_le_relaxedComplex
statement:
theorem closedActiveComplex_le_relaxedComplex (seed : V) (η r : ℝ) :
    closedActiveComplex seed η r ≤ relaxedComplex η (deletionTime seed η) r
proof:
:=
  fun _ h => h.1

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletion_inclusion_contiguous
statement:
theorem deletion_inclusion_contiguous (seed : V) {η r : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    Contiguous (VertexMap.comp (deletionVertexMap seed hη hη' hr)
      (inclusionVertexMap (closedActiveComplex_le_relaxedComplex seed η r)))
      (VertexMap.id (relaxedComplex η (deletionTime seed η) r))
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  change σ.image (deletionMap seed η r hη.le hr) ∪ σ.image id ∈
    relaxedComplex η (deletionTime seed η) r
  simpa only [Finset.image_id] using image_union_mem_relaxedComplex (deletionTime seed η)
      (deletionMap seed η r hη.le hr) (deletionMap_domination seed hη hη' hr) hσ

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.inclusion_deletion_contiguous
statement:
theorem inclusion_deletion_contiguous (seed : V) {η r : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    Contiguous (VertexMap.comp
      (inclusionVertexMap (closedActiveComplex_le_relaxedComplex seed η r))
      (deletionVertexMap seed hη hη' hr))
      (VertexMap.id (closedActiveComplex seed η r))
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  change σ.image (deletionMap seed η r hη.le hr) ∪ σ.image id ∈ closedActiveComplex seed η r
  rw [Finset.image_id]
  refine ⟨image_union_mem_relaxedComplex (deletionTime seed η)
    (deletionMap seed η r hη.le hr) (deletionMap_domination seed hη hη' hr) hσ.1, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hx with hx | hx
  · exact (deletionVertexMap seed hη hη' hr).map_face σ hσ.1 |>.2 x hx
  · exact hσ.2 x hx

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.closedActiveHomologyIso_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem closedActiveHomologyIso_hom (R : Type*) [Ring R] (seed : V) {η r : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (n : ℕ) :
    (closedActiveHomologyIso R seed hη hη' hr n).hom =
      simplicialHomologyIncl R (closedActiveComplex_le_relaxedComplex seed η r) n
proof:
:=
  simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion R _ n

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.isIso_closedActiveHomologyIncl
proof:
:= by
  have hi : IsIso (closedActiveHomologyIso R seed hη hη' hr n).hom := inferInstance
  rwa [closedActiveHomologyIso_hom] at hi

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.finiteWeight_of_le
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteWeight_of_le {η t r : ℝ} (h : r ≤ (1 - 2 * η) * t) :
    finiteWeight η t r = 0
proof: := by simp [finiteWeight, h]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.finiteWeight_of_between
proof:
:= by
  simp [finiteWeight, not_le.mpr h₁, h₂]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.finiteWeight_of_time_le
statement:
theorem finiteWeight_of_time_le {η t r : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (h : t ≤ r) :
    finiteWeight η t r = η * r
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteWeight
  split_ifs with hb
  · have hηt := mul_nonneg hη ht
    have htr : t = r := by nlinarith
    have hzero : η * r = 0 := by rw [← htr]; nlinarith
    exact hzero.symm
  · linarith
  · rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.finiteWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem finiteWeight_nonneg {η t r : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    0 ≤ finiteWeight η t r
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteWeight
  split_ifs <;> first | positivity | linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.finiteWeight_le
statement:
theorem finiteWeight_le {η t r : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) : finiteWeight η t r ≤ η * r
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteWeight
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂
  · positivity
  · have hprod := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 1 - 2 * η by linarith) (show 0 ≤ t - r by linarith)
    nlinarith
  · exact le_rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.finiteWeight_increment
statement:
theorem finiteWeight_increment {η t r s : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    0 ≤ finiteWeight η t s - finiteWeight η t r ∧
      finiteWeight η t s - finiteWeight η t r ≤ (s - r) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hp := mul_nonneg hη (show 0 ≤ s - r by linarith)
  have hq := mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ 1 / 2 - η by linarith) (show 0 ≤ s - r by linarith)
  have hηt := mul_nonneg hη ht
  unfold finiteWeight
  split_ifs <;> constructor <;> nlinarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.weight_none
statement: @[simp] theorem weight_none (η r : ℝ) : weight η none r = 0
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.weight_some
statement: @[simp] theorem weight_some (η t r : ℝ) : weight η (some t) r = finiteWeight η t r
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.weight_nonneg
statement:
theorem weight_nonneg {η r : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (time : Option ℝ) :
    0 ≤ weight η time r
proof:
:= by
  cases time with
  | none => simp
  | some t => exact finiteWeight_nonneg hη hr

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.weight_le
statement:
theorem weight_le {η r : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (time : Option ℝ) : weight η time r ≤ η * r
proof:
:= by
  cases time with
  | none => simpa using mul_nonneg hη hr
  | some t => exact finiteWeight_le hη hη' hr

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.weight_increment
statement:
theorem weight_increment {η r s : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (time : Option ℝ) (ht : ∀ t ∈ time, 0 ≤ t) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrs : r ≤ s) :
    0 ≤ weight η time s - weight η time r ∧
      weight η time s - weight η time r ≤ (s - r) / 2
proof:
:= by
  cases time with
  | none => simp only [weight_none, sub_self, le_refl, true_and]; linarith
  | some t => exact finiteWeight_increment hη hη' (ht t (by simp)) hr hrs

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.faceEntry_nonneg
statement:
theorem faceEntry_nonneg (η : ℝ) (time : V → Option ℝ) (σ : Finset V) :
    0 ≤ faceEntry η time σ
proof:
:= by
  exact (Finset.le_fold_max 0).mpr (Or.inl le_rfl)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pairEntry_le_faceEntry
statement:
theorem pairEntry_le_faceEntry (η : ℝ) (time : V → Option ℝ)
    {σ : Finset V} {x y : V} (hx : x ∈ σ) (hy : y ∈ σ) :
    pairEntry (η := η) time x y ≤ faceEntry η time σ
proof:
:= by
  exact (Finset.le_fold_max _).mpr
    (Or.inr ⟨(x, y), Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hx, hy⟩, le_rfl⟩)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.faceEntry_le_iff
statement:
theorem faceEntry_le_iff {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3)
    (time : V → Option ℝ) (ht : ∀ x t, t ∈ time x → 0 ≤ t)
    (σ : Finset V) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    faceEntry η time σ ≤ r ↔
      ∀ x ∈ σ, ∀ y ∈ σ, relaxedDistance η time r x y ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold faceEntry
  rw [Finset.fold_max_le]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx y hy
    exact (pairEntry_le_iff hη hη' time ht x y hr).mp
      (h.2 (x, y) (Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨hx, hy⟩))
  · intro h
    refine ⟨hr, ?_⟩
    intro p hp
    exact (pairEntry_le_iff hη hη' time ht p.1 p.2 hr).mpr
      (h p.1 (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).1 p.2 (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).2)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.faceEntry_mono
statement:
theorem faceEntry_mono (η : ℝ) (time : V → Option ℝ)
    {σ τ : Finset V} (hστ : σ ⊆ τ) :
    faceEntry η time σ ≤ faceEntry η time τ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  change (σ ×ˢ σ).fold max 0 (fun p => pairEntry (η := η) time p.1 p.2) ≤
    faceEntry η time τ
  apply (Finset.fold_max_le _).mpr
  refine ⟨faceEntry_nonneg η time τ, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  exact pairEntry_le_faceEntry η time
    (hστ (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).1) (hστ (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).2)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_relaxedComplex_iff_faceEntry
statement:
theorem mem_relaxedComplex_iff_faceEntry {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η)
    (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (time : V → Option ℝ)
    (ht : ∀ x t, t ∈ time x → 0 ≤ t) (σ : Finset V) (r : ℝ) :
    σ ∈ relaxedComplex η time r ↔
      σ.Nonempty ∧ 0 ≤ r ∧ faceEntry η time σ ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_relaxedComplex]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hne, hr, hp⟩
    exact ⟨hne, hr, (faceEntry_le_iff hη hη' time ht σ hr).mpr hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨hne, hr, hp⟩
    exact ⟨hne, hr, (faceEntry_le_iff hη hη' time ht σ hr).mp hp⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_sparseCarrier_iff_faceEntry
statement:
theorem mem_sparseCarrier_iff_faceEntry (seed : V) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (σ : Finset V) :
    σ ∈ sparseCarrier seed η ↔
      σ.Nonempty ∧ ∀ x ∈ σ,
        ClosedActive (deletionTime seed η x)
          (faceEntry η (deletionTime seed η) σ)
proof:
:= by
  let time := deletionTime seed η
  have ht := deletionTime_nonneg seed hη hη'
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hσ⟩
    have hentry : faceEntry η time σ ≤ a :=
      ((mem_relaxedComplex_iff_faceEntry hη.le hη' time ht σ a).mp hσ.1).2.2
    refine ⟨hσ.1.1, ?_⟩
    intro x hx
    have hactive := hσ.2 x hx
    cases htx : time x with
    | none =>
        change ClosedActive (time x) (faceEntry η time σ)
        simp only [ClosedActive, htx, Option.elim_none]
    | some t =>
        change ClosedActive (time x) a at hactive
        change ClosedActive (time x) (faceEntry η time σ)
        simp only [ClosedActive, htx, Option.elim_some] at hactive ⊢
        exact hentry.trans hactive
  · rintro ⟨hne, hactive⟩
    let a := faceEntry η time σ
    have ha : 0 ≤ a := faceEntry_nonneg η time σ
    refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
    constructor
    · exact (mem_relaxedComplex_iff_faceEntry hη.le hη' time ht σ a).mpr
        ⟨hne, ha, le_rfl⟩
    · exact hactive

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_sparseComplex_iff_faceEntry
statement:
theorem mem_sparseComplex_iff_faceEntry (seed : V) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (σ : Finset V) (r : ℝ) :
    σ ∈ sparseComplex seed η r ↔
      σ ∈ sparseCarrier seed η ∧ faceEntry η (deletionTime seed η) σ ≤ r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, har, hσ⟩
    refine ⟨⟨a, ha, hσ⟩, ?_⟩
    have hentry := ((mem_relaxedComplex_iff_faceEntry hη.le hη'
      (deletionTime seed η) (deletionTime_nonneg seed hη hη') σ a).mp hσ.1).2.2
    exact hentry.trans har
  · rintro ⟨hcarrier, hentry⟩
    let a := faceEntry η (deletionTime seed η) σ
    have ha : 0 ≤ a := faceEntry_nonneg η (deletionTime seed η) σ
    refine ⟨a, ha, hentry, ?_⟩
    have hc := (mem_sparseCarrier_iff_faceEntry seed hη hη' σ).mp hcarrier
    exact ⟨(mem_relaxedComplex_iff_faceEntry hη.le hη'
      (deletionTime seed η) (deletionTime_nonneg seed hη hη') σ a).mpr
        ⟨hc.1, ha, le_rfl⟩, hc.2⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseFilter_sublevel_eq
proof:
:= by
  ext σ
  change (∃ hs : σ ∈ sparseCarrier seed η,
    faceEntry η (deletionTime seed η) σ ≤ r) ↔
      σ ∈ sparseComplex seed η r
  rw [mem_sparseComplex_iff_faceEntry seed hη hη' σ r]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ <;> exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseFilter_sublevelFiltration_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply OrderHom.ext
  funext r
  exact sparseFilter_sublevel_eq seed hη hη' r

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseFilter_positiveOnEdges
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  obtain ⟨x, hx, y, hy, hxy⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.1 hσ
  have hdist : 0 < dist x y := dist_pos.mpr hxy
  have hpair := dist_le_pairEntry hη.le hη' (deletionTime seed η)
    (deletionTime_nonneg seed hη hη') x y
  have hface := pairEntry_le_faceEntry η (deletionTime seed η) hx hy
  change 0 < faceEntry η (deletionTime seed η) σ.val
  exact hdist.trans_le (hpair.trans hface)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.isIso_homologyIncl_of_eq
statement:
private theorem isIso_homologyIncl_of_eq (R : Type*) [Ring R]
    {K L M : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} (hLM : L = M)
    (hKL : K ≤ L) (hKM : K ≤ M) (n : ℕ)
    (hIso : IsIso (simplicialHomologyIncl R hKL n)) :
    IsIso (simplicialHomologyIncl R hKM n)
proof:
:= by
  cases hLM
  exact hIso

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.terminal_le_activeUnion
statement:
theorem terminal_le_activeUnion (seed : V) (η : ℝ) {F : Finset ℝ} {r : ℝ}
    (hr : r ∈ F) : closedActiveComplex seed η r ≤ activeUnion seed η F
proof:
:=
  closedActiveComplex_le_activeUnion seed η hr

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.isIso_terminal_activeUnion
statement:
theorem isIso_terminal_activeUnion (R : Type*) [Ring R] (seed : V) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (r : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (F : Finset ℝ) (hrF : r ∈ F)
    (hbound : ∀ a ∈ F, 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ r)
    (hcomplete : DeletionComplete seed η F r) :
    IsIso (simplicialHomologyIncl R (terminal_le_activeUnion seed η hrF) n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have main : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ F : Finset ℝ, F.card = k →
      (hrF : r ∈ F) →
      (∀ a ∈ F, 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ r) →
      DeletionComplete seed η F r →
      IsIso (simplicialHomologyIncl R (terminal_le_activeUnion seed η hrF) n) := by
    intro k
    induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h k ih =>
      intro F hcard hrF hbound hcomplete
      let hF : F.Nonempty := ⟨r, hrF⟩
      let d := F.min' hF
      let H := F.erase d
      by_cases hH : H.Nonempty
      · let s := H.min' hH
