        have hdF : d ∈ F := Finset.min'_mem F hF
        have hlt : H.card < k := hcard ▸ Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem hdF
        have hrd : r ≠ d := by
          intro heq
          have hsH : s ∈ H := Finset.min'_mem H hH
          have hds : d < s := Finset.min'_lt_of_mem_erase_min' F hF hsH
          have hsr : s ≤ r := (hbound s (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hsH)).2
          exact (not_lt_of_ge (heq ▸ hsr)) hds
        have hrH : r ∈ H := Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hrd, hrF⟩
        have hHbound : ∀ a ∈ H, 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ r := by
          intro a ha
          exact hbound a (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase ha)
        have hHcomplete : DeletionComplete seed η H r :=
          deletionComplete_erase_min seed η hF hcomplete
        have hfirst : IsIso
            (simplicialHomologyIncl R (terminal_le_activeUnion seed η hrH) n) :=
          ih H.card hlt H rfl hrH hHbound hHcomplete
        let data := tailDeletionData_of_complete seed hF hbound hcomplete hH
        have hsecond : IsIso
            (simplicialHomologyIncl R (activeUnion_mono seed η data.tail_subset) n) := by
          have : IsIso (tailDeletionHomologyIso R seed hη hη' data n).hom := inferInstance
          simpa only [tailDeletionHomologyIso_hom] using this
        have hcomp : IsIso
            (simplicialHomologyIncl R
              ((terminal_le_activeUnion seed η hrH).trans
                (activeUnion_mono seed η data.tail_subset)) n) := by
          rw [simplicialHomologyIncl_comp R
            (terminal_le_activeUnion seed η hrH)
            (activeUnion_mono seed η data.tail_subset) n]
          letI := hfirst
          letI := hsecond
          exact IsIso.comp_isIso
        exact hcomp
      · have hsingle : F = {r} := by
          have he : H = ∅ := Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hH
          rcases (Finset.erase_eq_empty_iff F d).mp he with hempty | hsingleton
          · simp [hempty] at hrF
          · have hrd : r = d := by simpa [hsingleton] using hrF
            simpa [hrd] using hsingleton
        have hback : activeUnion seed η F ≤ closedActiveComplex seed η r := by
          intro σ hσ
          obtain ⟨a, ha, hσa⟩ := hσ
          have har : a = r := by simpa [hsingle] using ha
          subst a
          exact hσa
        let e : simplicialHomology (closedActiveComplex seed η r) R n ≅
            simplicialHomology (activeUnion seed η F) R n := {
          hom := simplicialHomologyIncl R (terminal_le_activeUnion seed η hrF) n
          inv := simplicialHomologyIncl R hback n
          hom_inv_id := by
            rw [← simplicialHomologyIncl_comp, simplicialHomologyIncl_id]
          inv_hom_id := by
            rw [← simplicialHomologyIncl_comp, simplicialHomologyIncl_id]
        }
        exact Iso.isIso_hom e
  exact main F.card F rfl hrF hbound hcomplete

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.isIso_closedActive_sparse
proof:
:= by
  have hgrid : IsIso (simplicialHomologyIncl R
      (terminal_le_activeUnion seed η (show r ∈ deletionGrid seed η r from by simp)) n) :=
    isIso_terminal_activeUnion R seed hη hη' r n (deletionGrid seed η r)
      (by simp) (fun a ha => deletionGrid_nonneg_le seed hη hη' hr ha)
      (deletionGrid_complete seed η r)
  exact isIso_homologyIncl_of_eq R
    (sparseComplex_eq_activeUnion_deletionGrid seed hη hη' r).symm
    (terminal_le_activeUnion seed η (by simp))
    (closedActiveComplex_le_sparseComplex seed η hr) n hgrid

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.isIso_sparse_relaxed
proof:
:= by
  let hfirst := closedActiveComplex_le_sparseComplex seed η hr
  let hsecond := sparseComplex_le_relaxedComplex seed hη hη' r
  let f := simplicialHomologyIncl R hfirst n
  let g := simplicialHomologyIncl R hsecond n
  letI : IsIso f := isIso_closedActive_sparse R seed hη hη' hr n
  have htotal : IsIso (simplicialHomologyIncl R (hfirst.trans hsecond) n) :=
    isIso_closedActiveHomologyIncl R seed hη hη' hr n
  letI : IsIso (f ≫ g) := by
    change IsIso (simplicialHomologyIncl R hfirst n ≫ simplicialHomologyIncl R hsecond n)
    rw [← simplicialHomologyIncl_comp R hfirst hsecond n]
    exact htotal
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left f g

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_deletionTimes
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_deletionTimes (seed : V) (η t : ℝ) :
    t ∈ deletionTimes seed η ↔ ∃ x, deletionTime seed η x = some t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [deletionTimes, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    cases ht : deletionTime seed η x with
    | none => simp [ht] at hx
    | some u =>
      have htu : t = u := by simpa [ht] using hx
      subst t
      exact ⟨x, ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    exact ⟨x, by simp [hx]⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_deletionGrid
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_deletionGrid (seed : V) (η r a : ℝ) :
    a ∈ deletionGrid seed η r ↔ a = r ∨ (a ≤ r ∧ ∃ x, deletionTime seed η x = some a)
proof:
:= by
  simp [deletionGrid, and_comm]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_activeUnion
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_activeUnion (seed : V) (η : ℝ) (G : Finset ℝ) (σ : Finset V) :
    σ ∈ activeUnion seed η G ↔ ∃ a ∈ G, σ ∈ closedActiveComplex seed η a
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseComplex_eq_activeUnion_deletionGrid
proof:
:= by
  ext σ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, har, hσ⟩
    let F := (deletionGrid seed η r).filter (a ≤ ·)
    have hrF : r ∈ F := Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨by simp, har⟩
    let b := F.min' ⟨r, hrF⟩
    have hbF : b ∈ F := Finset.min'_mem F ⟨r, hrF⟩
    have hab : a ≤ b := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hbF).2
    have hbr : b ≤ r := Finset.min'_le F r hrF
    have hbGrid : b ∈ deletionGrid seed η r := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hbF).1
    refine ⟨b, hbGrid, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact relaxedComplex_mono hη.le (by linarith) (deletionTime seed η)
        (deletionTime_nonneg seed hη hη') hab hσ.1
    · intro x hx
      cases ht : deletionTime seed η x with
      | none => trivial
      | some t =>
        have hat : a ≤ t := by simpa [ClosedActive, ht] using hσ.2 x hx
        have hbt : b ≤ t := by
          by_cases htr : t ≤ r
          · apply Finset.min'_le F t
            exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
              ⟨(mem_deletionGrid seed η r t).mpr (Or.inr ⟨htr, x, ht⟩), hat⟩
          · exact hbr.trans (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge htr))
        simpa [ClosedActive, ht] using hbt
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hσ⟩
    have har : a ≤ r := (mem_deletionGrid seed η r a).mp ha |>.elim
      (fun h => h ▸ le_rfl) (fun h => h.1)
    exact ⟨a, hσ.1.2.1, har, hσ⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.weight_breakpoints
statement:
theorem weight_breakpoints : finiteWeight (1 / 3) 9 3 = 0 ∧
    finiteWeight (1 / 3) 9 6 = 3 / 2 ∧ finiteWeight (1 / 3) 9 9 = 3
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [finiteWeight]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.deletion_tie
statement: theorem deletion_tie : ClosedActive (some 9) 9 ∧ ¬ OpenActive (some 9) 9
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [ClosedActive, OpenActive]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.TwoPoints.pts_injective
statement: private theorem pts_injective : Function.Injective pts
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  apply Fin.ext
  change (i.val : ℝ) = (j.val : ℝ) at hij
  exact_mod_cast hij

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.TwoPoints.metric_dist
statement: private theorem metric_dist (i j : Fin 2) : dist i j = dist (pts i) (pts j)
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.TwoPoints.next_zero
statement: private theorem next_zero : next (0 : Fin 2) ({0}) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hnot := next_not_mem (0 : Fin 2) (n := 0) (by decide)
  have hne : next (0 : Fin 2) ({0}) ≠ 0 := by simpa using hnot
  apply Fin.ext
  have hi := (next (0 : Fin 2) ({0})).isLt
  have hn : (next (0 : Fin 2) ({0})).val ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (Fin.ext h)
  omega

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.TwoPoints.radius_zero
statement: private theorem radius_zero : radius (0 : Fin 2) 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  norm_num [radius, next_zero, greedyPrefix, nearestDistance, metric_dist, pts, Real.dist_eq]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.TwoPoints.insertionIndex_one
statement: private theorem insertionIndex_one : insertionIndex (0 : Fin 2) 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < insertionIndex (0 : Fin 2) 1 := by
    have hne := (insertionIndex_eq_zero_iff (0 : Fin 2) 1).not.mpr (by decide)
    omega
  have hmem : (1 : Fin 2) ∈ greedyPrefix 0 1 := by simp [greedyPrefix, next_zero]
  have hle : insertionIndex (0 : Fin 2) 1 ≤ 1 := by
    by_contra! hgt
    exact not_mem_before_insertionIndex 0 1 hgt hmem
  omega

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.TwoPoints.deletionTime_one
statement: theorem deletionTime_one : deletionTime (0 : Fin 2) (1 / 3) 1 = some 9
proof:
:= by
  rw [deletionTime_of_ne 0 (1 / 3) (by decide)]
  norm_num [insertionIndex_one, radius_zero]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.TwoPoints.weighted_self_pair
statement:
theorem weighted_self_pair :
    relaxedDistance (1 / 3) (deletionTime (0 : Fin 2) (1 / 3)) 9 1 1 = 6
proof:
:= by
  rw [relaxedDistance_self, deletionTime_one]
  norm_num [weight, finiteWeight]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.TwoPoints.edge_pairEntry_eq_one
statement:
theorem edge_pairEntry_eq_one :
    pairEntry (η := 1 / 3) (deletionTime (0 : Fin 2) (1 / 3)) 0 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hle : pairEntry (η := 1 / 3) (deletionTime (0 : Fin 2) (1 / 3)) 0 1 ≤ 1 :=
    (pairEntry_le_iff (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (deletionTime (0 : Fin 2) (1 / 3))
      (deletionTime_nonneg 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) 0 1 (by norm_num)).mpr (by
        norm_num [relaxedDistance, deletionTime_one, weight, finiteWeight,
          metric_dist, pts, Real.dist_eq])
  have hge := dist_le_pairEntry (η := (1 / 3 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    (deletionTime (0 : Fin 2) (1 / 3))
    (deletionTime_nonneg 0 (by norm_num) (by norm_num)) 0 1
  have hdist : dist (0 : Fin 2) 1 = 1 := by norm_num [metric_dist, pts, Real.dist_eq]
  exact le_antisymm hle (hdist ▸ hge)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.TwoPoints.singleton_at_deletion
statement:
theorem singleton_at_deletion :
    ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ closedActiveComplex 0 (1 / 3) 9
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨by simp, by norm_num, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx y hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx hy
    subst x; subst y
    rw [weighted_self_pair]
    norm_num
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
    subst x
    norm_num [deletionTime_one, ClosedActive]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.TwoPoints.singleton_after_deletion
statement:
theorem singleton_after_deletion :
    ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∉ closedActiveComplex 0 (1 / 3) 10
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hx := h.2 1 (by simp)
  norm_num [deletionTime_one, ClosedActive] at hx

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.TwoPoints.sparse_retains_deleted_singleton
statement:
theorem sparse_retains_deleted_singleton :
    ({1} : Finset (Fin 2)) ∈ sparseFiltration 0 (1 / 3) 10
proof:
:=
  ⟨9, by norm_num, by norm_num, singleton_at_deletion⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.LineSamples.point_injective
statement: private theorem point_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (point n)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  apply Fin.ext
  change (i.val : ℝ) = (j.val : ℝ) at hij
  exact_mod_cast hij

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.LineSamples.doubling_four
statement: theorem doubling_four (n : ℕ) : ClosedBallDoubling (V := Fin n) 4
proof:
:=
  ClosedBallDoubling.of_isometry_real (point n)
    (isometry_iff_dist_eq.mpr (fun _ _ => rfl))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.Examples.LineSamples.uniform_skeleton_bound
statement:
theorem uniform_skeleton_bound (n m h : ℕ) {η : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3)
    (hsmall : 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ h < η * (1 - 2 * η)) :
    (skeletonFaces (0 : Fin (n + 1)) η m).card ≤
      (n + 1) * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (4 ^ h) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  simpa using skeletonFaces_card_le (0 : Fin (n + 1)) hη hη' (doubling_four (n + 1)) h hsmall m

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.relaxedDistance_self
statement:
@[simp] theorem relaxedDistance_self (η : ℝ) (time : V → Option ℝ) (r : ℝ) (x : V) :
    relaxedDistance η time r x x = 2 * weight η (time x) r
proof:
:= by
  simp [relaxedDistance]; ring

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_relaxedComplex
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_relaxedComplex (η : ℝ) (time : V → Option ℝ) (r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ relaxedComplex η time r ↔ s.Nonempty ∧ 0 ≤ r ∧
      ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ s, relaxedDistance η time r x y ≤ r
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.relaxedComplex_mono
statement:
theorem relaxedComplex_mono {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (time : V → Option ℝ) (ht : ∀ x t, t ∈ time x → 0 ≤ t) :
    Monotone (relaxedComplex η time)
proof:
:= by
  intro r s hrs σ hσ
  refine ⟨hσ.1, hσ.2.1.trans hrs, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  have hxy := hσ.2.2 x hx y hy
  have hxw := (weight_increment hη hη' (time x) (ht x) hσ.2.1 hrs).2
  have hyw := (weight_increment hη hη' (time y) (ht y) hσ.2.1 hrs).2
  dsimp [relaxedDistance] at hxy ⊢
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.rips_le_relaxedComplex
statement:
theorem rips_le_relaxedComplex {η r : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (time : V → Option ℝ) :
    (Rips.filter inferInstance).sublevel ((1 - 2 * η) * r) ≤ relaxedComplex η time r
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  obtain ⟨hne, hdist⟩ := (Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).mp hσ
  refine ⟨hne, hr, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  have hwx := weight_le hη hη' hr (time x)
  have hwy := weight_le hη hη' hr (time y)
  have hxy := hdist x hx y hy
  dsimp [relaxedDistance]
  nlinarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.relaxedComplex_le_rips
statement:
theorem relaxedComplex_le_rips {η r : ℝ} (hη : 0 ≤ η) (time : V → Option ℝ) :
    relaxedComplex η time r ≤ (Rips.filter inferInstance).sublevel r
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  apply (Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).mpr
  refine ⟨hσ.1, ?_⟩
  intro x hx y hy
  have hwx := weight_nonneg hη hσ.2.1 (time x)
  have hwy := weight_nonneg hη hσ.2.1 (time y)
  have hxy := hσ.2.2 x hx y hy
  dsimp [relaxedDistance] at hxy
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_closedActiveComplex
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_closedActiveComplex (seed : V) (η r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ closedActiveComplex seed η r ↔
      s ∈ relaxedComplex η (deletionTime seed η) r ∧
        ∀ x ∈ s, ClosedActive (deletionTime seed η x) r
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_sparseComplex
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_sparseComplex (seed : V) (η r : ℝ) (s : Finset V) :
    s ∈ sparseComplex seed η r ↔ ∃ a, 0 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ r ∧ s ∈ closedActiveComplex seed η a
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseComplex_mono
statement: theorem sparseComplex_mono (seed : V) (η : ℝ) : Monotone (sparseComplex seed η)
proof:
:= by
  intro r s hrs σ
  rintro ⟨a, ha, har, hσ⟩
  exact ⟨a, ha, har.trans hrs, hσ⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseComplex_eq_bot_of_neg
statement:
theorem sparseComplex_eq_bot_of_neg (seed : V) (η : ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : r < 0) :
    sparseComplex seed η r = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm _ bot_le
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨a, ha, har, _⟩ := hs
  exact (not_le_of_gt hr (ha.trans har)).elim

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.closedActiveComplex_le_sparseComplex
statement:
theorem closedActiveComplex_le_sparseComplex (seed : V) (η : ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    closedActiveComplex seed η r ≤ sparseComplex seed η r
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs
  exact ⟨r, hr, le_rfl, hs⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.singleton_seed_mem_sparse
statement:
theorem singleton_seed_mem_sparse (seed : V) (η : ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
    ({seed} : Finset V) ∈ sparseFiltration seed η r
proof:
:= by
  apply closedActiveComplex_le_sparseComplex seed η hr
  refine ⟨⟨by simp, hr, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx y hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx hy
    subst x; subst y
    simpa [relaxedDistance] using hr
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton] at hx
    subst x
    simp

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.finiteSparseFiltration_of_isEmpty
statement:
@[simp] theorem finiteSparseFiltration_of_isEmpty [IsEmpty V] (η : ℝ) :
    finiteSparseFiltration (V := V) η = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  simp [finiteSparseFiltration]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseComplex_le_relaxedComplex
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  obtain ⟨a, _, har, hσa⟩ := hσ
  exact relaxedComplex_mono hη.le (by linarith) (deletionTime seed η)
    (deletionTime_nonneg seed hη hη') har hσa.1

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseFilter_logModule_eq
statement:
theorem sparseFilter_logModule_eq (k : Type u) [Field k] (seed : V)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (n : ℕ) :
    logModule k (sparseFilter seed η) n =
      simplicialHomologyPModule k
        (Filtration.reindex expHom (sparseFiltration seed η)) n
proof:
:= by
  change simplicialHomologyPModule k
      (Filtration.reindex expHom (sparseFilter seed η).sublevelFiltration) n = _
  rw [sparseFilter_sublevelFiltration_eq seed hη hη']

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.sparseLogDiagram_bottleneck_le
statement:
theorem sparseLogDiagram_bottleneck_le (k : Type u) [Field k] (seed : V)
    {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3)
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    bottleneck (logDgm k (sparseFilter seed η) n)
      (logDgm k (Rips.filter (V := V) inferInstance) n) ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal (Real.log (approximationFactor η))
proof:
:= by
  let f := sparseFilter seed η
  let g := Rips.filter (V := V) inferInstance
  have hi : RealInterleaving (logParam (approximationFactor η))
      (logModule k f n) (logModule k g n) := by
    rw [sparseFilter_logModule_eq k seed hη hη' n]
    exact sparseRipsLogInterleaving k seed hη hη' n
  have hs := logModule_isConstructible k n hn
    (sparseFilter_positiveOnEdges seed hη hη')
  have hg := logModule_isConstructible k n hn
    (positiveOnEdges_rips (V := V) inferInstance)
  have hbound := FiniteConstructible.bottleneck_le_of_interleaving
    hs hg
    (fun i => logModule_finiteDimensional k n f (logGrid f i))
    (fun i => logModule_finiteDimensional k n g (logGrid g i)) hi
  change bottleneck (logDgm k f n) (logDgm k g n) ≤ _
  have hc := one_le_approximationFactor hη hη'
  rw [← coe_logParam hc, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
  simpa only [logDgm, f, g] using hbound

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.closedActive_of_openActive_of_noDeletion
proof:
:= by
  cases ht : deletionTime seed η x with
  | none => trivial
  | some t => exact hgap x t (by simp [ht]) (by simpa [ht, OpenActive] using hx)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionMap_fixes_later
proof:
:= by
  apply deletionMap_of_active
  cases ht : deletionTime seed η x with
  | none => trivial
  | some t => exact hrs.trans_le (show s ≤ t by simpa [ht, ClosedActive] using hx)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.deletionMap_image_later
proof:
:= by
  have heq : σ.image (deletionMap seed η r hη hr) = σ.image id :=
    Finset.image_congr (fun x hx => deletionMap_fixes_later seed hη hr hrs (hσ.2 x hx))
  simpa only [Finset.image_id] using heq

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.image_mem_later_of_noDeletion
proof:
:= by
  have hproject := (deletionVertexMap seed hη hη' hr).map_face σ hσ.1
  refine ⟨relaxedComplex_mono hη.le (by linarith) (deletionTime seed η)
    (deletionTime_nonneg seed hη hη') hrs hproject.1, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
  exact closedActive_of_openActive_of_noDeletion seed hgap (deletionMap_active seed hη hη' hr a)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.unionDeletion_inclusion_contiguous
statement:
theorem unionDeletion_inclusion_contiguous (seed : V) {η r s : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrs : r < s)
    (hgap : NoDeletionBetween seed η r s) :
    Contiguous (VertexMap.comp (unionDeletionVertexMap seed hη hη' hr hrs hgap)
      (inclusionVertexMap (show closedActiveComplex seed η s ≤
        closedActiveComplex seed η r ⊔ closedActiveComplex seed η s from le_sup_right)))
      (VertexMap.id (closedActiveComplex seed η r ⊔ closedActiveComplex seed η s))
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  change σ.image (deletionMap seed η r hη.le hr) ∪ σ.image id ∈
    closedActiveComplex seed η r ⊔ closedActiveComplex seed η s
  rw [Finset.image_id]
  rcases (show σ ∈ closedActiveComplex seed η r ∨ σ ∈ closedActiveComplex seed η s from hσ)
    with hσ | hσ
  · apply (show closedActiveComplex seed η r ≤
      closedActiveComplex seed η r ⊔ closedActiveComplex seed η s from le_sup_left)
    change σ.image (deletionMap seed η r hη.le hr) ∪ σ ∈ closedActiveComplex seed η r
    have hcont := inclusion_deletion_contiguous seed hη hη' hr σ hσ
    change σ.image (deletionMap seed η r hη.le hr) ∪ σ.image id ∈
      closedActiveComplex seed η r at hcont
    simpa only [Finset.image_id] using hcont
  · rw [deletionMap_image_later seed hη.le hr hrs hσ, Finset.union_self]
    exact Or.inr hσ

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.inclusion_unionDeletion_contiguous
statement:
theorem inclusion_unionDeletion_contiguous (seed : V) {η r s : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrs : r < s)
    (hgap : NoDeletionBetween seed η r s) :
    Contiguous (VertexMap.comp
      (inclusionVertexMap (show closedActiveComplex seed η s ≤
        closedActiveComplex seed η r ⊔ closedActiveComplex seed η s from le_sup_right))
      (unionDeletionVertexMap seed hη hη' hr hrs hgap))
      (VertexMap.id (closedActiveComplex seed η s))
proof:
:= by
  intro σ hσ
  change σ.image (deletionMap seed η r hη.le hr) ∪ σ.image id ∈ closedActiveComplex seed η s
  rw [Finset.image_id]
  simpa only [deletionMap_image_later seed hη.le hr hrs hσ, Finset.union_self] using hσ

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.unionDeletionHomologyIso_hom
statement:
@[simp] theorem unionDeletionHomologyIso_hom (R : Type*) [Ring R] (seed : V) {η r s : ℝ}
    (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrs : r < s)
    (hgap : NoDeletionBetween seed η r s) (n : ℕ) :
    (unionDeletionHomologyIso R seed hη hη' hr hrs hgap n).hom =
      simplicialHomologyIncl R (show closedActiveComplex seed η s ≤
        closedActiveComplex seed η r ⊔ closedActiveComplex seed η s from le_sup_right) n
proof:
:=
  simplicialHomologyMap_inclusion R _ n

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.exists_packing_depth
statement:
theorem exists_packing_depth {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3) :
    ∃ h : ℕ, 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ h < η * (1 - 2 * η)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : 0 < η * (1 - 2 * η) / 2 := by
    have : 0 < 1 - 2 * η := by linarith
    positivity
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hp (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1)
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  have heq : 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ h = 2 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ h := by
    simp only [div_pow, one_pow]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  linarith

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_sparseCarrier
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_sparseCarrier (seed : V) (η : ℝ) (σ : Finset V) :
    σ ∈ sparseCarrier seed η ↔ ∃ a, 0 ≤ a ∧ σ ∈ closedActiveComplex seed η a
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_sparseCarrier_iff
statement:
theorem mem_sparseCarrier_iff (seed : V) (η : ℝ) (σ : Finset V) :
    σ ∈ sparseCarrier seed η ↔ ∃ r, σ ∈ sparseFiltration seed η r
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hσ⟩
    exact ⟨a, a, ha, le_rfl, hσ⟩
  · rintro ⟨r, a, ha, _, hσ⟩
    exact ⟨a, ha, hσ⟩

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_laterNeighbors
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_laterNeighbors (seed : V) (η : ℝ) (p q : V) :
    q ∈ laterNeighbors seed η p ↔ insertionIndex seed q < insertionIndex seed p ∧
      ({p, q} : Finset V) ∈ sparseCarrier seed η
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [laterNeighbors]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.laterNeighbors_seed
statement: @[simp] theorem laterNeighbors_seed (seed : V) (η : ℝ) : laterNeighbors seed η seed = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  simp

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.laterNeighbors_subset_prefix
statement:
theorem laterNeighbors_subset_prefix (seed : V) (η : ℝ) (p : V) :
    laterNeighbors seed η p ⊆ greedyPrefix seed (insertionIndex seed p - 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  have hi := ((mem_laterNeighbors seed η p q).mp hq).1
  exact prefix_mono seed (by omega) (mem_insertionIndex seed q)

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.laterNeighbor_dist_le
statement:
theorem laterNeighbor_dist_le (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (p : V)
    (hp : p ≠ seed) {q : V} (hq : q ∈ laterNeighbors seed η p) :
    dist p q ≤ radius seed (insertionIndex seed p - 1) / (η * (1 - 2 * η))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, _, hface⟩ := ((mem_laterNeighbors seed η p q).mp hq).2
  have hdist := ((Rips.mem_sublevel_iff _ _ _).mp
    (relaxedComplex_le_rips hη.le _ hface.1)).2 p (by simp) q (by simp)
  have hactive := hface.2 p (by simp)
  rw [deletionTime_of_ne seed η hp] at hactive
  exact hdist.trans hactive

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.laterNeighbor_closedActive_at_time
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hqs : q = seed
  · subst q; simp
  · rw [deletionTime_of_ne seed η hqs]
    have hi := ((mem_laterNeighbors seed η p q).mp hq).1
    have hrad := radius_antitone seed (show insertionIndex seed q - 1 ≤
      insertionIndex seed p - 1 by omega)
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hrad (mul_nonneg hη.le (by linarith))

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.laterNeighbors_card_le
statement:
theorem laterNeighbors_card_le (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3)
    {Λ : ℕ} (hd : ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) Λ) (h : ℕ)
    (hsmall : 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ h < η * (1 - 2 * η)) (p : V) :
    (laterNeighbors seed η p).card ≤ Λ ^ h
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hp : p = seed
  · subst p; simp
  · let ρ := radius seed (insertionIndex seed p - 1)
    let t := ρ / (η * (1 - 2 * η))
    have hρ : 0 < ρ := insertionRadius_pos seed p hp
    have hfactor : 0 < η * (1 - 2 * η) := mul_pos hη (by linarith)
    have ht : 0 < t := div_pos hρ hfactor
    have hcancel : t * (η * (1 - 2 * η)) = ρ := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hfactor)
    apply hd.packing_bound p ht h (δ := ρ) ?_ (laterNeighbors seed η p)
      (fun q hq => laterNeighbor_dist_le seed hη p hp hq) ?_
    · have hmul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsmall ht
      rw [hcancel] at hmul
      calc
        2 * (t / (2 : ℝ) ^ h) = t * (2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ h) := by ring
        _ < ρ := hmul
    · intro x hx y hy hxy
      exact separation seed (insertionIndex seed p - 1)
        (laterNeighbors_subset_prefix seed η p hx) (laterNeighbors_subset_prefix seed η p hy) hxy

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.mem_orientedEdges
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_orientedEdges (seed : V) (η : ℝ) (p q : V) :
    (p, q) ∈ orientedEdges seed η ↔ insertionIndex seed q < insertionIndex seed p ∧
      ({p, q} : Finset V) ∈ sparseCarrier seed η
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [orientedEdges]

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.pair_mem_carrier_iff_oriented
statement:
theorem pair_mem_carrier_iff_oriented (seed : V) (η : ℝ) {p q : V} (hpq : p ≠ q) :
    ({p, q} : Finset V) ∈ sparseCarrier seed η ↔
      (p, q) ∈ orientedEdges seed η ∨ (q, p) ∈ orientedEdges seed η
proof:
:= by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro hface
    rcases lt_trichotomy (insertionIndex seed q) (insertionIndex seed p) with h | h | h
    · exact Or.inl ((mem_orientedEdges seed η p q).mpr ⟨h, hface⟩)
    · exact (hpq (insertionIndex_injective seed h.symm)).elim
    · exact Or.inr ((mem_orientedEdges seed η q p).mpr ⟨h, by simpa [Finset.pair_comm] using hface⟩)
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact ((mem_orientedEdges seed η p q).mp h).2
    · simpa [Finset.pair_comm] using ((mem_orientedEdges seed η q p).mp h).2

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.orientedEdges_card_le
statement:
theorem orientedEdges_card_le (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3)
    {Λ : ℕ} (hd : ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) Λ) (h : ℕ)
    (hsmall : 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ h < η * (1 - 2 * η)) :
    (orientedEdges seed η).card ≤ Fintype.card V * Λ ^ h
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (orientedEdges seed η).card ≤ ∑ p : V,
        ((laterNeighbors seed η p).image (fun q => (p, q))).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ p : V, (laterNeighbors seed η p).card :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ => Finset.card_image_le
    _ ≤ ∑ _p : V, Λ ^ h :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ => laterNeighbors_card_le seed hη hη' hd h hsmall p
    _ = Fintype.card V * Λ ^ h := by simp

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.exists_assigned_vertex
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hne := (sparseCarrier seed η).isRelLowerSet_faces hσ |>.1
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hmax⟩ := σ.exists_max_image (insertionIndex seed) hne
  refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  obtain ⟨hqp, hqσ⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.mp hq
  apply (mem_laterNeighbors seed η p q).mpr
  refine ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne (hmax q hqσ) (fun h => hqp (insertionIndex_injective seed h)), ?_⟩
  apply (sparseCarrier seed η).isRelLowerSet_faces hσ |>.2 ?_ (by simp)
  intro x hx
  rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hx with rfl | hx
  · exact hp
  · simpa only [Finset.mem_singleton.mp hx] using hqσ

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.faces_subset_candidates
statement:
private theorem faces_subset_candidates (seed : V) (η : ℝ) (j : ℕ) :
    facesOfDimension seed η j ⊆ assignedCandidates seed η j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro σ hσ
  have hσ' : σ ∈ sparseCarrier seed η ∧ σ.card = j + 1 := by
    simpa [facesOfDimension] using hσ
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hsub⟩ := exists_assigned_vertex seed η hσ'.1
  apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨p, Finset.mem_univ p, Finset.mem_image.mpr ?_⟩
  refine ⟨σ.erase p, Finset.mem_powersetCard.mpr ⟨hsub, ?_⟩, Finset.insert_erase hp⟩
  rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hp, hσ'.2]
  omega

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.facesOfDimension_card_le
statement:
theorem facesOfDimension_card_le (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3)
    {Λ : ℕ} (hd : ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) Λ) (h : ℕ)
    (hsmall : 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ h < η * (1 - 2 * η)) (j : ℕ) :
    (facesOfDimension seed η j).card ≤ Fintype.card V * (Λ ^ h) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (facesOfDimension seed η j).card ≤ (assignedCandidates seed η j).card :=
      Finset.card_le_card (faces_subset_candidates seed η j)
    _ ≤ ∑ p : V, (((laterNeighbors seed η p).powersetCard j).image (insert p)).card :=
      Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ p : V, ((laterNeighbors seed η p).powersetCard j).card :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun p _ => Finset.card_image_le
    _ = ∑ p : V, (laterNeighbors seed η p).card.choose j := by simp only [Finset.card_powersetCard]
    _ ≤ ∑ p : V, (Λ ^ h) ^ j := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro p _
      exact (Nat.choose_le_pow _ _).trans
        (Nat.pow_le_pow_left (laterNeighbors_card_le seed hη hη' hd h hsmall p) j)
    _ = Fintype.card V * (Λ ^ h) ^ j := by simp

name: TDA.Filtration.SparseRips.skeletonFaces_card_le
statement:
theorem skeletonFaces_card_le (seed : V) {η : ℝ} (hη : 0 < η) (hη' : η ≤ 1 / 3)
    {Λ : ℕ} (hd : ClosedBallDoubling (V := V) Λ) (h : ℕ)
    (hsmall : 2 / (2 : ℝ) ^ h < η * (1 - 2 * η)) (m : ℕ) :
    (skeletonFaces seed η m).card ≤ Fintype.card V * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (Λ ^ h) ^ j
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hsub : skeletonFaces seed η m ⊆
      (Finset.range (m + 1)).biUnion (facesOfDimension seed η) := by
    intro σ hσ
    have hσ' : σ ∈ sparseCarrier seed η ∧ σ.card ≤ m + 1 := by
      simpa [skeletonFaces] using hσ
    have hpos := Finset.card_pos.mpr ((sparseCarrier seed η).isRelLowerSet_faces hσ'.1 |>.1)
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨σ.card - 1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), ?_⟩
    simp only [facesOfDimension, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    exact ⟨hσ'.1, by omega⟩
  calc
    (skeletonFaces seed η m).card ≤
        ((Finset.range (m + 1)).biUnion (facesOfDimension seed η)).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (facesOfDimension seed η j).card := Finset.card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), Fintype.card V * (Λ ^ h) ^ j :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => facesOfDimension_card_le seed hη hη' hd h hsmall j
    _ = Fintype.card V * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (Λ ^ h) ^ j := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.validBool_iff
statement: theorem validBool_iff (xs : Input) : validBool xs = true ↔ Valid xs
proof:
:= by
  simp [validBool]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.mem_complex
statement:
theorem mem_complex (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) (s : Finset ℕ) :
    s ∈ complex xs h ↔ s ∈ faces xs
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.listFace_bijective
statement:
theorem listFace_bijective (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) :
    Function.Bijective (listFace xs h)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro i j hij
    have hi : i.val < (faces xs).length := by simpa [faces] using i.isLt
    have hj : j.val < (faces xs).length := by simpa [faces] using j.isLt
    have heq : (faces xs)[i.val]'hi = (faces xs)[j.val]'hj := by
      simpa [faces, listFace] using congrArg Subtype.val hij
    exact Fin.ext ((h.2.1.getElem_inj_iff).mp heq)
  · intro s
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hs⟩ := List.mem_map.mp s.property
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp ha
    refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hs

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.faceCount_eq_length
statement:
theorem faceCount_eq_length (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) :
    @faceCount ℕ (complex xs h) (faceFintype xs h) = xs.length
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  simpa using Fintype.card_congr (listEquiv xs h).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.positionEquiv_val
statement:
theorem positionEquiv_val (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs)
    (i : Fin (@faceCount ℕ (complex xs h) (faceFintype xs h))) :
    ((positionEquiv xs h) i).val =
      (xs.get (Fin.cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) i)).1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [positionEquiv, Equiv.trans_apply, finCongr_apply,
    listEquiv, Equiv.ofBijective_apply, listFace]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.boundary_eq_faceBoundaryMatrix
statement:
theorem boundary_eq_faceBoundaryMatrix (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) :
    letI := faceFintype xs h
    ∀ i j : Fin (faceCount (complex xs h)),
      boundary xs (Fin.cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) i)
        (Fin.cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) j) =
        faceBoundaryMatrix (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h) i j
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  intro i j
  let a := Fin.cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) i
  let b := Fin.cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) j
  have hia := positionEquiv_val xs h i
  have hjb := positionEquiv_val xs h j
  change ((compatibleOrder xs h).enum i).val =
    (xs.get (Fin.cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) i)).1 at hia
  change ((compatibleOrder xs h).enum j).val =
    (xs.get (Fin.cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) j)).1 at hjb
  have hipos : 0 < (xs.get a).1.card :=
    Finset.card_pos.mpr (h.1 a)
  have hd : ((xs.get b).1.card = ((xs.get a).1.card - 1) + 2) ↔
      faceDegree (compatibleOrder xs h) j =
        faceDegree (compatibleOrder xs h) i + 1 := by
    simp only [faceDegree]
    rw [show ((compatibleOrder xs h).enum i).val = (xs.get a).1 from hia,
      show ((compatibleOrder xs h).enum j).val = (xs.get b).1 from hjb]
    omega
  rw [faceBoundaryMatrix_apply]
  by_cases hc : (xs.get b).1.card = ((xs.get a).1.card - 1) + 2
  · have hg := hd.mp hc
    have hc' : (xs.get (Fin.cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) j)).1.card =
        (xs.get (Fin.cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) i)).1.card - 1 + 2 := hc
    simp only [boundary, dif_pos hc', dif_pos hg]
    simp only [deletedFace, indexedFace, faceDegree, hia, hjb]
    congr 1
    ext x
    congr 1
    apply propext
    constructor
    · intro he
      apply Subtype.ext
      convert he using 1
      congr 1
    · intro he
      have hv := congrArg Subtype.val he
      convert hv using 1
      congr 1
  · have hg : ¬ faceDegree (compatibleOrder xs h) j =
        faceDegree (compatibleOrder xs h) i + 1 := fun q => hc (hd.mpr q)
    have hc' : ¬ (xs.get (Fin.cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) j)).1.card =
        (xs.get (Fin.cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) i)).1.card - 1 + 2 := hc
    simp only [boundary, dif_neg hc', dif_neg hg]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.boundary_reindex
statement:
theorem boundary_reindex (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) :
    letI := faceFintype xs h
    boundary xs =
      (Matrix.reindex (finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h))
        (finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)))
        (faceBoundaryMatrix (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h))
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro i j
  let a := (finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)).symm i
  let b := (finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)).symm j
  have he := boundary_eq_faceBoundaryMatrix xs h a b
  simpa [Matrix.reindex_apply, a, b] using he

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.degree_eq_faceDegree
statement:
theorem degree_eq_faceDegree (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs)
    (i : Fin xs.length) :
    letI := faceFintype xs h
    degree xs i = faceDegree (compatibleOrder xs h)
      ((finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)).symm i)
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  simp only [degree, faceDegree]
  have hv := positionEquiv_val xs h
    ((finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)).symm i)
  change ((compatibleOrder xs h).enum
    ((finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)).symm i)).val = _ at hv
  simpa using congrArg (fun s : Finset ℕ => s.card - 1) hv.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.boundary_sq_zero
statement:
theorem boundary_sq_zero (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) :
    boundary xs * boundary xs = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  let e := finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)
  rw [boundary_reindex xs h]
  change (Matrix.reindexRingEquiv (ZMod 2) e)
      (faceBoundaryMatrix (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h)) *
    (Matrix.reindexRingEquiv (ZMod 2) e)
      (faceBoundaryMatrix (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h)) = 0
  rw [← map_mul]
  rw [faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero]
  exact map_zero _

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.boundary_strict
statement:
theorem boundary_strict (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) :
    StrictBoundary (boundary xs)
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  intro i j hij
  let e := finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)
  have ha : faceBoundaryMatrix (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h)
      (e.symm i) (e.symm j) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [boundary_reindex xs h, Matrix.reindex_apply, e] using hij
  have hs := faceBoundaryMatrix_strict (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h)
    (e.symm i) (e.symm j) ha
  exact hs

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.boundary_lowersDegree
statement:
theorem boundary_lowersDegree (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) :
    LowersDegree (degree xs) (boundary xs)
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  intro i j hij
  let e := finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)
  have ha : faceBoundaryMatrix (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h)
      (e.symm i) (e.symm j) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [boundary_reindex xs h, Matrix.reindex_apply, e] using hij
  have hd := faceBoundaryMatrix_lowersDegree (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h)
    (e.symm i) (e.symm j) ha
  simpa [degree_eq_faceDegree xs h, e] using hd

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.boundary_vertex
statement:
theorem boundary_vertex (xs : Input) (j : Fin xs.length)
    (hj : (xs.get j).1.card = 1) : (boundary xs).col j = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [Matrix.col_apply, Pi.zero_apply, boundary]
  split_ifs with hc
  · omega
  · rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.reduce_reindex_cast
statement:
private theorem reduce_reindex_cast {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n)
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (ZMod 2)) :
    replay ((Matrix.reindex (finCongr h) (finCongr h)) M)
      (matrixReductionTrace ((Matrix.reindex (finCongr h) (finCongr h)) M)) =
    (Matrix.reindex (finCongr h) (finCongr h))
      (replay M (matrixReductionTrace M))
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.reduced_reindex
statement:
theorem reduced_reindex (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) :
    letI := faceFintype xs h
    reduced xs =
      (Matrix.reindex (finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h))
        (finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)))
        (reducedFaceBoundary (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h))
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  have hD := boundary_reindex xs h
  simp only [reduced, trace, reducedFaceBoundary]
  rw [hD]
  exact reduce_reindex_cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) _

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.pivotPairs_nodup
statement: theorem pivotPairs_nodup (xs : Input) : (pivotPairs xs).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  unfold pivotPairs
  apply List.Nodup.filterMap (l := List.finRange xs.length) ?_ (List.nodup_finRange _)
  intro j j' pair hj hj'
  rcases pair with ⟨i, k⟩
  simp only [Option.mem_def] at hj hj'
  cases h : columnPivot ((reduced xs).col j) <;>
    simp [h] at hj
  cases h' : columnPivot ((reduced xs).col j') <;>
    simp [h'] at hj'
  exact hj.2.trans hj'.2.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.pivotPairs_mem
statement:
theorem pivotPairs_mem (xs : Input) (i j : Fin xs.length) :
    (i, j) ∈ pivotPairs xs ↔ columnPivot ((reduced xs).col j) = some i
proof:
:= by
  unfold pivotPairs
  simp only [List.mem_filterMap, List.mem_finRange, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    cases h : columnPivot ((reduced xs).col k) with
    | none => simp [h] at hk
    | some p =>
        simp only [h, Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hk
        have hp := (Prod.mk.inj hk).1
        have hj := (Prod.mk.inj hk).2
        subst p
        subst k
        exact h
  · intro hj
    exact ⟨j, by simp [hj]⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.essentialIndices_mem
statement:
theorem essentialIndices_mem (xs : Input) (i : Fin xs.length) :
    i ∈ essentialIndices xs ↔ IsEssential (reduced xs) i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [essentialIndices, List.mem_filter, List.mem_finRange, true_and]
  simp only [IsEssential, IsPivot]
  constructor
  · intro hi
    have hz : columnPivot ((reduced xs).col i) = none := by
      cases hp : columnPivot ((reduced xs).col i) <;> simp [hp] at hi ⊢
    refine ⟨hz, ?_⟩
    intro ⟨j, hj⟩
    have ha : (pivotPairs xs).any (fun q => q.1 == i) = true := by
      simp only [List.any_eq_true, List.mem_finRange, true_and]
      exact ⟨(i, j), (pivotPairs_mem xs i j).mpr hj, by simp⟩
    simp [ha] at hi
  · rintro ⟨hz, hn⟩
    have hno : (pivotPairs xs).any (fun q => q.1 == i) = false := by
      cases ha : (pivotPairs xs).any (fun q => q.1 == i) with
      | false => rfl
      | true =>
          have hex : ∃ j : Fin xs.length,
              columnPivot ((reduced xs).col j) = some i := by
            obtain ⟨⟨r, j⟩, hp, hr⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp ha
            have hri : r = i := by simpa using hr
            subst r
            exact ⟨j, (pivotPairs_mem xs i j).mp hp⟩
          exact (hn hex).elim
    simp [hz, hno]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.pivotPairs_eq_pivotIndexPairs
statement:
theorem pivotPairs_eq_pivotIndexPairs (xs : Input) (p : ℕ) :
    ((pivotPairs xs).filter (fun q => degree xs q.1 = p) :
      Multiset (Fin xs.length × Fin xs.length)) =
      pivotIndexPairs (degree xs) (reduced xs) p
proof:
:= by
  have hpiv : DistinctPivots (reduced xs) := by
    intro i j q hi hj
    exact matrixReductionTrace_pivots_distinct (boundary xs) i j q hi hj
  apply (Multiset.Nodup.ext
    (Multiset.coe_nodup.mpr ((pivotPairs_nodup xs).filter _))
    (pivotIndexPairs_nodup (degree xs) (reduced xs) p)).2
  rintro ⟨i, j⟩
  simp only [List.mem_filter, Multiset.mem_coe, decide_eq_true_eq,
    pivotPairs_mem, mem_pivotIndexPairs_iff (degree xs) (reduced xs) hpiv]
  tauto

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.essentialIndices_eq_pivotEssentialIndices
statement:
theorem essentialIndices_eq_pivotEssentialIndices (xs : Input) (p : ℕ) :
    ((essentialIndices xs).filter (fun i => degree xs i = p) :
      Multiset (Fin xs.length)) =
      pivotEssentialIndices (degree xs) (reduced xs) p
proof:
:= by
  have hn : (essentialIndices xs).Nodup :=
    (List.nodup_finRange xs.length).filter _
  apply (Multiset.Nodup.ext (Multiset.coe_nodup.mpr (hn.filter _))
    (pivotEssentialIndices_nodup (degree xs) (reduced xs) p)).2
  intro i
  simp only [List.mem_filter, Multiset.mem_coe, decide_eq_true_eq, essentialIndices_mem,
    mem_pivotEssentialIndices_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.pairs_reindex_cast
statement:
private theorem pairs_reindex_cast {m n : ℕ} (hn : m = n)
    (d : Fin m → ℕ) (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (ZMod 2)) (p : ℕ) :
    pivotIndexPairs (fun i => d ((finCongr hn).symm i))
      ((Matrix.reindex (finCongr hn) (finCongr hn)) R) p =
    (pivotIndexPairs d R p).map
      (fun q => ((finCongr hn) q.1, (finCongr hn) q.2))
proof:
:= by
  cases hn
  simp [Matrix.reindex_refl_refl]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.essential_reindex_cast
statement:
private theorem essential_reindex_cast {m n : ℕ} (hn : m = n)
    (d : Fin m → ℕ) (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) (ZMod 2)) (p : ℕ) :
    pivotEssentialIndices (fun i => d ((finCongr hn).symm i))
      ((Matrix.reindex (finCongr hn) (finCongr hn)) R) p =
    (pivotEssentialIndices d R p).map (finCongr hn)
proof:
:= by
  cases hn
  simp [Matrix.reindex_refl_refl]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.pivotPairs_semantic
statement:
theorem pivotPairs_semantic (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) (p : ℕ) :
    letI := faceFintype xs h
    ((pivotPairs xs).filter (fun q => degree xs q.1 = p) :
      Multiset (Fin xs.length × Fin xs.length)) =
    (pivotIndexPairs (faceDegree (compatibleOrder xs h))
      (reducedFaceBoundary (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h)) p).map
      (fun q => ((finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)) q.1,
        (finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)) q.2))
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  let e := finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)
  have hdeg : degree xs = fun i =>
      faceDegree (compatibleOrder xs h) (e.symm i) := by
    funext i
    exact degree_eq_faceDegree xs h i
  rw [pivotPairs_eq_pivotIndexPairs, hdeg, reduced_reindex xs h]
  exact pairs_reindex_cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) _ _ p

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.essentialIndices_semantic
statement:
theorem essentialIndices_semantic (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) (p : ℕ) :
    letI := faceFintype xs h
    ((essentialIndices xs).filter (fun i => degree xs i = p) :
      Multiset (Fin xs.length)) =
    (pivotEssentialIndices (faceDegree (compatibleOrder xs h))
      (reducedFaceBoundary (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h)) p).map
      (finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h))
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  let e := finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)
  have hdeg : degree xs = fun i =>
      faceDegree (compatibleOrder xs h) (e.symm i) := by
    funext i
    exact degree_eq_faceDegree xs h i
  rw [essentialIndices_eq_pivotEssentialIndices, hdeg, reduced_reindex xs h]
  exact essential_reindex_cast (faceCount_eq_length xs h) _ _ p

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.grade_eq_semantic
statement:
theorem grade_eq_semantic (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs)
    (i : Fin (@faceCount ℕ (complex xs h) (faceFintype xs h))) :
    letI := faceFintype xs h
    (xs.get ((finCongr (faceCount_eq_length xs h)) i)).2 =
      (gradeFilter xs h).value ((compatibleOrder xs h).enum i)
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  simp only [gradeFilter, compatibleOrder, positionEquiv,
    Equiv.trans_apply, finCongr_apply, Equiv.symm_trans_apply,
    Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.finiteOccurrences_offDiagonal
statement:
theorem finiteOccurrences_offDiagonal (xs : Input) (o : Occurrence)
    (ho : o ∈ finiteOccurrences xs) :
    (o.birth : WithTop ℤ) ≠ (Occurrence.point o).2
proof:
:= by
  unfold finiteOccurrences at ho
  obtain ⟨pair, _, hp⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp ho
  rcases pair with ⟨i, j⟩
  dsimp [pairOccurrence] at hp
  split_ifs at hp with he
  cases hp
  simpa [Occurrence.point] using he

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.finitePointsList
statement:
private theorem finitePointsList (xs : Input) (p : ℕ)
    (pairs : List (Fin xs.length × Fin xs.length)) :
    ((pairs.filterMap (pairOccurrence xs)).filter (fun o => o.degree = p)).map
        Occurrence.point =
      (((pairs.filter (fun q => degree xs q.1 = p)).map (pairValue xs)).filter
        (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2)).map
        (fun q => (q.1, (q.2 : WithTop ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  induction pairs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons q pairs ih =>
      rcases q with ⟨i, j⟩
      by_cases he : (xs.get i).2 = (xs.get j).2
      · have he' : xs[i.val].2 = xs[j.val].2 := he
        have hpair : pairOccurrence xs (i, j) = none := by
          simp [pairOccurrence, he']
        simp [List.filterMap_cons, List.filter_cons, List.map_cons,
          hpair, pairValue, he', ih]
        by_cases hp : degree xs i = p <;> simp [hp, pairValue, he']
      · by_cases hp : degree xs i = p
        · have he' : xs[i.val].2 ≠ xs[j.val].2 := he
          have hpair : pairOccurrence xs (i, j) =
              some ⟨degree xs i, (xs.get i).2, .finite (xs.get j).2⟩ := by
            simp [pairOccurrence, he']
          simp [List.filterMap_cons, List.filter_cons, List.map_cons,
            hpair, pairValue, he', hp, Occurrence.point, ih]
        · have he' : xs[i.val].2 ≠ xs[j.val].2 := he
          have hpair : pairOccurrence xs (i, j) =
              some ⟨degree xs i, (xs.get i).2, .finite (xs.get j).2⟩ := by
            simp [pairOccurrence, he']
          simp [List.filterMap_cons, List.filter_cons, List.map_cons,
            hpair, pairValue, he', hp, ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.essentialPointsList
statement:
private theorem essentialPointsList (xs : Input) (p : ℕ)
    (indices : List (Fin xs.length)) :
    ((indices.map fun i =>
        (⟨degree xs i, (xs.get i).2, .essential⟩ : Occurrence)).filter
        (fun o => o.degree = p)).map Occurrence.point =
      (indices.filter (fun i => degree xs i = p)).map
        (fun i => ((xs.get i).2, (⊤ : WithTop ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  induction indices with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i indices ih =>
      by_cases hp : degree xs i = p
      · simp [List.filter_cons, List.map_cons, hp, Occurrence.point, ih]
        exact ih
      · simp [List.filter_cons, List.map_cons, hp, Occurrence.point, ih]
        exact ih

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.outputPointsList
statement:
theorem outputPointsList (xs : Input) (p : ℕ) :
    ((occurrences xs).filter (fun o => o.degree = p)).map Occurrence.point =
      (((pivotPairs xs).filter (fun q => degree xs q.1 = p)).map
        (pairValue xs) |>.filter (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2)).map
        (fun q => (q.1, (q.2 : WithTop ℤ))) ++
      ((essentialIndices xs).filter (fun i => degree xs i = p)).map
        (fun i => ((xs.get i).2, (⊤ : WithTop ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [occurrences, List.filter_append, List.map_append,
    finiteOccurrences, essentialOccurrences]
  rw [finitePointsList xs p (pivotPairs xs)]
  congr 1
  simpa only [degree] using essentialPointsList xs p (essentialIndices xs)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.outputDiagram_points
statement:
theorem outputDiagram_points (xs : Input) (p : ℕ) :
    (outputDiagram xs p).points =
      ((pairValuesAtDegree xs p).filter (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2)).map
        (fun q => (q.1, (q.2 : WithTop ℤ))) +
      (essentialBirthsAtDegree xs p).map
        (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop ℤ)))
proof:
:= by
  change (((occurrences xs).filter (fun o => o.degree = p)).map
    Occurrence.point : Multiset (ℤ × WithTop ℤ)) = _
  rw [outputPointsList]
  simp [pairValuesAtDegree, essentialBirthsAtDegree, List.map_map]
  simp [Function.comp_def]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.pairValuesAtDegree_semantic
statement:
theorem pairValuesAtDegree_semantic (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) (p : ℕ) :
    letI := faceFintype xs h
    pairValuesAtDegree xs p =
      (pivotIndexPairs (faceDegree (compatibleOrder xs h))
        (reducedFaceBoundary (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h)) p).map
        (pairValues (gradeFilter xs h) (compatibleOrder xs h))
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  unfold pairValuesAtDegree
  rw [pivotPairs_semantic xs h p, Multiset.map_map]
  congr 1
  funext q
  rcases q with ⟨i, j⟩
  simp only [Function.comp_def, pairValue, pairValues]
  rw [grade_eq_semantic xs h i, grade_eq_semantic xs h j]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.essentialBirthsAtDegree_semantic
statement:
theorem essentialBirthsAtDegree_semantic (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) (p : ℕ) :
    letI := faceFintype xs h
    essentialBirthsAtDegree xs p =
      (pivotEssentialIndices (faceDegree (compatibleOrder xs h))
        (reducedFaceBoundary (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h)) p).map
        (birthValue (gradeFilter xs h) (compatibleOrder xs h))
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  unfold essentialBirthsAtDegree
  rw [essentialIndices_semantic xs h p, Multiset.map_map]
  congr 1
  funext i
  simp only [Function.comp_def, birthValue]
  exact grade_eq_semantic xs h i

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.outputDiagram_eq_dgm
statement:
theorem outputDiagram_eq_dgm (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs) (p : ℕ) :
    letI := faceFintype xs h
    outputDiagram xs p = dgm (ZMod 2) (gradeFilter xs h) p
proof:
:= by
  letI := faceFintype xs h
  calc
    outputDiagram xs p = evaluatePivotTemplate (ZMod 2)
        (compatibleOrder xs h) (gradeFilter xs h)
        (compatibleOrder xs h).monotone p := by
      apply Diagram.ext
      rw [outputDiagram_points, pairValuesAtDegree_semantic xs h p,
        essentialBirthsAtDegree_semantic xs h p]
      rfl
    _ = dgm (ZMod 2) (gradeFilter xs h) p :=
      evaluatePivotTemplate_eq_dgm (ZMod 2) (compatibleOrder xs h)
        (gradeFilter xs h) (compatibleOrder xs h).monotone p

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.finite_birth_lt_death
statement:
theorem finite_birth_lt_death (xs : Input) (h : Valid xs)
    (o : Occurrence) (ho : o ∈ occurrences xs) (d : ℤ)
    (hd : o.death = .finite d) : o.birth < d
proof:
:= by
  rcases List.mem_append.mp ho with ho | ho
  · unfold finiteOccurrences at ho
    obtain ⟨⟨i, j⟩, hpair, hp⟩ := List.mem_filterMap.mp ho
    have hpiv : columnPivot ((reduced xs).col j) = some i :=
      (pivotPairs_mem xs i j).mp hpair
    have hstrict : StrictBoundary (reduced xs) :=
      (matrixReductionTrace_normalForm_input (degree xs) (boundary xs)
        (boundary_sq_zero xs h) (boundary_strict xs h)
        (boundary_lowersDegree xs h)).2.2.2.1
    have hentry : reduced xs i j ≠ 0 := by
      simpa only [Matrix.col_apply] using
        ((columnPivot_some_iff ((reduced xs).col j) i).mp hpiv).1
    have hij : i < j := hstrict i j hentry
    have hle : (xs.get i).2 ≤ (xs.get j).2 := h.2.2.2.2 i j hij.le
    simp [pairOccurrence] at hp
    obtain ⟨hne, hocc⟩ := hp
    subst o
    cases hd
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne
  · obtain ⟨i, _, hp⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ho
    cases hp
    cases hd

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.run_isSome_iff
statement: theorem run_isSome_iff (xs : Input) : (run xs).isSome = true ↔ Valid xs
proof:
:= by
  simp [run, validBool_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.run_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem run_eq_some_iff (xs : Input) (out : List Occurrence) :
    run xs = some out ↔ Valid xs ∧ out = occurrences xs
proof:
:= by
  cases hb : validBool xs with
  | false =>
      have hn : ¬ Valid xs := by
        intro h
        have ht := (validBool_iff xs).mpr h
        simp [hb] at ht
      simp [run, hb, hn]
  | true =>
      have hv : Valid xs := (validBool_iff xs).mp hb
      simp only [run, hb, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq, hv, true_and]
      exact eq_comm

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.run_eq_none_iff
statement: theorem run_eq_none_iff (xs : Input) : run xs = none ↔ ¬ Valid xs
proof:
:= by
  cases hb : validBool xs with
  | false =>
      have hn : ¬ Valid xs := by
        intro h
        have ht := (validBool_iff xs).mpr h
        simp [hb] at ht
      simp [run, hb, hn]
  | true =>
      have hv : Valid xs := (validBool_iff xs).mp hb
      simp [run, hb, hv]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.dgm_eq_of_heq
proof:
:= by
  cases hK
  cases hf
  have he : iK = iL := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  cases he
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.FiniteInput.outputDiagram_eq_of_same_graded_complex
statement:
theorem outputDiagram_eq_of_same_graded_complex (xs ys : Input)
    (hx : Valid xs) (hy : Valid ys)
    (hK : complex xs hx = complex ys hy)
    (hf : HEq (gradeFilter xs hx) (gradeFilter ys hy)) (p : ℕ) :
    outputDiagram xs p = outputDiagram ys p
proof:
:= by
  have hleft := outputDiagram_eq_dgm xs hx p
  have hright := outputDiagram_eq_dgm ys hy p
  rw [hleft, hright]
  exact dgm_eq_of_heq (faceFintype xs hx) (faceFintype ys hy)
    hK (gradeFilter xs hx) (gradeFilter ys hy) hf p

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnPivot_none_iff
statement:
theorem columnPivot_none_iff [DecidableEq k] (c : Fin m → k) :
    columnPivot c = none ↔ ∀ r, c r = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let nz : Finset (Fin m) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter (fun i => c i ≠ 0)
  change (if h : nz.Nonempty then some (nz.max' h) else none) = none ↔
    ∀ r, c r = 0
  constructor
  · intro h r
    by_contra hr
    have hmem : r ∈ nz := by
      simp [nz, hr]
    have hne : nz.Nonempty := ⟨r, hmem⟩
    simp [hne] at h
  · intro hc
    by_cases hne : nz.Nonempty
    · obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hne
      have hnonzero : c r ≠ 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2
      exact (hnonzero (hc r)).elim
    · simp [hne]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnPivot_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem columnPivot_zero [DecidableEq k] :
    columnPivot (0 : Fin m → k) = none
proof:
:= by
  apply (columnPivot_none_iff (0 : Fin m → k)).2
  intro r
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnPivot_some_iff
statement:
theorem columnPivot_some_iff [DecidableEq k] (c : Fin m → k) (p : Fin m) :
    columnPivot c = some p ↔ c p ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ r, p < r → c r = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let nz : Finset (Fin m) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin m)).filter (fun i => c i ≠ 0)
  change (if h : nz.Nonempty then some (nz.max' h) else none) = some p ↔
    c p ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ r, p < r → c r = 0
  by_cases hne : nz.Nonempty
  · rw [dif_pos hne]
    simp only [Option.some.injEq]
    constructor
    · intro hp
      change nz.max' hne = p at hp
      rw [← hp]
      have hmem : nz.max' hne ∈ nz := Finset.max'_mem nz hne
      refine ⟨(Finset.mem_filter.mp hmem).2, ?_⟩
      intro r hpr
      by_contra hnonzero
      have hr : r ∈ nz := by simp [nz, hnonzero]
      have hrle : r ≤ nz.max' hne := Finset.le_max' nz r hr
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hrle) hpr
    · rintro ⟨hp, hpAbove⟩
      have hpMem : p ∈ nz := by simp [nz, hp]
      have hmax : nz.max' hne = p := by
        apply (Finset.max'_eq_iff nz hne p).2
        refine ⟨hpMem, ?_⟩
        intro r hr
        have hrNonzero : c r ≠ 0 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2
        by_contra hpr
        exact hrNonzero (hpAbove r (lt_of_not_ge hpr))
      simp [hmax]
  · simp only [dif_neg hne]
    constructor
    · intro h
      cases h
    · rintro ⟨hp, _⟩
      have hfalse : False := hne ⟨p, by simp [nz, hp]⟩
      exact hfalse.elim

statement:

proof: := rfl

  cases q <;> simp [pivotHeight]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.cancelColumn_apply_pivot
statement:
theorem cancelColumn_apply_pivot [DecidableEq k] (a b : Fin m → k) (p : Fin m)
    (ha : columnPivot a = some p) : cancelColumn a b p p = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hden : a p ≠ 0 := (columnPivot_some_iff a p).mp ha |>.1
  change b p - (b p / a p) * a p = 0
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ (b p) hden]
  exact sub_self _

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.cancelColumn_apply_above
statement:
theorem cancelColumn_apply_above [DecidableEq k] (a b : Fin m → k) (p r : Fin m)
    (ha : columnPivot a = some p) (hb : columnPivot b = some p) (hpr : p < r) :
    cancelColumn a b p r = 0
proof:
:= by
  have haAbove := (columnPivot_some_iff a p).mp ha |>.2 r hpr
  have hbAbove := (columnPivot_some_iff b p).mp hb |>.2 r hpr
  simp [cancelColumn, haAbove, hbAbove]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotHeight_cancelColumn_lt
statement:
theorem pivotHeight_cancelColumn_lt [DecidableEq k] (a b : Fin m → k) (p : Fin m)
    (ha : columnPivot a = some p) (hb : columnPivot b = some p) :
    pivotHeight (columnPivot (cancelColumn a b p)) < pivotHeight (some p)
proof:
:= by
  have hnew : columnPivot (cancelColumn a b p) = none ∨
      ∃ q, columnPivot (cancelColumn a b p) = some q ∧ q < p := by
    by_cases hnone : columnPivot (cancelColumn a b p) = none
    · exact Or.inl hnone
    · cases hq : columnPivot (cancelColumn a b p) with
      | none => exact (hnone hq).elim
      | some q =>
        right
        refine ⟨q, rfl, ?_⟩
        have hqNonzero : cancelColumn a b p q ≠ 0 :=
          (columnPivot_some_iff (cancelColumn a b p) q).mp hq |>.1
        by_contra hpq
        have hpq' : p ≤ q := le_of_not_gt hpq
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hpq' with hpq'' | hpq''
        · exact hqNonzero (cancelColumn_apply_above a b p q ha hb hpq'')
        · subst q
          exact hqNonzero (cancelColumn_apply_pivot a b p ha)
  rcases hnew with hnone | ⟨q, hq, hqp⟩
  · rw [hnone, pivotHeight]
    exact Nat.succ_pos _
  · rw [hq]
    change q.val + 1 < p.val + 1
    have hval : q.val < p.val := Fin.lt_def.mp hqp
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.col_mul_transvection
statement:
theorem col_mul_transvection (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (i j : Fin m) (c : k) :
    (M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col j = M.col j + c • M.col i
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  simp [smul_eq_mul]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.col_mul_transvection_of_ne
statement:
theorem col_mul_transvection_of_ne (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (i j q : Fin m) (c : k) (hq : q ≠ j) :
    (M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col q = M.col q
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  simp [hq]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotHeight_mul_transvection_lt
statement:
theorem pivotHeight_mul_transvection_lt [DecidableEq k]
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (i j p : Fin m) (hij : i < j)
    (hi : columnPivot (M.col i) = some p) (hj : columnPivot (M.col j) = some p) :
    pivotHeight (columnPivot
      ((M * Matrix.transvection i j (-(M p j / M p i))).col j)) <
        pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j))
proof:
:= by
  let c : k := -(M p j / M p i)
  have hijne : i ≠ j := ne_of_lt hij
  have hsource : (M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col i = M.col i :=
    col_mul_transvection_of_ne M i j i c hijne
  have htarget : (M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col j =
      cancelColumn (M.col i) (M.col j) p := by
    calc
      (M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col j = M.col j + c • M.col i :=
        col_mul_transvection M i j c
      _ = cancelColumn (M.col i) (M.col j) p := by
        ext r
        simp [cancelColumn, c, smul_eq_mul]
        ring
  have htarget' : (M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col j =
      cancelColumn ((M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col i) (M.col j) p := by
    calc
      (M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col j = cancelColumn (M.col i) (M.col j) p :=
        htarget
      _ = cancelColumn ((M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col i) (M.col j) p := by
        rw [hsource]
  have hsourcePivot : columnPivot ((M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col i) = some p := by
    rw [hsource]
    exact hi
  change pivotHeight (columnPivot ((M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col j)) <
    pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j))
  rw [htarget', hj]
  exact pivotHeight_cancelColumn_lt _ _ p hsourcePivot hj

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceMatrixHomologyMap_mkQ
statement:
theorem faceMatrixHomologyMap_mkQ (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (x : originalCycleSpace (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e) p s)
    (y : originalCycleSpace (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e) p t)
    (hxy : x.1 = y.1) :
    faceMatrixHomologyMap k e p s t
      (Submodule.mkQ (R := k)
        (M := originalCycleSpace (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e) p s)
        (faceMatrixBoundarySubmodule k e p s) x) =
    Submodule.mkQ (R := k)
      (M := originalCycleSpace (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e) p t)
      (faceMatrixBoundarySubmodule k e p t) y
proof:
:= by
  let h := faceReduction_normalForm k e
  let E := originalHomologyEquivAlive (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
    (reducedFaceBoundary k e) (faceReductionChange k e) (faceReductionChangeInv k e)
    (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e) h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p t
  apply E.injective
  change (originalHomologyEquivAlive (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
    (reducedFaceBoundary k e) (faceReductionChange k e) (faceReductionChangeInv k e)
    (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e) h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p t)
    ((originalHomologyMap (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
      (reducedFaceBoundary k e) (faceReductionChange k e) (faceReductionChangeInv k e)
      (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e) h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p s t)
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk x)) =
    (originalHomologyEquivAlive (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
      (reducedFaceBoundary k e) (faceReductionChange k e) (faceReductionChangeInv k e)
      (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e) h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p t)
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk y)
  rw [originalHomologyMap_mk (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
    (reducedFaceBoundary k e) (faceReductionChange k e) (faceReductionChangeInv k e)
    (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e) h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p s t hst x]
  change _ = (originalLiveMap (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
    (reducedFaceBoundary k e) (faceReductionChange k e) (faceReductionChangeInv k e)
    (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e) h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p t) y
  apply Subtype.ext
  change aliveRepresentative (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e) p t
      (((normalMatrix (reducedFaceBoundary k e) (faceReductionChange k e))⁻¹).mulVec x.1) =
    aliveRepresentative (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e) p t
      (((normalMatrix (reducedFaceBoundary k e) (faceReductionChange k e))⁻¹).mulVec y.1)
  rw [hxy]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology_naturality
statement:
theorem prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology_naturality (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    (faceMatrixHomologyMap k e p s t).comp
      (prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology k e s p).toLinearMap =
    (prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology k e t p).toLinearMap.comp
      (simplicialQuotientIncl k (e.prefixComplex_mono hst) p)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  induction x using Quotient.inductionOn' with
  | _ z =>
    change faceMatrixHomologyMap k e p s t
      (prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology k e s p
        (Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles (e.prefixComplex s) k p)
          (simplicialBoundaries (e.prefixComplex s) k p) z)) =
      prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology k e t p
        (simplicialQuotientIncl k (e.prefixComplex_mono hst) p
          (Submodule.mkQ (R := k) (M := simplicialCycles (e.prefixComplex s) k p)
            (simplicialBoundaries (e.prefixComplex s) k p) z))
    rw [prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology_mkQ, simplicialQuotientIncl_mkQ,
      prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology_mkQ]
    exact faceMatrixHomologyMap_mkQ k e p s t hst _ _
      (prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv_inclusion k e s t p hst z).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixHomologyEquivMatrixHomology_naturality
statement:
theorem prefixHomologyEquivMatrixHomology_naturality (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    (faceMatrixHomologyMap k e p s t).comp
      (prefixHomologyEquivMatrixHomology k e s p).toLinearMap =
    (prefixHomologyEquivMatrixHomology k e t p).toLinearMap.comp
      (simplicialHomologyIncl k (e.prefixComplex_mono hst) p).hom
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  let qS := homologyKernelQuotient.{u,u,u} k (simplicialChainComplex (e.prefixComplex s) k) p
  let qT := homologyKernelQuotient.{u,u,u} k (simplicialChainComplex (e.prefixComplex t) k) p
  have hq := congrArg (fun F => F.hom x)
    (simplicialHomologyIncl_quotient_naturality k (e.prefixComplex_mono hst) p)
  have he := congrArg (fun F => F (qS.toLinearEquiv x))
    (prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology_naturality k e p s t hst)
  change faceMatrixHomologyMap k e p s t
      (prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology k e s p (qS.toLinearEquiv x)) =
    prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology k e t p
      (qT.toLinearEquiv ((simplicialHomologyIncl k (e.prefixComplex_mono hst) p).hom x))
  calc
    _ = prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology k e t p
      (simplicialQuotientIncl k (e.prefixComplex_mono hst) p (qS.toLinearEquiv x)) := he
    _ = _ := by
      congr 1
      exact hq.symm

statement:
private theorem filterMap_none_zero {A B : Type*} (s : Multiset A) :
    s.filterMap (fun _ => (none : Option B)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | @cons a s ih => simp [Multiset.filterMap_cons, ih]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.finiteIndexPair_paired
statement:
theorem finiteIndexPair_paired (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hstrict : StrictBoundary R) (j i : Fin m)
    (hji : columnPivot (R.col j) = some i) :
    finiteIndexPair (pairedInterval R hstrict j i hji) = some (i, j)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < i.val + 1 := by omega
  have hd : j.val + 1 ≤ m := by omega
  simp [finiteIndexPair, pairedInterval, hb, hd]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.finiteIndexPair_essential
statement:
theorem finiteIndexPair_essential (i : Fin m) :
    finiteIndexPair (essentialInterval i) = none
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < i.val + 1 := by omega
  have hd : ¬m + 1 ≤ m := by omega
  simp [finiteIndexPair, essentialInterval, hb, hd]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.essentialIndex_paired
statement:
theorem essentialIndex_paired (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hstrict : StrictBoundary R) (j i : Fin m)
    (hji : columnPivot (R.col j) = some i) :
    essentialIndex (pairedInterval R hstrict j i hji) = none
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < i.val + 1 := by omega
  have hd : j.val + 1 ≤ m := by omega
  simp [essentialIndex, pairedInterval, hb, hd]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.essentialIndex_essential
statement:
theorem essentialIndex_essential (i : Fin m) :
    essentialIndex (essentialInterval i) = some i
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < i.val + 1 := by omega
  have hd : ¬m + 1 ≤ m := by omega
  simp [essentialIndex, essentialInterval, hb, hd]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotBarcode_pairs
statement:
theorem pivotBarcode_pairs (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hstrict : StrictBoundary R) (p : ℕ) :
    (pivotBarcode degree R hstrict p).filterMap finiteIndexPair =
      pivotIndexPairs degree R p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold pivotBarcode pivotPairIntervals pivotEssentialIntervals pivotIndexPairs
  rw [Multiset.filterMap_add, Multiset.filterMap_map, Multiset.filterMap_map]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, finiteIndexPair_paired, finiteIndexPair_essential,
    filterMap_some_map, filterMap_none_zero, add_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotBarcode_essential
statement:
theorem pivotBarcode_essential (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hstrict : StrictBoundary R) (p : ℕ) :
    (pivotBarcode degree R hstrict p).filterMap essentialIndex =
      pivotEssentialIndices degree R p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold pivotBarcode pivotPairIntervals pivotEssentialIntervals pivotEssentialIndices
  rw [Multiset.filterMap_add, Multiset.filterMap_map, Multiset.filterMap_map]
  simp only [Function.comp_def, essentialIndex_paired, essentialIndex_essential,
    filterMap_some_map, filterMap_none_zero, zero_add]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotPairIntervals_count
statement:
theorem pivotPairIntervals_count (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hstrict : StrictBoundary R)
    (p s t : ℕ) :
    (pivotPairIntervals degree R hstrict p).countP
      (fun I => I.birth ≤ s ∧ t < I.death) =
      (pairSurvivorFinset degree R p s t).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold pivotPairIntervals
  rw [Multiset.countP_map]
  rw [← Finset.filter_val]
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun x _ => x.1)
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨hi, hdegree⟩ := x.2
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hx
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hi, hdegree, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [pairedInterval] at hx
      omega
    · simp only [pairedInterval] at hx
      omega
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    exact Subtype.ext hxy
  · intro i hi
    obtain ⟨hpiv, hdegree, hbirth, hdeath⟩ :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    let x : {i : Fin m // IsPivot R i ∧ degree i = p} := ⟨i, hpiv, hdegree⟩
    refine ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    change i.val + 1 ≤ s ∧ t < (deathOfPivot R i hpiv).val + 1
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotEssentialIntervals_count
statement:
theorem pivotEssentialIntervals_count (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p s t : ℕ) (_hst : s ≤ t)
    (ht : t ≤ m) :
    (pivotEssentialIntervals degree R p).countP
      (fun I => I.birth ≤ s ∧ t < I.death) =
      (essentialSurvivorFinset degree R p s).card
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold pivotEssentialIntervals
  rw [Multiset.countP_map]
  rw [← Finset.filter_val]
  apply Finset.card_bij (fun x _ => x.1)
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨he, hdegree⟩ := x.2
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hx
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, he, hdegree, ?_⟩
    simp only [essentialInterval] at hx
    omega
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    exact Subtype.ext hxy
  · intro i hi
    obtain ⟨he, hdegree, hbirth⟩ :=
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hi).2
    let x : {i : Fin m // IsEssential R i ∧ degree i = p} := ⟨i, he, hdegree⟩
    refine ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩
    apply Finset.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [essentialInterval, x]
    omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotBarcode_rank
statement:
theorem pivotBarcode_rank (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hstrict : StrictBoundary R)
    (hpiv : DistinctPivots R) (p s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (ht : t ≤ m) :
    (pivotBarcode degree R hstrict p).countP
      (fun I => I.birth ≤ s ∧ t < I.death) =
      (deathSurvivorFinset degree R p s t).card +
        (essentialSurvivorFinset degree R p s).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [pivotBarcode, Multiset.countP_add,
    pivotPairIntervals_count, pivotEssentialIntervals_count degree R p s t hst ht,
    pair_survivor_card_eq_death_card degree R hpiv p s t]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotIndexPairs_nodup
statement:
theorem pivotIndexPairs_nodup (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p : ℕ) :
    (pivotIndexPairs degree R p).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold pivotIndexPairs
  apply Multiset.Nodup.map _ (Finset.univ.nodup)
  intro x y h
  exact Subtype.ext (congrArg Prod.fst h)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.mem_pivotIndexPairs_iff
statement:
theorem mem_pivotIndexPairs_iff (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hpiv : DistinctPivots R)
    (p : ℕ) (i j : Fin m) :
    (i,j) ∈ pivotIndexPairs degree R p ↔
      degree i = p ∧ columnPivot (R.col j) = some i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold pivotIndexPairs
  simp only [Multiset.mem_map, Finset.mem_val, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, h⟩
    have hi : x.val = i := congrArg Prod.fst h
    have hj : deathOfPivot R x.val x.property.1 = j := congrArg Prod.snd h
    exact ⟨hi ▸ x.property.2, by rw [← hi, ← hj]; exact deathOfPivot_spec R _ _⟩
  · rintro ⟨hd,hj⟩
    let x : {i : Fin m // IsPivot R i ∧ degree i = p} := ⟨i, ⟨j,hj⟩,hd⟩
    exact ⟨x, Prod.ext rfl (deathOfPivot_unique R hpiv i j x.property.1 hj)⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotEssentialIndices_nodup
statement:
theorem pivotEssentialIndices_nodup (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p : ℕ) :
    (pivotEssentialIndices degree R p).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold pivotEssentialIndices
  exact Multiset.Nodup.map Subtype.val_injective (Finset.univ.nodup)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.mem_pivotEssentialIndices_iff
statement:
theorem mem_pivotEssentialIndices_iff (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (p : ℕ) (i : Fin m) :
    i ∈ pivotEssentialIndices degree R p ↔ IsEssential R i ∧ degree i = p
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp [pivotEssentialIndices]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.pivotBarcode_endpoints
statement:
theorem pivotBarcode_endpoints (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (R : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hs : StrictBoundary R) (p : ℕ) :
    (pivotBarcode degree R hs p).map (fun I => (I.birth, I.death)) =
      (pivotIndexPairs degree R p).map (fun q => (q.1.val+1,q.2.val+1)) +
      (pivotEssentialIndices degree R p).map (fun i => (i.val+1,m+1))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pivotBarcode, Multiset.map_add, pivotPairIntervals, pivotEssentialIntervals,
    pivotIndexPairs, pivotEssentialIndices, Multiset.map_map]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.Examples.HollowTriangle.s01
statement: private theorem s01 : ({0,1} : Finset (Fin 3)).sort (· ≤ ·) = [0,1]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.Examples.HollowTriangle.faceBoundaryMatrix_eq_expected
statement: theorem faceBoundaryMatrix_eq_expected : faceBoundaryMatrix (ZMod 2) e = expected
proof:
:= by
  funext i j
  rw [faceBoundaryMatrix_apply]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    norm_num [faceDegree, e, enumFun, expected, indexedFace, deletedFace,
      show (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide, show (1 : Fin 3) ≠ 2 by decide,
      Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_three, Finset.orderEmbOfFin_apply, s01, s12, s02, s012]

  all_goals decide +kernel

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.Examples.HollowTriangle.hollow_pivots
statement:
theorem hollow_pivots :

      columnPivot ((reducedFaceBoundary (ZMod 2) e).col j)) =

theorem hollow_essential (i : Fin (faceCount C.toPre)) :

theorem face_grades :
