name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChangeInv_nil
statement:
theorem traceChangeInv_nil :
    traceChangeInv ([] : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChangeInv_cons
statement:
theorem traceChangeInv_cons (op : EarlierColumnOp m k)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    traceChangeInv (op :: ops) = traceChangeInv ops * op.1.inv.toMatrix
proof:
:= by
  simp [traceChangeInv, inverseTrace, inverseEarlierColumnOp, traceChange]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChangeInv_append
statement:
theorem traceChangeInv_append (xs ys : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    traceChangeInv (xs ++ ys) = traceChangeInv ys * traceChangeInv xs
proof:
:= by
  simp [traceChangeInv, inverseTrace, List.reverse_append, List.map_append,
    traceChange_append]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_mul_traceChangeInv
statement:
theorem traceChange_mul_traceChangeInv (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    traceChange ops * traceChangeInv ops = 1
proof:
:= by
  let L := ops.map Subtype.val
  have h := Matrix.TransvectionStruct.prod_mul_reverse_inv_prod L
  simpa [traceChange, traceChangeInv, inverseTrace, inverseEarlierColumnOp,
    L, List.map_reverse, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChangeInv_mul_traceChange
statement:
theorem traceChangeInv_mul_traceChange (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    traceChangeInv ops * traceChange ops = 1
proof:
:= by
  let L := ops.map Subtype.val
  have h := Matrix.TransvectionStruct.reverse_inv_prod_mul_prod L
  simpa [traceChange, traceChangeInv, inverseTrace, inverseEarlierColumnOp,
    L, List.map_reverse, List.map_map, Function.comp_def] using h

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.single_upper
statement:
private theorem single_upper (op : EarlierColumnOp m k) :
    op.1.toMatrix.IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [Matrix.TransvectionStruct.toMatrix] using
    (Matrix.blockTriangular_transvection (b := id) (le_of_lt op.2) op.1.c)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_isUpperTriangular
statement:
theorem traceChange_isUpperTriangular (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    (traceChange ops).IsUpperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  induction ops with
  | nil => simpa only [traceChange_nil] using (Matrix.blockTriangular_one (b := id) (R := k))
  | cons op ops ih =>
      rw [traceChange_cons]
      exact (single_upper op).mul ih

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_apply_diag
statement:
theorem traceChange_apply_diag (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (i : Fin m) :
    traceChange ops i i = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction ops with
  | nil => simp [traceChange_nil]
  | cons op ops ih =>
      rw [traceChange_cons, Matrix.TransvectionStruct.toMatrix]
      by_cases h : i = op.1.i
      · subst i
        rw [Matrix.transvection_mul_apply_same]
        have hz : traceChange ops op.1.j op.1.i = 0 :=
          traceChange_isUpperTriangular ops op.2
        simp [ih, hz]
      · rw [Matrix.transvection_mul_apply_of_ne (ha := h)]
        exact ih

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceRespectsDegree_inverseTrace
statement:
theorem traceRespectsDegree_inverseTrace (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (hops : TraceRespectsDegree degree ops) :
    TraceRespectsDegree degree (inverseTrace ops)
proof:
:= by
  intro op hop
  rcases List.mem_map.mp hop with ⟨old, hold, rfl⟩
  have hmem : old ∈ ops := List.mem_reverse.mp hold
  simpa [inverseEarlierColumnOp] using hops old hmem

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.single_degree_support
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Matrix.TransvectionStruct.toMatrix, Matrix.transvection, Matrix.add_apply]
  rw [Matrix.single_apply]
  by_cases h : r = c
  · exact (hrc (congrArg degree h)).elim
  · simp only [Matrix.one_apply, if_neg h, zero_add]
    split
    · next heq =>
        rcases heq with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        exact (hrc hdegree).elim
    · rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.degree_support_mul
statement:
private theorem degree_support_mul (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (A B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hA : ∀ i j, degree i ≠ degree j → A i j = 0)
    (hB : ∀ i j, degree i ≠ degree j → B i j = 0)
    (r c : Fin m) (hrc : degree r ≠ degree c) : (A * B) r c = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro q _
  by_cases hrq : degree r = degree q
  · have hqc : degree q ≠ degree c := by
      intro h
      exact hrc (hrq.trans h)
    simp [hB q c hqc]
  · simp [hA r q hrq]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_apply_of_degree_ne
statement:
theorem traceChange_apply_of_degree_ne (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (hops : TraceRespectsDegree degree ops)
    (i j : Fin m) (hij : degree i ≠ degree j) :
    traceChange ops i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction ops generalizing i j with
  | nil =>
      rw [traceChange_nil]
      have h : i ≠ j := by intro heq; exact hij (congrArg degree heq)
      simp [h]
  | cons op ops ih =>
      rw [traceChange_cons]
      apply degree_support_mul degree op.1.toMatrix (traceChange ops)
      · exact single_degree_support degree op (hops op (by simp))
      · intro r c h
        exact ih (by intro x hx; exact hops x (by simp [hx])) r c h
      · exact hij

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_certificate
statement:
theorem traceChange_certificate (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (hops : TraceRespectsDegree degree ops) :
    TraceChangeCertificate degree (traceChange ops) (traceChangeInv ops)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨traceChange_mul_traceChangeInv ops, traceChangeInv_mul_traceChange ops,
    traceChange_isUpperTriangular ops, traceChange_apply_diag ops, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact traceChange_isUpperTriangular (inverseTrace ops)
  · exact traceChange_apply_diag (inverseTrace ops)
  · exact traceChange_apply_of_degree_ne degree ops hops
  · exact traceChange_apply_of_degree_ne degree (inverseTrace ops)
      (traceRespectsDegree_inverseTrace degree ops hops)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.replay_inverseTrace
statement:
theorem replay_inverseTrace (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    replay (replay M ops) (inverseTrace ops) = M
proof:
:= by
  rw [replay_eq_mul_traceChange, replay_eq_mul_traceChange, Matrix.mul_assoc]
  rw [← traceChangeInv, traceChange_mul_traceChangeInv, mul_one]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.lowersDegree_mul_degree_support
statement:
private theorem lowersDegree_mul_degree_support (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (M V : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hM : LowersDegree degree M)
    (hV : ∀ i j, degree i ≠ degree j → V i j = 0) :
    LowersDegree degree (M * V)
proof:
:= by
  intro r c hn
  by_contra hdegree
  have hz : (M * V) r c = 0 := by
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro q _
    by_cases hMq : M r q = 0
    · simp [hMq]
    · have hqc : degree q ≠ degree c := by
        intro h
        exact hdegree (h.symm.trans (hM r q hMq))
      simp [hV q c hqc]
  exact hn hz

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.replay_lowersDegree
statement:
theorem replay_lowersDegree (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k))
    (hM : LowersDegree degree M) (hops : TraceRespectsDegree degree ops) :
    LowersDegree degree (replay M ops)
proof:
:= by
  rw [replay_eq_mul_traceChange]
  exact lowersDegree_mul_degree_support degree M (traceChange ops) hM
    (traceChange_apply_of_degree_ne degree ops hops)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.degree_eq_of_common_pivot
statement:
theorem degree_eq_of_common_pivot [DecidableEq k] (degree : Fin m → ℕ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hM : LowersDegree degree M)
    (i j p : Fin m) (hi : columnPivot (M.col i) = some p)
    (hj : columnPivot (M.col j) = some p) : degree i = degree j
proof:
:= by
  have hi' : M p i ≠ 0 := (columnPivot_some_iff (M.col i) p).mp hi |>.1
  have hj' : M p j ≠ 0 := (columnPivot_some_iff (M.col j) p).mp hj |>.1
  exact (hM p i hi').trans (hM p j hj').symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.col_mem_prefixSpan
statement:
theorem col_mem_prefixSpan (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (t : ℕ) (q : Fin m) (hq : q.val < t) :
    M.col q ∈ prefixSpan M t
proof:
:= by
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_zero
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_zero (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) :
    prefixSpan M 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Set.range (fun q : {q : Fin m // q.val < 0} => M.col q.1)) = ∅ := by
    ext v
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q, _⟩
      exact (Nat.not_lt_zero _ q.2).elim
    · simp
  simp [prefixSpan, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_mono
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_mono (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    prefixSpan M s ≤ prefixSpan M t
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.span_mono
  rintro x ⟨q, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨⟨q.1, lt_of_lt_of_le q.2 hst⟩, rfl⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_eq_full
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_eq_full (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : m ≤ t) :
    prefixSpan M t = Submodule.span k (Set.range M.col)
proof:
:= by
  have hrange :
      Set.range (fun q : {q : Fin m // q.val < t} => M.col q.1) = Set.range M.col := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨q.1, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨q, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨q, lt_of_lt_of_le q.isLt ht⟩, rfl⟩
  simp [prefixSpan, hrange]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_range_update_add_smul
statement:
private theorem prefixSpan_range_update_add_smul (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (i j : Fin m) (c : k) (hij : i < j) (t : ℕ) (hj : j.val < t) :
    let ii : {q : Fin m // q.val < t} := ⟨i, lt_trans hij hj⟩
    let jj : {q : Fin m // q.val < t} := ⟨j, hj⟩
    let v : {q : Fin m // q.val < t} → (Fin m → k) := fun q => M.col q.1
    Submodule.span k (Set.range (Function.update v jj (v jj + c • v ii))) =
      prefixSpan M t
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let ii : {q : Fin m // q.val < t} := ⟨i, lt_trans hij hj⟩
  let jj : {q : Fin m // q.val < t} := ⟨j, hj⟩
  have hne : ii ≠ jj := by
    intro h
    exact (ne_of_lt hij) (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  simpa only [ii, jj, prefixSpan] using
    (Submodule.span_range_update_add_smul hne
      (fun q : {q : Fin m // q.val < t} => M.col q.1) c)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_mul_transvection
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_mul_transvection (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (i j : Fin m) (c : k) (hij : i < j) (t : ℕ) :
    prefixSpan (M * Matrix.transvection i j c) t = prefixSpan M t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hj : j.val < t
  · let ii : {q : Fin m // q.val < t} := ⟨i, lt_trans hij hj⟩
    let jj : {q : Fin m // q.val < t} := ⟨j, hj⟩
    let v : {q : Fin m // q.val < t} → (Fin m → k) := fun q => M.col q.1
    have hfun :
        (fun q : {q : Fin m // q.val < t} =>
          (M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col q.1) =
        Function.update v jj (v jj + c • v ii) := by
      funext q
      by_cases hq : q.1 = j
      · have hq' : q = jj := Subtype.ext hq
        subst q
        simp only [Function.update_self]
        exact col_mul_transvection M i j c
      · have hq' : q ≠ jj := by
          intro h
          exact hq (congrArg Subtype.val h)
        rw [col_mul_transvection_of_ne M i j q.1 c hq]
        simp [Function.update_of_ne hq']
        rfl
    unfold prefixSpan
    rw [hfun]
    exact prefixSpan_range_update_add_smul M i j c hij t hj
  · have hfun :
        (fun q : {q : Fin m // q.val < t} =>
          (M * Matrix.transvection i j c).col q.1) =
        (fun q => M.col q.1) := by
      funext q
      apply col_mul_transvection_of_ne
      intro hq
      exact hj (by simpa [hq] using q.2)
    unfold prefixSpan
    rw [hfun]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_cancel
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_cancel (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (i j p : Fin m) (hij : i < j) (t : ℕ) :
    prefixSpan (M * Matrix.transvection i j (-(M p j / M p i))) t =
      prefixSpan M t
proof:
:= by
  exact prefixSpan_mul_transvection M i j (-(M p j / M p i)) hij t

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.empty_homology_map_rank
statement:
private theorem empty_homology_map_rank (degree : Fin 0 → ℕ) (p : ℕ) :
    let ops := matrixReductionTrace emptyBoundary
    let R := replay emptyBoundary ops
    let V := traceChange ops
    let W := traceChangeInv ops
    let h := matrixReductionTrace_normalForm_input degree emptyBoundary empty_square
      empty_strict (empty_degree degree)
    Module.finrank ℚ (LinearMap.range
      (originalHomologyMap degree emptyBoundary R V W empty_square h.1 h.2.1
        h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p 0 0)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  have h := matrixReductionTrace_normalForm_input degree emptyBoundary empty_square
    empty_strict (empty_degree degree)
  have hr := originalHomologyMap_rank_formula degree emptyBoundary _ _ _
    empty_square h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p 0 0 (le_refl 0) (le_refl 0)
  simpa [deathSurvivorFinset, essentialSurvivorFinset] using hr

    (pairedInterval (twoGenerator c) (by
      intro r j h
      fin_cases r <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [twoGenerator] at h ⊢)
      1 0 (twoGenerator_pivot c hc)).alive t ↔
      0 < t.val ∧ t.val ≤ 1

      Pi.single (0 : Fin 2) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hp : IsPivot (twoGenerator c) 0 := ⟨1, twoGenerator_pivot c hc⟩
  rw [normalColumn_pivot _ _ 0 hp]
  have hcol0 : columnPivot ((twoGenerator c).col (0 : Fin 2)) = none :=
    (columnPivot_none_iff _).2 (by intro r; simp [twoGenerator])
  have hj := deathOfPivot_unique (twoGenerator c) (by
    intro i j p hi hj
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp_all [hcol0])
    0 1 hp (twoGenerator_pivot c hc)
  rw [hj]
  ext r
  fin_cases r <;> simp [twoGenerator, Pi.single_apply, hc]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.interleaved_original_map_kills_pair
statement:
private theorem interleaved_original_map_kills_pair :
    let ops := matrixReductionTrace interleaved
    let R := replay interleaved ops
    let V := traceChange ops
    let W := traceChangeInv ops
    let h := matrixReductionTrace_normalForm_input interleavedDegree interleaved
      interleaved_square interleaved_strict interleaved_degree
    let E₂ := originalHomologyEquivAlive interleavedDegree interleaved R V W
      interleaved_square h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 0 2
    let E₃ := originalHomologyEquivAlive interleavedDegree interleaved R V W
      interleaved_square h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 0 3
    ∀ x : originalHomology interleavedDegree interleaved R V W interleaved_square
      h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 0 2,
      (E₂ x).1 = Pi.single (0 : Fin 4) (1 : ℚ) →
      originalHomologyMap interleavedDegree interleaved R V W interleaved_square
        h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 0 2 3 x = 0
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  intro x hx
  have hR : replay interleaved (matrixReductionTrace interleaved) = interleaved := by
    simp [interleaved_trace_nil, replay]
  let R := replay interleaved (matrixReductionTrace interleaved)
  let V := traceChange (matrixReductionTrace interleaved)
  let W := traceChangeInv (matrixReductionTrace interleaved)
  let h := matrixReductionTrace_normalForm_input interleavedDegree interleaved
    interleaved_square interleaved_strict interleaved_degree
  let E₂ := originalHomologyEquivAlive interleavedDegree interleaved R V W
    interleaved_square h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 0 2
  let E₃ := originalHomologyEquivAlive interleavedDegree interleaved R V W
    interleaved_square h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 0 3
  apply E₃.injective
  rw [originalHomologyMap_transport]
  rw [map_zero]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change aliveRepresentative interleavedDegree R 0 3
    ((originalHomologyEquivAlive interleavedDegree interleaved R V W
      interleaved_square h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 0 2) x).1 = 0
  rw [hx]
  dsimp only [R]
  rw [hR]
  exact interleaved_dies_at_death

proof:
:= by
  let R := replay squareNonzeroAfterReduction
    (matrixReductionTrace squareNonzeroAfterReduction)
  let V := traceChange (matrixReductionTrace squareNonzeroAfterReduction)
  have hji : columnPivot (R.col (3 : Fin 4)) = some (2 : Fin 4) := by
    decide +kernel
  have hp : IsPivot R (2 : Fin 4) := ⟨3, hji⟩
  have hpiv : DistinctPivots R := by
    intro i j p hi hj
    exact matrixReductionTrace_pivots_distinct squareNonzeroAfterReduction i j p hi hj
  have hdeath := deathOfPivot_unique R hpiv 2 3 hp hji
  dsimp only
  rw [normalColumn_pivot R V 2 hp, hdeath]
  change (R 2 3)⁻¹ * R 1 3 = -1
  decide +kernel

  have hq : q.1 = 0 := Fin.ext (by omega)
  simp [coordOne, reversedMatrix, hq]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.facePivotBarcode_rank
statement:
theorem facePivotBarcode_rank (e : CompatibleOrder f) (p : ℕ)
    (s t : Fin (faceCount K + 1)) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    structureMapRank (barcodeModule (k := k) (facePivotBarcode k e p))
        s t hst =
      (deathSurvivorFinset (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e)
        p s.val t.val).card +
      (essentialSurvivorFinset (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e)
        p s.val).card
proof:
:= by
  let h := faceReduction_normalForm k e
  rw [rank_barcodeMap]
  change (pivotBarcode (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e)
    h.2.2.2.1 p).countP
      (fun I => I.birth ≤ s.val ∧ t.val < I.death) = _
  exact pivotBarcode_rank (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e)
    h.2.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p s.val t.val hst (by omega)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.facePrefixHomology_rank
statement:
theorem facePrefixHomology_rank (e : CompatibleOrder f) (p : ℕ)
    (s t : Fin (faceCount K + 1)) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    structureMapRank (facePrefixModule k e p) s t hst =
      (deathSurvivorFinset (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e)
        p s.val t.val).card +
      (essentialSurvivorFinset (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e)
        p s.val).card
proof:
:= by
  let F := (simplicialHomologyIncl k (e.prefixComplex_mono hst) p).hom
  let G := faceMatrixHomologyMap k e p s.val t.val
  have hcomm := prefixHomologyEquivMatrixHomology_naturality k e p s.val t.val hst
  have hrange := rangeEquivOfSquare k
    (prefixHomologyEquivMatrixHomology k e s.val p)
    (prefixHomologyEquivMatrixHomology k e t.val p) F G hcomm.symm
  have hrank := hrange.finrank_eq
  change Module.finrank k (LinearMap.range F) = _
  rw [hrank]
  
  
  have hSquareZero := faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e
  rcases faceReduction_normalForm k e with
    ⟨hReducedEq, hChange, hLowersDegree, _, hDistinctPivots, _⟩
  exact originalHomologyMap_rank_formula (faceDegree e)
    (faceBoundaryMatrix k e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e)
    (faceReductionChange k e) (faceReductionChangeInv k e)
    hSquareZero hReducedEq hChange hLowersDegree
    hDistinctPivots p s.val t.val hst (by omega)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.facePivotBarcode_eq_facePrefixBarcode
statement:
theorem facePivotBarcode_eq_facePrefixBarcode
    (e : CompatibleOrder f) (p : ℕ) :
    facePivotBarcode k e p = facePrefixBarcode k e p
proof:
:= by
  have hcomparison :
      rankBarcode (barcodeModule (k := k) (facePivotBarcode k e p)) =
        rankBarcode (facePrefixModule k e p) := by
    apply (rankBarcode_eq_iff
      (barcodeModule (k := k) (facePivotBarcode k e p))
      (facePrefixModule k e p)).2
    intro s t hst
    rw [facePivotBarcode_rank k e p s t hst,
      facePrefixHomology_rank k e p s t hst]
  simpa only [rankBarcode_barcodeModule, facePrefixBarcode] using hcomparison

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.nonempty_facePrefixHomologyIsoPivotBarcode
statement:
theorem nonempty_facePrefixHomologyIsoPivotBarcode
    (e : CompatibleOrder f) (p : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (facePrefixModule k e p ≅ barcodeModule (k := k) (facePivotBarcode k e p))
proof:
:= by
  
  rw [facePivotBarcode_eq_facePrefixBarcode k e p]
  exact nonempty_rankBarcodeIso (facePrefixModule k e p)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.replay_nil
statement: theorem replay_nil (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) : replay M [] = M
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.replay_cons
statement:
theorem replay_cons (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (op : EarlierColumnOp m k) (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    replay M (op :: ops) = replay (M * op.1.toMatrix) ops
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_nil
statement: theorem traceChange_nil : traceChange ([] : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_cons
statement:
theorem traceChange_cons (op : EarlierColumnOp m k)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    traceChange (op :: ops) = op.1.toMatrix * traceChange ops
proof: := rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.replay_eq_mul_traceChange
statement:
theorem replay_eq_mul_traceChange (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    replay M ops = M * traceChange ops
proof:
:= by
  induction ops generalizing M with
  | nil => simp [replay, traceChange]
  | cons op ops ih =>
      rw [replay_cons, ih, traceChange_cons, Matrix.mul_assoc]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.replay_append
statement:
theorem replay_append (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (xs ys : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    replay M (xs ++ ys) = replay (replay M xs) ys
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing M with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons op xs ih =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, replay_cons]
      exact ih (M * op.1.toMatrix)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.traceChange_append
statement:
theorem traceChange_append (xs ys : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
    traceChange (xs ++ ys) = traceChange xs * traceChange ys
proof:
:= by
  have replay_one (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) :
      replay (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) ops = traceChange ops := by
    rw [replay_eq_mul_traceChange, one_mul]
  calc
    traceChange (xs ++ ys) = replay (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (xs ++ ys) :=
      (replay_one (xs ++ ys)).symm
    _ = replay (replay (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) xs) ys := replay_append _ _ _
    _ = replay (traceChange xs) ys := by rw [replay_one xs]
    _ = traceChange xs * traceChange ys := replay_eq_mul_traceChange _ _

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixSpan_replay
statement:
theorem prefixSpan_replay (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (ops : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (t : ℕ) :
    prefixSpan (replay M ops) t = prefixSpan M t
proof:
:= by
  induction ops generalizing M with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons op ops ih =>
      rw [replay_cons]
      calc
        prefixSpan (replay (M * op.1.toMatrix) ops) t =
            prefixSpan (M * op.1.toMatrix) t := ih _

          simpa only [Matrix.TransvectionStruct.toMatrix] using
            prefixSpan_mul_transvection M op.1.i op.1.j op.1.c op.2 t

:= by
  calc

      simp [repeatedTraceChange, repeatedOps]

    _ = Matrix.transvection 0 1 (-(3 / 2 : ℚ)) * Matrix.transvection 0 1 (1 / 2 : ℚ) := by
      simp [traceChange, repeatedA, repeatedB, orderedOp, Matrix.TransvectionStruct.toMatrix]
