    replay (0 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) ops = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    replay (0 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) ops =
        (0 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) * traceChange ops :=
      replay_eq_mul_traceChange _ _
    _ = 0 := zero_mul _

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.TraceExamples.zero_operation_replay
statement:
private theorem zero_operation_replay :
    replay repeatedInput [zeroOperation] = repeatedInput
proof:
:=
  zeroScalar_replay repeatedInput 0 1 (by decide)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.TraceExamples.zero_operation_target
statement:
private theorem zero_operation_target :
    (replay repeatedInput [zeroOperation]).col 1 = ![3, 0, 0]
proof:
:= by
  rw [zero_operation_replay]
  exact repeatedInput_col1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.mem_earlierPivotSources
statement:
private theorem mem_earlierPivotSources
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j p i : Fin m) :
    i ∈ earlierPivotSources M j p ↔ i < j ∧ columnPivot (M.col i) = some p
proof:
:= by
  simp [earlierPivotSources]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.nextColumnOp_some_spec
statement:
private theorem nextColumnOp_some_spec
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m) (op : EarlierColumnOp m k)
    (hop : nextColumnOp M j = some op) :
    op.1.j = j ∧ ∃ p : Fin m,
      columnPivot (M.col j) = some p ∧
      columnPivot (M.col op.1.i) = some p ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m, i < j → columnPivot (M.col i) = some p → op.1.i ≤ i) ∧
      op.1.c = -(M p j / M p op.1.i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold nextColumnOp at hop
  split at hop
  · simp at hop
  · rename_i p hp
    by_cases h : (earlierPivotSources M j p).Nonempty
    · simp only [dif_pos h, Option.some.injEq] at hop
      subst op
      refine ⟨rfl, p, hp, ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
      · exact (mem_earlierPivotSources M j p _).mp
          (Finset.min'_mem _ h) |>.2
      · intro i hij hi
        have himem : i ∈ earlierPivotSources M j p :=
          (mem_earlierPivotSources M j p i).mpr ⟨hij, hi⟩
        exact Finset.min'_le _ i himem
    · simp [h] at hop

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.nextColumnOp_none_iff
statement:
private theorem nextColumnOp_none_iff
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m) :
    nextColumnOp M j = none ↔
      ∀ i : Fin m, i < j → ∀ p : Fin m,
        columnPivot (M.col i) = some p → columnPivot (M.col j) ≠ some p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hn i hij p hi hj
    unfold nextColumnOp at hn
    rw [hj] at hn
    have hs : (earlierPivotSources M j p).Nonempty :=
      ⟨i, (mem_earlierPivotSources M j p i).mpr ⟨hij, hi⟩⟩
    simp [hs] at hn
  · intro h
    unfold nextColumnOp
    split
    · rfl
    · rename_i p hp
      have hs : ¬ (earlierPivotSources M j p).Nonempty := by
        rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        have hi' := (mem_earlierPivotSources M j p i).mp hi
        exact h i hi'.1 p hi'.2 hp
      simp [hs]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.nextColumnOp_height_lt
statement:
private theorem nextColumnOp_height_lt
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m) (op : EarlierColumnOp m k)
    (hop : nextColumnOp M j = some op) :
    pivotHeight (columnPivot ((M * op.1.toMatrix).col j)) <
      pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ht, p, hj, hi, _, hc⟩ := nextColumnOp_some_spec M j op hop
  have hij : op.1.i < j := ht ▸ op.2
  rw [Matrix.TransvectionStruct.toMatrix, ht, hc]
  exact pivotHeight_mul_transvection_lt M op.1.i j p hij hi hj

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.nextColumnOp_col_of_ne
statement:
private theorem nextColumnOp_col_of_ne
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j q : Fin m) (hq : q ≠ j)
    (op : EarlierColumnOp m k) (hop : nextColumnOp M j = some op) :
    (M * op.1.toMatrix).col q = M.col q
proof:
:= by
  have ht := (nextColumnOp_some_spec M j op hop).1
  rw [Matrix.TransvectionStruct.toMatrix, ht]
  exact col_mul_transvection_of_ne M op.1.i j q op.1.c hq

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.nextColumnOp_degree
statement:
private theorem nextColumnOp_degree
    (degree : Fin m → ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (j : Fin m) (hM : LowersDegree degree M)
    (op : EarlierColumnOp m k) (hop : nextColumnOp M j = some op) :
    degree op.1.i = degree op.1.j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ht, p, hj, hi, _, _⟩ := nextColumnOp_some_spec M j op hop
  rw [ht]
  exact degree_eq_of_common_pivot degree M hM op.1.i j p hi hj

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.nextColumnOp_lowersDegree
statement:
private theorem nextColumnOp_lowersDegree
    (degree : Fin m → ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (j : Fin m) (hM : LowersDegree degree M)
    (op : EarlierColumnOp m k) (hop : nextColumnOp M j = some op) :
    LowersDegree degree (M * op.1.toMatrix)
proof:
:= by
  have hd := nextColumnOp_degree degree M j hM op hop
  have hs : TraceRespectsDegree degree [op] := by
    intro x hx
    simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hx
    subst x
    exact hd
  simpa only [replay_cons, replay_nil] using replay_lowersDegree degree M [op] hM hs

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.budget_zero
statement:
private theorem budget_zero
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m)
    (h : pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j)) ≤ 0) :
    columnPivot (M.col j) = none
proof:
:=
  (pivotHeight_eq_zero_iff _).mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero h)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.budget_succ
statement:
private theorem budget_succ
    (newHeight oldHeight fuel : ℕ)
    (hstep : newHeight < oldHeight) (hbudget : oldHeight ≤ fuel + 1) :
    newHeight ≤ fuel
proof: := by omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTraceAux_target
statement:
private theorem columnReductionTraceAux_target
    (j : Fin m) (fuel : ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (op : EarlierColumnOp m k) (hop : op ∈ columnReductionTraceAux j fuel M) :
    op.1.j = j
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing M with
  | zero => simp [columnReductionTraceAux] at hop
  | succ fuel ih =>
      unfold columnReductionTraceAux at hop
      split at hop
      · simp at hop
      · rename_i head hhead
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hop with heq | htail
        · subst op
          exact (nextColumnOp_some_spec M j head hhead).1
        · exact ih _ htail

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTraceAux_col_of_ne
statement:
private theorem columnReductionTraceAux_col_of_ne
    (j q : Fin m) (hq : q ≠ j) (fuel : ℕ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) :
    (replay M (columnReductionTraceAux j fuel M)).col q = M.col q
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing M with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ fuel ih =>
      unfold columnReductionTraceAux
      split
      · rfl
      · rename_i op hop
        rw [replay_cons, ih]
        exact nextColumnOp_col_of_ne M j q hq op hop

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTraceAux_length_le
statement:
private theorem columnReductionTraceAux_length_le
    (j : Fin m) (fuel : ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) :
    (columnReductionTraceAux j fuel M).length ≤ fuel
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing M with
  | zero => simp [columnReductionTraceAux]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      unfold columnReductionTraceAux
      split
      · simp
      · rename_i op hop
        simpa only [List.length_cons, Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using
          Nat.add_le_add_right (ih (M * op.1.toMatrix)) 1

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTraceAux_terminal
statement:
private theorem columnReductionTraceAux_terminal
    (j : Fin m) (fuel : ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hbudget : pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j)) ≤ fuel) :
    ∀ i : Fin m, i < j → ∀ p : Fin m,
      columnPivot (M.col i) = some p →
        columnPivot ((replay M (columnReductionTraceAux j fuel M)).col j) ≠ some p
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing M with
  | zero =>
      have hz := budget_zero M j hbudget
      intro i hij p hi
      simp [columnReductionTraceAux, replay_nil, hz]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      intro i hij p hi
      have hne : i ≠ j := ne_of_lt hij
      unfold columnReductionTraceAux
      split
      · rename_i hnone
        rw [replay_nil]
        exact (nextColumnOp_none_iff M j).mp hnone i hij p hi
      · rename_i op hop
        rw [replay_cons]
        have hstep := nextColumnOp_height_lt M j op hop
        have hbudget' : pivotHeight
            (columnPivot ((M * op.1.toMatrix).col j)) ≤ fuel :=
          budget_succ _ _ _ hstep hbudget
        have hi' : columnPivot ((M * op.1.toMatrix).col i) = some p := by
          rw [nextColumnOp_col_of_ne M j i hne op hop]
          exact hi
        exact ih (M * op.1.toMatrix) hbudget' i hij p hi'

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTraceAux_respectsDegree
statement:
private theorem columnReductionTraceAux_respectsDegree
    (degree : Fin m → ℕ) (j : Fin m) (fuel : ℕ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (hM : LowersDegree degree M) :
    TraceRespectsDegree degree (columnReductionTraceAux j fuel M)
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing M with
  | zero => simp [columnReductionTraceAux, TraceRespectsDegree]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      unfold columnReductionTraceAux
      split
      · simp [TraceRespectsDegree]
      · rename_i op hop
        have hhead := nextColumnOp_degree degree M j hM op hop
        have hM' := nextColumnOp_lowersDegree degree M j hM op hop
        have htail := ih (M * op.1.toMatrix) hM'
        intro x hx
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
        · subst x; exact hhead
        · exact htail x h

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTraceAux_step_spec
statement:
private theorem columnReductionTraceAux_step_spec
    (j : Fin m) (fuel : ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (pre post : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (op : EarlierColumnOp m k)
    (htrace : columnReductionTraceAux j fuel M = pre ++ (op :: post)) :
    let A := replay M pre
    op.1.j = j ∧ ∃ p : Fin m,
      columnPivot (A.col j) = some p ∧
      columnPivot (A.col op.1.i) = some p ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m, i < j → columnPivot (A.col i) = some p → op.1.i ≤ i) ∧
      op.1.c = -(A p j / A p op.1.i) ∧
      pivotHeight (columnPivot ((A * op.1.toMatrix).col j)) <
        pivotHeight (columnPivot (A.col j))
proof:
:= by
  induction fuel generalizing M pre with
  | zero => simp [columnReductionTraceAux] at htrace
  | succ fuel ih =>
      simp only [columnReductionTraceAux] at htrace
      split at htrace
      · simp at htrace
      · rename_i head hhead
        cases pre with
        | nil =>
            have heq : head = op := (List.cons.inj htrace).1
            subst op
            obtain ⟨ht, p, hj, hi, hmin, hc⟩ :=
              nextColumnOp_some_spec M j head hhead
            simpa only [replay_nil] using
              (show head.1.j = j ∧ ∃ p : Fin m,
                columnPivot (M.col j) = some p ∧
                columnPivot (M.col head.1.i) = some p ∧
                (∀ i : Fin m, i < j → columnPivot (M.col i) = some p → head.1.i ≤ i) ∧
                head.1.c = -(M p j / M p head.1.i) ∧
                pivotHeight (columnPivot ((M * head.1.toMatrix).col j)) <
                  pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j)) from
                ⟨ht, p, hj, hi, hmin, hc, nextColumnOp_height_lt M j head hhead⟩)
        | cons first rest =>
            have heq : head = first := (List.cons.inj htrace).1
            have htail : columnReductionTraceAux j fuel (M * head.1.toMatrix) =
                rest ++ (op :: post) := (List.cons.inj htrace).2
            subst first
            simpa only [replay_cons] using
              ih (M * head.1.toMatrix) rest htail

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_target
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_target
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m)
    (op : EarlierColumnOp m k) (hop : op ∈ columnReductionTrace M j) :
    op.1.j = j
proof:
:= by
  exact columnReductionTraceAux_target j _ M op hop

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_col_of_ne
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_col_of_ne
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j q : Fin m) (hq : q ≠ j) :
    (replay M (columnReductionTrace M j)).col q = M.col q
proof:
:= by
  exact columnReductionTraceAux_col_of_ne j q hq _ M

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_step_spec
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_step_spec
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m)
    (pre post : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (op : EarlierColumnOp m k)
    (htrace : columnReductionTrace M j = pre ++ (op :: post)) :
    let A := replay M pre
    op.1.j = j ∧ ∃ p : Fin m,
      columnPivot (A.col j) = some p ∧
      columnPivot (A.col op.1.i) = some p ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m, i < j → columnPivot (A.col i) = some p → op.1.i ≤ i) ∧
      op.1.c = -(A p j / A p op.1.i) ∧
      pivotHeight (columnPivot ((A * op.1.toMatrix).col j)) <
        pivotHeight (columnPivot (A.col j))
proof:
:= by
  exact columnReductionTraceAux_step_spec j _ M pre post op htrace

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_length_le
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_length_le
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m) :
    (columnReductionTrace M j).length ≤
      pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j))
proof:
:= by
  exact columnReductionTraceAux_length_le j _ M

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_terminal
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_terminal
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j i : Fin m) (hij : i < j)
    (p : Fin m) (hi : columnPivot (M.col i) = some p) :
    columnPivot ((replay M (columnReductionTrace M j)).col j) ≠ some p
proof:
:= by
  exact columnReductionTraceAux_terminal j _ M (le_refl _) i hij p hi

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_eq_nil_iff
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_eq_nil_iff
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m) :
    columnReductionTrace M j = [] ↔
      ∀ i : Fin m, i < j → ∀ p : Fin m,
        columnPivot (M.col i) = some p → columnPivot (M.col j) ≠ some p
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h i hij p hi
    have ht := columnReductionTrace_terminal M j i hij p hi
    simpa only [h, replay_nil] using ht
  · intro h
    unfold columnReductionTrace
    cases hn : pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j)) with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ fuel =>
        simp only [columnReductionTraceAux]
        rw [(nextColumnOp_none_iff M j).mpr h]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.columnReductionTrace_respectsDegree
statement:
theorem columnReductionTrace_respectsDegree
    (degree : Fin m → ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (j : Fin m)
    (hM : LowersDegree degree M) :
    TraceRespectsDegree degree (columnReductionTrace M j)
proof:
:= by
  exact columnReductionTraceAux_respectsDegree degree j _ M hM

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTraceAux_append
statement:
private theorem matrixReductionTraceAux_append
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (xs ys : List (Fin m)) :
    matrixReductionTraceAux M (xs ++ ys) =
      matrixReductionTraceAux M xs ++
        matrixReductionTraceAux (replay M (matrixReductionTraceAux M xs)) ys
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing M with
  | nil => simp [matrixReductionTraceAux, replay_nil]
  | cons j js ih =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, matrixReductionTraceAux]
      rw [ih, List.append_assoc, replay_append]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTraceAux_target
statement:
private theorem matrixReductionTraceAux_target
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (js : List (Fin m))
    (op : EarlierColumnOp m k) (h : op ∈ matrixReductionTraceAux M js) :
    op.1.j ∈ js
proof:
:= by
  induction js generalizing M with
  | nil => simp [matrixReductionTraceAux] at h
  | cons j js ih =>
      simp only [matrixReductionTraceAux] at h
      rcases List.mem_append.mp h with h | h
      · exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl (columnReductionTrace_target M j op h))
      · exact List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr (ih _ h))

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTraceAux_col_of_not_mem
statement:
private theorem matrixReductionTraceAux_col_of_not_mem
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (js : List (Fin m)) (q : Fin m)
    (hq : q ∉ js) :
    (replay M (matrixReductionTraceAux M js)).col q = M.col q
proof:
:= by
  induction js generalizing M with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons j js ih =>
      have hne : q ≠ j := by intro h; exact hq (h ▸ List.mem_cons_self)
      have htail : q ∉ js := by intro h; exact hq (List.mem_cons_of_mem j h)
      simp only [matrixReductionTraceAux, replay_append]
      rw [ih _ htail, columnReductionTrace_col_of_ne M j q hne]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefix_zero
statement:
private theorem prefix_zero (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) :
    matrixReductionTraceAux M ((List.finRange m).take 0) = []
proof:
:= by
  simp [matrixReductionTraceAux]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefix_succ
statement:
private theorem prefix_succ (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t < m) :
    matrixReductionTraceAux M ((List.finRange m).take (t + 1)) =
      matrixReductionTraceAux M ((List.finRange m).take t) ++
      columnReductionTrace
        (replay M (matrixReductionTraceAux M ((List.finRange m).take t)))
        ⟨t, ht⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hlen : t < (List.finRange m).length := by simpa using ht
  rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hlen, matrixReductionTraceAux_append]
  simp only [matrixReductionTraceAux, List.append_nil]
  congr 1
  simp [List.getElem_finRange]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefix_state_succ
statement:
private theorem prefix_state_succ (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t < m) :
    replay M (matrixReductionTraceAux M ((List.finRange m).take (t + 1))) =
      replay (replay M (matrixReductionTraceAux M ((List.finRange m).take t)))
        (columnReductionTrace
          (replay M (matrixReductionTraceAux M ((List.finRange m).take t)))
          ⟨t, ht⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [prefix_succ M t ht, replay_append]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefix_full
statement:
private theorem prefix_full (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) :
    matrixReductionTraceAux M ((List.finRange m).take m) = matrixReductionTrace M
proof:
:= by
  have h : (List.finRange m).take m = List.finRange m :=
    List.take_of_length_le (by simp)
  simp [matrixReductionTrace, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.mem_prefix_iff
statement:
private theorem mem_prefix_iff (q : Fin m) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ m) :
    q ∈ (List.finRange m).take t ↔ q.val < t
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.mem_take_iff_getElem]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, heq⟩
    have hu' : u < m := by omega
    have hv : u = q.val := by
      simpa [List.getElem_finRange (h := by simpa using hu')] using congrArg Fin.val heq
    omega
  · intro hq
    refine ⟨q.val, by simp; omega, ?_⟩
    simp

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTraceAux_prefix_invariant
statement:
private theorem matrixReductionTraceAux_prefix_invariant
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ m) :
    let ops := matrixReductionTraceAux M ((List.finRange m).take t)
    let A := replay M ops
    (∀ op ∈ ops, op.1.j.val < t) ∧
    (∀ q : Fin m, t ≤ q.val → A.col q = M.col q) ∧
    (∀ i j p : Fin m, i.val < t → j.val < t →
      columnPivot (A.col i) = some p →
      columnPivot (A.col j) = some p → i = j) ∧
    ops.length ≤
      (((List.finRange m).take t).map
        (fun j => pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j)))).sum
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | zero =>
      simp [matrixReductionTraceAux, replay_nil]
  | succ t ih =>
      have hlt : t < m := by omega
      have hle : t ≤ m := by omega
      obtain ⟨hops, hfuture, hpiv, hlen⟩ := ih hle
      let P := matrixReductionTraceAux M ((List.finRange m).take t)
      let A := replay M P
      let j : Fin m := ⟨t, hlt⟩
      let block := columnReductionTrace A j
      have hP : matrixReductionTraceAux M ((List.finRange m).take (t + 1)) =
          P ++ block := prefix_succ M t hlt
      have hA : replay M (matrixReductionTraceAux M ((List.finRange m).take (t + 1))) =
          replay A block := prefix_state_succ M t hlt
      have hsum : (((List.finRange m).take (t + 1)).map
          (fun q => pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col q)))).sum =
          (((List.finRange m).take t).map
          (fun q => pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col q)))).sum +
          pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j)) := by
        have hh : t < (List.finRange m).length := by simpa using hlt
        rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem hh, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
        simp [j, List.getElem_finRange]
      dsimp
      rw [hP, replay_append, hsum]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro op hop
        rcases List.mem_append.mp hop with h | h
        · exact Nat.lt_succ_of_lt (hops op h)
        · have hj := columnReductionTrace_target A j op h
          simp [hj, j]
      · intro q hq
        have hne : q ≠ j := by intro heq; subst q; simp [j] at hq
        rw [columnReductionTrace_col_of_ne A j q hne]
        exact hfuture q (by omega)
      · intro i q p hi hq hpi hpq
        have hile : i.val ≤ t := by omega
        have hqle : q.val ≤ t := by omega
        rcases (Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hile) with hio | hij
        · rcases (Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hqle) with hqo | hqj
          · have hiNe : i ≠ j := by intro heq; subst i; exact (Nat.lt_irrefl t) hio
            have hqNe : q ≠ j := by intro heq; subst q; exact (Nat.lt_irrefl t) hqo
            rw [columnReductionTrace_col_of_ne A j i hiNe] at hpi
            rw [columnReductionTrace_col_of_ne A j q hqNe] at hpq
            exact hpiv i q p hio hqo hpi hpq
          · have qeq : q = j := Fin.ext hqj
            subst q
            have hiNe : i ≠ j := by intro heq; subst i; exact (Nat.lt_irrefl t) hio
            rw [columnReductionTrace_col_of_ne A j i hiNe] at hpi
            have hij' : i < j := hio
            exact False.elim ((columnReductionTrace_terminal A j i hij' p hpi) hpq)
        · rcases (Nat.lt_or_eq_of_le hqle) with hqo | hqj
          · have ieq : i = j := Fin.ext hij
            subst i
            have hqNe : q ≠ j := by intro heq; subst q; exact (Nat.lt_irrefl t) hqo
            rw [columnReductionTrace_col_of_ne A j q hqNe] at hpq
            have hqj' : q < j := hqo
            exact False.elim ((columnReductionTrace_terminal A j q hqj' p hpq) hpi)
          · exact (Fin.ext (hij.trans hqj.symm))
      · have hlocal := columnReductionTrace_length_le A j
        have hjcol : A.col j = M.col j := hfuture j (by simp [j])
        rw [hjcol] at hlocal
        simpa only [List.length_append, hsum] using Nat.add_le_add hlen hlocal

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_pivots_distinct
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_pivots_distinct
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (i j p : Fin m)
    (hi : columnPivot ((replay M (matrixReductionTrace M)).col i) = some p)
    (hj : columnPivot ((replay M (matrixReductionTrace M)).col j) = some p) :
    i = j
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, hp, _⟩ := matrixReductionTraceAux_prefix_invariant M m (le_refl m)
  rw [prefix_full] at hp
  exact hp i j p i.isLt j.isLt hi hj

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_length_le
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_length_le
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) :
    (matrixReductionTrace M).length ≤
      ∑ j : Fin m, pivotHeight (columnPivot (M.col j))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, hlen⟩ := matrixReductionTraceAux_prefix_invariant M m (le_refl m)
  rw [prefix_full] at hlen
  have htake : (List.finRange m).take m = List.finRange m :=
    List.take_of_length_le (by simp)
  rw [htake] at hlen
  simpa only [Fin.sum_univ_def] using hlen

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTraceAux_respectsDegree
statement:
private theorem matrixReductionTraceAux_respectsDegree
    (degree : Fin m → ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (js : List (Fin m)) (hM : LowersDegree degree M) :
    TraceRespectsDegree degree (matrixReductionTraceAux M js)
proof:
:= by
  induction js generalizing M with
  | nil => simp [matrixReductionTraceAux, TraceRespectsDegree]
  | cons j js ih =>
      let block := columnReductionTrace M j
      have hb : TraceRespectsDegree degree block :=
        columnReductionTrace_respectsDegree degree M j hM
      have hM' : LowersDegree degree (replay M block) :=
        replay_lowersDegree degree M block hM hb
      have ht := ih (replay M block) hM'
      intro op hop
      change op ∈ block ++ matrixReductionTraceAux (replay M block) js at hop
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hop with h | h
      · exact hb op h
      · exact ht op h

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_respectsDegree
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_respectsDegree
    (degree : Fin m → ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hM : LowersDegree degree M) :
    TraceRespectsDegree degree (matrixReductionTrace M)
proof:
:= by
  exact matrixReductionTraceAux_respectsDegree degree M (List.finRange m) hM

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_certificate
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_certificate
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) :
    let ops := matrixReductionTrace M
    let R := replay M ops
    let V := traceChange ops
    let W := traceChangeInv ops
    R = M * V ∧ V * W = 1 ∧ W * V = 1 ∧
    V.IsUpperTriangular ∧ (∀ i, V i i = 1) ∧
    W.IsUpperTriangular ∧ (∀ i, W i i = 1) ∧
    replay R (inverseTrace ops) = M ∧
    (∀ s : ℕ, prefixSpan R s = prefixSpan M s)
proof:
:= by
  let ops := matrixReductionTrace M
  exact ⟨replay_eq_mul_traceChange M ops,
    traceChange_mul_traceChangeInv ops,
    traceChangeInv_mul_traceChange ops,
    traceChange_isUpperTriangular ops,
    traceChange_apply_diag ops,
    traceChange_isUpperTriangular (inverseTrace ops),
    traceChange_apply_diag (inverseTrace ops),
    replay_inverseTrace M ops,
    fun s => prefixSpan_replay M ops s⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_graded_certificate
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_graded_certificate
    (degree : Fin m → ℕ) (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (hM : LowersDegree degree M) :
    let ops := matrixReductionTrace M
    let R := replay M ops
    let V := traceChange ops
    let W := traceChangeInv ops
    R = M * V ∧ V * W = 1 ∧ W * V = 1 ∧
    V.IsUpperTriangular ∧ (∀ i, V i i = 1) ∧
    W.IsUpperTriangular ∧ (∀ i, W i i = 1) ∧
    replay R (inverseTrace ops) = M ∧
    (∀ s : ℕ, prefixSpan R s = prefixSpan M s) ∧
    TraceChangeCertificate degree V W ∧ LowersDegree degree R
proof:
:= by
  let ops := matrixReductionTrace M
  have hd := matrixReductionTrace_respectsDegree degree M hM
  have hc := traceChange_certificate degree ops hd
  exact ⟨replay_eq_mul_traceChange M ops,
    traceChange_mul_traceChangeInv ops,
    traceChangeInv_mul_traceChange ops,
    hc.upper, hc.diag, hc.inv_upper, hc.inv_diag,
    replay_inverseTrace M ops,
    fun s => prefixSpan_replay M ops s,
    hc, replay_lowersDegree degree M ops hM hd⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.split_append_occurrence
statement:
private theorem split_append_occurrence {α : Type*}
    (xs ys pre post : List α) (op : α)
    (h : xs ++ ys = pre ++ op :: post) :
    (∃ a b, xs = a ++ op :: b ∧ pre = a ∧ post = b ++ ys) ∨
    (∃ a b, ys = a ++ op :: b ∧ pre = xs ++ a ∧ post = b)
proof:
:= by
  induction xs generalizing pre with
  | nil =>
      exact Or.inr ⟨pre, post, by simpa using h, rfl, rfl⟩
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases pre with
      | nil =>
          have hx : x = op := (List.cons.inj h).1
          have ht : xs ++ ys = post := (List.cons.inj h).2
          subst x
          exact Or.inl ⟨[], xs, rfl, rfl, ht.symm⟩
      | cons y ps =>
          have hxy : x = y := (List.cons.inj h).1
          have ht : xs ++ ys = ps ++ op :: post := (List.cons.inj h).2
          subst y
          rcases ih ps ht with ⟨a,b,ha,hpre,hpost⟩ | ⟨a,b,ha,hpre,hpost⟩
          · exact Or.inl ⟨x :: a, b, by simp [ha], by simp [hpre], hpost⟩
          · exact Or.inr ⟨a, b, ha, by simp [hpre], hpost⟩

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTraceAux_step_spec
statement:
private theorem matrixReductionTraceAux_step_spec
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k) (js : List (Fin m))
    (pre post : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (op : EarlierColumnOp m k)
    (htrace : matrixReductionTraceAux M js = pre ++ (op :: post)) :
    let A := replay M pre
    ∃ p : Fin m,
      columnPivot (A.col op.1.j) = some p ∧
      columnPivot (A.col op.1.i) = some p ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m, i < op.1.j →
        columnPivot (A.col i) = some p → op.1.i ≤ i) ∧
      op.1.c = -(A p op.1.j / A p op.1.i) ∧
      pivotHeight (columnPivot ((A * op.1.toMatrix).col op.1.j)) <
        pivotHeight (columnPivot (A.col op.1.j))
proof:
:= by
  induction js generalizing M pre post with
  | nil => simp [matrixReductionTraceAux] at htrace
  | cons j js ih =>
      let block := columnReductionTrace M j
      let M' := replay M block
      have hs : block ++ matrixReductionTraceAux M' js = pre ++ op :: post := htrace
      rcases split_append_occurrence block (matrixReductionTraceAux M' js)
        pre post op hs with ⟨a,b,hblock,hpre,_⟩ | ⟨a,b,htail,hpre,_⟩
      · subst pre
        obtain ⟨ht,p,hpj,hpi,hmin,hc,hdec⟩ :=
          columnReductionTrace_step_spec M j a b op hblock
        simpa only [ht] using
          (show ∃ p : Fin m,
            columnPivot ((replay M a).col j) = some p ∧
            columnPivot ((replay M a).col op.1.i) = some p ∧
            (∀ i : Fin m, i < j →
              columnPivot ((replay M a).col i) = some p → op.1.i ≤ i) ∧
            op.1.c = -((replay M a) p j / (replay M a) p op.1.i) ∧
            pivotHeight (columnPivot (((replay M a) * op.1.toMatrix).col j)) <
              pivotHeight (columnPivot ((replay M a).col j)) from
            ⟨p,hpj,hpi,hmin,hc,hdec⟩)
      · subst pre
        have htail' := ih M' a b htail
        simpa only [replay_append] using htail'

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.matrixReductionTrace_step_spec
statement:
theorem matrixReductionTrace_step_spec
    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) k)
    (pre post : List (EarlierColumnOp m k)) (op : EarlierColumnOp m k)
    (htrace : matrixReductionTrace M = pre ++ (op :: post)) :
    let A := replay M pre
    ∃ p : Fin m,
      columnPivot (A.col op.1.j) = some p ∧
      columnPivot (A.col op.1.i) = some p ∧
      (∀ i : Fin m, i < op.1.j →
        columnPivot (A.col i) = some p → op.1.i ≤ i) ∧
      op.1.c = -(A p op.1.j / A p op.1.i) ∧
      pivotHeight (columnPivot ((A * op.1.toMatrix).col op.1.j)) <
        pivotHeight (columnPivot (A.col op.1.j))
proof:
:= by
  exact matrixReductionTraceAux_step_spec M (List.finRange m) pre post op htrace

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.face_card_eq_degree_add_one
statement:
theorem face_card_eq_degree_add_one (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) :
    (e.enum i).val.card = faceDegree e i + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < (e.enum i).val.card :=
    Finset.card_pos.mpr ((K.isRelLowerSet_faces (e.enum i).property).1)
  simp only [faceDegree]
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.degreewiseFaceIndex_degree
statement:
theorem degreewiseFaceIndex_degree (e : CompatibleOrder f) (p : ℕ)
    (s : Face K p) : faceDegree e (degreewiseFaceIndex e p s) = p
proof:
:= by
  have he : e.enum (degreewiseFaceIndex e p s) = (⟨s.1, s.2.1⟩ : TotalFace K) :=
    e.enum.apply_symm_apply _
  have hc := face_card_eq_degree_add_one e (degreewiseFaceIndex e p s)
  rw [he] at hc
  have hs := s.2.2
  simp only at hc
  omega

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.degreewiseFaceIndex_indexedFace
statement:
theorem degreewiseFaceIndex_indexedFace (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) (p : ℕ) (hp : faceDegree e i = p) :
    degreewiseFaceIndex e p (indexedFace e i p hp) = i
proof:
:= by
  exact e.enum.symm_apply_apply i

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.indexedFace_degreewiseFaceIndex
statement:
theorem indexedFace_degreewiseFaceIndex (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (p : ℕ) (s : Face K p) :
    indexedFace e (degreewiseFaceIndex e p s) p
      (degreewiseFaceIndex_degree e p s) = s
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (e.enum (e.enum.symm ⟨s.1, s.2.1⟩)).val = s.1
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.enum.apply_symm_apply ⟨s.1, s.2.1⟩)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.mem_prefixDegreeSpace_iff
statement:
theorem mem_prefixDegreeSpace_iff (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (t p : ℕ) (x : Fin (faceCount K) → k) :
    x ∈ prefixDegreeSpace k e t p ↔
      PrefixSupported t x ∧ Homogeneous (faceDegree e) p x
proof:
:= by
  rw [prefixDegreeSpace, Pi.mem_spanSubset_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    constructor
    · intro i hi
      exact hx i (by simp; omega)
    · intro i hi
      exact hx i (by simp [hi])
  · rintro ⟨hpre, hdeg⟩ i hi
    by_cases ht : i.val < t
    · exact hdeg i (by
        intro he
        exact hi ⟨ht, he⟩)
    · exact hpre i (by omega)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixChainEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem prefixChainEquiv_apply (e : CompatibleOrder f) (t p : ℕ)
    (c : Chain (e.prefixComplex t) k p) (i : Fin (faceCount K))
    (hi : i.val < t ∧ faceDegree e i = p) :
    (prefixChainEquiv k e t p c).1 i = c (prefixIndexedFace e t p ⟨i, hi⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [prefixChainEquiv, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    LinearEquiv.funCongrLeft_apply]
  simp [extendPrefixCoordinates, hi, chainCoordinates_apply, prefixFaceEquiv]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixChainEquiv_apply_zero
statement:
theorem prefixChainEquiv_apply_zero (e : CompatibleOrder f) (t p : ℕ)
    (c : Chain (e.prefixComplex t) k p) (i : Fin (faceCount K))
    (hi : ¬ (i.val < t ∧ faceDegree e i = p)) :
    (prefixChainEquiv k e t p c).1 i = 0
proof:
:=
  Pi.mem_spanSubset_iff.mp (prefixChainEquiv k e t p c).2 i hi

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixChainEquiv_single_apply
statement:
theorem prefixChainEquiv_single_apply (e : CompatibleOrder f) (t p : ℕ)
    (s : Face (e.prefixComplex t) p) (a : k)
    (i : Fin (faceCount K)) :
    (prefixChainEquiv k e t p (Finsupp.single s a)).1 i =
      if i = (prefixFaceIndex e t p s).1 then a else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hi : i.val < t ∧ faceDegree e i = p
  · rw [prefixChainEquiv_apply k e t p _ i hi]
    have he : prefixIndexedFace e t p ⟨i, hi⟩ = s ↔
        i = (prefixFaceIndex e t p s).1 := by
      constructor
      · intro h
        have := congrArg (prefixFaceIndex e t p) h
        have hh : prefixFaceIndex e t p (prefixIndexedFace e t p ⟨i, hi⟩) =
            ⟨i, hi⟩ := (prefixFaceEquiv e t p).left_inv ⟨i, hi⟩
        rw [hh] at this
        exact congrArg Subtype.val this
      · intro h
        have ht : (⟨i, hi⟩ : {q : Fin (faceCount K) //
            q.val < t ∧ faceDegree e q = p}) = prefixFaceIndex e t p s :=
          Subtype.ext h
        rw [ht]
        exact (prefixFaceEquiv e t p).right_inv s
    by_cases h : i = (prefixFaceIndex e t p s).1
    · have hf : s = prefixIndexedFace e t p ⟨i, hi⟩ := (he.mpr h).symm
      simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, if_pos hf, if_pos h]
    · have hf : s ≠ prefixIndexedFace e t p ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
        intro heq
        exact h (he.mp heq.symm)
      simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg hf, if_neg h]
  · rw [prefixChainEquiv_apply_zero k e t p _ i hi]
    have hne : i ≠ (prefixFaceIndex e t p s).1 := by
      intro h
      exact hi (h ▸ (prefixFaceIndex e t p s).2)
    simp [hne]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixFaceIndex_inclusion
statement:
theorem prefixFaceIndex_inclusion (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (s t p : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t) (q : Face (e.prefixComplex s) p) :
    (prefixFaceIndex e t p
      (faceIncl (e.prefixComplex_mono hst) p q)).1 =
      (prefixFaceIndex e s p q).1
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixChainEquiv_inclusion
statement:
theorem prefixChainEquiv_inclusion (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (s t p : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    (prefixChainEquiv k e t p).toLinearMap.comp
        (chainIncl k (e.prefixComplex_mono hst) p) =
      (prefixDegreeIncl k e s t p hst).comp
        (prefixChainEquiv k e s p).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro q a
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext i
  change (prefixChainEquiv k e t p
      (chainIncl k (e.prefixComplex_mono hst) p (Finsupp.single q a))).1 i =
    (prefixChainEquiv k e s p (Finsupp.single q a)).1 i
  rw [chainIncl_single,
    prefixChainEquiv_single_apply, prefixChainEquiv_single_apply,
    prefixFaceIndex_inclusion e s t p hst q]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceBoundaryMatrix_degree
statement:
theorem faceBoundaryMatrix_degree (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (i j : Fin (faceCount K)) (hij : faceBoundaryMatrix k e i j ≠ 0) :
    faceDegree e j = faceDegree e i + 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra h
  exact hij (by simp [faceBoundaryMatrix, h])

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceBoundaryMatrix_vertex
statement:
theorem faceBoundaryMatrix_vertex (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (j : Fin (faceCount K)) (hj : faceDegree e j = 0) :
    (faceBoundaryMatrix k e).col j = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext i
  by_cases h : faceDegree e j = faceDegree e i + 1
  · omega
  · simp [faceBoundaryMatrix, h]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceBoundaryMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem faceBoundaryMatrix_apply (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (i j : Fin (faceCount K)) :
    faceBoundaryMatrix k e i j =
      if h : faceDegree e j = faceDegree e i + 1 then
        ∑ a : Fin (faceDegree e i + 2),
          if deletedFace K (faceDegree e i)
              (indexedFace e j (faceDegree e i + 1) h) a =
                indexedFace e i (faceDegree e i) rfl
          then (-1 : k) ^ (a : ℕ) else 0
      else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype (Face K (faceDegree e i + 1)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  unfold faceBoundaryMatrix
  split_ifs with h
  · exact boundaryMatrix_apply K k (faceDegree e i) _ _
  · rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceBoundaryMatrix_of_degree
statement:
theorem faceBoundaryMatrix_of_degree (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (i j : Fin (faceCount K)) (p : ℕ)
    (hi : faceDegree e i = p) (hj : faceDegree e j = p + 1) :
    faceBoundaryMatrix k e i j =
      letI : Fintype (Face K (p + 1)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
      boundaryMatrix K k p (indexedFace e i p hi)
        (indexedFace e j (p + 1) hj)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  subst p
  rw [faceBoundaryMatrix, dif_pos hj]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceBoundaryMatrix_deletedFace
statement:
theorem faceBoundaryMatrix_deletedFace (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (j : Fin (faceCount K)) (p : ℕ) (hj : faceDegree e j = p + 1)
    (a : Fin (p + 2)) :
    faceBoundaryMatrix k e
      (degreewiseFaceIndex e p
        (deletedFace K p (indexedFace e j (p + 1) hj) a)) j =
      (-1 : k) ^ (a : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  let s := deletedFace K p (indexedFace e j (p + 1) hj) a
  have hs : faceDegree e (degreewiseFaceIndex e p s) = p :=
    degreewiseFaceIndex_degree e p s
  rw [faceBoundaryMatrix_of_degree k e _ j p hs hj]
  letI : Fintype (Face K (p + 1)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hrow : indexedFace e (degreewiseFaceIndex e p s) p hs = s :=
    indexedFace_degreewiseFaceIndex e p s
  rw [hrow]
  exact boundaryMatrix_deletedFace K k p (indexedFace e j (p + 1) hj) a

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceBoundaryMatrix_strict
statement:
theorem faceBoundaryMatrix_strict (e : CompatibleOrder f) :
    StrictBoundary (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro i j hij
  have hdeg := faceBoundaryMatrix_degree k e i j hij
  letI : Fintype (Face K (faceDegree e i + 1)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hmatrix : boundaryMatrix K k (faceDegree e i)
      (indexedFace e i (faceDegree e i) rfl)
      (indexedFace e j (faceDegree e i + 1) hdeg) ≠ 0 := by
    simpa only [faceBoundaryMatrix, dif_pos hdeg] using hij
  have hex : ∃ a : Fin (faceDegree e i + 2),
      deletedFace K (faceDegree e i)
        (indexedFace e j (faceDegree e i + 1) hdeg) a =
          indexedFace e i (faceDegree e i) rfl := by
    by_contra hn
    push_neg at hn
    exact hmatrix (boundaryMatrix_eq_zero_of_not_deletedFace K k
      (faceDegree e i) _ _ hn)
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hex
  have hproper : (e.enum i).val ⊂ (e.enum j).val := by
    have hdel : (deletedFace K (faceDegree e i)
        (indexedFace e j (faceDegree e i + 1) hdeg) a).1 ⊂
          (indexedFace e j (faceDegree e i + 1) hdeg).1 :=
      Finset.erase_ssubset (Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ _ a)
    rw [ha] at hdel
    simpa only [indexedFace] using hdel
  exact e.face_lt i j hproper

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceBoundaryMatrix_lowersDegree
statement:
theorem faceBoundaryMatrix_lowersDegree (e : CompatibleOrder f) :
    LowersDegree (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
proof:
:=
  faceBoundaryMatrix_degree k e

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.boundaryMatrix_inclusion_entry
statement:
theorem boundaryMatrix_inclusion_entry
    {L : PreAbstractSimplicialComplex V} (p : ℕ)
    [Finite (Face L (p + 1))] [Finite (Face L p)] (h : L ≤ K)
    (τ : Face L p) (σ : Face L (p + 1)) :
    letI : Fintype (Face L (p + 1)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
    letI : Fintype (Face K (p + 1)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
    boundaryMatrix L k p τ σ =
      boundaryMatrix K k p (faceIncl h p τ) (faceIncl h (p + 1) σ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Fintype (Face L (p + 1)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI : Fintype (Face K (p + 1)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [boundaryMatrix_apply, boundaryMatrix_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  have hd := faceIncl_deletedFace h p σ a
  have hinj : Function.Injective (faceIncl h p) := by
    intro x y hxy
    exact Subtype.ext (congrArg (fun z : Face K p => z.1) hxy)
  rw [← hd]
  simp only [hinj.eq_iff]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceBoundaryMatrix_prefix_entry
statement:
theorem faceBoundaryMatrix_prefix_entry (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (t p : ℕ) (i j : Fin (faceCount K))
    (hi : i.val < t ∧ faceDegree e i = p)
    (hj : j.val < t ∧ faceDegree e j = p + 1) :
    faceBoundaryMatrix k e i j =
      letI : Fintype (Face (e.prefixComplex t) (p + 1)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
      boundaryMatrix (e.prefixComplex t) k p
        (prefixIndexedFace e t p ⟨i, hi⟩)
        (prefixIndexedFace e t (p + 1) ⟨j, hj⟩)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let hpre : e.prefixComplex t ≤ K := by
    intro s hs
    exact ((e.mem_prefixComplex t s).mp hs).1
  letI : Finite (Face (e.prefixComplex t) p) :=
    Finite.of_equiv _ (prefixFaceEquiv e t p)
  letI : Finite (Face (e.prefixComplex t) (p + 1)) :=
    Finite.of_equiv _ (prefixFaceEquiv e t (p + 1))
  letI : Fintype (Face (e.prefixComplex t) (p + 1)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  letI : Fintype (Face K (p + 1)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  rw [faceBoundaryMatrix_of_degree k e i j p hi.2 hj.2]
  have h := boundaryMatrix_inclusion_entry k p hpre
    (prefixIndexedFace e t p ⟨i, hi⟩)
    (prefixIndexedFace e t (p + 1) ⟨j, hj⟩)
  simpa only [prefixIndexedFace, indexedFace, faceIncl] using h.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixChainEquiv_single_vector
statement:
theorem prefixChainEquiv_single_vector (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (t p : ℕ) (σ : Face (e.prefixComplex t) p) (a : k) :
    (prefixChainEquiv k e t p (Finsupp.single σ a)).1 =
      Pi.single (prefixFaceIndex e t p σ).1 a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext i
  rw [prefixChainEquiv_single_apply]
  simp only [Pi.single_apply]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixMatrixBoundary_single
statement:
theorem prefixMatrixBoundary_single (e : CompatibleOrder f) (t p : ℕ)
    (σ : Face (e.prefixComplex t) (p + 1)) (a : k) :
    prefixMatrixBoundary k e t p
        (prefixChainEquiv k e t (p + 1) (Finsupp.single σ a)) =
      prefixChainEquiv k e t p
        (boundary (e.prefixComplex t) k p (Finsupp.single σ a))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let j := (prefixFaceIndex e t (p + 1) σ).1
  have hj : j.val < t ∧ faceDegree e j = p + 1 :=
    (prefixFaceIndex e t (p + 1) σ).2
  apply Subtype.ext
  funext i
  change (faceBoundaryMatrix k e).mulVec
      (prefixChainEquiv k e t (p + 1) (Finsupp.single σ a)).1 i = _
  rw [prefixChainEquiv_single_vector, Matrix.mulVec_single]
  by_cases hi : i.val < t ∧ faceDegree e i = p
  · rw [prefixChainEquiv_apply k e t p _ i hi]
    have hentry := faceBoundaryMatrix_prefix_entry k e t p i j hi hj
    have hσ : prefixIndexedFace e t (p + 1)
        (prefixFaceIndex e t (p + 1) σ) = σ :=
      (prefixFaceEquiv e t (p + 1)).right_inv σ
    have hσ' : prefixIndexedFace e t (p + 1) ⟨j, hj⟩ = σ := hσ
    rw [hσ'] at hentry
    letI : Fintype (Face (e.prefixComplex t) (p + 1)) := Fintype.ofFinite _
    have hcoeff := boundaryMatrix_mulVec (e.prefixComplex t) k p
      (Finsupp.single σ a)
    have hcoord := congrFun hcoeff (prefixIndexedFace e t p ⟨i, hi⟩)
    have hsingle : chainCoordinates (e.prefixComplex t) k (p + 1)
        (Finsupp.single σ a) = Pi.single σ a := by
      funext q
      rw [chainCoordinates_apply]
      by_cases hq : q = σ
      · subst q
        simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply, if_pos rfl]
      · simp only [Finsupp.single_apply, Pi.single_apply,
          if_neg hq, if_neg (Ne.symm hq)]
    rw [hsingle, Matrix.mulVec_single] at hcoord
    change MulOpposite.op a • faceBoundaryMatrix k e i j = _
    rw [hentry]
    simpa only [Matrix.col_apply, Pi.smul_apply,
      chainCoordinates_apply] using hcoord
  · rw [prefixChainEquiv_apply_zero k e t p _ i hi]
    have hz : faceBoundaryMatrix k e i j = 0 := by
      by_contra hn
      have hdeg := faceBoundaryMatrix_degree k e i j hn
      have hlt := faceBoundaryMatrix_strict k e i j hn
      apply hi
      constructor
      · exact lt_trans hlt hj.1
      · omega
    change MulOpposite.op a • faceBoundaryMatrix k e i j = 0
    rw [hz, smul_zero]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixChainEquiv_boundary
statement:
theorem prefixChainEquiv_boundary (e : CompatibleOrder f) (t p : ℕ) :
    (prefixMatrixBoundary k e t p).comp
        (prefixChainEquiv k e t (p + 1)).toLinearMap =
      (prefixChainEquiv k e t p).toLinearMap.comp
        (boundary (e.prefixComplex t) k p)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro σ a
  exact prefixMatrixBoundary_single k e t p σ a

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceBoundaryMatrix_mulVec_prefix
statement:
theorem faceBoundaryMatrix_mulVec_prefix (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (t p : ℕ) (c : Chain (e.prefixComplex t) k (p + 1)) :
    (faceBoundaryMatrix k e).mulVec
        (prefixChainEquiv k e t (p + 1) c).1 =
      (prefixChainEquiv k e t p
        (boundary (e.prefixComplex t) k p c)).1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun F => F c) (prefixChainEquiv_boundary k e t p)
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceBoundaryMatrix_mulVec_zero_degree
statement:
theorem faceBoundaryMatrix_mulVec_zero_degree (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (t : ℕ) (x : prefixDegreeSpace k e t 0) :
    (faceBoundaryMatrix k e).mulVec x.1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  funext r
  rw [Matrix.mulVec_apply_eq_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j _
  by_cases hj : faceBoundaryMatrix k e r j = 0
  · simp [hj]
  · have hdegree := faceBoundaryMatrix_degree k e r j hj
    have hnot : ¬ (j.val < t ∧ faceDegree e j = 0) := by
      intro h
      omega
    have hz := Pi.mem_spanSubset_iff.mp x.2 j hnot
    simp [hz]

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero
statement:
theorem faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero (e : CompatibleOrder f) :
    faceBoundaryMatrix k e * faceBoundaryMatrix k e = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let D := faceBoundaryMatrix k e
  apply Matrix.ext
  intro r j
  have hentry : (D * D) r j = (D.mulVec (D.col j)) r := by
    simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec_apply_eq_sum, Matrix.col_apply]
  rw [hentry]
  cases hdeg : faceDegree e j with
  | zero =>
      have hz := faceBoundaryMatrix_vertex k e j hdeg
      simp [D, hz]
  | succ p =>
      let jj : {i : Fin (faceCount K) //
          i.val < faceCount K ∧ faceDegree e i = p + 1} :=
        ⟨j, j.isLt, hdeg⟩
      let σ := prefixIndexedFace e (faceCount K) (p + 1) jj
      have hindex : (prefixFaceIndex e (faceCount K) (p + 1) σ).1 = j := by
        have h := (prefixFaceEquiv e (faceCount K) (p + 1)).left_inv jj
        exact congrArg Subtype.val h
      have hvec : (prefixChainEquiv k e (faceCount K) (p + 1)
          (Finsupp.single σ 1)).1 = Pi.single j 1 := by
        rw [prefixChainEquiv_single_vector, hindex]
      have hcol : D.col j =
          (prefixChainEquiv k e (faceCount K) p
            (boundary (e.prefixComplex (faceCount K)) k p
              (Finsupp.single σ 1))).1 := by
        calc
          D.col j = D.mulVec (Pi.single j 1) :=
            (Matrix.mulVec_single_one D j).symm
          _ = D.mulVec (prefixChainEquiv k e (faceCount K) (p + 1)
              (Finsupp.single σ 1)).1 := by rw [hvec]
          _ = _ := faceBoundaryMatrix_mulVec_prefix k e (faceCount K) p _
      cases p with
      | zero =>
          rw [hcol]
          have hz := faceBoundaryMatrix_mulVec_zero_degree k e
            (faceCount K)
            (prefixChainEquiv k e (faceCount K) 0
              (boundary (e.prefixComplex (faceCount K)) k 0
                (Finsupp.single σ 1)))
          exact congrFun hz r
      | succ q =>
          rw [hcol]
          rw [faceBoundaryMatrix_mulVec_prefix k e (faceCount K) q]
          have hsq := congrArg (fun F => F (Finsupp.single σ 1))
            (boundary_comp_boundary (e.prefixComplex (faceCount K)) k q)
          simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at hsq
          rw [hsq, map_zero]
          rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixChainEquiv_cycle_iff
statement:
theorem prefixChainEquiv_cycle_iff (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (t p : ℕ) (c : Chain (e.prefixComplex t) k p) :
    c ∈ simplicialCycles (e.prefixComplex t) k p ↔
      OriginalCycle (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e) p t
        (prefixChainEquiv k e t p c).1
proof:
:= by
  have hsupport := (mem_prefixDegreeSpace_iff k e t p
    (prefixChainEquiv k e t p c).1).mp (prefixChainEquiv k e t p c).2
  cases p with
  | zero =>
      rw [simplicialCycles_zero]
      constructor
      · intro _
        exact ⟨hsupport.1, hsupport.2,
          faceBoundaryMatrix_mulVec_zero_degree k e t _⟩
      · intro _
        trivial
  | succ q =>
      rw [simplicialCycles_succ]
      have hb := faceBoundaryMatrix_mulVec_prefix k e t q c
      constructor
      · intro hc
        have hzero : boundary (e.prefixComplex t) k q c = 0 := hc
        rw [hzero, map_zero] at hb
        exact ⟨hsupport.1, hsupport.2, hb⟩
      · intro hc
        have hz := hb.symm.trans hc.2.2
        have hzero : boundary (e.prefixComplex t) k q c = 0 := by
          apply (prefixChainEquiv k e t q).injective
          apply Subtype.ext
          rw [map_zero]
          change (prefixChainEquiv k e t q
            (boundary (e.prefixComplex t) k q c)).1 = 0
          exact hz
        exact hzero

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixChainEquiv_boundary_iff
statement:
theorem prefixChainEquiv_boundary_iff (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (t p : ℕ) (z : simplicialCycles (e.prefixComplex t) k p) :
    z ∈ simplicialBoundaries (e.prefixComplex t) k p ↔
      OriginalBoundary (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e) p t
        (prefixChainEquiv k e t p z.1).1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_simplicialBoundaries_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
    let y := prefixChainEquiv k e t (p + 1) c
    have hy := (mem_prefixDegreeSpace_iff k e t (p + 1) y.1).mp y.2
    refine ⟨y.1, hy.1, hy.2, ?_⟩
    rw [faceBoundaryMatrix_mulVec_prefix k e t p c, hc]
  · rintro ⟨y, hpre, hdeg, hy⟩
    let x : prefixDegreeSpace k e t (p + 1) :=
      ⟨y, (mem_prefixDegreeSpace_iff k e t (p + 1) y).mpr ⟨hpre, hdeg⟩⟩
    let c := (prefixChainEquiv k e t (p + 1)).symm x
    refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
    apply (prefixChainEquiv k e t p).injective
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hb := faceBoundaryMatrix_mulVec_prefix k e t p c
    have hc : (prefixChainEquiv k e t (p + 1) c).1 = y := by
      exact congrArg Subtype.val
        ((prefixChainEquiv k e t (p + 1)).apply_symm_apply x)
    rw [hc, hy] at hb
    exact hb.symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv_inclusion
statement:
theorem prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv_inclusion (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (s t p : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (z : simplicialCycles (e.prefixComplex s) k p) :
    (prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv k e t p
      (simplicialCycleIncl k (e.prefixComplex_mono hst) p z)).1 =
      (prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv k e s p z).1
proof:
:= by
  have hc := congrArg
    (fun F : Chain (e.prefixComplex s) k p →ₗ[k] prefixDegreeSpace k e t p =>
      (F z.1).1)
    (prefixChainEquiv_inclusion k e s t p hst)
  change ((prefixChainEquiv k e t p)
    (chainIncl k (e.prefixComplex_mono hst) p z.1)).1 =
    ((prefixChainEquiv k e s p) z.1).1 at hc
  change ((prefixChainEquiv k e t p)
    (chainIncl k (e.prefixComplex_mono hst) p z.1)).1 =
    ((prefixChainEquiv k e s p) z.1).1
  exact hc

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceReduction_normalForm
statement:
theorem faceReduction_normalForm (e : CompatibleOrder f) :
    let D := faceBoundaryMatrix k e
    let R := reducedFaceBoundary k e
    let V := faceReductionChange k e
    let W := faceReductionChangeInv k e
    R = D * V ∧ TraceChangeCertificate (faceDegree e) V W ∧
      LowersDegree (faceDegree e) R ∧ StrictBoundary R ∧
      DistinctPivots R ∧
      (∀ j i, columnPivot (R.col j) = some i →
        columnPivot (R.col i) = none)
proof:
:= by
  exact matrixReductionTrace_normalForm_input
    (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
      (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e)
      (faceBoundaryMatrix_strict k e)
      (faceBoundaryMatrix_lowersDegree k e)

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceMatrixHomology_eq_originalHomology
statement:
theorem faceMatrixHomology_eq_originalHomology (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (p t : ℕ) :
    faceMatrixHomology k e p t =
      (let h := faceReduction_normalForm k e
       originalHomology (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
         (reducedFaceBoundary k e) (faceReductionChange k e)
         (faceReductionChangeInv k e) (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e)
         h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p t)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv_boundaries
statement:
theorem prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv_boundaries (e : CompatibleOrder f) (t p : ℕ) :
    (simplicialBoundaries (e.prefixComplex t) k p).map
        (prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv k e t p).toLinearMap =
      LinearMap.ker
        (let h := faceReduction_normalForm k e
         originalLiveMap (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
           (reducedFaceBoundary k e) (faceReductionChange k e)
           (faceReductionChangeInv k e) (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e)
           h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p t)
proof:
:= by
  let h := faceReduction_normalForm k e
  let E := prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv k e t p
  apply Submodule.ext
  intro x
  change x ∈ (simplicialBoundaries (e.prefixComplex t) k p).map E.toLinearMap ↔
    x ∈ LinearMap.ker
      (originalLiveMap (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
        (reducedFaceBoundary k e) (faceReductionChange k e)
        (faceReductionChangeInv k e) (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e)
        h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p t)
  rw [Submodule.map_equiv_eq_comap_symm]
  change E.symm x ∈ simplicialBoundaries (e.prefixComplex t) k p ↔ _
  have hc : (prefixChainEquiv k e t p (E.symm x).1).1 = x.1 := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (E.apply_symm_apply x)
  rw [prefixChainEquiv_boundary_iff, hc]
  exact (originalHomology_kernel_eq_boundaries (faceDegree e)
    (faceBoundaryMatrix k e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e)
    (faceReductionChange k e) (faceReductionChangeInv k e)
    (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e) h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1
    h.2.2.2.2.1 p t x).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixCycleToLive_kernel_eq_boundaries
statement:
theorem prefixCycleToLive_kernel_eq_boundaries (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (t p : ℕ) :
    LinearMap.ker (prefixCycleToLive k e t p) =
      simplicialBoundaries (e.prefixComplex t) k p
proof:
:= by
  let h := faceReduction_normalForm k e
  apply Submodule.ext
  intro z
  change (originalLiveMap (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
      (reducedFaceBoundary k e) (faceReductionChange k e)
      (faceReductionChangeInv k e) (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e)
      h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p t)
      (prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv k e t p z) = 0 ↔
    z ∈ simplicialBoundaries (e.prefixComplex t) k p
  have hk := originalHomology_kernel_eq_boundaries (faceDegree e)
    (faceBoundaryMatrix k e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e)
    (faceReductionChange k e) (faceReductionChangeInv k e)
    (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e) h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1
    h.2.2.2.2.1 p t (prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv k e t p z)
  exact hk.trans (prefixChainEquiv_boundary_iff k e t p z).symm

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixCycleToLive_surjective
statement:
theorem prefixCycleToLive_surjective (e : CompatibleOrder f)
    (t p : ℕ) : Function.Surjective (prefixCycleToLive k e t p)
proof:
:= by
  let h := faceReduction_normalForm k e
  intro y
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := originalLiveMap_surjective (faceDegree e)
    (faceBoundaryMatrix k e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e)
    (faceReductionChange k e) (faceReductionChangeInv k e)
    (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e) h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1
    h.2.2.2.2.1 p t y
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv k e t p).surjective x
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  change (originalLiveMap (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e)
    (reducedFaceBoundary k e) (faceReductionChange k e)
    (faceReductionChangeInv k e) (faceBoundaryMatrix_sq_zero k e)
    h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2.1 p t)
    (prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv k e t p z) = y
  rw [hz]
  exact hx

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology_mkQ
statement:
theorem prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology_mkQ (e : CompatibleOrder f) (t p : ℕ)
    (z : simplicialCycles (e.prefixComplex t) k p) :
    prefixQuotientToMatrixHomology k e t p
        (Submodule.mkQ (R := k)
          (M := simplicialCycles (e.prefixComplex t) k p)
          (simplicialBoundaries (e.prefixComplex t) k p) z) =
      Submodule.mkQ (R := k)
        (M := originalCycleSpace (faceDegree e) (faceBoundaryMatrix k e) p t)
        (faceMatrixBoundarySubmodule k e p t) (prefixCycleCoordinateEquiv k e t p z)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.faceTemplatePairs_eq_pivotIndexPairs
statement:
theorem faceTemplatePairs_eq_pivotIndexPairs (e : CompatibleOrder f) (p : ℕ) :
    faceTemplatePairs k e p =
      pivotIndexPairs (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e) p
proof:
:= by
  let h := faceReduction_normalForm k e
  unfold faceTemplatePairs
  rw [← facePivotBarcode_eq_facePrefixBarcode k e p]
  change (facePivotBarcode k e p).filterMap finiteIndexPair = _
  exact pivotBarcode_pairs (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e)
    h.2.2.2.1 p

statement:

    (e : CompatibleOrder f) (p : ℕ) :
    faceTemplateEssential k e p =
      pivotEssentialIndices (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e) p
proof:

  unfold faceTemplateEssential

  change (facePivotBarcode k e p).filterMap essentialIndex = _
  exact pivotBarcode_essential (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e)
    h.2.2.2.1 p

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.evaluatePivotTemplate_eq_dgm
statement:
theorem evaluatePivotTemplate_eq_dgm {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (e : CompatibleOrder f) (g : FilterFunction K β)
    (hg : Monotone (g.value ∘ e.enum)) (p : ℕ) :
    evaluatePivotTemplate k e g hg p = dgm k g p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evaluateFaceTemplate_eq_dgm k e g hg p]
  apply Diagram.ext
  change (((pivotIndexPairs (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e) p).map
      (pairValues g e)).filter (fun q => q.1 ≠ q.2)).map
      (fun q => (q.1, (q.2 : WithTop β))) +
    ((pivotEssentialIndices (faceDegree e) (reducedFaceBoundary k e) p).map
      (birthValue g e)).map (fun b => (b, (⊤ : WithTop β))) = _
  rw [← faceTemplatePairs_eq_pivotIndexPairs k e p,
    ← faceTemplateEssential_eq_pivotEssentialIndices k e p]
  rfl

name: TDA.Persistence.Reduction.evaluatePivotTemplate_order_independent
statement:
theorem evaluatePivotTemplate_order_independent {β : Type*} [LinearOrder β]
    (e₁ e₂ : CompatibleOrder f) (g : FilterFunction K β)
    (h₁ : Monotone (g.value ∘ e₁.enum))
    (h₂ : Monotone (g.value ∘ e₂.enum)) (p : ℕ) :
    evaluatePivotTemplate k e₁ g h₁ p =
      evaluatePivotTemplate k e₂ g h₂ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [evaluatePivotTemplate_eq_dgm k e₁ g h₁ p,
    evaluatePivotTemplate_eq_dgm k e₂ g h₂ p]
